text: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
Enok, Methuselah, Lamekh;
Noah, Shem, Ham leh Japheth.
Japheth tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek leh Tiras ahi uh.
Gomer tapate: Ashkenaz, Riphath, leh Togarmah ahi uh.
Javan tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, leh Rodanim ahi uh.
Ham tapate: Kush, Mizraim, leh Put, Kanaan ahi uh.
Kus tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah leh Sabtekhah ahi uh. Raamah tapate: Seba, leh Dedan ahi uh.
Kush in Nimrod asuang a; amah lei ah mihat ahong hi pan hi.
Mizraim in Ludte, Anamte, Lahabte, Naphtuhte,
Pathruste, Kasluhte, Philistiate hong kipatna leh Kaphtorte asuang hi.
Kanaan in Zidon ata masapen leh Heth asuang a;
Jebus mi, Amor mi, Girgas mi;
Hiv mi, Arki mi, Sin mi.
Arvad mi, Zemar mi leh Hamath mi leng asuang hi.
Shem tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, leh Meshek.
Arpakshad in Shelah asuang a, huan Shelah in Eber asuang hi.
Eber lak ah tapa nih apiang ua: khat pen min Peleg ahi (adam lai in lah lei akikhen ngal a), a-unaupa min Joktan ahi.
Joktan in Almodad, Seleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah;
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah;
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba;
Ophir, Havilah, leh Jobab asuang hi. Hiaite tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
Shem, Arpakshad, Shelah;
Eber, Peleg, Reu;
Serug, Nahor, Terah;
Abram, huai mah Abraham ahi.
Abraham tapate: Isak leh Ishmael ahi.
Hiaite akhang kizopdan uh ahi: Ishmael ta masapen Nebajoth ahi. Huan Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa; Hadad, Tema,
Jetur, Naphish, leh Kedemah. Hiaite Ishmael tapate ahi uh.
Keturah, Abraham mei tapate: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, leh Shuah ahi. Jokshan tapate: Sheba leh Dedan ahi uh.
Midian tapate: Ephah, Epher, Honok, Abida, leh Eldaah ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Keturah suante ahi uh.
Abraham in Isak asuang hi. Isak tapate: Esau leh Israel ahi uh.
Esau tapate: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, leh Korah ahi uh.
Eliphaz tapate: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, leh Amalek ahi uh.
Reuel tapate: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, leh Mizzah ahi uh.
Seir tapate: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezar leh Dishan ahi uh.
Lotan tapate: Hori leh Homam; leh Lotan sanggamnu Timna ahi uh.
Shobal tapate: Alian, Manahath leh Ebal, Shephi leh Onam ahi uh. Huan Zibeon tapate: Aiah leh Anah ahi uh.
Anah tapa Dishon ahi. Dishon tapate: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran leh Keran ahi uh.
Ezer tapate: Bilhan, Zaavan leh Jaakan ahi uh. Dishan tapate: Uz leh Aran ahi uh.
Huchi in hiaite Israel suante tung a vaihawm kumpipate himhim a-om ma ua, Edom gam a vaihawm kumpipate ahi uhi. Beor tapa Bela, akhopi min Dinhabah ahi.
Bela asi a, huchi in Bozrah a Zerah tapa Jobab in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Jobab asi a, Teman mite gam a Husham in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Husham asi a, Bedad, Moab gam a Midian mi thattu, Bedad tapa Hadad in asik in vai ahawm a; akhopi min Avith ahi.
Hadad asi a, huchi in Masrekah mi Samlah in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Samlah asi a, huchi in lui kiang a Rehoboth a Shaul in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Shaul asi a, huchi in Akbor tapa Baal-hanan in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Baal-hanan asi a, asik in Hadad in vai ahawm a, akhopi min Pai ahi; huan azi min Mehetabel, Matred tanu, Mezahab tanu ahi.
Hadad leng asi hi. Edom hausa makaite: hausa makai Timnah, hausa makai Aliah, hausa makai Jetheth,
hausa makai Aholibamah, hausa makai Elah, hausa makai Pinon,
hausa makai Kenaz, hausa makai Teman, hausa makai Mibzar,
hausa makai Magdiel, leh hausa makai Iram; hiaite Edom hausa makaite ahi uhi.
Philistia mite'n Israel adou ua; huchi in Israel mite Philistia mite ma ah ataikek ua, Gilboa tang ah thah in a-om uhi.
Philistia mite'n Saul leh atapate adelh vengveng ua; Philistia mite'n Jonathan, Abinadab leh Malki-shua, Saul tapate athat uhi.
Huchi in kidouna Saul a ding in ahaksa mahmahta a, thalkap mite'n amah aphata uh; huan thalkap mite ziak in alungkham mahmah hi.

Huchih lai in Saul in agalvan popa kiang ah, "Na namsau dokkhia inla, huai in hon dawt pailet in; huchi lou in zaw hiai zeksumlouhte hong pai in bawl louhlouh in ahon bawl kha ding uh," achi a. Himahleh agalvan popa a-ut kei; alau mahmah ngal a. Huaiziak in Saul in anamsau ala a kisiatna in aneita hi.
Agalvan popa'n Saul asita chih atheih in, huai bangmah in ama'n leng anamsau kisiatna in azang a asita hi.
Huchi in Saul asita a, atapa thumte; huan a-inkote tengteng leng asikhawm vek uhi.
Guam a om Israel mite tengteng in sepaihte taikek leh Saul leh atapate asi uh chih amuh un akhopite uh anusia ua, ataikekta uhi. Philistia mite ahong ua huaite ah atengta uhi.
Azingsang in hichi ahi a, thahsate puante suah ding a Philistia mite ahong pai lai un, Gilboa tang ah Saul leh atapate apuk uh chih amu uhi.
Huan amah vante asuah ua, alutang ala ua, agalvan leng, amilimte uh kiang leh mite kiang ah tanchin puak ding in Philistia mite gamsung ah akhak kimvel vek uhi.
Huchi in agalvan apathiante uh inn ah akoih ua, Dagon tempul ah alutang atak uhi.
Jabesh-gilead tengteng in Saul tung a Philistia mite thilhih tengteng azak un,
mihangsante tengteng athou ua, Saul luang leh atapate luang ava lamang ua, Jabesh ah ahon pua ua, Jabesh a tosaw sing nuai ah aguhte uh avui ua, ni sagih an angawl uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA tung a tatlekna hih a, TOUPA thu azuih louh a, dawi zawl aisan siam thu adot ziak in Saul asita hi.
Huai a thu kan a, TOUPA a kipan thu akan louh ziak in: huaiziak in amah athat a, lalgam Jesse tapa David kiang ah apeta hi.
Huchi in Israel tengteng Hebron ah David kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, "Ngai in, na guh leh na sa ka hi uh.

Tuma lam in, Saul mahmah kumpipa ahih lai in, Israel pikhia a pilut nang na hi a; TOUPA na Pathian in na kiang ah, Israel ka mite na vak ding a, ka mite Israel tung ah lal na hi ding hi, hon chi,” achi uhi.

Huchi in Israel Upa tengteng Hebron ah kumpipa kiang ah ahong pai ua; huan David in Hebron ah TOUPA ma ah amau toh thukhun abawlpih a; Samuel khut a TOUPA thu bang in, Israel tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi.
David leh Israel tengteng Jerusalem, huai tuh Jebus ahi a, huai ah ahoh ua; huchi in Jebus mite, huai gam a tengte huai ah a-om uhi.
Huchi in Jebus a tengte'n David kiang ah, "Hiai lam a na hong louh ding ahi," achi ua. Himahleh David in Zion kulh muanhuai ala a; huai mah David khopi ahi.
David in, "Kuapeuh Jebus mite that masa penpen alianpen leh heutu ahi ding," achi a. Huan Zeruiah tapa Joab akuantou masapen a, huchi in amah alianpen a bawl in a-omta hi.
David bel kulh muanhuai ah ateng a; huaiziak in David khopi achi uhi.
Huchi in khopi abawlsuak vek a, Millo kimvel a kipan nangawn in: huchi in Joab in khopi dangte abawlhoih vek hi.
Akiang a sepaihte' TOUPA a-om ziak in, David ahong thupi semsem hi.
Hiaite David neih mihatte lak a amakaipente ahi uh, Israel tungtang a TOUPA thu bang zel a, amah kumpipa dia bawl ding a, Israel tengteng toh, agamsung a amah lak a ahatna uh taklangte.
Hiai David in aneih mihatte zah ahi: Jashobeam, Hakmon mi tapa, sawmthumte lak a makai lianpen; zathumte dou ding in ateipi alek a khatvei thu in amaute athat hi.
Amah nung in Dodo tapa Eleazar, Ahoh mi, mihat thumte lak a khat ahi hi.
Pasdammim ah David kiang ah a-om a, huai ah kidou tum in Philistia mite akikhawm ua, barli buh a dimna mun ah; Philistia mite ma a kipan in mite ataikekta uhi.
Huchi in huai mun laitak ah adingh ua, ahum ua, Philistia mite athat uhi; TOUPA'N zohna thupitak in amaute ahondamta hi.
Heutu lian sawmthumte lak a thum suangpi a David kiang ah, Adullam kokhuk ah ahohsuk uhi; Philistia mite tampite'n Rephaim Phaizang ah puanin akai uhi.
Huai lai in David bel kohawm sung ah a-om a, Philistia mite kulhpi bel Bethlehem ah a-om hi.
Huchi in David in tui alunggulh a, "Aw kongpi kiang a om, Bethlehem tuileh tui dawn ding a hong pia mi khat omleh chi na ing e!" achi hi.

Huai thumte'n Philistia mite tampi lak aphu paisuak ua, kongpi kiang a om, Bethlehem tuileh a kipan tui ava tawi ua, ahon la ua, David kiang ahon tun uhi: himahleh David in adawn nuam kei a, TOUPA a ding in abungkhe zaw hi.

Hiai ka hih, ka Pathian in hon phal kei hen: ahinna uh lauhuaina a koih hiai mite sisan ka dawn ding hia? Amaute'n lah ahinna uh lauthawnna toh hon tawi uh ahi ngal ua,” achi hi. Huaiziak in adawn nuamta kei hi. Hiai thilte huai mihat thumte'n ahih uh ahi.
Abishai, Joab unaupa, huai thumte lak a khat ahi: ama'n zathumte dou ding in ateipi alik a amaute athat a, mi thumte lak ah min aneita hi.
Thumte lak ah, nihte sang in, amah azahtakhuai zaw hi, huchi in aheutupa ding ua bawl in a-om hi: hita mahleh thum masate zaw apha kei.
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kabzeel a mihangsan, thilhih thupite hihpa tapa, Moab a Ariel tapate nihte athat a: apaisuk lai a, vuk kiak lai in kokhuk lak ah humpinelkai athat hi.

Aigupta mi athat a, milian mahmah, tong nga a sang; huan Aigupta mi khut a ateipi siamganmi chiam bang ahi; huchi in akiang ah chiangkhun toh ahohsuk a, Aigupta mi khut a kipan teipi ala a, amah mah teipi in ahihlumta hi.
Hiai thilte Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in ahih a, huchi in huai mihat thumte lak ah min anei hi.
Ngai in, sawmthumte sang in zahtakhuaizaw in a-om a, himahleh thum masate zaw apha kei, huchi in David in agalvil heutu in amah akoih hi.
Sepaih pawlte a mihatte: Joab unaupa Asahel, Bethlehem a Dodo tapa Elhanan;
Haror mi Shammoth, Pelon mi Helez;
Tekoa mi Ikkesh tapa Ira, Antoth mi Abiezer.
Husat mi Sibbekai, Ahoh mi Ilai;
Netophah mi Maharai, Netophah mi Baanah tapa Heled;
Benjamin tate Gibeah a Ribai tapa Ithai, Pirathon mi Benaiah;
Gaash luitate a Hurai, Arbath mi Abiel.
Baharum mi Azmaveth, Saalbon mi Eliahba;
Gizon mi Hasem tapate, Harar mi Shage tapa Jonathan;
Harar mi Sakar tapa Ahiam, Ur tapa Eliphal;
Mekerath mi Hepher, Pelon mi Ahijah;
Karmel mi Hezro, Ezbai tapa Naarai;
Nahtan unaupa Joel, Hageri tapa Mibhar.
Ammon mi Zelek, Beroth mi Naharai, Joab galvan pomi Zeruiah tapa;
Ithri mi Ira, Ithri mi Gareb;
Hit mi Uriah, Ahlai tapa Zabad;
Reuben mi Shiza tapa Adina, Reuben mite lak a makai lianpen leh akiang a sawmthumte.
Maakah tapa Hanan, Mithni mi Josaphat;
Asterath mi Uzzia, Aroer mi Hotham tapate Shama leh Jehiel,
Shimri tapa Jediael, Tiz mi a-unaupa Joha;
Mahavi mi Eliel leh Jeribai, leh Elnaam tapate Joshaviah, Moab mi Ithmah;
Eliel, Obed leh Mezoba mi Jaasiel ahi uh.
Huchi in hiaite Kish tapa Saul ziak a akihepmang lai a Ziklag a David kiang a hong paite ahi uh: huchi in kidouna a amah panpih mite mihatte lak ah a-om uhi.
Thalte in akigalthuam ua, suangkap leh thalpeu a thalkap ah khut taklam leh veilam azang thei ua; amaute Saul unau, Benjamin a kipan ahi uhi.
Amakaipen Ahiezer ahi, huan Joash, Gibeah mi Shemaah tapate: Azmaveth tapate Jeziel leh Pelet; Berkah, Antoth mi Jehu;
Gibeon mi Ishmaiah, sawmthumte lak a mihat, sawmthumte tung ah; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan leh Geerath mi Jozabad;
Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah leh Haruph mi Shephatiah;
Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer leh Korahith mi Jashobeam;
Gedor mi Jeroham tapate Joelah leh Zebadiah ahi uh.
Gad mite ahihleh gamdai a kulh ah David lam ah akituamseh ua, mihangsan, kidouna a dia chilsa, lum leh teipi khoih theite; amaitang uh humpinelkaite maitang bang, mual a sazate bang a kin;
Ezer apipen, azom in Obadiah, Eliab athumna;
Mishmannah alina, Jeremiah angana;
Attai agukna, Eliel asagihna;
Johanan agiatna, Elzabad akuana;
Jeremiah asawmna, Makbannai asawm-le-khatna.
Hiai Gad tapate lak ate sepaihte heutute ahi uh: aneupen zakhat toh akikim a, alianpen pen sangkhat toh.
Hiaite Jordan lui piaute tui in atup lai a, akha khatna a kan a paite ahi ua; huchi in phaizang a om tengteng, suahlam leh tumlam tuaktuak, delhzakte ahi uh.
Benjamin leh Judah tate lak a mi, kulh ah David kiang ah ahong uhi.

Huchi in amaute tuak ding in David apaikhia a, amaute kiang ah, "Hon panpih dia lemna deih a ka kiang a hong na hih ualeh, nou a ding in ka lungtang phankhawm ahi ding; himahleh ka khut ah bangmah hiamgamna a-om kei chih thei a, ka galte a dia kei hon man ding a hong pai na hih uleh, ka pipute uh Pathian in huai en henla, sal hen," achi hi.

Huai lai in sawmthumte lak a amakai lianpenpa, Amasai tung ah kha ahong tung a, "Nang David, Jesse tapa, nang a, nang lam a pang ka hi uh: na kiang ah muanna om henla, nang hon panpih mite kiang ah muanna: na Pathian in lah nang ahon panpih ngal a,” achi hi. Huai lai in David in amaute ana kipahpih a, pawl heutute ding in abawlta hi.

Manasseh a kipan in leng khenkhatte, hong taikhia in kidouna a Saul dou ding a Philistia mite toh hong pai in David lam ah ahong belh ua; himahleh amaute'n amaute apanpih kei uh. Philistia mite toupate'n thu hilh in amah asawlmang ngal ua, i lupente uh lauthawnghuaina ding in, "Saul, heutupa lam ah apukmang ding," chi in.
Ziklag a David ahoh in, Manasseh a kipan amah lam ah hong puklut a-om ua, Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikael, Jozabad, Elihu, Zilthai, Manasseh a kipan sangkhatte heutute ahi uhi.
Huan galguk bawlte dou ding in David apanpih uh; amau lah mihat hangsante leh sepaih lak a heutute ahi ngal ua.
Sepaih pawl thupi, Pathian sepaih pawl bang a hong hih masiah uh niteng in David kiang ah amah panpih ding in ahong paikhawm uhi.
Hiaite TOUPA thu bang a Saul gam amah a dia bawl dia kidou ding kigalthuamte huaite lupente Hebron a David kiang a hong paite ahi uhi.
Judah tate lum leh teipi tawi theite sangguk-le-zagiat, kidou ding a kigalthuam.
Simeon tate ah kidouna ding a, mihat hangsante, sangsagih-le-zakhat.
Levi tate ah sangli-le-zaguk.
ehoiada bel Aaron inkote pipa ahi a, amah toh sangthum-le-zasagih a-om uhi;
Tangval hat hangsan, Zadok leh apa inkote heutu sawmnih-le-nih.
Benjamin tate, Saul unaute, sangthum: amaute lak a thupi penpente Saul inkote lam ah aginom lailai uhi.
Ephraim tate ah singnih-le-zagiat, mihat hangsan, apipute uh inkote a miminthangte.
Manasseh nam kimkhatte singkhat-le-sanggiat, hong a, David kumpipa a bawl dia, min genkhiakte.
Issakar tate, hunte theihsiamna nei mite, Israel in bang ahih dia chih thei ding; amaute lupente zanih ahi uh; huan a-unaute tengteng uh amau thupiak in a-om uhi.
Zebulun a kipan, sepaih pawl kuankhe theite bang, kidouna van chi chih toh kigalthuamsa singnga; kidou ding a kigalthuamsa, lungsim thuah nih nei lou mite.
Naphtali a kipan heutu sangkhat, amaute kiang ah lum leh teipi tawi singthum-le-sangsagih.
Dan mite kidou ding a kigal thuamsa, singnih sanggiat-le-zaguk.
Asher a kipan, sepaih pawl akuankhe thei, kidou ding a kigalthuamsa singli.
Jordan lehlam gal ah, Reuben mite leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte a kipan, kidouna a ding a kidouna vanzat chi chih toh nuaikhat-le-singnih.

Hiaite tengteng, kidoumi ngen hi in, kidou ding a kigalthuamsa, lungtang bukim toh Hebron ah David, Israel tengteng tung a kumpipa dia bawl ding in ahong pai ua: David kumpipa a bawl ding in Israel dang tengteng in lungkhat apu chiat uhi.
Huchi in huai ah David kiang a, ne leh dawn in, ni thum a-om uh; a-unaute un lah amau a ding in kisakna abawl ngal ua.

Huai ban ah Issakar, Zebulun leh Naphtali tanpha a teng amau kiangnai a omte'n, sabiltungte leh sangawngsaute leh sakol neute leh bawngtalte in tanghou ahon pua ua, an nek ding, theipi gah beute, grep minbomte, uain leh sathau, atam a tam bawngtalte leh belamte: Israel nopsakna thupi ahi.
Huchi in David in heutu leh makai chiteng, sangte leh zate heutute toh thu akikum uhi.

David in Israel kikhawmte tengteng kiang ah, "Hoih na sak ua, TOUPA i Pathian ua kipan ahihleh, mun chiteng a Israel gam tengteng nutsiat a om i unaute kiang ah thu i khak ding ua, loupa munte nei akhopite ua akiang ua siampute leh Levi mite om, huchi a i kiang a ahong kikhopkhawm theihna ding un.
Huchi in i Pathian uh bawm i lakik nawn ding uhi; Saul hun lai in i na zong kei uhi," achi hi.
Kikhawmpi tengteng in huchibang in i hih ding uh achi ua: mi tengteng mit ah huai thil dik ahi ngal a.
Huchi in David in Israel tengteng Aigupta gam luita Shihor a kipan Hamath lutna chiang pha in, Kiriath- jearim a kipan a Pathian bawm va la ding in amite akaikhawm hi.
Huchi in David, Israel tengteng toh, Baalah huai bel, Kiriath-jearim ah ahi, huai tuh Judah gam ahi a, huai a kipan a Pathian, TOUPA Cherubte tung a tupa, aminlohna om va la ding in akuantou hi.
Pathian bawm kangtalai thak in apua ua, Abinadab inn a kipan alakhia ua: huchi in Uzza leh Ahio in ahawl uhi.
Huchi in David leh Israel tengteng Pathian ma ah ahatna tengteng un late, kaihgingte, pekging gui sawm neite, khuangtate, dakkhutbette leh pengkulte toh lopna bawl in a-om uhi.
Huan Chidon buhchilna phual ahong tun un, bawngtalte akisuih man un, Uzza in bawm len ding in akhut in asawk hi.
Uzza tung ah TOUPA hehna asouta a, bawm a akhut akhoih ziak in, amah ahihlumta hi: huchi in Pathian ma ah asita hi.
TOUPA Uzza tung a apuahkhap ziak in, David alungkim kei hi: huchi in huai lai tuni tan in, Perez-uzzah achita hi.
Huai ni in David in Pathian akihta a, bangchi in Pathian bawm inn ka kitun thei dia? chi in.
Huchi in ama'n akiang a, David khopi sung ah bawm apolut kei a, Git mi Obed-edom insung ah apolut zawta hi.
Pathian bawm bel kha thum Obed-edom inkote kiang ah insung ah a-om a: huchi in TOUPA'N Obed-edom leh aneih tengteng avualzawlta hi.
Huchi in Tura kumpipa Hiram in David kiang ah sawltak mite asawl a, sidar singte, suangsek mite, khutsiam mite, inn lamsak ding in.
David in Israel tung ah TOUPA'N amah kumpipa in akoihkipta chih athei a, agam lah, ami Israelte, sangpi a tawisang in a-omta hi.
David in Jerusalem ah zite tamsem api a: huchi in David in tapate leh tanute tamsem asuangta hi.
Hiaite Jerusalem a aneih tate minte ahi; Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon;
Ibhar, Elishua, Elpalet;
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia;
Elishama, Beeliada, Eliphalet.
Philistia mite'n Israel tengteng tung ah kumpipa a David thaunilh ahi chih azak un, David zong ding in Philistia mite tengteng akuantou ua: David in huai azak in, amaute dou ding in akuankheta hi.
Philistia mite ahong ua, Rephaim Phaizang atuam uhi.
Huchi in David in Pathian adong a, "Philistia mite dou ding in ka kuantou diam? Amau ka khut ah na hon pe diam?" chi in. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Kuantou in; na khut a amaute hon pe ding ka hi," achi hi.

Huchi in Baal-perazim ah ahong tou ua, David in amau athat a; huchi in David in, "Pathian in tui khah bang in ka khut in ka melmate ahihsia," achi a. Huaiziak in huai mun min ding in Baal-perazim asa hi.
Huai ah apathiante uh anusia ua; David in thupiak apia a, mei in ahal uhi.
Huchih nung in Philistiate'n phaizang atuam nawn lai uhi.
David in Pathian thu adong nawn a; Pathian in akiang ah, "Amau delh ding in na kuantou kei ding: amau kihei mangsan inla, singtheimi singte zawntak ah amau sual in,” achi hi.
"Singthei mi singte dawn a taiging na zak chiang in; huai chiang in kidou ding in na kuankhe ding hi: Philistia mihonte that ding in na ma ah Pathian akuankheta chihna ahi ding hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Pathian in amah thu apiak bang in David in ahih a: Gibeon a kipan Gezer pha in Philistia mihonpi athatta uhi.
Huan gam tengteng ah David min athangkheta a; huchi in TOUPA'N nam tengteng tung ah amah launa atungsakta hi.
Huchi in David khopi sung ah David in innte akibawl a; Pathian bawm a ding in mun abawl a, puanin akaihsakta hi.
Huai lai in David in, "Levi mite chih louh kuamah in Pathian bawm apo ding ahi kei: TOUPA'N lah amau Pathian bawm po ding leh tangtawn a amah nna sepsak ding in amaute ana telta ngal a," achi hi.
Amun abawlsaksa a TOUPA bawm hon latou ding in, David in Jerusalem ah Israel tengteng akaikhawmta hi.
Huchi in David in Aaron tapate leh Levi mite akhawm a;
Kohath tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Uriel leh a-unaute za-le-sawmnih;
Merrari tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Asaiah leh a-unaute zanih-le-sawmnih;
Gershom tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Joel leh a-unaute za-le-sawmthum;
Elizaphan tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Shemaiah leh a-unaute zanih;
Hebron tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Eliel leh a-unaute sawmgiat;
Uzziel tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Amminadab leh a-unaute za-le-sawm-le-nih.
David in Zadok leh Abiathar siampute, Levi mite, Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel leh Amminadab asamsak a,
akiang uah, "Noute Levi mite pipute inkuan a lupente na hi ua: kihihsiang unla, nou leh na unaute uh, mun ka bawlsaksa a Israel' Pathian, TOUPA bawm na laktheihna ding un.
Atung a pan hih ding achih bang a amah i zon louh ziak un, i tung uah TOUPA i Pathian apuakzak hi," achi hi.
Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite, Israel' Pathian, TOUPA bawm latou ding in akisiangsak uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA thu bangbang a Mosi in thu apiak bang in Levi tate'n aliangzang uah huai a chiangtawnte in Pathian bawm azawngta uhi.
David in Levi mi makaipente kiang ah a-unaute uh lasa mite tumging theihte toh, pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte leh dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ging leh nuamsa a aw suah ding sep ding in ahilh hi.
Huchi in Levi mite'n Joel tapa Heman asep ua; a-unaute lak ah, Asaph Berekiah tapa; huan Merari tapate a-unaute uh lak ah, Kusaiah tapa Ethan;
amau toh a-unaute uh pawl nihnate, Zekariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, kongkhak ngak mite.
Huchi in lasami, Heman, Asaph, Ethente seh in a-omta ua, ngaihtak a tum ding, dal dakkhutbette toh;
Zekariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, Benaiah, pekging gui sawm neite Alamoth toh kituak a bawl toh;
Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mineiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, Azaziah, kaihgingte Sheminith toh bawl, makai ding in.
Huan Kenaniah, Levi mite lak a amakai lianpen, lapu in apang a: asiam ziak in, la hilh in apang hi.
Berekiah leh Elkanah bawm a dia kongkhak ngak mite in a-om uhi.
Shebaniah, Josaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zekariah, Benaiah, Eliezer, siampute'n, Pathian bawm ma ah pengkulte amut ua: Obed-edom leh Jehiah tuh bawm a dia kongkhak ngakte ahi uhi.
Huan David leh Israel Upa, sangte tung a heutute, Obed-edom inn a kipan TOUPA'N thukhun bawm latou ding in nuamsatak in akuanta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in TOUPA bawm zawng Levi mite apanpih ziak in, amau bawngtal sagih leh belamtal sagih in akithoih uhi.
David, puanmalngat hoih puanaktual in akizem a, bawm zawng Levi mi tengteng leh lasa mite leh la heutupa Kenaniah lasa mite toh, huchi in David in puanmalngat siampu lian puanak asilh hi.
Huchibang in Israel tengteng in TOUPA thukhun bawm kikou kawm leh pengkul ging binei toh, pengkulte toh, dakkhutbette toh pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte ngaihtak a ging toh, ahon latouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA thukhun bawm David khopi ahong tun in, Saul tanu Mikal tohlet ah adakkhia a, David lam leh mawl amuta a; alungtang in amusit hi.
Huchi in Pathian bawm ahon lalut ua, David in abawlsak, puanin laizang ah akoihta ua, Pathian ma ah halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
David in halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alat khit in TOUPA min in mite avualzawl hi.
Israel michih kiang ah, pasal leh numei michih kiang ah tanghou beu khat, sa bak khat leh grep min gaw beu khat ahawm hi.
Huchi in TOUPA bawm mai a nasem ding leh TOUPA, Israel' Pathian kipahpih ding, kipahthu gen ding leh phat ding in Levi mite lak a kuate hiam asepta hi:
Amakai lianpen Asaph, amah zom in Zekariah, Shemiramoth, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte toh; Asaph dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ging toh;
Benaiah leh Jahaziel siampute Pathian thukhun bawm ma a, om nilouhte toh.
Huchi in huai ni in David in, Asaph leh a-unaute khut ah, TOUPA kiang a kipahthute gen ding ahihkip masa penpen hi.
Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthute gen unla, amin lou un; mite lak ah athilhihte theisak un.
Amah mai ah la sa unla, phatna late sa un; anasep lamdangte tengteng thu in houlim un.
Amin siangthou suang unla: TOUPA zongte lungtang kipak hen.
TOUPA leh ahatna zong unla; amel zong nilouh un.
Ahih khitsa athillamdangte theigige unla; alamdannate leh, akam a vaihawmte;
Aw nou asikha Israel chi, nou amitel, Jakob tate.
Amah TOUPA i Pathian ahi: ama'n leitung pumpi vai ahawm hi.
Tangtawn in athukhun theigige unla, suan sangkhatte kiang a apiak athu;
Thukhun Abraham toh abawl, Isak kiang a athuchiam;
Huai mah dan thuseh ding in Jakob kiang ah ahihkip a, Israel kiang ah tangtawn thukhun ding in;
"Na kiang ah Kanaan gam, na goutan tuan, ka hon pe ding," chi in;
Mi tawmchik phet na hih lai un; ahi, tawmchik mahmah, asung a mikhual in;
Nam dangdang kiang ah abanhoh ua, gam dangdang a kipan in mi tuamtuamte kiang ah.
Kuamah nuaisiah aphal kei a; ahi, amaute ziak in kumpipate leng asal hi;
"Ka thaunilhte khoih kei unla, ka zawlneite leng hihna kei un," chi in.
Leitung luahte tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la sa unla, niteng in ahotdamna thu theisak un.
Namte lak ah athupidan gen unla, michihte lak ah athilhih lamdangte genzak un.
TOUPA lah athupi a, nakpi mahmah a phat ding ahih ziak in pathian tengteng sang a kihtak ding ahi.
Michih pathiante milim ahi ua; TOUPA'N bel vante abawl hi.
Pahtawina leh thupina ama ah a-om a; hatna leh kilawmna ama mun ah a-om hi.
Michih a chichihte aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA thupina leh hatna pia un.
TOUPA amin thupina pia unla, thillat ding tawi unla, ama ah hong pai un; siangthou kilawmna in TOUPA bia un.
Leitung tengteng aw, ama ah ling un; khovel leng alin theihlouhna ding in hihkip in a-om hi.
Vante kipaktak in om uhenla, leitung leng nuamsatak in om hen; namte lak ah "TOUPA'N vai ahawm," chi uhen.
Tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng ging honhon henla; gam leh asung a om tengteng kipaktak in om hen;
Huai hun chiang in gamnuai a sing tengteng in TOUPA ma ah nuamsa in la asa ding ua, leitung vaihawm ding in ahong pai sin ngal a.
Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un, amah lah ahoih ngal a; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
"Aw, ka hotdamna uh Pathian, hon hondam inla, na min siangthou phat ding leh na phatna suang ding in, namte lak a kipan hon pikhawm inla, hon humbit in," chi un.
Israel' Pathian TOUPA phat in om hen, tangtawn a kipan tangtawn dong in. Mipi tengteng in, Amen, chi in TOUPA aphatta uhi.
Huchi in huai a TOUPA thukhun bawm ma a niteng a akuldan bang zel a nasem ding in Asaph leh a- unaute akoihta a;
Obed-edom leh a-unau uh sawmguk-le-giatte toh; Jeduthun tapa Obed-edom leh Hosah bel kongkhak ngakmi ahi uhi;
Huan Zadok siampu leh a-unaute siampute, Gibeon a om mun sang a TOUPA biakbuk ma a,
zingsang leh nitak a halmang thillat maitam tung a TOUPA a dia halmang thillatte lan gige ding in, Israel kiang ah thupiak a piak TOUPA, dan sung a kigelh dungzui in;
Azahngaihna tangtawn a a-om ziak in TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen ding Heman leh Jeduthun leh midang min loh a telkhiakte toh;
Heman leh Jeduthun in Pathian lasakna dia vanzatte, pengkulte leh dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ginsak dingte anei ua; kongkhak ngakmi ding Jeduthun tapate toh.
Huchi in mipi tengteng amau inn lam chiat ah apaita ua; huan David leng a-inkote vualzawl ding in apai sam hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, David a-inn a a-om lai in zawlnei Nathan kiang ah David in, "Ngai in, kei sidar sing inn ah ka om a, himahleh TOUPA thukhun bawm puanzak nuai maimah ah a-om a," achi hi.
Nathan in David kiang ah, "Na lungsim a na vei bangtak in hih in; Pathian na kiang ah lah a-om ngal a," achi hi.
Huai zan mah in hichi ahong hi a, Nathan kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi,
"Ka sikha David va hilh in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ka omna ding in nang inn na hon lamsak ding ahi kei;
Israel suante Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak a kipan tutan in inn lam ah ka om kei a; puanin leh biakbuk ah ka om zel hi.
Israel tengteng toh ka paina himhim uah leng ka mite vak ding a thu ka piak Israelte vaihawmte kiang ah, bangziak a sidar sing inn hon lamsak lou, ka chi ngei a hia?'
"Huaiziak in ka sikha David kiang ah huchi in gen in, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, belam tatna mun a kipan na belamching lai ka mi Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in ka hon la a;
na paina peuhmah ah na kiang ah ka om zel a, na melmate ka hon hihmansak zel hi; lei a mithupi mahmahte bang in min thupitak ka hon bawlsak sin hi.

Ka mi Israelte a ding in mun ka sepsak ding a, kisuan nawn lou a amau tuam mun a a-om gige theihna ding un amaute ka phutkip ding a, tuma lam a bang in, migiloute'n amaute ahihgenthei nawn kei ding uh;
ka mi Israelte tung a vaihawmte ka seh hun a kipan. Huan na melma tengteng leng ka zahlaksak lai ding hi. Huai lou leng TOUPA'N inn khat ahon lamsak lai ding chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Huchi in na ni abei a, na pi-le-pute kiang a na pai hun chiang in, hichi ahi ding a, na nung a na suan na tapate lak a mi ka tungding ding a; agam ka hihkip ding hi.
Ama'n inn ahon lamsak ding a; alaltutphah tangtawn in ka hihkip ding.
Huchi in apa ka hi ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding; ka zahngaihna na ma a ompa a kipan a ka lakmang bang in, amah zaw ka lamang kei ding hi;
Ka inn ah leh ka gam ah amah tangtawn in ka dingkipsak ding a, alaltutphah tangtawn a hihkip ahi ding," chi in.
Huai thute tengteng leh huai kilakna bang geih in Nathan in David kiang ah agen hi.
Huchi in kumpipa David alut a, TOUPA ma ah atu a, "Aw TOUPA Pathian, kua ahia ka hih a, ka inkote leng kua ahia ahih ua, hichi tantan na hon pi?

Aw Pathian, huaite leng nang mitmuh in thil neuchik phet zaw ahi a; himahleh aw TOUPA Pathian, na sikha inkuan hong omdan ding thu kum tampi sung a ding na na genta a, milian bang in na hon sep lai a, aw TOUPA Pathian.
Na sikha pahtawi a a-om tungtang thu ah David in na kiang ah bang agen tuan nawn dia? Na sikha lah na theitel mahmah hi.
Aw TOUPA na sikha ziak in nangmah lungsim a pawt bang zel in hiai thil thupi mahmah theisak ding in thil thupi mahmahte na hihta hi.
Aw TOUPA ka theih un nang bang mahmah a-om kei ua, nang lou ngal Pathian himhim leng a-om sam kei hi.

Aigupta gam a kipan na tatkhiak a na mite ma a namdangte zahlaksak a, thil thupitak leh lauhuaitak hih a min thupitak bawlsak ding a Pathian in amah mite a dia ahon tatkhiak na mi Israelte bang mahmah leitung ah namdang kua a-om ua?
Na mi Israelte tangtawn a na mite ding in lah na bawlta ngal a; nang TOUPA amaute Pathian na hita hi.
"Huchi in aw TOUPA, na sikha tungtang thu leh a-inkote tungtang thu na gen tangtawn a ding in hihkip inla, na gensa bang in hih in.
Tangtawn in na min hihkip leh hihlet in om hen, 'Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian, Israelte a dia Pathian mahmah ahi,' na sikha David inkote na ma ah hihkip in om uhen," chi in.
"Aw nang ka Pathian, na sikha kiang ah inkuan na dingsak ding chih na na puangta ngal a; huaiziak in na sikha in na kiang ah ka thum ngam lai ahi.
Aw TOUPA, nang zaw Pathian na hi a, hiai thil hoih na sikha na chiamta hi.
Na sikha inkote na ma a tangtawn a a-om gige theihna ding un na vualzawl a; aw TOUPA, na vualzawl zaw tangtawn a vualzawlna ahi,” achi hi.
Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David in Philistia mite asual a, azou a, Gath khua leh akhotate Philistia mite asuhsak hi.
Moabte asual nawn a, Moab mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah ape zel uhi.
Euphrates Luipi a agam kipsak ding a David apai kawm in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer leng Hamath chin ah asual nawn hi.
Huchi in David in kangtalai sangkhat leh sakol tungtuangmi sangsagih leh sepaih singnih amatsak a; David in kangtalai kaimi sakol tengteng thagui asattansak a, kangtalai zakhat kai ding bel ahawi hi.
Huan Damaskas a Siria mite Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer huh ding in ahong kuan ua, David in Siria mi singnih-le-sangnih athat hi.
Huchi in David in Damaskas a Siria mite lak ah asepaihte akoih a; huchi in Siria mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah ape zel uhi.
David in Hadadezer pawlte dangka-eng lumte alaksak a, Jerusalem ah apaipih hi.
Hadadezer khua Tibhath leh Chun a kipan David in dal tampi apua a, huaite in Solomon in dal lohte, atunnate, dal tui-um belsuante abawl hi.
Huchi in Hamath kumpipa Tou in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer sepaih tengteng David in azou chih azak in,

Hadadezer asim a, athah ziak a chibai buk ding leh kipahpih ding in David kiang ah atapa Hadoram asawl a; Hadadezer leh Toute lah kidou sek ahi ngal ua; dangka-eng leh dangkasik leh dal tui-um belsuan chi chih leng atawisak lai hi.
Hiaite leng David in namdang azoh tengteng Edom, Moab, Ammon suante, Philistiate, leh Amalekte lak a pan dangkasik leh dangka-eng alakte toh TOUPA kiang ah alan hi.
Huai lou leng, Zeruiah tapa Abishai in Edomte singkhat-le-sanggiat Chi Phaizang ah athat hi.
Edom gam ah sepaihte akoih a; huchi in Edom mi tengteng David sikhate ahong hita uh. TOUPA'N David apaina peuh ah azousak zel hi.
Huchi in David in Israel mi tengteng tung ah vai ahawm a; ami tengteng tung ah diktattak in vai ahawm hi.
Zeruiah tapa Joab bel sepaih heutupen ahi a; Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat bel tanchin gelhpa ahi.
Ahitub tapa Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Abimelek bel siampu ahi ua, huan Shavsha bel laigelhmi ahi a;
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah bel Kereth mi leh Pelet mite heutu ahi a, David tapate bel kumpipa kim a heutu lian ahi uhi.
Huan huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Ammon suante kumpipa Nahash asi a, asik in atapa in vai ahawm hi.

David in, "Apa'n hon na hehpih zel ziak in ke'n leng Nahash tapa Hanun ka hehpih sam ding," achi a. Huchi in David in apa tungtang thu a lungmuan ding in mite asawl hi. Huan David mite Ammon suante gam ah Hanun kiang ah amah lungmuan ding in ava tung uhi.

Himahleh Ammon suan heutute'n Hanun kiang ah, "David in na pa azahtak ziak a lungmuan ding mi na kiang a hon sawl hi in na gingta a hia? Amite gam hihse ding a enchian leh enkhe ding a na kiang a hong pai ahi khamoh ding uam maw?" achi uhi.
Huchi in Hanun in David mite aman a, akhamul uh ametmaisak a, huan apuansilhte uh alaitak ah atobou uh khuhpha minmen in atansak a, apaisakta hi.

Huchi in kuate hiam in amite ana hihdan David ava hilh ua. Huan adawn ding in mi asawl a; amau lah azum mahmah ngal uhi. Kumpipa'n, "Na khamul uh asau nawn ma Jeriko ah om unla, huai zoh chiang in hong kik un," achi hi.

Huchi in Ammon suante'n David zakdah lam ana hihta uh chih akitheih un, Hanun leh Ammon suante'n Mesopotamia gam a mite, Siria-maakah a mite, Zobah a mite, kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite goihna ding in dangkasik talent sangkhat akhak uhi.
Huchi in kangtalai singthum-le- sangnih, Maakah kumpipa leh amite toh api ua, Medeba kiang ah panmun abawlta uhi. Ammon suante akhua ua kipan apawtkhia ua, akikaikhawm ua, kidou ding in akuanta uhi.
David in huai azak in, Joab leh sepaih hangsante tengteng asawlkhia hi.
Ammon suante ahong kuan ua, khopi kongpi chin ah akiphalh ua, kumpipa amau thu a hong kuante atuam in loubuk ah a-om uhi.
Huchi in amalam leh nunglam ah ahon sual dek uh chih Joab in atheih in Israel mite lak a mi teltuamte atelkhia a, Siria mite sual ding in akizalh uhi.
Midang tengteng bel a-unaupa Abishai khut ah akoih vek a, Ammon suante sual ding in amau leng akizalh uhi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Siria mite ka zoh kei dekleh, hon panpih in; Ammon suante na zoh kei dekleh ka hon panpih ding.
Hangsantak in om unla, i mite leh i Pathian khuate hum in i kipasalsak ding uh; TOUPA'N hoih asak bang zel in hih hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Joab leh akiang a mite'n kidouna mun a Siria mite ava naih ua; huchi in ama ah ataikekta uhi.
Ammon suante'n Siria mite ataikek uh chih atheih un amau leng a-unaupa Abishai ma ah ataikekta ua, khua ah alut uhi. Huchi in Joab Jerusalem ah apaita hi.
Siria mite'n Israelte ma ah apang thei kei uh chih ana theih un, mi asawl ua, Lui khen lam a Siria pawlte asamkhia ua, Hadadezer sepaih heutu Shophak bel aheutupen uh ahi.
Huai thu David ahilh ua; ama'n Israel mi tengteng asamkhawm a, Jordan lui akan ua, ava mu ua, sual ding in akiphalh uhi. Huchi in Siriate kidoupih dia David akisak khit in amah akidoupihta uhi.
Siria mite bel Israelte ma ah ataikek ua; David in Siria mi, kangtalai sangsagih tung a tuang leh sepaih singli athat a, sepaih heutu Shophak leng athat hi.
Huchi in Hadadezer mite'n Israelte ma ah apang theita kei uh chih atheih un, David toh kilemna abawl ua, asikhate ding in a-omta uh; Siria mite'n leng Ammon suante apanpih nuamta kei uhi.
Hiaite Israel tapate ahi uh: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakar, Zebulun;
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad leh Asher.
Judah tapate: Er, Onan leh Shelah; huaite Shuah tanu Kanaan nu a kipan amah lak a piang thumte ahi uh. Huan TOUPA mitmuh in Judah ta masapen Er agi kei a; amah athat hi.
Huchi in Tamar atapa zi in Perez leh Zerah asuansak hi. Judah tapate tengteng nga ahi uh.
Perez tapate: Hezron leh Hamul ahi uh.
Huan Zerah tapate: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Dara: avek un nga ahi uh.
Huan Karmi tapate: Akar, thil siangthou a talekpa, Israel hihbuaipa.
Huan Ethan tapa Azariah ahi.
Hezron, amah lak a piangte leng; Jerahmeel, Ram leh Kelubai.
Huan Ram in Amminadab asuang a; Amminadab in Nahson, Judah suante lal asuang hi.
Nahson in Salma asuang a, Salma in Boaz asuang;
Boaz in Obed asuang a, Obed in Jesse asuang hi.
Jesse in ata masapen Eliab, anihna Abinadab leh athumna Shimea asuang;
alina Nethaneel, angana Raddai;
agukna Ozem, asagihna David.
Huan asanggamnute uh Zeruiah leh Abigail ahi uh. Huchi in Zeruiah tapate: Abishai, Joab leh Asahel, thum ahi uh.
Abigail in Amasa asuang a, huan Amasa pa Ishmael mi Jether ahi.
Huan Jezron tapa Kaleb in Azubah azi leh Jerioth lak ah tate asuang a; hiaite atapate ahi: Jesher leh Shobab leh Ardon.
Azubah asi a, Kaleb in amah a ding in Ephrath api a, huai in Hur aneihsak hi.
Hur in Uri asuang a, Uri in Bezaleel asuang hi.
Huai nung in Gilead pa Makir tanu kiang ah Hezron alut a; huai zi dia api lai in kum sawmguk a upa ahi; ama'n Segub asuansak hi.
Segub in, Gilead gam a khopi sawmnih-le-thum nei Jair, asuansak hi.
Ama'n amau a kipan Kenath leh huai a khoneite, khopi sawmguk toh Geshur, Aramin leh Jair khuate ala hi. Hiaite tengteng Gilead pa Makir tapate a ahi uh.
Huai nung in Kaleb-ephrathah ah Hezron asi a, huchi in Hezron zi Abia in Tekoa pa Ashur asuansak hi.
Huan Hezron ta masapen Jerahmeel tapate: ata masapen Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem leh Ahijah ahi uh.
Jerahmeel in zi dang anei a, amin Atarah ahi; amah Onam nu ahi.
Jerahmeel ta masapen Ram tapate Maaz, Jamin leh Eker ahi uh.
Onam tapate: Shammai leh Jada ahi uh. Shammai tapate: Nadab leh Abishur ahi uhi.
Abishur zi min Abihail ahi; ama'n Ahban leh Molid asuansak hi.
Nadab tapate: Seled leh Appaim ahi ua, Seled bel tate nei lou in asi hi.
Appaim tapa Ishi ahi. Ishi tapa Sheshan ahi. Sheshan tapa Ahlai ahi.
Huan Shammai unaupa Jada tapate: Jether leh Jonathan ahi ua; Jether ta nei lou in asi hi.
Huan Jonathan tapate: Peleth, Zaza ahi uh. Hiaite Jerahmeel tapate ahi uh.
Huchi in Sheshan in, tanute chih louh, tapate anei kei hi. Huan Sheshan in Aigupta mi khat sikha anei a, amin Jarha ahi.
Huan Sheshan in asikha Jarha kiang ah zi ding in atanu apia a; huchi in Attai aneihsak hi.
Huan Attai in Nathan asuang a, Nathan in Zabad asuang;
Zabad in Ephlal asuang; Ephlal in Obed asuang;
Obed in Jehu asuang a, Jehu in Azariah asuang;
Azariah in Helez asuang a, Helez in Eleasah asuang hi;
Eleasah in Sisamai asuang a, Sisamai in Shallum asuang;
Shallum in Jekamiah asuang a, Jekamiah in Elishama asuang hi.
Huchi in Jerahmeel unaupa Kaleb tapate: Ata masapen Mesha ahi a; amah Ziph pa ahi, huan Mareshah ahi a, amah Hebron pa ahi.
Huan Hebron tapate: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, Shema ahi uh.
Shema in Raham, Jorkoam pa asuang; Rekem in Shammai asuang hi.
Huan Shammai tapa Maon ahi; Beth-zur pa Maon ahi.
Ephah, Kaleb mei in, Haran, Moza leh Gazez asuang a: Haran in Gazez asuang hi.
Jahdai tapate: Regem, Jotham, Gesan, Pelet, Ephah leh Shaaph ahi uh.
Maakah, Kaleb mei in, Sheber leh Tirhanah anei a.
Madmannah pa Shaaph, Makbenah pa leh Gibea pa Sheva anei a; Kaleb tanu Aksah ahi.
Hiaite Kaleb tapate ahi uh: Ephrathah ta masapen Hur tapa, Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal;
Bethlehem pa Salma, Bethgader pa Hareph.
Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal in tapate anei a; Haroeh leh Menaheth kimkhatte ahi ua,
Kiriath-jearim inkote; Ithrit mite, Puthit mite, Shumathit mite, Misrai mite; Zareathit mite leh Eshtaol mite hong kipatna ahi.
Salma tapate: Bethlehem, Netophah mite, Joab inkuante Atroth-beth, Zorit mite, Manahathit mite kimkhatte ahi uh.
Huan Jabez a teng laigelhmite inkote: Tirathit mite, Shimeathit mite, leh Sukathit mite. Hiaite Ken mi Rekab inkote pa, Hemath a kipan hong paite ahi uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum ahong bei a kumpipate kidou ding a akuankhiak lai un, Joab in asepaih hatte apikhia hi. Ammon suante gam asuhsak a, Rabbah khua a-um uh. David bel Jerusalem ah a-om hi. Huan Joab in Rabbah khua asual a, alata hi.
Huchi in David in akumpipa uh lallukhu khuk lai alaksak a, agikdan dangka-eng talent khat ahi, suangmantamte leng atel a; David akhusak ua; khopi a om gallak sum tampi ala hi.

Huchi in huai lai a mipite bel apikhia a, sing-atnate, leilehna sikzumte, heipite in nna asemsak hi. Huchibang in Ammon tate khopi tengteng David in ahih hi. David leh mi tengteng Jerusalem ah apai nawnta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in, Philistia mite toh Gezer ah kidouna a-om a; huchi in Husat mi Sibbekai in milian suante lak a mi Sippai athat a; huchi in avuallelta uhi.
Philistia mite toh kidouna a-om nawn a; Jair tapa Elhan in Git mi Goliath unaupa Lahmi athat a, ateikung chiampek bang ahi.
Gath ah kidouna a-om nawn a, huai ah misang mahmah, akhut lang tuak a khutzung guk, akhe lang tuak a khezung guk, avek a sawmnih-le-li nei a-om a; amah leng miliante lak a khat ahi.
Ama'n Israel mite asimmoh a, David unau Shimea tapa Jonathan in amah athat hi.
Huaite Gath a milian lak a piang ahi uh; huaite David leh amite khut ah asi uhi.
Huan Setan in Israelte asual a, David bel Israelte phakzah sim utna aneisak hi.
Huan David in Joab leh amiliante uh kiang ah, "Kuan unla, Beer-sheba a kipan Dan tan in Israel mite sim unla, aphakzah uh ka theihtheihna ding in hong hilh nawn un," achi hi.

Joab in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA'N amite amun za in hihpung taleh zong, kumpipa ka toupa, ka toupa mite mah hilou uh ahi maw? Bangziak a ka toupa'n huai theih kilawp ahia? Bangziak a Israelte siam louh tanlohna hi ding ahia oi?" achi hi.
Huchi in Joab apawtkhia a, Israel gam tengteng ah apai a, Jerusalem ah apai nawn hi.
Joab in mihing om zah David ahilh hi. Israel gam a namsau tawimi tengteng maktaduaikhat-le-nuaikhat ahi uh; huan Judah gam a namsau tawimi bel nuaili-le-singsagih ahi uh.
Levite leh Benjaminte bel asimtel kei; Joab in kumpipa thupiak zakdah lamtak ahi ngal a.
Huai thil ah Pathian akipak kei a; huchi in Israelte agawtta hi.
Huchi in David in Pathian kiang ah, "Hiai thil ka na hihna ah nakpitak in ka na hihkhialta ahi; himahleh na sikha thulimlouhna hehpih in ngaidam in, haihuaitak in ka na hihta hi,” achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N zawlnei Gad kiang ah,
"Kuan inla, David kiang ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Thil thum ka hon tah: na tung a ka hih ding in alak ua khat tel in achi,' " va chi in.
Huchi in David kiang ah Gad ava hoh a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi:

Akoi ahia na deih tel in; kum thum kialpi tun hia, na melmate namsau a delhphak a om a kha thum na melmate vuallelhsak hia, ni thum hipi len ding, TOUPA namsau a TOUPA angel in Israel gam tengteng a mi ahihmanthat zel?' chi in. Huchi in kei hon sawlpa bang ka chi dawn dia, kingaihtuah inla, hon hilh in," achi hi.
David in Gad kiang ah, "Ka lungzing mahmah, TOUPA khut ah puklut peuhmah mai leng; azahngaihna lah athupi mahmah ngal a; mihing khut ah zaw hon puklutsak mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Israelte lak ah hipi alengsakta.

Huan Jerusalem khua hihse ding in Pathian in angel asawl a; ahihsiat dek laitak in, TOUPA'N a-en a, thil hoih lou hih atup akhiam a, mite hihmangthang angel kiang ah, "Ahunta; na khut lik nawn ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA angel Jebus mi Ornan phual chin ah adingh hi.
David adaktou a, TOUPA angel, namsau phawisa a Jerusalem lam ngim a, lei leh van kikal a dingh amu hi. Huchi in David leh a-upate'n sai-ip puan silh in lei ah abokkhup uhi.

David in Pathian kiang ah, "Keimah ka hi kei a hia mipite sim ding chih thu pepa? Keimah ka hi ginat huai loutak a thil na hihkhial, hiai belamte'n bang thil ahia ahih tei uh? Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, keimah leh ka inkote tung ah na khutkha inla, na mite'n hipi thuak nawn kei uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA angel in David kiang a Gad va hohtou a, Jebus mi Ornan phual a TOUPA dia maitam doh ding a David hilh ding in thu apia hi.
Gad in TOUPA min a athugen ziak in David ahohtouta hi.
Ornan akilehhei a, angel amu a; atapa li akiang a omte abuta uhi. Ornan in buh ana chil ahi.
David, Ornan kiang atun in, Ornan akihei a, David amuta a, huan phual a kipan apawtkhia a, amai a lei si in David ma ah abokkhup hi.
Huchi in David in Ornan kiang ah, "Hiai phual TOUPA a dia maitam ka bawlna ding in hon pe dih ve; aman kim geih la in hon pia in, mipite lak a hii akikhin theihna ding in," achi hi.

Ornan in David kiang ah, "Tang in, TOUPA ka kumpipa'n pha asak bang in hih hen; halmang a lat ding in bawngtalte, sing ding in phual vanzatte, tangbuang thillat ding in buhte ka hon pia hi; ka hon sutuah vek ding," achi hi.
Huan kumpipa David in Ornan kiang ah, "Hilou e; aman kim geih in ka lei zaw ding, man bei in TOUPA a ding in nang a ka la kei ding, halmang thillat leng ka lan kei ding,” achi a.
Huchi in David in huai mun leina in Ornan dangka-eng shekel zaguk apia hi.
David in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam abawl a, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan a, TOUPA asam a; TOUPA'N maitam tung ah mei in van a kipan in adawngta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N angel thu apia a, anamsau apai ah athun nawnta hi.
Huchi in David in Jebus mi Ornan phual ah TOUPA'N ahon dawng chih atheih in huai ah akithoihta hi.
Huai lai in Mosi in gamdai a TOUPA biakbuk leh halmang thillatna maitam abawl Gibeon khua mun sang ah a-om ahi.
Himahleh David bel TOUPA angel namsau akihtak ziak in Pathian dong ding in huai ah ahoh thei kei hi.
Huchi in David in, "Hiai zaw TOUPA Pathian inn ahi hi; hiai zaw Israelte halmang thillatna maitam ahi hi," achi hi.
Huchi in David in Israel gam a namdang omte sapkhawm thu apia a; huan, Pathian inn lamna ding in suangsek mite suang aseksak hi.
David in intual kongkhak leh abulhna ding kilhna ding sik tampi abawlkhol a; dal tamtak buk seng louh toh; sidar sing sim seng louh toh;
Zidon mi leh Tura mite'n David kiang ah sidar sing tampi ahon la uhi.

David in, "Ka tapa Solomon lah anaupang lai in, bangmah athei nai kei a, TOUPA' inn lam ding thupitak, amin leh athupina gam chih a thangkhe ding ahi a; huaiziak in ka kisakhol hi," achi hi. Huchi in David asih ma in akisakhol nasa mahmah hi.
Huchi in atapa Solomon asam a, TOUPA Israel' Pathian inn lam ding in thu apia hi.
Huan David in atapa Solomon kiang ah, "TOUPA ka Pathian min ding in inn lam lungsim in ka nei gige hi.
Himahleh, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, nang zaw sisan na naksuah tel a, kidoute na uang tel a; leitung ah ka mitmuh a sisan na naksuah ziak in, ka min a ding in inn na lam kei ding.

Ngai in, tapa chingkam na hon nei ding a, amah kei lungtuak mi ahi ding a, akim gam a amelma tengteng lak ah galmuanna ka pe ding; amin Solomon ahi ding a, amah ziak in Israelte galmuang leh lungmuangtak in ka omsak ding.
Ama'n ka min a ding in inn alam ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding a, kei apa ka hi ding; huan, Israelte tung a agam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding.
"Huchi in ka tapa, TOUPA na kiang ah om henla, lamzang zel inla, na tungtang thu agenkholhsa bang in, TOUPA na Pathian inn lam in.
TOUPA'N pilna leh theihnate hon neisak peuhmah phot henla, Israelte tung ah thuneihna hon pia hen, huchi in TOUPA na Pathian dan na zui thei ding hi.
Huchi in Israelte tungtang thu a dan thusehte leh vaihawmnate TOUPA'N Mosi apiak na zuihleh, na lamzang zel ding; hattak in om inla, hangsantak in om in; lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n.

Ngai in, ka lungzin lai in TOUPA' inn a ding in dangka-eng talent nuaikhat leh dangkasik talent maktaduaikhat ka na kisakhol khin a; dal leh sikte leng buk seng louh, tampi ahi; sing leh suang leng ka kisakhol khin ahi, huaite na sunzom theita ding.
Nasemmi, sing-atmi leh suangsekmi leh khutsiamna chiteng sem thei leng na hau hi.
Sim seng vual louh dangka-engte, dangkate, dalte, sikte leng; thou inla, nasep pan in, TOUPA na kiang ah om hen," achi hi.
David in Israelte makai tengteng atapa Solomon panpih ding in thu apia hi.
"TOUPA na Pathian uh na kiang uah a-om kei a hia? Mun chih mual chih ah galmuanna ahon pe kei a hia? Hiai gam a mite ka khut ah ahon peta a, TOUPA ma leh amite ma ah gam lak ahita.

Tu in na lungtang uleh na lungsim uh TOUPA na Pathian uh zong ding in koihkip un; huaiziak in thou unla, TOUPA min a inn lam ding suang, TOUPA thukhun bawm leh Pathian tui-um belsuan siangthoute laklutna ding in, mun siangthou lam un," achi hi.
David adamsawt in a-upa mahmah a; huchi in Israelte kumpipa in atapa Solomon abawlta hi.
Huan Israelte makai tengteng siampute leh Levite toh asamkhawm hi.
Levite kum sawmthum a kipan atunglam sim ahi ua; atamlam uh piching singthum-le-sanggiat ahi.
Huaite lak a, "Singnih-le-sangli TOUPA' inn lam heutute heutu ding ahi ua; sanggukte heutute leh vaihawmmi dingte ahi uh;
Sanglite kongkhak ngak mite ding ahi ua, huan sanglite, phatna ding a thil tumging chi ka bawl," David in achihte zang a TOUPA phat ding mite ahi uhi.
Levi tapate Gershon, Kahath, Merari zah in David in pawl abawl a,
Gershon mite Laadan leh Shimei ahi uh.
Laadan tapate makaipente Jehiel, Zetham, Joel, thum ahi uh.
Shimei tapate Shelomith, Haziel, Haran, thum ahi uh. Hiaite Laadan suan inkuan makaipente ahi uh.
Shimei tapate bel Jahath, Zina, Jeush, Beriah ahi uh. Hiai lite Shimei tapate ahi uh.
Jahath a-upapen ahi a, Zizah anihna ahi; Jeush leh Beriahte'n bel ta ahau kei ua; huaiziak in inkuan khat bang a sim ahi uh.
Kohath tapate Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel, li ahi uh.

Amram tapate Aaron leh Mosi ahi uh; Aaron bel amah leh asuante tangtawn a ding a thil siangthoutakte hihsiangthou a, tangtawn a TOUPA ma a gimlim hal a, a-nna sem a, amin a vualzawlpa ding a hihtuam ahi uh.
Pathian mipa Mosi bel, atapate Levi nam lak a sim ahi uh.
Mosi tapate Gershom leh Eliezer ahi uh,
Gershom tapate lak a upapen Shebuel ahi.
Eliezer tapate lak a upapen Rehabiah ahi. Eliezer in tapa dang anei kei; Rehabiah in bel tapa tampi anei.
Izhar tapate: Shelmoth amakai lianpen.
Hebron tapate lak a makai lianpen Jeriah ahi a, anihna Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jekameam ahi.
Uzziel tapate lak a upazaw Mikah ahi a, anihna Isshiah ahi.
Merari tapate: Merari tapate bel Mahli leh Mushi ahi uh, Mahli tapate Eleazar leh Kish ahi uh.
Eleazar tapate nei lou in asi a, tanute kia anei a; Kish tapa a-unaute un zi in anei uh.
Mushi tapate Mahli, Eder, Jeremoth, thum ahi uh.
Huaite Levi suan a-inkuan uh bang zel a min gelh a asim uh inkuan makaipen, TOUPA' inn lam a kuan, kuni sawmnih a kipan tunglam asimte uh ahi.
David in, "TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in amite galmuangtak in a-omsakta a, Jerusalem ah a-om nilouh hi.
Levite'n leng biakbuk leh anasepna ding tui-um belsuan tengteng azon uh akiphamohta kei hi," achi hi.
David thupiak nanung ziak in Levite kum sawmnih a kipan atunglam tan in sim ngal ahi uhi.
Anasep uh Pathian inn a nasep a Aaron tapate panpih a intual sung leh dantan sung a thil siangthoute hihsiangthou a, TOUPA' inn a nasep ahi;
tanghou koih dingte, tangbuang thillat ding a tangbuang nel mahmah, silngou hel louh tanghou pek hiam, bel a uk hiam, kan hiam, ateh leh aletdan bang teng ding bawlte toh;
Zingsang teng a TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen leh amah phatte toh, nitak a leng huchi mah;
Sabbathte, kha thakte a ankuanglui neihte ahih ding seh bang zel a TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat tengteng TOUPA ma a lat gigete toh;
kihoupihna biakbuk kepte, mun siangthou kepte, TOUPA' inn a nasem a a-unau Aaron tapate'n hih ding aseh peuhmah uh hihte toh.
Aaron tapate pawl khendan hichibang ahi, Aaron tapate Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uh.
Nadab leh Abihu bel apa uh sang in asi masa ua; ta anei kei uh; huaiziak in Eleazar leh Ithamarte'n siampu nna asem uhi.
David in Eleazar tapa Zadok leh Ithamar tapa Ahimelekte toh anasepdan ding uh ahawmsak hi.
Ithamar suante sang in Eleazar suan makaipen a pang atamzaw uh; hichibang in akhen ua; Eleazar suan ah, inkuan makaipen sawm-le-guk a hi uh; Ithamar suan ah, inkuan makaipen giat ahi uhi.
Eleazar suan a mi leh Ithamar suan a mite lak ah, mun siangthou a miliante leh Pathian miliante a om tuaktuak uh ahih ziak in aisan in, amaute akhen uhi.

Huan Levi mi, laigelhmi Nethaneel tapa Shemaiah in kumpipa, milian, siampu Zadok, Abiathar tapa Ahimelek, siampute leh Levite inko makaipente mitmuh in agelh a; inkuan pipa khat tan Eleazar tung ah apuk a, khat bel Ithamar tung ah apuk hi.
Huchi in aisan akhatveina bel Jehoarib tung ah atu a, anihveina Jedaiah tung ah;
athumveina Harim tung ah, aliveina Seorim tung ah;
angaveina Makijah tung ah, agukveina Mijamin tung ah;
asagihveina Hakoz tung ah, agiatveina Abijah tung ah;
akuaveina Jeshua tung ah, asawmveina Shekaniah tung ah;
asawm-le-khatveina Eliashib tung ah, asawm-le-nihveina Jakim tung ah;
asawm-le-thumveina Huppah tung ah, asawm-le-liveina Jeshebeab tung ah;
asawm-le-ngaveina Bilgah tung ah, asawm-le-gukveina Immer tung ah;
asawm-le-sagihveina Hezir tung ah, asawm-le-giatveina Happizzez tung ah;
asawm-le-kuaveina Pethahiah tung ah, asawmnihveina Jehezekel tung ah;
asawmnih-le-khatveina Jakin tung ah, asawmnih-le-nihveina Gamul tung ah;
asawmnih-le-thumveina Delaiah tung ah, asawmnih-le-liveina Maaziah tung ah atu hi.
Huai bel TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in apu uh Aaron thu ana piak, TOUPA insung a nna asepdan ding ana sehdan ahi hi.
Levi suan dangte lak ah; Amram tapate lak ah Shubael ahi; Shubael tapate lak ah Jehdeiah.
Rehabiah lam ah; Rehabaihte lak ah amakaipen Isshiah ahi.
Izharte lak ah Shelomoth; Shelomoth tapate lak ah Jahath,
Hebron tapate, a-upapen Jeriah ahi a, anihna Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jokameam ahi.
Uzziel tapate lak a mi Mikah; Mikah tapate lak a mi Shamir ahi.
Mikah unaupa Isshiah ahi a; Isshiah tapate lak a mi Zekariah ahi.
Merari tapate bel Mahli leh Mushi ahi ua; Jaaziah tapate lak a mi Beno ahi.
Merari suante, Jaaziah lak ah Beno, Shoham, Zakkur leh Ibrite ahi uh.
Mahli lak ah, Eleazar ahi a, ama'n tapa anei kei.
Kish lak ah, Kish tapa Jerahmeel ahi.
Mushi suante bel, Mahli, Eder leh Jerimothte ahi uh. Hiaite bel Levite suante lak a a-inkuan ua makai lianpente ahi uhi.
Hiai inkuan chih a lianpen leh naupangpente'n leng Aaron ta a-unaute uh bang in, agam tan ding uh, kumpipa David, Zadok, Ahimelek, siampu leh Levite inko makaipente mitmuh in ai asan sam uhi.

Huan Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun tapa khenkhat kaihgingte, pekgingte, dakkhutbette toh ala vek a nasemmi ding in David leh sepaih heutute'n ahihtuam ua; nasep ding omdan bang zel in nasem mite tamdan ding asep uhi.
Asaph tapate lak a mi Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah leh Asarelah ahi ua, amau bel Asaph tapate, kumpipa thupiak bang a zawlnei thugen a gen, Asaph thuthu a omte ahi uh.
Jeduthun lak ah: Jeduthun tapate Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah leh Matithiahte, guk ahi uh; kaihging toh TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen a la vek a apa uh Jeduthun thuthu a omte ahi uh.
Heman lak ah: Heman tapate Bukkiah, Mataniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanni, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Malothi, Hothir leh Mahaziothte ahi uhi;
Huaite tengteng Pathian lam thu a kumpipa zawlnei Heman tapate pengkulkawi mut dingte ahi uh. Pathian in Heman tapa sawm-le-li leh tanu thum apia hi.

Huaite tengteng TOUPA' inn a dakkhutbet toh, kaihging toh, pekging toh, Pathian inn a nasepna ding a la toh lem mite, apa uh thuthu a omte ahi uh; Asaph, Jeduthun leh Hemante bel kumpipa thupiak iak a omte ahi leuleu uhi.
Atamlam uh, a-unau, TOUPA ding a lasak kisin siam khinsa tengtengte toh zanih sawmgiat-le-giat ahi uh.
Huan aneu leh alian, sinsakmi leh sinmi in atan ding uh kibang vek in ai asan uhi.
Huchi in aisan akhatveina Asaph tapa Joseph tung ah atu a; anihveina Gedaliah tung ah; amah leh a-unaute leh atapate sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
Athumveina bel Zakkur tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uh.
Aliveina Izri tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
Angaveina Nethaniah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Agukveina Bukkiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asagihveina Jesharelah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Agiatveina bel Jeshaiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Akuaveina bel Mataniah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawmveina Shimei tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-khatveina Azarel tung ah, atapa leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-nihveina Hashabiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-thumveina Shubael tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-liveina Matithiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-ngaveina Jeremoth tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-gukveina Hananiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-sagihveina Joshbekashah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-giatveina Hananiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawm-le-kuaveina Malothi tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawmnihveina Eliathah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawmnih-le-khatveina Hothir tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawmnih-le-nihveina Giddalti tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawmnih-le-thumveina Mahazioth tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
Asawmnih-le-liveina Romamti-ezer tung ah atu a, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
Kongkhak ngak pawl khendan: Kore mi bel Asaph tapate lak a Kore tapa Meshelemiah ahi.
Huan Meshelemiah in tapate anei a: ata masa Zekariah ahi a, azom Jediael, athumna Zebadiah, alina Jathniel;
angana Elam, agukna Jehohanan, asagihna Elioenai ahi.
Obed-edom in tapate anei a; ata masa Shemaiah ahi a, azom Jehozabad, athumna Joah, alina Sakar, angana Nethaneel,
agukna Amiel, asagihna Issakar, agiatna Peulethai ahi, amah bel Pathian in avualzawl hi.
Atapa Shemaiah a kipan tapa, a-inkote uh vaihawmte leng apiang ua; amaute mihat hangsan ahi chiat uhi.
Shemaiah tapate Othni, Rephael, Obed leh Elzabadte ahi ua, a-unau uh Elihu leh Semakiah bel mihat mahmah ahi uh.
Huaite tengteng Obed-edom suante ahi ua: amau leh atapate uh leh a-unaute uh nasepna lamsang ah mi piching ahi uh; Obed-edom a kipan mite sawmguk-le-nih ahi uhi.
Meshelemiah in tapa leh unau mihat mahmah sawm-le-giat anei hi.
Merari suante lak a Hosah in leng tapate anei a; Shimri bel amakai lianpen ahi a, ta masa ahi kei na a, apa'n makaipen in abawl hi.
Azom in Hilkiah ahi a, athumna Tebaliah, alina Zekariah ahi. Hosah tapate leh a-unaute avek un sawm-le-thum ahi uh.
Huai amakaipente lak a mi a-unaute uh bang a TOUPA' inn a nasem thilbawl a tantuan nei a kongkhak ngakmi pawl a akhente uh ahi.
Aneu alian in, a-inkuan dungzui zel un kongpi chih a om ding zonna ding in ai asan uhi.
Huchi in suahlam a dia aisan pen Shelemiah tung ah atu hi. Lemgel siam piltak, atapa Zekariah a ding in ai asan ua, mallam pen amah a tuam in atu hi.
Simlam bel Obed-edom tuam in; atapate tuam in Asuppim.
Tumlam a toupaina lampi a Shaleketh kongkhak venna toh, Shuppim leh Hosah tuam in.
Suahlam ah Levite guk a-om ua, niteng in mallam ah li, simlam ah li, thil koihkhawmna inn ah nih tuaktuak.
Tumlam inn um sung a ding in alutna ah li; inn um sung ah nih.
Huaite ahi uh, Korah tapate leh Merari mi tapate kongkhak ngakmi pawl akhente uh.
Huan a-unaute uh Levite lak ah Ahijah, Pathian sum koihkhawmna inn leh thil latsate koihkhawmna inn heutu ahi.
Laadan tapate: Gershon mite tapate Laadante a te, pipute inkote amakai lianpen Gershon mi Laadan a te; Jehieli.
Jehieli tapate: Zetham, Joel a-unaupa, TOUPA' inn a sum koihkhawmna heutu ahi uh.
Amram mite a kipan, Izhar mite a kipan, Hebron mite a kipan, Uzziel mite a kipan:
Mosi tapa, Gershom tapa Shebuel sum koihkhawmna heutu ahi.
A-unaute bel Eliezer tapa Rahabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zikri leh Shelomithte ahi.

Shelomith leh a-unaute bel kumpipa David leh a-inkote uh makaipen sepaih sangkhat heutute leh zakhat heutute leh sepaih pawl heutute'n ahihsiangthousa uh, thil siangthou koihkhawmna inn tengteng kemte ahi uhi.
Kidouna gallak thilte TOUPA' inn bawlphatna ding in akoih uhi.
Zawlnei Samuel, Kish tapa Saul, Ner tapa Abner leh Zeruiah tapa Joabte'n ahihsiangthou tengteng uh, kuapeuh in thil ahihsiangthousa peuhmah uh Shelomith leh a-unaute kep vek ahi.
Izhar mi Kenaniah leh atapate Israel gam polam tungtang thu a heutute leh vaihawmmi ahi uh.
Hebron mi Hashabiah leh a-unau mihangsan sangkhat-le-zasagih Jordan gal tumlam a Israelte ukpate ahi uhi; TOUPA nna tengteng leh kumpipa nasepna lam nna ah.
Hebron mi Jerijah bel asuan uh tungtang thu a inko makai lam ah Hebronte, amakaipente ahi uhi. David kum sawmli avaihawm kum a azon un Gilead gam a Jazer ah mihat hangsan amukhia uhi.

A-unau mihangsante sangnih-le-zasagih ahi uhi. Huaite inko makaipen, kumpipa David in Pathian lam thil chiteng leh kumpipa na lam thu a Reuben, Gad leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte heutu dia abawlte ahi uh.
Israelte atamdan uh inkuan makaipente, sepaih sangkhat heutute, zakhat heutute leh kumpipa nasem mite tengteng kum khat sung a kha teng a kikheng zelzel, pawl chih a mi singnih-le-sangli ahi uhi.
Pawl khatna akha khatna a heutu Zabdiel tapa Jashobeam ahi a, pawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Amah Perez suan a mi, akha khatna a sepaih heutu tengteng makaipen ahi.
Akha nihna pawl a heutu Ahoh mi Dodai ahi a, apawl a mi Mikloth leng ahi a, apawl uah singnih-le-sangli a-om uhi.
Akha thumna a sepaihte heutupen siampu Jehoiada tapa Benaiah ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Hiai Benaiah ahi a, sawmthum lak a mihangsan, sawmthum tung a mi pen; apawl ah atapa Ammizabad atel hi.
Akha lina a sepaih heutu Joab unaupa Asahel ahi a, atapa Zebadiah asik a pang ahi, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha ngana a sepaih heutu Izrah mi Shamhuth ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha gukna a sepaih heutu Tekoa mi, Ikkesh tapa Ira ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha sagihna a sepaih heutu Ephraim suan Pelon mi Helez ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha giatna a sepaih heutu Zerah suan Husat mi Sibbekai ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha kuana a sepaih heutu Benjamin suan Anathoth mi Abiezer ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha sawmna a sepaih heutu Zerah suan Netophah mi Maharai ahi a, apawl ah singnih sangli a-om uh.
Akha sawm-le-khatna a sepaih heutu Ephraim suan Pirathon mi Benaiah ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha sawm-le-nihna a sepaih heutu Othniel suan Netophah mi Heldai ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Huai lou leng, Israel namte tung a: Reubente lak a Zikri tapa Eliezer vaihawmpa ahi a, Simeonte lak ah Maakah tapa Shephatiah ahi;
Levite lak ah Kumuel tapa, Hashabiah; Aaronte lak ah Zadok;
Judate lak ah David unaute lak ah Elihu, Issakarte lak ah Mikael tapa Omri;
Zebulunte lak ah Obadiah tapa Ishmaiah; Naphtalite lak ah Azriel tapa Jeremoth;
Ephraim suante lak ah Azaziah tapa Hoshea; Manasseh nam kimkhatte lak ah Pedaiah tapa Joel.
Gilead gam a Manasseh nam kimkhatte lak ah, Zekariah tapa Ido; Benjaminte lak ah, Abner tapa Jaasiel;
Dante lak ah Jeroham tapa Azariel. Huaite Israel nam heutute ahi uh.
David in kum sawmnih a kipan anuailam asim kei hi, Israelte bel van a aksi zah in apungsak ding chih TOUPA'N ana gen khit tak ziak in.
Zeruiah tapa Joab in asim pan a, himahleh asimzou kei a, Israelte tung ah leng hehna ahong tungta a; kumpipa David vaihawm lai khangthubute ah azah gelh leng ahi sam kei hi.
Kumpipa sumkempa Adiel tapa Azmaveth ahi a; huan lou lam ah, khopite ah, khopel khawng ah, insangte a sumkempa bel Uzziah tapa Jehonathan ahi.
Lou a leileh nasep sem kempa Kelub tapa Ezri ahi a;
Grephuan kempa Ramath mi, Shimei ahi a, grephuan a uain suksa koihkhawm kempa Shiph mite mi Zabdi ahi.
Phaiguam olive sing leh theipi kungte kempa Geder mi Baal-hanan ahi a, sathau koihkhawmna kempa Joash ahi.
Sharon a ta ganhon kempa Sharon mi Shitrai ahi a, Phaizang a ganhon kempa Adlai tapa Shaphat ahi.
Sangawngsau kempa Ishmael mi Obil ahi a, sabiltung kempa Meronoth mi Jehdeiah ahi a;
belamhon kempa Hagar mi Jaziz ahi. Huaite tengteng kumpipa David sumkem mite ahi uh.
Huan David paneu, Jonathan tuh mipil, laisiam mahmah thu theipen ahi a, huan amah leh Hakmoni tapa Jehiel in kumpipa tapate asinsak uhi.
Kumpipa lemgelpihpa Ahithophel ahi a; Arki mi Hushai kumpipa lawm ahi a.
Ahithophel zom in Benaiah tapa Jehoiada leh Abiathar ahi ua, kumpipa sepaih heutu bel Joab ahi.

Huan David in Israel heutu tengteng nam makaipente, kumpipa nasem a kikheng zelzel pawl heutute, sepaih sangkhat heutute, zakhat heutute, kumpipa leh atapate sum leh thil neih tengteng tung a heutute, milian mihat, mihat hangsan tengtengte toh Jerusalem ah asamkhawm hi.

Huchi in kumpipa David adingh a, "Ka unaute leh ka mite aw, ka thu na ngaikhia dih ua, ke'n TOUPA thukhun bawm koihna leh i Pathian khe ngakna ding inn lam lungsim in ka nei gige a; alamna ding leng ka ngah khin sipsip hi.
Himahleh, Pathian in ka kiang ah, 'Nang zaw kidoumi sisan suahmi na hih ziak in ka min a ding in inn na lam kei ding,' achi hi.

Himahleh TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, ka pa inkote tengteng lak a kipan Israelte kumpipa dia tangtawn a om ding in ahon na telta a; Judah makai pipen ding in ana telta a; Judah namte lak ah ka pa inkote; ka pa tapate lak a kipan Israel tengteng kumpipa ding in ahon na telkhe tuamta hi.
TOUPA'N tapa tampi ahon pia a, ka tapa tengteng lak ah, Israelte kumpipa ding in TOUPA gam laltutphah a tu ding in ka tapa Solomon ana telta hi.
"Huchi in ka kiang ah, 'Na tapa Solomon in ka inn leh ka intualte adingsak ding; ka tapa ding in ka telta a, huchi in apa ka hi ding.
Ka thupiakte leh ka vaihawmte apom gigeleh tua na hih gige bang un agam tangtawn a ding in ka kipsak ding hi.'

Huchi in TOUPA mipi, Israelte tengteng mitmuh in leh i Pathian zak in TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak tengteng pom ding leh limsak ding in ka hon hanthawn ahi; huchi in hiai gam hoih mahmah na luah ding ua, na nung uah na suante uh tangtawn a ding in na luahtou sawnsak zel ding uhi.

"Huan nang, ka tapa Solomon, na pa Pathian thei inla, lungtang hoih bukim leh lungsim kilawptak in anasep sem in; TOUPA'N lah lungtang a-en sek a, lungsim a lunggel tengteng athei vek hi; amah na zonleh na mu ding a, na lehngatsanleh bel tangtawn in ahon khahkhe ding hi.
Pilvang in; mun siangthou a dia inn lam ding in TOUPA'N nang ahon septa; hattak in om inla, pang in," achi hi.
Huchi in David in atapa Solomon kiang ah atempul intual, asum koihkhawmna, adantan tungnung, asung dantan, azahngaihna tutphah,
Alungsim a alunggel bang tengteng, TOUPA' inn um sung intual, akim dantan tengteng, Pathian in asum koihkhawmna inn, thil tan koihkhawmna inn lamdan ding guhgel apia hi.
Siampute leh Levite apawlpawl a a-omna ding uh lim, TOUPA' inn a nasepna lam ding tengteng lim, TOUPA' inn a nasepna ding tui-um belsuan tengteng lim leng.
Nasepna lam a dia tui-um belsuan chi chih, dangka-eng tui-um belsuan ding, dangka-eng zat zel zah ding,

Dangka-eng khawnvak koihna leh akhawnvak ding dangka-eng zat zel zah ding, khawnvak koihna leh akhawnvak tui ding a zat zel zah ding, khawnvak koihna a mun kiphamoh chiat bang zel a dangkasik khawnvak koihna ding a dia zat zel zah ding toh;
tanghou at koihna ding dangka-eng dohkan leh dangkasik dohkan bawlna ding a, dangka-eng zat zah ding leh dangkasik zat zel zah ding atehna in apia hi.
Maiphiatna kuang, noute toh; dangka-eng belhbu ding, belhbu khat zel a dia zat zel zah ding.
Cherubte akha uh zak a; TOUPA thukhun bawm tuam tuanna lim bang bawlna ding dangka-engte toh.
David in, "Hiaite tengteng TOUPA'N amah mah khut a hon gelh, hiai a lim tengteng hon theisak hi in ka thei," achi hi.

Huchi in David in atapa Solomon kiang ah, "Hattak leh hangsantak in om inla, pang in; lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n; TOUPA Pathian, ka Pathian na kiang ah a-om hi; TOUPA' inn lam nasep tengteng zoh ahih vek mateng hon paisan in, ahon limsak lou kei ding hi.

Huan ngai dih, Pathian in na chih teng semmi pawl siampute leh Levite a-om ua, bang nna peuh a, bang lam peuh a nasep siam, hattak chiat a nang hon panpih ding na kiang ah a-om zel ding uhi; heutute leh mipi teng in leng na thupiak peuhmah azui ding uhi," achi hi.

Huan kumpipa David in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Pathian telkhiak ka tapa Solomon anaupang lai in bangmah athei nai kei a, asep ding lah athupi ngal a, tempul mihing a ding ahi kei a, TOUPA Pathian a ding ahi zaw hi.

Huchi in ka Pathian inn a ding in adangka-eng lam thil a ding in dangka-engte, dangkasik lam thil a ding in, dangkasik, dal lam thil a ding in dal, sik lam thil a ding in sik, sing lam thil a ding in sing theih tawk in ka na kisa khinta a, azepna ding onik suang, suang kilawm, asilh ding suang kilawm chi tuamtuam leh suangmantam chi chih leh suangpak suang tampite ka pe khinta hi.

Huai kia lou leng ka Pathian inn ka deihsak mahmah a, keimah sum dangka-eng leh dangkate leng, inn siangthou a dia ka na kisaksa tengteng chih louh, ka Pathian inn a ding in ka pia hi, huai tuh baang zutna ding in ophir dangka-eng,
dangka-eng talent sangthum leh dangkasik siangthou talent sangsagih, azatna lam tuamtuam a misiamte zat ding in, dangka-eng zatna ding a dangka-engte.
Dangkasik zatna ding a dangkasikte ahi. Tuni in TOUPA a ding a kipaktak a pe phal kuakua na om ua?" achi hi.
Huchi in inkuan makaipente, Israel nam heutute, sangkhat heutute leh zakhat heutute, kumpipa nasemte heutute toh kipaktak in apia uhi.
Pathian inn lamna ding dangka-eng talent sangnga leh darik singkhat, dangkasik talent singkhat leh dal talent singkhat-le-sanggiat, sik talent nuaikhat apia uhi.
Suangmantam neite'n TOUPA sum koihkhawmna a Gershon mi Jehiel kep ding in akoih uhi.
Huchi in mipite akipak mahmah ua, lungsim mun khat pu a kipaktak a TOUPA apiak ziak un, kumpipa David in leng nop sak petmah in nuam asa hi.
Huchi in David in mipi tengteng ma ah TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu agen hi,

"Aw TOUPA, ka pu uh Israel' Pathian, tangtawn in phat in om hen. Aw TOUPA, thupina, thilhihtheihna, pahtawina, zohna, lalna nang a ahi a, lei leh van a om tengteng nang a ahi. Aw TOUPA, gam nang a ahi a, mi tengteng atungnungpen na hi.
Hauhsakna leh pahtawina na kiang a kipan ahi, bangkim tung ah thu na nei a, na khut ah thilhihtheihna a-om a, mi tengteng hih thupina leh hatna piaktheihna na khut ah a-om hi.
'Huchi in ka Pathian uh kipahthu ka hon hilh ua, na min thupi ka phat uhi.'
"Himahleh kua ahia ka hih a, ka mite leng kua ahia ahih ua, hiaite kipaktak a ka hon lat theih mahmah uh? Thil tengteng na kiang a kipan a pawt ahi ua, nang a hon pe nawn lel ka hi uhi.
Ka pi-le-pute uh bang in kou zaw na ma ah mikhual, mite kiang a om sam bang ka hi ua; leitung adamsung nite zaw limliap bang lel ahi a, lamet ding himhim a-om kei hi.
TOUPA ka Pathian uh, na min siangthou ding a inn ka hon lamsak ding a hiai thil ka na kisakna tengteng uh nangmah khutsuak ahi a, nang a vek ahi.

Ka Pathian, nang lungtangte na enchian sek a, diktatnate na kipahpih nak chih leng ka thei hi. Ke'n zaw lungsim taktak in hiai thil tengteng kipak mahmah in ka hon lan ahi, hiai lai a kipak mahmah a na kiang a hon lan mite ka muh in ka kipak mahmah hi.
AW TOUPA, ka pu uh Abraham, Isak, Israel' Pathian, na mite'n hichibang lungsim aput gige theihna ding un alungsimte uh nang a ding in hihkip inla;
huan ka tapa Solomon na thupiakte, na thu theihsakte, na dante zui a, huaite tengteng hih ding leh ka kisakkholhna inn lam ding in lungsim hoihkim pusak in," David in achi hi.
David in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Khai le, TOUPA na Pathian uh phat un," achi a, huchi in mipi tengteng in TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian aphat ua, akun ua, TOUPA leh kumpipa abia uhi.

Azing in TOUPA kiang ah kithoihna ding leh TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat ding in bawngtal sangkhat leh belam sangkhat leh belamnou sangkhat, adawn ding uh thillat toh Israelte tengteng a ding in kithoihna tampi alan uhi.
Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA ma ah nuamsatak in ane ua, a-om chiat uhi. David tapa Solomon bel kumpipa ding in abawl tuan nawn ua, TOUPA milian ding in sathau anilh ua, huan, Zadok bel siampu ding in.
Huchi in Solomon TOUPA laltutphah ah apa David sik in kumpipa in atuta a, lamzangtak in a-om a; huan Israelte tengteng in athu azui uhi.
Huan heutute tengteng leh mihat hangsante leh kumpipa David tapa dang tengtengte kumpipa Solomon lak ah akipia uh.
TOUPA'N Israelte tengteng mitmuh in nakpitak in Solomon ahih thupi a, Israel gam a ama a kumpipate lak ah kuamah in atan ngei louh uh, kumpipa hihna thupi mahmah atangta hi.
Jesse tapa David in Israelte tengteng tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Israelte tung a avaihawm sung kum sawmli ahi; Hebron ah kum sagih vai ahawm a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum vai ahawm hi.
Upa tekkun a dam in, hausatak leh pahtawinate tang in asi a; asik in atapa Solomon in vai ahawm hi.
Ngai in, kumpipa David tanchin atung a kipan atawp tan in, zawlnei Samuel laibu, zawlnei Nathan laibu leh zawlnei Gad laibute ah atuang hi.
Avaihawm thute, athilhihtheihdan tengtengte, amah leh Israelte tung leh gam tengteng tung a thil hong omdante toh.
Hiaite Hebron a piang David tapate ahi uh: Ata masa, Jezreel numei Ahinoam a pan Amnon; anihna, Karmel numei Abigail a pan Daniel;
athumna, Geshur kumpipa Talmai tanu Maakah tapa a pan Absalom; alina, Haggith tapa Adonijah;
angana, Abital a pan Shephatiah; agukna, azi Eglah a pan Ithream.
Hebron ah atapa gukte apiang ua; huai ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm hi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum leh kum thum vai ahawm hi.
Hiaite Ammiel tanu Bath-shua lak a Jerusalem a piang lite ahi uh: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, leh Solomon.
Adang kuate Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet;
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia;
Elishama, Eliada, leh Eliphelet ahi uh.
Hiaite tengteng, ameite tapate chih louh, David tapate ahi uh; huan asanggamnu uh Tamar ahi.
Huan Solomon tapa Rehoboam ahi. Atapa Abia, atapa Asa, atapa Jehoshaphat,
atapa Joram, atapa Ahaziah, atapa Joash;
atapa Amaziah, atapa Azariah, atapa Jotham;
atapa Ahaz, atapa Hezekiah, atapa Manasseh;
atapa Ammon, atapa Josiah.
Josiah tapate: ata masa Johanan, anihna Jehoiakim, athumna Zedekiah, alina Shallum.
Jehoiakim tapate: Jekoniah atapa leh Zedekiah atapa ahi uh.
Huan salmatpa Jekoniah suante: Atapa Salathiel,
Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, leh Nedabiah.
Pedaiah tapate: Zerubbabel leh Shimei ahi. Zerubbabel tapate: Meshullam leh Hananiah ahi; asanggamnu uh Shelomith ahi:
Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, leh Jusa-hesed, nga ahi uh.
Huan Hananiah tapate: Pelatiah leh Jeshaiah ahi; Rephaiah tapate, Arnan tapate, Obadiah tapate, Shekaniah tapate.
Shekaniah tapa Shemaiah ahi. Huan Shemaiah tapate: Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah, leh Shaphat, guk ahi uh.
Neariah tapate: Elioenai, Hizkiah, leh Azrikam, thum ahi uh.
Elioenai tapate: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, leh Anani, sagih ahi uh.
Judah tapate: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur leh Shobal ahi uh.
Shobal tapa Reaiah in Jahath asuang; Jahath in Ahumai leh Lahad asuang hi. Hiaite Zorathit inkote ahi uh.
Huan hiaite Etam pa tapate ahi uh: Jezreel, Ishma, leh Idbash: huan asanggamnu uh Hazelelponi ahi.
Gedor pa Penuel ahi a, Hushah pa Ezer ahi. Hiaite Ephrathah ta masa, Bethlehem pa, Hur tapate ahi uh.
Tekoa pa Ashur in zi nih, Helah leh Naarah anei hi.
Naarah in Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, leh Haahashtari aneihsak hi. Hiaite Naarah tapate ahi uh.
Helah tapate Zereth, Izhar, leh Ethnan ahi uh.
Koz in Anub leh Zobebah, Harum tapa Aharhel inkote asuang hi.
Huan Jabez bel a-unaute sang in azahtakhuaizaw a: anu'n amin Jabez asa a, "Lungkhamna toh amah ka neih ziak in," chi in.

Jabez in Israel' Pathian asam a, "Aw hon vualzawl mahmah in, ka gam liansak in, na khut ka kiang ah om in, hoih lou a kipan in kei hon kem in, hon lungkham saklouhna ding in," chi in. Huchi in Pathian in anget aphalta hi.
Huan Shuhah sanggampa Kelub in Eshton pa Mehir asuang hi.
Eshton in Beth-rapha, Paseah, Irnahash pa Tehinnah asuang hi. Hiaite Rekah mite ahi uh.
Huan Kenaz tapate: Othniel, Seraiah; huan Othniel tapate: Hathat.
Meonothai in Ophrah asuang; Seraiah in Geharasim pa Joab asuang; khutsiam mite chih in a-om uhi.
Huan Jephunneh tapa Kaleb tapate: Iru, Elah leh Naam ahi uh. Elah tapa Kenaz ahi.
Jahaleleel tapate: Ziph leh Ziphah, Tiria leh Asarel ahi uh.
Ezra tapate: Jether, Mered, Epher leh Jalon ahi uh; huan Miriam, Shammai, leh Eshtemoa pa Ishbah anei hi.
Azi Jehudijah in Jered Gedor pa, Heber Sokoh pa, leh Jekuthiel Zanoah pa asuang hi. Huchi in hiaite Mered in api, Pharaoh tanu Bithiah tapate ahi uh.
Huan Naham sanggamnu, Hodiah zi tapate: Keilah pa Garmi, leh Maakah mi Eshtemoa pa ahi uh.
Simon tapate: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, leh Tilon ahi uh. Ishi tapate: Zoheth, leh Ben-zoheth ahi uhi.
Huan Judah tapa Shelah tapate: Lekah pa Er, Mareshah pa Laadah, leh puanmalngat hoih bawlte inkuante, Ashbea inkote;
Jokim, Kozeba mite, Joash, Saraph, Moab a vaihawmna nei, Jashubi-lehem. Huchi in chiamtehna laite alui mahmah hi.
Hiaite belvel mite leh Netaim leh Gederah a tengte ahi uh. Huai ah anasepna ziak in kumpipa kiang ah ateng uhi.
Simeon tapate: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul,
atapa Shallum, atapa Mibsam, atapa Mishma.
Mishma tapate: atapa Hammuel, atapa, Zakkur, atapa Shimei.
Shimei in tapa sawm-le-guk leh tanu guk anei a, himahleh a-unaute'n tate tampi anei kei ua, Judah tate bang in, a-inkote tengteng uh leng apung kei uhi.
Amaute Beer-sheba, Moladah leh Hazar-shual ah ateng ua;
Bilhah ah, Ezem ah, Tolad ah;
Bethuel ah, Hormah ah, Ziklag ah;
Beth-markaboth ah, Hazar-susim ah leh Beth-birei ah, Shaaraim ah leng. Hiaite David vaihawm tanpha in akhopite uh ahi.
Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, Ashan, akhotate uh ahi, khopi nga ahi.
Huai kim a khotate tengteng Baal pha in ahi. Hiaite atenna uh ahi a, khangthu suina anei uhi.
Meshobab, Jamlek leh Amaziah tapa Joshah;
Joel, Joshibiah tapa Jehu, Seraiah tapa, Asiel tapa;
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel leh Benaiah;
Shiphi tapa Ziza, Allon tapa, Jedaiah tapa, Shimri tapa, Shemaiah tapa;
Hiai minlohte a-inko sung ua vaihawmte ahi uh: huan apipute uh inkote akhang mahmah uhi.
Aganhon uh a dia loupa nek ding zong ding in, phaizang suahlam pang tanpha in, Gedor lutna chiang pha in apai uhi.
Loupa nek hoihna leh tamna amu ua, gam za leh dai, ban ah galmuang; tuma a huai a omte lah Ham a kipante ahi uhi.

Hiai min gelhte Judah kumpipa Hezekiah dam lai in ahong pai ua, apuaninte uh leh huai a om Meun mite asual ua, amaute ahihse vek ua, tuni tan in amun uah ateng uh; huai lai a agante uh a dia louhing a-om ziak in.
Alak ua khenkhatte, Simeon tapate, mi zanga, aheutute uh Ishi tapate Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah leh Uzziel makaih in Seir tang ah ahoh uhi.
Asuakta Amalek mite lak a khosuaksunte asual ua, tuni tan in huai ah ateng uhi.

Huan Israel ta masapen Reuben tapate (amah piang masapen ahi a; himahleh apa lupna ahihbuah ziak in, piandan a u-pa hihna Israel tapa, Joseph tapate kiang a piak ahi; huchi in upatna dungzui in khangthu akisim kei hi.
A-unaute tung ah Judah avualzou a, amah a kipan in vaihawmtu ahong om a; himahleh upatna Joseph a ahi).
Israel ta masapen Reuben tapate: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, leh Karmi.
Joel tapate: atapa Shemaiah, atapa Gog, atapa Shimei,
atapa Mikah, atapa Reaiah, atapa Baal;
atapa Beerah, atapa Assuria, kumpipa Tilgath-pilneser in apimang; amah Reuben mite vaihawmtu ahi.
Huan akhangthute uh khangthu sutna akisim lai a a-inkuankuan ua a-unaute; hausa makaipa, Jeiel leh Zekariah,

Suahlam ah luipi Euphrates a kipan gamdai lutna pha in atengta hi; Gilead gam a agante uh apun ziak in.

Huan Gad tapate amau zawntak ah, Salkah tan in Bashan gam ah ateng uh:
Hausa makai Joel leh azom Shapham, Janai leh Bashan ah Shaphat:
Apipute uh inkote a-unaute uh: Mikael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia leh Eber, sagih ahi uh.
Hiaite Huri tapa Abihail tapate ahi uh, Jaroah tapa, Gilead tapa, Mikael tapa. Jeshishai tapa. Jahdo tapa, Buz tapa;
Abdiel tapa Ahi, Guni tapa, apipute uh inkote hausapa.
Bashan a Gilead ah, akhopite, Sharon huapkhakte tengteng, agamgi tanpha ah ateng uhi.
Hiaite tengteng Judah Kumpipa Jotham dam lai leh Israel kumpipa Jeroboam dam lai in akhangthute in sim in a-om vek uhi.
Reuben tapate leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhat mihangsante, namsau leh lum thuah thei mite leh thalpeu a kap ding, kidou siam, galkap dia kuan thei, singli sangli zasagih-le-sawmguk ahi uh.
Hagarit mite, Jetur toh, Naphish toh, Nodab toh akidou uhi.
