Amaute dou ding in panpih in a-om ua, huchi in Hagarit mite akhut ua piak in a-om ua, akiang ua om tengteng toh; amau lah Pathian kiang ah kidouna ah akap ngal ua, Pathian in angetna uh aza a; amah a amuanna uh akoih ziak un.
Huchi in agante uh alamang ua; asangawngsau uh singnga, belam nuainih-le-singnga, sabiltung sangnih, mite nuaikhat.
Kidouna Pathian a ahih ziak in, mi tampi petmah apuk uhi. Huchi in saltanna tanpha in amun uah atengta uhi.
Huan Manasseh nam kimkhatte tate gamsung ah ateng ua: Bashan a kipan Baal-hermon leh Senir leh Hermon tang tan in apung uhi.
Hiaite Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, Jahdiel, mihat hangsante, miminthangte, apipute uh inkuan a lupente ahi uhi.
Huchi in apipute uh Pathian dou in atalek ua, ama ua Pathian in ahihsiat, gam a mite pathiante lak ah ang akawm uhi.

Israel' Pathian in Assuria kumpipa Pul kha leh Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser kha atokthou a, huchi in amaute apimang a, Reuben mite leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte mahmah, Halah, Habor, Hara leh Gozan lui pha in api a, tuni tanpha a-om uh.
Levi Tapate: Gershom, Kohath, Merari ahi uh.
Huan Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel ahi uh.
Amram tate: Aaron, Mosi, Miriam ahi uh. Aaron tapate: Nadab leh Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uh.
Eleazar in Phinehas asuang a, Phinehas in Abishua asuang;
Abishua in Bukki asuang a, Bukki in Uzzi asuang;
Uzzi in Zerahiah asuang a, Zerahiah in Meraioth asuang;
Meraioth in Amariah asuang a, Amariah in Ahitub asuang;
Ahitub in Zadok asuang a, Zadok in Ahimaaz asuang;
Ahimaaz in Azariah asuang a, Azariah in Johanan asuang;
Johanan in Azariah asuang a, amah Jerusalem a Solomon inn lam lai siampu nasep sempa ahi:
Huan Azariah in Amariah asuang a, Amariah in Ahitub asuang;
Ahitub in Zadok asuang a, Zadok in Shallum asuang;
Shallum in Hilkiah asuang a, Hilkiah in Azariah asuang;
Azariah in Seraiah asuang a, Seraiah in Jahozadak asuang;
TOUPA'N Nebukadnezzar khut a Judah leh Jerusalem apimang lai in saltanna lam ah Jahozadak apitel hi.
Levi tapate: Gershom, Kahath leh Merari Jahozadak ahi uh.
Hiaite Gershom tapate minte ahi uh: Libni leh Shimei.
Kohath tapate: Amram, Ezhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi uh.
Merari tapate: Mahli leh Mushi ahi uh. Hiaite apipute uh inkote dungzui in Levite inkuante ahi uh.
Gershom a kipan: Atapa Libni, atapa Jahath, atapa Zimmah;
atapa Joah, atapa Iddo, atapa Zerah, atapa Jeatherai.
Kohath tapate: Atapa Amminadab, atapa Korah, atapa Assir;
atapa Elkanah, atapa Ebiasaph, atapa Assir;
atapa Tahath, atapa Uriel, atapa Uzziah, atapa Shaul.
Elkanah tapate: Amasai leh Ahimoth ahi a,
atapa Elkanah, atapa Zophai, atapa Nahath,
atapa Eliab, atapa Jeroham, atapa Elkanah.
Samuel tapate: Ata masapen Joel, azom Abiah ahi.
Merari tapate: Mahli, atapa Libni, atapa Shimei, atapa Uzzah;
atapa Shimea, atapa Haggiah, leh atapa Asaiah.
Huan hiaite David in thukhun bawm akhawl nung a, TOUPA insung a la a nasepna tung a heutu a akoihte ahi uh.
Jerusalem a Solomon in TOUPA' inn alam khit masiah, kihoupihna biakbuk ma ah la sa in nna asem uhi. Athupiak bang zel un anasepna uh ahih uhi.
Hiaite atapate toh nasemte ahi uhi. Kohath mite tapate ahihleh: Lasami Heman, Joel tapa, Samuel tapa;
Elkanah tapa, Jeroham tapa, Eliel tapa, Toah tapa;
Zuph tapa, Elkanah tapa, Mahath tapa, Amasai tapa;
Elkanah tapa, Joel tapa, Azariah tapa, Zephaniah tapa;
Tahath tapa, Assir tapa, Ebiasaph tapa, Korah tapa;
Ezhar tapa, Kohath tapa, Levi tapa, Israel tapa.
A-unaupa Asaph, ataklam pang a dinghpa, Asaph Berekiah tapa mahmah, Shimea tapa;
Mikael tapa, Baaseiah tapa, Malkijah tapa;
Ethni tapa, Zerah tapa, Adaiah tapa;
Ethan tapa, Zimmah tapa, Shimei tapa,
Jahath tapa, Gershom tapa, Levi tapa,
akhut veilam ah a-unaute uh Merari tapate: Kishi tapa Etham, Malluk tapa Abdi;
Hashabiah tapa, Amaziah tapa, Hilkiah tapa;
Amzi tapa, Bani tapa, Shamer tapa;
Mahli tapa, Mushi tapa, Merari tapa, Levi tapa.
A-unaute uh Levi mite Pathian inn biakbuk a nasepna tengteng a ding a aseh ahi uhi.

Himahleh Aaron leh atapate'n halmang maitam tung ah, gimlim maitam tung ah, Mun Siangthoupen a nasepna tengteng a ding in alan uh; Pathian sikha Mosi thupiak tengteng bang a, Israel a ding a tatna bawl ding in.
Huan hiaite Aaron tapate ahi uh: atapa Eleazar, tapa Phinehas, atapa, Abishua;
atapa Bukki, atapa Uzzi, atapa Zerahiah;
atapa Meraioth, atapa Amariah, atapa Ahitub;
atapa Zadok, atapa Ahimaaz ahi.
Huchi in hiaite agamgite ua apuanin kaihnate uh dungzui a atenna uh ahi: Aaron tapate kiang ah, Kohath mite inkote a, amau mun ding a ai san a piak masakpen ahi.
Amau kiang ah Judah gam ah Hebron leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi;
Himahleh huai a khopi munte leh khotate, Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kiang ah apia uhi.
Aaron tapate kiang ah kihumbitna khopite apia uh, Hebron; Libna leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jattir, Eshtemoa leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Hilen leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Debir leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Ashan leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-shemesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.

Huan Benjamin nam a kipan; Geba leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Allemeth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Anathoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh. A-inkuante tengteng a akhopite tengteng uh khopi sawm-le-thum ahi hi.
Kohath tapa omlaite kiang ah, huai nam inkuan a kipan, nam kimkhat, Manasseh nam kimkhat a kipan khopi sawm aisan a piak ahi uhi.
Huan Gershom tapate ahihleh, a-inkuante uh dungzui in, Issakar nam a kipan, Asher nam a kipan, Naphtali nam a kipan, Bashan a Manasseh nam a kipan, khopi sawm-le-thum ahi.
Merari tapate kiang ah aisan a piak ahi, a-inkote uh dungzui in, Reuben nam a kipan, Gad nam a kipan, Zebulun nam a kipan, khopi sawm-le-nihte.
Israel suante'n Levi mite kiang ah khopite leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi.
Judah tate nam a kipan, Simeon tapa nam a kipan, Benjamin tate nam a kipan, hiai khopi minlohte, aisan in apia uhi.
Kohath tapa inkote lak a khenkhatte'n Ephraim nam a kipan amau gamgi khopite anei uhi.
Amaute kiang ah bitna khopite apia uh, Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Gezer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Jokmeam leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-horon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Aijalon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gath-rimmon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Manasseh nam kimkhat a kipan Aner leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Bileam leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kohath tapate inko lak a omlaite a ding in.
Gershom tapa kiang ah, Manasseh nam kimkhat inkuan a kipan a piak ahi; Bashan a Golan leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Astaroth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Issakar nam a kipan in: Kedesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Daberath leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Ramoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Anem leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Asher nam a kipan in: Mashal leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Abdon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Hukok leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Rehob leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Naphtali nam a kipan in: Galili a Kedesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Hammon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kiriathaim leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Levi mite omlaite kiang ah, Merari tapate, Zebulun nam a kipan a piak ahi, Rimmon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Tabor leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Jeriko a Jordan khen, suahlam pang, Reuben nam a kipan, amaute piak ahi, gamdai a Bezer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jahzah leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Kedemoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mephaath leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Gad nam a kipan in: Gilead a Ramoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mahanaim leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Heshbon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jazer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Issakar tapate: Tola, Puah, Jashub, Shimron, li ahi uh.
Tola tapate: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, Shemuel, apipute uh inkuan a lupente, huai bel, Tola a kipante; akhangte ua mihat hangsante: David dam lai in singnih sangnih-le-zaguk ahi uh.
Huan Uzzi tapa Izrahiah ahi, huan Izrahiah tapate: Mikael, Obadiah, Joel, Isshiah, nga ahi ua, avek un hausa makaipente ahi uh.
Amaute toh, apipute uh inkote dan in, akhangte un, kidouna ding a sepaih pawlte ahi ua, singthum-le-sangguk; zi leh tapa tampi anei uhi.
Huan Issakar inkote tengteng lak a, mihat hangsante, a-unaute uh avek ua khangthu sutna a sut in, singgiat-le-sangsagih ahi.
Benjamin tapate: Bela, Beker, Jediael, thum ahi uh.
Bela tapate: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, Iri, nga ahi ua; pipute inkuan a lupente, mihat hangsante; huan khangthu sutna a sim in singnih sangnih sawmthum-le-li ahi uh.
Beker, tapate: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, Alameth ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Beker tapate ahi uh.
Huchi in khangthu sutna a sim ahi ua, akhangte uh dungzui in, apipute uh inkuan a lupente, mihat hangsante, singnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
Huan Jediael tapa Bilhan ahi; Bilhan tapate: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, Ahisahar.
Hiaite tengteng Jediael tapate ahi uh, apipute uh inkuan a lupente dungzui in, mihat hangsan, kidouna a dia sepaih pawl a kuankhe thei dingte, singkhat sangsagih-le-zanih ahi uh.
Ir tapate Shuppim leh Huppim ahi ua, Aher tapa Hushim ahi.
Naphtali tapate: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer leh Shallum, Bilhah tapate ahi uh.
Manasseh tapate: Asriel, azi in asuan: amei Aram numei in Gilead pa Makir asuang hi;
Makir in Huppim leh Shuppim sanggamnu amin Maakah zi in api a; anihna min Zelophehad ahi: Zelophehad in tanute anei hi.
Makir zi Maakah in tapa anei a, amin Peresh asa a; a-unaupa min Sheresh ahi; atapate Ulam leh Rakem ahi uh.
Ulam tapa Bedan ahi. Hiaite Gilead tapate ahi uh Makir tapa, Manasseh tapa.
Asanggamnu Hammoleketh in Ishod, Abiezer, Mahlah anei hi.
Shemida tapate Ahian, Shekem, Likhi, Aniam ahi uh.
Huan Ephraim tapate: Shuthelah, leh atapa Bered, leh atapa Tahath, leh atapa Eleadah, leh atapa Tahath,
leh atapa Zabad, leh atapa Shuthelah, huan Ezer leh Elead, agante uh lamang ding a ahong paisuk ua gamsung a om Gath mite'n athahte uh.
Apa uh Ephraim in ni tampi asuun a, huchi in amah lungmuan ding in a-unaute ahong uhi.
Huchi in azi kiang ah ahoh a, nau apai a, tapa anei a, a-insung tuahsiat ziak in amin ding in Beriah asa hi.
Atanu Sheerah ahi a, Beth-horon nuainung leh tungnung leh Uzzen- sheerah lamnu ahi.
Rephah atapa ahi, Reseph leng; Reseph tapa Telah, Tahan atapa;
Laadan atapa, Ammihud atapa, Elishama atapa;
Nun atapa, Joshua atapa ahi.
Aneihte uleh atennate uh Bethel leh akhotate ahi, suahlam ah Naaran, tumlam ah Gezer, huai khopite toh, huai Ayyah leh khopite tan in.
Manasseh tate gamgi chin ah, Beth-shean leh akhopite, Taanak leh akhopite, Meggiddo leh akhopite, Dor leh akhopite, hiaite ah Israel tapa Joseph tapate ateng uhi.
Asher tapate: Imnah, Ishuah, Ishuai, Beriah, Sheerah asanggamnu uh.
Beriah tapate: Heber, Malkiel, Birzaith pa.
Heber in Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, Shua asanggamnu asuang hi.
Japhlet tapate: Pasak, Bimhal, Asvath. Hiaite Japhlet tapate ahi uh.
Shamer tapate: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah leh Aram.
A-unaupa Helem tapate: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, Amal.
Zophah tapate: Suah, Hernephar, Shual, Beri, Imrah;
Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, Beera.
Jether tapate: Jephunneh, Pispah, Ara.
Ulla tapate: Arah, Hanniel, Rezia.
Hiaite tengteng Asher tate ahi uh; pipute inkuan a lupente, mihat, mitel, hangsan, kumpi tapate lak a vaihawmte. Kidouna nasepna ding a khangthu sutna a sim in amau zah singnih-le-sangguk ahi uhi.
Huchi in Benjamin in ata masa Bela, azom Ashbel, athumna Aharah asuang;
alina Nohah, angana Rapha ahi.
Bela in tapate anei a, Addar, Gera leh Abihud;
Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah;
Gera, Shephuphan, Huram.
Hiaite Ehud tapate ahi uh: hiaite Geba a tengte pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh, huchi in amaute Manahath ah sal in api uhi.
Naaman, Ahiah, Gera, amaute sal in api a; Uzza leh Ahihud asuang hi.
Shaharaim in amaute asawlmang nung in, Moab mun ah tapate asuang; azite Hushim leh Baar ahi uh.
Azi Hodesh a pan, Jobab, Zibia, Messa leh Malkam asuang hi;
Jeuz, Sakia, Mirma. Hiaite pipute inkuan a lupente, atapate ahi uhi.
Hushim lak ah Abitub leh Elpaal asuang hi.
Elpaal tapate: Eber, Misham, Shamed, Ono lamkhetu leh Lod, huai khopite toh lampa.
Beriah, Shema, Aijalon, Gath a tengteng delhzakte tengtengte pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh;
Ahio, Shakshak, Jeremoth;
Zebadiah, Arad, Edar,
Beriah tapate Mikael, Ishpah, Joha.
Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hezeki, Heber;
Ishmerai, Jezliah, Jobab, Elpaal tapate,
Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi;
Elienai, Zilthai, Eliel;
Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, Shimei tapate:
Ishpan, Heber, Eliel;
Abdon, Zikri, Hanan;
Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah;
Ipdeiah, Penuel, Shashak tapate;
Samserai, Shehariah, Athaliah;
Jaaresiah, Eliah, Zikri, Jeroham tapate.
Hiaite akhangte ua pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh, ahausa makaipente: hiaite Jerusalem ah ateng uhi.
Gibeon ah Gibeon pa ateng a, azi min Maakah ahi:
Atapa masapen Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab;
Gedor, Ahio, Zaker.
Mikloth in Shimea asuang hi. Anaute uh toh Jerusalem ah a-unaute uh zom ah ateng lai uhi.
Ner in Kish asuang; Kish in Saul asuang; Saul in Jonathan, Malki-shua, Abinadab leh Eshbaal asuang hi.
Jonathan tapa Merib-baal ahi a; Merib-baal in Mikah asuang hi.
Mikah tapate: Pithon, Melek, Tarea leh Ahaz ahi uh.
Ahaz in Jehoaddah asuang; Jehoaddah in Alemeth, Azmaveth leh Zimri asuang; Zimri in Moza asuang;
Moza in Binea asuang; Rapha atapa, Eleasah atapa, Azel atapa:
Azel in tapa guk anei a, amin uh hiaite ahi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan. Hiaite tengteng Azel tapate ahi.
Unaupa Eshek tapate: Ulam ata masa, Jehush a zom, Eliphelet athumna ahi.
Ulam tapate mihat hangsan, thalkap mite ahi uh, tapate' tapate, tupate tampi, zakhat-le-sawmnga ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Benjamin tapate ahi uhi.
Huchi in Israel tengteng khangthu a sim in a-om ua; huan, ngai in, Israel leh Judah Kumpipate Laibu ah gelh in a-om uhi: atatlekna ziak un Babulon lam ah sal a pimang in a-om uh.
Amau tante akhopite ua teng masapente bel, Israel, siampute, Levi mite leh Nethinim mite ahi uhi.
Jerusalem ah Judah tate, Benjamin tate, Ephraim leh Manasseh tate ateng uhi.
Ammihud tapa Uthai, Omri tapa, Imri tapa, Bani tapa, Perez tapate ah Judah tapa.
Shilon mite; Asaiah piang masapen leh atapate.
Zerah tapate ah; Jeuel, a-unaute, zaguk-le-sawmkua ahi uh.
Benjamin tapate ah; Meshullam tapa Sallu, Hodaviah tapa, Hassenuah tapa;
Huan Jeroham tapa Ibneiah, Uzzi tapa Elah, Mikri tapa, Shephatiah tapa Meshallum, Reuel tapa, Ibnijah tapa.
A-unaute uh, akhangte uh dungzui in, zakua sawmnga-le-guk ahi uh. Hiai mite tengteng apipute uh inkote dungzui a alupente ahi uhi.
Huan siampute ah: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib; Jachin;
Hilkiah tapa Azariah, Meshullam tapa, Ahitub tapa, Pathian inn a vaihawmpa;
Jeroham tapa Adaiah, Pashur tapa, Malkijah tapa, Maasai Adiel tapa, Jahzerah tapa, Meshullam tapa, Meshillemit tapa, Immer tapa;
A-unaute uh, apipute uh lupente, sangkhat zasagih-le-sawmguk; Pathian inn a nasepna thilhihna ding a mihithei mahmahte ahi uh.
Huan Levi mite ah: Hashub tapa Shemaiah, Azrikam tapa, Hashabiah tapa, Merari tapate ah;
Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, Mika tapa Mattaniah, Zikri tapa, Asaph tapa;
Shemaiah tapa Obadiah, Galal tapa, Jeduthun tapa, Asa tapa Berekiah, Elkanah tapa, Netophah mite khuate a tengte.
Huan kongkhak ngak mite; Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, a-unaute uh, Shallum bel amakaipen ahi.
Kumpipa kongpi suahlam pang ngak sek: Levi tate puanin a dia kongkhak ngak mite ahi uhi.

Kore tapa Shallum, Ebiasaph tapa, Korah tapa, a-unaute, apa inkote a, Korah mite, nasepna thilhihna a heutu ahi ua, biakbuk kongpite ngak mite: apipute uh TOUPA puanin tung a heutu, biakbuk lutna ngak mite ahi uhi.
Eleazar tapa Phinehas hun paisa ah amaute tung a vaihawmpa ahi a, akiang ah TOUPA a-om hi.
Meshelemiah tapa Zekariah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ngakpa ahi.
Hiaite tengteng kongpite kongkhak ngak mite hi ding a telte zanih sawm-le-nih ahi uh. Hiaite akhuate ua khangthu a simte ahi ua, asep ding uh bawlsa a David leh zawlnei Samuel in ahihkipsate ahi uhi.
Huchi in amau leh atapate un TOUPA' inn kongpite, adandan in, biakbuk inn nangawn in akem uhi.
Apang lite ah, suahlam, tumlam, mallam, simlam ah kongkhak ngak mite a-om uhi.
A-unaute uh, akallak lak in ni sagih nite teng in amau kiang a om ding in ahong pai zel ding uh ahi:
Kongkhak ngakpipen lite lah, Levi mite, sep ding sehsa a om ahi ua, Pathian insung a dantante leh sumkoihnate tung ah heutu ahi uhi.
Huai lai a thupiak amau tung a a-om ziak in, Pathian inn kimvel ah agiak ua, zingsang teng in huai hon ding amau nasep ahi.
Huan alak ua kuate hiam in nasepna tui-um belsuante akem ua; alaklut uleh alakkhiak teng un aphazah asim gige uhi.
Alak ua khenkhatte vante, mun siangthoupen tui-um belsuan tangbuang nelte, uainte, sathaute begaw leh gimnamtuite kem ding a seh ahi uhi.
Siampute tapate lak a akhente gimnamtuite toh hel in abawl uh.
Mattithiah, Levi mite, Korah mi Shallum ta masapen lak a khat in belliangneite kan thilte tung a nasepna sehsa anei hi.
A-unaute uh lak a akhen, Sabbathte a bawl ding in, Kohath mite tapate'n tanghou akem uhi.
Hiaite lasa mite ahi ua, Levi mite inkote pipute inkuan a lupente, dantante sung ah ateng ua, sun leh zan in anasepna ua zat in a-om ua, nasepna dangte a kipan a-awl uhi.
Akhang pumpite uah, hiaite Levi mite pipute inkuan makaipente ahi uh, amakaipente: hiaite Jerusalem ah ateng uhi.
Huan Gibeon ah Gibeon pa ateng a, Jehiel, azi min Maakah:
Atapa masapen Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab;
Gedor, Ahio, Zekariah, Mikloth.
Huan Mikloth in Shimeam asuang a, huchi in amau leng a-unaute uh toh Jerusalem ah, a-unaute uh zawn ah ateng uhi.
Ner in Kish asuang a; Kish in Saul asuang; Saul in Jonathan, Malki- shua, Abinadab leh Eshbaal asuang hi.
Jonathan tapa bel Merib-baal ahi; Merib-baal in Mikah asuang hi.
Huan Mikah tapate: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea leh Ahaz.
Ahaz in Jarah asuang; Jara in Alameth, Azmaveth leh Zimri asuang hi; Zimri in Moza asuang hi.
Moza in Binea asuang; Rephaiah atapa, Eleasah atapa, Azel atapa;
Azel in tapa guk anei a, amin uh hiaite ahi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan: hiaite Azel tapate ahi uh.
Paul, Pathian deihlam a Jesu Khrist sawltak hi ding a sap leh i unaupa Sostheni in,
Korinth a Pathian saptuam omte, Khrist Jesu a sehtuam siangthoute, misiangthou hi ding a sapte leh gam chih a i Toupa, amau leh eite Toupa, Jesu Khrist min lou tengteng kiang ah;
Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Khrist Jesu a Pathian hehpihna noute kiang a hong kipiak ziak in na tungthu uah Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen gige a;
bangkim ah thugen peuhmah ah leh theihna chiteng ah, amah ahihhauh in na om uhi.
Huchi in Khrist thu ka theihsak pen noumau ah hihkip in a-om hi.
Huan i Toupa Jesu Khrist kilakna ngak kawm in, khalam thilpiak himhim na tasam kei uhi.
Ama'n i Toupa Jesu Khrist ni chiang a gensiatbei a na omna ding un, atawp pha in hon hihkip behlap ding hi.
A Tapa Jesu Khrist i Toupa toh kithuahna nei ding a nou hon samlutpa, Pathian amuanhuai hi.

Huan unaute aw, na vek un thu kibang na gen ua, na lak ua kikhenna himhim a-omlouhna ding in lungsim mun khat leh ngaihtuah mun khat a diktak a na kizop tinten zawkna ding un Toupa Jesu Khrist min in ka hon ngen ahi.
Ka unaute aw, na tungtang thu uh, na lak uah kiselna a-om chih Kloi inkuanpihte'n hon hilh uhi.
Hiai ka chihna ahi, nou sung a khat-le-khat in, "Kei Paul pawl ka hi, kei Apollos pawl ka hi, kei Kifas pawl ka hi, kei zaw Khrist pawl ka hi," na chih uh.
Khrist khenzak in a-om a hia? Na sik un Paul kilhden in a-om a hia? Ahihkeileh Paul min in baptis in na om ua hia?
Khrispas leh Gaias lou ngal na lak uah mi kuamah ka hon baptis louh ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen ahi.
Huchi hi keileh zaw mi'n keimah min a baptis na hi uh achi kha ding uhi.
Stephenas inkuanpihte bel ka baptis ngei a, tuate lou zaw midang ka baptis hia ka thei kei.
Khrist in baptis ding in hon sawl kei a, tanchinhoih gen ding in ahon sawl zaw hi; thupil a gen lou in, huchi lou in zaw Khrist kros thilhihtheihna bangmah lou asuaksak kha ding uhi.
Kros thu zaw mangthang lelte a ding in haina ahi ngal a; ei hotdam lelte a ding in bel Pathian thilhihtheihna ahi zaw hi.
"Mipil' pilna ka hihmang ding a, lemthei' lemtheihna leng ka paikhe ding," chih gelh ahi.
Mipil koi ah ahia? Laigelhmi koi ah ahia? Hiai khovel a selhatmi koi ah ahia? Pathian in khovel pilna haihuai ahi chih atheisak kei a hia?
Pathian pilna ah bel, khovel in apilna zang a Pathian atheihtheih louh nung in thugen haihuai zang a agingtate hotdam akipah lam ahi.
Judate'n chiamtehnate aphut ua, Grikte'n pilna'n azong uh.
Eite'n bel Khrist kilhden thu i gen ua; huai tuh Judate a ding in pukna, Zentelte a ding in haina ahi.
Himahleh Judate leng hi hen aw, Grikte leng hi heh, sapte a ding in zaw Khrist, Pathian thilhihtheihna leh Pathian pilna pen ahi.
Pathian haina mihing sang in apilzaw a, Pathian hatlouhna leng mihing sang in ahatzaw hi.
Unaute aw, ahon sapna ngaihtuah dih ua, salam a mipil tampite, mihat tampite, mihoih pipite, sap ahihlouhdan uh;
himahleh Pathian in mipilte azahlaksak theihna ding in khovel thil haite atel a; huan Pathian in khovel thil hatloute atel a, ahatte azahlaksak theihna ding in;
khovel thil niam leh simmohhuaite, thil omloute tan in Pathian in atel a; thil omte bangmah lou a abawltheihna ding in.
Huchi in Pathian ma ah mi kuamah aki-uangsak thei kei ding uh.
Amah ziak in noute Khrist Jesu ah na om uhi; Pathian in Khrist i pilna, i diktatna, i sianthouna leh i tatna hi ding in abawlta hi,
hichi a gelh ahih bang in, "Asuang peuhmah in Toupa suang hen."
Unaute aw, hiaite na theih louh uh ka deih kei, huchi a i pipute tengteng meipi nuai a a-om vek ua, avek ua tuipi leng akan ua,
avek ua meipi leh tuipi a Mosi a baptis lut a a-om vek ua,
avek ua khalam an kibang anek chiat ua,
avek ua khalam dawn ding kibang adawn chiatdan uh. Amaute zui, khalam Suangpi a pan adawn chiat ngal ua; huai Suangpi Khrist ahi.
Himahleh alak ua mi tamzaw tung ah Pathian alunghita kei a; gamdai ah apuklum uhi.
Huan huai thilte ei ding a etton ding ahi, thil gilou alunggulh bang ua i lunggulh samlouhna ding in.
Alak ua khenkhat milim bemi ahih bang un milim bemi hi kei un, "Mipite ne ding leh dawn ding in atu ua, lam ding in adingh nawn chiat uh," chih gelh bang in.
Alak ua khenkhat in nungak angai ua, ni khat in singnih-le-sangthum in apuklup loh bang un, i kingai kei ding uh.
Alak ua khenkhat in Toupa aze-et ua, gul a hihman a a-om bang un, Toupa zaw i ze-et kei ding uh.
Alak ua khenkhat aphun ua, hihmangthangpa hihmanthat a a-om bang un, phun sam kei ni.
Huan huaite vaukholhna ding in atung uah ahong tung hi; eite, hun tawp hong tunnate, hon thuhilhna ding a leng gelh ahi uhi.
Huaiziak in dingh a kingaihtuah pilvang hen, huchi lou in zaw apuk kha ding hi.

Mihing thuak theih val khemna himhim na tuang uah atung ngei kei hi. Pathian zaw amuanhuai hi, ama'n na thuak theih val uh khemna na tuah uh aphal kei ding; na thuaktheihna ding un khemna peuh ah taikhiakna lampi abawl zaw ding hi.
Huaiziak in ka deihtakte aw, milim biak taisan un.
Mipilte kiang a gen bang in ka thugente ngaihtuah un.
Vualzawlna nou a ka hon vualzawl uh, Khrist sisan kikoppihna ahi kei a hia? Tanghou ka balkhap uh Khrist pumpi kikoppihna ahi kei a hia?
Eite mi tampi tanghou beu khat, pum khat i hi uh; i vek un tanghou beu khat ah i tang chiat uhi.
Salam a Israelte en dih ua; kithoihna sa nete'n maitam thilte akikoppih kei ua hia?
Bang ka genna ahia le? Milim lak a kithoihna leh milim leng banghiamtak ahi chih ka genna hia?
Zentelte kithoihna, Pathian lak ah hilou in dawite lak ah akithoih uh ahi chih ka gen zaw ahi; noute zaw dawite toh na kithuah uh hon deih lou ka hi.
Toupa nou leh dawi nou na dawnkhawm thei kei ding uh; Toupa dohkan leh dawi dohkan ah na nekhawm thei sam kei ding uh.
Ahihkeileh Toupa hazatna tohthoh i tum uh ahi maw? Amah sang in i hatzaw ua hia?
"Thil bangkim hih asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih ahoih kei, "Thil bangkim hih asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih in mi abawlhoih kei hi.
Kuapeuh in amah hoihna ding zong lou in midang hoihna ding zong zaw hen.
Sa dawr a azuak peuhmah uh na sia-le-pha theihna ziak un bangmah dong lou in ne un.
"Lei leh asung a tengteng Toupa a ahi ngal a."
Gingloumi lak a kuahiam in nou hon sap a, hoh na ut ngal un, sia-le-pha theihna ziak in bangmah dong lou in, ahon lui peuh uh ne un.
Himahleh kuahiam in, "Hiai zaw kithoihna ahi chi a ahon hilh leh sia-le-pha theihna ziak leh nou a hon hilhpa ziak in ne kei un,"
Nangmah sia-le-pha theihna ka chi kei a, ama sia-le-pha theihna pen ahi ka chih zawk. Bang achia midang sia-le-pha theihna in ka noplenna thunun ahia?
Kipaktak a ka tanleh atung a kipahthu ka genna tung ah bang ding a gensiat a om ka hia?
Huchi in na nek uhiam na dawn uhiam, na hih peuhmah uh, Pathian thupina ding ngen in hih un.
Judate a ding hiam, Grikte a ding hiam, Pathian saptuamte a ding hiam in apukna ding uh bangmah hih kei un.
Ke'n keimah phattuamna zong lou a, hotdam ahihtheihna ding ua mi tampi phattuamna zong a, mi tengteng bangkim a ka kipahsak bang in.
Hon enzuite hi un, kei leng Khrist enzuipa ka hih mah bang in.
Huan bangkim a na hon theihgige ziak un leh thukhah ka hon hilh bang a na vom tinten ziak un ka hon phat ahi.
Himahleh pasal peuhmah lutang Khrist ahi, numei lutang pasal ahi, Khrist lutang Pathian ahi chih na theih uh ka deih hi.
Pasal alu khuh kawm a thum hiam, thu gen hiam peuhmah in, alu aselphou hi.
Himahleh numei alu khuh lou a thum hiam, thu gen hiam peuhmah in alu selphou ahi; metmai toh kibang ahi.
Numei alu khuh lou a a-om ngalleh met vanglak hen. Himahleh, numei a ding a sam met leh metmai azumhuaileh alu khuh hen.
Pasal zaw Pathian batpih leh thupina ahih ziak in alu akhuh ding hilou himhim ahi; numei bel pasal thupina ahi.
Numei a kipan pasal pawt ahi kei a; numei bel pasal a kipan a pawt ahi zaw hi;
numei a dia pasal siam ahi kei a; numei bel pasal a dia siam ahi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in angelte ziak in numei in pasal thuneihna chiamtehna akhuk ding ahi.
Himahleh Toupa thilgeldan ah, pasal lou in numei a-om thei kei a, pasal leng numei lou in a-om thei sam kei hi.
Pasal a kipan a numei pawt ahih bang in, pasal leng numei lak a piang ahi ngal a; himahleh bangkim Pathian a kipan a pawt vek ahi.
Noumau kingaihtuah dih ua, numei in alu khuh lou a Pathian kiang a thum akilawm hiam?
Pasal in samsau aneihleh amah a ding in azumhuai ahi chih na lungtang pianpih un leng ahon theisak kei a hia?
Numei in bel samsau aneihleh amah a ding in thupina ahi zaw; kikhuhna ding a asam piak ahih ziak in.
Himahleh mi kuahiam hiai thu a agenhakleh huchibang paidan himhim i nei kei ua, Pathian saptuam pawlte'n leng anei sam kei uhi.
Himahleh nou hiai thu ka hon hilhna ah ka hon phat thei kei, na hoihsemna ding uh hilou in, na siatsemna ding ua na kikhop nak ziak un.
Amasapen in saptuamte na kikhop un, na lak uah kilangkhenna a-om chih ka za a; gin leng ka gingta sim hi.
Na lak ua ataktakte alattheihna ding un, na lak ua gintuamna leng a-om sam ding him ahi.
Na hong kikhop ua na nekkhawm uh Toupa nitak an ahi kei hi;
Michih in na nek chiang un noumau nitak an na ne masa zel ngal ua; huchi in mi khat gil akial a, adang in akham hi.

Bangchidan ahia? Nek leh dawnna ding inn na nei kei ua hia? Ahihkeileh Pathian saptuamte musit in, bangmah neiloute na selphou ua hia? Na kiang uah bang ka genta dia? K'on phat dia hia? Hiai lam thu ah ka hon phat thei kei hi.
Ka thu hon hilhsawn Toupa kiang a kipan ka muh ahi, huchi a Toupa Jesu'n matsak a a-om zan a, tanghou alak a,
kipahthu agen khit a abalkhap a, "Hiai ka pumpi nou a dia piak ahi, keimah theihgigena in hiai hih zel un,” achih.
Huchi mah bang a nitak an anek khit a nou leng alak a, "Hiai nou ka sisan a thukhun thak ahi, na dawn teng un keimah theihgigena in hih zel un," achih.
Huai tanghou na nek ua, nou na dawn teng un ahong pai nawn masiah, Toupa sihna na puangzak uhi.
Huaiziak in kuapeuh kilawmloutak a tanghou ne hiam, Toupa nou dawn hiam in Toupa pumpi leh sisan tung ah siam louh atang ding hi.
Huchi in michih amah ki-enchian zaw hen, huchibang in tanghou ne in nou dawn hen.
Ane leh dawn in Toupa pumpi ngenteltak a angaihtuah keileh amah tung a vaihawmna ding in ane in adawn hi.
Hiai ziak in na lak ua mi tampi na hat kei ua, na zawngkhal ua, tampi'n na sihloh uhi.
Himahleh ngenteltak in eimah kingaihtuah zel lehang, vai hawmsak a om nak lou ding i hi uhi.
Himahleh vai hawmsak a i om in leng khovel toh siam louh tang a i omlouhna ding in Toupa taihilh in i om zel ahi.
Huaiziak in ka unaute aw, ne ding a na kikhop un kingak chiat un.
Na kikhop uh vaihawmna na thuakpihlouhna ding un, kuapeuh in agil akialleh a-inn lam ah ne masa hen. Huan thudang zaw ka hong pai chiang in ka bawllem ding hi.
Tu in unaute aw, khalam thilpiak thute na theih louh uh ka ut kei hi.
Zentelte na hih lai un bangchidan peuh a hon pi lai un leng, huai milim pau theiloute lam ah pimang in na om uh chih na thei uhi.
Huaiziak in kuamah in, Pathian Kha a thu gen in, "Jesu hamsiat in om hen," achi ngei kei. Huan kuamah in, Kha Siangthou kia lou ngal in, "Jesu, Toupa ahi," achi ngei kei uh chih ka hon theisak hi.
Huan thilpiak tuamtuam a-om a, Kha bel kikhat ahi.
Nasepna tuamtuam leng a-om, himahleh Toupa khat ahi.
Nasepsakna tuamtuam leng a-om, himahleh Pathian khat ahi, mi tengteng a bangkim sempa ahi.
Himahleh Kha theihsakna michih kiphattuampih chiatna ding in piak ahi.
Mi khat kiang ah Kha in pilna thu apia hi; midang kiang ah, huai Kha mah in theihna thu apia hi.
Huan midang kiang a, huai Kha mah in, ginna apia a; midang kiang ah hihdamtheihna apia;
midang kiang ah thillamdang hihtheihna, midang kiang ah thugenkholh theihna, midang kiang ah khate theihkak theihna, midang kiang ah pau tuamtuamte, midang kiang ah pautuamte hilhchetna.
Himahleh hiaite tengteng Kha khat leh akikhat mah in, michih kiang ah adeih bang zel a hawm in asem hi.
Pumpi i chih khat ahi a, hiang anei a, pumpi hiangte tengteng, tam mah le uh, pumpi khat ahi a; Khrist leng huchibang mah ahi.
I vek un pumpi khat a om ding in Kha khat a baptis in i omta ua, Judate hiam, Grikte hiam, sikhate hiam sikha lou hiam; huan i vek un Kha khat a kipan dawnsak in i omta uhi.
Pumpi i chih hiang khat kia hilou in tampi ahi zaw hi.
Khepek in, "Khut ka hih louh ziak in pumpi a pang ka hi kei," chileh, huai thu ziak in pumpi a pang lou ahi tuan kei hi.
Huan bil in, "Mit ka hih louh ziak in pumpi a pang ka hi kei," chileh, huai thu ziak in pumpi a pang lou ahi tuan kei hi.
Pumpi tengteng mit hi vek taleh gingzakna koi ah a-om dia? Avek in gingzakna hitaleh, gimzakna koi ah a-om dia?
Himahleh Pathian in hiang khempeuh pumpi ah a-utna peuh ah a-omsak chiatta hi.
Huchi in huai tengteng hiang khat kia hileh pumpi pen koi ah a-om dia?
Himahleh hiang tampi ahi zaw uh, himahleh pumpi khat kia ahi.
Huan mit in, khut kiang ah, "Bangmah in ka hon deih kei," achi thei kei; lu in leng khepekte kiang ah, "Bangmah in ka hon deih kei," achi thei sam kei hi.
Huchih nak sang in, pumpi hiang hat dia kilawm lou pente akiphamohzaw mahmah uhi.
Huchi in pumpi hiang pahtawi tham louh zaw a i sehte, huaite ngei i pahtawi zaw uhi; huan i hiang kilawmloute'n kilawmna thupizaw amu zel uhi.
I hiang kilawmte'n bel huchibang a hih akiphamoh kei uhi. Pathian in, kilawmna nei lou hiang pahtawi zawk ding in, pumpi alemkhawm hi.
Huchi a pumpi a kikhenna om lou a, ahiangte'n kibangtak a akibuaipihtuah theih zawkna ding un.
Huchi in hiang khat in athuakleh hiang tengteng in athuakpih a, hiang khat pahtawi a a-omleh hiang dangte'n akipahpih zel uhi.
Huchi in noute Khrist pumpi na hi ua, ahiangte na hi chiat lai uhi.

Huan Pathian in khenkhat saptuam lak ah ahon koih a, akhatna ah sawltakte, anihna ah thugenkholte, athumna ah sinsaktute akoih a; huai nung in thillamdang hihte a-om a; huai nung in hihdamtheihna thilpiakte, panpih theihna thilpiakte, vaihawm siamna thilpiakte, pau tuamtuam a thugentheihna thilpiakte a-om nawn hi.
Avek un sawltak ahi uhia? Avek un thugenkholmi ahi uhia? Avek un sinsaktu ahi uhia?
Avek un thillamdang hihmi ahi uhia? Avek un hihdamtheihna thilpiakte ahi uhia? Avek un pautuamte in thu agen uhia? Avek un thu hilhchianmi ahi uhia?
Thilpiak thupipente lunggulh mahmah zaw un. Huan lampi hoihsem ka hon ensak ding hi.
Mihing pautuamte leh angel pautuamte in thu gen mah leng, itna ka neih keileh dak ging lel hiam, dakkhutbet ging lel hiam ka hi ding hi.
Huan thugenkholh theihna nei in, thuguk tengteng leh theihna tengteng thei vek in, mual suantheihna khop hial ginna kim nei mah leng, itna ka neih keileh bangmah ka hi kei hi.
Huan migentheite vakna ding in ka sum tengteng pe vek in, ka pumpi leng kang ding hial in kipe mah leng, itna ka neih keileh kei a ding in bangmah aphatuam kei hi.
Itna in adohzou a, amigi a; itna in ahaza kei a, akisathei sam kei;
itna aki-uangsak kei a, ahuham sam kei. Amah thu achi tentun kei a, ahehbaih kei, hehsa in a-omden sam kei;
itna in gilou akipahpih kei a, adik akipahpih zaw hi.
Itna in bangkim athuak teitei a, bangkim agingta a, bangkim alamen a, bangkim athuakkhe zel hi.
Itna zaw chikchiang mah in abei kei ding; himahleh, thugenkholhnate om mahleh hihtawp ahong hi ding a, pautuamte om mahleh ahong tawp ding a, theihnate om mahleh hihtawp ahong hi ding.
Akim lou in i thei ua, akim lou in thu i gen uhi.
Akim ahong tun chiang in akim lou hihtawp ahita ding.
Ka naupan lai in naupang pau in ka pau a, naupang theih in ka thei a, naupang ngaihtuah in ka ngaihtuah hi; tua ka hong pichin nung in naupang hihdan ka tawpsanta hi.

Tu in zaw limlang ah i mu milmial ahi, huai hun chiang in zaw kimaituah in ahita ding hi. Tu in zaw akim lou in ka thei a, himahleh huai hun chiang in zaw theih khit a ka om bang in ka theikimta ding hi.
Huchi in hiai thumte: ginna, lametna, itna, a-om gige ding ahi; himahleh hiaite a athupipen itna ahi.
Itna delh zel unla, khalam thilpiakte leng lunggulh gige un, himahleh thu na gentheihna ding uh lunggulh sem un.
Pautuamte a pau in mi kiang a thugen hilou in Pathian kiang a gen ahi zaw hi, kuamah in athugen athei kei a; himahleh kha ah thuguk agen ahi.
Thugenmi in bel mihing kiang ah bawlhoihna thute, hanthawnna thute, khamuanna thute agen zaw zel hi.
Pautuamte a pau in amah kia akibawlhoih a, thugenmi'n saptuamte abawlhoih zaw hi.

Huan na vek un pautuamte a na pau uh ka hon deihsak a, himahleh thu na gen uh ka hon deihsak sem hi; saptuamte'n kibawlhoihna amuhtheihna ding un ahilhchet nawn keileh thugenmi zaw pautuamte a pau mi sang in athupizaw hi.
Tu in unaute aw, na lak uah kilakna hiam, theihna hiam, thugen hiam, sinsakna hiam toh hong lou a, pautuamte a thu gen in hong pai leng, nou a ding in bang ka phatuam dia?
Thil hinna nei lou, gingtheite leng, tamngai hiam, kaihging hiam, gen nei a agin keileh, bang la ahia atum ua akaih uh bangchi in atheihtheih dia?
Gen nei lou a pengkul amut un kua galkap ding in akisa dia?
Huchi mah bang in nou leng pau theih baihlam a na gen kei uleh bang thu ahia na gen uh bangchi in atheihtheih dia? Huihkhua a pau lel na hi kei ding ua hia?
Khovel ah pau chi tuamtuam tampi a-om tham a, himahleh gen nei lou himhim a-om kei hi.
Apau in bang gen ahia chih ka theih keileh a genmi a ding in kei melmak ka hi ding a; a genmi leng kei a ding in melmak ahi ding.
Huchi in noute'n khalam thilpiakte na lunggulh mah bang un saptuam bawlhoihna ding in theihtawp suah in zang un.
Huaiziak in pautuamte a thu gen in ahilhchet theihna ding in thum hen.
Pautuamte a ka thumleh ka kha in zaw athum ngei a, ka theihna bel aphatuam tuan kei hi.
Bangchi in ahita dia le? Kha in ka thum dia, theihna in leng ka thum ding; kha in la ka sa dia, theihna in leng la ka sa ding hi.
Hichi lou in, Kha in vualzawl mah lechin athei nailoute'n na thugen theiloupi in na kipahthugen uh bangchi in Amen, achi thei ding ua?
Nang zaw chihtak in kipahthu na gen hoih a, midang abawlhoih tuan kei hi.
Noumau tengteng sang in pautuamte a thu ka gen tam zawk ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi;
Himahleh saptuamte kikhopna ah pautuamte a thu singkhat gen sang in midangte ka hilhtheihna ding in ka theihtheihna in thumal nga kia gen ka utzaw ahi.
Unaute aw, ngaihtuahna ah naupang kei un; himahleh gilou ah zaw naungek unla, lungsim ah piching un.
Dan laibu ah: "Pautuamte leh gamdang mite muk in, hiai mite kiang ah thu ka gen ding a; huchi in leng ahon ngaikhe tuan kei ding uh, Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
Huaiziak in pautuamte zaw gingtate a ding in chiamtehna ahi kei a, gingloute a ding in ahi zaw, thugen bel gingloute a ding in chiamtehna ahi kei a, gingtate a ding in ahi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in saptuam tengteng kikhawm a na vek ua pautuamte a na pau uleh thei nailoute leh gingloute hong lut leh ahai uh hon chi kei ding ua hiam?
Na vek ua thu na gen uleh ging lou hiam, thei nai lou hiam hong lutleh asiamlouhdan uh na vek ua ma ah hihlat ahi ding;
huchi in alungtang thugukte uh hihlat in a-omta ding a, lei si in Pathian abe ding ua, "Pathian na lak uah a-om taktak," chih agen ding uhi.
Unaute aw, bangchi ding ahita dia le? Na hong kikhop un, phatna la hiam, thu kihilh hiam, theihsakna thu hiam, pautuamte, hilhchetna hiam na nei chiat zel ua. Bangkim bawlhoihna ding in hih hi hen.
Kuapeuh in pautuamte a thu agen uleh, nih in hiam, atampen in thum in hiam hileh, kikhel zel in leng hi hen.
Huan mi khat in hilhchian hen; hilhchianmi a-om keileh saptuamte kikhopna ah dai in om henla, amah leh Pathian kiang ah gen hen.
Thugenmi in leng nih in hiam, thum in hiam, gen uhenla, midangte'n hoihtak in ngaihtuah uhen.
Himahleh akiang a tu midang kiang a theihsakna thupiak ahong tunleh amasa pen dai mai hen.
Mi tengteng in atheihtheihna ding leh mi tengteng khamuang a a-omtheihna ding un, na vek un khatkhat in thu na gen thei ngal ua.
Thugen mite, khate thugen mite thuthu in a-om uh ahi.
Pathian zaw buaina Pathian ahi kei a, lemna Pathian ahi zaw hi. Mi Siangthou saptuam pawl tengteng a-om bang in,
Saptuamte kikhopna ah numeite dai dinden in om uhen; amau zaw athugen uh phal ahi kei a; Dan gen bang in thumang in om zaw uhen.
Huan bangpeuh atheihnop uleh inn ah amau pasalte dong uhen; saptuamte kikhopna a numei thugen zaw azumhuai hi.
Pathian thu noumau a pan pawt ahi maw? Ahihkeileh noumau kiang kia ahong tung ahi maw?
Kuapeuh thugenmi hiam khami hiam akisakleh na kiang ua ka gelh Toupa thupiak ahi chih atheih ding ahi.
Himahleh kuapeuh in atheih keileh amah leng theih ahi kei hi.
Huaiziak in unaute aw, thugen lunggulh unla, pautuamte a thugen leng kham kei un;
Himahleh bangkim kilawm leh diktak a hih hi hen.
Huai ban ah unaute aw, tanchinhoih ka hon hilh zaw ka hon theisak nawn ding a; huai tanchinhoih na kipahpih ua, huai mah ah na dingh ua;
k'on thuhilh pen na mawk gintak uh hilou a, pomkip na hih uleh, huai mah ah hotdam in na om uhi.
Amasapen in ke'n ka muh sam nou ka hon hilhsawn a; huchi a, Laisiangthou bangbang a i khelhnate ziak a Khrist asih a,
vui a a-om a, laisiangthou bangbang a ani thum ni a kaihthoh a a-omdan,
huchi a Kifas kiang a akilak a, huai khit a sawm-le-nihte kiang a akilak thute,
huai khit in unau zanga sang a tamzawte kiang ah khatvei thu in akilak nawn a, huaite lak a mi, atamzaw tutan in adam lai ua, khenkhat bel a-ihmuta uhi.
Huai khit in Jakob leh sawltak tengteng kiang ah akilak nawn hi.
Huan atawp pen ah, ahun lou bang a piang, keimah kiang ah leng akilak hi.
Kei zaw sawltak lak a neupen, Pathian saptuamte ka sawi ziak a sawltak chih tuak louh ka hi.

Himahleh Pathian hehpihna ziak in ka hihhih ka hita; huan ahehpihna hon piak athawn in a-om kei a, huchih nak sang in amau tengteng sang in ka semgimzaw hi; himahleh keimah kia in ka sem kei a, Pathian hehpihna ka kiang a om in asem zaw hi.
Himahleh, ke'n leng, amau leng huchi in ka gen zel ua, huchi in nou leng na gingta uhi.
Huan Khrist misi lak a kipan kaihthoh in a-om chih ahon hilh ngal uleh, bangchidan ahia na lak ua khenkhat in, misi thohnawnna himhim a-om kei na chih uh?
Misi thohnawnna himhim om lou ahihleh, Khrist leng kaihthoh in a-om kei ding hi.
Huan Khrist kaihthoh a a-om keileh, i thugen uh bangmah lou ahi ding a, na gin uh leng bangmah lou ahi ding hi.
Ahi, Khrist akaithou chih Pathian i theihpih ziak in, Pathian lam thu ah theihpih zuauthei i hong hi ding hi, misite kaihthoh a a-om kei uleh, amah leng akaithou kei ding hi.
Misite kaihthoh a a-om kei un zaw, Khrist leng kaihthoh in a-omta kei ding.
Huan Khrist kaihthoh a a-om keileh, na gin uh bangmah lou ahi ding a, na khelhna uah na om nilouh uh ahi ding.
Huchi hileh, Khrist a ihmusate mangthangta uh ahi ding hi.
Tu damsung kia a Khrist tung a lametna i neih in zaw mi tengteng lak a mi hehpihhuaipen i hi ding hi.
Himahleh Khrist misi lak a kipan kaihthoh in a-om taktak ahi, ihmute lak a kipan gah masa ana hita hi.
Mi khat ziak a sihna ahong om ziak in mi khat ziak mah in misi thohnawnna leng ahong omta ahi.
Adam ah mi tengteng asi mah bang un, Khrist ah mi tengteng hihhin in leng a-om ding uhi.
Himahleh amau hun chiat ah; Khrist gah masapente ahi a; huai khit chiang in ahong pai nawn na ah Khrist ate athou ding uhi.
Huai khit chiang in atawp ahong tung ding; huai hun chiang in, vaihawmna tengteng, thuneihna leh thilhihtheihna tengteng ahihman nung in, Pathian kiang ah, Pa kiang ngei ah gam ape ding hi.
Amelmate tengteng akhenuai a akoih masiah ama'n vai hawm ding ahi ngal a.
Melma nanungpen hihmang a om ding sihna ahi.
Ama'n, "Akhenuai ah bangkim akoih hi." Himahleh, "Akhenuai ah bangkim koih in a-om," achih in anuai a bangkim koihpa apang kha kei chih akimu gige ahi.
Huan anuai a bangkim koih a a-om hun chiang in, Tapa mahmah leng anuai ah koih in a-om ding; Pathian bangkim a bangkim ahihtheihna ding in.
Huchi ahih kei in, misite a ding a baptisma atansak uh bang achihna uh hi ding ahia? Misite kaihthoh a om lou ding ahih uleh bang achia amaute a dia baptisma tansak uh ahia?
Bangziak a eite dakkal chih a sih lauhuai a om i hi ua?
Unaute aw, Khrist Jesu i Toupa a ka hon suanna sial in niteng in ka si, ka chi ahi.
Mihing dan in gen leng Ephesa a gamsate kilaipih ka hihleh, kei a ding in bang aphatuam dia? "Misi, kaihthoh a a-om kei ding uleh ne in dawn leng ake, zingchiang a si ding hi ve hang in."
Khem in om kei un, "Lawm giloute'n omdan hoih ahihgawp nak uhi."
Kizentak in halh unla, thil hihkhial kei un; khenkhat in Pathian theihna himhim na nei kei ua. Hiai tuh na zumna ding ua ka gen ahi.
Himahleh kuahiam khat in, "Misi bangchi in kaihthoh ahi ding uh? Pumpi bangchibang pu in ahia ahong thoh ding?" chi ahi ding e.
Nang, mihai, nang mahmah in na tuh leng, asih phot keileh hihhin in a-om sam a;
huan chi na tuh in apumpi hong om ding pen ahi kei a, atang lel na tuh zaw nak, buhtang hiam, chi dang tang hiam ahi thei hi.
Himahleh Pathian in ama deih bangbang in pumpi apia a, haichitang chih kiang ah amau pumpi chiat apia hi.
Sa tengteng sa chi khat ahi kei ua; mihing sa atuam a, gamsa sa atuam; vasa sa atuam a, ngasa sa atuam hi.
Van pumpi a-om a, leitung pumpi leng a-om, himahleh van lam pumpite thupina atuam a, lei lam pumpite thupina atuam hi.
Nisa thupina atuam a, khapi thupina atuam a, aksite thupina atuam; aksi leh aksi leng athupina uh atuam ziak in.
Misite thohnawnna leng tua bang ahi. Muat thei a tuh in a-om a, muat thei lou a kaihthoh in a-om hi.
Pahtawi louh a tuh in a-om a, thupitak a kaihthoh in a-om hi. Hat lou a tuh in a-om a, thilhihtheihna nei a kaihthoh in a-om hi.
Pianken pumpi a tuh in a-om a, khalam pumpi a kaihthoh in a-om hi. Pianken pumpi a-omleh khalam pumpi leng a-om hi.
Huchi in mi masapen, "Adam mihing ahong hi a," chi a gelh ahi; Adam nanung pen bel hinna pepa kha ahong hita hi.
Himahleh khalam a-om masa kei a, salam a-om zaw; huai zoh in khalam pen a-om hi.
Mihing masa pen lei a siam, leimi ahi a; mihing nihna pen van a pan ahi.
Lei a siam mihing leimi ahih bang in, van a kipan mi tuh vanmi ahi.
Huan lei a siam mihing batna i put bang in, van a kipan hong paipa batna leng i pu sam ding uhi.
Unaute aw, sa leh sisan in Pathian lalgam aluah thei kei ding a; muat thei in muat theihlouhna aluah sam kei ding chih, ka gen ahi.
Ngai un, thuguk ka hon hilh ding hi! I vek un i ihmu khol kei ding ua, himahleh i vek un pengkul nanungpen agin chiang in, sawt lou kal in,
Mitphiat kal lou in hihlamdan in i om vekta ding; pengkul ging ding ahi ngal a, huchi in misite muat thei lou in kaihthoh in a-om ding ua, eite leng hihlamdan in i omta ding uhi.
Hiai muat thei in muat theihlouhna asilh ding ahi a, hiai sithei in leng sih theihlouhna asilh sam ding ahi.
Huchi a hiai muat thei in muat theihlouhna asilh a, hiai sithei in sih theihlouhna asilh hun chiang in, huai hun ngeingei in, "Zohna in sihna avalh zouta," chih thugelh ahong tung ding hi.
"Aw sihna, na gu koi a-omta ahia? Aw han, na zohna koi a-omta ahia?"
Sihna gu khelhna ahi a; khelhna thilhihtheihna dan ahi.
Himahleh i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak a zohna hon pepa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
Huaiziak in ka unau deihtakte aw, kiptak in, hihlin vual louh in, Toupa nasep phatuamngaitak a sem gige in om un, na sepgimna uh Toupa ah athawn ngei kei chih na thei uhi.
Huan misiangthoute a dia thilpiak thu zaw, Galatia gam a saptuam pawlte kiang a thu ka piak bang in nou leng na hih sam un.
Ni sagih ani masapen in michih in vualzawlna na muh bang zel un koih khawl chiat un; ka hong chiang a lakkhawm himhim a-omlouhna ding in.
Huan na hehpih thilpiak uh Jerusalem a hohpih ding in ka hong tun chiang in kuapeuh hoih na chih ua lai na piak uh ka sawl ding hi.
Huan kei va hoh kilawm ahihleh, kei toh ahoh ding uhi.
Huan Masidonia gam ka totsuah khit chiang in na kiang uah ka hong ding a; Masidonia gam ka tuansuak himhim ding hi.
Na kiang uah bang tan hiam, phalbi sung teng houh ka taam nilouh kha diam; ka hohna ding peuh a noute'n na hon khaksawn theihna ding un.
Tua pai kawm lel a hon muh malam ka ut kei a, Toupa'n lem asakleh na kiang ua sawt sim taam ka lamen hi.
Himahleh Pentikost ni tan in Ephesa ah ka taam ding hi.
Kong lianpi, phatuampi sepna ding kei a ding in akihong ngal a; huan dou mite leng tampi a-om uh.
Huan Timothi ahong tunleh lauthawng lou a na kiang ua a-omna ding in pilvang un; ke'n ka sep bangmah in Toupa nna asem hi.
Huaiziak in kuamah in musit kei uhen; ka kiang a ahong theihna ding in khamuangtak in khakhia unla; unaute toh amah muh ka lamen hi.
I unaupa Apollos thu zaw, unaute toh na kiang ua hong ding in ka deih ngial hi, himahleh tu'n zaw hong a-ut kei a; alemtan hun chiang in ahong ding hi.
Kiveng unla, ginna ah dingkip un, kihihhang unla, hattak in om un.
Na hih peuhmah uh itna a hih hi vek hen.
Unaute aw, Stephenas inkuan-pihte zaw Akhaia gam a gingta masate ahi ua, misiangthoute nna sem ding in akipia uh chih na thei uhi;
huchibang mite kiang ah leh nasep a panpih leh semgim peuhte kiang a lut ding in ka hon hanthawn hi.
Huan Stephenas, Fortunate leh Akaikas ahong tun uh ka kipak hi; noute hih louh kilang lou a ka taksapna hon huh ziak un.
Amau ka lungsim leh na lungsim uh hon hihhalh ua, hichibang mite zaw kipahpih un.
Asia gam a saptuam pawlte'n chibai hon buk uhi. Akuila, Priscilla leh a-inn ua om saptuamte'n deihsaktak in Toupa ah chibai hon buk uhi.
Unau tengteng in chibai hon buk uhi. Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un.
Kei Paul in hiai chibai bukna keimah khut mahmah a ka gelh ahi.
Kuapeuh in Toupa Jesu Khrist a-it keileh hamsethuak in om hen. I Toupa ahong pai hi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen.
Khrist Jesu a ka itna na vek ua lak ah om hen. Amen.
Unaute aw, Pathian thuguk noute hon hilh ding a na kiang ua ka hong lai in thugen thupi leh pilna thupi toh ka hong pai kei hi.
Jesu Khrist, amah mah kilhden a om thu kia lou ngal na lak uah bangmah theih ka tum kei hi.
Hat lou leh lau in, nakpitak a ling kawm in na lak uah ka om hi.
Ka paukam suak leh ka thugente thupil a khemna thu ahi kei a, Kha leh thilhihtheihna theihsakna in ahi zaw hi.
Huchi a na ginna uh mihing pilna a kinga lou a, Pathian thilhihtheihna a kinga a a-om zawk theihna ding in.
Himahleh pichingte lak ah ahihleh thupil i hilh zel a, hinapi in hiai khovel thupil zaw ahi kei; hiai khovel vaihawmte mangthang dingte thupil leng ahi sam kei hi;
Pathian pilna guk leh kisel, i thupina ding a Pathian in khovel om ma a asehkholhsa pen i hilh zaw nak hi.
Hiai khovel vaihawmte himhim in athei kei uh; thei le uh zaw thupina Toupa kilhden lou ding hi ve un.
"Mit a muh ngei louh, bil a zak ngei louh, mihing lungtang a lut ngei lou, Pathian in amah itte a dia abawl," chih gelh bang in.
Pathian in Kha in huaite ei ahon theisakta a; Kha in bangkim asuikhe vek a; Pathian thugilte tan in.
Mihing ngaihtuahte mihing sung a om kha mah lou in, kua'n ahia thei ding? Huchi mah bang in Pathian ngaihtuahte Pathian Kha mah lou kuamah in athei kei uhi.
Huan athawn a Pathian in thil hon piakte i theihna ding in, eite'n zaw khovel kha hilou in, Kha, Pathian a kipan ngei i mu zaw uhi.
Mihing' pilna a sinsak thute a hilh lou in Kha sinsak in i hilh zaw ua, Kha neite kiang ah khalam thutakte i hilhchian uhi.
Khovel mi'n Pathian Kha thilpiakte asang kei nak hi, amah ngaihdan in haihuai ahi ngal a, kha a theihchet ahih ziak in atheithei kei hi.
Khami in bel thil bangkim achian zel a, amah lah kuamahi achian kei uhi.
"Kua'n ahia Toupa lungsim thei khin a, amah thuhilh thei ding?" Eite'n bel Khrist lungsim i pu uhi.
Unaute aw, khamite kiang a gen bang in na kiang uah thu ka gen thei kei hi; sa mite, Khrist a naungekte kiang a gen bang in ka gen zaw hi.
An gum na nek theih nai louh ziak un, nawitui in ka hon vak a, sami na hih lai ziak un tua an gum tu tanpha in leng na ne thei nai kei lailai uhi.
Na lak ua kihazatna leh kiselna a-om nak ziak in sami hi lai in mihing bang a om lai hilou na hi uhiam?
Mi khat in, “Paul pawl ka hi," midang in, “Kei zaw Apollos pawl ka hi," na chih lai teng uh mihing lel hi lai hilou na hi uhiam?
Apollos kua ahia le? Paul leng kua ahia? Nasemmi, noumau hon gingtasak mi lel ahi ve ua, huai leng Toupa'n apiak bang zel in ahi.
Ke'n ka suan a, Apollos in tui in avak a, himahleh Pathian in akhangsak hi.
Huchi in akhangsakpa Pathian kia lou ngal, asuanpa lah bangmah ahi kei a, tui a vakpa leng bangmah ahi tuan kei hi.
Huan asuanpa leh tui a vakpa pum khat ahi ua, himahleh amau sepgim bang zel in, amau kipahman amu tuaktuak ding uhi.
Koute Pathian na seppihte ka hi ua, noute Pathian louma na hi ua, Pathian inn lam leng na hi uhi.
Pathian in hehpihna hon piak bang zel in inn lam heutupen piltak bang in ke'n suangphum ka lem a, midang in atung ah inn alam uhi. Himahleh michih atung a alamdan ding uah pilvang uhen.
Suangphum lepkhitsa lou ngal suangphum dang kuamah in alem theita kei ua, huai suangphum Jesu Khrist ahi.
Hiai suangphum tung ah kuapeuh in dangka-eng in hiam, dangka in hiam, suangmantam in hiam, sing in hiam, loupa in hiam, buhpawl hiam zang in lam taleh;
michih nasep ahong lang ding hi; tua Ni in hihlang ding ahi ngal a, meikuang a akilak ding ziak in; meikuang ngeingei in michih nasep bangchibang ahia chih a-enchian ding hi.
Kua nasep leng atung a alam pen a-om gigeleh huai mi in kipahman amu ding.
Kua nasep leng akatleh huai mi in atan ding hi; amah taktak zaw hotdam in a-om ding, himahleh mei apaisuak bang in.
Pathian tempul na hih uleh Pathian Kha noumau sung ah ateng gige chih na thei kei ua hia?
Kuapeuh in Pathian tempul ahihsiatleh Pathian in huai mi ahihse ding; Pathian tempul asiangthou ngal a, huai tempul noumau na hi uhi.
Kuamah amah-le-amah kikhem kei hen. Na lak ua kuapeuh hiai khovel a pil akisakleh, ahong piltheihna ding in mihai hong suak hen.
Hiai khovel pilna Pathian ngaihdan in haina ahi. "Ama'n amaute apil lepchiahna uah aman hi," chih gelh ahi;
Toupa'n mipilte ngaihtuahna athawn ahi, chih athei chi a gelh ahi nawn lai hi.
Huaiziak in kuamah in mihingte suang kei hen; bangkim nou a ahi vekta ngal a;
Paul hiam, Apollos hiam, Kifas hiam, khovel hiam, hinna hiam, sihna hiam, thil omsa hiam, thil hong om ding hiam;
avek in nou a ahi vek hi; noumau leng Khrist a na hi ua; Khrist leng Pathian a ahi.
Koute zaw Khrist nasemte leh Pathian thuguk kemte bang in min hon thei uhen.
Hiai ah kempa mimuanhuai hih akiphamoh ahi.
Himahleh nou na hon ettelna uh leh mihing ngaihtuahna a na hon ettelna uh kei a ding in thil neuchik ahi.
Keimah leng ka ki-entel ngei tuan kei. Bangmah kimohsakna ding ka kithei kei a; himahleh huai in siam hon tangsak tuan kei hi; hon entelpa Toupa ahi zaw hi.

Huchi in ahun ma in bangmah thukhenna bawl kei un, Toupa hong pai masiah, ama'n mial a thil selgukte vak ah hon lakhe ding a; lungtang a tupte leng ahihlang lai ding hi; huai hun chiang in michih in Pathian a kipan in amau tan hun chiat in phatna aloh chiat ding uhi.

Unaute aw, na phattuampihna ding un hiai thu Apollos leh kei tung ah ka belh hi, huchi a koute a kipan a hindan na sintheihna ding uleh, akigelhsa pen sang a na lak ua kuamah mi khat midang sang a ngaina zaw a na kisaktheihpih louhna ding un.
Kua'n ahia nou a thiltuam deuh om a mu? Na muhsawn louh ngal uh bang ahia na neih uh? Huchi a amusawn lel na hih uleh na muhsawn uh athawn a piak hilou bang a bangziak a kisathei zenzen?
Tu in na vahta ua! Tu in na hong hauta ua! Kou lou in vai na hawmta uh! Ahi, vaihawm taktak le uchin, huchi a noute toh vai ka hawm sam theihna ding un.
Pathian in kou sawltakte, si ding a sehsa bang in ananungpen in hon sepkhia hi in ka thei ahi; khovelte leh angelte leh mihingte mitmuh a etnop a bawl in ka om uhi.
Kou zaw Khrist ziak in mihai ka hi ua, nou bel Khrist ah mipil na hi zaw uhi; kou zaw ka hat kei ua, nou bel na hat uhi; nou zaw mi pahtawi in na om ua, kou zaw mi simmoh in ka om zaw uhi.
Tutan in leng ka gilkial un ka dangtak ua, puansilh ka kiching kei ua, mi khut thak nuhna ka hi ua, mun leh mual ka nei kei uh;
koumau khut a sem in ka gim mahmah ua; mi'n hon tai uleh ka vualzawl ua; ahon sawi uleh ka thuak teitei uhi.
Mi'n hon gensiat uleh ka khem ua; tutan in leng khovel ninnok thil tengteng nin kihhuai bang in ahon bawl uhi.
Na zumna ding un hiai thu ka gelh ahi kei a, ka ta deihtakte bang a hon taihilh ding in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
Khrist ah heutu singkhat nei mah le uchin, pa zaw tampi na nei tuan kei uhi. Ke'n Khrist Jesu ah tanchinhoih in noute ka hon neikhia hi.
Huaiziak in ka omdan zui ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
Hiai ziak in Timothi, Toupa a ka ta deihtak leh muanhuai, na kiang uah ka hon sawl hi. Ama'n Khrist a ka omdan, gam chih a saptuamte teng thu ka hilh zeldan noute ahon theisak nawn ding hi.
Huan kei na kiang ua hong nawn lou ding bang zen in khenkhat na na ki-uangsak uhi.
Himahleh Toupa'n pha asakleh sawt louchik nung in na kiang uah ka hong ding, huchi in miki-uangsakte kamhat thu hilou in, athilhihtheihna uh ka thei zawta ding hi.
Pathian lalgam zaw kamhat thu ah a-om kei a, thilhihtheihna ah a-om zaw hi.
Bang na deihzaw ua? Chiangpum toh hia, itna leh kingaihniamna lungsim toh na kiang ua ka hong ding?
Na lak uah kingaihna nin a-om chih thu athang vengvung hi. Huchibang kingaihna nin Zentelte lak a leng om ngei lou, na lak ua mi khat in amah pa zi akitenpih hi.
Huai thilhihpa na lak ua kipan delhkhiak ding a lungngaih nak sang in na kisaktheihpih zaw uhi.
Kei mahmah pumpi in ka pang kei na a, kha in noute lak ah ka om a, thil huchi tel hihpa tu in leng Toupa Jesu min in na lak ua pang bang a kingaihtuah in thupukna ka bawlta hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist min a na kikhop chiang un, noute lak ah kha in ka om a, Toupa Jesu Khrist thilhihtheihna leng a-om hi.
Mi huchibang zaw Toupa ni chiang a akha hotdam a a-omtheihna ding in asa hihmang ding in Setan kiang ah pekhia un.
Na kisaktheihna uh hoih lou ahi. Silngou tawmchik in tanghou beu apum in azelsuak chih na thei kei ua hia?
Silngou pang lou na hih mah bang un tanghou beu thak na hong hihtheihna ding un silngou lui pen paikhe siang un. I Paikan Ankuangluina ding Khrist latkhiak in a-omta hi.
Huaiziak in ankuanglui ni, silngou lui a ankuang lui lou in, nunsia leh gitlouhna silngou a leng ankuang lui sam lou in, takna leh thutak tanghou silngou soh louh in ankuang i lui zaw ding uh.
Ka laikhak ah kingaihhatte kithuahpih lou ding in na kiang uah ka gelh hi.
Hiai khovel a kingaihhatte hiam, huaiham leh lepgute hiam, milim bete hiam kithuahpih het louh ding chi ka hi kei a; huchibang hileh khovel a kipan na paikhiak uh kul ding ahi.

Tu'n bel kuapeuh unau min po ngal in, kingaihhatmi hiam, mihuaiham hiam, milim bemi hiam, mihuaiham hiam, milim bemi hiam, hanhatmi hiam, zukham hatmi hiam, lepgumi hiam hileh, kithuahpih lou ding in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi; mi huchibang kiang ah nek leng ne kei un.
Polam mite tung a vaihawm ding ke'n bang ahia ka awlmoh ding om? Nou sung a mite hilou hia na ngaihtuah ding uh?
Polam a mite tung a Pathian in vaihawm hilou hia? “Huai migiloupa na lak ua kipan koihkhia un."
Na lak uah kuapeuh in midang toh thubuai neita le uchin, misiangthoute ma a tun lou in, midiktatloute ma ah na tun ngam ding ua hia?
Ahihleh misiangthoute'n khovel tung a vaihawm ding ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Khovel mite tung a bawn vaihawm ding na hih uleh, thil neupente leng ngaihtuah tak lou na hi ua hia?
Tulai damsung thute gen louh angelte nangawn i vaihawm ding uh ahi chih na thei kei ua hia?
Huchi in tulai damsung thute ngaihtuah ding na neih un bangziak a saptuamte ngaihniam pente ngaihtuahsak na hi ua?
Na zumna ding un ka gen ahi. A-unaute kal a thu hihpuk thei mipil, khat bek na lak uah na mu kei ua ahi ding maw?
Unau in a-unau mah ginglou mite vaihawmna a atut zawk nak!
Hilou ahi, hiai na diklouhna khat uh ahi pah hi, thubuai na kineih tuah nak uh. Bangziak a dikloupi a hihna na thuak zaw lou? Bang achia kizangsak zaw mai lou oi?
Hilou ahi, noumau ngei in na unaute uh tung ah leng na hihdik kei ua, na zangsak uhi.
Ahihleh midiktatloute'n Pathian lalgam aluah kei ding uh chih na thei kei ua hia? Khem in om kei un, kingaihhatte, milim bete, angkawmte leh mihukte leh tokohukte,
gutate, mihuaihamte, zukhamhatte, salhhatte leh lepgute'n Pathian lalgam aluah kei ding uh.
Huan noute khenkhat huchibang na hi uh; himahleh Toupa Jesu Khrist min in leh i Pathian Kha ah siansak na hita ua, hihsiangthou na hita ua, siamtang na hita uhi.
"Thil bangkim hih kei a ding in asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih ahoihkim kei, "Thil bangkim hih kei a ding in asiang a," himahleh bangmah sikha ding in ka kiphal kei hi.
"Nek dingte gilpi a ahi a, gilpi leng nek ding a ahi," himahleh Pathian in ahihmang tuaktuak ding. Huan pumpi pen kingaihna ding ahi kei a, Toupa a ding ahi; Toupa leng pumpi a ding ahi;
Pathian in misi lak a kipan Toupa akaithou a, eite leng athilhihtheihna in hon kaithou sam ding hi.
Na pumpi uh Khrist hiang ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Khrist hiangte laksak in kizuak hiang ding peuh in ka bawl dia hia?
Bawl lou hial ding. Ahihleh kizuak zop amah toh pum khat ahi uh chih na thei kei ua hia? "Anih un sapum khat ahi ding uh," achi ngal a.
Toupa zop bel amah toh kha pum khat ahi uhi.
Kingaih taisan un. Mihing thilhihkhelh chiteng pumpi polam ah ahi; mingaih hat in bel amah pumpi tung ah thil ahihkhial hi.
Ahihleh na pumpi uh, na sung ua om Pathian kiang a kipan a na muh uh, Kha Siangthou tempul ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Noumau a leng na hi kei ua,
man a leisa na hih ziak un, na pumpi uh leh na kha Pathian a mah in, Pathian pahtawi un.
Tu in, na thilgelh thute uh zaw, "Pasal a ding in numei khoih louh ahoih hi."
Himahleh kingaihna a-om nak ziak in pasal chih in ama zi chiat nei henla, numei chih in leng ama pasal chiat nei hen.
Pasal in azi kiang ah atan ding hun pia hen; huchi mah bang in zi in leng apasal kiang ah atan ding hun pe sam hen.
Zi in ama pumpi tung ah thu anei kei a, apasal in thu aneizaw hi; huchi mah bang in pasal in leng ama pumpi tung ah thu anei kei a, azi in thu aneizaw hi.

Thum ding a na kipiak theihna ding uleh, na kikholh nawn theihna ding ua sawt lou kal a dia pha na sak tuaktuak kei ngal uleh akuamah mah kizangsak kei un, huchi lou in zaw na kidek zoh louh ziak un Setan in ahon khem kha ding hi.
Himahleh hiai thu thupiak dan hilou in phal lam thu in ka gen zaw ahi.
Ke'n bel, mi tengteng keimah bang a a-om vek uh ka deih ahi. Himahleh michih in Pathian a kipan thilpiak amau muh lam anei chiat uhi; khat in lam tuam ah khat in lam dang in.
Himahleh koppih neiloute leh meithaite kiang ah huchi in ka chi ahi; keimah bangtak in om le uh amau a ding in ahoih ding hi.
Kidektheihna aneih kei ualeh kiteng uhen; huk sang in kiten ahoihzaw hi.
Huan kitengsate kiang ah thu ka pia, keimah bel hilou in, Toupa piak ahi zaw; zi in apasal khen kei hen;
akhen vanglakleh pasal nei nawn lou in om vanglak hen, ahihkeileh, apasal toh mah kituak nawn uheh; huan pasal in azi ma kei hen.
Midang kiang ah ahihleh Toupa hilou in keimah in ka gen; unau kuapeuh in zi, gingloumi kitenpih leh akiang a om gige a-utleh, ma kei hen.
Huan numei pasal ginglou kitenpih in, apasal in akiang a om gige a-utleh ma kei hen.
Pasal gingloumi azi ziak in hihsiangthou in a-om a, zi gingloumi leng apasal ziak in hihsiangthou in a-om sam ahi; huchi hita keileh, na tate uh asiangthou kei ding uhi; himahleh asiangthou na uhi.
Himahleh aging lou pen in akhenleh khen mai hen, huchibang ah zaw unaupa hiam, unaunu hiam, hen ahita kei ding. Pathian in lemna ah ahon sam hi.
Zi aw, na pasal na hotdam ding leh ding louh bangchi in na thei a eita? Pasal aw, na zi na hotdam ding leh ding louh bangchi in na thei a eita?
Himahleh, Toupa'n michih kiang a apiak bang chiat leh Pathian in michih asap lai a a-omdan bang chiat in om hen. Huchibang in saptuam pawl tengteng ah ka hihkip hi.
Zeksumsa a sap a-om uhia? Zeksum louh hong hi tuan kei uhen. Zeksum louh a om sap a-om uhia? Zeksum tuan dah uhen.
Pathian thupiakte zuih lel louh ngal zeksum i chih bangmah ahi kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah ahi kei hi.
Michih sap a a-om lai ua atan ngeina uah om chiat uhen.
Sikha hisa a sap na hi hia? Khawk sa tuan ke'n. Na suahtak theihleh sensuk in.
Sikha hisa a om Toupa sap Toupa sikha noplen ahi a; huchi mah bang in noplen sa a sap Khrist sikha ahi.
Man a lei na hita ua mihingte sikha ah lut kei un.
Unaute aw, michih sap a a-om lai bangbang in Pathian kiang ah om gige hen.
Huan nungak siangthou lam thu ah zaw Toupa thupiak himhim ka nei kei; himahleh muanhuai a om ding in Toupa kiang a kipan zahngaihna mu ka hih ziak in ka ngaihtuahdan ka gen ding.
Tulai haksatna ziak in pasal a-omdan ngeingei bang in omleh amah a ding in hoih in ka gingta hi.
Zi a hen na hi hia? Kisutkhiak tum ke'n. Zi a hen louh na hi hia? Zi zong ke'n.

Himahleh zi na neihleh thil na hihkhial kei hi, nungak siangthou in leng pasal aneihleh thil ahihkhial sam kei hi. Himahleh, hichibang mite'n sa ah gimna athuak ding uhi; himahleh ke'n zaw hon thuaksak louh ka ut hi.
Himahleh unaute aw, hiai ka chi ahi; hun seh atomta; zi neite nei lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un;
kapte kap lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un leh kipakte kipak lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un;
khovel zangte zang lo zen lou a a-omtheihna ding un; hiai khovel omdan lah amangthang gige ahi.
Lungzinna nei lou a na om uh ka hon deih hi. Zi nei lou pasal in Toupa lungkimsakna ding in, Toupa lam thilte alimsak hi.
Zi nei pasal in bel azi lungkimsakna ding in, khovel thilte alimsak hi.

Pasal neisa leh nungak siangthou kilamdanna a-om hi. Pasal nei lou numei in apumpi leh kha asianthoudan ding, Toupa lam thilte alimsak a; pasal nei numei in bel apasal lungkimsakdan ding, khovel lam thilte alimsak hi.
Nou phattuamna ding in hiai ka gen ahi; na tung ua khamna nga hilou in, navak a na omna ding uleh Toupa kiang a na kipiakna uh bukimna ding in ahi zaw.
Kuapeuh in azikham tung a gamta diklou hi a akigintak a, alunggulhna a let ngal a akulleh, hoih asak bang in hih hen aw; kiteng uhen, khelhna ahi kei.
Himahleh kuapeuh alungtang a thu khensat a, alou thei lou khop a kulna nei hilou a, amah kithuzohmi in asianthouna kepbit atup tintenleh ahihhoih ding.
Huchi in nungak kitenpihpa'n ahihhoih a; himahleh zi nei lou dia amah kikham in ahihhoih zaw ding hi.
Zi zaw apasal adam lai teng hen ahi; himahleh apasal asihleh bel adeih peuh anei thei ding a, himahleh Toupa a ommi ahih ding ahi.
Himahleh kei ngaihdan in, a-om ngei in om gigeleh nuam asa zaw ding; ke'n Pathian Kha nei sam in ka kithei hi.
Tu in milimte kiang a kithoihna tungtang zaw; i vek un theihna i nei chiat uh, chih i kithei hi. Theihna in mi akisatheisak a itna in mi abawlhoih hi.
Kuapeuh in thil banghiam thei a akingaihtuahleh, atheih ding thei nai lou ahi.
Himahleh mi kuapeuh in Pathian a-itleh, huai mi mah ama theih ahi.
Huchi in milimte kiang a kithoihna thil nek thu zaw, "Khovel ah milim himhim bangmah ahihlouhdan uleh, khat kia lou ngal Pathian dang himhim a-omlouhdan i thei uhi."
Van ah leh lei ah pathian min pu tampi om mah le uh, huchibang pathian tampi leh toupate tampi a-om uhi.

Eite a ding in bel Pathian khat kia Pa, a-om a amah kiang a kipan in bangkim apawt a, eite leng amah a dia om i hi uhi. Toupa khat kia, Jesu Khrist a-om hi, amah ziak in bangkim a-om hi, eite leng amah ziak mah a om i hi uhi.

Himahleh huai theihna mi tengteng ah a-om kei hi; khenkhatte milim biakna sa ahih ziak un, milim kiang a kithoihna ahi chih thei napi in tutan in ane uhi; huchi in asia-le-pha theihna uh ahat louh ziak in athanghuaisak uhi.
Himahleh, sa nek in Pathian mit hon tungsak tuan kei ding a, ne kei mah lehang i se tuan kei a, ne mah lehang leng i hoih tuan sam kei hi.
Himahleh pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw na noplenna uh bangchi chi hiam in mihatloute a ding in pukna ahong hi kha ding hi.
Nang theihna neimi, kuapeuh in milim biakna in a-ankuang um a ahon muh ngal un, amau mihat lou na hita le uh milim kiang a kithoihna thil ne ding in asia-le-pha theihna hong maingal lou ding hia?
Huchi in na theihna ziak in unau hat lou, asih sik a Khrist in asihsakpa, amangthang ding hi.
Unaute tung a huchibang thil na hihkhelh ua, asia-le-pha theihna uh ahat louh nak lai a na liamsak behlap un, Khrist tung ah thil na hihkhial uhi.
Huaiziaktak in ka sa nek in ka unau ahihpuk sang in, ka unau ka hihpuklouhna ding in sa himhim ka ne ngei kei ding hi.
Noplen ka hi kei a hia? Sawltak kei a hia? I Toupa Jesu ka muta kei a hia? Noute Toupa a ka nasep gah na hi kei ua hia?
Midangte a ding in sawltak hi kei mah leng, noute a ding bek in zaw ka hi; Toupa a ka sawltak hihna chiamtehna noumau na hi uhi.
Hiai kei hon demte ka dawn na ahi,
Ne ding leh dawn ding in thu ka nei kei ua hia?
Sawltak dangte leh Toupa unaute leh Kifas bang in zi gingtami pi vialvial ding in thu ka nei kei ua hia?
Ahihkeileh kei leh Barnabas kia koumau kivak kawm a khut a nna sem lou ding in thu ka nei lou tuam ua hia?
Sepaih kua ahia amah kivak a galkap ngei? Kua'n ahia agah ne lou a grephuan bawl ngei? Ahihkeileh kua'n ahia ganhon nawitui ne lou a ganhon vul ngei?
Huai thute mihing bang mai in ka gen a hia? Dan thu mah in leng huai ngei agen sam kei a hia?
Mosi Dan Laibu ah, "Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk gak ke'n," chih gelh ahi. Pathian in bawngtal a ding kia hia angaihtuahsak?
Ahihkeileh ei a ding a kigen ahi hia? Hi e, ei a ding a agelh ahi; lei letpa'n lamet nei a aleh ding ahi a, buhvopa'n leng tan neih sam lamen a avuak ding ahi.
Koute'n khalam thilte na kiang ua ka tuh ngal uleh, na salam thilte uh at le ung leng thil thupi ahi dia hia?
Midang in bawn na tung ua thuneihna atan uleh kou tang sem lou ding ka hi uh maw? Himahleh huai thuneihna ka zang kei uh; Khrist tanchinhoih ka dallouhna ding un bangkim ka thuak teitei uhi.
Tempul a thil siangthou bawl vialvialte'n tempul a kipan nek amu ua, maitam a nasemte'n maitam a pan ane uh chih na thei kei ua hia?
Huchi mah bang in, Toupa'n tanchinhoih gente nek muhna ding in tanchinhoih mah asep hi.

Himahleh ke'n zaw tuate khat leng ka zang kei hi; ka tung a hiaite na hih ding uh ahi chi a hiai thu gelh ka hi kei hi. Kuapeuh in ka suan pen bangmah lou a abawl sang un, si mai leng kei a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
Tanchinhoih gen mah leng kisaktheihna ding ahi kei hi. Hih louh theih louh ka tung ah akinga ahi; tanchinhoih gen kei leng ka tung gik ding ahi.
Huai tuh keimah ut thu a hih hi leng kipahman ka nei hi; himahleh, keimah ut thu ahihkeileh tanchinhoih kepna nna piak a om ka hi.
Ka kipahman bang ahia le? Tanchinhoih ka gen in loh nei lou a, tanchinhoih athawn a pia ka hihtheihna ahi.
Mi teng a pan zalen himah leng, mi tamsem ka laktheihna ding in mi tengteng sikha in ka kibawlta hi.

Huchi in Judate ka laklut theihna ding in Judate kiang ah Juda mi bang in ka om zel; dan nuai a omte ka laklut theihna ding in dan nuai a omte kiang ah dan nuai a om bang in ka om zel; dan nuai a om tuan lou in.
Dan neiloute ka laklut theihna ding in dan neiloute kiang ah dan nei lou bang in ka om zel, Pathian dan a om lou tuan lou in; Khrist dan zom ngal in.
Hatloute ka laklut theihna ding in hatloute kiang ah hat lou bang in ka om zel; hihtheihna teng zang a khenkhatte ka hotdam theihna ding in mi tengteng kiang ah bangkim ka hita hi.
Tanchinhoih ziak in bangkim ka hih zel a, huai nasepna a ka tel sam theihna ding in.
Kitaitehte avek un atai ua, himahleh khat kia in kipahman amu zel chih na thei kei ua hia? Na muhtheihna ding un huchi mah bang in tai un.
Huan kidemna a kimawl mi peuhmah bangkim ah mahni kithunun in a-om nak hi. Amau zaw lallukhu se thei mu ding in ahih ua, eite'n bel Lallukhu Setheilou mu ding in.
Huaiziak in kei ka tai a, aziak bei hilou in; huihkhua leltak noh lou in ka pang hi.
Himahleh ka pumpi ka thunun a; sikha in ka bawl zaw zel hi; huchi lou in zaw midangte kiang a ka tangkoupih nung in leng bangchi hiam in kei ngeitak kipahman mu tak lou in ka om kha ding hi.
Hinna thu, atung a kipan a ana omta, koute'n ka zak uh, ka mit ua ka muh uh, ka et kilkel ua, ka khut ua ka khoih uh,
huai hinna latsak in ahong omta a, koute'n ka mu uhi, huai tangtawn hinna, Pa kiang a-omleh koute kiang ah latsak a om noute kiang ah ka hon puang uhi;

huai koute'n ka muhsa uh leh ka zaksa uh mah noute kiang a ka puankhiak uh, huchi a noute'n leng koute toh kithuahna na neihtheihna ding un; koute kithuahna bel Pa toh a Tapa Jesu Khrist toh kithuahna ahi.
Noute na kipahna uh abukimna ding in hiai ka hon gelh uhi.
Huan thukhah akiang a kipan a ka zak uh na kiang ua ka hon hilhsawn uh hiai ahi; Pathian zaw vak ahi a, amah ah mial a-om kei hi.
Mial a om napi in amah ka kithuahpih chi lehang zuau i gen a, thutak i zui kei uhi.
Himahleh amah vak a a-om bang a eite leng vak a i omleh i kithuah chiat ua, huan a Tapa Jesu sisan in i khelhna tengteng ahon silsiangsak zel hi.
Khelhna ka nei kei chi lehang eimah leh eimah i kikhem a, eimah ah thutak a-om kei hi.
I khelhnate thupha i tawileh i khelhnate ngaidam ding leh i diktatlouhna tengteng silsiang ding in amah amuanhuai in adiktat hi.
Thil ka hihkhial kei i chihleh amah zuauthei in i bawl ua, athu leng ei ah a-om kei hi.
Ka naute aw, thil na hihkhelhlouhna ding un hiai thute na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelhleh Pa kiang a hon gensakpa, Jesu Khrist, midiktat i nei hi.
Amah i khelhnate thuphatawina ahi, eimah khelhna kia hilou in, khovel tengteng khelhna thuphatawina leng ahi.
Huan athupiakte i zuihleh huai ah amah i thei chih i kithei hi.
Athupiakte zui lou a, "Amah ka thei," chimi zaw mizuauthei ahi, amah ah thutak a-om kei hi.
Kuapeuh athu zui peuhmah amah ah Pathian itna akim petmah hi. Amah ah i om chih hiai ah i kithei ahi.
Amah ah ka om gige chimi, amah om bang in a-om sam ding ahi.
Deihtakte aw, thupiak thak na kiang uah ka gelh kei a; thupiak lui atung a kipan a na neih uh ka gelh zaw ahi. Huai thupiak lui na thu theihsa pen uh ahi.
Himahleh thupiak thak gelh hi sam na veng, huai amah ah leh noumau ah alang hi, mial aman lellel ziak in leh vak taktak tua ahong vak tak ziak in.
A-unau ho napi a, vak ah ka om chimi tutan in leng mial ah a-om gige hi.
A-unau itmi bel vak ah a-om gige a, amah ah kipalpaihna ding san a-om kei hi.
A-unau homi zaw mial ah a-om a, mial ah akhosa a, mial in amit atotsak ziak in apaina leng athei kei hi.
Naute aw, ama min ziak a na khelhnate uh ngaihdam ahih tak ziak in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.

Pate aw, amah atung a kipan a om gige na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Tangvalte aw, Pathian thu noumau ah a-om gige a, giloupa na zoh tak ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Naute aw, Pa na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
Pate aw, amah atung a kipan a om gige na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Tangvalte aw, na hat ua Pathian thu noumau ah a-om gige a, migilou na zoh tak ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
Khovel it kei unla, khovel a thil omte leng it sam kei un. Mi kuapeuh in khovel a-itleh Pa itna amah ah a-om kei hi.
Khovel a thil om tengteng, taksa utnate, mit utnate, damsung thupina limte Pa a kipan ahi kei a, khovel a kipan ahi zaw hi.
Khovel, a-utnate toh amangthang lellel ahi. Pathian deihlam hihmi bel tangtawn in a-om gige ding hi.
Naute aw, hun nanungpen hita e, Khrist doupa ahong pai ding chih na zak bang un tu in leng Khrist doumi tampitak ahong pawtta uhi; huaiziak in hun nanungpen ahita chih i thei uhi.

Amaute i lak ua kipan in apawt ua, himahleh ei sung mi tak ahi kei uh; ei sung mi tak hi le uh i kiang uah a-om sam ding uhi; himahleh avek un ei sung mi tak ahi kei uh chih alatchetna ding in ahon pawtsanta uhi.
Mi Siangthou kiang a kipan thaunilhna na tang ua, bangkim na thei uhi.
Thutak na theih louh ziak ua ka gelh ahi kei a, na theih ziak uh leh thutak a zuau bangmah apawt ngei louh ziak in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
Jesu tuh Khrist ahi chih gingtaloumi sang a zuauthei kua a-om a? Khrist doumi tuh Pa leh Tapa gingtaloumi ahi.
Kuapeuh Tapa nial in Pa anei kei a; kuapeuh Tapa gingta in bel Pa leng asang hi.
Nou zaw atung a kipan a na zak uh noumau ah omsak gige un. Huai atung a kipan a na zak uh noumau a a-om gigeleh noute ngei leng Tapa leh Pa ah na om gige ding uhi.
Hiai ahi amah ngei in ahon chiam pen: tangtawn hinna.
Noumau hon pimang tumte tungtang na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.

Nou zaw amah kiang a kipan a thaunilhna na tan uh noumau ah a-om gige a, kuamah hilh na kiphamoh kei uhi; ama thaunilhna in thil tengteng ahon sinsak bang in leh hiai thudik hi a, zuau leng ahih louh ziak in huai in nou ahon sinsak bang in amah ah om gige un.
Huchi in naute aw, amah ah om gige un; amah ahong kilak chiang in ama ah zum lou in hangsantak in i om thei ding uhi.
Amah midiktat ahi chih na theih uleh mi kuapeuh diktatna hihmi amah a suak ahi chih na thei uhi.
Ngai un, Pa hon itna thupi hi na tel e! Pathian tate chih a i om; huai mah i hihna uh ahi hi. Hiai khawng ziak in khovel in ahon thei kei hi, amah atheih louh ziak in.

Deihtakte aw, tu'n ah Pathian tate i hi ua, bangchi in ahia i om ding chih akithei tadih kei hi; amah ahong kilak chiang in, amah bang in i om ding chih bel i thei hi, amah a-om ngeingei bangtak a mu ding i hi ngal ua.
Amah tung a lametna nei peuhmah amah asiangthou bang in akihihsiangthou hi.
Kuapeuh thil hihkhial dan ah atalek hi; dan a tatlekna khelhna ahi ngal a.
Amah khelhnate lamang ding in ahong langta chih na thei uhi; amah ah khelhna bangmah a-om kei hi.
Kuapeuh amah a om gige in thil ahihkhial kei; kuapeuh thil hihkhial in amah amu kei a, amah leng athei kei hi.
Tate aw, kuamah khem in om kei un. Diktatna hihmi amah adiktat mah bang in adiktat hi.
Thil hihkhialmi zaw diabol a pawt ahi; diabol in atung a kipan thil ahihkhial hi. Pathian Tapa hong latna pen diabol nasepte ahihmanthat theihna ding in ahi.
Kuapeuh Pathian a suak in amah a Pathian chi a-om gige ziak in thil ahihkhial kei, Pathian a suak ahih ziak in, thil ahihkhial thei kei hi.
Hiai ah Pathian tate leh diabol tate atheihtheih hi; kuapeuh diktatna hih lou Pathian a suak ahi kei a, a-unau it lou leng Pathian a suak ahi kei hi.
Atung a kipan thukhah na zak uh i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh chih ahi.
Kain, giloupa a kipan amah unau thatpa bang in om kei ni. Bangziak in ahia athah tak? Amah thilhihte agilou a, a-unau thilhihte adik ziak in ahi.
Naute aw, khovel in nou ahon huatleh lamdang sa kei un.
Unaute i it ziak in sihna a kipan in i pawt ua, hinna ah i lutta chih i thei uhi. Kuapeuh itna nei lou sihna ah a-om lai hi.
Kuapeuh a-unau hua tualthat ahi; tualthatmi tangtawn hinna nei a-om kei uh chih na thei uhi.
Hiai ah itna bang ahia chih i thei hi, ama'n eite a dia ahinna apiak tak ziak in; en leng unaute a ding in i hinna i piak sam ding ahi.
Himahleh kuapeuh in khovel sum nei in, a-unau tasam in mu henla, amah lainat tuan kei taleh Pathian itna amah ah bangchi in a-om dia?
Naute aw, thu kia in it kei ni, lei kia in leng it sam kei ni, thilhih leh thutak in hi zaw hen.
Hiai in thutak a suak i hi chih hon theisak a, amah ma ah i lungtang i muangsak thak ding hi.
I lungtang in siam louh ahon tansak dek chiang in chihna ahi; Pathian zaw i lungtangte sang in alianzaw a thil bangkim athei hi.
Deihtakte aw, i lungtang in siam louh ahon tan keileh Pathian lam ah i hangsan hi;
athupiakte i zuih ua, amitmuh a thil kipahhuai i hih zel ziak in i nget peuhmah amah a kipan in i mu zel uhi.
Huan athupiak hiai ahi, a Tapa Jesu Khrist min gingta lehang, ama'n thu ahon piak bang in ki-ittuah chiat lai lehang.
Athupiakte zuimi amah ah a-om gige a, amah mah leng amah ah a-om gige hi. Huan Kha ahon piak ah amah eimau ah a-om gige chih i thei uhi.
Deihtakte aw, kha napeuh gingta kei un, himahleh khate Pathian a kipan ahi uhiam hilou chih chian un; khovel a zawlnei taklou tampi ana pawt tak ziak un.
Hiai ah Pathian Kha na thei ding uh, bang kha peuh Jesu Khrist, sa in ahong pai chih gum tuh Pathian a kipan ahi.
Bang kha peuh Jesu gum lou Pathian a kipan ahi kei; huai tuh Khrist doumi kha, hong pai ding na zak uh ahi; tu in khovel ah a-om khinta hi.
Naute aw, Pathian a kipan na hi ua, tuate na zouta uhi; noumau a om khovel a om sang a athupi zawk ziak in.
Amau khovel a ahi ua; huaiziak in khovel a bang in apau ua, khovel in athu uh angaikhia hi.
Eite Pathian a kipan i hi ua, Pathian thei mite'n i thu angaikhe zel uhi; Pathian a kipan lou mite'n bel i thu angaikhe kei uhi. Hiai ah thutak Kha leh thutak lou kha i thei uhi.
Deihtakte aw, i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh; itna zaw Pathian a suak ahi ngal a, michih itna nei peuhmah Pathian a suak ahi khin ua, Pathian athei lai uhi.
Itna nei lou in Pathian athei kei; Pathian itna ahih ziak in.
Hiai ah Pathian itna i tung uah ahong langta hi, amah ziak a i hintheihna ding a Pathian in a Tapa neihsun khovel a ahon sawlna ah.
Hiai ah itna a-om, eite'n Pathian i it uh ka chi ahi kei, ama'n ahon it a, i khelhnate thuphatawina ding in, a Tapa ahon sawl ka chi zaw hi.
Deihtakte aw, Pathian in huchi tel a ahon itleh eite leng i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh ahi.
Kuamah in chik lai mah in Pathian amu ngei kei hi. I ki-ittuah chiat uleh ei ah Pathian a-om gige dia, a-itna leng eite sung ah akim lai ding hi.
Amah ah i om gige chih leh amah eite sung ah a-om gige chih Kha a hon piak tak ziak in hiai ah i thei hi.
Huan Pa in Tapa khovel Hondampa hihna nei in ahon sawl chih i muta ua, i theisak uhi.
Kuapeuh Jesu Pathian Tapa ahi chi a gum amah ah Pathian a-om gige a, amah leng Pathian ah a-om gige hi.
Pathian in eite a ding in itna anei chih i theita ua, i gingta lai uhi. Pathian itna ahi; itna a om gige mi Pathian ah a-om a, Pathian leng amah ah a-om hi.
Hiai ah i tung uah itna akimta, vaihawm ni a ding a lau lou a i omtheihna ah; amah om bang a khovel a i om ziak in.
Itna ah launa a-om kei, itna kim in lauhna adelhkhe zaw zel hi, lauhna in gawtna ahon ngaihtuahsak; alaumi peuhmah itna ah abukim nai kei hi.
Ama'n ahon it masak ziak in i it uhi.
Mi'n, "Pathian ka it," chi in a-unau ho taleh amah zuauthei ahi; a-unau amuhsa bawn a-it kei in, Pathian amuh ngei louhpi bangchi in a-it thei dia?
Amah kiang a kipan in hiai thupiak i nei uhi, kuapeuh in Pathian a-itleh a-unau leng a-it sam ding chihna ahi.
Kuapeuh Jesu, Khrist ahi chih gingta Pathian suahsak ahi; kuapeuh asuaksakpa it in asuahsak leng a-it nak hi.
Hiai ah Pathian tate i itna ah Pathian i it a, athupiakte i zui chih i thei uhi.
Pathian i itna hiai ahi, athupiakte i zuihna; athupiakte lah ahaksa ngal kei hi.
Pathian suahsak peuh in khovel azou zel hi; hiai ahi khovel tung a vualzohna, i ginna uh.
