Jesu, Pathian Tapa ahi chih gingtami kia ngal lou, kua'n khovel azou zel a?
Hiai ahi tui leh sisan a hong paipa, Jesu Khrist; tui kia ah hilou in, tui ah leh sisan ah ahi zaw. Theisakpa tuh Kha ahi, Kha thutak ahih ziak in.
Van tung ah theihpih thum a-om, Pa, Thu leh Kha Siangthou ahi ua, amaute khat ahi uhi.
Leitung ah theihpih thum a-om, Kha leh tui leh sisan; huai thumte akithutuak uhi.
Mihing theihpihna bawn i sanleh Pathian theihpihna athupizaw hi. Pathian theihpihna tuh a Tapa tanchin atheipihta chih ahi.
Pathian Tapa gingtami in amah ah theihna anei a, Pathian gingtaloumi in amah zuauthei in abawl hi; Pathian in a Tapa tanchin atheihpih agintak louh ziak in.
Theihpihna hiai ahi, Pathian in tangtawn hinna ahon pia a, huai hinna a Tapa ah a-om hi.
Kuapeuh Tapa nei in hinna anei; kuapeuh Pathian Tapa nei lou in hinna anei kei hi.
Tangtawn hinna na nei uh chih na theihna ding un, nou Pathian Tapa min gingtate kiang ah hiai thu ka gelh ahi.
Hiai pen amah tung a i hangsanna ahi, bangpeuh ama deihlam bang a i ngetleh ama'n ahon ngaihkhiaksak hi.
Huchi in bangpeuh i nget ahon ngaihkhiaksak chih i theihleh akiang a i thilnget i muta chih i thei hi.

Kuapeuh in a-unau sihna khop hilou khelhna hih in muleh angetsak ding, huchi in Pathian in an genmi kiang ah sihna tun hilou khelhna hihte a ding in hinna ape ding hi. Sihna tun khelhna a-om a; huchibang lam ah angetsak ding ka chi ahi kei hi.
Diktatlouhna tengteng khelhna ahi; sihna khop hilou khelhna leng a-om sam hi.
Kuapeuh Pathian suahsak in thil ahihkhial kei chih i thei hi; Pathian Tapa neihsun in amah akem gige a, giloupa'n khoih leng akhoih thei kei hi.
Huan eite Pathian a kipan i hi chih i thei ua, khovel pumpi bel giloupa thuthu in a-om chih i thei hi.

Huan Pathian Tapa ahong pai a, adikpa i theihna ding in theihtheihna ahon pia chih i thei behlap uhi; eite a Tapa Jesu Khrist a i om in adikpa ah i om uhi. Amah tuh Pathian diktak leh tangtawn hinna ahi.
Naute aw, milim lak ah kihemkhia un, Amen.
David hong upa in, ahong tek mahmahta hi. Huchi in puan in akhuh zel ua, himahleh lum asa thei tuan kei hi.
Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ka toupa kumpipa a ding in nungak zong le ungla; kumpipa kiangchin ah om gige henla, kemleh; na angsung ah hong lumleh, ka toupa kumpipa'n lum ahon sa thei ding," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel gam tengteng ah nungak melhoih azong ua, Shunam mi Abishag ava mu ua, kumpipa kiang ah api uhi.
Huai nungak amel ahoih mahmah a, kumpipa akem a, anek-tak abawlsak hi. Himahleh, kumpipa'n amah akithuahpih kei hi.
Haggith tapa Adonijah in, "Kei kumpipa a pang ding ka hi ve," chi in akingai thupi mahmah hi. Kangtalai leh sakol tungtuangmi sawmnga ama a tai dingte toh akisasak hi.
Apa'n lah chik lai in leng, "Bangziak a hichibang a hih na hia?" chi in alungkhamsak ngei kei hi. Amah melhoih mahmah a, Absalom sangpa ahi.
Ama'n Zeruiah tapa Joab leh siampu Abiathar thu adong a; amau Adonijah lam ah apang ua, amah apanpih uhi.
Siampu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, zawlnei Nathan, Shimei, Rei leh David pawl a mihangsante bel Adonijah lam ah apang kei uhi.
Adonijah in belamte, bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute Zoheleth' Suang ah agou a, huai tuh En-rogel kiangchin a om ahi. Kumpipa tapate, a-unau tengteng leh Judah gam a kumpipa sikha tengteng achial hi.
Zawlnei Nathan, Benaiah, mihangsante leh a-unaupa Solomon bel achial kei hi.
Nathan in Solomon nu Bathsheba kiang ah, "Haggith tapa Adonijah, i toupa David theih louh in vaihawm in a-om chih za lou na hi maw?
Na bitna ding leh na tapa Solomon bitna ding ka hon hilh ding.

Kumpipa David kiang ah va lut inla, akiang ah, Aw toupa, ka kumpipa, na sikhanu kiang ah na tapa Solomon, ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei dia, amah ka laltutphah ah atu ding, chi in na kichiam ahi kei maw? Bang achia Adonijah in vaihawm ahia?" va chi dih achi hi.
"Ngai in, kumpipa na va houpih laitak in ke'n leng ka hon zui lut sam dia, na thugen ka hon hihkippih ding," chi in agen hi.
Bathsheba kumpipa kiang ah indan ah ava lut a; kumpipa a-upa mahmahta a, Shunam mi Abishag in kumpipa nek-tak a na bawl hi.
Bathsheba in kumpipa kun in zahtakna apia hi. Kumpipa'n, "Bang na deih a?" ana chi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka toupa aw, TOUPA na Pathian min lou in na sikhanu kiang ah, na tapa Solomon ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei ding a, amah ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding, chi in na kichiam khinta hi.
Ngai in, tu in Adonijah lah alal a; nang ka kumpipa toupa'n lah na thei kei hi.
Bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute leh belamte agou zengzung a, kumpipa tapa tengteng leh siampu Abiathar leh sepaih heutu Joab achial a, na sikha Solomon achial kei hi.
Huchi in toupa aw, ka toupa nung a alaltutphah a kua hong tu ding ahia chih na gen ding in, Israelte tengteng mit nang ka toupa kumpipa tung ah atu hi.
Huchi lou in zaw hichi ahi ding a, toupa kumpipa apute kiang a a-ihmut sam hun chiang in, kei leh ka tapa Solomon thil hihkhial in ahon sep mai ding uh,” achi hi.
Ngai in, huchi a kumpipa ahoupih laitak in, zawlnei Nathan ava lut sam hi.
"En dih, zawlnei Nathan ahong," chi in kumpipa ahilh uh. Kumpipa kiang ava tun in, kumpipa ma ah amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
Nathan in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, ka nung ah Adonijah alal dia, ka laltutphah ah atu ding na chi maw?

Tuni in akuansuk a, bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute leh belamte agou zengzung a, kumpipa tapa tengteng, sepaih heutute leh siampu Abiathar achial hi. Ngai in, ane un adawnkhawm ua, Pathian in kumpipa Adonijah hondam hen, achi uh.
Himahleh kei na sikha ngei leh siampu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah leh na sikha Solomon ahon chial kei hi.
Hiai toupa ka kumpipa thu a hih ahih ngalleh toupa ka kumpipa'n anung a laltutphah a tu dingpa akua pen ahia chih na sikhate na hilh nai lou na hi ding maw?" achi hi.
Kumpipa David in adawng a, "Bathsheba hon sapsak dihua," achi hi. Kumpipa kiang ah ava hoh a, kumpipa ma ah ava dingh hi.
Kumpipa akichiam a, "Lungzinna tengteng a ka hinna humbitpa TOUPA ahin bang in,
na kiang a TOUPA Israelte' Pathian min lou a, na tapa Solomon ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei ding. Ka sik in ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding, chi a ka kichiam bang in, tuni in ka hih ding,” achi hi.
Bathsheba amai a lei si in abokkhup a, kumpipa zahtakna pia in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa David tangtawn in dam zel hen,” achi hi.
Kumpipa David in, "Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah hon va sapsak dih ua," achi hi. Amau kumpipa ma ah ava pai uhi.
Kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Na toupa uh sikhate pi unla, ka tapa Solomon keimah sabiltung mahmah ah tuangsak unla, Gihon ah pisuk un.
Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan in Israelte kumpipa ding in thau nilh uhen. Pengkul mut unla, Pathian in kumpipa Solomon hondam hen, chi un.
Huchi in amah na zuitou ding ua, ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding hi; amah lah ka sik a lal ding ahi ngal a. Amah Israel gam leh Judah gam vaihawmtu dia ka seh ahi,” achi hi.
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in kumpipa adawng a, "Amen, TOUPA, ka toupa kumpipa Pathian in leng pha sa hen.
TOUPA ka toupa kumpipa kiang a a-om bang in, Solomon kiang ah leng om sam henla, ka toupa kumpipa David laltutphah sang in alaltutphah hih thupizaw hen," achi hi.
Huchi in siampu Zadok, zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kereth mite leh Pelet mite ahohsuk ua, David sabiltung tung ah Solomon atuangsak ua, Gihon ah api uhi.
Siampu Zadok in puanin a pan thau koihna ala a, Solomon anilh hi. Pengkul amut ua, huchi in mi tengteng in, "Pathian in kumpipa Solomon hondam hen," achi uhi.
Mi tengteng in amah azuitou ua, mite'n tamngaite atum ua, akipak mahmah ua, ahusa ging un lei akheng hi.
Adonijah leh amichial, akiang a om tengteng in ankuang alui khit un aza ua, Joab in pengkul mutging azak in, "Khopi sung a husa ging zuazua bangchidan ahia le?" achi hi.
Huai achih laitak in, ngai in, siampu Abiathar tapa Jonathan ava hoh a, Adonijah in, "Hong pai dih ve, nang zaw mikizen na hi a, tanchinhoih na hon tun mahmah ding," ana chi hi.
Jonathan in adawng a, Adonijah kiang ah, "Tun ke'ng e, toupa aw, kumpipa David in Solomon kumpipa in abawl khinta hi.
Amah toh siampu Zadok, zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kereth mite leh Pelet mite kumpipa'n asawl a, kumpipa sabiltung tung ah atuangsak uhi.
Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan in Gihon ah kumpipa ding in thau anilh uh. Huai a pan nuamsatak in apaitou ua, huai in khopi sung athawn zuazua hi. Husa na zak uh huai ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon leng lalgam tutphah ah atuta hi.

Kumpipa sikhate i toupa kumpipa David vualzawl ding in ahong ua, "Pathian in na min sang in Solomon min hihhoih zaw henla, na laltutphah sang in ama laltutphah hih thupizaw hen,” ahong chi uh. Huchi in kumpipa lupna tung ah akun hi.
Kumpipa'n leng, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, tuni mahmah a ka laltutphah a tu ding hon pepa phat in om hen. Ka mit mahmah in amuta,” achi hi.
Adonijah michial tengteng in alauta ua, athou ua, alampi chiat uah apaivekta uhi.
Adonijah in Solomon alau a, athou a, maitam kii ava len hi.
"Ngai in, Adonijah in kumpipa Solomon alau a; kumpipa Solomon in asikha namsau a that lou ding in ka kiang ah kichiam phot hen," chi in maitam kii alen hi chi in Solomon ahilh uhi.
Solomon in, "Miginomtak ahih asuklat peuhmahleh asamzang khat leng lei ah ake kei ding. Gitlouhna anei chih theihna a-omleh bel asi ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in mi asawl a, maitam a pan ava pisuk ua, amah ava hoh a, kumpipa Solomon ma ah akun hi. Solomon in akiang ah, "Na inn ah pai in," ana chi hi.
Huan TOUPA min a athilhih tungtang thu a Solomon minthandan Sheba kumpinu'n ana zak in thuhaksa pipi toh amah ettel tum in akiang ah ahoh hi.
Jerusalem ah nungzui mi tampi toh, gimlimte leh dangka-eng tampi leh suangmantamte pua sangawngsaute tonpih in ahoh hi. Solomon kiang atun in alungtang a thu a pai tengteng suahkhe vek in ahoupih hi.
Solomon in athudot tengteng adawng vek a; kumpipa theih louh, ahilhchet theih louh himhim a-om kei hi.
Sheba kumpinu'n Solomon pildan tengteng, a-inn lam,
adohkan a nek ding, asikhate tutdan, anasemte nasepdan, akivatdante uh, anou pe mite, TOUPA' inn a lat halmang thillatte amuh in lungsim chih leng nei zou lou khop in lamdang asa hi.
Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na thilhihte leh na pildante ka gam a ka zak thuthang adik mah ana hi.
Himahleh keimah mit mahmah a ka hong muh masiah agen uh ka taksang kei hi. Huchi in ngai in, akimkhat leng ahon na hilh sam ua, agen uh ka zak sang in na pildan leh na hoihdan ana thupizaw hi.
Na mite, hiai na sikha, na kiang a om gige na pilna thu ngaikhe gigete ahampha uhi!

TOUPA na Pathian, na tung a kipak mahmah, Israelte laltutphah a hon tusakpa phat in om hen. TOUPA'N Israelte tangtawn in a-it a, huaiziak in, diktattak a vaihawm ding in kumpipa in ahon bawl hi," achi hi.
Huchi in dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih leh gimlim atam a tam leh suangmantamte kumpipa apia a, Sheba kumpinu'n kumpipa Solomon gimlim apiak bang lawmlawm a tam alut ngei kei hi.
Hiram longhon, Ophir a pan dangka-eng va pote'n leng Ophir a pan almug sing tampi leh suangmantamte ahon pua uhi.

Kumpipa'n almug singte TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn umna ding in leh lasa mite kaihging leh pekging bawlna ding in azang hi. Tuni tan in hichibang almug sing himhim alut in, muh leng muh ahi nawnta kei hi.
Anget louh Solomon in apiakte chih louh leng kumpipa Solomon in Sheba kumpinu'n adeih tengteng, anget peuhmah apia hi. Huchi in amah leh lawite a-omna gam ah apai nawnta uhi.
Solomon kiang a kum khat sung a dangka-eng lut gikdan dangka-eng talent zaguk sawmguk-le-guk ahi.
Hiaite lou leng sumsin mite leh thilzuak mite, Arab kumpipate leh gamsung vaihawmte a pan siahpiakte anei lai hi.
Kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng sekpek in lum lian zanih abawl a; lum khat ah dangka-eng shekel zaguk alut hi.
Dangka-eng sekpek in lum zathum abawl a; lum khat ah dangka-eng mina thum alut a; huaite kumpipa'n Lebanon gammang inn ah akoih hi.
Kumpipa'n saiha laltutphah thupi mahmah abawl a, huai dangka-eng hoihpen tui in aluan hi.
Laltutphah kaltouhna ah siksan guk a-om a, laltutphah nunglam dawn abem hi. Atutna sik tuak ah douna a-om tuaktuak a; adouna zulte ah humpinelkai dingh lim nih a-om hi.
Siksan gukte sik tuak ah humpinelkai dingh sawm-le-nih lim a-om a; huchibang koi gam mah ah leng abawl ngei kei uhi.
Kumpipa nou tengteng dangka-eng ahi vek a, Lebanon gammang inn a, atui-um belsuan tengteng leng dangka-eng ngen mah ahi vek uhi. Dangka himhim a-om kei. Solomon dam lai in huai bangpi in asim kei uh.
Kumpipa'n tuipi ah Hiram longhon kithuahpih Tarshish longhon anei a; Tarshish longhon in kum thum hal zel in dangka-eng, dangka, saiha, zawng leh utong ahon po zel uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in leitung a kumpipa tengteng hauh lam leh pil lam in akhup vek hi.
Pathian in alungtang a pilna thu akoihsak ngaikhe ding in leitung a mi tengteng in Solomon ahong zuan huthut zel uhi.
Michih in thilpiakte kum teng a piak zah nei in dangka tui-um belsuan dangka-eng tui-um belsuan puan, galvan, gimlim, sakol leh sabiltungnoute ahong pe zel uhi.

Solomon in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite akaikhawm a, kangtalai sangkhat-le-zali leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei hi. Huaite kangtalai koihnate ah, Jerusalem a kumpipa omna ah a-omsak hi.
Kumpipa'n Jerusalem ah atam mahmah ziak in dangka chite suang bang mai a sehkhop in a-omsak a, sidar singte phai a theipi sing bang lel a sehkhop in a-omsak hi.
Solomon neih sakolte Aigupta gam a pan ahon tolhkhiak ahi a; kumpipa sumsin mite'n huaite ahonhon in ana khak zel ua, ahon a lei zel ahi.

Aigupta gam a kangtalai dangka chi shekel zaguk zel in leh sakol dangka chi shekel za-le-sawmnga zel in ahon polut uhi. Huchibang mah in Hitte kumpipa tengteng leh Siria kumpipate a ding in leng apokhia uhi.
Himahleh Solomon in Pharaoh tanu ban ah namdang numei tampi a-it hi. Amau Moabte, Ammonte, Edomte, Zidonte leh Hitte ahi uh.

Huai namte tungtang thu TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah, "Amau toh na kitentuah het louh ding uh ahi. Na kitentuah uleh apathiante uh lam a na lungtang uh hon ngasak ngeingei ding uh ahi," chi a na hilh khit tak namte ahi uh. Hinapi in Solomon in amau it in alen tinten hi.
Huchi in zipi zasagih, kumpipa tanute anei a, mei zathum anei hi. Huai azite'n alungtang apikawisak uhi.
Hichi ahong hi a, Solomon ahong upat nung in, azite'n pathian dangte lam ah alungtang apikawisak uhi. Huchi in apa David lungtang bang in TOUPA a Pathian lam ah alungtang ahoihkimta kei hi.
Solomon in Zidonte pathiannu Ashtaroth leh Ammonte pathian kihhuai mahmah Milkom azuita hi.
Huchi in Solomon in TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahihta a, apa David bang in TOUPA azui tettet kei hi.
Huchi in Solomon in Jerusalem chin a mual ah Moabte pathian kihhuai mahmah Khemosh a ding leh Ammon suante Pathian kihhuai mahmah Molek a ding in mun sang abawlta hi.
Huai mah bang in namdang azi tengteng apathiante uh kiang a kithoih a gimlim hal zelte a ding leng abawlsak hi.
Huchi in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, akiang a nihvei kilak khinsa alungtang in alehngatsan ziak in, Solomon tung ah TOUPA ahehta hi.
Hiai thu, pathian dangte na zui ding ahi kei, chih thu a na pepa TOUPA thupiak lah azui kei hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Solomon kiang ah, "Hichibang in na omta a, ka thukhun leh ka dan thusehte zuih dia thu ka hon piak lah na zuita kei hi. Gam ka hon sut ngeingei dia, na sikha ka pe ding.
Himahleh na pa David ziak in na damsung tel in zaw ka hih tadih kei ding. Himahleh na tapa khut a pan gam pen ka hon sut ding hi.
Gam tengteng ka hon sut vek kei dia; himahleh ka sikha David ziak leh ka tel Jerusalem ziak in nam khat na tapa ka pe ding," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Solomon melma ding in Edom mi, Hadad adingkhesakta a; amah Edom gam kumpipa suan ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Edom gam a David a-om lai a, amithahte uh vui ding a asepaih heutu Joab ahohtouh a, Edom mi pasal peuhmah ava thah khit nung in,
Joab leh Israel mi tengteng kha guktak Edom gam a pasal tengteng ahihlup khit masiah om uhi.
Hadad leh apa sikhate lak a Edom mi khenkhatte Aigupta gam ah atai ua; Hadad ahihleh naupang neu ahi lai hi.

Midian gam a pan apawt ua, Paran ahong tung uh. Paran a pan mite api ua, Aigupta gam, Aigupta gam kumpipa Pharaoh kiang atungsuk ua; ama'n inn ana pia a, nek dingte ana ngaihtuahsak a, gam leng ana pia hi.
Hadad tung ah Pharaoh mit atung mahmah a, huchi in ama zi sanggamnu, kumpinu Tahpenes sanggamnu azi ding in apia hi.
Tahpenes sanggamnu in tapa Genubath aneihsak a, Tahpenes in Pharaoh inn ah anawinek tawpna abawlsak hi. Pharaoh inn ah Pharaoh tapate lak ah Genubath a-omta hi.
Hadad in Aigupta gam a pan David apute kiang ah a-ihmuta chih leh sepaih heutu Joab leng asita chih ana zak in, Hadad in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka gam ua ka paitheihna ding in hon pawtsak ve," achi hi.

Huchi in Pharaoh in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a nå om in taksap bang na nei a? Ngai in, huchi a na gam ua pai nawn na tup maimah?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Bangmah nei lou e. Bang teng hileh hon paisak himhim in," achi hi.
Pathian in amelma ding in Eliadah tapa Rezon, atoupa Hadadezer, Zobah kumpipa a pan taimangsa leng adingsak nawn hi.
David in Zobah a mite athah lai in ama'n akiang ah mite akaikhawm a, sepaih heutu in ana pang hi. Damaskas ah ahoh ua, huai ah ateng ua, Damaskas ah kumpipa in atuta hi.
Hadad in buaina tut behlap in Solomon damsung teng Israelte melma ahi gige a; Israelte aho mahmah a, Siria gam tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Nebat tapa Jeroboam, Zered a Ephraim mi Solomon sikha mah, anu min Zeruah ahi a, meithai ahi, huai mi'n leng kumpipa tung ah akhut alik sam hi.
Kumpipa tung a akhut ahon likna san hichibang ahi: Solomon in Millo abawl a, apa David khua asiatna lailai abawlhoih hi.
Jeroboam ahihleh mihat leh hangsan ahi a; huchi in Solomon in huai tangval mithanuamtak ahi chih atheih ziak in Joseph inkote nasep tengteng tung ah heutu in abawl hi.
Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem a pan Jeroboam apawtkhiak lai in Shiloh mi zawlnei Ahijah in lampi ah ana mu a; Ahijah in puan thak asilh a; amau gel kia in gamlak ah a-om uhi.
Ahijah in apuan thak silh ala a, nen sawm-le-nih in abotkek hi.
Jeroboam kiang ah, "Nen sawm la in," TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, Solomon khut a pan lalgam ka sut dia, nam sawm nang ka hon pe ding.
Himahleh ka sikha David ziak leh Israel nam tengteng lak a ka tel khopi, Jerusalem ziak in nam khat anei ding;

amau hon paisan a, Zidonte pathiannu Ashtaroth, Moabte pathian Kemosh leh Ammonte pathian Milkom abiak ziak un leh ka mitmuh a thil hoih hih ding leh ka sehte leh ka vaihawmte zui dia apa David bang a ka lampite azuih louh ziak in.
"Gam pumpi in ahihleh ka sut kei dia; himahleh ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte zuipa, ka tel, ka sikha David ziak in adamsung in kumpipa in ka omsak lai ding.
Himahleh atapa khut a pan in lalgam ka sutkhe dia, nang ka hon pe ding, nam sawmte tan in leng.
Ka sikha David in ka min omna ding a ka tel khopi Jerusalem a ka ma a vak aneih gige theihna ding in nam khat bel atapa ka pe ding hi.
Nang ka hon sep ding a, na ut tengteng bang in vai na hawm dia, Israelte kumpipa na hi ding.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, thu ka hon piak peuhmah na pom a, ka lampite na zuih a, ka sikha David bang a ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte zui dia ka mitmuh a thil hoih na hihleh na kiang ah ka om dia, David a dia ka dinkipsak bang in inkuan kip ka hon dinkhiaksak dia, Israelte ka hon pe ding hi.
Huchi in David suan ka hihgim dia, himahleh tangtawn in zaw ahi kei ding," achi hi.
Huaiziak in Solomon in Jeroboam thah atum a, Jeroboam a ding a, Aigupta gam ah, Aigupta gam kumpipa Shishak kiang ah atai a, Solomon sih matan Aigupta gam ah a-omta hi.
Solomon tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng leh apilna Solomon thilhih gelhna bu ah atuang kei a hia?
Solomon in Israel tengteng tung a Jerusalem a vai ahawm sung kum sawmli ahi.
Huchi in Solomon apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, apa David khopi ah avui uh. Huchi in atapa Rehoboam asik in ahong lalta hi.
Huan Rehoboam Shekem ah ahoh hi. Israel tengteng Shekem ah kumpipa a amah bawl ding in ahoh khinta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in huai thu ana zak in Kumpipa Solomon kiang a pan ataimangna Aigupta gam a om lai ahi a, Jeroboam ahihleh Aigupta gam a om ahi.
Amah ava samsak ua, Jeroboam leh Israel kikaikhawm tengteng ahong ua, Rehoboam kiang ah,
"Na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak mahmah hi. Huaiziak in na pa hon zat gimna leh ahakkol giktak ka tung ua angak hon hihzangsak inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," chi in ahong gen uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ni thum sung va kikhinkhe phot unla; ka kiang ah hong pai nawn un," achi hi. Huchi in mite apaikheta uh.
Kumpipa Rehoboam in apa Solomon dam lai a, akiang a om upate kiang ah, "Hiai mite bangchi in ka dawng dia hon hilh mah dih uh," chi in adong hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Tuni a hiai mite sikha a na om a, a-nna uh sem a, amau dawng a, akiang ua thuhoih na genleh, tangtawn in na sikha in a-om ding uh," achi uhi.
Himahleh upate hoihsak azui kei a, amah toh kivual tuailai akiang a omte adong zawta hi.
Akiang uah, "Hiai mite, ka kiang a, na pa'n ka tung ua hakkol angak hon hihzangsak in, chi a hong gen mite bangchi in ka dawng dia, hon hilh mah dih uh," achi hi.

Akhanvual tuailaite'n akiang ah, "Hiai mite, na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak thei mahmah a, nang hon hihzangsak dih ve, na kiang achi mite kiang ah, hichibang in chi inla, hichibang in akiang uah gen in.
'Ka pa kawng sang in ka khutme alianzaw. Ka pa'n hakkol giktak ahon na batsak a, ke'n na hakkol uh ka behlap lai ding hi. Ka pa'n zepna in ahon sawi a, ke'n aikam in ka hon sawi ding,' " achi hi.
Huchi in Jeroboam leh mi tengteng kumpipa'n ni thum nung chiang in, "Ka kiang ah hong nawn un," chi a ahilh bang in, ani thum ni in Rehoboam kiang ah ava hoh uhi.
Kumpipa'n mite khauhtak in ana dawng a, upate hoihsak apompih kei hi.
Tuailaite hoihsak bang in, "Ka pa'n na hakkol uh ana giksak a, ke'n na hakkol uh ka behlap lai dia, ka pa'n zepna in ahon na sawi a, ke'n ahihleh aikam in ka hon sawi ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n mite thu angaikheta kei; hiai bang a thil om TOUPA a pan lah ahi ngal a. TOUPA'N Shiloh mi Ahijah zang a Nebat tapa Jeroboam kiang a, athugen atungtun theihna ding ahi.

Israel tengteng in kumpipa'n athugen uh apom kei chih atheih un, "David ah tantuan bang i nei ua? Jesse tapa ah gouluah ding i nei kei uh. Israelte aw, na puanin chiat uah pai un. David, na inkuan kingaihtuah in," chi in kumpipa adawng uh. Huchi in Israelte apuanin chiat uah apaita uhi.
Himahleh Judah khopite a teng Israel suante tung ah Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in phutluih nasemte heutu Adoram asawl hi. Israel tengteng in suang in ana deng ua, asita hi. Huaiziak in Jerusalem a tai ding in kumpipa Rehoboam kintak in akangtalai ah atuang hi,
Huchi in tuni tan in David inkote tung ah Israelte ana hel uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel tengteng in Jeroboam ahong kik nawn chih azak un, kikaihkhawmna a hoh ding in asamsak ua, Israelte tung ah kumpipa in abawl uhi. Judah nam chih louh David inkote zui kuamah a-om kei uh.
Jerusalem atuntak in Rehoboam in Israel inkote dou a Solomon tapa Rehoboam lalgam la nawn ding in Judah inkuan tengteng leh Benjamin nam a pan mihangsan atelkhiak, nuaikhat-le-singgiat akaikhawm hi.
Himahleh Pathian mipa Shemaiah kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi.
Judah gam kumpipa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kiang ah leh Judah leh Benjamin inkuan tengteng kiang ah leh midang teng kiang ah,

TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Va hohtou kei un. Israel suan na unaute va dou kei un. Na inn chiat uah pai nawn vek un. Hiai kei thilhih ahi, chi in gen in," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA thu azui ua, TOUPA thu bang in akik nawn ua, apai nawn vekta uhi.
Huchi in Jeroboam in Ephraim tanggam ah Shekem khua asat a, huai ah ateng hi. Huai a pan apawtkhia a, Penuel khua asat hi.
Jeroboam in alungtang in, "Lalgam David inkote ahong hi nawn diam aw," achi hi.

"Hiai mite Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn a kithoihnate lan dia ahohtouh uleh alungtang un atoupa uh, Rehoboam, Judah gam kumpipa lam ah a-awn nawn mai ding. Huchi in kei ahon that ding ua, Judah gam kumpipa Rehoboam lam ah abelh nawn mai ding uh," achi hi.

Kumpipa'n mi adong a, dangka-eng in bawngnou lim nih abawl a; akiang uah, "Nou a ding in Jerusalem a hohtouh ahaksa lo tel hi. Aw, Israel en dih uh, Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhia na pathiante uh," achi hi.
Huchi in khat Bethel ah akoih a, khat pen Dan ah akoih hi.
Mipite lah hiai bawngnou lim khat be ding in Dan tanpha ava pai ziak un hiai khelhna ahong hita hi.
Mun sang ah innte alam a, Levi suante hilou, miniampente lak a mi siampu in abawl hi.

Jeroboam in Judah gam a ankuanglui aneih mah bang un akha giatna, huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni ankuanglui ni ding in asep hi. Maitam ah ahohtou a; Bethel ah abawngnou lim kiang ah akithoih hi. Mun sang abawlte ah siampute sep in Bethel ah akoih hi.
Ama'n adeih bang a, aseh kha mah, akha giatna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Bethel a maitam abawl ah ahohtou hi. Israel suante a ding in ankuangluina asep a, maitam a gimlim hal ding in ahohtou hi.
Huan ngai in, TOUPA thu in Judah gam a pan Bethel ah Pathian mipa khat ahong hi. Maitam chin ah gimlim hal ding in Jeroboam ana ding hi.

Ama'n TOUPA thu in maitam akikoukhum a, "Maitam aw, maitam, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ngai in, David inkuan ah tapa, amin Josiah ahong piang dia, ama'n na tung a gimlim halna mun sang a siampute na tung ah alan dia, na tung ah mihing guhte ahal ding, " achi hi.
Huai ni mah in chiamtehna apia hi. “Hiai TOUPA'N chiamtehna ding achih ahi. Ngai in, maitam ahong khangkham dia, atung a meivute ahong bo vek ding," achi hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian mipa in Bethel a maitam akikoukhum thu kumpipa'n azak in, Jeroboam in, "Man un," chi in maitam a pan akhut in asawk hi. Mat tum a asawkna khut azawta a, akhut akaikik nawn theita kei hi.
Pathian mipa in TOUPA thu chiamtehna dia agen bang in maitam leng akhangkham a, maitam a meivute leng abo vek uhi.

Kumpipa'n adawng a, Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ka khut ahong dam nawn theihna ding in TOUPA na Pathian hehpihna ngen inla, hon thumsak in," achi hi. Pathian min TOUPA kiang ah angen a, kumpipa khut ahong dam nawn a, amalam a bangmah in ahong om nawnta hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ka inn ah kei toh i pai dia hong kihihhalh tadih inla, huchi in kipahman ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
Pathian mipa in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na inn kimkhat zah hon pe ding himah lechin leng na kiang ah ka hong pai tuan kei ding, hiai ah tanghou ne in tui himhim leng ka dawn sam kei ding.
Tanghou va ne in tui himhim leng va dawn ke'nla, 'Na va hohna lampi ah leng kik nawn ke'n chi a TOUPA thu a sawl ka hi,' " achi hi.
Huchi in lampi dang ah apai a, Bethel a ahong kuanna lampi ah apaita kei hi.
Bethel ah zawlnei putek khat a-om hi. Atapate'n huai ni a Bethel a Pathian mipa thilhih tengteng ahilh vek uhi. Kumpipa kiang a athugente leng apa uh ahilh lai uhi.
Apa un akiang uah, "Koi lampi atawn a?" achi hi. Atapate'n Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa pai nawnna lampi akawkmuh uhi.
Huchi in atapate kiang ah, "Sabiltung hon bawlsak dih uh," achi hi. Sabiltung abawlsak ua; atung ah atuang hi.
Pathian mipa adelhta a, tosaw sing nuai a tu in ava mu hi. Akiang ah, "Nang na hi maw Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n akiang ah, "Ka inn ah kei toh hong pai inla; tanghou hong ne dih ve,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Nang toh kik nawn thei ka hi kei, na kiang a hong thei leng ka hi sam kei. Hiai ah na kiang ah tanghou ne in tui himhim leng ka dawn sam kei ding.
Tanghou va ne in tui himhim leng va dawn ke'nla, na va hohna lampi ah leng kik nawn ke'n, chi a TOUPA thu a hilh lah ka hi ngal a,” achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Kei leng nangmah bang a zawlnei ka hi. Angel in TOUPA thu in, tanghoute ne a tuite dawn ding in na inn ah pikik nawn in, chi in ahon houpih hi," achi hi. Himahleh akiang ah zuau agen hi.
Huchi in akiang ah akik nawn a, a-inn ah tanghoute ne in tui adawnta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, dohkan a-um lai un, apikik nawnpa zawlnei kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Huchi in Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa kiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "TOUPA thugen mang lou a, TOUPA na Pathian in thu ahon piak na zuih louh a,
hong kik nawn a, tanghou ne in tui leng dawn ke'n, ka chihna mun mahmah a tanghou ne a, tui na dawn ziak in na luang na pute han a koih ahi kei ding," chi in agenkheta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, tanghou ne a, tui adawn zoh in, zawlnei pikik nawnpa'n sabiltung abawlsak hi.
Huchi in apaita a lamkal ah humpinelkai toh akituak ua, ana that hi. Aluang lampi ah akipai a, akiang ah sabiltung adingh a, humpinelkai leng siluang kiang ah adingh hi.
Ngai in, mi ava pai ua, lampi a siluang kipai leh siluang kiang a humpinelkai dingh amu ua; zawlnei putek tenna khua ah ava gen uhi.

Lamkal a pan va pikik nawnpa zawlnei in huai thu ana zaktak in, "Pathian mi, TOUPA thugen mang nuamloupa ei ve. Huchi in ToUPA'N akiang a agen, athu bangbang a TOUPA'N humpinelkai kiang a pia a, na ham a, na keilum ahita ve," achi hi.
Atapate kiang ah, "Sabiltung hon bawlsak dih uh," chi in agen a; abawlsak uhi.
Huchi in akuanta a, aluang lampi a kipai leh sabiltung leh humpinelkai a luang kiang a dingh ava mu hi. Humpinelkai in luang ana ne nai kei a, sabiltung leng ana ham kei hi.
Zawlnei in Pathian mipa luang adom a, sabiltung tung ah akoih a, akikpihta hi. Huchi in zawlnei putek tenna khua ah suun ding leh vui ding in alalut hi.
Aluang ama han ah asial a, "Ka unaupa khawk hi na mah e!" chi in asuun uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, avui khit nung in atapate kiang ah, "Ka sih chiang in Pathian mipa kivuina han ah hon vui sam un. Aguhte kiang ah ka guhte koih un.
Pathian thu a Bethel a maitam leh Samaria gam khopite a mun sangte inn tengteng akikoukhumna thu hong tung ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi.
Huai thil zoh in Jeroboam in a omdan diklou atawpsan tuan kei hi. Miniampente lak a mun sang siampu dia abawl siampute a-omtheihna ding un adeihdeih ahihtuam hi.
Huai thil Jeroboam inkuan khelhna amau inn gamsaktu leh leitung maikaih a pan hihmangthangtu ahong hita hi.
Huai lai in Jeroboam tapa Abijah achina hi.

Jeroboam in azi kiang ah, "Thou inla, Jeroboam zi na hi chih ahon theihtheihlouhna ding un kihihlamdang inla, Shiloh ah va hoh dih; ngai in, huai ah zawlnei Ahijah, hiai mite tung a kumpipa dia ka hong om ding ka tungtang thu genpa a-om hi.
Tanghou beu sawm leh tanghou pei lian lou leh khuaizu thawl khat tawi inla, akiang ah va hoh dih. Naupang omdan ding hon na hilh ding," achi hi.
Jeroboam zi in huchibang in ahih a, athou a, Shiloh ah ahoh a, Ahijah inn ah ava hohta hi. Ahijah in khua amu thei nawn kei a; a-upat ziak in amit amialta hi.

TOUPA'N Ahijah kiang ah, "Ngai in, Jeroboam zi atapa tungtang a thu dong ding in ahong, achi ana a, chi in hichibang in na hilh ding ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahong lut chiang in numei dang hileh kilawmtak in ahong kibawl ding,” achi hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahijah in ahong lut lai a akhesik ging ana zaktak in, "Nang Jeroboam zi hong lut dih ve. Bang achia ahia midang dan a na kibawl? Tanchin hoih loutak nang hon hilh dia sawl ka hi.
Pai nawn inla, Jeroboam kiang ah, TOUPA'N, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Mipite lak a pan ka hon tawisang a, ka mi Israelte tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi.

David inkuante gam ka sut a, huai nang ka hon pia hi. Himahleh nang ka sikha David bang in na om kei. Ama'n zaw ka thupiakte azui a, ka mitmuh a thil hoih kia hih tum in alungtang tengteng in ahon zui hi.
Himahleh nang bel na ma a mite tengteng sang in thil na hihkhial mahmah se a, na hon hehsakna ding in pathian dangte leh milim sunte na bawl a, na hon nungngatsanta hi.

Huaiziak in ngai in, Jeroboam inkuan tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak dia, Jeroboam a pan ta pasal taphot Israel gam a mi nehden leh den louh leng ka hihmang dia, mi'n ek aphiatsiang sipsip bang in Jeroboam inkuan agam vek masiah ka phiatmang ding hi.
Jeroboam inko lak a mi, khopi a si peuhmahte ui in ane dia; gam a si peuhmahte tung a leng vasate'n ane ding uh. Hiai TOUPA'N agen khinta hi.
"Huchi in thou inla na inn ah pai nawn mai in, khopi sung na sik chiang in huai naupang asi ding hi.
Huchi in Israel tengteng in asuun ding ua, avui ding uh. Jeroboam inkote lak ah amah kia han akoih ahi ding hi. Jeroboam inko lak ah amah kia a TOUPA Israelte' Pathian lam a thil hoih omsun ahi.
TOUPA'N amah a dia Israelte tung a kumpipa hi ding; Jeroboam inkuan hihmang ding mi khat atungkhe ding hi. Himahleh bang eita? Huai ni ding, tu mah ahi.

TOUPA'N lah tui a phaiphek lingling bang mai in Israelte ahon sat ling dia; huchi in TOUPA hehsak a Asherte uh abawl ziak un apute uh ana piaksa, hiai gam hoihtak a pan Israelte abotkhe siang vek dia, lui khen lam ah ahon hihzak vek ding hi.
Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahih Jeroboam khelhnate ziak in Israelte alehngatsan ding,” achi hi.
Jeroboam zi athou a, apawtkhia a, Tirzah khua ava tung a; inn kongpi bul atuntak in huai naupang asita hi.
TOUPA'N asikha zawlnei Ahijah zang a thu agen bang ngei in Israel tengteng in avui ua, asuunta uhi.
Jeroboam tanchin dang, agaldou thute leh avaihawm thute, ngai in, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh in a-om hi.
Huchi in Jeroboam vaihawm sung kum sawmnih-le-nih ahi a, apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, amah sik in atapa Nadab ahong lalta hi.

Solomon tapa Rehoboam Judah gam ah alal hi. Alal tung lai in Rehoboam kum sawmli-le-khat a upa ahi. TOUPA'N amin omsakna dia Israel nam tengtengte lak a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-sagih alal hi. Anu min Naamah ahi a, amah Ammon mi ahi.
Judahte'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua; apute uh thilhih tengteng khup in akhelhnate un ahazatna atokthou uhi.
Mual sang teng ah leh sing hing teng nuai ah suangphuhte phut in mun sangte leh Asherte nangawn abawl ngal ua.
Huai gam ah pasal kizuakte leng a-om ua; Israel suante ma a TOUPA'N adelhkhiak namte thilhih kihhuai chiteng ahih uhi.
Kumpipa Rehoboam lal akum nga kum in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta kumpipa Shishak in Jerusalem asual hi.
TOUPA' inn a goute leh kumpipa' inn a goute ala a, avek in ala khin hi. Solomon dangka-eng lum bawl tengteng leng ala tel vek hi.
Kumpipa Rehoboam in huaite tang in dal lumte abawl a, kumpipa' inn kongpi vengmi heutute akemsak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA' inn a kumpipa alut peuhmah chiang in veng mite'n huaite atawi ua, dantan ah akoih nawn zel uhi.
Rehoboam tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Rehoboam leh Jeroboam adamsung teng un akidou uhi.
Huchi in Rehoboam apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, David khopi ah apute lak ah avui uh. Anu min Naamah ahi a, Ammon mi ahi. Asik in atapa Abijam ahong lalta hi.
Huan Nebat tapa kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawm-le-giat alal kum in Judahte tung ah Abijam alal pan hi.
Jerusalem ah kum thum alal a; anu min Maakah, Abishalom tanu ahi.
Ama a pan thil gilou ahih tengteng ama'n leng ahih sam ahi. Apu David bang in alungtang TOUPA a Pathian lam ah ahoihkim sam kei hi.
Himahleh David ziak in TOUPA a Pathian in anung a, atapa hong dinkhiakna ding leh Jerusalem khua dingkipsak ding in Jerusalem ah khawnvak apia hi.
Hit mi Uriah tungtang chih louh in David in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih ahih ziak leh adamsung teng a hih dia thu apiak peuhmah asel ngei louh ziak in.
Rehoboam adamsung teng Jeroboam toh akidou gige uhi.
Abijam tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw? Abijam leh Jeroboam akidou uhi.
Abijam apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; David khopi ah avui uhi. Ama sik in atapa Asa alal hi.
Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawmnih alal kum in Asa bel Judahte tung ah alal pan hi.
Kum sawmli-le-khat Jerusalem ah alal a; anu min Maakah ahi a, amah Abishalom tanu ahi.
Asa in apu David mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Pasal kizuakte gam a pan adelhkhia a; apute'n milim ana bawl tengteng uh alamang hi.
Anu Maakah leng, milim kihhuai mahmah Asherah abawlsak ziak in, akumpinu hihna atawpsak hi. Amilim bawl ahihsia a, Kidron lui ah ahal hi.
Mun sangte ahihleh alamang kei a; himahleh Asa lungtang adamsung teng in TOUPA lam ah ahoih bukim hi.
Apa'n thil ana latsate leh amah mah in ana latsa dangka, dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan TOUPA' inn ah alalut hi.
Asa leh Israel kumpipa Baasha lal sung teng akidou gige uhi.
Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judah ava dou a, Judah kumpipa Asa kiang a lut ding leh pawtkhe ding dalna ding in Ramah khua abawl hi.

Huchi in Asa in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou om lai dangka leh dangka-eng tengteng ala a, asikhate apia hi. Huchi in kumpipa Asa in Damaskas a om Siria kumpipa Hezion tapate Tabrimon tapa Ben-hadad kiang ah,

"Kei leh nang kikal ah leh ka pa leh na pa kikal ah thukhun a-om a; ngai in, thilpiak dangka leh dangka-eng ka hon khak hi. Hong pai inla, Israel kumpipa Baasha in ahon paisanna ding in amah toh na thukhun uh hihsia in," chi in akhak hi.
Ben-hadad in kumpipa Asa thu ana pom a, Israel khuate dou ding in asepaih heutute asawl a, Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maakah khuate, Kinneroth bial tengteng leh Naphtali gam tengteng tan in adou hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Baasha in huai thu ana zaktak in Ramah abawl atawp a, Tirzah ah atengta hi.

Kumpipa Asa in Judah gam tengteng ah thu athangsak vialvial hi. Kuamah om awl a-om kei uh. Huchi in Baasha in Ramah khua bawlna dia suang leh sing azatte anawn ua; huaite zang in kumpipa Asa in Mizpah khua leh Benjamin gam a Geba khua abawl hi.
Asa tanchin dang tengteng, athilhihdan tengteng, athilhih tengtengte leh akho bawlte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw? Himahleh atek lam in akhe ahong nata hi.
Huchi in a-ihmuta a, apu David khopi ah apute lak ah avui ua; atapa Jehoshaphat asik in alal hi.
Jeroboam tapa Nadab Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum nihna ah Israel tung ah alal pan a, Israel tung ah kum nih alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih a, apa lampi atawn a, Israelte thilhih akhialsak a, ahihkhelhna pentak ama'n leng ahih sam hi.
Issakar inkuante lak a mi Ahijah tapa Baasha in amah aguksawm a, Philistiate tan, Gibbethon ah Baasha in athat hi. Nadab leh Israel tengteng in Gibbethon a-um lai uh ahi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum thumna ah ahi Baasha in athah a, asik a ahong lal.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa ahong hih in Jeroboam inko tengteng athat a; Jeroboam a ding in kuamah ahinghawi kei hi. TOUPA Shiloh a mi asikha Ahijah zang a agensa bang in.
Huai bel Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahih, Jeroboam khelhnate ziak leh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahehsak ziak ahi.
Nadab tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Asa leh Israel kumpipa Baasha alal sung teng un akidou gige uh.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum thum na ah Ahijah tapa Baasha Tirzah ah Israel tengteng tung ah alal pan a, kum sawmnih-le-li alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, Jeroboam lampi zuih azui a, Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahihkhelhna ahih sam hi.
Huchi in Baasha kalh in Hanani tapa Jehu kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
"Leivui a pan ka hon domsang a, ka mi Israelte tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi. Nang Jeroboam lampi zuih na tawn a, akhelhnate a hon hehsak ding in ka mi Israelte thil na hihkhialsak hi.
Ngai in, Baasha leh a-inkote ka hihmang ding hi. Huchi in Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote bang mai in na inkote ka bawl ding.
Baasha inkote lak a mi khopi a si peuhmah ui in ane dia; a-inkote lak a mi gamlak a si peuhmah tungleng vasate'n ane ding uh," chi in.
Baasha tanchin dangte, athilhihte leh athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Baasha apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Tirzah ah avui ua; asik in atapa Elah alal hi.

Baasha leh a-inkote tungtang thu ah akhutsuak a TOUPA hehsak dia Jeroboam inkote batna nei a TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou mahmah ahih ziak leh amah athah ziak in Hanani tapa zawlnei Jehu zang a agen TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-gukna ah Baasha tapa Elah, Tirzah ah Israelte tung ah alal pan a, kum nih alal hi,
Asikha Zimri, akangtalai kimkhat tung a heutu in Tirzah ah amah gukthah asawm hi. Huchih lai in, Tirzah ah insung lam heutu Arza inn ah amah zukham in a-om hi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-sagih in Zimri lut in ava sual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ahong lal pan a, alaltutphah a ahong tuttak in, Baasha inko tengteng athat vek a; atanaute leh alawmte lak a mi pasal photphot khat leng ahawi kei hi.
Huchi in zawlnei Jehu zang a Baasha kalh a agen, TOUPA thu bang in, Zimri in Baasha inko tengteng athat vek hi;
TOUPA, Israelte’ Pathian, hehsak dia aginatlouhna ua, atohthoh ua, Baasha khelhnate leh atapa Elah khelhnate a amaute akhelh ua, huai mah a Israelte akhelhsak ziak un.
Elah tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-sagihna ah Zimri, Tirzah ah ni sagih alal hi. Philistiate neihsa, Gibbethon a mite'n a-um uhi.
A-um mite'n, "Zimri in aguksawm a, kumpipa athat," chih agen uh ana za ua; huchi in Israel tengteng in sepaih heutu, Omri, huai ni in agiahmun uah Israelte tung a kumpipa in abawl uhi.
Omri bel Israel tengteng toh Gibbethon a pan in ahohtou ua, Tirzah ava um uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Zimri in khua ala uh chih atheih in, kumpipa' inn a kulh ah atailut a, kumpipa' inn ah akibuhal a, asita hi;
TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou mahmah hih a akhelhnate ziak leh Jeroboam lampi tawn a Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, akhelh ziak in.
Zimri tanchin dangte leh asawmgukna thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Israel mite pawl nih in akikhenta ua; mipi kimkhat in Ginath tapa Tibni kumpipa dia bawl tum in azui ua; akimkhat in Omri azui uhi.
Himahleh Omri zuite'n Ginath tapa Tibni zuite azou ua: huchi in Tibni asi a, Omri ahong lalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmthum-le-khatna ah Omri Israelte tung ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-nih alal a: Tirzah ah kum guk alal hi.
Shemer a Samaria mual dangka talent nih in alei a; mual tung ah khua asat a, akhosat min huai neipa Shemer min tam in Samaria asa hi.
Omri in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, ama a mi tengteng sang in thil ahihkhial thupi tuamse hi.
Nebat tapa Jeroboam dan tengteng ala a, aginatlouhna ziak ua TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian hehsak dia Israelte thil ahihkhelhsak bang in akhial samta hi.
Omri thilhih tanchin dangte leh athilhihtheihdan ahihlat thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Omri apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahab ahong lal hi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmthum-le-giatna ah Israelte tung ah Omri tapa Ahab alal pan hi. Omri tapa Ahab, Samaria ah kum sawmnih-le-nih Israelte tung ah alal hi,
Omri tapa Ahab in ama a mi tengteng sang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna bang hih sam bangmah lou a ngai hileh kilawmtak in, Zidonte kumpipa Ethbaal tanu Jezebel zi in anei a, Baal nna sem in abia hi.
Samaria a Baal inn alam ah Baal a ding in maitam adoh hi.
Ahab in Asherah abawl a; ama a Israel kumpipa tengteng sang in Ahab in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian hehsakna thil anak hih tungtuan hi.

Alal lai in Bethel mi Hiel in Jeriko khua asat a; atachil Abiram tanloh in asuangphum aphum hi. TOUPA'N Nun tapa Joshua zang a ana gensa bang in, anautum Segub tanloh hial in akulh kongkhakte adingkhesak hi.

Huan Gilead gam a Tishbi a mi Elijah in Ahab kiang ah, "TOUPA, ama a ka dinna Israelte' Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Keimah thu lou in kum bangzah hiam sung daitui leh vuah azu kei ding," achi hi.
TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung hi,
"Hiai a pan pawt inla, suahlam zuan in pai inla, Jordan gei a om Kerith lui ah va kibu in.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, huai luitui na dawn dia; huai ah nang hon vak ding in va-ak thu ka pe khinta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in akuan a, TOUPA thu bang in ahihta hi. Jordan gei a om Kerith lui ah atengta hi.
Va-akte'n zingsang in tanghou leh sa ahong puak zel ua, nitaklam in tanghou leh sa ahong puak nawn zel uhi. Huai luitui adawn hi.
Anung deuh in hichi ahong hi a, huai gam a vuah himhim azuk louh ziak in lui ahong kangta hi.
TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung a,
"Thou inla, Zidon gam a Zarephath ah hoh inla, huai ah om in. Nang hon vak ding in meithai khat thu ka pe khinta," achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, Zarephath ah ahohta hi. Huai khokulh kongpi atun in, ngai in, meithai khat sing tom in ana om a; amah asam a, "Bel in tui tawmchik hon la dih ve, ka na dawn ding," achi hi.
La dia kuan asam a, "Tanghou neuchik bek hon tawi lechin," achi hi.

Ama'n, TOUPA na Pathian ahin bang in, ka gen hi. "Tanghou ka nei kei, bel ah tangbuang pham khat lel leh thawl ah sathau tawmchik kia ka nei hi. Ngai in, ka pai chia ka tapa a dia bawlna ding singkang nih hiam lel ka tom a, huchi in ka ne ding ua, ka si mai ding uh," achi hi.

Elijah in akiang ah, "Lau ke'n, na gen bang in va hih in. Himahleh huai in tanghou neuchik petmah hon bawlsak phot inla, huai hon tawi inla, huai khit chiang in nang a ding leh na tapa a ding na bawl ding hi.
TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: TOUPA'N leitung a vuah ahon zuksak masiah tangbuang bel avuak tuan kei dia, sathau thawl leng akang kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Elijah gen bang in ahih a; amah leh a-inkote leh Elijah toh ni tamtak ane uhi.
Elijah zang a agen TOUPA thu bang in tangbuang bel avuak tuan kei a, sathau thawl leng akang sam kei hi.
Huai thilte nung in hichi ahong hi a, huai numei, inn neinu tapa china in ahong gim mahmah a, anak ahong beita hi.
Ama'n Elijah kiang ah, "Nang Pathian mipa aw, ka tung a lungkimlouhna bang nei na hia? Ka khelhna hon theikhesak ding leh ka tapa hon thahsak dia hong pai na hi ve!" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Na tapa hon pia in," achi hi. Huchi in apom lai ala a, a-omna dantan ah apom tou a, alupna ah asial hi.
TOUPA asam a, "Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, ka tenna meithainu tung ah leh atapa hihlupsak in thil hoih lou hon tungsakta na hi maw?" achi hi.
Huchi in naupang tung ah thumvei bokkhup in, TOUPA asam a, "Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, hehpih in hiai naupang hinna asung ah hon omsak nawn in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Elijah thu ana ngaihkhiaksak hi. Hichi in naupang hinna amah sung ah ahong om nawn a, ahong halh nawnta hi.
Elijah in naupang api a, dantan a pan insung ah apaipihsuk a, anu apia hi. Elijah in, “En in, na tapa ahing hi," achi hi.
Numei in Elijah kiang ah, "Tu in Pathian mipa na hi a, na kam a TOUPA thu thutak ahi, chih ka theita," achi hi.
Huan ni sawtkuamtak nung in hichi ahong hi a, akum thum kum in TOUPA thu Elijah kiang ah ahong tung hi. "Va kuan inla, Ahab kiang ah va kihil in. Huchi in leitung ah vuah ka zusak ding," achi hi.
Ahab kiang a kihil ding in Elijah akuanta hi. Samaria gam ah kial ana mahmah hi.
Ahab in Obadiah, a-inn sunglam heutu asam hi. Obadiah bel TOUPA laudan siam mahmah mi ahi a;
huan, hichi ahong hi a, Jezebel in TOUPA zawlneite asatkhiak lai in Obadiah in zawlnei zakhat api a, kokhuk ah sawmnga nga in asel a, tanghou leh tui in avak hi.

Ahab in Obadiah kiang ah, "Tui nak nei tengteng leh lui phaizang tengteng omna gam va tuan vialvial dih ve. Sakol leh sabiltungte i hut hing theihna ding in loupa i muhsak thei kha hiam, huchi lou in zaw gante i tan vek kha ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in gam totsuak ding in akihawm ua; Ahab amah kia in lampi dang ah apai a, Obadiah leng amah kia in lampi dang ah apai hi.
Huchi a Obadiah apai lai in, ngai in, Elijah in ana tuak a; ama'n athei lai a, huchi in abokkhup a, "Ka toupa Elijah na hi maw?" achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Hi e, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah huai ah a-om hi, chi in na toupa va hilh in,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Thil bang ahia ka hihkhelh a, na sikha thah dia Ahab khut a na hon piak ding?
TOUPA na Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi, ka pu in nang ahon zonsaklouhna nam leh gam himhim a-om kei. Hiai ah a-om kei, achih chiang un nang ahon muhlouhna thu uah gam leh nam akichiamsak hi.
Tu in nang, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah hiai ah a-om, chi in na toupa va hilh in, na chi hi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, nang ka hon nutsiattak in TOUPA Kha in ka theihlouhna ah nang ahong lamang dia; huchi in Ahab ka va hilh a, nang ahon muh theih ngal ke'n zaw, kei hon that mai ding hi. Himahleh na sikha in ka valnou tung a pan TOUPA ka lau hi.
Jezebel in TOUPA zawlneite athah lai a ka thilhih, TOUPA zawlneite lak a mi zakhat, sawmnga nga a kokhuk a, tanghou leh tui a ka vakdan ka toupa hon hilh lou uhia?
Tu in nang, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah huai ah a-om hi, chi in na toupa va hilh in na chi mawk a; ama'n kei ahon that mahmah ding," achi hi.
Elijah in, "Ama ka dinna sepaihte' TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, tuni in akiang ah ka kihil ngeingei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Ahab houpih ding in Obadiah akuan a, ahilhta a; huchi in Elijah mu ding in Ahab akuanta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahab in Elijah amuh in Ahab in akiang ah, "Nang na hi maw, Israelte buaisakpa?" achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Israelte ka buaisak kei. Nang leh na pa inkote ahi ve abuaisak zaw; TOUPA thupiakte lehngatsan a, Baal na zuih zawkna ah.
Huchi in tu in Israel tengteng leh Baal zawlnei zali-le-sawmnga leh Asherah zawlnei, Jezebel dohkan a ankuang um zalite ka kiang ah Karmel tang ah va samkhawm in," achi hi.
Huchi in Ahab in Israel suan tengteng kiang ah mi asawl a, zawlneite Karmel tang ah asamkhawm hi.
Elijah in mipi tengteng ava naih a, "Vanglak a bang tan om ding na hi ua? TOUPA Pathian ahihleh, amah zui unla; Baal ahihleh amah zui un," achi hi. Mipite'n kam khat in leng adawng kei uh.
Huchi in Elijah in mipite kiang ah, "TOUPA zawlnei omsun kei kia ka hi a; Baal zawlneite bel mi zali-le-sawmnga ahi uh.

Huchi in bawngtal nih hong pia uhenla; amau bawngtal khat amau a tuam ding in tel uhenla, semnen uhenla, sing tung ah koih uhenla, anuai ah mei toh kei uhen. Ke'n leng bawngtal khat ka bawl sam dia, sing tung ah ka koih dia mei ahihleh ka toh kei ding.
Nou na pathiante min uh sam unla, ke'n TOUPA min ka sam ding. Huchi in mei a hon dawng Pathian pen Pathian hi hen," achi hi. Huchi in mi tengteng in, "Athugen ahoih hi,” chi in adawng uhi.
Elijah in Baal zawlneite kiang ah, "Nou bawngtal khat nou a tuam ding in tel unla, bawl masa un; nou na tam deuh ua; na pathiante min sam unla, himahleh anuai ah mei toh kei un," achi hi.

Bawngtal atan pen uh ala ua, abawl ua, "Baal aw, hon dawng in," chi in zingsang a pan sun tan in Baal min asam uh. Himahleh aw himhim a-om kei a, adawng leng a om sam kei a, maitam kibawl tung ah atawm uhi.

Sun lai in hichi ahong hi a, "Elijah in amau enghou in, kikou ngaih ve ua; pathian khat ahi ngal a. Midang houpih hiam, nungdelh nei lel hiam, khualzin ahihkeileh ihmu lel phawn teitei ngai houh hi in teh,” achi hi.
Huchi in angaih a ngaih in akikou ua, ahih zeldan bang un sisan pawt khop hial in temta in aki-atkeh ua, thilzum in akisun uhi.
Sun nung ahong hih in hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam kithoih hun tan in thu agen uhi. Himahleh aw hiam, dawngtu hiam limsaktu leng a-om kei.
Huchi in Elijah in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Hong naih dih ua," achi hi. Huchi in mipi tengteng in ava naih uhi.
TOUPA maitam kichimsa abawlhoih a; na min Israel ahi ding, chi a TOUPA thu ana mupa Jakob tapate nam zah suang sawm-le-nih Elijah in ala hi.
Huai suangte in TOUPA min in maitam abawl a; maitam kim buhchi tehna nih takna ding atoukuak hi.
Sing akoih hoih sipsip a, bawngtal asemnen a, sing tung ah akoih hi. "Bel li tui in dimsak unla, halmang thillat leh sing buak un," achi hi.
Anihveina ding in, "Buak nawn un," achi a, abuak nawn uhi. Athumveina ding in, "Buak nawn un," achi a, abuak nawn uhi.
Huchi in tui maitam kim ah aluang zuazua a; tohkuak tui in adimta hi.

Nitaklam kithoih hun in hichi ahong hi a, zawlnei Elijah in ava naih a, "TOUPA Abraham, Isak leh Israel Pathian, nang Israel gam a Pathian na hihleh, kei na sikha ka hih, hiai tengteng nang thu a ka hih tuni in theihsak hi hen.
Hon ngaikhia in, aw TOUPA hon ngaikhia in, hiai mipite'n nang TOUPA Pathian na hi a, alungtang uh na heikik nawnta chih atheihna ding un," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA mei ahong kia a, halmang thillat, asing, asuang leh aleivui akangtum a, tohkuak a tui ahipkang hi.
Huchi in mipi tengteng in huai amuh un abokkhup ua, "TOUPA amah Pathian ahi, TOUPA amah Pathian ahi,” achi uh.
Elijah in akiang uah, "Baal zawlneite man unla, khat leng suaktasak kei un," achi hi. Huchi in aman ua, Elijah in Kishon lui ah apisuk a, huai ah amaute athat hi.
Elijah in Ahab kiang ah, "Paitou inla, ne in dawnta in; vuahpi zu ding husa a-om," achi hi.
Ne leh dawn ding in Ahab apaitouta hi. Elijah bel Karmel tang vum ah apaitou a; lei ah akunsuk a, akhukte kikal ah amai aphual hi.
Asikha kiang ah, "Va paitou inla, tuipi lam va en mah dih!" achi hi. Ava paitou a, tuipi lam a-en a, "Bangmah a-om kei," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sagihvei kuan nawn in,” achi hi.

Asagihveina ah hichi ahong hi a, "Ngai in, tuipi a pan mihing khuttum chia lel meipi hong lengtou viaiviai," achi hi. Ama'n, "Va pai inla, Ahab kiang ah, na kangtalai bawl inla, paisukta in, vuah in ahon khum kha ding, chi in," achi hi.
Sawt lou nung in hichi ahong hi a, huih leh meipite in van adup keihkuih a, vuahpi tam petmah ahong zuta hi. Ahab kangtalai a tuang in Jezreel ah apaita hi.
TOUPA khut Elijah tung ah a-om a; apuan ateng a, Ahab ma ah Jezreel kholutna tan atai hi.
Huan Ahab in Elijah thilhih tengteng, namsau a zawlnei tengteng athah thute toh Jezebel ahilh hi.

Huchi in Jezebel in Elijah kiang ah, "Huai mite lak a mi khat hinna bang a zingchiang a hichi hun ma a na hinna ka hon bawlsak sam keileh pathiante'n alohloh uh hon loh uhenla, huai sang a sezaw in leng,” chi a hilh ding in mi asawl hi.
Huchi in huai atheih in alau a, athou a, ahinna humbit ding in atai hi. Judah gam a Beer-sheba khua ava tung a, huai ah asikha anusia hi.
Amah gamdai ah ni khat lampaina tan ah ahoh a, Juniper sing nuai ah tu in sih angenta hi. "Ahunta; TOUPA aw, tu in ka hinna la in, ka pute sang in lah ka hoihzaw tuan kei," achi hi.
Juniper sing nuai ah alum a, a-ihmuta hi. Ngai in, angel in ahong khoih a, akiang ah, "Thou inla ne in," achi hi.
Ama'n a-en vialvial a, ngai in, alu chin ah tanghou pei, suangsa a haiminsa leh tuithawl ana om hi. Huchi in hiaite ne in adawn a, alum nawn hi.
Anihveina ding in TOUPA angel ahong pai nawn a, ahong khoih a, "Thou inla, ne in, na paina ding agamla lo lai hi,” achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, ne in adawn a, an ziak a hatna in Pathian tang Horeb tan ni sawmli leh zan sawmli apai hi.
Huai a kokhuk khat ava tung a, huai ah a-omta hi. Ngai in, TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung a, akiang ah, "Hiai a bang hih na hia, Elijah?" achi hi.

Ama'n, "TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian a ding in phatuam ka ngai mahmah hi. Israel suante'n lah na thukhun alehngatsan ua, na maitamte achimsak ua, na zawlneite namsau in athat ua; a-om lai kei ka hi a, ka hinna lakmang ding in azong uh," achi hi.

Ama'n, "Pawtkhia inla, huai tang ah TOUPA ma ah va dingh in," achi hi. Ngai in, TOUPA ahong pai a, huihpi hat mahmah in tangte TOUPA ma ah amutkhang a, suangpi akitam phuakphuak hi. Himahleh huai ah TOUPA a-om kei. Huih nun khit in zin ahong ling a; himahleh huai zinling ah TOUPA a-om kei.
Zinlin khit in meikuang ahong pawt a; himahleh huai mei ah TOUPA a-om kei. Meikuang nung in aw ngat ngiingei ahong pawt hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Elijah in huai azak in apuanin amai akhuh a, va pawtkhia in kokhuk lutna ah ava dingh hi. Ngai in, huai aw in akiang ah, "Hiai a bang hih na hia, Elijah?" achi hi.

Ama'n, "TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian a ding in phatuam ka ngai mahmah hi. Israel suante'n lah na thukhun alehngatsan ua, na maitamte achimsak ua, na zawlneite namsau in athat ua. A-om lai kei ka hi a, ka hinna lakmang ding in azong uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Pai nawn inla, gamdai lam a Damaskas ah pai in. Na tun chiang in Siria kumpipa ding in Hazael thau na nilh ding hi.
Israel kumpipa ding in Nimshi tapa Jehu thau na nilh ding; na sik a zawlnei ding in Abel-meholah a mi Shaphat tapa Elisha leng thau na nilh ding ahi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, Hazael namsau pel peuhmah Jehu in athat dia; Jehu namsau pel peuhmah Elisha in athat ding.
Himahleh Israel gam ah Baal ma a khukdin ngei lou leh amah tawp ngeiloumi sangsagih kei a ding in ka sit hi," achi hi.

Huchi in huai a pan apawtkhia a, Shaphat tapa Elisha ava mukhia hi. Ama'n langkawn bat bawngtal tuak sawm-le-nih in lou ana kai hi. Asawm-le-nihna azang hi. Elijah in ava naih a, apuan ava silhsak hi.

Ama'n abawngtalte paisan in Elijah anungdelh a, "Ka nu leh ka pa hon tawpsak ding in ka hon ngen, huchi in ka hon zui ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Pai nawn ve le, bang ka hon chih a eita?" achi hi.
Amah zui lai akik nawn a, bawng tuakkhat agou a, bawng vante in asa ahuan a, mite apia a, amau ane uhi. Huchi in athou a, Elijah adelh a, a-nna asepsakta hi.
Huan David sih ni ding ahong naita a; atapa Solomon thu apia hi.
"Leitung pumpi lampi ah ka pai sam dia; nang hattak leh pasalphatak in om in.

Na thilhih peuhmah leh na kiheina lam peuhmah a na lamzan theihna ding in Mosi Dan a gelh ahih bang in, TOUPA na Pathian in alampite zui ding leh adan thusehte, athupiakte, avaihawmte leh athu theihsakte pom dia thu apiakte zui in.

TOUPA'N ka tungtang thu a, 'Na suante'n alungtang tengteng uleh alungsimtak ua ka mitmuh a thutak a-om ding a, a-omdan ua apilvan uleh Israelte laltutphah a tu ding mi na tatlak kei ding, chi a agen ahihkip ding hi.’ ”

"Zeruiah tapa Joab in ahon bawldan, Israelte sepaih heutu nih Ner tapa Abner leh Jether tapa Amasa abawldan na thei hi. Amaute athah a, kilep lai a kidou sisan suah a, atai a kawnggak leh akhedap but a kidouna sisan abansakdan.
Huchi in pha na sakdan bang in hih inla, alu a kelsam pou in han ah lungmuangtak in tumsak ke'n.
Gilead mi Barzillai tapate tung ah hehpihna hihlang in. Na dohkan a an ummi ding in telsak in; na unau Absalom a pan ka taimang lai in ka kiang ah ahong ngal a.

Ngai in Bahurim mi, Benjamin suan Gera tapa Shimei na kiang ah a-om hi. Ama'n Mahanaim a ka hoh lai in hamse hoihloupi ahon lohkhum hi. Himahleh Jordan ah hong dawn ding in ahong kuan hi. Huai ah, namsau in ka hon that kei ding, chi in TOUPA min lou in akiang ah ka na kichiamta hi.
Huchi in moh lou in zaw koih ke'n; Mipil na hi ngal a. Atung ah bangchi in na hih dia chih ahihleh na thei mai ding. Alu a kelsam pou in sisan toh han ah na tumsak ding ahi," achi hi.
David bel apute kiang ah a-ihmu samta a, David khopi ah avui uhi.
Israelte tung a David lal sung kum sawmli ahi. Hebron ah kum sagih alal a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum alal hi.
Apa David laltutphah ah Solomon atu a; huchi in agam nakpitak a hihkip in ahong omta hi.
Huan Solomon nu Bathsheba kiang ah Haggith tapa Adonijah ahoh a. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu a hong na hi maw?" ana chi hi. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu ah hi e,” achi hi.
"Na kiang ah banghiam gen ding ka nei hi," achi nawn a, ama'n, "Gen ve," achi hi.

Ama’n “Lalgam kei a ahita chih leh Israelte tengteng in leng kimpipa ding in kei ahon en gige uh chih na thei. Himahleh ka unaupa a ding in lalgam hei a om a, TOUPA sehdan in ka unaupa a ahong hita hi.
Tu in thil khat nget ding ka hon nei a, hon nial ke’n,” ahi hi. Ama’n akiang ah, “Gen ve.” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Hehpih in kumpipa Solomon hon houpihsak inla, na thu sel lou ding ahi ngal a, Shunam mi Abishag zi ding in hon neisak in," achi hi.
Bathsheba in, "Hileh ake, kumpipa ka hon na houpihsak ding," achi hi.

Bathsheba in Adonijah a dia kumpipa Solomon houpih ding in akiang ah ahohta hi. Amah mu ding in kumpipa adingh a, ama ah akun a, alaltutphah ah atuta hi. Kumpipa nu a ding in laltutphah akoihsak a; ataklam ah atu hi.
"Thil neuchik khat ka hon ngen ut hi. Hon nial mahmah ke'n," achi hi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Nu, hon ngen ve, ka hon phalsak lou kei ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Shunam mi Abishag na unaupa Adonijah zi ding in neisak in," achi hi.

Kumpipa Solomon in adawng a, anu kiang ah, "Bangchidan a Shunam mi Abishag, Adonijah a dia ngen na hia oi? Gam leng ngetsak vanglak tanla; amah ka u avo oi. Amah a ding leh siampu Abiathar leh Zeruiah tapa Joab a ding in leng ngen tanla," achi hi.
Kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA min lou in, "Adonijah thilnget in amah tung a sihna thu gen ahih kei himhimleh Pathian in alohloh in hon loh mai hen, huai sang a thupizaw in leng.
TOUPA, athuchiam bang a hon hihkip, ka pa David laltutphah a hon tusak, inkuan hon na phuhkhiaksakpa ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Adonijah tuni mahmah a asihsak ngeingei ding ahi," chi in akichiamta hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah asawl a, ama'n ava sual a, athatta hi.

Siampu Abiathar kiang ah kumpipa'n, "Anathoth a na inn-le-lou ah pai in, si tak lah na hi ngal a. Himahleh ka pa David ma a Toupa PATHIAN bawm na na zawn zel ziak in leh ka pa haksatna thuak tengteng na na thuak sam zel ziak in, tu in zaw ka hon that kei ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon in Abiathar TOUPA siampu ahihna atawpsak hi. Hiai TOUPA'N Shiloh a Eli inkuante tungtang thu agen atangtun theihna ding ahi.
Huai thu Joab kiang ahong tung a, Absalom lam ah Joab apang kei na a, Adonijah lam ah apang hi. Joab TOUPA puanin ah atai a, maitam kiite alen hi.
"TOUPA puanin ah Joab atai a, ngai in, maitam bul ah a-om," chi in kumpipa Solomon ahilh uhi. Kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, va sual in, chi in asawl hi.

Benaiah TOUPA puanin ah ahohtou a, akiang ah, "Kumpipa'n hong pawtkhia heh, achi,” achi hi. Ama'n, "Hilou e. Hiai ah ka si zaw ding,” achi hi. Benaiah in, “Joab in huchi in ahon na dawng hi,” chi in kumpipa kiang ah thu atun nawn hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Achih bang in hih inla, va sual inla, vui in, aziak om het lou a Joab in sisan asuahna a pan kei leh ka pa inkote na hulsak theihna ding in," achi hi.

"Amah sang a kizenzaw leh hoihzaw mi nih, Ner tapa Abner, Israelte sepaih heutu leh Jether tapa Amasa, Judahte sepaih heutu ka pa David theih louh a sual a, namsau a athah ziak in TOUPA'N alutung ah asisan akiksak nawn ding hi.

Huaiziak in asisan uh Joab lutung leh asuante lutung ah tangtawn in akik nawn dia; David leh asuante leh a-inkote leh alaltutphah tung ah TOUPA a pan lungmuanna tangtawn in a-om nilouh ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah va hohtou in ava sual a, athatta hi. Huchi in gamdai ah amah inn mah ah vui in a-om hi.
Kumpipa'n sepaihte tung ah asik in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah apangsak hi. Kumpipa'n Abiathar sik in Siampu Zadok apangsak hi.
Kumpipa'n Shimei asamsak a, akiang ah, "Jerusalem ah inn kilam inla huai ah teng inla, huai a pan koi dang mah ah pawt ke'n.
Na pawt ni, Kidron lui na kan ni in na si ngeingei ding chỉh thei in. Na sisan nangmah lutung mah ah a-om ding," achi hi.
Shimei in kumpipa kiang ah, "Adik hi. TOUPA ka kumpipa'n agen bang in na sikha in ahih zel ding," achi hi. Huchi in Jerusalem ah Shimei sawtkuamtak ateng hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum thum nung in Shimei sikhate lak a nih, Gath kumpipa Maakah tapa Akish kiang ah ataimang uhi. "Ngai in, na sikhate Gath ah a-om uh," chi in Shimei ahilh uhi.
Shimei athou a, asabiltung avan a, asikhate zong ding in Gath a Akish kiang ah ahohta hi. Shimei in Gath a pan asikhate ava pikik hi.
Shimei Jerusalem a pan apawt a, Gath ah hoh in ahong kik nawn chi in Solomon ahilh uhi.

Kumpipa'n Shimei asamsak a, akiang ah, "Na pawt ni, gamdang a na pawtkhiak ni in na si ngeingei ding, chi in TOUPA min lou a hon kichiamsak in, ka hon theisak ahi kei maw? Nangmah in leng ka kiang ah, na thugen ka zak ahoih hi, na chi hi.
Bangziak a TOUPA kichiamna leh ka hon thupiak zui lou na hia?" achi hi.
Kumpipa mah in Shimei kiang ah, "Na lungtang sunggil gitlouhdan, ka pa David tung a na gamtatdante na thei vek hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N na gitlouhna nangmah lutung ngei ah akiksak nawn ding.
Kumpipa Solomon vualzawl in a-om dia, David laltutphah TOUPA ma ah tangtawn in hihkip ahi ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Jehoiada tapa Benaiah thu apia hi. Amah akuan a, ava sual a, athatta hi. Huchi in gam Solomon khut a hihkip in a-omta hi.
Huan Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad in asepaih tengteng akaikhawm vek a, kumpipa sawmthum-le-nih atel ua, sakol leh kangtalaite toh akuantou a, Samaria khua ava um a, adouta hi.
Israel kumpipa Ahab kiang ah khopi sung ah mi asawl a, akiang ah, Ben-hadad in hichi in achi,
"Na dangka leh dangka-eng kei a ahi. Na zite leh na tate, na neih hoihpente tan in leng kei a ahi," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n ana dawng a, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, na gen bang in kei leh ka neih tengteng nang a ahi," achi hi.
Amisawlte apai nawn ua, Ben-hadad in hichi in achi, "Ka kiang a na dangka leh dangka-eng, na zite leh na tate na hon piak ding ahi, chi in mi hon sawl ding ka hi,
'Zingchiang hiai hun in ka sikhate na kiang ah ka hon sawl dia, na inn leh na sikhate inn ahong mai ding uh.' Huan hichi ahi ding a, na mit late ala ding ua, ahon paipih vek ding uh," achi hi.

Israel kumpipa'n agam a upa tengteng asam a, thei un, “Hiai mi in thil hoih loutak hih atupdan. Ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl a, ka zite, ka tate, ka dangka leh ka dangka-eng ahong ngen a, amah ka na nial kei hi," achi hi.
Upa tengteng leh mipi tengteng in akiang ah, "Amah na limsak dah inla, angette leng pe sam ke'n," achi uhi.

Ben-hadad misawlte kiang ah, "Kumpipa, ka toupa kiang ah, na sikha kiang a mi sawl a na hon nget masak tengteng bang in ka hih dia; himahleh hiai zaw ka hih kei ding," achi, chỉ un. Huchi in amisawlte apai nawn ua, huai thu ava tun uhi.
Ben-hadad in akiang ah mi asawl nawn a, "Kei hon zui teng in akhut dim ua apham dia kiching Samaria kho leivui nutsiat ahihleh pathiante'n alohloh hon loh uhenla, huai sang a sezaw in leng," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n adawng a, "Mi kigalthuam khinsa, agalvan suah khesa bang in ki-uangsak kei hen, chi in va hilh un,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah leh kumpipate'n puanin a zu ana dawnkhawm lai un huai thu Ben-hadad in ana za a, amite kiang ah, "Kisa dih ua," achi hi. Huchi in khua dou ding in akisata uhi.

Huchi in ngai in, zawlnei khat in Israel kumpipa Ahab ava naih a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai mipi tampite na mu hia? Ngai in, tu in na khut ah ka hon pe ding. Huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.

Ahab in, "Kua zang in eita?" achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte zang in," achi hi. Ama'n, “Kua'n dou dia thu pe ding eita?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Nangmah in,” chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in ama'n gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte akaikhawm a, zanih sawmthum-le-nih ahi uh. Huai mite nung in mi tengteng, Israel suan tengteng akaikhawm a, sangsagih ahi uh.
Sun laitak in ava pawt ua, Ben-hadad leh kumpipate, amah panpih kumpipa sawmthum-le-nihte huai puanin ah zu dawnkham in ana om uh.
Gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte ava pawt masa ua; Ben-hadad in mi asawl a, "Amau, Samaria a pan hong pawt a-om uh," chi in ahilh uh.
Ama'n, "Kilep tum a hong ahih uleh hingmat unla, kidou tum a hong ahih uleh leng hingmat un," achi hi.
Huchi in hiai gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte leh ahon zui sepaihte khua a pan apawt uhi.
Abitum chiat uh ava that ua; huchi in Siriate ataikekta ua, Israelte'n adelh uhi. Huchi in Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad sakol tung a tuang in sakol tungtuang mite toh asuakta hi.
Israel kumpipa ava pawtkhia a, sakol leh kangtalaite ava sual a, Siriate tampi athat hi.
Zawlnei in Israel kumpipa ava naih a, akiang ah, "Kihatsak inla, na hihdan ding ngaihtuah in kum hong beileh Siria kumpipa'n hong dou nawn ding ahi," achi hi.
Siria kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Apathiante uh mualte pathiante ahi uh. Huaiziak a ei sang a amau hatzaw ahi uh. Phaizang ah dou lehang, amau sang ini hatzaw ngeingei ding uh," achi uhi.
"Hiai thilhih in, kumpipate avek un lakhia inla, amun uah gamuk mite koih in.

Sepaihte, sakolte leh kangtalaite, na mansuahsa zah geih sepaihte ding khethaksak nawn in. Huchi in phaizang ah i dou ding ua, amau sang in i hatzaw na ding uhi,” achi uh. Ama'n athugen uh angaikhia a, huchibang in ahihta hi.
Akum nawn in hichi ahong hi a, Ben-hadad in Siriate akaikhawm a, Israelte dou ding in Aphek ah ahohtou hi.
Israel suante leng akikaikhawm ua, nek ding asekkhawm masa ua, dou ding in akisata uhi. Israel suante kelnou tawm chikchik hon nih bang lel in ava kilang ua; Siriate bel gam ah apumdim uhi.

Pathian mipa'n Israel kumpipa va naih in, ahoupih a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Siriate'n, TOUPA mualte Pathian ahi a, phaizang Pathian ahi kei, achi uhi. Huaiziak in hiai mipi tampite na khut ah ka hon pe ding hi, huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
Ni sagih sungtak akinangtuah nilouh uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in akidouta ua; Israel suante'n Siria mite ni khat in sepaih nuaikhat athat uhi.
Midangte bel Aphek ah, khopi sung ah atailut ua, omlaite mi singnih-le-sangsagih kulh chim in achipkhumta hi. Ben-hadad atai a, khopi sung ah dantan sunggil ah alut hi.

Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel inkuan lak a kumpipate mihehpih thei kumpipate ahi uh chih thu ka za uh. Sai-ip puan teng in, ka lu ua khau a kikhih in Israel kumpipa kiang ah hon va hohsak in; ama'n ahon hinghawi nuam khamoh kei ding," achi uhi.

Huchi in sai-ip puan ateng ua, alu uah khau in akikhih ua, Israel kumpipa kiang ah ava hoh ua, "Na sikha Ben-hadad in, hehpih in hon hinghawi hen, achi," achi uhi. Ama'n, "Dam lai ahi maw? Amah ka unaupa ahi," achi hi.

Huai mite'n lungnuamtak in, alungsim thutak gen ahi ding chih gingta in, "Na unaupa Ben-hadad himah e," achi pah uhi. Huchi in ama'n, "Va pai unla, hon pi un," achi hi. Ben-hadad ahong pawtkhia a, akiang ah ahoh a; ama'n akangtalai ah ana tuangsak hi.

Ben-hadad in akiang ah, “Ka pa'n na pa a pan khua ana lakte ka hon pekik ding. Ka pa'n Samaria a sumsinna munte a bawl bang in Damaskas ah sumsinna munte na bawl sam ding hi. Huchibang a thu kikhung in ka hon paisak ding hi," achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah thu akhung a, apaisakta hi.
Zawlnei tapate lak a mi khat in TOUPA thu in alawmpa kiang ah, "Hon khen in," achi a; huai mi in akhen ut kei hi.
Huchi in akiang ah, "TOUPA thu na man louh ziak in, ngai in, mual na hon khupsantak in, humpinelkai in ahon na kei ding," achi hi. Mual akhuptak in humpinelkai in atuak a, athat hi.
Huchi in midang ava mu nawn a, "Hon khen in," achi a; huai mi in akhen a, aliamta hi.
Huchi in zawlnei apai a, lampi ah kumpipa ana tang a, amai a vut nuh in ana kibawl lamdang hi.

Kumpipa ahong tun in kumpipa ana sam a, "Kei na sikha kidouna lak ah ka tailut a; ngai in, mi khat ahong kilehhei a, ka kiang ah mi khat ahon pi a, hiai mi na veng in, ataimangleh ahinna sik in na hinna na tan dia, ahihkeileh dangka talent khat na piak ding ahi," achi hi.
"Kei na sikha ka pumbuai ziak in ana paimangta hi," achi hi. Israel kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Huchibang geih in na tung a thu khen ahi ding, nangmah in thu khen khin na hi ve," achi hi.
Ama'n amai a pan vut alakhezok a; Israel kumpipa'n zawlneite lak a mi ahi chih atheita hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hihsiatgawp dia ka sehsa mi khat na paisak ziak in ahinna sik in nang hinna, amite sik in na mite na tan ding," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa bel nguitak leh lungkim loutak in apai a, Samaria khua ahong tungta hi.
Huan huai thilte nung in hichi ahong hi a, Jezreel mi Naboth in Jezreel ah grephuan anei a, huai Samaria kumpipa Ahab inn kiang a om hi.

Ahab in Naboth kiang ah, "Ka inn kiang a om ahih ziak in antehlouhing huan ding in na grephuan hon pia in. Asik in grephuan hoihzaw ka hon pe ding. Ahihkei a na deih zawkleh lah adangka in ama'n hun ding ka hon pe ding," chi in agen hi.
Naboth in Ahab kiang ah, "TOUPA'N ka pu ka pate gou nang ka hon piak ding aphal kei," achi hi.

Jezreel mi Naboth in huchibang thu akiang a agen ziak in Ahab ngui leh lungkim loutak in a-inn ah alut hi; ka pu ka pate gou ka hon pe thei het kei ding, achi bikbek ngal a. Huchi in alupna ah alum a, khat lam anga a, an ane kei hi.
Huchi in azi Jezebel ava hoh a, akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia na lungsim huchitak a alungkham a, an na nek louh?" achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Naboth kiang ah, na grephuan hon leisak in, ahihkeileh na deih zawkleh asik in grephuan dang ka hon pe ding ka chi hi. Ama'n, ka grephuan zaw ka hon pe thei het kei ding, chi in ahon dawng a ahi," achi hi.
Azi Jezebel in akiang ah, "Israel gam kumpipa na hi kei a hia? Thou inla, an ne inla, lungsim nuamtak in om in. Ke'n Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Ahab min in laithonte agelh a, Ahab suainamna in suai anam a, Naboth invengte a-upate leh makaite kiang ah akhak hi.
Laithonte ah, "An ngolh na puang unla, mipi lak ah Naboth ma kaisak un.
Belial tate mi nih ama ah tusak unla, nang Pathian leh kumpipa na gensia hi, chi a amah hek ding mi ana bawl un. Huchi in amah pikhia unla, suang in ana denglum un," achi hi.
Atenna khua a upate leh makaite'n Jezebel in akiang ua akhak laithon akigelh bang in ana hihta uhi.
An ngolh apuang ua, mipi lak ah Naboth a makaisak uhi.
Belial tate mi nih hong pai in ama ah ava tu ua; Belial tate'n mipite ma ah, Naboth in Pathian leh kumpipa agensia, chi in amah ahek uhi. Huchi in khua a pan apokhia ua, suang in adeng ua, asita hi.
Jezebel kiang ah, "Naboth suang in adeng ua, asita," chih hilh ding in mi asawl uhi.

Jezebel in Naboth suang in adeng ua, asita chih azak in hichi ahong hi a, Jezebel in Ahab kiang ah, "Thou inla, Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan, ahon leisak phal louh neita aw le. Naboth adam nawnta kei, asita hi," achi hi.
Ahab in Naboth asita chih azak in hichi ahong hi a; Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan nei dia kuansuk ding in Abab athouta hi.
Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
"Thou inla, Samaria a om Israel kumpipa houpih ding in hohsuk in. Ngai in, Naboth grephuan ah a-om a, neih tum in huai ah ahohsuk hi.

Akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Na that a, na neihsak behlap lai maw? chi inla, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, ui in Naboth sisan aliahna mun mah ah nang sisan leng aliak ding uh' na chi ding," achi hi.
Ahab in Elijah kiang ah, "Na hong muta maw, ka melmapa?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Hon muta ka hi ve; TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih dia nang leh nang na kikhotkhiak tak ziak in.
Ngai in na tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak dia, na suante ka lamang dia, Ahab a pan a ta pasal taphot Israel gam a mi zalen hi in zalen lou hitaleh ka satkhe ding.
Nang na hon hehsak ziak in leh Israelte thil na hihkhelhsak ziak in Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote leh Ahijah tapa Baasha inkote bang mai in na inkote ka bawl ding," achi hi.
Jezebel tungtang thu leng TOUPA'N agen a, "Jezebel khokulh chin ah uite'n ane ding uh.
Ahab inkote lak a mi khopi a si peuhmah uite'n ane ding ua; gam a si peuhmahte tung a leng vasate'n ane ding uh," achi hi.
Azi Jezebel tohthoh a TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih dia amah-le-amah kikhawngkhia Ahab bang mi kuamah a-om kei hi.
TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa Amorte thilhih chiteng bang in milimte bia in thilkihhuaitak ahih hi.
Ahab in huai thu azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh hi. An angawl a, sai-ip puan ah alum a, kidawmtak in apai hi.
TOUPA thu Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah ahong tung hi.
"Ka ma a Ahab akiniamkhiakdan na mu hia? Akiniamkhiak ziak in adamsung in hiai thil hoih lou ka tungsak kei dia, atapa damsung in bel a-inkote tung ah hiai thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding," achi hi.
Huan kum thum sung Siriate leh Israelte kidou lou in a-om uhi.
Akum thum kum in hichi ahong hi a, Israel kumpipa kiang ah Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ahohsuk hi.
Israel kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead khua ei a ahi chih thei napi a, bangchidan a Siria kumpipa khut a pan sutkhe lou a mawk om i hi ua oi?" achi hi.

Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead ah galdou ding in kei toh na hong kuan diam?" achi hi. Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, ka sakol leh na sakol pum khat ahi ve ua le," achi hi.
Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Tuni in TOUPA thu dong in, chi in ka hon ngen," achi hi.

Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n zawlnei mi zali asamkhawm a, akiang uah, "Ramoth-gilead khua dou ding in ka kuantou diam, kuantou lou ding?" achi hi. Amau, "Kuan in, Toupa'n kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding,” achi uh.
Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "Hiai ah TOUPA zawlnei dang kuahiam bek i dot ding om lou hia?" achi hi.

Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "TOUPA hon dotsak ding mi khat Imlah tapa Mikaiah om lai veh aw. Himahleh amah ka hua hi; ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam lou ngal agen ngei kei," achi hi. Jehoshaphat in, "Kumpipa'n hichibang in chi kei hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n heutu khat asam a, "Kintak in Imlah tapa Mikaiah va pi mah dih," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bel Samaria kongpi lutna gei phaizang ah akumpipa uh puan a kithuam in alaltutphah tuaktuak uah atu ua, zawlnei tengteng in ama uah thu agen uhi.
Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kiite abawlsak a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiaite in Siriate mangthang sipsip khop in na hihse ding chi in," achi hi.
Huchi mah bang in zawlnei tengteng in, "Ramoth-gilead ah va hohtou inla, va lohching in, TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding," chi in agen uhi.

Mikaiah sam dia sawl a ompa'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, zawlneite'n thukhat sat in ahoih lam in kumpipa kiang ah thu agen chiat uh. Agen khitsa bang un gen sam inla, ahoih lam in va gen in," chi in angen hi.
Mikaiah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen mah ka va gen ding," achi hi.

Kumpipa kiang atuntouh in, kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead khua dou ding in ka kuantou diam, kuantou lou ding?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kuantou inla, va lohching in; TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, “Thutak kia lou ngal ka kiang a TOUPA min agen lou dia bangzah vei ahia ka hon kichiamsak ding?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Israel tengteng ching ding nei lou belam bang in tang a dalhzak in ka mu hi. TOUPA'N, hiaite'n heutu aneita kei ua, michih ama inn chiat ah lungmuangtak in pai hen achi," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam kia lou ngal, ahoih lam himhim agen kei ding chih ka hon hilh ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Huaiziak in TOUPA thu ngaikhe dih, TOUPA alaltutphah tung a tu, van a mipi tengteng ataklam leh veilam a dinghte toh ka mu hi.
TOUPA'N, Ramoth-gilead a hohtou a, gal a si dia kua'n Ahab kunzou ding ahia? achi hi. Khat in hichibang in, midang in huchibang in," achi uh.
Huchi in kha khat ahong pawt a, TOUPA ma ah adingh a, "Ke'n ka kunzou ding," achi hi.

TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Bang in eita? achi hi. Ama'n ka va hoh dia, azawlnei teng muk ah kha zuauthei ka va suak ding, achi hi. Ama'n va kun mah inla, na lohching lai ding. Va kuan inla, huchibang in va hih ve leh," achi hi.
"Huaiziak in tu in ngai in, TOUPA'N hiai na zawlnei teng muk ah kha zuauthei akoih a, na tungtang thu ahoih lou lam TOUPA'N agen khinta," achi hi.
Huchi in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ahon naih a, Mikaiah biang ahong beng a, "TOUPA Kha in na kiang a thu gen ding in kei a pan koilam ah ahia apai?" achi hi.
Mikaiah in, "Ngai in, dantan sunggil a kibu dia na lut ni in na thei ding," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n, "Mikaiah pi unla, khopi ukpipa Ammon leh kumpi tapa Joash kiang ah paipih nawn un," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, "Hiai mi suangkul ah khum unla, galmuang a ka hong pai nawn masiah gimthuakna an leh gimthuakna tui na pia un," achi hi.
Mikaiah in, "Galmuang a na hong pai nawnleh TOUPA'N kei zang a thu gen lou ahi ding," achi hi. Amah mah in, "Nou, mipite aw, na vek un na za un," achi hi.
Huchi in Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa leh Jehoshaphat ahohtou uh.
Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka kibawl lamdang dia, kidouna ah ka hohtou dia; nang bel na kumpi puan silh in," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa akibawl lamdang a, kidouna ah ahohtou hi.
Siria kumpipa'n akangtalai tung a heutu sawmthum-le-nihte kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa kia lou ngal mineu leng, milian leng akuamah sual kei un," chi in thu apia hi.
Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Jehoshaphat amuh un, hichi ahong hi a, "Israel kumpipa ahi mah ve," achi uh. Huchi in sual tum in a-umta ua; Jehoshaphat akikoukhia hi.
Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Israel kumpipa ana hi kei chih atheih un hichi ahong hi a, adelh lai uh anungkiksan uhi.

Mi khat in tup tuam nei lou in athalpeu alai a, Israel kumpipa kithopna kikaltak ah akapkhata hi. Huchi in akangtalai hawlpa kiang ah, "Kaihei inla, sepaihte lak a pan hon pawtpih in, ka liam," achi hi.
Huai ni in kidouna athupi mahmah a; kumpipa akangtalai tung a kingai in Siriate lam nga in a-opsuk a, nitaklam in asita a; aliamna a pan sisan kangtalai sung ah aluang hi.
Nitum kuan in sepaihte lak ah, "Michih amah khua ah, michih amah gam ah pai vek hen," chi in thu puankhiak ahi.
