Huchi in kumpipa asita a, Samaria khua alutpih ua; huchi in Samaria ah kumpipa avui uh.
Samaria khua dil khat ah kangtalai asil ua; TOUPA thugen bang in uite'n asisan aliaksiang ua, agalvan leng asilsiang uh. Huai dil bel kizuakte kisilna dil ahi.
Huchi in Ahab tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, saiha inn alamte, akhosat tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in apute kiang ah Ahab a-ihmuta a; asik in atapa Ahaziah ahong lalta hi.
Israel kumpipa Ahab lal akum lina ah, Judahte tung ah Asa tapa Jehoshaphat alal pan hi.
Jehoshaphat alal kipat in kum sawmthum-le-nga ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-nga vai ahawm hi. Anu min Azubah ahi a, amah Shilhi tanu ahi.
Apa Asa lampi tot tengteng atawn a; pialsan het lou in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi. Himahleh mun sangte alamang kei a, mun sangte ah mite kithoih lai in gimlim ahal lailai uhi.
Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa toh kilemna abawl hi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdan ahihlat thute, agaldou thute Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Apa Asa dam lai a pasal kizuak omlaite, agam a pan adelhkhe vek hi.
Edom gam ah kumpipa a-om kei a, thuneihna piaksawn mi khat in vai ahawm hi.
Jehoshaphat in Ophir a pai a dangka-eng po ding Tarshish longte abawl hi. Himahleh Ezion-geber mun ah longte asiat khit vek ziak in ahohta kei hi.
Huchi in Ahab tapa Ahaziah in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, na sikhate toh longte ah ka sikhate kuankhawm le uh ake, achi a; himahleh Jehoshaphat in lem asa kei.
Huchi in apute kiang ah Jehoshaphat a-ihmuta a, apute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoram alalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat lal akum sawm-le-sagih kum in Samaria ah, Israelte tung ah Ahab tapa Ahaziah alal pan a, Israelte tung ah kum nih alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a, anu leh apa lampi totte, Nebat tapa Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Jeroboam lampi totte atawn sam hi.
Apa hih teng hih in Baal nna sem in abia a, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahehsak hi.
Huan Solomon in Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh toh kizolhna abawl hi. Pharaoh tanu akitenpih a, ama inn ding leh TOUPA' inn ding alam khit ma leh Jerusalem kulh a-umsuak masiah David khopi ah a omsak hi.
Mipite kia mun sangte ah akithoih ua, huai ma in TOUPA min a dia inn akilam nai takdih louh ziak in.
Solomon in TOUPA a-it a, apa David dan thusehte azui a; mun sangte a kithoih in, gimlimte kia ana hal hi.
Kithoih ding in Gibeon ah kumpipa ahoh hi; huai lah mun sang poimohtak ahi ngal a. Solomon in huai maitam tung ah halmang thillat sangkhat alan hi.
Gibeon ah zan in Solomon kiang ah amang in TOUPA ahong kihil hi. Pathian in akiang ah, "Ngen in, bang ahia ka hon piak ding?" achi hi.

Solomon in, "Na sikha, ka pa David na mitmuh a thutak leh diktatna leh lungtang diktak pu a a-om bang in, nang akiang ah hehpihna thupi mahmah na langsak hi. Nang hiai hehpihna thupi mahmah ama a ding in na guan a, nang alaltutphah a tu ding tapa na pia a, tuni a ahong om petmah bang in.
Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, nang na sikha, ka pa David sik in kumpipa in na hon bawlta hi. Kei zaw naupang leltak ka hi a; thu tung lam leh pawt lam leng ka thei kei hi.
Na sikha, na mitelte, mi tampi, atam ziak ua sim seng vual louh leh azah theihseng vuallouhte lak ah a-om hi.
Huaiziak in na mite vai hawmsak ding in na sikha theihsiamna lungtang pia in, huchi a asia leh apha ka khenkak theihna ding in. Na mi hiai zah zouzai kua'n ahia vai hawmsak thei ding?" achi hi.
Solomon in huai ngen a, athugen in TOUPA akipaksak hi.
Pathian in akiang ah, "Na damsawtna ding, nang a dia hauhsaknate, na melmate sihna ding ngen lou a, vaihawm siamna dia theihsiamna na nget zawk ziak in;

ngai in, na nget bang in ka hihta hi. Ngai in, pilna leh theihsiamna lungtang ka hon pia hi. Huchi in na ma ah nang bang kuamah a-om kei ding ua, na nung in leng nang bang kuamah ahong om sam kei ding.
Na nget louh, hauhsakna leh zahtakhuaina leng ka hon pe lai hi. Huchi in na damsung in kumpipate lak ah nang bang a-om kei ding uh.
Na pa David in azuih bang a ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte zui dia ka lampite a na paileh ka hon damsawtsak lai ding hi,” achi hi.

Solomon akhanglou lou a, ngai in, mang ana hi. Huchi in Jerusalem ah ahoh a, TOUPA thukhun bawm ma ah adingh a, halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alan a, asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuang alui hi.
Kizuak numei nih kumpipa kiang ah ahong ua, ama ah ava dingh uhi.
Numei khat in, "Aw ka toupa, hiai numei toh inn khat a tengkhawm ka hi ua; huai inn a amah toh ka om lai un nau ka nei hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ka nau neih nung ani thum ni in hiai numei in leng nau anei sam hi. Omkhawm ka hi ua; huai inn a om koute gel lou, kuamah mikhual om a-om kei hi.
Zan in hiai numei ta ana si a; ama'n adelhlup khak ahi.
Zan lai in athou a, na sikhanu a-ihmut kal in, ka sik a ka tapa ana la a, apom a, ama ta si pen ka ang ah ana sial hi.
Zingsang a ka ta nawi pe dia ka thohleh, ngai in, ana si khin hi. Himahleh zingsang a ka etchetleh ngai in, ka suan ka tapa pen ana hi kei," achi hi.

Numei dang in, "Hilou e. Ahing pen kei tapa ahi a, asi pen nang tapa ahi," achi hi. Khat in, "Hilou, asi pen na tapa ahi a, ahing pen ka tapa ahi,” achi tinten hi. Huchibang in kumpipa ma ah agen tuaktuak uhi.
Kumpipa'n, "Khat in, ahing pen ka tapa ahi a, asi pen na tapa ahi,” achi hi. Khat pen in, "Hilou, asi pen na tapa ahi, ahing pen ka tapa ahi zaw, achi zel hi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n, "Namsau hon va lak un," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa ma ah namsau ahon tawi uhi.
Kumpipa'n, "Naungek hing pen tum nih suah unla, akimkhat khat pia unla, adang khat kiang ah akimkhat pia un," achi hi.

Naungek hing pen nu in ata alainat mahmah ziak in kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, naungek hing pen amah pe mai in, that mahmah ke'n," achita hi. Khat pen in, "Kei a hi tuan dah henla, nang a leng lah hi tuan kei heh. Himahleh tumtan hi hen," achita hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n adawng a, "Naungek hing pen that kei unla, amah pia un. Amah anu ahi,” achi hi.
Israel tengteng in huai thu a kumpipa thukhendan ana za ua; kumpipa alau uh. Vaihawm ding in Pathian pilna amah ah a-om chih athei uhi.
Huchi in Kumpipa Solomon tuh Israel tengteng kumpipa ahong hita hi.
Hiaite amiliante ahi uh: Zadok tapa Azariah siampu ahi.
Shisha tapa Elihoreph leh Ahiah laigelhmi ahi uh. Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat tanchin gelhmi ahi.
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah sepaih heutu ahi a; Zadok leh Abiathar siampu ahi uh.
Nathan tapa Azariah heutute tung a mi ahi a; Nathan tapa Zabud siampu leh kumpipa lawm ahi khawm hi.
Ahishar insung lam heutu ahi a; Abda tapa Adoniram phutluih nasemte heutu ahi.

Solomon in Israel tengteng tung ah heutu sawm-le-nih anei hi. Huaite'n kumpipa a ding leh a-inkote a ding in nek-le-tak angaihtuah zel uhi. Mi khat in kum khat in kha khat zel nek ding tak ding ape zel hi.
Hiaite amin uh ahi: Ephraim tanggam ah Ben-hur.
Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh leh Elon-beth-hanan ah dil Ben-deker ahi.
Arubboth ah Ben-hesed ahi a, ama'n Sokoh leh Hepher gam teng leng atangkhawm hi.
Dor gam tengteng ah Ben- abinadab ahi a, ama'n Solomon tanu Taphath zi in anei hi.
Tanak khua leh Meggiddo khote, Jezreel kho nuai, Zarethan khochin a om Beth-shean bial teng ah, Beth-shean apan Abel-meholah, Jokmeam gam bul tan in Ahilud tapa Baana ahi.

Ramoth-gilead ah Ben-geber ahi a, ama'n Manasseh tapa Jair khote, Gilead gam a omte atangkhawm hi. Bashan gam a Argob bial, kho thupi taktak sawmguk, kulh leh akalhna daltawn neite leng atangkhawm hi.
Mahanaim ah Iddo tapa Ahinadab ahi.
Naphtali ah Ahimaaz ahi a, ama'n leng Solomon tanu Basemath zi in anei hi.
Asher leh Bealoth khua ah Hushai tapa Baana ahi a;
Issakar ah Paruah tapa Jehoshaphat;
Benjamin ah Elah tapa Shimei;
Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam, Gilead gam ah Uri tapa Geber ahi a, Amah huai gam heutu omsun ahi.
Judahte leh Israelte tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah in atam ua, ane un adawn ua, nuamtak in a-om zel uhi.
Solomon in lui a pan Philistiate gam leh Aigupta gamgi pha in gam teng ah vai ahawm hi. Thilpiakte ahon tawi zel ua, Solomon damsung teng a-nna asem uhi.
Solomon ni khat an nekkhiak, tangbuang nel mahmah pota sawmthum leh tangbuang pota sawmguk;
bawngtal thautak sawm, gam a bawngtal sawmnih leh belam zakhat ahi uh. Hiaite lou leng sakhite, sangaite, sakhital, ak vak thaute leng ahi lai uhi.
Lui gal khen lam gam teng, Tiphsah a pan Gaza tan, lui gal khen lam a kumpipate tung ah alal hi. Akimvel a mi teng toh kilem in a-om hi.
Solomon damsung in Judahte leh Israelte Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan in michih amau grep leh theipi chinna nuai ah bittak in ateng chiat uhi.
Solomon in kangtalai kai sakol singli leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei hi.
Hiai heutute'n amau tankha kha in Solomon leh kumpipa Solomon dohkan hong um teng nek ding apia ua, piak kim louh anei ngei kei uh.
Michih in ahih dia seh bang dungzui in a-omna ding mun ah sakolte leh gan taihat mahmahte a ding in barli buh leh buhpawlte ahon pua uhi.
Pathian in Solomon pilna leh theihsiamna thupi mahmah leh lungsim letna tuipi piau a piaunel bang mai apia hi.
Solomon pilna in suahlam ta tengteng pilna leh Aigupta mite pilna tengteng akhup vek hi.
Mi tengteng sang in apilzaw a, Mahol tapate, Ezrah mi Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Darda sang in leng. Huchi in akim a nam tengteng lak ah amin athangkheta hi.
Paunak sangthum agen a, alate sangkhat leh nga ahi uh.
Sing tanchin, Lebanon tang a Sidar sing a pan kulhbaang a hong selkhia hissop tan in agen hi. Gamsate tanchin, vasate tanchin, bokvak a paite tanchin leh ngasate tanchin leng agen hi.
Huchi in Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in nam tengteng a pan apilna zasate leh lei a kumpipa teng ahong pai uhi.
Huan Tura kumpipa Hiram in Solomon kiang ah asikhate asawl hi; apa mun ah kumpipa in amah thau anilh uh chih lah ana zata ngal a. Hiram in David a-it gige him ahi.
Solomon in mi sawl in Hiram kiang ah,
"Ka pa David in TOUPA'N akhepek nuai a akoih masiah akimvel a mun chih mual chih a kidounate ziak a TOUPA a Pathian min a dia inn alam theihlouhdan na thei hi.
Tu in TOUPA ka Pathian in mun chih mual chih ah muanna ahon neisakta hi. Melma leh vangsiatna leng a-om kei hi.

Ngai dih, TOUPA'N ka pa David kiang ah, 'Na tapa na sik a na laltutphah ka luahsak ding in ka min a ding in inn ahon lam ding, chi a ana gensa bang in, TOUPA ka Pathian min a ding in inn lam ka tum hi.'

Huaiziak in tu in Lebanon tang a sidar singte hon phuksak ding in thu pia inla, ka sikhate leng na sikhate lak ah ahong tel sam ding ua, na sikhate loh ahihleh na chih peuhmah ka hon pe ding. Zidon mite bang a sing phuksiam ka lak uah kuamah a-om kei uh, chih lah na thei ngal a," chi in agensak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hiram in Solomon thu azak in akipak mahmah hi. "Hiai mi tampi tung a vaihawm dia tapa piltak David pepa TOUPA tuni in phat in om hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Hiram in Solomon kiang ah, "N'on thukhah ka na za hi. Sidar sing thu leh meilah sing thu na deih peuhmah ka hih ding.

Ka sikhate'n Lebanon tang a pan tuipi pha in ahon lasuk ding ua, n'on mun sehsak a tuipi a tolh ding in ka gaklopsak ding hi. Huai ah ka phelsak dia, nang na na la ding hi. Nang leng ka inkote nek ding tum in ka deih na hon hihsak sam ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
Huchi in Hiram in sidar sing leh meilah sing Solomon deih teng apia hi.
Solomon in Hiram inkote nek ding in buh pota singnih leh sathau suk pota sawmnih apia hi. Hiai Solomon in kum teng a Hiram apiakdan ahi.
TOUPA'N achiam bangtak in Solomon pilna apia hi. Hiram leh Solomon kikal ah kilemna a-om a; anih un kilemna thukhun abawl uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon in Israel tengteng lak ah phutluih nasemmi abawl a; amau mi singthum ahi uh.
Lebanon ah kha khat a kikheng zel in singkhat asawl zel hi. Kha khat Lebanon ah a-om ua, kha nih amau inn ah. Phutluih nasem mite heutu Adoniram ahi.
Solomon in tangte ah thil pomi singsagih leh suangsekmi singgiat anei hi.
Huaite sim louh in Solomon in anasep tung a heutu tuam, nasep vengmi sangthum-le-zathum anei lai hi.
Kumpipa thupiak in inn suangphum dia lep ding in suang lian pipi, suang mantam pipi leh suang seksa ahon pua uhi.
Inn lam mite, Solomon mite leh Hiram mite leh Gebal mite'n suangte asek ua, huai inn lamna ding in sing leh suangte abawl uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawt nung uh kum zali-le-sawmgiatna kum, Israelte tung a Solomon lal akum lina, Ziv kha, akha nihna in TOUPA' inn lam apan uhi.
Solomon in TOUPA a dia a-inn lam adunglam tong sawmguk ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi, asanlam tong sawmthum ahi.
Huai inn a Mun Siangthou malam a inlim availam tan tong sawmnih a sau ahi a, amalam a pen availam tong sawm ahi.
Inn a ding in tohlet neuchik vathangkalh om in abawl hi.
Huai inn baang kimvel leh tempul baang kimvel in tempul mun baang kimvel leng huai inn baang si in inn chial nei alam hi.

Akimvel in dantan abawl a; achial nuainungpen availam tong nga ahi a, alai a pen availam tong guk ahi. Athumna availam tong sagih ahi. Kalvaite ahihleh inn baang a kigolh akiphamoh kei; inn polam ah akimvel in baang ah akingakna akibawl ziak ahi.
Huai inn alam lai un suang alaihna mun a seksa vek a bawl ahi. Huchi in alam sung un sek ging, heipi ging leh sik vanzat ging huai inn ah zak ahi kei hi.
Dantan laita pente kongpi huai inn taklam pang ah a-om a; alaita ah kahna kivial in akahtou ua, alaita a pan athumna tan ah.
Huchi in huai inn ahon lam a, azou a, inn bel sidar inkam leh apek in akhuh hi.
Inchial neite akisituah vek in tong nga chiat a sang in alam a; huaite sidar sing sige toh apeh hi.
Solomon kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.

"Hiai inn na lam laitak tungtang thu, ka dan thusehte na pom a, ka vaihawmte na zuih a, ka thupiak tengteng zui dia na pom peuhmahleh, na pa David kiang a ka gensa, huai ka thu na tung ah ka hihkip ding.
Israel suante lak ah ka teng dia, ka mi Israelte ka limsak lou kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon in huai inn alam a, azouta hi.
Inn sunglam baang ding in sidar singpek azang a; apialkhang a pan atunglam baang pha in asunglam ah sing abelh vek hi. Apialkhang ding in meilah singpek aphahbeh hi.
Inn phaitam lam tong sawmnih pen pialkhang a pan baangte tan in sidar singpek vek in abawl a; biakna mun, Mun Siangthoupen a ding in leng asunglam ah azang hi.
Huai inn, abiakna munpi adunglam tong sawmli ahi.
Huai insung lam ah apakmum leh apakpalh limgelh kilawm sidar sing a khuak a-om a; avek in sidar sing vek ahi a; suang himhim muh ahi kei hi.
TOUPA thukhun bawm koihna ding in huai insung ah biakna lam ah mun abawl hi.
Huai, biakna mun sung adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawmnih, asanlam tong sawmnih ahi a, dangka-eng hul ngen in aluan a; sidar sing a bawl maitam leng aluan hi.
Huchi in Solomon in huai insung dangka-eng hul ngen in aluan a; biakna mun malam dangka-eng khainiang in adaikaih a; huai dangka-eng in aluan hi,
Huai in avek a azoh pha in apumpi in dangka-eng in aluan tawmtawm hi. Biakna mun maitam pumpi leng dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Biakna mun ah tong sawm tuaktuak a sang, cherub nih olive sing in abawl hi.
Cherub kha khat pen tong nga ahi a, cherub kha langkhat pen tong nga mah ahi. Akha mong khat a pan akha langkhat mong kikal tong sawm ahi.
Cherub khat pen leng tong sawm ahi a; cherubte akikim geih un, akibang geih uhi.
Cherub khat sanlam tong sawm ahi a, cherub khat pen leng huai toh kikim mah ahi.

Cherubte insung gilzaw ah akoih a; cherubte kha akizak a, khat kha in baang langkhat lam ava khoih a, cherub khat pen kha in leng baang langkhat akhoih a; huai inn laitak ah akha uleh akha uh akisukhatuah uhi.
Huai cherubte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Inn baang tengteng akimvel in cherubte, tum sing leh pakpalh limte gelh kilawm insung lam leh polam ah abawl hi.
A-inn pialkhang sunglam leh polam dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Biakna mun lutna ding in olive sing kongkhak abawl a; kongpi lutung leh kongpi biangte abaang seh nga suah seh khat chiat ahi.
Huchi in olive sing inn kongkhak nih abawl a; huai ah cherubte tum sing leh pakpalh limte gelh kilawm in abawl hi. Huai dangka-eng in aluan a; cherubte leh tum singte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Tempul lutna ding in abaang seh li suah seh khat chia in olive kongpi khuam abawl lai hi.
Meilah sing kongkhak nih toh; kongkhak khat a pek nihte kheptheih ahi a, kongkhak khat pen apek nih leng kheptheih ahi.
Huaite ah cherubte tum sing leh pakpalh limte agelh a; huai gelh kilawm mamtak in dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Tempul huangsung intual sunggilzaw pen suangsek chial thum leh sidar singpek thuah khat in abawl hi.
Akum lina, Ziv kha in TOUPA inn suangphum lep khit ahi.
Akum sawm-le-khatna, Bul kha, akha giatna in huai inn zuih ding bangbang, bangkim mansa vek ahi. Huchi in kum sagih sung alam hi.
Huan Solomon in a-inn kum sawm-le-thum alam a, huchi in a-inn pumpi alamzou vekta hi.
Lebanon gammang inn, khuamvual li, khuam tung a sidar singpek tung ah alam a; adunglam tong zakhat ahi. Availam tong sawmnga ahi a, asanlam tong sawmthum ahi.
Huai khuam a kinga dantan sawmli-le-nga tunglam ah sidar singphel a khuh ahi a; vual khat ah sawm-le-nga zel ahi.
Vual thum ah tohlette a-om a, vak leh vakte bel vual thum in akigalsai vek uhi.
Kongkhak leh khuam tengteng singpek aning li nei a bawl ahi a, vak leh vakte vual thum in akigalsai vek uhi.
Inn lim khuam nei abawl a; adunglam tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmthum ahi. Huaite ma ah akhuamte leh ama a lutna tung kah toh inlim abawl hi.
Avaihawmna ding laltutphah inlim, vaihawmna inlim, avaihawmna ding abawl hi. Huai pialkhang langkhat a pan langkhat pha a sidar sing a khuh ahi.
Ama tenna ding in, inn lim nung a, huangsung intual dang nei om pen huchi mah bang a bawl ahi. Huai inlim mah bang in Solomon in zi a Pharaoh tanu aneih, inn ding leng alamsak lai hi.

Hiai tengteng suang manpha pipi, ahun geihgeih a sek zel suang, atna a at a lam ahi. Sunglam leng, polam leng asuangphum a pan alek pha in, huchi mah bang in polam ah huangsung intual lianpi tanpha in.
Suangphum suang manpha pipi, suang lian pipi, suang tong sawm leh suang tong giatte a lep ahi.
Huai tunglam ah suang manpha pipi, suang ahun geihgeih zel a sek leh sidar sing ahi.
Akimvel in huangsung intual lianpi suangsek chial thum leh sidar singpek thuah khat a um ahi. TOUPA' inn huangsung intual sunggilzaw leh inn inlim mah bang in.
Kumpipa Solomon in Tura a pan mi sawl in, Hiram asam hi.

Huai mi Naphtali nam meithai tapa ahi a, apa Tura khomi, dalsekmi ahi. Amah dalsek lam himhim ah apil in atheisiam in akhutsiam petmah hi. Kumpipa Solomon kiang ah ahoh a, a-nna tengteng asepsak vek hi.
Dal khuam nih, tong sawm-le-giat a sang; akimvel a teh a tong sawm-le-nih a lian tuaktuak abawl hi.
Khuam lu a koih ding dal sunbawk nih abawl a; bawk khat sanlam tong nga ahi a, bawk khat pen sanlam tong nga mah ahi.
Khuampite dawn ah lubawkte gial im-iam leh kihek nginngian a-om a; hiai lubawk kisuangsawn bel khainiang kiphan sagih, bawk khat pen a ding in leng sagih mah a kituam ahi.
Huchi in khuamte abawl a; khuam lu a bawkte tuamna ding in gial im-iam khat tung ah akimvel vual nih a-om a; huchi mah bang in khat tung ah leng a-om lai hi.
Inn lim a khuam dawn a bawk ah lili lim atuang a, huai tong li ahi.
Khuam nih dawn a bawkte gei ah gial im-iam kiang ah theibuhfaite a-om a; theibuhfaite bel huai bawkte ah zanih tuaktuak a volh in a-om uhi.
Tempul inlim ah khuamte adingsak a; taklam khuam adingsak a, amin Jakin asa a; veilam khuam leng adingsak a; amin Boaz asa hi,
Khuamte dawn ah lili lim atuang a; huchi in khuam lam nasep teng zohsiang ahita.
Dal tuibem lianpi, tong sawm, asanlam tong nga asung a; agei tong sawmthum kimvel ahi.
Agei nuai ah pakmum lim in akimvel vek a, tong sawm ahi a, tuibem kimvel in a-om hi. Huai pakmumte vual nih in a-om ua, sunkhawm pah ahi.
Huai bawngtal sawm-le-nih tung ah akinga a, thum in mallam anga ua, thum in tumlam anga ua, thum in simlam anga ua, thum in suahlam anga uhi. Atung uah tuibem akitung a, ameilam un asunglam adoh hi.
Khutpek chia a sah ahi a; agei lili pak bang, nou gei bang a bawl ahi. Bath sangnih takna ahi.
Dal in tunsawnna sawm abawl a; tunsawnna khat sau lam tong li ahi a, availam tong li mah ahi a, asanlam tong thum ahi.
Tunsawnna bawldan hichibang ahi. Huai in kuak anei a, huai kuakte ageite kikal ah a-om hi.
Ageite kikal a kuakte ah humpinelkaite, bawngtalte leh cherubte atuang ua; agei tungte ah tunsawnna a-om hi. Humpinelkaite leh bawngtalte nuailam ah kilawmsaknate a-om dindian hi.
Tunsawnnate ah dal kangtalai li leh dal tung chih a-om chiat a; aning lite ah kingakna a-om chiat hi. Kisilna nuailam ah akingakna sun a-om a, asik chiat ah kilawmsakna a-om chiat hi.
Valh gong sung tong khat ahi; akam kimvel valh bang a bem ahi a, tong khat-le-akim ahi. Akam gei kimvel gial kilawm ahi a, akuakte ning li ahi a, abem kei uh.
Akuak nuailam ah kangtalai lite a-om ua; kangtalai tungchihte tunsawnna ah a-om uhi. Kangtalai sandan tong khat-le-akim ahi,
Huai kangtalaite bawldan sakol kangtalai khe bawldan bang ahi a; atungchihte, avalhte, asutkalhnate leh laibawkte avek a sun ahi.
Tunsawnna ning li chiat ah kingakna li a-om a; huai kingaknate tunsawnna toh pum khat vek ahi uh.
Tunsawnna tung ah valh, tong kimkhat a sang a-om a; tunsawnna tung a atunna khete leh akuakte pum khat vek ahi.
Atunna khepekte leh akuakte ah azat bangbang in cherubte, humpinelkaite leh tum singte atuangsak a, akimvel in kilawmsakna a-om dindian hi.
Huchibang vek in tunsawnna sawm abawl a; avek in pum khat a sun ahi chiat ua, kikim chiat, bawldan kibang geih ahi chiat uh.
Kisilna bel sawm dal in abawl a; kisilna bel khat in bath sawmli adong a; kisilna bel tong li chiat ahi uh. Tunsawnna sawm tung ah kisilna bel khat akitung chiat hi.
Tunsawnnate inn taklam pang ah nga atung a, inn veilam pang ah nga mah. Tuibem pen inn taklam pang ah suahlam ah simlam nga in atung hi.
Hiram in kisilna belte, vutluahte, maiphiat kuangte abawl a, huchi in TOUPA inn a dia Solomon abawlsak teng azousiangta hi.
Khuam nihte, khuam dawn a bel bang a bawk nihte, khuam dawn a bel ban a bawk nih tuamna gial im-iam nihte,
tuamna gial im-iam nih a dia theibuhfai zalite, khuam dawn a bel bang a bawk nih tuamna ding gial im-iam tuaktuak a dia theibuhfai vual nihte;
tunsawnna sawm leh tunsawnna tung a kisilna bel sawmte;
tuibem khat leh tuibem nuai a bawngtal sawm-le-nihte,
belte, vutluahte leh maiphiat kuangte toh. Tui-um belsuan tengteng TOUPA' inn a dia Hiram in kumpipa Solomon abawlsak dal nawttet a bawl vek ahi.
Jordan Phaizang ah Sukkoth leh Zarethan kikal a bellei omna ah hiai teng kumpipa'n asung hi.
Huai tui-um belsuan tengteng atam mahmah ziak in Solomon in buk khe lou in akoih a; dal bukzah pen theihkhiak ahi kei hi.
Solomon in TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan om tengteng abawl a; dangka-eng maitam leh tanghou koihna dohkan dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Mun siangthoupen ma a khawnvak koihnate, taklam a nga leh veilam a ngate dangka-eng siang in; pakte, khawnvakte leh taitehte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Noute, khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, keute leh mei laknate dangka-eng siang in; insung gilzaw, Mun Siangthoupen kongkhakte leh inn, tempul, kongkhak bulhnate dangka-eng in aluan hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl tengteng azouvekta hi. Huchi in Solomon in apa David in ana latkhitsa dangka chite, dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuante alalut a, TOUPA' inn a goute lak ah akoihta hi.

Huchi in Solomon in Israel upate, anam intekpen tengteng Israel suan inkuan a lupente, Jerusalem a kumpipa Solomon kiang ah David khopi, Zion a pan TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngtou ding in akaikhawm vek hi.
Israel mi tengteng Ethanim kha, akha sagihna ah, ankuangluina ah kumpipa Solomon kiang ah akikaikhawm vek uhi.
Israel upa tengteng ahong ua, siampute'n bawm azawng uhi.
TOUPA bawm leh Kihoupihna Puanin leh puanin a tui-um belsuan siangthou tengteng tan in siampute leh Levi chite'n azawngtou uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon leh Israel suan omkhawm tengteng akiang a hong kikhawmte bawm ma ah a-omkhawm uh. Belam leh bawngtal atam ziak a sim seng vual louh leh azah theihseng vual louh in akithoih uhi.
Siampute'n TOUPA thukhun bawm omna ding, insung a biakna mun a Mun Siangthoupen ah cherubte kha nuai ah alalut uhi.
Cherubte'n bawm omna tung zawn ah akha uh azak gige ngal ua, cherubte'n bawm leh azawnna chiangtawnte ahuap vek uhi.
Azawnna chiangtawn asau mahmah ziak in, azawnna chiangtawn mongte biakna mun ma, mun siangthou a pan amuh theih hi. Himahleh inn polam ah zaw adawk kei, tuni tan huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
Aigupta gam a pan apawt ua TOUPA Israel suante toh thu akhun lai a Mosi in Horeb tang a suangpek nih akoihte kia lou ngal, huai bawm sung ah bangmah dang a-om kei.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute Mun Siangthou a pan ahong pawt khiaktak un meipi in TOUPA' inn ahong dim meuhmouh hi.
Meipi ziak in siampute nasem in a-om thei kei uh. TOUPA thupina in TOUPA' inn lah adimsak vek ngal a.
Solomon in thu agen a: "TOUPA'N, mial bikbek ah ka om ding," achi hi.
"Na tenna ding in, tangtawn a na om gigena ding inn ka hon lamsak petmah hi,” achi hi.
Kumpipa akinunghei a, Israel kikaikhawm tengteng avualzawl a, Israel kikaikhawm tengteng adingh dipdep uhi.
Ama'n, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, ka na David kiang a amah kam mahmah a,

Aigupta gam a pan ka mi Israelte ka pikhiak ni a pan Israel nam lak a koi lai khua leng ka min omna ding, inn lamna ding ka tel ngei kei hi. Himahleh ka mi Israelte heutu ding in David ka tel hi, chi a ana genpa, amah khut mahmah a hon pichingsakpa phat in om hen.
"Ka pa David in Israelte' Pathian, TOUPA min dia inn lam alungsim in ana tum hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N ka pa David kiang ah, 'Na lungsim in ka min a ding in inn lam na tum a, hichibang lungsim na put na hihhoih hi.
Himahleh nang zaw, inn na lam kei ding. Na tapa, na khal a hong pawtkhe ding in ka min a ding in inn alam zaw ding," ana chi hi.
"TOUPA'N athugen ahihkip a; TOUPA'N ana chiamsa bang ngei in ka pa David mun ka hon luah in, Israel laltutphah ah ka hong tuta a, Israelte' Pathian, TOUPA min a ding in inn ka na lamta ngei hi.
Huai ah bawm omna ding mun ka na sep a, huai ah Aigupta gam a pan apikhiak lai a i pute uh kiang a athukhun, TOUPA thukhun a-om,” achi hi.
TOUPA maitam ma, Israel hong kikhawm tengteng muh in Solomon adingh a, van lam ah akhut azaktou hi.

"AW TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, na sikha lungtang tengteng na mitmuh a omte kiang a thukhun tangtun a hehpihna hihlang zel, na sikha ka pa David kiang a thuchiam tangtunpa, tunglam ah leh nuailam lei ah nang bang Pathian dang a-om kei.
Ahi, nang na kam in thu na gen a, na khut in na hon lohchingsakta a, tuni a, hong omta ngei bang in.

Huaiziak in aw TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, na sikha ka pa David kiang a, na suante ka mitmuh a na om bang a ka mitmuh a om sam ding a a-omdan uh apilvan peuhmah uleh ka mitmuh in Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tatlak kei ding, chi a na chiam tangtun in.
Aw Israelte' Pathian, na sikha ka pa David kiang a thu na gensa hehpih in tungsak in."
"Himahleh lei ah Pathian ateng mahmah dia hia? Ngai in, van leh vante' van a leng ta lou na hi a; hiai ka inn lam ah nak tat tuak kei na tel chia!
Himahleh TOUPA ka Pathian, tuni a na sikha in ahon sapna thumna, athusam ngaihkhiaksak in, na sikha thumna leh ngetna hon limsak in.
Hiai mun lam nga a na sikha in thum a thu asam ding ngaikhia a, nang, huai ah ka min a-om ding, na chihna mun ngei a, inn lam a sun leh zan a na mit ahah gige theihna ding in.
Na sikha leh na mi Israelte'n hiai mun lam nga a, ahong thum chiang un angetnate uh na ngaihkhiaksak zel in. Ahi, na tenna mun, van ah na ngaikhia in; ngaikhia inla, ngaidam in." \
"Mi kuapeuh in a-invengte tung ah thil hihkhial in, kichiamsak hial ahong kiphatmohleh hiai inn a na maitam ma ah hong kichiam henla,
nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, gamtang inla na sikhate vai hawmsak in, migilou pen mohpaih in alutung ah a-omdan nga inla, midiktat pen siamtangsak in adiktatna bangbang amah pia in.
Na mi Israelte'n na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua melmate lak a avuallelh ua nang lam ahong ngat nawn ua, na min aphat ua, hiai inn a thum a thil ahon nget uleh,
nang van ah ana ngaihkhiaksak inla, na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, apute uh gam na piak ah pikik nawn in."
"Na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua van akikhak a, vuah ahong zuk louh hun chiang in, hiai mun lam nga a ahong thum ua, na min apuankhiak ua, amau na bawl gentheih ziak a akhelhnate uh akisik uleh,
nang van ah ana ngaikhia inla, na sikhate leh na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, apaina ding uh lampi hoih sinsak inla, na mite goutan dia na piakna gam ah vuah zusak in."
"Ka gam ua kial ahong kiak a, hipi ahong len a, keuna hiam, muatna hiam, khaukhup hiam, lung hiam ahong om a, amelmate un akongpi kim ua ahong um ua, hipi khatpeuh, chinatna bangpeuh ahong tunleh,
na mi Israel tengteng lak a amau lungtang a hipi om hi a thei a, hiai inn lam nga a khut zankhia a, thumna leh ngetna ahon lat uleh;
na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, ngaidam inla, gamtang inla, nang alungtang uh theipa, michih a-omdan bangbang in lohchingsak in; nang, nang kia lah mihing ta tengteng lungtang theipa na hi ngal a.
Ka pute uh na piak gam a aten lai teng uh nang ahon lauhtheihna ding un."
"Na mi Israelte hilou namdang, na min ziak a gam gamlapi a pan hong paite tungtang thu leng;
na min thupi mahmah, na khut hat mahmah, na ban na zak thu na za chiat ding ahi ngal ua, huaite'n hiai inn lam nga a, ahong thum chiang un,

nang na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, namdang in hon nget ana hihsak in. Na mi Israelte bangmah a leitung mite'n na min atheih ua, laudan ahong siam ua, hiai ka inn lam in na min pu ahi chih ahon theihtheihna ding un."
"Na mite'n amelmate uh na sawlna lamlam ah adou ua, na khopi tel lam nga leh na min a dia ka lam inn lam nga a, TOUPA kiang a ahong thum uleh,
athumna uleh angetna uh nang van ah ana ngaikhia inla, athu uah gamtang in."
"Na tung a thil ahihkhelh uleh, kuamah thil hihkhial lou lah a-om ngal kei a; atung ua na hehna, melma gam gamla mahmah hiam, naichik hiam a leng sal a api ua;
sal a apina gam ua ahong kingaihtuahkhiak ua, akisik ua, thil i na hihkhialta, dikloutak leh gilou mahmah in i na gamta uh, chi a sal a pi mite gam a nang ahon nget uleh,
amelma amau sal a pite gam a alungtangtak uleh alungsimtak ua nang lam ahong ngat ua, apute uh na piak gam lam leh na khopi tel lam leh na min a dia ka inn lamlam nga a na kiang a ahong thum uleh;
athumna uleh angetna uh nang na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, athu uah gamtang in.
Na mi na tung a thil hihkhialte leh na tung a ana tatlekna uah atatleknate tengteng uh ngaidam inla; sal a pite'n ahehpih theihna ding un hehpihna neisak in.
Na mi na goutan, Aigupta gam a pan sik haltuina sung a pan na pikhiakte lah ahi ngal ua."
"Ahon sap chiang ua na ngaihkhiak dia, na sikha ngetna leh na mi Israelte ngetna lam a na mit na hah gige theihna ding in.
Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ka pute uh Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak lai a na sikha Mosi zang a na gen bang in na goutan ding in leitung mite lak a pan na hihtuam lah ahi ngal ua,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA kiang a athumna leh ngetna tengteng agen khit in, TOUPA maitam ma a khukdin a, van lam a akhut zaktou a om lai athou hi.
Adingtou a, aw ngaihtak in Israel kikhawm tengteng avualzawl hi.
"Athuchiam tengteng bang zel a, ami Israelte khawlna pepa TOUPA phat in om hen. Asikha Mosi zang a athuchiam hoih tengteng thu khat leng avuaksuak kei," chi in.
"TOUPA i Pathian, i pute kiang a a-om bang in i kiang uah om henla; hon paisan in hon donsak lou kei hen.
Huchi in alampi tengteng tawn ding leh i pipute ana piak khitsa bang a, athupiakte, adan thusehte, avaihawmte zui dia i lungtangte ama lam a angatsak theihna ding in.
Asikha thu leh ami Israelte thu ah ani omdan bang zel a, agamtat theihna ding in hiai ka thugen, TOUPA ma a ngetna ka tutte sun leh zan in TOUPA i Pathian ma ah om gige hen.
TOUPA Pathian ahi a, kuamah dang a-om kei uh chih leitung a mite'n atheihtheihna ding in.
Huchi in adan thuseh bang a om ding leh athupiakte zui ding in TOUPA i Pathian lam ah na lungtangte uh hoihkim hen, tuni a bang in.”
Israel tengteng leh Solomon in TOUPA ma ah kithoihna alan uhi.
Solomon in TOUPA a dia alat kilemna kithoihna ding in bawngtal singnih-le-sangnih leh belam nuaikhat-le-singnih ahi. Huchibang in kumpipa leh Israel suan tengteng in TOUPA' inn alan uhi.

Huai ni mah in kumpipa'n TOUPA inka zawn a intual huangsung laitak ahihsiangthou hi. Huai ah halmang thillatte, tangbuang thillatte, kilemna thillat thaute alan hi. Aziak bel huai halmang thillatte, tangbuang thillatte, kilemna thillat sathaute huai dal maitam atat zoh louh ziak ahi.

Huchi in huai hun in Solomon leh Israel tengteng, mipi kikhawm tampi, Hamath lutna a pan Aigupta gam lui pha a mite'n TOUPA i Pathian ma ah ni sagih leh ni sagih, ni sawm-le-li sung ankuang aluikhawm uhi.

Ani giat ni in mipite akikhensak a, amau kumpipa avualzawl ua, huchi in TOUPA'N asikha David leh ami Israelte tung a ahoihna huchi lawmlawm a alatsak ziak in lungsim nuamsa leh kipak mahmah in a-inn lam uah apaita uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn lam a, lunggulhtak a, atup tengteng ahih khit vek nung in,
Gibeon khua a, akiang a, akilak bang in TOUPA Solomon kiang ah ahong kilak nawn hi.

TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na thumna leh na ngetna ka ma a na hon tutte ka na ngaikhia hi. Na inn lam tangtawn a ka min omna ding in ka hihsiangthouta hi. Ka mit leh ka lungtang huai ah tangtawn in a-omta ding hi.
Nang leng thu ka hon piak peuhmah bang a hih dia na pa David a om bang, lungtang hoihtak pu leh lungsim diktak pu a ka mitmuh a na om a, ka dan thusehte leh ka vaihawmte na zuih gigeleh,
Israelte tung ah na gam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding; na pa David kiang a, Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tatlak kei ding, chi a ka na chiamsa bang in.
Himahleh nang hiam na suante hiam in na hon zuih uh kiksan a, ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte leh ka hon theihsakte pom lou a, pathian dangte nna na sep ua, na biak uleh,

gam ka piak a pan Israelte ka hihmang dia; hiai inn ka min a dia ka hihsiangthousa ka mitmuh phak louh ah ka suanmang ding. Huchi in namte lak ah enghouna leh aselam gentehna in Israel zat ahong hi ding.
Hiai inn sang tawkleh leng, akiang a pai peuhmah in lamdang sa in amuk uh ahum ding ua, bangziak a TOUPA'N hiai gam leh hiai inn hichi tel a hih adiam aw? achi ding uh.

Mite'n TOUPA a Pathian uh, apute uh Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa apaisan ua, pathian dangte alet ua, abiak ua, a-nnate uh asep ziak uh ahi. Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hiai siatna tengteng atung uah atungsakta hi, chi in adawng ding uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon inn nihte; TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn alam sung kum sawmnih abei nung in,
Tura kumpipa Hiram in Solomon sidar singte, meilah singte leh dangka-engte akul teng atupsak vek ahi, kumpipa Solomon in Galili gam a khua sawmnih Hiram apia hi.
Solomon in apiak khuate en ding in Tura a pan Hiram apawtkhia a; ava en a himahleh alungtung kei.
Ama'n, unaupa aw, hiai na hon kho piakte bangchibang khua amaizen ua? achi hi. Huchi in tuni tan in ama'n huai khuate Kabul gam achi hi.
Hiram in dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih kumpipa akhak hi.
Kumpipa Solomon in phutluih nasem pawl abawl nangawn hiai ahi: TOUPA' inn leh amah inn lam ding leh Millo, Jerusalem kulh, Hazor khua, Meggiddo khua leh Gezer khuate bawl ding in ahi.
Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ahohtou a, Gezer khua ava la a, ahal a, huai khua a teng Kanaante athat a, atanu Solomon zi thilpiak in ana pe khinta ngal a.
Solomon in Gezer, Beth-horon khangnungzaw,
Baalath leh Israel gamdai a Tadmor khuate,
Solomon in thil koihkhawmna khua aneih tengteng, akangtalai koihna khuate, Jerusalem khua leh Lebanon a vaihawmna gamsung pumpi Solomon in lunggulhtak a bawl atup tengteng abawl hi.
Israel suante hilou, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte leh Jebus omsun tengtengte;
asuan uh, huai gam a om lai Israel suante'n ahihman zoh vek theihlouhte lak ah Solomon in sikha, phutluih nasem pawl abawl a, tuni tan in asem lai uhi.
Israel suante bel Solomon in sikha in abawl kei. Galdou mite, a-intekpate, amiliante, asepaih heutute, akangtalai leh asakol tungtuang pawl heutute ahi zaw uh.
Hiaite Solomon nasep tung a heutu tuam, zanga-le-sawmnga, nasep veng mite ahi uh.
Himahleh Pharaoh tanu bel David khopi a pan, Solomon in alamsak ama inn ah apaitou hi. Huchi in Solomon in Millo abawl hi.
Solomon in TOUPA a dia abawl maitam ah kum teng in thumvei halmang thillat leh kilemna thillat alan a, TOUPA ma a maitam ah gimlimte ahal hi. Huchi in inn alamzouta hi.
Kumpipa Solomon in Edom gam a Tuipi San gei Eloth chin a om Ezion-geber mun ah longhon abawl hi.
Hiram in asikha long mite, tuipi a kiseksa, long a Solomon sikhate kiang ah asawl hi.
Huai mite Ophir ah ava hoh ua, dangka-eng talent zali-le-sawmnih ahon pua ua, kumpipa Solomon kiang hon tun uhi.
Peter, Jesu Khrist sawltak in, Pontus gam, Galatia gam, Kappadosia gam, Asia gam Bithinia leh gam tuamtuam a mikhual dalhzakte kiang ah;
Pa Pathian theihkholh bang a Jesu Khrist thumanna leh sisan theh tang ding a Kha hihtuamna tungtawn a tel a omte kiang ah hehpihna leh khamuanna hihkhan in om hen.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist leh Pa Pathian phat in om hen! Ama'n azahngaihna thupitak bang zel in, misi lak a kipan Jesu Khrist thohnawnna ziak in lametna hing mu ding in ahon piang thaksak nawn hi;
goutan setheilou, nin baang lou, tul thei lou, van a nou a ding a sit muhna ding in;
hotdamna, hun nanung a lang ding a zohsa mu ding in, ginna ziak in Pathian thilhihtheihna a ven na hi uhi.
Tu in ze-etna chiteng ziak in hun sawt lou lungkham tadih mah le uchin, huai ah nakpitak in na kipak uhi.
Na ginna uh ze-etna, dangka-eng mei a ze-et nung nangawn a mangthang zel sang a manphazaw, Jesu Khrist kilak chiang a phatna leh pahtawina leh thupina ding ahong hihtheihna ding in.
Mu ngei lou napi in amah na it ua, tu in mu tadih kei mah le uchin, amah na gingta ua, kipahna gen vual louh leh thupina a dim in na kipak mahmah uhi.
Na ginna un atup pen na kha uh hotdamna na mu uhi.
Huai hotdamna thu zawlneite hehpihna na kiang ua hong tung ding thugenkholte'n akankan ua, siamneltak in azongkhia uhi.
Khrist kha amau a om in Khrist thuakna ding leh thupina hon zui dingte atheihkholhsak lai in, bang hun a bangchi a hong tung ding ahia chih zonkhiak atum uhi.

Huai thu in amau nasep kisep lou in, noumau nasep asem zaw uh chih akiang uah theihsak ahita, huai thute van a kipan a sawlkhiak Kha Siangthou panpih in tanchinhoih nou hon hilhte'n tu in ahon hilh ua, huai thilte angelte'n leng vel a-ut uhi.
Huaiziak in na lungsim puan uh teng in pilvang unla, Jesu Khrist kilak chiang a hehpihna nou ahon puak ding lungke lou in lamen un.
Ta thumangte bang in, na theih louh lai ua na nidanglai duhgawlna uh bang a om lou in;
nou hon sampa asiangthou bang in nou leng na tatdan tengteng uah hong siangthou un;
"Noute na siangthou ding uh ahi, kei ka siangthou ngal a," chih gelh ahi.
Huan khentuam nei lou a michih nasep bang chiat a vaihawmpa Pa bang a na loh uleh, hiai lai a na taam lai teng un laudan siam in om un.
Na pipute uh piaksawn, na omdan uh bangmah hilou a kipan, thil se thei, dangka leh dangka-eng a tat na hi kei ua,
belamnou gensiatbei leh nin baang lou sisan bang a, Khrist sisan pha a tat na hi zaw uh chih na thei uhi.
Amah leilung pian ma in sehkholh in a-om ngeitak a, himahleh hun nanung ah noumau ziak in kilak in a-om hi.
Amah ziak in misi lak a kipan kaithoupa leh athupina pepa Pathian gingtate na hi uh, na ginna uh leh na lametna uh Pathian a a-omtheihna ding in.
Unaute it taktak ding a thutak zui a na kha uh na hihsiangthou tak ziak un lungtang a phatuamngaitak in ki-ittuah chiat un.
Chi se thei lak ah hilou in, Pathian Thu hing gige leh om gige chi setheilou lak a piangthak na hi zaw uhi.
"Mi tengteng loupa bang ahi ua, athupina uh leng loupa pak bang ahi. Loupa avuai a, apak apulh hi.
Toupa bel tangtawn in a-om gige hi," chih ahi ngal a. Hiai ahi tanchinhoih nou ahon hilh pen uh.
Huchi in gitlouhna tengteng, khemna tengteng, lepchiahna tengteng, hazatna tengteng, gensiatna tengteng tawpsan unla,
naungek suak thakte bang in khalam nawitui, bangmah hel louh lunggulh un; huai a na khantheihna ding un:
Toupa mihehpih theitak ahi chih na chep tak ngal uleh.
Amah suang hing, mihingte deih louh, Pathian theih a bel tel leh manpha ahi.
Amah kiang a hong pai in, noute ngei leng suang hingte bang in Jesu Khrist ziak a Pathian kipah lam kithoihna lan ding a siampu siangthou hi ding in khalam inn ah leptouh in na om uhi.
Huaiziak in Laisiangthou ah: "Ngai un, Zion ah aning a suang kiphamohpen tel a om leh manphatak ka lem hi; amah gingtate azahlak kei ding uh," chih atuang hi.
Nou agingtate a ding in huai manphapi ahi, agingtaloute a ding in bel; "Inn lamte suang deih louhpen, huai mah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita hi."
Huan "Pukna suang leh dalna suangpi ahi. Thu kigente azuih louh ziak un akisuipuk ua; huchibang ding a sehsa ahi him uhi."
Himahleh mial a kipan pawt a, vak lamdangtak a lut ding a nou hon sampa hoihna na muhsak theihna ding un, nou zaw chitel, kumpi siampu, nam siangthou, Pathian mite na hi uhi;
Nidanglai in nam himhim na hi kei ua; tu in zaw Pathian namte na hita uh; nidanglai in zahngaihna na mu kei ua, tu in zaw zahngaihna na muta uhi.
Deihtakte aw, mikhual leh khualzin na hih ziak un kha dou nakpa taksa utnate tawpsan ding in nou ka hon ngen hi.
Zentelte lak a na tatdan uh kilawmtak hi hen, huchi in thil hihkhial a, ahon gensiat chiang un leng na thil hoih hih amuhte uh ziak in veh a a-om chiang un Pathian apahtawi thei ding uhi.
Toupa ziak in mihing dan bawl peuhmah ah lut un; thuneihna tawi kumpipa kiang ah hiam,
thil hihkhialte tung a thuk ding leh thil hoih hihte phat ding a kumpipa'n aseh gam ukpate thunuai ah lut un.
Hiai Pathian deihlam ahi, mihaite haina thil hoih hih in na hihdai thei ding uhi.
Noplen na hi ua, himahleh na noplenna uh khelhna khuhna ding a zang lou in Pathian sikha a omna ding in zang zaw un.
Mi tengteng zahtak un. Ki-unauna it un. Pathian laudan siam un. Kumpipa pahtawi un.
Sikhate aw, mihoih leh minunnemte lak kia hilou in migiloute lak ah leng laudan siam in nou hon heute thuthu in om un.
Mi'n Pathian theihna ziak in thuak louh ding thuak a lungkhamna athuak teiteileh huai pen Pathian pahtak lam ahi.

Nou na thilhihkhelh ziak ua vuak na thuak un, kuhkaltak in thuak mah le uchin phatna bang na loh ua? Himahleh na thil hoih hih ziak ua na thuak ua, kuhkaltak a na thuak teitei ualeh, hiai pen Pathian kipah lam ahi.
Khrist in leng nou ahon thuaksak ziak in, huai bang hih ding a sap na hi uhi; akhap a na zuihna ding un zuih ding ahon nutsiat ahi.
"Ama'n thil ahihkhial kei a, akam ah khemna leng a-om sam kei."
Enghou a a-om lai in, a-enghou thuk kei a, athuak lai in avau kei hi; diktattak a ngaihtuahpa kiang ah akipe zaw hi.
Khelhna lam a si khin, adiktatna lam a i hintheihna ding in amah mah in tua sing ah asa in i khelhnate apua hi; avuakna golhte ah hihdam in na omta uhi.
Belam mang bang in na mang ua, tu'n zaw nou hon chingpa leh heutupa kiang ah na kik nawnta uhi.
Huchibang in, nou zite aw, noumau pasalte thuthu in om un, huchi in alak ua khenkhat in Pathian thu zui kei mah le uh na tatdan uh zoh in a-om ding uhi.
Laudan siam kawm a na tatdan siangthou uh en in.
Na kivatna uh polam kivatna samphek leh dangka-eng khi-oh hiam, puansilh a kivatte hilou in,
lungtang a mihing thuguk lungsim thunuailut leh nunnem puansilh setheilou a kivat Pathian mitmuh in amanpha mahmah hi.
Huchibang in tuma lam a numei siangthou Pathian gingtate'n leng amau pasalte thuthu a om in akivan uhi.
Sarah in Abraham, toupa chi a athuthu a a-om bang in; thil hoih hih a, khemlauna himhim lau lou a na om uleh Sarah tate na hi ding uhi.

Huchi mah bang in, nou pasalte aw, numei zaw bel kitambaihzaw ahih bang un leh hehpihna hinna tanpihte ahih bang un, theihsiamna toh pahtawidan siam kawm in theihna bang zel in na zite uh kem un, na thumna uh dal a a-omlouhna ding in.
Atawp pen in, na vek un lungsim mun khat in om unla, kilainattuah unla, thunuailut in om un.
Khelhna, khelhna in thuk kei unla, salhna, salhna a thuk sam lou in, vualzawl zaw un. Hiai vualzawlna tang ding a sap na hi uhi.
"Hinna it a nihoihte muh ut in khelhna lak ah alei venghoih henla, amuk leng khemna thu gen lou ding in venghoih hen.
Gilou nungngatsan in thil hoih hih henla; kituahna zong in delh zel hen.
Midiktatte tung ah Toupa mit atu a, abil in leng athumna lam uah adoh zel hi, himahleh Toupa mel in thil hihkhialte adou nak," chih gelh ahi.
Thil hoih lam a phatuam na ngaih uleh na poikhoih ding uh kua a-om dia?
Himahleh diktatna ziak a na thuakta bang na hih uleh, na hampha ding uhi. Akihtakhuaina uh kihta kei un.
Himahleh na lungtang uah Toupa in Khrist bawl un; noumau a om, na lametpen uh hon dong peuhmah dawng ding in mansa gige in thunuailuttak leh laudan siam kawm in om un;
sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei un, huchi in nou ahon gensiatna lam uah, Khrist a na omdan hoih uh gen thanghuaite hih zahlak in a-om ding uhi.
Thil gilou hih ziak a thuak sang in Pathian hoihsak lam ahihleh thil hoih hih ziak a thuak ahoihzaw hi.
Pathian kiang a hon pitheihna ding in Khrist in leng khelhnate a ding in khatvei athuakta hi, midiktat in midiktatloute sik in athuak a; sa ah sihsak in a-om a, Kha ah hinsak in a-omta hi.
Huai kha in suangkul a kha omte kiang ah thu ava tangkoupih hi.
Huai mite'n nidanglai a Noah dam lai a long bawl sung teng a, Pathian thuakzohna in angak lai in thu amang kei ua; huai long ah mi tawmchik, mi giat lel tui a pan humbit in a-om uhi.
Huan huai tui in Jesu Khrist thohnawnna ziak a hotdamna baptisma lim hon ensak a, huai tuh pumpi nitna siansakna dan hilou in, sia-le-pha theihna siansakna ziak a Pathian kiang naihna ahi zaw hi.
Amah van a pai in Pathian taklam ah a-om a; angelte, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate amah thuthu a omsak in a-omta hi.
Huchi in Khrist in taksa a athuak ziak in nou leng huchibang lungsim in kivan un; sa a thuak khinsa in gilou atawpsanta hi.
Huchi in tunung sa a om lai teng mihing duhgawlna lam bang a om lou in, Pathian deihlam in a-omta hi.
Zentelte ut lam hihna, huknate, tak taksa utnate, uain hainate, zu khamnate, milim biakna kihhuaitakte tuma lam a hihsa teng i na zang khin ngal a.
Huai a amau nuambawl luatna bang a noute'n tu a na bawl sam louh uh lamdang asa ua, nou ahon gense nak uhi.
Amau mihing leh misite ngaihtuah ding a mansa kiang ah atanchin uh agen ding uhi.
Hiai ziak in ahi, misite kiang a leng tanchinhoih gen a hih, sa a om mihingte bang a ngaihtuah in om mah le uh, kha a bel Pathian bang a ahintheihna ding un.
Himahleh thil tengteng tawpna anaita, huaiziak in na thumtheihna ding un lungsim diktak pu in pilvang un.
Bangdang teng sang in phatuamngaitak in ki-ittuah chiat unla; itna in gilou tampi akhuh zel hi.
Phun lou in kizintun tuah unla;
michih in thilpiak na muh bang zel un, Pathian hehpihna chiteng kemhoihte bang in huaite in nna kisepsaktuah chiat un.

Mi kuapeuh in thu agenleh Pathian thute bang in gen hen; mi kuapeuh in nna asepleh Pathian in hatna apiak bang in sem hen; huchi in Jesu Khrist ziak in thil bangkim ah Pathian pahtawi in a-om thei ding, thupina leh vaihawmna tangtawn in amah a ahi, Amen.
Deihtakte aw, na lak ua ze-etna thupitak hong om, noumau ze-etna ding a na tung ua hong tung, thillamdang na tung ua tung bang in lamdang sa kei un.
Khrist thuaknate thuakpihte na hihdan bang zel un kipak zaw un; huchi in athupina a ahong kilak chiang in noumau leng nuamtak in na kipak thei ding uhi.
Khrist min ziak a tai na hih uleh, na hampha uhi; na tung uah thupina kha leh Pathian kha a-om gige hi.
Himahleh na lak uah kuamah in tualthatmi ahih ziak hiam, midangte thilhih gensakmi ahih ziak hiam in thuak kei hen.
Himahleh, Khristian ahih ziak a athuakleh zum kei hen; huai min pu ahih ziak in Pathian pahtawi zaw hen.
Pathian inkuanpihte ah vai-hawmna pat ahunta hi; huan eite ngei a apan masakleh Pathian tanchinhoih thumangloute tawpna bangchi phet ahi diam aw?
Huan, "Midiktat nangawn hotdam liailiai ahih in, Pathian limsak lou leh migiloute koi ah bang asuak ding ua?"
Huaiziak in Pathian hoihsak bang a thuakte'n thil hoih hih in akhate uh Siampa muanhuaitak kiang ah kemsak hen.
Huchi in na lak ua saptuam upate kei na upatpih uh, Khrist thuaknate theipa leh thupina hong lang ding tang sam ding in hiai bang in ka hon hanthawn hi:
Na lak ua Pathian belamhonte ching unla, enkol un, sawl teitei ziak hilou in, Pathian hon deihna bang hi zaw in, punna thanghuai deih ziak hilou in, kithalawptak zaw in,
na tante uh tung ah kiliansak tuan lou in belamhonte zuih ding a kibawl zaw in, kem un.
Huchi in Belamchingpa lianpen ahong lat chiang in, Thupina Lallukhu tul thei lou na mu ding uhi.

Huchi mah bang in, nou valnoute aw, upate nuai ah lut un. Ahi, na vek ua nna kisepsaktuah chiat ding in thunuailutna in kithuam un; "Pathian in kisatheite adou a, kingaineute bel hehpihna ape nak hi."
Huaiziak in ahuntak a nou ahon pahtawi theihna ding in, Pathian khut hattak nuai ah kihihniam un;
ama'n ahon limsak gige ziak in na mangbatna tengteng uh amah tung ah nga vek un.
Pilvang unla, limsak un; na melma uh diabol, humpinelkai humham bang in anawmvalh ding zong in avialvak hi.
Na unau uh khovel a omte tung ah huchibang thuaknate atung sam chih thei in gingkiptak a om in, amah dou un.
Huan hehpihna tengteng Pathian, atangtawn thupina tang ding a Khrist a nou hon sampa ngei in, sawt lou kal na thuak nung un ahoih bukim a hon bawl in, hon hihkip in, ahon hihhat ding hi.
Amah kiang ah vaihawmna tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
Ka unaupa muanhuaitak Silvanas khut in, noumau hanthawn leh huai Pathian hehpihna taktak ahi chih thei in, tomchik in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi; huaite ah dingkip un.
Babulon a om noumau bang a telnu'n chibai ahon buk hi; huchibang in ka tapa Marka in leng chibai ahon buk ahi.
Itna kitawpna a tawp in chibai kibuk un, na lak ua Khrist a om peuhmahte kiang ah khamuanna om hen, Amen.
Ephraim tanggam Ramathaim-zophim ah mi khat a-om a, amin Elkanah ahi a, amah Jeroham tapa, Elihu tapa, Tohu tapa, Ephraim mi Zuph tapa ahi.
Ama'n zi nih anei a, akhat min Hannah ahi, akhat min Peninnah ahi. Peninnah in tate anei a, Hannah in bel tate anei kei hi.
Huai mi akhua ua kipan Shiloh ah Sepaihte' TOUPA houpih ding leh kithoih ding in kum teng in ahohtou hi. Huai ah Eli tapate nih, Hophni leh Phinehas, TOUPA siampute a-om uhi.
Elkanah kithoih ni ahong tun in, azi Peninnah leh atapate leh atanute tengteng tantuan abawlsak hi.
Hannah tan nih abawlsak a, Hannah lah a-it mahmah ngal a. Himahleh TOUPA'N asul akhaksak hi.
TOUPA'N asul akhaksak ziak in alangnu'n alungkhamsak nak hi.
Huchibang a kum teng a ahih ziak in TOUPA inn ahohtouh teng in alungkhamna atokthou nak hi. Huchi in akapkap a, an leng ane kei.
Apasal Elkanah in akiang ah, "Hannah, bang achia ahia na kah? Bang achia an ne lou na hia? Bang achia lungkham na hia? Tapa sawm sang in nang a ding in ka hoihzaw kei a hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Shiloh a anek ua adawn khit un Hannah adingh a, siampu Eli TOUPA tempul kong khuambul a atutna ah atu hi,
Hannah lungsim haksa mahmah in a-om a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a, khase mahmah in akap hi.

Thu achiam a, "Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, na sikhanu gimna en a, na hon theihgige a, na sikhanu na hon mangngilh louh a, na sikhanu tapa na piakleh adamsung teng TOUPA ka pe dia, alu ah mulmetna zat ahi kei ding,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA ma a athum san lai in Eli in amuk-phun ana chiamteh hi.
Hannah in alungtang in agen a, amuk kia atangsak a, a-aw bel zak ahi kei hi. Huaiziak in Eli in zukham asa hi.
Huchi in Eli in akiang ah, "Bang tan ahia kham a na om nilouh ding? Na uain koihmang in," achi hi.
Hannah in, "Kham kei veng e, ka toupa. Lungsim lungkham mahmah numei ka hi. Uain leng, zu chik leng ka dawn kei, TOUPA ma ah ka lungsim ka suahkhia ahi zaw.
Na sikhanu Belial tanu in hon ngoh het ke'n. Ka lungsim a dimlet lunggimna leh ka lungkhamna genkhia ka hi zaw hi,” chi in adawng hi.
Eli in, "Lungmuangtak in pai in, Israelte' Pathian in na thilnget nang hon pia hen," chi in adawng hi.
Ama'n, "Na sikhanu na mitmuh in deihsakna musak in," achi hi. Huchi in numei apaita a, an ane a, lungkham mel aputa kei hi.
Zingsangpi in athou ua, TOUPA abia ua, apai ua, Ramah a a-inn uh atung nawnta uh. Elkanah in azi Hannah akithuahpih a, TOUPA'N amah atheigige hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hannah in nau apai a, ahun ahong tun in tapa anei hi. "TOUPA ka nget ziak in," chi in amin Samuel asa hi.
Huchi in Elkanah leh a-inkote tengteng TOUPA ma a kum teng a akithoihna uh lan ding leh athuchiam uh tangtun ding in ahong paitou uhi.

Hannah bel ahohtou kei hi. Apasal kiang ah, "Kei zaw naupang in nawinek atawp masiah ka hohtou kei ding. Huai hun chiang in TOUPA ma a akilat theihna ding in ka pi ding. Huai ah a-om nilouhta ding," achi hi.

Apasal Elkanah in akiang ah, "Hoih ding na chih bang zel in hih in. Anawinek na tawpsak tan in om in. Himahleh TOUPA'N athu hihkip lel hen," achi hi. Huchi in nawinek atawp masiah huai ah numei a-om a, atapa nawinek atawp masiah nawi anesak hi.
Nawinek atawptak in, tangbuang ephah khat leh uain thawl khat tawi in bawngtal kum thum a upa toh Shiloh a TOUPA inn ah ata naupang chik paipih in, apitou hi.
Bawngtal khat gou in, naupang Eli kiang ah api uhi.
Ama'n, "Toupa, na hin bang in ka gen ahi, kei zaw, aw toupa, hiai lai a na kiang a dingh a TOUPA kiang a thum numei ka hi.
Hiai naupang ngen in ka thum a, TOUPA'N ka nget ahon peta.
Huaiziak in ke'n leng TOUPA kiang ah ka lan hi. Adamsung teng TOUPA a dia lat ahi," achi hi. Huai ah ama'n TOUPA abia hi.
Huai khit in Samuel in sathau bawm lakhia in alu ah asung a, atawp a, "TOUPA'N agoutante tung a heutu ding a sathau hon nilh ahi kei maw?

Tuni a na hon nutsiat chiang in Zelzah ah Benjamin gamgi a Rakil han kiang ah mi nih na mu dia; amau na kiang ah, 'Na sabiltung zonte amuta uh. Ngai in, na pa'n sabiltungte lungkhampih nawn lou in, nang hon lungkhampihta hi. Ka tapa a ding in bang ka hih dia, chichi ahi, achi ding uh'.

Huai a pan pai zel inla, Tabor tosaw na va tung ding a, huai ah mi thum Bethel a Pathian kiang a hohtou dingte'n hon na kituahpih ding uh. Khat in kelnou apom dia, khat in tanghou pek khal thum atawi dia, khat in uain thawl atawi ding hi.
"Chibai ahon buk ding ua, tanghou pek khal nih ahon pe ding ua; huai na la ding ahi.

Huai khit in Philistia sepaihte omna Pathian mual na va tung ding ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, huai khua na va tun chiang in zawlnei pawl khat ama ua pekgingte, khuangtate, tamngaite leh kaihgingte tawimi pawl toh mun sang a pan hong paikhesuk na tuak dia, amaute'n thu agen ding uhi.
Na tung ah TOUPA Kha nakpitak in ahong tung ding a, nang leng amau toh thu na gen dia, huchi in mituam na suak ding hi.
" 'Hiai chiamtehnate na tung a ahong tun chiang in, thil hong om in azil dungzui in na hih ding ahi. Pathian lah na kiang ah a-om ngal a.

Kei ma in Gilgal ah hohsuk in. Ngai in, kei leng halmang thillatte leh lemna kithoihnate lan ding in na kiang ah ka hong suk ding.' Na kiang a ka hong a, na hih ding ka hon hilh ma ni sagih na taam ding," achi hi.
Huchibang ahong hi ngei a, Samuel paisan dia anungngattak in Pathian in lungtang dang apeta hi. Huai chiamtehna tengteng huai ni in ahong tung vek hi.
Huchi in mual ahong tun uleh, ngai in, zawlneite'n ana kituahpih uhi. Atung ah TOUPA Kha nakpitak in ahong tung a, athugenna uah amah leng atel samta hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, tuma lam a amah ana theisate'n zawlneite thugenna ah atel sam chih atheih un, akihou ua, "Kish tapa tung a thil hong om bangchidan ahita a? Saul leng zawlneite lak a tel samta ahi maw?" akichi uhi.
A-omna khua ua mi khat in adawng a, "Apa uh kua ahi tuan a ahia?" achi hi. Huchi in Saul leng zawlnei ahi samta maw? chih paunak ahong hita hi.
Athugen khit in mun sang atungta hi.
Saul paneu in akiang ah leh asikha kiang ah, "Koi a hoh na hi ua?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Sabiltung zong ka hi uh. Ka muh zoh louh ziak un Samuel kiang ah ka va hoh uhi," achi hi.
Saul paneu in, "Samuel in na kiang ua bang ahia agen hon hilh dih," achi hi.
Saul in apaneu kiang ah, "Sabengtungte amuta uh chih ahon hilh hi,” achi hi. Himahleh lalgam thu Samuel in agen pen ahilh kei hi.
Huchi in Samuel in mipite Mizpah ah TOUPA mai ah asamkhawm hi.
Huai ah Israel suante kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Israelte Aigupta a pan ka pikhia a, Aigupta mite khut a pan leh nou hon nuaisiah gam tengteng a pan ka hon hunkhia hi.

Himahleh tuni in na mangbatna tengteng uleh na gimthuakna tengteng ua kipan nou hon humbitpa na Pathian uh na deih kei uh. Akiang ah, 'Ahi kei, kumpipa hon bawlsak in,' na chi uh. Huaiziak in tu in anam a nam leh achi a chỉ in TOUPA ma ah hong kilang un" achi hi.
Huchi a Samuel in Israel chi tengteng ahong kilat naisaktak in Benjamin chitel ahong hita.
Benjamin chite bel a-inkuankuan in ahong kilak ua, Matri mite inkuan tel ahong hi a, Kish tapa Saul tel ahong hita hi. Amah azon uleh amuzou kei uh.
Huaiziak in TOUPA adong tuan nawn ua, "Hiai mi hong pai nai lou hiam," achi uh. TOUPA'N adawng a, "Ngai un, van lak ah akibu hi," achi hi.
Huchi in atai ua, ava pikhia ua, mipi lak a adinleh mi lak ah asangpen a, kuamah aliangzang khengzou a-om kei uhi.
Samuel in mi tengteng kiang ah, "TOUPA miseh na mu uhia? Mi tengteng lak ah amah bang mahmah a-om kei," achi hi. Mite akikou ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen," achi uhi.
Huchi in Samuel in mipite lalgam omdan ding ahilh hi. Laibu ah agelh a, TOUPA ma ah akoih hi. Samuel in mite amau inn chiat ah apaisakta hi.
Saul leng Gibeah a a-inn ah apai sam hi. Pathian in alungtang uh akhoih mihangsante leng amah toh apaikhawm uhi.
Himahleh Belial tapate'n, "Hiai mi'n bangchi in ahon hondam thei mahmah dia?" chi in amah angaineu ua, thilpiak ahong pe kei uh. Himahleh amah bel adai dide hi.
Huchi in Ammon mi Nahash ahong kisa a, Jabesh-gilead sual tum in ava giahkhum hi. Jabesh mi tengteng in Nahash kiang ah, "Kou toh thukhun bawl in, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," achi uh.
Ammon mi Nahash in akiang uah, "Hichibang in ahi nou toh thu ka khun ding. Na mit taklam tengteng uh khelkhiak vek ahi dia; huai Israel mi tengteng minsiatna dia koih ahi ding," achi hi.
Jabesh khua upate'n akiang ah, "Israel gam tengteng a thupo mite ka sawltheihna ding un ni sagih sung hon hungaih in. Hon hondam ding kuamah a-om keileh na kiang ah ka hong paikhe ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in huai thupo mite Saul omna khua Gibeah ahong tung uhi. Mite bil azak in huai thute agen ua; mite aw suah in akap uhi,
Ngai in, lou a pan bawng hawl in Saul ahong pai hi. Saul in, "Bang achi ua ahia mite akah uh?" achi hi. Jabesh a mite thugen ahilh uhi.
Huai thu azaktak in Saul tung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung a nakpitak in ahehta hi.

Huchi in bawngtal nih ala a, asemnen vek hi. Israel gam tengteng ah thupo mite ahawmsak a, "Kuapeuh Saul leh Samuel zui nuam lou peuhmah hiai bawngtal bang a hih ahi ding," achi hi. Huchi in mipite'n TOUPA alau ua, thukhat sat in ahong kuankheta uh.
Bezek ah amaute asim a, Israel mite nuaithum ahi uh. Judah mite singthum ahi uh.

Ahong pai thupo mite kiang ah, "Jabesh-gilead mite kiang ah, zingchiang in nisat san laitak mah in hotkhiak na hi ding uh va chi un," achi hi. Thupo mite ava hoh ua, Jabesh mite ahilh ua, huchi in akipak mahmah uhi.
Huchi in Jabesh mite'n, "Zingchiang in na kiang uah ka hong pawtkhe ding ua, ka tung uah na ut-ut un hih mai un," achi uhi.

Hichi ahong hi a, azing in Saul in mipite pawl thum in akoih a, zing ven hun laitak in agiahmun uah alut uhi. Ammon mite sun nisat san lai tan in athat uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, athahvalte adalhzak vek ua, nih a omkhawm himhim leng a-om kei uhi.
Mipite'n Samuel kiang ah, "Kuate ahia, Saul in i tung uah vai ahawm tel ding maw chi? Huai mite hon pi in ka that ding uh," achi uhi.
Saul in, "Tuni chitchiat in zaw kuamah that kei un. Tuni in TOUPA'N Israelte lak ah hotdamna abawlta ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel in mipite kiang ah, "Kisa dih uh, Gilgal ah i hoh ding ua, huai ah lalgam i thaksak nawn ding uh," achi hi.

Huchi in mite tengteng Gilgal ah ahohta uhi. Saul Gilgal ah TOUPA ma ah kumpipa in abawlta uhi. Huai ah TOUPA ma ah lemna kithoihnate alan uhi. Huchi in huai ah Saul leh Israel mi tengteng akipak mahmah uhi.
Huan Samuel in Israel mi tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai dih ua, ka kiang a na thugen tengteng uh ngaikhia in, na tung uah kumpipa ka bawlta hi.
Tu in, ngai dih ua, kumpipa in na ma uh akai hi. Kei zaw tek in ka sam leng akangta hi. Ngai dih ua, na kiang uah ka tapate a-om uh. Ka naupan a pan tutan na ma uh ka hon pi hi.

Hiai ah ka om hi. TOUPA ma leh asathau nilhpa ma ah hon sel un. Kua bawngtal ka suh ngei a? Kua sabiltung ahia ka suh ngei? Kua ka khem ngei a? Kua ka hihgenthei ngei a? Ka mit tawsak ding in kua a pan in golhna ka la ngei a? K'on din nawn vek ding," achi hi.
Amau, "Na hon khem ngei kei a, n'on hihgenthei ngei sam kei. Kuamah khut a pan lak tuak louh leng na la ngei kei," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka khut ah bangmah kilawm lou na mu kei uh, chih tuni in TOUPA na lak uah theihpihpa ahi a; asathau nilhpa atheipihpa ahi," achi hi. Amau, "Amah hon theipihpa ahi," achi uhi.
Samuel in mite kiang ah, "Mosi leh Aaron seppa leh Aigupta a pan na pipute uh pikhepa TOUPA ahi.
Huchi in dingh kinken unla, TOUPA ma ah TOUPA'N na tung uh leh na pipute uh tung a thil dik ana hihte ka hon sutpih ding.
Aigupta gam a Jakob alut nung in, na pipute un TOUPA asam ua, huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron asawl hi. Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a pan apikhia a, hiai mun ah atengsak hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA a Pathian uh amangngilh uh. Ama'n Hazor sepaih heutu Sisera khut, Philistia mite khut leh Moab kumpipa khut ah akhawng a, amaute'n adou uhi.
"TOUPA asam ua, 'TOUPA i lehngatsan ua, Baal leh Ashtaroth nna i sep ziak un i na khialta uh. Himahleh tu in ka melmate khut a pan hon hunkhia inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh,' achi uh.
TOUPA'N Jerubbaal, Bendan, Jephthah leh Samuel asawl a, khat lam khat lam a na melmate uh khut a pan ahon hunkhia hi. Huchi in bittak in na tengta uhi.
Ammon suante kumpipa Nahash nou dou ding in ahong kuan chih na theihtak un, ka kiang ah, 'Ahi kei, kumpi in ka tung uah vaihawm hen' na chi uh; TOUPA Pathian lah na kumpipa uh ahi gige ngal a.
"Huchi in na kumpipa tel uleh nget uh en dih uh, TOUPA'N kumpipa ahon bawlsakta hi.
TOUPA laudan na siam ua, a-nna na sep ua, a-aw na zuih ua, TOUPA thupiak na helsan louh ua, nou leh na tung ua vaihawm kumpipa toh TOUPA na Pathian uh zuite na hih uleh ahoih ding hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA aw zui lou a, TOUPA thupiak na helsan uleh na pipute un ToUPA khut athuak mah bang un nou leng na thuak ding uhi.
Huchi in ding kinken unla, TOUPA'N na mitmuh ua thil thupitak ahih ding en un.

Tuni in huit buh ala uh ahi kei maw? Van gingsak ding leh vuah zusak ding in TOUPA ka sam ding. Huchi in kumpipa na nget thu uah TOUPA mitmuh a thil na hihkhelh uh athupidan thei in na mu ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel in TOUPA asam a, TOUPA'N huai ni in van agingsak a, vuah azusak hi. Huchi in mite'n TOUPA leh Samuel alau mahmah uhi.

Mi tengteng in Samuel kiang ah, "Ka sihlouhna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah na sikhate hon thumsak in. Hiai thil hoih loutak, kumpipa ka na nget uh, ka gitlouhna tengteng uh behlap ka na hita uh," achi uhi.
Samuel in mite kiang ah, "Lau kei un, hiai thil giloutak na hihta uhi. Himahleh TOUPA na zuih uh pialsan kei unla, na lungtang tengteng un TOUPA nna sem zaw un.
"Lampial kei un. Manna bei thilte leh nou hon hunkhe theiloute zui kei un; amaute bangmah lou ahi ngal ua.
Amin thupitak ziak in TOUPA'N amite alehngatsan kei dia; amah mite hi ding a noute hon bawl TOUPA kipah lam ahi.
Huai phet leng ahi kei a, nou a dia thum tawp in TOUPA tung ah thil ka hihkhial het kei ding. Himahleh lampi hoih leh dik ka hon kawkmuh zaw ding ahi.
TOUPA laudan siam photphot un. Na lungtang tengteng un chihtaktak in amah nna sem unla; nou a dia athilhih thupitakte ngaihtuah un.
Himahleh giloutak a thil na hih lailai uleh nou leh na kumpipa uh na mangthang ding uh," achi hi.
Saul kum sawmthum ahih in vaihawm apan a; Israelte tung ah kum nih vai ahawm in,

Saul in Israelte lak ah mi sangthum atel hi. Huai teng lak a sangnih Mikmash ah leh Bethel tang ah Saul kiang ah a-om uh. Sangkhat Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah Jonathan kiang ah a-om uh. Adang teng apuanin uah apaisak vek hi.
Jonathan in Gibeah a om Philistia galvil sepaihte ava sual hi. Huai Philistia mite'n ana za uhi. Huchi in Saul in, "Hebru mite'n na za uhen," chi in agam tengteng ah pengkul amutsak hi.
Israel tengteng in, Saul in Philistia galvil sepaihte asual chih leh Israelte'n leng Philistia mite huat in a-om uh chih thute ana zata uh. Huchi in mite Saul kiang ah Gilgal ah akikaikhawm uhi.

Philistia mite Israelte sual ding in akikaikhawm uhi. Kangtalai singthum, sakol tungtuangmi sangguk, mihing tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah a tam ahi uh. Huchi in akuantou ua, Beth-aven suahlam pang ah Mikmash ah panmun akhoh uhi.
Israel mite'n umbit in a-om uh chih akitheih un, mite lah alunghimoh mahmahta ua, mite kokhuk ah, lounok ah, suangpi pang ah, kulh ah leikohawm ah akibu uhi.
Hebru mi khenkhatte Jordan gal ah Gad leh Gilead gam ah atai uhi. Saul bel Gilgal ah a-om lailai a, mite'n ling kawmkawm in amah azui uhi.
Samuel hun seh bang in ni sagih ataam hi. Himahleh Samuel lah Gilgal ah ahong pai kei hi. Huchi in mite'n ataizaksanta uh.
Saul in, "Haltum thillat ding leh lemna thillat dingte hiai ah ka kiang ah hon la un," achi hi. Huchi in halmang thillat alan hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, halmang thillat alan khin lel a, ngai in, Samuel ahong tung hi. Amah mu ding in Saul akuan hi. Samuel in, "Bang na hih na hia?" achi hi.
Saul in, "Mite'n ahon paimangsan khin ua, nang lah niseh ni in na hong tungta kei hi. Philistia mite lah Mikmash ah akikaikhawm uh chih ka thei hi.
Huaiziak in 'Philistia mite'n Gilgal ah hon sual dekdek uhi. TOUPA hehpihna lah ka ngen nai kei a,' ka chi hi. Huaiziak in halmang thillat lan lou thei ka hi kei,” achi hi.
Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Na thilhih ahaihuai mahmah hi. TOUPA na Pathian thupiak, nang thu ahon piak na zui kei hi. TOUPA'N Israelte tung ah na lalna tangtawn a hihkip tum zaw hiven maw,
Himahleh na lalna amongta ding; TOUPA'N thu ahon piak na zuih louh ziak in TOUPA'N ama lungtang bang pumi azong a, mite tung a heutu ding in TOUPA'N amah asepta hi," achi hi.
Samuel athou a, Gilgal a pan Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah ahohtou hi. Saul in akiang a mi omte asim a, zaguk tak ahi uh.
Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh akiang ua mi omte Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah a-om uh. Himahleh Philistia mite'n Mikmash ah panmun akhoh uhi.
Lok mite Philistia mite panmun a pan pawl thum ahong kuan ua, pawl khat in Shual gam a Ophrah lam zuan lampi azui uhi.
Pawl khat in Beth-horon lam zuan lampi azui ua, pawl dang in gamdai zul Zeboim Phaizang lam zuan gamgi lampi azui uhi.
Philistia mite'n, "Hebru mite'n namsau hiam, tei hiam abawl kha zenzen ding uh," achih ziak un Israel gam pumpi ah siksekmi akimu kei hi.
Himahleh Israel mi tengteng, michih aleilehna, asuanggal, aheipi, atupi tat-hiam ding in, Philistiate kiang ah ahohsuk zel uhi.
Himahleh tupite, suanggalte, sikkhutte leh heipite tat-hiamna ding sik-hat leh chiang mukzumte bawlna ding anei uhi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, akidou ni un Saul leh Jonathan kiang a om mite'n namsau hiam, tei hiam anei kei uh. Saul leh atapa Jonathan in bel anei uhi.
Philistia galvil sepaihte Mikmash kuam ah apaikheta uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni khat Saul tapa Jonathan in agalvan tawipa tangval kiang ah, "Kisa dih, gal langkhat a Philistia mi galvil sepaihte omna ah i va hoh ding," achi hi. Himahleh apa ahilh kei hi.
Saul bel Gibeah gam tawp lam pek a Migron a theibuhfai kung nuai ah a-om hi. Akiang a om mite zaguk ahi uh.
Shiloh a TOUPA siampu Eli tapa Phinehas tapa Ikabod unaupa Ahitub tapa Ahijah siampu puanak silh a-om hi. Jonathan ahoh chih mipite'n athei kei uhi.
Jonathan in Philistia mi galvil sepaihte omna a hoh atupna phaizang leh phaizang kikal ah alang tuaktuak ah suangpi sangtak a-om hi. Akhat min Bozez ahi a, akhat min Seneh ahi.
Suangpi sang khat pen Mikmash zawn mallam a om ahi a, adang khat pen Gebeah zawn simlam a om ahi.

Jonathan in agalvan tawipa tangval kiang ah, "Kisa dih, zeksum louh sepaihte omna ah i va hoh ding. TOUPA'N thil ahon hihsak kha mai hiam. TOUPA a ding in atam hiam, atawm hiam ahotdamna ding bangmah dalna a-om tuan ngal kei a," achi hi.
Agalvan tawipa'n akiang ah, "Na lungsim a om bangtak in hih in. Ngai in, na lungsim bang geih ka lungsim ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Jonathan in, "Kisa in, akiang uah i va hoh galkah dia, i va kimusak ding.
I kiang a, 'Na kiang ua ka hong matan uh na om un, ahon chih uleh i mun ah i dingh kinken dia, akiang uah i hohtou kei ding.'
"Ka kiang lam uah hong tou un, achih uleh bel i hohtou dia, TOUPA'N i khut ah amaute ahon pia chih ei a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding," achi hi.
Anih un Philistia mi galvil sepaihte ava kimusak uhi. Philistiate'n, "En dih uh, Hebru mite abukna leihawm a pan ahong paikhia uh," achi uhi.

Galvil sepaihte omna a mite'n Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa, "Hong paitou unla, thil banghiam ka hon ensak ding uh," chi in ana sam uhi. Jonathan in agalvan tawipa kiang ah, "Hon zuitou dih. TOUPA'N amaute Israelte khut ah apeta hi," achi hi.
Jonathan akhut leh khe toh pang in akaltou a, agalvan tawipa'n azui hi. Amau bel Jonathan ma ah apuk ua, ama nung in agalvan tawipa'n amaute athat hi.
Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa'n athah masakpen uh mi sawmnih vel, lou chiing khat, bawngtal nih leilehna chia sung ahi.
Giahmun leh gamlak a mipi tengteng aling ua; galvil sepaihte leh lok mite leng aling sam uh. Huan ziin ahong ling a; huchi in nakpitak a linna a-om hi.
Benjamin gam Gibeah ah Saul galvil mite'n a-en vialvial uhi. Ngai in, mipite zul in azulkhe zungzung ua, khat lam khat lam ah akiphutuah muimui uhi.
Huchi in Saul in akiang a mipi omte kiang ah, "Tu in kisim unla, kuate ahia kim lou hong ki-en dih ua," achi hi. Ahong kisim uleh ngai in, Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa ana om kei uhi.
Saul in Ahijah kiang ah, "Pathian bawm va la dih," achi hi. Huai lai in Pathian bawm Israel suante kiang a om ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul in siampu ahoupih laitak in Philistia mite giahmun lam a thawmging angaih semsem hi. Saul in siampu kiang ah, "Na khut kaikik in," achi hi.
Huchi in Saul leh akiang a mipi om tengteng apaikhawm ua, kidouna ah ahohta uh. Ngai in, amau leh amau namsau in ana kisattuah ua, huchi in apumbuai uhi.
Hiai ban ah tuma lam a Hebru mite huai gam kim a pan Philistiate giahmun a amau toh va paitoute leng Saul leh Jonathan kiang a om in Israel mite lam ah ahong pang nawnta uhi,
Huchi mah bang in Ephraim tanggam a Israel mi kibu tengteng in Philistia mite ataimang uh chih ana za ua, amau leng kidouna a pang sam in adelhzui uhi.
Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA'N Israelte ahumbitta hi. Beth-aven pha in asual uhi.

Huai ni in Israel mite alungkia ua, Saul in, "Ka melmate tung a phu ka lakna dia nitaklam ahih masiah kuapeuh in an anekleh hamsia thuak hen," achih ziak in. Huchi in kuamah in an himhim achiam kei uhi.
Mipi tengteng gamnuai ava tung ua, lei ah khuaizu ana om hi.
Mipite gamnuai ava tun un, ngai in, khuaizu ana takkhia hi. Himahleh mipite'n hamsia alauh ziak un kuama'n khut a sawk in achiam ngam kei uhi.
Himahleh apa'n mipite kichiam a, vau ahih lam Jonathan in thei lou in akhut a chiangmong in khuaikhak adawt a, akam a guang in aneta a, huchi in amit hah ahong chiangta hi.
Mipi lak a mi khat in ahoupih a, "Na pa'n zaw mipite tuni a an ne peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen, chi a vau bikbek hiven. Huchi in mipite abah uhi,” achi hi.
Jonathan in, "Ka pa'n mite buaisak lel ahi ve. Enta unla, khuaizu tawmchik ka chep ziak lel a ka mit ahong vak takdan.
Mipite'n gallak thil amuh peuhpeuh uh tuni in a-utut uh ne thei le uh vakzaw na tel in chia! Huaiziak in Philistiate tamsem thah louh loh i hi ve ua,” achi hi.
Huai ni in Mikmash a pan Aijalon tan in Philistia mite adou uh. Huchi in mipite abah mahmah uhi.
Mipite'n agallak thil uh aboh in aboh uhi. Belamte, bawngtalte leh bawngnoute aman ua, leitual ah athat ua, mipite'n asisan toh ane uhi.
"Ngai in, mipite'n sisan toh ne in TOUPA tung ah akhialta uh," chi in Saul ahilh uhi. Ama'n, "Na talekta uhi; ka ma ah suang lianpi khuk un," achi hi.

Saul in, "Mipi lak ah vakzak vek unla, akiang uah, michih in abawng hon kai hen. Michih in abelam hon kai hen. Hiai ah hong gou in ne hen. Asisan toh ne a TOUPA tung a thil hihkhial lou in, va chi un," achi hi. Huai zan in mi tengteng in amau bawngtal chiat uh ahon kai ua, huai ah agou uhi.
Saul in TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a; huai pen TOUPA a dia maitam abawl masakpen ahi.

Saul in, "Zan chiang in Philistia mite va dou unla, zing khovak tan in i sual ding uh. Kuamah i hawi kei ding uh," achi hi. Amau, "Hoih na sak peuhmah hih in," achi uh. Siampu in ahihleh, "Pathian naih ni," achi hi.
Saul in Pathian adong a, "Philistia mite ka va sual diam? Israelte khut ah amaute na pe diam?" achi hi. Himahleh huai ni'n adawng kei.
Saul in, "Nou mipi heutu tengteng hong nai dih ua. Tuni in akoi pen ah ahia i khelh uh theihkhiak tum dih uh.
Israelte hondam zelpa TOUPA ahin lai teng ka tapa Jonathan hilhial in ana hihkhelhleh amah asih ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi. Himahleh mipi lak a mi kuamah adawng himhim a-om kei uh.
Israel tengteng kiang ah, "Noute atuam in omkhawm unla, kei leh ka tapa Jonathan atuam in ka omkhawm ding uh," achi hi. Mipite'n Saul kiang ah, "Hoih na sak bang in hih in," achi uhi.
Saul in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian kiang ah, "Adiktak hon hihlang in," achi a, aisan pen Jonathan leh Saul tung ah apuk a; mipite bel ahul uhi.
Saul in, "Kei leh ka tapa kikal ah aisan un," achi hi. Huchi in Jonathan tung ah apuk hi.
Saul in Jonathan kiang ah, "Bang ahia na hih hon hilh in," achi hi. Jonathan in ahilh a, "Ka chiang tawi mong in khuaizu neuchik ka na chiam hi. Ngai in, ka sih ding mah ahi," achi hi.
Saul in, "Pathian in ahihhih in hih mai hen. Huai sang a thupizaw in leng. Jonathan, na si ngeingei ding ahi," achi hi.

Mipite'n Saul kiang ah, "Israelte lak a hiai hotdamna thupi mahmah hihpa Jonathan asi dia hia? Si lou hial ding. TOUPA ahin lai teng asamzang khat leng lei ah ake het kei ding. Tuni in Pathian toh asemkhawm uhi," achi uh. Mipite'n Jonathan ahondam ua, asi kei hi.
Saul in Philistia mite adelh lai akiksanta a, Philistia mite amau om mun ah apaita uhi.
Saul in Israelte tung ah vaihawmna ala a, aning teng ah amelmate, Moab, Ammon suante, Edom, Zobah kumpipate leh Philistia mite adou a; akiheina peuh ah avualzou zel hi.
Hangsantak in gal adou a, Amalekte azou a, alok mite khut a pan Israelte ahonkhia hi.
Saul tapate bel Jonathan, Ishvi leh Malki-shua ahi ua, atanu nihte min hiaite ahi; a-upazaw min Merab ahi a, anaupangzaw min Mikal ahi.
Saul zi min Ahinoam ahi a, amah Ahimaaz tanu ahi. Asepaih heutu min Abner ahi a, amah Saul paneu Ner tapa ahi.
Saul pa Kish ahi a, Abner pa Ner bel Abiel tapa ahi.
Saul damsung teng in Philistia mite toh nakpitak in akidou uhi. Saul in mihat leh hangsan amuh peuhmah anuai a sem ding in ala zel hi.
Huan Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "TOUPA'N amite tung ah, Israelte tung ah kumpipa dia nang sathau hon nilh dia ahon sawl ka hi. Huaiziak in tu in TOUPA thugen ngaikhia in.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, Amalek mite'n Israelte tung a athilhih uh, Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai ua lampi a ana daldan ka theigige hi.

Amalekte dou ding in kuan inla, athil neih tengteng uh hawi himhim nei lou in hihmang vek in. Numei leh pasal, naungek leh nawi ne lai, bawngtal leh belam, sangawngsau leh sabiltung tan in that vek in, achi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Saul in mipite asamkhawm a, Telaim ah amaute asim a, sepaih nuainih leh Judah mi singkhat ahi uh.
Saul Amalekte khua atungsuk a, phaizang ah ana buk hi.

Saul in Kente kiang ah, "Hong pawt unla, Amalekte a pan kihuikhia un. Huchi lou in zaw, ka hon that tel kha ding. Nou zaw Israel suan tengteng Aigupta a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai un na na hehpih ua," achi hi. Huchi in Kente Amalek mite lak a pan apawtkhia uhi.
Saul in Amalek mite Havilah a pan Aigupta gam gei a Shur tan in adou hi.
Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ahingmat a, mipi tengteng namsau in asatlum vek hi.
Himahleh Saul leh mipite'n Agag ahawi ua, belam leh bawngtal hoihhoih, athauthau, belamnoute, ahoih tengteng athat nuam kei uh. Ahoih lou leh adeih louh peuhmah uh bel athat vek uhi.
TOUPA thu Samuel kiang ah ahong tung hi,
"Saul kumpipa dia ka seh ka kisik hi. Hon zui lai hon kinungngatsan in ka thupiak bang in ahih ngal kei a," achi hi. Hiai in Samuel ahehsak a, zankhua in TOUPA asam hi.
Saul mu ding in Samuel zingkhangpi in athou a, Karmel ah Saul ahoh hi. Ngai in, huai ah amah theihgigena suang aphut a, akik nawn a, apai zel a, Gilgal ah apaisukta, chih Samuel hilh in a-om hi.
Saul kiang Samuel ahong tung a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen. TOUPA thupiak bang in ka hihta," achi hi.
Samuel in, "Tua belam ham ka bil a hong lut leh bawng ham ka zakte bangchidan ahi dia le?" achi hi.
Saul in, "Amalek mite ahon laksak uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian kiang a kithoihna ding in mipite'n belam leh bawngtal hoihhoih ahawi uhi. Adang tengteng ahihleh ka that vek uhi," achi hi.
Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Dai in, TOUPA'N tuzan a ka kiang a athugen ka hon hilh ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Gen dih ve," achi hi.
Samuel in, "Nang ngaih in mi neuchik himah lechin leng, Israel nam heutu dia bawl na hi kei maw? TOUPA'N Israelte kumpipa ding in sathau ahon nilh hi.
TOUPA'N nang ahon sawlkhia a, kuan inla, mikhialte, Amalek mite that vek inla, amanthat sipsip masiah uh dou zel in, ahon chi hi.
Bang ding a TOUPA thu zui lou a, gallak thilte aboh a na boh a, TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih mawk?" achi hi.
Saul in Samuel kiang ah, "E, TOUPA thu ka zui vo oi, TOUPA'N hon sawlna ah ka hoh a, Amalek kumpipa Agag ka hon man a, Amalek mite ka that vek vo oi.
Himahleh mipite'n gallak thil belam leh bawngtal hihman ding lak ah ahoihhoih Gilgal a TOUPA na Pathian kiang a kithoihna ding in ahon tawi uh," achi hi.
Samuel in, "TOUPA'N TOUPA thu zuih makipahpih bang in halmang thillatte leh kithoihnate akipahpih a hia? Ngai in, kithoihna sang in thuman ahoihzaw a, belamtal thau sang in athu man ahoihzaw hi.
Helna zaw aisan khelhna toh akibang a, engtatna zaw milim biakna toh akikim hi. TOUPA thu na nial ziak in ama'n leng kumpipa ding in nang ahon nialta," achi hi.
Saul in Samuel kiangah, "Mipite lau a, athu uh ka manna lam in TOUPA thupiak leh nang thu ka na bohse maizen a; ka na khialta hi.
Huaiziak in tu in ka khelhna ngaidam inla, TOUPA ka biaktheihna ding in kei lam ah hong kihei nawn in," achi hi.
Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "TOUPA thu na nialta a, nang lam ah ka hong kihei nawn kei ding. TOUPA'N Israelte kumpipa ding in ahon deih kei," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel pai dia akiheileh apuan mong ah alen a, akekta hi.
Huchi in Samuel in akiang ah, "Tuni a pan ToUPA'N Israel gam ahon sutta, nang sang a hoihzaw na inveng kiang ah apeta hi.
Israelte thagui azuau kei dia, akisik sam kei ding. Mihing bang a kisik nawn themthum mi ahi ngal kei hi," achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, “Ka na khialta hi. Himahleh ka mite upate leh Israelte ma a hon zahtak ding in ka hon ngen hi. TOUPA na Pathian ka biaktheihna ding in kei lam ah hong kihei in aw," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel in Saul apaipih a, Saul in TOUPA abia hi.
Samuel in, "Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ka kiang ah hon pi un," achi hi. Samuel kiang ah ling kawm in Agag ava hoh hi. Agag in, "Sihna mulkimhuai in hon paikhengta ahi ve," achi hi.
Samuel in, "Na namsau in numeite ta nei lou dia abawl bang in na nu leng numei lak a ta neiloumi ahi ding," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel in Gilgal ah TOUPA ma ah Agag asatzanta hi.
Huchi in Ramah ah Samuel apai a; Saul bel a-inn ah Saul omna khua Gibeah ah apaitou hi.
Huchi in Samuel in asih ni pha in Saul amu nawnta kei hi. Samuel bel Saul ziak in alungkham hi. Israelte kumpipa dia Saul ana tel ziak in TOUPA akisik hi.

Huan TOUPA'N Samuel kiang Huansraelite kummipang ka deih louhsa Saul ziak in bang tan ahia na lungkham ding? Na kii ah sathau thundim inla, kuan in. Bethlehem mi Jesse kiang ah ka hon sawl ding. Atapate lak a mi kumpipa ding in ka sep khinta hi," achi hi.
Samuel in, "Bangchi in ka kuan thei dia? Saul in ana zaleh hon that ding," achi hi. TOUPA'N, "Bawngla hon pi inla, TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia hong ka hi," chi in.
"Kithoihna ah Jesse sam inla, na hih ding ka hon hilh ding. Amin ka hon hilh dingpa sathau hon nilhsak in," achi hi.
