Philistia mite'n Israel mite Mizpah ah a-omkhawm uh chih azak un, Israel mite sual ding in Philistia hausate akisatou ua, Israel mite'n huai ana zak un Philistia mite alauta uhi.
Huchi in Israel mite'n Samuel kiang ah, "Philistia mite khut a pan hon hondam dia TOUPA i Pathian na hon sapsak tawp ke'n," achi uh.
Samuel in belamnou nawi ne lai ala a, halmang thillat in TOUPA kiang ah alan hi. Israel mite a ding in Samuel in TOUPA asam a, TOUPA'N adawng hi.

Samuel in halmang thillat alat laitak in Philistia mite'n Israel mite sual ding in ahon naih uhi. Himahleh huai ni in TOUPA'N Philistia mite tung ah ngaihtak in van agingsak a, abuaisakgawp a, Israel mite ma ah zoh in a-om uhi,
Mizpah a pan Israel mite apawt ua, Philistia mite adelh ua, Beth-kar nuai atun tan un athat zel uhi.
Huchi in Samuel in suang ala a, Mizpah leh Shen kikal ah aphut a, "Hiai tan TOUPA'N hon panpih hi," chi in amin "Ebenezer" asa hi.
Huchi in Philistia mite azahlakta ua, Israel gam ah ahoh nawnta kei uh. Huchi in Samuel damsung tengteng TOUPA khut in Philistia mite adou hi.

Philistia mite'n Israel mite khua alakte uh Ekron a pan Gath tan in Israel mite ape nawn vek uh. Agam Israel mite'n Philistia mite khut a pan atankheta uhi. Israel mite leh Amor mite kal ah kilemna a-om hi.
Huchi in adamsung teng Samuel in Israelte vai ahawmsak hi.
Kum teng in Bethel leh Gilgal leh Mizpah aveh zel a; huai mun teng ah Israelte vai ahawmsak hi.
A-inn omna ahih ziak in Ramah ah apai nawn zelzel hi. Huai ah Israel mite vai ahawmsak hi. Huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam khat adoh hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Samuel a-upata a, Israel mite tung a vaihawmmi in atapate abawl hi.
Ata masapen min Joel ahi a, azom min Abijah ahi. Amaute Beer-sheba a vaihawmte ahi uh.
Himahleh atapate'n ama omdan ala kei ua, sum-le-pai adelh ua, golhna ala ua, dik a vaihawmna akaikawi uhi.
Huchi in Israel mite upate tengteng akikhawm ua, Ramah ah Samuel kiang ah ahoh uhi.
Akiang ah, "Ngai in, na upa mahmahta a, na tapate'n lah na omdan ala kei hial uh. Namdang tengteng bang a ka tung ua vaihawm ding kumpipa hon bawlsak in," achi uhi.
Himahleh akiang a, "Ka tung ua vaihawm ding kumpipa hon pia in," achih un Samuel akipaksak kei hi. Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah Samuel athum hi,
TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Mite'n na kiang a agen tengteng uh ngaikhia in. Nang hon deih lou ahi kei ua, atung ua kumpipa dia kei hon deih lou ahi zaw uhi.
Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak ni a pan tutan a athilhihdan tengteng uh, hon lehngatsan a pathian dangte nna ahon sepsan zel uh mah bang in nang tung ah ahih uhi.
Huaiziak in athu uh ngaikhia in. Himahleh chitaktak in vauhilh inla, atung ua vaihawmmi kumpipa tatdan ding kawkmuh in," achi hi.
Samuel in TOUPA thu tengteng kumpipa ngen mipite ahilh vek hi.

"Na tung ua vaihawmmi ding kumpipa tatdan hichibang ahi ding. Na tapate uh ala dia, amah mah a ding, sakol kangtalai a ding leh asakol tungtuang mite ding in asep ding. Akhente asakol kangtalai ma ah atai ding uh.
Asepaih sangkhatte heutu ding leh sawmngate heutu ding asep dia; khenkhatte alei let ding, abuh la ding, agalvante bawl ding, akangtalai van bawl ding in azang ding hi.
Na tanute uh gimlim bawl ding, anhuan ding leh tanghou bawl ding in azang ding hi.
Na lou, na grephuan, olive huan a ahoih tata ahon sut dia, asikhate ape ding hi.
Na haichi leh na grephuan a sawm-a-khat ahon laksak dia; asikhate leh heutute ape ding hi.
Na sikhapate, na sikhanute, na tangval hoihhoihte leh na bawngte ahon sut dia, anasem ding in azang ding.
Na belamhon lak a sawm-a-khat ahon laksak dia; nou asikhate na hi ding uh.
Huai hun chiang in na tel ding uh kumpipa ziak in na kapkhe ding uh. Himahleh huai hun chiang in TOUPA'N ahon ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
Himahleh mipite'n Samuel thu azui nuam kei uh, "Ahi kei, kumpipa i neih ngeingei ding uh ahi.
Huchi in namdang tengteng bang i hong hi dia, i kumpipa'n vai ahon hawmsak dia, i namte pi in galte ahon doupih ding," achi uhi.
Samuel in mipite thugen tengteng aza a, TOUPA bil ah agensawn hi.
TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Athu uh la inla, kumpipa bawlsak in," achi hi. Samuel in Israel mite kiang ah, "Michih noumau khua chiat ah paita un," achi hi.
Huan Benjamin gam a Benjamin suan a mi khat mihat leh hangsan mahmah a-om a, amin Kish ahi. Amah Abiel tapa, Zeror tapa, Bekorath tapa, Aphiah tapa ahi.
Ama'n tapa khat anei a, amin Saul ahi. Tangval deihhuaitak ahi a, Israel mite lak ah amah sang a deihhuaizaw himhim a-om kei. Kuamah aliangzang khup leng a-om kei hi.
Saul pa Kish sabiltungte amang hi. Kish in atapa Saul kiang ah, "Thou inla, sikha khat pi inla sabiltungte va zong dih ve," achi hi.

Huchi in Ephraim tanggam ah avak a, Shalisha gam ah avak hi. Himahleh amu kei uh. Huchi in Shalim gam ah avak ua, huai ah leng amu kei uh. Benjamin mite gam ah avak nawn ua, himahleh amu tuan kei uhi.
Zuph gam atun un Saul in akiang a om asikha kiang ah, "Kisa dih, i pai nawn mai ding, ahuchih keileh ka pa'n sabiltungte awlmoh nawn lou in ei hon ngaihtuah zaw kha ding,” achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, hiai khua ah Pathian mipa a-om a, mizahtakhuaitak ahi. Agen peuhmah ahong tung ngeingei nak hi. Kisa in, huai ah i va hoh ding, i hohna lampi ahon hilhthei zenzen khakleh," achi hi.

Huchi in Saul in asikha kiang ah, "Ahi na a, ngai dih, hoh hita lehang, huai mi a ding in bang i tawi dia? I bawm ah lah tanghou a-om nawn kei. Pathian mipa kipahman tawi ding a-om het kei hi. Bang i nei a eita?" achi hi.
Sikha in Saul adawng nawn a, "Ngai in, dangka shekel mun li a khen mun khat ka tawi lai hi. Hiai i hohna ding a hon hilh man ding in Pathian mipa ka pe ding," achi hi.
Tuma siah Israelte lak a mi'n Pathian dot a-utleh, "Kisa dih, mutheipa kiang ah i hoh ding,” achi nak uh. Tulai a zawlnei achih uh tuma lam a mutheipa achih uh ahi.
Huchi in Saul in asikha kiang ah, "Hoih geih e, va hoh peuhmah ni," achi hi. Huchi in Pathian mipa omna khua ah ahohta uhi.
Mual a kho zotna lampi a apaitouh lai un nungak tui tawi dia hong kuante amu ua, akiang uah, "Hiai ah mutheipa a-om hia?" achi uhi.
Amau adawng ua, "Om mah e, ngai in, na ma uah apai, kin un, tuni in khua ah ana hoh hi. Tuni in mun sang ah mite akithoih uh.

Khua a na luttouhtak un mun sang a an ne dia ahoh ma in na va mu ngal ding uh. Kithoihna vualzawlpa ding ahih ziak in atun mateng mipi'n an ane kei ding uh. Huai khit chiang in amisapte un an ane zel uhi. Huaiziak in hohtou meng unla, na va mu pah ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in khua ah ahohtou ua, khua alut uleh, ngai in, Samuel mun sang a hoh ding in amau akituahpih hi.
Saul hong ma ni khat in Samuel kiang ah TOUPA akilak a:

"Zingchiang in hichi hun in Benjamin gam a pan na kiang ah mi khat ka hon hohsak dia, ka mi Israelte tung a heutu ding in thau na nilh ding ahi. Ama'n Philistia mite khut a pan ka mite ahondam ding. Akikou husa uh ka kiang ahong tun tak ziak in ka mite zaw ka limsak ahi," achi hi.
Samuel in Saul amuh in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "En dih, na kiang a ka mi gen; amah mah in ka mite tung ah vai ahawm ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kulh kongpi ah Saul in Samuel ava naih a, "Mutheipa inn koi lai a om ahia, hon hilh dih ve," achi hi.

Samuel in Saul adawng a, "Kei huai mutheipa ka hi. Ka ma ah mun sang lam zuan in pai inla, tuni in ka kiang ah an na ne ding hi. Zingchiang zingsang in ka hon paisak ding. Na lungtang a om tengteng leng ka hon hilh ding.
Ni thum paita a mang na sabiltung thu lunghimoh ke'n. Muh ahita uh. Israelte lunggulh kua tung ah ahia a-om? Nang leh na pa inn a mi tengteng tung ah ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Saul in adawng a, "Israel nam lak a neupen, Benjamin nam ka hi kei maw? Ka inkuan leng Benjamin inkuan tengteng lak a neupen ahi kei maw? Bangchidan a hichidan ka kiang a gen na hia?" achi hi.
Samuel in Saul leh asikha api a, mikhual indan ah apilut a, achialte uh, mi sawmthum lak ah mun zahtakhuai ah atusak hi.
Samuel in anhuanmi kiang ah, "Na kiang a koihtuam ding ka chih, tantuan ka hon piak pen hon la dih," achi hi.

Huchi in anhuanmi in aphei leh atung a om ahon tawi a, Saul ma ah alui hi. Samuel in, "En dih, ka na koihtuam, um inla ne in. Ahun sehsa a dia hiai mite ka chialkhawm lai a ka hon sehsak him ahi, ka na chita ngal a," achi hi. Huchi in huai ni in Saul in Samuel toh ankuang a-umkhawm uhi.
Mun sang a pan khua ahong paisuk un intung ah Saul in Samuel ahoupih hi.
Zingkhangpi in athou a; nisuah kuan in Samuel in intung a om Saul asam hi. "Thou in, ka hon paisakta ding," achi hi. Huchi in anih un apaikhia ua, Saul leh Samuel apawtta uh.
Khonawl atunsuk un Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Sikhapa i malam ah paisak inla, ama'n hon paipel zoh chiang in, nang bel khawl tadih in, Pathian thu ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
Paul, Silvanas leh Timothi in, Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist saptuam Thessalonika a omte kiang ah, Pathian i paleh Toupa Jesu Khrist a pan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Ka thumna uah na min uh lou in, nou tengteng ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen gige uhi.
I Pathian leh Pa ma ah ginna ziak a na thilhihdan uh leh itna ziak a na sepgimdante uh, Toupa Jesu Khrist lametna ziak a na kuhkalna uh mangngilh lou a, theigige in.
Unau Pathian ngaihtakte aw, nou ahon teldan ka thei uhi.

Ka tanchinhoih uh thu kia a na kiang uh hong tung lou in thilhihtheihna leh Kha Siangthou leh nakpi a theihchetna toh ahong tung zaw hi. Noumau makhua ngaihtuah in na tung uah bangchibang mi ka hita ua chih na thei uhi.
Huan thuhaksa thuak kawm in, Kha Siangthou a kipak in na pom ua, koumau leh Toupa zuite na hita uhi.
Huchi in Masidonia leh Akhaia gam a gingtu mi tengteng a ding in etton ding na hi uhi.
Toupa thu noumau a kipan in Masidonia leh Akhaia gam kia hilou, mun chih ah Pathian lam a na ginna uh athangkheta hi, kou bangmah ka gen uh akiphamoh nawn kei hi.
Amau mahmah in bangchibang vualzawlna toh na kiang ua ka hong lutdan uh ahon theisak uhi. Nou milimte a kipan a Pathian lam na hong ngat takdan uleh Pathian hing leh dik nasem ding leh,
van a kipan a Tapa, misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh, thangpaihna hong tung ding lak a kipan hon suaktasakpa, huai Jesu ngei na ngak ding in.
Unaute aw, na lak ua ka hong lutna uh athawn kei chih noumau mah in na thei uhi.

Athawn hih nak sang in huai malam in na theihsa bang un, Philippi a gimthuak leh zumhuaitak a bawl a ka om nung un, dalna thupitak lak ah leng Pathian tanchinhoih na kiang ua gen ding in ka Pathian uah hangsanna ka nei zaw uhi.
Ka thugen uh khemna a pawt ahi kei a, sianlouhna a suak leng ahi kei a, khemna in leng ahi sam kei hi;
tanchinhoih kepsak a om ding a Pathian hoihsakmi ka hih bang ngei un, mihing hihkipak ding hilou a, ka lungtang uh ze-etpa Pathian hihkipak zaw in thu ka gen zel uh ahi zaw hi.
Chik lai peuh in kimaitang phatna thu leh huaiham khuhmangna ding thu ka zong ngei kei uh chih na thei ua; Pathian leng ahon theihpihpa ahi.
Khrist sawltak ka hih ziak un mite buaisak thei himah le ung, mihing lak ah nou lak ah leh midangte lak ah leng pahtawina ka zong ngei sam kei uhi.
Nu naupom, ama tate deihthohtak a kemmi bang in, na lak uah nunnemtak in ka om zaw uhi.
Huchi in ittak a nou ka hon lunggulh tuntun ziak un, Pathian tanchinhoih kia hilou in, koumau hinna leng hon piak hial ka ut mahmah uhi.
Unaute aw, ka septawldan uleh ka sepgimdan uh na theigige uhi; na lak uah kuamah ka suk tuailuailouhna ding un, sun leh zan a nna sem in Pathian tanchinhoih nou ka hon hilh uhi.
Nou gingtate tung a siangthoutak, diktak leh dembei a ka omdan uh ahon theihpihte Pathian leh noute na hi uhi.
Na theih mah bang un, pa'n ama tate tung a ahih bang a hanthawn leh khamuan in nou ka hon theisak uhi.
Amah gam leh thupina a nou hon samlutpa Pathian mite hi ding a kilawm him a na hintheihna ding un.

Hiai ziak in tawp lou in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen uhi, Pathian thu koumau a kipan a na muh uh, na san lai un leng, mihing thu bang in na sang kei ua; Pathian thu ahihna bang a na san zawk ziak un; huai tuh Pathian a ahi him a, gingtami noumau sung a sem zel mah ahi.
Nou unaute aw, Judia gam a Pathian saptuam pawl Khrist Jesu a omte zuite na hi ua, amau Judate lak a athuak bang un, nou leng noumau gam mite lak ah na thuak sam uhi.
Huai Judate'n Toupa Jesu leh zawlneite leng athat ua, kou leng ahon delhkhia ua, Pathian ahihlungkim kei ua, mi tengteng akalh nak uhi.
Zentelte hotdam ahihtheihna ding ua akiang ua thugen akham ua, akhelhna uh hihdim gige ding in; himahleh atung uah thangpaihna tawpkhawk atungta hi.
Himahleh unaute aw, sawt lou kal a dia noumau toh lungtang lam a kikhen lou a, pumpi lam kia a kikhen a i om takdih ziak in, kilawptak a na mel uh mu ding in ka pang sansan uhi.
Na kiang ua hong pai ka tum tinten ngal ua; kei, Paul ngei in leng hong pai ka tumtum a, himahleh Setan in ahon dal nak hi.
Ka lametna uhiam, ka lungnopna uhiam, ka Kipahna Lallukhu uhiam bang ahia le? Ahong pai chiang in i Toupa Jesu ma ah noumau mah na hi kei ding ua hia?
Noumau mah ka thupina uleh ka lungnopna uh na hi uhi.
Huchi in ka thuakzoh tak louh phet un Athen ah koumau kia nutsiat in om le ung hoih ka sa ua,
i unaupa uh Timothi ahihleh Khrist tanchinhoih lam a Pathian nasempa, nou hon hihkip ding leh na ginna lam ua nou hon khamuan ding in ka hon sawlta uhi.
Hiai gimthuaknate ziak a kuamah alinlouhna ding un. Hiaite bang thuak ding a seh ka hi uh chih noumau ngei in na thei uhi.
Na kiang ua ka om lai ua gimthuak ding ka hi uh chih ka hon hilhkholh bang ngei in atungta hi, huai na thei uhi.
Hiai ziak in, ka thuakzoh tak louh nung in, khempa'n nou ahon khempuk kha dia, ka sepgimna uh athawn kha ding chi in na gindan uh ka na theihna ding in mi ka hon sawl ahi.

Himahleh Timothi, noumau a kipan a tua ka kiang uh ahong tun in, hon muh ka ut mahmah bang un nou leng hon muh ut mahmah in hehpih in na hon theigige uh chih leh na ginna uh leh na itna tanchin uh kipahhuaitak mai ahon puak hi.
Huchi ahih ziak in unaute aw, ka mangbatna uleh gimthuakna tengteng uah na ginna ziak un na tungthu uah lungmuan in ka omta uhi.
Toupa a na dinkip phot uleh tu'n tuh ka hingta uhi.
I Pathian ma ah na tung ua ka kipahna tengteng ziak un noumau lam thu ah Pathian kiang ah bangchibang in kipahthu ka gen thei zozen ding uam aw?
Na mel uh ka muhtheihna ding uleh na ginna lam ua na taksap awng uh ka hon huksak theihna ding un sun leh zan in nakpitak in ka thum uhi.
Huchi in Pathian, i Pa ngei leh Toupa Jesu'n leng, koute na kiang uah hon pitung hen.
Huan noumau lam a itna ka hauh bang un, noumau khat-le-khat na ki-ittuah chiatna uleh mi tengteng na itna uh hon khangsak zelpa Toupa'n hon hausak semsem hen;
huchi a i Toupa Jesu, amisiangthou tengteng toh ahong pai chiang a, i Pathian leh a Pa ma a na lungtangte uh sianthouna lam ah gensiatbei a om ding a nou ahon hihkip theihna ding in.

Huchi in unaute aw, atawp pen in na omdan ding uleh Pathian na hih kipahdan ding uh, tua na omdan bang uh, koumau a kipan a na lak bang un na hauhsemna ding un Toupa Jesu ah ka hon ngen un ka hon hanthawn uhi.
Toupa Jesu ziak in bangthute ahia ka hon piak uh na thei uhi.
Pathian deihlam a na sianthouna ding uh hiai ahi: kingaih tawpsan unla;
na pumpi chiat uh siangthou leh zahtakhuai a kepdan ding thei un,
Pathian thei lou Zentelte bang a huk lamsang a ut lou in.
Huai lam thu ah zaw kuamah takhial in a-unau tung ah thil hoih lou hih kei hen; huchibang thilhihte tengteng phulapa Toupa ahih ziak in ka hon hilhkhol un ka hon theisak khinta uhi.
Pathian in siang lou ding in ahon sam kei a, siangthou ding in ahon sam zaw hi.
Huaiziak in anial in mihing nial ahi kei a, Pathian nou a Kha Siangthou hon pepa nial ahi zaw hi.
Himahleh unaute itdan lam thu gelhsak na kiphamoh kei ua, ki-ittuah chiat ding in noumau ngei Pathian hilh in na omta uhi.
Masidonia gam a unau om tengteng tung ah huai na hih ngei uhi. Himahleh unaute aw, na hauhsemna ding un ka hon hanthawn uhi;
kamsim deuh a omleh noumau nna chiat limsak leh thu ka hon piak bang ua na khut ngei ua sep na tupna ding un;
huchi in polam mite tung ah kilawmtak in na om thei ding ua, bangmah na tasam kei ding uhi.
Himahleh unaute aw, midang lametna himhim neiloute bang a na lungkhamlouhna ding un, ihmute tungtang na theih louh uh ka deih kei uhi.
Jesu si a, thounawnta ahi chih i gintak mah bang in Jesu a ihmu khinsate Pathian in amah toh ahon tonpih ding hi.
Hiai Toupa thu in na kiang uah ka gen uhi; eite Toupa hong pai pha a hingdam a na omlaite'n, ihmu khinsate i makhelh kei hial ding hi, chih.
Toupa mahmah kikou aw toh, angel tungnungpen aw toh, Pathian pengkul ging toh, van a kipan a hong paisuk ding lah ahi ngal a, huan Khrist a sisate athou masa phot ding ua;
huai khit chiang in eite hingdam a na omlaite, huihkhua ah Toupa tuak ding in amau toh meipi lak ah laktouh in i om ding uhi; huchi in tangtawn in Toupa toh i omkhawm denta ding uhi.
Huaiziak in hiai thute in kikhamuantuah chiat un.
Himahleh naute aw, ahun leh ani lam thute himhim gelhsak na kiphamoh kei uh.
Toupa ni tuh zan lai in guta bang in ahong tung ding chih noumau ngei in chiantak in na thei uhi.
Muanna leh bitna chi a agen laitak un numei nauvei bang in thakhat in manthatna atung uah atung ding a, asuakta kei hial ding uhi.
Himahleh unaute aw, nou zaw huai ni in guta bang a hon bingphawn ding in mial ah na om kei uhi.
Vak tate leh sun tate na hi vek ngal ua; zan a mi i hi kei ua, mial a mi leng i hi sam kei uhi.
Huaiziak in midangte bang in i ihmu kei ding uh, hak ni in limsak zaw ni.
Ihmute zan in ahi a-ihmut uh; zukhamte leng zan in ahi akham uh.
Himahleh eite bel sun a mi i hih ziak in, ginna leh itna lum tawi in, hotdam lametna lukhu a zang in limsak zaw ni.
Pathian in thangpaihna thuak ding hilou in, Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak a hotdamna mu ding zaw in ahon chi hi.
I hah in leng i ihmut in leng, amah toh i hinkhawm theihna ding in i sih sik in amah asita hi.
Huaiziak in kihanthawntuah chiat in, na hih zel mah bang un kitungdingtuah chiat un.
Huan unaute aw, na lak ua semgim leh Toupa a na heutu ua na omleh nou hon thuhilhte thei ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
Anasep ziak un it in ngai thupi mahmah un. Noumau kituak in om un.
Tu in unaute aw, ka hon hanthawn uhi, dan lou a omte hilh unla, lungkete hanthawn un, hatloute panpih unla, mi tengteng lak ah thuakzoutak in om un.
Kuamah in kua gitlouh leng gilou a thuk lou ding in pilvang un; thil na kihihsaktuahna lam uah leh mi tengteng tung a na hihsakna lam uah leng ahoih lamlam zui un.
Nuam gige un;
tawp lou in thum un;
bangkim ah kipahthu gen gige un; huai tuh noumau lam a Khrist Jesu ah Pathian deihlam ahi.
Kha phelh kei un;
thugente simmoh kei un;
bangkim enchian zaw unla, ahoih lam peuhmah len tinten un;
gilou lam peuhmah ah kihemkhia un.
Huchi in lemna Pathian ngei in nou hon hihsiangthou sipsip hen; na kha uh leh na lungsim uh leh na pumpi uh i Toupa Jesu Khrist hong pai chiang in gensiatbei in humbit in omsuak sipsip hen.
Nou hon sampa amuanhuai a, hih leng ahih ding hi.
Unaute aw, hon thumsak un.
Unaute tengteng tawp siangthou in chibai hon na buksak un.
Hiai laithon unau tengteng kiang ah sim ngeingei ding in Toupa min in ka hon ngen hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen, Amen.
Paul, Pathian thupiak bang a i hondampa leh i lamet Toupa Jesu Khrist sawltak in;
ginna a ka ta taktak Timothi kiang ah, i Pa Pathian, leh i Toupa Khrist Jesu a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna na tung ah om hen.
Masidonia gam a ka hoh dek lai a ka hon nget bang in Ephesa ah om gige in, huchi a mi khenkhat gindan tuam sinsak lou ding a na hilhtheihna ding in.
Huan Pathian lam a phattuamna, ginna a om pen hilou, kiselna leh gintak thu gen omsak lel tangthu leh khangthu sui zoh louh peuh buaipih lou ding a na hilhtheihna ding in.
Eite'n thuhilh ding i kep pen bel lungtang siangthou leh sia-le-pha theihna siang leh ginna taktak a kipan a pawt itna ahi zaw hi.
Mi khenkhatte'n hiaite pialsan in thugina lou genna lam ah avakmang uhi.
Athugen uh leh thil ahi a agente uh leng bang ahia chih theiloupi in dan sinsak mite hih a-ut uhi.
Mi'n azat hoihleh dan ahoih chih i thei uhi.

Ahi a, dan zaw midiktatte a ding a bawl ahi kei a, dan kalhte leh dan lou a omte a ding, Pathian limsakloute leh mikhialte, misiangthouloute leh Pathian zahloute, pate thatte, nute thatte, mihing thatte;
kingaihhatte, tawkohukte, mihing gute, zuautheite, kichiam khemkhemte a ding leh thil dang thugin toh kituak lou himhimte a ding leh,
ka kiang a kepsak a om Pathian tanchinhoih thupi hilhna dik kalhte a ding ahi.
Ahon hihhatpa Khrist Jesu i Toupa kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi, muanhuai ahon sak a, anasempa dia ahon chih tak ziak in.
Tuma lam in Pathian gensepa leh sawipa leh hihsepa na hita mah leng; gingtaloupi leh theiloupi a hih ka hih ziak in ahi zahngaihna ka na muh tak.
Huan i Toupa hehpihna ginna leh Khrist Jesu a itna in nakpitak in adimletta hi.
Khrist Jesu khialte hondam ding in khovel ah ahong pai chih ataksanhuai in alak tuak mahmah hi. Alak ua khialpen ka hi.

Himahleh hiai ziak in ahi zahngaihna ka na muh; Jesu Khrist in adohzohna kim a khialpen keimah a alatsak theihna ding ahi, tuban siah tangtawn hinna muhna ding a amah hon gingta dingte a dia etsakna hi ding in.
Kumpipa tangtawn a om, sithei lou, muh theih louh, Pathian tak kia, tangtawn in zahtak leh thupi in om hen, Amen.
Ka tapa Timothi aw, na tungtang genkholhnate toh kituak in hiai mohpuakna leh thuhilhna ka hon pia hi, huchi a huai thute hilh a, kidouna hoih na dou theihna ding in,
ginna leh sia-le-pha theihna siangtak len tinten in, mi khenkhatte'n huai sia-le-pha theihna paikhia in ginna lam ah long sia bang in akekseta uhi.
Huaite lak ah Himenaias leh Alexander apang uhi; Pathian agensiatlouhna ding un amaute Setan ka peta hi.
Huchi in amasapen in thilnget thumnate, thumna himhimte, thumsaknate, leh kipahthu gennate, mi tengteng a ding a bawlsak ding in ka hon hanthawn hi.
Kumpipate leh thuneite tengteng a ding in leng; Pathian limsak leh zahtakhuaitak a kituak a khamuang a i omtheihna ding in.
Huai tuh i Hondampa Pathian theih in ahoih in, akipahhuai hi.
Ama'n mi tengteng hotdam a om ding leh thutak thei ding in adeih hi.
"Pathian khat kia a om, Pathian leh mihing kikal ah palai khat kia a-om nawn,
Amah mihing ahi, Khrist Jesu, mi tengteng tatna dia kipepa pen." Huai theihpihna ahuntak a piak ahi.
Hiai hih ding a tangkoupihpa ding leh sawltak a seh ka hi, Khrist ah thutak tak ka gen, ka zuau kei; ginna leh thutak a Zentelte sinsakpa a seh ka hi.
Pasalte'n mun chih a khut siangthou zak in, thangpai lou leh ginglel lou in thum le uh ka deih hi.
Huchibang mah in numeite zumthei leh omdan siam in puansilh kilawm lel in kivan le uh; samphek, dangka-eng, tuikepsuang leh puan mantam taktakte a kivan lou in;
himahleh numei Pathian limsak kichite akihun lel in thil hihhoih in kivan le uh ka deih hi.
Numei in thumang hiathiat in om dinden in zil hen.
Himahleh numei in thu ahilh zaw ka phal kei, pasal tung a thuneih leng ka phal sam kei, dai dinden in om zaw hen.
Adam siam masak ahi a, huai nung in Evi siam ahi.
Adam khem in a-om kei a, numei khem in a-om a, tatlekna ah apukta hi.
Numei in omdan siamna toh ginna leh itna leh sianthouna a a-om gigeleh nau pianna ah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh saptuam heutu a pan ut in nasep hoih a-ut ahi, chih adik ahi.
Huchi in saptuam heutu zaw gensiatbei, zi khat nei, kidek thei, navaktak, midiktat, mipahtakdan siam, thuhilh siam,
uain khamhat lou, mivuak hat lou, minunnem ahi ding hi, selhat lou, sum deihta lou,
zahtakhuaitak a tate kemsiam, amah insung kizentak a vaihawm siammi ahi ding hi.
Mi'n ama insung vaihawm nangawn kizentak a ahihsiam keileh bangchi in ahia Pathian saptuam akep theih ding?
Gingthakmi ahi ding ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw akisathei kha dia, diabol siam louh tansakna ah apuk kha ding hi.
Huaite lou leng polam a mite phat in a-om nalai ding ahi, huchi lou in zaw gensiat a a-om in diabol thang ah a-awk kha ding hi.
Huchibang in Saptuam Upate leng mizahtakhuai ahih ding uh ahi; kamtamte, uain haite, lepna nin a huaiham mite ahi ding ahi kei;
sia-le-pha theihna siang a ginna a thuguk kemmi ahi zaw ding uhi.
Huan huaite leng chet in om masa uhen, huai nung in gensiatbei ahong hih uleh Saptuam Upa nna sem uhen.
Huchibang in azite uh leng mizahtakhuai ahi ding uhi, gensiat hat lou, kidek thei leh bangkim a muanhuai ahi ding uhi.
Saptuam Upate zi khat nei atate uleh amau insung vaihawm navaktak a hihmi hi uhen.
Saptuam Upa nna hoihtak a semte'n amau a ding in phat tak hihna aloh ua, huan Khrist Jesu a om ginna a muanna leh hangsanna thupitak amu uhi.
Sawt lou nung a na kiang a hong hoh lamen in hiai thu na kiang ah ka gelh ahi;

himahleh ka hong zekai khakleh Pathian inkuanpihte lak a mi bangchibang in ahia a-om ding uh chih na theihna ding in ka gelh ahi; Pathian inkuanpihte Pathian hing saptuamte, thutak khuam leh kingakna ahi uhi.
Pathian limsakna thuguk nial vual louh in athupi hi: "Taksa a muh theih a latsak in Pathian a-om a, Kha a siamtansak, Angelte muh, namte lak a tangkoupih, khovel a mite gintak, thupina apitouh ahi."
Himahleh tunung chiang in mi khenkhatte'n; pimangna khate leh dawite thuhilhna limsak in, ginna atawpsan ding uh chih Kha in kichiantak in agen hi; huai tuh,
mizuautheite lepchiahna ziak in ahi; huai mizuautheite amau sia-le-pha theihna ngei a sik am a halkeu bang ahi uhi.
Kiten akham ua, nek ding ante, thutak thei a gingtate'n kipahthu gen a san ding a Pathian in asiamte, nek louh ding achi uhi.
Pathian thilsiam chiteng ahoih ngal a, kipahthu gen a san ahih khit nak photleh bangmah deih louh ding ahi kei hi;
Pathian thu leh thumna a hihsiangthou ahi khinta hi.
Huaite unaute na sinsakleh Khrist Jesu nasempa hoihtak, ginna leh thuhilhna hoih tutan a na zuih thu a vaklian na hi ding hi.
Himahleh Pathian zahlouhna leh tangthu bulbal neiloute deih ke'n. Pathian limsak ding in kithuzoh in;
pumpi kisawizoina aphatuam zek a; Pathian limsakna pen tangtawn in, tua omsa hinna leh hong om nawn ding piak chiamna aneih ziak in thil tengteng ah aphatuam hi.
Hiai thu amuanhuai in alak tuak mahmah hi.
Huchi in Pathian hing i muan ziak in i semgim ua, i pang teitei uhi; amah mi tengteng Hondampa ahi a, agingtate Hondampa ahi tuanse hi.
Hiaite thupiak in pia inla, sinsak in.
Na naupanna kuamah musitsak ke'n; thugen ah, tatdan ah, itna ah, kha ah, ginna leh sianthouna ah, gingtute zuih ding hi zaw in.
Ka hong pai masiah laisim, hanthawn leh thugin limsak in.
Nangmah a om thilpiak thugenkholhna a piak, upate khut ngak a Pathian in nang ahon neihsak limsak lou ke'n.
Mi tengteng kiang a na phattuamna alattheihna ding in huai thilte ah thanuam inla, kizang zou in.
Nangmah leh na thuhilh ah pilvang in; huai thilte hih in om gige in; huchibang hih in nangmah leh na thuzate na hondam ding hi.
Upa deuhte tai ke'nla, pa bang in thuhilh in; tangval deuhte unaupa bang in;
numei upa deuhte nu bang in; nungak deuhte siangthoutak in sanggamnu bang in thuhilh in.
Meithai, meithai taktakte zahtak in.

Himahleh meithai kuapeuh in tate leh tute aneih uleh huaite'n amau insung ah Pathian limsakna mohpuakna thei masa uhenla, amau nu leh pate uh kem uhen; hiai lah Pathian mitmuh in ahoih in apom tak ngal a.
Meithai taktak amah kia nutsiat a om in Pathian tung ah lametna anei a, sun leh zan a ngen in athum gige hi.
Himahleh meithai ama nopsakna sung a kipia zaw, adam lai nangawn in asi ahi.
Gensiatbei a a-omtheihna ding un huaite thupiak in pia in.
Himahleh kuapeuh in ama mite a ding angaihtuahsak louh a, ama inkuante khol houh angaihtuahsak keileh ginna azuausan a, gingloumi sang in agilouzaw hi.
Meithai kum sawmguk chiang nuailam hilou, mi khat zi hisa,

thil hoih hih lam a mi phatlohta, atate vaktei khin a, mikhualte na zintun khin a, misiangthoute khe na silta a, mangbangte na dawnzang khin a, thil hoih peuhmah thanuamtak a na hih khin ahihleh meithai a gelh theih ahi.
Himahleh meithai naupang simte zaw gelh ke'n; ataksa lunggulhna un Khrist lam a akipiakna uh athuzoh chiang in pasal neih a-ut nak ua,
aginna masa uh atawpsan ziak un siam louh tang in a-om nak uhi.
Huai lou leng thadah in inn teng ah aban pawt nak ua, thadah kia leng hilou in, thu gen louh ding gen in, kamtam leh mite thilhih lai avai hawmsak nak uhi.
Huchi in meithai naupang simte zaw pasal nei in, tate nei uhenla, insung khosak ngaihtuah le uh, melmapa gensiatna ding lemtang musak kei le uh ka deih hi.
Meithai khenkhat Setan lam naih in apialkheta uhi.
Gingtami numei hiam pasal hiam in methaite nei taleh dawnzang hen; saptuamte hihbuai in om kei hen; meithai taktakte adawnzang theihna ding un.
Saptuam Upa vaihawm hoihte, abik in thugen leh sinsakna a semgimte aleh nih a hih thupi tuak a seh nawn sem hi uhen.
Laisiangthou in, "Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk gak ke'n," achi hi. "Nasemmi loh mu tak ahi," achi nawn hi.
Saptuam Upa hekna zaw theihpih nih hiam thum hiam kam a lou zaw sang ke'n.
Mikhialte mi tengteng ma ah taihilh in, midangte'n leng alautheihna ding un.
Deihsak tuam leh khentuam nei a bangmah hih lou a hiai thute zui ding in Pathian leh Khrist Jesu leh angel teltuamte mitmuh in phatuamngaitak in ka hon theisak hi.
Kuamah tung ah khut nga pah ke'nla, midang khelhna ah leng kikum pah ke'n; kihihsiangthou gige in.
Tui kia dawn ke'nla, na gilpi ziak in leh na hat louh nak ziak in uain neu khakha zang zel in.
Mi khenkhatte khelhna alang gige a, vaihawmna atun nak hi; mi khenkhat khelhnate bel akhonung in ahong kilang hi.
Huchi mah bang in mi khenkhatte thil hoih hih kilang pah a-om a, akilangloute leng sel theih ahi kei hi.
Pathian min leh athuhilhna thu gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in sikha hakkol bat peuhmahte'n amau pute bangkim ah zahtak tham in sim uhen.
Huan gingtami pu a neite'n unau ahih ziak un ngaineu kei uhen, himahleh phattuamna mute leh deihtakte ahih ziak un a-nna uh sepsak semsem uhen. Huai thute hilh inla, hanthawn in.
Mi kuapeuh in thuhilhna dang ahilh a, thutak, i Toupa Jesu Khrist thu leh Pathian limsak lam thuhilhna hoih asak keileh,
amah kisathei ahi a, bangmah thei lou ahi, theih nak sang in kisel leh thukalh lam ah ahai zawta a, huchibang a kipan in, enna, kilaina, gensiatna,
hoih lou lam a ginna, selhatna asuak nak hi; huchibang mi lungsim sia neite'n thutak nei lou in, Pathian limsak pen punna khattou asa uhi.
Himahleh lungkimna toh kithuah Pathian limsakna tuh punna thupitak ahi.
Khovel ah bangmah i lutpih kei a, bangmah i pawtpih thei sam kei ding hi.
Himahleh nek ding leh silh ding nei in, huaite ah i lungkim ding uhi.
Himahleh, hauhsak tumte khemna, thang, haihuai leh hihse thei duhgawlna tampi ah apuklut nak uhi, huaite'n tuh siatna leh manthatna ah mite ahihtum nak uhi.
Dangka sum deihtak zaw gilou chiteng bul ahi; khenkhatte'n a-eng ua, ginna apaimangsan ua, amau leh amau lungkhamna tampi in akisunlet tektok uhi.
Himahleh nang Pathian mipa aw, huai thilte taisan inla, diktatna, Pathian limsakna, ginna, itna, thuaktheihna, kingaihniamnate delh in.
Ginna kidouna hoih dou inla, tangtawn hinna len tinten in; huai tang ding a sap na hi a; theihpih tamtakte mitmuh in gupna hoih na gumta hi.
Pathian thil bangkim hihhingpa leh Khrist Jesu, Pontias Pilat mai a gupna hoih gumpa mitmuh in thu ka hon pia hi;
Toupa Jesu Khrist hong kilat nawn masiah huai thupiak siangthou leh gensiatbei a kem ding in.
Huai kilakna ama huntak ah phat tuak thuneipa tak kia, kumpipate' Kumpipa, toupate' Toupa'n alak ding ahi.

Amah kia in sih theihlouhna anei a, vak naih theih vual louh ah a-om a, amah kuamah in amu ngei kei ua, muh leng amu thei sam kei uhi; amah kiang ah tangtawn in thupina leh thilhihtheihna om hen, Amen.
Hiai khovel a mihausate kisathei lou ding leh hauhna kip lou a muanna nga lou a, thil tengteng kipahna ding a tampi a hon pepa Pathian a nga zaw ding in hilh in.
Thil hoih ahih ding uh, thil hoih hih a ahauh ding uh, thilphal a asiam ding uh ahi.
Huchi a amau a ding a gou kikhol a, tunung a dia suangphum hoih phum a, tangtawn hinna taktak aletkip theihna ding un.
Timothi aw, na kiang a kepsak a om kemhoih in; Pathian zah louh thugen mawkmawk leh kikalhna dikloupi a pilna kichite nungngatsan in;
mi khenkhat in huai nei kichi in ginna ah apaikhial uhi. Hehpihna na kiang ah om hen, Amen.
Huan David tapa Solomon agamsung ah hatsak in a-om a; TOUPA a Pathian akiang ah a-om a, nakpi mahmah in athupisak hi.
Solomon in Israel tengteng, sepaih sangkhat heutu, zakhat heutu, vaihawmmi, Israel gam tengteng a milian, inkuan a makaipen tengteng ahoupih hi.
Huchi in Solomon leh kikhawm tengteng Gibeon a mun sang ah ahoh ua; huai ah TOUPA sikha Mosi in gamdai a abawl Pathian biakna buk a-om hi.
Pathian bawm bel David in ana bawl khitsa mun, Kiriath-jearim a kipan David in alatou khin a; Jerusalem ah akoihna ding puanin azak khitsa him ahi.
Huan Hur tapa, Uri tapa, Bezalel bawl dal maitam TOUPA biakna buk chin ah a-om behlap a; Solomon leh mipite'n ava zuan uhi.
Huan kihoupihna biakbuk chin a dal maitam omna TOUPA ma ah Solomon ahohtou a, halmang thillat sangkhat alan hi.
Huai zan in Solomon kiang ah Pathian akilak a, akiang ah, "Bang ahia ka hon piak ding hon ngen in," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon in Pathian kiang ah, "Ka pa David kiang ah hehpihna thupitak na langsak a, asik in kumpipa in na hon bawlta a,
aw TOUPA Pathian, ka pa David kiang a na thuchiam hihtangtung in; nang lei a leivui zah mipite kumpipa in na hon bawlta hi.
Huchi in hiai mipite ma a lut leh pawt a ka omtheihna ding in pilna leh theihna hon pia in; na mi hiai zahzah vai, kua'n ahia hawmsak thei ding?" achi hi.

Huchi in Pathian in Solomon kiang ah, "Hichibang lungsim na put a, sum-le-paite, hauhsaknate, pahtawinate, nang hon mudahte hinnate ngen lou a, damsawtnate leng ngen lou a, atung ua kumpipa a ka hon bawl na mite vai na hawmsak theihna ding a pilna leh theihnate na hon nget zawk ziak in, pilna leh theihna piak na hita hi.
Huchi in na ma a kumpipate'n ana neih ngei louh uh, nang nung a leng aneih het louh ding uh sum-le-paite, hauhsaknate, pahtawinate ka hon pe lai ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon mun sang chin a kihoupihna biakbuk omna Gibeon a zin Jerusalem ah apai a, Israel tung ah yai ahawmta hi.

Huan Solomon in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite akaikhawm a; kangtalai sangkhat-le-zali leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei a, huaite kangtalai koihna khuate leh Jerusalem a kumpipa omnate ah akoih hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Jerusalem ah suangtum bang mai in dangka-eng leh dangkasikte akoih a, sidar singte leng phaizang a theipi sing bang a tam in akoih lai hi.
Solomon neih sakolte, Aigupta gam a kipan a lakkhiak ahi a; kumpipa sumsin mite'n huaite ahonhon in akhak zel ua, ahon a lei zel ahi.

Aiguptate gam a kangtalaite bel dangkasik shekel zaguk zel in aleikhiaksak zel ua; sakolte dangkasik shekel za-le-sawmnga zel in; huchi mah bang in Hitte kumpipa tengteng leh Siria kumpipate kiang ah leng azuaksawn zel uhi.
Rehoboam bel Shekem ah ahoh a; Israelte tengteng Shekem ah kumpipa dia bawl ding in ahoh khinta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in huai thu azak in, Aigupta gam a kipan Jeroboam ahong pai nawn hi; amah kumpipa Solomon kiang a kipan ataimangna Aigupta gam a om lai ahi ngal a.
Mi asawl ua, ava sam ua; huchi in Jeroboam leh Israel tengteng ahong pai ua, Rehoboam kiang ah,
"Na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak mahmah a; huaiziak in na pa'n hon zat gimna leh ahakkol giktak ka tung ua akoih hon sukzangsak inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ni thum khit chiang in hong pai nawn zaw un," achi a, huchi in mipite akihemkhia uhi.
Kumpipa Rehoboam in, "Hiai mipite dawnna ding thupha bang ahia na hon hilh ding uh?" chi in apa Solomon dam lai a upate kiang ah adong hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Hiai mipite na hehpih a na kipahsak a, akiang ua thuhoih tata na genleh tangtawn in na mite ahi ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
Himahleh, upate hoihsakpih apom kei a, amah khanvualpih tangvalte, akiang a om sekte adong zosop hi.
Akiang uah, "Hiai mipite ka kiang a, 'Na pa'n ka tung ua hakkol akoih hon hihzangsak in chi a gen mite ka dawndan ding hoih bang ahia na hon hilh ding uh?" " achi hi.

Akhanvualpih tangvalte'n akiang ah hiai mipite na pa'n ahakkol uh ahihgik thei mahmah a, nang zaw hon hihzangsakzaw in na kiang a hong gen mite kiang ah huchi in chi inla, huchi in akiang uah gen in, "Ka pa kawng sang in ka khutzung agolzaw.
Ka pa'n hakkol giktak ahon na posak a, ke'n ahihleh na hakkol uh behlap lai ding ka hi, ka pa'n khetna in nou ahon sawi zel a, ke'n ahihleh aikam a hon sawi ding ka hi," chi in agen uhi.
Huchi in Jeroboam leh mipite tengteng kumpipa'n, "Ani thum khit chiang in hong nawn un, achih bang in ni thum ni in Rehoboam kiang ah ahoh uhi.
Kumpipa'n amaute gumtak in adawng a, kumpipa Rehoboam in upate thuhilhna apom kei.
Tangvalte phatsakpih bang in, ka pa'n na hakkol uh ahihgik a, ke'n huai behlap ding ka hi; ka pa'n khetna in nou ahon na sawi a, ke'n zaw aikam a nou hon sawi ding ka hi," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Shilon mi Ahijah zang a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam kiang a athu gensa akipsak theihna ding in kumpipa'n mite thugen Pathian ziak in apom kei hi.

Kumpipa'n athu uh apom kei chih Israelte tengteng in atheih un mipite'n: "David ah tantuan bang ahia i neih uh? Jesse tapa ah gouluah ding i nei sam kei uh, Israel mite aw, na puanin lam chiat uah pai un: David, na inkuan sung ngaihtuah mai in, chi in kumpipa adawng uhi." Huchi in Israel tengteng apuanin lam uah apaita uhi.
Israel suan Judah gam khua a omte bel atung uah Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in phutluih nasem dia asawlte uh heutu Hadoram asawl a; amah huai Israelte tengteng in suang in ana deng ua, asita hi. Jerusalem a tai tum in akangtalai ah kumpipa Rehoboam atuang pah hi.
Huchi in tutan in David inkote tung ah Israelte ahelta uhi.
Huan Jerusalem a Rehoboam atuntouh in, Israelte dou a, Rehoboam gam la nawn ding in Judah nuaikhat leh Benjamin inkote, mihangsan chiat telkhiak, nuaikhat-le-singgiattak akaikhawm hi.
Himahleh Pathian mipa Shemaiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
Judah gam kumpipa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kiang ah leh Judah gam leh Benjamin gam a Israel mi tengteng kiang ah,

"TOUPA'N hichi in achi: na hohtou ding uh ahi kei, na unaute uh dou sam kei un; na inn lam uah pai nawn vek un; hiai keimah hih ahi hi, chi in gen in," chi in. Huchi in TOUPA thu amang ua, Jeroboam dou ding a ahoh ding uh akik nawn uhi.
Rehoboam bel Jerusalem ah a-om a, Judah gam ah kivenna ding in khua asat hi.
Bethlehem khuate, Etam, Tekoa asat a,
Beth-zur, Shoko, Adullam,
Gath, Mareshah, Jip,
Adoraim, Lakish, Azekah,
Zorah, Aijalon, Hebron khua; huaite Judah leh Benjamin gam a kulh nei khopite ahi.
Huchi in huai kulhte ahihkip a, heutute akoih a, nek ding, thau leh uain asekkhawm hi.
Kho teng ah lum leh tei akoih a, khua kiptak in abawl chiat hi. Huchi in Judah leh Benjamin gam ama gam ahisak hi.
Huan Israel gam tengteng a siampute leh Levite amau gam a kipan chiat in akiang ah ahong uhi.
Levite'n agam uh leh a-omnate uh apawtsan ua, Judah gam leh Jerusalem ah ahoh uh; Jeroboam leh atapate'n TOUPA a dia siampu nna sem lou ding in atawpsak uhi.
Amun sang a ding leh keltal leh bawngnou lim abawl a ding a siampute aseh zawk ziak in.
Huan Israel nam, TOUPA Israel' Pathian lam a lungsim awn tengteng in azui ua, TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian kiang ah kithoih ding in Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi.
Huchi in Judah gam akipsak ua, kum thum sung Solomon tapa Rehoboam in akipsak hi: kum thum sung David leh Solomon lampi azui uhi.
Rehoboam in David tapa Jerimoth tanu Mahalath zi in anei a, huai Jesse tapa Eliab tanu ahihleh Abihail tanu ahi.
Tapate aneihsak a: Jeush, Shemariah leh Zaham ahi uh.
Amah nung in Absalom tanu Maakah anei a; ama'n Abijah, Atai, Ziza leh Shelomith aneihsak hi.
Rehoboam in Absalom tanu Maakah bel azite leh amite tengteng tung ah a-it tuan a; zi sawm-le-giat leh mei sawmguk anei a, tapa sawmnih-le-giat leh tanu sawmguk anei ahi.
Rehoboam in Maakah tapa Abijah, a-unaute lak ah makai lianpen in abawl a; kumpipa ding a bawl alungsim ahi zomah hi.
Piltak in agamta a, atapate tengteng Judah gam leh Benjamin gam tengteng kulh nei khopite ah a-om zaksak vek a; nek ding tampi apia a, zi tampi azonsak chiat hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Rehoboam in gam aphutkip a, mihattak ahong hih nung in amah lam a pang Israel tengteng toh TOUPA Pan alehngatsan uhi.
Hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Rehoboam vaihawm akum ngana kum in, TOUPA tung a atatlek ziak un, Jerusalem sim ding in Aigupta kumpipa Shishak ahong kuantou hi,
Kangtalai singkhat-le-sangnih leh sakol tungtuangmi singguk toh, Aigupta gammi hon zuite sim vual louh ahi uh; Libiate, Sukite, Ethiopiate ahi uhi.
Judah gam a kulh nei khopite ala a, Jerusalem ava tung hi.

Rehoboam leh Judahte intekpen, Shishak ziak a Jerusalem a kikaikhawmte kiang ah zawlnei Shemaiah ahohtou a, akiang uah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi, na hon lehngatsanta ua, huaiziak in ke'n leng noute Shishak khut ah ka hon koihta ahi achi," ava chi hi.
Huchi in Israel intekpen leh kumpipa akiniamkhiak ua, "TOUPA adiktat hi," achi uhi.

TOUPA'N akiniamkhiak uh atheih in TOUPA thu Shemaiah kiang ah ahong tung a, "Akiniamkhiakta ua; ka hihmang vek kei ding a, khenkhat ka humbit ding a, Shishak zang in Jerusalem tung ah ka hehna ka sungbo kei ding.
Himahleh asikhate ahi ding ua, ka nasep leh gamdangmi nasepdan atheihna ding un," chi in.
Huchi in Aigupta kumpipa Shishak Jerusalem sim in apaitou a, TOUPA' inn a goute leh kumpipa' inn a goute ala a; ala khin vek hi; Solomon bawl dangka-eng lumte leng ala hi.
Kumpipa Rehoboam in huaite tang in dal lumte abawl a, kumpipa' inn kongkhak ngakmi sepaih heutute akemsak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa TOUPA' inn a lut teng in veng mite'n ava pi ua, amah dantan ah akhakik nawn zel uhi.
Akiniamkhiak ziak a hihmanthat ahihlouhna ding in atung a TOUPA thangpaihna akiheimangta a; Judah gam leng ahoih gige hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in avaihawmna Jerusalem ah akipsakta hi: Rehoboam in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmli-le-khat a upa ahi, TOUPA'N amin omsakna ding a Israel nam tengteng lak a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-sagih vai ahawm a; anu min Naamah, Ammon mi ahi.
TOUPA zong dia alungsim azat louh ziak in thil hoih lou ahih hi.

Huchi in Rehoboam tanchin abul a kipan atawp pha in zawlnei Shemaiah gelh tanchinbu ah leh zawlnei Iddo gelh tanchinbu a suante tanchin lak a gelh ahi kei maw? Rehoboam leh Jeroboam bel a kidou nilouh uhi.
Huan Rehoboam api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khua ah avui ua: asik in atapa Abijah in vai ahawm hi.
Jeroboam kum sawm-le-giat avaihawm kum in Judahte tung ah Abijah in vai ahawm pan hi.
Jerusalem ah kum thum vai ahawm a, anu min Mikaiah, Gibeah mi Uriel tanu ahi. Huan Abijah leh Jeroboam bel akidou uhi.
Abijah in sepaih kidoumi, mihangsan telkhiak nuaili toh ava sual a, Jeroboam mihat hangsan telkhiak nuaigiat kiphalh in ana dou uhi.
Abijah bel Ephraim tanggam a om Zemariam tang tung ah adingh a, "Aw Jeroboam, Israelte tengteng toh na ngaikhia un;
TOUPA Israel' Pathian in Israel gam David leh atate kiang a chi a thukhun in tangtawn a ding in apia chih thei dia kilawm mahmah hilou na hi uh maw?
Himahleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam, David tapa Solomon sikha apu tung ah ahong hel maimah hi.
Rehoboam anaupang lai a, alungsim anem lai a, amaute ana nan theih louh lai in Solomon tapa Rehoboam kalh in mithulim lou Belial tate akikaikhawm uhi.
"David tapa lak ah TOUPA gam dou theih na kigingta kei ua: tamkuam leng hi ua, Jeroboam in pathiante ding a nou ahon bawlsak dangka-eng bawngnou limte leng na kiang uah a-om lai hi.

TOUPA siampu, Aaron tapate leh Levite delhkhia in, gamdang mite hihdan bang in siampu na kibawl uh ahi kei maw? Huchi in bawngtuai leh belam sagih a hong kilan peuhmahte pathian hiloupite siampu ahi thei zel mawk uhi.
"Himahleh kou zaw, ka Pathian uh TOUPA ahi a, amah ka lehngatsan kei ua: TOUPA a dia nasemmi amau nna chiat sem Aaron tapa siampute leh Levite ka nei uhi.

Ni teng leh zan teng in TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte, gimlimte ahal zel uh, tanghou siah leng dohkan siangthou ah akoih kichian gige uhi. Nitaklam teng a hal ding in dangka-eng khawnvak koihna akhawnvak toh; kou zaw TOUPA ka Pathian uh thupiak ka zui gige ua, nou bel amah na lehngatsan uhi.

Ngai dih ua, Pathian ka ma uh pi in ka kiang uah a-om a, asiampute leng apengkul ua nou hon noh ding a mut ding in a-om uhi. Aw, Israel suante aw TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian zaw dou mahmah kei un, na lamzang kei hial ding uh," achi hi.
Himahleh Jeroboam in anunglam uah aguktansak a: huchi in Judahte malam ah a-om ua, guktan mite anunglam uah a-om uh.
Judahte alehngat uleh anunglam uh leh amalam uah gal a-omta a, TOUPA asam ua, siampute'n pengkul amut uhi.
Huchi in Judahte akikou zuazua ua; huchi a Judahte akikou zuazua ualeh hichi ahong hi a, Abijah leh Judahte ma ah TOUPA'N Jeroboam leh Israelte tengteng avuallelsakta hi.
Israel suante Judahte ma ah ataikek ua, Pathian in akhut uah apeta hi.
Huchi in Abijah leh aheute'n amau athat ua: Israel mitel ngen nuainga athat uhi.
Huai tung in Israel suante vuallelhdan huchibang ahi, Judah suante'n TOUPA apipute uh Pathian amuan ziak un azouta uhi.
Huan Abijah in Jeroboam adelh a, akhuate alaksak a, Bethel akhotate toh, Jeshanah akhotate toh, Ephron akhotate toh.
Abijah vaihawm lai nite in Jeroboam in dinkhiak zohna anei nawn kei; TOUPA'N agawt a, asita hi.
Abijah bel ahat deuhdeuh a, zi sawm-le-li anei a, tapa sawmnih-le-nih leh tanu sawm-le-guk anei hi.
Abijah tanchin dangte leh a-omdante, athugente zawlnei Iddo hilhchetna bu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Huchi in Abijah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khopi ah avui ua, asik in atapa Asa in vai ahawmta hi. Avaihawm sung in agam uh kum sawm galmuang in a-om hi.
Asa in TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih leh thil dik ahih gige hi.
Gamdang pathian maitamte leh mun sangte alamang a, suangphuhte ahihchim a, Asherah songte aphuk hi.
Judahte TOUPA apipute uh Pathian zong ding leh adan leh athupiak zui ding in thu apia hi.
Huan Judahte khua tengteng a mun sangte leh milimte alamang vek a; amah nuai ah agam galmuang in a-om hi.
Judah gam ah kulh nei khopite abawl a, gam galmuang in a-om a, huai kumte in kidouna anei kei; TOUPA'N galmuanna apiak ziak in.

Judahte kiang ah, "Hiai khuate bawlpha nawn ni e, kulh in um lehang, insangte, kulh kongkhakte, akalhnate bawl ni: TOUPA i Pathian i zon tak ziak un gam i nuai uah ahong omta ahi: amah i zong ua, ama'n kil chih ning chih a galmuang a omna hon peta ahi,” achi hi. Huchi in abawlhoih ua, alamzang zelta uhi.
Asa in Judah mi lum leh tei tawimi sepaih nuaithum anei a: Benjamin mi phaw leh thal zangmi nuainih-le-singgiat; hiai tengteng mihat hangsan vek ahi uhi.
Huan Ethiopia mi Zerah, sepaih maktaduaikhat leh kangtalai zathum toh amau sual ding in ahong kuan a; Mareshah ahong tung hi.
Huchi in asual ding in Asa ava kuan a, Mareshah ah Zephathah Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.

Asa in TOUPA a Pathian asam a, "TOUPA kia lou ngal mihattak lak a hat lou panpih a-om kei a; aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, hon panpih ve; nang hon muang in na min in hiai mipite ka hong sual uhi. Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian uh na hi a, mihing in nang hon zou kei uhen,” achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Asa leh Judahte ma ah Ethiopia mite asual a; Ethiopia mite ataikekta uhi.
Asa leh aheute'n Gerar tan in adelh ua, Ethiopia mite asih tam mahmah ziak un apang thei kei ua; TOUPA leh asepaihte ma ah vuallelhsak in a-omta ua; gallak tampi ala uhi.
Gerar kim a khua tengteng asual ua, TOUPA launa atung uah a-om a, khua tengteng alok ua, gallak atam ngial hi.
Ganpute' puaninte leng asual ua, belam leh sangawngsau tampi ahawl ua, Jerusalem ah apai nawnta uhi.
Oded tapa Azariah tung ah Pathian kha ahong tung hi.

Asa dawn ding in apaikhia a, akiang ah, "Asa leh Judah mi tengteng leh Benjamin mite aw, ka thu ngaikhe dih ua, alam a na pan sung teng un nou lam ah TOUPA apang, amah na zon uleh na mu ding ua, amah na lehngatsan uleh ama'n ahon lehngatsan ding.
Israel mite sawtpi Pathian tak nei lou leh sinsakmi leh siampu nei lou leh dan nei lou in a-om uhi.
Himahleh, amangbat ua TOUPA Israel' Pathian lam angat ua, azontak un amu uhi.
Huai lai in apawt lam leh alut lamte a ding in galmuanna a-om kei a, gamsung a om tengteng a ding in mangbatna thupi mahmah ngen ahi zaw.
Nam leh nam, khua leh khua akihihsia ua, Pathian in haksatna chiteng in ahaksasak hi.
Himahleh, nou zaw hattak in om unla, kithadahsak kei un, na thilhih man uh na mu ding uhi," achi hi.

Huchi in Asa in huai thute leh zawlnei Oded thugente azak in akihangsak a, Judah gam leh Benjamin gam tengteng a kipan leh Ephraim tanggam a kholak a kipan athilkihhuaite apaimang vek a; TOUPA' inn lim chin a TOUPA maitam abawlhoih hi.
udah gam leh Benjamin gammi tengteng, akiang a om Ephraim leh Manasseh leh Simeon gam a mite toh asamkhawm vek a, TOUPA Pathian akiang ah a-om chih atheih un Israel gam a pan in ahong bel vek uhi.
Huchi in Asa vaihawm akum sawm leh kum nga, akha thumna ah Jerusalem ah akikaikhawm uhi.
Huai ni in agallak uh bawngtal zasagih leh belam sangsagih in TOUPA kiang ah akithoih uhi.
Alungsim uh leh alungtang tengteng un TOUPA apipute uh Pathian zong ding leh;
kuapeuh TOUPA Israel' Pathian zong lou aneu leh alian, anumei apasal in hihlup ding thu akhung uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah aw ngaihtak a ging in, akikou ua, pengkul ging toh, pengkul binei ging toh akichiam uhi.
Judah mi tengteng akichiamna uah akipak ua, alungtangtak ua kichiam a, kituaktak a ahih ziak un, muh leng amu him ua; huchi in TOUPA'N mun chih ah galmuang a omna apia hi.
Kumpipa Asa nu Maakah leng milim kihhuaitak Asherah abawlsak ziak in akumpinu hihna atawpsak a; huchi in Asa in milim aphuk a, ahihzan vek a, Kidron lui ah ahal hi.
Himahleh, Israel gam a kipan mun sangte paihmang ahi kei a; himahleh Asa lungsim avaihawm sung in akizen gige hi.
Apa thillatte leh ama latte dangkasik, dangka-eng, tui-um belsuan Pathian inn ah alalut hi.
Asa vaihawm lai kum sawmthum-le-nga sung in kidou himhim a-om nawn kei hi.
Asa kum sawmthum-le-guk avaihawm kum in Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judahte asual a, Judah kumpipa kiang a lut ding leh pawt ding dalna ding in Ramah khua abawl hi.
Huchi in Asa in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou dangkasik leh dangka-engte alakhia a, Damaskas a Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad kiang ah,

"Ka pa leh na pa kal a thukhun a-om bang mah in i kikal ah thukhun a-om a, ngai dih, dangkasik leh dangka-engte ka hon khak ahi; kisa dih, Israel kumpipa Baasha in ahon tawpsanna ding in akiang ah na thukhun phel nawn mai in," chi in akhak hi.
Huchi in Ben-hadad in kumpipa Asa thu ana pom a; Israel khuate sual ding in sepaih heutute asawl a, Ijon khua, Dan khua, Abel-maim khua, Naphtali gam a vankoihna khua tengteng asual uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Baasha in huai thu azak in Ramah khua abawl lai akhawlsan a, athilhih tup akikhelsakta hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Asa in Judah mi tengteng api a. Baasha in Ramah khua bawlna ding a suang leh sing azatte ala vek ua, huaite in Geba leh Mizpah khua abawl hi.
Huai lai in zawlnei Hanani Judah kumpipa Asa kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian muang lou in Siria kumpipa na muang a, huaiziak in Siria kumpipa sepaihhonte na khahta ahi.
Ethiopiate leh Libiate sepaihhon liantak, kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite tampi ahi kei uh maw? Himahleh TOUPA na muan ziak in na khut ah ahon pia hi.
Amah lam a lungsim diktak pu mite tung a ahatdan hihlang ding in leitung tengteng ah TOUPA mit avak dundun hi. Haihuai mahmah in thil na hihta a; tuban dou na nei gige ding," achi hi.
Huchi in zawlnei tung ah Asa aheh a, suangkul ah akhumta a; athugen ziak in aheh mahmah mai hi. Asa in mi khenkhatte leng asimmoh behlap lai hi.
Huan ngai dih ua, Asa tanchin abul a kipan a atawp pha in Judah leh Israel kumpipate tanchin gelhna bu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Kum sawmthum-le-kua vai ahawm kum in Asa khe ahong na a; anatna thupitak ahi; himahleh anatna ah TOUPA zong lou in damdawi siamte azong zaw hi.
Huchi in api-le-pute kiang ah Asa a-ihmu a, kum sawmli-le-khat avaihawm kum in asita hi.
David khopi a amah a tuam dia ahankhuk ah avui ua, gimlimtak, gimlim bawl mite'n gimlim chí tuamtuam a dim a kibawl lupna ah asial ua, amah zahtakna in meikuang thupi mahmah asem uhi.
Asik in atapa Jehoshaphat alal a, Israel mite dou ding in akihihhat hi.
Huchi in Judah gam a kulh nei khopi tengteng ah sepaih akoih a; Judah gam leh apa Asa in ana lak Ephraim gam a khuate ah galvilmi akoih hi.
Huan Jehoshaphat kiang ah TOUPA a-om a; Baal zong lou a, apu David in atot masaksa lampi tawn a,
apipute uh Pathian zong a, Israel mite hih bang hih lou a, athupiakte azuih zawk ziak in.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N akhut ah agam ahihkip a, huchi in Judah gammi tengteng in Jehoshaphat kipahman ahong pia ua, ahong hau in athupi hiaihiai hi.
TOUPA lam ah alungsim a-awn a, Judah gam a kipan mun sangte leh Asherahte aphiatmang vek hi.
Kum thum avaihawm kum in amilian Benhail, Obadiah, Zekariah, Nathanael, Mikaiah, Judah gam khuate a mite sinsak ding in asawlkhia a;
Levi mi, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, Tobadonijah atel tei ua, siampu Elishama leh Jehoramte leng atel uhi.
TOUPA Dan Bu atawi ua, Judah gam ah asinsak ua, Judah gam khua tengteng tawn in mite asinsak uhi.
Huchi in Judah gam leh akim gam tengteng a mite'n TOUPA laudan asiam ua, kuamah in Jehoshaphat adou ngam kei uhi.
Philistia mi khenkhat in Jehoshaphat kipahman ahong pia ua, siah ding in dangkasik leng ape lai uh; Arabia mite'n ganhon, belamtal sangsagih-le-zasagih leh keltal sangsagih-le-zasagih ahon kai uhi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat ahong thupi mahmah a, Judah gam ah kulhte leh thil koihkhawmna khuate abawl a, Judah gam khuate ah nasep tampi anei hi.
Jerusalem ah sepaih mihat hangsante ahau behlap lai hi.
A-inkuankuan ua a-omdan uh hichibang ahi: Judah inkuan a sangkhat heutute, heutu Adnah in mihat hangsan nuaithum aheu hi.
Azom Jehohanan in nuainih-le-singgiat aheu hi.
Azom nawn Zikri tapa Amasiah bel kiphaltak a TOUPA a ding a kipia in, mihat hangsan nuainih aheu hi.
Benjamin inkuante mihat hangsan Eliada in thal leh lum zangmi nuainih aheu hi.
Azom Jehozabad in galkap ding a mansiangsa nuaikhat- le-singgiat aheu hi.
Hiai tengteng Judah gam a kulh nei khopi a kumpipa'n akoihte sim louh akumpipa kiang a om gigete ahi uh.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat bel hong hau in athupi mahmah a, huchi in Ahab toh kizopna abawl hi.
Kum bangzah hiam nung in Samaria ah Ahab kiang ah ahohsuk a, Ahab in amah leh aheute belam leh bawngtalte tampi ana goh a, Ramoth-gilead a hohtouhpih ding in achial hi.

Israel kumpipa Ahab in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead ah i hohtoukhawm kei dia hia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, gal i doukhawm ding uh," achi hi.
Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA thu hungaih phot lai in," achi hi.

Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n, zawlneite mi zali asamkhawm a, akiang uah, "Ramoth-gilead khua sual ding in ka kuan ding uam, kuan lou ding?" achi hi. Amau, "Kuan in, Pathian in kumpipa khut ah ape ding," achi uhi.
Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "TOUPA zawlnei kuate hiam i dot ding a-om kei ua eita aw?" achi hi.

Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "TOUPA hon dotsak ding mi khat a-om; himahleh amah bel ka muhdah lamtak ahi; ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam kia lou ngal ahoih lam himhim agen ngei kei a; huai mi bel Imla tapa Mikaiah ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n heutu khat asam a, "Imla tapa Mikaiah hon pi meng dih," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Samaria kulh kongpi lutna chin mun awng ah akumpi puan ua kizem in alaltutphah tuaktuak uah atu ua; zawlnei tengteng in ama uah thu agen uhi.
Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kiite abawl a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiaite in Siriate mangthang sipsip khop in na sual ding achi," achi hi.
Huchi mah bang in zawlnei dangte'n leng, "Ramoth-gilead ah hoh inla, lamzang in; TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ape ding hi," chi in agen uhi.

Mikaiah sam dia asawlpa un, "Ngai dih, zawlneite'n kithutuaktak in ahoih lam in kumpipa kiang ah thu agen chiat ua; huaiziak in nang leng achihsa bang un ahoih lam in va gen sam dih ve," chi in agen hi.
Huan Mikaiah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka chi hi, ka Pathian in achih bang geih in ahi ka gen ding," achi hi.

Huchi in kumpipa kiang atun in kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead khua sual ding in ka kuan ding uam, kuan lou ding?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Kuan unla, va lamzang un, na khut a piak ahi ding hi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Thutak keleu lou ka kiang ah TOUPA min a gen lou ding in bangzah vei ahia nang ka hon kichiamsak ding?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Belamchingtu nei lou bang in Israel tengteng tang ah dalhzak in ka mu a; TOUPA'N, hiaite'n heutu anei kei ua, amau inn lam ah lungmuangtak in pai diam uhen achi," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka tungtang thu zaw aselam kia lou ngal ahoih lam himhim ahihleh agen sam kei ding chih ka hon hilh ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Mikaiah in agen nawn a, "TOUPA thu ngaikhia un, TOUPA alaltutphah a tu, van mipite tengteng ataklam leh aveilam a dingh ka mu hi.
TOUPA'N Ramoth-gilead a Israel kumpipa Ahab kuantou a, va si ding a kua'n ahia khem ding? achih chiang in khat in, 'Huchi khachi in' achi a, midang in, 'Huchibang khachibang in' achi hi.
Kha khat ahong pawt a, TOUPA ma a dingh in, 'Ke'n ka khem ding,' achi hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, 'Bang in eita?' achi hi.
Ama'n, 'Ka va hoh ding a, zawlneite tengteng kam ah kha zuauthei in ka va suak ding,' achi hi. Huan ama'n, 'Na va khem ngei ding a, na lohching ding, kuan inla, huchibang in hih in,' " achi hi.
Huchi in ngai dih, TOUPA'N, "Hiai zawlneite kam ah kha zuauthei akoih a; na tungthu TOUPA'N ahoih lou lam in agenta ahi," achi hi.
Huaitak in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ava naih a, Mikaiah biang ah abeng a, "Na kiang a thugen ding TOUPA kha in koilam a hon pawtsan ahia?" achi hi.
Mikaiah in, "Ngai dih, dantan sunggil a bu ding a na lut ni chiang in na hon thei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n, "Mikaiah pi unla, kho ukpa Ammon leh kumpipa tapa kiang ah paipih nawn un.
Kumpipa'n hichi in achi a, 'Hiai mi suangkul ah khum unla, lungmuangtak a ka hong pai nawn masiah gimthuakna an leh gimthuakna tui pia un,' achi a, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
Huan Mikaiah in, "Lungmuang- tak a na hong pai nawn peuhmahleh TOUPA'N kei hon zang a thu gen lou ahi ding hi," achi a, amah mah in, "Nou mipi tengteng in leng na za un," achi hi.
Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ava hohtou uhi.

Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Kei ka kibawl lamdang ding a, kisualna ah ka hoh sam ding; nang zaw na kumpipa puan kisilh in," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa bel akibawl lamdang a, kidouna ah ahohtou hi.
Siria kumpipa'n akangtalaite tung a heutute kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa lou ngal mineu leng milian leng na sual ding uh ahi kei," chi in thu apia hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, "Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Jehoshaphat amuh uleh Israel kumpipa ahi ve," achi ua. Huchi in sual tum in a-umta uhi; himahleh Jehoshaphat akikou a, TOUPA'N apanpihta a, huchi in Pathian in amau amah anusesak hi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, kangtalai tung a heutute'n Israel kumpipa ahi kei chih atheih un delh nawn lou in akiksanta uhi.

Mi khat in ngim tuam nei lou in athalpeu alai a, Israel kumpipa a-awmphaw leh a-awmphaw kikal ah akha a, huchi in akangtalai hawlpa kiang ah, "Lehhawl inla, mipi lak a kipan hon paikhiakpih in, liamna natak ka tuak hi," achi hi.
Huai ni in kisualna athupi mahmah a; Israel kumpipa bel Siriate lam nga in akangtalai ah nitaklam tanpha in adingh a; huan nitum kuan in asita hi.
Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bel lungmuangtak in Jerusalem a a-inn ah apai nawnta hi.
Huchi in zawlnei Hanani tapa Jehu in ana dawn a, kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Migilou na panpih in ToUPA ho mite na it ding ahi maw? Hiai ziak in TOUPA thangpaihna, na tung ah ahong omta hi.
Himahleh hiai gam a kipan Asherah na paimang a, TOUPA na zon ziak in hoihna lam banghiam khat na nei lai hi," achi hi.
Jehoshaphat bel Jerusalem ah a-om a; huan Beer-sheba a kipan a Ephraim tanggam pha in amite lak ah ahoh nawn a, TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian lam ah ama'n apikik nawn vek hi.
Huchi in kho chih ah Judah gam kulh nei khopi tengteng ah vaihawmte akoih a, vaihawmte kiang ah,
"Na thilhih uh hoihtak a ngaihtuah in hih un, mihing a ding a vaihawm na hi kei ua, TOUPA a ding ahi zaw ngal a; vaihawmna ah na kiang uah atel zel ahi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA lau unla, pilvangtak in hih un; TOUPA i Pathian ah gitlouhna, khentuam neihna leh golh neknate a-om kei," achi hi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem a ahong kik nawn un TOUPA vaihawm ding leh thubuaite lemmi ding in Levite, siampute, Israel inkuan makaite akoih behlap hi.
"TOUPA laudan siam kawm in muanhuaitak in, lungsim diktak pu in na hih ding uh ahi.

Koi lai khua a mi in leng thubuai ahong gen ua, tualthah thu, dan leh thupiak thu, dan thuseh leh vaihawm thute a hong kilan uleh, TOUPA tung a thil ahihkhelhlouhna ding un amau pilvangtak in na hilh ding ua, nou leh na unaute uh tung ah thangpaihna ahong tung zenhouh kha ding; huchibang in hih le uchin, mohsak in na om kei ding uhi.

"Huan ngai dih ua, TOUPA lam thu tengteng ah siampu lianpen Amariah bel na heutu uh ahi a; kumpipa lam thu tengteng ah Judah inkote tung a vaihawmmi Ishmael tapa Zebadiah ahi: Levite leng na heutute uh ahi sam ding uh. Hangtak in hih unla, mihoihte kiang ah TOUPA om hen," achi hi.
Huan Solomon in TOUPA min a ding inn leh kumpipa inn ding toh lam atum hi.
Solomon in van po ding mi singsagih leh mual a singphukmi singgiat leh amau vengmi sangthum-le-zaguk asep hi.
Solomon in Tura kumpipa Huram kiang ah, "Ka pa David thil na hihsak a, a-omna inn lamna ding sidarte na khak bang in, kei leng hon kithuahpih sam in.

Ngai dih, TOUPA ka Pathian min a-inn amah a dia lam a, ama a gimlim hal a, tanghou siah koih gige a, Sabbathte, kha thakte, TOUPA ka Pathian ankuanglui nite a zingsang leh nitak a halmang thillat latna ding inn ka lam ding ahi. Hiaite Israelte a ding in tangtawn thupiak ahi.
Huchi in ka inn lam tup athupi mahmah ding ahi; pathian tengteng sang a ka Pathian uh thupizaw ahih ziak in.
Van, vante van ah leng ta lou ahi ngal a, kua'n ahia a-inn lamsak thei ding? Kei, ama a gimlim halna ding lel chih louh ngal kei leltak in ka lamsak thei mahmah dia hia?

Huchi in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a mikhutsiamte ka pa David in ana zatsek, tu in ka kiang a omte lak a sem ding in mi khat, dangka-eng, dangkasik, dal, sik lam khoih thei, puan sandup, san-au, dumpuang bawl siam, gelh bangchibang peuh siam mi hon sawl in.
Lebanon a sidar sing, meilah sing, algum sing leng hon khak lechin; na mite'n Lebanon a singphuk asiam mahmah uh chih ka thei ngal a; huchi in ngai dih, ka mite nang mite lak ah tel sam le uh,
sing tampi hon ngaihtuahsak ding: ka inn lam tup athupi mahmah ding ahi.
Ngai dih, na singphuk mite huit buh pota a singnih leh barli buh pota singnih leh uain bath singnih leh thau bath singnih ka pe ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
Huchi in Tura kumpipa Huram in, "TOUPA'N amite a-it ziak in akumpipa ding ua nang hon bawl ei ve," chi in lai khak in Solomon adawng hi.
Huram in, "TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, lei leh van bawlpa, TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn lam ding a pilna leh theihna nei tapa piltak kumpipa David pepa phat in om hen.
Mikhutsiam, theihtheihna nei, ka pa Huram amah mah, ka hon sawl a,

Dan suan a mi numei khat tapa ngei, apa bel Tura a mi, dangka-eng lam, dangkasik lam, dal lam, sik lam, suang lam, sing lam, puan sandup, dumpuang, puanmalngat, sandang khoihsa, gelh bangchibang leng siam, siam chiteng siam ahi a; nang mikhutsiamte leh ka pu, na pa David khutsiamte lak ah ahong sem ding uhi.
Huchi in huit buh, barli buh, thau, uain thu ka toupa'n agen asikhate hon khak hen.
Huchi in kou Lebanon a sing na deih zahzah ka na phuk ding ua, tuipi ah Jopa tan in ka hon tolhsak ding uh; huan, nang Jerusalem ah na nawntou ding hi," achi hi.
Huan Solomon in Israel gam a apa David in asimsa, namdangmi tengteng asim a, nuaikhat singnga sangthum-le-zaguk ahi uh.
Huchi in van po ding mi singsagih leh tang a singphukmi singgiat leh mipite sepdan ngaihtuahsak ding mi sangthum-le-zaguk asep hi.
Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Moab suante leh Ammon suante khenkhat toh Jehoshaphat sual ding in ahong kuan uhi.

Huchi in kuate hiam in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Nang sual ding in mipi thupi mahmah, tuipi gal Siria a kipan ahong kuan uhi; ngai in, Hazazon-tamar ah a-omta ua, huai 'Engedi' leng achi uh," chi in agen uhi.
Jehoshaphat alau a, TOUPA zong ding in akipia a; Judah gam tengteng ah an ngawl ding thu athangsak hi.
Huchi in Judahte bel TOUPA panpihna zong in akikaikhawm ua; Judah kho chih a kipan TOUPA zong ding in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
Jehoshaphat TOUPA' inn ah, intual thak chin ah Judah leh Jerusalem kikaikhawm lak ah adingh a;

"Aw TOUPA ka pi-le-pute uh Pathian, van Pathian, van a Pathian na hi kei a hia? Namte' lalgam tung a vaihawmpa na hi kei a hia? Na khut ah thilhihtheihna leh hatna a-om a, kuamah zoh vual na hi kei hi.
Aw ka Pathian uh, hiai gam a tengte na mi Israelte na ma ah na delhkhiaksak a, na lawm Abraham suante tangtawn a dia na piak ahi kei maw?
Hiai gam ah ahong omta ua, na min a ding in mun siangthou ahon lamsak uhi.

Ka tung uah thil hoih lou, namsau a vaihawmnate hiam, hiite hiam, kialte hiam ahong tunleh hiai inn ma leh nangmah ma ah ka hong dingh ding ua, hiai inn ah lah na min a-om ngal a, ka mangbatna uah nang ka hon sam ding ua, nang na hon na ngaihkhiaksak in na hon hondam ding," chi in.
"Huchi in ngai in, Ammon suante leh Moabte leh Seir tang a mi, Israelte, Aigupta gam a kipan ahong paikhiak lai un, amau asim uh na phal kei a, amau a kipan akiheimang zaw ua, amau ahihmang kei uhi.
Ka luah ding ua na hon piak gam a kipan hon delhkhe ding in ahong kuan uhi.

Aw ka Pathian uh, atung ua vaihawm lou ding na hi maw? Mi huai zahzah hon sual ding a hong kuante lah na sualthei ding dan mahmah ka hi kei ua; alohna dan ka thei kei ua, nang lam ka hong nga zaw mai uhi,” achi hi.
Judahte tengteng, anau neu chikchik uh, azite uh atate uh toh TOUPA ma ah adingh uhi.
Huchi in mipi lak ah Jahajiel tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, huai mi Zekariah tapa ahi a, huai mi Benaiah tapa ahi a, huai mi Jeiel tapa ahi a, huai mi Asaph suan Levi mi Mataniah tapa ahi.

Ama'n, "Nou Judah gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a teng tengteng leh nang Jehoshaphat, na ngaikhia un: TOUPA'N na kiang uah hichi in achi, 'Lau kei unla, huai mipi thupi mahmahte ziak in leng lunglel sam kei un; kidouna noute kidouna ahi kei a, Pathian kidouna ahi zaw ngal a.
Zingchiang in va sual un; ngai dih ua, Ziz zottouhna ah ahong tou ua, Jeruel gamdai chin phaizang tawp lam ah na va mu ding uh.

Hiai kidouna na sual uh akiphamoh kei ding: kiphalh unla, adin in dingh mai unla, nou lam a pang TOUPA hotdamna tak en gige un, Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite aw: lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un, zingchiang in sual ding in kuan un, TOUPA lah nou lam ah apang ngal a,' " achi hi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat bel amai a lei si in akun a; Judah mite tengteng leh Jerusalem mite tengteng TOUPA bia in TOUPA ma ah akun uhi.
Kohath suan leh Korah suan Levite aw ngaihtak a TOUPA Israel' Pathian phat ding in ahong dinghta uhi.

Huchi in zingsang in zingkhang in athou ua, Tekoa gamdai ah alut ua; apai lai un Jehoshaphat adingh a, "Aw, Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; TOUPA na Pathian uh ging unla, kiptak in dingh unla, azawlneite gingta un, hileh lamzangtak in na om ding uh," achi hi.

Mipite ahanthawn khit in sepaihte ma a pai kawm a TOUPA pahtawina leh asiangthou kilawmdan phat ding a lasami dingte a sep hi, "Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un, azahngaihna lah tangtawn in a-om sin ngal a, chi un," achi hi.
Huan la asak ua aphattak un Ammon suante, Moab suante, tang a mite Judate sual ding a hong kuante guktan ding mite TOUPA'N akoih a; avuallelta uhi.
Ammon suante leh Moab suante'n Seir tang a omte thah chimih vek leh hihman sipsip tum in asualta uhi. Seir tang a mite ahihman khit un amau leh amau kihihman tum in akisual nilouh uhi.
Judahte'n gamdai etna mun sang ava tun uleh mipi lam a-en ua; ngai dih, misi luang lei ah apuk zengzung a, khat lel leng asuakta kei uhi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat leh aheute gallak la ding in ava hoh ua, alak uah sum-le-paite, puansilhte, suangmantamte ava mu ua, apuak zoh louh khop un ala ua, atam petmah a, ni thum tak gallak asek uhi.
Ani li ni in Berakah Phaizang ah akikhawm ua, huai ah TOUPA apahtawi ua; huaiziak in tutan in huai lai mun, Berakah Phaizang achi uhi.
Huchi in Judah mi leh Jerusalem mi tengteng apai nawn ua Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem a nuamsatak a pai ding in ama uh akai hi; TOUPA'N amelmate uh tungthu a nuamsatak a a-omsak ziak in.
Huchi in pekgingte, kaihgingte, pengkulte toh Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn atungtou uhi.
TOUPA'N Israelte melma asual chih atheih un, gam chih a mite'n Pathian alauta uhi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat gam galmuang in a-omta a; a Pathian in akimvel a mite lak a galmuanna apiak ziak in.
Jehoshaphat in Judah tung ah vai ahawmta a; kum sawmthum-le-nga a upa ahih in vaihawm apan a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-nga vai ahawm a; anu min Azubah, Silhi tanu ahi.
TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih hih in apa Asa lampi pialsan het lou in azui hi.
Himahleh mun sangte paihmang ahi kei a, mipite'n leng apipute uh Pathian tung ah alungtang uh anga tuan sam kei uh.
Huan ngai dih ua, Jehoshaphat thilhih tengteng abul a kipan atawp pha in Hanani tapa Jehu tanchin gelhna bu ah atuang a, Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Huai nung in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa Ahaziah, thil hoih loutak a hihsekpa akithutuahpih hi:
Tarshish lam a pai ding long abawlkhawm ua, Ezion-geber ah longte abawl uhi.

Huchi in Mareshah mi Dodavah tapa Eliezer in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ahaziah na kithuahpih ziak in TOUPA'N na thilhih tup ahon hihsiatsakta ahi," achi hi. Huchi in longte akise vek ua, Tarshish ah ahoh thei kei uhi.
Jehoshaphat api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, apute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui uhi. Asik in atapa Jehoram alalta hi.
Ama'n unau, Jehoshaphat tapate anei a, Azariah, Jehiel, Zekariah, Azariahu, Mikael leh Shephatiah ahi uh. Hiai tengteng Israel kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapate vek ahi uhi.
Apa un thil thupi taktak apia a, dangkasik, dangka-eng, thil mantam pipite, Judah gam a kulh nei khopite toh; himahleh gamte pen Jehoram apia a, ata upapen ahih ziak in.
Huchi in Jehoram in apa gam luah in ahong kihihhatta a, a-unaute tengteng namsau in Israelte lak a intek tampi toh athat vek hi.
Jehoram bel kum sawmthum-le-nih a upa ahih in vaihawm apan a: Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
Ahab inkote hih bang in Israel kumpipate lampi azui hi: Ahab tanu zi in anei hi. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA'N David inkote ahihmang nuam kei; David kiang a thukhun ziak leh amah leh asuante tan a khawnvak neihsak thak ana chiam khit ziak in.
Amah dam lai in Judahte lak a kipan Edomte ahel ua, kumpipa akibawltawm uh.
Huchi in Jehoram asepaih heutute leh akangtalai tengteng toh akuankhia a, zan in akuan a, amau leh kangtalai tung a heutute amau umkual Edomte asual hi.
Huchi in Edomte tuni tan in Judahte lak ah ahel lailai uh, huai lai mah in Libnah khote leng ahel uh; TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian alehngatsan ziak in.
Huan Judah gam tangte ah mun sang abawl a, Jerusalem mite a-angkawmsak a, Judahte apimang hi.
Huchi in zawlnei Elijah a kipan akiang ah lai ahong tung a, "TOUPA, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na pa Jehoshaphat lampite na tawn kei a, Judahte kumpipa Asa lampite leng na zui kei hi.
Israel kumpipate lampi na zui zaw a, Judahte leh Jerusalem a omte Ahab inkuan bang in ang na kawmsak a, na unau, na pa inkuante nang sang a hoihzaw na that lai hi.
Ngai dih, TOUPA'N na mite, na tate, na zite, na gante hipi in agawt ding a;
gilpi natna thupi mahmah na nei ding a, niteng in natna ziak a na ngoi teng atolhkhiak vek tan in na chi ana ding, " chi in.
Huchi in Ethiopia mite kiang a mi Philistiate leh Arabiate lungsim Jehoram sual ding in TOUPA'N atokthou hi.
Huchi in Judate ava sual ua, agam uah alut ua, kumpipa' inn a thil tengteng ala vek ua, atapate, azite uh leng; atapa naupangpen Jehoahaz lousiah atapa dang anutsiat kei uhi.
Huai nung in TOUPA'N hihdam thei louh gilnatna in agawt hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum nihna abei in anatna ziak in angoi apilhkhia a, natna mulkimhuaitak in asita hi. Amite'n apa meipi asehsak bang un asehsak kei uhi.
Avaihawm tung in kum sawmthum-le-nih ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm a, kuamah it louh in asi a, David khopi ah kumpipate han lou ah avui uhi.

Huchi in Jerusalem mite'n atapa naupangpen Ahaziah asik in kumpipa ding in abawl ua; ata upate tengteng, Arab sepaihhonte, apanmun ua hong pai mite'n athat khin vek uhi. Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah in vai ahawmta hi.
Ahaziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmli-le-nih a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ahawm a, anu min Athaliah, Omri tanu ahi.
Ama'n leng Ahab inkote lampi tot atawn a; anu bel thil giloutak a thuhilhtu ahi.
Ahab inkote hih bang mah in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a, apa sih nung in asiatna ding a thuhilhtu ahi.
Amah leng athuhilh un a-om a, Ramoth-gilead ah Siria kumpipa Hazael dou ding in Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Jehoram kiang ah ahoh a, huchi in Siriate'n Jehoram asuliam uhi.

Siria kumpipa Hazael asualna a Ramah a asukliam uh hihdam ding in Jezreel ah ahoh hi. Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Azariah bel Ahab tapa Jehoram adam louh ziak in aveh ding in Jezreel ah akuan hi.
Huchi in Jehoram kiang ah Ahaziah ahoh a, amanthatna Pathian hih ahi; Nimshi tapa Jehu sual ding in Jehoram kiang a ahoh ziak in. Huai mi bel Ahab inkote hihmang ding a TOUPA seh ahi him hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahab inkote hihse ding a asual lai in Judahte intekte leh Ahaziah nasem a-unau tapate amu a, athat vek hi.

Ahaziah azong ua, Samaria a akibuk lai in aman ua, Jehu kiang ah ahon pi ua, athat ua; alungtang tengteng a TOUPA Zong sek Jehoshaphat tapa ahi, achi ua, avui in avuithoh uhi. Huchi in Ahaziah inkote'n agam uah thuneihna aneita kei uhi.
Huan Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa si chih azak in athou a, Judah inkote kumpipa tengteng athat vek hi.

Ahaziah tapa Joash bel kumpipa tanu Jehosabeath in kumpipa tapa athahte uh lak a kipan aselmang a, naudonmi toh lupna dantan sung ah asel hi. Huchi in kumpipa Jehoram tanu Jehosabeath, siampu Jehoiada zi in, (amah Ahaziah sanggamnu ahi a) Athaliah muh louh ding in aselgu a, huchi in athah in a-om kei hi.
Akiang ua teng in Pathian inn ah kum guk aguk in akibu a; huchi in Athaliah in agam uah vai ahawm hi.
Akum sagih kum in Jehoiada akihatsak a, sepaih zaheutu, Jehoram tapa Azariah, Jehohanan tapa Ishmael, Obed tapa Azariah, Adaiah tapa Maaseiah, Jikri tapa Elisaphath kiang ah thu akhung hi.
Huchi in Judah gam ah avak ua, Judah gam kho chih a Levite leh Israel inkuan intekte akaikhawm ua, Jerusalem ava tungtou uhi.
Kikaikhawmte tengteng in Pathian inn ah kumpipa kiang ah thu akhung uhi. Huan akiang uah, "Ngai dih ua, TOUPA'N David tapate tungtang thu ana gen bang in kumpipa tapa in vai ahawm ding ahi.
Na hih ding uh hichibang ahi, siampute leh Levite Sabbath ni a hong kuansekte seh thum a khen seh khat kongkhak ngak mite na hi ding ua;
seh thum a khen seh khat kumpipa' inn ah na om ding ua; huan seh thum a khen seh khat kulh kongpi ah; mipi tengteng bel TOUPA intual sung ah a-om ding uh.
Himahleh, siampute leh nasemmi Levite kia lou ngal kuamah TOUPA' inn ah lut kei un, amau bel asiangthou ziak un alut ding ua, mipi tengteng bel TOUPA hungaih in a-om ding uhi.
Levite'n agalvan uh tawi in kumpipa a-um ding ua; kuapeuh inn a hong lut thah ding ahi a; huan kumpipa apawt leh alut in amah kiang ah om zel un," achi hi.

Huchi in Levite leh Judah tengteng in siampu Jehoiada thupiak bang in ahih ua; amaute heute chiat Sabbath ni a hong kuan dingte leh Sabbath ni a tawp dingte api ua; siampu Jehoiada in atawp ding pawl lah atawpsak nai kei hi.
Siampu Jehoiada in sepaih za heutute ToUPA' inn a om kumpipa David tei leh lum neu leh lum liante apia hi.
Huan mite galvan tawi chiat in taklam sang a kipan in veilam sang tan in maitam leh inn um in kumpipa a-umsak uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa tapa ahon pikhia ua, lallukhu akhusak ua, theihsakna thu apia ua, kumpipa in abawl ua, Jehoiada leh atapate'n thau anilh ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen," achi uhi.
Athaliah in mipi kumpipa pahtawi a mipi kiphu motmot husa azak in TOUPA' inn ah mipi lak ah ava hoh hi.

A-en a, ngai in, kongpi a khuambul ah kumpipa adingh a, akiang ah sepaih heutute leh pengkul mut mite toh; huai gam a mi tengteng in nuam asa mahmah ua, pengkulte amut zuazua ua; lasa mite'n athil gingtheite uh tum in phatna la asakhawm uhi. Huchi in Athaliah in apuante abotkek a, "Kiphialgukna; kiphialgukna ahi ve," achi hi.

Huan siampu Jehoiada in sepaihte tung a heutu dia seh sepaih za heutute apikhia a, akiang uah, "Sepaihte kikal ah pawtsak unla, huan kuapeuh azuizui namsau a satlup hi hen," achi hi. Siampu in, "TOUPA' inn ah zaw thah ding ahi kei," achita hi.
Huchi in lampi a-awn ua, sakol lutna kongpi ah kumpipa' inn ah ahoh a, huai ah athat uhi.
Huan Jehoiada in amah leh mipi tengteng leh kumpipa kikal ah TOUPA mite hi ding in thu akhung hi.
Mipi tengteng Baal inn ah ahoh ua, ahihsia ua, amaitamte, alimte ahihtam dimdem ua, Baal siampu Matan, maitam bul ah athat uhi.

Jehoiada in, Mosi Dan Bu a gelh bang a nuamsatak leh la sa kawm a, David in TOUPA' inn a TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat lan ding a ana seh siampu Levite nuai a sem ding in David thupiak bang in TOUPA' inn ngakmi dingte asep hi.
Siangthou lou peuhmah alutlouhna ding un TOUPA' inn kongkhak ngak mite asep hi.

Huan zakhat tung a heutute, mihoihte, mipi uk mite, huai gammi tengteng api a, TOUPA' inn a kumpipa apikhia ua; kongkhak saknungzaw ah kumpipa' inn lam ah ahoh ua, kumpipa agam laltutphah ah atusakta uhi.
Huchi in namsau a Athaliah athah nung un huai gam a mi tengteng nuamsatak in a-om ua, khopi galmuang in a-omta hi.
Joash in vaihawm apat tung in kum sagih a upa ahi; Jerusalem ah kum sawmli vai ahawm a; anu min Zibiah, Beer-sheba mi ahi.
Joash in siampu Jehoiada damsung in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Jehoiada in amah zi nih aguan a, tapate leh tanute anei hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in Joash in TOUPA' inn bawlphat lungsim in anei hi.

Siampute leh Levite akaikhawm a, "Judate khuate ah hoh unla kum teng a na Pathian inn uh bawlphatna ding in Israel mi tengteng kiang ah sum-le-pai khonkhawm unla, zekai kei un," achi hi. Himahleh Levite akintat tuan kei uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa'n siampu lianpen Jehoiada asam a, akiang ah, "Bangziak a Levite TOUPA sikha Mosi leh Israel mipite seh theihsak a puanin a dia thoh bikhiah seh Judah mi leh Jerusalem mite thoh ding a phut lou na hia?
Migilou nu Athaliah tapate'n lah Pathian inn ahihse khinta ua, huan, TOUPA' inn a thillat tengteng Baalte ape khin behlap lai uh," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apia a, bawm abawl ua, TOUPA in kongpi polam ah akoih uhi.
Gamdai a Pathian sikha Mosi in Israel mite hih ding a thoh bikhiah a seh TOUPA a ding a thoh ding in Judah gam tengteng leh Jerusalem ah thu athangsakta hi.
Huchi in miliante leh mipite akipak ua, adangkate uh ahon la ua, akhon khit masiah uh bawm ah ahong koihkoih mai uhi.

Levite'n kumpipa upate kiang a bawm ahon tawi ua, dangka tampi a-om chih atheih un kumpipa laigelhmi leh siampu kumpipa seh upa in bawm a kipan abungkhia a, ala ua, amun ah akoih nawn uh. Huchibang in niteng in ahih ua, dangka tampi akholkhawmta uhi.
Kumpipa leh Jehoiada in TOUPA' inn nasem mite khut ah apia ua, TOUPA' inn bawlpha ding in suangsek mite, khutsiamte, TOUPA' inn bawlpha ding in sik leh dal a khutsiamte leng aguai hi.
Huchi in nasem mite'n asem pan ua, asem hoih mahmah ua, Pathian inn angei bang geih in abawlhoih ua, adingkip nawnta hi.

Azoh un dangka om lai teng kumpipa leh Jehoiada kiang ah ahon tawi ua, huai in TOUPA' inn a nasepna ding a tui-um belsuante, latna tui-um belsuan sikkeute leh dangkasik tui-um belsuante nangawn abawl uhi. Huchi in Jehoiada damsung in TOUPA' inn ah halmang thillat alan gige uhi.
Jehoiada bel upapi tekkun a dam in asita. Asih in kum za-le-sawmthum a upa ahi.
Huchi in Israelte lak ah Pathian tung ah leh a-inn tungtang a thil ahihhoih ziak in David khopi ah kumpipate lak ah avui uhi.
Jehoiada sih nung in Judah miliante ahong kuan ua, kumpipa kiang ah toukaina abawl ua, kumpipa'n athu uh ana pom hi.
