Himahleh apipute uh Pathian TOUPA' inn alehngatsan ua, Asherahte leh milimte nna asemta uh. Huchi in akhelhna uh ziak in Judate leh Jerusalem tung ah thangpaihna ahong tungta hi.
Himahleh TOUPA kiang a pikik ding in akiang uah zawlneite asawl a, amohdante uh atheisak ua, himahleh abil uh adoh nuam kei uhi.

Siampu Jehoiada tapa Zekariah tung ah Pathian kha ahong tung a, amah mipi tunglam ah adingh a, akiang uah, "Pathian in hichi in achi: Bangziak a na lamzan theihlouhna ding ua TOUPA' thupiakte bohsia na hi ua? TOUPA na lehngatsan ziak un ama'n leng nou hon lehngatsan ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in amah asawmta ua, kumpipa thupiak in TOUPA' inn huangsung ah suang in adenglumta uhi.
Huchibang in kumpipa Joash in apa Jehoiada hehpihna theigige lou in atapa athatta hi. Asih kuan in, "TOUPA'N ahon ngaihtuah ding a, phu ahon laksak ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum abei in Siria sepaihte'n ahong sual ua; Judah gam leh Jerusalem ah alut ua, amilian tengteng uh ahihmansak ua, Damaskas kumpipa kiang ah gallak tengteng akhak vek uhi.
Siria sepaihte bel tawmchik kia ahong kuan ua; apipute uh Pathian TOUPA alehngatsan ziak un TOUPA'N sepaih tampite akhut uah apia ahi. Huchibang in Joash tung ah gawtna atungsak uhi.

Apaisan nung un, natna thupitak thuak in apaisan ua, amah mite ngei in siampu Jehoiada tapate sisan ziak in asawm ua, alupna a lum lai athat ua, asita hi. David khopi ah avui ua, himahleh kumpipate han ah aphum kei uhi.
Hiaite amah sawm mite ahi uh: Ammon mi Simeath tapa Zabad leh Moab mi Shimrith tapa Jehozabad.

Huchi in atapate tung ah thute, atung a puakgiktak puaksak tungtang thute; Pathian in abawlhoiht tungtang thute, ngai dih Kumpite Tanchin gelhna bu ah gelh ahi. Huan asik in atapa Amaziah in vai ahawmta hi.
Amaziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua vai ahawm a; anu min Jehoaddan, Jerusalem mi ahi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih a, himahleh alungsim ape bukim kei hi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, agam ahong dinkip in apa thattu, sikhate athat hi.

Himahleh atate uh bel athat kei a, Mosi Dan laibu a tuang, "Tate ziak in pate asi ding uh ahi kei, pate ziak in tate asi ding uh ahi sam kei, michih amau gitlouhna ziak in asi ding uh ahi,” chi a TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahih hi.

Amaziah in Judahte akaikhawm a, Judah leh Benjamin mi tengteng a-inkuan uh dungzui zel in sangkhat heutu leh zakhat heutute nuai ah a-omsak hi. Kum sawmnih tunglam teng asim a, mi teltuam, tei leh lum tawi thei, galkap thei mi nuaithum a-om uhi.
Huan Israel gam a mi, mihat hangsan nuaikhat dangka talent zakhat in aguai lai hi.
Himahleh, akiang ah Pathian mi, mi khat ahong a, "Aw Kumpipa, Israel sepaihte na kiang ah pai kei le uh, TOUPA Israel mite, Ephraim suante huam in, na kiang ah a-om kei hi.

Hoh hi lechin leng, hangtak in kidouna ah gamtang in: huchi lou in zaw Pathian in melma mai ah nang a hon vuallelsak ding: Pathian in lah panpih theihna leh vuallelhsak theihna anei ngal a," ahong chi hi.

Huchi in Amaziah in Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ahihleh Israel sepaihte ka piaksa talent zakhat bang i chihta dia awi?" achi a. Huan Pathian mipa'n, "TOUPA'N huai sang a tampi nang ahon pe thei ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Amaziah in Ephraim gam a kipan a sepaih hong paite paikik ding in akhen a; huaiziak in Judate tung ah aheh mahmah ua, hehtak in apaikikta uhi.
Amaziah in lunglel lou in mite apikhia a, Chi Phaizang ah ahoh ua, Seir suante singkhat athat uhi.
Singkhat dang Judate'n ahingmat ua, suangpi vum ah api ua, suangpi vum a kipan in asawnkhe mengmeng ua, akitamzangawp uhi.
Himahleh Amaziah in akiang ah galkap ding a pai lou ding a asawlkik sepaihte'n Judah gam khuate, Samaria a kipan a Beth-horon pha in asual ua, mi sangthum athat ua, gallak tampi ala uhi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, Amaziah, Edomte that ahong pai in Seir suante' pathiante ahon pua a, apathian ding in apangsak a, huchi in abia ua, gimlimte ahalsak chiat hi.
Huaiziak in Amaziah tung ah TOUPA hehna akuangta a, akiang ah zawlnei asawl a, huai mi in akiang ah, "Na khut a kipan a amite hunkhe thei lou nam pathiante bang ding mahmah a zong na hia?" achi hi.

Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, akiang a thu agen lai in kumpipa'n, "Kumpipa vaihawmpa ding in nang ka hon bawl ua hia? Dai mai in: bang ding a na hinna tan ding na hia?" achi a. Huchi in zawlnei in, "Pathian in hichibang a na hih ziak leh ka thuhilhna na ngaihkhiak louh ziak in nang hihmang lungsim in anei chih ka thei hi, achi a," adaita hi.
Huchi in Judah kumpipa Amaziah in thuhilh apom a, Israel kumpipa Jehu tapa, Jehoahaz tapa, Joash kiang ah, "Hong dih, kimatuah in i ki-en ding," chi in mi asawl hi.

Israel kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah kiang ah, Lebanon tang a sidar sing kiang ah, "Ka tapa zi ding in na tanu neisak dih, chi in athukhak a; huan, Lebanon tang a gamsa ahong pai a, ling ahong chilpukgawp hi.

'Nang ngai dih, Edom ka zou,' na chi a, na lungsim in na kisathei a, na inn ah om kinken mai in; nang leh Judah gam nangawn a siatna, nang dia poi ding thil bangziak a tokkhe ding na hia?" chi in mi asawl hi.
Himahleh, Amaziah in angaikhe nuam kei a; Edomte pathiante azon ziak a, Judah gam a amelmate uh khut a apiaktheihna ding a Pathian hih ahi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa Joash ahohtou a; Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah kimaituah in aki-enta ngei uhi.
Huan Israelte sang in Judate tan ahong sezaw a; michih amau inn lam chiat ah apaita uhi.

Israel kumpipa Joash in Beth-shemesh ah Judah kumpipa, Ahaziah tapa Jehoahaz tapa Amaziah aman a, Jerusalem ah api a, Jerusalem kulh Ephraim kulh kongpi a kipan akulh ning kongpi tan in tong zali tak achimsak hi.
Huan TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn agou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng leh dangka leh tui-um belsuan om tengteng ala a, henta koltang dingte toh, huan, Samaria kholam ah apaikik nawnta hi.
Huchi in Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah bel Israelte kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Joash sih nung in kum sawm-le-nga adam lai hi.
Amaziah thilhih dangte abul a pan atawp tan in ngai dih, Judah kumpite leh Israel kumpite thugelhnabu ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Amaziah in TOUPA zuih atawpsantak in Jerusalem ah thah asawm ua, Lakish ah atai a; himahleh khua ah mi adelhsak ua, huai ah athat uhi.
Aluang sakol in apua ua, api-le-pute kiang Judah khopi ah avui uhi.
Huchi in Judah mi tengteng in kum sawm-le-guk a upa Uzziah api ua, apa Amaziah sik in kumpipa ding in abawlta uhi.
Ama'n kumpipa api-le-pute kiang a a-ihmut nung in Eloth khua abawlhoih a, Judah gam ah apangsak nawn hi.
Uzziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawm-le-guk a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nih vai ahawm a, anu min Jekoliah, Jerusalem mi ahi.
Apa Amaziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihtak ahih zel hi.
Pathian kilakna theisiam Zekariah damsung in Pathian zong ding in akibawl tinten hi. Pathian azon sung teng in Pathian in alamzangsak hi.
Philistiate sim ding in akuankhia a, Gath kulhte, Jabneh kulh, Ashdod kulh ahihchim a; huchi in Ashdod gam ah leh Philistiate lak ah khua abawl hi.
Huchi in Pathian in Philistiate lak ah leh Gurbaal a om Arabiate leh Meuni mite lak ah apanpih hi.
Ammonte'n Uzziah lak ah siah aliau sek ua; huchi in ahong hat mahmah ziak un Aigupta gam tan in aminthangta uhi.
Uzziah in Jerusalem ah aning ah kongpi, Phaizang kongpi, kulh kawina lai kongpi, insangte, alam lai a, kulh in a-um hi.

Gamdai ah leng insang alam a, gam tampi aneih ziak in tuilehte atoukhia a, phailam leh phaizang ah ganhon anei a; lounei mite leh uain suk mite tang lam leh gam hoihte ah akoih a, amah louma lam limsakmi tak ahi.
Uzziah in sepaih kidoumi kumpipa sepaih heutu Hanani nuai a mi laigelhmi Jeiel leh heutu Maaseiahte'n aseh bang zel ua apawlpawl a galkapmi anei lai hi.
Mihat hangsan chiat, a-inkuan upate tengteng sangnih-le-zaguk ahi uh.
Anuai uah sepaih sinsiamsa ngen nuaithum sangsagih-le-zanga melma lak a kumpipa panpihmi galsualmi taktak a-om uhi.
Huchi in Uzziah in sepaih tengteng a ding in lum, tei, sik lukhu, sik puanak, thalpeu leh vaisuanglot a ding in suangte akisakhol hi.

Jerusalem ah mipilte theihkhiak khawlte abawl a, insang leh kulh ning chih ah thalkapna leh suang lian kuamkuam ana denna ding akoih a; amin gam chih mual chih ah athangta a; ahat mahmah tan in alam a lamdangtak a panpih in a-om hi.
Himahleh ahong hat nung in alungsim ahong sang a, hoih lou hial in thil ahih a, TOUPA a Pathian tung ah thil ahihkhial a; gimlim maitam a gimlim hal ding in TOUPA tempul ah alut hi.
Huchi in siampu Azariah in azui a, mihangsantak TOUPA siampu sawmgiat atel uhi.

Kumpipa Uzziah akhou ua akiang ah, "Uzziah aw, TOUPA a ding a gimlim hal nang hih ding ahi kei, gimlim hal ding a sehtuam Aaron tapa siampute hih ding ahi zaw hi; mun siangthou a kipan pawtkhia in; thil na hihkhial hi; TOUPA Pathian a pan na thupina ding ahi kei," achi uhi.
Huan Uzziah ahehta a; gimlim halna ding mei lakna atawi a, huchi a siampute tung a aheh laitak in TOUPA' inn ah, gimlim halna chin ah siampute ma ah atal ahong phakkheta hi.
Huchi in siampu heutu Azariah leh siampu tengteng in a-en ua, ngai in, atal ahong phak a, huai a kipan in avikkhe pah ua, ahi, TOUPA'N agawt ziak in amah leng kintak in apawtkheta hi.

Kumpipa Uzziah bel asih ni tan in aphakta a, aphak ziak in a-inn tuam ah a-omta hi. TOUPA' inn a kipan hihkhiak in a-omta a, huchi in atapa Jotham bel agam ua mite vaihawm in kumpipa' inn a ukpa ding in a-omta hi.
Uzziah thilhih dang tengteng bel abul a kipan a atawp pha in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai in agelh hi.
Huchi in Uzziah bel api leh apute kiang ah a-ihmu a, kumpipa kivuina mun a api leh apute lak ah avui uhi. "Amah zaw phak ahi ngal a," achi ua, huchi in asik in atapa Jotham in vai ahawmta hi.
Jotham bel avaihawmpat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm a, anu min Jerushah, Zadok tanu ahi.
Apa Uzziah thilhih bangbang hih in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel hi. TOUPA tempul ah bel alut kei hi. Himahleh mite'n hoih loutak in ana hih gige uhi.
TOUPA' inn a kongkhak saknungzaw abawl a, huan, Ophel kulh tung ah inn tampi alam behlap lai hi.
Huan Judah tanggam ah khuate abawl a, gamnuai ah inn thupi taktakte, insangte alam lai hi.

Ammon suante'n kumpipa adou ua, azou hi. Huchi in Ammon suante'n huai kum in dangka talent zakhat leh huit buh puak singkhat leh barli buh puak singkhat apia uhi. Huchibang mah in Ammon suante'n akum nihna leh akum thumna ah leng apia uhi.
Huchi in Jotham in TOUPA a Pathian ma a lampi hoih abawl ziak in ahong hatta hi.
Jotham thilhih dangte agaldoute, a-omdante ngai dih, Israel leh Judah kumpite thugelhnabu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm hi.
Jotham bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khopi ah avui uh; asik in atapa Ahaz in vai ahawmta hi.
Ahaz in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm; apu David bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih kei hi.
Israel kumpipate lampi azui zaw a, Baalte a ding in milim suntawmte abawl lai hi.
Hinnom tapa phaizang ah gimlimte ahal a, TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa namte thilkihhuaitak ahih sek bang un atate uh mei ah alutsak uhi.
Mun sangte, mualte, sing hing nuaite ah akithoih a, gimlimte ahal zel hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA a Pathian in Siria kumpipa khut ah apia a; asual ua, mi tampi sal in api ua, Damaskas ah apaipih uhi. Israel kumpipa khut a piak ahi lai a, ama'n tampi athat hi.
Api-le-pute uh TOUPA Pathian alehngatsan ziak un. Remaliah tapa Pekah in Judah gam ah nuaikhat-le-singnih ni khat in athat a, avek un mihangsan chiat ahi uhi.
Ephraim mihat Jikri in kumpipa tapa Maaseiah leh insung upa Azrikam leh Elkanah, kumpipa zom athat hi.
Huchi in Israel suante'n a-unaute uh nuainih, numeite, atapate uh, atanute uh sal in api ua; gallak tamtak alaksak lai ua, gallak pen Samaria ah atun uhi.

Huai ah TOUPA zawlnei ana om a, amin Obed ahi; Samaria a hong pai ding sepaihte ana vaidawn a, akiang uah, "Ngai dih uh, TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian Judahte tung ah aheh a, na khut ua hon pia ei ve, heh a na thahna un van asuntou hi.
Judah leh Jerusalem mite sikhanu leh sikhapa in bawl na tum ua, himahleh noute ngei in leng TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah na hihkhial uh ahi kei maw?
Huaiziak in ka thu pom unla, na unaute uh sal a na matte uh paisak nawn un; TOUPA hehna thupitak na tung uah a-om hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Ephraimte heutu khenkhat, Johanan tapa Azariahte, Mesillemoth tapa Berekiahte, Shallum tapa Jehizkiah, Hadlai tapa Amasa kidouna a kipan a hong paite ana dal ua, akiang uah,

"Salte na hon pilut ding uh ahi kei; ka khelhna uh leh ka tatlekna uh behlap in, TOUPA tung ah tatlekna na hon tungsak ding uh ahi, ka khelhna uh athupi mahmah ngal a, Israel mite tung ah hehna thupitak a-om hi," ana chi uhi.
Huchi in sepaihte'n miliante leh mipi ma ah salte leh gallak sumte anusia uh.

Huan minlohlouhte ahong thou ua, salte api ua, gallak thil in vuaktang a om teng puansilh aguan ua, avan ua, khedapte abunsak ua, nek ding leh dawn ding apia ua, sathau anilh ua, ahatloute tengteng sabiltung ah atuangsak ua, tum sing khua, Jeriko ah a-unaute uh kiang ah apaisak ua, amau Samaria ah akik nawnta uhi.
Huai lai in kumpipa Ahaz in Assuria kumpipate panpihna ngen ding in mi asawl hi.
Edomte'n Judahte va sual a, sal dia hon mat thuk ziak un.
Philistiate'n leng phailam khuate leh Judah simte ahong la ua, Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Sokoh leh akhotate toh, huan, Timnah leh akhotate, Gimzo leng akhotate toh ala ua, huai ah a-om uhi.
Israel kumpipa Ahaz ziak in TOUPA'N Judahte avuallelsak hi. Judahte tung ah thanghuaitak in thil ahih a, TOUPA tung ah nakpitak in akhial ahi.
Huchi in Siria kumpipa Tilgath-pilneser akiang ah ahong pai a, hihhat nak sang in ahihmangbang zaw hi.
Ahaz in TOUPA' inn, kumpipa' inn leh miliante a pan thilte ala a, Siria kumpipa apia a; himahleh aphatuam tuan kei.
Amangbat laitak in leng hiai kumpipa Ahaz in TOUPA tung ah thil ahihkhial semsem mawk hi.

Amah sualmi Damaskaste pathian kiang ah akithoih hi, “Siria kumpipate' pathian in amaute apanpih ziak in kei leng ahon panpih theihna ding in akiang ah ka kithoih ding ahi," achi hi. Himahleh amah leh Israel mi tengteng siatna ahi ngal a.
Huchi in Ahaz in Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan akaikhawm vek a, Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan ahihkham vek a, TOUPA' inn kongkhakte akhak bikbek a; Jerusalem ning chih ah maitam abawl hi.
Judah kho tampi ah pathian dangte dia gimlim halna mun sangte abawl a, TOUPA api-le-pute Pathian ahehsak hi.
Athilhih dangte tengteng leh a-omdan tengteng abul a kipan atawp pha in ngai dih, Judate leh Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Api-le-pute kiang ah Ahaz a-ihmu a, Jerusalem khopi ah avui ua; Israel kumpipate han ah akoih kei uh. Huchi in asik in atapa Hezekiah in vai ahawmta hi.
Hezekiah in kum sawmnih-le-nga upa ahih in vaihawm apan a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua vai ahawm a; anu min Abijah, Zekariah tanu ahi.
Ama'n apu David thilhih bang hih in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel hi.
Ama'n vaihawm apat kum akha khatna ah TOUPA' inn kongkhakte ahong a, azemhoih hi.
Siampute leh Levite apilut a, suahlam sang mun za lai ah apikhawm a, akiang uah,
"Nou Levite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; noute kihihsiangthou phot unla, huchi in TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian inn hihsiangthou unla, mun siangthou a kipan ninte paikhia un.
I pi-le-pute un thil ahihkhialta ua, TOUPA Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ana hih ua, ana lehngatsan ua, TOUPA omna alehngatsan ua, ana nungngatta uhi.
Inn lim kongkhakte akhak ua, khawnvakte ahihmit ua, Israel' Pathian' mun siangthou ah gimlimte ahal kei ua, halmang thillatte leng alan kei uh.
Huaiziak in TOUPA hehna Judate leh Jerusalem tung ah a-om a, na mit ua na muh bang un, gam chih mual chih a sepsep ding leh lamdangsak ding leh nuihzat ding in ana bawlta ahi.
Ngai dih ua, i pi-le-pute uh namsau a vuallelhsak in a-om ua, i tanu leh i tapate uh, i zite uh, huaiziak in sal in ana om uhi.
"Ngai dih ua, ahehna mahmah athentheihna ding in TOUPA Israel' Pathian kiang ah thu khun ka tum hi.
Ka naute aw don lou in om kei un, TOUPA nasem na hi ua, ama a nasem a om ding leh gimlim halmi ding in nou ahon telta ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Levi mi Amasai tapa Mahathte, Kohath mi Azariah tapa Joelte; Merari tapate lak a Abdi tapa Kishte, Jehalleleel tapa Azariah, Gershon, Zimmah tapa Joah, Joah tapa Edente,
Elizaphan tapate lak a mi Shimri leh Jeuelte: Asaph tapate lak a mi Zekariah leh Mataniahte;
Heman tapate lak a mi Jehuel leh Shimeite; Jeduthun tapate lak a mi Shemaiah leh Uzzielte akuankhia uhi.
A-unaute uh asamkhawm ua, akihihsiangthou ua, TOUPA thu a kumpipa thupiak bang a TOUPA' inn hihsiang ding in alutta uhi.
Huchi in kihihsiang ding in TOUPA insung gil lam ah siampute alut ua, TOUPA' inn a thilnin amuh tengteng uh TOUPA inkong ah alakhia uhi.
Akha khatna ani khat ni in apan ua, huai kha ani giat ni in TOUPA inlim atung ua; huchi in ani giat in TOUPA' inn ahihsiangthou ua; akha khatna ani sawm-le-guk ni in azou vek uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah kumpipa' inn ah alut ua, "TOUPA' inn a halmang thillatna maitamte, huai a tui-um belsuan tengteng, tanghou siahna dohkante, huai a vanzat tengtengte ka hihsiang vekta uh.
Kumpipa Ahaz in avaihawm lai a thil ahihkhelh a, apaihmang tui-um belsuan tengteng leng ka bawl zou vek ua, ka hihsiangthou lai ua; huan, ngai dih, TOUPA maitam malam ah a-om hi," achi uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah bel zingkhang in athou a, khua a miliante asamkhawm a, TOUPA' inn ah ahoh uhi.
Gam, mun siangthou leh Judate a ding a khelh thoihna ding bawngtal sagih, belamtal sagih, belamnou sagih leh keltal sagih akaitou ua. Aaron tapa siampute TOUPA maitam a lan ding in thu apia hi.
Huchi in bawngtalte agou ua; siampute'n sisan ala ua, maitam atheh ua: belamtalte agou ua, asisan in maitam atheh ua; belamnoute leng agou ua, asisan in maitam atheh uhi.
Huan keltalte khelh thoihna ding in kumpipa leh mipite kiang ah ahon kai ua, atung uah akhut uh anga uhi.
Siampute'n agou ua, Israel mi tengteng a ding a lemna bawlna ding in asisan un maitam ah khelh thoihna alan ua; kumpipa thupiak bang in Israel mi tengteng a ding in alan uhi.

Huchi in David leh kumpipa zawlnei Gad leh zawlnei Nathan thupiak bang in TOUPA' inn ah Levite dakkhutbette, pekgingte, kaihgingte tum ding in akoih a; thupiak a zawlneite zang a TOUPA piak lah ahi ngal a.
Levite bel David bawl tumging chi toh siampute pengkul toh adingh uhi.
Huan Hezekiah in maitam a halmang thillat lan ding in thu apia a. Halmang thillat ahon lat pat un TOUPA la pengkul leh Israel kumpipa David bawl tumging toh ahon sa uhi.
Huchi in mipite'n Pathian abia ua, lasiamte'n la asa ua, pengkul mut mite'n amut ua, halmang thillat lat khit ahih masiah huchibang in ahih nilouh uhi.
Thillat alat khit un kumpipa leh akiang a om tengteng in kun in Pathian abia uhi.
Kumpipa Hezekiah leh miliante'n Levite bel David leh zawlnei Asaph phuah phatna la sa ding in thu apia uhi. Huchi in nuamsatak in phatna la asa ua, akun ua, Pathian abia uhi.

Huchi in Hezekiah in, "TOUPA a ding in na kihihsiangthouta ua, hong nai unla, TOUPA' inn ah kithoihna leh kipahthu genna thillat hong lan un," achi hi. Mipite'n kithoihnate, kipahthu genna thillatte ahon lan ua, a-ut peuhmah in halmang thillat ahon lan uhi.
Mipite'n halmang thillat ahong lat zah uh bawngtal sawmsagih leh belamtal zakhat leh belamnou zanih ahi. Hiaite tengteng TOUPA a dia halmang thillat ding vek ahi.
Thillat tengteng bawngtal zaguk, belamtal sangthum ahi.

Himahleh siampu atawm lua ua, halmang thillat pen asem seng kei ua; huaiziak in a-unaute Levite'n akimansak ma un siampute kihihsiangthou tan in ahuh uhi. Levite siampute sang in kihihsiangthou thu ah angentelzaw uhi.
Huchi in halmang thillatte atam a, halmang thillat chih a ding a lemna thillat thaute, dawn ding thillat a dingte leng atam mahmah hi. Huchi in TOUPA' inn nasepdan hoihtak in ahih uhi.
Pathian in mite kisakholsak khin a, kintak a thil atunsak a, thil om guih ahih ziak in, Hezekia leh mi tengteng akipak mahmah uhi.
Huchi in Solomon in Jerusalem a Moriah tang, apa David kiang a TOUPA kilakna, Jebus mi Ornan phualzang, David sehsa ah TOUPA' inn alam panta hi.
Avaihawm akum lina kum, akha nihna, ani nih ni inn lam apan hi.
Pathian inn lamdan ding Solomon in angaihtuahdan hichibang ahi. Adunglam tong tehdan ngeina in tong sawmguk ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi.
Amalam a inlim dunglam inn vailam tan mah tong sawmnih ahi a, asanlam za-le-sawmnih ahi a, asung dangka-eng chi kia in aluan hi.
Dantan lianzaw pen baang ah meilah sing athuap a, huai dangka-eng chi kia in aluan a, huai ah tum sing leh khainiang lim atuangsak hi.
Huchi in akilawmsak ding in bel suangmantam in azem a, dangka-eng bel Paravaim dangka-eng ahi.
Inn bel, kalhkangte, baangte, apialkhangte, kongkhakte dangka-eng in aluan a; baangte ah cherub limte atuangsak hi.
Mun Siangthoupen abawl a, adunglam in vailam tan mah, tong sawmnih ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi a, dangka-eng chi ngen in aluan a, talent zaguk apha hi.
Akilhna gikdan dangka-eng shekel sawmnga ahi. Dantan tungnungte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Mun Siangthoupen ah cherub lim nih abawl a, huaite dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Cherub khate'n tong sawmnih akhak a, cherub khat kha tong nga ahi a, baang apha a, huan, akha langkhat leng tong nga mah ahi a, cherub khat kha apha hi.
Huchi in cherub dang khat kha leng tong nga ahi a, baang a pha a; huan, akha langkhat tong nga mah ahi a, cherub khat kha apha hi.
Cherubte'n tong sawmnih khak in akha uh azak ua, adingh ua, insung lam nga in adingh uhi.
Puanzak ding adumpuang, asandup, asan-au, khauzang ngatte in abawl a, huai ah cherub lim atuangsak hi.
Inn mailam ah tong sawmthum leh tong nga a sang khuam nih aphut a, huaite dawn tong nga tuaktuak ahi.
Huai ah khainiang abawl a, khuam dawn ah avial a; theibuhfai zakhat abawl a, khainiang ah akhai hi.
Tempul mailam ah khuam aphut a, khat taklam ah, khat veilam ah, taklam a pen Jakin achi a, veilam a pen Boaz achi hi.

Huan Hezekiah in Israel gam leh Judah gam teng ah mi asawl a, Ephraim leh Manasseh gamte ah leng TOUPA Israel' Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang nei ding a Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn a hong pai ding in lai akhak hi.
Kumpipa leh amiliante leh Jerusalem a mipi teng in akha nihna ah, Paikan Ankuang neih asawm uhi.
Huai lai in alui thei nai kei ua, siampu kihihsiangthoute atam nai kei uh; Jerusalem a mipi akikaihkhop nai louh ziak un.
Athil sawm uh kumpipa leh mipite ngaih in adik hi.

Huchi in Israel gam teng, Beer-sheba a kipan Dan pha in TOUPA Israel' Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang nei ding a Jerusalem a hong pai ding apuang ding in thu ahihkipta hi. Adan bangtak in huchibang a tam in ahih ngei nai kei uh.

Huchi in lai taipih mite kumpipa leh amiliante uh lai tawi in, Israel leh Judah gam tengteng a pai ding in kumpipa thupiak bang in apawt ua, "Nou Israel suante aw, Siria kumpipate khut a kipan pawt a akhosuaksunte TOUPA, Abraham, Isak leh Israel' Pathian lam hong nga nawn un; huchi a nou lam ahong ngat nawn theihna ding in.
Nou zaw na pi-le-pute uh leh na unaute uh, TOUPA apipute uh Pathian tung a thil hihkhial a om, segawp ding a donsak lou a na muhte uh bang in om kei un.

Na pi-le-pute uh bang in genhak nawn kei unla, TOUPA kiang ah kitulut zaw unla, tangtawn a dia ahihsiangthou, amun siangthou ah hong lut unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh nna sem un, huchi in ahehna thupitak na lak ua kipan akiheimangsak ding hi.

TOUPA lam na hong ngat nawn uleh na unaute uh leh na tate uh sal a man mite'n ahehpih ding ua, hiai gam ah ahong pai nawn ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh lah chingtheitak leh zahngaitheitak ahi ngal a, amah lam na hong ngat peuhmah uleh ahon nuse kei ding,” chi in.
Huchi in lai taipih mite kho chih ah Ephraim leh Manasseh gam tengteng ah Zebulun pha in apai ua, himahleh amaute nuihsan in ana simmoh uhi.
Himahleh Asherte leh Manassehte leh Zebulunte tampi akitulut ua, Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi.
Judah gamte ngial houh TOUPA thu a kumpipa leh miliante thupiak zui ding in Pathian in lungsim mun khat apusak hi.
Huchi in kha nihna ah tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina nei ding in Jerusalem ah mi tampi ahong kikhawm ua, atam mahmah uhi.
Huan athou ua, Jerusalem a maitamte ala ua, gimlim halna maitamte leng ala ua, Kidron lui ah apai uhi.
Huchi in akha nihna ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuangluina agou ua; siampute leh Levite azum ua, akihihsiangthou ua, halmang thillat toh TOUPA' inn ah alalut uhi.
Huan Pathian mipa Mosi Dan bangtak in amau mun chiat ah adingh ua; siampute'n Levite a kipan atan uh sisan atheh uhi.
Mipi lak ah lah kihihsiangthou lou atam ua; huaiziak in TOUPA a ding a hihsiangthou ding in asiangthouloute tuam ding in Levite'n Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou uhi.
Ephraim, Manasseh, Issakar, Zebulun mite tampi akihihsiangthou kei na ua, dan lou bang in Paikan Ankuangluina ane uhi. Himahleh amaute a ding in Hezekiah athum a, "Chingthei ToUPA'N,
Michih alungtang a TOUPA, apipute Pathian, Pathian zongte, mun siangthou siansakna dan dungzui in kisiangsak kei mahleh, ngaidam hen," chi in.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Hezekiah thumna angaikhia a, mipite ahihdamta hi.
Israel mi Jerusalem a omte'n Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina nuamsatak in ni sagih azang ua; Levite leh siampute'n kaihging ngaihtak toh TOUPA pahtawi a la sa in niteng in TOUPA aphat uhi.
Huan Hezekiah in siamtak in TOUPA kilawmtak a phat Levite alungmuan hi. Huchi in TOUPA apipute uh Pathian kiang a thupha tawi in lemna thillatte lan in ni sagih ankuangluina ane tawntung uhi.
Huan mipi in ni sagih dang ankuang lui nawn asawm ua; huchi in ni sagih dang nuamsatak in ankuang alui nawn uhi.
Huan Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in mipite bawngtal sangkhat leh belam sangsagih goh ding in apia a; miliante'n mipite bawngtal sangkhat leh belam singkhat apia uhi; siampu tampite akihihsiangthou uhi.
Huchi in Judah mipi tengteng siampute toh Levite toh, Israel gam a kipan a mipi hong pai tengteng leh namdang Israel gam a kipan a hong pai Judah gam a omte'n nuam asa mahmah uhi.
Huchi in nopsakna thupitak Jerusalem ah a-om a: Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon chiang ah huchibang himhim Jerusalem ah a-om ngei nai kei hi.
Huchi in siampu leh Levite athou ua, mipite avualzawl ua; a-aw uh ngaihkhiak in a-om a, athumna un a-omna siangthou van apha hi.

Huchi in huai tengteng ahih khit un huai a Israel mi om tengteng in Judah gam tengteng leh Benjamin gam leh Ephraim leh Manasseh gam suangphuhte ahihzan ua, Asherahte aphuk ua, mun sangte leh maitamte achipsak vek masiah uh Judah gam khuate ah apai zel uhi. Huchi in Israel suante tengteng agam uah amau khua chiat ah apai nawn uhi.

Huan Hezekiah in siampute leh Levite apawldan bang zel un michih siampute leh Levite'n atuah chiat ding un, halmang thillat leh lemna thillat lanmi dingte, nasemmi dingte, kipahthu genmi ding leh TOUPA omna kongpi a ngakmi dingte pawl abawlsak chiat hi.
TOUPA dan a tuang bangbang in zingsang lam leh nitaklam halmang thillat dingte, Sabbath leh kha thak leh hunbi nei ankuang a dingte kumpipa tantuan a ding asep hi.
Jerusalem a mipite TOUPA dan a akihihhatna ding un siampute leh Levite tantuan pe ding in thu ape lai hi.
Huai thupiak adalhzaktak in Israel suante'n abuhte, uainte, thaute, khuaizute, alou ua thilsuak masapente ahong pia ua; abangkim uh sawm-a-khat leng ahong pia uhi.
srael suante leh Judah suante, Judah khuate a omte'n abawng uleh belam uh sawm-a-khatte, TOUPA a Pathian uh tantuam dia apiaksawn uh sawm-a-khatte ahon pia ua, akoihkhawm ekok phet uhi.
Kha thumna ah akoihkhawm pan ua, akha sagihna ah akoihkhawm khin uhi.
Huchi in Hezekiah leh amiliante un koihkhawm amuh un TOUPA leh ami Israelte aphat uhi.
Hezekiah in athil koihkhawm tungtang thu uh huai siampute leh Levite adong a.

Zadok mi siampu heutu Azariah in adawng a, "Mite'n TOUPA' inn a thilpiak ahon tawi tung ua kipan in i ne zel ua, i deihkhop ua, a-om ekok lai hi. TOUPA'N mite avualzawl zel a, hiai a om ekok lai teng i kham val uh ei ve," achi hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah in TOUPA' inn ah dantante bawl ding in thu apia a; abawlta uhi.
Huan thilpiakte sawm-a-khatte, Pathian a tuamte muanhuaitak in anawn lut uhi: aheutu uh Levi mi Konaniah ahi a, a-unau Shimei bel azom ahi.
Konaniah leh a-unau Shimei nuai ah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Pathian inn a heutu Azariah seh in endikmi Jehiel, Azajiah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath leh Benaiahte a-om uhi.
Levi mi Imna tapa Kore, suahlam kongkhak ngakmi Pathian kiang a lungsim ut thu a thilpiak kempa leh TOUPA a dia thilpiak leh thil siangthoupen hawmpa ahi.
Anuai ah Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, Shekaniah, siampu khua ah nasep hunbi chiat ah a-unaute uh apawlpawl aneu leh aliante kiang a semmi a-om uhi:
Khangthu sut pasal kum thum chiang tunglam, niteng a TOUPA' inn a nasep kul nei a pawl dandan bang ua hohsekte sim louh in.
A-inkuan uh pipute gelhna a siampu asehte leh Levi mi kum sawmnih chiang tunglam apawldan bang zel ua nasemmi dia sehte;
pipute gelhna a tuang ataneute tengteng uh, azite uh, atapate uh, a-inkuan tengteng uh; asepna bik ua siangthoutak a akihihsiangthoute ahi uhi.
Aaron suan kho chih khopua a om siampute leh Levite suante gelhna a tuang peuhmahte tantuan pe ding mi sehtuam a-om uhi.
Huchibang in Judah gam tengteng ah Hezekiah in ahih a, TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in hoih leh dik leh muanhuai thil ahih sek hi.
Pathian nasep lam thu ah, dan lam thu ah, thupiak lam thu ah, a Pathian zon thu ah ahih peuhmah ah alungsim tengteng in ahih a, alamzang zel hi.
Huchibang a muanhuaitak a thil ahih nung un Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib ahong kuan a, Judah gam ah ahong lut a, kulh nei khuate ahong um a, lak ahong tum hi.
Sennakerib ahong kuan a, Jerusalem hong sual atum chih Hezekiah in atheih in,
kho polam a tuite hihtat ding in amiliante leh amihatte athuhilh a; huchi in apanpih uhi.
Huchi in mi tampi akikaikhawm ua, tui tengteng leh gamsung a luangsuak luite achingtan ua, Assuria kumpipate ahong lut ua, "Tui tampi bang ding in ahong nei mahmah ding ua," achi uhi.
Huchi in akihangsak ua, kulh chipna tata abawl a, insungte leh polam kulhte leng abawlhoih hi. David khua ah Millo ahihkip a, galvante leh lumte tampi abawl hi.
Kidouna a mipi heutute abawl a, khopi kongkhak mun za lai ah asamkhawm hi.
"Hattak in, hangsantak in om unla, Assuria kumpipa leh aheute mipi lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un:
Amah lam a pangsa sepaih ahi ua, ei hon panpih ding leh hon dousak ding a ei lam a pang bel TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in lungmuanna thu agen hi.
Huai nung in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in; amah leh asepaihte Lakish ah a-om ua, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Jerusalem a Judah mi tengteng kiang ah,
"Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in hichi in achi, Jerusalem lak bang ahia na uplouhna uh?
Hezekiah in, TOUPA i Pathian in Assuria kumpipa khut a kipan hon hunkhe ding, chi in gilkial leh dangtak a na sihna ding un ahon khem ahi kei maw?
Hezekiah mah ahi kei maw, amun sangte leh amaitamte chimsak a Judah mi leh Jerusalem a mite kiang a, maitam khat ah Pathian na be ding ua, gimlim na hal ding uh, chi a thu pepa?
Kei leh ka pute'n gamdang mite tung a ka thilhih uh na thei kei ua hia?
"Kua namte pathian ahia ka pute'n ahihman uh ka khut a kipan a amite uh hunkhe thei om a, noute Pathian in leng ka khut a kipan a ahon hutkhiak theih tuamna ding?

Huaiziak in Hezekiah in hon khem kei henla, huchibang in hon khem kei henla, amah um kei un; bang nam pathian leh bang gam pathian himhim amite uh ka khut a kipan leh ka pute khut a kipan hunkhe thei a-om kei ua; bangchi in na Pathian un ka khut a kipan a hon hunkhe thei tuam mahmah dia?" chi in Jerusalem ah amite asawl hi.
Huan amite'n huai sang a thupi in TOUPA Pathian leh asikha Hezekiah tungtang thu ahoih lou lam in agen uhi.

Israelte' TOUPA Pathian hehsak ding leh gense ding in lai agelh lai hi. "Gam chih, namte pathiante'n ka khut a kipan amite uh hunkhe thei lou bangmah in Hezekiah Pathian in leng ka khut a kipan amite ahunkhe kei hial ding," chi in.
Khua alaktheihna ding un amulkimsakna ding leh lungzinsakna ding in Jerusalem a kulh a omte Judah pau in ngaihtak in akikoukhum uhi.
Jerusalem Pathian mihing khut a bawl leitung mite pathian bang lel phet in agen uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah leh Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai huaiziak in athum ua, van a om asam uhi.

TOUPA'N angel asawl a, huai in Assuria kumpipa giahmun a mihat hangsan tengteng leh makai heutute athat hi. Huchi in zum mahmah melpu in agam lam ah apai nawnta hi. Huan apathian inn a hoh lai ama tapate mahmah in namsau in athat uhi.
Huchibang in TOUPA'N Hezekiah leh Jerusalem a mite Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib khut a kipan leh midang tengteng khut a kipan ahumbit a, akim ua mite lak ah aveng hi.
Huan mi tampi in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in thilpiak ahon tawi ua, thil manpha pipite Judah kumpipa Hezekiah ahong pia ua; huai a kipan in nam chih mitmuh in pahtawi in a-omta hi.
Huai lai in Hezekiah bel sizou ding khop in achina a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a: huan, adawng a, chiamtehna apia hi.
Himahleh Hezekiah in amah a ding a hoih kihih dungzui in ahih kei a, alungtang hong kisaktheih ziak in ahi; huaiziak in atung ah leh Judahte leh Jerusalem tung ah hehna ahong tung hi.
Himahleh Hezekiah in alungtang kisaktheihna kisik in akiniamkhiak nawn a, amah leh Jerusalem a mite toh; huchi in Hezekiah damsung in TOUPA hehna atung uah ahong tung kei hi.
Huan Hezekiah in sum-le-pai ahau a, athupita mahmah a; dangkasik, dangka-eng, suangmantam, gimlim, lum leh tui-um belsuan hoih pipi koihkhawmna inn alam hi.
Buh, uain leh thau koihkhawmna inn leng alam lai a; gan chiteng koihna leh belam huang leng abawl hi.
Huchi in khuate leng abawl lai a, belamhon leh bawnghon ahau mahmah hi. Pathian in neizoutak in abawl hi.
Hezekiah mah in Gihon luitui saknungzaw pen ahubing a, David khua tumlam pang ah aluangkhesak hi. Huchi in Hezekiah athilhih tengteng ah alamzang zel hi.
Babulon miliante'n palai asawl ua agam a thillamdang adot thu uah alungtang a om tengteng atheihtheihna ding in Pathian in anusia in aze-et hi.
Hezekiah thilhih dang tengteng, athilhih hoihte, ngai dih, Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kilakna bu, Judah kumpipa leh Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Api-le-pute kiang ah Hezekiah a-ihmu a, David tapate hanmun paitouhna ah avui ua; Judah tengteng leh Jerusalem a mite'n asih ni in thupitak in agal uhi. Asik in atapa Manasseh in vai ahawmta hi.
Manasseh in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawm-le-nih ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nga vai ahawm hi.
TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou, Israel suante ma a TOUPA'N adelhkhiak Pathian thei lou namte'n thilkihhuaitak ahih bang uh ama'n leng ahih zel hi.
Apa Hezekiah in ahihchip nung mun sangte abawlhoih a, Baalte a ding in maitam abawl a, Asherah limte abawl a, van a om tengteng abia a, a-nna uh asem hi.
"Jerusalem ah tangtawn in ka min a-om ding," TOUPA'N achihna TOUPA' inn ah maitamte abawl hi.
TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nih ah van a om tengteng a ding in maitamte abawl hi.
Phaizang ah Hinnom tapa mei ah atate alutsak a; aisante aching a, bumte aching a, dawi aisan siam zawlte leh bumsiamte aguai sek a; TOUPA thangpaisak ding in amitmuh ah thil hoih lou ahih hi.

Pathian in David leh atapa Solomon kiang a, "Hiai inn leh Jerusalem a Israel chi tengteng lak a ka tel ah ka min tangtawn in ka omsak ding, achih khitsa Pathian inn ah amah bawl, milim bawltawm akoih hi.

Thu ka piak tengteng leh dan tengteng, dan thuseh, thilhih ding Mosi zang a ka piakte azuih peuhmah uleh api-le-pute uh ka piaksa gam a kipan Israelte khe ka kal suankhesak nawn kei ding," achihna ah.
Manasseh in Judahte leh Jerusalem a mite thil ahihkhialsak a; TOUPA'N Israelte ma a ahihman khitsa namte sang in ahihkhialzaw hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Manasseh leh amite kiang ah thu agen zel a; himahleh alimsak kei uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria sepaih heutute asawl a, Manasseh khainiang in akhih ua, kol abunsak ua, Babulon ah apaipihta uhi.
Huchi in mangbangtak a a-om lai in TOUPA a Pathian azong a, api-le-pute Pathian ma ah nakpitak in akiniamkhiak hi.
Akiang ah athum a, hehpih angen a, angetna angaihkhiaksak a, Jerusalem ah agam ah apai nawnta hi.

Huai nung in David kho polam ah Gihon tumlam pang phaizang ah ngasa kongkhak lutna pha in kulh abawl a, Ophel umsuak in sangpi in adingsak a: Judah khua kulh nei tengteng ah heutu hangsan taktak akoih hi.
Gamdang pathiante leh milimte, TOUPA' inn a kipan apaimang a, tang a TOUPA' inn leh Jerusalem a maitam abawl tengteng khua a kipan apaikhe vek uhi.
TOUPA maitam abawl a, lemna thillat kithoihnate, kipahthu gennate alan a, Judahte bel TOUPA Israel' Pathian nasem ding in thu apia hi.
Mipite mun sang ah akithoih lailai ua; himahleh TOUPA a Pathian uh kiang ah kithoih ahi zawta hi.
Manasseh tanchin dang tengteng, a Pathian kiang a athum thute, TOUPA Israel' Pathian min a zawlnei in akiang a thu agente uh ngai dih, Israel kumpipate tanchin lak ah atuang hi.

Athumnate, Pathian in ahehpihna leh akiniamkhiak ma in agitlouhna tengteng, mun sang abawl a, Asher leh milim bawltawm a bawlkhiakna mun tengteng leng, ngai dih, Hozai tanchin gelhna bu ah atuang vek hi.
Huchi in Manasseh bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, ama inn ah avui ua; atapa Ammon in asik in vai ahawmta hi.
Ammon in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nih ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum nih vai ahawm hi.
Apa Manasseh hih mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; apa Manasseh in abawl milim bawltawm tengteng kiang ah Ammon akithoih a, a-nna asem hi.
Apa Manasseh kiniamkhiak bang in TOUPA ma ah akiniamkhiak kei a, Ammon agilou semsem hi.
Huchi in a sikhate'n asawm ua, ama inn ah athat uhi.
Himahleh kumpipa Ammon kalh a phialguk sawm mi tengteng mipi'n athat vek nawn ua; asik a kumpipa hi ding in mipite'n atapa Josiah abawlta uhi.
Josiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum giat a upa ahi; Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-khat vai ahawm hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel a, apu David lampite azui a, taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam apialsan kei hi.

Kum giat avaihawm kum, naupangtak ahih lai a kipan him in apu David Pathian azong pan a; kum sawm-le-nih avaihawm kum in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a mun sangte, Asherte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte ahihbei a.
Baal maitamte amitmuh in achimsak ua; huaite sang a sangzaw milimte aphuk a; Asherte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte ahihkham vek a, akiang ua kithoih mite han tung ah athehzak hi.
Siampu guhte amaitamte uah ahal a, Judah gam leh Jerusalem ahihsiang hi.
Huchi mah bang in Manasseh, Ephraim, Simeon leh Naphtali khuate tan in ahih vek hi.
Maitamte achimsak a, Asherte, milim bawltawmte ahihkham a, Israel gam tengteng a milimte aphuk vek a, Jerusalem ah apai nawn hi.
Huan avaihawm kum sawm-le-giat kum, agam leh innte ahihsiang kum in Azaliah tapa Shaphan, kho ukpa Maaseiah, Joahaz tapa laigelhmi Joah TOUPA a Pathian inn bawlhoih ding in asawl hi.

Siampu Hilkiah kiang ah ahoh ua, kongkhak ngak Levite'n Manasseh mite, Israel khosuaksunte, Judah mi leh Benjamin mite, Jerusalem a mite kiang a kipan ana lakkhawm uh, Pathian inn a hong koih uh dangka apia uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA' inn lammi nasemte apia ua; TOUPA' inn nasem mite'n inn bawl mite leh zem mite apia uhi.
Judah kumpipate'n ahihsiat uh bawlhoihna ding in suangsekte, apehnate leh a-inkamte ding sing leina ding in khutsiamte leh inn lam mite apia uhi.

Huchi in mite'n muanhuaitak in nna asem ua; aheutu uh, nasep ngaihtuah mite, Merari tapate lak a Levi mi Jahath leh Obadiah, Kohath mi tapate lak a mi Zekariah leh Meshullamte ahi ua; Levi mi, midang ginglawm tumsiam tengteng toh;
apuak a puakthoh mite heutu leh nna chiteng sem mite sep ding ngaihtuahmi ahi uhi. Laigelhmite, heutute, kongkhak ngak mite Levi mite lak a mi ahi uh.
Huan TOUPA' inn a hong koih uh sumte asuah ualeh, siampu Hilkiah in Mosi zang a apiak TOUPA Dan Bu amukhia hi.
Huchi in Hilkiah in laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah, "TOUPA' inn ah Dan Bu i mukheta uh," achi a. Huan Hilkiah in laibu Shaphan apia hi.
Huan Shaphan in laibu kumpipa kiang ah apaipih a, "Na sikhate'n hih ding a seh a om tengteng ahih uh.
TOUPA' inn a dangka om abungkhia ua, heutute leh nasem mite apia uh," chi in thu atun hi.
Laigelhmi Shaphan in, "Siampu Hilkiah in laibu ahon pia,” chi in kumpipa ahilh a, kumpipa ma ah asim hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa'n Dan thute azak in, apuan abotkek hi.
Kumpipa'n Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikah tapa Abdon, laigelhmi Shaphan leh kumpipa sikha Asaiah thu apia hi.

"Kuan unla, dan thu na muhkhiak tungtang thu uah kei leh Israel leh Judah gam a mite a ding in TOUPA hon dotsak dih ua; i pi-le-pute'n hiai Dan Bu a tuang bang a TOUPA thu azuih louh ziak un i tung uah TOUPA thangpaihna ahong om mahmah ngal a," chi in.
Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apiak mite leh Hilkiah puansilh kempa Hasrah tapa Tokhat tapa Shallum zi zawlnei Huldah kiang ah ava hoh ua, huai thu ah ava houpih uhi. Amah bel Jerusalem Misneh a om ahi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ka kiang a nou hon sawlpa hilh unla, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
'Ngai dih ua, hiai mun leh asung a omte tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding a, Judah kumpipa ma a kisimkhia, laibu a tuang hamsia tengteng leng;
akhut thilhih ua hon hehsakna ding ua hon lehngatsan a, milim dangte ding a gimlim ahal ziak un hiai mun tung ah ka hehna sun ahi a, daihsak ahi kei ding,' chi in.
Himahleh TOUPA thu dong ding a nou hon sawlpa Judah kumpipa kiang ah, hichibang in chi un, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na thuzakte tungtang thu ah,

na lungtang hihnem a a-om ziak a Pathian ma a na kiniamkhiak a, hiai mun tungtang thu leh asung a omte tungtang thu na zak a, ka ma a na kiniamkhiak a, na puan na bohkek a, ka ma a na kah ziak in ke'n leng na thu ka na ngaikhia hi.

Ngai dih, na pi leh na pute kiang ah ka hon hohsak ding a, na han ah lungmuangtak in na pai ding a, hiai mun leh asung a omte tung a ka hon tunsak ding thil hoih lou tengteng na mit in amu kei ding, chi in gen in,' achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah thu atunta uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n mi asawl a, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a upa tengteng asamkhawm hi.

Huchi in kumpipa leh Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng, siampu leh Levite, mipi tengteng aneu leh alian in TOUPA' inn ah ahohtou ua; TOUPA' inn a muhkhiak thukhun bu a thu tengteng abil ua zak in asim hi.

Kumpipa bel amun ah adingh a, huai laibu a tuang thukunte hihkip ding in alungtang tengteng, akha tengteng a ToUPA zui ding leh athupiakte, athu theihsakte, adan thusehte pom ding in TOUPA ma ah thu akhung uhi.
Jerusalem leh Benjamin mi tengteng huchibang a om ding in achi ua. Huan Jerusalem a mite'n Pathian, apipute uh Pathian thukhun bang in ahihta uhi.

Huchi in Josiah hi in Israel gam in ahuap tengteng a kipan thilkihhuai tengteng apaimang a, Israel gam a om tengteng TOUPA a Pathian uh nna asemsak hi. Adamsung in TOUPA apipute uh Pathian azuih uh apialsan kei uhi.
Huan Josiah in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in Paikan Ankuang abawl a; akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou hi.
Huchi in siampute anasep uh asehsak a, TOUPA' inn a nasepna sem ding in ahanthawn hi.

Israel mite sinsakmi, Pathian a ding a hihtuam Levite kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon inn lam ah bawm siangthou koih un; na liangzang ua zawn akiphamohta kei ding; TOUPA na Pathian uh leh ami Israelte nna semta un.
Israel kumpipa David gelh bang leh atapa Solomon gelh bang in na inkuan vaihawm makai dungzui zel un apawlpawl in kisa un.
Na unaute uh inkuan vaihawm makai dungzui zel in Levite tuam a tantuan nei in mun siangthou ah om un.
Paikan Ankuangluina ding gou unla, kihihsiangthou unla, Mosi zang a TOUPA gen bang hih ding in na unaute uh ding in bawl un," achi hi.
Huchi in Josiah in huai a mi om tengteng Paikan Ankuang a dia lan ding in ganhon lak a belamnou leh kelnou singthum leh bawngtal sangthum apia a: huaite kumpipa sum lak a ahi.

Amiliante'n mipite, siampute, Levite amau ut thu a lan ding in apia uhi. Pathian inn a heutu, Hilkiah, Zekariah leh Jehielte'n Paikan Ankuang dia lan ding in ganta nou sangnih-le-zaguk leh bawngtal zathum siampute apia uhi.
Konaniah, a-unau Shemaiah leh Nethaneel, Levite heutu Hashabiah, Zeiel leh Jozabadte'n leng Paikan Ankuang dia lat ding in Levite ganta nou sangnga leh bawngtal zanga apia uhi.
Huchi in nasepna abawl ua, kumpipa thupiak bang in siampute amun uah adingh ua, Levite apawldan bang zel un.
Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou ua, siampute'n sisan atheh ua, Levite'n avun ahawk uhi.
Huan Mosi laibu a tuang bang a inkuan khendan dungzui zel a TOUPA kiang a lat ding a piak ding in halmang thillatte alasawn ua. Bawngtalte leng huchi mah bang in ahih uhi.
Huchi in Paikan Ankuangluina ding a dan bang in a-em min ua; thillat siangthousa bel, bel khaina nei, belgongza in a-ui ua, mi tengteng kiang ah apaipih uhi.
Huai khit in amau leh siampute a ding abawl ua; Aaron ta siampute halmang thillat leh sathau lan in zan tanpha in abuai ngal ua; huaiziak in Levite'n amau leh Aaron ta siampute a ding abawl uhi.

David, Asaph, Heman leh kumpipa zawlnei Jeduthunte thupiak bang in lasami Ashaph tapate amun uah adingh ua, kongkhak ngak mite bel kongkhak chih ah a-om ua; a-unau Levite'n abawlsak ziak un a-nna uh paisan akiphamoh kei hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Josiah thupiak bang a Paikan Ankuang lui ding leh TOUPA maitam a halmang thillat lan ding in huai ni mah in TOUPA nasepna thil tengteng abawl uhi.
Huchi in huai lai a Israel suan omte'n huai ni in Paikan Ankuang abawl ua, tanghou silngou soh louh ankuang leng ni sagih abawl lai uhi.

Zawlnei Samuel dam lai a kipan Israel gam ah Paikan Ankuang huchibang himhim abawl ngei kei ua; Israel kumpipa kuamah in Josiah leh siampute leh Levite leh Judah tengteng leh Israelte'n aneih bang uh nei a-om sam kei uhi.
Kum sawm-le-giat Josiah vaihawm kum in huai Paikan Ankuangluina zat in a-om hi.
Huai tengteng khit a Josiah in tempul abawl khit in, Karkhemish sual ding in Euphrates Luipi ah Aigupta kumpipa Neko apaitou a; Josiah in amah ava sual hi.

Himahleh, ama'n, "Judah kumpipa, ei gel i kisaikhakna bang om ahia? Nang sual ding in ka hong pai kei a, ka dousa dou ding a hong ka hi zaw, Pathian in kinoh ding in thu ahon pia a, ka lam a pang Pathian doudal kei in, ahon hihmang kha ding," chi in palai asawl hi.
Himahleh Josiah in akiksan nuam kei a, adou theihna ding in akibawl lamdang a, Pathian kam a kipan a Neko thugen apom kei a, Meggiddo Phaizang ah na sual ding in akuan hi.
Huchi in thalkap mite'n Josiah akapkha ua; kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, "Hon paimangpih un, liamna thupi mahmah ka tuakta," achi hi.
Huchi in asikhate'n kangtalai a kipan alakhia ua, akangtalai dang ah akoih ua, Jerusalem ah apaipih ua, asi a, api-le-pute han ah avui uhi. Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mite'n Josiah asuun uhi.
Huan Jeremiah in Josiah akah a; lasami numei leh pasalte'n tutan in Josiah akahna la uh agen lailai uhi. Israel gam ah dan in anei ua, ngai dih, kahna la ah huai atuangta hi.
Josiah thilhih dang tengteng, athilhih hoihte, TOUPA Dan Bu a kigelh bang zel in,
amasapen leh ananungpente leng, ngai dih, Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipate tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om uhi.
Huai gam a mite'n Josiah tapa Jehoahaz api ua, Jerusalem ah apa sik in kumpipa in abawl uhi.
Jehoahaz in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-thum ahi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum vai ahawm hi.
Aigupta kumpipa'n Jerusalem a avaihawmna atawpsak a, agam uh dangkasik talent zakhat leh dangka-eng talent khat aliausak hi.
Aigupta kumpipa'n a-unaupa Eliakim, Judah leh Jerusalem a kumpipa ding in abawl a, amin Jehoiakim chi in akhensak hi. Huchi in Neko in a-unaupa Jehoahaz Aigupta gam ah api hi.
Jehoiakim in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm hi. TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar amah sual ding in ahong kuan a, Babulon a pi ding in kol abunsak hi.
Nebukadnezzar in TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan leng Babulon ah apua a, Babulon a atempul ah akoih hi.
Jehoiakim tanchin dangte, athilkihhuai hihte leh a-omdante, ngai dih, Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpite tanchinbu ah atuang hi. Huan asik in atapa Jehoiakin in vai ahawmta hi.
Jehoiakin in vaihawm apat tung in kum giat ahi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum leh ni sawm vai ahawm a, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
Kum abei in kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in mi asawl a, TOUPA in atui-um belsuan hoih pipite toh Babulon ah apisak a, a-unaupa Zedekiah, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a kumpipa ding in abawl hi.
Zedekiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-khat ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm hi.
TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; TOUPA kam a kipan a thugenpa zawlnei Jeremiah lak ah akiniamkhiak nuam kei hi.
Pathian min a kichiamsakpa kumpipa Nebukadnezzar tung ah ahel lai a, genhaktak in a-om a, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian lam nga lou ding in alungsim akhauhsak hi.
Siampu heutu tengteng leh mipite'n leng Pathian thei lou mite mah bang in thilkihhuai pipite ahih ua, Jerusalem a hihsiangthou TOUPA' innte leng ahihbuah uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N amite leh a-omna mun alainat ziak in apipute uh Pathian in akiang uah theihtawp a phatuamngai in mi asawl hi.
Himahleh Pathian misawlte amusit ua, athute angaineu ua, amite tung ah TOUPA hehna ahong thou a, hih lungdam nawnna mahmah om lou khop in azawlneite ahihgim uhi.
Huaiziak in atung uah Kaldai kumpipa agamtangsak a, ama'n atangvalte uh amun siangthou uah namsau in athat a, nungak leh tangval, tek, teksia kuamah lainatna anei kei a; akhut ah ape vek hi.
Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan tengteng, aneu leh alian, TOUPA' inn a sum koihkhawm tengteng, kumpipa sum koihkhawm leh amiliante sum koihkhawmte nangawn in Babulon ah apo vek hi.
Pathian innte ahal a, Jerusalem kulhte achimsak a, huai lai a inn thupi tengteng ahal a, huai lai a tui-um belsuan hoih tengteng ahihse vek hi.
Namsau thah bang teng Babulon ah api a, Persiate ahong laltak un, sikha in amah leh atapate a-om uhi.
Gam in nuamtak a a Sabbathte azattan a Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thugen atangtunna ding in, segawp a a-om sung teng, kum sawmsagih tangtunna ding in, a Sabbathte atang uhi.

Huchi in Persia kumpipa Kura vaihawm tung kum in Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thu atunkim theihna ding in agam tengteng a thankhiak vek ding leh agelh a gelh ding in leng TOUPA'N Persia kumpipa Kura lungtang atokthou hi.

Persia kumpipa Kura in hichi in achi: "Khovel gam tengteng TOUPA, van Pathian in ahon pia a; Judah gam a Jerusalem ah a-inn lamsak ding in thu ahon pia ahi. Na lak ua ama mite photphot kiang ah TOUPA a Pathian om henla, va hohtou uhen," chi in.
Dal maitam, adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawmnih, asandan tong sawm abawl hi.
Dal lohbem lianpi, agei leh agei kikal a tong sawm kia, asandan tong nga abawl a; agei akimvel in tong sawmthum ahi.
Agei nuai bawngtal limte in avelsuak a, tong khat ah sawm zel, dal loh kimvel in a-om hi. Bawngtal limte vual nih ahi a, dal loh akimat a sun ahi.

Huchi in bel bawngtal sawm-le-nih tung ah akinga a, thum in mallam anga ua, thum in tumlam anga ua, thum in simlam anga ua, thum in suahlam anga uh; dal loh bel huaite tung ah akoih a, anunglam anga hi.
Loh pen khutpek tan in asah a, agei ahihleh nou gei bangbang, lili pak bang a bawl ahi a, bath sangthum ta ahi.
Kisilna ding kuangzawn, sawm abawl lai a, taklam sang ah nga atung a, veilam sang ah nga atung a; huaite bel halmang thillat silna ding ahi; huan, dal lohbem bel siampute kisilna ding ahi.
Huan bawldan ding a aseh bang in, dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sawm abawl a, tempul sung taklam ah nga, veilam ah nga akoih hi.
Dohkan sawm abawl lai a, tempul sung ah taklam ah nga, veilam ah nga akoih a, dangka-eng kuangzawn zakhat abawl hi.
Huai lou leng siampute huang leh huang zapite a-um a, huang kongkhakte abawl a, dal in aluan hi.
Loh pen inn taklam pang ah suahlam ah simdoh in atung hi.
Huram in belte, vutluahnate, kuangzawnte abawl hi. Huchi in Pathian inn a ding a kumpipa Solomon abawlsak Huram in azouta hi.
Khuam nihte, noubemte khuam dawn a zing nihte, khuam dawn a noubem nihte tuamna gial chitek nihte;
huai tuamna gial chitek nih ding a theibuhfai zalite khuam dawn a noubial nih tuamna ding gial chitek tuaktuak ding a theibuhfai vual nihte.
Kingaknate, kingakna tung a kuangzawnte leng abawl a;
Loh khat leh anuai a bawngtal sawm-le-nihte toh.
Belte, vutluahnate, sa thuknate leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leng Huram in TOUPA' inn a dia dal nawttet akumpipa Solomon abawlsak ahi.
Huaite Jordan Phaizang ah Sukoth leh Zered bellei mun ah kumpipa'n asung hi.
Huchibang in Solomon in tui-um belsuan tampi abawl a; dal gikzah buk seng vual ahi kei hi.
Solomon in Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan om tengteng abawl a, dangka-eng maitamte, tanghou koihna dohkante.
Seh bang a mun siangthou mai adet ding khawnvak koihnate, akhawnvak nangawn toh, dangka-eng ngen in abawl hi.
Dangka-eng pakte, khawnvakte leh taitehte, dangka-eng siang ngen in abawl hi.

Khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, keute, mei laknate dangka-eng siang ngen mah in; huan, insung lutna, insung gilzaw Mun Siangthoupen kongkhakte leh a-inn, tempul kongkhakte dangka-eng in abawl hi.
Huchi in Solomon in TOUPA' inn ding alamzou vekta a; Solomon in apa David in thil ana latsa tengteng alalut a, dangkasik, dangka-eng, vanzat tengteng Pathian inn a goukoihna ah akoihta hi.
Huchi in Solomon in Israel upate, anam intekte, Israel suante inkuan makaite tengteng, David khopi Zion a kipan TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngtou ding in Jerusalem ah akaikhawm hi.
Huchi in Israel mi tengteng akha sagihna a ankuangluina ah kumpipa kiang ah ahohkhawm uhi.
Israel upate tengteng ahong ua, Levite'n bawm azawng uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA bawm leh kihoupihna biakbuk leh puanin a tui-um belsuan siangthou tengteng azawngtou ua; siampu Levite'n azawngtou uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon leh Israelte omkhawm tengteng akiang a hong kikhawmte bawm ma ah a-omkhawm ua, belam leh bawngtal gen seng vual louh leh sim seng vual louh in akithoih uhi.
Huchi in siampute'n ToUPA thukhun bawm a-omna ding ah alalut ua, insung a biakna mun, Mun Siangthoupen ah, cherubte kha nuai ah.
Cherubte'n bawm omna tung zawn ah akha uh azak gige ua, cherubte'n bawm leh azawnna chiangtawnte akhuh vek uhi.
Azawnna chiangtawnte asau mahmah a, azawnna chiangtawnte kongte biakna mun mai, Mun Siangthou a kipan in amuh theih a; himahleh polam ah zaw adawk kei: tutan huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
Aigupta gam a kipan apawt ua, TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang a thu akhun lai Mosi in Horeb tang a suangpek nih akoih kia lou ngal huai bawm sung ah bangmah dang a-om kei hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute Mun Siangthou a kipan a ahong pawttak un, siampu omte tengteng akisiangsak ua, apawl in akibawl tuan kei ua;

Levi lasami tengteng leng avek un, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, atapate uh leh a-unaute uh toh, puanmalngat silh a kivan in dakkhutbette, pekgingte, kaihgingte toh, maitam suahlam sang ah adingh ua, alak uah siampu za-le-sawmnih pengkul mut in a-om lai uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, pengkul mutte leh lasa mite'n TOUPA phatna leh kipahthu genna dia atumging uh ging khat bang mai in akiza a; pengkul leh dakkhutbet leh thil tumging toh a-aw uh asuah ua: "Amah lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a," chi a, TOUPA aphat uleh, meipi in TOUPA' inn akhuhdim meuhmouh hi.
Huchi in meipi ziak in siampute'n nna asem theita kei ua; TOUPA thupina in Pathian inn adim vek hi.
Huchi in Solomon in thu agen a, "TOUPA'N, mial bikbek ah ka om ding, achi a,
himahleh na tenna ding, tangtawn a na omna ding inn ka hon lamsakta hi," chi in.
Huchi in kumpipa akihei a, Israel kikhawm tengteng avualzawl a; Israel kikhawmte adingkhawm uhi.
Ama'n, "TOUPA Israel' Pathian, ka pa David kiang a amah kam mahmah a,

Aigupta gam a kipan ka mi Israelte ka pikhiak ni a kipan Israelte nam lak a koi khua mah ka min omna ding inn lamna ding ka tel ngei kei a; ka mi Israelte tung a heutu ding mi kuamah ka tel ngei kei hi.
Himahleh, ka min omna ding in Jerusalem ka telta a, ka mi Israelte heutu ding in David ka tel hi, chi a genpa, amah khut mahmah a hon pichingsakpa phat in om hen.
"Ka pa David in Israel' Pathian, TOUPA min ding a inn lam angaihtuah hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N ka pa, David kiang ah, ka min ding a inn lam na ngaihtuah a, hichibang lungsim na na put na hihhoih hi; himahleh nang zaw inn na lam kei ding;
na tapa, na khal a hong pawt ding in ka min ding in inn ahon lam zaw ding, ana chita hi.
"Huchi in TOUPA'N athugen atangtungsakta a: TOUPA chiamsa bang ngei in ka pa David mun ka hon luah a, Israel laltutphah ah ka hong tu a, Israel' Pathian TOUPA min ding inn ka hon lamta ahi.
Huai ah Israel suante kiang a na khun, TOUPA thukhun bawm ka koihta ahi," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA maitam bul ah Israel kikhawm tengteng muh in adingh a, aban azak a,
Solomon in dal dohkan asau lam tong nga, azatlam tong nga, asanlam tong thum a bawl huang laitak a tun tung ah atuang a, Israel kikhawm tengteng ma ah akhukdin a, van lam nga in aban azak a:
"Aw TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, lei leh van ah nangmah bang mahmah Pathian a-om kei uh, alungtang tengteng ua na lampi tawnmi asikhate tung a thukhun tangtungsak a hehpihna kem,
na sikha, ka pa David kiang a, na thuchiam na tangtungsak a; ahi, tuni in na kam a na gensa na khut in na lohchingsakta a:

Huchi in aw TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, na sikha, ka pa David kiang a, na suante na om bang a om sam ding a-omdan ua apilvan peuhmah uleh, ka mitmuh a Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tasam kei ding, chi a na chiamsa tangtungsak in.
Huchi in TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, na sikha, David kiang a na thugen lohchingsak mahmah in.
"Himahleh, Pathian lei ah mihing lak ah a-om petmah dia hia? Ngai in, van, vante van ah leng na ta kei a, hiai ka inn lam ah ta kei sem na tel ni chia!
Himahleh, aw TOUPA ka Pathian na sikha in nang ahon sapna leh athumna ngaihkhiaksak in, na sikha thumna leh ngetna hon limsak in.
Hiai mun lam nga a na sikha thumna ngaikhia a, huai ah ka min a-om ding, na chihna mun mahmah, inn lam ah sun leh zan a na mitsuan gige theihna ding in.
Na sikha leh na mi Israelte'n hiai mun lam nga a athum chiang un angetnate uh na ngaihkhiaksak zel in, ahi, na tenna mun van ah na ngaikhia inla, na zak chiang in ngaidam in.
"Mi kuapeuh in a-invengte tung ah thil hihkhial in, kichiamsak hong kiphamoh taleh, hiai inn a na maitam ma ah hong kichiam henla;
nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, gamtang inla, migilou agitlouh man a moh tangsak in, midiktat adiktak man a dik tangsak in, na sikhate vai hawmsak in.
"Na mi Israelte'n na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua melmate lak a avuallelh ua, nang lam ahong ngat nawn ua, na min agup ua, hiai inn a thum a thil na kiang a ahon nget uleh;
nang van a pan na ngaihkhiaksak inla, na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, amau leh api-le-pute uh na piak gam ah pi nawn in.
"Na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua van ahong bin a, vuah ahong zuk louh a, hiai mun lam nga a athum ua, na min agup uleh, amaute na hihgim ziak a akhelhna uh akisik uleh;
nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, apaina ding uh lampi hoih kawkmuh in na sikhate leh na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam in na mite agoutan ding ua na piakna gam ah vuah zusak in.

Ka gam ua kial ahong kiak a, hipi ahong len a, keuna hiam, muatna hiam, khaukhup hiam, lung hiam ahong om a, amelmate un akhuate uh ahong um ua, hipi bangpeuh, natna bangpeuh ahong tunleh hii avei uhiam, alungkhamna uh theipih in.
Hiai inn lam nga a ban zak a mimal hiam, Israel mipihon in hiam thumna leh ngetna ahon tut uh:
Na omna van a pan na ngaikhia inla, ngaidam inla, michih a-omdan bang chiat un lohchingsak in, alungtang uh lah na thei ngal a; nangmah kia mihing tate lungtang theipa na hi.
Ka pi-le-pute uh na piak gam a a-om sung teng ua na lampi tawn thei ding a nang laudan ahong siamna ding un.
"Na mi Israelte hilou, namdangmi, na min thupitak leh na khut hattak leh na ban zak ziak a gam gamlatak a kipan a hong pai, hiai inn lam nga a ahong thum chiang un:

Nang na omna van ah na ngaikhia inla, nang hon sapdan uh dungzui in namdangte tung ah leng hih in, huchi in na mi Israelte bangmah in leitung a mi tengteng in na min athei ding ua, nang laudan ahong siam ding ua, hiai ka inn lam in na min apu chih athei ding uhi.
"Na mite'n amelmate uh na sawlna lamlam a asual ua na khopi tel leh na min omna dia na lam inn lam nga a na kiang a athum uleh:
Nang athumna uh leh angetna uh van a pan na ngaikhia inla, athu uah pi zel in.
"Na tung a ahong khelh ua, kuamah lah khial lou a-om ngal kei a, atung ua na heh a, melma khut a na piak a, gam gamlapi ah hiam, naideuh ah hiam sal a api un leng,
sal a apina gam ua akingaihtuahkhiak ua, akisik ua, 'I na khialta, dikloutak leh gitlouhhuaitak in thil i na hihta,' chi a atanna gam ua ngetna ahon tut ua;
sal a amau apina ua, atanna gam ua alungtangtak uleh alungsim taktak ua nang lam ahong ngat ua, api-le-pute uh gam lam leh na khopi tel leh na min dia ka lam inn lam nga a na kiang a athum uleh;
athumna uh leh angetna uh nang na omna van ah na ngaikhia inla, athu uah pi zel inla, na tung a na khialta na mite ngaidam in.
"Aw ka Pathian, hehpih in na mit hong hak inla, hiai mun athumna ah na bildoh in.
Aw TOUPA Pathian, na omna mun ah paitou in nang leh na hatna bawm toh, Aw TOUPA Pathian, na siampute na hotdamna in van inla, na misiangthoute hoihna in nuamsasak in.
Aw TOUPA Pathian, na thaunilhpa mel lehngatsan ke'nla, na sikha David thil hoih hihte theigige in," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon athum khit in van a kipan mei ahong kesuk a, halmang thillat leh kithoihnate ahong kangmangta a, huan TOUPA thupina'n inn adimta hi.
TOUPA thupina in TOUPA' inn adimsak ziak in TOUPA' inn ah siampute alut thei kei uhi.

Israel suante in van a kipan a mei hong lengsuk leh inn tung a TOUPA thupina a-en nilouh ua, suanglep tung ah mai a lei si in abokkhup ua, TOUPA phat in abia uhi. "Amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi," chi in chibai abuk ua, kipahthu agen uhi.
Kumpipa leh mipite'n TOUPA ma ah kithoihnate alan uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon in kithoihna bawngtal singnih-le-sangnih leh belam nuaikhat-le-singnih alan uhi. Huchibang in kumpipa leh mipite'n Pathian inn alan uhi.

Huan siampute amun chiat uah adingh ua; Levite leng TOUPA kiang a kipahthu genna ding a phuah, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi, chi a TOUPA phatna dia David in azat sek, thil ging thei toh TOUPA lasa in adingh ua; huchi in siampute'n pengkul amut ua, Israel mi tengteng adingh diamduam uhi.

Solomon in TOUPA' inn mazawn a um sung kongtual ahihsiangthou behlap a; huai ah halmang thillatte, lemna thillat thaute alan a; Solomon dal maitam bawl halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, thaute latna ding a aneu luat ziak in.
Huchi in huai tung in Solomon leh Israel mi tengteng mipi kikaikhawm thupitak Hamath kholutna a kipan a Aigupta gam lui pha a mite toh ni sagih ankuang alui uhi.
Ani giat ni in kikhopna tak anei ua; maitam kipahpihna ding in ni sagih azang ua, ankuanglui ni a ding in ni sagih azang uhi.

Huchi in akha sagihna ani sawmnih-le-thum ni in mipite akikhensak a, TOUPA'N David leh Solomon leh ami Israelte tung a ahoihna alatsak ziak in nuamsatak leh kipaktak in mite a-inn lam chiat uah apaita uhi.
Huchibang in, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn apichinta a; Solomon in alungsim a atup bang in TOUPA' inn leh ama inn lamzangtak in apichinta hi.
Huan zan in Solomon kiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Na thumna ka za a, hiai mun kei a ding in kithoihna inn ding in ka sep khin hi.
Vante ka khak a, vuahte azuk louh in hiam, khaukhup ka sawl a, gamte ahihsiat hiam, ka mite lak a hipi ka lensak hiam a;
ka min pu ka mite kingaineu a athum ua, ahon zon ua, a-omdan giloute uh alehngatsan uleh van a kipan in ka na ngaikhe ding a, akhelhna uh ka ngaidam ding a, agam uh ka damsak ding hi.
Hiai mun a thumna ka mit ka suan ding a, ka bil ka doh ding hi.
Huai a ka min tangtawn a a-omtheihna ding in hiai inn ka sep a, ka hihsingthouta hi: huai ah ka mit leh ka lungtang a-om tawntungta ding hi.
Huan nang tungtang thu ah leng, na pa David bang a ka mitmuh a na om a, thu ka hon piak bang a na om a, ka dan thusehte leh ka vaihawmte na zuihleh:
Israelte lak ah 'vaihawmmi na tasam kei ding,' chi a na pa David kiang a ka thukhun bang in 'na gam laltutphah ka kipsak ding hi.'
Himahleh na kiheimang ua, ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte na lehngatsan ua, Pathian dangte nna na sep ua, na biak uleh:

Amau ka piak gam a kipan ka hon hihmang ding a; hiai inn, ka min ding a ka hihsiangthousa, ka mitmuh phak louh ah ka suanmang ding a, nam chih lak a paunak leh aselam a gentehna ding in ka bawl ding hi.
'Hiai inn sangpi akiang a pai peuh in lamdang asa ding ua, bangchi a hiai gam leh hiai inn TOUPA'N hichi a hih ahia? achi ding uh.'
TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian, 'Aigupta gam a kipan pikhepa alehngatsan ua, Pathian dangte zui a, abiak ua, a-nnate asep ziak un hiai siatna tengteng atung uah atung ahi, ahon chi ding uh achi hi.'
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh ama inn alam sung kum sawmnih abei in,
Huram in Solomon khopi apiakte Solomon in inn abawl a, Israel suante a-omsak hi.
Solomon in Hamath-zobah asual a, azou hi,
Gamdai ah, Tadmor abawl a, Hamath a vankoihna khuate toh.
Beth-horon saknungzaw leh khangnungzaw leng, kulhte, kongkhakte, akalhnate nei in abawlbeh hi.
Baalath khuate, avankoihna khua tengteng, akangtalai koihna khuate, asakol tungtuang mite omna khuate, Jerusalem leh Lebanon leh agamsung pumpi ah Solomon in adeih bangbang in abawl hi.
Israel suante hilou, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte, Jebuste suan a om lai mite tengteng;
Israel suante'n ahihmanlouhte uh, huai gam a amaute nung a nutsiat a om asuante uh, tutan a, Solomon in sikha nasem ding a goih teitei pawl ding in abawl hi.
Israel suante Solomon in anasemmi sikha ding in abawl kei a, kidou mite, asepaih heutute makaite, akangtalai leh asakol tungtuangmi heutu ahi zaw uhi.
Huaite mipite heutu, Solomon makai lianpente ahi ua, zanih-le-sawmnga ahi uhi.
Solomon in David khopi a kipan atuam a inn alamsak ah Pharaoh tanu apitou a, "Ka zi Israel kumpipa David inn a om ding ahi kei, TOUPA bawm hong tunna mun siang ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon in inlim mai a TOUPA a ding a TOUPA maitam abawl tung ah halmang thillatte alan hi.

Mosi thupiak, niteng a dia bikhiah bangbang in Sabbath ni ah, kha thak ni, ankuanglui hun nei, kum khat a thumvei, Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluinate, Nipikal Ankuangluinate, Biakbuk Ankuangluinate,

Huan apa David na seh bang in siampu pawlte leh Levite atantuam chiat ua, niteng a sep kul dungzui zel a, phat dingte, siampute ma a nasem ding in asep a; kongkhak teng ah apawlpawl a veng mite asep lai a; huchibang in Pathian mipa David in ana sep hi.
Kumpipa'n siampute, Levite thu apiak bangchi mah in sumthute leng apialsan het kei uhi.
TOUPA' inn abawlkhiak tung ua kipan a azoh tan un, Solomon in asuktuahsa bang geih ahi. Huchi in TOUPA' inn pichin ahita hi.
Huchi in Solomon bel Edom gam a luipi gei a Ezion-geber ah leh Eloth ah ahoh a,
Huram in asikha tuipi a gamtangmi, longte toh akuansak a, Solomon sikhate toh Ophir ah ahoh ua, huai ah dangka-eng talent zali-le-sawmnga ahon pua ua, kumpipa Solomon kiang ah hon tun uhi.

Solomon minthandan Sheba kumpin’n azak in solomon thuhaksa pipi a ettel tum in nungzui mi tampi toh sangawngsaute a gimlim leh dangka-eng tampi leh suangmantamte pua in Jerusalem ah ahohtou a: Solomon kiang atuntouh in, alungsim a om tengteng suahsiang vek in ahoupih hi.
Huan Solomon in athudot tengteng adawng vek a: Solomon in adawn theih louh himhim a-om kei hi.
Huchi in Sheba kumpinu'n Solomon pilna leh a-inn lam amuh in,
adohkan a nek dingte, asikhate tutdante, anasemte nasepdante, akivatdante uh, anou pe mite leh akivatdante uh, TOUPA' inn a hohtouhnate, alungmang hial hi.
Kumpipa kiang ah, "Na thilhihte leh na pildan thuthang ka gam a ka zak adik mahmah ahi.
Himahleh keimah mit mahmah a ka hong muh masiah agen kia uh ka um thei kei a, ngai in, na pilna thupidan akimkhat leng ahon na hilh kei uh: na minthanna ka zakte nakpi in na khup hi.
Na mite nak hamphat na uh e, hiai na sikha na kiang a om gige a na pilna thu ngaikhe gigete hampha hi na tel uh e!

TOUPA na Pathian, na tung a kipak, akumpipa ding a alaltutphah a hon tusakpa TOUPA na Pathian phat in om hen: na Pathian in Israelte tangtawn a hihkip ding in a-it a, huaiziak in diktattak a vaihawm ding in akumpipa ding ua nang hon bawl ahi ve," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih leh gimlim tampi mahmah leh suangmantamte apia a, Sheba kumpinu'n kumpipa Solomon gimlim apiak bang himhim a-om ngei kei hi.
Huan Solomon sikhate leh Huram sikhate Ophir a kipan a dangka-eng va pote'n algum sing leh suangmantam ahon pua uhi.
Kumpipa'n algum sing TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn umna ding leh lasa mite a ding a kaihging leh pekging ding in abawl a: huchibang Judah gam ah tuma lam in amu ngei kei uhi.
Sheba kumpinu'n athil apiak sim louh in kumpipa Solomon in adeihdeih ape sam a, huchi in agam lam ah aheute toh apai nawnta uhi.
Huchi in Solomon kiang a kum khat sung a dangka-eng hong lut gikdan dangka-eng talent zaguk sawmguk-le-guk buk ahi.
Mi ompolhte leh sumsin mite hon tawi sim het louh in: huan, Arabia kumpipa tengteng leh gam ukpate'n Solomon kiang ah dangka-engte, dangkasikte ahon tawi sek uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng sekthoh in lum lian chi zanih abawl a, lum lian khat ah dangka-eng shekel zaguk abei hi.
Dangka-eng sukpek in lum zathum abawl a; lum khat zel ah dangka-eng shekel zathum abei a; huaite Lebanon gammang inn ah akoih hi.
Huan kumpipa'n Saihapak laltutphah thupitak abawl behlap a, dangka siang ngen in aluan hi.
Laltutphah a akaltouhna siksan gukte, laltutphah toh azop, dangka-eng khe ngaknate, aban ngakna bul a ding humpinelkai lim nihte a-om hi.
Siksan guk lang tuak tung ah humpinelkai sawm-le-nih adingh uhi. Huchibang koi lai gam ah leng abawl ngei kei uh.
Kumpipa Solomon nou tengteng dangka-eng vek ahi a, Lebanon gammang inn a tui-um belsuan tengteng leng dangka-eng siang vek ahi; Solomon dam lai in dangkasik bangmah in asim kei uhi.
Kumpipa'n longhon, Huram sikhate, Tarshish a hohsek kikoppih anei a, kum thum hal zel in, Tarshish longhon in dangka-eng, dangkasik, saiha, zawng leh utongte, ahon po sek hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in leitung kumpipa tengteng hauhsakna leh pilna lam ah akhup vek hi.
Huchi in Pathian in alungtang a akoih, apilna thu ngaikhe ding in, kumpipa tengteng in Solomon ahon zuan huthut uhi.
Kum teng a piak bikhiah nei in dangkasik tui-um belsuan dangka-eng tui-um belsuan puante, galvante, gimlimte, sakolte, sabiltungte ape zel uhi.
Huan Solomon in sakol leh kangtalai koihna mun sangli anei a, huan sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei a, huaite kangtalai koihna khuate ah, Jerusalem kumpipa kiangte ah a-omsak hi.
Huchi in lui a kipan a Philistia gam leh Aigupta gam tan a kumpipa tengteng tung ah vai ahawm hi.
erusalem ah kumpipa'n dangkasikte suang bang mai a tam in a-omsak a, sidar singte phaizang a theipite bang lel a ngaih in a-omsak hi.
Solomon a ding in sakolte Aigupta a kipan leh gam chih a kipan in ahon la zel uhi.

Solomon tanchin dangte abul a kipan atawp tanpha in, zawlnei Nathan gelh tanchinbu ah, Shilon mi Ahijah genkholhna bu ah, Nebat tapa Jeroboam tungtang thu a zawlnei Iddo mengmuh gelhna bu ah atuang kei maw?
Solomon in Jerusalem ah Israel mi tengteng tung ah kum sawmli vai ahawm hi.
Solomon bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, apa David khua ah avui ua, asik in atapa Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.
Paul, Pathian deihlam a Khrist Jesu sawltak leh i unaupa Timothi in, Korinth a Pathian saptuam omte kiang leh Akhaia gam tengteng a misiangthou omte kiang ah:
Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist' Pa leh Pathian, zahngaihnate' Pa leh khamuanna tengteng Pathian phat in om hen.
Pathian in koumau hon khamuanna ngei in gimthuakna peuhmah a omte leng ka khamuan sam theihna ding un, ama'n ka gimthuaknate uah ahon khamuan hi.
Khrist thuaknate tampitak ka tan bang un, Khrist ziak in khamuanna leng tamsem ka tang uhi.
Himahleh gimthuak a ka om uleh noumau khamuanna ding leh hotdamna ding ahi a; huan khamuan a ka om uleh ka thuak bang uh na thuak chiang ua na theih ua na khamuanna ding uh ahi.
Huan gimthuakna tang samte na hih bang un, khamuanna tang samte leng na hi uh chih ka theih un, noute a ka lametna uh akip ahi.
Unaute aw, Asia gam a ka tung ua gimthuakna tung na theih louh uh ka deih kei uhi, huchi a nakpitak a thuakzoh vual louh leh hin leng lamethuai lou khop hial in delhden in ka om uhi.
Ahi, si dia thupukkhum in ka om ua; huai tuh koumau kimuang lou a misite kaithoupa Pathian ka muan zawkna ding uh ahi.
Ama'n huchibang sih lauhuai lak ah hon hunkheta a, ahon hunkhe lellel a, hon hunkhe nawn lai ding ahi, chi in amah ka muang uhi.
Noute'n leng thumna in na hon panpih ding uh ahi, huchi in tampite thumna dawnna vualzawlna piak a ka om chiang un koute ziak in mi tampi in kipahthu agen ding uhi.

Koute suanpen hiai ahi, sapilna ah hilou in, Pathian hehpihna ah hi zaw in sianthouna leh Pathian dikna nei in khovel ah mawltak a ka gamta in, nou lam ah ka gamta hoih nawn sem uh chih ka sia-le-pha theihna un hon theisak hi.
Na sim theih uleh na theihtheih ding uh lou ngal thudang himhim na kiang uah ka gelh kei uhi; atawp pha in ka thu uh na theihsiam uh ka lamen lai uhi.
Theihsiamna tan na neih tak bang un, i Toupa Jesu ni chiang in, noute ka hon suan theih bang un nou leng koute na hon suang thei sam ding uhi.
Huan huai gintakna nei in, na kiang uah hong masa leng ka chi a, kipahna thuah nih na neihtheihna ding un.
Noumau tawn kawm in Masidonia gam ah pai zel leng la, Masidonia gam a kipan na kiang uah hong kihei nawn in, Judia gam a ka hohna ding ah noumau hong kha le uchin ka chi ahi.
Huchibang ka ngaihtuah lai in ka lungsim kiplouhdan langsak in hia ka hih? Ahihkeileh, "Ahi, chih leh Ahi kei," chi tuaktuak ding in, thilhih ka tup nak pen sadan in hia ka tup?
Himahleh Pathian amuanhuai bang in noumau lam a ka thu uh, Ahi, chih leh Ahi kei, chih ahi kei hi.
Akoi abang hi hen aw, Pathian Tapa Jesu Khrist thu, kei Silvanas leh Timothi in na lak ua ka gen un, "Ahi leh Ahi kei,” chih ahi sam kei a, amah ah zaw thil tengteng, "Ahi," chih ahi gige hi.
Pathian thuchiamte tengteng in amah ah, "Ahi," chih amu vek hi. Huaiziak in ahi Pathian thupina ding a amah ziak a, "Amen," ka chih uh.
Huan Khrist a noumau toh hon hihkippa leh koute hon thaunilhpa, Pathian ahi.
Amah zaw hon chiamtehpa leh i lungtang a khamna Kha hon pepa leng ahi.
Himahleh ka kha tung a theihpih ding in Pathian ka sam ahi, noumau hon hawi ding in ahi Korinth a ka hong tak louh zawk.
Na ginna uh hon thuneihkhum hilou in, na kipahna ding ua nou toh semkhawm ka hi zaw uhi; ginna a na dinkip ziak un.
Huan kei Paul, na lak ua na mitmuh ua thunuailuttak a om a, na kiang ua om louh chiang a noumau lam a khauh in Khrist lungnemna leh nunnemna in ka hon ngen ahi.
Ahi, na kiang ua ka om chiang in khenkhat sa bang a om a hon septe tung a hangsantak a om ka tup ngamna bang in, ka hon khauhkhum akullouhna ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
Sa ah om mah leng sa kidou bang in i dou kei ua,
eite kigalthopnate zaw sa leng ahi kei a, kulhpi kiptak phelna ding a Pathian ziak a thilhihtheitak galvan ahi zaw hi.
Lung a gel pansante leh thil sang chiteng Pathian theihna dal ding a sangtak a bawlte i phuk zel; ngaihtuahna chiteng Khrist thumanna sikha a pi in;
na thumandan uh hihkim a a-om chiang in, thumanlouhna tengteng phu la ding nangawn a leng mansa in ka om uhi.
Noute'n polam muh theih thilte kia en na hi uh maw? Kuapeuh in Khrist a hi a kimuang ahihleh amah kingaihtuah nawn hen, amah Khrist a ahih bang in, koute leng ka hi sem uhi.
Ka thuneihna uh nou hihsiatna ding ahi kei a, noumau bawlhoih zawkna ding a Toupa'n ahon piak suang mah leng ka zahlak kei ding uhi.
Ka laikhakte a nou hon hihlau tum bang a ka latlouhna ding in huai ka chi ahi.
"Alaikhakte zaw agik in akhauh a, himahleh ataksa kilatdan mizawngkhalpi ahi a, apau leng ahawmthohhuai,” achi uhi.
Ka om louh chiang ua ka laikhakte ua ka thugelh uleh, huai lai a na kiang ua ka om chiang ua ka hih ding uh akibatlouhna a-om kei chih huchibang mite'n theisiam uhen.
Khenkhat amau kiphatte lak ah ka kisimkhawm ngam kei ua, amau toh leng ka kitehpih ngam sam kei uhi. Himahleh amau zaw amau leh amau kiteh in amau leh amau kitehpih in lungsim nei lou in a-om uhi.
Kou zaw Pathian hon tehna val in ka ki-uangsak kei ding ua, mohpuakna ahon piak bang zel in ka ki-uangsak zaw ding uhi, noumau ngei leng huai mohpuakna in hon huamkhak na hi uhi.
Ka thuneih phaklouhna ding tantan uh hong uk hilou in, Khrist tanchinhoih gen in na khua uah ka hong pai zaw uhi.
Koute ka hihna pel ua kiphat hiam, midang sepgimnate kisuanpih ka hi kei uh; na ginna uh akhandan bang zel in, na lak ua ka nasepna uh nakpitak a hihlet in omleh chih lametna ka nei zaw uhi,
huchi in midang nasepsa suang hilou a, nou khen lam gamte tanpha a tanchinhoih ka gentheihna ding un.
Himahleh, "Asuang peuh in Toupa suang hen,"
Amah kiphat mi in phat aloh ngal kei a, Toupa'n agen hoih mi in phat aloh zaw ahi.
Ka hai deuhna uah noute'n Pathian ah na hon thuak theih uh ka ut hi. Ahi, thuak leng na hon thuak theita uhi!
Pathian hazatna, thikthuse khop in ahi nou ka hon hazat; Khrist kiang a nungak siangthou bang a ka hon piaktheihna ding in, pasal khat ka hon hawisak hi.
Himahleh gul in azuau pil a Evi akhem bang in, Khrist lam a takna leh sianthouna a kipan bangchi hiam in na lungsim uh ahihse kha ding, chih ka lauthawng hi.
Khattei hong pai a Jesu dang, athu ka gen ngei louh uh, agen a, kha lamdang na muh ngei louh uh leh tanchinhoih lamdang na san ngei louh uh, na pom pah un kipe baih lua na himah kei ding ua hia!
Hiai Sawltaklian thuneipen na chihte uh sang in bang lam peuh ah niamzawkna nei in ka kigingta kei hi.
Thugen lam ah pau zatsiam kei mah leng theihna ah zaw huchibang ka hi kei uhi; huai noute kiang ah bang lam peuh leh thil tengteng ah ka kilangsak uhi.
Ahihkeileh, Pathian tanchinhoih athawn lel a ka hon hilh ziak a tawisan a na omtheihna ding ua ka kihihniam in thil ka hihkhial a hia?
Na nna uh ka septheihna ding in midangte a kipan huhna la in, saptuam pawl dangte ka lok ahi.

Huan na kiang ua ka om a, ka taksap lai in, kuamah ka hon hihbuai kei a; unau Masidonia gam a kipan a hong paite'n ka taksap awng ahong huksak ngal ua; bangkim ah noumau hihbuai lou in ka kibawl bang in, ka kibawl zel lai ding hi.
Khrist thutak kei mah a a-om bang in, hiai ka kisuanna zaw Akhaia gam lam ah hihdaih in a-om kei ding.
Bangziak in? K'on it louh ziak hia? Pathian in ka hon it lam athei hi.
Huan anasep uh kisaktheihpih a, kou sep bangbang a sem kichite kichihna ka bulkalh theihna ding in ka sep tuh ka sem zom zel ding hi.
Mi huchibangte zaw Khrist sawltak akibawltawm a, sawltak takloute, nasemmi, mikhem hatte ahi uhi.
Huai ahihleh alamdang kei; Setan hial leng vak sawltak in akibawltawm nak ahi.
Huaiziak in anasemte leng diktatna nasemmi in kibawltawm mah le uh thillamdang ahi kei; huaite tawpna zaw athilhih bang zel un ahi ding hi.
Ka chi nawn ahi, kuamah in mihai in hon sep kei uhen; himahleh na hon seh vanglak uleh, ke'n leng neuchik bek a ka kisaktheih sam theihna ding in mihai bangtak in hon pom un.
Ka gen zaw Toupa thuneihna in ka gen kei a, ka kisaktheihna mihai bangtak in ka gen zaw ahi.
Mi tampite'n khovel thilte akisaktheihpih ziak un kei leng ka hong kisathei sam ding hi.
Nou bel mipil na hih ziak un mihaite lungkimtak in na thuakzou zel uhi.
Mi sal a hon bawlte, hon negaite, nuamtak hon sa a na tung ua kiliansak leh na mai ua hon bengte na thuak thei zel ngal ua.
Kisitna dan in ka gen ahi, huchi dia zaw hat lou lua mah kei ve ua!
Amaute Hebru mi ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi. Israel mi ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi. Abraham suante ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi.
Khrist nasemte ahi uhia? Mihai bang in gen taleng, ka hi sem; sepgimna ah thupi sem in, suangkul tanna ah bang thupi sem in, vuakna ah bang akan-aval in, sih lauhuaina tamveipi ka tuak hi.
Judate lak ah vuakna khatvei a sawmli ching lou ngavei ka tuak hi.
Thumvei chiang a khet in ka om a, khatvei suang a den in ka om hi, thumvei longsiatna ka tuak a, zan khat leh ni khat tuipi ah taihmang in ka om hi.

Khualzinna ah tamveipi, luite lak ah lauhuai, suamhatte lak ah lauhuai, ka chipihte lak ah lauhuai, Zentelte lak ah lauhuai, khopi ah lauhuai, gamdai ah lauhuai, tuipi ah lauhuai, unau takloute lak ah lauhuai;
