septawlna leh sepgimna, ihmutmohna ah tamveipi, gilkial leh dangtakna ah, an ngawlna ah tamveipi, khosik leh vuaktang a omnate.
Huan hiaite ban a kigen lou saptuam pawl tengteng ka ngaihtuahna niteng a hon delh gige leng a-om hi.
Kua ahia zawngkhal a om a, ke'n ka zawnkhalpih louh? Kua ahia khelhna a puksia a, ke'n ka lunggimpih louh?
Suang ding ka hih vanglakleh ka hatlouhna lam thilte ahi ka suan ding.
Tangtawn a phat tak, Toupa Jesu' Pathian leh Pa in zuau ka genlouhdan athei hi.
Damaskas ah kumpipa Aretas nuai a gam-ukpa'n hon man ding in Damaskas khopi avengsak a;
himahleh kulhbaang tohlet ah bawm in hon khaikhia ua, huchi in akhut a kipan ka suakta hi.
Ka ki-uangsak lai ding hi. Ka phattuampih ding a-om kei na a, Toupa kiang a kipan mengmuhna leh kilakna thu ka genzom lai ding hi.
Khrist a mi khat ka thei; huai mi tuh kum sawm-le-li ahita a, pumpi in hia a-om ka thei kei, pumpi lou in hia a-om ka thei sam kei; Pathian in athei, van thumna hial ah laktouh in a-om hi.
Huai mi mahmah, pumpi in hia a-om, pumpi lou in hia ka thei kei; Pathian in athei hi;
paradis a laktouh a a-omdan, thu genkhiak vual louh, mihing gensiangloute aza chih ka thei hi.
Mi huchibang ahihleh ka suang ding; himahleh ka hatlouhna lou zaw keimah ka kisuang kei ding hi.
Suan ut mah leng mihai ka hi kei ding, thutak tak ka gen dek ngal a; himahleh ka kidek ding, huchi lou in zaw kuapeuh in hon muh bang uleh ka lak a thu azak sang un hon ngai thupizaw kha ding uhi.
Huan kilakna thupi mahmah ziak a ka kingaihlet luatlouhna ding in ka sa ah ling hon pia ahi, Setan sawltak, khut thak nuhna dia hon zang ding ngei; huchi lou in zaw ka kingailian kha ding hi.
Huai thil tungtang thu ah hon awngsut theihna ding in Toupa thumvei ka ngen hi.

Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Ka hehpihna nang a ding in ahun hi, hatlouhna ah ahi ka thilhihtheihna hihkim a a-om,” achi hi. Huchi in Khrist thilhihtheihna ka tung a a-omtheihna ding in kipaktak in ka hatlouhnate ka suang zaw ding hi.
Huaiziak in Khrist ziak a hatlouhna ah, liamna ah, taksapna ah, sawina ah, lungngaihna ah ka kipak zel hi; ka hat louh peuhpeuh chiang in ahi ka hat zawk zel.
Hai ka na hita; nou hai lou thei lou in na hon bawl ua ahi; bangmah hi kei mah leng, noumau na hon pahtawi ding uh ka hi, bang lam peuh ah leng sawltaklian thuneipente ka pha lou kei hi.
Ka sawltaklian hih chiamtehnate kuhkalna chiteng toh chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, nasep thupite in na lak uah hih ahi taktak hi.
Bang lam ah ahia, saptuam pawl dangte sang a niamzaw a bawl a na omna uh? Keimah ngeingei in ka hon hihbuailouhna lam thu ah ahih kei ngalleh. Huai diklouhna ah hon ngaidam un.

Ngai un, hiai na kiang ua hong hoh ding ka sawm athumveina ahi; noute ka hon hihbuai kei ding, na thilneihte uh hilou in noumau hon deih ka hi zaw hi; tate'n nu leh pate a ding in akholkhawmsak ding uh ahi kei a, nu leh pate'n tate ding in akholkhawmsak zaw ding uh ahi.
Huan kei zaw na kha ua ding in kipaktak in ka kizangbei ding a, ka kizangbei vek lai ding hi. Akan-aval a nou ka hon it ziak in ke'n noute itna tawmzaw muhna in ka nei ahi maw?
Himahleh kei mahmah in ka hon hihbuailouhna ah kei lepchiahpil leh khemna a noute hon man na sa ua hiam.
Na kiang ua ka misawl kuahiamte zang in nou ka hon hamphatpih ngei a hia?
Noute kiang a hong pai ding in Titas ka ngen a, amah toh unaupa ka hon sawl hi. Titas in nou ahon hamphatpih himhim hia? Kha kibang a gamtakhawm ka hi kei ua hia? Khap kibang a pai ka hi kei ua hia?
Noumau kiang a kou leh kou kihu na hon sa ua hia? Khrist ah Pathian mitmuh in ahi thu ka gen uh. Himahleh deihtakte aw, bangkim noumau bawlhoihna ding ahi.

Ka hong pai chiang in bangchi hiam a ka lamet bang a ka hon muh keileh kei deih bang in na hon mu kei kha ding uh chih leh bangchi hiam in kitainate, kihazatnate, hehnate, kilangkhennate, kigennate, kihuaukhumnate, kingaihlet luatnate, buainate a om in ka hon mu kha ding chih ka lau hi.

Na kiang ua ka hong nawn chiang in ka Pathian in na lak uah hon hih zahlak in thil hihkhialte leh thilsiang lou hihte, kingaite, huk ching a kisik tuan lou, mi tampite ka kahkhum kha ding chih ka lau hi.
Hiai pen na kiang ua ka hong athumveina ding ahi. "Theihpih nih hiam, thum hiam kam ah thu chiteng hihkip in a-om ding hi."

Ka genkholta a, anihveina a na kiang ua ka om lai a ka gen bang in, tu'n ah na kiang ua om lou in, tuma lam a thil hihkhialte kiang ah leh midang tengteng kiang ah ka genkhol nawn dek hi, ka hong nawnleh ka hawi kei ding, chih;
Khrist keimah a thu gen zelpa pen chetna na zon ziak un, amah zaw noumau lam ah ahat lou kei a, na lak uah thilhihtheitak ahi zaw hi.
Hatlouhna a kilhlup himahleh Pathian thilhihtheihna ziak in ahing hi. Kou leng amah ah ka hat kei uhi, himahleh, noumau lam a Pathian thilhihtheihna ziak in akiang ah ka hing sam ding uhi.
Ginna ah na om na uhiam chih noumau ngeingei ki-enchian zel un. Ahihkeileh noumau ah Jesu Khrist a-om chih noumau ngeingei in na theichian kei ua hia? Deih louh na hih kei ngal uleh.
Koute deih louh in ka om kei uh chih na thei lai ding un ka gingta hi.

Huan thil himhim na hihkhelhlouhna ding un Pathian kiang ah ka ngen zel uhi; koute deihhuai a ka lattheihna ding uh ahi kei a, koute deih louh in om mah le ung noute'n akilawm peuhmah na hihtheihna ding uh ahi zaw hi.
Thutak gum ding lou in zaw, thutak dou ding in bangmah ka hihthei kei uhi.
Koute ka hat louh lai un noute na hat ua, ka kipak uhi; noumau hoih lam a na kibawlphat uh thumna a ka nget uh ahi.

Huaiziak in hihse ding hilou a bawlhoih ding zaw a, Toupa'n thuneihna ahon piak bang zel in, na kiang ua ka om chiang a nakpitak a ka hon taihilhlouhna ding in, na kiang ua ka om louh lai in hiai thu ka gelh ahi.

Atawp pen in, unaute aw, kipaktak in om un, na omdan uh kitungding unla; ka hon ngetna limsak un, kikhamuantuah in om unla; lungsim mun khat pu unla, kituaktak in om un; huan na kiang uah itna leh khamuanna Pathian a-om ding hi.
Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un.
Misiangthou tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna, Pathian itna, Kha Siangthou kithuah-pihna na vek ua tung ah om hen, Amen.
Himahleh keimah lam thu ah zaw hiai ka na tum tintenta ahi, lungkhamna dia na kiang ua hong nawnta lou ding in.
Ke'n ka hon hihlungkhamleh ka hihlungkhampen mah lou in kua'n ahia kei hon hihkipak ding?
Huchi in huai mahmah ka gelh ahi, huchi lou in zaw ka hong in ka kipahna dingte lak ah lungkhamna ka mu zaw kha ding a; ka kipahna zaw na vek ua kipahna ahih ka hon gintaksak chiat ngal hi.
Khitui tampi ke kawm a lungtang a haksa leh lauthawng pipi a ka gelh ahi; hihlungkham a na omna ding uh ahi kei a, na tung ua itna thupizaw sem ka nei chih na theih zawkna ding uh ahi.
Himahleh kuapeuh in mite ahihlungkhamleh keimah kia hon hihlungkham ahi kei a, uanggen lua bel hilou in, na vek ua hon hihlungkham chiat ahi zaw hi.
Huchibang mi a ding in gawtna na piak tak uh akihun ahi.
Huchi in na ngaidam un na khamuan zawta ding uh ahi, huchi lou in zaw bangchi chi hiam in mi huchibang alungkham luatna in avalhzou kha ding.
Huaiziak in amah na itna uh hihkip ding in ka hon ngen hi.
Hiai ziak mah in leng ka gelh ahi, bang peuhmah thu na man uleh, na man louh uh theihchetna ding in.
Bang lam peuh a mi na ngaihdam uh ke'n leng ka ngaidam hi; ke'n ka ngaihdam khitsa, bangpeuh ka na ngaihdam takleh noumau ziak in Khrist ah ka ngaidamta ahi.
Huchi lou in zaw Setan in hunlem ala kha ding hi; atup lah i haih ngal kei ua.
Huan Khrist tanchinhoih gen ding a Troas ka tun in, Toupa ah kongkhak honsak in ka om hi.
Himahleh ka unaupa Titas ka muh louh ziak in ka khalam ah zaw tawldamna himhim ka nei tuan kei, huchi in amaute kampha in ka khen a, ka pawt a, Masidonia gam ah ka paita hi.
Himahleh Khrist vualzohna a hon pi zelpa leh koute a mun chih a amah theihna gimnamtui theisakpa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
Hotdam a omlelte leh mangthang lellelte ah Pathian a ding in Khrist gimnamtui ka hi uhi.
Pawl khatte a ding in sihna lak ah sihna ding gimnam ka hi ua, pawl khatte ding in hinna lak a hinna ding in gimnam ka hi uh. Hiai bangte a ding in kua ahia chingzou ding?
Mi tampi in Pathian thu mite khem a sumsinna a azat bang un kou zaw ka zang kei uhi. Pathian sawltak hi zaw in, chihtaktak in Pathian mitmuh in Khrist ah thu ka gen zel uhi.

Koumau kigenhoih pan nawn dek ka hi uhia? Ahihkeileh, na kiang ua piak ding hiam aw na kiang ua kipan hiam genhoihna lai, mi khenkhat a dia akiphatmoh bang in koute a ding in akiphamoh sam ding a hia?
Noute ka lai uh, na lungtang ua gelh, mi tengteng theih leh sim na hi uhi.
Khrist lai, kou hon gelhsak laitui a gelh hilou, Pathian hing Kha gelh hi zaw, suangpek a gelh hilou, sa lungtang pek a gelh hi zaw na hi uh chih chiantak in na taklangta uhi.
Huan Pathian lam ah huchibang muanna Khrist vang in ka nei uhi.
Bangpeuh koumau a kipan a pawt ahi chi a ngaihsun ding in koumau kia in ka chin uh ka chi kei ua; ka chintheihna uh Pathian kiang a kipan ahi zaw.
Amah mah in thukhun thak nasemte hi ding in hon chingsak a; alai thu gelh lel nasemte ding hilou in, a Kha nasemte ding in ahi zaw hi; laithu gelh lel in zaw ahihlum nak a, Kha in bel ahihhing hi.
Mosi mel avak ziak in Israel suante'n amel a-en sawt thei kei ua, huai thupina amang hiaihiai a; sihna nasepna suang a laimal gelh bawn, huchi tel a thupi a atunleh,
Kha nasepna pen bangchi phet a thupi in atung diam aw?
Siam louh tansakna nasepna bawn athupileh diktatna nasepna athupizaw mahmah ding ahi.
Hih thupi a omsa in hiai ah zaw thupina himhim aneita ngal kei a, thupina thupizaw in akhuh tak ziak in.
Mangta hiaihiai bawn thupi a atunleh om gige ding thupi atuam in a-om zaw mahmah ding ahi.
Huan huchibang lametna ka neih ziak un hangsantak in gen ngamna ka nei uhi.
Mosi hih bang in ka hih kei ua, ama'n zaw thupina mang hiaihiai tawpna Israel suante'n a-et sawt louhna ding un maikhuhna in amai akhuh a;
alungsim uh bel hihkhauh in a-om a; tuni tanpha in Thukhun Lui asim un khuhna ngeina hawk louh in a-om gige ngal a, huai khuhna Khrist ah hihmang in a-omta hi.
Himahleh tuni tanpha in Mosi Laibu asim peuh chiang un alungtang uah khuhna a-om hi.
Himahleh alungtang uh Toupa lam angat peuh chiang un khuhna lakmang ahita ding hi.
Huan Toupa tuh huai Kha ahi a, Toupa Kha omna peuh ah noplenna a-om zel hi.
Huchi in eite zaw i vek un mai khuh lou in limlang bang a Toupa thupina tangsawnsak zel in, amah kibatpih ngeingei a om ding in hihlamdan in i om zel uhi; hiai Toupa Kha ngei a kipan i muh ahi.
Huaiziak in Pathian zahngaihna a hiai nasepna mu in ka lungke kei uhi.

Thil zumhuai kiselte ka pampaih zawta ua, khemna thu ka zang kei ua, Pathian thu tuh mi khemna ding in ka zang kei ua, thutak theisak in Pathian mitmuh in michih sia-le-pha theihna mit ka tungsak uhi.
Himahleh ka tanchinhoih uh khuh a a-omleh, mangthang lelte ah ahi khuh a a-om.
Pathian batpih Khrist leh athupidan tanchinhoih vak in amau asalhvak theihlouhna ding in, huaite ah hiai khovel pathian in agingtaloute lungsim asukmialsakta hi.
Koumau thu ka gen kei ua, Khrist Jesu Toupa thu ka gen zaw uhi, koute leng Jesu ziak in sikha ka hih uh leng ka gen zel uhi.
Jesu Khrist mel ah Pathian thupidan theihna vak hon pe ding in, "Mial a kipan vak avakkhe ding," chipa Pathian in i lungtangte asalvakta ngal hi.
Himahleh thilhihtheihna thupina koute a hilou a, Pathian a ahihtheih zawkna ding in huai gou tuh leibel ah ka kem uhi.
Alanglang ah nehden in ka om ua, himahleh ning kitel in ka om tuan kei uh; mangbang in ka om ua himahleh ka lungke tuan kei uhi.
Sawi in ka om ua, himahleh taisan in ka om kei uh; khetpuk in ka om ua, himahleh hihmang in ka om kei uh.
Ka pumpi uah chik lai peuh in leng Jesu sihna ka pu zel ua, Jesu hinna leng ka pumpi ua alattheihna ding in.
Koute hingdam a omlaite Jesu ziak a si ding a matsak in ka om gige ua Jesu hinna leng ka sa sithei ua a lattheihna ding in.
Huchi in koute ah sihna in asem gige a, nou ah bel hinna in asem gige hi.
Himahleh, "Ka ging a, huaiziak in thu ka gen ahi," chih gelhpa ginna lungsim ngei pu in, kou leng ka ging ua, thu leng ka gen uhi.
Toupa Jesu kaithoupa'n koute leng Jesu ah hon kaithou sam ding a, noumau toh ama omna mun ah hon dingsak ding chih thei in.
Bangkim noumau hoihna ding ahi ngal a, hehpihna mi tamzaw ziak a hihkhan a om a, Pathian thupina ding a kipahthu genna nakpitak a akhansak sem theihna ding in.
Huai thu ziak in ka bah kei uhi; i polam mihing zawngkhal hiaihiai mahleh, i sunglam mihing pen niteng in bawl thak zel in a-om zaw ahi.
Ka gimthuakna neukha uh tu mitphiat kal sung kia a om ding in, thupina thupitak tangtawn a ding in ahon bawlsak hulhul ahi.
Thil muhtheihte en lou in, thil muh theihlouhte ka en zaw uhi; thil muhtheihte zaw sawt lou kal a ding ahi a, thil muh theihlouhte bel tangtawn a ding ahi zaw hi.
I omna lei inn, hiai puanin pen hihsiat in om mahleh van ah inn, khut a lam louh, tangtawn a om ding, Pathian a kipan inn kip i nei uh chih i thei uhi.
Van a kipan i omna ding silhthuah ut mahmah in hiai puanin ah thum chihtak in i thum gige uhi.
Huchibang a silh in om leng vuaktang in i om kei ding uhi.
Eite hiai puanin a i om sung in gik pua in thum petmah in i thum ngal ua, silh lou a om i ut ziak ahi kei a, silhthuah a om i ut ziak ahi zaw, sithei pen hinna valh a a-om theih zawkna ding in.
Huan huai mahmah ding a hon sutuahpa khamna Kha hon pepa Pathian ahi.
Huchi in pumpi a i om lai teng in Toupa kiang ah i om nai kei chih thei in, muangtak in i om gige uhi.
Muthei a pai lou in, ginna in i pai zaw zel uhi.
Muangtak in i om, huan pumpi a om lou a Toupa kiang a om i utzaw hi.
Huaiziak in om in om keita lehang leng, amah kipahpih lam mi hih i tum tinten ahi.
Michih in pumpi a thilhihte asia-apha in, i hih bangbang a i muh chiat theihna ding in, Khrist thukhenna tutphah ma ah hihlat in i om vek ding uhi.
Huchi in Toupa kihtakdan thei in mihingte ka hanthawn zel uhi, koute hihna Pathian kiang ah latsak a om bang in, na sia-le-pha theihna uah leng latsak a ka om uh ka lamen uhi.
Na kiang uah ka kigenhoih nawn uh ahi kei a, lungtang hilou a, dinmun lel suangte bang ahi hiam dawnna ding na neihtheihna ding un kou lam ah suantheihna hon bawl in ka gen zaw uhi.
Ka hai uleh Pathian a ding in ahi a; ka pil uleh noumau a ding in ahi.
Khrist itna in ahon sawl teitei ahi; hichi in ka ngaihtuah uhi; mi tengteng sih sik in mi khat asi a, huaiziak in mi tengteng asi uhi.
Mi tengteng sih sik a Khrist asihna pen ahingte leng amau a dia ahin nawn louh ua, asih sik ua si a thounawn a ding a ahin zawkna ding un.
Huchi ahih ziak in tuban kou zaw salam ah kuamah ka thei nawnta kei ding uh; salam ah Khrist na theita mah le ung leng; tu'n zaw ka theita kei uhi.
Huchi ahih ziak in, kuapeuh Khrist a a-omleh thilsiam thak ahong hi a; thil luite amangta a, ngai un, ahong thakta hi.
Himahleh bangkim Pathian kiang a kipan a pawt ahi a; ama'n Khrist ziak in amah toh kituak in hon bawl a, kituahna nasepna ahon pia hi.
Huchi in Pathian in Khrist ah khovel amah toh kituak nawn in abawl a, atatleknate uh tatlekna a sehsak lou in, kituah nawnna thu hon kemsak ahi.
Huaiziak in koute Khrist palai nasemte ka hi ua, Pathian in koute tungtawn in ahon ngen ahi. Pathian toh kituakta un aw chi in Khrist sik in ka hon ngen uhi.
Amah a Pathian diktatna i hong hihtheihna ding in khelhna himhim thei lou amah Pathian in eite ziak in khelhna in abawl hi.
Pathian hehpihna phattuampih lou a na tanlouhna ding un, amah seppih koute'n ka hon ngen petmah uhi.
"Hun kipahhuai ah ka hon ngaikhia a, hotdamna ni ah ka hon panpih," achi ngal a. Ngai un, tu hun kipahuai ahi a; ngai in, tu hotdamna ni ahi!
Ka nasepna uh dem a a-omlouhna ding in bang lam peuh ah kuamah pukloh ding himhim ka bawl kei uhi.
Pathian nasemte bang in bangkim ah mi mit tung in ka om zaw zel ua, nakpi a kuhkalna ah, gentheihna ah, taksapnate ah, lunggimnate ah;
vuaknate ah, hentaknate ah, mipihon buainate ah, sepgimnate ah, zan ihmutmohnate ah leh gilkialna ah;
sianthouna in, theihna in, kuhkalna in, migitna in, Kha Siangthou in leh
thutak thu in, Pathian thilhihtheihna in; taklam leh veilam a diktatna galvante zang in;
pahtawina ah leh pahtawilouhna ah, min gensiat leh min genhoihna ah leng;
midiktat hi ngal in mikhemte bang a bawl in ka om ua; minthangtak hi ngal in theih tham louh bang in, si dek phial a vuak a om a, hihlup louh in, ngai dih ua, ka hing ua;
lungkhamtak bang a om in, lah kipak gige ngal in; zawngtak bang a om in, lah bangkim a midangte hausa a bawl in, bangmah nei lou bang in, lah thil bangkim nei hi ngal in.
Korinthte aw, koute'n zalentak in ka gen ua, ka lungtang uh zatak in akihong hi.
Noute a ding in phal louh bangmah ka nei kei ua, nou bel na thil deihlam uah phal louh tan na nei uhi.
Huchi in ka hon piak bangbang hon pethuk sam ding in (tate kiang a gen bang in ka gen ahi), nou leng na lungtangte uh zasak sam un.
Ginglou mite toh kituakloupi a hakkol pokhawm in om kei un; diktatlouhna leh diktatna in bang ahia kikopna aneih uh? Ahihkeileh, mial leh vak in bang ahia kithuahna aneih uh?
Belial leh Khrist in bang ahia kituahna aneih uh? Ahihkeileh, gingloumi leh gingtami'n bang ahia tankhawm aneih uh?

Milimte leh Pathian tempul in leng bang ahia kituahna aneih uh? Eite zaw Pathian hing tempul i hi ngal ua; Pathian in, "Amaute ah ka teng dia, amau lak ah leng ka khosa ding; huan a Pathian uh ka hi dia, amau leng ka mite ahi ding uh, achih bang in.
Huaiziak in alak ua kipan in hong pawt unla, atuam in om un, thilsiang lou himhim khoih kei un, Toupa'n achi, huchi in ka hon kipahpih dia,
noute a ding in na Pa uh ka hi dia, noute leng kei a ding in tanute leh tapate na hi ding uh, Toupa Bangkim hihthei in achi," chi in.
Huchi in deihtakte aw, huai thuchiamte i neih ziak un, sa leh kha buahna tengteng a kipan ei leh ei i kisiangsak ding uh, Pathian laudan siam kawm a sianthouna hihbukim in.
Na lungtang uah mun hon awn un; kua tung mah ah ka khial kei ua, kuamah ka hihse kei ua, kuamah ka khem sam kei uh.
Kuamah siam louh tansak sawm a hiai thu gen ka hi kei; sih leh sihkhawm a, dam leh damkhawm ding in ka lungtang uah noute ka hon vom uh chih tuma zek in ka genta hi.
Nou lam ah zaw ka pau ngamdan athupi a, ka hon suandan athupi hi; khamuanna in ka dim a, ka haksatna tengteng uah nuamsa in ka dimlet hi.
Masidonia gam ka tun un leng ka sa un muanna himhim anei tuan kei a, khat lam khat lam ah hihgim in ka om zawta ua; polam kisualnate a-om a; sunglam launate leng a-om hi.
Himahleh, lungngai a omte khamuanpa, Pathian in, Titas ahong tunna in hon khamuan a;
ahong tunna kia in ahi kei, na lungkhamdante uh, na kahdante uh, ka tung a na phattuamngaihdante uh hon hilh a, noumau a akhamuanna mah in leng ahon khamuanta ahi; huchi in ka kipak nawn sem hi.
Ka laikhak in hon hihlungkham mah leng, ka kisik kei hi; atung in ahihleh ka kisik a, huai laikhak in nou ahon hihlungkham chih ka theih ziak in; himahleh sawt lou kal kia ahi.

Tu'n zaw ka kipak ahi, hihlungkham a na om ziak uh ahi kei a, kisikna ding a na lungkham ziak un ahi zaw hi. Koumau ziak a bangmah na tanlouhna ding un Pathian deihlam bang a hihlungkham in na om uhi.
Pathian deihlam a lungkhamna in hotdamna ding in, kisikna abawl a, kisikhuai thil atun kei; khovel lungkhamna in bel sihna atun zaw hi.

En mah un, Pathian deihlam a lungkhamna in bangchibang chihtakna, bangchibang kihahsiang nopna, bangchibang ki-awilouhna, bangchibang patauh-na, bangchibang lunggulhna, bangchibang phattuamngaihna, bang-chibang gawtna ahia nou a dia ahon tut tak. Bangkim ah huai thu ah na siang uh chih na kihihlangta uhi.

Huchi in na kiang uah gelh mah leng, agilou hihpa ziak in ka gelh kei a, agilou thuakpa ziak in leng ka gelh sam kei, ka tung ua na phattuam ngaihdan uh Pathian mitmuh a na kiang ua theihsak a a-omtheihna ding in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in khamuan in ka omta him ua; koumau khamuanna kia lou ah leng, Titas kipahna ziak in ka kipak nawn sem ua, noute tengteng in alungsim na hihhalhsak tak ziak un.

Akiang ah bang lam peuh ah leng noumau hon suang mah le ung, ka zahlak ngal kei ua, zahlak nak sang in bangkim, na kiang ua thutak tak a ka gen zel bang un, Titas ma a ka hon suan uh thutak tak ahong hita ngei hi.
Huan na vek ua athu na mandante uh, lau leh ling kawm a amah na kipahpihdante uh theigige in, alainatna noumau lam ah alian nawn semta ahi.
Thil bangkim ah na tung ua ka muan ziak in ka kipak ahi.
Huan unaute aw, Masidonia gam a saptuam pawlte lak a Pathian hehpihna piak pen ka hon theisak ding uhi.
Huchi a haksa thuakna ze-etna thupi a, akipahna uh kiching zou leh nakpi a genthei hinapi, amau lam a athilphalna thupi un huaite khupzou ahihdan bang.
Aneih bang un, ahi, aneih sang ua thupi in leng, amau ut thu un apia uh chih theihpih ka hi;
hiai hehpihna leh misiangthoute nasepsakna thu a nakpitak a hon ngen ngutngut in.
Huan hiai leng ka lamet bang uh hilou, Toupa kiang ah akipekhe masa phot ua, huan Pathian deihna bang in koute kiang ah ahong kipekhia uhi.
Huchi in tuma a apatsa, hiai hehpihna leng noumau a hihkim lai ding in Titas ka ngen uhi.
Huchi in bangkim ginna, thugen siamna, theihna, phattuamngaihna tengteng, na hon itna uh na hauh bang un, huai hehpihna leng na hauhtheihna ding un thanop suah un.
Thupia bang in ka gen kei a, midang phattuamngaihna in na itna uh gildan leng chian ding in ka gen ahi zaw hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna, agentheihna ziak a na hong hauhtheihna ding un hau mahleh noumau ziak ngeingei a ahong gentheih takdan, na thei uhi.
Huchi in huai ah ka ngaihdan bang ahia ka gen hi; kum khat paita a na hih pat kia uh leng hilou, hih ding a na na lunggulh uh tu in buchingsakta le uchin nou a ding in ahoihpen ahi.
Huchi in hihpichin ding a kimanna a-om bang in, na neih bang zel ua tangtunna leng a-omtheihna ding in, tu'n ah zaw hihtangtungta un.
Kimanna pen a-om nak photleh mi aneih louhpi hilou in, aneih bang zel a apiak kipahpih tuak ahi.
Midang agim louh ua, nou na gimna ding un ka chi kei hi.

Kibatlualna ding in, na hauhna uh tulai in ataksap awnghukna ahong hih a, ahauhna uh leng na taksap awnghukna uh ahong hih sam theihna ding in ka chi ahi zaw, huchi in kibatlualna ahong om thei ding hi.
"Akhawm tam in aval in anei kei a, akhawm tawm in leng atasam tuan kei," chih gelh bang in.
Huan ke'n nou ka hon awlmoh bang a awlmohna lungtang Titas kiang a pepa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
Ka ngetna uh ahon sansak a; himahleh ka nget ziak kia uh hilou in, ama phatuamngaihna in, amah ut thu in na kiang ua hoh dia pawt ding in akisa hi.
Unaupa khat toh amah ka hon sawl uhi. Huai unaupa asaptuam un tanchinhoih lam a aphatna uh saptuam pawl tengteng ah athangsuak hi.

Huchi lel leng ahi kei, hiai hehpihna thawnpiak po ding a kou toh zin vialvial ding a saptuam telkhiak ahi a, Toupa thupina ding in hiai thilthawnpiak ka hawm ua, midangte huh na kithalawpna uh ensak ding in leng ka hawm uhi.
Hiai thilpiak ka hawmna lam uah kuamah in ahon demlouhna ding un ka pilvang uhi.
Toupa ngaihdan kia in hilou in, mihing ngaihdan a leng thil kilawm ka ngaihtuah khol zel uhi.
Huan akiang uah ka unaupa uh ka sawl ua, amah thil tampitak ah phatuamngaitak ahi chih tamveipi ka theichianta uhi, tu khol a houh nou ahon taksan mahmah ziak in phatuam angai nawn sem hi.
Titas ahihleh, ka lawm leh noumau lam a ka naseppih ahi a; huan, ka unaute uh ahihleh, saptuam pawlte palai, Khrist thupina ahi uhi.
Huaiziak in na it uh chih theihna leh ka hon suanna uh theihtelna saptuam pawlte ma ah akiang uah langsak un.
Misiangthoute a dia thilpiak thu zaw na kiang uah ka gelh akiphamoh kei hi.

Na kimandan uh ka thei ngal a, huai lam thu ah zaw nikum in Akhaia gamte kimansa in a-omta uh chi in Masidonia gam a mite kiang ah ka hon na suang zel a; na phattuamngaihna un alak ua mi tampi atok halhta hi.
Himahleh huai lam thu ah zaw ka hon suanna bangmah lou ahong hihlouhna ding in unaute ka hohsak zel hi; ka gen bangtak a mansa a na na omtheihna ding un.
Huchi lou in zaw Masidonia gam a mi kuate hiam in ahon zuih zenzen uleh, kiman lou in hong mu le uh, noute kia hilou in noute ka hon ginna uh lam ah kou leng ka zahlak kha ding uhi.

Huaiziak in unaute bel nou kiang a hong masa a, hoihtak a thilpiak na chiamkholhte uh na bawlkhol ding a, nget kiphamoh in ka gingta hi, laksak teitei bang hilou a phaltak a piak bang zaw a mansa a na omna ding un.
Himahleh huai lam thu ah zaw, theh tawm in a-at tawm ding a, theh tam in a-at tam ding hi.
Michih in it pipi a pe lou in, piak louh theih louh a ngaihtuah a pe tuan lou in, alungtang ua atup bang zel un pe chiat uhen; Pathian in kipaktak a pe mite ahi a-it.
Huan Pathian in hehpihna chiteng in na tung uah avuk thei ahi; huchi in nou bangkim ah ahun ngial nei gige in, nasep hoih chiteng a ding in na hau thei ding uhi;
"Ahawmzak a; gentheite kiang ah apia a; adiktatna tangtawn in a-om gige," chih gelh bang in.
Thehpa kiang a achi pepa leh nek ding a tanghou pepa'n na theh ding uh chi ahon pe ding a, ahon hihpungsak ding a, na diktatna gahte uh leng ahon hihpungsak ding.
Thilphalna chiteng koute ziak a Pathian kiang a kipahthu genna pen nei ding a, bangkim a hihhauh a om in,
hiai sepsakna nna in misiangthoute taksapna awngte ahuksak kia ahi kei a, Pathian kiang a kipahthu genna tampi in leng aluanglet lai ahi.
Hiai nasepna a etkhiak a om in Khrist tanchinhoih lam a na thugin uh na zuihdan uleh amau a ding leh mi tengteng a dia thilpiak a na thilphaldan un Pathian na hih thupi ding uh ahi.
Amau ngei in leng na tung ua Pathian hehpihna thupi mahmah ziak in, nou a dia thumsak kawm in ahon ngai mahmah uhi.
Athilpiak gen zoh vual louh ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
Upa in, tel a om numei leh atate thutak a ka it, kei kia hilou a, thutak thei peuhmahte kiang ah;
thutak eimah a om gige, tangtawn a i kiang ua om gige ding ahih ziak in;
Pa Pathian a kipan leh Pa' Tapa, Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna in thutak leh itna ah noute hon ompih hen.
Pa kiang a kipan athupiak i muh bang in na ta kuate hiam thutak a om a ka muh ziak in ka kipak mahmah hi.
Numei hoih, na kiang a thupiak thak gelh hilou in, atung a kipan a i neih pen gelh zaw in, i ki-ittuah theihna ding in nget petmah in ka hon ngen hi.
Huan hiai itna ahi, athupiak bang zel a i omna uh. Hiai ahi thupiak atung a kipat ana zak uh, huai ah na om ding uh ahi.
Jesu Khrist taksa in ahong pai chih gum lou khemmi tampi khovel ah ahong pawtta uhi. Huai mite ahi, khemmi leh Khrist doumi.
I sepkhiaksate mangsak lou a, akipahman bukim a i muhtheihna ding un, nangmah kivenghoih in.
Kuapeuh huai Khrist thu sinsakna thu a om gige lou a talek in Pathian anei kei. Huai thu sinsakna thu a a-om gige in Pa leh Tapa aneikhawm hi.
Kuapeuh huai thu sinsakna thu hon po lou a, na kiang ua ahong paileh na inn uah tungsak kei unla, paukam hoih in kha sam kei un,
paukam hoih a kha peuhmah athilhihkhelh ah panna anei ngal a.
Na kiang ua thu tampi gen ding ka neih ziak in lai leh laitui a gelh ka ut kei a; na kipahna uh akimtheihna ding in na kiang ua hong hoh a, kimaituah a kihou ka lamen zaw hi.
Na sanggamnu tel tate un chibai ahon buk uhi, Amen.
Huan Ahab sih nung in Israelte tung ah Moabte ahel uhi.

Samaria a dantan tungnung vathangkalh tohlet a pan Ahaziah akekhia a, akihihnata hi. Huchi in mi asawl a, akiang uah, "Kuan unla, hiai ka natna ahoihkhe nawn thei hiam Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub va dong un," achi hi.

Himahleh TOUPA angel in Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah, "Thou inla, Samaria kumpipa misawlte houpih ding in kuantou inla, akiang uah, Israel gam a Pathian a-om louh ziak in hia Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub dong dia na hong kuan uh?
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei dia, na si ngeingei ding, chi in va gen in," achi hi. Huchi in Elijah akuanta hi.
Amisawlte akiang ah ahong kik nawn un akiang uah, "Bang achi a ahia na hong kik nawn mawk uh?" achi hi.

Amau akiang ah, "Mi khat hong houpih ding in ahong a, ka kiang uah, pai unla, nou hon sawlpa kumpipa kiang ah kik nawn unla, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Israel gam a Pathian a-om louh ziak in hia Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub dong dia na sawl? Huchi in na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei ding a, na si ngeingei ding, chi in va hilh un ahon chi," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou hon houpih dia hong, huai thute hong hilhpa mi bangchibang ahia oi?" achi hi.
Amau adawng ua, "Samul puan a kizem ahi a, akawng savun kawnggak in agak," achi ua; ama'n, "Tishbi mi Elijah ahi ve," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n sepaih sawmnga heutu, aheute sawmnga toh akiang ah asawl hi. Mualvum a tu Elijah kiang ah ahohtou a, ama'n, "Nang, Pathian mi, kumpipa'n hong paisuk in, achi ve," achi hi.

Elijah in adawng a, sepaih sawmnga heutu kiang ah, "Pathian mipa ka hihleh van a pan mei hong kesuk henla, nangmah leh na heute sawmnga hong kangmang vek hen," achi hi. Huchi in van a pan mei ahong kia a, amah leh aheute sawmnga akangmang vek uhi.
Akiang ah sepaih sawmnga heutu dang, aheute sawmnga toh asawl nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Nang Pathian mi, kumpipa'n, hong paisuk meng in, achi ve," achi hỉ.

Elijah in adawng a, akiang ah, "Pathian mipa ka hihleh van a pan mei hong kesuk henla, nang leh na heute sawmnga hong kangmang vek hen,” achi hi. Huchi in Pathian mei van a kipan ahong kia a, amah leh aheute sawmnga akangmang vekta uhi.

Sepaih sawmnga dang heutu, aheute sawmnga toh asawl nawn a, huai sepaih sawmnga dang heutu akuantou a, Elijah ma ah ava khukdin a, akiang ah, "Pathian mipa aw, ka hinna leh hiai na sikha mi sawmngate hinna na mitmuh in manpha hen.
Ngai in, van a pan mei ahong kesuk a, sepaih sawmnga heutu nihte aheute sawmnga utoh akangmangta ua; huaiziak in ka hinna na mitmuh in manpha hen," chi in angen hi.
Huchi in TOUPA angel in Elijah kiang ah, "Kumsuk pih in, amaute lau ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in athou a, amah toh kumpipa kiang ah akumsukkhawm uhi.

Ama'n akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ekronte pathian Baal-zebub dong dia mite na sawl, Israel gam a dot ding Pathian a-om louh ziak hia? Huaiziak in na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei ding a, na si ngeingei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Elijah in agen TOUPA thu bang in asita hi. Tapa aneih louh ziak in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapa, Jehoram kum nih alal kum in, asik in Jehoram alalta hi.
Ahaziah thilhih tanchin dangte Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huan Ahab in Samaria ah tapa sawmsagih anei hi. Jehu in Samaria a, Jezreel kho heutute, upate leh Ahab tapate ana dontei mite kiang ah, laigelh in akhak hi.
"Hiai laikhakte na muh phet chiang un, na pu tapate na kiang uah a-om ua, kangtalaite, sakolte, kulhpi nei khuate leng, galvante toh na nei uhi.
Huchi in na pu tapate lak a mi, ahoihpen leh akizenpen zongkhia unla, apa laltutphah ah tusak unla, na pu uh inkote a ding in gal dou un," achi hi.
Himahleh amau alau mahmah ua, "Ngai dih ua, kumpipa nihte'n azoh louhsa uh ahi a, e'n bangchi in i zou mahmah dia?" achi uhi.

Kumpipa insung heutupen, khopi ukpen, upate, naupangte ana dawntei mi teng in Jehu kiang ah, "Na sikhate ka hi uh, hih dia na hon hilh tengteng ka hih ding uh. Kuamah kumpipa in ka bawl kei ding uh; nang hoih na sakdan in hih in," chi in mi asawl uhi.

Akiang uah, "Kei lam a pang na hih ua, ka thu na man ding uleh na pute uh tapate lu hon la unla, zingchiang in hichih hun ma in Jezreel ah ka kiang ah hong un," chi in lai akhak nawn hi. Kumpipa tapate sawmsagih ahi ua, khopi miliante, amau dontei mite kiang ah a-om uhi.
Laikhak amuh un hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa tapate aman ua, sawmsagihte athat ua, alute uh bawmpi a koih in Jezreel ah akiang ah akhakta uhi.
Thangkou khat ahong tung a, "Kumpipa tapate lu ahon tawita uh," chi in ahilh uh. Ama'n, "Kulh lutna kongpi gei ah mun nih in sekhawm unla, zingchiang tan in om hen," achi hi.
Azingchiang in hichi ahong hi a, ava pawt a, adingh a, mi tengteng kiang ah, "Noute diktat hi un, ngai un, ka pu ka guksawm a, ka hihlumta a; ahihleh hiai tengteng kua thah ahia le?
TOUPA'N Ahab inkote tungtang agen, TOUPA thu lei ah ake het kei ding chih thei un; TOUPA'N asikha Elijah zang a agen ahon tungsakta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Jehu in Jezreel a Ahab inkuan a mi omsun teng, amilian tengteng, alawm tengteng leh asiampute khat lel leng hawisak het lou in athat siang vek hi.
Huchi in athou a, apawt a, Samaria ah ahohta hi. Lampi a belampute belam mulmetna inn ava tun in,
Jehu in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah unaute amu a, "Kuate na hi ua?" achi hi. Amau, "Ahaziah unaute ka hi uh, kumpipa tapate leh kumpinu tapate chibai va buk dia paisuk ka hi uh," chi in adawng uh.
Ama'n, "Hingmat un," achi a; huchi in ahingmat ua, belam mulmetna inn khukchin ah athat ua, mi sawmli-le-nih ahi ua; khat lel leng ahawi kei uh.

Huai a pan apawt nung in Rekab tapa Jehonadab, amah dawn dia hong pai amu hi. Chibai abuk a, akiang ah, "Na tung a lungsim dik ka put bang in, lungsim dik na pu sam hia?” achi hi. Jehonadab in, “Pu e,” chi in adawng hi. "Ahihleh na khut hon pe dih," achi a; huchi in akhut apia a, ama'n akiang ah kangtalai sung ah akailut hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hong sam inla, TOUPA a dia phatuam ka ngaihdan mu himhim dih,” achi hi. Huchi in akangtalai ah atuangsak hi.
Samaria ava tun in Ahab inkote Samaria a omsunte, Elijah kiang a agen TOUPA thu bang ngei in, ahihman khit vek masiah athat zel hi.
Jehu in mite tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah, Ahab in Baal nna sem zek phet ahi a, Jehu in bel nakpi in asem ding hi.

"Tu in Baal zawlnei tengteng, abemi tengteng leh asiampu tengteng ka kiang ah hon samkhawm dih ua. Kuamah kim lou kei uhen; Baal kiang ah kithoihna thupitak lat ding ka nei a; kuapeuh akim lou ahing het kei ding," achi hi. Himahleh Jehu in Baal bemite hihlup tum in, gitlouh piltak a, ahih ahi.
Jehu in, "Baal min in khawmpi thupi bawl un,” achi hi. Huchi in agenzakta uhi.
Jehu in Israel gam tengteng ah akhakkhia a; huchi in Baal bemi tengteng ahong pai ua, atel lou himhim a-om kei uhi. Baal inn ah alut ua; Baal inn kongpi a pan aphaitam pha in adim dipdep uhi.
Kivatna puan kemmi kiang ah, "Baal bemi tengteng kivatna puan hon la in," achi hi. Huchi in kivatna puante ahon la uhi.
Rekab tapa Jehonadab toh Baal inn ah Jehu alut ua; Baal bemite kiang ah, "Hiai ah Baal bemite lou ngal, TOUPA mite a-om kha ding uh, zong unla, en vialvial dih uh," achi hi.

Kithoihnate leh halmang thillatte lan dia alut un, Jehu in inkuan ah mi sawmgiat ana dingsak khin hi. "Na khut ua ka hon piak kuapeuh asuahtakleh, asuaktami hinna tang a amah hinna lak ding ahi,” achi hi.

Haltum thillat alat khittak in hichi ahong hi a, Jehu in galvil sepaih leh aheutute uh kiang ah, "Lut unla, va that un; kuamah suaktasak kei un," achi hi. Huchi in namsau in asat ua; galvil sepaih leh aheutute uh apaikhia ua, Baal inn ah alut uhi.
Baal inn a milimte alakhia ua, ahal uhi.
Baal lim alaichim ua, Baal inn ahihsia ua, tuni tan in dailenbuk in azang lai uhi.
Huchibang in Jehu in Israel gam a pan Baal ahihsia hi.
Himahleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna, Israelte thil ahihkhialsak a, ahihte Jehu in atawpsan kei hi. Huai bel Bethel khua leh Dan a dangka-eng bawngnou limte biak ahi.

TOUPA'N Jehu kiang ah, "Ka mit tungtak a thil na hih ziak leh ka lungsim a deihthusam bangtak a Ahab inkote tung a na hih ziak in, na tapate suan lina tan in Israel laltutphah ah atu ding uh," achi hi.
Himahleh Jehu in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian dan alungtang tengteng in azui kei a; Jeroboam in Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahihkhelh atawpsan tuan kei hi.
Huai lai in TOUPA'N Israel gam letdan aneusak panta hi. Huchi in Hazael in Israel gam tengteng ah amau anuaisiahta hi.
Jordan a pan suahlam, Gilead gam tengteng, Gadte, Reubente, Manassehte, Arnon Phaizang a Aroer a pan Gilead leh Vasan gam tan in.
Jehu tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, athilhihtheihdan tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Jehu api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoahaz ahong lalta hi.
Samaria gam a Israelte tung a Jehu vaihawm sung kum sawmnih-le-giat ahi.
Huan Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa asi chih atheih in, athou a, kumpipa tapa tengteng athat vek hi.

Ahaziah tapa Joash bel kumpipa Jehoram tanu, Ahaziah sanggamnu Jehosheba in kumpipa tapa athahte uh lak a pan pimang in, adontu toh lupna dantan ah a-omsak a; Athaliah muh theih louh ding in asel ua, huchi in thah ahita kei hi.
Amah bel amah toh TOUPA' inn ah kum guk akibu ua, huchi in Athaliah in huai gam ah vai ahawmta hi.

Akum sagihna ah Jehoiada in Keroth mite leh galvil sepaihte lak a mi sepaih za heutute asamsak a, TOUPA' inn ah akiang ah apilutsak hi. Akiang uah thu akhung a, TOUPA' inn ah akichiamsak a, kumpipa tapa amusak hi.
Ama'n, “Na hih ding uh hichibang ahi. Na lak ua Sabbath ni a hong dingte seh thum suah seh khat in kumpipa' inn na veng ding uh.
Seh thum suah seh khat bel Sur kulh kongpi ah na om ding uh. Huchibang in na veng ding ua, asiat ding na dal ding uhi.
Na lak ua pawl nih, Sabbath ni a pai dingte'n kumpipa kiang ah TOUPA' inn na veng ding uhi.
Michih in galvan tawi in kumpipa na umsuak ding ua; kuapeuh huai huamsung a hong lut na thah zel ding uh ahi. Huchi in kumpipa alut leh apawt zui vialvial un," chi in thu apia hi.
Sepaih za heutute'n siampu Jehoiada thupiak bangbang in ahih ua; amau heutu chiat Sabbath ni a hong dingte leh Sabbath ni a pai dingte api ua, siampu Jehoiada kiang ah ahoh uhi.
Siampu in sepaih za heutute TOUPA' inn a om, kumpipa David teipite leh lumte apia hi.
Galvil sepaihte'n galvan tawi chiat in, Tempul sik taklam a kipan veilam tan in maitam leh inn zul ah kumpipa a ding in umkhum uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa tapa ahon pikhia a, lallukhu akhusak hi. Theihsakna thu apia a; kumpipa in abawl ua, sathau anilh ua; akhut uh abeng ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen,” achi uhi.
Galvilmi leh mipite husa Athaliah in ana zak in, TOUPA' inn ah mipite lak ah ava hoh hi.

A-en a, ngai in, kumpipa dan dungzui in khuam zul ah ana dingh a, sepaih heutute leh pengkul mut mite bel kumpipa kiangnai ah adingh uhi. Huai gam mite'n nuam asa mahmah ua, pengkul amut uh. Huchi in Athaliah in apuante abotkek a, "Guksawmna! Guksawmna ahita ve!" chi in akikou hi.

Siampu Jehoiada in sepaihte tung a heutute dia aseh sepaih za heutute thu apia a, akiang uah, "Sepaihte kikal ah pawtsak in. Kuapeuh amah zui namsau a satlup ding ahi," achi hi. Siampu in, "TOUPA' inn a thah ding ahi kei," ana chita ngal a.
Huchi in aman ua; kumpipa' inn a sakolte lutna lampi a pai in, huai ah athatta uh.
Jehoiada in TOUPA leh kumpipa leh mipite kikal leh kumpipa leh mipite kikal ah TOUPA mite ahihna ding un thukhun abawl hi.
Huai gammi tengteng Baal inn ah ahoh ua, ahihchim ua; amaitamte leh alimte ahihnen dimdem ua, Baal siampu Mattan leng maitam bul ah athat uh. Huchi in siampu in TOUPA' inn vengmi heutute asepta hi.

Ama'n sepaih za heutute, veng mite, galvil sepaihte leh huai gam a mi tengteng api a, TOUPA' inn a pan kumpipa apikhia ua, galvil mite kongpi tawn in kumpipa' inn a lut in, kumpipa laltutphah ah atuta hi.
Huchi in huai gam a mi tengteng akipak ua, khopi buai lou in a-omta hi; Athaliah namsau in kumpipa' inn ah athat uhi.
Joash in vai ahawm pat lai in kum sagih a upa ahi.
Jehu kum sagih alal kum in Joash alal pan hi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmli alal a; anu min Zibiah ahi a, Beer-sheba khomi ahi.
Siampu Jehoiada in Joash asinsak sung teng TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Himahleh mun sang teng hihsiat vek ahi tuan kei a; mun sangte ah mite kithoih lailai in gimlim ahal nilouh lai uhi.
Joash in siampute kiang ah, "TOUPA inn a laklut thilzek tatna sum teng simsate lak a pai peuhmahte ahinna uh tatna sumte, kuapeuh in TOUPA inn a laklut aphal uh sum tengtengte,
siampute'n ameltheihte ua pan la uhenla; inn sia, asiatna na bawl uhen," achi hi.
Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Joash bel kum sawmnih-le-thum alal nung in leng siampute'n inn sia abawl kei lailai uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa Joash in siampu Jehoiada leh siampu dangte asam a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a inn siatna bawl lou na hi ua? Tu'n zaw na sumkemte a pan dangka la nawn kei unla, inn sia bawlna ding in pekhe zawta un," achi hi.
Siampute'n mite a pan dangka lak nawn louh leh inn siatna puahphat louh pha asa uhi.

Himahleh siampu Jehoiada in bawm ala a, asin gei avutvang a, TOUPA inn lutna taklam pang, maitam kiang ah atung hi. Huai bawm ah TOUPA inn a dangka tawilut tengteng kongkhak vengmi siampute'n ana koih zel uh.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, bawm ah dangka atamta chih atheih un, TOUPA' inn ah kumpipa laigelhmi leh siampu lianpen ava hoh ua, sumte asim ua ipte ah athun khe zel uhi.
Adangka sim uh nasem mite, TOUPA inn lam mite tung a heutute khut ah apekhia ua; amau TOUPA' inn lam mite leh khutsiam mite;
suangsek mite leh suang laikhe mite kiang ah, TOUPA inn siatna bawlna ding sing leh suangte leh inn bawlna, akhawkna peuh a zat ding in apekhia uhi.

Himahleh TOUPA insung a dangka ahon tawi un, TOUPA' inn a ding dangkasik noute, khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, pengkulte, dangka-eng tui-um belsuante, dangkasik tui-um belsuante abawl kei uhi.
Nasem mite ape zel ua, TOUPA' inn bawlna in azang uhi.
Nasem mite piak dia dangka akepsak mite uh leng a-etzui pih tuan kei uh. Amau ginomtak in ahih zel uhi.
Mohna thoihna dia thillat dangka leh khelhna thoihna dia thillat dangkate bel TOUPA' inn ah alalut kei ua; siampute tantuam ahi.
Huchi in Siria kumpipa Hazael in Gath khua ava sual a, ala a; Hazael in Jerusalem a hoh atum hi.

Judah kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpipa apu Jehoshaphat, Jehoram leh Ahaziah in ana latsa thilzek tengteng leh amah thilzekte leh TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng om tengteng ala vek a, Siria kumpipa Hazael akhak a; huchi in Jerusalem apawtsanta hi.
Huchi in Joash tanchin dangte, athilhihte tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Asikhate athou ua, aguk in asim sawm ua, Joash bel Silla zot sukna lampi Millo inn ah asual ua; athatta uhi.
Amah Simeath tapa Jozakar leh Shomer tapa Jehozabadte'n athat ua; huchi in api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Amaziah ahong lalta hi.
Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah tapa Joash kum sawmnih-le-thum alal kum in Jehu tapa Jehoahaz Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-sagih alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahih Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate ama'n leng ahih samta a, apaisan nawn kei.
Israelte tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, huchi in Siria kumpipa Hazael khut leh Hazael tapa Ben-hadad khut ah adamsung teng ape vekta hi.
Jehoahaz in TOUPA kiang ah nget chihtak in angen a, TOUPA'N athu angaihkhiaksak a; Israel simmoh a om a, Siria kumpipa'n amau asimmohdan lah amu kilkel ngal a.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Israelte hondampa apia a, huchi in Siriate nuai a pan apawtkhia uh. Israel suante tuma lam bang in amau inn ah a-om kinken uhi.
Himahleh Israelte thil ana hihkhialsak a Jeroboam inkote khelhnate apaisan kei ua, ahih lailai zosop ua; Samaria ah Asherah song leng a-om lailai hi.
Jehoahaz in amite lak a sakol tungtuangmi sawmnga, kangtalai sawm leh sepaih singkhat chih louh aneih aphalsak ngal kei a; Siria kumpipa'n ahihmang vek a, leivui chilzan bang in abawl hi.
Huchi in Jehoahaz tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Hichi in Jehoahaz bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoash alalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Joash kum sawmthum-le-sagih alal kum in Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-guk alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou pipi ana hih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahih Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna tengteng apaisan kei a, aching lailai zosop hi.
Huchi in Jehoash tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh akisual lai ua athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Jehoash api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; Jeroboam alaltutphah ah atu a, Jehoas bel Samaria ah Israel kumpipate lak ah avui uhi.
Elisha achi ana a, sihpih ding khop chinatna ahi. Huchi in akiang ah Israel kumpipa Jehoash ahohsuk a, akah a, "Aw, ka pa, ka pa, Israelte kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite," achi hi.
Elisha in akiang ah, "Thalpeu leh thaltangte hon la in," achi a; ama'n thalpeu leh thaltangte ahon la hi.
Israelte kumpipa kiang ah, "Thalpeuh tung ah na khut nga in," achi hi. Huchi in akhut anga a; Elisha in kumpipa khut tung ah akhut anga hi.

Ama'n, "Suahlam tohlet hong in," achi hi. Huchi in ahong hi. Elisha in, "Kap in," achi a, akap hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hotkhiakna thaltang leh Siria a pan hotkhiakna thaltang; Aphek ah na zoh tanpha in Siriate na sual ding hi,” achi hi.
"Thaltangte hon la in," achi a, Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Huai in leitual sun dih," achi a; huchi in thumvei asun a, atawpta hi.
Huchi in Pathian mipa atung ah aheh a, "Ngavei ahihkeileh gukvei na sut ding ei ve; huchi in Siriate mangthang vek khop in na zou ding. Himahleh Siriate thumvei kia zou ding na hita ve," achi hi.
Huchi in Elisha asi a, avui uh. Kum hong kivei in, Moab pawlte'n agam uh ahong dou uhi.
Mi khat avui laitak un hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, mi pawl khat amu uhi. Huchi in huai mi Elisha han sung ah akhe mawk ua; aluang in Elisha guhte asukkhaktak in, ahong hing nawn a, adingtouta hi.
Siria kumpipa Hazael in Jehoahaz damsung teng in Israelte anuaisiah hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a thu akhun ziak in amau ahehpih a, alainat a, azahtak a, amau ahihmang nuam kei a, akiang a pan apaikhe kei hi.
Siria kumpipa Hazael asi a; asik in atapa Ben-hadad alal hi.
Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash in Hazael tapa Ben-hadad in apa Jehoahaz adou a, khua alaksakte asut nawn a, Joash in thumvei azou a, Israel gam khuate alakik nawn hi.
Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash kum nih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah alal pan hi.
Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua alal a; anu min Jehoadan, Jerusalem mi ahi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil dik ahih a, himahleh apu David zaw apha kei; apa Joash thilhih bang ahih sam hi.
Mun sangte lakmang ahi tuan kei a, mun sangte ah mite akithoih lai ua gimlim ahal lai uhi.
Akhut a lalgam ahong kiptak in hichi ahong hi a, apa, kumpipa thatmi ama sikhate athat hi.

Himahleh huai tualthat mite tate athat kei hi. Mosi Dan Bu a, "Tate ziak in pate hihlup ding ahi kei a, pate ziak in leng tate hihlup ding ahi sam kei, michih amau khelhna ziak in asi ding uh," chi a TOUPA thupiak gelh ahih bang in.
Edomte chi phaizang ah singkhat athat a, Selah khua asual a, ala a, amin ding in Joktheel asa a, tuni tan in hiai ahi lai hi.
Huchi in Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jehu tapa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash kiang ah, hong kuan in, kimaituah ni, chi in mi asawl hi.

Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah kiang ah, "Lebanon tang a ling in Lebanon tang a sidar sing kiang ah, na tanu ka tapa zi ding in neisak dih ve, chi in athukhak a; Lebanon tang a gamsa ahong pai a, huai ling ahong tuanpuk hi.

Nang Edomte na zou ngei a, na lungtang ahong kisathei hi; na kisaktheihna ompih maimai in; nang leh Judah nangawn tan a siatna, nang a dia hoih lou ding thil bang ding a khoihkhe ding na hia?" chi in adawng hi.
Himahleh Amaziah in ana ngaikhe nuam kei a; huchi in Israel kumpipa Jehoash va hohtou in ava douta hi. Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah ava kimaituahta uhi.
Judah bel Israelte ma ah azahlakta a; michih amau inn chiat ah ataikekta uh.

Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah tapa Joash tapa Amaziah Beth-shemesh ah aman a, Jerusalem ah apaipih a, Jerusalem kulh, Ephraim kongpi a pan kulh ning kongpi pha in tong zali ahihchim hi.
TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng leh dangka leh tui-um belsuan om tengteng ala a, thuchiam tangtunna dia mat a om mite toh, huchi in Samaria kholam ah apai nawnta hi.
Huchi in Jehoash thilhih tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdante, Judah kumpipa Amaziah adou thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Jehoash api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, Samaria ah Israel kumpipate lak ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jeroboam alalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash sih nung in kum sawm-le- nga adam lai hi.
Huchi in Amaziah tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Jerusalem ah amah aguksawm ua; huchi in Lakish ah mi adelhsak ua, huai ah athatta uhi.
Aluang sakol in apaipih ua, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi Jerusalem ah avui uhi.
Judah mi tengteng in kum sawm leh kum guk a upa, Azariah api ua, apa Amaziah sik in kumpipa in abawl uhi.
Ama'n Elath khua abawlhoih nawn in Judah gam ah apangsak nawn a; huai nung in kumpipa api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta hi.
Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah kum sawm-le-nga alal kum in Israel kumpipa Jehoash tapa Jeroboam Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawmli-le-khat alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil ahihkhialsak a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna tengteng apaisan kei hi.
TOUPA, Israelte Pathian in asikha, Gath hepher mi Amittai tapa zawlnei Jonah zang a athugen bang in, Hamath lutna a pan Arabah Tuipi pha in Israel gam ah apangsak nawn hi.
TOUPA'N Israelte haksatna a thupi mahmah chih lah athei ngal a; sal hi in noplen hitaleh athuakdan uh akibang a; Israelte panpih ding kuamah om sam kei hi.
TOUPA'N Israel min van nuai ah achimitsak zenzen ding chih ahihleh agen kei him a; Jehoash tapa Jeroboam zang in ahondam zawta hi.

Huchi in Jeroboam tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, athilhihtheihdante, agaldou thute, tuma lam in Judah gam tan hi gige Damaskas leh Hamath khua Israelte a dia ana laksak nawn thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Jeroboam api leh pu, Israel kumpipate kiang ah a-ihmu samta a; huchi in atapa Zakariah asik in alalta hi.
Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawmnih-le-sagih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Amaziah alal pan hi.
Alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-guk a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nih alal a; anu min Jekoliah, Jerusalem mi ahi.
Apa Amaziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Himahleh mun sangte lakmang ahi tuan kei. Mun sangte ah mite kithoih lailai in, gimlim ahal lai uhi.
TOUPA'N kumpipa agawt a, huchi in asih ni pha in aphak a, inn tuam ah atengta hi. Kumpipa tapa Jotham in agam ua mite vai hawmsak in inkuan tung a heutu in a-om hi.
Huchi in Azariah tanchin dangte athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Azariah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; huchi in asik in atapa Jotham alalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmthum-le-giat alal kum in Jeroboam tapa Zakariah Israelte tung ah Samaria ah kha guk alal hi.
Apute hih mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil ahihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei hi.
Jabesh tapa Shallum in aguk in thah asawm a, mipite ma ah asual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
Huchi in Zakariah tanchin dangte bel ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
Huai bel ToUPA'N Jehu kiang a, "Na tapate suan lina tan in Israelte laltutphah ah atu ding uh," chih thu agen hi. Huchi in huai bang geih ahong hita hi.
Judah kumpipa Uzziah kum sawmthum-le-kua alal kum in Jabesh tapa Shallum alal pan a; Samaria ah kha khat sung alal hi.
Tirzah a pan Gadi tapa Menahem ahohtou a, Samaria ah ahoh a, Samaria ah Jabesh tapa Shallum asual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
Huchi in Shallum tanchin dangte, aguksawmna thute ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
Huchi in Menahem in Tirzah a pan Tiphsah leh asung a om tengteng leh agamte asual a; amah a dia akihon louh ziak un asual a; huai ah naupai lai numei tengteng apikkek hi.
Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmthum-le-kua alal kum in Gadi tapa Menahem Israelte tung ah alal pan a, Samaria ah kum sawm alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna in adamsung apaisan kei hi.
Assuria kumpipa Pul in agam ahong sual a; gam aneihkippih theihna ding in Menahem in Pul dangka talent sangkhat apia hi.
Menahem in Assuria kumpipa piak ding in Israel mi nei zou tengteng lak ah dangka shekel sawmnga chiat akhon a; huchi in Assuria kumpipa apai nawn a, huai gam ah ataam nilouh kei hi.
Menahem tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Menahem api-le-pute kiang ah ihmuta a; asik in atapa Pekahiah alal hi.
Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmnga alal kum in Israelte tung ah Samaria ah Menahem tapa Pekahiah alal pan a, kum nih alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei hi.
Asepaih heutu Remaliah tapa Pekah in amah aguksawm a, Samaria a kumpipa' inn a kulh ah Argob toh, Arieh toh athatta a; akiang ah Gilead mi sawmnga toh; huchi in Pekahiah athat a, asik in alalta hi.
Huchi in Pekahiah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmnga-le-nih alal kum in Remaliah tapa Pekah Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawmnih alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei.

Israel kumpipa Pekah lal lai in Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser in Ijon, Abel-beth-maakah, Janoah, Kadesh, Hazor, Gilead leh Galili gamte leh Naphtali gam tengteng ala a, Assuria gam ah sal in api hi.
Elah tapa Hoshea in Remaliah tapa Pekah aguksawm a, asual a, athat a, Uzziah tapa Jotham kum sawmnih alal kum in asik in alalta hi.
Huchi in Pekah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah kum nih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Uzziah tapa Jotham alal pan hi.
Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk alal a; anu min Jerusha, Zadok tanu ahi.
Apa Uzziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Himahleh mun sangte hihmang ahi tuan kei; mun sangte ah mite'n kithoih in, gimlim ahal lai uhi. TOUPA' inn kongpi saknungzaw abawlhoih hi.
Huchi in Jotham tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huai lai in Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Remulia tapa Pekah Judate sual ding in TOUPA'N asawl pan hi.
Jotham api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-pute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahaz alalta hi.
Remaliah tapa Pekah kum sawm-le-sagih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Jotham tapa Ahaz alal pan hi.
Ahaz alal pat tung in kum sawmnih a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk alal hi. Apu David bang in TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih ahih sam kei hi.
Israel kumpipate tot lampi atawn sam a, ahi, TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a adelhkhiaksa namte thilkihhuaitak ahih bang un atapa mei ah alutsuaksak hi.
Mun sangte leh mualte tung ah leh sing hing chih nuai ah kithoih in gimlim ahal hi.
Huchi in Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah, Jerusalem dou ding in akuantou ua; Ahaz ava um ua, himahleh azou thei kei uhi.
Huai lai in Siria kumpipa Rezin in Elath khua Siria gam ding in ala nawn a, Elath a pan Judate adelhkhia a; huchi in Siriate'n Elath khua ava luah ua, tuni tan in ateng lai uh.

Huchi in Ahaz in Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser kiang ah, "Na sikha leh na tapa ka hi kei a hia; kei hong dou dia hong kuan, Siria kumpipa khut a pan leh Israel kumpipa khut a pan hon hunkhe dih ve," chi in mi asawl hi.
Ahaziah in TOUPA' inn a dangka leh dangka-eng om peuhmah leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmte ala a, Assuria kumpipa kiang ah thilpiak ding in akhak hi.
Assuria kumpipa'n athugen ana pom a; huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n Damaskas khua ava dou a, ala a, Kir gam ah sal in huai a mite api a, Rezin athat hi.

Kumpipa Ahaz bel Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser houpih ding in Damaskas ah ahoh a, Damaskas ah maitam ava mu a, huchi in kumpipa Ahaz in huai maitam lim leh akibawldan bang geih etton ding in siampu Urijah kiang ah akhak hi.
Siampu Urijah in maitam abawl a; kumpipa Ahaziah in Damaskas a pan akhak bang geih in siampu Urijah in Damaskas a pan a Ahaz ahong pai nawn in ana bawl khin vekta hi.
Damaskas a pan kumpipa ahong tun in maitam amu a; kumpipa'n maitam anaih a, atung ah thillatte alan hi.
Maitam ah ahalmang thillat hal in tangbuang thillat alan a, dawn thillat asung a, alemna thillatte sisan atheh hi.
TOUPA ma a dal maitam ala a, maitam leh TOUPA' inn kikal a, inn mazawn a pan alasuan a, amaitam mallam pang ah akoih hi.

Kumpipa Ahaz in, maitam lianpi tung ah zinglam halmang thillat, nitaklam tangbuang thillat, halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, i gam ua mipi tengteng halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat toh hal in lan inla; atung ah halmang thillat sisan tengteng leh kithoihna sisan tengteng theh in; dal maitam bel kei thudotna ding ahi, chi in siampu Urijah thu apia hi.
Huchi in siampu Urijah in kumpipa Ahaz thupiak bangbang in ahihta hi.
Kumpipa Ahaz in tunna kuakte a-atkhia a, kisilna bel akoihkhia a; atunna dal bawngtal a pan lakhia in suanglep tung ah atung hi.
Sabbath ni a dia atung nei lampi abawl uleh inn polam a kumpipa lutna TOUPA' inn a pan Siria kumpipa a ding in akheng hi.
Huchi in Ahaz thilhih tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Ahaz api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Hezekiah alalta hi.
Judah Kumpipa Ahaz akum sawm-le-nihna alal kum in Elah tapa Hoshea Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum kua alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih a, himahleh ama a Israel kumpipate bang zen in zaw ahih kei.
Assuria kumpipa Salmaneser in ava dou a, huchi in Hoshea asikha ahong hi a, siah apia hi.

Assuria kumpipa'n, Aigupta kumpipa So kiang a mi sawl in Hoshea thuguk sawm ana theikhia a; a kumchin a, apiak zel bang in leng Assuria kumpipa kiang ah siah ape kei behlap lai a; huaiziak in Assuria kumpipa'n suangkul ah hensa in akhumta hi.
Huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n gam tengteng atuansuak vek a, Samaria ah ahohtou a, kum thum a-umkhum hi.
Hoshea kum kua alal kum in Assuria kumpipa'n Samaria ala a, Assuria gam ah Israelte api a, Halah, Habor a Gozan lui leh Mediate khuate ah akoih hi.
Huchibang a, ana omna uh bel Israel suante'n Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh khut nuai a pan, Aigupta gam a pan a pikhepa TOUPA a Pathian uh tung a thil ahihkhelh ua, pathian dangte alau ziak uh ahi.
TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a, ana delhkhiaksa namte thuzoh leh Israel kumpipate dan thusehte azuih zawk ziak uh leng ahi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA a Pathian uh tung ah thil hoih loutak aguk in ahih uhi. Akho teng uah galvil mite insang a pan kulh nei khopite pha in mun sangte abawl uhi.
Mual sang teng ah pathian limte leh sing hing teng nuai ah suangphuhte phut in Asherah songte abawl uhi.
Huai mun sang tengteng ah TOUPA'N ama ua adelhmangsa namte hih bang in gimlim ahal ua; TOUPA hehsak ding in thil gilou ahih lai uhi.
TOUPA'N akiang uah, "Hichibang hih kei un," achih milimte nna leng asem uhi.

TOUPA'N, dan zuih ding na pi-le-pute uh ka piakleh ka sikha zawlneite zang a ka hon theihsak bang zel in, "Na omdan gilou uh lehngatsan unla, ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte zui un," chi in Israelte leh Judah zawlnei chih leh mu thei michih zang in atheisak hi.
Huchi pipi in leng azui nuam kei ua, api-le-pute un TOUPA a Pathian uh gingta nuam lou a, angawng uh akhauhsak mah bang un, angawng uh akhauhsak uhi.

Adan thusehte, api-le-pute uh toh athukhun, akiang ua athu theihsakte anial ua; thil gina lou azui ua, bangmah lou phet ahong hita uh. Atungthu ua TOUPA'N, amau bang in zaw hih kei un, ana chihsa, akiang ua namte azui uhi.
TOUPA a Pathian uh thupiak tengteng alehngatsan ua, bawngnou lim sun nih abawl ua, Asherah song abawl ua, van a om tengteng abia ua, Baal nna asem uhi.
Atapate uh leh atanute uh mei tawn in alutsak ua, aisan leh bum aching ua, TOUPA hehna tokthou ding in amitmuh in thil hoih lou hih ding in akizuak uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA Israelte tung ah heh petmah in aheh a, amuh phaklouhna ding ah asuanmang a; Judah nam kia lou ngal a-omta kei uhi.
Judahte'n leng TOUPA a Pathian uh thupiakte azui kei ua, Israelte bawltawm dan thusehte azui zawta uhi.
Israel suante himhim adeihta kei a, amau ahihgim a, amuh phak louh ua asuanmang masiah lok mite khut ah apia hi.

Israelte lah David inkote ahihna uh apaihsakta ngal a; huchi in Nebat tapa Jeroboam pen kumpipa ding in abawl ua; Jeroboam in Israelte'n TOUPA azuih uh ahawlkawi a, thil gilou thupi mahmah ahihsak hi.
Israel suante'n Jeroboam thilhihkhelh bangbang ahih sam ua;

TOUPA'N azawlnei tengteng zang a ana gensa bang a amuh phaklouhna a, asuanmang masiah huaite apaisan ngal kei ua. Huchi in Israelte amau gam a pan Assuria gam ah api ua, tuni tan in huai gam ah a-om lai uhi.

Assuria kumpipa'n Babulon khomite, Kuth khomite, Ava khomite, Hamath khomite leh Sepharvaim khomite athukhak a, Samaria khote ah Israel suante mun aluahsak a; huchi in Samaria gam aluah ua, akhuate ah ateng uhi.
Huai lai a a-om tung un hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA laudan asiam kei ua, huchi in TOUPA'N alak uah humpinelkaite asawl a, khenkhatte akeilum uhi.

Huchi in Assuria kumpipa kiang ah, “Na lakkhiak a, Samaria gam khuate a na koih namte'n hiai gam Pathian omdan athei kei ua, huaiziak in, alak uah humpinelkaite asawl a; ngai dih, hiai gam Pathian omdan atheih louh ziak un athat uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n, "Huai a sal a na pite uh lak a siampu khat pi unla, hong om sam henla, ama'n huai gam Pathian biakdan sinsak hen," chi in thu apia hi.
Huchi in Samaria gam a pan apite uh lak a siampu khat Bethel ah ava teng a, TOUPA laudan ding asinsak hi.
Himahleh nam chih in amau pathian chiat akibawl ua, Samari mite'n mun sang ana bawl innte ah nam chih in amau omna khua chiat ah huai apathiante chiat uh akoih uhi.
Babulon mite'n Sukkoth-benoth abawl ua, Kuthte'n Nergal abawl ua, Hamathte'n Ashima abawl ua;
Ava mite'n Nibhaz leh Tartak abawl uhi. Sepharvaim mite'n pathiante Adrammelek leh Anammelek kiang ah atate ahal uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA laudan asiam ua, alak ua mineupente mun sang siampute in abawl ua, mun sang innte ah amau a ding in thil alan uhi.
TOUPA alau ua, apikhiakna gam ua namte hihdan bang in amau pathiante nna asem uh.
Tuma lam a, ahihdan bang un tuni tan in ahih lailai uhi. TOUPA laudan asiam kei ua, TOUPA'N Jakob suan Israel achihte kiang ah,
"pathian dangte zaw lau kei unla, amau be kei unla, akiang ah kithoih sam kei un.
TOUPA, thilhihtheihna thupitak leh ban zak hial a Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa amah laudan na siam zawk ding uh ahi, amah na biak ding uh ahi a, ama kiang a na kithoih ding uh ahi.
Huchi in dan thusehte, vaihawmte, dante, thupiakte ahon na gelhsaksate tangtawn in na pom gige ding uh ahi; pathian dangte laudan na siam ding uh ahi kei.
Na kiang ua thu ka khun pen na mangngilh ding uh ahi kei; pathian dangte leng laudan na siam ding uh ahi sam kei hi.

TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding uh ahi. Huchi in na melma tengteng khut a pan ama'n ahon hunkhe dia, chi a thu akhun a, amau a dia TOUPA thupiakte, dan thusehte, vaihawmte, dan bawlte, azui tuan kei uhi," achi hi.
Bangchi mah in leng azui nuam tuan kei ua, tuma lam a ahihdan bang un ahih lailai uhi.
Huchi in huai namte'n TOUPA alau ua; amilim bawltawmte uh nna leng asem lai uh. Huchi mah bang in asuante uh leh asuante uh suante tan in leng tuni tan in api-le-pute uh hih bang in ahih lailai uhi.
Huan Elah tapa Israel kumpipa Hoshea, kum thum alal kum in hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Ahaz tapa Hezekiah alal pan hi.
Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua alal a; anu min Abi, Zakariah tanu ahi.
Apu David thilhih tengteng hih sam in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Mun sangte ahihgawp a, suangphuhte ahihchim a, Asherahte aphuk a; Mosi dal gul bawl akitam nensak vek a; huai hun tanpha a Israel suante'n akiang a gimlim ahal ziak un, ama'n huai Nehushtan asa hi.
Ama'n TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian amuang a; huchi in anung a Judah kumpipa tengteng lak ah amah bang kuamah a-om kei ua, amalam in leng a-om sam kei uh.
TOUPA alen tinten a, ama zuih atawp nuam kei a, athupiak, TOUPA'N Mosi apiakte azui hi.
Huchi in TOUPA akiang ah a-om a; avakkhiakna peuh ah alamzang a; Assuria kumpipa tung ah ahel a, a-nna asemta kei hi.
Philistiate Gaza khua tan in agamgi chiang tengteng toh, galvilmi insang a pan kulh nei khopi tan in azou vek hi.
Kumpipa Hezekiah kum li alal kum, Israel kumpipa Elah tapa Hoshea kum sagih alal kum in hichi ahong hi a, Assuria kumpipa Salmaneser in Samaria ahong dou a, a-umkimvel a,
huchi in kum thum achin kum in alazou hi. Hezekiah kum guk alal kum, Israel kumpipa Hoshea kum kua alal kum in ahi Samaria khua alak zoh.
Assuria kumpipa'n Assuria gam ah Israel apimang a, Halah, Habor, Gozan lui leh Mediate khuate ah akoihta hi;
TOUPA a Pathian uh thu mang lou a, athukhun bohsia a, TOUPA'N asikha Mosi thu apiak tengteng azuih louh ziak un.
Kumpipa Hezekiah kum sawm-le-li alal kum in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib Judah gam a khokulh nei tengteng dou ding in ahohtou a, alata hi.

Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in Lakish a Assuria kumpipa kiang ah, "Thil ka na hihkhial hi, kei a pan kik nawn in, ka tung a na hon got peuhmah ka po ding," chi a gen ding in mi asawl hi. Assuria kumpipa'n Judah kumpipa Hezekiah dangka talent zathum leh dangka-eng talent sawmthum abikhiahsak hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah in TOUPA' inn a dangka om teng leh kongkhak a dangka-eng tengteng leh kumpipa gou koihkhawmna a om tengteng apia hi.
Huai tung mah in Hezekiah in TOUPA tempul kongkhak a dangka-eng aluante leh Judah kumpipa Hezekiah inn khuampite a kiluante alakhe vek a, Assuria kumpipa apia hi.

Assuria kumpipa'n Tartan, Rab-saris leh Rabshakeh sepaih tampi toh Lakish a pan Jerusalem a kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah asawl hi. Jerusalem khua atungtou ua; atuntouh un Puansawpmi Lamlian lampi a dil saknungzaw tuilakna kiang ah adingh uhi.
Kumpipa asap uleh, insung heutu Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joah, akiang uah ahong pawtkhia uhi.
Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Hezekiah kiang ah va gen dih ua, Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa in hichi in achi: Na gin a na muan bang ahia oi?
Kidouna a ding in geldan siam leh hatna ka nei uh, na chi a; himahleh huai zaw paukam lel ahi. Kua ahia na muan a ka tung a na hel maizen?
Tu in, ngai in, hiai sialluang chiangkhun, Aigupta muang na hita a; huai a mi akingaihleh akhut asun ding hi. Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh bel amah muang tengteng tung ah huchibang ahi naknak hi.

Ahihkeileh, ka kiang ah, TOUPA ka Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh, na chih uleh, amah pen Hezekiah in Judah leh Jerusalem kiang a Jerusalem a hiai maitam ma ah na biak ding uh ahi, chi a mun sangte leh amaitamte alakmangsakpa ahi kei a hia? chi in.
Huchi in ka pu Assuria kumpipa toh thu kichiam dih ua, huchi in atung a tuangmi ding na muh theih peuhmah ding leh sakol sangnih ka hon pe ding.
Bangchi in ahia kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu in Aigupta tung a na muanna koih in, ka pu mite lak a neupen heutu khat lel leng na nankik zoh mahmah ding?
Hiai gam TOUPA lou a hihse ding a hong kuantou ka hi a hia? TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, hiai gam dou inla, hihsia in, chi ahi,” chi in achi hi.

Hilkiah tapa Eliakim leh Sebnah leh Joahte'n Rabshakeh kiang ah, "Hehpih in na sikhate Siria pau in hon houpih in; huai lah ka theisiam ngal ua; kulh tung a mite zak in Judah pau in hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi uh.

Himahleh Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Ka pu in na pu uh kiang leh nou kiang kia ah hiai thu gen ding in ahon sawl a hia? Kulh tung a tute, noute leh a-ek uh ne dingte kiang ah leng hon sawl ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Rabshakeh adingh a, Judah pau in aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa thu ngaikhia un.
Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, 'Hezekiah khem in om kei un; ama'n akhut a pan noute hon humbit thei lou ding ahi.
Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N ahon humbit dia; hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in TOUPA ah hon muangsak kei hen.'

Hezekiah thu pom kei un. Assuria kumpipa'n hichi in achi: Hon kileppih unla, ka kiang ah hong pawtkhia un; michih in ama grepgui leh ama theipi kung ngei ate ne chiat uhenla, michih in amah tuikhuk tui dawn chiat hen.

Noumau gam bang a buh leh uain gam, tanghou leh grephuan gam, olive leh khuaizu gam, si lou a na hintheihna ding uh gam a ka hon pi masiah, Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N hon humbit ding, chi a nou ahon khem in leng pom kei un.
Namte' pathian mawngmawng lak a himhim in agam uh Assuria kumpipa a pan ahumbit ngeita uh hia?
Hamath leh Arpad pathiante koi a omta uh ahia? Sepharvaim, Hena leh Ivah pathiante leng koi a omta ahi ua? Samaria ka khut a pan ahumbit uhia?
Gam chih pathian tengteng lak a kuate ahi ua ka khut a pan agam uh humbit a, TOUPA'N Jerusalem khua kei a pan humbit mahmah ding? chi in,” achi hi.
Amau adai sipsip ua, kam khat in leng adawng kei uh, kumpipa dan thupiak, "Amah dawng ke'n," chih ahi ngal a.
Huchi in kumpipa insung heutu Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joahte'n apuansilh bohkekte uh silh in Hezekiah kiang ah ahoh ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilh uhi.
Huan kumpipa Hezekiah in huai azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh a, TOUPA' inn ah alutta hi.
Inn sung heutu Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh siampu upate sai-ip puan silh in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kiang ah asawl hi.
Amau akiang ah, Hezekiah in hichi in achi, "Tuni mangbatna leh salhna leh minsiatna ni ahi. Naute lah apian uh ahunta ngal a, piangsak ding in lah thahatna a-om nawnta ngal kei.

Apu Assuria kumpipa'n Pathian hing gense ding a asawl Rabshakeh thugen tengteng, TOUPA na Pathian in aza dia, athugen, TOUPA na Pathian in athu azak in ana sal kha mai ding, huaiziak in, a-om lai khosuaksunte thumsak in," achi va chi un.
Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah sikhate Isai kiang ah ahoh uh.
Isai in akiang uah, "Na pu kiang ah huchi in gen in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Assuria kumpipa sikhate'n kei ahon gensiatnate uh, na zak thute ziak in lau mawk ke'n.
Ngai in, asung ah kha ka omsak ding a, thuthang aza ding a, ama gam ah apai nawn ding. Huchi in ama gam mahmah ah namsau puksak in ka omsak ding, achi hi,' chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in Rabshakeh akik nawn a, Assuria kumpipa'n Libna khua ana sual lai amu a; Lakish a pan apawt chih azaksa him ahi.
"Ngai in, nang hon dou ding in apawtta," chi a Tirhak Ethiopia gam kumpipa tungtangmi gen ana zak in Hezekiah kiang ah mite asawl hi.
Hichi in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah na gen ding uh, "Na Pathian na muan in Jerusalem khua Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in hon khem kei hen.
Ngai in, Assuria Kumpipate'n gam tengteng ahihse vek ua, atung a athilhih uh na za a; nang humbit na hi tuan dia hia?
Namte pathiante'n ka pi-le-pute'n ahihmangte uh ahumbit ua hia? Gozan, Haran, Reseph, Eden ta Thelasar a omte.
Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sepharvaim khopi kumpipa, Hena kumpipa, Ivah kumpipate koi a om ahita ua? chi in,” achi hi.
Hezekiah in amisawlte khut a pan lai amu a, asim a: Hezekiah TOUPA' inn ah alut a, TOUPA ma ah huai aphalh hi.
Hezekiah TOUPA ma ah athum a, "TOUPA aw, cherubte tung a tu, Israel Pathian, nang, nang kia leitung gam tengteng Pathian na hi a; lei leh van nangmah siamsa ahi uh.
TOUPA aw, na bil na doh inla, ngai dih ve; TOUPA aw, na mit hak inla, en dih ve; Pathian hing gense dia Sennakerib in thu ahong gen ngaikhe dih ve.
TOUPA, Assuria kumpipate'n namte leh agamte uh ahihse ngei ua, apathiante uh mei ah apai uh.
Hiaite pathian ahi kei him ua, mihing khut a bawl sing leh suang ahi zaw uhi. Huaiziak in mei a pailut in ahihmang uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in TOUPA, ka Pathian uh aw, nang, nang kia TOUPA Pathian na hi chih leitung a lalgam tengteng in atheihtheihna ding un akhut a pan hon humbit in," achi hi.
Huai lai in Amoz tapa Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, TOUPA Israel Pathian in hichi in achi: Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib siatna ding a ka kiang a na thum ka za, chih gen ding in mi asawl hi.
Amah tungtang TOUPA'N agen hiai ahi: "Zion tanu nungak siangthou in nang hon musit in, ahon nuihsan a; Jerusalem tanu in alu hon sinkhum hi.
Kua na minsesak a, kua na gensia a? Kua tung ah ahia na aw na sansak a, na mit na hah sang? Israelte Mi Siangthoupa tung ah ahi.

Na misawlte zang in TOUPA na minsesak a, ka kangtalai tampi toh Lebanon gamgi tang sangte ka hong tungtouta hi. Huai a sidar sing sang pipite leh taksing hoih pipite ka phuk dia; alei hoihna mun gammang a tenna mun ngil pen ah ka lut ding.
Gamdang tui ka laikhia a, ka dawn zel a, ka khepek nuai ah Aigupta lui tengteng ka kangsak vek ding, na chi hi.
"Keimah in nidanglai a pan huai ka hih ahihdan bang, ma lai a pan huai ka bawl ahihdan bang na za kei a hia? Khokulh neite in chinkhawm lel bang a hihsepa ding in nang ka hon septa hi.
"Huaiziak in asung a omte'n hatna anei kei ua, alauthawng ua, ahong zahlakta uhi. Gamlak loupa bang leh loupa hing bang leh intung a loupa bang leh buh alet ma a haivuai bang ahi uhi.
"Ke'n bel na tut, na lut, na pawt leh ka tung a na hehnate ka thei hi.
Ka tung a na heh ziak leh uangtak a na pau ka bil a ahong luttouh ziak in ka nakbulh na nak ah ka bulh dia, ka sikbah na muk ah; na hong kuanna lampi mahmah ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding," chi in.
"Hiai nang a dia chiamtehna ahi ding. Tukum in buhsang na sen ding ua; kum nawn chiang in asang mah; kum thumna ah buh na tuh ding ua, at unla, grephuante bawl unla, agahte ne un.
Huchi in Judah inkote lak a khosuaksunte'n asuklam in zung akai ding ua, atoulam in agah nawn ding uhi.
Jerusalem a pan a omsunte Zion tang a pan akhosuaksunte apawtkhe ding uhi. TOUPA phatuamngaihna in hiai ahih ding," achi hi.

Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria kumpipa tungtang thu huchi in agen: "Hiai khopi ah ahong tung kei ding, hiai ah leng thal akap sam kei ding, lum toh akiang ah lah ahong pai kei ding a, akhozul ah lah lei ase sang kei ding hi.
Ahong kuanna lampi ah, huai mah ah anungkik nawn dia, hiai khopi ahong tung kei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
"Kei ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi humbit ding in ka veng ding," chi in.
Huchi in huai zan in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA angel akuankhia a, Assuriate giahphual ah mi nuaikhat singgiat-le-sangnga athat a; zingkhang a ahong thoh uleh, ngai in, misi luang ngen ana om maimah hi.
Huchi in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib apawt a, akik nawn a, apai zel a, Nineveh ah a-omta hi.
Apathian Nisrok inn a amah abiak lai in hichi ahong hi a, Adrammelek leh Sarezerte'n namsau in athat ua; huchi in Ararat gam ah atailutta uh. Huchi in asik in atapa Esarhaddon alalta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Elijah pingpei a van a apitouh ding in, hichi ahong hi a, Gilgal a pan Elisha toh Elijah apawt uhi.

Elijah in Elisha kiang ah, "Hiai ah ana om dih; TOUPA'N Bethel a pai ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Elisha in, “TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. K'on nuse kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchi in Bethel ah apaisukkhawm uhi.
Bethel a om zawlneite tapate Elisha kiang ah ahoh ua, akiang ah, "Tuni in TOUPA'N na heutupa ahon lakmangsak ding chih na thei hia?” achi uh. Ama'n, "Hi, thei mah ing, dai un," achi hi.

Elijah in akiang ah, "Elisha, hiai ah na om dih; TOUPA'N Jeriko a hoh ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. K'on nuse kei hial ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Jeriko ah ahohkhawmta uhi.
Jeriko a om zawlneite tapate'n Elisha ava naih ua, akiang ah, tuni in TOUPA'N na heutupa ahon lakmangsak ding chih na thei hia? achi uh. Ama'n adawng a, "Hi, thei mah ing, dai un,” achi hi.

Elijah in akiang ah, "Hiai ah na om dih, TOUPA'N Jordan a hoh ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, k'on nuse kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchi in anih un apaikhawmta uh.
Zawlneite' tapate lak a mi sawmnga ava hoh ua, amaute zawn, gamla kuamtak ah ava dingh ua; amau gel bel Jordan gei ah ana dingh uhi.
Elijah in apuan la in alomzial a, tui asat a, alang tuak ah ahong kikhenta a, huchi in anih un lei keu ah apaita uhi.
Agalkah nung un hichi ahong hi a, Elijah in Elisha kiang ah, "Na kiang a pan lakmang a ka om ma in bang ahia ka hon hihsak ding hon ngen in," achi hi. Elisha in, "Na kha tan nih tang leng,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Thil haksapi ngen na hi ve; haksa mahleh na kiang a pan lakmang a ka om lai na muhleh na tang ding, na hon muh keileh bel na tang kei ding,” achi hi.
Apai kawmkawm ua, ahoulim lai un hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, mei kangtalai leh mei sakolte ahong kimu guih uhi. Akal ua kigolh in akikhensakta a; Elijah bel pingpei in van ah apaitouta hi.
Elisha in huai amu a, "Ka pa aw, ka pa aw, Israelte kangtalai leh asakol a tuangte aw!" chi in akikou hi. Huchi in Elijah amuta kei a; ama puan aman a, phel nih in abotkek hi.
Elijah puan hong kia leng atawm a, apaikik nawn a, Jordan lui gei ah adingh hi.
Elijah puan hong kia ala a, huai in tui asat a, "TOUPA, Elijah Pathian koi ah?" achi hi. Huchi a tui asattak in alang tuak ah hong kikhen a, Elisha agalkahta hi.
Jeriko a zawlneite tapate, amah zawn a omte'n amuh un, "Elijah kha Elisha tung ah atu mah ve," achi uhi. Amah mu ding in akuan ua, ama ah lei si in akunsuk uhi.

Amaute'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhate'n mi ngalhat pipi sawmnga ka ompih uh. Na heutupa zong ding in sawl ve. TOUPA Kha in latou ahi dia, koi lai tang ah hiam, koi lai phaizang ah hiam a khia khattou ahi mai ding," achi uh. Ama'n, "Kuansak ke'n," achi hi.
Zumhuai khop a anget nung un, "Kuansak ve ua,” achi khong hi. Huchi in mi sawmnga asawl ua; ni thum sung azong ua, himahleh amuzou kei uh.
Jeriko a anituan lai in akiang ah ahong nawn ua; ama'n akiang uah, na kiang uah, "Kuansak kei un, ka hon chi ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Huai khua a mite'n Elisha kiang ah, "En in, hiai khomun anuam mahmah a, ka toupa un leng na hon muhpih hi. Himahleh tui ahoih kei a, agam mahmah gahsuah thei lou gam ahi," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Tuithawl thak hon la unla, chi thun un,” achi a; huchi in ahon la uhi.
Tuikhuk ah ava hoh a, chi athehlut a, “TOUPA'N hichi in achi, hiai tui ka limsakta, tuban siah sihna leh gahsuahlouhna a-om nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Elisha gen bang in tuni tan in huai tui alimta hi.
Huai a pan Bethel ah ahohtou a; lampi a apai lai in khua a pan pasal naupang hon ahong pawtkhia ua, ahong nuihsan ua, akiang ah, "Nang lugiaupa, va hohtou in, nang lugiaupa va hohtou in," achi uhi.
Anunglam anga a, amau amu a, TOUPA min in ahamsiatta hi. Huchi in gamnuai a pan vompinu nih ahong pawtkhia ua, alak ua naupang sawmli-le-nih abalgawp uhi.
Huai a pan Karmel tang ah ahoh a, huai a pan Samaria ah apai nawnta hi.

Huai lai in Hezekiah, muanmohhuai in achi ana hi. Huchi in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai akiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na inkote omdan ding gel in; damkhe zou lou a si ding na hi ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in baang lam nga in akihei a, TOUPA kiang ah,
"TOUPA aw, na ma a thutak leh lungtang hoihkim pu a ka omdan leh na mitmuh a thil hoih ka hihdan hehpih in theigige in," chi in athum hi. Huchi in Hezekiah kah petmah in akap hi.
Isai huangsung intual laitak atun ma in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung hi.

"Kik nawn inla, ka mite heutu Hezekiah kiang ah gen in, TOUPA'N, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na thumna ka za a, na khitui kia leng ka mu hi. Ngai in, ka hon damsak ding a; ani thum ni in TOUPA' inn ah na hohtou ding.
Na damsung kumte kum sawm-le-nga in ka behlap dia; nang leh hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa a pan ka humbit ding.' Keimah ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi ka hum ding, achi," chi in.
Isai in, theipi gah beu khat hon la un, achi a; huchi in ahon la ua, ameimatum ah atat a, ahong dam nawnta hi.
Hezekiah in Isai kiang ah, "TOUPA'N ahon damsak dia, TOUPA' inn ah ani thum ni in ka hohtou ding, chih chiamtehna bang ahi dia?" achi hi.

Isai in, TOUPA'N athil gen ahih ngei ding chih hiai nang a ding in TOUPA a pan chiamtehna ding ahi ding, "Limliap kalbi sawm tan, amailam a akintouh hia na deih, kalbi sawm tan a anunglam a akik?" achi hi.
Hezekiah in adawng a, "Limliap kalbi sawm tan amalam a kintouh abaih tel a, huai zaw hi kei henla, limliap kalbi sawm tan in nunglam ah nungkik zaw hen," achi hi.
Huchi in zawlnei Isai in TOUPA asam a; huchi in Ahaz dak zah theihna a limliap niamsa kalbi sawm tan in nunglam ah akiksak nawn hi.
Huai lai in Hezekiah chi ana chih ana zak ziak in Baladan tapa Babulon kumpipa Merodak-baladan in laikhakte leh thilpiakte Hezekiah akhak hi.
