Huchi in Hezekiah in amau ana kipahpih a, athil manpha koihna inn a thil manpha tengteng, dangka, dangka-eng, gimlimte, sathau manpha, agalvan koihna inn teng leh agou koihkhawmna insung a om tengteng a-ensak a: a-inn leh agamsung a Hezekiah in a-etsak louh a-om kei hi.

Huai lai in zawlnei Isai kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "Huai mite'n bang ahia agen uh? Koi a pan na kiang a hong hoh ahi ua?" chi in adong hi. Hezekiah in, "Gam gamla, Babulon a kipan a hong hoh ahi uh," achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Na inn ah bangbang ahia amuh uh?" achi a; Hezekiah in, "Ka insung a om tengteng amu vek ua, ka gou lak ah ka etsak louh a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, "TOUPA thu ngaikhia in.
Ngai in, na insung a om tengteng leh tuni tan a na pi-le-pute'n ana kholkhawmte uh Babulon ah apaipih nite uh ahong tung ding; bangmah nutsiat anei kei ding uh TOUPA'N achi.
Na gil a gah, na suan ding, na tapate ngei leng apaimangpih ding ua; Babulon kumpipa' inn ah michilgeh ahi ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah in Isai kiang ah, "Na gen TOUPA thu ahoih ahi,” achi hi. "Ka damsung a lemna leh thutak a-om ding nakleh hoih himai lou hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdan tengteng leh dil leh tuilakna abawl a, khopi sung a tui alaklut thute Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Hezekiah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; atapa Manasseh asik in alal hi.
Manasseh alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nga alal a; anu min Hephzibah ahi.
TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a adelhkhiaksa namte, thilkihhuaitak ahihte uh bang, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
Apa Hezekiah in ahihsiatsa mun sangte adingsak nawn a; Israel kumpipa Ahab hih bang in Baal maitamte adingsak a, Asherahte abawl a, van a om tengteng bia in a-nna uh asem hi.
TOUPA'N, "Jerusalem ah ka min ka omsak ding," achihna TOUPA' inn ah maitamte abawl hi.
TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nihte ah van a om tengteng a ding in maitamte abawl hi.
Atapa mei ah apaisuaksak a, aisan leh bum ahih a, dawi zawlte leh kha napeuh adong hi. TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou thupi mahmah amah hehsak ding in ahih hi.
TOUPA'N David leh atapa Solomon kiang a, "Hiai inn leh Jerusalem khua, Israel chi tengteng lak a ka tel ah ka min tangtawn in ka omsak ding," achihna mun ah Asherah lim khuaktawm atungkhia hi.
"Thu ka piak tengteng leh ka sikha Mosi in dan apiak tengteng zuih peuhmah uleh api-le-pute uh ka piaksa gam a pan Israelte khete leng ka kal ka suankhesak nawn sam kei ding," achi hi.
Himahleh amau azui kei ua; TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa namte hih sang tham a thupizaw thil hihkhial ding in Manasseh in mite alampialsak hi.
TOUPA'N asikha zawlneite zang in thu agen hi.
"Judah kumpipa Manasseh in hiai thilkihhuaitakte ahih a, Amorte sang tham in ahihkhial thupi hi. Judahte'n leng amilimte a thil ahihkhelhsak ziak in," achi hi.
TOUPA, Israel Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ngai dih ua, Jerusalem leh Judah tung ah aza peuhmahte bil langnih khengzou khop in thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding hi.
Jerusalem tung ah Samaria tehna khau leh Ahab inkuan' ulum khai ka khung dia; mi'n akuangnul akilumletsak bang in Jerusalem ka nul ding hi.
Ka goutan khosuaksunte ka taisan dia, amelmate uh khut ah ka pe ding.
Huchi in api-le-pute uh Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh tuni pha a ka mitmuh a thil hoih lou ahih ua, hon hehsak ziak un, amelma tengteng mat ding leh gallak ding ahi ding uh," chi in achi hi.
TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih loutak hih a Judahte thil ahihkhelhsak, khelhna a sim lou in Manasseh in poi khoih lou sisan nakpitak in asuah lai a, Jerusalem dung leh vai adimsak hi.
Manasseh tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, athilhihkhelhte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Manasseh api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Uzza huansung a om ama inn huan mah ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ammon alalta hi.
Ammon alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum nih alal a; anu min Mesullemeth, Jotbah a Haruz tanu ahi.
Apa Manasseh hih bangmah TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih hi.
Apa lampi tot tengteng atawn sam a, apa septe milimte nna sem in amaute abia hi.
Huchi in TOUPA, api-le-pute Pathian apaisan a, TOUPA lampi atawn kei hi.
Ammon sikhate'n amah aguksawm ua, kumpipa amah inn ah athatta uhi.
Himahleh huai gam a mite'n kumpipa Ammon guksawm mi tengteng athat vek uhi. Huchi in huai gam mite'n atapa Josiah asik in kumpipa in abawlta uhi.
Huchi in Ammon thilhih tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Uzza huan a amah han ah avui ua; asik in atapa Josiah alalta hi.
Josiah alal pat tung in kum giat a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-khat alal a; anu min Jedidah, Boskath a Adaiah tanu ahi.
Ama'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil dik ahih a, apu David lampi tot tengteng atawn a, taklam ah hiam veilam ah hiam apialkhe kei hi.
Kumpipa Josiah alal kum sawm-le-giatna kum in hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa'n Meshullam tapa Azaliah tapa laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah,
"Siampu lianpen Hilkiah kiang ah hohtou inla, kongkhak veng mite'n mite a pan ana lakkhawm uh TOUPA' inn a dangka kikoih sim uhenla;
TOUPA' inn lam nasem mite pia uhen; amau inn se bawl TOUPA' inn a nasemte pia uhen.
Singlem bawl mite, inn lam mite, inn sia bawl mite'n inn siatna tak bawlna sing leh suangsek aleitheihna ding un, chi in va gen in, chi in TOUPA' inn ah asawl hi.
Himahleh dangka apiakte uh etpih nawn ding in agelhsak tuan kei, muanhuaitak a hih zel ahih ziak un," achi hi.
Siampu lianpen Hilkiah in laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah, "TOUPA' inn ah dan laibu ka mu,” achi hi. Hilkiah in huai laibu Shaphan apia a, ama'n asimta hi.
Kumpipa kiang ah laigelhmi Shaphan ava hoh a, kumpipa kiang ah thu ava tun nawn a, "Na mite'n inn a dangka omte apekhe vek ua, TOUPA' inn lam nasem mite ape vek uh," achi hi.
Laigelhmi Shaphan in, "Siampu Hilkiah in laibu ahon pia,” chi in kumpipa ahilh a, huchi in Shaphan in kumpipa ma ah asim hi.
Kumpipa'n dan laibu a thute azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuante abotkek hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n siampu Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikaiah tapa Akbor, laigelhmi Shaphan leh kumpipa sikha Asahiah kiang ah,

"Kei, mi tengteng leh Judah teng a ding in hiai laibu a thu tuang toh kisai in TOUPA hon dotsak un. I pi-le-pute'n hiai laibu a thute zuih ding ana ngaihkhiak louh ziak un i tung uah TOUPA thangpaihna athupi mahmah ngal a," chi in thu apia hi.

Huchi in siampu Hilkiah, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan, Asahiah, puansilh kempa Harhas tapa Tikvah tapa Shallum zi zawlnei Huldah kiang ah ahoh ua, ava houpih uhi. Amah bel Jerusalem sehkhen nihna a teng ahi.
Ama'n akiang uah TOUPA, Israelte Pathian in hichi in achi, “Ka kiang a nou hon sawlpa hilh un," TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
"Ngai in, hiai mun ah leh asung a tengte tung ah thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding, Judah kumpipa'n laibu a, athusim tengteng bang in.
Kei ahon paisan ua, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, akhutsuak ua ahon thangpaihsak ziak un hiai mun ah ka thangpaihna nakpitak in akuang dia, amawkmih kei ding hi.
Himahleh TOUPA thu dong ding a nou hon sawlpa Judah kumpipa kiang ah huchi in na chi ding uh. TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Na thuzakte tungtang thu ah,

hiai mun leh asung a tengte hihgam leh hamsiat in a-om ding uh chih thu ka gen na zak a, na lungtang anem a, TOUPA ma a na kiniamkhiak a, na puante na bohkek a, ka ma a na kah ziak in, ke'n leng na thu ka na za, TOUPA'N achi.

Huchi in ngai in, na pi-le-pute kiang ah ka hon pi dia, na han ah lungmuangtak a pi in na om dia, hiai mun a thil hoih lou ka tunsak ding tengteng na mit in amu vek kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in huai thu kumpipa kiang ah atun nawn uhi.
Huan kumpipa'n mi asawl a, akiang ah Juda leh Jerusalem khopi a upa tengteng asamkhawm uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa Judah gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng toh, siampute leh zawlneite toh, mipi tengteng toh, aneu leh alian in TOUPA' inn ah ahohtou ua; TOUPA' inn a kimu thukhun laibu a tuang thu tengteng abil ua zak in asim hi.

Khuam zul ah kumpipa adingh a, huai laibu a tuang thukhun thu hihkip ding in lungtang tengteng leh akha tengteng a TOUPA zui ding leh athupiakte, athu theihsakte, adan thusehte zui ding in TOUPA ma ah thu akhung a; huchi in mipi tengteng in leng akhunpih uhi.

Kumpipa'n siampu lianpen Hilkiah leh azom a siampute, kongkhak veng mite kiang ah TOUPA tempul sung a Baal, Asherah leh van a om tengteng a dia kibawl tui-um belsuan tengteng lakhe vek ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in Jerusalem polam, Kidron mun ah huai tengteng ahal a, avute Bethel ah apaipih hi.

Milim pathian bia siampute, Judah Kumpipate'n Judah gam khopi mun sangte a, Jerusalem kim a gimlim hal dia ana seh uh atawpsak a; Baal a dia, ni a dia, kha a dia, aksite a dia van a omte tengteng a dia gimlim hal mite leng.
TOUPA' inn a Asherah pen Jerusalem polam Kidron lui a lakhia in ahal a, asiknengawp a, anen mi vantangte han ah atheh hi.
Asherah a dia puan gan numeite omna, TOUPA' inn kiang a pasal kizuakte omna innte aphelkhe vek hi.

Judah khopi a pan siampu tengteng apikhia a, siampute'n gimlim ahalna uh Geba a pan Beer-sheba pha in ahihbuah vek a; khopi kongpi veilam pang a om khopi ukpa Joshua kongpi ah alut a kongpite a mun sangte achimsak hi.
Mun sang siampute Jerusalem a TOUPA maitam ah ahohtou kei ua, himahleh a-unaute uh lak ah tanghou silngou soh louh ane uhi.
Kuamah in atapa hiam atanu hiam Molek kiang a mei a apaisuaksak nawnlouhna ding in, Hinnom suante phaizang a Tophet ahihbuah hi.
TOUPA' inn lutna a inn huangsung a kumpipa' inn vengmi Nathan-melek dantan chin a Judah kumpipate'n nisa a dia sakol apiakte uh alamang vek a; nisa kangtalai mei in ahal hi.
Ahaz inn chial tung a Judah kumpipate'n maitam abawlte uh leh Manasseh in TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nih a maitam abawlte kumpipa'n ahihchim a, ahihnen vek a, anente Kidron lui ah apai hi.

Jerusalem ma a tatsiatna tang taklam pang a Zidonte pathian kihhuai mahmah Astoreth a dia, Ammon suante pathian kihhuai mahmah Khemosh a dia, Ammonte Pathian kihhuai mah Molek Israel kumpipa Solomon in mun sang abawlte kumpipa'n ahihbuah hi.
Milimte akitamsak vek a, Ashera ahihpuk a, huai munte ah mihing guhte akoih hi.

Huai lou leng Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam in Bethel a maitam leh Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam in abawl mun sang, huai maitam ahihchim a mun sang mei ahal in asikzan a, Ashera ahal hi.
Josiah akihei a, tang a hante amu a; huchi in han a guhte ava lasak a, huai thu Pathian mipa'n ana gen, TOUPA thu bangbang in maitam tung ah ahal a, ahihbuah hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Huai a ka muh kua suangphuh ahia?" achi a; khomite'n, “Pathian mipa, Judah gam a pan hong pai, Bethel a maitam tung a tua na hih a na genkholpa han ei ve," chi in ahilh uhi.
Ama'n, "Bangmah chih kei un; kuamah in aguhte lasuan kei hen," achi hi. Huchi in aguhte Samaria gam a pan zawlnei hong paipa guhte toh bangmah achih kei uhi.
Israel Kumpipate'n TOUPA hehsak dia alam uh Samaria gam khua a mun sang inn tengteng leng Josiah in asuanmang a, Bethel a ahih vek bang geih in ahih hi.
Huchi in huai a mun sang siampu tengteng maitam tung ah athat a, huaite ah mihing guhte ahal a, Jerusalem ah akik nawnta hi.
Kumpipa'n mi tengteng kiang ah, "Hiai thukhun bu a tuang bang in TOUPA, Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang zang un," chi in thu apia hi.
Israelte tung a vaihawm mite'n vai ahawm ua kipan Israel kumpipa tengteng, Judah kumpipate lal sung hun teng in huchibang hial Paikan Ankuang azang ngei nai kei uhi.
Kumpipa Josiah lal akum sawm-le-giatna kum in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in hiai bang in Paikan Ankuang anei phet uhi.

Huai ban ah TOUPA' inn a siampu Hilkiah in amuh laibu a thu tuangte akipsak theihna ding in dawi aisan siam zawlte, bumsiamte, pathian limte, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a thilkihhuai amuh tengteng Josiah in ahihmang vek hi.
Mosi Dan tengteng alungtang leh kha tengteng leh hatna tengteng a TOUPA pom amah bang mahmah ama a kumpipate kuamah a-om kei ua; anung in leng amah bang kuamah a-om nawn sam kei hi.
Huchipi in leng TOUPA'N athangpaihna thupi mahmah, Manasseh in ana thangpaihsakna tengteng ziak in Judah tung a athangpaihna akiheisan kei hi.
TOUPA'N, “Israel ka suanmang bang in Judah leng ka muhphaklouhna ah ka suanmang sam dia, hiai khua ka tel Jerusalem ngei leh huai a inn ka min a-omna ding, ka chih ka paimang ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Josiah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah tuang ahi kei maw?
Amah alal lai in Assuria kumpipa dou ding in Euphrates Luipi ah Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh Neko ahohtou hi. Kumpipa Josiah in amah ana dou a; ama'n amuhtak in Meggiddo ah athat hi.

Huchi in asikhate'n Meggiddo a pan aluang kangtalai in apaipih ua, Jerusalem ah alutpih ua, ama han ah avui uh. Huchi in huai gam a mite'n Josiah tapa Jehoahaz api ua, thau anilh ua, apa sik in kumpipa in abawlta uhi.
Jehoahaz alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-thum a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kha thum sung alal a; anu min Hemutal, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
Api-le-pute hih bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
Pharaoh Neko in Jerusalem a vaihawm thei nawn lou ding in Hamath gam a Riblah ah akoltangsak a; agam uh dangka talent zakhat leh dangka-eng talent khat siah akipesak hi.
Pharaoh Neko in Josiah tapa Eliakim, apa Josiah sik in alalsak a, amin Jehoiakim chi in akheksak hi. Jehoahaz bel apimang a; Aigupta gam ah apai a, huai ah asita hi.

Jehoiakim in dangka leh dangka-eng Pharaoh ape phot a; himahleh Pharaoh thupiak bang a dangka apiakna ding in agam siah aliausak hi. Pharaoh Neko kiang a piak ding in michih liau dia aseh zah chiat bang in huai gam a mite dangka leh dangka-eng aliausak hi.
Jehoiakim alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat alal a; anu min Zebudah, Rumah a Pedaiah tanu ahi.
Huchi in api-le-pute hihdan bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
Alal lai hun in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in huai gam ahong dou a, Jehoiakim bel asikha in kum thum a-om hi. Huai nung in alehngatsan a, atung ah ahelta hi.
TOUPA'N Kaldai pawlte, Siria pawlte, Moab pawlte, Ammon suan pawlte amah sual ding in asawlkhia a, asikha zawlneite zang a agen TOUPA thu bang in Judah gam hihsesak ding in asawl hi.
Manasseh khelhna, athilhih tengteng ziak a, amuh phaklouhna a amaute suanmang ding in, Judah tung ah TOUPA thupiak ahong tung petmah hi.
Midik sisan asuah ziak in leng; midik sisan a Jerusalem ahihdim ziak in leng TOUPA'N amah angaidam kei hi.
Huchi in Jehoiakim tanchin dang leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah tuang ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Jehoiakim bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; asik in atapa Jehoiakin alalta hi.
Aigupta kumpipa agam a pan ahong kuankhe nawn kei; Babulon kumpipa'n Aigupta gam lui a pan Euphrates Luipi pha a kumpipa gam huap tengteng alak zoh tak ziak in.
Jehoiakin bel alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-giat a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kha thum alal a, anu min Nehushta, Jerusalem a Elnathan tanu ahi.
Apa hihdan tengteng hih in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
Huchih lai in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar sikhate Jerusalem ah ahohtou ua, khua ava um uhi.
Huchi a asikhate'n ava um lai un khua ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ava hohtou hi,
Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin, anu, asikhate, amiliante, aheutute toh Babulon kumpipa kiang ah ava pawtkhia ua; alal akum giatna kum in Babulon kumpipa'n ana man hi.
TOUPA gen bang in, a-inn a gou tengteng leh kumpipa' inn a gou tengteng ala vek a, TOUPA tempul a Israelte kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng tui-um belsuan abawl tengteng asatgawp vek hi.
Jerusalem a mi tengteng, milian tengteng, mihat hangsan hoih tengteng, singkhat leh khutsiam leh siksekmi tengteng sal in api vek hi. Huai gam a migentheite chih louh kuamah a-omta kei uhi.
Jehoiakin bel Babulon ah api a; kumpipa nu, kumpinute, aheutute leh huai gam a mihatte Jerusalem a pan Babulon ah sal in api hi.
Babulon kumpipa'n pasal hoih tengteng sangsagih leh khutsiam leh siksekmi sangkhat, mihat hoih teng gal dou thei mi ngen Babulon ah sal in api vek hi.
Apa unaupa Mattaniah, Babulon kumpipa'n asik in alalsak a, amin Zedekiah chi in akheksak hi.
Zedekiah bel alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-khat a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat sung alal a; anu min Hamutal, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
Jehoiakim hihdan tengteng bang in ahih a, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
TOUPA hehna tawn in Jerusalem leh Judah tung ah Zedekiah, Babulon kumpipa tung a ahel a pan ama'n amuh phak louh dia apaihmang masiah hiai thilte ahong tungta hi.
Alal kum kuana kum, akha sawmna, ani sawm ni in hichi ahong hi a, asepaih tengteng toh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong kuan in Jerusalem ahong dou a, om mun ava bawl a; kulh in a-umsuakta hi.
Hichi in kumpipa Zedekiah lal akum sawm-le-khatna tan in khua um in a-om hi.
Akha lina, ani kua ni in khua akial mahmahta a, huai gam mite a ding in tanghou a-om kei hi.
Khopi kulh ahihvang ua, zan in gal dou thei mi tengteng kumpipa huan ning, kulhbaang nih kikal a kulh kongpi ah ataikhe vek ua; Kaldaite'n khua a umsuak uhi; kumpipa Arabah lampi ah apai hi.
Himahleh Kaldai sepaihte'n kumpipa adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah apha ua; asepaih tengteng in amah taizaksan vek uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa aman ua, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah api ua; atungtang thu angaihtuah uhi.
Zedekiah tapate amitmuh ngei in athat ua, Zedekiah mitte akhelkhiaksak ua, kol abunsak ua, Babulon ah apaipih uhi.
Huchi in Babulon kumpipa, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar lal akum sawm-le-kuana, akha ngana, ani sagih ni in Jerusalem ah Babulon kumpipa vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan alut hi.
TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn ahal a; Jerusalem inn tengteng, inn thupi taktakte ahal hi.
Vengmi pawl heutu kiang a om Kaldai sepaih tengteng in Jerusalem kim a kulhte ahihchim vek uhi.
Khopi sung a nutsiat a om mite, Babulon kumpipa kiang a kipia mite leh mipi dang teng vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in sal in api vek hi.
Huai gam a azawng tatate lak a mite vengmi pawl heutu in grepgui kem ding leh lou bawl ding in anusia hi.
TOUPA' inn a dalkhuamte leh atunnate leh dal limlang tuipi Kaldaite'n ahihkekgawp vek ua, adal Babulon ah apaipih uhi.
Belte, vutluahnate, khawnvak puantehnate, keute leh dal tui-um belsuan tengteng, nasepna dia azatte uh ala uhi.
Mei laknate, belkuangte toh, vengmi pawl heutu in dangka-eng abawlte bel adangka-eng ala a, dangkasik a bawlte adangka ala hi.
Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl khuampi nih, tuikuangpi khat leh atunnate leh hiai vanzat tengteng bawlna dal buk theih vual ahi kei hi.

Khuam khat sandan tong sawm-le-giat ahi a, adawn ah dal sunbawk a-om a; huai sunbawk sandan tong thum ahi. Sunbawk kim ah agial tiktek leh theibuhfai atuang a, dal a bawl vek ahi uh. Huchi mah bang in khuampi khat leng agial tiktek hi.
Vengmi pawl heutu in siampu lianpen Seraiah leh azompa siampu Zephaniah leh kongkhak vengmi thum aman hi.

Galdou thei mite tung a heutu khat toh, kumpipa kiang a om khopi tung a om lai ngate toh, mipite mingelhpa sepaihte heutu laigelhmi toh, khopi sung a om lai gam a mi sawmguk toh khopi sung a pan aman hi.
Vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in amau api a, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah apaipih hi.
Babulon kumpipa'n Hamath gam, Riblah ah amau ana that hi. Huchi in Judah, agamsung a pan sal a pikhiak in a-omta hi.
Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah gam a anutsiat teng tung ah Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah ukpa ding in abawl hi.

Huchi in sepaih pawl heutu tengteng leh aheute'n Babulon kumpipa'n Gedaliah ukpa in abawl chih azak un Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah ahoh ua, huaite bel Nathaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapa Johanan, Netophah mi Tanhumeth tapa Seraiah, Mak mi tapa Jaazaniah leh aheute ahi uhi.
Gedaliah huai mite leh aheute uh kiang ah akichiam a, akiang uah, "Kaldaite sikha a om lau kei un. Hiai gam ah teng unla, Babulon kumpipa na sem un, huchi in nou a ding in ahoih ding," achi hi.

Himahleh akha sagihna ah hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa suan Elishama tapa, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bel mi sawmkhat toh ahong kuan a, Mizpah a Juda mi leh Kaldai mi akiang a om teng leh Gedaliah ahong sual ua, athat vek uhi.
Huchi in mi tengteng aneu leh alian in sepaih heutute toh apawtkhia ua, Kaldaite alauh ziak un Aigupta gam ah apaita uhi.

Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin saltan akum sawmthum-le-sagihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, ani sawmnih-le-sagih ni in hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Evil-merodak in alal pat tung kum in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin atanna inn a pan akhahkhia hi.
Akiang ah hoihtak in thu agen a, Babulon a kumpipa om samte laltutphah tung ah alaltutphah akoihsang tuamse hi.
Atanna inn puansilhte akheng a, adamsung teng in akiang ah an ane gige samta hi.
Huchi in aloh ding, kumpipa'n apiak tatlak lou a-om a, adamsung teng in, niteng a azat ding abawlsak gige hi.
Huan Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kum sawm-le-giat alal kum in Ahab tapa Jehoram Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a; kum sawm-le-nih alal hi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihloupi ahih a; himahleh anu leh apa bang tel in zaw thil ahih kei. Ama'n apa Baal suangphuh apaimang hi.
Himahleh, Israelte thil hihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate amah ah abelh tinten a; huai apaisan kei hi.
Moab kumpipa Mesha belam vul mi ahi a; ama'n Israel kumpipa kiang ah belamnou nuaikhat mul leh belampa nuaikhat mul siah aliau hi.
Himahleh Ahab sih nung in hichi ahong hi a, Moab kumpipa Israel kumpipa tung ah ahelta hi.
Huchih lai in Samaria a pan kumpipa Jehoram apawt a, Israel tengteng akaikhawm vek hi.

Huchi in apawt a, Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Moab kumpipa ka tung ah ahel a, Moabte na hon doupih diam?" chi in mi asawl hi. Ama'n, "Hon doupih e, kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, ka sakolte leh na sakolte leng pum khat ahi uh," achi hi.
Amah mah in, "Koi lampi ah ahia i kuan touh ding?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Edom gamdai lampi ah," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa Judah kumpipa toh, Edom kumpipa toh, akuanta ua; ni sagih apaikual ua; asepaihte leh agan tonpihte dawn ding tui a-omta kei hi.
Israel kumpipa'n, "E heh he! TOUPA'N kumpipa thumte Moabte khut a piak dia hon pikhawm ahi peuhmah ve,” achi hi.

Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "Hiai ah TOUPA hon dotsak ding TOUPA zawlnei kuahiam bek a-om kei maw?" achi hi. Israel kumpipa sikha khat in adawng a, "Elijah khut tui buaksekpa Shaphat tapa Elisha hiai a om ei ve," achi hi.
Jehoshaphat in, akiang ah, "Ama'n TOUPA thu anei hi," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa leh Jehoshaphat leh Edom kumpipa akiang ah ahohsukta uh.

Elisha in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Nang leh ke'n kizopna bang i nei a? Na pa zawlneite leh na nu zawlneite kiang ah va hoh in," achi hi. Israel kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Pai lou e; kumpipa thumte Moabte khut a piak ding in TOUPA'N ahon pikhawm hi,” achi hi.
Elisha in, "Akiang a ka dinna sepaihte' TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat zahtak lou hi leng nang lam leng ka nga kei dia, muh leng ka hon mu het kei ding.
Himahleh, kaihging tumsiammi hon sam un," achi hi. Kaihging tumsiam in ahon tumleh, hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA khut atung ah ahong omta hi.
Ama'n, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai phaizang tengteng toukuak tektuk un.

TOUPA mah in hichi in achi: Huih himhim na mu kei ding ua, vuah himhim leng na mu sam kei ding uh. Himahleh hiai phaizang tui in adim vek ding hi. Huchi in nou leh na bawnghonte uh leh na gante un adawn ding uh.
Hiai TOUPA ngaih in thil neuchik lel ahi a; Moabte na khut uah ahon piak behlap ding hi.
Kulhpi nei khua tengteng leh khopi hoih tengteng na hihse ding ua, sing hoih tengteng na phuk ding ua, tuikhuk tengteng na hubing ding ua, mun hoih tata suang in na dengse vek ding uh," achi hi.
Zingsang in, thillat lat hun lai in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, Edom gam lam a pan tui ahong luang a, tui in agam ahong dimta hi.
Moab tengteng in amau sual ding in kumpipate ahong kuantou uh chih ana zak un, galdou thei chiang tengteng ana kikaikhawm ua, gamgi ah ana pangta uhi.
Huchi in zingkhang in athou ua, ni in tui tung a hon salvak a, Moabte'n azawn ua tui sisan bang a san in amu uhi.
"Sisan ei ve, kumpipate amau le amau akidou ua, amau leh amau kithat uh ahi mahmah ve. Kisa un, Moabte aw, gallak thil i va tuh ding uh,” achi uhi.
Israelte giahphual ava tun uleh, Israelte ahong thou phut ua, Moabte asual ua, huchi in ama uah ataikek uh. Moabte that kawm in agam uah adelhlutta uhi.

Khuate ahihsia ua; amun hoih tata teng uh michih in adeng ua, suang in adimgawpta hi. Tuikhuk tengteng ahubing ua, sing hoih tengteng aphuk ua; Kir-hareseth a om suangte kia akhoih kei uhi. Huai leng vaisuanglot tawi pawl in a-umkimvel ua, asual uhi.
Moab kumpipa'n akidou uh zou ding in akitheita kei, Edom kumpipa kiang a tung dia phut paisuak tum in namsau tawimi zasagih apikhia a, himahleh alohsam uhi.
Huchi in atapa upapen, asik a hong lal ding pen kulh dawn ah halmang thillat in alanta hi. Huchi in Israelte atung ah aheh mahmah ua, akisa ua, agam uah apaikik nawnta uhi.

Huan zawlneite tapate' zite lak a numei khat in Elisha kiang ah, "Na sikha, ka pasal ana sita hi. Na sikha in TOUPA alau chih na thei a; aleibatna pa'n ka tate anih ua sikha dia pi ding in ahong kuan hi," chi in amangbat thu ahilh hi.
Elisha in akiang ah, "Bang ka hon hihsak dia? Hon hilh ve, inn ah bang na nei a?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikhanu'n sathau um khat kia lou ngal inn ah bangmah ka nei kei," achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Va kuan inla, na invengte tengteng bel vuak va khelkhawm in; tam lou kia zaw khel ke'n.
Na hong lut chiang in na tapate toh kong kikhakkhum unla, huai tuh tengteng ah sathau thun inla; adimdim in na tuamkoih ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in akiang a pan apaita a, amah leh atapate toh kong akikhakkhum ua; amau belte ahon la ua, ama'n ana thun zel hi.
Belte adim nung in, hichi ahong hi a, atapa kiang ah, "Bel hon la nawn dih," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Bel a-om nawn kei," achi hi. Huchi in sathau akangta hi.
Huai khit in Pathian mipa kiang ah ava hoh a, thil omdan ava hilh hi. Ama'n, "Va pai inla, sathau va zuak inla, na leibat va din inla, aval in na tapate toh khosa un,” achi hi.
Ni khat Shunem ah Elisha ava zin hi. Huai ah numei neizoutak khat a-om hi. Ama'n an ne ding in ana sawl teitei hi. Huchi in apai peuhmah chiang in huai ah an ne ding in alut hi.
Ama'n apasal kiang ah, “Ngai in, hiai mi hon nawk zelpa Pathian misiangthoupa ahi, chih ka thei.
Kisa dih, inn pindan neu i bawlsak dia, lupna, dohkan, tutphah leh khawnvak koihna i koihsak ding. Huchi a i kiang a ahong chiang in alut zel ding,” achi hi.
Ni khat ava hoh a, huai in pindan ah ava lut a, ava lum hi.
Asikha Gehazi kiang ah, "Hiai Shunem numei hon sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a ama ah ahong dingh hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, nang nakpitak in na hon deihthoh a, bang ka hon hihsak sam dia, kumpipa hiam, sepaih heutu hiam hon houpihsak leng na ut hia? chi in akiang ah gen in," achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Ка chipihte lak mah a teng ka hi," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Amah a dia bang hih ding ahia le?" achi hi. Gehazi in adawng a, "Tapa anei kei, apasal lah a-upata a," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Va sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a, kong ah ahong dingh hi.
Ama'n, "Tu bang hun ahong tun nawn chiang in tapa na pomta ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Maizen, toupa, nang Pathian mipa in na sikhanu kiang ah zuaugen ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in numei agai a, Elisha in akiang a, agen bang a ahun ahong tun nawn in tapa aneita hi.
Naungek ahong khanglian a, ni khat apa toh buh la mite kiang ah akuan hi.
Apa kiang ah, "Ka lu, ka lu," achi hi. Apa'n sikha valnou khat kiang ah, "Pom inla, anu kiang ah paipih in," achi hi.
Apaipih a, anu kiang atun in aphei tung ah sun tan atu a, huchi in asita hi.
Apaitou a, Pathian mipa lupna ah asial a, kong akhakkhum a, apawtta hi.
Huchi in apasal asam a, "Sikha kuahiam leh sabiltung khat hon ngaihtuahsak dih ve, Pathian mipa kiang ah ka va tai dia, ka hong kik nawn ding,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Bangziak a tuni chitchiat a akiang a hoh tum na hia? Kha thak leng ahi kei a, Sabbath leng ahi ngal kei a," achi hi. Ama'n, “Ahoih ding," achi hi.
Huchi in sabiltung abawl a, asikha kiang ah, "Hawl inla malam ah pai in, thu ka hon piak keileh awl pai ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in apaita a, Pathian mipa kiang ah Karmel tang ah ava hoh hi. Pathian mipa'n gamlapi a pan ana muh in, hichi ahong hi a, asikha Gehazi kiang ah, "En in, huai ah Shunem numei a-om.
Amah dawn ding in va tai inla, akiang ah, na dam hia? Na pasal adam maw? Naupang leng adam maw? va chi in,” achi hi. Ama'n ana dawng a, "Dam e," achi hi.

Mual a Pathian mipa kiang ava tun in, akhe alen tinten a, amah hong sawnhang tum in Gehazi in ava naih hi. Himahleh Pathian mipa'n, "Bangmah chih ke'n, alungsim mangbang ahi. TOUPA'N ka lak ah asel a, ahon hilh nai kei hi,” achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Ka toupa, tapa ka hon ngen a hia? Hon khem ke'n, ka hon chi hilou maw?" achi hi.

Huchi in Gehazi kiang ah, "Na puan teng inla, ka chiangkhun tawi in va hoh in. Kuapeuh mu lechin leng, chibai buk ke'n. Kuapeuh in chibai ahon buk uleh leng dawng ke'n. Naupang maitang ah ka chiangkhun va nga in," achi hi.
Naupang nu'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, ka hon khah het kei ding,” achi hi. Huchi in athou a, azuita hi.
Gehazi in amau ana makhelh a, naupang mai ah chiangkhun ana nga hi. Himahleh aw leh zak bangmah a-om kei. Huchi in houpih ding in akik nawn a, "Naupang hak het kei veh aw," chi in ahilh hi.
Elisha insung ava lutleh ngai in, naupang asi khinta a, alupna ah ana lumsak lai uhi.
Huchi in ava lut a, anih un kong akhakkhum a, TOUPA kiang ah athum hi.
Apaitou a, naupang abohkhum a, amuk leh amuk, amit leh amit, akhut leh akhut asutuah a; atung ah akizan a; huchi in naupang taksa ahong lum hiaihiai hi.
Huchi in akik nawn a, insung ah akivialleh a; ahohtou a, atung ah abok a; huchi in naupang sagihvei ahong hahchiai a, ahong hakta hi.
Huchi in Gehazi asam a, "Hiai Shunem numei hon sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a, akiang a ava lutleh, "Na tapa pom in," ana chi hi.
Huchi in ava lut a, akhebul ah abokkhup a, amai a lei si in akun a; atapa apom a, apawtkhia hi.
Gilgal ah Elisha ahoh nawn hi. Huai gam ah kial akia hi. Zawlneite tapate ama ah atukhawm ua; ama'n asikha kiang ah, "Bel lianpi suang inla, zawlneite tapate an huansak in," achi hi.
Mi khat gam ah meh zong in ava kuan a, gam khau ava mu a, agah khenkhat alou a, apuan in atun theih zah atun a, a-atnen a, bel sung ah akha hi. Bang ahia chih athei kuamah a-om kei uh.
Huchi in huai mite nek ding in asuakkhia ua, anhuan anek ualeh, hichi ahong hi a, "Ehe, Pathian mi, bel sung a sihna om akei maw,” achi kheukhou ua; ane theita kei uh.
Ama'n, "Tangbuang hon la dih ua,” achi a; huai tuh ah akha hi, “Mite nek ding in hon suakkhe dih ua,” achi hi. Huchi in bel ah lauhuai bangmah a-omta kei hi.
Baal-shalisha a pan mi khat ahong a, Pathian mipa a ding in buh thak masapen abawl barli buh sangpek sawmnih leh buh thak vui a-ip in ahon tawi a; ama'n, "Hiai mite nek ding in pia in," achi hi.
Asikha in, "Bang e, mi zakhattak hiai ka lui ding maw?" achi hi. Ama'n hiai mite nek ding pia in. TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ane ding ua, akhamval lai ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in alui a, ane ua, TOUPA chih bang ngei in akhamval lai uhi.
Siria kumpipa sepaih heutu Naaman, TOUPA'N Siriate humbitpa a azat ziak in, apu ngaih in thupi leh zahtakhuaitak ahi. Amah mihat ahi lai a, himahleh aphak hi.
Siriate apawlpawl in akuankhia ua, Israel gam a pan numei naupangnou khat sal in ahon pi ua; ama'n Naaman zi nna asem hi.
Ama'n api kiang ah, "Samaria a om zawlnei kiang ah ka toupa va hohleh chi na ing e! Ama'n aphakna na hihdamsak ding hi a,” achi hi.
Mi khat ava lut a, atoupa kiang ah, "Israel gam a numei naupangnou in huchibang khachibang in agen," chi in apu ahilh hi.
Siria kumpipa'n, "Va hoh hen aw, Israel kumpipa kiang ah lai ka khak ding,” achi hi. Huchi in apawt a, dangkasik talent sawm leh dangka-eng khal sangguk leh silh-le-ten kikhenna ding sawm akeng hi.
Huai laikhak Israel kumpipa ava pia a, huai ah hiai akigelh hi, “Hiai lai na mu dia, ngai in, ka sikha Naaman aphakna na hihdamsak ding in na kiang ah ka hon sawl hi,” chih.

Israel kumpipa'n huai lai asim a, hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a, "Mite that thei a, hingsak nawn thei Pathian hia ka hih? Hiai mi in phak hihdam dia ka kiang ah ahon sawl mawkmawk. Ngaihtuah unla, ka tung ah thusia azong hi, chih thei dih ua," achi hi.

Pathian mipa Elisha in Israel kumpipa'n apuan abotkek chih ana zak in, hichi ahong hi a, "Bangziak a na puan botkek na hia? Ka kiang ah hong paileh ake, huchi in Israel gam ah zawlnei a-om chih athei mai ding," va chi ding in kumpipa kiang ah mi asawl hi.
Huchi in asakolte leh akangtalaite toh Naaman ava hoh a, Elisha inn kongbul ah ava dingh hi.
Elisha in, "Jordan lui ah sagihvei va kisil inla, na sa in ngeina apu nawn dia, huchi in na siangta ding," chi ding in mi asawl hi.

Himahleh, Naaman aheh mahmah a, apaikhia a, “Ngai un, amah mah ka kiang a hong pawt dia, ahong dingh dia, TOUPA a Pathian min asam dia, ka phakna tung ah akhut akoih dia, ka phak damsak ding ei ve, chi mah hi veng in," achi hi.
"Israel gam lui tengteng sang in Damaskas kho luite, Abana leh Pharpar ahoihzaw kei a hia? Huaite a kisil in ka siangthou thei kei dia hia?" achi hi. Huchi in akilehhei a, heh mahmah in apai hi.

Asikhate'n ava naih ua, ava houpih ua, "Ka pa aw, zawlnei in thil haksatak hon hihsak dekleh leng na hihmai kei dia hia? Va kisil inla, hong siangthou in, achih pen hih zawk tuak lua hilou maw?" achi uhi.
Huchi in ahohsuk a, Pathian mipa gen bang in Jordan lui ah sagihvei ava kidiah a; huchi in asa naungek sa bang ahong hi nawn a, ahong siangta hi.

Amah leh aheute tengteng Pathian mipa kiang ah akik nawn ua, ama ah ava dingh uhi. Ama'n, "Ngai in, Israel ah lou ngal leitung tengteng ah Pathian ana om kei, chih ka theita. Huaiziak in tu in na sikha vualzawlna la ding in ka hon ngen," achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n, "Akiang a ka omna TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Bangmah ka la kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in ama'n la ding in angen a; himahleh ala ut kei bikbek hi.

Naaman in, "Ahihkeileh, kei na sikha sabiltung nih puak khop leitang hon lasak in. Tuban siah kei na sikha in TOUPA kiang kia ah ngal lou halmang thillat leh kithoihna himhim pathian dangte kiang ah ka lan nawn het kei ding hi.
Hiai thil ah TOUPA'N na sikha ngaidam hen. Rimmon inn a be dia ka ban a kingai a ka toupa alut chiang a, kei leng ka kun sam angaih chiang in TOUPA'N hon ngaidam hen," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in pai in," achi hi. Huchi in akiang a pan apawt a, gamla lou apaikhe man hi.

Himahleh Pathian mipa Elisha sikha Gehazi in, "Ngai in, ka pu in Siria mi Naaman thil hon tawite la het lou in apaisak mawk a. TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, ka va delh dia, aneih banghiam bek ka va la ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Gehazi in Naaman adelhta hi. Naaman in kuahiam in adelh amuh in, na houpih ding in kangtalai a pan akumkhia a, "Hoih vek na maw?" achi hi.

Ama'n, "Hoih vek mah e. Ka pu in, ngai in, tu mah in Ephraim tanggam a pan in zawlneite tapate lak a tangval nih ka kiang ah ahong ahong ua, amaute dangkasik talent khat leh puansilh kikhenna ding nih pia in, chih gen ding in ahong sawl hi," achi hi.
Naaman in, "Khamuang inla, talent nih la ve," achi hi. Huchi in la ding in angen a, dangkasik talent nih puansilh kikhenna ding nih toh ip nih ah athun a, asikhate nih aposak a, ama ah apaipihta uhi.
Tang ava tun un alaksak a, insung ah akoih a; huchi in mite apaisakta hi.
Amah alut a, apu ma ah ava dingh hi. Elisha in akiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia, Gehazi?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikha koimah ah ka hoh kei," achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Nang mu dia kangtalai a pan huai mi ahong kum lai in ka lungtang na kiang ah apai kei maw? Sum, puansilhte, olive huante, grephuante, belamte, bawngtalte, sikhapate leh sikhanute lak hun ahi a hia?
Huaiziak in Naaman phak nang ah abelh dia, tangtawn in na suante ah leng abelh ding," achi hi. Huchi in a-omna a pan vuk bang a ngou in phaksa in apaikheta hi.
Huan zawlneite tapate'n Elisha kiang ah, "En in, hiai mun na kiang a ka tenna uh kou a ding in akochik lua hi.
K'on ngen uh. Jordan lui ah ka hohsuk ding ua, huai ah sing ka va la chiat ding ua, ka tenna ding uh huai ah ka va lam ding uh aw?" achi uhi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kuan ve ua,” achi hi.
Mi khat in, "Na sikhate kiang ah hoh sam in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hoh sam leng akei dia," chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in akiang uah ahoh samta hi. Jordan lui atun un sing aphuk uhi.
Mi khat in aphuk san lai in, aheitang tui ah akia hi. Ama'n, "Maizen! Pu, mi a kikhel ei ve," chi in akikou hi.
Pathian mipa in, "Koi lai ah ahia akiak?" achi hi. Ama'n akiakna mun a-ensak hi. Huchi in singhiang khat asat a, huai ah apailut a, sik ahong kilam hi.
Ama'n, "Tawm aw le," achi a; huchi in asawk a, atawmta hi.
Siria kumpipa'n Israelte ahong dou in, huai mun ah giahphual ka sat ding, chi in asikhate thu akum hi.
Pathian mipa'n Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Huchibang mun a hoh lou ding in pilvang in. Huai ah Siriate ahong suk ding uh," chi in mi asawl hi.
Israel kumpipa'n Pathian mipa'n ana hilhna mun mi ava enkhesak zel hi. Huai ah khatvei nihvei phet lou in, ana kihumbit zel hi.
Huchi in huai thu ah Siria kumpipa lungtang amangbanggawp hi. Asikhate asam a, akiang uah, "I lak ua mi akua pen ahia Israel kumpipa lam a pang? N'on hilh kei ding ua hia?" achi hi.
Asikhate lak a mi khat in, "Kuamah pang kei ve ung e, kumpipa, ka toupa aw. Israel gam a om zawlnei Elisha in na dantan sunggil a na gente Israel kumpipa ana hilh zel ahi zaw hi." achi hi.
Ama'n, "Koi a om ahia va simzon un, ka va mansak ding," achi hi, "Ngai in, Dothan ah a-om,” chi in ahilh uhi.
Huchi in sakolte, kangtalaite leh sepaih tampite huai ah asawl a, zan in ava hoh ua, khua a-umkimvel uhi.
Pathian mipa sikha zingkhang in athou a, ava pawtkhiakleh, ngai in, sepaihte'n sakol leh kangtalaite toh khua ana umsuakta uh. Sikha in akiang ah, "Maizen! Pu aw, bang i chihta dia le?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Lau ke'n; amau lam a pangte sang in ei lam a pangte atamzaw hi,” achi hi.

Huchi in Elisha athum a, "TOUPA, amuhtheihna ding in amit vaksak in," achi hi. TOUPA'N huai tangval mit avaksak a; huchi in amu samta a; ngai in, Elisha kimvel a mualte mei kangtalai leh sakol in adim vekta hi.
Amah lam a ahong paisuk uleh TOUPA kiang ah Elisha athum a, "Hiai mite mit tawsak in," achi hi. Huchi in Elisha thu bang in amit uh atawsakta hi.
Elisha in akiang uah, "Hiai lampi ahi kei, hiai leng khua ahi sam kei. Kei hon zui un, na mizonpa uh kiang ah ka hon pi ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Samaria ah apita hi.

Samaria khosung atun un hichi ahong hi a, Elisha in, "TOUPA, hiaite'n amuhtheihna ding un amit uh vaksak in," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N amit uh avaksak a, amuta ua; ngai in, Samaria khosung ah ana omta uhi.
Israel kumpipa'n amaute amuh in Elisha kiang ah, "Ka pa aw, ka that diam? Ka that diam?" achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "That ke'n, na namsau leh na thalpeu in na salmatte na that dia hia? Tanghou leh tui ama uah lui inla, ne in dawn uhenla, apu uh kiang ah paikik nawn uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in nek ding thupi mahmah abawlsak a; anek ua adawn khit un apaisak vek ua, apu uh kiang lam ah apai nawn uh. Huchi in Siria pawlte Israel gam ah ahong nawnta kei uhi.
Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad in asepaih tengteng akaikhawm a, Samaria khua ava um hi.
Samaria ah kial anasa mahmah a, ngai in, sabiltung lutang dangka sawmgiat a akhot uh leh begap kab mun li a khen mun khat dangka nga a lei ahih tan hial un, khua a-um bikbek hi.
Israel kumpipa kulh dawn a apai lai in numei khat in, "Aw kumpipa, ka toupa, hon huh in," chi in ana sam hi.
Ama'n, "TOUPA'N ahon panpih ngal keileh ke'n koi a pan in ahia ka hon panpih ding? Buhphual ahihkeileh grep sukna khuk a pan in maw?"
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang na chi a ahia awi?" achi nawn hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Hiai numei in ka kiang ah, tuni in na tapa i nek ding in hon thoh ve, zingchiang in ka tapa i ne na kei dia," achi hi.
Huchi in ka tapa ka huan ua, ka ne uh. Azing in ke'n akiang ah, "Na tapa i nek ding in hon thoh sam in, ka chi hi. Ama'n atapa aselgu maimah hi,” achi hi.
Kumpipa'n numei thugen azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a; kulh dawn a apai lai ahi a; mipite'n a-et uleh, ngai in, asa tung ah sai-ip puan ana silh nilouh hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Tuni a Shaphat tapa Elisha in alutang apuak lai peuhmah leh Pathian in alohloh in hon loh mai hen, huai sang a leng thupizaw in," achi hi.

Elisha a-inn ah atu a, upate leng akiang ah atu sam uh. Kumpipa'n akiang ah mi khat asawl a, himahleh amisawl akiang atun ma in upate kiang ah, "Hiai tualthatpa tapa in ka lu la ding in mi ahon sawl, chih na thei na uhia? Pau kei dih ua, amisawl ahong tun chiang in, kong na khak unla, kongkhak in na dal bikbek un. Anung ah apu kalsuan ging akiza kei maw?" achi hi.
Huchi a amau ahoupih san lai in, ngai in, amisawl ahong tungsuk hi. Ngai in, kumpipa'n, "Hiai thil hoih lou TOUPA hon sawl ahi; bang ding in TOUPA ka hungaih lailai dia? chi ahi," achi hi.

Elisha in, "TOUPA thu na za un. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Zingchiang hiai hun ding vel in Samaria kulh kongpi bul ah tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat in akhawng ding ua, barli buh tehna nih shekel khat in," chi in agen hi.

Heutu khat kumpipa'n akhut angaknapa'n Pathian mipa adawng hi. "Ngai in, TOUPA'N van ah tohlette bawl leh leng hiai bang ahi thei mahmah dia hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Ngai in, na mit in na mu dia, himahleh na ne kei ding," achi hi.
Huai lai in kulh lutna kongpi bul ah phak li a-om uhi. Amau, "Bangziak a sih ngak lel a tu nilouh i hi ua?

Khopi sung ah lut ni, chi leng, khopi sung kial a, huai a va si mai ding hang a; hiai ah tu nilouh lehang lah si thouthou ding hang a; huaiziak in tu in pai ni in Siria sepaihte kiang ah i va lut peuhmah ding uh. Ahon na hinghawi uh leh i hing dia; ahon na thah uleh si i himai ke," chi in akihou uhi,
Huchi in Siriate giahphual a hoh ding in khomui in akuan uhi. Siriate giahphual tuah masak ava tun un, ngai in, kuamah ana om kei uhi.

TOUPA'N Siria sepaihte kangtalaite husa, sakolte husa leh sepaih tampi husa ana zasak hi. Huchi in "Ngai un, Israel kumpipa'n Hit kumpipate leh Aigupta kumpipate ei hong dou dia guai ei ve,” chi in akihou uhi.
Huchi in athou ua, khomui in ataikekta uh. Apuaninte uh, asakolte uh, asabiltungte uh leh agiahphual uh a-om ngeingei in ataisan ua, ataikekta uhi.

Huai mi phakte giahphual tuah masak ava tun un puanin khat ah alut ua, ne in adawn uh. Dangkasik, dangka-eng leh puansilhte ala ua, asel ua; anungkik nawn ua, puanin dang ah alut nawn ua, huai leng ala ua, asel uhi.

"Aden chiang in, i hihdik het kei. Tuni tanchin kipahhuai tun ni ahi a, ei i daih dide ua; khovak i ngak uleh gawtna i tuak ding uh. Huaiziak in kisa ni, kumpipa inkote i va hilh ding uh," chỉ in akihou uhi.

Huchi in khopi kongkhak vengmi ava sam ua, "Siriate giahphual ah ka va hoh ua, ngai in, kuamah ana om kei ua, mihing husa himhim leng a-om kei, sakolte leh sabiltungte kia ana kikhih a, puaninte leng a-om ngeingei in ana om uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
Kongkhak veng mite asam a; amau kumpipa insung a mite ava hilh uh.

Zan in kumpipa athou a, asikhate kiang ah, "Siriate hon bawldan ka hon hilh ding. I gilkialdan uh athei uh. Huaiziak in khopi a pan ahong pawt uleh ahing in i na man ding ua, khosung ah i lut ding uh, chi in gamlak a kibu dia agiahphual uh pawtkhiaksan ahi uh," achi hi.

Asikhate lak a khat in adawng a, "Khopi a omsun sakol nga va pisak inla, ngai in, Israel mipi adam lai tengteng Israel mipite si bang a sehte ahi himhim uhi; huchi in amaute sawl in enkhe ni," achi hi.
Huchi in kangtalai kai sakol nih api ua; kumpipa'n, "Va en dih ua," chi in Siria sepaihte delh ding in asawl hi.
Jordan lui pha in ava delh ua; ngai in, Siriate'n akin ziak ua apaih uh puansilhte leh vante, lamtawn in a-om zelzul hi. Huchi in amisawlte ahong kik nawn ua, kumpipa ahong hilh uhi.
Huchi in mipi apawtkhia ua, Siriate giahphual ava lok uhi. Huchi in TOUPA thu bang ngei in tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat in akhong ua, barli buh tehna nih shekel khat mah in.
Kumpipa'n sepaih heutu, akhut angaknapa kulh kongpi vengmi in asep hi. Mipite'n akulh kongpi bul ah achil uhi, Pathian mipa'n akiang a kumpipa ahong paisuk lai a, ana gen bang in asita hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian mipa'n kumpipa kiang a, Zingchiang hichih hun ding vel in Samaria kulh kongpi bul ah, "Barli buh tehna nih shekel khat in akhong ding ua, tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat mah in," achih a;

sepaih heutu in Pathian mipa adawng a, "Ngai in, TOUPA'N van ah tohlette bawlleh leng, huchibang ahi thei dia hia?" achih a, ama'n, "Ngai in, na mit in na mu ngei dia, himahleh na ne kei ding," achih bang in;
huchibang in atung ah ahong tungta hi; mipi'n kulh kongpi bul a achil ziak un asita hi.

Huan Elisha in atapa ahihdamsak numei kiang ah, “Thou inla, nang leh na inkote na omtheihna munmun uah va kialtai tadih un. TOUPA'N lah kial akesak ngal a, hiai gam ah kum sagih sung kial ake ding," achi hi.
Huchi in numei athou a, Pathian mipa thugen bang in ahih a; a-inkote toh Philistiate gam ah kum sagih ava kialtai uhi.
Kum sagih ahong kivei nung in hichi ahong hi a, huai numei Philistiate gam a pan akik nawn a; a-inn leh alou ngen ding in kumpipa azuan hi.
Kumpipa'n Pathian mipa sikha Gehazi ahoupih a, "Elisha in thil thupi ahih tengteng hon hilh dih ve," achi hi.

Asisa mi khat ahinsak nawn thu kumpipa ana hilh laitak in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, atapa ahinsak nawn numei in a-inn leh alou kumpipa kiang ah ahong ngen hi. Gehazi in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, hiai numei ahi, hiai ahi atapa, Elisha in ahinsak nawn,” achi hi.
Kumpipa'n numei adotleh ahilh hi. Huchi in kumpipa'n heutu khat asehsak a, "Amah a tengteng, alou a thil piang tengteng tan in, hiai gam apawtkhiaksan a pan tuni tan ateng pe nawn vek un,” achi hi.
Damaskas ah Elisha ahoh a; Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad achi ana hi. "Pathian mipa hiai ah ahong ve," chi in ahilh uh.
Kumpipa'n Hazael kiang ah, "Thilpiak tawi inla, Pathian mipa houpih ding in va hoh inla, ka chinatna a pan ka hoihkhe nawn thei diam, TOUPA hon na dotsakleh," achi hi.

Amah houpih ding in Hazael akuan a, thilpiak ding Damaskas a thil hoih chiteng, sangawngsau sawmli puak khop atawi a, ama ah ava dingh a, "Na tapa Ben-hadad, Siria kumpipa in, ka chinatna a pan ka hoihkhe nawn diam chi ding in na kiang ah kei ahon sawl hi,” achi hi.
Elisha in akiang ah, "Pai nawn inla, akiang ah, na hoihkhe nawn na mah ke, achi ve, va chi in. Himahleh ataktak in bel asi ngeingei ding chih, TOUPA'N ahon theisak hi," achi hi.
Huchi in amah a dia zumhuai khop in Elisha in a-ensal gegu a; huchi in Pathian mipa akapta hi.

Hazael in, "Bangziak a ka toupa kap ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Israel suante tung a na thil hoih lou hih ding ka theih ziak in ahi. Akulhte uh na hal dia, atangvalte uh namsau in na that dia, atanu neu chikchikte na paizan dia, naupai lai anumeite uh na pikkek ding," achi hi.
Hazael in, "Kei na sikha ui leltak in hiai thil thupi hihthei ding ka hi mahmah a hia?" achi hi. Elisha in adawng a, "Siriate tung ah na hong lal ding chih TOUPA'N ahon theisak hi " achi hi.
Huchi in Elisha kiang a pan apawt a, apu kiang ah apaita hi. Ama'n, “Elisha in bang hon na hilh a?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na hoihkhe nawn na tham ding, chi in ahon hilh," achi hi.
Azing in hichi ahong hi a, puansahpi khat ala a, tui ah adiah a, amai akhuhsak a, huchi in asita a; asik in Hazael alalta hi.
Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Joram kum nga alal kum in huai lai in Jehoshaphat bel Judah kumpipa ahi, Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehoram alal pan hi.
Alal pat lai in kum sawmthum-le-nih a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
Ahab inkote bang in, Israel kumpipate lampi tot atawn a; Ahab tanu zi in anei hi. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihloupi ahih hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N asikha David ziak in Judah gam ahihse nuam kei a, asuante tan a khawnvak neihsak gige ana chiam tak ziak in.
Adam lai in Judahte tung ah Edomte ahel ua, atung ua kumpipa ding akibawltawm uhi.
Huchi in Zair ah kangtalai tengteng toh Joram ahoh hi. Zan in akisakhia a, amau um Edomte leh akangtalai tung ua heutute ava sualta hi. Huchi in mite apuaninte uah atai uhi.
Edomte tuni tan in Judahte tung ah ahel lailai uh. Huai hun mah in Libnah leng ana hel sam uhi.
Jehoram tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah akigelh kei maw?
Huchi in Jehoram api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahaziah alalta hi.
Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Joram lal akum sawm-le-nih kum in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah alal pan hi.
Ahaziah in vai ahawm pat in kum sawmnih-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ahawm hi. Anu min Athaliah ahi a, amah Israel kumpipa Omri tanu ahi.
Ahab inkote lampi tot atawn sam a, Ahab inkote makpapa ahih ziak in, Ahab inkote hih bang in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
Amah Ahab tapa Joram in Ramoth-gilead a Siria kumpipa Hazael ava douna ah apang sam hi. Siriate'n Joram ana hihliam uhi.

Siria kumpipa Hazael adouna uah Siriate'n Ramah ah kumpipa Joram ana hihliam ua, Jezreel a kidamsak ding in akik nawnta hi. Ahab tapa Joram adam louh ziak in, amah veh ding in Jezreel ah Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah ahohsuk hi.
Huan zawlnei Elisha in zawlneite tapate lak a khat asam a, akiang ah, "Na puan teng inla, hiai sathau bawm tawi inla, Ramoth-gilead ah va hoh in.
Na va tun chiang in Nimshi tapa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu va zongkhia inla; va lut inla, a-unaute lak a pan samkhia inla, dantan sunggil ah lutpih in.
Huchi in sathau bawm la inla, alu ah sung inla, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in sathau ka hon nilh hi," chi in. "Huchi in kong hong inla, taikhia in, om sawt ke'n,” achi hi.
Huchi in tangval, zawlnei tangvalpa Ramoth-gilead ah ahohta hi.

Ava tunleh ngai in, sepaih heutute atukhawm ua; ama'n, "Sepaih heutu, na kiang a gen ding thukhah ka nei," achi hi. Jehu in, "Kua pen kiang ah eita?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Nang kiang ah, sepaih heutupa," achi hi,
Athou a, inn ah alut a; alu ah sathau asung a, akiang ah, "ToUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: TOUPA mipite, Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in thau ka hon nilh hi.
Ka sikha zawlneite sisan leh TOUPA sikha tengteng sisan phu Jezebel tung a ka laktheihna ding in na pu Ahab inkote na that ding hi.
Ahab inko tengteng amangthang vek ding uh. Ahab a pan pasal taphot Israel gam a zalen hi in sikha hitaleh ka hihmang ding hi.
Ahab inkote Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote leh Ahijah tapa Baasha inkote bang in ka bawl ding hi.
Uite'n Jezreel khokulh zul ah Jezebel ane ding ua, amah vui ding mi a-om kei ding, chi in," achi hi. Huchi in kong ahong a, ataikheta hi.

Huchi in Jehu bel atoupa sikhate kiang ah ahong pawt a; khat in akiang ah, "Hoih lam thu hia? Huai mihaipa koi a pan na kiang a hong ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Huai mi na thei ua; athugen leng na thei uh," achi hi.
Amau, "Thei maizen dia, tu'n hon hilh in," achi uh. Ama'n, "Hichibang in ahon chi ahi: 'TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in sathau ka hon nilh hi, " achi hi.
Huchi in michih in apuan uh asuah somsom ua, kailawn tung ah aphahsak chiat ua, "Jehu kumpipa ahita," chi in pengkul amutta uhi.
Huchi in Nimshi tapa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu in Joram thahna ding aguksawm hi. Siria kumpipa Hazael ziak in Joram leh Israelte tengteng in Ramoth-gilead khua aveng uhi.

Siria kumpipa Hazael toh kumpipa Joram akidouna ua Siria mite'n asukliam uh, Jezreel a kidamsak ding in akik nawn hi. Huchi in Jehu in, "Kei lam a pang na hih uleh kuamah Jezreel a hiai thu gen ding in khua a pan paikhesak kei un," achi hi.
Huchi in Jehu bel kangtalai ah atuang a, Jezreel ah ahoh a, huai ah Joram alum hi. Judah kumpipa Ahaziah leng Joram veh ding in ahohsuk hi.

Jezreel kulh ah galvilmi adingh a, Jehu pawlte amah toh hong pai amu a, “Mi tampi ka mu,” achi hi. Joram in, "Sakol tungtuangmi amau va dawn ding in sawl inla, hoih lam thu hia? va chi uhen,” achi hi.

Huchi in mi khat sakol tung a tuang amau dawn ding in akuan a, kumpipa'n hichi in achi, “Lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?” achi hi. Jehu in, "Lemna thu toh hong pai leng, nang na theih ding bang a-om a? Ka nung ah pai in," achi hi. Galvilmi'n, "I mi sawl akiang uh ava tung a, himahleh ahong kik nawn het kei mawk a," chi in ahilh hi.

Huchi in mi khat sakol tung a tuang asawl nawn a, huai mi leng akiang uh ava tung a, kumpipa'n hichi in achi, "Lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?" achi hi. Jehu in adawng a, "Lemna thu toh hong pai leng, nang na theih ding bang a-om a? Ka nung ah pai in,” achi hi.
Galvilmi leng akiang uh ava tung a, amah leng ahong kik nawn het kei mawk hi. "Huai kangtalai kihawldan leng Nimshi tapa Jehu hawldan geih ahi; mihai bang mai in ahawl hi," achi hi.

Joram in, "Kimansak un," achi a; kangtalai akimansakta uh. Huchi in Israel kumpipa Joram leh Judah kumpipa Ahaziah amau kangtalai tuaktuak in ava pawtkhia ua, Jehu tuak ding in ataikhia ua, Jezreel mi Naboth huan ah ava mu uhi.
Joram in Jehu amuh in hichi ahong hi a, "Lemna toh hong pai na hia, Jehu?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Na nu Jezebel angkawmna leh bumna atam lai teng bangchi in lemna a-om thei dia?" achi hi.
Joram akihei a, atai a, Ahaziah kiang ah, "Kikhem a kilehbawlna om ei ve, Ahaziah," achi hi.
Jehu in athalpeu atheihtawp in alai a, Joram liang leh liang kikal ah akap a, thaltang in alungtang apailet a, akangtalai sung ah apuklut hi.
Huchi in Jehu in asepaih heutu Bidkar kiang ah, "Dom inla, Jezreel mi Naboth huan ah paikhia in. Tuma lam a nang toh apa Ahab nung a i tuankhawm lai a TOUPA'N hiai puakgik atung ah anga hi.

TOUPA'N zan in Naboth sisan leh atapate sisan ka muh ngei ahi," achi hi. "TOUPA'N, hiai mun ngei ah ka hon thuk ding," achi nawn hi. Huchi in "TOUPA thu bang in dom inla, hiai mun ngei ah paikhia in," achi hi.

Himahleh Judah kumpipa Ahaziah in huai amuh in huan in lampi ah atai hi. Jehu in adelh a, "Amah leng huai kangtalai sung ah that un," achi hi. Huchi in Ibleam kiang, Gur zottouhna ah asatliam uhi. Meggiddo ah atailut a, huai ah asita hi.
Amite'n Jerusalem ah kangtalai in apaipih ua, amah han ah, api-le- pute lak ah David khopi ah avui uhi.
Ahab tapa Joram kum sawm- le-khat alal kum in Judahte tung ah Ahaziah alal pan hi.
Jezreel ah Jehu ava lut chih Jezebel in ana za hi. Huchi in amitte anuh a, asam azem a, tohlet ah ana dakkhia hi.
Jehu kulh kongpi a, ahong lut laitak in, "Na pu thatpa nang Zimri, lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?" ana chi hi.
Tohlet lam nga in amah adaktou a, "Kei lam a pang kuakua na om ua? Kua?" achi hi. Michilgeh nih hiam, thum hiam amah lam nga in ahong dakkhia uhi.
Ama'n, "Hon lawnkhia un," achi hi. Huchi in alawnkhia ua; asi khenkhat in baang leh sakolte atheh nengnung a; ama'n lei ah akhe in ana chil hi.
Huchi in alut a, ne in adawn a, "Hamse thuaknu va dom unla, va vui un, kumpipa tanu lah ahi ngal a." achi hi.
Vui ding in akuan ua; himahleh aluguh, akhebomte leh akhutpek bomte kia lou ngal amu kei uh.
Huchi in ahong pai nawn in ahong hilh uh. Ama'n, "Hiai TOUPA'N asikha Tishbi mi Elijah zang a, Jezreel kulhchin ah uite'n Jezebel ane ding ua;
Jezebel luang Jezreel khokulh chin a huan a ekchim bang ahi dia, huchi a, hiai Jezebel ei ve, achihlouhna ding un, chi a agen ahi," achi hi.
Simon Peter, Jesu Khrist sikha leh sawltak in, i Pathian leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist diktatna ziak a ginna manphatak i tan bang tang samte kiang ah:
Pathian leh Jesu i Toupa theihna ah hehpihna leh khamuanna noute ah hihkhan in om hen.
Ama thupina leh hoihna ziak a hon sampa, atanchin theih ziak in ama Pathianna thilhihtheihna in hinna leh Pathian limsakna lam thu ah thil tengteng ahon peta hi.

Huaite ziak in athuchiam manphatak leh thupi mahmahte ahon pia hi; huchi in utna ziak a khovel a siatna hong om taikhiaksan in; huai thuchiam manphatak leh thupi mahmahte ziak in Pathian omdan na kikoppih thei sam ding uhi.
Ahi, huaiziak tak in, thanop himhim suah in, na ginna uah hoihna hel unla, na hoihna uah theihna hel unla,
na theihna uah kidekna hel unla, na kidekna uah kuhkalna hel unla, na kuhkalna uah Pathian limsakna hel unla,
na Pathian limsakna uah unaute itna hel unla, na unaute itna ah itna hel un.
Hiai hoihnate nou a ahih a, akhan zelleh i Toupa Jesu Khrist theihna lam ah thadah lou leh gah lou lou in nou ahon bawl ding hi.
Kuapeuh huai thilte nei lou mittaw, naichikte kia mu thei, anidanglai khelhnate siansakna mangngilhte ahi uhi.
Huaiziak in unaute aw, nou ahon sapna leh ahon telna hihkip ding in thanop suah semsem un; huaite na hih uleh chik lai mah in na puk kei ding uhi.
Huchi in Jesu Khrist i Toupa leh Hondampa'n tangtawn gam a lutna ahon musak lo mahmah ding hi.
Huaiziak in huai thilte nei in na kiang ua om thutak a phuhkip hita mah le uchin, huai thutak mah ka hon theisak nawn ding hi.
Huan hiai pumpi a ka om lai teng noumau hon theihpih in hon tohhalh gige hoih ka sa hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist in hon theihsak bang in ka pumpi puanin koihkhiak hun ding hong tung pah ding chih ka thei hi.
Ahi ka paikhiak nung in huai thilte na theihgigena ding un ka kisuk ding hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist thilhihtheihna leh ahong paina thu ka hon theihsak lai un, tangthu piltak a ngaihtuahkhiak phet zui ka hi kei ua, athupina mute ka hi zaw uhi.
Ama'n Pa Pathian kiang a kipan in pahtawina leh thupina amu a, huchih lai in thupina thupitak a kipan in hichibang aw akiang ahong tung hi, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi," chi in.
Huan tang siangthou a akiang a ka om ziak un huai aw van a kipan a hong suak koumau ngei in ka za uhi.
Huchi in genkholhna thu kip nawn sem i nei uhi. Khua ahong vak a, zingsol aksi na lungtang ua ahong suah masiah hiai thu khawnvak mun mial a vak alimsak bang ua, na limsak uleh na hihhoih ding uhi.
Laisiangthou a thugenkholh himhim eimah kihilhchet ding ahi kei chih thei masa un.
Thugenkholh himhim mihing thu a pawt ahi ngei kei a, mite'n Kha Siangthou sawl in, Pathian a kipan agen zaw uhi.

Himahleh mite lak ah zawlnei takloute leng ahong pawt ua, huchi mah bang in na lak uah heutu takloute ahong om ding uhi, amaute leipa Toupa hilhial tawpsan in mi hihse thei ginna tuam, aguk in ahon lutpih ding ua, amau tung ah thakhat in manthatna atungsak ding uhi.
Mi tampi in azautatna lam thil uh ahon ching ding ua, amaute ziak in lampi dik gensiat ahi ding hi.
Sum deihna ziak in zuauthu in sumsinna ding in nou ahon zang ding uh, himahleh nidanglai a omsa amohtanna ding uh akhawl kei a, amanthatna uh leng a-ihmu kei hi.
Angelte'n thil ahihkhelh un Pathian in ahawi kei a, gawtmun ah apai a, vaihawm ding in phaizang khuk thuk mial ah akhum hi.
Amah limsakloute omna khovel ah tuichim tungsak in, nidanglai khovel ahawi kei a, himahleh Noah, diktatna thugenpa midang sagih toh ahondamta hi.
Sodom leh Gomorrah khuate amah limsak lou hong om dingte etsakna ding in azang a, vut suaksak in hihmangthang in siam louh atangsakta hi;
huan midiktat Lot, migiloute omdan huktak ziak a lungkham mahmah pa ahondamta hi.
Huai midiktatpa alak ua a-om in, amit in amu a, abil in aza a, dan lou bang a athilhihte un alungsim diktat niteng in ahih na mahmah hi.
Toupa'n amah limsak mite khemna a pan hotkhiakdan leh diktatloute vaihawm ni a ding a gawt kawm a hawidan athei hi.
Utna thanghuai lam a sa bang a om leh vai hawmsakna musit mite ngial houh vaihawm ni a ding a gawt kawm a hawidan atheisem hi. Haihan leh chihhak ahi ua, amithupite agensiat un leng aling kei uhi.
Angel hatna leh thilhihtheihna neite'n amaute dem in Toupa ma ah agense ngei kei uhi.
Himahleh hiaite'n bel ganhing ngaihtuahna nei lou, mat a hihman dingte bang in, thil atheihlouhte uh agensia uhi.
Amau diktatlouhna gah lou in asegawp ding ua, suntang lai a zu leh sa kham a buai nuamsami ahi uh. Na kiang ua ankuang alui un, amau kikhemna ankuanglui ahih ziak un, thanghuaina gensiatna ahi uhi.
Mit angkawmna a dim, khelhna tawpsan theiloute anei ua; mikiploute akhempuk ua; en hat lungsim apu ua; hamsethuak tate ahi uhi.
Beor tapa Balaam, thilhihkhelhna, loh deihpa lampi atot ziak un lam dik paisan in avakmang uhi.
Himahleh amah atatlekna ziak in taihilh in a-omta a; sabiltung pau thei lou mihing pau in ahong pau a, zawlnei haina akham hi.
Hiaite tuikhuk tui om lou leh tuimei huihpi mutleng ahi ua; amaute a ding in nuailam mial sah meuhmouh sit ahita hi.
Thugina lou chiak zen a gen in gitlouhna lak a kipan a taikhete, taksa utna ah hukna in akhempuk nak uhi.
Amau siatna sikha hi kawmpi in mite sikha suahtakna thu achiam nak uhi; mite'n zohsa achihte mah in amau sikha in abawl nak hi.
Toupa leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist atheih ziak ua khovel thanghuainate ataikhiaksan nung ua, huai mah a apuk nawn ua, zoh a a-om nawn ualeh zaw, amasa sang in a-omdan nanung uh ahong hoih keizaw hi.
Diktatna lampi pen theih nung a, thupiak siangthou akiang ua kepsak nungngatsan sang in, diktatna lampi thei lou hi le uh amau a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
"Ui ama luak ah akik nawn a, vokpi kisilsiangsa leng buannawi ah kisil ding in akik nawn chih paunak diktak amaute tung ah atungta hi.”
Deihtakte aw, tua na kiang ua ka gelh laikhak nihna ahi. Hiaite gel ah theih thak nawnna in na lungsim siang uh ka tokthou hi.
Zawlnei siangthoute thugenkholh leh na sawltakte uh kam a Toupa leh Hondampa thupiak na theihgigena ding un.
Hiai thei masa un, ni nanungte ah, misimmoh hatte amau utna bang a om in, simmoh kawm in ahong pai ding uhi.
Ahong pai nawnna thuchiam koi ah? Siam tung a kipan bangkim a-om ngeingei bang in pi-le-pute ihmut ni a kipan in a-om zel ngal a! ahon chi ding uhi.
Pathian thu in nidanglai pek in vante ahong om achih akitheihmohbawl ua, tui a kipan leh tui zang a leitung kibawl ahi a,
huai tui mah in atum a, amangthangta hi.
Himahleh tua vante leh lei omte huai thu mah in Pathian limsak lou mite vaihawm leh manthat ni a ding a sit in mei hihsiat ding a kholkhawm ahita hi.
Himahleh deihtakte aw, hiai thu kam khat pen mangngilh kei un, Toupa ngaih in ni khat tuh kum sangkhat bang ahi a, huan kum sangkhat leng ni khat bang ahi, chih.
Mi khenkhat in zekai asak bang un Toupa zaw athuchiam ah azekai kei hi; kuamah manthat deih lou a, mi tengteng hong kisik deih in noumau lam ah adohzou zaw ahi.
Himahleh Toupa ni zaw guta bang in ahong tung ding; huai ni chiang in nakpitak a ging in vante amangthang ding, thilbulte mei a haitui in a-om ding a, lei leh asung a nasep omte, akangtum ding hi.
Huai thilte huchibang a mangthang vek ding uh ahi chih na theih un, omdan siangthou leh Pathian limsakna lam ah mi bangchibang hi ding na hi ua.
Pathian' Ni ahong tun baihna ding lamen leh phatuamngaitak a ngak in; huai ni atun ziak in vante hong kang in amangthang dia, thilbulte leng mei a haltui in a-omta ding hi.
Himahleh athuchiam bang in van thak leh lei thak, asung a diktatna omte i lamen hi.
Huaiziak in deihtakte aw, huai bang thilte na lamet ziak un nin baang lou leh gensiatbei in, khamuangtak a na om uh ahon muhtheihna ding in thanop suah un.
Huan i unaupa deihtak Paul in leng akiang a pilna piak bang zel a na kiang ua agelh bang in Toupa dohzohna hotdamna in sim un.

Alaikhak tengteng ah huai thute gen in, huai mah bang in agelh hi. Huai ah thu theihhak thu thukte a-om a, huaite mipil lou leh mikiploute'n Laisiangthou dang angaihkawi bang un angaikawi ua, amau leh amau siatna ding in azang uhi.
Huchi in deihtakte aw, noute'n tua thute na theihkholh ziak un pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw migiloute diklouhna a pimang a om in, na kipna ua kipan na pukkha ding uhi.
Himahleh i Toupa leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist hehpihna leh theihna ah hong khang un. Tu leh tangtawn in amah kiang ah thupina om hen, Amen.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul sih nung in Amalekte zou khin David ahong kik nawn a, Ziklag ah David ni nih a-om hi.
Hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni in, ngai in, mi khat Saul panmun a kipan apuante bohkeksa leh alu a lei kai niaunuau in ahong pai hi.
David kiang ahong tun in lei a bokkhup in zahtakna apia hi. David in akiang ah, "Koi a pan hong pai na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Israel mite panmun a pan hong taikhia ka hi," achi hi.

David in akiang ah, "Bangchibang in thil a-om a? Hon hilh dih ve," achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kidouna a pan mite ataikek ua, mi tampi puk in asi uh. Saul leh atapa Jonathan leng asi tuaktuak uh," achi hi.
David in amah hilhpa tangval kiang ah, "Bangchi in ahia Saul leh atapa Jonathan asih uh na theih?" achi hi.
Ahilhpa tangval in, "Bangchi chi hiam in Gilboa tang ah ka na om kha zenzen hi. Ngai in, ateipi ngai a Saul dingh ka mu a, kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite'n hon naihta uhi.
Anunglam angatleh ahon mu a, hon sam hi. Ke'n, 'Hiai ah ka om,' chi in ka dawng hi.
Ka kiang ah, 'Kua na hia?' ahon chi hi. Ke'n, Amalek mi ka hi, chi in ka dawng hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, 'Ka kiang ah hong dingh inla hong that mai dih, ka hing lai vanglak a, lungdonna in lah hon manta ngal a,' achi hi.
Akiang ah ka dingh a, huchi a pukgawp khinsa, damzou nawn lou ding chih ka theih ziak in ka thatta mai hi. Alu a lallukhu leh aban a tau ka la a, ka pu kiang ah ka hon tawi hi,” achi hi.
David in apuansilhte abotkekta a, huchi mah bang in akiang a mi om tengteng in leng ahih uhi.
Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh TOUPA mite leh Israel inkuante asuun ua, akah ua, nitaklam tan in an angawl ua, namsau a thah ahih ziakun.
David in amah va hilhtu tangval kiang ah, "Koilam mi na hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Gamdangmi, Amalek mi tapa ka hi," chi in adawng hi. David in akiang ah, "TOUPA thaunilh hihmang dia atung a khut khak bangchidan a lau lou na hia le?" achi hi.
David in tangval khat asam a, "Va naih inla, that in," achi a, ama'n ava sat a, asita hi.
David in akiang ah, "Na sisan nangmah lutung ah om hen. Nangmah kam ngei in, TOUPA thaunilh ka that ahi, chi a na puan tak man in," achi hi.
David in Saul leh atapa Jonathan hiai kahtam in asuun hi:
Thalkapdan Judah suante sinsak ding in asawl a, ngai in, Jasher laibu ah hiai gelh ahi:
Aw Israel, na kilawmna mun sangte ah athat ua, na mihatte apukta uh.
Gath ah gen kei unla, Ashkelon kongzingte ah puang kei un. Huchi lou in zaw Philistia tanute akipak ding ua, Ezeksum louh tanute avualzou kha ding uhi.
Nou Gilboa tangte aw, na tung uah daitui leh vuah ke kei hen. Thillat dingte leng suah sam ke'n. Huai ah lah mihat lum Saul lum, thaunilh louh mi lum bang mai in giloutak in apaimang uhi.
Thah a omte sisan a pan leh mihat thau a pan Jonathan thal akik nawn kei a, Saul namsau avuak in akik nawn kei hi.
Saul leh Jonathan hindan adeihhuai in akilawm a, asih un leng akikhen kei uh. Mupite sang in ahatzaw ua, humpinelkaite sang in ahatzaw uhi.
Nou Israel tanute aw, Saul kah un, puansan kilawmte na tung uah abaang a, na puan uah dangka-eng a zephoihnate hon koihsakpa ahi.
Kidou laitak a mihatte apuk maizen uh! Aw, Jonathan, na mun sangte ah nang ahon thatta uhi.
Ka unaupa Jonathan, na tungthu ah ka lungzing petmah hi. Ka tung ah na hoih mahmah a, N'on itna alamdang a, numei itna akhup hi.
Mihatte apuk ua, kidouna galvante leng amangthang khinta!
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in Ammon suante kumpipa asi a, atapa Hanun in amun ah vai ahawm hi.

David in, "Apa'n hon na hehpih bang in ke'n leng Nahash tapa Hanun ka hehpih sam ding," achi hi. Huchi in David in apa tungtang thu a lungmuan ding in amah mite asawl a, huchi in David mite Ammon suante gam ava tung uhi.

Himahleh Ammon suante makaite'n atoupa uh Hanun kiang ah, "David in na pa azahtak ziak a na kiang a lungmuanmi hon sawl hi in na um a hia? David in na mite khuate ahong hihsiatna dia zongkhe ding leh enkhe dia hon sawl ahi kei a hia?" achi uhi.
Huchi in Hanun in David mite aman a, akhamul langkhat uh ametsak a, apuansilhte uh alaitak ah ataw uh phazou lel in atansak a, asawlkheta hi.
David ahilhtak un, amau dawn ding mi asawl hi; amau lah azum mahmah ngal ua. Kumpipa'n, "Na khamul uh asau nawn ma in Jeriko ah om tadih unla, huai nung in hong paikik un," achi hi.

Ammon suante'n David huat lam ana hihta uh, chih atheih un, Ammon suante'n Beth-rehob a Siriate leh Zobah a Siriate sepaih singnih leh kumpipa Maka mi sangkhat, Tob mite singkhat-le-sangnih toh thukhak in aguai uhi.
David in huai azak in Joab leh sepaih hangsan tengteng asawl hi.
Ammon suante ahong kuan ua, kholutna kongkhak lam ah panmun akhoh uh. Zobah a mite leh Rehob a Siriate leh Tob leh Maakahte bel atuam in loubuk ah a-om uhi.
Huchi in amalam uh leh anunglam uah ahon sual ding uh chih Joab in atheih in, Israel mite lak a mihoih tata atelkhia a, Siria mite sual ding in panmun ana khoh hi.
Midang tengteng a-unaupa Abishai khut ah akoih vek a, Ammon suante sual ding in panmun akhoh hi.
"Siria mite ka zoh kei dingleh, nang na hon huh dia, Ammon suante na zoh kei dingleh ke'n ka hon huh ding hi.
Hangtak in om unla, i mite leh i Pathian khua hum in i kipasalsak ding uh. TOUPA'N hoih asak bangbang in hih hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Joab leh akiang a mite'n Siria mite sual ding in kidouna mun anaih ua; ama uah ataikek uhi.
Ammon suante'n Siria mite ataikek uh chih atheih un amau leng Abishai ma ah ataikek samta ua, khosung ah alut uhi. Joab in Ammon suante akiksan a, Jerusalem ah apaita hi.
Siria mite'n Israelte ma ah thah in a-om uh chih akitheih un akikaikhawm uhi.
Hadadezer in mi asawl a, Lui khen lam a Siria mite apikhia a, Hadadezer sepaih heutu Shobak in ma kai in lehlam ah ahong pai uhi.
Huai David ahilh ua, ama'n Israel mi tengteng asamkhawm a, Jordan lui kan in Helam ah apai uhi. David dou ding in Siria mite'n panmun khoh in ahong dou uhi.
Israelte ma ah Siria mite ataikek ua, David in Siria mi kangtalai zasagih tung a tuang leh sakol tungtuangmi singli athat a, asepaih heutu uh Shobak leng athat a, huai ah asita hi.

Huchi in Hadadezer sikha a om kumpipa tengteng in Israelte ma ah tamtak thah ahi uh chih atheih un, Israelte toh kilemna abawl ua, asikha un a-omta uh. Huchi in Siria mite'n Ammon suante apanpih ngam nawn kei uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum ahong kivei a, kumpipate galdou dia akuankhiak lai un, David in Joab leh asikhate tengteng asawl a, Ammon suante ahihmang ua, Rabbah khua a-umkhum uhi. Himahleh David bel Jerusalem ah a-om nilouh hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam ninem in alupna a pan David athoukhia a, kumpipa' inn tung ah akahtou hi. Inn tung a pan numei khat kisil lai amu hi. Huai numei bel melhoihtak ahi.
David in huai numei tanchin dongtel ding in mi asawl hi. Huai mi in, “Eliam tanu, Bathsheba, Hit mi Uriah zi ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
David in thupote asawl a, ava pita uh. Akiang ahong tung a, ana kithuahpihta hi. Asianlouhna a pan siansak khit ahita hi, huchi in a-inn ah paikikta hi.
Huchi in numei ahong gaita a, "Nau ka paita," chi in David atheisak hi.
David in Joab kiang ah, "Hit mi Uriah ka kiang ah hon sawl in," chi in athukhak hi. Joab in David kiang ah Uriah asawlta hi.
Uriah akiang atun in David in, "Joab leh mite bang achi ua, kidouna ah bang achi ua?" chi in adong hi.
David in Uriah kiang ah, “Na inn ah pai inla, na khete va sil in," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa' inn a pan Uriah apawtkhia a, kumpipa'n an nek ding thawnpiak azuisak hi.
Himahleh atoupa sikha tengteng lak a kumpipa' inn kongkhak bul ah Uriah agiak a, a-inn ah apai kei hi.
"A-inn ah Uriah apai kei," chi a David ahilhtak un, David in Uriah kiang ah, "Khualzin hong tung hilou na hi maw? Bangziak a na inn a pai lou na hia?" achi hi.

Uriah in David kiang ah, "Pathian bawm, Israelte leh Judahte aidakbuk a om gige ua, ka toupa Joab leh ka toupa sikhate gamlak ah akikulh uh. Kei ka inn a pai in ka ne in ka ta in, ka zi kiang ah ka lum ding maw? Na hinna leh na kha ahin bang in ka gen ahi, huai zaw ka hih kei ding," achi hi.
David in Uriah kiang ah, "Tuni leng hiai ah om lai inla, zingchiang in na pai na ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Uriah huai ni leh azingchiang leng Jerusalem ah a-omta hi.
David in amah asam a, ama ah ne in adawn hi. Adawn khamsak hi. Nitaklam in a-inn a pai lou in atoupa sikhate lak ah agiak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingchiang in David in Joab lai akhak a, Uriah aposak hi.
Huai laikhak ah, "Gal khawkna pen ah Uriah ma phusak inla, athah ua asihna ding in kikhinsan un,” chi in agelh hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Joab in khua a-um lai in, mihangsante omna hi a atheihna ah Uriah apangsak hi.
Khua a mite apawtkhia ua, Joab asual ua, David sikhate khenkhat asi ua, Hit mi Uriah leng asi hi.
Huchi in Joab in mi asawl a, kidou tungtang thil tengteng David ahilhsak hi.
Amisawl kiang ah, Kumpipa kiang a kidou tanchin tengteng na gen khit in,
ahong heh guih a, "Bangziak a dou dia huchibang a khobul chin a hoh na hi ua? Kulh a pan a hon kap ding uh chih thei lou na hi uh maw?

Jerubeseth tapa Abimelek that kua ahia? Buh gawizanna suang tungnungpen numei in kulhbaang tung a pan atung ah akhesuk a, Thebez a si ahi kei maw? Bangziak a hichibang a kulh kiangchin a pai na hi ua?" achihleh, “Na sikha Hit mi Uriah leng si ei ve, na chi ding uh," chỉ in thu apia hi.
Huchi in amisawl akuanta a, ava tung a, Joab in asawlsan tengteng David ahilh hi.
Amisawl in David kiang ah, "Mite'n ahon na zou ua, loubuk ah hon sual ua, kou akho lutna kongkhak tanpha in ka nohkik uhi.
"Thalkap mite'n kulh a pan na sikhate ahon kap ua, huchi in kumpipa sikha khenkhatte asi ua, na sikha Hit mi Uriah leng asi," achi hi.

Huchi in David in misawl kiang ah, Joab kiang ah huchi in va gen in, "Hiaite'n na lungsim kipaklousak kei hen. Namsau in kuamah akhentuam ngal kei a, naksem in khua sual unla hihsia un, chi in hanthawn in," achi hi.
Uriah zi in apasal Uriah asi chih azak in apasal asuun hi.
Asuun hun abei nung in David in a-inn ah api a, azi ahong hita a, tapa khat aneihsak hi. Himahleh David thilhih in TOUPA akipaksak kei hi.
Huan TOUPA'N David kiang ah Nathan asawl hi. Akiang ah ava hoh a, hichi in achi, "Khua khat ah mi nih a-om ua; khat pen mihausa ahi a, khat pen mizawng ahi.
Mihausa in belamhon tampi leh ganhon tampi anei hi.

Mizawng in bel belamnou anu neuchik khat lei a, avulh kia lou ngal bangmah dang anei kei hi. Amah leh atate toh khangliankhawm in akuang sawkpih leh anou kikoppih, a-angsung a om, atanu bang geih a angaihtuah ahi.
Mihausa kiang ah khualzinmi khat ava tung hi. Akiang a mikhual tung ama belam leh gan goh ding phal lou in mizawngpa belamnou leh ganhon a pan agohsak zawta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in huai mi tung ah David aheh mahmah a, Nathan kiang ah, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, huai thilhihmi asih ngeingei ding ahi.
Hichibang thil ahih ziak leh hehpihna aneih louh ziak in abelamnou amun li a adit ding ahi," achi hi.
Nathan in David kiang ah, "Huai mipa nangmah na hi. TOUPA, Israelte’ Pathian in hichi in achi: Israelte kumpipa ding in thau ka hon nilh a, Saul khut a pan ka hon hunkhia hi.
Na pu in ka hon luahsak a, na pu zite na angsung ah ka koih hi. Israel leh Judah inkote ka hon pia a; huaite atawm luat uleh thil dangte leng hon piakbeh lai ding ka hi.
Bangziak a TOUPA thupiak ngaineu a, amitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih maizen? Hit mi Uriah namsau in na that a, azi na zi ding in na neihsak a, Ammon suante namsau in amah na that hi.
Huaiziak in namsau in na insung anuse ngei nawn kei ding. Kei hon ngaineu a, Hit mi Uriah zi na zi dia na lak ziak in.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, nangmah inkote mah nang kalh ding thil hoih lou ka tungkhe dia, na mitmuh mahmah in na zite ka hon laksak dia, na inveng ka pe dia, ama'n hiai sun khovak in na zite akithuahpih ding.
Nang aguk in na hih a, ke'n Israel mite tengteng mitmuh in sun khovak in ka hih ding," achi hi.
David in Nathan kiang ah, "TOUPA tung ah ka khialta," achi hi. Nathan in David kiang ah, "TOUPA'N leng na khelhna akoihmangta. Na si kei ding.
Himahleh hiai na thilhih a Pathian gensiatna dia hun lemtang thupitak TOUPA melmate na piak ziak in nang a pan hong piang ding naupang asi ngeingei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Nathan in a-inn ah apaisanta hi. Uriah zi in David asuansak naupang tung ah TOUPA'N akhut kha in, achi ana mahmahta hi.
Huaiziak in David in naupang a ding in Pathian kiang ah angen ngutngut a, an angawl a, alut a, zankhua in lei ah alum hi.
A-inkote lak a upate athou ua, lei a pan kaithou ding in akiang ah adingh uhi. Himahleh athou nuam kei a, akiang uah leng ane sam kei.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in naupang asita hi. David sikhate'n naupang asita chih ahilh ngam kei uh, "Ngai in, naupang adam lai in akiang ah thu i gen ua, angaikhe nuam kei a. Naupang asita chih bangchi in i hilh ngamta ding ua? Bangchi hiam in thil hoih lou akihih kha ding," achi uhi.
Himahleh David in asikhate kisimhou amuh in naupang asita chih atheita hi. David in asikhate kiang ah, "Naupang sita hia?" achi a, amau, "Asita,” achi uh.
Huchi in David lei a pan athou a, akisil a, sathau akinilh a, apuante akheng a; TOUPA' inn ah ahoh a, Pathian abia hi. A-inn ah apai nawn a, an akan a, ama ah alui ua, aneta hi.
Huchi in asikhate'n akiang ah, "Na thilhih bangchidan ahia? Naupang adam lai in an na ngawl a, na kap a, himahleh naupang asihtak in na thou a, an na ne a," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Naupang adam lai in an ngawl in ka kap hi. Naupang adamna ding in TOUPA'N hon hehpih khamoh kei ding chih kua ahia thei? Ka chi hi.
Himahleh tu in asita ngal a, bang ding in an ka ngawl dia? Ka pikik nawn thei dia hia? Akiang ah ka pai dia, himahleh amah ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David in azi Bathsheba alungmuan a, akiang ah alut a, akithuahpih a, tapa asuang a, amin Solomon asa hi. TOUPA'N amah a-it hi.
Huchi in zawlnei Nathan athukhak a, ama'n TOUPA ziak in amin Jedidiah asa hi.
Huchi in Joab in Ammon suante khopi Rabbah sim in alata hi.
Joab in David kiang ah mi asawl a, "Rabbah ka sim a, tuite khopi ka lata hi.
Tu in mi om lai teng kaikhawm inla, khopi sual tum in zuan inla, la in. Ke'n khopi la leng ka min apu kha ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David in mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Rabbah ah ahoh ua, ava sim ua, alata uhi.
Akumpipa uh lallukhu khuk lai alaksak a, agikdan dangka-eng talent khat ahi a, suangmantamte leng atel hi. David akhusak ua, khopi ah gallak tampi ala uhi.

Huchi in asung a om mipite apikheta a, sing-atnate, leilehna sikzumte leh sik heipite zang in nna asemsak hi. Lei haltakte abawlsak a; Ammon suante khopi tengteng ah huchibang in ahih hi. Huchi in David leh mi tengteng Jerusalem ah apaikik nawnta uhi.
Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David tapa Absalom in sanggam numei melhoih khat anei a, amin Tamar ahi. David tapa Amnon in amah a-it hi.
Huchi in asanggamnu Tamar ziak in Amnon abuai mahmah a; achi ana hi. Amah lah nungak siangthou ahih ziak in atung a thil banghiam hih haksapi ahi chi in Amnon in angaihtuah hi.
Himahleh Amnon in lawm anei a, amin Jonadab ahi. Amah David unaupa Shimea tapa ahi. Jonadab migitlouhpil mahmah mi khat ahi.

Ama'n Amnon kiang ah, "Aw, nang kumpipa tapa bangchidan ahia, aniteng a na gawn hulhul mawk? Hon hilh lou ding maw?" achi hi. Amnon in akiang ah, "Ka unaupa Absalom sanggamnu Tamar ka it a ahi," achi hi.

Jonadab in akiang ah, "Na lupna ah lumlum inla, kichinasak in. Na pa'n ahong veh chiang in akiang ah, Hehpih in ka sanggamnu Tamar ka kiang ah hong hoh henla, tanghou nek ding hong pia hen. Ka muh theih in ka mitmuh mahmah in nek ding hon bawlsakleh, akhut ngei ah ka na ne ding, na chi in," achi hi.

Huchi in Amnon alum a, akichinasakta hi. Kumpipa'n amah ava et in Amnon in akiang ah, "Hehpih in ka sanggamnu Tamar hong pai henla, ka mitmuh mahmah in tanghou pek nih hiam hon bawlsak henla, amah khut mahmah ah ka ne ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David in Tamar kiang ah, "Na sanggampa Amnon inn ah hoh inla, nek ding va bawlsak dih ve," chi ding in a-inn ah mi asawl hi.
Huchi in Tamar, asanggampa Amnon inn ah ahoh hi. Amah ana lum hi. Tangbuang ala a, amek a, amitmuh a tanghou pek bawl in akang hi.
Akanna bel ala a, ama ah abungkhia hi. Himahleh ama'n ane nuam kei hi. Huan Amnon in, "Mi tengteng in hon pawtkhiaksan uhen," achi hi. Huchi in apawtkhiaksan vek uhi.
Huan Amnon in Tamar kiang ah, "Na khut mahmah a ka nektheihna ding in nek ding dantan ah hon la in," achi hi. Tamar in atanghou pek bawl ala a, asanggampa Amnon kiang ah dantan ah alalut hi.
Nesak dia akiangnai a ava paipih in ana len a, akiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu, ka kiang ah hong lum in," achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Hilou e, ka sanggampa, hon chi teitei ke'n. Israelte lak ah hichibang thilhih ding ahi kei. Hiai thil gilou haihuaitak hih ke'n.
Ke'n ka maizumna koi ah ka paisak dia? Nang leng Israelte lak a mihaite lak a khat na hi ding. Huaiziak in tu in kumpipa houpih zaw in, na hon neih anial kei ding," achi hi.
Himahleh athu azui kei a, amah sang in ahatzaw ngal a, thagum in akithuahpih teiteita hi.
