David kiang ah Saul tapa Jonathan tapa Mephibosheth ahong hi. Amai a lei si in zahtakna apia hi. David in, "Mephibosheth," achi a; ama'n, "En in, na sikha," chi in adawng hi.
David in akiang ah, “Lau ke'n. Na pa Jonathan ziak in hehpihna ka hon musak ngeingei ding. Na pu Saul gam tengteng ka hon pe nawn dia, ka dohkan ah an na ne gige ding," achi hi.
Huchi in akun a, "Ui sisa bang lel na hon limsak, kei na sikha bang ka hi a?" achi hi.
Kumpipa'n Saul sikha Ziba asam a, akiang ah, "Saul thil neih tengteng leh a-inkote thil tengteng na pu tapa ka pe vek hi.

Amah a ding in lei na lehsak dia, nang leh na tapate leh na sikhate teng in na pu tapa in nek ding aneihtheihna ding in na sepkhiakte na hon la ding. Na pu tapa Mephibosheth in bel ka dohkan ah an a-um gige ding," achi hi. Ziba in tapa sawm-le-nga leh sikha sawmnih anei hi.

Huchi in Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa ka toupa'n asikha thu apiak bang zel in na sikha in ahih ding," achi hi. Kumpipa'n, "Mephibosheth in ka dohkan ah kumpipa tapa bang in an a-um ding," achi hi.
Mephibosheth in tapa naupang anei a, amin Mika ahi. Ziba inn a om tengteng Mephibosheth sikhate ahi uh.
Huchi in kumpipa dohkan a an a-um gige ziak in Jerusalem ah Mephibosheth atengta hi; amah akhe lang tuak bai ahi.
Paul, Silvanas leh Timothi in, Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist a Thessalonika a om saptuamte kiang ah;
Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Unaute aw, na ginna uh nakpitak a khanglian in, na vek ua na ki-ittuah chiatna uh akhan semsem ziak in noumau tungthu ah Pathian kiang a kipahthu gengen ding him ka hi uh; huai ka hihtuak him uh ahi.
Huaiziak in mi'n ahon sawina tengteng uleh gim na thuaknate ua na kuhkaldan uleh na ginna ziak un Pathian saptuam pawlte lak ah koute mahmah in ka hon suang uhi.
Huai lah Pathian' vaihawmna adiktat chih chiamtehna ahi a, tu a Pathian kumpigam mi a seh tak na hi uh chih kilatna semsem ahi; huaiziak a leng thuak na hi ngal ua.
Pathian in nou hon hihgimte gimthuakna a thuk diktathuai in asepta hi.
Toupa Jesu van a kipan a-angel hatte toh meikuang a hong kilak chiang a, nou hihgim a omte koute toh khawlna ahon pe ding hi.
Pathian theiloumi leh i Toupa Jesu tanchinhoih taksangloute tung ah phu ala ding hi.
Amau tangtawn manthatna a gawtna leh Toupa omna leh athilhihtheihna thupina a kipan posiahna athuak ding ua,

amah ahong pai chiang in misiangthoute hih thupi in a-om ding ua, gingtute tengteng lak ah lamdangsak in a-om ding uhi, ka hon thu theihsak uh na gintak ziak un nou leng amaute lak ah na tel sam ding uhi.

Huchi a hih thupi leh lamdangsak ahihtheihna ding a i Pathian in nou ahon sapna a sap tuak him ahon saktheihna ding in leh lungtaina chiteng leh ginna nasep chiteng a thilhihtheihna a ahon lohchinsak theihna ding in noute a ding in ka hon thumsak gige uhi;
huchi a i Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna bang zel a i Toupa Jesu min noumau a hih thupi a om a, noumau leng amah a hih thupi a na omtheihna ding un.
Himahleh unaute aw, i Toupa Jesu Khrist hong paina leh amah tuak ding a i kikhopna ding thu ah;
Toupa ni atung khinta chihna kha in hiam aw, thu ziak in hiam aw, kou a kipan a laikhak ziak in hiam aw, na lungsim uh alin pahlouhna ding in leh na buailouhna ding un ka hon ngen uhi.
Kuamah in bangmah in hon khem kei uhen; puksanna tak ahong tun masak phot a, khelhna mipa, mangthang tapa ngei ahong kilat keileh huai ni tung lou ding ahi.
Ama'n Pathian kichi peuhmahte leh biak a om peuhmahte kalh in, amah leh amah kitawisang in Pathian tempul ah atu dia, Pathian in amah leh amah akibawl ding hi.
Na lak ua ka om lai in leng huai bang thu ka hon hilh zel chih na theigige kei ua hia?
Amah hun tuam a ahong kilattheihna ding in bang in kham ahia chih na thei uhi.
Dan lou a omna thuguk in tu in leng asem lellel ngal a, himahleh lakmang a a-om masiah tua akhampa'n huchibang in akham ding hi.
Huai lakmang ahih chiang in dan a talekpa ahong kilangta ding a, Toupa Jesu'n akam hatna in athat dia, ahong paina leh kilakna in ahihmang ding hi.
Huai dan a talekpa ahong paina Setan sepdan bang zel in, thilhihtheihna chiteng, chiamtehna chiteng, zuau thillamdang chiteng toh,
mangthang lelte ding in khemna gilou chiteng toh ahi ding; hotdam a a-omtheihna ding ua thutak itna apom louh ziak un.
Huaiziak in zuauthu agintakna ding un, Pathian in diklouhna nasep akiang uah ahon sawl ding hi;
thutak gingta lou a diktatlouhna a kipakzawte'n siam louh atan vek theihna ding un.

Unau Toupa ngaihtakte aw, Kha hihsiangthou leh thutak gingta a hotdam a om ding in atung a kipan Pathian in nou ahon tel ziak in na tungthu uah zaw Pathian kiang ah kipahthu gen zel ding him ka hi uhi.
Huchibang ding in ama'n i Toupa Jesu Khrist thupina tang ding in ka tanchinhoih un nou ahon sam hi.
Huchi in unaute aw, dingkip unla, kam a ka thugen uleh laikhakte a nou ka hon sinsakte uh lenkip un.
Huchi in i Toupa Jesu Khrist mahmah leh Pathian i Pa, eite hon itpa leh hehpihna ziak a tangtawn a khamuanna leh lametna hoih hon pepa'n,
na lungtangte uh hihkhamuang in, thil hoih hih leh thugen chiteng ah hon hihkip hen.
Atawp pen in unaute aw, Toupa thu noumau lak a a-om bang in, khang a hih thupi a a-omtheihna ding leh,
migenhakte leh migiloute lak a ka bit theihna ding un, hon thumsak un; mi tengteng in lah ginna anei vek kei uhi.
Himahleh Toupa amuanhuai a, ama'n noute hon phutkip in giloupa a pan ahon veng ding hi.
K'on thupiak peuhmah uh na hihzou ua, na hih zelzel uh leng Toupa ah ka hon gingta uhi.
Toupa'n na lungtangte uh Pathian itna ah leh Khrist kuhkalna ah pilut hen.
Huan unaute aw, koute a kipan a thuhilhna amuh bang ua om lou nasep thadah, dan lou bang a om unau tengteng a pan kihemkhe ding in i Toupa Jesu Khrist min in thu ka hon pia uhi.
Na kiang ua ka om lai un, dan lou bang in ka gamta ngei kei uh chih leh noumau mahmah in na hon zuihdan ding uh na thei uhi.
Kuamah khut a kipan athawn in na tanghou uh leng ka ne ngei kei uh; noute ka hon tuailuai saklouhna ding un sun leh zan a gim leh tawltak a sem kawm in ka ne zaw zel uhi.
Huai thuneihna ka neih louh ziak uh hilou in, ka omdan uh na zuih ding ua etton ding hon pia ka hi zaw hi.
Na kiang ua ka om lai un; kuapeuh in nna asepnop keileh nek leng ne kei hen, chi in thu ka hon pia uhi.
Na lak ua khenkhat dan lou a omte tungtang ka za uhi, huaite'n nna himhim asem kei ua, midangte nasep ah akichinglah zaw uhi.
Huchi ahih chiang in, huai mite nasem hiathiat ding leh amau tanghou ne ding in Toupa Jesu Khrist ah thu pia in ka hanthawn uhi.
Unaute aw, nou zaw thil hoih hih chimtak kei un.
Huan kuapeuh in hiai ka laikhak ua ka thu uh azuih kei uleh, na kithuahpih hetlouhna ding un chiamteh un, azumtheihna ding in.
Ahi, melma bang in en kei unla, unau bang in hilh zaw un.
Tu in muanna Toupa'n kong chiteng ah noute hon khamuan tawntung hen. Toupa na vek ua lak ah om hen.
Kei, Paul in, keimah khut a hiai chibai bukna ka gelh ahi; hiai ka laikhak teng ah chiamtehna ahi; hichibang ka gelhdan ahi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
Paul, Pathian deihdan a Khrist Jesu a om hinna thuchiam dungzui a, Khrist Jesu sawltak in,
ka tapa deihtak Timothi kiang ah, Pa Pathian leh Khrist Jesu i Toupa kiang a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna om hen.
Sun leh zan khawl lou a ka thumnate a nang hon theigige in, ka pipute a kipan a sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei a ama nna ka sep gigena pa, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen a,
kipak a ka dimtheihna ding in hon muh ka ut mahmah hi, na khitui theigige in.
Ginna taktak nangmah a om ka theigige a, huai ginna atung in na pi Lois ah a-om a, huan na nu Iunis ah, tu in nangmah ah leng a om chih diktak in ka theichian hi.
Huaiziak in ka khut ngak ziak a Pathian thilthawnpiak nangmah a om pen mutkuang ding in ka hon theisak hi.
Pathian in launa kha ahon pe kei a, thilhihtheihna leh itna leh kithuzohna kha ahon pe zaw hi.
Huchi in i Toupa thu theihsak zumpih ke'nla, kei ahentapa leng hon zumpih sam ke'n. Tanchinhoih ziak a gimthuak Pathian thilhihtheihna dungzui in hon thuakpih zaw in.
Ama'n i thilhihte bang hilou in, ama seh leh hehpihna bang zaw in hon hondam a, sapna siangthou in ahon sam hi; huai hehpihna leilung pian ma a Khrist Jesu a hon piak ahita hi.
Himahleh i Hondampa Khrist Jesu kilakna ziak in tu in hihlat in a-omta hi. Ama'n sihna hihmang in, tanchinhoih in hinna leh sih theihlouhna ahihlangta hi.
Huai tanchinhoih theisak ding a tangkoupihpa, sawltak leh sinsaktu a seh ka hi.
Hiai ziak in ahi, hiai thilte leng ka na thuak. Himahleh ka zum kei; ka ginpa ka thei a, akiang a ka kepsak huai ni a ding in akemhoih thei chih diktak in ka thei hi.
Khrist Jesu a om ginna leh itna nei in, ka kam a thudik na zakte zui tinten in.
I sung a teng Kha Siangthou hon kepsak thutak kemhoih in.
Asia gam a om tengtengte'n ahon nungngatsan uh chih na thei a; alak uah Phigelas leh Harmogenes apang uhi.
Toupa'n Onesiforas inkuanpihte kiang ah zahngaihna pia hen aw, ama'n ahon hihhalh zelzel ziak in; leh ka khainiang but leng ahon zumpih kei hi.
Rome ahong tun in hon limzon ngial a, ahong mukhia hi.
Huai ni chiang in Toupa kiang a zahngaihna mu ding in Toupa'n amah sep hen. Ephesa a anasep thupidan na thei hi.
Huchi in nang ka tapa, Khrist Jesu a hehpihna om ah thilhihtheihna nei in om in.
Theihpih tampite lak a ka kam a thu na zakte, mimuanhuai, midangte hilhsawn thei dingte kiang ah kemsak in.
Khrist Jesu sepaih hoih bang in gimthuak hon thuakpih in.
Sepaih a om ding a atelpa kipahsak ahihtheihna ding in, sepaih kuamah kidou lai in hiai damsung khosaknate in akisubuai ngei kei hi.
Huan kidemnate ah mite pang mahleh dan bang a ahihkeileh khuksak in a-om ngei kei hi.
Louneipa semgim agah tang masapa ahih ding ahi.
Ka thugentak ngaihtuah in; Toupa'n thil tengteng ah theihsiamna ahon pe ding hi.
Jesu Khrist, David suan ka tanchinhoih gen bang a misi lak a kipan a thounawnpa theigige in.
Huai tanchinhoih ziak in thil hihkhialpa bang in hen hial in gimna ka thuak zel hi; himahleh Pathian thu hen in a-om kei hi.
Huaiziak in Khrist Jesu a hotdamna tangtawn a thupina toh amuh sam theihna ding un, telte ziak in bangkim ka thuak hi.
Hiai thugen adik hi: "Asihna a i sih khit ngalleh, ahinna ah i hing ding hi.
I thuak leh avaihawmna ah vai i hawm sam ding hi; amah i kitheihmohbawlleh ama'n leng hon kitheihmohbawl ding.
Eite muanhuai lou in om mah lehang, Amah zaw muanhuai in a-om gige hi; amah-le-amah akitheihmohbawl thei ngal kei a.”
Hiai theisak inla, thute leltak tung a akisellouhna ding un Toupa muh in phatuamngaitak in theisak in; huai kiselna bangmah aphatuam kei a, angaikhete a ding in siatna ahi zaw hi.
Nasemtu, zumna ding nei lou, thutak thu diktak a zang, Pathian pomtak hi ding a nangmah kipe ding in theihtawp suah in kisin in.
Himahleh Pathian zah louh thugen mawkmawkte nungngatsan in; huchibang mite Pathian limsaklouhna lam ah apai gamla semsem ding ua,
athu un meima sia nek bang in ane zel ding; alak uah Himenaias leh Philetas apang uhi.
Huai mite'n thohnawnna a-om khinta chi in thutak lam apialsan ua, mi khenkhatte ginna ahihmangsak uhi.
Himahleh Pathian suangphum kip adingh lai a, hiai chiamtehna anei hi: "Toupa'n ama ate athei," chih leh, "Toupa min lou peuhmah in diktatlouhna paisan hen," chih.

Himahleh inn thupi ah tui-um belsuan dangka-eng leh dangka a bawlte kia a-om kei a, sing leh bellei a bawlte leng a-om hi; khenkhatte manphatak a zat a-om a, khenkhatte manpha lou deuh a zat leng a-om sam hi.
Huaiziak in mi huai thil manphaloute lak a akihepleh tui-um belsuan manphatak a zat ding, siangthou, apu a dia zat tak, nasep hoih chiteng a dia mansa ahi ding hi.
Himahleh valnou duhgawlnate taisan inla, lungtang siangthou a Toupa sam peuhmahte lak adiktatna, ginna, itna leh khamuanna delh in.
Himahleh kidounate asuaksak nak chih thei in, kiselna haihuai leh pil lou ah pang nuam ke'n.
Toupa sikha in adou ding ahi kei a, mi tengteng tung ah siam tum in, thuhilh siam in, gitlouh tung a thuakzou in,
amah doute thunuailuttak in athuhilh zaw ding hỉ. Huchi in Pathian in thutak atheihna ding un akisiksak zenzen kha ding hi,
huchi in khua ahon theithei ding ua, amaute suak-le-sal a man a a-utut a bawlpa diabol thang a kipan asuakta thei ding uh.
Huan hiai thei in, ni nanung ah hun haksa pipi a hong om ding hi.
Mi amau ki-itte, dangka deihtate, ki-uangsakte, kisatheite, Pathian gensete, nu leh pa thu mangloute, kipahna dan theiloute, siangthouloute,
itna pianpih neiloute, buaina bawlte, hekte, kidek theiloute, mihuhamte, hoih deih hetloute,
zuautatte, kingaisang, thunung khualloute, Pathian it sang a amau kipahna kia itzawte ahi ding uh;
Pathian limsak batna anei ding ua, himahleh athilhihtheihna ataksang kei ding uhi. Huchibang mite nungngatsan in.
Amaute lak a khenkhatte inn peuh a lut a gitlouh gik pua numei haideuhte sal a manmante ahi ua, huchibang numeite duhgawlna chi chih a pimang in,
zilzil napi a, thutak theipha ngeiloute ahi uhi.
Jannes leh Jambres in Mosi adou bang un, huai mite'n leng thutak adou gige uhi; lungsim sesa ginna lam a Pathian deih louh mi ahi uhi.
Himahleh huai val ahih kei ding uhi, ahaidan uh Jannes leh Jambres haidan ahong kitheih mah bang in mi tengteng kiang ah hong kilang ding hi.
Himahleh nang zaw ka thugin, ka omdan, ka thiltup, ka ginna, ka thuakzohna, ka itna, ka kuhkalna na thei vek hi,
Antiok khua, Ikoniam khua, Listra a ka tung a thil tung ahon sawinate uh, huai sawina ka thuakte; huai tengteng ah Toupa'n hon hunkheta hi.
Ahi, kuapeuh Khrist Jesu Pathian limsak a om tum photphot in sawina athuak sam ding uhi.
Migilou leh mikhem hatte mi khem leh khem a om in agilou semsem ding uhi.
Himahleh nang zaw na zilsa leh kiptak a na gintaksa thutak ah om gige in, kua a kipan na zil hiam chih theigige in.
Huan Khrist Jesu ginna ziak a hotdamna mu ding a nang hon hilhpil thei Laisiangthoute naupangnou a kipan thei khin na hi chih theigige in.
Laisiangthou peuhmah Pathian hatkhum a piak ahi a; huaiziak in thuhilhna ding, taihilhna ding, bawlhoihna ding, diktatna lam a kichilna ding in aphatuam hi.
Huchi a Pathian mipa nna hoih chiteng sem ding a kimtak a kivan a akimtheihna ding in.
Huaiziak in Pathian ma leh akilatna leh alalgam a misi leh mihing tung a vai hawm dingpa, Toupa Jesu Khrist ma ah mohpuakna ka hon guan hi.
Thu gen in; ahun hi in ahun lou ah leng pang zel in; thuakzoutak a thuhilh kawm in asiamlouhdan uh theisak inla, taihilh inla, hanthawn in,
thuhilhna dik angaihkhiak ngap louh hun uh ahong tung ding a; abilte uh azau ziak in amau deihlam bang in heutute akiang uah akhawm ding uh;
abilte uh thutak lam ah angongsak ding ua, tangthu lam naih in apialta ding uhi.
Nang zaw bangkim ah pilvang in, gimthuak inla, tanchinhoih genna lam nna sem in na nasepna pen hihtangtung in.
Kei zaw tu in leng luikhiak in ka om lellel a, ka pawt hun atungta hi.
Douna hoih tuh ka dou khinta a, kitaitehna ka tai khinta, ginna ka lenkip paisuakta hi.
Tu'n ah zaw kei a ding in Diktatna Lallukhu koih in a-omta, Toupa vaihawmpa diktat in huai ni chiang in kei ahon pe ding, kei kiang kia hilou in akilakna it peuhmahte kiang ah ape sam ding hi.
Kintak in ka kiang a hong pai pah hon tum in; Dema in tulai khovel a-it ziak in hon paisan a,
Thessalonika ah apaita hi; Galatia gam ah Kristens apai a, Dalmatia gam ah Titas apaita hi.
Luka kia ka kiang ah a-om hi. Marka chial inla, hon pi in, amah nasepna lam ah kei a ding in aphatuam hi.
Ephesa ah Taikika ka sawlta.
Na hong pai chiang in Troas a Karpas kiang a puanaktual ka nutsiat, laibute toh hon tawi in, savun lai mahmah hon tawi in.
Alexander, dalsun siampa, ka tung ah agilou mahmah hi.
Toupa'n athilhih bang zel in athuk ding; amah lak ah nang leng pilvang in, i thu adou mahmah hi.
Ka siamna thu ka gen masakpen in kuama'n ahon gum kei ua, ahon zuausan vek uhi; amoh pua in om tuan kei uhen.
Tanchinhoih keimah ziak a hilhkim a a-omtheihna ding leh Zentelte'n azaktheihna ding un, Toupa'n hon gum a ahon hihhat zawta hi; humpinelkai kam a kipan in suahtaksak in ka omta hi.
Toupa'n gitlouhna tengteng lak a kipan in ahon suaktasak dia, avan-gam ah bittak in ahon tun ding; ama kiang ah tangtawn in thupina om hen. Amen.
Priscilla leh Akuila, Onesiphoras inkuanpihte toh, chibai hon buksak in.
Korinth ah Erastas a-om gige a, Trophimas bel Melita ah damlou in ka nusia hi.
Phalbi ma in hong pai teitei in, Iubalas, Pudens, Linas, Klaudia leh unau tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist in na kha ompih hen. Na kiang ah hehpihna om hen. Amen.
Upa in, deihtak Gaias thutak a ka it kiang ah;
deihtak, na kha in vualzawlna amuh bang in, bangkim a vualzawlna na muh leh na damtheihna ding in ka thum zel hi.
Unaute ahong pai un, thutak a na hindan leh na muanhuaidan ahon theihpih ziak un ka kipak mahmah hi.
Ka tate thutak ah a-om uh chih ka zak kan a kipahna thupizaw ka nei kei hi.
Deihtak unaute mikhual himah le uh, atung ua na hih peuh ah muanhuaitak in na hih zel a;
huaite'n saptuamte ma ah na itna atheipihta uhi; amau tuh azinna ua Pathian mite hihtuak him a na khakkhiakleh na hihhoih ding hi.
Amau Khrist min a azinna uah Zentelte kiang a kipan bangmah la lou in apawt zel ngal ua.
Huchi in thutak a seppihte i hihtheihna ding in huchibang mite, eite'n i kipahpih ding mah ahi.
Saptuamte kiang ah thu neukha zaw ka gelhta; himahleh Diotrephes, alak ua tungnun ut nakpa'n akipahpih kei hi.

Huaiziak in ka hong paileh athilhihte ka pholhkhe ding a, i tung ua thu dikloupi agen a akamtamdan ka theikhesak ding hi. Huan huai leng hun asa kei a, amah ngei in unaute akipahpih kei a, akipahpih nuamte leng khou in saptuamte lak a kipan adelhkhia hi.
Deihtak, giloumi omdan zui ke'n, ahoih zui zaw in. Kuapeuh thil hoih hihmi tuh Pathian a pan ahi; thil gilou hihmi in Pathian amu ngei kei hi.
Demetrias in mi tengteng phat aloh a, thutak a phat nangawn aloh behlap hi; eite'n leng i phat ua, hiai phatna adik ahi chih na thei hi.
Na kiang ah thu tampi gelh ding ka nei, himahleh laitui leh laipuan a gelh ka ut kei hi.
Sawt lou nung chiang in hon muh ka lamen hi, huchi in kimaituah in i kihou ding.
Khamuanna na tung ah om hen. I lawmte'n chibai ahon buk uhi. Amin uh lou chiat in lawmte chibai hon buksak in.
Theophilas aw, tuma a ka laigelh ah, Jesu thilhih leh athuhilh pat tung tengteng thu ka gelh hi.
Kha Siangthou tawn a asawltak telte kiang a thupiak tampi apiak khit a van a pitouh a a-om ni tan a thute ahi.
Huai sawltakte kiang ah gimna athuak nung in theihna zuau lou tampi in ahing in akimusak a, ni sawmli hial akiang uah akilak a, Pathian lalgam thu agen hi.
Huan a-omkhawm uh akithuahpih a, "Jerusalem khua paisan kei un, Pa thilchiam ka gen na zak uh ngak un, achi tinten hi.
Johan in tui in abaptis zel a, himahleh, ni sawt lou nung in Kha Siangthou a baptis in na om ding uh," achi hi.
Huan amaute ahong kikhop un akiang ah, "Toupa, tu in hia Israelte kiang a lalgam na piak nawn ding?" chi in adong uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Pa in ahun leh ani amah thuthu a om dia aseh, nou theih ding ahi kei hi.

Himahleh, Kha Siangthou na tung ua ahong tun chiang in thilhihtheihna na nei ding uh; huchi in Jerusalem ah, leh Judia gamsung pumpi ah, leh Samaria leh kawlmong pha in ka theihpihte na hi ding uh," achi hi.
Huai thu agen khit in amuh laipi un, van a pitouh in a-omta a, meipi in amuh phak louh uah apitouta hi.
Huan apaitouh lai a van lam a-et nilouh lai un, ngai in, mi nih, puanngou silh in, akiang uah ahong dingh uhi.
Huai mite'n, "Galili gam a mite aw, bangziak a van lam en a dingh na hi ua? Hiai Jesu na kiang ua kipan a van apitouh a om, van a paitou na muh bang un amah mah ahong kik nawn ding," achi uhi.
Huan Olive tang achih ua kipat Jerusalem ah akik nawnta uhi. Huai tang Jerusalem kho kiang ahi a, Sabbath ni a hohna hun lel ahi.

Huan alut un, a-omna dantan tungnung uah apaitou ua, Peter leh Johan, Jakob leh Andru, Philip leh Thomas, Bartholomai leh Matthai, Alphai tapa Jakob, Simon Zealot Pawl a leh Jakob tapa Judas toh ahi uh.
Huai tengteng numei kuate hiam leh Jesu nu Mari toh, Jesu unaute toh, lungsim mun khat a, phatuamngaitak a thum in a-om nilouh uhi.
Huan huai ni in unaute lak ah Peter adingh a, avek un za-le-sawmnih ahi uhi.
"Unaute aw, Kha Siangthou in, David kam a, Jesu mante makai Judas thu agenkholh Laisiangthou thu ahong tung ding him ahi."
Amah zaw i lak ua simtel ahi a, hiai nasepna ah tan leng anei sam hi.
Himahleh huai mi'n akhelhna man in mun khat alei a, akhuplam in akia a, alai ah apuakkham a, agil tengteng alawt vek hi.
Huai thu Jerusalem a omte tengteng in ana za uhi; huchi in huai mun amau pau in, Akeldama, achi ua, huai tuh Sisan Mun, chihna ahi.
"Sam Laibu ah hiai thu gelh ahi. 'A-omna mun hihgam in om hen, asung ah kuamah om kei hen,' 'huan aheutu hihna midang in tang hen,' chih ahi.
"Huchi in Toupa Jesu i lak ua lut zel pawt zel a a-om sung teng a,
Johan baptisma nungsiah, i lak ua kipan van a pitouh a a-om ni tan hiai hon kithuahpihte lak a mi khat athohnawnna theihpih ding in a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan mi nih asepkhia ua, khat Joseph Barsabbas kichi ahi a, aminkhem Justas leh midang khat Mathias ahi.
Huan athum ua, "Toupa, Nang, mihing tengteng lungtang thei, hiai nihte akua zaw pen ahia na tel hon hilh in,
Judas in amah omna a pai ding in hiai nasepna leh sawltakna akiaksan sik a ding in," achi uhi.
Huan ai asan ua, a-aisan uh Matthias tung ah atu a; huchi in amah sawltak sawm-le-khatte lak a simtel ahita hi.
Kaisaria ah mi khat amin Kornelia a-om a; amah Itali pawl achih uh, huai pawl a sepaih zaheutupa ahi.
Amah Pathian limsakmi ahi a, a-inkuanpihte tengteng toh Pathian laudan asiam uhi, mite kiang ah thilthawnpiak tampi ape zel a, Pathian kiang ah leng athum gige hi.
Hiai mi'n sun dak kuana ding khawng in mengmuhna in Pathian angel khat akiang ah alut a, "Kornelia" chi a asap lai chiangtak in amu hi.
Huan Kornelia in lau in amah ana en kilkel a, "Toupa, bang ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Na thumnate leh na thilpiakte theihgigena ding in Pathian ma ah atungtouta hi.
Tu'n ah Joppa khua ah mi sawl inla, mi khat Simon Peter achih uh va pisak in;
amah huai tuipi gei a om, savunbawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi a, ama'n na hih ding hon na hilh ding hi," achi hi.
Ahoupihpa angel apaitak in, Kornelia in asikhate lak a mi nih leh anek bawl gigete lak a Pathian limsak sepaih khat asam hi.
Thu tengteng akiang ua ahilh khit in Joppa khua ah asawlta hi.
Huan azing nawn in, khopi zuan a pai, khua atun kuan un, thum ding in dak gukna vel in intung ah Peter akaltou hi.
Huan agil ahong kial mahmahta a, an nek a-utta hi; himahleh nek ding abawl lai un ihmu bang in zeel in ahong om hi.
Van kihong in, banghiam bawm, puan liantak bang, ning li a khih, lei a luai a khaikhiak a om in amu hi.
Huai sung ah leitung a khe li nei ganhing chi chih leh gamsa leh ganhing bokvak, tungleng vasa chichihte a-om uhi.
Huan akiang ah aw in, "Peter, thou in gou inla, ne in," achi hi.
Himahleh Peter in, "Toupa hilou e; siang lou leh nin bangmah himhim ka ne ngei kei," achi hi.
Aw in, anihveina in, “Pathian in ahihsiangthousa nang siang lou chi ke'n," achi hi.
Huchibang ngen in thumvei ahong om a; huan van ah bawm khaitouh in a-om nawnta hi.
Huan Peter in mengmu bang a amuh theisiam lou a, abuai lai in, Kornelia mi sawlte'n Simon inn ana kankhia ua,
kongkhak bul ah ana dingh ua asam ua, "Simon, Peter achih uh, huai a atun leh tun louh," ana dong uhi.
Peter in mengmu bang a amuh angaihtuah lai inla, Kha in akiang ah, "Ngai in, mi thum in ahong zong uh.
Huaiziak in thou inla, kumsuk in, bangmah ginglel lou in amaute zui in; amau ka sawl ahi uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Peter huai mite kiang ah ahohsukta a, akiang uah, "Ngai un na mizon uh ka hi; bang ahia na hong nasan uh?" achi hi.

Amau, "Angel siangthou khat in, Kornelia, sepaih zaheutupa, midiktak, Pathian laudan siam, Juda nam tengteng lak a mihoih kiang ah, na thugen azakna ding in, a-inn ah nangmah sam ding in ahilh hi," achi uhi.
Huchi in mite asamlut a, agiaksakta hi. Huan azing in Peter athou a, akiang uah apai a, Joppa khomi unau kuate hiam leng akiang uah apai sam uhi.
Huan azing nawn in Kaisaria ah alutta uhi. Kornelia in, asanggamte leh alawm deihpente samkhawm in, amau ana ngak nilouh hi.
Peter ahong lut dek laitak in Kornelia in ana dawn a, akhebul a bokkhup in, abia hi.
Himahleh Peter in amah akaithou a, dingh in, "Kei leng mihing mai ka hi,” achi hi.
Amah toh kihou kawm in alut a, mi tampi omkhawm amu hi.
Akiang uah, "Juda mi namdang toh kithuah leh pai asianlouhdan noumau mah in na thei uhi; himahleh kuamah siang lou leh nin ka chih ding ahi kei chih Pathian in ahon theisak hi.
Huaiziak in na hong saptak in sel lou in ka hong pai hi. Huchi in ka hon dong ahi, bangziak a hon sam na hi ua le?" achi hi.
Huan Kornelia in, “Ni li ahita, tu hun bang tan in, ka inn ah, dak kuana hun thumna ah ka thum a; ngai in, ka ma ah puan vaktak silh mi khat ahong dingh a,
'Kornelia, na thumna zak in a-omta, mi kiang a na thilthawnpiakte leng Pathian in atheigige hi.

Huaiziak in Joppa ah Simon, Peter achih uh, sam ding in mi sawl inla, na kiang ah sam in; amah tuipi gei ah savunbawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi, amah ahong tun chiang in na kiang ah thu agen ding hi,' achi hi.
Huaiziak in na kiang ah mi ka hon sawl pah hi; na hong pai ahoih ahi. Huchi in Toupa'n thu ahon piak peuhmah thei ding in tu'n ah Pathian mitmuh in i vek un hiai ah i om uhi," achi hi.
Huan Peter in agen a, "Pathian in mi deihsak tuam anei kei chih, diktak in ka thei hi.
Himahleh nam chih lak ah kuapeuh amah kihtakdan siam a, diktak a gamta peuhmah, apahtak mi ahi naknak uhi.
Ama'n khamuanna tanchinhoih, Jesu Khrist tungtawn in Israel suante kiang ah agen a (amah mi tengteng Toupa ahi),
Johan in atangkou pihpih baptisma nung in, hiai tanchinhoih, Galili gam a kipan ahong thang pan a, Judia gam tengteng ah athangsuak a, noumau leng na thei uhi.

Nazaret Jesu tungtang thu, huchi a Pathian in amah Kha Siangthou leh thilhihtheihna a athaunilhdan, Pathian akiang a a-om ziak in amah mi tung a thil hoih hih leh diabol gawt tengteng hihdam in avialvak vak hi.
Judate gam ah leh Jerusalem a athilhih tengteng theihpihte ka hi uh, amah sing dawn ah khai in athat uhi.
Amah Pathian in ani thum ni in akaithou nawn a, chiantak in akitheisak hi.
Himahleh mi tengteng kiang ah ahi kei, Pathian in theihpih dia asehkholhte kiang kia ah ahi koute, misi lak a kipan athohnawn nung a akiang a ne a dawnte kiang ah.
Amah misi leh mihingte tung a Vaihawmpa dia Pathian seh ahi chih, mi kiang a tangkoupih leh theisak ding in Pathian in thu ahon pia hi.
Kuapeuh amah gingta amin ziak in khelhnate ngaihdam in a-om ding uh chih hiai a tanchin zawlnei tengteng in ana theihsak det uh ahi,” achi hi.
Peter in huai thu agen laitak in thuzate tengteng tung ah Kha Siangthou ahong tung hi.
Zeksumte lak a agingtate Peter hon zui peuhmah in Kha Siangthou thawnniak Zentelte tung ah leng sunbuak ahih ziak in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Paute a thu gen in Pathian phat in aza uhi.
Huan Peter in apuang a, "Hiai mite, eimah bang a Kha Siangthou tang sam, baptisma ding in tui zat kuama'n akham thei dia hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Toupa min a baptisma tan ding thu apia hi. Huai khit in ni bangzah hiam taam ding in akhou uhi.
Huan Judia gam a sawltak leh unau omte'n Zentelte'n leng Pathian thu agingta uh chih azata uhi.
Huchi in Peter, Jerusalem atuntouhtak in, zeksumte'n akiang ah,
"Zeksumloute inn ah lut in, akiang uah na ne," chi in akalhta uhi.
Himahleh Peter in abul a kipan in kizom zel in akiang uah ahilhchian hi.
"Joppa ah thum in ka om a, huan ihmu bang in ka om a, banghiam bawm, puan liantak bang aning li a kikhih, van a kipan khiaksuk bang in ka mu a; ka kiang ngeingei ahong tung hi.
Huai tuh ka en kilkel a, ka ngaihtuah a, 'Lei a ganhing khe li nei leh gamsate chi chih, awm a kitholh ganhingte leh tungleng vasate ka mu hi.'
Huan aw in, 'Peter, thou in; gou inla, ne in, hon chi in' ka za hi.
Himahleh ke'n, 'Toupa, hilou e, siang lou leh nin bangmah ka kam ah alut ngei kei,' ka chi hi.
Himahleh van a kipan aw in, anihveina in, 'Pathian in ahihsiangthousa nang siang lou chi ke'n,' chi in ahon dawng hi.
Huchibang ngen in thumvei ahong om a; huan bangkim van ah khaitouh in a-om nawnta hi.
Huan ngai in, mi thum Kaisaria a kipan ka kiang ah ahon sawl ua, ka omna inn kong ah ana dingh nilouh uhi.
Huan Kha in kuamah khentuam nei lou a amau zui ding in ahon sawl hi. Hiai unau guk in leng ahon zui sam ua, huai mi inn ah ka lutta uhi.
Huan ama'n ka kiang uah, a-inn a angel kilak amuhdan leh angel in akiang a, Joppa ah mi sawl a, Simon Peter achih uh, pisak ding leh;
'Ama'n thu ahon hilh ding a, huai mi thu in nang leh na inkuanpihte hotdam in na om ding uh' achihdan leng ahon hilh hi.
Huan thu ka gen patleh, achil a eite tung a ahong tun bang mah in, atung uah Kha Siangthou ahong tungta hi.
Toupa thu, Johan in tui in abaptis zel; himahleh nou zaw Kha Siangthou a baptis in na om ding uh achih ka hon theikhe nawn uhi.
Huchi in Toupa Jesu Khrist i gintak ua, Pathian in thilthawnpiak ahon piak amaute kiang a apiak sam, kei Pathian sel vual ka hi a hia?" achi hi.
Huai thu azak un adaita ua, huchi ahihleh, "Pathian in Zentelte leng hing ding a kisik phalta ahi ve maw," chi in Pathian aphat uhi.
Huan Stephen ziak a sawina thuak dalhzakte, Phoinisia gam, Kupra tuikulh leh Antiok khua pha in apai ua, Judate kiang kia ah lou ngal kuamah kiang ah thu agen kei uhi.
Himahleh alak ua akhen tuh Kupra tuikulh leh Kurini a mite ahi ua, huai mite'n Antiok khua atun un Grikte leng ahoupih ua, Toupa Jesu tanchinhoih ahilh samta uhi.
Huan Toupa khut in amaute apanpih a; mi tampi in agingta ua, Toupa lam ahong nga chiatta uhi.
Huan atanchin thu uh Jerusalem a saptuam omte bil ah alutta a; huchi in Antiok kho pha in Barnabas asawlkhia uhi.
Amah ava tung a, Pathian hehpihdan amuh in akipak a, phatuamngaitak in Toupa len gige ding in avek un ahanthawn hi.
Barnabas mihoihtak ahi a, Kha Siangthou leh ginna a dim ahi. Huan Toupa kiang ah mi tampi a behlap in a-omta uhi.
Huan Saul zong ding in Tarsas ah Barnabas ahoh hi.
Amuh in Antiok ah ahon pi hi. Huan kum khat hilhial saptuamte kikhopna ah apang zel ua, mi tampi leng thu ahilh uhi. Antiok ah ahi nungzuite, "Khristian," achih masakpen uh.
Huai lai in zawlnei kuahiam Jerusalem a kipan in Antiok ah ahohsuk hi.
Alak ua mi khat amin Agabas kichi adingh a, khovel tengteng ah kial thupitak atung dek chih Kha hilh in atheisak a; huai kial tuh Klaudias vaihawm lai in ahong tungta hi.
Huchi in nungzuite'n atheihdan chiat un Judia gam a unau omte kiang ah panpihna khak atum uhi.
Huai tuh ahihta ngei uhi, Barnabas leh Saul khut ah upate kiang ah akhak uhi.
Huai lai in Kumpipa Herod in saptuamte lak a kuate hiam hihgim tum in akhut alikta hi.
Huan Jakob, Johan unau, namsau in asatlum hi.
Huai in Judate akipaksak chih atheih in, Peter leng mat atum zel hi. Huai ni tuh Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ni ahi.
Huan amat nung in suangkul ah akhum a, sepaih pawl li, li chiat zel in, akivenkhelsak hi; Paikan Ankuanglui nung in mi tengteng kiang ah pikhiak atum hi.
Huaiziak in suangkul ah Peter a-omsak tadih hi; himahleh, saptuamte'n amah a ding in phatuamngaitak in Pathian kiang ah athumsak uhi.
Herod in apikhiak ding zan in sepaih nih kikal ah khainiang nih bun in Peter a-ihmu a; avengte kongkhak bul a om in suangkul aveng uhi.
Ngai in, Toupa angel khat akiang ah ahong dingh a, suangkul sung ah vak ahong tang hi; huan Peter nak ah abenghalh a, "Thou meng in," achi hi. Huan akhut a kipan khainiangte atolhkhesuk hi.
Huan angel in akiang ah, "Na puan silh inla, na khetuam bun in," achi hi. Huan ama'n huchibang in ahih hi. Angel in akiang ah, "Na puan silhhoih inla, hon zui in,” achi hi.
Huan Peter apawt a azuita hi, angel tatdan atak hia ahih athei kei, mengmu bang a amuh hiam akisa hi.

Huan chingmi masa leh azom akhen nung un, khopi lutna sik kongpi ava tung ua, huai tuh amau a ding in akihong tawmta hi; huan apawt ua, kongzing khat akheng ua; huai a kipan angel in amah paisanta hi.
Huan Peter ahalhtak in, "Herod khut leh Juda mite lametna tengteng a kipan a hunkhe ding a Toupa'n a-angel hon sawlkhia ahi chih tu in diktak in ka theita," achi hi.
Huan akingaihtuah khit in, Johan, Marka achih uh, huai nu Mari inn ah ava hoh a; huai ah thum in mi tampi ana omkhawm uhi.
Kongpi kongkhak a kiuhtak in, nungak khat amin Rhoda, adawng ding in ava hoh hi.
Peter aw azaktak in akipah ziak in kong hon lou in atailut nawn a, kongkhak bul ah Peter adingh chih ava gen hi.
Himahleh amau akiang ah, "Ahai na hita ve," ana chi uhi. Ama'n bel, "Hi petmah ahi," chi in apang teitei hi. Amau, “A-angel hi in teh," achi lai uhi.
Himahleh Peter in kongkhak akiukiu a; ahon ualeh amah amu ua, lamdang asa uhi.
Huchi in ama'n amaute dai ding in akhutvan a, Pathian in suangkul a kipan amah apikhiakdan ahilhta hi. "Hiai thute Jakob leh unaute kiang ah va hilh un," achi hi. Huan apawt a mun dang ah ava pai hi.
Ni ahong suahtak in, Peter tung a bang thil tung hiam, chi in buai chihtak in sepaihte abuai uhi.
Huan Herod in amah azong a amu kei, avengtute a-enchian a, thah ding in thu apeta hi. Huan Judia gam a kipan Kaisaria ah ahohsuk a, huai ah a-om nilouh hi.

Huan Tura leh Sidon a mite tung ah Herod alung hi kei mahmah hi; amau thukhat sat in Blastas, kumpipa lupna ngakpa, alawm in abawl ua, kumpipa kiang ah hong pai ua, amah a kipan nek-le-dawn ngah zel ahih ziak un akholamte uh toh kilemna angen uhi.
Huan ani chiam ni in kumpipa Herod in kumpi puan asilha, alaltutphah a tu in akiang uah thu agen hi.
Mi tengteng in, "Hiai pathian aw ahi, mihing aw ahi kei," achi ua, akikou zuazua uhi.
Ama'n Pathian kiang a thupina apiak louh ziak in Toupa Angel in amah aman pah a, hut in ane a, asita hi.
Pathian thu bel adalh a, apung zel hi.
Barnabas leh Saul in nna asep khit un, Jerusalem a kipan akik nawnta ua, Johan, amin dang Marka achih uh leng atonpih uhi.
Antiok a saptuam omte lak ah zawlnei leh thuhilhmi kuate hiam a-om ua; huaite Barnabas, Niger achih uh Simeon, Kurini khomi Lusias, kumpipa Herod toh khangkhawm Manaen leh Saul ahi uhi.
Huan Toupa nna sem a an angolh lai un, Kha Siangthou in, "Barnabas leh Saul ka sapna nna sem ding in kei a ding in hon koihtuamsak un," achi hi.
Huchi in an angawl ua, athum khit un atung uah akhut uh akoih ua, apaisakta uhi.
Huchi in Kha Siangthou sawlkhiak in apai ua, Seliusia ah ahohsuk ua, huai a kipan in Kupra tuikulh ah long in apai uhi.
Salamis a a-om lai un Judate sinagog ah Pathian thu agen ua; Johan leng amaute panpih ding in atonpih uhi.
Huan tuikulh gam Paphos kho pha in anawksuak ua, bumsiam, zawlnei tak lou, Juda mi khat amu ua, amin tuh Bar Jesu ahi.
Huai mi gam-ukpa Serjia Paulus, mipiltak kiang a om ahi. Huai gam-ukpa'n Barnabas leh Saul asam a, Pathian thu zak atum hi.
Himahleh bumsiam Elimas, (huai tuh ama minkhiakna ahi a), amau nasep dal in ginna a kipan gam-ukpa heimang atum hi.
Huchi in Saul, Paul leng kichi; Kha Siangthou in adim a, amah a-ensal hi.
"Nang, mi khem leh huathuai chiteng a dim diabol tapa, diktatna tengteng melmapa aw, Toupa lam diktatte hihsiat na tawp kei ding maw?

Thei in, tu in Toupa khut na tung ah atu hi, na mit ahong taw ding a, bang tan hiam khovak na mu kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in khomui leh mial in amah akhuh pah a, khut a kai ding mi zong in amai puampuam hi.
Huan gam-ukpa'n huai thilhih amu a, Toupa sinsakna lamdang asa mahmah a, agingtata hi.
Paul, atonpihte toh Paphos a kipan in long in apai ua, Pamphilia gam a Perga khua atung uhi; huai ah Johan in amaute paisan in, Jerusalem ah akiksan hi.
Himahleh amau Perga a kipan apai zel ua, Pisidia gam a Antiok khua atung uhi; huan Sabbath ni in sinagog ah alut ua, atu uhi.
Dan leh zawlneite laibu asim khit un, sinagog upate'n akiang uah mi asawl ua, "Unaute aw, mite hanthawnna thu banghiam na neih uleh gen un," achi uhi.
Huan Paul adingh a, akhut a zap in agen a, “Israel mite leh Pathian laudan siamte aw, ngai un.
Hiai Israel chite Pathian in i pipute atel a, Aigupta gam a ataam lai un ahih thupi mahmah a, ban thahat in amaute huai a kipan in apikheta hi.
Huan kum sawmli gamdai ah athilhihte uh athuak teitei hi.
Kanaan gam a nam sagihte ahihsiat khit in, agam uh aisan a hawm in, aluah ding un apia hi.
Huaite nung kum zali-le-sawmnga sung teng, zawlnei Samuel hun tan in vaihawmte ape zel hi.
Huan huai nung in kumpipa angen ua; Pathian in, Saul kichi, Benjamin nam a Kish tapa, kum sawmli sung amau apia hi.
Amah asuanmang nung in akumpipa ding un David abawlta hi; Pathian in huai thu theisak in, David, Jesse tapa, ka lungtang bang pumi ka mukheta, ama'n ka deihlam ahih ding," achi hi.
Hiai mi suan a kipan in Pathian in athuchiam bang in Israelte kiang ah Hondampa, Jesu kichi ahon dinkhia hi.
Amah ahong pai ma in Johan in kisikna baptisma thu Israel mi tengteng kiang ah ana hilh masa hi.

Huan Johan in asep ding azoh kuan in, "Noute'n kei kua na hon sa ua? Amah zaw ka hi kei hi. Himahleh ngai un, ka nung ah mi khat ahong pai dek, kei zaw akhepek a khetuam phel tak leng ka hi kei,” achi hi.
"Mite leh unaute, Abraham suante leh Pathian laudan siam Zentelte tengteng aw, noute kiang ah hiai hotdamna thu piak in a-omta hi.
Jerusalem a omte leh amakaite un, amah atheih louh ziak ua siam louh atansak lai un, zawlneite thute Sabbath teng a asimte uh tangtungsak ana hi uhi.
Asihna ding khop atung a bangmah amuh louh nung un leng, Pilat kiang ah hihlup ding in angen uhi.
Huan athu zawlneite'n agelhkholh tengteng uh ahihtangtun khit un, sing a kipan in alakhia ua, han ah asialta uhi.
Himahleh Pathian in misi lak a kipan akaithou nawnta hi.
Huchi in Galili gam a kipan Jerusalem a amah toh hohtoute kiang ah ni sawtpi akilak a; huai mite mah mi kiang a athu theihpihte ahi uhi.
Kou leng pipute kiang ah huai thuchiam a Tanchin kipahhuai ka hon puangzak uhi.
Huchi a Pathian in Jesu akaihthoh, ei atate kiang ah huai thuchiam tuh ahihtangtung hi. Sam nihna ah, 'Nang zaw ka tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia hi,' chih gelh bang in.
Muatna mun a pai nawn lou ding in Pathian in amah misi lak a kipan akaihthohdan ding hiai bang in agen hi, David kiang a hehpihna ka chiamte nangmah ka hon pe ding," chi in.
"Huaiziak in Sam dang ah, 'Na Mi Siangthou muatmang na phal kei ding,' achi behlap hi.
David zaw, Pathian vai hawmsak bang in ama khang hun a nna asep khit in, a-ihmu a, apipute kiang ah asial ua, amuatmangta hi.
Himahleh Pathian kaihthoh pen in zaw muatna amu kei hi.
Huchi in unaute aw thei un; amah ziak in khelhna ngaihdamna thu na kiang ua gen ahi.
Kuapeuh agingta tuh bangkim ah amah siamtansak in a-om, huai lah Mosi Dan in siamtansak in na om thei kei uhi.
Huaiziak in pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw zawlneite a agen uh na tung uah ahong tung kha ding hi."
"Musitte aw, en un, lamdang sa unla, mangthang un; na damsung un nna khat ka sem hi, huai nna mi'n hon hilh mah le uh, na gingta kei hial ding uhi, chih," achi hi.
Huan apawt un, Sabbath nawn chiang a huai thute gen nawn ding in angen uhi.
Huan omkhawmte akikhentak un, Judate leh phungkaite Pathian limsak lak a mi tampi in Paul leh Barnabas azui zel ua; amau ana houpih ua, Pathian hehpihna a om gige ding in ahanthawn uhi.
Huan Sabbath nawn in akhozang phial un Pathian thu ngaikhe ding in ahong kikhawm uhi.
Himahleh Judate'n mipite amuhtak un ahaza mahmah ua; Paul thugente kalh in agensia uhi.

Huchi in Paul leh Barnabas in hangsantak in adawng ua, "Pathian thu noumau kiang ah gen masak ding him ahi; himahleh na nial ua, tangtawn a hing tak lou a na kiseh nung un, thei un, Zentelte lam ka ngata uh," achi uhi.
Huchibang in Toupa'n thu ahon pia hi, "Zentelte hihvakpa ding in ka hon sep a, kawlmong pha a Hondampa dia na omtheihna ding in, chih gelh bang in,” achi hi.
Zentelte'n huai thu azak un, akipak ua, Toupa thu apahtawi ua, tangtawn a hing ding a sehkholh peuhmah in agingta uhi.
Toupa thu huai gam kimvel ah adalhta hi.
Himahleh Judate'n numei zahtakhuai Pathian limsakte leh kho upate hanthawn in, Paul leh Barnabas soisasak in, agam ua kipan adelhkhia uhi.
Amau leng atung uah akhepek ua leivui asingkhia ua, Ikoniam ah apaita uhi.
Huan nungzuite kipahna leh Kha Siangthou in adim chiat uhi.
Ikoniam ah Judate sinagog ah alutkhawm ua, thu agen zel uhi, huchi in Judate leh Grik mipi tampi in leng agingtata uhi.
Himahleh agingta nuam lou Judate'n Zentelte lungsim atokthou ua, unaute ahosak uhi.
Huaiziak in Toupa ah hangtak a thu gen in huai ah sawt sim a-om uhi. Ama'n chiamtehna leh thillamdangte akhut ua hihsak in, ahehpihna thu atheisak zel hi.
Himahleh khua a mipite akilangta ua, akhen in Judate agum ua, akhen in sawltakte agum uhi.
Zentelte leh Judate aheutute uh toh pangkhawm in sawltakte simmohhuaitak a bawl a suang a den atup lai un,
amau ana thei ua, Likonia gam mah, Listra leh Darbi ah leh akim gam ah ataimang uhi.
Huai ah tanchinhoih agen zom zel uhi.
Listra ah khezaw kuahiam atu a, apian tung a pan khebai him ahi a, khe in apai ngei kei hi.
Huai mi'n Paul thugen angaikhia a; huan Paul in a-en gegu a, damna ding in ginna anei chih athei a, aw ngaihtak in, “Na khe in dingtang in,” achi hi.
Huan amah atawm a, khe in apaita hi.
Mipite'n Paul thilhih amuh un, Likonia pau in aw ngaihtak in, “Mihing melpu in i kiang uah pathiante ahong sukta uh e!" achi uhi.
Amaute'n Barnabas pen, "Jupiter" achi ua, Paul bel thugenpi pen ahih ziak in, "Hermes" achi uhi.
Huan Jupiter siampu, khopi lutna a atempul om in, bawngtalte leh pakkhigui limte kongpi ah ahon tawi a, mipite toh biakna ding in lat atum uhi.
Himahleh sawltak Barnabas leh Paul in huai azak un, apuan uh abotkek ua, mipi lak ah adianglut ua, akikou uhi.

"Pute aw, hiai thilte bangziak a hih na hi ua? Kou leng noumau hindan toh kibang pu, mihing ka hi ve ua le; hiai thil ginaloute na kiheisan ua, van, lei, tuipi leh asung ua om tengteng bawlpa Pathian hing kiang a na hong kiheina ding un tanchinhoih ka hon tun uhi.
Pathian in nidanglai in nam chih amau lampi chiat zuih aphal hi.
Himahleh amah theihsakna om lou in akibawl kei, huchi in thil ahihhoih zel a, van a kipan in vuahtui ahon pia a, na lungtang uh nek ding leh kipahna a hihdim gige akei hiam," achi uhi.
Huchi in huai thu in mipite'n amaute biakna dia gan agoh ding uh akhamzou teitei hi.
Himahleh Antiok leh Ikoniam ah Juda mi kuate hiam ahong ua, mipite akhempukta uhi; huchi in suang in Paul adeng ua, si hi a agintak ziak un khua a kipan akaikhia uhi.
Himahleh nungzuite akim a adin lai un, ahong thou a, khua ah alut nawnta hi. Huan azing in Barnabas toh Darbi ah apaita uhi.
Huan huai khuate kiang ah tanchinhoih ahilh ua, nungzui tampi abawl nung un Listra, Ikoniam leh Antiok khua ah akik nawn uhi.
Gim tampi thuak in Pathian lalgam i lut ding ahi him ahi, chi in nungzuite lungsim ahihkip ua, ginna a om gige ding in ahanthawn uhi.
Huan saptuam pawl teng ah upate asehsak ua, an ngawl kawm a athum khit un, agin uh Toupa kiang ah akemsak zelzel uhi.
Pisidia gam atawnsuak ua, Pamphilia gam atung uhi.
Perga a thu agen khit un Attalia ah ahohsuk uhi.
Huai a kipan in long in apawt ua, Antiok khua ahong tung nawnta uhi. Huai mun ahi tua athilhih khitsa uh hih ding a unaute'n Pathian hehpihna a kemsak a asawlkhiakna uh.
Huan a tun nung un asaptuamte asamkhawm ua, Pathian in, amaute zang a athilhihte leh Zentelte a dia ginna kongkhak ahonsakdan ahilh uhi.
Huan nungzuite kiang ah sawt sim a-om uhi.
Mi kuate hiam Judia gam a kipan in ahong suk ua unaute kiang ah, "Mosi Dan bang a zek na sum kei uleh hotdam na hi thei kei ding uh," chi in ahong gen uhi.

Huchi in Paul leh Barnabas in amaute kalh in nakpitak a kisel a akilan ziak un, huai thubuai tungtang a Jerusalem a sawltakliante leh upate va mu ding in Paul leh Barnabas, leh alak ua kuate hiam asep uhi.
Huchi in saptuamte'n ava kha ua, amau Zentelte hong kikhekdan thu gen zel in, Phoinisia gam leh Samaria gam atawnsuakta uh; huchi in unaute tengteng akipaksak mahmah uhi.
Jerusalem atuntouh un saptuam pawlte, sawltakte, upate'n ana kipahpih ua; Pathian in amau zang a athilhihte apuangkhe zelzel uhi.
Himahleh Pharisai pawl a mi gingta kuate hiam akisa ua, "Zentelte zeksum ding leh Mosi Dan azuih chiat ding uh ahi," achi uhi.
Huan sawltakliante leh upate, huai thu ngaihtuah ding in akikhawm uhi.
Nakpi a akisel nung un Peter adingtou a, akiang uah, "Mite leh unaute aw, Zentelte'n keimah kam a tanchinhoih thu za a gingta ding a, Pathian in nidanglai a na lak ua kipan ahon sehdan na thei uhi.
Lungsim theipa Pathian in eite hon piak bang mah in Kha Siangthou akiang ua pe sam in atung uah akipak chih atheisak hi.
Huan eite leh amau khentuam nei lou in ginna in alungsim uh ahihsiangthou hi.
Huchi in i pipute leh eite'n i zuih zoh louhsa hakkol, tu'n ah nungzuite tung a ngak tum a bangziak a Pathian kalh na hi ua?
Amau gintak bang mah in eite'n leng Toupa Jesu hehpihna ziak a hotdam ding hi in i kigingta ngal ua,” achi hi.
Barnabas leh Paul in, amaute zang a Pathian in Zentelte lak a chiamtehna leh thillamdang ahih thu agen lai un mipite'n ngaikhia in adai sipsip uhi.
Huchi a mipite adaih sipsip zoh un Jakob in adawng a, “Unaute aw, ka thu ngaikhia un, chi in agen sam hi.
Simeon in, Pathian in amah min pu ding leh alak ua kipan mite lakhe ding in Zentelte aveh tungthu agenta hi.
Huai thu leh zawlneite thu, gelh a omsa toh akituak hi.
Huai khit chiang in ka kik nawn ding a, David biakbuk chimsia ka bawl nawn ding a, asiatna lai ka puah ding a, ka tungding nawn ding.
Midang akhosuaksunte leh ka min pu Zentelte ka min kikoppihte'n, Toupa azonna ding un huai thilte tengteng ahihta hi," chi in.
"Khovel siamchil a kipan hiai thu theisakpa Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
"Huaiziak in Zentelte lak a Pathian lam ngate hihgim kei ni chih ka thusawm ahi.
Milim biakna in abuahsak thilsiang lou, kingaihna nin, sa heklup leh sisan nek atawpsanna ding un akiang uah laigelh zaw lehang, ka chi pen hi.
Mosi Dan lah nidanglai a kipan kho teng ah athu tangkoupih ahih ban ah sinagog peuh ah Sabbath niteng in athu sim ahi,” achi hi.

Huan sawltakte, upate, saptuam tengteng toh, apawl ua mitel, Paul leh Barnabas kiang ah Antiok a hohsak hoih asa ua; atelte uh min Judas, Barnabas achih uh leh Silas ahi ua, huai mite unaute lak a heutu deuhte ahi uhi.
Hichibang in agelh ua, akhut uah akhak uh: "Sawltakte leh unaute lak a upate'n Antiok khua, Siria gam leh Silisia gam a Zentel unaute chibai abuk uhi.

Ka pawl lak ua mi kuate hiam in noute kiang a thu gen in, zeksum ding leh Mosi Dan zui ding in ahon hihbuai ua, na lungsim uh ahon mangbangsak uh chih ka za ua, amaute hiai thu gen ding in ka sawl kei uhi.
Huaiziak in thukhat sat a ka kikhop un, ka deihtak uh Barnabas leh Paul,
Toupa Jesu Khrist min ziak a sih khawk saloute toh, mitelte na kiang ua hon sawl hoih ka sa uhi.
Huchi in Judas leh Silas ka hon sawl uhi, amau leng hiai thu mah kam in ahon hilh ding uhi.
Hiai thu poimohte ka gelhte uh chih louh ngal Kha Siangthou leh koute'n puakgik tuan na tung uah bangmah nga kei le ung hoih ka sa uhi.
Milim biakna sa nek, sa sisan nek leh kingaih tawpsan le uchin ka chi uhi; hiaite na tawp uleh nou a ding in ahoih ding hi. Damtak in om un,” chi in.
Huchi in asawl un akuan ua, Antiok khua atungsuk ua; mipi asamkhawm ua, lai apia uhi.
Huan asim khit un lungmuanna thu ziak in akipak mahmahta uhi.
Judas leh Silas in, zawlnei leng ahi ua, thu tampi in unaute akhamuan ua, ahihkip uhi.
Huan huai a sawt khop a-om nung un amau sawltakte kiang apai nawn ding in, unaute'n khamuangtak in apawtsak nawnta uhi.
Bang teng hileh Silas in bel akiang ua om takdih hoih asa hi.
Paul leh Barnabas bel midang tampite toh Antiok ah Toupa thuhilh leh gen in a-om nilouh uhi.
Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Paul in Barnabas kiang ah, "Kho teng a Toupa thu i genna peuh a unau omte va veh nawn in, a-omdan uh va en lehang," achi hi.
Barnabas in Johan, Marka achih uh, akiang ua tonpih atum hi.
Himahleh Paul in bel, ama'n Pamphilia gam a amaute kiksan a, nasepna a akiang ua ahoh louh ziak in tonpih hoih asa kei hi.
Huchi in nakpi in akiselta ua, huan akikhen ua Barnabas in Marka atonpih a, Kupra tuikulh lam ah long in apaita hi.
Paul in Silas atel a, unaute'n Toupa hehpihna akepsak nung un apaikheta uhi.
Huan saptuam pawlte hihkip zel in Siria leh Silisia gam atawnsuak uhi.
Huchi in Darbi khua leh Listra ah leng ahoh a; huai ah nungzui khat amin Timothi a-om hi. Amah gingta Juda numei tapa, apa bel Grik ahi;
Listra leh Ikoniam khua a unau omte'n amah aphat mahmah uhi.
Paul in akiang a hoh sam ding in adeih a; huchi in huai a Juda omte ziak in zek asumsak a, apa Grik ahi chih lah athei vek ngal ua.
Kho teng a apai kawm un Jerusalem a sawltak leh Upa omte vaihawm zui ding in unaute kiang ah thupiak zuih ding ape zel uhi.
Huchi in ginna ah saptuam pawlte akipta ua, niteng in akhang deuhdeuh uhi.
Huan Kha Siangthou in Asia gam a thugen akham ziak in Phrigia leh Galatia gam a tawnsuakta uhi.
Misia gam ahong tun nung un, Bithinia gam lut atum ua; himahleh Jesu Kha in aphal kei hi.
Huchi in Misia gam tawn in Troas ah ahohsukta uhi.
Zan in Paul in mengmu bang in Masidonia gam a mi khat dingh a, "Masidonia gam ah hong galkai inla, hong huh in," chi a thumthum in amu hi.
Huan huai mengmuhna aneih khit in akiang ua tanchinhoih gen ding in Pathian in hon sam ahi, chih kichiantak a thei in, Masidonia gam ah hoh ka tum pah uhi.
Huan Troas a kipan long in ka pawt ua, tangtak in Samothrasi ah ka pai ua, azing in Neapoli ah ka pai nawn uh;
huai a kipan in Phillippi ah ka pai ua, huai khua tuh Masidonia gam a khua khat Rome a mipemte khua ahi a, huai uk a kho poimohpen ahi. Huai khua ah ni tamsim ka tamta uhi.
Huan Sabbath ni in kulh kongpi polam lui gei ah, thumna mun hi a ka gintakna uah ka hoh ua; huan ka tu ua, numei hong paikhawmte kiang ah thu ka gen uhi.
Huan amin Lidia, puan sandup zuak, Thiatira khomi, Pathian bia numei khat in ka thu uh aza a; huan Paul thugen zui ding in Toupa'n alungtang ahonsak hi.
Amah leh a-inkuanpihte'n baptisma atan khit un, "Toupa a ginom a na hon seh uleh ka inn ah hong tung un," chi in ahon ngen a, ahon khou hi.
Huan thumna mun a ka hoh lai un, sikha nungak kuahiam dawi aisan siam zawl in ahon kituahpih a, ama'n a-aisan ziak in apute sum tampi amuhsak zel hi.
Huai mi in Paul leh kou ahon zui a, “Hiai mite, hotdamna lampi nou hon hilhte, tungnungpen Pathian sikha ahi uh," chi in akikou hi.
Huchibang in ni tampi ahih hi. Huchi in Paul alungkimta kei a, akihei a dawi kiang ah, "Jesu Khrist min in asung a kipan pawt thu ka hon pia,” achi hi. Huchi in ahong pawtkhe pah hi.
Huan apute'n asummuhna uh amang chih atheihtak un, Paul leh Silas aman ua, heutute ma ah dawr mun ah akailut uhi.
Huchi in vaihawmte kiang ah api ua, “Hiai mite Judate ahi uh, ka khua uh ahihbuai mahmah uhi.
Rome mite a dia kipahpih huai lou leh zuih siangloute chindan agengen uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in mipite sawltakte sual ding in ahong dingkhia ua, vaihawmte'n apuan uh asahkeksak ua, chiang a sat ding in thu apia uhi.
Huan tamveipi asat khit un suangkul ah akhum ua, avengpa kiang ah bittak a ven ding, achi bikbek uhi.
Huchi tel a thu apiak ziak un ama'n tanna sungnung ah akhum a, akhe uh singkol abunsak hi.
Himahleh zan lai in, Pathian kiang ah Paul leh Silas athum ua, la asa ua, hentate'n angaikhia uhi.
Thakhat in zin nakpitak in ahong ling a, huchi in suangkul suangphumte tan in alingsak a, kongkhak tengteng akihong pah a, saltang chih kolbutte akiphel vekta hi.
Huan asuangkul vengpa ihmu ahong halh a, suangkul kongkhakte kihong in amu a, hentate taimang uh asa a, anamsau adokkhia a, kithah atum hi.
Himahleh aw ngaihtak in Paul akikou a, "Bangmah kichih ke'n, ka vek un hiai ah ka om lai uh," achi hi.
Huan suangkul vengpa'n khawnvakte azong a, asung a tawmlut in, ling kawm in Paul leh Silas ma ah abokkhup hi.
Amaute apikhia a, "Pute aw, hotdam a ka omna ding in bang ahia ka hih ding?" achi hi.
Huan amau, "Toupa Jesu ging inla, huchi in hotdam in na om ding, nang leh na inkuanpihte toh," achi uhi.
Amah leh a-inn a om teng kiang ah Toupa thu agen uhi.
Huai zan lai mah in apikhia a, asatna golhte uh asilsiangsak a; amah leh a-inkuanpihte tengteng in baptisma atang uhi.
A-inn ah apitou a nek ding alui a, Pathian agintak ziak un, amah leh a-inkuanpihte, akipak mahmah uhi.
Khua ahong vak in vaihawmte'n, mimante sawl in, “Huai mite khah in," achi uhi.
Suangkul vengpa'n, Paul kiang ah athu uh ahilh a, "Vaihawmte'n nou khah ding in mi ahon sawl uh; huaiziak in tu'n hong pawt unla, khamuangtak in paita un," achi hi.

Himahleh Paul in akiang uah, "Rome khomi ka hi ngal ua, ka siamna uleh siamlouhna uh thei lou in vantang mitmuh in na hon sat ua, suangkul ah na hon khum ua; tua aguk a hon khah maw na hon sawm uh? Hilou! Amau mahmah hong uhenla, hong pikhia uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in mimante'n huai thute vaihawmte kiang ah ahilh uhi. Rome mi ahi uh chih azak un alauta mahmah uhi.
Va hoh in thupha ava tawi ua, huan apikhia ua, khua pawtsan ding in angen uhi.
Huan suangkul a kipan apawt ua, Lidia inn ah alut uhi. Unaute amuh un, akhamuan ua, apawtta uhi.
Amphipolis khua leh Appolonia khua tawn in, Thessalonika khua atungta ua, huai ah Judate sinagog a-om hi.
Paul, adan ngeina bang in, akiang uah alut a, Sabbath ni thumvei Laisiangthou a kipan in teltak in asutpih hi.
Khrist in gimthuak ding him ahihdan leh misi lak a kipan a thounawn ding ahihdan hilhchian in, ahihlang zel hi. "Hiai Jesu, athu ka hon hilh, amah Khrist ahi," chi in agen behlap hi.
Huchi in alak ua khenkhat in agingta ua, Pathian limsak Grik mipi tampitak leh numei makai tampi toh Paul leh Silas akithuahpihta uhi.
Himahleh gingta lou Judate'n ahaza ua; dawr mun a migilou thadah kuate hiam akiang uah atonpih ua, mipi samkhawm in kho pumpi atokbuai ua, Jason inn aluh ua, vantang kiang a pikhiak atum uhi.
Amau amuh louhtak un Jason leh unau dang kuate hiam kho heutute kiang ah akailut ua, akikou ua, "Khovel tokbuai a lumlette hiai ah ahong uh,
Jason in ana zintun a; hiai mite'n Kaisar vaihawmna kalh in kumpipa dang khat, amin Jesu a-om," achi uhi.
Huan mipi leh kho heutute'n huai thu azak un abuaita uhi.
Jason leh midangte tatkhiakna ding banghiam ala ua, amau tuh akhahta uhi.
Huan unaute'n azanzan in Beriah ah Paul leh Silas apaisak pah ua; huai lai ava tun un Judate sinagog ah alut uhi.
Huai mite Thessalonika khote sang in ana hoihzaw ua, huchi in lungsim kipaktak in thu apom ua, athugen uh adik leh diklouh theihna ding in niteng in Laisiangthou azong zel uhi.
Huchi in huaite mi tampi in agingtata ua; Grik numei zahtakhuai leh pasalte leng tampi mahmah in agingtata uhi.
Himahleh Thessalonika a Judate'n, Paul in Beriah ah Pathian thu agen chih azaktak un, huai ah leng ava hoh ua, mipite hanthawn in, ahihbuai nawn uhi.
Huchi in unaute'n tuipi tan a pai ding in Paul asawlkhia ua, Silas leh Timothi bel huai ah a-om tadih uhi.
Paul pitute'n Athen khua tan in api ua; Silas leh Timothi kintak a akiang a hong pai ding thupiak toh apaikikta uhi.
Huan Paul in Athen a amau ana ngak lai in, huai khua milimte a dim in amu a, alungtang in na asa mahmah hi.
Huchi in sinagog ah Judate leh Pathian limsakte ahoulimpih zel a, dawr mun ah leng huai a na om peuhmahte toh niteng in akihoulim zel uhi.

Huan Epikuria mi leh Stoik mi lak a mipil kuate hiam in leng amah ahong kiselpih uhi. "Hiai mi kamtam in bang ahia gen atup?" achi ua, akhen in, "Jesu thu leh thohnawnna thu agen ziak in gamdang pathiante thugenpa ahih tuak e," achi uhi.
Amah alen ua, Areopagus ah api ua, akiang ah, "Hiai sinsakna thak na gengen na hon theisak thei diam?
Thillamdang banghiam ka bil uah na hon tun ahi; huchi in hiai thil omdan theih ka ut uh," achi uhi.
Athen khomi tengteng, huai amikhualte toh, aman peuh ualeh thu thak photphot gen hiam, angaikhe ding in ahunte uh azang zel uhi.
Huchi in Areopagus laitak ah Paul adingh a, "Nou Athen a mite aw, bangkim ah sabiak limsakmi na hi uh chih ka thei hi.
Ka vak kawm a, na biaknate uh ka et lai in, maitam khat, atung a, 'Theih louh pathian' a ding,' chi a kigelh ka mu ahi. Huchi in thei lou a na biak uh, huai thu ka hon hilh ahi zaw hi," achi hi.
Pathian, khovel leh asung a thil tengteng siampa, lei leh van Toupa ahih ziak in khut a lam inn peuh ah a-om kei hi.
Thil tasam bang in mihing khut a nna sepsak in leng a-om kei, amah mah bangkim kiang a hinna, hatna leh thil tengteng pepa ahi zaw hi.
Huan leitung maikaih teng a om ding in bul mun khat vek in nam chih asiam a, amau a ding in hunbi asehsak a, tenna ding gamgi akhunsak hi.
Ama'n hon gamlat kei mahleh mi tengteng in Pathian azon ua, amai amai ua, amuh teiteina ding ua alemgel ahi.
Noumau laphuahsiam kuate hiam in leng, "Eite leng asuante i hi uh, chi a agen bang un. Amah vang in i hing in i tang in, i om uhi."
Huchi in "Pathian suante i hih nung, Pathian zaw dangka-eng hiam, dangka hiam, suang hiam, mihing khutsiam leh suktuah sekte bang ahi chih i gingta ding uh ahi kei.
Huchi in Pathian in i theih louh hun lai khawng akitheihmohbawl a; himahleh, tu'n ah zaw gam chih a mi tengteng kisik ding thu apeta,
Pathian in amiseh zang a dikna a khovel vai ahawm ni ding achiam ziak in; amiseh tungthu amah misi lak a kipan a kaithou in, mi tengteng kiang ah atheisakta hi," achi hi.
Huan misi thohnawnna thu azaktak un, akhen in anuihsan ua; akhen in, “Hiai thu na kiang ah ka ngaikhe nawn ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Paul tuh alak ua kipan apawtta hi.
Himahleh mi kuate hiam amah lam ah apang tinten ua, agingtata ua, huaite lak a khenkhat Areopagus mi Dionisias leh numei khat amin Damaris leh akiang ua midangte toh ahi uhi.
Huai thilte zoh in Athen a kipan Paul apawt a, Korinth ah ahohta hi.

Huan amin Akuila, Juda khat amu a, huai mi Pontus gam a piang ahi a, Klaudias in Judate tengteng Rome a kipan pawt thu apiak ziak a azi Priscilla toh Itali gam a kipan hong tung phet ahi uhi. Huai mite kiang ah Paul atungta hi.
Anasep uh kibang ahih ziak in amau akikoppih in nna asemkhawm ua; anasep uh puanin bawl ahi.
Sabbath teng in sinagog ah chitaktak in thu agen zel a, Judate leh Grikte thuzoh atum hi.
Masidonia gam a kipan Silas leh Timothi ahong tun un, Paul tuh kha phutluih in thu nasem in a-om a, tua Jesu zaw Khrist ahi chih Juda mite kiang ah atheihpih zel hi.
Himahleh akalh un agensia ua, Paul in apuan asing a, akiang uah, “Na sisan moh uh noumau lutung ah om hen; kei zaw ka hul ahi; tuban Zentelte kiang ah ka paita ding,” achi hi.
Huan huai a kipan apai a, amin Titas Justas mi khat inn ah alut a, huai mi'n Pathian abe zel hi, a-inn leng sinagog toh kizom ahi.
Huan Krispus pa sinagog heutu in a-inkuanpihte tengteng toh Toupa agingta a, Korinth a mi tampi'n leng za in agingta ua, baptisma atang uhi.
Zan in Toupa'n Paul kiang ah mengmu bang in, "Lau ke'nla, dai lou in thu gen zel in;
kei na kiang ah ka om akei hiam, sihna ding in kuamah in na tung ah khut akha kei ding uhi; hiai khua ah mi tampi ka nei ngal a," achi hi.
Huan huai ah alak uah Pathian thu hilh in kum khat leh kha guk a-omta hi.
Huan Akaia gam-ukpa Gallio ahih lai in Judate'n kituak in Paul kalh in buaina abawl ua, vaihawmna tutphah ma ah api uhi.
“Huai mi'n dan lou bang in a Pathian be ding in mi athuzoh," achi uhi.
Paul in adawn dekleh Gallio in, Judate kiang ah, "Judate aw, hiai thil diklou thu hiam, thilhihkhelh thu hiam bek hileh, pel lou in ka hon awlmoh ding hi.
Himahleh thumalte leh minte, noumau dan thu lel zaw noumau kingaihtuah zaw un; ke'n zaw huchibang thu ngaihtuah ka ut kei," achi hi.
Huan vaihawmna tutphah a kipan in amau adelhkheta hi.
Huan Grik mi tengteng in sinagog heutu Sostheni aman ua, vaihawmna tutphah ma ah avua uhi. Gallio in athilhih uh khawk asa kei hi.

Huai zoh in Paul ni sawttak ataam nilouh a; huai zoh in unaute kampha in akha a, huai a kipan Siria gam lam ah long in apaita a, akiang ah Priscilla leh Akuila leng apai uhi. Paul in thuchiam aneih ziak in Kenkriai ah sam amet phot hi.
Huan Ephesa atung ua, huai ah amau anusia a; himahleh amah kia sinagog ah alut a, Judate kiang ah chitaktak in thu asutpih hi.
Huan sawt deuh taam ding in akhou ua, himahleh ama'n lem asa kei a,
"Pathian in aphalleh na kiang uah ka hong nawn ding," chi in kampha in akhen a, Ephesa a kipan long in apaita hi.
Huan Kaisaria ah ahong kai a, Jerusalem ah ahohtou a, saptuamte chibai buk in, Antiok ah ahohsukta hi.
Huan huai a sawt kuam a-om nung in apai nawn a, nungzuite tengteng hihhat in Galatia gam leh Phrigia gam atawnsuak vek hi.
Huan Juda mi khat, amin Apollos, Aleksandria a piang, mipiltak, Ephesa ah ahohsuk a; ama'n Laisiangthou anak theih mahmah hi.
Hiai mi'n Toupa Lampi thu zilsa ahi a, lungsim a phatuamngaitak ahih ziak in Toupa thu ahilh zel hi, Johan baptisma thu kia athei hi.
Sinagog ah hangsantak in thu agen hi. Huchi in Priscilla leh Akuila in athugen azak un, a-inn uah leh akiang ah Pathian Lampi thu kichian sem in ahilhchianta uhi.
Ama'n Akhaia gam a paikai atuptak in unaute'n ahanthawn ua, amah ana kipahpihna ding un nungzuite kiang ah lai agelhsak uhi. Huan atun in, Pathian hehpihna ziak a gingtate nakpitak in apanpih hi.
Vantang theih in Judate nakpitak in aseldong a, Laisiangthou zang in tua Jesu zaw Khrist ahi ngei chih atheisak hi.
Korinth a Apollos a-om kal in Paul in saklam gamte tawnsuak masa kawm in, Ephesa khua atung a, huai ah nungzui kuate hiam amu hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Na gintak chil ua pan Kha Siangthou na tang uhia?" achi hi. Amaute'n akiang ah, "Tang lou, Kha Siangthou a-om chih zak leng ka za kei uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Bang baptisma ahia na tan uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Johan baptisma," achi uhi.
Huan Paul in, "Johan in zaw anung a hong paipa Jesu gingta ding a mite hilh in kisikna baptisma in abaptis zel ahi," achi hi.
Huan huai thu azaktak un Toupa Jesu min in baptisma atang uhi.
Paul in atung uah akhut akoih a, Kha Siangthou atung uah ahong tungta hi. Huchi in pautuamte in thu agen ua; Pathian thu leng ahilhta uhi.
Avek un piching sawm-le-nih vel ahi uhi.
Huan sinagog ah Paul alut zel a, kha thum phial hangsantak in thu agen a, Pathian lalgam thu ahihna sutpih in, mi athuzoh zel hi.
Himahleh akhen achihhak ua, agingta nuam kei uh, mipi ma a Lampi agensiattak un, ama'n amaute apaisan a, nungzuite apituam a, niteng in kisinsakna mun Tairanas ah thu hilh in asutpih zel hi.
Huchibang ngen in kum nih phial ahih a; huchi in Asia gam a om tengteng, Judate leh Grikte'n leng Toupa thu azata uhi.
Pathian in Paul khut in thillamdang taktak ahihsak hi.
Huchi in ataksa sukha kinulna puan neu, puan tungsilh damloute kiang ah ahon tawi ua, anatnate uh adam zel hi, asung ua kipan dawite leng apawt uhi.
Huan Juda mi dawi hawlkhia chi a vakvai dawithu thei kuate hiam in, "Paul in athu tangkoupih Jesu Khrist min in ka hon vau hi, chi in dawimatte tung ah Toupa Jesu min alou uhi."
Juda mi siampu lianpen khat Skeva in huchibang hih tapa sagih anei hi.
Himahleh dawi in akiang uah, "Jesu ka gingta, Paul leng ka thei, nou kuate na hi ua?" chi in adawng hi.
Huan dawipai in aboh a, avek un azou a, anuaisiahta hi; huchi in huai mipa inn a kipan vuaktang leh liam in ataikheta uhi.
Huchi in Ephesa a om tengteng, Judate leh Grikte kiang ah huai mi thu athangta hi. Huan avek un alau ua, Toupa Jesu min alianta hi.
Huan agingtate leng akhen tampi ahong ua, athilhihkhelhte uh thupha atawi ua, akipulak uhi.
Mitkhialdawi hihmi akhen tampi in leng alaibute uh ahon tawikhawm ua, mi tengteng mitmuh in ahalta uh; huan aman asut ua dangka singnga hi in athei uhi.
Huchi lawmlawm a thupi in Toupa thu adalh a, azou zel hi.
Huan huai khit in, Paul in Masidonia gam leh Akhaia gam tawtsuak takdih a, Jerusalem a hoh atum hi. "Huai a ka hoh khit chiang in Rome khua ka sik sam ding," achi hi.
Huchi in amah nasepsakte nih Timothi leh Erastas, Masidonia gam ah apaisak phot a, amah bel Asia gam ah ataam tadih hi.
Huai lai in Lampi ziak in mi buai petmah in abuaita uhi.
Mi khat amin Demetrias, dangkasik sek a Diana milim bawlpa a-om a, khutsiamte a ding in kilohna tampi apia hi.
Hiai mi in amaute asamkhawm a, anasep bang uh semte toh; huan akiang uah, "Pute aw, hiai nasepna i hauhna uh ahi chih na thei uhi.

Hiai Ephesa khua kia hilou in, Asia gam kho kim teng phial ah leng, Paul in khut a bawl pathiante, Pathian ahi kei uh chi in mi tampi thuzoh in, akiheisak khinta chih noumau ngei in na mu un na za uhi.

Huchi in i nekzonna un athuak ding chih alauhuai kia hilou in, pathiannu thupitak Diana tempul leng ahon ngaineu ding uh. Asia gam a mi tengteng leh khovel a mi'n abiak zel uh, athupipi toh, ahong neu ding chih alauhuai hi," achi hi.
Huai thu azaktak un, aheh mahmah ua, "Ephesa a Diana thupitak ahi," chi in akikou uhi.
Huchi in akhua in apumbuai vekta ua, Gaias leh Aristarkhas, Masidonia gam a mi, Paul nungzuite, aman ua, kituaktak in etnop inn ah ataipih kheukhou uhi.
Paul in mipi lak a lut atupleh nungzuite'n aphal kei uhi.
Asia gam a heutupente lak a khenkhat kuate hiam Paul lawmte ahi ua, akiang ah mi asawl ua, etnop inn ah lut teitei lou ding in akun uhi.
Omkhawmte abuai ua, mi tamzaw in akikhopna san uh leng athei kei uh, khenkhat thukhat in akikou ua, khenkhat thudang in akikou uhi.
Mipi lak a mi khenkhat in Alexander, asiamna thu gendan ding ahilhta ua, Judate'n amah malam ah asawnphei uhi. Huan Alexander in akhut in azap a, mi tengteng kiang ah asiamna thu gen atum hi.
Himahleh amah Juda mi ahi chih atheihtak un, dakkal nih sung aw kituaktak in, "Ephesate Diana athupi hi," chi ngen in akikou uhi.
Huan khosung laigelhpa'n mipi asukdaih khit in, "Ephesa a mite aw, Diana thupitak tempul kemtu leh van a kipan a milim kia, Ephesa khuate a kem na hi uh chih, kua ahia thei lou om?
Huchi in hiai thu sel vual ahih louh nung in, na dai dide ding uh ahi, thunung veng lou in bangmah na hih ding uh ahi kei hi.
Hiai mi hiai mun a na hon pite uh, tempul lokmi ahi kei ua, i pathiannu gensete leng ahi kei uh.
Huchi in Demetrias leh alawm khutsiamte'n leng kua lak ah leng thubuai aneih uleh, thubuai genna innte honsa in a-om vele, gam ukpate leng a-om uhi; kihektuah uhen.
Thil dang buaina nei him na hih uleh, kikhopna ngeina ah alem ding uh.
Tuni a thu vengvung ziak in salh lauhuai in i omta uh, athu om ngel lou buaina bawl a ngoh theih i hi ngal ua, hiai kikhopna san bangmah gen ding thei lou ding i kei uhiam," achi hi.
Huan huchibang thu agen khit in omkhawm heutute akikhenzak sakta hi.
Pentikost ni ahong tun in, avek un mun khat ah a-omkhawm uhi.
Thakhat in van a kipan huihpi nung bang in ging ahong om guih a, huchi in huai in atutna inn uh ahihdim vekta hi,
leite amah-le-amah mei bang a kihawm in, alutung uah ahong tuang chiat hi.
Huchi in avek un Kha Siangthou in aluahdimta a, Kha in hihtheihna apiak a apausak bang zel in pau dangte in apauta uhi.
Huan van nuai nam chih lak a kipan Pathian limsak Juda kulmutte Jerusalem ah a-om uhi.
Huan ging husa azaktak un mipi ahong kikhawm ua, michih in apau uh amau pau chiat a azak ziak un alungsim uh ahong buai hi.
Huan avek un amangbang ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi, "En dih uh, hiai a pau tengteng Galili gam a mi ahi kei ua hia?
Bangchi in ahia i vek ua pianpih pau chiat a i zak uh?
Eite Parthai nam, Medes nam, Elam nam; khenkhat Mesopotamia gam a om, Judia gam a om, Kappadosia gam a om, Pontas gam a om, Asia gam a om,
Phrigia gam a om, Pamphilia gam a om, Aigupta gam a om, Kurini kho kiang a Libia gam a om i hi ua; khenkhat Rome a pan mikhualte, Judate leh aphungkaite uh toh i hi ngal ua,
khenkhat Krit tuikulh leh Arab gam a mite i hi ngal ua; himahleh, Pathian thilhih thupite agen uh eimau pau chiat in i za ngal ua!" achi uhi.
Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, akhiakna dan thei lou in, "Hiai bangchidan ahia?" akichi uhi.
Khenkhat in, "Uain thak akham ua ahi," chi in anuihsan uhi.
Himahleh Peter in sawm-le-khatte toh dingkhawm in, aw ngaihtak in akiang uah agen a, nou Judia gam a mite aw, nou Jerusalem a om tengteng aw, hiai thei unla, ka thu leng ngaikhia un.
Hiaite na gin bang un akham kei uh, dak thumna hun ahi.
Hiaite zawlnei Joel in agen ahi zaw:

"Pathian in, ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding, mi tengteng tung ah ka kha ka sungbo ding a; na tapa leh na tanute'n ka thu ahilh ding uh; na tangvalte un kilaknate amu ding ua, na putekte un mang anei ding uh.
Ahi, huai ni in ka sikhapate, ka sikhanute tung ah leng ka Kha ka sungbo ding a, ka thu agen ding uhi.
Huan tunglam van ah thillamdang nuailam lei ah chiamtehna ka musak ding a; sisan, mei, meikhu hu toh,
Nisa mial asuak ding a, kha sisan asuak ding, Toupa ni thupitak leh lauhuaitak ahong tun ma in.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, Toupa min lou peuhmah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
"Nou Israel mite aw, hiai thu za un: Nazaret Jesu, Pathian in amah zang in na lak uah thil thupite, thillamdangte, chiamtehnate ahih in ahon theichiansak hi; nou ngei in tuate na theichian uhi.
Huai mi Pathian' tupkholhsa leh theihkholh bang in na mansak ua, nou migiloute khut a kilhden in na hihlumta uhi.
Amah, Pathian in sihna thuaknatna phelsak in, akaithouta a; ama sihna letdet vual ahih louh ziak in.
Huan David in athu agen a, 'Ka ma ah chik lai peuh in Toupa ka mu gige hi. Ka mangbatlouhna ding in ka taklam ah a-om hi.
Huaiziak in ka lungtang anuam a, ka lei leng akipak a, ka sa lamentak in a-om behlap lai hi.
Misikhua ah ka kha na nuse kei ding a, muatna na Mi Siangthou na musak sam kei ding hi.
Nangma'n hinna lampite na hon theisak a; nangma'n na mel in kipak in na hon hihdim ding,'" chi in.
"Unaute aw, chikhahpa David thu lau lou in na kiang uah ka gen thei hi; amah zaw asi a, vui leng avui khinta ua, ahan leng tutan in i kiang ah a-om lai hi.
Amah tuh zawlnei ahi a, Pathian in akhal a mi kuahiam sadan a achite lak a mi khat Khrist laltutphah a tu ding in akaithou ding chih kichiam in agen chih athei hi.
Huchi in huai tuh atheihkholh him ziak in Khrist thohnawn ding thu agen hi, 'Misikhua a nutsiat in a-om kei a, aluang leng amuat sam kei hi, chi in.
"Pathian in Jesu akaithouta chih theihpihte i vek un i hi uhi.
Pathian khut taklam ah pahtawi in a-om a, Kha Siangthou chiam Pa kiang a kipan in amu a, na muh uh leh na zakte uh ahon sunbuak ahi uhi.
David zaw van ah akahtou kei, amah ngei in, Jehovah in ka Toupa kiang ah,
'Na melmate na khepek ngakna dia ka bawl masiah, Ka taklam ah tu kinken in,' " achi, ana chi hi.
"Huchi in Jesu, na kilhden uh, Pathian in Toupa leh Khrist hikhawm in abawlta chih Israel inkuan chih in kichiantak in thei uhen," achi hi.
Huan huai thu azak un alungtang ua sut bang ahong hi ua, Peter leh sawltak dangte kiang ah, "Unaute aw, bangchi in ka hihta ding ua?" achi ua.
Peter in akiang uah, "Na khelhnate uh ngaihdamna ding in lungsim khek unla, Jesu Khrist min in baptisma tang chiat un; huchi in Kha Siangthou thawnpiak na tang ding uhi.
Achiam nou a ding, na tate uh a ding, gamlapi a mi tengteng a ding leh Toupa i Pathian in akiang a asap peuhmahte a ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan thudang tampi in ahilhchian a; hiai khang thulimloute lak ah kihumbit un, chi in ahanthawn hi.
Huan athu zui peuhmah in baptisma atang ua, huai ni in mi sangthum vel behlap in a-om uhi.
Huan sawltakte thusinsakte sin in, kithuah in, tanghou balkham in, thum in, phatuamngaitak in a-omkhawm uhi.
Huan michih in alauta ua; sawltakte'n thillamdang leh chiam-tehna tampi ahih uhi.
Agingta peuhmah in bangkim akikopkhawm uhi.
Agoute uh, athil neihte uh azuak ua, adeihdong ching lel chiat in avek ua kiang ah ahawm zel uhi.
Huan niteng in, lungsim mun khat in, tempul ah phatuamngaitak in a-om zelzel ua, a-innte uah leng tanghou balkham in, nuam leh lungkim in, a-an uh ane zel uhi.
Pathian aphat ua, mi tengteng deihsak in a-om uhi. Huan ahotdam lel peuhmah Toupa'n niteng in akiang uah abehlapsak zel hi.
Buaina aven nung in, Paul in nungzuite asamsak a, ahanthawn a, kampha in akha a, Masidonia gam a pai ding in apawtta hi.
Thu tampi anungzuite hanthawn in huai gam atawnsuak a, Grikte gam atungta hi.
Huan huai ah kha thum ataam hi. Siria gam a long a azin dek kuan in, Judate'n amah thah asawm ziak un, Masidonia gam tawn a kilehkik atum zawta hi.
Asia gam tan a amah zuite, Beriah khomi Pirhas tapa Sopater, Thessalonika a pan Aristarkhas leh Sekundas, Darbe khomi, Gaias, Timothi leh Asia gam a Taikikas leh Trophimaste ahi uh.
Huaite'n ka ma uh akai ua, Troas ah hon na ngak uhi.
Kou bel Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ni abei in Philippi a kipan long in ka pawt ua, ni nga nung in Troas ah akiang uh ka tung uhi; huai ah ni sagih ka taam uhi.
Huan nipikal a ani masapen in, tanghou balkham ding a ka kikhop lai un, Paul in akiang uah thu agen hi; ama'n azingchiang a pai atup ziak in zankim tan hial thu agen hi.
Huan indan tungnung, ka omkhawmna uah khawnvak tampi a-om hi.

Huan amin Eutikas tangval khat tohlet ah atu a, nakpitak in ana ihmu hi. Huan Paul in thu agen sawt tak ziak in ama'n a-ihmut suak a thuakzou nawnta kei a, insawng thumna a kipan in aketa a, asisa in aphong uhi.
Himahleh Paul akumsuk a, bohkhum in a-angpom a, "Lunglau kei un, alaitat kei lai hi," achi hi.
Huan Paul akahtou nawn a, tanghou balkham in an ane a, khovak pha in akiang uah thu agen a, huai nung in apaita hi.
Huan valnoupa dam in api ua, akhamuang petmah uhi.
Huan koute Assos khua zuan in long in ka na pai masa ua, long ah Paul tuansak ka tum uhi; ama'n khe a paina lam tot atup ziak in huchibang tuh amah geldan ahi.
Huan Assos a ahon tuah chiang in, long ah ka tuangsakta ua, Mitilini khua ka tung uhi.
Huan huai a kipan in long in ka pai nawn ua, azing in Khios tuikulh gal ka tung ua; huan azing nawn in Samo tuikulh ka tung ua, Troguliam ah ka giak uhi. Azing nawn in Miletas khua ka tung nawn uhi.
Huan Paul in Asia gam a om sawt lou a, long a Ephesa khua khen atupsa him ahi a, ahihtheihleh Jerusalem a Pentikost ni huam tum in akinpai hi.
Huan Miletas a kipan in Ephesa ah mi asawl a, akiang ah saptuam upate asamsak hi.
Huan akiang ahong tun un, ama'n akiang uah, Asia gam ka tot chil ni a kipan na kiang ua ka om sung teng in ka omdan na thei uhi.
Thunuailutpen kawm leh Judate'n hon thah asawm ziak ua khitui kai leh thil haksa ka tung a tungte thuak kawm in Toupa nna ka sem hi.
Huchibang in aphatuam ding thu na kiang uah bangmah iim ka nei kei a, vantang lak leh inn teng ah thu ka hon hilh zel a,
Judate leh Grikte kiang ah leng Pathian lam a kisikna thu leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist lam a ginna thu ka theisak zel hi.
Ngai un, tu in Kha in hon sawl teitei a ka theih ziak in, Jerusalem a hoh dia kisa ka hi, huai ah ka tung a thil hong tung ding bangmah ka thei kei;
Kha Siangthou in, henna leh haksatna in nang ahon dawn hi, chi in kho teng ah ahon hilh zel hi, tuate kia ka theih ahi.

Himahleh ka kitaitehna lam ka maban tun ding leh Pathian hehpihna tanchinhoih a dia theihpihtu a pang ding a Toupa Jesu kiang a huai nasepna ka muh pen sem khin phot leng, ka hinna leng khiaklah tham in ka sep kei hi.
"Huan thei un, noute tengteng, Pathian lalgam thu tangkoupih a ka vakvaknate'n ka mel na mu nawnta kei ding uh chih ka thei hi.
Huaiziak in mi tengteng sisan ah ka hul ahi chih tuni in ka hon theisak hi.
Pathian vaihawm tengteng avek in na kiang uah iim ka nei kei hi.
Pathian saptuamte, ama sisan a aleite, vak ding in noumau leh na heute tengteng uh tung ah pilvang un, Kha Siangthou in atung uah nou heutu in ahon bawl hi.
Ka pai nung in na lak uah ngehangte ahong lut ding ua, pawlte ahawi kei ding uh chih ka thei hi.
Noumau lak a mi nangawn, nungzui pawlte amau lam a kaimang ding in thu tuam gen na hong om ding uh.
Huaiziak in limsak unla; kum thum hilhial khitui ke kawm a, sun leh zan a michih taihilh ka tawplouhdan, theigige un.
"Tu in noute Pathian leh ahehpihna ah ka hon kemsak hi, huai in noute ahon bawllian thei a, mi lungsim siangthoute kiang ah goutan ahon neisak thei lai hi.
Kuamah dangka, dangka-eng leh puansilh ka eng ngei kei.
Hiai khutte'n keimah leh ka lawmte taksap asepkhiak zeldan, noumau ngei in na thei uhi.

Bangkim ka hih peuhmah na chin ding ua ka hih ahi, huchibang a semgim leh Toupa Jesu thu theigige kawm in mihatloute na panpih ding uh ahi; amah mah in, 'Lak sang in piak in lukhawng anei zaw' achih," achi hi.
Huai thu agen khit in akhukdin a, avek un athum uhi.
Huan avek un akap huphup ua, Paul ngawng ah kawi in atawp uhi.
Amel amuh nawn tak louh ding thu agen alungkhamna pen uh ahi. Huan long pha in amah ava kha uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, amaute toh ka kikhen ua, long in ka pawt ua, huai khit in tangtak in Kos tuikulh ka tung ua, azing in Rhodes tuikulh ka tung nawn ua, huai a kipan in ka pai zel ua, Patara khua ka tung uhi.
Phoinisia gam pai ding long khat ka mu ua, ka tuang ua, ka pai zel uhi.
Huan Kupra tuikulh ka mu ua, veilam pang ah ka kheng ua, Siria gam ah ka pai zel ua, Tair ah long van nawnkhiak ding a-om man in ka kum phot uhi.
Nungzuite ka zongkhia ua, huai ah ni sagih ka taam uhi; huan Kha theihsak in Paul kiang ah, Jerusalem a hohtou lou ding in achi uhi.
Himahleh huai nite khit in ka pawt ua ka paita ua, unaute'n avek un, azi atate uh toh khopi pua dong ahong kha ua; tuipi piau ah ka khukdin ua, ka thum uhi.
Huan mangpha ka kikhak zoh un, long ah ka tuang ua, amau bel a-inn uah apai nawnta uhi.
Tair a kipan long a ka pai khit un Ptolemais khua ka tung ua, unaute chibai ka buk uhi, akiang uah ni khat ka nituang uhi.
Huan azing in ka pawt ua Kaisaria khua ka tung ua huai ah tanchinhoih genpa, Philip inn ah ka lut ua, amah ahihleh sagihte lak a khat ahi a, akiang ah ka taam uhi.
Huai mi'n, amau zawlnei bang a thu agen zel nungak siangthou ngen, tanu li anei hi.
Huai ah ni tampi ka taam ua, huai lai in Judia gam a kipan amin Agabas kichi zawlnei khat ahong suk hi.

Ka kiang uah ahong a, Paul kawnggak ala a, akhete, akhutte amah in akigak a, "Jerusalem a Judate'n hichibang in hiai kawnggak neipa agak ding ua, Zentelte khut ah ape lai ding uh, Kha Siangthou in achi,” achi hi.
Huan huai thu ka zaktak un, kou leh huai khua a mite'n Jerusalem a Paul hoh lou ding in ka khou chiat uhi.
Himahleh Paul in adawng a, "Bangchi na hi ua, na kahkah ua, na hon khasiatsak uh? Toupa Jesu min ziak in Jerusalem a hen kia hilou in, sih leng ngap ka hi," achi hi.
Huan khouhzoh vual ahih louhtak in, ka tawpta ua, "Toupa thuthu hi hen aw," ka chi uhi.
Huai nung in ka van uh ka bawl ua, Jerusalem ah ka hohtou uhi.
Kaisaria a mi nungzuite kuate hiam, ka kiang uah apai ua, amau, amin Mnason inn, nungzui masa pawl Kupra tuikulh a mi khat ka tunna dingpa uh api sam uhi.
Huan Jerusalem khua ka tun un unaute'n nuamtak in hon na kipahpih uhi.
Azing in Paul toh Jakob kiang ah ka lut ua; huai ah saptuam upate tengteng leng a-om uhi.
Paul in amau chibai abuk khit in, anasepna zang a Pathian in Zentelte lak a thil ahihsak peuhmah avek in agen hi.
Unaute'n huai thu azak un Pathian apahtawi uh; huan Paul kiang ah, "Unaupa, Judate lak a gingtami tamdan na mu a; avek un dan lam ah phatuam angai lai uhi.
Nang Zentelte lak a Juda omte tengteng kiang ah atate uh zeksum louh ding leh dan bang a om louh ding chi in Mosi Dan paihkhiakna ding na thuhilh zel chih mi kam ah na thu athei vek uhi," achi uhi.
"Bangchi hita ding ahia le? Na hong tung chih aza ngal ding ua.
Huaiziak in na kiang a ka gen bang un hih in; thuchiam nei pasal li ka kiang uah a-om uhi.

Huai mite pi in la, akiang uah kisiangsak sam inla, asam uh amettheihna ding un amau a ding in sum seng in; huchi in mi tengteng in mi kam a na thu azak teng uh gen tham ahi kei chih athei ding ua, nangmah mah dan zui in kichiantak in na om zaw chih athei ding uhi.
Zentelte lak a gingtate thu zaw, milim biakna thil nek lam ah, sa sisan nek thu ah, sa heklup nek lam ah, kingaih lam a kipan in akihulsak ding uh ahi, chi in ka gen ua, ka gelhta uhi," achi uhi.
Huan azing in Paul in pasalte atonpih a, amau toh akisiangsak a, tempul ah alut a, amaute a ding a kithoihna apiaksak chiat masiah kisiansakna ni anei phot ding uh chih, siampu kiang ah ahilh hi.
Kisiansuahna ni sagih achin dektak in Asia gam a Judate'n tempul ah Paul amu ua, mipi tengteng atokthou ua, amah aman ua, kikou in,

"Israel mite aw, hong huh un! Hiai mi, gam teng a mi tengteng kiang a Juda mite dante, hiai mun siangthou gensepa ahi; huai lou leng, tempul ah Grik mite alutpih a, hiai in siangthou ahihbuah khin," achi uhi.
Huai ma in khua ah Ephesa a mi Trophimas akiang ah amu ua, Paul in huai mi tempul ah alutpih agingta uhi.
Huan akhua in akising kheukhou ua, mite ataikhawm ua; Paul aman ua, tempul a kipan akaikhia ua; kongkhakte akhak pah ngal uhi.
Amah hihlup atup laitak un Jerusalem a mi tengteng abuai uh chih sepaih pawl heutu lianpen kiang atungtou hi.
Ama'n sepaihte leh sepaih za heutute api pah a, akiang uah ataisuk uhi; heutu lianpen leh sepaihte amuhtak un Paul vuak atawpta uhi.
