Sepaih heutu lianpen in ahong naih a, Paul alen a, khainiang nih butsak ding thu apia a; kua ahia ahih a, bang ahia ahih adong hi.
Mipite akhen thu khat in akikou ua, akhen thudang a akikou ziak un, buaina ziak diktak athei kei a, sepaihte giahbuk a pilut thu apia hi.
Paul kalbi atun lai in mipi ahiamgam ziak un sepaihte'n amah apumzawn uhi.
Mi tengteng in, "Hihmangthang un," chi akikou in, azui uhi.
Sepaihte giahbuk sung a apilut dek lai un Paul in, sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah, "Na kiang ah thu kam khat ka gen thei diam?" achi hi.
Huan ama'n, "Grik pau na thei maw? Tuma a mite hanthawn a, gamdai mun a mihing sangli suam a thatte heutupa Aigupta mi na hi kei maw?" achi hi.
Paul in, "Silisia gam a Tarsas a om Juda mi ka hi, khopi neu liai lou khat khua-le-tui ka hi; hon hehpih inla, mi tengteng kiang ah thu hon gensak in," achi hi.
Huan alemsaktak in kalbi ah Paul adingh a, mi tengteng daihna ding in akhut avan a; huan adaih duamtak un Hebru pau in akiang uah thu agen hi.
"Unaute aw, pate aw, tu'n ah na kiang uah ka siamna thu ka hon hilh ding hi, ngaikhia un," achi hi.
Huan Hebru pau in akiang uah thu agen chih azaktak un, adai nawn sem ua; huan ama'n,

"Juda mi ka hi a, Silisia gam a Tarsas a piang ka hi. Himahleh hiai khua ah Gamaliel khebul a zil a khanglian ka hi, i pipute Dan omdan kimtak zil zel a om ka hi a, tuni a noumau tengteng bang in Pathian a ding a phatuam na ngai sam ka hi.
Hiai Lampi a mite that hial khop in ka sawi zel a, numei pasal ka hen a, suangkul ah ka khumsak hi.
Siampu lianpen leh upate tengteng in leng huai thu hon theihpih ua, amau a kipan in leng unaute piak ding in lai ka mu hi, huan Damaskas a omte sawi ding leh hensa a Jerusalem a pi ding in ka hoh hi.
"Huan hichi ahong hi a, ka pai a Damaskas kho kiang ka tun in, sun lai in, thakhat in van a kipan vak thupitak ka kim ah ahong vak hi.
Huan lei ah ka puk a, ka kiang ah, 'Saul, Saul, nang bang achia hon sawi?' chi in aw ka zata hi.
Huan ke'n, 'Toupa kua na hia?' chi in ka dong a. Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, Nazaret Jesu na sawi ka hi,” achi hi.
Ka lawmte'n vak amu ua, hon houpihpa aw aza kei uhi.
Ke'n, "Toupa, bang ka hih dia?" ka chi a. Toupa'n ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, Damaskas ah lut in, thil tengteng na hih ding achih peuhmah ahon hilh ding uh," achi hi.
Huan huai vak thupi ziak in khua ka mutheita kei a, ka lawmte'n khut in ahon kai ua, Damaskas ah ka lutta uhi.
"Huan mi khat, Ananias Dan lam a Pathian limsak leh huai a Judate tengteng lak a minhoih
amah ahong a ka kiang ah ahong dingh a, 'Unau Saul, mitvakna nei in,' ahon chi hi. Huaitak in amah ka mutheita hi.
Ama'n, 'I pipute Pathian in adeihlam thei ding in ahon deih a, Diktatpa mu a, akamsuak za ding a hon sep ahi, achi hi.
Na muh leh na zak thu ah mi tengteng kiang ah amah thu theihpihpa na hi ding.
Huan bangziak a om maimai na hia? Thou inla, Toupa min sam in, baptisma tang inla, na khelhna hihsiang tanla,' ahon chi hi.
"Jerusalem a ka pai nawn nung, tempul a ka thum lai in, mengmu bang in ka om hi.
'Kin inla, Jerusalem a kipan pawt in; ka tanchin na gen ding apom tuak kei uh,' ahon chih lai ka mu hi.
Huan ke'n, 'Toupa sinagog teng a nang gingta peuhmah hentasak a, ka vuak zeldan athei uhi.
Huan na thu theihpihpa Stephen sisan asuah lai un kei leng akiang uah ka dingh a, asih ding lem ka na sa a, ahihlumte puante leng ka na kem hi,' ka chi hi.
Huan ama'n, 'Pai in, hiai a kipan in gamlatak a Zentelte kiang ah ka hon sawl ding ahi,' ahon chita hi,” achi hi.
Huan huai thutan in angaikhia ua; aw ngaihtak in akikou ua, "Mi hichibang hing tak ahi kei, khovel a kipan hihmangthang un," achi uhi.
Akikou ua apuan uh alem ua, apai ua, leivui avik uhi,
huchi in sepaih heutu lianpen in Paul sepaihte giahbuk sung a pilut thu apia a, atung ah huchi tel a akikouna uh atheihna ding a soisak kawm a dottel ding in, achi hi.
Savun khau a alehhensawm khit un, Paul in akiang a dingh sepaih zaheutu kiang ah, "Siam louh tansak louh Rome mi vuak ding chih nang a ding in dan toh kituak ahi hia?" achi hi.
Sepaih zaheutu in huai azaktak in, sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah ahoh a, "Na thilhih ding ah pilvang dih aw; hiai mi Rome mi ana hi," achi a, ahilh hi.
Sepaih heutu lianpen ahong a, akiang ah, "Rome mi na hi maw? Hon hilh in," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi. Sepaih heutu lianpen in, “Ke'n hiai khomi hihna sum tampi a ka lei ei ve," chi in adawng hi. Paul in, "Kei zaw Rome mi a piang him ka hi,” achi hi.
Huchi in amah dottel tumte'n apaisan pah ngal ua; sepaih heutu lianpen in Rome mi ahi chih atheih in akihta a, ahen ziak in alau hi.

Azing in Judate'n bangziak a Paul hek ahi uhiam chih theihtel tum in, sepaih heutu lianpen in amah aphel a, siampu liante leh vaihawm tengteng kikhop ding thu apia a, Paul pisuk in, ama uah adingsak hi.
Paul in vaihawmte a-en kilkel a, "Unaute aw, tuni tan in Pathian mitmuh a ahoih lam hi a ka theih peuhmah hih in ka om hi,” achi hi.
Huan siampu lianpen Ananias in, Paul kiang a dinghte kiang ah, akam betsak ding thu apia hi.
Paul in akiang ah, “Nang baang nuhngou bang lelpa, Pathian in ahon beng zaw ding, nang dan bang a vaihawm ding a tu a, dan lou bang a mi bet ding na chi vial maw?" achi hi.
Huan akiang a dinghte'n, "Bangziak a Pathian siampu lianpen tai?" achi uhi.
Paul in, "Unaute aw, siampu lianpen ahi chih ka thei kei a ahi; na chipihte vaihawmte tung ah thuhoih lou gen ke'n, chih gelh ahi ngal a,” achi hi.

Paul in akhen Saddukaite, akhen Pharisaite ahi uh chih atheih in vaihawmte lak ah akikou a, "Unaute aw, Pharisai ka hi, Pharisai tapa leng ka hi; misi lametna leh thohnawnna thu ah vaihawmte mai a dinsak a om ka hi," achi hi.
Huai agentak in, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite ana kisel ua, vaihawmte akilangkhenta uhi.
Saddukaite'n, misi thohnawnna a-om kei, angelte, khate leng a-om tuan kei, achi ua; Pharisaite'n huaite teng a-om vek chih agen uhi.

Huai thu in nakpitak in abuaita ua; Pharisaite lam a mi laigelhmite khenkhat adingh ua; asel ua, "Hiai mi bangmah agitlouhna i mu kei uh; kha hiam angel hiam in akiang a thu gen hileh, eite Pathian dou suak ding i hi uh,” achi uhi.
Huan kituahlouhna lianpi ahong omtak in, sepaih heutu lianpen in Paul abohzan khak uh alau a, sepaihte kiang ah, ava hohsuk a, alak ua kipan giahbuk a va pitouh teitei ding achi hi.
Huan azan in, Paul kiang ah Toupa adingh a, “Khamuangtak in om in, Jerusalem a ka thu na theihsak bang in Rome ah leng na theisak ding hi,” achi hi.
Huan khua ahong vaktak in Judate apanghuan ua, Paul athah masiah uh bangmah ne lou dawn lou ding in akichiamta uhi.
Huai thubawlte sawmli sang a tamzaw ahi uh.
Amau siampu liante leh upate kiang ah ahoh ua, "Paul ka thah masiah uh bangmah chiam lou ding in ka kichiam uh achi uhi.

Huaiziak in nou vaihawmte toh athu kichian nawn sem a ngaihtuah tum bang in, na kiang ua pekhe ding in sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah ahem deuh in va gentou un; kou bel na kiangnai uh ahong tun ma a amah that dia mansa ka hi uh,” achi uhi.
Himahleh Paul sanggamnu tapa in athusawm uh ana za a, giahbuk ah ava lut a, Paul ava hilhta hi.
Paul in sepaih zaheutu khat asam a, “Hiai tangval sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah pi in, akiang ah thu banghiam gen ding nei ahih tuak,” achi hi.
Huchi in sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah api a, "Paul, hentapa'n ahon sam a, hiai tangval na kiang a hon pi ding in ahon sawl a, na kiang ah thu banghiam gen ding nei ahih tuak,” achi hi.
Sepaih heutu lianpen in akhut in alen a, asim in atuam paipih a, "Bang ahia hon hilh ding na neih?" chi in adong hi.
Ama'n, "Paul tungtang kichian nawn sem a na ngaihtuah ding mah bang in, zingchiah vaihawmte kiang ah pisuk ding in Judate'n hon nget hoih asa chiat uh.

Himahleh athu uh na gingta ke'n; alak ua mi sawmli sang a tamzaw in thah asawm ua, huai mite'n amah athah masiah uh bangmah ne lou dawn lou ding in akichiam uh; tu in na thu ngak in mansa in a-om uhi,” achi hi.
Sepaih lianpen in tangval apaisak a, "Hiai thute na hon theisak chih kuamah hilh ke'n,” achi bikbek hi.
Huan sepaih zaheutu nih asam a, "Zan ihsip hun in Kaisaria kho pha a pai ding in sepaih zanih, sakol tungtuangmi sawmsagih, tei tawimi zanih mansa in koih un, achi hi.
Huan Paul tuanna ding sakol leng na ngaihtuahsak unla, gam-ukpa Felik kiang ah bittak in tun un," achi hi.
Huan hichibang in lai agelh hi.
"Klaudias Lisias in Felik gam-ukpa hoihpa chibai abuk hi.
Hiai mi Judate'n amu ua, athah dek lai un akiang uah sepaihte pi in ka hoh a, Rome mi ahi chih ka theih in ka hunkheta hi.
Huan ahekna uh theih ut in, vaihawmte kiang ah ka pisuk a,
huchi in adan uh banghiam a hek a om ahi chih ka thei a, himahleh ahekna thu uah sihna leh henna ding bangmah ka thei kei hi.
Huan Judate'n amah tang uh ahi chih theihsak a ka omtak in, na kiang ah amah ka hon sawl ngal a, amah hekte leng atung a thubuai aneih peuh uh na ma a gen ding in thu leng ka pia hi," achi hi.
Huchi in sepaihte'n athupiak bang in Paul azanzan in api ua, Antipatris atunpih uhi.
Huan azing in sakol tungtuang mite akiang a pai zel ding in anusia ua, amau giahbuk ah akik nawnta uhi.
Huan amau Kaisaria khua atung ua, gam-ukpa kiang ah lai apia ua, Paul leng ama ah adingsak uhi.
Gam-ukpa'n asim khit in, Paul omna gam adong hi. Huan Silisia gam a pan ahi chih atheih in,
"Nang hon hekte ahong tun chiang un na thubuai ka ngaihtuah ding,” achi hi. Herod thukhenna inn a ven ding thu apia hi.
Huan ni nga nung in siampu lianpen Ananias ahong tungsuk a, upa kuate hiam toh, amin Tertullas thugen siam khat toh; Paul tung a thubuai gam-ukpa kiang ah agen uhi.
Paul asapkhiak nung un Tertullas in amah ahek pan a, "Felik hoihpen, nangmah vang a khamuang petpet a ka om ziak un leh na hon kepna ziak a hiai namte a ding a kipuahthakna a-om zel ziak in,
chik lai peuh in koipeuh ah leng lungkimtak in ka pom gige uhi.
Akoi abang hitaleh, nang a dia chimtakhuai hih ka ut kei hi, na migitna in thu kam khat ahihleh hon ngaihkhiaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi.
Hiai mihuathuaipi, khovel a Judate tengteng tokbuaipa leh Nazarit mite pawl a amakaipen khat uh ahih ka thei uhi.
Tempul hihbuah leng atum a; huaiziak in ka man uhi.

Ka dan bang ua atung a vaihawm tum zaw hi ung a, himahleh sepaih heutu lianpen Lisias ahong kuan a, thagum suah in ka khut ua kipan alakhia a, atung a thubuai neite na kiang a hong pai ding in thu apia hi.
Nangmah ngei in amah dongtel in ka hekna tengteng uh na theithei ding hi," achi hi.
Huan Judate'n leng huai thu huchibang ahi, chi in apanpih uhi.
Huan gam-ukpa'n thugen ding a Paul akhutvantak in, hichi in adawng a, "Ama'n nang kum tampi hiai namte vai hawmsakpa na hi chih ka theih ziak in kipaktak in ka siamna thu ka gen ding ahi.
Jerusalem a Pathian be ding a ka hohtouh nung ni sawm-le-nih aval nai kei ding chih na na thei ding hi.
Tempul ah hiam sinagog ah hiam, khua ah leng mi kuahiam ka sel leh mipi ka hanthawn lam amau zong ahon mu kei uh.
Tu'n ah leng ahon hekna thu uh na theih in abul asuikhe thei kei ding uh.
Himahleh hiai thu na kiang ah ka genkhe ding, Dan leh zawlneite thugelh tengteng gingta in, pawl tuam achihte uh Lampi dan bang in ka pipute uh Pathian ka be zel hi.
Pathian ah lametna nei in, hiai mite'n leng huai agintak sam uh, midiktatte leh diktatloute thohnawnna a-om ding hi.
Huchi ahih ziak in Pathian leh mihing tung a hihkhial lou ding in sia-le-pha siangtak nei ding in ka kibawl gige hi.
"Huan kum tampi nung in ka chipihte kiang ah thilpiak ding leh thillat ding hon tawi in ka hong hi.
Huai thil ka piak lai in, Asia gam a kipan Juda mi khenkhatte'n mipi pang lou leh buaina om lou in, tempul ah kisiangsak in ahon mu uhi.
Hiai mite'n ka tung a thubuai nei hi le uh na ma ah hong pai in ahong hek khinta ding uhi.
Ahihkeileh hiai mite ngei in vaihawmte ma a ka din lai in, ka hihkhelh bang ahia amuh uh, gen uhen.
Alak ua dingh a, 'Misi thohnawnna thu ah tuni in na ma uah salh in ka om ahi,' ka chih a hiai thu kam khat ziak houh ahih kei ngalleh, chi in adawng hi."
Huan Felik hiai thilte azak a, Lampi thu atheihchet ziak in, "Sepaih heutu lianpen Lisias ahong tunsuk hun chiah na thu uh ka lem ding," chi in akoih tadih hi.
Sepaih zaheutu kiang ah, Paul zalentak leh alawmte amah hong veh leh nek-tak abawlsak utte kham lou a, vensak ding in thu apia hi.
Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Felik ahong nawn a, azi Drusilla, Juda numei toh, Paul asamsak a, Khrist Jesu ginna thu angaikhia hi.
Paul in diktatna thu, kidek thu, thukhen vaihawmna hong tung dingte asuipih detdet lai in, Felik in lauhuai asa mahmah a, "Pai nawn phot inla, hunlem ka neih hun chiang in ka hon sam ding," achi hi.
Paul in dangka apiak peuh alamen a, huaiziak in asam mun hial a, ahoupih zihzeh hi.
Himahleh kum nih akivei sung in Porsias Festas in Felik mun ahon kheng a; Felik in Judate deihsakna ngah a-ut ziak in, hensa in Paul anuseta hi.
Huchi in Festas in gamukna alak nung ni thum zoh in Kaisaria a kipan Jerusalem ah ahohtou hi.
Siampu liante leh Juda makaite'n akiang ah Paul tungtang thu aselam in ana theisak uhi.
Jerusalem khua a pitouhsak ding in adeihsakna leng ana ngen ua; lampi a na lamtan a thah ding atum uhi.
Himahleh Festas in, “Kaisaria a Paul kep ding leh amah leng huai lam a hoh pah ding,” achi hi.
Huaiziak in "Huai mi'n gitlouhna nei ahihleh na lak ua thunei peuhmah in hon zuisuk in hong hek uhen," chi in adawng hi.
Alak ua ni sawm val ataam nung in, Kaisaria ah apaisuk a; azing in thukhenna tutphah a tu in, Paul hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
Paul ahong tun phet in, Jerusalem khua a kipan Juda hong sukte akim ah adingh ua, suikhiak vual louh ding thubuai tampi giktak tak agen uhi.
Paul in asiamna thu agen a, "Judate dan hi in tempul thu hitaleh, Kaisar tung ah leng bangmah hihkhelh ka nei kei," achi hi.
Himahleh Festas in Judate deihsakna ngah a-ut ziak in Paul kiang ah, "Jerusalem a hohtouh a, huai lai a ka ma a hiai thute lepsak na deih hia?" chi in adong hi.
Paul in, "Kaisar thukhenna tutphah ma a, vai hawmsak a om ding in ka dingh hi. Judate tung ah thil bangmah ka hihkhial kei chih nangmah in leng na theichian mahmah hi.

Migilou ka hih a, sihna khop hial khelhna ka hihleh, sih leng ka nial kei; himahleh hiaite hon hekna abul bangmah a-om keileh kuamah in akiang uah hon pekhe thei kei ding. Kaisar kiang ah ka tun ding,” achi hi.
Huan Festas in avaihawmpihte ahoulimpih kimvel nung in, "Kaisar kiang a thu tut ding na ngen maw? Kaisar kiang ah na pai mahmah ding," chi in adawng hi.
Ni bangzah hiam nung in kumpipa Agrippa leh Barnis, Kaisaria khua ahong tung ua, Festas chibai abuk uhi.
Huai a ni tampi ataam ziak un Festas in Paul thubuai kumpipa kiang ah aluikhia a, "Felik in mitang kuahiam anusia hi.
Jerusalem a ka om lai in siampu liante leh Juda upate'n atungtang thu ahon hilh ua, siam louh tansak ahon ngen uhi.
Ke'n amaute kiang ah, ahekpa uleh amah hekte akimaituah ua, ahekna thu ua asiamna thu genna hunlem aneih ma in, mi kuahiam thah ding a piakkhiak Rome mite dan ahi kei, chi in ka dawng hi.
Huchi in hiai lai ka hong tun un, sawt hal lou in azing in thukhenna tutphah ah ka tu a, huai mipa hon pi ding in thu ka pia hi.
Ahekte adin lai un, ka muanmohdan ngohna atung ah gitlouhna thubuai agen kei uhi.
Asabiak thu ua, Jesu, mi khat sisa, Paul in ahing nawn ahi, chi a agup ziak in atung ah thubuai anei uh ana hi zaw hi.
Ke'n huai thute ngaihtuahdan ding ka thei kei a, Jerusalem a hoh a, huai lai a huai thu lepsak a-utleh ut louh ka dong hi.
Himahleh Paul in Kumpipa lep dia sit angen zawta hi. Huaiziak in Kaisar kiang a ka sawl theih masiah veng ding in thu ka pia hi,” achi hi.
Huan Agrippa in Festas kiang ah, "Hiai mi thu kei mahmah in zak ka ut gige ahi," achi hi. Ama'n, “Zingchiah athugen na ngaikhe ding," achi hi.
Huchi in azing in Agrippa leh Barnis thupitak in ahong ua, thugenna inn ah alut ua, sepaih heutu liante toh, khua a milian deuhte toh; huan Festas thu in Paul apilutsak uhi.

Huan Festas in, “Kumpipa Agrippa leh hiai lai a om tengtengte aw, hiai mi na muh uh ahi, atungtang thu a Judate tengteng in, hing tak nawn lou ding chi a kikou a, Jerusalem khua leh hiai lai a ka kiang a ahek uh ahi.
Himahleh sihna ding khop bangmah ahih kei chih ka thei hi. Huan ama'n Kumpipa kiang a tut anget ziak in sawl ka tum ahi;

Himahleh ka toupa kiang ah atungthu ginatak in bangmah gelh ding ka thei kei hi. Huaiziak in na ma uah ka hon pikhia hi, Kumpipa Agrippa nangmah ma a hon pi tuanse ka hi a, etchet nung a banghiam bek gelh ding ka muhtheihna ding in.
Hekna kiteltak omloupi a henta kuahiam Kumpipa kiang a sawl thil haihuai hi in ka thei hi,” achi hi.
Huai zoh in Agrippa in Paul kiang ah, "Na siamna thu na gen thei," achi hi. Huan Paul in akhut avan a, asiamna thu agen hi.
"Kumpipa Agrippa, Judate'n ahon hekna tengteng uah ka siamna thu gen ding a tuni a na ma a ka din theih hampha ka kisa hi.
Judate tawndan leh pupa ngeinate theisiam leh pil mahmah na hih ziak in ka kipak tuanse hi. Huaiziak in thuakzoutak in ka thugen hon ngaihkhiaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi.
"Ka tuailai hun a kipan ka chipihte lak leh Jerusalem a ka omdan Judate tengteng in athei uhi.
Atung a kipan a ka tanchin theite ahi ua, huchi a ka sabiakdan ua ngentelpen a khosa Pharisai ka hihdan a-ut ualeh ahon genpih thei uhi.
Pathian in ka pipute uh kiang a thu achiam lametna ziak in tu in hiai ah vai hawmsak in ka dingh hi.
Huai thuchiam lametna ziak in ka nam uh sawm-le-nih in, sun leh zan in Pathian nna phatuamngaitak a sem in muh alamen uhi. Kumpipa aw, huai lametna tungthu ah Judate'n ahon hek uhi.
Pathian in misite akaithou ding chih bangchidan a thil hi thei lou a ngaihtuah na hi ua?
"Kei mahmah in Nazaret Jesu min kalh a hihtheih teng hih thil hoih hi in ka na ngaihtuah hi.
Huai bang Jerusalem ah leng ka hih zel hi; siampu liante kiang a thu mu in, misiangthoute lak a mi tampi suangkul ah ka khum zel hi; ahihlup lai un lemsa lam ah leng ka na pang zel hi.
Huan sinagog teng ah ka sawi gige a, Jesu thu gensiatsak ka tum teitei hi. Huan atung uah ka gilou mahmah a, gamdang khuate tanpha in leng ka sawi zel hi.
"Huchibang a hih ding in siampu liante thu mu in leh asawlna lai uh tawi in Damaskas ah ka hoh hi.
Kumpipa aw, huchi a ka pai lai in sun laitak in, nisa vak sang a vakphazaw van a kipan in keimah leh ka paipihte kim ah hong vak ka mu hi.
Ka vek un lei ah ka puk ua, Hebru pau in, 'Saul, Saul, nang bang achia hon sawi? Sutna chiangzum tot nang dia na ahi,' hon chi in ka za hi.
Ke'n, 'Toupa, kua na hia?' ka chi hi. Toupa'n, 'Na sawi, Jesu ka hi,' achi hi.
Himahleh thou inla dingh in; hiai na thil muhte leh na kiang a ka hon lah lai dingte sem ding leh theihpih dia sikha a nang hon bawl ding in na kiang ah ka hong kilak ahi.
Mi tengteng leh ka hon sawlna mite, Zentelte khut a kipan ka hon humhing ding;

amit uh hihvak ding in akiang uah ka hon sawl ahi, huchi in mial a pan vak lam anga ding ua, Setan thuneihna Pathian lam angatsan ding uhi, khelhna ngaihdamna amuhna ding uleh ahon gintak ziak ua sehtuam siangthoute lak a goutan aneihna ding un," achi hi.
"Huaiziak in kumpipa Agrippa aw, van a kilakna ka sel kei hi.
Atung in Damaskas a mite kiang ah, huan Jerusalem ah, Judia leh gam chih a mite kiang leh Zentelte kiang ah leng athilhih uh kisik a, Pathian lam angatna ding un ka hilh zaw hi.
Hiaite ziak in Judate'n tempul ah ahon man ua, hon hihlup atum uhi.

Himahleh Pathian kiang a kipan a panpihna ka muh ziak in tuni tan in mineute leh miliante kiang a thu theisak in ka om lai hi; zawlneite leh Mosi in hong tung ding achih thu kia uh lou ngal thudang gen lou in.
Huchi a, Khrist in gim athuak ding a, misi lak a kipan athohnawn ziak a mi tengteng kiang leh Zentelte kiang a vak musakpa masapen ahi ding achih thu uh," achi hi.
Huchibang a asiamna thu agen lai in, Festas in, aw ngaihtak in, "Paul, hai na hi; na theih tamna in nang hon haisak ahi," achi hi.
Himahleh Paul in, Festas hoihpen, "Hai kei veng e; thu diktak leh thu piltak ka gen zaw ahi.
Hiai thute kumpipa'n athei, akiang ah leng hangsantak in ka gen ahi; hiai thil bangmah akiang ah iim ahi kei chih diktak in ka thei hi. Hiai thu inkil kawm peuh a aguk a hih ahi kei hi.
Kumpipa Agrippa, zawlneite na gingta hia? Na gingta chih ka thei,” achi hi.
Agrippa in Paul kiang ah, "Sawt louchik sung in Khristian na hon suaksak zou dek," achi hi.
Paul in, "Sawt in tom taleh, nang kia ka chi kei, tuni a ka thu za tengteng leng keimah bang a om ding in Pathian kiang ah ka ngen ahi, hiai kolbutte chih louh ngal," achita hi.
Huan thu agen zoh in kumpipa adingtou a, gam-ukpa, Barnis leh akiang ua tute leng adingh chiat uhi.
Apaituam ua akihou ua, “Hiai mi'n sihna leh kolbutna khop hial thil bangmah ahih kei,” achi uhi.
Agrippa in Festas kiang ah, "Hiai mi'n Kaisar kiang a tut ding na ngen lou hileh pawt mai ding hiven,” achi hi.
Itali gam a long a pai ding thu ahihpuktak un, Paul leh henta dang kuate hiam Augusta pawl a sepaih zaheutu, amin Julias akemsak uhi.
Huan Adramittium kho long, Asia gam tuipi piau a kho omte tawn ding ah ka tuang ua, tuipi ah ka paita uhi. Ka kiang uah Masidonia gam a mi Aristarkhas, Thessalonika khomi a-om hi.
Azing in Sidon khua ka tawn uhi. Julias in Paul alimbawl ngial a, kihihhalh ding in alawmte kiang ah apawtsak hi.
Huai a kipan in tuipi ah ka pai nawn ua, huih in ahi lou lam a hon mut ziak in Kupra tuikulh zul huih hatlouhna lam ah ka tai uhi.
Silisia gam leh Pamphilia gamzul tuipi ka khen nung un, Lisia gam a Mira khua ka tung uhi.
Huai ah sepaih zaheutupa'n Aleksandria kho long Itali gam tawn ding amu a; huai ah hon tuangsak hi.
Ni tampi, awlawl in ka pai ua, Knidas kho zawn haksapi in ka tung teitei ua, huih in hon sawnkik ziak in Salmoni zuan in Krit tuikulh zul huih hatlouhna lam ah ka tai uhi.
Haksatak in tui geigei ah ka pai ua, Longkhawlna Kilawm achih mun uh ka tungta ua; huai kiang ah Lasea khua a-om hi.
Huan ni tampi abei tak ziak in leh long a pai alauhuai ziak in, An Ngawl ni akhengta ngal a, Paul in amau athuhilh a, akiang uah,
"Pute aw, tua long a tuangte siatna leh manthatna thupitak i tung ua tung ding ahi chih ka thei a, avante leh long tung ah kia ka chi kei a, eimah tung ah leng ka chi ahi," achi hi.
Himahleh sepaih zaheutu in Paul thugen sang in longpu leh long neipa thu agingta zaw hi.

Phalbi douna ding in longkhawlna aginat louh ziak in atamzaw in huai a kipan a tuipi a paikhiak a, bangchi hiam bek a Phoenik khua tun teitei a, huai lai a phalbi dou asawmpih ua; Phoenik ahihleh Krit tuikulh a longkhawlna khat ahi a, simtum leh maltum lam doh ahi.
Sim huih awlawl a ahong nuntak in adeihlam uh mu akisa ua, sikkip akhaikhia ua, Krit tuikulh zulzul ah apai uhi.
Himahleh sawt lou nung in huih hattak, Euroklidon kichi, gam lam a kipan in ahong nung hi.
Long ahon mutkhata a, huihlam angat theih louhtak in ka khahta ua, hon mutleng hon mutlengta hi.
Kauda tuikulh neuchik petmah pansan in huih hatlouhna lam ah ka tai ua, haksatak in long neu ka bitsak thei ham uhi.

Akaihkhiak nung un panpihna khaute khawng azang ua, long nuailam ah vial kawm in akhih uhi. Puanzakna bangkim apuksak ua, huchi lou in zaw Sirtis piaunel kip lou a lenlut alau ua, huchi in huih mutdan dungzui in apai uhi.
Tuikihot in hon sep ek ziak in, azing in tui lak ah long a vante apaikheta uhi.
Huan ani thum ni in, amau khut in long vante apaikhe nawnta uhi.
Huan ni tampi nisa leh aksi leng akimu kei a, huihpi hat petmah in hon nuai a, hin himhim ka lamen nawn kei uhi.
Huan an ne lou a sawttak a-om nung un, alak uah Paul adingh a, "Pute aw, Krit tuikulh a kiphel lou dia, ka thu ngaikhia hi le uchin hiai siatna leh manthatna tuah louh ding hi zen a.
Himahleh tu'n ah leng khamuangtak a om ding in ka hon hanthawn lai hi. Na lak uah kuamah in hinna na mangsak kei ding uh, long zaw amangthang ding.
Amah Pathian a ka hih a, a-nna leng ka sep, amah angel tuzan in ka kiang ah ahong dingh a, ka kiang ah,
'Paul, lau ke'n, Kaisar ma ah na dingh ding. Ngai in, long a na kiang a zin tengteng leng Pathian in ahon pia hi,' ahon chi hi.
Huaiziak in Pute aw, khamuangtak in om un, Pathian ka gingta hi, hon hilh bang in a-om ding hi.
Himahleh bang tuikulh hiam ah zaw ahon lenkhe ding," achi hi.
Zan sawm-le-li achin zan in Adria tuipi ah huih in alanglang ah ahon mutleng leng lai hi. Zankim lai in, long mite'n koi gam hiam tung dek in akithei uhi.
Huchi in tui thukdan ateh ua, laam sawmnih hi in athei ua, huan sawt louchik in ateh nawn ua, laam sawm-le-nga hi in athei uhi.
Huan longmei lam ah sikkip li akhia ua, huchi lou in zaw suang se mun ah hon lenkhe zenzen kha ding chih alau ua; huan khovak kal angaklahtak in a-om uhi.
Huan long mite'n long malam a sikkipte khiak ding bawl a kineih in tuipi ah long neu akhia ua, long taisan atum uhi.
Hiai lai in Paul in, sepaih zaheutu leh sepaihte kiang ah, "Hiaite long a a-om gige kei uleh abit kei ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in sepaihte'n long neu khaute a-attat ua, akhahta uhi.
Khovak kuan in, Paul in an ne ding in mi tengteng asawl a, "Tuni bangmah ne lou a na om ua, an na ngawlna uh ani sawm-le-li ni ahita.
Huaiziak in an ne ding in ka hon sawl chiat ahi; na damna ding uh; na lak uah kuamah asamzang khat leng amangthang kei ding,” achi hi.
Huai thu agen khit in tanghou ala a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen khit in, mi tengteng ma ah abalkham a, ane panta hi.
Amau leng khamuangtak in a-om ua, an ane samta uhi.
Long a mite ka vek un zanih sawmsagih-le-guk ka hi uhi.
An anek kham khit un, tuipi ah buh apai ua, long ahihzang deuh uhi.
Huan ni asuah in, koi lai gam ahia chih athei kei ua; himahleh, koi lai longkhawlna hiam piautak nei khat amu ua, huai tung ah ahihtheih uleh long taikhiaksak atum uhi.
Huan sikkip khihnate a-attat ua, tuipi ah anusia ua; huchih lai mah in kaihheina khihnate aphel ua, huih mut ding in malam puanzak akaitou ua; piautak azuanta uhi.

Himahleh tuikihot khauh nih kituahna mun ah ka lutkha zenzen ua, long in lei hetkha in, huan, long mailam atang bikbekta a, hihtat zoh louh in a-omta a, tuikihot ahat ziak in longmei lam akekgawpta hi.
Huan hentate, tui liau galkai khattou a om kha ding ua, ataimang kha ding uh chih alauh man un sepaihte'n amaute hihlup mai asawm uhi.
Himahleh sepaih zaheutu in Paul humhing a-ut a, athiltup uh akham a; tuileuh siam peuhmah tuipi a tawmkhiak a gam na kai masa ding leh,
midang akhen singpek tung leh akhen long van tung a kitholh galkai ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in avek un gam ah bittak in agalkai vek uhi.
Huan gam a ka suahtak un, tuikulh min tuh Malta ahi chih ka theita uhi.
Tuikulh gam mite'n asiam theihtawp uh suah in hon na hehpih ua; vuah ahong zuk ziak leh khovot ziak in mei atoh ua, ka vek un hon na kipahpih uhi.
Paul in singlom khat atom a mei ah achih a, asat ziak in gul ahong vakkhia a, akhut a tu in atangden hi.
Tuikulh gam mite'n ganhing akhut a kikhaiden amuh un, "Hiai mi tualthat ahi ding, tuipi a kipan taikhe mahleh diktatna in ahin phalta lou ahi,” achi uhi.
Himahleh ama'n mei ah gul asingkhia a, bangmah achi kei hi.
Amau bel abawk hiam, thakhat a puk pah a si ding in agingta uh; hun sawtpi angak nilouh ua, bangmah achi kei chih atheih un alungsim uh akheng ua, Pathian ahi achi zaw uhi.
Huai mun kiang ah huai tuikulh a hausapa, amin Publias a-om a, huai mi in ahon na kipahpih a, ni thum siamtak in ahon tungsak hi.
Publias pa khosik leh santen vei in ana lum a; akiang ah Paul alut a, athum a, atung ah akhut koih in ahihdamta hi.
Huai ahihdam khit in tuikulh a midang natna nei peuhmah ahong ua; adam chiatta uhi.
Huai mite'n nakpitak in ahon na pahtawi ua; ka pai ding un long ah ka vante uh ahong koih uhi.
Huan kha thum nung in, Aleksandria kho long, phalbi a tuikulh a omsa, unau phik, Kastor leh Pollux lutang kisuanna long ah ka pai uhi.
Sairakus khua ka tawn ua huai ah ni thum ka taam uhi.
Huai a kipan ka paikawi ua, Rejiam khua ka tung ua; ni khat nung in sim huih ahong nung a, azing nawn in Puteoli khua ka tung nawn uhi.
Huai ah unaute ka mu ua, akiang uah ni sagih taam ding in ahon khou ua; huchibang in Rome kholam ah ka pai zelta uhi.

Huan unaute'n ka Tanchin uh azaktak un huai a kipan in Appii dawr leh Khualbuk thumte omna chiang ah hong dawn ding in ahong kuan ua; Paul in huai mite amuh in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen a, alungmuang mahmahta hi.
Rome a ka lut un Paul bel avengpa sepaih kiang a amah kia a om aphal uhi.

Ni thum nung in, Paul in Juda heutute asamkhawm a; akihoukhawm ua, akiang uah, "Unaute leh mite aw, i pipute dan tung ah bangmah ka hihkhelh louh in leng Jerusalem a kipan in Rome a mite kiang ah ahon hentasak uhi.
Amau ahon etchet khit un, sihna khop hial ka tung ah bangmah amuh louh ziak un khah ahon tum uhi.
Himahleh Judate'n huai asel ziak un Kaisar kiang tun lou thei ka hita kei a; himahleh ka chipihte hekna nei a hih bel ka hi kei hi.
Huai lam thu a noumau hon mu a hon houpih ding in ka hon sam ahi; Israelte lamet thilte toh kisai a khainiang bun ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Na tanchin Judia gam a kipan lai in ka mu kei ua, unau hiai a hong omte kuamah in na tungtang thubuai bangmah apulak kei ua, gen leng agen ngei kei uhi.
Himahleh hiai pawl zaw gam teng ah gensiat ahi ngal ua, nang bangchi in ahia na ngaih chih theih ka utzaw uhi,” achi uhi.

Huan ni achiam ua, huai atunna ah akiang ah mi tampi ahong ua; zing a kipan nitaklam pha in akiang uah huai thu ahilhchian a, Pathian lalgam thu atheisak a, Mosi Dan laibu thu leh zawlneite laibu thu in Jesu lam ah amaute athuzoh zel hi.
Khenkhat in athugen agingta ua, akhen in agingta kei uh.
Huan akituakta kei ua, Paul in thu agen khit in apaikheta uhi. Athugen tuh hiai ahi: Kha Siangthou in zawlnei Isai kam a na pipute uh kiang a athugen adik mahmah ahi chi in:
"Hiai chite kiang ah va gen in, bil in zaw na za na ding ua, angaihna ahihleh na thei kei hial ding uh; muh zaw na mu ding ua, theih ahihleh na thei kei hial ding uh.

Hiai chite lungtang atakta a, abilte uh ana ngong deuh a, amit uh leng asi ua, huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza ding ua, alungtang un leng athei ding uh, akiheikik ding ua, ke'n ka hihdam kha ding hi," achi, achih pen ahi.
"Huaiziak in Pathian hotdamna thu Zentelte kiang a khakkhiak ahi chih thei un, amau bel ngaih leng angaikhe ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi a hiai thute agen khit nung in, Judate apawtkheta ua, alak uah nakpitak in kiselna apiang hi.
Huchi in kum nih vengveng ama inn luahna mun ah Paul a-om a, akiang a hoh peuhmah ana kipahpih hi.
Pathian lalgam thu ahilh a, hangsantak in Toupa Jesu Khrist thu agen zel a, kuamah in amah akham kei uhi.
Huan Peter leh Johan, dak kuana ah thum hun lai in tempul a lut ding in ahohtou uhi.
Piching kuahiam apian tung a pan khebai ahon zawng ua, tempul a lutte kiang a khutdoh ding in, tempul Kongkhak Kilawm kichi bul ah niteng in alumsak uhi.
Peter leh Johan tempul a lut ding mu in khut adoh hi.
Peter in amah a-en gegu a, Johan in leng; huan Peter in, “Hon en in," achi hi.
Ama'n amau a pan banghiam muh akilamen a, a-en pah hi.
Himahleh Peter in, "Dangka leh dangka-eng bangmah ka nei kei; himahleh ka neihsun ka hon pe ding, 'Nazaret Jesu Khrist min in khe in paita in,' " achi hi.
Huan akhut taklam alen a, akaithouta a; huchi in thakhat in akhete leh asiakmit guhte ahong hat pah hi.
Amah atawmtou a, adingh a, khe in apai pah hi. Khe a paipai, diangdiang leh Pathian phat kawm in tempul ah alut hi.
Huan khe a pai leh mi tengteng in Pathian aphat lai amuh un;
Tempul Kongkhak Kilawm bul a khutdoh a tupa ahi chih athei ua; atung a thil tunglamdang asa mahmah ua, abuaipih uhi.
Huan ama'n Peter leh Johan alet lai in, mi tengteng in lamdang asa mahmah ua, inlim Solomon a achih uah akiang uah ahong taikhawm uhi.
Peter in huai amuh in, mite ahoupih a, "Nou Israel mite aw, hiaite bangziak a lamdang sa? Koumau thilhihtheihna leh Pathian ka limsak ziak ua amah ka paisak bang zen ua bang achia hon en gige?
Abraham, Isak leh Jakob' Pathian, i pipute Pathian in, asikha Jesu apahtawita ahi; amah na mansak ua, Pilat in khah atup hun in leng ama ah na ut kei uhi.
Mi Siangthou leh Dik na deih kei ua, tualthatpa na kiang ua piak na ngen zawta uhi.
Hinna Siampa na that ua; himahleh Pathian in amah misi lak a pan akaithou nawn a; huai theihpihte ka hi uhi.
Ama min gintak ziak in amin in hiai mi na muh uh leh na theih un ahihhatta hi. Amah ziak a ginna ahong om in na vek ua mitmuh in ahihdam vilvelta hi.
"Himahleh unaute aw, na heutute un atheih louh ziak ua ahih bang un, na theih louh ziak un hiaite na hih uh ahi, chih ka thei uhi.
Himahleh Pathian in zawlnei tengteng kam in, Khrist in gim athuak ding thu atheikholsak hi, huchibang in atungsak zawta hi.
Huaiziak in na khelhnate uh thaimanna ding in kisik unla, kihei nawn un, huchi in Toupa a pan halh hun ahong tung ding hi.
Khrist Jesu nou a dia aseh mah leng, ahon sawl ding hi.
Himahleh Pathian in thil bangkim abawlhoih hun ahong tun masiah amah van a a-om ding him ahi; huai bawlhoih ding thu Pathian in leilung pian tung a kipan azawlnei siangthoute kam a agen khit ahi.
Mosi ngei in 'Toupa Pathian in keimah ahon bawl bang in na unaute lak ah zawlnei khat ahon bawlsak ding; ama'n thu tengteng na kiang ua agen peuh na ngaihkhiaksak ding uhi.
Huan mi kuapeuh huai zawlnei thu ngaihkhiaksak lou tuh, mi lak a kipan hihmangthang ahi ding,' achi hi.
Ahi, Samuel om a kipan zawlnei tengteng, anung ua mite toh, thugen peuhte'n, tulai tanchin agenkhol uhi.
Noute zawlneite leh thukhun tate na hi ve ua; Pathian in Abraham kiang ah, 'Na suante ziak in khovel a nam chih avualzawl ding uh, chi in na pipute uh kiang ah achiam hi.
Pathian in a Tapa Jesu, misi lak a kipan kaithou in, na khelhnate uh kiheisanna ding leh kisik mite vualzawl ding in noumau kiang ah ahon sawl masapen hi,' " achi hi.
Huan Peter leh Johan in mite kiang a thu agen lai un, siampute, tempul heutute leh Saddukaite akiang uh ahong tung guih ua;
mite asinsak uh leh Jesu ziak a misi lak a kipan thohnawnna thu ahilh ziak un alungkim kei hial uhi.
Huan amaute aman ua nitaklam ahih ziak in azingsang pha in suangkul ah akhumta uhi.
Himahleh thu ngaikhete akhen tampite'n agingta ua; atamlam uh piching ngen leng sangnga vel aching uhi.
Azing in aheutute uh, upate, laigelhmite,
siampu lianpen Annas leh Kaiapha, Johan, Alexander, siampu lianpen tanau tengtengte leng Jerusalem ah a-omkhawm uhi.
Peter leh Johan alai ah adingsak ua, "Bang thilhihtheihna in ahia, kua min in ahia hiai na hih uh?" chi in adong uhi.
Huchi in Peter Kha Siangthou in adim a, akiang uah, "Nou mipite vaihawmte leh Israel upate aw,
hiai mi damlou tung a nna hoih ka sep thu uah, hiai mi bangziak in ahia ahong dam tak chi in tu in salh leh dot a om ka hi uh maw;

nou tengteng leh Israel mi teng in leng thei hen, kros a Nazaret Jesu Khrist na kilhden uh, Pathian in misi lak a kipan in akaithou nawn a, amah min ngei in hiai mi hiai ah na ma uah dam in adinghta ahi.
"Nou inn lam mite aw, na suangpaih uh, aning a, suang phatuampen ahong hita, huai amah ahi achi uhi."
"Midang kuamah kiang ah hotdamna a-om kei, van nuai a mihing min sak lak ah, hon hondam ding min dang a-om kei,” achi hi.
Peter leh Johan hansandan amuh un, milaisiam lou leh minautang maimai ahi uh chih atheih un lamdang asa mahmah uhi; huchi in Jesu kiang ah a-om khinta uh chih athei uhi.
Huan mi ahihdam uh akiang ua dingh amuh un, bangmah agense thei tuan kei uhi.
Huchi in avaihawmna ua pat a apaituamsak nung un, akihou ua,
"Hiai mite bangchi in i hih dia? Thillamdang chiamteh tham ahih uh Jerusalem a om tengteng in teltak in atheita uh; en leng i sel thei tuan kei hi.
Himahleh midang kiang a athan semsemlouhna ding in tunung siah kuamah kiang ah hiai min a thu agenlouhna ding un i vau ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in amau asam ua, Jesu min a thu gen het lou ding leh hilh het lou ding in achi tinten uhi.
Himahleh Peter leh Johan in akiang uah, "Pathian mitmuh in Pathian thuman sang in noumau thuman adikzaw hia ngaihtuah un.
Kou zaw ka thil muh uh leh ka zakte uh gen lou in ka om thei kei uh," achi uhi.
Huan amau avau semsem ua, akhahta uh, mipi ziak in gawtna lemtang amu kei uh; athilhih ziak un mi tengteng in Pathian apahtawi uhi.
Hiai ahihdamna chiamtehna uh kum sawmli sang a tamzaw ahi.
Huan Peter leh Johan apawt un amau lawmte kiang ah ava hoh ua, siampu liante leh upate'n akiang ua agen peuh uh ahilh vek uhi.
Huchi in angaikhete'n akituak in aw ngaihtak in Pathian kiang ah, "Toupa, nang tuh van leh lei, tuipi leh asung a omte tengteng bawlpa na hi;
Nang Kha Siangthou in, ka pu uh na sikha David kam in, hiai thu na gen ahi: 'Zentelte bangchi in ahita aheh uh? Mite'n bangchi in ahia thil phatuam lou angaihtuah uh?
Khovel kumpipate adingh ua, heutute leng akikhawm ua, Toupa leh ama Khrist kalh in,' chi in.
"Hiai khua ah na sikha siangthou, na thaunilh Jesu tung ah, Herod leh Pontias Pilat toh, Zentelte leh Israel mite toh akikhawmta uh;
na khut leh na lungsim a hong tung ding a na sehkholh peuh hih ding in.
Huchi in tu'n ah, Toupa, ahon vaudan uh ngai in; na sikhate kiang ah na thu hangsantak a gentheihna pia in.
Damsak ding a na khut na zak a, na sikha Jesu min a chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte hih ahih lai in,” achi uhi.
Huan athum khit un a-omkhawmna mun uh ahong ling a, avek un Kha Siangthou in adim ua, hangsantak in Pathian thu ahilhta uhi.
Huan agingta mipite lungsim mun khat leh ngaihtuah mun khat in a-om ua; alak ua kuamah in athil neihte, kei a tuam ahi, achi kei ua, thil tengteng akikop uhi.
Sawltakte'n thilhihtheihna thupitak in Toupa Jesu thohnawn thu ahilhhilh ua; avek ua tung ah hehpihna thupitak a-om hi.
Huan alak uah leng tasam kuamah a-om kei uh; gam leh inn nei peuh in azuak ua, athil khotte uh aman ahon tawi uhi.
Huan sawltakte khebul ah akoih zel ua, amau deihdong ching hun chiat in ahawm chiat zel uhi.
Huan Levi chi a mi khat, Kupra tuikulh a kipan, Joses kichi, sawltakte'n Barnabas achih uh, (huai min omdan, "Hanthawnna Tapa," chihna ahi),
hiai mi in agam neih azuak a, aman ahon tawi a, sawltakte khebul ah akoih hi.
Himahleh mi khat amin Ananias in azi Sapphira toh athil neih uh azuak hi.
Huan azi theih in ama'n akhen a-iim a, akhen hon tawi in sawltakte khebul ah ahong koih hi.
Himahleh Peter in, "Kha Siangthou khem ding leh gam man akhen iim ding in bangziak a Setan in na lungtang hihkhauh ahia?

A-om lai teng leng nang a ahi gige kei a hia? Na zuak nung in leng na thuthu in a-om kei a hia? Bang achia hiai thute na lungtang a ngaihtuah? Mihing khem na hi kei a, Pathian khem na hi zaw,” achi hi.
Ananias in huai thu azaktak in apuk a, asita hi; aza kha peuh in alau mahmah uhi.
Tangvalte athou ua, tuam in azawngkhia ua, avuita uhi.
Dakkal thum ding hiam nung in, thil omdan thei lou in azi ahong lut hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Hon hilh in, hiai zah phet in maw gam na zuak uh?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi, hiai zah phet in ahi," achi hi.
Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Bang achia Toupa Kha ze-et ding a kithutuak na hi ua? Ngai in, kongkhak bul ah na pasal vuite khepek ahong omta, nang leng ahon zawngkhe ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in thakhat in akhebul ah apuk pah a, asi hi; tangvalte ahong lut ua, amah si in ahong mu ua, azawngkhia ua, apasal kiang ah avuita uhi.
Huan saptuamte leh huai thu za peuhmahte'n alau mahmah uhi.
Huan mi lak ah Pathian in sawltakte khut in chiamtehna leh thillamdang tampi ahih zel hi. Huan amaute avek un lungsim mun khat in Solomon inlim ah akikhawm zel uhi.
Midang bel kuamah alak uah apang ngamta kei uhi; himahleh mi'n amaute angaisang uhi.
Huan Toupa lam ah numei leh pasal gingthak tampi behlap semsem in a-om uhi.
Huchi in mi damloute kongzing ah alumsak ua, Peter pai kawm a alim bek in alak ua khat bek aliahtheihna ding in, achi uhi.
Jerusalem kho kim a kipan mipite leng huai damloute dawi nin hihgimte hon pi in ahong paikhawm ua; huaite leng ahong dam chiat uhi.
Huan siampu lianpen akisa a, akiang a omte tengteng toh, alawmte tuh Saddukai pawl ahi ua; amau hazatna in adim uhi.
Sawltakte aman ua, vantang khumna ah akhumta uhi.
Zankim in Toupa angel khat in kongkhakte hong in, apikhia hi.
"Tempul ah pai unla, va dingh in mite kiang ah hiai hinna thu va gen un," achi hi.

Huan huai thu azak un, khua hong vak phet in tempul ah ava lut ua, thu ava gen uhi. Himahleh, siampu Lian leh alawmte ahong ua, vaihawmte leh Israel suante upate tengteng asamkhawm ua, sawltakte va pi ding in suangkul ah mi asawl uhi.
Suangkul ah heutute va hoh mah le uh, amau ava mu kei ua; huchi in akik nawn uhi.
"Suangkul bittak a kikhak in, avengte leng kongkhak bul a dingh amu uhi, himahleh ka hong ua, asung ah kuamah ka mu kei uh," chi in agen uhi.
Huan tempul upa leh siampu liante'n huai thute azak un, hiai bangchi phet in athang diam aw? chi in athu ah amangbang petpet uhi.
Huan mi khat ahong pai a akiang uah, "Ngai un, suangkul a na mikhumte un tempul a dingh in thu agen uh," chi in ahong gen hi.
Huchi in sepaih heutupa toh heutu liante ava kuan ua, vantang akihtak ziak un hiamgamna om lou in sawltakte ahon pi ua, huchi hi keileh suang a den ahi kha ding uhi.
Huan apitung un, vaihawmte ma ah adingsak uhi. Siampu lianpen in akiang uah,
"Huai min in thu hilh louh ding ka hon chita ua; thei un na thuhilh un Jerusalem ahihdim vekta hi, hiai mipa sisan hon khuksak tum na hi ve ua," chi in asal hi.
Himahleh Peter leh sawltakte'n, "Mihing thu sang in Pathian thu i man zawk ding ahi," achi uhi.
"Nou sing ah Jesu khaikang in na that ua, i pipute Pathian in akaithou nawnta hi.
Amah mah Pathian in Kumpipa leh Hondampa a om ding in ataklam ah ahihlianta hi. Israelte khelhna a pan kiheisak ding leh ngaidam ding in.
Huai thute kou atheihpihte ka hi ua; Kha Siangthou, Pathian in athu zui peuhte kiang a apiak tak, atheipa ahi nawn lai," chi in adawng uhi.
Amau huai thu azak un asin uh athak mahmah a, hihlup atumta uhi.
Himahleh vaihawmte lak ah, amin Gamaliel, Pharisai, dan sinsakmi, mi tengteng lak a minthangpi khat adingtou a, huai mite inn polam a omsak takdih ding thu apia hi.
Huan vaihawmte kiang ah, "Nou Israel mite aw, hiai mite tung a na thilhih tup uah pilvang un.
Tuma lam in Theuda kichi, mi khat ahong om a, huai mipa kiang ah mi tampi, zali phial, a-awn uhi, amah tuh hihlup in a-omta a; athu zui peuhmah avek un adalhzakta ua bangmah ahita kei uhi.
Huai mi om nung in kisimpi lai in, Galili gam ah mi khat Judas kichi ahong om nawn hi; alam ah mi khenkhat ahip nawn hi; himahleh amah leng asita a, athu zui peuhmah avek un adalhzakta uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai mite khoih kei unla, amau om-om in omsak un; hiai athiltup uh leh athilhih uh mihing a kipan ahihleh amang ding hi.
Himahleh Pathian a kipan ahihleh amau na hihmang thei kei ding uh; huchi lou in zaw Pathian dou na hi zaw kha ding uh," achi hi.
Huan agen lem asata ua; huchi in sawltakte asam ua, avua ua; avuak khit un, Jesu min a thu gen lou ding chi bikbek in akhahta uhi.
Huchi in vaihawmte lak a kipan apawtkhia ua, Khrist min ziak a daina thuak tak a seh ahih ziak un akipak mahmah uhi.
Huan niteng in tempul leh amaute inn ah, Jesu Khrist ahi, chi in thuhilh leh sinsak atawp kei uhi.
Huai lai a, nungzuite apunpun lai un, aniteng thilhawm uah Grik pau zang Juda meithaite limsak lou chi in Hebru pau zang Judate tung ah Grik Judate aphun uhi.
Huan sawm-le-nihte'n nungzui mipite asamkhawm ua, "Pathian thugen tawpsan a dohkan a nek-tak ka bawl uh ahoih kei.
Huaiziak in unaute aw, na lak uah Kha leh pilna a dim mi minhoih ngen sagih tel un, amau hiai thil gel ding in ka bawl ding ua;
kou ahihleh thum leh thu nasem in ka om gige zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
Huai thu in mi tengteng akipaksak a; huchi in ginna leh Kha Siangthou a dim ngen, Stephen, Philip, Prokoras leh Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas leh Judate phungkai Antiok a mi Nikolas atel uhi.
Sawltakte ma ah hiai mite adingsak ua; amau athum ua, atung uah akhut uh anga uhi.
Huchi in Pathian thu ahong dalh zom zel a; Jerusalem ah nungzuite apungta mahmah ua; siampute lak ah leng mi tampi'n ginna lam ahong ngata uhi.
Huan Stephen, hehpihna leh thilhihtheihna in adim in, mi lak ah thillamdang leh chiamtehna thupite ahih zom zel hi.
Himahleh Kurini, Aleksandria leh Silisia gam leh Asia gam a kipan Juda pawl khat Salsuakte sinagog kichite leh mi khenkhat ahong kisa ua, Stephen hong kiselpih uhi.
Himahleh apilna leh agenpihpa Kha aselkhe thei kei uhi.
Huan mi khenkhat aguai ua; huai mite'n, "Mosi leh Pathian agensiat ka za uh," achi uhi.
Huan mite, upate leh laigelhmite atokthou ua, Stephen asual ua, aman ua, vaihawmte kiang ah api uhi.
Theihpih zuauthei bawlkhia in, amaute'n, “Hiai mi'n hiai mun siangthou leh Dan agense gige,
Nazaret Jesu'n hiai mun ahihse dia, Mosi in hon piak dante ahihlamdang ding chih, agen ka za uh," achi uhi.
Huan vaihawmte tengteng in Stephen a-ensal chiat ua, amel angel mel bang in amu uhi.
Huan siampu lianpen in, "Hiai thute adik ahi na hia?" achi hi.
Stephen in, “Unaute aw, pate aw, ngai un. I pu Abraham, Haran a a-om ma, Mesopotamia gam a a-om lai a, thupina Pathian akiang a hong kilak in akiang ah,
'Na kholam leh na chite lak a kipan pawt inla, gam ka hon etsak ding lam ah pai in,' " achi hi.
Huan amah tuh Kaldaite gam a kipan apaikhia a, Haran ah ava om a; huan apa sih nung in huai a kipan in tua na omna kholam uah Pathian in apemlutsak hi.
Huan hiai ah zaw mun luah ding, khe ngakna tham bangmah ape kei. Himahleh tapa aneih ma nangawn in ama gou ding leh anung a asuante gouluah ding in gam piak achiam hi.
Pathian in hichibang in agen, asuante mi kholam ah kum zali ataam ding ua mi'n sikha in abawl ding ua, asawi behlap ding uh.
Pathian in, " ‘Sikha a nei dingte nam keima'n ka ngaihtuah ding a, huai khit chiang in ahong pawt ding ua, hiai mun ah ka nna asem ding uh,' achi behlap hi.
Pathian in akiang ah tua zeksum thu akhung a; huchi in Abraham in Isak asuang a, ani giat ni in azek asum a, huan Isak in Jakob asuang a; Jakob in suangtubul ding sawm-le-nihte ahon nei hi.
"Huai suangtubul dingte'n Joseph ahaza ua, Aigupta gam ah azuak ua; himahleh akiang ah Pathian a-om hi.

Agimthuak tengteng ah ahunkhe zel a, Aigupta gam kumpipa Pharaoh deihsakna angahsak a, mipiltak ahi chih atheisak behlap hi; huchi in ama'n Aigupta gam leh a-inn a mi tengteng tung ah gam-ukpa in abawlta hi.
Aigupta leh Kanaan gam tengteng ah kial ahong tung a, gimthuakna thupitak ahong tungta hi; i pipute'n lah nek ding himhim amuta kei ua.
Himahleh Jakob in Aigupta gam ah buh a-om chih azaktak in i pipute asawlkhia a; huai tuh ahoh pat tungna pen uh ahi.
Huan anihvei hohna uah, a-unaute kiang ah Joseph kitheisakta a, huchi in Joseph chite tuh Pharaoh kiang ah akitheisakta uhi.
Huan Joseph in apa Jakob leh a-unau tengteng mi sawmsagih leh nga asamsak hi.
Huchi in Aigupta gam ah Jakob ahohsuk a; huai ah amah leh i pipute asita uhi.
Shekem ah apotung ua, Abraham in Shekem a Emmor tapate lak a dangka sum a alei han ah avuita uhi.
"Pathian in Abraham kiang a athuchiam ahong tun ding in Aigupta gam ah mite ahong pung ua, ahong tam deuhdeuh uhi.
Huan Aigupta gam ah Joseph thei lou kumpi dang khat ahong lal hi.
Huai mi in i chipihte akhem a, i pipute asawi a, anaungekte uh hing lou ding in apaikhesak hi.
Huai lai in Mosi ahong piang a, Pathian muh in melhoih mahmah ahi; apa inn ah kha thum akem uhi.
Akoihkhiak un Pharaoh tanu in ama tapa ding a la in akem hi.
Huan Aigupta gam a pilna tengteng Mosi ahilh ua, thu ah leh athilhih ah athupi mahmah hi.
"Huan amah kum sawmli achin kuan in, a-unau, Israel suante aveh hi.
Huan alak ua mi khat gimthuak lai amu a, apanpih a, ahihgimpa Aigupta mi athat a, aphu alaksakta hi.
Mosi in ama khut in Pathian in amaute ahondam chih a-unaute'n thei na uhiam asa a, himahleh athei kei uh.
Huan azing in alak ua mi nih akilai un akiang uh ava naih a, 'Pute aw, unau nei ve ua; bangziak a dikloutak a kibawl na hi ua?' chi in lep atum hi.
Himahleh a-invengpa tung a thugilou bawl zaw pen in Mosi tuh asawnhang a, koute tung a heutu leh vaihawm ding a kua'n hon bawl ahia?
Zan a Aigupta mi na thah bang a hon thah tum na hi maw? achi hi.
Huai thu ziak in Mosi ataimangta a, Midian gam ah ataam nilouh a, huai ah tapa nih ava nei hi.
"Huan kum sawmli nung in Sinai Tang gamdai ah; loubuk ah meikuang lak ah angel khat akiang ah ahong kilak hi.
Mosi in amuh in, athil muh tuh lamdang asa mahmah a; huan en ding a apai lai in, Toupa aw in:
'Kei na pipute Pathian, Abraham’ Pathian, Isak' Pathian, Jakob' Pathian, ka hi,' ana chi hi. Huchi in Mosi aling a a-en ngamta kei hi.
Huan Toupa'n akiang ah, 'Na khepek a kipan na khetuam suah in; na dinna Mun Siangthou ahi,' achi hi.
Aigupta gam a om ka mite gimdan ka mu gige hi, athum uh leng ka za gige, amau hunkhe ding in ka hong suk hi. Hong in, Aigupta gam ah ka hon sawl ding," achi hi.
"Kou tung a heutu leh vaihawm ding a kua'n hon bawl ahia, chi a adeih louh uh, Mosi, loubuk a angel kilak tungtawn in, Pathian in amah mah heutu leh hunkhepa hikhawm ding in asawlta hi.
Ama'n Aigupta gam ah Tuipi San leh gamdai mun ah, kum sawmli sung in thillamdang leh chiamtehnate amusak phot a, amaute apikheta ahi.
Israel suante kiang ah, 'Pathian in keimah bang in, na unaute lak a mi zawlnei khat, athu na ngaihkhiak ding uh ahon bawlsak ding chipa Mosi ahi.
Hiai mi ahi gamdai a omkhawmte lak a ompa, Sinai Tang a angel in ahoupihpa leh i pipute kiang a ompa; huai mi eite hon piaksawn ding a thuhingte lasawnpa mah ahi.
"I pipute'n amah thu amang kei ua, ahua ua, Aaron kiang ah,
'I makai ding in pathiante hon bawlsak in; Aigupta gam a kipan a hon pikhepa Mosi lah atanchin ka thei nawnta kei uhi,' chi in alungtang uh Aigupta gam lam ah anga nawnta uhi.
Huai lai in bawngnou lim abawl ua, amai a kithoihna alan ua amau khutsuak milim tung ah akipak uhi.

Huchi in Pathian in alehngatsan a, van a aksi abiak theihna ding un amaute akilehngat santa hi. Zawlnei laibu a, ‘Aw nou Israel inkote aw, gamdai ah kum sawmli sung in gan sisan a kithoih in thillat toh in kei na hon bia ua eita?

Molok biakna maitam leh na pathian uh, Remphan aksi leh, na milim bawltawmte uh, vialpuak in biak ding in na zong ua, huaiziak in Babulon kho khen lam ah sal in ka hon pomang ding,' chih gelh bang in.
"I pi-le-pute'n gamdai ah theihpihna biakbuk, Mosi kiang a theihsak a a-om bang leh alim amuhsak bang in ana bawl uhi.

Huai biakbuk mah i pipute suansawnte'n leng aneisawn zel ua, Pathian in i pipute ma a Zentel adelhkhiakte gam aluah lai un, Joshua makaih in biakbuk alutpih uhi. David hong om tan in huai ah a-om gige a,
amah Pathian mitmuh a deihsakna tang, Jakob' Pathian a ding in inn bawlsak angen hi.
Himahleh Solomon in huai inn alamsak zawta hi.
"Himahleh zawlnei gen bang in khut a bawl innte ah Tungnungpen a-om kei;
"Toupa'n van ka tutphah ahi a, lei ka khepek ngakna ahi; inn bangchibang na hon lamsak ding ua? Ka khawlna mun ding koi mun ahia?
Hiai thilte keimah khut in ka bawl kei a hia?" chi a, agen bang in.
"Migenhakte, lungtang leh bil a zeksumlouhte aw, chik lai peuh in Kha Siangthou na dal gige uh; na pipute uh hih bang in na hih nilouh uhi.
Na pipute un zawlneite lak ah kua ahia asawi louh uh? Mi Diktak hong ding thu genkholte athat ua; huai midiktak mansakte leh thatte noumau na hi uhi.
Dan angelte piaksawn mu masa a zuiloute aw," achi hi.
Huan huai thu azak un asin uh athakta a, Stephen tung ah aha uh agawita uhi.
Himahleh amah Kha Siangthou in adim a, van lam a-en a, Pathian thupina leh Pathian taklam a Jesu dingh amu hi.
"Ngai un, van kihong ka mu a, Pathian taklam a Mihing Tapa dingh leng ka mu," achi hi.
Huchi in amau aw ngaihtak in akikou ua, abil uh ahum ua,
kituaktak in apang ua, khua a kipan adelhkhia ua, suang in adeng ua, atheihpihte'n tangval khat amin Saul khebul ah apuante uh akoihkhawm chiat uhi.
Amaute'n Stephen suang in adengta ua; ama'n Pathian sam in, "Toupa Jesu, ka kha la in," achi hi.
Huan khukdin in aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Toupa, hiai akhelhna tung uah moh posak ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in huai agen zoh in, a-ihmuta hi.
Saul in leng asih hoih asa hi. Huai ni in Jerusalem a saptuam omte tung ah nakpitak in sawina atung a; sawltakte kia lou ngal Judia leh Samaria bial teng ah adalhzak vekta uhi.
Huan Pathian limsak kuate hiam in Stephen avui ua, nakpitak in asuun uhi.
Saul in bel saptuam pawlte asawi a, inn teng a lut in, numei pasal akaikhia a, suangkul ah akhum hi.
Huan adalhzakte kho teng ah apaita ua, thu agen zel uhi.
Samaria ah Philip ahohsuk a, akiang uah Khrist thu atangkoupih hi.
Huan athillamdang hihte azak ua, amuh un, mipite'n lungsim mun khat in, Philip thugente alimsakta uhi.
Dawi nin paimi tampi amatte uh sung a kipan in aw ngaihtak a kikou a pawt leh mizaw leh khebai tampi hihdam a a-om ziak un.
Huchi in huai khopi ah nakpitak a kipahna a-om hi.
Huan mi khat amin Simon a-om a; ama'n mithupi ka hi, chi in tuma lam in huai khua ah mitkhialdawi in Samaria khomite lamdang satak in abawl nilouh hi.
Mi tengteng, aneupen a pan alianpen tan in, "Hiai mi Pathian thilhihtheihna thupi achih uh ahi," chi in athu alimsak chiat uhi.
Amitkhialdawi in sawtpi lamdang satak a abawl nak ziak in athu alimsak uhi.
Himahleh Philip in Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih leh Jesu Khrist min agen pen agintak tak un, numei leh pasalte'n baptisma atangta uhi.
Huan Simon nangawn in leng agingta a, baptisma atan zoh in Philip kiang ah a-om gige a, chiamtehna leh thillamdang thupite amu a, lamdang asa thei mahmah hi.
Huan sawltak Jerusalem a omte'n Samaria mite'n Pathian thu agingtata uh chih azak un, akiang uah Peter leh Johan asawl uhi.
Huai mite ava tunsuk uleh Kha Siangthou atantheihna ding un athumsak uhi.
Huai ma in alak uah kuamah tung ah atung nai kei a; Toupa Jesu min in baptisma atang phet uhi.
Huan sawltakte'n atung uah akhut uh akoih ua, Kha Siangthou atangta uhi.
Huan sawltakte khut ngakna ziak a Kha Siangthou piak ahi chih Simon in amuh in; dangka piak asawm hi.
"Hichibang thuneihna hon pe sam un, kuapeuh tung a leng khut ka koihna in Kha Siangthou atan samna ding in,” achi hi.
Himahleh Peter in akiang ah, "Na dangka nang toh mangkhawm hen, Pathian thilpiak dangka sum a lei na tup ziak in.
Hiai thu ah nang zaw na pang kei, tan leng na nei kei hi; Pathian ngaih in na lungtang adik kei hi.
Huaiziak in hiai na gitlouhna tawpsan inla, Toupa kiang ah thum in, huchi in na lungtang a na ngaihtuah ahon ngaidam khamoh ding hiam.
Thil khakna sinkha ah leh gitlouh gaklopna ah na om chih ka thei hi," achi hi.
Huan Simon in, "Na thil gen uh bangmah ka tung a hong tunlouhna ding in noumau in Toupa kiang ah hon thumsak un," chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in amau Toupa thu atheihsak ua, agen zoh nung un, Jerusalem a kik nawn in, Samari mite tenna khua tampi ah tanchinhoih agen zel uhi.
Huan Toupa angel khat in Philip ahoupih a, "Thou inla, simlam a Jerusalem a kipan Gaza kho sunsuk lampi huai gamdai ah hoh in," achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, apaita hi; huan ngai in, Ethiopia gam a mi khat, Ethiopia kumpinu Kandas gou tengteng kempa, michilgeh thuneitak, Jerusalem ah Pathian be ding in ahohtou hi.
Apaikik lam kangtalai a tu in zawlnei Isai laibu asim hi.
Huchi in Kha in Philip kiang ah, "Huai kangtalai va naih inla, va kithuahpih in,” achi hi.
Michilgeh kiang ah Philip ava tai a, zawlnei Isai laibu asim aza a, "Na laibu sim na theisiam hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, “Kuamah hon hilhchet louh in bangchi in ka theisiam dia?" chi in akiang a kaltou a tutpih ding in Philip achialta hi.
Laisiangthou asim lai tuh hiai ahi: "Goh ding belam bang in amah api ua; belamnou amulmetpa ma a adaih dide bang in ama'n leng akam aka kei;
avuallelh lai in atung ah thugen aphal kei ua; asuante tanchin kua'n ahon gen ding ua? Khovel a kipan in ahinna alaksak ngal ua," chi in.
Michilgeh in Philip ahoupih a akiang ah, "Zawlnei in hiai thu kua thu ahia agen, amah thu hia, midang thu? Ka hon dong hi," achi hi.
Huan Philip in adawng a, Laisiangthou thu abul a pan in, akiang ah Jesu thu ahilhta hi.
Huan lampi a apai kawm un koi mun hiam tui omna khat atung ua; huan michilgeh in, "En dih, hiai ah tui a-om, baptisma ka tan ding bang in hon dal ahia?" achi hi.
Philip in, "Na lungtang tengteng a na gintakleh na hi thei," achi hi. Ama'n, "Jesu Khrist, Pathian Tapa ahi chih ka gingta," chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in kangtalai akhawlsak ua, anih un, Philip leh michilgeh, tui ah ahohkhawmsuk ua; huchi in ama'n abaptista hi.
Huan tui a pan apaitouh un Toupa Kha in Philip alamangta a; huan michilgeh in amah amu nawnta kei, nuamsatak in apai zel hi.
Himahleh Azotas ah Philip muh in a-om nawn hi; huan apaisuak kawm in Kaisaria atun masiah kho teng ah tanchinhoih agen zel hi.
Saul in Toupa nungzuite vau leh thah atup thu agen lailai man in siampu lianpen kiang ah ava hoh hi.
Damaskas a sinagog tengteng amite kiang a piak ding in lai angen a, hiai Lampi zui mi kuapeuh amuhleh, numei leh pasal leng, hen a Jerusalem a hon pitheihna ding in.
Huan apai lai in, Damaskas atun kuan in, thakhat in van a kipan vak akim ah ahong vak puap hi.
Huan lei ah apuk a, akiang ah, "Saul, Saul, bang achia nang hon sawi na hia?" chi in aw aza hi.
Huan ama'n, "Toupa, kua na hia?" achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Na sawi Jesu ka hi; kilhna sikzum na tot nang ding in ahaksa hi," achi hi.
Huan ling leh lamdang sa kawm in, "Toupa bang sem ding a hon deih na hiam?" achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, khopi ah lut in, huchi in na hih ding hilh in na om ding hi," achi hi.
Atonpihte gen ding thei lou in adingh ua, aw zaw aza ua, himahleh kuamah amu kei uh.
Huan lei a kipan in Saul athou a; ahong hak a kuamah amutheita kei hi; huchi in akhut in akai ua, Damaskas ah apilut uhi.
Huan ni thum kho mu lou in a-om a, bangmah ne in adawn kei hi.
Huan Damaskas ah amin Ananias nungzui khat a-om hi. Toupa'n mengmu bang in akiang ah, "Ananias,” achi hi.
Huan ama'n, "En in, Toupa, hiai ah ka om," achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, Kongzing Tang achih uah hoh inla, Judas inn ah, Tarsas khomi, amin Saul kichi kankhia in. Ngai in, athum laitak ahi.
Ama'n mengmuhna in mi khat amin Ananias akiang ava lut a, amit hihvakna ding a atung akhut nga in amuta hi," achi hi.
Ananias in, "Toupa huai mi Jerusalem a na misiangthoute tung a atatsiat thu mi tampi kam ah ka za hi.
Huan hiai ah na min lou peuhmah hen ding in siampu liante a kipan thuneihna toh hong pai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
Himahleh Toupa'n akiang ah, "Hoh mai in; Zentelte, kumpipate leh Israel suante kiang a ka min polut ding a ka belseh ahi.
Ka min ziak in gimna bangchi a thupi ahia athuak ding akiang ah ka theisak ding," achi hi.

Huan Ananias ava hoh a, inn ah alut a, huan atung ah akhut anga a, "Unau Saul, na mitvakna ding leh Kha Siangthou dim a na omtheihna ding in, Toupa, na hong paina lampi a na kiang a kilak Jesu'n hon sawl ahi," achi hi.
Huan thakhat in amit a kipan lip bang aketa a, amit avak nawnta a; athou a, huan baptisma atangta hi.
Huan an ane a, ahalhta hi. Huan Damaskas a nungzui omte kiang ah ni bangzah hiam ataam hi.
Huan Sinagog ah, "Jesu, Pathian Tapa" ahihdan thu atangkoupih zui ngal hi.
Huan athu zate tengteng in lamdang asa ua, “Hiai mipa Jerusalem a hiai minloute sawi zelpa ahi kei a hia? Huai mite siampu liante kiang a hensa a piak sawm a hong hohpa hilou hia?" achi uhi.
Saul bel ahong hattuam a, huai mi Khrist ahi taktak chih ahilhchian a, Damaskas a Juda omte gen ding bei in akoih hilhial hi.
Huan ni sawttak nung in Saul that ding in Judate akihou uhi.
Himahleh ama'n athiltup uh ana thei hi. Huan amah thah tum in kulh kong teng ah sun leh zan in atang uhi.
Himahleh anungzuite'n zan in api ua, kulh tohlet ah bawm in akhaikheta uhi.
Huan Jerusalem a Saul atuntak in nungzuite kithuahpih atum a; amau bel avek un amah akihta ua, nungzui ahih sam agingta kei uhi.
Barnabas in amah api a, sawltakte kiang ah apaipih a, lampi a Toupa amuh a, ahoupihdan bang, Damaskas a Jesu min a hangtak a thu ahilhdan khawng leng akiang uah agenta hi.
Huchi in Jerusalem ah Saul tuh akiang uah lut zel pawt zel in a-omta a, Toupa min in hangsantak in thu agen zel hi.
Huan Grik pau zang Judate kiang ah thu agen a, asel a; amau bel amah hihlup atum uhi.
Huan unaute'n huai atheihtak un, Kaisaria ah apisuk ua, Tarsas ah asawlmangta uhi.
Huchi in saptuamte Judia, Galili leh Samaria gam kimvel ah akip deuhdeuh ua, muangtak in a-omta ua; huan Toupa laudan siam kawm in, Kha Siangthou khamuan in a-om ua, ahong pung deuhdeuh uhi.
Huan Peter in kho kim atot vialvial kawm in, Lidda a Mi Siangthou omte kiang ah leng ahohsuk hi.
Huai ah mi khat amin Ainias, azawt ziak a kum giat lupna a lumden amu hi.
Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Ainias aw, Jesu Khrist in ahon hihdam, thou inla, na awngphah zial in,” achi hi. Huchi in athou pahta hi.
Huan Lidda khua leh Sharon phai a omte tengteng in Ainias amu ua, Toupa lam anga duam uhi.
Huan Joppa ah amin Tabitha nungzui khat a-om a, Tabitha minkhiakna tuh Dorkas ahi, huai numei in thil hihhoih leh thilpiak ahau mahmah hi.
Huai lai in, achi ana a, asi hi; huchi in asilsiang ua, indan tungnung ah asial uhi.
Huan Lidda khua tuh Joppa kho kiang ahih ziak in, nungzuite'n Peter huai ah a-om chih aza ua, "Sawt hal lou in ka kiang uah hong pai in," chi a va thum ding in akiang ah mi nih asawl uhi.
Huan Peter athou a akiang uah apaita hi. Huan atuntak in indan tungnung ah api ua; meithai tengteng dingh in, akiang ua Dorkas a-om lai a apuanak bawlte, apuan bawlte lak kawm in akap chiat uhi.
Himahleh Peter in avek un apawtsak a, akhukdin a, athumta hi; huan luanglam anga a, "Tabitha, thou in," achi hi. Huchi in amit ahong hak a, Peter amuhtak in atutou hi.
Huan Peter in akhut apia a, akaithou hi, misiangthoute leh meithaite asam a, hingdam in apeta hi.
Huan huai Joppa kho tengteng in athei vek ua; mi tampi in Toupa agingta uhi.
Huan Joppa ah savunbawlpa Simon inn ah ni tampitak Peter ataam nilouh hi.
Judah kumpipa Uzziah vaihawm lai leh Israel kumpipa Joas tapa Jeroboam vaihawm lai a zinling ma kum nih in, Tekoa mun ganhon veng mite lak a mi Amos thu Israel tungtang amuh:
Huan ama'n, "Zion tang a kipan TOUPA ahumham ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in a-aw asuah ding; belam veng mite gantatna munte alungkham ding ua, Karmel tang vum avuai ding," achi hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Damaskas kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Gilead gam buhgawina sikte a agawi ziak un.
Himahleh Hazael inn ah mei ka sawl ding a, Ben-hadad kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.

Huan Damaskas kho kongkhak sik ka hihtan ding a, Aven Phaizang a kipan luah mite leh Eden inn a kipan kumpipa chiang tawipa ka mangsak ding a; Siria gam mite Kir gam ah sal in a-om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Gaza kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka hihtawp kei ding; Edom kiang a piak ding in mi tengteng sal a api ziak un.
Himahleh Gaza kulh tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.

Huan Ashdod a kipan luahmi leh Ashkelon a kipan kumpipa chiang tawimi ka hihmang ding a; huan, Ekron kho tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, Philistia mi khosuaksunte amang ding uh," Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Tura kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Edom kiang a mi tengteng apiak ua, unau tung a athukhun atheihgige louh ziak un.
Himahleh Tura khokulh tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding,” achi hi.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Edom tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, gawtna ka daisak kei ding; a-unau namsau in adelh a, ahehpihna tengteng apaimang a, ahehna in abotkek gige a, tangtawn a ahehna avom nilouh ziak in.
Himahleh Teman tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Bozrah kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ammon tate tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; agam uh azatsak theihna ding un, Gilead kho numei naupaite akuihkek ziak un.
Himahleh Rabbah khokulh tung ah mei ka mutkuang ding a, huan, kidouna ni a kikou toh, pingpei ni a huihpi toh, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding.
Akumpipa uh sal in aman ding ua, amiliante toh kiton in," TOUPA'N achi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Moab tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Edom kumpipa guhte sunu bang zen a ahal ziak in.
Himahleh Moab tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Kerioth kumpipa guhte akang khin ding; huan Moab buaina leh kikou leh pengkul ging in asi ding hi.
Huai lak a kipan vaihawmmi ka hihmang ding a, amiliante tengteng, amah toh ka that ding," TOUPA'N achi.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Judah tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; TOUPA dan adeih kei ua, athupiakte azui kei uh, apate uh chih sek azuaugente un amaute apimang ziak in.
Himahleh Judah tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Jerusalem kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding," chi in.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; dangkasik a midiktat azuak uleh khedap but khat a mitasam azuak ziak un.
Gentheite leivui bang a sikden ut tuntun a, mizawngte vaihawmna akaikawi uhi; huan, mi khat leh apa nungak khat kiang ah ka min hihnin ding in ahoh zel uhi.
Maitam tengteng kiangchin a khamna puanphah tung ah alum zel ua, a Pathian uh inn a mi aliausakna mante un uain adawn zel uh," chi in.
"Himahleh amau ma a Amorte, Sidar bang a sang leh tosaw bang a khauh hihmang a; tunglam a kipan agah leh nuailam a kipan azung leng hihmangpa ka hi.
Huan Amorte gam nei ding in Aigupta gam a kipan in ka hon pikhia a, gamdai ah kum sawmli sung ka hon pi hi.
Huan zawlnei hi ding in na tapate uh lak a mi leh Nazaritte hi ding in na tangvalte uh lak a mi ka bawl a, Aw Israel suante aw, huchibang in ahi kei a hia? TOUPA'N achi.
Himahleh Nazarit mite kiang ah uain dawn ding na pia ua, zawlneite kiang ah, thu gen kei un, chi in thu na pia uhi.
Ngai dih ua, kangtalai a buhphal sawnsip bang in, na mun uah ka hon sawn ding hi.
Huan mitaihatte hatna amang ding a, mihat in tha asuah thei sam kei ding hi; mihat mahmah leng akihumbit thei kei ding hi.
Thalpeu zangmi leng adingh thei sam kei ding; paihat thei mi leng akihumbit thei kei ding, sakol tungtuangmi leng akihumbit thei kei ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in mi thilhihthei mahmah lak a mihangsan leng vuaktang in ataimang ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Aw, Israel suante aw, Aigupta gam a kipan a ka hon pikhiak inkote aw, TOUPA'N hichibang a nou ahon demna thu ngaikhia un,
"Noute kia leitung a inkuan tengteng a ka theih na hi ua; huaiziak in na thulimlouhna tengteng uah ka hon gawt ding," achi hi.
Akithukim kei un mi nih apai-khawm ding ua hia?
Humpinelkai in gammang a sa amat lai louh ngal in, ahumham ngei a hia? Humpinelkai lun lai in bangmah amat keileh akohawm sung a kipan ahumham ngei a hia?
Amah a dia tah a-om keileh, leitung a thang ah vasa a-awk thei a hia? Thang pen bangmah awk lou in lei a kipan in akisai dia hia?
Khopi ah mi launa lou ah pengkul amut ding ua hia? TOUPA hih louh in khopi ah hoihlouhna ahong om dia hia?
Diktak in Toupa PATHIAN in anasemmi, azawlneite kiang ah athuguk hilh lou in bangmah ahih kei ding hi.
Humpinelkai ahumham a, kua ahia lau lou ding? Toupa PATHIAN in thu agen a, kua'n ahia gen lou thei ding?
Ashdod kumpipa' inn te leh Aigupta gam kumpipa' inn te ah gen unla, "Samaria tang tungte ah kikhawm unla, huai a buaina liantak omte leh huai lak a simmohna omte en un," chi in.
"Akumpipa uh innte a hiamgamna leh kisuamna koihkhawm mite'n lah hihdik dan asiam ngal kei ua," TOUPA'N achi.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Gam kimvel in melma a-om lai ding a; na kiang a kipan na hatna alakhe ding a, na kumpipa' inn te ahihse ding uhi.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Belampu in humpinelkai kam a kipan akhe nih hiam, bil them hiam, ahonkhia bang in, huchibang in Samaria a teng Israelte lupna ning leh lupna maimom puanphan lukham them toh hutkhiak in a-om ding uhi.
Ngai unla, Jakob inkote tung ah theisak un,"

"Israel tatleknate amah tung ah ka gawtleh, huai ni chiang in, Bethel a maitamte leng ka gawt ngal dia; maitam kiite tankhiak in a-om ding ua, lei ah ake ding uh," sepaihte Pathian, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
"Huan phalbi leh nipi inn ka satse ding a; saiha innte amangthang ding a, inn thupite'n tawpna anei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Nou Bashan bawngpite, Samaria tang tung a om a, gentheite simmoh a, tasamte nuaisiah a, atoupate uh kiang a, "Hon la unla i dawn ding uh," chite aw, hiai thu za un;
Toupa PATHIAN in ama sianthouna in akichiam a, "Ngai dih ua, sikkuaika a nou ahon lakmang a, na lak ua omsun ngakuai a ahon lakmang ni ahong tung ding hi.
Huan awngvang ah na paisuak ding ua, michih tangtak in apai ding uh; Harmon ah paih in na om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
"Bethel ah hong unla, talek un; Gilgal ah hong unla, tatlekna pungsak un; huan, na kithoihnate uh zingsang teng in hon la unla, ni khat hal zel in na sawm ua khatte uh hon la un.
Huan silngou pang kipahthu gen kithoihna lan unla, amau deihdan a lante hilh unla, puang un; Aw Israel suante aw, hiai lah na deih ngal ua," Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
"Huan ke'n leng na khopi tengteng uah hasianna leh na mun tengteng uah taksapna ka hon pia a; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.

“Buh lak hun ding kha thum ahih lai in na tung ua vuah zu ding leng ka len a; khopi khat tung ah ka zusak in, khopi dang tung ah ka zusak kei hi; mun khat tung ah ka zusak sek a, azuklouhna mun akeu hi.
Huchi in khopi nih leh thum ah tui dawn ding zong in khopi dang ah ataikhawm ua, adeihkhop kei uh; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.

"Keuna leh apna in ka hon gawt a; na huante uh, na grephuante uh, na theipi kungte uh, na olive singkungte uh singnget lung in ane khin vekta hi; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.

"Aigupta gam bang in na lak uah huihpi ka sawl a; namsau in na tangvalte uh ka that a, na sakolte uh ka pimang a; na giahphualte uh gim namsia na nak ua nam khop in ka hon omsak a; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
"Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah khua achipsak lai bang in, na lak uah mi khenkhat ka hihchim a, singkang lakkhiak bang na hi ua; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Huaiziak in "Aw Israel, na tung ah hichibang in ka hih ding; na tung a hiai ka hih ding ziak in, Aw Israel, na Pathian tuak ding in mansa in om in!"
"Ngai in, tangte dingkhesak a, huih bawl a, mihing kiang a angaihtuahna bang ahia chih genkhesak a, zingsang mialsak, lei mun sangte chilpa amin TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian ahi!"
Aw Israel inkote aw, hiai thu noute suunna ding ka gen za un.
Nungak, Israel, apukta hi; adingh nawn kei ding; agam tung ah paihkhiak ahita; amah tungding ding kuamah a-om kei.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel chite kiang ah, khopi sangkhat pawtna in zakhat anuse ding a, khopi zakhat pawtna in sawmkhat anuse ding hi.”
TOUPA'N Israel inkote kiang ah hichi in achi:

"Hon zong un, na hing ding uh; himahleh Bethel khua zong kei unla, Gilgal ah lut sam kei un, Beer-sheba ah galkah kei unla; pel lou in Gilgal khua sal in aman ding a, Bethel khua ahong vuaksuak ding hi."
TOUPA zong unla, na hing ding uh; huchi lou in zaw Joseph inn ah mei bang in apawt ding a, akang khin ding a, Bethel ah mitsak ding kuamah a-om kei ding uhi.
Vaihawmna singkha suaksak a, diktatna lei a paikhete aw;
siguk leh zuheisuktun bawlpa leh sihna limliap lak a tangsakpa leh sun zanmial a bawlpa, tuipi tuite sam a, leitung a luangsakpa, amah tak zong le uchin; amin TOUPA ahi;
kulh tung a manthatna hong tung guih zou hial a, mihatte tung a manthatna tungsakpa pen.
Kongpi ah taihilhmi amudah ua, thudiktak genmi akih uhi.
Huaiziak in migentheite tuanden in buh na laksak ua; suangsek in innte na lam ua, himahleh asung ah na teng kei ding uh. Grephuan nuamte na bawl ua, himahleh uain na dawn kei ding uhi.
Na tatleknate uh tamdan leh na khelhnate uh athupidan lah ka thei ngal a; midiktatte na simmoh ua, golhna la a, kongpi a tasamte ahih ding him ua pampaihte aw.
Huchi in hun hoih lou ahih ziak in mipil zaw huai hun chiang in adai dide ding hi.
Na hintheihna ding un hoihlouhna zong lou in, hoihna zong unla; huan na gen bang un, TOUPA sepaihte' Pathian na kiang uah a-om ding hi.
Khelhna hua unla, hoihna it un; kongpi ah vaihawmna kiptak in tungding un; Joseph inkuan akhosuaksunte tung ah TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian in hehpihna anei kha mai ding hi.

Huaiziak in TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Toupa'n hichi in achi: "Kongzing teng ah nakpi a kahna a-om ding a, lamliante tengteng ah, khawk hi na mah e; achi ding uh; lungkham ding in lounei mite leh nakpi a kap ding in sisuun siamte asam ding uhi.
Grephuan teng ah nakpi a kahna a-om ding a; na lak uah ka paisuak ding," TOUPA'N achi.
TOUPA ni deihte aw, na tung uh agik hi! Bangziak a TOUPA ni deih na hia ua? Vak hilou in mial ahi zaw hi.
Humpinelkai taisan a, vompi tuak mi bang leh inn a lut a, baang tung a khut nga a gul in atuk bang ahi.
TOUPA ni vak hilou in mial ahi sin kei a hia? Mial sah leh vakna nei lou in?
"Na ankuangluite uh ka hua in ka musit a, na kikhawmpi pisuakte uah leng ka kipak sam kei hi.
Ahi, na thillat uleh na buh lat uh hon lan mah le uchin, ka sang kei ding, na gan thau uh lemna thillatte leng ka limsak sam kei ding hi.
Na kaihging ging kilawm uh ka ngaikhe kei ding; huaiziak in kei a kipan bil aphuai na late uh lamang un.
Himahleh vaihawmna bel tuite bang in leh diktatna lui lian bang in luang hen," TOUPA'N achi.
"Aw Israel inkote aw, kum sawmli sung in gamdai ah kithoihnate leh thillatte ka kiang ah na hon lan ngei ua hia?
Ahi, na milim uh Molok leh na milimte uh Kaiuan, na aksi pathian uh, noute ding in na tawisang zaw uhi.
TOUPA amin sepaihte' Pathian in, noute Damaskas kho khen ah sal in ka hon paisak ding," TOUPA'N achi.
"Zion tang a nuam lua a omte leh Samaria tang a bittak a omte leh Israel nam lian lak a inkuan mithupite tung agik hi!
Kalneh ah hoh unla, en un; huai a kipan in Hamath kho thupi ah hoh un; Philistia gam Gath ah paisuk unla; hiai gamte sang in noute na hoihzaw uhia? Nou gam sang in agam uh azazaw a hia?
Nou ni hoih lou gamlapi a koih leh hiamgam tunna naihsakte aw,
saiha lupna a lum a, atutphah sau tungte ua kizia a, belamhon lak a belamnoute leh bawnghonte lak a kipan bawngtuaite ne a;
David bang a kaihging tumtum a, lasak ding na bawlbawl uh;
belhbu lian a uain dawn a, sathau hoihpen a kinuhte mah; himahleh Joseph haksatna ziak in alungkham kei uhi.
Huchi in tua sal dia pai masate toh sal in apai ding ua, nuam sa a kiziate nopsakna lakmang in a-om ding hi."
TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Toupa PATHIAN in amah-le-amah kilou in akichiam a, "Jakob kisaktheihna ka kih a, akumpipa' inn te ka mudah a; huaiziak in khua leh asung a om tengteng ka mansak sin ahi.”
Hichi ahong hi ding a, inn khat a mi sawm a-omleh asi vek ding uhi.

Huan vui ding a thaunilh, misite tanau, amaute halpa ngei in insung a kipan a aguh lakhe ding in, insung tawng pen a mi om kiang ah, "Na kiang ah kuahiam midang a-om lai uhia?" achih a, ama'n, "Om lou,” achihleh; ama'n, "Dai sipsip in! TOUPA min i lou ding uh ahi ngal kei a," achi ding hi.
Ngai dih ua, TOUPA'N thu apeta hi; inn lian achim lemlum ding a, inn neu leng akhangkham ik-iak ding hi.
Sakolte suangpi tung ah atai ding ua hia? Huai ah mi'n bawng in lei alet ding ua hia? Noute'n vaihawmna lah gu na suaksak ua diktatna gah singkha na suaksak uh.
Nou thil bangmah lou tung a kipak a, i hatna in ahi kei maw kiite i lak ua? chite aw.
"En dih ua, Aw Israel inkote aw, nou hon dou ding in nam ka dingkhesak ding a; huan Hamath khomual a kipan in Arabah lui tan in nou ahon engbawl ding uh," TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian in achita hi.
Huchibang in Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; ngai dih ua, haichi poi nanungzaw pen adot pat tungna ah khaukhup abawl a; ngai dih ua, kumpipa tangseu khit a pou nanungzaw ahi.
Huan huchi ahong hi a, huai gam a loupa anek khit nung un, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ngaidam in, ka hon ngen ahi; bangchi in Jakob adingh thei dia? Amah lah aneu ngal a," ka chi hi.
Hiai thu ah TOUPA'N alung hei in, "TOUPA'N, hiai hong tung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Huchibang in, Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; huan en dih ua, Toupa PATHIAN mei a dou ding in asam a; mei in tui thuk lian akang khin a, gam leng kat a-ut lai hi.
Ke'n, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, khawl in ka hon ngen ahi; bangchi in Jakob adingh thei dia? Amah lah aneu ngal a," ka chi hi.
Hiai thu ah TOUPA'N alungsim hei in, "Toupa PATHIAN in, huai leng ahong tung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Hichibang in ahon ensak a; ngai dih ua, TOUPA bel ulum a bawl baang kiang ah adingh a, akhut a ulum toh.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA'N, "Amos, bang na mu a?" achi a. Ke'n, "Ulum," ka chi hi. TOUPA'N, “Ngai in, ka mi, Israelte lak ah ulum ka koih ding a; amau ka paikheng nawnta kei ding;
Isak mun sangte ahong segawp ding a, Israel mun siangthoute hihsiat ahi ding ua; Jeroboam inkote namsau in ka dou ding," achi hi.
Huan Bethel kho siampu Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kiang ah, "Amos in Israel inkote lak ah nang hon kalh a; gam in athu tengteng athuak thei kei," chi in.
Amos in lah hichi in achi ngal a, “Jeroboam namsau in asi ding, pel lou in agam a kipan in Israel sal in apikhe ding," chi in thu akhak hi.
Huan Amos kiang ah Amaziah in, "Aw nang zawlnei, kuan inla, Judah gam ah taimang in, huai ah an ne inla, thu hilh in.
Himahleh Bethel ah thu hilh nawn ke'n; kumpipa mun siangthou leh kumpipa' inn ahih ziak in," achi lai hi.
Huan Amaziah kiang ah Amos in, "Zawlnei ka hi kei a, zawlnei tapa leng ka hi sam kei; ganhon vengpa leh theipi sing kempa ka hi zaw hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, 'Kuan inla, ka mi Israelte kiang ah thu gen in,' hon chi hi.
Huchi in tu in TOUPA thu za in; nang Israel kalh in thu gen ke'nla, Isak inkote kalh in thu khak ke'n, na chih.

Huaiziak in ToUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Khopi ah na zi kizuaknu ahi ding a, na tapate, na tanute namsau in apuk ding ua, tehna khau in na gam ahawm ding ua; nang leng siang lou mun ah na si ding a; pel lou in Israel a gam a kipan sal in apimang ding uh, achi,' " chi in adawng hi.
Hichibang in Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; en dih ua, nipithei bawm na hi hi.

Ama'n, "Amos, bang ahia na muh?" achi a. Ke'n, "Nipithei bawm," ka chi hi. TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Ka mi Israelte tung ah tawpna ahong tungta; amaute gawtna ding ah ka lungsim ka kheng nawn kei ding hi, chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in, huai ni chiang in tempul a lasakte dahna la ahi ding a; mun chih ah siluang tampi a-om ding a, dai dide in apaikhe ding uh," achi hi.
Hiai ngaikhia in, aw tasamte ne bei nuam a; gam a migentheite hihmang nuamte aw,

"Buh ka zuaktheihna ding un chikchiang a kha thak bei ding a, tangbuang buh ka zuaktheihna ding ua chikchiang a Sabbath ni bei ding ahia, chi in; Ephah hihneu a shekel hihlian, dikloupi a bukna khemna in na zang ua,
huchi a dangkasik a migentheite lei a, tasamte khedap buh khat a i lei a, buhsi i zuaktheihna ding in,” chi in.
TOUPA, Jakob thupina sial in akichiam a, “Pel lou in anasep himhim ka mangngilh het kei ding," chi in.
Hiai ziak in gam pumpi ling in asung a om peuhmahte alungkham kei ding ua hia? Ahi, tui lian bang in ahong khang vek ding a; Aigupta gam lui bang in ahong buai in akiam ding hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in, huai ni chiang in, hichi ahong hi ding a, sun lai in ni ka tumsak ding a, nisat lai in lei ka mialsak ding hi.

Na ankuangluite uh lungkhamna leh na la tengteng uh kahna ka suaksak ding a; kawng tengteng sai-ip puan ka tengsak ding a, lu chih sip ah giauna ka hon tungsak ding; tapa tang neih suunna ding in lungkhamna leh atawpna khatna ni bang in ka bawl ding hi.
“Toupa PATHIAN in, ngai dih ua, nite ahong tung lellel; huai ni chiang in gam ah kial ka sawl ding a, an kialna hilou, tui a kialna hi sam lou, TOUPA thu theihna kialna pen," achi hi.
Huan tuipi a kipan tuipi ah leh mal a kipan suahlam ah leng avakvai ding ua; TOUPA thu zong ding in ning chih ah atai ding ua, amu kei ding uh.
Huai ni chiang in nungak siangthou leh tangvalte dangtak in abah ding uhi.
"Samaria khelhna sial a kichiam a, 'Aw Dan, na Pathian ahin bang in' leh 'Beer-sheba Lampi ahin bang in' chi, huai mite leng apuk ding ua, athounawn het kei ding uh,” achi hi.

Maitam chin a TOUPA dingh in ka mu a, ama'n, "Kongpi bulte alin theihna ding ua alu bawkte uh khen inla, avek ua lutung ah hihzan vek in; ke'n asibangte namsau in ka that ding a; khat lel leng ataimang kei ding uh, khat lel leng asuakta het kei ding uh," achi hi.
Misikhua pha in paisuak mah le uh, huai a kipan ka khut in ka lakhe ding a; van ah kaltou mah le uh huai a kipan ka kaikhe ding hi.
Karmel mualvum ah bu mah le uh ka zong ding a, huai a kipan amau ka lasuk ding a, tuipi taw ah ka mitmuh louh in bu mah le uh, huai a kipan gulpi thu ka pe ding a, amau atu ding hi.
Amelmate uh ma ah sal in pai mah le uh, huai a kipan namsau thu ka pe ding a, amau asatlum ding ua; hoihna hilou in, hoihlouhna ding in atung uah ka mit ka nga ding hi.
