Gam khoih a, zulsakpa TOUPA, sepaihte’ Pathian ahi ngal a; huai lai a omte tengteng alungkham ding ua; luipi bang in akhang ding ua, Aigupta lui bang in akiam nawn ding uh;
van a adantante bawl a, leitung a adantan kual bawl a, tuipi tuite sam a, leitung a sungbopa, amin TOUPA ahi.

TOUPA'N "Aw Israel suante aw, ka tung ah Ethiopia tate bang in na om kei ding ua hia? Aigupta gam a kipan Israel leh Kaphtor gam a kipan Philistia mite leh Kir gam a kipan Siria mite ka pikhe kei a hia?" achi hi.
TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih ua, Toupa PATHIAN mit gam gilou tung ah atu a, leitung a kipan ka hihmang ding a; himahleh Jakob inkote ahihse vek kei ding,” achi hi.
"Ngai dih ua, thu ka pe ding ahi; hakvang a buh ahaih bang un, nam tengteng lak ah Israel inkote ka haih ding a; himahleh tang neupen leng leitung ah ake kei ding hi.
'Ka mite mikhial tengteng, hoihlouhna in ahon delhpha kei ding a, hon pha sam kei ding,' chite namsau in asi ding uh," achi hi.
TOUPA, hiai thilhihpa'n, "Huai ni chiang in David biakbuk chim ka tungding ding a, a-awngvangte ka hu ding a; asiate ka lemtou ding a, nidanglai a a-om bang in ka lam thak ding hi, chi in;
Edom mun a khosuaksunte leh ka min a sap nam tengtengte aneihtheihna ding un," achi hi.

TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih ua, nite ahong tung lellel ahi, huai ni chiang in leiletmi in buh atmi adelhpha ding a, grep chil mi'n chi thehmi adelhpha ding a; tang sang in uain khum ataksak ding; mual tengteng azul ding uhi.

Huan ka mi Israelte sal a kipan ka pikik nawn ding a; khua kigawpsate abawl nawn ding ua, aluah ding uh; huan grephuante abawl ding ua, a-uain adawn ding uh; huante leng abawl ding ua, agah ane ding uhi.
Agam uah amau ka phutkip ding a, akiang ua ka piak agam ua kipan bohkhiak in a-om nawnta kei ding," TOUPA na Pathian in achi hi.
Paul, Pathian deihdan a Khrist Jesu sawltak leh i unaupa Timothi in,
Kolossa a Khrist a misiangthoute leh unau muanhuaite kiang ah, Pathian i Pa kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Nou a ding a thum gige in Pathian i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa kiang ah kipahthu ka gen uhi,
Khrist Jesu na gindan uh leh misiangthou tengteng tung a itna na neihdan uh ka zak tak ziak un.
Huai bel nou a ding a lametna van a koihkholh a a-om ziak ahi. Huai lametna tanchin mah tuma in, tanchinhoih thutak na zata uhi.
Huai tanchinhoih tuh khovel tengteng ah gah a akhan zel mah bang in na kiang uh ahong tung a, Pathian hehpihna na ngaihkhiak ua na zak ni ua kipan in, noumau ah leng gah in akhang zel hi.
Huchibang in Epaphras i sikha hihpih ngaihtak lak a na zil bang un, amah kou sik in Khrist nasempa muanhuai ahi.
Ama'n Kha a na itna uh ahon hilh hi.
Huaiziak in ka zak ni ua kipan kou leng noute a ding in thum leh nget ka tawp kei uhi; huchi a khalam pilna leh theihna tengteng a adeihlam theihna a hihdim a na hong omtheihna ding un.
Huan nasep hoih chiteng a gah a, Pathian theihna a khang a, ama kipah lam a Toupa a dia kilawm a na hintheihna ding un.
Kipahna toh kithuah thuakhatna leh kuhkalna nei ding in, ahatna thupi bang zel a hihhat in hong om un.
Vak a misiangthoute gouluahpih dia hon chingsak Pa kiang a kipahthu gen in.
Ama'n mial thuneihna lak a kipan hon suaktasak in, a Tapa ittak gam ah hon kaisakta hi.
Amah ah i tatkhiakna leh khelhnate ngaihdamna i mu uhi.
Amah muh theih louh Pathian batpih, thilsiam tengteng a piang masapen ahi.

Amah ah bangkim siam ahi a, van a omte leh lei a omte, muhtheihte leh muh theihlouhte, laltutphahte, thuneihnate, vaihawmnate leh thilhihtheihnate hitaleh bangkim ama siam ahi, amah a ding mah a siam ahi.
Huan amah zaw bang teng om ma in leng a-om hi, amah ah bang teng adingkhawm chiat uhi.
Amah tuh pumpi, saptuam lutang ahi a; bangkim a tungnungpen ahong hihtheihna ding in abulpi, misi lak a kipan piang masapen ahi.
Amah ah Pathian taangchinna tengteng a om Pa deihlamtak ahi,
Ama kros sisan a lemna abawl in amah ah bangkim amah toh akilemsak a; amah ngei ah lei a thil omte leh van a thil omte leng amah toh akilemsakta hi.
Huan nou tuma lam in na lungsim uah amelma na hi ua, na thilhih gilou ua amah a kipan a khen a om na hi uhi, himahleh tu in ama'n amah toh hon kilemsakta a;
asihna in apumpi ah amah toh noute ahon kilemsakta hi, ama a siangthou, gensiatbei leh mohsak theih louh a ahon dinsak theihna ding in,

kingakna nei a kiptak a om a, tanchinhoih na zak ua lametna a kipan a suanmang a om lou a, ginna a na om gige peuhmah uleh; huai tanchinhoih van nuai a thilsiam tengteng lak a tangkoupih ahi a; kei Paul leng huai nna sem ding a bawl ka hi.
Nou ziak a tu a ka gimthuaknate ah ka kipak hi; huan apumpi ziak a Khrist in agimthuaknate ban zom zel ka hi; huai tuh Saptuam ahi.
Nou a ding a Pathian nasepna kei kiang a piak a om bang zel in huai saptuam nasempa ka hong hita; Pathian thu bukimtak a theisak ding in.
Huai Pathian thu tuh tangtawn leh akhang-akhang a kipan a thuguk kisel ahi; tu in bel misiangthoute kiang ah latsak in a-omta hi.
Amau kiang ah, Zentelte lak a huai thuguk thupina hauhsakna atamdan Pathian in theihsak a-ut him ahi; huai thuguk tuh Khrist noumau a om, thupina lametna pen ahi.
Michih Khrist a hoihkim a ka piaktheihna ding un michih hilh in, pilna chiteng a zilsak in, atanchin ka gen zel uhi.
Huchibang ding in nakpitak a keimah a asepsak thahatna tengteng zang in theihtawp in ka sem zel hi.
Noumau leh Laodisia a omte leh sa a ka mel mu lou peuhmahte a ding in bangchibang a thupi in ahia noute a dia ka kisuk na theih uh ka ut hi.
Pathian thuguk atheihtheih ua, theihsiamna theihchetna kim hauhna tengteng lam a, phankhawm a a-om ua, alungtangte uh lungmuang a a-omtheihna ding un;
pilna leh theihna gou chiteng amah Khrist ah selguk in a-om hi.
Kuamah in paukam siam a ahon khemzohlouhna ding un, huaite ka gen ahi.
Sa in na kiang uah om kei mah leng, kipaktak a om in na kizendan uleh Khrist ginna a na kipdan uh thei in, kha in na kiang uah ka om hi.
Huaiziak in Khrist Jesu, Toupa na kipahpih bang un, amah ah om un.
Amah a zungkai leh lamtouh a om in, ahon zilsak bang un na ginna ua kiptak a om in, kipahthu genna hau in amah ah om un.
Pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw kuapeuh in Khrist thu hilou, mihing thugousiah leh khovel thubulte bang in athupil uh leh khemna peuh in gallak in ahon la kha ding uhi.
Amah ah Pathian taangchinna chiteng tuh pumpi nei in a-om gige hi.
Amah ah hinna taangchinna na neita ngal ua; amah vaihawmna leh thuneihna tengteng lutang ahi.
Amah ah zeksum, mihing khut a sum hilou, Khrist in abawl zeksumna ah na pianken khelhna uh suahkhia in zeksum na hita uhi.
Baptisma a amah toh vui na hita ua, huai mah ah misi lak a kipan a Pathian nasep gintak ziak in amah toh kaihthoh na hi uhi.
Huan noute na tatleknate uleh na sa uh zeksumlouhna a si na hi ua, noumau ngei amah toh ahon hingsak in na tatlekna tengteng uh angaidamta hi.
I tatlekna tengteng hon ngaidam a, batna lai thupiak a gelh i tung ua om eimah hon dou gige anulmangta hi. Huai ngei kros a kilhlum in alamangta hi.
Vaihawmna leh thuneihnate suankhia in, huaite kros a zou in alangtang in theihsakna in azangta hi.
Huchi in nek-le-dawn thu ah hiam, ankuanglui leh kha thak thu ah leh Sabbath ni tan thu ah kuamah in hon dem kei hen.
Huaite thil hong tung ding lim ahi a, atak zaw Khrist ahi.
Kuamah in amau deih thu lel a thunuailutna leh angel biakna zang in, athil muhte uh pansan in, asalam lungsim ziak ua kisathei mawkmawk in, na kipahman uh hon suhsak kei hen.
Lutang len tinten lou in a-om uhi. Amah a kipan in pumpi apum in aguhtuah leh thaguite a vak leh zopkhawm a om in, Pathian khansak bang zel in akhang hi.
Khovel thubulte Khrist kiang a na sihsan uleh, bang achia khovel a khosa bang a thupiakte lak a na kipelut na hi ua?
Lawng ke'n, chiam ke'n, khoih ke'n, chihte,
mihingte thuchiam leh zilsakna huchibang thil tengteng zat kawm a mangthang ding hilou uhiam?
Hiai thilte bawltawm biakna leh thunuailutna tak lou leh pumpi kisukgentheihna ah zaw hihtuak hileh akilawm na a, himahleh sa deihlam zuih khamna ah bangmah aphatuam kei hi.
Huchi in Khrist toh kaihthohkhawm a na om tak man un, tunglam a Pathian taklam a tu Khrist omna a thil omte zong un.
Tunglam a thil omte ah na lungsim uh nga un; lei a thil omte a nga lou in.
Na sita ua, tu in na hinna uh Pathian ah Khrist toh sel in a-om hi.
Khrist i hinna uh ahong kilak chiang in nou leng amah kiang ah thupi in na kilak sam ding uhi.
Huchi in noumau a lei lam thil deihna omte that un, kingaihna, nitna, hukna, utna gilou, huaihamna; huai milim biakna ahi.
Huai thilte ziak in Pathian thangpaihna thumang lou tate tung ah atung nak ahi.
Nou leng tuma lam a huai thilte a na khosak lai un, huaite ah na kalsuan uhi.
Himahleh tu in nou leng hiai tengteng, hehna, thangpaihna, huatna, gensiatna, na kam ua pau zahmohte koihmang un.
Mihing lui athilhih toh na suahkheta uh chih mu in, kuamah kizuausantuah kei un,
mihing thak in na kivanta ngal ua; huai mihing thak asiampa batpih bang a theihna a siam thak in a-om lellel hi.
Huai ah Grik mi leh Juda mi, zeksum leh sum louh, melmak mite, Skithia mite, sikhate, noplente leng a-om kei; Khrist bangkim hi zaw in, bangkim ah a-om behlap lai hi.
Huaiziak in Pathian mitel, misiangthou leh deihtakte bang in lainatna lungtang, migitna, kingaih-niamna, thunuailutna, thuakzohna in kivan un.
Kuapeuh in kua tung ah leng thubuai nei hi le uchin, kithuakzou chiat in, kingaidamtuah unla, Toupa'n ahon ngaihdam tak bang in kingaidamtuah chiat un.
Huan huai tengteng tung ah itna silhthuah un; huai in thil bangkim kituaktak in agakkhawm hi.
Huan Khrist khamuanna in na lungtang uah vai hawm hen, huai ding in pumpi khat a sap na hi ua, kipahna dan leng thei un.
Khrist thu a hauhna teng toh noumau ah dimsak kiihkeih un, pilna chiteng a kisinsak leh kihilhtuah a om in, kipahna lungtang toh Pathian kiang a phatna late, Pathian late, khalam late sa in om un.
Huan na hih peuhmah uh thugen ah leh thilhih ah amah ziak a Pa Pathian kiang a kipahthu gen kawm in Toupa Jesu min in hih vek un.
Zite aw, Toupa ah akilawm hun bang zel in na pasalte uh kiang ah kiniamkhiak un.
Pasalte aw, na zite uh it unla, alak uah hanhat kei un.
Naupangte aw, bangkim ah na nu uleh na pate uh thu mang un, huai tuh Toupa pahtak lam ahi.
Pate aw, na tate uh hihnuak kei un, huchi lou in zaw alunglel kha ding uhi.
Sikhate aw, sa a na heutute uh thu bangkim ah mang un, mihing hihkipak lelte bang a mitmei nasem hilou in, lungtang sa khat a Toupa kihta kawm in,
na hih peuhmah uh, mihing a ding bang a hih lou in, Toupa a ding zaw in kilawptak in hih un;
Toupa a kipan in a-itna gouluah ding na mu ding uh chih thei in, Toupa Khrist nasem na hi uhi.
Thil diklou hihpa'n athil diklou hihman amu nawn ding hi; mi khentuamna a-om ngal kei hi.
Heutute aw, nou leng van ah heutupa na neih uh thei in, na sikhate uh tung ah adik atang leh akilawm hih un.
Thum gige unla, kipahthu gen kawm in kiveng gige un.
Khrist thuguk gen ding a Pathian in thu a dia kong a hon honsak theihna ding in kou leng hon thumsak un, huai thu ziak a hen a om ka hi.
Ka gen ding bangtak a ka genkhiak theihna ding in.
Hun na neih sung un atam theipen sem zel unla, polam mite lak ah piltak in om un.
Michih bangchibang a dawn ding hiam chih na theihna ding un na paukam suak uh chisoh, hehpihna hi gige hen.
Toupa a unau ngaihtak, nasempa muanhuai, sikha hihpih Taikikas in ka tanchin tengteng nou ahon theisak ding hi.
Hiai ziak in, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uleh, na lungtang uh ahon khamuan theihna ding in amah na kiang uah ka hon sawl hi;
Onesimas, unau muanhuai leh ngaihtak noumau lak a mi mah toh ahong ding uhi. Amau hiai lam a thil omdan tengteng ahon theisak ding uhi.
Aristarkhas, ka hentakpihpa'n nou chibai ahon buk hi. Barnabas tupa Marka in leng chibai ahon buk hi, amah tungtang thu ah thupiakte na mu uh; na kiang ua ahong paileh na kipahpih un;
Jesu, Justas achih un chibai nou ahon buk hi. Huaite zeksummi ahi ua, huaite kia Pathian lalgam thu lam ah ka seppih leh ahon khamuante ahi uhi.

Epaphras noumau lak a mi mah, Khrist Jesu sikha in noute chibai ahon buk hi, ama'n Pathian deihlam photphot a piching leh gingta tinten a na dintheihna ding un, athumna ah noute a ding in akisuk gige hi.
Noumau a ding, Laodisia a omte a ding leh Hierapolis a omte a ding in phatuam angai mahmah chih ka theihpih hi.
Luka, daktor ngaihtak leh Dema in chibai ahon buk uhi.
Laodisia khua a unau omte leh Nimphas leh a-inn a saptuamte chibai hon buksak un.
Huan hiai laikhak na lak ua na sim nung un, Laodisia saptuamte lak ah leng simsak un; nou leng Laodisia a pen na na sim sam ding uhi.
Huan Arkippas kiang ah, "Nasepna Toupa a i muh pen tangtun ding in pilvang in," na chi un.
Kei Paul in keimah khut ngei a hiai chibai bukna ka hon gelh ahi. Ka kolbulhte theigige un. Hehpihna na kiang uah om hen, Amen.
Judah kumpipa Jehoakim vaihawm akum thum kum in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong kuan in Jerusalem ahong um hi.

Huan TOUPA'N akhut ah Judah kumpipa Jehoakim apia a, Pathian in atui-um belsuan khenkhat toh; ama'n Shinar gam ah apathian inn ah huaite apua a; huchi in tui-um belsuante apathian sumkoihna inn ah alalutta hi.
Kumpipa'n amichilgehte heutupa Ashpenaz, Israel suante lak a kuate hiam, kumpi chite a kipan leh miliante a kipan hon pi ding in akiang ah thu agen hi.

Tuailaite amau a gensiatna om lou, himahleh hoihtak a deihsakna tang leh pilna tengteng a siamtheihna leh pilna theihsiamna lungpilte, kumpipa inpi a dingh thei ding, huchibang mite; huchi a Kaldai laisiamna leh pau amaute asinsak theihna ding in.
Huchi in kumpipa'n amau niteng tantuan ding in kumpipa an leh adawn uain a kipan in asehsak a, huchi a kum thum sung a kisinsiamsak a; huchi a huai hun abei chiang a kumpipa ma a adintheihna ding un.
Huchi in hiaite lak ah, Judah tate a kipan, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael leh Azariah a-om uhi.
Michilgehte heutupa'n amaute min ding aphuahsak a; Daniel min ding in Belteshazzar; Hananiah min ding in Shadrak; Mishael min ding in Meshak leh Azariah min ding in Abednego aphuak hi.
Himahleh Daniel in kumpipa an hiam adawn uain hiam a kihihnit louh alungtang in atum tinten hi. Huaiziak in michilgeh heutupa kiang ah akihih nitlouhna ding in angenta hi.
Huchi in Pathian in Daniel michilgehte heutupa mitmuh in deihsakna leh lainatna amusak hi.

Huan michilgehte heutupa'n Daniel kiang ah, "Ka toupa kumpipa na an uleh na dawn uh seppa ka lau; bang ding in na khanvualpih uh tuailaite sang a na mel uh hoih lou zaw a hon mu ding ahia oi? Huchi in kumpipa lak ah ka lutang na lauthawngsak dia hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Daniel in sumkempa, michilgehte heutupa'n Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael leh Azariah tung a asehpa kiang ah,
"Na sikhate ni sawm sung enkhia in, ka hon ngen ahi; nek ding in anteh-louhing leh dawn ding in tui hon pia uhen.
Huai chiang in na ma ah ka mel uleh amau kumpipa an ne tuailaite mel et hi hen; na muh bang in, na sikhate tung ah hih in," achi hi.
Huchi in amau thu angaikhia a, ni sawm sung a-enkhia hi.
Ni sawm abei in tuailai kumpipa an nete tengteng sang in amel uh hoihzaw in akilang a, asa uh leng athauzaw hi.
Huchi in sumkempa'n a-an uleh adawn ding uh uain alamang a, amaute kiang ah anteh-louhing ape zawta hi.
Hiai tuailai lite ahih uleh Pathian in amaute kiang ah laisiamna leh pilna tengteng atheihna leh kivakna apia a; huchi in Daniel in mengmuhna leh mang tengteng ah theihsiamna anei hi.
Kumpipa'n amaute hon pilut ding achih nite abei in michilgehte heutupa'n amaute Nebukadnezzar ma ah ahon pi hi.
Kumpipa'n amau ahoulimpih a; amau lak ah Daniel, Hananiah Mishael leh Azariah bang kuamah muh in a-omta kei hi; huaiziak in kumpipa ma ah adinghta uhi.
Huchi in pilna leh theihsiamna thu chiteng, amaute kumpipa'n adotte ah agamsung a om mitkhialdawi tawi leh bummi tengteng sang in amun sawm a hoihzaw in amaute amu hi.
Kumpipa Kura in kum khatna vai ahawm tanpha in Daniel apaisuaktou hi.

Persia kumpipa Kura vaihawm kum thumna ah Daniel, amin Belteshazzar kiang ah thu khat ahong kihil hi; huan huai thu atak ahi a, kidouna thupi mahmah thu ahi; huchi in huai thu atheisiam a, mengmuhna theihsiamna anei hi.
Huai lai in kei, Daniel in nipikal pumpi kal thum ka suun hi.
Tanghou lim ka ne kei a; sa hi in uain hileh ka kam ah alut kei; nipikal thum tunkim masiah sathau ka kinilh kei himhim hi.
Huan akha masapen ani sawmnih-le-li ni in, lui lian, Tigris pang ah ka dingh hi.
Ka dak a, ngai in, mi khat puanmalngat silh, akawngte Uphaz dangka-eng siang a gak ka mu hi.
Apumpi leng beril suang bang ahi a; amaitang khophia bang ahi; amitte meisel kuangpha abang a, abante leh akhepekte dal nawttet abang a; athugen ging mipi aw abang hi.
Huchi in kei, Daniel kia in hiai mengmuhna ka mu a; ka kiang a om mite'n lah huai mengmuhna amu ngal kei ua; himahleh atung uah nakpi a linna ahong tung a, kibu ding in ataikek uhi.
Huchi in kei kia a nutsiat in ka om a; hiai mengmuhna thupi ka muta hi; huchi in kei ah hatna a-om nawnta kei a; ka kilawmna kei ah siatna ahong suakta a; hatna ka neita kei hi.
Hinapi in ka muh mipa aw ka za a; athute ka ngaihkhiak lai in, akhup in ka mai lei lam nga in nakpitak in ka ihmu hithit hi.
Ngai in, khut in ahon khoih a; ka khuk leh ka khutpek leh ban ah hon len in ling kawmkawm lai ahon phong hi.

Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Aw Daniel, nang nakpitak a-it a ompa, na kiang a ka thugente theisiam in dingtang in; na kiang a sawl a ompa ka hi," achi a; hiai thu ka kiang a agen lai in, ling kawm in ka dinghta hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Lau ke'n, Daniel, theisiam ding leh na Pathian ma a kiniamkhiak ding a, na lungtang na koihkip ni masapen a kipan, na thugente zak a omta ahi; na thugente ziak a hong ka hi.
Himahleh Persia gam kumpipa'n ni sawmnih-le-khat kei ahon dal hi; himahleh ngai in, Persia kumpipa kiang ah hentang a ka om nilouh ziak in Mikael, angel lianpen kei hon panpih ding in ahong pai hi.
Huchi in ni nanung lam chiang a na mite tung a hong tung ding bang ahia chih nang hon theisiamsak dia hong pai ka hi; mengmuhna tunung ni tampi a hong tung ding ahi lai hi," chi in.
Huan hiai thute bang a ka kiang a ama'n thu agen khit in lei lam ah ka mai ka nga a, ka pau thei kei hi.

Huan ngai in, mi khat mite tapate toh kibang in ka mukte ahon khoihsak a; ka kam ka a, thu ka gen a, ka ma a dingpa kiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, mengmuhna ziak in lungkhamnate ka tung ah hong kibung a, hatna ka neita kei.
Bangchi in ahia ka toupa sikha in ka toupa ahoulimpih theih ding? Kei ah lah thahatna a-om kei a, nak leng nak lah sim ka hi," ka chi hi.
Huai lai in mi khat mihing toh kibang in ahon khoih nawn a, ahon hatsakta hi.

Huan ama'n, "Aw nakpitak a it mipa, lau ke'n; na kiang ah muanna om hen, hattak in om in; ahi, hattak in om in," achi hi. Ama'n ka kiang a thu agen khit in, ka hatta hi, "Ka Toupa thugen heh, ka chi a; nang na hon hatsakta ngal a," chi in.

Ama'n, "Na kiang a bang ding a hong pai ka hia chih na thei hia? Tu in Persia gam makaipa kidoupih ding in ka kik nawn ding; huchi a ka paikhiak chiang in, ngai in, Grik makaipa ahong pai ding hi,” achi hi.
Himahleh thutak laibu sung a kigelh nang ka hon hilh ding; na makaipa Mikael chih louh kuamah hiaite kalh a kei hon doupih a-om kei.
Huan kei ka hihleh, Mid mi Darias akum khatna kum in, amah hihkip ding leh hihhat ding in ka dingh hi.

Huchi in thutak ka hon ensak ding hi. "Ngai in, Persia ah kumpipa thum ahong dingkhe lai ding ua; alina pen amaute tengteng sang in nakpitak in ahausazaw ding hi. Huchi a ahauhna ziak a ahong hat mahmah chiang in, Grik dou ding in mi tengteng atokthou ding hi.
Huan kumpipa hattak ahong dingkhe ding a, thuneihna thupi toh vaihawm ding leh adeihdan a hih ding in.

Ahong dinkhiak chiang in agam akek ding a, van huih lite lam ah hawmzak ahi ding; amah suan hilou in vai ahawm ding a, himahleh ama'n thilhihtheihna anei kei ding; agam bohkhiak leh midangte kiang ah piak in a-om ding hi.
"Huchi in simlam kumpipa ahat ding a, asepaih heutu khat amah sang in ahatzaw ding a, gam anei ding a; avaihawmna thupi ahi ding.

Huan kum bangzah hiam nung in, akizomkhawm ding ua; simlam kumpipa tanu mallam kumpipa kiang ah kituahna bawl ding in ahong pai dia; himahleh hiai kizopna in hun sawt adaih kei ding; huai ni in amah veng mite leh apa leh amah kithuahpih pa leng piakkhiak in a-om ding hi.

"Himahleh azung a kipan ahiang selnou mun ah mi khat ahong dingkhe ding a; huai tuh sepaih pawl kiang ah ahong pai dia; mallam kumpipa kulhpi sung ah alut dia; amaute dou in thil ahih ding a, avualzou ding hi.

Huchi in apathiante u leng, amilim sunte uh toh, huan adangka leh dangka-eng tui-um belsuan hoihte uh toh, Aigupta ah ama'n asal in alakik ding a; huan mallam kumpipa a kipan kum bangzah hiam akidangkoih ding hi.
Huan simlam kumpipa gam ah ahong pai dia, himahleh ama gam lam ah akik nawn ding hi.
Huchi in atapate'n adou ding ua; sepaih thupi tampi akaikhawm ding ua; huaite adimlet in ahong kuan ding ua, apaisuak ding uh; huan akik nawn ding ua, amah kulh tanpha hial in adou ding uhi.
Huchi in simlam kumpipa aheh mahmah ding a, ahong kuankhe dia mallam kumpipa akidoupih ding hi. Mallam kumpipa'n sepaih atam a tam tungkhe mahleh mipite akhut a piak in a-om ding uhi.
Huan mipite pimang in a-om ding ua, alungtang sansak in a-om ding a; huchi in sing tampite apuksak ding a, himahleh avualzou kei ding hi.
"Huan mallam kumpipa ahong kik dia, ama sang a thupizaw mipi ahon tungkhe ding a; kum bangzah hiam nung in sepaihhon thupi leh van tampi toh ahong kuan ding hi.
Huan huai hunte ah simlam kumpipa dou in mi tampi adingkhe ding uh; na mite lak a hiamgam tate leng mengmuhna hihkip ding in ahong kidomkang ding ua; himahleh apuk ding uhi.
Huchibang in mallam kumpipa ahong kisa dia, panmun abawl dia, khopi kulh neite ala ding; simlam sepaihte leh amitelte'n leng anang kei ding ua, nanna ding in hatna leng a-om kei ding hi.
Himahleh amah dou dia hong paipa'n ama deihlam bang in ahih ding a, ama ah kuamah adingh kei ding; gam thupi ah adingh dia, akhut ah siatna a-om ding hi.
Agam pumpi thahatna toh hong pai atum tinten ding a, simlam kumpigam toh kizopna bawl ding in atanu akiang ah ape ding hi; himahleh athil sawm alohsam ding a, aphattuampih sam kei ding.
"Hiai khit in tuikulh lam anga dia, gam tampite azou ding hi; himahleh gamdangmi sepaih heutu khat in amah azou dia, ami simmohna atawpsak ding; ahi, ami simmohna amah tung ah akibungsak ding hi.
Huai hun chiang in ama gam kulhpi lam ah akik nawn dia; himahleh kisuipai in apuk dia, muh in a-om nawnta kei ding hi.

Huai hun chiang in ama mun ah mi khat ahong dingkhe dia, ama'n agamsung puahna ding in leiman khonpa gam thupi tan apalsuaksak dia; himahleh ni tam lou zoh in hehna leh kidouna hilou in hihsiat in a-om ding hi.
"Huan amun ah mizahpihhuai khat ahong dingkhe ding a, huai lalgam in zahtakna apiaklouhna pa uh; himahleh mite bit akisak lai un ahong pai dia, maitang phatna in gam ala ding hi.
Huan sepaihhonte ama ah taihmang in a-om ding uh, thukhun heutupa tanpha tel in.
Huchi in amah toh pankhawmna kibawl nung in lepchiahtak in thil ahih ding a; ahong kuantou dia, nam neuchik toh hong hat ding ahi.

Gam khen a hausa mahmah namte abit lai pen un dou ding in akuantou dia, apipute'n ahihzoh louh uh ahon hihzou ding a, apipute'n leng ahih ngei louh uh alak uah samat leh gallakte leh vante ahawmzak dia, ahi, kulh nei khopite dou ding in aguksawm ding hi, himahleh hun khat kia adaih ding hi.

"Huan sepaih thupi toh simlam kumpipa dou ding in athilhihtheihna leh ahatna atokthou ding a; huchi in simlam kumpipa'n sepaih athupi a thupi leh hat in kidouna ah adouthuk ding hi. Himahleh ama siatna ding a aguk a thusawm ahih ziak in adingh zou kei ding hi.
Ahi, a-an nete'n amah ahihmang ding ua, asepaihte phiatmang in a-om ding uhi; huchi in tampi thah in apuk ding uhi.
Kumpipa nihte ahih uleh gilou lungtang pu kawm in dohkan khat ah atukhawm ding ua, zuau in akikhemtuah ding uh. Himahleh hun tawp atung ding a sehsa ahih ziak in alohching kei ding uhi.
Huai hun chiang in simlam kumpipa tuh gallak thupi toh agam lam ah akik nawn dia; huchi in alungtang in thukhun siangthou adou ding; a-utut ahih ding a ama gam ngei ah akik nawn ding hi.
"Hun sehsa ah akik nawn dia, simlam ah ahong pai dia; himahleh hun masa hiam hun nanung bang ahi kei ding hi.

Amah dou dia Kittim longte hong pai ding ahih ziak in; huaiziak in adah ding a, akik nawn dia; thukhun siangthou dou in ahehna asungbo ding a a-utut ahih ding a; ahong kik nawn ngeingei dia, thukhun siangthou nungngatsante deihsakna alak ding hi.
Amah lam ah sepaihte apang ding ua, mun siangthou kulhpi mahmah abuahsak ding ua; halmang thillat gige ahihbei ding ua ahihgawp ding in kihhuai atungkhe ding uhi.
Huan thukhun nungngatsante maitang phatna in giloutak in, ama'n ahekkawi dia; himahleh mi a Pathian uh theite bel ahat ding ua, thilhih minthangpente ahih ding uhi.
Huchi in mite lak a theihsiamna neite, ni tampi sung, namsau leh meikuang, saltanna leh siatna ah puk mah le uh, mi tampi athuhilh ding uhi.
Huan apuk chiang un, panpihna tawmchik angah ding ua, himahleh maitang phatnate toh mi tampi in amau apawlbawl ding uhi.
Alak ua theihsiamna neite lak a mi khenkhatte, amaute bawlhoih ding leh siangthousak ding leh amaute ngousak ding in, apuk ding uhi. Hun tawp tanpha; hun sehsa a ding ahih lai ziak in.

"Huan kumpipa'n adeihlam bang in ahih dia; akiliansak ding a, pathian chiteng tung ah akikoih lian dia, pathiante' Pathian dem in thillamdangte agen ding hi; thangpaihna apichin matan alohching ding; atup tintensa ahih ding hi.
Apipute pathiante leh numeite lunggulh leng azahtak kei dia, pathian leng azahtak kei ding; mi tengteng tung ah akiliansak ding hi.
Himahleh ama'n kulhpite pathian apahtawi dia; api-le-pute theih ngei louh dangka-eng leh dangka leh suangmantamte leh thilthawnpiak manphate in amah abe ding hi.

Huan gamdang pathiante panpihna in kulh muanhuaipen pente asual ding a; kuapeuh amah hihna pomte kiang ah zahna lianzaw ape ding a, tampi tung a vaihawm ding in abawl dia, man nei in gam ahawm ding hi.

"Huan hun tawp chiang in simlam kumpipa'n amah akidoupih ding; mallam kumpipa amah dou ding in pingpei bang in, kangtalaite toh, sakol tungtuang mite toh, long tampi toh ahong kuan ding; huchi in gamte ah alut dia, adimlet dia apaisuak ding hi.
Ama'n gam siangthoupen leng asim ding a, huchi in gam tampi zoh in a-om ding hi; himahleh Edom leh Moab leh Ammon tate hausapate akhut a kipan suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
Gam tampite tung ah akhut azan ding a; Aigupta gam asuakta kei ding hi.
Himahleh dangka-eng leh dangka goute tung leh Aigupta thil manphate tengteng tung ah thilhihtheihna anei dia; huan Libia mite leh Ethiopia mite akalsuanna ah a-om ding uhi.
"Himahleh suahlam a kipan leh mallam a kipan a thuthang in amah ahihlau dia; thangpaihna thupi a mi tampi hihse ding leh hihmang ding in akuankhe ding hi.
Huan tuipi leh tang siangthou thupi kikal ah a-inpi puaninte akai ding a, himahleh amah abeina hong tung dia, kuamah in amah apanpih kei ding uh."

Huai hun chiang in Mikael, heutu thupi na mite tapate vengbittu ahong dingkhe ding hi. Leitung pianchil a kipan tu hun tanpha a om ngei nai lou, mangbat hun ahong tung ding hi, huai hun chiang in laibu sung a gelh a om a, muhkhiak a om na mite hutkhiak in a-om ding uh.
Huan alak ua mi tampi leitung a leivui a ihmute akhanglou ding ua, akhen tangtawn hinna tang ding in, akhen zumna leh tangtawn simmohna tang ding in.
Apilte vansin vakna bang in avak ding ua; mi tampi diktatna lam a heite tangtawn tangtawn in aksite bang in atang ding uhi.
Himahleh nang, Aw Daniel, hun tawp tan a ding in thute khakkhum bikbek inla, laibu bilh in; mi tampi avialtai ding ua, theihna apung ding.
Huai lai in kei, Daniel in ka en a, ngai in, midang nih, lui gei hiai lam pang ah khat, lui gei lang lam pang ah khat adingh uhi.
Huan khat in puanmalngat asilh a, luituite tung a ompa kiang ah, "Hiai thillamdangte tawpna ding bangchi a sawt hi ding ahia?" achi hi.

"Puanmalngat silh a, luituite tung a ompa'n van lam a akhut taklam leh akhut veilam liktou in, amah tangtawn a hingpa min a kichiam in hun khat, hunte leh hun kimkhat ahi ding achih ka zata hi; misiangthoute thilhihtheihna asuknen dimdem khit chiang un, hiai thil tengteng zoh ahi ding," chi in.
Huai ka za a, himahleh ka theisiam kei. Ke'n, "Aw ka Toupa, hiai thilte tawpna bang hi ding ahia?" ka chi hi.
Ama'n, "Pai in, Daniel; thute khakkhum bikbek ahita ua, hun tawp matan a bilh bikbek ahita hi,” achi hi.
Mi tampi akihihsiangthou ding ua, angou ding ua, akibawlhoih ding uh; himahleh giloute agilou sem ding ua; giloute lak a kuamah in atheisiam kei ding uh; himahleh apilte'n atheisiam ding uh.
Huchi in halmang thillat gige lakmang a om a, hihgawptu kihhuai tunkhiak a hong om ding hun a kipan, ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmkua a-om ding hi.
Ni sangkhat zathum sawmthum-le-nga ngak a, huai a hong paite'n nuam asa uhi.
Himahleh atawp matan nang zaw pai in; na khawl ding a, nang a dia piakna mun ah nite beina ah na goutan sang ding in na thoukhe ding hi.
Nebukadnezzar vaihawm akum nih kum in Nebukadnezzar in mang anei a; alungsim abuai mahmah a, a-ihmutheita kei hi.
Kumpipa'n mitkhialdawi tawite leh bum mite leh aisan mite leh Kaldai mite, kumpipa mang hilh ding a sap ding thu apia hi. Huchi in ahong lut ua kumpipa ma ah ahong dinghta uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Mang ka nei a, huai mang thei ding in ka lungsim abuai mahmah hi,” achi hi.
Kaldai mite'n kumpipa kiang ah Siria pau in, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in dam in; na sikhate na mang hilh in, ahilhchetna ka ensak ding uh," achi uhi.
Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Kaldai mite kiang ah, hiai thil kei a kipan apaikheta; mang leh ahilhchetna ka kiang a na hon theihsak kei ualeh atnen in na om ding ua, na innte uh ekvum asuak ding.
Himahleh mang leh ahilhchetna na hon theihsak ualeh kei a kipan in thilpiakte leh kipahman leh nakpitak a zahtakna na mu ding uh; huaiziak in mang leh ahilhchetna hon ensak un,” achi hi.
Anihveina ding in amau adawng ua, "Kumpipa'n mang hon hilh henla, kou ahilhchetna ka ensak ding uh," achi uhi.
Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Kei a kipan hiai thil apaikheta chih na muh ziak un, hun hihsau tum na hi uh chih ka theitel hi.

Himahleh mang ka kiang a na hon theihsak kei uleh, nou a ding in dan khat kia a-om; hun akikhen tan a, ka ma a thuzuau leh sia gelkhol na hih ziak un; huaiziak in mang hon hilh unla, ahilhchetna na hon ensak thei uh chih ka thei ding," achi hi.

Kaldai mite'n kumpipa adawng ua, "Kumpipa thudot ensak thei leitung ah kuamah a-om kei; kumpipa hiam, toupa hiam, vaihawmmi kuamah in mitkhialdawi tawi kuamah hiam, bummi kuamah hiam, Kaldai mi kuamah mah huchibang thu adot ngei louh ziak un.
Kumpipa thil deih vangtak ahi, mihingte lak a sa a om lou pathiante chih louh ngal, midang kuamah in kumpipa ma ah huai a-ensak thei kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Hiai ziak in kumpipa aheh mahmah a, athangpai tuntun a, Babulon mipil tengteng hihmang ding in thu apeta hi.
Huchi in thupiak piakkhiak ahita a, mipilte thah ding ahong hita ua; Daniel leh alawmte thah ding in azong uhi.
Huchi in Daniel in kumpipa veng sepaih zaheutu Ariok, Babulon mipilte that ding a kuankhe pa kiang ah thuhilhna leh thupil toh dawnna akiksak hi.
Ariok kumpipa sepaih zaheutu adong a akiang ah, "Bangziak a kumpipa a kipan thupiak huchi tel a kin ahia?" achi hi. Huchi in Ariok in Daniel kiang ah athil omdan atheisak hi.
Daniel alut a, amah a dia hun sehsak ding in kumpipa angen hi, huchi a ahilhchetna kumpipa a-etsak theihna ding in.
Huchi in Daniel a-inn ah apai a, Hananiah, Mishael, Azariah, alawmte kiang ah huai thil atheisakta hi.
Huchi a amaute'n hiai thuguk tanchin a van Pathian zahngaihnate angettheihna ding un; huchi a Daniel leh alawmte Babulon a mipilte alakte toh amanthatlouhna ding un.
Huchi in zan mengmuhna ah Daniel kiang ah thuguk taklat in a-omta hi. Daniel in van Pathian aphat hi.
Daniel in adawng a: Tangtawn tangtawn in Pathian min phat in om hen; pilna leh hatna amah a ahi.
Ama'n hunte leh hunbite ahih lamdang a; kumpipate asuankhia a, kumpipate atungkhia a; mipilte kiang ah pilna apia a, theihsiamna theite kiang ah theihna apia hi.
Thil thukte leh thil gukte ataklang a, mial a om bang ahia chih athei a, akiang ah khovak a-om hi.
Na tung ah ka kipak a, ka hon phat hi, Aw nang ka pipute Pathian, pilna leh hatna hon pepa, nang ka hon nget uh ka kiang ua hon theisakpa'n; kumpipa thu ka kiang uah na hon theisakta ngal a, chi in.

Huaiziak in kumpipa'n Babulon mipilte hihse dia asehpa Ariok kiang ah Daniel ava hoh a, akiang ah, "Babilon mipilte hihmang ke'n; kumpipa ma ah hon pilut inla, kumpipa kiang ah ahilhchetna ka ensak ding," ava chi hi.
Huchi in Ariok in kintak in kumpipa ma ah Daniel apilut a, akiang ah, "Judah saltangte lak ah mi khat ka mu a, ama'n kumpipa kiang ah ahilhchetna atheisak ding," achi hi.
Kumpipa, amin Belteshazzar in adawng a Daniel kiang ah, "Mang ka neih na hon theisak thei in, ahilhchetna na hon theisak thei ding maw?" achi hi.
Daniel in kumpipa ma ah adawng a, "Thuguk kumpipa'n anget mipilte hi in, mitkhialdawi tawite hi in, bum mite hin in, aisan mite hitaleh, kumpipa kiang ah a-ensak thei kei ding uhi.

Himahleh van ah Pathian a-om a, ama'n thugukte ataklang hi; ni nanung lam a bang om ding ahia chih, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah atheisak hi. Na lupna tung a na lutang mengmuhna leh na mang hiaite ahi.

"Nang na hihleh aw kumpipa na lupna tung ah na lungsim sung ah na ngaihtuahnate ahong om ua; tunung chiang a bang ahia hong om ding thu; huan amah thugukte na kiang a taklangpa'n bang ahia hong om ding na kiang ah atheisakta hi.

Himahleh kei bel pilna mihing dangte sang a pilna ka neih tam zawk ziak a hiai thuguk ka kiang a taklat ahi kei a; himahleh ahilhchetna kumpipa kiang a theihsak ahihtheihna ding leh nang na lungtang ngaihtuahte na theihna ding ahi zaw hi.
"Aw kumpipa, ngai in, nang milim thupitak na muta hi. Hiai milim hattak mai, avakna thupi mahmah, na ma ah adingh a; amel a kihtakhuai mahmah hi.
Hiai milim ahihleh alutang dangka-eng hoih ahi a, a-awm leh abante dangka, agil leh apheipite dal,
akhete sik, akhezungte sik leh tungman khenkhat kihel ahi.
Suang khut a sek louh huai milim a khepek sik leh tungman deng a kitam nensak dimdem tan in na mu hi.

"Huchi in sik, tungman, dal, dangkate leh dangka-eng toh akitam nenkhawm vek ua, nipi buhphual a buhsi bang mai ahong hi ua; huchi in huih in huaite amutmang a, huai milim dengzan suangpi pen tang thupitak ahong suak a, leitung pumpi adimta hi.
Hiai mang ahi a; kumpipa ma ah ahilhchetna ka gen ding uhi.
"Aw kumpipa, nang kumpipate' Kumpipa, van Pathian in akiang a gam leh thilhihtheihna, hatna leh thupinate a piakna na hi.
Koipeuh a mite tate atenna uah, gam a sate leh van a vasate na khut ah ahon pia hi; amau tengteng tung a vaihawm ding a abawl dangka-eng lutang na hi.
Nang nung in nang sang a niamzaw gamdang khat ahong dingkhe ding; huchi in lalgam thumna dang, leitung tengteng a thunei ding in.
Huan gam lina sik bang in ahat ding a, sik in akeknensak a thil tengteng anuaisiah bang in sik in hiaite tengteng adelhzan bang in, akeknensak in, adelhzan ding hi.
"Huan khepek leh khezung na muhte, akhen belvelmi tungman leh akhen sik ahihleh gam hawmzak ahi ding a; himahleh asung ah sik hatna a-om ding a, sik tungman toh helkhawm na muh bangtak in.
Huan khepek khezungte, akhen sik leh akhen tungman pen ahihleh, huchibang in gam hatna chiang nei, kitapna chiang nei ahi ding hi.
Huan sik leh tungman kihel na muh pen ahihleh, mite chi toh amau akitok hel ding uh; himahleh sik leh tungman akigawm theih louh bang in akikawikip kei ding uhi.

"Huai kumpipate dam lai in van Pathian in gam suksiat a om ngei lou ding, athuneihna midang kiang a nutsiat a om ngei sam lou ding, ahon dingkhesak ding a; himahleh hiai gam tengteng akitam nensak ding a, ahihse vek ding, amah bel tangtawn in adingh ding hi.

"Huchi in tang a kipan khut a sek louh suangpi ahong omkhia a, sik, dal, tungman, dangka leh dangka-engte a kitamsak dimdem na muh pen ahihleh; tunung chiang a bang ahia hong om ding kumpipa kiang ah Pathian thupi in atheisakta hi; mang omzia theihsa ahi a, akhiakna akichian hi,” achi hi.
Huaitak in Nebukadnezzar in amai a lei si in Daniel abia a, thillat leh gimnamtui akiang a lan ding in amaute thu apia hi.
Kumpipa'n Daniel adawng a, "Chihtaktak in na Pathian, pathiante' Pathian leh kumpipate' TOUPA leh thugukte taklangpa ahi; hiai thuguk taklang ding a hihtheihna na neih ziak in," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Daniel aliansak a, thilpiak tampi apia hi, Babulon bial pumpi a heutu leh Babulon mipilte tengteng tung a ukpipapen ding in abawlta hi.
Daniel in Shadrak, Meshak, Abednego, Babulon bial thu leh la tung a koih ding in kumpipa kiang ah angen hi; himahleh Daniel bel kumpipa kongpi ah a-om hi.
kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in dangka-eng milim, tong sawmguk a sang, tong guk a lian abawl a; Babulon bial a Dura Phaizang ah adingsak hi.

kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in bial heutute, vaihawm mite, ukpipate, thukhenmi, sumkemmi, thudotmi, dansiammi leh bial vaihawmmi tengteng akaikhawm a, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in adinkhiak milim kipahpihna bawlna a hong pai ding in mite asawlkhia hi.

Huchi in bial heutu vaihawmmi, ukpipa, thukhenmi, sumkemmi, thudotmi, dansiammi leh bial vaihawmmi tengteng kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in adinkhiaksak milim kipahpihna ah ahong kikhawm vek uhi; Nebukadnezzar dinkhiaksak milim ma ah adingh uhi.
Huaitak in tangkou ngaihtak in akikou a, "Na kiang ua thupiak ahi, Aw mite, namte, paute,
pengkul, tamngai, kaihging, gosem, nawtging, tumging peng nih nei leh tumging chi chih ging na zak chiang un, puk unla, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in adinkhiaksak dangka-eng milim bia un.
Huan kuapeuh puk lou a beloute meipi kuang zuazua sung ah huai hun mah a paihlut ding ahi," achi hi.

Huaiziak in huai lai a mi tengteng in pengkul, tamngai, kaihging, gosem, nawtging leh tumging chi chih ging azak un, mi tengteng, namte, paute apuk ua, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in atunkhiak dangka-eng milim abia uhi.
Huchih lai in Kaldai mi kuate hiam ahong pai nai ua, Juda tuailaite ahong hekta uhi.
Adawng ua kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in dam in!

Aw kumpipa, nang thupiak na bawl a, mi chiteng in pengkul, tamngai, kaihging, gosem leh nawtging, tumging peng nih neite leh tumging chi chih azak chiang ua, apuk ding ua dangka-eng milim abiak ding uh chi in.
Kuapeuh puk lou a beloute meipi kuang zuazua ah paihlut ahi ding, chi in.

Babulon bial a thu leh la tung a na sehsa Juda kuate hiam a-om ua, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego. Hiai mite'n, Aw kumpipa, nang ahon limsak kei ua; na pathiante nna asem kei ua na dinkhiaksak dangka-eng milim leng abe sam kei uh," chi in.
Huchi in Nebukadnezzar heh leh thangpai in Shadrak, Meshak, Abednego hon pi ding in thu apia hi.

Huchi in hiai mite kumpipa ma ah ahon pi ua, Nebukadnezzar in adong a, akiang uah, "Aw Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, ka pathian nna na sep louh ua, dangka-eng milim ka tunkhiak na biak louh uh, na tup mawng uh hia?" achi hi.

Tu in na kimansak unla chik hun peuh a pengkul, tamngai, kaihging, gosem, nawtging leh tumging peng nih nei leh tumging chi chih ging na zak chiang un puk unla milim ka tunkhiak bia un, hoihtak in; himahleh na biak kei ualeh meipi kuang zuazua sung ah huai hun mah in ahon paihlut ding uh; huchi in ka khut a kipan a nou hon hunkhe ding huai pathian kua hi ding ahia?
Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego in adawng ua kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw Nebukadnezzar, hiai thu ah ka hon dawn uh akiphamoh kei hi.
Huchibang ding ahihleh, Aw kumpipa, a-nna ka sep uh ka Pathian un meipi kuang zuazua a kipan koute ahon hunkhe thei hi, na khut a pan ahon hunkhe ding hi.
Huchi ahihkeileh leng, na thei in, Aw kumpipa, na pathiante nna ka sem kei ding ua, na dinkhiak dangka-eng milim leng ka be sam kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Nebukadnezzar athangpai petmah a, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego tung ah amel putdan akikheng hial hi. Huaiziak in meipi asat ngeina sang a mun sagih a asatsak ding in thu apia hi.
Huan asepaih pawl lak a om mihat kuate hiam Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego hen ding leh meipi kuang zuazua sung a paihlut ding in thu apia hi.
Huchi in hiai mite apuansilh lai uh, samul puanak toh, puanak kawnggak nei leh apuansilh dangte uh toh, meikuang zuazua lak ah apailutta uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa thupiak akhawk mahmah ziak leh meipi asat mahmah ziak in huai mi Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego domte meikuang in ahul lumta hi.
Hiai mi thumte, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednegote, meipi kuang zuazua lak ah hensa in apuk uhi.

Huchih lai in Nebukadnezzar in lamdang asa mahmah a; kintak in athoukhia a; amah thudot mite kiang ah, "Mei lak ah mi thum hensa in i pailut uh ahi kei maw?" chi in agen hi. Amau adawng ua kumpipa kiang ah, "Dik mah e, kumpipa aw," achi uhi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Ngai un, mi li phelsa a om, mei lak a vak in ka mu a, bangmah achi kei uh, ami lina melputdan Pathian tapa abang," achi hi.

Huchi in Nebukadnezzar meipi kuang zuazua gei chin ah ahong pai a; thu agen a, "Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, nou Pathian Tungnungpen sikhate, hong pawtkhia unla, hiai lam ah hong pai un," achi hi. Huchi in Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, mei lak a kipan in ahong pawtkhia uhi.

Huan bial heutute, vaihawm mite, ukpipate leh kumpipa dan thei mite, omkhawmte'n hiai mite, mei in apumpi tung uah hihtheihna anei kei a, aluzang ua sam leng akangdang kei a, apuansilh uh leng alamdang kei a, meigim leng anam kei uh chih amu uhi.

Nebukadnezzar in thu agen a, "Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego Pathian in a-angel sawl a, amah muang asikhate hunkhia a, kumpipa thu hihlamdang a, amau Pathian lou ngal pathian nna asep louh ua abiaklouhna ding ua apumpite uh pepa phat in om hen.

"Huaiziak in thupiak ka bawl hi, michih, nam chih, pau chih, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego Pathian gensiatna thil banghiam gente, atnen in a-om dia, a-innte uh ekvum a bawl ahi ding hi; hichibang a hunkhe thei pathian dang a-om louh ziak in," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, Babulon bial ah akaisangsak hi.
Kumpipa, Nebukadnezzar mite tengteng, namte leh paute, leitung pumpi a tengte kiang ah, na kiang uah lemna hihpun in om hen.
Tungnungpen Pathian in kei lam a abawl chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte etsak, kei a ding in hoih hi in ka ngaihtuah hi.
Achiamtehnate thupi hi na mahmah e; athillamdangte thilhihthei hi na mahmah uh e; agam tangtawn gam ahi a, avaihawmna akhang-akhang in a-om hi.
Kei Nebukadnezzar, ka insung ah ka khawl a, ka inpi sung ah ka lum hi.
Hon lausak mang ka nei hi; ka lupna tung ah ngaihtuahnate leh ka lungtang mengmuhte'n hon hihbuai uhi.
Huaiziak in hilhchetna ka kiang a akitheihsak ding un, Babulon mipil tengteng ka ma a pi ding thupiak ka bawlta hi.
Huchi in mitkhialdawi tawite, bum mite, Kaldai mite leh aisan mite ahong pai ua; ama uah ka mang ka genta hi; himahleh ahilhchetna ka kiang ah ahon theisak thei kei uhi.
Himahleh atawptawp in ka ma ah, Daniel amin ka pathian min dungzui a Belteshazzar hiven, amah a Pathian siangthoute kha a-omna ma ah mang ka genta hi.

Aw Belteshazzar, mitkhialdawi tawite heutupa, nang ah, Pathian siangthoute kha a-om a, thuguk bangmah in nang ahon hihbuai kei chih ka theih ziak in ka mang a ka muh mengmuhte leh ahilhchetna hon hilh in, ka chi hi.
Ka lupna tung a ka lutang mengmuhte hichibang ahiz: Ngai in, lei laizang ah sing khat ka mu a, huai sing sandan athupi mahmah hi.
Huai sing akhangtou a, ahong hat a, asanna in van asuntou a, lei mong tengteng tanpha huai ah akimu hi.
Anahte ahoih un, agah pha mahmah a; huai ah mi tengteng a ding in an a-om hi; anuailim ah gamsate a-om ua, ahiangte ah van a vasate ateng ua, sa tengteng huai a kipan in akivak uhi.
Ka lupna tung a ka lup in mengmuhte ka mu a, ngai in, van a kipan in vengmi siangthou khat ahong paisuk hi.
Ngaihtak in akikou a, hichibang in achi a: "Sing phuk inla, ahiangte satkhia in, anahte singkhia inla, agah thehzak in; anuai a kipan gamsate leh ahiang a kipan vasate hawlmang in om uhen.
Himahleh abulsum leh azungte zaw hawi in, sik leh dal gui a henkhawm in, gam a loupa nou lak ah nutsiat in om hen. Van daitui in kawt henla, atantuan lei a loupa lak a gamsate toh hi hen.
Huan atung a hun sagih abei mateng mihing lungsim kikheng in akiang ah gamsa lungtang piak hi hen.
Tungnungpen in mite gam ah vai ahawm a, a-utna peuh kiang ah apia a, miniampente adingkhesak chih mihingte'n atheihna ding un veng mite'n agenkhia ua, misiangthoute'n apuangkhia uhi.

"Hiai mang kei kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in ka man hi. Huan nang, Aw Belteshazzar, ahilhchetna genkhia in, ka gam a mipilte tengteng in ka kiang ah ahilhchetna ahon theisak thei kei ua; himahleh nang na hihthei, nang a pathian siangthoute kha a-om ziak in,” achi hi.

Daniel, amin Belteshazzar in, sawt lou kal lamdang asa a, angaihtuahnate'n amah apatausak hi. Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Belteshazzar, mang hiam ahilhchetna hiam in nang hon patausak kei hen," achi hi. Belteshazzar in adawng a, "Ka toupa, mang nang hon mudahte lam thu hi henla, ahilhchetna na galte lam thu hi zawleh maw.
Na sing muh, hong khang a, hong hat a, asanna in van asuttouh a, hiai a kipan lei mong tengteng akimuhna;
anahte hoih a, agah pha mahmah a, mi teng a dia an om a; huai nuai a gamsate teng ua, ahiang a van a vasate atenna uh,
Aw kumpipa, huai hong khang a, hong hat na muh, nangmah na hi; na thupina akhang in, van asun in, na vaihawmna lei mong tawp pha in ahi.

Van a kipan a kumpipa'n vengmi siangthou hong paisuk amuh, Sing phuk inla, hihgawp in; himahleh abulsum leh azungte zaw hawi in, sik leh dal gui a henkhawm in gam a loupa nou lak ah van daitui in kawt henla, huan atantuan gamsate kiang ah hi in, atung a hun sagih abei matan, chih thu ahihleh;
Aw kumpipa, ka toupa kumpipa tung a hong tung Tungnungpen thupiak ahilhchetna hiai ahi:

Mite a kipan hawlkhiak in na om dia; gamsate kiang ah na khosa ding a, bawngtalte bang a loupa neksak in na om ding a; van daitui in na kawt ding a; na tung ah hun sagih abei ding; mite gam ah Tungnungpen in vai ahawm a; a-ututna kiang ah apia chih na theih matan.
Huan sing bulsum leh azungte nutsiat ding a thupiak a om pen ahihleh; van Pathian in vaihawm petmah ahi chih na theih khit hun chiang in na gam nang kiang a piakkik ding genna ahi.
Aw kumpipa, huaiziak in ka hon thuhilh nang a ding in pom tuak leh tagahte kiang a zahngaihna etsakna in na thulimlouhnate tawpsan in; na lamzanna suksau a a-om khak zenzenleh," achi hi.
Hiai tengteng kumpipa Nebukadnezzar tung ah ahong tung hi.
Kha sawm-le-nih abei in Babulon a kumpi Inpi sung ah avialvak hi.
Kumpipa'n thu agen a, hiai Babulon thupi, kumpipa tenna mun ding a, ka thilhihtheihna hatna leh ka thuneihna thupina ding a ka lam ahi kei maw? chi in.
Kumpipa kam a thu a-om lai mahmah in, van a kipan aw ahong suakkhia a, "Aw kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, na kiang a thugen ahi; nang a kipan gam apaimangta hi.

Tungnungpen in mite gam ah vai ahawm a, a-ututna kiang ah apia chih na theih matan, mihingte a kipan in hawlkhiak na hi ding a, na tenna gamsate kiang ah ahi ding; bawngtalte bang a loupa ne ding a bawl in na om dia; na tung ah hun sagih abei ding," achi hi.

Kintak in huai bang thil ahong tungta, mite a kipan hawlkhiak in a-om a; bawngtalte bang in loupa ane petmah hi; apumpi van daitui in akawt a; asam muvanlai multe ahong bang a, achinte vasate chinte ahong bangta hi.

Huan nite abei in kei Nebukad-nezzar in van lam ah ka mitte ka suantou a, ka theihtheihnate ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn a, huchi in Tungnungpen ka pahtawi hi; amah tangtawn a om gige phat in ka zahtak hi. Avaihawmna tangtawn vaihawmna ahi a, agam akhang-akhang in ahi, chi in;

Huan leitung a teng tengteng bangmah lou bang a ngaih ahi ua; huan van sepaih pawl leh leitung a teng tengtengte lak ah adeihlam bang in ahih zel a; kuamah in akhut alen thei un, akiang ah, "Bangziak a hih na hia?" achi thei kei uhi.

Huai lai mah in ka theihtheihna ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn a; ka gam thupina, ka lalna leh hoihna ka kiang ah ahong kik a; ka midotte leh ka toupate'n kei ahong zong ua; huchi in ka gam ah kiptak in ka dingh a, kei a ding in thupina lian mahmah behlap in a-omta hi.
Huchi in kei Nebukadnezzar in van Kumpipa phat a pahtawi in ka zahtak a; athilhih tengteng thutak ahi a, alampite vaihawmna ahi a, kisatheitak a omte ahihniam thei hi.
Belshazzar kumpipa'n atoupate lak a mi sangkhat a ding in ankuang thupitak abawl a, sangkhatte ma ah uain adawn hi.

Belshazzar in uain achep lai in, apa Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a om tempul a kipan a alak dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuante kumpipa leh atoupate, azite leh ameite'n huaite a adawntheihna ding un hon la ding in thu apia hi.
Huchi in Jerusalem a om Pathian inn, tempul a kipan alakkhiak dangka-eng tui-um belsuante ahon la ua; kumpipa leh atoupate, azite leh ameite'n, huaite in adawn uhi.
Uain adawn ua, dangka-eng, dangka, dalsik, sing leh suang pathiante aphat uhi.
Huai dak mah in mihing khutzungte ahong kilang guih a, kumpipa inpi baang pek tung, khawnvak koihna toh etdetna tak ahon gelh hi. Kumpipa'n laigelhtu khut bang tan hiam amu hi.
Huai lai in kumpipa mel ahong lamdang a, angaihtuahnate'n amah apatausakta hi; akhut akhe akipzouta kei a, akhukte akisat tuah nomnom uhi.

Bum mite, Kaldai mite leh aisan mite hon pi un chi in nakpitak in kumpipa akikou hi. Kumpipa'n thu agen a, Babulon mipilte kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hiai laigelh sim a, ahilhchetna hon ensak, puan sandup silhsak ahi ding a; angawng kimvel in dangka-eng khainiang a-ok ding a; gamsung ah vaihawmmi thumna ahi ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa mipilte tengteng ahong lut ua; himahleh laigelh asim thei kei ua, ahilhchetna leng kumpipa atheisak thei kei uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Belshazzar apatau mahmah a; amah ah amel ahong lamdang a; akhawnbawlte alungzing uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa leh khawn-bawlte thu ziak in ankuangluina insung ah kumpinu ahong lut hi; kumpinu'n thu agen a, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in hing in, na ngaihtuahnate'n hon patausak kei henla, na mel leng lamdang kei hen.

Na gamsung a mi khat, amah a pathian siangthoute kha omna a-om a; na pa dam lai in vakna leh theihtheihna leh pilna, pathiante pilna bang, amah ah muh in a-om; kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, kumpipa, na pa'n, amah mitkhialdawi tawite leh bum mite, Kaldai mite leh aisan mite heutu in abawl hi.

Lungsim hoihpen, theihna, theihtheihna, mangte hilhchetna, thugen haksa etsakna, ginlelhna hihvenna kumpipa'n Belteshazzar min asakpa, huai Daniel mah ah muh in a-om hi. Tu in Daniel sapsak in om henla, ama'n hilhchetna ensak hen," achi hi.
Huan kumpipa ma ah Daniel ahon pi ua, Kumpipa'n thu agen a Daniel kiang ah, "Daniel, ka pa'n Judah gam a kipan Judah salmat hon pilut na hi hia?
Nang ah pathian kha a-om a, vakna leh theihtheihna leh pilna hoihpen nang ah muh in a-om chih na tanchin ka za hi.
Tu in ka ma ah mipilte, bum mite ahon pilut ua, hiai laigelh sim a, ahilhchetna ka kiang a theisak ding in; himahleh huai thil hilhchetna a-ensak thei kei uhi.

Himahleh hilhchetnate na bawl thei a, ginlelhnate na bawlhoih thei chih na tanchin ka na za hi. Tu in laigelh na sim theih a, ahilhchetna na hon hilh theih leh puan sandup ka hon silhsak ding a; na ngawng kimvel in dangka-eng khi na ok ding a; gamsung ah vaihawmmi thumna na hi ding hi," achi hi.

Huchi in Daniel in adawng a kumpipa ma ah, "Na thilpiakte nangmah kiang ah hi zaw henla, na kipahmante midang kiang ah pe zaw in; ahi a, kumpipa kiang ah laigelh ka sim ding a, ahilhchetna amah ka theisak ding hi.
Aw nang kumpipa, Tungnungpen Pathian in na pa Nebukadnezzar gam leh thupina, letna leh vaihawmna ahon pia hi.
Huai amah apiak letna ziak in ama ah mi tengteng, namte, paute aling un alau ua; a-utut athat a, a-utut hinghawi in; a-utut akaithou a, a-utut asawnniam hi.
Himahleh alungtang ahong kisaktheih a, ki-uangsaktak a gamta a alungsim hihkhauh a a-om lai in, alaltutphah a kipan suan in a-om a, amah a kipan athupina alakheta hi.

Huan mite tapate a kipan hawlkhiak in a-om a; huchi in alungtang gamsate a bang a bawl in a-om a; bawngtalte bang a loupa a vak in a-om a, apumpi van daitui in akawt a; Tungnungpen Pathian in mihing gam ah vai ahawm a, a-ututte atung ah adingkhesak chih ahon theih matan.
"Huan nang atapa, Aw Belshazzar, hiai tengteng na theih in leng na lungtang na niamkhiak kei hi.

Himahleh van Toupa dem in na kihihsang a; amau na ma ah toupa inn a tui-um belsuante na lasak a; nang leh na toupate, na zite leh na meite'n, huaite in uain na dawn uh a; bangmah mu thei lou, za thei lou, theithei lou dangka leh dangka-eng, dal, sik, sing leh suang pathiante bia in na phat a; Pathian akhut a na hatna omna leh na lampite tengteng neipa na pahtawi zaw kei hi.
Huchi in amah a kipan huai khut banghiam tan sawl in ahong om a, hiai laigelh gelh in ahong omta hi.
"Huan gelh a om laithu hiai ahi: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
Huai hilhchetna hiai ahi. MENE: Pathian in na gam asimta, abeisakta hi.
TEKEL: bukna a buk in na om a, na chingzou kei hi.
PERES: na gam hawm in a-om a, Mid mite leh Persia mite kiang ah piak ahita," achi hi.
Huchi in Belshazzar in thu apia a, dangka-eng khainiang angawng kimvel in a-oksak ua; gamsung a vaihawmmi athumna hi ding in amah tung ah thu apuang uhi.
Huai zan mah in Kaldai kumpipa Belshazzar thah in a-om hi.
Mid mi Darias, kum sawmguk-le-nih a upa in gam atangta hi.
Darias in agam pumpi bial za-le-sawmnih omsuak ding bial heutu za-le-sawmnih gam tung ah akoih hi.
Huan amaute tung ah, heutu lian thum, huaite lak ah Daniel akhatna ahi a; huchi a hiai bial heutute'n huaite kiang a thu atut ua, kumpipa'n siatna aneihlouhna ding in.
Huchi in hiai Daniel, amah a lungsim hoihpen a-om ziak in, heutu liante leh bial heutute tung ah akan-aval a bawl in a-om a; kumpipa'n gam pumpi tung ah amah koih ding angaihtuah hi.

Huai lai in heutu liante leh bial heutute'n gam thu ah Daniel demna ding azong uhi; himahleh amah miginom ahih ziak in thupatna ding in adiklouhna amu kei ua, amah ah diklouhna leh khelhna muh in a-om kei hi.
Huchi in hiai mite'n, "Hiai Daniel demna ding bangmah i mu kei ding; a Pathian dan toh kisai a amah demna ding i muh kei ngalleh," akichi uhi.
Huan hiai heutu liante leh bial heutute kumpipa kiang ah akikhawm ua, akiang ah hichibang in, "Kumpipa Darias aw, tangtawn in dam in!

Gam heutu lian tengteng, heutute leh bial heutute, dan thei mite leh ukpipate, kumpi dan thuseh bawlkhiak a, khamna khauhtak bawl ding in akikumkhawm uhi. Huchi in mi kuapeuh, nang chih louh, Aw kumpipa, ni sawmthum sung a pathian hiam mihing hiam lak a ngetna abawlleh, humpinelkai huangsung ah paihlut in a-om ding hi.
Tu in, Aw kumpipa, khamna hihkip inla, laigelh ah na min gelh in; huchi a Mid mite leh Persia mite dan bang a akihih lamdanlouhna ding in," achi uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Darias in laigelh leh khamna ah amin agelhta hi.

Daniel in laigelh ah min akigelhta chih atheih in a-insung ah alut a; adantan sung a atawlette Jerusalem lam a hon hi ve un, akhukdin a, ni khat in thumvei, huchi in athum a, amalam a ahih bang in, a Pathian ma ah kipahthu agen hi.
Huchi in hiai mite akikhawm ua, Daniel a Pathian ma a thu ngen leh thum in amu uhi.

Huchi in ahong pai nai ua, kumpipa khamna tungtang kumpipa ma ah ahong genta uhi, "Aw kumpipa, nang chih louh michih kuapeuh in ni sawmthum sung a pathian hiam mihing hiam kiang a ngetna abawlleh humpinelkai huangsung ah paihlut ahi ding chih khamna ah na gelh ahi kei maw," achi uhi. Kumpipa'n, "Mid mite leh Persia mite dan lamdang thei lou bang in huai dan kip lai ahi," achi hi.
Huan amau adawng ua kumpipa ma ah, "Huai Daniel, Judah saltang tate lak a mi in nang leh na min gelhna khamna leng ahon limsak kei, Aw kumpipa, ni khat in thumvei ngetna abawl hi," achi uhi.
Hiai thute azak in, kumpipa alungkim het kei a, amah suaktasak ding in Daniel tung ah alungtang anga a; amah hutkhiak tum in nitum tan asemgim hi.

Huchi in hiai mite kumpipa kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw kumpipa, khamna hiam dan thuseh hiam kumpipa'n ahihkipsa hihlamdan theih ahih louh Mid mite leh Persia mite dan ahi chih thei in," achi uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apia a, Daniel ahon pi ua, humpinelkai huangsung ah apailut uhi. Huan kumpipa'n thu agen a, Daniel kiang ah, "A-nna na sep gige na Pathian in ahon suaktasak ding," achi hi.

Huan suang khat ahon la ua, huangsung gong ah akoih ua; kumpipa'n amah suaisawnna zungbuh leh atapate suaisawnna zungbuh in suai anamta hi; Daniel tungtang thu a bangmah hihlamdan theih ahihlouhna ding in.
Huchi in kumpipa a-inpi ah apai a, an ngawl in, tumging leh nopbawlna khawlsak in azanhak a; amah lah a-ihmu thei kei hi.
Huchi in zingsang beltak in kumpipa athou a, humpinelkaite huangsung lam ah kintak in ava hoh hi.

Huangsung lam a Daniel kiang a ahong pai nai lai in, kah aw in akikou a; kumpipa'n thu agen a, Daniel kiang ah, "Aw Daniel, Pathian hing sikha, a-nna na sep gige, na Pathian in humpinelkaite a kipan nang hon suaktasak thei hiam?" achi hi.
Daniel in kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in hing in!
Ka Pathian in a-angel hon sawl a, humpinelkaite kam ahong chihsak a, ahon hihna kei uh; amah ma a keimah a hoihna muh a a-om ziak leh Aw kumpipa nangmah ma a leng gilou ka hih louh ziak in," achi hi.

Huchi in nakpitak in kumpipa akipak a, huangsung a kipan Daniel lakhe tou ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in huangsung a kipan in Daniel alakhe tou ua, a Pathian amuan ziak in atung ah bangmah natna akimu kei hi.

Huan kumpipa'n thu apia a, Daniel hekte huai mite ahon pi ua, humpinelkai huangsung ah apai ua, amau, azi leh tate uh; humpinelkaite'n amaute huangsung taw ahong tun ma un ana man ua, aguhte uh ahihnen vek uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Darias in mite tengteng, namte, paute leitung pumpi a tengte kiang ah lai agelh a, "Na kiang uah lemna hihpun in om hen!

Ka gam seh thum tengteng ah Daniel Pathian ma ah mite aling un alau ding uh; Amah Pathian hing, tangtawn a omkip, agam hihsiat ahi ngei kei ding a; athuneihna a-omden ding hi, chi in thupiak ka bawl hi.
Ama'n asuaktasak a, atankhia a, van leh lei ah chiamtehna leh thillamdangte ahih a; ama'n humpinelkaite thilhihtheihna a kipan in Daniel asuaktasak hi."
Huchibang in Darias vaihawm lai leh Persia mi Kura vaihawm lai in hiai Daniel alamzang mahmah hi.
Babulon kumpipa Belshazzar kum khatna kum in Daniel in alupna tung a alup lai in mang anei a, alungsim ah mengmuh ahong kilang a, mang agelh a athute akim in agen hi.
Daniel in thu agen a, "Zan a ka mengmuhna ah, ngai in, van huih lite tuipi thupi tung a hong nungkhia un ka mu hi.
Huan tuipi a kipan sa thupi li, kibang lou chiat ahong paitou ua,

akhatna humpinelkai abang a, muvanlai kha anei hi; huchi a ka et lai in akhate bohkhiak in a-om ua; lei a kipan phottouh a mihing bang a khe nih a dinsak a om in; akiang ah mihing lungsim piak in a-om hi.”

Huan ngai in, sa dang, anihna, vompi bang, apang langkhat tung ah photkang in a-om a; akamsung ah ahate kikal ah nakguh thum a-om a; hichibang in akiang ah hilh in a-om a, "Thou inla, sa tampi negai in," chi in.
Hiai khit in ka en a, huan ngai in, sa dang khat, gialbem bang, anungzang a vasa bang a kha li nei ka mu hi. Huai gamsa in lu li anei a; akiang ah thuneihna piak in a-om hi.

Hiai khit in, zan mengmuhna in ka mu a, ngai in sa lina, lauhuai leh thilhihtheitak, nakpi mahmah a hat; sik ha lianpite nei in anegai in abotnen a; a-omlaite akhe in achil hi. Ama a gamsa om tengteng toh akibang kei; kii sawm anei hi.

Kite ka ngaihtuah lai in, alak uah kii dang aneu khat hong poukhia a, huai ma ah huai kii masa thumte azung uah bohkhiak in a-om uh, hiai kineu ah mit, mihing mit bang leh kam thil thupite gen a-omta hi.

Huchi a ka et lai in, laltutphah akikoih a, Tanglai Mipa'n alaltutphah aluahta hi; apu apuansilh vuk bang in angou a, samul siang bang in alu a sam angou hi; huai alaltutphah meikuang zuazua ahi a, huai akangtalai khete meikuang lai bang ahi.
Meikuang luipi hong pawt a ama a kipan ahong paikhia a, asang asangte'n amah nna asepsak uh; ama ah singkhat mun singkhat adingh ua; vaihawmna atungkhia ua, laibute ahong uhi.
Huai kii in athugen thupite ziak in ka en nilouh hi. Huchi a ka et lai in, huai gamsa thah in ahong om a; apumpi hihsiat in ahong om a; meikuang a apaih dong uh ka en gige hi.
Huan sa dangte ahihleh athuneihna uh lakmang in a-om a; hun seh khat leh hun khat tan ahinna uh hihsau in a-om hi.
Zan mengmuhna in ka mu a, ngai in, van meipite toh mi khat mihing tapa toh kibang ahong pai a, Tanglai Mipa kiang mahmah ah ahong a, amah ama chin ah ahon pi uhi.

Huan thuneihna, thupina leh gam piak in a-om a; huchi a mi tengteng, namte leh paute'n amah nna asepsak theihna ding un; athuneihna tangtawn thuneihna ahi a, amang kei ding, agam hihsiat in a-om kei ding hi.
"Kei Daniel ahihleh ka sung ah ka lungsim adah a, ka lutang mengmuh in kei ahon patausak hi.
Akiangnai a dinghte lak a khat kiang ka zuan a, hiai tengteng thu ah thutak amah ka dongta hi. Huchi in huai thilte hilhchetna ka kiang ah ahon theisakta hi.
Hiai gamsa thupi lite etsak bel lei a hong dingkhe ding kumpipa lite ahi uhi.
Himahleh Tungnungpen misiangthoute'n gam atang ding ua, tangtawn, tangtawn in, gam aneiden ding uhi," achi hi.
Huchi in sa lina, amaute tengteng toh kibang lou, kihtakhuai mahmah, ahate sik hi a, achinte dal, ne khin a, botnen a, a-omlaite akhepek a chil tungtang thutak theih ka ut hi.

Huan kii sawmte aluzang a omte lak ah kii dang khat hong poukhia a, huai ma a kii thumte apukna; huai kii mitte nei leh kam nei a thil thupite gen a, alatdan a lawite sang a hat tuakzaw pen tanchin ka thei nuam hi.
Huchi a ka etleh huai kii in misiangthoute dou in, gal abawl a,
Tanglai Mipa'n Tungnungpen misiangthoute gum in thu akhen a, amau lalgam aneih masiah ua ding in amaute azouta hi.
Huchi in sa lina pen leitung ah gam lina ahi ding a, huai gam tengteng toh akibang kei ding a, leitung pumpi agai ding a, asikden dia, abotnen ding achi hi.
Huan kii sawmte ahihleh, hiai gam a kipan in kumpipa sawm hong dingkhe dingte ahi ua; amau nung in adang khat; amasa toh akibang kei ding a, ama'n kumpipa thumte azou ding hi.
Tungnungpen dem in agense ding a, misiangthoute anuaisiah ding hi; hunte leh dan khen ding angaihtuah dia; hun khat leh hunte leh hun kimkhat abei masiah misiangthoute akhut ah piak in a-om ding uhi.
Huaite zoh in vaihawmna a-om ding a, athuneihna lakmang ahi ding a, atawp tan a hihgawp ding leh suksiat in a-om ding hi.

Huan leitung gam leh thuneihna leh van nuai pumpi nuai a gamte thupina, Tungnungpen misiangthoute kiang ah piak in a-om ding; agam tangtawn gam ahi a, avaihawmnate'n amah nna asepsak un athu amang ding uhi.
Hiai ah thu leh la tawpna a-om hi. Kei Daniel ahihleh ka ngaihtuahnate'n nakpi in hon hihbuai a, kei ah ka mel amual hi; himahleh ka lungtang in huai thu ka kem khinkhian hi.
Kumpipa Belshazzar vaihawm akum thumna kum in kei, Daniel kiang a amasa a kilang pen mah ahong kilat khit nung in mengmuhna ka kiang ah hong kilang nawn hi.
Ka mengmuhna ah hichi ahong hi a, Elam bial a Susa inpi ah ka om a; huan mengmuhna in Ulai lui kiang ah om in ka mu hi.
Huchi in ka dakleh ngai in, huai lui gei ah belamtal khat kii nih nei adingh a, akii nihte asau uhi. Himahleh khat sang in adang pen asauzaw a, asauzaw pen ahong pou nanung pen ahi.

Huai belamtal in akii a si ding in tumlam, mallam leh simlam nawt in ka mu hi; ama ah sate adingh thei kei ua, akhut a kipan suaktasak thei leng kuamah a-om kei uh; himahleh ama deihlam in ahih a ahong thupi hi.
Huchi a ka ngaihtuah lai in, ngai in, leitung pumpi tawnsuak in tumlam a kipan in keltal khat lei sukha lou in ahong pai a, huai kel in amitte kikal ah kii minthang khat anei hi.
Belamtal kii nih nei lui malam a dingh ka muh kiang ah ahong pai a, athilhihtheihna toh heh in amah adelhta hi.

Belamtal kiangchin ah ahong pai ka mu a, atung ah nakpitak in athangpaita a, belamtal aboh a, akii nihte ahihtan a; huchi in belamtal in amah adinna ding thahatna aneita kei hi. Lei ah asipuk a, amah achilzial a; akhut a kipan belamtal suaktasak ding kuamah a-om kei hi.
Nakpi mahmah in keltal akiliansakta a; huchi a ahat lai in, huai kii thupi akitan a; amun ah kii li minthang, van huih lite lam ah ahong suakkhetou uhi.
Huan huai kiite lak a kii neu thupi mahmah khat, simlam, suahlam leh gam kilawm lam nga in ahong khangkhia hi.
Huchi in van sepaihte bang hial in ahong thupi mahmah a; aksihonte lak a khenkhatte lei ah apaikhesuk a, amau achil hi.
Ahi, van sepaihte' TOUPA tung nangawn ah akiliansak a; amah a kipan in niteng halmang thillat alamang a, amun siangthou apaikhesuk hi.
Huan tatlekna ziak in halmang thillatte toh van sepaihte amah kiang ah piak in a-om ua; huchi in lei ah thutak apaikhia a, asep leh bawlte ah alohching hi.

Huchi in misiangthou khat in misiangthou dang khat kiang ah, "Hiai mengmuhna a kimu tatlekna mulkimhuai in niteng halmang thillat bang tan luahtou ding a, mun siangthoupen leh van sepaihte akhenuai a bang tan nuaisiah a omsak ding ahia," achih ka za hi.
Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Nitaklam leh zinglam sangnih-le-zathum sung tan in; huai chiang in mun siangthoupen silsiang ahi ding hi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kei, Daniel in ka mengmuh lai in, theihchet ka na tum a; huchi in ka ma ah mihing kibatpih bang ahong dingh hi.
Huan Ulai luipiau kikal ah, mihing aw kikou in, "Gabriel, hiai mipa mengmuhna theichiansak in," achih ka za hi.

Huchibang in ka dinna mun naih in ahong pai a; huchi a ahong pai lai in, ka lauta a, ka mai in lei ka si hi; himahleh ama'n ka kiang ah, "Aw mihing tapa, mengmuh lah hun tawp a ding ahi a, theisiam in," achi hi.
Huan kei ahon houpih lai in, lei lam nga in nakpitak in ka ihmuta a; himahleh ahon khoih a, ahon dingtangsak hi.
Huan ama'n, "Ngai in, thangpaihna hun tawp lam a bang ahia hong om ding ka hon theisak ding; hun tawp sehsa a ding lah ahi ngal a," achi hi.
"Belamtal na muh kii nih nei, Media leh Persia kumpipate ahi uh.
Huan huai keltal huham Grik kumpipa ahi; amitte kikal a om kii thupi kumpipa khatna ahi.
Huan akitan pen mun luah kii lite ahihleh, huai nam a kipan in gam li hong dingkhe dingte ahi ua; himahleh amau bang in thilhihtheihna anei kei ding uh.
Huan agam vaihawm hun tawp na uah, talek mite ahong hat mahmah chiang un, kumpipa lauhuai melpu, zuau a khem siam khat adingkhe ding hi.
Huchi in athilhihtheihna ahat dia, himahleh amah mah thilhihtheihna hilou in; siatna lamdangtak atun dia, athilhih khempeuh alohching ding hi; huchi in mihatte leh misiangthoute ahihsegawp ding hi.

"Huan amah dan zui in khemna nasep ah alohching zel ding hi; huan alungtang akiliansak ding a, mi tampite bit akisak lai un ahihse ding a; kumpite Kumpi dou ding in akisa ding; himahleh mihing khut hilou in hihkhap in a-om ding hi.
Huan nitak lamte leh zingsang lamte toh kisai mengmuhna kigen adik ahi; himahleh ahong tung ding ni tampi a ding ahih lai ziak in hiai mengmuhna khak bikbek in," achi hi.
Huchi in kei, Daniel ka sibup a; ni bangzah hiam ka china hi; ka thou a, kumpipa nna ka sem a hiai mengmuhna lamdang ka sa hi, himahleh kuamah in hiai atheisiam kei.
Media mi, Ahasueras tapa Darias, Kaldaite tung a kumpipa ding abawl, vaihawm akum khatna,
avaihawm akum khatna kum in kei, Daniel in laibute a kipan Jerusalem hihsiatna in kum sawmsagih daih ding ahi chih zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung tanchin a kipan in ka theisiam hi.
Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN lam ah ka mel ka koihkip a, thumna leh thilngette, an ngawlna leh sai-ip puan silh in, vut lak a tu in Toupa PATHIAN kiang ah ka ngen ngutngut hi.
Huan TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah ka thum a, thupha ka tawi hi, "Aw TOUPA, Pathian thupi leh mulkimhuai, nang hon it a na thupiakte zuite tung a thukhun leh zahngaihna vom;
ka na khialta ua, hoih loutak in ka gamtang ua, giloutak in ka na hihta ua, ka hel ua, na thuseh leh na vaihawmte ka na lehngatsanta uhi.
Ka kumpipate uh, ka vaihawmtute uleh ka pipute uh leh gam a mi tengteng kiang a na min a thugen, na sikha zawlneite thu leng ka na ngaikhe kei uhi.

Aw TOUPA, diktatna nang a ahi a, himahleh tuni bang in, kou a bel zahlakna leh buaina ahi; Judah a mite, Jerusalem a tengte, Israel tengteng, anai leh gamla a omte, na tung a atatlekna ziak un amaute gam tengteng ah delhzak in ka om uhi.
"Aw TOUPA, ka kumpipate, ka vaihawmte uh, ka pipute uh leh kou hon suangtute'n na tung a dikloutak a akhelh ziak un zahlakna in hon khuh hi.
Amah tung ah na helta mah le ung zahngaihnate leh ngaihdamnate TOUPA ka Pathian uh a ahi.
TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw leh adante a om ding a asikha zawlneite zang a ka ma ua hon na koihsakte ka na mangta kei uhi.

Ahi, Israel tengteng in na dan atatleksan ua, ahilou lam ah apial ua, na aw amanlouhna ding un; huaiziak in na tung a ka hihkhelhte ziak in Mosi, Pathian sikha dan sung a gelh a om kichiamna hamsia ka tung ah sunbuak in a-omta hi.
"Huan koute demna leh ka tung ua vaihawmte demna thute leh ka tung ua siatna thupitak in ahihkip khinta hi; Jerusalem tung a kihih bang van nuai pumpi ah lah akihih ngei ngal kei a.

Mosi Dan sung a gelh ahih bang in, hiai siatna tengteng ka tung uah ahong tung hi; huchipi in leng ka thulimlouhnate uh kiheisan a, na thutak a theihkhen theihna ka neihtheihna ding un TOUPA ka Pathian uh deihsakna ka ngen nai kei lai uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA ka Pathian uh athilhihte tengteng a adiktat gige man in, TOUPA'N thil hoih lou en gige in, ka tung uah ahon tungsakta hi; hinapi in kou lah a-aw ka na mangta kei uhi.
Huan tu in, Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, khut hattak a na mite Aigupta gam a kipan pikhepa leh tuni bang a minthanna kimuhpa, tuni bang in ka khialta ua, giloutak in ka na hihta uhi.

"Aw TOUPA, ka hon ngen ahi, na diktatna tengteng ziak in, na hehna leh thangpaihna, na khopi Jerusalem leh na tang siangthou a kipan kihei mangsak in; ka khelhnate uh ziak leh ka pipute uh thulimlouhna ziak in, Jerusalem leh na mite lah ka kim ka vel ua omte tengteng simmoh ahong hita uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in, Aw ka Pathian uh, na sikha thumna leh athilngette ngaikhia inla, TOUPA ziak in, asegawpsa na mun siangthou tung ah na mel vaksak in.

Aw ka Pathian, na bil hon doh inla, za in; na mitte hak inla, na min a kilou na khopi siatgawpnate en in; ka diktatna ziak un na ma a hiai ka thilngetnate uh lan ka hi ngal kei ua, na zahngaihna thupite ziak in ahi zaw hi.
Aw TOUPA, za in, Aw TOUPA ngaidam in, Aw TOUPA, ngaikhia inla hih in; hal ke'n; nangmah ziak mahmah in, Aw ka Pathian, na khopi leh na mite nang min pute ahi uhi," achi hi.
Huchi a thu ka gen a, ka thum a, ka khelhna leh ka mi Israel khelhna thupha ka tawi a, TOUPA ka Pathian ma a ka Pathian tang siangthou a dingh a thilngetna ka piak lai in;
ahi, thumna a thu ka gen lai in, pasal Gabriel, achil a mengmuhna a ka muh pa, kintak a leng dia bawl a om in, nitaklam thillat hun ding in ahong khoih hi.
Huan ahon thuhilh a, ahon houpih a, "Aw Daniel, theihsiamna a siam mahmah a hon bawl ding in tu in ka hong paikhia hi," achi hi.
Na thilngetna kipat phet in adawnna piak ahi; nang hilh ding a hong pai ka hi, nakpitak a it lah na hi ngal a; huaiziak in thu ngaihtuah inla, mengmuhte theisiam in.

"Na mite leh na khopi siangthou a ding in tatlekna hihbeina ding, khelhnate tawpsakna ding leh thulimlouhna a dia kilemna bawlna ding, tangtawn diktatna laklutna ding leh mengmuhte leh genkholhnate khakkhum bikbekna ding leh asiangthoupen thaunilhna ding in na tung ah nipikal sawmsagih hun seh leh thu piak ahi.

Huaiziak in thei inla, theisiam in, Jerusalem tungding nawn ding leh lam ding a thupiak apaikhiak a kipan sathau nilh a ompa, vaihawm tan in, nipikal sagih ahi ding; huan nipikal sawmguk-le-nih sung in hun haksa mahmahte akongzing leh bukna phaizang toh akilam nawn ding hi.

"Nipikal sawmguk-le-nih khit chiang in sathau nilh a ompa satkhiak in a-om ding a, bangmah anei kei ding hi; huchi in ahong om ding vaihawmpa leh mite'n khopi leh mun siangthou ahihse ding ua; hun tawpna tui khang bang in ahong tung ding, huan atawp dong kidouna leh siatgawpnate om ding a guankholhsa ahita hi.

Huchi in nipikal khat a ding in tampi toh thukhun khauhtak abawl ding a; nipikal kimkhat a ding in kithoihna leh thillat atawpsak ding hi; mun siangthou ah mulkimhuai leh kihhuai atungkhe ding a; amah tung a tung dia guankholhsa hun tawp leh thangpaihna atung ah sunbuak ahih tan a-om ding hi,” achi hi.
Hiai thute Jordan suahlam gamdai, Paran leh Tophelen Laban leh Hazeroth leh Dizahab kikal a Suph chin a Arabah a Mosi in Israel mi tengteng kiang a agen ahi.
Horeb tang a kipan Kadesh-barnea, Seir tang lam lampi tawn a pai in ni sawm-le-khat lam ahi.
Akum sawmlina, akha sawm-le-khatna, huai kha ani khat ni in, hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N amau hilh dia thu apiak tengteng Israel kiang ah Mosi in agen hi.
Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Edrei leh Astaroth a om Bashan kumpipa Og athah nung in;
Jordan suahlam Moab gam ah hiai dan Mosi in hiai bang in agenchian panta hi.
TOUPA i Pathian un Horeb tang ah ahon houpih a, "Hiai tang ah na om sawt huntawkta uhi.
Kisuan unla, paikhia unla, Amorte tanggam ah leh akimvel teng Arabah ah, tanggamte ah, phaizang gam leh Lebanon ah, Luipi Euphrates tan in pai un.
Ngai un, gam ka hon pe khin a; na pu uh Abraham, Isak, Jakob leh amaute nung a, asuansawnte uh kiang a kichiam a TOUPA'N apiak gam va luah un," achi hi.
Huai lai in na kiang uah, "Kei kia in ka hon po zou kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon pungsak a, ngai un, tu in na tamdan uh van a aksi zah hial ahong hita hi.
TOUPA, na pi-le-pute Pathian in tu sang in amun sang tamtak in hon pungsak henla, hon chiam bang in hon vualzawl hen.
Bangchi in kei kia in na buainate uh, na puakgikte uh, na kihoutheih louhnate uh ka po zou dia?
Na nam lak ua mi, mipil, theisiammi, adan ding thei mi kitelkhia unla, na tung ua heutu ding in ka bawl ding," ka chi hi.
Nou, "Na thil gen kou a ding in ahoih mahmah," chi in na hon dawng uhi.

Huchi in na nam heutute uh ka la a, na nam lak ua mi, mipil, dan thei mite na tung ua heutu in ka bawl hi: sangkhatte tung a heutute, zakhatte tung a heutute, sawmngate tung a heutute, sawmkhatte tung a heutute, intekpente toh.
Huai lai in na vaihawmte uh kiang ah, "Na unaute uh kal a thu kingaihkhiaksak unla, unau leh unau kikal ah leh gamdangmi, a-ompih toh akal uah diktattak in vai hawm un.

Vaihawmna ah deihsak tuam na nei ding uh ahi kei. Mineu leh milian kibang a na ngaihkhiaksak ding uh ahi. Kuamah na lau ding uh ahi kei. Vaihawmna lah Pathian a ahi ngal a. Nou a dia thuhaksa luate ka kiang ah na hon tun zel ding ua, huai ka ngaikhe zel ding," chi in thu ka pia hi.
Huai lai in na thilhih ding tengteng uah thu ka hon pia hi.
TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in Horeb tang a pan i pawt ua, Amorte tanggam lampi a gamdai zapi leh mulkimhuaitak na muh uh i kantan ua, Kadesh-barnea khua i va tung uhi.
Na kiang uah, "TOUPA i Pathian in hon piak Amorte tanggam na hong tungta uhi.
Ngai dih ua, TOUPA na Pathian un gam ahon pe khinta hi. Hohtou unla, TOUPA na pi-le-pute Pathian in ana gen khitsa bang in va luahtou un. Lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un," ka hon chi hi.
Ka kiang ah na hong pai vek ua, "Agam va enkhia a, i hohtouhna ding lampi leh i hohna ding kho tanchinte hong hilh nawn ding in i ma uah mi sawl leng," na chi uhi.
Huai thu in hon kipaksak a; huchi in na lak ua mi sawm-le-nih, nam khat a khat zel ka tel hi.
Huchi in apawtta ua, tang ah akahtou ua, Eshkol Phaizang ava tung ua, ava enkhe vek uhi.
Huai gam a theite alou ua, ahon puak ua, tanchin hon tun ua, "TOUPA i Pathian hon gam piak hoih petmah ahi," achi uhi.
Himahleh na hohtou nuam kei ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak na helsan uhi.
Na puaninte uah na phun ua, "TOUPA'N ahon huat ziak in hon hihmang dia, Amorte khut a hon pe ding in Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia ahi.

Koi lai ah ahia i hohtouh ding? I unaute'n, mihing ei sang in alianzaw ua, san leng asangzaw ua; khuate alian a, van sun in kulh anei uh. Anak tapate leng i mu a, chi in hon lung kesak uh," na chi uhi.
Ke'n na kiang uah, "Amaute kihta kei unla, lauh leng lau sam kei un.
TOUPA na Pathian na makaipa un na mitmuh ua Aigupta gam a hon hihsak tengteng bang in ahon doupih ding.
Gamdai ah leng mi'n ata apuak bang a TOUPA na Pathian un hiai mun na tun tan un lamtawn a hon puakdan na mu ding uhi, ka chi hi.
Himahleh hiai thil ah TOUPA na Pathian uh na gingta kei uh.
Na puanin na zak ding uh hon zonsak ding leh na lampi uh hon kawkmuh dia zan a meikuang a, sun a meipi a na ma uh pipa na muang kei uhi."
TOUPA'N na thugen uh aza a, aheh a, akichiam hi.
"Hiai suan giloutak lak a mi khat mahmah in leng na pi-le-pute uh pe dia ka kichiamna gam hoih petmah amu kei ding uh,
Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kia ngal lou in. Ama'n zaw amu dia, ava sik gam amah leh atate ka pe ding, ama'n alungtang tengteng a TOUPA azuih ziak in," achi hi.
Noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh a, "Nang leng huai ah na lut kei ding,
na nasempa Nun tapa Joshua bel alut ding. Amah hanthawn in, Israelte alutsak ding hi.
"Na taneute uh, gallak in ala mai ding uh, na chihte uleh, tua asia-apha thei nai lou na tate uh alut ding ua, amau zaw ka pe dia, aluah ding uhi.
Nou ahihleh kihei unla, Tuipi San lam ah gamdai ah pai un," achi hi.

Nou, "TOUPA tung ah i na khialta uh, i hohtou ding ua, TOUPA i Pathian in thu hon piak tengteng bang in i va dou ding uh," chi in na hon dawng ua, huchi in kidouna van in na kivan chiat ua, tang a hohtouh thil neuchik in na ngaihtuah uhi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hohtou kei un. Va dou sam kei un, na lak uah ka om kei hi. Na melmate un hon na that kha ding uh, akiang uah chi in," ahon chi hi.
Huai ka hon hilh a, na ngaikhe kei ua, TOUPA thupiak na helsan zawta ua, tang ah na hohtou teitei uhi.
Huai tang ah Amorte'n hon na dou ua, khuai midelh bang in hon delh ua, Seir a pan Hormah tan in hon that uhi.
Na hong kik nawn ua, TOUPA ma ah na kap ua; himahleh TOUPA'N na aw uh angaikhe kei a, abil leng ahon doh sam kei hi.
Huchi in huai a na om sung uh ngaihtuah in Kadesh ah sawtpi na taam uhi.
Huai lai in TOUPA'N ka kiang huanghang ate bang sek nawn inla, tang ah ka kiang ah hong pai inla, singkuang bawl in.
Tuma lam a suangpek na hihkhapte a thu tuangte suangpekte ah ka gelh dia, singkuang ah na koih ding ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in singgi sing in singkuang ka bawl a, tuma lam a bang suangpek nih ka sek a, suangpek nihte tawi in tang ah ka hohtou hi.
Suangpekte ah ama a gelh bang, na kikhopkhawm ni ua tang a mei a pan TOUPA'N na kiang ua agen thupiak sawm agelh a, TOUPA'N ahon pia hi.
Tang a pan ka kiheisuk nawn a, ka singkuang bawl ah suangpek ka koih hi. TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
Israel suante Bene-jaakan tuileh a pan Moserah ah apai ua; huai ah Aaron asi a, huai ah avui uhi. Atapa Eleazar in amun ah siampu nna asem hi.
Huai a pan Gudgodah ah apai ua; Gudgodah a pan tuiluite gam Jotbathah ah apai uhi.
Huai lai in tutan a TOUPA thukhun singkuang zawng a, ama a TOUPA nna sem a, amin a vualzawlsakmi hi ding in Levi chi aseptuam hi.
Huaiziak in Levi in a-unaute lak ah tantuan, goutan anei kei hi. TOUPA na Pathian un akiang a agen bang in TOUPA agoutan ahi.
Amalam mah bang in tang ah, ni sawmli ka om a; huai lai in leng TOUPA'N ka thu angaikhia a, TOUPA'N nou hon hihmangthang kei hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, mipite ma kai in; amaute piak dia api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam gam aluah ding uh ahi," achi hi.

Khai le, Israel mite aw, nou a pan TOUPA na Pathian un ahon phut bangdang ahia, na hoihna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siam a, alampi tengteng tawn a, amah it a, na lungtang tengteng uleh na lungsim tengteng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh nna sem a,
TOUPA thupiakte, adante zuih dia tua thu ka hon piak zuih hilou maw?
Ngai un, van leh van sangpente leh lei leh asung a om tengteng TOUPA na Pathian uh a vek ahi.
Himahleh na pi-le-pute it bel amah kipah lam ahi a, namdang tengteng tung ah noute, amau nung a asuante uh tua na hih mah bang un hon na telta hi.
Huaiziak in na lungtang vun uh sum unla, genhak nawn kei un.
TOUPA na Pathian uh lah pathiante' Pathian, toupate' Toupa, Pathian thupitak, hattak, lauhuaitak, kuamah deihsak tuam nei lou a, golhna leng la ngei lou ahi ngal a.
Pa neiloute leh meithaite hoihtak in vai ahawmsak hi.
Huaiziak in gamdang mite it sam un; nou leng Aigupta gam ah gamdangmi na hi ngeita uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding ua, amah nna na sem ding ua; amah na len tinten ding ua, amin lou in na kichiam ding uh ahi.
Amah na phat dingpa uh ahi, hiai na mit ua na muh khitsa uh thil thupitak leh mulkimhuaitakte hon hihsakpa na Pathian uh ahi.
Na pi-le-pute uh Aigupta gam ah mi sawmsagih apaisuk ua; tu in bel tamlam in van a aksi zah in TOUPA na Pathian un ahon tamsakta hi.
