Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh na it un adan thusehte, adante, avaihawmte leh athupiakte na zui gige ding uh ahi.
Tu in thei un, TOUPA na Pathian sawina, athupidan, aban hatdan, aban zakdan,
achiamtehnate, athilhih, Aigupta gamsung a Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh tung leh agamsung pumpi a ahihte;
Aigupta sepaihte leh asakol leh akangtalai tung a athilhihte; nou ahon delhzui ua, Tuipi San a atumsakdan, tutan a TOUPA'N ahihmanthatdante;
hiai mun na tun masiah ua gamdai a na tung ua athilhihtheihdante;

Reuben tapa Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram tung a ahihdan; lei in akam akat a, Israel mite tengteng lak a amaute leh a-inkuanpihte uh leh apuaninte uh leh aganhon tengteng uh avalh vekdante thei lou na suante uh kiang a thu gen ka hi kei hi.
Na mit ngei ua TOUPA'N thil thupitak, ahih tengteng mute kiang a thugen ka hi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in na hong hat ua, luah dia na va zot gam uh na luahtheihna ding un, tuni a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng na zuih ding uh ahi.
Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, na pi-le-pute leh asuante kiang a piak dia TOUPA'N akichiamna gam a na ten sawttheihna ding un.
Huai na va luah ding uh gam, na hong pawtna uh Aigupta gam, anteh-louhing huan a haichi na tuh ua, na khe ua tui na buah uh bang uh ahi kei hi.
Na va luah ding uh gam zaw, mualte leh phaizangte leh van vuahtui mu gam ahi zaw hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh zonkhiak gam ahi a; TOUPA na Pathian uh mit kum thak a pan kum tawp pha atuk gigena gam ahi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua a-nna sem dia tu a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng phatuamngaitak a na zuih uleh,
na gam vuahtui uh ahun geihgeih in, vuahtui ke masa leh vuahtui ke nanung ka hon pe dia, huchi in na buh uh, na uain uh, na thau uh na seklut thei ding uhi.
Na gante uh a ding in leng na loute uah loupa ka hon sawl dia, nou leng na ne ding ua, na tai ding uhi.
Pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw na lungtang uh khem in a-om dia, na pial ding ua, pathian dangte nna sem in, na be kha ding uh.
Na huchih uleh TOUPA na tung uah athangpai dia, van akhak dia, vuah azu kei dia, lei in agah apiangsak kei ding. Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon piak, gam hoih a pan na mangthang pah ding uhi.
Huaiziak in hiai ka thute na lungtang uleh na lungsim uah khum unla, chiamtehna ding in na ban uah na vial ding ua, na mit kikal uah talgakna ding in leng a-om ding ahi.
Huaite na tate uh na sinsak ding ua, na inn ua na tut lai un, lampi a na pai lai un, na lup lai un, na thoh chiang un na gen ding uhi.
Na inn kongkhak biangte uah, na kongkhakte uah na gelh ding uh ahi.
Huchi in na pi-le-pute uh piak dia akichiamna gam ah na damsung nite uh leh na tate uh damsung nite leitung a vante nite bang in asausak ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh alampi tengteng zui ding leh amah len tinten ding a phatuamngaitak a hiai thupiak nou ka hon piak tengteng na zuih peuhmah uleh;
TOUPA'N hiai nam tengteng ahon delhkhiaksak dia, nou sang a thupizaw leh thilhihtheizaw namte gam na luah ding uhi.
Na khepek ua na sikna peuh uh nou a ahi dia, gamdai a pan leh Lebanon tang a pan lui, Euphrates Luipi a pan tumlam tuipi pha in na gam uh ahi ding hi.
Kuamah in hon pha kei dia; TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua agensa bang in na va sik ding uh gam tengteng ah noute kihtakna leh lauhna a-omsak ding.
Ngai un, tuni in na ma uah vualzawlna leh hamsia ka koih hi:
TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte, tua ka hon piakte na zuih uleh, vualzawlna ahi ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zuih kei uleh, na theih ngei louh uh pathian dangte be ding a tua ka hon thupiakte na pialsan uleh bel, hamsiat na hi ding uh.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, na va luah ding uh gam a TOUPA na Pathian un hon pilut chiang in, Gerizim tang ah vualzawlna, Ebal tang ah hamsiatna na koih ding uhi.
Nitumna khen, Arabah a om, Kanaante gam, Gilgal zawn Moreh tosaw sik, Jordan gal ate ahi kei uh maw?
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam va luah ding in Jordan na kan ding ua, na luah ding ua, huai ah na teng ding uhi.
Tua na ma ua ka koih, dan leh vaihawm tengteng zui ding in na pilvang ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon piak gam na luah ua, leitung a na ten sung ua pilvangtak a na zuih ding uh dante leh vaihawmte hiaite ahi uh.
Na va luah ding uh gam namte'n tang sangte leh mualte tung leh sing hing nuai a pathiante nna asepna mun tengteng uh na hihsiat vek ding uh ahi.
Amaitamte uh na hihchim ding ua, a Asherahte uh mei in na hal ding uh ahi. Abawltawm uh pathian limte na phuksak ding ua, huai a minte na hihse ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah bel huchibang in na hih ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un na nam tengteng lak ua amin omna dia amun seh ding na zong zaw ding ua, huai ah na hoh ding uh ahi.

Huai ah na halmang thillatte uh, na sawm-a-khatte uh, na vei thillat uh leh na thuchiamte uh, piak dia na chiamsate uh, na ut thu ua thillatte leh na ganhon uh leh na belamhon lak ua piang masapente na hon tawi ding uh ahi.
Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na ne ding ua, na khut koihna peuh ua TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawlna ah kipaktak in na om ding uh.
Michih in amau hoihsak bang chiat a tuni a na hih bang ua na hih ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon piak gam leh khawlna lah na tung nai tadih ngal kei ua.
Jordan lui na galkah ua, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon luahsak ding gam a na ten ua, bittak a na tentheihna ding ua na kim ua melma tengteng a pan hon khawlsak chiang in hichi ahi ding.

TOUPA na Pathian un amin a-omsakna dia asehna mun ah ka chih tengteng na hon tawi ding uh ahi: Na halmang thillatte uh, na kithoihnate uh, na sawm ua khatte uh, na vei thillat uh leh TOUPA kiang a na chiamsa uh na neihte ua ahoihpen teng na hon tawi ding uh ahi.

TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding ua, noumau leh na tapate uh, na tanute uh toh, na sikhapate uh, na sikhanute uh toh, na inn ua om, Levite toh, amau lah na lak uah tantuan leh gam anei ngal kei uhi.
Mun na muh peuh ua na halmang thillatte uh lan mawkmawk lou ding in pilvang un.
Na namte uh lak a TOUPA'N aseh ding mun ah na halmang thillatte uh na lan zaw ding ua, huai ah thu ka hon piak tengteng na hih ding uh ahi.

Himahleh TOUPA na Pathian un vualzawlna hon muhsak bang zel in na hinna un alunggulhpen uh na inn chiat uah na gou ding ua, asa na ne thei ding uh. Asiangloute leh asiangte'n leng sangai leh sakhi ane thei ding uhi.
Asisan ahihleh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Tui bang in lei ah na sungbo ding uh ahi.

Na inn uah, na buh uh leh na uain thak ua sawm-a-khat na khuate uah na ne ding uh ahi kei. Ahihkeileh na ganhonte uh leh belamhonte uh leh na kelhonte uh lak a piang masapente ahihkeileh na ut thu ua na thillat uh ahihkeileh na vei thilte na khuate uah na ne ding uh ahi kei.

TOUPA na Pathian un amun seh ding ah, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na ne zaw ding uh ahi: Noute leh na tapate uh leh na tanute uh, na sikhapate uh, na sikhanute uh, na inn ua om Levite toh. TOUPA na Pathian ma uah na khut ngakna peuhmah ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
Na gam ua na ten sung teng un Levite limsak lou a om lou ding in pilvang un.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon chiam bang a na gam uh ahih zat a, na hinna un sa nek a-ut ziak a, sa ka ne ding, na chih hun chiang un, na hinna un alunggulh lam peuh sa na ne thei ding uhi.

TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding mun agamlat luatleh, thu ka hon piak bang in TOUPA'N hon piak na ganhon uleh na belamhon lak ua na gou ding ua, na hinna un alunggulh lam pang na inn uah na ne ding uh ahi.
Sangaisa leh sakhisa nek ahih bang in na ne ding ua, asiangloute leh asiangte'n leng akibang in na ne ding uhi.
Sisan ahihleh ne lou ding in pilvang un; sisan lah hinna ahi ngal a; hinna toh sa na ne ding uh ahi kei.
Na ne mahmah ding uh ahi kei; tui bang in lei ah na sungbo mai ding uh ahi.
Na ne ding uh ahi kei. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh a thil dik na hih un noumau leh na nung ua na tate uh a ding in ahoih ding hi.
Himahleh na thil siangthoute uh leh lat dia na thuchiamsate kia uh tawi unla, TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah paipih un.
TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam ah na halmang thillat uh, asa leh asisan na lan ding ua; na kithoihna sisante uh TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam ah na sungkhe ding ua, asa na ne ding uh ahi.

Hiai ka hon thupiak tengteng limsak unla, ngaikhia un, huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih leh thil dik na hih un noute a ding leh na nung ua na tate uh a ding in tangtawn in ahong hoih ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na zoh ding uh namte ahon hihmanthatsak a, agam uh na luah ua, na ten hun chiang un;

hihmanthat a a-omna ua na awk khaklouhna ding un, pilvang un. Hiai namte'n bangchi in ahia apathiante uh nna asep uh? Achih bang un en leng i chi sam ding uh, chi in apathiante uh tungtang kan kei un.

Huchibang in TOUPA na Pathian tung ah na hih ding uh ahi kei. Apathiante tung uah TOUPA theih a thilkihhuai chiteng, ahuat mahmahte ahih zel ua; atapate uh, atanute ngei uh leng apathiante uh a ding in ahal zel uhi.
Hih ding a ka hon thupiak peuhmah na hih ding uh ahi. Na behlap ding uh ahi kei a, na tawmsak ding uh leng ahi kei.
Na lak ua zawlnei hiam, mangnimi ham ahongom a, chiamtehna hiam, thillamdang hiam hon etsak a,
chiamtehna hiam, thillamdang hiam hon etsak, ahong tangtun a, na theih ngei louh uh, "pathian dangte zui ni e, a-nna uh sem ni," na kiang ua achihleh;

huai zawlnei hiam, mangneimi hiam thute na ngaikhe ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na hinna tengteng un na it uhia, itlou chih theihtelna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian un ahon ze-et ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh na zui ding ua, amah laudan na siam ding ua, athupiakte na zui ding ua, athugente na zui ding ua, amah nna na sem ding ua, amah na len tinten ding uh ahi,

Huai zawlnei hiam, mangneimi hiam hihlup ding ahi. Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia a, saltanna inn a pan hon tanpa TOUPA na Pathian un zuih ding thu ahon piak lampi a pan hon pialsak dia, TOUPA na Pathian uh tung a helna thu agen ziak in, huchibang in na lak ua thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.

Na unaupa, na nu tapa hiam, na tapa hiam, na tanu hiam, na zi pom lai hiam, na lawm nangmah hinna bang hial nangawn in leng, ahon zol a, kisa ni, "pathian dangte nna sem ni," ahon chihleh; nang hiam, na pipute hiam in leng na theih louh uh pathiante;
na kimvel ua, na kiangchin ua omte hiam, na kigamlatpih deuh uhiam, kawlmong a pan kawlmong khat lam pha a mite pathiante;
pha na sakpih ding uh ahi kei, amah na ngaikhe ding uh ahi sam kei. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, na hawi ding uh leng ahi sam kei, na iim ding uh leng ahi sam kei hi.
Na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi zaw. That ding in khut na kha masa ding a, huai khit chiang in mipi tengteng in akhut uh akha ding uh.
Suang a na denlup ding uh ahi, Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian ua kipan hon pialsakna ding azon ziak in.
Huchi in Israel mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding ua, na lak ua huchibang tatsiatna himhim achingta kei ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na tenna ding ua ahon piak na khua khat a na lak ua kipan Belial tate khenkhat hong pawt a,
huai khopi a mite na theih ngei louh uh, "pathian dangte be ding in apimang uh," chih thu kigen na zak uleh kan unla;
dingkhia unla, phatuamngaitak in dongkhia un. Ngai un, thudik ana hih a, huchibang thilkihhuai na lak ua hih ahi, chih theihtel ahihleh,
namsau a huai khua a tengte na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi. Asung a om tengteng, ganhonte toh namsau in na hihmangthang vek ding uh ahi.
Gallak thil teng kholak ah na lakhawm ding ua, khua leh gallak thil teng TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah halmang thillat in na hal ding ua, leivui lel ahi tawntung ding a, lam thak ahi nawn kei ding hi.
Gallak thil bangmah na khoih ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA'N aheh mahmahna akiheisan dia, zahngaihna ahon musak ding a, hon hehpih ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih hih dia tua ka hon piak thupiak tengteng na zuih peuhmah uleh nou ahon pungsak ding hi; na pi-le-pute uh kiang a ana kichiam khit bang in.
TOUPA na Pathian uh tapate na hi ua; misi ziak in na ki-atkeh ding uh ahi kei. Na mitmul uh leng na metmai ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
TOUPA na Pathian a ding in nam siangthou na hi uh. Leitung a nam tengteng tung ah amah a tuam mawng hi dia TOUPA'N hon tel na hi uhi.
Thilkihhuai himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei.
Hiai sate ahi, na nek theih ding uh: Bawngtal, belam, kel,
sakhi, sangai, sakhital, sathak, gamkel, gamlawi leh gam belam.
Sa chiteng, achin ka, achin ka paisuak, eknel hai chi peuhmah na ne thei ding uh.
Himahleh eknel hai lel leh achin uh leng ka ngalte, na nek ding uh ahi kei. Sangawngsau, zupi leh zusapi in eknel ahai na ua, achin uh akat louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh.
Vok ahihleh achin aka na a, eknel ahai louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi; asa na ne ding uh ahi kei a, asiluang leng na khoih ding uh ahi kei.
Tui a tengte lak ah hiaite na ne thei ding uh: phe leh lip nei peuhmah na ne thei ding uhi.
Phe leh lip nei lou peuhmahte na ne thei kei ding uh, nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh.
Vasa siang tengteng na ne thei ding uh.
Hiaite zaw na ne ding uh ahi kei: Muvanlai, mungawnggiau, mu-akla;
musane, mumeika, mu chi himhim;
va-ak chi himhim;
simbu, zan mu, mu chi himhim, tuipi mu;
simbu neu, simbu lian, simbutanglip;
gamdai simbu, musane, vangawngsau;
Tuiva kengsang, tuivapi chi himhim, huihtun leh bak.
Kha nei khe a pai chi himhim nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh, nek ding ahi kei.
Vasa siang tengteng na ne thei ding uh.

Amah sih a si bangmah na nek ding uh ahi kei. Na ompih uh gamdang mite nek ding in na pe thei ding uh. Namdang mite kiang ah leng na zuak thei ding uh. Nou zaw TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in nam siangthou na hi uhi. Kelnou api nawitui in na huan ding uh ahi kei.
Kum chih in na lou ua an tung tengteng sawm-a-khat na piak ngeingei ding uh ahi.

TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siamna dan na hon theihgige theihna ding un sawm-a-khat, na buh uh, na uain uh, na thau uh leh na ganhon uh leh na belamhon lak ua piang masapente TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, amin omna dia aseh ding ah na ne ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl chiang in, TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding mun agamlat luat ziak a nou a dia alampi asau luat a, na tawi theih kei uleh,
sum na suah ding ua, sum na tawi ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un amun sehna ah na hoh ding uh ahi.

Na lungsim ua na deihpen uh, bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, uain hiam, zu khauh hiam, na lungsim ua na lunggulh peuhmah uh a ding in sum na zang ding ua; huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na ne ding ua, kipaktak in na om ding uh; noute leh na inkote uh toh.
Na tenna ua teng Levite limsak lou in om het kei un. Na lak uah amau tantuan leh goutan anei kei uhi.
Kum thum achin kum in huai kum a na thil tung tengteng ua sawm-a-khat na lakhawm vek ding ua, na omna uah na koih ding uh ahi.

Na omna ua om Levite leng, na lak ua tantuan, goutan leng neiloute leh gamdang mite leh pa neiloute leh meithaite'n ane ding ua, ahong khosa thei sam ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut koihna teng uh avualzawl ding hi.
Kum sagih achin kum in ngaihdamna na bawl ding uh ahi.
Ngaihdamdan ding hichibang ahi: Leiba neimi peuhmah in a-invengte ana leitawisak angaihdam ding ahi. A-invengte leng, a-u anau leng asik teitei ding ahi kei; TOUPA khahkhiak chih ahih ziak in.
Namdangmi ahihleh na sik teitei thei ding uh. Himahleh nou a bangpeuh na unaute un ana zat uh na ngaihdam ding uh ahi.
Mizawng himhim na om ding uh ahi kei; TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia nou ahon piak gam ah TOUPA'N lah hon vualzawl ngei ding ahi ngal a.
Hiai thupiak tuni a ka thupiak tengteng zui dia TOUPA na Pathian uh phatuamngaitak a na zuih peuhmah uleh;
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon chiam bang in hon vualzawl ding a, nam tampi na leitawisak ding uh. Nam tampi tung ah vai na hawm ding ua, nou tung ah bel amau vai ahawm kei ding uhi.
TOUPA'N ahon gam piak na tenna ua na unaute uh lak a mizawng a-om uleh na unau gentheite lak ah na lungsim khauhsak kei unla, sumchil sam kei un.
Atung uah na thilphal ngeingei ding ua, ataksap awng hukna khop na leitawisak ding uh ahi.

"Ngaihdam kum, akum sagihna ahong tung dekta, chi in na unau zawngte mudah a bangmah pe nuam lou in na lungtang uah dikloutak a ngaihtuahna om lou ding in pilvang un," Huchi lou in zaw, amau na tungtang thu uah TOUPA asam ding ua, nou a ding in khelhna ahi kha ding.

Na piak ngeingei ding uh ahi. Na piak chiang un leng na lungtang uh anuam moh ding ahi kei. Huchibang thil ziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un na thilhih tengteng uah leh na khut ngakna peuh uh ahon vualzawl ding hi.

Huai gam ah lah mizawngte om louh lai om lou ding ahi ngal a. Huaiziak in na gam ua na unaute uh tung ah, tasamte tung ah, na mizawngte uh tung ah, na thilphal ngeingei ding uh ahi, chih ka hon thupiak ahi.
Na unau uh, Hebru pa hiam, Hebru nu hiam, na kiang ua azuak ua, kum guk nangmah nna asepleh akum sagih kum in na khah ding uh ahi.
Na khah chiang un khutvuak in na pawtsak ding uh ahi kei.
Na belamhon ua kipan, na phual ua kipan, na uain sukna khuk ua kipan itloutak in na pe ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawl dan bang zel in na pe ding uhi.
Aigupta gam ah sikha na hita ua, TOUPA na Pathian un hon tan chih na theigige ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in ahi, tua hiai thu ka hon piak.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, noute leh na inkuan uh angaih ziak uleh, na kihoutheih ziak ua, "K'on pawtsan kei ding," achih bikbek aleh;
sikzum na la ding ua, kongkhak ah abil na vut pailet ding ua, huchi in tangtawn in na sikha uh ahi ding. Na sikhanu uh leng huchi mah bang in na hih ding uh ahi.
Pawtsak thil haksa bang in na ngaihtuah ding uh ahi kei. Kiloh sep zahnih sem in kum guk nang nna ahon sepsak khinta ngal a. TOUPA na Pathian un na thilhih peuh uah hon vualzawl ding hi.

Na ganhonte uh, na belamhonte uh lak a apa, piang masapente TOUPA na Pathian uh a tuam in na pe ding uhi. Na ganhon uh apiang masapen nasem ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei. Na belamhonte uh lak a piang masapen mul na met ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kum teng in TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah nou leh na inkuante uh toh na ne ding uh ahi.
Gensiat kai, akhe bai hiam, amit taw hiam, gensiatna om peuhmah TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a kithoihna ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei.
Na omna huangsung ah na ne ding uh ahi. Asiangloute leh asiangte'n sangai leh sakhi leng ane thei ding uh.
Asisan kia na ne ding uh ahi kei. Tui bang in lei ah na sungbua mai ding uh ahi.
Abib kha tang unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in Paikan Ankuangluina ding in zang un. Abib kha in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un Aigupta gam a pan zan a ahon pikhiak.
TOUPA'N amin omna mun dia aseh ding ah TOUPA na Pathian kiang uah na belamhon lak ua leh na ganhon lak ua Paikan Ankuang ding in na kithoih ding uh ahi.

Tanghou silngou soh toh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Na damsung teng ua Aigupta gam a pan na pawt ni uh na theihgigena ding un ni sagih tanghou silngou soh louh, haksatna tanghou toh na nek ding uh ahi, Aigupta gam a pan kintak a pawtkhia na hi uhi.
Na gamsung uah ni sagih sung, na lak uah silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei. Ani khat ni nitaklam a na kithoihna sa uh zankhua in azingsang tan in bangmah a-om ding ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na omna uh koi lai mah ah Paikan Ankuang kithoih in na kithoih thei kei ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna mun dia aseh ding kia ah ahi ding. Huai ah Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawt hun bang un nitaklam in Paikan Ankuang kithoih in na kithoih ding uhi.
Na em ding ua, TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah na ne ding ua, zingsang in na pai nawn ding ua, na puanin uah na lut ding uhi.
Ni guk sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh ahi. Ani sagih ni pen TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna na sem ding uh ahi kei hi.
Nipikal sagih na sim ding ua; na buhlak tung ua kipan nipikal sagih na sim ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawl bang zel in na sepkhiak uh lak a noumau ut thu a thillat lan in TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in Nipikal Ankuanglui na nei ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding ah na sikhanute uh, na tenna ua om Levite, na lak ua om gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite toh TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi uh, chih na theihgige ding uh ahi. Hiai dante pilvangtak in na zui ding uh ahi.
Na buhphual ua kipan leh na uain sukna khuk ua kipan na sekkhawm khit un ni sagih sung Biakbuk Ankuanglui na nei ding uhi.
Na ankuangluina uah nou toh, na tapa uh toh, na tanu uh toh, na sikhanu uh toh, na tenna ua om Levite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite toh kipaktak in na om ding uhi.

TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in ni sagih ankuang na lui ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un thil tung tengteng ah leh na khut ngakna tengteng uah ahon vualzawl dia, na vek un kipaktak in na om ding uh ahi.

Kum teng in na pasal tengteng uh thumvei TOUPA ma ah mun hon sehsak ding ah akilang ding uh ahi. Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuang ah, Nipikal Ankuang ah, Biakbuk Ankuang ah akilang ding ua, TOUPA ma ah kuamah khutvuak in na kilang ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un vualzawlna ahon muhsak bang zel in michih in azoh hun bang in ape ding ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak kulh kongpi tengteng ah na nam bang zel un vaihawmte leh heutute na kibawl chiat ding ua, mipite vai hoihtak in ahawmsak ding uh ahi.
Dik loutak in vai na hawm ding uh ahi kei. Kuamah deihsak tuam na nei ding uh ahi kei. Golhgukna na la ding uh ahi kei. Golhgukna in mipilte mit atawsak a, midiktatte thu akaikawi hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam dam a na luahtheihna ding un adik kia na zui ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam na bawl chiang un apang ah sing bangchi mah in leng Asher na phutkhe ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un amuhdah lam suang leng na phut ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
Bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, himhim nei in TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah na kithoih ding uh ahi kei. Hiai lah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in thilkihhuai ahi ngal a.
Na lak uah TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na tenna koipeuh uah leng pasal hiam, numei hiam leng, thukhun bohsia a pathian dang nna va sem a,
ka thupiak louh, ni hiam, kha hiam, van ate himhim hiam, TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih a-om a;
ahon hilh ua, nang na zak a, phatuamngaitak a na dot a, ngai in, adik a, thu atel mahmah a, huchibang thilkihhuai Israelte lak a hih ana hihleh;
huai thil gilou hihmi, pasal hiam, numei hiam na kulh kongkhak polam uah pasal hiam numei hiam pen na pikhe ding ua, suang in na denglum ding uhi.
Theihpih nih hiam, thum hiam kam a pan in asi ding mi hihlup ding ahi. Himahleh theihpih khat kia kam a pan in hihlup ding ahi kei.
Hihlup ding pen tung ah theihpihte'n akhut uh that ding in akha masa ding ua, huai khit chiang in mipi tengteng in, huchibang in na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
Sisan kisuah thu ah, sum-le-pai thu ah, kivuak thu ah, na tenna ua kiselna thu himhim a nou a dia vaihawm haksa lua ahong omleh, TOUPA na Pathian un amun seh ding ah na hoh ding ua,
huai hun a siampu Levite leh vaihawmte kiang a hoh in na dong ding uhi. Amau thu hihpukdan ding hon na kawkmuh ding uhi.
Huchi in nou TOUPA'N mun aseh ding a pan thu hihpukdan hon na kawkmuh bang un na hih ding ua, ahon sinsak bang un pilvangtak in na hih ding uhi.
Thu hihpukdan hon na sinsak uleh vaihawmdan hon na hilh bang zel un na hih ding uhi. Thu hihpukdan hon na kawkmuh uh taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam na pialsan ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a nasem a pang siampu leh vaihawmmi thu pom lou a, engtat peuhmah, huai mi hihlup ding ahi. Israel a pan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
Huchi in mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding ua, a-engtat nawn kei ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding gam na va tun ua, na va luah ua, na va ten ua, "I gam a nam tengteng bang in kumpipa i nei ding uh, na chih chiang un,"
TOUPA na Pathian un atel pen kumpipa dia na neih ding uh ahi. Na unau lak ua mi khat na kumpipa ding ua na bawl ding uh ahi. Namdangmi, na unau uh hilou zaw nou hon uk dia na bawl ding uh ahi kei.

Himahleh sakol tampi akaikhawm ding ahi kei, ahihkeileh sakol zong ding in Aigupta gam a kik nawn ding in mite asawl ding ahi kei. Aziak ahihleh TOUPA'N, "Huai lam a na kik nawn louh ding uh ahi," achi khinta hi.
Alungtang pimang a a-omlouhna ding in zi leng tampi aneih ding ahi kei. Dangka leh dangka-eng leng tampi akhawm ding ahi kei.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, alalgam laltutphah a atut chiang in siampu Levite a pan kila hiai dan teisawn a, amah a dia laibuzial a agelh ding ahi.
Hiai dan amah kiang ah a-om gige ding a, adamsung teng a, asim zel ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA a Pathian laudan asin thei dia, hiai dan thu tengteng leh dan thusehte pilvangtak in azui thei dia,
a-unaute tung ah alungtang akisathei kei dia, dan a pan taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah apial kei ding hi. Huai nung in alalgam Israel tung ah amah leh asuante'n sawtpi vai ahawm ding uhi.
Siampu Levite, Levi nam tengteng in Israelte lak ah tantuan leh goutan anei ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA kiang a mei a thillat leh amau a tuam pen ane ding uhi.
A unaute uh lak ah goutan anei ding uh ahi kei; agoutan uh bel akiang ua agen bang in TOUPA ahi ngal a.
Mipite lak a pan kithoihna lanpa siampu a tuam ding hiaite ahi: Bawngtal leh belam liang leh abiangtuai langnih leh agilpi siampu apiak ding uh ahi.
Na buh na bal, na uain, na thau tung masate uh, na belam mulmet masakpente uh leng na piak ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un TOUPA min a nasem a om tawntung ding in nam tengteng a pan amau leh atapate uh toh atel ahi ngal ua.
Levi mi kuapeuh atenna Israel gam na tenna ua akoipeuh pawtsan a, alungsim a kilawptak a TOUPA'N aseh ding mun a ahong paileh;
huai a TOUPA ma a om Levite, a-unaute mah bang in TOUPA a Pathian min in nna asem ding ahi.
Asiamput man uh sim louh in midang tuam nek ding atang sam himhim ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding gamsung a na lut chiang un, huai gam a namte thilhih kihhuaite zui kei un.
Na lak uah mi kuamah atapa hiam, atanu hiam mei a paisuaksak, mi kuamah aisan ching, mi kuamah mangsan ching hiam, bum hiam, mitkhialdawi tawi hiam,
zawl aitawi hiam, mi sisa houpih hiam, khate zawl hiam, misisate dong thei hiam na om ding uh ahi kei.
Hichibang thilhih chingte peuhmah TOUPA a ding in mikihhuai ahi ngal ua. Hiai thilkihhuaite ziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un amaute ahon delhkhiaksak.
TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a na hoihkim ding uh ahi.
Huai na va luah ding uh gam a namte'n mitkhialdawi leh aisan ching mite angaikhia ua; nou zaw TOUPA na Pathian un huchibang hih ahon phal kei hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un keimah bang na unaute uh lak a mi zawlnei a hon bawlsak dia, ama thu na ngaikhe ding uh ahi.
"TOUPA i Pathian aw zaw hon zasak nawn ke'nla, hiai mei thupi hon musak nawn ke'n, ka si kha ding uh," chi a Horeb tang a kikhopkhawm ni a TOUPA na Pathian uh na deihdan bang un.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, athugen uh agen hoih ngel uhi.
A-unaute uh lak ah nangmah bang zawlnei ka bawlsak dia, akam ah ka thute ka koih dia, akiang a ka thupiak peuhmah akiang uah agen ding.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka min a ka thu agen zui lou peuhmah ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
Ka min agen ding ka piak louh gen teitei zawlnei hiam, pathian dangte min a thugenmi zawlnei hiam, huai zawlnei hihlup ding ahi.
"Na lungtang ua, bangchi in ahia athu TOUPA gen ahi kei chih i theih ding? na chih uleh,

zawlnei in TOUPA min a thu agen a, athil gen pen ahong tangtun kei a, alohchin keileh, huaitak ahi, TOUPA gen louh, zawlnei in ki-uangsaktak in agen mawkmawk ahi a, amah na lau ding uh ahi kei," achi hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un agam uh nou ahon piak namte TOUPA'N ahihmanthat khopite na luah ua, a-innte ua na ten chiang un;
TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia nou ahon piakna gam ah nou a ding in khopi thum na sep ding uhi.
Huai khopite zotna ding lampite sial unla, TOUPA'N hon luahsak ding gam seh thum suah un. Huchi in mi that kha kuapeuh huaite ah atailut thei ding uhi.
Huai a tailutmi that kha bit thei ding hiaite ahi: Mi a-invengte tuma lam a huatna leng nei khol lou a that kha peuhmahte;
a-invengte toh sing phuk dia gamlak a kuan, asing phuk dia aheipi asat a, heipi tang kitol in a-invengte adenlup khakte ahi ding ua hiai khopite lak a khatpeuh ah atai thei ding uh;
sisan phulami in ahehna apai lai a mithat mi pen delh a, lampi asau ziak a delhpha in ava satlum kha ding hi. Tuma lam a huatna na nei khol lou ahih ziak in si tak ahi kei hi.
Huaiziak in Khopi thum nou a ding in na sep ding uh, chi in thu ka hon pia hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiam bang a na pi-le-pute uh piak ana chiam gam ahon piak a;
TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh alampi zui gige ding a, tuni a ka hon thupiak tengteng na zuih uleh hiai khopi thumte sim louh in nou a ding in khopi thum dang na behlap nawn ding uhi.
Hiai bel TOUPA'N luah ding a ahon piak na gamsung ua poi khoih lou sisan suah a-om louh a, na tung ua sisan a-omlouhna ding ahi.
Himahleh mi'n a-invengte ahuat a, atan a, asual a, si khop hial a avuak a, huai khopite lak a khat a ataileh;
akho upate un mi sawl uhenla, huai mipa va pi uhenla, hihlup ding in sisan phulami khut ah pekhia uhen.
Amah na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, nou a dia hoih ding in Israel gam a pan poi khoih lou sisan suahna na hihmang ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak gam ah, ana phuhsa uh na invengte gamgi na suan ding uh ahi kei.
Mi athulimlouhna hiam, akhelhna himhim hiam theihpih khat ahun kei dia; theihpih nih kam hiam, theihpih thum kam hiam a thu hihkip ding ahi.
Mi khatpeuh thil hihkhial a ngoh dia tup gilou nei theihpihmi adinleh,
huai bang a kingohna neite gel TOUPA ma leh huai hun a siampute leh vaihawmte ma ah adingh tuak ding uhi.
Vaihawmte'n ngenteltak in thu adong ding ua, ngai in, theihpihmi thu theihpih zuau ahih a, a-unau zuau a ngoh ahihleh;
a-unau tung a hih atup bangbang amah tung ah na hih ding uh. Huchibang in na lak ua thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
Midangte'n aza ding ua, alau ding ua, huchi in tunung chiang in huchibang thil hoih lou mawngmawng na lak uah ahih nawn kei ding uhi.
Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei. Hinna tang in hinna, mit tang in mit, ha tang in ha, khut tang in khut, khe tang in khe ahi ding ahi.
Huan i kihei ua, TOUPA'N i kiang ua agen bang in Tuipi San lam ah gamdai ah i lutta ua; Seir tang ni tampi i vel uhi.
TOUPA'N ahon houpih a,
"Hiai tang na vel sawt hunta uh. Mallam zuan in kihei un.
Mipite, Seir tang a om, Esau suan na unaute uh gam ah na paisuak ding uhi. Amau hon na lau ding ua; huaiziak in pilvang mahmah un.
Kisualpih kei un. Agam uh koi lai mah leng, khepek a sik khop lel leng nou ka hon pe kei ding. Seir tang zaw ama a tuam ding in Esau ka pe khinta hi.
Na nek ding un a-an uh sum in na lei ding ua, na dawn ding un atui uh leng sum in na lei ding uhi.

TOUPA na Pathian un na khut nasep peuhmah uah ahon vualzawl zel a, hiai gamdai zapi na totsuakdante uh leng athei hi. Hiai kum sawmli sung teng in TOUPA na kiang uah a-om a, bangmah na tasam kei uh, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
Huchi in Elath leh Ezion-geber a pan Arabah lam a pai in Seir tang a om Esau suan i unaute gam i tawn paisuak uhi. I kihei ua, Moab gamdai lam ah i pai uhi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Moabte hihbuai kei unla, galsual in leng sual kei un. Agam uh nou a tuam ding in ka hon pe kei ding, Lot suante a tuam ding in Ar ka pe khinta hi,” achi hi.
Tuma lam in Emimte, huai ah ateng ua, amaute Anakte bang a milian leh tam, mi sangpite ahi uh.
Huaite leng Anakte mah bang a miliante ahi ua, himahleh Maobte'n Emimte achi uhi.
Tuma lam in Seir tang ah Horte leng a-om ua; himahleh Esau suante'n aluahsak uhi. Athat ua, amun uah atengta ua; Israelte TOUPA'N amau a tuam dia apiak gam mah bang in.
Huchi in "Thou unla, Zered Phaizang kan dih ua," achi a; huchi in Zered Phaizang i kanta uhi.
Kadesh-barnea a pan i pawt a, Zered Phaizang i kan ua, TOUPA'N akiang ua akichiam bang a mipi lak a misuan a gal dou thei mi tengteng abei vek kikal uh kum sawmthum-le-giat ahi.
Mipite lak a pan abei sipsip ma uh amaute hihmang ding in atung uah TOUPA khut atu hi.
Huchi ahi a, huchibang a mipi lak a pan galdou thei tengteng abei ua, ahong sih khit nung un,
TOUPA'N ahon houpih hi.
"Tuni in Moab gam, Ar na khen paisuak ding uh ahi.
Ammon suante kiang ava tun chiang un, hihbuai kei unla, kisualpih kei un. Ammonte gam nang a tuam ding in ka hon pe kei ding. Lot suante a tuam ding in ka pe khinta," achi hi.
Huai leng Rephaimte gam bang a sim ahi sam; huai ah tuma lam in Rephaimte ateng uhi. Himahleh Ammonte'n zaw Zamzummim achi uhi.
Anakte bang a milian leh tam leh misang pipi ahi ua; himahleh TOUPA'N ahihmang a, amau aluah leuleu ua, amun uah atengta uhi.
Seir tang a om Esau suante Horte ahihmansak lai a, ahih bang in; huchi in amau aluah ua, amun uah tu dong in ateng lai uhi.
Gaza tan a khoneu chikchik a om Avvite Kaphtor a pan a hong pawt Kaphtorte'n ahihmang ua, amun uah ateng uhi.
"Thou unla, paikhia unla, Arnon Phaizang kan un; ngai dih ua, Amor mi Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh agam ka hon pe khinta hi; luah peuhmah unla, galsual in sual un.
Tuni in, van nuai a mite tung ah nang hon lauhna uh leh hon kihtakna uh ka omsak pan dia, na tanchin aza ding ua, aling ding ua nang ziak in gimthuak in a-om ding uhi," achi hi.
Kedemoth gamdai a pan Heshbon kumpipa Sihon kiang ah lemna thu pua in mi ka sawl hi.
"Na gam ah hon paisuaksak dih ve. Lamlian zel ah ka pai ding ua, ataklam ah hiam, aveilam ah hiam leng ka pial kei ding uh.
Ka nek ding un an sum in na hon leisak dia, ka dawn ding un tui leng sum mah in na hon leisak ding hi.
Jordan ka kan ua TOUPA ka Pathian un ahon piak gam ka lut masiah uh, Seir a om Esau suante leh Ar a om Moabte'n ahon paisuaksak bang un hon paisuaksak lel in," chi in.
Himahleh Heshbon kumpipa Sihon in agam ah hon paisuaksak nuam kei a; TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piaktheihna ding in alungtang akhauhsak a, na theihsa uh bang un apaupengsak hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Ngai in, Sihon leh agam hon pe ding ka hita, agam tang ding in luah peuhmah in," ahon chi hi.
Sihon leh ami tengteng Jahaz a hong sual ding in ahong kuan uh.
TOUPA i Pathian in ahon pia a; amah leh atate leh amite tengteng i that uhi.
Huai lai in akhua tengteng i la ua, huai khuate a mihing tengteng, numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh tan in i hihmang vek ua, hawi mahmah i nei kei uhi.
I lak khua a gallak a i lak thil leh gante kia ei a tuam ding in i la uhi.
Arnon Phaizang a om Aroer a pan leh phaizang a kho omte a pan Gilead pha in ei a ding in khua sang lua a-om kei hi, TOUPA i Pathian in hon pe vek hi.
TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in Ammon suante gam koimah, Jabok lui tan in mual tung a khuate kim leh kiang gam hitaleh na naih kei uhi.
Na melmate uh dou ding a na kuan ua, sakol, kangtalai, nou sang a mipi tamzaw na muh chiang un, na lau ding uh ahi kei. Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh na kiang uah a-om hi.
Kidou dia na kuan dek chiang un siampu in mipi va naih henla, houpih henla, akiang uah,
"Israelte aw, za un, tu in na melmate uh dou ding na hi ua, na lungtang uh patausak kei un. Lau kei unla, ling sam kei un, amaute lauhsak in om kei un.
Noute hon tonpih a na melmate uh hon dousak a, hon hondam ding TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi, chi hen."
Heutute'n mipite kiang ah, "Inn thak lam a lan nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen. Kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in alan kha ding,"
"Grephuan bawl a, agah ne nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen, kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in ane kha ding hi."
"Zikham a kiteng nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen. Kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in akitenpih kha ding," chi in gen hen.
Heutute'n mipite kiang ah, "Lau leh patau na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen, a-unaute uh lungtang amah lungtang bang in azulsak kha ding," chi lai uhen.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, heutute'n mipite kiang a thu agen khit un mipite makaih ding sepaih heutute asep ding uhi.
Dou ding kho kim na va tun chiang un lemna thu gen phot un.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahon kileppih ua, ana kihon uleh hichi ahi ding a, huai a mi om tengteng nasem dia na goih ding uh ahi dia, na nna uh asem ding uhi.
Hon kileppih ut lou a, ahon na dou ding uleh umkhum un.
TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piak hun chiang in pasal tengteng namsau in na that vek ding uh ahi.

Numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh, gante leh khua a thil omte leh huai a gallak thil tengteng nou a tuam dia na lak ding uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na melmate uh a pan gallak thil na ne ding uhi.
Hiai namte khua hilou, na tenna ua kipan a kho gamla tengteng huchibang in na hih zel ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak hiai namte khuate zaw TOUPA na Pathian un thu ahon piak bang in ahing peuhmah bangmah na hawi ding uh ahi kei.
Hitte, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste na hihmang vek ding uhi.
Apathiante uh tung a ahih zel uh thilkihhuai tengteng ahon sinsaklouhna ding un hihmang vek un. Huchi lou in zaw TOUPA na Pathian tung ah thil na hihkhial kha ding uhi.

Lak tum a na dou uh khua sawtpi na um chiang un, asingte uh heipi in na phuk ding uh ahi kei; na nek ding uh ahi ngal a. Huai khopi douna a zat ding in leng na phuk ding uh ahi kei; huai gam a singte mihing hinna ahi ngal a.
Himahleh gah nei lou singte bel phuk in na hihse thei ding ua, na doute khua na lak zoh masiah uh adouna vanzat in na zang ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak gamsung a thahsa mi ana om a, athatmi theih louh ahihleh,
na upate uh leh na vaihawmtute uh ahong pai ding ua, athahna kim khua a pan ateh ding ua,
huan hichi ahi ding a, aluang a pan kho naipen khua a upate'n bawnghon lak a bawngla, zat nai louh, hakkol po nai lou akai ding uhi.
Huai khua upate'n bawngla, tui luanna, lei leh louh leh bangmah chinlouhna phaizang ah akaisuk ding ua, phaizang ah angawng atan ding uh.
Levi tapa siampute'n ahon zuan ding ua, amau TOUPA na Pathian un anasemmi leh TOUPA min a vualzawlmi dia asehte uh lah ahi ngal ua; thubuai leh kivuak thu agen bangbang uh ahi ding ahi.
Luang naihpen khua upa tengteng in phaizang a bawngla ngawng atan tung uah akhut uh asil ding uhi.
"Ka khut un hiai sisan asuah kei a, ka mit un leng amu sam kei.
TOUPA aw, na tatkhiak, na mi Israelte lak ah poi khoih lou sisan suahna moh hon khusak ke'n," chi in apang ding uhi. Huchi in sisan thu ah ngaihdam ahi ding uhi.
Huchibang in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih hih in poi khoih lou sisan suahna na lak ua kipan na koihmang ding uhi.
Na melmate uh dou dia na kipatkhiak ua, TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piak a, sal a na pi ua,
sal lak a numei melhoihtak, na mi deihlam, zi ding a na mi deihlamtak na muhleh,
na inn ah na pi dia; alu amet dia, akhutchin atan ding hi.
Asal puanak asuahkhe dia, na inn ah a-om dia, kha khat sung anu leh apa asuun dia, huai khit in, na kithuahpih dia, apasal na hi dia, amah na zi ahi ding hi.
Amah a kipahna na neih keileh a-utna peuh a pai na phal ding ahi, sum-le-pai in na zuak ding ahi kei a, sumsinna in na zang ding leng ahi kei, amah na daisakta ngal a.
Mi'n zi nih nei henla, khat pen deih in khat pen ho taleh, adeihnu leh ahuatnu in ta suansak tuak taleh; a upapen ahuatnu tapa hitaleh;
agou neih atapate akhopsak hun chiang in adeihpen tapa, atapa upa ahuat pen ta sang a deihsakna apiak tuam ding ahi kei.
Ahuat pen ta, ata upapen, aneih tengteng a pan tan nih huai a dia abawl ding ahi; ahatna bul ahi a, tachil hihna ama a tuam ahi.
Mi'n tapa phengphitak, helhattak nei henla, anu leh apa thumang lou in, asawina uh limsakta keileh;
anu leh apa'n akai ding ua, akho upate uh kiang ah akhokulh kongpi bul ah api ding uhi.
Akho upate uh kiang ah, hiai ka tapa uh phengphitak leh helhattak ahi a, ka thu uh leng amang nuam kei a; kizatbei hat leh kham hatmi ahi, achi ding uhi.
Huchi in khua a mi tengteng in suang in adenglum ding uhi. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi. Israel mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding uhi.
Mi'n sihna khop khelhna ahih a, thah a om a, sing dawn a na khai uleh;

aluang sing ah zankhua in a-om ding ahi kei. Huai ni mahmah in na vui ding uhi. Sing a khai peuhmah lah Pathian hamsethuak ahi ngal a. TOUPA na Pathian un luah ding a ahon piak na gam uh na hihnitlouhna ding un.
Na unau bawngtal hiam, abelam hiam mang na muhleh na daihsan ding ahi kei. Na unau inn ah na pi ngeingei ding ahi.
Na unau inn kiangnai a om ahih louh a, aneimi na theih louh uh ahihleh, na inn ah na pitou dia, na kiang ah a-om nilouh dia, na unau in azon hunhun in na pe nawn ding ahi.

Huchi mah bang in asabiltung leng na hih ding ahi. Huai mah bang in apuansilh leng na hih ding ahi. Huchi mah bang in na unau thil mansak na muh peuhmah na hih ding ahi, na daihsan mawkmawk ding ahi kei.
Na unau sabiltung hiam, bawngtal hiam, lampi a puk na muhleh na daihsan maimah ding ahi kei. Na photpih ngeingei ding ahi.
Numei in pasal van asilh ding ahi kei. Pasal in numei van asilh ding ahi kei. Kuapeuh huchibang hihmi TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in kihhuai ahi.
Lampi a vasabu, sing ah hiam, lei ah hiam, anou hiam, atui hiam om, anou hiam atui hiam, api in a-opkhum lai na muhleh api toh anou na lakkhawm ding ahi kei.
Api na khah ngeingei ding ahi. Anou bel na la thei ding ahi. Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih dia, na damsung na sawtsak ding hi.
Inn thak na lam chiang in atung a pan mi kia a, asisan moh na khuklouhna ding in atung na um ding ahi.
Na grephuan ah thil chi nih na ching ding ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na chi tuh gah leh na grephuan a gah teng siang lou ahi ding uhi.
Bawngtal leh sabiltung lei na kaikhawmsak ding ahi kei.
Samul leh pat kigankhawm puan na silh ding ahi kei.
Na kituamna puan uh agei li ah mong khih na bawl ding uh ahi.
Pasal khatpeuh in zi aneih a, akithuahpih a, amuhdah nawn thepthup a,
hiai numei ka kitenpih a, ka kithuahpih a, nungak siangthou ahihna ka mu kei, chi a zahlaktak a bawl a, amin ahihsiatleh,
nungak nu leh pa'n kulh kongpi ah huai kho upate kiang ah nungak siangthou ahih kichetnate ahon tawi ding uhi.
Nungak pa'n upate kiang ah, "Hiai mipa ka tanu ka neisak a, aho nawn thepthup hi.

Ngai un, na tanu nungak siangthou ahihna ka mu kei, chi in zahlaktak in abawl a, himahleh hiaite ka tanu nungak siangthou ahihna ahi,” achi ding hi. Huchi in huai kho upate ma ah tua puan aphah ding hi.
Huai kho upate'n huai mipa paipih in agawt ding ua;
Israel nungak siangthou asukminsiat ziak in dangka shekel zakhat aliausak ding ua, nungak pa ape ding uhi; amah zi ahi dia, adamsung in akhen thei kei ding.
Himahleh huai mipa thu ana dik a, nungak siangthou ahih kichetnate muh ahihkeileh;

nungak pen apa'n kongpi ah apikhe dia, atenna khua a mite'n amah suang in adenglum ding uh; apa inn a kizuak a Israelte lak a thil gilou haihuai mahmah ahih ziak in. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan, huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
Pasal khat in pasal nei numei akithuahpih lai muh ahihleh akithuahpih pasal leh numei anih ua asih ding uh ahi. Huchibang in Israel a pan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
Nungak siangthou, mi zikham, pasal khat in khopi a amuh a, akithuahpihleh;

anih un khokulh kongpi ah na pikhe ding ua, suang in na denglum ding uh; numei pen khua a-om ngal a, akikou louh ziak in. Pasal pen a-invengte zi ahihminsiat ziak in. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
Himahleh min gamlak a midang in zi dia akhamsa nungak amuh a, apawngsualleh hiai thilhih pasal kia sihsak ding ahi.
Nungak pen bangmah loh louh ding ahi. Nungak in sihna khop khelhna bangmah hih lou ahi. Hiai bang mi ahihleh min a-invengte sual a, that toh kibang ahi.
Hiai bang thu ahihleh gamlak a va tuak kha a, mi zikham nungak kikou a, panpih ding mi om lou ahih ziak ahi.
Mi'n nungak siangthou kuamah kham louh amuh a, amat a, akithuahpih amuh uleh;
akithuahpih pasal in nungak pa dangka shekel sawmnga ape ding ahi. Zi in anei ding ahi; ahihminsiat tak ziak in. Huchi in adamsung in akhen thei kei ding hi.
Pasal in apa zi akitenpih ding ahi kei. Apa lupna abuahsak ding ahi kei.
Chiltang kitam ahihkeileh zahmoh atkhiak mi kuapeuh TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding ahi kei.
TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah sawnta atel ding ahi kei. Suan sawm tan in asuante TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding ahi kei hi.
Ammonte leh Moabte TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding uh ahi kei. Suan sawmna tan in alak ua mi TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak a, atel mahmah louh ding uh ahi.
Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawt lai ua tanghou leh tui a, ahon na dawn louh ziak un leh hon hamsiat dia Mesopotamia gam a Pethor a Beor tapa Balaam agoih ziak un.
Himahleh TOUPA na Pathian un Balaam thu angaikhe nuam kei; TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon it ziak in TOUPA na Pathian un huai hamsia nou a ding in vualzawlna asuaksak zaw hi.
Na damsung teng un akhamuanna ding uh leh alohchinna ding uh na ngaihtuahpih ding uh ahi kei.
Edom mite na kih ding uh ahi kei, na unaute uh lah ahi ngal ua. Aigupta mite na kih ding uh ahi kei, agam ua mikhual na hih tak ziak un.
Asuan uh thumna a pan TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding uh ahi.
Na melmate uh dou dia giahphual na sat chiang un thilsiang lou chiteng a pan na kihuikhiak ding uh ahi.
Na lak ua kuapeuh zan chiang a amah a pan chi apawt ziak a thanghuai na om uleh, giahphual a pan apawt dia, giahphual ah alut nawn ding ahi kei.
Himahleh ni ahong kai chiang in, akisil dia; nitum chiang in giahphual ah alut nawn ding ahi.
Giahphual polam ah zun leh ek thakna ding mun na sep ding uh ahi.
Na vanzat lak uah ninluahna na nei ding ua; hichi ahi ding a, na dailen chiang un, huai in lei na khuak ding ua, zun leh ek na thak uh na vuk nawn ding uhi.

TOUPA na Pathian un lah na giahphual uah nou hon humbit ding leh na melmate uh hon pe ding in ahong tel ngal a. Huaiziak in na giahphual uh asiangthou ding ahi. Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua thilsiang lou amu dia, hon paimangsan ding hi.
Na kiang ua sikha, apu hon taikhiaksan na pekik nawn ding uh ahi kei.
Na omna ua adeihpen atel peuhpeuh ah na lak uah a-om sam ding ahi. Amah na nuaisiah ding uh ahi kei.
Israel tanute lak ah kizuak a-om ding ahi kei a, Israel tapate lak ah leng pasal kizuak a-om ding ahi kei.
Kizuakna man hiam, toko man hiam thuchiamna ding in TOUPA na Pathian inn ah na tawi ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
Apung delh in na unau na leitawisak ding ahi kei. Dangka lam a pung hiam, nek ding lam a pung hiam, bangpeuh apung delh a leitawisak louh ding ahi.

Gamdang mite bel apung delh in na leitawisak thei ding uh. Himahleh na unaute apung delh in na leitawisak ding ahi kei. Huchi in na va luah ding uh gam a na khut ngakna tengteng uah TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a thu na chiam un sawt hal lou in na pe pah ding uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian un lah hon phut ngei ding ahi ngal a. Khial in na moh kha ding hi.
Thuchiam lam a na kidek uleh nou a ding in khelhna ahi kei ding.
Na kam ua pawtsa na hih ding uh ahi: Ut thu a thillat na kam ua na chiam uh TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a na chiam bang ua na lat pah ding uh ahi.
Na invengte grephuan a na hoh chiang un na deih zah uh na ne ding ua, himahleh na seng ua na guan louh ding uh ahi.
Na invengte buh ding lai mun a na hoh chiang un avui na khiak thei ding uh. Himahleh na invengte buh ding lai ah kawite na zang ding uh ahi kei hi.
Pasal khat in zi aneih a, amah a siang lou banghiam khat amuh ziak a, amitmuh a lungtunna angah keileh hichi ahi ding a, kimakna lai agelhsak dia, ape dia, a-inn a pan apawtsak ding hi.
A-inn a pan apawt nung in midang ava nei thei ding hi.
Apasal nanungpen in azakdah a, kimakna lai agelhsak a, apiak a, a-inn a pan apawtsak hiam, apasal nanungzaw, zi a neipa si hiam ahihleh;
apasal masa, amah paisakpa'n ahih nitsa ahi a, anei nawn thei kei ding. TOUPA mitmuh in hiai thilkihhuai ahi. TOUPA'N luah dia ahon piak gam ah khelhna na lutsak ding uh ahi kei.
Pasal zi nei tung sepaih in akuan ding ahi kei a, bang nna sem dia phut ding leng ahi kei. A-inn ah kum khat zalen in a-om dia, azi lungnuamtak in a-omsak ding hi.
Buh gawizanna hiam, atunglam suang hiam kichiamna ding in kuamah a pan na lentang ding uh ahi kei; mi hinna lettangsak na hi ngal ua.
Kuapeuh, Israel suan a-unaute lak a mi gu a, sal a zat hiam, zuak hiam theihkhiak ahihleh huai gutapa hihlup ding ahi. Huchibang na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
Phak hipi tungtang thu ah hoihtak a ettel a, siampu, Levite sinsakdan bang zel a hih ding in pilvang un. Amau thu ka piak bang in pilvangtak in na hih ding uh ahi.
Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtna lampi a TOUPA na Pathian un Miriam tung a ahihdan theigige un.
Bangpeuh na invengte uh na leitawi sakleh akhamna la ding in a-inn ah na lut ding ahi kei.
Inn pua ah na dingh dia, leitawisakmi in tua khamna inpua ah ahon tawikhe ding ahi.
Mizawng ahihleh akhamna kem in na giahpih ding ahi kei.

Bang teng hileh ni ahong tum chiang in akichiamna thil akiang ah pekik in. Huchi in apuantual silh in a-ihmu thei dia, nang hon phat thei ding hi. Huai khamna thil pen na Pathian ma ah nang a ding in diktatna ahi ding hi.
Na migoih, mizawng leh tasam na unau hiam, na gam ua na tenna ua om gamdangmi hiam leng hitaleh na simmoh ding uh ahi kei.
Asep ni in aloh na pe ding uh; ni in atumkhum ding ahi kei. Mizawng ahi a, huai ah alungtang akoih hi. Huchi lou in zaw na tungtang uah TOUPA asam dia, nou a ding in khelhna ahi ding hi.
Tate ziak in pate hihlup ding ahi kei a, pate ziak in tapate leng hihlup ding ahi sam kei. Michih amah khelhna ziak a hihlup ding ahi.
Gamdang mite leh pa neiloute dikloutak a na gensak ding ahi kei. Meithai puan leng khamna ding in na laksak ding ahi kei.

Nou leng Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi ngeita ua, TOUPA na Pathian un huai a pan a hon tat na hi uh, chih na theihgige ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ngakna chiteng uah hon vualzawl ding hi.

Na lou ua buh na lak un, buhphal na khop maih uleh na lak nawn ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite a ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut koihna tengteng uh avualzawl ding hi.
Na olive sing uh na sat chiang un ahiangte na sat ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite a ding ahi.
Na grephuan ua na loh chiang un asang na zong ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite a ding ahi.
Aigupta gam ah sikha na hita uh, chih na theigige ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in ahi, hiai thilhih dia thu ka hon piak.
Mi akinak ua, vaihawmna mun a ahoh uleh, vaihawmte'n ana gensak ding ua, midiktat siam atangsak ding ua, migilou moh atangsak ding uhi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, migilou zep tuak mah ahihleh, vaihawmmi in alumsak dia, ama ah azep ding ahi. Agitlouh dungzui a zep ding zah bikhiah ding ahi.
Sawmli vei tan zep theih ahi dia, huai val zaw hilou in. Hiai sang a val azepleh na unaupa uh na zahlaksak lo kha ding uh.
Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk na gak ding uh ahi kei.

Unaute tengkhawm uhenla, tapa nei lou in alak ua khat si taleh, asipa zi in polam a midang akitenpih ding ahi kei. Apasal unaupa in aluah dia, zi in anei dia, apasal unau mohpuakna tung ah ahih ding ahi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, atachil suansak in Israel lak a, amin amanlouhna ding in a-unau sipa min apu ding ahi.

Ama'n a-unaupa zi kitenpih a-ut keileh, kulh kongpi a upate kiang ah a-unaupa zi ahohtou dia, "Ka pasal unaupa'n Israel lak a a-unaupa min omsak zel a-ut kei a, ka pasal unaupa hih ding ka tung ah ahih nuam kei," ava chi ding hi.
Huchi in akho upate un amah asam ding ua, ahoupih ding ua ama'n, "Ka kitenpih nuam kei," chi a apanleh;

a-unaupa zi akiang ah upate ma ah ahong dia, upate ma ava naihtou dia, akhedap asuahsak dia, amai ah achil ase ding hi. "A-unaupa inkuan khotuah nuamloupa tung ah hichibang a hih hi ngeingei hen," achi ding hi.
Huchi in inkuan khedap suahsakpa, chi in Israelte lak ah amin putsak ahi ding hi.
Mikilai uhenla, akhat penpa zi in akilaihpihpa a pan apasal honkhe ding in azahmoh kaihsak taleh;
akhut na tansak ding uh ahi. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei.
Na ip sung uah bukna suang chi tuamtuam, agik leh azang na nei ding uh ahi kei.
Na inn uah tehna chi tuamtuam, alian leh aneu na kem ding uh ahi kei,
Bukna diktak leh hoihtak na nei ding uh ahi. Tehna diktak leh hoihtak na nei ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon gam piak ah na damsawt ding uhi.
Huchibang hihmi, diktat loutak a hih tengteng TOUPA na Pathian un akih hi.
Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtna lampi ua Amalekte'n hon na bawldan uh:
Pathian leng lau lou a, na bah lai uh leh na nguai lai ua lampi a hon kituahpih a, na lak ua ananungpente, na nunglam ua hatloute, na bah lai leh na gim lai ua hon na sualdante uh theigige un.

Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia gam ahon piak chiang in, na kim ua na melma tengteng ua pan TOUPA na Pathian un galmuanna ahon piak chiang in van nuai a Amalekte theihgigena na hihmang sipsip ding uhi. Na mangngilh ding uh ahi kei.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un gouluah dia gam hon piak a na va lut ua, na va ten chiang un;
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na gam leigah tung masapen chiat uh na hon tawi ding ua; bawm ah na koih ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un amin omsakna dia aseh ding ah na hoh ding uhi.
Huchi in siampu kiang ah na hoh ding ua, akiang ah, hon piak dia i pi-le-pute kiang a, achiamna gam ka hong tungta uh, chih tuni in TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah i hihlang uhi, na chi ding uh.
Siampu in na khut ua kipan bawm ala dia, TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam bul ah anga ding hi.
Nou TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, "Ka pu uh Siria mi, mivakvai ahi a, Aigupta gam ah apaisuk a, ava teng a, tawmchik ahi ua; huai ah nam thupitak, thilhihtheitak, tamtak ahong hita uhi.
Aigupta mite'n hon simmoh ua, hon hihgenthei ua, nasep haksa pipi hon semsak uh.
Huchi in TOUPA i pi-le-pute Pathian i sam ua, TOUPA'N i aw uh ana za a, i gentheihdan, i gimdan leh nuaisiah a i omdan amu hi.
TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan khut hattak, ban zak, thil lauhuaitak, chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte in ahon pikhia a;
hiai mun ah hon pilut a, hiai gam, nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ahon pia hi.
Ngai in, TOUPA aw, nang na hon piak leigah masapen chiatte ka hon tawi uhi,” na va chi ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na vual ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh bia in na kun ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na inkuante, noute, Levi mite, na lak ua gamdang mite thil hoih ahon piak tengteng ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.

Kum thum kum, sawm-a-khat piak kum a na thil tung tengteng uh sawm-a-khat na piak khit uleh, Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite'n na omna uah ane ding uh, ahong khosak theih samna ding un.

TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, thu na hon piak tengteng bang in ka inn ua kipan thil siangthoute ka sepkhia ua, Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite ka peta uh. Na thupiak akoi mahmah ka bohse kei ua, ka mangngilh kei uhi.

Ka dah lai un huai ka ne kei ua, ka sian louh lai un ka thehthang sam kei ua, misi tuam a ding in leng ka pe sam kei uhi. TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw ka dawp ua, na hon thupiak tengteng bang in ka hih uhi.
Na omna siangthou van a pan hon en inla, nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, ka pi uh leh pute piak dia na kichiamsa bang in na mi Israelte leh na gam hon piak vualzawl in, na chi ding uh.
"Tuni in TOUPA na Pathian un hiai dan leh vaihawmte zui ding in thu ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua pom in na zui ding uh ahi.
Tuni in TOUPA lampite zui a, adante, athupiakte leh avaihawmte zui a, a-aw dawp tum in na Pathian ding un na telta uh.
Thu ahon chiamsa bang in leh athupiak tengteng na zuihna ding un TOUPA'N tuni in amah a tuambik hi ding in noute ahon na telta hi.
Ana gensa bang a TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia a misiangthou na hihtheihna ding un leh nam a bawl tengteng tung a phat, minhoih leh pahtawi a na omtheihna ding un,” achi hi.
Huan Mosi leh Israel upate'n Huniadania ka hon piak thupiak tengteng zui un.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon gam piak a lut dia Jordan na kan ni chiang un hichi ahi ding a, suang liantakte na phut ding ua, suang lou na nuh ding uh ahi.

Na galkah khit chiang un atung uah hiai dan thu tengteng na gelh ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon na chiamsa bang in nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam ah na pai thei ding uhi.
Jordan lui na galkah khit chiang un hichi ahi ding a, tuni a ka hon thupiak bang in Ebal tang ah suangte na phut ding ua, suang lou na nuh ding uh ahi.
Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in maitam, suang maitam na bawl ding uh ahi. Vanzat ding in sik na zang ding uh ahi kei,
TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam suang sek louh in na bawl ding uh ahi. Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in halmang thillatte na lan ding uhi.
Kilepna thillatte in na kithoih ding ua, huai ah na ne ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding uh ahi.
Suangte ah hiai dan thu tengteng teltak in na gelh ding uh ahi," chi in.
Mosi leh siampu Levite'n Israel mi tengteng ahoupih ua, Israel mite aw, hoihtak in ngaikhia un. Tuni in TOUPA na Pathian uh mite na hong hita uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh thu na zuih ding uh ahi. Tuni a ka hon thupiakte leh adante na zuih ding uh ahi, achi uhi.
Huai ni mah in Mosi in mipite thu apia a,
"Jordan lui gal na kah khit chiang un mipite vualzawl ding in Gerizim tang a hiaite adin ding uh ahi: Simeon nam, Levi nam, Judah nam, Issakar nam, Joseph nam leh Benjamin nam.
Hamsiat ding in hiaite Ebal tang a adin ding uh ahi: Reuben nam, Gad nam, Asher nam, Zebulun nam, Dan nam leh Naphtali nam," achi hi.
Levite'n ahon gen pan ua, Israel mi tengteng kiang ah aw ngaihtak in,
"Khutsiamte khutsuak TOUPA a dia kihhuai milim tunkhiak tawm hiam, gukkep peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen,” chi in ana dawng ding uhi.
"Anu hiam, apa hiam zahtak lou peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!” ana chi ding uh.
"A-invengte gamgi suanmi hamsethuak in om hen,” achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
"Lampi a pan mittaw lampi lou a paisakmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
"Gamdangmi, pa nei lou leh meithai vai dikloutak a hawmsakmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
"Apa zi kithuahpihmi ham-sethuak in om hen," apa nik lem ahih ziak in, achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
"Bang gan peuhpeuh kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
"Asanggamnu, apa tanu hiam, anu tanu hiam, kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
"Asungnu kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
"A-invengte gukthahmi ham-sethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
"Poi khoih lou thahna ding a golhna lami hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
"Hiai dan thute zui ding a pomkip lou mi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!” achi ding uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian aw hoihtak a na ngaihkhiak ua, tuni a thu ka hon piak, thupiak tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih uleh, TOUPA na Pathian un leitung nam tengteng a tungnungpen in ahon bawl ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh thu na zuih peuhmah uleh hiai vualzawlna tengteng na tung uah ahong tung dia, ahon zui ding uhi.
Inn lam leh gam lam ah vualzawl in na om ding uh.
Na gil ua gah, na lei ua gah, na ganhon, na bawngpi leh na belamhon uh vualzawl in a-om ding.
Na bawm uh leh na tanghou mekna kuangte uh vualzawl in a-om ding.
Vakkhete vualzawl in na om ding ua, inn a hong lutte leng vualzawl in na om ding uh.
Na melma nou hon doute TOUPA'N ahon zohsak dia; nou hon dou ding in lampi khat ah ahong kuan ding ua, lampi sagih ah ataikek ding uh.
TOUPA'N na buh inn tung uah, na khut koihna tengteng uah vualzawlna thu ape dia; TOUPA na Pathian un ahon gam piak ah ahon vualzawl ding hi.
Na kiang ua ana kichiam bang in TOUPA'n amah a ding in nam siangthou ding in ahon hihkip ding, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zuih ua, alampite na zuih phot uleh.
Huchi in leitung a mite'n TOUPA min a sap na hi uh, chih athei ding ua, hon lau ding uhi.
Nou piak dia na pi-le-pute uh TOUPA'N ana chiam gam ah na gil ua gah, na ganhon gah leh na leigah uh TOUPA'N nakpitak in apungsak ding.

TOUPA'N ahun geihgeih in na gam uh vak ding, vuahtui hon pe ding leh na khut koihna tengteng uh hon vualzawl ding in, avan goubawm hoih akihongsak ding hi. Huchi in nam tampi na leitawisak ding ua, nou bel na leitawi kei ding uhi.
TOUPA'N amei hilou in, alu in hon bawl dia, anuainung hilou in, atungnung na hi ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak, tuni a ka hon piak ngaikhia a, pilvangtak a na zuih uleh.
Tuni a ka hon thupiak mah bang a taklam hiam, veilam hiam a pathian dangte zui leh nasem dia na pialsan kei peuhmah uleh.

Himahleh hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh aw hoihtak a na ngaihkhiak louh ua, tuni a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih kei uleh, na tung uah hiai hamsia tengteng ahong tung dia, ahon pha nawn ding uhi.
Inn lam leh gam lam ah hamsia na thuak ding uh.
Na bawm uh leh na tanghou mekna kuang uh hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
Na gilgahte, na leigahte leh na bawngpi uh leh na belamhon gahte hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
Na pawtkhete uh hamsethuak in a-om ding ua, ahong lutte leng hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
TOUPA'N na tung uah, na khut koihna tengteng uah hamsia, buaina leh salhna ahon sawl dia, na vuallel ding ua, na mangthang pah ding uh; na thilhih giloute ua kei na hon paisan ziak un.
Luah dia na lutna gam ua kipan ahon hihmanthat masiah TOUPA'N na lak uah hipi alengsak gige ding hi.
TOUPA'N kumzawnna, khosik, bawkna, sat huthutna, namsau, keuna leh muatna in hon gawt dia, na manthat vek masiah uh hiaite'n hon delh ding uhi.
Na lutung ua van dal ahi dia, na nuai ua lei sik ahi ding.
TOUPA'N na gam vuah uh leivui leh vut asuaksak ding a; na manthat masiah uh van a pan na tung uah ahong ke ding hi.
TOUPA'N na melmate uh lak ah hon hihniam dia; amaute dou ding in lampi khat ah na kuankhe ding ua, lampi sagih ah na taikek ding uh. Leitung a lalgamte lak ah paihkhiak in na om ding uhi.
Na luang uh tungleng vasa tengteng leh gamsa tengteng nek ding an ahi dia, mi kuamah in amaute adelhmang kei ding uh.
Hihdam theih louh Aigupta meimatum, chithak, bawkna leh vunthak in TOUPA'N ahon gawt ding hi.
Haina, mittawtna leh lunglelhna in TOUPA'N ahon gawt ding.

Mittaw in khomial amaimai bang in, sun khovak nangawn ah na maimai ding ua, na khosakna uah na lamzang kei ding uh. Nuaisiah ding leh gallak ding phet na hi ding ua, hon hunkhe ding kuamah a-om kei ding uhi.
Zi na kham ding ua, midang in akithuahpih ding uh. Inn na lam ding ua, na luah kei ding uh. Grephuan na bawl ding ua, agah na ne kei ding uh.

Na mitmuh un na bawngtal uh hon gohsak ding ua, asa na ne kei ding uh. Na mitmuh un na sabiltung uh thagum a suhsak na hi ding ua, piakkik na hi kei ding uh. Na belam uh na melmate uh piak ahi ding; hon hunkhe ding kuamah na nei kei ding uh.
Na tanute uh leh na tapate uh namdangte piak ahi ding ua, nitum in amaute ngai in na en vungvung ding ua, na etetna lam un na mitte uh avai ding; bangmah lah hihtheih na nei kei ding uhi.
Na leigah, na sepkhiak teng uh na theih louh uh nam in ane khin dia, hihgentheih leh hihsiat in na om gige ding uh.
Huchi in hiai thil mu in na hailoh ding uhi.
TOUPA'N na khuk uah, na khe uah, hihdam theih louh meimatum ahon veisak ding, na khepek ua kipan na lusip tanpha un.
Nou leh na kumpipa uh nangawn in na pi-le-pute'n atheih ngei louh uh nam kiang ah TOUPA'N ahon pi dia; huai ah pathian dangte, sing leh suang pathiante nna na sem ding uh.
TOUPA'N hon pimangna ding nam tengteng lak ah lamdang chih leh paunak leh aselam a gentehna na hong hi ding uhi.
Lou ah buhchi tampi na kuankhiakpih ding ua, tawmchik kia na la ding uh, khaupe in anegai vek ding hi.
Grephuan na bawl ding ua, na kem ding ua, himahleh a-uain na dawn kei ding uh. Grep lah na lou kei ding uh, lung in anegai ding hi.
Na gam tengteng uah olive sing na suan ding ua, himahleh athau na nilh kei ding uh, na olive gahte uh apulh khin ding hi.
Tanu tapa na suang ding ua, himahleh sal a kaihmang a, a-om ding ziak un na ompih kha kei ding uh.
Na theikung tengteng uh leh na leigah tengteng uh khaupe an ahi ding.
Gamdangmi na lak ua tengte na tung uah asang hiaihiai ding ua, nou na niam giaigiai ding uh.
Ahon leitawisak ding ua, nou zaw na leitawisak kei ding uh. Amau alu ahi ding ua, nou amei na hi ding uh.
Hiai hamsia tengteng na tung uah ahong tung dia, ahon delh dia, ahon pha dia; hihmanthat a na om masiah uh; athupiak leh adan hon piak zui dia TOUPA na Pathian aw na ngaihsak louh ziak un.
Na tung uah leh na suante uh tung ah tangtawn a dia chiamtehna leh lamdang chih ding in a-om ding uhi.
Thil bangkim a na hong kiningchin ua leng TOUPA na Pathian uh lungsim kipaktak leh nuamsatak a na sepsak louh ziak un.

Huaiziak in noute hon dou dia TOUPA'N ahon sawl ding na melmate uh gilkial, dangtak leh vuaktang leh thil bangkim tasam kawm in na sepsak ding uh. Ahon hihsiat masiah uh na ngawng uah sik hakkol ahon batsak ding uhi.
Gamlapi a pan, kawlmong a pan nou hon dou ding nam, TOUPA'N muvanlai ngumkiak bang in ahon sawl ding; apau uh na theih louh uh nam;
nam lauhuai melpu, upa leng khawk sa lou leh tuailaite leng deihsak tuam lou.
Na ganhon pungte leh na leigah, na manthat masiah uh ane ding ua, buh, uain, thau, na bawnghon leh na belamhonte uh ahawi kei ding uh, na tung ua manna ahon tunsak tan in.

Na gam tengteng ua na muanpen uh, na kulhsangte uh achip tan in na kulh kongpi tengteng uah ahon um ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon piak na gam tengteng ua na kulh kongpi tengteng uh ahong um ding uhi.
Na melmate'n hon umbichilh ziak un leh ahon hihmangbatna uah na gil ua gah, TOUPA'N ahon piak na tanu, na tapate sa na ne ding uhi.
Na lak ua minunnem leh chingkam nangawn in leng a-unaupa, ahihkeileh azi it, a-ompih lai atate ngialtak leng a-it kei ding hi.
Bangmah aneih nawn louh ziak in atate uh sa anek ding kuamah ape kei ding hi. Ahon umna uh leh ahon khelhchipna uah, na melmate'n na kulh kongpi ua ahon khelhchip ziak un.
Na lak ua numei chinou leh chingek, achinouna leh achingekna ziak a lei leng sik nuam lou in apasal deih mahmah uh, atapate, atanute;
apom lai atasen leh ata piang lai dingte leng a-en moh ding uh. Bangkim ataksap khit ziak in asimnek ding; na melmate'n na kulh kongpi ua ahon lungkiaksak ziak un.
TOUPA na Pathian uh min thupitak leh lauhuaitak na lauhtheihna ding ua, hiai laibu a tuang thu tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih kei uleh;
TOUPA'N noute leh na suante uh tung ah hipi lamdangtak, hipi leng gige, damlouhna haksatak leng gige chi a lengsak ding hi.
Na lauh mahmah uh Aigupta gam hiite na tung uah alengsak nawn dia, hon lenkip ding uhi.
Hiai dan laibu a tuanglou, damlouhna hii chiteng leng na manthat masiah uh TOUPA'N na tung uah alengsak ding hi.
Van a aksi zah hita noute tawmchik kia na hong hita ding uh; TOUPA na Pathian aw na man louh ziak un.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, hon hihhoih ding leh hon pungsak dia TOUPA na tung ua akipah bang in, hon hihmang ding leh bangmah lou hon suah ding in TOUPA na tung uah akipak dia, na va luah ding uh na lutna gam ua kipan suanmang na hi ding uhi.
TOUPA'N kawlmong a pan kawlmong langkhat tan in chi chih lak ah hon hihdalh dia, huai ah sing leh suang, na pi uh leh pute uh tan a na theih ngei louh uh pathian dangte nna na sem ding uhi.
Hiai namte lak ah tawldamna na mu kei ding ua, na khe uh a ding in khawlna a-om kei dia; huai ah, TOUPA'N lungtang ling, mit gim leh lungsim ngui hon pe zaw ding hi.
Na hinna uh lauthawng gige in a-om dia, sun leh zan in lau gige in na om ding ua, na hinna un kitheihchetna anei kei ding hi.
Zingsang in, "Nitak hita maileh aw!" na chi ding ua, nitak in, "Zingsang hita maileh aw!" na chi ding uh, "Thil lauhuai na lungtang un alauh ding ziak leh na mit ua na thil muh ding uh ziak in.

Na mu nawn kei ding uh, na kiang ua ka chih lampi ah long in Aigupta gam ah TOUPA'N ahon pi nawn ding. Huai ah na melmate uh sikhapa ding leh sikhanu dia zuak na hi ding ua, kuamah in ahon lei kei ding uh," achi hi.
Horeb tang a akiang ua thu akhun sim louh, TOUPA'N Moab gam a Israel suante kiang a Mosi thu akhunsak, athukhun thu hiaite ahi.
Mosi in Israel mi tengteng asam a, akiang uah, Aigupta gam a Pharaoh, asikha tengteng leh agam tengteng tung a na mitmuh ngei ua TOUPA'N thil ahih tengteng na mu uhi.
Khemna thupi mahmahte, chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na mit mahmah ua na muh uh.
Himahleh TOUPA'N tuni tan in theisiam ding lungtang, mu thei ding mitte, za thei ding bilte ahon pe nai kei hi.
Gamdai ah kum sawmli ka hon pi a; na puansilhte uh na silhtul kei ua, na khedapte uh leng na buntul kei lai uhi.
Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na theihna ding un tanghou na ne kei ua, uain hiam zu khauh hiam leng na dawn kei uhi.
Hiai mun na hong tun un Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og hon dou ding in ahong kuan ua, amau i na zou uh.
Agam uh i la ua, Reubente, Gadte, Manasseh nam kimkhatte luah ding in i pia uhi.
Na thilhih tengteng ua na lamzan zel theihna ding un hiai thukhun thute pom unla, zui un.
Tuni in na vek un, na nam lupente uh, na upate uh, na heutute uh leh Israel mi tengteng, TOUPA na Pathian ma ah na dingh ua;
na taneute uh, na zite uh, na tenna ua gamdangmi na ompih uh, na singphukmi uh leh na tui tawi mite uh nangawn in;
TOUPA na Pathian uh kichiamna leh athukhun tuni a nou toh abawl a na luttheihna ding un:
Na pipute uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a ana kichiam bang leh na kiang ua ana gensa bang a amite hi ding a tuni a hon hihkip theihna ding leh na Pathian uh ahihtheihna ding in;
hiai kichiamna leh thukhun na kiang kia ua khung ka hi kei;
tuni a TOUPA i Pathian uh ma a dinghte leh tua i kiang ua omloute kiang ah leng ahi.
Aigupta ota gam a i omdan, namdangte pal paisuak a i paidan bang uh na thei ua;
alak ua athilkihhuaite uleh amilimte uh, sing leh suang, dangka chi leh dangka-eng leng na mu uh.

Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua pasal hiam, numei hiam, inkuan hiam, nam hiam, huai pathiante be ding in alungtang un tu in TOUPA i Pathian uh kiheisan in, na lak uah thil kha leh gamsai selkhiakna bulte na hong om kha ding uh.
Huchi ahihleh zaw, hiai hamsia thu samte azaktak in, amah kivualzawl tawm in, "Paupeng in pai teitei leng le ka bit na ding," chi in akingaihtuah kha ding.
TOUPA'N angaidam het kei dia, TOUPA hehna leh amullitna in huai mi akhuh dia, hiai laibu a hamse tuang tengteng atung ah atung dia, TOUPA'N van nuai a pan amin athaimang zaw ding hi.
Hiai Dan Bu a tuang hamsia thukhun tengteng bang in Israel nam tengteng lak a pan hihtuam in thil hoih lou lam ah TOUPA'N akhenkhe ding hi.
Khangthak hong om ding, na nung ua na tate uh hong om ding leh gam gamlapi a pan a hong pai dingte'n, huai gam a hipi leh TOUPA'N natna aveisakte amu ding uhi.

Agam pumpi mei katsiat leh chi leh kat a dim, haichi lah kipawi lou, bangmah pou lou, sing leh lou bangmah om lou ahi ding. TOUPA heh leh thangpaihna Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah leh Zeboim alumlet lai a siatna bangmah ahi ding.
"Nam teng in bangziak in ahia hiai gam hichi tel a TOUPA'N abawl? Hiai thangpaihna thupi bangchidan ahia?" achi ding uh.
Mite'n, "Aigupta gam a pan apikhiak lai a TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian thukhun amau toh akhun amangngilh ziak un.
pathian dangte, atheih ngei louh uh pathiante, ama'n asehsak louhte nna sem a, abiak ziak un.
Hiai laibu a tuang hamsia tengteng tungsak ding in hiai gam tung ah TOUPA aheh hi.
Thangpai, heh leh thangpai mahmah in agam ua kipan abotkhe vek a, gamdang ah asawnlut hi, tua a-omdan bang uh," achi ding uhi.
Thil kiselte TOUPA i Pathian a ahi, thil kiphoulakte bel hiai dan thu tengteng i zuihtheihna dia eite leh i suante a ahi gige ding ahi.
Huai khit in i kihei ua, Bashan lampi ah i paitou uhi. Bashan kumpipa Og leh ami tengteng Edrei ah ei dou ding in ahong kuan uhi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Amah lau ke'n, amah leh ami tengteng leh agam na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon tung a na hih bang in amah tung ah na hih ding," achi hi.
TOUPA i Pathian in Bashan kumpipa Og leng, ami tengteng toh i khut ah hon pia hi. Huchi in khat lel leng hawi lou in i that vek uhi.
Huai lai in akhua tengteng kho sawmguk, Argob gambup a Bashan kumpipa Og gam tengteng i la vek ua, i laksak louh khua khat lel leng a-om kei hi.
Hiai khua tengteng kulh sang pipi, kongpi leh kalhna nei chiat ahi a, kulh nei lou khua tampi sim louh in leng.
Heshbon kumpipa Sihon tung a i hih bang in khua a pasal tengteng, numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh tan in i hihmang sipsip uhi.
Himahleh ganta tengteng leh khua a gallak a i lak thilte ei a tuam ding in i la uhi.
Huai lai in Jordan gal a om Amorte kumpipa nihte a pan Arnon Phaizang a pan Hermon tang pha in gam i la uhi.
Sidonte'n Hermon tuh Sirion achi ua, Amorte'n ahihleh Senir achi uhi.
Phaigam a khua tengteng leh Gilead gam tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng toh, Bashan gam a Og gam a khuate, Salekah leh Endrei tan in i la uhi.

Milian sibangte lak a khosuaksun Bashan kumpipa Og kia ahi a, ngai dih, alupna sik ahi a; Ammon suante khua Rabbah ah tutan in a-om ahi kei maw? Huai lupna mihing tong a teh in adunglam tong kua, availam tong li ahi.
Huai tung in huai gam i luah ua; Arnon Phaizang kiang Aroer a pan Gilead tanggam kimkhat tan in, khua omte toh Reubente leh Gadte ka pia hi.
Gilead gam om lai teng leh Og gam Bashan tengteng Manasseh nam kimkhatte ka pia hi, Argob gam tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng Rephaimte gam chih in a-om hi.
Manasseh tapa Jair in Argob gam tengteng Geshurte leh Maakathte gam tan in ala a, Bashan pen, ama min tam in Havothjair asa a, tuni tan in achi lai uh.
Gilead kiang ah Makir ka pia hi.
Reubente leh Gadte bel Gilead a pan Arnon Phaizang, phaizang laitak tan in agam ding un ka pia a; Ammon suante gamgi, Jabok lui tan in.
Atumlam gamgi Arabah a Jordan lui, Kinereth a pan Arabah Tuipi tan, Pisgah mual pang ken nuai apai ahi. Arabah Tuipi, Chi Tuipi ahi.
Huai lai in, TOUPA na Pathian un, "Hiai gam nou a tuam ding in ahon pia hi. Israelte, na unaute uh ma ah na mihangsan tengteng uh kigalthuam in va hohtou sam uhen.
Himahleh, na zite uh leh na taneu chikchikte uh leh na gante uh, ganta na hau uh chih ka thei, na khua uah, ka hon piaksa ah ana om ding uhi.

Nou bang a na unaute uh TOUPA'N galmuang a abawl ma leh TOUPA na Pathian un Jordan gal a gam apiak aluah sam matan uh; huchi in nou a tuam ding ua ka hon piak ah na hong pai nawn ding uh, chi in thu ka hon pia hi.
Huai lai mah in Joshua bel, TOUPA na Pathian un huai kumpipa nihte tung athilhih tengteng na mit in amu vek a; huchi mah bang in na lutna ding gam tengteng tung ah TOUPA'N ahih ding hi.
Amaute lau ke'n; hon doupihpa TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in thu ka pia hi.
"Huai lai mah in TOUPA ka ngen a,
Toupa PATHIAN aw, na sikha kiang ah na thupidan leh na khut hattak na langsak ahi peuhmah ngei hi. Van ah hiam, lei ah hiam na thilhih bang leh na thilhih thupitak bang hihthei pathian kua a-om a?
Hon galkahsak inla, Jordan gal a gam hoihtak, huai tang kilawmtak leh Lebanon hon musak in," ka chi hi.
Himahleh noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, ka thu angaikhe kei a; huchi in TOUPA'N, "Hunta hen, hiai thu ah hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi hi.
"Pisgah tang vum ah va paitou inla, tumlam, mallam, simlam leh suahlam na mit in en inla, en vialvial in. Jordan kan lou ding na hi.
Himahleh Joshua thu pia inla, hanthawn inla, hatsak in. Hiai mipite api galkai dia, na va muhtouh ding gam aluah ding uhi," ahon chi hi.
Huchi in Beth-peor kiangchin a phaizang ah i omta uhi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai thil tengteng na ma ua ka omsak, vualzawlna leh hamsiate na tung ua ahong tun a, TOUPA'N hon delhzakna nam tengteng lak a na theihkhiak nawn ua,
TOUPA na Pathian lam na ngat nawn ua, tua thu ka hon piak bang a nou leh na tate uh toh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua a-aw na zuih hun chiang un.
TOUPA na Pathian un na sal hihna uh ahihmang dia, ahon hehpih dia, TOUPA na Pathian un nam chih lak a hon dalhsakna a pan hon pikhawm nawn ding hi.
Na lak ua mi van nuai tawp pha a delhkhiak a-om uleh, TOUPA na Pathian un huai a pan hon pikhawm dia, huai a pan hon pikhe ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute un aluah gam ah hon pilut nawn dia, na luah ding uh. Ama'n hon lamzangsak dia, na pi-le-pute uh khup in hon pungsak ding hi.
Na hintheihna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua na it theihna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian un na lungtang uh leh na suante lungtang hon sumsak ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un hiai hamsia tengteng hon simmohte, na melmate uh leh hon hote túng ah atungsak ding hi.
Na hong kihei nawn ding ua, ToUPA aw na zui ding uà, tuni a thu ka hon piak, athupiak tengteng na zui ding uhi.

TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ngakna tengteng uah, na gil ua gah ah, na ganhon gah uah leh na gam gah uah hoih atungsak dia, na pi-le-pute uh tung a akipah bang in na tung uah TOUPA akipak nawn ding hi.
Hiai Dan Bu a tuang athupiakte, adante zui dia TOUPA aw na zuih ua, na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh lam na ngat phot uleh.
Hiai thupiak, tua ka hon piak nou a ding in ahaksa lo kei a, gamlat leng hon gamlat kei hi.
I zak ua i zuihtheihna ding in, "Kua ahia van a hon kahsak a, hon laksak ding?" chih ding in van a om ahi kei hi.
I zak ua i zuihtheihna ding in tuipi gal ah, "Kua'n ahia hon va hohsak dia, hon laksak ding?" chih ding in tuipi gal a om leng ahi sam kei.
Na zuihtheihna ding un thu in ahon naih mahmah a, na kam uh leh na lungtang uah a-om hi.
"Tu in na ma uah hinna leh hoih, sihna leh hoih lou ka koih hi.

TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding, alampi zui ding, athupiak, adan, avaihawm, zui dia tua ka hon thupiak na zuih uleh na hing ding ua, na hong pung ding ua, na va luah ding uh gam ah TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl ding hi.
Himahleh na lungtang uh akiheimang a, na ngaihkhiak kei ua, pimang a na om ua, pathian dangte na biak ua, a-nna uh na sep uleh;
na mangthang ngeingei ding uh, chih tu in ka hon hilh ahi. Jordan lui kan a, luah ding a na va lutna gam uah na damsawt kei ding uhi.
Na ma uah hinna leh sihna, vualzawlna leh hamsia ka koih chih tu a hon theihpih ding in lei leh van ka sam ahi. Huchi in hinna tel un, na hinna ding un nou leh na suante uh toh.

TOUPA na Pathian uh it in, a-aw zui in, amah len tinten un, amah na hinna uh, na damsawtna uh lah ahi ngal a. Huchi in na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a piak gam ah na teng ding uhi," achi hi.
Huan Mosi in, Israel mite teng kiang ah hiai thu agen hi.
“Tu in kum za-le-sawmnih ka hita a; ka vialvak zou nawn kei. TOUPA'N 'Hiai Jordan lui na kan kei ding,' ahon chi hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na ma uh api dia, hiai namte ahon hihsiatsak dia, agam uh na luah ding uh. TOUPA'N ana gensa bang in Joshua in na ma uh api ding hi.
TOUPA'N Amorte kumpipa, Sihon leh Og leh agam tung ua ahih bang in atung uah ahih dia; amaute ahihse ding hi.
TOUPA'N amaute ahon pe dia, thu ka hon piak thupiak tengteng atung uah na hih ding uhi.
Kuhkaltak leh hangsantak in om un. Lau kei unla, kihta sam kei un. Na kiang ua hon pepa TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi ngal a. Ahon vuallelsak kei dia, pai leng hon paisan kei hial ding," achi hi.

Mosi in Joshua asam a, Israel mi tengteng mitmuh in akiang ah, "Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Hiai mite toh akiang ua api-le-pute uh TOUPA'N kichiam a piak ana chiamsa gam ah na lut ngeingei ding ua, amaute na luahsak ding ahi.
Na ma uh pipa TOUPA ahi dia, na kiang ah a-om zel dia, ahon vuallelsak kei dia, pai leng hon paisan kei hial ding hi. Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n," achi hi.
Mosi in dan agelh a, TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng Levi tapa siampute leh Israel upate tengteng apia hi.
Mosi in, amau thu apia a, "Kum sagih kum, ngaihdam kum teng a Biakbuk Ankuangluina,
mun aseh dia Israel mi tengteng TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a hong kilat chiang un, hiai dan Israel tengteng zak in na sim ding uh ahi.

Mipite, numei leh pasal, na taneu chikchikte uh, na ompih uh gamdang mite, amau angaihkhiak ua, akisin ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan asiam ua, hiai dan thu tengteng pilvangtak a azuihtheihna ding uh leh
atate uh athei nailoute'n leng azak ua, Jordan lui kan a na va luah ding uh gam a na ten sung teng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siam akisintheihna ding un samkhawm in," achi hi.
