TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sih hun ahong naita; Joshua sam inla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah va kihil in, amau thu ka pe ding hi,” achi hi. Huchi in Mosi leh Joshua ahoh ua, kihoupihna biakbuk ah ava kihil uhi.
TOUPA puanin ah meipi ding in akilak a; meipi ding puanın kongpl lutung ah adingh hi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na pi-le-pute kiang ah na ihmu ding hi. Hiai mite athou ding ua, ava tenna dingte uh lak ah huai gam pathiante lak ah ang a kawm ding ua, ahon lehngatsan ding ua, ka thukhun akiang ua ka khun abohse ding uh.

Huchi in huai ni in atung uah ka heh dia, ka lehngatsan dia, ka kibuk mangsan dia, hihsiat in a-om ding uh. Thil hoih lou leh mangbatna tampi atung uah atung ding hi. Huchi in huai ni in, i Pathian uh i lak ua a-om louh ziak in hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua hong tung ahi kei maw? achi ding uh.
Pathian dangte lam nga a thil hoih lou ahih ding tengteng uh ziak in huai.ni in ka kibuksan ngeingei ding hi.
Huaiziak in tu in 'hiai la gelh inla, Israel suante sinsak inla, akam uah koih in. Hiai la Israel suante kalhna a kei a dia theihpihtu ahihtheihna ding in.

Api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam, nawitui leh khuaizu luang gam ah ka pi a, ne leh ta in a-om ua,.atai ua, ahong thau hial chiang un.pathian dangte lam anga ding ua, a-nna uh asem ding ua, kei hon hehsak ding ua, ka thukhun abohse ding uh'.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, thil hoih lou leh mangbatna tampi atung ua ahong tun chiang in, hiai la akhelhna uh theihpihtu ahi ding. Asuante kam a pan mangngilh theih ahi kei ding hi. Tu in ka kichiam gam a ka pilut ma him in leng alunggel uh akawidan ka thei hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in, huai la, huai ni mahmah in agelh a, Israel suante asinsak hi.
Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah hiai thupiak apia hi. "Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Israel suante kiang a ka kichiam bang in huai gam ah na pilut ding hi. Na kiang ah ka om ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in hiai dan thute laibu agelh khit a mansa ahih vek nung in,
TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng Levite Mosi in thu apia hi.
"Hiai Dan Bu la unla, noute kalh a theihpihtu hi ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun bawm sik ah koih un.
Na helhatdan uh leh na paupendan uh ka thei hi. Ngai un, tua ka hon dampih lai a bawn TOUPA tung a hel na hi ua; ka sih nung ngial in houh bangchi phet in anasazaw diam aw?
"Abil ua zak a hiai thu ka gen a, noute kalh a theihpihtu dia lei leh van ka saptheihna ding in na nam ua intekpen tengteng leh na heutute uh hon samkhawm un.

Ka sih nung in nakpitak in na kihihse ding ua, ka hon thupiak lampi a pan na pial ding uh chih ka thei kilkel hi. Atawp chiang ngial in houh thil hoih lou in hon buakkhum dia; na khut thilhih ua hihheh ding in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih ding ziak un," achi hi.
Mosi in, Israel kikhawmkhawm tengteng zak in hiai la thu abul a pan atawp pha in agen vek hi.
Bil na doh un, vante aw, ka gen ding hi. Lei aw, ka kam a thu za in.

Amah suangpi ahi, Athilhih adik kim sipsip hi. A-omdan tengteng dan ahi. Pathian muanhuai, thulimlouhna nei lou, diktat leh hoih ahi.
Amau leh amau akihihsia ua, atate ahi kei uh, gensiat alohna uh ahi, suan gina lou leh genhak ahi uhi.
Mihai leh pilloute aw, huchi in maw, TOUPA na thuk ding uh? Nou hon suang, na pa uh ahi kei maw? Ahon bawl a, ahon dingkipsak hi.
Nidanglai nite theigige inla, suan tampi kumte ngaihtuah dih. Na pa dong in, ahon kawkmuh ding, na upate'n leng ahon hilh ding uhi.
Tungnungpen in namte gam apiak lai a, mihing tate akhen lai in namte gamgi Israel suante zah in akhung hi.

Muvanlai in abu a anou tokthou a, anou tung ah kha azap a, akhate azak a, atuah a, akha a apuak bang in;
Gamdang pathian hilou in TOUPA kia in api zel hi.
Lei mun sangte ah atuangsak a, lou a thil tung ane zel a; suangpi a pan khuaizu akikhohkhesak zel a, suang tak a pan thau toh;
Ganhon a pan nawitui khal, belamhon a pan nawitui, belamnou thau toh, Bashan uain na dawn ding.

Nang hon suang Suangpi па ngaisang kei, nang hon bawlpa Pathian na mangngilh lai hi.
Huai TOUPA'N amu a, amudah a, atanu leh tapate'n ahihheh ziak un.
Ka bukmang san dia, atawpna uh bang ahi dia chih ka en ding, achi hi. Suan thulim lou ginna nei lou tate ahi uhi.
Pathian hilou thil in ka mullitna atokthou ua; athil gina lou un ahon hehsak uh; chi a genlouhte ka mullitsak dia, nam haite in ka hehsak ding hi.
Ka hehna akuang a, gawtmun nuainungpen tan in akang a, lei leh athilpung akang ding, tangte kingaknate mei in akang ding hi.
Atung uah siatna ka chiangkhawm dia, atung uah thal ka khah ding.
Gilkial in agongthak ding ua, meisa leh siatna in akangmang ding ua, atung uah gamsa hate ka sawl dia, leivui agulte gu toh.
Nungak, tangval, nawi ne lai, lu a kelsam poute tanpha in polam ah namsau in asi ding ua, sunglam ah launa in.
Ke'n, ka delhzak vek ding, mihing lak a amau theihgigena ka hihmang vek ding.
Melma thangpaihna lau lou hi leng, amelmate un theikhial in, i khut uh tawisang in a-omta, huai teng TOUPA hih ahi kei, achi kha ding uhi, ka chi hi.
Pilna nei lou namte ahi ua, amau ah theihsiamna a-om kei.
Aw, pil le uh hiaite atheisiam ding ua, atunung thu uh ngaihtuah ding hi ve un!
Bangchi in khat in sang adelh dia, nih in sing ataikeksak ding ua, a Suangpi un amaute akhawng khinta hi, TOUPA'N amaute apiakkhiak kei ngalleh?
Asuangpi uh lah i melmate mahmah theihdan in leng i Suangpi bang ahi kei hi.
Agrepgui uh Sodom grepgui ahi a, aloute uh Gomorrah loute ahi. Agrepte uh sinkha grepte ahi uh, agahbomte akha hi.
A-uainte uh dragon gu leh gulgial gu khatak ahi.
Hiai ka kholkhawm, ka goubawm a bilh bikbek ahi kei maw?
Phulak leh thuk zaw kei hih ding ahi, asiksan uh ateu hun chiang in; asiatna ni uh ahong naita, atung ua thil hong tung dingte ahong tungpahta ding hi.
TOUPA'N amite avaihawm ding, asikhate leng alainat ding, athilhihtheihna uh abei chih leh kuamah sikha leh noplen a-om kei, chih amuh chiang in.
Ama'n apathiante uh koi ah, amuan suangpi uh koi ah;
akithoihna thau netute, adawn thillat uain dawntute? Hong thou in nou hong panpih uhenla, nou hon humbittute hi le uh ake, achi ding.
Kei, kei mahmah ka hihthei unla, pathian dang a-om kei. Ka that a, ka hingsak a, ka liamsak a, ka damsak hi. Ka khut a pan noute hon hunkhe thei kuamah a-om kei uhi.
Van lam ah ka khut ka zak a, keimah ka hin bang in ka kichiam hi.
Ka namsau tat-hiam a, ka khut a vaihawmna ka letleh ka melmate tung ah phu ka la dia, kei hon hote ka thuk ding hi.
Ka thaltangte asisan uah ka diah dia, ka namsau in sa teng ka that bei dia; thahte leh salte sisan toh melmate tung a phulakna a kipan, achi ding hi.
Aw, nou nam chihte aw, amite toh kipak un; asikhate sisan phuba ala ding hi. Amah doute tung ah phu ala ding, agam leh amite a ding in kilemna bukim abawl ding.
Huchi in mipite zak in Mosi leh Nun tapa, Joshua in hiai la thu tengteng agen uhi.
"Mosi in huai thu tengteng Israel mi tengteng kiang a agen khit in, akiang uah;
Tua na kiang ua ka hon thu theihsak ah na lungtang uh koihkip unla, hiai dan tengteng pilvang mahmah a zui ding in na tate uh thu pia un.
Nou a ding in thil bangmah lou lel ahi kei a, na hinna uh ahi ngal a. Hiai thilhih in luah dia Jordan na va galkahna gam uah na damsawt ding uhi," achi hi.
Huai ni mah in TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Moab gam a Jeriko zawn a Abarim tang dung a Nebo tang ah va hohtou inla, Israel suante luah dia ka piak Kanaan gam va gal-et in.
Na sanggampa Aaron Hor tang a si a, achipihte kiang a pi ahih tak mah bang in na kahtouh na tang ah na si dia, na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding hi.
Zin gamdai a Meribah-kadesh tui munte a Israel suante lak a ka tung a na khelh ziak in leh Israel suante lak a na hon pahtawi louh ziak in.
Tua gam na va galmuh dia; himahleh Israel suante ka piak gam ah na lut kei ding," achi hi.
Hiai vualzawlna in ahi Pathian mipa Mosi in asih ma a Israel suante avualzawlna:

"Sinai a pan TOUPA ahong pai a, Seir a pan akiang uah athoukhia a, Paran tang a kipan hong vakkhia in, Mi Siangthou singkhat lak a pan ahong pai; akhut taklam a pan amau a ding in meikuang bang dan a-om.
Ahi, amite a-it a, Mi Siangthou tengteng na khut ah a-om uh. Na khebul ah atu ua; na thute azui chiat ding uh.
Mosi in eite dan ahon pia, Jakob mipite gouluah ding.
"Jeshurun ah amah kumpipa ahi, mipite intekpen leh Israel chi tengteng a-omkhawm lai un.”
"Reuben hing hen, si lou in, amite ahihleh tawm kei uhen."
"Hiai Judah vualzawlna ahi. TOUPA Judah aw ngaikhia inla, amite kiang ah pilut in. Amah a ding in akhut kiching henla, nang amelmate doupihpa hi in."
Levi tungthu ah, "Na Thummim leh na Urim, na misiangthou kiang ah omsak in, Massah ah na ze-et a, Meribah tuite ah na dou hi;
ka nu leh ka pa ka thei kei, chi in; a-unaute leng athei sam kei hi. Amah tate ngei leng athei tuan kei; na thu apom ua, na thukhun azui ngal ua.
Na vaihawmte Jakob asinsak ding ua, Israelte, na dan. Na ma ah gimlim akoih ding ua, na maitam ah halmang thillat.
Aneihte vualzawl in, TOUPA, akhut nasepte ana pom inla; amah doute kawng sat inla, amah hote kawng toh, adin nawnlouhna ding un."
Benjamin tungthu ah zaw, "TOUPA deihtak zaw akiang ah bit in ateng ding. Nitum in amah akhuh dia, aliangte kikal ah ateng ding."
Joseph tungthu ah zaw, "Agam TOUPA vualzawl in om hen, van thil mantam daitui in, tui thuk mahmah nuailam a tui in.
Nisa in apiansak gah manphate leh khapi in a-omsak thil mantamte in.
"Nidanglai tangte athil deihhuaipente in, tangtawn mual a thil mantamte in.
Lei leh atung a thil mantamte in, loubuk a ompa deihsakna in. Vualzawlna Joseph lutung ah hong om hen, a-unaute a pan hihtuam a ompa lusip ah.
Athupina bawngtal piang masa thupina bang ahi a, akiite gam bawngtal kiite bang ahi. Huai in nam chih asi a, kawlmong tan in asi ding. Amaute Ephraim singkhatte ahi ua, Manasseh sangte ahi uhi."
Zebulun tungthu ah, "Kipak in, Zebulun, na vakkhiaknate ah, Issakar, na puaninte ah.
Tang ah chi chih asam ding ua, huai ah diktatna kithoihnate alan ding uh. Tuipi buchinna ne ding ahi ngal ua, piaunel a gou kiselte toh," achi hi.
Gad tungthu ah, "Gad hihlianpa phat in om hen, humpinelkai bang in ateng a, aluzang leh aban ahamkek hi."
"Amah a ding in ahoihna pen atel a, dan pepa tantuan mun a amah atut ziak in, intekpente toh ahoh a, TOUPA vaihawmna dik leh Israelte kiang a vaihawmnate azui hi."
Dan tungthu ah, "Dan zaw humpinelkai nou ahi a, Bashan a pan ahong tawm ding."
Naphtali tungthu ah, "Naphtali aw, deihsakna a lungkim, TOUPA vualzawlna a tai, sim leh tum luah in."
Asher tungthu ah, "Asher tapate a vualzawl in om henla, a-unaute lak ah tuitum henla; thau ah akhete diah hen.
Na khedap sik leh dal ahi dia, na damsung ni bang in na hatna leng a-om ding."
"Jeshurun Pathian nang hon panpih dia van a tuang, thupitak a van a tuang bang kua mahmah a-om kei uhi.
Tangtawn Pathian na kibukna ahi a, nuailam ah atangtawn ban a-om, melmate ahon satmang dia, hihmang in, achi ding hi.
"Israel bel galmuangtak in amah kia in ateng dia, Jakob tui leh buh leh uain gam ah a-om ding, avante'n leng daitui akesak ding uhi.

Na hampha hi, aw, Israel, nangmah bang a TOUPA'N ahotdam mite kua a-om a? Nang hon panpihpa phaw, na thupina namsau ahi! Na melmate nang ah ahong kipe ding ua, nang amun sangte uh na tuanchil ding hi.”
Huan Moab Phaizang a pan Jeriko zawn a Nebo tang, Pisgah tang vum ah Mosi ahohtou a; TOUPA'N Gilead gam tengteng, Dan pha in a-ensak hi.
Naphtali leh Ephraim gam tengteng, Manasseh leh Judia gam tengteng, atumlam tuipi pha in.
Sim gam leh tum khopi Jeriko Phaizang, Zoar pha in.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Hiai gam ahi Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a, 'Na suante ka pe ding,' chi a kichiam a ka na chiam. Muh ahihleh ka hon musak peuhmah a, himahleh huai ah na pai kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA sikha Mosi, TOUPA thu bang in Moab gam ah asita hi.
Beth-peor zawn a Moab gam phaizang ah avui a; himahleh tuni tan in kuamah in ahan athei kei uh.
Mosi asih in kum za-le-sawmnih a upa ahi; amit amial kei a, atha leng akiam tuan kei hi.
Israel suante'n Moab Phaizang ah ni sawmthum Mosi akah ua, huchi in Mosi suun a, akah nite uh hong beita hi.
Mosi in atung a, akhut akoih ziak in Nun tapa Joshua pilna kha in adim a; Israel suante'n athu azui ua, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahih uhi.
Huai nung in Israelte lak ah Mosi bang a TOUPA'N kimaituah a ahoupih zawlnei himhim a-omta kei;
chiamtehna leh thillamdang tengteng, Pharaoh leh asikha tengteng kiang leh Aigupta gam tengteng a-ensak a,
khut hattak leh lauhuai pipi a Israel mi teng mitmuh a Mosi in ahih bang hih a-om kei uhi.
Huaiziak in Israelte aw, TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon piak gam, dam a na luahtheihna ding ua na zuih ding uh ka hon hilh dante leh vaihawmte ngaikhia un.
TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak ka hon piak na zuihtheihna ding un, ka hon thupiak na behlap ding uh ahi kei a, na kiamsak ding uh leng ahi sam kei.
Baal-peor a TOUPA thilhih na mit un na mu ua; Baal-peor bemi tengteng TOUPA na Pathian un na lak ua pan ahihmangta hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh lenkip peuhmahte bel tutan in dam in a-om lai chiat uhi.
Ngai un, na va luah ding gam ua leng na zuih zel ding un TOUPA ka Pathian in thu ahon piak bang geih in dante leh vaihawmte ka hon hilh hi.

Hiai dan leh dan thuseh tengteng za a, "Hiai nam thupi, apil leh atheisiam mite ahi taktak uh," chi ding namte kiang a hiai in na pilna uh leh na theihsiamna uh lak ding ahih ziak in pilvangtak in hiaite zui un.
I sap peuhmah chiang ua TOUPA i Pathian in ahon naih bang a amau naih zel pathian nei nam thupi kua a-om ua?
Hichitak a dik, dan leh vaihawmna, tua na ma ua ka khun tengteng bang dan nei nam thupi dang kua a-om a?

Bang teng hi heh, pilvang unla, ngenteltak in kikem phot un. Huchi lou in zaw na mit un athil muhte na mangngilh ding ua, na damsung un na lungtang ua pan amang kha ding hi. Na tate uh leh na tute uh sinsak un.

Horeb tang a TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a na din ua, TOUPA'N ka kiang a, "Mite hon sapkhawmsak in, leitung a a-om sung teng ua hon kihtakdan akisintheihna ding uh leh atate uh sinsak ding in ka thute ka hon zasak ding, ahon chih ni na mangngilh kha ding uhi," achi hi.
Huchi in na hong naih ua, huai tangbul ah na hong dingh uhi. Huai lai in meikuang in van sun zen in huai tang akang a, meipi vom leh mial in akhuh lai hi.
TOUPA'N meikuang a pan ahon houpih a; athugen na za ua, himahleh lim bangmah na mu kei ua, aw ging lel na za uhi.
Athukhun zui dia nou thu ahon piak, thupiak sawm na kiang uah agenkhia a, suangpek nih ah agelh hi.
Huai lai in luah dia na va galkahna gam ua na zuih ding un dante leh vaihawmte sinsak ding in TOUPA'N thu ahon pia hi.
Huaiziak in pilvang mahmah un. Horeb tang a meikuang a pan TOUPA'N nou hon houpih ni in lim bangmah na mu kei uhi.
Nou leh nou kihihsia in, milim gelh kibawl in, lim kibatpih, apa lim hiam, anu lim hiam,
leitung a om gamsa kibatpih, huihkhua a leng kha nei vasa kibatpih,
lei a vak thilte kibatpih, lei nuai a tui a om ngasa mawngmawng kibatpih na kibawl kha ding uhi.
Van lam na nga un, ni, kha, aksite, van a om tengteng leng na mu un, TOUPA na Pathian un van nuai a mi tengteng ahon sehsakte un hon hip in, hiaite bia in a-nna uh na sepsak kha ding uh.
TOUPA'N amite, agou hi ding in sik haltuina a pan, Aigupta gam a pan nou ahon pikhe zawta ahi; tu a na hih mah bang un.
Hiai kia leng hilou in, noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh a, Jordan lui ka galkah louh a, na luah ding ua gam hoihtak TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak a ka lutlouhna ding in leng akichiam hi.
Kei zaw hiai gam a si ding ka hi a, Jordan lui gal kah lou ding ka hi. Nou bel na galkah ding ua, hiai gam hoihtak na luah ding uhi,
Pilvang mahmah un, TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun, na kiang ua akhun na mangngilh ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un akibatpih himhim bawl aphal louh milimte na kibawltawm kha mahmah ding uh.
TOUPA na Pathian uh katmang hat mei, mullit hat Pathian ahi.

Tu leh tate na neih ua, huai gam a sawt kuam na ten nung ua, na kineksiat louh ua, banghiam akibatpih peuh a milim bawltawm lelte na bawlkhiak ua, hihheh dia TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih maizen uleh;

Jordan kan a na va luah ding uh gam a pan na mangthang pah ding uh, chih na tungtang thu ua hon theihpih ding in tu in lei leh van ka chial ahi. Sawt na teng kei ding ua, na mangthang vek mai ding uh.
TOUPA'N mite lak ah hon dalhsak dia, TOUPA'N hon paimangsakna namte lak ah tawmchik kia na teng ding uh.
Huai ah, sing leh suang a abawl uh pathiante, mu thei lou peuh, za thei lou peuh, ne thei lou peuh, dik thei lou peuh na be ding uh.
Himahleh huai lai mah a TOUPA na Pathian uh na zon ua, na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua na zon uleh na mu ding uh.
Haksa a na om ua, na tung ua hiai thil tengteng ahong tun chiang in, TOUPA na Pathian uh lam na hong nga khongkhong ding ua, athu na zuita ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh lah zahngaihna a dim Pathian ahi ngal a; ahon donsak lou kei dia, ahon hihmang kei ding. Na pi-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a athukhun amangngilh het kei ding hi.
Na om ma uh, nidanglaite sui le uchin leitung a Pathian in mihing asiam nungsiah van nuai ah, hichibang a thil thupi a-om ngei in, zak ahi ngei hia?
Na zak bang un, mei a pan Pathian aw mi'n aza ngei mawngmawng in, ahing uhia?

Namdang lak a pan khemna, chiamtehna, thillamdang, kidouna, khut hattak, ban zak, thil mulkimhuai a TOUPA na Pathian un na mitmuh ua Aigupta gam a ahih tengteng bang a nam pikhe ngam Pathian a-om ngei hia?
TOUPA amah tuh Pathian ahi, chih na theihtheihna ding ua na kiang ua hihlat ahi a; amah lou ngal adang a-om kei.
Ahon sinsak theihna ding in van a pan a-aw hon zasak a, leitung ah ameikuang thupi ahon musak a, meikuang a pan athu na za uhi.
Na pi-le-pute uh a-it ziak in anung ua asuante uh ahon tel a, amitmuh in athilhihtheihna thupitak in Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia hi.
Namdang nou sang a thupi leh thilhihtheizaw ahon delhkhiaksak a, agam uh hon luahsak a, tua na hih mah bang un hon lutsak hi.
Huaiziak in tu in na lungtang un vom unla, tunglam van ah leh nuailam lei ah TOUPA zaw Pathian ahi, chih thei un. Adang himhim kuamah a-om kei hi.
Tangtawn a dia TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon piak gam ah noumau leh na suante uh a dia hoih ding leh na ten sawttheihna ding un, adante leh athupiakte, tua ka hon piakte na zuih ding uh ahi.
Huchi in Mosi in Jordan gal, nisuahna lam pang ah khopi thum asep hi.
Tualthatmi, a-invengte, tuma lam a leng mudah khol lou, mi that kha humbitna ding in, hiai khua khatpeuh peuh a, atailutleh humbit in a-om ding.
Huai khuate hiaite ahi uh: Reubente gam a Bezer khopi; Gadte gam Gilead a Ramoth khopi leh Manassehte gam Bashan a Golan ahi uhi.
Mosi in Israel suante apiak, dan hiai ahi.
Hiaite Mosi piak theihsaknate, dan thusehte leh dante ahi. Huai bel Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai uleh,

Sihon gam, Jordan lui suahlam a Beth-peor kiang phaizang a, a-om lai ua apiak ahi. Sihon bel Amorte kumpipa, Heshbon a vaihawmpa, Mosi leh Israelte'n Aigupta a pan ahong paikhiak lai ua azohpa uh ahi.
Amau Sihon gam leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam aluah uhi. Amau nihte Jordan lui suahlam a Amor kumpipa nihte ahi uhi.
Hiai gam ahihleh Arnon Phaizang gei a Aroer a pan Sion tang, Hermon leng achih uh, pha a kizalh ahi. Sion tang in min dang anei a, Hermon ahi.
Huai gam in Jordan lui suahlam a Arabah luipiau tengteng, Pisgah tang a tui nakte nuai a Arabah tuipi tan ahuap hi.
Huan Mosi in Israel tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah: Israel mite aw, na sin ua na zuih ding uh dante, vaihawmte tuni a na bil ua na zak ua ka gen ngaikhia un.
TOUPA Pathian in Horeb ah eite toh kikal ah thu akhung hi.
TOUPA'N hiai thu i pi-le-pute kiang ah ana khung kei a, eite, tutan a hingdam a om lai tengteng kiang ah ahi, akhun zawk.
TOUPA'N tang ah mei a pan kimaituah in hon houpih a,
huai lai in TOUPA thu nou hon kawkmuh ding in TOUPA toh na kikal uah ka dingh a; meikuang ziak in lah na lau ngal ua, tang ah na hohtou kei uhi.
Kei TOUPA Pathian, Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa ka hi.
Ka ma ah keimah lou ngal pathian dangte na nei ding ahi kei.
Milim bawltawm, tunglam van a om hiam, nuailam lei a om hiam, lei nuailam a tui a om hiam, akoi batpih mahmah na kibawl ding ahi kei.

Huaite ma ah na kun ding uh ahi kei a, a-nna uh leng na sem ding uh ahi ahi kei. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh Pathian mullit hat, pate khelhna ziak a tate gawt zel, hon mudahte suan thumna leh suan lina tan a gawt zel leh;
ahon itte, ka thupiakte zuimi sang tampite tung a hehpihna langsak zel ka hi.
TOUPA na Pathian min na lou mawkmawk ding ahi kei. TOUPA'N amin lou mawkmawkte lah moh lou in akhah ngal kei ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian in thu hon piak bang in Sabbath ni tang siangthou in.
Ni guk sung nna na sem dia, nna tengteng na sem ding ahi.

Ani sagih ni, TOUPA na Pathian a ding in Sabbath ni ahi. Huai ni in nang, na tapa, na tanu, na sikhapa, na sikhanu, na bawngtal, na sabiltung, na gante uh lak a akoi mahmah in leng, na inn a gamdang mite'n leng nna himhim asem ding uh ahi kei. Nangmah bang in na sikhapate, na sikhanute leng akhawl ding uh ahi.

Nang leng Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi khin a, TOUPA na Pathian in huai a pan khut hat leh ban zak a, hon pikhiak na hi, chih theigige in. Huaiziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian in Sabbath ni tang dia thu ahon piak.
TOUPA na Pathian in thu ahon piak bang in na nu leh na pa zahtak in. Huchi in TOUPA'N gam ahon piak ah lamzang in, na damsawt ding hi.
Tual na that ding ahi kei.
Ang na kawm ding ahi kei.
Na gu ding ahi kei.
Na invengte tung ah theihpih taklou in na pang ding ahi kei.
"Na invengte zi na eng ding ahi kei, na invengte inn hiam, alou hiam, asikhapa hiam, asikhanu hiam, abawngtal hiam, asabiltung hiam, na invengte thil bangmah na eng ding ahi kei," achi hi.
Hiai thute tang a mei, meipi leh mial sah bikbek a pan TOUPA'N aw ngaihtak in na vek ua kikhawmte kiang ah agen a, abehlap nawn tuan kei hi. Huaite suangpek nih a gelh in, kei kiang ah hon pia hi.
Tang akat lai a, mial a pan aw na zak un, hichi ahong hi a, na nam ua intekpen teng leh na upate un hon naih uhen.
Nou ngai in, "TOUPA i Pathian in i kiang uah athupidan leh aletdan alangsak a, mei a pan a-aw i za uh. Pathian in mihing ahoupih a leng na sih tuanlouhdan uh tuni in na theita uhi.
Huaiziak in bangziak a si ding i hi ua? Hiai meikuang thupitak in hon kangmang mai ding. TOUPA i Pathian aw i zak nawnleh zaw i si mai ding uhi.
Meikuang a pan Pathian hing aw i zak bang a za sam a lah hing ngal mihing tengteng lak ah kua a-om a?

Nang va naih inla, TOUPA i Pathian in agen ding tengteng va ngaikhe dih ve. TOUPA i Pathian in na kiang a, agen tengteng kou kiang ah na gen dia; huchi in ka na ngaikhe ding ua, ka zui ding uh," na chi uhi.
N'on houpih lai ua na thugen uh TOUPA'N ana za a; huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n na kiang a thu agen uh ka na za a; athugen tengteng uh agen hoih uhi.
Huchibang lungsim pu gige le uh aw, laudan ahong siam ding ua, ka thupiak azui gige ding ua, amau leh atate uh tangtawn in alamzang ding uhi.
Pai inla, apuanin ua kik nawn ding in amaute hilh in.
Himahleh aluah ding ua ka piak ding gam a azuih ding ua na sinsak ding thupiak, dan thuseh leh dante tengteng ka hon piaktheihna ding in nang zaw hiai ah om tadih in,” achi hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian un thu ahon piak bang a hih ding in pilvang un. Taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam na pial ding uh ahi kei.
Na va luah ding uh gam a na hin ua, na lamzanna ding uh leh na ten sawttheihna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian un thu hon piak lampi na zuih tawnsuak ding uh ahi.
Luah dia na va galkahna gam ua na zuih ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un noute hon sinsak dia thu ahon piak, thupiak, dan thuseh leh dan hiaite ahi uh.

Huai bel nou leh na tapate uh leh na tupate un TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ua, na damsung teng ua adan leh athupiak ka hon piak tengteng na zuihna ding uh leh na hong ten sawttheihna ding uh ahi.

Huaiziak in Israel mite aw, lamzang a TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon kamchiam bang a nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a nakpitak a na hong puntheihna ding un, ngaikhia unla, zui ding in pilvang un.
Israel mite aw, ngaikhia un, TOUPA na Pathian uh kia TOUPA ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng un, na lungsim tengteng un, na hatna tengteng un na it ding uh ahi.
Hiai thu, tuni a ka hon piak na lungtang uah ataam gige ding a;
na tate uh phatuamngaitak in na sinsak ding ua, na inn ua na tut lai un, lampi a na pai lai un, na lup lai un leh na thoh chiang bang un na gen ding uh ahi.
Chiamtehna ding in na ban uah na vial ding ua, na mit kikal uah talgakna ding in a-om ding ahi.
Na inn kongkhak biang leh na kongkhak uah na gelh ding uhi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a ahon piak gam, na bawlkhiak uh hi het lou,

kho thupi leh kilawm taktakte, na hihdim uh hi het lou, thil hoih chiteng a dim innte, na leh uh hi het lou tuikhuk lehsate, na suan uh hi het lou grephuan leh olive singte omna a hon pilut a, na nek ua na tai chiang un, pilvang mahmah un.
Huchi lou in zaw Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhia TOUPA na mangngilh kha mahmah ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding ua, ama nna na sem ding ua, amin lou in na kichiam ding uh ahi.
pathian dangte na zui ding uh ahi kei, na kim ua mite pathiante na be ding uh ahi kei.
Na lak ua TOUPA na Pathian uh zaw Pathian mullit hat ahi; TOUPA na Pathian uh na tung uah aheh dia, lei a pan hon hihmang kha ding hi.
Massah a na ze-et bang un TOUPA na Pathian uh na ze-et ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak, athupiakte, athu theihsakte leh adante pilvangtak in na zui ding uh.
TOUPA mitmuh a dik leh hoih na hih ding uh ahi. Huchi in nou a ding in ahoih dia, TOUPA'N na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, achiam gam hoih a lut in, na luah thei ding uhi.
TOUPA'N agensa bang in, na ma ua kipan na melma tengteng uh ahawlkhe ding hi.
Na tate un, "TOUPA i Pathian un thu hon piak, athu theihsaknate, dante, dan thusehte, bangchidan ahia?" chi a tunung lam chiang a ahon dot chiang un,
nou na tate uh kiang ah, "Aigupta gam ah Pharaoh sikha i na hi ua, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan khut hattak in hon pikhia hi.
TOUPA'N i mitmuh un Aigupta gam tung ah, Pharaoh tung ah, a-inkuanpih tengteng tung ah, chiamtehna leh thillamdang, thupi leh huaise mahmahte amusak hi.
Eite bel hon pe dia i pi-le-pute kiang a piak ding chi a akichiam gam hon piaktheihna ding in huai gam a pan hon pikhia hi.
Huchi in hiai dan tengteng zui ding leh i hoih tawntungna dia TOUPA i Pathian laudan siam ding in TOUPA'N thu hon pia a, tuni a mihing a hon hawitheihna ding in.
Athu hon piak bang a TOUPA ma a thupiak tengteng zui dia i pilvanleh ei a ding in damna ahi ding," na chi ding uhi.

Na va luah ding uh gamsung a TOUPA na Pathian un ahon pilut a, na ma ua nam tampi, Hitte, Girgaste, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste, nou sang a thupizaw leh hatzaw nam sagihte, adelhkhiak a;
TOUPA na Pathian un amaute nou ahon piak a, na thahgam chiang un amaute na hihgam sipsip ding ua; amaute toh thukhun na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
Zi leh ta in na nei ding uh ahi kei. Na tanute uh atapate uh na pe ding uh ahi kei. Atanute uh na tapate uh a ding na la ding uh ahi kei.
Na tapate uh, kei hon zuilaite pathian dangte biakna ah apikawi mai ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na tung uah aheh dia, hon hihmang pah ding hi.
Atung uah hichibang in na hih zaw ding uh ahi. Amaitam uh na hihchim ding ua, asuangphuhte uh na kitamzansak ding ua, a Asherahte uh na phuk ding ua, amilim bawltawmte uh na hal vek ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in lah nam siangthou na hi ngal ua. Leitung maikaih a nam tengteng tung a amah a tuam ding a TOUPA na Pathian un hon tel na hi uhi.
Namdang sang a na tam zawk ziak ua TOUPA'N na tung uah a-itna tusak a, hon tel ahi kei a, namdang tengteng a nam tawmpen na hi zomah uhi.

TOUPA'N noute ahon it ziak in leh na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna tangtun a-ut ziak in ahi zaw, TOUPA'N Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh khut a pan leh saltanna inn a pan khut hat mahmah a hon tatkhiak.
Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh Pathian ahi chih thei un. Pathian muanhuai, amah it a athu zuimi tung a suan sangkhat tan a athukhun leh behpihna zui gige,
amah hote hihmang dia amaitang mahmah ua thuk zel ahi. Amah hote ahal sawt kei dia, amaitang mahmah uah athuk ding hi.
Huaiziak in athupiakte, adante, dan thusehte, zui dia tuni a thu ka hon piak na zuih ding uh ahi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, avaihawmte na ngaihkhiak ua, na zuih ua, na hih ziak un TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna thukhun leh hehpihna na tung uah azui ding hi.

Noute ahon it dia, ahon vualzawl dia, hon hihpung ding hi. Piak ding a na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna gam ah na gil ua gah leh na leigah uh leng avualzawl lai ding. Na buhte uh, na uainte uh, na thaute uh; na bawngnou uh leh na belamnoute uh leng avualzawl ding hi.
Nam tengteng tung ah vualzawl na hi ding ua; na lak uah numei hiam pasal hiam, na gante uh lak ah leng ching himhim a-om kei ding hi.
TOUPA'N hipi tengteng hon hihthengsak vek dia, na theihsa uh Aigupta gam hipite na tung uah atungsak kei dia, nou hon hote tengteng tung ah atungsak zaw ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding nam tengteng na hihmang vek ding uhi. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, apathiante uh nna na sem ding uh ahi kei; huaite nou a dia thang ahih ding ziak in.
Na lungsim ua, "Hiai namte lah ei sang in atamzaw ngal ua, bangchi in i hawlkhe thei dia?" chi na hih uleh,
Amau kihta kei un. TOUPA na Pathian un Pharaoh leh Aigupta mi tengteng tung a athilhihte theigige un.

Ze-etna thupitak na mit mahmah ua na muhte uh, chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, khut hattakte leh ban zakte a TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon pikhiak; huchibang in TOUPA Pathian in na mi lauhte uh tung ah ahih ding hi.
Noumau a pan kibute leh akhosuaksunte amanthat vek tan un TOUPA na Pathian un alak uah tunpite asawl ding hi.
Amau na lau ding uh ahi kei. Pathian thupitak leh lauhuaitak TOUPA na Pathian uh na lak uah a-om hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un huai namte awlawl in ahon delhkhiaksak ding. Amau na hihmang pah ding uh ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw nou a ding in gamsate ahong tam lo kha ding uhi.
Ama'n masiah uh TOUPA na Pathian un ahon pe dia, buai petmah in ahihbuai ding hi.
Akumpipate uh na khut uah ahon pe dia, amin uh van nuai a pan na thaimang sipsip ding uh ahi. Na hihman sipsip tan un kuamah in hon dalzou kei ding hi.

Apathian lim bawltawmte uh na hal ding uh ahi. Huaite dangkasik hiam, dangka-eng hiam na enlah ding uh ahi kei. Nou a dia na lak ding uh ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na awk kha ding uh; TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia thilkihhuai ahi ngal ua.
Na insung ua thilkihhuai lalut in huai thil bang in hamsiat thuak ding in na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Kih petmah a kih in na mudah mahmah ding uh ahi, hamsiat thuakna thil lah ahi ngal ua.
Chidam ludam a na om ua, na hong tam semsem ua, nou hon pe dia na pi-le-pute uh kiang a TOUPA'N akichiamna gam na va luahtheihna ding un ka hon thupiak tengteng zui ding in pilvang un.
Athupiakte na zui ding uhia, zui lou ding, na lungsim uh theihna dia enchian ding leh hon hihgim dia gamdai a kum sawmli sung nou ahon pina lampi tengteng theigige un.

Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei. TOUPA kam a thu chih pawt in ahing zaw, chih nou ahon theihsak theihna ding in hon hihgim a, na kial uh aphal a, na theih ngei louh uh, na pi-le-pute un leng atheih ngei louh uh manna in ahon vak hi.
Hiai kum sawmli sung in na puansilhte uh na silhtul kei ua, na khete uh leng abawk kei hi.
Mi'n ata asawi bang in TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon sawi ahi, chih na lungsim un thei un.
Alampi zui dia amah laudan siam ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zui ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un phaizangte leh mualte a pan hong pawtkhia luitui, tuikhuk leh tui thukpi omna gam;
buh, barli buh, grep, theipi leh theibuhfaite omna gam; thau nei olive leh khuaizu omna gam;
kitatlak lou a tanghou na nekna ding gam uh, bangmah na taksaplouhna ding uh, asuangte bang sik, atangte dal laihkhiak theihna gam hoih mahmah ah nou hon pilut ding ahi ngal a.
Na neih ua, na tai mahmah chiang un, gam hoih mahmah ahon piak ziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh na phat ding uh ahi.
Athupiakte, adan thusehte leh adante, tuni a ka hon piak zui lou in TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh kha mahmah ding uh, pilvang un.
Huchi lou in zaw na nek ua, na tai ua, inn hoih taktak na lam ua, na luah chiang un;
na ganhon uh, na belamhon uh ahong tam a, na dangka uh, na dangka-eng uh ahong tam a, na thil neih tengteng uh ahong tam hun chiang in na lungtang uh akisathei kha dia,
Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan noute hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh mai kha ding uh,
Ama'n gamdai zatak leh lauhuaitak, gul gukhahte leh aikamte omna, tui omlouhna, gamkeu ah hon pi paisuak a;

suangpi a pan meisah suang tui ahon pawtkhesak a, na pi-le-pute uh theih ngei louh, manna in nou ahon vak a, tunung chiang khualna a na hoihtheihna ding un nou hon hihgim a, ahon chet theihna ding in.
"Hiai i sum-le-paite eimah hatna leh i khut hatna in asepkhiak ahi," na lungtang un na chi kha ding uh, pilvang un.
Tua na kip bang ua na pi-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a thu akhun ahihkipna ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh theigige un, sum-le-pai muhkhiak theihna hon pepa lah amah ahi ngal a.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh ua, pathian dangte na zuih ua, a-nna uh na sep ua, na biak uleh, na mangthang ngeingei ding uh, chih tuni in ka hon theisak ahi.
Na ma ua namdangte ahihmanthat bang in noute leng na mangthang ding uh, TOUPA na Pathian aw ngaikhe ut lou na hih ding ziak un.
Israel mite aw, ngaikhia un, nou sang a thupizaw leh thilhih-theizaw namte, khopi van sun a kulh daikaih leh thupi luah ding in tuni in Jordan galkah a, na kuan ding uh ahi.
"Milian leh sang, Anakte, Anak suante ma ah kua adingh zou dia?" achih uh na theih uh leh zaksa uh ahi.

Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh katmang hat mei bang a na ma ua pai ahi, chih tuni in thei un. Ama'n amaute ahihmangthang dia, ahon hihniamsak ding. Huchi in TOUPA'N na kiang ua agensa bang in, amau na delhkhe ding ua, na hihmangthang pah ding uhi.

TOUPA na Pathian un ahon delhkhiaksak khit chiang in, "I diktat ziak a hiai luah dia TOUPA'N hon pilut ahi, na lungsim un chi kei hial un." Hiai namte agitlouh ziak un ahi zaw, TOUPA'N hon delhkhiaksak ding.

Na diktat ziak uh hiam, na lungsim uh dik ziak hiam in, agam uh na luah kei ding ua, hiai namte gitlouhna ziak leh TOUPA'N na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a, akichiamna hihkip ding in TOUPA na Pathian un amau hon delhkhiaksak ahi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in hiai gam hoih mahmah na diktat ziak ua luah ding in TOUPA'N hon pia ahi kei chih thei un. Nam genhakpi lah na hi ngal ua.
Gamdai a TOUPA na hehsak nak dante uh theigige unla, mangngilh kei un. Aigupta gam a pan na pawt ni ua kipan hiai mun na hong tun tan un TOUPA tung a helhat na hi uhi.
Horeb ah leng TOUPA na hehsak ua, nou hon hihmangthang ding khop hial in TOUPA aheh hi.
Suangpek, na kiang ua TOUPA'N thu akhunna suangpek la dia tang a ka va hohtouh lai in, tang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ka va om a; tanghou ka ne kei a, tui leng ka dawn sam kei hi.
TOUPA'N suangpek nih, Pathian khutzung a gelh ahon pia a; huai ah na kikhopkhawm ni ua tang tung a mei a pan TOUPA'N na kiang ua thu agen tengteng atuang hi.
Ni sawmli leh zan sawmli khit in hichi ahong hi a, suangpek nih, thukhun suangpek ahon pia hi.

TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, hiai a pan paisuk meng in, Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak na mite akihihse khinta uh. Zuih dia ka hon thupiak lampi a pan apialmangta ua, milim suntawm akibawl uh," achi hi.
Huaite ban ah, "TOUPA'N, hiai mite ka etet aleh, ngai in, nam genhak ahi uh.

Amau hihmangthang ding leh van nuai a pan amin uh thaimang ding in ka hih dandan in ka hih mai ding. Amau sang a nam thilhihtheizaw leh thupizaw in nang ka hon bawl ding," chi in leng hon houpih lai hi.
Huchi in tang a pan ka kihei a, ka paisuk a, tang akangta, thukhun suangpek nihte ka khut langnih in ka tawi hi.
Huchi in ka en a, ngai un, TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah na khialta uhi. Bawngnou lim suntawm na kibawl ua; TOUPA'N thu ahon piak lampi na pialsanta uhi.
Suangpek nihte ka dom a, ka khut langnih a pan ka pai a, na mitmuh un ka hihkhamta hi.

Tuma a ka hih bang in TOUPA ma ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ka bokkhup hi. Amah hihheh dia TOUPA mitmuh a na thilhihkhelhsa uh, nou khelhna tengteng ziak in tanghou ka ne kei a, tui leng ka dawn sam kei hi.
Nou hon hihmangthang dia TOUPA hehna, athangpaihna leh alungkimlouhna mahmah lah ka lau ngal a. Himahleh huai lai in leng TOUPA'N ka thu hon ngaihkhiaksak hi.
TOUPA bel Aaron hihmangthang nuam hial khop in aheh a; himahleh Aaron mah leng ka thumsak pah ngal hi.
Na khelhna uh ziak a na bawl uh bawngnou lim ka la a, ka hal a, ka satzan a, leivui bang in ka gawinel dimdem a; tang a pan a lui hong luang ah anel ka pai hi.
Taberah, Massah leh Kibroth-hattaavah ah leng TOUPA na hihheh uhi.
TOUPA'N, k'on gam piak va luah un, chi a, Kadesh-barnea a pan ahon sawl lai in, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak na helsan ua, amah na gingta kei ua, a-aw lah na ngaikhe sam kei uh.
K'on theih tung a pan TOUPA tung a helhatmi na hi gige uh.
Huchi in TOUPA'N, ka hihmangthang ding, ahon chih ziak in TOUPA ma ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung ka bokkhup hi.
TOUPA kiang ah ka thum a, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, na thupina a tat, khut hattak a Aigupta gam a pan na tatkhiak, na mite leh na goutante hihmangthang ke'n.
Na sikha Abraham, Isak leh Jakob theigige inla, hiai mite phengphitdan, gitlouhdan leh akhelhdante uh en ke'n.
Huchi lou in zaw na hon pikhiakna gam a mite'n TOUPA'N agam chiam a apilut theih louh ziak leh amuhdah ziak in gamdai a thah ding in apikhia, achi kha ding uh.
Na thilhihtheihna thupitak leh na ban zak a na pikhiak, na mite leh na goutante lah ahi ngal ua," ka chi hi.
Thugenpa, David tapa, Jerusalem kumpipa thute.
Bangmah loute bangmah lou, bangmah loute bangmah lou, bang teng bangmah lou ahi, Thugenpa'n achi hi.
Asepgimna tengteng ni nuai a asepgim a kipan mihing in bang phattuamna anei a?
Khang khat apai a, khang dang ahong tung a; tangtawn in lei a-om gige.
Ni leng asuak zel a, ni atum zel; huchi in asuahna mun lam ah akik nawn pah hi.
Simlam ah huih apai a, mallam ah akilehhei a; alampi ah akivialhei gige, huan huih alam zuih ah akik nawn zel hi.
Luite tengteng tuipi ah aluanglut ua, himahleh tuipi a dim tuan kei; luite paina mun lam ah, huai lam ah apai nawn uh.
Thil tengteng gimna in adim a; mihing in agen thei kei; muh in mit alungkim kei a, zak in bil leng alungkim sam kei.
A-om khinsa ahong om ding ahi a; hih khitsa hih a om ding ahi a; huchi in ni nuai ah thil thak a-om kei hi.
En dih, "Hiai athak ahi?" chi a mite'n agen uh thil a-om hia? I ma ua hunte ua a-om khinsa ahi.
Khang masate theihgigena a-om kei a; anung a hong om dingte lak ah hong om ding khang nanung lam theihgigena leng a-om sam kei ding.
Kei Thugenpa, Jerusalem ah Israel tung a kumpipa ka hi.
Van nuai a hih a omte tengteng tungtang pilna a zong ding leh zongkhe ding a ka lungtang suah ka hi; huai a kisuk ding a mite tapate kiang a Pathian in apiak nakpitak a gimna ahi.
Ni nuai a hih a om nasepte tengteng ka muta a; ngai in, bang teng bangmah lou ahi a, huih nungdelh ahi.
Akawisa bawl tang theih ahi kei; huan akim lou sim theih ahi kei.
Keimah lungtang ka houlimpih a, "Ngai in, Jerusalem a ka ma a omte tengteng sang in pilna thupi ka hon muhsak a; ahi, ka lungtang in pilna aneita," chi in.
Huchi in pilna thei ding leh haina haitatna thei ding in ka lungtang ka suk a; hiai leng huih nungdelh ahi chih ka thei hi.
Pil mahmahna ah lungkham mahmahna a-om a; kuapeuh theihna khangsak in lungkhamna akhangsak hi.
Thou sisa in gimlim bawlpa nuhtheihna uingim asawlkhesak a; huchi mah bang in haina neuchik in pilna leh zahna abukzou nak hi.
Mipil lungtang ama khut taklam ah a-om a; himahleh mihai lungtang akhut veilam ah.
Ahi, huai ban ah, lampi a mihai avak lai in, atheihsiamna in azuausan a, mi chiteng kiang ah hai ahihdan agen hi.
Vaihawmmi lungsim nang dou ding a athohleh na mun taisan ke'n; kipiak in tatkhelhna thupite alungkimsak hi.
Gilou ni nuai a ka muh, vaihawmmi a kipan adiklouhna hong kipankhia bang in a-om hi.
Haina nakpi a zahtakhuai in akibawl a, mun niam ah hauhsakna atu hi.
Sikhate sakol tung a tuang leh lalte leitung a sikhate bang a khe a pai ka mu hi.
Kuapeuh kokhuk tou huai sung ah ake ding; kuapeuh dai phuvang; gulpi in akei ding.
Kuapeuh suang hemkhia huai in akihih na ding a; kuapeuh sing a belh huai ah lauhuai in akibawl hi.
Sik amol a, mi'n ama atat-hiam keileh, hatna tamsem akoih ding ahi; himahleh pilna thuzoh aphatuam hi.
Khim a om ma a gulpi in akeihleh, khimmi ah phattuamna a-omta kei hi.
Mipil kam a thute hehpih thei in a-om a; himahleh mihai mukte'n amah mah anawmvalh ding.
Akam a thute kipatna haina ahi; huan ahoulimna tawpna lungsim kimlouhna gilou ahi.
Mihai in leng thu akhangsak a; himahleh mihing in bang a-om dia chih athei kei; huan amah nung a hong om ding, amah kua'n ahilh thei dia?
Khopi a hohna dan atheih louh ziak in, mihaite sepgimna in amaute lak a michih agimsak hi.
Aw gam, na tung agik hi, na kumpipa naupang ahih lai in na lalte'n zingsang in ane uh!
Aw gam, na kumpipa miliante tapa ahih a, na lalte'n, kham ding hilou a, hatna ding a ahuntak a anek lai un, nuam na sa hi.
Thadahna ziak in intung achim a; khut zawntatna ziak in inn akeh hi.
Nuihna ding in ankuang a kilui a, uain in hinna akipaksak; sum thil tengteng awnghukna ahi.
Kumpipa, na ngaihtuahna in hamsiat ke'n, na lupna dantan sung ah mihausate hamsiat ke'n; huihkhua a vasate'n na aw pua a, kha neite'n athu agen ding ziak un.
Tuite tung ah na tanghou pai in; ni tampi nung a mukhe ding na hi ngal a.
Sagih kiang ah tantuan pia in, ahi, giat ngei kiang ah; leitung a bang gilou hong om ding ahia chih lah na thei ngal kei a.
Meipite vuah a adimleh, leitung ah akihih awngthawl uh; huan simlam a sing apukleh, hiam mallam ah, apukna mun ah, huai ah a-om ding hi.
Huih ngeingaihmi in atuh kei ding a; meipi limsakmi in a-at kei ding hi.
Huih lampi hiam, amah nau toh omna gilsung a guhte bang hong chi khan uh ahia chih na theih louh bang in; bang teng bawlpa Pathian thilhih na thei kei hi.
Zingsang in na chi tuh inla, nitak in na khut ton maimah ke'n; koi pen hong lohching ding ahia, hiai hia huai hia, ahihkeileh hong hoih tuaktuak ding uhia chih lah na thei ngal kei a.
Diktak in khovak anuam a, mitte a dia nisa muh thil nuamtak ahi.
Ahi, mi kum tampi adamleh, huaite tengteng ah kipak hen; himahleh khomial hunte theigige hen, tampi pha ding uh lah ahi ngal a. Ahong om tengteng bangmah lou ahi.

Aw tangval, na tuailai in kipak in; na tuailai nite ah na lungtang in hon kipaksak hen, na lungtang lampite ah leh na mitte muh in om in; himahleh hiai thilte tengteng ziak in Pathian in nang vaihawmna a hon pi ding ahi chih thei in.
Huaiziak in na lungtang a kipan lungkhamna suankhia inla, na sa a kipan gilou koihmang in; tuailaina leh khan lut lai lah bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
Na tuailai nite in nang hon siampa theigige in, ni hoihloute ahong tun ua kumte ahong nai ua, Amaute ah kipahna ka nei kei, na chih hun ahong tun nai louh lai in.
Ni hiam, khovak leh kha leh aksite, hihmial a om a, meipite vuahzuk khit a akik nawn ma un;
inn ngakte akivuan ua, mihatte ahong kun ua, atawm tak ziak ua ansute akhawl ua, tawlet a dakkhete hihmial a a-om ua,
kongzing akongkhakte khak ahih nai louh lai un; ansuk ging angaih louh a, vasa aw a mi athoh a, tumging theih tanute tengteng sukniam a a-om nai louh lai un;

Ahi, tungsang a om akihta ding ua, alampi ah launa a-om ding; vaisuaklu sing apaklun ding a, huan khaukhup tunggikna ahi dia, lingmin thuk azuau ding; mihing a-inn sau a pai a, suun mite kongzing kim a apai ziak un.
Dangka khau kiphel a, dangka-eng noubem suktap a a-om a, tuibel tuikhuk a hihkek a a-om a, tuibem a kangtalai khe hihtan a a-om nai louh lai in.
Huan a-om bang in leivui lei ah akik nawn a, kha bel apepa Pathian kiang ah akik hi.
Bangmah loute bangmah lou, thugenmi'n achi; bang teng bangmah lou ahi.
Huai ban ah, Thugenpa apil ziak in, mite theihna asinsak lailai a; ahi, paunak tampi kizomzom in angaihtuah a, azongkhia a, akoih hi.
Thugenpa'n thu pomtakte mukhe ding in azong a; diktak a gelhkhiak a omte, thutak thute ngei.
Mipil thute sutna zum bang ahi a, hoihtak a khetkip sikkilhnate bang tuh Belamchingpa khat thugen lakkhawm piakte ahi.
Huan huai lou leng, ka tapa, hilh in om in; laibu tampi bawl ahihleh tawp chih ni a-om kei hi; huan zil tamna zaw taksa bahna ahi.
Hiai thu leh la tawpna ahi; avek in zak in a-omta; Pathian laudan siam inla, athupiakte zui in; hiai lah mihing hih ding pumpi ahi.
Pathian in thilhih chiteng, thil selguk chiteng, ahoih hia ahihkeileh ahoih lou toh vaihawmna a lalut ding ahi.
Ka lungtang in, "Kisa in, vualnopna in ka hon entel dia; huaiziak in nopbawlna ah bual in," ngai in, hiai leng bangmah lou ahi, ka chi hi.
Nuihzatna thu ah, "Haina ahi," Vualnopna thu ah, "Bang ahih a?" ka chi hi.
Adamsung ua mite tapate'n ahih ding uh bang ahia hoih ka muh theih matan, ka lungtang in pilna kei hon pi kawm in, uain a ka sa kipahsakdan leh haina let tintendan ka lungtang in ka zong hi.
Nasepna thupi ka bawl a; innte ka kilam hi.
Grephuante ka kibawl a; huante leh gamsitte ka kibawl a, huaite ah thei chi chih ka suan hi.
Gammang singte khoinate hihkawt ding in, tui lite ka kibawl hi.
Pasal sikhate leh numei sikhate ka lei a, ka insung ah sikhate apiang ua; belamhon leh bawnghon ka hau a, Jerusalem a ka ma a omte tengteng sang in.
Dangka leh dangka-eng leng, bialte leh kumpipate a kipan kei a ding in gou ka kaikhawm a; pasal lasa mite leh numei lasa mite, mite tapate kipahna, atam a tam meite ka nei hi.
Huchi in Jerusalem a ka ma a om tengteng sang in ka thupi in, ka pung zaw a; ka pilna leng ka kiang ah a-om gige hi.

Huan bangpeuh ka mit in alunggulh amau ka it kei hi; nopsakna himhim a kipan in ka lungtang ka len kei, ka sepgimnate tengteng ziak in ka lungtang lah akipak ngal a; huan hiai tuh ka sepgimna tengteng a kipan ka tantuan ahi.
Huchi in ka khutte'n abawl uh nasep tengteng ka vel a, semgim a ka hih nasep gimna tengteng; huan, ngai in, bang teng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh ahi a, ni nuai ah bangmah phattuamna a-om kei hi.
Huan pilna leh lungsim kimlouhna leh haina en ding in ka kihei a; kumpipa nung a hong pai mihing in bang hihthei ding ahia? Akihih khinsa mahmah tanpha in leng.
Huchi in khovak in khomial akhen dandan in, pilna in haina kheng ahi chih ka muta hi.
Alutang ah mipil mitte a-om a, khomial ah mihai avak hi; huchi hinapi in lah thu khat mi tengteng kiang ah atung hi.

Huai lai in ka lungtang in, "Mihaite kiang a ahong om bang in, huchibang in kei kiang ah leng ahong om ding; ahihleh bang ding a kei pilzaw ka hia?" ka chi hi. Huan ka lungtang in hiai mah leng bangmah lou ahi, ka chita hi.
Mipil, mihai bangmah a, theihgigena lah tangtawn in a-om ngal kei a; tunung chiang in avek ua mangngilh khit ahi ding uh chih thei in. Huan bangchi a mihai bang a mipil si ahia?
Huchi in hinna ka hua a; ni nuai a bawl thilhih kei a ding a ahaksat ziak in; bang teng lah bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh ahi ngal a.
Huan ni nuai a ka sepgim ka sepgimna tengteng ka hua a; ka nung a hong om ding mi kiang a ka nutsiat ngei ding ahi chih thei in.
Kua'n ahia mipil hia ahihkeileh mihai ahong hih ding thei? Ka sepgimna tengteng a ka sepgimna tung ah thu anei ding a, ni nuai a pilna ka etsakna ah. Hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
Huaiziak in ni nuai a sepgimna tengteng ka na bawl tak tungtang thu a ka lungtang lungdongsak ding in ka kipumhei hi.
Mi asengimna pilna leh theihna leh kivakna toh om lah a-om ngal a; himahleh huai a semgimloumi kiang ah atantuan ding a nutsiah in a-om ding hi. Hiai leng bangmah lou leh gilou lianpi ahi.
Ni nuai a asepgimna tengteng a kipan leh alungtang a akisukna tengteng a kipan mihing in bang anei a le?
Anite tengteng lungkhamna lel ahi ngal a, athuakna dahna; ahi, zan nangawn in alungtang akhawl kei hi. Hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
Mihing a ding a anek a adawn a, asepgimna a thil hoih a akha abualsak val a hoihzaw bangmah a-om kei hi. Hiai leng ka thei a, Pathian khut a kipan om ahi.
Kei sang a kua'n ahia ne thei a, ahihkeileh kua'n ahia nopsakna nei zaw?

Amah hihlungkim mi kiang ah Pathian in pilna leh theihna leh nopsakna ape ngal a; himahleh mikhial kiang ah, gimthuakna apia, lakhawm ding leh kholkhawm ding in, huchi a kuapeuh Pathian hihlungkim kiang a apiaktheihna ding in. Hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
Bangchiteng a ding in hunbi a om, van nuai a thiltup chiteng a ding in hun;
Pian hun leh sih hun; suan hun leh suansa bohkhiak hun;
Thah hun leh hihdam hun; phel hun leh lam nawn hun;
Kah hun leh nuih hun; suun hun leh lam hun;
Suangte paihmang hun leh suangte lakkhawm hun; kawi hun leh kawi kidek hun;
Zon hun leh mansuah hun; vom hun leh paihmang hun;
Bohkek hun leh khui hun; pau louh hun leh thugen hun;
It hun leh muhdah hun; kidou hun leh kilep hun.
Asepgimna nasempa'n bang phattuamna anei a?
Huai akisawizoina ding a Pathian in mite tapate kiang a apiak haksatna ka muta hi.
Thil chiteng ahun a kilawm in abawl a; alungtang uah khovel leng akoihta a, hinapi in mihing in Pathian nasep abul a kipan a atawp pha ahihsa amukhe thei kei hi.
Adamsung teng un kipah leh hoih hih sang a amau a dia hoihzaw bangmah a-om kei chih ka thei hi.
Michih in anek a adawn a, asepgimna tengteng a hoih leh nuam asakpih Pathian thilpiak ahi.

Bangpeuh Pathian in ahih, tangtawn in a-om ding chih ka thei a; huai ah bangmah akikoih thei kei ding a, huai a kipan in bangmah mah akilakhe thei sam kei ding; Pathian in ahih khinta a, huchi in ama ah mite'n alau ding uhi.
A-om khinsa pen; a-om ding a om khinsa ahi; huan Pathian in apaimangsa azong hi.
Huchi in ni nuai ah, vaihawmna mun ah, gitlouhna a-om chih leng ka mu hi; huan diktatna mun ah, gitlouhna huai ah a-om hi.
Ka lungtang in, "Pathian in midiktat leh migilou angaihtuah ding; thiltup chiteng leh nasep chiteng a ding in hun a-om," ka chi hi.
Ka lungtang in, mite tapate ziak in ahi, Pathian in amau a-ettel a, amau mahmah gamsa bang lel ahihdan uh akitheihtheihna ding un.

Mite tapate tung atung peuhmah lah gamsate tung ah atung ngal a; thil khat ngei atung uah atung a; khat asih bang in, huchi mah bang in adangdang asi a; ahi, hu khat aneikhawm ua; huan mihing in gamsate sang a masak zawkna anei kei; bang teng bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
Bang teng mun khat ah apai ua; bang teng leivui a kipan ahi ua, bang teng leivui ah akik nawn uh.
Mihing kha tunglam a paitouleh gamsa kha nuailam a paisuk ahihdan kua ahia thei?
Huaiziak in mihing a nasepte a akipah ding sang a hoihzaw bangmah a-om kei chih ka thei hi; huai atantuan ahi ngal a; amah nung in bang ahi dia chih mu ding in amah kua'n hon pi nawn ahia le?

Huchi in ka kihei a ni nuai a nuaisiahna hih a om tengteng ka mu a; huan ngai in, huchibang a nuaisiah a omte, lungmuanpa neiloute; huan amau nuaisiahte lam ah thilhihtheihna a-om a, himahleh lungmuanpa anei kei uh.
Huaiziak in misite asi khinsate adam lai dam a omlaite sang in ka phat zaw.
Ahi, a-om ngei nai lou, ni nuai a nasep gilou hih a om mu ngei nailoumi amaute sang in ka ngai thupizaw hi.
Huchi in sepgimna leh nasep siamna tengteng, hiai ziak a mihing invengte hazat a omna ka muta hi. Hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
Mihai in abante khepkhawm in amah sa ane hi.
Khut dim nih sepgimna leh huih nungdelhna sang in, lungmuanna toh khut dim khat ahoihzaw hi.
Huchi in ka kihei a ni nuai a bangmah lou ka mu hi.

Amah kia a om khat ka mu a, nihna anei kei a; ahi, tapa anei kei, sanggampa leng anei kei; hinapi in lah asepgim tawpna a-om kei a, hauhsakna in amitte leng alungkim tuan kei hi. "Kua a dia semgim a, ka kha hoih tansak ka hia?" achi a. Hiai leng bangmah lou ahi, ahi, nakpi a gimthuakna ahi.
Khat sang in nih ahoihzaw; asepgimna ua ding a kipahman hoih aneih ziak un.
Puk le uh, khat in alawm phong ding ahih ziak in; himahleh apuk chiang a amah kia a-om a, amah phong ding midang nei lou tung agik hi.
Huai lou in, nih alupkhawm un, lumna athei uh; himahleh khat kia bangchi in alum thei dia?
Huan mi khat in amah kia a om pen zouleh, nih in amah adou ding ua; khauzang guk a hek akitat mengmeng kei hi.
Kumpipa tek leh hai, thuhilhna sang thei nawn lou sang in tuailai genthei leh pil ahoihzaw hi.
Suangkul a kipan a kumpipa hi ding a hong paikhia lah ahi ngal a; ahi, ama gam mahmah a gentheisa a piang ahi.
Ni nuai a vak ahing tengteng, tuailaite toh om uh ahihleh, anihna, amun ah adingh chih ka muta hi.
Mi tengteng, amaute tung a a-omna mahmah, bei chih a-om kei a; hinapi in lah tunung chiang a hong om dingte amah ah akipak kei ding uh. Chihtaktak in hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
Pathian inn a na hoh chiang in na khepek kem in; ngaikhe ding a pai, mihaite kithoihna piak sang in ahoihzaw ngal a; gilou ahih uh chih akithei kei uhi.
Kam lawp ke'nla, Pathian ma a thil himhim gen ding in na lungtang lawptawp kei hen; Pathian lah van ah a-om a, nang lah leitung ah na om ngal a; huaiziak in na thute tawmsak in.
Mang lah thu leh la tampi toh ahong om a; huan mihai aw thu tampi toh.
Pathian kiang a thuchiam na chiam chiang in, pe ding in hal ke'n; mihaite tung ah kipahna anei ngal kei a; na thuchiam pen pia in.
Na chiam a na piak louh sang in, na chiam louh ahoihzaw hi.
Na kam in na sa thil ahihkhelhsak phal ke'n; angel ma ah leng, adik kei chi sam ke'n; bang ding in na aw ah Pathian in aheh in, na khut nasep ahihse dia?
Huchibang in mangte punna leh thute tamna ah bangmah loute a-om nak; himahleh nang zaw Pathian kihta in.
Gentheite hiamgamna in bial sung ah vaihawmna leh diktatna alamang chih na muhleh, huai thu lamdang sa ke'n; thuneitu sangte'n thuneihna neite a-enkai ua; huan amau tung ah asangzaw a-om hi.
Huai lou in lei a punna bang teng a ding ahi; kumpipa ngei leng louma in a-nna asepsak hi.
Kuapeuh dangka deihta dangka in alungkim kei ding; kuapeuh hauh-sakna punna deih taleng; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
Van akibehlap chiang in, amau nete akhang uh; huan huai neimi a ding in bang phattuamna a-om a, amitte a huaite et chih ngal louh?
Ne tawm in ne tam taleh, semgimmi ihmut alim a; himahleh mihausa vahna in amah a-ihmusak kei hi.
Ni nuai a gilou hoih het lou ka muh a-om a, huai tuh, hauhsakna a neipa'n amah siatna ding a akep.
Himahleh huai hauhsaknate thuakna gilou in amangthang hi; tapa asuanleh, akhut ah bangmah a-om kei.
Anu gil a kipan ahong paileh, vuaktang in apai nawn ding a hong pai bang in, asepgimna, akhut a apuakmang theih a ding in bangmah ala kei ding hi.
Huan hiai leng gilou hoih het lou ahi, ahong paidan tengteng in, hichibang in apai ding a; huih a ding a asepgimna ah bang punna anei a?
Adamsung teng in khomial ah an ane a, huan nakpitak a hihbuai in a-om a, chinatna leh thangpaihna anei hi.
Ngai in, hoih leh kilawm hi a ka muh mi'n Pathian in amah apiak adamsung teng a anek a, adawn a, ni nuai a asepgimna tengteng a hoih asakpih a, huai ahi; hiai lah atantuan ahi ngal a.
Mi chiteng leng amah kiang a Pathian in hauhsakna leh neih zohna apiak, huai a nektheihna apiak a, atantuan la ding leh asepgimna a kipak ding in; hiai Pathian thilpiak ahi.
Adam lai nite lah atheigige kei ding a; alungtang kipahna a Pathian in amah adawn ziak in.
Ni nuai a ka muh gilou a-om a, mite tung ah agik hi.

Mi Pathian in hauhsakna leh neih zohna leh zahna apiak a, huchi a adeih peuh akha a dia bangmah taksap nei het lou a, himahleh huai ne ding a Pathian in thilhihtheihna apiak louh a, mikhual in anek zawkna; hiai bangmah lou ahi a, gilou natna ahi.
Mihing in ta zakhat suang henla, kum tampi dam in akumte nite tampi phaleh, akha lah hoih in dim kei ngal in, kivuina nei kei ngalleh; amah a ding in ahun lou a pian ahoihzaw ka chi ahi.
Bangmah lou lah ahong hi a, khomial ah apaimang a, khomial in amin akhuh hi.
Huai lou in ni amu kei a, theih leng athei kei; hiai in adang sang in akhawlna anei hi.
Ahi, kum sangkhat gentuan dam mahleh, hoih nuam asakpih tuan kei; bang teng mun khat ah apai kei uh maw?
Mihing sepgimna tengteng akam a ding ahi a, himahleh agilkialna adim tuan kei.
Mihai sang in mipil in bang phattuamna anei a le? Ahihkeileh, mihing ma a omdan thei, migenthei in bang anei a?
Lunggulhna tam vak sang in mitte muh ahoihzaw hi; hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
Ana om khinsa bangpeuh, sawtpi a huai amin piaksa ahi, huan mihing ahi chih theih ahi; amah sang a hatzaw amah toh leng akisual thei kei ding hi.
Thil tampi bangmah lou pungsak a om ding chih thei in, mihing bang ahoih tuan a?
Adamsung bangmah lou limliap bang a asukbei tengteng, adamsung in mihing a ding a hoih kua'n athei a le? Ni nuai ah amah nung in bang a-om dia chih kua'n mihing ahilh thei a ahia?
Nuh theih mantam sang in minhoih ahoihzaw; mi pian ni sang in sih ni.
Ankuangluina inn a hoh sang in, suunna inn a hoh ahoihzaw; huai mi tengteng tawpna ahi a; huan mihing in alungtang a angaihtuah ding ahi.
Nuih sang in lungkham ahoihzaw; mel lungkhamna ah lungtang kipahsak in lah a-om ngala.
Mipil lungtang suunna inn ah a-om; himahleh mihaite lungtang vualnopna inn ah a-om hi.
Mi a ding in mihaite lasak zak sang in, mipil taina zak ahoihzaw.
Bel nuai a lingte puak vengvung bang in, mihai nuihna huchibang in a-om ngal a; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
Simmohna in mipil ahaisak mahmah a; thilpiak in theihsiamna asusia hi.
Akipatna sang in thil tawpna ahoihzaw; lungsim a kisaktheih sang in lungsim a doh theih ahoihzaw hi.
Heh ding in na lungsim in kinoh ke'n; hehna lah mihaite awm ah akhawl hi.
Nidanglaite hiaite sang a ahoihzawkna aziak bang ahia? chi ke'n; hiai thu lah pilhuaitak in na dong kei hi.
Pilna gouluah bang in ahoih a; ahi, amau ni mute a ding in ahoihzaw tham hi.
Dangka sum kihumna ahih bang in, pilna lah kihumna ahi ngal a; himahleh theihna hoihzawkna bel, pilna in aneimi hinna ahawisak hi.
Pathian nasep ngaihtuah in; ama'n akawisak sa, kua ahia bawl tang thei ding?
Hauhsak ni in nuamsa inla, huan vangtah ni in ngaihtuah in; mihing in anung a thil om ding amuhkhiaklouhna ding in, Pathian in khat lah adang kiang ah kihiang helhel in abawl hi.
Ka bangmah lou ni in hiai tengteng ka muta hi; midiktat adiktatna a mangthang a-om a, huan migilou agilou bawlna a ahinna hihsau a-om hi.
Kidiktatsak lo zen ke'n; kipilsak lo zen sam ke'n; bangziak a nang kihihse ding na hia?
Gilou lo zen ke'nla, hai sam ke'n; na hun tun ma a bangziak a si ding na hia?
Hiai na let tinten ahoih hi; ahi huai a kipan in leng na khut kai ke'n; kuapeuh Pathian kihta lah amute tengteng a kipan hong paikhe ding uh ahi ngal a.
Khopi a om vaihawmmi sawmkhat sang in mipil a ding in pilna athupizaw.
Hoih hih a, khial lou, leitung ah midiktat a-om mahmah kei hi.
Thu kigen tengteng leng limsak khol dah in; huchi lou in zaw na sikha in nang ahon hamsiat na za kha ding hi.
Na lungtang in lah huchi mah bang in nang leng midangte na hamsiat mun chih athei ngal a.
Hiai tengteng pilna in ka enchian vek a, "Ka pil ding," ka chi a; himahleh kei a kipan agamla hi.
Gamlatak a thilte leh athuk petpette; kua'n amukhe thei dia?
Ka kipumhei a, thei ding leh zongkhe ding, pilna zong ding leh thilte ziak zong ding, gitlouhna haina ahi chih thei ding, haina lungsim kimlouhna ahi chih thei ding in ka lungtang koihkip in a-om hi.

Sihna sang a khazaw tuh numei, alungtang thangte leh lente hi a, akhut henna khau hi ahi chih ka muta hi. Kuapeuh Pathian lungkimsak huai nu a pan asuakta ding a, himahleh mikhial bel athang-awk ding hi.
Ngai in, hiai ka mukhia, thugentu in achi; thil omdantak mukhe ding in thil akhat akhat ka buk hi.
Tu in leng ka zong lai a ka mu kei; pasal sangkhat lak a mitang khat ka mu, himahleh numei tengteng lak a mitang ka mu kei hi.
Ngai in, Pathian in mihing hoihtak in abawl chih, hiai kia ka mu a; himahleh bawltawm tampi azongkhia uhi.
Mipi bang a om kua ahia? Huan thil hilhchetna kua ahia thei? Mihing pilna in amai avaksak a, amai takna akikheng hi.
K'on thuhilh, Pathian thuchiam lam thu ah, kumpipa thupiak zui in.
A-omna mun a kipan paikhe ding in kinoh ke'n; thil gilou ah engtat ke'n; ama'n lah a-utut ahih sek ngal a,
Kumpipa thu in thilhihtheihna aneih ziak in, "Bang ahia na hih?" Kua'n ahia akiang achi thei ding?
Thupiak zuite'n thil gilou athei kei ding uh; huan mipil lungtang in hun leh vaihawmna atheikhen zel.
Thiltup chiteng ah lah hun leh vaihawmna a-om ngal a; mihing haksatna lah atung ah athupi ngal a.
Ahong om ding lah athei ngal kei a; bangchi in a-om dia chih amah kua'n ahilh thei dia le?

Kha lentang ding in kha tung a thilhihtheihna neimi a-om kei; sihna ni tung ah leng thilhihtheihna anei sam kei. Huan huai kidouna ah panna a-om kei; piak a om gitlouhna in amah ahunkhe sam kei ding hi.
Hiai tengteng ka mu a, nasep chiteng ni nuai a hih ah ka lungtang ka pia a; asiatna ding in mi khat in midang tung a thilhihtheihna aneih louh hun a-om hi.
Huan giloute vui a om ka mu lai a, huan han ah ahong ua; huchi in hihdikte mun siangthou a kipan apaimang ua, khopi ah mangngilh in a-om uhi; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
Gilou nasep kintak a gawtna akibawl louh ziak in, huaiziak in mite tapate lungtang gilou hih ding in huai ah koihkip in a-om hi.
Mikhial in gilou zakhat vei hih in, anite hihsau mahleh, Pathian kihta mite amau a ding in ahoih ding chih ka thei mahmah hi, ama a laudan siamte.
Himahleh giloute a ding in ahoih kei ding, anite leng asausak kei ding a, huai lah limliap bang ahi; Pathian ma a laudan asiam louh ziak in.

Bangmah lou leitung a hih a om a-om a; midiktat omta bang hileh leng, ama tung a migilou nasep dungzui in ahong om nak hi; huai lou in migiloute omta bang hileh leng, midiktatte nasep dungzui in atung uah ahong om hi; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.

Nek leh dawn a vualnuam a om kan a ni nuai a mihing in thil hoihzaw aneih louh ziak in, vualnopna ka phat hi. Pathian in amah ni nuai a apiak adamsung ni tengteng a asepgimna ah amah toh om gige ding ahi ngal a.
Pilna thei ding leh leitung a hih a om thu-le-la mu ding a ka lungtang ka suk lai in; sun hiam zan hiam a mit a ihmut muh louh lah a-om ngal a.

Huchi in Pathian thilhih tengteng ka mu a, huchi in ni nuai a thilhih mihing in amukhe thei kei hi; zongkhe ding in mihing nakpitak in pang lezong, amuh louh ding ziak in; huai lou in, mipil in thei kisa mahleh, amukhe thei kei ding hi.

Hiai tengteng ka lungtang in ka vei ngal a, hiai tengteng zongkhe ding in; midiktatte leh mipilte leh athilhihte uh Pathian khut ah a-om ahi chih; itna ahi hia muhdahna, mihing in athei kei; ama uah avek in a-om hi.

Thil tengteng kibang in avek ua kiang ah ahong om a; midiktatte leh migiloute tung ah tanchin khat a-om hi; mihoih kiang leh migilou kiang, misiang kiang leh misiang lou kiang, kithoihmi kiang leh kithoihloumi kiang ah, mihoih a-om bang in, mikhial a-om a; akichiampa, thuchiam kihtapa bang in.

Ni nuai ah hih a om tengteng ah hiai gilou ahi, bang teng tung a tanchin khat om; ahi nalai a, mite tapate lungtang gilou in adim a, adam lai uh alungtang uah lungsim kimlouhna a-om, huai nung in misite kiang ah apai uh.
Amah hing lai tengteng toh kizom a om ding in lah lametna a-om ngal a; humpinelkai sisa sang in ui hing lai lah ahoihzaw ngal a.
Mihingte'n asi ding uh chih lah athei ngal ua; himahleh misi in thil himhim athei kei, kipahman leng aneita kei uhi; amaute theihgigena lah akimangngilh hi.
A-itna uh bang in, amuhdahna uleh a-enna uh tu in amangta a; ni nuai a hih a om thil himhim ah tangtawn in tantuan anei nawnta kei uhi.
Pai inla, nopsakna toh na tanghou ne inla, lungtang kipak toh in na uain dawn in; Pathian in lah na thilhihte asang khinta ngal a.
Na puansilhte ngou gige in om hen; huan na lu in nilh theih tasam kei hen.

Na bangmah lou damsung ni tengteng a na it na zi kiang ah kipaktak in om inla, huai ama'n ni nuai a ahon piak, na bangmah lou ni tengteng in; huai lah damsung in na tantuan ahi ngal a, ni nuai a na sepgimna a na sepgimna ah.
Na khut in hih ding bangpeuh amuh na theihtawp in sem in; na paina lam han sung ah, nasep hiam, thil ngaihtuah hiam, theihna hiam, pilna hiam a-om lou ding ahi ngal a.

Ka kihei a, kitaitehna kinte a ding ahi kei a, galdouna hatte a ding ahi tuan kei chih ka mu hi, tanghou leng apilte a ding, hauhsakna leng theisiam mite a ding, deihsakna khutsiamte a ding hi tuan lou; himahleh hun leh phat amaute tengteng tung ah ahong om zel hi.
Mihing in ahun athei kei hi; ngasate len gilou a akimat bang leh vasate thang a a-awk uh bang in, huchibang in mite tapate, amau tung a thakhat a ahong tun guih lai in, hun gilou a mat in a-om uhi.
Hichibang in pilna leng ni nuai ah ka mu a, ka kiang ah thupi in akilang hi.
Khopi lian lou a-om a, asung ah mi tawmchik; huan kumpipa thupi in ahong sim a, ala a, adouna ding in sepaih nasep thupitak abawl hi.
Huchi in huai ah mipil genthei khat a-om, apilna in khopi ahunkhia a; himahleh kuamah in huai migentheipa atheigige kei uh.
Huan ke'n, "Hatna sang in pilna ahoihzaw; migenthei pilna muhsit in a-om a, athute ngaihkhiaksak in a-om kei," ka chi hi.
Mihaite lak a vaihawmmi kikou sang in awl a mipil thugente akiza zaw hi.
Kidouna galvante sang in pilna ahoihzaw; himahleh mikhial khat in hoih tampi ahihsia hi.
Paul, Pathian deihlam a Khrist Jesu sawltak in, misiangthou Ephesa a om Khrist Jesu a miginomte kiang ah:
Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pathian phat in om hen. Ama'n van munte ah khalam vualzawlna chiteng in eite Khrist ah ahon vualzawlta hi.
Amah mai a siangthou leh dembei a om ding a leitung pian ma a eite hon tel tak bang ngei in;
Ama'n adeih leh atup bangbang in, eite Jesu Khrist vang a atate hi ding in, itna ziak in hon sepkhol khinta hi.
Huchi a it a ahon piak hehpihna thupi mahmah pahtawina i hihtheihna ding ahi.
Asisan ziak in amah ah tatkhiakna, ahehpihna hauhdan bang a i tatleknate ngaihdamna ngei i tangta ua,
huai mah tuh ama'n eite lam ah pilna leh theihsiamna chiteng hon dimsakta a;
athiltup Khrist a agelkhiak bangbang in adeihlam thuguk eite ahon theisakta hi.
Huai adeihlam thilgel bel; hunbi ahong kim chiang a, thil tengteng, van a omte leh leitung a omte Khrist ah gawmkhawm a asuktuah vek ding ahi.
Ama deihlam a lunggel bang a thil bangkim semkhepa tup bang ngei in, amah mah ah sehkholh a om in i gouluah ding i muta uhi.
Koute, Khrist a ana lamen masate, athupina pahtawina ding a hing ding in sehkholh in ka na om khinta uhi.
Huan noute'n thutak thu, na hotdamna tanchinhoih uh ngaikhia a na gintak nung un, amah ah chiamsa Kha Siangthou a chiamteh in na omta uhi;
huai tuh, Pathian thupina ding a tatna kim i tan mateng a i gouluah ding tang ngei ding i hi chih khamkholhna ahi.
Huaiziak in ke'n leng Toupa Jesu a ginna na lak ua om leh misiangthoute tengteng tung a na itna uh ka zak in,
ka thumnate ah na min uh lou in nou ziak a kipahthu gen ka tawp kei hi;
i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pathian, thupina Pa'n, amah theihna lam thu a pilna leh kilakna kha nou ahon piaktheihna ding in.
Huchi a na lungsim mitte uh hihvak a hong om a, ama'n nou ahon sapna lametna bang leh misiangthoute agouluah hauhsaknate na theihna ding un.
Huan agingta eite athilhihtheihna thupina teh vual louh, huai a hatna thilhihtheihna toh asep bang zel in.
Hiai thilhihtheihna bel misi lak a kipan a Khrist akaihthoh a, vanmun a, ataklam a atutsak hun a,
lalnate, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate, vaihawmna tengteng tung leh tu khovel kia hilou a khovel hong tung ding nangawn a minsak chiteng tunglam pek ah akoih lai a azat mah ahi.
Ama'n akhenuai ah bangkim akoih a, saptuam a bangkim tung a lutang in amah abawl a,
huai saptuam apumpi ahi a, amah bangkim a bangkim hihdimpa taangchinna ahi.
Nou leng na tatlekna uleh na khelhnate uh ziak a si na hih lai un ahon hihhing hi.
Huaite ah tuma lam in hiai khovel dan bang in, huihkhua a thuneipa, tua thumang lou tate sung a semlelpa kha deihdan in na khosa uhi.
Huai thumang lou tate lak ah eite leng tuma lam in sa duhgawlna hih in, i tak taksa utnate bang in i om vek ua, midangte mah bang in thangpaihna ta a piang i na hi uhi.
Himahleh zahngaihna hau Pathian in, itna thupitak a hon it ziak in,
tatleknate ziak a si i hih lai in Khrist toh ahon hihhing a, hehpihna a hotdam na hita uhi.
Khrist Jesu ah amah toh ahon kaithou a, van munte ah amah kiang ah ahon tukhawmsak hi.
Huchi a hun hong tung dingte a, Khrist Jesu a i tung a migitna nei a, ahehpihna hauhdan a-etsak theihna ding in.
Hehpihna ziak a ginna tawn a hotdam na hi uhi; huai leng noumau a suak ahi kei a, Pathian thilthawnpiak ahi.
Thilhih ziak ahi kei, huchi hi keileh mi'n asuang kha ding hi.
Thil hoih hih ding a Khrist Jesu a siam a om in, ama khutsuak i hi uhi; huai thil hoih hih i khosakna dan ding in Pathian in abawlkhol ahi.
Huaiziak in tuma lam a nou taksa a Zentelte, taksa khut a zeksum, achihte un zeksum louh hon chihte uh na hi uhi.
Huai lai in, Khrist lou in Israelte khua-le-tui toh kimidang in khovel ah lametna nei lou leh Pathian lou a om in, thuchiam thukhun lak ah mikhual in na om uh chih theigige un.
Tu'n bel, Khrist Jesu ah nou nidanglai a gamlapi a omte, Khrist sisan a hihnai in na hong omta uhi.
Amah i kilemna ahi; ama'n ei nihte khat a siam in i kikal a kimelmakna baang lai ahihchimta hi.
Thusehte leh dan thupiakte asa a hihmang in; huchi a nihte amah a mihing thak khat a siam a kilemna abawltheihna ding in.
Huan kros ziak a nihte pumpi khat a Pathian toh hon kilemsakna ding in kimelmakna ahihbeita hi.
Huan amah ahong pai in, nou gamlapi a omte kiang ah leh naichik a omte kiang ah leng lemna tanchinhoih ahilh sam hi.
Amah ziak in kha khat a Pa kiang luttheihna i nei tuaktuak uhi.
Huchi in tu'n zaw, zin-le-leng na hi nawnta kei ua, misiangthoute toh tualsung khat leh Pathian inkuanpihte na hita uhi.
Khrist Jesu ngei aning a suang kiphamohpen hi in, sawltakte leh zawlneite suangphum tung a lam na hi ua,
amah ah suanglep tuam chiat kituaktak a suktuah, Toupa ah tempul siangthou asuak hi.
Amah ngei ah nou leng, Kha a Pathian tenna ding a lepkhawm na hi uhi.
Hiai ziak in kei Paul, nou Zentelte ziak a Khrist Jesu hentapa in,
noute a dia Pathian hehpihna nasepna piak a om ka hihdan na za thamta ding uhi.
Huchi a kilakna tungtawn a Khrist thuguk ka kiang a theihsak a a-omdante; tuma a tomchik a ka gelh bang in.
Huai na sim un Khrist thuguk ka theihdan na thei ding uhi.
Tu hun a asawltak siangthoute leh azawlnei siangthoute kiang ah Kha theihsak a a-om bang in, tuma lam in mihing tate kiang ah theihsak in a-om ngei kei hi.
Huai thuguk hiai ahi, tanchinhoih ziak in Khrist Jesu ah, Zentelte gouluahpihte, pumpi hiangte leh thuchiam tanpihte ahi uhi.
Athilhihtheihna nasepdan bang a, Pathian hehpihna thawnpiak bang zel in huai tanchinhoih nasemtu ding a bawl ka hi.
Kei, misiangthou tengteng lak a neupen sang a neuzaw kiang ah, hiai hehpihna piak ahi, Khrist hauhsakna suikhiak vual louh Zentelte kiang a gen ding in;
huan Pathian thil bangkim siampa a tangtawn a sel a na om, thuguk kisel bang ahia chih mi tengteng musak ding in,
Pathian pilna chiteng van munte a kumpi vaihawmte leh thuneihnate kiang a saptuamte zang a, tu hun a theihsak ahihna ding in.
Hiai atangtawn thiltup dungzui a Toupa Khrist Jesu a atup leh sepdan ahi.
Khrist Jesu i gin ziak in amah mah ah maingalna leh kimuanna toh luttheihna i nei hi.
Huchi in noute ziak a ka gimthuak ziak in lungke lou ding in ka hon ngen hi, huaite na thupina uh ahi.
Huaiziak in i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa ma ah ka khukdin hi,
lei leh van a inkuan chiteng min phuahkhiakna pa,
athupina hauhdan bang zel a, ama Kha ziak a mihing sunglam a thilhihtheihna a hihhat a ahon omsak theihna ding in.
Huan na lungtang ua Khrist ginna a atentheihna ding in, a-itna a noute zungkai leh kingakna nei a na omtheihna ding un,
misiangthou tengteng toh azatdan, asaudan, asandan leh athukdan theihchet theihna leh,
Khrist itna theih phak louh, Pathian taangchinna chiteng bang a hihdim a na omtheihna ding un.
Huan eimah a sem zel thilhihtheihna bang in, i nget leh i ngaihtuah tengteng sang a thupizaw tham hihtheipa kiang ngei ah,
tangtawn in suan tengteng tan in, saptuamte leh Khrist Jesu ah thupina om hen, Amen.
Huaiziak in noute sap a na omna uh toh kikhawm a khosa ding in kei Toupa a hentapa in ka hon ngen hi.
Kingaihniamna leh migitna tengteng, kuhkalna toh, itna a kithuakzou chiat in,
lemna Kha a kipum khatna vom tinten ding in.
Ahon sapna pen lametna mun khat a sap na hih mah bang un pumpi khat leh Kha khat kia a-om hi.
Toupa khat, ginna khat, baptisma khat,
bangkim Pathian leh Pa khat kia a om a; amah bangkim tung a om a, bangkim mu suak leh bangkim sung a om ahi.
Himahleh Khrist thilpiak tehna bang zel in hehpihna i kiang chiat uah piak in a-om hi.
"Huaiziak in ahi, tunglam a akahtouh lai in matte tampi api a, mihingte kiang ah leng thilpiakte apia,” achihna.
Huchi in "Akahtou," chih lei mun nuainungpente bang a ahong suk masak phot keileh bangchi ahita dia le?
Hong suk pen thil tengteng ahihdim theihna ding in, van tengteng tung pek a kahtoupa mah ahi.
Huan khenkhatte sawltak hi ding in, khenkhatte zawlnei hi ding in, khenkhatte tanchinhoih gen ding in, khenkhatte pastor hi ding in, khenkhatte sinsaktu ding in apia hi.
Hiai tuh misiangthoute thopna ding, nasepna sepna ding, Khrist pumpi lamtouhna ding in.
Huai tuh ginna leh Pathian Ta theihna lam a thukituak a, piching a, Khrist taangchinna bang a i vek ua i om masiah a ding ahi.
Huchi a mihingte diklouhna khemna bang a lepchiahpil a khem tawmtawm a om a, thuhilhna huih chiteng a alanglang a sep leh mutleng naupang i hih nawnlouhna ding un.
Itna a thutak gen a, bangkim a amah lupen, Khrist ngei a i khanlet zawkna ding uh ahi.
Amah a kipan pumpi tengteng kizopna chiteng sep ziak a lemtak a suktuah leh kizomkhawm a, hiang chih in sepdan ding bang asep chiang in pumpi akhang a itna ah amah-le-amah akilamtou hi.
Tu in hiai Toupa ah ka hon theisak hi, Zentelte alungsim ginatlouhna uh pu a a-om bang un, na om nawn mahmah ding uh ahi kei hi.
Amau alungtang uh khauh ziak a theihtheihna nei lou in Pathian hinna theihtheihna a pan posiah in a-om ua; atheihtheihna uh hihmial in a-om uhi.
Akhenggawpta ua, siang lou chiteng hihna lam a huaiham in zautatna ah akipumpiak uhi.
Himahleh nou zaw huchibang in Khrist thu na zil kei uhi!
Athu za a amah a thuhilh a om khin na hih peuhmah uleh, Jesu a thutak a om bang in,
na pianken lui uh, na nidanglai hindan uh segawpsa suahkhia in,
na lungsim Kha uah athak in hong om unla,
pianken thak, diktatna leh sianthouna a Pathian batpih a siam pen silh un.
Huchi in zuaugen tawpsan in, noumau inveng chiat kiang ah thudik gen un; khat-le-khat kihiangtuah chiat lah na hi ngal ua.
Heh unla, khelh zaw khial kei un; na hehna uh ni in tumpih kei hen.
Diabol leng mun awn sam kei un.
Guta in gu nawn kei hen; tasam kiang a piak ding aneihtheihna ding in, akhut a thil hoih sem in gim zaw hen.
Thusia peuhmah na kam ua kipan in pawt kei hen; akhawkdan bang zel a bawlhoih ding in thuhoih peuhmah pawt zaw hen, angaikhete a ding a hehpihna ahong hihtheihna ding in.
Huan Pathian Kha Siangthou hihlungkham kei un, tatna ni a ding in amah ah chiamteh na hi uhi.
Khaatna bang, thangpaihna bang, hehna bang, hanna bang, gensiatnate leh gitlouh tupna chiteng toh tawpsan in om hen.
Huan kihehpihtuah chiat a lainatna nei in om unla, Pathian in Khrist a nou ahon ngaihdam bang in, noumau leng kingaidamtuah chiat un.
Huchi in ata deihtakte bang in Pathian omdan zuite hi un.
Huan Khrist in hon it a, namtui ding a Pathian kiang a thilpiak ding leh kithoihna ding a i sik a akipiak bang in itna ah khosa un.
Misiangthou hita na hihman un kingaihna leh siang lou tengteng huaihamna toh, na lak uah lohkhak in om kei hen.
Zahmohte, thugina lou gente, chiamnuih thu nangawn huaite akilawm lou ahi; huaite gen sang in kipahthu gen zaw un.
Kingaihhat leh mithanghuai leh mihuaiham in, mihuaiham zaw milim bemi ahi, Khrist leh Pathian lalgam ah gou tan ding anei kei uh chih na thei mahmah uhi.
Kuamah in thugina lou peuh in hon khem kei uhen; huai thilte ziak in Pathian thangpaihna thumang lou tate tung ah atung nak hi.
Huaiziak in amau kikoppih kei un.
Tuma in mial na hi ua, tu'n zaw Toupa ah vak na hong hita uhi; vak tate bang in om un;
vak gah tuh hoihna, diktatna leh thutak tengteng ahi;
huan Toupa ah akipah lam pomtak bang ahi hiam zong un.
Huan mial thilhih gah nei ngeiloute ah leng panna nei kei unla, pan nak sang in adiklouhdan uh theisak zaw un.
Aguk a athilhih nakte uh agen lel leng azumhuai hi.
Himahleh thil bangkim adiklouhdan muh theih a om tuh vak hihlat ahi nak hi; muh theih a om peuhmah vak ahi ngal a.
Huaiziak in “Nang ihmu! Hak inla, misi lak a kipan thou in. Huchi in Khrist in vak hon pe ding," chih ahi.
Huan mihaite bang a om lou in, mipilte bang a om zaw in, na omdan uah pilvang un;
nite ahoih louh ziak in hun na neih sung un atam theipen sem un.
Huaiziak in hai nuam kei unla, Toupa deihlam bang ahia chih thei zaw un.
Uain kham in om kei un, huai ah kideklouhna a-om hi; Kha a dim in om zaw un,
phatna late, Pathian late, khalam late a kihoupih chiat a Toupa kiang a na lungtang tengteng ua ging kilawm bawl leh la sa in,
i Toupa Jesu Khrist min a, Pathian, Pa ngei kiang a bangkim tung a kipahthu gen gige in.
Khrist laudan siam in kiniamkhiak chiat un.
Zite aw, Toupa kiang a na kiniamkhiak bang un, noumau pasalte kiang ah kiniamkhiak un.
Khrist amah ngei pumpi hondampa hi a, saptuamte lutang ahih mah bang in zi lutang tuh pasal ahi.
Huchi in saptuamte Khrist kiang a akiniamkhiak bang un bangkim ah apasalte uh kiang ah zite kiniamkhiak uhen.
Pasalte aw, na zite uh it un, Khrist in saptuamte a-it a, asik ua akipiak bang in,
huchi a ama'n tui a sil a, thu a ahihsiangthou theihna ding in;
huchi a saptuamte nin baang lou, vuai lou leh huchibang thil mawngmawng pu lou a, siangthou leh gensiatbei a om zaw a, saptuamte amah-le-amah thupitak a akipiak theihna ding in.
Huchibang in pasalte'n leng amau pumpi mah bang in amau zite a-it ding uh ahi. Ama zi itpa amah ki-it ahi.
Kuamah in ama sa mah aho ngei kei, Khrist in saptuamte avak a adeihthoh bang in, avak in adeihthoh zaw hi;
ama sa leh guh a pan a om, apumpi hiangte i hi ngal ua.
Huaiziak in pasal in anu leh apa paisan in azi alen tinten ding a, anih un sapum khat ahong hita ding uhi.
Hiai thuguk athupi hi, himahleh ke'n zaw Khrist leh saptuamte toh kisai ahi ka gen.
Akoi abang hitaleh, nou lak a kuapeuh in amah a ki-it bang in azi it hen; zi mah in leng apasal zahtak ding in pilvang hen.
Naupangte aw, Toupa ah na nu leh pate uh thu mang un, huai tuh thil dik ahi ngal a.
"Na nu leh pa zahtak in," hiai thupiak chiam nei masapen ahi.
"Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih dia, lei ah leng na damsawt ding hi."
Huan nou pate aw, na tate uh hihthangpai kei unla, Toupa thuzohna leh hilhna ah kem zaw un.
Sikhate aw, Khrist thumang bang in laudan siam leh ling kawm in lungtang khat in sadan a na pute uh thumang un;
Mihing kipaksakte maimah bang a mitmei kia veng lou in, Khrist sikha bang a lungtang a Pathian deihlam hih zaw in.
Mihing nasem phet hilou in, Toupa nasem bang zaw a chitaktak kawm a nna sem in,
michih sikha hi in noplen himahleh thil hoih ahih bang mah Toupa kiang a kipan in angei mah amu nawn ding uh chih thei in.
Nou heutute aw, huchibang in amau leh noumau heutupa van ah a-om chih leh ama'n mi deihsak tuam anei kei chih thei in vau lou in atung uah hih sam un.
Atawp pen in, Toupa leh ahatna thagui ah thilhihtheihna nei in hong om un.
Diabol khemnate na dou zohtheihna ding un Pathian galvan kim in kivan un.
I doute zaw sa leh sisan ahi kei ua, lalnate leh thuneihnate leh tu a om lel mial tung a khovel vaihawmte leh van munte a kha gilouhon omte ahi zaw uhi.
Huaiziak in ni hoih lou a na douzohna ding un leh na hihzoh vek nung ua leng na dintheihna ding un, Pathian galvan kim la un.
Na kawng uh thutak a gak in, diktatna awmphaw zang in,
lemna tanchinhoih vanzat na khe ua bun in dingh un.
Huaite ban ah ginna lum la unla, huai in migilou thal kuangthei tengteng na hihmit thei ding uhi.
Huan hotdamna lukhu leh Kha namsau, Pathian thu la unla;
thumna leh ngetna chiteng in bangchik lai peuh in Kha ah thum un. Huai lam ah misiangthou tengteng a ding in phatuamngai leh ngen bilbel in limsak un.
Tanchinhoih thuguk hangsantak a theisak ding a, ka kam ka kat a, thu gensak a ka omtheihna ding in kei a ding in leng hon ngetsak un.
Ka gen ding bang hangsantak a ka gentheihna ding in, huai tanchinhoih palai khainiang bun ka hi.
Himahleh nou leng bangchibang in ka om hiam ka tanchin na theihtheihna ding un, Taikikas, Toupa a unau deihtak leh nasempa muanhuai in bangkim ahon theisak ding hi.
