Huaiziak in amah na kiang uah ka hon sawl ahi, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uleh ama'n na lungtang uh akhamuan theihna ding in.
Unaute kiang ah Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan lemna leh ginna tel itna om hen.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist tul lou a itte tengteng kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
Ahasueras dam lai in hichi ahong hi a, hiai Ahasueras bel India a kipan Ethiopia tan a, bial zakhat sawmnih-le-sagih tung a vaihawm ahi.
Huai lai a, Susa Inpi a kumpipa Ahasueras a gam laltutphah tung a atut lai,
avaihawm kum thum kum in, avaihawmte leh asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuangluina abawl a; Persia leh Media thuneihna, bialte a miliante leh vaihawmte ama ah a-om uhi.
Agam thupi hauhsaknate leh avaihawmna sang zahtakhuaina ni tampi, ni za-le-sawmgiat a-ensak hi.
Huchi in hiai nite zoh in, kumpipa'n Susa Inpi a om mite tengteng, aneu leh alian a ding in kumpipa Kulhpi huangsung ah, ankuangluina ni sagih abawl hi.

Puan kang khaite, ahing, adum, puanmalngat hoih leh sandup khauzangte a dangka zungbuhte leh suangpak khuamte a henden a-om a, tutna nemte dangka-eng leh dangka a bawl, suangchian suangpak san, ngou, eng leh vom a bawl tung ah a-om uhi.
Dangka-eng noute in dawn ding amau apia ua, noute akibang kei vek uh; kumpipa uain tampi, kumpipa khuttawi letna dungzui zel in.
Huchi in dan bang zel in uain dawnna a-om a; kuamah phutluih a-om kei; kumpipa'n a-inn heutu tengteng kiang ah, michih in nuam asak bang zel ua ahih ding un atheisak khin hi.
Kumpinu Vasti in leng kumpipa Ahasueras inn a om numeite a ding in ankuangluina abawl sam hi.
Ani sagih ni a, kumpipa lungtang uain a kipak a a-om lai in, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha leh Abagtha, Zethar leh Karkaste, kumpipa Ahasueras omna a nasem michilgehte thu apia hi.
Kumpipa ma a kumpi lukhu toh Vasti hon tonpih a, akilawmna mite leh vaihawmte ensak ding in, amah et in ahoih hi.
Himahleh kumpinu Vasti in michilgehte zang a kumpipa thupiak hoh lou ding in asel a, huaiziak in kumpipa aheh mahmah a, asung ah ahehna akuang hi.
Huchih lai in hunte thei mipilte kiang ah kumpipa'n, huchibang lah kuapeuh dan leh vaihawmna theite lau a kumpipa omdan sek ahi him hi.
Amah zom in Karsena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena leh Memukan, Persia leh Media vaihawmtu sagihte kumpipa mai mute leh gamsung a tu masate ahi uhi.
"Michilgehte zang a kumpipa Ahasueras chih ahih louh ziak in, dan dungzui in kumpinu Vasti tung ah bang i hih ding ua?" achi hi.

Kumpipa leh vaihawmte ma ah Memukan in adawng a, “Kumpinu Vasti kumpipa tung ah kia thil diklou hih ahi kei a, kumpipa Ahasueras bial sung a om vaihawmte tengteng tung leh mite tengteng tung ah leng hih ahi.

Kumpipa Ahasueras in ama a hong pai ding in kumpinu Vasti thu apia a, himahleh ahong pai kei, chih akigenthang chiang in, hiai kumpinu thilhih numei tengteng kiang atung ding a, amit uah apasalte uh simmohna suaksak ding ahi.
Tuni a kumpinu thilhih na za Persia leh Media vaihawmte'n kumpipa vaihawmte tengteng kiang ah huchi mah bang in agen ding uh. Huchi in nakpi a kisimmohna leh thangpaihna ahong kipankhe ding hi.

Kumpipa deihlam ahihleh, amah a kipan kumpi thupiak pekhia henla, kumpipa Ahasueras ma ah Vasti hong pai nawn het lou ding chih, hihlamdan theih louh ding in, Persia mite leh Media mite dante lak ah gelh in om hen; huan kumpipa'n amah sang a hoihzaw midang khat amah kumpi mun leh mual peleh.
Huchi in kumpipa'n thupiak abawl ding a, gamsung pumpi a akithehzak chiang in, athupi ngal a; zi tengteng in apasalte uh, aliante leh aneute kiang ah zahtakna ape ding uh," chi in.
Huchi in thugen in kumpipa leh lalte akipaksak a; huchi in Memukan thu dungzui in kumpipa'n ahihta hi.

Ama'n lah huai a kigelh dungzui in, kumpipa bial tengteng, bial chiteng leh mi chiteng kiang ah apau uh dungzui in, huchi a michih in ama insung mahmah a dante apuaklut theih a, amite pau dungzui a, athehzak theihna ding in laikhakte akhakta hi.
Huan kumpipa Ahasueras in gam tung leh tuipi tuikulh gam tung ah siah abawlta hi.
Huchi in athilhihtheihna leh ahatna thilhihte tengteng leh Mordekai, kumpipa'n amah akoihsanna, letna genna kim, Media leh Persia kumpipate chiamtehna laibu a gelh ahi kei uh maw?
Juda mi Mordekai, kumpipa zom a Judate lak a lian ahi, a-u anau mi tampi in apom uh ahi. Ama'n mite hoihna ding zong a nasem achipihte tengteng kiang ah lemna thu agen hi.
Hiai thilte zoh in, kumpipa Ahasueras thangpaihna lungkimsak a om in, Vasti bang ahia ahih, asiatna dia bang ahia thupiak chih atheigige hi.
Huchi in anasepsak kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Kumpipa a ding in nungak siangthou tuailai melhoih kizong henla,

kumpipa'n agam a bial tengteng ah heutu sep hen, huaite'n nungak siangthou tuailai tengteng Susa Inpi ah, numeite inn ah, Hegai kumpipa michilgeh numeite kempa in ahon pikhawm theihna ding un; huchi in siansakna ding a thilte uh amau kipeleh.
Huchi in nungak kumpipa lungkimsak pen Vasti sik in kumpinu hi hen," achi uhi. Huai thil in kumpipa alungkimsak a; huchibang in ahihta hi.
Susa Inpi ah Juda mi kuahiam, amin Mordekai, Jair tapa, Shimei tapa, Benjamin mi a-om a;
amah bel Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah kumpipa Jekoniah apimang a om salte toh pimang in a-om uhi.
Ama'n Hadassah, huai tuh Esther, apaneu tanu akem piching hi; ama'n nu leh pa anei kei. Huai nungak akilawm in amel ahoih hi, anu leh pa asih un Mordekai in atanu ding in ala hi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl akizak in, nungak tampi Susa Inpi, Hegai in akaihkhawm a-om lai un, Esther leng kumpipa' inn ah, Hegai, numeite kempa nuai ah ahon pi uhi.

Huchi in nungak in amah alungkimsak a, ama deihsakna angahta a; ama'n siansakna ding in athilte amah ape pah a, atantuante toh, amah piak ding akilawm, kumpipa' inn a kipan nungak sagih toh; amah leh anungakte numeite inn a mun hoihpen ah asuanta hi.
Esther in ahihna agenkhe kei a, atanaute hihna leng agenkhe sam kei hi; Mordekai in lah genkhe lou ding in amah athuhilh ngal a.
Huchi in Mordekai bel niteng in numeite inn mai ah Esther in bangchi in ahih zel a, bang ahong chi dia chih thei ding in ahoh zel hi.

Numeite a dia dan dungzui a kha sawm-le-nih, murrah thau toh kha guk, gimnamtuite toh kha guk leh numeite siansakna ding a thilte toh, huchibang in asiansakna nite hihkim a a-om nung in, nungak chih kumpipa Ahasueras kiang a ava lut hun uh atungta hi.
Nungakte kumpipa kiang a alut chiang un, kumpipa' inn a hohpih ding in numeite omna a kipan adeihdeih uh piak in a-om uhi.

Nitaklam in apai a, azing nawn in numeite inn nihna ah, kumpipa michilgeh Shasgaz, meite kempa inn ah ahong kik a, kumpipa amah ah kipak napi in, kumpipa kiang ah ahong lut kei a, amin a sap in a-om hi.

Huchi a amah atanu ding a lapa, Mordekai paneu Abihail tanu, Esther kumpipa kiang a ava lut hun ahong tun in, Hegai kumpipa michilgeh, numeite kempa a seh chih ngal louh bangmah akan kei hi. Huchi in amah ente tengteng mitmuh in Esther in deihsakna atang hi.
Huchi in Esther kumpipa Ahasueras kiang a kumpi inn ah akha sawmna, Tebeth kha a avaihawm kum sagihna kum in laklut in a-omta hi.

Huchi in kumpipa'n numei tengteng sang in Esther a-it a, nungak siangthoute sang in amitmuh in hehpihna leh deihsakna atang hi. Huchi in alutung ah lallukhu akoih a, Vasti sik in kumpinu ding in amah abawlta hi.

Huchih lai in kumpipa'n avaihawmte tengteng leh asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuang thupi, "Esther Ankuang mahmah," aluita a; bialte kiang ah khawlna abawl a, kumpipa siamna bang zel in, thilpiakte apia hi.
Huchi a nungak siangthoute nihveina dia kaihkhawm a-om lai un, Mordekai bel kumpipa kongpi ah atu hi.
Esther in atanaute leh amite hihna agenkhe kei; amah kiang a khanletsak a om bangtak in Mordekai thupiak bang in ahih hi.
Huai lai a, Mordekai kumpipa kongpi a atut lai in, kumpipa michilgeh lak a nih, Bigthan leh Teresh, kongkhak ngakte aheh ua, kumpipa Ahasueras tung a khut kha ding in azongta uhi.
Huai thil Mordekai in athei a, ama'n kumpinu kiang ah atheisak hi. Esther in Mordekai min in huai akumpipa ahilhta hi.
Huchi in athu akikanleh, huchibang ahi ngei chih akimukhia a, anih un sing dawn ah khailup in a-om uhi. Hiai thu tanchin gelhna laibu ah kumpipa ma ah akigelh hi.
Hiai thilte nung in kumpipa Ahasueras in Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman akaisangsak a, malam anawtsak a, akiang a om vaihawmte tengteng tunglam ah atutphah akoih hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n amah tungtang thu huchibang a apiak bang in kumpipa sikha tengteng, kumpipa kongpi a omte Haman azahna pia in akun uhi. Himahleh Mordekai akun kei a, amah zahna abawl kei hi.
Huchih lai in kumpipa sikhate kumpina kongpi a omte'n, Mordekai kiang ah, "Bangziak a kumpipa thupiak a talek na hia?" achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, niteng a amah ahoupih lai un, amau angaikhe kei a, Mordekai thu pai ding hia pai lou ding chih thei ding in Haman ahilh ua; amah Juda mi ahi chih amaute ahilhta hi.
Huchi a Mordekai niamchik a kun lou in, amah azahtak kei chih Haman in atheih in, aheh mahmah hi.

Himahleh Mordekai tung kia a khut khak bang tham lou in angaihtuah a; Mordekai mite lah amah a-ensakta ngal ua; huchi in Haman in Ahasueras gam pumpi a om Judate tengteng, Mordekai mite, hihgawp ding in azongta hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras vaihawm akum sawm-le-nih ni, akha khatna, Nisan kha in, "Pur," asan ua, huai tuh aisan ahi, Haman ma ah, niteng in, kha teng in, akha sawm-le-nih, Adar kha tan in.

Huan Haman in kumpipa Ahasueras kiang ah, "Mi kuate hiam kithehzak a na gam bial sung tengteng a mite lak a dalh a-om ua; adante uh mi tengteng dan toh akibang kei a; kumpipa dante azui kei uhi. Huaiziak in amaute thuakzoh kumpipa punna ding ahi kei hi.
Kumpipa deihlam ahihleh, hihsiat a a-omna ding un lai kigelhleh, kumpipa nasepna a heutute khut ah ke'n dangka talent singkhat ka pe ding, kumpipa sumbawmte a tawilut ding in," achi hi.
Huchi in akhut a kipan kumpipa'n azungbuh asuah a, Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman, Judate melmapa kiang ah apia hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Haman kiang ah, "Dangka na kiang a piak ahi, mipi leng, amau tung a pha na saksak hih ding in," achi hi.

Huchih lai in akha khatna, ani sawm-le-thum ni in, kumpipa laigelhmite asamlut ua, kumpipa heutu liante leh kumpipa bial chih a omte tengteng leh mi chiteng vaihawmte Haman in thu apiak peuhmah dungzui in akigelhta hi. Bial chih kiang ah huai a kigelh dungzui in, michih kiang ah apau bang zel un; kumpipa Ahasueras min in akigelh a, kumpipa zungbuh in suai akisawn hi.

Huchi in Adar kha, akha sawm-le-nih, ani sawm-le-thum ni mahmah a, ni khat a, Juda mite tengteng atek-akhang naupang noute leh numeite hihsiat ding, that ding leh mangthangsak ding in, kumpipa bial sung tengteng ah dak in laikhakte akhak ua, asum uh gallak a laksak ding in.
Laigelh teisawn, thupiak bial teng a piakkhiak ding leh huai ni a dia mansa a om chiat ding in, mi tengteng kiang ah asuah uhi.
Kumpipa thupiak in dakte kinohtak in asawlkhia ua, Susa Inpi ah thupiak akipekhia hi. Huchi in dawn ding in kumpipa leh Haman atu ua; himahleh Susa khopi ahamhaihsak hi.
Huchi a thil kihih tengteng Mordekai in atheih in, apuante abotkek a, vut toh sai-ip puan asilh a, khopi laizang ah apaikhia a, ngaihtak leh nakpi in akap hi.
Kumpipa kongpi mai pha in ahong pai a, sai-ip puansilh mi kuamah lah kumpipa kongpi sung ah alut thei kei hi.

Huchi in bial chiteng a, koi lai peuh a kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl tunna ah, Judate lak ah nakpitak a suunna, an ngawlna, kahna, mauna a-om hi. Huchi in mi tampi sai-ip puan silh in, vut lak ah alum uhi.
Esther nungakte leh aheutute ahong pai ua athu amah ahilhta uhi. Huchi in kumpinu adah mahmah a, Mordekai silh ding in puansilh akhak a, amah a kipan a asai-ip puan lakhe ding in, himahleh asang kei.
Huchi in Esther in Hatak, kumpipa michilgehte lak a khat asam a, amah vil ding a kumpipa'n aseh, Mordekai kiang a hoh ding in thu apia hi, hiai bang thu ahi, bangziak a hichi ahia chih thei ding in.
Huchibang in kumpipa kongpi mai a om, khopi mun za ah Mordekai kiang ah Hatak ava pawtkhia hi.
Mordekai in atung a tung tengteng thu amah ahilh a, Judate a dia, amaute hihsiatna ding, kumpipa sumbawmte a Haman in dangka sum piak ding a achiam zah geih ahilh hi.

Huai lou leng Esther kiang a lak ding leh akiang a puan ding in amaute hihsiatna ding a Susa a thubawl piakkhiak laigelh kiteisawn amah apia a; kumpipa kiang ava hoh ding a hilh ding in, akiang athumna va bawl ding leh amite a dia, ama a ngetna va bawl ding in.
Huchi in Hatak ahong a Mordekai thute Esther ahilh hi.
Huchih lai in Esther in Hatak kiang ah thu agen a, Mordekai a ding thukhah apia hi.

"Kumpipa sikhate tengteng leh kumpipa bialte a mite'n athei kilkel uhi, mi kuapeuh numei, pasal leng, sap louh a, kumpipa pisa sungnungzaw pen a ahoh uleh, amah a ding in dan khat a-om a, 'Sihsak ding,' chih leh 'Ahing ding,' chi a, kumpipa'n dangka-eng kumpi chiang aletkhumte chih louh ngal, himahleh hiai ni sawmthum sung kumpipa kiang a hong pai ding in sap in ka om nai kei hi," chi in.
Huan Esther thute Mordekai ahilh uhi.
Huchih lai in Mordekai in Esther kiang a dawnna va tun nawn ding in amau achi a, "Juda tengteng sang a, kumpipa insung a nang na suahtak tuan ding kingaihtuah het ke'n.

Nang hiai hun a bangmah gen lou a na daih dideleh, mun dang a kipan in Judate ding in panpihna leh hutkhiakna ahong om ding a, himahleh nang leh na pa inkote na mangthang ding uh: hun hichibang a dia hong lal na hih mel kua'n athei a?"
Huchi in Esther in Mordekai kiang a dawnna va tun ding in amau achi hi.

"Kuan inla, Susa a om Judate tengteng kaikhawm inla kei a ding in an ngawl unla, ni thum, zan hiam sun hiam: nek lah ne kei unla, dawn leng dawn kei un. Huchi mah bang in ke'n leng ka nungakte toh an ka ngawl ding uh; huai chiang in kumpipa kiang ah ka hoh ngeingei ding, dan bang zaw ahi kei a, huchi a ka manleh, mang ka himai ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Mordekai akuan a, Esther in amah thu apiak tengteng bang in agamta hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni in, Esther in akumpi puansilh asilh a, kumpipa' inn zawn a, kumpipa pisa sungnungzaw pen ah ava dingh a; kumpipa bel inn lutna zawn a, kumpi inn ah alaltutphah tung ah atu hi.

Hichibang ahi a, kumpipa'n pisa a kumpinu Esther dingh amuh in, amitmuh in deihsakna atangta: kumpipa'n akhut a om dangka-eng kumpi chiang Esther lam ah alik hi. Huchi in Esther ahong painai a, kumpi chiangdawn ahong khoih hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang na deih a, kumpinu Esther? Na ngetna bang ahia? Gam kimkhat tan leng piak na hi ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Esther in, "Kumpipa'n hoih asakleh tuni in kumpipa leh Haman amah a dia ka bawl an nekna ah hong pai un," achi hi.
Huan kumpipa'n, "Esther gen bang a hih ahihtheihna ding in Haman kinohsak un," achi hi. Huchi in Esther an nekna abawl ah kumpipa leh Haman ahong uhi.
Huan uain adawn lai un kumpipa'n Esther kiang ah, "Bang ahia na thumna? Phal ahihtheihna ding in bang ahia na ngetna? Gam kimkhat tan in leng piak ahi ding,” achi hi.
Esther in adawng a, "Ka thumna leh ka ngetna hiai ahi:

Kumpipa mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, ka thumna phal ding leh ka ngetna bawl ding a kumpipa alungkimleh, kumpipa leh Haman, amau a dia ka bawl ding an nekna ah hong le uh, kumpipa'n achih bang in zingchiang in ka hih ding," achi hi.
Huchi in huai ni in nuamsa leh lung kipak in Haman apaikheta a: himahleh Mordekai kumpipa kongpi a om, Haman in ama a Mordekai dingh lou a tat leng tang lou amuh in, atung ah aheh mahmah hi.
Huchi in leng Haman aki-ip teitei a, inn ah apaita; huan mi asawl a alawmte leh azi Zeresh ahon tonpih hi.
Haman in akiang uah, ahauhsakna thupina leh atate tamdan leh kumpipa'n akaisansakna thil tengteng leh kumpipa sikhate vaihawmte tung a amasak tuamdan agen hi.
Haman in, ahi, "Esther in an nekna abawl ah kumpipa toh kei chih louh ngal mi kuamah ahohsak kei; zingchiang in leng kumpipa toh kei ahon sam hi.
Himahleh Mordekai huai Juda mipa, kumpipa kongpi a tu ka muh lai teng hiaite tengteng kei a ding in bangmah aphatuam kei,” achi lai hi.

Huchi in azi Zeresh leh alawmte'n akiang ah, "Khailupna khuam tong sawmnga a sang kibawl henla, zingsang in nang kumpipa kiang ah thu gen inla, huai a Mordekai khailup ahihtheihna ding in; huchi in vualnuamtak in kumpipa toh an nekna ah na hoh ding uh," achi uhi. Hiai in Haman akipaksak a; huchi in khailupna khuam abawlsakta hi.
Huai zan in kumpipa a-ihmu thei kei; tanchin chiamtehna laibu hon tawi ding in thu apia a, huaite kumpipa ma ah asim uhi.
Kumpipa michilgehte lak a mi nih Bigthan leh Teresh, kongkhak vengte'n, kumpipa Ahasueras tung a khut khak sawmte tanchin Mordekai in agen chih kigelhna muh in a-om hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n, "Hiai ziak in Mordekai tung ah bang zahtakna leh thupina hih in a-om a?" achi hi. Kumpipa sikha amah nasemte'n, "Amah a ding in bangmah hih a-om kei,” achi uhi.
Kumpipa'n, "Pisa a om kua ahia?" achi a. Huchi in Haman, kumpipa' inn pisa ponungzaw ah, kumpipa kiang a abawlkholhsa khailupna khuam a Mordekai khai ding thu gen ding in ahong hi.
Kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in pisa ah Haman adingh nilouh hi," achi ua. Kumpipa'n, "Hong lut heh," achi hi.

Huchi in Haman ahong lut hi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mi kumpipa'n azahtak nop tung ah bang kihih ding ahia?" achi hi. Haman in alungtang in, Kumpipa'n kei sang a pahtawi dia akipahna kua kiang a bawl nuamzaw ahia? achi hi.
Haman in kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa'n apahtawi nopmi a ding in,
kumpipa'n asilh zel kumpi puansilh hon lakhia henla, sakol kumpipa tuan zelna leng, aluzang a lallukhu akoihna zel:

Huchi in puansilh leh sakol kumpipa vaihawmpih thupi penpente lak a khat khut ah pekheleh, huaite akumpipa'n zahtak a-utpa azeptheihna ding un leh khopi kongzing lak ah sakol tung ah tuangsak henla, ama ah, huchibang in kumpipa'n apahtawi nopte kiang ah hih in a-om ding, chi in puang leng," achi hi.

Huai laitak in kumpipa'n Haman kiang ah, "Kin inla, na chih bang in, puansilh leh sakol la inla, kumpipa kongpi a tu zel Juda mi Mordekai tung ah hih in: na gen tengteng bangmah vuaksuak kei hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Haman in puansilh leh sakol ala a, Mordekai azem a, khopi kongzing lak ah atuangsak a, ama ah, "Hichibang in kumpipa'n azahtak nopmi tung a ahih ahi ding,” chi in apuangta hi.
Huan kumpipa kongpi ah Mordekai ahong pai nawn hi. Himahleh Haman bel suun leh alutang khuhsa in a-inn lam ah kintak in apai hi.

Huchi in Haman in azi Zeresh kiang leh alawmte tengteng kiang ah atung a thil tung tengteng agen vek hi. Huaitak in amipilte leh azi Zeresh in akiang ah, "Ama a na puk patna Mordekai, Juda chi a mi ahihleh, amah na zou kei ding, himahleh ama ah na puk ngei ding," achi uhi.
Amah toh ahoulim san lai un, kumpipa michilgehte ahong pai ua, Esther in an nek ding abawlna a ding in kintak in hong pita uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa leh Haman kumpinu Esther toh an nekna ah ahong uhi.
Uain adawn lai un ani nih ni in kumpipa'n Esther kiang ah, "Bang ahia na thumna, kumpinu Esther? Ahon phalsak ding uh bang ahia na ngetna? Gam kimkhat leng piak in na om ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Esther kumpinu'n adawng a, "Aw kumpipa, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan a, kumpipa kipahna ahihleh, ka thumna ah ka hinna leh ka mite hinna piak in om hen:

Zuak in ka omta ua, kei leh ka mite, hihgawp a om ding in, thah a om ding in leh hihmang ding in. Sikhapa ding leh sikhanu ding a zuak a om hi le ung zaw, melma in kumpipa siatna gun bawl theita kei mahleh, dai dide ding hi veng in " achi hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras in thu agen a, kumpinu Esther kiang ah, "Kua ahia, koi a om ahia, huchibang a lungtang sung a tum ngam?" achi hi.
Esther in, "Melma leh gal, hiai giloupa Haman mah," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa leh kumpinu ma ah Haman alauta hi.

Huchi in uain dawnkhamna a kipan aheh ziak in kumpipa adingkhia a, inpi huansung ah alut a; huchi in kumpinu Esther kiang a ahinna ngen ding in Haman adingh hi; kumpipa'n asiatna ding in hoih lou a tup a-om chih lah athei ngal a.

Kumpipa Kulhpi huan a kipan uain an nekna mun ah ahong kik a; huchi in Esther omna tutphah nem tung ah Haman apuk hi. Kumpipa'n, "Inn sung a ka ma a kumpinu nangawn sual ding ahi hia?" achi hi. Kumpipa kam a thupawt bang in, Haman maitang atuamsakta uhi.

Huai lai in kumpipa ma a om zel michilgehte lak a khat, Harbonah in, "En un, Haman in Mordekai, kumpipa gum a thugenpa a dia abawl, khailupna khuam tong sawmnga a sang, Haman inn ah adingh hi," achi hi. Huan kumpipa'n, "Huai ah amah khailum un," achi hi.
Huchi in Mordekai a dia abawlkholhsak khailupna khuam ah Haman akhailumta uhi. Huchi in kumpipa thangpaihna adaita hi.
Huai ni in kumpipa Ahasueras in kumpinu Esther kiang ah Judate melmapa Haman inn apia hi. Kumpipa ma ah Mordekai ahong a; Esther in amah a ding in kua ahia chih agen khinta hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n azungbuh asuah a, Haman a kipan alak, Mordekai kiang ah apeta hi. Esther in Haman inkote tung ah Mordekai akoihta hi.
Esther in kumpipa ma ah thu agen lai a, akhebul a puk in, Agag mi Haman gilou bawl leh Judate siatna ding a alunggel khitsa a lunggelna koihmang ding in khitui toh amah angen ngutngut hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Esther lam ah adangka-eng kumpi chiang alen a. Huchi in Esther athou a kumpipa ma ah adingh hi.

Ama'n, "Kumpipa lungkimna ahih a, amitmuh a deihsakna ka tan a, kumpipa ma a thil dik a alat a, amuh a lungkimhuai ka hihleh, Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman in laikhak abawlte kumpipa bial a om Judate hihsiatna ding a agelh sut in om hen.
Huchi lou in ka mite tung a gilou tung ding ke'n bangchi in ka en ngam dia? Ahihkeileh ka tanaute siatna bangchi in ka mu ngam dia?" achi hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras in kumpinu Esther kiang leh Juda mi Mordekai kiang ah, "Ngai un, Judate tung a akhut akhak ziak in, Haman inkote leh khailupna khuam a akhailuppa uh amah Esther kiang ah apeta hi.

Na deih bang in, kumpipa min in, kumpipa zungbuh a sawn in, Judate kiang ah leng lai gelh un; kumpipa min a lai kigelh, kumpipa zungbuh a kisawn peuhmah, mi kuamah in ahihlamdang thei ngal kei a," achi hi.

Huchi in kumpipa laigelhmite asam ua, akha thumna Sivan kha a, ani sawmnih-le-thum ni in; Judate tungtang thu Mordekai in thu apiak bang in gam heutute kiang leh India a kipan Ethiopia pha a om bialte ukpipate leh vaihawmte, bial zakhat sawmnih-le-sagih, huai a kigelhdan bang zel a bial chiteng kiang, mi chih apau uh dungzui zel in, alaigelh uh bang zel a Judate, apau uh bang zel in akiang uah gelh in a-omta hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras min in agelh a, kumpipa zungbuh in asawn a, kumpipa nasepna a kizangsek sakol man-gang, hoihtak a vulhte a tuang in sakol tung ah dak in laikhakte akhakta hi.

Huai ah kumpipa'n khopi chiteng a om Judate kikhawmkhawm a, ahinna ua dia pang a, amaute sual ding a anau neute uleh anumeite uh, asum uh gallak a la ding a kisa mite leh bial thilhihtheihna hihse ding leh mangthangsak ding in phalna apia hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras bial tengteng ah ni khat in, huai bel, akha sawm-le-nih, Adar kha ahi a, ani sawm-le-thum ni geih in.
Bial chih a piak ding chi a thupiak, kigelh a teisawn mite tengteng kiang ah suah in a-om a, huai ni chiang a Judate'n amelmate uh tung a phu la dia mansa a a-om chiat theihna ding un.
Huchi in dak kumpipa nasepna a zat sakol man-gangte tung a tuangte apaikhia ua, kumpipa thupiak in amau anoh in akhawksak ngal ua; thupiak pen Susa Inpi a piakkhiak ahi.
Huchi in Mordekai bel kumpi puandum leh kang, dangka-eng lallukhu thupitak toh, puanaktual puanmalngat hoih leh sandup toh kumpipa ma a kipan apaikheta hi: Susa khopi akikou a, akipak hi.
Huchi in Judate'n kouzanna leh kipahna, nopna leh zahna anei uhi.

Bial chih leh khopi chih a koi lai peuh a kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl paina peuh ah, Judate'n ankuangluina leh ni hoih kipahna leh nopna anei uhi. Huchi in gam a mite lak a tampite Judate ahong hi ua; Judate launa lah atung uah ahong omta hi.

Huan akha sawm-le-nih, Adar kha, huai mah ani sawm-le-thum ni, kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl tangtunna ding ahong nai lai in, Judate melmate'n atung ua vaihawmna neih akilamet ni uh; hinapi a, ahilou lam a hong kilehbut a, Judate'n amau mudahte tung a vaihawmna ahon neih lai un;

Kumpipa Ahasueras bial tengteng akhopite uah Judate, amau siatna zongte tung a khut kha ding in, akikhawmkhawm ua: kuamah in lah amaute anangzou kei uhi; mite tengteng tung ah lah amaute launa ahong omta hi.
Huchi in bialte a vaihawmte leh gamuk mite leh ukpipate leh kumpipa nasemte'n, Judate apanpih ua; Mordekai launa lah atung uah ahong om ngal a.
Kumpipa' inn ah Mordekai athupi a, bial tengteng ah amin athangkheta hi: hiai mipa Mordekai lah ahong thupi semsem hi.
Huchi in namsau a sat in Judate'n amelmate tengteng athat ua, thahna leh hihsiatna in, amaute mudahte tung ah ahih ding uh ahihta uhi.
Susa Inpi ah Judate'n mi zanga athat ua ahihgawp uhi.
Parsandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,
Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,
Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, Vajezathate,
Judate melmapa Hammedatha tapa Haman tapate, athat ua; himahleh gallak ah akhut uh anga kei uhi.
Huai ni in Susa Inpi a thah a om zah kumpipa ma ah ahon tawi uhi.

Huan kumpipa'n kumpinu Esther kiang ah, "Judate'n Susa Inpi sung ah mi zanga athat ua ahihsia uh, Haman tapa sawmte toh; kumpipa bial dangte ah bang achi bawlta phet ding uam ah: Khai le, bang ahia na nget? Na kiang ah phal ahi ding; ahihkeileh bang ngetbeh na nei lai a? Suk pichin ahi ding," achi hi.
Esther in, "Kumpipa' lungkimna ahihleh, zingchiang a tuni a thupiak bangbang a gamtang ding in Susa a om Judate phal inla, Haman tapa sawmte khailupna khuam ah kikhai le uh," achi hi.
Huchi in huchibang a hih ahi ding chi in kumpipa'n thu apia hi: Susa ah thubawl akipekhia a: huchi in Haman tapa sawmte akhaita uhi.
Adar kha mah ani sawm-le-li ni in Susa a om Judate akikhawmkhawm ua, Susa ah mi zathum athat uh; himahleh gallak tung ah akhut uh anga kei uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa bialte a om Juda dangte akikhawmkhawm ua, ahinna uh ahum ua, amelmate ua kipan khawlna anei ua, amau mudahte lak ah mi singsagih-le-sangnga athat ua; himahleh gallak tung ah akhut uh anga kei uh.
Adar kha ani sawm-le-thum ni in hiai tuh hih ahi; huai mah ani sawm-le-li ni in akhawl ua, ankuanglui ni leh kipahna ni in azang uhi.
Himahleh Susa a om Judate akikhawm ua, ani sawm-le-thum ni in leh ani sawm-le-li ni in; huai mah ani sawm-le-nga ni in akhawlta ua, ankuanglui ni leh kipahna ni in azang uhi.
Huaiziak in khoneute a Judate, kho kulhbaang nei lou a tengte'n, Adar kha ani sawm-le-li ni kipahna ni leh ankuanglui ni in, ni hoih, khat-le-khat tantuan kikhaktuahna ni in azang uhi.
Huan Mordekai in hiai thilte agelh a, kumpipa Ahasueras bial tengteng a om Judate, gamla leh nai a omte kiang ah akhak hi.
Kum teng a, Adar kha ani sawm-le-li leh ani sawm- le-nga ni, kum teng a tan ding ahilhna ding in,

Judate amelmate ua kipan akhawl ni uh, amau a dia lungkhamna kipahna ahong hihna kha, misi suunna ni hoih ahong hihna kha bang in: huai nite ankuangluina leh kipahna ni a a-om ua, tantuante khat-le-khat akikhaktuah uhi; gentheite kiang a thilpiakte piakna aneihtheihna ding un.
Huchi in Judate'n apatkhitsa bang un leh Mordekai in amaute kiang a agelh khitsa bang in hih ding in atheisiam uhi.

Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman, Juda tengteng melmapa'n Juda tengteng siatna ding amau hihse ding, angaihtuah a, amaute hihgawp ding leh amaute hihse ding a, Pur, (huai tuh aisan ahi) ana paih ziak in.

Himahleh athu kumpipa ma ahong tun in, angaihtuah gilou, Judate siatna ding a angaihtuah, ama lutung mahmah a kibung ding in laikhakte in thu apeta a; huchi a amah leh atapate khailupna khuam a khai a a-omna ding un.
Huchibang ahih ziak in hiai nite Pur min zui in Purim asa uhi. Huaiziak in hiai laikhak thute tengteng ziak leh hiai thu tungtang thu amuhsa uh, atung ua ahong tun ziak in.

Judate'n ahihkip ua, amau tung leh asuante uh tung leh amaute huchibang akizomkhawm bangte tengteng tung ah akisuanta uhi, huchi a pel lou a, huai a laigelh dungzui leh huai a hun sehsa dungzui a, kum chiteng a hiai ni nihte atantheihna ding un.

Huchi a hiai nite akhang-akhang a, a-inkuankuan a, bial chiteng leh khopi chiteng atheihgigeleh tan a a-omtheihna ding in; huchi a hiai Purim nite Judate lak a kipan a azuau louh a, huaite theihgigena leng asuante uh a kipan amanlouhna ding in.
Huchi in kumpinu Esther, Abihail tanu leh Juda mi Mordekai in, hiai Purim laikhak nihna sukkipna ding in thuneihna tengteng in agelhta uhi.
Judate tengteng kiang ah, Ahasueras gam a bial zakhat sawmnih-le-sagihte kiang ah, lungmuanna leh thutak thute, laikhakte akhakta hi.

Hiai Purim nite a hun asehsa uh, Juda mi Mordekai leh kumpinu Esther in huaite pha asak uh dungzui leh amau a ding leh asuante uh a dia, an ngawlna leh akahna thu ua ana hihkip bang ua hihkip ding in.
Esther thupiak in hiai Purim thute ahihkip a; laibu ah kigelh ahita hi.
Aigupta gam a hong lut Israel suante, michih leh a-inkote Jakob toh hong tonte min hiaite ahi:
Reuben, Simeon, Levi leh Judah,
Issakar, Zebulun leh Benjamin,
Dan leh Naphtali, Gad leh Asher,
Jakob khal a pan hong pawtkhia mi tengteng sawmsagih ahi uhi. Joseph bel Aigupta gam ah ana om khinta hi.
Joseph leh a-unau tengteng leh asuan tengteng leng asita uhi.
Israel suante'n gah asuang ua, tampi in akhang ua, ahong kibehlap zel ua, hat petmah in ahong hatkhia ua; agam hong dimta uhi.
Joseph thei lou, Aigupta gam ah kumpi thak ahong omta hi.
Ama'n amite kiang ah, "En un, Israel suante ei sang in atamzaw ua, ahatzaw uhi.

Kisa un, piltak in amaute i bawl ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw ahong kibehlap semsem ding ua, huan, hichi ahong hi ding a, kidouna ahong om chiang in, i melmate lam ah apang ding ua, ei ahon dou kha ding uh, huchi in gam apawtsan kha ding uh," achi hi.
Huaiziak in puakgikte a amau hihgim ding in atung uah nasem heutu akoihta uhi. Huchi in Pharaoh a ding in khopite, Pithom leh Rameses alamta uhi.
Himahleh amau ahihgim semsem uleh, akibehlap semsem ua, akhang semsem uhi. Huchi in Aiguptate'n Israel suante alau mahmah uhi.
Huaiziak in Aiguptate'n Israel suante gimtak in nna asemsak uhi.
Nasep haksa in ahinna uh nuamloutak in abawlsak ua, buanman leh teklei bawl in gamlak a nna chiteng sem in, nakpitak in nna asemsak uhi.
Aigupta kumpipa'n Hebru naudom mite kiang ah thu agen a, huaite lak a khat min Siprah ahi a, adang khat min Puah ahi.
"Hebru numeite lak a nau na dop chiang un, tutphah tung ah en unla, tapa ahihleh na that ding ua, tanu ahihleh bel na hawi ding uh,” achi hi.
Himahleh naudom mite'n Pathian alau ua, Aigupta kumpipa'n thu apiak bang a hih lou in, pasal naupangte ahinghawi uhi.
Aigupta kumpipa'n naudom mite asamsak a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a hiai thilhih a pasal naupangte hinghawi na hi ua?" achi hi.
Naudom mite'n Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hebru numeite zaw Aigupta numeite bang ahih louh ziak un, atei ngal ua, naudom mite akiang uh atun ma un ana nei khin man zel uh," achi uhi.
Huaiziak in Pathian in naudom mite a-angvan a, huchi in mite ahong kibehlap ua, ahat mahmah uhi.
Huchi in naudom mite'n Pathian alauh ziak un inkuante abawlsakta hi.
Pharaoh in asikha tengteng thu pia in, "Tapa hong piang peuhmah lui ah na pai ding ua, tanu hong piang peuhmah na hinghawi ding uh," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Pharoah kiang ah va lut in. Ama a hiai ka chiamtehnate ka etsak theihna ding in alungtang, asikhate lungtang toh ka khauhsak ahi.
Na tapa bil leh na tapa' tapa bil a, Aigupta gam a bang thil ahia ka hih, alak ua chiamtehna ka hihte na gen theih a, TOUPA ka hi chih na theihna ding un,” achi hi.
Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron alut ua, akiang ah, "Hebrute TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Bang tan vei ka ma a kiniamkhiak nial lai ding na hia? Ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.'
Huchi ahih kei a, ka mite paisak na nialleh ngai in, na tuipiau ah zingchiang in khaukhup ka hon sawl ding hi.
Lei mai atuam ding ua, mite'n lei amu thei kei ding. Asuakta bang ane ding ua, gial in ahon hawisak teng, lou a pan nang a dia singpou chiteng ane ding uh.

Na innte uah adim ding ua, na sikhate innte leh Aiguptate innte leh leitung om a pan tuni tan a na pate, na pate uh pate un amuh ngei louh uh," achi uhi. Huchi in akihei a, Pharaoh a pan apawtkheta hi.

Pharaoh sikhate'n akiang ah, "Bang tan hiai mipa ei a dia thang hi ding ahia? Mite paisak mai in, TOUPA a Pathian uh nna aseptheihna ding un. Aigupta hihsiat a omta ahi, chih thei nai lou na hi hia?" achi uhi.
Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron ahon pi nawn ua; ama'n akiang uah, “Pai un, TOUPA na Pathian uh nna va sem un. Himahleh apai dingte kuate ahi ua?" achi hi.
Mosi in, "Ka naupangte uh toh, ka tekte uh toh, ka tapate uleh ka tanute uh, ka ganhonte uleh ka belamhonte uh toh ka pai ding uhi, TOUPA kiang a ankuangluina nei ding ka hih ziak un," achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "TOUPA na kiang uah om hen, na numeite uh leh na nau neute uh ka hon paisakleh, en mah un, na ma uah gilou a-om hi.
Huchi hilou e, nou pasal piching teng kuan unla, TOUPA nna va sem un. Huai lah na ut ngal ua,” achi hi. Huchi in Pharaoh a pan delhkhiak in a-om uhi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tung ah khaukhupte ahong omna ding in na khut zankhia in. Aigupta gam a ahong paitouh ua, gam a haichi teng, gial in ahawi teng tanpha anektheihna ding un,” achi hi.
Mosi in Aigupta gam tung ah achiangkhun alik a, TOUPA'Nhuai ni nitum in leh huai zankhua in suahlam huih anungsak a; zingsang ahong hih in suahlam huih in khaukhup ahon tunta hi.

Huchi in Aigupta gam tengteng tung ah khaukhupte a-om ua, Aigupta gam tengteng ah akhawl ua: achimtakhuai mahmah uhi. Amalam uah huchibang khaukhup a-om ngei kei a, anunglam uah leng huchibang a-om kei ding hi.

Lei mai tengteng atuam ziak un, gamsung amialta hi. Gam a haichi gial in ahawite, singgahte toh ane uhi. Huchi in singte ah hiam, lou a haichite ah hiam leng thil hing a-omta kei, Aigupta gamsung teng ah.
Huaitak in Pharaoh in kintak in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "TOUPA na Pathian leh noute tung ah ka na khialta hi.
Huaiziak in tu in ka hon ngen ahi. Tutung kia hiai ka khelhna ngaidam inla, kei a pan hiai sihna alakmang theihna ding in, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah ngen in," achi hi.
Huchi in Pharaoh a pan apaikheta a, TOUPA kiang ah angenta hi.
TOUPA'n suahlam huih hat mahmah akhahta a, huai in khaukhupte alamang a, Tuipi San ah ahawllutta hi. Huchi in Aigupta gam tengteng ah khaukhup khat leng a-omta kei hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, Israel suante apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tung a khomial, theihtheih ding khop mial sah a- omtheihna ding in, van lam ah na khut liktou in," achi hi.
Mosi in van lam ah akhut aliktou a; huchi in ni thum ah khomial sung Aigupta gam m tengteng bikbek a-omta hi.
Kuamah akimutuah kei ua, a-omna ua pan kuamah ni thum sung athoukhe kei uh; himahleh Israel suante tenna ah khua avak hi.
Pharaoh in Mosi asam a, "Pai un, TOUPA nna sem un. Na bawnghonte leh na ganhonte uh kia om uhen. Na nau neute un leng hon zui uhen," achi hi.
Himahleh Mosi in, “TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a ka kithoihtheihna ding un, kithoihnate leh halmang thillatte leng na hon piak ngeingei ding ahi.

Ka bawnghonte un leng ahon zuih ding uh ahi. Nunglam ah khechin khat lel leng nutsiat ahi kei ding; huaite a pan TOUPA ka Pathian uh nna sepna dia ka lak ding uh ahih ziak in. Huai mun ka tun masiah uh, bang in ahia TOUPA nna ka sep ding uh, ka thei kei uh," achi hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, amau apaisak nuam kei.
Huchi in Pharaoh in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a pan paimang in. Ka mel mu nawn lou ding in pilvang in, ka mel na muh nini a si ding lah na hih ngal a," achi hi.
Mosi in, "Na gen bang in, na mel ka mu nawn kei ding,” achi hi.

Huan TOUPA’N Mosi kiang ah, “Pharoah tung leh Aigupta gam tung ah gawtna khat ka tun lai ding. Huai khit chiang in hiai a pan ahon paisakta ding hi. Ahon paisak chiang in, hon hawlkhe siang sipsip ding hi.
Tu in mite zak in thu gen inla, pasal chih in a-inveng kiang ah ngen hen. Numei chih in a-inveng kiang ah dangka suangmantamte leh dangka-eng suangmantamte ngen hen," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Aiguptate mitmuh in mite deihsakna apia hi. Huai lou in Aigupta gam ah, Pharaoh sikhate mitmuh leh mite mitmuh in Mosi athupi mahmah hi.
Mosi in, "Hiai bang in TOUPA'N achi, zankim chiang in Aigupta gamsung teng ka tawnsuak ding hi.
Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, alaltutphah a tu Pharaoh tapa upapen a pan buhhek a om sikhanu ta masapen leh ganta piang masa tengteng asi ding uhi.
Aigupta gam pumpi ah kahna thupitak a-om ding a, huchibang om ngei nai lou, huchibang om ngei nawn lou ding.
Himahleh Israel suante lak a kuamah siatna ding in, mi hiam ganta hiam siatna ding in ui in alei atangsak kei ding a; TOUPA'N Aiguptate leh Israel akhentuamdan na thei ding hi.

Huai hun chiang in ka kiang ah na milian tengteng ahong paisuk ding ua, ahong kun ding ua, 'Nang hon zui mi tengteng toh paikhia un' ahong chi ding uh. Huai khit chiang in ka paikhe ding," chi in hehtak in Pharaoh a pan Mosi apaikhia hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ka thillamdangte Aigupta gam a apunna ding in Pharaoh in ahon ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
Mosi leh Aaron in Pharaoh ma ah hiai thillamdang tengteng ahihta ua; TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, gam a kipan Israel suante apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
TOUPA'N Aigupta gam ah Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah thu agen hi.
Hiai kha noute a dia khate kipatna ahi ding. Noute a ding in kum khat a akha masapen ahi ding hi.
Israel omkhawmte kiang ah thu gen in, hiai kha ani sawm ni in apipute inkuan dungzui zel in, michih in amah a ding in belamnou akilak chiat dia, inn khat zel a ding in belamnou khat zel.
Belamnou khat a dia inkuan atawm luatleh, ami phazah dungzui in amah leh a-inn zom a-invengte a toh lakhawm hen. Michih in akham ding bang zel in belamnou na sim ding uhi.
Na belamnou uh gensiatbei, apa kum khat a upa ahi dia; belamhon lak hiam kelte lak a pan in hiam na lakhe ding uhi.
Huai kha mah ani sawm-le-li tan na kem ding ua; nitaklam in Israel khawmpi omkhawmte'n agou ding uhi.
Asisan na la ding ua, anekna ding uh inn kongkhak biang khuam nihte ah leh kongkhak tung ah na tat ding uhi.
Huai zan in sa mei a haimin, tanghou silngou soh louh toh na ne ding uhi; lou kha toh na ne ding uhi.
Sialnek kei unla, tuihuan het kei un, alutang, akhete leh asungkua toh mei ah na haimin zaw ding uhi.
Azingchiang tan in bangmah na valsak kei ding uhi. Azingchiang tan a omlaite mei in na haltum ding uhi.
Hichibang in na ne ding uhi. Na kawng uh gaksa in, na khedap uh na khe ua bulhsa in, na khut ua na chiangkhunte uh tawisa in na kin nek ding uhi. Hiai TOUPA Paikan Ankuang ahi.
Tuzan chiang a Aigupta gamsung tawnsuak a, Aigupta gam a piang masa teng, mi leh ganta that ding ka hih ziak in, Aigupta pathiante tengteng siatna ding in ka vaihawm ding hi: Kei TOUPA ka hi.

Sisan tuh noute a ding in na omna innte uah chiamtehna ahi ding. Sisan ka muh chiang in, ka hon paikan ding, Aigupta gam ka gawt chiang in, nou hon hihse ding in na tung uah hiai gawtna a-om kei ding hi.
Hiai ni noute a ding in theihgige ahi ding. Na khang na khang un TOUPA kiang a ankuangluina in na nei ding ua; tangtawn in dan thuseh a ankuangluina in na nei ding uhi.

"Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ua; ani masapen ni ngei in na innte ua pan in silngou na koihmang ding uhi. Ani masapen ni a kipan ani sagih ni tan, tanghou silngou soh ne peuhmah, huai mi Israel a pan satkhiak ding ahi ngal a.

Ani masapen ni in kikhopna siangthou a-om dia, ani sagih ni in noute a ding in kikhopna siangthou a-om ding. Huai nite in nek bawl chih louh ngal nna sep louh himhim ding ahi. Nekbawl kia na hihthei ding uh.
Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina na tang ding ua; hiai ni mah a Aigupta gam a kipan na mite ka pikhiak ziak in. Huaiziak in tangtawn in na khang un dan thuseh in hiai ni na tang ding uh ahi.
Akha khatna ah, huai kha ani sawm-le-li ni, nitaklam a kipan huai kha nitaklam ani sawmnih-le-khat matan in, tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uhi.
Na insung uah ni sagih sung silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei. Kuapeuh silngou soh ne, huai mi ngei mikhual hiam hi in, agamsung a piang hitaleh Israel omkhawmte a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
Silngou soh bangmah na ne ding uh ahi kei. Na tenna peuhmah uah tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uhi," achi hi.
Mosi in Israel upate asamsak a, akiang uah, “Na inkuan dungzui zel un belamnou kaikhia in kilak unla, Paikan Belamnou gou un," achi hi.

"Hissop gaklop na la ding ua, belkuang sung a om sisan ah na diah ding ua, belkuang sung a om sisan in kongkhak biang khuam tuak leh kongkhak tung na zep ding uhi. Zingsang masiah na lak ua kuamah a- inn kongkhak ah ava pawtkhe ding ahi kei;

Aiguptate that dia TOUPA hong paisuak ding ahih ziak in. Kongkhak tung a leh kongbiang khuam nihte a sisan amuh chiang in TOUPA'N huai kongkhak apaikan dia, hon that ding in na insung uah hihsemi hong lut aphal kei ding hi.
Tangtawn in na tapate uh a ding leh noute a ding in dan thuseh in hiai thil na tang ding uh ahi.
Huan achiam bang a, nou ahon piak ding gam na tun chiang un, hichi ahi ding a, hiai biakna thilzek in na nei ding uh ahi.
Hichi ahong hi ding a, na tate un na kiang ua, hiai biakna thilzek bang na chihna uh ahia? ahon chih chiang un,
'Aiguptate athah a, ei innte atatkhiak lai a, Aigupta gam a Israel suante innte paikanpa, TOUPA paikanna theihgigena ahi, " na chi ding uh. Huchi in mite'n alu uh akunsak ua abeta uhi.
Israel suante apaimang ua, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron thu apiak bang in ahih ua, huchibang in amau leng ahihta uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, zankim lai in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, alaltutphah tung a tu Pharaoh ta masapen a pan suangkul sung a om sal ta masapen tan in, ganhon nou masapen teng toh athatta hi.
Huchi in zan in Pharaoh athou a, amah leh asikhate leh Aigupta tengteng, Aigupta gamsung teng ah kahna thupitak a-omta a; inn khat mahmah mi khat sihlouhna a-om louh ziak in.
Zan in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Thou unla, ka mite lak a pan paikhia un. Noute gel leh Israel suante pai un. Na gensa bang un, TOUPA nna va sem un.
Na bawnghonte uleh na ganhonte uh leng, na chih bang un, pi unla, paikhia un. Huchi in kei leng hon vualzawl un," achita hi.
Kintak a gam a pan asawlkhiak theihna ding un Aiguptate'n mite anoh mahmah ua, "Si khin vek ding i hi uh," achih ziak un.
Mite'n atangbuang uh silngou soh ma in ala ua, aliangzang uah atangbuang haihnate uh puan a khihsawn in.
Mosi thu bang in Israel suante a-omta ua; Aiguptate dangka suangmantam leh dangka-eng suangmantam leh puansilh angen uhi.
Aiguptate mitmuh in TOUPA'N mite deihsakna apia a, adeih bang un huai thilte akiang uah apia uhi. Huchi in Aiguptate alok uhi.
Israel suante Rameses a pan Sukkoth atung ua, numei leh naupangte sim louh pasal ngen khe a pai nuaiguk ahi uhi.
Mikihelte'n leng bawnghonte, ganhonte leh ganta tampi petmah toh amaute azuitou uhi.

Aigupta gam a kipan apuakkhiak uh tangbuangte mek in silngou soh louh tanghou abawl ua, amaute Aigupta gam a kipan kintak a hawlkhiak a om, akizekaisak theih louh ziak un, atanghou uah silngou asoh man kei ua, lamkal a nek ding leng abuaipih man kei uhi.
Huchibang in Aigupta gam a teng, Israel suante taam sung kum zali-le-sawmthum ahi.
Kum zali-le-sawmthum bei in hichi ahong hi a, huai ni ngei in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a pan TOUPA mi tengteng apaikheta uhi.
Aigupta gam a kipan amau apikhiak ziak in TOUPA a ding in huai zan zahtak petmah a tan ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA zan Israel suante'n akhang-akhang a, pilvangtak a atan ding uh ahi.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "Hiai Paikan Ankuang zat ding a dan thuseh ahi. Mikhual in hiai anek louh ding ahi.
Himahleh michih sikha sum a leisa, azek na sum nung in hiai ane thei ding hi.
Gamdangmi leh sikha goihmi in hiai ane ding ahi kei hi.
Inn khat a nek ding ahi; inn polam ah sa, abangmah na lathang ding uh ahi kei. Aguh leng na hihtan ding uh ahi kei.
Israel omkhawmte tengteng in hiai azuih ding uh ahi.

Na kiang ua mikhual a-om a, TOUPA a dia Paikan Ankuang a-um dingleh, pasalte zek sum ding ahi, huai khit chiang in hong pai nai uhenla, um uhen. Amah gamsung a piang bang ahi ding; zeksum louh mi in anek louh ding ahih ziak in.
Khotual mi a ding leh na lak ua mi khual taam a ding in dan khat a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
Huchibang in Israel suan tengteng in ahih uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron thu apiak bang in ahih uhi.
Huai ni mah in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawlpi in apikheta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
"Piang masapen tengteng, Israel suante lak a sul hong peuhmah, mihing hi in ganta hitaleh siangthou in sehtuamsak in, kei' a ahi," achi hi.

Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Hiai ni theigige un, Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtkhiak ni uh, saltanna inn a pan na hong pawtkhiak ni uh ahi; TOUPA'N khut thahat a hiai mun hon tun lah ahi ngal a. Tanghou silngou soh nek louh ding ahi.
Hiai ni, Abib kha in na hong paikhia uhi.

Hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA'N Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam nou hon piak dia, na pipute uh kiang a, akichiamna, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ahon tut chiang in, hiai biakna thilzek hiai kha in na tang ding uhi.
Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ua, ani sagih ni in TOUPA a ding in ankuangluina a-om ding ahi.
Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh akine dia; na kiang uah tanghou silngou soh akimu ding ahi kei. Na omna tengteng uah leng silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei hi.
Huai ni in na tapa na hilh ding a, 'Aigupta gam a pan ka hong paikhiak lai a TOUPA'N kei a dia athilhih ziak a hiai kihih ahi' na chi ding hi.
Na ban ah nang a ding in chiamtehna ahi dia, na mitte kikal ah theihgigena, huchi a na kam a TOUPA dan a-omtheihna ding in TOUPA'N ban thahat a Aigupta gam a pan noute ahon pikhiak ziak in.
Huaiziak in kum teng in ahunbi in hiai dan thuseh na zui ding uh ahi."
"Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N, nang kiang leh na pipute kiang a, akichiam bang a, Kanaante gam ahon tut chiang in, hiai ahon piak chiang in,
TOUPA a ding in sul hong tengteng na koihtuam ding a, na neih ganta a pan hong om, anou masapen teng; apate TOUPA a ahi ding uhi.
Sabiltungnou masapen teng belamnou in na tankhe dia; huchi a na tatkhiak keileh, angawng na hektan ding. Na tapate lak a mihing tapa masa tengteng na tankhe ding ahi.

Hun hong tung ding ah hichi ahi ding a, na tapa in, 'hiai bang ahia? chi a hon dot chiang in, nang akiang ah, ban thahat in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan, koltanna inn a pan ahon lakheta' akiang ah na chi ding uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh in genhaktak a hon paisak nop louh lai in, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, mihing apiang masate leh ganta apiang masate athat hi. Huaiziak in pasal, sul hong tengteng, TOUPA kiang a ka lat ahi ua; himahleh ka tapate lak a piang masa tengteng ka tankhia hi.
Huchi in na khut ah chiamtehna ding ahi dia, na mitte kikal a khaukhip ahi ding; TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ban thahat a ahon pikhiak ziak in," na chi ding hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh in huai mite apaisak lai in, naizaw mahleh Pathian in Philistiate gam tawn in api kei hi. Pathian in, "Kidouna amuh chiang un mite akisik kha ding ua, Aigupta gam ah akiheikik kha ding uh," achih ziak in.
Huchi in Pathian in mite apikual a, Tuipi San gamdai lampi tawn in api hi. Huchibang in Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawlpawl a kizom in apaitou uhi.
Mosi in Joseph guhte apua hi. "Pathian in pel lou in ahong veh dia; hiai a pan ka guhte na puak ding uh ahi," chi a Israel suante chihtaktak a, akichiam ziak in.
Sukkoth a pan azinkheta ua, gamdai zul ah, Etham mun ah agiak uhi.

TOUPA ama uah sun in meipi khuampi dingh in, amaute lampi a pi ding in apai a; zan in meikuang khuampi dingh in, amaute vakna pe ding in; sun leh zan in apai hi; huchi a sun leh zan a apaitheihna ding un.
Mite ma a pan sun a meipi khuampi dingh hiam ahihkeileh zan a meikuang khuampi dingh alamang ngei kei hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi.
"Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in, kihei uhenla, Pi-hahiroth ma ah, Migdol leh tuipi kikal ah, Baal-zephon zawntak ah giak uhen. Ama ah tuipi kiang ah na giak ding uh ahi.
Israel suante tungtang thu, gamdai in adaltan ziak in gamsung ah tang in abuaigawp uh, Pharaoh in chi ding ahi.

Amaute nungdelh ding in Pharaoh lungtang ka khauhsak ding. Pharaoh tung leh asepaihte tung ah zahtak in ka om ding hi. Huchi a Aiguptate'n TOUPA ka hi, chih atheihna ding un," achi hi. Huchibang in Israel suante'n ahihta uhi.

Mite apaikheta uh, chih Aigupta kumpipa ahilh uhi. Pharaoh lungtang leh asikhate lungtang mite siatna ding in hei in a-om hi. "Eite nna asepna ua pan Israel i paisak uh, bangziak a hiai hih i hi ua!" achi uhi.
Akangtalai amansak a, amite atonpihta hi.
Kangtalai hoihpen zaguk, Aigupta gam a kangtalai tengteng leh aheutute chiat uh toh atonpih hi.
TOUPA'N Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a; Israel suante anungdelhta hi. Israel suante hangsantak in apaikheta uhi.
Himahleh Aiguptate'n Pharaoh sakol tengteng leh kangtalai tengteng, sakol tungtuang mite leh sepaih pawlte toh anungdelh ua, Baal-zephon ma a Pi-hahiroth pam a tuipi kiang a agiahna uah aphata uhi.
Pharaoh in ahon naih lai in, Israel suante adaktou ua, ngai in, Aiguptate'n amau ahon delhta uhi. Alau mahmah ua, Israel suante TOUPA kiang ah akapkhia uhi.
Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam a han a-om louh ziak a gamdai a si dia hon pikhia na hi maw! Bang achia hichibang a hon bawl dia Aigupta gam a kipan hon pikhia na hia?
Aigupta gam a ka hon hilh uh hiai thu ahi kei maw? Om maimai ni, Aiguptate nna i septheihna ding in," chi in. "Gamdai a ka sih sang ua, koute a dia Aiguptate nasep ahoih zawk ding ziak in," achi uhi.
Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Lau kei unla, dingh dinden un, TOUPA hotdamna tuni a nou ahon etsak ding en un; tuni a na muh uh Aiguptate tangtawn a mu nawn lou ding na hih ziak un.
TOUPA'N nou a ding in ahon dousak dia, na pau kei ding uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Bang achia ka kiang a kap na hia? Malam a apaina ding un, Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in.
Na chiangkhun lik inla, tuipi tung ah na khut zankhia in, kikhensak in. Huchi in Israel suante tuipi laizang ah leihul ah apaisuak ding uhi.
Ngai in, ke'n Aiguptate lungtang ka khauhsak ding a; amaute adelhzui ding uhi. Pharaoh tung ah, akangtalaite tung ah leh asakol tungtuang mite tung ah zahtakhuaina ka kimuh ding hi.
Pharaoh tung, akangtalaite tung leh asakol tungtuang mite tung a zahtakhuaina ka kimuh chiang in, kei TOUPA ka hi, chih Aiguptate'n athei ding uh," achi hi.
Israelte giahphual ma a pai, Pathian angel akisuan a, anunglam uah apai a; amailam ua kipan meipi dingh akisuan a, anunglam uah adinghta hi.

Aiguptate giahphual leh Israelte giahphual kikal ah ahong omta a; amaute a ding in meipi leh khomial ahi a; himahleh zan in hiaite a ding in vak apia hi; huchi a zankhua a kuamah kinaihtuah thei zaw sam a-omlouhna ding un.
Mosi in tuipi tung ah akhut azankhia a; TOUPA'n zankhua in suahlam huih hat in tuipi apaikiksak a, gam hul in tuipi abawl a, tuite akikhenta hi.
Tuipi lak a gam hul tung ah Israel suante apai ua; akhut taklam uh leh akhut veilam uah amau a ding in tuite baang ahong hita uhi.
Aiguptate'n adelh ua, Pharaoh sakol tengteng, akangtalai tengteng leh asakol tungtuangmi tengteng nangawn tuipi lak ah amau nung ah apailut uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, zingsang ahong hihtak in TOUPA'N meikuang khuampi dingh leh meipi khuampi dingh kawm ah Aigupta sepaihte lam a-en a, Aigupta sepaihte ahihbuaita hi.
Akangtalai khete uh alakkhiaksak a, haksapi in ahawl ua; Aiguptate'n, "Israelte ma a pan taikek ni; amaute a ding in TOUPA'N lah Aiguptate siatna ding in adousak ngal a," achi uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aiguptate tung leh akangtalaite tung leh asakol tungtuang mite tung a tuite ahong kizop nawn theihna ding in, tuipi tung ah na khut zankhia in," achi hi.
Mosi in tuipi tung ah akhut azankhia a, zingsang ahong hih in tuipi ahatna ah ahong kik nawn a; Aiguptate alak ah ataikek ua; tuipi lak ah TOUPA'N Aiguptate athalpaihta hi.
Tuite ahong kik nawn ua, kangtalaite, sakol tungtuang mite leh Pharaoh sepaih anung ua hong lut tengteng tui in akhuhta hi. Alak uah khat lel leng dam a suakta a-om kei uh.
Himahleh tuipi lak ah gam hul tung ah Israel suante apai ua; akhut taklam uleh, aveilam uah tuite amaute a ding in baang ahita hi.
Huchibang in TOUPA'N huai ni in Aiguptate khut a pan Israelte ahondamta hi. Israelte'n tuipi piau ah Aiguptate' misi amu uhi.
Aiguptate tung a anasep thupi Israelte'n amu ua, huchi in TOUPA leh asikha Mosi agingtata uhi.
Huai khit in Mosi leh Israel suante'n TOUPA kiang ah hiai la asa uhi: Thupitak a avualzoh ziak in, TOUPA kiang ah la ka sa ding. Sakol leh atung a tuangmi tuipi ah apaikheta.
TOUPA ka hatna leh ka la ahi, ka hotdamna ahong hi a; ka Pathian ahi, omna ka bawlsak ding. Ka pa' Pathian, huchi in amah ka tawisang ding hi.
TOUPA galhatpa ahi: TOUPA amin ahi.
"Pharoah kangtalaite leh asepaihte tuipi ah apaikheta: aheutute uh leng, Tuipi San ah akelum uhi.
Thukna in amaute akhuhta: Suang bang in ataw ah atumta uhi.
"TOUPA aw, na khut taklama thilhihtheihna thupi ahong hita: TOUPA aw, na khut taklam in melma agawizanta hi.
Na hoihna thupina in nang hon dou dia thoute azouta: na thangpaihna na sawlkhia a, huai in amaute buhpawl bang in akangta hi.
Na nakvangte mut in tuite kaihkhawm in a-om ua, tui tampite vum bang a chian in a-om, huchi in tuipi sunggil ah thuknate kipsak in a-om hi.
Melma in, ka delh ding a, ka pha dia, gallak ka hawm ding: Huaite ah ka duhgawlna atai ding, ka namsau ka phawi dia, ka khut in amau ka hihgawp ding," achi hi.
Nang na huih in na muta, tuipi in amau akhuhta hi; tui hatte ah ngen bang in atumta uhi.
"TOUPA aw, nang bang kua a-om a? pathiante lak ah! Sianthouna a thupi, phatnate a lauhuai, thillamdang hih ah, nang bang kua a-om a?
Na khut taklam na zankhia a, lei in amaute avalhta hi.
"Na tatsa mite nang na zahngaihna in na pikhia a; na tenna siangthou ah na hatna in amaute na pita hi.
Mite'n aza ua, aling uhi: Lunggimna in Philistia a tengte amanta.
Huai chiang in Edom hausate'n lamdang asa mahmah ua: Moab a mi thilhihtheite, linna in aman a; Kanaan a tengte tengteng azulmang uhi.
Launa leh kihtakna atung uah ahong tung a; na ban thupina in suang bang in adai dide ua; na leisa na mite'n apaikan masiah uh, TOUPA aw, na mite'n apaikan masiah uh.
Na gouluah tang ah amau na hon tun ding a, na suan ding, TOUPA aw, tenna ding a na kibawlna mun ah, Mun Siangthou ah, TOUPA aw, na khut in alamkipsa ah.
TOUPA'N tangtawn tangtawn in vai ahawm ding."
Pharaoh sakol kangtalaite leh asakol tungtuang mite toh tuipi ah apilut a, TOUPA'N atung uah tuipi tuite ahon nilkhawm nawn a; himahleh Israel suante tuipi tung ah gam hul ah apai uhi.
Miriam zawlneinu, Aaron sanggamnu'n khuangta akhut in ala a; numei tengteng in khuangta toh lam kawm in anung ah azui uhi.
Miriam in amaute adawng a: "Thupitak a avualzoh ziak in, TOUPA kiang ah la sa un; tuipi ah sakol leh atungtuangmi apaikheta hi," chi in.
Huchibang in Tuipi San a pan Mosi in Israelte api a, Shur gamdai ah apai ua, gamdai ah ni thum apai ua, tui amuta kei uhi.
Marah ahong tun un, Marah tuite akhat ziak in adawn thei kei uh; huaiziak in amin Marah asa uhi.
Mosi dem in mite aphun ua, "Bang dawn ding i hia!" achi uhi.
TOUPA kiang ah akap a; TOUPA'N singkung khat a-ensak a, tui lak a akhiakleh, tui ahong limta hi. Huai ah amaute a ding in dan thuseh leh dan abawl a, huai ah amaute a- enchian hi.

"Lungluttak a TOUPA na Pathian aw na ngaihkhiak a, amitmuh a dik na hih a, athupiakte a bil na doh a, adan thusehte na zuihleh, Aiguptate tung a ka tut, huai hipite lak ah abangmah na tung ah ka koih kei ding. Nang hon hihdampa TOUPA ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
Elim, tuikhuk sawm-le-nih omna leh tum sing sawmsagih omna ahong tung ua; huai a tuite kiang ah agiakta uhi.
Huan Elim a pan azin zom zel ua, Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan apawtkhiak nung uh akha nihna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Israel suante Sin gamdai atung ua, huai Elim leh Sinai kikal a om ahi.
Gamdai ah Israel suan omkhawmte Mosi leh Aaron dem in aphun uhi.

Israel suante'n akiang uah, "Sa bel bulte a i tut lai un, khamtak a tanghou i nek lai un, Aigupta gam ah TOUPA khut in na si zaw mai lehang. Hiai a omkhawm tengteng kial a hon that dia, hiai gamdai a na hon pikhiak tak ziak un," achi uhi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, nou a ding in van a pan tanghou ka hon zusak ding. Huchi in mite apaikhe ding ua, niteng daih ding bangzah zah hiam alakhawm ding ua, ka dan ah a-om uhiam om lou, amau ka etchet theihna ding in.
Ani guk ni in, hichi ahi ding a, ahon lakte uh abawl ding ua; niteng a alakkhawm uh mun nih a tam ahi ding,” achi hi.
Mosi leh Aaron in Israel suan tengteng kiang ah, "Nitaklam in huai hun in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ahon pikhia chih na thei ding uhi.
Zingsang huai hun in TOUPA thupina na mu ding ua; TOUPA kalh a na phunnate uh lah azata ngal a. Kou bang ka hi ua, ka tung ua na phun uh?"

Mosi in, "Nitaklam a nek ding sa, zingsang a kham ding tanghou TOUPA'N ahon piak chiang in hiai na mu ding uhi. Amah tung a na phunnate uh TOUPA'N azata ngal a. Kou bang ka hi ua? Kou kalh a phun na hi kei ua, TOUPA kalh a phun na hi zaw uhi," achi hi.
Mosi in Aaron kiang ah thu agen a, "Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kiang ah TOUPA ma ah hong pai nai un. Na phunnate uh lah azata ngal a, chi in,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aaron in Israel suan omkhawmte tengteng kiang a thu agen lai in, gamdai lam a-et uleh, ngai in, meipi ah TOUPA thupina ahong dawk hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
"Israel suante phunna ka za; akiang uah thu gen in. Nitaklam in sa na ne ding ua, zingsang lam in tanghou na kham ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam in vengkeng ahong tungtou ua, giahphual ahong tuamdim ua; zingsang in giahphual kimvel ah daitui akia hi.
Daitui kia a-om nawn louhtak in, ngai in, gamdai pumpi ah thil bem neu, lei lak ah zing daitui khal ngou chia a neu a-om hi.
Israel suante'n amuh un, “Hiai bang ahia?" akichituah ua, bang ahia chih lah athei ngal kei ua. Mosi in akiang uah, "Hiai TOUPA'N ahon piak na nek ding uh tanghou ahi.
Michih in ama khamkhop ding zah la hen. Na mite uh zah dungzui in, michih a ding in omer khat la uhen chi a, TOUPA'N thu apiak hiai ahi. Michih in apuanin a om ding zah la un," achi hi.
Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih ua, akhen in tam deuh, akhen in tawm deuh ala uhi.
Omer a ateh uleh atam la in bangmah anei val kei a, atawm la in bangmah atasam tuan kei hi. Michih in akham ding bang zel in ala uhi.
Mosi in, "Kuamah in zingsang tan nutsiat nei kei hen," achi hi.
Hinapi in Mosi angaikhe kei ua; alak ua khenkhatte'n zingchiang tan in akoihkhol ua, athan a, a-uih hi. Huchi in atung uah Mosi ahehta hi.
Zingsang teng in, michih in akham ding bang zel in ala ua; ni ahong sat chiang in azul hi.
Ani guk ni in hichi ahong hi a, tanghou amun nih a tam mi khat a ding in omer nih zel ala uhi. Khawmpite heutu tengteng ahong ua Mosi ahilh uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai TOUPA chihsa ahi, zingchiang TOUPA a dia Sabbath siangthou khawlna ahi. Na kan nop uleh tuni in kang unla; na huan ding uleh huan un. Avalte zingchiang tan a ding in kikoih un," achi hi.
Mosi thupiak bang in azingchiang tan akoih ua, a-uih kei a, athan leng a-om kei hi.
Mosi in, "Tuni in huai ne un; tuni lah TOUPA a dia Sabbath ni ahi ngal a. Tuni in gamlak ah tanghou na mu kei ding uh.
Ni guk na lakhawm ding ua; himahleh ani sagih ni Sabbath ni ahi, huai ni in bangmah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in lakhawm ding in mi khenkhat apaikhia ua, himahleh bangmah amu kei uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Bang tan ka thupiakte leh ka dante zui lou ding na hi ua?
En in, TOUPA'N Sabbath ni ahon piak ngalleh, huaiziak a, ani guk ni a ni nih a ding tanghou hon pia ahi. Michih amun ah om henla, ani sagih ni in amun a pan kuamah paikhe kei hen,” achi hi.
Huchi in mite ani sagih ni in akhawlta uhi.
Israel inkote'n amin Manna asa ua; koriandar tang bang ahi a, angou a; chep in tanghou pei khuaizu soh abang hi.
Mosi in, "Hiai thil TOUPA thupiak ahi. Na khang na khang ua ding in omer khat thundim un. Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pikhiak lai a, gamdai a ka hon vakna tanghou amuhtheihna ding un," achi hi.
Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Bel la inla, huai ah omer khat manna dim koih in, TOUPA ma ah luikhia in, na khang na khang ua zuih ding in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, Aaron in Theihpihna ma ah, koih ding in aluitouta hi.
Gam kiluah ahong tun masiah uh, Israel suante'n kum sawmli sung manna ane uhi. Kanaan gamgi ahong tun masiah uh, manna ane uhi.
Omer khat, ephah khat mun sawm ahi.
Huan Israel suante omkhawm Sin gamdai a pan azin ua, TOUPA thupiak bang a azin nung un Rephidim ah apuanin uh akai uhi. Huai ah mite dawn ding tui a-om kei hi.
Huaiziak in mite'n Mosi akinakpih ua, "Ka dawn ding uh tui hon pia in," achi uhi. Mosi in akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon kinakpih na hi ua? Bangziak a TOUPA ze-et na hi ua?" achi hi.
Mite lah tui duh in huai ah adang uh atak a; Mosi tung ah mite aphun ua, "Dangtakna a kou leh ka tate uh leh ka gante uh hon that dia, bangziak a Aigupta gam a pan hon lakhia na hia?" achi uhi.
TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akap a, "Hiai mite bang ka loh dia? Suang a hon denglum ding in mansa in a-om uhi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mite ma ah pai inla, Israel upate tonpih inla; lui na satna chiang na khut in tawi inla, pai in.

Ngai in, Horeb ah suangpi tung ah na ma ah ka dingh ding a, suangpi na sat dia, huai a pan tui ahong pawtkhe ding, mite'n adawntheihna ding un," achi hi. Israel upate muh in Mosi in huchibang in ahihta hi.
Huai mun min Massah leh Meribah asa hi, Israel suante'n TOUPA tawng a, amah chian in, "I lak uah TOUPA a-om hia, om lou," achih ziak un.
Huai khit in Amalek ahong kuan a, Rephidim ah Israelte ahong dou hi.
Mosi in Joshua kiang ah, “Mi hon telkhia inla, pawtkhe ni in, Amalek i dou ding. Zingchiang in ka khut a Pathian' chiangkhun tawi in mualvum ah ka kuan ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in akiang a, agen bang in Joshua in ahih a, Amalek adou uhi. Mosi leh Aaron leh Hur mualvum ah ahohtouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in akhut aliktouh chiang in, Israelte ahat ua; akhut akhiaksuk chiang in, Amalek ahat hi.

Himahleh Mosi khut agik a; huchi in suang ala ua, anuai ah akoih uhi. Huai tung ah amah atu a, Aaron leh Hur in akhut adoptouhsak uhi; khat in akhat lam pang, leh adang pen in akhat lam pang ah. Huchi in nitum matan akhutte apangzou hi.
Huchi in Joshua in Amalek leh amite anamsau in azouta hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Theihgige ding in hiai laibu ah gelh inla, Joshua bil ah gen nawn in. Van nuai a pan Amalek theihgigena ka koihmang sipsip ding ziak in," achi hi.
Mosi in huai ah maitam adoh a, amin Jehovah-nissi asa hi.
"Akhang akhang a TOUPA'N Amalek dou gige ding chi a akichiam ziak in,” achi hi.
Jethro, Midian siampu, Mosi sungpa'n, Mosi a ding leh ami Israelte a dia Pathian in ahih tengteng leh Aigupta gam a pan TOUPA'N Israelte apikhiakdan ana za hi.
Huchi in Jethro, Mosi sungpa'n, Zipporah, Mosi zi, asawlkik nung in ana kem hi;
Zipporah tapa nihte toh. Huai nih lak a khat min Gershom ahi, "Melmak gam ah mikhual ka na hi,” achih ziak in.
Adang min Eliezer ahi, "Ka pa' Pathian hon panpihpa ahi, Pharaoh namsau a pan ahon tatkhiak ziak in," achi hi.
Jethro, Mosi sunghpa atapate leh azi toh gamdai ah Mosi kiang ah ahong hoh ua, Pathian tang a apuanin kaihna mun ah.
Mosi kiang ah, "Kei na sunghpa Jethro na kiang ah ka hong, na zi leh akiang a atapa nihte toh," achi hi.
Asunghpa dawn ding in Mosi apawtkhia a, akun a, atawp a; bang na chi uhiam chi in akidongtuah ua; puanin sung ah alut uhi.
Mosi in asungpa, Pharaoh tung leh Aiguptate tung a Israelte ziak a TOUPA thilhih tengteng leh lampi a haksatna atung ua hong tung tengteng leh huaite a kipan TOUPA'N atatkhiakdante ahilh hi.
Aiguptate khut a pan atatkhiak, Israelte tung a TOUPA'N ahihhoihna tengteng ziak in Jethro akipak hi.
Jethro in, "Aiguptate khut a pan leh Pharaoh khut a pan hon tankhepa, Aiguptate khut a pan amite tankhepa TOUPA pahtawi in om hen.
Tu in pathian tengteng sang in TOUPA athupizaw, chih ka thei. Kisatheitak a Israel suante tung a thilhihte tung a hiai ahih tak ziak in," achi hi.
Mosi sunghpa Jethro in, halmang thillat leh thillat dangte Pathian a ding in alan hi. Pathian ma a ankuang umkhawm ding in Aaron leh Israel upa tengteng ahong pai uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in mipite vai hawm ding in Mosi atu hi. Mipite zingsang a pan nitaklam tan in Mosi kiang ah adingh uhi.

Mosi sungpa'n Mosi in mite tung a ahih tengteng amuh in, "Mite tung a hiai thil na hih bangchidan ahia? Bangziak a nang kia tangtut na hia? Bangziak a zingsang a pan nitaklam tan na kiang mite dingh uh ahia?" achi hi.
Mosi in asunghpa kiang ah, "Pathian dong dia mite ka kiang a hong pai ahi uh.
Haksatna aneih chiang un, ka kiang ah ahong pai ua; khat leh adang kikal ah vai ka hawm a, Pathian dan thusehte leh adante ka theisak hi," achi hi.
Mosi sungpa'n akiang ah, "Na thilhih ahoih kei hi.
Nang leh na kiang a om hiai mite na segawp mahmah ding uhi. Nang a dia hiai thil agik luat ziak in, nang kia in na hihthei kei hi.
Tu in ka aw ngaikhia in, ka hon thuhilh ding hi. Na kiang ah Pathian om hen. Pathian lam ah nang mite palai na hi dia, athubuaite uh Pathian kiang ah na tun ding hi.
Thusehte leh dante amau na sinsak dia, apaina ding lam uh leh anasep ding uh toh na ensak ding hi.

Huai lou in mite a pan hi thei, Pathian kihtakdan siamte, thutak mite, enna hote na telkhe dia, amaute atung uah na koih ding hi. Huchibang mite sangkhatte tung a vaihawmte, zakhatte tung a vaihawmte, sawmngate tung a vaihawmte leh sawmkhatte tung a vaihawmte ahi ding uh.

Hun tengteng in amau mite vai hawmsak uhen. Huan hichi ahi ding a, thu lian chiteng nang kiang ahong tun ding ua, thu neu chiteng amaute'n thu akhen ding uhi. Huchi in nang a ding in abaihlamzaw dia, na puakgik hon puakpih ding uhi.
Hiai thil na hih a, huchibang a Pathian in thu ahon piakleh, huchi in na pangzou dia, hiai mite leng lungkim in amun uah apai ding uh," achi hi.
Mosi in asunghpa aw angaikhia a, agen tengteng ahihta hi.

Israel tengteng a pan Mosi in mihitheite atelkhia a, mite tung a lutang in abawlta hi. Sangkhatte tung a vaihawmte, zakhatte tung a vaihawmte, sawmngate tung a vaihawmte leh sawmkhatte tung a vaihawmte in abawlta hi.
Hun tengteng in mite vai ahawmsak ua; thu haksate Mosi kiang ah atun ua, thu neute bel amau akhen zel uhi.
Huchi in Mosi in asunghpa apaisak a, ama gam ah apaita hi.
Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante ahong paikhiak uh; akha thumna, huai ni mah in Sinai gamdai ahong tung uhi.
Rephidim a pan pawtkhia in, Sinai gamdai ahong tung ua, gamdai ah agiak uhi. Huai ah Israelte'n tang mazawn ah puanin akai uhi.
Pathian kiang ah Mosi ahohtou a, TOUPA'N tang a pan amah asam a, "Hichibang in Jakob inkote kiang ah na chi dia, Israel suante na hilh ding hi:
Aiguptate tung a ka hih leh muvanlai khate a ka hon tuah a, keimah kiang ngei ka hon tutdan na muta uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in, ka aw na man taktak ua, ka thukhun na zuih taktak uleh, leitung pumpi kei a ahih ziak in mite sang in kei a ding in gou manpha na hi ding uhi.
Kei a ding in siampute, lalgam leh nam siangthou na hi ding uhi. Hiai thute Israel suante kiang a na gen ding ahi,” achi hi.
Mosi ahong a mite upate asamsak a, TOUPA'N amah apiak hiai thu tengteng ama uah aluita hi.
Mi tengteng in kituaktak in adawng ua, "TOUPA thugen tengteng ka hih ding uh," achi uhi. Mosi in mite thu TOUPA kiang ah atun nawn hi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na kiang ah meipi sah in ka hong, na kiang a thu ka gen chiang a mite'n azak theih ua, chik lai peuh a nang ahon gintak theihna ding un,” achi hi. Mosi in mite thu TOUPA ahilh hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mite kiang ah va hoh inla, tuni leh zingchiang a ding in amaute siangsak in, apuante uh sawpsiang uhen.
Ani thum ni a ding in mansa in om uhen. Ani thum ni a mi tengteng mitmuh a Sinai Tang tung a TOUPA ahong paisuk ding ziak in.
Mite kimvel ah dai na kai ding a, tang a hohtou lou ding in pilvang un, ahihkeileh tang kim khoih lou ding in pilvang un. Kuapeuh tang khoih sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.

Khut in alawng ding uh ahi kei, alawng peuhmah suang a denlup ngeingei ahi ding; ahihkeileh thal a kap pailet ahi ding. Ganta hiam mihing hiam hileh leng, ahing kei ding. Pengkul sawtpi agin chiang in, tang ah ahong paitou ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Tang a pan mite kiang ah Mosi apaisuk a, apuante uh asawp uhi.
Ama'n mite kiang ah, "Ni thum ni a ding in kisakhol un; na zite uh naih kei un," achi hi.
Ani thum ni in zingsang in hichi ahong hi a, vanpigingte leh khophiate, tang tung a meipi sah, pengkul aw angaih a ngaih ahong ging a, giahphual sung a om mi tengteng alingta uhi.
Mosi in puanin a pan mite Pathian toh kimu ding in ahon pikhia a; amau tang nuailam ah adingh uhi.
Meikuang a tang tung a kipan TOUPA ahong kumsuk ziak in Sinai Tang apumkhut vekta hi. Haltuina meikhu bang in atungkah a, atang pumpi aling zungzung hi.
Sawtpi pengkul ging angaih semsem lai in Mosi in thu agen a, Pathian in aw in amah adawng hi.
Sinai Tang tung a tang vum tung ah TOUPA ahong paisuk hi. Atang vum tung ah TOUPA'N Mosi asamtou a, Mosi ahohtou hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Paisuk inla, mite vauhilh in. En ding in TOUPA lam hong phuvang in alak ua tampi amangthang kha ding uhi.”
"TOUPA kiang a hong pai siampute leng kihihsiangthou uhen, huchi lou in zaw atung uah TOUPA apuakzak kha ding," achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Sinai Tang ah mite ahong paitou thei kei ding uh. Tang kimvel in dai kai inla, hihsiangthou in chi a na hon hilh ziak in," achi hi.

TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Paisuk inla, huan Aaron toh hong paitou un. Himahleh siampute leh mite'n TOUPA kiang a hong ding in hon phuvang kei uhen. Huchi lou in zaw amaute tung ah apuakzak kha ding,” achi hi.
Mite kiang ah Mosi ahohsuk a, akiang uah thu agenta hi.
Huan Levi inn a pan pasal khat apaikhia a, Levi tanu zi in anei hi.
Huai numei in nau apai a, tapa anei a, naupang melhoih ahi chih atheih in kha thum sung aselta hi.
Asel zoh nawn louhtak in, phaiphek bawm abawlsak a, vahaibuan leh chim in azutbit a, asung ah nau akoih a; luipang ah loupa kawm ah akoih hi.
Asanggamnu'n bang hong suak hiam chih thei ding in gamla kuam ah adingh hi.
Pharaoh tanu lui ah kisil ding in ahong paisuk a; anungzui numeite toh lui gei ah avak uhi. Loupa lak a bawm amu a, asikha numei khat va la ding in asawl hi.
Ahonleh, naupang amuta a, ngai in, naungek akapta hi. Alainat a, "Hiai Hebru tate lak a khat ahi," achi hi.
Asanggamnu'n Pharaoh tanu kiang ah, "Naungek hon donsak ding, Hebru numeite lak a naudonmi khat hon va sapsak leng na ut hia?" achi hi.
Pharaoh tanu in akiang ah, "Va kuan in,” achi hi. Nungak akuanta a, naungek nu ava samta hi.
Pharaoh tanu in akiang ah, "Hiai naungek la inla, hon donsak in. Na loh ka hon pe na ding," achi hi. Huchi in huai numei in nau alata a, adonta hi.
Naungek ahong khanglian a, Pharaoh tanu kiang ah ahon pi a, huchi in atapa ahong hita hi. "Tui a pan ka kaihkhiak ahih ziak in, chi in amin Mosi asa hi."
Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Mosi ahong khanlet in chipihte kiang ah ava hoh a, apuakgikte uh ava mu hi. Asanggamte lak a khat, Hebru mi khat Aigupta mi in avuak lai ava muta hi.
Adak loplop a, kuamah a-om kei chih atheihtak in, Aigupta mi athat a, piaunel ah asel hi.
Huan ani nih ni a, ava hoh nawnleh, ngai in, Hebru mite lak a mi nih ana kisual ua; gilou hihpa kiang ah, "Bangziak a na lawm vua na hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka tung ua lal leh vaihawm dia nang kua'n hon bawl ahia? Aigupta mi na thah bang a, hon thah tum na hi maw?" achi hi. Huchi in Mosi in alau a, “Hiai thil kitheikhe petmah ahita ve,” achi hi.
Pharaoh in hiai azak in, thah ding in Mosi azongta hi. Himahleh Pharaoh mai a pan Mosi ataimang a, Midian gam ah ava teng a; tuileh kiang ah atu hi.
Midian siampu in tanu sagih anei a, amau ahong pai ua, tui ahong tawi ua, apa uh belamhonte piak ding in atuitheite adim uhi.
Belamchingte ahong pai ua, ahawlmangsak uhi. Himahleh, Mosi adingtou a, amau apanpih a, abelamhonte uh tui apia hi.
Apa uh Reuel kiang a ahong paitak un, "Bangziak a, tuni'n hong pai baih ve uchia?" ana chi hi.
Amau, "Belamchingte khut a pan Aigupta mi khat in hon hunkhia a, tui leng ahon tawisak a, belamhonte tui apia hi,” achi uhi.
Ama'n atanute kiang ah, "Ahihleh amah koi a om ahia? Bangziak a huai mi hon nusia? An ne ding in va sam ve ua," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi bel huai mi kiang a ten alungkim a, ama'n atanu Zipporah, Mosi apeta hi.
Ama'n tapa aneihsak a, "Melmak gam ah mikhual ka hita," achih ziak in amin Gershom asa hi.
Hun hong pai zel in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta kumpipa asita a, huchi in akoltan ziak un Israel suante athumthum ua, akap ua, koltan ziak a akahna uh Pathian kiang atungtou hi.
Amauna uh Pathian in aza a, huchi in Pathian in Abraham toh, Isak toh leh Jakob toh athukhun atheigige hi.
Pathian in Israel suante a-en a, Pathian in amau aphawk hi.
Huan Pathian in huchi a chi in hiai thute tengteng agen hi.
Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, Aigupta gam a kipan leh saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa ka hi;
ka ma ah keimah lou ngal pathian dangte na nei ding ahi kei.
Milim gelhthoh himhim ahihkeileh tunglam van a om thil lim kibatpih mawngmawng hiam nuai lei a om hiam lei nuai a tui sung a om kibatpih na kibawl ding ahi kei.

Akiang uah na kun ding ahi kei, a-nna uh leng na sem ding ahi kei. Kei lah TOUPA na Pathian, mullit hat Pathian, kei hon hote khang thumna leh khang lina tan a, pate gitlouhna tate tung a thuk ka hi ngal a,
kei hon it a, ka thupiakte zuite lak a sang tampite kiang a zahngaihna lak zelpa ka hi.
TOUPA na Pathian min na mawk gen ding ahi kei; amin mawk genmi lah TOUPA'N moh lou in akoih ngal kei a.
Sabbath ni siangthou a tan ding theigige in.
Ni guk sung teng nna na sem ding a, na nna tengteng nasep ding ahi.

Himahleh ani sagihna TOUPA na Pathian Sabbath ni ahi. Huai ah nna himhim; nang leng, na tapa in leng, na tanu in leng, na sikhapa hiam, na sikhanu hiam, na ganta hiam, na huangsung a om na mikhual hiam in leng asem ding ahi kei.
Ani guk ni in TOUPA'N lei leh van, tuipi leh asung ua om tengteng bawl in, ani sagih ni in akhawl ngal a. Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Sabbath ni vualzawl in, atang siangthou hi.
Na nu leh na pa zahtak in. TOUPA na Pathian in ahon piak gam a na nite asautheihna ding in.
Tual na that ding ahi kei.
Ang na kawm ding ahi kei.
Na gu ding ahi kei.
Na inveng siatna ding in palai taklou na hi ding ahi kei.
Na inveng inn na eng ding ahi kei. Na inveng zi na eng ding ahi kei, asikhapa leng, asikhanu leng, abawngtal hiam, asabiltung hiam, thil himhim na inveng a peuhpeuh.
Mi tengteng in vanpigingte, khophiate, pengkul husate leh tang kang khu amu ua; mite'n huaite amuh un, akisuan ua, gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
Mosi kiang ah, "Ka kiang uah thu gen inla, ka hon ngaikhe ding uhi. Himahleh Pathian in hon houpih kei hen, ka si kha ding uh," achi uhi.
Mosi in akiang uah, "Lau kei un. Amah launa na ma ua a-om a, na khelhlouhna ding un, noute hon enchian ding a Pathian hong pai ahih ziak in," achi hi.
Mite gamlatak ah adingh ua, Pathian omna mun mial bikbek lam ah Mosi ava pai nai hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Israel kiang ah hichibang in na chi ding, "Van a pan nou ka hon houpih na muta uhi.
Kei lou dangka pathiante na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Dangka-eng pathiante leng na kibawl ding uh ahi kei.

Kei a ding in lei maitam na bawl ding ua, huai ah na halmang thillatte leh na lemna thillatte, na belamte leh na bawngtalte na lan ding uh ahi. Mun tengteng a ka min ka khumna ah na kiang uah ka hong dia, ka hon vualzawl ding hi.
Suang maitam na hon bawlsakleh, suangsek a na bawl louh ding ahi. Suang tung a na vanzat na likleh, na hihnin ahi ngal a.
Huai a na vuaktanna adawklouhna ding in, ka maitam ah kalbi in na kahtou ding ahi kei," achi hi.
Huan hiai vaihawmnate, ama ua na ngak dingte ahi uhi.
Hebru sikha na leileh, kum guk sung nang nna asem ding a, akum sagihna ah bangmah pe lou in noplen in apawtkhe ding.
Ama tum a hong lut ahihleh, ama tum mah in apawtkhe ding. Zi nei ahihleh, azi in amah azuikhe ding.
Apu in zi apiak a, tapate hiam tanute hiam aneihsakleh, azi leh atate apu a ahi ding ua, amah kia in apawtkhe ding.
Sikha in teltak a, "Ka pu ka it, ka zi leh ka tate ka it; noplen in ka pawtkhe kei ding," achihleh;
apu in vaihawmte kiang ah amah api dia; kongkhak chiang ah hiam kongkhak khuam chiang ah hiam api dia, apu'n vuhna in abil avut pailet ding. Huchi in ama'n apu nna asem tawntung ding hi.
Mi'n sikhanu ding a atanu azuakleh, sikhapate bang in apaikhe kei ding.
Amah khampa, apu alung-kimsak keileh, apa atankiksak ding. Atung ah muanhuai loutak a ahihleh melmak nam kiang a zuak ding in thuneihna anei kei.
Atapa zi dia adeihleh, tanute bang in abawl ding hi.
Ama'n zi dang aneihthuahleh, a-an nek, apuansilh leh apiak ding a kilawm asukkiam louh ding ahi.
Atung a hiai thumte ahihkeileh, sum-le-pai pe lou in nonlen in apawtkhe ding ahi.
Asihna dia mi vua peuhmah, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Mi'n thah ding a na buk lou ahih a, Pathian in akhut a amah apiakkhiakleh, ataikhiakna ding mun ka sehsak ding hi.
Himahleh mi khatpeuh in tupmawng in a-invengte tung ah gitlouh piltak in asihna ding in gamta taleh, ka maitam a pan amah na lakhe dia, asih ding ahi.
Kuapeuh apa hiam, anu hiam vomi, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Kuapeuh mihing gu a zuakmi, ahihkeileh akhut ah muhkhiak a ommi, amah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Kuapeuh anu leh pa hamsiatmi, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Mite kisual uhenla, khat in khat suang in deng hiam, akhuttum hiam in tum henla, si lou in, lupna ngak taleh;
thou nawn in, chiangkhun khun in kholak vakleh, avopa ahul dia; ahun sukbei man ape dia, amah adamsiangsak sipsip ding hi.
Mi'n chiang in asikhapa hiam, asikhanu hiam sat henla, akhutlum in si taleh amah gawt ngeingei ding ahi.
Himahleh ni khat hiam, ni nih hiam nung a dam a, athohzohleh, gawt louh ding ahi; amah apu neihsa ahih ziak in.

Mite kisual in, numei gai lai hihna in, anau tolh henla, himahleh siatdetna in zui keileh; numeinu pasal in atung a, achih bangbang a gawt ngeingei ding ahi. Vaihawmte'n abikhiah bang uh aliau ding hi.
Siatna mawngmawng in zui taleh hinna tang a hinna apiak ding ahi.
Mit tang a mit, ha tang a ha, khut tang a khut, khe tang a khe.
Mei a hal tang a mei a hal, liam tang a liam, pawn tang a pawn.
Mi'n asikha mit hiam, asikhanu mit hiam suksak in, se taleh amit ziak in noplen in akhah ding ahi.
Asikhapa ha hiam, asikhanu ha hiam sukhe taleh, aha ziak in noplen in akhah ding ahi.
Bawngtal in pasal hiam, numei hiam, asik ziak in si taleh; huai bawngtal denlup ngeingei ding ahi. Asa nek louh hial ding ahi. Himahleh abawngtal nei pen gawt louh in asuakta ding hi.

Himahleh huai bawngtal amalam a, akii a misik hat hi a, aneitu kiang a hilhsa leng hinapi a, ama'n ana khum tuan lou ahihleh, pasal hiam, numei hiam ana siklupleh, huai bawngtal denlup ding ahi a; aneitu leng sihsak ding ahi.
Atung ah dangka sum akiphutleh, akiphut bangbang ahinna tatna man ding in ape ding ahi.
Tapa hiam, tanu hiam ana sikleh, hiai vaihawmna bang a, atung a hih ding ahi.
Bawngtal in sikhapa hiam sikhanu hiam asikleh, apu kiang ah dangka shekel sawmthum ape dia, bawngtal pen denlup ding ahi.
Pasal in kokhuk sin hong henla, ahihkeileh pasal in kokhuk tou henla, sin kei henla, asung ah bawngtal hiam sabiltung hiam ke taleh,
kokhuk neitu in abawlhoih a, aneipa kiang a dangka sum apiak ding ahi. Huchi in aganta si pen amah a ahi ding.
Mi khat bawngtal in midang khat bawngtal mah hih na kha henla, si taleh; abawngtal hing lai pen azuak ding ua, asum akihawm ding uhi. Abawngtal si pen leng akihawm ding uh ahi.
Ahihkeileh amalam a huai bawngtal sik hat ahi chih akitheih a, aneitu in akhum kei chih akitheihleh; bawngtal tang a bawngtal apiak ngeingei ding ahi. Huchi in aganta si pen amah a tuam ahi ding hi.
Mi'n bawngtal hiam, belam hiam gu in gou hiam zuak taleh; bawngtal khat gun in bawngtal nga, belam khat gun in belam li a adit ding ahi.
Guta inn luh kimu in, kivua in si taleh, avopa pen sisan suah chi a mohsak theih ahi kei ding.
Himahleh atung a ni asuah nung ahihleh sisan suah chi a mohpaih theih ahi ding. Ditna kim apiak ding ahi. Piak ding bangmah aneih keileh, aguktak ziak a amah zuak ding ahi.
Avan guk akhut a hing a akimuhleh, bawngtal hiam ahihkeileh sabiltung hiam, ahihkeileh belam hiam hitaleh, amun nih apiakkik ding ahi.
Mi'n lou hiam, grephuan hiam nek a omsak in, aganta lutsak in, midang lou ah va ta taleh; ama lou hoihna pen leh ama grephuan hoihna pen a pan ditna abawl ding ahi.
