Mei hong kang in, ling lak hong kuang in, buh hiam ahihkeileh hai dingh lai hiam ahihkeileh lou kangse taleh; amei khahpa'n ditna abawl ngeingei ding ahi.
Mi'n a-invengpa kep ding in dangka sum hiam van hiam pekhia henla, huai mi inn a pan kigu taleh; guta akimuhleh azahnih pia hen.
Guta akimuh keileh, a-invengpa van tung ah akhut akha na hiam, chih theihna ding in vaihawmte kiang ah inn neipa api ding ahi.

Tatlekna chiteng, bawngtal thu ah hiam, sabiltung thu ah hiam, belam thu ah hiam, puansilh thu ah hiam, van mansak thu ah hiam, midang in kei a ahi, achihleh, alang tuak thu vaihawmte ma atut ding ahi. Vaihawmte mohpaihpa'n a-invengpa aleh nih apiak ding ahi.
Mi'n a-invengpa kiang ah akep ding in sabiltung hiam, bawngtal hiam, belam hiam gan himhim hiam pekhia henla; si hiam, liam hiam, hawlmang hiam a om in, kuamah in mu kei taleh;
TOUPA kichiamna amau gel kikal ah a-om dia; a-invengpa' van tung ah akhut akha kei chihna; avan neipa'n huai apom dia, adin kei ding hi.
Amah a pan guk a-omleh, aneipa kiang ah ditna abawl ding hi.
Gan balnen in ana om taleh, atheihpihna ding in asa hon tawi hen, balnen a om pen adin kei ding hi.
Mi'n a-invengpa banghiam khel henla, anei pen om louh kal in liam in hiam si hiam in om taleh, adit ngeingei ding ahi.
Himahleh aneipa akiang a om ahihleh adin kei ding. Van khelh man in adin khin lel hi.
Khamsa hilou nungak siangthou khat pasal in zol henla, kithuahpih taleh, mou man pia in zi in anei ngeingei ding ahi.
Anumei pa'n akiang a piak anial bilbelleh, nungak siangthoute man dungzui in sum ape ding hi.
Dawizawl ahin na phal ding ahi kei.
Ganta kithuahpih peuhmah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
TOUPA kiang kia lou ngal, pathian himhim kiang a kithoih peuhmah hihsiat dimdem ding ahi.
Mikhual na subuai hiam, na nuaisiah hiam ding ahi kei hi; Aigupta gam a mikhual na hih tak ziak un.
Meithai hiam, pa nei lou naupang hiam na hihgenthei ding ahi kei.
Bangchiteng a amau na gentheihsak a, ka kiang a ahong kah peuhmah uleh, akahna uh ka ngaikhe ngeingei ding hi.
Ka thangpaihna asou dia, namsau in ka hon that ding hi. Na zite uh meithai ahi ding ua, na tate uh pa nei lou ahi ding uhi.
Na kiang ua om ka mite lak a mizawng kuapeuh kiang a sum na leitawi sakleh, leitawisakmi hih bang a sumpung na nek louh ding ahi.
Kichiamna a na inveng puansilh na lakleh, ni tum ma a ama kiang a na va piakkik ding ahi.
Huai lah akikhuhna neihsun ahi ngal a, avun a ding a apuansilh ahi. Bang in a-ihmu dia? Hichi ahi dia, ka kiang a, ahong kah chiang in ka za ding; hehpih thei ka hih ziak in.
Pathian na enghou ding ahi kei a, na mite vaihawmmi leng na hamsiat ding ahi kei hi.
Na theigah min masate, na uain masate lan ding in na zekai ding ahi kei. Na tapate lak a piang masapen kei na hon piak ding ahi.
Huchi mah bang in na bawngtalte lak ah leng na hih ding ahi. Na belamte lak ah leng hiai bang in na hih ding ahi. Ni sagih sung api kiang ah na omsak dia, ani giat ni a kei na hon piak ding ahi.
Kei a dia misiangthoute na hih ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in gamlak a gamsa nek bang sa himhim na nek louh ding uh ahi a; uite na pe zaw ding uhi.
Thutut zuau na genzak ding ahi kei. Theihpih diklou hi ding in migiloute toh na kizop ding ahi kei.
Gilou hih ding in mipi na zui ding ahi kei. Vaihawmna kaikawi ding in mi tam lamlam zui in amau na gum ding ahi kei.
Thubuai genna ah mizawng dou in guptuam na nei ding ahi kei.
Na melma bawngtal hiam sabiltung hiam taimang na tuahleh, akiang a na pi nawn ngeingei ding ahi.
Nang hon homi' sabiltung, avan puak lel a puk na muhleh taisan lou a, na panpih ngeingei ding ahi.
Thubuai a kihekna ah mizawngte a ding in thukhenna na kaikawi ding ahi kei.
Thil diklou a pan gamlapi ah om in, thil hihkhial lou leh midikte that ke'n; migiloute siamtangsak lou ding ka hih ziak in.
Golhgukna na la ding ahi kei. Golhgukna in mit atosak a, midiktatte thu akaikawi ngal hi.
Huai lou in mikhual na hihgenthei ding ahi kei. Mikhual lungtang na theih ziak in, Aigupta gam ah mikhual in na om ngeita uh, chih thei in.
Kum guk sung na gam ah haichi na tuh dia, agahte na lakhawm ding,

himahleh akum sagihna na omsak kinken a, na khawlsak ding ahi; na mite lak a mizawngte'n anektheihna ding un. Anutsiat peuh uh gamlak sate'n ane ding uhi. Huchibang mah in na grephuan leh na olive huan tung ah na hih ding uhi.
Ni guk sung nangmah nna na sem dia, ani sagih ni in na khawl ding; na bawngtal leh na sabiltung akhawl ua, na sikhanu tapa leh mikhual ahalhtheihna ding un.
Na kiang a ka gen tengteng zui ding in pilvang inla; pathian dangte min lou ke'n, na kam a pan zak in leng om kei hen.
Kum khat sung in ka kiang ah ankuangluina thumvei na bawl ding ahi.

Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina bawl in ka hon thupiak bang in, Abib kha a hun sehsa in, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ahi, huai ni a Aigupta a pan hong paikhia na hih ziak in. Ka ma a kuamah khutvuak a ahong kilat ding uh ahi kei.
Pawltak Ankuanglui, na sepgim gahte, lou a na tuh Puaklutna Ankuangluina na bawl ding ahi. Na lou a pan na sepgimna gahte na puaklut khit chiang in kum tawp ah, Puaklut Ankuanglui na bawl ding ahi.
Kum khat sung in thumvei pasal tengteng Toupa PATHIAN ma a akilat ding uh ahi.
Ka kithoihna sisan, tanghou silngou soh toh na lat ding ahi kei. Ka kithoihna thau a zingsang chiang tan in a-om ding leng ahi kei hi,
TOUPA na Pathian inn a na gam gah masa hoihpente lak a masapen na laklut ding ahi. Kelnou, api nawitui in na huan ding ahi kei.
Ngai in, lampi a nang hon kem ding leh ka mun bawlsa a nang hon tun ding in na ma ah Angel khat ka sawl hi.
Ama ah pilvang inla, a-aw zui in hehsak ke'n; na tatleknate angaihdam louh ding ziak in, ka min lah amah ah a-om ngal a.
Himahleh a-aw na zuih taktak a, ka gen tengteng na hihleh; na melmate tung ah melma ka hi dia, nang hon doute tung ah doumi ka hi ding hi.
Na ma ah ka Angel pai ding ahi, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Kanaante, Hivte leh Jebuste lak ah nang ahon pilut ding hi; huchi in amaute ka satkhe ding hi.

Apathiante uh ma ah na kun ding ahi kei. A-nna uh leng na sem ding ahi sam kei. Athilhihte bang uh leng na hih ding uh ahi kei. Himahleh amaute na zou siang sipsip dia, amilimte uh na hihzan dimdem ding ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh nna na sem ding ua, ama'n na annek-tuidawn uh avualzawl ding hi. Huchi in na lak ua pan chinatna ka lamang ding hi.
Kuamah nausia a-om kei dia, na gamsung uah kuamah aching kei ding. Na nite zah uh ka tangtungsak ding hi.
Na ma uah kei lauhna ka sawl dia, na hong tunna mi tengteng lak ah buaizakna ka omsak ding hi. Huchi in na melma tengteng nang a pan ka taikeksak ding hi.
Na ma ah khuaizanta ka sawl dia, huai in Hivte, Kanaante leh Hitte na ma a pan ahawlkhe ding hi.
Kum khat sung in amaute na ma a pan ka hawlkhe kei ding. Agam ahong vuak dia, noute hon hihse ding in gamsa ahong pung kha ding hi.
Na hong pun ua, gam na luah mateng, na ma ua pan amaute tawm khakha in ka hawlkhe ding hi.
Tuipi San a pan Philistiate tuipi pha hial in, gamdai a pan Lui chiang pha in na gamgi ka khung ding. Na khut ua agam luah mite ka hon piakkhiak ding ziak in na ma uah amaute na hawlkhe ding uhi.
Amaute toh hiam apathiante uh toh hiam leng thukhun na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
Na gamsung uah ateng ding uh ahi kei. Ka tung ah nang ahon khialsak kha ding uhi. Apathiante uh nna na sep uleh huaite nou a ding in thang ahi ding hi.
Huai nung in Pathian in Mosi kiang ah, “TOUPA kiang ah hong tou in, nang leh Aaron, Nadab leh Abihu leh Israel upate lak a sawmsagihte, gamlapi a pan in Pathian bia un.
Mosi kia TOUPA kiang ah ahong pai ding, himahleh amau ahong pai nai louh ding uh ahi. Mite leng amah toh ahong hohtouh louh ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Mosi ahong pai a, TOUPA thute leh vaihawmna tengteng mite ahilhta hi. Mite'n aw kituak in adawng ua, "TOUPA'N agen thu tengteng ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
TOUPA thu tengteng Mosi in agelh a, zingsang in beltak in athou a, tang nuai ah maitam abawl a, Israel nam sawm-le-nih dungzui in, khuam sawm-le-nih aphut hi.
Ama'n Israel suante lak a tangvalte asawl a, amau TOUPA kiang ah halmang thillat leh lemna thillat in bawngtalte alan uhi.
Mosi in bawngtalte sisan kimkhat ala a, kuangdai sung ah akoih a; maitam tung ah asisan kimkhat atheh hi.
Thukhun Laibu ala a, mite zak in asim hi. Mite'n, "TOUPA'N agen tengteng hih in athu ka mang ding uhi," achi uhi.
Mosi in sisan ala a mite tung ah atheh a, "Thukhun sisan en un, hiai thu tengteng thu a TOUPA'N akhun," achi hi.
Mosi, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu leh Israel Upa sawmsagihte apaitou ua
Israel' Pathian ava mu uhi. Akhepek nuai ah sapphir a bawl hileh kilawm leh van bang a siang a-om hi.
Himahleh Israel suante lak a upate dou in Pathian in atung uah akhut alik kei hi. Amau leng Pathian mu napi in hingdam a om in ne in adawn uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Tang ah ka kiang ah hong tou inla, huai ah om in. Suangpekte a ka gelhsa dan leh thupiakte ka hon pe ding; amaute na sinsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
Mosi leh amah huhpa Joshua adingkhia ua, Pathian tang ah ahohtou uhi.

Upate kiang ah, na kiang ua ka hong kik nawn masiah uh hiai ah hon ngak un. "Ngai un, Aaron leh Hur na ompih uhi. Mi kuapeuh in thubuai bangpeuh gen ding na neih uleh, amah akiang uah hong hoh hen," achi hi.
Tang ah Mosi ahohtou a, meipi in tang akhuhta hi.
Sinai Tang tung ah TOUPA thupina a-om a, meipi in ni guk sung akhuh hi. Ani sagih ni in meipi lak a kipan Mosi asamta hi.
Tang vum tung a TOUPA thupina, Israel suante muh in kangmang thei meikuang bang ahi.
Meipi lak ah Mosi alutta a, tang ah ava hohtou hi. Mosi tang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ava omta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
"Thillat ahon tawitheihna ding un, Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in. Michih lungtang a uttak a pete a pan thilpiak na la ding hi.
Amau a pan thilpiak na lak ding hiai bang ahi. Dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal.
Puanmalngat dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au leh khau hoih leh kel mul.
Belampa vun sansaksa leh ngalvang vun leh singgi sing.
Vak ding in sathau, thaunuh ding gimlim, gimnamtui a ding toh.
Onik suangte, siampu puan leh awmtuamna a siat ding suangte.
Alak ua ka tentheihna ding in mun siangthou hon bawlsak uhen.
Nang ka hon etsak bangbang in, biakbuk lim bang in leh avanzat tengteng lim bang in na bawl ding ahi.
"Singgi sing in thukhun bawm na bawl ding ahi. Adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi dia, availam tong khat-le-akim ahi dia, asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
Dangka-engtak in na luan dia, asunglam leh apolam na luan dia, akimvel ah dangka-eng lallukhu bawl in atung ah na bawl ding ahi.
Dangka-eng in asikkual li na sung dia, aning lite ah na bulh ding hi. Sikkual nih apang khat ah a-om ding ua, sikkual dang nihte apang khat ah a-om ding uh.
Singgi sing chiang na bawl dia, dangka-eng in na luan ding ahi.
Thukhun bawm sik a sikkualte sung ah chiangte na thunlut dia, huaite thukhun bawm zawn ahihtheihna ding in.
Chiangte thukhun bawm sikkual sung ah a-om ding uhi.
Thukhun bawm sung ah ka hon piak theihsakna dudes na koih ding ahi.
"Dangka-engtak in zahngaihna tutphah na bawl dia; adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi dia, availam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
Zahngaihna tutphah mong nihte ah, dangka-eng in cherubte na bawl dia, huaite sekthoh e in na bawl ding ahi.
Among khat ah cherub khat na bawl dia, among langkhat ah cherub dang. Among nihte ah zahngaihna tutphah ah cherubte na bawl ding ahi.
Cherubte'n tungsang lam ah akhate uh azakkhe ding ua, akhate ua zahngaihna tutphah tuam in, amai un aki-entuah ding ua; zahngaihna tutphah lam ah cherubte mai a-om ding ahi.
Thukhun bawm tung ah zahngaihna tutphah na koih dia; thukhun bawm sung ah ka hon piak ding theihsakna na koih ding ahi.

Huai ah ka hon kimuhpih dia, zahngaihna tutphah tung a pan, theihsakna thukhun bawm tung a om cherub nihte kikal a pan Israel suante kiang a thupiak ka hon piak ding thil tengteng thu ah ka hon houpih ding hi.
"Singgi in dohkan na bawl dia; adunglam tong nih ahi dia; availam tong khat, asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
Dangka-engtak in na luan dia, akımvel in dangka-eng lallukhu na bawl ding ahi.
Akimvel in khut chia in agei na bawl dia; akimvel in agei ah dangka-eng lallukhu na bawl ding ahi.
Asikkual ding in dangka-eng in li na bawl dia; sikkualte aning lite akhe li tung a omte ah na koih ding.
Dohkan puakna ding chiangte a-omna ding in ageichin ah sikkualte a-om ding uh ahi.
Singgi in chiangte na bawl dia, dangka-eng in na luan dia, huaite dohkan akipuaktheihna ding ahi.
Akuangte, akeute, asinte, anoute, asitna ding in na bawl ding hi. Huaite dangka-engtak in na bawl ding ahi.
Ka ma a dohkan tung ah tanghou sawm-le-nih na koih gige ding ahi.
"Dangka-engtak in khawnvak koihna na bawl ding ahi. Khawnvak koihna sekthoh in na bawl ding ahi. Akungpi leh ahiangte, apakmum leh apakte, kibang mah in na bawl ding ahi.
Apangte a pan hiang guk akakhe dia; khawnvak koihna pang khat a pan hiang thum, khawnvak koihna pang dang a pan hiang thum.
Belkuang thumte makha bang a bawlte, hiang khat a pakmum leh pak; hiang dang a belkuang thumte makha bang a bawlte, pakmum leh pak; huchibang in khawnvak koihna a pan a hong suak hiang gukte.
Khawnvak koihna ah belkuang li makha bang a bawl a-om ding ahi, apakmumte leh pakte uh toh.
Huai mah ahiang nihte nuai ah pakmum khat a-om dia, huai mah ahiang nihte nuai ah apakmum khawnvak koihna a pan a hong suakkhia hiang gukte dungzui in.
Apakmumte leh ahiangte akibang ding ua, avek in dangka-engtak a sekthoh ahi ding hi.
Huai ah khawnvak sagih na bawl dia; khawnvakte ade ding ua, apang a vakna apiaktheihna ding un.
Ataitehte leh ameivu kuangte, dangka-engtak ahi ding ua;
belsuan tengteng toh dangka-engtak talent khat a bawl ding ahi.
Tang a ka hon etsak lim dungzui a bawl ding in pilvang in," achi hi.
Huai lou in biakbuk puan-maingat hoih koptah puanzak sawmkhat toh adum leh asandup leh asan-au in na bawl dia; siamtak a bawl cherubte toh na bawl ding ahi.
Puanzak khat saudan tong sawmnih-le-giat ahi dia, puanzak khat zatdan tong li; puanzak chih in tehna khat anei ding ahi.
Puanzak ngate akithuapkhawm chiat ding uh ahi. Puanzak nga dangte akithuapkhawm chiat ding uh ahi.
Akithuapna a akipehna a pan puanzak khat gei ah adum in avang na bawl dia; huchibang zel in, puanzak dang mongchin mahmah ah, anihna kithuapna ah na bawl ding ahi.
Puanzak khat ah vang sawmnga na bawl dia, anihna kithuapna a om, puanzak mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl ding; huchi a baangte akimat chiat theihna ding un.
Dangka-eng in kilhna sawmnga na bawl dia, kilhnate'n puanzakte nihnih in akilhkhawm ding; huchi in biakbuk khat ahi ding hi.
Biakbuk tungkhuhna ding in kel mul puanzakte na bawl dia; puanzak sawm- le-khat na bawl ding ahi.
Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmthum ahi dia, puanzak khat vailam tong li; puanzak sawm-le-khat tehna khat ahi vek ding hi.
Puanzak ngate amau mah in na thuapkhawm dia, puanzak gukte amau mah in, biakbuk mai ah puanzak gukna na khep ding ahi.
Akithuapna apuanzak ponung penpen mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl dia, anihna kithuapna puanzak mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl ding ahi.
Dal in kilhna sawmnga na bawl dia, kilhnate vang ah na guang dia, puanin khat ahihtheihna ding in, na thuapkhawm ding ahi.
Puanin puanzak val om lai tum khat pen biakbuk phaitam a khai ding ahi,
Puanin puanzakte dunglam a-omlaite, apang khat lam ah tong khat, akhuhna ding in hiai lam pang leh huai lam pang a biakbuk pangte a khai ding ahi.
Puanin khuhna ding belampa vun sansaksa leh atungsawn khuhna ding in ngalvang vunte na bawl ding ahi.
Biakbuk a ding in singgi singpek tunna dingtang in na bawl ding ahi,
Singpek khat dunglam tong sawm ahi dia, singpek khat vailam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
Singpek khat ah atunna ding nih a-om dia, kimuamtuah ding in lem in. Huchibang in biakbuk singpek tengteng a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
Biakbuk a ding in singpek na bawl dia, simlam pang ah pek sawmnih ahi ding.

Singpek sawmnih nuai ah dangka in kingakna khuakkuak sawmli na bawl ding. Akimuamtuah nihte a ding in singpek khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, akimuamna nihte a ding in singpek dang khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih na bawl ding ahi.
Biakbuk pang nihna a ding in mallam pang ah singpek sawmnih a-om ding hi.
Adangka kingakna khuakkuak sawmlite singpek khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, singpek dang khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih.
Biakbuk pang tumlam ate ding in singpek guk bawl in.
Pang nih ah biakbuk ningte a ding in singpek nih na bawl ding ahi.
Anuailam ah akithuapkhawm ding ua, sikkual khat ah atunglam ah akithuapkhawm ding uhi. Huchibang in amau tuak a ding in ahi ding hi. Ning nihte a ding in ahi ding uhi.
Singpek giat a-om dia, - dangka kingakna khuakkuak sawm-le-gukte; singpek khat nuai ah kuak nih leh singpek dang khat nuai ah kuak nih zel a-om ding ahi.
Biakbuk pang khat a singpekte a ding in, singgi sing chiangtawn na bawl dia;
huan biakbuk pang dang khat a singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga, biakbuk pang a singpekte, tumlam sik nihte a ding in chiangtawn nga.
Singpekte laitak a chiangtawn laita in mong khat a pan mong khat tan aphak ding ahi.
Singpekte dangka-eng in na luan dia, chiangtawnte a ding in dangka-eng sikkualte a munte a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
Tang a ka hon etsak dungzui in biakbuk na dinsak ding ahi.
Puanzak adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah siamtak a hih na bawl dia, cherubte toh bawl ding ahi.
Dangka-eng a luan singgi sing khuam lite tung ah na zak ding a; abannate dangka-eng ahi ding a, dangka kingakna khuakkuak lite tung ah khai in.
Huai a theihpihna bawm na hon laklut theihna ding in puanzak kilhnate nuai ah na khai dia, huan huai puanzak in nang a ding in Mun Siangthou leh Mun Siangthoupen kikal akhen ding hi.
Mun Siangthoupen ah theihpihna bawm tung ah zahngaihna tutphah na koih ding ahi.
Puanzak polam ah dohkan na tung ding a; simlam ah biakbuk sik ah dohkan ngai in khawnvak koihna na koih ding ahi. Mallam sik ah dohkan na tung ding hi.
Puanin kongkhak a ding in puankhai na bawl ding a, puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui, adum, asandup leh asan-au.
Akhaina ding in singgi sing khuam nga na bawl dia, dangka-eng a luan, akibatnate dangka-eng ahi ding uhi. Huaite a ding in dal kingakna khuakkuak nga na sung ding ahi.
Singgi sing in maitam na bawl ding a, tong nga a sau, tong nga a za; maitam detdou ahi ding. Asanlam tong thum ahi ding ahi.
Aning lite tung ah akiite na bawl dia; akiite akibang ding ua; dal in na luan ding ahi.
Ameivu dohna ding belte na bawl ding a, aluahna suahdul, kuangdal, keupi leh asikkhut leh amei beldai. Abelsuan tengteng dal a na bawl ding ahi.
Huai a ding in dal in sing khul ding koihna len bang in na bawl dia; atung a ning li ah dal sikkual li na bawl ding ahi.
Anuailam maitam huapna nuai ah na koih dia; huchi a maitam laizang a, lente akikim theihna ding in.
Maitam a ding in chiangte na bawl dia, singgi sing chiangte dal in na luan ding ahi.
Chiangte sikkual sung a thunlut ding ahi a; chiangte maitam sik nihte tung ah a-om ding hi, apuakna ding in.
Tang a ka hon etsak bang in, singpekte ah ahawm na bawl dia, huchibang in na bawl ding ahi.
Biakbuk huang na bawl ding ahi. Simlam pang a ding in simlam manoh in puankhai, huang umna ding in puanmalngat hoih sik khat a ding in tong za a sau a-om ding ahi.
Akhuam sawmnihte leh akingakna khuakkuak sawmnihte dal ahi ding ua; khuamte khainate leh puanduangte dangka ahi ding uhi.
Huchi mah bang in mallam pang ah asau lam tong za a sau puankhai a-om ding, dal khuam sawmnihte leh akingakna khuakkuak sawmnihte dangka chi khuam, akhaina leh puanduangte ahi ding hi.
Tumlam pang a huang vailam a ding in puankhai tong sawmnga a-om ding. Akhuamte uh sawm leh akingakna khuakkuak sawm ahi ding.
Suahlam a suahlam pang a huangsung umna vailam tong sawmnga ahi ding.
Kongpi sik khat lam a puankhaite tong sawm-le-nga ahi dia; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuak thum ahi ding.
Langkhat lam pang ah puankhai tong sawm-le-ngate a-om dia; akhuamte thum leh akingakna khuakkuak thum ahi ding.
Huangsung kongpi a ding in puankhai tong sawmnih a-om dia, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui ahi dia, akhuam uh li ahi dia, akingakna khuakkuak li ahi ding hi.
Huangsung kimvel a khuam tengteng dangka puanduang a gak ahi dia, abannate dangka ahi dia, akingakna khuakkuak dal ahi ding hi.
Huangsung dunglam tong zakhat ahi dia, availam tong sawmnga koipeuh ah, asanlam tong nga puanmalngat hoih koptah a bawl, akingakna khuakkuak dal ahi ding.
Biakbuk a vanzat tengteng, anasepna chiteng, akilhbelhna sikzumte leh huangsung a kilhbelhna sikzum tengteng dal ahi ding ahi.
Israel suante meivak ding in olive thautak a bawl hon tawi ding in thu na pe ding, khawnvak kuangsak gige ding in.

Puanzak, theihpihna ma a om, polam a kihoupihna puanin ah, Aaron leh atapate'n TOUPA ma ah nitaklam a pan zingsang lam tan in thu ape ding uhi. Israel suante ziak in akhang-akhang un tangtawn a ding in dan thuseh ahi ding hi.
Israel suante lak a pan na sanggampa Aaron leh atapate siampu hi a ka nna aseptheihna ding un la in. Aaron leh atapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar na la ding ahi.
Athupina ding leh akilawmna ding in na sanggampa Aaron a ding in puan siangthou bawl in.
Pilna kha a ka dimsak khutsiam tengteng kiang ah thu gen in, amau Aaron puan, amah hihsianna ding abawltheihna ding un. Huchi a ama'n siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.

Apuan bawl ding uh hiaite ahi: Awmtuam, siampu puan, puanaktual, puanakzem, lukhu leh kawnggak. Na sanggampa Aaron a ding leh tapate a ding in puan siangthou abawl ding uh ahi, huchi a ama'n siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
Amau dangka-eng, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih ala ding ua.
Dangka-eng, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in hoihtak a bawl in, siampu puan abawl ding uhi.
Aliang nihte gei nihte akimat ding ua; akimatkhawm ding uhi.
Siampu puanakzem gakna, puanduang kawnggak dangka-eng khau toh khau dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au siamtak a gat puanmalngat in abawl ding uh ahi.
Onik suang nih na la dia, huaite tung ah Israel suante min na gelh ding ahi.
Suang khat tung ah aminte uh lak a guk, suang dang tung ah, a-omlaite min guk dangte, apiandan bang zel un na gelh ding ahi.

Suainamna zungbuh khuakthoh a kigelh bang in, suangmantam khuakthoh agelhsiamte gelh, huai suangmantam nihte ah Israel tapate min na gelh ding a, huai suangmantamte dangka-eng khuak sung ah na phum ding ahi.

Huai suang nihte Israel suante a ding a theihgigena suang hi ding in siampu puan liangzang ah na koih ding. Huchi in theihgigena ding in Aaron in aliangzang nihte tung ah TOUPA ma ah aminte uh apo ding hi.
Dangka-eng bulhna na bawl ding ahi.
Amongte a dangka-engtak khainiang nihte; pakkhi bang in na bawl dia, akibulhnate ah pakkhi bang khainiangte na khih ding ahi.
Vaihawmna omtuamna siamtak in na bawl dia; siampu puan bawl bang in na bawl ding, dangka-eng in, adum in, asandup in leh asan-au in leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in, na bawl ding ahi.
Khep nih in akikhep dia, akhep adung-avai kikim, khap khat a sau leh khap khat a za ahi ding ahi.
Huaite tung ah suang vual li in suangmantamte na bulh dia: avual khatna sardi suang, topaz suang leh karbankul suang ahi ding. Hiai avual khatna ahi ding hi.
Avual nihna emerald suang, sapphir suang leh diamond suang ahi ding ahi.
Avual thumna liguri suang, agate suang leh amethis suang ahi ding.
Avual lina beril suang, onik suang leh jasper suang ahi ding hi. Abulhna ua dangka- eng bulh ding ahi.
Suangte Israel suante min toh akithuah dia, amin uh dungzui in sawm-le-nih, chiamtehna gelhte bang in, michih amin toh nam sawm-le-nihte dungzui in ahi ding uhi.
Awmtuam tung ah pakkhi bang a bawl amongte ah dangka-eng siang khainiang na bawl ding ahi.
Awmtuam tung ah dangka-eng sikkual nih na bawl dia, huai sikkual nihte awmtuam mong nihte tung ah na koih ding hi.
Awmtuam mongte tung a om sikkual nihte ah dangka-eng pakkhi bang nihte na koih ding ahi.
Pakkhi bang khainiang nihte mong nih dangte bulhna nihte ah na khih dia, ama a siampu puan liangzangte ah na koih ding hi.
Dangka-eng in sikkual nih na bawl dia, huai gei a siampu puan mong nihte tung ah na koih ding; asunglam a siampu puan gei a om pen ah.
Dangka-eng in sikkual dang nihte na bawl dia, siampu puan gei nihte nuailam a atung ah na koih ding, amalam sang a akikhepna zawntak ah, siampu puan konggak lamdang tungtak ah.
Asikkual in awmtuam siampu puan sikkual ah puanduang dum toh na hen dia, huchi a siampu puan kawnggak lamdang tung a a-omtheihna ding in leh siampu puan a pan awmtuam akiphellouhna ding in.
Aaron in, TOUPA ma a theihgigena hiden ding a, mun siangthou a alut chiang in, alungtang zawntak ah vaihawmna awmtuam tung ah Israel suante minte apo ding hi.

Vaihawmna awmtuam ah Urim leh Thummim na koih ding. TOUPA ma a ava lut chiang in, Aaron lungtang zawn ah a-om ding hi. Huchi in Aaron in TOUPA ma ah alungtang zawntak ah Israel suante vaihawmna apo gige ding hi.
Siampu puan puanaktual adum in na bawl ding ahi.
Akhung ah a-awng a-om dia; alaitak a, a-awng kimvel ah gatthoh khihna a-om dia, siklen puanak ban nei lou hileh kilawm ahi ding, akeklouhna ding in.
Huai puanaktual mong ah adum in, asandup in leh asan-au in na bawl dia, agei kimvel in. Dangka-eng dakte akimvel in akikal zel uah na bawl ding ahi.
Dangka-eng dak leh theibuhfai puanaktual gei tung ah akivel in a-om ding ahi.
Aaron in nna asep chiang in huai asilh ding hi. Huchi in TOUPA ma a Mun Siangthou a alut chiang leh ahong pawt chiang in aging akiza dia, asi kei chih theihna ding in.
Dangka-engtak in kuang na bawl dia, atung ah na gelh ding, suainamna zungbuh bang a khuak in, TOUPA A DIA SIANTHOUNA chih na gelh ding ahi.
Huai laigelhna sikpek siampu dialkhip a, amailam ah khau dum in na khihbelh ding ahi.

Huai Aaron taltang ah a-om dia, ama'n Israelte thillat siangthou toh kisai a, Israel suante khelhna apo ding ahi. Huai Aaron taltang ah a-om gige dia, thillat siangthoute TOUPA mai ah san ahi ding hi.
Puanmalngat hoih puanak na gan dia, puanmalngat in lukhu na bawl dia, agatthoh in kawnggak na bawl ding hi.
Aaron tapate a ding in puanakte na bawl dia, kawnggakte na bawlsak ding. Athupina ding leh akilawmna ding in lukhute amau a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
Huaite na sanggampa Aaron tung ah leh akiang a atapate tung ah na koih dia; amaute thau na nilh dia, na septuam dia, na siansak ding ahi; siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding un.
Avuaktanna uh khuh ding in puan pheituam zumte na bawlsak dia; atai a pan aphei chiang atun ding uh ahi.

Kihoupihna puanin a alut chiang un hiam ahihkeileh Mun Siangthou a nasem dia dohkan kiang a, ahong pai chiang un, khelhna khatpeuh neih ziak a asihlouhna ding un huaite asa tung uah a-om gige ding ahi. Huchi in huai amah a ding leh anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn a dan thuseh ahi ding hi.
Huan siampu a pang a, ka na sem ding a na siansakna dia hiai ahi atung ua na hih ding, bawngtalnou khat leh belampa nih gensiatbei na la ding ahi.
Huai ban ah tanghou silngou soh louh, tanghou beu silngou soh louh thau a zut leh tanghou pek silngou soh louh thau a zut, huit buh tangbuang in na bawl ding ahi.
Huaite loh sung ah na koih dia, bawngtal leh belampa nihte toh, loh in na hon tawi ding hi.
Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Aaron leh atapate na hon pi dia, tui in amau na sil ding ahi.
Huai khit in siampu puansilhte na la dia, puanak tung leh siampu puanaktual leh siampu puan leh awmtuam Aaron na silhsak dia, siamtak a kigan puanduang kawnggak in amah na gak ding ahi.
Alutung ah lukhu na koih dia, lukhu tung ah lallukhu siangthou na koih ding ahi.
Thau nilhchi na la dia, alutung ah na buak dia amah na nuh ding ahi.
Atapate na hon pi dia puanak tungte na silhsak ding ahi.
Kawnggak in amau na gak dia, Aaron leh atapate, lukhu bem na khusak ding hi. Omden ding dan thuseh a ding in siampu nasep amaute a ahi ding. Hichibang in Aaron leh atapate na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin ma ah bawngtal na kaisak dia; Aaron leh atapate'n bawngtal lutung ah akhutte uh anga ding uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak kiang ah, TOUPA ma ah bawngtal na gou ding ahi.
Bawngtal sisan na la dia, na khutzung in maitam kiite na nuh dia, sisan tengteng maitam bul sik ah na sungkhe ding ahi.
Asunglam tuamtu athau tengteng na la dia, asin tung a alam omleh, akailing nihte leh atung ua athau maitam tung ah na hal ding hi.
Bawngtal sa leh avun leh a-ek, giahphual polam ah mei in na hal ding hi. Hiai khelhna thillat ahi.
Belampa khat na la dia, belampa lutung ah Aaron leh atapate'n akhut uh anga ding uhi.
Belampa na that ding a, asisan na la dia, maitam kimvel in na theh ding hi.
Belampa na semnen dia, asunglam na sawpsiang dia, akhete leh asate leh alu na koihkhawm ding hi.
Belampa avek in maitam tung ah na halmang ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat gimnamtui ahi.
Belampa dang na la dia; belampa lutung ah Aaron leh atapate'n akhut uh akoih ding uhi.

Huan huai belampa na gou dia, Aaron bil taklam dawn leh atapate bil taklam dawn ah leh akhut taklam khutpi uah, akhe taklam khepi uah, asisan na la dia, na nuh ding a, maitam kimvel ah huai sisan na theh ding ahi.

Maitam tung a om sisan na la ding a, nuh theih thau toh, Aaron tung ah leh apuan tung ah leh atapate tung ah leh akiang a atapate puan tung ah na theh ding hi. Huchi in amah leh apuante leh tapate leh atapate' puante hihsiangthou ahi ding hi.
Huai Belampa thaute, amei thau, asung thau, asin leh akailing nihte leh athaute, ataklam phei toh na la ding ahi; hiai bel siangthou a sehtuamna belampa ahih ziak ahi.
TOUPA mai a lohbeu a om silngou soh louh tanghou kikoihte lak a tanghou beu khat, sathau a kikang tanghou pei khat leh tanghou kan pek khat na la dia,
Aaron khut leh atapate khut ah na koih dia; huaite TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in na vei ding hi.
Amau khut a pan huaite na sang dia, halmang thillat ding in maitam tung ah na hal ding ahi, TOUPA ma a gimlim hi ding in. Hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
Aaron hihsianthouna belampa awm na la dia, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in na vei ding hi. Hiai nang tan ding ahi.
Huai siangthou a sehtuamna belampa a pan vei thillat a veisa a-awm leh vei thillat a veisa aphei, Aaron tan leh atapate tante na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
Hiai Israel suante a pan a dan thuseh bang a Aaron leh atapate tan ngeina ahih gige ding ahi. Huai bel Israel suante'n alemna thillatte ua pan TOUPA a dia apiak ding uh ahi.
Aaron puansilh siangthoute amah nung in atapate a ahi ding uh; amaute a hihsiangthou ding leh sehkip ding in.
Ama mun a siampu hong hi atapa in Mun Siangthou a nasem dia kihoupihna biakbuk sung a alut chiang in, ni sagih sung huai puansilhte asilh ding ahi.
Kihihsianthouna belampa na la dia, mun siangthou ah asa na tuihuan ding ahi.
Aaron leh atapate'n belampa sa leh loh sung a om kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak kiang ah tanghou ane ding uhi.
Amau sehkipna ding leh hihsianthouna dia akhelhna thoihna thilte anek ding uh ahi. Thilzek leh siangthou ahih ziak in midang kuamah in anek louh ding uh ahi.
Kihihsianthouna sa hiam tanghou hiam zingsang tan a-omleh mei in na hal ding ahi. Asianthou ziak in na ne ding ahi kei.
Huchibang a thu ka hon piak bangbang in Aaron kiang ah leh atapate kiang ah na hih dia, ni sagih sung amau na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
Lemna thillat ding in niteng in bawngtal khat khelhna thillat ding in na lan ding ahi. Hiai a dia lemna na bawlzoh chiang in, maitam na hihsiang dia, thau na nilh dia, na siangthousak ding ahi,
Ni sagih sung maitam a ding in lemna na bawl dia; na hihsiangthou dia; maitam siangthoupen ahi ding. Huai maitam khoih peuhmah a sianthou ngeingei ding ahi.
Niteng a maitam tung ah kum khat a upa belamnou nih na lat gige ding ahi.
Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan dia; belamnou dang khat nitaklam in na lan ding ahi.
Belamnou khat na lat chiang in tangbuang seh sawm suah seh khat, athau toh hin khat a seh lina toh dawn thillat ding in uain hin khat a seh lina na lan ding ahi.
Belamnou khat dang pen nitaklam in na lan dia, tangbuang thillat dungzui in leh dawn thillat dungzui in gimlim ding in, na hih dia, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat gimnamtui ahi.
Na khang na khang un hiai TOUPA ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a halmang thillat ahi nilouh ding ahi. Huai ah na kiang ua thu gen ding in ka hon kituahpih ding hi.
Huai ah Israel suante ka kituahpih dia, ka thupina in biakbuk ahihsiangthou ding hi.
Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam ka hihsiangthou dia; siampu a pang a kei a dia nasem ding in Aaron leh atapate leng ka hihsiangthou tuaktuak ding hi.
Huchi in Israel suante lak ah ka teng dia, a Pathian uh ka hi ding.
TOUPA a Pathian uh, alak ua ka tentheihna dia amaute Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa ka hi, chih athei ding uh. TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi.
Mosi in asungpa, Midian siampu, Jethro belamhonte aching hi. Gamdai nunglam a belamhonte pi in, Pathian tang, Horeb pha in, ahong pai hi.
Pawn lak a pan meikuang in akiang ah TOUPA Angel ahong kilak hí. A-en a, ngai in, mei in loubukh akuang a, himahleh loubukh akang kei hi.
Mosi in, “Ka kihei dia, hiai thil muh thupi, bangziak a loubukh kang lou ahia, ka va en ding,” achi hi.
Huchi a-en dia kihei lai TOUPA'N amuh in loubuk a pan amah asam a, "Mosi, Mosi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Hiai mun hon naih ke'n. Na khepek a pan na khedapte suah in. Na dinna mun lei siangthou ahi,” achi hi.
Hiai achi lai a, "Na pa' Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ka hi," Mosi in Pathian a-et ngam louh ziak in amai asel hi.
TOUPA'N, "Aigupta gam a ka mite thuakgimna ka mu a, atung ua nasem heutute ziak a akah uh ka zata a, adahnate uh ka thei hi,” achi hi.
"Aiguptate khut a pan amaute pikhe ding leh huai gam a pan gam hoih leh za, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam, Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam tun dia hong paisuk ka hi.
Huaiziak in tu in, ngai in, Israel suante kah thawm ka kiang ahong tungta. Aiguptate'n amau anuaisiahdan uh leng ka mu hi.
Huaiziak in tu in kisa in, Pharaoh kiang ah ka hon sawl ding, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante, ka mite na hon pikhiak theihna ding in," achi hi.
Mosi in Pathian kiang ah, "Pharoah kiang a hoh a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante pikhe ding, kei kua ka hia?" achi hi.

Ama'n, "Na kiang ah ka om ngeingei ding, ka hon sawl chih, hiai nang a ding in akitheihna ahi ding. Aigupta gam a pan mite na pikhiak khit chiang in, hiai tang tung ah Pathian nna na sem ding uh," achi hi.

Mosi in Pathian kiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel suante kiang a ka hong pai a, akiang ua, hichibang a ka va gen chiang in, 'Na pipute uh Pathian in na kiang ua ahon sawl ka hi,' huan amau ka kiang ah, 'Amin bang ahia?' chi in ahon dong ding ua, ke'n akiang uah bang ka genta dia?" achi hi.
Pathian in Mosi kiang ah, "KA HIH KA HI,” achi hi. Huchibang in Israel suante kiang ah na va gen ding ahi, “KA HIH IN na kiang uah ahon sawl hi," chi in.

Pathian in Mosi kiang ah agen behlap lai a, “Israel suante kiang ah hiai gen in: Israel suante Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian in na kiang uah ahon sawl hi: "Hiai ka min ahi gige a, suan tengteng tan a kei theihgigena min ahi.

Kuan inla, Israel upate kaikhawm inla, akiang uah hichi in va gen in. Ka kiang ah, 'Na pipute uh TOUPA Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ahong kilak a, hichi in achi, "Ka hong veh petmah a, Aigupta gam a na tung ua hih a omte ka muta hi."
Huan hichi in ka chita, Aigupta gimna a pan Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ah ka hon pilut ding."

"Na aw angaikhe ding uhi. Huchi in na kuan ding a, nang leh Israel upate, Aigupta kumpipa kiang ah na va hoh ding ua, akiang ah hichibang in na va gen ding uhi. Hebrute' TOUPA Pathian in ahon kimuhpih a, tu in, ka hon ngen uhi, hon paisak in, gamdai a ni thum lam a TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a ka kithoihtheihna ding un.
Ahi a, Aigupta kumpipa'n bantha hatna toh lou in ahon paisak kei ding chih ka theitel hi.
Ka ban ka zak ding a, alak ua ka hih ding ka thillamdang tengteng in Aigupta gam ka gawt ding. Huai nung in ahon paisak pan ding hi.
"Aiguptate mitmuh in hiai mite deihsakna ka pe ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, na pai chiang un khutvuak in na pai kei ding uh.

Numei teng in invengte leh a-inn a khualtamte a pan dangka suangmantamte, dangka-eng suangmantamte leh puansilhte aleitawi ding. Huchi in huaite na tapate uh na silhsak ding ua, na tanute uh na silhsak ding uh. Huchibang in Aiguptate na lok ding uhi," achi hi.
Gimlim halna ding maitam na bawl ding ahi. Singgi sing in na bawl ding ahi.
Asau lam tong khat ahi dia; azatlam tong khat mah. Asau lam leh azatlam akikim dia, asanlam tong nih ahi ding ahi. Akiite leng akibang in sa khat ahi ding uhi
Dangka-engtak in na luan dia; atung, asikte leh akiite ah akimvel in dangka-eng in agei vel na bawl ding hi.
Dangka-eng sikkual nih apang nih a ding na bawl dia, maitam pang nihte ah na bulh dia, azawnna zawlte khumna ding ahi ding uhi.
Singgi sing in azawnna ding chiangte na bawl dia, dangka-eng in huaite na luan ding ahi.
K'on kituahpihna ding mun, theihsakna tung a om zahngaihna tutphah ma, theihpihna bawm kiang a om puanzak ma ah na koih ding ahi.
Zingsang teng in huai tung ahbAaron in gimlim ahal dia; khawnvakte adet chiang in, atung ah gimlim ahal ding ahi.
Nitaklam a Aaron in khawnvakte adet chiang in, atung ah gimlim ahal ding hi. Na khang na khang un TOUPA ma a gimlim ahi tawntung ding hi.
Huai ah theih louh gimlim hiam halmang thillat hiam, tangbuang thillat hiam, na lan ding uh ahi kei. Huai lou in huai ah dawn thillat leng na sung ding uh ahi kei hi.
Kum khat in khatvei Aaron in khelhna thillat sisan akiite ah atat dia, lemna abawl ding ahi. Na khang na khang un kum khat in khatvei atung ah lemna abawl ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia siangthoupen ahi.
Huai khit in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
"Azah uh theihna dia kisimpina na bawl chiang in, pasal chih in ahinna tatna sum TOUPA kiang a apiak ding ahi. Hiai ahihleh amaute na sim chiang a alak ua hipi alenlouhna ding ahi.
Simtel a om michih in tatna sum apiak ding ahi. Mun siangthou sum shekel kimkhat ahi ding ahi. Shekel khat gerah sawmnih a gik ahi.
Simtel a omte lak a paisuak peuhmah kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam in TOUPA kiang a thillat alat ding uh ahi.
Na kha ua ding a lemna bawlna dia, TOUPA kiang a thillat apiak chiang un, ahaute leh azawngte'n shekel kimkhat sang a tamzaw leh tawmzaw apiak louh ding uh ahi.
Hiai bang in Israel suante lemna sum na la dia, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasepna ding in na sep ding ahi; na kha uh tatna ding a, TOUPA ma a Israel suante a dia theihgigena ahihtheihna ding in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
"Kisilna ding in tuikuang dal in na bawl dia, atunna khete leng dal in na bawl ding ahi. Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah na koih dia, huai ah tui na koih ding ahi.
Aaron leh atapate'n akhutte uh leh akhete uh tui in asil ding uh ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin sung a alut ding chiang uhiam, nasem dia TOUPA mai a, mei a thillat lan dia maitam anaih ding chiang ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Akisil kei uleh asi ding uhi.

Huai bang a, asihlouhna ding ua akhutte uh leh akhete uh asil ding uh ahi. Hiai tangtawn in amau a ding in dan thuseh ahi dia; akhang-akhang un amah a ding leh asuante a ding nangawn in ahi ding ahi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen lai hi:
"Gimlim leng kilak inla, murrah tui shekel zanga leh singguithak gimlim huai zah kimkhat, shekel zanih-le-sawmnga sialluang khum shekel zanih-le-sawmnga,
Singguithak shekel zanga, mun siangthou shekel dungzui in, olive thau hin khat.
Nilh theih siangthou in thau na bawl dia, nilh theih damdawi misiamna bang a gawm; nilh theih thau siangthou ahi ding.
Huai in kihoupihna biakbuk na nuh ding, theihpihna bawm toh,
adohkan leh abelsuan tengteng leh khawnvak koihna leh abelsuan chiteng leh gimlim maitam toh.
Haltum thillat maitam leh abelsuan tengteng leh tuikuang leh akhe.
Huaite asiangthoupen hi ding in na hihsiangthou ding ahi. Bangpeuh huaite khoih asianthou ngeingei ding uh ahi.
Aaron leh atapate thau na nilh dia, amau na siangsak ding, siampu nasepna mun a kei a dia nna aseptheihna ding un.
Israel suante kiang ah thu na gen dia, na khang na khang un kei a ding in hiai thaunilh siangthou ahi ding hi.
Mihing sa tung ah na buak ding uh ahi kei. Akihelkhawm bang in akibatpih dang himhim leng na bawl ding uh ahi kei. Hiai nilh siangthou ahi a, nou a ding in asiangthou ding ahi.
Hiai bangbang a hel a, akibatpih sathau bawl hiam, siampu hilou midang tung a zang hiam kuapeuh amite lak a pan ka satkhe ding, achi," chi in.
Huai ban ah TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Gimlimte, singnai, onicha, galbanum leh begaw akikim chiat la in.
Hiaite a pan gimnamtui na bawl ding ahi. Gimnamtui bawlsiamte hel bang na hel ding ahi. Chisoh, asiang leh azek a siangthou ahi ding hi.
Khenkhat na gawizan mahmah dia, kihoupihna biakbuk sung a theihpihna ma ah na koih dia, huai ah ka hon kimuhpih ding hi. Hiai nang a ding in siangthoupen ahi ding hi.
Na bawl ding gimnamtui toh kisai in, ahelkhawmdan a abatpih nou aituam ding in na kibawl ding ahi kei. Nou a ding in TOUPA mai ah siangthou ahi ding ahi.
Agim namtui nap dia abatpih bawl peuhmah amite a pan ka satkhe ding," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
"En in, Judah nam a Hur tapa, Uri tapa Bezaleel amin in ka samta hi.
Pathian Kha leh pilna leh theihsiamna leh theihna leh khutsiamna lam chiteng in amah ka dimsakta hi.
Ama'n khutsiamna in thil lim leh mel nei in agel dia, dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal in thil abawl ding hi.
Huai ban ah suangmantamte a-at dia, singte lim leh mel nei in khutsiamtak in abawl ding hi.
Aseppih ding in akiang ah Dan nam a mi Ahisamak tapa, Aholiab ka peta hi. Khutsiamna nei tengteng leng pilna lungtang ka peta a, amau nang ka hon thupiak bang in thil tengteng abawl ding uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin, theihpihna bawm, huai tung a om zahngaihna tutphah leh puanin vanzat tengteng;
Dohkan leh avante leh khawnvak koihna a van tengteng toh, gimlim maitam;
halmang thillat maitam, avan tengteng toh, tuikuang leh akhe;
nasepna puante leh siampu Aaron puan siangthoute leh atapate puansilhte, siampu nasepna mun a nasem ding in;
huan nilh theih thau leh Mun Siangthou a ding gimlim abawl ding ua, nang ka hon thupiak tengteng bang in ahih ding uhi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:

Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in, "Chihtaktak a ka Sabbath na tan ngeingei ding uh ahi. Na khang ua kei leh nou kal a chiamtehna ahih ziak in. Nou hon hihsiangthou, TOUPA ka hi, chih na theihna ding un.
Huaiziak in Sabbath na tang ding ua; nou a dia siangthou ahih ziak in. Kuapeuh hiai hihbuah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi. Kuapeuh hiai ni a nasem, amite lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
Ni guk sung nna septheih ahi dia; himahleh ani sagihna Sabbath, TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi. Sabbath ni a kuapeuh in nna khatpeuh asepleh, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Huaiziak in Israel suante'n Sabbath ni atang ding ua, thukhun tawntung hi ding in, akhang-akhang un Sabbath ni atang ding uhi.
Hiai tangtawn in kei leh Israel suante kikal a chiamtehna ahi. Ni guk a TOUPA'N lei leh van abawl a, ani sagih ni akhawl a, atawldam ziak in," achi hi.
Sinai Tang tung a Pathian in Mosi houpih a, thu agen khit in theihsakna pek nih, suangpekte, Pathian khutzung a gelh, Mosi apia hi.

Tang a pan Mosi ahong paisuk pah louh mite'n atheih un, mite Aaron kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, akiang ah, "Kisa in, ka ma ua pai ding, pathiante hon bawlsak in. Hiai Mosi, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa lah, bang chita ahia, ka thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi.
Aaron in akiang uah, "Na zite uh bil a om, na tapate uh bil a om, na tanute uh bil a om, dangka-eng bilbahte tolkhia unla, ka kiang ah hon tawi un,” achi hi.
Mi tengteng in abil ua dangka-eng bilbahte atolkhia ua, Aaron kiang ah ahon tawi uhi.

Ama'n akhut ua pan huaite ala a, sunthoh bawngnou lim abawl a, huai bang in dangka-eng bawngnou lim in asung hi. Huai khit in amau, "Israel aw, Aigupta gam a pan nang hon pikhia na pathian hiai ahi,” akichi uhi.
Aaron in huai amuhtak in, ama uah maitam abawl a, Aaron in thupuan anei a, "Zingchiang TOUPA a dia ankuangluina ahi," achi hi.
Azing in beltak in athou ua, halmang thillat alan ua, lemna thillat atawi uhi. Mite ne ding leh dawn ding in atu ua, kimawl ding in adingh uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Kumsuk in, na mi Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiakte, akihihsiat ziak un.

Amau ka lampi hilh a pan apial pah man hial uhi. Bawngnou lim sun akibawl ua, huai abia ua, amai ah thillatte alan ua, 'Israel aw, hiai na pathian, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhetu ahi,' achi uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mite ka muta a, ngai in, migenhakte ahi uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in atung uah ka thangpaihna akuangzak a, amaute ka kattum theihna ding in hon subuai kei in. Huchi in nam thupi in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA a Pathian angen a, "TOUPA, thilhihtheihna thupi leh ban thahat a Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiaksa, na mite tung ah bangziak a na thangpaihna kuangzak ding ahia?

Bang ding in ahia Aiguptate'n thu gen a, 'Hihse dia amau pikhia ahita ve, tangte a amaute that ding leh leitung maikaih a pan amaute kangtum ding in?' Na thangpaihna thupi lakik inla, na mite tung a hiai thil hoih lou na ngaihtuah kikhelsak in.

Akiang ua, 'Van a aksite bang in na suante ka pungsak dia, na suante kiang a thu ka gensa, hiai gam tengteng ka hon pe ding, huchi in tangtawn in na luah ding uh,' chi a, nangmah ngei a na kichiamna, na sikhate, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob theigige in," achi hi.
Huchi in amite tung a thil hoih lou hih dia angaihtuah TOUPA'N akikhelsakta hi.
Mosi akihei a, tang a kipan apaisuk hi. Akhut ah theihpihna suangpek nihte a-om a, suangpekte alangnih tuak a gelh ahi a, khat lam leh langkhat lam a gelh ahi uhi.
Suangpekte Pathian thilhih ahi a, agelhte leng Pathian gelh ahi, suangpekte tung a kigelhte.
Joshua in mite kikou husa azak in Mosi kiang ah, "Giahphual ah kidouna husa a-om," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Tungnun kituh a kikoute aw ahi kei a, nuaisiah a om ziak a kapte aw leng ahi kei. Lasate husa ahi zaw ka zak," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, giahphual kiang ahong tuntak in, bawngnou leh lam amuta hi. Huchi in Mosi hehna asou a, akhut a pan suangpekte apai a, tang nuai ah akeksakta hi.
Abawngnou bawl uh ala a, mei ah akhul a, agawinen a, tui tung ah atheh a, Israel suante adawnsak hi.
Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Hiai mite'n bang ahia na kiang a ahih uh, atung ua hichi tel a khelhna thupi na tunsak?" achi hi.
Aaron in, "Mite'n thil sia azondan uh na thei hi, ka toupa' hehna kuang kei hen.
Ka ma ua pai ding, pathiante hon bawlsak in. Hiai Mosi, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhetoupa lah, bang suakta ahia ka thei ngal kei ua, ka kiang a achih ziak un.
Ke'n akiang uah, dangka-eng nei peuh in hon tolkhia un ka chi hi. Huchi in amau kei ahon pia ua; ke'n mei sung ah ka khia a, hiai bawngnou lim ahong pawtkhia," achi hi.
Aaron in a-utut ua om dia mite ataizak uh phal in, melmate ma ah zahlak in a-omsak, chih Mosi in amu hi.
Giahphual kongpi ah Mosi adingh a, "TOUPA lam a pang kuakua ahia? Ka kiang ah hong pai hen," achi hi. Akiang ah Levi ta tengteng akikhawmkhawmta uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Israel TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Michih in apang ah anamsau kuah henla, giahphual tuansuak in kongpi khat a pan kongpi dang ah lut in pawt henla, michih in asanggampa, michih in alawmpa, michih in a-invengte that hen," achi hi.
Levi tapate'n Mosi thu dungzui in ahihta ua; huchi in huai ni in mite lak ah mi sangthum asi uhi.
Mosi in, "Michih in atapa, michih in a-unaupa douta na hih ziak un, ahon vualzawl theihna ding in tuni in TOUPA a ding in kihihsiangthou un," achi hi.
Azing in hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Khelhna khawktak in na khialta uhi. Tu in TOUPA kiang ah ka hohtou dia; na khelhna uh a ding in lemna ka bawl thei maithei hi," achi hi.
TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akik nawn a, "Aw, hiai mite'n khelhna thupitak ahih ua, dangka-eng pathiante akibawl uhi.
Ahi a lah, tu in, akhelhna uh ngaidam in; Na ngaihdam kei dingleh, na gelhsa na laibu a pan kei hon thaimang in, ka hon ngen ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Kuapeuh ka tung a khial, ka laibu a pan ka thaimang ding.
Huaiziak in tu in kuan inla, na kiang a ka genna mun ah mite pi in. Ngai in, na ma ah ka Angel apai ding. Akoi abang hitaleh gawt dia ka veh ni in akhelhna uh ziak in amaute ka gawt ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Aaron in abawl bawngnou mai a thil alat ziak in TOUPA'N mite hipi in agawtta hi.

Huai khit in, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Kuan inla, hiai a kipan paitou in, nang leh Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak mite, na suante kiang ah ka hon pe ding, chi a, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a ka kichiamna gam ah.
Na ma ah ka angel ka sawl ding a; huchi in Kanaante, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste ka hawlkhe ding.
Bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ah hohtou un. Migenhakte na hih ziak un, kei na lak ua hohtou lou ding ka hi. Huchi lou in zaw lampi ah ka hon kangtum kha ding," achi hi.
Mite'n hiai thuhoih lou azak un, alungkham uhi. Huchi in mi kuamah kizepna a kizem a-om kei uh.

TOUPA'N lah Mosi kiang ah, "Israel suante kiang ah, migenhakte na hi uhi. Mitphiat kal lou a na lak ua hong tou a, hong kangtum thei ka hi. Huaiziak in na tung ua bang hih ding ka hia, chih ka theihna ding in na kizepnate uh suahkhia un," chi in ana gen khinta hi.
Huchi in Israel suante'n Horeb tang ah akizepnate uh asuahkhe vek uhi.

Mosi in puanin asut a, giahphual polam, giahphual a pan gamlapi ah akai a, Kihoupihna Biakbuk, achi hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, michih TOUPA zongte kihoupihna biakbuk, giahphual polam a om ah ahoh uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanin lam a Mosi apaikhiak teng in, mite avek un adingh ua, michih apuanin kongkhak bul ah adingh ua; puanin a alut mateng Mosi a-enzui uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanin a Mosi alutleh, meipi khuam ahong kumsuk a, puanin kongkhak bul ah adingh a, huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupihta hi.
Mi tengteng in puanin kongkhak bul a dingh, meipi khuam amu uhi. Mi tengteng adingh ua abia uhi; michih in apuanin kongkhak chiat ah.
Mi'n alawm ahoupih bang in, TOUPA'N kimaituah in Mosi ahoupih hi. Huchi in giahphual ah akik nawn a, himahleh asikha Joshua, Nun tapa, tangval nou ahihleh puanin a pan apaikhe kei hi.

Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "En in, hiai mite hon pitou in na hon chi a, himahleh ka kiang a kua hon sawl ding na hia chih na hon theisak kei hi. Hinapi in lah, na min in ka hon thei a, ka mitmuh in hehpihna leng na mu hi, na chi hi.

Huaiziak in tu in, ka hon ngen ahi. Na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhleh, nang ka hon theihna ding leh na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhtheihna ding in, tu in na lampi hon ensak in. Hiai nam na mite ahi, chih ngaihtuah in," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka ompihna nang toh aton dia, khawlna ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Na ompihna kei toh aton kei dingleh, hiai a pan hon pitou ke'n.

N'on tonpih keileh, bangchi in na mite leh ke'n na mitmuh in deihsakna ka mu uh chih kithei ding ahia? Leitung pumpi a teng mi tengteng a pan kei leh na mite atuam ka hi uh, chih bang in akichiansak dia?" achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ka mitmuh in deihsakna na mu a, na min in ka hon theita a, hiai na nget pen leng ka hon hihsak ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka hon ngen hi, na thupina hon ensak in," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Na ma ah ka hoihna tengteng ka paisak dia, na ma ah TOUPA min ka tangkoupih ding. 'Ka hehpih nopmi, ka hehpih dia, zahngaihna ka lah nopmi kiang ah zahngaihna ka lak ding,' achi hi.
Himahleh ka mai na mu thei kei ding; mi, kei hon mu, ahing kuamah a-om louh ziak in.
TOUPA'N, 'En in, hiai ah ka kiang ah mun khat a-om a; suangpi tung ah na dingh in.
Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, ka thupina in hon khen sung in suangpi heng ah ka hon koih dia, ka hon khen sung in ka khut in ka hon khuh ding hi.
Huai khit chiang in ka khut ka lakhe dia, huchi in ka nunglam na mu dia; himahleh ka mai bel akimu kei ding, " achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Amasa bang in suangpek nih bawl inla; hiai suangpekte tung ah, na hihsiat suangpek masapente a om thute ka gelh ding.
Zingsang in mansa in om inla, zingsang in Sinai Tang ah hong paitou inla, tang vum ah ka kiang ah hong kihil in.
Na kiang a kuamah ahong paitouh louh ding uh ahi. Tang kimvel a leng kuamah himhim muh a a-om louh ding uh ahi. Tang mazawn lam a bawnghon leh belamhon leng agamtat louh ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in amasapen bang in suangpek nih abawl hi. Zingkhang in Mosi athou a, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in, Sinai Tang ah ahohtou a, akhut in suangpek nihte atawi hi.
Meipi ah TOUPA ahong kumsuk a, akiang ah ahong dingh a, TOUPA min agenkheta hi.
Huchi in ama ah TOUPA apaisuak a, "TOUPA, TOUPA Pathian, hehpih thei leh it thei, dohthei leh, hoihna leh thutak hau.

Sangte a dia zahngaihna nei, gitlouhna, tatlekna leh khelhna ngaidam, mohna bangchi mah a siangsak lou ding, pate gitlouhna tate tung leh atusuante tung, akhang thumna leh akhang lina tan a thukpa," chi in apuangkhia hi.
Kintak in lei si in Mosi akunsuk a, abeta hi.

Ama'n, "Tu a na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhleh, TOUPA aw, ka hon ngen hi, ka lak uah ka TOUPA pai hen; migenhak ahih ziak un. Ka gitlouhna uleh ka khelhna uh ngaidam inla, na gouluah ding in hon la in," achi hi.

Ama'n: Ngai in, nou toh thukhun ka bawl hi. Leitung pumpi a hih a om ngei lou, koi nam a leng hih a om ngei lou, thillamdangte na mi tengteng ma ah ka hih ding hi. Alak ua na tenna mi tengteng in TOUPA'N nou a dia thil lauhuai ka hih dingte amu ding uh.
Nang tuni a ka hon thupiak zui in. Ngai in na ma uah Amorte, leh Kanaante, leh Hitte, leh Perizte, leh Hivte, leh Jebuste ka hawlkhe ding hi.
Pilvang in, na paina gam a tengte toh thukhun na bawl kha ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua thang ahi ding uhi.
Amaitamte uh hihsia un, amilimte uh hihgawpsak un, a Asherah songte uh na phuksak ding uh ahi.
Pathian dang na be ding uh ahi kei: TOUPA, amin Mullit hat ahi a, mullit hat Pathian ahi.
Huai gam a teng mite toh kikal ah thukhun na bawl kha ding uh. Apathiante uh kiang a kithoihna alat chiang in khattei in ahon chial dia, akithoihna sa uh na ne kha ding uh.
Na tapate a ding in atanute uh na pisak kha ding ua, atanute uh apathiante uh kiang a akizuak chiang un, na tapate uh leng amaute hih bang a, amilimte uh be ding in akhempuk kha ding uhi.
Sunthoh pathiante na kibawl ding uh ahi kei.

Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina na nei gige ding uh ahi. Thu ka hon piak tak bang in, Abib kha in, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh; Abib kha a Aigupta a pan a na hong paikhiak ziak un.
Sul hong ta masa tengteng, na ganhon lak ua piang masapen teng, bawngtal hi in belam hileh, apa peuhpeuh kei a ahi.

Himahleh sabiltungnou masapen belamnou in na tatkhiak ding uh ahi. Na tatkhiak kei uleh, angawng na hektan ding uh ahi. Na tapate tengteng lak a piang masapen na tatkhiak ding ahi. Ka ma ah kuamah khutvuak in ahong kilang ding uh ahi kei.
Ni guk sung nna na sem ding ahi. Himahleh ani sagih ni in na khawl ding ahi. Haichi pawi hun leh pawltak hun in na khawl ding ahi.
Nipi kalte a ankuangluina, huit buh pawltak gah masa ankuangluina, kum tawp a koihkhawmna ankuang- luinate na tan ding ahi.
Kum khat in thumvei pasal teng- teng Toupa PATHIAN, Israel' Pathian ma a akilat ding uh ahi.
Na mai ua namte ka delhkhe ding a, na gamgi uh ka keklian ding. Kum khat a thumvei TOUPA na Pathian ma a na kilat chiang un, kuamah in na gam uh ahon deihgoh kei ding hi.
"Ka mai a kithoihna thillat; silngou toh sisan na lan ding uh ahi kei. Paikan Ankuanglui kithoihna leng azingchiang tan in nutsiat in a-om ding ahi kei.
Na gam a gah masa hoihpente a masapen TOUPA na Pathian inn ah na hon tawi ding ahi. Kelnou anu' nawitui in na huan ding ahi kei," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai thute gelh in. Hiai thute omdan zui a nang leh Israel toh thukhun ka bawl tak ziak in," achi hi.
TOUPA kiang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli a-om a; an ane kei a, tui leng adawn kei hi. Suangpek tung ah thukhun thute, huai Thupiak Sawmte agelh hi.
Sinai Tang a kipan akhut a theihpihna suangpek nihte tawi a, tang a kipan Mosi ahong paisuk lai in, amah ahoupih sung in amaitang tang ahi chih Mosi in athei kei hi.
Aaron leh Israel suan tengteng in Mosi amuhtak un, ngai in, amaitang atang a; amah naih a hong pai alauta uhi.
Himahleh Mosi in amaute asam a; Aaron leh mipi kikhawmte heutu tengteng akiang ah ahong kik nawn ua; Mosi in amaute ahoupih hi.
Huai nung in Israel suan tengteng ahong pai nai ua; Sinai Tang a TOUPA'N akiang a agen tengteng thupiak in amaute apeta hi.
Mosi in amaute ahoupih khit in, amaitang khuhna in akhuh hi.
Himahleh TOUPA houpih dia amai alut teng in, ahong pawtkhiak nawn mateng, thupiak a omte Israel suante kiang a agen chiang in, amai khuhna ahawkkhia hi.
Israel suante'n Mosi maitang amu ua, Mosi maivun atang hi. Mosi in amah houpih dia alut nawn matan in amaitang akhuh zel hi.
Huan Mosi in Israel suan tengteng akhawmkhawm a, akiang uah: "Hiaitę na hih ding ua TOUPA thupiakte ahi.

Ni guk sung in nna sep zoh ahi dia, himahleh ani sagih ni noute a dia inn om ni ahi ding hi. TOUPA a dia Sabbath khawlna ahi. Sabbath ni a noute a dia inn om ni: Hiai ni nna sem peuhmah thah ding ahi.
Sabbath ni in na tenna peuh uah mei na chih ding uh ahi kei," achi hi.
Israel suan kikhawmkhawm tengteng kiang ah Mosi in thu agen a, "TOUPA'N noute ahon thupiak hiaite ahi uh.
TOUPA a ding in na lak uah thilpiakte lakhawm un. Lungtang a utna nei kuapeuh in TOUPA a ding in thilpiakte: dangka-eng, dangka leh dal;
khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih, kel mul;
belampa mul diahsan, ngalvang vun, singgi sing;
khawnvak a ding thau, thaunilh ding in gimlim; hal namtui ding;
onik suangte, siampu puanak leh awmtuam a siat ding suangmantamte hon tawikhawm uhen," achi hi.
"Na lak ua khutsiam tengteng na hong pai ding ua, TOUPA'N bawl ding chi a thu ahon piak tengteng abawl ding uhi.
Biakbuk, apuanin, akhuhna, asikkawi, asingpekte, asiktawnte, akhuamte leh akingakna khuakkuakte;
abawm leh achiangte, zahngaihna tutphah leh akhuhna puanzak;
dohkan leh achiangte, atui-um belsuan leh tanghou koihna;
khawnvak a ding in khawnvak koihna leng, avante, akhawnvakte, avakna thau;
gimlim maitam leh achiangte, nilh theih thau, gimlim leh biakbuk lutna kongkhak a dia puankhai,
halmang thillatna maitam, adal vutluah, azawlte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng, tuikuang leh akhe;
ahuangsung puankhaite, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, huangsung kongkhak a dia puankhai;
biakbuk kilhna zumte, huangsung kilhna zumte leh akhaute;
nasepna puante, mun siangthou a nasepna dia siampu Aaron puan siangthoute, atapate puante bawl uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel suan kikhawm teng Mosi omna a pan apaita uhi.

Michih alungtang tohthoh a om peuhmah leh michih utna nei peuhmahte ahong pai ua, kihoupihna biakbuk lamna ding leh asung a nasepna ding leh puansilh siangthoute bawlna ding TOUPA ma ah thilpiak ahon tawi uhi.
Lungtang a utna nei pasalte leh numeite ahong pai ua, dangka-eng a kibawl thil tuamtuam: bilbah, nakbah, zungbuh, ohthoh leh butthoh kizepnate ahon tawi ua, TOUPA mai ah alan uhi.
Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih, kel mul, belampa vun, ngalvang vun neite'n huaite ahon tawi uhi.
Thilpiak dia dangka leh dal neite'n TOUPA mai a thillat ding in ahon tawi uhi. Singgi sing nei teng in leng ahon tawi uhi.
Numei khutsiam teng in khut in khau akhek ua, akheksa uh ahon tawi ua, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih ahon tawi uhi.
Lungtang tohthoh numei tengteng in kel mul akhek uhi.
Vaihawm mite'n onik suangte, suangte, siampu puan leh awmtuam a siat dingte ahon tawi uhi;
gimnamtui hal ding singgah namtui leh det ding meivak leh nilh ding sathau a zat ding leh gimnamtui a hel ding sathau ahon tawi uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu apiak a, van bawl ding achih tengteng bawlna ding in Israel suante, numei leh pasalte'n amau ut thu in thilpiakte TOUPA mai ah ahon tawi uhi.
Mosi in Israel suante kiang ah, "En un, TOUPA'N Bezaleel, Uri tapa, Hur tapa, Judah nam a mi amin in asam a;
Pathian Kha leh pilna leh theihsiamna leh theihna leh khutsiamna chiteng in amah adimsak hi.
Huai bel khutsiamtak a bawl dingte gelsiamna, dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal thilbawlsiamna ahi a, bulh ding suangmantamte atsiamna, sing lam siamna ahi.
bulh ding suangmantamte atsiamna, sing lam siamna leh khutsiam thilbawl chiteng asiamna ahi.
Huan amah leh Dan nam a Ahisamak tapa Aholiab leng midangte sinsak siamna apia hi.
Amaute teng khuakthoh a thilbawl siamna chikim leh khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih gat zep siamna, gat siamna, ze tuamtuam gelh siamna nei ding in pilna apia hi," achi hi.
"Hiai bang in Bezaleel, Aholiab leh mun siangthou vanzatte bawldan ding thei ding a TOUPA'N pilna leh theihsiamna a piak khutsiamte'n TOUPA thupiak bang in vanzatte abawl ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
Huai khit in Mosi in Bezaleel, Aholiab leh michih khutsiamna nei, alungtang ua TOUPA'N pilna akoih leh michih alungtang ua nasem a kuan dia tohthoh a omte Mosi in asamta hi.
Amaute'n mun siangthou bawlna dia Israel suante'n ahon tawi uh thilpiak tengteng Mosi a pan alata uhi. Huchi in zingsang teng in ut thu apiak thillatte akiang ah hon tawi uhi.
Mun siangthou a nna tengteng sem, khutsiam teng a nasep chiat a pan ahong pai ua,
Mosi kiang ah, "TOUPA'N bawl dia ahon thupiak bang a nasepna dia poimoh zah sang a tamzaw mite'n ahon tawi uh," achi uhi.

Mosi in thu apia a, giahphual teng ah atangkoupih ua, "Pasal hileh numei hileh mun siangthou bawlna dia thilpiak kuamah in pe nawn kei un," achi hi. Huchi in thilpiak hon tawi nawn lou dia kham in a-omta uhi.
Mun siangthou bawlna a nna tengteng sepna ding in avan neihsa uh kiching in, atam lota hi.
Nasemte lak a khutsiamte'n biakbuk khuhna ding siamtak a khui cherubte lim tuanna puanzak sawm, khau dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au khuk in abawl uhi.
Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmnih-le-giat ahi a; availam tong li; puanzak tengteng letdan akikim chiat hi.
Puanzak ngate kithuah in akhep uhi. Puanzak dang ngate leng akhep hi.
Akithuahna mong khepna a pan puanzak khat gei ah khau dum in abilte abawl a, huchi mah in anihna khepna ah, puanzak dang gei chin ah abilte abawl hi.
Puanzak khat ah abil sawmnga abawl a, anihna kikhepna a puanzak gei ah abil sawmnga abawl hi. Abilte kizawn geihgeih in a-om uhi.
Dangka-eng in kilhna sawmnga abawl a, kilhnate in puanzakte agawmkhawm hi. Huchi in biakbuk khat ahong hita hi.
Puanin biakbuk tung a ding in kel mul in puanzak abawl a; sawm-le-khat abawl hi.
Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmthum ahi a, puanzak khat vailam tong li ahi. Puanzak sawm-le-khatte alehlam akibang vek hi.
Puanzak ngate amau in akikheptuam a, puanzak gukte amau in akikheptuam hi.
Akikhepna puanzak mongchin ah abil sawmnga abawl a, puanzak anihna thuahna pen mong ah abil sawmnga abawl hi.
Khat ahihtheihna dia puanin kaihkhawmna ding in dal in kilhna sawmnga abawl hi.
Puanin khuhna ding in belampa vun diahsan in abawl a, huai tung ah ngalvang vun in khuhna abawl hi.
Singgi sing in biakbuk singpek ding atunthoh in abawl hi.
Singpek sau lam tong sawm ahi a, singpek zatlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
Singpek khat in atgek nih anei a, akigamlatdan uh kikim in huchibang in biakbuk singpek tengteng a ding in abawl hi.
Biakbuk a ding in singpek abawl a, simlam pang a ding in singpek sawmnih abawl hi.

Singpek sawmnih nuai ah dangka-eng in kingakna khuakkuak sawmli abawl a; a-atgek nihte a ding in singpek khat dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, a-atgek nih a ding in singpek dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
Biakbuk pang khat lam a ding in, amallam ning a om a ding in singpek sawmnih,
adangka-eng kingakna khuakkuak sawmlite toh; singpek khat dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, singpek dang khat ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
Tumlam biakbuk pangte a ding in singpek nih abawl hi.
Apang nihte ah biakbuk ningte a ding in singpek nih abawl hi.
Anuai ah akithuah ua, atung ah sikkual khat ah akikaikhawm a; huchibang in aning tuak ah ahih tuaktuak hi.
Singpek giat a-om a; akingakna khuakkuak uh, dangka a bawl kingakna khuakkuak sawm-le-guk ahi ua, singpek chih dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
Singgi sing chiangtawn abawl a, biakbuk pang khat a singpekte a ding in nga abawl hi.
Biakbuk pang dang a singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga abawl a, tumlam pang a biakbuk singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga abawl hi.
Chiangtawn laita pen singpekte khat a pan adang kap paisuak in abawl hi.
Singpekte dangka-eng in aluan a, adangka-eng sikkualte chiangtawn omna ding in abawl a, chiangtawnte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat koptah hoih in puankhai abawl a; khutsiamtak in cherubte abawl hi.
Singgi sing in khuam li abawl a; dangka-eng in aluan a, abannate dangka-eng abawl hi. Huaite a ding in dangka in kingakna khuakkuak li asung hi.
Biakbuk kongkhak a ding in khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui in puankhai abawl hi.
Akhuam ngate abanna uh toh; azingte uleh apuanduangte dangka-eng in aluan a, himahleh akingakna khuakkuak ngate dal a bawl ahi.
Huan Bazaleel in singgi sing in bawm abawl a, adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi a, availam tong khat-le-akim, huan asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
Dangka-engtak in asunglam leh apolam aluan a, dangka-eng lallukhu akimvel in abawl hi.
Aning lite a bulh ding in dangka-eng sikkual li asung hi. Apang khat asikkual nih, apang khat lam ah sikkual nih.
Singgi sing in zawl abawl a, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Huan bawm pang a sikkual sung ah, bawm zawnna ding in hiai zawlte athunlut hi.
Dangka-engtak in zahngaihna tutphah abawl a; tong nih-le-akim adunglam ahi a, tong khat-le-akim availam ahi.
Dangka-eng sekkhiak in zahngaihna tutphah mong nihte tuak ah cherubte abawl hi.
Hiai lam pang mong ah cherub khat, huai lam pang mong ah cherub dang khat, zahngaihna tutphah a pan among langnihte ah cherubte abawl hi.
Cherubte'n tunglam ah akha uh azak ua, zahngaihna tutphah tunglam ah, amai uh kingattuah in, akha un akhuh ua; zahngaihna tutphah lam ah cherubte mai a-om hi.
Singgi sing in dohkan abawl a; adunglam tong nih ahi a, availam tong khat, huan asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
Dangka-engtak in aluan a, akimvel in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
Huai lou in huai ah akimvel in khutpek chia in agei abawl a; akimvel in agei ding in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
Dangka-eng sikkual li asung a, akhe lite a om aning lite tung ah sikkualte abulh hi.
Ageichin ah, dohkan puakna ding chiangte a ding in mun, sikkualte a-om uhi.
Singgi sing in chiangte abawl a, dohkan puakna ding in, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Dohkan tung a om tui-um belsuan abawl a, akuangte leh asikkeute leh anoubemte leh akhuhna ding singte, dangka-engtak in abawl hi.
Khawnvak koihna dangka-engtak in abawl a; sekthoh in khawnvak koihna abawl hi. Akungpi, ahiang, anoubemte leh amumte leh apakte kibang chiat uhi.
Apangte a pan hiang guk akakhia a; khawnvak koihna hiang thum apang khat a pan, apang dang a pan khawnvak koihna hiang thum.
Noubem thum makha gah bang a bawl hiang khat ah, amum leh apak; noubem thum makha gah bang a bawl hiang dang ah, amum leh apak, huchibang in hiang guk teng ah khawnvak koihna a pan in.
Khawnvak koihna makha gah bang a bawl noubem li a-om; amumte leh apakte toh.
Akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, hiang gukte bang zel in akakhia uhi.
Amumte uh leh ahiangte uh kibang ahi ua: avek un dangka-engtak sekthoh ahi.
Khawnvak sagihte, meihalnate leh meivu kuangte dangka-engtak in abawl hi.
Dangka-engtak talent khat in tui-um belsuan teng abawl hi.
Gimlim maitam singgi sing in abawl a; adunglam tong khat ahi, availam tong khat; kiptak a bawl ahi a; asanlam tong nih ahi. Akibang vek uhi.
Dangka-engtak in atung leh akimvel in apangte leh akite aluan hi. Huai lou leng akimvel in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
Alallukhu nuai ah dangka-eng in sikkual nih abawl a, aning nihte kiang ah, asik nihte tung ah, apuakna ding chiangte omna ding in.
Huan singgi sing in zawlte abawl a, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Nilh theih thau siangthou, gim-namtui siangthou, gimlim bawlmi hih bang in abawl hi.
Singgi sing in halmang thillat maitam abawl a; adunglam tong nga ahi a, availam tong nga ahi a, huan asanlam tong thum ahi. Kiptak a bawl ahi.
Aning lite ah akii abawl a; akiite akibang vek ua; dal in aluan hi.
Atui-um belsuan tengteng, maitam, belte, vutluahte, salu kuangte, sa thuknate leh meibel tengteng dal in abawl hi.
Huan alaizangtak nuai ah among dang ah dal hakvang maitam a ding in abawl hi.
Chiangte omna ding in, dal hakvang mong lite a ding in sikkual li asung hi.
Singgi sing in zawl abawl a, dal in aluan hi.
Azawnna ding in, maitam pang a sikkualte sung ah zawlte athunlut a; maitam singpek in asung ahawmsak hi.
Dal in tuikuang leh akhe abawl a, numei nasem, kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a kikhawmte' limlangte abawl hi.
Huangsung abawl a; simlam pang simlam ah huangsung puankhai, puanmalngat hoih koptah, tong zakhat a-om hi.
Akhuamte sawmnih ahi ua, adal kingakna khuakkuakte sawmnih; khuam bannate leh adangka puanduangte a-om uhi.
Amallam pang a ding in puankhaite tong zakhat ahi ua, akhuamte uh sawmnih leh adal kingakna khuakkuakte sawmnih; akhuamte abannate leh dangka gaknate.
Atumlam pang a ding in tong sawmnga a sau puankhaite a-om ua, akhuamte sawm leh akingakna khuakkuak sawm; akhuamte abannate leh adangka gaknate a-om uhi.
Asuahlam pang suahlam a ding in tong sawmnga.
Kongpi sik khat a puankhaite tong sawm-le-nga ahi ua; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuakte thum mah.
Hiai lam leh huai lam, huangsung kongpi sik khat lam pang a ding in puankhai tong sawm-le-nga ahi ua; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuakte thum mah ahi.
Huangsung akimvel a puankhai tengteng puanmalngat koptah hoih ahi.
Khuam kingakna khuakkuakte dal ahi ua; khuam bannate leh adangka gaknate dangka azingte uh luanna; huangsung khuam tengteng dangka in agaknate akibawl hi.
Huangsung kongpi a puankhai phim a khui, khau dum, khau sandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah ahi. Adunglam tong sawmnih ahi a, apek sanlam tong nga ahi, huangsung puankhaite toh akituak hi.
Akhuamte li ahi a, akingakna khuakkuakte li, dal a bawl ahi. Abannate dangka a bawl, dangka a bawl azingte leh adung luante.
Biakbuk kilhna zum teng leh huangsung kimvel kilhna tengteng dal ahi uh.
Hiai biakbuk vankim, sim a om bang in, theihpihna biakbuk ate ngei, Levite nasepna dia, Mosi thupiak bang zel a siampu Aaron tapa, Ithamar khut a bawl ahi uhi.
Huchi in Bezaleel, Uri tapa, Hur tapa, Judah nam a mi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng abawlta hi.
Amah toh sem, gelh nasep siam, khau dum leh khau sandup leh khau san-au leh puanmalngat a zebawl siam, Aholiab, Ahisamak tapa, Dan nam a mi ahi.
Dangka-eng tengteng mun siangthou a nasepna teng a sepna dia zat, thillat dangka-eng nangawn, talent sawmnih-le-kua leh shekel, mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in, zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi.
Dangka, khawmpi a simte mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in talent zakhat leh shekel sangkhat zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
Michih a ding in beka khat, huai bel, shekel kimkhat ahi, mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in, michih sim a omte a ding in, kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam, pasal nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga.

Dangka talent zakhat mun siangthou a kingakna khuakkuak a ding in asung ua, puanzak a kingakna khuakkuakte toh; talent zakhat a dia kingakna khuakkuak zakhat, kingakna khuakkuak khat a dia talent khat zel.
Shekel sangkhat zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga in khuam bannate abawl a, azingte luan in akimatsak hi.
Thillat dal talent sawmsagih leh shekel sangnih-le-zali ahi.
Huaite in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak kingakna khuakkuak abawl a, dal maitam leh dal hakvang a bawl, maitam tui-um belsuan tengteng toh.
Huangsung kimvel a kingakna khuakkuak, huangsung kongpi kingakna khuakkuak, biakbuk kilhna zum tengteng leh huangsung kimvel a kilhna zum tengteng azou hi.
Khau dum leh khau sandup leh khau san-au kigan in Mun Siangthou a nasepna ding siampu puante abawl ua, Aaron puansilh siangthoute abawl uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a bawl ahi.
Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah dangka-eng in siampu puan abawl uhi.
Dangka-eng khau leh khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih a kigan in siampu puanakzem abawl uhi.
Anunglam leh malam kaihkhawmna ding, aliangzang ah kaihna abawl ua, atunglam gei tuak akhihkhawm hi.

Atung a om, asiampu puanak siamneltak a gat leng akibang mah in anasep dungzui in; dangka-eng, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak dungzui in gat in abawl uhi.
Onik suang abawl ua, chiamtehna gelhna a gelh, dangka- eng bulhna a bulh in, Israel suante min dungzui zel in abawl uhi.
Huaite siampu puanak liangzang ah akoih ua, Israel suante a dia theihgigena suangte hi ding in: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl hi.
Khutsiamtak in awmtuam abawl a, siampu puan bawl bang in, dangka-eng, khau dum leh khau san leh khau sandup leh khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in abawl hi.
Adung-avai akikim a; awmtuamna thuah nih in abawl uhi. Asau lam khap khat ahi a, availam khap khat, thuah nih ahi.
Huai ah vual li in suang asiat ua; avual khatna sardi suang, topaz suang leh karbankul suang; hiai avual khatna ahi.
Avual nihna, emerald suang, sapphir suang leh diamond ahi.
Avual thumna, liguri suang, agate suang leh amethis suang ahi.
Avual lina, beril suang, onik suang leh jasper suang ahi a; aphuhna uah dangka-eng bulhna asiatlut uhi.
Suangte Israel suante min dungzui zel leh ahihna zah uh dungzui zel in, sawm-le-nih, chiamtehna gelhnate bang in, michih amin toh nam sawm-le-nihte gelh ahi.
Amongte ah awmtuam tung ah khainiang, dangka-engtak pakkhi abawl uhi.
Huchi in dangka-eng bulhna nih abawl ua, dangka-eng sikkual nih toh, awmtuamna mong nihte ah sikkual nihte akoih uhi.
Awmtuamna mongte a sikkual nihte sung ah dangka-eng khainiang nihte pak bang a bawl in athun uhi.
Pak khainiang nihte mong nihte suangmantam bulhna nihte ah akoih ua, ama ah siampu puan liangzang thuahna ah akoih uhi.
Dangka-eng in sikkual nih abawl ua, awmtuamna mong nihte tung ah akoih ua, agei ah sunglam pang ah siampu puanak a-om hi.
Dangka-eng sikkual nih dang abawl ua, nuailam ah siampu puanak mong nihte ah akoih uhi, amalam sang ah, akikhepna zawntak ah, siampu puanak kawnggak kigatthoh tung ah akoih uhi.
Gakna khau dum in siampu puanak sikkualte in awmtuam agakden ua, siampu puanak a pan a awmtuam akiphel theihlouhna ding in; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
Siampu puanak puanaktual gatthoh, avek a adum a bawl ahi.
Puanak tual laitak ah avang a-om a, sik puanak banbei vang bang in, akeklouhna ding a, avang kimvel in kaihna khau a-om hi.
Puanak tual mongte ah khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih in theibuhfai gahte abawl uhi.
Dangka-engtak in dak abawl ua, dakte puanaktual mong a theibuhfai gahte kikal ah, theibuhfai gahte kikal zel ah akhaisuak uhi. 26 Dak leh theibuhfai akhaisuak uhi.
Dak leh theibuhfai gahte nasepna ding a puanaktual mong kimvel ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
Aaron leh atapate a ding in puanmalngat puanak tung gatthoh abawl uhi.
Puanmalngat hoih in lukhu leh puanmalngat hoih in lutuam leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in puan pheituam gek abawl uhi.
Kawnggak puanmalngat hoih koptah, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in khuithoh in abawl uhi.
Dangka-engtak in lallukhu siangthou abawl ua, atung ah laigelh, chiamtehna gelhnate bang in, SIANTHOUNA TOUPA A AHI chih agelh uhi.
Huai ah khauhual dum akhih ua, lukhu tunglam gaktou pek ding in; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
Hichibang in khawmpite' kihoupihna biakbuk nasep tengteng zoh ahita hi. TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a thupiak bang in Israel suante'n ahihta uhi.
Biakbuk leh puanin van tengteng, akibatnate, asingpekte, azawlte, akhuamte leh kingakna khuakkuakte Mosi kiang ah hon tawi uhi.
Akhuhna belampa vun diahsan leh akhuhna ngalvang vun leh akhuhna puanzak;
theihpihna bawm leh azawlte leh zahngaihna tutphah;
dohkan leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leh Pathian Ompihna tanghou sawm-le-nihte;
khawnvak koihna, khawnvakte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leh khawnvak a dia sathau;
dangka-eng maitam leh nilh theih sathau leh gimlim leh puanin kong a ding a puankhai;
dal maitam, adal hakvang, azawlte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng tuikuang leh akhe;
huangsung puankhaite, akhuamte leh akingakna khuakkuakte leh huangsung kongpi puankhai, akhaute, akilhna zumte leh biakbuk nasepna tui-um belsuan tengteng, kihoupihna biakbuk a ding:
Mun siangthou a nasepna ding nasepna puan, hoihtak a bawlte, siampu Aaron a ding puan siangthoute leh atapate puante, siampu nasepna mun a nasepna ding,
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, huchibang in Israel suante'n nna tengteng asem uhi.
Mosi in nasep tengteng a-en a, ngai in TOUPA thupiak bangtak in asemkheta uhi. Huchi in Mosi in huaite avualzawl hi.
Huan Mosi in adawng a, "Ahi na a, ngai in, ahon gingta kei ding ua, ka aw leng ana ngaikhe sam kei ding uh, 'Na kiang ah TOUPA akilak keí, achih ding ziak un,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, “Na khut a bang ahia?" achi a; ama'n, “Chiangkhun," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Leitual ah khia in," achi a; leitual ah akhia a, gul ahong suak a; huai a pan Mosi ataikheta hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Na khut zankhia inla, amei ah man in,” achi hi. Akhut azankhia a, amei ah amanta a, akhut ah chiangkhun ahong suak nawn hi;
"huchi a apipute uh TOUPA Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian, na kiang ah akilak chih agintakna ding un,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Tu in na ang ah na khut koih in," achi nawn hi. A-ang a akhut koih a, azankhiaktak in, ngai in, vuk bang in akhut aphakta hi.
"Ama'n na ang ah na khut koih nawn in," achi hi. A-ang ah akhut a akoih nawn a, huan alakkhiakleh, ngai in, akhut khat lam bang ahong suak nawn hi.
"Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahon gintak louh ua, chiamtehna khatna leng angaihkhiak kei uleh, chiamtehna nanung agintak ding uh ahi ding hi.

Hichi ahong hi ding a, hiai chiamtehna nihte agintak louh lai ua, na aw leng angaihkhiak kei uleh, lui a pan tui na la dia, gamkeu ah na sung ding. Lui a pan na tui lakkhiak gamkeu ah sisan ahong suak ding hi,” achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Aw Toupa, midangnal ka hi kei a, chik lai mah in, na sikha kiang a thu na gen nungsang in leng midang-awk leh pau zekai ka hi zaw hi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Mihing kam bawl kua ahia? Ahihkeileh pau theiloute, nangongte, muhnate leh mittawte kua bawl ahia? Kei TOUPA'N ka bawl ahi kei maw?
Huaiziak in tu in kuan inla, na kam ka ompih dia, na gen ding ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Aw TOUPA, hehpih in midang sawl in, na sawl dingpa khut in, ka hon ngen hi," achi hi.

Mosi tung ah TOUPA hehna asouta a, "Aaron, na unaupa a-om kei maw? Ama'n hoihtak in thu agen thei, chih ka thei. Huan ngai in, nang kimuhpih ding in ahong paikhia a, ahon muh chiang in alungtang akipak ding hi.
Akiang ah thu na gen dia, akam ah thute na guang ding. Na kam ka ompih dia, na hih ding ka hon hilh ding hi.
Amah mite kiang ah na thugenpa ahi dia; amah nang a ding in na kam' tang ahi dia, huan nang amah a ding in Pathian' tang na hi ding hi.
Chiamtehnate na hihna ding in, na khut in hiai chiangkhun na tawi ding ahi," achi hi.

Mosi akisa a, asunghpa Jethro kiang ah akik a, akiang ah, "K'on ngen ahi, hon paisak inla, Aigupta gam a om ka unaute kiang ah ka kik dia, adam lai uhiam chih ka va kan ding," achi hi. Jethro in Mosi kiang ah, "Damtak in va hoh in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Midian gam a Mosi kiang ah, "Pai inla, Aigupta gam ah kik nawn in. Thah hon tum mi teng lah asita ngal ua,” achi hi.
Mosi in azi leh atapate api a, sabiltung tung ah atuangsak a, Aigupta gam ah akik nawnta hi. Mosi in akhut in Pathian' chiangkhun atawi hi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam a kik nawn dia na kuan chiang in, na khut a ka koih huai thillamdangte tengteng Pharaoh ma ah hih ngeingei in. Himahleh alungtang ka khauhsak dia, huchi in mite apaisak kei ding," achi hi.
Pharaoh kiang ah, "TOUPA'N Israel ka tapa ahi, ka ta masapen," achi hi.
"K'on chi ahi, nna ahon sepsak theihna ding in, ka tapa paisak in. Paisak na nialleh, ngai in, na tapa ka that ding, na ta masapen ngei, na chi ding hi."
Lampi a khualbuk ah hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N amah ana tuak a, thah ding in azongta hi.
Huchih lai in Zipporah in suang hiamtak khat ala a, atapa zekmuk vun a-atkhia a, akhebul ah akhia a, "Kei a ding in sikai pasal na hi taktak hi," achi hi.
Huchi in amah apaisak hi. Zekvun ziak in, "Sisan kai pasal na hi," achi hi.
