TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Mosi tuak ding in gamdai ah hoh in," achi hi. Ava hoh a, Pathian tang ah amah atuak a, atawp hi.
Mosi in amah sawl TOUPA thu tengteng leh amah apiak chiamtehna tengteng toh Aaron ahilh hi.
Mosi leh Aaron apaita ua; Israel suan upate tengteng akaikhawm vek uhi.
Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N thu agen tengteng leh mite mitmuh a chiamtehna ahih tengteng Aaron in agenta hi.
Huchi in mite'n agingta ua; TOUPA'N Israel suante ahong veh a, agimna uh amuta, chih azaktak un, alu uh kunsak in abeta uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a:
"Kha masapen ani masapen in kihoupihna biakbuk na dingsakta ding ahi.
Huai sung ah theihpihna bawm na koih dia, bawm puanzak in na khuh ding ahi.
Dohkan na lalut dia, atung ah thil kizom akoih dingte kizom in na koih ding a; khawnvak koihna na lalut dia, akhawnvakte na det ding ahi.
Theihpihna bawm ma ah gimlim a dia dangka-eng maitam na koih dia, kongkhak puankhai biakbuk ah na koih ding ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin biakbuk kongkhak ma ah halmang thillat maitam na koih ding ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah tuikuang na koih dia, huai ah tui na koih ding ahi.
Akimvel in huangsung na bawl dia, huangsung kongpi ah puankhai na khaitou ding ahi.
"Thaunilhna sathau na la dia, biakbuk na nilh ding a; huai sung a om tengteng toh, na hihsiangthou dia, atui-um belsuan tengteng asiangthou ding hi.
Haltum thillat maitam na nilh ding a; atui-um belsuan tengteng toh, maitam na siangthousak ding. Huchi in maitam asiangthou penpen ding hi.
Tuikuang leh akhe na nilh dia, na siangsak ding ahi.
"Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Aaron leh atapate na hon pi dia, tui in na sil ding ahi.
Puan siangthoute Aaron na silhsak dia, na nilh dia, na siangthousak ding ahi; siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
Atapate na hon tonpih dia, puanak tung na silhsak ding ahi.
Apa uh sathau na nilh bang in amau siampu nasepna mun a, ka nna aseptheihna ding un thau na nilh ding ahi. Athaunilhna uh akhang-akhang ua siampu hihna ahih taktak ding ziak in," achi hi.
Hiai bang in Mosi in ahihta a; TOUPA'N amah thu apiak bang zel in ahi, ahih.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum nihna, akha masapen, huai kha a ani masapen ni in, biakbuk dinsak in a-omta hi.
Mosi in biakbuk adingsakta a, akingakna khuakkuakte ahen a, asingpekte atung a, azawlte athunlut a, akhuamte adingsak hi.
Biakbuk tung ah puanin azalhta a; atunglam ah puanin khuhna akoih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahihta hi.
Theihpihna ala a bawm sung ah akoih a, bawm tung ah azawlte akoih a; bawm tunglam ah zahngaihna tutphah akoih hi.
Bawm biakbuk sung ah atawilut a, khuhna puanzak azak a, theihpihna bawm akhuh hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahihta.
Kihoupihna puanin sung ah biakbuk pang mallam, puanzak polam ah dohkan akoih hi.
TOUPA ma ah dohkan tung ah tanghoute kizom in akoih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in akoih hi.
Kihoupihna puanin sung ah dohkan zawn ah, biakbuk sik simlam pang ah khawnvak koihna akoih hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in TOUPA ma ah khawnvakte det ahi.
Huan puanzak ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah dangka-eng maitam akoih hi:
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, huai tung ah gimlim ahal hi.
Biakbuk kongkhak ah puankhai akhai hi.
Kihoupihna puanin biakbuk kongkhak kiang ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in halmang thillat leh tangbuang thillat alan hi.
Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah kisawpna ding in tuikuang akoih a, huai ah tui akoih hi.
Mosi leh Aaron leh atapate'n akhutte uh leh akhepekte uh huai ah asil uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin sung ah ahoh ua, maitam kiang ah ahong pai nai ua TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in akisil uhi.
Biakbuk leh maitam kimvel in huangsung abawl a, huangsung kongpi puankhaite akhaita hi. Huchi in Mosi in nasep azouta hi.
Huai khit in meipi in kihoupihna biakbuk atuam a, TOUPA thupina in biakbuk adimsak hi.
Huchi in kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah Mosi alut theita kei; atung a meipi akai ziak in leh TOUPA thupina in biakbuk adimsak ziak in.
Biakbuk tung a pan meipi laktouh a a-om chiang in, Israel suante akhualzinna uah malam ah apai zel uhi.
Himahleh meipi laktouh a a-om louh chiang in, akilaktouh louh ni in azin kei uhi.
Akhualzin sung teng uh Israel inkote mitmuh in sun in biakbuk tung ah meipi in TOUPA a-om a, zan in biakbuk tung ah meikuang in a-om hi.
Huan huai nung in Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron alut ua, "Hichibang in Israelte' TOUPA Pathian in achi. Gamdai a kei a dia ankuangluina abawltheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in," chi in ahilh uhi.
Pharaoh in, "Israelte paisak ding a a-aw ka man ding, huai TOUPA kua ahia? Hiai TOUPA ka thei kei, Israelte leng ka paisak kei ding," achi hi.

Huchi in amau, "Hebrute' Pathian in ahon kimuhpih a; gamdai ah ni thum lam ah, hon paisak in, ka hon ngen uhi. TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah hon kithoihsak in. Hipi hiam, namsau hiam in ahon gawt kha ding hi,” achi uhi.
Aigupta kumpipa'n akiang uah, - "Mosi leh Aaron, bangziak a noute'n mite nasep khawlsak na hi ua? Na puakgikte uh pua un," achi hi.
Pharaoh in, "Ngai un, gam a mite tu in atam ua, apuakgik ua pan na khawlsak uhi,” achi hi.
Pharaoh in huai ni mah in mite' nasem heutute leh upate thu apia hi.
"Tuma siah a bang in teklei bawlna ding in mite buhpawl na pe nawn kei iding uhi. Kuan uhenla, buhpawl va - kilak uhen.

Tuma siah ateklei bawlsa tengteng uh, atung uah na koih ding a; huai a pan in bangmah na kiamsak kei iding uhi. Atha uh adah kha dia; huchi in kap in, ka Pathian kiang uah hon paisak inla, hon va kithoihsak in, achi kha ding uh.
Nna tamsem atung uah guan unla, asepgim theihna ding un; thugina lou limsak kei uhen,” achi hi.
Mite nasem heutute apaikhia ua, a-upate uh toh, mite kiang ah thu agen ua, "Pharoah in buhpawl ahon pe kei ding.
"Nouskuan unla, na muh theihtheihna uah buhpawl kilak un. Himahleh na nasep uh bangmah kiamsak ahi kei ding," achi uhi.
Mite buhpawl sik a buhbul lakhawm ding in Aigupta gam teng ah avak zakta uhi.
Nasem heutute'n amau anoh ua, na nasep uh zou un, na niteng sep dingte uh, buhpawl a-om lai in, achi uhi.
Israel suan upate, Pharaoh nasem heutute atung ua akoihte un, avua ua, bangziak a tuma lam a bang a zan leh tuni a na teklei bawl uh zou lou na hi ua? chi in aphutluih uhi.
Huaitak in Israel suan upate ahong ua, Pharaoh kiang ah akap ua, "Bangziak a na sikhate hichi bawl tel na hia?
Na sikhate buhpawl piak ka hi kei ua, amau lah ka kiang uah, 'Teklei bawl un!' ahon chi uh. Ngai in, na sikhate vuak in ka om ua, amoh na mite ahi uh," achi uhi.
Himahleh ama'n, “Thadah na hi uh, thadah na hi uh. Huaiziak in nou, 'Pai ni in, TOUPA kiang ah va kithoih ni,' na chi uhi.
Huaiziak in kuan unla; nna va sem un. Pawl ahon kipe kei dia, himahleh teklei bikhiah zah na piakkhiak ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Na niteng nasep ua na tekleite ua pan bangmah na kiamsak ding uh ahi kei, akichih nung Israel suan upate'n thusia om ahihdan atheita uhi.
Pharaoh a pan ahong paikhiak un lampi a dingh Mosi leh Aaron akituahpih uhi.
Akiang uah, "TOUPA'N nou hon en in vai hawm hen. Pharaoh mit leh asikhate mit in ka gimnam uh kihhuai in na bawl ua, koute hon that dia akhut ua namsau na koih tak ziak un," achi uhi.
TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akik nawn a, "Toupa, bangziak a hiai mite hichibang a gilou suaksak na hia? Bangziak a kei hon sawl na hia?
Na min a thu gen dia Pharaoh kiang a ka va hoh nungsiah lah, ama'n hiai mite tung ah gilou abawl ngal a. Na mite lah na pikhe ngal kei a," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Tu in Pharaoh kiang a bang ahia ka hih ding na mu ding. Khut thahat in amau apaisak dia, khut thahat in amau agam a kipan hawlkhe ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Pathian in Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, akiang ah, "Kei TOUPA ka hi.
Bangkim hihthei Pathian min in Abraham kiang, Isak kiang leh Jakob kiang ah ka kilakta a, himahleh ka min JEHOVAH in alak uah ka kitheisak kei.
Amau Kanaan gam, mikhual a a-omna gam uh, akhualzinna gam uh, pe ding in amaute toh ka thukhun leng ka hihkipta hi.
Aiguptate'n koltanna a, atansak un, Israel suante maunate leng ka zata a, ka thukhun ka theigige hi.

Huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, kei TOUPA ka hi, chih gen inla, Aiguptate puakgik nuai a pan ka hon pikhe dia, na koltanna ua pan ka hon suaktasak ding, ban zak in leh vaihawmna thupite toh ka hon tan ding hi.
Mipite a ding in ka hong kilak ding a, noute a ding in Pathian ka hi ding. Huchi in Aiguptate puakgikte nuai a pan hon lakhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na thei ding uh.
Gam tungtang thu Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a pe dia ka chiamsa, huai gamsung ah ka hon tun ding. Huchi in gouluah ding in ka hon pe ding, Kei TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
Mosi in Israel suante kiang ah huchibang in thu agensawn hi. Himahleh lungsim dahna ziak leh koltanna haksatna ziak in Mosi angaikheta kei uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
"Lut in, agam a pan Israel suante apaikhiaksakna ding in Pharaoh kiang ah thu gen in,” achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA ma ah thu agen a, "Ngai in, Israel suante'n hon ngaihkhiak kei ualeh kei muk sum louh, bangchi in Pharaoh in hon ngaikhe dia?" achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang leh Aaron kiang ah thu agen a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante pikhe ding in Israel suante lam leh Aigupta kumpipa lam ah amaute thu apeta hi.
Hiaite asuangtute inkuan a kipan alupente ahi uhi: Israel ta masa Reuben tate; Hanok leh Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi, hiaite Reuben inkote ahi uh.
Simeon tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar leh Kanaan numei tapa Shaul. Hiaite Simeon inkote ahi uh.
Akhang uh dungzui in hiaite Levi tapate min ahi: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari. Levi damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi.
Gershon tapate, a-inkuan dungzui un, Libni leh Shimei.
Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel. Kohath damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-thum ahi.
Merari tapate: Mahli leh Mushi. Akhang uh dungzui in hiaite Levi inkote ahi uh.
Amram in apa sanggamnu Jokebed zi in anei hi. Ama'n Aaron leh Mosi aneihsak hi. Amram damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi.
Izhar tapate: Korah, Nepheg leh Zikri.
Uzziel tapate: Mishael, Elzaphan leh Zithri.
Aaron in Amminadab tanu, Nahson sanggamnu, Elisheba zi in anei a, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar aneihsak hi.
Korah tapate: Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaph. Hiaite Korah inkote ahi uh.
Aaron tapa Eleazar in Putiel tanute lak a khat zi in anei a, Phinehas aneihsak hi. Hiaite Levi inkuan suangtute inn a kipan a lupente ahi uhi.
Hiaite TOUPA'N Aaron leh Mosi kiang a anam uh dungzui a Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante hon pikhia un, achihte ahi.
Hiaite Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh kiang a Aigupta a pan Israel suante pikhe dia thugentute ahi ua, hiaite Mosi leh Aaron mah ahi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N thu agen ni in akiang ah,
"Kei TOUPA ka hi. Na kiang a ka gen tengteng Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh kiang ah gen in," achi hi.
Himahleh Mosi in TOUPA ma ah, “Ngai in, muk sum louh ka hi a, bangchi in Pharaoh in hon ngaikhe dia?" achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "En in, Pharaoh a ding in Pathian in ka hon bawlta. Huchi in na sanggampa Aaron na zawlnei ahi ding,” achi hi.
Thu ka hon piak tengteng na gen ding hi. Huchi in Aaron na sanggampa'n agam a pan a Israel suante sawlkhe ding in Pharaoh kiang ah agen ding.
"Huan Pharaoh lungtang ka khauhsak dia, Aigupta gam ah ka chiamtehnate leh ka thillamdangte ka pungsak ding hi.

Himahleh, Aigupta tung a ka khut ka ngaktheihna ding leh ka sepaihte leh ka mi Israel suante, vaihawmna thupite a Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak theihna ding in, Pharaoh in nang ahon ngaikhe kei ding hi.
Aigupta tung a ka khut ka lik a, alak ua pan Israel suante ka pikhiak hun chiang in, Aiguptate'n kei, TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
Mosi leh Aaron in ToUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi.
Pharaoh kiang a thu agen lai un, Mosi kum sawmgiat a upa ahita a, Aaron kum sawmgiat-le-thum a upa ahita hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah thu agen a, akiang uah,
"Pharoah in na kiang ua, 'Nou a ding in thillamdang suah un,' achih chiang in Aaron kiang ah, 'Na chiangkhun la inla, Pharaoh ma ah khia in, gul hong suak hen,' na chi ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron alut ua, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi. Pharaoh leh asikhate ma ah Aaron in achiangkhun akhia a, gul ahong suak hi.
Pharaoh in leng mipilte leh bumsiamte asam a; Aigupta mitkhialdawi tawite'n amitkhialdawi un huchibang mah in ahih sam uhi.
Michih in leng amau chiangkhun chiat akhia ua, gul ahong suak uhi. Himahleh Aaron chiangkhun in amau chiangkhunte avalhta hi.
Hinapi in TOUPA'N achih bang in Pharaoh in alungtang akhauhsak a, amau thu angaikhe nuam kei.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Pharoah lungtang akhauhta a, mite paisak anial hi.
Zingsang in Pharaoh kiang ah va hoh in, ngai in, amah lui a hoh ding ahi a, ahong pai ngak in lui gei ah na dingh in. Na khut in huai chiangkhun, gul hong suak pen na tawi ding ahi.
Akiang ah, 'Hebrute' TOUPA Pathian in na kiang ah ahon sawl a, gamdai a ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.' Ngai in, tuma lam in na ngeingaih kei, achi," chi in.
Hichibang in TOUPA'N achi, "Hiai ah TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding. Ngai in, ka khut a chiangkhun in lui a om tuite ka sat dia, sisan ahong suak ding uhi.
Lui a om ngasate asi ding ua, lui a-uih dia; Aiguptate'n luitui adawn thei kei ding uh," achi hi.

Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, "Na chiangkhun la inla, Aigupta tuite tung ah, atui nak neite tung ah, aluite uh tung ah, atuichinte uh tung ah leh atuilite uh tung ah, sisan ahon suahtheihna ding un, Aigupta gam pumpi a singhawmte leh suanghawmte a sisan a-omtheihna ding in na khut likkhia in, Aaron kiang ah chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA thupiak bang in, Mosi leh Aaron in ahih uhi. Achiangkhun aliktou a, Pharaoh leh asikhate mitmuh in, lui a om tuite asatta a, lui a om tuite sisan ahong suak vek uhi.
Lui a om ngasate asi ua; lui a-uih a, Aiguptate'n luitui adawn theita kei uhi. Aigupta gam pumpi ah sisan a-omta hi.
Aigupta mitkhialdawi tawite'n leng amitkhialdawi tawi un huchi mah bang in ahih uhi. Pharaoh lungtang akhauh a, TOUPA'N achih bang in amau angaikhe kei hi.
Pharaoh akihei a, a-inn ah apaita a, huai thil in alungtang akhoih kei hi.
Aigupta tengteng in luitui adawn theih louh ziak un, dawn ding zong in lui kim teng akhuat uhi.
TOUPA'N lui asat nung ni sagih ahong chingta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, "Pharoah kiang ah hoh inla, akiang ah hichi in chi in ‘Toupa’n hichi in achi, ka nna ahon sepsak theihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.'
Amau paisak na nialleh, ngai in, ukengte in na gam tengteng ka gawt ding hi.

Lui in ukeng atam a tam hon suahkhe ding ua, huaite ahong paitou ding ua, na inn ah ahong lut ding ua, na lupna dantan sung ah, na lupna tung ah, na sikhate inn ah, na mite tung ah, na thuk ah leh na tangbuang bawlna ah ahong om ding uh.
Ukengte nang tung ah leh na mite tung ah leh na sikhate tung ah ahong kaltou ding uhi," chi in.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron kiang ah, luinak neite tung leh luite tung leh tuichinte tung ah na chiangkhun toh na khut lik inla, Aigupta gam tung ah ukengte hon paitousak in, chi in," achi hi.
Aaron in Aigupta luite tung ah akhut alik a; ukengte ahong paitou ua, Aigupta gamsung atuamta uhi.
Huchi mah bang in mitkhialdawi tawite'n amitkhialdawi un ahih ua, Aigupta gam tung ah ukengte ahon latou uhi.
Huaitak in Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Kei leh ka mite a pan ukengte alakmang theihna ding in, TOUPA ngen un. TOUPA kiang a kithoihna abawltheihna ding un, mite ka paisak ding," achi hi.

Mosi in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka tung ah ki-uangsak in; nang a ding leh na sikhate a ding leh na mite a ding leh nang leh na innte a pan, tui a a-omtheihna ding ua ukengte lakmangna dia chikchiang a hon ngetsak ding ka hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Zingchiang in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na thu bang hi hen. TOUPA ka Pathian bang kuamah a-om kei, chih na theihna ding in.
Nang leh na innte uh leh na sikhate leh na mite a pan ukengte apawtkhe ding ua; lui kia ah a-omta ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Pharaoh a pan Mosi leh Aaron apaikhia ua; Pharaoh gawtna ding a ukengte akoih tungtang ah TOUPA kiang ah Mosi athum hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi thu bang in ahihta a; innte leh khuate a pan leh loute a pan ukengte asita uhi.
Huchi in akaikhawm ua, avum ua, gam a-uihta hi.
Himahleh Pharaoh in atung azangta chih atheih in, alungtang akhauhsak a; amaute angaikhe kei; TOUPA gen bang in.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron kiang ah, na chiangkhun lik inla, gam a leivui sat in, Aigupta gam pumpi a hik ahong omtheihna ding un, chi in,” achi hi.
Huchibang in ahih ua; Aaron in achiangkhun toh akhut alik a, lei a leivui asat a, mi tung leh sa tung ah hik ahong omta a; gam a leivui teng Aigupta gam pumpi ah hik ahong suak vekta hi.
Mitkhialdawi tawite'n leng amitkhialdawi un hikte omsak ding in huchibang in ahih ua, himahleh ahihthei kei uh. Huchi in mi tung leh sa tung ah hik a-omta hi.
Huaitak in mitkhialdawi tawite'n Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hiai Pathian khutzung ahi," achi uhi. Himahleh Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, TOUPA'N achih bang in amau angaikhe kei hi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Zingkhang in thou inla, Pharaoh ma ah va dingh in. Ngai in, tuilam zuan a, ahong paikhiak in akiang ah, 'Hichibang in TOUPA'n achi, ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.

Huchi lou a, ka mite na paisak keileh, ngai in, na tung ah leh na sikhate tung ah leh na mite tung ah leh na insung ah thouhonpi ka sawl ding. Huchi in Aiguptate innte thouhonpi in adim ding, a-omna lei uh toh.
Huai ni in ka mite tenna, Goshen gam ka satkhen ding, huai a thouhonpi a-omlouhna ding in; huchi a gamsung ah kei TOUPA ka hi chih na theihna ding in.
Ka mite leh na mite kikal ah kikhenna ka koih ding. Zingchiang in hiai chiamtehna a-om ding hi,' " achi hi.
Huchibang in TOUPA'N ahih a; Pharaoh insung leh asikhate insung leh Aigupta gam tengteng ah, thouhonpi thupitak ahong omta a; thouhonpi ziak in gam asegawp hi.
Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Pai unla, gamsung ah na Pathian kiang uah kithoihun." achi hi.

Himahleh Mosi in, "Huchibang a hih adik kei ding. TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang ah Aiguptate zakdah kithoihna lan ding ka hih ziak un. Ngai in, amuh ua Aiguptate zakdah kithoihna lan ding ka hi uh maw, suang in ahon deng kei ding ua hia?
Gamdai ah ni thum lam ah ka pai ding uh; ahon thupiak ding bang a TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a kithoihna bawl ding in," achi hi.
Huan Pharaoh in, "Gamdai a TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a na kithoihtheihna ding un ka hon paisak ding. Gamlapi ah pai kei peuh le uchin. Kei a ding in hon ngetsak in," achi hi.

Huan Mosi in, “Ngai in, nang a pan ka paikhe dia, Pharaoh a pan, na sikhate a pan, na mite a pan zingchiang a thouhonpi apaimang theihna ding in TOUPA ka ngen ding. Himahleh TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia amite paisak ding in lepchiahtak in Pharaoh gamta nawn kei hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Pharaoh a pan Mosi apawtkhia a, TOUPA angenta hi.
Huan Mosi thu bang in TOUPA'N ahihta a; Pharaoh a pan leh asikhate a pan thouhonpi alamangta a; khat lel leng a-om nawnta kei hi.
Himahleh hiai hun in leng Pharaoh in alungtang akhauhsak a, mite apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Pharoah kiang ah va lut inla, TOUPA Hebrute' Pathian in ka nna aseptheihna ding un ka mite paisak in.
Amaute paisak na nial a, amau na letdet laileh,
ngai in, TOUPA khut, lou a om na bawnghonte tung ah, sakolte tung ah, sabiltungte tung ah, sangawngsaute tung ah, bawngtalte tung ah leh belamte tung ah atu ding. Hipi nase mahmah a-om ding hi.
TOUPA'N Israelte bawnghon leh Aiguptate bawnghon asatkhen ding. Israel suante a lam bangmah si a-om kei ding.
TOUPA'N hun biseh asepta, zingchiang in TOUPA'N gamsung ah hiai ahih ding,” chi in va gen in.
Huan azing in TOUPA'N hiai thil ahih a, Aigupta bawnghon tengteng asita uhi. Himahleh Israel suante bawnghonte khat lel leng asi kei hi.
Pharaoh in mi asawl a, ngai in, Israel bawnghonte lak ah khat lel leng asi kei ngut hi. Himahleh Pharaoh lungtang akhauh a, mite apaisak kei lai hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "Meiphualpi vut na khut dim un la unla, Pharaoh muh in Mosi in van lam ah theh hen.
Aigupta gam ah leivui nen ahong suak dia, Aigupta gamsung teng ah, mi tung leh sa tung ah meimatum nasetak ahong hi ding," achi hi.
Meiphualpi a vut ala ua, Pharaoh mai ah adinghta uhi. Mosi in van lam ah athehtou a; mi tung leh sa tung ah, meimatum ahong suakta hi.
Huchi in meimatumte ziak in Mosi ma ah mitkhialdawi tawite adingh theita kei ua; mitkhialdawi tawite tung leh Aiguptate tung ah lah meimatum a-om ngal a.
Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N agen bang in amau thu angaikhe kei hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Zingkhang in thou inla, Pharaoh ma ah va dingh inla, akiang ah, TOUPA Hebrute' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Ka nna aseptheihna ding un ka mite paisak in.
Hiai hun in na lungtang tung leh na sikhate tung leh na mite tung a ka gawtna tengteng hon tun ding ka hi ngal a. Lei pumpi ah kei bang kuamah a-om kei, chih na theihna ding in.
Tu in ka khut zankhia in nang leh na mite hipi in hon gawt leng lei a pan satkhiak in na om ding hi.
Himahleh hiai ziak in ahi, nang ka hon tunding, nangmah a ka thilhihtheihna ka latsak theihna ding leh huchi a leitung tengteng a ka min akipuankhiak theihna ding in.
Amaute paisaklou ding in, ka mite kalh in nang leh nang na kiliansak nalai maw?
Ngai in, zingchiang tu hun in apian tung a kipan tutan a om ngei nai lou, Aigupta gam ah gialpi tam petmah ka zusak ding hi.

Huaiziak in tu in mi sawl inla, lou a na neih tengteng leh na gantate kaikhawm in. Michih tung leh lou a kimu sa tung ah, inn lam a hong kihawlloute tung ah, gial ahong kesuk ding a, asi ding uh,' achi," chi in.
Kuapeuh Pharaoh sikhate lak a TOUPA thu laute'n asikhate leh agantate uh insung ah ahawllut uhi.
TOUPA thu khawksaloute'n lou ah asikhate uh leh agantate uh anusia uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tengteng a, mi leh sa tung leh Aigupta gam tengteng alou a haichi tung teng a gial a-omtheihna ding in, van lam ah na khut zankhia in,” achi hi.
Mosi in van lam ah achiangkhun azankhia hi. TOUPA'N van-ging leh gial ahon sawl a, leitung zui in meikuang ataita a; TOUPA'N Aigupta gam tung ah gial azusakta hi.
Huchi in gial a-om a, gial toh kihel meikuang huaise mahmah, nam ahih nungsiah Aigupta gam ah huchibang om ngei kei hi.
Gial in Aigupta gamsungte a lou omte teng adengta hi. Gial in mi leh sa; lou a haichi chih adeng a, gam a sing chih akitansakta hi.
Israel suante tenna, Goshen gam kia ah gial ake kei hi.
Pharaoh in mi asawl a, Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, akiang uah, "Tutung in ka khialta. TOUPA adiktat a, kei leh ka mite ka gilou uh.
TOUPA ngen in, ahunta, vanpiging leh gial thupi a-om nawnlouhna ding in. K'on paisakta dia, na om nawn kei ding uh," achi hi.

Huan Mosi in akiang ah, "Khopi a pan ka pawtkhiak chiang in TOUPA lam ah ka khutte ka zak ding a; vanpiging adai dia, gial leng a-om nawn kei ding; huchi a leitung TOUPA a ahihdan na theihtheihna ding in.
Himahleh nang leh na sikhate'n ahihleh, TOUPA Pathian na lau nai kei ding uh chih ka thei," achi hi.
Pat leh barli buh densiat in a-om a, barli buh atuipumta a, pat gah akuhmumta hi.
Himahleh huit buh leh buhman zaw densiat in a-om kei; anou lai ziak un.
Pharaoh a pan Mosi in khopi apawtkhiaksan in, TOUPA lam ah akhutte azak a; vanpiging leh gial adai a, leitung ah vuah buak in a-omta kei hi.
Pharaoh in vuah leh gial leh vanpiging atawpta chih atheih in, akhial tamsem a, amah leh asikhate'n alungtang uh akhauhsak uhi.
Huchi in Pharaoh lungtang khauhsak in a-om a, Mosi kam a TOUPA'N agen bang in Israel suante apaisak nuam kei hi.
Saltan akum sawmthumna, akha lina, huai kha ani ngana ah Kebar lui a saltangte lak a ka om lai in hichi ahong hi a, van hong kihong a, Pathian kilakna ka mu hi.
Huai kha ani ngana ah, huai tuh kumpipa Jehoiakin saltan akum ngana ahi,
Kaldai gam a Kebar lui a Buzi tapa siampu Ezekiel kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: huai ah TOUPA khut atung ah a-om hi.
Huan ka en a, ngai in, mallam a kipan huihpi thupi mahmah ahong kuan a, meipi asah a sah, kuang zoizoi, akim tengteng tanvak puappuap asung mei laitak ah sik am bang a am a-om hi.
Huchi in huai lai a kipan in thil hing li kibatpih ahong pawtkhia ua, akimuhdan uh hichibang ahi a: Mihing batna anei ua,
mai li anei chiat ua, kha li anei chiat uhi.
Akhete uh atang a; akhepek nuailam uh bawngnou khepek bang ahi a; huan dalte mahmah bang in avakkhe zualzual uhi.
Apang lite ua akha nuai uah mihing khut bang anei ua; huchi in ali un amel uleh akhate uh hichibang in apu uhi:
Akhate uh akizom a; apai un leng akihei ngei kei ua, amazawn uah apai chiat uhi.
Amel un akibatpihte mihing mel bang ahi a, ali un ataklam pang uah humpinelkai mel apu ua, ali un aveilam pang uah bawngtal mel apu ua, ali un muvanlai mel apu nawn ua, amel uh huchibang ahi.
Huan akhate uh azakkhia ua, akha nihte un akizak zom chiat ua, nih in apumpi uh akhuh uh.
Malam ah apai chiat ua, kha paina lam ding ah apai ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uhi.
Thil hingte lak ah suangkuangthei ampha bang, meisel bang mai asuk leh tou in apai a; meibel a-ampha mahmah a, mei a kipan khophia ahong suakkhe zualzual hi.
Thil hingte khophe zualzual bang in avialtai uhi.
Huan thil hingte ka et lai in, ngai in, thil hingte zul ah amel lite uh a ding in lei ah kangtalai liim khat zel ka mu hi.
Kangtalai khe leh atatdan beril suang zia bang mai in alang a, ali un latdan khat anei ua, alatdan uh leh atatdan uh kangtalai liim khat sung a kangtalai liim dang om bang ahi hi.
Apai chiang un sik li in apai thei ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uh.
Akangtalai liim kual sangtak leh mulkimhuaitak ahi a; ali un akual teng mit in adim uhi.
Huchi in thil hingte apai chiang un azul uah kangtalai peite apai sam uhi; thil hingte lei a kipan dopkang a a-om uleh kangtalai liimte leng dopkang in a-om sam uhi.
Kha apai utna lam peuhmah ah apai ua; huai lam a kha apai zel ziak in; huchi in kangtalai liimte azul uah dopkang in a-om ua, thil hing kha kangtalai liimte ah a-om hi.

Huaite apai chiang un hiaite apai uhi; huaite adin chiang un hiaite adingh ua; huaite lei a kipan a dopkang a a-om chiang un kangtalai liimte amau zul ah dopkang in a-om ua, kangtalai liimte ah thil hingte kha a-om hi.
Thil hingte lutung ah van kibatpih a-om a, kristal vak bang a te mulkimhuaitak alutung uah akiphalh zeizoi hi.
Van dum nuai ah akha uh akop khat thil hing dangte sun in azak ua, akha uh kop khat in apumpi uh akhuh uhi.
Huan alen chiang un akha ging uh tui tampi mahmah ging bang, bangkim hihtheipa aw bang mai, mipi ging vengvung husa, sepaihhon husa bang mai in ka za a; adin uleh akha uh akaisak uhi.
Alutung ua vansin tung ah aw ahong om a, adin uleh akha uh akaisak uhi.
Huan alutung ua vansin tung ah laltutphah bang, sapphir suang bang mai a kimu a-om a; huai laltutphah batpih tung ah mihing bang a kilang a-om hi.
Akawng chiang tunglam sik hal-ap bang mai in ka mu a, akawng hileh kilawm chiang nuailam mei bang mai hi in ka mu a, avak kimvel lelaw hi.
Vuahzuk ni a meipi tung a sakhituihup latdan bang in akim vak alang hi. Hiai TOUPA thupina latdan bang ahi. Huan ka muh in akhup in ka puk a, thugenpa aw ka za hi.
Huchi in ka en a, ngai in, cherubte lutung a vansin om ah sapphir suang hileh kilawmtak, laltutphah bangtak a kimu ahong lang hi.
Ama'n puanmalngat silhpa kiang ah, "Cherub nuai a kangtalai peite kikal ah va lut inla, cherubte kikal a meivu na khut langnih dim in va luak inla, khopi tung ah thehzak in," achi hi.
Ka mitmuh lai mahmah in akuanta hi. Huan mi ahoh lai in tempul taklam pang ah cherubte adingh ua; huang sungnungpen meipi in adimta hi.
TOUPA thupina cherubte a kipan apaitou a, inn kongpi tung ah ava dinghta a, huai inn meipi in adim a, TOUPA thupina vak in huangsung adimta hi.
Cherubte khazap gingte huangsung ponungzaw leng Pathian Bangkim hihthei in ahon houpih lai a a-om bang mai in akiza hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanmalngat silhpa kiang ah, "Cherubte kikal a kangtalai pei kikal a kipan mei va la in," chi a thu apiakleh, amah ava lut a, kangtalai liimte bul ah ava dinghta hi.
Huan cherubim, cherubte kikal a kipan in, cherubte kikal a mei om sawk in, ala a, puanmalngat silhpa khut ah apia a, ama'n ana la a, apawtkheta hi.
Huchi in cherubte bel akha nuai uah mihing khut bangtak ahong lang a.

Huan ka en a, ngai in, cherubte sik ah kangtalai liim li, cherub khat kiang ah, kangtalai liim khat, cherub dang kiang ah kangtalai liim dang ka mu a; kangtalai liim latdan bel beril suang zia bang ahi.
Alatdan un ali un kibatna khat anei ua, kangtalai liim khat sung a kangtalai liim dang om bang mai ahi hi.
Apai chiang un sik li in apai thei ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uh; himahleh amasa ngatna lam azui zel ua, apai un akihei tuan kei uh.
Huan apumpi uh apum in anungte uh, akhutte uh, akhate uleh kangtalai liimte leng akim in mit in adim a, ali ua kangtalai liimte leng.
Akangtalai liimte bil a ka zak mahmah in, "Kangtalai liimte kipei," chih ahi.
Michih in mel li chiat anei ua, mel khat cherub mel ahi a, anihna mihing mel ahi a, athumna humpinelkai mel, alina muvanlai mel ahi.
Huchi in cherubte apaitou ua; hiai bel Kebar lui gei a thil hing ka muh ahi.
Huan cherubte apai uleh kangtalai liimte leng agei uah apai tei a, cherubte'n lei a kipan paitou ding a akhate uh azak uleh kangtalai liimte'n alehngatsan ngei kei uh.
Adin uleh hiaite adingh tei ua, apaitouh uleh hiaite leng apai tei zel ua, thil hingte kha amau ah a-om hi.
TOUPA thupina inpi kongpi tung a kipan apawtkhia a, cherubte tung ah adinghta hi.

Huan cherubte'n akha uh azak ua, apawt un ka mitmuh mahmah in lei a kipan apaitou ua; kangtalai liimte akiang uah a-om zel a; huan TOUPA Inn lutna suahlam kongkhak chin ah adinghta a; Israel' Pathian thupina atung uah a-om hi.
Hiai bel Kebar lui a Israel' Pathian nuai a ka thil hing muh mah ahi; cherubte ahi uh chih ka thei hi.
Avek un maitang li leh kha li anei chiat ua, akha nuai uah mihing khut bang mai a-om hi.
Huan amel lam uh ahihleh Kebar lui a ka muh melte mah bang, alatdan uleh amau mahmah leng ahi uh; huan amazawn zel uah apai chiat uhi.

Huan kha in ahon domkang a, TOUPA' inn suahlam lutna, suahlam muhna ahon tun a; ngai in, lutna kongkhak chin ah mi sawmnih-le-nga ana om ua; alak uah Azzur tapa Jaazaniah leh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah, mipi heutute ka mu hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiaite gitlouhna sawmkhete ahi ua, hiai khopi a gitlouh sawmkhe mite ahi uh.
Inn lam hun ahi nai kei; hiai khopi sa uina bel ahi a, eite asa i hi uh," chite.
"Huaiziak in thu gen inla, aw mihing tapa, atung uah thu gen in," achi hi.
Huan ka tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, ama'n ka kiang ah, "Gen in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hichibang in na hihsek ua, aw Israel inkote aw, na lungsim ua thil hong tungte ka theisiang vek hi.
Hiai khopi ah na mithahte uh na pungsak huthut ua, akongzingte na mithah un na dimsakta uhi."
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na mithah uh alai a na koihte uh asa ahi ua; hiai khopi ahihleh sa uina bel ahi, himahleh alai a kipan suankhiak in na om ding uhi.
Namsau na kihta ua, na tung uah namsau ka hon tun ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi.
"Alai a kipan ka hon pawtkhesak ding a, namdangte khut ah ka hon mansak ding a, na tungthu uh angaihtuah ding uh.
Namsau in na si ding ua, Israel gamgi lam ah na tungthu uh ka ngaihtuah ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
Hiai khopi na sa uina bel uh ahi kei ding a, nou asung a sa na hi sam kei ding ua, Israel gamgi lam ah na tungthu uh ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
Huan TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh, ka dan bawl na zui kei ua, ka thupawt leng na zui sam kei ua; na kim ua namte hihdan na zui zawta uh, achi," chi in.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, thu ka genleh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah ana sita mai a, huchi in ka khuppuk a, aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Ah, Toupa PATHIAN, Israel khosuaksunte chimihna na bawl ding a hia?" ka chi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
"Mihing tapa, na unaute, na chi-le-kuangte ngei leh Israel inkote tengteng, avek un, Jerusalem luah mite'n TOUPA a kipan paimang un, hiai gam kou a dia piak ahita hi," achihnate uh ahi uhi.

Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamlapi ah namte lak ah ka suanmang a, gam tampi ah ka hihdalh na a, sawt lou kal in ava tunna gam uah amaute a ding in Mun Siangthou ka hi ding," achi hi.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Namdangte a kipan in ka hon pikhawm nawn ding a, na dalhna gam ua kipan ka hon kaikhawm nawn ding a, Israel gam ka hon pe ding hi.
Huchi in huai ah ahong pai ding ua, thil huathuai tengteng leh thilkihhuaite a kipan alamang ding uhi.
Lungtang khat ka pe ding a, na sung uah lungsim thak ka koih ding. Huan asa ua kipan lungtangsak ka lamang ding a, akiang uah lungtang nem ka pe ding hi.
Ka dan thusehte azuih ua, ka thupiakte avom ua, ahihtheihna ding un, huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei leng a Pathian uh ka hi ding.
Ahuathuaina uleh akihhuaina laigil lungtang zuite bel akhelhna uh avek in amau ka khusak ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi.
Huchi in cherubte'n akhate uh azak ua, akiang uah kangtalai liimte a-om a, atung uah Israel' Pathian thupina a-om hi.
Khopi lai a kipan in TOUPA thupina apaitou a, khopi suahlam pang a tang sang ah ava dinghta hi.
Huan kha in ahon domkang a, kilakna ah Pathian kha in Kaldai gam a saltangte kiang ah ahon tun hi. Huchi in ka kilakna muh in ahon paitouhsanta hi.
Huchi in saltangte kiang ah TOUPA'N thil ahon etsak tengteng ka genta hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
"Mihing tapa, helhat inkuan, muhna ding mit nei a mu lou, zakna ding bil nei a zaloute lak a om na hi; helhat inkuan ahih himhim ziak un.

"Huaiziak in nang mihing tapa, saltanna a pai ding bang in na vante lomgak dimdiam inla, sun khovak ah amitmuh mahmah un paikhia in; amuh mahmah na mun ua kipan mun dang ah na paikhe ding ahi; helhat inkuan ahi ua, akingaihtuah loh kha mai ding uh.
Huan na van sun khovak in amitmuh mahmah uah, saltang pai ding van lakkhiak in na lakhe ding a, nang mahmah leng amitmuh uah gamdang a khakmang ding pai in na pai ding ahi.
Amitmuh mahmah uah kulhbaang vangsak inla, huai ah lakhia in.
Amitmuh mahmah uah na po ding a, mial ah na paikhe ding a, lei na muhlouhna ding in na mai na khuh ding ahi; Israel inkote a ding in etsak kholhna ding in nang ka hon bawl ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka hihta a, ka van saltang ding van bang in sun khovak in ka lakhia a, ka khut in baang ka sunvang a, khomial lai in ka lakhia a, amitmuh mahmah uah ka pua hi.
Huan zingsang in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Mihing tapa, Israel inkuan, helhat inkuante'n na kiang ah, "Bang hih na hia?" ahon chi uh ahi kei maw?
Akiang uah, "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Hiai thuphuan Jerusalem heutute leh Israel inkote pumpi, a-omna uh mite tungthu ding ahi.
Nou a ding in etsak kholhna ka hi a, ka chih bang geih a atung ua hih ahi ding; khakmang in, saltang ding in apaimang ding uh," chi in.
"Huan alak ua heutu omsun in mial nuai ah aliang in apo ding a, apaikhe ding; alakkhiakna ding un baang avangsak ua, amit in gam amuh nawn louh ziak in amai akhuh ding ahi.
Amah ka len in ka khuh ding a, ka thang a awk ahi ding; Kaldai gam a Babulon ah ka hon pi ding a, muh zaw amu kei ding; huai ah asi ding hi.
Amah panpih dia akiang a omte leh asepaihte tengteng gam chih ah ka hihzak ding a, namsau dokkhia in ka delh ding hi.
"Huan namte lak a ka delhzak a, gam chih a ka hihdalh hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
Himahleh namsau, kial, hipi a kipan mi tawmchik ka hawi ding; huaite'n ahong paina gam ua namte kiang ah akihhuaina tengteng aphuanna ding un; kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
"Mihing tapa, na an ling vonvon kawm in ne inla, na tui lungzing a ling kawm in dawn in.

Huan gam a mite kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in Jerusalem a tengte tungtang ah leh Israel gam tungtang ah hichi in achi: Lau kawm in a-ante uh ane ding ua, lungzingtak in atui uh adawn ding ua, agamsung a tengte hiamgamna ziak in asung a thil om tengteng a kipan hihgawp in a-om ding hi.
Huchi in mite tenna khopite loihsan in a-om ding a, agam hihsiat in a-om ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
"Mihing tapa, Israel gam a hiai paunak na neih uh bang chihna ahia? Anite asawt chiang in kilakna peuhmah avuaksuak nawn zel," na chih uh.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hiai paunak ka hihbei ding a, Israel gam ah azang nawn ngei kei ding uh; kilakna tundik ni ding anaita, chi in akiang uah gen zaw in.
"Israel inkuante lak ah kilakna hong vuaksuak leh aisan hoih lam a maitang phatna a-omta kei ding.

TOUPA ka hi a, ka gen ding a, ka gen tangtun ahi ding a, sit ahi kei ding; Aw helhat inkuante aw, na dam lai mahmah un thu ka gen ding hi, ka tangtungsak pah ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
"Mihing tapa, ngai in, 'Israel inkote a min kilakna amuhte bel ni tampi a ding ahi a, agenkholhte leng gamlapi a ding ahi,' " achi uhi.
Huaiziak in akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ka thu bangmah sit ahi kei ding a, ka thugen peuhmah hihtangtun in a-om zaw ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in hilh in,” achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
"Mihing tapa, Israel zawlnei, amah lungtang kia a kipan a gen chingte tung ah thu gen inla, 'TOUPA thu ngai un.' "
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Zawlnei hai, amau ngaihdan zui a, bangmah muloute tung agik hi!
Aw Israel, na zawlneite khopi sesa a sehal om bang lel ahita uh.
TOUPA ni a kidouna a dingzou ding a kulhbaang dingkipsak ding leh Israel inkote hum ding a kulhbaang lam ding in na paitou kei uhi."
"TOUPA thupawt ahi," chi mite'n bangmah lou lel leh genkholhna lim lel atang ua, TOUPA sawl ahi kei uh; athu uh hi ngei ding bang in mite agingtasak ua.
Kilakna hong vuaksuak lel na mu un, thugenkholh diklou na gen uh ahi kei maw? "TOUPA thupawt ahi," na chi nawn ngal ua, ke'n ka gen a hia?
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Bangmah lou phet na gen ua zuau lel na muh ziak un, ngai un, ka hon nang ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.

Huan ka khut in bangmah lou mute leh zuau genkhol mite anang ding a, ka mite kidotkhawmna ah atel kei ding ua, Israel inkuante min gelhna ah gelh in a-om sam kei ding uh; huchi in Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
Galmuanna omloupi ma, "Muanna," chi a mite apimang ziak un leh mi baang bawl a, sunu nuh mite'n,
"Ake nawn mai ding, vuahpi ahong zu ding a, nou gial lianpite aw, na hong ke ding ua, huih thupi in ahihse ding," chi in.
Ngai un, baang achip khit chiang in, "Na sunu nuh uh koi ah, ahon chi kei ding ua hia?"
"Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ka heh in huihpi thupi in ka hihse vek ding, ka heh in vuahpi ahong zu ding a, ka heh in gial thupitak hihmang ding in ahong ke ding.

Huchi in sunu na nuhngou bang uh ka chimsak ding a, lei pha in achim dia, huchi in asuangphumte adawk hial ding hi; huan achim ding a, baang kichim ah hihmang in na om ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
"Hichibang in baang tung ah leh sunu nuh mite tung ah ka hehna ka damsak ding; huan, baang a-om nawn kei a, abaang zutte leng a-om nawnta kei uh, ka hon chi ding hi.
Huai bel Israel zawlnei Jerusalem tungthu gen a, galmuanna omloupi a galmuanna musak mite ngei, a-om nawn kei uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
"Nang mihing tapa, na mite tanute, alungtang lel ua gen mite masuan inla, amaute kalh in thu gen in, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
Numei, mite ban a sik bunsak leh mi hinnate mat belhna ding a miliante lukhuhna khui mite atung uh agik hi! Nou hinna ding in ka mite hinna na man ding uh maw?
Buhman tawmchik leh tanghou them mu ding a si lou ding sisak ding leh hing lou ding hingsak ding in na zuaugen uh ka mite'n a-up ziak un ka mite lak ah ka min athanghuai ahi.

"Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, mi hinna, vasa bang a man ding a na thil butsakte uh ka mudah ahi; na bante uh ka bot ding a, na mimat dingte uh vasa bang a na mat dingte uh hinna ka pawtsak vek ding hi.
Na lukhuhnate uh leng ka botkek ding a, ka mite na khut ua kipan ka suaktasak ding, na mat theih ding un na khut uah a-omta kei ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
"Kei lungkhamsak hilou a, midiktatte lungtang zuau a na hihnat ziak un leh migilou hingdam a a-omna ding a akhelhna lampi a kipan akilehheilouhna ding in migilou khutte na hihhat uh ahi.

Huaiziak in bangmah lou lel, thugenkholh diklou hiam zaw na mu nawn kei ding uh; huan na khut ua kipan ka mite ka hunkhe ding a, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh, achi, chi in gen in," achi high in," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel upa khenkhatte ka kiang ah ahong pai ua, ka ma ah atu ua.
Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tungta, ka kiang ah;
"Mihing tapa, hiai mite'n amilimte uh alungtang uah alalut ua, ama uah athulimlouhna pukna uh akoih uhi; kei ahon dong peuhmah ding ua hia?"

Huaiziak in amau houpih inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel inkuan a michih alungtang ua milim lalut a, ama ua athulimlouhna pukna koih a, zawlnei kiang a hong pai peuhmah, kei TOUPA'N amilim uh tamdan bang zel in ka dawng ding.
Israel inkote amilim uh ziak a hon na omtuamsan ziak ua alungtang ua ka mattheihna ding in."
Huaiziak in Israel inkote kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hong kik unla, na milimte ua kipan in hong kik un, na kihhuaina tengteng uh lehngatsan un.

"Israel inkote lak a mi kuapeuh hiam, mikhual Israel gam a teng hiam, kei a kipan a kihihtuam, alungtang ua milim lalut a, ama ua thulimlouhna pukna koih kawm a, atungtang ua hon dong ding a zawlnei kiang a hoh kei leh TOUPA ngei in ka dawng ding hi.
Huai mi ka masuan ding a, mi'n lamdang asak ding in tangtawn tangtawn a gen ding in ka mite lak a kipan ka hihmang ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uhi.
"Huan zawlnei khem a om in thu gen henla, kei TOUPA'N zawlnei ka thuzoh ahi a, atung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, ka mi Israelte lak a kipan ka hihmang ding.
Athulimlouhna uh apo ding ua; zawlnei thulimlouhna amah dong mite thulimlouhna bang mai ahi ding hi.

Israel inkote kei a kipan aman nawn louh ua, atatleknate tengteng ua akihihnit nawn samlouhna ding un, ka mite ahih zawk ua a Pathian uh ka hihtheihna ding in, Toupa PATHIAN in achi, chi in gen in," achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
"Mihing tapa, gam mite'n tatlekna thilhih a, ka tung a thil hihkhial a, ke'n ka khut ka lik a, a-an uh, hinna bul ka hihsiat a, atung ua kial ka tunsak a, mi leh sate ka hon hihmanleh hiai mi thum,
Noah, Daniel leh Job hial leng hong om bang hileh, adiktatna un amau hinna kia a humbit ding ahi," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Gam sahangte a gam uh ka tuansuaksak a, gam ahihsiat ua, ahong kigawp a, gamsa ziak a kuamah paisuak ding a-om kei uleh,
hiai mi thumte om le uh, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanute uh, atapate uh ahumbit tuan kei ding uh; amau kia hotdam in a-om ding ua, gam asegawp ding hi.
Ahihkeileh huai gam ah namsau ka lik dia, "Namsau aw, gamsung teng tawnsuak in," mi leh gamsa ka gawimang ding hi.
Hiai mi thumte om le uh leng, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanute uh, atapate uh ahumbit tuan kei ding ua, amau hinna kia humbit in a-om ding uh.
Ahihkeileh, huai gam ah, hipi ka hon lensak a, mi leh sa hihmang ding a sisan suah a ka hehna huai gam tung a ka hon sunleh;
Noah, Daniel leh Job hial leng na om le uh, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanu uhiam, atapa uhiam ahumbit kei ding ua, adiktatna un amau hinna ngei ahumbit lel ding uhi.

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ngal a, "Jerusalem tung a ka vaihawmna na mahmah lite, namsaute, kialte, gam sahangte, hipite, mi leh sa gawimang vek ding a ka hon tut hun chiang in bangzah a thupi ahi diam aw?

Himahleh ngai in, huai lai a akhosuaksun pikhiak dingte nutsiat in a-om ding ua, tanute leh tapate leng; ngai un, akiang uah ahong pawtkhe ding ua, a-omdan uh athilhihte na mu ding uh, Jerusalem tung a thil hoih lou ka hon tut thu ah lungmuan in na om ding ua, atung a ka hon tut tengteng thu ah leng.
A-omdan uleh athilhihte uh na muh hun chiang un ahon lungmuan ding uh; atung a ka thilhih tengteng hihsan nei lou in ka hih kei chih na thei ding uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
"Mihing tapa, sing dang sang in gammang nuai a sing lak a grepgui bang ahi tuam a le?
Thil bawlna dia asing zat ahi hia? Tui-um belsuan khaina ding in kua'n azang ngei a le?
Ngai in, mei a paihlut ahi a, toh ding in mei in akangmang, among langnih, akang khin a alai ah phattuamna anei a hia?
Ngai in, abit lai nangawn in aphatuam kei; akatmang khit nung in, phatuam sin kei na tel e!"
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamnuai sing lak a grep guite, toh ding in mei ah ka khul maimah bang in, Jerusalem luah mite ka bawl ding.
Amau ka masuan ding a, pawt mah le uh, mei a kipan, akangbei ding, mei in, TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh; amaute ka masuan hun chiang in.
Agam uh ka hihgawp ngei ding ahi, thulimlouhna ahih ziak un chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
"Mihing tapa, Jerusalem akihhuainate theikhesak inla, akiang ah,
Toupa PATHIAN in Jerusalem kiang ah hichi in achi: Na pawtna gam leh na pianna gam Kanaan mite gam ahi a, na pa Amor mi ahi a, na nu Hit mi ahi.
Huan na pianna thu bel na pian ni in na laigui at ahi kei a, nang hihsiang ding a tui a sil na hi sam kei, chi nuh na tuak kei a, tuamlum na hi kei.
Lainat ding a na tung a hiaite hih ding in kuamah mit in nang ahon hehpih kei ua; gamlak a paihkhiak na hita, na pian ni a kipan kih a om na hi hi."
Huan na kiang a ka hong pai in sisan lak a kital in ka hon mu a, na kiang ah, "Sisan ah om lechin leng 'hing in!' ka hon chi a," ahi, ka hon chi ahi, "Sisan ah om mah lechin 'hing in!'
Gam thil pakmum bang in ka hon khangsak a, khanglian a piching in, na hong melhoih mahmah hi. Na nawite ahong kisa ua, na sam ahong hoih a; himahleh savuak leh vuaktang lel na hi lailai hi."

Huan na kiang a ka hong pai a ka hon et in, deihhuai tham na hong hita a, ka puan ka hon zawn a, na vuaktanna ka hon khuhta hi; ahi, na kiang ah ka kichiam a, thukhun ah ka hon lutpih a, kei a na hita hi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Huchi in tui in ka hon sil a, ahi, na sisan ka hon hihsiang sipsip a, sathau ka hon nuh hi.
Puanzem in ka hon van a, saham vun khedap ka hon bunsak a, puanmalngat hoih in ka hon van a, silk puan ka hon khusak hi.
Kizepna hoih in ka hon zem a, na khut ah taute, na ngawng ah dangka-eng khainiangte.
Na nak ah nakbulhte, na bil ah bilbahte, na lu ah lallukhu hoihtak in ka hon zem hi.

Huchi in dangka-eng leh dangkasik a zephoih na hita a, na puansilhte puanmalngat hoihtak leh silk puan leh puankhui kilawm ahi ua; na nek tangbuang nel leh khuaizu leh sathau ahi, na kilawm mahmah a, kumpi chi leng na ching hi.
Na kilawmna ziak in namte lak ah athangkhia a, ka thupina a kivan in na buchingta, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Himahleh na kilawmna na muang lua a, na minthanna na hukloh a, mi vialvak peuh leh na muh peuh na kithuahpih hi.
Na puansilhte suah in mun sangte na zuan a, huai ah kizuak in na pang a, hichibang in na om ngei nawn kei ding hi.
Ka dangka-eng leh ka dangkasik tui-um belsuan hoih taktak ka hon piakte na la a, pasal limbawlna ding in na zang, na hukpihta hi.
Puansilh khui kilawmte na la a, amau na tuam a, ka sathaute leh ka gimlimte ama uah na tung hi.
Ka hon tanghou piak leng ka tangbuang hoih leh sathau leh khuaizu ka hon vaknate gimlim ding in ama uah na lui a; hichi ahong hita, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Huai lou leng na tanu, na tapa, na hon suansakte akiang uah kithoihna ding in zatbei ding in na pia a; na hukna thil namai ahi a hia?
Ka tate na thah a, meipi a pailut a akiang ua na latte?
Na kihhuaina leh na hukna tengteng ah na naupan lai avuaktang a na omleh na sisan a na tal maimah hunlaite na thei nawnta kei hi.
Huan hiai na thulimlouhna tengteng khit in leng, hichi ahong hi a, na tung agik hi! Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
Mun kiphoute na kibawlna, kongzing chiteng ah mun sangte na lam hi.
Lampi kipatna teng ah mun sang na lam a, na kilawmna kihhuai in na bawl a vialvak peuhmahte kiang ah na kilemdawk a, na hukna a-uang semsem hi.
Aigupta mi, na inveng, sami mahmah toh kingaihna khelhna leng na hihta; hon hehsak ding in na hukna na uangsakta ahi.
Huaiziak in ngai in, na tung ah ka khut ka lik a, na an nek ka kiamsak a, nang hon mudah Philistia tanute, na hukdan zumpih mahmah nute kiang ah ut-ut a ahon bawl ding un ka hon peta hi.
Assuria mite kiang ah leng na kizuak a, huntawk chih lah nei tel lou; ahi, akiang uah kizuak in na pang a, na kham tuan sam kei hi.
Kanaan gam ah, Kaldai mite kiang ah na hukna na uangsak lailai a, na kham tuan kei hi.
Nang lungtang sia hina mai e, na tatdan numei genhak gilou mahmah mai thil na hih a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Lamka thuam teng a milim biakna inn na bawl a, kongzing chih a mun sang na bawlte loh na delh louh ziak in kizuak leng na bang kei hi.
Zi angkawm, pasalte sang a mi tuam deihzaw nu!
Kizuakte kiang ah thil apesek ua, nang bel na lehpiak a hon deihmi ang ah, gam chih a kipan ahong pai ua, ahon kithuahpih theihna ding un na nou zaw nak ahi.
Huan na huk thu a kuamah in ahon zot louh midang toh na kibatlouhna uh ahi; nang aman na pe zosop a; kuamah in man ahon piak louh uh na lamdanna ahi.
Huaiziak in aw mihuknu, TOUPA thu ngai in;

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na kihhuaina buakkhiak ahih a, na mingaihte toh na kithuahna lam ua na vuaktanna suklat ahih ziak leh na kihhuaina milim tengteng ziak leh akiang ua na piak na tate sisan ziak in;

ngai in, nang hon ngaimi na nuamtatpihte tengteng leh na na ngaih khitsa tengteng leh na muhdahte tengteng ka samkhawm ding a, ahi, na kim ah ka pikhawm ding a, na vuaktanna tengteng amuhtheihna ding un akiang uah na vuaktanna ka hihlang ding hi.
Huan numei pasal khen a, amah ta sisan suah tungthu a bang in ka hon vaihawmkhum ding; hehna leh mullitna sisan na tung ah ka tungsak ding.
Akhut uah ka hon pe dia, na mun kidohte ahihpuk ding ua, na mun sangte achimsak ding ua; na puansilhte asuah ding ua, na suangmantamte ahon sut ding ua, savuak leh vuaktang in ahon nuse ding uh.
Na tung ah mipi akaikhawm ding ua, suang in ahon deng ding ua, namsau in ahon kui pailet ding uhi.
Na innte mei in ahal ding ua, numei tampi mitmuh in na tung ah vaihawmna atangtungsak ding ua; na hukna ka tawpsak ding a, loh leng na peta kei ding hi.
Huchi in ka hehna na tung ah ka lungdamsak ding a, ka hon mullitna adaita ding, ka dai dide dia, ka heh ngei nawn kei ding hi.

Na tuailai nite na theihgige louh a, hiai thilte a na hon vuisak zawk ziak in, ngai in, na tatdan dan, na tung ah ka tun ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Huan na kihhuaina tengteng behlap in hiai hukna na hih nawn kei ding hi.
"Ngai in, paunak zang peuhmah in hiai paunak azang ding uh, 'Atanu in anu asuun,' chih.
Na nu, amah pasal leh tate mudahnu tanu na hi a, kitanauna lam ah bel, ama pasal leh tate mudahnu tanau na hi; na nu Hit mi ahi a, na pa Amor mi ahi.
"Huan na tanau, na u Samaria, na veilam a teng amah leh atanute toh ahi uh; na tanau, na nau, na taklam a teng Sodom leh atanute ahi uhi.
Himahleh amau omdan na zui kei a, akihhuaina bang uh na hih kei na a, na omdan tengteng a na thulim louh zawkdan ngaihtuah in huaite bangmah tham ahi kei hi.
"Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, nang leh na tate'n ahih bang uh na tanau Sodom leh atanute'n leng ahih het kei uh.
Na tanau Sodom thulimlouhna hiaite ahi: kisaktheihna, nekvah luatnate, amah leh atanute nuamtat mawkmawkte, migentheite leh tasamte apanpih tuan sam kei uh.
Huan mi uang ahi ua, ka ma a thilkihhuai hihsa ahi uh; huchi in hoih ka sak bang in ka hihmangta ahi.
"Samaria in na khelhna kimkhat leng ahih sam kei; amau sang a na kihhuainate na nak hih zawk ziak in na hihsa na kihhuaina tengteng in na sanggamnute siam na tangsak hi.

Na sanggamnute dikzaw a na suklat ziak in nangmah in na zahlakna na puak ding ahi; amau sang in thilkihhuai uangzawte na hih a, na khelhnate ziak in amau nang sang in adiktatzaw uhi; ahi, na sanggamnute siam na tansakna ah nang anen-aham in zahlakna na tang ding ahi.
"Huan a-omdan uh, Sodom leh atanu omdante, Samaria leh atanu omdante, amaute toh ton in nang omdan mahmah ka hei ding.
Amau a dia lungmuanna na na hih sekna a na thilhihsa tengteng ziak a na zumtheihna ding in.
Huan na sanggamnute, Sodom leh atanute, Samaria leh atanute a-omdan uh masa bang in a-om nawn ding ua; nang leh na tanu leng na omdan uh masa bang in na om nawn ding uh.
Na thulimlouhna muhkhiak a hih ma a na kihih thupi nite in na sanggamnu Sodom na kamse khuahna ahi sek kei maw?
Tu'n zaw Siria tanu leh akim a mi tengteng, Philistia tanute na kim a hon simmoh mite'n ahon genseta uhi.
Na hukna leh na kihhuaina na po zel ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Thukhun bohsia in thuchiam na khawksak louhdan bang zel in na tung ah ka hih tei sin ahi.
Himahleh na naupan lai a na kiang a ka thukhun ka theigige ding a, na kiang ah tangtawn thukhun ka bawl ding hi.
Huchi in na sanggamnute ka pom hun chiang in na omdante na hon theikhe ding a, na kizumpih ding; amau lah na tanu ding in ka hon pia hi, na thukhun ziak bel hilou in.
Na kiang a ka thukhun ka hihkip ding a, TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh.
Na thilhih tengteng ka hon ngaihdam vek hun chiang in na theihgigena na zum ziak a na kam kat nawnlouhna ding in," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah:
"Mihing tapa, Israel inkote kiang ah thuhaksa bawlkhia inla, gentehna in gen in,
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, chi in; Muvanlai lianpi, kha zapi, khaveng saupi gial em-um, mul bittak Lebanon tang ah aleng a, sidar sing zik atuah hi.
Ahiang ziknou pen akitan a, mi vialvakna gam ah alenpih a, sumsinna khopi ah aphut hi.
Huai gam haichi leng atuah a, lei hoih ah apawipou a, tui tampi gei ah aphut a, muisum sing bang in aphut hi.
Huan akhang a, grepgui niam bilbial ahong hi a, selnoute ahon suah a, ahiangte ahong dawn hi.

"Muvanlai lianpi dang a-om nawn a, kha zapi leh mul bittak anei a, ngai in, hiai grep kung amah lam ah azung azam a; asuanna mun a kipan in amah lam ah hiangte apoukhia a, amah tui a avaktheihna ding in.
Hiangte asuah a, grep hoihtak ahihtheihna ding in tui tampi gei a lei hoih aphuh ahi."

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Apiching den dia hia? Avuai maimah theihna ding in anahte satkhia in, azung toh abotkhe kei dia hia? Anah sel thak tengteng in leng avuailoh ding; azung toh botkhe ding in thilhihtheihna thupitak hiam, muvanlai tampi akiphamoh tuan kei dia hia?
"Ahi, ngai in, phuh hileh leng apiching den dia hia? Suahlam huih in ahon nuai hun chiang in avuai khin maimah kei dia hia? Apouna mun mah ah avuai maimah ding chi in," achi a.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah:
"Helhat inkote kiang ah gen in, hiai thil omdan athei kei ua hia? Hilh in, ngai un, Babulon kumpipa Jerusalem ah ahong pai a,
akumpipa uleh aheutu uh aman a, amah kiang ah Babulon ah api a, akumpipa uh suan khat aman a, thukhun abawlpih a, thu achiam teitei a, gam a miliante apimang vek a,
alalna gam akeniam a, amah a adinkhiak theih nawnlouhna ding in athukhun len kawm kia a adintheihna ding in.

Himahleh sakolte leh mi tampi hon sawl ding a ngen ding in Aigupta gam a palai sawl in atung ah ahelta hi. Alohching ding hia? Hichibang hihmi asuakta ding hia? Thukhun hihse ngal in apawtkhe thou ding hia?"
Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; kumpipa, kumpipa dia bawlpa tenna ngei ah akichiamnate musit leh athukhunte bohsia a, amah kiang mahmah ah Babulon ah asi ding hi.
Mi tampi hihlup ding a mual pawngte leh kulhte abawl hun chiang un leng Pharaoh sepaihhon leh pawl thupi mahmah leng bangmah ahihsak thei kei ding uh.
Thukhun bohsia in kichiamna amusitta ngal ua; thu akichiam nung in hiai thil tengteng ahih nawn a, asuakta peuhmah kei ding hi.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: ka kichiamna amusit a, ka thukhun abohsia a, kei ka hin bang in, ama tung ah ka bung ngeingei ding hi.
Len in ka khuh ding a, ka thang ah a-awk ding a, Babulon ah ka hon pi ding a, huchi in abohsiatna, ka tung ngei a abohsiatnate ziak in amah ka sual ding.
Huan apawl tengteng a taikekte tengteng namsau in asi ding ua, a-omlaite kawlmong chih ah adalh ding uh; huan kei TOUPA'N ka genta chih atheikhe ding uh.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sidar sang mahmah dawn ke'n ka la ding a, ka phut ding; azikpi pen aziknou ka khiak ding a, tang sang kidoh ah ka phut ding.
Israel sanna tang ah ka phut ding a, hiangte ahong sel ding ua, ahong gah ding, sidar thupitak ahi ding; anuai ah tungleng vasa chi chih ateng ding ua, ahiang liimte ah a-om ding uh.

Huan gam sing tengteng in kei TOUPA'N sing sangte ka niamsak a, sing niamte ka sangsak a, sing hingte ka keusak a, sing keute ka hingphasak a, ka chi nalai hi,” achi hi. Kei TOUPA'N ka genta a, ka gen bang in ka hih ding hi.
Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
"Israel gam tungtang a hiai paunak azat uh bang chihna ahia, 'Pate'n grep thuk ane ua, atate uh ha azau hi, chih?'
"Kei ka hin bang in, Israel ah hiai paunak zat nawn chih na nei kei ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Ngai un, hinna tengteng kei a vek ahi, pa hinna kei a ahih bangmah in tapa hinna leng kei a ahi; kha khial peuhmah asi ding.
"Himahleh mi adiktat a, siang leh dik ahih a,
mun sangte a ne lou a, Israel inkote milim lam nga sam lou a, numei kizen lou leng naih lou a, kuamah tung a thil hihkhial lou a,
leibami thil khamna koih pe kik zaw a, kuamah hiamgam a lok lou a, gilkial kiang a nek ding pia a, vuaktang puan silhsak a;
apung delh ding a leitawisak lou a, asumpung leng la sam lou a, thil gilou hih dia akhut kidek a, mi leh mi kikal a diktak a vai hawmsak a;
ka dan bawlte zui a, diktak a hih a, ka vaihawmnate azuihleh, amah midiktat ahi a, ahing ngei ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
"Himahleh ama'n tapa guktak ching asuan a, sisan suahmi ahih a, hiai bang ahih a,
ahih ding zaw pen ahih louh a, mun sangte a anek zawk a, invengte zi ahihbuah a,
genthei leh tasamte asimmoh a, aloh a, akhamna koih apiak louh a, milimte lam nga, thilkihhuai ahih hi.
Apung delh a apiak a, apung alakleh, ahing ding hia? Ahing het kei ding; hiai thilkihhuai tengteng ahihta a, asi ngeingei ding, amah sisan moh ama tung ah atu ding ahi.
"Huan ngai in, tapa na nei tei taleh, apa thil gilou hihsa tengteng amuh a, lau a,
huchibang ahih teitei louh a, mun sang a anek louh a, Israel inkote milim lamte angat louh a, invengte zi ahihnit louh a,
kuamah tung a thil ahihkhelh louh a, khamna koih bangmah la lou a, kuamah lok lou a, gilkialte nek ding pe zaw a, savuakte asilhsak a;
genthei lak a akhut akideksak a, anou leh apung la lou a, ka thupiakte zang a ka dan bawlte zuimi ahihleh, apa thulimlouhna ziak in asi kei ding a, ahing zaw ngei ding hi.
Apa bel kheltak a mi nuaisiah a, a-unaupa hiamgamtak a sual a, amite lak a thil hoih lou ahih ziak in, ngai in, athulimlouhna ziak in asi ding ahi.
"Himahleh, bangziak a tapa in apa thulimlouhna thuak lou ding, na chi nak uh? Tapa in dan azuih a thil kizen ahih a, ka dan bawl tengteng azuih a, ahih laileh, ahing ngeingei ding hi.

Kha khial asi ding; tapa in apa thulimlouhna athuak kei ding a, pa in leng tapa thulimlouhna athuak sam kei ding; midiktat diktatna amah mah tung ah a-om ding, migilou gitlouhna amah mah tung ah a-om ding hi.
"Himahleh, migilou in akhelhna hih tengteng alehngatsan a, ka dan bawlte azuih a, dan zui a thil diktat ahihleh ahing ngei ding a, asi kei ding.
Tatlekna a na hihsa theihsak ahita kei ding; ana hihsa adiktatna ah ahing ding,
Migilou sihna ah kipahna ka nei a hia? Alampite alehngatsan a, ahong hin ding chih louh ngal? chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.

"Himahleh midiktat in adiktatna lampi alehngatsan a, thulimlouhna ahih a, migiloute hih bang zel a thilkihhuaite ahih in ahing dia hia? Athil diktat hihsa bangpeuh leng theihgige ahi nawnta kei ding a, atatlekna hih ah leh akhelhna hih ah, huai mahmah ah asi ding hi.
"Hinapi in, TOUPA hihdan akibang gige kei hi, na chi sek uh. Israel inkote aw, ngai un; ka hihdan akibang gige kei maw? Na hihdan uh akibang kei gige zaw ahi kei maw?
Midiktat in adiktatnate alehngatsan a, thulimlouhnate ahihleh huai ah asi ding a, thulimlouhna ahih ah asi ding.
Huai lou leng, migilou in akhelhna ahihsate lehngatsan a, dan azuih a, thil diktat ahihleh ahinna ahumbit ding.
Akingaihtuah a, atatlekna a hihsa tengteng alehngatsan ziak in ahing ngei ding, asi kei ding hi.
Hinapi in Israel inkote'n, TOUPA hihdan akibang gige kei, achi uhi. Aw Israel inkote aw, ka hihdante kibang gige ahi zaw kei maw?

"Huaiziak in aw Israel inkote aw, michih, noumau hihdan bang zel in vai ka hon hawmsak ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Kihei unla, na tatlekna tengtengte uh lehngatsan un; huchi in thulimlouhna na puksiatna uh ahi kei ding hi.
Na tatlekna tengteng uh, na tatleksate uh paimang vek unla, lungtang thak leh lungsim thak kibawl un! Israel inkote aw, bangziak a si ding na hi ua?
Mi sihna ah kipahna mahmah ka nei kei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; huaiziak in kihei unla, hing un."
Huai lou in leng Israel heutute tungtang ah suunna la phuah ahi;
Na nu bang ahia ahih? Humpinelkaipi ahi! Humpinelkaite lak ah akual a, humpinelkai lunlaite lak ah anoute avaklian hi.
Huan anoute lak ah khat avaktei a; humpinelkai lun lai ahong hi; samat asiam a, mite anegai hi.
Namte'n leng atanchin aza ua; akokhuk uah mat in a-om; huan Aigupta gam ah sikkawi in amah api uh.
Huchi in angak a, alametna avuaksuak chih atheih in, anoute lak ah khat ala a, humpinelkai lun lai in abawl hi.
Humpinelkai lak ah apaisuk paitou a, humpinelkai lun lai ahong hi a; samat asiam a, mite anegai hi.
Ama'n a-inpi kisesate uh athei a, akhopite uh ahihgawp a, gam asegawp a, ahumham husa ziak in, huai a tengteng.
Huchi in bialte a kipan in ning chih a namte'n amah adou ua; atung ah alen uh azak ua; akokhuk uah mat in a-omta hi.
Sikkawite in bawm sung ah akoih ua; Babulon kumpipa kiang ah api ua; kulh muanhuaite sung ah apilut uh; huchi a Israel tang sangte tung a aw akizak nawnlouhna ding in.
Na nu na sisan a grepgui bang ahi, tuite kiang a suan; tui tampite ziak in gahpha leh hiangte in adim.
Huan vaihawmna pote lalchiang sikchiang khauh a nei in, nah bawkpha lak ah asandan uh hihsang in a-om hi, huchi in ahiang tampite uh toh sangpi amuh in a-om uhi.
Himahleh thangpaihna a bohkhiak in a-om a, lei ah paihkhiak in a-om a, suahlam huih in agah amutkeu a; akung khauhte kitan in akeu a; mei in amaute akang beita.
Huan tu in gamdai ah, gamkeu leh tui om lou ah phuh in a-om.
Huchi in ahiang a sikchiang a pan mei apaikhia, agah ahulbei a, huchi in amah ah vaihawm ding in lalchiang ding sikchiang khauh a-om kei hi. Hiai kahla ahi, kahla a dia sak ahi ding hi.
Huan ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, na khe in dingh in, na kiang ah thu ka gen ding hi," achi hi.
Ka kiang a thu agen lai in kei ah kha ahong lut a, ka khe in ahon dingsak a, huchi in kei hon houpihpa ka ngaikhia hi.
Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, Israel suante kiang ah, helhat nam, ka tung a helnakte kiang ah ka hon sawl hi; amau leh apipute leng hiai ni pha nangawn in ka tung ah atalek uhi."
Suan lungkhauh leh genhakte ahi ua, akiang uah nang ka hon sawl hi; akiang uah, "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi," na chi ding ahi.
Huchi in amau angaikhia uhiam, angaikhe kei uhiam, (amaute lah helhat inkuan ahi ngal ua), alak uah zawlnei a-om chih atheigige ding uhi.

"Nang, mihing tapa, amaute kihta ke'nla, athu uah leng lunglel sam ke'n, na kiang ah khaulingnei leh louling neite om in, aikam lak a teng himah lechin; helhatmi himah le uh, athu uh kihta ke'nla, alatdan uah leng lunglel sam ke'n.
Angaikhia uhiam, angaikhe kei uhiam, akiang uah ka thu na gen ding ahi; amaute lah helhat inkuan ahi ngal ua.
"Himahleh nang mihing tapa, na kiang a ka gen ngaikhia in; mihelhat inkuan bang in helhat ke'nla; na kam ka inla, ka hon piak ne in," achi hi.
Huan ka en a ngai in, khut in ahon sawk a, ngai in huai ah laibuzial a-om hi.
Ka ma ah aphalh a, asunglam leh apolam gelh ahi a; huai ah kahna, lusuunna leh unggikna gelhna a-om hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sagihna, akha ngana, huai kha ani sawm ni in Israel Upa kuate hiam TOUPA thu dong ding in ahong pai ua, ka ma ah atu uhi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,

"Mihing tapa, Israel upate houpih inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Kei thudong dia hong pai na hi uh hia? Kei ka hin bang in, noute thudot in ka om kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
Amaute vai na hawmsak ding hia, mihing tapa, amaute vai na hawmsak ding hia? Apate uh kihhuainate thei uh hen.

Huan akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Israelte ka tel ni a Jakob inkote telte kiang ah ban zak hial a Aigupta gam a akiang ua ka kitheihsak a, akiang ua ka khut ka zak a, Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, ka chih.
Huai ni a Aigupta gam a kipan pikhia a, amah a dia gam kham, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, gam tengteng a kilawmpen a pilut ding a ka khut ka zak ni in akiang uah:
Michih in na mit ua muh thilkihhuai paimang unla, Aigupta gam a milimte in kihihnin kei un, kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in ka gen hi.

Himahleh, ka tung ah ahel ua, hon limsak kei ua, michih in amit ua muh thilkihhuaite leng apaimang kei ua, Aigupta milimte leng alehngatsan sam kei uh. Huai ah atung ua ka hehna lungdamsak ding in Aigupta gamsung ngei ah atung uah ka hehna ka leihbo kei na diam, ka chi hi.
Himahleh, keimah min ziak in ka gamtang zawta a, a-omna namte uh mitmuh in Aigupta gam a kipan pikhia in akiang uah ka kitheisakta; huai namte mitmuh a ka min gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in.
Huchi in Aigupta gam pawtsan ding in ka chita a, gamdai ah ka hon pilut hi.
Ka dan bawlte amaute ka pia a, ka dan thukhunte ka ensak a, huai tuh mi'n azuih ua ahinna ding un.
Huai lou leng kei leh amaute kikal achiamtehna ding in ka Sabbathte amau ka pia a, kei TOUPA, amaute koihtuampa ka hi chih atheihtheihna ding un.

Himahleh Israel inkote gamdai ah ka tung ah ahel ua, ka dan bawlte azui kei ua, ka thugelte, mi'n ahih a ahinna ding tak uh apaikhia ua, nakpitak in ka Sabbath abohsia ua; huchi in gamdai ah amaute hihmang ding in atung uah ka hehna ka leih kei na diam aw, ka chi hi.
Ka pikhiak lai in athei mite nam mahmah mitmuh a hihsiat a a-omlouhna ding un ka min ziak in ka gamtang zawta hi.
Huai lou in huai gamdai ah ka gam piak, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, gam tengteng a kilawmpen ah ka pilut kei ding, ban zak hial in ka chi hi.
Ka thugelhte apaikhia ua, ka dan bawlte azui kei ua, ka Sabbathte abohsiat ziak un; alungtang un amilimte uh azui uhi.
Himahleh hihmang lou ding in ka mit in amuh maihta a, gam ah leng ka hihmang vekta kei hi.
Huan gamdai ah atate uh kiang ah: Na pipute uh dan bawl zui kei unla, athugelte uh zui kei unla, amilimte un kihihnin sam kei un;
Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, ka dan bawlte zui unla, ka thugelte vom unla, zui un.
Ka Sabbath tang unla, kei leh noute kikal a chiamtehna ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi chih na theihna ding un, ka chi hi.

Himahleh atate uh ka tung ah ahel ua, ka dan thukhunte azui kei ua, ka thugelte, mi'n ahih a ahinna ding tak, zui ding in avom sam kei uh. Sabbath ni abohseta ua; gamdai ah ka hehna lungdamsak ding in atung uah ka hehna ka leih kei na hiam, ka chi hi.
Himahleh ka khut ka kideksak a, ka pikhiak lai athei mite nam ngei mitmuh a hihsiat a a-omlouhna ding un ka min ziak in ka gamtang zawta ahi.
Huai lou leng, namte lak ah amau ka dalhsak ding a, gam chih ah ka thelthangsak ding, gamdai ah ban zak hial in ka na chi hi.
Ka thugelte zui lou a, ka dan bawlte paikhia a, ka Sabbath ni bohsia a, apipute uh milim lam angat ziak un.
Huai lou leng, dan bawlhoih lou ka pia a, ahinlouhna ding ua thugelte toh;
athiltan uh, sul hong tengtengte'n mei a apaihna uah amaute ka hihnin a, ka lungzuangsak a, atawp a TOUPA ka hi chih atheihna ding un.
Huaiziak in mihing tapa, akiang uah thu gen inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: “Na pate un hiaite ah ahon gense lailai uhi, ka tung a tatlekna thil ahihte uah.

Ban zak hial a amaute ka chiam gam ah ka hon pilut in, mual sang leh singbuk lian amuh peuhmah uah akithoihnate uh alan ua, athillat uh hehhuai mahmahte apia uh. Agimlimte uh abawl ua, adawn ding thillatte uh abungkhia uh," chi in.
Huchi in ke'n akiang uah, mun sang a na hoh nak uh bang na chihna uh ahia? ka chi a; huchi in amin a ding in tuni tan in, Bamah, chih ahita hi.
Huchi in Israel inkote kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na pipute uh bang zel in noumau na kihihnin un akihhuaina bang un hupmang na hi ding uh maw?

Na thil tan uh na lan un, na tate uh mei ah na pai ua, tuni tan in na milimte tengteng un na kihihnin uh ahi kei maw? Noute thudot ding ka hi a hia, aw Israel inkote aw? Kei ka hin bang in noute thudot in ka om kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
I kim ua namdang pau tuam mite bang a singbul suangbul be ding i hi uh, na lungsim ua na chih uh, atangtung himhim kei ding.
Kei ka hin bang in, khut thagui hattak in, ban zak kawm leh heh suah in na tung uah vai ka hawm ngeingei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Namte lak a kipan ka hon pikhe ding a, dalhsak a na omna gam ua kipan khut hattak leh ban zak leh heh suah in ka hon pikhawm ding.
Pau tuam mite gamdai gam ah ka hon pilut ding a, kimaituah in i kisual ding uh.
Aigupta gam gamdai a na pipute uh ka sual bangtak in nou leng ka hon sual ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Chiang nuai ah ka hon lutsak ding a, thukhun delhkhumna nuai ah ka hon pilut ding hi;

Huan na lak ua kipan mihelte leh ka tung a talek mite ka khuahsiang ding a, a-omna gam ua kipan in ka pikhe ding a, himahleh Israel gam ah alut het kei ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.

Noute ahihleh, Aw Israel inkote aw, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ka thu na ngaihkhiak kei uleh tunung chiang in na milim nna uh sem chiat maita unla; himahleh ka min siangthou bel na thilpiakte uleh na milimte un na hihninta kei ding uhi.

Ka tang siangthou, Israel sanna tang ah, huai ah Israel inkote tengteng in avek un, huai gam ah ka nna asem ding uh; huai ah amaute ka paktata dia, huai ah na thillatte uh na thilpiak hoih tatate uh, na thil tan tengteng uh ka deihta ding.

Namte lak a kipan ka hon lakkhiak hun chiang in leh gam chih a na dalhna ua kipan ka hon pikhawm hun chiang in, gimlim ding in noute ka hon sangta ding a, namte mitmuh in noute ah ka sianthoudan alangta ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
Huan Israel gam, ban zak hial a na pipute uh piak ka chiam gam a noute ka hon pilut hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
Huan huai ah na omdante uleh na thilhih uh, na kihihnitna tengteng uh na theita ding uh; huchi in na thil hoih lou hih tengtengte uh ziak in noute mitmuh ngei in na kihta ding uhi.

Na omdan hoihloute uh bang hilou a, na thilhih uh thulimloute bang leng hi sam lou a, ka min ziak a noute ka hon pichinsak hun chiang in, aw Israel inkote aw, TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
"Mihing tapa, simlam masuan inla, simlam nga in na thu khah inla, simlam gammangpi lam ah thu gen inla,

simlam gammangpi kiang ah, TOUPA thu ngai in, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, nang ah mei ka toh ding a, nang ah sing hing tengteng akangbei ding a, sing keu peuhmah leng; meikuang luahluah adai kei ding, sim a kipan mal tanpha in, matuah teng akangvom ding hi.
Huan mi tengteng in kei TOUPA meikhahpa ka hi chih amu ding ua, amit kei ding, chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in ke'n, "Ah! Toupa PATHIAN, gentehna thugenmi lel ahi kei maw? ahon chi ding uh," ka chi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kianh ah,
"Mihing tapa, Jerusalem maituah inla, amun siangthou lam nga in na thu gen inla, Israel gam tung ah thu gen in;
Israel gam kiang ah, huchi in TOUPA'N achi hi: Ngai in, ka hon dou ahi, ka namsau apai a kipan ka phawi ding a, na lak ua midiktat leh diktat lou kibang sap in ka phuk ding.
Huchi in na lak ua midiktat leh diktat lou ka phuk ding ziak in ka namsau apai a kipan apawt ding a, simlam a kipan mallam pha in mihing tengteng aphuk ding hi.
Huchi in mi tengteng in, kei TOUPA'N ka namsau apai a kipan ka phawi ahi chih athei ding uh, akikhum ngei nawnta kei ding hi."
Huaiziak in nang mihing tapa, thum huthut inla khasetak in amitmuh un thum in.

Huan "Bangziak a thum na hia?" ahon chih uleh, "Thuthang ziak in ahi, ahong tung sin ngal a, huai hun in lungtang chiteng azul ding a, khut tengteng azaw ding a, lungsim teng abah ding a, khuk tengteng tui bang in azaw ding a; ngai in, ahong tung hi, atangtun ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
Mihing tapa, thu gen inla, huchi in TOUPA'N achi hi:
"Namsau, namsau tat-hiam ahita, tetsak ahita, mi satna ding a tat-hiam ahita, tetsak ahi, khophia bang in! I nuamsa lailai ding maw? ka tapa, chiang na simmoh, sing a bawl peuhmah toh,
tetsak ahi, khut a let ding in ahi namsau tat-hiam tetsak ahi, thatmi khut a tuang ding in.
Mihing tapa, kikou inla; sehal ham in, ka mite tung ahi ngal a; Israel miliante teng tung mahmah; piak ahi ua, ka mite toh, namsau nuai ah; huaiziak in kikou inla, na pheipi beng in.
Hiai namsau midang tung a chiamtehsa ahi ngal a, na ngaihsak kei hitaleh bang suak ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi hi."
"Huaiziak in nang, mihing tapa, khut beng hial in thu gen in; thah a om dingte a ding namsau nihvei liksuk in om hen, ahi, thumvei; tampi thahna ding namsau ahi.
Lungtang zul, apukna uh apunna ding in, namsaute kongbiang teng ah ka giaksak hi; Ah! Khophia bang in ate zolzol, sihna namsau.
Nakpi'n gamtang in, taklam ah, gamtang in veilam ah leng van zel inla, na mazawn peuhmah ah leng.
Ke'n leng khut ka beng ding a, ka tangtun ngei ding, ka hehna, kei TOUPA'N hiai ka genta hi, chi in,” achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,

"Mihing tapa, Babulon kumpipa namsau hong tuntheihna ding in lampi nih na bawl in; huai lampi nihte gam khat a kipan in ahong pawtkhe ding uh ahi; lampi kawkmuhna bawl inla, kho pilut na khomual ah bawl in.
Ammon mite khua Rabbah a namsau ahong tuntheihna ding in lampi sep inla, Judah gam lai Jerusalem kulh ah leng.
Ai san ding in Babulon kumpipa lampi ka ah adingh a, lampi nih kigawmna tak ah; thalte asing loklok a terephim adong a, sa sin a-en hi.
A-aisanna ah akhut taklam ah Jerusalem ana tuang a, kulh suksiatnate galsual awng zuazuate, kongpi zawn a kulh suksiatnate, mual pawngsunte, kulh bawlte toh.
Aisan vuaksuak lel bang ahi a, himahleh mat a a-omna ding ua athulimlouhna uh theihkhiakna lel ding ahi."

Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Theihgigena ding a na thulimlouhna uh na bawl ziak un na tatleknate uh ahong kilang, na thilhih tengteng uah na khelhnate uh akimu kilkel a, theihkhiak na hong hih tak ziak un khut a mat na hong hi ding uhi.
Huan nang, Israel heutu, migilou si ding a liampa, na gitlouhna gawtna tawp ni ahong tung e;
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Heutu lukhu paihsak unla, lallukhu suhsak un, hiai angei in a-om kei ding; mivuallelte tawisang unla, miliante vuallelsak un.
Ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding; hiai leng angei in a-om kei ding, aneimi diktak ahong pai mateng amah ka pe ding hi."

Huan nang mihing tapa, thu gen inla, hichi in chi in; Toupa PATHIAN in Ammon tate tungtang ah leh agensiatna thu uah hichi in achi: "Namsau, namsau phawi ahita, mithahna ding leh hihmanna ding khophia bang a tetsak ahita.
"Kilakna taklou nang ahon musak ua, zuau in ai ahon sansak ua, namsau bel migilou si ding a liam, agitlouhna ni uh tawp hong tung dingte ngawng ah na golh ding, ahon chih un azuau uh ahi.
Apai ah thun in. Na pianna siam a na omna gam ngei ah na thu ka ngaihtuah ding.
Na tung ah ka hehna ka sung dia, ka thangpaihna mei na tung ah ka toh ding, minunsetak, hihman siamtak khut ah ka hon mansak ding.
Mei a khul ding na hi ding a, gam lai ah na sisan abo ding a, theih mahmah na hita kei ding, kei TOUPA'N ka genta ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
"Nang mihing tapa, sisan suah hat khopi na vaihawmkhum ding hia? Na vaihawmkhum ding hia? Akihhuaina tengteng theisak dih ve.
Huan akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Khopi, ahun hong tunna ding a amah sung a sisan suah leh amah kihihnin ding a milim bawl!

Na sisan suahna ah mohna na pua a, na milim bawl ah na kihihnin ahi; na hunte na naisak a, na kumte na tung phialphial a; huaiziak in namte kiang ah gensiat ding leh gam tengteng engbawl ding in ka hon bawl ahi.
Nang naih a om mite leh gamla a om mite'n ahon simmoh ding ua, nang, minsiat pua leh buaina a dimmi;
Ngai in, Israel heutute michih in athilhihtheihna bang zel ua sisan suah mai ding in nangmah ah a-om uhi.
Nang ah mi'n nu leh pate amusit ua, nang ah mikhualte anuaisiah ua, nang ah tagahte leh meithaite amawkbawl uh.
Ka thiltante na musit a, ka Sabbathte na bohsia hi.
Nang ah sisan suah ding in mi hekhatte a-om ua, nang ah tang sang a nete a-om ua, nang ah hukna aching uh.
Nang ah apate uh vuaktanna lemsak a-om ua, nang ah numei kizen louh lai kithuahpih a-om uh.
Huan mi'n a-inveng' zi tung ah thilkihhuai ahih a, midang in huktak in amou ahihnin a, midang in nang ah asanggamnu, apa tanu ngei azahlaksak hi.
Nang ah sisan suah ding in golhna ala ua, anou leh apung na la a; na inveng nuaisiah in huaihamtak in na lepguksak hi; kei mahmah leng na hon mangngilh a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
"Huaiziak in ngai in, na lepgukna thu ah, nang a sisan pawt thu ah khut ka hon betkhum ding.
Nang ka hon sual ni chiang in na lungtang in athuakzou in na khut ahat thei diam maw? Kei ToUPA ngei in ka genta a, ka hih lai ding.
Huan namte lak ah ka hon hihdalh ding a, gam chih ah ka hon thehzak ding; nang a kipan in na nitnate ka hihmang vek ding.
Namte mitmuh in nangmah kihihnin na hi ding, huan, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding, chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
"Mihing tapa, Israel inkote ei a ding in eksia lel ahong hita ua; avek un haltuina mei lai ah dalte, langvate, sikte, suante ahi ua, dangkasik eksia lel ahita uh.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Eksia lel na hong hih ziak un, ngai un, Jerusalem lai ah ka hon khawm ahi.

Dangkasikte, dalte, sikte, suante, langvate haltuina mei a akoihkhawm ua, tuisak ding a atung a mei atoh bang un ka hehna leh ka thangpaihna ah nou ka hon khawm ding, huai ah ka hon koih ding a, ka hon tuisak ding.
Ahi, ka hon khawm ding a, na tung uah ka hehna mei ka toh ding a, alai ah na tui khin ding uhi.
Haltuina mei lai a dangkasik atui bang in nou leng, huai lai ah na tui khin ding uh, kei TOUPA'N na tung uah ka hehna ka sung ahi chih na theita ding uh,” achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, akiang ah gen inla,
gam khuahsiang louh hehna ni chia vuahtui tang lou na hi.
Humpinelkai in humham a samat azon bang mai in nang ah zawlnei sawmnate a-om ahi; mi hinnate ane khin ua, goute leh thil manphate alaksak ua, alai ah meithai tampi abawl uh.

Asiampute leng nakpitak in ka dan ah atalek ua, ka thil siangthoute ahihnin uh ahi, thiltante leh thil namai akhen kei ua, mite'n lah siangthou leh siangthou lou akhen tuan kei uh; ka Sabbathte akitheihmohbawl ua, alak uah hihminsiat in ka om hi.
Alai a heutute lah nge duhgawl nek ding zong bang lel ahi ua, sisan suah a mi hinnate hihmang in ginom loutak a aleptheihna ding un.
Huan azawlneite un sunu in baang anuh ua, kilakna bangmah lou lel amu ua, zuau in ai asan ua, TOUPA'N bangmah a gen louh in leng, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi," achi uh.
"Gam a mipite'n nuaisiah aching ua, loh ahat ua, ahi, migenthei leh tasamte amawkbawl ua, dikloutak in mikhualte anuaisiah uhi.
Gam ka hihsiatlouhna ding in alak ua dai kai ding leh gam hum a ka ma a pang ding mi ka zong a, ka mu kei hi.
Huaiziak in atung uah ka hehna ka sungbota a, ka thangpaihna mei in ka halmangta ahi; a-omdan ngei uh atung uah ka tungsak ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
"Mihing tapa, numei nih, nu khat ta a-om uhi.
Aigupta gam ah ahukmang ua, atuailai neu ua huk ahi ua, huai ah a-angnem uh azawtsak ua, atuailai nawi uh ameksak ek uhi.
