Huan asungpite, tohlet khuam neute, polam sumtawngte singpek in athuap ua; athum un akimvel in hon theih louh tohlet leh inchial anei a; inpi lutna kongpi tan in apialkhang a kipan tohlet pha a apum a singpek a thuap ahi, tohlet leng thuap ahi lai hi.
Kongpi lutungte, dantan sungnung tanpha leh apolam toh, baang tengteng asunglam leh apolam tan in.
Huaite cherub limte leh tum sing limte a zep ahi a, cherub leh cherub kikal ah tum sing a-om zel a; cherubte'n mai nih anei chiat uhi.
Mihing mel bang in alangkhat in tum sing lam anga a, humpinelkai tuailai mel bang in alangkhat in tum sing lam anga nawn hi. Hiaite tempul kimvel vek in agelh uhi.
Apialkhang a kipan in kongpi tung pha in cherub leh tum sing lim a zep vek ahi; tempul baang bel huchi vek ahi.
Tempul kongpi biang khuamte tuh asah azat kibang ahi. Mun Siangthou ma ah sing a bawl maitam bangtak a-om hi.
Tong thum a sang, tong nih a za, aningte, atawte leh apangte sing a bawl vek ahi. Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai TOUPA ma a dohkan ahi,” achi hi.
Tempul leh Mun Siangthou in kongkhak nih tuaktuak anei hi.
Kongkhak in phel nih anei tuaktuak a; aphel khat bel kheptheih chiat ahi; kongkhak khat ah phel nih, adang ah phel nih anei hi.
Baang a agelh mah bang un tempul kongkhakte ah cherub leh tum sing lim agelh chiat lai ua; sumtawng pua ah singpek sah mahmah aphalh uhi.
Huan sumtawng baang lang tuakte leh singpek phalhte ah tohlet hon theih louh leh tum sing lim a-om lai a; atempul pang dantan leh singpek phalh leng huchibang mah ahi.
Huan huang sungnungzaw malam pang ah ahon pikhia a; mun awng zawn mallam kulh khuam doh dantan ah hon pilut hi.
Mallam pang a dantante tong za a sau tong sawmnga a za ahi.
Huang sungnungzaw pen mun awng tong sawmnih lam nga leh huang ponungzaw suanglep lam doh inchial thum a-om tuaktuak hi.
Dantante kikal ah tong sawm a za, tong za a sau paisuakna a-om a, akongkhakte'n mallam anga hi.
Dantan tungnungte akochikzaw a; inchial nuainungzaw leh alaitate sang in a-inchialte'n mun lian aluah zaw uhi.
Chial thum a lam ahi a, huangsung khuamte bang in khuam anei kei a; huchi in alaita sang in atungnungpen akochikzaw a, alaita leng anuainungpen sang in akochikzaw lai hi.
Huan dantan pang polam ah huangsung ponungzaw pen lam doh baang tong sawmnga a sau a-om hi.
Huangsung ponungzaw a dantante tong sawmnga a sau ahi ua; tempul zul a pen tong za a sau ahi.
Huan huai dantante nuai ah suahlam pang ah huangsung ponungzaw a kipan polam ah alutna a-om hi.
Simlam ah leng mun awng zawn a kulhbaang doh in dantante a-om nawn hi.
Ama a paina leng mallam dantante paina mah bang ahi a; adung leh avai leng, apawtkhiaknate, alepkhawmdante, akongkhakte'n simlam anga chih kia lou ngal akibang vek ahi.
Huai dantante lutna ding paisuakna tawp suahlam baangchin ah kongkhak a-om hi.

Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Simlam leh mallam dantan, mun awl hon dohte dantan siangthoute ahi ua; thil siangthoute akoihkhawm ua; nek ding latnate, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, moh ziak a kithoihnate alatna ding uh ahi; amun lah asiangthou ngal a.

Huai lai a siampute alut phot uleh, mun siangthou a kipan in huangsung ponungzaw ah apawtkhe ding uh ahi kei; huai ah anasepna puansilhte uh akoih zaw ding ua, puansilh siangthou ahi ngal ua; puansilh dang silh kia in vantang lak ah agamtang thei ding uh," achi hi.
Tempul sungnungzaw pen ateh khit in suahlam nga kongpi ah ahon pikhia a, tempul kimvel in ateh hi.
Tehna chiang in suahlam pang ateh a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga ahi.
Mallam pang ahon teh nawn leuleu a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga ahi.
Simlam pang ateh nawn a, tehna chiang a teh in tong zanga mah ahi.
Huan tumlam ahon teh nawn a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga mah ahi.
Apang li in atehta a; adunglam tong zanga, availam tong zanga ahi; akim in kulhbaang nei ahi; huai mun siang leh siang lou deidanna ding a bawl ahi.
Huchi in kongpi ah, suahlam kongpi ah ahon pi hi.
Ngai dih, Israel' Pathian thupina suahlam a kipan in ahong tung a; ahusa tui tampi ging bang ahi a, athupina in leitung atanvak hi.
Kilakna ka muh a alatdan, khopi hihse ding a hong pai leh Kebar lui gei a kilakna ka muh bangmah ahi a; huchi in bokkhup in ka pukta hi.
Suahlam nga kongpi ah tempul sung ah TOUPA thupina alut hi.
Kha in ahon domkang a, huang sungnungzaw ah ahon pilut a; huan, ngai in, TOUPA thupina in tempul aluahdim hi.
Huan mi khat ka kiang a adin lai in mi kuahiam tempul polam a kipan hon houpih in ka za a, ka kiang ah,

"Mihing tapa, hiai ka laltutphah omna mun, ka khepek ngakna, Israel suante lak a tangtawn a ka tenna ding mun ahi; ka min siangthou Israel inkote'n amau inn hiam, akumpipate uh hiam, ahukna uleh akumpipate uh luangvuina a zang in ahihthanghuai nawnta kei ding uh.

Akongpi uh ka kongpi chin mahmah a bawl in, akongpi biang uh ka kongpi biang zul a koih in amau leh keimah kikal ah baang kia omsak in athilhih kihhuaite un ka min siangthou ahihthanghuai uhi; huaiziak in ka hehna in amau ka hihmangta hi.
Tu a kipan in kizuaknate, akumpipa uh luangte kei a kipan gamlapi ah koihmang le uh; huchi in alak uah tangtawn in ka teng ding hi.
"Nang mihing tapa, Israel inkote kiang ah tempul lim ensak in; athilhihkhelh uh azumpih theihna ding un, abawldan ding leng na teh uhen.

Huan athilhih tengteng uh azumpih ua atempul omdante, apawtkhiaknate, alutnate, ageldante, azatdante, akepdante ensak inla, amitmuh mahmah uah gelh in; adan pumpi leh azatdan tengteng avom ua, azuihtheihna ding un.
Hiai tempul a dia dan ding ahi; tang vum tau kim tengteng mun siangthoupen ding ahi; ngai dih, hiai tempul a dia dan ding ahi.
"Huan tong a teh in hiai maitam let lam ahi, tong khat chih tong khat leh khutpek tuam ahi a, akingakna tong khat a sang, tong khat a za, agei akim a khap khat a pawng zel ahi.
Huan maitam sanlam hichibang ahi; lei a akingakna a kipan dohdan nuainungzaw pen tong nih ahi a, azatlam tong khat; adohdan neuzaw pen a kipan dohdan lianzaw pen tong li ahi a, tong khat a za ahi.
Amaitam tau tong li a sang ahi nawn a, maitam tau a kipan leh atunglam kii li ding ahi.
Maitam tau adung leh avai tong sawm-le-nih tuaktuak ahi; adung-avai kikim ahi.
Dohdan dung leh vai tong sawm-le-li tuaktuak ahi; adung-avai kikim ahi; agei tong kimkhat ahi; akingakna akim in tong khat ahi; akalbi in suahlam angat ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Abawl khit chiang ua maitam zatdan ding hichibang ahi; halmang kithoihna dingte, sisan thehna dingte ahi.
Levi chi siampu Zadok suan a mi, nna hon sepsak ding a hon naih sekpa kiang ah khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai na piak ding ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Asisan na la ding a, maitam kii lite leh adohdan ning lite, agei kimvel in na luan ding a; huchibang in maitam na hihsiang in na siangsak ding hi.
Khelh ziak a kithoihna bawngtaltuai na la ding a, huai ding a tempul aseh uh, mun siangthou polam ah hal ahih ding ahi.
Huan ani nihna in keltal dembei, khelh ziak a kithoihna ding a lat ding ahi; huchi in maitam bel bawngtaltuai a ahihsiang mah bang un na siangsak ding hi.
Maitam hihsiang pen na hih khit chiang un ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei leh belamtal, gensiatbei, ahon lak a na lan ding hi.
TOUPA ma ah na lan ding a, siampu in chi asoh ding a, TOUPA kiang ah halmang a ding in alan ding.
Ni sagih sung niteng khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in keltal na zang ding ahi; ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai leh belamtal, ahon lak a, gensiatbei leng azat ding uh ahi.
Maitam hihsiang leh siansakna in ni sagih ala ding a; huchi in maitam siangthou ahita ding hi.

Huan huai nite ahihtangtun khit chiang un, ani giat ni a kipan in siampute'n na halmang kithoihnate uh leh lemna kithoihnate amaitam uah alan ding ua, huan ka hon na sang ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," achi hi.
Huan mun siangthou kongpi ponungzaw, suahlam nga ah hon pikik nawn a, kong khaksa ana hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai kongpi akikhak gige ding a, akihong ngei kei ding a, kuamah alut sam kei ding uh; TOUPA, Israel' Pathian ahong lut khit ziak in; akikhak gige ding ahi.
Kumpi bel TOUPA ma a an ne ding in huai ah atu phet ding; sumtawng kongkhak ah alut ding a, huai mah ah apawt nawn ding," achi hi.
Huan mallam nga kongpi ah tempul intual ah ahon pi a; ka en a ngai dih, TOUPA thupina in TOUPA tempul aluahdim vek a; huchi in bokkhup in ka pukta hi.

TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, TOUPA tempul zatdan leh adan tengteng na kiang a ka gen tungtang ah na bildoh inla, na mitsuan inla, na lungsim ah chiamteh hoih dih; atempul a lutdante, amun siangthou a kipan pawtdante, na lungsim ah hoihtak in chiamteh in.
"Huan helhat, Israel inkote ngei kiang ah huchi in na gen ding ahi; Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, nou Israel inkote aw, na thilhih kihhuai tengteng uh ahunta,
lungtang leh sa zeksum louh, ka tanghoute, thaute na lat lai ua ka mun siangthou, ka tempul mahmah hihbuah ding a na pilut ua, ka thukhun a na tatlek uh, na kihhuaina tengtengte uh na tawpta hen.
Ka thil siangthoute nou na kem kei ua, hiai pau tuam mite ka mun siangthou ah nou sik a kemmi in na sep zaw uhi."
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamdangmi kuamah, lungtang leh sa zeksum louh, Israel suante lak a gamdangmi kuamah ka mun siangthou ah alut ding uh ahi kei hi.”
Levi chi, Israelte milim delh a avakmang lai ua kei a kipan a gamlapi a paisate'n bel athulimlouhna uh apo ding uh.

Ka mun siangthou ah nasemmi in apang ding ua; tempul kongkhakte angak ding ua; tempul sung ah nna asem ding uh; halmang kithoihnate, mipi a dia kithoihnate agou ding ua; mipi nna sepsak ding in ama uah adingh ding uhi.

Amilimte uh ma ah a-nna uh asepsak ding ua; Israelte inkote a ding in thulimlouhna a pukna ahih nak ziak un atung uah ka khut ka lik ding a; athulimlouhna uh apo ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.

Huchi in ka kiang ah siampu nna sem ding in ahon naih ngei kei ding ua; ka thil siangthoute, thil siangthoupente ahon naih ngei sam kei ding uh; azahlakna uleh athilkihhuai hihsate uh apo zaw ding uh.
Tempul kem mite ding in ka bawl ding a, nasepna tengteng leh hih ding om peuhmahte hih ding in.

Siampu Levi chi, Zadok ta, kei a kipan a Israel suante avakmang lai ua ka mun siangthou kem mite'n bel ka nna sem ding in ahong naih ding uh; thau leh sisan lan ding in ka ma ah adingh ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Ka mun siangthou ah alut ding ua, nna hon sepsak ding in ka dohkan ahong naih ding ua, kei hon kemmi in apang ding uh.
Huan huang sungnungzaw kongpite a alut un puanaktual malngat in akithuam ding ua, huang sungnungzaw leh insung lam a nna asep sung un samul puan asilh ding uh ahi kei hi.
Dial malngat akhim ding ua, puanmalngat pheitom abun ding ua, kho-ulsak thei asilh ding uh ahi kei hi.

Huan huangsung ponungzaw, vantang kiang a ahong pawtkhiak uleh anasepna puansilhte uh asuah ding ua, dantan siangthou ah akoih ding uh, puansilh dang asilh ding uh; mipite apuansilh ua misiangthou a abawl teilouhna ding un.
Alute uh ametgiau ding uh ahi kei a; asam uh leng ahawisau ding uh ahi sam kei; amet lel ding uh ahi.
Siampu kuapeuh huang sungnungzaw pen alut chiang un uain adawn ding uh ahi kei hi.
Meithai hiam maksa nung hiam zi in anei ding uh ahi sam kei hi; Israel inkote, nungak siangthou hiam siampu sihsan meithai akitenpih zawk ding uh ahi.
Ka mite thil siangthou leh thil nin kibatlouhdan ahilh ding ua; siang leh siang lou akhentuamsak ding uhi.

Thubuaite leng angaihtuah ding uh ahi; ka ngaihtuah bang zel in angaihtuah ding uh; ka ankuanglui sehsa tengteng ah ka dante leh ka dan thuseh bawlsate azuih ding uh ahi; ka Sabbathte leng atan ding uh ahi.
Amau kihihbuah ding in misi luang anaih ding uh ahi kei; himahleh nu hiam, pa hiam, tanu hiam, tapa hiam unaupa hiam sanggamnu pasal nei lou hiam a ding in bel akihihbuah thei ding uh.
Huan akisiansak nung in amah a ding in ni sagih simsak nawn ding ahi.
Huang sungnungzaw mun siangthou a nasem ding a alut ni in khelh ziak a kithoihna amah a ding in alan ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Goutan bangmah anei kei ding ua; agoutan uh kei ka hi ding. Israel ah tan bangmah na pe ding uh ahi kei, atan uh keimah ka hi.
Nek ding latte, khelh ziak a thillatte, moh ziak a thillatte ane ding ua; Israel lak a thil latsa peuhmah amau a ding ahi.

Gah masate lak a ahoihpente, na thillat chiteng ua ahoihpen, na thillat tengteng ua siampute a ding ahi; na inn ua vualzawlna atamdet theihna ding in tangbuang meklom hoihpen siampu kiang ah na pe ding uh ahi.
Siampute'n sapul anek louh ding uh ahi. Vasa hiam gamsa bohzan hiam, amah sih a si hiam anek ding uh ahi kei hi.

Huai lou in leng goutan ding a gam na hawm hun chiang un gamseh siangthou, TOUPA kiang ah thilpiak na bawl ding uhi. Adunglam tong singnih-le-sangnga, availam tong singnih, apum in gam siangthou ahi ding hi.
Hiai ah mun siangthou a ding in adung leh avai tong zanga tuaktuak, kimvel ahi ding a, akimvel in tong zanga a za mun awng a-om ding ahi.
Huan hiai tehsa a kipan in adung tong singnih-le-sangnga leh avai tong singkhat na tehkhe ding a, huai ah Mun Siangthoupen a-om ding ahi.
Gamseh siangthou bel, mun siangthou a nasemmi, a-nna sem ding a TOUPA hong naih siampute a ding ahi ding a, a-inn mun ding un leh mun siangthou ding in gam siangthou ahi ding hi.
Mun dang adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singkhat, Levi chi tempul a nasem mite tuam ding in, atenna khopi ding in a-om ding ahi.
Gamseh siangthou latsa zul ah khopi tan avai tong zanga leh adung tong singnih-le-sangnga na sep ding uhi, Israel inkote pumpi a ding ahi ding.

Huan kumpi tapa tan bel gam siangthou latsa leh khopi tan malam ah tumlam a tumlam nga in, suahlam a suahlam nga in a-om ding ahi. Adung bel tumlam gamgi a kipan a suahlam gamgi pha in, gamseh dang tan mah ahi.
Huai bel Israel gam a amah tantuam ahi ding ahi; ka vaihawmte'n ka mite anuaisiah nawn kei ding ua, Israel inkote anam tuamdan bang zel un gam ape zaw ding uhi.

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, Israel vaihawmte aw, hunta hen, hiamgamna leh kigapna tawpsanta unla; diktattak a vaihawm leh diktak a hih chingta unla, ka mite delhkhiak nak pen tawpsanta un, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Bukna dik, ephah dik leh bath dik na zat ding uh ahi.
Ephah leh bath akikim ding uh ahi, bath homer seh sawm a khen seh khat ahi ding a, ephah leng homer seh sawm a khen seh khat ahi sam ding; homer a kipan a tehkhiak ding ahi ding.
Huan shekel bel gerah sawmnih ahi ding a; shekel sawmnih toh shekel sawmnih-le-nga toh shekel sawm-le-nga gawmkhawm na mina uh khat toh kikim ahi ding hi.
Huan hiai thillat na lat ding uh ahi ding; buh homer khat zel ah ephah seh guk a khen seh khat leh buh man homer khat zel ah ephah seh guk a khen seh khat na pe ding uhi.
Huan sathau latdan ding kor khat zel ah bath seh sawm a khen seh khat; kor bel bath sawm ahi.

Israel gantatna mun hoih a kipan belamhon lak a zanih zel ah anou khat, nek ding lat ding in, halmang kithoihna ding in lemna thillat ding in amaute hihsianna bawlna ding in alat ding uh ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Gam a mi tengteng in Israel vaihawmpa kiang ah hiai thillat ape ding uh.

Ankuang luina ah, kha thak ah, Sabbath ni ah, Israel ankuanglui ni sehsa tengteng ah halmang kithoihna, nek ding lat, dawn ding latte lan in angaihtuah ding a; khelh ziak a kithoihna, nek ding lat, halmang kithoihna, lemna thillat Israel inkote kisiansakna ding in ama'n atumsak ding ahi.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: “Kha khatna, huai kha ani khat ni in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei na la ding a, mun siangthou na siangsak ding ahi.
Huan siampu in khelh ziak a kithoihna sisan ala ding a, tempul kongpi biang leh maitam dohdan ning lite leh huang sungnungzaw pen kongpi baangka ah atat ding hi.
Huai kha ani sagih ni in hihkhak hiam theih louh ziak hiam a thil hihkhialmite a ding in leng huchi mah bang in na hih ding a, huchibang in tempul hihsianna na bawl ding hi.
"Akha khatna, huai kha ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang na lui ding ua; huan, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh.
Huai ni in vaihawmpa'n amah leh agam a mi tengteng a ding in, khelh ziak a kithoihna ding bawngtaltuai atum ding ahi.

Ankuanglui hun ni sagih sung teng in bawngtaltuai gensiatbei sagih leh belamtal sagih zel TOUPA a ding in halmang kithoihna ding in atum ding; huan khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in niteng in keltal khat toh.
Huan tanghou lat ding in bawngtal khat zel ah ephah khat, belamtal khat zel ah ephah khat leh ephah khat zel ah sathau hin khat atum ding hi.

"Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawm leh ni nga ni a ankuangluina ah ni sagih sung huchibang mah in ahih ding a, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, halmang kithoihnate, tanghou latte leh sathau latte atum ding ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Huang sungnungzaw pen kongpi suahlam nga pen nasep ni, ni guk sung a kikhak ding a, Sabbath leh kha thak ni in akihong ding ahi.

Huan vaihawmpa bel kongpi sumtawng ah alut ding a, kongpi baangka chin ah adingh ding a, siampute'n ahalmang kithoih leh lemna thillatte abawlsak ding ua, lutna kongpi dantan ah Pathian abe ding; huchi in apawtkhe ding a, nitaklam tan kong khak louh ahih ding ahi.
Huan vantang in bel Sabbath leh kha thakte ah kongpi lutna chinte ah TOUPA ma ah Pathian abe ding uhi.
Sabbath ni in vaihawmpa'n TOUPA kiang a halmang kithoihna a lat ding bel belamnou gensiatbei guk leh belamtal gensiatbei khat ahi ding.
Belamtal khat zel ah tanghou lat ephah khat, belamnou pen ah bel apiak theih bangbang leh ephah khat ah sathau hin khat zel ahi ding hi.
Kha thak ni in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei khat, belamnou guk leh belamtal khat ahi ding a, gensiatbei ahih vek ding uh ahi.
Huan tanghou lat abawl ding a, bawngtaltuai ah ephah khat, belamtal ah ephah khat, belamnou pen ah atheih bangbang leh ephah khat zel ah sathau hin khat ahi ding hi.
Vaihawmpa alut chiang in kongpi sumtawng ah alut ding a, huai mah ah apawtkhe nawn ding hi.

Vantangte bel ankuanglui ni sehsa a TOUPA ma a ahong pai uleh Pathian be ding a mallam kongpi a hong lut simlam kongpi ah apawtkhe ding ua; simlam kongpi a hong lut mallam kongpi ah apawtkhe leuleu ding uh; alutna kongpi uah akik ding uh ahi kei a, amalam uah apai zaw ding uh ahi.
Huan alut chiang un alak uah vaihawmpa alut ding a, apawt chiang un apawtkhe nawn ding hi.
Nopbawlna leh sehsa ankuanglui nite, tanghou lat bawngtaltuai khat ah ephah khat, belamtal khat ah ephah khat, belamnou pen ah apiak theih bangbang, ephah khat ah sathau hin khat zel ahi ding hi.

Huan vaihawmpa'n ut thu a thillat alat dekleh halmang kithoihna hiam lemna thillat hiam TOUPA kiang a ut thu a athillat bang a alat dekleh suahlam nga kong ahonsak ding a, Sabbath ni a hih bangmah in, halmang kithoihnate leh lemna thillatte abawl ding; huchi in apawtkhe ding a, apawtkhiak nung in kong akhak ding uhi.
"Niteng a TOUPA kiang a halmang kithoihna ding in belamnou kum khat a upa, gensiatbei na zang ding a, zingsang in na zat ding ahi.

Zingsang teng in tanghou lat na bawl ding a, ephah seh guk a khen seh khat leh sathau hin khat seh thum a khen seh khat tangbuang nel mahmah anomsakna ding; huai tuh tangtawn a TOUPA kiang a tanghou latdan ding ahi.
Hichibang in halmang thillat gige ding in belamnou, tanghou latte, sathaute zingsang teng in na bawl ding ahi," chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Vaihawmpa'n atapate, kua kiang ah leng, goutan bangpeuh apiakleh atapate a ahi ding a, agou uh luah ahi mai hi.
Himahleh agoutan a pen anasemmi kuahiam kiang a apiakleh sal pawtna kum tan in anei ding a, huai ah vaihawmpa kiang ah apekik nawn ding hi. Amah gou ngeingei bel atapate a ding ahi ding.

Huai lou in vaihawmpa in mite goutan asuhsak ding ahi kei a, aneih-le-lam ua kipan adelhkhe ding ahi sam kei; amah a pen mah atapate kiang ah goutan in ape ding a; amau neih-le-lam a kipan mite avakzaklouhna ding un," achi hi.
Huan kongpi pang a siampute a dia dantan siangthou mallam nga ah ahon pilut a; ngai dih, aphaitam tumlam pang ah mun ana om hi.

Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai siampute'n moh ziak a thillat leh khelh ziak a thillat ahuanna mun uh, tanghou lat omna mun ahi; huangsung ponungzaw a atawikhiak ua mite hihsianna dia abawllouhna ding un," achi hi.
Huang ponungzaw ah ahon pikhia a, huangsung ningzul ah ahon paisak a; ngai dih, ahuangsung ning chiat ah huang ana om nawn hi.
Huangsung ning li ah huang, bang nei, adung tong sawmli, avai tong sawmthum ana om a; huai aning ate ali un akikim vek uhi.
Huai mun li sunglam ah akimvel in suang vual in alem ua, huai vual nuai ah akim in huanna ding thuk a-om hi.
Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Hiai an huanna innte ahi, tempul nasem mite'n mite kithoihna sa ahuanna dingte uh," achi hi.

Huchi in tempul kongkhak ah ahon pikik a; ngai dih, tempul kongpi chin nuai a kipan, suahlam nga in tui ahong luangkhia a; tempul suahlam nga ahi a, huan tui maitam simlam tempul pang taklam nuai a kipan in ahong luangkhia hi.
Huan mallam nga kongpi tawn in ahon pikhia a, inpua ah suahlam nga pawtkhiakna lampi ponungzaw tawn in ahon pi a; ngai dih, taklam pang ah tui ahong luangkhia hi.
Huan huai mi'n tehna khau tawi kawm a suahlam nga a pai in tong sangkhat ateh a; tui ahon ngap galkahsak a, siakmit tan ahi.
Huchi in tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; tui ahon ngap galkahsak nawn a, khuk tan ahi. Huan tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; hon ngap galkahsak nawn a, tui kawng tan ahi.
Huan tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; ngah galkah vual louh luipi ahong hita a; tui ahong sang zel a, angah a ngah galkah vual louh, aleuh a leuh tham luipi ahong hita hi.
Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai na mu hia?" achi hi. Huan lui gei a kik nawn ding in ahon pikikta hi.
Huchi in ka kik a, ngai dih, lui gei tawn in, lui gei lang tuak in sing tampi ana om hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai suahlam gam lam a tui luang Arabah gam a luanglut ding ahi; tuipi ah aluanglut ding a, tuipi tui al tui siangthou asuaksak ding.

Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; luite aluanna peuh uah ganhing chiteng in ahinloh ding ua, ngasate a-om huthut ding uh; tuipi tui asianthouna ding leh aluanna peuh a ganhingte'n ahinlohna ding ua hiai lui hong luang ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; agei ah ngaman mite adingh ding ua; Engedi a kipan Eneglaim pha in lenpaihna mun ahi ding; angasa pen achi bang zel un, tuipi lian ngasa bang mai in atam mahmah ding uh.
Buannawi leh chiklakte bel asiangthou kei ding ua, chikhuk ding a nutsiat ahi ding hi.

Alui gei ah agei langnih in theikung chi chih apou ding a, huaite anah avuai ngei kei in agah lou ngei sam kei ding, mun siangthou a kipan a lui hong luangkhia a vak ahih ziak in kha teng in agah ding; agah nek ding ahi ding a, anah bel hihdamna ding ahi ding," achi hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Hiai Israel nam sawm-le-nih lak a gam kihawmdan ding ahi hi; Joseph in tan nih atang ding.
Kibang chiat in na tang ding uh ahi; na pipute uh kiang a piak ding a ka kichiamsa ahi; hiai gam na gam tan un apuk ding ahi.
Hiai a gam pumpi gi ding ahi; mallam ah Tuipi Lian a kipan Hethlon a paisuak in Hamath lutna phaizang ah Zedad atung a;
Berothah, Damaskas leh Hamath kigitna lai a om Sibraim, Hauran gamgi zul a om Hazor-hattikon pha in.
Huchi in gamgi bel Tuipi Lian a kipan in Damaskas gamgi zul a Hazar-enan pha in ahi ding a; mallam ah Hamath gamgi ahi ding hi. Hiai mallam gamgi ahi.
Huan suahlam ah Hauran leh Damaskas kikal ah Gilead leh Israel gam kikal a Jordan luidung azui ding; mallam gamgi a kipan in suahlam tuipi ah Tamar apha ding. Hiai suahlam gamgi ahi ding hi.
Simlam ah Tamar a kipan in Meibothkadesh tuite pha in Aigupta lui zui in Tuipi Lian atung ding. Hiai simlam gamgi ding ahi.
Tumlam ah Tuipi Lian in agi ding a, simlam gamgi a kipan in Hamath lutna phaizang zawn pha in. Hiai tumlam gamgi ahi ding hi.
Huchi in hiai gam Israel nam dungzui in na lak uah na hawm ding uh.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, na gam tan ding uleh na lak ua namdang teng, zi leh ta neisate gam tan ding bel na hop ding uh ahi. Amau lah Israel ta ding a piang mawng ahi ding uh ahi; Israel namte lak ah noute bang in tan aneih ding uh ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; kua nam lak ah leng namdang ana teng taleh, huai lai a agam tan ding na sehsak ding uh ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.

Hiaite anam minte uh ahi: Mallam gamgi Tuipi Lian a kipan a Hethlon paisuak in Hamath lutna phaizang ah Damaskas gamgi a Hamath kiang mallam pang Hazar-enan pha in, suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Dante tan ahi.
Dante tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Asherte tan ahi.
Asherte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Naphtalite tan ahi.
Naphtalite tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Manassehte tan ahi.
Manassehte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Ephraimte tan ahi.
Ephraimte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Reubente tan ahi.
Reubente tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Judahte tan ahi.
Judahte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah, thilpiak na lat ding uh avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding a; adung suahlam leh tumlam sang ah tan dang bangmah in ahi a, alai a mun siangthou om in.
Thilpiak TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singnih ahi ding ahi.

Huan hiai ah siampute a ding in gam siangthou thilpiak ding ahi ding a; mallam ah adung tong singnih-le-sangnga leh tumlam ah avai tong singkhat leh suahlam ah avai tong singkhat, simlam ah adung tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding ahi. Alaizang ah TOUPA mun siangthou a-om ding hi.
Siampu siansaksa, Zadok tapate ka thu kem mite a ding ahi ding, amaute Israel suante avakmang lai ua Levi chite avakmang bang ua vakmangloute ahi uhi.
Huan gam thilpiak pumpi a kipan amau a dia piak tuam, mun siangthoupen ahi ding; Levi chi tan toh akigi in.
Siampu tan zulzul ah Levi chite'n tan anei ding ua, adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singkhat ahi ding hi.
Huan azuak ding uh ahi kei a, akhen ding uh leng ahi sam kei; agam hoihna tata leng midang kiang a piak ding ahi kei hi; TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ngal a.
Huan avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ban ah tong sangnga vantang tan, khopi dinna ding, tenna inn dingte leh khopuate a ding ahi ding; khopi bel alaizang a a-om ding ahi.
Huchi in ateh vialdan hichibang in ahi ding: Amallam pang tong sangli-le-zanga, asimlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga; asuahlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga, atumlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga.
Akhopi in khopua anei ding a; mallam pang in tong zanih-le-sawmnga; simlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga, suahlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga, tumlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga ahi.

Adunglam val lai, thilpiak siangthou zul a pen suahlam ah tong singkhat, tumlam ah tong singkhat ahi ding; thilpiak siangthousa zulzul ahi ding hi; huai a thilpawtte khopi a nasem mite nek ding ahi ding.
Huchi in khopi a nasemmi Israel nam tengteng a mite'n alei alet ding uhi.
Thilpiak pumpi adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding; thilpiak siangthousa, dung leh vai kikim khopi tan toh na lat ding uh ahi.

Aval thilpiaksa siangthou leh khopi tan pang lang tuaktuak vaihawmpa tan ahi ding a, suahlam sang ah thilpiak tong singnih-le-sangnga ban, gamseh dangte zulzul vaihawmpa tan ahi ding; huchi in thilpiak siangthousa leh tempul mun siangthou bel alaizang ah a-om ding.
Huan Levi chi tan leh khopi tan vaihawmpa tante kikal ah a-om ding a; vaihawmpa tan Judah tan leh Benjamin tan toh akigi ding.
Huan nam omlaite tungthu ah, suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Benjaminte tan ahi ding.
Benjaminte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam ah tan khat Simeonte tan ahi.
Simeonte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam Issakarte tan ahi.
Issakarte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam tan khat Zebulunte tan ahi.
Zebulunte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam tan khat Gadte tan ahi.
Gadte tan simlam pang gamgi Tarmar a kipan in Meribah-kadesh tuite tan in Aigupta lui zui in Tuipi Lian atung ding hi.
Hiai Israel namte goutan ding a gam kihawmdan ding leh agam sehtuamte ahi uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Huan hiaite khopi a kipan pawtnate ahi uh; mallam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum;
khopi kongpite Israel nam min bang zel a sak ding ahi a; mallam kongpi thumte, Reuben kongpi khat, Judah kongpi khat, Levi kongpi khat;
suahlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Joseph kongpi khat, Benjamin kongpi khat, Dan kongpi khat ahi ding hi.
Simlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Simeon kongpi khat, Issakar kongpi khat, Zebulun kongpi khat ahi ding.
Tumlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Gad kongpi khat, Asher kongpi khat, Naphtali kongpi khat ahi ding hi.
Akimvel in tong singkhat-le-sanggiat ahi ding a; huai ni a kipan in khopi min bel, "TOUPA omna mun" chih ahi ding hi.
"Huan nang mihing tapa, namsau hiam mahmah la inla, na lu leh na khamul metna ding in sammetmi tem zang in; huan bukna la inla, sam khen in.

Seh thum a khen seh khat sim a a-om sung nite abei hun chiang in khopi lai a mei ah na hal ding ahi; seh thum a khen seh khat nawn na la dia, akim ah namsau in na satnen ding ahi; huan, seh thum a khen seh khat nawn huih mutleng ding in na thehzak ding a, ke'n namsau in ka delhzui ding hi.
Huan tawmchik na la ding a, na puanaktual mong ah na tun ding hi.
Hiaite lak a tam lou na la ding a, mei ah na thehlut ding a, na hal ding ahi; huai a kipan in Israel inkote tengteng ah mei ahong pawt ding," achi hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hiai Jerusalem khua ahi, namte' laizang ah ka koih a, akim ah gamte a-om hi.
Namte sang a nakpi a gitlouhna hih zaw in ka thugel tung ah ahel a, akim a gamte sang a thupizaw in ka dan bawl tung ah ahel uhi. Ka thugelte apaikhia ua, ka dan bawlte bang in a-om kei uhi."

Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na kim a namte sang a buai hatzaw in na om a, ka dan thusehte bawl bang in na om kei a, ka thukhennate leng na zui kei ua, namte a dia ka thukhendan a na hih louh ziak un, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
Ngai un, kei, kei nangawn in leng ka hon nang ahi, namte mitmuh ngei in na lak uah vaihawmna ka tangtungsak ding hi.
Na kihhuaina tengteng uh ziak in thil ka hih ngei nai louh, hih leng ka hih ngei nawn louh ding na tung uah ka hih ding hi.
Huchi in pate'n na sung ah atate uh ane ding ua, tate'n leng apate uh ane ding uh; nang a mikhosuaksun tengteng ka dalhsak vek ding."

Huchi in hiai Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi: "Na nitna leh na kihhuainate a ka mun siangthou na hihnit ziak in, kei ka hin bang in, ka hon kiamsak ding a, ka mit in ahon maih het kei ding a, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding hi.
Seh thum a khen seh khat hipi in hiam, kial in hiam na lak uah asi ding uh; seh thum a khen seh khat nawn ka hihdalh ding a, namsau in ka delhzui ding hi."

Hichibang in ka hehna ka tangtungsak ding a, atung uah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a, ka om anuamta ding hi; kei TOUPA'N atung ua ka hehna ka lungdamsak hun chiang in phatuamngaitak in ka genta chih atheikhe ding uh.
Huai lou in, na kim a namte lak ah leh vialvak tengtengte mitmuh in kho segawp leh simmohhuai in ka hon bawl ding hi.
Huchi in thangpai leh heh mahmah a, nakpi a taihilh a, na tung a thugelte ka tunsak hun in na kim a namte mitmuh in nuihsan leh kouna leh hilhna leh mulkimhuai na hi ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita hi.
Atung uah kialna thaltang hoih loutak manna ding, noumau manna ding ka hon kesak ding; na tung uah kialna ka uangsak ding a, na an uh, hinna bul ka hihse ding hi.

Huchi in na tung uah kialna leh gamsa hangte ka hon sawl ding a, ta leh nau tan in ahon laksak ding uh; hipi leh sisan suahna na lak uah aleng ding a; na tung uah namsau ka hon sawl ding, kei TOUPA'N ka chita hi, chi in.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
"Mihing tapa, Israel tang lam nga inla, akiang uah thu gen inla,

Israel tangte aw, Toupa PATHIAN thu ngaikhia un; Toupa PATHIAN in tangte leh mualte kiang ah, leh phaizangte leh kuamte kiang ah hichi in achi: Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in na tung uah namsau ka hon lik ding a, na mun sangte uh ka hihse vek ding.
Na maitamte uh loihsan in a-om ding a, na ni pathian limte uh akitamzan ding; na mithah luangte uh na milimte uh ma ah ka pai ding hi.
Amilimte uh ma ah Israel suante luang ka koihkhawm ding a, na guhte uh na maitam kim uah ka thehzak ding hi.

Na tenna mun tengteng uah khopi ase ding a, mun sangte akisegawp ding; na maitamte uh hihsiat leh loihsan ahihtheihna ding un leh na milimte uh akitapnen a, aman theihna ding in leh na ni pathian limte uh phukpaih a a-omtheihna ding un, na nasepte uh aman theihna ding in.
Huan na lak uah mithahte apuk ding ua, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
"Himahleh gam chih a na dalhzak hun chiang un namte lak ah namsau a suakta a-om ding ziak un akhen ka hon hawi ding.

Huan na lak ua kipan a pawtte'n sal a apina namte uh lak ah kei ahon theigige ding ua, a-angkawmna lungtang uh ka lakmang sakleh amit uh, amilim lam ua angkawmte ka hihsiat sakdante athei ding uh; thil gilou a na hih ziak uleh akihhuai ziak un amau mitmuh ngei in leng kihhuai akisa ding uh.
Huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding ua, hiai thil hoih lou akiang uah ka hih ding a, amawk in ka chi kei chih athei ding uh, chi in," achi hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na khut beng in na khe pek inla, Maizen! Israel inkote kihhuaina gitlouh ziak maw! Namsau in, kial in, hipi in apuk ding uhi.
Gamlapi a om hipi in asi ding ua, anai a om namsau in apuk ding ua, aval, um a omte kial in asi ding uh; hichibang in ka hehna mahmah atung uah ka bukimsak ding hi.

Mual sang teng ah, tang vumte ah leh sing hing peuhmah nuai ah leh tosaw bawkpha chih nuai a amilimte uh kiang a gimlim alatna mun ua amaitam kim ua amilimte uh lak a amisi luangte uh a-om hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
Atung uah ka khut ka lik ding a, gamdai a kipan Diblah lam a atenna mun tengteng uh gamsia suaksak in ka loihsan vek ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
"Nang mihing tapa, Toupa PATHIAN in Israel gam kiang ah hichi in achi: Tawpna, tawpna gam ning li ah ahong tung hi.
"Tu nang a ding in tawpna ahi, na tung ah ka hehna ka hon tungsak ding a, na omdan bang zel in vai ka hon hawmsak ding a, na kihhuaina tengteng na tung ah ka hon tun ding hi.
Ka mit in ahon maih kei dia, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding hi; na omdan bang in na tung ah ka hon tun zaw ding a, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh."
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Siatna, siatgawpna mah, ngai dih, ahong tung hi.
Tawpna ahong tung hi, tawpna ahong tung hi, na tung ah ahong thouta, ngai in, ahong tung hi.
Aw gam luahpa, na siatna ding na tung ah ahong tung hi, hun ahong tung hi, ni anaita hi; buaina, kipak a tang tung a kikouna ni hilou.
"Tu in ka hehna na tung ah ka hon buakzok ding hi, na tung ah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a; na omdan bang zel in ka hon vai hawmsak ding hi; na kihhuaina tengteng na tung ah ka hon tun ding hi.

Huan ka mit in ahon maih kei dia, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding; na omdan bang zel in na tung ah ka hon tun ding a, na kihhuaina leng na lak uah a-om ding; huchi in kei TOUPA gawt theipa ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
"Ngai in, ani, ngai in, ahong tung hi, na siatna ding apawtta, satna chiang apakta, kisaktheihna apakmumta hi.
Hiamgamna gitlouhna chiang asuakta ahi; kua mahmah a-omta kei ding a, ahusa uhiam, ahauhsakna uhiam leng; kuamah in a-it sam kei ding uh.
"Hun ahong tungta, ani ahong naita; aleimi kipak kei henla, akhawngmi leng dah kei hen; thangpaihna avek ua tung ah a-omta hi.
Azuakmi in, dam lai mahleh, athil zuak amu nawn kei ding; muhkholhna zaw avek ua tungthu ahi a, kuamah akik kei ding uh, kuamah ahinna thulimlouhna uah akhosa suak sam kei ding uh.
Pengkul amut ua, bangkim akimanta; himahleh kidouna ah kuamah ahoh kei uh; avek ua tung a ka hehna a-om ziak in.
"Inpua ah namsau, asung ah hipi leh kial; gam a om namsau in asi ding ua, khopi a om kial leh hipi in ane khin ding hi.
Himahleh ataikhete, apawt ding ua, tangte ah phaizang gam vakhu bang in; avek un, lungzuangtak in amau thulimlouhna chiat ah a-om ding uh.
Khut tengteng azaw ding a, khuk tengteng tui bang in anem ding.
Sai-ip puan ateng ding ua, mulkimna in amau atuam ding a, mel chiteng ah zumna alang ding a, alutang tengteng uh agiau khin ding hi.
Adangkasik uh leh adangka-engte un TOUPA heh ni chiang in ahunkhe thei kei ding a, ahinna uh ataisak kei ding a, agil uh avahsak sam kei ding; athulimlouhna uh pukna ahih khit tak ziak in.
Akizepna kilawmna uh akisaktheihpih ua, akihhuaina milim un leh anitna thil un asuaksak zaw lel uhi; huaiziak in amau a ding in thilkihhuai ding in ka na bawlta hi.
"Huan gallak ding in namdang khut ah ka pe dia, lei a migiloute kiang ah gallak ding in ka pe ding a, amau ana hihnin ding uh.
Amaute ka nungngatsan ding a, ka mun siang ahihnin ding uh; huan guta ahong lut dia, ahihnin ding uh.
"Gamsung lah sisan suah hat vaihawmna a dim a, hiamgamna a khopi adim ziak in khainiang bawl un.
Huchi in namdang giloupente ka hon pilut ding a a-innte uh aneihsak ding ua; ahatna otpih uh ka hihtawp ding a, amun siangte uh hihnit in a-om ding hi.
Lungzinna ahong tung a, muanna azong ua, a-om het kei hi.
Siatna tung ah siatsemna, thuthang tung ah thuthang ahong om ding a, zawlnei lak ah kilakna azong ding ua, himahleh dante siampu lak ah amang ding a, upate lak ah thudot a-om kei ding hi.

Kumpipa adah ding a, kumpi tapa lungdonna puansilh in akivan ding a, vantang khut leng aling ding. Akiang uah a-omdan bang un ka hih ding a, athilhih bang zel un vai ka hawmsak ding; huan TOUPA ka hi chih atheita ding uh," achi hi.
Akum gukna, akha gukna, huai kha ani nga ni in hichi ahong hi a, ka inn a ka tut a, Judah upate ka ma a atut lai un Toupa PATHIAN khut ka tung ah ahong om hi.
Huchi in ka en a, ngai in, mi meikuang bang a kimu ahong om a; akawng chiang nuailam hi dia kilawm meikuang bang ahi a; akawng chiang tunglam bel sik hal-ap bang a vaktak ahi.

Huchi in khut melput ahon sawkkhia a, ka talsam a hon man in, kha in lei leh van kikal ah ahon domkang a, Pathian kilakna in Jerusalem ah ahon pi hi, Jerusalem mallam huang sungnung kongpi khakna kiang ahon tun a, huai ah mullitna lim tutna mun a-om a, huai in amullitsak hi.
Huan ngai in, phaizang a ka muh bang mah in huai ah Israel' Pathian thupina a-om hi.
Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, mallam nga in na mitsuan dih ve leh," achi hi. Huchi in mallam nga in ka mit ka suan a, ngai in, maitam kongpi mallam lutna ah hiai mullitna lim ana om hi.

Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, athilhih uh na mu hia? Israel inkote'n thilkihhuai mahmah, hiai a ahih ngei uh, ka inn siangthou a kipan a gamla a ka paimangna ding a ahih uh? Himahleh thil dang kihhuaizaw na mu nawn lai ding," achi hi.
Huan huangsung lutna ah ahon pi a; ka en a, baang ah vang ana om hi.
Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, huai baang hon khuak dih," achi hi. Ka khuakleh kongkhak ana om hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Lut inla, hiai a khelhna kihhuaitak ahih uh en dih," achi hi.
Huchi in ka lut a, ka mu a, ngai in, thil hing chi chih limte, gamsa kihhuai limte, Israel inkote milim tengteng baang ah akimvel in ana tuang hi.
Huan ama uah Israel inkuan, upate lak a mi sawmsagihte adingh ua, alaitak uah Sephan tapa Jaazaniah adingh a, michih in belhbu atawi chiat ua; huan gimlim khu gim azamtou ngoingoi hi.
Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, Israel inkuan upate mial nuai a thilhih na mu hia? Michih in milim dantan a ahih uh? TOUPA'N ahon mu kei a, TOUPA'N gam apaisanta aka," achi uhi.
Ka kiang ah, "Athilhih uh kihhuai sem dang leng na mu nawn lai ding," achi lai hi.
Huchi in TOUPA' inn mallam panglutna kongkhak ah ahon pi a, ngai dih, huai ah numeite Tammuz ngai in kap in atu uhi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Aw mihing tapa, hiai na mu hia? Hiai sang a kihhuaizaw sem na mu nawn lai ding," achi hi.

Huan TOUPA' inn um sungnungzaw ah ahon pilut a, ngai in, TOUPA tempul lutna ah inliim leh maitam kikal ah mi sawmnih-le-nga, TOUPA tempul lam anungngat a, amaite uh suahlam nga in ana om ua, suahlam ah ni ana bia uhi.

Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai na mu hia, aw mihing tapa, athilkihhuai hih uh, hiai ahih uh Judah inkote a ding in thil neutham ahi hia? Gam hiamgamna in ahihdim ua, hon hehsak nawn sem ua, anak uah singhiang abat uhi.
Huaiziak in ke'n leng hehtak in ka hih ding a; ka mit in amaih kei dia, ka hehpih sam kei ding: aw ngaihtak in ka bil ah hong kikou mah le uh ka ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in bil a ka zak in, "Khopi kem mite michih hihmanna van tawi in hong nai uhen," chi in ngaihtak in akikou hi.

Huan ngai in, mallam kongpi tungnung paina a kipan in mi guk ahong pai ua, michih in hihlupna van atawi chiat ua; alai ua mi khat puanmalngat silh in laituibuk akuah hi. Alut ua, dal maitam kiang ah adingh uhi.
Huan Israel' Pathian thupina a omna cherub a kipan in huai inn kongpi kiang ah apaitou a; puanmalngat silh, laituibuk kuahpa asam hi.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Khopi sung tawnsuak inla, Jerusalem tawnsuak in; asung a thilkihhuai hihsate ziak atunggik a kapte atal uah chiamteh in," achi hi.
Huan midangte kiang ah ka zak mahmah in, "Anung ah khopi tawnsuak unla, khut kha un, na mit un mumaih kei henla, hehpih sam kei un.
Putekte, tangvalte, nungakte, naupangte leh nute that siang vek un. Chiamtehna neite bel hon naih kei un; ka Mun Siangthou ah pan un," achi hi. Huchi in inn kong a upate ah apan uhi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Inn hihbuah unla, ahuangsungte mi luang in dimsak unla, pawt un," achi hi. Huan apawtta ua, khopi ah agamtangta uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, khopi ah agamtat lai un kei bel nutsiat in ka na om a, akhup in ka puk hi. "Ah! Toupa PATHIAN, Jerusalem tung a na hehna na sunbuak ah Israel khosuaksunte leng hihman vek sawm na hi hiam?" chi in ka kikou hi.

Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Israel leh Judah inkote thulimlouhna athupi tel a ahi. 'Sisan in gamsung adim a; khopi vaihawmna kaihkawi in a-om a, TOUPA'N gam apaisanta a, TOUPA'N bangmah amu kei!' achi hi.
Kei toh kisai in leng, ka mit in amau ka mumaih kei ding a, ka hehpih sam kei ding hi; agitlouhna uh avekpi in amau ka khusak ding," achi hi.
Huchi in ngai in, puanmalngat silh a laituibuk kuahpa'n thu atun a, "N'on thupiak bang in ka hih khinta," achi hi.

Persia kumpipa Kura kum khatna ah, Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thu hihtangtun ahihtheihna ding in, TOUPA'N Persia kumpipa Kura kha atokthou a, huchi in agamsung teng ah thupuan abawl a, agelhthoh in leng akoih hi.
Hichibang in Persia kumpipa Kura in achi, “TOUPA, van Pathian in, Lei gam tengteng kei ahon peta hi; Judah a om Jerusalem a amah inn lamsak ding in kei thu ahon pia hi.
Amite tengteng na lak ua om peuhmah, akiang ah Pathian om henla, Judah a om Jerusalem ah hohtou henla, TOUPA Israel' Pathian, amah Pathian ahi, Jerusalem a om inn lam hen.

Kuapeuh akhualtamna koi mun peuh a nutsiat a omna mun a mite'n, amah dangka leh dangka-eng, vante leh gantate in panpih uhenla, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn a ding a ut thu a thillat chih louh," chi in.
Huchi in Judah leh Benjamin intekpate inkuan a lupente, siampute leh Levite, Pathian in Jerusalem a om TOUPA' inn lam dia hohtou dia akha uh atohthohte tengteng, athouta uhi.
Huan akimvel ua omte tengteng in akhut uh dangka tui-um belsuan dangka-engte, vante, gantate leh thil manphate in ahihhat ua, uttak a piakte tengteng sim louh in.
Kumpipa Kura in leng TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a kipan alakkhiak, pathiante inn a akoihte alakhe vek hi;
Huaite Persia kumpipa Kura in sumkempa Mithredath khut in alakhe vek a, Judah vaihawm, Sesbazzar pia in asimsak hi.
Huchi in hiai amuh zah uh ahi: dangka-eng kuang sawmthum, dangka kuang sangkhat, gimlim halna kuang sawmnih-le-kua;
Dangka-eng noubem sawmthum, dangka noubem ahoih lou deuhte zali-le-sawmkhat leh tui-um belsuan dangte sangkhat.
Dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan tengteng sangnga-le-zali ahi uh. Saltangte lak ate Babulon a kipan Jerusalem a pitouh a a-om lai un, hiai tengteng Sesbazzar in atawitou vek hi.

Huchi a Ezra kap a Pathian inn mai a lei kidenna a nei in, athum a, thupha atawi lai in, Israel a kipan pasal leh numei leh naupang tampi kikhawmte akiang ah hong kikaikhawm ua: mite lah anak kah mahmah ngal ua.

Elam tapate lak a khat, Jehiel tapa Shekaniah in adawng a Ezra kiang ah, "I Pathian tung ah i talekta ua, gammi numei namdangte i kitenpihta uh: Himahleh hiai thil thu ah Israel a ding in lametna a-om lai hi.

Huaiziak in tu in zite tengteng leh amau a kipan a huchibang a piangte, ka toupa thuhilh dungzui in leh i Pathian uh thupiak a lau a lingte thuhilh dungzui in, koihmang ding in i Pathian toh thu i khung ding uh; huan dan dungzui a hih hi hen.
Thou in, athu lah nang a ahi ngal a, kou leng na kiang ah ka om ding uh; hangsantak in om inla, hih in,” achi hi.
Huchi in Ezra athou a, hiai thu dungzui a ahih ding un, siampute leh Levi mite lak a amakai lianpente leh Israel tengteng akichiamsak hi. Huchi in akichiamta uhi.
Pathian inn mai a kipan Ezra athoukhia a, Eliashib tapa Jehohanan dantan sung ah alut a: huai lai a ahong pai lai in, tanghou ane kei a, tui lah adawn kei hi; saltanna a tatlekna ziak in asuun hi.
Judah leh Jerusalem teng a saltanna tate tengteng kiang ah Jerusalem a kikaikhawm vek ding in thu apuangkhia ua;
kuapeuh ni thum sung a hong pai lou, vaihawmte leh upate thu bang zel in, avan tengteng laksak ahi ding a, amah mah saltanna omkhawmte a kipan a tuamkoih ahi ding hi.

Huchih lai in Judah leh Benjamin mi tengteng Jerusalem ah ni thum sung in akikaikhawm ua; hiai akha kuana, akha ni sawmnih ni ahi. Huchi in mi tengteng Pathian inn kongtual a mun awng ah atu ua, hiai thu leh vuahpi ziak in aling uhi.
Huchi in siampu Ezra adingh a, akiang uah, "Na talek ua, Israel mohna khangsak ding in, numei nam dangte na kitenpih uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in na pipute uh Pathian, TOUPA kiang ah thupha tawi unla, akipah lam hih un; gam a mite a kipan, numei namdangte a kipan kituamseh un," achi hi.
Huchi in kikhawmte tengteng in adawng ua, aw ngaihtak in, "Ka tungtang uh na gen bang in, huchibang in ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
Himahleh mite tampi ahi ua, vuah tampi zuk lai ahi a, huchi in inkuan ah ka dingh thei kei ua, hiai lah ni khat hiam nasep ahi kei; hiai thu ah lah nakpitak in i talekta ngal ua.

Tu in omkhawmte a ding in i vaihawmte ding seh in om henla, i Pathian uh thangpaihna ei a kipan a akihei a, hiai thu hihbei ahih masiah, numei lamdangte kitenpihte i khopite a omte hun sehsate ah, khopi chiteng a upate amau toh, huai lai a vaihawmte toh, hong pai uhen.
Asahel tapa Jonathan leh Tikvah tapa Jahaziah kia in hiai thu asel uh: huan Meshullam leh Levi mi Shabbethai in amaute apanpih uhi.

Huchibang in saltanna a kipan kik nawnte'n ahihta uhi. Siampu Ezra, apipute uh inkote dungzui a, pipute inkuan lak a vaihawm makai kuate hiam toh leh aminte ua amaute tengteng, tuam sehkhiak in a-om ua; huchi in athu entel ding in akha sawmna ani khat ni in atuta uhi.
Huchi in akha khatna ani khat ni in numei namdang kitenpih mite ahih khin uhi.
Huchi in siampute tapate lak ah numei namdang kitenpih muh in a-om a: huaite, Jeshua tapate, Jozadak tapa leh a-unaute, Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib leh Gedaliahte.
Huchi in azite uh koihmang ding in pha asa ua; amoh ziak un, amohna a ding in belamhon lak a belamtal alan uhi.
Immer tapate lak ah: Hanani leh Zebadiah.
Harim tapate lak ah: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel leh Uzziah.
Pashur tapate lak ah: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad leh Elasah.
Levi mite lak ah: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, huai mah Kelita ahi, Pethahiah, Judah leh Eliezer.
Lasa mite lak ah: Eliashib: huan kongkhak ngak mite lak ah; Shallum, Telem leh Uri.
Israel lak ah: Parosh tapate lak ah; Ramiah, Jeziah, Malkijah Mijamin, Eleazar leh Malkijah leh Benaiah.
Elam tapate lak ah: Mattaniah, Zekariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth leh Eliah.
Zattu tapate lak ah: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad leh Aziza.
Bebai tapate lak ah; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
Bani tapate lak ah: Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal leh Ramoth.
Huan Pahath-moab tapate lak ah: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui leh Manasseh.
Harim tapate lak ah: Eliezer, Isshiah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Simeon,
Benjamin, Malluk leh Semariah.
Hashum tapate lak ah: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
Bani tapate lak ah: Maadai, Amram leh Uel;
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Kelluh,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib;
Mattaniah, Mattenai leh Jaasau;
Bani, Binnui, Shimei;
Shelemiah leh Nathan leh Adaiah,
Maknadebai, Shasai, Sharai;
Azarel leh Shelemiah, Shemariah;
Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
Nebo tapate lak ah: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel leh Benaiah.
Hiai tengtengte'n namdang zite api ua: huchi in alak ua khenkhatte'n hiai zite a kipan tate anei uhi.
Hiaite pimang a om koltanna a kipan a paitou, bial a tate, Babulon lam a akumpipa Nebukad-nezzar in apimang, Jerusalem leh Judah a, michih ama khua chiat a hong kik nawnte ahi uh.
Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah toh hong tonte, Israel mite lak a pasal phazah:
Parosh suante sangnih zakhat sawmsagih-le-nih.
Shephatiah suante, zathum sawmsagih-le-nih.
Arah suante, zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga.
Pahath-moab suante, Jeshua leh Joab tate, sangnih zagiat leh sawm-le-nih.
Elam suante, sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
Zattu suante, zakua sawmli-le-nga.
Zakkai suante, zasagih-le-sawmguk.
Bani suante, zaguk sawmli-le-nih.
Bebai suante, zaguk sawmnih-le-thum.
Azgad suante, sangkhat zanih sawmnih-le-nih.
Adonikam suante, zaguk sawmguk-le-guk.
Bigvai suante, sangnih sawmnga-le-guk.
Adin suante, zali sawmnga-le-li.
Ater suante, Hezekiah tate, sawmkua-le-giat.
Bezai suante, zathum sawmnih-le-thum.
Jorah suante, zakhat leh sawm-le-nih.
Hashum suante, zanih sawmnih-le-thum.
Gibbar suante, sawmkua-le-nga.
Bethlehem suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-thum.
Netophah mite, sawmnga-le-guk.
Anathoth mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
Azmaveth suante, sawmli-le-nih.
Kiriath-arim, Kephirah leh Beeroth suante, zasagih sawmli-le-thum.
Ramah leh Geba tate, zaguk sawmnih-le-khat.
Mikmas mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-nih.
Bethel leh Ai mite, zanih sawmnih-le-thum.
Nebo suante, sawmnga-le-guk.
Magbish suante, zakhat sawmnga-le-guk.
Elam dang suante, sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
Harim suante, zathum-le-sawmnih.
Lod, Hadid leh Ono tate, zasagih sawmnih-le-nga.
Jeriko suante, zathum sawmli-le-nga.
Senaah suante, sangthum leh zaguk-le-sawmthum.
Siampute: Jedaiah suante, Jeshua inkote, zakua sawmsagih-le-thum.
Immer suante, sangkhat sawmnga-le-nih.
Pashur suante, sangkhat zanih sawmli-le-sagih.
Harim suante, sangkhat leh sawm-le-sagih.
Levi mite: Jeshua leh Kadmiel suante, Hodaviah suante, sawmsagih-le-li.
Lasa mite: Asaph suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
Kongkhak ngak mite: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai suante, avek un zakhat sawmthum-le-kua.
Nethinim mite: Ziha, Hasupha leh Tabbaoth suante;
Keros, Siaha leh Padon suante;
Lebanah, Hagabah leh Akkub suante;
Hagab, Shalmai leh Hanan suante;
Giddel, Gahar leh Reaiah suante;
Rezin, Nekoda leh Gazzam suante;
Uzza, Paseah leh Besai suante;
Ashna, Meunim leh Nephusim suante;
Bakbuk, Hakupha leh Harhur suante;
Bazluth, Mehida leh Harsha suante;
Barkos, Sisera leh Thamah suante;
Neziah leh Hatipha suante,
Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai, Hassopheret leh Peruda suante;
Jaalah, Darkon leh Giddel suante;
Shephatiah, Hattil, Zebaim mi Pokereth leh Ami suante.
Nethinim mite teng, Solomon sikhate tate, zathum sawmkua-le-nih.
Huchi in hiaite Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan leh Immer a kipan a paitoute ahi uh: himahleh apipute inkote, asuan uh, Israel a kipan ahi uhia chih ataklang thei kei uh:
Delaiah, Tobiah leh Nekoda suante, zaguk sawmnga-le-nih.
Huan siampute suante: Habaiah, Hakkoz leh Barzillai Gilead mi Barzillai tanute a kipan azi kitenpihpa suante, amau min zui a sak in a-om hi.
Hiai khangthu sutna a sim mite lak a min gelhna azong ua, himahleh amu kei uh. Huaiziak in buah a sim in a-om ua siamputna a kipan dangkoih in a-om uhi.
Huan Tirshatha in, siampu Urim leh Thummim toh ahong dinkhiak mateng, thil siangthoupente ne lou ding in amau ahilh hi.
Omkhawm tengteng avek un singli sangnih zathum-le- sawmguk ahi.
Apasal sikhate uleh anumei sikhate uh, sangsagih zathum sawmthum-le-sagihte sim louh in pasal lasami leh numei lasami sangnih anei uhi.
Asakolte uh zasagih sawmthum- le-guk ahi ua; sakol neute, zanih sawmli-le-nga;
Sangawngsaute, zali sawmthum- le-nga; sabiltung uh, sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnih.
Huan Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn ahong tun un, apipute uh inkuan lak a alupente akhen in, TOUPA' inn alamna ding in ut thu a thillat alan uhi.
Nasepna sumbawm ah ahihtheihdan un dangka-eng darik singguk-le-sangkhat, dangka paun sangnga leh siampute puansilh zakhat.
Huchi in siampute, Levi mite, mite lak a akhenkhat leh lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite leh Nethinim mite, akhopite uah ateng ua, Israel mite akhopite uah ateng uhi.
Huchi akha sagihna ahong tun a, khopite a Israel suante a-om lai un, mite Jerusalem ah mi khat bang in akikhawmkhawm uhi.

Huchi in Jozadak tapa Jeshua leh a-unaute siampute leh Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh a-unaute adingh ua, Pathian mipa Mosi Dan a akigelh bang a, atung a halmang thillatte lan ding in, Israel' Pathian maitam abawl uhi.
Maitam kingakna tung ah atung ua; gamte a mite ziak in atung uah launa a-om hi: huchi in atung ah TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte zing leh nitak a halmang thillatte ngei alan uhi.
Huan akigelh bang in, biakbukte ankuangluina abawl ua, ahih ding zah in niteng halmang thillatte, dan dungzui in, niteng a sep ding kiphamoh bang in alan uhi.
Huai nung in halmang thillat ngeinate, kha thakte thillatte leh hihsiangthou a om TOUPA ankuanglui sehkhiakte tengteng leh michih a kipan TOUPA a dia uttak a ut thu a thillatte alan uhi.
Akha sagihna ani khat ni a kipan in TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte alan pan ua; himahleh TOUPA tempul suangphum akiphum nai kei hi.

Sumte suangsek mite kiang leh khutsiam mite kiang ah apia ua; Kura Persia kumpipa a kipan aphalna amuh bang ua tuipi a, Joppa tan a Lebanon tang a kipan sidar singte hon la ding in, Zidonte kiang leh Turate kiang ah, sa, dawn ding leh sathau apia uhi.

Huchi in akha nihna, Jerusalem a Pathian inn ahong tun uh akum nihna in, Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak tapa Jeshua leh a-unaute siampute leh Levi mite leh koltanna a kipan a Jerusalem a hong paite akipan ua; Levi mite kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam TOUPA' inn nasepna a heutute hi ding in asep uhi.
Huchi in Pathian inn a nasem mite heutu ding in, Jeshua atapate leh a-unaute, Kadmiel leh atapate, Judah tapate, Henadad tapate, atapate uh leh a-unaute uh Levi mite toh adingkhawmta uhi.

Inn lam mite'n TOUPA tempul suangphum akoih lai un, Israel kumpipa David thupiak bang in, TOUPA phat ding in, siampute pengkulte toh apuan uh asilhsak ua, Levi mite Asaph tapate dakkhutbette aguan uhi.

Huchi in TOUPA phatna leh kipahna piakna in la asakhawm chiat ua, "Amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in Israel lam ah a-om gige ngal a," chi in. Huchi in TOUPA' inn suangphum akoih ziak un mite tengteng aw ngaihtak a kikou in TOUPA aphat uhi.

Himahleh siampute leh Levi mite leh pipute inkote lak a mi tampi, amit mahmah ua hiai inn suangphum akikoih lai a, tua inn masa mute putekte, ngaihtak in akapkhia ua; mi tampi nuamsa in ngaihtak in akikou uhi.
Huchi in mite'n nuamsa a kikouna husa, mite kahna husa toh atheikak thei kei ua: mite ngaihtak in akikou ua, ahusa uh gamlapi ah akiza hi.
Huchi a Judah leh Benjamin melmate'n saltangte tate'n TOUPA, Israel' Pathian a ding in tempul alam uh chih azak un;

Zerubbabel leh pipute inko lupente kiang ah ahong pai nai ua, akiang uah, "Hon lampih le ung ake: noute bang in, na Pathian uh lah ka zong ngal ua; Assuria kumpipa Esarhaddon in hiai mun ahon pipa dam lai nite a kipan amah kiang ah ka kithoih uhi," achi uhi.

Himahleh Zerubbabel leh Jeshua leh Israel pipu inko lupente'n akiang uah, "Ka Pathian uh a dia inn na hon lampihna ding ziak bangmah na nei kei uh; himahleh Persia kumpipa Kura in kou thu ahon piak bang in, Israel' Pathian, TOUPA a ding in koute'n ka lam ding uhi," achi uhi.
Huchi in gam a mite'n Judah a mite khut ahatsakta kei ua, inn lamna ah amau asubuaita uhi.
Persia kumpipa Kura dam lai tengteng, Persia kumpipa Darias lal lai tanpha in, athiltup uh kalhse ding, amaute siatna ding in thuhilh mite aguai uhi.
Ahasueras vaihawm pat tung lai in, Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte hekna lai agelh uhi.
Huan Artaksarses dam lai in Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel leh akithuahpihte'n Persia kumpipa Artaksarses kiang ah lai agelh ua; laikhak gelhdan Siria laimal a gelh a, Siria pau a bawlkhiak ahi.
Sepaih heutu lian Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai in Jerusalem siatna ding in kumpipa Artaksarses kiang ah hichibang in laikhak agelh uhi.

Sepaih heutu lian Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh akithuahpihte un huchi in agelhta ua; Dinai mite, Apharsatki mite, Tarpe mite, Aphar mite, Arki mite, Babulon mite, Susan mite, Deha mite, Elam mite leh,
Osnappar lian leh thupi in apikhiak, Samaria khopi leh luipi khen a gamdang leh adangdang a kikoih namte tan in.
Kumpipa Artaksarses kiang a alaikhak uh teisawn hiai ahi: "Luipi khen lam leh adangdang a na sikhate.

Na kiang a kipan a hong tou Judate Jerusalem ah kou kiang ah ahong uh chih kumpipa kiang ah theih in om hen: Khopi helhat leh hoih lou alam lellel ua, akulhbaangte azouta ua, asuangphumte apuah khinta uh.
Kumpipa'n thei hen, hiai khopi lam a a-om a, akulhbaangte zoh in omleh zaw, leimante, siahte sumsinna leimante hiam lamlian leimante ape kei ding ua, atawptawp in kumpipa siatna ahi ding.
Tu in koute kumpi inn a pan huhna ngahte ka hih ziak un, kumpipa zahlakna muh koute ding in akilawm kei a, huaiziak in kumpipa thudik ka hon khak uhi.

Na pipute chiamtehna laibu sung ah kizong hen: huchi in chiamtehna laibu sung ah na mu ding a, hiai khopi helhat, kumpipate leh bialte a dia poikhoih hat chih leh nidanglai mah in leng huai sung mah a helna ana bawlta uh chih na thei mai ding; huaiziak a hiai khopi kihihsegawp lah ahi ngal a.
Hiai khopi akilam a, akulhbaangte hichibang a akihih khitleh zaw, luipi khen lam ah tan na nei kei ding chih kumpipa ka hon theitelsak uhi," chi in.
Huchi in dansiam Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh Samaria leh luipi khen a gam a teng akithuahpih tengteng kiang ah kumpipa'n dawnna akhak hi: Chibai,
"Laikhak ka kiang a na hon khak uh ka ma ah teltak a sim ahita.
Huchi in thu ka pia a, akizong khin a, nidanglai in hiai khopi in kumpipate tung ah helna abawl a, huai ah helpina leh helna a na kibawlta chih muhkhiak in a-om hi.
Huai lou in kumpipa thilhihthei taktak, luipi khen gam tengteng tung a vaihawm, Jerusalem tung a vaihawmte ana om ua; van leimante, sumsinna leimante leh lamlian leimante amau kiang a piak ahi hi.
Huchi in keimah in thupiak ka bawl masiah, huai mite khawl ding leh hiai khopi lam lou ding in, thupiak bawl un.
Hiai thu a ze-ol lou ding in pilvang un: Bang ding in kumpipate siatna ding in hoihlouhna akhang dia?" chi in.

Huchi a kumpipa Artaksarses laikhak teisawn Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh akithuahpihte ma a asim khit un, kintak in Jerusalem a Judate kiang ah ahoh ua, kihatsakna leh thilhihtheihna zang in amau akhawlsakta uhi.
Huchi in Jerusalem a Pathian inn nasep akhawl a: Persia kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum nihna tan in akhawl hi.
Huan zawlneite, zawlnei Haggai leh Zekariah Iddo tapa in Judah leh Jerusalem a om Judate kiang ah athu agenkhol ua; akiang uah Israel' Pathian min in thu agenkhol uhi.
Huchi in Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak tapa Jeshua athou ua, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn alam panta ua; amaute panpih in akiang uah Pathian zawlneite a-om uhi.

Huchih lai mah in akiang uah Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa leh Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpihte uh ahong ua, akiang uah hichibang in, hiai inn lam ding leh hiai kulhbaang zou ding in kua'n thu ahon pia a? achi uhi.
Huai ban ah ka kiang uah, "Hiai inn lam mite min bang ahia?" chi in ahong dong uhi.
Himahleh Juda upate tung ah a Pathian uh mit atu a, athu Darias kiang a ahong tun a, huai tungtang laikhak a dawnna ahong kik nawn masiah, amaute akhawlsak kei uhi.
Laikhak teisawn Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa leh Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpih Abharsa mite, luipi khen a omte'n kumpipa Darias akhak uhi.
Akiang ah laikhak akhak uh hichibang a gelh ahi. "Darias kumpipa kiang ah khamuanna kim om hen.
Kumpipa'n thei hen, Judia bial ah ka pai ua, suang thupite a lam, Pathian thupi inn ah, kulhbaangte singte akikoih a, hiai nasep thanopna toh apai zel a, akhut uah ma asawn zel hi.
Huai upate thu ka dong ua, hichibang in akiang uah, 'Hiai inn lam ding leh hiai kulhbaang zou ding in nou kuan thu ahon pia a?' ka chi uhi.
Nang kiang a tel mahmah gen thei ding in, aminte uh leng ka dong ua, huchi a amau makaipen a om mite min ka gelhkhiak theihna ding un.
Huchi in hichibang in kou ahon dawng uhi, 'Van leh lei Pathian sikhate ka hi ua, hiai inn kum tampi a na kilamsa, Israel kumpipa thupi in alam leh azohsa inn ka lam uhi.
Himahleh ka pipute un van Pathian a na suk heh nung un, amaute Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, Kaldai mi khut ah apia a, ama'n hiai inn ahihsia a, mite Babulon lam ah apimang hi.
Himahleh Babulon kumpipa Kura akum khatna kum in, kumpipa Kura in hiai Pathian inn lam ding in thupiak abawl hi.

Dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan Pathian inn ate leng, Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a om Pathian inn a kipan a alakkhiak a, Babulon tempul a laklutte, huaite kumpipa Kura in Babulon tempul a kipan alakhia a, mi khat Sesbazzar, ukpipa dia abawl kiang ah huaite apekhia hi.'
Ama'n akiang ah, 'Hiai tui-um belsuan la inla, pai in, Jerusalem a om tempul ah koih in, amun ah Pathian inn lam hi hen,' achi hi.
Huai lai in Sesbazzar ahong a, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn suangphumte aphum a: huai hun a kipan tutan in lam in a-om a, hinapi in lah zoh ahi kei hi.

Huaiziak in tu in kumpipa'n hoih asakleh, Babulon a om, kumpipa laigelhte koihchingna insung kizong henla, Jerusalem a hiai Pathian inn lam ding kumpipa Kura in thupiak bawlna hiam abawlleh, hiai thu ah kumpipa'n akipahna kou hon khak hen," chi in.
Huchih lai in kumpipa Darias in thupiak abawla, Babulon a goute koihkhawmna, laibute insung azong uhi.
Huchi in Akmetha ah, Media bial a om inpi ah laizial akimukhia a, huai ah chiamtehna ding in hichibang a gelh ahi.

"Kumpipa Kura akum khatna kum in, Kura kumpipa'n thupiak abawl hi: Jerusalem a Pathian inn tungtang, a-inn lam hi henla, kithoihnate a latna mun uh leh huai a suangphumte kiptak a koih hi hen; asanlam tong sawmguk, azatlam tong sawmguk;
Suang thupi taktak vual thum leh sing thak vual khat toh, huan sum sennate kumpipa' inn a kipan piakkhiak hi hen:

Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem tempul a kipan a alakkhiak, Babulon lam a alak, Pathian inn a dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan piak nawn vek hi henla, Jerusalem a om Pathian insung ah amau mun chiat ah koih nawn vek hi hen."
"Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa, Shethar-boznai leh na kithuahpihte uh Apharsa mite, luipi khen a omte: huai inn lamna a kipan gamla ah om un:
Hiai Pathian inn nasepna subuai kei un; Judate ukpipa leh Juda upate'n amun ah hiai Pathian inn lam uhen.

Huai lou in hiai Pathian inn lamna ding a hiai Juda upate kiang ah na hih ding uh thu ka bawl hi: kumpipa vante a kipan, luipi khen a siah a kipan mahmah in, hiai mite kiang a sumzatnate thanopna chiteng toh apiak ding ahi, huchi a dala a-omlouhna ding un.

Huan ataksapnate uh, bawngtalnoute, belamtalte, belamnoute, van Pathian kiang a halmang thillat ding huit buh, chi, uain leh thaute, Jerusalem a om siampute thu bang zel in, tatlak lou in niteng in amau piak ding ahi:
Huchi a van Pathian kiang a gimlim kithoihnate alat theih ua, kumpipa hinna leh atapate hinna a dia athumtheihna ding un.
Thupiak ka bawl lai a, kuapeuh in hiai thu a suklamdan leh a-inn a kipan inkam dohkhiak hi henla, huai ah amah dopkang touh leh henden in om hen; hiai ziak in a-inn ekvum a bawl hi hen.

Huai mah hihlamdang ding, Jerusalem a om hiai Pathian inn hihse ding a akhut uh kuansak ding kumpipate tengteng leh mite tengteng Pathian huai lai a teng ding a amin omsakpa'n paithal vek hen. Kei, Darias in, thupiak ka bawlta; thanopna tengteng toh sepkhiak in om hen," chi in.
Huchi in Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa, Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpihte un, kumpipa Darias in asawl ziak in, thanopna tengteng toh huchibang in asemkheta uhi.

Juda upate'n zawlnei Haggai leh Iddo tapa Zekariah genkholhna pansan in inn alam ua ma asawn zel uhi. Israel' Pathian thupiak dungzui leh Kura, Darias leh Persia kumpipa Artaksarses thupiak dungzui in inn alam ua azouta uhi.
Kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum gukna kum a om, Adar kha ani thum ni in hiai inn zoh ahita hi.
Huchi in Israel suante, siampute leh Levi mite leh saltanna ta dangte'n, hiai Pathian inn latna nuamtak in aneita uhi.
Hiai Pathian inn latna ah bawngtal zakhat, belamtal zanih, belamnou zali alan ua; Israel tengteng a dia khelhna thillat ding in, keltal sawm-le-nih, Israel namte zah dungzui in.
Huchi in Jerusalem a om, Pathian nasepna a ding in, Mosi laibu a kigelh bang in, siampute atan hawmna uah, Levi mite amun tan uah akoih uhi.
Huan saltanna tate'n akha khatna ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang alui uhi.
Siampute leh Levi mite lah akisiangsakkhawm vek ngal ua; avek un asiang uhi: huchi in saltanna tate a ding leh a-unaute uh siampute a ding leh amau mah a ding in, Paikan belamnou agou uhi.
Saltanna a kipan a hong paikhe nawn, Israel suante leh TOUPA, Israel' Pathian zong ding a, gam a khovel mite buahna a kipan amau leh amau kihuikhetuam tengteng in, ane uhi.

Nuamtak in ni sagih sung Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina abawl uhi: TOUPA'N amaute nuam asasak in, Israel' Pathian, Pathian inn a nasepna khutte uh hatsak ding in amau lam ah Assuria kumpipa lungtang akiheisak hi.
Hiai thilte nung in, Persia kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm lai in, Seraiah tapa Ezra, Azariah tapa, Hilkiah tapa,
Shallum tapa, Zadok tapa, Ahitub tapa,
Amariah tapa, Azariah tapa, Meraioth tapa,
Zerahiah tapa, Uzzi tapa, Bukki tapa,
Abishua tapa, Phinehas tapa, Eleazar tapa, Aaron siampu lian tapa:
Babulon a kipan in hiai Ezra apaitou a; amah Mosi Dan, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in apiak, dan theisa ahi a: atung a TOUPA a Pathian khut a-om dungzui in, angetna tengteng kumpipa'n aphalsak hi.
Huan kumpipa Artaksarses kum sagih kum in, Jerusalem ah Israel suante lak a akhen, siampute lak a akhen, Levi mite, lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite leh Nethinim mite, ahohtou ua.
Huchi in kumpipa akum sagih kum akha ngana in Jerusalem ah Ezra ahong pai hi.
Babulon a kipan akha khatna ani khat ni in akuantou pan a, akha ngana ani khat ni in a Pathian khut hoih atung a a-om bang zel in, Jerusalem ah ahong pai hi.
Ezra in bel TOUPA Dan zong ding, zui ding leh Israel tua dan thusehte leh vaihawmnate sinsak ding in alungtang akoihkip hi.
Tu in kumpipa Artaksarses in siampu, laigelhmi, TOUPA thupiakte thu gelhmi leh Israel kiang a adan thusehte gelhmi Ezra kiang a apiak laikhak teisawn hiai ahi.
Artaksarses, kumpipate' kumpipa'n, siampu, van Pathian Dan gelhmi, buching leh huchibang zel in, Ezra kiang ah,
Thupiak ka bawl hi, huchi a Israel a mite lak a amaute tengteng, ka gamsung a, asiampute uh leh Levi mite, amau ut thu petmah a Jerusalem a pai ding a theihsakte, nang kiang ah pai uhen.
"Kumpipa leh athudot mi sagihte'n, na khut a om na Pathian Dan dungzui a, Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu kan ding a, nang ahon sawl bang un;
atenna Jerusalem a om, Israel' Pathian kiang a man nei lou a kumpipa leh athudot mite'n apiaksate uh dangka leh dangka-eng po ding in,
Babulon bial tengteng a dangka leh dangka-eng na muh tengteng, mite leh siampute'n amau ut thu a thillat, Jerusalem a om a Pathian uh inn a dia uttak a alat tengteng uh toh.

"Huaiziak in thanopna toh hiai sum in bawngtalte, belamtalte, belamnoute na lei ding a, a-anpiak thillatte uleh adawn ding thillatte uh toh, huchi in Jerusalem a om na Pathian uh inn maitam tung ah huaite na lan ding hi.
Dangka leh dangka-eng om lai hihdan ding nang leh na unaute'n hoih na sak dandan uh, na Pathian uh deihlam bang in hih un.
Na Pathian inn a nasepna ding a tui-um belsuan ka hon piak uh, Jerusalem Pathian ma ah pia in.
Na Pathian inn ding a kiphamoh dangdangte, piakna ding na neih dingte, kumpipa gou koihkhawmna a kipan in pekhia in.

"Kei, kumpipa kei Artaksarses mahmah in luipi khen a om sumkem mite tengteng kiang ah thupiak ka bawl hi, huchi a Ezra siampu, van Pathian Dan, laigelhmi in nou ahon nget, thanuamtak a hih zel ahihtheihna ding in.
Dangka talent zakhat, huit buh tehna zakhat, uain bath zakhat, sathau bath zakhat leh aphazah gen lou in chi nangawn.
Bangpeuh van Pathian in thu apiak, van Pathian inn a ding in hih in om zel hen; aziak bel bang ding in kumpipa leh atapate gamsiatna ding in thangpaihna a-om dia?

Huai lou in leng ka hon chitaktak uh hi, siampute leh Levite, lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite, Nethinim mite hiam hiai Pathian inn sikhate lak a akuakua tungtang ah, van leimante, sumsinna leimante hiam lamlian leimante amau liausak dan ahi kei ding hi.
Huan nang, Ezra, na khut a om na Pathian pilna zui in, thukhenmi leh vaihawmmi, tuipi khen a omte mite tengteng vaihawm ding in sep in; na Pathian dante tengteng, huaite theiloute nou sinsak un.
Kuapeuh na Pathian dan leh kumpipa dan zui lou, sihna chiang hizong leh thanuamtak in atung ah vaihawmna bawl in om hen, ahihkeileh, khakmangna hiam, vankhakna hiam, suangkul lutna tan in," chi in.
Jerusalem a om TOUPA' inn kilawmsak ding a, kumpipa lungtang a hichibang a thil koih, i pipute Pathian, TOUPA nuamsa in om hen;

Kumpipa leh athudot mite leh kumpipa vaihawmpih thilhihthei tengteng ma a ka tung a zahngaihna hon pepa amah ahi. Huchi in ka tung a TOUPA ka Pathian khut dungzui in hihhat in ka omta a, ka kiang a hoh ding in Israel a kipan mikizen tungtuan ka kaikhawmta hi.
Huan hiaite apipute uh inkote lak a alupente ahi ua, kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm lai a kei hon zuite khangthu suina ahi.
Phinehas tapate lak ah, Gershom: Ithamar tapate lak ah Daniel: David tapate lak ah, Hattush,
Shekaniah tapate lak ah; Parosh tapate lak ah, Zekariah: amah toh pasalte khangthu suina a suikhawmte zakhat-le-sawmnga ahi.
Pahath-moab tapate lak ah, Elihoenai Zerahiah tapa; huan amah toh pasal zanihte.
Shekaniah tapate lak ah, Jahaziel tapa; amah toh pasal zathumte.
Adin tapate lak ah, Jonathan tapa Ebed; amah toh pasal sawmngate.
Elam tapate lak ah, Athaliah tapa Jeshaiah; amah toh pasal sawmsagihte.
Shephatiah tapate, Mikael tapa Zebadiah; amah toh pasal sawmgiatte.
Joab tapate lak ah, Jehiel tapa Obadiah; amah toh pasal zanih sawm-le-giatte.
Shelomith tapate lak ah, Josiphiah tapa; amah toh pasal zakhat-le-sawmgukte.
Bebai tapate lak ah, Bebai tapa Zekariah; amah toh pasal sawmnih-le-giatte.
Azgad tapate lak ah, Hakkatan tapa Johanan; amah toh pasal za-le-sawmte.
Adonikam tapate lak ah, ananungpente; hiaite amin uh ahi, Eliphelet, Jeiel, Shemaiah leh amau toh pasal sawmgukte.
Bigvai tapate, Uthai leh Zabbud; amau toh pasal sawmsagihte.
Huchi in Ahava pha a luang luipi tan in amaute ka kaikhawm a; huai ah ni thum ka giak uhi. Mite leh siampute ka en vialvial a, huai ah Levi tapate kuamah ka mu kei.
Huan Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekariah leh Meshullam, mikizen tungtuante, sinsak mite Joiarib leh Elnathan leng ka thukhak hi.

Kasiphia mun a Iddo hausapa kiang ah amau ka sawlkhia a; Iddo kiang ah leh Kasiphia mun a a-unaute Nethinimte kiang a agen ding uh ka hilh a, i Pathian inn ua ding a nasemmi ei a dia hon tonpih ding in.
Huchi in i tung ua i Pathian khut hoih a om dungzui in pasal khat lunggelsiam, Mahli tapate lak a, Levi tapa, Israel tapa ei ding in Sherebiah atapate leh a-unaute, sawm-le-giat toh ahon pi uhi.
Hashabiah, amah toh Merari tapate lak a Jeshaiah toh, a-unaute leh atapate uh, sawmnih toh;
Nethinimte, David leh avaihawmpihte'n Levi mite nasepna ding a apiakte uh, zanih-le-sawmnih Nethinimte: avek un minkhumna ah akhum uhi.

Huchi in huai ah, Ahava lui ah, an ngawl ka puang a, huchi a ei a ding leh i nau neute a ding leh i neih i lamte tengteng a dia lampi tang amah lak a zong ding a i Pathian uh ma a ei leh ei i kiniamkhiak theihna ding in.

Lampi a melma dou ding a ei hon panpih ding a kumpipa kiang a sepaih pawl leh sakol tungtuangmi nget lah ka zum ngal a: hoihna ding a, amah zongte tung ah i Pathian khut a-om a; himahleh amah mangngilh tengteng siatna ding in athilhihtheihna leh athangpaihna a-om hi, chi a, kumpipa kiang a thu i gen tak ziak in.
An i ngawl ua hiai ding in i Pathian i ngen ngutngut ua: huchi in ama'n i thumna uh hon dawng hi.
Huai lai in siampute lak a amakai lianpente lak a sawm-le-nih, Sherebiah, Hashabiah leh akiang ua om a-unaute uh lak a sawmkhat ka sehkhen a,
amau a ding in dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuante, kumpipa leh athuhilh mite leh avaihawmpihte'n TOUPA' inn a alatte uh huai lai a om Israel tengteng puak ding in ka buksak hi.
Akhut sung mahmah uah dangka talent zaguk-le-sawmnga leh dangka tui-um belsuan talent za ka buksak a; dangka-eng lak ah talent za;
dangka-eng noubem sawmnih, darik sangkhat lak ah; dal hoih nawttet, dangka-eng bang a manpha bel nih.
Huan akiang uah, "TOUPA a ding in na siangthou ua, tui-um belsuante asiangthou uh; dangka leh dangka-eng TOUPA, na pipute uh Pathian a dia ut thu a thillat ahi uh.
TOUPA' inn dantante, Jerusalem a siampute lak a lupente leh Levi mite leh Israel pipute inko vaihawmte ma a huaite na buk masiah uh, pilvan suah in, amaute kem un," ka chi hi.
Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite'n i Pathian inn ua Jerusalem a apuak ding un dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan bukkhiakte ala uhi.

Huai lai in Jerusalem lam a pai ding in, akha khatna ani sawm-le-nih ni in Ahava lui a kipan i pawtkhia ua: huan i Pathian khut i tung uah a-om a, melma khut leh lampi a buk mi a kipan ama'n hon tankheta hi.
Huchi in Jerusalem i tung ua huai ah ni thum i om uhi.

Ani li ni in dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan i Pathian inn uah Uriah siampu tapa Meremoth khut ah buk in a-om a; akiang ah Phinehas tapa Eleazar a om; akiang uah Jeshua tapa Jozabad leh Binnui tapa Noadiah, Levi mite a-om uhi;
aphazah leh agikdan tengteng sim ahi a, huai hun in laibu a chiamteh ahi.

Pimangna a kipan a hong pai, saltanna tate'n Israel' Pathian kiang ah halmang thillatte, bawngtal sawm-le-nih Israel tengteng a ding in, belamtal sawmkua-le-guk, belamnou sawmsagih-le-sagih, keltal khelhna thillat ding in sawm-le-nih alan uhi: hiaite tengteng TOUPA a ding a halmang thillat ahi.
Kumpipa thukhen mite kiang leh tuipi khen a ukpipate kiang ah kumpipa thupiakte apekhia ua: huchi in mite leh Pathian inn apanpih uhi.

Huchi a hiai thilte hih khit ahih lai in, ka kiang ah vaihawmtute ahong pai nai ua, "Israel mite leh siampute leh Levi mite, gamte a mite a kipan amau leh amau akikoihtuam kei ua, amaute kihhuainate, Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Periz mi, Jebus mi, Ammon mi, Moab mi, Aigupta mi leh Amor mite, dungzui in a-om uhi.

Amau a ding leh atapate uh a ding in atanute uh ala ua; huchi in chi siangthou gamte mite toh amau leh amau akihelkhawmta hi: ahi, hiai tatlekna ah vaihawmtute khut leh vaihawmte amakai lianpente ahi uhi," achi hi.
Huchi a hiai thil ka zak in, ka puansilh leh ka puanak ka botkek a, ka lu a sam leh ka khamul ka botkhia a, lamdang sa in ka tusuk hi.
Huai lai in saltanna a amaute tatlekna ziak a, Israel' Pathian thute ziak a lau a ling michih ka kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua; nitaklam kithoih hun masiah lamdang sa in ka tu hi.
Nitaklam kithoih hun lai in ka tunggikna a pan ka thou a, ka puansilh leh ka puanak bohkeksa toh; ka khukdin a, TOUPA ka Pathian lam ah ka khutte ka zakkhia a;
"Aw ka Pathian, na kiang a daktou ding in ka zum in ka zakta hi, ka Pathian: ka thulimlouhnate uh ka lutunglam uah apung deuhdeuh a, ka mohna un vante asunta hi.

Ka pipute uh dam lai hun a kipan tuni pha in nakpi in ka mohta ua; huchi in ka thulimlouhnate uh ziak in kou, ka kumpipate uh leh ka siampute uh, gamte kumpipate khut ah, namsau ah, saltanna ah, lohna ah leh zahlakna ah, hiai ni bang in piakkhiak in ka omta uhi.

Huan tu in sawt lou sung a ding in TOUPA ka Pathian ua kipan in hehpihna hong lang a, suakta ding a om lai dia nutsiat ding in leh amun siangthou a omkipna hon pe ding in, huchi a ka Pathian un ka mitte uh ahon sukvaksak a, ka tanna ua halhna neukha ahon piaktheihna ding in.

Sikha lah ka hi ngal ua; huchipi in leng sikha ka hihna uah ka Pathian un ahon mangngilh kei a, himahleh Persia kumpipate mitmuh in zahngaihna ahon pia a, halhna hon pe ding, ka Pathian uh inn dingsak ding leh huai a siatna bawlpha ding leh Judah leh Jerusalem a kulhbaang hon pe ding in.
"Tu in, Aw ka Pathian uh, hiai zoh in bang ka chita ding ua? Na thupiakte lah ka lehngatsanta ngal ua,
Na sikha zawlneite zang in thu na hon pia a: 'Luah ding a na paina uh, huai gam, gamte a mite nitna ziak a gam nin ahi. Akihhuainate un gam tawp khat lam a kipan khat lam tawp tan ahihdimna ziak in.

Huaiziak in na tanute uh atapate uh kiang ah pe kei unla, atanute uh leng na tapate uh a ding in la sam kei un, amuanna uhiam ahauhsakna uhiam leng tangtawn in zong sam kei un: huchi a na hat ua, gam a ahoih na nek ua, tangtawn a na tate uh a ding a gouluah dia na nutsiat theihna ding un.'

Huchi a ka gamtat giloute uh ziak leh ka mohna thupi mahmah ziak ua, ka tung ua hong tung tengteng zoh in, nang ka Pathian un ka thulimlouhnate uh gunzah sang a hon gawt tawmzaw a, akhosuaksun om lai na hon piak mu in.
Na thupiakte bohse nawn in, kihhuaite hih mite toh kituak in ka om ding uam? Akhosuak ding hiam, suakta ding himhim leng om lou khop a na bawlgawp matan ka tung uah na heh nilouh dia hia?

Aw TOUPA Israel' Pathian, nang na diktat a; hiai ni bang a akhosuak omlaite na hon nutsiat ziak in. Ngai in, ka mohna un na ma ah ka om uhi;' hiai ziak in lah kuamah na ma ah adingh thei kei ding uhi."
Paul, Jesu Khrist leh misi lak a kipan a kaithoupa, Pa Pathian ziak a sawltak, mihing sawlkhiak hilou, mihing vang a leng hi sam lou,
leh ka kiang a unau om tengtengte'n, Galatia gam a saptuamte kiang ah:
Pa Pathian leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Ama'n i Pathian leh Pa deihdan in, tulai khovel giloutak lak a ahon suahtaksak theihna ding in i khelhnate a ding in amah mah ahong kipeta hi.
Pathian kiang ah thupina tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
Khrist hehpihna ziak a nou hon sampa huchi guih a tanchinhoih tuam lam a na kisuansan uh lamdang ka sa hi.
Tanchinhoih dang om ahi kei a; noumau hon hihbuai in Khrist tanchinhoih hihlamdan ut kuate hiam a-om uh ahi zaw hi.
Himahleh koumau hiam, van a kipan hong suk angel nangawn in leng, tanchinhoih na kiang ua ka gensa pen lou ngal uh tanchinhoih dang himhim hon na hilhta a-om uleh hamsiat in om uhen.
Tuma a ka gen bang un, tua gen nawn ding ka hi. Tanchinhoih na muh pen lou ngal uh, tanchinhoih dang kuapeuh in nou ahon hilhleh hamsiat in om uhen.
Ahihleh tu in mihing maipha hia ka zon, Pathian a? Ahihkeileh mihing ahi maw lungtaisak ka tup? Mihing ana lungtaisak lel hi taleng, Khrist sikha ka hi kei ding hi.
Huchi in unaute aw, ka tanchinhoih gen pen mihing a pan ahi kei chih ka hon theisak hi.
Mihing kiang a kipan a ka muh leng ahi kei, mi hon hilh leng ka hi sam kei, Jesu Khrist kilakna ziak amu ka hi zaw hi.
Judate sabiakdan a nidanglai ka omdan na thei khinta ngal ua, huchi a Pathian saptuamte nakpitak a sawi in sukchimih ka na sawm gige hi.
Huan ka pipute thugousiah tung a phatuam ka ngaih tuankhol ziak in Judate sabiakdan lam ah ka chipihte lak a ka khanvual tampite ka na khengta hi.
Ka nu gilsung a kipan a hon hihtuampa leh ahehpihna ziak a hon sampa Pathian in,
Zentelte lak a ka hilhtheihna ding a, ama Tapa lungkimtak a keimah a akilaksak lai in, sa leh sisan toh kidong lou in,
sawltak ka hih ma a sawltak ana hisate kiang a Jerusalem a hohtou tuan lou in, Arabia gam ah ka paimang pah a; huan Damaskas ah ka kik nawnta hi.
Kum thum abei nung in Kifas veh ding in Jerusalem ah ka va hohtou a, akiang ah ni sawm-le-nga ka taam hi.
Sawltak dangte, Toupa unau Jakob kia lou ngal kuamah ka mu kei hi.
Na kiang ua ka thugelhte ngai dih ua, Pathian mitmuh ah ka zuau kei hi.
Huai nung in Siria leh Silisia gamte ah ka pai hi.
Judia gam a saptuam, Khrist a omte meltheih ka hi nai kei lai hi,
"Tuma lam a khatvei ginna thu sukchimih tum a hon sawipa'n tu in huai thu agen zawta," chih mi gen kia aza uhi.
Huan keimah ziak in Pathian apahtawita uhi.
Kum sawm-le-li abei nung in Titas mah leng pi in, Barnabas toh Jerusalem ah ka va hohtou nawn hi.
