Kilakna ziak a va hohtou ka hi a, Zentelte kiang a tanchinhoih ka tangkoupih amau ka va hilh a; himahleh milian deuhte atuam in ka hilh a; huchi lou in zaw athawn a tai kha hiam ahihkeileh taithawnta ka hi kha ding hi.
Himahleh ka kiang a om Titas hial leng Grik mi himahleh zeksumsak teitei in a-om kei hi.
Huai unau tak lou, aguk a pilut a omte, sal a ahon laktheihna ding ua Khrist Jesu a noplenna i neih uh enkhe ding a hong lutte ziak in ahi.
Himahleh noute a dia huai tanchinhoih thutak a bittak a kep ahihtheihna ding in amau kiang ah mitphiat kal lel leng ka kipe himhim kei uhi.
Hihna deuh min nei mahmahte bangchibang hihna nei mah le uh kei a ding in alamdanna a-om kei hi. Pathian in kuamah akhentuam kei a; huai min nei mahmahte thugen in bangmah hon behlap kei hi.
Huchih nak sang in zeksumte kiang a tanchinhoih Peter kiang a kepsak a a-om bang in zeksumlouhte kiang a tanchinhoih kei kiang ah kepsak in a-om chih athei zaw uhi.
Zeksumte sawltak hi ding a Peter a sempa mah in Zentelte sawltak hi ding in kei ah asem hi.

Huan kei kiang a piak a om hehpihna amuh un, Jakob, Kifas, Johan, khuam muanhuai leh min neite'n amau bel zeksumte kiang a hoh ding leh kou Zentelte kiang a hoh ding in kei leh Barnabas kithuahna khut taklam hon pe zawta uhi.
Gentheite ka theihgige lel uh adeih ua, huai mah hih ka tum tinten hi.
Huan Antiok a Peter ahong pai lai a demhuai mahmah a a-om ziak in amaitang ngei ah ka kalh hi.
Jakob kiang a kipan mi kuate hiam ahong pai ma un ama'n Zentelte kiang ah an ane zel a; himahleh ahong tuntak un zeksumte akihtak ziak in pang nawn lou in akikoihtuamta hi.
Juda dangte leng alepchiah chiat sam ua, huchi in Barnabas hilhial leng alepchiahna uah pimang in a-om zou hial hi.

Tanchinhoih thutak bang in a-om kei uh chih ka theih in avek ua ma ah Peter kiang ah, "Nang Juda mi na hi ngal a, Judate om bang a om lou in Zentelte om bang a na om zawkleh bangchidan ahia Judate om bang a Zentelte na omsak teitei nak?" ka chi hi.
Ei zaw Zentel mikhialte hilou in, Juda mi him a piang i hi uhi.

Himahleh dan thilhihte ziak in mi siamtang in a-om kei, Jesu Khrist ginna ziak in siamtang in a-om zaw uh chih i thei uhi; e'n leng dan thilhih ziak hilou in, Khrist ginna ziak a siamtang a i omtheihna ding in, Khrist Jesu i gingta hi; dan thilhihte ziak in mihing himhim siamtang a om lou ding uh ahi.
Ahihleh Khrist a siamtang a om tum kawmpi a eite mikhialte i na hih nakleh Khrist khelhna omsakpa hita ve maw le! Hilou hial!
Ka thilhihsiatte ka lam nawn zel in zaw, talekpa ka hi chih ka kitheisak phet ahi ding hi.
Pathian lam a dia ka hong hintheihna ding in, kei zaw dan ziak in dan lam ah ka si khinta hi.

Khrist toh kilhden in ka omta; himahleh ka hing ahi; keimah pen ka hita kei a, keimah ah Khrist ahing ahi zaw; tua sa a ka hin bel ginna a hing ka hi; Pathian Tapa, hon it a ka sik a kipepa pen ginna ah.
Pathian hehpihna bangmah lou in ka bawl kei, dan ziak a diktatna a om in zaw Khrist athawn a si ahi kha ding hi.
Nou Galatia mihaite aw, kua'n hon bumhai amaizen a? Na mitmuh ngei ua Jesu Khrist kilhden a kichiantak a lahsak zaw hiven maw.
Hiai leltak ka hon dong ding; dan thilhihte ziak in hia Kha na muh uh, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak ziak un?
Hichi tel in na hai uh maw? Kha a pan khin ngal in, sa in na zou ding ua hia?
Thil huchi zahzah athawn a thuak na hi uh maw? Athawn taktak na hitaleh.
Na kiang ua Kha hon pepa leh na lak ua thillamdang hihpa'n dan thilhihte ziak in hia ahih, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak ziak un?
"Abraham in Pathian agingta a, huai ginna diktatna a simsak ahih tak mah bang in,"
Huchi in thei un, ginna a omte Abram tate ahi uhi.

Huan Laisiangthou in, "Pathian in ginna ziak in Zentelte siamtangsak ding in akisa chih theikhol in, nangmah ah namte vualzawlsak in a-om ding uh," chi in Abraham kiang ah tanchinhoih ana genkholta hi.
Huchi in ginna a omte ginna mipa Abraham toh vualzawlsak in a-om sam nak uhi.
Dan thilhih a kinga peuhmahte hamse nuai ah a-om uhi, "Dan laibu a thugelh tengteng bang a hih gige lou peuhmah hamsiat in om hen," chi a gelh ahi.
Tu in Pathian mitmuh in kuamah dan a siamtang a-om kei, "Midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding,” chih ahih ziak in chih alang kilkel hi.
Himahleh dan zaw ginna a kinga ahi kei; huchibang a hihpa huaite in ahing ding chih ahi zaw hi.
Eite sik in Khrist hamsiat in ahong om a, dan hamsia a kipan in ahon tankheta hi, "Sing a khailup peuhmah hamsiat hi hen," chih gelh ahih bang in.
Huchi a Abraham tung a vualzawlnate Khrist Jesu ziak a Zentelte tung ahong tun theih a, ginna ziak a chiam a om Kha pen i muhtheihna ding in.
Unaute aw, mihing hihdan in gen leng; mihing thukhun leltak leng, hihkipsa nung aphel kei ua, behlap leng abehlap ngei kei uhi.

Abraham kiang ah leh achisuante kiang ah thuchiamte piak ana hi. Mi tampi tungthu gen bang in, "Chisuante kiang ah," achi kei a; mi khat tungthu gen bang in, "Nang chisuan kiang ah," achi zaw a, huai tuh Khrist ahi.
Huchi in hiai ka chi ahi; huai thuchiam bangmah lou suaksak a hihmang ding in, thukhun Pathian in ana hihkipsa, anung kum zali-le-sawmthum khit a hong om, dan in ahihmang thei kei hi.
Gouluah ding thu dan ziak ahihleh thuchiam ziak ahita kei ding a; himahleh Pathian in Abraham kiang ah thuchiam ziak in ahi ana piak.
Ahihkeileh bangchi thu a dan om ahia le? Chisuan thuchiamna ahong om masiah tatleknate ziak in behlap in a-om a, angelte zang a palai khut a hihkip ahi.
Huan palai himhim mi khat lak ah palai ahi ngei kei hi; Pathian bel khat ahi.
Ahihkeileh dan in Pathian thuchiamte akalh hia? Kalh lou hial! Hihhing thei himhim dan piak a om na hitaleh, dan ziak in diktatna a-om ngei ding hi.
Himahleh Jesu Khrist gin ziak a thilchiam a gingtate kiang a piak ahihtheihna ding in Laisiangthou in khelhna nuai ah bangkim akhakkhum vekta hi.
Himahleh ginna ahong tun ma in ginna hong kilang ding ah khakkhum in dan nuai a ven i na hi uhi.
Huchi in ginna ziak a siam i tantheihna ding in huai dan tuh Khrist hon chilpa ahi.
Himahleh ginna ahong tun in, hon chilpa nuai ah i omta kei uhi.
Khrist Jesu gin ziak in Pathian tate na hi vek uhi.
Noute Khrist a baptis lut a omsate Khrist in na kithuamta uhi.
Huai ah Juda mi a-om kei a, Grik mi leng a-om kei; huai ah sikha a-om kei a, noplen leng a-om kei; huai ah pasal leh numei leng a-om kei hi. Khrist Jesu ah na vek un pum khat na hi uhi.
Huan Khrist a na hih uleh Abraham suan thuchiam bang a gouluah dingte na hi uhi.
Himahleh huchi in ka chi ahi, Gouluah dingpa bangkim tung ah toupa himahleh naupang ahih lai teng sikha toh bangmah in akilamdang kei;
apa hun seh ahong tun masiah achilpa leh akempa nuai ah a-om hi.
Huchibang in ei leng naupang i hih lai in, khovel thubulte nuai ah sikha in i om uhi.
Himahleh ahunbi ahong kim in, Pathian in a Tapa, numei suan in, dan nuai a hong suak in ahon sawlkhia hi;
ta hihna i muhtheihna ding leh dan nuai a omte tankhe ding in.
Huan tate na hih ziak un Pathian in a Tapa Kha, "Abba, Pa,” chi a kikou in, i lungtang uah ahon sawl hi.
Huchi in sikha na hita kei ua, ta na hi zawta uhi; huan ta na hihleh Pathian vang a gouluah ding na hi uhi.
Hinapi, tuma Pathian na theih louh lai un, apiandan mawng ua pathian hilou hialte sikha na hi uhi.
Himahleh tu a Pathian na hon theih nung un bel, ahihkeileh Pathian theihmi na hong hih nung un chih ding ahi zaw; thubul zawngkhal leh namanloute nuai a bangchidan a bawi a tan ut nawn na hi ua?
Nite, khate, hunte, kumte na tang zel ua.
Na tung uah tha ka sengthawn kha ding chih ka lau hi.
Unaute aw, ka hon ngen ahi, keimah bang in om un, kei leng noumau bang in ka om a, ka bangmah na hihse kei uhi.
Tanchinhoih na kiang ua ka gen masakna pen ka sa hat louh ziak ahi chih na thei uhi.
Huan ka sa a nou a dia khemna om tuh na simmoh kei ua, na kih sam kei uh; Pathian angel bang leh Khrist Jesu bang hial in na hon pakta zaw uhi.
Vangpha na kisakna uh koi a omta ahia le? Hihtheih liai hileh na mit uh khelkhia in na hon pe khin ding uh chih ka hon theihpih ahi.
Thutak ka hon hilh ziak in na melma uh ka hong hita a hia?
Amau noute phatuamngaitak in, ahoih lam deih hilou napi in ahon zol ua; ahi, amau a dia phattuam na ngaih theihna ding ua koute a kipan posiah a hon omsak a-ut uhi.
Atup ahoih nakleh ahoih lam ah chik lai peuh in phatuamngaih gige ahoih hi, na kiang ua ka om lai kia hilou in.
Ka unaute aw, Khrist noumau a siam piching a a-om masiah nauvei in ka hon vei hi.
Ahi, tulai in na kiang ua om a, ka awsuah hihlamdan ka ut theihdan; na tungthu uah ka mang abang ahi.
Dan nuai a om utte aw, hon hilh un, dan in agen na thei kei ua hia?
Hichibang a gelh ahi: Abraham in tapa nih anei a, khat sikhanu toh khat noplennu toh ahi.
Himahleh sikhanu lak a pen sadan in apiang a, noplennu lak a pen bel thuchiam ziak a piang ahi.
Huai thilte etsakna ahi, huai numeite thukhun nih ahi uh; khat Sinai Tang a sikha hi ding a ta neinu, Hagar ahi.
Huan Hagar bel Arabia gam a Sinai Tang ahi a, tulai a om Jerusalem toh kibang ahi, atate toh sikha in a-om uhi.
Tunglam Jerusalem bel noplen ahi; huai ngeingei eite nu ahi.
"Nang chiing, ta nei ngei lou, nuam in, nang, nauvei ngei lou, kikoukhia in; pasal neinu sang in lungzuangnu tate tamzaw ding ahi ngal a," chih gelh ahi.
Huchi in unaute aw, eite Isak bang in thuchiam tate i hi uhi.
Himahleh huai lai bang in tu in leng ahi; sadan a piang in Khadan a piang asawi ahi.
Himahleh Laisiangthou in bangchi in agen a? "Bawinu atapa toh hawlkhia un; bawinu tapa in noplennu tapa gou aluahpih louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
Huchi in unaute aw, bawinu tate i hi kei ua, noplennu tate i hi zaw uhi.
Noplending in khrist in ahon suaktasakta, huaiziak in dingkip unla, bawi hakkol ah zaw lut nawn kei un.
Ngai un kei Paul in na kiang ua ka gen, zek na sum uleh Khrist nou a ding in bangmah phattuamna hilou ding ahi.
Ahi a, dan thu tengteng zui ding a bate ana hi uh chih zeksumte tengteng kiang ah ka theisak nawn ahi.
Nou dan a siamtan tumte aw, Khrist toh kikhenta na hi ua, hehpihna na puksanta uhi.
Kou bel Kha ziak in ginna in diktatna lametna ka ngak uhi.
Khrist Jesu ah zeksum bangmah aphatuam kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah aphatuam sam kei; itna a sem ginna bel aphatuam hi.
Hoihtak in na tai uhi. Kua'n thutak zui lou ding a hon dal ahia?
Hiai khemna zaw nou hon sampa kiang a kipan ahi kei hi.
Silngou tawmchik in tanghou beupi azelsuak hi.
Kei ngaihtuahna bang lou in na ngaihtuah lamdang tuan kei ding uh chih Toupa ah ka hon muang hi; himahleh nou hon hihbuaite, akua akua hita le uh vaihawmna atung ua kia pen athuak ding uh ahi.
Unaute aw, ke'n zeksum thu gen lailai ka hihleh, bangziak a sawi a om lailai ka hia? Huchibang ahih ngalleh kros kisuihna tuh hihmang ahita ding hi.
Nou hon hihbuaite satkhiak in om vanglak le uh ka deih ahi.
Nou unaute aw, noplen ding a sap na hi ua; himahleh na noplenna uh sa a ding a lemtanna in zang kei unla, itna in akua akua a ding a kisepsakte hi zaw un.
Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi, chih thu kam khat ah dan thu tengteng kimsak in a-om hi.
Himahleh na kikeih ua, na kinektuah uleh na kinekgaihlouhna ding un pilvang un.
Huchi in hiai ka chi ahi, Kha ah om un, huchi in taksa utna na hihtangtung kei ding uhi.
Sa in Kha adou nak a, Kha in leng sa adou hi; thilhih na tupte uh na hihtheihlouhna ding un huaite akikalh uh ahi.
Himahleh Kha pi a na om uleh dan nuai ah na om kei uhi.
Huan sa thilhihte akilangchian hi, huaite hiaite ahi uh: angkawmna, kingaihna, thanghuaina, hukna,
milim biakna, bumna, huatna, kinakna, hazatna, hehna, kilanna, omtuamna, gintuamna,
deihgohna, tualthahna, zukhamna, zumun uangtatna, huchibang thilhih chingte'n Pathian lalgam atang kei ding uh chi a tuma a ka hon hilhkholh mah bang in, ka hon hilhkhol ahi.
Kha gah ahihleh, itna, kipahna, lemna, thuaktheihna, migitna, hoihna, muanhuaina,
nunnemna, kidektheihnate ahi zaw uhi; huchibang kalh lam in dan himhim a-om kei hi.
Khrist Jesu a hitate'n sa, alunggulhna leh aduhgawlna toh akilhdenta uhi.
Kha a hing i hihleh kha mah ah i om ding uhi.
Kitawngtuah a, kihaza chiat in, i kikoihlian kei ding uhi.
Unaute aw, mi takhial bangpeuh ahih lai phawk a na omleh nou khamite aw, khemna ka tuak sam kha ding e, chi a kivenghoih kawm in, huai bang mi nunnemna lungsim toh tungding thak nawn un.
Na puakgikte uh kidawn chiat un, huchi in Khrist dan na zui uh ahi ding.
Mi bangmah hiloupi in mi liankuam a akibawlleh amah kikhem tawm lel ahi.
Michih in amah thilhih ki-enchian hen; huchi a midang toh kiteh a, ki-uangsak lou a, amah mah a suanhuai thil ahihtheihna ding in.
Michih in ama puak mah po ding ahi ngal a.
Thuhilh a ommi in thil hoih tengteng ahilhpa kiang ah pe sam hen.
Zekhem in om kei un; Pathian zaw khem a mawkbawl vual ahi kei; mi'n atuh peuh uh huai mah at nawn ngei ding ahih ziak un.
Amah salam a tuh in sa a om siatna a-at ding a, khalam a tuh in bel kha a kipan tangtawn hinna a-at ding hi.
Huchi in thil hoih hih chimtak kei ni; i lungkiak keileh ahuntak ah i at ngei ding uhi.
Huchi in lemtang hun i neihdan bang zel in mi tengteng tung ah thil hoih hih ni, ginna inkuanpihte lak a omte tung ah hi kholdiak hen.
Keimah khut mahmah a na kiang ua laimal gol pipi a ka gelh en un.
Sa a mel kilawmsak utte peuhmah in zeksum a om ding in nou ahon sawl teitei nak uhi; bangmah dang ziak ahi kei, Khrist kros ziak a sawina athuaklouhna ding lel uh ahi.
Zeksumte nangawn in leng dan azui tuan sam kei ua, na sa uah, suan ding aneihtheihna ding un na zek uh kisumleh chih a-ut lel uh ahi.
Ke'n zaw i Toupa Jesu Khrist kros lou ngal ka suan louh ding dan, huai kros ziak in khovel kei a ding in kilhden in a-om a, kei leng khovel a ding in kilhden in ka om hi.
Siam thak nawnna lou zaw zeksum bangmah ahi kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah ahi sam kei hi.
Huai dan bang a om peuhmahte tung ah lemna leh zahngaihna, Israel' Pathian tung ngei ah om hen.
Tuban siah kuamah in hon hihbuai nawn kei hen; ka pumpi ah Jesu chiamtehnate ka pu ngal a.
Unaute aw, Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kha uah om hen. Amen.
Atung in Pathian in lei leh vante asiam hi.
Lei tuh lim leh mel nei lou in, avuak kia ahi a, tui thukpi tung mial in amial hi. Pathian Kha in tuite tung a-opkhum hi.
Pathian in, "Vak om hen," achi a, huchi in vak ahong omta hi.
Pathian in vak a-en a, hoih asa hi. Huchi in Pathian in mial a pan vak akhenkheta hi.
Pathian in vak, "Sun" achi a, mial, "Zan" achi hi. Huchi in ani khatna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
Pathian in, "Tuite kikal ah vansin om henla, huai in tuite a pan tuite khenkhia hen," achi hi.
Pathian in vansin abawl a, vansin tung a tui omte a pan vansin nuai a tui omte akhenkhia a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
Pathian in vansin, "Van" achi hi. Huchi in ani nihna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
Pathian in, "Van nuai a tuite mun khat ah omkhawm uh henla, gamkeu hong dawk hen," achi a; huchibang ahong hita hi.
Pathian in gamkeu, "Lei" achi a; tui omkhawmte Tuipite achi hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
Pathian in, "Lei in loupate, anteh chi neite, thei sing lei a amau chi omdan ding bang zel a gah, agah sung a chi omte omsak hen," achi a, huchibang ahong hita hi.
Huchi in lei in loupate, anteh amau chi omdan ding bang a chi neite, sing amau chi omdan ding bang a gah, agah sung a chi omte a-omsak hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
Huchi in ani thumna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
Pathian in, "Sun leh zan khenna ding in vansin ah tanvakte om uhenla, huaite chiamtehnate, hunbite, nite leh kumte theihna hi uhen.
Lei tanvak ding in van a vansin ah vakte om uhen," achi a, huchibang ahong hita hi.
Pathian in tanvak thupi nih abawl a; tanvak thupizaw pen sun a vaihawm ding in, tanvak thupi louzaw pen zan a vaihawm ding in abawl hi. Aksite leng abawl hi.
Pathian in huaite lei tanvak ding in van a vansin ah akoih a;
sun tung leh zan tung a vaihawm ding leh vak leh mial khen ding in. Huchi in Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
Huchi in ani lina ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
Pathian in, "Tuite'n thilsiam tang thei hinna neite tampi pawtsak uhenla, vasate leng leitung a vansin hawm heuhou ah leng uhen," achi hi.

Pathian in ngapi liante asiam a, ganhing tang thei chiteng tui in apawtsak a, amaute chi omdan ding bang leh kha nei vasa chiteng amaute chi omdan ding bang in asiam hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
Pathian in, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, tuipi tuite dimsak unla, vasate leng lei ah pung uhen," chi in avualzawl hi.
Huchi in ani ngana ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
Pathian in, "Lei in ganhing amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in; gante, bokvak a pai ganhingte, gamsate, amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in pawtsak uhen," achi a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.

Pathian in gamsa amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in, gante amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in, lei a thil bokvak a paite tengteng amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in abawl hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
Pathian in, "I kibatpih in, eimah bang in mihing i bawl dia, tuipi a ngasate tung ah, tung a leng vasate tung ah, gante tung ah leh leitung tengteng tung ah thu i neisak ding," achi hi.
Pathian in ama kibatpih in mihing asiam a, akibatpih mah in ahi asiam; pasal leh numei asiamta hi.

Pathian in amaute avualzawl hi. Pathian mah in akiang uah, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, leitung luahdim unla, na thuthu un omsak un. Tuipi a ngasate tung ah, tung a leng vasate tung ah, thil hing leitung a bokvak a pai tengteng tung ah thu nei un," achi hi.
Pathian mah in, "Ngai un, leitung tengteng a anteh chi nei om teng leh sing chiteng, sing chi nei gah omnate, ka hon pia hi; na an ding uh ahi.

Lei a gamsa chiteng kiang ah, tung a leng vasa chiteng kiang ah, leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng kiang ah, hinna nei chiteng kiang ah a-an ding un loupa hing chiteng ka pia hi," achi a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
Pathian in athilsiam tengteng a-en a, ngai in, hoih asa mahmah hi. Huchi in ani gukna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
Hiaite Noah tapa Shem, Ham leh Japheth suante ahi uh. Tuichim tun nung in tapate anei chiat uhi.
Japheth tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek leh Tiras ahi uh.
Gomer tapate: Ashkenaz, Riphath leh Togarmah ahi uh.
Javan tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim leh Dodanim ahi uh.
Huaite a kipan in Zentelte, amau pau leh amau nam dungzui zel in, amau chite omna tuikulh gam, amau gamte ah akikhenzak uhi.
Ham tapate: Kush, Mizraim, Put leh Kanaan ahi uh.
Kush tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah leh Sabtekhah ahi uh. Raamah tapate: Sheba leh Dedan ahi uh.
Kush in tapa Nimrod anei hi. Amah leitung ah mihattak ahong hi panta hi.
TOUPA ma ah sabengmi hattak ahi a; huaiziak in ahi, "TOUPA ma a sabet hattak Nimrod bang ahi," achih zel uh.
Alal patna Shinar gam a Babel khua, Erek khua, Akkad khua leh Shinar gam a Kalneh khua ahi uh.
Huai gam a kipan apawt a, Assuria gam ah alut a, Nineveh khua, Rehoboth-Ir khua leh Kalah khua asat hi.
Nineveh leh Kalah kikal ah Resen khua asat a, huai Resen khua thupitak ahi.
Mizraim in Ludte, Anamte, Lehabte, Naphtuhte,
Pathruste leh Kasluhte, Philistiate leh Kaphtorte pawtna asuang hi.
Kanaan in tapa masa Zidon anei a, Heth leng anei lai a,
Jebuste, Amorte, Girgaste;
Hivte, Arkate, Sinte;
Arvadte, Zemarte, Hamathte asuang; huai nung in Kanaan namte akithehzakta uhi.
Kanaante gamgi Zidon a kipan Gerar, Gaza, Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboim leh Lasa khua tan ahi.
Huaite, anamte dungzui zel leh apaute, agamte leh anamte lak ua dungzui zel in Ham suante ahi uh.
Shem, Eber ta tengteng suangpa, Japheth upa'n leng tate anei hi.
Shem tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud leh Aram ahi uh.
Aram tapate: Uz, Hul, Gether leh Mash ahi uh.
Arpakshad in tapa Shelah anei a; Shelah in tapa Eber anei hi.
Eber in tapa nih anei a: khat min Peleg ahi a, adam lai a leitung akikhen ziak in; anau min Joktan ahi.
Joktan in tapa Almodad, Seleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah;
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah;
Obal, Abimael, Sheba;
Ophir, Havilah leh Jobab anei a; huai tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
Atenna uh Mesha a kipan suahlam tang Sephar tan ahi.
Huaite Shem suante ahi ua; anamte dungzui zel leh apaute dungzui zel in, agamte ah leh achite dungzui zel in.
Huaite Noah suan namte ahi ua, asuante uh dungzui zel in achite uh lak ah; tuichim tun nung in huaite a kipan ahi a; lei a chi chih khenkhiak ahi uhi.
Huan lei a mi tengteng in khat leh paudan khat anei uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, suahlam a kipan akisuan zel lai un, Shinar gam ah phaizang amu ua; huai ah atengta uhi.
"Kisa un, teklei i bawl ding a, hoihtak in i hal ding," akichita uhi. Suang sik in teklei anei ua, suang hukna sik in longnai anei uhi.
"Kisa un, khopi i bawl ding a, avum in van sun ding in insang i bawl ding ua, i min i thangsak ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw leitung pumpi ah thehdalh in i om kha ding," achi uhi.
Mite tate' khopi leh insang lam en ding in TOUPA ahohsuk hi.
TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih ua, mite pum khat ahi ua, avek un lah pau khat anei ngal ua; hiai thil ahih pan uhi. Tu'n zaw athil hihtupte uh leng kham vual ahita kei ding.
Kisa un, i va hohsuk ding ua, pau akitheihtuah louhna ding un, apau uh i va suk lamdangsak ding," akichi uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N amaute huai a pan leitung tengteng ah adalhsak hi. Huchi in akhopi bawl uh atawpsanta uhi.
Huaiziak in amin Babel achi ua; TOUPA'N leitung tengteng ah amaute adalhsakta hi.
Hiaite Shem suante ahi uh. Shem kum zakhat a upa ahi a; tuichim tun nung kum nih nung in tapa Arpakshad anei hi.
Arpakshad aneih nung in Shem kum zanga adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Arpakshad in kum sawmthum-le-nga ahih in tapa Shelah anei hi.
Shelah aneih nung in Arpakshad kum zali-le-thum adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Shelah in kum sawmthum ahih in tapa Eber anei hi.
Eber aneih nung in Shelah kum zali-le-thum adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Eber in kum sawmthum-le-li ahih in tapa Peleg anei hi.
Peleg aneih nung in Eber kum zali-le-sawmthum adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Peleg in kum sawmthum ahih in tapa Reu anei hi.
Reu aneih nung in Peleg kum zanih-le-kua adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Reu in kum sawmthum-le-nih ahih in, tapa Serug anei hi.
Serug aneih nung in Reu kum zanih-le-sagih adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Serug in kum sawmthum ahih in tapa Nahor anei hi.
Nahor aneih nung in Serug kum zanih adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Nahor in kum sawmnih-le-kua ahih in tapa Terah anei hi.
Terah aneih nung in Nahor kum za-le-sawmkua adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Terah in kum sawmsagih ahih in tapate Abram, Nahor leh Haran anei hi.
Hiaite Terah suante ahi ua: Terah in tapa Abram, Nahor leh Haran anei a; Haran in tapa Lot anei hi.
Haran ahihleh apianna gam, Kaldaite khua Ur ah, apa Terah ma in asi hi.
Abram leh Nahor in zi anei ua; Abram zi min Sarai ahi a, Nahor zi min Haran tanu Milkah ahi. Haran ahihleh Milkah pa leh Iskah pa ahi.
Sarai achiing a; ta himhim anei kei.
Terah in atapa Abram, atapa Haran tapa Lot, amou, atapa Abram zi Sarai api a; Kanaan a hoh ding in Kaldaite khua Ur a kipan apawtkhekhawm uhi. Haran ahong tung ua, huai ah ateng uhi.
Terah damsung kum zanih-le-nga ahi a, Haran ah Terah asi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Abram kiang ah, "Na khua a kipan leh na tanaute a kipan leh na pa inn a kipan pawt inla, ka hon etsak ding gam ah pai in.
Chi thupi mahmah in ka hon bawl dia, ka hon vualzawl ding a, na min ka hih thupi ding. Nang vualzawlna na hi ding hi.
"Nang hon vualzawl peuhmah ka vualzawl ding a, hon hamsiat peuhmah ka hamsiat ding. Nang ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N akiang a agen bang in Abram akuankheta a; Lot in azui hi. Haran a kipan Abram apawt lai in kum sawmsagih-le-nga a upa ahi.
Abram in azi Sarai leh asang gampa' tapa Lot leh athil kaihkhawm tengteng uh leh Haran khua a, ami neih tengteng uh api a; Kanaan gam a teng ding in apawt ua; Kanaan gam atung uhi.
Abram huai gam a Shekem mun pha in, Moreh tosaw tan in apai zel hi. Huai lai in, huai gam ah Kanaante ateng uhi.
Abram kiang ah TOUPA akilak a, "Na suante kiang ah hiai gam ka pe ding," achi hi. Huai ah akiang a kilak TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh hi.
Huai a kipan Bethel suahlam a tanggam ah akisuan a, huai ah apuanin akai hi. Atumlam ah Bethel a-om a, asuahlam ah Ai khua a-om hi. Huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh nawn a, TOUPA min alou hi.
Sim gam lam zuan in Abram akisuan lai hi.
Huai gam ah kial akia a; huai gam anak kial mahmah ziak in, Aigupta gam a om tadih ding in Abram apaisuk hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam lut ding a akisak lai un, azi Sarai kiang ah, "Ngai in, numei melhoihtak na hi, chih ka thei hi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, Aiguptate'n nang ahon muh chiang un, 'Hiai azi ahi,' achi ding ua; kei hon that in, nang ahon hawi ding uh.
Nang ziak a hoihtak a ka omtheihna ding in leh nang vang a ka hintheihna ding in, hehpih in asanggamnu ka hi chi zel in," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta a Abram alutleh, Aiguptate'n numei amu ua, amel hoih ana sa mahmah uhi.
Pharaoh miliante'n leng amu ua, Pharaoh kiang ah ahoihdan agen uhi. Huchi in numei Pharaoh inn ah apilutta uhi.
Ama'n Sarai ziak in Abram hoihtak in abawl a; belamte, bawngte, sabengtungpate, sikhapate, sikhanute, sabengtungnute leh sangawngsaute aneihloh hial hi.
TOUPA'N Abram zi Sarai ziak in Pharaoh leh a-inkuante tung ah hipi khawktak atungsak hi.
Pharaoh in Abram asam a, "Ka tung a na thilhih bangchidan amai a? Na zi ahi chih bangziak a hon hilh lou na hia? Bangziak a, 'Ka sanggamnu ahi,' chi na hia?
Huaiziak akei maw, ka zi ding a ka na neih hial, huaiziak in, tu'n en in, na zi pi inla, paimang in," achi hi.
Pharaoh in atungthu ah mi kiang ah thu apia a, azi leh aneih tengteng toh asawlkhia hi.
Aigupta gam a kipan Abram pawt in simlam ah apaitou a, akiang ah azi, aneih tengteng leh Lot leng apaitou hi.
Abram tuh ganta, dangkate leh dangka-engte in ahausa mahmah hi.
Negev a kipan Bethel tan in apai zel a, Bethel leh Ai khua kikal atung a, achil a apuanin akaihna mun tanpha,
maitam adoh masakna mun mah ah Abram in TOUPA min alou hi.
Lot leng Abram kiang a pai in, belamhonte, bawnghonte leh puaninte anei hi.
A-omkhawmna ding un gam akichingta kei a; avan neih uh atam mahmah ziak in, a-omkhawm thei nawnta kei uhi.
Abram ganpute leh Lot ganpute kikal ah kiselna ahong omta a; huai lai in huai gam ah Kanaante leh Perizte ateng uhi.
Abram in Lot kiang ah, "Hehpih in, nang leh kei kikal ah, na ganpute leh ka ganpute kikal ah leng kiselna om kei hen; unau lah i hi ngal a," achi hi.

"Gam pumpi na ma ah a-om kei a hia? Hehpih in ka kiang a kipan tuam om mai in. Nang veilam a na paileh, kei taklam ah ka pai ding, ahihkeileh, nang taklam a na paileh, kei veilam ah ka pai ding," achi hi.

Lot adak a, Zoar kholam zuan in, Jordan Phaizang tengteng, TOUPA huan bang ahihkeileh Aigupta gam bang in, gam chih a tui tampi omna ahi chih athei hi: TOUPA'N Sodom leh Gomorrah ahihsiat ma lah ahi ngal a.
Lot in Jordan Phaizang tengteng atelta hi. Suahlam ah Lot akisuan a; huchi in akikhenta uhi.
Kanaan gam ah Abram ateng a, phaizang khopite ah Lot ateng a, Sodom khua pha in apuanin akai hi.
Ahi a, Pathian mitmuh in Sodom mite nakpitak in hoih lou leh khial in a-om uhi.
Akiang a kipan Lot a-om tuam nung in, TOUPA'N Abram kiang ah, "Dak inla, na omna a kipan mallam, simlam, suahlam leh tumlam en in.
Na gam muh tengteng na kiang ah leh na suante kiang ah tangtawn a ding in ka hon pe ding.
Na suante lei a leivui bang in ka bawl ding hi. Mi'n lei a leivui asim seng uleh, na suante leng sim seng ahi ding uh.
Thou inla, gam dung leh vai palsuak in; na kiang a hon pe ding ka hi," achi hi.
Abram in apuanin asuan a, Hebron a om Mamre tosaw kiang ah atengta a, huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh hi.
Huan Shinar kumpipa Amraphel, Ellasar kumpipa Ariok, Elam kumpipa Kedorla-omer, Goiim kumpipa Tidal dam lai in hichi ahong hi a;
amau Sodom kumpipa Bera asim uhi. Gomorrah kumpipa Birsha, Admah kumpipa Sinab, Zeboiim kumpipa Semeber, Bela kumpipa leng asim uhi, huai tuh Zoar ahi.
Hiai tengteng Siddim Phaizang ah apang uh, huai tuh Chi Tuipi ahi.
Kum sawm-le-nih sung Kedorla-omer nuai ah ana om ua, akum sawm-le-thumna in ahelta uhi.
Akum sawm-le-lina ah Kedorla-omer leh akiang a kumpipa omte ahong ua, Asteroth-karnaim ah Rephaimte athat ua, Ham ah Zuzimte athat ua, Shaveh-kariathaim ah Emimte athat uh;
a-omna Seir tang a El-paran gamdai zul a Horte omna tanpha in.
Akik nawn ua, Enmishpat atung ua, huai ahihleh Kadesh ahi a, Amalekte gam a mi teng leh Amorte, Hazezon-tamar a tengte leng athat nawn uhi.
Sodom kumpipa, Gomorrah kumpipa, Admah kumpipa, Zeboiim kumpipa leh Bela (huai Zoar kichi) kumpipa apawt ua, Siddim Phaizang ah amau sual ding in apangta uhi.
Elam kumpipa Kedorla-omer, Goiim kumpipa Tidal, Shinar kumpipa Amraphelte, Ellasar kumpipa Ariok sual ding in, Kumpipa li in kumpipa nga asual uhi.
Longnai khuk in Siddim Phaizang adim a; Sodom leh Gomorrah kumpipate ataikekna lam uah, khenkhatte huai ah akia ua, akeloute tang ah ataitou uhi.
Sodom leh Gomorrah mite sum tengteng leh anek ding tengteng uh la in apaita uhi.
Sodom a om Abram unaupa tapa, Lot leh aneih teng toh alaksak ua, apaita uhi.
Huai a pan suakta mi khat ahong pai a, Hebru mi Abram ahilh a, amah Amor mi Mamre tosaw kiang a teng ahi. Mamre ahihleh Eshkol leh Aner unaupih ahi a; huai mite Abram toh pangkhawm ahi uh.
Abram in unaupa sal in api uh chih azaktak in, a-inn a piang, ama'n achilsiamsa mi zathum apikhia a, Dan khua pha in adelhta hi.
Zan in amau sual ding in amah leh asikhate akihawmzak ua, azou ua Hobah pha in adelh uh; Hobah bel Damaskas mallam a om ahi.
Thil tengteng alakik nawn vek a, a-unaupa Lot leh aneih tengteng ban ah midang tengteng toh, numeite leng ahon pi nawn hi.
Kedorla-omer leh akiang a om kumpipate zou a, apaikik lam in Shaveh Phaizang (huai Kumpipa Phaizang kichi) ah Abram dawn ding in Sodom kumpipa ahohsuk hi.
Salem kumpipa Melkizedek in tanghou leh uain ahon tawi a; amah Pathian Tungnungpen siampu ahi.
Ama'n Abram avualzawl a, "Lei leh van neipa, Pathian Tungnungpen, Abram vualzawl in om hen.
Na melmate na khut a hon pepa, Pathian Tungnungpen phat in om hen," achi hi. Abram in amah bangkim a sawm- a-khat apia hi.
Sodom kumpipa'n Abram kiang ah, "Mite hon pia inla, thilte zaw nang kineih in," achi hi.
Abram in Sodom kumpipa kiang ah, "Lei leh van neipa, TOUPA, Pathian Tungnungpen lam ah ka khut ka zakta hi.
Khauzang khat lel leng, khedap khau khat lel leng, na neih himhim ka la kei ding, huchi lou in zaw, Abram, kei hauhsaksak ahi, na chi kha ding," achi hi.
"Tangvalte nekmang leh ka mi tonpihte tantuan kia lou zaw ka la kei ding, Aner, Eshkol leh Mamrete'n atantuan uh la uhen," achi hi.
Huai thilte nung in, "Abram, lau ke'n, kei na phaw leh na kipahman thupitak ka hi,” chi in Abram kiang ah mengmuhna in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Abram in, "Aw, Toupa PATHIAN, bang na hon pe dia, ta nei lou a ka om na mu a, ka goukempa lah Damaskas a Eliezer ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Abram mah in, "Ngai in, chi lah na hon suahsak kei a; en in, ka inn a piang pen mah ka gouluahpa hong hi ding ahi,” achi hi.
"Ngai in, huai mi na gouluah ding ahi kei. Nangmah gil a hong gah ding ngei, na gouluah ahi zaw ding,” chi in akiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Amah inpua ah apikhia a, "Van lam en inla, aksite na simtheihleh sim him in," achi hi. Amah mah in akiang ah, "Na suante huchibang ahi ding uh," achi hi.
Ama'n TOUPA agingta a, huchi in ama'n huai adiktatna in asehsakta hi.
Akiang ah, "Hiai gam na luah ding a hon pe ding a Kaldaite khua Ur a kipan hon pikhia TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, ka luah ding chih, bangchi in ka theithei dia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, akiang ah, "Bawngla kum thum a upa, kelpi kum thum a upa, vakhu leh vapalnou hon la in," achi hi.
Huai teng ahon la a, alaitak ah aphelkhap chiat a, aphel khat, aphel khat lam doh in akoih chiat a; vasate bel aphelkhap kei hi.
Sasial ne vasate'n saluangte tung abohsuk chiang un Abram in ana hawlkhe zel hi.
Ni tum ding a akisak lai in, Abram a-ihmu hithit hi. Ngai in, amial a mial, thil mulkimhuai petmah in amah hon khuh hi.
Hiai thilte nung in Pathian in Abram kiang ah, "Na suante amau gam hilou ah mikhual in a-om ding ua, a-nna uh asepsak ding uh, chih teltak in thei in. Kum zali sung hihgentheih in a-om ding uh.
A-nna uh asepsak nam uh ka vaihawmkhum ding hi. Huai khit chiang in thil tampi nei in ahong paikhe ding uh.
Nang na pipute kiang ah lungmuangtak in na pai ding a; na lu a kelsam pou vek in ahon vui ding uhi.
Himahleh, Amorte khelhnate akim nai louh ziak in, suan lina ah hiai ah ahong pai nawn ding uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni tum a, khua ahong mial in, ngai in, haltuina mei khu lunglung leh meisel kuang luahluah, huai sa kiphelkhapte kal a paipai ahong om hi.
Huai ni mah in TOUPA'N Abram toh thukhun bawl in, "Hiai gam, Aigupta lui a kipan lui lian, Euphrates Luipi pha in na suante kiang ah ka peta," achi hi.
Kente, Kenizte, Kadmonte,
Hitte, Perizte, Rephate,
Amorte, Kanaante, Girgaste leh Jebuste toh leng ka pe lai hi, chi in Abram toh thu akhungta hi.
Huan Abram zi, Sarai in ta aneihsak kei hi. Sarai in Aigupta mi sikhanu khat anei a, amin Hagar ahi.
Sarai in Abram kiang ah, "Ngai dih ve, TOUPA'N lah ta ka neih hon phal lou a; hehpih in ka sikhanu kithuahpih in. Amah a pan tate ka neih khakleh,” achi hi. Huchi in Abram in Sarai thu azuita hi.
Kanaan gam a Abram kum sawm a-om nung in, Abram zi Sarai in asikhanu Aigupta mi api a, apasal Abram kiang ah azi ding in apia hi.
Hagar athei a, huan agaita hi. Agai chih akitheihtak in, api asimmoh maimah hi.
Sarai in Abram kiang ah, "Ka thil thuak amoh nang pua in. Ka sikhanu na kawi ding in ka hon pia a; agai chih akitheihtak in, hon simmoh maimah hi. TOUPA'N nang leh kei kikal ngaihtuah hen," achi hi.
Abram in Sarai kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhanu na khut a om ahi, nang pha na sak bang in atung ah hih in," achi hi. Sarai in ahihgentheih mahmah tak in ataimangsanta hi.
TOUPA angel in gamdai a tuikhuk kiang a, Shur zotna lampi a tuikhuk kiang ah ana mu hi.
Akiang ah, "Hagar, Sarai sikhanu aw, koi a kipan hong pai a, koi a hoh dia kisa na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka pi Sarai kiang a kipan taimang ka hi,” achi hi.
TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Na pi kiang ah kik nawn inla, athuthu in om in," achi hi.
TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Na suante sim seng louh khop hial a tam in ka pungsak ding," achi nawn hi.
TOUPA angel mah in akiang ah, "Ngai in, nau na paita, tapa na nei ding a; TOUPA'N na gimthuakna azak ziak in amin Ishmael na sak ding ahi.
Amah gam-sabiltung bang ahi ding a; michih adou ding a, michih in leng amah adou ding uh. Asanggamte a kipan atuam ten ding," achi nawn hi.
Hagar in amah houpih TOUPA min, "Nang muthei Pathian na hi," chih asa hi. "Pathian mu a, hing lai ka hi maw?" achi ngal a.
Huaiziak in huai tuikhuk Beer-lahai-roi sak ahita. Ngai in, huai Kadesh leh Bered kho kikal a om ahi.
Hagar in Abram tapa aneihsak a; Abram in atapa, Hagar in aneihsak min Ishmael asata hi.
Hagar in Abram a ding a Ishmael aneihsak lai in Abram kum sawmgiat-le-guk a upa ahi.
Abram kum sawmkua-le-kua a upa ahih in, Abram kiang ah TOUPA akilak a, akiang ah, "Kei Pathian Bangkim hihthei ka hi; ka ma ah pai inla, hoihkim in om in.
Nang toh i kal ah thu ka khung ding a, nakpitak in ka hon pungsak ding," achi hi.
Abram abokkhup a; Pathian in amah ahoupih hi.
"Ngai in, ke'n zaw, na kiang ah ka thukhun ahi ka khun, nam tampite' Pa na hita ding.
Na min leng Abram ahi nawnta kei ding a, na min Abraham ahi zawta ding; nam tampite' Pa ding a ka hon bawl tak ziak in.
Nakpitak in ka hon chiphasak ding a, nang ah nam tampi ka bawl ding a, nang a kipan kumpipate ahong piangkhe ding uh.
"Kei leh nang leh na suante, suan sawnsawnte tan in leng ka thukhun nang a ding leh na nung a na suante a ding a, a Pathian uh hi ding in, tangtawn thukhun ding in ka hihkip ding hi.
Na kiang ah leh na nung a na suante kiang ah mikhual na hihna gam, Kanaan gam tengteng, tangtawn gou ding un ka hon pe ding, kei a Pathian uh ka hi ding," achi hi.
Pathian mah in Abraham kiang ah, "Nang ka thukhun na zui ding ahi. Na nung a na suante suan sawnsawnte tan in leng azui ding uhi.
Hiai kei leh nang leh na suante kal a ka thukhun na zuih ding uh ahi. Na lak ua pasal peuhmah in zek asum ding ahi.
Na zekvun sa uh na sum ding ua, huai tuh nang toh i kal a thukhun chiamtehna ahi ding hi.

Na lak ua kuapeuh ni giat a upa, na suan sawnsawn tan un leng, na suan hi chitchiat lou leng na inn a piang hiam, mikhual kuapeuh a kipan dangka sum a na lei hiam leng, pasal peuhmah zek sum ding ahi.
Na inn a piang leh na dangka sum a na leite leng zeksum ngeingei ding ahi. Ka thukhun tangtawn thukhun ding in na sa ah a-omta ding hi.
Pasal zeksum louh leh azekvun sa a zeksum a om lou, achipihte lak a kipan satkhiak ahi ding; ama'n ka thukhun hihsia ahi," achi nawn hi.
Pathian mah in, Abraham kiang ah, "Na zi Sarai, amin Sarai na chi nawnta kei ding a, amin Sarah ahi zawta ding hi.
Amah ka vualzawl ding a, huai lou leng amah ah tapa ka hon pe ding. Ahi, amah ka vualzawl ding a, namte nu ahita ding. Amah a kipan nam tuamtuam kumpipate ahong om ding uh," achi hi.
Abraham abokkhup a, anui a, alungsim in mi kum za a upa in ta anei ding maw? Sarah kum sawmkua a upa in ta anei ding maw? achi hi.
Abraham mah in Pathian kiang ah, "Na ma ah Ishmael om thei maileh aw," achi hi.
Pathian in, "Hilou e, na zi Sarah in tapa ahon neihsak taktak ding a; amin Isak na sak ding ahi. Ka thukhun, anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn thukhun ding in akiang ah ka hihkip ding.

Ishmael tungthu leng ka hon ngaihkhiaksak hi. Ngai in, amah ka vualzawlta a, chi tampi ka suangsak ding hi. Nakpitak in leng ka pungsak ding a, ama'n vaihawmmi sawm-le-nih asuang ding a, amah chi thupitak in ka bawl ding hi.
Himahleh ka thukhun, Sarah in kum nawn hichi hun a ahon neihsak ding Isak kiang ah ahi ka hihkip ding," achi hi.
Akiang a thugen azoh in, Pathian in Abraham apaitouh santa hi.

Abraham in atapa Ishmael leh a- inn a piang tengteng leh dangka sum a alei tengteng, Abraham inkuante lak a pasal peuhmah api a, Pathian in akiang a agen bang in, huai ni mah in azekvun uh asumsak chiat hi.
Abraham zekvun asum lai in kum sawmkua-le-kua a upa ahi.
Atapa Ishmael azekvun asum lai un kum sawm-le-thum a upa ahi,
Huai ni mah in Abraham leh atapa Ishmael zeksum ahita uh.
A-inkuanpihte lak a pasal tengteng, a-inn a piangte leh mikhual a kipan dangka sum a aleite leng, amah toh zeksum ahi vekta uhi.
Huan sun nisat laitak a puanin kongkhak bul a Abraham atut lai in, Mamre a tosaw kiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak hi.
Abraham dak in a-en a, ngai in, akiang ah mi thum ana dingh uhi. Amuhtak in puanin kongkhak a kipan amaute tuak ding in ava tai a, lei lam ah akunsuk hi.
"Ka toupa na deihsakna ka tan theihleh hehpih in na sikha hon paikheng mahmah ke'n.
Tui tawmchik bek hon la uhenla, na khete uh sil unla, sing nuai ah khawl tadih un.

Tanghou tawmchik bek ka va la ding a, na lungtang uh halhsak un. Huai khit chiang in na pai zom zel na ding uh. Huai ding a na sikha kiang a hong pai na hi peuhmah ding uh," achi hi. Amau, "Na chih bang in va hih in," achi uhi.
Puanin sung a Sarah kiang ah Abraham ava lut pah a, "Tangbuang nel mahmah tehna thum bawl in, mek inla, tanghou pei in bawl in," achi hi.
7 Ganhon lam ah Abraham atai a, bawngnou hoihtak ava man a, asikha kiang ah apia a, ama'n abawl mengmeng hi.
Nawituidat, nawitui leh bawngnou sa kibawl ala a, ama uah ava luita hi. Amau anek sung teng uh, sing nuai ah akiang uah adingh nilouh hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Na zi Sarah koi a om ahia?" achi ua, "Ama'n pam a puanin ah," achi hi.
Amaute'n, "Hun ahong chin nawn peuhpeuh chiang in na kiang ah ka hong nawn ngeingei ding uh. Ngai in, na zi Sarah in tapa anei ding," achi hi. Anung a puanin kongkhak bul a kipan Sarah in ana za hi.
Abraham leh Sarah upapi, tektak ahita ua; numei dan ngeina Sarah ah akam khin thamta hi.
Sarah in tektak ka hih nung in nopsakna ka nei thei lai diam maw, ka toupa lah a-upata ngal a? chi in alungsim in anui hi.
TOUPA'N Abraham kiang ah, "Bang achia Sarah in, kei pitek in ta ka nei thei lai diam maw, chi a nui ahia?
TOUPA a ding in thil himhim haksa lua a-om a hia? Hun seh ahong tun chiang in, na kiang ah ka hong nawn ding a, Sarah in tapa anei ding," achi hi.
Sarah in alauh ziak in, "Ka nui kei," chi in anial hi. Ama'n, "Zuau ahi, na nui tawk ve," achi hi.
Huai a kipan mite adingh ua, Sodom kholam a-en ua, amaute khakhe ding in akiang uah Abraham apai hi.
TOUPA'N, "Ka thilhih ding Abraham ka iim diam aw;
Abraham lah chi thupi leh thilhihtheitak ahong hi ngei ding a, amah ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl a om ding ahihdante?

Anung a atate leh a-inkuanpihte'n diktatna leh thudik a TOUPA lampi zui a, vaihawmna ding thu apiaktheihna ding in amah ka septa a; huchi a atungthu genpa TOUPA'N Abraham tung a atunsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N, “Sodom leh Gomorrah kalh a kikou thawmging anasa a, agitlouh mahmah ziak un.
Tu in ka hohsuk ding a, akikou ging uh ka kiang a hong tung bangbang in ahih uhia, hih lou, ka en ding a, ahih kei uleh ka thei mai ding," achi hi.
Huai a kipan mite akihei ua, Sodom kholam azuanta uhi. Abraham bel TOUPA ma ah adingh lai hi.
Abraham in ava naih a, “Mikhialte lak a midiktatte hihmangkhawm tel ding na hi maw?
Khosung ah midiktat sawmnga bek a-om kha ding uh e. Asung a midiktat sawmnga omte ziak in akhua hawi lou in na hihmang ding maw?
Nang hial in zaw migiloute bang a midiktatte a-om samna ding ua migiloute lak a midiktatte hihlup zaw na hih tel kei ding hi. Leitung pumpi Vaihawmpa in diktattak in ahih kei dia hia?" achi hi.
TOUPA'N, “Sodom a midiktat sawmnga ka muhleh amau ziak in akho pumpi ka hawi ding,” achi hi.
Abraham in, "Ngai in, kei leivui leh meivu lel in Toupa ka hon houpih thei hi.
Midiktat nga in sawmnga chingzou lou ahi kha ding e; nga achin louh ziak in kho pumpi na hihmang ding maw? chi in adawng hi. Ama'n sawmli-le-nga ka muhleh ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
Ama'n amah ahoupih zel a, "Huai ah sawmli kia na mu ahi kha ding e," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawmli ziak in leng ka hihmang dah mai ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Toupa aw, heh ke'n, ka hon gen nawn lai ding. Huai ah sawmthum lel na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Huai a sawmthum leng ka muhleh ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ngai in, Toupa ka hon houpih theita a, huai ah sawmnih kia na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawmnih ziak in leng ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Toupa aw, heh ke'n, khatvei kia ka hon gen lai ding. Huai ah sawm kia na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawm ziak in leng ka hihmang kei ding,” achi hi.
Abraham toh akihou khit un TOUPA apaita a; Abraham leng amun ah akik nawnta hi.
Huan angel nih in nitaklam in Sodom khua aphasuk ua, Sodom khokulh kongkhak ah Lot ana tu hi. Lot in amaute ana mu a, va tuak ding in adingh a, amai a lei si in chibai abuk a,

"Ngai un, ka toupate aw, hehpih in na sikha inn ah hong lut phot unla, giak unla, na khete uh sil un. Na thou baih ding ua, na pai nawn na ding uh," achi hi. Huan amau, "Hilou e, kholak ah ka giak zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
Himahleh ama'n nakpitak in akun a; akiang ah api a, huchi in a-inn ah alutta uhi. Ama'n meh abawlsak a, tanghou silngou soh louh akang a, aneta uhi.
Alup ma un khopi a mite, Sodom khomite, veng teng a mi tengteng, atek-akhang in a-inn ava umkimvel uhi.
Lot kiang ah, "Tuzan a na inn a hong lut mite koi a om uh ahia? Amau ka kithuahpih theihna ding un ka kiang uah hon pikhia in," ahong chi uhi.
Kongkhak bul ah akiang uah Lot ava pawt a, kongkhak akhak hi.
"Ka unaute aw, hehpih in, hichi tel in gilou dah un.

Ngai un, pasal' kithuahpih ngei nai louh tanu nih ka nei hi. Hon hehpih unla, na kiang uah amaute ka hon pikhe ding a, hoih na sak bang un, atung uah na hih na ding uh. Hiai mite tung ah zaw bangmah hih mahmah kei un. Hiai ding a ka insung a hong lut lah ahi ngal ua," achi hi.

Amau, "Hon hon mai in," achi uhi. Amau mah in, “Hiai mi sop lai hiai a teng ding in ahong pem lut a, vaihawmpa a om maw atup vial. Tu'n amaute tung a hih sang in nang tung ah ka hihse zaw sem ding uh," achi uhi. Lot abohta ua, kongkhak hihse ding in hon naih uhi.
Himahleh mite'n akhut uh agolhkhia ua, akiang uah insung ah Lot akailut ua, kongkhak akhak bikbek uhi.
Kongkhak bul a mite, aneu-alian mit atawsak ua, huchi in kongkhak amuzouta kei uh.
Mite'n Lot kiang ah, "Hiai mite lou hiai ah inkuanpih dang na nei hia? Na makpate, na tapate, na tanute leh khosung a na neih peuhmahte khua a kipan pikhia in.
TOUPA ma a, akikou husa uh anasat luat tak ziak in hiai khua hihmang ding ka hi uh. Hihmang ding in TOUPA'N hon sawl ahi," achi uhi.

Lot apaikhia a, atanute kitenpih, amakpate kiang ah ava gen hi. "Thou unla, hiai khua a kipan pawtkhia un, TOUPA'N khua hihmang ding ahi,” achi hi. Himahleh amakpate ngaih in chiamnuih thu gen bang lel ahi.
Phalvak in angelte'n, "Thou inla, na zi leh hiai a na tanu nih omte pikhia in. Huchi lou in zaw hiai khua gawtna ah na mangkhawm kha ding uh," chi in Lot anohta uhi.
Himahleh a-awltat mahmah lai a, TOUPA'N amah ahehpih ziak in, mite'n ama khut leh azi khut leh atanu nihte khutte manbet in apikhia ua, kho polam ah akoihta uhi.

Huan polam a apikhiak khit un, khat in akiang ah, "Na hinna ding in taikhia in; na nunglam nga ke'nla, phaizang himhim ah leng khawl ke'n. Huai tang sang ah suahtak san in, huchi lou in zaw na mangkhawm kha ding hi,” achi hi.
Himahleh Lot in akiang uah, "Ka toupate aw, huai zaw hi kei hen.

Ngai in, na sikha in na mitmuh in deihsakna atang a, ka hinna humbitna ding in zahngaihna thupi na hon musak lai hi. Himahleh huai tang sang ah zaw ka tai thei kei ding, thil hoih lou khat in hon pha in ka si kha ding hi.
Ngai in, hiai khua taina ding in anaipen a, kho neuchik leng ahi. Aw, huai ah, kho neuchik ahi kei a hia! Hon taisak zaw in, huchi in ka hing ding hi," achi hi.
Ama'n, akiang ah, "Ngai in, hiai thil tungtang ah leng ka hon mang, na kho gen ka hihmang dah ding.
Kin inla, huai ah tai in. Huai mun na tun mateng lah bangmah ka hihthei ngal kei a," achi hi. Huaiziak in huai kho min Zoar chih in a-omta hi.
Zoar a Lot atun in leitung ah ni asuak khinta hi.
TOUPA'N Sodom leh Gomorrah kho tung ah van a TOUPA kiang a kipan mei leh kaat azusak hi.
Huai khuate, phaizang tengteng, khua a mite tengteng leh leitung a thilpoute tengteng ahihmang vekta hi.
Himahleh Lot nung ah azi in nunglam a-en a, huchi in chikhuam ahong suakta hi.
TOUPA ma a adinna mun ah beltak in Abraham ahohtou hi.
Sodom leh Gomorrah kholam leh phaizang gam lam tengteng a-en hi. Ngai in, huai gam a meikhu, haltuina meikhu bang mai in akhutou ngoingoi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in phaizang khopite, Lot tenna mun ngei ahihman lai in, Pathian in Abraham atheigige a, manthatna lak a pan Lot asawlkhia hi.
Zoar a kipan Lot apaitou a, tang ah ateng a, atanu nihte leng akiang ah ateng uhi. Zoar ah lah ateng ngam kei a, amah leh atanu nihte kohawm ah atengta uhi.
Huchi in atanu upazaw in anauzaw kiang ah, "I pa a-upata a, leitung tengteng dan bang a hon kithuahpih ding lei ah pasal khat leng a-om nawn kei hi.
Kisa in, i pa uain i dawnsak ding a, huchi a i pa chisuan bei lou a i bawltheihna ding in akiang ah i va lum ding," achi hi.
Huai zan in apa uh uain adawnsakta uhi. A-upazaw alut a, apa kiang ah ava lum a; ama'n alup lam ana phawk kei a, athoh lam leng aphawk kei hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in a-upazaw in anaupangzaw kiang ah, "Ngai in, zan in ka pa kiang ah ka va lum a; tuzan in leng uain i dawnsak nawn ding a; nang va lut inla, huchi a i pa chisuan bei lou a i bawltheihna ding in akiang ah va lum in," achi hi.
Huai zan in leng apa uh uain adawnsak nawn ua; anaupangzaw athou a, akiang ah ava lumta hi. Ama'n alup lam aphawk kei a, athoh lam leng aphawk kei hi.
Huchibang in Lot tanu nihte'n apa ua pan nau apai tuak uhi.
A-upazaw in tapa anei a, amin Moab asa a, huai mi tulai a Moabte suangpa ahi.
Anaupangzaw in leng tapa anei a, amin Ben-ammi asa a, huai mi tulai a Ammonte suangpa ahi.
Huan lei leh vante leh asung a om tengteng siam zoh ahita hi.
Pathian in ani sagih ni in anasep azou a; huchi in ani sagih ni in anasep tengteng akhawlsanta hi.
Huai ni a Pathian in asiam leh abawl, anasep tengteng akhawlsan tak ziak in, Pathian in ani sagih ni vualzawl in, atangta hi.
TOUPA Pathian in lei leh vante asiam ni a, lei leh vante siam ahih ua akisuansawndan uh hiai bang ahi.
Leitung ah gamlak loupa himhim a-om nai kei a, sing-le-louhing leng apou nai kei hi. TOUPA Pathian in leitung ah vuah azusak nai kei a, lei let ding in mihing leng a-om nai kei hi.
Himahleh lei a pan tuihu ahong pawttou a, leitung tengteng anomsak hi.
TOUPA Pathian in lei a leivui in mi abawl a, anakvangte ah hinna hu ahalut a; huai mi, hinna nei mihing ahong hita hi.
TOUPA Pathian in suahlam a Eden ah huan abawl a; huai ah abawl pasal a-omsak hi.
TOUPA Pathian in lei a kipan sing mit hiptak leh nek tuak chiteng apousak hi. Hinna sing leh asia leh apha theihna sing leng huan laizang ah apousak hi.
Eden a pan huan nomsak ding in lui aluang paisuak a; huai a kipan akazak a, ka li ahong hita hi.
Akhatna min Pishon ahi a, hiai Havilah gam tengteng kualkhum lui ahi a; huai dangka-eng omna ahi.
Huai gam a dangka-eng hoihtak ahi a, huai ah bedeli leh onik suang leng a-om hi.
Lui nihna min Gihon ahi a; huai lui in Kush gam tengteng akualkhum hi.
Lui thumna min Hiddekel ahi a; hiai Assuria gam suahlam a luang ahi. Lui lina bel Euphrates ahi.
TOUPA Pathian in pasal api a, Eden huan ah akem ding leh aveng ding in akoihta hi.
TOUPA Pathian in pasal kiang ah, "Huan a singgah chiteng na ut-ut na ne thei hi.
Asia leh apha theihna singgah bel na ne ding ahi kei. Na nekleh na nek ni mah in na si ngeingei ding hi," chỉ in thu apia hi.
TOUPA Pathian in, "Pasal amah kia a-om ahoih kei. Amah panpihtu dia kilawm ka bawlsak ding," achi hi.

TOUPA Pathian in leitung a kipan gamsa chiteng leh tung a leng vasa chiteng abawl hi. Amin ding ua bang sak ding ahia chih theihna ding in Adam kiang ah apikhawm hi. Ganhing chiteng amin uh Adam in ana phuah, huai amin uh ahi denta hi.
Adam in ganhing tengteng, tung a leng vasa tengteng leh gamsa chiteng min aphuak chiat hi. Himahleh Adam panpihtu ding muh in a-om kei hi.
TOUPA Pathian in nuamtak in Adam a-ihmusak a, huchi in a-ihmuta a; anakguh khat alakhia a, alakkhiakna mun sa in adimsak hi.
TOUPA Pathian in Adam a pan alak nakguh a kipan in numei abawl a, Adam kiang ah apita hi.
Adam in, "Hiai pen zaw ka guh a kipan guh, ka sa a kipan sa ahi. Pasal a kipan lakkhiak ahih ziak in, Numei, chih ding ahi," achi hi.
Huaiziak in pasal in anu leh apa apaisan ding a, azi ah abelh ding. Huchi in sa khat ahong hita ding uh.
Adam leh azi vuaktang ahi tuak ua, azum tuan kei uhi.
Huai a kipan Negeb gam lam zuan in Abraham akisuan a, Kadesh leh Shur kho kikal ah ateng a, Gerar ah hun bang tan hiam a-om tadih hi.
Abraham in azi Sarah, "Ka sanggamnu ahi,” achi hi. Gerar kumpipa Abimelek in mi asawl a, Sarah ava pisak hi.
Himahleh, zan in amanglam in Abimelek kiang ah Pathian ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na numei pi ziak in misi leltak na hita, amah lah mi zi ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Abimelek in anaih nai tadih kei hi, "Toupa, nam diktat na that hial dia hia?"
Amah mah in ka kiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu ahi," chi in; amah ngei in leng ka sanggampa ahi, achih behlap ngal a. "Lungtang hoihtak pu leh khut siangthoutak nei kawm a hiai bang ka hih ahi," achi hi.
Pathian in amang in, "Ahi, hiai lungtang hoihtak pu kawm a na hih ahi chih ka thei, ke'n leng ka tung a na khelh ding ka hon kham hi. Huaiziak in amah na khoih ka phal louh ahi.
Tu in huai mi zi pekik in; amah lah zawlnei ahi ngal a. Ahon thumsak ding a, na dam ding. Na piakkik keileh, na si ngeingei ding chih thei in; nang leh na neih tengteng toh," achi hi.
Abimelek beltak in athou a, asikha tengteng asam a, azak ding un huai thu tengteng ahilh a, mite'n alau mahmah uhi.

Abimelek in Abraham asam a, akiang ah, "Ka tung ua na thilhih bangchidan ahia oi? Bang lam ah ahia na tung a ka khelh a, kei leh ka lalgam tung a thil gilou thupitak na hon tut? Thil hih tuak louhtak ka tung ah na hihta," achi hi.
Abimelek mah in Abraham kiang ah, "Bang na mu a, hichibang a thil hih na maizen a?" achi nawn hi.
Abraham in, "Hiai khua a Pathian launa himhim om lou a, ka zi ziak in ahon that mai ding uh, chih ka ngaihtuah ziak a hiai bang a na gamtang mah ka hi.
Huai lou in ka sanggamnu leng ahi him a, ka pa tanu ahi a, ka nu tanu bel ahi kei. Himahleh amah ka zi ahong hita hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in ka pa inn a kipan ahon vakvaihsak lai in akiang ah, 'Hiai na hehpihna ka tung a na lahsak ding ahi. Ka tunna peuh uah, ka sanggampa ahi hon chi zel in' ka chi him hi,” achi hi.
Abimelek in belamte, bawng-talte, sikhapate leh sikhanute pi in Abraham kiang ah apia a, azi Sarah leng apekikta hi.
Abimelek in, "En in, na ma ah ka gam zapi a-om, na utna peuh ah teng in," achi hi.
Sarah kiang ah, "En in, na sanggampa dangka sangkhat ka peta hi. Ngai in, na kiang a om tengteng leh nangmah a ding in amah na mit khuhna ahi ding. Hiai bang in amah taihilh in a-om hi."
Pathian kiang ah Abraham athum a, Pathian in Abimelek leh azi leh asikhanute adamsak nawn a, huchi in tate aneita uhi.
Abraham zi Sarah ziak in TOUPA'N Abimelek inkuante tengteng achiingsak vek ngal a.
Huan TOUPA'N agensa bang in Sarah ava veh a, achiamsa bang in Sarah tung ah TOUPA'N ahihta hi.
Sarah agai a, Pathian in akiang a agen hun seh bang in, atek nung in Abraham tapa aneihsakta hi.
Abraham in Sarah in aneihsak atapa min Isak asa hi.
Abraham in Pathian in akiang a thu apiak bang in atapa Isak ni giat achin in azek asumsak hi.
Atapa Isak apian lai in Abraham kum zakhat a upa ahita.
Sarah in, "Pathian in hon nuisakta; aza kha peuhmah in hon nuihpih ding uh," achi hi.
Amah mah in, "Sarah in naungekte apom ding, chih kua'n ahia Abraham kiang a gen thei ding? Atek nung in tapa ka neihsakta,” achi hi.
Naungek ahong khanglian a, nawinek atawpsakta uh. Isak nawinek atawpsak ni un, Abraham in ankuang thupitak alui hi.
Aigupta mi Hagar tapa, Abraham a ding a aneihsak pen in Isak asimmohbawl lai Sarah in amu hi.
Huaiziak in Abraham kiang ah, "Hiai sikhanu leh atapa delhkhia in. Hiai sikhanu tapa in ka tapa Isak gou aluahpih thei kei ding,” achi hi.
Hiai thu atapa mah toh kisai ahih ziak in Abraham ngaih in thil hoih loutak ahi.

Himahleh Pathian in Abraham kiang ah, "Naupang tungtang thu leh na sikhanu tungtang thu na ngaih in thil hoih lou hi kei hen. Sarah in na kiang a thu agen tengteng zui in, Isak ah na suante kisim ding chih ahi ngal a,
Sikhanu tapa ah leng, na suan ahih ziak in, nam chih tham ngial ka bawl ding," achi hi.
Beltak in Abraham athou a, tanghou leh tuithawl, tui a dim ala a, Hagar kiang a pia in, aliangkou ah asuan a, naupang toh asawlkhia hi. Apai a, Beer-sheba gamdai ah avakvakta hi.
Tuithawl a tui ahong beitak in, sawlbawk lim nuai khat ah naupang akoihta mai hi.
"Naupang si ding ka en ngam kei," achih ziak in gamla kuam, thal kap phakna ding ah, ava pai a, amazawn a tu in ngaihtak in akapta hi.
Pathian in naupang aw aza a; Pathian angel in van a kipan Hagar asam a, akiang ah, "Bangchi na hia, Hagar? Lau ke'n, a-omna a naupang aw Pathian in aza hi.
Thou inla, naupang phong in, na khut in len in, amah nam thupitak a bawl ding ka hi," achi hi.
Pathian in amit ahihvaksak a, huan tuileh amuta hi. Huai ah ava pai a, tuithawl dim in tui adim a, naupang adawnsak hi.
Naupang kiang ah Pathian a-om a, ahong khanglian a; gamdai ah ateng zel a, thalkapmi ahong hita hi.
Paran gamdai dai ah ateng a; Aigupta gam a kipan zi aguan hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in Abimelek leh asepaih pawl a heutu Phikol in Abraham kiang ah, "Na thilhih peuh ah na kiang ah Pathian a-om.

Tu in hiai ah Pathian min lou inla, kei leh ka tapa leh ka tapa' tapa leng khem lou in, ka hon hehpih khit tak sa bang in kei leh na tenna gam hehpih thuk sam ding in ka kiang ah kichiam in," achi hi.
Abraham in, “Ka kichiam ding," achi hi.
Abimelek sikhate'n tuileh asuhsak ziak un Abraham in Abimelek asal hi.
Abimelek in, “Hiai thilhih pen kua ahia, ka thei himhim kei. Nang lah na hon hilh ngal kei a, tuni ngal lou in ka za kha himhim kei," achi hi.
Abraham in belamte leh bawngtalte api a, Abimelek kiang ah apia a; anih un thu akhungta uhi.
Abraham in abelamhon lak a belamnou anu sagih akoihtuam hi.
Abimelek in Abraham kiang ah, "Belamnou anu sagih atuam a na koih bang na chihna ahia?” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Hiai tuileh keimah leh ahi, chih na hon theihpihna ding in hiai belamnou anu sagih ka khut a kipan na lak ding ahi," achi hi.
Huaiziak in huai mun Beer-sheba asa hi; huai a anih ua akichiam ziak un.
Beer-sheba ah thu akhungta uh. Abimelek athou a, asepaih pawl heutu Philok toh Philistiate gam ah apai nawnta uhi.
Abraham in Beer-sheba ah meilah sing asuan a, huai ah TOUPA, Tangtawn Pathian min alou hi.
Philistiate gam ah Abraham sawtpi ataam hi.
Huai thilte nung in Pathian in Abraham a-enchian hi. Akiang ah, "Abraham," achi a; ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Na tapa, na tapa neihsun, na ittak, Isak tonpih inla, Moriah gam ah pai in, huai ah ka hon hilh ding tang khat ah halmang thillat in amah lan in," achi hi.
Beltak in Abraham athou a, sabiltung abawl a, akiang ah atapa Isak toh sikha tangval nih atonpih hi. Haltum thillat a ding in sing a-ek a, athou a, Pathian in ahilhna mun lam ah apaita hi.
Ani thum ni in Abraham adak a, amun gamlapi a om amu hi.

Abraham in asikha tangvalte kiang ah, "Hiai ah sabiltung toh ana om un. Kei leh naupang huai pam ah ka va hoh ding ua; huai ah Pathian ka va be ding ua; na kiang uah ka hong kik nawn ding uh," achi hi.
Abraham in halmang thillatna ding sing ala a, atapa Isak aposak hi. Ama'n mei leh temta atawi a; anih un apaikhawm uhi.
Isak in apa Abraham ahoupih a, "Pa," achi a, ama'n, "Bawi, hiai ah ka om,” achi hi. Ama'n, "En dih, mei leh sing a-om a; hileh leng halmang thillat ding belamnou lah koi ah?" achi hi.
Abraham in, "Bawi, Pathian in amah a dia halmang thillat ding belamnou angaihtuah tawm ding hi," achi a; anih un apaikhawm zel uhi.
Pathian in ahilhna mun ava tungta ua, Abraham in huai ah maitam adoh a, sing chiangkhawm in, atapa Isak ahen a, maitam a sing tung ah alumsak hi.
Abraham in akhut alik a, atapa thahna ding temta ala hi.
TOUPA angel in van a kipan amah asam a, "Abraham, Abraham," achi a, ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Naupang tung ah na khut kha ke'n. Amah bangmah loh ke'n. Na tapa, na neihsun mahmah leng kei a dia na it louh ziak in Pathian na lau chih tu in ka theita," achi hi.
Abraham adak a, a-en a, ngai in, anunglam ah belampa, singbawk a akii awk ana om hi. Abraham in huai belampa ava man a, atapa sik in halmang thillat in alan zawta hi.
Abraham in huai mun min, "Jehovah Jireh," asa hi; tuni tan a, "TOUPA tang ah ngaihtuah hi na ve," achih zel bang un.
TOUPA angel in anihveina ding in van a kipan Abraham asam nawn hi.
"Hiai thil na hih ziak leh na tapa neihsun na it louh ziak in kei mahmah in ka kichiam hi.
K'on vualzawl ngeingei ding a, van a aksite zah leh tuipi piau a piaunel zah in na suante ka pungsak ngeingei ding. Na suante'n adoute uh kulh kongkhak atang ding uhi.
Ka thu na man ziak in na suan ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
Asikha tangvalte kiang ah Abraham akik nawn a, athou ua, Beer-sheba lam manoh in apai uhi. Beer-sheba ah Abraham ateng hi.
Hichi in huai thilte nung in Abraham kiang ah, "Ngai in, Milkah in leng na sanggampa Nahor tate aneihsakta ve," chi in Abraham ahilh uhi.
Ata masa Huz ahi a; asanggampa Buz ahi, Aram pa Kemuel;
Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph leh Bethuelte leng ahi uh,
Bethuel in tanu Rebekah anei a; huai giatte Milkah in Abraham nau Nahor aneihsakte ahi uh.
Amei, amin Reumah in leng Tebah, Gaham, Thahash leh Maakah anei hi.
Sarah damsung kum zakhat wmnil Sarah damsung kumte ahi uh.
Kanaan gam a Kiriath-arba, Hebron kichi ah Sarah asi a, Sarah suun ding leh kah ding in Abraham ahong hi.
Amisi luang ma a kipan Abraham adingtou a, Heth suante kiang ah,
"Na lak uah mikhual leh khualtam lel ka hi a; ka misi luang muh louh dia ka vuitheihna ding in vuina mun hon pia un,” chi in angen hi.
Heth suante'n Abraham adawng ua, akiang ah,

"Ka toupa, hon ngaikhia in, nang ka lak ua vaihawm thupitak na hi a; ka hante uh lak a na deihna penpen ah na misi vui in. Na misi na vuina ding in ka lak uah kuamah in ka han uh hon piak ka it kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Huai gam mite leh Heth suante ma ah Abraham dingtou in akun hi.
"Ka misi ka muh louh dia ka vui pha na sak uleh, hon ngaikhia unla, Zohar tapa Ephron kiang ah hon ngetsak un.
Alou taw a om, aneih, Makpelah kokhuk hon pe ding in, na lak ua vuina mun ding ama'n hun asak zahzah la henla, hon pia hen," achi hi.
Heth suante lak ah Ephron atu a; Heth mi Ephron in Heth suante theih in akhokulh kong a lut peuhmah nangawn theih in Abraham adawng a,
"Hilou e, ka toupa, hon ngaikhia in. Lou leh asung a om kokhuk leng ka hon pia hi. Ka chipihte tapate mitmuh in ka hon pia hi. Na misi vui in," chi in.
Huchi in huai gam mite ma ah Abraham akun hi.
Huai gam mite theih in Ephron kiang ah, "Pha na sakleh hehpih in hon ngaikhia in; lou man ka hon pe ding, kei a kipan la in, huai mun kia ah ka misi ka vui ding," achi hi.
Ephron in Abraham adawng a, akiang ah,
"Ka toupa, hon ngaikhia in. Lei mun dangka shekel zali ahi a, huai zaw, nang leh kei a ding in gen tham ahi a hia? Na misi vui mai in," achi hi.
Abraham in Ephron thu azuita a; Heth suante theih in Ephron in agen zah, dangka shekel zali, sumsinte zat zel abuk a, Ephron kiang ah apeta hi.
Ephron lou, Mamre toh kizawn Makpelah gam a om, alou toh, asung a kokhuk om toh, lou a sing om tengteng toh, alou kim a sing om tengteng toh,
Heth suante mitmuh in, akhokulh kong a om peuhmahte muh in, gou ding in Abraham kiang ah piakkip in a-omta hi.
Huai nung in Kanaan gam a Mamre toh kizawn, Hebron kichihna, Makpelah lou a kokhuk ah Abraham in azi Sarah avuita hi.
Lou leh asung a kokhuk om vuina mun ding in Abraham kiang ah Heth suante'n apekipta uhi.
Abraham upa in ahong tek mahmahta a, TOUPA'N thil bangkim ah Abraham avualzawl hi.
Abraham in asikha, a-inn a upapen, aneih tengteng tung a thuneipa kiang ah, "Hehpih in ka pheipi nuai ah na khut golh in,
TOUPA, van Pathian leh lei Pathian min lou in, ka tenna Kanaan mite nungak lak a mi ka tapa zi ding a neihsak lou ding in, ka hon kichiamsak ding.
Ka gam lam a ka tanaute kiang ah hoh inla, ka tapa Isak zi na pisak ding ahi," achi hi.
Sikha in akiang ah, "Numei in hiai gam lam ah hon zui nuam kei taleh, na tapa na hong pawtna gam a pikik nawn ding ka hi diam?" achi hi.
Abraham in akiang ah, "Huai a ka tapa pikik nawn lou ding in pilvang in.

TOUPA, van Pathian, ka pa inn a kipan leh ka pianna gam a kipan hon pikhepa leh hon houpihpa leh hiai gam na suante kiang ah ka pe ding, chi a ka kiang a kichiampa'n, amah ngei in na ma ah a-angel apaisak ding a, huai a kipan ka tapa zi na pisak ding ahi.
Numei in hon zuih nop keileh, ka kiang a na kichiamna thu ah na siang ding. Akoi abang hitaleh, huai ah zaw ka tapa na pikik nawn ding ahi kei," achi hi.
Sikha in apu Abraham pheipi nuai ah akhut agolh a, akiang ah huai thu ah akichiamta hi.
Sikha in apu sangawngsaute lak ah sangawngsau sawm akai a, apu thil hoih chiteng tawi in, apawtkheta hi. Athou a, Mesopotamia gam a Nahor khopi lam ah akipankheta hi.
Nitaklam a tui tawi dia numeite akuan hun laitak un, dainawl a tuileh kiang ah asangawngsaute akhukdinsak hi.
"Aw TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, hehpih in tuni in hon lohchingsak in, ka pu Abraham tung ah hehpihna langsak in.
En in, tuikhuk kiang ah ka dingh a, khua a mite tanute tui tawi ding in ahong kuan uhi.

Huan hichi hi henla, nungak kuapeuh kiang a, 'Hehpih in ka dawn ding in na tuibel niamsak dih ve,' ka chih a, ama'n, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding,' chi peuhmah, huai mi ngei na sikha Isak zi ding a na miseh hi hen. Hiai ah ka pu tung ah hehpihna na langsak, chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, agen khit ma in, ngai in, Abraham nau Nahor zi Milkah tapa Bethuel tanu Rebekah, aliangzang a tuibel pua in ahong kuan hi.
Huai nungak amel hoih mahmah, nungak siangthou ahi a, pasal himhim akithuahpih ngei kei hi. Tuikhuk ah apaisuk a, atuibel adimsak a, apaitou nawn hi.
Amah tuak ding in sikhapa atai a, "Hehpih in na tuibel a tui tawmchik hon dawnsak dih ve,” achi hi.
Ama'n, “Dawn in, ka toupa," achi a; kintak in akhut in atuibel adomkhesuk a, adawnsak hi.
Adawn nung in, "Na sangawngsaute a ding leng, adawnkham masiah uh ka tawi ding," achi hi.
Kintak in gankuang ah atuibel atei a, tui tawi ding in tuileh lam ah atai nawn a, asangawngsau tengteng a ding leng atawisak hi.
Sikha in alohchingsak leh sak louh theihna ding in adai dide hi.
Huan hichi ahong hina, sangawngsaute'n adawnkhamtak un, sikha in dangka-eng bilbah shekel kimkhat a gik leh akhut a ding dangka-eng tau nih shekel sawm a gik asuahkhia hi.
Akiang ah, "Kua tanu na hia? Hehpih in hon hilh in. Na pa inn ah ka giahna ding uh mun a-om diam?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Bethuel, Milkah tapa, Nahor a ding a aneih- saknu tanu ka hi," achi hi.
Amah mah in akiang ah, "Buhpawl leh gan an ka hau tuak ua, giahna mun leng ka nei uh," achi hi.
Sikha in alu akunsak a, TOUPA abia hi.
"Ka pu tung ngei a azahngaihna leh athutakna tawp ngei lou, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian phat in om hen. Kei leng, TOUPA'N ka pu unaute inn lam a hon na pi ahi ve,” achi hi.
Nungak atai a, huai thute anu inkuanpihte ava hilh hi.
Rebekah in sanggam pasal anei a, amin Laban ahi. Laban apawtkhia a, tuikhuk lam ah huai mi kiang ah ava tai hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, bilbah leh asanggamnu khut a taute amu a, huai mi'n, "Huchi khachi in ahon chi," chi a, asanggamnu Rebekah thugente azaktak in, huai mi kiang ah ahohta hi. Ngai in, amah tuikhuk ah sangawngsaute kiang ah ana dingh gige hi.
Laban in, "Nang, TOUPA vualzawlpa, hong inla, ka inn uah hong lut in. Bangziak a inpua a dingh nilouh? Inn leh mun sangawngsaute a ding in ka bawl khinta," achi hi.
Huchi in inn ah alut a, Laban sangawngsau van aphel a; sangawngsaute a ding in buhpawl leh gan an apia a, akhe leh alawmte khe silna ding tui apia hi.
Abraham sikha ma ah nek ding alui a; himahleh ama'n, "Ka hong hohna san thu ka gen mateng ka ne kei ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Gen ve le," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Kei Abraham sikha ka hi.
TOUPA'N ka pu nakpitak in avualzawl a, miliantak ahong hita. TOUPA'N akiang ah belamhon, bawnghon, dangka, dangka-eng, sikhapate, sikhanute, sangawngsaute leh sabiltungte leng apia hi.
Ka pu zi Sarah in tek nungpi in ka pu a ding in tapa aneihsak a; akiang ah aneih tengteng ape vek hi.
Ka pu in, ka tenna gam a Kanaante nungak lak a ka tapa zi ding a na neihsak ding ahi kei.
Ka pa inn lam ah, ka tanaute kiang ah hoh inla, ka tapa zi na pisak zaw ding ahi, chi in ahon kichiamsak hi."
Ke'n ka pu kiang ah, "Numei in hon zui nuam kei kha ding," ka chi hi.

Ama'n, ka kiang ah, "TOUPA ama a ka om zelnapa'n na kiang ah a-angel ahon sawl ding a; na hohna ding ah hon lohchingsak ding. Ka tapa a ding in ka tanaute leh ka pa inkote lak a zi na neisak ding ahi.
Ka tanaute kiang ngei na tun chiang in, ka kiang a na kichiamna a kipan na siang ding. Nungak ahon piak kei uleh ka kiang a na kichiamna a kipan na siang ding," achi hi.
"Tuni in tuikhuk ka hong tung a, 'Aw, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, ka paina a na hon lohchinsak dingleh, en in, tuikhuk kiang ah ka dingh hi.'
Hichi hi henla, tui tawi ding a nungak hong kuan kuapeuh kiang a, 'Hehpih in dawn ding na tuibel a tui tawmchik hon pia in,' ka chih a,
ama'n ka kiang a, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute a ding leng ka tawi ding, chi peuhmah, huai mi ngeingei ka pu tapa a ding a TOUPA numei seh hi hen,' ka chi hi.
Ka lungsim a ka gen khit ma in, ngai in, Rebekah, atuibel pua in ahong kuan a; tuikhuk ah apaisuk a; tui atawi a; akiang ah, 'Hehpih in tui hon dawnsak dih ve,' ka na chi hi.
Ama'n kintak in aliangzang a kipan tuibel adomkhia a, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding,' achi hi. Ka dawn a, sangawngsaute leng adawnsak hi.
Ke'n, 'Kua tanu na hia?' chi in ka dong a; ama'n, 'Nahor tapa, Milkah in aneihsakpa Bethuel tanu ka hi,' achi hi. Abil ah bilbah ka batsak a, taute leng akhut ah ka bunsak hi.
"Ka lu ka kunsak a, TOUPA ka bia a, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, ka pu sanggampa tanu ngei, atapa a dia azi ding a pisak ding a lampi diktak a hon pipa ka phat hi.
Tu in ka pu na hehpih ua, atung a chihtak pet a na hih ding uleh hon hilh un. Na hih kei ding uleh leng hon hilh un. Taklam hiam, veilam hiam, ka nga thei ding," achi hi.
Laban leh Bethuel in adawng ua, "Hiai thil TOUPA a kipan a pawt ahi. Kou na kiang ah asia-apha bangmah ka gen thei kei uh.
En in, na ma ah Rebekah a-om, pi inla, paipih in, TOUPA'N agensa bang in na pu tapa zi ding in om hen," achi uh.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Abraham sikha in athu uh azaktak in lei si in TOUPA abia hi.
Abraham sikha in dangka suang kizepnate, dangka- eng kizepnate leh silh-le-ten alakhia a, Rebekah apia a; asanggampa leh anu kiang ah leng thil manpha pipi apia hi.
Amah leh alawmte'n ne in adawn ua, huai ah agiakta uh. Zingsang in athou ua, "Ka pu kiang ah hon paisakta un," achi hi.
Asanggampa leh anu'n, "Nungak ni sawt lou chik, ni sawm lel bek, ka kiang uah om tadih hen. Huai khit in ahong pai na ding," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zekaisak kei dih ua, TOUPA'N lah ka hohna ah ahon lohchingsakta ngal a. Ka pu kiang a ka paitheihna ding in, hon sawl zaw mai ve ua,” achi hi.
Amau, "Nungak ka sam ding ua, ama kam mahmah kidongleh," achi uhi.
Rebekah asam ua akiang ah, "Hiai mipa kiang ah na pai nuam maw?" achi ua. Ama'n, "Pai nuam ve ning e,” achi hi.
Asanggamnu uh Rebekah leh adonnu leh Abraham sikha leh amite akhakheta uhi.
Huan Rebekah avualzawl ua, akiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu uh aw, nang, sing ngenta sang tampite nu hong hi in! Na suante'n amau hote kulh kongkhak neihsak uhen!" achi uhi.
Rebekah athou a, asikhanute toh sangawngsaute tung ah atuang ua, huai mi azuita uhi. Abraham sikha in Rebekah api a, apaita uhi.
Huan Beer-lahai-roi tuikhuk lam a kipan Isak ahong a, amah sim gam a teng ahi.
Nitaklam in loubuk ah kingaihtuah ding in Isak apawtkhia hi. Adak a, a-en a, ngai in, sangawngsau hong paite amu hi.
Rebekah adak a, Isak amuhtak in sangawngsau tung a kipan akumkhia hi.
Sikhapa kiang ah, "Gamlak anhon dawn ding a hong pai kua ahia?" achi a; sikha in, "Ka pu ahi,” achi hi. Kikhuhna puan ala a, akikhuhta hi.
Sikha in athilhih tengteng Isak ahilh hi.
Isak in anu Sarah puanin ah apilut a, Rebekah ala a, azi ahong hita hi. Amah a-it a, anu sih nung Isak khamuang in a-omta hi.
Huan Abraham in zi dang anei nawn a, amin Keturah ahi.
Ama'n Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak leh Shuah aneihsak hi.
Jokshan in tapa Sheba leh Dedan anei a, Dedan tapate Asshurim leh Letushim leh Leummim ahi uh.
Midian tapate Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abidah leh Eldaah ahi uh. Huai tengteng Keturah tate ahi uhi.
Abraham in aneih tengteng Isak apia hi.
Amei tapate kiang ah Abraham in thilpiakte apia a; amah dam lai ngei in atapa Isak a kipan amaute suahlam gam ah asawlkhia hi.
Abraham damsung kum zakhat sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
Abraham in akha akhahta a, lu a kelsam pou vek in tekkun a dam in asi a, achipihte kiang a pi in a-omta hi.
Atapa Isak leh Ishmael in Hit mi Zohar tapa Ephron lou a, Mamre phak ma a Makpelah kokhuk ah avui uhi.
Huai lou, Abraham in Heth suante a pan aleisa ahi a, huai mun ah azi Sarah kiang ah Abraham vui in a-om hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Abraham sih nung in, Pathian in atapa Isak avualzawl a; Beer-lahai-roi ah Isak ateng hi.
Hiaite Abraham tapa Ishmael, Sarah sikhanu, Aigupta mi Hagar in Abraham aneihsak suante ahi uh.
Hiaite amin chiat uleh asuante uh dungzui zel in Ishmael tapate min ahi. Ishmael tapa upapen Nebajoth ahi a, huai ban ah Kedar, Adbeel leh Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah leh Massa,
Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish leh Kedemah ahi uh.
Huaite Ishmael tapate ahi ua, huaite akhua uh bang leh agiahphual uh dungzui zel a amin uh gelh ahi a, anam uh bang zel in vaihawmmi sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
Ishmael damsung kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi a; akha khah in asi a, achipihte kiang ah pi in a-omta hi.
Atapate Havilah gam a kipan Assuria gam lam a Aigupta gam phak ma a Shur tan in ateng ua, a-unau dang teng a kipan atuamten uhi.
Hiaite Abraham tapa Isak suante ahi ua: Abraham in tapa Isak anei hi.
Isak in Padan-aram gam a Siria mi Bethuel tanu, Aram mi Laban sanggamnu Rebekah zi a aneih lai in kum sawmli a upa ahi.
Azi achiin ziak in Isak in TOUPA kiang ah azi a ding in nget petmah in angetsak hi. TOUPA'N angetna angaihkhiaksak a, azi Rebekah ahong gaita hi.
Asung a anaupaite akisual ua; ama'n, "Hichibang ahih ngalleh, bangziak in ahia, ka hi chih?" achi a; TOUPA dong ding in akuanta hi.
TOUPA'n akiang ah, "Na sul ah nam nih a-om ua, na gilsung a kipan nam nih akikhen ding uh, nam khat sang in nam khat ahatzaw ding a, a-upazaw in anaupangzaw nna asem ding,” achi hi.
Anau neih ahun in, ngai in, asul ah phik a-om hi.
Amasazaw asan a san seksawk, puanmul bang a mul thiapthuap in ahong suakkhia a, amin Esau asa uhi.
Huai nung in anau hong suakkhe nawn a, akhut in Esau khetul alenkip a; ama min Jakob asa uhi. Rebekah in amaute aneih lai in Isak kum sawmguk a upa ahi.
Naupangte hong khanglian ua; Esau sabetsiam, gamvakmi ahi a; Jakob mimelmawl, puaninte a tengmi ahi.
Isak in asamatte anek zel ziak in Esau a-it a; Rebekah in bel Jakob a-it hi.
Jakob in betang ahuan laitak in Esau gamkuan ahong tung a, atawl mahmah hi.
Esau in Jakob kiang ah, "Hehpih in na betang huan hon nesak in; ka bah mahmah hi,” achi hi. Huaiziak in ahi amin Edom achih uh.
Jakob in, "Na ta masa hihna hon leisak phot lechin,” achi hi.
Esau in, "Ngai in, si dek ka hi ngal a; kei a ding in hiai ta masa hihna bang aphatuam dia?" achi hi.
Jakob in, "Tuni in ka kiang ah kichiam phot in,” achi hi. Akiang ah akichiam a, Jakob kiang ah ata masa hihna akhawng maimah hi.
Jakob in Esau tanghou leh abetang huan apia a; ama'n ne in adawn a, athou a, apaikheta hi. Huchibang in Esau in ata masa hihna angaineu hi.
Huan Abraham dam lai a kial ke masapen chih louh, huai gam ah kial ahong ke nawn a, Philistiate kumpipa Abimelek kiang ah Gerar ah Isak ava hohsuk hi.
Akiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak a, "Aigupta gam ah hohsuk ke'n. K'on hilh ding gam ah teng in.
Hiai gam ah om tadih inla, na kiang ah ka om ding a, ka hon vualzawl ding hi. Hiai gam tengteng nang kiang leh na suante kiang a pia in, na pa Abraham kiang a ka kichiamna ka hihkip ding hi.
Van a aksi zah in na suante ka pungsak ding hiai gam tengteng na suante kiang ah ka pe lai ding hi. Na suan ah leitung a nam tengteng vualzawl in a-om ding uh.
"Abraham in ka thu amang a, ka thuhilhte, ka thupiakte, ka dan thusehte leh ka dante azuih ziak in," achi hi.
Huchi in Gerar ah Isak ateng hi.
Huai khua a mite'n azi tungtang adong ua; ama'n, "Ka sanggamnu ahi,” achi hi. Amel ahoih ziak in hiai khua a mite'n Rebekah ziak in hon that kha ding uh, chi in "Ka zi ahi," achi ngamta kei hi.
Hichi a, huai a sawtpi a-om nung in, Philistiate kumpipa Abimelek in tohlet a kipan a-en a, ngai in, Isak in azi Rebekah athoh lai amuta hi.
Abimelek in Isak asam a, "Ngai in, amah na zi ahi mah vele. Bangziak a ka sanggamnu ahi, chi maimah na hia?" achi hi. Isak in akiang ah, "Amah ziak in ka si kha ding ka chih ziak ahi," achi hi.
Abimelek in, "Ka tung ua na thilhih bangchidan ahia? Mite lak a mi kuapeuh in na zi kithuahpih kha thei uh akei maw, ka tung uah siamlouhna na hon tungsak dek vele," achi hi.
Abimelek mah in, "Kuapeuh hiai mi hiam, azi hiam, khoih, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi," chi in mi tengteng thu apia hi.
Isak in huai gam ah buh aching a, huai kum in aleh za anei a, TOUPA'N avualzawl hi.
Ahong thupi mahmah a, nakpitak a mithupi hong suak hial in ahong lian huaihuai hi.
Belamhon leh bawnghon anei a, inkuan leng tampi anei a, huaiziak in Philistiate'n amah ahaza uhi.
Apa Abraham dam lai a, apa sikhate'n tuileh atoh tengteng uh Philistiate'n ahudim ua, lei in ahihdim vek uhi.
Abimelek in Isak kiang ah, "Ka kiang ua kipan paimang in, kou sang in lah na hatzaw ngal a,” achi hi.
Huai a kipan Isak apawtkhia a, Gerar Phaizang ah puanin akai a, huai ah atengta hi.
Isak in apa Abraham dam lai a tuileh atohte uh atou nawn a; Abraham sih nung in Philistiate'n lah ana hudim vek ngal ua. Apa'n amin ana sak bangbang in amin asa chiat hi.
Isak sikhate'n phaizang ah atou ua, huai ah tuileh nak nei amu uhi.
Gerar a ganpute'n, “Kou tui ahi," chi in Isak ganpute toh akisel ua, amah toh akisel ziak un tuileh min Eshek asata hi.
Tuileh dang atou nawn ua; huai leng tuhkhiak tum in akiselpih nawn zel ua; amin Sitnah asa hi.

Huai a kipan akisuan a, tuileh dang atou nawn hi. Huai ahihleh tuhkhiak tum in asubuai nawn ngal kei uhi. Tu in, “TOUPA'N mun lianpi ahon bawlsakta a, hiai gam ah chi tampi i suang ding uh," chi in amin Rehoboth asa hi.
Huai a kipan Beer-sheba ah ahohtou hi.
Huai zan mah in akiang ah TOUPA akilak a, “Kei, na pa Abraham' Pathian ka hi. Lau ke'n, na kiang ah ka om hi. Ka hon vualzawl ding a, ka sikha Abraham ziak a na suante pungsak ding ka hi," achi hi.
Huai mun ah maitam adoh a, TOUPA min alou a, huai ah apuanin leng akai hi. Isak sikhate'n huai ah tuileh atou nawn uhi.
Gerar a kipan Abimelek, alawm Ahuzzath leh sepaih pawl heutu Phikol toh akiang ah ahoh uhi.
Isak in akiang ah, "N'on ngai kei ua, na kiang ua pan na hon paimangsak ngal ua, bangchidan in ahia ka kiang a na hong pai uh?" achi hi.
Amau, "Na kiang ah TOUPA a-om chih chiantak in ka thei ua, i kikal uah, kou leh nangmah kikal ah kichiam in thu i khung ding uh.

Na zakdah ka hih ngei louh bang ua, thil hoih kia lou ngal na tung a ka hih louh ua, hoihtak a ka hon paimangsak bang un; nang leng ka siatna ding himhim uh na hihlouhna ding in. Tu in nang TOUPA vualzawl na hita," achi uhi.
Huan amaute a ding in ankuang aluisak a, ne in adawn uhi.
Zingsang in beltak in athou ua, akichiamtuah uhi. Isak in amau apaisak a, akiang a kipan khamuangtak in apawtta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai ni mah in Isak sikhate ahong pai ua, tuileh toh thu ahong hilh ua, akiang ah, “Tui ka muta uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n huai tuileh Shebah asa hi. Huaiziak in tutan in huai kho min Beer-sheba akichi lai hi.
Esau kum sawmli a upa ahih in, Hit mi Beeri tanu Judith leh Hit mi Elon tanu Basemath zi in anei hi.
Huaite Isak leh Rebekah lunggimnate ahi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Isak hong tek a, kho mu thei lou khop in amit ahong mialta hi. Atapa upazaw Esau asam a, akiang ah, "Ka tapa," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hiai ah ka om,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ngai in, ka tek mahmahta a, ka sih ni ding lah ka thei kei hi.
Tu in hehpih in na vanzat, na thaltang leh na thalpeu tawi in, va gamvak inla, sa hon va matsak in.
Ka sih ma a ka hon vualzawl theihna ding in, ka duh lamtak in meh ding in limtak hon bawlsak inla, ka nek ding in ka kiang ah hon tawi in,” achi hi.
Isak in atapa Esau ahoupih lai Rebekah in ana za hi. Sa beng a hon po ding in Esau agamvakta hi.
Rebekah in atapa Jakob kiang ah, "Ngai in, na pa'n na u Esau kiang a athugen ka za.
Sa hon puak inla, ka nek a ka sih ma a TOUPA ma a ka hon vualzawlna ding in, meh limtak hon bawlsak in, chi ahi.
Ka tapa, tu in ka hon thupiak bang in ka thu zui in.
Ganhon lak ah va hoh inla, kelnou nih hoihtak, huai a kipan hon la in. Aduh lamtak in na pa a ding in meh limtak in huai ka na bawl ding.
Asih ma a hon vualzawlsak ding in, anek ding in na pa kiang ah na va paipih ding ahi,” achi hi.
Jakob in anu Rebekah kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka u Esau mimulhau ahi a, kei lah minel ka hi.
Ka pa'n hon na zawt vialvial kha ding a, amah a ding in khempa ka hong hi dia, vualzawl gen tak louh hamsiat kizon lel ka hi kei ding maw," achi hi.
Anu'n akiang ah, "Ka tapa, ka tung ah na hamsiat muh ding tung hen. Ka thu zui inla, hon va lak in," achi hi.
Huchi in akuan a, ava la a, anu kiang ah apaipihta hi. Anu'n apa duh lamtak in meh limtak abawl hi.
Rebekah in atapa upapen Esau puansilh hoihtak, akiang a inn a om ala a, atapa naupangzaw Jakob asilhsak hi.
Huai ban ah kelnou vun leng akhut leh angawng nelna munte ah aphah hi.
Meh limtak leh tanghou abawlte atapa Jakob khut ah apia hi.
Amah apa kiang ah ava pai a, "Pa aw," achi a; ama'n, “Hiai ah ka om, ka tapa, akua zaw pen na hia?" achi hi.
Jakob in apa kiang ah, "Na tapa upazaw Esau ka hi; na hon sawl bang in ka hih khinta. Hehpih in thou inla, hon vualzawl ding in tu inla, ka samatsa ne in," achi hi.
