Ka toupa kiang ah, 'Pa putektak leh atek lam a neih naupang chik ka nei uh. Huai mipa upa asita a, anu neih lak ah amah kia a-om lai a, apa'n lah amah a-it mahmah hi,' ka chi uhi.
Nang na sikhate kiang ah, 'Ka mit a amah ka muhtheihna ding in ka kiang ah hon pisuk un,' na chi hi.
Ka toupa kiang ah, 'Ka naupa un apa anuse thei kei ding; apa paisanleh apa asi mai ding,' ka chi uhi.
Nang na sikhate kiang ah, 'Na nautumpen uh na hon tonpih kei uleh, ka mel na mu nawn kei ding uh,' na chi hi.
"Huan hichi ahong hi a, na sikha ka pa uh kiang ka va tun un, ka toupa thute ka hilh uhi.
Ka pa un, 'Kuan nawn unla, buh tawmchik bek ei a ding in va lei nawn un,' ahon chi hi.
Kou, 'Ka hohsuk thei nawn kei ding uh. Ka nautumpen uh ahong dingleh bel ka hohsuk ding ua, ka nautumpen un ahong pai keileh zaw huai mi mel mu thei lou ding ka hi uh,' ka chi uhi.
Na sikha ka pa un ka kiang uah, 'Ka zi in tapa nih ahon neihsak chih na thei uhi.
Akhat pen ka kiang a kipan apaikhia a, bohzan vek a om hi ngei ding ahi, ka chi hi. Huai nungsiah amah mu lou vengveng ka hi.
Huchi in hiai mi leng ka kiang a kipan na pikhiak ua, tuahsia va tuak taleh lungkhamtak a han a ka samkangpi toh hon tumsak ding na hi uh,' achi hi.
"Huchi in ka nau in kou hon zui lou in, na sikha ka pa uh kiang va tung leng, ka nau uh hinna toh ahinna akizop ziak in,
hichi ahong hi ding a, naupang in ahon zui kei, chih atheih chiang in asi mai ding. Huchi in na sikhate'n na sikha ka pa uh samkangpi toh lungkhamna a han a tumsak ding ka hi uh.
Na sikha in na kiang a ka hon pikik nawn keileh, amoh tangtawn in ka pa lak ah ka po ding, chi in ka pa kiang ah ka nau uh tungtang thu ah abultumpa in ka kibawlta hi.
Huchi in hehpih in na sikha ka nau uh sik in, ka toupa sikha in hon omsak zaw inla, ka nau asanggamte zuitousak in.
Ka naupa'n hon zui lou in bangchi in ka pa kiang ah ka paitou thei dia? Atung a siatna tung mu ding ka kei hiam," achi hi.

Huan akiang a dinghte ma ah Joseph akidek zouta kei, “Mi tengteng ka kiang a kipan pawtkhesak vek un," chi in akikoukhia hi. Joseph asanggamte kiang a akigen sung teng akiang ah kuamah adingh kei uhi.
Akap loloih a, Aiguptate'n aza ua, Pharaoh inkuanpihte'n leng aza uh.
Joseph in asanggamte kiang ah, "Keimah Joseph ka hi. Ka pa adam lai na maw?" achi hi. Himahleh asanggamte'n adawng thei kei ua, ama ah buaitak in a-om uhi.
Joseph mah in asanggamte kiang ah, "Hehpih in hon naih un," achi hi. Huchi in ava naih ua, ama'n, "Na unaupa uh Joseph, Aigupta gam a lutpih ding a na khotpa uh ka hi.
Himahleh hiai a pai ding a na hon khot ziak un lungkham kei unla, kihehkhum tuan sam kei un. Mite hinna hondam ding in Pathian in na ma ua hon sawl masa ahi.
Hiai kum nih sung hiai gam ah kial aketa a; kum nga in asam lai hi. Huai sung in leileh a-om kei ding a, buhlak leng a-om kei ding.
Tunung khang om zel ding hawisak ding leh noute hotdamna thupitak a hingdam a ka hon omsak theihna ding in Pathian in na ma uah kei ahon sawl masa hi.
Huchi in hiai a hon sawl noute na hi kei ua, Pathian ahi zaw. Ama'n Pharaoh pa in leh a-inkuanpih tengteng heutu in leh Aigupta gam tengteng vaihawmtu in ahon bawlta hi.
"Kintak in ka pa kiang ah va pai unla, akiang ah, na tapa Joseph in hichi in achi: Pathian in Aigupta gam tengteng heutu in ahon bawlta a, ka kiang ah hong paisuk in, sawt hon hal ke'n.
Huchi in Goshen gam ah na teng ding a, ka kiang ngei ah na om ding; nang, na tate, na tute, na belamhonte, na bawnghonte leh na neih tengteng toh.
Hiai ah keimah in ka hon vak ding; kial lah kum nga om lai ding ahi ngal a. Huchi lou in zaw nang leh na inkuanpihte leh na neih tengteng toh na kialgawp kha ding uh," hon chi un.
"Ngai un, noumau mit ngei leh ka nau Benjamin mit ngei in keimah kam mahmah in agen lai na mu kilkel uhi.
Aigupta gam a ka thupina tengteng thu leh na thil muh tengteng thu uh ka pa na hilh ding ua; kintak in hiai ah ka pa na hon pisuk pah ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Anau Benjamin ngawng a kun in akap a; Benjamin leng ama ngawng a kun in akap hi.
Asanggamte tengteng atawp a, akahkhum chiat a, huai khit in asanggamte'n thu vantang agenpih uhi.
Joseph sanggamte ahong uh chih thu thuthang Pharaoh inkote'n ana za uhi. Huai in Pharaoh leh asikhate akipaksak mahmah hi.
Pharaoh in Joseph kiang ah, "Na sanggamte kiang ah huchi in hih in. Na gante uh buh posak unla, pawt unla, Kanaan gam ah pai un.
Na pa uh leh na inkuanpihte uh hon pi unla, ka kiang ah hong pai un. Aigupta gam a thil hoihte ka hon pe ding a, hiai gam a thil om hoihpente na ne ding uh.
Thu ka hon pia ahi, 'Hichibang in hih un: Na taneu chikchikte uh a ding leh na zite uh a ding Aigupta gam a kipan kangtalaite la unla, na pa uh pi ding in va kuan un.
Na van uh leng ngaihtuah nuam dah un, Aigupta gam tengteng thil hoih peuhmah nou a ahi ngal a,' " achi hi.
Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih ua, Joseph in Pharaoh thupiak bang in akiang uah kangtalaite apia a, lampi a nek ding leng apia hi.
Avek ua kiang ah puansilh kikhenna ding ape chiat a; Benjamin kiang ngial ah houh dangka zathum leh puansilh kikhenna ding nga apia hi.
Apa kiang ah hiaite akhak hi: Aigupta gam a thil hoih pua sabiltung sawmkhat leh lampi a, apa a ding buh leh tanghou leh nek ding pua sabengtungnu sawmkhat toh.
Huchi in asanggamte asawlkhia a, apaita uh. Ama'n akiang uah, "Lampi ah kina lou ding in pilvang un aw,” achi hi.
Aigupta gam a kipan apaitou ua, huan Kanaan gam a apa uh Jakob kiang ava tungta uhi.
Akiang ah, "Joseph adam lai a, huan Aigupta gam tengteng tung ah vaihawmpa in apang," chi in ahilh uhi. Athugen uh agintak louh ziak in, alungtang abahta hi.
Akiang ua Joseph thugente ahilh ua; atuanna ding kangtalai Joseph in akhakte amuh in Jakob lungtang ahong halh nawn hi.
Israel in, "Ahunta; ka tapa Joseph hingdam a na om ahi maw. Ka sih ma in amah ka va mu ding,” achi hi.
Huan Israel aneih tengteng toh apawtkhia a, Beer-sheba atung a, apa Isak' Pathian kiang ah kithoihnate alan hi.
Pathian in zan a mengmuhna in Israel ahoupih a, "Jakob, Jakob," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Kei Pathian, na pa Pathian ka hi. Aigupta gam a hohsuk lau ke'n. Huai ah chi thupitak in ka hon bawl ding hi.
Aigupta gam ah na kiang ah ka hong ding a; ka hon pitou nawn ngeingei ding, na sih chiang in Joseph in hon mitsisak ding hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Beer-sheba a kipan Jakob apawt a; Israel suante'n apa uh Jakob leh ataneu chikchikte uh leh azite uh tuanna ding a Pharaoh in kangtalai akhakte ah atuangsak uhi.
Huchi in Jakob leh asuan tengteng in Kanaan gam a alamkhiak uh, gantate leh vante tawi in, Aigupta gam atungta uhi.
Atapate, atupate, atanute, atunute leh asuan tengteng, Aigupta gam ah alutpihta hi.
Hiaite Israel suan Aigupta gam a lut, Jakob leh atapate min ahi uh: Jakob ta masa Reuben ahi.
Reuben tapate Hanok, Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi ahi uh.
Simeon tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Johar leh Kanaan numei tapa Shaul ahi uh.
Levi tapate: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari ahi uh.
Judah tapate: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez leh Zerah ahi ua; (Kanaan gam ah Er leh Onan asita ua) Perez tapate Hezron leh Hamul ahi uh.
Issakar tapate: Tola, Puah, Job leh Shimron ahi uh.
Zebulun tapate: Sered, Elon leh Jahleel ahi uh.
Hiaite tengteng Leah tapa, atanu Dinah toh Padan-aram gam a Jakob aneihsakte ahi ua; atapate leh atanute avek un sawmthum-le-thum ahi uh.
Gad tapate: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi leh Areli ahi uh.
Asher tapate: Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui leh Beriah leh asanggamnu uh Serah ahi uh. Beriah tapate: Heber leh Malkiel ahi uhi.
Hiaite Zilpah Laban in atanu Leah kiang a apiak tapate, Jakob aneihsak mi sawm-le-guk ahi uh.
Jakob zi Rakil tapate: Joseph leh Benjamin ahi uh.
Joseph in Aigupta gam ah tapa Manasseh leh Ephraim anei a, huai mite On kho siampu Potiphera tanu Asenath in amah aneihsakte ahi uh.
Benjamin tapate: Belah, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim leh Ard ahi uh.
Hiaite Rakil tapa Jakob aneihsakte ahi ua, avek un sawm-le-li ahi uh.
Dan tapa Hushim ahi.
Naphtali tapate: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer leh Shillem ahi.
Hiaite Bilhah tapate Laban in atanu Rakil kiang a apiak ahi uh. Hiaite Jakob aneihsak a, avek un sagih ahi uh.
Jakob tapate' zite sim louh in Jakob kiang a Aigupta gam a lut, akhal a pawt tengteng avek un sawmguk-le-guk ahi uhi.
Joseph in Aigupta gam a tapa aneihte nih ahi ua; Jakob inkote, Aigupta gam a lutte, avek un sawmsagih ahi uhi.
Jakob in Goshen gam lampi na kawkmuh ding in Joseph kiang ah Judah ahoh masasak hi.
Huchi in Goshen gam ah alutta uhi. Joseph in akangtalai abawlkhol a, Goshen gam ah apa dawn ding in ahohtou hi. Akiang ah akigen a, angawng a kun in akap nilouh hi.
Israel in Joseph kiang ah, "Dam in na om a, na mel ka muh nawn ziak in tu'n zaw si ding in ka kimanta,” achi hi.
Joseph in asanggamte leh apa inkuanpihte kiang ah, "Ka va hohtou ding a, Pharaoh ka hilh ding a, akiang ah, ka unaute leh ka pa inkuanpihte, Kanaan gam a-omte ka kiang ahong tungta uh.
Amaute ganvulmi, belamching mite ahi ua, abelamhonte uh, abawnghonte uh leh aneih tengteng uh ahon po vek uh, chi in ka va gen ding.
Hichi ahong hi ding a, Pharaoh in nou ahon sap a, bang nasem na hi ua? ahon chih chiang in,

na sikhate, hon suangtute a kipan naupang chik ka hih lai ua kipan tuni tanpha ganvulmi ka hi uh, na chi ding uh. Huchi in Goshen gam ah na teng thei ding uh," achi hi; belamching mite himhim lah Aigupta mite kihlamtak ahi ngal ua.

Huai khit in Joseph in Pharaoh ava hilh a, akiang ah, "Ka pa, ka sanggamte, abelamhonte uh, abawnghonte uh leh aneih tengteng uh toh Kanaan gam a kipan ahong tungsuk ua; ngai in, Goshen gam ah a-om uh," achi hi.
Huan asanggamte lak a kipan mi nga api a, Pharaoh ava lak hi.
Pharaoh in asanggamte kiang ah, "Bang nasem na hi ua?" achi hi. Amau Pharaoh kiang ah, "Na sikhate, kou hon suangtute a kipan belamching mite ka hi uh," achi uhi.

Amau mah in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hiai gam a om tadih ding a hong pai ka hi ua; ka gam uah lah na sikhate' belamhonte nek ding a-om nawnta kei a; kial lah Kanaan gam ah a-uang mahmah hi; hehpih in na sikhate Goshen gam ah hon tengsak in," achi uhi.
Pharaoh in Joseph ahoupih a, "Na pa leh na sanggamte na kiang ahongta ua;
Aigupta gam akiching mahmah hi. Na pa leh na sanggamte gam hoihpenna mun ah tengsak in. Alak ua thilhihtheitak, theihna nei a-om ngialleh ka ganvulhte tung a makai ding in bawl in," achi hi.
Joseph in apa Jakob apilut a, Pharaoh ma ah adingsak a; Jakob in Pharaoh avualzawl hi.
Pharaoh in Jakob kiang ah, "Kum bangzah na hita a?" achi hi.
Jakob in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka khualzin nung zaw kum za-le-sawmthum ahita, ka damsung kumte atawm in ahaksa hi. Hon suangtute akhualzin lai ua adamsung kum uh leng phazou kei ing," achi hi.
Huchi in Jakob in Pharaoh avualzawl a, Pharaoh a kipan apawtkhia hi.
Joseph in apa leh asanggamte tenna abawlsak a, Pharaoh thupiak bang in Aigupta gam a hoihpenna mun ah, agou ding un Rameses gam apeta hi.
Joseph in apa leh asanggamte leh apa' inkuanpih tengteng a-inkuan uh dungzui zel in nek ding apia a, avakta hi.
Huai gam tengteng ah nek ding himhim a-omta kei a; kial lah a-uang semsem hi. Kial ziak in Aigupta leh Kanaan gam abahta hi.
Joseph in abuh leina man uh, Aigupta gam leh Kanaan gam a dangka om tengteng akhawmsak vek hi. Joseph in huai dangka Pharaoh inn ah atawilut hi.

Aigupta gam leh Kanaan gam a dangka tengteng azatbei khit un, Aigupta mi tengteng Joseph kiang ah ahong ua, "Nek ding hon pia in. Na ma a si maimah ding ka hi ding uam? Dangka lah a-om nawn ngal kei a," achi uhi.
Joseph in, "Na gantate uh hon pe mai un. Dangka a-om nawn keileh na ganta man un nek ding ka hon pe ding," achi hi.

Joseph kiang ah agantate uh ahon pi ua; Joseph in sakol man ding, belamhon man ding, bawnghon man ding leh sabiltung man ding in nek ding ana pe zel hi. Huai kum in aganta tengteng uh man in nek ding apia a, avak chiat hi.

Huai kum abei a, kum ahong thak nawn in akiang ah ahong nawn ua, "Ka dangka teng uh abei takdan ka toupa ka hon iim kei ding uh. Ka toupa'n ka gantate uh na neita hi. Ka toupa mitmuh in ka pumpi uh leh ka gam uh chih louh, bangmah ka nei nawn kei uh.

Bangziak a na mitmuh a kou leh ka gam uh mangthang maimah ding ahia? Koumau mah ka gam uh toh an in hon lei mai in. Koumau leh ka gam uh Pharaoh sikhate ka hi ding uh. Si lou a dam a ka omtheihna ding un leh gam asiatlouhna ding in buhchi hon pia in," achi uhi.
Huchi in Joseph in Pharaoh a ding in Aigupta gam tengteng aleisakta hi. Atung ua kial a-ot mahmah ziak in Aigupta mite'n lah alou uh azuak chiat uhi. Huchi in gam Pharaoh a ahi vekta hi.
Aigupta gamgi tawp khat lam a kipan khat lam tawp pha in khuate ah mite akisuansakta hi.
Siampute gam kia alei kei a, siampute'n Pharaoh a kipan tantuan anei ua, Pharaoh in apiak atantuan uh ane zel uhi. Huaiziak in agam uh azuak kei uhi.
Huai nung in, Joseph in mite kiang ah, "Ngai un, tuni in na gam uh leh noute Pharaoh a ding in ka hon leita hi. Hiai ah nou a ding in buhchi a-om, lei ah na ching ding uhi.

Buh lak hun chiang in hichi ahi ding a; Pharaoh a ding in seh nga suah seh khat zel na pe ding ua, aseh li pen noumau a ahi ding. Lou a achi ding, noumau na inkuanpihte uh leh na tanu neu chikchikte uh nek ding ahi ding," achi hi.
Amau, "Nang ka hinna uh na humbitta. Ka toupa'n pha asakleh adeihsakna hon musak henla, Pharaoh sikhate ka hi ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Joseph in Pharaoh in seh nga suah seh khat amuh zel ding thu, Aigupta gam a ding in tuni tanpha in dan in abawlta hi. Siampute gam kia ahi, Pharaoh a hilou.
Israel in Aigupta gam a Goshen gam ah tenna abawlta a, huai ah akihih inbul a, chi tampi asuang a, nakpitak in apungta hi.
Aigupta gam ah Jakob kum sawm-le-sagih ateng a, huchi in Jakob damsung kum zakhat sawmli-le-sagih ahi.

Israel sih hun ahong naita a; atapa Joseph asam a, akiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, hehpih in ka pheipi nuai ah na khut golh inla, ka tung ah ginom leh diktak in gamta in, hehpih in Aigupta gam ah hon vui mahmah ke'n.
Hon suangtute kiang a ka ihmut hun chiang in, nang Aigupta gam a kipan na hon pokhe ding a, amaute vuina mun ah na hon vui zaw ding ahi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na chih bang in ka hih ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka kiang ah kichiam in," achi a; akiang ah akichiamta hi. Huchi in lupna lukhung si in Israel akunta hi.
Huan hiaite nung in hichi ahong hi a, Joseph kiangah, "Ngai in, na pa achi na,” achi uhi. Huchi in atapa nihte Manasseh leh Ephraim akiang ah atonpih hi.
Jakob kiang ah, "Ngai in, na tapa Joseph na kiang ah ahong hi," chi in ahilh uh. Israel akihalhsak a, lupna ah atutou hi.
Jakob in Joseph kiang ah, "Pathian Bangkim hihthei, Kanaan gam a Luz ah ka kiang ah akilak a, ahon vualzawl hi.
Ka kiang ah, chi tampi ka hon suangsak ding a, ka hon hihpung lai ding. Chi tuamtuam omkhawm in ka hon bawl ding. Hiai gam na nung a na suante kiang ah atangtawn gou ding un ka pe ding," ahon chi hi.
"Na tapa nihte, Aigupta gam a na neihte, kei' a ahi ua, Reuben leh Simeon mah bang in Ephraim leh Manasseh kei' a ahi ding uhi.
Hiai mite nung a ta na neihte nang a ahi ding uh, agoutan uah asanggamte uh min akikoppih ding uh ahi.

Kei tungthu ahihleh, Padan gam a kipan ka hong pai lai in Kanaan gam ah lamkal ah Ephrath khua gamla kuam ahih lai in, ka kiang ah Rakil asi hi. Huai ah Ephrath kho lampi ah ka vuita, huai tuh Bethlehem khua ahi,” achi hi.
Israel in Joseph tapate a-en a, "Hiaite kuate ahi ua?" achi hi.
Joseph in apa kiang ah, "Hiaite ka tapa, Pathian in ahon piakte ahi uh," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hehpih in ka kiang ah hon pi in, amau ka na vualzawl ding," achi hi.
Israel mit a-upat tak ziak in achiim nawn kei a, ama'n ana tawp a, ana pom hi.
Israel in Joseph kiang ah, "Na mel muh ka kilamen nawn kei a, himahleh, ngai in, Pathian in na suante mel nangawn ahon musakta," achi hi.
Joseph in amau apa khuk kal a kipan apikhia a, amai a lei si in akun hi.
Joseph in anih un akai a, Ephraim pen akhut taklam in Israel khut veilam pang ah, Manasseh pen akhut veilam in Israel khut taklam pang a kai in apinai hi.
Israel in asawkkalh teitei a, akhut taklam in asawk a, Ephraim anaupangzaw lusip ah anga a; Manasseh bel ata masa ahi.
Joseph avualzawl a, "Hon suangpa Abraham leh Isak om zelna Pathian, tuni tan a ka damsung tengteng hon vakpa Pathian,
thil hoih lou tengteng a kipan hon tanpa Angel in naupangte vualzawl hen. Ka min leh hon suangpa Abraham leh Isak min pu uhen. Khovel ah thupitak hi ding in hong pung uhen,” achi hi.
Joseph in apa'n akhut taklam Ephraim lusip a angak amuh in alungkim kei hial a; apa khut Ephraim lusip a kipan Manasseh lusip a suan ding in apa khut suansak a sawm hi.
Joseph in apa kiang ah, "Pa, hichibang ding ahi kei. Hiai ahi ta masa, na khut taklam a lusip ah nga zaw in," achi hi.

Himahleh, apa a-ut kei a, "Ka thei hi, ka tapa aw, ka thei hi. Amah leng nam gen tham in a-om ding a, amah leng athupi ding hi. Himahleh amah sang in anaupa athupizaw ding a, asuante leng chi tuamtuam tamtak ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Jakob in, "Nang ah Israel vualzawl ahi ding, Pathian in Ephraim leh Manasseh bang in hon bawl hen," chi in avualzawl hi. Huchibang in Manasseh ma ah Ephraim a-omsak hi.
Israel mah in Joseph kiang ah, "Ngai in, si ding ka hita. Himahleh na kiang uah Pathian a-om ding a, nou hon suangtute gam ah ahon pilut nawn ding hi.
Huai lou leng, na sanggamte tantuan sang in tan khat ka hon pe tuan hi, ka namsau leh ka thalpeu a Amorte khut a kipan ka laksak pen," achi hi.
Huan Jakob in atapate asamkhawm a, hichibang in agen hi: "Ni nanungte a na tung ua thil hong tung dingte ka hon hilhtheihna ding in hong kikhawm un.
"Nou Jakob tapate aw, hong kikhawm unla, ngaikhia un; na pa uh Israel thu ngai un.
"Reuben, nang ka tapa masa, ka thilhihtheihna, ka hatna gah masapen na hi. Sanpenna leh thuneihpenna nang a ahi.
Himahleh tui bang a kip lou na hi, tungnunpenna na nei kei ding; na pa lupnapi a na kal ziak in. Huai ah ka lupna a kal in na hihbuah hi.
"Simeon leh Levi unau ahi ua, anamsaute uh sisan suahna vanzat ahi.
Ka kha aw, nang zaw akikupna uah va kigolh ke'n. Ka thupina, nang zaw akikhopna uah tel ke'n. Aheh un mi athat ua, agenhak un bawngtal thagui asattat uhi.
Ahehna un hamsia dong hen, hangsantak ahi ngal ua. Athangpaihna un leng hamsia dong hen, hinsetak ahi ngal ua. Jakob ah amaute ka kikhensak ding a, Israel ah ka hihdalh ding hi.
"Judah, nang na unaute'n ahon phat ding uh. Na doute ngawng ah na khut na nga ding a; na ma ah na tapate akun ding uh.
Judah humpinelkai nou ahi. Ka tapa, na sa keih na paitouhsanta. Na kun a, humpinelkai bang in na bok a, humpinelkainu bang in na kualsuk hi. Kua'n ahia hon thousak ngam ding?
Judah a kipan lalchiang amang kei ding, vaihawmpa chiang akhekal a kipan amang kei ding. Shiloh ahong pai mateng; mite'n ama thu amang ding uhi.
Grepgui ah asakolnou akhih ding a, asabiltungnou grepgui hoih chi ah akhih ding hi. Apuansilhte uain in asawp ding a, grep sisan in apuan asawp lai ding hi.
Amitte uain in asan ding ua, ahate nawitui in angou ding uhi.
"Tuipi gei ah Zebulun ateng ding a, longkhawlna luipiau ahi ding a; agamgi Zidon ah ahi ding.
"Issakar zaw sabiltung hattak ahi a, van-gik nih kal a kual ahi.
Khawl hoih in athei a, gam leng hoih in athei; huchi in van po ding in aliangzang aniamsak a, phutluih nasem in sikha in ahong omta hi.
"Dan in Israel nam lak a khat bang in amite vai ahawmsak ding.
Dan ahihleh lamlian gei a gul, lampi a gulgial, atung a tuangmi thalkiak ek khop a sakol khetul tu nakpa ahi ding.
"AW TOUPA, na hotdamna ka ngak gige hi.
"Gal in Gad asual ding a, himahleh ama'n akhetul lam uah amaute asual zaw ding hi.
"Asher, anek ahoih ding a, kumpi nekte apiangsak ding hi.
"Naphtali, zukpi khah ahi. Thuhoih pipi agen zel hi.
"Joseph hiang gah nuamtak ahi, tuikhuk kiang a hiang gah nuamtak; ahiang nawnsawnte'n baang atuam uhi.
Thalkap mite'n nakpitak in amah ahihgenthei ua, akap ua, asimmoh uhi.
Himahleh, amah thalpeu khauhtak in a-om gige a, abanthate Jakob' Pathian Mihatpa hatsak; belamchingmi, Israel suangpi a pan ahi.

Na pa Pathian, nang hon panpih dingpa, Bangkim hihtheipa, tunglam van vualzawlnate, nuailam a om gige tui thuktak vualzawlnate, nawite leh sul vualzawlnate, nangmah hon vualzawl dingpa ngei hihhat in na om hi.
Na pa vualzawlnate hon suangtute vualzawlna sang in tangtawn mualte tawpkhawk pha in athupizawta hi. Hiaite Joseph lutung ah a-om ding a, asanggamte a kipan hihtuam a ompa lusip ah a-om ding hi.
"Benjamin ngia duhgawl bang in, zingsang in asa matte ane ding a, nitaklam in agallak ahawm ding," achi hi.
Huaite tengteng Israel nam sawm-le-nihte ahi uh. Huai thute leng amaute vualzawlna akiang ua apa uh thugen ahi. Vualzawlna atan ding gun bang zel un avualzawl chiat hi.
Ama'n atapate thugou asiah a, akiang uah, "Ka chipihte kiang a pi a om ding ka hita. Hit mi Ephron lou a kokhuk a kei hon suangtute kiang ah hon vui un.
Kanaan gam a Mamre ma a Makpelah lou a kokhuk, Abraham in kivuina mun ding a Hit mi Ephron a kipan alou toh alei ah.
Huai ah Abraham leh azi Sarah avui ua; huai ah Isak leh azi Rebekah avui ua; huai mah ah Leah ka vui hi.
Alou leh asung a kokhuk om Hit suante a kipan alei ahi,” achi hi.
Jakob in atapate kiang a thugou asiah khit in akhete lupna ah angatou a, akha akhahta a, achipihte kiang ah pi in a-om samta hi.
Hiai Adam suante khangthubu ahi. Pathian in mihing asiam ni in Pathian batpih in amah abawl hi.
Pasal leh numei in amaute asiam a; avualzawl a, siam a a-om ni un amin uh Adam asa hi.
Adam in kum za-le-sawmthum ahih in amah mah bang, akibatpih ngei tapa anei a; amin Seth asa hi.
Seth aneih nung in Adam kum zagiat adam lai a; tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Adam damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-sawmthum ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
Seth in kum za-le-nga ahih in, tapa Enosh anei hi.
Enosh aneih nung in Seth kum zagiat-le-sagih adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Seth damsung tengteng kum zakua sawm-le-nih ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
Enosh in kum sawmkua ahih in tapa Kenan anei hi.
Kenan aneih nung in Enosh kum zagiat sawm-le-nga adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Enosh damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-nga ahi a, huchi in asita hi.
Kenan in kum sawmsagih ahih in, tapa Mahalalel anei hi.
Mahalalel aneih nung in Kenan kum zagiat-le-sawmli adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Kenan damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-sawm ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
Mahalalel kum sawmguk-le-nga ahih in tapa Jared anei hi.
Jared aneih nung in Mahalalel kum zagiat-le-sawmthum adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Mahalalel damsung tengteng kum zagiat sawmkua-le-nga ahi a, huchi in asita hi.
Jared in kum zakhat sawmguk-le-nih ahih in tapa Enok anei hi.
Enok aneih nung in Jared kum zagiat adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Jared damsung tengteng kum zakua sawmguk-le-nih ahi a, huchi in asita hi.
Enok in kum sawmguk-le-nga ahih in, tapa Methuselah anei hi.
Methuselah aneih nung in Enok kum zathum sung Pathian toh atonkhawm ua, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Enok damsung tengteng kum zathum sawmguk-le-nga ahi.
Pathian toh Enok atonkhawm ua, amah a-omta kei a; Pathian in alata hi.
Methuselah in kum zakhat sawmgiat-le-sagih ahih in tapa Lamekh anei hi.
Lamekh aneih nung in Methuselah kum zasagih sawmgiat-le-nih adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Methuselah damsung tengteng kum zakua sawmguk-le-kua ahi a, huchi in asita hi.
Lamekh in kum zakhat sawmgiat-le-nih ahih in tapa anei hi.
"Hiai ngei in TOUPA hamsiatkhum leitung ziak a i nasepna leh khut a i sepgimna ah hon lungmuan ding," chi in amin Noah asa hi.
Noah aneih nung in Lamekh kum zanga sawmkua-le-nga adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
Lamekh damsung tengteng kum zasagih sawmsagih-le-sagih ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
Noah kum zanga a upa ahi. Noah in Shem, Ham leh Japheth anei hi.
Huan Joseph in apa mai asi a, akah a, atawp hi.
Joseph in asikha damdawi siamte apa luang muat thei lou a bawl ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in damdawisiamte'n Israel luang muat thei lou in abawl uhi.
Aluang bawlna in ni sawmli azang ua; muat thei lou a bawlna ding a ni hiai zah lut zel mah ahi. Ni sawmsagih sung teng Aiguptate'n amah asuun uhi.
Amah asuun nite uh abei nung in, Joseph in Pharaoh inkuante ahoupih a, "Na mitmuh ua deihsakna ka tanleh hehpih in Pharaoh bil a zak ding in, 'Ka pa'n, ngai in, si ding ka hita.

Kanaan gam a ka han ding a ka tohsa ngei ah na hon vui ding ahi,' chi in ahon kichiamsak hi. Huaiziak in tu in hehpih in ka pa hon potousak inla, hon va vuisak in. Huchi in ka hong pai nawn ding, achi, chi in hon gensak un," achi hi.
Pharaoh in, "Ahon kichiamsak bang in na pa va potou ve," achi hi.
Joseph, apa vui ding in ava hohtou hi. Pharaoh sikha teng, a-inkuan lak a upate leh Aigupta gam upate tengteng leh,
Joseph inkuanpih tengteng leh asanggamte leh apa inkuanpihte, akiang ah ava hohtou uhi. Ataneu chikchikte uleh abelamhonte uleh abawnghonte kia uh Goshen gam ah anusia uhi.
Akiang uah kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite leng ahohtou ua, pawlching petmah ahi uh.
Jordan lui gal a Atad phual atung ua, huai ah nakpitak in akah ua, ni sagih sung apa suunna anei uhi.
Hiai gammi Kanaante'n, Atad phual a ami suun uh amuh un, “Hiai Aiguptate misi suunna thupitak ahi," achi uhi. Huaiziak in huai mun Abel- mizraim asa ua, huai Jordan lui gal a om ahi.
Atapate'n athupiak bang in ahihsak uhi.
Atapate'n Kanaan gam ah azawnglut ua, Abraham in kivuina mun ding a, Hit mi Ephron a kipan alou toh aleikhawm Mamre ma a Makpelah lou a kokhuk ah avuita uhi.
Apa avui khit in Joseph leh asanggamte leh apa vui ding a amah toh hohtou tengteng Aigupta gam ah akik nawnta uhi.
Joseph sanggamte'n apa uh sita ahi chih amuh un, "Joseph in ahon mudah ding a, atung a i thilhihkhelh tengteng phu i tung uah akim in ahon la kha ding e,” achi uhi.
Joseph kiang a hilh ding in mi asawl ua, "Na pa'n asih ma in hichi in thu apia hi.

Joseph kiang ah, 'Hehpih in na sanggamte tatlekna leh agitlouhna uh ngaidam in. Na tung ah thil hoih lou ahihta ngal ua. Tu in hehpih in na pa Pathian sikhate tatlekna ngaidam in,' achi, chi in va gen un," achi hi. Akiang a agentak un Joseph akap hi.
Asanggamte leng ava hoh ua, ama ah abokkhup chiat ua, "Ngai in, na sikhate ka hi uh," achi uhi.
Joseph in akiang uah, "Lau kei un. Pathian sik a om ka hi a hia?
20 Nou zaw ka tung ah thil gilou hih lungsim na pu ua; himahleh tuni in mi tampi hing leh dam a humbitna ding a thil hoih suahsak Pathian lungsim ahi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in tu in lau kei un. Nou leh na taneu chikchikte uh ka hon vak ding," achi hi. Huchi in amau alungmuan a, kamsiamtak in ahoupih hi.
Joseph, amah leh apa inkuanpihte toh Aigupta gam ah ateng ua, Joseph kum za-le-sawmkhat adam hi.
Joseph in Ephraim ta, tusawn thum chiang amu hi. Manasseh tapa Makir tate leng Joseph phei tung a khanglian ngen ahi uh.

Joseph in asanggamte kiang ah, "Si ding ka hita hi. Himahleh Pathian in ahong veh ngeingei ding a, hiai gam a kipan hon pikhia in, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a, piak ding achiamsa gam ah ahon pitou ding," achi hi.
Joseph in Israel suante akichiamsak a, "Pathian in ahong veh ngeingei ding a, hiai a kipan ka guhte na potou ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Joseph kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi. Aluang muat thei lou ding in abawl ua, Aigupta gam ah hankuang sung ah akoih uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, leitung a mite ahong pun ua, tanute ahon neih un,
Pathian tapate'n mite tanute melhoih in amu ua; adeihlam chiat uh zi in anei uhi.
TOUPA'N, "Ka Kha in tangtawn in mi asual nilouh kei ding, amah lah sa ahi ngal a, himahleh kum za-le-sawmnih adam ding," achi hi.
Huai hun lai in lei ah miliante a-om ua; huai nung in leng Pathian tapate'n mite tanute thei a, amau toh tate aneih zel lai un, huaite mah nidanglai a mihat, miminthangte ahi uhi.
TOUPA'N lei ah mite gitlouhdan nasa ahi chih leh alungtang lunggeldan uh gilou ngen ahi ngitnget chih amu hi.
Leitung a mi abawl ziak in TOUPA akisik a, lunggimna in aneihloh hi.
TOUPA'N, "Leitung a kipan ka misiam ka hihmang mai ding. Mite, sate, ganhingte leh tung a leng vasate tan in; ka bawl ziak in ka kisik," achi hi.
Noah in bel TOUPA mitmuh in deihsakna atang hi.
Noah suan hiaite ahi uh: Noah midik ahi a, adam tonpihte lak ah gensiatbei ahi a; Pathian toh Noah atonkhawm uhi.
Noah in tapa thum Shem, Ham leh Japheth anei hi.
Pathian' mitmuh in lei asia a, hiamgamna in lei adim khin hi.
Huan Pathian in lei a-en a, ngai in, asegawp a; sa tengteng in leitung ah a-omdan uh ahihse khinta uhi.
Pathian in Noah kiang ah, "Sa tengteng beina ka ma ah ahong tungta; amaute ziak in hiamgamna in leitung adim khinta ngal a. Ngai in, leitung toh amau ka hihmang ding.
Nang a ding in meilah sing in long bawl inla; long ah dantante na bawl ding ahi. Asunglam leh apolam meilah nai in na zut vek ding hi.
Hiai na bawldan ding ahi. Long dunglam tong zathum hi henla, availam tong sawmnga hi henla, asanlam tong sawmthum hi hen.
Long ah tohlet na bawl ding a, atunglam tong khat chiang a na zoh ding ahi. Apang ah long kongkhak na bawl ding a; chial nuainung leh chial nihna leh chial thumna nei in na bawl ding ahi.
Ngai in, kei mahmah in, sa tengteng hinna hatna pai khempeuh, van nuai a kipan hihmangthang ding in leitung ah tuichim ka tungsak ding a; lei a thil chih omte asi vek ding uh.
Himahleh nang toh ka thukhun ka kipsak ding a, long ah na lut ding ahi. Nang na lut ding a, na tapate leh na zi leh na tapate' zite leng na kiang ah alut ding uh ahi.
Sa tengteng a thil hing chiteng lak a kipan, chi chih nihnih in, na kiang ah hinsak ding in long ah na pilut ding ahi. Amaute anu leh apa zel ahi ding uhi.
Vasate amau chi omdan bang chiat in, gante amau chi omdan bang chiat in, chỉ chih nihnih in na hinsak ding in na kiang ah ahong pai ding uh ahi.
Nek theih an chi tuamtuam kaikhawm inla, na kiang ah koih in. Nang leh amaute a ding in an ahi ding uh," achi hi.
Huchibang in Noah in ahih a; Pathian in akiang a thu apiak tengteng ahi bangbang in ahihta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Noah kiang ah, "Nang leh na inkuanpih tengteng long ah lutta un. Nang zaw hiai khang a ka ma ah midiktat na hih ka hon mu hi.
Sa siang chiteng lak ah anu leh apa, kop sagih zel; sa siang lou lak ah anu leh apa chiat toh kop nih zel, na kiang ah na pi ding ahi.
Tung a leng vasa lak ah leng, anu leh apa chiat, kop sagih zel in; leitung a chi khah ding a hinsak ding in.
Ni sagih in asam lai a, huai khit chiang in leitung ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung vuah ka zusak ding a; ka bawl thil hing chiteng leitung a kipan ka hihmang ding," achi hi.
Noah in TOUPA'N akiang a thu apiak tengteng ahi bangbang in ahihta hi.
Leitung a tuichim ahong tun lai in, Noah kum zaguk a upa ahita hi.
Tuichim atun ding ziak in long ah Noah alut a, atapate leh azi leh atapate' zite leng akiang ah alut chiat uhi.
Sa siang lak ah leng, sa siang lou lak ah leng, vasa lak ah leng, leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng lak ah leng,
Pathian in Noah kiang a thu apiak bang in, anu leh apa chiat, akopkop in, Noah kiang ah long ah alut uhi.
Huan ni sagih nung in leitung ah tuichim atungta hi.
Noah kum zaguk ahih kum, akha nihna, ani sawm-le-sagih ni in, huai ni mah in tui thuk zapi nak tengteng ahong puakzak a, van tohlette leng hong kihongta uhi.
Ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung teng leitung ah vuahpi azuta hi.
Huai ni mah in long ah Noah leh Noah tapate Shem, Ham, Japheth leh Noah zi alut ua, atapate zi thumte leng akiang ah alut uhi.

Amaute alut ua, sa chiteng amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, ganhing leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, vasa chiteng, amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, vasa chiteng, kha nei chiteng leng alut uhi.
Sa tengteng hinna hatna pai himhimte, akopkop in Noah kiang ah long ah alut uhi.
Alutte Pathian in akiang a thu apiak bang in, sa tengteng lak a anu leh apa zel in alut uhi. Huchi in TOUPA'N amah akhakkhumta hi.
Leitung ah ni sawmli sung teng tuichim atung a; tui ahong khang a, long alam a, leitung ah adomkangta hi.
Tui ahong om zuazua a, leitung ah akhan in ahong khang a, tui tung ah long akilam hi.
Leitung ah tui nakpi in ahong om zuazua a; van nuai a tang sang tengtengte atum khin vekta hi.
Tong sawm-le-nga hial a sang in tui ahong om a; tangte tupmang in a-omta uhi.
Lei a tang thei sa chiteng, vasate, gante, gamsate, ganhing lei a bokvak a pai chitengte, michih tengte toh asi khin vek uhi.
Anak ua hinna kha hatna omna tengteng, gam a om tengteng asi khin vek uhi.
Leitung a thil hing chiteng omte, mite, gante, ganhingte, tung a leng vasate toh hihmang in a-om ua; lei a kipan hihman in a-omta ua, long sung a om Noah leh akiang a omte kia hawi in a-om uhi.
Ni za-le-sawmnga sung teng leitung ah tui avung hi.
Huan Pathian in Noah leh long sung a akiang a thil hing chiteng leh ganta om tengteng atheigige a; Pathian in leitung ah huih anungsak a, tui ahong dai panta hi.
Tui thukpi nakte leh van tohlette hong kikhakta ua, van a kipan vuah leng theusak ahita.
Lei a kipan tui akiam giaigiai a; ni za-le-sawmnga nung in tui hong tawm deuhta a,
akha sagihna ani sawm-le-sagih ni in Ararat tang ah long ahong kinga hi.
Akha sawmna tan in tui akiam giaigiai zel a; akha sawmna ani khat ni in mualvumte akimuta hi.
Ni sawmli nung in hichi ahong hi a, Noah in abawl long tohlet ahongta hi.
Va-ak khat akhahkhia a, leitung a kipan tui akan khit masiah huai va-ak avial lenlen hi.
Leitung ah tui atawmta hia, tawm nai lou, chih theihna ding in vakhu khat akhahkhe nawn hi.
Himahleh vakhu in tukna ding himhim amu kei a, akiang ah long ah akik nawn a; tui lah leitung pumpi ah a-om lai ngal a. Polam ah akhut agolhkhia a, long sung ah akiang ah ana lalut nawn hi.
Ni sagih dang angak lai a; long a kipan vakhu akhahkhe nawn hi.
Nitaklam in akiang ah vakhu ahong lut nawn a; ngai in, amuk in olive nah khat ahon tuah hi. Noah in leitung ah tui atawmta chih atheita hi.
Ni sagih dang angak nawn a; vakhu akhahkhe nawn a; akiang ah hong kik nawn kei hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum zaguk-le-khatna, akha khatna, ani khat ni in, leitung a kipan tui akangta hi. Noah in long khuhna akoihsuan a, a-en a; ngai in, leitung ahulta hi.
Akha nihna ani sawmnih-le-sagih ni in leitung ahulta hi.
Pathian in Noah kiang ah thu agen a;
"Long a kipan nang pawt inla, na zi leh na tapate leh na tapate zite leng na kiang ah pawt uhen.

Sa tengteng lak a thil hing chiteng na ompihte, vasate, gante, leitung a bokvak a pai ganhing chitengte toh na kiang ah pikhia in, leitung a chiphatak a chi tampi suang a ahong puntheihna ding un," achi hi.
Noah apawt a, atapate leh azi leh atapate zite leng akiang ah apawt uhi.
Sa chiteng, ganhing chiteng, vasa chiteng, leitung a tang thei peuhmahte amau chi omdan dungzui zel in long a kipan apawtta uhi.
Noah in TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a; sa siang chiteng lak leh vasa siang chiteng lak a kipan ala a, maitam ah halmang pumpiaknate alanta hi.

TOUPA'N huai gim namtui aza a; TOUPA'N alungsim in, "Mite ziak in leitung ka hamsiat nawn kei ding, mite lungsim ngaihtuahnate lah tuailai ahih a kipan gilou ahi ngal ua. Tua ka gawt bang in thil hing chiteng leng ka gawt nawn kei ding.
"Leitung a-om lai teng buhtuh leh buhlakte, khovot leh kholumte, nipi leh phalbite, sun leh zante abei kei ding," achi hi.
Huan Pathian in Noah leh atapate avualzawl a, akiang uah, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, lei hon luahdim un.
Leitung a sa chiteng leh tung a leng vasa chiteng in nou kihtakna leh lauhna anei ding uh. Hiaite leh lei a bokvak a pai tengteng leh tuipi a ngasa tengteng na khut ua piak ahita uhi.
Thil hing tang thei chitengte nou a ding in nek ding ahi ding ua; anteh hing ka hon piak bang in bangkim ka hon pe vek hi.
Himahleh sa, ahinna sisan toh zaw na nekhawm ding uh ahi kei.
Na hinna sisan phu ka la ngeingei ding. Sa chiteng lak ah ka la ding a; mi lak ah leng. Michih asanggamte uh lak ah, mite hinna phu ka la chiat ding.
"Mi sisan suahmi kuapeuh, huai mi mah in ama sisan asuah ding, Pathian batpih a mihing bawl ahi ngal a.
"Nou chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, ta leh nau tampi nei unla, leitung ah hong pung un," achi hi.
Pathian in Noah kiang leh akiang a om atapate kiang ah,
"Ngai un, kei mahmah in na kiang uah leh na nung ua na suante uh kiang ah leng ka thukhun ka hihkip hi.
Na kiang ua om thil hing chiteng, na ompih uh vasate, gante, na ompih uh lei a sa chitengte kiang ah leng; long a kipan hong pawt tengteng, lei a sa chiteng kiang nangawn ah.
Na kiang uah ka thukhun ka hihkip ding; sa tengteng leng tuichim a hihman in a-om nawn kei ding ua; lei hihse ding in tuichim atung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Pathian mah in, "Kei leh nou leh na kiang ua thil hing chiteng omte kal a, suan tawp nei lou a omte a ding in, hiai ka thukhun chiamtehna ahi ding hi.
Meipi ah ka sakhituihup ka zamsak a, huai kei leh lei kal a thukhun chiamtehna ding ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, leitung a meipi ka kaisak in meipi ah sakhituihup akimu ding hi.
Kei leh nou leh sa tengteng lak a thil hing chitengte kal a, ka thukhun om ka theigige ding. Sa tengteng hihmang ding in tui alet nawn kei ding hi.
Meipi a sakhituihup azam chiang in, Pathian leh leitung a sa om tengteng lak a thil hing chiteng kal a tangtawn thukhun om ka theihgige theihna ding in ka en zel ding," achi hi.
Pathian mah in Noah kiang ah, "Hiai kei leh leitung a sa om tengteng kal a ka thukhun hihkip chiamtehna ahi," achi nawn hi.
Noah tapa long a kipan pawtte Shem, Ham leh Japheth ahi uhi (Kanaan pa Ham ahi).
Hiai mi thumte Noah tapate ahi ua, amaute a kipan pawtte'n leitung pumpi azelsuak uhi.
Louneimi in Noah ahong om pan a, grephuan abawl hi.
Uain adawn a, akham a; apuanin ah alumkhialta hi.
Kanaan pa Ham in apa lumkhial amu a, inpua a om a-unau nihte ava hilh hi.
Shem leh Japheth in puan ala ua, aliang ua kizawn in anung pai ua, apa uh lumkhial ava khuh uhi. Amai uh lehlam nga in apa uh lumkhial amu kei uhi.
Noah, uain kham ahong halh a, atung a atapa naupangpen in ahihdan ahon theita hi.
"Kanaan hamsiat in om hen. Asanggamte sikhate sikha ahi ding,” achi hi.
"Shem TOUPA Pathian phat in om hen. Asikha in Kanaan om hen.
Pathian in Japheth hihlian henla, Asikha in Kanaan om hen,” achi lai hi.
Tuichim tun nung in Noah kum zathum-le-sawmnga adam hi.
Noah damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-sawmnga ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
Puakgik zawlnei Habakkuk in amuh;
Aw TOUPA, kei bang tan kikou a, nang hon za lou ding na hia? Hiamgamna thu ah na kiang ah ka kikoukhia a, nang lah na hon dawng nuam kei hi.
Bangziak a thulimlouhna hon musak a, ginatlouhna hon ensak na hia? Lohna leh hiamgamna lah ka ma ah a-om ngal ua; kilanna a-om a, kinakna a-om hi.
Huaiziak in dan a ze-ol a, vaihawmna akuankhe ngei kei; giloute'n lah diktatte a-umsuak vek ua; huaiziak in vaihawmna pawtkhia hekkawi in a-om hi.
Namte lak en unla, thei un, lamdangtak in lamdang sa unla; noute hun sung in nna khat ka sem ding, huai hon hilh mah le uh na gingta nuam kei ding uhi.
Ngai un, Kaldaite ka bawlkhia hi, huai nam hiamgam leh ngongtat; huaite'n amau tenna mun hilou tang ding in lei vailam khaktan in apai uh.
Amulkimhuai un alauhuai ua; avaihawmna uh leh athuneihna uh amau ngei a kipan apawtkhia hi.

Asakolte uh leng gialbemte sang in akinzaw ua, nitaklam ngiate sang in alauhuaizaw uh; asakol tungtuang mite uh akiphalh ua; ahi, gamlapi a kipan asakol tungtuang mite uh ahong pai ua; negai ding a kinoh muvanlai bang in aleng uhi.
Hiamgam ding in avek un ahong ua; suahlam huih bang in kilawptak in amailam uh en in atai ua; piaunel bang in salte akaikhawm uhi.
Ahi, amaute'n kumpipate anuihsan ua, amau a ding in thuneite nuihzatna ahi uhi; kulh muanhuai chiteng anuihsan ua; leivui a vum a, alak zel ziak un.
Huai chiang in huih bang in apaisuak ding ua, mailam anawt zel ding ua, athahatna uh Pathian a neite gilou mohtansak ahi uhi.
Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, ka Mi Siangthou, tangtawn a kipan na hi kei a hia? Ka si kei ding uh, Aw TOUPA, vaihawm ding in amah na hihkipta hi. Nang, Aw suangpi, bawldik ding in amau na tungkheta hi.
Gilou muhna ding a nang mit chiimzaw, hoihlouhna ensim thei lou, bang ding a lepchiahtak a thilbawlte mu a, gilou in ama sang a diktatzaw mi anawmvalh lai a dai maimah na hia?
Mite tuipi ngasate bang, atung ua vaihawmtu nei lou leh bokvak ganhingte bang a bawl maimah na hi.
Ngakuai in avek un akhaikhe tou a, alen in amau aman a, amaute alenpi a huaikhawm a om in nuamsa in akipak uhi.
Huaiziak in len a ding in kithoihna alan ua, alenpi ua ding in gimlim ahal hi; amaute ziak a atan uh hoih a, asa uh atam ziak in.
Huaiziak in amau lente hihvuak a, namte hihse gige tel ding ahi uh maw?
Ka galvenna ah ka dingh dia, insang ah ka pang ding a, ka kiang a bang ahia agen chih thei ding in leh ka phunna tungtang bangchi in ka dawng dia chih thei ding in ka ngak ding hi.
Huan TOUPA'N kei ahon dawng a, mengmuh pen gelh inla, asim peuhmah atai theihna ding in, suangpekte ah kichiantak in gelh in.
Mengmuh lah hun sehsa a ding ahi lai a, atawplam ah akinoh a, azuau kei ding; om tadih mahleh, ngak in; ahong tun ding ziak in, azekai kei ding hi.
Ngai in, akha kiliansak amah midiklou ahi, himahleh midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding hi.

Ahi, uain in lepchiahtak in a-omsak a, miki-uangsak, om kinken lou ahi; gawtmun bang a adeih hihlian, sihna bang ahi a, suklungkim theih ahi kei, nam tengteng amah ah akaikhawm zaw a, atung ah mipite tengteng asekhawm hi.

Hiaite tengteng in amah dem in gentehna agen un, amah demna paunak enghouna hiai bang a gen in, "Amah a lou hihpungpa tung agik!" Bang tan? chi in agen kei ding ua hia! Bang tan thil khamna zang a kihih inbulpa;
na leibatnate thakhat a hong thoukhia a, nang hon hihbuai ding a hong khanglou lou ding uhia? Nang amaute a ding a gallak suak ding hilou na hi maw?
Nam tampi na loh ziak in, mipi akhosuaksunte tengteng in nang ahon lok ding ua; mite sisan ziak in leh gam tung, khopi tung leh asung a teng tengteng tung a hiamgam na hihna ziak in.
"Tunglam sang a abu asehtheihna ding leh gilou khut a kipan tatkhiak a-omtheihna ding a, a-inn a dia punna gilou mumi tung agik!"
Mi tampi satkhia in, na hinna tung a khial in na inkote tung ah zumhuaina na zong ahi.
Baang a kipan suang akikoukhe ding a, sing a kipan inkam in dawng ding ahih ziak in.
"Sisan a khua lam a, khopi gitlouhna a dingsakmi tung agik!"
Ngai in, mite sepgimna mei a khul ding singkhuah bang leh namte kisukgimna uh bangmah lou a suah ding sepaihte' TOUPA thilgelsa ahi kei maw?
Tuite'n tuipi akhuh bang in, TOUPA thupina theihna a leitung pumpi dim ding ahih ziak in.
A-inveng dawn ding pia a, huai a gu hel a, avuaktanna uh a-ettheihna ding a, amah khamsak lai mi tung agik hi!
Thupina deihna in zumhuaina in na dim a; nang leng dawn inla, zeksumloupa bang in om in; TOUPA khut taklam nang lam ngatsak ahi ding a, na thupina tung ah zumhuaina hoih lou a-om ding hi.
Lebanon tung a hiamgam hihna in nang ahon khuh ding a, gamsate siatna in nang ahon lausak ding; gam tung, khopi leh asung a teng tengteng tung a hiamgam a mite sisan na suah ziak in.
A gelhmi in agelh, milim gelh; milim sun, zuaute sinsakpa, milim pau thei lou bawl ding a, huai a anasep bang phatuam ahia?
Sing kiang a, Halh in; suang pau thei lou kiang a, Thou in, chimi tung agik hi! Ngai in dangka-eng leh dangka a luan milim, amah ah nakna om lou in asinsak thei diam?
Himahleh TOUPA atempul siangthou ah a-om a; ama ah leitung pumpi dai sipsip hen.
Zawlnei Habakkuk thumna, Sigionoth toh kituak a bawl
Aw TOUPA, na tanchin agen uh ka za a, ka lau hi. Aw TOUPA, kumte lak ah nasep hihhalh in, kumte lak ah kitheisak in; thangpaihna zahngaihna theigige in.
eman a kipan in Pathian ahong pai a, Paran tang a kipan in Mi Siangthou, Selah Athupina in vante atuam a, amah phatna in leitung adim hi.
Amah thupina vak bang ahi a; akhut a pan nizung ahong suakkhia hi; athilhihtheihna huai ah akhuh hi.
Ama ah hipi apai a, akhepekte ah suangkuangthei kuang apaikheta hi.
Adingh a, lei alingsak a; amu a, namte ahawlzak hi; tangtawn tangte hihdalh in a-omta ua, tangtawn mualte akun ua, apaina nidang a bang ahi.
Kushan puaninte gimthuak in ka mu a; Midian gam mite alinggawp uhi.
Luite tung a TOUPA lungkim lou ahi diam aw? Luite tung a na hehna om hia ahihkeileh tuipi tung a na thangpaihna, na sakolte tung a na tuanna leh hotdamna na kangtalaite tung a na tuanna?
Na thalpeu avuak petmah a bawl ahi; namte kiang ah kichiamnate thutak ahi uh, Selah Luite'n lei akhangkhamsak hi.
Tangte'n nang ahon mu ua, alau uh; tui khang in akheng a, tui thuk in a-aw asuah a, tungsang ah khutte aliktou hi.
A-omna uah ni leh kha adingh kinken ua; apai bang un na thalte vak ah, na teipi te zolzol in avak uhi.
Heh in gam na palsuak petmah a, thangpai in namte na chil hi.
Na mipite hondam ding in na kuankhia a, na thaunilh hotdamna ding in; giloute inn a kipan lutang na hihliam a; ngawng chiang pha hial in suangphum na hihse vek. Selah
Agalhatte lutang amah chiangte ngei in na sun a; kei hon dalhsak ding in pingpei bang in ahong pai uhi; nuam asakna uh gentheite aguk a ne khin ding in ahi.
Na sakolte in tuipi leh tui hatte sunvumte na chil hi.

Ka za a, ka gilpi akising a, ka kam a awte aling pupulh a; ka guhte ah muatna ahong lut a, ka mun ah ka linggawp hi; buai ni a amah sim dia hong kuan mite dou ding a ahong paitouh chiang a ka linlouhna ding in, dai dide in ka ngak ding hi.
Theipi kung pak pha lou in, grep guite ah agah om lou in; olive sepgimna vuaksuak in, loute'n nek ding piangsak lou in; huang a pan ganhonte satkhiak a om in, huangsung ah ganta omta kei mahleh;
huchipi in leng TOUPA ah ka kipak ding a, ka hotdamna Pathian ah ka nuam ding hi.
Jehovah, TOUPA, ka hatna ahi, ka khepekte zukpi khe bang in abawl a, ka mun sangte ah ahon vaksak ding hi. Lapu lian a ding, tumging guineite a sak ding.

Kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum nihna, akha gukna, huai kha ani khat ni in, Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kiang leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kiang ah zawlnei Haggai a kipan TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N thu agen, "Hiai mite'n, eite i kisak a TOUPA' inn lam hun ahi kei," achi uh.
Huchi in zawlnei Haggai a kipan in TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
"Hiai inn kigawpsa a om a, nou a dia na intung dalneite ua na ten hun uh ahi maw?" chi in.
Huaiziak in tu in sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Na lampite uh ngaihtuah un," achi hi.

Tampi na tuh ua, tawmchik na la uh; na ne ua, himahleh na vah kei uh; na dawn ua, himahleh na dawnkham zou kei uh; na kisilh ua, himahleh kuamah na lum kei uh; loh mu in iptaw vangsa a koih ding in loh amu hi, chi in.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na lampite uh ngaihtuah un.
Tang ah hohtou unla, sing va la un, inn lam unla; huai ah ka kipak ding a, hih thupi in ka om ding," TOUPA'N achi.

Tampi na lamen ua, ngai un, tawmchik ahong hi hi; inn na hon tut chiang un, ka na mutmang hi. Bangziak in? Sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Michih noumau inn tuam ah na tai chiat ua, kei inn pen kisegawp a a-om ziak in.
Huaiziak in noute ziak in van in adaitui akhou a, lei in agah akhou hi.
Huchi in gam, tang, buh leh uain, sathau leh lei a pan piangkhia thil peuhmah, mi, ganhon leh khut nasep tengteng tung ah keuna ka samta hi.

Huchi in Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh siampu lianpen Jehozadak tapa Joshua in mikho-suaksunte tengteng toh TOUPA a Pathian uh aw leh TOUPA a Pathian un asawl, zawlnei Haggai thute amang ua; huan mite'n TOUPA alau taktak uhi.
TOUPA thukhah in TOUPA sawltak Haggai in mite kiang ah thu agen a, TOUPA'N, "Na kiang uah ka om, achi," chi in.
Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kha leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kha leh mikhosuaksunte tengteng kha TOUPA'N atokthou a; akuan ua sepaihte' TOUPA, a Pathian uh inn ah nna asemta uh;
huai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni, akha gukna, kumpipa Darias vaihawm kum nihna in.
Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawmnih-le-khatna in, zawlnei Haggai a kipan TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
"Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kiang ah leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kiang leh mikhosuaksunte kiang ah tu'n thu gen in," chi in.
Tuma a athupina a hiai inn mu, na lak uah kua na om lai ua? Huan tu in bangchibang in na mu ua? Na mitmuh un bangmah lou bang ahi maw? chi in.

Himahleh, Zerubbabel aw, hattak in om in, TOUPA'N achi, Joshua, siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa aw, hattak in om in; nou gam a mite tengteng aw, hattak in om unla, nna sem un, TOUPA'N achi; na kiang ua ka om ziak in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Aigupta gam a kipan a na hong paikhiak lai ua na kiang ua thu ka khun a, na lak ua ka kha a-om gige dan theigige un; lau kei un.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a: Khatvei lai, sawt lou kal in, vante, leitung leh tuipi, gamhulte tan in ka sing ding hi.
Nam tengteng ka sing ding a, huchi in nam tengteng thil deihte ahong tung ding, huchi in thupina in hiai inn ka dimsak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Dangka kei a ahi, dangka-eng kei a ahi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Hiai inn thupina nanung, amasa sang in athupizaw ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: hiai lai mun ah muanna ka pe ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Darias akum nihna, akha kuana ani sawmnih-le-lina in, zawlnei Haggai a kipan in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Tu in dan lam thu a siampute dong un;
mi'n apuansilh puanten ah sa siangthou lou leh apuanten in tanghou hiam, meh hiam, uain hiam, sa hiam sukha taleh, siangthou ahi lai diam?" chi in. Siampute'n, "li" chi in adawng uhi.
Haggai in, "Misi luang ziak a minin in hiaite abangpeuh khoih kha taleh siang in a-om diam?" achi hi. Siampute'n adawng ua, "Siang lou in a-om ding," achi uhi.
Haggai in adawng a, "TOUPA'N, huchibang in hiai mite leh huchibang in hiai nam ka ma ah ahi uh; huchibang in akhutte uh nasep chiteng; leh huai lai a athillat uh asiang kei, achi,” chi in.
Huchi in tu in, ka hon ngen ahi, tuni a kipan leh abanban in, TOUPA tempul a suang akichian ma in ngaihtuah un;
mi'n tehna sawmnih kivum ahong muh lai, huai nite a-om nungsiah, sawmkhat kia a-om hi; bawm sawmnga a dimkhe ding a mi'n uain thau ahon muh lai in, sawmnih kia a-om hi.
Na khut nasepte tengteng uah keuna leh kawt luatna leh gial in ka hon gawt a; huchipi in leng kei lam na hong nga kei uh, TOUPA'N achi.
Tuni a kipan leh abanban in ngaihtuah un, TOUPA tempul suangphum akiphum ni a kipan, akha kuana ani sawmnih-le-li ni a kipan, ngaihtuah un.
Buhpang ah haichi a-om lai hia? Ahi, grepgui, theipi kung, theibuhfai, olive sing ahong suak kei lai a; tuni a kipan in ka hon vualzawl ding hi.
Huai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni in Haggai kiang ah anihveina in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
Judah ukpipa Zerubbabel kiang ah, "Van leh lei ka sing ding a,

lalgam leh laltutphahte ka lumlet ding a, namte, lalgamte hatna ka hihse ding a, kangtalaite leh huai a tuangte ka pai ding; huchi in sakolte leh atung ua tuang mite ahong kum ding uh, michih a-unau namsau in satlum ding achi, chi in thu gen in.
Huai ni chiang in, Aw Zerubbabel, ka sikha, Shealtiel tapa, ka hon la ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, suainamna in ka hon bawl ding, TOUPA'N, achi; nang ka hon telta ngal a," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Pathian, nidanglai api-le-pute kiang a seh tampi leh lam chiteng a zawlneite zang a thu na genpa'n,
tu hun nanung ah eite kiang ah a Tapa in thu ahon genta hi. Huai mi bangkim gouluahpa ding in asiam a, huai mi mah in khovel asiam hi.
Amah ah athupina vak leh atak batpih leh ama thilhihtheihna a bangkim tungdingpa hi in, i khelhnate sianna abawl khit nung in tunglam a thupina khut taklam ah ava tuta hi.
Angelte sang a min ngaihzaw amuh bang in amaute sang a tungnungzaw tham ana hi him hi.
Angelte lak ah kua kiang ah hiai thute agen ngei a? "Nang zaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia," chih leh "Amah a ding in Pa ka hi dia, amah kei a ding in Tapa ahi ding,"
Huan ata neihsun khovel a apilut lai in, “Pathian angelte tengteng in leng amah chibai buk uhen," achi hi.
Huan angelte tungtang thu ah, Ama'n zaw a-angelte huih in asuaksak a, anasemte leng meikuang in asuaksak chi in agen hi.
Tapa tungthu ah bel, "Pathian aw, na laltutphah tangtawn in a-om ding hi; dikna kumpi chiang leng na gam kumpi chiang ahi, chi in agen hi.
Diktatna na it a, tatlekna na hua a; huaiziak in Pathian, na Pathian in na lawmte sang in nang kipahna thau ahon nilh hi."
Huan nang, "Toupa'n, atung in leilung kingakna na phum khin a, vante leng na khutsuak ahi;
Huaite ahong mangthang ding ua, nang bel om tawntung ding na hi; huaite tengteng puansilh bang in ahong lui ding ua,
Puan bang in na zial ding a, puansilh bang lel in ahong lamdangta ding a; nang bel angeingei na hiden a, na kumte leng amang kei ding," chi in.
Himahleh angelte akua pen kiang ah ahia hiai agen ngei? "Na melmate na khepek ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, chih.”
Angelte tengteng nasepna khate, hotdamna gouluah dingte a dia nasem ding a sawlkhiak ahi kei ua hia?
Dan bel thil hoih hong om ding lim kia ahih ziak in, ataktak lohkhiakna nei lou in, kum teng a kithoihna ngeingei alat zelte un, abe ding a hong paite bangchi mah in abukimsak thei ngei kei hi.
Huchi hi keileh lat tawp thamta lou ding uhia? Abemite khatvei a hihsiangthou pah hileh khelhna kitheihna anei nawn kei ding uhi.
Himahleh huai kithoihna ah kum teng in khelhnate theih nawnna ahong om nak hi.
Bawngtal leh kelte sisan in khelhnate lamang theivual ahi kei hi.
Huchi a khovel a Khrist ahong lut lai in; "Kithoihna leh thillat na deih kei a, kei a ding in pumpi na hon bawlsak zaw hi."
Halmang a pumpiaknate leh khelhna ding a kithoihnate ah kipahna himhim na nei kei hi.
Huaitak in ke'n, "Pathian aw, Ngai in, laibuzial a ka tungthu gelh ahih bang in na deihlam hih ding in ka hong pai," ka chi hi.
Atung ah, "Kithoihnate, thillatte, halmang pumpiaknate, khelhna ding a kithoihnate dan bang a lat ahih ziak in na deih kei a, amaute ah kipahna na nei sam kei," achi hi.
Huaitak in ama'n, "Ngai in, Pathian aw, na deihlam hih ding in ka hong pai," achita hi. Anihna atunding theihna ding in amasapen alamangta hi.
Huai deihlam in Jesu Khrist pumpi khatvei thu a setdet ding a alat tak ziak in, hihsiangthou in i omta hi.
Huan siampu tengteng in kawl a nisuak sim a nna sem in, khelhnate bangchik mah a hihmang thei lou kithoihna ngeingei lan gige in adingh uhi.
Amah bel tangtawn a ding akhelhnate a dia kithoihna khat kia alat nung in, "Pathian taklam ah ava tu zawta hi."
Huai nungsiah, "Amelmate akhepek ngakna a siam ahih masiah uh angak nilouh hi."
Huchi in khatvei thillat in hihsiangthousate tangtawn a ding in ahih bukimta hi.
Huan Kha Siangthou in eite ahon theihpih sam a, amasa in hiai bang in agen hi,
"Huai nite khit chiang in akiang ua ka thukhun ding hiaite ahi, Toupa'n achi; alungtang uah ka thupiakte ka koih dia, alungsim uah ka gelh nalai ding chi a agen khit in,
akhelhnate uh leh atatleknate uh ka theigige nawnta kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in khelhna ngaihdam ahih nung in khelhna a ding in thillat a-om nawnta kei hi.
Huchi in unaute aw, Jesu sisan ziak a mun siangthou a lutngamna nei in,
lampi thak leh hing tawn a puanzak sung a luttheihna, ama pumpi tawn in i nei uhi.
Pathian inkuante tung a siampu thupitak i neih ziak in,
i lungtang a sia-le-pha theihna siang lou a pan thehsiang a om in leh i pumpi leng tui siang a sil a om in, ginna a theihchetna kim nei in lungtang diktak mah pu in amah i naih ding uhi.
I lamet thugin ling lou in i pomkip ding uh, thuchiampa amuanhuai hi.
Huan itna leh thil hoih hih a kitokthou ding in i kingaihtuah ding uhi.
Khenkhatte hihdan bang a i kikhopnate uh tawpsan lou in, kihanthawn chiat ni; ni hong nai hulhul a na theih un kihanthawntuah sem un.
Thutak theihna kim i tan nung a thil i hihkhelh teitei in zaw, khelhnate a dia kithoihna a-om tak louh ziak in,
Vaihawmna lauhuai mulkimhuaitak, dou mite kangmang ding thangpaihna mei maban a nei in i om zawta ding hi.
Mosi Dan khawk saloumi, "Theihpihtu mi nih hiam thum hiam nuai ah, zahngaihna bei in asi zel uhi."
Pathian Tapa sikden a, thukhun sisan amah hihsianthouna pen thil namai a bawl a, hehpihna Kha hihvuimi, huai mi sang a bangchi phet a gawtna thupizaw thuak tak in na sep uhiam?
"Phulakna himhim keimah lak ding ahi, keima'n ka thuk ding chih leh Toupa'n amite vai ahawmsak ding," chi nawnpa lah i thei ngal uhi.
Pathian hing khut a puk thil mulkimhuaitak ahi.
Himahleh tuma lam a hihvak a na om nung ua thuakna buaina thupitak na thuak lai nite uh thei nawn un;
kong khat ah zaw muhsit leh haksatna thuak in etnop a bawl in na om ua, kong khat ah lah huchibang a bawl a omte thuakpihte na hong hi uhi.
Kolbunte na lainat ua, gou hoihzaw leh a-omden ding noumau in na neih uh kithei in na van hon laksakte uh leng kipaktak in na na thuakzou behlap uhi.
Huchi in kipahman piak thupitak ngahna ding na ginna uh paimang kei un.
Pathian deihlam na hih nung un thilchiam na muhtheihna ding un kuhkalna na kiphamoh uhi.
Sawt lou nung chiang a hong pai dingpa, hong pai ding ahi, sawt ahal nawn kei ding hi.
"Tu in ka midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding; anungtolhleh bel ka kha in amah ah kipahna anei kei ding," chih ahi ngal a.
Himahleh eite zaw mangthang ding a nungtolh pawl a pang i hi kei ua; hinna humbit ding a ginna nei pawl a pang i hi zaw uhi.
Ginna tuh thil lamette om ngei a theihtelna leh thil muhlouhte theihchetna ahi.
Huai ah nidanglai upate'n phat aloh uhi.
Ginna in khovelte Pathian thu a suktuah ahita chih i thei ua, huchi in thil muhtheihte leng thil langtheite a siam ahi kei hi.

Ginna in Abel in Kain sang in Pathian kiang ah kithoihna hoihzaw alan a, huaiziak in midik hihna amu chih Pathian in athilpiakte apomna ah atheisak hi; huai ginna ziak mah in ama'n sih nung nangawn in thu agen lai hi.
Ginna in Enok leng sihna chiam lou ding in lakmang in a-om a; Pathian in alakmang ziak in muh theih ahita kei a; lakmang a a-om ma in Pathian pahtak lam mi ahi chih theihsakna amu khinta hi.
Himahleh ginna lou in amah pahtak lam mi hih vual ahi kei; Pathian kiang a hong pai in, amah a-om chih leh azong mite lohchingsakpa ahi chih gin ding ahi.

Ginna in Noah thil muh nailouhte lam thu ah Pathian hilh a om in, Pathian laudan siam in a-inkuan hotdamna ding in long abawl a; huai in khovel siam louh atangsakta hi, ginna ziak adiktatna gouluahpa ahita hi.
Ginna in Abraham sap a a-om lai in agouluah ding mun a lut ding in paikhiakna ding thu amuta hi; apaina ding lam thei lou in apaikheta hi.
Ginna in gam chiam ah mi gam a taam bang in ana taam nilouh a, thuchiam kikhat gouluahpih ding Isak leh Jakobte toh puanin ah a-om uhi.
Khopi suangphum nei, Pathian gel leh lam angak nilouh hi.
Ginna in Sarah ngei in leng a chiampa muanhuai asak ziak in, atek nung in chi paitheihna amu hi.
Huchi in pasal khat amah lah misi bang mai a kipan, "Van a aksite bang a tam, tuipiau a piaunel bang a sim zoh louh suangtu," ahong suakta uhi.

Hiai mi tengtengte'n thilchiamte tang khin hilou in, himahleh huaite gamlapi a kipan galmuh a na kipahpih hi zaw in, lei ah zaw khualzin leh mikhual lel ahi uh chih kitheigige in ginna nei in amaute asita uhi.
Huchibang a thu na gente'n amau gam ding azong uh chih ahihlang mahmah uhi.
Apawtsan gam uh lunggulh hi le uh bel kik nawnna hunlem mu mahmah ding ahi uhi.
Himahleh tu'n bel gam hoihzaw huai van a om pen deih ahi ua; huchi in Pathian a Pathian uh chih a om azum kei a; amau ding in khopi khat abawlsak hi.
Ginna in Abraham tuh ze-et a om in, Isak alan a; huan thuchiamte kipaktak a sangpa'n atapa neihsun alan hi,
huai lah, "Isak ah na suante akiminloh ding," achih pen ahi.
Pathian in misi lak a kipan nangawn kaithou thei in asep a; huchi in gentehna dan a gen in amah misi lak a kipan mu nawn ahi ngei hi.
Ginna in Isak in thil hong tung dingte thu ah Jakob leh Esau avualzawl hi.
Ginna in Jakob in asih ding kuan in Joseph tate avualzawl tuaktuak a, "Achiangkhun dawn a kingai in Pathian abia hi."
Ginna in Joseph in asih ding kuan in, Israel suante pawt ding thu agen a; aguhte vui ding tungtang thu apia hi.
Ginna in Mosi apian lai in, naungek melhoihtak ahi achih ziak un kha thum sung anu leh apate sel in a-om a; kumpipa thupiak leng alau kei uhi.
Ginna in Mosi in ahong pichin nung in Pharaoh tanu tapa a kiloh a-ut kei a;
sawt lou kal a dia khelhna nopna kipahpih sang in Pathian mite toh sukgentheih thuak atel zawta hi.
Khrist amuhsitna uh Aigupta gam goute sang a hauhsakna thupizaw in angai a; kipahman piak ding a-et zel ziak in.
Ginna in kumpipa thangpaihna lau lou in Aigupta gam apaisan a, muh theih louh pa amuh ziak in athuak teitei hi.
Ginna in Paikan Ankuangluina leh sisan thehna abawl a, ta masa hihmangthangpa'n amaute akhoihlouhna ding in.
Ginna in gam hul a pai bang in Tuipi San akan ua, Aiguptate'n tua bang a hih atum sam ua, tui ah akelum uhi.
Ginna in Jeriko khokulh ni sagih a-um nung un achimta hi.
Ginna in Rahab kizuaknu, gingloute lak ah amangthangkhawm kei, enkhete iim nei lou a ana pahtak ziak in.
Huan bang ka gen nalai dia? Gideon thute, Barak thute, Samson, Jepthah leh David thute, Samuel thute, zawlneite thute gen ni chi lehang hun in hon daih lou ding ahi.
Huai mite'n ginna in gam ala ua, thudik a vaihawm azong ua, thuchiamte atang ua, humpinelkai kamte achihsak uhi.
Mei thilhihtheihna ahihmit ua, namsau hiam nangawn apel ua, hatlouhna a kipan hattak a bawl in a-om ua, kidouna ah mihat minthang ana hi ua, namdang kidou pawlte ataikeksak uhi.
Numeite'n amisite uh thounawn amu ua; khenkhatte gimthuaksak in a-om ua, thohnawnna hoihzaw atantheihna ding un khahkhiakna adeih kei uhi.
Midangte'n leng nuihza bawlna leh vuak athuak ua, ahi, huai lou leng, kolbut leh hentakna atuak uhi.
Suang a den in a-om ua, sing-atna a attan in a-om ua, khemna atuak ua, namsau a satlup in a-om ua; belam vun leh kel vun silh in avakvai ua; gentheitak a gimthuak a sawi in a-om uhi.
Khovel amau tenna tak hilou mite, gamdai mun, mual tung, phaizang leh kawlhawm ah avial vakvak uhi.
Ahi a, hiaite tengteng in ginna ziak in phat na loh khin mah le uh thilchiam pen atang kei uh;
Pathian in eite a dia thil hoihzaw muhkholh aneih ziak a, ei tel lou a amaute hihbukim a a-omlouhna ding ziak uh ahi.
Huaiziak in huchi tel a theihpihte, meipi thupi umsuak a i om thei in, hon hihnok peuhmah leh khelhna eimah a belhte koihmang ni, huan i ma ua kitaitehna ding om ah kuhkaltak in tai ni.
Jesu, i ginna siampa leh hihkippa, ama a kipahna om ziak a zahlaknate ngaineu a kros a thuakpa, Pathian laltutphah taklam a tupa, amah lam en in.
Na khalam ua na bah ua, na lungkiaklouhna ding un, mikhialte a pan a huchibang a selkalhna thuakpa ngaihtuah un.
Khelhna dou in sisan suak hial in na pang nai kei uhi; hanthawnna thu, tate taihilh bang a nou hon taihilhna na mangngilhta uhi.
"Ka ta, Toupa sawina ngaineu ke'nla, ataihilh a na om in leng lungke sam ke'n;
Toupa'n a-itte asawi nak a, ta akipahpih avo nak hi,” chi in.
Na thuak uh zaw noumau a ding ahi; tate tung a hih bang in Pathian in na tung uah ahih a; pa sawi louh ta kua a-om ngei a?
Ta chihna teng loh a sawina loh lou a na om un bel, tatak hilou in, sawn na hi ua akei dia.
Huai lou leng eite hon sawi ding, sa ah pate i nei uhi, huaite lah zahtak ngal hang a; huai sang a thupizaw in, i hinna ding in, khate Pa thuthu in i om kei ding ua hia?
Amau zaw ni sawt louchik, hoih asak bang zel un ahon sawi ua, ama'n bel asianthouna i tantheihna ding in, i hoihna ding in ahon sawi zaw hi.
Sawina himhim thuak lai in kipahhuai in alang kei a khasiathuai in alang zaw hi, himahleh anung in huchi a sawizawt a omte ding in diktatna gah khamuanhuaitak asuahsak zel hi.
Huchi in khut kaikhete leh khut zawte liktou un;
huan khebai kilawisak lou a, hihdam a a-om zawkna ding in, na khete uh a ding in lamtang bawl un.
Mi tengteng toh kituahna leh sianthouna delh un, huai sianthouna lou in kuamah in Toupa amu kei ding uhi;
Pilvangtak in en un, huchi lou in zaw Pathian hehpihna ngah zou lou kuahiam a-om ding a, khaatna zung banghiam hong sel a nou hon hihbuai in, huai in mi tampi hihnit in a-om ding uhi;
kingaihhat hiam, Esau bang a Pathian zahloumi hiam ahong om kha ding hi. Ama'n ata masa hihna an khatvei nek in akhawngta hi.
Huai nung in vualzawlna gouluah a-ut in, khitui ke kawm in phatuamngaitak in zong mahleh, kisikna hun amuh louh ziak in paih in a-omta chih na thei uhi.
Nou zaw tang khoih theih, mei a kangte, meivomte, mialte, huihpite,
pengkul ginnate, thugen ging omnate tung na hi kei ua; huai ging zate'n thudang akiang ua gen nawn lou ding in angen uhi.
"Gamsa nangawn in huai tang akhoih aleh suang a denlup in a-om ding," ahi chih thupiak pen athuak thei kei uhi.
Athil muh peuhmah uh akihtakhuai mahmah ziak in Mosi in, "Ka lau a, ka nak lin mahmah,” achi hial hi.
Himahleh Zion tang, Pathian hing khopi, van lam Jerusalem, sim zoh louh angel hon khawmpite,
ta masa van a min tuang saptuam hon kiang, Pathian, mi tengteng ngaihtuahpa kiang bang, midiktat hih hoihkim kha kiang leh,
Jesu thukhun thak palai kiang, sisan theh, Abel sisan sang a thuhoihzaw genpa kiang tung na hi zaw uhi.
Thugenpa na deih kei kha ding uh, pilvang un. Lei a amaute taihilhpa adeih louh ua bawn, gimthuakna apelh louh ngal un, eite, van a kipan a hon taihilhpa kiheisante'n i pel kei sem ding uhi.
Huai hun in aw in lei ahihling a, "Himahleh tu'n zaw, khatvei lei kia hilou in, van leng ka hihling nawn ding chi in akichiam zawta hi."
Khatvei ka hihling nawn ding chih in, thil lingloute a-om dettheihna ding in, thil lingtheite thilsiamte bang phet in, suanmang in a-om ding chih theisak ahi.
Huchi in hihlin vual louh gam i tan ziak in, hehpihna i nei ding ua, huaiziak in zah leh laudan siam kawm in, Pathian pahtak lam nna i sem thei ding uhi.
Pathian zaw mikatmang hat mei ahi.
Unau ki-itna om zel hen.
Mikhualte tung ah itna suah ding mangngilh kei un; huchibang hih in khenkhat in theiloupi in angelte azintun uhi.
Hen a omte hen hi sam bang in theigige unla; gimthuakte sa a om sam na hih ziak un theigige un.
Mi tengteng lak ah kitenna pahtawi in om henla, lupna leng hihbuah louh in om hen; kingaite leh angkawmte tung a Pathian in vaihawm ding ahi.
Na lungsim putdan uh dangka deihtakna pang lou hi hen; na thil neihsun tung uah lungkim un; amah mah in, "Bangchik mah in ka hon don lou kei ding a, pai leng ka hon paisan kei ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in hangsantak in, "Toupa hon panpihpa ahi, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia?" i chi uhi.
Noute hon heu, Pathian thu hon hilhte, theigige unla, a-omdan ua thilsuakte ngaihtuah in a-omdan uh ching un.
Jesu Khrist tuh zan, tuni leh tangtawn in angeingei in a-om gige hi.

Kisinsakna tuamtuam leh thugin lamdangte mutleng in om kei un; lungtang hehpihna a hihkip a om ahoih ngal a, nek dingte bang a hihkip a om lou in; huchibang lam lungkhamte'n huaite ah phattuamna amu tuan kei uhi.
Eite'n maitam khat, biakbuk nasemte'n anek theihlouhna mun i nei hi.
Gan sisan, siampu lianpen in mun siangthou a khelhna a dia lan a alutpih zel luangte dainawl ah ahal uhi.
Huchi in Jesu in leng amah sisan mahmah a mite ahihsianthouna ding in kulh kongkhak polam ah ana thuakta hi.
Huchi in amah amuhsitna uh pu in dainawl ah akiang lam ah i paikhe ding uhi.
Hiai lai ah zaw khomun kip i nei ngal kei ua, kho hong om ding i zong uh ahi zaw hi.
Huchi in amah vang in phatna kithoihna Pathian kiang ah i lan gige ding uh, amin gupna mukte gah ahih ziak in.
Himahleh thil hihhoih leh thilphal mangngilh kei un; huai bang kithoihna tung ah Pathian alungkim mahmah hi.

Nou hon heutute thu mang unla, athuthu un om un, anasepte uh tanchin gen nawn ding a, na khate uh ching a hon veng ahi uhi, lungkham kawm hilou in, kipaktak in semsak un; huchi lou in zaw nou a ding a khawk ahi zaw ding hi.
Hon thumsak un; bangkim a diktattak a om a, sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei ka hi uh chih diktak in ka kithei uhi.
Huan kintak a na kiang ua sawl nawn a ka omtheihna ding in, huai ding in ka hon ngen nawn sem hi.
Tu in, lemna Pathian, tangtawn thukhun sisan ziak a misi lak a kipan a, i Toupa Jesu, belamchingpa thupitak, kaithou nawnpa'n,
amitmuh a akipah lam peuhmah Jesu Khrist ziak in eimah a sem in, adeihlam hih ding in thil hoih chiteng lam ah nou hon hihkim hen; Jesu Khrist kiang ah thupina tangtawn in om hen. Amen.
Himahleh unaute aw, ka hon ngen ahi, hanthawn thuhilhna ngaithei teitei un; na kiang uah thu tomchik ka gelh uhi.
I unaupa Timothi apawtsakta uh chih na thei un; ahong pai baihleh, amah toh nou ka hong mu ding uhi.
Nou hon heute tengteng leh misiangthoute tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Itali gam a mite'n chibai ahon buk uhi.
Na vek ua kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
Huaiziak in bil a i zakte phatuamngaitak in i khawk sa nawn sem ding uh, huchi lou in zaw i tolhmangsan kha zenzen ding uhi.
Angelte zang a thugen nangawn akip a, tatlekna leh thumanlouhna chiteng in thukna diktathuaitak amuh zel ngal un,
huchi tel a hotdamna thupi ngeingaih kei leng bangchi in ahia i suahtak theih mahmah ding? Huai hotdamna thu atung a Toupa zang a gen khit ahi a, azate'n hon na hihkipsak uhi.
Pathian in leng chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte leh thilhihtheihna chiteng toh, ama deih bang zel in Kha Siangthou thilhawmte toh, amaute atheihpih hi.
Khovel hong om ding a tanchin i gen uh, angelte nuai ah akoih kei hi.
Himahleh mi kuahiam in koi lai hiam ah hiai thu gen in atheisak hi, "Mihing bang atel a, na theihgige? Mihing tapa leng bang ahia, na veh nak?”
"Amah angelte sang a nuaizaw zek in na bawl a; thupina leh pahtawina na khusak a, na khutsuak tung ah heutu in na bawl hi,
akhenuai ah bangkim na koih a," chi in. Huchi in bangkim anuai a akoih ziak in anuai a koih louh bangmah anei kei hi. Himahleh tu'n ah zaw bangkim anuai a om in i mu nai tadih kei uhi.

Himahleh Jesu, angelte sang a niamzaw deuh a abawl takdih tuh, sihna thuak in thupina leh pahtawina khuksak a om in i mu zaw, huchi a Pathian hehpihna ziak a michih a ding a sihna acheptheihna ding in.
Amah a ding leh amah ziak a bangkim omsakpa'n tapa tampi thupina a pilut a, athuakna ziak a amaute hotdamna makaipa bukim hih amah a dia kilawm him ahi.
Hihsiangthoupa leh hihsiang-thoute avek un mi khat a pawt ahi uh. Huaiziak in ama'n amaute unaute, chih azum kei hi.
"Ka unaute kiang ah na min ka gen dia; omkhawmte lak ah la sa in ka hon phat ding,” chi in.
Huan "Amah ah ka muanna ka nga dia, achi nawn hi. Huan en dih ua, kei leh Pathian hon piak tate," achi nawn lai hi.
Huchi in naupangte sa leh sisan tangte ahih chiat ziak un, amah ngei in huai bangmah atang sam hi; asihna a sihna thuneipa, diabol, ahihmanthat theihna ding leh,
sih kihtak ziak a damsung sikha a omte tengteng asuahtaksak theihna ding un.
Ahitak in, ama'n apanpih zelte zaw angelte ahi kei ua, Abraham suante apanpih zaw ahi.

Huchi in mite a ding a khelhna thupha tawina bawlsak ding in, Pathian lam a siampu lianpen, milainat thei leh muanhuaitak ahihtheihna ding in, bangkim a-unaute bang a hong om amah a ding in akiphamoh him ahi.
Amah ngei in khemna tuak a, ana thuak tak ziak in khemna tuakte apanpih thei ahi.
Huchi in unau siangthou, van sapna tanpihte aw, i thugin toh kisai a Sawltak leh Siampu Lian, Jesu ngaihtuah un;
Pathian inkuante tengteng lak a Mosi amuanhuai mah bang a, amah seppa lak a muanhuaipa.
Inn sung a papen a-inkuante sang a apahtawi zawk bang un, amah Mosi sang a thupi zawk semna mu dia kilawm a seh ahita hi.
Inkuan chih in papen kuahiam anei chiat ngal ua; bangkim pa pen bel Pathian ahi.
Huan huai nung a thugen lai dingte theihsakna ding in, Mosi Pathian inkuante tengteng lak a nasempa in zaw amuanhuai ngei hi.
Khrist bel Pathian inkuante tung a Tapa in amuanhuai hi. Atawp tan a i kingakna a, i lametna ziak a kipahna, kiptak a i vomhoih photleh, eite a-inkuanpihte i hi uhi.
Huchi in Kha Siangthou gen bang in, “Tuni a a-aw na zak chiang un,
Gamdai a ze-etna ni a ahel bang un, na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un;
huai lai ah na pi-le-pute un hon ze-et in ahon khem ua, kum sawmli sung a ka thilhihte amu uhi.
Huchi in huai suante tung ah ka lung hita kei a, 'Alungtang un angaihtuah khial gige ua, ka lampite leng athei kei uh,' ka chi hi.
Ka thangpaihna a ka kichiam bang in ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh," chi in.
Unaute aw pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw Pathian hing tawpsan ding in na lak uah kuapeuh sung ah ginlouhna lungtang gilou ahong om kha ding hi.
"Tuni," achih lai un niteng in kihanthawntuah zaw un, huchi a na lak ua mi kuamah khelhna khemhat ziak a hihkhauh a na omlouhna ding un.
I kingakna kipatna pen atawp tan a kiptak a i vomhoih photleh Khrist a tan neite i hita uhi.
"Tuni in a-aw na zak chiang un ahel lai bang un, na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un," akichih lai teng.
Ahihleh kuate ahi ua thei napi a helte? Aigupta a kipan a Mosi pipawt tengteng hilou uhia?
Kuate tung ah ahia, kum sawmli sung alunghih louh? Hihkhialte aluang uh gamdai a pukmangte tung ah hilou hia?
Thumangloute kiang ah kia lou ngal kua kiang ah ahia akhawlna a lut lou ding a akichiam?
Huchi in ginlahna ziak in alut theita kei uh chih i thei uhi.
Huaiziak in i lau ding uh, huchi lou in zaw akhawlna a lutna thuchiam om lai napi, na lak ua kuapeuh ching lou in na om kha zenzen ding uh.
Amau kiang a gen ahih bang in tanchinhoih i kiang ua gen ahi ngal a; himahleh athuzak uh amaute'n aphattuampih kei uh, azate toh ginna a akizom louh ziak un.
Ei gingta khinte huai khawlna ah i lut lellel uhi, "Ka thangpaihna a ka kichiam bang in ka khawlna ah alut kei hial ding uh," achih bang in; leilung pian tung a kipan ama nnate sep zoh hita mahleh.
Koi lai mun hiam ah ni sagih ni thu hichibang in agen hi: "Huan ani sagih ni in Pathian in anasep tengteng akhawlsanta," chi in.
Huan hiai mun ah, "Ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh," achi nawn hi.
Huchi in ni dang a tanchinhoih za masate thuman louh ziak in lut kei mah le uh, khenkhatte huai khawlna a alutna ding ua thuchiam a-om lai ziak a lut lai ding a-om uhi.
Hun sawttak nung in David ah ama a kigensa bang in bang ni hiam aseptuan nawn hi. "Tuni a aw na zak chiang un na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un," chi in.
Joshua in amaute na khawlsakta hileh zaw, huai nung in ni tuam dang thu gen angai kei ding hi.
Huchi in Pathian mite a ding in Sabbath khawlna a-om lai hi.
Pathian in ama nasepte akhawlsan bang in, akhawlna a lut khinsa mi'n leng anasepte akhawlsan samta hi.
Huchi in kuamah huai thumanlouhna bang a om a i puklouhna ding un huai khawlna a lut ding in phatuam i ngai ding uhi.

Pathian thu ahing a, thil ahihthei a, namsau hiamtuah bangchibang sang in ahiam a, hinna leh kha, guhlawi leh guhngek tuamkhen hel khop in asun thei a, lungtang a ngaihtuah leh tupte athei pah thei hi.
Huaiziak in thilsiam peuhmah ama mitmuh a lang lou himhim a-om kei; i tanchin tutna dingpa mitmuh ah bangkim vuaktang leh kihongsa ahi.
Hichi in van munte a paisuak khinsa siampu lianpen thupitak, Jesu Pathian Tapa, i neih ziak in i thugin i pomkip ding uhi.
Siampu Lianpen i hat louh kitheihnate hon theihpih pha lou nei i hi kei ua; eimah bang a lam tuamtuam a khemna tuaksa, khelh bel khial lou, nei i hi zaw uhi.
Huchi in zahngaihna i muhtheihna ding leh huh i poimoh chiang a huhna hehpihna i ngah theihna ding in, hehpihna laltutphah hangtak in i naih ding uhi.
Siampu Lianpen peuhmah mihingte sik-le-tang akhelhnate ziak a thilpiak leh kithoihnate Pathian kiang a lankhawm ding a mihing lak a kipan telkhiak leh mihingte a dia Pathian seh ahi uhi.
Huaite'n amau ngei leng hatlouhna a tuam a om sam ahih ziak un, bangmah theiloute leh lamhaihte tung ah zahngaihna anei thei uhi.
Huaiziaktak in mite a ding a alatsak bang un, amau a ding ngei leng khelhnate ziak in lan lou thei lou ahi uhi.
Huan huai pahtawina Aaron bang a Pathian sap ahih ngal kei uleh kuamah amau akipe ngei kei uhi.
Huchibang in Khrist leng siampu lianpen a bawl ding in amah akihih thupi kei a, "Nang zaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia hi," chi a akiang a genpa'n ahih thupizawta hi.
Mun dang a agen bang in; "Nang zaw, Melkizedek omdan bang a tangtawn siampu na hi,” achi hi.
Ama'n sa aput lai nite in, sihna lak a amah hondam theipa kiang ah nakpitak a kikou leh khitui ke kawm in thumnate leh ngetnate alan a, akihtakdan asiam zel ziak in ngaihkhiak in a-om hi.
Tapa hilhial himahleh athilthuakte ah thuman azil hi.
Huchi in hihbukim a hong om in, athumang peuhmahte a ding in tangtawn a hotdamna bulpi ahong hita hi.
Melkizedek omdan bang a siampu lianpen in Pathian in abawlta hi.
Huai mi tanchin ahihleh gen ding tampi i nei ua, genchet leng ahaksa; na bil uh angon tak ziak in.
Ahun thu ngaihtuah in zaw heutu hi khinta hial le uchin kilawm hiven, Pathian thubulte hilh kiphamoh nawn na hi ve ua, an gum hilou nawitui kiphamoh na hong hita uhi;
nawitui ne peuhmah in diktatna thu ah theihna anei kei ua, naungek ahih ziak un.
An gum piching a ding ahi, huaite'n azat gige ziak un sia-le-pha theichian ding in atheihtheihnate uh asin zongsangta uhi.
Huchi in Khrist thubulte gen nawn lou in pichin lam i manoh ding uh; thilhih sisate kisikna, Pathian lam a ginna,
baptisma leh khutngak leh misi thohnawnna leh tangtawn vaihawmna lam thuhilhnate suangphum phum nawn lou in.
Pathian in pha asakleh huai bang i hih ngei ding uhi.
Khatvei hihvak a om khin a, van thilpiak chiamta, Kha Siangthou dong khin a,
Pathian thuhoihna leh hun hong om ding a thilhihtheihnate chiam khin hinapi,
ginna akihei mangsan ualeh huchibang mite zaw akisikna ding ua bawl thak theih ahi kei uhi; Pathian Tapa amau a ding a kilhlum tuan nawn a selphou ahih ziak un.
Lou, atung ua vuahtui ke gige na dawn khin a, huai khohsak a ompa a dia nek theih anteh-louhing hon suah pen in Pathian vualzawlna atang hi.
Himahleh loulingnei leh khaulingnei asuah nak in bel aphatuam kei a; hamsiat in a-om ding a, atawpna halmang ahi ding hi.
Himahleh deihtakte aw, huchibang thu gen mah leng nou zaw huai thilte sang a hoihzaw hotdamna toh kizui thilte nei na hih uh ka muang uhi.
Amin ziak a itna a nna na sep uleh misiangthoute nna na sepsak uh na latsak uh leh tutan a leng nasep lai uh mangngilh ding in Pathian mitak lou ahi kei hi.
Himahleh atawp tan a lametna theihchetna kim mu ding in na thanop ngeingei bang un thanop suah gige chiat le uchin ka chi uhi.
Huchi in na kithadahsak kei ding ua, ginna leh kuhkalna ziak a thuchiamte gouluah khin khawngte entonte na hi zaw ding uhi.
Pathian in Abraham kiang a thu achiam lai in, amah sang a thupizaw lou a akichiam theih louh ziak in, amah-le-amah kilou in akichiam hi.
Taktak in ka hon vualzawl ngeingei ding a, hih leng ka hon hihpung ding chi in akichiamta hi.
Huchi in kuhkaltak a athuakkhiak nung in, thilchiam amuta hi.
Mihingte zaw asang ua thupizawte min lou in akichiam ua; akiselna chiteng uah leng hihkipna ding in kichiam tuh thutawp ahi.
Huchi in Pathian in athiltup hihlamdan tuan theihlouhdan nakpi mahmah a theihsak ut in thuchiam gouluah dingte kiang ah kichiamna apalaisak hi.
Pathian thugen zuauthei vual ahihlouhna ah thil kikhek lamdang thei lou nihte ziak in, i ma a lametna koih lenkip ding a bitna ding a amah delhte'n hanthawnna thupitak i neihtheihna ding in ahi.
Huai lametna hinna sikkip in i nei ua, muanhuai leh kiptak ahi, huai lametna puanzak sung ah leng alutta hi.
I ma a na paita Jesu, mun siangthoupen ah i makaipa a alut tak man in Melkizedek omdan bang in eite a ding in tangtawn a siampu lianpen ana hita hi.
Abraham in kumpipate athah zoh a hong kiklam na dawn a vualzawlpa, hiai "Melkizedek, Salem kumpipa, Tungnungpen Siampu," ahi a,
Abraham in, “Bangkim ah sawm-a-khat," apia hi. Amin khiakna genchian in amasapen in, "Diktatna Kumpipa," azom nawn in, "Salem Kumpipa," ahi nawn a, huai tuh "Lemna Kumpipa," chihna ahi.
Amah pa nei lou, nu nei lou, khangthu nei lou, om pat ni nei lou hin tawp ni leng nei sam lou in, Pathian Tapa bang a siam tangtawn a siampu hi gige ahi zaw hi.
Huchi in suangtu, Abraham in agallak hoih peuhmah lak a sawm-a-khat apiakna pa, huai mipa thupidan ngaihtuah un.
Levi suante lak a siampu nna tang peuhmah in dan bang in mite lak ah sawm-a-khat lak ding thu a-unaute uh lak ah amu uhi, huaite Abraham khal a pawt hi sam mah le uh leng.
Himahleh alak ua asuante suikhawmsak sam louhpa'n Abraham lak ah sawm-a-khat ala a, thuchiamte kempa avualzawlta hi.
Himahleh sel vual louh in aneuzaw tuh alianzaw vualzawlsak in a-om hi.
Huan hiai ah mihing si zelte'n sawm-a-khat amu ua, huai ah bel, ahing gige pen chi a athu atheisak in amu zaw hi.
Levi, sawm-a-khat la zelpa nangawn in Abraham khut ah sawm-a-khat apeta, chih theih ahi;
Melkizedek in ana dawn lai in apa khal ah a-om lai hi.

Huchi in Levite'n siampu hihna ziak a bukimna muhtheihna hileh huai nuai ah mite'n dan thu ana mu ngal ua, Aaron omdan bang hilou a Melkizedek omdan bang a siampu dang hong om, bang kiphamoh ding ahia?
Siampu hihna ahong kilamdan ziak in dan leng hihlamdan sam ahong kiphamoh hi.
Hiai a thugenpa nam tuam ahi ngal a, huai namte lak a akuamah maitam ah agamtang ngei kei uhi.
