I Toupa, Judah nam lak a hong suak ahi chih akichian hi; huai nam thu ah Mosi in siampute lam thu bangmah agen kei hi.
Melkizedek bang a tangtawn siampu dang hong suahna in nakpitak in i thugen achiangsak nawn sem hi;
amah khangthu dan leh dan thupiak ziak a siampu hilou in, hin tawp nei lou leh thilhihtheihna bang zaw in siampu ahong hi.
"Nang zaw, Melkizedek omdan bang a tangtawn siampu na hi," chih theihsak ahi.
Ahat louh leh aphattuamlouhna ziak in thupiak om masa paihkhiak ahi.
Dan in bangmah ahih bukim louh ziak in Pathian in lametna hoihzaw hon lalut in huai pansan in amah i naih theita uhi.
Huan kichiamna tel lou a amah siampu a bawl ahi kei hi;
siampu dangte ahihleh kichiam lou a siampu a bawl ahi ua; Jesu bel, nang zaw tangtawn siampu na hi chi in Toupa akichiam hi, ka khelkik kei ding chi a akiang a genpa khut ah akichiam hi.
Huchitak a thupi in Jesu thukhun hoihzaw hihkippa ahong hita hi.
Huan siampu tampi ana om tak ziak bel amaute asi zel ua, kuamah omden thei lou ahih ziak uh ahi.
Hiai mi bel tangtawn a omden ahih ziak in, asiampu hihna khen theih vual louh aneizaw hi.
Huchi in amah tawn a Pathian kiang a hong paite atawp dong in ahondam thei hi, amaute thumsak a tangtawn a ahin gige ziak in ahi.
Huchibang siampu lianpen, misiangthou, poikhoih lou, nin baang lou, khialte lak a om tuam, vante sang a tungnungzaw a siam eite a ahong hita hi.

Ama'n siampu lianpen dangte lat bang in, niteng in ama khelhna a ding kithoihna lan masa phot in, huai nung a mite khelhna kithoihna alat akiphamoh kei hi; amah akilat laitak in setdet ding in khatvei ana lan khinta hi.
Dan in mihing hatlouhna neite, siampu lianpen ding in asep a; himahleh tua kichiam thu, dan nung a hong om in, Tapa mahmah tangtawn siampu ding a hihkim khitsa asep zawta hi.
Huchi in i thugente lak a poimohpen hiai ahi; vanmun a Thupipen laltutphah taklam a va tu siampu lianpen neite i hi uhi.
Amah mun siangthou leh biakbuk taktak, mihing lam hilou, Toupa lam zaw a nasempa i nei uhi.
Siampu lian peuhmahte thilpiak leh kithoihnate lan ding a seh ahi ua; huchi in hiai siampu lianpen in banghiam bek lat ding neih akiphamoh hi.
Amah leitung a om lai hileh zaw, dan bang zel a thilpiakte lan ding om khinta ahih ziak un, siampu hilou ding ahi.

Amaute'n van lam thilte etsakna leh aliim in nna asem uhi. Mosi biakbuk lam dia akisak lai in Pathian hilh a om in, "Tang tung a etton ding ka hon etsak bang a biakbuk lam ding in pilvang in," achi hi.
Tu in bel thuchiam hoihzaw tung a kinga thukhun hoihzaw a dia nasem palai ahih bang in, nasepna hoihzaw ana tangta hi.
Thukhun masa dembei na hileh, anihna hong om kul lou ding ahi.
Amaute dem in hiai thute agen hi, "Ngai in, nite ahong tung dek, Toupa'n achi, huai ni chiang in Israel inkuante leh Judah inkuante kiang ah thukhun thak ka bawl ding,"
"Api-le-pute uh Aigupta gam a kipan pikhe ding a akhut ka let ni a akiang ua ka khun bang hilou in; ka thukhun ah a-om gige kei uhi, huchi in amau ka limsakta kei,” Toupa'n achi hi.

"Huai ni zoh chiang in Israel inkuante kiang a thu ka khun ding hiaite ahi, Toupa'n achi; alungsim uah ka thupiakte ka koih dia, alungtang uah ka gelh nalai dia, huan amau a ding in Pathian ka hi dia, kei a ding in amaute ka mite ahi ding uhi.
Huan michih in Toupa thei in, chi in ama inveng leh ama unau athuhilhta kei ding uhi; aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in avek un ahon thei chiat ding uhi.
Atatleknate uah ka zahngai dia, akhelhnate uh leng ka theigige nawnta kei ding," chi in.
Thukhun thak chi a agen ziak in amasa zat nawn louh ding in aluisakta hi. Huchi in aluita a, zat tak louh mang pah thei ahita hi.
Huchi in thukhun masa in leng Pathian nasepna a zuih ding thukhun leh lei lam mun siangthou leng anei hi.
Biakbuk alam ua, pindan tuah masak ah khawnvak koihna mung, dohkan leh tanghou koihna a-om hi; huai tuh Mun Siangthou achi uhi.
Puanzak nihna ban ah biakbuk, Mun Siangthoupen achih uh a-om hi.
Huai sung ah dangka-eng gimlim halna bawm leh thukhun bawm dangka-eng a kiluan a-om a, huai thukhun bawm sung ah Manna omna dangka-eng bel, Aaron chiang sel leh thukhun gelhna suangpek a-om hi.
Atunglam ah zahngaihna tutphah liah in, thupina cherubte a-om ua; huaite tu in zaw akim sipsip in i gen thei kei ding uh.
Huai thilte huchibang a bawl ana hi ua, siampute'n Pathian nna sem in, biakbuk tuah masak ah alut zel uhi.
Pindan sungnungpen ah bel siampu lianpen kia, kum teng in khatvei sisan tawi in alut a; ama khelhna a ding leh mite khelhna a ding in alan zel hi.
Kha Siangthou in hon theihsak nop bel, biakbuk masa adin lai teng Mun Siangthou a luttheihna lampi akilang nai tadih kei, achihna ahi.
Biakbuk a thilpiak leh kithoihna kilan zelte'n abemite sia-le-pha theihna asiangsak thei kei chih tu hun a eite hon etsakna ahi.
Huaite nek-le-dawn, kisilna dan tuamtuamte, ataktak bawlhoihna hong tun ma a kizang salam thilte ahi.
Himahleh Khrist bel thil hoih hong om dingte siampu lianpen ding a hong pai in, khut a lam louh biakbuk thupizaw leh bukimzaw sung ah alut hi, huai tuh thilsiamte lak a ahi kei chihna ahi,
ama'n ei a ding a tangtawn tatkhiakna ngah khin in, kelte leh bawngtalte sisan hilou, ama sisan mahmah tawi in khatvei a setdet ding in mun siangthou sung ah alutta hi.
Kel leh bawngtalte sisan leh bawngla vu, minin tung a theh in bawn sa siang khop a ahihsiangthouleh,
Khrist, tangtawn Kha ziak a gensiatbei a Pathian kiang a kilan sisan in, Pathian hing nasem ding in na sia-le-pha theihna uh thilhih sisa a pan nak hihsiangthou na tel in chia!

Hiai ziak in amah thukhun thak palai ahong hi a, sapte'n tangtawn a gouluah ding thuchiam atantheihna ding un thukhun masa nuai a tatleknate lak a kipan hon tankhe ding in amah ahong sita, chihna ahi.
Thusiah omna peuh ah asiahmi sihna leng a-om teitei ding ahi.
Mi asih nung un thusiah in thu anei nak hi, asiahmi adam lai teng bel thu anei kei hi.
Huchi in thukhun masa leng sisan lou in ahihkip kei uhi.
Dan thupiak peuhmah Mosi in mipi tengteng kiang a apuan nung in, bawngnoute leh kelte sisan tui, samulkhau sandup leh hissop in ala a, laibu leh mipi tengteng atheh a,
huai Pathian in na kiang ua anamkip thukhun sisan ahi, chi in.
Huai lou leng biakbuk leh nasepna van tengteng huchi mah bang in sisan in atheh hi.
Huan dan in sisan a bangkim hihsiangthou angiat bang in, sisan suak lou in ngaihdamna himhim a-om kei hi.
Huai thilte van a om batpih laksawnte huaite a hihsiangthou a-om ding him uh ahi; van thil taktakte bel huai sang a kithoihna hoihzawte a hihsiangthou a-om ding ahi.
Khrist khut a lam mun siangthou, atak batpih ah alut ngal kei a; tu'n ah bel Pathian ma ah i sik ua dingh ding in van ah alut zawta hi.
Himahleh kum teng a siampu lian, ama sisan toh hilou, sisan tawi kawm a mun siangthou a alut zihzeh bang a, amah kilan ding a van a lut ahi kei;
huchi hi keileh leilung pian tung a kipan tamveipi athuakta ding hi; himahleh tulai hun tawp ah amah kithoihna pansan a khelhna hihmang ding in khatvei a setdet ding in amah ahong kilangta hi.
Huan mihing a ding in khatvei sih seh ahi, huai nung in vaihawmna a-om ding hi;
huchi mah bang in Khrist leng mi tampi khelhnate paipih ding a khatvei lat khit a om in, hotdamna mu ding a amah ngakte kiang ah khelhna pang lou in anihveina ah ahong lang nawn ding hi.
Judah kumpipate, Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah leh Israel kumpipa, Joas tapa Jeroboam dam lai a, Beeri tapa Hosia kiang a hong tung TOUPA thu ahi.

Hosia zang a TOUPA'N thu agen masak lai in, Hosia kiang ah TOUPA'N, "Kuan inla, na zi ding in kizuakmi pi inla, kizuakmi tate nei in; gam in lah TOUPA paisan in kizuakna nakpitak in ahihta ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in akuan a Diblaim tanu Gomer api a; ahong gai a, tapa aneihsak hi.
Huan TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Amin Jezreel sa in; sawt lou nung chiang a, Jehu inkote tung a Jezreel sisan phuba la ding ka hi, Israel inkote lalgam ka tawpsak ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, Jezreel Phaizang ah Israel thalpeu ka kitansak ding," achi hi.
Huan agai nawn a, tanu anei hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Amin ding in Lo-ruhamah sa in; amaute bangchi mah a ngaidam ding in, Israel inkote tung ah zahngaihna ka neih nawn louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
"Himahleh Judah inkote tung ah zahngaihna ka nei ding a, TOUPA a Pathian un amaute ka hondam ding a, thalpeu, namsau, kidouna, sakol, sakol tungtuang mite in amaute ka hondam kei ding hi," achi hi.
Huan Lo-ruhamah nawi angolhsak zoh in, agai nawn a, tapa anei hi.
Pathian in, "Amin ding in Lo-ammi sa in; ka mite na hih louh ua, na Pathian uh ka hih louh ding ziak in," achi hi.

Hinapi in Israel suante zah tuipi piaunel, teh theih louh, sim theih louh bang ahi ding; akiang ua, "Ka mite na hi kei uh," chih a a-omna mun uah, hichi ahi ding a, "Pathian hing tate na hi uh," akiang ua chih ahi ding hi.
Huchi in Judah suante leh Israel suante kaihkhawm ahi ding ua, amaute a ding in lu khat akiguan ding ua, gam a kipan a kuantou ding; Jezreel ni thupi ding ahi.
Israel in gahtam asuah zel, grepgui pha ahi; agahtam mahmah dungzui in amaitamte apungsak; agam hoihna dungzui in milim kilawm taktak abawl uhi.
Alungtang uh akikhen a; huchi in mohtansak in a-om ding uh; amaitamte uh asat ding a, akhuamte uh alok ding hi.
Kumpipa i nei kei uh; TOUPA i kihta kei ua; kumpipa leng, ei a ding in bang ahihthei dia, tu in achi ding uhi.
Thukhunte bawlna a zuau a kichiam in, thute agen ua; huaiziak in lou lehsa a namtul bang in thukhenna apoukhe ding hi.
Beth-aven bawngnoute ziak in Samaria a tengte'n alau ding ua; huai mite'n siampu atung a kipakte asuun ding uh, huai bawngnou ziak in thupina amah a kipan apaimang tak ziak in.
Kumpipa Jareb kiang a thilpiak ding a Assuria lam a puak ahi lai ding a, Ephraim in zahlakna amu dia, Israel amah pilna ah azahlak ding hi.
Samaria bel tui tung a tuiphuan bang in akumpipa satkhiak ahi.
Aven mun sangte leng, Israel khelhna hihsiat ahi ding, amaitam tung uah ling leh loulingnei ahong poutou ding a; tangte kiang ah, "Hon khuh un; mualte kiang ah hon pukkhum un," achi ding uhi.
Aw Israel, Gibeah nite a kipan na khialta a; huai ah adingh ua; Gibeah thulimlouhna tate tung a kidouna in amaute aphaklouhna ding in.
Amaute ka sawi ding ka deihlam ahi; atatlekna uh thuah nih ziak a taihilh ahih hun chiang un, amaute dou ding in mite akikhawm ding uh.

Huan Ephraim bawngla chilsiamsa, buh-le-bal chilkhiak ut ahi; himahleh angawng kilawm tung ah hakkol ka bat dia, Ephraim tung ah tungtuangmi ka koih ding; Judah in lei alet dia, Jakob in asai anawn ding.
Diktatna ah kituh unla, zahngaihna bang zel in at un, na leileh lei uh satkham un; ahong pai a na tung ua diktatna ahon zuksak matan, TOUPA zon hun ahi.
Gitlouhna lei na let ua, thulimlouhna na lata uh; zuaugenna gah na neta ua; na lampi ah, na mihatte ah na muangta uhi.
Huaiziak in na mite lak ah buaina ahong pawt ding a, na kulhte uh loh in a-om ding hi, kidou lai a Salman in Beth-arbel aluh bang in; atate toh anu paih nen in a-om uhi.
Huchibang mah in na gitlouh mahmah ziak in Bethel in na tung ah ahih ding; nuaisiah in Israel kumpipa satkhiak siang in a-omta ding hi.
Israel naupang ahih lai in, amah ka it a, Aigupta a kipan ka tapa ka samkhia hi.
Amaute asap chiang un, amau a kipan apai gamla sem ua, Baal kiang ah akithoih ua, lim bawltawmte kiang ah gimlim ahal uhi.
Hinapi in Ephraim pai ka kisinsak a; ka ban in amau ka pom a; himahleh amaute'n ka hihdam ahih lam uh athei kei uhi.
Mihing khaute leh itna gui in amau ka kai a, amaute a ding in amuk tung uleh amuk nuai ua kibat hakkol ka lakkhiaksak a, ama uah an ka lui hi.
Aigupta gam ah akik nawn kei ding a; himahleh Assuria mi akumpipa ahi ding, kik nawn anial ziak un.
Huan akhopite tung ah namsau lik in a-om dia, asiktawnte ahul in, anegai ding, athuhilhte uh ngei ziak in.
Huchi in ka mite'n kei a kipan nungtawn atum tinten uh; amah tungsang a ompa sam mah le uh, kuamah in amah aliansak kei ding uh.

Ephraim, bangchi in ka hon tawpsan dia? Israel, bangchi in ka hon tankhe dia? Admah bang in bangchi in ka hon bawl dia? Zeboim bang in bangchi in ka hon koih dia? Ka sung ah ka lungtang akilumlet a, ka lainatnate toh akuangkhawm hi.
Ka hehna mahmah ka suahkhesak kei ding a, Ephraim hihse ding in ka kihei kei ding; mihing hilou in, Pathian ka hi a, nang lak a Mi Siangthou, khopi sung ah ka lut kei ding hi.
Amau TOUPA deihdan in a-om ding ua; amah humpinelkai bang in ahumham ding a, amah ahumham chiang in, tumlam a kipan tate ling kawm in ahong pai ding uhi.
Aigupta a kipan a vasa bang in ling kawm in ahong pai ding ua, Assuria gam a kipan a vakhu bang in; a-innte ua teng ding in amau ka bawl ding, TOUPA'N achi.
Ephraim in zuauthu in leh Israel inkuan in khemna in kei ahon umsuak a; himahleh Judah bel Pathian toh vai ahawm lai a, misiangthoute toh aginom lai hi.
Ephraim huih in akivak a, suahlam huih azui; zuaute leh siatgawpna apungsak gige a; Assuria toh thukhun abawl ua, Aigupta gam ah sathau puaklut in a-om hi.
TOUPA'N leng Judah akiselpih a, alampite bang in Jakob agawt ding; athilhihte bang in amah athuk ding hi.
Sul ah a-unaupa akhetul in aman a; apichin in Pathian ah thilhihtheihna anei hi.
Ahi, angel tung ah thilhihtheihna anei a, avualzouta a; akap a, akiang ah zahngaihna angen hi; Bethel ah amah amu a, huai ah kou ahon houpih hi.
TOUPA mahmah, sepaihte' Pathian, TOUPA theihgigena ahi.
Huaiziak in nang na Pathian lam nga in; zahngaihna leh vaihawmna kem in, na Pathian ngak nilouh in.
Amah Kanaan mi ahi, akhut ah khemna buknate a-om; nuaisiah a-utlam ahi.
Ephraim in, "Taktak in ka hong hauta a, hauhsakna ka kimuhkhiakta hi; ka sepgimna tengteng ah thulimlouhna thilhih-khelhna kei ah bangmah amu kei ding uh," achi hi.
Himahleh Aigupta gam a kipan kei TOUPA na Pathian ka hi; ankuanglui thupi lai nite bang in, puaninte a teng ding in nang ka hon bawl lai ding hi.
Zawlneite kiang ah leng thu ka genta a, mengmuhnate ka tamsakta hi; zawlneite nasepna zang in kibatpihte ka zangta hi.
Gilead thulimlouhna ahi hia? Bangmah lou ahi vek uh; Gilgal ah bawngtalte in akithoih ua; amaitamte uh loukaihna a leivup bang in a-om uh.
Aram lou a Jakob atailut bang in, Israel in zi loh ding in nna asem, zi loh ding in belamhon aching hi.
Aigupta a kipan zawlnei in TOUPA'N Israel apikhia a, zawlnei a hawi in a-om hi.
Nakpi mahmah in Ephraim in TOUPA ahehsak a; huaiziak in amah tung ah asisan nutsiat in a-om ding, amah gensiatna TOUPA'N akiang lam ah akiksak nawn ding hi.
Ephraim in thu agen lai in, midangte aling ua; Israel ah amah-le-amah akiliansak; himahleh Baal milim bia in, asita hi.
Huchi in akhial semsem ua, adangka un milim sun abawl ua, amau theihtheihna dungzui a milimte mahmah avek ua khutsiam mite nasep; kithoih mite'n bawngnoute tawp uhen! chi in huaite tungthu agen uhi.
Huaiziak in zingsang meipi, daitui hulmang pah bang, phual a kipan a pingpei lak a buhsi bang a mutleng leh meikhu suahna a kipan a meikhu bang ahi ding uhi.
Hinapi in kei Aigupta gam a kipan TOUPA na Pathian ka hi; kei lou ngal pathian na thei kei ding, kei chih louh hondampa a-om kei hi.
Gamdai ah ka hon theita a, khokhalna gam ah.
Aloupa hing nou mitmet mun uh bang in, amaute hihdim in a-om ua; hihdim in a-om ua, huan alungtang uh hihlet in a-om; huaiziak in kei ahon mangngilhta uhi.
Huaiziak in amaute a ding in humpinelkai bang ka hi a; gialbem bang in lampi kiang ah ka tang ding hi.
Vompi anoute suun bang in amaute ka maituah ding a, alungtang ua kipan alap uh ka kaikhe ding; huai ah humpinelkai bang in amaute ka ne bei ding; gamsa bang in amaute ka botnen ding hi.
Aw Israel, na panpihpa dou a, kei na hon dou, na siatna ahi.
Na khopi tengteng a nang hon hondam ding na kumpipa tua koi a om ahia? Kumpipa leh heutute hon pi un, na chihnate uh, na vaihawmte uh koi ah?
Hehngoh in kumpipa ka hon pia a, hehngoh in amah ka lamangta hi.
Ephraim thulimlouhna koih hoih in a-om a, akhelhna chiamtehna akoih in a-om hi.
Numei nauvei lungkhamna atung ah ahong tung ding; tapa pil lou suang ahi a, naupian hun tungta a, amun a a-omom ding ahita ngal kei a.
Han thilhihtheihna a kipan amaute ka tan ding a; sihna a kipan amaute ka tan ding; Aw sihna, na gu koi ah a-om ua? Aw han, na hihsiatna koi ah a-om a? Ka mit a kipan kisikna sel ahi ding hi.

A-unaute lak ah gahpha mahleh, suahlam huih ahong kuan dia, gamdai a kipan TOUPA huih ahong nung dia, atui nak ahong keu dia, aluikhuk akang vek ding; bel kipahhuai tengteng a agou loh in a-om ding hi.
Samaria in amoh apo ding; a Pathian tung ah ahel a; namsau in apuk ding ua; anaungekte uh paihgawp in a-om ding uh, nau toh kithuah a numeite uh dawt pailet in a-om ding uhi.
Aw Israel, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah kik nawn in, na thulimlouhna ah na pukta hi.
Thupha tawi inla, TOUPA kiang ah kik nawn in, "Thulimlouhna tengteng lamang inla, ahehpihna in na sang in; huchi in ka mukte uh thillat bawngtalte bang in ka pe ding uh," akiang ah chi in.
Assuria in ahondam kei dia; sakolte tung ah i tuang kei ding uh; i khut ua i bawlte kiang uah, pathiante na hi uh, i chi nawn kei ding hi; nang ah pabeite'n zahngaihna amu uhi.
Aginomlouhna uh ka hihdam ding a, amaute athawn in ka it ding, kei a kipan in ka hehna lah akiheimangta ngal a.
Israel lak ah daitui bang ka hi ding, lili pak bang in apaklun dia, Lebanon sing bang in zungkip akakhesuk ding hi.
Ahiangte abawkpha dia, akilawmna olive sing bang ahi dia, agim Lebanon bang ahi ding hi.
Alimnuai a tengte ahong kik nawn ding ua, buh-le-bal bang in ahong hing thak ding ua, grepgui bang in apaklun ding; agim Lebanon uain bang ahi ding.
Milimte bang ding ka chi nawnta dia? Ephraim in achi ding hi. Ka dawng khin a, amah ka limsak ding, meilah sing hing bang ka hi a; kei a kipan na gah muh ahi.
Kua ahia pil a, hiai thilte theithei ding? Pilvang a amaute thei ding? TOUPA lampite adik a, huaite ah midiktat a-om ding a; himahleh talekte huai ah apuk ding uhi.
Na sanggampa Ammi kiang ah, "Ka mite na hi," chi inla, na sanggamnute uh Ruhamah kiang ah, "Zahngaihna na tangta," chi in gen in.
Na nu uh genpih un, genpih un; ka zi ahi kei a, apasal ka hi sam kei hi; amuhna a kipan akizuaknate leh anawi kikal a kipan a-angkawmnate koihmang hen.
Huchi lou in zaw vuaktang in ka omsak in, apian ni bang in ka koih in, gamdai bang in ka bawl in, gamkeu bang in ka koih in, dangtakna in amah ka that kha ding hi.
Ahi, atate tung ah zahngaihna ka nei kei ding a; kizuak tate ahih ding ziak un.
Anu uh kizuak ahih ziak in; amaute painu'n zumhuaitak in ahihta hi, "Ka tanghou leh ka tui, ka samul leh ka pat, ka sathau leh ka dawn ding hon pia, ka itte ka delh ding," achih ziak in.
Huaiziak in ngai in, ling in alampi ka dal dia, amah dal ding in dai ka kai dia, huchi in alampite amu kei ding hi.

Huchi in a-itte anungzuih ding a, himahleh apha kei ding; amaute azong ding a, himahleh amu kei ding, "Ka pai dia ka pasal masapen kiang ah ka kik ding; huai chiang in tu sang in kei a ding in ahoihzaw ding," achi ding hi.
"Abuh-le-bal, uain, sathau ka piak leh adangka leh adangka-eng, Baal a dia azat uh, ka hihpunsak chih atheih louh ziak un.
Huaiziak in buh-le-bal alak hun in ka la nawn ding, ka uain atun hun in, avuaktanna khuhna ding ka samul leh ka pat ka botkhe ding hi.
Huchi in tu'n ama itte muh in azahlakna ka mukhe ding a, ka khut a kipan kuamah in amah atankhe kei ding hi.
Avualnopna tengteng ka tawpsak ding a, a-ankuangluite, akha thak, a Sabbathte leh akhawmpi kulmut tengteng.
Hiaite ka kipahman ka itte'n kei hon piak uh ahi, achihna, agrep guite leh atheipi kungte ka hihse vek ding huchi in gammang in ka bawl ding a, gamsate'n huaite ane ding uh.
Baalim ni, huai agimlim hal nite amah tung ah ka kan ding a; abilbahte leh asuangmantamte a kizem a, a-it azuih a, kei ahon mangngilh ziak in,” TOUPA'N achi.
Huaiziak in ngai in, amah ka khim ding a, gamdai ah ka tonpih ding a, akiang ah lungmuanhuaitak in thu ka gen ding hi.

Huan huai a kipan in agrephuante amah ka pe ding a, lametna kongkhak ding in Akor Phaizang; huan atuailai nite bang in, Aigupta gam a kipan a ahong pawtkhiak lai ni bang in huai ah ama'n la asa ding hi.
"Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding hi, Baalte na hon chi nawnta kei dia, Ishi na hon chita ding hi," TOUPA'N achi.
Akam a kipan Baalim minte ka lamangta ding a, amin uh genkhiak ahih nawn tak louh ding ziak un.

Huai ni chiang in, gamsate, van vasate, lei a bokvak a pai thilte toh amaute a ding in thukhun ka bawl ding; thalpeu leh namsau leh kidouna gam a kipan ka hihmangta ding a, galmuangtak in amau ka kualsak ding hi.
Huan kei a ding in tangtawn in nang ka hon khamta ding; ahi, diktatna leh vaihawmna leh, itna siamna leh zahngaihna in kei a ding in nang ka hon kham ding hi.
Ginomna in kei a ding in ka hon kham ding a; TOUPA na thei ding.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, ka dawng ding, vante ka dawng ding a, amau lei adawng ding uh, TOUPA'N achi.
Lei in buh-le-bal leh uain leh, sathau in adawng ding a, Amau Jezreel adawng ding uhi.

Huan lei ah kei a ding in amah ka tuh ding a; zahngaihna tanglounu tung ah zahngaihna ka musak ding; ka mite hiloute kiang ah, "Ka mite na hi uh," ka chi ding a; amau, "Ka Pathian na hi," ahon chi ding uhi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Kuan inla, alawm in alunggulh tuntun numei, angkawmnu, pathian dangte lam nga in, grep beu gamte it mah le uh, TOUPA'N Israel suante a-it bang in it nawn in," ahon chi hi.
Huchi in kei a ding in amah dangka shekel sawm-le-nga leh barli buh homer khat leh barli buh homer kimkhat in ka leita hi.
Akiang ah, "Kei a ding in ni tampi na om nilouh ding; kizuak in na om nawn kei dia, mi kuamah zi na hi kei ding; huchibang in kei leng nang lam ah ka om ding," ka chi hi.
Israel suante bel kumpi nei lou, vaihawmmi om lou, kithoihna nei lou, khuam siangthou lou, siampu puanak lou leh pathiante lou in ni tampi a-om nilouh ding uhi.
Huai nung chiang in Israel suante ahong kik nawn ding ua, TOUPA, a Pathian uh leh David akumpipa uh azong ding uhi; ni nanungte ah TOUPA kiang ah ahoihna zuan in lau kawm in ahong pai ding uhi.
Nou Israel suante, TOUPA thu za un, "Gamsung a thutak hiam, zahngaihna hiam, Pathian theihna a-om louh ziak in, TOUPA'N gam a tengte akinakpih hi.
Kichiam leh ginna hihsiat, thah, guktak leh angkawm hih chih ngal louh bangmah a-om kei hi; akitungkhia ua, sisan akisuah zialzial uhi.
Huaiziak in gam adah ding a, asung a tengte leh gamsate leh tungleng vasate abah ding ua, ahi, tuipi ngasate tengteng amangthang ding uh," achi hi.
"Hinapi in kuamah in sual kei henla, kuamah in sal kei heh; na mite lah siampu kisualpihte bang ahi ngal ua.
Huan sun in na kisui ding a, nang toh zawlnei leng zan in akisui ding uhi; huchi in na nu ka hihse ding hi.

Ka mite theihna taksap ziak in hihsiat in a-om ua; theihna na deih louh ziak in, ke'n leng, kei a dia siampu na hihlouhna ding in ka hon sam kei ding; na Pathian dan na mangngilhta chih thei in, ke'n leng na suante ka mangngilh ding hi.
"Ahong pun bang zel un, ka tung ah thil ahihkhial uhi; athupina uh zumna in ka khek ding hi.
Ka mite khelhna kivakna in anei ua, athulimlouhna uah alungtang uh akoihkip uhi.
Huan mipite hi in siampute akibang ua, atatdante uh ziak in amaute ka gawt ding a, athilhihte uah kipahman ka pe ding hi.
Ane ding ua, akham kei ding uh; akizuak ding ua, apung kei ding uh; TOUPA lam a pilvan ding a-awlmoh louh ziak un."
TOUPA'N "Kizuakna leh uain leh uain thak in theihtheihna alamang hi!" achi hi.
Ka mite'n amilimte uh thu adong ua, akiang uah achiangkhun un thu agenkhia uhi; angkawmna kha in amaute takhialsak in, a Pathian uh nuai a kipan angkawm in a-omta uh.

Tang sangte tung ah akithoih ua, mualte tung leh tosaw singte leh ahiang singte leh nai nei singte nuai ah, huai nuailim ahoih ziak in, gimlim ahal uh; huaiziak in na tanute un kizuakna ahih ua, na moute un kizuakna ahih ua; na moute un angkawmna ahih uhi.

Na tanute un akizuak chiang un ka gawt kei ding a, na zite un ang a kawm chiang un leng ka gawt kei ding; pasalte kizuakna apaizak ua, tempul a kizuakte kiang ah akithoih uh; huchi in theihna nei lou mite nuaisiah in a-om ding uhi.
Nang Israel in, kizuakna hih mah leteh, Judah ahihleh moh kei hen, Gilgal ah hong pai kei unla, Beth-aven ah leng hohtou sam kei un, "TOUPA ahin bang in," chi in leng kichiam kei un.
Bawngla genhak bang in, Israel genhaktak in akibawl a; mun za a belamnou bang in tu in TOUPA'N amaute avak ding hi.
Ephraim milimte toh akizom a; a-omom in om hen.
Adawnkham nung un leng kizuak in a-om lailai ua, thupina sang in zumhuaina a-it tuntun uhi.
Huih in akha in amaute amutmang ding a, akithoihna ziak un azum ding uhi.
Nou siampute aw, hiai za un, nou Israel inkote aw, ngaikhia un, kumpipa inkote aw, bildoh un, na tung ua vaihawmna hong tung ding ahi; Mizpah a thang leh Tabor tung a lenthang na hi khinta uhi.
Mithahna lam ah thukpi in akihelta ua; himahleh amaute tengteng thuhilhpa ka hi.
Ephraim ka thei a, Israel ka lak ah sel in a-om kei; Ephraim aw, tu in, kizuak in na omta a, Israel abuahta hi.
Athilbawlte un a Pathian kiang lam angasak kei ding hi; asung uah kizuakna kha a-om a, TOUPA athei kei uhi.
Israel kisaktheihna in amai ah atheihpih a; huaiziak in athulimlouhna uah Israel leh Ephraim akisuipuk ding ua, Judah leng amaute toh apukkhawm ding hi.
TOUPA zong ding in abawnghonte uh leh abelamhonte uh toh akuan ding ua; himahleh amah amu kei ding uh; amau a kipan in akihemkheta hi.
TOUPA tung ah lepchiahtak in agamta ua; ta lamdangte anei ua; tu in aloute uh toh kha thak in amau anegai ding hi.
Gibeah ah na pengkul binei uh mut unla, Ramah ah pengkul; Beth-aven ah ngaihtak in kikou un; aw Benjamin, ka hon zui uhi.
Salhna ni in Ephraim asegawp ding a; ahong om ngeingei ding Israel namte lak ah ka theisakta hi.
Judah heutute zaw gamgi chiamtehna lamangte bang ahi uh; tui bang in atung uah ka hehna ka sungbo ding hi.
Epraim nuaisiah in a-om, vaihawmna ah delhkhum in a-om, thupiak zui a om alungkim ziak in.
Huaiziak in Ephraim a ding in puannget leh Judah inkote a ding in siatna ka hi ding hi.

Ephraim in achinatna amuh a, Judah in aliamna amuh chiang in, huchi in Assuria kiang ah Ephraim ahoh a, kumpipa Jareb kiang ah asawl a; himahleh nang ahon hihdam thei kei a, na liamna leng ahihdam thei sam kei hi.

Ephraim a ding a humpinelkai bang leh Judah inkote a ding a humpinelkai lun lai bang ka hih ziak in; kei, kei mahmah in, ka botnen ding a ka paimang ding; ka pomang ding a; honkhe ding kuamah a-om kei ding hi.
Atatkhelhna uh thupha atawi ua, ka mel azon masiah uh, ka pai dia ka mun ah ka kik nawn ding; agimthuakna uah chihtaktak in kei ahon zong ding uhi.
Hong un, TOUPA kiang ah i kik ding uh; ama'n ahon botkekta a, ahon damsak ding ziak in, ahon sat a, ahon tuam ding hi.
Ni nih nung in ama'n ahon hihhalh ding; ani thum ni in ahon kaithou ding a, ama ah i hing ding uhi.
Huan thei ni, TOUPA thei ding in zuitou pek ni; zingsang a khua avak ngeingei bang in leh vuah, lei kawtsak vuah nanung bang in i kiang uah ahong pai ding chih theihsa ahi.
Aw Ephraim, bang ka hon chih dia? Aw Judah, bang ka hon loh dia? Na hoihna lah zingsang meipi bang leh daitui zulmang pah bang ahi.
Huaiziak in zawlneite in amaute ka heuhta; ka kam a thute in amaute ka thatta; na vaihawmnate khovak paikhe pah bang ahi.
Kithoihna hilou in, zahngaihna ka deih a; halmang thillat sang in Pathian theihna ka deih hi.
Himahleh Adam bang in thukhun ah atalek ua; huai ah lepchiahtak in ka tung ah ahih uhi.
Gilead thulim lou sepna khopi ahi a, sisan a hihnit in a-om hi.
Suamhat pawlte'n mi aguktan bang un, siampu pawlte'n Shekem zotna lampi ah tual athat uh; ahi, kilawm lou ahihta uhi.
Israel inkote ah thil mulkimhuai ka muta a; huai ah Ephraim ah kizuakna muh in a-om a, Israel abuahgawpta hi.
Huai lou in, Aw Judah, ka mite saltang ka pi nawn chiang in, nang a ding in buhlak ding sehsa a-om hi.
Israel ka sukdam chiang in, huai chang in Ephraim thulimlouhna muhkhiak ahi, Samaria gitlouhna toh; zuauthei ahi ngal ua; gutate'n inn aluh ua, apolam ah suamhatte'n mite asuam uhi.
Agitlouhna tengteng uh ka theigige chih alungtangte un angaihtuah kei uh; tu in amau thilhihte ngei in amaute ahihbuai hi; tuate ka mai ma ah a-om uhi.
Agitlouhna un akumpipa uh akipaksak ua, azuau un aheutute uh.
Avek un angkawmte ahi uh; thuk sa gige, tanghou kangmi in tangbuang mekman silngou in azelhsuah masiah mei sawn kul lou thuk bang ahi.
I kumpipa uh ankuanglui ni in heutute uain sa in amau leh amau akichinasak ua; simmoh hatte toh akhut azankhia uhi.
Alungtang uh thukkhuk sa bang ahi a, mite zuau in abuk ua, zankhua in ahehna uh a-am a, zingsang in meikuang bang in akuangkhia hi.
Thuk bang in asa vek ua, avaihawmte uh anegai uh; akumpipa tengteng uh apukta uh; kei lam a hong patau kuamah a-om kei uhi.
Ephraim, mite lak ah akidiah a; lumleh louh tanghou beu ahi.
Mikhualte'n ahatna agai ua, ama'n athei kei; ahi, alutung koi lailai hiam a samkang a-om lam athei kei hi.
Huan Israel kisaktheihna amel ah alang hi; TOUPA a Pathian lam ah akihei kei ua, hiai tengteng ziak in, amah azong tuan kei uh.
Ephraim vakhu hai bang, theihsiamna bei ahi; Aigupta lam ah asam ua, Assuria kiang ah apai uhi.
Apai chiang un, atung uah len ka zak ding; van a vasate bang in amaute ka kaikhesuk ding a; a-omkhopna uh azaksa bang un ka sawi ding.
Atung uh agik hi! Kei a kipan ataimang ziak un, atung uah siatna atung hi, keimah tung ah atalekta ua; amaute tankhe ut mah leng, ka siatna ding in zuau agengen uhi.
Alungtang uh toh ka kiang ah akap kei ua, alupna tung uah akap zosop uh; buh-le-bal leh uain zong in akikaikhawm ua, ka tung ah ahel uhi.
Akhut uh sinsak in hatsakta mah leng, ka siatna ding in angaihtuah uhi.
Akik ua, himahleh tungsang a ompa kiang ah ahi kei; thalpeu gilou bang ahi uh; alei hehna ziak in namsau in aheutute uh apuk ding uh; Aigupta gam ah hiai nuihsan a a-omna uh ahi ding hi.
Na kam ah pengkul bulh in, muvanlai bang in TOUPA inkote dou ding in ahong hi; ka thukhun tung a atatlek ua, ka dan a atatlek ziak un.
Ka Pathian, kou Israel in ka hon thei uh, chi in kei lam ah akikoukhe ding uhi.
Israel in ahoih anawlkhin a; melma in amah adelh ding hi.
Kumpipate atungkhia ua, himahleh kei thu in bel ahi kei; heutute abawl ua, ke'n ka thei kei; satkhiak a a-omtheihna ding un adangka uleh adangka-eng un milimte abawl uhi.
Aw Samaria, na bawngnou milim in hon satkheta; amaute tung ah ka hehna asou; poi khoih lou a bang tan om zou ding uh ahia?
Bawngnou milim Israel a kipan in ahi a; nasem mite'n abawlkhiak uh ahi, huai Pathian ahi kei, ahi, Samaria bawngnou milim akitamzan ding hi.
Huih atuh ua pingpei a-at ua, buh-le-bal ding lai anei kei; avui in an asuah kei hi; huchi ahihleh suah hen, mikhualte'n anawmvalh khin ding uhi.
Israel nawmvalh in a-om, kipahna omlouhna bel bang in tu in namte lak ah a-om uhi.
Gam sabiltung tang-om bang in, Assuria zuan in apaitou uhi; Ephraim in it mite aguaita hi.
Ahi, namte lak ah kizuak mah le uh, amaute ka kaikhawm ding; heutute kumpipa dangte puakgik ziak in alungkham ding uhi.
Khial ding a Ephraim in maitam apunsak ziak in, amah a ding in maitamte khelhna ding ahi.
Amah a ding in ka dante singkhat in gelh mah leng, thillamdang bang a sim in a-om uhi.
Ka thillatte kithoihna thu ahihleh, sa in akithoih ua ane uh; himahleh TOUPA'N huaite asang kei hi; tu in agitnatlouhna uh atheigige ding a, akhelhnate un aveh ding; Aigupta ah akik ding uhi.
Israel in amah bawlpa amangngilha, mun sangte alamta hi; himahleh akhopite tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, huai a kulhpite akangtum ding uhi.
Aw Israel, midangte bang in nuamsa in kipak ke'n; Pathian taisan in kizuak in na om khinta ngal a, phual tung teng ah kizuakman na itta hi.
Phual leh uain suknate'n amaute avak kei ding a, uain thak in amah azuausan ding hi.
TOUPA gam ah ateng kei ding ua; himahleh Ephraim Aigupta ah akik ding, Assuria ah an siang lou ane ding uhi.

TOUPA kiang ah uain thillatte asungkhe kei ding ua, amah a ding in lungkimhuai ahi sam kei ding uh; akithoihnate uh amau a ding in sisuun mite tanghou bang ahi ding; huai ne tengteng hihnit in a-om ding uh; atanghou uh agilkialna uh a ding ahi; TOUPA insung ah ahong pai kei ding hi.
Kikhawmpi chikleh TOUPA ankuanglui ni in bang na hih ding ua?
Ngai un, Assuria ah apai ding uh; Aigupta in amaute akhawm ding, Memphis in amaute avui ding. Dangka a bawl agou manphate uh lahou in akhuh ding; apuaninte uah lingte a-om ding hi.
Vehna nite ahong tung, thukna nite ahong tung; Israel in athei ding hi; zawlnei mihai a seh ahi a, khamite leng mihai ahi, na ginatlouhna atam mahmah ziak in leh muhdahna athupi ziak in.
Ephraim galvilmi Pathian toh a-om hi; zawlnei tungtang ahihleh alampi tengteng ah thangkampa thang a-om a, muhdahna Pathian inn ah a-om hi.
Gibeah nite a bang in, nakpi in amau leh amau akihihsia ua; athulimlouhna uh atheigige ding a, akhelhnate uh agawt ding hi.

Gamdai a grepte bang in Israel ka mu a; theipi kung ahun masapen lai a min masa bang in na pipute uh ka muta hi. Himahleh Baal-peor ah ahong ua, thil zumhuai lam ah akipumpiak ua, athil deihte uh bang in amaute kihhuai ahong hita uhi.
Ephraim ahihleh, vasa bang in athupina uh alengmang ding a; nau pianna, nau paina leh nau neihna himhim a-om kei ding hi.
Atate uh khoilian mah le uh, amau ka suunsak ding a, piching a hawi in a-om kei ding hi; ahi, amaute ka nutsiat hun chiang in atung uah tunggikna a-om ding hi.
Ephraim, Tura ka muhsa bang in, mun nuam a phuh in a-om; himahleh Ephraim in atate tualthatmi kiang ah ahon pikhe ding hi.
Aw TOUPA amau pia in; bang na pe dia? Sul naupai thei lou leh nawizu nei lou pia in.
Agitlouhna tengteng uh Gilgal ah a-om a; huai ah amaute ka mudahta hi; athilhihte uh gitlouh ziak in ka inn a kipan amau ka delhkhe ding a; ka it nawn kei ding; aheutute tengteng uh mihel ahi uhi.
Ephraim sat in a-om, azung uh akeu, gah asuang kei ding uh; tate suang mah le uh, asulgah it uh ka that ding hi.
Ka Pathian in amaute apaimang ding a, amah angaihkhiak louh ziak un; huchi in namte lak ah vakvai in a-om ding uhi.
Amoz tapa Isai in Judah kumpipa Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiahte vaihawm lai a, Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu a kilakna amuh thu.
"Vante aw, ngaikhia unla, lei aw, bildoh in, TOUPA'N thu agen hi: Tapate ka khoi a, ka khangliansak a, himahleh ka tung ah ahel uhi.
Bawngtal in aneitu athei a, sabiltung in leng apu anpiakna athei; Israelte'n ahihleh athei kei uh, ka mite'n angaihtuah kei uh," chi in.
Ah! Nam gilou thulimlouhna gikpi po mite, thil hoih lou hihte, gamtat hoihloupi a gamtate ahi ua; TOUPA apaisan ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou amusit ua, kihihtuam in anungtolhta uh.
Bang achia hel semsem a, vuak a om lailai na hi ua oi? Lutang apum in achi ana a, lungtang leng apum in agimta.
Khepek nuai a kipan lutang pha in dam lai himhim a-om kei; chikeh, vuak sidup ek, meima naila ngen ahi; huaite lah amekbing kei ua, tuam leng atuam sam kei ua, sathau leng anuh kei uhi.
Na gam uh loih in a-om khinta; na khuate uh mei in akang khinta; na gam uh gamdang mite'n na mitmuh un anei khin ua, gamdang mite hihsiat bang in ase khinta hi.
Zion tanu grephuan a buk bang leh tangmai huan a buk bang leh khopi umbichilh bang in loih in a-omta hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N khosuaksun tawmchik hon na sitsak lou hileh Sodom bang in i om khin ding ua, Gomorrah bang in i om khinta ding uhi.
Sodom vaihawmte aw, TOUPA thu za un; Gomorrah mite aw, i Pathian dan thu ah bildoh un.

TOUPA'N, "Huai zahzah a na kithoihna uh kei a dia bang ahia athamatna om? Belamtal halmang alatte leh gan vak thaute thau in ahon nimta; bawngtalte leh belamnoute leh kelpate sisan ah leng ka kipak kei, achi hi.
Ka ma a kilak ding a na hong pai un, ka huangsung intual sik ding kua'n ahon phut a?

Thilpiak bangmah loute hon tawi nawn kei un; banghiam gimlim kei a ding in thilkihhuaipi ahi; kha thakte, Sabbathte, khawmpite na kichialkhawmte mawkmawk uh ka iplah mahmah; kikhopna thupitak leng thulimlouhna ahi.
Na kha thakte uleh hunbi nei a na ankuangluinate uh ka lungsim in ahua hi; kei a ding in tunggikna ahi; ka thuak chimta hi.
"Huchi in na khut uh na zak chiang un leng ka mit ka hon humsan dia; ahi, tamveipi na thum chiang un leng ka ngaikhe kei ding; na khutte uh lah sisan in adim ngal a.
Kisil unla, kihihsiang un; ka mitmuh phak louh ding in na thilhih giloute uh koihmang unla; gilou hih tawpta un.
Thil hoih hih kisinta unla; vaihawmna diktat zong un, nuaisiahna thuakte panpih unla, pa neiloute vai hawmsak unla, meithai thu gensak un," achi hi.
TOUPA'N, "Hong pai un, ngaihtuah khawm dih ve ni! Na khelhnate uh san-au bang in om mahleh, vuk bang in angou ding; sandup bang in san khin mahleh belam mul bang in a-om ding.
Gennoptak leh thumang a na om uleh, na gam thil hoihte uh na ne ding uh.
Himahleh na ut kei ua na hel uleh bel, namsau nek khit in na om ding uh; TOUPA kam in huai agenta hi," achi hi.
Bangchidan ahia khopi muanhuaitak kizuak ahong suah maimah, vaihawm diktatna a dim nu hisek hi a! Amah ah diktatna a-om sek a, tu'n lah tualthat mite a-om hi!
Na dangka eksia ahong hita, na uain lah tui toh hel ahita.
Na miliante mihelhat, gutate lawmte ahi uh; michih in golhna adeih ua, thilpiak adelh nak uhi; pa neiloute ahawmsak sek kei ua, meithaite makhua khualna leng akiang uh atung ngei sam kei hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA, Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israelte Mihat in hichi in achi! "Aw le! Hon doute tung ah ka hehna ka tangtungsak dia, ka melmate tung ah phu ka la ding.
Huchi in na tung ah ka khut ka kha ding a, na eksia siang sipsip in ka hihmang ding, na sikgawm tengteng ka lamang vek ding.

Huan na sung a vaihawmtute atung a la-om bang un ka omsak nawn ding a, na sung a lemthei mite amasapen a a-om bang un ka omsak lai ding hi. Huai khit chiang in, diktatna khopi, khopi muanhuai, ahon chi ding uhi,” achi hi.
"Zion vaihawmna diktat a hotkhiak ahita ding a, asung a mi piangthak nawnte leng diktatna a hotkhiak ahi ding uhi.
Himahleh mihelte leh mikhialte hihsiatna akituak in a-om ding a, TOUPA paisan mite leng hihman in a-om ding uhi.
"Na tosaw deih mahmahte uh azumpihta ding ua, na huan telte uh ziak in zaktatak in na om ding uhi.
Tosaw nah vuaite leh huan tui mu lou bang phet na hi ding hi.
Huchi in mihattak ziza zial bang ahita ding a, anasep mei-ek bang ahi ding; huchi in akang tuaktuak ding ua; kuamah in aphelh kei ding uh," chi in.
Hoih loutak a thupukna bawlte leh dikloutak a gelh mite tung agik hi!

Meithaite tan ding gallak a laksak a-omtheihna ding uleh, pa neiloute thil laksak bang a abawltheihna ding un, nei zouloute vaihawmna diktat tangsak lou ding leh ka mite lak a gentheite muh ding mawngmawng laksak tumte!

Huchi in gawtna ni ahong tun chiang leh gamlapi a kipan huihpi ahong tun chiang in, bang na hih ding ua oi? Panpihna ngen ding in kua kiang ah na taita ding ua? Na thupina uh koi ah na nuseta ding ua?
Hentate lak ah akun ding ua, thahte lak ah apuk ding uh, hiaite lel atan uh ahita ding hi. Huchi ahih in leng ahehna adai tuan kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
TOUPA'N "Kisa in, Assuria mi, ka hehna khetbuk, ka lungkimlouhna chiangkhun tawi!
Gallak la ding leh thil laksak la ding leh kongzing buannawi bang a ngap ding in amah zaw Pathian zah lou nam dou ding in ka sawl ding a, ka hehna mite sual ding in thu ka pe ding hi,” achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n huchibang a tup ahi kei a, huchibang zaw alungsim in leng angaihtuah sam kei; nam tam petmah a tam hihsiat leh hihmanthat ahi, lungsim a aneih zawk.
"Ka miliante tengteng kumpipa ahi vek kei ua hia?
Kalno khua Karkhemish khua bang hita lou ahi maw? Hamath khua Arpad khua bang hita lou ahi maw? Samaria khua Damaskas khua bang hita lou ahi maw?
Ka khut in milimte gam, Jerusalem khua leh Samaria khuate sang a milim bawltawm hoihzaw neite leng, azongkheta uhi.
Samaria leh amilimte tung a ka hihtak bang in Jerusalem leh amilimte tung ah ka hih kei dia hia?"

Huchi ahih ziak in hichi ahi ding a, "Toupa'n Zion tang leh Jerusalem khosung a anasep ding tengteng asep khit hun chiang in Assuria kumpipa lungsim ki-otsakna gah leh amit kisathei thupina ka gawt ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka khut hatna in ka hihta hi, ka pilna toh in; ka kizen ngal a; chi chih gamgite lah ka suan a, avaihawmna uh lah ka sut a, laltutphah a tute mihangsan hih bang in ka kaikhia hi.

Ka khut in chi chih hauhsaknate lah vasabu bang in azongkhia a; mi'n vasa tui api loihsansa ala uh bang in leitung pumpi ka la khin vekta hi; khazap hiam, kam ka hiam ham himhim leng a-om kei uhi," achi vial ngal a.
Heipi in thil ehna ding a azangmi akisaktheihsan dia hia? Sing-atna in atmi anuaisiah dia hia? Khetbuk in adom mite alik zosop diam aw, chiangkhun in sing hilou alik zomah bang phet ahi.
Huaiziak in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Ami thaute lak ah gawnna asawl ding a; athupina nuai ah meikuang lai lel bang in mei toh in a-om ding.
Huan Israelte vakna mei ahong hi ding a, amaute Mi Siangthou mah leng meikuang ahi ding; huai in ni khat thu in louling neite leh khaulingneite kangsak in ahihmangthang ding.
Agammang leh alei hoih mun thupina leng, kha leh sa nangawn in, ahihmang ding; huchi in chiamtehna tawi pen kia hun lai bang ahi ding.
Agammang a sing om zek laite naupang gelh tham phet a tawm ahita ding," achi hi.

Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Israelte khosuaksunte leh Jakob inkuanpihte lak a khosuaksunte'n amaute thatpa ah akinga nawnta kei ding ua; TOUPA Israelte Mi Siangthou, chihtaktak in amuangzawta ding uhi.
Akhosuaksunte, Jakob khosuaksunte, Pathian hattak kiang ah akik nawn ding uh.
Na mi Israelte tuipi piaunel zah himah le uh, akhosuaksunte kia akik nawn ding uhi; diktatna luanletna suksiatna tung ding avaihawm puk ahi.
Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA, tawpna, tawpna tung ngei ding a vaihawm puk, gam tengteng laizang ah abawl ding hi.
Huaiziak in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Zion a om ka mite aw, Aigupta gam a ahih bang un khetbuk a nou hon vua in achiangkhun na tung uah lik mahleh, Assuria mi kihta kei un.
Sawt louchik nung in ka lungkimlouhna ahong bei dia, ka hehna leng amaute hihmanthatna ding in hei in a-omta ding hi.
Oreb suangpi a Midiante athah lai bang un sepaihte' TOUPA'N amah sual ding in zepna apei ding a; achiang lah tuipi tunglam ah a-om ding a Aigupta gam a apei bang in apei ding hi.
Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, puakgik na liangzang a kipan lakmang in a-om ding a, ahakkol leng na ngawng a kipan lakmang in a-om lai ding hi; thaunilh ziak in hakkol hihsiat in a-omta ding,” chi in.
Rimmon a kipan Aiath khua atungta, Migron ah apaisuakta; Mikmash ah avan akoihta hi.
Guam ah atumta uh; Geba ah agiakta uh; Ramah khuate alingling ua; Saul, Gibeah khote ataimangta uh.
Gallim tanu aw! Na aw in ngaihtak in kikou in; Laish a khua aw! Ngaikhia in; Anathoth aw, hehpihhuai na lawmlawm chia!
Madmenah khote taimang in a-omta uh; Gebim a omte taimang tum in akidelh ding uhi.
Tuni mah in Nob ah ataam dia; Zion tanu tang, Jerusalem mual pawng akhut asinkhum hi.
Ngai dih, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, thil mulkimhuaitak in ahiangte asatkhe ding a, sang pipite phuk in a-om ding a, adawktuamte leng gawiniam in a-om ding hi.
Sik in gamnuai sing sahte aphuk ding a, Lebanon sidar singte mithupi puk in apuk zuazua ding uhi.
Jesse bul a kipan in selnou ahong pawt ding a, azungte a kipan in ahiang hong khangkhe ding hi.
Huan TOUPA kha pilna leh theihtheihna kha, lemtheihna leh hatna kha theihna leh TOUPA launa kha atung ah atu ding hi.
Huchi in akipahna uh TOUPA launa ah ahi ding. Amit a amuh bang in vai ahawm kei ding a, abil a azak bang in leng ataihilh sam kei ding hi.

Diktattak in gentheite vai ahawmsak zaw ding a, lei a mi thunuailutte a ding in khentuam nei lou in ataihilhsak lai ding hi; akam a khetbuk in lei akhen ding a, amuk a hu in migilou-saloute athat ding.
Diktatna akawnggak ahi ding a, ginomna ataigakna ahi ding hi.
Huchi in ngia leh belamnou a-omkhawm ding ua, kelnou toh gialbem abokkhawm ding uh, bawngnou leh humpinelkai tuailai leh gan vak thaute a-omkhawm ding ua; naupangnou in api zungzung ding hi.
Bawng leh vompi agamtakhawm ding ua; anoute uh abokkhawm tiptep ding uhi; huan humpinelkai in bawngtal bang in buhpawl ane ding hi.
Nau nawitui ne lai thangtom ko gei ah a-om hiathiat ding a, nau nawitui nek tawpsa in guldekpak ko gei ah akhut anga ding.
Ka tang siangthou ah kihihnat a-omta kei ding a, kihihsiat leng a-om nawn kei ding, tuipite tui a adim gige bang in, TOUPA theihna in leitung adim ding hi.
Huan huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Jesse zung michih chiamtehna ding in a-om ding a, amah mahmah namte'n adong ding ua, akhawlna mun athupi ding hi.

Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Toupa'n asi val khosuaksun amite, Assuria gam a kipan, Aigupta gam a kipan, Pathros gam a kipan, Kush gam a kipan, Elam gam a kipan, Shinar gam a kipan leh Hamath a kipan leh tuipi tuikulh gam a kipan, ala nawn ding a, anihveina ding in akhut azak nawn ding hi.
Huchi in namte a ding in chiamtehna atakkhe ding a, Israel delhkhiakte apikhawm ding a, Judah dalhte kawlmong li a kipan apikhawm ding.
Huchi in Ephraimte hazatna abeita ding a, Judahte hihbuai mite hihmanthat in a-omta ding uh; Ephraimte'n Judahte ahaza nawnta kei ding ua, Judahte'n leng Ephraimte ahihbuai nawn kei ding uh.
Huchi in amaute tumlam ah Philistiate liangzang ah lengsuk in ava tuang ding ua; suahlam mite alokkhawm ding uh; Edom leh Moabte tung ah akhut uh akha ding ua, Ammon suante'n athu uh amangta ding uh.
TOUPA'N Aigupta Tuipi lei ahihse vek ding a, Luipi leng ahuih sa huthut in akhut asinkhum ding a, luita sagihte a bawl hial in avo ding a, mite khepek leng kawt lou in apai galkah ding.
Huchi in Aigupta gam a kipan apaitouh ni ua Israelte a ding a lamlian ahong om bang in, akhosuaksun amite a ding in Assuria gam a kipan in lamlian ahong om ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in hichibang in na chi ding hi, "TOUPA aw, kipahthu ka hon hilh hi; ka tung ah na hehta mah lechin, na hehna lah adaita, na hon khamuan hi.
Ngai in, Pathian hon hondampa ahi a; ka gingta ding a, lau in ka om kei ding; TOUPA Jehovah ka hatna leh ka la ahi, hon hondampa ahi," chi in.
Huaiziak in hotdamna tuikhuk a pan nuam in tui na tawi ding uh.
Huai ni in huchi in na chi ding hi. "TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh unla, amin lou un, athilhihte michih lak ah theisak unla, amin pahtawi in a-om chih gen un.
TOUPA pahtawi in la sa un; ama'n thil hoihpente ahihta hi; huai leitung ah theih in om hen.
Zion a omte aw, ngaihtak in kikou unla, kikou vengvung un, Israelte Mi Siangthou na lak ua om lah athupi ngal a," chi in.
Babulon kho puakgik Amoz tapa Isai in amuh thu.
Miliante kongpite a aluttheihna ding un tang sang mai velvul ah chiamtehna takkhia unla, ngaihtak in amau sam unla, khut in hihdan ding hilh un.
Kei mahmah in ka misehte thu ka peta, ahi, ka mihattak, ka mi kinuamsakte, ka hehna tangtungsak ding in ka samta hi.
Tang a mipi husa, mipi atam a tam husa bang mahmah! Namte' lalgam a mi omkhawmte chiak vengvung husa! Sepaihte' TOUPA'N galsual ding a sepaihte kaikhawm ei ve.
Amaute, TOUPA leh alungkimlouhna vanzat, gam gamlapi a kipan, kawlmong tawpna mahmah a kipan in gam tengteng hihse ding in ahong pai uhi.
Mau tuaituai un, TOUPA ni anaita hi. Bangkim hihthei a kipan siatna ahong tung bang in ahong tung ding hi.
Huaiziak in khut tengteng ahat kei ding a, mihing lungtang chiteng leng azulmang ding.
Huchi in alau ding ua; damlouhna leh lungkimlouhnate'n amaute aman ding a; numei nauvei bang mai in achi uh ana ding; lamdang kisatuah in a-om chiat ding uh; amelte uh meikuang mel bang ahi ding.
Ngai in, gam hihse ding leh huai lai a mikhialte asung a kipan a hihmangthang ding in TOUPA ni thupitak, thangpaihna leh hehna thupitak toh, ahong tung ding hi.
Van aksite leh aksi munkipte un avakna uh asuaksak kei ding ua; ni lah asuah lai in mialsak in a-om ding a, kha in leng avakna avaksak kei ding hi.
Huan khovel agitlouhna ziak in ka gawt ding a, migilou-saloute athulimlouhna ziak un ka gawt sam ding. Mikisathei paukhauh lah ka tawpsak ding a, mikihtakhuai kisaktheihna ka niamsak lai ding hi.
Mi dangka-eng siangthou sang a leng manphazaw in ka bawl ding a, mihing mahmah lah Ophir dangka-eng siangthou sang a leng manphazaw in ka bawl ding.
Huchi in tung a van ka kisingsak ding a, sepaihte' TOUPA hehna ziak in, ahehna ni thupitak ni in, lei leng a-omna mun kisuan tham in linsak in a-om ding.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, sakhi delh ek bang leh belam kuamah hawlkhawm louh bang in michih amau chipihte lam chiat anga ding ua, michih amau gam lam chiat ah ataimang ding uh.
Muh a om peuhmah dawt pailet in a-om ding a, huan, mat a om peuhmah namsau a satpaih in a-om ding.
Anaungekte uh leng amitmuh un zan dimdem khop a leitual satna a zat in a-om ding uh; a-innte uh loh in a-om dia, azite uh leng mawksual in a-om ding uh.
Ngai in, Mediate amau sual ding in ka tokthou ding a, huaite'n dangka alimsak kei ding ua, dangka-eng leng akipahpih sam kei ding uh.
Athalpeute un tangvalte azansak ding a; gil a gahte hehpihna himhim anei kei ding uh; amit un naupangte ahawi kei ding uh.
Huan Babilon, gam chih thupina, Kaldaite kisaktheihpih thil hoihtak, Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah asukman lai bang in a-om ding uh.

Chik mah chiang in leng huai ah mi a-om nawnta kei ding uh, suan om lai siah in leng asung a om a-om sam kei ding. Arab mite'n huai ah apuaninte uh akai kei ding ua; belamchingte'n huai ah abelamhonte uh akualsak kei ding uh.
Gamdai a gamsate huai ah a-om ding ua; a-innte uh simbute inn in adim ding a; vasa ngawngsaute huai ah ateng ding ua, sathakte huai ah amawl leklek ding uhi.
A-insangte uah ngiate aham ding ua, sihalte leng a-inpi nuam mahmahte uah aham ding uh; huan, agawt hun ding atung dekta a, anite leng suksau in a-om kei ding hi.
"TOUPA'N Jakobte tung ah zahngaihna anei ding a, Israelte tel in amau gam ngeingei ah a-omsak ding hi; huan, gamdang mite'n amau azui ding ua, Jakob inkuanpihte alenkip ding uhi.

Huchi in michih in amau api ding ua, amun ding uh atun ding uhi; huchi in Israel inkuanpihte'n TOUPA gam ah amau salpa leh salnu in anei ding ua; amau sal a nei mite sal in ahon man ding ua; amaute simmohte tung ah vai ahon hawm ding uhi.
"Huan na lungkhamna a kipan, na buaina a kipan leh nasep haksa pipi ahon sepsakna ua kipan in TOUPA'N nang ahon khawlsak ni chiang in hichi ahi ding hi.
Hiai pau-el thu Babulon kumpipa kikoukhum in na gen ding. Bangchidan ahia, simmoh hatpa daita na e! Bangchidan ahia, dangka-eng khopi daita na tel e!
TOUPA'N migilou-salou chiangkhun ahihtanta, vaihawmte lalchiang.
Michih heh kawm a vo zialzial zel, thangpai kawm a kuamah kham ngei louh sawina a namte vai hawmsak zel.
Lei pumpi akhawl a, adai vungvung a; thakhat in la asakhe guih uh.
Ahi, na tungthu ziak in meilahte anuam ua, Lebanon tang a sidar singte toh. Hihniam a na om nungsiah phukpaitu ding himhim ka kiang uah ahong tou ngei nawn kei uh," chi in.
"Nuailam a kipan Sheol nang hon dawn ding in, nangmah ziak in abuai lutlut hi; misi, lei a makai tengteng nangmah ziak in atokthou a; namte kumpipa tengteng alaltutphah ua kipan akaidinghta hi.
Huai tengteng in nangmah bia in, na kiang ah huchi in agen ding uh. Nang leng kou bang a hat lou na hita maw?
Na thupi mahmahna Sheol a pikhiaksuk ahita, na kaihging lunglungte toh; tangtel na nuai ah aphah ua, than in nang ahon khuhta uhi,” chi in.
"Sun Aksi aw, Zingsang lam tapa, bangchidan ahia van a kipan na kiak tak maimah! Namte hihpukpa, bangchidan ahia lei a satkhiaksuk a na om maimah!
Na lungtang in, van ah ka kah ding a, Pathian aksite tunglam ah ka laltutphah ka tawisang ding; huan, kikhopna tang, mal tawp a om ah, ka tu ding a;
meipi sang a sang ah ka kah ding a; Tungnungpen bang mai in ka om ding, na chi nak vial a.
Himahleh, Sheol ah, kokhuk tawp ah, pikhiaksuk a om ding na hi ngal a.
"Ahon mu peuh in ahon lim-et ding ua, hiai mi maw lei hihling a, gam chih kisingsak a,
Khovel gamdai bang a bawl a, akhua omte hihmang a, asalte a-inn lam ua pai dia pawtsak ngei lou? chi in na tanchin asut ding uhi.
"Namte kumpipa tengteng, avek un, amau inn chiat uah thupitak in a-ihmu uh.

Nang bel ahun lou a piang kihhuaitak bang in leh gal thah, namsau a sut pailet, kokhuk a thante lak a paisukte puansilh bang in na han a kipan gamlapi ah paihkhiak in na om zawta hi; luang sikden bang mai in.
Na gam na hihsiat a, na khua na tuite na thah ziak in alak ua vui in nang zaw na om kei ding hi. Thil hoih lou hih mite suante min tangtawn in alou ngei kei ding uh.
Akisak ua, lei aneih ua, leitung khopi a adimsaklouhna ding un, apipute uh khelhna ziak in atate uh thah ding ngaihtuah un," chi in.
Huan "Amaute sual ding in ka kisa ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, Babulon a kipan min leh akhosuaksunte leh tapa leh tapa' tapa ka hihmang ding, TOUPA'N achi.
Sakuh a ding in gou in ka bawl ding a, dilte ah leng ka bawl ding; hihmanna munphiah in ka phiat lai ding," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichibang a gen in akichiamta, "Pel lou in ka ngaihtuah bangtak in ahong tung ding; ka seh bangtak in leng a-om ding.
Ka gam ah Assuria mi ka hihse ding a, ka tangte ah ka chil-ek ding achih bang in; huai hun chiang in ahakkol uh amau a kipan amangta ding a, apuakgik uh aliangzang ua kipan in amang sam ding hi.
Huai ahi, leitung pumpi a thuseh, huai mah ahi, nam chih tung a khut zak.
Sepaihte' ToUPA'N asepta ngal a, kua'n asut dia? Akhut zak in a-omta, kua'n alaksak nawn dia?" chi in.
Kumpipa Ahaz sih kum in hiai puakgik ahong omta.
Philistia gam pumpi aw, nangmah vuakna chiang akitan tak ziak in kipak ke'n; gul zung a kipan in guldekpak apawt ding a, agah gul kuang leng thei ahong hi ding hi.
Migenthei ta masate'n ane un ata ding ua, mitagahte leng bittak in a-om ding uh; nang a zung bel kial in ka that ding a, nang akhosuaksunte thah in a-om ding uh.
Kongkhak aw, mau tuaituai in; khopi aw, kikou in; Philistia aw, na pum in na zulmang khinta; mallam a kipan in lah meikhu ahong pawt ngal a, ahun seh uah tuantual himhim a-om ngei kei uhi.
Philistia nam palaite bangchibang in i dawng ding ua? TOUPA'N Zion lah atungding a, amite lak a gentheite'n bitna amu uh, i chi ding uhi.
Moab gam puakgik. Zan khat thu in Moab gam a Ar khua suksiat in a-om a, bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta hi; zan khat thu in Moab gam a Kir khua suksiat in a-om a, bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta hi.
Dibon tanu, mun sangte a kap ding in ahohtouta a; Moabte'n Nebo leh Medeba akahkhum ua, alu tengteng uh agiau vek a, akhamul teng uh leng met in a-om vek hi.
Akongzingte uah sai-ip puan ateng ua; a-intungte uah leh akholak uah michih nakpi in amau tuaituai uhi.
Heshbonte leng akikou ua, Elealehte toh; Jahaz kholam in leng a-aw uh aza uh; huaiziak in Moabte galvan a kivante ngaihtak in akikou ua; ahinna uh asung uah aling hi.
Moabte ziak in ka lungtang akikou a; amihoihte uh Zoar leh Eglath-shelishijah khuate ah atai ua; Luhith tou ah kap kawm in apaitou ua; Horonaim lampi ah siatna kikou in akikoukhia uhi.
Nimrim tuite hihsiat a om ding ahi; loupa avuai khinta; loupa selnoute avuai a, thil hing a-omta kei hi.
Huaiziak in asum neihsunte uleh akoih hoihte uh Muisum Lui gal akaimangpih uhi.
Moab gamgi kim ah kikou husa athang ngal a; amau tuaituai husa Eglaim khua atungta; amau tuaituai husa Beer-elim khua atungta hi.
Dimon tuite sisan in adim vek ngal a; Dimon tung ah thil thupi sem tungsak ding ka hi, Moabte lak a taikhete tung ah leh huai gam a khosuaksunte tung ah humpinelkai ka tungsak ding hi.
Gam vaihawmmi a ding in belamnoute Sela khua gamdai a om a kipan in Zion tanu tang ah khak un.
Huchi in vasa abu a kipan dalh a lengleng bang in Arnon lui kainate ah Moab tanute a-om ding uhi.
Thu hon hilh inla, vai hon hawmsak in; na lim sun lai in zan bang in bawl inla; delhkhiakte sel in; taimangte mansak ke'n.

Moab lak a mi delhkhiak a omte na kiang ah om uhen; amau a ding in hihsemi mel a kipan bukna mun hi hen; lepgumi lah bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta ngal a, hihsiatna adaita a, nuaisiahnate gam a kipan hihmanthat in a-omta uhi.
Huchi in laltutphah hehpihna a hihkip in a-om ding a, huai tung ah, David puanin ah, mi khat, vaihawm in, vaihawmna diktat zong in, thil diktat kintak a hihpah in, chihtaktak in atu ding hi.
Moabte kisaktheihna thu, akisathei mahmah uh chih, ka za ua; asuahngaldan uleh, akisaktheihdan uleh, ahehdan thu uh; aki-otsaknate uh bangmah ahi kei hi.
Huaiziak in Moab tung ah Moab amau tuaituai ding a, michih a mau tuaituai ding; Kir-hareseth grep beu khase tuntun in na kah ding uhi.

Heshbon loute lah atul khinta a, Sibmah grepgui toh, namte toupate'n akung hoih tata akitansak phengphung ua; Jazer kho tanpha in azam ua, gamdai ah azamlut ua; ahiangte azamdalh sengsung ua, tuipi ah azam galkahta uhi.
Huaiziak in Sibmah grepgui Jazer kah in ka kah ding a; Heshbon leh Elealeh aw, ka khitui in ka hon buak ding; na nipi gahte tung leh na buh tung ah kisual kikou husa aketa ngal a.

Kipahna laksak in a-omta, lou hoihtak a kipan in leng nopna laksak in a-omta a; grephuan ah lasak himhim a-omta kei ding a, husa nop tuak himhim leng a-om nawn sam kei ding; grep sukna khukte ah chil a sukmi himhim in uain achilkheta kei ding uh; grep la a kikou ka daisakta hi.
Huaiziak in ka gilte lah Moab hehpihna in pekging bang in aging a, ka gilsung lah Kir-hareseth hehpihna in pekging bang in aging lai hi.
Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, Moab akilat chiang in mun sang akihihgim a, thum ding a ama Mun Siangthou a ahong pai chiang in avuaksuak ding hi.
Huaite Moab tungthu TOUPA'N tuma a agen ahi.

Tu in bel TOUPA'N, kilohmi kum sim a kum thum sung in Moab, thupina, amipi tampitakte nangawn in, muhsithuai a omsak in a-om ding a; akhosuaksunte tawmchik mahmah, gen tham louh ahi ding uh, chi in agenta hi.
Damaskas kho puakgik. Ngai in, Damaskas khopi hi nawn lou ding a lakmang ahita, huchi in inn chimsia koihkhawm lel ahita ding hi.
Aroer khote taisan in a-omta; belamhonte omna ding ahi mai ding, huaite lah a-om ngei ding ua, kuamah in alausak kei ding uh.
Ephraim a kipan kulhpi amang ding a, Damaskas a kipan gam amang ding, Siria gam a khosuaksunte leng amang ding uh; Israel suante thupina bang lel in a-om ding uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jakob thupina hihgawn in a-om ding a, asa thauna leng ahong gawngta ding hi.
Huchi in buh la pan buh alak a, avuite alak bang mai ahi ding a, ahi, Rephaim phaizang ah mi'n buh maihkhakte atom bang mai uh ahi ding hi.

Himahleh, olive singgah loh khit a azikpi dawn a gah nih hiam thum hiam om lai bang leh singgah hiang hoih li hiam nga hiam a-om sek bang in, maih khak top ding a-om lai ding, TOUPA Pathian in achi hi.
Huai ni chiang in mi'n a Bawlpa uh lam a-enta ding ua, amitte un Israelte Mi Siangthou azahtakta ding uh.
Maitam, amau khutsuakte lam a-en nawnta kei ding ua, amau khut a bawl Asherim hiam, gimlim maitamte hiam azahtak nawnta kei ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in akhopi kiptakte uh gammang leh tang vum a mun taisansa, Israel suante ma a ataisansa bang uh, ahi ding; huchi in munloih ahita ding hi.
Nang hon hondampa Pathian na mangngilh a, na hatna Suangpi lah na theigige kei hi; huaiziak in singkung kilawm taktakte na suan ding a, asung ah hiang tuamte na vut paisuak ding hi.
Na suan ni in na khangsak a, zingsang in thil chi lah na paksak a; himahleh agahloh lah lungngaihna leh natna thupitak ni in amang hi.
Ah! Mipi tampi ging zuazua, tuipite ging zuazua bang a ging zuazuate leh namte husa ging hawhaw, tui thupitakte ging hawhaw bang a ging hawhawte na tung uh agik hi!

Namte lah tuipi tampi ging hawhaw bang in aging hawhaw ding ua; himahleh ama'n ataihilh ding a, huchi in gamlapi ah ataimang ding ua, tang a buhsi huih mut bang leh leivui huihpi mutleng lunglung bang in delh in a-om ding uhi.
Nitaklam in, ngai in, thil mulkimhuaitak a-om a; huan, khovak ma in lah a-om nawn kei uh. Huai gallak a hon laksak mite tan ahi a, hon guksak mite tuam leng ahi hi.
Ethiopia gam khen a lui gal a om, akhazap ging hawhaw gam tung agik hi.

Tuipi ah, tui tung a tolh longte ah palaite sawlpa! Misawl hattakte aw, nam sang zehzoh mam hethot kiang ah, apawt tung ua kipan tutan a mi kihtakhuaitakte kiang ah, hoh un; nam in gam ahawm ua, apalpuk uhi, agam uh luite'n ahawmzak hi.
Khovel a om tengteng leh lei a tengte aw, tangte a chiamtehna atakkhiak chiang un en un; pengkul amut chiang un ngaikhia un.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi, "Ka om kinken ding a, ka omna ah ka en gige ding a; nisat lai a kholum huthut bang leh buhlak kholum lai a daitui mei bang in," chi in.
Grep loh hun ma a, apak abei a, apak grep puam a ahong om chiang in, ahiangnoute theikung attanna temta in a-attan sin ngal a, ahiang zam dalhte lamang in asattan lai ding hi.
Huaite tang a vasa sa ne chite a ding in, lei a sate a ding in nutsiat in a-om ding uh; huchi in vasa sa ne chite'n amaute nipi sung in ane ding ua, lei a sa tengteng in phalbi sung in ane ding uhi.

Huai hun chiang in, sepaihte' TOUPA min omna mun, Zion tang ah, sepaihte' TOUPA kiang a piak ding in mi sang zehzoh nam, mam pekpokte'n, kipahman ahon tawi ding ua; nam ahih ua kipan kihtakhuaitak leh pau tuam nei ahi uhi. Huai nam in gam ahawm zel ua, apalpuk behlap lai ua, agam uh lah luite'n ahawmzak hi.
Aigupta gam puakgik. Ngai in, TOUPA meipi hattak tung a tuang in, Aigupta gam ahong tungta, Aigupta gam milimte ama ah aling vonvon ding ua, Aiguptate lungtang lah asung uah azulmang mai ding hi.

Aigupta mite Aigupta mite mah sual ding in ka tokthou ding a; huchi in michih in amau unau sual in michih in amau invengte sual in, akidou ding uh; khua leh khua akidou ding ua, gam leh gam akidou ding uhi.
Huchi in Aiguptate kha asung uah bangmah lou a bawl in a-om ding a; athusawm uh ka hihse ding; huchi in milimte leh bumsiamte thu adong ding uhi.
Aigupta mite heutu tatsetak khut ah ka pekhe ding a; huchi in kumpipa hangsan in atung uah vai ahawmta ding, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Tuipi tuite akang ding ua, luite luangmang in akangtatta ding.
Luite anamsia ua; Aigupta gam tui luangte akiam hiaihiai ding ua, akangtat ding a; phailuangte leh tui loupate avuai khin ding uh.
Nile lui kiang a Nile lui gei mahmah a, gantatna pawnte leh Nile lui kiang a thil chin tengtengte ahong keu vek ding a, taihmang in a-om ding a, a-om nawn kei ding hi.
Ngaman mite leng akap ding ua, Nile lui a ngakuai khaimi tengteng in a-awm uh akitum ding ua, tui a lenpi zakte athadahgawpta ding uhi.
Huai lou in leng ziza hiahsiang khoih mite leh puanngou gan mite azahlak ding uhi.
Akingakna pipen hihzan in a-om ding a, kiloh mite alungkham ding uh.
Zoan a miliante ahai ding ua, Pharaoh mipilpente lemtheihnasa lemtheihna bang lel ahong hita. Pharaoh kiang ah, mipil tapa, nidanglai kumpipate tapa ka hi, bangchidan a chi sek na hi ua?
Na mipilte koi a om ahi ua? Amau hon hilh pah ngal uhen; Aigupta gam tung a thil tung ding, sepaihte' TOUPA sehte, thei uhen.
Zoan a vaihawm miliante mihai ahong hita ua, Memphis a vaihawm miliante khem in a-omta uh; Aigupta namte ning a suangte'n Aiguptate avakmangsakta hi.
TOUPA'N Aiguptate lak ah phengphitna kha a-omsakta; huchi in zukhammi aluak a ahoi doidoi bang in Aiguptate anasep chiteng uah apaikawisakta uhi.
Aiguptate a ding in lutang in hiam, mei in hiam, tumnah hiang in hiam, pumpeng in hiam a sepsak theih a-om nawnta kei ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in Aigupta numeite bang ahi ding ua; Sepaihte' TOUPA khut sin atung ua akisin ziak in aling un alau ding uhi.
Judah gam a omte Aiguptate a ding in mulkimhuaitak ahong hita ding ua, amin uh alohna peuh uah akihta ding ua, amau tung atung ding sepaihte' TOUPA thuhilhna ziak in.
Huai ni chiang in Kanaante pau a pau leh sepaihte' TOUPA kiang ah kichiamna thuchiam sekte, Aigupta gamsung ah kho nga a-om ding a; khat tuh Ni Khopi achi ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in Aigupta laitak ah TOUPA a ding in maitam a-om ding a, agamgi ah TOUPA a ding in suangphuh a-om ding hi.
Huai Aigupta gam a sepaihte' TOUPA a ding in chiamtehna leh theihna ahi ding; nuaisiahte ziak in TOUPA asam ding uhi, huchi in ama'n hondampa leh humbitpa asawl ding a, ama'n amaute ahunkhe ding hi.

Huchi in TOUPA tuh Aiguptate theih ahita ding a, Aigupta mite'n huai ni chiang in TOUPA atheita ding uh; ahi, kithoihna leh thilpiak in abe ding ua, TOUPA kiang ah thu achiam ding ua, atangtun lai ding uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Aiguptate avo ding a, avo ding a, ahihdam lai ding; huchi in TOUPA kiang ah akik nawn ding ua, ama'n angetnate za in amaute ahihdam ding hi.

Huai ni chiang in Aigupta gam a kipan in Assuria gam pha in lamlian a-om ding a; huchi in Assuria mite Aigupta gam ah ahoh ding uh; Aigupta leng Assuria gam ah ahoh ding uh. Aigupta mite'n Assuria mite toh Pathian abekhawmta ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in Israelte Aiguptate leh Assuriate toh athumna ahi ding ua, lei laizangtak ah vualzawlna ahi ding uh.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, ka mi Aiguptate leh ka khutsuak Assuriate leh ka goutan Israelte vualzawl in om uhen, chi in avualzawl hi.
Amoz tapa Isai in Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu amuh:
Ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA' inn omna tang tuh tang lian tungte ah hihkip in a-om ding a, mual neu chikchikte tung ah leng tawisan in a-om ding; huai ah nam chihte ahoh ding uhi.

Huan chi tampite ahoh ding ua, "Hong pai unla, TOUPA tang ah, Jakob' Pathian inn ah, i hohtou ding uh; ama'n alampite tanchinte ahon sinsak ding a, alampite ah i pai ding," achi ding uh. Zion a kipan in dan thu ahong pawt ding a, Jerusalem a pan TOUPA thu ahong pawt ding hi.

Huchi in ama'n namte lak ah vai ahawm ding a, chi tampitak leng ataihilh ding; atemsaute uh leilehna mukzum ding in asek ding uh; namdang in namdang tung ah namsau alikta kei ding a, kidoudan leng asin kei ding uhi.
Jakob inkuanpihte aw, hong pai un TOUPA vak ah i khosa ding uh.
Suahlam a kipan dan hong pawtta a, ana dim ua, Philistiate bang a aisan siamte ahih ua, gamdang mite tate toh khut akilet ziak un, na mi, Jakob inkuanpihte na paisanta hi.
Agam uh dangka leh dangka-eng in adim a, asumte uh lah sim seng vual ahi kei; agam uh sakol in adim a, akangtalaite uh lah sim seng vual ahi kei hi.
Agam uh milim in adim a; akhut ua asepkhiak uh, akhutzungte ua abawl uh, abesek uhi.
Mineute hihniam in a-om ua, miliante leng niamsak in a-om uh; huaiziak in amau ngaidam ke'n.
TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan suangpi ah lut unla, leivui ah kibu un.
Mihing kideihnate hihniam in a-om ding a, mite kisaktheihna niamsak in a-om ding, huai ni in TOUPA kia tawisan in a-om ding hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA ni lah kingaisang leh kisathei tengteng tung ah leh tawisang a om tengteng tung a om ding ahi ngal a; huchi in niamsak in a-om ding uh.
Lebanon tang a sidar sing sang pipite leh tawisang a om tengteng tung ah, Bashan gam a tosaw tengteng tung ah,
tang lian sang pipite tung ah, tang neu tawisang a om tengteng tung ah,
insang sang pipite tung ah, kulhbaang tengteng tung ah,
Tarshish long lian tengteng tung ah, thil lim deihhuai tengteng tung ah leng ahong om ding hi.
Mihing kideihnate hihniam in a-om ding a, mite kisaktheihna niamsak in a-om ding. Huai ni in TOUPA kia tawisang in a-om ding.
Milimte amang vengveng ding hi.
Huan lei nak pipi a lingsak ding a athoh hun chiang in, TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan in mite suangpi hawmte leh lei kohawmte ah alut ding uhi.
Huai ni in mite'n adangka milimte uleh adangka-eng milimte uh, biak ding a abawlsak uh, buite leh bakte kiang ah apai ding uh.
Lei nak pipi a lingsak ding a athoh hun chiang in, TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan in, suangpi hawmte leh kawl suangpi hawmte ah alut ding uhi.
Anak vang ua hu om mihing muan tawpsanta un; bang lam ah ahia muantak ahih mahmah uh?
Assuria kumpipa Sargon sawl Tartan Ashdod ah ahong a, Ashdod khua asual a, alak kum in;
TOUPA'N Amoz tapa Isai kam in, "Kuan inla, na kawng a sai-ip puan phel inla, na khe a na khedap koih in," chi in agen hi. Huchi in huchibang in ahih a, vuaktang leh khevuak in apaipai hi.
Huan TOUPA'N, "Ka sikha Isai Aiguptate tung ah leh Ethiopiate tung ah chiamtehna leh thillamdang ding a kum thum sung vuaktang leh khevuak a apai bang in,
Assuria kumpipa'n Aigupta matte leh Ethiopia salte, aneu leh alian in, vuaktang leh khevuak in leh taw dawk in Aiguptate zahlakna ding in apimang ding.
Huchi in alamet pen uh Ethiopiate leh athupina pen uh Aiguptate ziak in mangbangtak leh zahlaktak in a-omta ding uhi.

Huchi in huai ni chiang in hiai tuipi gei a mi in, 'Ngai in, i lamet pen, Assuria kumpipa lak a hon humbit ding a, ahon panpihpa ding a i taina uh lah hichi ahita a, eite bangchi in i suakta ding ua? achi ding uh," " achi hi.
Tuipi gamdai puakgik. Sim gam a pingpei apaisuak bang in gamdai a kipan in, gam lauhuaipi a kipan in ahong hi.
Kilakna thu khauhtak ka kiang ah theihsak ahita; lepchiahtak a hihmi in lepchiahtak in ahih a, lokmi in alok hi. Elamte aw, paitou un, Mediate aw, umbichilh un; athumna tengteng uh ka daisakta hi.
Huaiziak in ka kawng natna thupitak in adim a, numei nauvei natna bang a natna in ahon manta; bil a za thei lou khop in na ka thuak a; kho mu thei lou khop in ka mangbang hi.
Ka lungtang aha huaihuai a, thil mulkimhuaitak in ahon hihlau a; nitak ninem ka na ngaklah sek, kei a ding in linna ahong suakta.
Dohkan abawlkhol ua, galvengmi avengsak ua, ne in adawn ua; miliante aw, thou unla, lum sathau nuh un.
Toupa'n ka kiang ah huchi in agen hi, "Kuan inla, galvengmi vengsak in, ama'n athil muh gen hen;
Sepaih apawlte, sakol tungtuang akopkop a paite sabiltung pawlte, sangawngsau pawlte, amuh chiang in pilvangtak in angaikhe kilkel ding," chi in.
Huan amah humpinelkai bang in akikou a, "TOUPA aw, sun in galven buk tung ah ka dingh a, zankhua in ka venna ah na hon omsak gige a;
ngai in, hiai lai ah mihing pawl, sakol tungtuang akopkop a pai ahong uh," chi in. Amah mah in, "Babilon apukta, apukta, amilim bawltawmte tengteng uh lei ah hihzan in a-omta," chi in adawng hi.
Aw ka buh vuaksa, ka phual a buh; sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian a kipan a ka zak na kiang ua pulak ka hi.
Dumah puakgik. Mi'n Seir tang a kipan in ahon sam ua, "Galvengpa zan bangchi ahita a? Galvengpa, zan bangchi ahita a?" chi in.
Galvengpa'n, "Zingsang hi ding ahita, zan leng; na dot nop uleh dong un; kihei nawn unla, hong pai un,” achi hi.
Arabia gam tung a puakgik. Dedante khualzin pawlchihte aw, Arabia gam a gamnuai ah na giak ding uh.
Dangtak kiang ah tui ahon tawi ding ua, Tema gam a omte'n a-an un taimangte ana dawn uhi.
Amau lah namsaute a kipan, namsau dohsa a kipan leh thalpeu laisa a kipan leh kidouna thupitak a kipan ataimang uhi.
Toupa'n lah huchi in ka kiang ah achi ngal a, "Kilohmi kum sim a kum khat sung in Kedarte thupina tengteng amang khin ding hi.
Thalkapmi, Kedar suante lak a mihattak omsunte, tawmchik ahi ding uh; TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, huai agenta hi," chi in.
Mengmuhna Phaizang puakgik Bang na chi ua amai, intung a na kaltouh vek uh?
Aw kikou husa a dim, khopi chiak vengvung, kho kipaktak, na sung a athahte uh namsau a thah ahi kei ua, kidouna a si leng ahi sam kei uh.
Na vaihawmmi tengteng ataimang chiat ua, thalkap mite gak in a-om ua, gamlapi a kipan a hong taimangte.
Huaiziak in ke'n, "Hon en lou in lehlam en un, nakpi in ka kap ding; ka mite tanu gallak a alak thu uah hon nem vanglak dah un," ka chi hi.
Toupa, sepaihte' PATHIAN a kipan in mengmuhna phaizang ah buaina, sikdenna leh mangbatna ni lah ahi ngal a; kulhpi baang hihsiatna leh tangte sapna.
Huchi in Elamte'n thalbawm atawi ua, mihing tuanna kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite toh; Kir in lum alakhia hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, na phaizang hoihpente lah kangtalai in adimta a, sakol tungtuang mite lah kulh kongkhak bul ah akiphu noinoi uh. Huan Judahte khuhna alamang hi.
Judahte khuhna alamangta. Huchi in huai ni in gammang inn a galthuamna lam na enta uhi.
David khopi kulhpi siatnate leng na en ua, atam chih na thei uh; huchi in dil khangnungzaw tuite na luangkhawmsak uhi.
Jerusalem innte na sim ua, kulhpi bang bawlhoihna ding in innte na phel uhi.
Dil luitui omna ding in kulhpi nih kikal ah tui chinkhawmna na bawl ua; himahleh huai hihmi lam na en kei ua, nidanglai a ana bawlpa na limsak het kei uhi.
Huai ni in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, kap ding leh awm kitum ding leh lu giausak ding leh sai-ip puan teng ding in asam a;
himahleh, ngai in, nopna leh kipahnate, bawng thahna leh belam thahnate, sa nekna leh uain dawnnate a-om zawta a, ne ni, dawn ni, zingchiang a si ding i hi ngal ua, achi uhi.
Huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA tuh ka bil ah akilak a, "Pel lou in hiai khelhna na sih masiah uh na lak uah silsiang ahita kei ding, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, hichi in achi, "Kuan inla, hiai sumkempa kiang ah, Shebna, inn tung a heutu a om kiang ngeingei ah, hoh in.
Akiang ah huchi in gen in: Hiai a bang hih na hia? Hiai ah kua na nei a, hiai a han na khuak vial? Amah a ding in sangpi a ahan akhuak a, amah a dia suangpi a omna abawl vial!
Ngai in, TOUPA'N nang apaih in ahon pai ek ding, mihat in apaih bang in; ahi, atun in nang ahon tun ding hi.
Pel lou in ama'n nang lum bang in ahon pei ding a, gam zapi ah ahon vawklut ding a; huai ah na si ding a, huai lai mah ah, nang, na pu insung zahlaksakpa, na thupina kangtalaite a-om ding hi.
Na nasepna a kipan ka hon delhkhe ding a, ama'n heutu na hihna a kipan ahon kaikhesuk ding hi.
"Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, ka sikha Eliakim, Hilkiah tapa ka sam ding a; amah na puanaktual ka silhsak ding a,
na kawnggak in ka hihhat ding a na vaihawmna amah khut ah ka kemsak ding. Huchi in Jerusalem a omte a ding in leh Judah inkuanpihte a ding in pa ahi ding.
Huan David inkuanpihte chabi aliangzang ah ka koih ding a; ama'n ahong ding a, kuamah in akhak kei ding uh; akhak ding a kuamah in ahong kei ding uh.
Amah kilhna mun kiptak a akilh ngiungeu bang un, ka hihkip ngiungeu ding a; huchi in amah apa inkuanpihte a ding in laltutphah thupi mahmah ahi ding hi.
"Amah ah apa inkuanpihte thupina tengteng abang vek ding ua, atate leh asuante, tui-um belsuan neu chiteng, belhbu tui-um belsuan a kipan tui koihna tui-um belsuan tengteng tan in.

Huai ni in kilhna, mun kiptak a kilh ngiungeu a om in anangzou kei ding a; satkhiak a om in, aketa ding a, atung a thil gik om lah hihmanthat in a-omta ding a; TOUPA'N huai lah agenta ngal a, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
Tura kho puakgik. Tarshish longpite aw, mau tuaituai un; innte om lou khop leh lutna ding om lou khop a hihsiat in a-omta hi; huai lah Kittim gam a kipan in akiang uah hihlat in a-om hi.
Tuikulh a omte aw, dai sipsip un; Sidon kho sumsin tuipi a paite'n ahon kiningchinsak uh.
Shihor a pan buhchi tuipite tung ah hon pua a, Nile lui a buh, apunna hi a, namte sumsinna mun ahi hi.
Sidon aw, zum in; tuipi kulhpi in thu agenta ngal a, "Nau ka vei ngei kei a, ka nei ngei sam kei, tangval lah ka vak ngei sam kei a, nungak leng ka khangliansak ngei sam kei hi,” chi in.
Thuthang Aigupta gam atun hun chiang in Tura thuthang anak vei mahmah ding uhi.
Tarshish ah va hoh unla; Tuikulh a omte aw, mau tuaituai un.
Hiai maw na kho kipak uh, upat a upa, akhe in gamlapi a om ding a api sek?
Lallukhu khusaktu khua Tura tung ah kua'n ahia hiai tung ding a sep? Huai lai a sumsin mite lah miliante ahi ua, huai lai a sumsin mite lah lei a mizahtakhuaite ahi uhi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, thupina tengteng kisaktheihna nawngkaisak ding leh lei a mizahtakhuai tengteng muhsithuai a omsak ding in asep hi.
Tarshish tanu aw, Nile lui bang in na gam ah luanglet in; na kawnggakna himhim lah a-omta kei hi.
Tuipi tung ah akhut azak a, gamte alingsak a; TOUPA'N Kanaan gam tungtang ah thu apia a, akulhte hihse ding in.
Ama'n, "Sidon tanu nungak aw, mi nuaisiah, nuam na sa nawn kei ding; thou inla, Kittim gam ah galkah in; huai ah leng khawlna himhim na mu tuan kei ding hi," achi hi.
En in, Kaldaite gam; hiai mite a-omta kei uh; Assuria mi in gamdai a gamsate a ding in asepta hi; a-insangte uh alam ua, huai a inpite ahihmang ua, inn sia in abawlta.
Tarshish longpite aw, mau tuaituai un; na kulhte uh hihsiat in a-omta hi.
Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Tura khua, kumpipa khat kum sim a, kum sawmsagih sung mangngilh in a-om ding; kum sawmsagih abei nung in kizuak la a agen bang un Tura kho tung ah ahong tung ding.
Nang kizuak mite mangngilhsa nung, kaihging la inla, kho kim ah vak in, kaihging kai inla, theih a na om nawn theihna ding in la tampi sa in.
Huan kum sawmsagih abei nung in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N Tura apha ding a, huchi in huai minu aloh delh in a-om nawn ding a, leitung a khovel lalgam tengteng lak ah kizuak in a-om ding.

Asum muhkhiak leh aloh TOUPA a ding in siangthou ahi ding; huai lah kholkhawm in hiam, koihkhawm in hiam a-om kei ding a, asum muhkhiak TOUPA ma a omte a ding in ahi ding a, niang-le-tai a anek ding uleh, puansilh thupitak aneihtheihna ding uh ahi.
Ngai in, TOUPA' lei a-awngsak in asesak ding a, alumlet ding a, a-omte adalhsak ding hi.

Huan vantang tung a om bang in siampu tung ah leng a-om ding; sikhapa tung a om bang in apu tung ah leng a-om ding; sikhanu tung a om bang in api tung ah leng a-om ding; aleimi tung a om bang in, akhawngmi tung ah leng a-om ding; leitawisakmi tung a om bang in, leitawimi tung ah leng a-om ding; apung delh a leitawisakmi tung a om bang in, akiang a apung pemi tung ah leng a-om ding.
Leitung awnsak keuhkeuh in leh hihsiat dimdem in a-om ding; TOUPA'N achita hi.
Leitung akap in atul a, khovel abah in atul a, leitung a mi tungnungte abah uhi.
A-om mite nuai ah leitung abuah khinta; dante ah atalek ua, thupiakte hihlamdang a, tangtawn thukhun a atatlek ziak un.
Huaiziak in hamsiat in leitung ane khin a, a-om mite lah siam louh tansak in a-omta uh; huaiziak in lei a om mite lah akanglum ua, mi tawmchik kia a-om lai uh.
Uain thak akap a, grepgui abah a, lungtang nuamte tengteng amau uhi.
Khuangtate kipahna adai a, kaihging nuamsa ging adaita.
Lasa kawm in uain adawn kei ding uh; adawn mite a ding in zu akha mahmah ding.
Buaina khopi chipsak in a-omta; kuamah alutlouhna ding un inn chih khak in a-omta.
Uain ziak in kongzingte ah kah husa a-om a; nopna tengteng mialsak in a-om a, hiai gam nopna amangta.
Khopi ah siatna nutsiat in a-om a, akulh kongkhak vuaksiat in a-omta.
Lei laitak ah michih lak ah huchi in a-om ding hi, olive sing vuak nung a gah a-om lai bang in leh grep loh nung a maih khak grep loh ding a-om lai bang in.
Huaite'n a-aw uh asuah ding ua, akikou ding uh; TOUPA thupina ziak in tuipi a kipan in ngaihtak in akikou ding uh.
Huaiziak in TOUPA tuh Suahlam ah pahtawi un. TOUPA, Israel' Pathian min mahmah, tuipi tuikulh gamte ah pahtawi un.

Kawlmong tawp a lasak i za, Midiktatte kiang ah thupina om hen, chih la. Himahleh, ke'n bel, "Ka gawng huaihuai a, ka gawng huaihuai a, ka tung agik hi! Lepchiahtak a gamta mite'n lepchiahtak in thil ahih ua; ahi, lepchiahtak a gamta mite'n lepchiahtak in ahih uhi, ka chi hi.
Leitung a tengte aw, lauhuainate, kokhukte, thangte na tung ah a-om hi.

Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, lauhuai husa a kipan a taipa kokhuk ah ake ding a; kokhuk sung a kipan a pawtkhetoumi thang ah a-awk ding; tunglam a tohlette lah hon in a-om ngal a, lei kingaknate aling hi.
Leitung akitamgawp vek a, leitung hihman in a-om vek a, nakpitak in leitung aling hi.
Mi zukham bang in leitung ahoi dongdong ding a, biakbuk hawt bang in akihot ding; atatlekna lah atung ah giktak in a-om ding a, huchi in apuk ding a, athounawnta kei ding hi.
"Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N tunglam a mi tungnung pawl lian pipite a gawt ding, leitung a leitung kumpipate toh.
Hentate kokhuk a pikhawm a a-om bang un huaite pikhawm in a-om ding ua, suangkul a khum in a-om ding uh, ni sawttak nung in gawt in a-om ding uh.
Huai hun chiang in tung a khapi zumtak in a-om ding a, tung a nisa zahlaktak in a-om ding; sepaihte TOUPA lah Zion tang leh Jerusalem ah leh a-upate ma ah, thupitak a kumpi a om ding ahi ngal a."
TOUPA aw, nang ka Pathian na hi a; ka hon pahtawi ding, na min ka phat ding; thillamdangtak, nidanglai a vaihawmte, ginomtak leh thutak in na hih ngal a.
Khopite leivum in na suaksak a; akulhte uh leng na hihsia hi; gamdang mite kumpipa' inn leng khopi hi nawn lou in na bawl ngal a; chikchiang mah a lam in a-om nawnta kei ding.
Huaiziak in mihat mahmahte'n ahon pahtawi ding ua, nam kihtakhuai mahmah khopi in ahon kihta ding uhi.
Mikihtakhuaite hu huihpi in baang asawn ok-ok lai bang a ahong om chiang in, nang zaw migenthei a ding in bukna, tagah mangbang lai a ding in bukna, huihpi lak a kihumbitna, nisa liahna na hi ngal a.
Mun keu a kholum na daihsak zel bang in, gamdang mite husa na daisak hi; kholum meiliah a daihsak a a-om bang in, milauhuaite thawm daihsak ahi ding.
Huan hiai tang ah sepaihte' TOUPA'N michih a ding in thil thaute, uain todat toh kidiah, thil thau mahmah guhngek a dim, uain todat toh kidiah hoihtak a khitsiang in ankuang alui ding hi.
