Huan khuhna mi tengteng tung a khiak, puanzak nam chih tung a kizak, hiai tang ah ahihse ding hi.
Sihna avalh denta, Toupa PATHIAN in mi tengteng mai a kipan khitui anulsiang ding a; amite minsiatna lah leitung luah tengteng a kipan in alamang ding; TOUPA'N huai achita hi.
Huai ni in, “Ngai un, hiai i Pathian ahi; amah i ngakngak ua, huchi in ahon hondam ding; hiai TOUPA ahi; amah i ngakngak ua; ahotdamna ah i kipak in i nuam ding uh," achi ding uhi.
Hiai tang ah TOUPA khut a kinga ding a, Moab, buhpawl ek kua a sikden a a-om sek bang in, amah mun ah sikden a om ding ahi ngal a.
Huchi in tuiliaumi in liau ding a tui akhuat bang in, huai lak ah akhut azakkhe ding a; akisaktheihna lah akhut lepchiahna toh in TOUPA'N akoihniam ding.
Huan na kulhbaangte insang kulhpi hihchim in, akoihniam a, lei ah leivui pha hial in apuksakta hi.
Huai ni chiang in Judahte gam ah hiai la asa ding uh. Khopi kiptak i nei ua; ama'n hotdamna kulhbaangte leh kulhpite a ding in asep ding hi.
Nam diktat thutak zui nam a luttheihna ding in kulh kongkhakte hong un.
Na tung a lungsim ngami, nangmah ahon muan ziak in, muanna kim in na kem ding.
TOUPA tangtawn in muang un; TOUPA, Jehovah ah lah tangtawn suangpi a-om ngal a.
Ama'n sangpi a omte ahihniam a khopi sangpi mah; akoihniam a, lei pha in akoihniam a, leivui pha hial in apuksak hi.
Khe in asikden ding; gentheite khe leh tagahte kalsuan in.
Midiktat lampi lah dikna ahi a; nang lungtang diktat pu in midiktat lampi na hihmam sek a.
Ahi, TOUPA aw, na vaihawmna lampi ah ka hon ngak uhi; kou hinna deih zaw na min loh leh nangmah theihgigena ahi.
Zan chiang in ka hinna in nangmah ahon ngai a; ahi, zingkhang in ka sung a ka kha om in ka hon zong ding hi; na vaihawmnate leitung a ahong om chiang in khovel a omte'n diktatna lah asin zel ngal ua.
Mithulim lou deihsak in om mahleh, diktatna asin tuan sam kei ding; dikna gam ah dikloutak in ahih ding hi. TOUPA thupina amu tuan kei ding.
TOUPA, na khut zak in a-om a, himahleh amau amu tuan kei ua; himahleh mite a dia na phatuamngaihna amu ding ua, azum ding uh; ahi, nang hon doute mei in akangmang ding hi.
TOUPA nang lemna na hon sehsak ding; nang ka nasep tengteng uh na hon sepsak hi.
TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, nang kia hilou in kumpipa dangte'n leng ka tung uah thu anei khinta ua, himahleh na min kia ka louta ding uh.
Amau lah asita uh a, ahing nawn kei ding uh; amangta ua, athounawn kei ding uh; huaiziak in nang amaute gawt in na hihsia a, atheihgigena teng uh leng na hihmangta hi.
Hiai nam na pungsakta a, TOUPA aw, hiai nam na pungsak a; nang pahtawi in na omta; hiai gam a gamgite na hihlian hi.
TOUPA, adah lai un ahon zong ua, amau na thunun chiang in athum zel uhi.
Numei naupai, neih hun naita bang in; TOUPA aw, kou na ma ah ka om uhi.
Nau ka pai ua, ka na ua, huih bang lel ka nei uh; lei ah lah tatkhiakna lam himhim ka ngah kei ua; khovel a omte lah apuk sam kei uhi.
Na misite ahing nawn ding ua; ka misi luang toh athounawn ding uh. Leivui a omte aw, halh unla, nuamtak in la sa un; na daituite khovak daitui bang ahi a, lei in misite apaikhe ding hi, chih.
Kisa un, ka mite aw, na dantan sungte ah lut unla, na kongkhakte uh kikhakkhum un; lung hihlouhna aven masiah sawt lou sung kibu un.
Ngai un, TOUPA, agitlouhna ziak ua lei a omte gawt ding in a-omna a kipan ahong pawtkhe ding a; lei mah in asisan ahihlang dia, ami athahte uh akhuhta kei ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in TOUPA'N, anamsau hoihtak a hiam, lianpi, muanhuaitak in, leviathan gulpi hattak leh leviathan gulpi kivial ngeingoi agawt ding a, tuipi a dragon om leng athat ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in, uain grephuan khat, huai pahtawi in la sa un.
Kei TOUPA lah avengpa ka hi a; mitphiat kal teng in tui ka buak ding a, kuamah in akhoihlouhna ding un sun leh zan in ka veng ding.
Kei ah hehna a-om kei hi; loulingnei leh khaulingneite'n hon dou in hon sual le u aw! Amau sual ding in ka kuan ding a, mun khat ah ka halkhawm ding hi.
Ahihkeileh, hon kileppihna ding in ka hatna len hen; ahi, hon kileppih hen.
Hun hong tung ding ah Jakobte'n zung akha ding ua; Israelte'n zung akha ding ua; Israelte apakmum un apakpalh ding uh; huchi in leitung gah in adimsak ding uhi.
Amah vote avuak bang in amah avo sam a hia? Ahihkeileh, amah thatte thahna bang in amah thah in a-om a hia?
Amah na paimangsak lai in ahun lel in amah na sel a; suahlam huih nun ni in ahu thupitak in amah amutlengta hi.

Huaiziak in hiai in Jakobte thulimlouhna silsiang ahi ding a, hiai akhelhna uh paimangpihna gah ngen ahi; Asherim hiam, gimlim maitamte hiam ding nawn lou ding khop in maitam suang tengteng suangpak den khap bang in abawl uhi.
Khua kulhpi nei lah alungzuang a, omna nutsiat leh paisan, gamdai bang ahi; huai ah bawngnou ata ding a, huai lai mah ah akual ding a, aselte ane ding.

Ahiangte lah avuai chiang un khiah in a-om ding a; numeite ahong pai ding ua ahal ding uh; amau lah theihtheihna himhim neiloumi ahi ngal ua; huaiziak in amaute bawlpa'n atung uah zahngaihna anei kei ding a, amaute sutuahpa'n amaute deihsakna himhim anei kei ding hi.
Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N, Euphrates Luipi akuang dim a luang zoizoi a kipan in, Aigupta luita pha in, agah asatkhe ding a, huchi in Israel suante aw, khatkhat a pikhawm in na om ding uhi.
Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, pengkul lianpi amut ding ua; Assuria gam a mangthang dekdekte leh Aigupta gam a delhkhiak a omte ahong pai ding ua; Jerusalem a tang siangthou ah TOUPA abe ding uhi.
Ephraimte azukhamhatte kisaktheihna lallukhu tung leh akilawmna uh thupi pak vul lel laitak, uain thazoh a omte phaizang hausatak lutang tung a omte atung uh agik hi!
Ngai in, TOUPA'N mihat thilhihtheitak anei a; ama'n, gial thupitak ke phuakphuak, huihpi thilhihse lemlum bang leh tui lian thupi let zuazua bang mai in, lei ah apai ek ding.
Ephraimte zukhamhatte kisaktheihna lallukhu lah sikden in a-om ding a;
akilawmna uh thupi pak vul laitak, phaizang hausatak lutang tung a om, nipi ma a theipi min masapen, a-enmi in amuh a, akhut a a-omtak a anek khit sek bang ahi ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in sepaihte' TOUPA tuh, thupina lallukhu leh kilawmna lukhute, amikhosuaksunte a ding in ahi ding;
Vaihawm dia tu a ding in vaihawmna khate, kulh kongkhak bul a hon sualte nangkik mite a ding in hatna ahi ding.

Himahleh huaite leng uain ziak in akipekpek ua, zu ziak in ahoihoi ua; siampute leh zawlneite leng zu ziak in akipekpek ua, uain valh khit in a-om ua, zu ziak in ahoihoi ua; kilakna thute ah akipekpek ua, vaihawmna thu ah ahoihoi uhi.
Mun siang mahmah om lou khop in dohkan tengteng lah luak leh thilnin in adim hi.
Ama'n theihna lam a kua ahia asinsak ding? Thukhah leng ama'n kua ahia atheihsak sin laitei? Nawinek tawptungte leh nawi neksak nawnlouhte ahi ding uam?
Thuhilhna tung a thuhilhna, thuhilhna tung a thuhilhna chiantouh; dan tung a dan, dan tung a dan chiantouh; hiai ah tawmchik, huai ah tawmchik chih ngenta ahih ziak in.
Ahi, muk lamdang pumi zang in, pau tuam in hiai mite kiang ah thu agen zawta ding.
Hiai lah khawlna ahi a, atawlte khawlsak un; hiai lah kihihhalhna ahi, achihte; himahleh amau angaikhe nuam kei ua.

Huaiziak in apai ua, athal a apuk ua, akitapgawp ua, thang a a-awk ua, mat a a-omtheihna ding un, TOUPA thu amaute a ding in, thuzohna thu tung a thuzohna thu chiantouh, thuzohna thu tung a thuzohna thu chiantouh, dan tung a dan chiantouh; dan tung a dan chiantouh; hiai ah tawmchik huai ah tawmchik chih ngen a ahi mai ding hi.
Huaiziak in mi muhsithatte aw, hiai mite, Jerusalem a omte, vai hawmsakte aw, TOUPA thu za un.

Sihna toh thu i khungta, Sheol ah thu i kichiamta; vuakna tui lian a luansuak hun chiang in lei pha in zaw aluang kei ding; zuauthute i kihumbitna ding in i zang ua, zuau nuai ah lah i buta ngal ua, na chih ziak un.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ding, "Ngai in, suang, suang ettelsa, akil a suang manphatak phumkip mahmah, Zion ah suangphum ding in ka lem hi; agingtami zaw akin kei ding.
"Vaihawmna diktat a tansakna khau ding in ka zang ding a, diktatna lah a-ulum khai ding in ka zang ding a, gial in kihumbitna zuauthute aphiatmang vek ding a, tuite'n lah bukna atum ding.
Huan sihna toh na thukhun uh akiphel ding a, Sheol toh na chiam uh leng apiching kei ding, vuakna tui lian aluansuak hun chiang in. Huai hun chiang in sikden in na om ding uhi.
Aluansuak peuhmah chiang in nou ahon la zel dia; zingsang teng, sun leh zan in, aluangsuak ding a; thukhah omdan theihsiam lah thil mulkimhuai ngen ahi ding," chi in.
Lupna lah khekhuanna ding in atom lo zen a, puanthuah lah lukhuhna ding in aneu lua hi.
Anasep, anasep lamdang aseptheihna ding leh athilhih, athilhih lamdang azuihtheihna ding in, TOUPA Perazim tang a athou bang in athou sin ngal a, Gibeon Phaizang a aheh bang in aheh sin hi.

Huchi in mi muhsit chingte hi nawn kei un, huchi lou in zaw na kolbutte uh muanhuaitak in abawl kha ding uh; tawpna, tawpna tung ngei ding a seh, leitung pumpi tung a atunsak ding. Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA a kipan in ka za hi.
Bildoh unla, ka aw za un; ngaikhia unla, ka thugen za un.
Leilet mi in chi thehna ding in lei tatlak lou in alet ngei ahia? Aleikhalte tatlak lou in akhenkham in ahihzan ngei a hia?
Atung a tohtam khit in mohurite athehdalh kei a hia? Zirate leng atheh kei a hia? Buhte avual in, huit buhte leng amun sehsa ah, vaibuhte leng anawlzul ah atuh sek kei a hia?
A Pathian in lah amah diktak in athuzoh in asinsak ngal a.
Mohuri lah buhchilna khawl in achil ngei ngal kei ua, zira tung ah leng kangtalai khe atuksak ngei kei uh; mohuri zaw chiang in akhen ua, zira leng khetbuk in akhen zaw sek uhi.
Tanghou bawlna buh gawizan in a-om a, ama'n tangtawn in avo kei ding a, akangtalai khe leh asakolte'n dalhsak mahleh, agawizansak ngei kei hi.
Huaite leng sepaihte' TOUPA, lemtheihna a mi lamdang mahmah leh pilna a mihoih mahmah a kipan a pawt ahi.
Ariel, Ariel, David puanin kaihna mun! Kum ah kum gawm inla; ankuangluinate hong tung nawn hen.
Huai hun chiang in Ariel ka lungzingsak ding a, huchi in suunna leh kahna a-om ding; huan amah kei a ding in Ariel bang ahi ding.
Huan nangmah sual tum in na kim ah ka hon giahkhum ding a, nangmah sual ding in umsuakna insangte ka bawl ding.

Huchi in puksak in na om ding a, lei nuai a kipan in thu na gen ding a, na aw lah leivui lak ah awlawl in agingkhe ding; na aw dawi aisan siam zawl aw bang in lei nuai a kipan in apawt ding hi, na pau leivui lak a kipan in ahong pawt siausiau ding hi.
Himahleh nang hon dou mipite zaw leivui nel mahmah bang in a-om ding uh, mikihtakhuai mipite leng buhsi mangthang sekte bang in a-om ding uh; ahi, huai mitphiat kal lou in ahong om guih ding hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N van-gingte, zinlingte, ging thupi mahmahte, pingpeite, huihpite, leh hulmang thei mei in ahong veh ding hi.
Huchi in Ariel dou nam tengteng mipite, amah leh a-insang sualmi tengteng leh amah hihlungzingte tengteng, ihmu mang bang lel ahi ding uh, zan a kilakna bang lel.
Mi gilkial in mang aneih in an ane a, himahleh akhanglou a abah lai in tui aduh lai bang ahi ding hi; Zion tang sual, nam chih leh mipite, huai bang ahi ding uhi.
Dingh kinken unla, lamdang sa un, kituam unla, mittaw in om un; akham ua, himahleh uain ziak ahi kei; ahoihoi ua, himahleh zu ziak ahi kei.
TOUPA'N ihmut limna kha na tung uah asungbua a, zawlneite na mit uh amitsisak a, na lu uh, mutheite, akhuhta ngal a.
Huchi in kilakna himhim nou a ding in laibu bilhkhum bikbek bang ahita, mite'n laisiammi kiang ah, hehpih in huai sim in, chi in apia ua, ama'n, ka sim thei kei, bilhkhum bikbek ahi, achi a;
Huan laibu tuh laisiamloumi kiang ah, "Hehpih in hiai sim in, chi in apia ua, ama'n, laisiam ka hi kei," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA, “Hiai mite'n ahong naih ua, akam un leh amuk un ahon pahtawi ua, himahleh alungtang uh kei a kipan in agamla a, ahon launa uleh mihingte thupiak min asinsak lel uh ahi.
Hiai mite lak ah thillamdang ka hihbehlap ding, thillamdang, thillamdang mahmah; huchi in amipilte uh pilna amang ding a, ami teite uh teina sel in a-om ding," achi hi.
Athusawm uh TOUPA lak a sel ding a thuktak zong mite tung agik hi! Athilhihte uh lah mial nuai ah a-om a, kua'n ahon mu dia? Kua'n ahon thei dia? achi uhi.

Thilte na lumlet vek uh! Belvelpa bellei bang lel a seh in a-om sin a hia? Thil bawl in abawlpa tung ah, ama hon bawl ka hi sam a, achih? Ahihkeileh, thil suktuah a om in asutuahpa tungthu ah, theihna himhim anei kei, achih?
Sawt louchik nung in ahi ka hia, Lebanon lei hoihtak mun a suahsak in a-om sin a, lei hoihtak mun lah gammang a seh a a-om sin?
Huai ni in nangongte'n laibu thute abil un aza ding ua, mittawte'n mial nuai leh mial lak a kipan in amu ding uhi.
Thunuailutte'n leng TOUPA ah anopna uh akhangsakta ding ua, mihingte lak a gentheite Israelte Mi Siangthou ah akipakta ding uh.
Milauhuai bangmah lou a bawl ahita a, misimmoh hat adaita, thulimlouhna ngaklah tengteng hihmanthat in a-omta uhi.
Huaite'n thu in mite thil hihkhial in abawl ua, kulh kongpi ah taihilhmi awkna ding in thang akam ua, midiktat bangmah lou in anawlkhin uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA, Abraham tan pen, Jakob inkote tungthu ah hichi in achi: Jakobte zaw tu in azahlakta kei ding ua, amai uh amual nawn sam kei ding.
Ata uh, ka khutsuakte, alak ua amuh un, ka min asiangthousak zawta ding uh; ahi, Jakobte Mi Siangthou asiangthousak ding ua, Israel' Pathian lah akihta ding uhi.
Kha a vakmangte'n leng ahon theisiamta ding ua miphunhatte'n sinsak thu asinta ding uhi.
Ngai dih ua, Toupa Sepaihte’ PATHIAN in Jerusalem a kipan leh Judah a kipan amuanpi uleh achiang uh, amuanpi uh an tengteng leh amuanpi uh tui tengteng, alaksak hi.
Mihat leh kidousiamte toh; vaihawmmi leh zawlnei leh aisan siam leh upate toh;
sawmnga heutu leh mizahtakhuai leh lemthei mi leh khutsiam leh thugensiamte toh.
Huchi in amiliante uh hi ding in naupangte ka pe ding a, naungekte'n atung uah vai ahawm ding uh.

Huchi in mite nuaisiah in a-om ding ua, michih kinuaisiah in a-om ding uh, michih amau invengte toh kinuaisiah in a-om ding uh; naupang upa tung ah kisatheitak in a-om ding ua, mithulimloupi nangawn mizahtakhuai tung ah kisatheitak in a-om ding.
Mi'n apa inn a-unau len in, "Nang silh-le-ten na nei a, ka vaihawmtu un om inla, hiai siatna na khut ah om heh," achih chiang in.
Huai chiang in amah apau khe ding a, "Kei zaw bawlhoihtu in ka om kei ding hi; ka inn ah nek ding a-om kei a, silh-le-ten leng a-om kei; mite vaihawmpa in na hon bawl kei ding," chi in.
Athupina mit vuisak ding a apau uleh athilhihte uh TOUPA dou lam ahih ziak in Jerusalem ase khin a, Judahte apuk khinta uhi.
Amel latdan in amau ahek tawm a; akhelhna uh Sodom bangtak in alangsak ua, a-iim kei uh. Atung uh agik e! Thil hoih lou in akithuk tawm ngal ua.
Midiktat thu ah ahoih ding uhi, chi un; athilhih gahte uh lah ane sin ngal ua.
Migiloute tung agik hi! Lah ase sin ngal ua; akhut ua thilhih thukna akiang ua piak ahih ding ziak in.
Ka mite zaw, amau nuaisiahtute naupangte ahita ua, numeite'n atung uah vai ahawmta uhi. Ka mite aw, nou hon pite'n ahon pikhial ua, na paina lamte ahihse sek uhi.
TOUPA genpih ding in ahong dingkhia a, mite vaihawm ding in ahong dinghta hi.
TOUPA'N a mi upate tung ah leh amau miliante tung ah vai ahawm ding: TOUPA Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Noute na hi uh grephuan negaite; na innte uah ahi mitagahte a kipan a sumlakte a-om;
bang achia ahia ka mite na at ua, tagahte mai na gawizan uh?" Toupa, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi hi.
Huai lou in TOUPA'N, "Zion tanute kisatheitak a a-om ua, dak vuauvuau leh mi en loplop in apai ua, apai un apai lohloh ua, akhete uh asuan ging thuapthuap ziak un.
Toupa'n Zion tanute luzang ah meima khem a-omsak ding a, TOUPA'N azahmohte uh leng adawksak ding," achi hi.
Huai ni chiang in Toupa'n akizepna hoihnate uh alaksak ding a, khebulhte, len lukhute, hakkolte;
bilbah kai ngiahngiahte, taute, kikhuhna puante;
lutang puante, khebulh khainiangte, kawng a tente, gimlim bawmte, kikaunate;
minsawnna zungbuhte, nakbulhte;
ankuangluina vante, puanaktualte, puansilhte, kawlzalte;
limlangte, puanmalngatte, dialte, kituamhoihna puante.
Thaunamtui sik in thilmuat a-om ding; kawnggak sik in khauzen a-om ding; sam mam sik in talkolh a-om ding; puan kilawmtak sik in sai-ip puan a-om ding; melhoih sik in meikang pawn a-om ding hi.
Namsau in na mite vatpaih ahi ding ua, na mihat mahmahte kidouna ah apuk ding uh.
Akulh kongkhakte ah awm kitum in akap ding ua; ahawm a nutsiat ahi ding ua, lei ah atu ding hi.
TOUPA'N, "Ta helhatte atung uh agik hi! Huaite'n mi adong ua, kei lah hon dong kei uh, akhelhna tung ua khelhna abehlapna ding un, khuhna in akhuh ua, ka kha thu in lah akhuh tuan kei uh.
Pharaoh hatna a kihatsak ding in leh Aigupta lim bel ding a ka kam dong tuan lou in Aigupta gam a paisuk tum in akuan uhi.
Huaiziak in Pharaoh hatna noute zahlakna ahita ding a, Aigupta lim na belh uh lah na maizumna uh ahita ding.
Amiliante lah Zoan ah a-om ua, apalaite Hanes khua atungta ngal uhi.
Amau a dia phattuamna himhim nei lou mi, huhna hilou, phattuamna neimi leng hilou, maizumna leh minsiatna hi zawte, avek un azumpih ding uh," achi hi.

Sim gam a sate puakgik, buaina leh lunglauna gam, humpinelkainu leh humpinelkaipa, guldekpak leh gul kuang lengthei pawtna, asum uh sabiltungnou tungte ah, agou uh sangawngsau nungvumte ah posak in, amau a dia phattuamna nei lou mite kiang a piak ding in, apaiton dapdap uhi.
Aigupta in lah phatuam loutak leh panna nei loutak in apanpih zel ngal a; huaiziak in ahi, amah, Rahab tu kinkennu, ka chih.
Tu in pai inla, huaite ama ua laigelhna pek ah gelh inla, laibu ah leng gelh in, tunung a tangtawn dong a ding ahihtheihna ding in.
Huaite lah mihelhatte, ta zuautheite, ta TOUPA dan ngaikhe nuamloute ahi ngal ua.
Mutheite kiang a, “Mu kei un," zawlneite kiang a, "Thil dikte hon hilhkhol kei un, thil nuam lam ka kiang uah gen un, khemna thu gen un, khemna thu genkhol un.
Lampi lou ah pai un, lamsik ah pial un, Israelte Mi Siangthou ka ma ua kipan hihmang un," chi ngitngette.
"Huaiziak in Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi, hiai thu na muhsit ziak un leh nuaisiahna leh phengphitna na muan ua, atung ua na kingak ziak un.
Hiai thulimlouhna noute a ding in suangbaang sangpi se lai, chim dekdek, puak eng ong, thakhat a mitphialkal lou a segawp ding bang ahi ding hi.
Huchi in belvelmi bel akitap gawpsak bang un, hawi om het lou a keknen in, athemnen lak ah belpei thuk a mei lakna ding hiam tuikhuk a tui dipna ding om lou khop in, akitam nensak ding," chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi, "Kik nawn a khawl in hotdam in na om ding ua; muangtak a omna ah leh ginna omna ah na hatna uh a-om ding, chi in; himahleh nou na ut kei uhi.

Hilou e, sakol tung a tuang in i tai zozot ding uh," na chi zosop ua, huaiziak in na tai zozot ngei ding uh. "Thil hattak tung ah i tuang ding, na chi ua; huaiziak in nou hon delh ding lah hattak ahi ding uh."
Mi khat phawn in sangkhat ataikek ding ua; mi nga phawn in na taikek ding uh; atawp in mualvum a puankhai khai bang leh tang tung a chiamtehna om bang a nutsiat in na om ding uhi.

Huaiziak in noute TOUPA'N ahon hehpih theihna ding in ahon ngak ding a, huaiziak in noute tung a zahngaihna asuahtheihna ding in pahtawi in a-om ding hi; TOUPA lah vaihawm diktatna Pathian ahi ngal a; amah ngakte tengteng in nuam asa uhi.
Mite Jerusalem a Zion ah om ding ahi ngal ua; na kap nawn kei ding uh; na kahna husa uah ama'n ahon hehpih mahmah ding a; azaktak in ahon dawng ding hi.
TOUPA lungkhamna tanghou leh haksatna tui hon pe mahleh, nou hon sinsak mite akibu nawn kei ding ua, na mit un nou hon sinsak mite amu zawta ding hi.
Huan taklam a na pial un hiam, veilam a na pial un hiam, na bil un na nunglam uah, "Hiai alampi ahi, hiai ah pai un," chi in thu azata ding hi.
Na dangka uh milim bawl dangka chi a zepna leh na dangka-eng uh, milim sun dangka-eng tui a luanna na buahsak ding ua; thilnin bang in na paita ding ua, akiang ah, "Paimang in!" na chi ding uh.

Huchi in ama'n na buhchi uh lei a na tuh ding uh a ding in vuahtui ape ding a; lei a thilpoute leng an ding in ape ding, huai lah hoihtak pungtak ahi ding; huai ni chiang in gantatna mun zapi ah na gantate uh ata ding ua,
bawngtal leh sabengtungnou lei lette'n an chisoh, ninluahna leh phazah a hihsiangsa ane ding uh.
Kithahna thupitak ni a galvenna singte achip ni in, tang sang teng ah leh mualvum sang teng ah luipite leh luite tui luang ahong om ding.
Huai lou leng TOUPA'N amite kihehna atuam a, aliamna ma uh adamsak ni chiang in, khavak nivak pha in a-omta ding a, nisa vak amun sagih in, ni sagih vakpha in a-omta ding hi.
Ngai in, TOUPA min, ahehna kuang zuazua in, meikhu sahtak a zamtou lak ah, gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai hi; amukte lung hihlouhna in adim a, alei thil katmang hat mei bang ahi.
Ahu lah, manna lohpi a namte sep ding in, lui ngawng chiang pha hial a akuang a let bang ahi; michih kam ah pikhelhsakna kaihgingna khau a-om ding.

Zan a zehtan siangthou a zeh atan lai ua la asak bang un, la asa ding ua; TOUPA tang a Israelte' Suangpi kiang tung ding a tamngai toh apai lai ua lungtang nopsakna anei bang un lungtang nopsakna leng anei ding uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N a-aw thupitak akizasakta ding a, ahehna thupitak leh thil katmang ching meikuang in, ahuihpi leh vuahpi leh gial in, akhut khakdan a-ensakta ding.
TOUPA aw ziak in Assuria mi, khetbuk a mi khen nakpa, kitapzansak a om ding ahi ngal a.
Amah lah chiangkhun sehsa a TOUPA'N azep peuhmah chiang in khuangtate leh kaihgingte toh azep ding a; achiang lik a kisualnate ah amau asual ding.

Tophet khat lah tuma a na bawlkholhsa ahi ngal a; ahi, kumpipa a ding in bawlzoh siang ahi a; thutak zatak in abawl a; athil sekkhawm mei leh sing tamtak ahi a; TOUPA hu, kat luiluang bang in, akangsak zuazua hi.

Aigupta gam a panpihna zong ding a hohsuk a, sakolte tung muang a, atam ziak ua kangtalaite leh ahat mahmah ziak ua sakol tungtuang mite muang a Israelte Mi Siangthou lam en lou a, TOUPA leng dongloute zaw atung uh agik hi!

Dong kei mah le uh amah leng piltak ahi, thil hoih lou ahon tungsak ding a, athute akhel nawn kei ding, thil hoih lou hih mite inkuan sual ding in athou zaw ding a, khialte panpihna dou ding in athou ding hi.
Aigupta mite zaw, Pathian ahi kei ua, mi leltak ahi uh; huchi in TOUPA'N akhut azak hun chiang in apanpihtu pen apai ekek ding a, apanpih pen leng apuk ding a, avek un amangthangkhawm ding uhi.

TOUPA'N lah huchi in ka kiang ah achi ngal a, "Humpinelkai leh humpinelkai lun lai in sa akham lai in belamchingmi tamtak amah sual ding in sapkhiak in om mah le uh, a-aw uh alau kei ding ua, abil ap ziak ua akihtak tuan louh ding bang in, sepaihte' TOUPA zaw Zion tang ah amual tung a sual ding in ahong paisuk ding hi."
Vasate abu tung ua alenlen bang un sepaihte' TOUPA'N Jerusalem aveng ding; veng in atankhe ding a, apaikan in ahumbit ding hi.
"Israel suante aw, nakpitak a na helsansa lam uh nga nawnta un.
Huai ni in michih in amau dangka milimte, amau dangka-eng milimte, khelhna ding a amau khut a na kibawltawmte uh lah apaimang ding ua.

Huai hun chiang in Assuria mi bel, mi namsau a puksak hilou in, namsau a puksak hilou in, namsau hihpuk in a-om ding a; namsau mite a hilou in, amah agai ding; huan, namsau lak a kipan ataimang ding a, atangvalte lah siahliaumi ahong hita ding uhi.
Huchi in asuangpi lah thil mulkimhuai ziak in amang ding a, amiliante lah chiamtehna ziak in abuaita ding, chỉ in TOUPA, ameikuang Zion a om leh, ahaltuina mei Jerusalem a om in," achi hi.
Ngai in, kumpipa khat diktattak in kumpipa in atu ding a, miliante'n vaihawmna diktak in vai ahawm ding uh.
Huchi in mi khat huihpi lak a bukna mun bang, vuahpi lak a bitna mun, mun keu a tui luangte bang, gam tultak a suangpi lianpi nuamsatak bang ahi ding hi.
Huchi in amute mit amial kei ding a, azate bil in angaikhe ding.
Mingongtatte lungtang in theihna thu atheisiam ding a, dang-awkte lei teltak in apau thei ding hi.
Migilou mithilphal achi nawnta kei ding uh, milepchiah misiam achi nawn kei ding uh.

Pathian zahlouhna thilhih ding leh TOUPA hekna dia thudiklou gen ding, gilkialte sung hawmsak ding leh dangtakte dawn ding hihmang ding in, migilou in lah gitlouhna thu agen dia, alungtang in thil ahihkhial ding hi.
Milepchiah vante zaw hoih lou ahi a; tagahte'n thudik agen un leng migentheite zuauthu a hihmang ding in, ama'n lah thil gilou hih angaihtuah zel hi.
Mithilphal bel thilphal in thil liante angaihtuah a; huchi in thilphal lam thilte ah a-om gige ding hi.
Numei mawk omte aw, thou unla, ka aw ngaikhia un; tanu pilvangloute aw ka thugen ah bildoh un.
Numei pilvangloute aw, kum khat leh ni bangzah hiam nung in na buaita ding uh; grep loh ding lah a-om ngal kei ding a, grep lohkhawm ding ah leng bangmah asuak sam kei ding hi.
Numei mawk omte aw, ling un; mipilvangloute aw, buaitak in om un; kisuah unla, vuaktang in kibawl unla, na kawng uah sai-ip puan teng un.
Lou deihte ziak leh grep guigah nuamte ziak in a-awm uh atumtum ding uhi.
Ka mite gam loulingnei leh khaulingnei in nopsakna inn tengteng leh nopsakhuai khopi tengteng tung ah abuak ding hi.
Kumpipa' inn paisan a om ding ahi ngal a; amual pawng leh agalvenbuk tangtawn kohawm ding leh gam sabiltung kipahnate, ganhon tatna munte ahi ding.
Tunglam a kipan akha ka tung ua sunbuak a a-om a, gamdai lei hoihtak mun asuah a, lei hoihtak mun lah gammang bang a sim ahih mateng.
Huai hun chiang in vaihawm diktatna gamdai ah ateng ding a, diktatna lei hoihtak mun ah a-om ding.
Huan diktatna nasep kituahna ahi ding a, diktatna a thilpawt lah tangtawn a muangtak a omna leh kitheihchetna ahi ding.
Huchi in ka mite bel galmuang a omna ah leh inkiptak leh khawlna mun muanhuaite a-omta ding uhi.
Himahleh gammang bel hihpuk ding in gial ake ding a; khopi hihniam in a-om ding hi.
Tui luanna piau achi theh zel, bawngtal leh sabiltung khah zelte aw, nuam na sa uhi.

Nang loh tuak ngeiloupi, alok a pang, lepchiahtak a bawl tuak ngeiloupi, lepchiahtak a pang, na tung agik hi. Mi loh na tawp hun chiang in nang leng loh na tuak sam ding hi; lepchiahtak a na hih khit chiang in, na tung ah lepchiahtak in ahih ding uhi.
TOUPA aw, hon hehpih in; ka hon ngak nilouh uhi; zingsang teng in ka ban uh hong hi inla, buai hun chiang in leng hon hondampa hong hi in.
Lum vengvung husa in michih ataimangta ua; nang na kisak hial chiang in namte hihdalh in a-om uhi.
Na sum uh gallak a lak ding lung in thil anek dundun bang in nekgaih in a-om ding; khaupete atawm duamduam uh bang in amaute sum tung ah atawm duamduam ding uhi.
Tunglam ah TOUPA tawisang in a-omta hi; ama'n Zion vaihawm diktak leh diktatna in adimsakta hi.
Na damsung in omkipna a-om ding a, hotdamna, pilna, theihna a-om kikeih ding; TOUPA launa tuh agou ahi.
Ngai in, apasalphate uh polam ah akikou ua; kituahna palaite akap hawhaw uhi.
Lamliante amualta ua, mizin vialvakte a-om nawn kei uh; ama'n thukhun abohsia a, khuate amusit a, mi khawk asa kei hi.
Gam akap in agim a; Lebanon azum in avuai a; Sharon gamdai bang ahita; Bashan leh Karmel in anah uh asingkhia uhi.
TOUPA'N, "Tu'n ka thou ding a, tu'n ka kisa ding a, tu'n tawisang in ka omta ding.
Lou keu naupai in na pai ding ua, buhpawl na suang ding uh; na hu uh noumau kangmang ding mei ahi.
Michih lah chinai suang hal bang, loulingnei vatsa mei a apaih bang uh, achi ding uh," achi hi.
Gamlapi a omte aw, ka thilhih bil in za un; naichik a omte aw, ka thilhihtheihdan thei un.
Zion a migilou omte'n alau ua; Pathian zah lou mite linna in amanta hi. I lak ua kua ahia thil katmang ching mei kiang a om ding? I lak uah kua ahia tangtawn a kang zoizoi kiang a om ding?
Diktattak a om a, diktak a genmi; nuaisiahnate punna himhim bangmah a ngai lou a, golhna la nuam lou abil hum a, gilou himhim en nuam lou a mitsi zel.
Huai mi tunglam ah a-om ding a; akidalna mun sang suangpi kidalnate ahi ding; akiang ah a-an piak ahi ding a, atuite a-om ngeingei ding hi.
Na mite'n kumpipa akilawmna in amu ding a, gam kiphalh zatak ahon en ding uhi.
Asimmi koi a omta ahia? Siahliau tehmi koi a-omta ahia? Galven insangte simmi koi a omta ahia? chi in na lungtang in thil mulkimhuai mahmah na ngaihtuah ding.
Mihangtak, pau giltak na theihtheih louh a pau mite, pau tuam na theihsiam louh a pau mite, na mu nawnta kei ding.

I zehtanna khopi Zion en dih; na mit in Jerusalem omna muanhuaitak, puanin chik mah chiang a leng suan louh ding, kaihgakna khet chik mah chiang a leng boh louh ding, akaihna khau himhim kitat lou ding bang, amu ding hi.

Huai ah TOUPA, lui za pipi leh luitate omna mun, thupitak in i kiang uah a-om zaw ding; huai tui tung ah kidouna long lianpi kalhna chiang neite apai kei ding a, long lian thupitak in leng akheng sam kei ding hi.
TOUPA lah i vaihawmpa ahi a, TOUPA lah dan hon pepa ahi a, TOUPA lah i kumpipa ahi; ama'n ahon hondam ding hi.
Na khaute kolsak in a-om ding a; apuanzak peu bul uh akipsak thei kei ua, puanzak lah azak thei kei uh; huaitak in gallak sum tampi hawm in a-om a; khebaite'n leng gallak sum alata uhi.
Huai khua a mi om in, ka chi ana, achi kei ding a, asung a mite khelhna ngaihdam in a-om ding uhi.
Nou namte aw, bil a za ding in hong nai un; michihte aw, ngaikhia un; leitung leh asung a om tengteng in bil in za uhen; khovel leh asung a pan pawt tengteng toh.
TOUPA'N nam chiteng tung a lungkimlouhna nei in asepaihte uh tengteng tung ah lah hehna anei ngal a; amau ahihmang vek a, thah ding in apeta hi.
Alak ua thah a omte paihkhiak in a-om ding ua, aluang namsia uh apaitou vutvut ding a, tangte asisan ua zulsak in a-om ding uhi.

Van a omte tengteng hihman in a-om ding ua, laibuzial kizial bang in van zial in a-om ding a, a-omte tengteng, grepgui a kipan a nahvuai apulh bang in leh theipi kung a kipan a nahvuai apulh bang in avuai khin un apulh vek ding uhi.
Ka namsau in van ah taitak in adawnta ngal a, ngai in, huai vaihawm ding in Edomte tung ah leh ka hamsiat mite tung ah ake ding.
TOUPA namsau sisan in atai ding a, thauna a thausak in a-omta, belamnoute leh kelte sisan in, belampa gilthaute in. TOUPA'N Bozrah ah kithoihna anei a, Edom gam ah leng thahna thupitak anei hi.
Gam bawngtalte leng kituak in satpaih in a-om ding ua, bawngtalte toh, agam un sisan akham ding a, aleivui uh thauna a thausak in a-om ding.
TOUPA phulak ni lah ahita ngal a, Zion selna lam thu athukna kum.
Aluituite longnai dia suahsak in a-om ding a, leivuite mei leh kaat asuak ding a, agam longnai kang asuak ding hi.
Sun leh zan in mihsak ahi kei ding a; ameikhu lah tangtawn in atungkah ding a; suan om lai siah asia in a-om nilouh ding a; tangtawn in leng kuamah in angap kei ding uhi.
Tuivagik leh sakuh in huai gam atang ding ua; simbu leh va-ak huai ah ateng ding uh; siatna khau leh siatgawpna ulum atung ah akhai ding hi.
Amihoihte uh gam uk ding in asam ding ua, himahleh huai ah kuamah sap ding a-om kei ding uh; amilian tengteng uh bangmah ahi kei ding uh.
Akumpipa uh inn ah louling neite apou ding a, akulhpi sung uah dailing leh lingnok apou ding; sehalte tenna ding leh vasa ngawngsaute a ding in inn um sung intual ahi ding hi.
Huan gamdai a, gamsate ngiate toh akituak ding ua, sathak in alawm asam ding; ahi, zan thil lauhuaipi in huai ah omna abawl ding a, amah a ding in khawlna mun ding amu ding hi.
Huai ah simbu thupi in bu abawl ding a, atui dia, akeuh ding a, a-opkhawm ding; ahi, huai ah mute koppih nei chiat in a-omkhawm ding uhi.
TOUPA laibu ah zong unla, sim un; huaite lak ah khat leng kim lou a-om kei ding a, khat leng koppih nei lou a-om kei ding; amah kam ngei in thu apia a, akha ngei in huaite apikhawmta hi.
Ama'n lah amaute a ding in ai asansak a, akhut a khau a teh in huai gam ahawmsak chiat a; tangtawn in anei ding ua, suan om lai teng huai ah a-om ding uhi.
Gamdai leh phaksap gam akipak ding a; gamkeu in nuamsa in pawn pak bang in apak ding.
Apaklun ding a, kipaktak leh la sa in nuam asa ding hi. Lebanon thupina akiang ah piak ahi ding, Karmel leh Sharon kilawmna toh; TOUPA thupina amu ding ua, i Pathian kilawmna toh.
Khut hatloute hatsak unla, khukzawte kipsak un.
Lungtang dawilokte kiang ah, "Hattak in om unla, lau kei un! Ngai un, na Pathian uh phulakna toh, a Pathian thukna toh, ahong pai ding a, hon hondam ding," chi un.
Huai hun chiang in mittawte mit hahsak in a-om ding a, nangongte bil hihvak in a-om ding.

Huai hun chiang in khebaite sakhi bang in atawm ding ua, pau theiloute lei in nuamsatak in la asa ding uh; gamdaite ah tuite ahong phulkhe ding ua, gamkeute ah luita tui ahong phulkhe biabia ding uhi.
Huchi in piaunel sa mahmah munte dil ahong suak ding a, lei dangtak mahmah tui nak ahong suak ding; sehalte tenna a, alupna uah, loupa, maute leh sikhapat toh a-om ding.

Huan huai ah lamlian a-om ding a, kongpi toh, huai Sianthouna Lampi achi ding uh; mithanghuai in lampi atawn kei ding, himahleh huai mite a ding in ahi zaw ding; mi vialzinte, ahi, mihaite leng, huai ah amang kei ding uhi.
Humpinelkai himhim huai ah a-om kei ding a, sa hing ne himhim huai ah apaitou sam kei ding uh, muh phak in leng a-om kei ding ua, himahleh tatsate bel huai ah apaitou ding uh.
TOUPA tatsate akik nawn ding ua, lasa kawm in Zion atung ding uh, tangtawn a kipahna alutung uah a-omta ding a; nopsakna leh kipahna angah ding ua, lungkhamna leh thumna amang ding hi.
Kumpipa Hezekiah akum sawm-le-li kum in hichi ahong hi a, Assuria gam kumpipa Sennakerib tuh Judah gam a kulh nei khua tengteng sim ding in ava hohtou a alata hi.
Assuria kumpipa'n Lakish a kipan Jerusalem a kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah sepaihhon tampipi toh Rabshakeh asawl hi. Huan dil saknung tuilakna kiang a Puansawpmi Loubuk lamlian ah adingh hi.
Huchi in kumpipa inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Shebna, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joah akiang ah ahong suk uhi.
Huan Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Hezekiah kiang ah huchi in gen un, 'Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa in hichi in achi: Na muanna kingakna bang ahi mai a?'
Kidouna ding a na lemtheihna leh na hatna zaw thu lel ahi, ka chi. Kua muang a, ka tung a hel na himai a?
Ngai in, hiai sialluang chiangkhun kitan Aiguptate muang na hi ve; huai mi na muanleh, na khut ah asun ding hi. Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ah zaw amah muangte tung ah huchibang ahi.”

Ahihkeileh, ka kiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh," na chihleh, amah pen Hezekiah in Judahte kiang ah leh Jerusalem kiang ah, "Hiai maitam ma ah kia na biak ding uh ahi," chi a, amun sangte leh amaitamte lakmangsakpa hilou hia?
Huchi in hehpih in, ka pu Assuria kumpipa kiang ah thu chiam in, huchi in ke'n sakol sangnih ka hon pe ding, nang atung ua tuang dingte na muh theih peuh dingleh.
Bangchi in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu ah Aiguptate tung a na muanna nga a, ka pu sikha neupente lak a heutu khat leng na nan zoh ding?
Huan hiai hihse ding a sim ding in TOUPA pang lou a hong paitou ka hi a hia? TOUPA'N, ka kiang ah, "Huai gam sim ding in hohtou inla, hihsia in, ahon chi, chi un," achi hi.

Eliakim leh Shebna leh Joahte'n, Rabshakeh kiang ah, "Hehpih in na sikhate Siria pau in hon houpih in; huai ka theithei ngal ua; kulhbaang tung a mite zak in Judah pau in hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi uhi.

Himahleh Rabshakeh in, "Ka pu in na pu kiang kia ah leh nang kiang ah hiai thu gen ding in ahon sawl a hia? Kulhbaang tung a tute, noute toh amau ek ne ding leh amau zun dawn dingte kiang ah, ahon sawl ahi zaw kei maw?" achi hi.
Huchi in Rabshakeh adingh a, Judah pau in ngaihtak in akikou a, "Kumpipa thupi Assuria kumpipa thute ngaikhia un.
Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, 'Hezekiah khem in om nuam dah un; ama'n lah ahon humbit thei kei ding hi.
Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N pel lou in hon humbit ding; hiai khopi zaw Assuria kumpipa khut a piak in a-om kei ding, chi in thu gen mahleh, Hezekiah gen ziak in TOUPA muang nuam tuan dah un.' "

Hezekiah thu ngaikhe kei un; Assuria kumpipa'n lah hichi in achi ngal a, "Thilpiak in hon kituahpih unla, ka kiang ah hong paikhia un; michih in agrepgui a pan leh michih in atheipi kung a pan ne chiat unla, michih in atuikhuk a pan tui dawn chiat un.
Ka hong pai a, noumau gam bang a buh leh uain omna gam, tanghou leh grephuante omna gam a ka hon paipih matan.
TOUPA'N hon humbit ding, chi a, Hezekiah in ahon khem khakleh pilvang un. Namte pathiante'n Assuria kumpipa khut a pan agam uh ahumbit ngei ua hia?
Hamath leh Arpahte pathiante koi a om ahita ua? Sepharvaimte pathiante koi a om ahita ua? Huai Samaria khua kei a kipan in ahumbitta ua ahia?
Huai gam pathian tengteng lak a kuate'n ahia kei a kipan agam uh ahumbit uh? TOUPA'N Jerusalem khua kei a kipan in ahumbit mahmah ding maw? chi in," achi hi.
Amau bel adai dide ua, "Thu khat lel in leng adawng kei uh; kumpipa thupiak, amau dawng kei un," chih ahi ngal a.

Huchi in kumpipa inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Shebna, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joahte'n a uansilh uh botkek in Hezekiah kiang ah ahong pai ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilh uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Hezekiah in huai azaktak in apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh a, TOUPA' inn ah alutta hi.
A-inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Eliakim leh laigelhmi Shebna leh siampute upate sai-ip puan silh in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kiang ah asawl hi.
Amau akiang ah, Hezekiah in hichi in achi, "Tuni mangbatna leh muhsitna ni ahi; naupangte lah apian hun uh ahita a, amau piangsak ding in hatna lah a-om nawn kei.

Rabshakeh apu Assuria kumpipa'n Pathian hing gense ding a asawl thugente, TOUPA na Pathian in abil in aza lai ahi kha ding buchi in athugen, TOUPA na Pathian in abil a azakte ah, ahon sal ding hi; huaiziak in akhosuaksunte a ding in na thumna lan in achi,” achi uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah sikhate Isai kiang ah ahong pai uhi.
Isai in akiang uah, "Na pu kiang uah hichi in na chi ding uh, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Na thuzak, Assuria kumpipa sikhate'n ahon gensiatnate uh, kihta ke'n.
Ngai in, asung ah kha banghiam ka omsak ding a, huchi in thuthang aza ding a, amah gam ah akik nawn mai ding; huchi in amah gam ngei ah namsau a puksak in ka omsak ding, achi,' chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in Rabshakeh akik nawn a, Assuria kumpipa in Libnah adouna a kipan apaikheta chih athei khinta hi.
Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in Tirhak Ethiopia kumpipa tungthu, "Nang hon sim ding in apawtta," chi in mi gen aza hi. Huchi in huai azaktak in Hezekiah kiang ah palaite asawl a.
Hichi in Judahte kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah na chi ding uh ahi, “Na muan Pathian in, Jerusalem khua Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in hon khem kei hen.
Ngai in, Assuria Kumpipate'n gam tengteng hihse vek in atung ua athilhihte uh na bil in na za hi, huchi in nang penpen humbit in na om tuam ding hiam?
Namte pathiante'n, Gozan, Haran, Reseph, Eden ta Telassar a omte, ka pipute sukmante, ahumbit ngei ua hia?
Hamath kumpipate, Ivvah kumpipate koi a om ahita ua? chi in," achi a.
Hezekiah in palaite khut a kipan in lai amu a, asim a, huchi in TOUPA' inn ah Hezekiah ava lut a, TOUPA ma ah aphahta hi.
TOUPA kiang ah Hezekiah athum hi.
"Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian aw, cherubte tung a tupa, nang, nang kia, leitung luah gam tengteng Pathian na hi; nangma'n leitung leh van na bawl hi.
TOUPA aw na bildoh inla, ngai dih ve; TOUPA aw na mit hak inla, en dih ve; Pathian hing gense ding a mite sawlpa Sennakerib thu tengteng ngai in.
TOUPA, Assuria kumpipate'n nam tengteng leh agam uh ahihse ngei ua, apathiante uh leng mei ah apai uhi.
Huaite zaw Pathian ahi kei him ua, mihing khut a bawl sing leh suang, ahi zaw uh. Huaiziak in ahihmang uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, nang, nang kia, TOUPA na hi chih leitung luah gam tengteng in atheihna ding un amah a kipan in hon humbit in," chi in.
Huai lai in Amoz tapa Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah mi asawl a, hichi in achi, "TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib siatna ding nangawn a ka kiang a na thum ziak in,
hiai atungtang thu TOUPA'N agen ahi, 'Nungak siangthou, Zion tanu in ahon musit a, hon nuihsan hi; Jerusalem tanu in alu hon sinkhum hi.
Kua ahi mai a na minsiatsak a na gensiat? Kua tung ah ahia na aw na puamsak a, na mit na sansak? Israelte Mi Siangthou tung ah ahi kei maw.

Na sikhate zang in TOUPA min na sesak a, ka kangtalai tampi toh tang sang sanna, Lebanon gam kil ah ka hong tungtouta hi; asidar sing sangtakte leh ameilah sing hoihte ka phuk ding; amun sangpen, alei hoihna gammang ah ka lut ding.
Tuileh ka let a, tui ka dawn zel a, ka khepek nuai in Aigupta lui tengteng ka kangsak vek ding, " na chi hi.
Ke'n nidanglai a pan in huai ka hih ahi a, tuma lam a kipan a ka suktuah ahi chih na za kei a hia? Khua kulh neite inn chimkhawm bang lel a hihsepa na hihtheihna ding in tu in ka tungsak hi.
Huaiziak in asung a omte ahat lo kei ua, alau ua, azahlak uhi; loubuk loupa bang lel leh loupa hing bang lel, intung loupa hing bang lel, intung loupa bang leh lou buh hoih mah bang lel ahi uhi.
"Ke'n bel na tut, na pawt, na lut leh ka tung a na hehdan ka thei hi.

Ka tung a na heh ziak leh na uangpau ka bil a ahong luttouh tak ziak in ka nakbulh nang nak ah ka bulh ding a, ka sikkaihna leng na muk ah ka bulh ding, na hong paina lampi mah ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding, chih," chi in.

"Huan hiai pen nang a ding a chiamtehna ding ahi ding; tukum in buhsang na sen ding ua; kum nawn in leng huai buhsang mah na sen ding uh; akum thumna ah buh tuh unla, at unla, grephuante bawl unla, agah ne un.
"Huan Judah inkuanpihte lak a akhosuaksunte bel asuklam a zungkai a, atoulam a gah in a-om nawn ding.
Akhosuaksunte Jerusalem a kipan in apawt ding ua, dam lai dingte Zion tang a kipan in apawt ding uh; sepaihte' TOUPA phatuamngaihna in huaite ahih ding hi.

"Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria kumpipa tungtang thu ah hichi in achi: Amah hiai khopi ahong tung kei ding a, hiai lai ah athal leng akap sam kei ding a, lum toh akiang ah leng ahong pai sam kei ding, asimna ding in lah leikulh abawl sam kei ding.
Ahong paina lampi ah huai mah ah akik nawn ding ziak in, hiai khopi ah ahong tung kei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
Kei ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi ka humbit ding hi,” chỉ in achi a.
Huchi in TOUPA angel ava pawt a, Assuriate giahmun ah mi nuaikhat singgiat-le-sangnga asisak a; huan, zingkhang a mi athoh uleh, ngai in, misi luang ngen ana hi uhi.
Huchi in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib apawt a, apaikik a, Nineveh ah a-om nilouh hi.

Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, apathian Nisrok inn a pathian abiak lai in atapa Adrammelek leh Sarezerte'n namsau in asatlum ua; huchi in ataimang ua, Ararat gam ah alut uhi. Huchi in atapa Esarhaddon in asik in vai ahawm hi.

Huai lai in Hezekiah si thei ding khop in achi ana hi. Huchi in akiang ah Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai ahong a, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na inkuanpihte omdan ding gelsak in; damkhe lou a si ding na hi ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah baang lam nga in akihei a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a,
"TOUPA aw, na ma a thutak leh lungtang hoihkim pu a ka om zeldan leh na mitmuh a thil hoih ka hih zeldan, hehpih in theigige in," achi hi. Huchi in Hezekiah akap huphup hi.
Huchi in TOUPA thu Isai kiang ah ahong tung a,
"Kuan inla, Hezekiah kiang ah gen in, TOUPA, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi: Na thumna ka za a, na khituite leng ka mu a; ngai in, na damsung nite ah kum sawm-le-nga ka behlap ding hi.
Huan nang leh hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa a kipan ka humbit ding a; hiai khopi ka hum ding hi.
"TOUPA'N athil gen ahih ngei ding chih, hiai nang a ding in TOUPA a kipan chiamtehna ding ahi.
En in, inlim chial a lim, Ahaz dakbi theihna a niamkiaksa, inliim chial sawm tan in ka kiksak nawn ding," achi hi. Huchi in ni niamna dakbi theihna ah inliim chial sawm tan in akik nawnta hi.
Judah kumpipa Hezekiah china, adam nawn nung a alaigelh a:
"Ka damsung nite sun laitak in han kongpi ah lut ding in ka kisa a; ka damsung kum om lai dingte suh in ka omta, ka chi hi.
TOUPA, TOUPA ngei, mihing gam ah ka mu nawnta kei ding a; khovel a omte lak ah mihing ka mu nawn kei ding hi.

Ka omna suan in a-om a, belamchingmi puanin bang in ka kiang a kipan a lakmang in a-omta hi. Puan ganmi'n apuan azial bang in ka hinna ka zial a; ama'n siambu a kipan ahon teptan ding a; ni khat leh zan khat thil thu a hon hihtawp maimah ding na hi ve, ka chi hi.
Zingsang tan ka dai teitei a; humpinelkai bang in ka guh tengteng ahihtan vek a; nang ni khat leh zan khat thil thu a hon hihtawp mai ding na hi ve.
Lensiam hiam, vakang hiam bang in ka hamham a, vakhu bang in ka thum hi, tunglam etna in ka mit avaita hi; TOUPA aw, nuaisiah a om ka hi, nang ka tang in ding in.
Bang ka gen dia? Ama'n ahon houpih a, amah mah in ahih pah hi; ka hinna ning kitelna ziak in ka damsung kum teng awl khakha in ka pai khiankhianta ding.
"TOUPA aw, hichibang thil ziak in mihingte ahing zel uh, huaite kia ah ka kha hinna a-om zel hi; huaiziak in hon damsak nawn in hon hingsak nawn in.

Ngai in, ka lungmuanna ding in ahi, ning kitelna thupitak ka na neih; himahleh nang, ka hinna na it ziak in, siatna kokhuk a kipan in na humbitta; ka khelhnate tengteng lah na nunglam ah na pai vekta hi.
Han in lah hon phat thei ngal kei a, sihna in leng ahon pahtawi thei sam kei hi; kokhuk a kumte'n na thutak alamen thei kei uhi.
Mihing in, mihing in, amau ngei in tuni a ka hih bang in ahon phat ding uh; pa'n atate kiang ah na thutak atheisak ding.
"TOUPA bel hon hondam ding in amansa gige hi; huaiziak in i damsung tengteng in, TOUPA' inn ah, ka late tumging guineite toh i sa ding."
Isai in, "Theipi gah lom khat la henla, damdawi atat a tatte ding in ameimatum ah tuamkhum hen, huchi in adam ding," ana chi khinta hi.
Hezekiah mah in leng, "TOUPA' inn ah ka hohtou nawn ding chih theihna bang chiamtehna hong om ding ahia?" ana chi khinta hi.
Huai lai in Baladan tapa Babulon kumpipa Merodak-baladan in Hezekiah kiang ah achi ana chih leh adam nawnta chih azak ziak in laite leh kipahman akhak hi.

Huchi in Hezekiah atung uah akipak a, akiang uah athil manphate koihna inn dangkate, dangka-engte, gimlim bangbang hiamte, sathau manphate, agalvan koihna insung tengtengte, agou hoih lak a om tengtengte a-ensak hi. A-inn leh agamsung a om himhim Hezekiah in akiang ua a-etsak louh a-om kei hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah zawlnei Isai ahoh a, akiang ah, "Den a mite'n bang ahia agen uh? Koi a kipan in ahia na kiang a ahong uh?" achi hi. Hezekiah in, "Gam gamlapi a kipan, Babulon a kipan in, ka kiang a hong pai ahi uh,” achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Na inn ah bangbang en ahi ua?" achi hi. Hezekiah in, "Ka insung a om tengteng a-en vek uh; ka gou hoihte ka etsak louh bangmah a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, "Sepaihte' TOUPA thu thei in.
Ngai in na insung a om tengteng leh tuni tan a na pipute'n akholkhawmte uh Babulon a paipih in a-om vek ding; bangmah nutsiat in a-om kei ding; huchibang nite ahong tung ding, TOUPA'N achi.
Huan na tapa, na gil a hong gah ding, na suan dingte ngei lak a mi, apaimangpih ding uh; amau Babulon kumpipa' inn ah michilgeh ding in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah in, Isai kiang ah, "TOUPA thu na gen ahoih hi," achi hi. Amah mah in, "Ka damsung in lemna leh muanna a-om ding hi," achi lai hi.

Huai ni in numei sagih in pasal khat alen ding ua, "Koumau an ka ne ding ua, koumau silh-le-ten ka silh un ka teng ding uh; na min lel hon pusak in; ka minsia uh hon lakmangsak in," chi in agen ding uhi.
Huai ni in TOUPA hiang kilawmtak in leh thupitak in a-om ding a, Israelte damlaite a ding in lei a gahte hoihtak leh kilawmtak in a-om ding.
Huchi in Zion nutsiat a omleh, Jerusalem a omden tuh siangthou chih in a-om ding, michih Jerusalem a dam lai a min gelhte.
Vaihawmna kha leh katna kha a Toupa'n Zion tanu buahte asawpsiangsak a, asung a kipan Jerusalem sisan asuksiang khit chiang in.
Huan TOUPA'N Zion tang a omna tengteng tung ah leh akikhawmpite tung ah sun in meipi leh meikhu, zan in meikuang vak asiamsak ding; thupina tengteng tung ah banghiam zak a om ding ahi ngal a.
Sun in nisa liah ding leh huihpi vuahpi lak a kihumbitna leh bukna mun ding in biakbuk ahi ding hi.
Lungmuan un, ka mite lungmuan un, na Pathian un achi hi.
Jerusalem kiang ah lungmuan lam sang in thu gen unla, agaldouna uh hihzoh ahita a, akhelhna uh ngaihdam ahi a, athilhihkhelh teng gun ding in TOUPA khut a kipan amun nih in amuta uh chih hilh un.
Tua! Kikou aw in, "Gamdai ah TOUPA lampi bawl unla, gamkeu ah i Pathian a ding in lamlian kilualsak un.
Guam chih sansak ahi vek ding a, tang chih mual chih niamsak ahi ding; lampi kawite tansak ahi ding a, aphokna lailai hihlual ahi ding hi;
TOUPA thupina hihlat ahi ding a, mi tengteng in huai amu chiat ding uh chih TOUPA kam in lah agenta ngal a," achi hi.
Tua aw in, "Kikou in," achi hi. Mi'n, "Bang gen in ka kikou dia?” achi hi. Mi tengteng loupa bang ahi ua, athupina tengteng uh leng lou a pak bang ahi.
"TOUPA hu in amut ziak in loupa avuai a, apak atul nak; mite zaw loupa bang ahi mahmah uhi.
Loupa avuai a, apak atul zel; i Pathian thu bel tangtawn in a-om gige ding," chi in achi a.

Zion kiang a atanchinhoih hilh mi aw, tang sang mahmahte ah va hohtou in; Jerusalem kiang a tanchinhoih hilh mi aw, ngaihtak in na aw suah in; suah in, lau ke'n; Judah khuate kiang ah, "En un, na Pathian uh!”
"En un, Toupa PATHIAN mihattak bang in ahong pai ding hi; aban in vai ahawm ding; En un, akipahman akiang ah a-om a, ditna leng ama ah a-om.
Ama'n belamchingpa bang in abelamhonte avak ding a, belamnoute aban in apomkhawm ding a, a-angsung a koih in apaipih ding a, nou kailaite bel awlawl in api hiathiat ding," chi in.
Kua'n ahia tuite akhutpek sung lel ateh a, tung a van khap lel ateh a, lei a leivui tehna khat lel a thun vek a, tangte lah khaina a khai a, mual pawngte bukna lel a buk?
Kua'n ahia TOUPA kha thilhih dan ding kawkmuh? Ahihkeileh kua ahia amah lemsehsak hi a amah chil?
Ama'n kua adong a, kua'n ahia amah theisak a, vaihawm lampi ensak a, theihna hilh a, theihsiamna lampi ensak ngei?
Ngai in, namte lah baltin a tui tak khat bang lel ahi ua, bukna a banghiam nen bang lel a seh ahi ua, ngai in, ama'n tuikulh gamte thil neu neuchikte bang in adom zel hi.
Lebanon nangawn khul tham ahi kei a, agam a gante leng halmang a kithoihna tham ahi sam kei hi.
Nam chihte lah ama ah bangmah lou bang ahi ua, amah ngaihtuah in bangmah lou sang a tawm zaw, huihkhua lel ahi uhi.
Pathian kua toh teh na hi ua? Ahihkeileh, bang lim ahia amah toh na teh ding uh?
Milim bawltawm zaw, nasem mi in asung a, dangka-eng sekmi'n dangka- eng in aluan khum a, huai a ding in dangka khainiangte asunsak zel hi.
Huchibang thilpiak pe zou lou a, genthei lo mahmah in sing muat lou ding atel zel, milim bawltawm, ling lou ding, amah a dia bawlkhiaksak ding khutsiam mi azong zel hi.
Na lungsim un na thei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za kei ua hia? Atung a kipan in hon hilh kei ua hia? Lei pianchil a pan na theisiam kei ua hia?

Amah zaw lei kualkhumna tung a tupa ahi, ama mitmuh in leitung a omte khaupe bang lel ahi uh, amah zaw tung a van puanin tung bang a kaipalh a, omna ding a puanin zak a, miliante bangmah lou suaksakpa ahi.
Amah leitung a vaihawm mite bangmah lou a bawl nakpa ahi.
Ahi, suan ahi kei ua; ahi, tuh ahi sam kei uh; ahi, akung un lei ah zung akai kei; huai lou in ama'n amau amut a, avuai ua, pingpei in buhsi alakmang bang in alamang hi.
Kua toh hon teh a, kua kimpih a hon sep na hi ua? Mi Siangthou in achi hi.

Tunglam ah na mit uh hak unla, huai thilte kua siam ahia en un; ama'n sepaihte kizomzom in apikhia a, amin chiat un asam a; ahatna thupina ziak leh thilhihtheihna a ahat ziak in khat mah leng kim lou a-om ngei kei uhi.
Jakobte aw, bang achia hiai chi na hi ua, Israelte aw, bang achia hichibang a thu gen na hi ua, "Ka lampi zaw TOUPA lak a sel ahi a, avai hawmsakna ka Pathian lak a lakmang ahi," chih?
Na lungsim un na thei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za ngei kei ua hia? Tangtawn Pathian, TOUPA kawlmong Siampa, abah louh a, agim ngeilouhdan; atheihsiamdan zonkhiak vual ahi kei hi.
Bahte kiang ah thilhihtheihna apia a, hatna himhim neiloute ahatsak naknak hi.
Tuailaite nangawn leng bah in agim ding ua, tangvalte leng apukzou ding uh.
TOUPA ngakte'n zaw ahatna uh athaksak nawn ding ua; muvanlai bang in kha in alengtou ding ua; gim lou in atai ding ua; bah lou in khe in apai ding uhi.
Tuikulh gamte aw, ka ma ah dai sipsip unla; michih in ahatna uh thaksak nawn uhenla; hong pai nai chiat le uh; huai khit chiang in gen uhen; vaihawm ding in paikhawm ni.

Suahlam a kipan mi khat, diktatna ziak a akhebul a asap, kua'n ahia kaihalh? Ama'n ama ah namte apia a, kumpipate tung ah vai ahawmsak a; leivui bang in anamsau kiang ah apia a, buhsi huih mutleng bang in athalpeu kiang ah leng apia hi.
Ama'n amaute adelh a, bittak in араі а; akhe a apai nailouhna lampi ah.
Atung a kipan suan tengteng sam in, kua'n ahia sem a, hih khin? Kei TOUPA, amasapen leh ananungpen, ahihpa kei kia ka hi.
Tuikulh gamte'n amu ua; alau ua; kawlmongte aling ua; ahon naih a, ahong pai uhi.
Michih in amau lawmte apanpih ua; michih in a-unaute uh kiang ah, Khamuangtak in om un, achi chiat uhi.
Huchi in abulhkipna lam thu ah, "Ahoih hi,” chi in khutsiam mi in dangka-eng sekmi ahanthawn a, sek a sekmum mi in sekdou sekmi a ahanthawn; alinlouhna ding in kilhnate in akilh kipta hi.
Himahleh nou Israelte ka sikha, Jakobte ka mitel, ka lawm, Abraham suante aw,
Nou, lei tawpna a kipan a ka mipi, anawl a kipan a ka misap, "Ка sikhate na hi ua, hon paikhe lou in ka hon tel zaw," ka hon chihte aw,

Lau kei un, kei lah na kiang uah ka om ngal a; mangbang kei un, kei lah na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a; ka hon hatsak ding a; ahi, ka hon panpih ding; ahi, ka diktatna khut taklam in ka hon len gige ding hi.
Ngai in, na tung ua lungkim lou tengteng zahlaktak leh zumtak in a-om ding uh; nou hon selte lah bangmah lou bang ahi ding ua, amang ding uh.
Nou hon selte na zong ding ua, na mu tuan kei ding uh; nou hon doute lah bangmah lou bang ahi ding ua, thil om lou bang lel ahi ding uh.
Kei TOUPA na Pathian un, Lau kei un, ka hon panpih ding, chi in na khut taklam uh ka len ding hi.
Nou Jakob tangtel leh Israel mite aw, lau kei un, ka hon panpih ding, TOUPA'N achi, nou hon tanpa Israelte Mi Siangthou ahi.
Ngai in, buhsukna khawl thak mahmah, hiam mahmah, ha nei in ka hon bawl ding; tangte chil in na khenzan ding ua, mualte buhsi bang in na bawl ding uh.
Na zap ding ua, huih in amut leng ding, pingpei in ahihdalh ding a, huan, noute TOUPA ah na kipak ding ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou na hon suang ding uh.
Migenthei leh tagahte'n tui azong ua, a-om kei a, alei uh dangtak in ahul khin hi; kei TOUPA'N amau ka dawng ding a, kei Israel' Pathian in amau ka paisan kei ding.
Tang sang giau ah luite ka luangsak ding a, phaizang laizangte ah tui nak ka suaksak ding; gamdai dil in ka bawl ding a, gamkeu leng tui nak in ka bawl ding hi.
Gamdai ah sidar singte, singgite, muite, thausingte ka suan ding a, gamkeu ah meilah singte, phante, sing gelh chite ka suankhawm vek ding;
TOUPA khut in huaite ahih ahi chih leh Israelte Mi Siangthou in asiam ahi chih amuh ua, atheih ua, angaihtuah ua, atheihsiam theihna ding un.
Na thu uh hong gen un, TOUPA'N achi; na paulam pen uh langsak un, Jakobte' Kumpipa'n achi hi.

Huaite langsak uhenla, thil hong tung dingte i kiang uah gen uhen; i ngaihtuah theihna ding leh atawpna ding i theihtheihna ding in, tuma thilte bang ahia gen un; ahihkeileh, thil hong tung dingte hon theisak un.
pathiante na hi uh chih ka theihna ding un tunung chiang a thil tung dingte gen un; ahi, i mangbat chiatna ding un leh i et chiat ding un thil hoih thiam thil hoih lou hiam hih dih ua le.
Ngai un, bangmah na hi kei ua, na thilhih uh leng bangmah ahi kei; nou hon telpa mikihhuai ahi.
Mallam a kipan mi khat ka dingsak a, amah ahong tung a; nisuahna a kipan ka min loupa; ama'n suang bulhkipna abawl bang in vaihawmte abawl ding a, belvelmi'n bellei achil bang in achil ding hi.

I theihtheihna ding un kua'n ahia atung a kipan gen ngei? Amah zaw adik i chih theihna ding un kua'n ahia genkhol ngei? Ahi gen himhim a-om kei uh, ahi, theisak himhim a-om kei uh, ahi, na thugente uh za a-om kei uh.
Ke'n Zion kiang ah, "En in, hiai ah amaute a-om uh," chi masa ding ka hi a, Jerusalem kiang ah tanchinhoih hon tun mi khat ka pe ding.
Ka et in leng mi himhim a-om kei ua; amau ka dot in leng, alak ua lemthei mi, thu khat leng dawng thei, kuamah himhim leng a-om kei uh.
En un, anasepte uh bangmah lou ahi a, thil om lou ahi; amilim sunte uh lah huih leh huihkhua lel ahi.
Ka sikha, ka let gige, ka tel, ka lung in apahtak mahmah en dih ua; atung ah ka kha ka koihta; Zentelte kiang a piak ding in vaihawmna thu ahong pawt ding.
Akikou kei ding a, a-aw asuaksak sam kei ding, kongzing ah a-aw akizasak sam kei ding.
Sialluang gawpsa akuaitan kei ding a, meikuang liakliak amitsak kei ding; thudik in vai ahawm zaw ding hi.
Leitung a vaihawmna a-omsak masiah, amah abah kei ding a, alungdong sam kei ding; tuikulh gamte'n adan thu angak nilouh ding uhi.
Pathian, TOUPA, van siampa leh phalhpa, lei leh asung a kipan a pawt tengteng hihlianpa, atung a mite kiang a hatna pepa leh atung a paite kiang a kha pepa'n hichi in achi:
"Kei TOUPA in diktatna in ka hon sam a, na khut ka len ding a, ka hon humbit ding, mite thukhun hi ding leh Zentelte hihvakpa hi ding in ka hon sep ding a;
mitdelte mit hihvak ding leh mitangte suangkul a kipan pikhe ding leh, mial lak a tute suangkul a pan pikhe ding in.
"TOUPA ka hi; huai ka min ahi; ka thupina midang kiang ah ka pe kei ding a, phat ka lohna leng milim bawltawmte kiang ah ka pe sam kei ding.
Ngai un, tuma thilte ahong tungta, thil thakte gen ka hi; apou ma in nang ka hon hilh hi.
Tuipi a hoh sukte leh asung a om tengteng leh tuikulh gamte leh, atung a om tengtengte aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa unla, kawlmong a kipan in leng amah phatna la sa un.
Gamdai leh akhote'n a-aw uh suaksak uhen, Kedarte omna khuate'n; suangpi khua a omte'n nuamsa in la sa uhenla, mual dawn a kipan kikou uhen.
TOUPA hih thupi uhenla, tuikulh gamte'n aphatna thu gen uhen.
TOUPA lah mihat mahmah bang in apawt ding a, galdoumi bang in mullitna atokthou ding; akikou ding a, ahi, ngaihtak in akikou ding; amah doute tung ah hattak in agamtang ding.
Sawtpi ka daita a; ka om kinken in ka kidek teitei; tu'n zaw numei nauvei bang in ka kikou tuaituai ding a; ka nak honhon in ka nak huhu ding.
Tang leh mual pawngte ka hihse ding a, aniam tengteng ka keusak vek ding; luite tuikulh gam in ka bawl ding a, dilte ka kangsak ding.

Mittawte atheih ngei louh lam uah ka pi ding a, atheih ngei louh uh lampi ah ka pi ding; ama uah mial vak in ka bawl ding a, lam kawinate leng ka tangsak ding. Huai thilte ka hih ding a, amau leng ka nuse kei ding.
Milim bawltawmte muang a, milim sunte kiang a, ka pathian uh na hi uh, chite kiheisak in a-om ding ua, nakpitak in azahlak ding uhi."
Bilngongte aw, za un; mittawte aw, na muhtheihna ding un en un.
Ka sikha lou ngal kua mit ataw a? Ahihkeileh, ka sawltak sawl bang in kua bil angong a? Hon kithuahpih mi bang in kua mit ataw a? TOUPA sikha bang in kua mit ataw a?
Thil tampi na mu a, himahleh na lungsim in na vom gige kei; abilte akihong a, himahleh aza kei hi.
Dan lah adiktatna ziak a letsak a pahtawisak a om TOUPA'N hoih asa hi.

Himahleh hiaite zaw guta guksak leh loh tuak mite ahi ua; phaizang a ahi vek ua, suangkul a khummangte ahi ua; sal kaih ding ahi ua, kuamah in lah ahumbit ngal kei ua, gallak a lak ding ahi ua, kuamah in, "Pe nawn in!" achi kei uhi.
Na lak uah huaite bildoh ding kua na om ua? Hun hong tung ding a dia ngaikhia a za ding kua na om ua?
Kua'n ahia Jakobte gallak a lak ding a pia a, Israelte gutate kiang a pia? TOUPA, atung a i khelhnapa un, apiak hilou hia? Ama lampi ah apai nuam ngal kei ua. Adan thu amang sam kei uhi.
Huaiziak in aheh mahmahna leh kibawlna tha amau tung ah asungbua a, huai in amaute akang a himahleh athei sam kei uh; huai in amaute ahul a, himahleh alungsim un angaihtuah tuan kei uhi.
Tu in zaw, Jakob aw, TOUPA nou hon siampa leh, Israel aw, nang hon bawlpa'n, hichi in achi: Lau ke'n, ka hon tanta hi; na min in ka hon sam a, kei a na hi hi.
Tuite na ngah tan lai in na kiang ah ka om ding a; luite na ngah tan lai in leng ahon tum kei ding hi; mei a na pai tan lai in leng ahon hul kei ding a; meikuang in ahon liau kei ding hi.
Kei, TOUPA na Pathian, Israelte Mi Siangthou, nang hon humbitpa ka hi ngal a; na tatna ding in Aigupta gam ka pia a, Ethiopia leh Seba gam na sik in ka pia hi.
Ka ngaih in manpha mahmah na hi a, mizahtakhuai mahmah leng na hi hi, it leng ka hon it ziak in, na sik in mite ka pe ding a, na hinna sik ding in michih ka pe ding hi.
Lau kei in, na kiang ah ka om ngal a; na suante suahlam a kipan ka hon pi ding a, tumlam a kipan ka hon pikhawm ding hi.
Mallam kiang ah, khah in, ka chi ding a; simlam kiang ah, len kei in, ka chi ding; ka tapate gamlapi a kipan hon pi inla, ka tanute kawlmong a kipan hon pi in;
Ka min po peuhmahte leh ka thupina ding a ka siam peuhmahte; amau ka bawl a, ahi, amau ka suktuahte ahi uhi.
Mit nei ngal a mittawte leh, bil nei ngal a nangongte, pikhia un.

Nam chih kikhawm uhenla, michih omkhawm uhen; alak ua kua ahia hiai gen thei a, tuma lam in thilte hon theisak thei? Siamtansak a a-omtheihna ding un apalaite uh hon pi uhen; ahihkeileh bil in za uhenla, thutak ahi, chi uhen.

"Noute ka theihpihtute na hi uh" TOUPA'N achi; "Ka sikha ka mitelsate, kei amah ka hi chih thei a, na gintak ua, na theihsiamna ding un. Ka om ma in Pathian bawlkhiak in a-om kei a, ka om nung in leng a-om sam kei ding.
"Kei, kei mahmah, TOUPA ka hi; keimah lou ngal hondampa a-om kei hi.
Ke'n ka gen a, ka hondam a, ka theisak a, na lak uah gamdang pathian a-om kei hi; huaiziak in noute ka palaite na hi uh, TOUPA'N achi, kei Pathian ka hi.
Ahi, ni om nungsang kei bamah ka hi; huchi in ka khut a kipan hunkhe thei kuamah a-om kei uh; nna ka sem a, kua'n ahia huai hei ding?
TOUPA, nou hon tanpa, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi: Nou ziak in Babulon ah sepaihte ka sawl a, huchi in avek un, Kaldaite, akipahna longpi uah taimang mi pi in ka pisuk ding.
Kei TOUPA, na Mi Siangthou uh, Israelte Siampa, na Kumpipa uh ka hi,” chi in.
Tuipi a lampi bawlpa leh, tui thupi mahmahte a paina ding bawlpa, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
"Kangtalai leh sakol, sepaihte leh thilhihtheihna a pikhepa'n, huaite alumkhawm zengzung ua, athounawnta kei ding uh; achimit khin ua, khawnvak puan mihsak bang in mihsak in a-omta uh," chi in.
Tuma lam thilte zaw theigige kei unla, nidanglai thilte ngaihtuah sam kei un.
Ngai un, thil thak ka hih ding; tua kipan in adawnkhe ding; huai na thei kei ding ua hia? Gamdai nangawn ah lampi ka bawl ding a, gamkeu ah leng luite ka bawl ding.
Gamsate'n leng hon pahtawi ding ua, sehalte, vasa ngawngsaute tan in; gamdai a tuite ka omsak ziak leh gamkeu a luite ka omsak ziak in, ka mi, ka telte kiang a dawn ding a piak ding.
Hiai mite kei a ding in ka bawl a; kei phatna ahihlang ding uhi.
Himahleh Jakobte aw, nou zaw na hon sam kei ua, Israelte aw, nou zaw nawn chimtak zawta uhi.
Haltum thillat gannoute na hon lak ngei kei ua; na kithoihnate un na hon pahtawi sam kei uh. Thillat in na ka hon semsak ngei kei a, begaw in ka hon hihgim ngei kei hi.
Kawltu dangka in na hon leisak ngei kei ua, na kithoihna thaute un na hon taisak ngei kei uh; na khelhnate uh puak nasepte na hon semsak ua, na tatleknate un na hon hihgim zawta uhi.
Kei, kei mahmah, keimah leh keimah ziak lel a, na tatlekna uh nulmangpa ka hi; na khelhnate uh leng ka theigige nawnta kei ding.
Hon theihpih un; ngaihtuah chiat ni; siamtansak a na omtheihna ding un na thu uh gen un.
Na pu masapen uh akhial a, na thugen mite uh leng ka tung ah atalek uhi.
Huaiziak in Mun Siangthou a miliante ka hihbuah ding a, huchi in Jakobte hamsethuak ding in ka bawl ding a; Israelte muhdah ding in ka bawl ding hi.
Tu in zaw, Jakobte, ka sikhate aw, ka tel Israelte aw, ngaikhia unla;
TOUPA nou hon siampa, sul a pan nou hon bawlpa, nou hon panpih ding pa'n hichi in achi: "Ka sikha Jakob aw, ka tel nou Jeshurunte aw, lau kei un.
"Dangtakmi tung ah tui ka sung ding a, lei keu ah tui luangte ka sung ding; na suante uh tung ah ka kha ka sung ding a, na tate uh tung ah ka vualzawlna ka sung ding hi.
Huchi in amau, tui luanna kiang a singhiang kaite apou bang in, loupa lak ah apou ding uh.
"Mi khat in, TOUPA a ka hi, achi ding a; midang Jakob min in akilou ding a; midang in akhut a, TOUPA, chi a gelh in, Israel min abeh min in azang ding chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA, Israelte Kumpipa, amau tanpa sepaihte TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Kei amasapen pa ka hi a, ananungpen pa ka hi; keimah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei hi.
Nidanglai a mite ka seh nungsang kei hih bang in kua'n asam dia, huaite kua'n agen dia, kua'n ahia kei sik a akizom zel a hihlang ding? Thil hong tung dingte leh hong om dingte gen hen.

Lau kei unla, kihta sam kei un; tuma lam in na kiang uah ka gen khin in ka hon theisak khin hilou hia? Noute ka palaite na hi uhi. Keimah lou Pathian a-om hiam? Ahi, Suangpi himhim a-om kei; khat lel leng a-om lam ka thei kei."
Milim bawltawm bawl mite avek un huihkhua lel ahi ua; athil deihlam uh aphatuam kei ding; azahlakna ding un amau palaite un leng amu thei kei ua, atheithei kei uhi.
Kua'n ahia Pathian bawl? Ahihkeileh, kua'n ahia bangmah ding a phatuamloupi milim bawltawm sung?
Ngai in, apawlpi tengteng azahlak ding ua; nasem mite leng mihingte lak a mi ahi uh. Avek un kikhawm vek uhenla, dingh uhen; alau ding ua, azahlakkhawm ding uh.
Siksek in heipi asek zel a, meihol ah atholh a sek ding bang in asek a, aban hattak in asek zel; ahi, agil ahong kial a, atha ahong zoi zel; tui adawn kei a, abah nak hi.

Singlem bawlmi in khau akaigak a, pensil in ahi ding achiamteh a, nawt mamna in ahihdan ding abawl a, bem bawlna in ahi ding abawl a, mihing lim bang in abawl a, inn a om ding in mihing kilawmna bang in abawl zel hi.
Sidar singte akiphuk a, sesing leh tosaw ala a, gammang sing lak a khat amah tuam a om ding in ahihkip a; meilah sing asuan a, vuahtui in avak hi.

Huai nung in mi a ding a mei a khul ding ahita ding; huai a kipan in ala a, akihihlum zel; ahi, akuangsak a, tanghou ahai zel hi; ahi, pathian abawl a, abe zel hi; huai sing pen milim bawltawm ding in abawl a, huai bokkhup in abia hi.
Huai sing khenkhat mei ah akhul a; akhen sa nekna ding in azang a; sa a-em a, atai hi; ahi, meilum a-awi a, "Nuam e, ka lumta, mei mel ka muta e," achi hi.
Aval pathian ding in abawl a, abawltawm milim mah; huai bokkhup a bia a, akiang ah athum a, "Hon hondam in, ka pathian lah na hi ngal a," achi zel hi.
Athei kei ua, angaihtuah sam kei uh; ama'n lah amit uh amitsisakta ngal a; atheihsiamlouhna ding un alungtang uh leng akhaksakta hi.

Huchi in kuamah in atheikhe nawn kei ua, "Mei ah khenkhat ka khul a; ahi, a-am ah tanghou bang in ka hai a; sa leng ka em a, ka ne a; aval thilkihhuai ding in ka bawl ding hia? Sing a suak bokkhup in ka be ding hia? Hih ding in amau ah theihna leh theihsiamna a-om tuan kei hi."
Vut kia ane zel a; alungtang khem a om in, ahinna akihumbit theihlouhna ding leh, "Ka khut taklam ah zuau a-om kei a hia?" achih theihlouhna ding in, amah akalsuansakta hi.

"Jakobte aw, huai thilte theigige un, Israelte aw, nou leng theigige un ka sikhate lah na hi ngal ua; kei bawl na hi ua; ka sikhate na hi uh; Israelte aw, ka mangngilh in na om kei ding uhi. TOUPA, bangkim siamtu leh hondampa.
"Na tatleknate uh meipi hihmang bang in ka hihmangta a, na khelhnate uh mei hihmang bang in ka hihmang nalai hi; ka kiang ah hong kik nawn un, nou lah ka hon tanta ngal a," chi in.

"Vante aw, nuamsatak in la sa un, TOUPA'N lah huaite ahihta ngal a; lei nuailamte aw, kikou un, tangte aw, gamnuai leh asung a sing om chiteng aw, la sakhe guih un; TOUPA'N Jakobte atanta a, Israelte ah akipahtawi ding hi."
TOUPA, noumau hon tanpa, sul a kipan noute hon bawlpa'n hichi in achi: "Kei zaw TOUPA, thil tengteng siampa, keimah kia a van kaipalhpa, liansakpa ka hi; kua ahia ka kiang a om?
"Kei lah zuautheite chiamtehnate bangmah lou a bawl a, aisan siamte mihai a bawlpa, mipilte nunglam ngasak a, atheihna uh haihuai a bawlpa.

"Asikha thu hihkip a, apalaite lemtheih tangtungsakpa, Jerusalem tungthu a, 'Huai ah mi a-om nawn ding uh, chipa leh Judah gam kho tungthu a, Bawl in a-om nawn chiat ding uh, asiatna lailai ka bawl nawn ding,' chipa.
Tui thuk mahmah kiang a, 'Kangtat in, na luite leng ka kangtatsak ding,' chipa.

"Kura tungthu a, 'Amah zaw ka belamchingpa ahi a, Jerusalem tungthu ah, Bawl in a-om nawn ding,' chih leh tempul kiang ah, 'Na suangphum lep in a-om nawn ding, chi khop hial in ka deihlam tengteng a hih ding,' chipa ka hi," chi in.

TOUPA'N athaunilh, Kura, namte ama a phukpai ding leh, kumpipate kawnggakte phelsak ding a, ama a kongkhakte honsak ding leh, kulh kongkhakte khak louh a omsak dingpa, akhut taklam ka letpa kiang ah, hichi in achi:
"Kei na ma ah ka pai ding a, aphok lailai ka kibangsak ding; dal kongkhak ka hihse vek ding a, akalhna siktawnte ka tansak ding;
TOUPA, na min a hon sampa, Israel' Pathian ka hi chih na theihtheihna ding in mial lak a goute ka hon pe ding a, mundai a sum selte leng ka hon pe ding.
Jakob ka sikhate leh Israel ka telte ziak in na min in ka hon sam a; hon thei ngei kei mah lechin na min ka hon phuahsak hi.
Keimah TOUPA ka hi, adang himhim a-om kei; keimah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei; hon thei ngei kei mah lechin na tai ka hon gaksak ding hi.
Keimah lou ngal adang a-om kei chih nisuahna lam a kipan leh tumlam a kipan atheihtheihna ding un. kei TOUPA ka hi, adang himhim a-om kei.
Vak ka bawl a, mial leng ka bawl hi; kituahna ka bawl a, siatna leng ka bawl hi; kei zaw TOUPA, huchibang thilte hih zelpa ka hi," chi in.
Vante aw, tunglam a kipan takkhesak un, van dumte'n diktatna sungsuk uhen; hotdamna adotkhiak theihna ding un lei kihong henla, diktatna toh poukhawm hen; kei, TOUPA'N huaite ka siam ahi.
Amah bawlpa kinakpihmi tung agik hi! Bellei in avel mi kiang ah, "Bang a hon bawl na hia?" achi dia hia? Ahihkeileh, nna na sep in, "Akhut in siam anei kei?" achi dia hia?
Apa kiang a, "Bang chi suang na hia?" chimi tung hiam, anu kiang a, "Bang toh ahia na hinkhiak ding?" chimi tung agik hi!
TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou, amau Bawlpa'n hichi in achi: "Thil hong tung ding thu hon dong unla; ka tapate leh ka khut nasepte ah thu hon pia un.
Leitung ka bawl a, atung a mihing omte leng ka siam hi; keimah in ka khut ngei in, van ka kaipalh a, asepaihte thu ka pia hi.

Kura diktatna nei in ka dingsak a, alampite teng ka tangsak ding; ama'n ka khopi abawl nawn ding a, atatna man uh deih ziak in hilou in, kipahman deih ziak leng hilou in, ka salte apawtsak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Aigupta semgimte leh Ethiopia sumsinmi leh Saviate misang pipite na kiang uah ahong pai ding ua, nou a ding in a-om ding ua; nou ahon zui ding ua; khainiang bun in ahi ahong pai ding uh; huchi in bokkhup in, Pathian noumau ah a-om hi; adang himhim a-om kei, pathian dang himhim a-om kei, chi in ahong thum ding uhi.
Israel' Pathian aw, Hondampa, Pathian kisel nakpa na hi ngut hi.
Zahlaktak in a-om ding ua, ahi, avek un zumtak in a-om ding uh; milim bawl mite zumna ah alut ding uh.
Israelte bel tangtawn hotdamna a TOUPA hotdam in a-om ding uh; tangtawn in na zahlak kei ding ua, na zumsak kei ding uhi.
TOUPA van siampa'n, amah Pathian, lei bawl a siampa ahi; ama'n lei akipsak a, bangmah lou ding in abawl kei a, mihing omna ding in abawl a, hichi in achi ngal a; Kei TOUPA ka hi; adang a-om kei.
Aguk in, mun mial ah, thu ka gen ngei kei a; Jakob suante kiang ah bangmah lou ding in hon zong un, ka chi ngei kei; kei TOUPA'N diktatna thu ka gen zel a, thudik mahmahte ka gen zel hi.
Kikhawm unla hong pai un; namte lak a gawtna pelte aw, hong pai nai chiat un; asing milim bawltawm tawi a, mi hondam theiloupi pathian kiang a thum zelte'n theihna himhim anei kei uh.

Gen unla, hon pawtkhesak un; ahi, kidong uhenla; nidanglai a kipan kua'n ahia theisak? Huai hun lai a kipan kua'n ahia gen? Kei TOUPA'N ka hih ahi kei maw? Keimah lou ngal Pathian dang a-om kei; Pathian diktat leh hondampa ka hi; keimah lou ngal adang a-om kei.
"Kawlmong a mi tengteng aw, kei lam hong nga unla, hotdam in om un; kei lah Pathian ka hi ngal a, adang himhim a-om kei.

Khuk chih ka ma ah akhukdin ding ua, lei chih in leng ka kiang ah kichiam in thu achiam ding chi in kei-le- kei kilou in ka kichiamta, thu lah diktatna in ka kam a kipan in apawtta a, ahong kik nawnta kei ding.
"Mi'n, TOUPA kia ah diktatna leh hatna a-om, chi in ka tanchin agen ding ua; amah kiang ah mi ahong pai ding ua, atung a lungkim lou tengteng zahlaktak in a-omta ding uh.
Israel suan tengteng TOUPA ah ahi, siamtansak a a-om ua, TOUPA asuan ding uh," chi in.
Bel akun a, Nebo akihihniam a; amilimte gamsa leh gan tung ah ana omta ua; na thil vakpihte uh vanpuak abawl ua, gamsa bah a ding in van puakgik dia bawl ahi lel hi.
Ana kihihniam un, ana kun chiat ua, van puakgik lah ahumbit thei ngal kei ua, amau mah sal a pi in a-om zawta uhi.
Jakob inkuanpihte leh, Israel inkuanpihte lak a khosuaksun tengteng aw, gil a kipan ka hon puak a, sul a pan a ka kithuahpihte aw, ka thu ngaikhia un.
Tekkun a na om tanpha un leng amah ka hi ding a, na lu ua kelsam apou vek hun chiang in leng ka hon pom ding hi; ke'n ka bawl a, kei mahmah in ka po ding; ahi, ke'n ka pom ding a, ka humbit ding.
Kibang a seh ka hihna ding un kua toh na hon teh a, kua kimpih in na hon bawl a, kua toh ahia na hon teh ding?
Zaip a kipan dangka-eng bungkhe zel dangka bukna a buk zelten, dangka-eng sekmi achial ua, ama'n huai pathian in abawl a, huchi in abokkhup ua, ahi, abe zel uhi.
Aliangzang uah apua ua, apaipih ua, a-omna a kipan asuan nawn kei ding; ahi, min amah asam ding ua, himahleh adawng thei kei ding, amangbatna ua kipan ahunkhe thei kei ding hi.
Talek mite aw, huai theigige unla, kipasalsak unla, theikhe nawn un,
Nidang a thil masate theigige un; kei Pathian ka hi a, adang a-om kei; kei Pathian ka hi, kei bang a-om kei;
Ke'n atawpna ding uh atung a kipan in ka gen a; pha ka sak adingsuak ding a, ka deihlam tengteng ka hih vek ding, ka chi hi;
Suahlam a kipan vasa duhgawl, khopi gamlapi a pan in ka miseh ka sam ding a; ahi, ka genta, ka tangtungsak ding; ka na tumta, ka hih ding.
Lungsim ki-uangsak, diktatna toh kigamlate aw, ka thu ngaikhia un;
Ka diktatna ka hon tawi nai a, gamla ah a-om kei ding, ka hotdamna in leng sawt ahal kei ding; huchi in ka thupina Israelte a ding in hotdamna Zion ah ka koih ding.
Babulon tanu nungak siangthou aw, hong suk inla, leivui ah tu in; Kaldai tanu aw, laltutphah tel lou in lei lak ah tu in; awm nou leh nuamsa hon chi nawn lou ding uhi.
Buh gawizanna suangte la inla, tangbuang bawl in; na kikhuhna puan koih inla, na tentual lem inla, na khe hong inla, luite ngap galkah in.
Na vuaktanna khuh louh in a-om ding a, ahi, na zahmoh adawk ding; phu ka la ding a, mi kuamah ka kithuahpih kei ding.
Ahon tanpa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA ahi, Israelte Mi Siangthou.
Kaldai tanu aw, dai dide in tu inla, mial nuai ah lut in, Gam chih lalnu hon chita kei ding uh TOUPA'N achi.
Ka mite tung ah ka heh a, ka goutan ka hihthanghuai a, na khut ah ka hon pia hi; nang atung uah zahngaihna na langsak kei a; tek lamte tung ah nangawn ah na hakkol giktak na nga ahi.
Kei tangtawn in lalnu ding in ka om ding, na chi a; huchi in huai thilte na lungsim in na ngaihtuah kei a, atawpna ding na theigige sam kei hi.
Huchi in nang nuamtat a om, awlmoh nei lou a om, lungsim a, "Keimah ka hi, keimah lou midang a-om kei, meithai in ka tu kei ding a, tate tan thu ka thei sam kei ding," chinu, hiai thei in;

Hiai thil nih, tate tanna leh meithaina in, ni khat thu in mitphiat kal lou in ahon pha ding a; na bumna zatna tamngial in, na kivenna tamkuam mahleh, huaite nakpitak in na tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
Na gitlouhna muang a; "Kuamah in hon mu kei uh," na chi vial ngal a; na pilna leh na theihna in hon hihsia hi; na lungsim in, "Keimah ka hi, kei lou midang a-om kei," na chi behlap hi.

Huaiziak in thil hoih lou na tung ah ahong tung ding a; na vengsiam kei ding; vangtahna in ahon buak ding a; huai na hihmang thei kei ding; siatna leng thakhat in na tung ah hong tung guih ding a; huai na theikhol kei ding.
Na kikauna leh bumna na zatna, valnou na hih a kipan a na kisukgimnate, dinpih inla; na phattuampih theih ding phot a, na zohpih theih ding photleh.
Na lemtheihna atam mahmah ziak in na gimta hi; tu in van thu theite, aksi en mite, kha teng a thugenkhol mite ding uhenla, na tung a thil hong tung dingte lak a kipan in hon hong uhen.
Ngai in, buhpawl bang lel ahi ding ua; mei in akang ding; meikuang thilhihtheihna lak a kipan akihumbit kei ding uh; hihlumna ding meihol bang ahi kei ding a, awi ding mei bang ahi sam kei ding.
Huchibang in na kihihgim nakna thilte nang a ding in a-om ding uhi; na naupan nou a kipan a na lak a sumsin mite amau lampi chiat ah avakmang ding ua; hon humbit ding kuamah himhim a-om kei ding uh.
Aw Jakob inkuan, Aw Israel min kikoppih, Judah tuite a pan a pawt, thutak hilou, diktatna ah hi sam lou, TOUPA min lou a kichiam a, Israel' Pathian min lou zelte aw, hiai ngaikhia un.
Khopi siangthou a mi akichi ngal ua, Israel' Pathian tung ah ginna anga ua; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
Atung a kipan in thil masate ka gen a; ahi, ka kam a kipan in apawt a, ka theisak a; thakhat in ka tangtungsak guih a, ahong tung hi.
Migenhak na hi uh, na ngawng uh sik tha ahi, na tal uh dal ahi chih ka theih ziak in,

Nidanglai a kipan na kiang uah ka genta; ahong tun ma in na kiang uah ka hon theisakta hi; huchi lou in zaw, "Ka milim in ahih ahi, ka milim bawltawm leh ka milim sun in thu apiak ahi,” na chi kha ding uh.
"Na zata uh, hiaite tengteng en un, noumau na genta kei ding ua hia? Tua kipan in thil thak ka hon theisak ding a, thil kisel na theih ngeilouhte uh.
Huaite nidanglai a siam hilou in, tu a siam ahi; tuni ma in na bil un na za ngei kei uh; huchi lou in zaw, 'Ngai in, huaite i theihsa ahi, na chi kha ding uh.’

Ahi, na bil un na za ngei kei ua; ahi, na lungsim un na thei ngei kei uh, ahi, nidanglai a kipan in na bil uh hon in a-om ngei kei him hi; lepchiahtak in na hih zel uh chih leh, sul a kipan in talek mi ahon chi him uh chih lah ka thei ngal a.
"K'on hihmanlouhna ding in ka min ziak in ka hehna ka hawi lai ding a, phat ka lohna ding in na tung uah ka kidek ding.
Ngai un, ka hon hihsiang ahi, himahleh dangka hihsiang bang in ahi kei; haksatna haltuina mei ah ka hon chian hi.
Kei leh kei ziak in, ahi, kei leh kei ziak lel in ahi ka hih ding; bang ding in ka min suksiat in a-om dia? Ka thupina midang kiang ah ka pe kei ding.
Jakob leh ka sap Israel aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; kei amah ka hi; amasapen ka hi, ananungpen leng ka hi.
Ahi, ka khut in lei kingakna aphum a, ka khut taklam in avante akaipalh a; ka saptak in adingkhawm zel uh.
"Noute aw, kikhawm unla, ngaikhia un; alak uah kua'n hiai thil agen dia? TOUPA'N amah a-it a; ama'n Babulon tung ah adeihlam ahih ding a, Kaldaite tung ah aban lik in a-om ding.
Kei, keimah ngei in, thu ka genta; ahi, amah ka sam a, ka pi a, alampi alamzangsak ding.
Noute'n hon naih unla, hiai ngaikhia un; atung a kipan in asim in thu ka gen ngei kei; a-om tung lai a kipan in huai ah ka om; tu in Toupa PATHIAN in keimah leh ama Kha hon sawlta hi."
TOUPA, nou hon tanpa, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi: "Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh, na hoihna ding ua hon chilpa, na paina ding lampi ua hon pipa ka hi."
"Aw noute'n ka thupiakte na ngaikheta hi le uchin, na tung ua lemna lui bang mai a om ding a, na diktatna uh tuipi kihawtte bang mai a om ding hiven maw;
Na suante uh piaunel zah pha ding ua, na gil ua gahte leng piaunel mal neu chikchik zah a pha ding ua; amin uh ka ma a kipan thaimang in a-om kei ding, hihman in leng a om sam kei ding," chi in.
"Babilon a kipan pawt unla, Kaldaite taimangsan un; hiai lasak husa in genzak in, hilh unla, kawlmong pha in gingsak un, TOUPA'N asikha Jakobte atanta!" chi un.
Gamdai a api lai in adangtak kei ua; suangpi a pan in amaute a ding in tuite aluangkhesak a; suangpi aphelkhap a, huchi in tui ahong pawtkhia hi.
"TOUPA'N, mithulimloute a ding in muanna himhim a-om kei," achi hi.
Tuikulh a gamte aw, ka thu ngaikhala, gamlapi a michih aw, ngaikhia un; TOUPA'N sul a kipan ahon sap ka hi; ka nu gilsung a pan in ka min agenta hi.
Ka kam namsau hiam bang in abawl a, akhut ah ahon sel a; thal nawttet vilvel in hon bawl a, athalbawm ah ahon khum a;
Ka kiang ah, "Nang zaw ka sikha na hi; Israel pahtawi a ka omna ding na hi,” achi a.
