Ke'n bel, "Athawn in ka semgim a, bangmah lou ding leh huihkhua lel ding in ka thapai; himahleh pel lou in ka tung a vaihawmna ding TOUPA kiang ah ahi a-om, hon ditna ding leng ka Pathian kiang ah ahi a-om," ka chi a.

Huan tu in TOUPA, Jakobte akiang a pi nawnna ding leh Israelte akiang pikhawm a a-omna ding un, asikha a om ding a sul a kipan a hon bawlpa'n agen, TOUPA mitmuh in mizahtakhuai ka hi ngal a, ka Pathian ka hatna ahi behlap hi.

Ahi, ama'n, "Jakob namte tundinna ding leh Israelte lak a humbitte a-omsak nawnna ding in, ka sikha a na om zaw, thil neuchik mahmah ahi lai; Zentelte vaksakpa ding in ka hon sep ding, kawlmong pha a hondampa dia na omtheihna ding in," achi a.

TOUPA, Israelte tanpa leh a Mi Siangthou un, mite muhsitpa, namte kih tuntun, vaihawmte sikha kiang ah hichi in achi: "Muanhuai TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou, nang hon telpa ziak in Kumpipate'n amu ding ua, athou ding uh; miliante'n amah abe ding uh," chi in.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hun kipahhuai ah ka hon dawng a, hotdamna ni ah ka hon panpih hi; ka hon hawi ding a, mipite thukhunna ding in ka hon pe ding, lei dingkipsak a, gouluah nutsiatsa luahsak ding in;
Suangkul tangte kiang a, Pawt un, mial a omte kiang a, Hong kilang un, na chih theihna ding in. Lampite ah ane zel ding ua, tang sang mai pengpongte ah atatna mun uh a-om ding hi.
Agilkial un adangtak kei ding ua; kholum a bawlgim in ni in leng ahai sam kei ding hi; amaute itpa in api ding a, tui nak nei kiang ah api ding hi.
"Huchi in ka tang tengteng lampi ding in ka bawl ding a, ka lamliante leng sansak in a-om ding uh.
En in, hiaite gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai ding ua; en in hiaite mallam a kipante, tumlam a kipante in ahong pai ding uh; Sinim gam a kipan in ahong non pai ding uhi.
Vante aw, nuamtak in la sa un; lei aw, nuamsa in om in; tangte aw, la sakhe guih un; TOUPA'N lah amite alungmuan ngal a, a mi haksa thuakte leng ahehpih ding hi.
Himahleh Zion in, "Jehovah in ahon paisan a, TOUPA'N ahon mangngilhta," achi hi.
"Numei in atapa, agilgah ngei, hehpihlouhna ding in anau nawi ne lai amangngilh thei a hia! Thei e, huaite'n zaw amangngilh uh ahi thei, himahleh ke'n zaw ka hon mangngilh kei ding hi.
En in, ka khutpek ah ka hon gelh a; na kulhbaangte ka ma ah a-om gige hi.
Na tate akin ua, hon hihmang mite leh hon hihse mite'n ahon pawtsan ding uh.

Dak inla, en vialvial inla, en in; hiai tengteng akikhawm ua, na kiang ah ahong pai uhi. Kei ka hin bang in, nang pahtawina kisilh bang in hiaite na kisilh a, mou akigak bang in hiaite in na kigak ngei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
"Na mun sia leh nutsiatsate leh na gam hihmansa thu zaw tu in a-omte a ding in na neu lota ngeingei ding a, nang hon valhte gamlapi ah a-omta ding uh.
Na ta mansak nung a na ta neih nawnte'n, 'Kei a ding in mun aneu lua a; ka omna ding in mun hon pia in,' chi in na bil ah ahon gen ding uh.

Huchi in nang na lungsim in: 'Hiaite kua'n hon suaksak ua eita? Ka tate ka mangsak a, keimah kia sal a vialvak ka hi a; huchi in hiaite kua'n akem ua eita? Ngai in, keimah kia a nutsiat in ka om ngal a, hiaite koi a na om uh ahia? na chi ding, " chi in.

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, namte a ding a khut zak in, michih a ding in ka chiamtehna ka takkhe ding; huchi in na tapate angpom in na kiang ah ahon pi ding ua, na tanute leng liangkolou a suan a pi in a-om ding uh.

Kumpipate na tate donpate ahi ding ua, kumpinute na tate donnute ahi ding uh; amau amai ua lei si in ahon be ding ua, na khe a leivui aliak ding uh; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei mai ding, hon ngak mite zahlak in a-om kei ding uh.
"Gallakte mihattak a kipan suh a om in, sal lauhuaite hotkhiak in a-om ding uam?"
Om na ke, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Mihattak salte suh in a-om ding ua, milauhuai gallakte hotkhiak in a-om ding; nang hon doute dou ding ka hi ngal a, na tate leng ka hondam ding hi.

Nang hon simmohte amau sa ka nesak ding; uain khum kham bang in amau sisan akham ding uh; huchi in mi tengteng in, kei TOUPA nangmah Hondampa leh nangmah Tanpa, Jakob Mihat ka hi chih, athei ding uh," chi in.
Ka it luat thu, agrephuan tungtang thu, ka it luat a ding in la in ka sata mai ding. Ka it luat in lei hoihna mahmah mual ah grephuan anei hi.

Akimvel in lei atoukuak a, asuangte atomsiang a, grepgui hoihpen asuan a, alai ah insang alam a, huai ah grep sukna khuk leng atou hi. Huchi in grep gah a gah ding in alamen a, himahleh grep tak lou ahong gah maimah hi.
Tu in, Jerusalem a omte leh Judah mite aw, "Hehpih in kei leh ka grephuan kal thu hon ngaihtuah dih ve ua.
Tua grephuan ah ka hihsa akan-aval atung ah hih nawn lailai ding bangbang om ahita mai a? Bangziak in ahia, grep gah a gah ding a ka lamet et toh, grep tak lou ahong gah maimah?
"Tu in ngai un, ka grephuan tung ah ka hih ding ka hon hilh ding; aling dai ka lamang ding a, nekgaih in a-om ding; asuangdai ka chimsak ding a, sikden in a-om ding.
Huan ka hihse vek ding a; satnou in om ke'n chin, tohvui in leng om sam ke'n teh; loulingnei leh khaulingneite apou zaw ding; meite leng atung a vuah zusak lou ding in thu ka pe ding," achi hi.

Sepaihte' TOUPA grephuan Israel inkuanpihte ahi a, Judah mite akung deihhuai ahi uhi. Vaihawmna diktat alamen a; himahleh, ngai in, nuaisiahna ahong om zawta ahi; diktatna alamen a, himahleh, ngai in, kikou husa ahong om zawta hi.
Gam laizang a amau kia a-omtheihna ding ua mi om samna ding mun himhim om lou khop hial a inn leh inn kizomsak zel leh lou leh lou kizom sakte tung agik hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N ka bil ah hichibang in achi, “Innte tampi, lian pipite kilawm pipi, ateng ding om lou in ahawm vek ngeingei ding.
Grephuan tin sawm mun ah bath khat kia suak ding in akisa a, buhchi homer khat tuh in ephah khat kia suak ding in lah akisa ngal a," chi in.
Zu delh ding a zingkhang pipi a thou a, uain in akhamgawpsak mateng zan sawt pipi tan a-omsakte atung uh agik hi.
Tumging leh kaihgingte, khuangta leh tamngaite, uain toh ankuangluinate uah a-om sek a, himahleh TOUPA nasep angaisang kei ua, akhut thilhihte leng, angaihtuah ngei kei uhi.
Huaiziak in ka mite zaw, theihna aneih louh ziak un, sal a pi in a-om ua; amizahtakhuaite uh gil akial a, amipite uh dangtak in adang uh akeugawpta hi.
Huaiziak in Sheol in agilkialna ana liansak a, akam teh vual louh khop in akata a; huchi in athupinate uh, amipite uh, athupina mahmahte un, alak ua kipaktak a omte toh alutsuk ngoingoi uhi.
Mineute kunsak in a-om ua, miliante niamsak in a-om ua, kisatheite sukniam in a-omta uhi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA bel vaihawmna a tawisang in a-om zawta, Pathian, Mi Siangthou, diktatna a hihsiangthou in a-omta hi.
Huan belamnoute atatna mun ua ata bang un ata diamdiam ding ua, mithau pipite mun sesa a thilte vakvaite'n ane ding uhi.
Zuautheihna khaute a thulimlouhna kai a, khauzen a kangtalai kaih bang a khelhna kai sekte tung agik hi!
I muhna ding in hih meng henla, athilhih ding hihkin heh; i theihna ding in Israelte Mi Siangthou lemtheih hong nai in hong tung hen, chi gigete ngei.
Thil hoih lou thil hoih chi a, thil hoih lah thil hoih lou chi zel a, vak mial a ngai a, mial vak a ngaisek a, thil khum thil kha a ngai a, thil kha thil khum a ngaisekte atung uh agik hi.
Amau pil a kingaihtuahte leh amau mitmuh a teite atung uh agik hi!
Uain dawn lam a mihattak, zu hel lam a thagui nei mite atung uh agik!
Golh nek ziak a migilou siamtangsak sek a, midiktat diktatna laksak sekte ngei.

Huaiziak in meikuang in buhpawl aliah bei dundun sek bang in leh loupa keu meikuang a apuk zungzung sek bang in azung ua muatna bang in a-om ding a, apak uh leivui bang in atungkah lunglung ding; Sepaihte' TOUPA dan adeih louh ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou thu angaihneu ziak un.

Huaiziak in TOUPA amite tung ah aheh mahmah a, atung uah akhut alik a, avua a, huchi in mualte ah aling vonvon ua, aluangte uh kongzing lak ah nin bulom bang in a-om venvon hi. Huchi tel a ahih in leng ahehna lah adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
Gamlatak a om namte a ding in chiamtehna atakkhe ding a, kawlmong a kipan sam ding in asingsit ding; huchi in ngai in, amaute kintak in ahong pai pah ding uh.
Amau lak ah kuamah agim kei ding ua, akisui sam kei ding uh; kuamah alusu kei ding ua, a-ihmu sam kei ding uh; akawnggak uh lah phelkol in a-om kei ding a, akhedap gakna leng atan sam kei ding hi.
Athalte uh azum mahmah a, athalpeu tengteng uh lai sa in a-om keukou a; asakol chinte uh meisah suang abang a, akangtalai khete uh leng pingpei abang hi.

Ahusa ging honhon uh humpinelkai humham bang mai ahi. Humpinelkai lun lai humham bang mai in aging honhon hi; ahi, aging honhon a, asamat ding uh aman ua, bittak in apaimangpih ua, kuamah in ahunkhe thei kei hi.
Huai ni in tuipi ging hawhaw bang in atung uah aging hawhaw ding uh. Huchi in mi'n gam ahon et uleh, ngai in, mial leh mangbatna ngen ahi a, vak lah huai ameite a hihmial in a-om hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na nu uh makna lai, ka makna, koi a om ahia? Ahihkeileh, ka leibatnate akua pen kiang ah ahia ka hon zuaktak? Ngai un, na thulimlouhnate uh ziak a na nu uh mak a om ahi.

"Bangziak in ahia ka hong pai a mi himhim a-om louh uh? Bangziak in ahia ka sap a hon dawng ding a-om louh uh? Ka khut hotdam theih louh ding in tomsak in a-om himhim a hia? Ahihkeileh, humbit ding in thilhihtheihna ka nei kei a hia? Ngai un, ka salhna in tuipi ka kangsak a, luipite gamkeu in ka bawl hi; tui himhim a-om louh ziak in angasate a-uih ua, dangtak in asi uh.
"Van mial in ka thuam a, akhuhna ding in sai-ip puan ka bawl zel," chi in.
Mi gimtak thu a ka tawldamsak siamna ding in sinsakte lei Toupa PATHIAN in ahon pia; ama'n zingsang teng a phawng in, sinsakte atheih bang ua thei ding in ka bil aphawng zel.
Toupa PATHIAN in ka bil ahon vangsak a, kei zaw ka hel kei, ka lehngat sam kei hi.
Ka nungzang sat mite ka doh a, ka biang mul bot mite ka doh hi; zahlakna ah leh chilsiatna ah ka mai ka sel kei.
Toupa PATHIAN in ahon panpih ding a; huaiziak in ka zum kei a; huaiziak in meisah suang bang in ka nga zel a, ka zahlak kei ding chih ka thei.
Siam hon tangsakpa anai hi; kua'n ahia hon dou ding? Dingkhawm ni ung; hon dou kua ahia? Hon naih mah hen aw.
Ngai in, Toupa PATHIAN in hon panpih ding; kua'n ahia siam louh hon tangsak ding? Ngai in, huaite puansilh bang in alui ding ua, kausi in anese ding.
Na lak ua, TOUPA kihta a, asikha thu mang, kua ahia? Mial nuai a khosa, vakna himhim nei lou in TOUPA min muang henla, a Pathian ah kinga hen.
Mei toh a, mei-ekte a ki-umte aw, ngai un; na meikuang uah leh na mei-ek halte uh lak ah vak un. Hiai ka khut a kipan a na muh ding uh ahi hi; lungkhamtak a na lupna ding uh.
Diktatna delh mite, "Nou, TOUPA zong mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un: noute sekna suangpi lam leh noute tohkhiakna kokhuk lam en un.
Na pu uh Abraham lam leh noute hon suangnu Sarah lam en un; khat kia ahih lai in ka sam a, ka vualzawl a, mi tampi ding in ka bawlta hi.

"Na TOUPA'N Zion alungmuanta ngal a; amun sesate tengteng alungmuan a, Eden bang in agamdai abawl a, agamkeu leng TOUPA huan bang in abawl hi; huai ah kipahna leh nopsaknate, kipahthu genna leh lasak husate a-om ding hi.
"Ka mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia unla; ka namte aw, ka thu bil na doh un; kei a pan in dan thu ahong pawt ding a, michih vakna ding in ka vaihawmna ka kipsak ding.
Ka diktatna anai a, ka hotdamna apawtta, ka bante'n michih vai ahawmsak ding, tuikulh gamte'n ahon ngak ding ua, ka ban amuang ding uh.

Van lam ah daktou unla, nuailam ah lei en un; van meikhu bang in azammang ding a, puansilh bang in leitung alui ding, asung a omte huchibang in asi ding uh; ka hotdamna bel tangtawn in a-om ding, ka diktatna leng hihman in a-om kei ding.
"Diktatna theimi, ka dan thu lungtang a pai mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; mihing gensiatna lau kei unla, ahon tainate uh ziak in lunghimoh kei un.
Sim in puansilh anekgawp vek bang in, amaute anegawp vek ding, nget in samul anek bang in, amaute ane ding; ka diktatna tangtawn in a-om ding a, ka hotdamna suan tengteng tan in a-om ding.
"AW TOUPA ban aw, halh inla, hatna kisilh in; nidanglai a, tang a suante om lai a na halh bang in halh in. Nang Rahab satzanpa, dragon sunpa na hi kei a hia?
Nang tuipi, tui thuk zapi tui kangsakpa, tatsate paisuakna lampi ding a tuipi taw bawlsakpa na hi kei a hia?
TOUPA tatsate akik nawn ding ua, la sa kawm in Zion atung ding ua; tangtawn a kipahna alutung uah a-omta ding; kipahna leh nopsakna amu ding ua, lungkhamna leh mauna amangta ding.
"Kei, kei mahmah, nou lungmuanpa ka hi; si ding mihing kihta ding, loupa bang a bawl ding mihing tapa kihta ding nang kua hi na hia;
Na TOUPA nang hon Bawlpa, van kaipalh a lei kingaknate phumpa, mangngilh a, nuaisiahmi hihse ding a angim lai hehna ziak lel a nitum a lau? Nuaisiah mi hehna koi a om ahita a?
Sal pimang kintak a khah in a-om ding a, suangkul ah asi kei dia, an nek ding atasam kei ding hi.
"Kei na TOUPA na Pathian, tuipi kihot ging honhonte khen a tuipi tokletpa ka hi ngal a; ka min sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
Van ka kaihpalh a, lei kingaknate ka phum theih a, Zionte kiang a, ka mite na hi uh, ka chih theihna ding in ka thute na kam ah ka koih a, ka khut in ka hon hum hi.
Jerusalem aw, Na TOUPA khut a kipan ahehna nou dawnnu, halh inla, thou in; nang hoihoina nou a anengte na dawn a, na dawn siang sipsip hi.
Atapa suan tengteng lak a pi ding kuamah a-om kei ua; atapa vaklet teng lak ah akhut a len kuamah a-om kei uh.
"Hiai thil nihte'n ahon phat ahi; kua'n ahon kahpih ding ua? Gamna leh siatna leh kial, leh namsau; bangchi in ka hon lungmuan diam aw?
Na tapate abah ua, sathak len a awk bang in, kongzing lu lam ah alum uhi; TOUPA hehna leh na Pathian salhna in adim uhi.
"Huaiziak in nang hihgentheih leh uain kham hilou a mi kham, hiai za in.
Na TOUPA Jehovah, na Pathian, amite thu genpihpa'n, hichi in achi, 'Ngai in, hoihoina nou, ka hehna nou belhbu ngei, na khut a kipan ka lakheta; na dawn nawnta kei ding,'

Huchi in nang hon hihgentheite khut ah ka koih ding; mamau na hinna kiang ah, 'K'on tot ding un bokkhup un,' achi uh; huchi in atawn mite kiang ah na nungzang lei leh kongzing bang in na doh," chi in.
Zion aw, halh in, halh in, na hatna silh in; Jerusalem aw, khopi siangthou, na puansilh kilawmtakte silh in; tuban zeksum louh leh minin na sung ah alutta kei ding uh.
Jerusalem aw, na tung a bang leivui sing in; thou inla, tu in; Zion tanu aw, sal a om, na ngawng gaknate phel in.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a: "Bangmah lou a zuak na hi ua; huchi in dangka lou a tat na hita ding uh," chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ka mite atung in Aigupta gam a om ding in apaisuk ua; Assuria mite'n athu-ala bei in anuaisiah uhi.
Tu a, ke'n hiai a bang ahia ka neih?" "Ka mite bangmah lou in pimang in a-om ua," TOUPA'N achi. Atung ua vaihawmte nuam in a-awng ua, TOUPA'N achi, "Ni tumtum in ka min gensiat in a-om hi.
Huaiziak in ka mite'n ka min athei ding uh; huai ni in agenpa ka hi chih athei ding ua; ngai in, keimah ka hi," chi in.
Tangte a tanchinhoih tun a, lemna thu tangkoupih a, thil hoih tanchinhoih tun a, hotdamna thu tangkoupih a, Zion kiang a, "Na Pathian kumpi in atu, chimi khe akilawm hi!
Ngai in! na galvil mite'n aw suah in, nuamsatak in la asa chiat uh; TOUPA Zion a ahong kik nawn chiang a kimaituah a mu ding ahi ngal ua.
Jerusalem mun sesate aw, nuam sakhe guih unla, nuamsatak in la sa un; TOUPA'N amite alungmuanta a, Jerusalem atanta hi.
TOUPA'N nam chih mitmuh in aban siangthou alemta; huchi in kawlmong a mi tengteng in i Pathian hotdamna amu ding uh.
Pawt un, pawt un, huai a kipan in pawt un, thilnin himhim lawng kei un; asung a kipan paikhia un; TOUPA belsuan tawite aw, siangthoutak in om un.
Kintak in na paikhe kei ding ua, taikek in na pai sam kei ding uh; TOUPA'N na ma uh pi ding ahi ngal a; Israel' Pathian na nungdal uh ahi ding hi.
Ngai in, ka sikha in piltak in ahih ding, pahtawi leh tawisang in a-om ding a, sangpi in a-om ding.
Mi tampi'n lamdang honsak bang un, amel mihing mel sang in asesak zaw a, apiandan lah mihing tate piandan sang mah ahihsiat in a-om.
Huchi in ama'n nam tampi tung ah sisan atheh ding; Kumpipate'n amah lak ah akam uh achih ding uh; akiang ua gen ngei louh amu ding ua; bil a azak ngei louh uh angaisiam ding uhi.
I thugen uh kua'n agingta a? TOUPA khut kua kiang ah ahia akihil?

Ama ah thilpou noutak bang in amah lah adawnkhia a, lei keu a pan zung bang in akhangkhia hi; piandan hoihna leh mel kilawmna himhim anei kei a; amah i muh un amah i deihna ding un kilawmna himhim a-om kei hi.
Amah mihingte muhsit leh deih louh in a-om a; dahnate neimi leh natna thei mi ahi a; amah lak a i mai uh sel bang i hi ua, muhsit in a-om a, e'n lah amah i ngaisang tuan kei uhi.
Ama'n i natnate pua in, i dahnate leng apo ngei a; himahleh e'n bel dahna khu, Pathian vuak, hihgentheih in i bawl ngal ua.
Ahih hang in i tatleknate ziak in amah liam in a-om a, i thulimlouhnate ziak in vuak sidup in a-om a; i lungmuanna ding in atung ah sawina akia a; avuakna golhte a hihdam in i omta hi.
I vek un belam bang in i vakmang ua; eimah lampi tuam chiat uah i pialta uh; TOUPA'N amah tung ah i vek ua thulimlouhna angata hi!
Amah nuaisiah in a-om a, himahleh akingainiam a, akam aka kei; belamnou goh ding api uh bang leh, belam amulmet mite ma a adai dide bang mai in; ahi, akam aka kei hi.
Nuaisiahna leh vaihawmna a lakmang in a-om a; adam tonpihte'n houh kua'n ahia mihing gam a kipan hihman a a-om ngaihtuah mahmah? Ka mite tatlekna ziak a dahna khu ahih.
Huan hiamgam ahih ngei kei a, akam ah zekhemna om ngei kei mahleh, ahan migiloute kiang ah asehsak ua, asih nung in mihausa kiang ah a-om hi.

TOUPA'N, amah vuak sidup a-ut him ahi; adahsakta ngei a; ahinna khelhna a dia thillat ding a na zat peuhpeuh chiang in, achisuan amuta ding a, adamsung nite asausak ding, TOUPA deihlam akhut ah lohching in a-om ding hi.
Akha nauvei gim gah amu ding a, alungkimta ding; ka sikha diktattak in atheihna in mi tampi'n siam atang ding ua, athulimlouhnate uh apuaksak ding.

Huaiziak in miliante tantuan amah ka hawm ding a, gallak sumte ama'n mihatte ahawm sam ding hi; ahinna pen si khop hial a asunbuak a, talekte lak a simtel a a-om ziak in; himahleh mi tampi khelhna apua a, talekte athumsak hi.
"Aw chiing, nang ta nei ngei lou, nuamsatak in la sa in; nang, nauvei ngei lou, la sakhe guih in, kikoukhia in; pasal neimi tate sang in lunglengnu tate lah atamzaw ngal ua," TOUPA'N achi.
Na puanin mun kek in, na omnate puanin tung kaipalh in; chil ke'n; na khaute sausak inla, na kaihgakna khette kipsak in.
Taklam leh veilam ah na dalhzak sin ngal a; huchi in na chisuante'n namte' gou aluah ding ua, khopi loih sa nungte ah mi a- omsak nawn ding uh.
"Lau ke'n, na zahlak kei ding; zum sam ke'n, zahlak in na om sin kei hi; na tuailai zahlakna na mangngilh in, na meithaina minsiatna na theigigeta kei ding hi.
Nang hon bawlpa na pasal ahi a; amin sepaihte' TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou nang hon tanpa ahi; amah leitung pumpi Pathian achi ding uh.
"Zi mak lungsim a lungkhamtak, tuailai zi khensa, paihsa nung sap nawn bang in TOUPA'N nang ahon sam ahi, na Pathian in achi hi.
Mitphiat kal lel ka hon ma a; himahleh hehpihna thupitak in ka hon pi nawn ding.
Ka heh dimlet in mitphiat kal na lak ah ka mai ka sel a; himahleh tangtawn zahngaihna in ka hon hehpih ding," TOUPA nang hon Tanpa'n achi hi.

"Huai lah kei a ding in Noah dam lai nite bang ahi a; Noah tuite'n leitung atummang nawn kei ding, chi a, ka kichiam bang in, Na tung ah ka heh nawn kei ding a, ka hon sal nawn kei ding, chi in ka kichiamta ahi.

Tangte apaimang ding ua, mual neute leng suan in a-om ding uh; ka zahngaihna ahihleh nang a kipan in apaimang kei ding a, ka lemna thukhun leng suan in a-om sam kei ding," TOUPA hon hehpihpa'n achi hi.
"Aw nang hihgentheih, tuikihot sepsep, lungmuanna nei lou, ngai in na suangte zehoih in ka lem ding, na suangphumte sapphir suang in ka lem ding hi.
Na tungzumte rubi suang in, na kongkhakte karbankul suang in, na kulh tengteng suang hoihte in ka bawl ding.
"Na ta tengteng TOUPA chil in a-om ding ua; na tate lungmuanna thupitak ahi ding.
Diktatna a kipsak in na om ding a, nuaisiahna a pan gamlapi ah na om ding, na lau kei ding hi; thil mulkimhuai a pan gamlapi ah na om ding a, ahon naih kei ding hi.
Ngai in, ahong kikhawm uh ahi thei, himahleh ka thu ahi kei ding; nang sual ding a kikhawm peuhmahte nang ziak in apuk ding uh.
"Ngai in, ke'n siksekmi pumzap anasepna ding vanzat sek zel mi ka siam a; kei mahmah in hihse ding in hihsemi ka siam ding hi.
Nang sualna ding avanzat sek himhim aphatuam kei ding; lei chih thubuai a nang hon lang siam louh na tangsak ding a, Huai TOUPA sikhate goutan ahi a, adiktatna uh ka kiang a kipan ahi," TOUPA'N achi.
Ngai un, dangtak peuhmahte aw, tuite ah hong pai un, dangka neiloute; hong pai unla, lei unla ne un! Ahi, hong pai unla, uain leh nawitui dangka pe lou in, aman leng pe lou in lei un.
An hiloupi a bang ding a dangka pai? Niang leh taina hilou a bang ding a na tha uh pai? Ka thuhoihtak in ngaikhia unla, thil hoih ne un, na hinna uh thil thau in nuamsa hen.
Na bil uh doh unla, ka kiang ah hong pai un; za unla, huchi in na hinna uh ahing ding; na kiang uah tangtawn thu ka khung ding, David kiang a huai hehpihna chiamte.
Ngai in, michih a ding in amah palai in ka sep a, michih a ding in makai leh heutu in ka sep ahi.
Ngai in, na theih ngei louh na sam ding a, nang hon thei ngei lou namte na kiang ah ahong tai ding uh, TOUPA na Pathian ziak leh Israelte Mi Siangthou ziak in; ama'n ahon pahtawi ngal a.
Muh theih a a-om lai in TOUPA zong unla, anai lai in amah sam un;

Migilou in a-omdan tawpsan henla, midiktat lou in angaihtuahnate tawpsan sam hen; TOUPA kiang ah kik nawn hen, huchi in ama'n atung ah zahngaihna asuah ding; i Pathian kiang uah kik nawn hen, ama'n angaidam mahmah ding hi.
Ka ngaihtuahte na ngaihtuahte ahi kei a, na omdante leng ka omdan ahi sam kei, TOUPA'N achi.
Leitung sang a vante asa zawk bang in, ka omdante na omdan sang in asangzaw hi, ka ngaihtuahte leng na ngaihtuahte uh sang in asang lai hi.
Vuah leh vuk van a kipan azu a, huai lam ah akiktou ngei kei, lei avak zaw hi, thil apousak in adawnsak a, buhchi thehmi kiang ah buhchi apia a, nemi kiang ah nek ding ape zel hi.
Huchi mah bang in ka kam a kipan ka thupawt a-om ding; bangmah hih nei lou in ka kiang ah akik nawn kei ding a, ka deih bang ahihzou zaw ding a, thilhih ding a ka sawlna ah leng alohching ding.
Nuam satak a pawt in, lungmuangtak a pikhiak a om ding na hi ngal ua; tangte leh mual neute'n na ma uah la asakhe guih ding uh, gamlak sing tengteng in leng akhut uh abeng ding uh.
Loulingnei tang in meilah apou zaw ding a, khaulingnei tang in muising apou zaw ding; huai TOUPA minhoihna ding leh tangtawn chiamtehna hihman a om lou ding ahi ngal a.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Vaihawm zui unla, diktak in hih un; ka hotdamna ahong tung dek in, ka diktatna ahong tung dekta hi.
Huchibang hihmi leh huaitak pom geih mihing tapa in nuam asa hi; Sabbath buahsak a, tang zel leh hoih lou hih lou ding a akhut venghoihmi ngei."
Huan gamdangmi, TOUPA toh kizommi in, TOUPA'N amite lak ah hon hihtuam ding, chi keileh; michilgeh in, “En in, singkeu ka hi, chi sam keileh.
Ka Sabbathte tang a, ka kipahpih lam thilte tel a, ka thukhun pomkip michilgehte tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a;
akiang uah ka insung leh ka kulh sungte a tanu leh tapa neite sang mah in theihgigena hoihzaw leh minhoihzaw ka pe ding; akiang uah tangtawn min, hihman nawn louh ding, ka pe ding," chi in.
"Gamdang mite leng, Sabbath tang lou lou a, tang zel leh ka thukhun pomkip peuhmah, TOUPA nasem ding leh TOUPA min it ding leh asikhate a om ding a TOUPA toh kizom peuhmahte;

amaute mah ka tang siangthou ah ka pi ding a, ka thumna inn ah nuam ka sasak ding; halmang a athillatte uleh akithoihnate uh ka maitam a kipahpih in a-om ding; ka inn michih a ding a thumna inn chi ding uh ahi ngal a," chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN, delhkhiak Israelte pikhawmpa'n, "Amah a pikhawm a omte lou leng namdangte akiang ah ka pikhawm lai ding," achi hi.
Gamsa tengteng aw, ahi, gamnuai a sa om tengteng aw, ne ding in hong pai un.
Agalvil mite amit uh ataw a, theihna nei lou ngen ahi ua; ui aw nei lou ngen ahi ua, ana thei kei uh; mang nei a, lum gige a, lup hai mi ahi uh.
Ahi, amaute ui duhgawlte ahi ua; hunsak chih anei ngei kei uh; theihsiamna nei lou belampu ahi ua, avekpi un amau lampi, amau punna lam chiat anga uhi.
"Hong pai un," chi in "Uain ka la ding a huchi in zu in i kithundim ding; zingchiang tuni bang ahi nawn ding a, ni thupi mahmah ahi ding," achi chiat uhi.
Midiktat amang zel a, kuamah in alungsim un angaihtuah kei uh, Pathian limsak mite lakmang in a-om ua, midiktat thil hoih lou hong tung ding a kipan lakmang ahi uh chih kuamah in angaihtuah kei uhi.
Lungmuanna ah alut ua; alupnate uah alum tawldam zel ding uh, diktak a pai peuhmahte.
Himahleh nou bumsiamnu tapa, angkawm leh kizuak suante aw, hiai ah hon naih un.
Nuihza bawlna dia na zat zel uh kua eita? Kua na maiphen khum ua, na lei khatkhum ua? Tatlekna ta, zuautheihna suante na hi kei uh maw?
Nou tosaw lak a, singbuk nuai teng a milimte toh kithoh a suangpi kawl lak nuai a phaizang sung a naupang that zelte.
Lui Phaizang suang mam lak ah na tantuan a-om a; huaite, huaite ngeingei na tantuan ahi; huaite a ding in dawn thillat na sung a, thilpiak na lan hi. Huai thil ah hihlungkim in ka om ding hia?
Tang sang zou mahmah tung ah na lupna na koih a; huai lai mah ah kithoihna lan ding in na hohtou zel hi.

Huan kongkhakte leh kongbiang liahte ah na theihgigena na tung a; kei a ding hilou in midang a ding in na kisuah a, na hohtou ngal a; na lupna na kek a, akiang uah thu na khung a; alupna uh lah na muhna ah na it hi.
Huan sathau toh kumpipa kiang ah na hoh a, na gimlimte lah na bawl thupi diakdiak a, gamlapi ah na palaite na sawl a, sheol pha hial in na niamsak hi.
Na paina lampi sau ziak in na gim a; himahleh, “Lametna himhim a-om kei, na chi ngal kei a; na hatna halhsakna na mu a; huaiziak in na bahta kei hi.
"Kua na kihta in na lau, zuau na gen nak a, kei na hon theih tak louh a, na lungsim a na ngaihtuah tak louh mai? Sawtpi ka dai dide kei maw? Kihtak leng na hon kihtak louh, TOUPA'N achi.
Na diktatna leh na thilhihte ka gen ding; bangmah lah na loh tak kei dia.
Na kikou chiang in na lak khawmte'n hon humbit uheh; himahleh huih in amaute ala ding a, hu in amut vek ding; kei hon muang in bel gam anei ding a, ka tang siangthou aluah ding.
Ama'n, "Sungvum un, sungvum un, lampi bawl un, ka mite lampi bawl un, ka mite lampi a kipan pukna ding pai un," TOUPA'N achi.

Mitungnung, tawisang, tang-tawn a om, amin Siangthou in hichi in achi ngal a, “Kei mun tungnung leh siangthou ah ka om a, mithunuailutte lungsim hihhalh ding leh kisik tuntunte lungtang hihhalh ding in mi lungsim a kisik tuntun a thunuailuttak kiang ah leng ka om hi.
Tangtawn a dou lou ding ka hi, ka heh gige sam kei ding hi; huchi keileh mi lungsim ka ma ah abah ding a, hinna ka bawlte leng abah ding uh.
Ahuaiham a athulimlouhna ziak in ka heh a, ka sat a, ka mai ka hum a, ka heh ahi; amah lah alungtang omdan ngeingei in paupengtak in a-om hi.
"A-omdante ka mu a, amah ka damsak ding; ka pi ding a, amah leh asuunpih mite kiang ah lungmuanna ka pe nawn ding.
Ke'n muk gah ka siam hi. Lemna, lemna, gamlapi a om kiang ah leh naichik a om kiang ah om hen," TOUPA'N achi, “Amah ka damsak ding.
Mithulimloute bel tuipi kihot gige bang ahi uh; a-om kinken thei ngei kei a, atuite'n lah nin leh buannawi avikkhe zel uh," chi in.
Ka Pathian in, “Mithulimloute a ding in muanna himhim a-om kei," achi hi.
Ngaihtak in kikou inla, kidam ke'n, pengkul bang in na aw suaksak loloih inla, ka mite kiang ah atatlekna uh hilh inla, Jakob inkuanpihte kiang ah akhelhnate uh hilh in.

Zon zaw niteng in ahon zong zel ua, ka lampi thute theih akilawp ua; diktattak a hih leh a Pathian uh vaihawmna tawpsan ngei lou nam bang in ka kiang ah vaihawmna diktat ahon ngen ua, Pathian naih leng akilawp uhi.

Bangziak in ahia an ka ngawl ua, na muh louh? Bangziak in ahia ka kihihgentheih ua, na theih louh? achi nak uhi. Ngai un, na an ngawl ni un noumau nopsakna na bawl ua, na nasem mite tengteng na nuaisiah uh.
Ngai un, kihoutheih louh leh kiselna ding leh thulimlouhna khuttum a kitum ding in ahi, an na ngawl nak uh; na aw uh tunglam a zak ding in hiai ni in an na ngawl ngei kei uhi.

Huchibang an ngawlna ka deihlam ahi hia? Mi akihih gentheihna ni ding uh ahi maw? Sialluang bang a alu kun ding leh anuai a sai-ip puan phah a vut buah ding hia? Huaite an ngawlna TOUPA a ding a ni kipahhuai na chi ding ua hia?
Hiai an ngawlna ka deihlam ahi kei maw? Thulimlouhna a gakna phelsak leh hakkol khaute sutsak leh nuaisiahte pawtsak leh hakkol chiteng hihtansak.
Na an mi gilkialte kiang a hawm leh genthei delhkhiakte na inn a pi ahi kei maw? Mi vuaktang mu a puan piakleh nangmah tanaute a kipan a kisel louh ahi kei maw?
Huai hun chiang in na vak zing nisuak bang in ahong suak ding a, na damna ding ahong poukhe zok ding; na diktatna in na ma akai ding a; TOUPA thupina na nungdal ahi ding.
Huai hun chiang in na sam ding a, huchi in TOUPA'N ahon dawng ding; na kikou ding a, huchi in ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi ding. Na lak ua kipan ahakkolte khutzung a mikawkte, mawkpaute na hihman a,
gilkialte kiang a na deihlam pia a, hihgentheihmi na taisakleh, na vak mial lak ah avakkhe ding a, na mial bikbek sun lai bang ahita ding.
Huan TOUPA'N ahon pi gige ding a, mun keu ah leng ahon taisak ding a, na guhte leng ahatsak ding; tui a vak huan bang leh tui nak nei kang ngei lou bang na hita ding hi.

Huchi in nang a kipan a hong pawt dingte'n mun lui sesate alem nawn ding ua; suan tampi suangphum ding in na lemtou nawn ding; huchi in nang bel, ase lai bawlhoihpa, mi omna ding a lampite bawlhoihpa, ahon chi ding uh.

"Sabbath tang lou lou ding a, ka ni siangthou a na deihlam hih lou ding a na khepek na ngat kiksak a, Sabbath ni kipahhuai leh TOUPA ni siangthou zahhuai na chih a, nangmah lampi tawn lou a, nangmah nopsakna bawl lou a, nangmah thu gen lou a, na pahtawileh,
TOUPA tung ah na kipak ding a, lei mun sangte ah ka hon tuangsak ding; na pu Jakob gouluah thil in ka hon vak ding," TOUPA kam in huai achita hi.
Ngai un, TOUPA khut hondam thei lou ding in tomsak in a-om kei a; abil leng za thei lou ding in angong sam kei.
Na thulimlouhnate uh noumau leh na Pathian kal ua kia in ahon khen ahi, bil a azak noplouhna ding in na khelhnate un amai ahon liahsak ahi.
Na khutte uh lah sisan a hihnit in a-om a, na khutzungte uh lah thulimlouhna a hihnit in a-om hi; na mukte un zuau agen a, na lei uh ginatlouhna thu gen in aphun nuanua hi.
Kuama'n diktak in thukhawk agen kei ua, kuama'n thutak in thu agenpih ngei kei uh; huihkhua lelte amuang ua, zuau agen nak uhi; thilhihkhelhna apai ua, thulimlouhna asuang zel uhi.
Thangtom tuite a-opkhum ua, maimom gil puan agan uh; atui ne mite asi uhi, hihtap a om ah gul ahong pawt hi.
Amaimon gil puante uh puansilh ding in ahong om kei ding a, athilhihte uh leng asilh sam kei ding uh; athilhihte uh lah thulimlouhna thilhihte ahi a, hiamgamtak a hihna akhut uah a-om hi.
Akhete uh thil hoih lou lam ah atai a, gensiatbei sisan suah ding in akintat nilouh ua; angaihtuahte uh lah thulimlouhna ngaihtuahnate ahi a; gamna leh siatna alampite uah a-om zel hi.
Lungmuanna lampi athei kei ua; apaina uah dikna himhim a-om ngei kei; amau a ding in lam kawi bang abawl ua; huai lai a pai peuhmah in lungmuanna athei ngei kei uh.
Huaiziak in vaihawmna ei a kipan gamlapi ah a-om naknak a, diktatna in ahon phazou ngei kei; vak i ngak ua, himahleh, ngai in, mial ahong hi a; vakna i ngak ua, himahleh mial bikbek mah ah i pai uhi.
Mittaw bang in baang i mai puampuam ua, ahi, mit neiloute bang in i mai puampuam uhi; khomial tung bang in sun lai in i kisui ua; mihatte lak ah misi bang phet i hi uhi.
Vompite bang in i vek un i ham dupdup ua, vakhute bang in nakpitak in i thum ngutngut uh; vaihawmna i ngak ua, himahleh, a-om het kei hi; hotdamna i ngak ua, himahleh gamlapi ah ahon omsan hi.
I tatleknate uh na ma ah akhangta a, i khelhnate'n ahon hek gige hi; i kiang ua i tatleknate uh a-om gige ziak in, i thulimlouhnate uh i thei uhi.
I takleknate, TOUPA i theihmohbawlte, i Pathian i zuih louh a i kiheisante, nuaisiah thu leh hel thu i gente, zuau thu i pai ua, lungtang a kipan i genkhiak zelte.
Huchi in vaihawmna in nunglam ahon ngatsan a, diktatna in gamlapi ah ahon dinsanta; thutak lah kongzing ah apuk a, dikna alut thei kei hi.
Ahi, thutak a-omta kei a; thil hoih lou tawpsanmi gallak in akibawl zel. Huchi in TOUPA'N huai amu a, thudik a vaihawmna himhim a-om louh ziak in alungkimsakta kei hi.
Huan mi kuamah a-om kei chih athei a, ngetsakmi mawngmawng a-om louh uh lamdang asa a; huaiziak in amah ban mahmah in hotdamna akibawl a; amah diktatna mah in akilenkip hi.
Diktatna lum in anei a, hotdamna lukhu akhu a; puansilh in phulakna puansilhte asilh a, puanaktual ding in phatuamngaihna asilh hi.
Athilhihte uh bang in, athilhihte uh bang in ama'n athuk ding, amah dou mite hehna in, amelmate thukna in athuk ding; tuikulh gamte thukna in athuk ding.
Huchi in tumlam a kipan TOUPA min alau ding ua, athupina leng nisuahna a kipan in alau ding uh; tui khang bang a melma ahong pai chiang in, TOUPA Kha in amah dou in alamang ding hi.
"Zion ah Tanpa in ahong pai ding a, Jakobte lak a tatlekna tawpsan mite lak ah leng ahong pai ding, TOUPA'N achi.

Ke'n zaw, hiai ahi akiang ua ka thukhun,” TOUPA'N achi. “Ka kha na tung a omleh, na kam a thu ka koihte'n, tuban tangtawn pha in na kam apawtsan kei ding ua, na suante kam leng apawtsan sam kei ding ua, na tusuan sawnte kam leng apawtsan sam kei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Kumpipa Uzziah asih kum in TOUPA laltutphah sangtak a tawisan a tu ka mu a, apuansilh mong tual in tempul adimsak vek hi.
Akiang ah serafte adingh ua; kha guk chiat anei ua, akha nihte un amai uh akhuh ua, nih in akhepekte uh akhuh ua, nih in aleng uhi.
Huchi in, "Sepaihte' TOUPA asiangthou hi, asiangthou hi, asiangthou hi: Leitung pumpi athupina in adim," chi in akidawngtuah uhi.
Huchi in akikou husa in kongpi bul suangphum nangawn alingsak dupdup a, meikhu in insung adim hi.
Huaitak in, ke'n, "Muk nin pumi ka hi a, muk ninpu mite lak a teng ka hih ziak in ka tung gik hi na tel e! Mangthang ka hita ve; ka mit in kumpipa, sepaihte’ TOUPA, amuta ngal a," ka chi hi.
Huchi in serafte lak a khat, maitam a kipan taiteh a teh, mei-am tawi in ka kiang ah ahong leng a, ka kam ahong bi hi.
"Ngai in, hiai in na muk asukhata, huchi in na thulimlouhna lakmang ahita, na khelhna leng sawpsiang ahita," achi hi.
Huan "Kua ka sawl dia, kou a dia kua kuan ding ahia?" chi in TOUPA aw ka za hi.
Huchi in ke'n, "Kei hiai ah ka om, hon sawl ve," ka chi hi. Ama'n, "Kuan inla, hiai mite va hilh in, bil in zaw za unla, theihsiam bel theisiam kei un; muh zaw mu unla, theih bel thei kei un, chi in.

Hiai chite lungtang khengsak inla, abil uh ngongsak inla, amitte uh mit sisak in; huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza ding ua, alungtang un athei ding ua, ahong kihei nawn ding ua, damsak in a-om kha ding uh," achi hi.
Huan ke'n, "Toupa bang tan ahi dia?" ka chi a. Ama'n ahon dawng a, "Khopite a teng ding bei a suksiat a a-om a, innte a mi bei a a-om a, gam loih sipsip a a-om a,
TOUPA'N mite gamlapi ah asuan a, gamsung a mun paisansa tampi a-om masiah.

Huan asung ah sawm lak ah khat leng om lai a-omleh nek khit in a-om behlap ding uhi; himahleh nahhi leh tosaw phuk khit nung a abul a om nilouh bang in chi siangthou abulsum a om nilouh ahi," ka chi hi.
Thou inla, vak in, na vak ahong tung a, Toupa thupina na tung ah ahong suakta hi.
Ngai in, mial in leitung akhuh ding a, mial bikbek in mite akhuh ding ahi; himahleh na tung ah TOUPA ahong suak ding a, thupina na tung ah ahong kilang ding hi.
Huchi in nam chih na vak lam ah ahong pai ding ua, kumpipate leng na hong suah vakna lam ah ahong pai ding uh.
Dak inla, na mit in en vialvial in, en in, avek un akikhawm ua, na kiang ah ahong pai uhi; na tapate gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai ding ua, na tanute ahong don ding uhi.

Huai hun chiang in na mu ding a, na vakta ding a, na lungtang kipak in aling ding, zatsak in a-om ding; tuipi a hauhsakna in na kiang lam ahon naih ding a, namte thahatna na kiang ahong tun ding ziak in.

Sangawngsau tampi'n ahon tuam ding ua, Midian leh Ephah gam a sangawngsau tuaite'n; huaite tengteng Sheba gam a kipan in ahong pai ding uh; dangka-eng leh begaw ahon po ding ua, TOUPA phatna thu atheisak ding uhi.
Kedarte ganhon tengteng na kiang ah a-omkhawm ding ua, Nebajoth a belamtalte'n na nna asem ding uh; ka maitam ah kipak in apaitou ding ua, ka thupina in ka pahtawi ding.
Mei bang a leng leh vakhu amau tohlet zuan a leng duamduam bang kuate ahi ua?

Ama'n ahon pahtawi ziak in TOUPA na Pathian min ding leh Israelte Mi Siangthou a ding in na tapate adangka uh leh dangka-eng toh gamlapi a kipan a pi ding in pel lou in tuikulh gamte'n ahon ngak ding ua, Tarshish long liante'n masakpen atuh ding uh.
Huan gamdang mite'n kulhbaangte alemtou nawn ding ua, akumpipate un na nna asem ding uh; ka heh in ka hon sat a, himahleh ka hon deihsakna in na tung ah ka zahngai leuleu hi.
Na kongkhakte leng hon in a-om gige ding ua; sun le zan in akhak kei ding uh; mite'n nam chih sum na kiang a ahon tawi ua, akumpipate uh ahon pi theih samna ding un.
Na nna sem nuam lou nam leh gam amangthang ding uhi; ahi, huai namte zaw suksiat in a-om ding uh.
Ka Mun Siangthou zem ding in Lebanon thupina na kiang ah ahong pai ding, meilahte, phante, sing gelh chi ahong paikhawm ding ua ka khe sikna mun ka thupibawl ding hi.
Nang hon hihgentheite tapate kun in na kiang ah ahong pai ding ua; nangmah musit mite na khepek nuai ah akun ding ua, nang bel TOUPA khopi, Israelte Mi Siangthou Zion, ahon chi ding uh.
Kuamah veh ngei louh khopi, paisan leh huat a na om sang in tangtawn suanpen, suan tampi kipahna ding in ka hon bawl ding.
Namte nawitui na tep ding a, kumpipate nawi leng na tep ding; kei TOUPA zaw nang hon hondampa leh nang Tanpa, Jakob Mi Hat ka hi chih na hon thei ding hi.

Dal tang in dangka-eng ka hon la ding a, sik tang in dangka ka hon la ding, sing tang in leng sumbelsik, suang tang in sik; lungmuanna na heutu ding in ka sep lai ding a, diktatna nang hon phutmi ding in ka sep ding hi.

Hiamgam a thilhih husa na gam ah zak ahita kei ding a, hiamgamna leh siatna husa leng na gamgi sung ah zak ahita kei ding; na kulhbaang Hotdamna, na chi zaw ding a, na kongkhakte leng, Phatna, na chi ding hi.
Sun a nang hon tan ding nisa ahi kei ding a; kha leng vakna ding in ahon vaksak sam kei ding; TOUPA bel nang a ding in tangtawn vaksakpa ding in a-om ding a, na Pathian leng na thupina ding ahi ding.
Na ni atumta kei ding a, na kha leng amangta kei ding hi; TOUPA tangtawn vaksakpa ahita ding a, na lusuun nite atawp ding hi.
Na mite avek un midiktat ahi ding ua, na gam aluah tawntung ding uh; pahtawi a ka omtheihna ding a amau a zung selkhia ka suan, ka khutsuak ahi ding uh.
Mi tawmpen sangkhat ahi ding ua, mineupen leng nam hatte ahi ding uhi, kei TOUPA'N ahunhun in ka tungsak pahpah ding.

Liangvaite kiang a tanchinhoih gen ding a TOUPA'N thau ahon nilh ziak in ka tung ah Toupa PATHIAN kha a-om; ama'n lungtang khasiate tuam ding, salte kiang a pawtna thu leh saltangte kiang a tanin honna thu gen ding.
TOUPA lungkim kum thu leh i Pathian phulak ni thugen ding bang, lungkhamte lungmuan ding bang,

Vut tang a pakkhigui bang, lungkham tang a nopna thau bang, nguina kha tang a phatna puansilh bang akiang ua piak ding, Zion a lungkham a omte a ding a seh ding bang in ahon sawl ahi. Amah pahtawi a a-omna ding in, diktatna sing TOUPA suante chih, ahihtheihna ding un.
Mun lui sesate alem nawn ding ua, tuma a khua sesate adingh hoihsak nawn ding ua, khopi sesa, suan tampi gamnate, abawlhoih nawn ding uh.
Gamdang mite'n dinsa in na ganhonte uh avak ding ua, theih ngei louh mite na leiletmi ding un leh na grepgui uh kemmi ding in a-om ding uh.
Nou bel, TOUPA siampute, chih a loh in na om ding uh; mite'n i Pathian nasem mite ahon chi ding uh. Namte sum na ne ding ua, athupina uh na suang ding uh.
Na zahlakna gun uh aleh nih na mu ding ua; na zum gun un na tantuan uah nuamsa in la na sa ding uh; huaiziak in na gam uah azahnih na luah ding ua; tangtawn nopsakna nou a ahi ding.
Kei TOUPA'N vaihawmna dik ka deih a, thulim loutak a hiamgam zaw ka hua hi; huchi in amau ka thukna chihtak ngial in akiang uah ka pe ding a, akiang uah tangtawn thu leng ka khung ding.
Huchi in asuante uh nam chih lak a theih ahi ding ua, atate uh michih lak a theih ahi ding uh; amau mute'n TOUPA vualzawl chi ahi uh chih athei ding uhi.

TOUPA ah nakpitak in nuam ka sa ding a, ka hinna Pathian ah kipaktak in a-om ding. Mouneipa ding pakkhigui a akizep bang leh mou ding a kivatnate a akivat zel bang in, ama'n hotdamna puansilhte ahon silhsak a, diktatna puanaktual in ahon tuamta hi.
Leitung in athil dawn apawtsak bang leh, huan in asung a thil chinte adawnsak bang in, Toupa PATHIAN in diktatna leh phatna nam chih ma ah adawnkhesak ding ahi.
Adiktatna uh vakna bang a suah a, amah hotdamna khawnvak kuang bang a asuah masiah, Zion ziak in ka dai nilouh kei ding a, Jerusalem ziak in ka om kinken kei ding hi.
Huchi in na diktatna amu ding ua, kumpipa tengteng in na thupina amu ding uh; huan, min thak, TOUPA kam in asak ding in, ahon sam ding uh.
TOUPA khut a kilawmna lallukhu leh i Pathian khut a thupina lukhu na hi ding.

Taihsansa, ahon chi nawn kei ding uh; na gam leng, Loihsansa achi nawn sam kei ding uh; Hephzibah, ahon chita ding ua, na gam leng Beulah, achi ding uhi; TOUPA na tung ah akipak ngal a, na gam in pasal anei ding hi.
Tangval in nungak zi a aneih bang in na tapate'n zi in ahon nei ding uh; mou neimi mou tung a akipah bang in, na tung ah na Pathian akipak ding hi.
Jerusalem aw, na kulh tung ah galvilmi ka vilsak a; sun leh zan in chik lai mah in adai kei ding; nou TOUPA theihpih ding a omte aw, om kinken het kei un.
Amah leng om kinkensak kei un, Jerusalem ahihkip a, lei a phathuai a abawl masiah.
TOUPA'N akhut taklam leh abanhat lou a akichiam in, na buh nang hon dou mite an ding in ka pe nawn kei ding a; gamdang mite'n nna sepkhiak uain adawn nawn kei ding uh.
Abuh late'n ane zaw ding ua, TOUPA aphat ding ua alou mite'n ka Mun Siangthou huangsung intual ah adawnta ding, chi in.
Pawt unla, kulh kongpite ah pawt un; mite a ding in lampi bawl unla; sungvum un, lamlian sungvum un; suangte tomsiang unla; mite a ding in chiamtehna takkhia un.
Ngai un, kawlmong pha in huchi in atheisak ahi, Zion tanu kiang ah hichi in gen un, "En in, nangmah hotdamna ahong tung ding; en in, akipahman akiang ah a-om hi, aditna leng ama ah a-om hi.
Huchi in amau, 'Mipi Siangthou, TOUPA tatte,' achi ding uh; nang bel Zonkhiak, Paisan louh khopi ahon chi ding uh, chi in,” achi hi.
Edom gam a kipan hong pai, Bozrah a kipan puansilh diahsan silh kua ahia? Apuansilh a thupitak, ahatna thupidan bang a hong pai? Kei TOUPA diktattak a thu gen a, hotdam lam a mihat mahmah ka hi.
Bangziak a na puansilh san a, na silh-le-tente leng grep sukna khuk a chiltaimi' silh-le-ten bang a om ahia?

Keimah kia in grep sukna khuk ah ka chiltai a; michih lak a mi khat lel leng ka kiang ah a-om kei uh; ahi, amau ka heh a ka chil a, ka heh a ka pal a; huchi in ahinna sisan uh ka puansilhte ah theh in a-om a, ka puan tengteng ka hihninta hi.
Phulak ni ka lungtang ah a-om a, ka tatkhiakna kum ahong tungta ahi.
Huchi in ka en a, panpih ding mi a-om kei ua; len ding mi a-om louh uh lamdang ka sa a; huaiziak in keimah ban mahmah in hotdamna ahon puak a; ka hehna in ahon lenkip hi.
Huchi in michih ka heh in ka sikden a, ka heh in ka khamsak a, ahinna sisan uh lei ah ka bota hi.

TOUPA'N thil bangkim ahon vuh bang zel in TOUPA chitdan thute leh TOUPA phatna thute ka gen ding a; ahehpihnate leh azahngaihna thupidante bang zel a Israel inkuanpihte lak a ahoihna thupi mahmah a atung ua avuh thu leng ka gen ding hi.
Ama'n, "Ka mite, hi taktak hi ua, zuautat lou ding tate ahi uh," achi hi. Huchi in amaute hondampa ding in ahong omta hi.
Amangbatna tengteng uah amah amangbang a, angel, ama a om in, amaute ahumbit a; a-itna leh ahehpihna in atanta a; nidanglai ni tengteng ah amaute pua in apom hi.
Himahleh ahel un, a Kha Siangthou alungkhamsak ua; huaiziak in amau dou ding in kilehheisak in a-om a, amau asualta hi.
Huai lai in amite'n Mosi nidanglai nite atheigige ua, hichi in achi uh, "Tuipi a kipan a abelamching mite toh amaute pi TOUPA koi a om ahia? A Kha Siangthou alak ua koihpa koi a om ahia?
Aban thupitak Mosi taklam a paisakpa koi a om ahia? Tangtawn min kibawlna dia ama ua tui kikhensakpa koi a om ahia?
Akisuihlouhna ding ua tui thuktak a, gamdai a sakol pi bang a, amaute pikaipa koi a om ahia?
Guam a ganta paisukte bang in TOUPA Kha in amaute akhawlsak a; huchibang in, min thupitak na kibawlna ding in, na mite na pi hi," chi in.

TOUPA, Van a kipan in hon ensuk inla, na sianthouna leh na thupina omna a kipan in hon en in; na phatuamngaihna leh na thilhih thupitakte koi ah? Na lungtang a na hon ngaihna leh na hon hehpihna, kham a omta hia?
Abraham in hon thei lou in, Israel in leng hon limsak kei mahleh, nang zaw ka Pa uh na hi a; nang zaw, aw TOUPA, ka Pa uh na hi; na min tangtawn a kipan in koute hon Tanpa ahi.
TOUPA aw, nang bangziak a na lampi a kipan hon vakmangsak na hia? Na sikha, na gouluah namte ziak in hong kik nawn in.
Na misiangthoute'n sawt louchik kia anei ua; hon doute'n lah na min siangthou asikgawpta uh.
Atung ua vai na hawm ngeilouhte, na min pu ngeilou namte ka bangta uhi.
Aw tangte na ma a aluankhiak zoizoina ding un, van botkek in hong kumsuk teitei lechin aw.
Namte na ma a alinna ding un nang hon doute kiang a na min theihsakna ding in, mei in sing nen akuansak a, mei in tui asousak bang in!
Ka lamet louh uh thil mulkimhuai na hih lai in na hong suk a, na ma ah tangte aluangkhe zoizoi uhi.
Nidanglai a kipan in mite'n, nang kia lou ngal, amaute ngak ding a, sepsak zelpa Pathian athei ngei kei ua, bil in lah aza ngei kei ua, mit in leng amu ngei sam kei uhi.

Nang zaw, nuamtak a om a diktattak a hihmi, na lampite a nang hon theigigete, na don a; ngai in, nang na heh a, kou thil ka hihkhial ua; huaite ah sawtpi ka omta ua, huchi in hotdam in ka om thei lai ding uam?
Minin bang in ka na om vekta ngal ua, ka diktatna teng uh leng puansilh nin bang ahi; ka vek un nah bang in ka vuai ua; ka thulimlouhnate un huih bang in ahon mutmang zel hi.
Huchi in na min lou a, nang hon len ding a kihihhalh kuamah a-om kei uh; kou a kipan in na mai na selta ngal a, ka thulimlouhnate uh zang in na hon mangsakta hi.
Tu in zaw, aw TOUPA, nang ka pa uh na hi; kou bellei ka hi ua; nang kou hon velpa na hi; huchi in ka vek un na khutsuak ka hi uh.
TOUPA aw, heh ke'nla, thulimlouhnate leng tangtawn in theigige ke'n; ngai in hehpih in hon en inla, ka vek un nangmah mite ka hi uhi.
Na khopi siangthoute gamdai ahong suak ua, Zion gamdai ahong suak a, Jerusalem mun nutsiat ahong hita hi.
Ka inn siangthou uleh ka inn kilawmtak uh, ka pipute un nang a hon phat zelna uh, mei ahal ahi; ka thil deihhuaite tengteng uh lah hihsiat in a-omvekta ngal a.
TOUPA aw, huai thilte ah na kidek thei ding a hia? Na dai nilouh in na hon hihgenthei nilouh ding a hia?
Kei hon deih ngeiloute zon in ka om; hon zong ngeiloute muhkhiak in ka om; ka min pu lou nam kiang ah, "Hon en un, hon en un," ka chi hi.
Mihelhatte a ding in nitum in ka bante ka zak, huaite bel amau ngaihtuahnate bang zel a lampi hoih lou a paite ahi.
Huante a kithoih a, teklei tungte a banghiam gimlim hal a, ka maitang mahmah a hon hihheh nakte.
Han lakte khawng a tu a, mundaite a giak a, voksa ne a, abelte ua thilkihhuai tuihuante.
Nang kia dingh in, hon naih ke'n, nang sang in ka siangthouzaw hi, chite ahi uh; huaite bel ka nak a meikhu om, nitum a mei mit lou om gige nakte ahi uhi.
Ngai in, ka ma ah gelh in a-om; ka dai nilouh kei ding a, ka thuk ding, a-angsung uah ka thuk ding.

Noumau thulimlouhna leh na pute uh thulimlouhnate, TOUPA'N achi, huaite'n lah tangte tung ah gimlim ahal ua, mual tungte ah ka min agensia uhi; huaiziak in anasep uh amasapen in a-angsung uah ka tehsak ding hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Grep bawm ah uain thak amu ua, mi'n, 'Hihse ke'n, huai ah lah vualzawlna a-om ngal a,' achih bang un, ka sikhate ziak in ka hih sam ding, avek ua ka suksiatlouhna ding in.
Huan Jakob a kipan in chi khat ka pawtsak ding a, Judah a kipan in ka tangte luah ding ka pawtsak ding; huchi in ka mitelte'n huai aluah ding ua, ka sikhate huai ah a-om ding uh.
Huan ka mi, kei hon zongte a ding in, Sharon belamhonte huang ahi ding a, Akor Phaizang bel bawnghon kualna mun ahi ding hi.
"Himahleh nou TOUPA paisan a, ka tang siangthou mangngilh a, Gad pathian a ding a dohkan bawl a, Meni a ding a dawn thillat lante aw;

k'on sap lai in na hon dawng nuam kei ua, thu ka gen lai in na za ut kei ua, ka mitmuh in thil gilou na hih zaw ua, ka kipahpih louh thil na tel zawk ziak un namsau in na tan hun uh ka hon ngaihtuahsak ding a, na vek un thahna ah na kun vek ding uh.

Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, 'Ngai un, ka sikhate'n ane ding ua, nou bel gilkial in na om ding ua; ngai un, ka sikhate'n adawn ding ua, nou bel dangtak in na om ding uh; ngai un, ka sikhate'n nuam asa ding ua, nou bel na zum ding uh;
ngai un, ka sikhate lungtang akipah ziak un la asa ding ua, nou bel lungtang a na lungkham ziak un na kap ding uh, kha a na vui ziak un na mau vungvung ding uh.
Huan hamsia hi ding in ka mitelte kiang ah na min uh na nuse ding ua, Toupa PATHIAN in ahon that ding hi; huan, asikhate min dang in asamta ding hi.

Huchi in lei a amah kivualzawl tawmmi bel thutak Pathian ah akivualzawl ding a; lei a kichiammi in thutak Pathian lou in akichiam ding; nidang alungkhamnate mangngilh a a-om tak ziak in leh ka mit a kipan a sel a a-om tak ziakin.'
"Ngai un, van thakte leh lei thak ka siam ahi; nidanglai thilte zaw theihgige in a-om nawn kei ding a, lungsim ah leng alut nawn kei ding hi.
Himahleh ka thilsiam ah tangtawn in kipak in nuamsa un; ngai un, Jerusalem nopsakna ding in ka siam a, amite kipahna ding in ka bawl hi.
Jerusalem tung ah nuam ka sa ding a, ka mite tung ah leng ka kipak ding; asung ah kap husa zak ahi nawn kei ding a, mau husa leng zak ahi nawn kei ding hi.

Huai a kipan a pawt zaw naungek ni sawt louchik dam a-om kei ding ua, putek adamsung nite tangtun lou leng a-om kei ding uh; naupang lah kum za a upa in asi ding ua, mikhial kum za lel dam zaw hamsethuak ahi ding uhi.
Huan innte alam ding ua, huaite ah a-om gige ding uh; grephuan abawl ding ua, agah leng ane ding uh.

Midang omna ding in inn alam nawn kei ding ua, midang nek ding in grephuan abawl nawn kei ding uh; sing damsung nite bang in ka mite damsung nite lah om ding ahi ngal a, ka mitelte zaw sawtpi asepkhiak tung uah akipak ding uhi.
Bangmah lou in asemgim kei ding ua, vangtah lel ding in ta anei sam kei ding uh; TOUPA vualzawlmi suante ahi ngal ua, atate uh akiang uah a-om nilouh ding uh.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, amau hon sap ma un ka dawng ding a; thu agen san lai un leng ka bil in ka za ding hi.

Ngia leh belamnou agamtakhawm ding ua, humpinelkai in bawngtal bang in buhpawl ane ding a; gulpi an leivui ahi ding hi. Ka tang siangthou ah akihih na nawn kei ding ua, akihihse nawn sam kei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Van ka tutphah ahi a, lei ka khe ngakna ahi; inn bangchibang ahia na hon lamsak ding uh? Koi lai ahia ka khawlna ding?

Hiai thil bangkim lah ka khut a ka bawl ahi ngal ua, huchi in hiai thil bangkim ahong omta ahi, TOUPA'N achi; himahleh hiai mi gentheitak a om, lungsim a kisik tuntun, ka thu a ling zel zaw ka en zaw ding.

"Bawngtal goumi zaw mi that bang ahi a; belam a kithoihmi zaw ui ngawng hektan bang ahi; thilpiak lanmi peuhmah vok sisan lanmi bang ahi a; begaw halmi peuhmah milim vualzawlmi bang ahi; ahi, amau lampi atelta ua, athilkihhuaite uah alungsim uh akipak zel hi.

Ka sap lai a kuama'n ahon dawn louh ua, thu ka gen lai a bil a azak louh ua, ka mitmuh a thil gilou ahih zawk ua, ka thil kipahpih louh lam atel ziak un ke'n leng amau khemna dingte ka telsak ding a, akihtak lam uh atung uah ka tungsak ding," chi in.

Athu a lingte aw, TOUPA thu za un; na unau uh, nou hon hopa leh ka min ziak a nou hon delhkhete'n, "Na kipahman uh ka muhtheihna ding un, TOUPA hih thupi in om hen," achi ua, himahleh azum zawta ding uh.
Tua! Khopi a lum vengvung husa! Tempul a kipan husa! Amelmate thukpa TOUPA husa ei ve!
"Ama'n vei man lou in nau anei a; na sa man lou in pasal naupang anei hi.
Huchibang kua'n za ngei ahia? Huchibang kua ahia mu ngei? Ni khat in gam apiang guih ding a hia? Thakhat in nam suan in a-om guih ding a hia? Zion in nau aveitak in tate anei pah hi.
Pian hun tungsak ngal in ka nei kei ding a hia?" TOUPA'N achi, "Kei neisak zelpa'n ta ka neisak phal kei ding a hia?" Na Pathian in achi hi.
"Jerusalem itte tengteng aw, Jerusalem nopsakpih unla, kipahpih un; amah suunte tengteng aw, kipah ziak in nuamsakpih un.
Na tep ua, alungmuanna nawite a na taitheihna ding un leh, na tep peng ua, athupina tampi a na kipahtheihna ding un," chih.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, "Ngai un, luipi bang mai in akiang pha in lemna ka luangsak ding a, nam chih thupina luita akuang a let zoizoi bang mai in akiang pha in ka luangsak ding, huchi in huai na tep ding uh; ahon angpom ding a, apheipi tung ah ahon tawmsak ding hi.
"Mi, anu'n alungmuan bang in ka hon lungmuan ding; huchi in Jerusalem ah lungmuan in na om ding uhi.

Huai na mu ding ua, na lungtang un nuam asa ding a, na guhte uh leng loupa hing dipdip bang in apha lihliah ding; huchi in TOUPA khut asikhate lam ah a-om chih athei ding ua, amelmate tung ah alungkim kei ding.
"Ngai un, ahehna thangpaihna a thuk ding leh asalhna meikuang a thuk ding in TOUPA mei toh ahong pai ding hi, akangtalaite pingpei bang mai ahi ding hi.
Mei in ahi, TOUPA'N angaihtuah ding, anamsau in ahi mi tengteng angaihtuah ding; huchi in TOUPA hihlupte zaw tampi ahi ding uh.
"Huante ah ahoh ua, alai a mi nung a om khepkhup ding a kihihsiangthou leh kisiangsak zelte, voksa leh thilkihhuai leh chikpi nete, amangthangkhawm ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
“Athilhihte uleh angaihtuahte uh lah ka thei ngal a; nam chih leh pau chih ka pikhawm hun ahong tung sin; huchi in ahong pai ding ua, ka thupina amu ding uh.

Huan alak uah chiamtehna ka omsak ding a, huchi in alak ua gawtna pelte peuhmah namte kiang ah Tarshishte, Pulte, thangpeulaite Lud kiang ah, tuikulh gam gamlapi, ka minthanna za ngei nai lou Tubalte leh Javante kiang ah, ka thupina mu ngei nailoute kiangte ah ka sawl ding; huchi in nam chih lak ah ka thupina thu agen ding uh.

Huchi in Israel telte'n athillat uh belsuan siangthoutak a TOUPA' inn a ahong lut zel bang un, TOUPA kiang a thillat ding in nam chih teng lak a kipan na unaute tengteng uh sakol tung, kangtalaite, zawnnate, sabiltung tungte, sangawngsau tungte ah, Jerusalem ka tang siangthou ah ahon pi ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
"Huan huaite lak a kipan in siampu dingte leh Levi mi dingte ka la ding," TOUPA'N achi.
"Ka bawl ding van thakte leh lei thak ka ma ah om gige ding bang in, na suante uh leh na min uh leng a-om gige ding ahi," TOUPA'N achi.
"Huan hichi ahi ding a, kha thak a kipan kha thak dang tan in, Sabbath ni a kipan Sabbath dang tan in mi tengteng ka ma a hon be ding in ahong pai zungzung ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Apaikhe ding ua, ka tung a talekte luang a-en ding uh; athante uh asi kei ding a, ameikuangte uh leng thah in a-om sam kei ding hi; mi tengteng a ding in thilkihhuai mahmah ahi ding uh.”
Huan Uzziah tapa Jotham tapa Ahaz vaihawm lai in hichi ahi a, Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah Jerusalem sim ding in akuantou ua; himahleh azou kei uhi.
Siria leh Ephraim apangkhawmta uh chi in David inkuanpihte ahilh ua, huchi in alungtang leh akhua-le-tuite lungtang, gamnuai singte huih in amutling suausuau bang in, hihlin in ahong omta hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Isai kiang ah, "Nang leh na tapa Shear-jashub, dil saknungzaw pen tuilakna tawp ah, Puansawpmi gam lamlian ah, Ahaz dawn ding in kuankhia unla;
akiang ah, pilvang inla om kinken in; meisel sum khu lel nih, Siria toh Rezin leh Remaliah tapa hehna thupitak kihta ke'nla, na lungtang taikek kei hen.
Siria in, Ephraim leh Remaliah tapa toh nangmah tung a gitlouh asawm tak ziak in, chi in achi hi.
Judah dou ding in kuantou ni in, va hihlau ni, eimah a ding ngei in i va zou dia, alaitak ah kumpipa in Tabeel tapa i tusak ding," chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichibang in achi, "Athusawm uh apiching kei dia, avuaksuak ding.
Siria lutang Damaskas ahi a, Damaskas lutang Rezin lah ahi ngal a; kum sawmguk leh kum nga man ma in Ephraim chi chihtak louh a om ding in suksiat vek in a-om ding.
Huan Ephraim lutang Samaria ahi a, Samaria lutang Remaliah tapa lel ahih ziak in. Na up nop kei uleh hihkip in na om kei hial ding uh, chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Ahaz ahoupih nawn a,
"TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah chiamtehna ngen in; thukpi ah hiam, tunglam sangpi ah hiam ngen in," achi hi.
Ahaz in bel, "Ka ngen kei ding, TOUPA ka ze-et kei ding," achi hi.
Huan ama'n, "David inkuanpihte aw, tu in ngaikhe dih ua; mihing hihgim thil neuchik ding in na sep uh maw, ka Pathian nangawn hihgim na ut zel uh?
Huaiziak in TOUPA mahmah in chiamtehna nou ahon pe ding; ngai un, nungak siangthou khat agai ding a, tapa anei ding a, amin 'Immanuel' asa ding uh.
Ama'n thil hoih lou lam deihlouhna dan atheih chiang in leh thil hoih lam deihna dan atheih chiang in bawngnawi dat leh khuaizu ane ding.
Naupang thil hoih lou lam deihlouhna dan leh thil hoih lam deihna dan atheih ma in leng na lauh kumpipa nihte gam nutsiat in a-om ding," achi hi.
"Ephraim in Judah anutsiat ni a kipan tung ngei nai lou nite TOUPA'N na tung ah leh na khua-le-tuite tung ah leh na pa inkuanpihte tung leh Assuria kumpipa mahmah tung ah atungsak ding hi.
"Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N Aigupta luinak a thoute leh Assuria gam a khuai omte singsit in asam ding hi.
Huchi in ahong pai ding ua, avek un phaizang leh kense lak ah, suangpi hawm ah, loulingnei tengteng leh gantatna mun tengteng ah adim ding uhi.
"Huai ni chiang in Toupa'n mulmet tem kikhel in, Luipi khen gam a Assuria kumpipa omte zang in, lutang leh khemul ametsiang ding a; khamul leng ametsiang vek ding hi.
"Huchi in huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mi khat in bawngla khat leh belam nih kia avul ding.
Himahleh hichi ahi ding a, nawitui tampi aneih ding ziak un nawituidat anesak ding; gamsung a om lai mi'n nawituidat leh khuaizu ne chiat ding ahi ngal ua.
"Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mun chih, grepgui sang, dangka sang man omna peuhmahte loulingnei leh khaulingnei omna lel ahita ding.
Gam pumpi loulingnei leh khaulingnei ngen ahong hih tak ziak in huai ah thaltang leh thalpeu tawi in apai ding uhi.
Huchi in mual, tupi a tohsa teng ah, loulingnei leh khaulingnei kihtak ziak in na hong pai kei ding a, bawngtalte tatsakna leh belam gamtatna mun ding lel ahita ding hi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, “Laigelhna pek lianpi la inla, mihing laigelhna in atung ah Mahershalalhashbaz a ding, chi in gelh in.
Huchi in theipih muanhuai, siampu Uriah leh Jaberekiah tapa Zekariah theihpihpa ding in ka bawl ding," achi hi.
Huan zawlneinu kiang ah ka hoh a, huchi in ama'n nau apai a, tapa aneita hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Amin in Mahershalalhashbaz sa in.
Naupang in, Nu, Pa, chihna dan atheih ma in leng Damaskas hauhsakna leh Samaria a gallak tengteng Assuria kumpipa ma ah apaimangpih ding uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen nawn a,
"Hiai chite'n Shiloah tui awl a luang diahdiah adeih louh ziak un leh Rezin leh Remaliah tapa tung a akipah un,

huaiziak in tu in, ngai in, Toupa'n luipi tui, khauh mahmah leh tam mahmah, Assuria kumpipa leh athupina tengteng, atung uah aluangsak ding; huchi in apiau tengteng a hong let zoizoi in, agei tengteng ah leng alet zoizoi ding;
huchi in Judah gam tuam in aluang ding a; ngawng tan atum pha hial ding a; akha zak in, Immanuel aw, na gam vailam tengteng akhak vek ding hi.
Chichihte aw, buai vengvungta unla, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi; gam gamlapi a mi tengteng aw, bildoh un; kigalthuam un, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi; kigalthuam un, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi.
Thu kikum unla, bangmah hi peuh ke'n teh; thu gen unla, piching peuh ke'n teh; Pathian i kiang ah a-om ngal a," chi in.
TOUPA'N khut hattak in huchi in ka kiang ah agen, hiai chite lampi a ka pailouhna ding in hon thuzoh ei ve;
Hiai chite'n, "Sawm anei uh, achih teng uh, Sawm anei uh, chihpih kei un, akihtak teng uh zong nou zaw kihta kei unla, lau leng laupih sam kei un.
Sepaihte' TOUPA, amah mah na hihsiangthou ding uhi; amah na kihtak uh hi henla, amah na lauh uh hi hen.
Huan amah mun siangthou a ding ahi ding a; Israel inkuanpih nihte a ding in bel pukna suang leh dalna suangpi ahi zaw ding a, Jerusalem a omte a ding in thang leh pial ahi lai ding hi.
Huchi in mi tampi in huai asui ding ua apuk ding uh, kitapsak in a-om ding ua, a-awk ding ua, mat in a-om ding uh," chi in.
Theihsakna thu zial gak inla, dan thu ka sinsakte lak ah bilh in.
Huan ke'n Jakob inkuanpihte lak a amai selpa TOUPA ka ngak ding a, amah ka en nilouh ding.
Ngai in, kei leh TOUPA hon piak naupangte, Israelte lak ah sepaihte' TOUPA Zion tang a om lak a chiamtehna a dingte leh thillamdang a dingte i hi uhi.

Huan mi'n, "Dawi aisan siam zawl leh bumsiam ham tualtual leh phun nomnomte dong in, ahon chih chiang un huchi in dawng un; Mi'n a Pathian uh adot zawk ding uh hilou hia? Mihingte a ding in misi adong ding ua hia?"
"Dan thu leh theihsakna thu dot ding ahi," chi in. Huai thu bangbang a agen kei uleh amaute a ding in khua himhim avak zok kei ding hi.
Lungkhamtak leh gilkial kawm in gam atuansuak ding ua; hichi ahi ding a, agil uh akial chiang in aheh mahmah ding ua, akumpipa uleh a Pathian uh ahamsiat ding ua, van lam anga ding uhi.
Huchi in lei lam a-en ding ua, ngai in, lungkhamna leh mialna, lunglauna nguina ahi ding; huchi in mial bikbek ah delhmang in a-om ding uh.

Himahleh lunglau a om khinnu a ding in nguina himhim a-omta kei ding. Tunung Kumpipa Ding Nidanglai in Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam simmohhuai in a-omsak a, himahleh hun nanung ah zaw thupitak in a-omsakta, tuipi gei, Jordan gal ah, namte' Galili mah.
Mi mial nuai a vakte'n vak thupitak amuta ua; sihna lim gam a omte tung mahmah ah vak ahong vakta hi.
Nam na pungsakta a, anopsakna uh na khangsakta hi; buhlak lai a nuamsa bang in na ma ah nuam asata ua, min gallak sum ahawm ua nuam asak bang mai un.
Apuakgik puakna hakkol leh aliangzang a zawnna zawl, amah nuaisiahte khetbuk mah, Midiante zoh ni bang in na suktansakta ngala.
Chiak vengvung a mi galthuam a akithuamna tengteng uleh puansilh sisan toh kidiah niaunuau tengteng, hal a, mei a khul ding phet ahi ngal a.
Ei ding in naupang ahong piang a, tapa piak in i omta; vaihawmna aliangzang ah atuang ding a; amin Lamdang, Lemthei, Pathian Hat, Tangtawn Pa, Lemna Lal lah achi sin ngal ua.

David tutphah tung ah leh agam tung ah avaihawmna khandan leh lemna in tawp ni anei kei ding, hihkip ding leh tua kipan a tangtawn tan a leng vaihawmna leh diktatna tungding ding in, Sepaihte' TOUPA phatuamngaihna in huaite ahih ding.
Toupa'n Jakobte gam ah thu akhak a, Israelte tung ah aketa.
Huchi in mi tengteng, Ephraimte leh Samaria a om, kisatheitak leh lungsim a ki-uangsak;
tekleite chim mahleh, suang tak sek in i lemna ding; theipi singte sattan in om mahleh, sidar singte in i kheng ding, chite'n athei ding uh.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Rezin dou mite amah dou ding in atawisang ding a;
amelma, suahlam a Siriate, tumlam a Philistiate, atokthou ding; huchi in kam ka in Israelte ane khin ding uh. Huchi hial ahih in leng ahehna adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
Himahleh mite'n amaute vopa lam anga tuan kei ua, Sepaihte' TOUPA lah azong tuan kei uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Israelte a kipan in alutang leh amei, tum hiang leh pumpeng ni khat thu in abantan ding.
Upa leh mizahtakhuaite, alutang ahi ua; zuauthu sinsak zawlneite, amei ahi uh.
Hiai mipite'n apikhial nak uhi, apite uh hihmanthat in a-om nak uhi.

Huaiziak in TOUPA'N atangvalte uh tung ah akipak kei ding a, atagahte uleh ameithaite uh leng azahngai sam kei ding ua; avek un Pathian zahloumi leh thil hoih lou hih mite ahi chiat ua, akam un thugina lou agen uhi. Hichi ahih nung in leng, ahehna adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
Gitlouhna lah mei bang in akuang luahluah a, loulingnei leh khaulingneite akangmang ahi, gammang nong lak akang luahluah a, akhutou ngoingoi hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA heh ziak in gam akangsia a, mite leng mei a khul ding sing bang ahi ua; kuamah in amau unau leng ahawi kei uhi.
Huchi in mi'n ataklam ua mi asuh ding ua, himahleh atai tuan kei ding uh; michih in amau bansa ane chiat ding uh.
Manassehte'n Ephraimte ane ding ua, Ephraimte'n Manassehte ane ding ua; anih un Judahte adoukhawm ding uhi. Huchi lawmlawm a ahih in leng, ahehna lah adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
Jakob, Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist sikha in, nam sawm-le-nih dalhzakte kiang ah chibai abuk hi.
Ka unaute aw, na ginna uh ze-etna in kuhkalna asiam chih thei in, khemna chiteng na tuah chiang un kipahna ngen in sim un.
Na ginna ze-etna un kuhkalna asiam chih thei in.
Bangmah tasam lou a na kim ua, na vek ua na bit theihna ding un, kuhkalna in semkim hen.
Na lak ua kuapeuh in pilna ataksapleh mi tengteng kiang a itlou leh tai lou a pepa Pathian kiang ah ngen hen, huchi in akiang ah piak ahi ding hi.
Himahleh ginglel het lou in ginna nei in ngen hen, ginglelmi zaw tuipi kihot huih mutleng leh sep bang ahi.
Huchibang mi'n Toupa a kipan bangmah muh kiging kei hen.
Lungsim det neiloumi athilhih tengteng ah akip kei hi.
Unau daikil kal a om dopsang a a-om ziak in kipak hen;
mihau hihneu a a-om ziak in kipak zaw hen; loupa pak bang a aman ding ziak in.
Ni hong suak a huihlum ahong nun in loupa avuai a; apak apulh a; akilawmna amangthang hi; huchi mah bang in mihau apaina ah avuai ding hi.
Khemna thuak teitei mi ahampha hi; ze-et a a-om nung in Hinna Lallukhu, Toupa'n amah itte kiang a achiam amuh ding ziak in.
Kuamah in khemna atuah lai in Pathian khem ka hi, chi kei hen. Pathian gitlouhna toh khemvual ahi kei, ama'n leng kuamah akhem ngal kei a.
Michih amau utna a hip leh pimang a a-om chiang un khemna atuak uh ahi zaw hi.
Huan utna pai ahih chiang in huai in khelhna apiangsak a, huan, huai khelhna ahong pichin in, sihna atun hi.
Ka nau deihtakte aw, khem in om kei un.
Thilpiak hoih leh thilpiak buching tunglam a kipan a vakte Pa kiang a kipan a hong suk ahi a, amah ah lamdanna leh kikhekna lim a-om kei hi.
Athilsiamte lak a gah masa i hong hihtheihna ding in, amah deihlam in thutak lak a pan in ahon suangkhia hi.
Unau deihtakte aw, huaite na thei uhi, himahleh michih ngaihkhiak kilawp henla, thugen kituhpih kei henla, heh hak hen.
Mihing thangpaihna in Pathian diktatna abawl kei hi.
Huaiziak in nin tengteng leh gilou dim val koihmang unla, thu kipawi, na kha uh hondam thei, thunuailuttak in pom un.
Himahleh noumau kikhem in ngaikhete leltak hilou in thuzuite hi zaw un.
Kuapeuh thu ngaikhia a zui tuan lou zaw limlang a apianpih maitang hoihtak a ki-en bang ahi.
Hoihtak in aki-en a, apaimang zoh in mi bangchi ahia ahih akimangngilh nawn pah hi.
Himahleh kuapeuh dan bukim, noplenna dan vel a, huchibang a om gige a, ngaikhia a, mangngilh nawn maimah nak bang hiloute zui a nasem gige, huai mi athilhih ah vualzawl in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh sabiak limsak hi a kigingta a, alei venghoih lou a, amah lungtang kikhem zaw mi sabiakdan bangmah ahi kei hi.
I Pathian leh Pa mitmuh a sabiak siangthou leh gilou pang lou zaw, tagah leh meithaite agimthuak lai ua veh leh khovel buahna bang lou a kibawl zel ahi.
Ka unaute aw, i i Toupa Jesu Khrist, thupina Toupa gingta kawm in, mite khentuam kei un.
Na kikhopkhawmna inn uah mi dangka-eng zungbuh bun, puan hoihtak silh hong lut henla, huan migenthei puansetak silh hong lut samleh;
puan hoihtak silhmi na limsak ua akiang ah, "Nang hiai mun hoih ah tu in," na chi ua, migenthei kiang ah bel, "Nang huai ah na dingh in, ahihkeileh, ka khe ngakna nuai ah tu in,” na chih uleh,
na lungsim uah khentuam nei leh ngaihtuahna giloupu, gense mite na hong hi kei ding ua hia?
Ka unau deihtakte aw, Pathian in hiai khovel a gentheite ginna a hau ding leh amah itte kiang a achiam gam luah ding in achi kei a hia?
Nou bel migentheite na zahlaksak zaw uhi. Mihaute hilou uhia nou hon nuaisiah? Mihaute hilou uhia vaihawmna a nou hon kailut?
Amaute hilou uhia minhoih na put uh gensete?
Himahleh Laisiangthou in, "Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi," chih kumpi dan na zop uleh na hihhoih uhi.
Himahleh mi khentuam na neih uleh, na hihkhial uhi, dan in talekte na hih uh ahon theisak zawta hi.
Kuapeuh in dan zuikim mahleh mun khat a ahihkhelhleh avek ah siam louh tang in a-om khin hi.
"Ang kawm ke'n," chipa'n, "Tualthat ke'n," achi lai hi. Huchi in angkawm kei mah lechin tual na thah in, dan a talekpa na hita hi.
Huaiziak in noplenna dan a vai hawmsak dingte bang in thu gen unla, thilhih behlap un.
Zahngaihna suahloumi tuh zahngaihna bei a vaihawmkhum hi ding ahi ngal a. Vaihawmna tung a vualzou zahngaihna ahi.
Ka unaute aw, mi'n ginna ka nei chi mahleh thilhih aneih keileh bang aphatuam dia? Huchibang ginna in amah ahondam thei dia hia?
Unaupa hiam, unaunu hiam, vuaktang a om in aniteng an nek tasam le uh,
na lak ua kuahiam in akiang ah, "Khamuangtak in pai inla, lumtak leh vahtak in om in," chi in asa a ding a thil kiphamoh pe tuan keileh bang aphatuam dia?
Huchi mah bang in ginna leng thilhih nei lou a amah kia a a-omleh si ahi.
Ahi, mi kuahiam in, "Nang ginna na nei a, ke'n thilhih ka nei hi," na ginna na thilhih pang lou in hon ensak inla, ke'n thilhih in ka ginna ka hon ensak ding achi thei hi.
Pathian khat kia ahi chih na gingta maw? Na hihhoih e; dawite'n leng agingta ua, aling zel uh, achi ding hi.
Mithulim lou aw, thilhih pang lou a ginna lel bangmah ahi kei chih na thei nuam hia?
I pu uh Abraham in maitam tung a atapa Isak alat lai in thilhih ziak a siamtang ahi kei a hia?
Ginna in thilhih toh asemkhawm a, thilhih ziak in ginna abukimta chih i thei uhi.
"Abraham in Pathian agingta a, huai ginna adiktatna a sim ahi," chih Laisiangthou hihkim in a-om hi; huchi in amah Pathian lawm chih in a-om hi.
Ginna ziak kia hilou in, thilhih ziak zaw in mi'n siam atang zel uh chih na theita uhi.
Huchibang in, Rahab kizuaknu'n leng sawltakte ana kipahpih a lam tuam a apaisak lai in, thilhih ziak in siamtang ahi kei maw?
Kha pang lou in pumpi si ahih bang in, thilhih pang lou ginna leng si ahi.
Ka unaute aw, na lak uah mi tampi heutu in hong om kei un, heutu in vaihawmna thupi sem atuak ding chih i thei uhi.
Thil tampi ah i vek un i gilou nak uhi. Kuapeuh thugen lam a agitlouh keileh mi piching ahi a, apumpi vengtheimi ahi.
Ngai un, sakolte'n i thu aman theihna ding ua akam ua kamkaihna sikkual i batleh apumpi uh i kaihei hi.
Longpite leng ngaihtuah sam un, alian mahmah ua, huih hat mutleng in a-om nak uhi, himahleh alonghekpa'n apaisak utna lam peuh ah ahekna neuchik petmah in akiheisak hi.
Hichibang in leitung pumpi hiang neuchik ahi a, nakpitak in aki-uangsak nak hi. Ngai un, meikuang neuchik phet in gammang nak katsak na tel e!
Huan lei tuh meikuang ahi, pumpi hiangte lak a gitlouhna lumpi, pumpi avek a ninsak a, mihing kisuansawndan pianphungpi kangsak ahi; huai lei mah in gawtmun mei toh apeh hi.
Sa chi chih, vasa chi chih, ganhing chi chih tuipi ate khoizual theih ahi ua, mite khoizual in a-om uhi.
Himahleh lei zaw kuamah in akhoizual thei kei uhi; sihna gu a dim gilou om kinken thei lou ahi.
Huai lei in Pa Pathian i phat ua; huai mah in Pathian bang a bawl mihingte i hamsiat uhi.
Kam khat a kipan in phatna leh hamsia apawt nak hi. Ka unaute aw, huchibang ding hilou ahi.
Tuikhuk khat in nak khat mah a kipan in tui lim leh lim lou asuaksak zel a hia?
Ka unaute aw, theipi kung ah olive thei agah thei a hia? Ahihkeileh grepgui ah theipi agah thei a hia? Huchibang in chikhuk in tui al lou asuaksak thei sam kei hi.
Na lak uah kua apil in, thu atheithei a? Thunuailut leh piltak in athilhihte omdan hoih in ensak hen.
Himahleh na lungtang uah hazatna thupitak leh kidemna na neih uleh thudik zuausan kei un.
Huai bang pilna zaw tunglam a kipan a hong paisuk ahi kei a, lei lam thil, khamitlouhna leh dawi lam thil a kipan ahi zaw hi.
Hazatna leh kidemna omna ah buaina leh thilhihkhelhna chiteng a-om hi.
Tunglam a kipan pilna bel, atung in asiangthou phot a, huai khit in kituah a-ut a, anunnem a, achihnuam a, zahngaihna leh gah hoih in adim a, khentuam anei kei a, alepchiah kei hi.
Huan diktatna gah zaw lemna bawlmi in lemna a atuh ahi.
Na lak ua kidounate leh kinaknate koi a kipan hong suak ahi ua? Hiaite na pumpi hiangte ua kidouna bawl nak, na nopsak utna ua kipan a hong suakkhete ahi kei ua hia?
Na lunggulh ua, na nei tuan kei ua, huchi in tual na that uh. Na eng ua, na ngah thei tuan kei ua, huchi in na kidou ua, gal na bawl uh. Na nget louh ziak un, na nei kei uh.
Na ngen ua, na nget diklouh ziak un na ngah kei uh, na nopsak bawlna ding lel ua zat na tup ziak un.
Nou angkawm hatte aw, khovel lawm hihna zaw Pathian melma hihna ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Huaiziak in khovel lawm hih ut peuhmah Pathian melma in akibawl nak hi.
Ahihkeileh eimah a teng Kha in, "Haza khop hial in ahon deih chih Laisiangthou in agen bangmah lou in na ngaihtuah ua hia?"
Himahleh ama'n hehpihna tamsem ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in Laisiangthou in, "Pathian in mikisatheite adou a, kingaineute bel hehpihna ape nak hi," achih.
Huaiziak in Pathian ah kitulut un. Diabol dou un, hileh noute ahon taimangsan ding hi.
Pathian naih unla, huchi in ama'n ahon naih ding. Khialte aw, na khut uh silsiang un; lungsim thuah neite aw, na lungtang uh hihsiangthou un.
Lungkham unla, suun unla, kapkhia un. Na nuih uh suunna suak henla, na lungnopna uh lungngaihna suak hen.
Toupa mitmuh in kingaineu un, huchi in ahon hihlian ding hi.
Unaute aw, kigensetuah kei un. Kuapeuh in a-unau agensiat hiam vai ahawmkhumleh, dan gensia a vaihawmkhum ahi; dan na gensiatleh dan zuimi na hi kei a, vaihawmpa na hi zaw hi.
Dan pepa leh vaihawmpa, amah hondam theipa leh hihmang theipa khat lel a-om hi; nang na vengte vaihawmkhum kua kisa na hia?
Tu'n ah noute'n ngai un, "Tuni hiam zingchiang hiam in, huai khopi ah i hoh ding ua, huai ah kum khat i va taam ding ua, i sumsin ding ua, punna i mu ding," chite aw.
Zingchiang a bang hong om ding ahia chih na thei kei uhi. Na hinna uh bang ahia? Tuimei sawt lou kal a hong dawk a, mang nawn lel bang na hi uhi.
Huchi in "Toupa'n pha asakleh i dam dia, hiai hiam, huai hiam i hih ding," na chih ding uh ahi.
Himahleh na ki-otsaknate uh na suang zaw ua, huai bang suanna tengteng gilou ahi.
Huchi in kuapeuh thil hoih ding thei a hih tuan lou zaw amah a ding in khelhna ahi.
Mihausate aw, ngai dih uh, na tung ua gimthuakna hong tung ding ziak a kap in, mau tuaituai un.
Na goute uh aseta a, na puante uh leikha in ne khinta hi.
Na dangka-eng uleh na dangkate uh atui-ek khinta hi; huan atui-ek uh nou hon theihpihtu ahi ding ua, meikang bang in na taksa uh akangse zou ding hi.
Ngai un, na lou ua buh at a kilohte loh amau khem a na piak louh uh akikou ua, buh atte mangbang kikou aw Sepaihte' Toupa bil ah alutta hi.
Khovel ah nuamsatak leh noptaltak in na hing ua, na thah ni bang un na lungtang uh na taisak uhi.
Midiktat, nou hon douloute siam louh tangsak in na that uhi.
Huchi in unaute aw, Toupa hong pai mateng kuhkaltak in om un. Ngai un, louneimi in vuahtui ke masa leh nanung amuh mateng leigah hoihtak angak zel hi.
Nou leng kuhkaltak in om un; na lungtang uh hihkip un; Toupa hong paina ding anaita hi.
Unaute aw, siam louh tang a na omlouhna ding un, kiphunkhum kei un; ngai un, kongkhak bul ah vaihawmpa adingh hi.
Unaute aw, Toupa min a thugenmi zawlneite thuakdan leh akuhkaldan uh zuih ding in nei un.
Ngai un, athuak mite tuh nuamsa i chi uhi; Job kuhkaldan na zata ua, Toupa'n atawp a ahihdan leh Toupa hehpihna a adimdan leh azahngaih theihdan leng na mu uhi.

Himahleh ka unaute aw, bang teng tung ah, kichiam kei un; van lou in hiam, lei lou in hiam, thil dang himhim lou in hiam kichiam kei un, hiamhleh "hi" na chih uh "hi" henla, "hilou" na chih uh "hilou" hi hen; huchi lou in zaw siam louh tang in na om kha ding uhi.
Na lak uah thil hoih lou thuak a-om uhia? Thum uhen. Kipak a om uhia? Phatna la sa uhen.
Na lak uah damlou a-om uhia? Saptuam Upa samsak uhenla, ama'n Toupa min a sathau nilh in atung ah thum hen.
Huan ginna a thumna in damlou adam ding a, Toupa'n amah akaithou ding; thil ahihkhelh takleh ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
Huchi in hihdam a na omtheihna ding un, na khelhnate uh thupha kitawituah unla, kithumsaktuah un. Midiktat thumna in thil thupitak ahih zel hi.
Elijah leng eimah piandan bang pu mihing ahi a, vuah zuklouhna ding in phatuamngaitak in athum a, kum thum leh kha guk sung teng leitung ah vuah azu kei hi.
Athum nawn a, van in vuah azusak a, lei in agahte ahon suah hi.
Ka unaute aw, na lak ua mi kuapeuh thutak a kipan in pialmang henla kuahiam in pikik nawnleh,
mikhial alamhaihna a kipan a kiheisakpa'n sihna a kipan akha ahondam ding a, khelhna tampi akhuhsak lai ding chih kithei hen.
Juda, Jesu Khrist sikha leh Jakob unau in, Pa Pathian sehtuam siangthoute leh Jesu Khrist a kep leh sap a omte kiang ah:
Zahngaihna, khamuanna leh itna na tung uah hihkhan in om hen.

Deihtakte aw, i kikop hotdamna thu na kiang ua gelh teitei ka tup lai in, misiangthoute kiang a ginna khatvei kepsak a om thu a, phatuamngaitak a humbit a pang ding a hon hanthawn ding in, na kiang ua laigelh kiphamoh ahi chih ka na thei hi.

Mi kuate hiam aguk a hong lut a-om ua, nidanglai a pan hiai siam louh tanna dia sehte; huaite'n thangtatna dia Pathian hehpihna kaikawi in, Toupa Pathian omsun leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist akitheihmohbawl behlap uhi.
Huan bangkim khatvei in thei vek mah le uchin, Toupa'n Aigupta gam a kipan mite asuahtaksak a, huai nung a gingtaloute ahihmanthatdan, nou hon theihsak nawn ka ut hi.
Huan angelte, amau sawltak hihna zui lou a, a-omna ngei uh paisante ni thupi vaihawmna a ding a mial nuai a tangtawn gawtna a hen kawm in asit hi.

Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akiangnai ua khuate kingaihna a kipumpiak a, gitlouhna lek lua, amau mihinpihloute nangawn enlah a adelh tak ziak un, tangtawn mei a gawt a om dingte etsakna ding in suankhiak in a-om uhi.
Himahleh huaite'n leng huchibang mah in, hiai mite'n leng, mang a kinga in sa ahihthanghuai ua, thuneihna anial ua, thupina neite agense nak uhi.
Himahleh Mikael, angel tungnungpen in bawn, diabol toh kisel a, Mosi luang thu a akinak lai un atungthu gensak in amah agense ngam kei a, "Toupa'n hon tai zaw hen," achi zawta hi.
Huai mite'n bel thil atheih louh peuh uh agensia ua, ngaihtuahna nei lou ganhingte bang a theihsiamna pianpih aneihte un, huai lam pang ah amau akihihsia uhi.
Atung uh agik hi! Kain lampi azui ua, punna delh in Balaam mohna ah atai ua, Korah thukalhna ah amangthangta uhi.

Hiaite ahi uh na itna ankuangluina ua hihmelhemtu leh lauhuai kiselte, amau mah kikhem, angsung ngaihtuah a, maingaltak a tathangte; meipi tuipai lou, huih mutlengte; phavang a singgah lou, nihvei sisa, azung toh bohkhiakte ahi uh.
Tuipi kihot vonvon, amau zahlakna thankhia ahi ua; aksi vialvak, amau a dia tangtawn mial bing bikbek sitsakte ahi uh.
Huan Enok, Adam a kipan akhang sagihna in hiai mite tungtang ah, "Ngai un, Toupa amisiangthou sangsawmte toh ahong pai, chi in ana genkhol hi.

Mi tengteng tung a vaihawm ding leh Pathian limsakloute tengteng Pathian limsaklouhna leh Pathian limsakloute tung a asep tengteng uah leh Pathian limsak lou mikhialte'n atung a thu khauhtak agen tengteng ua siam louh tangsak ding in," achi hi.
Huaite phunhatte leh ngohhatte ahi ua, amau utna bang zel in a-om ua, akamte un leng ki-otsakna thu agen gawpgawp ua, punna deih ziak in mite maitangphat adeih uhi.
Himahleh deihtakte aw, nou zaw i Toupa Jesu Khrist sawltakte'n thu agenkholhte uh theigige un.
"Hun nanung ah Pathian limsaklouhna lam a amau utna bang zel a om, nuihsan hatte ahong om ding uh," chih na kiang ua agendante uh.
Hiai sa mite ahi, Kha nei lou, pawl tuam bawlte.
Himahleh deihtakte, nou zaw na ginna siangthou tung a noumau leh noumau kilemtou in; Kha Siangthou a thum in,
tangtawn hinna neihsakna khop i Toupa Jesu Khrist zahngaihna ngak in, Pathian itna ah kikemhoih un.
Khenkhatte, ginglah a omte hehpih unla;
