khenkhatte, mei a kipan in lakhe zok unla, hondam un; khenkhatte, asa thanghuai banna uh puansilh lam leng kih in, lau kawm in hehpih un.
Tu in, na puklouhna ding ua hon veng thei leh athupina ma a nakpitak a nuamsa leh nin baang lou a noute hon koihtheipa,
apil omsun Hondampa, Pathian tak kia kiang ah, i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak in, hun himhim om ma leh tu leh tangtawn dong in pahtawina, leh thupina, leh vaihawmna, thuneihna omta hen, Amen.
Joshua sih nung in hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante'n, "Kanaante dou a ei a dia hon sualsak ding in kua akuantou masa dia?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi.
TOUPA'N, "Judah va kuan hen. Ngai un, akhut ah gam ka peta," achi hi.
Judah in a-unau Simeon kiang ah, "Kanaante dou ding in ka gam tantuam ah hong paitou in. Kei leng na gam tantuam ah ka hong pai sam ding," achi hi. Huchi in Simeon akiang ah ahohta hi.
Huchi in Judah ava hoh a; Kanaante leh Perizte TOUPA'N akhut uah apeta hi. Bezek ah mi singkhat athat uhi.
Bezek ah Adoni- bezek amu ua, adou ua, Kanaante leh Perizte athat uhi.
Himahleh Adoni-bezek atai a; anungdelh ua, aman ua, akhutpi leh akhepi atansak uhi.

Adoni-bezek in, "Kumpipa sawmsagihte khutpi leh khepi ka tankhiaksakte'n ka dohkan nuai ah anneng atawm uh. Ka hih bang geih a Pathian in hon thuk ahita ve," achi hi. Jerusalem ah api ua, huai ah asita hi.
Judah suante'n Jerusalem khua dou in ala ua, namsau a sual in akhopi ahal uhi.
Huai nung in Judah suante tanggam simlam leh phaizang a teng Kanaante dou ding in akuansuk uhi.
Judah in Kanaante Hebron a tengte ava dou a, (ama in Hebron min Kiriath-arba ahi) Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai athat uhi.
Huai a pan Debir khomite adou uh, ama in Debir kho min Kiriath-sepher ahi.
Kaleb in, "Kuapeuh Kiriath-sepher khua dou a, la peuhmah ka tanu Aksah azi ding in ka pe ding," achi hi.
Kaleb nau Kenaji tapa Othniel in alazou a, azi ding in atanu Aksah apeta hi.
uan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ava tun in gam ngen thei ding in apa akunzou hi. Sabiltung a pan akumkhia a; Kaleb in akiang ah, "Bang na deih a?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Hon vualzawl in. Simlam gam lah na hon peta ngal a, tui nak neite leng hon pe lai in," achi hi. Kaleb in tui nak nei tungnungte leh khangnungte apeta hi.
Mosi puzon Ken suante Arad simlam a om Judah gamdai ah Judah suante toh tum sing khopi a pan ahohtou ua; mipite lak ah ava teng uhi.
Judah bel a-unau Simeon toh akisa ua, Zephath a om Kanaante ava that ua, ahihchimit vek uhi. Huai khopi min Hormah chih ahi.
Judah in Gaza khua leh abialte, Ashkelon khua leh abialte leh Ekron khua leh abialte tan in ala hi.
TOUPA Judah kiang ah a-om a; tanggam a tengte adelhkhia a; phaizang a tengte bel sik kangtalaite aneih ziak un adelhkhe zou kei hi.
Mosi in ana gensa bang in Hebron khua Kaleb apia ua, ama'n huai a pan Anak tapa thumte adelhkhia hi.
Benjamin suante'n Jebuste, Jerusalem a tengte adelhkhe kei ua, Jebuste Benjamin suante toh tuni tan in Jerusalem ah atengkhawm uhi.
Joseph inkuante leng Bethel khua dou ding in akisatou ua, akiang uah TOUPA a-om hi.
Joseph inkuante'n Bethel ah enkhe mite asawl uhi. Ama in huai kho min Luz ahi.
Enkhe mite'n mi khat khosung a pan hong pawtkhia amu ua, akiang ah, "Hehpih in khopi sung lutna hon ensak dih ve, huchi in ka hon hehpih ding uh," achi uhi,
Khopi sung lutna a-ensak a, namsau in huai khua adou ua; huai mipa leh a-inkuanpihte teng bel ahinghawi uhi,
Huai mipa Hitte gam a lut in khua asat a, huai kho min Luz asa a; tuni tan in hiai min apu lai hi.

Manasseh in Beth-shean khua leh akhopel a tengte, Taanak khua leh akhopel a tengte, Dor khua leh akhopel a tengte, Ibleam khua leh akhopel a tengte, Meggiddo khua leh akhopel a tengte adelhkhe kei hi. Huai gam ah Kanaante ateng uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante ahong hat un anasem ding un Kanaante a omsak ua, adelhkhe siang vek kei uhi.
Ephraim in Gezer a teng Kanaante adelhkhe kei a; Gezer ah alak uah Kanaante ateng zawta uh.
Zebulun in Kitron a tengte leh Nahalol a tengte adelhkhe kei a; Kanaante alak uah ateng sam ua, anasem ding un a-om zawta uhi.
Asher in Akko a tengte, Zidon a tengte, Ahlab a tengte, Akjib a tengte, Helbah a tengte, Aphik a tengte leh Rehob a tengte adelhkhe kei hi.
Asher suante huai gam a teng Kanaante lak ah ateng samta uhi; amau lah adelhkhe ngal kei ua.
Naphtali in Beth-shemesh a tengte, Beth-anath a tengte adelhkhe kei. Huai gam a teng Kanaante lak ah ateng samta uhi. Beth-shemesh a tengte leh Beth-anath a tengte nasem ding in a-omta uhi.
Amorte'n Dan suante tanggam ah ahawltou uh; phaizang a apaisuk uh aphal ngal kei ua.
Amorte Aijalon a Heres tang leh Shaalbim ah ateng ua, Joseph inkuante'n amau azou ua, anasem ding un alak uah ateng uhi.
Amorte gam chiang Akrabbim tungkahna a pan, suangpi a pan leh Sela a pan ahi.
Huan Abimelek sih nung in Israelte hunkhe ding in Issakar mi Tola ahong dingkhia a; amah Puah tapa ahi. Puah bel Dodo tapa ahi. Amah Ephraim tanggam Shamir ah ateng hi.
Kum sawmnih-le-thum sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm a, huchi in asita a, Shamir ah avui uhi.
Huai nung in Gilead mi Jair ahong dingkhia a, kum sawmnih-le-nih sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Ama'n sabiltungnou tung a tuang tapa sawmthum anei a, amau Gilead gam ah khua sawmthum anei ua, huaite tuni tan in Havothjair achi lai uhi.
Jair asi a, Kamon ah avui uhi.

Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou hih nawn in Baal leh Ashtaroth, Siriate pathian, Zidonte pathian, Moabte pathian, Ammon suante pathian leh Philistiate pathian nna asem uhi. Huchi in TOUPA alehngatsan ua, ama nna asemta kei uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA Israelte tung ah ahehta mahmah a, Philistiate leh Ammon suante kiang ah amaute akhawngta hi.
Huai kum in amau Israel suante hihbuai in anuaisiah uhi. Jordan gal Gilead gam a Amorte gam a Israel suan om tengteng kum sawm-le-giat sung anuaisiah uhi.
Ammon suante bel Judahte, Benjaminte, Ephraim inkote dou ding in Jordan agalkah ua; huchi in Israelte alungzing mahmah uhi.
Israel suante'n, "I Pathian in Baalte nna i na sep ziak un hon lehngatsanta, atung ah thil i hihkhialta uh," chi in TOUPA asam uhi.
TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah, "Aiguptate a pan, Amorte a pan, Ammon suante a pan leh Philistiate a pan noute ka hon hunkhe kei maw?
Sidonte, Amalekte leh Ammonte'n leng noute ahon nuaisiah ua; na hon sam ua, huchi in akhut ua kipan ka hon hunkhia hi.
Himahleh noute'n na hon lehngatsan ua, pathian dangte nna na sem zawta uh. Huaiziak in ka hon hunkhe nawn kei ding.
Na pathian telte uh samta unla, amau na gimthuak hun un hon hunkhia uhen," achi hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA kiang ah, "Thil ka na hihkhialta uh. Nang pha na sak bangbang in ka tung uah hih in. Himahleh ka hong thum uhi, tuni in hon hunkhe lai in," chi in.
Huchi in alak ua namdang pathiante akoihmang ua, TOUPA nna asemta uh. Ama'n Israelte lungzinna athuakzou nawnta kei hi.
Ammon suante akikhawm ua, Gilead gam ah ava kikulh ua, Israel suante leng akikhawm ua, Mizpah ah akikulh uhi.
Mipite leh Gilead gam a miliante akihou ua, Ammon suante dou pan ding kua a-om a? Huai mi Gilead gam tengteng tung ah heutu ahi ding, akichi uhi.
Gilead mi Jephthah mihat hangsan ahi a, kizuaknu tapa ahi. Gilead in Jephthah asuang hi.
Gilead zi in tapate asuansak a; azi tapate ahong pichin un Jephthah adelhkhia ua, akiang ah, "Nang zaw ka pa uh inn ah gou na luah thei kei ding. Numei tuam khat tapa na hih ziak in," achi uhi.
Huchi in Jephthah a-unaute a pan ataimang a, Tob gam ah ateng hi. Jephthah kiang ah mithulim lou pipi atengkhawm ua, amah azui zel uh.
Huai nung deuh in Ammon suante'n Israelte adouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ammon suante'n Israelte adou uleh, Gilead upate Tob gam a Jephthah pi ding in apaikheta uhi.
Jephthah kiang ah, "Ammon suante ka dou theihna ding un ka heutupen ding un hong om in," achi uhi.
Jephthah in Gilead upate kiang ah, "N'on hua ua, ka pa inn a pan na hon delhkhia uh ahi kei maw? Bang achia na buaitak ua ka kiang a hong na hi ua?" achi hi.

Gilead upate'n Jephthah kiang ah, "Huaiziaktak ahi, tua nang lam ka hong ngat nawn uh. Ammon suante dou dia ka kiang ua na paitheihna ding in; Gilead gam a teng tengtengte tung ah ka heutu ding un na om ding," achi uhi.
Jephthah in Gilead upate kiang ah, "Ammon suante dou dia na hon pikik nawn ua, TOUPA'N amau ahon piakleh na heutu ding un maw ka om ding?" achi hi.
Gilead upate'n Jephthah kiang ah, "Na thu bangbang a ka hih kei uleh i kikal uah hon theihpihpa TOUPA ahi ding,” achi uhi.
Huchi in Jephthah bel Gilead upate kiang ah ahohta a, mite'n heutu ding leh api penpen ding in ana bawlta uhi. Jephthah in Mizpah ah TOUPA ma ah athu teng agenta hi.
Jephthah in Ammon suante kumpipa kiang ah, "Bangchidan a hichibang a ka gam hong dou dia ka kiang a hong pai mawk na hia?" chi in palai asawl hi.

Ammon suante kumpipa'n, "Israelte Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt lai ua, ka gam ahon laksak ziak uh ahi. Arnon a pan Jabok leh Jordan tan in. Huaiziak in huai gamte lungdam in hon pe nawn mai in," chi in Jephthah palaite ana dawng hi.
Huchi in Jephthah in Ammon suante kumpipa kiang ah palai asawl nawn hi.
Akiang ah, Jephthah in hichi in achi, “Israelte'n Moab gam alaksak kei ua, Ammon suante gam leng alaksak sam kei uh.
Himahleh, Aigupta gam a pan Israelte ahong pawt un gamdai tawn in Tuipi San ahong tung ua, huai a pan Kadesh ah ahong pai uhi.

Israelte'n Edom kumpipa kiang ah, 'Hehpih in na gam ah ka paisuak ding uh,' chi in palai asawl uh. Himahleh Edom kumpipa in ana ngaikhe nuam kei. Huchi mah bang in Moab kumpipa kiang ah asawl nawn a, himahleh pha ana sa kei hi. Huchi in Kadesh ah Israelte a-omta uhi.

Huchi in gamdai ah apaisuak ua, Edom gam leh Moab gam kimvel in apai ua, Moab gam suahlam pang ah apai ua, Arnon lehlam pang ah giahphual asat uhi. Moab gamsung ah alut kei hial uh; Arnon bel Moab gamgi chiang ahi.

Israelte'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Heshbon kumpipa kiang ah palai asawl uhi. Israelte'n akiang ah, ka hong thum uhi, 'Ka mun ua ka paina ding un hehpih in na gam tawn in hon paisuaksak in,' achi uhi.
Himahleh Sihon in Israelte agam a paisuak ding in amuangzou kei. Sihon in ami tengteng akaikhawm a, Jahaz ah akikulh a, Israelte adouta hi.
TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in Sihon leh ami tengteng Israelte khut ah apia a, amaute athat uhi. Huchi in Israelte'n huai gam a om Amorte gam tengteng atangta uhi.
Huchi in Amorte gamgi chiang tengteng Arnon a pan Jabok pha in, gamdai a pan Jordan pha in atangvekta uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in ami Israelte ma ah Amorte ahawlkhia a, bangziak a nang hiai gam luah thei ding na hia?
Na pathian Kemos in nang a tuam dia ahon sehsaksa tang ding hilou na hi maw? Huchi in TOUPA ka Pathian un ka ma ua ahawlkhiakte uh ka tang ding uhi.
Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak sang in na hatzaw a hia? Ama'n Israelte kinakpih in ahihkeileh adou ngei himhim a hia?
Heshbon leh akhotate, Aroer leh akhotate, Arnon gamgi naih khopi tengteng a kum zathum tak aten lai ua, bangziak a nang ana lakik lou nilouh na hia?

Huaiziak in na tung ah thil bangmah ka hihkhial kei. Nangma'n hon dou na tup ziak in ka tung ah thil na hihkhial ahi zaw. TOUPA, Vaihawmpa in tuni in Israel suante leh Ammon suante kal ah thu ngaihtuah hen," achi hi.
Himahleh Ammon suante kumpipa'n Jephthah thukhah ana ngaikhe nuam kei hi.
Huchi in Jephthah tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, Gilead leh Manasseh gam ah apaisuak a, Gilead a Mizpah ah apaisuak a, Gilead gam Mizpah a pan Ammon suante kiang ah apai zel hi.
TOUPA kiang ah Jephthah akichiam a, "Ammon suante ka khut a na hon piakleh,
hichi ahi ding a, Ammon suante a pan galmuang a ka paikik nawn chiang in bangpeuh ka inn kongpi a pan hon dawn masa penpen TOUPA a ahi dia, halmang thillat ding in ka zang ngeingei ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in Jephthah bel Ammon suante dou ding in akuanta hi. TOUPA'N akhut ah amaute apeta hi.
Aroer a pan Minnith pha leh Abel-keramim kal a khopi sawmnih azou vek a, mi tampi athat hi. Huchi in Israel suante'n Ammon suante anuaisiahta uhi.
Jephthah, atenna khua Mizpah a a-inn ah apai a, ngai in, atanu in khuangtate toh lam in ana dawn hi. Ata neihsun ahi a; amah lou tapa hiam tanu dang himhim anei kei hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah amuhtak in apuante abotkek a, "Ehe, ka tanu! N'on niamkiaksak mahmah ve. Hon mangbangsak mite lak a khat na hita. TOUPA ma ah lah ka kam ka na kata ngal a, huai lah zukkik thei ka hita kei," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Pa aw, TOUPA kiang a thu na chiam tak ahihleh, na kam a thupawt bang in ka tung ah hih in. TOUPA'N lah na melma Ammon suante tung ah na phu ahon laksakta ngal a," achi hi.
Ama'n apa kiang ah, "Hichibang in kei a ding in kihih hen. Kha nih sung ka tang-om dia, tangte ah asuk atou in ka pai dia, ka nungak siangthou hihna ka suun ding, kei leh ka lawmte'n," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Pai ve," achi hi. Huchi in kha nih taam ding in asawlkhia a; apawt a, amah leh alawmte'n tangte ah anungak siangthou hihna ava suun uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kha nih nung in apa kiang ah ahong kik nawn a, ama'n ana kichiamsa bang in atung ah ahih hi. Atanu nungak siangthou in a-omdenta a, pasal toh alumkhawm ngei kei hi.
Israel tanute'n Gilead mi Jephthah tanu kum teng in ni li sung asuun zel uhi. Hiai Israelte lak ah ngeina in aneita uhi.

Huan Ephraimte akikaikhawm ua, mallam zuan in apai ua; Jephthah kiang ah, "Bangziak a Ammon suante dou dia hong paiphei a, na kiang a hoh dia hon chial sam lou? Na inn toh ka hon buhalkhawm ding uh,” achi uhi.
Jephthah in akiang uah, "Ammon suante ka mite toh theihtawp suah in ka dou ua; ka hon sap lai in akhut ua kipan in lah na hon hunkhe ut kei ua.

Huchi in na hon hunkhe nuam kei uh chih ka theihtak in, sih khawk sa lou hial in ka pang a, Ammon suante dou ding in ka kuan a, huchi in TOUPA'N amaute ka khut ah ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in bangziak a hon dou dia tuni a hong kuan na hi ua?" achi hi.

Huchi in Jephthah in Gilead mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Ephraimte adouta hi. Gileadte'n Ephraimte athat uhi. "Nou Gileadte, Ephraimte leh Manassehte lak a galtai vakvai maimaite na hi uh," achih ziak un.

Gileadte'n Ephraimte ma in Jordan lui kainate ana la ua; hichi ahong hi a, Ephraim mi suaktate'n, "Ka hong galkah ding uh," achih chiang un Gileadte'n akiang ah, "Ephraim mi na hi hia?” ana chi zel uh. Ama'n, "Hilou e,” achihleh,

akiang ah, "Shiboleth, chi mah dih," ana chi ua, ama'n, "Siboleth," achi zaw zel a; alouchian thei kei hi. Huchi in aman ua, Jordan lui kainate ah ana that zel uh. Huchi in huai tung in Ephraimte singli-le-sangnih athat uhi.
Jephthah in Israelte tung ah kum guk vai ahawm a, huchi in asita a, Gilead gam a khua khat ah avui uhi.
Anung in Bethlehem a mi Ibzan in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Ama'n tapa sawmthum leh tanu sawmthum anei hi. Atanute gamdang ah asawl a, atapate a ding in gamdang a pan tanu sawmthum apisak hi. Ama'n Israelte tung ah kum sagih vai ahawm hi.
Ibzan asita a, Bethlehem ah avui uh.
Anung in Zebulun mi Elon in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm a; Israelte tung ah kum sawm vai ahawm hi.
Zebulun mi Elon asita a, Zebulun gam a Aijalon ah avui uhi.
Huai nung in Pirathon mi, Hilel tapa Abdon in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Ama'n tapa sawmli leh sabiltungnou sawmsagih tung a tuang zel tupa sawmthum anei hi. Ama'n Israelte tung ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
Pirathon mi, Hilel tapa Abdon asita a, Ephraim gam, Amalek mite tanggam ah Pirathon ah avuita uh.
Huan Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn ua; huchi in TOUPA'N Philistiate khut ah amaute kum sawmli sung apia hi.
Zorah ah Dan nam mi khat a-om a, amin Manoah ahi a, azi bel achiing a, nau anei kei hi.
Numei kiang ah TOUPA angel ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na chiing a, nau nei thei lou himah lechin na gai dia, tapa na nei ding hi.
Huchi in pilvang in, uain leh zu hat leh siang lou thil himhim ne het ke'n.

'Ngai in, na gai dia, tapa nei ding na hi ngal a. Alu ah mulmet tem himhim zat ahi kei ding; naupang bel sul a a-om lai a pan Pathian a dia Nazarit hi ding ahi ngal a.' Ama'n Israelte Philistia mite khut a pan hutkhiak apan ding," achi hi.

Numei in apasal kiang ah, "Pathian mipa khat ka kiang ah ahong a, amel Pathian angel mel bang ahi a, kihtakhuaitak ahi. Koilam mi ahia chih bel ka dong chitchiat kei a, ama'n lah amin ahon hilh sam kei hi.

Himahleh ka kiang ah, Ngai in, na gai dia, tapa na nei ding. Huchi in uain leh zu hat himhim dawn ke'nla, siang lou thil himhim leng ne het ke'n. Naupang sul a a-om lai a pan asih tan in Pathian a dia Nazarit mi hi ding ahi, achi,” chi in agen hi.

Huchi in Manoah in TOUPA kiang ah nget chihtak in angen a, akiang ah, "Aw TOUPA hehpih in huai Pathian mipa na hon sawl ka kiang uah hong nawn henla, naupang hong piang ding bang ka chih ding ua hong sinsak hen," achi hi.
Pathian in Manoah thugen ana ngaikhia hi. Loubuk a numei atut lai in akiang ah Pathian angel ahong nawn hi. Apasal Manoah bel akiang ah a-om kei hi.
Numei kintak in atai pah a, apasal ava hilh a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, zanlam a ka kiang a hong hohpa ka kiang ah ahong kilak nawn," achi hi.
Huchi in Manoah athou a, azi azui a, huai mi kiang ava tung uhi. Akiang ah, "Numei kiang a thu gen nang na hi maw?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi.
Manoah in, “Na thu bang zel in hong tung hen. Naupang omdan ding bangchibang ahi dia, asep ding bang ahi dia le?" achi hi.
TOUPA angel in Manoah kiang ah, "Numei kiang a ka gen tengteng ah amah pilvang hen.
Grepgui a pan mawngmawng ane ding ahi kei a, uain leh zu hat adawn ding ahi kei. Siang lou thil mawngmawng leng ane ding ahi kei. Ka thupiak tengteng zui hen," achi hi.
Manoah in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Ka hong thum uh. Hehpih in hon ompih lai in, kelnou ka hon bawlsak khit matan uh," achi hi.

TOUPA angel in Manoah kiang ah, "Hon khou lechin leng na an zaw ka ne kei ding. Haltum thil lan ding na hihleh TOUPA kiang a na lat ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi. Manoah in lah TOUPA angel ahi chih athei ngal kei hi.
Manoah in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Na min bang ahia, na thugen bang a hong tun chiang a ka hon pahtawi theihna ding un?" achi hi.
TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Bangziak a ka min hon dong na hia, lamdang ahi chih theizen napi a?" achi hi.
Huchi in Manoah in kelnou khat leh nek ding thillat ala a; suangpi tung ah TOUPA kiang ah alan hi. Angel in thillamdangtak ahih a, Manoah leh azi in a-en nilouh uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, maitam a pan meikuang van lam a akahtouh lai in, maitam a meikuang ah TOUPA angel apaitouta hi. Manoah leh azi in a-en nilouh ua, amaitang un lei asi uhi.
Himahleh TOUPA angel Manoah leh azi kiang ah ahong kilak nawn kei hi. Huchi in Manoah in TOUPA angel ahi chih atheita hi.
Manoah in azi kiang ah, "Pathian i muh ziak in i si ngeingei ding,” achi hi.

Himahleh azi in akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hon hihlup tum hileh halmang thillat leh nek ding thillat i latte asang kei ding. Hiai thil tengteng leng ahon ensak kei ding a, tu hun in hiai thilte leng hon hilh kei ding," achi hi.
Numei in tapa aneita a, amin Samson asa uh. Naungek ahong khanglian a, TOUPA'N avualzawl hi.
Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal ah Mahaneh Dan mun ah TOUPA kha in atokthouta hi.
Huan Samson bel Timnah ah ahohsuk a, Timnah ah Philistiate tanute lak ah numei khat ava mu hi.
Ahong paitouh nawn in anu leh apa ahilh hi. "Timnah khua ah, Philistiate tanute lak ah numei khat ka mu a; ka zi ding in hon pisak un," achi hi.

Huchi in anu leh apa'n akiang ah, "Na unaute tanute lak ah hiam, ka mipite lak a hiam numei om het lou hia? Zeksum louh Philistiate lak a zi ding na va zon maimah?" achi uhi. Samson in apa kiang ah, "Hon pisak mai in; ama'n hon lungkimsak mahmah ahi," achi hi.
Himahleh anu leh apa'n, hiai TOUPA a pan ahi chih athei kei uh; ama'n Philistiate tung a phulakna ding hun lemtang zong lah ahi ngal a. Huai lai in Philistiate'n Israelte tung ah vai ahawm uhi.
Huchi in Samson bel anu leh apa toh Timnah ah ahohsuk ua, Timnah a grephuan ava tung uhi. Ngai in, humpinelkai lun lai ana humham hi.
TOUPA Kha atung ah nakpitak in ahong tung hi. Huchi in kelnou balnen bang mai in abalnen maimah hi; bangmah lah atawi ngal kei a. Himahleh athilhih anu leh apa ahilh kei hi.
Ahohsuk a, huai numei ahoupih hi. Ama'n Samson akipaksak mahmah hi.
Anung in va pi ding in ahoh nawn a, humpinelkai luang en ding in ava pial hi. Ngai in, humpinelkai luang ah khuai hon leh azu ana om hi.
Huai ala a, apai nawn a, apai kawm in ane kawmkawm hi. Anu leh pa kiang atungtou a, amau leng apia a, amau leng ane sam uhi. Himahleh huai khuaizu humpinelkai luang a pan alak ahi chih ahilh kei hi.
Huchi in huai numei kiang ah apa ava hohsuk a, huai ah Samson in ankuang alui hi. Huai ahihleh tangvalte hihdan ahi him hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah amuhtak un, akiang a om ding in mi sawmthum api uhi.
Samson in akiang uah, "Tu in thuhaksa hon dong ning e. Ankuanglui ni, ni sagih sung a na hon hilhchet theih ua, na theihkhiak theih uleh puanmalngat silh sawmthum ka hon pe ding.

Himahleh na hon hilhchet theih kei uleh, puanmalngat silh sawmthum leh kikhenna puan sawmthum na hon piak ding uh ahi,” achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Na thuhaksa gen dih ve le, ka na ngaikhe ding uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Netu a pan nek ding hong pawt, hattak a pan thil khumtak hong pawt," achi hi.

Ni thum sung in huai thuhaksa ahilhchian thei kei uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in Samson zi kiang ah, "Ka kiang ua hiai thuhaksa hilhchetna puangkhe ding in na pasal kun in. Huchi lou in zaw nang leh na pa inkote ka hon hal ding uh. Ka neihsa uh la dia hon sam na hi kei maw?" achi uhi.

Huchi in Samson zi ama ah akap a, "N'on it kei a, na hon ho zaw ve. Ka chite lah thuhaksa na dong ngal a, kei na hon hilhchian kei," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, ka nu leh pa leng ka hilh kei a; nang ka hon hilh dia hia?" achi hi.
A-ankuanglui uh, ni sagih sung teng ama ah akapkap hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in anget ngutngut ziak in ahilh khongkhong hi. Ama'n thuhaksa hilhchetna achipihte ava hilhta hi.

Ani sagih ni, nitum ma in huai khua a mite'n akiang ah, "Khuaizu sang a khumzaw bang ahia? Humpinelkai sang a hatzaw bang ahia?" achi uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka bawngla in lei let kei le uchin zaw, ka thuhaksa theikhe lou ding hi ve uchin," achi hi.

TOUPA Kha atung ah nakpitak in ahong tung a, Ashkelon ah ahohsuk hi. Mi sawmthum ava that a, apuansilhte uh ahawksak a, kikhenna puante thuhaksa hilhchiante apia hi. Huchi in aheh mahmah a, apa inn ah apaitou hi.
Himahleh Samson zi pen akitenna ua theihpih a pang Samson lawmpa kiang ah zi ding in piak in a-om hi.
Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, anung sawt lou in, buhlak hun in, Samson in kelnou tawi in azi ava veh hi. "Dantan sung ah ka zi kiang ah ka va lut ding," achi hi. Himahleh apa'n alut aphalta kei hi.
Apa'n, “Amah na ho mahmah ka sa a, huaiziak in na lawmpa kiang ah ka peta hi. Anau amah sang in amelhoih zaw hilou hia?" achi hi.
Samson in, "Tutung in Philistiate khoih leng amau sang in dem ka kai kei zaw ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Samson in sihal zathum ava man a, meisel ala a, amei uleh mei apehkhawm a, amei uh kikal chiat ah meisel akoih chiat hi.
Meiselte adettak in Philistiate buhlak ah atailutsak a, buhphal leh buh dingh laite, olive munte toh nangawn in akang vek hi.

Huchi in Philistiate'n, "Kua hih ahia?" achi uh. Amau, "Timnah a mi makpapa Samson hih ahi. Huai Timnah a mi in Samson zi alawmpa zi dia apiak man ahi," akichi uhi. Huchi in Philistiate ahong kuan ua apata un ahallumta uhi.
Samson in akiang uah, "Hichibang na hih uh leh na tung uah phu ka la sam ding, huai khit in ka tawp ding," achi hi.
Huchi in nakpitak in asual a, tampi athat a, apaisuk a, Etam suangpi tung ah a-omta hi.
Huchi in Philistiate ahohtou ua, Judah gam ah ava kikulh ua, Lehi mun ah akiphalh uhi.
Judah gam a mite'n, "Bangchidan ahia kou sual dia na hong kuan mawk uh?" achi uhi. Amau, "Samson khaukhih a ka tung ua ahih mah bang a ama tung a leng hih ding in ka hong uh," achi uhi.

Huchi in Judah gam a mi sangthum Etam suangpi tung ah ahoh ua, Samson kiang ah, "Philistiate i tung ua vaihawmte ahih uh thei lou na maw? Bangchidan a hichibang a ka tung ua thil hon hihta mai na hia oi?" achi uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka tung a, ahih bang ua ke'n leng amau tung a hih sam ka hi,” achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Nang hon khaukhih a, Philistiate khut a hon pe dia hong kuan ka hi uh," achi uhi. Samson in akiang uah, "Noute'n hon that lou ding in ka kiang ah kichiam un," achi hi.

Amau akiang ah, "That lou e. Himahleh ka hon khaukhih tinten ding ua, akhut ua hon pe ding ka hi uh. Thah zaw ka hon that kei hial ding uh," achi uhi. Huchi in khauzen thak nih in akhih ua, suangpi a pan apita uhi.

Lehi mun ahong tun in, Philistiate'n ana dawn ua, ana kikou zuazua uhi. TOUPA kha atung ah nakpitak in ahong tung a, huchi in aban a gakna khauzen ziza zang mei in kangtat bang mai ahong hita a, agaknate a khut a pan akekhe niang maimah uhi.
Sabiltung khaguh thak amu a, asawk a, ala a, huai in mi sangkhat asatlum hi.
Samson in, "Sabiltung khaguh in ka chiang vum venvon a, sabiltung khaguh in mi sangkhat ka satlum,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, athugen khit in akhaguh tawi apai a; huai mun Ramath Lehi asa hi.
Adang atak mahmah a, TOUPA asam a, "Nang na sikha khut zang in thupitak in na hon hunkheta hi. Tu in dangtak in ka si mai ding maw? Zeksumlouhte khut ah ka puklut dia hia?" achi hi.

Himahleh Pathian in Lehi mun a leikuak akhisak a, tui ahong kikhohkheta hi. Huai adawntak in alungsim ahong halh a, ahong hat nawnta hi. Huai mun min En-hakkore asa a; tuni tan in Lehi mun ah a-om lai hi.
Huchi in Philistiate hun in Israelte tung ah kum sawmnih vai ahawm hi.
Huan Gaza ah Samson ahoh a, huai ah numei kizuak khat ava mu a, ava kithuahpih hi.

"Samson hiai ah ahong hoh," chi in Gaza mite ahilh uhi. Huchi in ava umta ua, khopi kulh kongpi chin ah zankhua in atang uhi. Zankhua in adai sipsip ua, "Khua hong vak peuhmahleh, huchi in that na ni," akichi uhi.
Samson bel zankim tan in alum a, zankim in athou a, khopi kulh kongkhakte leh akhuam nih alen a, akalhnate toh aphawikhe vek a, aliangzang ah apua a, Hebron ma a mualvum ah apotou hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, anung in Sorek Phaizang a numei khat a-it a, amin Delailah ahi.
Philistia' miliante akiang ah ahohtou ua, akiang ah, "Amah ka zohtheihna ding un, ahatna san theih tum in kankhia in. Huchi in ka vek un dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat ka hon pe chiat ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "Na hat mahmahna san hon hilh dih ve. Bangchi in ahia hihnat dia khau khihtheih na hih ding?" achi hi.
Samson in akiang ah, "Khauhual thak, keu nai lou sagih in hon hen le uchin, ka hat kei dia, midang bang lel mah ka hi ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in Philistiate' miliante'n khauhual thak sagih, keu nai lou apia ua, ama'n huaite in ahenta hi.

Dantan sunggil ah guktan mite akoih a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n hon sual dek uh e," achi hi. Mei in ziza khaulom akattat bang phet in ama'n khauhual ahihtanta hi. Huchi in ahatna san atheikhe zou kei hi.
Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "Ngai in, na hon khem a, zuau hon hilh na hi. Bangchi a hen theih ding na hia? Hon hilhta in," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Khauzen thak, zat nai louh in hon hen le uh, huchi in ka hat kei mai ding, midang bang lel mah ka hi ding," achi hi.
Delailah in khauzen thak ala a, ahen a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n ahon sual dek uh," achi hi. Dantan sunggil ah guktan mite a-om uhi. Akhut a henna patzang suktat bang mai in ahihtanta hi.

Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "N'on khem lai a, zuau na hon hilh lai hi. Bangchi a hen theih ding na hia? hon hilh dih ve," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka samphek sagih puan in gatkhum leteh ahi mai," achi hi.
Ama'n kilhna in akilhkip giugeu a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n hon sual dek uh e,” achi hi. Huchi in ihmu lai ahong halh a, puanbu kilhdenna leh puanbu nangawn toh kikhongsak in apaikhia hi.
Akiang ah, "Na lungtang hon pe hetloupi in, bangchidan a ka hon it, chi thei na hia oi? Tu'n thumvei hilhial na hon khemta hi, na hat mahmahna san na hon hilh nai kei lailai," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, niteng a ngen ngutngut a, adotdot ziak in, si ding khop hial in alunggimta hi.

Huchi in alungsim tengteng ahilh vekta hi. Akiang ah, "Ka lu ah mulmet tem himhim zat ahi ngei nai kei hi. Ka nu sul a ka om lai a pan Pathian a dia Nazarit mi dia na om ka hi. Tu in met taleng, ka hatna amang vek ding, huchi in ka hat kei dia, midang bang lel ka hi ding," achi hi.

Alungsim tengteng ahilh vekta chih Delailah in atheih phet in, "Tu kia hong hoh un, alungsim tengteng ahon hilh vekta," chi in Philistia' miliante thukhak in asamsak hi. Huchi in akiang ah Philistia' miliante ava hohtou ua, dangka atawi uhi.
Apheipi tung ah a-ihmusak hi. Mi asam a, asamphek sagihte ametkhesak vek hi. Huchi in amah ahihgim panta a, ahatna in anuseta hi.

"Samson, Philistiate'n ahong sual dek uh e,” achi hi. Ihmu lai ahong halh a, "Nidang mah bang in ka pawtkhe nawn ding a, ka kitungkhe nawn ding," achi hi. Himahleh TOUPA'N apaisan khinta chih himhim athei kei hi.
Philistiate'n aman ua, amitte akhelkhiaksak uhi. Gaza ah apaipihsuk ua, sikkol abunsak ua; suangkul ah buh gawizantu in apang hi.
Himahleh asam met ahih nung in hong pou in ahong khang nawn hi.
Philistia' miliante Dagon pathian kiang a kithoihna thupitak lan ding leh kihih nuamsa ding in akikhawm uhi. "I pathian un i melmapa uh Samson ahon peta," achi uhi.
Mipite'n amuh un apathian uh aphat ua, "I pathian un i melmapa, i gam hihsia a mi tampite thatpa i khut uah ahon peta," achi uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, alungtang un nuam asak laitak in, Samson pen muhnop ding in va sam dih ua, achi uhi. Huchi in suangkul a pan Samson ava samkhia uhi. Ama uah muhnop ding in a-omta a; khuam leh khuam kikal ah adingsak uhi.
Samson in amah kaitu naupang kiang ah, "Hiai inn dou pen khuam hon khoihsak dih ve, ka hon ngai deh," achi hi.
Huai inn, pasal leh numei in adim miuhmeuh uhi. Philistiate milian tengteng huai ah a-om vek ua, Samson muhnop dia en mite intung ah pasal leh numei sangthum a-om uhi.
Samson in TOUPA asam a, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, hehpih in hon theigige inla, hehpih in tutung in hon hihhat in, aw Pathian, ka mit langnih phu Philistiate tung ah tu kia hon lasak in," achi hi.
Samson in, huai inn dou pen sut nihte alen a, akhut taklam in khat, akhut veilam in khat mah apansan hi.

Samson in, "Philistiate toh sikhawm ning e," achi hi. Huchi in theihtawp in akunsuk a; miliante leh mipi asung a om tengtengte huai inn chim in adelhkhumta hi. Huchi in adam lai a athahte sang in asihkhumte atamzaw uhi.

Huchi in a-unaute leh apa inkote tengteng ahong paisuk ua, ala ua azawngtou ua, Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal a; apa Manoah kivuina mun ah avuita uhi. Huchi in ama'n kum sawmnih sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Huan Ephraim tanggam ah mi khat a-om a, amin Mikah ahi.

Ama'n anu kiang ah, "Dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat nang a pan lakmang a omte, nang leng na hamsiat leh ka zak mahmah a na gen pen, ngai in, huai dangka ka kiang ah a-om, kei lak ahi,” achi hi. Anu'n, "Ka tapa TOUPA vualzawl in om hen," achi hi.

Dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat anu apekik a, anu'n, "Hiai dangka kei khut mahmah in ka tapa in milim abawlna ding leh milim asunna ding in TOUPA kiang ah ka lan hi. Huaiziak in tu in ka hon pekik ding," achi hi.
Huchi in huai dangka anu apekik a, anu'n dangka zanih ala a, dangka sekmi apia a, ama'n milim khuakthoh leh sunthohte ana bawl a, huaite Mikah inn ah a-om uhi.
Mikah in pathiante inn anei a, ephod leh milimte abawl a, atapa khat asiampu in aseptuamta hi.
Huai lai in Israel gam ah kumpipa a-om kei a; michih in ama mit a dik asakte ahih chiat mai uhi.
Judah gam Bethlehem mi Judah nam, Levi chi tangval khat, huai ah ava om hi.
Huai mi Bethlehem Judah khopi a pan apawt a, omna zong a vak ahi. Avakna lam ah Ephraim tanggam a Mikah inn ava tung hi.
Mikah in akiang ah, "Koi a pan hong pai na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Bethlehem Judah mi Levi chi ka hi a, omna mun zong a vak ka hi,” achi hi.
Mikah in akiang ah, "Ka pa leh siampu ding in ka kiang ah teng in, kum teng in, dangkasik tang sawm ka hon pe dia, puansilh khat leh nek dingte leng," achi hi. Huchi in Levi chi alutta hi.
Levi chi, huai mi kiang a ten alungkim hi. Huchi in atapa khat bang in huai tangvalpa a-omta hi.
Mikah in Levi chi aseptuamta a, huchi in tangvalpa asiampu in apangta a, Mikah inn ah atengta hi.
Huchi in Mikah in, "Tu in zaw Levi chi ka siampu ding in ka neita hi. TOUPA'N ahon lamzangsak ngei ding, chih ka thei," achi hi.
Huai lai in Israel gam ah kumpipa a-om kei. Dan chite’n gam luah ding azong uhi. Israel chite lak ah gam luah ding atang nai kei uhi.

Dan suante'n anam pumpi lak ua mi, pasalpha nga, Zorah leh Eshtaol a pan gam enkhe ding leh va entel ding in mi asawl uhi. Akiang uah, "Va kuan unla, gam va entel dih ua," achi uhi. Huchi in Ephraim tanggam a Mikah inn ava tung ua, huai ah agiak uhi.
Mikah inn kiang a a-om lai un, Levi chi tangval aw athei ua, huai lam ava zuan ua, akiang ah, "Hiai a hon pi kua ahia? Hiai mun ah bang ahia na hih? Bangchi in ahia hiai a na ten?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Mikah in huchi in ahon na bawlta a, ahon guai a, asiampu in ka om hi," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Ka hohna ding uah ka lamzang ding uh hia ding lou, chih theihtheihna ding in Pathian hon dotsak dih ve," achi uhi.
Siampu in akiang uah, "Lungmuangtak in pai un. Na hohna ding ma uah TOUPA a-om hi,” achi hi.

Huchi in mi ngate apawtkhia ua, Laish ah alut ua, huai mite Zidon mite mah bang a galmuangtak leh lungmuangtak a om hithiat a om ava mu ua; amaute zahlaksak ding thuneimi kuamah a-om kei a, Zidonte toh akigamla ua, kuamah toh leng akisai kha kei uhi.
Zorah leh Eshtaol ah a-unaute uh kiang ah ahong pai ua; a-unaute un akiang uah, "Bangchi ahia oi?" achi uhi.
Amau, "Thou dih ua, i sual ding uh. Gam ahihleh ka va mu ngei ua, ngai un, ahoih mahmah hi. Dai maimah ding na hi uhia? Huai gam va lut a, va luah ding in zekai kei dih uh.
Va hoh le uchin galmuang a om mite ahi chih na va mu ding uh; agam lah aza mahmah ngal a. Pathian in nou ahon pe khinta hi. Lei a thil om ah zaw bangmah taksap ding a-om hetlouhna mun ahi," achi uhi.
Huchi in Zorah leh Eshtaol a pan Dan namte kidouna galthuam silh in mi zaguk apawt uhi.
Ava hohtou ua, Judah gam Kiriath-jearim ah om mun abawl uh. Huaiziak in huai mun tuni tan in Mananeh Dan achi lai ua, Kiriath-jearim tang lam a om ahi.
Huai a pan Ephraim tanggam lam azuan ua, Mikah inn ava tung uhi.

Huchi in Laish gam enkhe dia mi nga pawtte'n adawng ua, a-unaute uh kiang ah, "Hiai innte ah ephod, milimte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte a-om chih na thei uhia? Huchi bangchi in ahia na hih ding uh ngaihtuah un," achi uhi,
Huai a pan apai ua, Levi chi tangval omna Mikah inn ngei ava tung ua, atungtang thu adong uhi.
Dan suan mi zaguk kidouna galthuam silhte kulh kongpi bul ah adingh uhi.
Mi nga gam enkhete ava hohtou ua, alut ua, milim bawltawm, ephod, milimte leh suntawm milimte ala ua, mi zaguk kidouna galthuam silhte lak ah kulh kongpi bul ah siampu adingh hi.
Huaite Mikah inn ah ava lut ua, bawltawm milimte, ephod, milimte leh suntawm milimte ava lak uleh, siampu in akiang uah, "Hiai a bang hih na mai ua?" achi hi.

Amau, "Dai in, na khut in na muk hum inla, ka kiang uah hong pai inla, ka pa uh leh siampu ding un hong om in. Nang a ding in inn khat kia siampu a om hia hoihzaw, Israel lak a chi khat leh nam khat siampu dia om?" achi uhi.
Siampu lungtang akipak mahmah a, huchi in ephod, milim leh bawltawm milimte ala a, mipite lak ah a-omta hi.
Huchi in apaikhia ua, anau neute uh, gante uh leh avante uh amasuan tou zel uh.
Mikah inn a pan gamla kuam apaikhiak nung un Mikah invengte akikaikhawm ua, Dan suante adelhphata uhi.
Dan suante asam uhi. Amau anunglam anga ua, Mikah kiang ah, "Bang achia ahia, mi huai zahzah na hon tonpih?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Ka bawl pathiante leh siampu na paipih ua, na pai vengveng ua, bang ka nei lai a? Bangziak a bangchi na hia, na hon chih uh?" achi hi.
Dan suante'n akiang ah, "Ka lak uah pau mawkmawk kei dih aw, huchi lou in zaw mithangpai khut na thuak kha dia, na inkote toh na hinna na tan ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Dan suante apai ua, Mikah in lah sual ngam vual hi un athei kei a, a-inn lam ah apai nawnta hi.
Mikah thilbawlte leh asiampu neih apaipih ua, Laish khua, galmuang a om hithiatte kiang atungtou ua, namsau in athat ua; mei in khua ahalta uh.
Zidon a pan agamlat mahmah ziak in va hunkhe ding mi kuamah a-om kei, akuakua toh kizatna mahmah anei kei uh. Beth-rehob kiang a om phaizang ahi a, khopi khat alam ua, huai ah atengta uhi.
Akho min Israel tapa, apu uh Dan tam in, Dan asa uhi. Himahleh atung in huai kho min Laish ahi.
Dan suante'n huai milim bawltawm adingkhesakta ua, Mosi tapa Gershon tapa Jonathan leh atapate, gam sal a pi ahih masiah uh Dan chite siampu ahita uhi.
Huchi in Mikah bawltawm milim ahihleh Shiloh a Pathian inn a a-om lai teng adingsak uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai a Israel gam a kumpipa a-om louh lai in, Levi chi a mi khat Ephraim tanggam tawp lam ah a-om a, Judah gam a Bethlehem mi mei in anei hi.
Amei in ang a kawm san a, huchi in Judah gam a Bethlehem a apa inn ah ataisan hi. Huai ah kha li tak a-om hi.
Apasal athou a, asikha leh asabiltung nih pi in kamdam in ava khem a, lungkim a pikik nawn tum in ava delhzui hi. Ama'n apa inn ah ana pilut a, apa'n ana muh in ana kipahpih hi.
Asungpa, numei pa'n akiang a om ding in ana khou a; akiang ah ni thum a-om a, ane un adawnkhawm ua, huai ah atung hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani li ni in zingkhang in athou a, amah bel pawt tum in athou hi. Numei pa'n amakpa kiang ah, "Tanghou tawmchik ne in. Na lungtang hihhalh tadih inla, huai khit chiang in na pai na ding," achi hi.
Huchi in atu ua, anih un ane un adawnkhawm uh. Numei pa'n huai mi kiang ah, "Lungkimtak in tuzan giak in, na lungtang nuamsak in," achi hi.
Huai mi bel pawt tum in athou a, himahleh asungpa'n azolzol a, agiak nawnta hi.
Ani nga zingkhangpi in pawt tum in athou hi. Numei pa'n, "Na lungtang hihhalh tadih lechin akei dia, nitak ninem hun tan bek om tadih in," achi hi. Huchi in anih un an anekhawm nawn uhi.

Huai mi bel amei leh asikha toh pawt tum a akisakleh asungpa, numei pa'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, ni leng akaita, tuzan giak nawn mai inla, ni leng tum ding ahita. Hiai ah giak in; na lungtang akipahna ding in. Huchi in zingchiang in zingkhang in na thou dia, inn lam ah na pai mai ding," achi hi.
Himahleh huai mi huai zan giah a-ut kei a, athou a, apawtta hi. Jebus kho zawn atung a, huai tuh Jerusalem khua ahi, sabiltung nih bawlsa api a; amei leng atel hi.
Jebus kho kiang atun un ni akai mahmahta hi. Sikha in apu kiang ah, "Hong pai dih, hiai Jebuste khopi ah i lut mai dia, i giak mai ding," achi hi.
Apu'n akiang ah, "Israel suan hilou namdang khua ah lut lou e. Gibeah kholam i zuan zaw ding," achi hi.
Asikha kiang ah, "Kisa aw, hiai munte akoi zaw hiam i zuan ding. Gibeah ah hiam, Ramah ah hiam i giak ding," achi hi.
Huchi in apai nawn zel ua; Benjaminte Gibeah kho kiang atun un ni atumta hi.
Gibeah a giak ding in alut ua, alut un huai khopi kholak ah atu uh; kuamah zintun ding a-om ngal kei ua.
Ngai in, nitaklam in putek khat lou kuan ahong pai hi. Huai mi bel Ephraim tanggam a mi ahi a, Gibeah a om zual ahi. Amah Benjamin chite lak a ahi.
Akiheileh kholak a mikhualpa amu hi. Putek in, "Koi a hoh ding? Koi a pan a hong pai na hia?" achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Judah gam a Bethlehem a pan Ephraim tang tawp gam lam a hoh tum ka hi uh. Huai a om ka hi, Bethlehem, Judah gam ah ka va hoh a; tu in TOUPA' inn a hoh tum ka hi. Kuamah hon zintun a-om kei hi.
Ka sabiltung ua ding buhpawl leh gan an ka nei uh. Kei leh na sikhanu leh na sikhate kiang a om tangval a ding leng tanghou leh uain a-om lai a, bangmah taksap ka nei kei uh," achi hi.
Putek in, "Lungmuangtak in om in. Na kulna tengteng ke'n ka tum vek ding. Kholak ah zaw giak mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in a-inn ah apilut a, sabiltungte an apia a; akhete uh asil ua, ne in adawn uhi.

Huchi a nuamsa leh kipaktak a a-om lai un, ngai in, huai khua a mi, Belial tapate khenkhat in huai inn ahon umta uh. Kongkhak ahong khen ua; inn neipa putek kiang ah, "Na inn a hong tungpa hon pikhia in, ka kithuahpih ding uh," achi uhi.
Inn neipa akiang uah ava pawt a, akiang uah, "Hilou e, ka unaute aw, hichi tel a gilou zaw hih mahmah kei un. Hiai mi ka mikhual ahi. Hiai thil haihuai hih kei un," achi hi.
"Ngai un, hiai ah ka tanu nungak leh amei a-om uh. Amau ka hon pikhe dia, amaute zahlaksak in na ut-ut uh atung uah hih un. Himahleh hiai mi tung ah zaw hiai thil gilou hih kei un," achi hi.

Himahleh huai mite'n athu azui nuam kei ua, huchi in hiai mi'n amei aman a, akiang uah ava pikhia hi. Amau ana kithuahpih ua, khovak masiah zankhua in apawngsual uhi. Huchi a khua ahong vaktak in, akhah uhi.
Khua ahong vaktak in numei apai a, apu tunnapa inn kongpi bul ah apuk a, khovak nung tan in a-om nilouh hi.
Apu zingsang in ahong thou a, inn kongpite ahong a, pai tum in ava pawt hi. Ngai in, ameinu kongpi bul ah akhutte insung lam nga in ana lum hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Thou in, i pai ding,” achi hi. Himahleh adawng kei. Huchi in asabiltung tung ah akoihtou a; athou a, amun lam ah apaita hi.
A-inn atun in temta ala a, amei asem a, aguhte toh seh sawm-le-nih in asemnen a, Israel gam teng ah akhak vek hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, amu peuhmahte'n, "Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh hichibang thilhih leh muh tutan in a-om ngei nai kei. 'Ngaihtuah unla, kihou unla, na lungsim uh gen un, " achi uhi.

TOUPA Angel khat Gilgal a pan Bokim ah ahohtou hi. Ama'n, "Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pawtsak a, 'na pipute uh kiang a kichiam a ka na chiamsa gam ah ka hon pilut a, noute toh ka thukhun ka bohse kei hial ding.
Hiai gam a tengte toh thu khung kei unla; amaitamte uh hihchipsak un' ka chi hi. Himahleh ka thupiak na zui kei ua, bangziak in ahia hiai na hih uh?
Huaiziak in amaute ka hon delhkhiaksak nawn kei dia, na pang uah lingte ahi zawta ding ua, apathiante uh nou a ding in thang ahi ding uh," ka chi ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA angel in Israel suan tengteng kiang a hiai thu agenleh mipite aw suah hial in akap uhi.
Huai mun min Bokim asa ua; huai ah TOUPA kiang ah kithoihnate alan uhi.
Joshua in mipite akikhenzaksak nung in Israel suante michih amau tantuam gam chiat luah ding in apaita uhi.
Joshua damsung leh upate Joshua kheng a dam teng, TOUPA'N Israelte a dia thil thupi ahih tengteng mu mite damsung in mipite'n TOUPA nna asem uhi.
Nun tapa Joshua, TOUPA sikha kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi.
Gaash tang mallam pang Ephraim tanggam a amah tantuam gamgi sung Timnath Heres ah avui uhi.
Huai khang a mi teng leng apipute uh kiang ah apaikhawmta uhi. Amaute nung in TOUPA leh Israelte a dia athilhihte thei lou suan dang ahong omta hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua, Baal nna asem uhi.
TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian, Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa alehngatsan ua, pathian dangte, akim ua tengte pathiante azui ua, abia ua, TOUPA ahehsakta uhi.
TOUPA alehngatsan ua, Baal leh Astoreth nna asem uhi.
Israelte tung ah TOUPA ahehta a, amau dou mite khut ah apia a, amelma uh, akim ua tengte kiang ah akhawng a, amelmate uh azouta kei uhi.
Koipeuh ah hoh mah le uh TOUPA khut atung uah aselam in ake zel a, TOUPA'N akiang ua kichiam a agensa bang in. Huchi in buai namai in abuaita kei uhi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N vaihawmte abawlsak a, huaite'n amau dou mite khut a pan ahunkheta hi.
Huchipi in leng avaihawmte uh thu angaikhe kei ua, pathian dangte kiang a angkawm in amaute abe zawta ua, apipute un TOUPA thupiakte pom a azuih uh lampi pen apialsan pah maimah uhi.

TOUPA'N vaihawmte abawlsak chiang in, vaihawmmi kiang ah TOUPA a-om a, vaihawmte damsung in amelmate uh khut a pan ahunkhe zel hi. Amau nuaisiah mite leh hihlungkham mite ziak a amauna un, TOUPA akisiksak hi.

Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, vaihawmmi asih khit chiang in, anungtolh ua, pathian dangte zui a, a-nna uh asep uah apipute uh sang mah in agamta sezaw sem ua; athilhihte uh leh apaupenna uh leng atawpsan tuan kei uhi.
Israelte tung ah TOUPA ahehta a, "Hiai namte'n apipute uh thu ka piak, ka thukhun abohsia ua, ka thu lah angaikhe kei ua;
huaiziak in tuban Joshua sih ma a delhkhiak louh namte ka delhkhiaksak nawn kei ding.
Apipute uh zuih bang a TOUPA dan zuih ding leh ding louh uh Israelte ze-etna ding in amau ka zang ding," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N huai namte delhkhe pah lou in a-omsakta a; Joshua khut ah leng apekhe kei hi.
Huchi in Israel suan om khawmte tengteng akisata ua, pheikhai lual in Dan a pan Beer-sheba kho pha in Gilead gam a mite toh Mizpah ah TOUPA kiang ah akikhawm uhi.
Mi tengteng heutu, Israel chite tengteng Pathian mite kikhopkhawmna ah atel ua, sepaih namsau tawimi nuaili ahi uhi.
Benjamin suante'n Israel suante Mizpah ah ahohtou uh chih aza ua, Israel suante'n, "Bangchidan a hichibang a gitlouhna hong om ahia, hon hilh un?" achi uhi.
Levi chi, athah uh numei pasal in, "Benjamin chite omna Gibeah ah ka mei toh giak ding in ka va lut uhi.
Gibeah mite'n ahong sualta ua, zan in inn ahong um ua; hon thah atum ua, ka mei apawngsual ua asita hi.
Huchi in ka mei luang ka sem a, Israelte gam luah tengteng ah ka khak a, Israel gam ah thilkihhuai leh haihuaitak ana hihta ngal ua.
Nou Israel suante aw, na vek un ngai un, na ngaihdan uleh pha na sakdan uh gen dih ua," achi hi.
Huchi in mi tengteng pheikhai lual in athou ua, “Kuamah i puanin lam ah i pai het kei ding, kuamah i inn ah i lut kei ding uh.
Gibeahte i bawldan ding hichibang ahi. Ai i san ding ua, amaute i dou ding uh.
Gibeah mun a Benjaminte i va sualna ua mipite nek ding pe ding in Israel nam tengteng lak a mi zakhat ah sawmkhat zel, sangkhat ah zakhat zel, singkhat ah sangkhat zel i telkhe ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel mi tengteng pheikhai lual in huai khopi sual ding in akikhawm uhi.
Israel namte'n Benjamin nam tengteng kiang ah mi asawl ua, "Na lak ua na hih uh bang gitlouhna ahia?
Gibeah a mi Belial tate hon pi unla, Israel gam a gitlouhna adaihtheihna ding in ka na that ding uh," chi in mi asawl uhi. Himahleh Benjamin chite'n a-unau Israel suante thugen azui nuam kei uh.
Benjamin suante bel Israel suante dou ding in khopite a pan ahong pawtkhawm ua, Gibeah ah alutta uhi.
Huai ni a Benjamin suante khopi a pan namsau tawi a pawtte, Gibeah a mi zasagih telkhiakte sim louh in singnih-le-sangguk ahi uh.
Huai tengteng lak ah veilong zasagih, telkhiak a-om ua; amaute'n vaisuangseh in samzang chia leng akhial kei uhi.
Israel mite, Benjamin mite sim louh in namsau tawimi nuaili ahi uh. Amau tengteng galdou thei vek ahi uh.
Israel suante athou ua, Bethel ah ahohtou ua, Pathian ava dong ua, Benjamin suante kua'n ahia va sual adto masa ding? achi uh.
TOUPA'N, "Judah nam va hoh masa uhen," achi hi. Huchi in Israel suante lak ah athou ua, Gibeah khua ava umta uhi.
Israel mite Benjamin pawl sual ding in akisa ua, Israel mite'n Gibeah ah amaute sual ding in panmun akhoh uhi.
Benjamin suante Gibeah a pan apawtkhia ua, huai ni in Israel suante lak a mi singnih-le-sangnih ava that uhi.
Mipite, Israel mite akihasuan nawn ua, asual tung ni ua asualna mun mah uah sual ding in panmun akhoh nawn uhi.
Israel suante ahohtou ua, Pathian ma ah nitak tan in ava kap ua, "Ka unau uh Benjamin suante ka va sual nawn ding uam?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi. TOUPA'N, "Va sual nawn un," achi hi.
Ani nih ni in Israel suante'n Benjamin suante ava naih uhi.
Benjamin suante leng huai ani nih ni in sual ding in Gibeah a pan apawt sam ua, Israel suante lak a mi singkhat-le-sanggiat ahong that nawn uh. Huaite tengteng namsau tawimi ngen ahi uh.

Huchi in Israel suan tengteng leh mi tengteng ava paitou ua, Bethel ah ahohtou ua, akap ua, TOUPA ma ah atu uhi. Huai ni in nitak tan in an angawl uh. TOUPA kiang ah halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA adong uh (huai hun lai in huai ah Pathian thukhun bawm a-om hi).

Huai lai in Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in a-nna asem zel ahi. "Ka unau uh Benjamin suante ka va sual nawn ding uam, ka tawpsanta mai ding uam?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi. TOUPA'N, "Va hoh un; zingchiang in zaw na khut uah ka hon peta ding," achi hi.
Israel suante'n Gibeah kho kim ah tangpang mi agukkoih uhi.
Israel suante Benjamin suante sual ding in ani thum ni in akisa nawn uh. Nidang mah bang in Gibeah khua sual ding in panmun akhoh nawn uhi.

Benjamin suante bel huai mite sual ding in apawt ua, khua apawtsan uhi. Huchi in nidang mah bang in mite sual in athat pan nawnta ua, loubuk ngial ah Bethel kholam lamliante ah Israel suante sawmthum athat uhi.
Benjamin suante'n, "Ama mah bang in i ma uah azahlak nawnta uh e," achi uhi. Israel suante'n bel, "I tai ding uh, khopi a pan lamlian lam ah i tolhkhesak ding," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel suan tengteng in apanmun uh apawtsan ua, Baal Tamar mun ah panmun akhoh uhi. Israel suan aguk a na tangpangte amun ua pan, Gibeah Phaizang a panmun tan in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
Israel suante tengteng lak a telkhiak mi singkhat in ava sual ua, kidouna athupi mahmah hi. Himahleh amau thil hoih lou akiang naichik uah a-om chih athei kei uh.
TOUPA'N Israelte ma ah Benjamin suante athat hi. Israel suante'n huai ni in Benjamin suante mi singnih sangnga-le-zakhat athat uhi. Huaite tengteng namsau tawimi ngen ahi uh.
Huchi in Benjamin suante'n avuallelta uh chih ahong kitheita uhi. Israel suante'n Gibeah khua sual dia aguk a tangpang mite akoih uh amuan ziak un Benjamin suante anungtolh san uhi.
Aguk a tangpang mite'n Gibeah khua asual guih uhi. Huchi in aguk a tangpangte akiphalh ua, khua a mi tengteng namsau in asualta uhi.
Israel suante leh aguk a tangpang mite'n akichiam uh bel khopi sung a mei khuttouhsak ding, chih ahi.
Huai amuh chiang ua, Israel taikekte kilehhei a, dou ding achih uh ahi.
Huchi in khopi sung a meikhu ahong kitun nguingui tak in, Benjamin suante akihei uleh, ngai in, khopi apum in van lam tan ah akhutou ngoingoi hi.
Huchi in Israel suante ahong kilehhei ua, Benjamin suante'n lamdang asa mahmah uh. Atan uh ahoih kei ding chih lah atheita ngal ua.
Huaiziak in Israel suante ma ah gamdai ah ataikekta uh. Himahleh adelhzui pek ua, khopi a pan hong pawtte'n huai ah ana that uhi.
Benjamin suante bel a-umsip ua, adelh ua, nisuahna lam Gibeah kiang a akhawlna uah aphata uhi.
Benjamin suante mi singkhat-le- sanggiat asi ua; avek un mihat hangsan chiat ahi uh.
Akihei ua, gamdai lam Rimmon suangpi ah atai uh. Mi sangnga lamliante ah atom ua; Gidom tan in adelhzui ua, mi sangnih athat uhi.
Huchi in huai ni a Benjamin suan site, namsau tawimi ngen singnih-le-sangnga ahi ua, avek un mihat hangsan ahi uhi.
Mi zagukte gamdai lam Rimmon suangpi ah ataikek ua, huai Rimmon suangpi ah kha li sung a-om uhi.
Israel suante Benjamin suante tung ah akisa nawn ua, khopi sung a om peuhmah gante, amuhmuh uh namsau in asatlum zel ua, huai lou leng khua amuh peuhmah uh ahal zel uhi.
Huan Israel suante'n Mizpah khua ah, i lak ua mi kuamah in i tanute uh Benjamin suante zi ding in i pe kei ding uh, chi in akichiam uhi.
Bethel ah mipite ahoh ua, Pathian ma ah nitak tan in atu ua, a-awte uh suah in akap vongvong uhi.
Amau bel, "Aw TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, bangchidan ahia Israelte lak a hichibang thil ahong om?" achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in zingkhang in athou ua, huai ah maitam abawl ua, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.

Israel suante'n, Israel nam tengteng lak a TOUPA kiang a paikhawm pawl lak a va tel tei lou kuate ahi ua? achi uh. Mizpah a TOUPA kiang ava hoh lou peuhmahte bel, thah ngeingei ding ahi, chi in ana kichiamta uhi.
Israel suante a-unaupa uh Benjamin suante tungthu ah akisik ua, "Tuni in Israel suante lak ah nam khat satkhiak ahita, achi uhi.
A-omsunte a ding in azi ding uh bangchi in i hihta ding ua? I tanute uh lah azi ding ua neisak lou ding in TOUPA min lou in i na kichiamta ngal ua,” achi uhi.
Amau achi ua, Mizpah a TOUPA kiang a hong paitou lou Israel namte lak ah a-om hia? Ngai in, kikhawm pawl omna mun ah Jabesh-gilead mite lak ah khat lel leng ahong hoh kei uhi.
Mite akisim uleh, ngai in, Jabesh-gilead gam a omte khat lel leng ana omta kei uhi.
Omkhawmte'n mihangsan hoih ngen singkhat-le-sangnih asawl uhi. "Kuan unla, Jabesh-gilead gam a omte numei leh atanu neute uh toh namsau in va satlum vek un.
Na hihdan ding uh hichibang ahi. Mi tengteng leh numei, pasal kithuahpih khinsa peuhmah hihmangthang vek un,” chi in thu apia uhi.
Jabesh-gilead gam a omte lak ah nungak zali, pasal kithuahpih ngei het louh amu uhi. Huchi in a-omna uh Shiloh ah api ua, huai tuh Kanaan gam a om ahi.
Omkhawm tengteng in mi asawl ua, Rimmon suangpi a om Benjamin suante ava houpih ua, kilemna bawl ding in asam uhi.
Huaitak in Benjamin pawl ahong nawn ua; Jabesh-gilead gam a numei ahawite uh azi ding un apia uhi. Huchi in leng akiching kei lai uhi.
Israel nam lak a TOUPA'N kihih- tuamna ana bawl ziak in mite, Benjamin suante tungthu ah akisik uhi.
Huchi in omkhawmte upate'n, "Adamlaite zi ding bang i chih ding ua? Benjamin suante lak a numeite lah hihmang ahita ngal ua?" achi uhi.
"Amau Israel nam hihmanlouhna ding in Benjamin suan omsunte bangchi in suan i neisak ding ua?
I tanute uh lah azi un i neisak thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi. Israel suante'n, "Kuapeuh Benjamin suante zi dia neisak peuhmah hamsiat in om uhen," chi in akichiam uhi.
Amau, "Ngai un, Bethel mallam, Bethel a pan Shekem zotna lamlian suahlam pang a Lebonah simlam a om Shiloh ah kum sim in TOUPA a ding in ankuangluina a-om,” achi uhi.
Amau Benjamin suante kiang ah, "Va hoh unla, grep mun ah va guktan un;
Na en unla, ngai un, Shiloh a nungakte lamna a lam dia ahong pawt uleh, grep mun a pan hong pawt unla, Shiloh nungakte na zi ding un man chiat unla, Benjaminte gam ah paipih un.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, apate uh hiam, asanggampate uh hiam kalh dia i kiang ua ahong uleh, akiang uah, hon hehpih un. Kidouna sung in lah zi ka guan thei kei uh. Nou lah na tanute uh na piak thoh un hilou a, kichiamna a moh tang lou ding na hi uh," ka chi ding uh, achi uhi.
Benjamin suante'n huchibang in ahih uhi. Lampawlte lak a mi amau zah chiat zi ding in aman ua, apaimangpihta uhi. Huchi in agam uah apai ua, khopite apuah nawn ua, huai ah atengta uhi.
Huaitak in huai a pan Israel suante bel amau chichi leh amau namnam in akihuituam nawn ua, huai nungsiah amau gam chiat ah apai nawn uhi.
Huai lai in Israelte lak ah kumpipa a-om kei a; michih in ama mitmuh a dik asak bang in ahih chiat uhi.
Kanaan gam a galdou kha nai het lou Israelte etchetna ding in TOUPA'N hiai namte anusia hi.
Atup bel Israel suante, tuma a galdoudan thei nai hetloute galdoudan sinsak ahihna ding lel ahi.
Huaite bel: Philistiate kumpipa ngate, Kanaan mi tengte, Sidonte leh Lebanon tang a teng Hivte ahi ua, Baal-hermon tang a pan Hamath lutna pha in ahi uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi zang a apipute uh thu ana piakte azuih ding uh leh zuih louh ding uh theihna ding in, huaite Israelte chetna ding ahi uh.
Israel suante Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste lak ah ateng uhi.
Atanute uh zi in anei ua, atanute uh atapate uh zi in apia ua, apathiante uh nna asem uhi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh amangngilh ua, Baal leh Astoreth nna asem uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA Israelte tung ah ahehta a, Mesopo Mesopotamia gam kumpipa Kushan-risathaim kiang ah azuakta hi. Huchi in Israel suante'n Kushan-risathaim nna kum giat asem uhi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Israel suante hunkhepa abawlsak a, huai mi in amau ahunkheta hi. Huai mi bel Kaleb naupa Kenaz tapa Othniel ahi.
TOUPA kha atung ah ahong tung a, Israel tung ah vai ahawm hi. Ama'n Mesopotamia gam kumpipa Kushan-risathaim ava dou a, TOUPA'N Kushan-risathaim a khut ah apia a, azouta hi.
Huchi in kum sawmli gam galmuang in a-omta a, huchi in Kenaz tapa Othniel asita hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn uh. TOUPA mitmuh a thil ahihkhelh ziak un TOUPA'N Israelte tung ah Moab kumpipa Eglon ahatsak hi.
Ama'n Ammon leh Amalek suante akaikhawm a; Israelte ava dou a, tum sing khopi aluahta hi.
Huchi in Moab kumpipa Eglon thunuai ah Israelte kum sawm-le-giat a-om uhi.
Himahleh Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Gera tapa Ehud, Benjamin mi, miveilong, hunkhepa abawlsak hi. Israel suante'n Moab kumpipa piak ding kipahman Ehud atawisak uhi.
Ehud in namsau hiamtuah tongtan a sau in asek a; puan nuai ah ataklam pheipi ah ahenbelh hi.
Moab kumpipa Eglon kipahman ava pia a; Eglon bel mithautak ahi.
Kipahman ava piak khit in, kipahman tawite apaisak nawn hi.

Amah bel Gilgal kho kiang a suangsekna mun a pan anungkik nawn a, "I aw, kumpipa, hon hilh ding thuguk ka nei hi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Dai un," achi hi. Huchi in akiang a dingh teng in apawtkhiaksan vek uhi.
Ehud in akiang ava naih a; amah bel anipi dantan ah amah kia in ana tu hi. Ehud in, "Pathian in na kiang a gen ding thu ahon thukhak hi," achi hi. Atutphah a kipan amah hong dingh hi.
Ehud in akhut veilam in apheipi taklam a namsau adokkhia a, agil ah adawt hi.
Anamsau bul tan in atum a, athau in namsau ahubit a, agilpi a pan namsau adokkhe kei a, a-ek atolhkhia hi.
Huchi in Ehud inlim ah apawt a, dantan kongkhakte akhakkhum a, akalh bikbek hi.
Apawt khit nung in, asikhate ahong pai ua, ava ettak un ngai in, dantan kongkhakte ana kikalh hi. "Anipi dantan ah atuam om tadih a hi in teh," achi uhi.
Zumhuai tan khop in angak nilouh ua, ngai in, dantan kongkhakte ahong himhim kei a; huchi in chabi ala ua, ahong ua; ngai in, akumpipa uh pialkhang ah sisa in ana puk hi.
Ehud lah huchi a angak nilouh sung un ana taimang khin a, huai suangsekna mun akheng a, Seirah ah atailut hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai mun atun in Ephraim tanggam ah pengkul amut a, Israel suante tanggam a pan akiang ah apaisuk ua, ama'n ama uh akaita hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zui dih ua. TOUPA'N na melma uh Moabte hon pe khinta ahi,” achi hi. Huchi in azuisuk ua, Moab gam chin Jordan lui kannate ala ua; kuamah agalkah uh aphal kei hi.
Huai hun in Moabte mihat ngen taleh mihat hangsan hoih ngenta singkhat athat ua; khat lel leng taikhia a-om kei uh.
Huchi in huai ni in Israelte lak ah Moabte azahlak uhi. Huchi in gam kum sawmgiat sung galmuang in a-om hi.
Anung in Anath tapa Shamgar ahong kilang a, huai mi'n bawng sutna chiang in Philistiate zaguk asunlum a; Israelte ahunkhia hi.
Ehud sih nung in Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn uh.
Huchi in Hazor a vaihawmpa, huai Kanaan gam kumpipa Jabin kiang ah TOUPA'N akhawngta hi. Huai mi sepaih heutupen bel Sisera ahi a, Zentelte gam Haroseth ah ateng hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA asam uh. Huai mi in kangtalai zakua tak anei a, kum sawmnih sung Israel suante nakpitak in anuaisiah hi.
Huai lai in Lapidoth zi, zawlnei Deborah in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Ephraim tanggam a Ramah leh Bethel kho kikal a tum sing nuai ah Deborah ateng hi. Israel suante akiang ah avai uh hawmsak ding in ahong hoh zel uhi.
Kedesh Naphtali gam a pan Abinoam tapa Barak athukhak a, akiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in, Tabor Tang kiang ah hohtou inla, Naphtali suante leh Zebulun suante mi singkhat pi in.
Huchi in Kishon lui ah Jabin sepaih heutu Sisera, akangtalaite leh amipite toh ka hon sawl ding; amah nang ka hon pe ding, chi in thu ahon pia ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Barak in akiang ah, "Hon tonpih lechin ka hoh ding. N'on tonpih kei dingleh ka hoh kei ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "K'on tonpih tham ding. Himahleh na hohna a minhoih loh lou ding na hi. TOUPA'N Sisera numei kiang ah akhawng ding hi," achi hi. Huchi in Deborah athou a, Barak toh Kedesh ah ahohta uhi.
Barak in Zebulunte leh Naphtalite Kedesh ah athukhakkhawm a; mi singkhat amah toh ahohtou ua; Deborah leng akiang uah ahohtou sam hi.
Ken mi Heber bel Mosi puzon Hobab suante lak a pan ana om tuam a, Kadesh kiang a Zaanaim gam a tosaw sing mun ah apuanin ava kai hi.
Abinoam tapa Barak bel Tabor tang ah ahohtou chih Sisera ahilh uhi.
Huchi in Sisera in akangtalai tengteng, sik kangtalai zakua leh aheute Zentelte gam Haroseth a pan, Kishon lui ah akaikhawm hi.
Huchi in Deborah in Barak kiang ah, "Khai le, tuni TOUPA'N Sisera hon piak ni ahi. Na makaipa TOUPA ahi kei a hia?" achi hi. Huchi in Barak Tabor tang a pan apaisuk a, mi singkhat in azuisuk uhi.
TOUPA'N Sisera leh akangtalai tengteng leh asepaih tengteng namsau in Barak ma ah ahihbuai gawpta a; akangtalai a pan Sisera akumkhia a, akhe in ataimang hi.
Barak in bel kangtalaite leh sepaihte Zentel gam Haroseth pha in adelh hi. Huchi in Sisera sepaih tengteng namsau in athat vek a; khat lel leng ahinghawi kei uhi.
Sisera bel Ken mi Heber zi Jael puanin ah khe in atailut hi. Hozor Kumpipa Jabin leh Ken mi Heber inkuante kikal ah lemna a-om hi.
Jael bel Sisera dawn ding in ahong pawt a, akiang ah, "Pu, hong lut in, ka kiang ah hong lut in; lau ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in puanin sung ah akiang ah alutta a, ama'n puan in akhuh hi.
Akiang ah, "Hehpih in tui tawmchik hon pe dih ve, ka dang atak mahmah hi," achi hi. Ama'n bawngnawi thawl ahong a, adawnsak a, akhuhkhum nawn hi.
Akiang ah, "Puanin kongpi ah ding inla, huchi in 'Hiai ah mi a-om hia?' chi a hon dot uleh, 'om lou' na chi zel in," achi hi.

Heber zi Jael in puanin khetkilhna ala a, sek atawi a, awlchik in akhe asuanphei a, khetkilhna in ahaizek ah akhen paisuak a, lei toh akilhbelh hi. Bah in a-ihmut alim mahmah ngal a; huchi in asita hi.

Ngai in, Barak in Sisera ahon delh a, amah tuak ding in Jael ava pawt a, akiang ah, "Hong pai in, na mi zon ka hon ensak ding," achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah ava hoh a; ngai in, Sisera ana sita mai a, ahaizek ah puanin khetkilhna ana tal hi.
Huchi in Pathian in huai ni in Israel suante ma ah Kanaan gam kumpipa Jabin anuaisiah hi.
Kanaan kumpipa Jabin anuaisiah masiah uh, Kanaan kumpipa Jabin tung ah Israel suante ahat semsem uhi.
Huai ni in Deborah leh Abinoam tapa Barak in hiai la asa uhi:
"Israel a makaite'n ma akaih lai un, amau ut thu a mite'n azuih lai un, TOUPA phat un!
Aw, nou kumpipate aw, ngaikhia un. Aw, nou heutute aw, bil na doh un. Kei mahmah in TOUPA pahtawi in la ka sa dia, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
TOUPA, Seir gam a pan na hong paikhiak a, Edom loubuk a na hong pawt in, lei aling a, van ahong kia a, meipi'n vuah azusak uhi.
TOUPA ma ah tangte achim ua, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ma ah Sinai Tang mah leng.
Anath tapa Samgar dam lai nite leh Jael dam lai nite in lamliante tot louh in a-om ua, zin-le-lengte lah lam neute ah apai uhi.
Israel gamte atul khin a, akhuate luah louh in atul khin hi, kei Deborah ka gamtang a, Israel gam nu ka gamtat masiah.
Amau pathian thakte atel ua; huchi in kulh kongkhak bul ah kidouna a-om a; Israel gam a mi singli lak ah lum leh tei muh in a-om hia?
Ka lungsim Israelte vaihawmpa, mipite lak a lungluttak a kipiate lam ah a-om hi. TOUPA phat un.
Pau un, nou sabiltung kang tung a tuangte, nou vaihawmna a tute leh lampi a paite.
Thalkap mite husa zak phak louh, tui tawina mun ah TOUPA thil dik hihte agengen ua, Israel gam tung a thil dik ahihte ngei. Huchi in TOUPA mipite kulh kongkhakte lam ah apaisuk ding uhi.
Thou in, thou in, Deborah; thou in, thou in, la sa in. Thou in, Barak, thou inla, Abinoam tapa, na salmatte pi in.
Huchi in mi omlaite mipite lak a miliante tung ah thu aneisak a, TOUPA'N mihat tung ah thu hon neisak hi.
Ephraim a pan zungzam khat Amalek dou a-om a, Benjamin, na mite lak a mite'n nang hon zui uh, Makir a pan gam vaihawmte ahong paisuk ua, Zebulun a pan laigelhmi chiangkhun tawi mite ahong paisuk uhi.
Deborah kiang ah Issakar miliante a-om ua; Issakar leh Barak mah leng. Amah phaizang lam a sawlsuk ahi a, Reuben pawlte ahihleh nakpitak in akingaihtuah lai uhi.
Bangziak a belam huang lak a tu nilouh, belamhon ham ngai ding lel in maw? Reuben pawlte a ding in lungtang a kingaihtuahna thupitak a-om hi.
Gileadte Jordan gal ah a-om nilouh ua; bangziak a Dante longte a om nilouh uh ahia? Asherte tuipi piau ah atu kinken ua, atuipiaute ah a-om nilouh uhi.
Zebulun leh Naphtali leng mun sang pawn a sih ngap gigete ahi uh.
Kumpipate'n ahong dou ua, Kanaan kumpipate'n Meggiddo tui kiang, Taanak ah adou ua; sum himhim ala kei uhi.
Van a pan ahon dou ua; aksite'n amun ua kipan Sisera ahon dou uh.
Kishon lui in amaute ataimang a, nidanglai lui, Kishon lui in, Aw ka kha, hattak in pai zel in.
Huchi in sakolte akipek thotthot ua, sakol hatte atawmtawm ziak un.
Meroz hamsiat un," TOUPA angel in achi, huai a tengte nakpitak in hamsiat un. TOUPA panpih ding, TOUPA'N mihattak adouna panpih dia ahong louh ziak un.
Numei lak ah Jael, Ken mi Heber zi nuamsapen ahi, numei puanin a tengte lak ah amah minuamsapen ahi.
Tui ahong ngen a, ama'n nawitui apia hi: miliante' nou in nawituidat ana pia hi.
Kilhna atawi a, ataklam in nasemmi sek; sek in Sisera akhen a, alu ah akhen pailet a, ahi, ahaizek ah akhen a, akhental vengvong hi.
Akhebul ah akun a, apuk a, alum a; akhebul ah akun a, apukta a; apukna mun ah asita hi.
Sisera nu bel tawlet ah adak a, vathangkalh awng ah asam a, "Bang achia kangtalai hong tunghak ahia? Bang achia akangtalai khe zekai ahia?" achi hi.
Anumei pilte'n ana dawng ua, ahi, amah dawng ding in ahong nawn ua:

Amuzouta kei ua hia? Gallak kihawmta lou uhia? Michih in nungak khat hiam nih chiat; Sisera tan ding gallak puan ze tuamtuam, gallak puan ze kilawm, ze tuamtuam, gallak ngawng a velh ding puan, alangnih a ze kilawm, ze tuamtuam, chi in.
"Huchibang in aw, TOUPA, na melmate tengteng mangthang vek uhen. Amah itte bel hattak a pai, nisa bang hi uhen,” achi uhi. Huchi in kum sawmli sung gam galmuang in a-om hi.
Huan Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih uh. Huchi in TOUPA'N Midiante khut ah kum sagih sung apekhia hi.
Midiante'n Israelte azouta ua; huchi in Midiante ziak in tang ah kokhukte, kohawm leh kulhte abawl uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte'n haichi achin khit un Midiante, Amalekte leh suahlam mite ahong kuan ua; ava dou ua,
panmun ava khoh ua, Gaza tan in lei a thilpoute ahihsiatsak ua, Israel gam ah nek ding himhim ahawi kei ua, belam, bawng leh sabiltung tan in ahihse vek uhi.
Aganhonte uh leh apuaninte uh toh ahong kuan ua, khaupe bang in tampi ahong kuan ua; amaute leh asangawngsaute uh sim seng ahi kei, gam hihse dia hong kuan ahi uhi.
Huchi in Midiante ziak in Israelte akeniam mahmahta ua; huchi in Israel suante'n TOUPA asamta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Midiante ziak a Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah zawlnei khat asawl a; ama'n akiang uah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in, hichi in achi:
'Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pitou a, saltanna inn a pan ka hon pikhia hi.
Aiguptate khut a pan leh nou hon nuaisiah mi teng khut a pan ka hon hunkhia a, na ma uah amaute ka delhkhia a, agam uh nou ka hon pia hi.
Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, agam ua na tenna uh Amorte pathiante na lau ding uh ahi kei, ka chi hỉ'. Himahleh ka thugen na zui kei uh," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA angel ahong pai a, Ophrah a Abiezer mi Joash tosaw sing nuai ah atu hi. Atapa Gideon in Midiante muh louh ding in grep sukna khuk ah buh ana vua hi.
TOUPA angel akiang ah ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Nang mihat hangsan, na kiang ah TOUPA a-om hi,” achi hi.

Gideon in akiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, ka kiang ua TOUPA om ahihleh bangchidan a hichibang a ka tung ua hiai thilte hong tung ahia? Ka pipute un, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan hon pitou hilou hia? chi a, athilhih lamdang ahon hilhte uh koilam a bangchi khinta ahia? Tu'n zaw, TOUPA'N hon pampaih ahita a, Midiante khut a hon peta ei ve," achi hi.
TOUPA'N, amah a-en a, akiang ah, "Hiai na hatna in kuan in, Midiante a pan Israelte hunkhia in. K'on sawl ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, “Aw TOUPA, bangchi in ahia Israelte ka va hutkhiak mahmah ding? Ngai in, Manasseh suan lak a inkuan hatloupen ka hi ua, kei lah ka pa inkote lak a neupen ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
TOUPA'N, akiang ah, "Na kiang ah ka om ngeingei ding hi, huchi in Midiante mi khat lel bang in na zou vek ding," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, nang mahmah in na hon pi chih chiamtehna banghiam hon musak in.
Na ma a lat ding thilpiak ka va lak a, na kiang a ka hong nawn masiah hiai a pan hehpih in ana paimang ke'n," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na hong nawn masiah ka na om gige ding," achi hi.
Insung ah Gideon alut a, kelnou leh tangbuang ephah khat silngou soh louh abawl a; seng ah asa akoih a, huai gel tuibel ah akoih a, tosaw sing nuai ah akiang a hon tawi in ahong lan hi.
Pathian angel in akiang ah, "Sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh la inla, hiai suang tung ah koih inla, atui pen sungkhia in,” achi hi. Huchibang in ama'n ahihta hi.

Huchi in TOUPA angel in achiangkhun tawi muk in sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh akhoih a; suang a pan mei ahong pawt a, sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh akangtum vek hi. Huan amuhlouhna ah TOUPA angel in apaimangsanta hi.
Huchi in Gideon in, TOUPA angel ahi chih atheita hi. Gideon in, "Maizen, Aw Toupa PATHIAN, TOUPA angel kimaituah a mu ka kei maw," achi hi. "
TOUPA'N akiang ah, Lungmuangtak in om inla, lau ke'n. Na si kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Gideon in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a, Jehovah Shalom asa hi. Tuni tan in Abiezerte gam Ophrah ah a-om lai hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan mah in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na pa bawngtaltuai, bawngtal nihna kum sagih a upa la inla, na pa neih Baal maitam hihchim inla, abul a sing a bawl Asherah phuk in.
Hiai suangpi tung ah zeneitak in TOUPA na Pathian a ding in maitam bawl inla, bawngtal nihna la inla, na phuk ding Asherah sing zang in halmang thillat lan in," achi hi.

Huchi in Gideon in asikhate lak a mi sawm api a, TOUPA'N akiang a agen bang in ahihta hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, apa inkote leh khopi a mite alauh ziak in, sun lai in ahih ngam kei a, zan lai in ahihta hi.
Khopi a mite zingkhang a athoh uleh, ngai in, Baal maitam hihchip in ana om a, abul a Ashera phukpaih in ana om a, maitam tung ah bawngtal nihna lat in ana om hi.
"Hiai kua hih ahia?" chi in akihou ua, akidongtuah ua, azon khit un, "Joash tapa Gideon in hiai thil ahih ana hi,” achi uhi.
Huchi in khopi a mite'n Joash kiang ah, "Na tapa va pikhia in, asih ngeingei ding ahi. Baal maitam ahihchip ziak leh abul a Asherah aphuk ziak in,” achi uhi.

"Joash in amah hong kalh teng kiang ah, Baal gum ding na hi uh maw? Ama'n hon hondam ding hia? Kuapeuh amah gum zingsang mahmah a thah ding ahi. Pathian khat ahihleh amaitam ahihchip ziak in kigum leh akei dia," achi hi.
Huaiziak in huai ni in amah Jerubbaal asa uhi, amaitam hihchip ahih ziak in, "Baal in amah kalh heh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Midiante tengteng leh Amalekte leh suahlam mite akikhawm ua; lui akan ua, Jezreel Phaizang ah akikulh uhi.
Himahleh, TOUPA Kha Gideon tung ah ahong tung a; pengkul amut a; huchi in Abiezerte'n amah agum uhi.
Manasseh tengteng kiang ah mi ataisak a; huaite'n leng anaihkhawm uhi. Asherte, Zebulunte leh Naphtali teng kiang ah leng mite ataisak a; amau leng abehlaptouta uhi.
Gideon in Pathian kiang ah, "Na gen bang a ka khut a Israelte na hutkhiak dingleh,
ngai in, buhphual ah belam mul ka koih dia, belam mul tung kia a daitui ana om a, leitual ana hul vekleh, na gen bang in ka khut in Israelte na hunkhe ding, chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
Huchibang ahong hi a, azing zingsangpi a thou a, belam mul asukleh belkuang dim tui atakkhia hi.

Gideon in Pathian kiang ah, "Ka tung ah heh ke'n, khatvei kia ka hon gen nawn ding. Hehpih in, khatvei kia belam mul in hon ze-etsak nawn in. Tutung in ahihleh belam mul kia hul henla, leitual ah daitui om nawn leuleu hen," achi hi.
Huchibang in Pathian in huai zan in ahih a; belam mul kia ana hul a, leitual ah daitui ana om leuleu hi.
Huchi in Jerubbaal, huai tuh Gideon ahi a, huan akiang a om mi tengteng zingkhang in athou ua, Harod tuikhuk chin ah akikulh uh. Midiante bel mallam pang Moreh mual bul phaizang ah akikulh uhi.
TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Na kiang a om mite, Midiante akhut ua ka piakna ding in atam lua uh. Huchi lou in zaw Israelte'n, 'Ei khut ngei a kihunkhia i hi uh,' chi in ahon otkhum kha ding uhi.

Huaiziak in ngai in, mite zak in, 'Kuapeuh lau leh ling a-omleh kik nawn henla,' Gilead tang a pan paikik nawn hen, chi in genkhia in," achi hi. Huchi in mite singnih-le-sangnih akik nawn ua; singkhat a-om lai uhi.

TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Mite atam lo lai uh. Lui ah pisuk inla, huai ah ke'n ka hon khensak ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai mi zaw na kiang ah pai heh, ka chih peuhmah na kiang ah pai hen. Hiai mi zaw na kiang ah pai kei heh, ka chih peuhmah pai kei hen," achi hi.
Huchi in lui ah mite apisuk a, TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Ui bang a, alei a tui liahthoh peuhmah atuam in koih inla, huchi mah bang in kun a khukdin a tui hipthoh peuhmah leng," achi hi.
Akhutpek a liahthohte mi zathum ahi ua, midang tengteng kun a khukdin a tui hip vek ahi uh.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Mi zathum, aliah a liahthohte zang in ka hon hunkhe ding. Midiante na khut ah ka hon pe ding hi. Mipi teng amau mun chiat ah pai nawn uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in mite'n nek ding leh apengkulte uh atawi ua; Israel mi tengteng apuanin lam uah apaisak vek a, mi zathumte ahihleh a-omsak a, Midiante kulh bel anuai phaizang a om ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Thou inla, kulh ah va hohsuk dih ve; na khut ah ka hon peta.
Himahleh hohsuk na lauhleh na sikha Purah toh kulh ah va hohsuk phot un.
Huchi in athugen uh na za dia; huai khit chiang in na khut hihhat in a-om dia, kulh ah na hoh ngamta ding,” achi hi. Huchi in asikha Purah toh kulh a galvengte tuah masakna pen omna ah ahohsuk uhi.
Midiante, Amalekte leh suahlam tapate tengteng huai phaizang ah khaupehon bang in tampi ana om ua; asangawngsaute uh sim seng vual louh, atamlam uh lah tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah ahi uhi.

Gideon atunsuk in, ngai in, mi khat in alawmpa amang ana hilh a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, mang ka nei a, Midiante kulh ah barli buh tanghou phel ana om a, puanin ah ana tuklut a, ahon hihchim a, ahih lumlet a, puanin akiphah maimah," achi hi.
Alawmpa'n adawng a, "Huai ahihleh Israel mi, Joash tapa Gideon namsau lou bangdang hi kei e. Pathian in Midiante leh sepaih tengteng akhut a pia ahita ve," achi hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gideon in huai mang leh alehkhiakna akihilhchian uh azak in Pathian abeta hi. Huchi in Israelte kulh lam ah akik nawn a, "Thou dih uh; TOUPA'N Midian sepaihte na khut uah ahon peta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in mi zathumte pawl thum in akhen a, avek un pengkul leh leibel vuak, asung a meisel koihsa ape chiat hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon en unla, ka hih bang in hih sam un. Ngai un, kulh tuah masakpen ka tun chiang a ka hih bang a na hih sam ding uh ahi.
Kei leh ka kiang a om tengteng in pengkul ka hon mut chiang un, kulh kimvel a om tengteng in pengkul na mut sam ding uhi, "TOUPA a ding leh Gideon a ding in' na chi chiat ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Gideon leh akiang a om mi zakhatte zanven laizang, galven akikhen kuan laitak in kulh tuah masak atungsuk ua, pengkul amut ua, aleibel tawi uh atatkham uhi.
Pawl thumte'n pengkul amut ua, leibelte atatkham ua, akhut veilam un meisel atawi ua, ataklam un pengkul mut ding atawi uhi. "TOUPA leh Gideon namsau," chi in akikou uhi.
Kulh kim ah michih amau panmun chiat ah adingh vek ua; huchi in sepaih tengteng atai ua; akikou ua, ataizak uhi.
Mi zathumte'n pengkulte amut ua, TOUPA'N sepaih tengteng amau leh amau namsau in akisualsak a, huchi in sepaihte Zererah a Beth-shittah, Tabbath kiang a Abel-meholah gamgi pha in ataizak uhi.
Israelte Naphtali, Asher leh Manasseh tengteng a pan kigawmkhawm in Midiante anung-delhta uhi.

Gideon in Ephraim tanggam tengteng ah, Midiante hong sual un, Beth-barah tan in luite na lakkhalh un, Jordan lui toh, chi in mite avialtaisak a, huchi in Ephraim tengteng akikhawm ua, Beth-barah tan in luite Jordan lui toh ana lakkhalh vek uhi.

Midian kumpipa Oreb leh Zeeb aman ua; Oreb suangpi ah athat ua, Zeeb pen Zeeb grep sukna khuk ah athat uhi. Midiante adelhta ua, huchi in Oreb leh Zeeb lutang Jordan lui gal a Gideon kiang ah ahon tun uhi.
Huan Ephraimte'n akiang ah, a hon "Bangziak a hichibang bawl e, Midiante na douna ua na hon chial sam louh?" achi uhi. Huchi in nakpitak in amah atai uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou toh genkak ding ke'n bang ka hihzou a eita? Abiezerte grep loh sang a Ephraimte grep loh hoihzaw hilou maw?
Pathian in Midiante kumpipa Oreb leh Zeeb na khut uah ahon peta hi. Huchi in nou toh genkak ding in ke'n bang ka hihzou a eita?" achi hi. Huchi in huai thu agentak in atung a ahehna uh adaita hi.
Gideon leh akiang a om mi zathumte'n Jordan lui aphasuk ua, akan ua, bah mah le uh adelh teitei uhi.
Sukoth a mite kiang ah, "Hehpih in kei hon zuite sangpek pe dih ua; abah mahmahta uh. Midiante kumpipa Zebah leh Zalmunna delh ka hi,” achi hi.
Sukoth a miliante'n, “Zebah leh Zalmunna na khut a om khinta uhia, huchi a na sepaihte tanghou ka piak pah mai ding uh?" achi uh.
Gideon in hiai ziak in, "TOUPA'N Zebah leh Zalmunna ka khut a ahon piak chiang in gamdai a ling leh louling neite in na sa uh ka kuikek ding," achi hi.
Huai a pan Penuel ah ahohtou ua, akiang uah huchi mah bang in agen nawn hi. Penuel a mite'n Sukoth a mite dawn mah bang in adawng uhi.
Penuel khomite kiang ah, "Vualzou a ka hong kik nawn chiang in, hiai kulh ka hihchim ding," achi hi.
Zebah leh Zalmunna bel Karkor ah a-om ua, asepaihte leh suahlam mite sepaih asibang teng, singkhat-le-sangnga toh; namsau dok mi nuaikhat-le-singnih lah asi khinta ngal ua.
Gideon bel Nob leh Jogbeh suahlam a puanin a tengte lampi ah ahohtou a, sepaihte ava dou a; sepaihte galmuangtak in ana om ngal uhi.
Zebah leh Zalmunna ataikekta ua; amau adelh ua; huchi in Midiante kumpipa nih Zebah leh Zalmunna aman ua, sepaihte tengteng apatausakgawp uhi.
Joash tapa Gideon bel kidouna a pan nisuah ma in ahong kik nawnta hi.
Sukoth ah tangval khat aman ua, thu adong ua; huchi in Sukoth a miliante leh upate min agelhsak vek a, sawmsagih-le-sagih ahi uh.
Sukoth a mite kiang ah ahohtou a, "Zebah leh Zalmunna en dih ve ua, hiaite akei ua, Zebah leh Zalmunna na khut ua omsa bang a, mibahte tanghou ka piak ding uh, chi a na hon enghou uh?" achi hi.
Huchi in huai khua upate aman a, gamdai ling leh louling neite in Sukoth mite athuhilh hi.
Penuel khokulh ahihchim a, khua a mite leng athat hi.
Huchi in Zebah leh Zalmunna kiang ah, "Tabor tang a na mithahte uh mi bangchibang ahi ua? achi hi. Amau, Nangmah bang ahi uh; Kumpipa tapate abang chiat uh,” achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Ka unaute ahi uh, ka nu tapate mahmah ahi ve ua. TOUPA ahin bang in, amaute na hinghawi le uchin zaw, nou hon that lou mah ding hi veng in," achi hi.
Atapa upapen Jether kiang ah, "Khai le, nang amaute that in," achi hi. Himahleh tangval in anamsau aphawi kei; tangval lel ahih lai ziak in alau hi.

Huchi in Zebah leh Zalmunna in, "Nangmah hong kisa in, hong satlum tanla. Piching leh piching kisual ding ahi," achi uhi. Huchi in Gideon athou a, Zebah leh Zalmunna that in, sangawngsaute ngawng zepnate ala hi.
Huchi in Israel mite'n Gideon kiang ah, "Nang ka tung uah vaihawm in, nang leh na tapa leh na tapa tapate tan in leng; nang Midiante a pan lah na hon hunkheta ngal a," achi uhi.
Gideon in akiang uah, "Ke'n zaw na tung uah vai ka hawm kei ding. Ka tapa in leng na tung uah vai ahawm sam kei ding. TOUPA'N na tung uah vai ahawm zaw ding," achi hi.
Gideon in akiang uah, "Thil khat ahihleh hon nget ka ut, michih in na gallak bilbah uh hon pe chiat un," achi hi. (Ishmaelte ahih ziak un dangka-eng bilbah anei uhi).
Amau, "Phaltak in ka hon pe ding uh," achi uhi. Huchi in puan aphah ua, michih in agallak bilbah uh apaikhe chiat uhi.
Huai dangka-eng bilbah angette gikdan dangka-eng shekel sangkhat-le-zasagih ahi; hakkolte, bilbahte, Midian kumpipate puan sandup sim louh in, asangawngsaute uh khainiang omte leng tel lou in.
Gideon in huaite in Ephod abawl a, a-omna Ophrah ah akoih hi. Israel tengteng in hiai thil ah ang a kawm uh. Huchi in Gideon leh a-inkote a ding in thang ahong hita hi.
Huchi in Midiante bel Israel suante nuaisiah in a-om ua; atangkhe zou nawn kei uhi. Huchi in Gideon damsung kum sawmli sung in gam galmuang in a-omta hi.
Joash tapa Jerubbaal apai a, a-inn ah atengta hi.
Gideon in zi tampi aneih ziak in ama suan mahmah tapa sawmsagih anei hi.
Shekem a amei in tapa asuansak lai a, amin Abimelek asa hi.
Joash tapa Gideon kha leh khuk tuah a dam in asita a, Abiezer mi Ophrah a apa Joash han ah avui uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gideon asih phet in Israel suante akinunghei ua, Baalte toh ang a kawm ua, pathian in Baal-berith aneita uhi.
Israel suante'n akim ua melmate tengteng lak a pan amau hunkhepa TOUPA a Pathian uh atheigige kei uhi.
