Heshbon lim ah taikekpawl bahgawp in akhawl ding ua, Heshbon a kipan in mei apawt a, Sihon lak a kipan in meikuang, chiak vengvung mite sip a sam toh Moab baksam akang khin hi.
Na tung agik hi, aw Moab! Khemosh mite amangta ua; na tapate sal a pi in, na tanute sal in atangta uhi.
Himahleh ni nanung chiang in Moab omdan ka hei ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Hichi tan Moab tungthu ahi.
Ammon mite thu, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel in tate anei kei a hia? Gouluahmi nei lou hia? Bang achia ahia akumpipa'n Gad atantak a, khopite a amite aten uh?

Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tùng hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ammon tate Rabbah ah kidou husa ging ka kizasak ding, thil sia omkhawm lel ahong hi ding hi, atanute mei in akang ding a, huchi in Israel in amah neimi anei thuk ding, TOUPA'N achi.
Aw Heshbon, mau tuaituai inla, Ai alok khinta ua; Rabbah tate aw, kap un, kap unla, umna sungte ah vialtai un. Kumpipa, siampu leh amiliante toh sal a pi in a-om ding uhi.
Bangziak a na phaizang hoihte suang na hia, aw muanhuailounu aneih hoihhoihte muang a, 'Kua ahia hon sual ding?' chichi nak mi.
Ngai in, na tung ah launa ka hon tun ding a, na kim a mi tengteng a kipan, chih Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi; michih delhkhiak na hi vek ding uh, kuamah in taikekpawl akaikhawm kei ding uh.
"Huai khit chiang in bel Ammon tate omdan ka kiheisak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Edom thu, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Teman a pilna om nawn lou ahi maw? Lemthei lemtheihna amang khinta a hia? Apilna uh mang khin hia?
Aw Dedan a tengte aw, taikek unla, lehngat unla, tummang vengveng un; amah ka gawt hun chiang in, Esau siatna atung ah ka hon tun ding hi.
Grep lou mite na kiang a ahong pai un, maih anei kei ding ua hia? Zan a guta mite'n adeihzah uh angah masiah un alok zel kei ding ua hia?
Esau ka vuaktang sakta a, agukkhuhte ka hongta, abu thei nawn kei ding. Asuante hihsiat ahi ua, a-unaute, a-invengte toh a-omta kei.
Na tagahte limsak ke'n, ke'n ka hum ding, na meithaite'n kei hon muang uhen."
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Nou dawn lou dingte'n leng adawn mawk uleh, nang gawt louh hial in na suakta ding a hia? Gawt louh in na pawt kei ding, na dawn mahmah ding hi.
TOUPA'N keimah kilou in ka kichiamta ngal a, Bozrah lamdangsak chiat, gensiat, hihgawp, hamsethuak ahi ding, akhua tengteng leng asegawp tawntung ding," achi hi.
TOUPA kiang a kipan thupuan ka zata, namte kiang ah sawltak sawl ahita, "Kikaikhawm unla, amah sual unla, kidou ding in kuan un!
Ngai in, mihingte muhsit in namte lak ah nang ka hon neusakta hi.

Na kihih mulkimhuaina tak na lungtang kisathei in ahon khemna ahi, aw nang kawl suangkal a, mualvum a teng zel, mu bang in, sangpi ah bu sep mah lechin, huai a kipan in ka hon lakhesuk ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Huchi in Edom bel lamdang asak uh ahong hi ding a, mi vialvak peuh in lamdang asa ding ua, asiat luat ziak in atekkhum ding uh.
Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akim a khopite hihsiat a om mah bang in, kuamah ateng nawn kei ding ua, mihing ta kuamah huai ah a-om ngei nawn kei ding uh.

Ngai un, Jordan gam gammang a kipan a humpinelkai, gan khahna mun ah ahong tou ding a; amah a kipan amau ka taimangsak pah ding a, atung a thunei ding in ka ut-ut ka sep ding. Keimah bang kua ahia om? Kua'n ahia hunbi hon bikhiahsak ding? Belamchingmi kua ahia ka ma a dingh ding pen?
Huaiziak in Edom tung a TOUPA thuhilh leh Teman mite tung a athilseh, hih atuppente ngaikhia un; ganhon nou neute ngei kaihmang in a-om ding ua; atenna uh ahihgawp ding hi.
Apuksiatna husa uah lei akising a; akah husa uh Tuipi san ah leng zak ahi ding.
Ngai un, muvanlai bang in ahong lengtou ding a; Bozrah tung ah kha azak ding; huai ni in Edom mihangsante lungtang numei nauvei lungtang bang lel ahi ding hi.
Damaskas thu: Hamath zumta, Arpad toh, thuhoih lou azata ngal ua, azulta uh; tuipi kihot om kinken thei lou bang in abuai uh.
Damaskas athazaw, taikek atum a, linna in alap a, lungkhamna leh natna in numei nauvei bang mai in alenta hi.
Ka nopsakna khopi, khopi minthang bangziak a nutsiat a om lou ahia?
Huchi in huai ni in atangval honte kongtual ah apuk ding ua, galdoumi tengteng amangthang ding uh, chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Damaskas kulhbaang ah mei ka khah ding a, Ben-hadad kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.
Kedar leh Hazor gamte Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in agawtna thu; TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Thou unla, Kedar sual unla, suahlam tate bawl ek un.
Apuaninte uh, aganhonte uh alaksak ding ua, apuanzakte uh, atui-um belsuan tengteng uh, asangawngsaute uh apaimangpih ding uh, ning chih ah launa a-om a, chi in mite'n akikoukhum ding uh.
Taikek unla, vakmang vengveng un, tummang vengveng unla, Hazor a tengte aw, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in nang ahon sawm a, na tung ah hihtup aneita hi.
Thou unla, lungmuangtak a om, amah a khosa, kulh kongkhak leng nei lou, kalhna siktawn leng nei lou nam sual un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Asangawngsaute uh gal in ala ding ua, abawnghonte uh alok ding uh. Baksam metgiau honte ning chih ah ka dalhsak ding, asiatna ding uh ning chih a kipan in ka hon tun ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Huan Hazor bel sihna tenna mun ahi ding a, asegawp tawntung ding, huai ah kuamah ateng nawn kei ding uh, mihing tate a-omta kei ding uh.
Judah kumpipa Zedekiah vaihawm pat tungna Elam tungtang a TOUPA thu, zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a hong tung;
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, Elam thalpeu, ahatna bulpi pen uh, ka kitansak ding;
Kawlmong li a kipan in huih lite ka hon tun ding, Elam tung ah ka dalhsak ding, kawlmong chih ah, Elam delhkhiak mite phak louh nam a-om kei ding uh.
Amelma uh, ahinna uh zong mite ma ah, Elamte ka lunglelsak ding, atung uah siatna ka hon tun ding, ka hehna thupitak, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Amau ka hihman vek masiah namsau ka delhsak ding hi.
Akumpipate uleh aheutute uh hihmang in Elam ah ka laltutphah ka tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Himahleh ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding, Elam omdan ka kiheisak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Jerusalem kholakte ah vialtai unla, chiamteh un! Amual tamte zong unla, mi khat bek diktattak a hih a, thutak zong mahmah na muh theih uleh, Jerusalem ka ngaidam ding.
"TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, chi mah le uh, zuau in akichiam lel uh ahi.

Aw TOUPA, thutak na muhnop ahi kei a hia? Amau na sat a, himahleh alungkham tuan kei uh, amau na hihmang a, na thuzohna apom nuam tuan kei uh, suangpi sang a tak in atal uh ataksak ua, akilehhei nuam kei bikbek uhi.
"Ke'n, hiaite miphalou, ahai lai ua, TOUPA dan, a Pathian uh thugel athei kei uhi.
Miliante kiang ah ka hohta ding a, ka houpih ding a, amau zaw TOUPA dan leh Pathian thugelte athei uh," achi a. Himahleh hiai mite'n thukhat sat in, hakkol ahihtan ua, henna khau ahihtat uhi.

Huaiziak in gammang nuai a humpinelkai in amaute akei ding a, gamdai ngia in amaute ane bei ding a, gialbem in akhopite a tang in, huai a hong pawt peuhmah abotzan ding; atatleknate uh atam a, anungkinnate uh athupi mahmah ziak in.
"Bangchi in ka hon ngaidam thei dia? Na tate'n ahon paisan ua, Pathian hiloupite sam in akichiam ua, taitak a ka vak nung in ang a kawm ua, kizuak innte ah akivel hehu uh.
Amaute zingsang a sakol vakvah bang mai ahi ua, michih ama invengpa zi enlah in aham hi.
Hiai thilte ziak in ka gawt kei ding maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Hichibang nam tung ah phu ka kilaksak kei ding a hia?
Abaangte ah kaltou unla, hihsia un, himahleh hihse khin vek kei un, ahiangte lamang un, TOUPA a lah ahi ngal kei hi.
Israel inkote leh Judah inkote'n ka tung ah lepchiahtak in ahih uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
TOUPA bel zuauthei dia sep in, "Bangmah ahihthei sam kei ding, siatna i tung uah atung kei ding, kial hiam namsau hiam i thuak kei ding.
Zawlneite leng huihzam lel ahi ding ua, amau ah thu a-om kei a; atung uah hichibang a hih ahi ding,” achi uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA, Sepaihte Pathian in achi: "Huchibang thu na gen ziak un, ngai in, na kam a ka thute mei ka suaksak ding a, hiai mipi singte akang khin ding.”
Ngai un, aw Israel inkote aw, gamlapi a kipan, nam khat na kiang ah ka hon pi ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Nam hattak, nidanglai a kipan a, apau uh na theih louh, athugen uh na theih louh namte.
Athalbawm uh han kihong ahi a, avek un mihattak ahi khin uh.

Na buhlaksa leh na nek ding ane khin vek ding uh; na tanute na tapate nek ding mahmah; na ganhonte, na belamhonte ane ding ua, na grep guite, na theipi kungte ane ding ua, na khopi kulh nei, na muanpi pente mahmah namsau in ahihse ding uhi.
"Himahleh huai nite ah leng ka hon hihchimit kei ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.

Hichi ahong hi ding a, "Bangziak a ToUPA i Pathian un hiai thil tengteng i tung ua hih ahia?" Na mite un achih hun chiang un, "N'on paisan ua, na gam ua pathian dangte nna na sep bang un, na gam lou uah, paudang mite nna na sem ding uh, akiang uah na chi ding ahi."
"Jakob inkote lak ah hiai genkhia unla, Judah gam ah puang un.
Aw theihtheihna nei lou, mihaite aw, mit nei a lah mu lou, bil nei a lah zaloute aw, hiai ngaikhia un.

N'on kihta kei uh maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ka ma ah na ling kei ding uh maw? Kei, tuipi huap chiang a dia piautak, tangtawn a aletlouhna ding a daikaihna, tuipi kihot zou mahleh alet tuan theih louh a, ging honhon mahleh akhen theih louh ding bawlpa ka hi.
Himahleh hiai mite'n genhakna leh helhat lungtang apu ua, ahel ua, ataimangta uh.
Alungtang un leng, TOUPA i Pathian, ahuntak a vuah masa leh vuah nanung zusakpa, buh leh hunbi hon sehsakpa laudan i siam ding uh, achi sam kei uh.
Hiai thilte na thulimlouhnate un ahihmang a, na khelhnate un thil hoih nou ahon tansak ahi.
"Ka mite lak ah migilou a-om ngal ua, vasa gemmi in atan bang in atang gige ua, thang akam ua, mite aman uh.
Bawm vasa a dim bang mai in, a-innte uh khemna in adim a, huaiziak in ahong lian ua, ahong hauhsak lohta uhi.
Ahong thau ua, ahong zol ua, ahi, agitlouhna thilhihte un hun chiang anei kei, pa neiloute lamzanna ding in amau lam ah apang kei uhi.
"Hiai thilte ziak in ka gawt kei dia hia?" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. "Hichibang nam tung ah ka hinna in phu ala kei ding a hia?
Huai gam ah thillamdangtak leh mulkimhuaitak ahong tung hi.
Zawlneite'n zuauthu agen ua, siampute'n lah amau thuthu in vai ahawm ua, ka mite'n lah huchibang hih a-ut uhi, atawp ah bangchi in na hih ding ua le?”
Babulon tungtang, Kaldai mite gam tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thugen:
Namte lak ah gen unla, puang un, puanzak khai in, puang un, sel kei un, Babulon lak ahita. Bel azahlak a, Merodak mulkimna in adim a, milimte ase khinta.
Mallam a kipan amah nam khat in ahon sual a, huai in agam ahihgawp ding a, huai ah kuamah ateng nawn kei ding ua; ataikek ua, mi leh sate leng amang khinta uhi.
Huai nite in leh huai hun chiang in Israel suante ahong pai ding ua, amau leh Judah tate toh; kap kawm in ahong pai ding ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh azong ding uh; chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Zion lam nga in akalsuanna ding uh adong ding ua, "Kisa un, tangtawn thukhun mangngilh nawn lou ding in TOUPA hong len un," achi ding uh.
Ka mite zaw belam mang ahi ua; amau ching mite'n apimang ua, mualte ah apaimangsak ua, tang a pan mual dungte ah apai ua, ahuang uh amangngilh khinta uhi.
Amu peuh in ane zel ua, amelmate un, i gilou kei, TOUPA dikna omna apipute uh lamet TOUPA hilhial tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ahi, achi uhi.
Babulon sung a kipan in taikhia unla, Kaldaite gam a kipan paikhia un, kelhon lak a keltalte bang in om un.

Ngai dih ua, Babulon hong sual ding in mal gam a kipan nam honpi thupitak kikaikhawm ka tokthou ding a, amah dou ding in akisa ding ua; huai a kipan in lak ahi ding uh; athalte uh lah galbawl siamtak vuaksuak ngei lou bang ahi ding uh.
Huan Kaldai loh in a-om ding, alok mite atai ngial ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Kipak mah le uchin, nuamsa mah le uchin, aw ka goutan lok mite aw, lou lak a bawngla takhialkhial bang leh sakoltal ham ngekngek bang himah le uchin;
Na nu uh ahong zum mahmah ding a, nou hon suangnu ahong zahlak ding hi. Ngai un, namte lak a nuainungpen, gamdai, gamkeu, gamvuak ahi ding.
TOUPA hehna ziak in luahmi a-om kei ding a, ase vek zaw ding hi, Babulon hoh peuhmah amulkimsak ding a, asiatna tengteng ziak in atek ding uhi.
Thalpeu tawimi tengteng aw, Babulon umsuak in kivual unla, kap unla, thalte chil kei un, TOUPA tung ah akhialta uhi.
Akimvel in awng unla, amah-le-amah akipeta, akulhte apukta a, abaangte achimta, TOUPA phulakna ahi ngal a, atung ah phu la unla, ahih bangbang in atung ah hih un.
Babulon a kipan chi thehmi attan unla, buhlak lai a kawite tawimi toh, nuaisiahna namsau lau in amau mite lam azuan chiat ding ua, amau gam chiat ah atai ding uh.
Israel bel belam dalhzak ahi a; humpinelkaite'n adelhmang ua; Assuria kumpipa'n amah ane phot a, atawp in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in aguhte ahaizanta hi.
Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Assuria kumpipa ka gawt bang in Babulon kumpipa leh agam ka gawt ding.
Huan Israel agantatna ah ka pi nawn ding a, Karmel leh Bashan ah ata ding a, Ephraim tang ah leh Gilead ah amah ata ding hi.

Huai nite leh huai hun chiang in Israel thulimlouhnate azong ding ua, muh ding a-om kei ding; Judah thilhihkhelhte leng muh ding a-om sam kei ding; omsun ding a ka koihte ngaidam ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Merathim gam sual un, agam leh Pekod luah mite mahmah that unla, hihgam sipsip un, thu ka hon piak bangbang in hih un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Huai gam ah gal husa a-om, siatna thupi mahmah husa toh.
Khovel pumpi sek kitam in, nak keknen hi na tel e; namte lak ah Babulon kinaksiat hi na mai e!
Aw Babilon, nang ding in thang na kam a, thei lou a awk na hita ve; muhkhiak leh mat in na omta, TOUPA na sual ziak in.
TOUPA'N agalvan bawm ahongta, ahehna vanzatte alakhia a, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Kaldaite gam ah hih ding anei hi.
Gamgi tawp pek a kipan in hon sual unla, athil koihkhawmna innte hong vek unla, paikhawm un, hihse vek unla, abangmah hawi kei un.
Abawngtal tuaite that vek unla, goh in om uhen. Atung uh gik hi na tel e! Ani uh, amaute gawtna ni mahmah ahong tungta hi.
TOUPA i Pathian phulak, atempul phulakna ngei Zion a gen ding a Babulon a kipan a taikhete leh taimangte husa ngei.

Babulon sual ding in thalkap siam, thalpeu zangmi tengteng samkhawm un; akimvel in buk bawl unla, kuamah suakta kei uhen. Athilhih bangbang in thuk un, ahihsa bang tengteng amah tung ah hih un; TOUPA, Israel Mi Siangthou lah achou ngam hi.
Huaiziak in akholakte ah tangvalte apuk ding ua, galkapmi tengteng huai ni in amangthang ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Ngai in, nang mikisathei, ka hon dou ahi, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi hi. Na ni ahong tungta, na gawtna ding ni mah,
Huan mikisathei akisui in apuk ding a, kuamah in aphong kei ding ua, akhopite ah mei ka khah ding a, akimvel a om tengteng ka kangsiangsak vek ding.

Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israel suante leh Judah tate nuaisiah in a-om khawmta ua; sal a amaute pi mite tengteng in amau alen tinten ua, akhah nuam kei uhi. Amaute tanpa bel ahat a; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
Amah amau lam ah apang a, Babulon a tengte hihbuai in, leitung a khawlna atuttheihna ding in.
Kaldai mite tung ah namsau aleng hi, Babulon a tengte, aheutute uh leh amipilte uh tung ah leng, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Mizuautheite tung ah namsau, mihai ahong suak ding uh; agalkapmi tung ah namsau, alunglel khin ding uh.
Asakolte uh leh kangtalaite uh tung ah namsau, asung a mi kilak hel tengtengte tung ah leng, numei bang phet ahong hi ding uh; agou thil tung ah namsau lok in a-om maimai ding uhi.
Atuite kang in akeu khin a, milimte gam lah ahi ngal a, milimte lah ahailoh uhi.
Huaiziak in gamdai gam sahangte, ngiate toh huai ah ateng ding ua, ostrikte leng huai ah ateng ding uh; luah in a-om ngei nawn kei ding; suan tengteng pha in leng luah in a-om kei ding hi.
Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akho invengte ahihsiat bangbang in; huai ah kuamah atengta kei ding ua, mihing tapa kuamah in aveh nawnta kei ding uh, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
Ngai un, mallam gam a pan mite ahong ua, mun tawp a kipan nam thupitak leh kumpipa tampi ahong kuan uhi.

Thalpeu leh tei atawi ua, hiamgamtak, zahngaihna nei lou ahi uh. Ahusa uh tuipi ging huhu bang ahi a, sakol tung ah atuang ua, michih galkapmi bang a kivan in, Babulon tanu aw, nang ahong sual ding uhi.
Ahusa uh za in Babulon kumpipa khut azawgawpta a, numei nauvei lai natna bang in, natna thupitak in amanta hi.

Ngai un, Jordan gammang a kipan humpinelkai, kahna mun a ahong tou bang in ahong paitou ding a; amah a kipan in amaute ka taimangsak pah ding; atung a thunei ding ka ut-ut ka sep ding. Kei bang kua a-om a! Kua'n sep ding. Kei bang kuakua a-om a? Kua'n ahia hunbi hon sehsak ding? Belamchingmi kua ahia ka ma a dingh ding?
Huaiziak in Babulon tung ah TOUPA thuhilh, Kaldai mite tung a athilseh ngaikhia un. Ganhon noute ngei kaihmang in a-om ding ua, gan khahna mun a mite amulkimsak ding.
Babulon lakna husa ah lei aling ding a, akahna husa namte lak a zak ahi ding hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih, Babulon leh Kaldai mite tung ah, hihse ding huihpi ka sawl ding hi.
Zapsiangmi ka sawl ding, Babulon tung ah, amah zap in agam azapsiang ding ua, siatna ni a um a sual ding ahi ngal ua.
Thalpeu zangmi in thalpeu lai a, sik puanak silh in, dingh heh, tangvalhon khat leng hawi lou in, asepaih tengteng nuaimang un.
Kaldai gam ah thah in apuk ding ua, akholakte uah sut pailet in a-om ding uhi.
Israel leh Judah, agam uah Israel Mi Siangthou tung ah khelhna in adim na ua, a Pathian uh sepaihte' TOUPA'N amangngilh kei hi.
Taimang unla, Babulon khosung a kipan, michih in amah hinna humbit hen; athulimlouhna manloh kei un, TOUPA phulak hun ahi ngal a, ama'n athuk ngeigngei ding hi.
Babulon bel TOUPA khut a dangka-eng nou, leitung pumpi hihkhamna ahi a, namte'n kham in alung uh amawl khinta hi.
Babulon apuk guih a, amangta, amah kah ekek un, hihdam theihdan ding ahihleh singnai damdawi nuhchi laksak un.
Babulon hihdam ka tum a, adam tuan kei, amah nusia in eimah gam chiat uah pai ni, amohna in van asun a, van dum pha a dopkang ahi.
"TOUPA'N ka dikna apuangta; kisa un, TOUPA i Pathian thilhih, Zion ah i puang ding uh.
"Thalte tat-hiam unla, lumte len un, Media kumpipate lungsim TOUPA'N atokthouta a, athiltup Babulon hihsiat ahi. Huai TOUPA'N atempul ziak a phulakna ahi.
Babulon kulh bul ah kidouna puangzak thak un, venna hihhat in, galvilmi koih un, galbuknate bawl unla, Babulon mite tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N agen tak, angaihtuah in ahih khinta hi.
Aw nang, tui tamna mun a tengmi, sum-le-pai hau mahmah, na tawpna atungta, na hinna khau akitanta hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA amah kilou in achiamta hi, khaupete bang mai in mihing in ka hon dimsak ngeingei ding, nakpi in ahon otkhum ding uh."
Athilhihtheihna in lei abawl a, apilna in khovel adingkhesak a, alemtheihna in van aphalhsak.
A-aw asuah a, van a tui aging hawhaw a, kawlmong a kipan meipi apaitousak a, vuah zukna ding in khua aphesak a, agoubawm a kipan huih anungsak hi.
Michih amual ua, theihna lou in, dangka-eng sekmichih in alimsek pen azumpih ua, amilim sun lah zuau ngen ahi a, amau ah nakna a-om kei lai hi.
Bangmah lou, khemna nasep lel ahi ua, agawt hun chiang in amang ding uh.
Jakob tantuan bel hichibang ahi kei, thil tengteng bul ahi ngal a; Israel agouluah nam ahi a, amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
Nang bel ka galdouna heipi leh vanzat na hi a, nang hon zang in namte ka hihzan a, nang zang in lalna gamte ka hihmang hi.
Nang hon zang in sakol leh atung a ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in kangtalai leh atung a tuang ka hihzan a;
Nangmah zang in numei leh pasal ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in putek leh tuailai ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in nungak leh tangval ka hihzan hi.
Nangmah zang in belamching leh belamhon ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in louneimi leh bawngtal kop ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in gam ukpipate leh upate ka hihzan sek ahi.
Nang mitmuh ngei in Zion tung a athil hoih lou hih tengteng uh Babulon leh Kaldai mite tung ah ka thuk ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.

Ngai in, leitung pumpi hihsia, aw hihsetu tang lian, nang ka hon dou ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, kawl sang a kipan ka hon khukkhe ding, tang kang mit khinsa in ka hon bawl ding.
Nang a kipan suang ning ding leh suangphum ding lakkhiak ahi nawn kei ding; tangtawn in na segawp zaw ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.

"Huai gam ah kidou puanzak tak unla, namte lak ah pengkul mut un, amah dou ding namte kisasak unla, Araratte, Minnite, Ashkenaz gamte, amah sual ding sepaih sep unla, khaupe zuanzaang bang mai in sakolte kaikhawm un.
Amah dou ding namte kisasak un; Media kumpipate, ukpipate leh upate, athuneihna gam tengteng toh.
Huai gam nat thuak in aling a, Babulon gam, tengmi om lou a hihsiat ding in, Babulon tung a TOUPA thiltup adingh gige hi.
Babulon galdou mite'n galkap ding ngapta lou in, akulhpi uah aton maimah uh, apasalphatna uh akhing a, numei bang mai ahong hita ua, atenna munte akang khin a, adeidanna siktawn akitan hi.
Thangkou tai in midang leng akituahpih a, misawl in leng midang atuak a, Babulon kumpipa kiang a akhopi ning chih ah amanta uh chih hilh ding in.
Lui kannate aman ua, phailuangte ahal siang ua, kidou mite leng alunglelta uh.
Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Babulon tanu phual sikngil lai bang ahi a, sawt lou nung in buhchil hun atung ah ahong tung ding hi."
"Hon negaita, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in, hon haizan a, bel vuak lel in ahon bawlta, gulpi bang in ahon nawmvalhta, ka thil limte'n agilpi adimsak a, ahon paikhe nawnta hi.
Kei leh ka satung a hiamgam thilhih, Babulon tung ah om hen; ka sisan Kaldai mite tung ah om hen, Jerusalem in achi ding."
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, nang lam ah ka pang ding a, na phu ka hon laksak ding, atuipi ka kangsak ding a, atuikhuk leng ka keugawsak ding.
Huan Babulon bel hoih lou paihkhawm lel, sehal tenna mun, lamdangsak chiat leh enghou, tengmi om lou mun ahong hi ding.
Akikou ton ding ua, humpinelkai lun lai bang in, angik tuaktuak ding uh; humpinelkai nou bang in.
Akham mahmah lai un ankuang ka luisak dia, khothei het lou in ka khamsak dia, khanglou het lou ding a a-ihmut dettheihna ding un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Ka pikhe ding a, belam goh ding bang in, belamtalte leh keltalte bang mai in."
Shesak lak ahita ve; leitung pumpi pahtawi zel mat in a-omta ve, namte lak ah Babulon asegawpta ve.
Babulon tuipi in atumta, akihot thupi mahmah in akhuh khinta.
Akhopi asegawpta a, gamkeu, gamdai, mihing tenlouhna mihing ta kuamah phak louh gam ahong suakta hi.
Babulon bel ka gawt ding, avalhkhitsa akam a kipan asuahkhe ding, namte bel akiang ah aluangkhawm nawn kei ding uh, ahi Babulon kulhpi achim ding.
Ka mite aw, asung a kipan hong pawt unla, TOUPA hehna lauhuai mahmah a kipan, michih amau kihumbit chiat un.

Na lungtang uh bah kei hen, huai gam a thuthang leng lau kei un; kum khat in thuthang ahong tung ding a, kum dang in thuthang ahong tung nawn ding ahi, kumpipa leh kumpipa kisual in gam ah hiamgamna a-om ding.
Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi. Babulon milim sektawmte tung a vai ka hawm a, agam pumpi zumna ni ding; huan, asung ah amithahte apuk ding uh.
Huchi in lei leh van leh asung a om tengteng in, Babulon tung a kipak in la asa ding uh; mallam a kipan sim mite akiang a tung ding uh ahi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Babulon in Israel mithahte apuksak bang in Babulon ah gam chih a thah a omte apuk ding uh.
Nou namsau pel mite aw, kuan unla, dingh maimai kei un, gamlapi a kipan in TOUPA theigige unla, na lungsim uah Jerusalem lut hen.
Gensiatna thu ka zak ziak un ka zum ua, lungdonna in ka mai uh atuam a, TOUPA' inn a mun siangthoute ah pau theih louh mite ahong lutta uhi.
Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, amilim sektawmte uh tung a ka vaihawmna ding leh agam pumpi tung a miliamte thumna ni ding ngei.
Babulon bel van sun in sang mahleh, akulh sangte hihkip mahleh, atung ah ka kiang a kipan hihsemi ahong tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Babulon a kipan kah husa leh Kaldai gam a kipan siatna thupitak husa;
TOUPA'N Babulon asim a, ahusa uh thupitak ahih daihsak hi. Agamtat husa uh tui tampi ging hawhaw bang ahi, a- awng zuazualua.
Atung ah simmi ahong tung, Babulon tung ngei ah pang ni, amihatte mat in a-om ua, athalpeute uh akitangawpta, TOUPA bel thukna Pathian ahi a, athuk ngeingei ding.
Huan aheutute leh amipilte, a-ukpipate leh upate leh mihatte ka khamsak dia; alumden ding ua, akhanglou kei ding uh, chih, kumpipa, Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Babulon kumpipa kulhbaang sahtakte achim vek ding a, akongpi sangte akang vek ding; amite'n athawn in asem ua, namte'n meihal a ding lel a kihihgim uh ana hi.
Judah kumpipa Zedekiah vaihawm akum lina a Babulon ahoh lai a akiang a hoh sam, Seraiah Neriah tapa, Maaseiah tapa kiang a zawlnei Jeremiah thupiak.
Seraiah bel kumpipa insung heutupen ahi a, Jeremiah in Babulon tung a siatna hong tung ding tengteng, Babulon tungtang a hiai thu gelh tengteng laibu ah agelh hi.
Huan Jeremiah in Seraiah kiang ah, Babulon na tun hun chiang in hiai thu tengteng sim ngeingei inla,
Aw TOUPA hiai nam tungtang ah kuamah, mi leh sa leh tenlouhna ding suksiat a om in, tangtawn a kisegawp zaw ding in thu na genta a, na chi ding.
Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, hiai laibu na sim khit chiang in suang toh gakkhawm in Euphrates Luipi ah pailut inla,
Babulon hichibang mai in atum ding a, atung a siatna ka hon tut ding ziak in athounawn kei ding; abah mahmah ding uh, chi in na gen ding ahi, achi a. Hichi teng Jeremiah thu ahi.
Zedekiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih leh kum khat a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm a; anu min Hamutal ahi a, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
Jehoiakim hih bangbang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih hi.
TOUPA aheh mahmah ziak in Jerusalem leh Judah gam ah ama a kipan a paihkhiakna khop in thil ahong tungta a; huchi in Babulon kumpipa tung ah Zedekiah ahelta hi.

Huan avaihawm akum kuana ah hichi ahong hi a, kha sawmna, huai kha ani sawm ni in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh asepaihhonte Jerusalem dou ding in ahong kuan ua, buk abawlkhumta ua; akim ah kulh abawl uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Zedekiah kum sawm-le-khatna tan in khopi um in a-omta hi.
Akha lina, huai kha ani kuana ah khopi ah kial ahong uang mahmah a, gam mipite a ding in nek ding a-omta kei hi.
Huchi in khopi kulhbaang asunvang ua, kidoumi tengteng ataimang ua, kumpipa huan a baang nih kikal a kongpi a pawt in, zan in khopi a kipan ataikhia ua; Kaldai mite' khopi a om ahi uhi.
Himahleh Kaldai sepaihte'n kumpipa adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah Zedekiah apha ua, sepaihhonte akiang a kipan adalhzak uhi.
Huchi in Zedekiah aman ua, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Hamath gam a Riblah ah apaipih ua; ama'n atung ah vai ahawmkhum hi.
Babulon kumpipa'n Zedekiah tapate amitmuh ngei in athat a; Riblah ah Judah heutu tengteng leng athat lai hi.
Zedekiah mit akhelkhia a, Babulon ah apaipih hi; asih ni tanpha in suangkul ah akoih hi.
Huan kumpipa vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan, amah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ma a dingh sek, akum sawm-le-kuana, akha ngana, huai kha ani sawmna in Jerusalem ah ahong lut hi.
TOUPA’ inn leh kumpipa' inn ahal a, Jerusalem inn tengteng toh, inn thupi chitengte mei in ahal hi.
Huan Kaldai sepaihhon tengteng, kumpipa vengpa pawl heutu kiang a omte'n Jerusalem kulhte akimvel in ahihchim vek uhi.
Huchi in vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in mipi lak a genthei pawl khenkhat khopi a nutsiat a omte, Babulon kumpipa kiang a kipesate leh mikhutsiam omsun tengtengte toh sal in apivekta hi.
Himahleh vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in gam a migenthei pen khenkhatte grephuan kemmi leh vengmi ding in anusia hi.
TOUPA' inn a dalkhuamte leh akingaknate, dal maiphiat kuang lian TOUPA' inn a omte Kaldai mite'n ahihtamgawp ua, dal tengteng Babulon ah ala uhi.
Belte leng, vutluahte, khawnvak mihsaknate, maiphiat kuangte, sikkeute, dal tui-um belsuan tengteng a zat sekte uh ala vek uh.
Noute leng, meivu koihnate, maiphiat kuangte, belte, khawnvak koihnate, sikkeute leh belhbute; dangka-eng a bawl huai dangkasik in vengmi pawl heutu in ala vek hi.
Khuam nih, dal a bawl bawngtal sawm-le-nih, maiphiatna kuang kingakna, kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl, hiai tui-um belsuan tengteng dalte tamdan teh vual ahi kei hi.
Huan khuamte khuam khat sandan, tong sawm-le-giat ahi a, tong sawm-le-nih in akimvel zou phet ahi; asahdan zung za delh ahi a, asung ahawm hi.
Atung ah dal lubawk a-om a, alubawk sandan tong nga ahi a, alubawk kimvel leh theibuhfai, dal ngen a zep ahi a; khuam nih in leng hichi mah bang in theibuhfai a-om hi.
Asik ah theibuhfai sawmkua-le-guk a-om a, akim a azepna theibuhfai tengteng zakhat ahi.
Huan vengpa pawl heutu in siampu lianpen Seraiah leh siampu nihna, Zephaniah leh kongkhak ngakmi thumte aman hi.

Kidou mite tung a heutu dia seh michilgeh leh mi sagih, kumpipa mel mu sekmi, khopi a omte leh sepaih heutu gelhmi, gam mite min kempa leh gam mipi lak a mi sawmguk, khopi a na omte khopi a kipan in apikhia hi.
Nebuzaradan, vengpa pawl heutu in amaute api a, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah atun hi.
Babulon kumpipa'n Hamath gam a Riblah ah atung ua khut kha in, athat vek hi. Huchi in Judah nam agam ua kipan in sal a pimang in a-omta.
Hiaite Nebukadnezzar in mipi sal a apite ahi uh; akum sagihna ah Juda mite sangthum sawmnih-le-thum;
Nebukadnezzar kum sawm-le-giatna ah Jerusalem a kipan in mi zagiat sawmthum-le-nih sal in api hi.
Nebukadnezzar akum sawmnih-le-thumna ah Nebuzaradan vengtu pawl heutu in Juda saltang mi zasagih sawmli-le-nga api a, saltang tengteng avek un sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.

Kumpipa saltan kum sawmthum-le-sagihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, huai kha ani sawmnih-le-nga ni geih in hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Evil-merodak in avaihawm akum khatna ah, Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin lutang adopkangsak a, suangkul a kipan apikhia hi.
Akiang ah hoihtak in apau a, Babulon a akiang a om Kumpipate tutphah sang a sang in laltutphah atunsak hi.
Asuangkul puansilhte akikhengsak a, adamsung teng ama ah an ane den hi.
Huan amah vakna ding adamsung ni tengteng, asih ni tan in aniteng tantuan Babulon kumpipa'n ape gige hi.

Benjamin tate aw, Jerusalem sung a kipan na bitna ding un taimang unla; Tekoa ah pengkul mut unla Beth-hakkerem ah theihsakna suaksak un. Mallam a kipan in siatna ahong kuan hi, hihsiatna thupi mahmah.
Zion tanu melhoihtak leh noutak ka hihmang ding.
Belampute, abelamhonte uh toh akiang ahong tung ding ua, akim ah apuaninte uh akaihkhum ding ua, amau mun chiat ah ake ding uh.
Amah dou ding in kisa un, thou unla, sun lai in i sual ding uh, ei a ding in khawk hi na e! Ni akihekta a, nitaklam limliap ana sauta hi.
Thou unla, zan in i sual mai ding uh! A-inn hoihhoih uh hihsia ni.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Asingte phuk unla, Jerusalem sualna ding in mualvum bawl un, khopi gawt ding pen hiai ahi, asung ah nuaisiahna ngen ahi.
Tuileh in tui apawtsak bang mai in agitlouhna apawtsak sek, asung ah hiamgamna leh kilohna a-om chih zak ahi, ka ma ah natna leh kiliamsaknate a-om nilouh hi.
Ka lungsim in ahon nutsiat vengveng ma in aw, Jerusalem, pilvang in, huchi lou in zaw luahmi nei lou gam dia hon bawl in, ka hon hihgawp kha ding hi."
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel khosuaksunte grep bang in lou siang vek unla, grep lou mi bang in ahiangte ban tuantuan un.

"Angaihkhiak theihna ding un kua ka houpih in, kua ka theisak dia? Ngai in, bil lam zeksum louh ahi ua, angaikhe thei kei uh; ngai in, TOUPA thu amau a ding in thil simmohhuai ahi a, kipahna mahmah anei nawn kei uh.

Huaiziak in TOUPA hehna in ka dim a, ka kidek zou nawn kei; kholak a naupang tung ah ka bungkhe dia; tangval omkhawmte tung ah leng, azi toh kiton in pasal leng lak ahi ding a, upate leh teksiate leng.
A-innte uh midang kiang a piak ahi ding a, aloumate uleh azite uh toh; huai gam a tengte tung ah ka khut lik ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in leng michih huaihamna in adim ua; zawlneite leh siampute nangawn leng, michih azuautat mahmah uhi.
Ka mite liamna, awlmoh loutak buaipih in, muanna a-om louh laitak in Muanna, muanna, achi ua.

Thilkihhuai ahih un leng azum ua hia? Zum lou hial, azum het kei uh, amai uh leng asan sam kei; huaiziak in pukte lak ah apuk tei ding ua; amaute ka gawt hun chiang in paihkhiak in a-om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Lamka thuam ah dingh unla, en un, lampi hoih omna lampi luite tawn un, huai ah pai unla, na kha uh a ding in khawlna na mu ding uh," amau bel, "Huai ah ka pai kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Huan nou a ding in galvil mite ka sep ding a, "Pengkul ging ngaikhia un," chi in; amau bel, “Ka ngaikhe kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Huaiziak in "Aw, namte aw, ngaikhia unla, aw, kikhawmte aw, atung ua hong tung ding thei un.
Aw, leitung, ngaikhia in, ngai in, hiai mite tung ah siatna ka hon tun ding; angaihtuahna gahte uh; ka thute angaihkhiak louh ziak un; ka dante lah apaikhe hithet ua.
Bangziak a Sheba a kipan begaw, gamlapi a kipan kawltute ka kiang hong tung nak ahia? Na halmang kithoihnate uh kipahpihtak ahi kei a, na kithoihnate un ahon kipaksak sam kei hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Hiai mite kiang ah puknate ka koih ding a, huai ah pate atapate uh toh apukkhawm ding ua, inveng leh alawm leng amangthang ding uh," chi in.
Huan TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, mallam gam a kipan mite ahong pai uh, lei mun tawp a kipan nam thupi mahmah ahong kuankhia hi.

Thalpeu leh teipi atawi ua, hiamgam mahmah, zahngaihna himhim nei lou ahi uhi, ahusa uh tuipi ging honhon bang ahia; sakol tungte ah atuang ua, michih galkapmi bang a kivan in, aw, Zion tanu, nang ahong sual dek uhi," chi in.
"Aminthanna uh i za ua, i khutte azaw khinta, numei nauvei lunggimna bangbang lunggimna'n ahon manta hi.
Gam ah paikhe kei un, lampi ah leng pai sam kei un, huai ah lah melma namsau a-om ngal a, kil chih ah launa a-om hi."
"Aw, ka mi, ka tanu, sai-ip puan teng inla, vut lak ah tubial in; tapa tang khat suun bang in suun inla, kap vongvong dih, i tung uah hihsemi ahong tung guih dek ngal ua.
Ka mite lak a chiamtehmi ding leh ze-etmi ding in ka hon bawl a, a-omdan uh na theih a, na ze-et theihna ding in.
Avek un genhaktak a helhat, gensiat ching a vialvak, dal leh sik bang ahi uh, hoihloupi in agamtang uhi.
Pum in azap huhu a, mei ah asuan zulbei a, hihsiangthou tupna athawn lel ahi; migiloute lah paihmang ahi ngal kei ua.
Mite'n dangkasik ek hoih lou achi ding uh, TOUPA'N amaute apampaih ziak in," achi hi.
TOUPA a pan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung:
"TOUPA' inn kongpi ah dingh inla, huai ah hiai thu puang inla, hichi in chi in; Nou Judah mi tengteng, TOUPA be ding a hiai kongpi a lutte'n TOUPA thu ngaikhia un."
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh bawlhoih unla, hiai mun ah ka hon tengsak ding hi.
Hiai, "TOUPA tempul, TOUPA tempul, TOUPA tempul ahi," chih zuauthute gingta kei un.
"Na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh na bawlhoih petmah ua, mi leh invengte kikal a thu diktak a na vai hawmsak ua,
namdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite na nuaisiah louh ua, hiai mun a midiktat sisan na suah louh ua, na hoihlouhna ding ua pathian dangte na delh sam kei ualeh,
hiai gam, tuma lam a na pipute uh kiang a ka piak ah tangtawn in ka hon tengsak ding hi.
Ngai un, zuauthu, phattuamna om het lou na gingtazaw ua.
Gukgu in, tualthat in, angkawm in, zuau a kichiam in Baal kiang a gimlim hal in, pathian dang, na theih ngeilouhte uh na delh uhi.
Hiai inn, ka min mahmah a loh ah ka ma ah hong ding in, hiai thilkihhuai tengtengte hih zel kawm in, hotkhiak ka hita, na chi ding ua hia?
Hiai inn ka min mahmah a loh, na mitmuh un suamhatte kokhuk bang lel ahi hia? Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in ka mu hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Atung a ka min ka tensakna, ka mun Shiloh ah hoh dih ua, ka mi Israel gitlouhna ziak a ka thilhih va en un.
Tu in hiai thil tengteng na hih ua, phalvak a thou a na kiang ua thu ka gengente na ngaihkhiak louh ua, nou ka hon sap a, na dawn louh ziak un;
Shiloh tung a ka hih bang in hiai ka min lohna inn, noumau leh na pipute uh kiang a ka mun piak, na muan uh tung ah ka hih dek ahi.
Na unau tengteng uh, Ephraim nam pumpi nangawn ka paihkhiak bang in ka mitmuh a kipan nou ka hon paikhe ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
"Huaiziak in hiai mite a ding in thum ke'nla, kikoukhia in thum ke'nla, ka kiang ah leng ngetsak sam ke'n; ka hon ngaikhe kei ding hi.
Judah khopite a leh Jerusalem kholakte a athilhih uh na mu kei a hia?
Naupangte'n sing atom ua, apate un mei atoh ua, numeite'n van kumpinu kiang a lat ding tanghou amek ua, pathian dangte ding in dawn ding thillat atungkhia ua, ahon hehsakna lel ding un.
Kei ahi maw hon hehsak uh?" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; amau zumna ding in amau ahi zaw kei uh maw?
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai dih uh, hiai mun tung ah ka hehna leh thangpaihna ka sungkhe ding a; akang dia, amit kei ding.
Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na kithoihnate uah halmang kithoihnate behlap unla, sa ne un.
Halmang thillat hiam, kithoihnate hiam tungthu ah zaw na pipute uh kiang ah thu ka gen kei a, Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak lai in leng thu ka pe sam kei.
Ka aw ngaikhia unla, na Pathian uh ka hi ding a, nou leng ka mite na hi ding uh; na hoihtheihna ding un na omdan ding uh ka hon hilh tengteng zui un, chi in thu ka pe zaw hi.
Himahleh angaikhe kei ua, bil adoh sam kei uh; alungtang gilou ua angaihtuah uh zui in a-om zaw uh, malam zot sang in anungtawn zawta uhi.
Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a kipan apawt ni ua kipan a tuni tan in ka nasemmi, zawlnei tengtengte phalvak a thou in na kiang uah niteng in ka sawl zel a,
himahleh ahon ngaikhe tuan kei ua, bil adoh sam kei uh; alungsim uh akhauhsak ua, apipute uh sang in agilou zawta uhi.
"Hiai thu tengteng akiang ua na gen ding ahi; himahleh ahon ngaikhe kei ding ua; amau na sam ding a, ahon dawng kei ding uh.
Akiang uah, 'Hiai nam TOUPA a Pathian uh aw ngaikhe lou a, thununna tang lou nam ei ve ua, na chi ding a; thudik amangthangta, akam ua kipan paihmang ahita.
Na sam tan inla, paimang in, mun sang giaute ah kapkhia in; TOUPA'N ahehna khang paikhia in anawlkhinta hi.'
"Judah tate'n lah ka mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ngal uh chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ka min lohna inn ninsak ding in athilkihhuaite uh akoih khin uhi.
Atanute uh, atapate uh hal ding in Ben Hinnom Phaizang ah Taphet mun sangte abawl ua; huaite ka thupiak ahi kei a, ka lungsim ah leng alut ngei sam kei.

Huaiziak in ngai dih uh, nite ahong tung dek," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Huai phaizang pen Tophet, chih ahi nawn kei ding a, Ben Hinnom Phaizang, chih leng ahi sam kei ding a Kithahna Phaizang chih ahita ding; Tophet ah avui ding ua, vuina ding mun a-omta kei ding.
Mite luang tung a leng vasate leh gamsate an ahi ding; kuamah in adelhmang kei ding uh.
Judah khopite ah leh Jerusalem kholakte ah nuamsa husate leh kipahna gingte, mouneipa awte, mou awte leng ka daisak ding; agam segawp ding ahi ngal a.
Huai hun chiang in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; Judah kumpipate guhte, aheutute guhte, siampute guhte, zawlneite guhte, Jerusalem a tengte guhte ahan ua kipan alakhe ding ua;

nite, khate, van a om tengteng, a-it ua, nna asep ua, adelh ua, azon ua, chibai abukte uh ma ah aphoukhe ding uh; lakkhawm ahi nawnta kei ding ua, vui ahi sam kei ding uh; leitung a ekvut lel ding ahi ding.
Hiai inkuan gilou mahmah om lai sung tengteng, ka hawlzakna mun a omlaite'n hin sang in sih atel zaw ding uh, chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Huai lou leng akiang uah huchi in na gen ding hi, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mi apuk un athounawn kei ding ua hia? Mi avakmang in ahong kik nawn kei dia hia?
Bang achia hiai Jerusalem mite, tangtawn a nungtawn ding a atolhpuk uh? Khemna alenkip ua, kik nawn a-ut kei uh.

Ka bildoh in ka ngaikhia a, kuamah in thudik agen kei uh, kuamah in, "Bang ahia ka hih?" chi in athulimlouhna uh akisik sam kei uh; michih in amau lampi anga chiat uh; kidouna mun a sakol dianglut bang mai in.
Ahi, van a tuivapi in ahunbite athei a, vakhute, lensiamte, tuivanelkaite, ahun geihgeih in ahong tung zel uh. Ka mite'n bel TOUPA thukhendante athei kei uh.
Bangchi in ahia, mipil i hi ua, TOUPA dan i kiang uah a-om, na chih uh? Ngai un, laigelhmi laigelhna zuauthei in, zuau in asuaksak zaw uhi.
Mipilte azum un alungdong ding ua, mat in a-om ding uh; ngai un, TOUPA thu apaikhia ua, amau ah bang pilna a-om a hia?

Huaiziak in azite uh midangte kiang ah ka pe ding a, aloute uh leng ahon neimi a dingte kiang ah; michih, aneupen a kipan athupipen tan in en hat ahi uhi. Zawlnei a kipan a siampu tan in leng michih khemhat ahi uhi.
Ka tanu, ka mite liam awlmoh loutak in, muanna om lou napi, "Muanna, muanna," chi in athoih uhi.
Thilkihhuai ahih un azum uhia? Ii, azum het kei ua, amel uh leng asan kei. Huaiziak in pukte lak ah apuk tei ding ua, amaute gawt hun chiang in paihkhiak in a-om ding uh chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Amau ka hihmang vek ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; grep guite agah kei ding a, theipi kungte agah sam kei ding; anah leng avuai ding a, amaute tummang dingte ka sep khinta hi.

Bangziak a tulai lai i hi ua? Kikaikhawm unla, khopi kulh neite ah lut unla, huai ah i mangthang diam ding uh; TOUPA tung a i gitlouh tak ziak in; TOUPA i Pathian un gutui dawn ding hon pia in manthatna ah ahon koih hi.
Muanna i zong ua, hoihna bangmah ahong tung kei, hihdamna hun ding leng, ngai in, lungdonna lel!
Asakol nak ging uh Dan a kipan a zak ahi a, asakol uh ham ging in gam pumpi aling a, ahong tung ua, asung a om teng, agai vek ua, khopi leh asung a tengte toh.
Ngai un, na lak uah gulpi ka sawl ding a, gulgu nei, khoizual vuallouhte; huaite'n nou ahon tu ding ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Aw lungkhamna ah kilungmuan thei leng aw! Sunggil ah ka lungtang abah khinta hi.
Ngai un, gam gamlapi a kipan, ka mite tanu kah husa, Zion ah TOUPA a-om kei a hia? Asung a akumpipa om lou ahi maw? milim bawltawmte leh namdang milimte'n bang achia hon hehsak ahi ua?
Buh lak hun akikhelta, nipi abeita, hotdam in i om kei lailai.
Ka mite, ka tanu natna ah ka na a, ka suun a, lungdonna in ahon len hi.
Gilead a singnai damdawi om lou hia? huai ah hihdam mi a-om kei a hia? bangziak a ka mite, ka tanu damthei lou ahia?
Ka lu tui hi in, ka mit khitui nak hileh aw, ka mi, ka tanu thahte a ding in asun-azan in ka kap ding,
Gamdai ah khualbuk nei thei leng aw! Ka mite paisan in om mangsan leng aw; angkawm hatmi ahi vek ngal ua, khemhat omkhawm lel ahi uh.
Alei uh thalpeu bang in zuau in azang ua, gam ah akhanglian ua, thutak a khang lou in gilou lam ah akhang ua, kei hon thei lou in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Noumau inveng lak ah pilvang chiat unla, na unaute himhim uh muang kei un; unaute lah khemhat ahi ngal ua; invengte leng gensiat hat ahi uh.
Amau inveng chiat akhem ding ua, thudik agen kei ding uh; alei uh zuaugen akisinsak ua, thulimlouhna sem in agim uhi.
Khem hat lak ah na teng a, akhemna uh ziak in kei ahon thei nuam kei uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai un, amau ka tuisuaksak ding a, ka ze-et ding; ka mi, ka tanu ziak in bang dang ahia ka hihtak ding aw?
Alei uh sihna thal ahi a, khemna thu agen zel, mi'n kam in invengte kiang ah kituahna thu gen mahleh, alungtang ah amah atang giugiau hi.
Hiai thilhihte ziak in ka gawt kei dia hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; nam hichibang tung ah phu ka la kei dia hia?

Tangte a ding in ka kap dia, ka mau vungvung ding, gamdai loupa munte ka suun ding a, kuamah pai nawnlouhna ding a akat khit tak ziak in, mite'n ganta husa aza nawnta kei ding ua, tung a leng vasate leh gamsate leng ataikek ua, apaimangta uh.
Huan Jerusalem bel thil sia omkhawm lel in ka bawl dek a, sehalte tenna mun ahi ding; Judah khopite tengmi om lou in ka hingawn ding.
Hiai theisiam ding in mipil kua ahia? Puangkhe ding a TOUPA thugen na sang mi pen kua ahia? Bangziak in ahia gam asiat khit a, kuamah pailouhna ding a gamdai bang a akat khit?
Huan TOUPA'N, "Ka dan, ama ua ka koih apaisan ua, ka paukam suak amang kei ua, azui kei uh,
alungtang khauh uh zui a, apipute un asinsak uh Baalte adelh zawk tak ziak un;
Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, amau, hiai mite mahmah gamsai in ka vak ding a, tui kha leng ka dawnsak ding.
Nam, amau leh apipute un leng atheih ngeilouhte lak ah ka dalhsak ding a; ka hihmanthat vek mateng namsau ka delhsak ding."
Sepaihte' ToUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngaihtuah unla, numei kap mite hong pai ding in sam un, numei kahsiamte hong pai ding in sam lai un.
Hong kin uhenla, hong kahkhum peuhmah le uh, i khitui aluan a, i mitte ua tui apawttheihna ding in.
Zion a kipan kah husa zak ahi ngal a, i naksiat khit takdan uh; gen ding i thei mahmah kei ua, i gam i paisan ziak uleh, i tennate apaihkhiak tak ziak un.
Aw nou numeite aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia unla, akamsuak thu na bil uah lut henla, na tanute uh kah sinsak un; michih in a-invengnu kiang ah suunna la.
I tawlet uahte sihna kal lut in i kumpipa' inn uahte alutta hi; inn polam a kipan naupang hihmang ding leh, kholak a kipan tangval hihmang ding.
TOUPA thupawt in hichi in achi: Mi luangte gamlak ah ekvut bang in apuk ding ua, buh lami buhmaih bang in; kuamah in alakhawm kei ding, chi in.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mipil in apilna suang kei henla mihat in ahatna suang sam kei hen, mihau in asum-le-pai suang kei hen.
Asuang peuhmah in hiai suang hen, Kei TOUPA, zahngaihna, vaihawmdikna, diktatna lei a zangpa ka hi chih atheih a, atheihsiamnatak; hiai thilte ka kipah lam ahi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
Ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, chih Toupa thupawt ahi, zeksum hi ngal, sum louh bang zaw ka gawt ding.
Aigupta, Judah, Edom, Ammon leh Moab, gamdai a teng, baksam metgiaute; hiai nam tengteng zeksumlouhte ahi ngal ua, Israel inkote tengteng leng lungtang a zeksumlouhte ahi uh.
Uz gam ah mi khat a-om a, amin Job ahi; amah mihoihkim leh tang ahi a, Pathian kihta a, hoih lou mudah ahi.
Ama'n tapa sagih leh tanu thum anei hi.
Aneih-le-lam leng belam sangsagih, sangawngsau sangthum, bawngtal zanga leh sabiltungnu zanga leh inkuan thupi mahmah ahi, huchi in hiai mipa suahlam tate tengteng lak a thupipen ahi.
Huan atapate akuan ua khat chiat inn ah, ani ni in ankuangluina anei ua; huchi in mi asawl ua asanggam numei thumte uh amau kiang a ne ding leh dawn ding in asamsak uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-ankuanglui san laitak un, Job in mi asawl a amaute ahihsiangthou a, zingsang beltak in athou a, avek ua zah dungzui in halmang thillatte alan a: Job in, "Ka tapate'n thil ahihkhial un, alungtang un Pathian ahamsiat kha ding uh," achi hi. Hichibang in Job in ahih gige hi.
Huchi in TOUPA ma a Pathian tapate ahong kilak ni uh a-om a, alak uah Setan leng ahong pai hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Leitung langkhat langkhat tawn a, asung a sukvak-touvak ka hi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ka sikha Job na ngaihtuah ngei hia? Amah bang a hoihkim leh mitang, Pathian kihta a hoih lou mudah lei ah lah kuamah a-om ngal kei a," achi hi.
Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Bangmah lou dia Job in Pathian kihta ahi maw?
Amah kimvel in, a-inn kimvel in leh aneih tengteng kimvel in, ning chiteng ah umna na bawl kei maw? Akhut nasep na vualzawl a, gamsung ah aneih-le-lam apung hi.
Himahleh tu in na khut zankhia inla, aneih tengteng khoih in, huchi in na maitang ah nang ahon gense mai ding hi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ngai in, aneih tengteng nang thu ahi; amah mah tung ah kia na khut kha ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA ma a kipan in Setan akuankhia hi.
Huan atapate leh atanute'n a-unaupa uh upapen inn a ne a uain adawn ni uh a-om a,
Job kiang ah sawltak khat hong pai in, "Bawngtalte'n lei alet ua, sabiltungte akiang ah agamta ua,
Sheba mite'n amau adelh ua, apimang uh; ahi, namsau hiam in sikhate athat ua; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
Huchi a thu agen lai in midang khat leng ahong a, "Van a kipan in Pathian mei akia a, belamte leh sikhate akangmang a, amau akangtum hi; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.

Huchi a thu agen lai in, midang khat ahong lai a, "Kaldai mite'n pawl thum abawl ua, sangawngsaute adelh ua, apimang uh, huan namsau hiam in sikhate athat ua; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
Huchi a thu agen lai in, midang khat mah ahong a, "Na tapate leh na tanute'n a-unaupa upapen inn a anek ua uain adawn lai un,
ngai in gamdai a kipan in huih thupi ahong nung a, huai inn ning lite ahon nuai a, tangvalte tung ah achim a, asi uh: huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Job athou a, apuanak- tual abotkek a, asam ametsiang a, leitual kidenna in anei a, Pathian abeta hi.
Ama'n, "Ka nu sul a kipan vuaktang in ka hong a, huan vuaktang in ka kik ding, TOUPA'N apia a, huan TOUPA'N alamangta; TOUPA min phat in om hen," achi hi.
Hiai tengteng ah Job in ahihkhial kei a, haihuaitak in Pathian leng amohsa kei hi.
"Ka kha in ka hinna achimtak a, ka utdan dan in ka phun ding; ka kha thangpaihna in thu ka gen ding.
Pathian kiang ah, Hon mohpaih ke'n; bangziak a hon kinakpih na hia hon theisak in, ka chi ding hi.
Na nuaisiah nang a dia hoih ahi maw, na khutte thilhih na muhsit a, giloute thugen tung a na maitai?
Sa mitte nei na hi hia, ahihkeileh mihing muh bang amu na hi hia?
Na nite mihing nite bang hi a, ahihkeileh na kumte mihing kumte bang,
Ka thulimlouhna na kan a, ka khelhna na nungdelh hi.
Ka gilou kei chih thei napi a, na khut a kipan hon suaktasak ding a-om louh?
"Na khutte'n ahon sek un ahon bawl kimvel sipsip ua; tu'n kihei in na hon hihse dia hia?
Theigige in, ka hon ngen ahi, tungman bang a na hon mekdan; leivui hon tun nawn ding na hi hia?
Nawitui bang in na hon sungkhia in, nawituidat bang in na hon tok kei maw?
Vun leh sa in na hon tuam a, guhte leh thagui in na hon phankhawm hi.
Hinna leh deihsakna na hon phal a, huan na hon vehna in ka kha ahawi hi.
"Himahleh hiai thilte na lungtang sung ah na sel a; hiai bel na tup ahi chih ka thei hi.
Thil ka hihkhelhleh na hon chiamteh a, ka thulimlouhna a kipan na hon khah kei ding hi.
Ka gitlouhleh, ka tung agik hi; midiktat himah leng, ka lutang ka sangsak kei ding hi. Lungbuaina in ka dim a, huaiziak in ka gimthuakna en in.
Ka lutang akiletsakleh, humpinelkai bang in nang na hon beng a, ka tung a na lamdandan na hon ensak nawn hi.
Kei kalh in na palainate na thaksak a, ka tung a na hehna na khangsak a; hon dou ding sepaihhon thak na hon sawl hi.
"Bangziak a sul a pan hon lakhia na hia? Na si in kuamah muh louh na hi leng.
Om lou mah bangta ding hi ing a; sul a pan a han a puak a om ding hi ing.
Ka nite atom kei maw? Huchi ahihleh, tawp in, hon omsak maimai in, huchi a neukha a ka lungmuan theihna ding in.
Ka kik nawnlouhna a ka pai ma in khomialna gam leh sihna limliap gam mahmah ah.
Mialna mah bang a, mialna sahna gam a: sihna limliap gam, dan himhim omlouhna, khovak khomial bang a a- omna mun ah.”
Huan Naamath mi Zophar in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Thu tampite dawn louh ding ahi a hia? Mi houlimna a dim siamtansak ding hia?
Na khemnate'n mite daisak ding hia? na simmoh chiang in, kuamah in nang hon zahlaksak lou ding uhia?
Ka thuhilh asiangthou a, na mit uah ka siang hi, na chi ngal a.
Himahleh Pathian in thugen maizenleh zaw, nang dem in amukte hongleh;
Huchi in pilna thugukte nang ahon ensak ding a, atheihna ah thuah tampi ahi chih, huaiziak in na thulimlouhna sang a tawmzaw na lak ah Pathian in nang ahon phut chih thei in.
"Zon in Pathian na mu thei diam; hoihkimna ah Bangkim hihthei na mu thei diam?
Van bang in asang a; bang na hihthei dia? Sheol sang in athuk a; bang na theithei dia?
Huai a tehna lei sang in asauzaw a, tuipi sang in azazaw hi.
Paisuak henla, man henla, vaihawmna ah samleh, huchi in kua'n amah adal thei dia?
Ama'n lah mi bangmah loute athei ngal a; ngaihtuah kei mahleh, thulimlouhna leng amu hi.
Mihing theihsiamna bei in theihsiamna anei ding, mihing a sabiltungnou apian chiang in.
"Na lungtang na koih dik a, amah lam a na khutte na zakleh;
Na khut a thulimlouhna a-om a, gamlapi a na koihkhiak a, gitlouhna na puanin a na tensak keileh;
Gensiatna ding om lou in na mai na daksak ding a; ahi, na kip ding a, na lau kei ding.
Na haksatna na mangngilh ding ziak in; tui luangmang bang in na theigige ding hi.
Sun lai sang in na hinna achiangzaw ding a; khomial om mahleh, zingsang bang in na tangkhe ding hi.
"Lametna a-om ziak in, na kipta ding hi; ahi, ama tanchin na zong ding a, muang in na khawlta ding hi.
Lup leng na lum ding a, kuamah in nang hon lausak kei ding uhi; ahi, mi tampi'n nang hon zong ding uhi.
Himahleh gilou mitte azuausuak ding a, asuakta kei ding ua, alametna uh kha khah ahi ding hi."
Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Ginlelh vual louh in mite zaw na hi peuhmah ua, nou toh pilna asi ding hi.
Himahleh noute bang in theihsiamna ka nei; nou sang in ka niamzaw kei, ahi, hiaite bang thilte kuan athei kei a?
Kei zaw mi invengte a dia nuihzabuk ka hi a, kei, huai Pathian sam a, huai ama'n amah adawnpa, midik, mihoihkim, nuihzabuk ka na hi.
Om nuam a om ngaihtuahna ah vangsiatna muhsitna a-om a; himahleh akhe uh teute a ding in mansa in a-om hi.
Suamhatte puaninte alohching a, Pathian hehsakte abit ua; akhut a pathian tawite Pathian in tampi apia hi.
"Himahleh gamsate dong in, huchi in amau nang ahon sinsak ding uh; huan huihkhua a vasate'n, nang ahon hilh ding uhi.
Ahihkeileh lei kiang ah thu gen in nang ahon sinsak ding ua; tuipi a ngasate'n na kiang ah apuang ding uhi.
Hiai tengteng ah, TOUPA khut in ahih khin chih kua ahia thei lou?
Amah khut ah thil hing chiteng kha leh, mihing tengteng hatna a-om hi.
Bil in thute enchian in, Kam in ana chiam kei maw?
"Mi upate kiang ah pilna a-om a nite sauna ah theihsiamna a-om hi.
Amah kiang ah pilna leh hatna a-om; ama'n thupha leh theihsiamna anei.
Ngai in, akaipuk a, akilam nawn thei kei ding; mihing akhakbing a, kuama'n ahong thei kei ding.
Ngai in, tui aching a a akang hi; akhahkhia a, lei atum vek hi.
"Akiang ah hatna leh pilna a-om a; khem a omte leh khempa amah a ahi.
Thuhilh mite loh sam in apimang a, huan vaihawmte mihai in abawl hi.
Kumpipate kolte asut a, kawnggak in akawng uh agak hi.
Siampute loh sam in apimang a, mihatte azou hi.
Muan mite thugen asuan a, upate theihsiamna alamang hi.
Lalte tung ah muhsitna abuak a mihatte kawnggak aphel hi.
"Mial a kipan in thil thukte amukhia a, sihna limliap khovak ah ahon lakhia hi.
Namte apungsak a, amau hihsia in, namte athehzak a, alakhawm nawn hi.
Lei a mite hausate lungtang alamang a, gamdai a lampi omlouhna ah amau avakvaisak hi.
Vakna bei in khomial ah amai ua, huchi in zukhammi bang in amaute ahoisak hi.”
Ngai in, ka mit in hiai tengteng amu a, ka bil in huai za in atheisiamta hi.
Na thei uh, huai mah ke'n leng ka thei a, nou sang in ka niamzaw kei hi.
Bangkim hihthei kiang ah thu ka gen mahmah ding, Pathian toh houlim ka ut hi.
Himahleh nou zuau phuakte na hi ua, phattuamna bei damdawisiam na hi vek uhi.
Aw na vek un dai sipsip le uchin maw; na pilna uh hi ding hiven.
"Tu in ka thusut za un, ka mukte ngetna ngaikhia un.
Pathian a ding in dikloutak in thu na gen ding uam, amah a ding in khemhattak in na houlim ding uam?
Ami na zahtak ding uam? Pathian a ding in na sual ding uam?
Nou ahon zonkhiak ahoih hia? Ahihkeileh mi'n mi akhem bang in, amah na khem ding uam?
Nou ahon sal mahmah ding, aguk a mite na zahtak uleh.
Ahoih tungtuanna in nou ahon lausak kei dia hia, nou tung ah akihtakhuaina ake kei diam?
Na thupilte uh vut bang lel ahi, manna bei paunak ahi a, na kidalnate uh tungman kidalnate ahi.
Dai unla, thu ka gentheihna ding in, hon omsak maimai un, ka tung ah ahong tung ding hong tung hen.
"Bangziak a ka ha in ka sa kei a, ka khut a ka hinna koih ding ahia?
Ama'n hon that mahleh, amah ka ngak lai ding; ama ah ka lampite ka kemhoih lailai ding hi.
Hiai leng ka hotdamna ahi ding; Pathian limsakloumi ama a hong pai lou ding ahih ziak in.
Ka thugen thanuamtak in za un, ka thupuanna na bil sung uah om hen.
Ngai un, tu in ka thu ka bawlhoihta a; ka diktat ahi chih ka thei hi.
"Kei hon kiselpih ding amah kua ahia? Kei tu in ka dai dia kha ka khah ding hi.
Ka tung ah thil nih hih kei phot le uchin, huchi in na mai a kipan ka bu kei ding hi.
Kei a pan gamlapi ah na khut kaikik in; na lauhuaina in hon lausak ke'n.
"Huai chiang in hon sam lechin, ka hon dawng ding; ahihkeileh hon pausak inla, hon dawng in.
Ka thulimlouhnate leh khelhnate bang ahia? Ka tatlekna leh ka khelhna hon theisak in.
Bangziak a na mai sel a na melma dia hon bawl na hia?
Singnah mutleng na hihbuai dia hia? Buhpawl keu na delh dia hia?
"Nang lah kei dem in khatak in na gelh a, ka tuailai thulimlouhnate na hon luahsak hi.
Ka khete leng kol na bunsak a, ka lampite tengteng na chiamteh hi; ka khenuai kim ah gi na khung hi.
Mihing zaw thilmuat leh nget nekgawp puansilh bang in amangthang hi."
"Mihing, numei a pan pian nite tomchik ahi a, buaina ngen in adim hi.
Pak bang in ahong dawnkhia a, avuai nawn pah a, limliap bang in atai a, a-om gige kei.
Mi huchibang tung ah na mit hak in, vaihawmna ah kei na hon pi dia hia?
Thilnin a kipan kua'n ahia thilsiang lakhe thei? Kuamah in.
Anite sehsa ahi chih thei in, na kiang ah akhate simna a-om a, akan thei louh ding in agamgite na septa hi.
Amah en ke'n, akhawltheihna ding in, kiloh bang a, ani ahihkim matan.
"Phukpaih in om mahleh, ahong sel nawn ding a, ahiang nou atawp kei ding, chih sing a ding in lametna lah a-om ngal a.
Lei ah azung upa mahleh, akungpi lei ah sita mahleh;
Tuigim ziak in ahong nou thak dia, sing suan bang in bawkte ahon neikhe nawn ding hi.
Mihing asi a, amang zel hi; ahi, mihing in akha akhah a, huan koi ah a-om a?
"Tuipi a kipan tuihute alenmang bang in, luipi bel atul a, akang hi.
Huai mah bang in mihing alum a athou kei hi, vante a-om nawn louh matan, akhanglou kei ding uh, a-ihmu uh leng ahalh khe sam kei ding uhi.
"Aw Sheol ah hon sel lechin aw, na thangpaihna aman masiah hon na gukkep lechin, hun sehsa hon na pia in, kei hon theigige lechin aw;
Mi sileh ahing nawn diam? Ka galdouna leh nasepna ni tengteng ka ngak ding a, ka suahtakna ahong tun matan in.
N'on na sam dia, k'on dawng ding hi, na khut nasep na hon lunggulh ding hi.
Tu in ka kalsuante na sim a: ka khelhnate na chiamteh hi.
Ip sung ah ka tatlekna bilh in ni a-om a, ka thulimlouhna na gonggak hi.
"Tang kipuk bangmah lou ahong hi taktak a, amun a kipan in suangpi suan in a-om hi;
tuite'n suang akiamsak ua; leivui a kibawl mun sangte na taimang a; huan mihing lametna na hihsia hi.
Tangtawn in amah na zou a, apai a; amel na lamdangsak a, na sawlmang hi.
Atapate zah in a-om ua, ama'n athei kei; hihniam in a-om ua, himahleh ama'n amau ahi chih athei kei hi.
Himahleh atung a sa in natna anei a, asung ah akha in asuun hi."
Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Mipil in theihna bangmah lou toh dawnna abawl in, suahlam huih in agilpi adimsak diam?
Houlimna phatuam lou thu angaihtuah in, ahihkeileh hoih ahihtheihlouhna ding a thugente angaihtuah diam?
Ahi, launa na hihmang a, Pathian ma a kipiakzohna na dal lai hi.
Na kam in na thulimlouhna asinsak a, khemhatmi lei na tel ngal a.
Nang mahmah kam in siam louh ahon tangsak a, kei hilou in; ahi, nang dem in nangmah mukte mah in hon theihpih hi.
"Mihing piang masapen hi hia? Ahihkeileh mualte om ma a lakkhiak na hi maw?
Pathian thuguk na zata hia? Huan pilna na kikoih hoih hia?
Ka theih louh uh bang na thei a? kou a om lou bang na theisiam a?
Ka lak uah samkang leh upa mahmah a-om tuaktuak, na pa sang a nakpi a upazaw.
"Pathian nepnate leh siamtak a hon hilhte nang a dia neu lua uhia?
Bangziak a na lungtang in nang hon pimang ahia? Bangziak a na mitte phia ahia?
Huchi a Pathian dem a na lungsim na hei a, na kam a pan a huai thute na pawtkhiaksak.
"Mihing bang ahia, asian ding? Numei a pan piang amah kua ahia diktat ding?
Ngai in, amisiangthoute ah muanna anga kei a; amitmuh in vante asiang kei uhi.
Mikihhuai leh sia, tui bang a thulimlouhna dawnmi, siang kei sem na in chia.
"K'on ensak ding, hon za in; huan ka muhsa ka puang ding.
Mipil kuate in ahia apipute ua kipan na thu gen a, a-iim louh uh.
Amau kiang kia ah gam piak in a-om a, mikhual kuamah alak uah apai kei uh.
"Migilou in adamsung niteng in natna athuak a, nuaisiah hatmi a dia kholkhawm kumte zah mah.
Abil ah launa ging a-om a; hauh lai in lokmi atung ah ahong pai ding hi.
Khomial a kipan ahong kik ding chih a-um kei a, namsau a ngak in a-om hi.
Tanghou zong in avakvai a, Koi a om ahia? chi in. Khomial ni akiangchin ah mansa in a-om chih athei hi.
Dahna leh haksatna in amah alausak a; kumpipa galdou dia mansa bang in, amah azou uhi.
"Pathian dou ding a khut alikkhiak ziak in, Bangkim hihthei dou a kisatheitak in,
alum, atuamna sahtak nei toh amah dou a atai teitei ziak in;
athau in amaitang akhuh a, agil ah thau akholkhawm hi.
"Khopi tulsa ah ateng a, kuamah ten tuaklouhna innte ah, segawp ngiingei dingte aluah ziak in.
Ahau kei ding a, aneih-le-lam a-om gige kei ding a; amah lei ah zung akai kei ding.
Khomial a kipan asuakta kei ding a, meikuang in aselnoute akangkeu ding a, apaklun laite amutmang ding.
Amah kikhem in, bangmah lou ah muang kei hen: bangmah lou lah athukna hi ding ahi ngal a.
"Ahun ma in hihzoh in a-om dia, huan ahiang nou kei ding hi.
Grepgui bang in agah min lou asingpulh dia, olive bang in apak apaikhe ding.
Pathian limsak lou kithuahkhawmna hut ding ahi a, golhna puaninte lah mei in akangmang ding hi.
Siatna apai ua, thulimlouhna asuakkhesak uh, alungtang un khemna a- nopkeuh uhi.
Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Huchibang thil tampi ka zata hi: lungmuanmi chimtakhuai ngen na hi uh.
Thu bangmah loute'n tawp hun anei ding uam? Ahihkeileh dawng ding a nang hon hihheh bang ahia?
Nou bang in kei leng ka pau thei sam hi; na kha uh ka kha mun a om hileh, noute dem a thute kaikhawm a, ka lu hon sinkhum thei ding hi veng in.
Himahleh ka kam in nou ka hon hatsak ding a, ka muk a muanna in na lungkhamna uh ka hon nem ding.
"Thu gen mah leng, ka dahna nep in a-om kei a: doh mah leng, hihnop in ka om a hia?
Himahleh ahon chimtaksakta a; ka lawmte tengteng na hihgamta hi.
Huan kiptak in na hon len a, huai kei demna theihpihna ahi: huchi in ka gawnna kei dem in athou a, ka maitang ah atheisak hi.
"Ahehna in kei ahon botkek a, ahon sawi hi; aha ahon gawikhum a: ka tung ah ka gal in amit atat- hiam hi.
Akam uh lianpi in ahon katkhum ua; simmohtak in ka biang ah ahon beng ua; kei dou ding in akikaikhawm uh.
Pathian in Pathian limsakloute kiang ah ahon pekhia a, migiloute khut ah ahon paikhia hi.
Om nuam in ka om a, himahleh ahon kitamsak a; ahi, ka ngawng in ahon man a, hon pai nen hi; amuitum ding in ahon tungtou hi.
Athalkap mite'n ka kimvel ah ahon um ua, ka sisan guite abottan a, ahawi kei; lei ah ka sinkha asungkhia hi.
Siatna tung ah siatna in ahon sesak a; galhat bang in ka tung ah atai hi.
Ka vun tung ah sai-ip ka khui a, leivui ah ka kingata hi.
Kahna in ka mai ahoihta kei a, ka mitvunte ah sihna limliap a-om hi.
Ka khut ah hiamgamna om kei mahleh, ka thumna siangthou mahleh.
"Aw leitung, ka sisan khuh ke'n, huan ka kahna in mun nei kei hen.
Tu mahmah in, ngai in, van ah kei hon theihpihpa a-om a, tungsang ah kei hon genpihpa a-om hi.
Ka lawmte'n hon nuihsan ua, himahleh ka mit in Pathian ah khituite asungkhia hi.
"Huchi a Pathian lak a mihing dikna aletkip theih a, invengte lak a mihing tapa dikna aletkip theihna ding in.
Kum tawmchik ahong tun chiang in, ka kik nawnlouhna ding lampi ah ka paita ding hi."
"Ka lungsim hihgawp in a-om a, ka nite abei a, kei a ding in han mansa in a-om hi.
Ka kiang ah musit mite a-om taktak ua, ahehna uah ka mit a-om gige hi.
Tu in thuchiam hon pia in, nangmah toh kei a ding in moh khu hong hi in; kei toh khutte beng ding kua a-om a?
Theihsiamna a kipan alungtang uh na sel ngal a; huaiziak in amau na hihlian kei ding hi.
"Kuapeuh mat ding a alawmte hek a, aneih-le-lam tan tummi, atate nangawn mit azuausuak ding hi.
Mite houlimna ding in ahon bawl lai a; huchi in tangpi kih ka hong hita hi.
Lungkhamna ziak in ka mit leng amial a, ka hiangte tengteng limliap bang ahi.
Midikte'n hiai ah lamdang asa ding ua, mihoih Pathian limsakloute dou ding in akitokthou ding.
Himahleh midiktat alampi ah apang zouzou dia, kuapeuh khut siangneite ahat semsem ding uhi.
Himahleh hong kik un, na vek un, tu in hong un; huchi in na lak uah mipil ka mu kei ding.
"Ka nite abeita, ka thiltupte asegawpta hi, ka lungtang ngaihtuahte tan in.
Zan, sun in akheng ua; khovak in khomial anaih, achi uh.
Ka inn bang in Sheol en leng: khomial ah ka lupna phah taleng:
siatna kiang ah, 'Ka pa na hi,' chi leng; tangtel kiang ah, 'Ka nu leh ka sanggamnu na hi,' chi leng;
huchi hileh ka lametna koi a om ahia? Lamet nei hi leng kua'n ahon musak dia?
Sheol mundaite ah paisuk in leivui ah ka kikkhawm ding ua adiam?"
Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Thute zong a bang tan thang kam ding na hi ua? Ngaihtuah in, huai zoh chiang in ka pau ding uh.
Bangziak a gamsa bang a sim a om a, na mitmuh ua siang lou ka hi ua?
Nang na hehna kipumpei ziak in lei mangngilh in a-om diam? Ahihkeileh amun a kipan in suangpi suankhiak in a-om diam?
"Ahi, migilou vakna mihsak in a-om ding a, amei-ek atang kei ding.
Apuanin ah vakna amial dia, atung a khawnvak mihsak ahi ding.
Ahatna kalsuante hihtuailuai ahi dia, amah thupha gen in apaikhe ding hi.
Amah khe mahmah in len sung ah amah apailut ua, len ah a-awksak hi.
Thang in akhetul ah aman dia, thang in amah alen ding hi.
Lei ah amah a ding in thangkual sel in a-om a, lampi ah amah a ding in thang.
"Kihtakhuaite'n ning chiteng ah amah alausak dia, A akhetul ah adelhzui ding hi.
Ahatna gilkial nek in a-om dia, akhawlna ding in mansa in tuahsiatna a-om ding.
Apumpi hiangte anegai ding a, ahi, ahiangte sihna ta masapen in anegai ding hi.
Asuan apuanin a kipan zungkalhkhiak in a-om dia lauhuainate kumpipa kiang a pi in a-om ding hi.
Amah a hilou puanin ah teng a-om ding, atenna ah kat thehzak in a-om ding hi.
"Nuailam ah azungte akeu dia, tunglam ah ahiang satkhiak ahi ding.
Lei a kipan in atheihgige amangthang ding; kongzing ah min anei kei ding.
Khovak a kipan in khomial ah hawllut ahi ding a, khovel a kipan a delhkhiak.
Amite lak ah tapa anei kei dia, tute leng atenna ah kuamah om lai a-om kei ding hi.
"Amalam a omte'n ani lamdang asa ding uh; nunglam a omte hihlau a a-om bang un.
Huchibang midiktatloute tennate ahi petmah a, Pathian theiloumi mun ahi hi."
Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Bang tan ka kha hihbuai a, thute a hon hihzan gawp ding na hi ua?
Hiai sawmvei na hon kouta ua; ka tung a giloutak a na hih uh na zum kei uh.
Ana paikhial taleng maw, keimah kiang a ka diklouhna a-om gige hi.
Kei dem in nou kiliansak petmah ve ni uchin, ka minsiatna ka tung ah na gen ding ua,
Pathian in ka thu ah hon zouta chih tu in thei un, huchi in alen in ahon umsuak hi.
"Ngai un, 'Hiamgamna,' chi in ka kikoukhia a, himahleh zak in ka om kei, panpih deih in ka kikou a, himahleh vaihawmna a-om kei hi.
Ka pai theihlouhna ding in ka lampi a-um a, ka paina dingte ah khomial akoih hi.
Ka thupina hon suahsak a, ka lu a kipan lallukhu alakhia hi.
Ning chiteng ah ahon hihniam a, ka mangta hi; huchi in sing bang in ka lametna abotkhia hi.
Ka tung ah ahehna leng asou a, amah a ding in agalte lak a khat bang in ahon sim hi.
Asepaih pawlte ahong kuankhawm ua, ka siatna ding in alampi uh abawl ua ka puanin kimvel in puanin akai uhi.
"Kei a pan in ka unaute gamlapi ah akoih a, ka meltheihte kei a pan in atuam vekta uh.
Ka tanaute'n ahon zuausan ua, ka lawm theihngeite'n ahon mangngilhta uhi.
Ka inn tengte leh, ka sikhanute'n, mikhual ahon sa ua: amitmuh un namdangmi ka hi.
Ka sikha ka sam a, hon dawng kei, ka kam in amah khem mah leng.
Ka zi a ding in ka hu kihhuai ahi a, sanggamte ziak in pumpi hahsiang mah leng ka namsia hi.
Naupang neute nangawn in hon simmoh ua; ka thohleh, ka siatna ding in thu agen uhi.
Ka lawm thudotte'n kei ahon hua ua, amau ka itte ka tung ah ahel uhi.
Ka vun ah leh ka sa ah ka guh abelh bikbek a, ka ha vun toh ka suakta hi.
Hon hehpih un, hon hehpih un, Aw nou ka lawmte; Pathian khut in kei ahon khoihta ngal a.
Bangziak a Pathian bang a nou hon sawi na hi ua, ka sa a bangziak a lungkim lou na hi ua?
"Aw ka thute tu in gelh in om le uh aw; Aw laibu ah kigelh lutleh aw.
Sik leh ngen gelhna zum in tangtawn a ding in suangpi a gelh hi le uh aw;
Ka Tanpa ahing chih leh, atawp chiang in leitung ah adingh nawn ding chih ka theih ziak in.
Ka vun huchibang a hihsiat a a-om khit nung in, himahleh ka sa a kipan Pathian ka mu ding hi.
Keimah a ding in amah kei mahmah in ka mu dia, ka mitte'n a-en ding, midang hilou in; ka sung ah ka lungtang asidang hial hi!
"Amah bangchibang in i sawita phet ding uam, na chih uleh, kei ah thubul muh in a-om chih thei in.
Namsau kihta un; hehna in lah namsau gawtnate ahon tun ngal a, huchi a vaihawmna a-om chih na theihtheihna ding un."
TOUPA Pathian tapate ahong kilak ni uh a-om nawn a, huan TOUPA ma a kilak ding in alak uah Setan leng ahong pai hi.
TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Leitung langkhat langkhat tawn a, asung a sukvak-touvak ka hi," achi hi.

Huan TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ka sikha Job na ngaihtuah ngei hia? Amah bang a hoihkim leh mitang, Pathian kihta a hoih lou mudah lei ah lah kuamah a-om ngal kei a; ama siatna ding in hon tangsak mah lechin, aginomna alen tinten hi," achi hi.
Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Vun sik in vun, ahi, mihing in aneih tengteng hinna sik in ape ding hi.
Himahleh tu in na khut kha inla, aguh leh asa khoih lechin, na maitang ah nang hon gense ding hi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ngai in, amah na khut ah a-om hi; ahinna lel hawi in," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA ma a kipan in Setan apawtkhia a, meimatum in akhepek nuai a kipan aluzang tan in Job agawt hi.
Huchi in ama'n kikhuatna ding in belpei ala a; meivu lak ah atu hi.
Huai lai in azi in akiang ah, "Na ginomna len tinten lailai na hi hia? Pathian gensia inla, si in," achi hi.

Himahleh akiang ah, "Numei hai thugente lak a khat bang in thu na gen a. Bang ahia? Pathian khut ah hoih i mu dia, hoih lou leng i mu kei dia hia?" achi hi. Hiai tengteng ah Job in amuk in thil ahihkhial kei hi.

Huchi a Job lawm thumte'n atung a hiai hoih lou hong tung tengteng azak un, michih ama mun a kipan in ahong ua: Teman mi Eliphaz, Shuah mi Bildad leh Naaman mi Zophar, amah kah ding leh amah lungmuan ding in hohkhawm ding in hun seh abawl uhi.
Huchi a gamlapi a pan adaktouh uleh, amah athei kei ua, nakpi in akikoukhia ua, akapta uhi. Apuanaktual uh michih in abotkek ua, alutang uah van lam ah leivui akibuak uhi.
Huchi in akiang ah leitual ah ni sagih leh zan sagih atu ua, akiang ah kuamah in thu khat leng agen kei uh; alungkhamna anasa mahmah chih amu uhi.
Huan Naamath mi Zophar in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Huaiziak in ka ngaihtuahnate'n kei dawnna ahon pia a, ka sung a om ka kinohna thu ziak mahmah in.
Kei hon zahlaksak salhna ka zata a, ka theihsiamna kha in ahon dawng hi.
"Leitung a mihing a-om nungsiah, hun lui thu hiai na thei kei maw;
Giloute vualzohna atom a, Pathian limsakloute nopsakna mitphiat kal sung lel ahi chih?
Ahoihkimna in vante suntou in, alu in meipite phatou mahleh;
Himahleh amah ek bang in tangtawn in amangthang ding a, 'Koi a om ahia?' Amah mute'n achi ding uh.
Mang bang in alengmang dia, muh in a-om kei ding hi; ahi, zan mengmuh bang in hawlmang in a-om ding hi.
Amah mu mit in amah amuta kei ding hi; amun in leng amah amuta kei ding hi.
Atate'n gentheite deihsakna azong ding ua, akhutte'n athil hoih ape nawn ding hi.
"Atuailai hatna in aguhte dim mahleh, leivui ah amah toh alum ding uhi.
Akam ah gitlouhna khum in alei nuai ah sel mahleh;
Sit in, paisak kei in, akam ah kem gige zou mahleh;
Agil a an akitok a, asung ah gulgu bang in akha hi.
Hauhsaknate anawmvalh a, alokhe nawn ding hi. Pathian in agilpi a kipan in apaikhe ding hi.
Sokval gu atawp dia, gulngan in amah athat ding.
Luipite, khuaizu leh nawituidat lui luangte a-en kei ding hi.
Sepgim gah ape nawn dia anawmvalhsuk kei ding a; amuhsa ah kipahna anei kei ding.
Ama'n lah gentheite anuaisiah a, amangngilh hi; alam louhpi inn hiamgamtak in alata uhi.
Adeihgawlna in huntawk anei kei a akipahpih thil himhim akhol kei ding.
Anekgaih louh bangmah om lai a-om kei hi; huaiziak in ahauhna in adaih sawt kei ding.
Ahauh san lai in haksa sakna anei dia, thulimloumi khut ahong tung ding hi.
Agilpi hihdim ding a akisak lai in, Pathian in atung ah athangpaihna kihtakhuaina akhe ding a, anek lai in atung ah azusak ding hi.
Sik galvan a kipan atai dia, dal thal in amah akap pailet ding.
Adokkhia a, apumpi a kipan in ahong paikhia; ahi, asinkha a pan amukzumte velvel hong paikhia a launate atung ah ahong tung hi.
Agou ding in mialna tengteng kholkhawm in a-om; mei mut louh in amah anegai ding; apuanin a nutsiat a om anegai ding hi.
Vante'n abohsiatna ataklang ding ua, lei amah dou ding in athou ding.
A-inn a punna apaimang dia, aheh ni in avante aluangmang ding hi.
"Hiai Pathian a pan a migilou tantuan ahi, agouluah dia Pathian in asehsak."
Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Ka thugen hoihtak in ngaikhia unla, hiai na khamuanna thu uh hi hen.
Hon thuak teitei unla, ka hon gen ding a, ka gen khit chiang in nuihsan na ni uteh.
"Kei phunna mihing tung ah hia? Bangziak a kuhkal lou a om lou ding ka hia?
Hon en unla, lamdang sa unla, khut in na kam uh hum un.
Ka ngaihtuah in ka lung adong a, linna in ka sa aman nak.
"Bangziak in ahia migilou ahin a, tekkun a adam a, ahong thupikhiak?
Asuante uh akiang uah amitmuh uah ahihkip a, agil ua gahte amai ma uah.
A-inkuante uh lauhuai lak ah abit a, atung uah Pathian chiang ake kei hi.
Abawngtal un chi akhah a, ahut ngei kei, abawngpi un nou anei a, anou ase ngei kei.
Ganhon bang in ataneute uh apawtsak ua, atate uh alam uh.
Apekging uleh kaihging toh kituak in la asa ua, atamngai ging uah akipak uh.
Anite uh lamzangtak in azang ua, lungmuang in Sheol ah apaisuk uh.
"Pathian kiang ah, 'Hon paisan in, na lampite theih ka kilawp kei uh.
Bangkim hihthei bang a ahih, a-nna ka sep ding uh, akiang a ka thum un punna bang a ka muh ding uh?' achi uhi.
Ngai in, alamzanna uh akhut ua om ahi kei a hia? Migilou lemtheihna kei a kipan a gamlapi a om ahi.
"Migilou meisel bangzah vei amit a, vangtahna atung ua atun a, Pathian in athangpaihna in lungkhamna apiak chiat?
Bangzah vei ahia buhpawl huih mut bang ahih ua, buhsi huihpi mutmang bang ahih uh?
"Pathian in gitlouhnate atate uh a ding in akholkhawm, na chi ua, amau tung ah tungsak le ake; atheihsiamna ding un.
Amau mit ngei in asiatna uh mu uhenla, Bangkim hihthei thangpaihna dawn uhen.
Aman nung in a-inn uh amau a ding in bang a ahih, akha zah uh hihtawp ahih nung in?
Kua'n ahia Pathian theihna sinsak ding? ama'n sangpi a omte vai ahawmsak ngal a.
"Alut lai in mi asi a, nuam leh bit lai in.
Anawite nawizu in adim a, aguhngekte thau in adim hi.
Midang lungkhamtak in asi a, Nuamsa a a-an chiam ngei lou in.
Vut lak ah kibang in alum ua, than in apumtuam hi.
Ngai in, na ngaihtuah uh ka thei, dikloupi a ka tung a na sawmte uh.
'Koi ah ahia kumpi inn a-om, migilou tenna puanin koi ah a-om a?' na chi uh.
"Zinzin mite na dong ngei kei ua hia? Agente uh na pom kei ua hia?
Migilou vangtah ni in hawi in a-om a, thangpaih ni in hotkhiak in a- om, chih.
Kua ahia amaitang a alampi pulak ding, kua ahia athilhih bang a amah din ding?
Han lam a puak ahih in, ahan ven ahi.
Lui phaizang a leitang amah a ding in anuam a; mi tengteng in amah nung azui ua, amah ma a na paite sim seng louh ahi uh.
Bangchi in thu mumal omloupi a hon khamuan ding na hia? Na dawnnate uah zuauthu lou ngal bangmah a-om kei hi."
Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz in hichi in achi:
"Pathian a ding in mihing aphatuam thei diam? Kuapeuh apil amah mah a ding in aphatuam ngei a.
Na diktat, Bangkim hihthei a ding a kipahna ahi a hia? Ahihkeileh na lampite na hoihkimsak, amah a dia punna hia?
Nang ahon salha, vaihawmna a nang toh alut, amah na kihtak ziak hia?
Na gitlouhna alian kei maw? Na thulimlouhna ah leng tawpna a-om sam kei hi.
"Bangmah lou ding in na unau thuchiamte na la a, vuaktangte puansilh na suahsak hi.
Bahte a ding in dawn ding tui na pe kei a, gilkial a ding in tanghou na it hi.
Himahleh mihat in gam anei a; asung ah ami deihthoh ateng hi.
Khutvuak in meithaite na sawlmang a, pabeite khutte hihtan in a-om hi.
Huaiziak in na kim ah thangte a-om ua, lauguihna in nang ahon hihbuai hi.
Ahihkeileh khomial, na muh theih louh, leh tui tampi in nang ahon khuh hi.
"Van sang ah Pathian a-om kei a hia? Aksite sandan en in, sang hi na tel uh e;
Nang, 'Pathian in bang athei a? Khomial bikbek ah vai ahawm thei dia hia?
Ama'n hon muhlouhna ding a, meipi sah in liah a, van dum khen a vak ahi,' na chi hi.
Migiloute totsa lampi lui na kem ding hia?
Ahun ma ua lakmang a-om a, akingakna ua tui luang bang a butkhiak a omte.
Pathian kiang a, 'Hon paimangsan in; huan ei a ding in Bangkim hihthei in bang ahihthei a?' chite.
Himahleh a-innte uh thil hoih in adimsak ua, himahleh migiloute thugen kei a kipan agamla hi.
Midiktatte'n amu ua, akipak uh; mihoihte'n amau anuihsan ua,
Chihtaktak in ei dou ding a thoute satkhiak in a-om ua, amaute lak a khosuaksunte mei in ahulta," chi in.
"Tu in amah kimeltheihpih inla, muangtak in om in. Huai ah hoih na kiang ah ahong pai ding hi.
Akam a kipan in dan sang in, ka hon ngen hi, na lungtang ah athute kholkhawm in.
Bangkim hihthei kiang a na kik nawnleh, lamkip na hi ding; na puaninte a kipan gamlapi ah diktatlouhna na koihmang ding ahi.
Huan na gou leivui ah koih inla, luite suangte lak ah Ophir dangka-eng;
Bangkim hihthei na gou ahi dia, dangka manpha nang a ding in
Bangkim hihthei ah kipak in, Pathian kiang ah daktou ding na hih ziak in.
Amah kiang ah na thum ding a, ama'n hon na za ding a, na thuchiam na tangtun ding hi.
Thil khat tung ah thupukna bawl in thu na pe dia, nang a ding in hihkip in a-om ding; huchi in na lampite ah khovak atang ding hi.
Ahon sawnpuk chiang un, 'Thohtouhna a-om,' na chi ding. Hihniam a omte ama'n ahondam ding hi.
Ama'n ahoih lou nangawn asuaktasak ding a; ahi, na khutte sianna ziak in amah suahtaksak in a-om ding."
Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
Tuni mahmah in ka phunna helhuai ahi, ka mauna sang in ka thuakna agikzaw hi.
Aw amah ka muhna mun thei leng la, atutna mahmah ah hoh thei leng aw!
Ama ah ka thu ka bawlhoih dia, thugente in ka kam dimsak ding hi veng.
Ahon na dawnna ding thute ka thei dia, huchi in bang ahia ka kiang a agen ding ka theisiam ding.
Athilhihtheihna thupina in kei ahon sel diam? Ii, himahleh kei hon hatsak ding hi.
Huai ah midik in amah thu asutpih thei dia; huchi in ka vaihawmmi a pan suahtaksak in ka om tawntungta ding hi.
"Ngai in, mailam zuan in ka pai a, himahleh huai ah a-om kei; nunglam zuan in, himahleh amah ka mu kei hi.
Veilam pang ah, na sep lai in, himahleh amah ka mu thei kei a; taklam pang ah abu, amah ka muh theihlouhna ding in.
Himahleh ka zuih lampi athei a; ahon ze-et lai in, dangka-eng bang in ka hon suakkhe ding hi.
Ka khe in akalsuante alenkip a; alampite ka zuita a, ka pial kei hi.
Amukte thupiak a kipan ka paikik kei a, akam a thute akiphamoh ka an sang in ka kholkhawm zaw hi.
"Himahleh amah lungsim khek lou ahi a, amah kua'n ahei thei dia? Akha in adeih, huai mah ahih zel hi.
Kei a dia sehsa ahih ngal a; thil huchibang tampi akiang ah a-om hi.
Huaiziak in a-omna ah ka buai a; ka ngaihtuah chiang in amah ka lau hi.
Pathian in ka lungtang abahsakta a, Bangkim hihthei in ahon hihbuaita hi.
Khomial ma in satkhiak in ka om ngal kei a, ka mai a kipan khomial sah leng akhuh sam kei hi.”
"Bangziak a Bangkim hihthei in vaihawmna hunte bawl lou ahia? Amah theite'n bangziak a anite mu lou uh ahia?
"Gamgi suan a-om ua; hiamgamtak in ganhon alamang ua, avak uhi.
Pabeite sabiltung ahawlmang ua, thuchiamna ding in meithai bawngtal ala uh.
Lampi a kipan tasamte aheikhia ua; lei a gentheite akiselkhawm uhi.
"Ngai in gamkeu a sabiltungte bang in athilhihna lam uah, an thanuamtak a zong in apaikhia ua, atate uh a ding in gamdai in amau an asuaksak hi.
Gam lam ah agan an a-at ua; migiloute grep gah ala uh.
Zankhua in puan bei in vuaktang in alum ua, khovot ah khuhna nei lou in.
Tangte vuahpi in amaute akawt ua, belh ding deih man in suangpi akawi uhi.
"Pa neiloute nawi a kipan kaikhia a-om ua, huan, gentheite thuchiam la in.
Huchi in tasamte puan bei in vuaktang in avialvak ua, buhphalte gilkial in apua uhi.
