Olive a pan sathau abawl ua; a-uain sukna uh achil ua, himahleh adangtak uhi.
Khopi a kipan mite amau ua, liamte kha akikoukhia ua; Pathian in alimsak kei hi.
"Hiaite khovak tung a helte lak a ahi ua; huai lampite athei kei ua, alampite ah a-om gige sam kei uhi.
Khovak tung in tualthatmi athou a, gentheite leh tasamte athat a; ahi, zan in guta bang in a-om hi.
Ang kawm mi mit in leng khomui angak a, kuamah in hon mu kei ding, chi in amai abawl lamdang hi.
Khomial in innte avut pailet ua, sun chiang in akikhumbilh ua; khovak athei kei uh.
Amaute tengteng a ding in zingsang sihna limliap bang ahi a; zan mial lauhuaite lawm in anei uhi."
"Tuite tung ah kintak a taihmang in a-om ua, atantuan uh lei ah hamsiat in a-om; agrephuante sukmi in anaih kei.
Khokhal leh nisa in vuk tuite atawpkang a, huai mah bang in thil hihkhialte Sheol in ahih hi.
Sul in amah amangngilh dia; than in limsatak in amah kivakna in anei ding uh; theihgige in a-omta kei dia, diktatlouhna sing bang a hihtan in a-om ding.
“Ta nei lou numei ching anegai a; meithai a ding in hoih ahih kei hi.
Ahi a lah Pathian in athilhihtheihna in mihatte adomkang a, hinna alamet phak louh lai un adingtou uh.
Bitna Pathian in amaute apia a, huchi in huai ah akhawl uh; alampite uah amitte a-om hi.
"Hihlet in a-om. ua; himahleh sawt lou kal in, abei uhi; ahi, sukniam in a-om ua, midang tengteng bang in lampi a kipan lakkhiak in a-om-ua, buhvui bang in atkhiak in a-om uhi.
Huchibang na hi kei taleh kua ahia zuauthei a hon chian a, ka thugen bangmah lou suah ding?"
Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Pathian kiang ah lalna leh launa a-om; ama'n amun sangte ah muanna abawl hi.
"Asepaihhonte kua'n asim seng dia? Kua tung ah ahia avakna tanlouhna a om?
Huchi ahih chiang in Pathian ma ah bangchi in mihing adik thei dia? Ahihkeileh amah numei suan bangchi in asiang thei dia?
Ngai in, khapi nangawn in vakna anei kei a, amitmuh in aksite asiangthou kei hi.
"Mihing, tangtel sang a bangzah a neuzaw? Pathian mitmuh ah mihing bangchi phet ahi diam, mihing tapa, lungnou leltak!"
Huan Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Thilhihtheihna nei lou amah bangchi a panpih in; hatna nei lou ban bangchidan a hondam thei na hia?
Pilna nei lou amah bangchi in na thuhilh a, nakpitak a theihna hoih na puangkheta a;
Kua kiang ah ahia thute na genkhiak? Kua kha ahia nang a kipan hong paikhia?"
"Sisate leh huai a tengte tuite nuai a kipan ahi uh.
Ama ah Sheol vuaktang in a-om a, Abaddon in kikhuhna anei kei hi.
Ama'n mal mun awng ah aphalhkhia a, bangmah lou tung ah lei akhai hi.
Ameipi sah in tuite atun a; anuai ah meipi akikek kei hi.
Ama'n laltutphah mai akhuh a, atung ah ameipi aphalh hi.
Tuite tung ah, khovak leh khomial kigitna ah, kawlmong akaikual hi.
Asalhna ah van khuamte aling ua, lamdang asa uh.
"Athilhihtheihna in tuipi akhawlsak a, huan atheihsiamna in Rahab asat hi.
Ahu in vante bawlhoih in a-om a; akhut in gulpi kinoh tai lai abawl hi.
Ngai in, hiaite a thilhih among lel ahi uh. Ngatchik a ahuau siausiau lel! Athilhihtheihna van-ging kua ahia theisiam ding?"
Huchi in Job in agentehna thu apan nawn a, hichi in achi:
"Pathian ahin bang in, ama'n ka dikna alamang a; Bangkim hihthei in, ama'n ka kha ahihbuaia;
Ka sung a ka hinna a-om lai teng, Pathian hu ka nakvang a a-om lai teng?
Ka mukte'n thutak lou agen kei ding, ka lei in leng khemna thu agen kei ding.
Siam ka hon tangsak kei ding a, ka sih ma kei a pan ka dikna ka koihmang kei ding.
Ka diktatna ka len tinten a, ka khah kei ding hi, ka dam lai teng ka lungtang in kei hon kou kei ding.
"Ka melma gilou bang hi henla, kei dou ding a thou midiktat lou bang hi hen.
Punna muta mahleh, Pathian limsakloumi lametna, Pathian in akha alakmang ngal in, bang ahia?
Atung a buaina atun in, Pathian in akikou aza diam?
Bangkim hihthei ah nuam asa in, chik lai peuh in Pathian sap nuam asa diam?
"Pathian khut tungtang ah nang ka hon sinsak ding; Bangkim hihthei kiang a om ke'n ka iim kei ding hi.
Ngai un, noute tengteng in huai na muta ua; ahih ngalleh, bangziak a bangmah lou hong hi na hi ua?"
"Hiai Pathian lak a migilou tantuan leh, nuaisiah hat mite goutan, Bangkim hihthei a pan amuh uh ahi.
Atate apun uleh, namsau a ding ahi; huan asuan tanghou in atai kei ding hi.
Anung a omlaite hi leng in avui dia, ameithaite un kahna abawl kei ding uh.
Leivui bang a dangka vum in, tungman bang in puansilh bawl mahleh;
Abawl thei, himahleh midikte'n asilh ding ua, mihoihte'n dangka pen ahawm ding uh.
Maimomlen bang in inn alam a, vengmi in abawl aidakbuk bang lel ahi.
Hausa in alum a, himahleh khop in a-om kei ding; amit ahak a, huan amah a-om kei.
Tuite bang in launate'n amah apha a; zan in huihpi in amah agumang hi.
Suahlam huih in amah apomang a, apaimang hi; huchi in amun a kipan in amah amutmang hi.
"Pathian in amah nakpi in alawn dia, adawm kei ding; akhut a pan ataimang ding hi.
Mite'n amah akhut uh abetkhum ding ua, amun a kipan in amah anuihsan ding uhi."
"Chihtaktak in dangka a ding in khuk a-om a ahihsiang uh dangka-eng a ding in mun.
Lei a pan in sik akilakhia a, suang a kipan in dal akisungkhia hi.
Mihing in khomial phak tawp aneisak a, bukimna azongkhia hi; khomial leh sihna lim phak tawp tan in.
Mite omlouhna ah kokhuk lutna hawm atouvang ua, mite a pan gamla ah akikhai ua, lehlam lehlam ah akivei uh.
Lei ahihleh, huai a kipan in tanghou ahong suak a; anuai ah mei ahih bang in akilumlet hi.
Huai suangte sapphir suang mun ahi a dangka-eng nen anei hi.
Huai lampi sasial ne vasa in athei kei a, mu-akla mit in leng amu ngei sam kei hi.
Gamsa kisatheite'n asik kha ngei kei ua, humpinelkai lun lai leng huai ah apai kha nai kei hi.
"Meisah suangpi tung ah akhut akoih a; azung in mualte alumlet hi.
Suangpite lak ah tuilam ahong a; amit in thil manpha chiteng amu hi.
Atakkhiaklouhna ding un lui luangte atuam a; thil kisel khovak ah ahon lakhia hi.
Himahleh koi lai ah apilna akimu dia? Theihsiamna koi lai a om ahia?
"Mihing in alampi athei kei; mihing gam ah leng muh in a-om kei.
Thukna in, 'Kei ah a-om kei,' achi a, tuipi in, 'Ka kiang ah a-om kei,' achi hi.
Dangka-eng a lei theih ahi kei a, huai man ding in dangka buk theih ahi kei hi.
Ophir dangka-eng toh amanphatna teh theih ahi kei ding, Onik mantam hiam Sapphir toh hiam.
Dangka-eng leh limlang in akimpih thei kei ua, huai khenna ding in dangka-eng hoih leh suangmantam leng ahi thei kei ding hi.
Suang dum hiam suang muh paisuak theih akigen kei ding, Ahi, pilna man rubi suang sang in asangzaw hi.
Ethiopia topaz suang in apha kei dia, dangka-engtak toh leng amanphatna teh ding ahi kei.
"Ahihleh pilna koi a kipan a hong pai ahia? Theihsiamna koi a om ahia?
Mihing tengteng mit a kipan a sel ahi chih leh, huihkhua a vasate a kipan sitsa a om ahi chih thei in.
Abaddon leh Sihna in, 'Huai a thuthang ka bil un ka za uh,' achi uhi.
Pathian in huai alampi atheisiam a, amun athei hi.
Lei mong tan in a-en ngal a, van nuai thil tengteng amu hi.
Huih a ding a gikna apiak lai in leh tuite tehna a ateh lai in;
Vuah a ding a thupiak abawl a, vanpiging khophia a dia lampi abawl lai in;
Huai lai in ama'n amu a, apuang a; ahihkip a, ahi, azongkhia hi.
"Mihing kiang ah, 'Ngai in, TOUPA kihtak, huai pilna ahi; hoih lou a kipan paimang theihsiamna ahi,' achi hi.”
Job in agentehna thu agen nawn a, hichi in achi.
"Aw nidanglai khate bang a om hi leng, Pathian in ahon veh lai nite bang in;
Ka lutung a akhawnvak atan a, amah vakna a khomial a ka vak lai;
Ka tuailai nite a ka om bang a, ka puanin tung a Pathian thuguk a-om lai in;
Ka kiang a Bangkim hihthei a-om a, ka tate ka kim a-om lai un;
Ka kalsuante bawngnawi a sawp ahih a, suangpi in sathau luite abutkhiak lai in.
Khopi a kongpi zuan a ka pai lai in, kongzing a ka tutna ka bawl lai in,
Tangvalte'n ahon mu ua, abu ua; upate athou ua adingh uh.
Lalte houlim akidek ua, akam uah akhut uh akoih uh.
Miliante aw adai a, akam dangtawng uah alei uh abelh hi.
"Bil in ahon zak lai in, hampha ahon chi a; mit in ahon muh lai in, pom ahon chi a;
Migenthei, panpih ngai a kap, Pa nei lou, panpihtu bei ka hutkhiak ziak in.
Mangthang ding a mansa a kipan vualzawlna ka tung ah ahong tung a; meithai lungtang kipah ziak a lasa ding in ka omsak hi.
Diktatna ka silh a, ahon tuam hi; ka dikna puanak thupi leh lukhum bang leh suangmantam bang ahi.
Mittaw a ding in mitte ka hi a, khebai a ding in khete ka hi.
Tasam a ding in pa ka hi a; ka theih louh thubul ka zongkhia hi.
Diktatloumi haizek ka hihtan a, aha a kipan asamat ka khahsak.
"Huchi in ke'n, ka bu ah ka si ding a, piaunel bang in ka nite ka pungsak ding, ka chi a.
Ka zungte tuite pha in adalhzak a, ka hiangte ah zankhua in daitui akai.
Kei ah ka thupina athak gige a, ka khut ah ka thalpeu athak gige.
Mite'n ahon ngai ua, angak ua, ka thuhilh a ding in adai dide uhi.
Ka thute zoh in apau nawn kei uh; ka thugen atung uah atakkhia.
Vuah ngak bang in ahon ngak ua; vuah nanungte a ding bang in lianpi in akamka uh.
Kimuanna aneih louh chiang un atung uah ka nuihmai a; huchi in ka mel tang apaikhe kei uh.
"Alampi ding uh ka telsak a, hausa bang in ka tu a; sepaih pawl lak a kumpipa bang in ka leng a, suun mite lungmuanmi bang in."
Hiai khit in Job in akam aka a, ani ahamsiat hi.
Job in adawng a, hichi in achi.
"Ka pian ni leh zan, pasal naupang pai in a-om, akichihna mangthang hen.
Huai ni mialna hi hen; tunglam a kipan Pathian in ngaihsak kei hen, atung ah leng khovak tang kei hen.
Khomial leh sihna lim in amau a ding in huai ngen uhen; atung ah meipi kai hen; khua nimsak tengteng in huai tuh lausak uhen.
"Zan ahihleh, mial sah bikbek atung ah tu hen; kum nite lak ah telsak kei hen; khate simna ah tel kei heh.
Ngai in, huai zan hut henla; huai ah kipah aw ging kei hen.
Huai ni hamsiatte amau hamsiat uhen, Leviathan tokthou ding a mansa a omte.
Huai a khomui aksite mial uhen; khovak zong henla, himahleh bangmah nei kei hen; zingsang mitvunte leng mu sam kei hen.
Ka nu sul kongkhakte akhak louh ziak in, ka mit a kipan abuaina asel louh ziak in.
"Sul a kipan bangziak a si lou ka hia? Gil a kipan ka hong paikhiak lai a bangziak a kha khah lou ka hia?
Bangziak a khukte'n kei hon dom ahia? Ahihkeileh bangziak a ka tep ding nawi na om ahia?
Tu a na lum khin a, na dai mai ding lah ka hi ngal a; ka na ihmuta dia; huchi in ka na khawlta ding hi.
Lei kumpipate leh thudot mite, amau a ding a mun sia bawlte toh.
Ahihkeileh dangka-eng nei kumpite, a-innte uh dangka a dimsakte toh.
Ahihkeileh muh louh a ahun lou a piang bang na hilou ka hia, naungek khovak mu ngeiloute bang?
Huai ah migiloute'n sukbuai atawpsan ua; huai ah mitawlte akhawl uhi.
Huai ah salmatte nuam in a-omkhawm uh; nasem heutute aw aza kei uhi.
Huai ah aneu leh alian a-om ua; apu a kipan in sikha anuamlen.
"Bangziak a dah a omte kiang a khovak piak ahia, kha a haksa sa kiang ah hinna;
Sihna deih a, atunlouhnate kiang ah; gou selguk zon sang a thupi a zong mite kiang ah.
Han atun lai ua, nakpitak a kipakte kiang ah?
Bangziak a mi alampi sel a om kiang leh Pathian in a-umsuak kiang a khovak piak a om ahia?
An ka nek ma in ka thumna ahong tung a, ka maunate tui bang a leihbuak in a-om hi.
Ka kihtak thil lah ka tung ah ahong tung ngal a, ka laulau ka tung ah ahong tung hi.
Nuam ka sa kei a, ka lung amuang kei, khawlna leng ka nei kei hi; himahleh buaina ahong pai hi.”
"Huan kei sang a naupang, apate uh, ka ganching uite toh koih dia ka sitte'n, kei nuihza bawlna in ahon zang uh.
Ahi, akhutte uh hat a, kei bang ahon loh tak dia, huai ahatna uh beisate'n?
Taksapna leh kialna in atuikang ua; lei keu leh sia akheuh uh,
Pawn a anteh alou ua; huan lou kha zungte a-an uh ahi.
Mite lak a kipan hawlkhiak in a-om ua; guta bang in amau nung ah akikou ua.
Guam a hengte ah ateng ding ua, lei leh suangpi hawmte ah.
Pawn lak ah aham ua; lahou nuaite ah akisekhawm uh.
Mihaite tate ahi ua, ahi, mithulim lou tate; gam a pan in delhkhiak ahi uhi.
"Huan tu in kei ala uh ka hong hi ahi, amau a ding in houlimna ka hi.
Ahon kih ua, kei a kipan atuam ding in uh, ka mai a chilsiat akidek kei uh.
Pathian in ka khau akhah a, ahon hihgim a, huan ka ma ah kamkaihna akhahkhia uh.
Ka khut taklam ah tuailaite athou ua; ka khe anawlkhin ua, siatna lampi ka ma ah akoih uhi.
Ka lampi hihsiarin, ka tuahsiatna azong ua, kuama'n akham kei uh.
Awng zapi apaisuak bang in ahong ua, siatna lak ah ka tung ah akikhuk uh.
Ka tung ah launate ahei ua, huih bang in ka minphatna adelhmang uh; meipi bang in ka hauhna apaimang hi.
"Huchi in tu in ka sung ah ka kha buakkhiak in a-om; gimthuakna nite'n kei ahon man uhi.
Zan in ka guhte asawi a, kei hon sun natnate'n khawl chih anei kei uh.
Ka natna hi hat mahmah ziak in ka puansilh anin a: ka puanak ngawng bang in kei ahon gak hi.
Buannawi ah ahon pailut a, leivui leh meivu bang ka hi hi.
"Na kiang ah ka kikou a, na hon dawng kei hi. Ka ding a, kei na hon en maimah a.
Ka tung a gilou ding in na kilumlet a, na bantha hatna in kei na hon sawi hi.
Huih ah na hon domkangtou a, huai tung ah na hon tuangsak; huchi in huih ah na hon lumlet den hi.
Sihna na hon tun ding chih ka thei hi, mihing tengteng a dia sehsa inn ah.
Himahleh siatna a pukgawp mi'n aban zak lou ding hia? Atuahsiatna ah panpihna ngen in kikou lou ding hia?
Buaina a ding in ka kap kei diam? tasam a ding in ka kha adah kei ding a hiam?
Hoih ka ngak chiang in, hoih lou ahong pai a; khovak ka ngak chiang in, khomial ahong pai.
"Ka lungtang abuai, khawl hun amu ngei kei; gimthuakna nite ka tung ah ahong tung.
Hihvom a om in ka vialvak, himahleh ni hihvom hilou in; khawmpi ah ka dingh a panpih deih in ka kikou hi.
Sehalte unaupa ka hi a, simbute lawm ka hi.
Ka vun avom a, kei a kipan apilh uh, kholum in ka guhte akang hi.
Huaiziak in ka kaihging suunna asuak a, ka mutging mikapte aw."
"Ka mit toh thukhun ka na bawl khinta; bangchi in nungak ka en theita dia?
"Ahihleh tunglam Pathian a kipan in ka tantuan bang ahia, tungsang a Bangkim hihthei a kipan in ka goutan?
Midikloute tung ah siatna, gitlouh nasemte tung ah gawtna atung kei maw?
Ama'n ka lampite amu kei a hia? ka kalsuante asim vek kei a hia?
"Thuzuau toh na om a, huai a ka khe khem ding a kinoh ahihleh;
bukna diktak ah hon buk dih ua, Pathian in ka thutakna thei hen!
Ka kalsuan lampi a kipan a na pial hiam, ka lungtang in ka mitte na zui hiam, ka khutte ah nin himhim na belh hiam;
Huchi ka hihleh, chi tuh ning, midang in ne hen; ahi, ka lou a piang bulkalh khiak hi hen.
"Ka lungtang numei lam a khem a om a, ka inveng kongkhak ka na ngak takleh;
huchi ahih takleh ka zi in midang a ding in an su henla, midangte amah tung ah kun uhen.
Huchibang gitlouhna hoih het lou ahi; ahi, vaihawm mite gawt ding khelhna ngei,
siatna ding a Abaddon tan a kangbei leh, ka punna tengteng zungkalh ding mei hi ding lah ahi ngal a.
"Ka tung a phunna aneih lai ua, ka sikhapa hiam ka sikhanu hiam makhua na musit a, na khualsak lou ka hihleh;
Pathian athohkhiak chiang in bang ka hihta dia? Thu akan hun chiang in bang in ka dawngta dia?
Kei sul a pan hon bawlpa'n amah abawl kei maw? Khat in ahon bawl tuak ahi kei maw?
"Migentheite alunggulh uh ka piak louh a, ahihkeileh vuaksuak ding a meithai mitte ka na omsakleh;
Ahihkeileh kei kia in ka an ka nek a, huai a pabei in an anek keileh;
Ii, ka tuailai a kipan in pa bang ka hi, ka kiang ah ana khanglianta; ka nu sul a kipan amah pipa ka hita hi.
"Kuapeuh taksap ziak a mangthang hiam, ahihkeileh tasam khuhna nei lou hiam ka na muhleh;
Akawngte'n kei hon vualzawl lou a, ka belam mul a lumsak a ana om keileh.
"Kongpi a panpihna ka muh ziak a pabeite siatna ding a ka khut ka na likleh;
Huchi ka hihleh, ka liang ka liangzang a kipan kia henla, aguh a kipan ka ban kitan hen.
Pathian a kipan tuahsia kei a ding in launa ahi ngal a, athupina ka tuak ngam kei hi.
"Dangka-eng lametpen a ka na bawl a, dangka-eng hoih kiang ah, ka muanna na hi, ka na chihtak a;
Ka hauhna thupi ziak a hiam, ka khut in tam alam ziak a ka kipah a;
Avak lai a ni ka na et a, kha thupitak paikhia ka na et a,
Ka lungtang guk a khem a a-om a, ka kam in ka khut ana tawp takleh;
Hiai leng thulimlouhna vaihawmte gawt ding ahi, tung a Pathian kiang a na zuauta hi ding ka hih ziak in.
"Kei hon mudah siatna a ka na kipah a, ahihkeileh hoih lou atung a atun chiang a ka na kipah luatleh;
Ka melma hamsiat ding leh ahenna thum ding in ka kam ka na khialsak kei.
Ka puaninte a, 'A-an a kihihvah lou kua a-om a?' hon na chih kei ualeh;
Kongzing ah mikhual agiak ngei kei a; khualzin a ding in ka kongte ka na hongta.
"Adam bang a ka angsung a thulimlouhna na sel a, ka tatlekna na khuh ka hih a,
aziak, mi tampi launa thupitak ka neih ziak ahih a, sungte hon muh daina launa ziak a huchi a dai dide a, popawt lou ka hihleh,
Aw, kei hon za ding mi nei leng maw. Ngai in, ka deihlam hiai ahi. Bangkim hihthei in hon dawng henla; ka melma in laibu ah gelhkhiak hen.
"Chihtaktak in ka liangzang ah ka po dia; lallukhu bang in kei ah ka kan den ding hi.
Akiang ah ka kalsuan zah ka puang ding a; lal bang in akiangnai ah ka hoh ding hi.
"Ka gam kei dem a akikou a, lei lehsate akahkhawm uleh;
Sum lou a huai gahte ka na nek tak a, ahihkeileh huai a aneite ahinna uh ka na tansakleh,
Buh hilou in louling neite, barli buh hilou in loubualte pou zaw hen," Job thute abeita hi.
Huchibang in hiai mi thumte Job dawn atawpta ua, amah mit a diktat ahih ziak in.
Huai lai in Job tung ah Ram inkuan a Buz mi Barakel tapa Elihu hehna akuangkhia a, Pathian hi zaw lou a amah siam akitansak ziak in.
Alawm thumte tung ah leng ahehna akuangkhia a, dawnna ding nei lou a, hinapi a lah Job amohpaih ziak un.
Amah sang a a-upat zawk ziak un, Job kiang a thu gen ding in Elihu in angak hi.
Hiai mi thumte kam a dawnna a-om kei chih atheih in, ahehna akuangkhia hi.
"Huchi in Buz mi Barakel tapa. Elihu in adawng hi: Ka naupang a, noute na upa mahmah uh; huaiziak in ka dai a, ka lungsim ka hon ensak ngam kei hi.
Huchi in ka chi, 'Nite'n thu agen ding uh, kum tampi in pilna a sinsak ding hi.'
Himahleh mihing lungsim a om a, Bangkim hihthei in theihsiamna apia hi.
Apilte mithupite ahi kei ua, vaihawmna theisiamte upate ahi sam kei uh.
Huaiziak in hong ngaikhia un; ke'n leng ka lungsim ka ensak ding, ka chi.
"Ngai un, na thute uh ka ngak a, gen ding na zonkhiak lai un, na thusutte uh ka ngaikhia.
Ahi, ka hon limsak a, ngai un, kuamah Job thuzoh zou na om kei uh, ahihkeileh na lak uah, athute dawng.
Pilna i muta, chi lou ding in pilvang un; mihing hilou in Pathian in amah azou thei hi.
Ama'n kei siatna ding in athute ahih kei a; ke'n leng nou thugente in amah ka dawng sam kei ding.
"Lamdang sa in, adawng nawn akei ua, gen ding thu khat leng anei kei uh.
Thu ging neih louh ziak in adingh kinken ua, adawn nawn louh ziak un ke'n ka ngak diam?
Ke'n leng ka dawnna ding ka nei hi, ka lungsim ka ensak sam ding, ka chi hi.
Thu in ka dim a; ka sung a ka kha in hon sawl teitei hi.
Ngai un, ka gilpi pawtkhiakna nei lou uain thawl bang ahi; uain thawl thakte bang in puakzak ding in mansa in ma-om hi.
Ka halhtheihna ding in, ka pau ding; ka mukte ka hong dia, ka dawng ding hi.
Mihing mihinna zahtaksak kei un, ka hon ngen hi; kuamah kiang ah leng maitang phatna min ka pe kei ding hi.
Maitang phatna minte piak ding ka thei ngal kei a; huchi lou in zaw kei hon bawlpa'n ahon lazok ding hi."
"Akoi abang hitaleh, Job, ka hon ngen hi, thugen za inla ka thugen tengteng ngaikhia in.
Ngai in, tu in, ka kam ka ka a, ka kam in ka pau hi.
Ka thute'n ka lungtang dikna agenkhe ding uh; Ka mukte'n atheih ngei uh chihtaktak in agen ding uhi.
Pathian Kha in ahon bawl a, Bangkim hihthei hu in hinna ahon pia hi.
"Na theihleh hon dawng in; ka ma ah na thute akizom in koih inla na panna ah dingh in.
Ngai in, nang bang in Pathian lam ah ka om hi; kei leng tungman a bawl ka hi.
Ngai in, ka lauhuaina in nang ahon lausak kei ding, ka hahkatna leng na tung ah agik kei ding hi.
"Chihtaktak in ka zak in na pauta a, huchi in na thute ging ka zata hi.
Ka siang hi, tatlekna bei; ka hoih a, kei ah thulimlouhna leng a-om kei, chi in.
Ngai in, kei demna ding ziak amu a melma in ahon simta hi;
Ka khete kol abunsak a, ka lampite tengteng achiamteh hi.
"Ngai in, ka hon dawng ding, hiai na diklouhna ah; mihing sang in Pathian alianzaw hi.
Bangziak a amah dou na hia, Ka thute a bangmah mah lah adawng kei ding, chi in?
Pathian in lah khatvei agen a, ahi, nihvei, mihing in limsak kei mahleh.
Zan a mang ah, mengmuhna ah, mite tung a ihmut kip akiak lai un, lupna tung a ihmut laite un;
huai lai in mite bilte ahong a, vaunate in amau ahihlau a,
Huchi a athiltup a kipan a mihing alakkika, mihing a kipan akisaktheihna asatkhiak theihna ding in;
Ama'n kokhuk a kipan akha akepkiksak a, namsau a kipan ahinna.
"Alupna tung ah natna asawi in leng a-om aguhte akinakna om gige toh in.
Huchi in ahinna in tanghou, akha in an lim akih hi.
Asa atummang a, huchi in muh theih in a-om kei; Akimu lou a guhte hong dawkkhia uhi.
Ahi, han kiang ah akha ahong nai a, ahinna hihse mite kiang ah.
"Akiang a angel, kamlet, sangkhat lak a khat, mihing kiang a amah a dia dik bang ahia chih etsak ding a-omleh;
Huchi a amah a ding a zahngai thei, Kokhuk a paisukna a kipan amah suaktasak un, tatna ka muta.
Asa naupang a sang in nou zaw hen; atuailai nite lam ah kik nawnta hen.
Pathian kiang ah athum a, amah ding in deihsak theih in a-om hi; huchi in nopna toh amai amu a; adiktatna akiang ah ape nawn hi.
Mite ma ah la asa a, ka khialta a, adik ka na hekkawi a, thuk in ka om kei!
Kokhuk sung a paisukna a kipan akha atanta hi, ahinna in vakna amuta ding hi, achi a.
"Ngai in, hiai thilte tengteng Pathian in, mihing lak ah ahih a, nihvei, ahi thumvei.
Kokhuk a kipan akha pikik ding in, huchi a mihing vakna ahihvak a a-omtheihna ding in.
"Chiamteh in, Aw Job, ngaikhia in, dai inla, thu ka gen ding.
Gen ding na neihleh, hon dawng in, pau in, siam hon tansak ka ut ngal a.
Na neih keileh, kei hon ngaikhia in, dai inla pilna ka hon sinsak ding hi."
Huai lou in Elihu in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Ka thute za un, nou mipilte; nou theihna neite, bil hon doh un.
Dangtawng in an achep bang in, bil in thute a-enchian hi.
Adik ei a ding in i tel ding uh; i lak ua hoih bang ahia i thei ding uh.
Job in, 'Ka dik a, Pathian in ka dikna a lamang,' achi ngal a.
Ka dikna huchi hita mahleh zuauthei a sim ka hi a; tatlekna bei himah leng, ka liamna hihdam theih louh ahi.
"Muhsitna tui bang a dawn bei, Job bang mihing kua ahia?
Thulim lou nasem mite toh ahon a pai, migiloute toh omkhawm mi.
Ama'n lah, 'Pathian lak a ka kipahna ding bangmah ka loh tak kei,' achi ngal a.
Huaiziak in nou theisiam mite, hon ngaikhia un. Pathian in, gilou bangchi in ahih ngei dia; Bangkim hihthei in thulim lou bangchi in ahih mahmah dia.
Ama'n lah mihing thilhih amah kiang apekik ding a, mi chiteng alampite kiang a pekik ding ahi.
"Ahi, moh khuksakna thu ah, Pathian in giloutak in ahih kei dia, Bangkim hihthei in leng vaihawmna ahihse sam kei ding hi.
Kua'n ahia amah leitung heutu hihna pia? Ahihkeileh khovel pumpi kua'n ahia athu a koih?
Mihing tung a alungtang nga a, ama lam a akha leh ahu lakhawm;
Sa tengteng amangthang vek ding ua, mihing leivui asuak nawn ding hi.
"Theihsiamna na neihleh, hiai za in; ka thu aw ngaikhia in.
Mi thudik hua in vai ahawm ding hia? Dik leh hat amah na mohpaih ding hia?
Kumpipa kiang a, 'Na hoih kei' chih akilawm hia? Ahihkeileh miliante kiang a, 'Na gilou uh?' chih.
Milalte mihinna zahtak lou a, Genthei sang a mihausate limsak zawte kiang a chih akilawm sem lou ding hia? Amaute lah akhut nasep ahi ngal ua.
Mitphiat kal lou in asi ua zankim lai mahmah in; mite aling ua apaimang ua, mihing khut hilou in mihatte lakmang in a-om uhi.
"Amitte mihing lampite tung ah a-om a, apainate amu hi.
Thulim lou nasem mite bukna ding khomial hiam limliap hiam a-om kei hi.
Vaihawmna a Pathian ma a pai ding in, mihing angaihtuah lailai akiphamoh kei hi.
Lamte theih phak vual louh in ama'n mihatte ahihzan vek a, amun uah midang atungkhia hi.
Huaiziak in anasepte uh athei hi; zan in amau alumlet a, hihsiat in a-om uhi.
Midang mitmuh mahmah in migiloute bang in amau agawt hi.
Amah zuihna a kipan apialkhiak ua, alampite a koimah alimsak louh ziak un.
Huchi in mizawng kahna akiang tung ding in abawl ua, gimthuak kahna aza hi.
"Amah na pau keileh, kua'n siam louh atangsak dia? Ama'n amai aselleh, kua'n amah amu thei dia? Namte kiang a hih hiam, ahihkeileh mihing kiang a hih hiam akibang hi.
Huchi a Pathian theiloumi in vai ahawm louh a, amite thang a awksak ding a- omlouhna ding in.
"Kuapeuh in Pathian kiang ah, Gawtna ka thuakta, ka gilou nawn kei ding,
Ka muh louh nang hon sinsak in, gilou ka hihleh ka hih nawn kei ding, achi uhia?
Athukna huchi a na nial na deih bang in a-om diam? Kei hilou in, nang na tel ngeingei ding ahi.
"Theisiam mite'n ka kiang ah, 'Ahi,' achi ding uh, aza mipil teng in.
Job in theihna bei in thu agen a, athute pilna bei ahi uh.
Mihaite bang a adawnna ah, atawp chiang in Job tungtang ngaihtuah le uh.
Ama'n akhelhna ah helna abehlap a, i lak uah akhut abeng a, Pathian kalh in athu apungsakta hi.”
Elihu in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Hiai na dikna hi in na ngaihtuah hia, ahihkeileh, kei a mawng ahi, Pathian mai ah na chi hia?
Kei a ding in bang phattuamna a-om dia? Khial lou a ka om in bang phattuamna ka nei a? na chih.
Nang leh na kiang a na lawmte ka hon dawng ding.
"Vante lam en inla, mu in; vante, nang sang a sangzaw, en in.
Na hihkhelhleh, amah dem a bang hih na hia? Na tatleknate punsak hileh, amah tung a bang hih na hia?
Diktat na hihleh, amah bang na pia a? Ahihkeileh na khut a kipan bang amu a?
Na gitlouhna in nang bang in mi ahihna thei a; na diktatna in mihing tapa ahih hampha thei hi.
Nuaisiahna atam mahmah ziak in akikoukhia ua; mihat ban ziak in panpih deih in akikou uh.
Kuamah in, 'Zan chia late hon pia, Pathian kei hon Bawlpa koi a om ahia;
Lei a gamsate sang a hon sinsak tamzaw leh, van a vasate sang a hon pilsakzaw?' achi kei uh.
Huai ah akikou ua, himahleh, migilou kisaktheihna ziak in, kuamah in dawnna ape kei.
Chihtaktak in Pathian in bangmah lou aza kei dia, Bangkim hihthei in leng alimsaksak kei ding hi.
"Nang ngial in houh, ‘Amah ka mu kei, athu ma ah a-om, Amah ka ngak hi,' na chih vial.
Himahleh tu in, heh a aveh louh a, ki-otsakna leng alimsak louh ziak in;
Huaiziak in Job in bangmah lou in akam aka ahi; theihna bei in thu atamsak ahi.”
Elihu mah in agenzom zel a, hichi in achi:
"Hon na thuakzou zek inla, huan ka hon ensak ding; Pathian sik in lah banghiam khat gen ding ka nei ngal a.
Gamla a kipan ka theihna ka hon la ding a, kei hon Bawlpa tung ah diktatna ka nga ding hi.
Diktak in ka thute zuau ahi kei a; hoihkim khat ka kiang ah a-om hi.
"Ngai in, Pathian in thil ahihthei a, kuamah amusit kei; theihsiamna hatna ah thil ahihthei hi.
Gilou hinna ahawi kei a; himahleh gimthuakte kiang ah adikna uh apia hi.
Midiktat a kipan amit alakik kei; himahleh laltutphah tung a kumpipa toh amau tangtawn in akoih a, huchi in hihlet in a-om uhi.
Huan sikkhaute a gak a a-om ua, gimthuakna guite alak a a-om uleh;
Huchi in athilhih uh amau a- ensak a, atatlekna uh, huchi a kisatheitak a ana omna uh.
Thuhilhna lam ah abil uh ahonsak a, thulimlouhna a kipan kik ding in thu apia hi.
Amah thu angaihkhiak ua, a-nna asep uh leh, anite uh hauhsakna in ahihbei ding ua, akumte uh kipahna in.
Himahleh angaihkhiak kei ualeh, namsau in amangthang ding ua, huchi in theihna bei in asi ding uh.
"Himahleh amau lungtang a Pathian limsaklouhnate'n hehna akholkhawm hi; amau ahen lai in panpih deih in akikou kei uh.
Tuailai in asi ua, siangloute lak ah ahinna uh amangthang hi.
Agimthuakna in gimthuakte asuaktasak a, nuaisiahna ah abil uh ahonsak hi.
Ahi, gakchihna omlouhna, mun lian lam ah dahna a kipan nang ahon pimang ding a; na dohkan tung a kilui thauna in adimta ding hi.
Himahleh giloute vaihawmna in na dim a; vaihawmna leh diktatna in nang hon len hi.
Thangpaihna a-om ziak in, pilvang in huchi lou in zaw na hauhna in nang ahon pimang kha ding hi; golhgukna tampi in leng nang hon pialsak kei hen.
Dahna ana omlouhna ding in, na hauhsaknate ahun diam, ahihkeileh na hatna thilhihtheihna tengteng?
Mite tengteng amun ua satkhiak a a-om zan uah lunggulh ke'n.
Pilvang in, gilou limsak ke'n; gimthuakna sang in hiai lah na telzawta ngal a.
"Ngai in, Pathian in athilhihtheihna in sangtak in ahih; amah bang sinsakmi kua ahia?
Kua'n amah alampi thu apia a? Ahihkeileh, 'Diklouhna na bawlta,' kua'n achi thei dia?
Mite'n la asak uh, athilhih hihlian ding in theigige in.
Huai ah mite tengteng a-en ua; huai mihing in gamlapi ah amu hi.
Ngai in, Pathian alian a, amah i thei kei; akumte zah zontheih ahi kei.
"Tui takte ama'n atawi khin a, huai a tuihu a kipan vuah azu.
Huai vante'n asungkhia ua, mihing tung ah tampi in atak.
Meipi kiphahte leh a-inn vanpi gingte kua'n atheisiam dia?
Ngai in, akim ah akhovak azak a; tuipi nuai atuam hi.
Hiaite in mite avai hawmsak a; an tampi apia hi.
Akhutte in khophia atawi a; chiamtehna khoh ding in thu apia hi.
Huai husa in atungtang thu agen a, ganhonte'n leng hong kuantou huihpi tungtang thu athei uh."
"Hiai ah leng ka lungtang aling a, amun a kipan suan in a-om hi.
A-aw ging leh akam a kipan avan-ging paikhia noute'n ngaikhia un.
Van pumpi nuai ah asawlkhia a, akhophia lei tawpnate tan in.
Huai zoh in aw akikou a; alalna aw in vanpi agingsak a: a-aw zak a a-om chiang in amau alen kei hi.
Pathian in a-aw in lamdangtak in vanpi agingsak a; i theihtheih louh, thil thupite ahih zel hi.
Ama'n lah vuk kiang ah, 'Lei ah kia in,' achi ngal a; huchi mah bang in vuahmal phin kiang ah leng.
Mi chiteng khut atuambit a; abawlsa mite tengteng in huai atheihtheihna ding un.
Huai lai in gamsate amun uah alut ua, akuate uah a-om uhi.
Simlam dantan a kipan huihpi ahong a; mallam a kipan khovot.
Pathian hu in tui khal piak ahi; tuite nakna hihhaksat in a-om.
Ahi, meipi nawnna aposak a; akhophia meipi aphalhsak hi.
Amah pi in akivial heihei ua, tentheihna khovel maikaih a amaute thu apiak peuhmah ahihna ding un.
Bawlhoihna ding hiam, agam a ding hiam, ahihkeileh zahngaihna ding thiam a, ahon paisakna ah.
"Hiai ngaikhia in, Aw Job; dingh kinken inla, Pathian thilhih lamdangte ngaihtuah in.
Amaute tung a Pathian thupiak akoih a, ameipi khophia atansakdan na thei hia?
Meipite kibuk diknate, amah theihna hoihkim thilhih lamdangte na thei hia?
Sim huih ziak a lei adaih sipsip lai a, na puansilhte alumdan?
Amah toh van, suntawm limlang bang a khauh na phalh thei hia?
Akiang a ka gen ding uh hon sinsak in; mialna ziak in ka thugen ding uh ka gelkhol thei kei ua.
Thu ka gen ding chih amah hilh ding ahi diam? Ahihkeileh mihing in valh khit a om ut ding ahi diam?
"Huchi in mite'n meipi a om khovak amu kei ua: himahleh huih anung a, amaute ahihsiang hi.
Mal a kipan in dangka-eng bang a thupi ahong pai a; Pathian alalna ah athupi hi.
Bangkim hihthei thu ahihleh, mu thei kei hang; thilhihtheihna ah athupi petmah hi. Huan vaihawmna leh dikna hauhna ah gim athuaksak kei ding hi.
Huaiziak in mite'n amah alau ua; lungtang a pil kuamah alimsak kei hi."
Huchi in TOUPA'N pingpei a kipan in Job adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Theihna bei thute a thuhilh hihmial hiai kua ahia?
Kipasalsak in tu in na kawng gak inla; hon dong ding ka hi, ka kiang a na gen ding ahi.
Lei kingaknate ka koih lai in nang koi ah na om a? Gen in, theihsiamna nei na hihleh.
Atehnate kua bawl ahia? Thei na hihleh! Atung a tehna khau kua zan ahia?
Anuai suangphumte kua phum ahia? Huai aning a suang kua koih ahia?
Zingsang aksite'n la asakkhawm ua, Pathian tapate tengteng kipak a akikou lai un?
"Ahihkeileh kua'n kongkhakte in tuipite akhakbing a? Gil a kipan hong pawtkhia bang a, ahong puahkhiak lai in.
Huai a puansilh meipi leh, khomial bikbek, huai a ding a tuamna puan ka bawl a,
huai a ding a ka thupiak bawl a, kalhnate leh kongkhakte koih a,
hiai tan na hong pai ding, himahleh aban hilou in, ka chih a; hiai lai ah aki-uangsak na tuikihotte kholsak in a-om ding uh, ka chih lai in?
Na nite akipat nungsiah zingsang thu na pia in, phalvak amun thei ding in na bawlta hia?
Lei tawpnate amat theih a, huai a kipan a gilou sinkhiak ahihtheihna ding in?
Chiamtehna nuai a tungman lei bang in mel akikheng a; puansilh bang in thil tengteng zenei in adingkhia hi.
Gilou a kipan a akhovak uh lettangsak ahi a, aban liksang uh akitan hi.
"Tuipi nak sung ah na lutta hia? Ahihkeileh tui thuk tawp ah na paita hia?
Sihna kongpite na kiang ah taklat in a-omta hia? Ahihkeileh sihna limliap kongpite na muta hia?
Leitung zatdan na theisiamta hia? Puangkhia in, huai na theihleh.
Khovak tenna zotna lampi koi ah a-om a, huan khomial omna mun koisan ahia?
Huchi a gamgi tan a na tonpih theih a, huai a inn tan a lampite na theihna ding in?
Thei mah niteh maw, huai lai a piangta hi ding hi chin a? Na nite atam mahmah ngal a!
"Vuk koihkhawmna ah na lut ngei hia, ahihkeileh gial koihkhawmna na muta hia?
Huai buaina hun a ding leh kidou leh kisat ni a dia ka koihkholhte?
Bang lampi ah ahia khovak akikhen hiam leitung a suahlam huih adalhzak?
Kua'n ahia tui tampi luanna ding a tuilam khuak a, kekkia a dia lampi sial?
Mihing omlouhna mun gam tung a vuah zusak ding in; mihing omlouhna, gamdai tung ah.
Lei kisia leh segawpsa lungkimsak ding; loupa hing nou khangkhesak ding?
Vuah in pa anei hia? Ahihkeileh daitui takte kua suan ahia?
Kua gil a kipan a tui khal hong pai ahia? Van daitui khal ngou, kua suahsak ahia?
Suang bang in tuite atak a, tui thuk maite akhal hi.
"Siguk khaute na khihkhawm thei hia? zuheisuktun khaute na phel thei hia?
Ama hunbi ah Aksi lamvak a chiamtehnate na pikhe thei hia? Ahihleh Zaangkhua leh tate na pi thei hia?
Van thupiakte na thei hia? Huai lalna lei ah na dingkhesak thei diam?
Nang tui tampi in akhuhtheihna ding in meipi kiang ah aw na suah thei diam?
Amau kiang ah, 'Hiai ah om ung,' chi a apaikhiak theihna ding un khophiate na sawlkhe thei a hia?
Sunggil lam ah pilna kua'n akoih a? Ahihkeileh lungsim kiang ah kua'n theihsiamna apia a?
Pilna in kua'n meipite asim thei dia? Van tuithawlte kua'n abokhe thei dia?
Alompi a leivui aluan a, asakte akimatkhawm ngiungeu lai un?
"Humpinelkai a ding in samat na betsak ding hia? Ahihkeileh humpinelkai noute gilkial na hihdam ding hia?
Akua ua aboh ua, buk ding a abukna mun ua a-om nilouh lai un?
Va-ak a ding a an kua'n pia ahia? Anoute Pathian kiang akikou a an duh man a avakvak lai un?"
"Suangpi a gam sathakte'n nou asuaksak hun uh na thei hia? Ahihkeileh nou aneih lai uh na chiamteh thei hia?
Akha chinsak zah uh na thei hia? Ahihkeileh apian hun na thei hia?
Akun ua, atate uh asuang uh, alungkhamnate uh apaikhia uhi.
Atate uh deihhuaitak in a-om ua, gamlak ah akhanglian ua; akuankhia ua, ahong kik nawn kei uh.
"Kua'n gam sabiltung akhahkhia a? Ahihkeileh kua'n gam sabiltunghonte aphel a?
Kua ahia a-inn ding a gamdai ka piak a, atenna ding a gamkeu ka bawlsak?
Khopi buai nuanua amusit a, hawltute kikounate aza kei hi.
Mual dungte agantatna mun ahi a, huan thil hing chiteng azong hi.
"Na nna sem ding in gam bawngtal alungkim hia? Ahihkeileh na anpiakna kiang ah a-om gige diam?
Leilehna ah khau in gam bawngtal na khihthei diam? Ahihkeileh na nung ah phaizangte atoktam diam?
Ahatna athupi ziak in, amah na muang diam? Ahihkeileh akiang ah na sepgimna na khiak diam?
Na buhchi inn ahon tut a, na buhphual a buh akaihkhawm theihna ding in amah na muang diam?
"Ostrik kha kisatheitak in akizap a; akhavengte leh amulte amigi hia?
Atuite lah leitung ah anusia a, leivui ah alumsak a,
Khe in asikkham thei chih a mangngilh a, ahihkeileh gamsa in asikgawp thei, chih.
Amah a hilou bang in, anoute siatna ding in akhauh a; asepgimna bangmah lou himahleh, alau kei hi.
Pathian in pilna angolhsak ziak in, theihsiamna leng ape sam kei hi.
Tungsang lam a akitawisang chiang in, sakol leh atungtuangmi anuihsan.
"Sakol hatna nang piak hia? Mul nem in angawng na tuam hia?
Khaukhup bang in na tawmsak hia? Ahamna thupi alauhuai ve.
Guam ah lei akhuat a, ahatna ah akipak a, mi kigalthuamte tuak ding in apaikhia.
Lauhuai anuihsan a, alungdong kei a, namsau leng anungngat sam kei hi.
Amah ah thalbawm aging lengleng a, teipite zelzel leh chiangzum.
Kihtakhuaina leh hehna in lei anawmvalh a; Pengkul aw ahi chih leng agingta sam kei hi.
Pengkul agin teng in, 'Hah' achi a, kidouna, heutute vanpiging leh kikou, gamlapi a pan athei.
"Na pilna in mu sangpi a lengsak in, akhate simlam ah aphalh hia?
Nang thupiak in hia muvanlai in tungsang a leng a abu aseh?
Suangpi tung ah ateng a, huai ah giahna anei a, suanghengte leh kulh muanhuaite ah.
Huai a kipan in mat ding amu a; amitte'n gamla amu hi.
Anoute'n leng sisan atawpbei ua; thah a a-omna mun, huai ah a-om hi.”
Huai lai in Eliphaz, Teman mi in adawng a hichi in achi:
"Mi'n nang hon houlimpih tumleh na zadah diam? Himahleh pau lou in kua a-om thei dia?
Ngai in, mi tampi na hilhta a, khut hatloute na hihhatta hi.
Apuk lai in na thute'n adingsak a, khuk hatloute na kipsak hi.
Himahleh tu in na tung ah ahong tung a, na bah a; nang ahon khoih a, na buaita hi.
Pathian na kihtakna, na muanna hilou hia, na lametna na lampite muanhuaina?
Theigige in, ka hon ngen ahi, hoih hinapi a, mangthang ngei kua ahia? Ahihkeileh koi lai ah ahia midik satkhiak a a-om?
Kei muh in, thulimlouhna lei lette ahi ua, buaina tuh a huai mah atte.
Pathian hu in amangthang ua, hehna a mut a hihmang in a-om uhi.
Humpinelkai humham leh, humpinelkai hangsan aw leh, humpinelkai tuailai hate, akitanta hi.
Samat taksap ziak in humpinelkai tek amangthang a, huan humpinelkaipi noute adalhzak uhi.
"Tu in aguk in thil ka kiang a hong tung ka bil in huai a huauna asangta hi.
Zan mengmuhna a kipan angaihtuahnate ah, mite nakpitak a a-ihmut san lai un,
ka tung ah launa ahong tung a, linna in ka guhte tengteng asing hi.
Huai lai in ka mai ah kha apai a; ka chimul adinghta hi.
Ka dingh kinken a, himahleh huai a kilatdan ka theikak theita kei a; alim tuh ka mit ma ah a-om a; daihna a-om a, aw ka za hi,
Pathian sang in sithei mihing dikzaw ding hia? Abawlpa sang in mihing siangthouzaw ding hia? chi in.
Ngai in, asikhate ah muanna akoih kei a; angelte hai in angoh hi:
Tungman inn a teng amaute hi sem na un chia, asuangphum leivui a om a, leikha ma a chimsia.
Zingsang leh nitak kikal in hihsiat in a-om ua; theih louh hial in tangtawn in amangthang uhi.
Amau sung a apuanin khau uh bohkhiak touh hilou hia? Pilna tel lou in asi uhi."
Huai lou in TOUPA'N Job adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Kuapeuh awlmoh nei lou in thil Bangkim hihthei akiselpih diam? Kuapeuh Pathian kiselpih, huai tuh amah dawngsak un."
Job in TOUPA adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Ngai in, bangmah ka hita kei a; bangchi in ka hon dawng dia? Ka kam ah ka khut ka koih.
Khatvei ka pauta a, ka dawng kei ding; ahi, nihvei himahleh ka pau nawn kei ding.”
Toupa'n pingpei a kipan in Job adawng a, hichi in achi.
"Kipasalsak inla, tu in na kawng gak in. Nang a kipan ka hon phut dia, kei kiang ah na hon puang ding hi.
Ka vaihawmna bangmah lou a koih ding na hiam? Siam na tantheihna dia, kei hon mohpaih ding na hi hia?
Ahihkeileh Pathian bang in ban na nei hia? Amah bang in aw in vanpi na gingsak thei hia?
Tu in nang hoihkim leh zahna in kizem in; zahna leh lalna in kivan in.
Na hehna dimlette sungkhia in; michih kisatheite en inla, hihniam in.
Michih kisathei en inla, kainiam in; adinna uah migiloute tuanchil in.
Leivui ah amaute selkhawm in; mundai ah amai uh kan in.
Huchi in na khut taklam in nang ahondam thei chih ka hon thei ding.
"Ngai dih, nang ka hon siam bang a ka siam, tu in behemoth en in; bawngtal bang in loupa ane hi.
En in tu in, akawng ah ahatna a-om a, agilpi thate ah ahatna a-om hi
Sidar sing bang in amei atangsak a, apheite thaguite phankhawm in a-om hi.
Aguhte dal lawng ahi a, aguh leh tangte siktawn bang ahi.
"Pathian lampite amakai lianpen ahi, amah bawlpa kia in anamsau amah kiang lam naih ding in abawl thei ding.
Chihtaktak in mualte'n amah an apuak ua; gamsate tengteng mawlna mun ah.
Singbawk limte nuai ah alum a, pumpeng kawm leh chiknawng lak ah.
Tui lili singte'n alim un akhuh ua; lui gei singnah kaite'n atuam kimvel uhi.
Ngai in, lui adimletleh, aling kei a; akam chiang pha hial in Jordan khang mahleh, amuang hi.
Akiven lai in kuapeuh in amah sikkawi in aman diam, thang in anak avut pailet diam?”
“Ngakuai in Leviathan na kaikhe thei diam? Ahihkeileh akhau in alei na sawntum thei diam?
Anak sung ah khauhual na thun thei diam? Ahihkeileh sikkawi in ahaizek na vut pailet thei diam?
Na kiang ah thilnget tampi abawl diam? Ahihkeileh na kiang ah thu nemte agen diam?
Tangtawn a ding in amah sikha dia na laktheihna ding in, nang toh thukhun abawl diam?
Vasa toh bang in amah toh na mawl diam? Ahihkeileh na sikhanute a ding in amah na hen diam?
Ngaman mite'n amah sumsinna ding in abawl ding uam? Sumsin mite lak ah amah azuak ding uam?
Siklen in avun na dimsak thei diam, ahihkeileh alu ngalingte in?
Atung ah na khut koih in; kidouna theigige in, huchi in na hih nawn kei ding hi.
"Ngai in, amah lametna bangmah lou ahi; amah muh mahmah in mi paihkhiak in a-om kei dia hia?
Amah hihhalh ngam khop ding in kuamah ahang kei; ka ma a dingh kua ahia le?
Amah ka dit ding, ka kiang ah kua'n ape masa a le? Van nuai a om peuhmah kei' a ahi.
"Aguh-le-tang thu ah ka dai kei ding, ahatna mahmah leh, apum kilawmna ah leng.
Apuansilh tungnung kua'n asuahsak thei dia? Akamkaih thuah nih sung ah kua ahong pai dia?
Amai kongkhakte kua'n ahong thei dia? Aha kimvel ah lauhuaina a-om.
Alip hattakte akisaktheihna ahi, namkipsa bang a khakkhum ahi.
Akal ua huihzam alut theihlouhna ding in, khat in adang anaih mahmah.
Khat leh adang akizom ua, akisoumat ua, khen theih louh in a-om uh.
Ahahchhiaite'n avaksak a, amitte zingsang mitvunte bang ahi.
Akam a pan meikuangte apawtkhia, mei-ekte atawmkhia hi.
Anakvangte a kipan in meikhu apawt a, halsianna bel leh chiklak loupa kang a kipan bang in.
"Ahu in suang akuangsak a, akam a pan meikuang apawtkhia hi.
Angawng ah hatna a-om gige a, ama ah lauhuaina alam hi.
Asa thate akizomkhawm ua, atung ah akip ua; hihtat theih in a-om kei uh.
Alungtang suang bang in akip a; ahi, buhgawina suang nuainung bang ahi.
Amah athoh chiang in, mihatte alau uh; lauh luatna ziak in omdan ding athei kei uh.
Mi'n amah namsau in satleh, aphatuam kei hi; teipi hiam, thal hiam, sikmuk zum hiam in leng.
Buhpawl bang in sik asim a, sing muatsa bang in dalsik.
Thal in amah ataisak thei kei ding; amah lak ah vaisuanglot suangte buhpawl asuak hi.
"Khetbukte buhpawl bang a sim ahi. Teipi ging anuihsan hi.
Anuailam pangte belpei ahi, buannawi tung ah buhkhetna chiang bang in akiphah hi.
Tui thukte belpi sou bolhbolh ding in abawl a, tuipi nuh theih bawm in abawl hi.
Anung ah lampi avaksak a; tui thuk samkang nei asa uhi.
Leitung ah amah bang a lauh nei lou a-om kei a,
Thil sang chiteng a-en a, kisathei tapate tengteng tung ah kumpipa ahi."
Huchi in Job in TOUPA dawng hichi in achi.
"Thil bangkim na hihthei chih leh nang thiltup kham theih ahi kei chih ka thei hi.
Hiai thuhilhna theihna tel lou a sel kua ahia? Huaiziak in ka theihsiam louh, ka theih louh, kei a dia thillamdang luate ka genkhia hi.
"Za in, ka hon ngen ahi, ka pau ding; nang ka hon phut ding, kei lam ah nang puang in, na hon chi hi.
Zakna bil in nang ka hon za a; himahleh tu in ka mit in ka hon mu a,
Huaiziak in ka kikih a, leivui leh meivu ah ka kisik hi."

Huan hichi ahong hi a, huchi a TOUPA'N Job kiang a hiai thute agen khit in, TOUPA'N Teman mi Eliphaz kiang ah, "Ka hehna nang tung leh na lawm nihte tung ah akuang, ka sikha Job bang a noute'n ka tanchin thil dik na gen louh ziak un," achi hi.

"Huaiziak in tu in, bawngtal sagih leh belamtal sagih la unla, ka sikha Job kiang ah hoh unla, nou a ding in halmang thillat lan un; huchi in noute a ding in ka sikha Job athum ding a; amah vang in ka sang dia, huchi in na haina uh dungzui in na tung uah ka hih kei ding; ka sikha Job bang in lah ka tanchin thil dik na gen kei uh," chi in.
Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz leh Shuah mi Bildad leh Naamath mi Zophar akuan ua, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi. TOUPA'N Job asangta hi.
Alawmte a dia Job athum zoh in TOUPA'N Job saltanna akiheisak a, TOUPA'N Job ama a aneih zahnih apeta hi.

Huai lai in akiang ah, a-unaute tengteng leh asanggamnute tengteng leh tuma lam a amel theihsa tengteng leh a-insung a tanghou amah toh nete ahong pai ua, amah anem ua, TOUPA'N atung a hoih lou atunsak tengteng tungtang thu ah amah alungmuan uhi. Michih in leng ama sum leh michih in dangka-eng bilbah apia uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Job tawpna lam a kipatna lam sang in anak vualzawl zaw hi. Belam singkhat-le-sangli leh sangawngsau sangguk leh bawngtal sangkhat leh sabengtungnu sangkhat anei hi.
Tapa sagih leh tanu thum leng anei hi.
Amasapen, Jemima achi a; anihna min, Kezia; athumna min, Keren-happuk.
Huchi in gamsung pumpi ah Job tanute bang a melhoih a-om kei uh; apa un a-unaute lak ah goutan amaute apia hi.
Huai nung in Job, kum za-le-sawmli adam a, atapate leh atapate' tapate, khang lina tan amu hi.
Huchi in Job atek mahmah a, a-upat tak ziak in asita hi.
"Tu in sam in; nang hon dawng kua a-om a? Misiangthoute lak ah akua lam na nga dia?
Lungzinna in lah mihai athat a, huan thikna in mimawl athat sek hi.
Mihai zungkai ka muta a; himahleh thakhat in atenna aka hamsiat hi.
Bitna a kipan gamlapi ah atate a-om ua, kongpi ah hihgawp in a-om uh, kuamah amaute hunkhe ding a-om kei uhi.
Agilkial in ling lak a kipan nangawn a-an kaihkhawm agaihsak a, suamhat in aneih-le-lam anawmvalhsak hi.
Gimthuakna leivui a kipan in ahong pawt kei a, lei a kipan in buaina leng ahong dawnkhe sam kei hi.
Himahleh mihing buai ding mah apiang ahi, mei-ekte atoulen bang in.
"Himahleh ke'n ahihleh, Pathian lam ah ka zong ding a, Pathian kiang ah ka thu ka koih ding hi.
Thil thupite hihpa leh zonkhiak theih louh; sim zoh louh thillamdangte,
leitung a vuah pepa leh, loute tung a tui sawlpa.
Huchi in ama'n aniamsate tungsang ah akoihtou a; misi suunte muanna ah atawisang hi.
Zekhem hatte lunggelte bangmah lou asuaksak a, huchi in akhutte un athiltup uh ahihthei kei uhi.
Mipilte akhemhatna un aman a, mihoihloute thilgel athalpaihsak hi.
Sun lai in khomialna athuak ua, zan lai bang in suntang lai in amai maimah uhi.
Himahleh ama'n gentheite mihatte kam leh khut a kipan leh tasamte mahmah namsau a kipan ahondam hi.
Huchi in mizawng in lametna anei а, thulimlouhna in akam ahumsak hi.
"Ngai in, Pathian in abawlhoih mi in nuam asa hi; huaiziak in Bangkim hihthei sawina musit ke'n.
Ama'n lah meima abawl a, atuam a, aliamsak a, akhut in adamsak hi.
Buaina guk ah ahon suaktasak ding a; ahi, sagih ah gilou in nang ahon khoih kei ding hi.
Kial chiang in nang sihna a kipan ahon tan ding; namsau thilhihtheihna a kipan, kidou chiang in.
Kam sung a leizepna a kipan ahon sel ding a; siatna ahong tun chiang in na lau sam kei ding hi.
Siatna leh kialna ah na nui ding a, lei gamsate na kihta kei ding hi.
Gam a suangte toh na kithuahtheih ding ziak un; huan gam a gamsate nang toh na kituak ding uhi.
"Na puanin muang in a-om chih na thei ding a; na ganhuang na veh ding a, bangmah kim lou a-om kei ding hi.
Na chite leng athupi ding a, na suante lei a loupa bang in a-om ding uh chih na thei ding hi.
Kum ching in na hankhuk na zuan ding a, ahun a buhlak a-om bang in.
Ngai in, hiai thu i zongta ua, adik mah ahi, za in na hoihna ding in thei in."
Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Aw ka lungzinna kibuk thei hi henla, ka tuahsiatna selbukna ah kikoihkhawm thei hileh!
Tu in tuipite a piaunel sang in agikzaw ding: huaiziak in ka thugente leng akhauh hi.
Bangkim hihthei thalte lah ka sung ah a-om ngal a, agu uh huai a kipan a ka kha in adawnvek; kei dou ding in Pathian mulkimhuainate akivual uhi.
"Anek ding loupa mu, gam sabiltung aham a hia? Ahihkeileh gan an mu bawngtal aham a hia?
Chi tel lou in gim nei lou akine thei dia hia? Ahihkeileh aktuida ah limna mawngmawng a-om a hia?
Ka kha in amaute akhoih nuam kei; kei a ding in an kihhuai bang ahi uhi.
"Aw ka nget tang thei leng zaw; ka thil deih Pathian in hon phalleh zaw.
Kei hon hihgawp ding in Pathian deihlam hi lai henla; akhut zan in, kei hon satkhe maileh.
Huchi in lungmuanna ka nei lai dia; ahi, damlou natna ah ka kipak ding hi; Mi Siangthou thute ka kitheihmohbawl ngal kei a.
Ka hatna bang ahia, ka ngak ding? Huan ka beina bang ahia, ka kuhkal ding?
Ka hatna suangte hatna hi hia? Ahihkeileh ka sa dalsik hia?
Kei ah panpihna a-om het kei a, kei a kipan theihsiamna hawlmang in.
"Bah dia mansa a om kiang ah alawm in siamna a-etsak ding ahi kei maw; huchi lou in Bangkim hihthei kihtakna tawpsan ahi kei ding maw.
Luita bang in ka unaute alepchiah uh; luita mangthang luanna bang in.
Huai tui khal ziak a vom a; huai a vukkhal akisel.
Alum hun chiang in atuimang ua, asat chiang in amun ua kipan amangthang uhi.
Huai lampi a khualzinte a pial ua, bangmah omlouhna mun ah apaitou ua, amangthang uh.
Tema khualzinte'n azong ua, Sheba pawlte'n alamen uh.
Akilamet hang un azahlak uh; huai lam ah ava pai ua azahlak uh.
Tu in bangmah na hi ngal kei ua; mulkimhuaina na mu ua, na lau uhi.
Kei hon pia un? Ahihkeileh na neih-le-lam ua kipan in kei a ding in thilpiak lan un, ka chi hia?
Ahihkeileh, melma khut a pan hon tan un, mihat khut a pan hon hukhia un ka chi hia?
"Hon sinsak in, huan ka dai ding: ka diklouhna hon theisiamsak un.
Thudikna thute hat hi nah e: himahleh miselna in bang aselphou a?
Thute selphou ding a um na hi uhia? Chimoh mi thugente huih bang ahi chih thei in.
Ahi, pa neiloute tung ah ai na san ua, na lawm uh sumsinna van in na bawl uh.
Tu in hehpih in hon en un; na ma uah thuzuau ka gen kei a.
Kik nawn un ka hon ngen ahi, diklouhna om kei hen; ahi, kik nawn un, ka thu adik ahi.
Ka lei ah diklouhna a-om hia? Ka lei in thil hoih lou atheikak thei kei dia hia?"
"Leitung ah mihing a ding in kidouna a-om kei maw? Anite kilohmi nite bang ahi kei a hia?
Limliap deih mahmah sikha bang in, aloh lamen kilohmi bang in.
Huai bang in bangmah lou khate nei ding a bawl ka hi, huan kei a ding in zan chimhuaite seh ahi.
Ka lup chiang in, chikchiang in ka thou dia? ka chi a; himahleh zan asawt hi; lehlam lehlam ah nisuah matan kilumlet in ka om hi.
Ka sa than leh leivui khal in atuam a; ka vun kimat in apuakkham hi.
Ka nite siamganmi khohthei sang in akinzaw a, lametna bei a zatbei ahi.
"Aw ka hinna huih ahi chih theigige in; ka mit in hoih amu nawn kei ding hi.
Kei hon mu mit in ahon en thei nawnta kei ding a; ka tung ah na mitte a-om ding ua himahleh ka omta kei ding hi.
Meipi mangthang a-om nawn louh bang in, huchi in kuapeuh Sheol a paisuk ahong paitou nawnta kei uhi.
A-inn ah akik nawn kei ding a, amun in amah athei nawn kei ding hi.
Huaiziak in ka kam ka khou kei ding a; ka lungsim gimna ah thu ka gen ding; haksatna ah ka kha ka phun ding hi.
"Tuipi ka hi hia, ahihkeileh tua tuipi ngapi lian ka hi a hia, huchi a kei na hon chin nak?
Ka lupna in hon lungmuan ding a, ka tutna nem in ka phunna azangkhaisak ding, ka chih chiang in.
Huai chiang in mang in na hon lausak a, mengmuhna in na hon mulkimsak hi.
Huchi in ka kha in heklup leh sihna atel a, hiai ka guhte sang in.
Ka hinna ka chimtak a; ka hing gige kei ding, hon omsak maimai un; ka nite lah bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
"Mihing bang ahia, hichi tel a na pahtawi ding a, amah tung a na lungtang na koih ding?
Zingsang teng a amah na veh a, mitphiat kal chih a amah na ettel ding?
Bang tan vei kei hon lehngatsan lou ding na hia, bang tan vei ka chil ka nawmvalh matan hon omsak maimai lou ding na hia?
Na khial hi taleng, na tung ah bang ka hih a, Aw mite chingpa nangmah? Bangziak a nang a dia chiamtehna bang a hon koih na hia, huchi a keimah a dia puakgik ka hih maimah?
Bangziak a ka tatlekna ngaidam lou a, ka thulimlouhna lamang lou oi? Kei tu in leivui a lum ding ka hi a; kuhkaltak in na hon zong dia, himahleh ka omta kei ding hi."
Huchi in Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Bang tan hiai thilte gen ding na hia? Bang tan na kam a thute huih hat bang ding ahi ua?
Pathian in vaihawmna ahekkawi a hia? Ahihkeileh Bangkim hihthei in dikna ahekkawi ahia?
Atung ah na tate akhial ua, huai tatlekna ziak a akhut a amaute apikhiakleh,
Pathian lam kuhkaltak a na zon a, huai Bangkim hihthei kiang a na thilnget na bawlleh;
Na sianthou a na dikleh; nang ziak in tu in ka khanglou dia, na diktatna omna alohchingsak ding hi.
Na kipatna neu mahleh, na tawpna nanung lam nakpi in athupi ding hi.
"Huaiziak in ka hon ngen hi, hun masa thu kan inla, apipute un ana zonkhiak uh lam ah kisuk in.
Ei lah zan a lel i hi ua, bangmah i thei kei uh, leitung ah i nite uh lah limliap ahi a.
Amaute'n nang ahon sinsak un, ahon hilh un, alungtang ua kipan in thute agen kei ding ua hia?
Buannawi lou in phaiphek akhangkhe thei a hia? Tui lou in loupa akhangthei a hia?
Hing a om a, satpuk louh ahih lai in, loupa dangte ma in avuai nak hi.
Huai bang mah in Pathian mangngilhte tengteng lampi ahi; Pathian limsakloumi lametna amangthang ding:
Amuanna akitan ding a, akingakna maimomlen ahi hi.
A-inn tung ah akingai dia, himahleh adingh kei ding; huai ah alen tinten ding a, himahleh apang sawt kei ding hi.
"Nisuah ma in ahing a, ahuan ah aselte amengkhia uhi.
Azungte leivum kim ah azam ua, suangte omna mun ah ahing hi.
Amun a kipan lakmang hileh, huchi in amah akitheihmohbawl ding a, Ka hon mu ngei kei, chi in.
Ngai in, hiai alampi kipahna ahi a, lei a kipan adangte ahong suak ding uh.
Ngai in, Pathian in mihoihkim apaikhe kei ding, gilou hih mite leng atungding sam kei ding hi.
Na kam nuih in ahon dimsak lai dia, na mukte kikouna in.
Hon mudahte zumna in akhuh ding a; gilou puanin a-omta kei ding hi.”
Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Chihtaktak in huchi ahi chih ka thei hi, himahleh Pathian lak ah mihing bangchi in adik thei dia?
Amah kiselpih a-utlam ahihleh, sangkhat lak a khatvei zong amah adawng thei kei ding hi.
Amah lungtang in apil a, hatna in thil ahihthei ahi, amah dou in kua akikhauhsak in, alohchingta a oi?
"Mualte asuan a, athei kei ua, heh a amaute alumleh lai in.
Amun a kipan in lei asing a, huan huai a khuamte aling uhi.
Nisa thu apia a, asuak kei; aksite abilhkhum ngiungiau hi.
Amah kia'n vante aphalhkhia a, tuipi kihot tung ah apai hi.
Ama'n Zangkhua, Zuheisuktun, Siguk leh simlam aksi munte abawl hi.
Ama'n sui theih vual louh thil thupite sim zoh louh thillamdangte ahih hi.
"Ngai in, ka kiang ah apai a, amah ka mu kei, apai lailai a, himahleh amah ka mu kei hi.
Ngai in, alamang a, amah kua'n akham thei dia? Bang hih na hia? Kua'n akiang ah achi dia?
Pathian in ahehna alakik kei ding; Rahab panpih mite amah nuai ah akun petmah uhi.
Bangchi phet a tawmzaw in amah ka dawng in, amah toh ngaihtuah ding in ka thute ka telkhe dia hia?
Diktat himah leng amah ka dawng kei ding hi; ka thukhentu kiang ah thilngetna ka bawl thei lel ding hi.
"Amah sam in hon dawng mahleh; ka aw angaikhia chih ka um kei ding hi.
Huihpi in ahon kitamsak a, asan om lou in ka liamnate apungsak hi.
Ka nak ahon phal kei a, himahleh thangpaihna in hon dimsak hi.
Hatna thu gen leng, ngai in, Amah ahat hi, vaihawmna thu, kua'n hun ahon pe dia?
Kidiktatsak leng, ka kam mah in ahon mohpaih hi, hoihkim ka hi, kichi taleng, hoih lou in ahon telsak ding hi.
Hoihkim mah leng, ka kilimsak kei; ka hinna ka musit hi.
"Akibang ahi vek a; huaiziak in ke'n hoihkim leh gilou ahihse tuak, ka chi hi.
Jepna in thakhat in thatleh, mihoih thuakna anuihsan ding hi.
Lei migilou khut a piak a a-om chiang in huai a vaihawmte amaituam a; amah ahihkeileh, kua ahita dia?
Tu in ka nite laihawmmi sang in akinzaw a ataimang ua, hoih amu kei uh.
Long kinte bang in apaimang ua, muvanlai samat tung a ngumkiak bang in.
Ka phunna ka mangngilh dia, ka mel lungkham ka pai dia, ka kipak ding, chi leng.
"Ka lungkhamna tengteng ka lau a, hoih na hon sa kei ding chih ka thei hi.
Mohpaih in ka om dia; bangziak a athawn a semgim ka hia?
Vuk tui in kisil in, ka khutte siangsak kei leng;
Hinapi in phaizang ah na hon pailut dia, keimah puante'n ahon kih ding uhi.
"Kei bang in amah lah mihing ahi kei a, amah ka dawn theih a, vaihawmna a ka hohkhawm theihna ding un.
Ka kikal uah kou gel hon mattheihna ding in, thulai genmi a-om kei hi.
Kei a pan in achiang lamang henla akihtakhuaina in kei hon lausak kei hen.
Huai chiang in thu ka gen dia, amah ka lau kei ding: keimah ah huchibang ka hi ngal kei hi."
Pethuel tapa Joel kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
Putekte aw, hiai za un; hiai, nou hun lai leh na pute uh hun lai in a-om kha ngeita a hia?
Huai pen na tate uh hilh unla, na tate un amau tate hilh uhenla, ata nawnte un suan dang hilhsawn zel uhen.
Singnget khaupe in anek bang teng khaukhuphon in ane a, khaukhuphon in anek bang teng khaupehon in ane a; khaupehon in anek bang teng khaupenouhon in ane khinta hi.
Nou zukhamte aw, halh unla kap un; uain dawn tengteng aw, a- uain khum ziak in kap vongvong un; na kam ua kipan lah uain lakmang ahita ngal a.
Nam hat mahmah, sim seng louh in ka gam ahong douta uh, ahate humpinelkai liante ha ahi a, humpinelkai pite hapak anei hi.
Ka grepgui ahihsia a, ka theipi sing hawng akheuh a, akheuhsiang vek a, apaimang a; ahiangte akiatngou vek hi.
Nungak in, sai-ip puan teng a, atuailai pasal asuun bang in kap vongvong un.
Tangbuang latte, dawn ding latte TOUPA' inn a kipan hihman ahi a; siampu TOUPA nasemte alungkham uhi.
Lou hihsiat ahi a, gam alungkham a; buh hihsiat ahi a, uain thak akang a, sathau aginata kei hi.
Aw, nou lounei mite aw, suun unla; aw, nou grepgui kem mite aw, huit buh leh barli buh ziak in dah in mau tuaituai un; lou a buhlak ding amangthang vekta hi.
Grepgui avuai a, theipi kung avuai a; theibuhfai zung, tum leh epul theikung, lou a sing tengteng leng avulta hi; mihing tate lak a kipahna lah avuaimangta ngal a.

Nou siampute aw, sai-ip puan teng unla kap un; nou maitam nasem mite aw, chiau vengvung un; nou ka Pathian nasem mite aw, hong pai unla, sai-ip puan silh in zankhua in hong lum un; na Pathian inn ua pan tangbuang lat leh dawn ding lat lah kham ahita ngal a.
An ngawl hun tang siangthou in, khawmpi taksuak bawl unla, TOUPA na Pathian inn ah putekte leh hiai gam a teng mi tengteng pikhawm unla, TOUPA sam un.
Huai ni atung agik hi; TOUPA ni lah anai ngal a, Bangkim hihtheipa a kipan manthatna ahong tung ding hi.
Ka mitmuh in nek ding hihman ahi kei a hia, ahi, i nopna leh i kipahna i Pathian inn a kipan hihman ahi kei a hia?
Leikhal nuai ah haichitang amuat a; pangte lah akigawp a, buh innte phel in a-om a, abuhte avuaita uhi.
Gante nak thum hi na tel uh e! Bawnghonte abuaizak ua, loupa hing mun aneih louh ziak un; ahi, belamhonte asegawp uhi.
Aw, TOUPA ka hon sam hi, mei in gamdai gam loupa mun akangsiangta a, meikuang in gam a sing tengteng akangsiangta hi.
Ahi, gamsate nang hon ngai in anak huhu ua; luitate akangtat a, mei in gamdai gam loupa mun akangsiangta hi.
Zion ah pengkul mut unla, ka tang siangthou ah kigalginna puang un; hiai gamsung a mi tengteng ling uhen; TOUPA ni hong tung ding, anaita hi.

Mialna leh khonimna ni, mei kai ni leh mial sah ni, tangte tung a phalvak tangkhia bang a mipi tampitak leh hattak, huchibang om ngei nai lou, tunung a suan tampi tan a leng om nawn ngei sam lou ding ahong tung ding hi.
Amaban uh mei in akangsiang a; anunglam uh meikuang in ahul a; ama ua gam lah Eden huan bang ahi, anunglam ua gamdai gamkeu ahi a; ahi, bangmah in huai apel kei uh.
Alatdan uh sakol latdan bang ahi; sakol tungtuangmi bang in atai uhi.
Kidouna kangtalai ging bang in tang tung ah akilek suausuau ua, buhpawl kang kuang luahluah leh kidouna a mipi hattak mansa abang uhi.
Amaute mu mipite alau ua; amelte uh ahong mual khin uhi.
Mihattak bang in atai ua; kidoumi bang in baang ah akah ua, amau zawn chiat ah apai ua, akivolhdan uh ahihbuai kei uhi.
Akiphu kha tuan kei ua; amau lampi ah apai chiat ua; galvante anawk paisuak ua, apialzak kei uh.
Khopi tung ah atawm ua; kulh tung ah atai ua; insungte ah akaltou ua; guta bang in tohlette ah alut uhi.
Ama uah lei aling a; vante aling hi; ni leh kha amial a, aksite'n avak uh asel uhi;
Huan TOUPA'N asepaihhonte ma ah a-aw asuah a; agiahbukte lah athupi ngal a; athu tangtungsakpa ahat a, TOUPA ni athupi in amulkimhuai ngal a, kua'n athuak thei mahmah dia?
TOUPA'N, huchipi in leng tu in na lungtang tengteng ua an ngawl a, kap a, lungkham in kei lam hong nga le uchin.
Na puante uh hilou in na lungtang uh botkek unla, TOUPA na Pathian lam nga un; amah hehpih theitak leh lainatna a dim, lungnel leh zahngaihna hau, thil hoih lou a kipan kik nawn sek ahi, achi hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un lungsim kihei in tangbuang leh dawn ding thillat ah vualzawlna nutsiat in a-om kei ding chih kua'n athei a?
Zion ah pengkul mut unla, an ngawl hun tang siangthou un, khawmpi taksuaktak bawl un.
Mipi kaikhawm unla, omkhawmte hihsiangthou unla, putekte, naupangte, nawitui ne laite kaikhawm unla; mouneite adantan a kipan in hong pawt uhenla, mou leng adantan sunggil a kipan in hong pawt hen.

Siampu, TOUPA nasem mite inlim leh maitam kikal ah kap uhenla; TOUPA aw, "Na mite hawi inla, na goutante gensiat a om namte'n atung ua vai ahawmsak ding un pe ke'n; 'A Pathian uh koi a om ahia,' chi in amipite lak ah bangziak a chi ding ahi ua?" chi uhen.
TOUPA'N agam thikthuse khop in adeihthoh a, amite ahehpih hi.
TOUPA'N amite kiang ah, Ngai unla, na kiang uah buhte, uainte, sathaute ka hon tungsak ding a, huaite in na tai ding ua; namte lak ah gensiat in ka hon omsak nawn kei ding.

Himahleh na kiang ua kipan in mallam sepaihhon ka suanmang ding a, gamkeu leh sia ah ka paisak ding, amasa pawl suahlam tuipi ah, ananung pawl tumlam tuipi ah; ahong uihkhe ding a, namsetak in ahong nam ding, thil thupitak ahih ziak in, chi in adawng hi.
Aw gam, lau ke'n, nuam in kipak in; TOUPA'N thil thupite ahihta hi.
Gante aw, lau kei un, gamdai loupa mun ahong sel a, sing ahong gah a, theipi kung leh grepgui ahong selpha ding hi.
Nou, Zion tate aw, kipak un, TOUPA na Pathian uah nuam un; noute a ding in vuah azusak a, akha khatna a vuah masa leh vuah nanung ahun lel ahon pe ding hi.
Pialkhangte buh in adim ding a, uain leh sathau belte adimlet ding uhi.
Na lak ua ka sepaihhon tampi ka sawl, khaukhupte, singnget khaute, khauhonte, leh khaupete'n anek khit kumte nou ka hon din nawn ding hi.
Tampi na ne ding ua, na tai ding ua, nou lamdangtak a hon ngaihtuah sekpa TOUPA na Pathian min na phat ding uh; ka mite azahlak ngei kei uhi.
Huan Israelte lak ah ka om chih leh TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, kuamah dang a-om kei uh chih na thei ding uh; ka mite azahlak ngei nawn kei ding uhi.

Huai nung chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, mi tengteng tung ah ka kha ka sung ding; huchi in na tapate, na tanute un ka thu agen ding ua, na putekte un mang aman ding ua, na tangvalte un kilaknate amu ding uh;
Huai ni chiang in sikhapate, sikhanute tung ah leng ka kha ka sungbo ding hi.
Vante leh leitung ah thillamdangte, sisan, mei leh meikhu ding ka musak ding hi.
Nisa mial asuak ding a, kha sisan asuak ding hi, TOUPA ni thupitak leh mulkimhuai ahong tun ma in.
Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, kuapeuh TOUPA min lou peuhmah humbit in a-om ding; TOUPA'N agen bang in, Zion tang ah leh Jerusalem khua ah akhosuaksunte a-om ding uhi.
Ngai dih ua, huai nite leh huai hun a, Judah leh Jerusalem saltangte ka kaihkhop hun chiang in,

nam chih ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute Jehoshaphat Phaizang ah ka pisuk ding hi. Huai ah, nam chih lak a athehdalh uh, ka mi, ka goutan Israelte tung a agamtatna uh leh, ka gam akihawmna ziak un, atung uah amaute toh thukhenna ka bawlpih ding;
ka mite a ding in ai asan ua, kizuakna man ding in pasal naupang apia ua, uain adawntheihna ding un, aman ding in numei naupang azuak uhi.

"Ahi, aw Tura leh Sidon leh Philistia gam tengteng aw, kei a ding in bang na hi ua le? Na thuk ding ua hia? N'on thuk uleh, hattak in, kintak in na thukna uh na lutung mahmah uah ka hon thuk sam ding hi.
Ka dangkasik leh adangka-eng na la ua, ka thil hoihtak deihhuaite na tempul sung uah na tawilut uhi;
Judah tate leh Jerusalem tate leng agamgi ua kipan gamlapi a na suanmang theihna ding un, Grik tapate kiang ah na zuakta uhi.
Ngai dih ua, na zuakna mun ua kipan in tokthou in ka pawtsak ding a, na thukna uh na lutung mahmah uah ka thuk sam ding hi.
Judah tate khut ah na tapate uh leh na tanute uh ka zuak ding, amau gamlapi ah Sheba mite kiang ah azuak ding uhi," TOUPA'N achita hi.
Namte lak ah hiai puang unla; kidou ding in kisa unla; mihat mahmahte tokthou un; kidoumi tengtengte hong nai uhenla, hong paitou uhen.
Na leilehna mukzumte uh namsau ding in sek unla, teipi ding in na theikung kuaika temtate uh sek un; mihat lou in leng ka hat chi hen.
Akim a nam tengteng aw, kin unla, hong pai unla kikaikhawm un; Aw TOUPA, huai ah na mihat mahmahte paisuksak in.
Namte kitokthou uhenla Jehoshaphat Phaizang ah hong paitou uhen; huai ah akim a nam tengteng tung a vaihawm ding in ka tu ding hi.
Na kawite uh suah un, buhlak ahun hi; hong pai unla, childen un; grep sukna khuk adim a, bel adimlet a; akhelhna uh athupi hi.
Mipi tampite, thukhenna phaizang a mipi tampite! Thupukna Phaizang ah, TOUPA ni anaita hi!
Ni leh kha hihmial in om ding ua, aksite'n avakna uh asel ding uh.

TOUPA Zion tang a kipan in ahumham ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in a-aw asuah ding; leitung leh vante aling ding ua; himahleh TOUPA zaw amite a ding in kihumbitna leh Israel suante a ding in insang ahi ding hi.
Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh ka tang siangthou Zion a teng ka hi chih na thei ding uh; huchi in Jerusalem asiangthou ding a, mikhual kuamah apaisuak nawn kei ding.

Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, tang sangte'n uain khum akaisak ding ua, nawitui in mualte aluang ding a; TOUPA' inn a kipan in tuikhuk ahong kikhohkhe ding a, Shittim lui phaizang anomsak ding hi.
Judah tate tung ah engbawltak a agam ua sisan asuah ziak un, Aigupta asegawp ding a, Edom gam gamdai gamkeu asuak ding hi.
Judah gam tangtawn in luah in a-om gige ding a, Jerusalem khua suan a kipan suan zel tan in luah in a-om ding.
Huan asisan suahna uh ka sawpsiang louh ka sawpsiang ding a, Zion ah TOUPA ateng gige hi.
Atung in Thu a-om a, Thu tuh Pathian kiang ah a-om, huai Thu Pathian ahi.
Huai Thu mah atung in Pathian kiang ah a-om hi.
Bangkim avek in ama siam ahi; thilsiam tengteng amah siam louh bangmah a-om kei.
Amah ah hinna a-om, huai hinna mihingte vakna ahi.
Mial lak ah vak ahong vak a; mial in huai azou kei hi.
Pathian sawl mi khat a-om a, amin Johan ahi.
Huai mi theihpihtu hi ding in ahong, huai vak toh kisai theihpih ding in, amah tawn a mi tengteng in agintak theihna ding un.
Amah bel vak ahi kei a, vak thu theihpih ding a hong ahi zaw hi.
Vak diktak, michih kiang a vakna pia, khovel ah ahong pailel ahi.
Amah khovel ah a-om, khovel ama siam ahi, hinapi in khovel in amah athei kei hi.
Ama mite kiang ah ahong a, amite mahmah in ana pom kei uhi.
Himahleh amah kipahpih a pom, amin gingtate tengteng kiang ah Pathian tate suahtheihna apia a:
amaute sisan hiam, sa deihna hiam, mihing deihna hiam hilou in, Pathian suan a piang ahi zaw uhi.
Huai Thu tuh sa ahong suak a, i lak uah ahong teng a, hehpihna leh thutak a dim in; athupina Pa Tapa tang neihsun thupina bangbang i muta uhi.
Johan in amah theihpihna apia a, "Ka nung a hong paipa'n hon paikheng, amah ka ma a omsa him ahih ziak in, chi a athu ka genpa hiai ahi," achi hi.
Huan eite'n ataangchinna a kipan hehpihna tung a hehpih nawnsawnna i tang chiat uhi.
Mosi zang a Dan piak ahi a, himahleh Jesu Khrist ziak in hehpihna leh thutak ahong om hi.
Kuamah in chik lai mah in Pathian amu ngei kei; Tapa tang neihsun, Pa angsung a om in theihtheih in amah abawlta hi.
Huan Judate'n, "Kua na hia?" chi a dong ding a, Jerusalem a kipan akiang a siampute leh Levi chi a mite asawl lai un hiaite Johan thu na theihsak ahi uhi.
Ama'n chiangtak in agen a, "Khrist ka hi kei hi," chi in apulak hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Kua na hia le? Elijah na hi hia?" achi ua, adong uhi. Huan ama'n, "Ka hi kei," achi hi. "Huai zawlnei na hi hia?" achi ua. Ama'n, "Hilou e,” chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah ahihleh, "Kua na hia? Hon sawlte ka dawntheihna ding un hon hilh in; na tanchin himhim bang ahia na gen ding?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, zawlnei Isai gen bang in, "Toupa lampi hihtang un, chi a, gamdai a kikoupa aw ka hi," achi hi.
Amisawlte uh Pharisaite kiang a kipan kuate hiam ahi uhi.
Amau akiang ah, "Khrist bek, Elijah bek, zawlnei bek na hih kei ngalleh bang achia baptis nak na hia le?" achi ua, adong nawn uhi.
Johan in akiang uah, "Ke'n tui in ka hon baptis a, na lak uah mi khat na theih louh uh adingh ahi,
mah ahi ka nung a hong pai dingpa, ka ma a omsa pen, akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei," chi in adawng hi.
Hiaite Jordan gal a Bethani a Johan in abaptisna mun a thil tung ahi.
Huan azing in Johan in akiang a hong pai Jesu amu a, agen a, "En un, Pathian Belamnou khovel khelhna lamangpa!
Hiai ahi amah, mi khat ka nung a hong paipa, ka ma a omsa him ahi, ka chihpa.
Amah lah ka na thei ngal kei a; himahleh Israelte kiang a amah latsak ahihna ding in tui a baptis in ka hong pai ahi,” achi hi.
Huan Johan in athu atheisak a, "Vakhu bang in van a kipan Kha hong suk ka mu a, atung ah a-om nilouh," chi in agen hi.
Amah lah ka thei ngal kei a; himahleh tui a baptis ding a hon sawlpa'n ka kiang ah, "Kua tung ah leng Kha hong suk a atung a om na muh peuh, hiai tuh Kha Siangthou a baptispa ahi, ahon chi hi.
Huai ka muta a, hiai mipa Pathian Tapa ahi chih ka theisakta hi,” achi hi.
Huan azing nawn in anungzui nihte toh Johan adingh a,
Jesu vialvak vak lai a-en a, "En un, Pathian Belamnou!" achi hi.
Anungzui nihte'n athugen aza ua, Jesu azuita uhi.
Jesu akihei a, ahon zui uh amu a, akiang uah, "Bang ahia na zon uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Rabbi (huai tuh Sinsakpa chihna ahi), koi a teng na hia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hong le uchin na mu ding uh," achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai ua, a-omna amu ua; huai hun dak sawmna vel ahih tak ziak in akiang ah huai ni ataam uhi.
Johan thugen za a Jesu zui nihte lak a khat zaw pen Andru, Simon Peter sanggampa ahi.
Ama'n amasapen in amah sanggampa Simon amu a, akiang ah, "Messia ka muta uh," achi a, huai tuh Khrist chihna ahi.
Huchi in Jesu'n amah ana en a, "Johan tapa Simon na hi, Kifas ahon chi ding uh," achi a (huai tuh Peter chihna hi).
Huan azing in Jesu'n Galili gam a hoh atum a, Philip amu a, akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
Philip bel Bethsaida khomi ahi a, Andru leh Peter omna khopi mah ahi.
Philip in Nathanael amu a, akiang ah, atanchin Mosi in dan laibu a agelh leh zawlneite'n agelh uh, "Amah ka muta uhi, Nazaret Jesu, Joseph tapa," achi hi.
Nathanael in akiang ah, "Nazaret ah thil hoih apawt thei a hia?" achi hi. Philip in akiang ah, "Hong pai inla, en in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang a Nathanael hong dek in amu a, atanchin ana gen a, "En un, Israel mitak, khemna himhim nei lou," achi hi.
Nathanael in akiang ah, "Nang bangchidan a hon thei na hia?" achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Philip in nang ahon sap ma a, theipi bul a na om lai in, ka hon mu hi," chi in adawng hi.
Nathanael in akiang ah, "Rabbi, Pathian Tapa na hi, Israelte kumpipa na hi," chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Theipi bul ah nang ka hon mu, na kiang a ka chih ziak in na gingta ahi maw? Hiaite sang a thil thupizaw na mu lai ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jesu mah in akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, van kihong a, Mihing Tapa tung a Pathian angelte kahtou leh kumsuk na mu ding uh," achi hi.
"Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh belam huang kongkhak a lut lou a, lampi dang a kahlutmi guta leh suamhat ahi.
Kuapeuh kongkhak a lut belamchingpa ahi.
Kongkhak ngakpa'n amah ana honsak a; belamte'n a-aw aza uh; ama'n belamte amin un asam chiat a, apikhe zel hi.
Amah a tengteng apawtsaktak in, ama uh akai a, belamte'n amah azui zel ua, a-aw athei uhi.
Midang azui kei ding ua, ataimangsan zaw ding uh; midangte aw atheih louh ziak un,” achi hi.
Hiai gentehna Jesu'n akiang uah agen hi; himahleh bang thu ahia akiang ua agen chih athei kei uhi.
Huchi in Jesu'n akiang uah agen nawn a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kei belam kongkhak ka hi.
Ka ma a hong pai tengteng gutate leh suamhatte ahi vek uh; himahleh belamte'n athu uh angaihsak kei uh.
Kei kongkhak ka hi; keimah a mi alutleh, humbit in a-om ding a, alut in apawt dia, nek ding leng amu ding hi.
Guta zaw, gu ding leh that ding leh hihse ding lou in ahong pai kei; kei ka hihleh hinna aneihna ding ua, tampitak aneihna ding ua hong pai ka hi.
"Kei belamchingpa hoih ka hi; belamchingpa hoih in abelamte a ding in ahinna apia hi.
Kilohmi, belamchingpa tak hilou, belamte amah a hilou in, ngia hong pai amuh in belamte ataisan a; huan ngia in amau akei a, huchi in belamte ahihdalh hi.
Kilohmi ahi a, belamte a ding a deihsakna himhim aneih louh ziak in ataimang hi.
Kei zaw belamchingpa hoih ka hi.
Pa in ahon theih bang in ke'n leng Pa ka thei hi, huan belamte a ding in ka hinna ka pia hi.
Hiai belam huang a lou belam dangte ka nei hi; amau leng ka hon pi ding a, ka aw aza ding ua, hon khat in chingpa khat toh a-omkhawm ding uhi.
"Hiai ziak in Pa'n kei ahon it ahi; lak nawn ding a ka hinna ka piak ding ziak in.
Kuamah in hon laksak kei ding, keimah thuthu in ka pe zaw ding hi. Pe thei ka hi a, la nawn thei leng ka hi. Hiai thupiak ka Pa a pan ka muh ahi,” achi hi.
Hiai thu ziak in Judate akikhen ua, akilang nawnta uhi.
Akhen tampi in, "Dawi zawl ahi, ahai ei ve; bangziak a athu ngaikhia na hi ua?" achi uhi.
Akhen in, "Hiai dawi zawl thute hi kei e. Dawi in mittaw mit ahihvak thei a hia?" achi uhi.
Huan Jerusalem a Latna Ankuanglui lai ahi a, huai hun phalbi lai ahi.
Tempul, Solomon inlim ah Jesu akivialleh hi.
Judate'n hong umkual ua, akiang ah, "Bang tan lakloh tak a hon koih ding na hia? Khrist na hihleh chiantak in hon hilh in," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka hon hilhta a, na gingta tuan kei uh; ka Pa min a thil ka hih hiaite'n ka tanchin atheisak uhi.
Himahleh na gingta kei uhi, ka belam lak a mi na hih louh ziak un.
Ka belamte'n ka aw aza uh, ke'n leng amaute ka thei a, amau ahon zui uhi.
Akiang uah tangtawn hinna ka pia; tangtawn in amangthang himhim kei ding ua, kuamah in ka khut a kipan hon sut sam kei ding hi.
Amau hon pepa ka Pa, mi tengteng sang a thupizaw ahi; kuamah in Pa khut a kipan asut thei kei ding hi.
Kei leh Pa lah pum khat ka hi uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Judate'n adenna ding in suang atawm nawn uhi.
Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, "Pa a kipan nasep hoih tampi ka hon ensak a, huai nasepte lak ah bang nasep ziak in ahia suang a na hon den dek uh?" achi hi.
Judate'n akiang ah, "Nasep hoih ziak in suang in ka hon dengdek kei uh; Pathian na gensiat ziak leh nang mihing hi ngal a, Pathian a na kibawl ziak ahi zaw," chi in adawng uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na dan uah, 'noute pathiante na hi uh ka hon chi,' chih gelh ahi kei a hia?
Pathian thu tunnate bawn pathiante achihleh Laisiangthou bohsiat theih ahi kei hi.
Pathian Tapa ka hi, ka chih ziak in Pa'n aseh a, khovel a asawlpa Pathian na gensia hon chi na hi uh maw?
Ka Pa nasem ka hih keileh hon gingta kei un.
Himahleh sem ka hihleh kei hon gingta kei mah le uchin ka nasepte bek gingta un; huchi a keimah ah Pa a-om chih leh kei Pa ah ka om chih na theihna ua, na theihsiamna ding un," chi in adawng hi.
Huaitak in mat atum nawn ua, himahleh akhut ua kipan asuakta hi.
Jordan lui gal ah Johan in atung a mi abaptisna lam ah apaimang nawn a, huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
Huan akiang ah mi tampi ahong pai ua, "Johan in thillamdang bangmah ahih kei a; himahleh Johan in hiai mi tungtang thu agen peuhmah ana dik mahmah hi," achi uhi.
Huan huai ah mi tampi in amah agingta uhi.
Huan mi khat, Mari leh asanggam Martha omna Bethani khua ah, mi khat amin Lazaras kichi damlou in a-om hi.
Asanggampa Lazaras damlou neinu hiai Mari ahihleh sathau gimnamtui Toupa nuh a, asam a akhete nulnu ahi.
Asanggamnute'n Jesu kiang ah, "Ngai dih Toupa, na it achi ana," chi in mi asawl uhi.
Jesu'n huai azak in, "Hiai natna sihna ding zen ahi kei, Pathian thupina ding ahi zaw hi. Hiai ziak a Pathian Tapa hih thupi ahihtheihna ding in ahi," achi hi.
Martha, asanggamnu, Mari leh Lazaraste Jesu'n a-it hi.
Ama'n china ahi chih azak in, a-omna ngei ah ni nih ataam lai hi.
Huai khit in anungzuite kiang ah, "Judia gam ah i hoh nawn ding uh," achi hi.
Huan nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Rabbi, tuma zek in Judate'n suang a hon den atum ua; huchipi in huai ah na hoh nawn dia hia?" achi ua.
Jesu'n, "Sun in dakkal sawm-le-nih a-om kei a hia? Mi sun a avakleh akisui ngei kei, hiai khovel vak amuh ziak in.
Himahleh mi zan a avakleh akisui hi; amah a vak a-om louh ziak in," chi in adawng hi.
Huai thute agen khit in akiang uah, "I lawmpa Lazaras a-ihmuta; amah phawnghalh ding in ka hoh ding," achi hi.
Huchi in anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Toupa, a-ihmut takleh akhanglou nawn mai na ke," achi uhi.
Jesu'n asih thu gen ahi a; himahleh amau ihmu a atawldam thu gen hiam asa uhi.
Huchi in Jesu'n chiangtak in akiang uah, "Lazaras si ahi, achi a,
huai a ka om louh nou ziak in ka kipak ahi, na gintak theihna ding un; himahleh akiang ah i hoh ding uh," achi hi.
Thomas, Didum achih un, anungzuihpihte kiang ah, "Amah toh i sih samna ding un eite leng i hoh ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Jesu atun in ni li han ah a-omta chih athei hi.
Bethani khua ahihleh Jerusalem kiang a om ahi a, ching sawm-le-nga phial a gamla ahi.
Huchi in asanggampa uh sihna tung a khamuan ding in Judate tampi Martha leh Mari kiang ah ahoh uhi.
Jesu ahong dek chih Martha in azak phet in ava dawn a; Mari bel insung ah atu lailai hi.
Martha in Jesu kiang ah, "Toupa, hiai a om hi lechin zaw, ka sanggampa si lou ding hi a.
Tu'n ah leng Pathian kiang a na nget peuhmah Pathian in nang hon pe ding chih ka thei," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na sanggampa athounawn ding," achi hi.
Martha in akiang ah, "Nitawp ni chiah, thohnawnna ah, athounawn ding chih ka thei,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kei thohnawnna leh hinna ka hi; kuapeuh hon gingta si mahleh ahing gige ding.
Ahing peuhmah a, ahon gingta peuhmah tangtawn in asi kei ding; huai thu na gingta hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Gingta e, Toupa, Khrist, Pathian Tapa, khovel a hong pai dingpa na hi chih ka gingta hi," achi hi.
Huan huai thu agen khit in akuan a, asanggamnu Mari asim sap a, "Sinsakpa hiai ah a-om a, nang ahon samsak,” achi hi.
Ama'n huai azaktak in, adingkhe pah a, akiang ah ava hoh hi.
Khua ah Jesu alut nai kei a, Martha in ava dawn lai a a-omna ngei ah a-om lai hi.
Huan insung a amah khamuan a ompih Judate'n Mari dingkhe pah a pawt amuhtak un, han a kap ding a hoh dek hi in teh, chi in azui uhi.
Huan Jesu omna ah Mari ava tung a, amah amuhtak in, akhebul a bokkhup in akiang ah, "Toupa, hiai a om hi lechin zaw, ka sanggampa si lou ding hi a," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n Mari kap leh ahon zui Judate kap amu a, alung akhoih mahmah a, kha in amau hi.
Huan ama'n, "Amah koi a sial na hi ua?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Toupa hong pai inla, hong en in," achi uhi.
Jesu akapta.
Judate'n, "En dih uh, Lazaras it hi na tel e," achi uhi.
Himahleh khenkhat in, "Hiai mi, mittaw mit hihvakpa'n, hiai mi leng asi lousak thei kei a eita?" achi uhi.
Huan Jesu nakpi in amau nawn a, han atung hi. Huai han kokhuk, suang a sit ahi.
Jesu'n, "Suang hemkhia un,” achi hi. Asipa sanggamnu Martha in akiang ah, "Toupa, tu'n zaw anamta ding, asihna ni li ahita," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, na gintakleh Pathian thupina na mu ding, ka hon chi kei a hia? achi hi. Huchi in suang ahemkhia uhi.
Huchi in Jesu avandak a, "Pa ka thu na ngaihkhiak ziak in na tung ah ka kipak hi.
Ka thu na ngaikhe zel chih ka thei; himahleh, mipi dinghte ziak in hiai ka chi ahi nang na hon sawl chih agintak theihna ding un," achi hi.
Huan huchi a apau khit in aw ngaihtak in, "Lazaras, hong pawt in," chi in akikou hi.
Huan misi akhut akhe, han puan a tuamsa in ahong pawtta a, amai leng kinulna puan a tuam ahi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Phel unla, paisak un," achi hi.
Huchi in Mari kiang a hong pai Jesu thilhih mu, Judate akhen tampi in Jesu agingta uhi.
Himahleh, akhen Pharisaite kiang ah ava hoh ua, akiang uah Jesu thilhihte ava hilh uhi.
Huchi in siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n vaihawmte asamkhawm ua, "Bangchi in i hih ding ua? Hiai mi'n thillamdang tampi ahih ngal a, achi uhi.
Hichibang a i khahzan un zaw mi tengteng in amah agingta ding ua; Rome mite hong pai in, i mun leh i namte ahong laksak tuak ding uh," achi uhi.
Huan alak ua mi khat Kaiapha, huai kum a siampu lianpen in akiang uah, "Nou bangmah thei kei uteh,
i nam pumpi manthatlouhna ding in mi tengteng sik a mi khat sih, nou a ding in ahoih chih leng na ngaihtuah kei uh," achi hi.
