Huai thu amah phuahtawm in agen kei, huai kum in siampu lianpen ahi a, anamte sik a Jesu asih ding genkhol ahi zaw hi.
Huai namte sik kia ahi kei a, khovel a Pathian' ta dalhte tengteng apikhawmna ding in leng ahi sam hi.
Huchi in huai ni a kipan amah thahna ding in akihou zel uhi.
Huaiziak in Judate lak ah alangtang in Jesu avak nawnta kei a, huai a kipan gamdai zullam a khua khat Ephraim achih uah ava hohta hi; huai ah nungzuite toh a-om nilouh uhi.
Huan Judate Paikan Ankuangluina anaita a, mi tampi kisiangsak ding in, gam a pat, Paikan Ankuanglui ma in, Jerusalem ah ahohtou uhi.
Huchi in Jesu azong ua tempul ah dingh kawm in akihou ua, "Bang ahia na ngaihtuah uh? Ankuangluina ah ahong kei ding maw?" akichi uhi.
Siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n amah amattheihna ding un kuapeuh in a-omna atheih uleh amaute theihsak ding thu apeta uhi.
Huan Paikan Ankuangluina ding ni guk a-om lai a, Jesu'n misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh Lazaras omna khua, Bethani ahong tung hi.
Huai ah amah a ding in nitak an abawl ua, Martha in nek abawl hi, Lazaras bel a-ankuang umpih khat ahi.
Mari in spiknardi buk kimkhat thaunamtui manphatak ahon tawi a, Jesu khete anuh a, asam in anul a, huai thaugim in insung adimta hi.
Himahleh Judas Iskariot, anungzuite lak a khat, amansak ding pa'n,
"Hiai thaunamtui bangziak a makhai zathum a zuak a migentheite kiang a pe zaw lou uh ahia?" achi hi.
Migentheite a-awlmoh ziak a hiai thu gen ahi kei; amah guta ahi a, dangka ip akem a, asung a koih a alak zel ziak ahi zaw hi.
Jesu'n, "Subuai kei un, ka kivui ni a dia asit ahi.
Na kiang ua migentheite om gige ahi ua, kei bel na kiang ua om gige ding ka hi kei,” achi hi.
Huan huai mun ah Jesu a-om chih Juda mipite'n atheih un; ahong ua, Jesu ziak kia hilou in, misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh, Lazaras mah leng amuh nop ziak uh ahi.
Huan siampu liante Lazaras leng thah ding in akihou uhi.
Amah ziak a Judate tampi in langkaisan a, Jesu agintak ziak un.
Azing in, Ankuangluina a hong mipi tampi'n Jerusalem ah Jesu ahong pai ding chih azak un,
tumnahte atawi ua, dawn ding in apawtkhia ua, "Hosanna! Toupa min a Israelte Kumpipa hong pai ahampha e!" chi in akikou uhi.
Huan Jesu'n sabiltungnou amu a, atung ah atuang hi.
"Lau ke'n, Zion tanu; en in, na Kumpipa, sabiltungnou tung a tuang in, ahong pai ding," chih gelh ahih bang in.
Huai thute atung in anungzuite'n atheisiam kei ua; himahleh, Jesu pahtawi ahih nung in, atanchin ah huai thu gelh ahi chih leh amah tung ah huai thilte akihih ngei chih atheita uhi.
Huan han a kipan asapkhiakpa Lazaras, misi lak a kipan akaihthoh lai a akiang a mipi omte'n, athu atheihpih uhi.
Huaiziak in ahi, mipite'n leng amah ava dawn uh; huai thillamdang ahih chih atheih ziak un.
Huchi in Pharisaite'n, "Thei un, bangmah na hihtheih louh uh, en un, khovel in amah azuita,” akichi uhi.
Huan ankuangluina a Pathian be ding a hohtoute lak ah Grik kuate hiam a-om uhi.
Huaite Galili gam a Bethsaida a mi Philip kiang ah ahong ua, akiang ah, "Pu, Jesu ka mu nuam uh," achi ua, angen uhi.
Philip in Andru ahong hilh a, Andru leh Philip in Jesu ahong hilh uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa pahtawi a a-omna ding hun atungta hi.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, lei a buhtang akiak a, asih phot keileh amah kia in a-om tawntung; asih in bel, tampi in agah hi.
Kuapeuh ahinna it in amangsak ding a; kuapeuh hiai khovel a ahinna ngaineu in tangtawn hinna ah akem ding hi.
Kuapeuh in ka nna asepleh hon zui hen; ka omna ah ka sikha leng a-om ding hi; kuapeuh in kanna asepleh Pa'n amah apahtawi ding hi.
"Tu in ka kha amangbang mahmah; bang ka genta dia? 'Pa, hiai hun a pan hon hondam in, ka chi dia hia?' Himahleh hiai ding ziak mah a hiai hun a hong pai lah ka ngal a.
Pa na min pahtawi in," achi hi. Huchi in van a kipan in aw ahong suak a, "Ka pahtawita, ka pahtawi nawn lai ding,” achi hi.
Mipi akiang a dinghte'n huai aza ua, "Vanpiging ahi," achi ua; midangte'n, "Angel in amah houpih ahi," achi uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a, "Huai aw kei a dia hong suak ahi kei, noumau a ding ahi zaw," achi hi.
"Tu hiai khovel thukhensakna hun ahi; tu hiai khovel lal paihkhiak hun ahi.
Huan lei a kipan a khaikang a ka omleh, mi tengteng keimah kiang ah ka hip ding," achi hi.
Huai thu asihdan ding theihsakna dia agen ahi.
Huan mipi'n akiang ah, "Khrist tangtawn in a-om chih Dan Bu ah ka thei uh, nang Mihing Tapa khaikang a om ding ka hi, bangchi chih a chi na hia? Huai Mihing Tapa kua ahia?" achi ua, adong uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na lak uah sawt lou sung vak a-om tadih hi. Huai vak na neih sung un vak ah khosa un, huchi lou in zaw mial in ahon lap ding hi. Kuapeuh mial a khosa in apaina athei kei hi.
Vak na neih sung un vak gingta un, vak tate na hong hihtheihna ding un," achi hi. Huai thute Jesu'n agen a; huan apai a, amuh louh ding un akiselta hi.
Ama uah huchi tel a tam thillamdang hih mahleh, amah agingta tuan kei uh.
"Toupa, ka thugen uh kua'n ahia gingta? Toupa khut leng kua kiang ah ahia latsak a a-om?" chi a zawlnei Isai thugen atangtunna ding in.
Hiai ziak in ahi a gintak theih louh uh, Isai in,

"Ama'n amit uh ahihtaw a, alungtang uh ahihkhauh; huchi lou in zaw amit un amu kha ding ua, alungtang un athei kha ding uh, huan hong kihei nawn ding ua, ke'n amau ka hihdam kha ding," chih agen nawn ziak in.
Hiai thilte Isai in athupina amuh a atanchin agen ahi.
Himahleh, heutute lak nangawn ah tampi in Jesu agingta uhi; himahleh Pharisaite ziak in akipulak nuam kei uh, huchi lou in zaw sinagog a kipan ahawlkhe kha ding uhi;
Pathian pahtakna sang a mihing pahtakna adeih zawk ziak un.
Huan Jesu akikou a, "Kuapeuh hon gingta, kei hon gingta ahi kei a, hon sawlpa gingta ahi zaw hi.
Kuapeuh kei hon mu hon sawlpa mu ahi.
Khovel a vak hong pai pen ka hi, kuapeuh kei hon gingta mial a a-omlouhna ding in.
Kuapeuh ka thugen za in, gingta kei mahleh, ke'n siam louh ka tangsak kei; khovel siam louh tangsak ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, khovel humbit ding a hong pai ka hi zaw hi.
Kuapeuh kei hon deih lou a, ka thugente pom lou in, siam louh tangsak khat anei hi, ka thugen huai thu mahmah in, nitawp ni chiang in amah siam louh atangsak ding hi.
Keimah phuahtawm in thu ka gen kei a; Pa hon sawlpa'n ka thugen ding leh ka hih ding thu ahon pe zaw hi.
Amah thupiak tangtawn hinna ahi chih ka thei; huaiziak in ka thugen, Pa hon hilh bang zel in ka gen ahi," achi hi.
Paikan Ankuanglui kipat ma in, Jesu'n hiai khovel nusia a Pa kiang a apai hun hong tungta chih athei a; khovel a a-itte, atawp pha in a-it hi.
Huan nitak an nek lai a, diabol in Simon tapa, Judas Iskariot, lungtang a Jesu zuausan a matsak lungsim akoihsak khit nung in,
Pa'n akhut ah thil bangkim apeta chih leh Pathian a kipan hong pai ahi a, Pathian kiang a pai ding ahi chih, Jesu'n theigige in,
nitak an um lai adingh a, apuante asuahkhia a, kinulna puan ala a, ateng hi.
Huan kisilna kuang ah tui asung a, nungzuite khe asilsak a, akinulna puanten in anul zel hi.
Huchi in Simon Peter kiang ah ahong a, "Toupa, nang tel in ka khe na sil dia hia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka thilhih tu'n ah na thei kei; himahleh tunung chiang in na thei ding," chi in adawng hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Ka khe na sil kei hial ding," achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na khe ka sil keileh ka kiang ah tan na nei kei ding," achi hi.
Simon Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, ka khe kia hilou in, ka khutte leh ka lutang leng aw," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kisil khinsa akhe lou ngal sil akiphamoh kei, apumpi in asiang; nou na siang uh, na vek un zaw ahi kei," achi hi.
Amansak dingpa athei ngal a; huaiziak in, "Na vek un zaw na siang kei uh," achi hi.
Huchi in akhete uh asil khit a, apuante alak a, atut nawn in akiang uah, "Na tung ua ka thilhih na thei uhia?" achi hi.
"Nou, Toupa leh heutupa na hon chi ua; na chi dik uh, ka hihna mah ahi.
Kei Toupa leh na heutupa un na khe uh ka silleh noute'n leng na khe uh na kisilsak chiat ding uh ahi.
Na tung ua ka hih bang in, nou leng na hih sam ding un, hihdan ding hon hilh ka hi.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, sikha apu sang in athupizaw kei a; sawl a om leng asawlpa sang in athupizaw sam kei hi.
Huai thilte na theih ua, na hih uleh minuamsa na hi uhi.
"Na vek ua thu ka gen kei a; ka telte ka thei; himahleh ka tanghou nepa'n ka tung ah akhetul alikta chih, Laisiangthou ahong tuntheihna ding ahi.
Tu in ahong tun ma in ka hon hilh ahi, ahong tun hun chiang a kei amah ka hi chih na gintakna ding un.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh ka sawl kipahpih, kei hon kipahpih ahi; kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih, hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi," achi hi.
Jesu'n huai thu agen khit in, alungsim amangbang a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat in kei hon mansak ding," chi in atheisakta hi.
Huan nungzuite'n achih pen athei kei ua, aki-entuah chiat uhi.
Anungzuite lak a khat, Jesu'n a-itpa, dohkan sik ah Jesu angsung ah kingai in a-om hi.
Simon Peter in huai mi kiang ah, kua pen thu ahia agen dong ding in akhutvan hi.
Jesu awm ngai mah in a-awnphei a, akiang ah, "Toupa, kua pen ahia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Tanghou them ka diah a, ka piakpa ahi ding," chi in adawng hi. Huchi in tanghou them adiah zoh in Simon tapa, Judas Iskariot in kiang ah apia hi.
Tanghou them apiak nung in asung ah Setan alutta hi. Huchi in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na hih ding hih meng in," achi hi.
Dohkan a omte'n bang tum a hiai thu gen hiam chih athei kei uh.
Akhen in Judas in dangka ip akep ziak in, Jesu'n ankuangluina a ding thil kiphamoh peuh lei in, chi hiam, migentheite kiang ah banghiam piak ding, chi hiam asa uhi.
Huan tanghou them la in, apawtkhe pah a; huai tuh zan lai ahi.
Huaiziak in apawt nung in, Jesu'n agen a, "Tu in Mihing Tapa pahtawi in a-omta a, Pathian leng amah ziak in pahtawi in a-om hi.
Amah a Pathian pahtawi a a-omleh amah leng Pathian mahmah in apahtawi ding a, apahtawi pahta ding hi.

Naute aw, hun tomchik na kiang uah ka om lai tadih hi. Nou na hon zong ding uh; Judate kiang a, ka paina ding ah nou na hong pai thei kei ding uh chih ka gen bang in, tu in huchi mah bang in na kiang uah ka gen ahi.
Thupiak thak ka hon pia ahi, ki-ittuah chiat un; ke'n nou ka hon it bang in, nou leng ki-ittuah un.
Na ki-ittuah uleh mi tengteng in ka nungzuite na hi uh chih hiai ah athei ding uh," achi hi.
Simon Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, koi a hoh ding na hia? achi hi. Jesu'n, ka hohna ding ah nang tu in na hon zui thei kei ding; tunung chiang in zaw na hon zui ding," chi in adawng hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, bang ding in ahia tua leng ka hon zuih theih louh ding? Nangmah ziak in ka hinna ka koihkhe ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Keimah ziak in na hinna na koihkhe ding maw? Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ma in ak akhuang kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
"Na lungtang uh hihmangbat in om kei hen; Pathian na gingta ua, kei leng hon gingta sam un.
Ka Pa inn ah tenna mun tampi a-om; a-om lou hileh, ka hon hilhta ding hi; noute a dia mun bawl ding a kuan dek ka hi.
Huan nou a dia mun bawl ding a ka kuanleh ka hong kik nawn ding a, ka kiang ah nou ka hon la ding, ka omna a nou leng na om theih samna ding un.
Ka hohna ding alampi na thei uh," achi hi.
Thomas in akiang ah, "Toupa, koi a hoh ding na hia ka thei kei uh, alampi bang ka chi theih ding ua?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Keimah tuh huai lampi, huai thutak leh huai hinna ka hi; keimah a pai lou kuamah Pa kiang atung kei," achi hi.
"Kei na hon theih khit uleh ka Pa leng na thei khinta ding uh; tu a kipan amah na thei ua muh leng na muta uhi," achi hi.
Philip in akiang ah, "Toupa, huai Pa kou hon ensak in, huchi in kou a ding in ahun ding,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Philip, hiai tanpi na kiang ah ka om a, huchi a leng hon thei lou maw? Kuapeuh kei hon mu tuh Pa mu ahi. Huai Pa kou hon musak in bangchi chih a na chih ahia?
Kei Pa ah ka om a, keimah ah Pa a-om chih na gingta kei a hia? Na kiang ua thu ka gen, keimah phuahtawm in ka gen kei; keimah ah Pa a-om gige a, thil ahih zaw nak hi.
Kei Pa a ka omleh Pa keimah a a-om gingta un; ahihkeileh thilhih ziak bek in hon gingta un.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh hon gingta in ka thilhihte ahih sam ding; hiai sang a thupizaw leng ahih ding, Pa kiang a ka pai ding ziak in.
Huan ka min a na nget peuhmah uh ka hih zel ding, Tapa a Pa pahtawi a a-omtheihna ding in.
Nou ka min a bangpeuh na hon nget uleh, ka hih zel ding hi," achi hi.
"Nou na hon it uleh, ka thupiakte na zui ding uhi.
Huan Pa ka ngen dia, ama'n Khamuanpa dang ahon pe ding, tangtawn a na kiang ua om ding in;
huai thutak Kha; khovel in aneih theih louh ahi, amah amuh louh a, atheih louh behlap ziak in; nou amah na thei ua, na kiang uah a-om gige ngal a, noumau sung ah a-om ding hi.
"Tagah ding in ka hon paisan kei ding; na kiang uah ka hong pai nawn ding hi.
Sawt louchik sung khovel in ahon mu nawn kei ding; himahleh nou zaw na hon mu ding uh; keimah ka hin ziak in nou leng na hing sam ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in kei ka Pa a ka om leh nou keimah a na om bang un, kei noumau a ka omdan na thei ding uhi.
"Kuapeuh ka thupiakte nei a, zui tuh kei hon it ahi; kuapeuh kei hon it ka Pa'n a-it ding, ke'n leng amah ka it ding a, akiang ah ka hihna ka kilak ding," achi hi.
Huan Judas, Iskariot lou pen in akiang ah, "Toupa, koute kiang a na kilak a, khovel kiang a na kilak louh se ding bangziak ahia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Mi'n ahon itleh ka thute azui ding a; ka Pa'n amah a-it dia, akiang ah ka hong pai ding ua, amah toh ka tengkhawm gige ding uhi.
Kuapeuh hon itlou in ka thu azui kei; na thuzakte uh kei a ahi kei a, Pa hon sawlpa a ahi zaw.
"Na kiang ua ka om takdih sung in, hiai thute ka hon hilh ahi.
Khamuanpa, Kha Siangthou, Pa in ka min a hon sawl ding in bangkim nou ahon sinsak ding a, na kiang ua ka gen tengteng nou ahon theikhesak nawn lai ding.
"Khamuanna ka hon nutsiat hi; keimah khamuanna ka hon pia; khovel in apiak bang in ka hon pe kei. Na lungtang uh hihmangbat in om kei hen, lauh leng lau kei hen.
Ka paimang ding a, na kiang uah ka hong pai nawn ding, ka hon chih omdan na theita uh. Nou na hon it uh leh Pa kiang a ka pai ding ziak in na kipak ding uh ahi; keimah sang in Pa athupizaw ngal a.
Tu in hiai thil ahong tun chiang a na gintak theihna ding un ahong tun ma in ka hon hilh ahi.
Na kiang uah thu ka gen tam nawn kei ding, khovel vaihawmpa ahong pai dek ziak in; ama'n keimah ah bangmah anei kei hi.
Himahleh ke'n Pa ka it chih leh Pa in hon thupiak bang zel in thil ka hih chih, khovel in atheihna ding uh ahi ve. Dingh dih ua, hiai a kipan i paikhe ding uh.
"Kei grepgui dik ka hi, ka Pa akempa ahi.
Kei a hiang gah lou peuhmah alamang a; agah peuhmah tamsem agahna ding in ahahsiang hi.
Na kiang ua ka thugen ziak in tu'n ah na siangthou pah uhi.
Keimah ah om gige un, kei leng noumau ah ka om gige ding. Hiang, grepgui a a-om gige keileh amah in agah thei kei bang in, nou leng keimah a na om gige kei uleh, na gah thei kei ding uhi.
"Kei agrepgui ka hi a, nou ahiangte na hi uh. Kuapeuh keimah a om gige a, kei leng amah a ka om gigena, huai mah tampi in agah hi; keimah lou in bangmah na hihthei kei uhi.
Mi kei a a-om gige keileh hiang bang a paihkhiak in a-om a, avuai hi; huan atawm ua mei ah apai ua, akang hi.
Nou keimah a na om gige ua, ka thu leng noumau a a-om gigeleh na ut peuh uh ngen un, nou a ding in hih in a-om ding hi.
Hiai ziak in tampi a na gah chiang un ka Pa pahtawi in a-om hi, huchi in ka nungzuite na hi ding uhi.
Pa'n kei ahon it mah bang in ka hon it hi; ka itna ah om gige un.
Nou ka thupiakte na zuih uleh ka itna ah na om gige ding uhi, ke'n ka Pa thupiakte ka zui a, a-itna a ka om gige mah bang in.
"Ka kipah noumau a a-om gige theihna ding in leh na kipah uh akimna ding in hiai thu na kiang uah ka gen ahi.
Hiai ka thupiak ahi, ke'n nou ka hon it bang in, noumau leng ki-ittuah un.
Mihing in alawm a dia ahinna apiak sang a itna thupizaw kuama'n anei kei.
Thu ka hon piak peuhmah na hih uleh ka lawmte na hi ding uh.
Sikha ka hon chi nawn kei ding; apu thilhih sikha in atheih louh ziak in; lawmte ka hon chi zawta ding; Pa kiang a ka thil zak tengteng na kiang uah ka hon theisakta hi.
Nou na hon tel kei ua, ke'n ka hon tel zaw hi, va gah ding leh na gah uh om gige ding in ka hon sep ahi; ka min a Pa kiang a na nget peuhmah uh ahon piakna ding in.
Hiaite ka hon thupiak ahi, ki-ittuah chiat un.
"Khovel in nou ahon huatleh ahon huat ma in keimah ahon ho khinta chih thei un.
Nou khovel a hi le uchin, khovel in amah a a-it ding; khovel a kipan ka hon telkhiak zawk ziak in, khovel in nou ahon hua hi.
Apu sang in sikha athupizaw kei, chih thu ka hon hilhta hi, hiai theigige un. Amau kei ahon sawi uleh, nou leng ahon sawi ding uh; ka thu zui hita le uh, noumau thu leng azui ding uhi.
Himahleh hiai thil tengteng ka min ziak in na tung uah ahih ding uh, hon sawlpa atheih louh ziak un.
Kei hong pai lou in akiang uah thu gen kei leng khelhna nei lou ding hi ua, himahleh tu in akhelhna uah paulap ding aneita kei uhi.
Kuapeuh kei hon hua in, ka Pa leng ahua ahi.
Midang kuamah hih ngeilouhte alak ua hih lou hi taleng, khelhna nei lou ding hi ua, himahleh tu in amau kei leh ka Pa, ka nih un ahon muta uh, huat leng hon hota uhi.
Adan uah, amau aziak om lou in hon hua uh chih, thu kigelh pen, ahong tangtunna ding ua hih uh ei ve.
"Huan Pa a kipan Khamuanpa na kiang ua ka hon sawl ding, Pa a kipan thutak Kha ahong tun chiang in, keimah hon theihpih ding hi.
Atung a kipan a kei toh omkhawm na hih ziak un nou leng na theihpih ding uhi.
"Lungkia a na paimanglouhna ding un na kiang uah hiai thute ka genta hi.
Sinagogte ah ahon nongsak ding ua; kuapeuh nou hon that Pathian tung a thil hoih hih in akithei ding ua huai bang hun hong tung ding ahi.
Huai thilte ahih ding ua, Pa leh kei hon theih louh ziak un.
Hiai thute na kiang uah ka genta hi, ahun ahong tun chiang a, ka hon hilh khinta chih na theih nawnna ding un. Hiai thilte na kiang ua ka om takdih ziak in atung a ka hon hilh louh him na hi uhi.
"Tu in hon sawlpa kiang ah ka pai ding a noute kuamah in, koi a hoh ding? chi in na hon dong kei uh.
Hiai thute na kiang ua ka gen ziak in na lungtang uh lungkhamna in adimzou hialta hi.
Himahleh thutak ka hon hilh ahi; ka pai nou a ding in ahoihzaw hi; ka pai keileh na kiang uah Khamuanpa ahong tung kei ding a; ka paileh bel na kiang ua hon sawl ding ka hi.
Amah ahong tun chiang in khelhna thute ah, diktatna thute ah, leh vaihawmna thute toh kisai a khovel asiamlouhdan atheisak ding hi.
Khelhna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh, kei hon gintak louh ziak un.
Diktatna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh; Pa kiang ah ka pai ding; nou kei na hon muh nawn tak louh ding ziak un.
Vaihawmna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh; hiai khovel lal siam louh a apuk tak ziak in.
"Na kiang uah gen ding tampi ka nei lai a, himahleh tu in zaw na chin tadih kei uhi.
Himahleh amah Thutak Kha ahong tun chiang in, thutak tengteng ah nou ahon pi ding; ama phuahtawm in thu agen kei dia; azak peuhmah agen zaw ding, thil hong tung dingte leng nou ahon theisak ding hi.
Ama'n kei ahon pahtawi ding a; kei a ala ding a, nou kiang ah ahon theisak ding hi.
Pa'n thil aneih tengteng kei a ahi; huaiziak in kei a ala ding a, na kiang uah ahon theisak ding, ka chi hi.
"Sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding ua; sawt louchik mah in na hon mu nawn ding uh," achi hi.

Anungzuite khenkhat in, i kiang ua athugen bang ahi, sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding uh, sawt louchik mah in na hon mu nawn ding uh achih leh Pa kiang a ka hoh dek ziak in, achih? akichi uhi.
Amau mah in, sawt louchik, achih bang chihna ahia? Athugen i theisiam kei uh, achi uhi.
Huan amah dot ut anei uh chih Jesu'n athei a, akiang uah, "Sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding uh, sawt louchik mah in nou kei na hon mu nawn ding uh chi a ka thugen na kidong uh maw?
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na khitui uh ake ding a, na kap huphup ding uh, khovel bel akipak ding; na lungkham ding ua, himahleh na lungkham uh kipahna asuak ding hi.
Numei nau nei ding in avei lai in alungkham nak hi, ahun atun tak ziak in; himahleh nau asuahtak in alunggimna athei nawnta kei hi, khovel a naungek hong pian a akipah ziak in.
Tu in nou na lungkham uh; himahleh ka hon mu nawn ding a, na lungtang uh akipak ding, na kipahna uh kuamah in hon laksak kei ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in nou kei bangmah na hon ngen kei ding uh. Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Pa kiang a bangpeuh ka min a na nget uleh ahon pe ding hi.
Tutan in ka min in bangmah na ngen nai kei uh. Ngen un, huchi in na mu ding uh, na kipah uh akimna ding in.
"Huai thute ahem in na kiang uah ka genta hi; ahun atung dekta, huai hun chiang in na kiang uah ahem in thu ka gen nawnta kei ding a, chiantak in Pa tanchin ka hon hilh ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in keimah min in thil na ngen ding uh; Pa kiang ah ke'n ka hon ngetsak ding ka chi kei hi.
Pa in amah ngei in noute ahon it ngal a, nou kei na hon it ua, Pa a kipan ka hi chih na hon gintak ziak un.
Kei Pa kiang a kipan hong pawt a, khovel a hong pai ka hi a; khovel paisan a, Pa kiang a pai nawn ding ka hi,” achi hi.
Huan anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, tu in teltak in na genta, ahem in na genta kei hi! achi uhi.
Nang bangkim na thei a, kuamah hon dot na kiphamoh kei chih tu in ka theita uh; hiai ziak in Pathian kiang a kipan hong pai na hi chih ka gingta uhi," achi uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a akiang uah, "Tu in na gingta uh maw?

Ngai un, ahun hong tung ding ahita, tu in leng atung lellel hi, huai hun chiang in noumau inn chiat ah na dalh vek ding ua, keimah kia na hon nuse ding uh. Himahleh ka kiang a Pa a-om ziak in keimah kia in ka om kei hi.
Hiai thute na kiang uah ka genta hi, keimah a na khamuanna ding un. Khovel ah gimthuakna na nei ding uh, himahleh khamuangtak in om un, ke'n khovel ka zouta,” achi hi.
Huai thute Jesu'n agen khit in van lam nga in, "Pa ahun atungta, Tapa in nang ahon pahtawi theihna ding in na Tapa pahtawi in;
huchi a mi tengteng tung a thunei a na bawl in, akiang a na piak peuhmahte tangtawn hinna apiaktheihna ding in.
Hiai tangtawn hinna ahi, nang Pathian tak kia leh na sawl Jesu Khrist theih.
Nang thilhih ding na hon piakte ka hih khinta a, khovel ah ka hon pahtawita hi.
Pa aw, khovel om ma a na kiang a thupina ka neih in, tu in nangmah kiang ngei ah hon pahtawi in.
"Nang khovel a kipan a mi, kei na hon piakte kiang ah na min ka hihlangta; amau nang a ahi ua, nang amaute kei na hon piak ahi uh; amau lah na thu azuita uhi.
Nang kei na hon piak tengteng nang a kipan ahi chih atheita uhi.
Nang thu na hon piakte akiang uah ka peta a; huaite akem ua, nang a kipan ka hi chih diktak in atheita uh, nang na hon sawl chih leng agingta uhi.
"Amaute a ding a ngetsak ka hi. Khovel a dia ngetsak ka hi kei, nang na hon piakte a ding ahi zaw, nang a ahi uhi.
Thil tengteng kei a peuhmah nang a ahi a, nang a lah kei a ahi a; amau ziak in pahtawi in ka om hi.

Huan kei zaw khovel ah ka omta kei ding, hiaite bel khovel ah a-om ding uh; kei na kiang ah ka hong paidekta hi. Pa Siangthou aw, nang kei na hon piakte na min in hum in pum khat ahihtheihna ding un, eimah pum khat i hih bang in.
Akiang ua ka om sung in, nang kei na hon piakte na min in ka hum a; amau ka don a, alak ua khat leng amangthang kei hi, mangthang tapa lou ngal, Laisiangthou atangtun theihna ding in.
Himahleh tu in na kiang ah ka hong paidekta; khovel ah hiai thute ka gen ahi, ka kipahna amau ua aneih kimna ding un.
Na thu akiang uah ka peta hi; khovel in amau ahua a, khovel a ahih louh ziak un, kei khovel a ka hih louh mah bang in.
Nang amaute khovel a kipan na lakkhiak ding ngen ka hi kei a, migilou lak ah na hum ding ka chi ahi zaw hi.
Amau khovel a ahi kei uh, kei khovel a ka hih louh mah bang in.
Amau thutak in hihsiangthou in, na thu thutak ahi.
Nang khovel a kei na hon sawl bang in, khovel ah amaute ka sawl hi.
Amau ziak in ka kihihsiangthou a, amaute leng thutak a asianthouna ding un.
"Hiaite a ding kia a ngetsak ka hi kei, athugen ziak ua kei hon gingta lai dingte a ding in leng ka ngetsak hi; avek ua pum khat ahihna ding un;
Pa, nang keimah a na om leh kei nangmah a ka om bang in, amau leng eimah a a-omna ding un; nang kei na hon sawl chih khovel in ataksan theihna ding in.
Huan nang thupina na hon piak ke'n amau ka peta; amau pum khat ahihtheihna ding un, ei pum khat i hih mah bang in.
Kei amau ah, nang kei ah, amau pum khat a a-om ua abukim theihna ding un; nang kei na hon sawl chih leh na hon it bang in amaute na it chih khovel in atheihtheihna ding in.
"Pa, nang kei na hon piakte, ka omna a ka kiang a om ding in ka deih; leilung pian ma a itna a nang na hon piak ka thupina amuhtheihna ding un.
Pa diktat aw, khovel in nang hon thei kei mahleh, ke'n zaw ka hon thei hi; hiaite'n leng nang kei na hon sawl chih athei uhi.
Huan akiang uah na min ka theisakta a, ka theisak lai ding, nang kei na hon itna bangbang na itna amau a a-om a, kei leng amau a ka omtheihna ding in,” achi hi.
Jesu'n huai thute agen khit in anungzuite toh apawt ua, Kidron luita akan ua, huai ah huan khat a-om hi. Huai ah amah leh anungzuite alut uhi.
Huan amansak dingpa Judas in leng huai mun athei a; huai ah anungzuite toh Jesu ava tawlnga zelzel uhi.
Huchi in Judas in sepaih pawl, siampu liante leh Pharisaite kiang a om heutute api a, khawnvakte, meiselte, galvante tawi in huai ah ahong pai uhi.
Jesu'n atung a thil tung ding tengteng atheigige a, ava pawt a, akiang uah, "Kua ahia na zon uh?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Nazaret Jesu," chi in adawng uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah ka hi," achi hi.
Amansakpa Judas leng alak uah adingh a, "Keimah ka hi," achihtak in, anungtolh ua, lei ah apuk duam uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Kua ahia na zon uh?" chi in adong nawn hi. Amau, "Nazaret Jesu," achi uhi.
Huan Jesu'n, "Keimah ka hi chih ka hon hilhta a; nou kei hon zong na hih uleh hiaite hoihtak in khah un," achi a adawng hi.
"Nang kei na hon piakte khat leng ka mangsak kei," chi a athugen atangtunna ding ahi.
Huan Simon Peter in anamsau vom adokkhia a siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil taklam asatkhiaksak hi. Huai sikha min Malkas ahi.
Huchi in Peter kiang ah Jesu'n, "Na namsau apai ah siat in; Pa in nou ahon piak ka dawn kei dia hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in sepaih pawl leh Judate heutute'n Jesu aman ua, ahenta uhi.
Annas kiang ah api masa uh, amah Kaiapha sunghpa ahih ziak in. Kaiapha, huai kum a siampu lianpen ahi.
Kaiapha bel, mi tengteng sang a mi khat sih ahoihzaw chi a, Judate hanthawnpa ahi.
Huan Simon Peter in nungzui dang khat toh Jesu azui hi. Huai nungzuipa siampu lianpen meltheih ahi a, siampu lianpen huangsung intual ah, Jesu kiang ah alut sam hi.
Himahleh polam a kongkhak bul ah Peter adingh hi. Huchi in nungzui dang siampu lianpen meltheih khat ava pawt a, kongkhak ngaknu ahoupih a, Peter apilut hi.
Kongkhak ngak, nungak in Peter kiang ah, "Nang leng hiai mi nungzuite lak a pang sam na hi hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka hi kei," achi hi. Sikhate leh heutute huai ah adingh uhi. Avot ziak in meihol in mei atoh ua, meilum a-awi uhi. Peter leng akiang uah a-om a, dingh kawm in meilum a-awi sam hi.
Siampu lianpen in Jesu anungzuite tanchin leh athusinsak adong hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Khovel kiang ah vantang theih in, thu ka gen gige hi; sinagog, tempul leh Judate omkhawmnate ah thu ka hilh zel a, asim in bangmah ka gen kei.
Bang achia kei hon dong? Akiang ua ka thugen ka thuzate dong in, ngai in, amaute'n ka thugen athei uh akei hiam," achi hi.
Huan agentak in akiang a dingh heutu khat in Jesu abeng a, "Siampu lianpen hichibang in na dawng maw?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Thudiklou gen ka hihleh, adiklouhna hon theisak in; himahleh, ka thugen dik ahihleh bang achia hon beng?" achi hi.
Huan Annas in hensa in siampu lianpen Kaiapha kiang ah asawl hi.
Simon Peter in dingh kawm in meilum a-awi hi. "Nang leng anungzuite lak a pang sam na hi hia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka hi kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi.
Huan siampu lianpen sikha khat Peter in abil satkhiaksakpa sanggampa'n, akiang ah, "Huan ah ka hon mu kei maw?" achi hi.
Huchi in Peter in akitheih-mohbawl nawn a; huan ak akhuang pah hi.
Kaiapha inn a pan in Vaihawmna inn ah Jesu api nawn ua; huai zingsang ahi a; amau ahihleh Vaihawmna inn ah alut kei uh, alut un zaw buah in, Paikan Ankuanglui ane thei kei ding uhi.
Amaute kiang ah Pilat ava pawt a, "Hiai mi tung ah hekna bang ahia na neih uh?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Hiai migilou hi keileh na kiang ah ka hon pi kei ding uh," chi in adawng uhi.
Huan Pilat in akiang uah, "Nou pi unla, na dan bang un vai hawmsak un," achi hi. Judate'n akiang ah, "Kou thu in kuamah hihlup dan bang ahi kei," achi uhi.
Hiai thu asihdan ding, Jesu'n agen bang a atangtunna ding ahi.
Huchi in insung ah Pilat alut nawn a, Jesu asam a, akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Hiai ka tungtang thu nangmah lungsim puakkhiak a na gen hia, midang in hon hilh?" chi in adawng hi.
Pilat in, "Kei Juda mi ka hi a hia? Nangmah chipihte leh siampu liante'n ka kiang ah ahon pekhia ua ahi; thil bang ahia na hih?" chi in adawng hi.

Jesu'n, "Ka kumpi hihna hiai khovel ahi kei; ka kumpi hihna hiai khovel a hileh Judate kiang a piak a ka omlouhna ding in, ka sikhate'n adou ding uh. Himahleh ka kumpi hihna zaw hiai khovel a kipan ahi kei," chi in adawng hi.

Pilat in akiang ah, "Huchi, nang kumpipa na hi mawleh?" achi hi. Jesu'n, "Kumpipa ka hi na hon chi mah ve. Thutak theihsak ka piansan leh khovel a ka hong paisan ahi. Kuapeuh thutak a om peuhmah in ka thu asang uh," achi hi.
Pilat in akiang ah, "Thutak bang ahia?" achi hi. Huan huai thu agen khit in, Judate kiang ah ava pawt nawn a, akiang uah, "Bangmah agitlouhna ka mu kei," achi hi.
Himahleh Paikan Ankuangluina ah mi khat ka hon pawtsakna ding dan na nei uh; huchi in "Judate' Kumpipa hon pawtsak leng na ut uhia?" achi hi.
Amau akikou nawn ua, "Hiai mi hi kei henla, Barabbas pen hi zaw hen," achi uhi. Barabbas tuh suamhat ahi.
Huchi in Pilat in Jesu api a, azep hi.
Huan sepaihte'n linglukhu aphan ua, akhusak ua, puan sandup leng asilhsak uh.
Akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Chibai, Judate' Kumpipa," achi ua, abeng uhi.
Huan Pilat apawt nawn a, akiang uah, "En un, bangmah agitlouhna ka mu kei chih na theihna ding un, na kiang uah ka hon pikhia hi,” achi hi.
Jesu, linglukhu khu in leh puan sandup silh in ahong pawt hi. Pilat in akiang uah, "En un, Mihing!" achi hi.

Huan siampu liante leh heutute'n amah amuhtak un akikou ua, "Kros ah kilhden in, kros ah kilhden in," achi uhi. Pilat in akiang uah, "Noumau paipih unla, kros ah kilhden un; ke'n zaw bangmah agitlouhna ka mu ngal kei hi,” achi hi.
Judate'n akiang ah, "Ka dan uh khat a-om, huai dan bang zel in Pathian Tapa a akibawl ziak in asi ding ahi," achi ua, adawng uhi.
Pilat in huai thu azak in alau nawn semsem hi.
Ama inpi sung ah va lut nawn in Jesu kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Himahleh Jesu'n adawng kei.
Pilat in akiang ah, "Nang kei hon houpih lou ding maw? Hon khah thei leh kros a hon kilhden thei ka hi chih na thei kei a hia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Tunglam a kipan piak hi kei lechin, ka tung ah hihtheih na nei kei ding. Huaiziak in na kiang a hon pekhepa'n khelhna lianzaw apua hi," achi hi.
Huai nungsiah Pilat in khah atum a; himahleh Judate akikou ua, "Hiai mi na khahleh Kaisar lawm na hi kei; kuapeuh kumpipa a kibawl Kaisar dou ahi,” achi uhi.
Pilat in huai thu azak in Jesu apikhia a, amin Suanglep, Hebru pau a Gabbatha achih uh, huai mun ah thukhenna tutphah ah atu hi.
Huan huai ni Paikan Ankuangluina kiginni ahi a, dak gukna vel ahi. Huan ama'n Judate kiang ah, "En un, na Kumpipa uh," achi hi.

Huan amau akikou ua, "Hihmangthang in, hihmangthang in, kros ah kilhden in," achi uhi. Pilat in akiang uah, "Na kumpipa uh kros ah ka kilhden ding maw?" achi hi. Siampu liante'n, "Kaisar lou ngal kumpipa dang ka nei kei uh," achi ua, adawng uhi.
Huchi in Pilat in kilhden ding in akiang uah amah apeta hi. Huchi in Jesu api ua, apaikhiakpih uhi.
Ama'n kros kipuak in Luguh Mun, achih uh, Hebru pau a Golgotha achih mun tan apai hi.
Huai ah kros ah alai ah Jesu midang nih asik ah khat tuaktuak toh akilhden uhi.
Pilat in lai agelh a, kros ah atak a, “NAZARET JESU, JUDATE' KUMPIPA,” chi in.
Huai laigelh Judate tampi in asim ua; Jesu kros akilhdenna mun uh khopi kiang ahi a; huai Hebru pau, Grik pau leh Latin pau a gelh ahi.
Huchi in Juda siampu liante'n Pilat kiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa, chi in gelh ke'n; Judate' Kumpipa ka hi achi," chi in gelh zaw in, achi uhi.
Pilat in, "Ka gelh khit, gelh khit ahita," chi in adawng hi.
Huan sepaihte'n Jesu akilhden khit un apuansilh phel li asuah ua, phel khat chiat in atang ua; apuanak leng ala uh. Puanak khui louh puanak ahi a, angawng a kipan ataw tan a gatthoh ahi.

Huaiziak in amau, "I botkek kei dia, kua tan ding ahi hiam, ai i san ding uh," akichi uhi. Laisiangthou a, "Ka puansilhte akihawm ua, ka puanak ding in ai asan uh," chih atangtunna ding in hiai thil sepaihte'n ahih uhi.
Huan Jesu kros kiang ah anu leh anu sanggam, Kleopas zi Mari leh Mari Magdalin adingh uhi.
Huan Jesu'n anu leh nungzui a-itpa akiang a dingh amu a, anu kiang ah, "Numei, en in, na tapa,” achi hi.
Nungzuipa kiang ah, "En in, na nu,” achi hi. Huai dak a pan huai nungzui in a-inn ah amah pita hi.
Huai nung in, Jesu'n thil bangkim hihzoh ahita chih athei a, Laisiangthou atangtunna ding in, "Ka dang atak," achi hi.
Huai ah bel khat uain thuk a dim atung ua, huchi in spanji khat uain thuk a diahdim in, hissop chiangdawn a tak in, amuk ah atulhtou uhi.
Huan Jesu'n uain thuk adawn khit in, "Zoh ahita," achi a, huan alu akun a, akha akhahta hi.
Huan kiginni ahih ziak in, Sabbath ni a kros a siluangte a-omlouhna ding in, (huai Sabbath ni lah ni thupi ahi ngal a), Judate'n Pilat kiang ah akhete uh hihtan a aluang uh paipih ding in angen uhi.
Sepaihte ahong pai ua, akiang a kilhden a om, tuah masakpen leh akhat pen khe ahihtansak uhi.
Himahleh Jesu kiang ahong tun un, ana sita chih athei ua, akhete ahihtan tuan kei uhi.
Himahleh sepaihte lak a mi khat in anak ah tei in adawt a, huchi in sisan leh tui ahong luangkhia hi.
Huaite mupa'n atheisakta, athu theihsak adik ahi; agen dik chih akithei a, nou leng na gintakna ding un.
Laisiangthou in, "Aguh khat lel leng hihtan ahi kei ding," achih tangtunna ding in huai thil ahong omta hi.
Huan Laisiangthou dang in, "Asutpa uh lam a-en ding uh,” achi hi.

Huan huai thilte khit in, Joseph, Arimathai mi, Jesu nungzui, Judate kihtak ziak a sim-om in Jesu luang paipih ding in Pilat kiang ah angen hi. Pilat in aphal a, huchi in ahong pai a, aluang apaipihta hi.
Huan Nikodem, atung a zan a akiang a hong in, murrah leh aloe kihelsa buk sawmnga vel tawi in ahong pai sam hi.
Jesu luang ala ua, Judate kivuidan bang in gimlimte toh puanmalngat hoih in atuam uhi.
Huan kros a akilhlupna mun uah huan khat a-om a; huan ah kuamah sial ngei nailouhna han thak khat a-om hi.
Judate kiginni ahih ziak in, han omna akiangchin uh ahih toh, huai ah Jesu asialta uhi.
Huan ani thum ni in, Galili gam a Kana ah kitenna a-om a, huai ah Jesu nu a-om hi.
Jesu leh anungzuite leng kitenna ah chial in a-om uhi.
Uain abeitak in Jesu nu'n akiang ah, "Uain atasamta uh e,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, nang na hon theihsak ding bang ahia om? Ka hun atung nai kei hi,” achi hi.
Anu'n sikhate kiang ah, "Na kiang ua agen peuhmah hih zel un,” achi hi.
Huan Judate silsiang dan bang in suang tuibel guk, buk sawmli mun nih hiam, mun thum hiam ta chiat, huai ah atung uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tuibelte tui in dimsak un," achi hi. Agong toh kikim in adimsak chiat uhi.
Akiang uah, "Tu in dim unla, nekbawl thusa kiang ah paipih un," achi hi. Huchi in apaipihta uhi.
Nekbawl thusa in, tui uain hong suak achiam a, ahong kipatna athei kei a, tuidim sikhate'n ahihleh athei uh, mouneipa asam a, akiang ah,
"Michih in atung in uain hoih ahawm ua, atam deuh adawn nung un, ahoih lou ahawm uh; nang bel tutan in uain hoih na kem lailai a,” achi hi.
Jesu'n hiai a thillamdang hihpatna Galili gam Kana khua a ahih ahi; athupina alangsakta a; anungzuite'n amah agingta uhi.
Huan huai khit in Kapernaum ah ahohsuk a, amah leh anu toh, a-unaute leh anungzuite toh; huai ah ni tam lou a-om uhi.
Huan Judate Paikan Ankuang-luina anaita a, Jerusalem ah Jesu ahohtou hi.
Tempul a bawng, belam leh vakhu zuak leh dangka kheng a tute amu hi.
Huan khauhual in zepna ding abawl a, belam leh bawng avek un tempul a kipan adelhkhia a, dangka khengte dangka asungbua a, adohkante uh leng asawnpuksak hi.
Vakhu zuakte kiang ah, "Hiai thilte hiai a kipan paipih un, ka Pa inn sumsinna mun in bawl kei un," achi hi.
Huan “Na inn a ka phatuamngaihna in ahon gai ding," chih gelh ahi chih anungzuite'n athei nawnta uhi.
Huchi in Judate'n akiang ah, "Hiai na thilhih chiamtehna bang ahia na hon lah theih?" chi in adong uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai inn hihse le uchin, ni thum sung in ka tungding nawn ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Judate'n, "Hiai inn kum sawmli-le-guk sung lam ahi, nang ni thum sung in na tungding ding maw?" achi uhi.
Himahleh amah pumpi inn thu gen ahi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in misi lak a kipan athohnawn in, anungzuite'n huai thugen athei nawnta uhi. Laisiangthou thu leh Jesu thugen agingta uhi.
Huan Jerusalem a Paikan Ankuangluina a-om lai in, athil-lamdang hihte amu ua, mi tampi in amin agingta uhi.
Himahleh Jesu bel alak uah akikangkoih a, mi tengteng athei hi.
Mihing thu kuamah hilhchet akiphatmoh louh ziak in; amah mah in mihing sung a om peuhmah athei ngal hi.
Nipikal a ani masapen ahong tun in, zingsangpi khomial lai in, han ah Mari Magdalin ava hoh a, hansuang lakkhiaksa in amu hi.
Huchi in atai a, Simon Peter leh nungzui dang, Jesu'n a-itpa kiang ah ahong pai a, "Han a kipan Toupa apaimangpih ua, akoihna uh ka thei kei uh," chi in agen hi.
Huchi in Peter apawt a, nungzui dang toh han lam azuan uhi.
Atai tuak ua; nungzui dang in Peter amakhelh a, han atung masa hi.
Huan kunsuk in a-en a, puanmalngat hoih amu a; himahleh asung ah alut kei hi.
Simon Peter amah nung in ahong tung sam a, han sung ah alutsuak a; puanmalngat hoih omte amu hi.
Jesu lukhung a kinulna puan pen, puanmalngat hoih lak a om lou a, atuam a khepsa a om amu hi.
Huchi in nungzui dang, han tung masazaw pen leng alut sam a, amu a, agingta hi.
Misi lak a kipan a thounawn ding ahi, chih Laisiangthou gen atheigige nawn kei uhi.
Huchi in nungzuite amau inn ah apai nawnta uhi.
Himahleh han pua ah kap kawm in Mari adingh a; kap kawm in akun a, han sung a-en hi.
Huan angel nih puanngou silh, Jesu luang sialna mun ah khat alulam leh khat akhe lam a tu amu hi.
Huan amau, "Numei, bangziak a kap na hia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka Toupa apaimangpih ua, akoihna uh ka theih louh ziak in," chi in adawng hi.
Huan huchi a agentak in anunglam anga a, Jesu dingh amu a, himahleh Jesu ahi chih athei kei hi.

Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, bangziak a kap na hia? Kua ahia na zon?" achi hi. Ama'n huanpu hiam asa a, akiang ah, "Pu, amah hiai a kipan a paimangpih na hihleh, na koihna hon hilh tanla, huchi in ka la ding,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Mari" achi hi. Amah akihei a, akiang ah Hebru pau in, "Rabboni" achi a, (huai tuh Sinsakpa chihna ahi).

Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hon lawng ke'n, tutan in leng Pa kiang ah ka kahtou nai kei hi. Himahleh ka unaute kiang ah va hoh inla, akiang uah, ka pa, na Pa uh, ka Pathian, na Pathian uh kiang ah ka kahtou dek, achi, va chi in," achi hi.
Mari Magdalin ava hoh a, nungzuite kiang ah, "Toupa ka muta," achi a, akiang ah hiai thute agen chih ahilhta hi.

Huan huai ni, nipikal a ni masapen, nitaklam ahong hih in, Judate kihtak ziak a nungzuite omna inn kongkhakte akhak nung un, Jesu ahong pai a, alak uah ahong dingh a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
Huai agen khit in akiang uah akhut leh anak alak a, Toupa amuhtak un nungzuite akipak uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen, Pa'n kei hon sawl bang mah in nou ka hon sawl hi," achi nawn hi.
Huai thu agen khit in amau ahatkhum a, akiang uah, "Kha Siangthou tang un.
Kua khelhna leng na ngaihdam uh ngaihdam ahi ding a; kua khelhna leng na ngaihdam louh uh, ngaihdam louh ahi ding,” achi hi.
Huan Jesu ahong lai in sawm-le-nihte lak a pang sam Thomas, Didum achih uh, akiang uah a-om kei hi.

Huchi in nungzui dangte'n akiang ah, "Toupa ka muta uh," achi uhi. Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Akhut sikkhetna pawn ka muh a, ka khutzung a ka khoih a, anak a ka khut ka golhlut hial keileh ka gingta kei ding," achi hi.

Huan ani giat nung in, insung ah anungzuite a-om nawn ua, Thomas leng akiang uah a-om sam hi. Huan kongkhakte khak hinapi in Jesu ahong pai a, alak uah ahong dinghta a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
Huan Thomas kiang ah, "Na khutzung in sawk in, ka khutte en in; na khut in khoih inla, ka nak ah sawk in; ging lou ke'nla, gingta mai in," achi hi.
Thomas in, "Ka Toupa leh ka Pathian na hi," chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang zaw na hon muh ziak in na gingta ahi; mu lou a gingta peuhmahte ahampha uh," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n nungzuite ma ah chiamtehna dang tamtak ahih a, huaite hiai laibu ah gelh vek ahi kei hi.
Himahleh Jesu tuh huai Khrist, Pathian Tapa ahi chih na gintakna ding uleh, na gintak ua amin a hinna na neihna ding ua gelh ahi.
Huai thilte nung in, Tiberias tuipi ah anungzuite kiang ah Jesu akilak nawn a; hichibang in amah mah akilak hi.
Simon Peter leh Thomas, Didum achih uh, Galili gam a Kana a Nathanael, Zebedai tapa nihte, anungzui dang nihte toh a-omkhawm uhi.

Simon Peter in akiang uah, "Ngasa man ding in ka kuan dek," achi a, amau akiang ah, "Kou leng na kiang ah ka hong sam ding uh," achi uhi. Apawtkhia ua, long ah atuang ua, huai zan in bangmah aman kei uhi.
Phalvak in piautak ah Jesu ava dingh a; himahleh anungzuite'n Jesu ahi chih athei kei uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Naute aw, nek ding banghiam na nei uhia?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Nei lou," chi in adawng uhi.
Huan akiang uah, "Long sik taklam ah len pai le uchin na man ding uh," achi hi. Apai ua, ngasa atam ziak in akaikhe zou kei uhi.
Huchi in nungzui Jesu itpa'n Peter kiang ah, "Toupa ei ve," achi hi. Huchi in Toupa ahi chih Simon Peter in atheih in, apuanak tungsilh ateng a, amah vuaktang a om ahi a, tuipi ah atawmkheta hi.
Himahleh nungzuite'n long neuchik in, len ngasa a dim toh kai kawm in ahon zuan ua, gam a kipan in agamla ngal kei ua, tong zanih hiam phet ahi.
Huan gam a ahong suahtak un, meihol a mei tohsa atung a ngasa leh tanghou emsa amu uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tu in na ngasa mat uh akhen hon latou un," achi hi.
Huchi in Simon Peter ava tuang a, ngasa lian pipi a dim tui gei ah ahon kaikhia a, zakhat sawmnga-le-thum apha hi; huchi lawmlawm in tam mahleh len akek kei hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zing an hong ne un," achi hi. Nungzuite lak ah kuamah in akiang ah, "Kua na hia?" chi in adong ngam kei uh. Toupa ahi chih athei uhi.
Huan Jesu ahong pai a, tanghou ala a, akiang uah apia a, ngasate leng huchibang mah in ape sam hi.
Huai tuh Jesu misi lak a kipan athohnawn nung a, anungzuite kiang a akilak thumveina ahi.

Huan zing an anek khit un, Simon Peter kiang ah Jesu'n, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang hiaite sang in kei na hon itzaw hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi, Toupa, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka belamnoute vak in," achi hi.

Huan anihveina ding in akiang ah, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang kei na hon it hia?" achi nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi, Toupa, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka belamte ching in," achi hi.

Huan athumveina ding in akiang ah, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang kei na hon it hia?" achi hi. Huan thumveina a nang kei na hon it hia? chi a akiang a agen ziak in Peter alungkham a, akiang ah, "Toupa, bangkim na thei a, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka belamte vak in."

"Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na naupan lai in na tai ah na kigak a, na utna peuh ah na hoh a; himahleh na upat hun chiang in na khut na zak ding a, midang in ahon gaksak ding ua, na utlouhna lam ah ahon kai ding uh," achi hi.
Huai thu bangchidan a si in ahia Pathian apahtawi ding, chih theihsakna ding a agen ahi. Huai agen khit in akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
Huai khit in Peter akihei a, Jesu nungzui itpa, nitak an nek lai a a-awm ngai a hong awnphei a, "Amansak dingpa kua pen ahia?" chipa'n, amau hon zui amu hi.
Peter in amah amuhtak in, Jesu kiang ah, "Toupa, hiai mi'n bang ahih dia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka hong pai nawn tan a om nilouh ding in deih leng, huai nang bang lunghimoh zenzen? Nang hon zui in," achi hi.

Huchi in huai nungzuipa si lou ding in athu unaute lak ah athangta a; himahleh Jesu'n asi kei ding chih akiang ah agen kei a, "K'ong pai nawn tan a om nilouh ding in deih leng, huai nang bang lunghimoh zenzen?" chi lel ahi zaw hi.
Huai nungzuipa, "Hiai thu theisakpa leh gelhpa ahi; huan athu theihsak adik chih i thei uhi."
Huan hiaite lou leng Jesu thilhih dang tampi a-om lai a; huaite gelh vek ding hileh, laibu gelh ding tengteng khovel ah leng tazou in ka gingta kei hi. Amen.
Pharisaite lak a mi, Judate vaihawmpa, amin Nikodem a-om hi.

Huai mi zan in Jesu kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "Rabbi, Pathian a kipan hong pai sinsakpa na hi chih ka thei uhi. Pathian na kiang a om lou hileh hiai thillamdang na hihte kuamah in ahihthei kei ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi kuapeuh apianthak keileh Pathian lalgam amu thei kei," achi hi.
Nikodem in akiang ah, "Mi atek nung in bangchi in apiangthak thei dia? Anu sung a nihvei lut in apiang thei dia hia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh tui a leh Kha a apianthak keileh Pathian lalgam alut thei kei hi.
Sa suan peuhmah sa ahi a, Kha suan peuhmah kha ahi.
Na pianthak ngeingei ding ahi ka hon chih lamdang sa ke'n.
Huih a-utna peuh ah anung a, aging na za hi, himahleh koi a kipan hong pai ahia, koi ah ahia ahoh ding chih na thei ngal kei a; kuapeuh Kha a piang huchibang mah in a-om hi," achi hi.
Nikodem in adawng a, "Hiai bangchi in a-om thei dia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Israelte sinsakpa na hi ngal a, huaite na thei kei maw?
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kou ka theih uh ka gen ua, ka muh uh ka theisak uh; himahleh ka thu theihsak uh na sang kei uhi.
Lei lam thil ka hon hilh bawn gingtaloute'n, van lam thil hon hilh leng bangchi in na gingta ding ua?
Mihing Tapa, van a ompa leh van a kipan hong sukpa kia lou ngal kuamah van ah akahtou ngei kei.
"Huan Mosi in gamdai a gul akhaikang bang in, Mihing Tapa khaikang in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh agingta in amah ziak a tangtawn hinna aneihna ding in.
Pathian in khovel a-it mahmah ziak in, a Tapa tang neihsun apia hi. Kuapeuh amah gingtate amanthat louh ua, tangtawn hinna aneih zawkna ding un.
Khovel siam louh tangsak ding in Pathian in khovel ah a Tapa asawl kei, khovel amah vang a ahintheihna ding in asawl ahi zaw hi.
"Kuapeuh amah gingta siam louh in a-om kei ding a, kuapeuh agingta lou, tu a kipan siam louh in a-om pah ngal hi; Pathian Tapa tang neihsun min agintak louh ziak in.
Hiai siamlouhna ahi, khovel ah vak ahong a, himahleh mi'n vak sang in mial a-itzaw uh; athilhihte uh agitlouh ziak in.
Kuapeuh thil gilou hih in vak aho nak, vak ah leng ahong pai kei hi; huchi lou in zaw athilhihte alang kha ding hi.
Himahleh kuapeuh adik hihte athilhih uh Pathian ziak a hih ahi, chih alatna ding in vak ah ahong pai uhi," achi hi.
Huai khit in Jesu anungzuite toh Judia gam ah ahoh ua, huai ah Jesu akiang uah a-om nilouh a, abaptis zel uhi.
Johan in leng Ainon ah, Salim kho kiang ah abaptis sam a, huai a tui atam ziak in mi ahong ua, baptisma atang uhi.
Hiai hun in Johan suangkul a khum ahi nai kei hi.
Huan Johan nungzuite leh Juda khenkhat silsiang thu ah akisel uhi.
Johan kiang ah ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Rabbi, Jordan gal a na kiang a om, athu mi na theihsakpa'n, ngai dih, mi abaptis a, akiang ah mi tengteng ahong pai uh," achi uhi.
Johan in adawng a, "Van a pan a piak ahihkeileh mihing in bangmah anei thei kei uhi.
Kei Khrist ka hi kei, ama a misawl ka hi, ka chih, noumau mahmah hon theihpihte na hi uhi.
Mouneipa zaw mounu pasal ahi; himahleh mouneipa lawm ding a athu za mouneipa aw ziak in akipak mahmah a, ka kipahna atangtungta hi.
Amah alian semsem ding a, kei bel ka neu hiaihiai ding," achi hi.
"Tunglam a kipan hong pai zaw mi tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi; lei a kipan bel lei a ahi a, lei lam thu agen a, van a kipan a hong paipa zaw mi tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi.
Amuh leh azak peuh atheisak hi; kuamah in athu theihsak ataksang kei uhi.
Athu theihsak taksangmi in, Pathian midiktat ahi, chih akipsak hi.
Pathian sawl in Pathian thu agen hi; ama'n zaw teh chitchiat in Kha ape ngal kei a.
Pa in Tapa a-it a, akhut ah bangkim avek in apeta hi.
Kuapeuh Tapa gingta in tangtawn hinna anei; himahleh Tapa gingta lou in hinna anei kei ding a, Pathian thangpaihna atung ah a-om zaw," achi hi.
Johan sang in Jesu'n nungzui tamzaw abawl a, tam abaptis zaw chih Pharisaite'n aza uh chih Toupa'n atheih in.
(Jesu hial in zaw abaptis kei a, anungzuite'n abaptis zaw zel uh),
Judia gam paisan in, Galili gam ah akik nawnta hi.
Huchi in Samaria gam tawn a pai akul hi.
Huchi in Samaria gam khua khat, Saikar achih uh, Jakob in atapa Joseph kiang a mun apiakna kiang ahong tung hi.
Huai ah Jakob tuileh a-om hi. Huchi in Jesu apaigim ziak in tuileh gei ah atu a; huai hun dak gukna khawng ahi.
Huchi in Samari numei khat tui tawi in ahong kuan a, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Dawn ding hon pia in," achi hi.
(Anungzuite lah nek ding lei in khua ah ahoh ngal ua).

Huchi in Samari numei in akiang ah, "Nang Juda mi hi chin a, kei Samari numei hi ing a, bangchidan a ka kiang a dawn ding hon ngen na hia? achi hi. Judate'n lah Samari mite bangmah in angai ngal kei ua," achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Pathian thilthawnpiak leh dawn ding hon pia in, na kiang a chipa thei leteh zaw nang akiang a ngen zaw ding hi chin a, ama'n tuihing hon pe ding hiven," achi hi.
Huan numei in akiang ah, "Pu, akhaikhiakna ding bangmah lah na nei kei a, tuileh athukthuk toh, koi a kipan in ahia huai tuihing na muh ding?
Ka pu uh Jakob sang in na thupizaw a hia? Ama'n hiai tuileh hon pia a, amah leh atate leh agante'n leng adawn uhi,” achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuapeuh hiai tui dawn adangtak nawn ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
"Kuapeuh akiang a ka piak ding tui dawn bel, dangtak nawn ngei lou ding a; akiang a tui ka piak ding pen amah ah tui nak ahong phulkhe ding a, tangtawn hinpha a kikhohtou ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan numei in akiang ah, "Pu, huai tui hon pe ve, ka dangtak nawnlouhna ding leh hiai tantan a tui tawi ding a ka hong kuanlouhna ding in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pai inla, na pasal va sam inla, hiai ah hong kik nawn in,” achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, “Pasal ka nei sam a," chi in adawng hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pasal ka nei sam a, na chih zaw, na chi dik ve;
pasal nga na neita a, tua na neihpa pen na pasal ahi kei him ahi, hiai thu na chi dik ve,” achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, "Pu, zawlnei na hi chih ka thei hi.
Kou pipute'n hiai tang ah Pathian abe zel ua; nou bel mihing in Pathian abiakna mun ding Jerusalem khua ahi, na chi sese ua," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, kei hon gingta in, hiai tang chitchiat lou leh Jerusalem khua chitchiat lou ah leng Pa na biak hun uh atungta hi.
Nou na theih louhpi uh na be nak ua, kou zaw ka theih uh ka bia uh; hotdamna lah Judate a kipan ahi ngal a.
Himahleh Pathian be taktakte'n kha leh thutak a Pa abiak hun uh tung ding ahita, tu in leng atung lel hi, Pa'n huchibang mi abemi ding in azong hi.
Pathian zaw Kha ahi a, abemite'n kha leh thutak a abiak ngeingei ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, "Messia, Khrist akichi, ahong pai ding chih ka thei, amah ahong pai chiang in bangkim ahon hilh ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Keimah nang hon houpihpa, huai amah ka hi," achi hi.
Huan huai lai in anungzuite ahong pai ua, numei ahoupih lamdang asa mahmah uhi; himahleh kuamah in, "Bang zong na hia? Bangziak a numei houpih?" achi kei uh.
Numei in atuibel apaisan a, khua ah ava pai a, mite kiang ah,
"Ка thilhih peuh hon hilh zel mi khat a-om, hong unla, en dih uh; Khrist ahihtheih tuak na hiam?" achi hi.
Amaute khua a kipan ahong pawt ua, akiang lam azuanta uhi.
Huai kal in nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ne in," achi uhi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Na theih louh uh nek ding an ka nei," achi hi.
Huan nungzuite akihou ua, "Anek ding mi'n ahon tawi ua eita maw?" akichi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah agen a, "Hon sawlpa deihlam hihleh, ama nna sep zoh ding ka an ahi.
Nou, buhlakna ding kha li a-om lai, na chi uh hilou hia? Ngai un ka hon hilh ahi, dak unla loute en un, tu mahmah in lak ding in amin ahi.
Alapa'n loh amu a, tangtawn hinna ding in gah ala hi, huchi a atuhpa leh alapa akipah tuaktheihna ding un.
Khat in atuh a, midang in ala chih thu hiai ah adik hi.
Na sepgim louh uh at dia hon sawl ka hi; midang in asem ua, nou asepsa uh na sunzom uh ahi," achi hi.
Huan numei in, "Ka thilhih peuh hon hilh zel," chi a atheihsak thu ziak in huai khua a om Samari mi tampi in Jesu agingta uhi.
Huchi in Jesu kiang ah Samari mite ahong pai ua, akiang ua om ding in akhou ngutngut ua; huchi in huai ah ni nih ataam hi.
Huan midang tampi in amah thu ziak in agingta samta uhi.
Amau numei kiang ah, "Tu in zaw na thugen ziak a gingta ka hi kei uh; koumau ngei in athu ka za ua, hiai mipa Khrist, khovel Hondampa ngei ahi chih ka theita uh," achi uhi.
Huan ni nih nung in huai a pan pawt in, Galili gam ah apaita hi.
Jesu ngei in, zawlnei zaw ama kholam ah pahtawi in a-om ngei kei chih atheihpih hi.
Huchi in Galili gam ahong tun in Galili gam mite'n ana kipahpih ua, Jerusalem a ankuanglui lai a athilhih tengteng amuh tak ziak un; amau mah leng ankuangluina ah ahoh sam uhi.
Galili gam a Kana khua, tui uain asuahsakna mun ahong tung nawnta hi. Kumpi milian kuahiam a-om a, Kapernaum ah atapa achina hi.
Judia gam a kipan Galili gam ah Jesu ahong chih azak in akiang ah ahohtou a, va hohsuk a atapa si dekdek hihdam ding in achial hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na muh kei uleh na gingta kei hial ding uh," achi hi.
Huan Kumpi milian in akiang ah, "Pu, ka ta asih ma in hong suk mai in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pai nawnta in, na tapa adamta," achi hi. Huai mipa'n, Jesu'n akiang a thu agen agingta a, apaita hi.
Apaisuk lai in asikhate'n ana dawn ua, "Na tapa adamta," ana chi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah adam tung lai adong hi. Amau akiang ah, "Zan in dak sagihna ah akhosik ahong daita hi," achi uhi.
Naupang pa'n Jesu'n akiang a, "Na tapa adamta hi,” achih lai ahi chih atheita a; amah leh a-inkuanpihte'n avek un, agingtata uhi.
Hiai Judia gam a kipan Galili gam a ahong a Jesu thillamdang hih anihveina ahi.
Huai thil nung in Judate ankuangluina a-om a; Jerusalem ah Jesu ahohtou hi.
Jerusalem ah belam kongkhak kiang ah dil khat a-om a, huai mun Hebru pau in Bethesda achi ua, inlim nga anei hi.
Huai ah tui hong tat ngak in damloute, mittawte, khebaite, zawte tampi alum phengphung uhi.
Bang hun hiam in huai dil ah angel ahohsuk a, tui ava tok zel a; kuapeuh huai tui kitoh khit a va lut masa penpen in, bangchibang natna nei hileh leng hihdam in a-om zel hi.
Huai ah kum sawmthum-le-giat damlou mi kuahiam a-om hi.
Jesu'n huai a lum amu a, huchibang in sawtpi ana omta chih athei a, akiang ah, "Hihdam na ut hia?" achi hi.
Damloupa'n, “Pu, tui kitoh in dil a hon koih ding mi ka nei kei a, ka kuan sung in midang in hon makhelh nak uh," chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in," achi hi.
Thakhat in huai mipa adam pah a, a-awngphah la in, apaita hi.
Huai ni Sabbath ni ahi a, Judate'n adampa kiang ah, "Sabbath ni ei ve, na awngphah na lak asiang kei," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon hihdampa ngeingei in ka kiang ah, 'Na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in,' hon chi ahi," chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in, na kiang a chipa kua ahia?" chi in adong uhi.
Himahleh adampa'n kua ahia ahih athei kei, huai a mipi a-om ziak un Jesu apaimangta hi.
Aden chiang in Jesu'n amah tempul ah amu a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na damta hi, khial nawn ke'n, huchi lou in zaw thil hoih lou sem na tung ah ahong tung kha ding," achi hi.
Huan huai mi ava paikhia a, Judate kiang ah, "Ahihdampa Jesu ahi," chih ahilh hi.
Huchi in Sabbath ni a athilhih ziak in Judate'n Jesu a-engbawl ua, thah ding in azong uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Ka Pa'n tu tanpha in nna asem zel a, ke'n leng ka sem zel," achi hi.
Huchi in Judate'n hihlup atum semsem ua, Sabbath ni atan louh ziak kia ahi kei, Pathian amah Pa a abawl leh Pathian toh kikim a akibawl ziak in leng ahi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, “Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Tapa in amah in bangmah ahihthei kei, Pa thilhih amuh kia lou ngal; thil ahih peuhmah, Tapa in leng ahih sam zel hi.
Pa in Tapa a-it a, athilhih peuhmah akiang ah amusak a; hiaite sang a thilhih thupizaw akiang ah amusak lai ding, lamdang na sak ding un.
Pa in misite kaithou a, hinna apiak bang in, Tapa in leng a-utna peuh kiang ah hinna apia hi.
Pa in kuamah vai ahawmsak ngei kei, himahleh vai tengteng Tapa in ahawmsak zaw hi;
mi tengteng in Pa zahna apiak bang un, Tapa leng zahna apiakna ding un. Kuapeuh Tapa zahloute'n, Pa asawlpa leng azah kei uhi.
"Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh ka thu za a, hon sawlpa gingta in, tangtawn hinna anei; siam louh in a-om kei a, sihna a kipan apawt a, hinna ah alut zawta hi.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ahun atung dekta, tu in leng atung lellel, huai hun chiang in misite'n Pathian Tapa aw aza ding ua, aza peuhmah ahing ding uh.
Pa in amah a hinna aneih bang in, Tapa in leng amah a hinna nei ding in apeta hi.
Mihing Tapa ahih ziak in, akiang ah thukhenna leh thuneihna apia hi.
Hiai lamdang sa kei un, ahun atungta, huai hun chiang in han a om tengteng in a-aw aza ding ua,
ahong pawt vek ding uh; thil hoih hihte hinna tang in athounawn ding ua, thil gilou hihte siam louh tang in athounawn ding uhi.
"Keimah in bangmah ka hihthei kei; bil a ka zak bangbang in vai ka hawm zel; ka vaihawm adik ahi, keimah deihlam a om ka tum kei; hon sawlpa deihlam a om ka tup zel ziak in.
"Keimah tanchin theihpihtu a pang hi leng, ka thu theihpihna adik kei ding hi.
Ka tanchin toh kisai theihpihtu midang khat a-om, ama'n ka tanchin atheihpihna apiak pen dik ahi, chih ka thei hi.
Nou Johan kiang ah mi na sawl ua, ama'n thutak thu ahon theihpih hi.
Thu theihpihna ka san mihing a kipan ahi kei a; himahleh na hinna ding un hiai thu ka gen ahi.
Huai Johan khawnvak kuangtak leh vaktak ahi, avak ah nopsak takdih na ut uhi.
"Himahleh theihpihna ka neih zaw Johan theihpihna sang in athupizaw hi; Pa'n thilhih zoh ding a ahon piak, ka thilhih ngei in Pa'n hon sawl chih ka tanchin atheisak hi.
"Pa hon sawlpa ngei leng ka tanchin atheihpihtu in apang hi. Nou chik lai mah in a-aw na za ngei kei ua, amel leng na mu ngei kei uh.
Athu leng noumau ah na tengsak kei uh, asawl mipa na gintak louh ziak uh ahi.
"Laisiangthou sung a tangtawn hinna om ding a na ngaihtuah ziak un na nak zon ngial ua; huaite mah ka tanchin theihpihtute ahi uhi.
Himahleh hinna nei ding in ka kiang ah na hong nuam kei uhi.
"Mihing pahtawina ka sang kei.
Himahleh nou ka hon thei hi, Pathian itna noumau ah na nei kei uhi.
Ka Pa min in ka hong a, noute'n na hon kipahpih kei uh; midang ama min in hong taleh amah na na kipahpih ding uhi.
Nou kipahtawi tuahna paktate'n Pathian tak kia a pawt pahtawina zong lou in bangchi in kei na hon gingta thei ding ua?
Ke'n Pa kiang a nou ka hon hek ding gingta kei un; nou hon hek khat a-om, na muan uh Mosi ngei.
Mosi gingta hi le uchin, kei leng na hon gingtata ding uh; ka tanchin gelh lah amah ahi ngal a.
Himahleh ama thugelh gingta lou in, bangchi in ka thute na gingta ding ua?" achi hi.
Huai thilte khit in, Galili dil, Tiberias tuipi kichi gallam ah Jesu apai hi.
Damloute tung a thillamdang ahihte amuh ziak un mipi tampi in amah azui uhi.
Jesu tang ah ahohtou a, huai ah anungzuite kiang ah atu hi.
Huan Paikan Ankuangluina, Judate ankuangluina anaita hi.
Jesu adak a, mipi tampi in akiang lam hon zuan in amu a, Philip kiang ah, "Hiaite nek ding tanghou koi a lei ding i hi ua?" achi hi.
Huai thu amah ze-etna ding a agen ahi, ahih ding lah ama'n athei ngal a.
Philip in akiang ah, "Michih in tawmchik a atan chiat ding uh leng, makhai zanih man tanghou in adaih kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan anungzuite lak a khat, Simon Peter unau Andru in akiang ah,
"Barli buh tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih nei pasal naupang khat hiai ah a-om, himahleh mi hiai zah lawmlawm lak ah bang tham hizou ding ahia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Mite tusak un," achi hi. Huai ah loupa tampi a-om hi. Huchi in pichingte atusuk ua, atamlam uh sangnga vel ahi.
Jesu'n tanghou phelte ala a, kipahthu agen khit in atute kiang ah ahawm a, huchi mah bang in ngasate leng adeih hun un ahawm sam hi.
Huan akham nung un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangmah mang lou ding in anente luak un," achi hi.
Huchi in aluak ua, barli buh tanghou phel nga nete nek bang nente bawm sawm-le-nih ahihdim uhi.
Mite'n athillamdang hih amuhtak un, "Hiai mi, zawlnei, khovel a hong dingpa ana hi ngei e,” achi uhi.
Huchi in amah kumpipa dia bawl ding a mat teitei tum in ahong kuan ding uh, chih Jesu'n athei a, tang ah amah kia in apaituam nawnta hi.
Huan nitaklam in anungzuite tuipi ah apaisuk uhi.
Long ah atuang ua, tuipi ah Kapernaum azuan uhi. Khua amialta a, Jesu lah akiang uah ahong tung nai kei hi.
Huihpi hattak anun ziak in tuikihot asang hulhul hi.
Ching sawmnih leh ching nga hiam, ching sawmthum hiam akalh nung un, tuipi tung a khe a Jesu pai a, long lam hon naih in amu ua, alauta uhi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
Huchi in kilawptak in long ah Jesu atuangsakta ua, huchi in along uh azotna gam uah atung pah hi.
Azing in dil gal lehlam a mipi dinghte'n, long khat lou ngal long dang a-om kei a, anungzuite toh long ah Jesu atuang ton kei a, anungzuite amau kia in apai uh chih athei uhi.
Himahleh Toupa'n kipahthu agen nung a, tanghou anekna kiang uh, Tiberias a kipan long neu chikchik ahong tung uhi.
Huchi in mipi'n Jesu leh anungzuite a-omta kei uh chih atheih un, amau leng long neute a tuang in, Jesu zong in Kapernaum khua ahong tung uhi.
Huan tuipi gal a ahong muh un akiang ah, "Rabbi, chik in ahia hiai lam na hong tun?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, thillamdangte na muh ziak ua hon zong na hi kei ua, tanghou phel na nekvah ziak uh ahi zaw.
An mang thei phet zong in phiaphia kei un, himahleh an, tangtawn hinpha a om gige ding, Mihing Tapa hon piak ding pen zong in phe zaw un; Pa Pathian in amah achiamtehta hi," chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Pathian nna ka septheihna ding un bang ahia ka hih ding uh?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian nasep hiai ahi, amisawl gingta le uchin," chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Chiamtehna bang ahia na hih ding, ka muh ua nang ka hon gintak theihna ding un? Thil bang ahia na hih ding?
Van a kipan akiang uah amau tanghou nek ding apia chih gelh bang in, ka pipute un gamdai ah manna ane uh," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, van a kipan a tanghou na muh pen uh Mosi hon piak ahi kei, ka Pa'n van a kipan tanghoutak noute ahon piak ahi zaw.
Pathian tanghou van a kipan in ahong paisuk a, khovel kiang a hinna pepa ahi," achi hi.
Amau, "Toupa, huai tanghou hon pe gige in," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah hinna tanghou ka hi; kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai agilkial kei ding, kuapeuh kei hon gingta chik mah chiang in adangtak kei ding.
Himahleh nou na hon muh un leng na hon gingta kei uh chih ka hon hilhta ve.
Pa'n hon piak peuhmah ka kiang ah ahong pai vek ding uh; kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai ka delhkhe ngei kei ding hi.
Kei deihlam hih ding a van a kipan a hong paisuk ka hi kei, hon sawlpa deihlam hih ding a hong paisuk ka hi zaw hi.
Hiai ahon sawlpa deihlam ahi, ama'n hon piak tengteng bangmah mangsak lou in, nitawp ni chiang in kaithou zaw leng.
Kuapeuh Tapa mu a gingta in tangtawn hinna aneih a, nitawp ni chiang a amah ka kaihthoh ding ka Pa deihlam ahih ziak in," achi hi.
Van a kipan a tanghou hong paisuk ka hi, achih ziak in, atung ah Judate aphun uhi.
"Hiai mi Joseph tapa Jesu ahi kei a hia, anu leh apa leng i theih? Van a kipan a hong paisuk ka hi, bangchi chih a chi ahia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Phunphun dah un.
Pa hon sawlpa'n ahip keileh kuamah ka kiang ah ahong pai thei kei. Ke'n ahong pai mi nitawp ni chiah ka kaithou ding.
Zawlneite laibu ah 'Pathian hilh in a-om ding uh,' chih gelh ahi. Michih Pa thu za a thei peuhmah ka kiang ah ahong pai uhi.
Pathian a kipan pen lou ngal in kuamah in Pa amu ngei kei, ama'n zaw Pa amu hi.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh agingta in tangtawn hinna anei.
Keimah hinna tanghou ka hi.
Na pipute un gamdai ah manna ane ua, huchi in asi uhi.
Hiai tanghou i chih pen van a kipan a hong paisuk ahi, mi'n anek ua asihlouhna ding un.
Keimah van a kipan a tanghou hing hong paisuk ka hi, kuapeuh in hiai tanghou anekleh tangtawn in ahing gige ding; ahi, khovel hinna dia ka piak ding tanghou ka sa ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Judate akisel ua, "Hiai mi'n bangchi in asa nek ding in hon pe thei ding ahia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Mihing Tapa sa na nek ua, asisan na dawn kei uleh noumau in hinna nei lou hi ve uchin.
Kuapeuh ka sa ne a, ka sisan dawn in tangtawn hinna anei; huan, nitawp ni chiang in amah ka kaithou ding.
Ka sa zaw an taktak ahi a, ka sisan leng dawn tak taktak ahi.
Kuapeuh ka sa ne a, ka sisan dawnmi, keimah ah a-om gige a, kei leng amah ah ka om gige hi.
Pa hing in hon sawl a, Pa ziak a hing ka hih mah bang in, kuapeuh kei hon nete keimah ziak in amah leng ahing ding hi.
Hiai van a kipan a tanghou hong paisuk ahi; na pipute un tanghou anek ua, asih bang uh zaw ahi kei; kuapeuh hiai tanghou ne tangtawn in ahing gige ding,” achi hi.
Huai thute Kapernaum a sinagog a thu ahilh lai a agen ahi.
Huchi in anungzuite akhen tampi in huai azak un, “Hiai thuhaksa ahi, kua'n angaikhe thei dia?" achi uhi.
Huai thu ah anungzuite aphun uh chih Jesu'n alungsim a atheih in, akiang uah, "Hiai thu in hon hih lunghi lou hia?
Mihing Tapa tuma lam a a-omna ngei a kahtou mu le uchin, bang na chi ding ua?
Hinna pia zaw kha ahi a, sa zaw bangmah ding in aphatuam kei; na kiang ua thu ka gente kha ahi a, hinna leng ahi.
Himahleh na lak uah akhen gingta lou om na hi uh," achi hi. Jesu'n atung a kipan in agingtaloute leh amansak dingpa atheigige ngal a.
Huan ama'n, huaiziak in ahi na kiang ua, "Pa in apiak keileh kuamah ka kiang ah ahong pai thei kei, ka chih," achi hi.
Hiai nung in anungzuite akhen tampi akinunghei ua, amah akithuahpih nawnta kei uhi.
Jesu'n sawm-le-nihte kiang ah, "Nou leng paimang sam na ut uhia?" achi a.
Simon Peter in, “Toupa, kua kiang ah ahia ka pai tuan ding uh? Nangma'n tangtawn hinna thu na nei hi.
Nangmah Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi chih ka taksangta ua, theih leng ka thei uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Nou sawm-le-nihte keimah hon tel hilou na hi uh maw? Na lak ua mi khat diabol ahih laitei toh," achi hi.
Iskariot, Simon tapa Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a tel sam, huai thu agen ahi, amah zuausan a mansakpa ding ahi.
Huai khit in Galili gam ah Jesu avak a; Judate'n amah hihlup atup ziak un Judia gam apha nuam kei hi.
Judate Biakbuk Ankuangluina anaita hi.
Huchi in a-unaute'n akiang ah, "Hiai a kipan in Judia gam ah va hoh in, na nungzuite'n na thilhih amuhtheihna ding un," achi uhi.
"Kuamah in aguk in thil bangmah ahih kei ua, amah mah in alangtang in mite theih ding in ahih hi. Hiai thilte na hih ngalleh khovel kiang ah kimusak in," achi uhi.
A-unaute nangawn in leng amah agingta kei uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka hun atung nai kei; nou hun zaw chik lai peuh in atung gige hi.
Khovel in nou ahon ho thei kei, kei zaw hon ho nak uh, athilhihte uh gilou ahi chih ka theihsak ziak in.
Nou ankuangluina ah va hohtou unla, kei zaw tu ankuangluina ah ka hohtou tadih kei ding, ka hun atun nai louh ziak in," achi hi.
Huai thu akiang uah gen in Galili gam ah a-om nilouh hi.
Himahleh a-unaute ankuangluina a ahohtouh nung un, amah leng vantang theih louh in, aguk bang in ahohtou sam hi.
Judate'n ankuangluina ah amah azong ua, "Koi a om ahia?" achi uhi.
Atung ah mipite lak a mi aphun sim supsup ua, khenkhat in, "Mihoih ahi," achi ua; khenkhat in, "Hi dek kei e, mipi khem ahi," achi uhi.
Himahleh Judate akihtak ziak un kuamah in alangtang in atungtang thu agenlang ngam kei uhi.
Ankuanglui san laitak in, tempul ah Jesu ahohtou a, thu ahilh hi.
Huan Judate'n, "Hiai mi'n zil ngeiloupi a bang achia hichi theih ahia?" achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huan Jesu'n amau adawng a, "Ka thuhilh kei a hilou in, hon sawlpa thu ahi zaw.
Kuapeuh ama deihlam hih ut in ka thuhilh Pathian a kipan hia, keimah phuahtawm a ka gen chih athei ding hi.
Kuapeuh ama phuahtawm thu gen zaw, ama hoihna zong ahi; asawlpa hoihna zongmi mitak ahi, amah ah diklouhna himhim a-om kei hi.
Mosi in na kiang uah dan ahon pe kei a hia? Himahleh na lak uah kuamah in dan na zui kei uh. Nou bang achia hon hihlup tum na hi ua?" achi hi.
Mipi'n, "Dawi zawl na hi ve; kua'n ahia hon hihlup tum?" chi in adawng uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a akiang uah, "Thil khat ka hih nou tengteng in lamdang na sa uh.
Ahi a, Mosi in zeksum thu nou ahon piak ziak in Sabbath ni in leng mi zek na sum zel uhi. Huai pen Mosi a kipan hilou in pipute a kipan ahi zaw hi.
Mosi Dan a tatleklouhna ding a Sabbath ni a pasal in azek asum ngalleh, ke'n Sabbath ni a mi ka hihdam ziak in ka tung ah na heh tuam uh maw?
Akilatdan in ngaihtuah kei unla, diktattak in ngaihtuah zaw un," achi hi.
Huan Jerusalem a mi khenkhat in, "Hiai mi thah atuppa uh hilou hia?
En dih uh, alangtang in hiai ah thu agen a, akiang ah bangmah agen kei uhi. Amah Khrist ahi chih vaihawmte'n thei taktak uh ahita diam?
Hiai mi ahong kipatna lam nangawn i thei ngal a. Khrist ahong kilat chiang in ahong kipatna lam kuamah in athei kei ding uh," achi uhi.

Huaiziak in tempul a Jesu'n thu ahilh kawm in akikou a, "Nou na hon thei ua, ka hong kipatna lam leng na thei uh. Himahleh keimah thu a hong pai ka hi kei, amah kei hon sawlpa midik ahi, amah lah na thei ngal kei ua.
Ke'n amah ka thei; amah a kipan a hong pawt ka hi a, ama'n lah ahon sawl ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in amah mat atumta ua, himahleh ahun atun nai louh ziak in kuamah in akhoih thei kei uhi.
Mipi akhen tampite'n bel amah agingta ua, "Khrist ahong kilak chiang in, hiai mi hih sang in chiamtehna tamzaw ahih tuan dia hia?" achi uhi.
Huan Pharisaite'n atung a mipi phunna thute aza ua; huchi in siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n amah man ding in heutute asawlta uhi.
Jesu'n, "Sawt lou kal na kiang uah ka om phot ding a, hon sawlpa kiang ah ka pai ding hi.
Nou na hon zong ding ua, na hon mu kei ding uh; ka omna ah leng na hong thei kei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan Judate akihou ua, "I muh louh ding in hiai mi koi a hoh dek ahi ding? Grik pemdalhte kiang a hoh in Grikte thu va hilh ding adiam aw?
Nou na hon zong ding ua, na hon mu kei ding uh, ka omna ah leng na hong thei kei ding uh achih, bang achihna adiam maw?" achi uhi.
Huan ankuanglui ni nanungpen, ni thupi ni in, Jesu adingh a, akikou a, "Kuapeuh adangtakleh ka kiang ah hong henla, dawn hen.
Kuapeuh kei hon gingta Laisiangthou gen bang in tuihing luite asung a pan ahong luangkhe ding," achi hi.
Hiai thu agingtate'n Kha atan ding thu uh agenna ahi; Jesu pahtawi a a-om nai louh ziak in Kha lah piak ahi nai tadih ngal kei ua.
Huchi in mipi lak a khenkhat in huai thu azak un, "Hiai zaw zawlnei hi petmah e," achi uhi.
Khenkhat in, hiai zaw, "Khrist ahi," achi ua, khenkhat in bel, "Bang ding in Galili gam ah Khrist ahong pawt tel dia?
Khrist zaw David suante lak ah, David omna khua Bethlehem a apawt ding ahi, chih Laisiangthou in agen kei a hia?" achi uhi.
Huchi in amah ziak in mipi akikhen ua, akilangta uhi.
Khenkhat in mat a-ut ua, himahleh kuamah in akhoih tuan kei uh.
Huan heutute, siampu liante leh Pharisaite kiang ah ahong pai nawn ua akiang uah, "Bang achia hon tonpih lou?" achi uhi.
Heutute'n, "Hiai mi bang in kuamah in thu agen ngei kei," achi ua, adawng uhi.
Pharisaite'n akiang uah, "Nou leng pimang a om sam na hita uh maw?
Vaihawmte leh Pharisaite lak a mi amah gingta a-omta a hia?
Huai dan thei lou mipite sop lai, hamsethuak ei ve ua,” achi ua, adawng uhi.
Nikodem, tuma a Jesu kiang a hong, alak ua pang sam ahi a, ama'n akiang uah,
"Amah kam ngei a thu zak leh athilhih theih ahih ma, i dan un mi siam louh atangsak ngei a hia?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Nang leng huai Galili mi na hi sam maw? Zong lechin, Galili gam ah zawlnei kuamah pawt ding a-om kei uh chih thei tanla," achi ua, adawng uhi.
Huan michih ama inn chiat ah apaita uhi.
Himahleh Olive tang ah Jesu ahohtou hi.
Zingsang phalvak in tempul ah alut nawn a, mi tengteng akiang ah ahong pai ua, amah atu a, amaute thu ahilh hi.
Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n numei khat angkawm lai amat uh ahon pi ua; alai ah adingsak uhi.
Jesu kiang ah, "Sinsakpa, hiai numei angkawm, a-angkawm laitak a amat uh ahi.
Mosi Dan laibu in hichibang mi suang a denlup thu ahon pia hi; nang bangchi na sa a?" achi uhi.
Huai thu amah hekna ding amuhtheihna ding ua, ze-etna dia agen uh ahi. Huchi in Jesu akun a, athugen uh za lou bang in akhutzung in leitual agelh hi.
Huan adot lailai ziak un amah adaktou a akiang uah, "Na lak ua khelhna nei lou in amah suang in deng masa heh," achi hi.
Akun nawn a, akhutzung in leitual agelh nawn hi.
Amau athugen azak un, upapen a pan atawp pha in, khatkhat in akigelkhia ua; huchi in numei alai a a-omna ngei a om toh Jesu kia a-om uhi.
Jesu adaktou a, "Numei, koi a om ahi ua? Kuamah in siam louh hon tangsak lou uhia?" achi hi.
Huan ama'n, "Toupa, kuamah in hon tangsak kei," achi hi. Jesu'n, "Ke'n leng siam louh ka hon tangsak kei; pai inla, tuban khial nawn ke'n," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang uah thu agen nawn a, "Kei khovel vak ka hi; kei hon zui kuapeuh mial ah akhosa kei ding a, hinna vak anei zaw ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Pharisaite'n akiang ah, "Nangmah thu theisak na hi; na thu theihsak adik kei," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah thu theisak na hi taleng zong ka thu theihsak adik ahi. Ke'n ka hong kipatna leh ka manohna ding ka thei hi; noute'n bel ka hong kipatna leh ka manohna ding na thei kei uh.
Nou sadan in vai na hawmsak uh; ke'n kuamah vai ka hawmsak kei.
Ahi, vai hawmsak na hi taleng zong, ka vai hawmsak adik ding; keimah kia ka hi kei a, kei leh Pa hon sawlpa ka hi zaw uhi.
Ahi, na dan laibu uah leng mi nih theihpihna adik, chih gelh ahi.
Kei ka hihleh keimah thu theisakpa ka hi a, Pa hon sawlpa'n ka thu atheisak hi," chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Koi a na Pa om ahia?" achi uhi. Jesu'n, "Nou kei na hon thei kei uh, ka Pa leng na thei kei uh; kei hon thei hi le uchin, ka Pa leng na thei ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huai thu tempul a thu ahilh kawm a, sumkoihna mun a agen ahi; ahun a tun nai louh ziak in kuamah in amah aman nai kei uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ka paimang ding a, nou na hon zong ding ua, na khelhna uah na si ding uh; ka hohna ding ah na hong thei kei ding uh," achi nawn hi.
Judate'n, "Ka hohna ding ah na hong thei kei ding uh, achih, akihihlum dia adiam?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou nuailam a kipan na hi ua; kei tunglam a kipan ka hi; nou khovel a na hi ua, kei zaw hiai khovel a ka hi kei hi.
Huaiziak in na kiang uah, na khelhna uah na si ding uh ka chih, huai amah ka hi, chih na gintak kei ualeh na khelhna uah na si ngeingei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan amau akiang ah, "Kua na hia?" achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Atung a kipan in na kiang uah ka genta hi.
Nou tungtang thu ah thil tampi gen ding leh ngaihtuah ding ka nei; himahleh, hon sawlpa zaw midik ahi; amah kiang a ka thuzakte khovel kiang ah ka hilh ahi," achi hi.
Pa thu akiang uah agen chih atheisiam kei uhi.
Huchi in Jesu mah in, "Nou mihing Tapa na khaikang nung un, amah ka hi chih leh ke'n keimah thu in thil bangmah ka hih kei a, Pa hon hilh bang zel in hiai thu ka gen zaw ahi chih na thei ding uhi.
Hon sawlpa ka kiang ah a-om a, Pa'n kei kia in hon nuse ngei kei; athil kipah lam peuhmah ka hih zel ziak in," achi hi.
Huan huai thute agen lai in mi tampi'n amah agingta uhi.
Huchi in Jesu'n amah gingta Judate kiang ah, "Ka thu a na om gige uleh, ka nungzuite na hi taktak ding uhi.
Huan thutak na thei ding ua, thutak in ahon suaktasak ding,” achi hi.
Huan amau akiang ah, “Abraham suante ka hi ua, tutan in kuamah sal ah ka om ngei kei uh, suahtaksak in na om ding uh bangchi chih a chi na hia?" achi ua, adawng uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh thil hihkhial khelhna sal ahi.
Sal kichi peuhmah inn ah a-om gige kei a; Tapa bel a-om gige hi.
Tapa in sal a pan ahon suahtaksakleh na suakta taktak ding uhi.
Abraham suante na hi uh chih ka thei hi, himahleh hon thah na tum ngal ua, ka thu in noute a mun aneih louh ziak in.
Ke'n ka Pa kiang a thil ka muh ka gen a; nou leng na pa uh kiang a thil na muh uh na hih uh," achi hi.
Huan amau akiang ah, "Ka pa uh Abraham ahi," achi ua, adawng uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Abraham tate hi le uchin, Abraham thilhih na hihta ding uhi," achi hi.
"Himahleh Pathian kiang a thutak ka zak, kei ahon hilhpa ngei, tu'n ah hon thah na tum ngal ua; Abraham in zaw hichibang in ahih kei. Nou zaw na pa uh thil na hih nak uhi," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Ang kikawm a piang ka hi kei uh, Pa khat kia ka nei uh, Pathian," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian na Pa uh hitaleh nou kei na hon it ding uh; Pathian a pan hong pawt leh akiang a kipan hong pai ka hi; keimah thu a hong leng ka hi sam kei, ama'n ahon sawl zaw hi.
Bangziak a ka thugen theisiam lou? Ka thu na zak theih louh ziak uh ahi.

Nou zaw na pa uh diabol a pawt na hi ua, na pa uh utna na hih ding uh. Amah zaw atung a kipan tualthat ahi, thutak ah a-om kei; asung a thutak himhim a-om louh ziak in. Zuauthu agen in amah a ngei agen ahi; zuauthei ahi ngal a, zuaupa leng ahi.
Thutak ka gen ziak in nou hon gingta lou na hi uhi.
Na lak uah kua'n ahia khelhna a siam louh hon tan thei om? Thutak ka gen in leng nou bang achia hon gingta lou?
Pathian a pan pawt in Pathian thu apakta a; Pathian a pan pawt na hih louh ziak un na pakta kei uhi," achi hi.
Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Samari mi dawi zawl na hi ka chih uh, ka chi dik ngel uh ahi kei maw?" achi ua, adawng uhi.
Jesu'n, "Dawi zawl ka hi kei. Ka Pa ka zahtak ahi zaw, nou kei na hon zahtak kei uhi.
Himahleh keimah kilawmna zong ka hi kei; azongmi leh angaihtuahmi khat a-om hi.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi'n ka thu azuihleh tangtawn in sihna amu kei ding," achi hi.
Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Dawi zawl na hi chih tu in ka theita uhi. Abraham asita, zawlneite toh, nang mi'n ka thu azuihleh tangtawn in sihna achiam kei ding, na chi maw.
Ka pu uh Abraham sang in na thupizaw a hia? Amah leng asita a, zawlneite leng asita uh; kua a kibawl na hia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n, "Keimah kipahtawi hi taleng ka kipahtawina bangmah ahi kei; na Pathian uh, na chih uh ka Pa, hon pahtawipa ahi; nou amah na thei kei uhi.
Ke'n zaw amah ka thei; amah ka thei kei chi leng noumau bang a zuauthei ka hi ding; huchi in amah ka thei a, athu leng ka zui zel.
Na pu uh Abraham in ka ni mu ding ahih ziak in akithalawp a, huan amu petmah a, akipak hi," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Nang kum sawmnga leng hi nailoupi in, Abraham na mu a hia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Abraham om ma a Ompa ka hi,” achi hi.
Huchi in adenna ding un suangte atawm ua; himahleh Jesu akibu a, tempul a kipan apawtta hi.
Huan Jesu'n apai kawm in pian tung a kipan mittaw khat amu hi.
Anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Rabbi, mittawsa a apian kua'n ahia thil hihkhial, hiai mi hia, anu leh apa?" chi in adong uhi.
Jesu'n, "Hiai mi'n ahihkhial kei, anu leh apa'n leng ahihkhial kei uh; Pathian nasepte atung a alatna ding ahi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
"Sun ahih lai in hon sawlpa nna i sep ngeingei ding uh ahi; zan hi dekdekta ahi, huai hun chiang in kuamah in nna asem thei kei ding uh.
Khovel a ka om sung in khovel vak ka hi," chi in adawng hi.
Huchibang a agen khit in, lei ah chil asia a, tungman abawl a, huan amit ah tungman anuh hi.
