Akiang ah, "Siloam dil ah va sil in,” achi a, (huai tuh Sawl chihna ahi). Va pai in asil a, mitvak in ahong kik nawn hi.
Huchi in avengte leh tuma a khutdoh a mute'n, "Hiai mi tu kawm a khutdohpa ahi kei a hia?" achi uhi.
Midang in, "Ahi mah vo oi,” achi ua, midang in, "Hi kei e, akibatpih ahi zaw," achi uhi. Ama'n bel "Huai mi mah ka hi," achi hi.
Huan amau akiang ah, "Na mit bangchi in ahia ahong vak?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Mi khat, Jesu achih un tungman abawl a, ka mit anuh a, 'Siloam dil ah va hoh inla va sil in' ahon chi a, huchi in ka va hoh a, ka sil a, mitvakna ka muta," achi hi.
Huan amau akiang ah, "Amah koi a om ahia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka thei kei," achi hi.
Amaute'n Pharisaite kiang ah huai mittawpa ahon pi uhi.
Jesu'n tungman bawl a, amit ahihvak ni Sabbath ni ahi.
Huchi in Pharisaite'n amit ahong vak takdan adong nawn uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka mit ah tungman akoih a, ka sil a, ka mutheita hi," achi hi.

Huan Pharisai khenkhat in, "Huai mi'n Sabbath ni atan louh ziak in, Pathian a kipan ahi kei," achi uhi. Khenkhat in bel, "Mikhial in bangchi in hichibang thillamdang ahihthei dia?" achi uhi. Huchi in akikhen ua, akilangta uhi.
Mittawpa kiang ah, "Na mit ahihvaksak, nang bangchibang in amah na ngaihtuah a?" achi nawn ua. Ama'n, "Zawlnei ahi,” achi hi.
Himahleh Judate'n amit hong vakta nu leh pa asap masiah uh, mittaw ana hi him a, amit ahong vakta chih atungtang thu ataksang kei uhi.
Anu leh apa kiang ah, "Hiai mi na tapa uh mittawsa a piang ahi na chih uh ahi hia? Bangchi in ahia tua amuh theih tak?" chi in adong uhi.
Anu leh apa'n, "Hiai ka tapa uh ahi chih ka thei uh, mittawsa in apiang chih leng ka thei uh.
Himahleh bangchi in ahia tua hon muh theih chih ka thei kei uh, amit hihvakpa leng ka thei sam kei uh; amah dong un; piching ahi a; amah thu kigen thei ahita," achi ua, adawng uhi.
Judate akihtak ziak ua anu leh apa'n huai thute agen uh ahi; Judate'n, huai ma him in leng, amah Khrist ahi chi a gum a-omleh sinagog a pan nohsuah ding chih lem ana sa chiat ngal ua.
Huaiziak in anu leh pa'n, "Piching ahi, amah dong un," achi uhi.
Huchi in mittawpa asam nawn ua akiang ah, "Pathian phat in hiai mi zaw mikhial ahi chih ka thei uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n bel, "Mikhial ahi hia hilou ka thei kei, thil khat ka thei, tuma in ka mit ataw a, tu in ka mutheita," chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Na tung ah bangchi in ahia ahih? Na mit bangchi in ahia ahihvak?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Den in ka hon hilhta vele, na thei nuam ngal kei ua; bang achia thei nuam nawn na hi ua? Nou leng anungzui hih sam ut na hi uh maw?" chi in adawng hi.
Huan amau amah atai ua, "Nang amah nungzui na hi, kou zaw Mosi nungzuite ka hi uh, chi in.
Pathian in Mosi ahoupih chih ka thei uh, hiai mi koi a hong kipan ahia ka theihsak kei uh," achi uhi.
Huai mi'n akiang uah, "Huai pentak ahi alamdanna, koi a hong kipan ahia na theih louh uh, ka mit lah ahihvak ngei ngal a," achi hi.
"Pathian in mikhial thu angaikhe kei chih i thei uhi. Himahleh kuapeuh in Pathian alimsak a, adeihlam ahihleh, Pathian in amah angaikhia hi.
Khovel om tung a kipan kuamah mittawsa a piang mit ahihvak nawn chih akithei ngei kei hi.
Hiai mi Pathian a kipan a pawt ahihkeileh bangmah ahihthei kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Nang khial lumlet a piang in hiai bang na hon hilh vial maw?" chi in adawng uhi. Huchi in amah ahawlkhia uhi.
Huan anohkhia uh chih Jesu'n aza a; amah amuh in, "Pathian Tapa na gingta hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Pu aw, ka gintak theihna ding in amah kua ahia?" chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n, "Amah na mu khinta, tua nang hon houpihpa ahi," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Toupa, ka gingta hi," chi in amah abia hi.
Jesu'n, "Thukhen ding in hiai khovel a hong ka hi, mittawte' mit ahong vakna ding uleh mitvakte' mit ahong tawtna ding un,” achi hi.
Akiang a Pharisai omte'n huai thu azak un, akiang ah, "Kou leng mittaw ka hi sam uh maw?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Mittaw hi le uchin khelhna nei lou ding hi uchin a, himahleh ka mu thei uh na chih ziak un khelhna ah na om gige uhi," achi hi.
Amittai tapa Jonah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
"Thou inla, Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak ah hoh inla, atungthu kikoupih in; ka ma ah agitlouhna uh ahong tungtouta," achi hi.

Himahleh Jonah bel TOUPA ma a kipan Tarshish ah taimang ding in athou a; Joppa ah ahohsuk hi. Tarshish zuan ding long amu a; huchi in atuanman pia in, TOUPA ma a kipan Tarshish zuan dingte toh ton ding in long ah alutsuk hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N huih hat mahmah tuipi ah anungsak a, tuipi ah huihpi hat mahmah anung hi, huchi in long tamzak ding bang in a-omta hi.
Long mite'n lau in, amau pathian chiat asam ua; long zanna ding in long sung a vante tuipi ah apaikhia uhi. Jonah bel long sunggilpen ah na lutsuk pah a, huai ah lum in, ana ihmu hithit hi.
Huchi in longheutu akiang ah ahong pai a, “Aw nang ihmu, bangchidan ahia? Thou inla, na Pathian sam in, Pathian in, i manlouhna ding in ahon ngaihtuah khamoh ding hiam,” achi hi.
“Khai, hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua hong om kua ziak ahia chih i theihna ding in, ai i san ding uh," chi in akihou uhi. Huchi in ai asan ua, aisan Jonah tung ah atuta hi.
Huchi in akiang ah, "Hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua om kua ziak ahia, hon hilh in, ka hon ngen uh; na nasep bang ahia? Koi a kipan a hong na hia? Koi gammi na hia? Bang mi na hia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hebru mi ka hi; tuipi leh gam bawlpa TOUPA, van Pathian ka lau ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in mite'n akihta mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Bangziak a hiai bang hih na hia?" achi ua ahilhkhitsa ahih ziak in mite'n TOUPA ma a kipan taimang ahi chih lah athei ngal ua.
Huchi in akiang ah, "Kou a dia tuipi kihot adaihna ding in na tung ah bang ka hih ding ua?" achi ua; tuipi lah akihot sang hulhul ngal a.
Ama'n akiang uah, “Hon domkang unla, tuipi ah hon lawnkhia un; huchi in nou a ding in tuipi akihot nawn kei ding; kei ziak in na tung uah hiai huihpi thupitak anung ahi chih ka thei hi,” achi hi.
Himahleh mite'n gam a kik ding in nakpi in long akal ua; himahleh ahi thei kei; tuipi lah atung uah anak kihoh semsem ngal a.

Huaiziak in TOUPA asam ua, “Aw TOUPA, hiai | mipa hinna ziak in hon hihmang ke'nla, mihoih sisan moh ka tung uah nga mahmah lou ding in nakpitak in ka hon ngen uhi; TOUPA, hiai lah nang na deih bang a na hih ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
Huchi in Jonah adomkang ua, tuipi ah alawnkheta ua; huchi in tuipi kihot phul vonvon adaita hi.
Huchi in mite'n nakpitak in TOUPA alau ua; TOUPA kiang ah kithoihna alan ua, thu achiam uhi.
TOUPA'N Jonah valh ding in nga liantak anasep khin a; huai ngapi gilsung ah Jonah, ni thum leh zan thum a-om hi.
Huan ngapi gilsung a kipan in TOUPA a Pathian kiang ah Jonah athum a, hichi in achi a;
"Ka haksatna ziak in TOUPA ka sam a, ama'n ahon dawng a; Sheol gilsung a kipan in ka kikou a, nang ka aw na zata hi.
Thukpi ah, tuipi sunggil ah na hon pailut a, tui tampi ka kimvel ah a-oma; na tuikihot leh na tuikisep tengteng in ahon tum zel hi.
'Huan na mitmuh a kipan paihkhiak ka hi a; himahleh na tempul siangthou lam ka nga nawn ding,’ ka chi hi.
Tuite'n ka hinna tan in ahon umkimvel ua; tui thuk ka kim ka vel ah a-om hi; louhingte'n ka lu atuamsuak hi.
Tangte taw ah ka paisuk a; lei in tangtawn a ding in akalhnate'n ahon khakkhum a; himahleh nang Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, kohawm a kipan ka hinna na lakhia hi.
Ka sung a ka hinna abah lai in, TOUPA ka theigige ding a; na tempul siangthou ah ka thumna na kiang ahong tung hi.
Thil gina lou leh zuau leltak limsak mite'n amau zahngaihna alehngatsan uh ahi.
Ke'n zaw kipahthu genna aw toh na kiang ah kithoihna ka lan ding; ka chiamsa thu ka tangtun ding. Hotdamna TOUPA a ahi."
Huan TOUPA'N ngapi ahoupih a, gam ah Jonah alokheta hi.
Huan TOUPA thu Jonah kiang ah ahong tung nawn leuleu a,
"Thou inla, Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak ah hoh inla, thu gen ding ka hon chih pen va tangkoupih in," chi in.
Huchi in Jonah athou a, TOUPA thu bang in Nineveh ah ahohta hi. Nineveh bel khopi thupi petmah, ni thum pai aching hi.
Jonah ni khat pai zoh chiang khopi sung ah ava pai phot a, "Ni sawmli in, Nineveh hihman ahi ding hi," chi in akikou hi.
Nineveh mite'n Pathian agingta ua; an ngawl apuang ua, alak ua alianpen a kipan aneupen tan in sai-ip puan asilh uhi.
Huai thu Nineveh kumpipa bil ahong tungta a, alaltutphah a kipan athou a, akumpi puan asuah a, sai-ip puan silh in, vut ah atuta hi.

Kumpipa leh amiliante thupiak in kumpipa'n Nineveh khosung ah thu apuang in apulakta hi. "Mihing hiam, ganta hiam, ganhon hiam, belamhon hiamte in bangmah chiam kei uhen; banghiam ne in tui leng dawn kei uhen;
mihing leh ganhingte'n sai-ip puan silh uhenla, nakpitak in Pathian sam uhen; ahi, michih in amau lampi hoih lou leh akhut ua hiamgamna lehngatsan uhen.
I manlouhna ding in, Pathian lunghei in lungsim kilehhei in, ahehna mahmah a kipan akilehhei kei ding chih kua'n ahia theithei?" achi hi.
Huchi in Pathian in athilhihte uh en in, alampi hoih lou uh alehngatsan uh chih amu a; akiang ua achihsa, hih atup thil hoih lou Pathian in alehngatsan a; ahihta kei hi.
Himahleh huai in Jonah alungkim het kei a, ahehta hi.

TOUPA kiang ah athum a, “Aw TOUPA, ka hon ngen ahi, hiai ka gam ua ka om lai a ka gen hilou hia? Hiai ziak in Tarshish lam ah ka taimang pah a; hehpih thei Pathian, lainatna a dim, heh mengmeng lou, zahngaihna hau, thil hoih lou lehngatsan sek na hi chih ka thei hi.
Huaiziak in AW TOUPA, tu in ka hinna hon laksak ding in ka hon ngen hi; kei a ding in hin sang in sih ahoihzaw hi,” achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N, na heh mawk, na hihdik hia? achi hi.
Huchi in khopi a kipan Jonah apaikhia a, khopi suahlam pang ah atu a, huai ah sawlbuk alam a, khopi tung a thil hong tung ding muh tum in anuailim ah atu nilouh hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in umgui Jonah tung ah azamsak a, ahaksatna a kipan hunkhe ding a alu liah ding in ana sepkhol hi. Huchi in Jonah umgui ziak in akipak mahmah hi.
Himahleh Pathian in, azingsang phalvak in, leikha ana sepkhol a, huai in umgui akeitan a, ahong vuaita hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni ahong suah in Pathian in suahlam huih ana sepkhol a; ni in Jonah lu ahai a, asibup a, amah a ding in sih angen hi, “Kei a ding in hin sang in sih ahoihzaw," achi hi.
Pathian in Jonah kiang ah, “Umgui tungtang thu a na heh mawk, na hihdik hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Sih ut hial a ka heh, ka hihdik hi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N, “Na gim pih louh, na khansak leng hi sam lou, zan khat thu a hong om a, zan khat thu a mang nawn umgui na hehpihleh;
Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak, asung a mi nuaikhat-le-singnih sang a tam, ataklam uleh aveilam uh leng khen theiloute leh ganhon tampi omna, ka hehpih kei dia hia?" achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA sikha Mosi sih nung in Mosi nasempa Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah TOUPA'N
"Ka sikha Mosi asita a; thou inla, nang leh hiai mipi tengteng in Jordan lui kan unla, Israel suante ka piak gam ah pai un.
Mosi kiang a ka gensa bang in na khepek ua na sikna peuhmah uh ka hon pe vek ding.
Gamdai a pan leh hiai Lebanon tang a pan lui lianpi Euphrates Luipi pha a, Hitte gam tengteng, nitumna lam a tuipi zatak pha in na gam uh ahi ding.
Na damsung teng kuamah himhim in hon nangzou kei ding. Mosi kiang a ka om bang in, nang kiang ah leng ka om ding hi. K'on zuausan kei dia, pai leng k'on paisan sam kei ding hi.
Hattak leh hangsantak in om in; asuante uh kichiam a piak ka na chiamsa gam, hiaite luahsak ding na hi ngal a.

Ka sikha Mosi in dan tengteng zui dia thu hon piak zui tinten ding in hattak leh hangsantak in om peuhmah phot in. Na paina teng a na lamzan zel theihna ding in na taklam ah hiam, na veilam ah hiam pialsan het ke'n.

Hiai Dan Bu in na kam pawtsan het kei hen. Hiai a thu kigelh tengteng na zuih tinten theihna ding in sun leh zan in na ngaihtuah zaw ding ahi. Huchi in na lampite na tuahphasak dia, na hong lamzang ding hi.
Thu ka hon pia hilou hiam? Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n, TOUPA na Pathian na paina teng ah na kiang a om ding ahi," achi hi.
Joshua in mipi heutute thu apia a,
"Giahphual va sik unla, mipite kiang ah, 'Nek ding sutuah dih ua, ni thum sung a TOUPA na Pathian un gam luah dia ahon piak luah ding a Jordan lui kan ding na hih ziak un,' " chi in thu ahon pia hi.
Reubente, Gadte leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang ah Joshua in,
"TOUPA na Pathian un khawlna ahon pia a, hiai hon pe ding chi a TOUPA sikha Mosi in thu hon piak theigige un.

Na zite uh, na taneu chikchikte leh na ganhonte uh zaw Jordan lui gal a Mosi in gam hon na piak ah a-om ding uh. Nou mihat leh hangsan teng kigalthuamsa in na pai masa ding ua, na unaute uh na panpih ding ua,

TOUPA'N na unaute uh noute bangmah a khawlna apiak a, TOUPA na Pathian un hon gam piak amaute'n leng aluah mateng uh. Huchi in TOUPA sikha Mosi in Jordan lui gal, nisuahna lam gam nou a tuam ding a hon na piakna lam ah na kik nawn ding ua, na luah ding uh," achi hi.
Amau, "Hih dia na hon thupiak tengteng ka hih ding uh, n'on sawlna teng ah leng ka pai ding uh.
Bang lam peuh a Mosi thu ka zuih bang un, nang thu leng ka zui ding uh. Mosi kiang a TOUPA na Pathian a-om bang in nang kiang ah leng om peuhmah phot hen.
Kuapeuh na thupiak kalh a, hel a, thu na piak peuhmah zui nuam lou zaw hihlup ding ahi. Hattak leh hangsantak in om peuhmah phot in," chi in Joshua adawng uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Joshua in Ai khua ala a, ahihsegawp dimdem a, Jeriko khua leh akumpipa ahihsiat bang in Ai khua leh akumpipa leng ahihsegawp a, Gibeon a mite'n Israelte toh lemna bawl in, alak uah ateng sam uh, chih azak in, alauta mahmah hi.
Gibeon khua bel lianpi, kumpipa khopite lak a khat bang a lian ahi. Ai khua sang a lianzaw leh amite leng hattak ahih ziak un alau mahmah uhi.
Huaiziak in Jerusalem kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Hebron kumpipa Hoham, Jermuth kumpina Piram. Lakish kumpipa Japhia leh Eglon kumpipa Debir kiang ah,
"Hong pai unla, hong panpih un, Gibeon i va dou ding uh. Joshua leh Israel suante toh lemna abawl ngal ua," chi in athukhak hi.

Amorte kumpipa ngate: Jerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Jermuth kumpipa, Lakish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa akikhawm ua, asepaih tengteng uh toh ahohtou ua, Gibeon kho zawn ah giahphual sat in adouta uhi.

Gibeonte'n Gilgal giahphual a om Joshua kiang ah mi asawl ua, "Na sikhate hon nuse ke'n. Kintak in ka kiang uah hong tou in, hong panpih inla, hong hondam in. Singtang gam a teng Amor kumpipate kou hong dou ding in akikhawm uh," chi in ava hilh uhi.
Joshua leh akiang a gal dou thei mi tengteng leh mihat hangsan tengteng Gilgal a pan ahohtou uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Amaute lau het ke'n. Na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Alak ua mi kuamah na ma ah adingh zou kei ding uh," achi hi.
Huaiziak in Joshua in amaute adou guih a; zankhua a Gilgal a pan ana hohtousa ahi.
TOUPA'N Israelte ma ah amaute ahihbuai gawpta a, Gibeon ah tampi athat a, Beth-horon zottouhna lampi ah adelh a, Azekah leh Makkedah kho pha in athat hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte ma ah ataikek ua, Beth-horon a pan apaisukna mun a a-om lai un, TOUPA'N van a pan gial lian pipi atung uah Azekah kho pha in akesak a, asi uhi. Israel suante'n namsau a asatlup sang un gial denlup atamzaw hi.
TOUPA'N Amorte Israel suante apiak ni in Joshua in TOUPA kiang h thu agen a; Israelte mitmuh in, "Ni, Gibeon kho tung ah dingh nilouh in; kha, nang leng, Aijalon Phaizang ah om nilouh in," achi hi.

Mite'n amelmate uh tung a phu alak masiah uh ni adingh daikinken a, kha leng a-om nilouh hi. Hiai thu Jasar laibu a gelh hilou hia? Huchi in van lai ah ni a-om nilouh a, ni khat sung vengveng tum thu angaihtuah kei hi.
TOUPA'N huchibang a mihing aw angaihkhiak ni, ama in a-om ngei kei a anung in leng a-om ngei kei; TOUPA'N lah Israelte adoupih ngal a.
Joshua leh Israelte agiahphual uh Gilgal ah akik nawn vek uhi.
Huai kumpipa ngate ataimang ua, Makkedah kokhuk ah akibu uhi.
"Makkedah kokhuk a kibu, kumpipa ngate muh ahi uh," chi in Joshua hilh in a-om hi.
Joshua in, "Kokhuk kam suang lianpi khuk in sin unla, veng mite leng omsak un.
Noute bel om kei unla; na melmate uh delh unla, anungdalte that unla; akhua himhim uah lutsak kei un. TOUPA na Pathian un na khut uah amau ahon peta ngal a," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Joshua leh Israel suante'n athah bei khit ua, kulhbaangpi nei khuate a, a-omlaite atailut khit un,
mi tengteng Joshua kiang Makkedah ah galmuangtak in ahong kik nawn ua. Israel suante dem in kuamah in lei alok ngam kei uh.
Joshua in, "Kokhuk kam hong unla, kokhuk a pan ka kiang ah kumpipa ngate hon kaikhia un," achi hi.
Hichibang in ahih ua, kumpipa ngate: Jerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Jermuth kumpipa, Lakish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa kokhuk a pan akiang ah ahon pikhia uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipate Joshua kiang a ahon pitak un, Joshua in Israel tengteng asamkhawm a, amah toh kuan galdou thei mite lak a heutute kiang ah, "Hong pai nai unla, hiai kumpipate ngawng sik un," achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai nai ua, angawng uh ahong siksak uhi.
Joshua in akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un. Hattak leh hangsantak in om un. Na dou uh na melma tengteng tung ah TOUPA'N hichibang in ahih ding," achi hi.
Huai khit in Joshua in amau asatzan a, athat a, sing dawn ah akhai a; nitaklam tan in sing dawn ah akikhai lai uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitum kuan in Joshua in thu apia a, sing dawn a pan alakhia ua, akibukna kokhuk uah apailut ua, akokhuk kam suang lianpi in asin ua, tuni tan in leng a-om lai hi.

Joshua in huai ni in Makkedah khua ala a, akumpipa uh tan in namsau in alok a; huai khua a om tengteng asatlum vek a, khat lel leng hawi anei kei. Jeriko kumpipa tung a ahih mah bang in, Makkedah kumpipa tung ah leng ahihta hi.
Joshua Israel tengteng toh Makkedah a pan Libnah ah apai ua, Libnah khua adou uhi.

TOUPA'N huai khua kumpipa tan in Israelte khut ah apia hi. Huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng athat vek hi. Asung a om mi khat mah leng hinghawi anei kei hi. Jeriko kumpipa tung a ahih mah bang in akumpipa tung ah ahih hi.
Joshua Israel tengteng toh Libnah a pan Lakish ah apai ua, panmun khoh in asual uhi.
TOUPA'N Lakish khua Israelte khut ah apia a, ani nih ni in ala ua huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng namsau in athat vek ua, Libnah khote tung a ahih bang in ahihta uhi.
Bezer kumpipa Horam, Lakish khua panpih ding in akuantou a; Joshua in amah leh aheute nangawn khat mah leng hawi lou in athatgam vek hi.
Joshua Israel tengteng toh Lakish a pan Eglon ah apai ua, panmun akhoh ua; adou uhi.
Huai ni in ala ua, huai ni mah in huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng namsau in athat bei sipsip hi. Lakish kho tung a ahih bang in ahihta hi.
Joshua, Israelte tengteng toh Eglon a pan Hebron ah apai ua adou uhi.

Ala ua, huai khua, akumpipa, akhopel tengteng leh asung a om tengteng namsau a dou in athat vek ua, Eglon kho tung a hih bang in khat mah leng hinghawi anei kei hi. Akhua nangawn hihse vek in asung a om tengteng athat bei sipsip hi.
Joshua leh Israel tengteng Debir ah akihei nawn ua adou ua;

huai khua, akumpipa leh akhopel tengteng ala ua; namsau in adou ua, asung a om tengteng athat bei sipsip ua; khat mah leng hawi anei kei uh. Hebron kho tung leh Debir khua leh akumpipa uh tung a ahih bang in ahihta hi.

Huchi in Joshua in agam pumpi, tanggamte, simlam a phaizang leh mual gamte hihse vek in akumpipa tengteng uh athat vek a; khat mah hinghawi anei kei hi. TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian thupiak bang in anak thei peuhmah ahihchimit vek hi.
Joshua in Kadesh-barnea a pan Gaza pha in, Goshen gam tengteng toh Gibeon pha in ahihse vek hi.
Huai kumpipate tengteng leh agam uh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in Israelte adoupih ziak in, Joshua in hun khat a alak vek ahi uhi.
Joshua leh Israel tengteng a giahphual Gilgal ah akik nawn vek uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hazor kumppaangaazak in, Madon kumpipa Jobab, Shimron kumpipa leh Akshaph kumpipa,
Mallam tanggam kumpipate, Kineroth simlam a Arabah kumpipate, Phaigam kumpipate leh tumlam pang a Dor kumpipate,
suahlam leh tumlam a om Kanaan mite, tanggam a om, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Jebuste, Mizpah gam Hermon tang nuai a om Hivte kiang ah mi asawl hi.
Huan asepaih tengteng uh toh mi tampi, atamdan uh tuipi a piaunel zah mahmah sakol leh kangtalai tampi toh akisa uhi.
Huai kumpipa tengteng akimukhawm ua Israelte dou ding in Merom tuite ah agiakkhawm uhi.

TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Amaute lau ke'n. Zingchiang in hichih hun in amaute hihlupsa vek in Israelte ka hon pe mai ding hi. Asakolte khukguh na kilawisak dia, akangtalaite uh na halsak ding uh," achi hi.
Joshua leh gal dou thei mi tengteng Merom tuite ah ava kuan guih ua adou uhi.
TOUPA'N Israelte khut ah apia a adou ua, Zidon lianzaw pha in, Misrephoth-maim munte pha in, suahlam pang a Mizpeh Phaizangte pha in adelh ua, khat leng hawi nei lou in athat vek uhi.
TOUPA'N asawl bang in Joshua in atung uah ahih a; asakolte khukguh akilawisak ua, akangtalaite uh ahalsak uhi.
Huai hun in Joshua akilehhei a, Hazor khua ala a, akumpipa uh namsau in athat hi. Tuma in Hazor khua huai lai a hiai gamte tengteng lak a khopi pen ahi.
Huai khua a om tengteng namsau in athat vek a, ahihchimit vek a, ahing peuhmah khat mah leng ahinghawi kei uhi.
Huchi in Kumpipate khopi tengteng leh akumpipa tengteng uh Joshua in aman vek a, namsau a dou in athat a, ahihchimit vek a; TOUPA sikha Mosi in thu apiak bang in.
Mual pawng a khopi a na om khinsate, Hazor khua chih louh, Israelte'n khat mah leng ahal kei uh. Huai khua bel Joshua in ahal hi.
Hiai khopite a gallak tengteng leh gante Israel suante'n amau a tuam ding in anei ua; mihing bel ahihman vek masiah uh namsau in athat zel ua, ahing peuhmah hawi anei kei uhi.
TOUPA'N a sikha Mosi thu apiak bang in, Mosi in huai thu Joshua apesawn a; Joshua in huai bang in ahih zel hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng hih louh himhim anei kei hi.
Huai bang in Joshua in huai gam tengteng, tanggamte, sim gam tengteng, Goshen gam tengteng, phaizang leh phaizang teng leh Israelte tangte leh phaizang teng toh ala vek hi.
Seir va suntou Halak tang a pan Hermon tang nuai a Lebanon Phaizang a Baal-gad pha in akumpipate tengteng uh aman a that in ahihlum hi.
Joshua in huai kumpipa tengteng sawtpitak adou hi.
Gibeon a om Hivte kia chih louh Israelte toh lemna bawl khua a-om kei uh. Dou a lak vek ahi uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a, ahihchimit vek a, deihsakna nei het lou a, ahihman theihna dia alungtang uh hihkhauhsak a Israelte dou sakpa TOUPA ahi.
Huai lai in Joshua akuan a, tanggamte a pan, Hebron a pan, Debir a pan, Anab khua leh Judia tanggam tengteng leh Israel tanggam tengteng a pan Anakte ahihmang vek hi.
Israel suante gam ah Anakte khat lel leng atengta kei ua; Gaza, Gath leh Ashdod khuate kia ah bel a-om lai uhi.

Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a, agen tengteng bang in Joshua in gam pumpi alata hi. Joshua in Israelte anam uh kikhendan bang zel in agouluah ding un gam ape chiat hi. Huchi in gam galmuang in a-omta hi.

Hiaite ahi uh huai gam kunipipate, Israel santen ahihman ua, agam uh Jordan lui gal, nisuahna lam gamte, Arnon Phaizang a pan Hermon tang tan, suahlam pang a Arabah tengteng toh aneihsak uh kumpipate:
Amorte kumpipa Sihon, Heshbon a teng in Arnon Phaizang pang a om Aroer a pan vai ahawm a, phaizang laitak a khopite, Ammon suante gamgi Jabok lui pha in Gilead gam kimkhat tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Suahlam ah Arabah ah Kineroth Tuipi tan in ahi a; suahlam ah Beth-jeshimoth hohna lampı lam ah Arabah Tuipi, Chi Tuipi tan in ahi a; simlam ah Pisgah tang nuai pha in ahi.
Astaroth leh Edrei a om Rephaim nam khosuaksunte lak ah Bashan kumpipa Og in vai ahawm hi.
Amah Hermon tang, Salkah khua leh Bashan tengteng, Geshurte leh Maakathte gamgi pha leh Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gamgi chiang Gilead gam kimkhat pha in vai ahawm hi.
TOUPA sikha Mosi leh Israel suante'n huaite athat ua; TOUPA sikha Mosi in Reuben chite, Gad chite, Manasseh nam kimkhatte agouluah ding un ahawm hi.

Hiai gam kumpipate ahi, Joshua leh Israel suante'n Jordan lui gal tumlam pang a, athahte uh, Lebanon Phaizang Baal-gad a pan Seir tang suntou Halak tang pha in. Joshua in Israel suante akikhendan bang zel un, huai gam agouluah ding un ape chiatta hi.
Tanggam a, phaizang gamte, Arabahte, tanggamte, gamdai gamte, sim gamte; huaite bel Hit mite, Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite, Jebus mite gam ahi.
Jeriko kumpipa khat; Bethel kho kiang a Ai kumpipa, khat;
Jerusalem kumpipa, khat; Hebron kumpina khat;
Jarmuth kumpipa, khat; Lakish kumpipa, khat;
Eglon kumpipa, khat; Gezer kumpipa, khat;
Debir kumpipa, khat; Geder kumpipa, khat;
Hormah kumpipa, khat; Arad kumpipa, khat;
Libnah kumpipa, khat; Adullam kumpipa, khat;
Makkedah kumpipa, khat; Bethel kumpipa, khat;
Tappuah kumpipa, khat; Hepher kumpipa, khat;
Aphek kumpipa, khat; Lasaron kumpipa, khat;
Madon kumpipa, khat; Hazor kumpipa, khat;
Shimron-meron kumpipa, khat; Akshaph kumpipa, khat;
Taanak kumpipa, khat; Magiddo kumpipa, khat;
Kedesh kumpipa, khat; Karmel tang a Jokneam kumpipa, khat;
Dor tuipang a Dor kumpipa, khat; Gilgal a Goiim namte kumpipa, khat;
Tirzah kumpipa, khat; kumpipa tengteng sawmthum-le-khat ahi uh.
Joshua ahong upata a, ahong tek mahmahta hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na hong upa in na hong tek mahmahta a, gam lak ding lah atam lai mahmah ngal a.
Hiai gamte ahi lak louh: Philistia gam tengteng leh Geshur gam tengteng.

Aigupta gam chin a om Shihor a pan mallam pang a Ekron gamgi tan in, huai tuh Kanaan mite gam a sim ahi; Philistiate vaihawmtu ngate, Gaza mite, Ashdod mite, Ashkelon mite Git mite leh Ekron mite: simlam a Avi mite.
Kanaan mite gam tengteng leh Zidon mite gam a Mearah, Amorte gamgi Aphek kho pha in.
Gebal mite gam leh nisuahna lam Lebanon gam tengteng Hermon tang nuai Baal-gad a pan Hamath kholutna pha in.
Lebanon a pan Misrephoth-maim mun pha in, tanggam a teng tengteng, Zidon mi tengteng. Amaute Israel suante ma ah ka delhkhe dia; ka hon thupiak bang in Israel gouluah ding in bawlsak in.
Huchi in hiai gam nam kuate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte gouluah ding in hawmsak in," achi hi.
TOUPA sikha Mosi in amau a dia asehsak bang in Reuben suante leh Gad suante'n Manasseh nam kimkhat dangte toh Mosi piaksa Jordan suahlam gam ah goutan aneita uhi.
Huai gam ahihleh Arnon Phaizang gei a om Aroer a pan leh phaizang laitak a khopi leh Medeba phaigam tengteng, Dibon tan ahi.
Amorte kumpipa Sihon, Heshbon a vaihawm a tu khopi tengteng Ammon suante gamgi tan ahi.
Gilead gam leh Geshurte leh Maakathte gamgi chiang leh Hermon tang tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng Salkah kho tan ahi.
Astaroth leh Edrei a kumpipa a tu Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam tengteng toh, huaite Rephaim nam milian khosuaksunte ahi uh; huaite Mosi in ana dou a, ana delhkheta hi.
Himahleh Geshurte leh Maakathte Israel suante'n adelhkhe kei ua; Geshurte leh Maakathte tuni tan in Israelte lak ah atengden lai uhi.
Levi namte kia ahi gouluah ding a piak louh. Akiang ua ana gensa bang in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian a dia mei a thillatte amau gouluah ahi.
Reuben suante nam a-inkuan dungzui in Mosi in gam ana peta hi.
Agamgi uh Arnon Phaizang a om Aroer a pan phaizang laitak a khopi leh Medeba phaigam tengteng a pan,
Heshbon leh huai phaigam a khopi tengteng; Debon, Bamoth-baal leh Beth-baal-meon;
Jahaz, Kedemoth leh Mephaath;
Kiriathaim, Sibmah leh phaizang a tang a om Zereth-sahar;
Beth-peor leh Ashdot-pisgah leh Beth-jeshimoth;
Phaigam khopi tengteng, Heshbon a vaihawm Amorte Kumpipa Sihon lalgam teng, Mosi in ana thah khitsa Midiante kumpipate Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba omna gam toh ahi.
Beor tapa Balaam, aisan siam leng a-inkuante toh Israel suante'n athat uhi.
Reuben suante gam chiang bel Jordan leh apang teng ahi. Hiai gam leh akhopite leh khuate ahi Reuben suante a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a gouluah dia asehsak uh.
Mosi in Gad suante a-inkuan dungzui un gam apia hi.
Agamgi uh Jazer khua leh Gilead gam khopi tengteng leh Ammon suante gam kimkhat, Rabbah kho kiang a om Aroer pha in;
Heshbon a pan Ramath-mizpeh leh Betonim pha in; Mahanaim a pan Debir gamgi pha in;
Guam ah Beth-aram, Beth-nimrah, Sukoth, Zaphon, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gam teng, Jordan leh agei a gamte, Jordan gal suahlam pang a Kinereth Tuipi tawp chiang tan in ahi.
Hiai Gad suante a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a agouluah ding ua seh, akhopite uh leh akhuate uh ahi.
Mosi in Manasseh nam kimkhatte gam apia hi. Manasseh nam kimkhatte a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a piak ahi uh.
Agamgi uh Mahanaim a pan Bashan gam tengteng. Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam tengteng leh Bashan gam a Jair khopi tengteng toh, kho sawmguk ahi.
Gilead gam kimkhat leh Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam a Astaroth, Edrei; huai Manasseh tapa Makir suan Makir suan kimkhatte a dia a-inkuan uh omdan bang zel a seh ahi.
Hiaite Moab phai, Jeriko zawn, Jordan gal lehlam a, Mosi in gouluah dia a piak gamte ahi uh.
Levi chite Mosi in gouluah ding ape kei hi. Akiang ua ana gensa bang in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian agouluah uh ahi.
Hiaite ahi Israel suante'n Kanaan gam alak ua, siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel suante nam inkuan lupente'n agouluah ding ua ana hawm uh.
Nam kuate leh nam kimkhatte a tuam dia TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu ana piak bang in aisan in agouluah uh piak ahi.
Mosi in nam nih leh nam kimkhatte Jordan gal ah agouluah ding uh ana peta hi. Levi chite bel alak uah gouluah ding ape kei hi.

Joseph suante nam nih ahi ua, Manasseh leh Ephraim. Levi chite huai gam ah tantuam ape kei uh, a-omna ding uh khopite leh adaikim ua gantatna ding mun leh a-inn leh alou uh bawlna ding lou ngal piak ahi kei uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Israel suante'n ahih ua, gam ahawm uhi.

Judah suante Gilgal ah Joshua kiang ah ava hoh ua; Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb in akiang ah, "Kadesh-barnea mun a Pathian mipa Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N ka tungtang leh na tungtang thu ana gen na thei hi.
TOUPA sikha Mosi in Kadesh-barnea mun a pan gam va enkhe dia ahon sawl lai in kum sawmli a upa ka na hita a; ka lungsim a om bangtak akiang ah ka tun nawn hi.
Himahleh ka unau ka kiang a pai samte'n mipite lungtang azulsuaksak ua; ke'n bel TOUPA ka Pathian ka zui hi.
Mosi in huai ni in, TOUPA ka Pathian na zuih ziak in na khe in ana siksa gam tangtawn in nang leh na suante gouluah ahi ngeingei ding, chi in akichiam hi.

Huchi in ngai in, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a huai thute agen nung Israelte gamdai a, avakvaih sung un TOUPA'N agensa bang in kum sawmli-le-nga tak ahon damsak lai hi. Ngai in, tu in kum sawmgiat-le-nga ka hita.
Hichi pipi in leng Mosi in ahon sawl lai mah bang in ka hat lai a, nidanglai a kidouna ding leh nasep silbawlna dia thagui ka neih mah bang in tu in leng ka nei lai hi.

Huaiziak in hiai tang, TOUPA'N huai ni a agensa pen hon pia in, Anakte a-om ua, akhopite uh athupi a, kulhbaang a umsuak ahi uh, chih huai ni in na za a; TOUPA'N ahon ompih dia, amaute ka delhkhe thei ding, TOUPA'N ana gensa bang in," achi hi.
Joshua in avualzawl a; Jephunneh tapa Kaleb gouluah ding in Hebron khua apeta hi.
Huaiziak in Hebron khua tuni tan in Keniz mi, Jephunneh tapa Kaleb gouluah ahong hita hi; TOUPA Israelte' Pathian azuih ziak in.
Hebron kho min ama in Kiriath-arba ahi. Arba ahihleh Anakte lak a mithupipen ahi. Huai khit in agam ahong galmuangta hi.
Hiai Judah suante a-inkuan dungzui a amau a tuam dia seh a om ahi: Edom gamgi chiang, simlam pang Zin gamdai tan hial in, simtawp tanpha in akizalhsuk hi.
Simlam gamgi bel, chi Tuipi simtawp a tuipi gam geng a pan simlam doh ahi.
Simlam zuan in Akrabbim tan in apai zel a, Zin ava tung hi. Kadesh-barnea simlam ah atungkah a, Hebron ava tung a, Adar ah atoupai a, Karka akualkhum hi.
Azmon ah apai zel a, Aigupta luita ah atuakkhia a; tuipi ah gamgi atawp hi. Hiai bel simlam pang gamgi ahi.
Suahlam pang gamgi bel Chi Tuipi ahi a, Jordan ah atawp hi. Mallam pang gamgi bel tuipi tuimeng a pan Jordan tun tawp chiang ahi.
Beth-hoglah ah atoupai a, Beth-arabah mal ah apai zel a; Reuben tapa Bohan suang ah apaitou zel hi.
Akor Phaizang a pan Debir ah apaitou a, lui simlam a om Adummim atungkahna chin ah Gilgal lam zuan in mallam ah apai zel a; En-shemesh tuite ah apaipai a, En-rogel ah asuakkhia hi.

Hinam tapa phaizang ah Jebuste gam pang simlam, huai tuh Jerusalem ahi, pha in apaitou a; Hinnom tang lam pang phaizang chin a om tang vum ah apaitou a, huai tuh Rephaim mallam pang phaizang tawp mahmah ahi.
Mualvum a pan Nephtoah a luituite pha in apaisuak a, Ephron tang a khopite ah apai zel a; gamgi Baalah, huai tuh Kiriath-jearim ahi, lam ah apaisuk hi.
Baalah a pan tumlam pang ah Seir tang pha in akihekkual nawn a, mallam pang ah Jearim, huai tuh Kesalon ahi, Beth-shemesh ah apaisuk a, Timnah tawn in apai zel hi.
Mallam pang Ekron zul ah apaikhia a, Shikron ah apaisuak a, Baalah tang ah apai zel a, Jabneel ah apawt a; tuipi ah atawp hi.
Tumlam pang gamgi bel tuipi azat a za leh apiau chiang teng ahi. Huai gam chiang ahi Judah suante a dia a-inkuan uh dungzui a sehsak a om.
Jephunneh tapa Kaleb TOUPA'N Joshua thu apiak bang in Judah suante lak ah tantuam abawlsak a, huai tuh Kiriath-arba ahi, Arba bel Anan pa ahi a, akhopi ahihleh Hebron ahi.
Kaleb in huai khua a pan Anak tapate thum Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai adelhkhia hi.
Huai a pan Debir khomite ava dou a; ama in Debir kho min Kiriath-sepher ahi.
Kaleb in, "Kuapeuh Kiriath-sepher va dou a, va la zou peuhmah, azi ding in ka tanu Aksah ka pe ding," achi hi.
Kaleb unaupa Kenaz tapa Othniel in ava la zou a; huchi in azi ding in atanu Aksah aneisakta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ava tun in, apa gam ngen ding in akuan a; asabiltung a pan akumkhia hi. Kaleb in akiang ah, "Bang na deih a?" ana chi hi.
Ama'n, "Hon vualzawl in. Simlam gam lah na hon peta ngal a. Tui nak neite leng hon pe tel lai in," achi hi. Huchi in tui nak nei saknungte leh khangnungte apeta hi.
Hiai ahi Judah suante nam, a-inkuan uh dungzui a agouluah uh.
Simlam a Edom gamgi zul a Judah suante aneih khopi hiaite ahi uh: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
Kinah, Dimonah leh Adadah;
Kadesh, Hazor leh Ithnan;
Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron (huai Hazor ahi),
Amam, Shema, Moladah,
Hazar-gaddah, Hesmon, Beth-palet,
Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba, Bizjothjah,
Baalah, Ijim, Ezem,
Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah.
Ziklag, Madmannah leh Sansannah.
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain leh Rimmon ahi ua; khopi tengteng, akhotate uh toh sawmnih-le-kua ahi.
Phaigam lam ah Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,
Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah leh Gederothaim ahi ua, akhotate uh toh khopi teng sawm-le-li ahi uh.
Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad;
Dilean, Mizpah leh Joktheel;
Lakish, Bozkath, Eglon;
Kabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish;
Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, Makkedah. Akhopel teng uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-guk ahi uh.
Libnah, Ether, Ahsan,
Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
Keilah, Akzib leh Mareshah. Akhopel teng uh toh khopi tengteng kua ahi uh.
Ekron leh akhopite leh akhotate toh,
Ekron a pan tuipi tanpha in Ashdod zul a om tengteng, akhotate uh toh.
Ashdod leh akhopite leh akhotate: Gaza leh akhopite leh akhotate; Aigupta lui leh tuipi za leh agei chiang pha in.
Singtang gam lam ah Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,
Dannah leh Kirjath-sannah, huai tuh Debir ahi,
Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim leh Gosen,
Gosen, Holon leh Giloh; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-khat ahi.
Arab, Dumah, Eshean,
Janum, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,
Humtah leh Kiriath-arba, huai tuh Hebron ahi, huan Zior; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng kua ahi.
Maon, Karmel, Ziph, Juttah,
Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
Kain, Gibeah leh Timnah; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm ahi.
Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
Maarath, Beth-anoth leh Eltekon; akhotate uh toh khopite tengteng guk ahi.
Kiriath-baal, huai tuh Kiriath-jearim ahi, leh Rabbah; akhotate uh toh khopi nih ahi.
Gamdai a Beth-arabah, Middin, Sekakah,
Chi khopi Nibshan leh En-gedi; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng guk ahi.
Jerusalem a teng Jebuste ahihleh Judah suante'n adelhkhe zou kei ua, tuni tan in Jerusalem ah Judah suante leh Jebuste atengkhawm uhi.
Joseph suante tantuam, Jeriko zawn a pan gamdai kiang, suahlam pang Jeriko tuite ah asuak a, Jeriko a pan singtang gam ah Bethel pha in apaitou zel hi.
Bethel a pan Luz ah alut a, Arki mite gamgi a Ataroth pha in apai zel hi.
Tumlam pang ah Japhlet suante gamgi, Beth-horon gamgi khangnungzaw, Gezer pha in apaisuk zel a; tupi ah asuak hi.
Huchi in Joseph suante Manasseh leh Ephraim suante'n tantuam in alata uhi.
A-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Ephraim suante gamgi hiai ahi: Suahlam pang atantuam uh gamgi Ataroth-addar ahi a, Beth-horon saknungzaw apha hi.
Mikmethath maltum lam pang ah asuak a, suahlam pang ah Taanath-shiloh pha in akihei nawn a, Janohah suahlam ah apai zel hi.
Janohah a pan Ataroth ah, Naarah ah apaisuk a, Jeriko atung a, Jordan ah asuak hi.
Tappuah a pan tumlam pang ah Kanah luita pha in apai a; tuipi ah asuak hi. Huaite ahi Ephraim suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a atantuam uh.
Manasseh suante tantuam lak a Ephraim suante a dia khopi asehtuamsakte toh; akhopi tengteng leh akhotate leng.
Gezer a teng Kanaante adelhkhe kei ua; Ephraimte lak ah Kanaante tuni tan in a-om lai ua, asikha un a-om uhi.
Manasseh suante tantuam hiaite ahi. Manasseh Joseph tapa masa ahi a, Gilead pa, Manasseh tapa masa Makir galhat ahih ziak in Gilead leh Bashan gam atang hi.

Manasseh suan dang tengteng a ding in a-inkuan uh dungzui in tantuam leng a-om hi. Abiezer suante a ding, Helek suante a ding, Shekem suante a ding, Hepher suante a ding leh Shemida suante a ding. Huaite a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Joseph tapa Manasseh suan pasalte ahi uhi.
Manasseh tapa Makir, huai tapa Gilead, huai tapa Hepher, huai tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lou in tanu ngen anei hi. Atanute min Mahlah, Noah, Hoglai, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi.

Siampu Eleazar ma ah leh Nun tapa Joshua ma ah leh miliante ma ah ahoh ua, "Ka unaute uh lak a tantuam hon pe sam ding in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apia hi," chi in agen uhi. TOUPA thupiak bang in apa uh unaute lak ah tantuam ape samta hi.
Jordan gal ah Gilead leh Bashan gam sim louh in, Manasseh tantuam ding in mun sawm apuk a;
Manasseh tanute'n atapate uh lak ah tantuam aneih sam ziak uh ahi. Gilead gam bel Manasseh tapa dangte'n atang uhi.
Manasseh gamgi Shekem suahlam a om Asher a pan Mikmethath pha in ahi a; taklam pang ah En-tappuah mite tenna pha in apai hi.
Tappuah gam Manasseh a ahi a; himahleh Manasseh gamgi chin a Tappuah ahihleh Ephraim suante a ahi.

Gamgi kan in luita simlam pang ah apaisuk a, Ephraim suante gamgi asun hi. Ephraim suante khopite khenkhat Manasseh suante khopite lak ah a-om hi. Himahleh Manasseh suante gamgi bel Kanah kuam mallam pang ah apai a, tuipi ah atawp hi.
Simlam pang Ephraim a ahi a, mallam pang pen Manasseh a ahi. Tuipi a gamgi ahi. Mallam ah Asher pha in ahi a, suahlam ah Issakar pha in ahitou hi.

Issakar leh Asher gam ah Manasseh in Beth-shean leh akim a khuate, Ibleam leh akim a khuate, Dor a tengte leh akim a khuate, Endor a tengte leh akim a khuate, Taanak a tengte leh akim a khuate, leh Meggiddo a tengte leh akim a khuate zou in, kho seh thum anei uhi.
Kanaan mite'n huai gam luah asawm teitei ziak un, Manasseh suante'n huai khopi a tengte adelhkhe zou kei uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante ahong hat hiaihiai un, Kanaante nasem a goih ding in a-omsak ua, adelhkhe siang vek kei uhi.
Joseph suante'n Joshua kiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia gouluah ding tantuam seh khat, tan khat kia na hon piak tuam, TOUPA'N lah tutan in hon nak vualzawl mahmah ngal a?" achi uhi.
Joshua in akiang uah, "Tam na hih uleh, Perizte leh miliante gammang na tenna ding un va vat un. Ephraim tanggam pen nou a dia aneu luatleh," achi hi.
Joseph suante'n, "Tanggam kou a ding in ahun kei. Phaigam a teng Kanaan tengteng, Beth-shean leh akhopi a tengte leh Jezreel phaizang a tengte'n sik kangtalai anei chiat tuamse uh," achi uhi.
Joshua in Joseph inkuante, Ephraim leh Manasseh suante kiang ah, "Na tam mahmah ua, hat leng na hat ua; tan khat kia na nei kei ding uh.

'Tanggam teng nou a ding ahi lai ding hi. Gammang hitaleh, na vat ding ua, agam chiang tengteng nou a ahi ding.' Kanaante'n sik kangtalaite nei in, hat tawk le uh leng, na hawlkhe zou ding uh," achi hi.
Huai nung in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Shiloh ah akikhawm ua, huai ah kihoupihna biakbuk akai uhi. Huai gam teng azou khinta uhi.
Israel suante lak ah atantuam uh tang nai lou nam sagih a-om lai uhi.
Joshua in Israel suante kiang ah, "TOUPA na pipute uh Pathian in nou hon piaksa gam, bang tan ahia luah lou a na awltat lai ding uh?
Nam chih a kipan mi thum zel telkhia unla; amau akuan ding ua, gam ava en vialvial ding ua, atantuam hun ding uh bang chiat zel in ava gelh ding ua; ka kiang ah ahong nawn ding uh.
Mun sagih in akhen phot ding ua; Judah pawl simlam ah atantuam uah a-om ding ua, Joseph inkuante mallam ah atantuam uah a-om ding uh.
Gam mun sagih in va khen unla, huai gelhna hon pia un. Huchi in hiai ah TOUPA i Pathian ma ah ai ka hon sansak ding hi.

Levi teng in na lak uah tantuam anei kei ding uh. TOUPA mai a siampu nasep amau goutan ahi. Gad pawl, Reuben pawl leh Manasseh nam kimkhat bel Jordan gal suahlam ah amau tantuam TOUPA sikha Mosi in apiak ana tangta uh," achi hi.
Huchi in huai mite apawtkheta ua, Joshua in, "Gam va en vialvial unla, hon gelhkhia unla, ka kiang ah hon tun nawn unla, hiai ah Shiloh ah TOUPA ma ah ai ka hon sansak ding," chi in thu apia hi.
Mite akuan ua, gam ava en vialvial ua, mun sagih in akhen ua, laibu ah akhuakhua in agelhkhia ua, giahphual Shiloh ah Joshua kiang ah akik nawn uhi.
Joshua in Shiloh ah TOUPA ma ah ai ana sansak a; huai ah Joshua in Israel suante akikhendan bang zel un gam ahawmta hi.
Aisan a-inkuan uh dungzui in Benjamin suante tung ah aketa a; agamgi chiang uh Judah suante leh Joseph suante kikal ahi.
Mallam pang a agamgi chiang uh Jordan a pan ahi a; Jeriko sik ah mallam pang ah apaitou a, tumlam pang ah tanggam ah apaitou zel a; Beth-Aven gamdai ah atawp hi.
Hiai a pan Luz lam ah, Luz, huai tuh Bethel ahi, sik ah, simlam pang ah apai zel a; Beth-horon khang simlam pang a mual zul ah Ataroth-addar ah apaisuk hi.
Apai zel a, Beth-horon simlam pang a tangchin a pan tumlam ah simlam pang ah akualphei a; Kiriath-baal, huai Kiriath-jearim ahi, Judah suante khopi ah atawp a; huai tumlam pang gamgi ahi.
Simlam pang a gam Kiriath- jearim tawp a pan ahi a; tumlam ah apawt a, Nephtoah luituite ah apai zel hi.
Rephaim mallam pang phaizang a Hinnom Tapa phaizang chin a tangmong ah apaisuk a; Jebuste sik ah, simlam pang a Hinnom Phaizang ah apaisuk a, En-rogel ah apaisuk hi.
Mallam zuan in apai a, En-shemesh ah apai a, Adummim kahtouhna chin Geliloth ah apai a; Reuben tapa Bohan suang ah apaisuk a;
Arabah sik mallam pang ah apai zel a, Arabah ah apaisuk a;
Beth-hoglah sik, mallam pang ah apai zel a; atawpna bel Jordan simtawp, Chi Tuipi mallam tuipi meng ah ahi. Huai simlam gamgi ahi.
Jordan suahlam pang, agamgi chiang ahi. Huai ahi Benjamin suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a atantuam gam in akolhkhum sung.
Benjamin suante a-inkuan dungzui un akhopite uh, Jeriko, Beth- hoglah, Emek-keziz,
Beth-arabah, Zemariam, Bethel,
Avim, Parah, Ophrah,
Kephar-haammonai, Ophni leh Geba; akhopel tengteng toh akhopi tengteng sawm-le-nih ahi.
Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,
Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah;
Zelah, Eleph, Jebus, huai Jerusalem ahi, Gibeah leh Kiriath, akhotate toh khopi sawm-le-li ahi. Hiaite ahi Benjamin suante a-inkuan uh dungzui ua atantuam ding ua kisepte.
Aisan nihveina Simeon suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi. Atantuam uh Judah suante tantuam lak ah atel hi.
Atantuam ding ua pukte Beer-sheba, Sheba, Moladah,
Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
Ziklag, Beth-markaboth. Hazar-susah,
Beth-lebaoth leh Sharuhen; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-thum ahi.
Ain, Rimmon, Ether leh Ashan: akhotate toh khopi li.
Huai khopi kim akhopel tengteng Baalath-beer simlam a Ramah apha hi. Huaite Simeon suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a amau tantuam dia seh ahi.
Simeon suante tantuam Judah suante tantuam lak a ahi. Judah suante tantuam amau a ding in aza lo ngal a; huaiziak in Simeon suante tantuam lak ah atel hi.
Aisan thumveina Zebulun suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi. Atantuam gamgi uh Sarid tan ahi.
Agamgi uh tumlam pang ah Maralah pha in apai a, Dabeseth ava tung a; Jokneam kiang a luita tan ava tung hi.
Sarid a pan suahlam pang nisuahna lam ah Kisloth-tabor gamgi pha in akawitou a; Daberath ah apawt hi.
Huai a pan suahlam pang ah Gittah-hepher leh Eth-kazin ah apai zel a, Neah lam zuan in Rimmon ah apawt hi.
Mallam ah Hannathon ah akualphei nawn a, apawtna Iphtah-el Phaizang ah ahi.
Katath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah leh Bethlehem; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm- le-nih ahi.
Hiaite ahi Zebulun suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a, atantuam ding ua seh; huai khopite leh khopelte toh.
Aisan liveina Issakar suante tung ah a-inkuan uh omdan dungzui in apuk hi.
Agamgi chiang uh Jezreel, Kesuloth, Shunem,
Haphraim, Shion, Anaharath,
Rabbith, Kishion, Abez,
Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah leh Beth-pazzez tan ahi.
Tabor, Shahazimah leh Beth-shemesh ava pha a; apawtna Jordan ah ahi a, akhopel teng toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-guk ahi,
Hiaite ahi Issakar suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, atantuam ding ua seh; khopite leh akhotate toh.
Aisan ngana Asher suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
Gamgi chiang Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,
Allammelek, Amad leh Mishal ahi a; tumlam pang ah Karmel tang leh Shihor-libnath aphasuk hi.
Nisuahna lam pang ah Beth-dagon akualtou a, Zebulun leh mallam pang ah Jiphthah-el Phaizang ah Beth-emek leh Neiel ava pha a; veilam ah Kabul pha in apai a,
Ebron leh Rehob, Hammon leh Kanah, Zidon thupi pha in apai zel hi.
Gamgi Ramah leh Tura khopi kulhbaang nei ah akualphei a, Hosah ah akualphei nawn a, Akzib gam tuipi ah apawt hi.
Ummah, Aphek leh Rehob; akhopel teng toh khopi tengteng sawmnih-le-nih ahi.
Huaite ahi Asher suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, khopite leh akhotate atantuam uh.
Aisan gukna Naphtali suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
Agamgi chiang uh Heleph leh Zaananim a singkung lianpi a pan Adami-nekeb, Jabneel leh Lakkum pha in apai a, Jordan ah atawp hi.
Tumlam pang ah Aznoth-tabor ah apaisuk a; huai a pan Hukok ah apai a, simlam ah Zebulun ava tung a, tumlam ah Asher atung a, nisuahna lam ah Judia gam a Jordan aphatou hi.
Khopi kulhbaang neite: Ziddim, Zer, Hamath, Rakkath, Kinneret,
Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath leh Beth-shemesh ahi a, akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm ahi.
Hiaite ahi Naphtali suante nam a-inkuan dungzui ua khopite leh akhotate atantuam uh.
Aisan sagihna Dan suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
Atantuam gamgi uh Zorah, Estaol leh Ir-shemesh,
Shaalabbin, Aijalon leh Jethlah,
Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
Me-jarkon, Rakkon leh Joppa kiang a gamgi toh.
Dan suante gamgi in huaite ava kheng a; Dan suante'n Lesem adou ua, ala ua, namsau in ahihmang ua, atangta uh. Huai ah ateng pah ua, apu uh Dan min tam in Lesem, Dan ana chi uhi.
Hiaite ahi Dan suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, huai khopi leh akhotate toh atantuam uh.
Huchi in atantuam ding ua gamgi bawl bang zel a gam ahawm khit un, Israel suante'n Nun tapa Joshua alak uah tantuam abawlsak uhi.
TOUPA thupiak bang in Ephraim singtang gam a, akhopi ding in anget mah Timnath-serah apia ua; ama'n khopi asat a, huai ah ateng hi.

Hiaite ahi siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel suante nam inkuan a lupente'n Shiloh a TOUPA ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a ai san a, agoutan ding ua ana hawmte uh. Huchi in gam kihawm azouta uhi.

Huan Nun tapa Joshua in, "Agam leh Jeriko khua va en mah dih ua," chi in mi nih Sittim a pan asim a enkhe ding asawl hi. Ava hoh ua, kizuak khat, amin Rahab inn ah ava lut ua, huai ah ava zintung uhi.
"Ngai in, tuzan in gam enkhe ding in Israel suante ahong uh," chi in Jeriko kumpipa hilh in a-om hi.
Jeriko kumpipa'n, "Na inn a hong tung mikhualte hon pekhia in. Gam pumpi enkhe ding a hong ahi uh," chỉ ding in Rahab kiang ah mi asawl hi.
Numei in huai mi nihte api a, asel a, akiang uah, "Hi, ka kiang ah mite ahong ngei ngut ua, himahleh koi a pan hong pai ahi ua, chih zaw ka thei kei.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, khomial, kulh kongpi khak hun lai in huai mite apawtkhe nawnta uh. Koilam ah ahia apai uh ka theita kei hi. Delh meng le uchin, na pha lai ding uh,” achi hi.
Himahleh inn tung ah apitou a, inn tung a ziza kung siatkhawm lak a sel khin lah ahi ngal a.
Mite'n Jordan lui lam ah, agalkaina tan in ava delh ua; adelh mite apawtkhiaktak un kulh kongpi akhak uhi.
Alup ma un inn tung ah akiang uah ava hohtou hi.
Akiang uah, "Hiai gam TOUPA'N nou ahon peta, na lauhhuaina un hon delhkhum a, hiai gam a teng tengteng na ma uah azul khin uh, chih ka thei hi.

Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtkhiak un TOUPA'N Tuipi San ahon hihkangsak a, Jordan lui gal a Amorte kumpi nih: Sihon leh Og tung a na hihdante uh, huchibang a na hihmangdante uh lah ka na zata ngal ua.
Huai ka na zaktak un, ka lungtangte uh azul khin a, noute ziak a lau lou himhim a-om kei hi. TOUPA na Pathian u lah tunglam van ah leh nuailam lei ah Pathian ahi.
"Tu in na tung uah ka hehpihna ka langsakta hi, nou leng ka pa inkote tung ah na hehpihna uh langsak sam un.

Ka nu leh ka pa, ka sanggam pasalte, ka sanggam numeite leh aneih teng uh hawi unla, sihna lak a pan ka hinna uh hon humbitsak ding in TOUPA min in hehpih in ka kiang ah kichiam unla, chiamtehna dik hon pia un," achi hi.

Mite'n akiang ah, "Ka thilhih uh na genkhiak kei dingleh na sih tang in ka si ding uh. Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N gam ahon piak hun chiang in, ka hon hehpih ding ua, na tung ah muanhuaitak in ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
Tohlet ah khauhual azankhesuk a; khopi kulhbaang khou a a-inn om ahi a, huan amah kulhbaang tung a teng ahi.

Akiang uah, "Tang lam zuan in pai un, huchi lou in zaw nou hon delhte'n ahon mu kha ding uh. Huai ah ni thum sung va kibu un; nou hon delhte ahong kik nawn masiah uh. Huai zoh chiang in na pai nawn na ding uh," achi hi.
Mite'n akiang ah, "Kichiamna a na hon kichiamsakna ah zaw dembei ka hi ding uh.
Ngai in, hiai gam ka hong lut chiang un na hon khiakna tohlet ah hiai khau san na gak belh în. Insung ah na kiang ah na pa, na nu, na sanggam teng leh na pa inkote tengteng pilut vek in.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, na inn kongpi a pan kholak a pawtkhe peuhmah alutung ah asisan a-om dia, kou ahihleh moh in ka om kei ding uh. Kuapeuh insung a na kiang a om peuhmah atung ua khutkhak ahihleh, ka lutung uah asisan uh a-om ding hi.
Himahleh ka thilhih uh na genkhiakleh na hon kichiamsakna ah moh in ka om kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Na thu bang zel uh hi hen," achi a; huchi in amau akhakhia a, apaita uhi. Tohlet ah khau san agakden hi.
Apai ua, huai tang ava tung ua, huai ah ni thum, amau delhte akik nawn masiah uh ava om uhi. Adelh mite'n lamtawn in azong ua, himahleh amuzou kei uh.
Huai mi nihte akik nawn ua, huai tang a pan apaisuk ua, agalkah ua, Nun tapa Joshua kiang atung ua; atung ua thil tung tengteng ahilh uhi.
Joshua kiang ah, "TOUPA'N agam pumpi i khut uah ahon na pe petmah ve, huai kia leng hilou, huai gam a tengte i ma uah azul khin uh," achi uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Joshua ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah, 'Kihumbitna khuate bawl in, Mosi zang a na kiang ua ka gen khitsa ahi.
Kuapeuh thei lou leh tumloupi a mi that kha, huai ah atailut thei ding hi. Huchi in sisan phulami a pan nou a ding in kihumbitna ahi ding.

Huai khopite lak a akoi hiam pen a, atailut chiang in, khopi kulhbaang kongpi lutna ah ava dingh ding a, huai kho upate bil a zak in atanchin ava tun ding. Amau khopi sung ah akiang uah apilut ding ua, alak ua aten sam theihna ding in a-omna ding asehsak ding uhi.
Sisan phulami in ahon delhleh athatmi pen akhut ah na pe ding uh ahi kei. A-invengte thei lou a, athah ahi; ama in aho ngal kei hi.

Omkhawmte ma a vai hawmsak dia adin ma leh siampu lianpen a pangpa asih mateng, huai khopi ah ateng ding hi. Huai nung in mithat mi pen amah khosung mahmah, ataikhiaksan khua, amah mah insung ah alut nawn ding ahi,' chi in gen in," achi hi.
Huchi in Naphtali tanggam a Galili a Kadesh, Ephraim tanggam a Shekem leh Judia singtang gam a Kirath Arba, (huai tuh Hebron ahi) asep uhi.
Suahlam ah Jordan gal a Jeriko ah Reuben nam gam a gamdai phaizang a Bezer, Gad nam gam a Gilead gam a Ramoth, Manasseh nam gam a Bashan a Golan asepta uhi.

Hiai khuate ahi Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng leh alak ua namdang tengte a dia seh a om. Kuapeuh mi that kha, hiai khuate a tailut in mipi mai a adin mateng sisan phulami khut ah si lou in a-om thei ding hi.
Huchi in Levi chi inkuan a pente siampu Eleaza kiang ah leh Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah leh Israel suante nam inkuan a lupente kiang ah ahoh uhi.
"Kanaan gam a Shiloh khua ah, TOUPA'N Mosi zang in ka tenna ding uh khopite, ka gante uh tatna ding akimvel toh na hon piak ding uh thu ana peta," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel suante'n TOUPA thupiak bang in atantuam ua kipan hiai khopite akimvel toh Levi chite apia uhi.

Aisan Kohath suan tung ah apukta hi. Huchi in siampu Aaron suan Levi chi a mite'n Judah nam tantuam a pan, Simeon nam tantuam a pan leh Benjamin nam tantuam a pan khopi sawm-le-thum aisan in atangta uhi.
Kohath suan dangte'n Ephraim nam suante tantuam a pan, Dan nam tantuam a pan leh Manasseh nam kimkhat tantuam a pan khopi sawm aisan in atangta uhi.
Gershon suante'n Issakar nam suante tantuam a pan, Asher nam tantuam a pan, Naphtali nam tantuam a pan leh Bashan gam a Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan, khopi sawm-le-thum aisan in atangta uhi.
Merari suante'n a-inkuan uh dungzui in Reuben nam tantuam a pan, Gad nam tantuam a pan leh Zebulun nam tantuam a pan khopi sawm-le-nih atangta uhi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu apiak bang in Levi mite khopite leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte aisan in apia uhi.
Huchi in Judah suante nam tantuam a pan leh Simeon suante nam tantuam a pan hiai khopi minlohte apia uhi.
Huaite Levi suan Kohath pawl a namte, Aaron suan pawl a ding ahi; amau tung ah aisan apuk masapen hi.
Amau a ding in Judah tanggam a Kiriath-arba leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi. Kiriath-arba Hebron kichi ahi a, Arba ahihleh Anak pa ahi.
Khopi kimvelte leh akhotate Jephunneh tapa Kaleb tantuam ding in apia uhi.
Siampu Aaron suante Hebron, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Libnah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Jattir khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Eshtemoa khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Holon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Debir khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Ain khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Juttah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Beth-shemesh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; huai nam nihte tantuam a pan khopi kua apia uhi.
Benjamin nam tantuam a pan Gibeon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Geba khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Anathoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Almon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li ape lai uhi.
Aaron suan siampute khopi tengteng khopi sawm-le-thum ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Kohath suante inkuan, Levi pawl leh Kohath suan dangte'n leng atantuam khopite uh Ephraim nam tantuam a pan in ahi atan uh.
Mi that mite kihumbitna khopi Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gezer khua akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Kibzaim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-horon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li apia uhi.
Dan nam tantuam a pan Eltekeh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gibbethon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Aijalon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gath-rimmon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.
Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan Taanak khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Gath-rimmon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi nih.
Kohath suan dangte nam khopi tengteng kho sawm ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.

Gershon suante pawl, Levi namte Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Bashan gam a Golan khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Beeshterah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi nih apia uhi.
Issakar nam tantuam a pan Kishion khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Daberath khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Jarmuth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, En-gannim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li.
Asher nam tantuam a pan Mishal khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Helkath khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Rehob khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.

Naphtali nam tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Galili gam a Kadesh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Hammoth-dor khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kartan khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi thum.
Gershon pawl a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a, atantuam uh khopi tengteng sawm-le-thum ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Merari suante pawl inkuan, Levi pawl dangte bel Zebulun nam tantuam a pan Jokneam khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kartah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Dimnah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Nahalal khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.
Reuben nam tantuam a pan Bezer khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jahaz khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Kedemoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li.
Gad nam tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Gilead gam a Ramoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mahanaim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Heshbon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jazer khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; avek in khopi li,
Hiai tengteng Levi pawl inkuan dangte Merari suante pawl a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a, akhopite uh ahi. Huchi in atantuam uh khopi sawm-le-nih ahi.
Israel suante pawl tantuam a pan Levi pawl khopi tengteng sawmli-le-giat ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Hiai khopite'n akimvel anei chiat ua; khopi tengteng huchibang vek ahi uh.
Huchi in TOUPA'N apipute uh kichiam a piak ana chiamsa gam tengteng Israelte apia hi. Amau huai gam aluah ua, asung ah atengta uhi.
TOUPA'N apipute uh kiang a kichiam a, ana chiamsa bang ngei in mun chih ah muanna apia a, amelma tengteng uh kuamah ama ua pangzou himhim a-om kei uhi. TOUPA'N amelma tengteng akhut uah ape vek hi.
TOUPA'N Israel inkuante kiang a, ahoih lam thu a na gen tengteng vuaksuak khat leng a-om kei a, ahong tung vek hi.
Huai khit in Joshua in Reuben pawlte, Gad pawlte leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte asam hi.
Akiang uah, "TOUPA sikha Mosi in hon thupiak peuhmah na zuita ua, ke'n thu ka hon piak peuhmah leng na zuita uhi.
Tuni tanpha in na unaute uh na taisan kei ua, TOUPA na Pathian un hih dia thu ahon piak na zuita uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un akiang ua ana gensa bang in, na unaute uh muanna apeta hi. Huaiziak in TOUPA sikha Mosi in Jordan gal a na tantuam ding ua hon piaksa gam ah, na puanin kaihte uah pai nawnta un.

TOUPA sikha Mosi in TOUPA na Pathian uh it a, alampi tengteng tawn a, athupiakte zui a, amah len tinten a, na lungtang tengteng uleh na kha tengteng ua amah nna sem chiatchiat dia hon thupiakte, huai thupiak leh dante pilvangtak in limsak un," achi hi.
Joshua in amau avualzawl a, apaisakta hi. Huchi in apuanin lam uah apaita uhi.

Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in Bashan gam ah tantuam apia a; akimkhat dangte Joshua in tumlam pang ah Jordan gal ah a-unaute lak ah tantuam ape zawta hi. Joshua in a-inn lam ua apaisak dek lai in avualzawl hi.

Akiang uah, "Na puanin lam uah hauhsakna tamtak toh paita unla, ganta tampi toh, dangka toh, dangka-eng toh, dal toh, sik toh, silh-le-ten tampi toh. Na melmate ua pan na gallakte uh unaute toh kihawm dialdial un," achi hi.

Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte akik nawn ua, Kanaan gam Shiloh a pan Israel suante kiang a pan Gilead gam, TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu a na piak bang in amau tantuam ding mawng a sehsa gam a pai ding in apawtkheta uhi.
Kanaan gam a Jordan gamgi ava tun un Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Jordan lui gei ah maitam lianpi kholang mahmah khat adoh uhi.
Ngai in, Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Kanaan gam chin tak, Jordan gamgi, Israel suante gam lam pang ah maitam adoh uh, chih Israelte kiang ah kuahiam khat in ava hilh hi.
Israel suante'n hiai thu azak un, Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng amaute dou tum in Shiloh ah akikhawm uhi.
Israel suante'n Gilead gam a Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang ah siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas asawl uhi.
Milian sawmkhat, Israel nam a inkuan a lupente'n Phinehas azui uhi.
Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang Gilead gam ah ahoh ua, akiang uah,
huchi in TOUPA mi omkhawm tengteng in, "Bangziak a tuni a TOUPA tung a hel tum a maitam doh a, TOUPA lehngatsan na hi ua?" achi uhi.
"Peor mun a tatsiatnate, ei a dia neu lua a sim theih ahi maw? Tuni tan in leng huai a i khelhna ua pan silsiang i hi nai kei ua, TOUPA mi omkhawmte lak ah hipi alen tanpha in leng.
Tuni a TOUPA lehngatsan na tup maizen uh? Huchi in tuni in TOUPA tung ah na na helta maimah ua, zingchiang a zaw Israel mipi omkhawm tengteng tung a amah heh ding ahita ve.

Na gam luah uh siang lou ahihleh, TOUPA gam, TOUPA biakbuk omna mun ah hong pai unla, ka lak uah hong teng un. Himahleh TOUPA i Pathian un achih louh maitam dang bawl in TOUPA tung ah hel kei unla, kou tung ah leng hel kei un.
Zer tapa Akan in hamsiat thil ah ana hihkhial a, Israel mipi tengteng tung ah hehna ahong om ahi kei maw? Huai mi tatsiatna ah amah kia amangthang tuam kei hi," achi uhi.
Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Israel nam a intekpente adawng ua, akiang uah,

"TOUPA, pathiante' Pathian, pathiante TOUPA Pathian in athei. Israel pawl in leng thei hen! Ka maitam doh uh TOUPA lehngatsan a, hel tupna hiam thilhihkhelh tupna hiam a ka hih uleh, tuni in leng hon hawi kei un,
halmang thillatna ding hiam, nek ding thillatna ding hiam, lemna thillatna ding hiam ahihleh, TOUPA mahmah in thukhen hen.
Tunung chiang in na suante un ka suante uh kiang ah, Nou TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian na zat phakna uh bang om ahia?

Nou Reuben suante leh Gad suante aw, TOUPA'N kou leh nou a ding in Jordan gamgi ding in abawl hi. TOUPA ah tantuam na nei sam kei uh, ahon chi kha ding uh, chi a, pilvan ziak a aziak neitak a ka hih uh ahi. Na suante un kou suante TOUPA laudan thei lou in abawl kha thei uhi.
Huaiziak in kisa un, maitam i bawl ding uh, halmang thillatna ding leh kithoihna ding bel hilou in.

Kou leh nou leh i nung ua i suante kikal ah theihpihna ahi dia, huchi in ka halmang thillatte uh leh ka kithoihnate uh leh ka lemna thillatte ua TOUPA nna ka septheihna ding uh leh na suante un leng tunung chiang a ka suante uh kiang a TOUPA ah tantuam na nei sam kei uh ahon chihlouhna ding un, ka chi ua ahi.

Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, tunung chiang a ka kiang uh hiam, ka suante uh kiang uh hiam a huchibang a ahon chih chiang ua kou, 'En ve ua, ka pipute un TOUPA maitam abawl uh omdan, halmang thillatna ding leh kithoihna ding ahi kei a, kou leh nou kikal a theihpihna ahi zaw hi,' ka chihna ding ua, ka hih uh ahi.

TOUPA tung a hel a TOUPA lehngatsan a, TOUPA ka Pathian uh maitam, abiakbuk chin a maitam kia lou halmang thillatna ding hiam, nek ding thillatna ding hiam, theihpihna ding hiam a maitam bawl ka hihlouhdan uh," achi uhi.
Siampu Phinehas leh akiang a omkhawmte' miliante, Israel pawl nam intekpente'n Reuben suante leh Gad suante leh Manasseh suan kimkhatte thugen azak un akipaksak mahmah hi.

Siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas in Reuben suante leh Gad suante leh Manasseh suan kimkhatte kiang ah, "TOUPA tung a thil na hihkhelh louh ziak un, tu'n zaw TOUPA i lak ua om ngeina ahi, chih ka theita ve ua. Huchi in Israel suante TOUPA khut a pan na hunkheta uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas leh milian pawl, Reuben suante leh Gad suante a pan leh Gilead gam a pan Kanaan gam ah Israel suante kiang ah akik nawnta ua, thu ava tun nawn uhi.
Huai thute'n Israel suante akipaksak mahmah a; Israel suante'n Pathian aphatta uh. Huchi in Reuben suante leh Gad suante dou a, atenna gam uh suksiatsak ding in kuankhiak atum nawn kei uhi.
Reuben suante leh Gad suante'n huai maitam pen, "theihpihtu,” achi uhi. "TOUPA, Pathian a na hi ngei chih i kikal ua theihpihtu ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Israelte amelma tengteng a pan galmuanna apiak nung hun sautak a pai nung in Joshua ahong upa in, ahong tekta hi.
Joshua in Israel tengteng, a-upate leh a-intekpente, avaihawmte leh aheutu teng uh asamsak a, akiang uah, "Ka upa in, ka tekta hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un noute ziak a hiai nam tengteng tung a athilhihte na muta ua; TOUPA na Pathian un, amah mah in noute a ding in gal ahon dousak hi.
Ngai un, Jordan lui leh tumlam Tuipi Lian kikal a nam omlaite zou in, aisan in na tantuam ding un ka hon pia hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na ma uah amau adelhkhe dia, na muhbatlouhna uah ahawlmang vek ding. TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua agensa bang in agam uh na luah ding uhi.
Huaiziak in Mosi Dan laibu a gelh tengteng taklam ah hiam veilam ah hiam a na pialsan hetlouhna ding un hangsantak in zui un.
Hiai nam na lak ua omlaite toh tengkhawm kei un. Apathiante uh min gen kei unla, aminte un kichiam kei unla, a-nna uh leng sem kei unla, ama uah leng kun in a-nna uh sem kei un.
Himahleh tuni tan a na hih gige bang un, TOUPA na Pathian uh lenkip un.
TOUPA'N na ma uah nam thupitak leh hattakte adelhkhe khinta hi. Na ma uah tuni tan in kuamah pangzou himhim a-om kei uhi.
Na lak ua mi khat in mi sangkhat adelh ding, na kiang ua agensa bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un nou a ding in gal ahon dousak ngal a.
TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding in pilvang mahmah un.

Pilvang lou a, na lehngatsan himhim ua, hiai namte lak a khosuaksun, na lak ua omlaite ngei, na pawlmat ua, amaute toh pasal leh zi a na kineih ua, amaute na kithuahpih ua, amau leng nou ahon kithuahpih uleh zaw,

TOUPA na Pathian un hiai namte na mitmuh un ahon delhkhiaksak nawn kei ding hi. TOUPA na Pathian un hiai gam hoihtak a hon piak a pan na manthat vek masiah uh amaute nou a ding in pial leh thang leh na pang ua ding in khetna chiang leh na mit ua ding in ling ahong hi zaw ding uh, chih teltak in thei un.

"Ngai un, tuni in leitung pumpi dan bang in ka paita ding hi. TOUPA na Pathian un na tungtang uh, ahoih lam, ana gensa tengteng vuaksuak khat lel leng a-om kei, chih na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng un na thei uhi. Na tung uah ahong tungvekta a, khat lel leng vuaksuak a-om kei hi.

Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua thil hoih agen tengteng na tung ua ahong tun vek tak mah bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak hiai gam hoihtak a pan ahon manthatsak vek masiah TOUPA'N thil hoihloute na tung uah atungsak ding hi.

TOUPA na Pathian un ahon thupiak thukhun na tatlek san ua, pathian dangte nna sem a, kun a na biak uleh, TOUPA hehna na tung uah a-om dia, ahon piak gam hoihtak a pan na mangthang pah ding uhi," achi hi.
Huan Joshua in Israel nam tengteng Shekem ah asam-khawm a, Israel upate, a-intekpente, avaihawmte leh aheutute uh asamsak a; Pathian ma ah ahong kimusak chiat uhi.

Joshua in mi tengteng kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Na pipute uh nidanglai in lui khen lam ah ateng ua, Abraham pa leh Nahor pa Terah hialte leng, amaute'n pathian dangte nna asem uhi.
Na pu uh Abraham huai lui gal a pan ka pikhia a, Kanaan gam teng tawnsuak in ka pi a, asuante ka pungsak a, Isak ka pia hi.
Isak kiang ah Jakob leh Esau ka pia a; Esau tantuam ding in Seir tang ka pia a; Jakob leh atate Aigupta ah apaisuk uhi.
Mosi leh Aaron ka sawl a, alak ua thillamdang hih in Aigupta ka gawt a: huai khit in amaute ka hon pikhia hi.
Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhia a, tuipi na hong tung ua; Aigupta mite'n na pipute uh kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite toh Tuipi San tan in anungdelh uhi.
Amau TOUPA asam ua, Aigupta mite toh na kikal uh amialsak bikbek a, amaute tuipi tuamsak in akhuhkhumsak a; Aigupta gam a ka thilhih na mit un amu a; gamdai ah sawtpi na teng uhi.
Jordan lui gal a om Amorte gam ah ka hon pi a; amau ahon dou uh. Na khut uah amaute ka hon pia a, agam uh na luahta uhi. Amau ka hon hihmangsakta hi.
Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak ahong kisa a, Israel adou a; Beor tapa Balaam nou hon hamsiat ding in asamsak hi.
Himahleh Balaam thu ka ngaikhe kei hi. Huaiziak in nou ahon vualzawl zosopta hi. Huchi in akhut a pan ka hon hunkheta hi,
Jordan lui na kan ua, Jeriko khua na tungtou ua; Jeriko khomite'n hon na dou ua, Amorte, Perizte, Kanaante, Hitte, Girgaste, Hivte leh Jebuste toh; amau na khut uah ka hon peta hi.
Na ma uah tunpi ka sawl a, huai in na ma uah amau adelh a, Amorte' kumpipa nihte tan in leng. Himahleh na namsau un hiam, na thal un hiam in ahi kei hi.
"Na sepkhiak het louh uh gam leh na bawl het louh uh khopite ka hon pia a, huaite ah na teng ua; na suan louh uh grephuan leh olive huan a pan na ne uhi.
"Huaiziak in TOUPA laudan siam unla, chitak leh thutak in ama nna sem un. Na pipute un Lui gal leh Aigupta gam a, a-nna asep uh pathiante koihkhia unla; TOUPA nna sem un.

TOUPA nna sep hoih lou a na theih uleh tuni in kua nna ahia na sep ding uh, tel un. Na pipute un Lui gal a, a-nna asep uh pathiante hia, na luah uh gam a Amorte pathiante? Kei leh inkuante'n zaw TOUPA nna ahi ka sep ding uh," achi hi.
Mipite'n, "TOUPA Pathian paisan a, pathian dangte nna ka sep louh ding dan uh.
TOUPA i Pathian ngei ahi, i pipute toh Aigupta gam saltanna inn a pan hon pikhia a, i mitmuh a chiamtehna thupi taktak hih a, i paina teng leh mipi tengteng i nawk paisuakna ah leng hon vengbit hi.
TOUPA'N i ma ngei uah mi chih, huai gam a om Amorte ngei adelhkhe vek hi. Huaiziak in kou leng TOUPA nna ahi ka sep ding uh; amah lah ka Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in adawng uhi.
Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "TOUPA nna ná sem thei kei ding uh. Amah lah Pathian siangthou ahi ngal a. Mullit hat Pathian ahi a; na tatleknate uh leh na khelhnate uh angaidam kei ding hi.
TOUPA na paisan ua, namdang pathiante nna na sep uleh, na tung ua thil hoih ahih khit nung in ahong kihei dia, hon hih na in ahon hihmangthang ding," achi hi.
Mipite'n, Joshua kiang ah, "Hilou e, TOUPA nna ka sem kinken zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "A- nna sep tum in TOUPA na telta uh, chih atheihpihtute noumau mah na hi uh," achi hi. Amau, "Theihpihtute ka hí uh,” achi uhi.
Amah mah in, "Huchi ahihleh na lak ua namdang pathian omte koihmang unla, na lungtangte uh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian lam ah awnsak un," achi hi.
Mipite'n Joshua kiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian nna ka sem ding ua, athu ka zui ding uh," achi uhi.
Huai ni in Joshua in mipite toh kikal ah thu akhung a, Shekem ah dan thuseh leh thuseh asehsak hi.
Joshua in hiai thu Pathian Dan Laibu ah agelh a; suang lianpi ala a, TOUPA Mun Siangthou chin a tosaw nuai ah aphut hi.

Joshua in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai un, hiai suang i thu hon theihpihtu hi hen. TOUPA'N i kiang ua thu agen tengteng aza vekta hi. Huaiziak in na thu uh hon theihpihtu ahi ding hi, huchi lou in zaw Pathian na kitheihmohbawl kha ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Joshua in mipite atantuam gam chiat uah apaisakta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thilte khit in Nun tapa Joshua, TOUPA sikha kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi.
Gaash tang mallam pang, Ephraim tanggam a amah tantuam gamgi sung Timnath-serah ah avuita uhi.
Joshua damsung leh amah khup a dam, TOUPA'N Israelte a dia thil ahih tengteng theihpih mite damsung in Israelte'n TOUPA nna asem uhi.
Israel suante'n Aigupta gam a pan Joseph guhte apuaktouh uh Shekem a Shekem pa Hamor tapate a pan Jakob in dangka zakhat a aleina mun ah avui ua; huai mun Joseph suante tantuam ahita hi.
Huan Aaron tapa Eleazar asi a; atapa Phinehas tantuam dia apiak Ephraim tang ah avui uhi.
Huan Joshua zingkhang in athou a, Israel suan tengteng toh Shittim a pan akisuan ua, Jordan lui atung uhi. Agalkah ma un huai ah agiak uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni thum nung in heutute'n giahphual ava tawn vialvial uhi.
"TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun bawm leh siampute, Levi chite'n azawn uh na muh chiang un na omna ua kipan kisuan unla, na zui ding uh ahi.

Himahleh nou toh akal tehna tong sangnih vel ahi ding ahi. Naih kei unla, huchi in na paina ding lampi na theithei ding uhi. Hiai lampi lah tuma lam in na tawn ngei ngal kei ua," chi in mipite thu apia uhi.
Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kihihsiangthou un, zingchiang a TOUPA'N na lak ua thillamdang mahmah hih ding ahi," achi hi.
Joshua in siampute kiang ah, "Thukhun bawm zawng unla, mipite ma ah galkah un," achi hi. Huchi in thukhun bawm azawng ua, mipite ma ah apaita uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, “Mosi kiang a ka om bang in na kiang ah ka om ding, chih atheihtheihna ding un, tuni in Israel tengteng mitmuh in ka hon pahtawi pan ding hi.
Thukhun bawm zawng siampute, Jordan lui gei na tun chiang un, Jordan lui ah dingden un, chi in thu pia in,” achi hi.
Joshua in Israel suante kiang ah, "Hong pai unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh thu hong ngaikhia un," achi hi.
Joshua in, "Hiai ah Pathian hing na lak uah a-om a, na ma uah Kanaante, Hitte, Hivte, Perizte, Girgaste, Amorte leh Jebuste adelhkhe ngeingei ding hi.
Ngai un, leitung pumpi TOUPA thukhun bawm in na ma uah Jordan lui akan hi.
Israel namte lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih sik in mi khat zel telkhia un.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA leitung pumpi TOUPA bawm zawng siampute khepek Jordan tui a akingaktak in, saklam a pan Jordan tui hong luangte akitat dia; ahong kiching venvon ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipite Jordan lui kan dia apuanin ua kipan apawt lai un, mipite ma ah thukhun bawm zawng siampute apai uhi.
Bawm zawngte Jordan lui ava tung ua, bawm zawng siampute khe in tui gei asiktak in, buhlak sung teng Jordan lui a kuang tengteng ah tui alet gige hi.

Saklam a pan tuipi luang lai akhawlta a, gamla kuamtak a Zarethan gam chin a Adam ah ahong kiching hi. Arabah tuipi, Chi Tuipi lam a luangsuk lai akitat geih a; huchi in Jeriko khozawntak ah mipite agalkahta uhi.
Jordan lui lai ah TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng siampute leihul ah adingh ua, mipi tengteng Jordan lui agalkah vek uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, anam pumpi ua Jordan lui agalkah siang nung un, TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah,
"Mipite lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih a mi khat zel telkhia inla,
akiang uah, Jordan lui lai, siampute dinna laitak a suangte sawm-le-nih la unla, pophei unla, giahphual, tuzan a na giahna ding uah koih un, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
Huchi in Joshua in Israel suante lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih a mi khat zel atelkhiakte asam a;
Joshua in akiang uah, "TOUPA na Pathian uh bawm ma ah Jordan lui lai ah galkah unla, Israel suante anam zah zel in, michih in suang khat chiat pua hen.
Hiaite na lak uah chiamtehna ahong hi ding a, tunung chiang in na tate un, hiai suangte bang na chihna uh ahia? chỉ a ahon dot chiang un,

Nou akiang uah, TOUPA thukhun bawm ma a Jordan tuite ahong kan tak ziak in ahi. Jordan akan lai un, Jordan tuite ahong kitat a ahi. Hiai suangte Israel suante'n tangtawn a atheihgigena ding uh ahi, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
Israel suante'n Joshua thupiak bang in ahih ua, Israel suante'n anam zah zel in, Jordan lui lai a suang sawm-le-nih ala ua; agiahphual uah, apophei ua, huai ah akoih uhi.
Thukhun bawm zawng siampute dinna laitak, Jordan lui lai ah Joshua in huai suang sawm-le-nihte aphut a; huaite tuni tan in a-om lai uhi.

Mosi in Joshua thu ana piak tengteng bang a TOUPA'N mipite kiang a hih dia Joshua thu apiak ahihzoh vek mateng uh siampu bawm zawngte Jordan lui lai ah adingh nilouh uhi. Mipite akinoh ua, agalkahta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng agalkah siang vek nung un, TOUPA bawm leh siampute leng mipi mitmuh in agalkahta uhi.
Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in akiang ua ana gen khitsa bang in, Israel suante ma ah kigalthuam in agalkah uhi.
Galvan a kivan dimdiam mi singli vel galdou ding in Jeriko phaizang ah TOUPA ma ah agalkah uhi.
Huai ni in TOUPA'N Israel tengteng mitmuh in Joshua atawisang a; Mosi alauh mah bang un adamsung teng in amah alau uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah thu agen a:
"Siampute, thu theihpihna bawm zawngte Jordan lui a pan hong pawt ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
Joshua in siampute, "Jordan lui a pan hong pawtta un," chi in thu apia hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute, TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngte Jordan lui lai a pan ahong pawt ua, siampute khete'n leihul asiktak in, Jordan tuite aluan ngeina bang un ahong luang nawn ua, ama a mah bang in akuang ah aluanglet nawn hi.
Mipite akha khatna, ani sawm ni in Jordan lui a pan apawt ua, Jeriko suahlam pang Gilgal ah giahphual asatta uhi.
Jordan lui a pan suang sawm-le-nih apuakkhiak uh, Joshua in Gilgal ah aphut hi.
Israel suante kiang ah, "Tunung chiang a na suante un apate uh kiang a, hiai suangte bang chihna ahia? chi a hon dot chiang un,
Israelte'n Jordan lui leihul ah agalkah ua ahi, chi in na suante uh na theisak ding uhi.'
TOUPA na Pathian un nidanglai a Tuipi San i galkah masiah ua, i ma ua ana kangtatsak mah bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un Jordan tuite na galkah masiah uh na ma uah akangtatsak a ahi.
Lei a nam chiteng in TOUPA khut ana hat ngei, chih atheih ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh tangtawn a alauhtheihna ding un," chi in agen hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jordan lui khen suahlam a om Amorte kumpipa tengteng leh tuipi gei a om Kanaan gam kumpipa tengtengte'n, agalkah masiah uh TOUPA'N Jordan tuite Israel suante ma ah akangtatsak, chih ana zak un, Israel suante ziak in alungtang uh ana zul khin a, lauthawng lou himhim a-om kei uhi.
Huai lai in TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Temta hiam kibawl inla, Israel suante zek anihveina ding in sumsak in," achi hi.
Joshua in temta hiamte akibawl a, Israel suante Gibeth Haraloth ah azek uh asumsak hi.
Joshua in azeksumna ziak hiai ahi: Aigupta gam a pan pawt tengteng, pasal galdoumi tengteng Aigupta gam a pan apawtkhiak nung un lamkal a gamdai a asih khit tak ziak uh ahi.
Aigupta gam a pan pawt tengteng zeksumsa vek ahi ua; himahleh Aigupta gam a pan apawt ua gamdai a lamkal a piang tengteng bel zeksum ahi kei uhi.

TOUPA aw angaihkhiak nop louh ziak ua mipi tengteng, Aigupta gam a pan hong pawt galdou mite tan hihman a a-om vek tan un Israel suante gamdai ah kum sawmli avialvak uhi. TOUPA'N amau pi-le-pute kiang a nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam kichiam a piak ana chiam, huai gam mu lou ding in akiang uah TOUPA ana kichiamta hi.
Asuante uh amau sik a akhanletsakte Joshua in azek uh asumsak hi. Lamkal a azek uh sum ahih louh ziak in zeksum louh ana hi him uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng zek asum khit un, adam mateng uh amau giahphual chiat uah a-om uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Tuni in Aiguptate'n nou hon muhsitna uh noumau a pan ka khukmangta," achi hi. Huchi in tuni tan in huai mun Gilgal achi uhi.
Israel suante'n Gilgal ah giahphual asat ua; Jeriko Phaizang ah huai kha, ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang alui uhi.
Paikan khit azing mah in huai gam a tanghou silngou soh louh leh vaimim kan ane uhi.
Huai gam a buh anek ni zing ua pan manna aketa kei a; Israel suante'n manna leng amu nawn kei uhi. Huai kum in Kanaan gam a buh-le-bal ane zawta uhi.

Huan Jeriko kho kiangchin a Joshua a-om lai in adak a, a-entou a, ngai in, hichi ahong hi a, amazawn chin ah mi khat anamsau phawisa tawi in ana ding hi. Joshua in ava naih a, akiang ah, "Kou lam a pang na hi hia, ka melmate uh lam a pang?" achi hi.
Ama'n, “Hilou e, TOUPA sepaihte heutu dia hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi. Huchi in lei ah Joshua abokkhup a, amah abia a, akiang ah, "Ka toupa'n asikha kiang ah bang gen ding nei ahia?" achi hi.
TOUPA sepaihte heutu in Joshua kiang ah, "Na khepek a pan na khedap phel in. Na dinna mun siangthou ahi,” achi a; huchi in Joshua in aphelta hi.
Jeriko khua Israel suante ziak in akikhak bikbek a; kuamah apawt kei ua, kuamah leng alut kei uh.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "En in, Jeriko leh akumpipa uh leh amihat hangsante uh na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi.
Galdoumi tengteng in khopi kimvel in khatvei na va velsuak phot ding uh. Huchibang in ni guk sung na hih ding uh ahi.
Siampu sagih in bawm malam ah belampa kii pengkul sagih atawi ding ua, ani sagih ni in khopi sagihvei na velsuak ding ua, siampute'n pengkul amut ding uh.
