Huan hichi ahi ding a, belampa kii amutging uh na zak chiang un, mipi tengteng ngaihtak in kikou uhen. Huchi in khopi kulhbaang achim dia, mipi amau mazawn chiat ah apaitou ding uh," achi hi.
Nun tapa Joshua in siampute asam a, akiang uah, "Thukhun bawm zawng unla, siampu sagih in TOUPA bawm malam ah belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi uhen," achi hi.
Ama'n mipite kiang ah, "Pai zel unla, khopi velsuak un, mi kigalthuamte TOUPA bawm malam ah pai zel uhen,” achi hi.
Hichi ahong hita a, Joshua in mipite kiang a thu agen khit in TOUPA ma a belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi siampu sagihte apai zel ua, pengkul amut ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm in azui hi.
Mi kigalthuamte pengkul amut ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm in azui hi. 9 Mi kigalthuamte pengkul mut siampute ma ah apai ua, nungdal mite'n bawm amasuan ua, siampute'n pai kawm in pengkul amut uhi.

Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kikou kei unla, na aw uh leng zak hi kei hen. Kikou dia thu ka hon piak ni atun mateng na kam ua pan thu pawt kei hen. Huai hun chiang in na kikou ding uh," chi in thu apia hi.
TOUPA bawm khopi khatvei velh in avelsuaksak a; giahphual ah apai ua, giahphual ah agiak nawn uhi.
Joshua zingkhang in athou a, siampute'n TOUPA bawm azawng uhi.

TOUPA bawm ma ah belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi siampu sagihte apai ua, pengkul amut uhi. Ama uah mi kigalthuamte apai ua; nungdalte'n TOUPA bawm ahon masuan ua, siampute'n apai kawm un pengkul amut uhi.
Ani nih ni in khopi khatvei avelsuak nawn ua, agiahphual uah akik nawn uh. Huchibang in ni guk ahih uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in zingkhang, phalvak in athou ua, ahihdan ngei mah un sagihvei avelsuak ua; huai ni kia in khopi sagihvei avelsuak uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, asagihveina a siampute'n pengkul amuttak un Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kikou un: TOUPA'N khopi ahon pe khinta hi.
Khopi leh asung a thil om tengteng TOUPA hamsiat ahi. Rahab kizuaknu kia, amah leh a-insung a akiang a om tengteng bel i misawlte uh ana sel ziak in hinghawi ding ahi.
Nou zaw hamsiat thilte a pan kihuikhe hiau un, huchi lou in zaw, hamsiat thilte la in noumau mah hamsiat in na omloh kha ding uhi. Israelte giahphual hamsiat a omsak in na buaisak kha ding uhi.
Dangkasik, dangka-eng, dal leh sik tui-um belsuan teng ahihleh TOUPA a tuam ahi vek hi. TOUPA sum in akoih ding ahi," achi hi.

Mipite akikou ua, siampute'n pengkul amut uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipite'n pengkul ging azaktak un, ngaihtak in akikou ua, kulhbaang achimta hi. Huchi in mipite amazawn chiat uah apaitou ua, khopi ah alut ua, khopi alata uhi.
Khopi sung a mi tengteng, numei leh pasal, atek- akhang, bawngtal, belam leh sabiltung teng namsau in asatlum vek uhi.
Joshua in mi nih, gam va enkhete kiang ah, "Huai kizuaknu inn ah va lut unla, akiang a na kichiamsa bang un huai numei leh aneih teng hon pikhia un," achi hi.
Enkhe mi tangvalte ava lut ua, Rahab, anu leh pa, asangamte leh aneih teng ahon pikhia ua, atanau teng leng ahon pikhia ua; Israelte giahphual polam ah a-omsak uhi.
Khopi leh asung a thil om teng mei in ahal vek ua; dangkasik, dangka-eng, sum-eng leh sik tui-um belsuan teng kia TOUPA' inn a sumkoihna ah akoih uhi.
Himahleh Joshua in Jeriko khua enkhe dia amisawlte ana humbit ziak in, Rahab kizuaknu leh aneih teng leh apa inkuante Joshua in ahinghawi vek a; Israelte lak ah tuni tan in ateng lai uhi.

Huai lai in Joshua in, Hiai Jeriko khopi hon lam nawn peuhmah TOUPA ma ah hamsiat in om hen. Asuangphum phummi ta masa leh akulhbaang kongpite tungkhemi ta tumpen leng hamsiat in om hen, chi in amaute ahilh chiatchiat hi.
Joshua kiang ah TOUPA a-om a; gam pumpi ah amin hong thangta hi.
Himahleh Israel suante hamsiat thilte ah ahong talekta ua, Judah nam a Zerah tapa Zabdi, huai tapa Karmi, huai tapa Akan in hamsiat thilte ana la a, Israel suante tung ah TOUPA ahehta hi.
Joshua in Jeriko a pan Bethel suahlam Beth-Aven chin a om Ai ah mi asawl a, akiang uah, "Va hohtou unla, gam va enkhia un," chi in agen hi. Mite ava hohtou ua, Ai khua ava enkhia uhi.

Joshua kiang ah akik nawn ua, akiang ah, "Mi tengteng hohtou chitchiat kei uhen. Mi sangnih hiam sangthum hiam va hohtou uhenla, Ai khua dou le uh. Mi tengteng va hihgim chitchiat ding ahi kei; tawmchik kia lah ahi ngal ua," achi uhi.
Huchi in mipi lak a mi sangthum huai ah ahohtou ua, Aite ma ah ahong taikek uhi.
Aite'n mi sawmthum-le-guk ana that ua; kulhbaang kongpi chin a pan Sebarim pha hial in adelh ua, akumsukna ah athat uhi. Huaiziak in mite lungtang azul khin a, tui bang ahong hita hi.
Joshua in apuante abotkek a, TOUPA bawm ma ah amah leh Israel upate amai ua lei si in nitaklam tan in abokkhup uhi. Alu uah leivui abuak uhi.

Joshua in, “Maizen! Toupa PATHIAN aw, bang ding in ahia, hiai mipite hihmanthat dia, Amorte khut a piak dia, Jordan lui na pi galkai mahmah? Jordan lui gal ah lungkimtak in om hiathiat zaw mai le ung!
TOUPA aw, hichi a melmate delh a Israelte ataikek mawk uh bang ka lohta dia oi?
Kanaante leh hiai gam a tengte'n aza ding ua, ahon um ding ua, lei a pan ka min uh hihmangthang ding ahita ve ua. Na min thupi bang na chihta dia le?" achi hi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Thou in, Bang achia bokkhup nilouh na hia?
Israelte'n thil ahihkhial ua; zuih dia ka piak ka thukhun ah atalek ua, hamsiat thilte ala ua, agu nalai ua, asim iim behlap ua, amau van lak mahmah ah asimsel uhi.
Huaiziak in ahi, Israel suante'n amelmate uh zou lou a, amelmate a pan ataikek uh. Hamsiat in a-omta ua ahi. Hamsiat a om pen na lak ua pan na hihmang keileh ka hon ompih nawn kei ding.

'Thou inla, mipite hihsiangthou photmai in'. Akiang uah, zingchiang a ding in kihihsiangthou un. TOUPA Israelte' Pathian in, Israelte aw, na lak uah hamsiat thil a-om a ahi. Na lak ua pan hamsiat thil na lakmang masiah uh na melmate uh na zou thei kei ding uh.

Zingchiang in achichi a, na hong kilat ding uh ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N huai chi a na mat pen anam anam a ahong kilat ding uh ahi. TOUPA'N huai nam a na mat pen a- inkuankuan ua ahong kilat nawn ding uh ahi. TOUPA'N huai inkuan a na mat pen amalmal a ahong kilat nawn ding ahi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, kuapeuh hamsiat thil na la peuhmah, amah leh aneih tengteng mei a hal vek ding ahi. TOUPA thukhun atatleksan ziak leh Israelte lak a thil gilou haihuaitak ahih ziak in, achi," na chi ding hi.
Joshua zingkhang in athou a, Israelte achichi in ahong kilangsak a; Judah namte mat ahong hita uh.
Judah namte ahong kilangsak nawn a; Zerah namte ana man a; Zerahte inkuante amalmal in ahong kilang nawn ua; Zabdi mat ana hita.
A-inkuante amalmal in hong kilangsak nawn a; huchi in Judah chi a Zerah tapa Zabdi, huai tapa Karmi, huai tapa Akan mat ahong hita hi.
Joshua in Akan kiang ah, "Ka tapa, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian thupina pia inla; akiang ah kipuang in. Na thilhih hon hilh in. Kei kiang ah iim ke'n," achi hi.
Akan in Joshua adawng a, akiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian tung ah thil ka na hihkhialta, hichibang in ahi ka na hih:

'Gallak lak a Babulon puan hoihtak leh dangka shekel zanih leh dangka-eng tang shekel sawmnga buk ka mu a, ka enlah lua a, ka lata mai hi. Ngai in, ka puanin sung a lei a selguk ahi a, dangka pen huai nuai ah a-om,'" achi hi.
Joshua in mite asawl a, puanin sung ah ava tai ua; ngai in, apuanin ah selguk ahi ngei a, anuai ah dangka ana om hi.
Puanin sung a kipan alakhia ua, Joshua leh Israel suan tengteng kiang ah ahon tawi ua; amau TOUPA ma ah akoih uhi.

Joshua leh Israel tengteng in Zerah tapa Akan dangka, puan, dangka-eng tang, atapate, atanute, abawngtal, asabiltungte, abelamte, apuanin leh aneih tengteng toh api ua; Akor Phaizang ah apaitouhpih uhi.
Joshua in, "Bangziak a hon hihmangbang na hia? TOUPA'N tuni in nang leng ahon hihmangbang ding hi,” achi hi. Huchi in Israel tengteng in suang in adeng ua; suang a aden khit un mei in ahal uhi.
Atung ah suang achiangvum ua, tuni tan in a-om lai hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N aheh petmahna akiheisan hi. Huaiziak in huai mun min tuni tan in Akor Phaizang achi lai uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n. Galdou thei tengteng tonpih inla, thou inla, Ai ah hohtou in. Ngai in, na khut ah Ai kumpipa, amite, akhua leh agam ka hon peta hi.
Jeriko leh akumpipa uh tung a na hih bang in, Ai khua leh akumpipa tung ah leng na hih ding hi. Gallak leh gante kia nou a tuam ding in nei un. Khopi nung ah guktan un," achi hi.
Joshua leh galdou thei tengteng Ai a hohtou ding in akisata ua, huchi in Joshua in mihat hangsan singthum atelkhia a, zan in asawlkheta hi.
Akiang uah, "Ngai un, khopi nunglam ah khopi dou ding in guktan un. Khopi a pan gamla lua ah pai kei unla, mansa in om gige un.
Kei leh ka kiang a om tengteng in khopi ka hon zuan ding uh. Huan hichi ahi ding a, tuma a mah bang in hong dou dia ahong pawt chiang un, ama uah i taikek ding uh.
Hon delh ding in ahong pawt ding ua, khua a pan gamla sim i kihepkhiak tan in. Amau, Tuma a mah bang in i ma uah taikek uh e,' achi ding ua; ama uah i taikek ding uh.
Guktanna a pan na hong pawtkhe ding ua, khopi na la ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un na khut uah ahon pe ding hi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, khopi na lak chiang un, khopi na hal ding uh ahi. TOUPA thu bang zel in na hih ding uh ahi. Ngai un, thu ka hon peta," chi in thu apia hi.
Joshua in asawlkheta a, guktanna mun ah ahoh ua, Ai kho tumlam ah Bethel leh Ai kho kikal ah a-om uh. Joshua bel huai zan in mipite lak ah agiak hi.
Zingkhang in Joshua athou a, mipite akaikhawm a, amah leh Israel upate mipite ma ah Ai kholam ah ahohtou uhi.
Mi tengteng, akiang a galdou thei omte tan in ahohtou ua, ava zuan ua, khopi chin ah ahohtou ua, Ai kho mallam pang ah agiaktou uhi. Ai khua toh akikal uah phaizang a-om hi.
Mi sangnga atonpih a, khopi tumlam a Bethel leh Ai kho kikal ah aguktansak hi.
Mite, khopi mallam a sepaihte panmun leh khopi tumlam a guktan mite panmun hoihtak in asep a; Joshua huai zan in phaizang lak ah apai hi,

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ai kumpipa'n huai amuhtak in, kintak in zingkhang in athou a, huai khua a mite leh amah leh alawite tengteng toh, amun seh Arabah zawn ah Israelte dou ding in apawtta hi. Himahleh kho nunglam ah amah dou ding in guktanmi a-om uh chih athei kei hi.
Joshua leh Israel tengteng zohsa bangtak in a-om ua, gamdai lampi ah atai uhi.
Khopi a om tengteng amau delh ding in asamkhawm ua; huchi in Joshua adelh ua, khopi a pan gamla sim ah khemkhiak in a-omta uhi.
Ai ah leh Bethel ah Israelte delh lou khat leng a-om kei ua; khopi bangmah lou kal a pawtsan in Israelte adelhta uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Na teipi tawi Ai kholam nga in lik in. Na khut a hon pe ding ka hi," achi hi. Joshua in khopi lam nga in ateipi alikta hi.
Guktan mite a-omna ua kipan ahong paikhe guih ua, akhut azaktak in atai ua, khopi ah alut ua, alata ua; khua ahal pah uhi.
Aite'n anunglam uh a-et uleh, ngai in, khopi kang meikhu van lam a khutou amu ua, akoilam lam ah leng taitheihna himhim anei kei ua; gamdai a tai delhte'n ana lehdelh uhi.
Joshua leh Israel tengteng in guktan mite'n khopi alak ua, khopi meikhu paitou amuhtak un akik nawn ua, Ai mite athat uhi.
Midangte amau dou ding in khopi sung a pan ahong pawtkhia ua Israelte'n akaltehta uhi. Akhen alangkhat ah, akhen alangkhat ah a-om uhi. Huchi in athat ua, khat lel leng hawi leh khah anei kei uhi.
Ai kumpipa ahingmat ua, Joshua kiang ah ahon pi uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte'n Ai khomi gamlak a om tengteng, gamdai gam a amau ava delhna mun uah namsau in athat vek uhi. Huai khit in Israelte tengteng Ai ah akik nawn ua, asung a om tengteng namsau in ava that uhi.
Huai ni a si tengteng numei leh pasal singkhat-le-sangnih ahi ua, Ai a pasal teng asi khin vek uhi.
Joshua in lah ateipi likna khut Ai khomite tengteng ahihman keuhkeuh masiah akaikik kei hi.
TOUPA'N Joshua thu apiak a, hih dia achih bangbang in huai khopi a gante leh gallakte kia Israelte a tuam ding in atangta uhi.
Joshua in Ai khua ahal a, tangtawn a ding in leivum in abawl a, tuni tan in loihsan ahita.

Ai kumpipa nitak tan in sing dawn ah akhai a; nitum kuan in Joshua in thu apia a, huchi in aluang sing dawn a pan alakhia ua, khopi kulhbaang kongpi lutna ah apai ua, atung ah suang avum ua, tuni tan in a-om lai hi.
Joshua in Ebal tang ah TOUPA, Israel Pathian a ding in maitam adoh hi.

Mosi Dan laibu a gelhsa bang in, TOUPA sikha Mosi in Israel suante ana piaksa bang in, sek louh suangte, kuamah in sik a asek ngei nai hetlouhte in maitam abawl hi. Huai ah TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte alan a, lemna thillatte leng alan uhi.
Huai ah Israel mite muh mah in Mosi Dan gelhsa huai suangte tung ah ateisawn hi.

Israel tengteng, gamdangmi hi in, tualsungmi hitaleh avekpi un, a upate uh, amakaite uh leh vaihawmte toh TOUPA thukhun bawm sik tuak ah adingh uhi. Amau huai bawm zawng Levi siampute mai ah huai bang in adingh uhi. Amau kikimkhen in, akimkhat Gerizim tang mazawn ah adingh ua, akimkhat dang Ebal tang mazawn ah adingh uhi. TOUPA sikha Mosi in Israelte vualzawl dia thu ahilh lai in, hiai bang a hih ding in thu ana pe khinta hi.
Huai khit in Joshua in dan thu teng, vualzawlna thu leh hamse thu tengteng asim a, dan laibu a kigelh tengteng bang in asimkhia hi.
Mosi thupiak tengteng Israel omkhawm tengteng leh numeite leh naupang neuchikte leh alak ua namdang omte ma ah Joshua in sim louh himhim anei kei hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jordan gal a kumpipa tengteng, mual a omte, phaizang a omte, tuipi zatak dung teng a Lebanon pha a om tengteng, Hitte, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste'n ana zak un,
Joshua leh Israelte pheikhai khat a dou tum in akikhawm uhi.
Himahleh Gibeon khomite'n Joshua in Jeriko khua leh Ai khua abawldan ana zak un, lepchiahpil in agamtang uhi.
Palai a kibawl in ip lui pipi, uain thawl lui pipi, asesa kithuap nemnum sabiltungte a pua in mi akisawl uhi.
Khedap lui thuap nennon abun ua, puan lui pipi asilh ua, anek ding tanghoute uh gaw gemgom, ap khetkhut ngen ahi.
Gilgal giahphual ah Joshua kiang ah ava hoh ua, akiang leh Israelte kiang ah, "Gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi ua, huaiziak in tu in kou leh nou lemna thu khung ni,” achi uhi.
Israelte'n huai Hivte kiang ah, "Ka lak ua teng hi kha ni uchia; bangchi in nou toh lemna thu i khung thei dia?" achi uh.
Amau Joshua kiang ah, "Na sikhate ka hi uh," achi uhi. Joshua in akiang uah, "Kuate na hi ua? Koilam a pan hong pai na hi ua?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "TOUPA a Pathian min uh ka zak ziak un na sikhate gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi uh. Aminthandan, Aigupta gam a athilhih tengteng,
Jordan lui gal a Amorte kumpipa nihte, Heshbon gam kumpipa Sihon, Bashan gam kumpipa Astaroth a om Og tung a athilhih tengteng ka na za uhi.
Ka upate uh leh ka gam ua tengte'n ka kiang uah, 'Lampi a nek ding tawi unla, amau va houpih un,' akiang uah, 'Na sikha ka hi uh. Nou toh kilem ni, na va chi ding uh," " chi in ahon sawl uhi.
“Hiai ka nek ding uh tanghoute na kiang a hong dia ka hong pawt ni ua ka inn ua kipan asa a ka hon puak uh ahi. Himahleh tu in en dih, agaw gemgom a a-ap khetkhutta hi.
Hiai thawl uain ka thunnate uh leng athak ahi. En dih, avang khin vekta hi. Hiai ka puante uh leh ka khedapte uh leng ka hong paina uh agamla mahmah a, aluigawpta hi," achi uhi.
Mite'n atawi uh nek-le-dawn dingte achiam ua, TOUPA dong in thu akan masa kei uhi.
Huchi in Joshua in amau toh kilemna abawl a, amaute hawi ding in amau toh thu akhungta hi. Omkhawm miliante leng akiang uah akichiam uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ua thu akhun ua kipan ni thum nung in, akhopite uh amau kiangnai a teng sam ahi uh, chih atheikheta uh.
Israel suante akipankhia ua, ani thum ni in akhopite uh ava tung uhi. Akhopite uh Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth leh Kiriath-jearim ahi.
Omkhawm heutute'n TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian min lou a akiang ua ana kichiam tak ziak un, Israel suante'n akhoih kei uh. Huchi in mipi omkhawm tengteng heutute tung ah aphun uhi.
Himahleh heutu tengteng in mipi omkhawm tengtengte kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian min lou in akiang uah i na kichiamta ngal ua. Huaiziak in amaute i khoih uh siang lou ahi.
Hichibang in atung uah hih ni. I hinghawi mai ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw i tung uah thangpaihna ahong tung kha ding, akiang uah lah i na kichiam khinta ngal ua," achi uhi.
Heutute mah in akiang uah, "Hinghawi in om uhen. Himahleh omkhawm tengteng a dia sing po mite leh tui tawi mite hi uhen," achi uhi; heutute'n ana chiam khit tak sa bang un.
Joshua in amaute asamsak a, akiang uah, "Bangdia, gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi uh, chi a hon khem na hi ua? Ka kiangnai a teng sam lah na hi ngal ua.
Huaiziak in tu in hamsiat na hi uh, na lak ua mi kuamah ka Pathian inn a dia sing pomi leh tui tawimi na hihna ua pan asuakta ngei kei ding uh," achi hi.

Amau Joshua adawng ua, "TOUPA na Pathian un asikha Mosi gam pumpi nou hon pe dia, agam luahmi tengteng na ma ua kipan ahihmang zel ding ahi, chih thu ana piak, na sikhate hon na hilhchian mahmah ua; huaiziak a noute ziak a ka hinna uh mansuah lau mahmah a, hichibang a na gamta ka hi uh.
Tu in ngai in, na khut a om ka hi ua; na ngaihtuahna a hoih leh dik a na theih bang in ka tung uah hih mai in," achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante a pan Joshua in hunkhia in, athatta kei uhi.
Huai ni in Joshua in aseh bang in omkhawmte leh TOUPA maitam a dia sing po mite leh tui tawi mite in asep a, tuni tan in hiaite in apang uhi.
Mite a khopi dim sek, bangchidan a lungzuang a tu maimah ahia! Bangchidan a meithai bang a hong om maimah ahia! Namte lak a thupi sek a, bialte lak a lalnu sek, bangchidan a sikha suak maimah ahia!
Zan in nakpitak in akap a, abiang a khituite toh; a-itte tengteng lak ah amah nem ding kuamah anei kei a; alawmte tengteng atung ah lepchiahtak in agamta ua, amelmate ahong hi uhi.
Gimthuakna ziak leh, saltanna thupi ziak in saltanna ah Judah apaita hi; khovel mite lak ah ateng a, tawldamna amu kei; mun kochikte ah amah sawi tengteng in apha uhi.

Kikhopna thupi a kuamah ahong pai louh ziak un. Zion lampite'n asuun ua; akongpite tengteng loih in a-om a, asiampute athum huthut uh; anungak siangthoute gimthuak in a-om ua, amah mah haksa thuak in a-om hi.
Agalte vaihawm makai ahong hi a, melmate alohching uh; atatlekna tam luat ziak in TOUPA'N lah amah gim athuaksak ngal a; melma ma ah ata tuailaite saltanna ah apai uh.
Zion tate a pan in kilawmna tengteng apaimangta; alalte loupa hing mu lou zuktalte bang ahi ua, delhmi ma ah hatna nei lou in apai uh.

Agimthuak ni leh ahaksat ni in Jerusalem in nidanglai a kipan a om khinsa athil nuamte tengteng atheigige a; melma khut a mite apuk lai un, amah kuamah in apanpih kei, galte'n amah amu ua, asiatna ah anuihsan uhi.
Nakpitak in Jerusalem in thil ahihkhial a; huaiziak in thilnin bang in ahong om hi; avuaktanna amuh ziak un, amah zahte'n amusit ua, ahi, anak huthut a, nunglam ah akiheita hi.
Anik ah anitna a-om a; abeina nanung atheigige kei; huaiziak in lamdangtak in ahong kun a; lungmuanmi anei kei hi; ngai in, Aw TOUPA, ka gimthuakna; melmapa akiliansak hi.
Gal in amah nu gou manphate tengteng tung ah akhut azak a; amun siangthou sung ah khovel mi ahong lut chih amu ngal a, na kikhopna uah amau ahong lut louh ding uh ahi chi a thu na piak.
Amite tengteng anak huhu ua, tanghou azong ua; kha hihhalh ding in athil nuamte uh sa khenna ding in apia ua: "Thei inla, Aw TOUPA, en in ka hong buah ziak in."
Nou a ding a bangmah lou ahi maw, nou hon paisuaksante tengteng? Ngai unla, en un, ka tung a hih a om ka lungkhamna bang lungkhamna himhim a-om hiam? Aheh mahmah lai a TOUPA'N ahon hihgimna bang.
Tungsang a kipan in ka guhte ah mei ahon sawl a, amaute azou a; ka khe a ding in len azak a, ahon nungheisan; segawp leh nitum a bah in ahon bawlta hi.
Akhut a ka tatleknate hakkol khih in a-om a; phialkhawm in a-om ua, ka ngawngzang ah ahong tung ua; ka hatna avuaksuaksak; amau ka dou zohlouhte, akhut uah Toupa'n kei ahon pia hi.
Ka lak a ka mihatte Toupa'n bangmah lou in a-omsak a; ka tangvalte mekgawpna ding in ka siatna ding in ama'n kikhawmpi poimoh asam a; uain sukna bang in Toupa'n Judah tanu siangthou asikdenta hi.
Hiai thilte ziak in ka kap a; ka mit tui in atum a; lungmuan ding ka kha hihhalh ding kei a pan agamla ngal a; melma avualzoh ziak in, ka tate amau kia a nutsiat in a-om uhi.
Zion in akhutte azakkhia a; amah lungmuan ding kuamah a-om kei uh; TOUPA'N Jakob tungthu ah thu apia a, huchi a akimvel a omte agalte ahong hihna ding un; Jerusalem alak uah thilnin bang in a-om hi.
TOUPA adiktat a; athupiak ka helsan ua; himahleh za un, ka hon ngen hi, nou mi tengtengte aw, ka lungkhamna en un; ka nungak siangthoute leh ka tangvalte saltanna ah apai uhi.
Ka itte ka sam a, himahleh ahon khem uh; ka siampute leh ka upate'n amau khate hihhalh ding a an akizon lai un khopi sung ah asihloh uhi.
Aw TOUPA, ngai in; ka dah ua; ka lungsim amangbang a; ka sung ah ka lungtang akilumlet a; nakpitak in ka helta ua; polam ah namsau thah in insung ah sihna a-om hi.
Ka thum aza ua; kuamah hon khamuan ding a-om kei; ka melmate tengteng in ka mangbatna aza ua, huchibang a na hih ziak in akipak uh; na phuankhiaksa ni na tun ding a, kei bang ahi ding uh.
Agitlouhna tengteng uh na ma ah hong tung hen; ka tatlekna tengteng ziak a ka tung a na hih bang in amaute tung ah leng hih in; ka khoisatna atam lua a, ka lungtang leng abahgawpta hi.
Bangchidan a Toupa'n ahehna a Zion tanu meipi a tuam ahia! Israel kilawmna van a kipan lei ah apaikheta a, aheh ni in akhe ngakna atheigige kei hi.
Jakob tenna tengteng Toupa'n anawmvalh a, ahehpih kei; ahehna ah Judah tanu kulh hatte alaichim a, lei toh kilual in akoih hi; gam leh huai a vaihawmte ahihninta hi.
Aheh mahmahna ah Israel kii tengteng asattan a; melma ma a kipan akhut taklam alakikta; meikuang, kimvel hulbei bang in Jakob akangmangta hi.
Melma bang in athalpeu alai a, gal bang in akhut taklam toh adingh a, mit a ding a etnophuaite tengteng athat a; Zion tanu puanin ah meikuang bang in athangpaihna asungbua hi.
Toupa'n melma bang ahong hi, Israel anawmvalhta; a-inpi tengteng anawmvalh vek a, akulh muanhuaite ahihseta; Judah tanu ah suunna leh kahna apungsak hi.

Huan hileh kilawm bang in, hiamgamtak in abiakbuk alamang a; akikhopna mun ahihseta; TOUPA'N kikhawm thupi leh Sabbath Zion ah mangngilh in a-omsak a, ahehna thangpaihna in kumpipa leh siampu amusit hi.
Toupa'n amaitam apaimang a, amun siangthou akih a, a-inpi kulhbaangte melmate khut ah apeta hi; kikhop thupi ni bang in TOUPA insung ah thawm anei uhi.
Zion tanu kulhbaang TOUPA'N suksiat atumta; akhauzan a, hihse lou ding in akhut ala kei hi; himahleh leichian leh kulhbaang akapsak a; akigawp tuak uhi.
Akongpite lei ah atum ua; akalhna chiangte hihsia in akuaitan hi; dan omlouhna namte lak ah akumpipa leh alalte a-om uh; ahi, TOUPA a kipan azawlneite'n meng amu kei uhi.
Leitung ah Zion tanu upate atu ua, apau kei uh; aluzang ua leivui akhi ua; sai-ip puan asilh uhi; Jerusalem nungak siangthoute'n lei lam ah alu uh akun uhi.
Khitui in ka mitte azuau a, ka lungsim amangbang hi, leitung ah ka sin buakkhiak in a-om a, ka mite tanu siatna ziak in khopi kongzingte a naupang tuailaite leh nawi ne laite asihbup ziak un.
Anute uh kiang ah, buh-le-bal leh uain koi a om ahia? achi ua. Khopi kongzingte miliamte bang a asihbup lai un, anute uh angsung a akha uh sunbuak a a-om lai in.

Na kiang ah bang ka theisak dia? Nang toh bang ka teh dia, Aw Jerusalem tanu? Aw Zion tanu siangthou, ka hon lungmuan theihna ding in, bang toh ka hon kikimsak dia? Na siatna lah tuipi bang in athupi ngal a; kua'n nang ahon hihdam thei dia?

Na zawlneite'n bangmah lou leh haina nang a ding in mengmuh in amu ua; na koltanna pi nawn ding in, na gitlouhna amukhe kei uh; himahleh bangmah lou puakgik leh pimang a omna ziakte nang hon muhsak uh.
Hon paikheng tengteng in nang akhut uh ahon betkhum ua; Jerusalem tanu akikoukhum ua; alu uh asinkhum uh, hiai khopi kilawmna bukim, leitung pumpi a nopsakna, achih uh ahi maw? achi uhi.
Nang siatna ding in na melmate tengteng in lianpi in akam uh aka ua; hiai ni i ngakngak uh ahi mahmah ve; i mukheta a, i muta uh.
TOUPA'N alunggeli ahihtangtungta, nidanglai a athupiak ahihtangtung a; apaita, ahehpih kei; na tung a melma akipaksak a, na galte kii atawisangta hi.
TOUPA kiang ah alungtang akikou a; Aw Zion tanu kulhbaang, sun leh zan in khitui luipi bang in luangsak in; khawl kipe ke'nla; na mit khawlsak ke'n.

Thou in, zan in kikou in, anvente kipatna ah; TOUPA mai ah tui bang in na lungtang sungkhia in; na ta tuailaite hinna a ding in amah lam ah na khutte liktou in, kongzingte ah an ngawl in abahgawp uhi.
Aw TOUPA, en inla, ngai in, hichibang a na hihna; numeite'n agah uh ane ding uam, khut a oih a om naupangte? TOUPA mun siangthou sung ah siampu leh zawlnei thah a-om ding uh hia?
Kongzingte a leitual ah tuailaite leh putekte alum ua; namsau in ka nungak siangthoute leh ka tangvalte apuk uh; na heh ni in amaute na that a; na that a, na hehpih kei hi.
Kikhawmpi thupi lai bang in, mun chih ah a-unaute na sam a, TOUPA heh ni in kuamah suakta hiam, om hiam a-om kei; huai ka dontei a ka khoilette ka melma in anegaita hi.
Ahehna chiang a gimthuakna mu keimah ka hi.
Khovak ah hilou in khomial ah ama'n hon pi in, ahon vaksak hi.
Nitum in ka siatna ding in akhut ahei ahei petmah hi.
Ka sa leh ka vun a-upasak a; ka guhte akitansak hi.
Ka siatna ding in alam a, khatna leh nauveina in ahon umsuak hi.
Sawtpi a sisate bang in, mun mialte ah ahon tengsak hi.
Ka pawtkhiak theihlouhna ding in, ka kimvel in dai akai a, ka khainiang agik hi.
Ahi, ka kah a, panpihna ka nget lai in, ka thumna adaltan hi.
Suangsek in ka lampite dai akaitou a, ka lam zuihte akawisak hi.
Kei a ding in amah vompi mibuk leh mun-guk a humpinelkai bang ahi.
Ka lampite akaihei a, ahon botnen a; ahon bawlgawp hi.
Athalpeu alai a, athal a dia ngim ding in kei ahon bawl hi.
Athalbawm a thalte ka lungtang ah alutsak a,
Ka mite tengteng nuihsan ka hong hi; ni tumtum a ala uh.
Hehna in ahon dimsak ua, gamsai in ahon vak uhi.
Suangtat in ka hate leng akitamsak a, vut in ahon tuam hi.
Muanna a kipan gamlapi ah ka kha na suan a; hauhsakna ka mangngilhta.
Ka hatna amang a, TOUPA a kipan ka lametna, ka chi a.
Ka gimthuakna leh ka haksatna, gamsai leh khatna theigige in.
Ka kha in amaute atheigige a, ka sung ah akun ngiungiau hi.
Hiai ka thei thaka, huaiziak in lametna ka nei hi.
TOUPA zahngaihnate ziak ahi hihmang a i om louh uh; alainatnate azuau ngei louh ziak in.
Zingsang teng in athak zel ua; na ginomna athupi hi.
TOUPA ka tantuan ahi, ka kha in achi; huaiziak in amah ah lametna ka nei ding.
Amah ngakte kiang ah TOUPA ahoih, amah zongmi tung ah.
Mi'n TOUPA hotdamna a lamet angak vengveng ahoih hi.
Mi'n atuailai a hakkol apuak amah a ding in ahoih ahi.
Amah tung a angak tak ziak in, tangtut henla, dai sipsip hen.
Leivui ah akam koih hen; huchi a lametna a-omtheihna ding in.
Amah bengpa kiang ah abiang doh hen; kouna in amah dimvum hen.
Toupa'n lah tangtawn in adelh kei ding a.
Dahna suaksak mahleh, azahngaihna tamdan dungzui in lainatna anei ding hi.
Kilawptak in mite tate hihgim hiam lungkhamsak hiam ahi kei hi.
Lei a suangkul tangte tengteng khenuai sikkham ding,
Tungnungpen maima a mihing thuneihna kaihei ding in.
Athu a mihing bawlsiat, Toupa'n pha asa kei.
Toupa'n thu apiak louh in, hichi ahong hi, chi kua ahia?
Tungnungpen kam a kipan in hoih lou leh hoih ahong pai kei maw?
Bangziak a mihing, akhelhna gawtna a ding a mi phun ahia?
I lampite zong in enchian ni, huan TOUPA lam ah kik nawn ni.
Vante a Pathian kiang ah i lungtang leh i khutte liktou ni;
Ka tatlek ua ka hel uh; na ngaidam kei hi.
Hehna in na khuh a, kou na hon delh a, that in, na hehpih kei hi.
Meipi in na kituam a, huchi a ka thumna in apailetlouhna ding in.
Mite lak ah deih louh leh ninneng bang in na hon bawl hi.
Ka siatna ding in ka melma tengteng un akam uh lianpi in aka uh.
Launa leh kokhuk ka tung uah ahong tung a, siatgawpna leh siatna.
Ka mite tanu suksiatna ziak in, ka mit tui in atum hi.
Khawl lou in, ka mit in abuak a, akhawl kei hi.
Van a kipan TOUPA'N a-etsuk a, amuh matan
ka khopi tanute tengteng ziak in ka mit in ka kha adahsak.
Vasa bang in ahon delhbah ua, aziak bei a ka melma hite'n.
Leikohawm sung ah ka hinna asattat ua, ka tung ah suang akhia uhi.
Ka lutung ah tuite aluang a; satkhiak in ka om, ka chi hi.
Aw TOUPA, leikohawm niampen a pan in, na min ka sam hi.
Ka aw na za a; ka kahna ah, ka nakna ah na bil sel ke'n.
Nang ka hon sap ni in na hong pai nai a, "Lau ke'n!" na chỉ hi.
Aw TOUPA, ka kha thu na hon gensak a; ka hinna na tanta hi.
Aw TOUPA, ka diklouhna na mu a, ka thu ngaihtuah in.
Ka tung a aphulakna tengteng uleh athusawm tengteng uh na muta hi.
Akouna uh na za a, Aw TOUPA, ka siatna ding a athusawm tengteng uh.
Ka siatna ding a dinghte mukte leh nitum a ka siatna ding a angaihtuahna uh.
Atut uleh adintouh uh nang en in; ala uh ka hi.
Aw TOUPA, akhut nasep dungzui in, atung uah thuk in.
Lungtang lungkhamna leh na hamsia atung uah pia inla,
heh in amau na delh ding a TOUPA vante nuai a kipan amaute na hihgawp ding hi.
Bangchidan a dangka-eng mial ahia! Bangchidan a dangka-eng siangthoupen lamdangta ahia! Mun siangthou a suangte kongzingte ah sunkhiak ahi.
Zion tapa manphate, dangka-eng hoih toh teh theih, bangchidan a leibel, belvelmi khutsuak bang a ngaih hi ahia!
Sehalte nangawn in anawi uh asuah ua, ata tuailaite uh atepsak uh; gamdai ostrikte bang in ka mite tanu ahong gilou uhi.
Nawitep lai naupang lei dangtak ziak in adangtawng ah abelh a; naupangte'n tanghou angen ua, kuamah in amaute a ding in abalkham kei uhi.
Nuamtak a nete kongzing ah amangthang ua; puan sandup a khangliante'n ekvum akawi uhi.
Ka mite tanu gitlouhna gawtna Sodom khelhna gawtna sang in athupizaw a, huai tuh mitphiat kal lou in akizou a, amah tung ah khut akinga kei hi.
Amiliante vuk sang in asiangthou zaw ua, nawitui sang in angouzaw uh, rubi sandup sang in apum uh asandupzaw ua, atetna uh sapphir suangmantam bang ahi.
Amel uh suangkuangthei sang in avomzaw a; kongzing atheih in a-om kei uh; avun uh aguh uah abelh bikbek a; akeu a, chiangkang abang hi.
Namsau a thah a om dingte, kial a thah a om dingte sang in ahoihzaw uh; gam a theigahte duh ziak in hiaite lah agawnggawp un, nakpi in asia uhi.
Hehpihthei numeite khut in atate uh huan in, ka tanute hihsia in ane uhi.
TOUPA'N athangpaihna ahihpichingta, ahehna asungkhia a; Zion ah mei atoh a, huai in asuangphumte asuse vek hi.
Lei a kumpipate leh khovel a mi tengteng in leng, Jerusalem kongpi ah gal leh melma alut ding uh, chih.
Azawlneite khelhna ziak leh asiampute ginatlouhna ziak ahi, huchibang a alaktak a midikte sisan suah a a-om.
Mittawte bang in kongzing ah avakvai ua, sisan a suknit in a-om ua, mite'n apuante uh alawng kei uh.
"Paimang un, Siangloute! Paimang un, paimang un! Hon lawng kei un," chi in amau akikoukhum ua; ataimang ua, avialvak lai un, mite'n namte lak ah, hiai ah a-om nawn kei ding uh, achi uh.
TOUPA hehna in amaute ahawmzak a; amaute alimsak nawnta kei ding; siampute min azahtak kei ua, upate adeihsak kei uh.
Koute mitte avaigawp a, huhna mu lou in; lametna i ngak uah nam hon hondam thei lou ding i ngak uhi.
I kongzingte ua i pai theihlouhna ding in, i kalsuante azong ua; i tawp uh anai a, i nite akimta; i tawp uh lah ahong tungta.
Van a muvanlaite sang in ei hon delhte akinzaw uh; mual tung ah hon delh ua, gamdai ah ahon na buk uhi.
I nakvangte a hu, TOUPA thaunilh, akokhuk ua lak in a-om ua; amah thu gen in. Alimnuai a namte lak ah i hing ding, i chi uhi.
Nuamsa inla kipak in aw Edom tanu, Uz gam a teng; nou lah nang pha in leng ahong paisuak ding; na kham ding a vuaktang in na kibawl ding.
Aw Zion tanu, na thulimlouhna gawtna zoh ahita; saltanna ah nang ahon pimang nawn kei ding; na thulimlouhna in ahong veh ding, Aw Edom tanu; na khelhnate amukhe ding hi.
Theigige in, Aw TOUPA, ka tung ua hong tung; ahon kouna uh en inla, mu in.
Ka gouluah uh mikhual kiang a hei ahi a, ka innte uh gamdang mite lam ah.
Tagah leh pabei ka hi ua, ka nute uh meithai bang ahi uh.
Ka tui dawn ding uh sum in ka lei ua; ka singte uh kou lak a zuak in a-om hi.
Ka ngawngzang uah kou hon delhte a-om ua, ka bah ua, khawlna ka nei kei uh.
Aiguptate leh Assuriate kiang ah, tanghou a lungkim ding in ka kipia uh.
Ka pipute uh akhial ua, a-om kei uh; agitlouhna uh kou ka pua uh.
Sikhate'n ka tung uah vai ahawm ua; akhut ua kipan kou hon tankhe ding kuamah a-om kei uh.
Ka hinna uh lauthawnna toh ka tanghou uh ka mu ua gamdai namsau ziak in.
Thuk bang in ka vun uh avom a nakpitak a kialna ziak in.
Zion a numeite asual ua, Judah khopite a nungakte.
Akhut un lalte khailup in a-om ua, upa melte zahtak in a-om kei hi.
Tangvalte'n khawl apua ua, naupangte sing nuai ah akisui uh.
Kongpi a kipan upate akhawl ua, alasakna ua kipan in tangvalte akhawl uh.
Ka lungtang kipahna uh atawp a, ka lamna uh dahna asuak hi.
Ka lu ua kipan ka lallukhu uh akia a, ka khelh ziak un, ka tung uh agik hi!
Hiai ziak in ka lungtang uh abah a; hiai thilte ziak in ka mitte uh amial hi.
Hihsiat a om, Zion Tang ziak in; sehalte atung ah avak uh.
Aw TOUPA, nang tangtawn in na om gige; na laltutphah khang khat a kipan in khang khat tan in a-om hi.
Bangziak a tangtawn a hon mangngilh a, hichi tantan hon nungngatsan na hia?
Nang lam hon ngasak in, Aw TOUPA huchi in bawlhoih nawn in ka om ding uh; nidanglai bang in ka nite uh thaksak in,
ka tung ua heh lua a, hon pum nawlkhin na hih kei ngalleh.
TOUPA'N Mosi asam a, kihoupihna biakbuk a pan ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na lak ua kuapeuh in TOUPA kiang a thillat na lat un, ganhon, bawnghon leh belamhon lak ate, na lat ding uh ahi," achi hi.
"Athillat pen ganhon lak ate halmang thillat ahihleh apa, gensiatbei alat ding ahi. Amah TOUPA ma a pom ahihtheihna ding in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah alan ding ahi".
Haltum thillat lutung ah akhut akoih dia; huchi in amah a ding in lemna bawlna dia pomsak ahi ding.
TOUPA ma ah bawngtal agou dia; Aaron tapa, siampute'n asisan alan ding ua, sisan in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a maitam atheh ding uhi.
Haltum thillat vun alip dia, asemnen ding ahi.
Siampu Aaron tapate'n maitam ah mei akoih ding ua, mei tung ah sing achiangkhawm ding uhi.
Aaron tapa siampute'n sabakte, alute leh athaute maitam a mei tung ah sing ah kilawmtak in akoih ding uhi.
Asungkuate leh akhete tui in asil ding ua; siampu in TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ding in apum in maitam ah ahal ding ahi.
“Athillat, halmang thillat ding aganhon lak ate, belam hiam, kel hiam ahihleh apa, gensiatbei alan ding ahi".
Maitam sik, mallam pang ah TOUPA ma ah agou dia; Aaron tapa, siampute'n maitam kimvel in sisan atheh ding uhi.
Asem ding a, alu toh, athau toh; siampu in maitam tung a mei tung a sing tung ah akoih hoih ding hi.
Asungkuate leh akhete tui in asil dia; apum in siampu in alan dia, maitam ah ahal ding hi. TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ahi.
“TOUPA a dia thillat vasa lam halmang thillat ahihleh athillat ah vakhute hiam, vapalnoute hiam alan ding ahi".
Siampu in maitam ah ahon tawi dia, alu ahektan dia, maitam ah ahal ding. Asisan maitam pang ah atakkangsak ding ahi.
Agongkholh amul toh alakhe dia, maitam kiang, suahlam pang a meivu koihna mun ah apai ding hi.
Akhate abottol dia, atak botzak lou in siampu in maitam a mei tung ah ahal ding; huai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ahi.
Huan Aaron tapa Nadab leh Abihute'n amei lakna uh ala tuak ua, huai ah mei-am akoih ua, gimlim abuak ua, TOUPA thupiak louhpi in Ama ah mei zat louh chi alan uhi.
TOUPA ma a pan mei ahong pawtkhia a, amau akanglum a, TOUPA ma ah asita uhi.
Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, “Kei hon naih mite ah ka siangthou ding a, mipi tengteng ma ah thupisak in ka om ding, chi a TOUPA'N agentak hiai ahi,” achi a, Aaron adai dide hi.
Mosi in Aaron paneu Uzziel tapate, Mishael leh Elzaphan asam a, akiang uah, "Mun siangthou mai a pan giahphual polam ah na unaute uh pokhia un," achi hi.
Amau ahong pai nai ua, Mosi gen bang in a-unaute uh puanaktual in giahphual polam ah apokhia uh.

Mosi in Aaron kiang ah leh atapa Eleazar leh Ithamar kiang ah, "Na sam uh khah kei unla, na puante uh leng botkek kei un, huchi lou in zaw na si kha ding ua; mi tengteng tung ah TOUPA athangpai kha ding. Himahleh na unaute uh leh Israel inkote teng in ahihleh TOUPA'N mei a ahihmanthatte asuun thei ding uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin kongpi a pan na pawt ding uh ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na si ding uh. TOUPA sathau nilhchi na tung uah a-om ngal a," achi hi. Huchi in Mosi thu bang in ahihta uhi.
TOUPA'N Aaron ahoupih a,

"Nang hiam, na tapate hiam in leng, kihoupihna biakbuk sung a na lut chiang un, zu leh dawn theih hat himhim dawn kei un, huchi lou in zaw na si ding uh. Hiai na suan zelte uh tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
Huai bel asiangthou leh siangthou lou, asiang leh siang lou na khentheihna ding uleh;
TOUPA'N Mosi zang a akiang ua agen, thupiak tengteng Israel suante na sinsak theihna ding uh ahi," achi hi.

Mosi in Aaron kiang ah leh atapa dam lai Eleazar leh Ithamar kiang ah, "TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a tangbuang thillat lat bangte la unla, maitam bul ah silngou tel lou in ne un; hiai thil siangthoupen ahi ngal a.
TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a nang a tuam leh na tapate a tuam ahih ziak in mun siangthou ah na ne ding uhi. Huchibang a thupiak a om ka hi.
A-awm vei leh aliang taklam vei pen mun siang ah na ne ding uh; nang leh na tapate leh na tanute toh; Israel suante lemna thillat kithoihna nang a tuam leh na tapate a dia seh ahi ngal a.

Aliang vei leh a-awm vei pen TOUPA ma a vei thillat dia vei ding in mei a thillat thau toh ahon tawi ding uh ahi. Huai nang leh na tapate toh, tangtawn a nou a tuam ding ahi; TOUPA thupiak bang in," achi hi.
Mosi in khelh thoihna kel pen ngenteltak in azong a, ngai dih, ana hal khin tham uh ahi a; huchi in Aaron tapa dam lai, Eleazar leh Ithamar tung ah ahehta hi.
"Bangziak a khelh thoihna mun siangthou a ne lou na hi ua? Thil siangthou, mipi omkhawmte thulimlouhna po dia TOUPA ma a lemna bawlsakna dia nou ahon piak ahi ngal a.
Ngai dih ua, asisan pen mun siangthou ah laklut ahi kei a, thu ka hon piak bang a mun siangthou a na nek ngeingei ding uh ahi,” achi hi.

Aaron in Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai dih, tuni in TOUPA ma ah akhelh thoihna uh leh ahalmang thillat uh alan uhi. Hichibang thilte lah ka tung ah ahong omta ngal a; tuni in khelh thoihna ana ne taleng, TOUPA mitmuh in pom in a-om dia hia?" achi hi.
Mosi in huai azak in alungkimta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih unla, leitung a gamsa tengteng lak a na nek ding uh gamsa hiaite ahi uh.
Gamsa khechin nih a ka paisuak, eknel hai peuhmah na ne thei ding uh.
Himahleh eknel hai hiam, khechin nih a ka paisuak hiam lak ah hiaite zaw na ne ding uh ahi kei. Sangawngsau in eknel haileh leng, achin akat louh ziak in; nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
Zupi, eknel ahai na a, himahleh achin akat louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
Zusapi, eknel ahai na a, himahleh achin akat louh ziak in, nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
Vok, achin aka paisuak na a, himahleh eknel ahai louh ziak in; nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
Asa uh na ne ding uh ahi kei, aluang uh leng na khoih ding uh ahi kei, nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
"Tui sung a tengte lak ah hiaite na ne thei ding uh: Tuipite leh luite a om kha leh lip nei photphot na ne thei ding uhi.
Tui sung a tengte leh tui a thil hing om tengteng lak ah tuipi ate, lui ate, kha leh lip nei lou photphot nou a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
Nou a ding in thilkihhuai ahi ding ua; asa uh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Aluangte uh thilkihhuai a na neih ding uh ahi.
Tui a kha leh lip nei lou photphot zaw nou a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
"Vasa lak ah hiaite thilkihhuai a na neih ding uh ahi a; nek ding ahi kei. Thilkihhuai ahi uh: muvanlai, musane leh tuivapi.
Muvompi leh musi chi himhimte.
Va-ak leh achi himhimte.
Simbu, vabak, tuipi vasate leh mu chi himhimte.
Simbutanglip, ngagal leh simbupi.
Tuivapi, vabukngak leh musanepi,
Intung vasa, dil vasa leh achi himhim, huihtun leh bakte.
"Kha nei khe li a pai chi peuhmah nou a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
Himahleh aleng thei ganhing neu pawl khat na nek theih ding uh a-om. Huaite ahihleh lei lak a tawm thei kheguh tang neite ahi uhi.
Hiaite lak a na nek theih dingte uh, khaupe chí himhim, kelkum, khuangbai ahihkeileh khaukhup.
Himahleh kha nei, khe li nei dangte peuhmah nou a ding in kihhuai ahi vek uhi.
"Hiaite ziak in siang lou na suak thei uhi. Kuapeuh hiai ganhing siang lou sisa toh kisukha peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Kuapeuh huai luang lami peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
Gamsa chin ka paisuak lou, eknel leng hai lou chi tengteng nou a ding in siang lou ahi ua; kuapeuh huaite khoih siang lou ahi ding.
Bokvak a pai tengteng lak a khebom a pai peuhmahte nou a ding in siang lou ahi a; aluang uh khoih peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Aluang lami peuhmah in apuante asawp ding ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding a; nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
"Lei a vakthoh chi lak a nou a dia siang lou hiaite ahi: Bui, chikpi, thankikpi leh achi himhim.
Inhik, tangteuh, thankik, dokdawn leh zusa.
Avakthoh chi tengteng lak a nou a dia siang lou hiaite ahi uh. Kuapeuh hiaite sisa akhoih uleh nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.

Asih ua bangpeuh adelhkhum uh, siang lou ahi dia; vanzat photphot sing a bawl tui-um belsuan hiam, puan hiam, savun hiam, sai-ip hiam leng tui a diah ding ahi a; nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding. Huai khit in ahong siang ding hi.
Akiakna peuh leibel chih na hihtam ding uh ahi, asung a om tengteng siang lou ahi ding uh.
Huai bel a nek chi om tengteng leh huai a om tui a diahsa himhim siang lou ahi dia; dawn chi, dawn theih chi tengteng leng huai bel sung a om himhim siang lou ahi ding.

Thil bangpeuh asiluang a kahiang khatpeuh in adelhkhum phot siang lou ahi zel dia; tanghou kanna hiam, kan lumna bel hiam leng hihtap vek ding ahi, siang lou ahi khin a, nou a ding in siang lou ahi ding.
Himahleh tuikhuk hiam, tuibem, tui tamtak omna siang lou chih a-om kei, himahleh asiluang in asuk khak peuhmah siang lou ahi ding.
Chin ding haichi himhim zaw siluang in bang lai peuh in delhkhum taleh asiang lou kei hi.
Himahleh haichi, tui a diahsa siluang in koi lai peuh adelh khakleh nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
"Gamsa na nek theih chi himhim uh leng asihleh aluang khoihmi peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Asa ne peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding. Aluang lami in leng apuante asawp ding ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
"Ganhing leitung a bokvak chi tengteng thilkihhuai ahi ua, nek ding ahi kei.
Akitholh chi leh khe li a pai chi hiam, khe tampi nei chi hiam, leitung a bokvak chi himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei, thilkihhuai ahi ngal ua.
Bokvak chi himhim in na kihihthanghuai ding uh ahi kei, hiaite in na kihihbuah ding uh ahi kei, huaite in siang lou in na kibawl ding uh ahi kei hi.
Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a; huaiziak in, kisiangsak unla, siangthou in om un; kei lah ka siangthou ngal a. Leitung a teng, abok a vak, abangchi mah in kihihbuah kei un.
Na Pathian uh hi ding a Aigupta gam a kipan noute hon pikhia TOUPA lah ka hi ngal a. Kei ka siangthou a, huaiziak in, nou leng na siangthou ding uh ahi.
"Hiai pen gamsa leh vasate leh tui a teng chi thil hing chiteng leh lei a bokvak chitengte tungthu a dan ding ahi.
Asiang leh siang lou khenna ding leh gamsa nek theih chi leh gamsa nek theih louh chi khenna ding in, chi in,” achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah, numei in nau apai a, tapa aneihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; numei dan ngeina hun lai a asian louh bang in siang lou ahi ding hi.
Ani giat ni in atapa zekmong vun asum ding ahi.
Sisan ziak a kisiangsak in ni sawmthum-le-thum a-om lai ding ahi. Akisiansak ni akim mateng thilsiang himhim akhoih ding ahi kei a; mun siangthou ah leng alut ding ahi sam kei hi.
"Nau numei aneihleh bel numei dan ngeina hun lai a asian louh bang in nipikal nih sung siang lou ahi dia, sisan ziak a kisiangsak in ni sawmguk- le-guk a-om lai ding ahi.

"Tapa hiam, tanu hiam ziak a kisiansak ni akim chiang in halmang thillat ding in belamnou kum khat a upa leh khelh thoihna ding in vapalnou hiam, vakhu hiam kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah siampu kiang ah ahon tawi ding ahi:
Ama'n TOUPA ma ah alan ding a, kilemna abawlsak dia, huchi in asisan pawtna a pan asiang ding. Hiai pen pasal hiam, numei hiam neinu a dia dan ahi.

"Aneih in belamnou achin keileh vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam atawi ding ahi: Khat halmang thillat ding in, akhat pen khelh thoihna ding in. Siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding, chi in gen in," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
"Mi vun a, akhem hiam, abol hiam, phak hileh kilawm akimuhleh siampu Aaron kiang ah hiam, atapa siampute lak a kua pen hiam kiang api ding ahi.
Siampu in avun a hii pen ana en dia, ahii omna amul akan a, ahii pen avun sang a thukzaw a akimuhleh phak ahi a, siampu in amah ana en dia, misiang lou in apuang ding ahi.
Avun a bolte akan a, avun sang a thukzaw a akimuh keileh, amul akan keileh hii nei mi pen siampu in ni sagih sung akhumtuam ding hi.
Siampu in ani sagih ni in amah a-en dia; ngai dih, ahii pen angeingei a amuh a, ahii pen avun a azamzak keileh siampu in ni sagih mah akhumtuam nawn ding hi.
Siampu in ni sagih ni in a-en nawn dia; ngai dih, hii pen amial a, hii pen avun a azamzak keileh siampu in asiang chih apuang ding ahi. Akhem lel ahi a, apuante asawp dia, ahong siang ding hi.
Himahleh asiansakna ding a siampu aki-etsak nung a akhem pen avun a azamzak luatleh siampu aki-ensak nawn ding ahi:
Siampu in a-en dia, ngai in, akhem pen avun a azamzakleh siampu in siang lou chih apuang dia, hiai phak ahi.
"Mi'n phak hii avomleh siampu kiang a pi ding ahi;
Siampu in ana en dia, ngai dih, avun a akang a-om khiak a, amul akansak a, abawk dulh hethutleh,
asa a phak kumlui om ahi a, siampu in siang lou ahi chih apuang dia, himahleh amah siang lou ahih ziak a khumtuam ding ahi kei hi.
Aphak pen avun a azamzak mahmah a, ahii veimi vun, alu a pan akhe tan a siampu theih chiang phak in abopleh, siampu'n a-en ding hi.
Ngai dih, phak in asa tengteng abop suaksa ahihleh, hii veimi asiang chih apuang dia, akang khinta a, asiangta hi.
Himahleh asa adulh hethutleh, siang lou ahi dia,
Siampu in asa dulh hethut a-en dia, siang lou in apuang ding hi. Sa dulh hethut pen siang lou ahi a, phak ahi.
Himahleh sa dulh hethut pen ana lamdan nawn a, ana kan nawnleh siampu kiang ah ahoh ding hi.
Siampu in ana en dia; ngai dih, ahii akanleh siampu in hii veimi asiang lou kei chih apuang ding hi. Amah asiangta hi.
"Asa leh avun a om meimatum ahi a, adamta hi.
Ameimatum omna mun ana kan a na san hiam, kang san deuh a na bol hiam ahihleh, siampu in a-et ding ahi.
Siampu in ana en dia, ngai dih, avun sang a thukzaw a akimuh a, amul akanleh siampu in siang lou in apuang ding ahi: phak hii ahi a, meimatum hong suakkhia ahi.
Himahleh siampu in ana et a, ngai dih, mul kang a-om louh a, amial sim phet ahihleh, siampu in ni sagih akhumtuam ding a:
Avun a azamzakleh siampu in siang lou in apuang ding hi.
Himahleh abol ngou pen a-omna ngei a om a, azamzak keileh meimatum pawn lel ahi a; siampu in asiangthou chih apuang ding ahi.
"Ahihkeileh avun polna mun asa a-om a, akang hiam, asan sim hiam ahihkeileh angouleh,

siampu in ana en dia, ngai dih, apolna laitak a mul pen akan a, huchi avun sang a thukzaw a akimuhleh phak ahi a, meikat ahong omkhia phak ahi a, siampu in siang lou in apuang ding ahi, hiai phak hii ahi.
Himahleh siampu in ana et a, ngai dih, apol a mul kang om lou a, avun sang a thuk lou zaw a, mial deuh lel ahihleh siampu in ni sagih akhumtuam ding ahi.
Siampu in ni sagih ni in amah a-en dia, avun a azamzak luatleh siampu in asiang lou in apuang ding hi, hiai phak hii ahi.
Apol pen a-omna ngei a ana omdet a, vun a azamzak keileh, mial deuh lel ahihleh meikat bawk lel ahi a, siampu in asiang chih apuang ding ahi; meikang pawn lel ahi.
"Numei hiam, pasal hiam in alu ah hiam, akhamul lak ah hiam hii aveileh
Siampu in hii pen ana en dia; ngai dih, avun sang a thukzaw a akimuh a, amul eng ngattak a-omleh siampu in siang lou in apuang ding ahi; meima sungtum ahi a, alu hiam akhamul hiam phak ahi.
Siampu in meima sungtum hii pen a-et a, ngai dih, avun sang a thuk lou zaw a akimuh a, amul vom a-om keileh siampu in meima sungtum hii veimi pen ni sagih akhumtuam ding hi.
Ni sagih ni in siampu in hii a-en dia, ngai dih, meima sungtum azamzak louh a, mul eng a-om keileh, meima sungtum a vun sang a thukzaw a akimuh keileh,
met ding ahi a, meima sungtum laitak bel amet ding ahi kei; siampu in meima sungtum neimi ni sagih dang akhumtuam nawn ding ahi.

Ni sagih ni in siampu in meima sungtum a-en nawn dia; ngai dih, meima sungtum pen avun a azak louh a, avun sang a thukzaw a akimuh keileh, siampu in siang in apuang ding ahi. Huchi in apuante asawp dia, ahong siangta ding hi.
Himahleh meima sungtum pen akisiansak nung a, avun a azamzak luatleh,
siampu in amah ana en dia, ngai dih, meima sungtum pen avun a, azamzakleh, siampu a ding in mul eng zon akiphamoh chitchiat kei ding; amah siang lou ahi.
Himahleh meima sungtum pen angeingei a amuh a, mul vom apouleh, meima sungtum adamta ahi a, amah a siang a, siampu in asiang, chih apuang ding hi.
"Numei hiam, pasal hiam, avun ah pol, pol ngou kilhkelh ana omleh,
siampu in a-en dia, ngai dih, avun a pol pen mialngou sim lel ahihleh pol lel ahi a, vun a hong suak ahi a, amah asiang hi.
Asam pulhsiang mi lugiau ahi; himahleh amah asiang hi.
Asip sam apulh siangleh talkolh ahi a, himahleh amah asiang hi.
Himahleh lugiau hiam, talkolh hiam ah, hii san sim a ngou a-omleh, alugiau hiam, atalkolh hiam phak ahi.
Huchi in siampu in ana en dia, ngai dih, alugiau hiam, atalkolh hiam a hii hong bawkkhia pen asan simleh ngou sim hethut a, avun a phak bang akimuhleh,
amah phak ahi a, siang lou ahi. Siampu in siang lou a apuan ngeingei ding ahi, alu ah phakna a-om hi.
"Phak hii veimi puante bohkek ahi dia, asamte khah ahi dia, amuk tunglam atuam dia, siang lou, siang lou, chi in akikou ding ahi.
Phak in abop sung teng siang lou ahi dia; siang lou ahi a, atengtuam dia; giahphual pua ah ateng ding hi.
"Phak hii omna puansilh, samul puan hiam, khauzang ngat puan hiam;
agatthoh hiam, aphanthoh hiam; khauzang ngat hiam, samul hiam, savun hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam; savun hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam, savun hiam,
gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam ahing sim hiam a adawkkhiakleh, phak hii ahi a, siampu in a-en ding hi.
Siampu in hii a-en dia, hii omna ni sagih akhumtuam ding hi.
Ni sagih ni in hii a-en dia, hii pen puansilh, gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, savun ah hiam, bang ding peuh a leng azat uh savunte ah hiam, azamleh hii pen phakkip mahmah chi ahihleh siang lou ahi.
Puansilh, gatthoh hiam, phanthoh hiam, samul hiam, khauzang ngat hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim hiam, phak omna peuhmah hal ding ahi; phakkip mahmah chi ahi ngal a, hal ngeingei ding ahi.
"Siampu in ana et a, huchi a, ngai dih, puansilh, gat hiam, phan hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim ah leng hii pen azam keileh
hii omna siampu in sawp ding thu ape dia, ni sagih dang akhumtuam nawn ding hi.

Hii omna sawp ahih khit nung in siampu in ana en nawn dia, ngai dih, huai hii latdan akikhek keileh hii pen zam kei mahleh, asiang tuan kei, mei a na hal ding ahi; akipchi ahi, asunglam hiam, apolam hiam agiauleh leng.
Siampu in ana et a, huchi a, ngai dih, sawp khit nung a mial sim lel ahihleh puansilh a pan hiam, savun a pan hiam, gat a pan hiam, phan a pan hiam abotkhe ding ahi.
Puansilh pen, gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, savun bawl ah hiam alat lailai leh ahong pawt nawn ahi a; hii omna pen na hal ding ahi.
Puansilh, gat hiam, phan hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl chi himhim hiam na sawp a, hii in anutsiatleh sawp nawn ding ahi a, huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
"Hiai bel, puansilh samul hiam, khauzang ngat hiam, gat hiam, phan hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim hiam a phak hii om asian leh sian louh puanna dan ding ahi," chi in.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hiai phak siansak ni a hihdan ding ahi. Siampu kiang a pi ding ahi.
Huchi in siampu giahphual pua ah apaikhe dia; siampu in a-en dia, ngai dih, phakmi pen aphakna hii adamleh
siampu in akisiangsak ding mi vasa hing siang nih, sidar sing, khauzang san leh hissop tawisak ding in thu ape ding hi.
Siampu in vasa khat pen leibel ah luitui tung ah goh ding in thu ape ding hi.
Vasa hing pen ala dia, sidar sing, khauzang san, hissop toh luitui luang tung a gohsa vasa sisan ah adiah vek ding hi.
Phakna a pan a kisiangsak ding mi sagihvei atheh dia, asiang chih apuang ding, huchi in vasa hing pen gamlak ah akhah ding hi.
Akisiangsak ding mi'n apuante asawp dia, akimetmai vek dia, akisil ding ahi. Huchi in ahong siang dia, huai khit chiang in giahphual ah ahoh dia, himahleh apuanin pua ah ni sagih a-om lai ding hi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, ani sagih ni in alu a sam tengteng leh akhamul leh amitkhu multe ametmai dia, amul tengteng ametmai ding hi. Apuante asawp in akisil dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.

"Ani giat ni in belamnoupa nih gensiatbei leh belamnounu khat gensiatbei, kum khat a upa leh tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nel mahmah ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum sathau a mek leh sathau thawl khat atawi ding ahi.
Asiangsakpa siampu in kisiangsak ding mi leh huai thilte kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah akoih ding hi.
Siampu in belamnoupa khat pen sathau log khat toh ala dia, tatlek thoihna ding in alan dia, TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding in avei ding hi.

Khelh thoihna leh halmang thillat agoh zelna mun uh, mun siangthou ah belamnoupa pen agou dia, khelh thoihna siampu a tuam ahih bang in tatlek thoihna leng siampu a tuam ahi; hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
Siampu in tatlek thoihna sisan ala dia, kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam mongte, akhut taklam khutpite, ataklam khepite siampu in anuh ding hi.
Sathau log khat pen siampu in ala dia, amah khutpek veilam ah asung ding hi.
Siampu in akhut veilam a sathau ah akhut taklam zung adiah ding a, TOUPA ma ah akhutzung in sathau sagihvei atheh ding.
Akhut a sathau om lai teng in kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi ah tatlekna kithoihna sisan tung ah anuh ding hi.
Siampu in akhut a om lai teng in kisiangsak ding mi lu anuh dia; huchi in siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi.
"Siampu in khelh thoihna alan dia, asianlouhna a pan kisiangsak ding mi pen kilemna abawlsak dia; huai khit in halmang thillat agou ding hi.
Siampu in halmang thillat leh tangbuang thillat maitam ah alat ding asiam a, siampu in kilemna abawlsak ding a, huchi in ahong siang ding hi.

"Mizawng ahih a, hiaite aneih zoh keileh, belamnoupa khat tatlek thoihna, kilemna bawlsakna dia vei ding leh tangbuang thillat dia tangbuang nel mahmah ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat, sathau a zut, sathau log khat toh atawi ding ahi.
Vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam, aneih zoh lamlam; khat khelh thoihna ding, khat pen halmang thillat ding ahi ding hi.
Ani giat ni in akisiansakna ding in siampu kiang ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah ahon tawi ding ahi.
Huchi in siampu in tatlek thoihna belamnou leh sathau log khat ala dia, vei thillat ding in TOUPA ma ah siampu in avei ding ahi.
Tatlek thoihna belamnou pen agou dia; siampu in tatlek thoihna sisan ala dia, kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi anuh ding hi.
Siampu in sathau amah khutpek veilam ah asung ding ahi.
Siampu in akhut veilam a sathau khenkhat akhut taklam in TOUPA ma ah sagihvei atheh ding ahi.
Siampu in akhut a sathau in kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi, akhe taklam khepi leh tatlek kithoihna sisan tungtak ah anuh ding hi.
Siampu in akhut a sathau om lai teng in TOUPA ma a kilemna bawlsak ding in kisiangsak ding mi lu anuh ding hi.
Vakhu hiam, vapalnou hiam, aneih zoh lamlam khat alan dia;
aneih zoh lamlam, khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in khat, tangbuang thillat toh. Huchi in siampu in kisiangsak ding mi a ding in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding hi.
Hiai bel phak hii vei, kisiansakna dan bang a chinloute a dia dan ahi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
"Luah dia ka hon piak Kanaan gam na lut chiang ua, na luah ding uh gam a inn khat a phak hii ka koihleh,
Huai inn neitu in, hiai inn ah hii hileh kilawmtak omleh kilawm ka sa, chi in siampu ahong hilh ding ahi.
Siampu in hii a-en dia, alut ma in insung hihvuak ding in siampu in thu ape dia, hiai insung a thil om tengteng siang lou ahi ding hi; huai nung in siampu insung en ding in alut ding ahi.
Ama'n hii a-en dia, ngai dih, hii in ahinglam sim hiam asanlam sim hiam a baang anekkuak a, baang sang a niamzaw a akimuhleh,
siampu inn a pan kongpi ah apawt dia, ni sagih sung huai inn akhak ding ahi.
Ani sagih ni in siampu'n inn ava en nawn dia, ngai dih, hii pen huai inn baang a ana zamzakleh;
siampu in huai hii omna suang pen lakhia a, khopi polam a ninpaihna mun a paih ding in thu ape ding hi,
Insung lam akiatsiangsak kimvel dia, suang zutbitna a kiatkhiak leivui pen dainawl mun nin ah asung ding uhi.
Suang dang ala ding ua, huai suangte mun ah akoih ding ua; suang zutbitna dang ala ding ua, inn ahu ding uhi.
"Suang alakkhiak a, inn akiat-siang a, ahuk khit nung a hii ahong dawk nawnleh, siampu ava lut dia, ava en nawn ding hi.
Ngai dih, hii ana zamzakleh huai inn a phak akipchi ahi a, siang lou ahi.
Huai inn aphel dia, asuang, asing leh asuang zutbitna teng leng dainawl mun nin ah anawnkhe vek ding ahi.
Kuapeuh huai inn khak ahih sung himhim alut taphot nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding hi.
Kuapeuh huai inn a lum taphot in apuante uh asawp ding ua; kuapeuh huai inn a an ne taphot in apuante uh asawp ding uh ahi.
"Siampu alut a, a-et kimvel a, ngai dih, huai inn hukbit ahih nung a, hii azamzak keileh, inn asiang chih siampu in apuang ding; hii pen akikhinmang tak ziak in.
Inn siansakna ding in vasa nih leh sidar sing leh khauzang san leh hissop atawi ding hi.
Vasa khat pen leibel ah luitui luang tung ah agou ding hi.
Sidar sing, hissop, khau san leh vasa hing pen ala dia, vasa gohsa sisan ah leh luitui ah adiah ding hi.
Vasa sisan, luitui luang, vasa hing pen, sidar sing, hissop leh khau san in huai inn asiangsak ding ahi.
Vasa hing pen khua a pan gamlak ah kilemna bawlna ding in alengkhesak dia; huchi in huai inn asiangsak ding a, ahong siang ding hi.
"Hiai pen phak hii chi chih leh meima sunglut tungthu a dan ahi;
puan a-omleh innte a om phak a ding;
chibawk, khem, pol leh chikang chihte toh kisai a,
sianlouhna hun leh sianna hun a sinsak ding, phak dan ahi," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupihua,
Israel suante houpih unla, akiang uah, 'Mi kuapeuh sa a thil apawtleh athilpawt ziak in siang lou ahi.
Athilpawt sung teng siang lou ahi a, asa ah apawt gige hiam, apawt atawpta hiam leng hitaleh, amah siang lou himhim ahi.
Thilpawtmi lupna peuhmah siang lou ahi dia; atutna peuhmah leng siang lou ahi lai ding hi.
Kuapeuh alupna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
Thilpawtmi tutna a tu peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
Kuapeuh thilpawtmi sa khoih peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
Thilpawtmi in misiang chil asiatkhumleh apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Tuanna bangpeuh a leng thilpawtmi atuanleh siang lou ahi ding.

Kuapeuh akingaihnasa nung thil khoih peuhmahte nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding ua; huai thil lasuan mi peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding ua; akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
Kuapeuh thilpawtmi in akhut sil lou a akhoih peuhmah in apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Thilpawtmi leibel khoihsa suktap ding ahi; asing vanzat tengteng silsiang vek ding ahi,' achi hi.
"Huan thilpawtmi bel, athilpawt hihsiang ahihleh, akisiansakna ding in ni sagih akipe dia, apuante asawp dia; luitui ah akisil dia; huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
Ani giat ni in vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam tawi in TOUPA ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah ahoh dia, siampu ape ding ahi.
Siampu in khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in akhat pen alan ding hi. Siampu in athilpawt thu ah TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding.
"Pasal kuapeuh kipolhna chi amah a pan apawtleh apumpi in akisil vek dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Puansilh leh vun, kipolhna chitukna peuhmah sawpsiang vek ding ahi a, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Numei akithuahpih leng anih ua akisil tuak ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
"Numei in thilpawt aneih a, asa a thilpawt si ahihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; kuapeuh amah khoih kha taphot nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Asian louh sung a, alupna peuhmah siang lou ahi dia, atutna peuhmah leng siang lou ahi lai ding hi.
Alupna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
Kuapeuh atutna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
Alupna a thil om hiam, atutna a thil om hiam khoih peuhmah leng nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
Kuapeuh in akithuahpih a, asi neih luang in amah asuk khakleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; alupna peuhmah siang lou ahi vek ding hi.

"Numei asi neih ngeina hilou, ni sawtkuamtak a sipawt hiam, anitdan ngeina sang a sawtzaw sipawt hiam ahihleh, asianlouhdan ngeina sung a, a-om zel bang in sipawtmi anit sung teng siang lou in a-om ding hi.
Asipawt sung teng alupna taphot asiang louh ngeina hun lai a, alupna bang ahi dia; atutna peuhmah asian louh ngeina hun lai a, asiang louh bang in siang lou ahi ding.
Kuapeuh huai thil khoih peuhmah siang lou ahi dia, apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Himahleh asipawt pen siansak ahihleh ni sagih ama'n akisim dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
Ani giat ni in vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam atawi dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah siampu ahong pe ding ahi.
Siampu in khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in khat alan ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in sipawtmi asianlouhna thu ah TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi.
"Hiai bang in Israel suante asianlouhna ua pan na hihtuam ding uh ahi; alak ua ka biakbuk ahihbuah khak chiang ua leng asianlouhna ua asihlouhna ding un.
"Hiai dan pasal thilpawt neimi leh kipolhna a pan chi pawtkhia a ninte leh
numei kha teng si neih sung a ding, pasal hi in numei hitaleh sa a pan thilpawt neimi a ding leh siang lou a ngaih numei kithuahpih pasal a ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan Aaron tapa nihte'n TOUPA ava naih ua asihloh nung un TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Na unau Aaron houpih inla, puanzak sung Mun Siangthou ah, bawm tung a zahngaihna tutphah ma ah chik lai peuh in leng hong lut het kei heh, asi kha ding hi. Zahngaihna tutphah tung a, meipi a hong kilang ding ka hih ziak in.
Hichibang in Mun Siangthou ah khelh thoihna ding in bawngtuai, halmang thillat ding in belampa toh Aaron ahoh ding ahi.

"Puanmalngat puanak siangthou asilh dia, asa khuhna ding in puanmalngat pheituam abun ding, puanmalngat dial akhim ding ahi. Hiaite puansilh siangthou ahi a; akisil masa dia, huchi in asilh phet ding ahi.
"Israel suan mipi omkhawmte a pan khelh thoihna ding in kelpa nih leh halmang thillat ding in belampa khat atawi ding ahi.
Aaron in amah a tuam, khelh thoihna bawngtal pen alan dia, amah leh a-inkote a ding in kilemna abawl ding ahi.
Kel nih akai dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah akoih ding hi.
Aaron in kel nih tungthu ah ai asan dia, khat TOUPA a tuam ahi dia, akhat pen thuak sik thuak kel ahi ding.
Aaron in TOUPA a tuam dia puk kel pen ala dia, khelh thoihna ding in alan ding hi.
Thuak sik thuak kel dia puk pen kilemna bawlna dia khah ding in TOUPA ma ah ahing in akoih ding hi.
"Aaron in ama a tuam khelhna bawngtal pen ala dia, amah leh a-inkote a ding in kilemna abawl dia, amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngtal pen agou ding hi.
TOUPA ma a maitam a pan mei lakna dim in mei-am ala dia, gimlim gawizan ngiingei pham khat toh puanzak sung ah alutpih ding hi.
Gimlim khu in thu theihpihna tung a zahngaihna tutphah abopna ding in TOUPA ma a mei ah gimlim abuak dia, sihna atuahlouhna ding in.
Bawngtal sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, akhutzung in zahngaihna tutphah suahlam pang a theh dia, akhut in zahngaihna tutphah bul sisan in sagihvei atheh ding ahi.
"Mipi a tuam khelh thoihna kel pen agou dia, asisan, bawngtal sisan abawl bang in abawl dia, zahngaihna tutphah tung leh zahngaihna tutphah ma ah atheh ding hi.

Israel suante sianlouhnate leh akhelhnate ua atatleknate uh ziak in Mun Siangthou a ding in kilemna abawl ding hi. Huai mah bang in, asianlouhnate uh lak a om, kihoupihna biakbuk a ding in leng abawl sam ding hi.
Mun Siangthou a kilemna bawl dia alut lai in, amah leh a-inkote leh Israel mipite a dia kilemna bawl khin a ahong pawtkhiak masiah kuamah puanin sung ah a-om ding ahi kei.
TOUPA ma a maitam lam ah apawt dia, huai a ding in kilemna abawl dia, bawngtal sisan leh kel sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, maitam kiite ah akimvel in atat ding ahi.
Akhut in huai sisan sagihvei atheh dia, asiangsak dia, Israel suante sianlouhna a pan ahihsiangthou ding hi.
"Mun Siangthou leh kihoupihna biakbuk leh maitam a dia kilemna abawl khit chiang in, kel hing pen ahon kai ding hi.

Aaron in kel hing lutung ah akhut langnih akoih dia, atung ah Israel suante gitlouhna teng leh khial a atatlekna teng uh apulak dia; huaite kel lutung ah anga dia, mi khat asehkholhsa un gamdai ah apimang ding hi.
Huai kel in agitlouhna tengteng uh luah louh gam ah apomang dia, kel bel gamdai ah akhah ding hi.
"Kihoupihna puanin ah Aaron alut dia, Mun Siangthou a, alut lai a puanmalngat puansilh asuah dia, huai ah anuse ding hi.
Mun siangthou ah akisil dia, apuansilh asilh dia, ahong pawtkhe dia, amah a tuam halmang thillat leh mipi a tuam halmang thillat alan dia, amah leh mipi a ding in kilemna abawl ding hi.
Khelh thoihna thau maitam ah ahal ding hi.
Thuak sik thuak kel khah mi kuapeuh in apuante asawp dia, akisil dia, huai khit in a-omna mun ah apai nawn ding ahi.
Khelh thoihna bawngtal leh khelh thoihna kel sisan kilemna abawlna dia Mun Siangthou a, alutpih uh giahphual pua ah apaipih ding hi; avun, asa leh a-ek ahal ding ahi.
Ahalmi'n apuan asawp dia, akisil dia, huai khit in a-omna mun ah apai nawn ding ahi.

"Hiai na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi: Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawm ni in na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding ua, na gam ua mi himhim hiam, gamdangmi na lak ua teng hiam in bangmah asep louh ding ahi.
Hiai ni in noute hihsiangthou ding in noute a ding in kilemna bawl ahi dia; huchi in TOUPA ma ah na khelhna tengteng lak ua pan na siang ding uhi.
Nou a dia Sabbath ni ahi a, na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding uh ahi. Hiai tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.

Siampu, apa sik a siampu hi dia sathau nilh ding leh hihtuam mi hi ding in kilemna abawl dia, puanmalngat puansilh siangthou asilh dia; mun siangthou a ding in kilemna abawl dia; kihoupihna biakbuk leh maitam a ding in leng kilemna abawl sam ding hi.
Siampute leh mipihon a ding in kilemna abawl nawn lai ding hi.
Akhelhna tengteng uh ziak a kum chih a khatvei Israel suante a dia kilemna bawl na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Mosi in ahihta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron leh atapate leh Israel suan tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah: Hiai TOUPA thupiak ahi:
Israel inkote lak a mi bawngtal hiam, belamnou hiam, kel hiam giahphual hiam, giahphual polam hiam a gou a,

TOUPA biakbuk ma a TOUPA a dia athillat dia kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a hon tawi lou peuhmah, huai mi sisan suah a ngaih ahi ding; sisan suah ngei ahi, huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.

Hiai pen Israel suante'n akithoihnate uh, gamlak a kithoihnate uh ahon lak ua, TOUPA a ding ngei a kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a, siampu kiang a, ahon tawi ua, TOUPA a dia lemna thillat kithoihna ahihtheihna ding ahi.
Siampu in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a maitam, sisan in atheh dia, TOUPA a ding in gimlimtak in athau ahal ding ahi.
A-angkawmna uh dawite kiang ah akithoih nawn ding uh ahi kei. Hiai asuante uh tan a tangtawn a dia dan thuseh ahi.
"Akiang uah, Israel inkomi himhim hiam, gamdangmi alak ua tengte hiam in halmang thillat hiam, kithoihna hiam,
TOUPA kiang a kithoihna dia kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a hon tawi lou a-omleh huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
"Kuapeuh Israel inkote lak a mi hiam, gamdangmi alak ua teng hiam, bang sisan leng ne peuhmah, huai sisan nemi tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia, achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ahi ding hi.
Sa hinna pen sisan a a-om ziak in, na hinna ua dia kilemna bawlna ding a maitam tung a nou ka hon piak ahi. Hinna ding a kilemna bawlna pen sisan mah lah ahi ngal a.
Huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, kuamah in sisan na ne ding uh ahi kei. Gamdangmi na lak ua teng in leng sisan a ne ding ahi kei, ka chi ahi.
"Israel suante lak a mi hiam, gamdangmi alak ua teng hiam, gam va vak a, sa hiam, vasa hiam, nek theih chi ahon tutleh asisan apawtsak dia, leivui in asisan avuk ding ahi.

Sa tengteng hinna thu ah asisan leh ahinna kibang geih ahi. Huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, sa sisan mawngmawng na ne ding uh ahi kei, sa tengteng hinna asisan ahi ngal a. Hiai ne peuhmah satkhiak ahi ding.

"Amah sih a si hiam, sa keihlup hiam nemi, huai gam a mi hiam leng hi hen aw, apuan uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh. Huchi in nitaklam in ahong siangta ding uh.
Asawp louh ua, akisil kei uleh athulimlouhna moh akipuak ding uh," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Kei TOUPA, na Pathian uh ka hi.
Na omna masa uh Aigupta gam mite hih bang in hih kei unla, ka hon pilutna ding Kanaan gam mite dan thusehte bang in leng hih kei un.
Ka vaihawmte na zui ding ua, ka dan thusehte zui in na mang ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
Huaiziak in ka dan leh ka vaihawmte na mang ding uh ahi, huai mi'n ahihleh ahing ding hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,' achi hi.
"Kuamah in na tanau nai numei, avuaktanna lem ding in na zuan ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
Na pa vuaktanna ahihkeileh na nu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na nu ahi a, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei hi.
Na pa zi vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na pa vuaktanna ahi.
Na sanggamnu, na pa tanu hiam na nu tanu hiam, na pianpih hiam, na pianpih louh hiam vuaktanna leng na lem ding ahi kei.
Na tapa tanu hiam, na tanu, tanu hiam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Avuaktanna uh nang vuaktanna ahi ngal a.
Na pa zi tanu, na pa suan vuaktanna, na sanggamnu ahi, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
Na pa sanggamnu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na pa tanaunu nai ahi.
Na nu sanggamnu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na nu tanaunu nai ahi ngal a.
Na pa sanggam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, azi na zuan ding ahi kei, amah na nu ahi.
Na mounu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na tapa zi ahi a, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
Na sanggampa zi vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na sanggampa vuaktanna ahi.
Nutate vuaktanna na lem ding uh ahi kei. Avuaktanna lem ding in atapa tanu hiam, atanu tanu hiam na la ding ahi kei. Na tanau naite ahi ua; gitlouhna lianpi ahi.
Na zi adam lai teng, asanggamnu vuaktanna lem ding in na zi in na nei ding ahi kei hi.
"Numei anitdan ngeina a, anit sung in avuaktanna lem ding in na zuan ding ahi kei.
Alak a kihihnin ding in na invengpa zi na kithuahpih ding ahi kei.
Molek a dia mei a lutsuaksak ding in na gil a gah himhim na pe ding ahi kei, na Pathian min na hihse ding ahi sam kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
Numei bang in pasal na kithuahpih ding ahi kei. Thilkihhuai ahi.
Kihihnin ding in ganta himhim na kithuahpih ding ahi kei. Luppih ding in ganta ma ah numei adin ding ahi kei. Gitlouhna tungtuan ahi.
"Hiaite ah, abangmah ah kihihnin kei un. Hiai thil tengteng ah na ma ua ka delhkhiak khitsa namte ana nin khinta uhi.
Agam leng anin khinta hi. Huaiziak in athulimlouhnate uh ziak in amau ka gawt a, gam in asung a teng mite alokhe khin vek hi.
Huaiziak in nou zaw ka dante, ka vaihawmte na zui ding uh ahi. Hiai thilkihhuaite na hih ding uh ahi kei; na gam ua mi himhim hiam, gamdangmi na lak ua tengte hiam in leng.
Hiai thilkihhuai tengteng na ma ua hiai gam a omte'n ana hih khin ua, gam mah leng anin khinta hi;
na ma ua om nam aluakkhiak mah bang a na hihnit ua, gam in ahon luakkhiaklouhna ding in.
Kuapeuh hiai thilkihhuaite lak a khatpeuh hihmi achipihte a pan satkhiak ahi ding.
"Huaiziak in hiai thilkihhuai na ma ua omte'n achin bang uh na chin samlouhna ding un leh huai a na kihihnitlouhna ding un ka thuseh na zui ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na siangthou ding uh ahi, Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka siangthou ngal a.
"Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na siangthou ding uh ahi, Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka siangthou ngal a.
"Milim lam ah kihei kei unla, sunthoh milimte leng kibawltawm kei un. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
"TOUPA a dia kilemna thillat na lat chiang un noumau deihtelna a na lat ding uh ahi.
Na lat ni mah uh ahihkeileh azing a na nek ding uh ahi. Ani thum ni tan a, aval a-om laileh mei a na hal ding uh ahi.
Ani thum ni tan a nek ahihleh thilkihhuai ahi a; pomsak ahi kei ding hi.
Ane kuapeuh in TOUPA sianthouna ahihnit ziak in athulimlouhna moh akipuak dia, huai mi achipihte a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
"Na lou ua buh na lak chiang un, lounawl zulte tan in na la vek ding uh ahi kei. Asang leng na zong ding uh ahi kei.
Na grephuan uah asang na zong ding uh ahi kei. Na grephuan ua agah kia leng na tomkhawm ding uh ahi kei. Mizawng leh gamdangmi a ding in na hawisak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
"Na gu ding uh ahi kei. Atak lou in thil na hih ding ahi kei. Zuau na kihilhtuah ding uh ahi kei.
Na Pathian min hemsak ding in ka min in dikloutak in na kichiam ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Na invengte na khem ding ahi kei. Na guksak ding leng ahi kei. Kilohmi loh zankhua in azingsang tan in na kem ding ahi kei.
Nangong na hamsiat ding ahi kei. Mittaw ma ah apukna ding na koih ding ahi kei. Na Pathian na lauh ding ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Vaihawmna ah diktat loutak in thu na khen ding ahi kei. Mizawng na simmoh tuam ding ahi kei hi. Mi thilhihthei na zahtak tuam ding ahi kei. Himahleh diktattak in na invengte vai na hawmsak ding ahi.
Na chipihte lak ah migensia in na vialvak ding ahi kei. Na invengte sisan thu ah ahilou lam in na pang ding ahi kei. TOUPA ka hi.
"Na lungtang in na unau na ho ding ahi kei. Na invengte na taihilh ngeingei ding ahi. Na huchihleh agitlouhna ah na siang ding hi.
Phu na la ding ahi kei. Na chipihte suante huatna na pai ding ahi kei. Nang na ki-it bang in na invengte na it ding ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Ka thupiakte na zui ding uh ahi. Na ganta chi tuamtuam suangsak ke'n. Na lou ah haichi chi nih chingkhawm ke'n. Thil chituam nih gatpolh puan na silh ding ahi kei.
"Kuapeuh sikhanu, apasal ding khamsa nei, tat nai louh, khahkhiak nai louh pasal dang toh lumkhawm peuhmah gawt ding ahi. Himahleh hihlup ding bel ahi kei, amah zalen ahih louh ziak in.
Kihoupihna puanin kongpi bul ah TOUPA kiang ah atatlekna thoihna ding in belampa ahon kaih ding ahi.
Athilhihkhelhsa, akhelhna ah TOUPA ma ah tatlek thoihna belampa in siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia; huchi in athilhihkhelhsa ngaihdam ahi ding.
"Gam na va luah ua, nek dia theikung chi chih na suan hun un agah siang lou in na ngai ding uh. Nou a ding in kum thum siang lou a ngaih ding ahi a, nek het louh ding ahi.
Himahleh, akum lina ah agah teng TOUPA phatna ding in amah a dia sehtuam ahi ding hi.
Akum ngana ah nou a dia apun zel theihna ding in agah na ne ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
"Asisan toh khatpeuh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Bum ching in ai na san ding uh ahi kei.
Na baknel a pan akimvel in na lu na met ding ahi kei. Na khamul lang tuak leng na tan ding ahi sam kei.
Misi ziak in na sa uh na atkeh ding uh ahi kei. Na satung ua gelh in chiamtehna na gelh ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Na tanu kizuaksak ke'n. Gam angkawmna gam ahong suak kha dia, gitlouhna in ahong dim kha ding hi.
Ka Sabbathte na tan ding uh ahi. Ka mun siangthou na zahtak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Dawi aisan siamte zuan kei unla, bumsiamte leng ahon nitsak-louhna ding un zongkhe kei un. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Lu a kelsam poute ma ah dingh in. Tek omna na zahtak in. Na Pathian lau in. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Gamdangmi, na gam ua ana teng a-omleh na hihsiat louh ding uh ahi.

Gamdangmi na lak ua tengte bel nou a ding in na gam ua mi bang ahi ding ua, nangmah na ki-it bang in amah na it ding ahi. Nou leng Aigupta gam ah gamdangmi na hi ngeita uhi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
"Vaihawm thu ah, tehna chiang ah, gikdan ah leh saudan tehna ah diktatloupi in na hih ding uh ahi kei.
Bukna dik, gikdan dik, ephah dik, hin dik na nei ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa ka hi.
Ka thupiak tengteng leh ka vaihawm tengteng na pom ding ua, na zuih ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
“Huan kuapeuh in TOUPA kiang a thillat, tangbuang thillat alat chiang in, athillat tangbuang nel dimdem ahi ding ahi. Sathau abuak dia, atung ah begaw akoih lai ding ahi”.

Aaron tapa siampute kiang ah apaipih dia; ama'n apham khat in huai a tangbuang nel dimdem, asathau toh, abegaw tengteng toh alakhe ding a, siampu in maitam tung ah theihgigena, TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ding in ahal ding hi.
Tangbuang thillat bangte Aaron leh atapate a ding ahi ding. Huai TOUPA a dia mei a thillatte a thil siangthoupen ahi.
“Tangbuang thillat, akanna a kan thillat na latleh, tangbuang nel dimdem, sathau a mek silngou soh louh tanghou hiam, sathau a zut, silngou soh louh tanghou pei hiam ahi ding ahi”.
“Na thillat, kuang a kan tangbuang thillat ahihleh, silngou soh louh, sathau a mek, tangbuang nel dimdem ahi ding hi”.
Na phelkhap ding a, sathau a na buah ding ahi. Huai tangbuang thillat ahi.
“Na thillat kan bel a kan, tang- buang thillat ahihleh tangbuang nel dimdem leh sathau a bawl ahi ding hi”.
Hiai thil a bawl tangbuang thillat TOUPA kiang ah na hon tawi dia; siampu kiang a lat ahi dia, ama'n maitam ah hon paipih ding hi.
Siampu in tangbuang thillat a pan theihgigena pen alakhe dia, maitam ah ahal ding. Hiai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ahi.
Tangbuang thillat lat bangte Aaron leh atapate atuam ding ahi dia; hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillatte lak a siangthoupen ahi.
"Tangbuang thillat himhim, TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh silngou soh a bawl ding ahi kei. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ah silngou hiam, khuaizu himhim na hel ding uh ahi kei”.
Gah masapen thillat bang in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; gimlim dia maitam akoih ding ahi kei hi.
Na tangbuang thillat ah na Pathian thukhun chi na maih ding ahi kei. Na thillat tengteng ah chi na lat tel ding ahi.
Gah masapen tangbuang thillat TOUPA kiang a na latleh na buh thak masapente, tangbuang thillat ding in tanghou pek na lan ding ahi.
Sathau na buak dia, atung ah begaw na koih ding ahi,
siampu in huai theihgigena, buh sukzan bangzah hiam toh begaw tengteng toh ahal ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia amei a thillat ahi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Israel suante kiang ah, kuapeuh, Israel suante lak a mi hiam, Israel gam a teng gamdangmi hiam, agil a gah Molek pe peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Hiai gam a mi teng in suang in adenglum ding uhi.
Ka mun siangthou leh ka min siangthou hihnin ding a, agilgah khenkhat Molek kiang a apiak ziak in huai mi tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia, achipihte lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
Hiai gam a mite'n agil a gah Molek kiang a piak akitheihmohbawl ua, ahihlup kei uleh,
amah leh a-inkote tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia, Molek kiang a kei hon ang kawmsan peuhmahte toh achipihte uh lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
"Alak ua angkawm dia dawi aisan siamte leh bumsiamte zuan mi tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia; achipihte lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
Huaiziak in kihihsiangthou unla, siangthou in om un. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a.
Ka thupiakte pom in na zui ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA noute hon hihsiangthoupa ka hi.
