"Anu hiam, apa hiam hamsiat-khum peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Anu hiam, apa hiam hamsiatkhum ahi a, atung ah asisan moh a-om ding ahi.
"Mi zi angkawm, a-invengte zi angkawm zaw, a-angkawmpa leh a-angkawmnu, anih ua hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
Apa zi kithuahpih in apa vuaktanna lem ahi a; hihlup tuaktuak ding ahi. Asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
Mi'n amounu akithuahpihleh hihlup tuaktuak ding ahi. Tatsiatna tungtuan hih ahi ua, asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
Mi'n numei akithuahpih bang a pasal akithuahpihleh thilkihhuai mahmah hihtuak ahi ua, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
Mi'n nuta zi in nei leh gitlouhna ahi. Na lak ua thulimlouhna a-omlouhna ding in amah leh nutate mei a hallup ding ahi.
Mi'n ganta akithuahpihleh hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Ganta leng hihlup ding ahi.
Numei in ganta ava naih a, akithuahpihsakleh huai numei na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi. Ganta leng hihlup ngeingei ding ahi a; asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.

"Mi'n asanggamnu, apa tanu hiam, anu tanu hiam akitenpih a, avuaktanna amuh a, ama'n leng avuaktanna amuhleh thil gilou hih ahi ua, amite mitmuh a satkhiak ding ahi uh. Asanggamnu vuaktanna lem ahi a, atatlekna moh apo ding hi.
Mi'n numei akha teng si neih aneih lai a, akithuahpih a, avuaktanna alemleh asi pawtna lem ahi a, ama'n leng asi pawtna lem ahi a, achipihte ua pan anih ua satkhiak ding ahi.
"Na nu sanggamnu hiam, na pa sanggamnu hiam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Asanggam nai vuaktanna lem ahi a, agitlouhna moh apo ding.
Mi'n apaneu zi akithuahpihleh apaneu vuaktanna lem ahi a; akhelh moh uh apo ding ua, suan-le-pak bei in asi ding uh.
Mi'n a-unaupa zi akitenpihleh thilnin ahi a, a-unaupa vuaktanna lem ahi a, suan-le-pak nei lou in a-om ding uh.
"Huaiziak in ka thupiak tengteng, ka vaihawm tengteng na pom ding ua, na zui ding uh ahi. Huchi in tenna ding a ka hon pina gam in nou ahon lokhe kei ding hi.
Na ma ua ka delhkhiaksa namdangte thilhihte na zui ding uh ahi kei. Hiai thil tengteng ahih ua, huaiziak in, amau ka kih hi.
Himahleh nou kiang ah, agam uh, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, na luah ding un ka hon pe ding, ka chi khinta hi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, namdangte a pan hon hihtuampa ka hi.

Huaiziak in sa siang leh siang lou leh vasa siang leh siang lou na khentuam ding ua; sa hiam, vasa hiam lei a vakthoh chi himhim hiam nou a dia siang lou dia ka sehtuamte in na hinna uh na kihhuaisak ding uh ahi kei.
Kei a ding in misiangthou na hi ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA lah ka siangthou ngal a. Kei a na hihna ding un namdangte lak a pan nou ka hon septuamta hi.
"Pasal leng, numei leng dawi aisan siam zawl hiam, bumsiam hiam hihlup ngeingei ding ahi a; suang a denlup ding ahi uh. Asisan moh uh atung uah a-om ding hi," achi nawn lai hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron tapa siampute houpih inla, akiang uah: Achipihte uh lak a misi ziak in kuamah akihihnit ding ahi kei.
Atanau nai, anu uh, apa uh, atapa uh, atanu uh, a-unau,
asanggamnu, a-ompih lai uh nungak, pasal nei nailoute ziak in ahihleh akihihnin thei ding uh.
Hiai bang ahih kei ngalleh, achipihte uh lak a intekpen ahih ziak in akihihnin ding ahi kei.
"Alu uh ametgiau ding uh ahi kei. Akhamul sik tuak uh leng atantom ding uh ahi kei. Asa uh leng a-atkeh ding uh ahi kei.
A Pathian uh a ding in misiangthou ahi ding ua, a Pathian min ahemsak ding ahi kei hi. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, a Pathian a dia nek ding ansiahte alat ziak in asiangthou ding ahi.
Numei kizuak hiam, min hem hiam, apasal maksa hiam akitenpih ding ahi kei, a Pathian a ding in misiangthou ahi ngal a.
Huaiziak in amah na siangthousak ding ahi; ama'n na Pathian tanghou alat ziak in, nang a ding in asiangthou ding hi. Kei, TOUPA, nou hon hihsiangthoupa lah ka siangthou ngal a.
Siampu kuapeuh tanu kizuak a, akihihthanghuai leh apa ahihthanghuai ahi a, mei a hal ding ahi.
"A-unaute lak a siampu lian, alu sathau nilhsa, puansilh dia sehtuamsa in alukhuhna alakhe ding ahi kei. Apuante abotkek ding ahi kei.
Misi luang omna ah alut ding ahi kei. Anu hiam, apa hiam ziak in akihihnin ding ahi sam kei hi.
Mun siangthou a pan apawtkhe ding ahi kei. A Pathian' mun siangthou ahihthanghuai ding ahi sam kei hi. A Pathian sathau nilhna lah atung ah a-om ngal a; Kei TOUPA ka hi.
Zi ding in nungak siangthou akitenpih ding ahi.
Meithai hiam, maksa hiam, numei min hem hiam, kizuak hiam akitenpih ding ahi kei. Amah chipih, nungak siangthou zi ding in akitenpih ding ahi.
Achipihte lak ah asuante ahihnin ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA'N amah ka hihsiangta ngal a, chi in,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron kiang ah, asuante lak a na khang ua demna ding nei peuhmah in a Pathian a dia ansiah lan ding in hon zuan kei hen.
Kuapeuh melhemna nei in ahon naih het louh ding ahi. Mittaw, khebai, nakpek ahihkeileh akan-aval a om peuhmah;
ahihkeileh khe kitan, khut kitan,
ahihkeileh nungkul, mineu lua, mit sia, meima damthei lou nei ahihkeileh chiltang kitam,
siampu Aaron suan gensiatna ding nei himhim in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat lan ding in ahon naih ding ahi kei. Gensiatna ding nei ahi a, a Pathian a dia sehtuam an lan dia ahon naih het louh ding ahi.
A Pathian a dia an siangthou leh siangthoupen ahihleh ane thei ding hi.

Himahleh gensiatna ding nei ahih ziak in puanzak sung ah hiam, maitam kiangnai ah hiam ahong pai thei kei ding. Ka mun siangthoute ahihnin kha ding hi. Kei TOUPA amah hihsiangthoupa ka hi ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in Aaron leh atapate leh Israel suante tengteng kiang ah agenta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron leh atapate kiang ah gen inla, Israel suante'n ka ma a thillat siangthou, kei a dia sehtuam alatte uh zahtaktak in sai uhen. Ka min siangthou ahihnin kha ding uh. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
Akiang uah, khang sawnsawn in na suante uh lak a kuapeuh siang lou a ngaih a om in TOUPA a dia sehtuam a om thillat siangthou anaihleh ka omná a pan satkhiak in a-om ding. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Aaron suan kuapeuh phak hiam, thilpawt nei hiam in asian masiah thil siangthoute ne kei hen. Misi in ahihnit hiam, amah a pan chipawt peuhmah hiam;
ahihkeileh amah siang lou hisak thei bokvak ganhing khatpeuh khoih kha hiam bangchibang siang lou khoih kha siang lou in a-om ding hi.
Huchibang khoihmi nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi dia, tui a akisil keileh thil siangthoute anek louh ding ahi.
Nitum chiang in ahong siangta ding hi. Huai khit in thil siangthoute ane theita ding, anek ding an ahih ziak in.
Akihihnin ding in amah sih a si hiam, gamsa in abalnen hiam ane ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Huaiziak in ka thuseh azuih ding ahi. Huchi lou in zaw akihihnitna khelh moh akipuak ding a, asihloh ding hi. Kei TOUPA, amaute hihsiang- thoupa ka hi ngal a.
"Gamdangmi'n thil siangthou ane ding ahi kei. Siampu kiang a gamta hiam, kiloh hiam in thil siangthou ane ding ahi kei.
Himahleh siampu in kuahiam sum a aleileh, huai mi in bel ane thei dia, a-inn a piangte'n leng ane thei sam ding uh.
Siampu tanu in gamdangmi akitenpihleh thillat siangthoute ane ding ahi kei.
Himahleh siampu tanu in ta nei lou in meithai in hiam, mak hiam a-om a, apa inn a, akik nawnleh anungak lai mah bang in apa nek dingte ane sam ding hi. Himahleh gamdangmi in ane ding ahi kei.
"Mi'n thei lou a thil siangthou anekleh amun nga a khen mun khat akoih behlap dia, thil siangthou pen siampu kiang ah ape ding hi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA kiang a alat uh thil siangthou athangbawl ding uh ahi kei.
Ahihkeileh, hiai thil siangthoute ne in atatlekna uh moh akipuak ding uh, hiaite kei TOUPA'N ka hihsiangthouta ngal a," chi in.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Aaron leh atapate leh Israel inkote teng houpih inla, akiang uah, Israel lak a teng, gamdangmi hiam, kuapeuh athillat uh, halmang thillat dia TOUPA kiang a alat uh, athuchiamna uh hiam, amah ut thu a thillat hiam lan peuhmahte'n,
santak na hihtheihna ding un bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam, apa gensiatbei na lat ding uh ahi.
Gensiat kai himhim na lat ding uh ahi kei; hon pomsak theih lah ahi ngal kei a.

Kuapeuh thuchiam hih buching ding hiam, amah ut thu a athillat ding hiam, lemna thillat kithoihna a ganhon lak a hiam, abelamhon lak a hiam, TOUPA kiang a lan taphot in, pomtak ahihtheihna ding in gensiatbei alat ding ahi a; gensiat kaina himhim a om ding ahi kei.
Amit taw, aguh tan, akhe bai, meima nei, chibawk leh phak nei, TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi kei, mei a thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah maitam ah na lan ding uh ahi kei.
Ama ut thủ a thillat ding in bawngtal hiam, belamnou hiam, akan- aval a om sahiang nei hiam, sahiang kim lou hiam bel na lan thei ding uh. Himahleh thuchiamna thillat ding in hiaite pom ahi kei ding.
Achiltang dup hiam, kitam hiam, keh hiam TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uh ahi kei. Na gam uah huchibang kithoihna ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei hi.
"Gamdangmi a pan la in huaite lak a himhim na Pathian uh a dia sehtuam an ding in na lan ding uh ahi kei. Asiatna leh gensiat kaina a-om ziak in pomsak theih ahi kei ding hi, chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam, ahong pian chiang in api kiang ah ni sagih a-om ding ahi, ani giat ni a pan anunglam in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ding in pom theih ahi ding.
Bawngpi hiam, belampi hiam, anou toh ni khat in na gou ding uh ahi kei.
Kipahthu genna kithoihna dia TOUPA kiang a na kithoih chiang un pomtak na hihtheihna ding un na kithoih ding uh ahi.
Huai ni mah a nek bei ding ahi, azingchiang tan in bangmah na sit ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Huaiziak in ka thupiakte na pom ding ua, na zuih ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
Ka min siangthou na hemsak ding uh ahi kei. Israel suante lak ah hihsiangthou in ka om ding ahi. Kei noute hon hihsiangthoupa,
na Pathian uh hi dia Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa ka hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'TOUPA ankuanglui hunbi hiaite ahi.
Ni guk sung nna na sem ding ua, ani sagih ni khawlna Sabbath ni ahi a, khawmpi siangthou ahi. Hiai ni in nna na sem ding uh ahi kei. Na tenna teng uah hiai TOUPA Sabbath ni ahi.
TOUPA ankuanglui hunbi, khawmpi siangthou, ahun geihgeih a na puankhiak ding uh hiaite ahi,' achi hi.
"Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li nitaklam in TOUPA Paikan Ankuang akipan ding hi.
Huai kha mah ni sawm-le-nga TOUPA a dia silngou soh louh tanghou ankuang ahi a, ni sagih sung silngou soh louh tanghou na ne ding uh ahi.
Ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
Ni sagih sung mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; ani sagih ni pen khawmpi siangthou ahi a, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei, chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, k'on gam piak ding na va tun ua, huai a buh na lak chiang un, na buh thak masate uh phal khat siampu kiang a na hon tawi ding uh ahi.
Pomsak theih na hihna ding un, ama'n buhphal pen TOUPA ma ah hon na veisak dia; Sabbath zingchiang in siampu in avei ding ahi.
Buhphal na vei ni un belamnoupa, gensiatbei, kum khat a upa halmang thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uh ahi.
Tangbuang thillat bel tangbuang nel chi ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih sathau a mek, TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat ahi ding ahi. Dawn thillat ahihleh uain hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi.

Na Pathian uh a dia thillat na lat ma un, huai ma himhim in tanghou hiam, kan thoh hiam, an thak hitaleh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Hiai na tenna teng ua na suante zel uh tan a na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi.
"Sabbath zingchiang vei thillat buhphal na hon tawi ni ua pan in na sim ding ua, Sabbath sagihvei aching ding ahi.
Sabbath sagihveina zingsang a pan ni sawmnga na sim ding ua, TOUPA kiang a tangbuang thak thillat na lat ding uh ahi.
Na tenna mun ua pan in ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih a bawl, tanghou beu vei ding nih, tangbuang nel chi, silngou toh kan, TOUPA a dia gah masa vei thillat a lat dia na hon tawi ding uh ahi.

Tanghou lat toh kituak in belamnou sagih gensiatbei, kum khat a upa leh bawngtuai leh belampa nih na lan ding uh ahi. Huaite atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh toh, TOUPA a dia halmang thillat, TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat ahi ding hi.
Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat leh kilemna thillat kithoihna ding in belamnou apa nih kum khat a upa na lat ding uh ahi.
Siampu in gah masa a bawl tanghou, belamnou nih toh TOUPA ma a vei thillat in avei dia; siampu a tuam, TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ding.
Huai ni mah na sep ding ua, nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei. Hiai na tenna teng uah na suante uh tan in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.

"Na lou ua buh na lak chiang un na lounawl zul uh la vek kei un. Asang leng na zong ding uh ahi kei. Mizawng leh gamdangmi a dia na hawisak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, akha sagihna huai kha ani khat ni, noute a ding in khawlna ni ahi dia; pengkul mut in theihgigena khawmpi siangthou ahi ding.
Nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei; TOUPA a dia mei a thillat na lan ding uh ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Akha sagihna ani sawm ni Thoihna Ni ahi a; nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi ding. Na lungsimte uh zangsak unla, TOUPA a ding in mei a thillat lan un.
Huai ni in bang nna peuh na sem ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a lemna bawlsak ding, Thoihna Ni lah ahi ngal a.
Huai ni kigimsak lou peuhmah, amite a pan satkhiak ahi ding.
Kuapeuh hi hen aw, huai ni a bang nna peuh sem, achipihte uh lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
Bang nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei. Hiai bel na tenna peuh ua na suante zel uh tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
Nou a ding in khawlna Sabbath ni ahi a; na kigimsak ding uh ahi. Huai kha ani kua ni nitaklam, huai kha nitaklam a pan nitaklam nawn tan Sabbath ni in na zang ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, akha sagihna ani sawm-le-nga ni TOUPA a ding in ni sagih sung Biakbuk Ankuang ahi ding hi.
Ani khatna pen khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.

Ni sagih sung in mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua, ani giat ni nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi ding. Mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; khawmpi bei ni ahi a, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
"Hiaite ahi, TOUPA ankuangluina hunbi, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, kithoihna, dawn thillat, ani tuam chiat a lan dia khawmpi siangthou na zat dingte uh;
TOUPA Sabbathte, na thilpiakte uh, na thuchiam tengteng uh, amah ut thu a thillat, TOUPA kiang a na thillat zelte uh ban ah.

"Akha sagihna ni sawm-le-nga ni a na lou ua thilpiangte na lak khit chiang un TOUPA ankuangluina ni sagih na zang ding ua; ani khatna ni khawl kinkenna ni ahi dia, ani giat ni leng khawl kinkenna mah ahi ding hi.
Ani khat ni in singkung hoihte gahte, tum sing hiangte, singbawkpha hiangte, lui a muisumte na tawi ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah ni sagih sung kipak in na om ding uhi.
Hiai ankuangluina bel TOUPA a dia kum chih a ni sagih sung na zat ding uh ahi. Hiai na suante uh zel tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi. Akha sagihna ana zat zel ding uh ahi.
Sawlbuk ah ni sagih sung na teng ding ua, Israel mi a piang himhim aidakbuk ah na ten vek ding uh ahi.
Huchi in na suante un Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak lai in aidakbuk ah ka tengsak, chih athei ding uh. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in TOUPA an-kuangluina hunbite Israel suante kiang ah apuangta hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante, Olive thau chimtak, det ding a suk, khawnvak kuansak gigena ding a na kiang a hon tawi ding in thu pia in.
Kihoupihna puanin a thu theihpihna puanzak polam ah nitaklam a pan zinglam tan a ding in TOUPA ma ah Aaron in koih hoih hen. Hiai na suante zel uh tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
TOUPA ma ah khawnvak koihna siangthoutak tung ah khawnvakte koih hoih zel hen.
"Tangbuang nel chi la inla, tanghou sawm-le-nih in bawl in. Tanghou khat a ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih zat ding ahi.
TOUPA ma ah dohkan siangthou tung ah vual nih in, vual khat a guk tuaktuak in na chiang ding ahi.
Tanghou tung a avual nih ah begaw chimtak na koih dia, theihgigena, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahong hihtheihna ding in.
Sabbath teng in TOUPA ma ah akoih hoih zel ding ahi. Hiai tangtawn thukhun, Israel suante a ding ahi.
Hiai Aaron leh atapate a tuam ahi dia, mun siangthou ah ane ding uh. Tangtawn dan thuseh ding a TOUPA a dia mei a thillatte lak a, amah a dia thil siangthoutak ahi," chi in.
Israel numei tapa, apa Aigupta mi khat Israel suante lak ah ava hoh a; huai Israel numei tapa leh Israel mi khat giahmun ah akisual uhi.
Israel numei tapa in Pathian min gensia in ahamsiatkhum a; huchi in Mosi kiang ah ahon pi uhi. Anu min Shelomith ahi a, Dan chi Dibri tanu ahi,
TOUPA kam a pan thupawt ngakna in suangkul ah akhum uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hamsiat loupa giahphual polam ah pikhia unla, atheihpihte tengteng in alu ah akhut uh nga uhenla, mipi omkhawm tengteng in suang in deng uhen.
Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, kuapeuh a Pathian hamsiat loh peuhmah in akhelh moh apo ding.
TOUPA min gense peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Mipi omkhawm tengteng in suang in adeng ngeingei ding uh ahi. TOUPA min agensiatleh gamdangmi leng, hiai gam a mi him leng hihlup ding ahi.
"Si khop a mi tung a khut kha peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
Si khop a ganta tung a khut kha peuhmah in adit ding ahi; ganta sik in ganta mah ahi ding hi.
"Mi'n a-invengte amelsiat sakleh ahih bang geih atung a hih ding ahi.
Guh kitan sik in guh kitan, mit sik in mit, ha sik in ha; mi ahih melsiat bang in atung ah leng hih ahi ding.
Ganta that peuhmah in adit ding ahi. Mi that peuhmah hihlup ding ahi.
Gamdang mite a ding leh hiai gam mite a ding in dan kibang khat na nei ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, na chi ding," chi in.
Huchi in Mosi in Israel suante ahoupih a, hamse loupa giahphual polam ah apikhia ua, suang in adeng uh, Israel suante'n TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Sinai Tang ah Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'K'on gam piak ding a na va tun chiang un, TOUPA min in agam in leng Sabbath ni atang ding ahi.
Na lou uah kum guk sung thil na ching ding ua, na grephuan kum guk sung na satnou ding ua, agahte na la ding uhi.
Akum sagih kum in gam khawl kinkenna, TOUPA min a Sabbath ni ahi dia: na lou a buh-le-bal na chin ding uh ahi kei, na grephuan na satnou ding ahi sam kei.
Na buhpou na la ding ahi kei, na kep louh grep na lou ding ahi kei. Gam khawl kinkenna kum ahi ding ahi.
Gam khawl kum ate na nektawm ding uh ahi dia; nang, na sikha leh na sikhanu, na kiloh mi, na kiang a teng gamdangmi a ding ahi.
Na bawnghon, na gam a ganta a dia nektawm ding ahi,' achi hi.
"Khawl kum, kum sagih na sim dia, kum sagih mun sagih ahi ding a; khawl kum, kum sagih sung kum sawmli-le-kua ahi ding hi.
Huai khit akha sagihna, a ani sawm ni in pengkul ngaihtak in na vialmutsak dia; Thoihna Ni in na gam tengteng uah pengkul na vialmutsak ding uhi.

Akum sawmngana na kipahpih ding ua, gamsung pumpi a, huai a teng mite kiang ah noplenna thu na puang ding uhi. Noute a ding in Jubili ahi dia; michih ama neih-le-lam chiat na pekik nawn ding ua, michih ama inkuan ah akik nawn ding ahi.
Huai akum sawmngana pen nou a ding in Jubili ahi dia; bangmah na ching kei ding ua, apou leng na la kei ding ua, kep louh grep gah leng na lou ding uh ahi kei.
Jubili ahih ziak in nou a ding in siangthou ahi dia, na lou ua thil gahte na ne ding uhi.
"Hiai Jubili kum in michih kiang ah amah a mah na pekik nawn ding uh ahi.
Na invengte kiang a banghiam na khot a, na invengte kiang a banghiam na lei in leng kikhem in kinekna lemtang in na zang ding uh ahi kei.
Jubili khit akum zah dungzui zel in na invengte thil na lei dia, buh-le-bal tun kum tamdan dungzui in na kiang ah azuak ding ahi.
Akum tamdan dungzui zel in ama'n na khangsak dia, akum tawm dan dungzui in ama'n na kiamsak ding ahi. Buh-le-bal tun kum tam dungzui a na kiang ah zuak lah ahi ngal a.
Na kikhem ding uh ahi kei. Na Pathian na lau ding uh ahi; kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a.
"Huaiziak in ka dan thusehte zui in ka vaihawmte na pom ding uh ahi. Huchi in huai gam ah bittak in na teng ding uhi.
Gam in gah asuah dia, niang-le-tai a ne in na ta ding ua, bittak in na va teng ding uhi.
Ahihleh, akum sagih kum in bang ka neta ding ua? Ngai dih, bangmah lah ka ching kei ua, ka thil tungte uh lah ka la sam kei ua, na chih uleh,
akum guk kum in ka vualzawlna na tung ua tung ding in thu ka pe dia, kum thum sung a ding gah asuah ding hi.
Akum giat kum in buh na ching ding ua, haichi na pawi sung un buh luite na ne ding ua, akum kua kum tan, ahong thak nawn matan in aluite na ne ding uhi.
"Tangtawn a dia gam pen khot det ding ahi kei, gam lah kei a ahi ngal a. Noute mikhual, akhohloh lel na hi uh.
"Na gam luah tengteng uh, tatkik na phal ding uh ahi.
Na unau ahong gentheih a, agam khenkhat azuakleh atanau naipen ahong kuan dia, a-unau gam zuaksa atan ding ahi.
Mi'n tatsak ding mi nei kei mahleh ahong navak a tatna khop aneihleh,
azuak kum sut henla, azuakna pa kiang ah aval pe nawn hen; huchi in agam aluah nawn ding.
Amah a dia atatkik theih nawn keileh, akhotsa pen Jubili kum tan in aleipa khut ah om hen. Jubili kum in apawt nawn dia, ama'n agam aluah nawn ding hi.
"Mi'n kulh nei khua a tenna inn azuakleh, azuak a pan kum khat sung in atat nawn theihna hamphatna anei ding hi. Kum khat sung in atan thei nawn ding hi.
Kum khat sung a atat theih keileh, kulh nei khua a a-inn pen tangtawn in asuante zel tan in leng aleimi a ahi den ding ahi, Jubili chiang in leng apawt tuan kei ding hi.
Kulh nei lou khua a innte singtang gam bang a ngaih ahi dia, tat theih ahi dia, Jubili chiang in apawt ding.
Himahleh Levi mite khua, atantuam khua ua innte Levi mite'n chik lai peuh in leng atan thei ding uhi.
"Levi chite lak a mi'n atat keileh zuaksa inn leh atantuan khua pen Jubili chiang in apawt ding. Levi chite khua a innte Israel suante lak a atantuan uh ahi.
Akho kim ua loute zuak theih ahi kei ding, tangtawn a atantuan uh ahi.
"Na unau ahong gentheih a, nang ahong belhleh na kep ding ahi. Mikhual ahihkeileh khualzin bang himahleh amah na kiang ah na tengsak ding ahi.
Amah a pan dangka hiam, thil hiam, apung la ke'n, himahleh, Pathian lau in, na unau na kiang a atentheihna ding in.
Apung delh in na sum na leitawisak ding ahi kei.
Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, Kanaan gam hon pepa leh na Pathian uh hi dia Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa ka hi.
"Na unau ahong gentheih a, na kiang a ahong puklutleh sikha bang ana zat ding ahi kei.
Kilohmi bang leh na kiang a teng sam bang in na kiang ah ateng dia, Jubili kum tan in nangmah nna asem ding ahi.
Huai khit in na kiang a pan apawt dia, amah leh atate, amau inkuan ngei ah alut nawn ding uh, api-le-pute inn-le-lou aluah nawn ding uhi.
Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak, ka sikhate ahi ngal ua, sikha dia zuakkhiak ding ahi kei uh.
Huhamtak in atung uah gamta ke'nla; na Pathian lau zaw in.
Sikhanu leh sikhapa na neih dingte na kim ua namte lak a mi, sikhanu leh sikhapa dia na lei dingte ahi ding uh.
Na lak ua teng gamdangmi leh na gam ua piang a-inkote uh lak a mite leng na lei thei sam ding ua; amau na thil neih asuak ding uh.

Na nung ua na tapate uh gouluah ding in, athil neih ding un na bawl ding uhi. Huai lak a mite na tangtawn sikha ding in na nei ding uh. Himahleh na unau Israel suante lak ah huhamtak in na gamtang ding uh ahi kei.
"Gamdangmi hiam, na kiang ua teng kuahiam hong hau a, akiang a na unaupa ahong gentheih a, na kiang a gamdangmi hiam, na kiang a teng kiang hiam a amah-le-amah akizuak khiakleh,
khotsa ahih nung in leng akitankik thei ding hi; a-unaute lak a khat in amah atan thei ding hi.
Apaneu in hiam, apaneu tapa in hiam atan thei ding; achipihte lak a atanau nai in hiam atan thei ding hi. Amah leng ahong hauh nawnleh akitan thei ding hi.
Apuklutnapa toh apuklut a pan Jubili kum nawn ding sutkhawm uhenla, apuklut man, akum omdan in ahi dia; kiloh sikha ding a goih sut bang zel a sutsak ahi ding hi.
Kum tampi a-om laileh atatna man pen abelh sung hu toh kituak a piakkik nawn ding ahi.
Jubili kum tunna ding kum tawmchik kia om lai ahihleh sutkhawm uhenla; a-om kum tamdan dungzui in atat man apekik ding ahi.
Kum khat bi zel a goih kilohmi bang in abel ding hi. Abelhpa atung a huhamtak a na gamtatsak louh ding ahi.
Hiai kumte a tat ahihkeileh, Jubili kum in apawt ding; amah leh atate teng toh.
Israel suante lah ka sikhate ahi ngal ua, Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak, ka sikhate ahi uh. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," achi hi.
"Milimte na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Milim bawltawm suangphuh na dingsak ding uh ahi kei. Biak ding in na gam uah suang milim na phut ding uh ahi sam kei; kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a.
Ka Sabbathte na tang ding ua, ka mun siangthou na zahtak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
"Ka thusehte na man ua, ka thupiakte pom a na man uleh ahunhun in vuahtui ka hon zusak ding hi.
Lei in thil ahon piangsak dia, gam a singte'n gah asuang ding uhi.
Na phual ua buh in grep loh hun abanpha dia, na grep loh hun un thil chin hun abanpha ding hi. Na tanghou uh niang-le-tai in na ne ding ua, na gam uah bittak in na teng ding uh.
"Hiai gam ah muanna ka omsak dia, na lum ding ua, kuamah in ahon lausak kei ding. Gamsa hoihloute hiai gam a pan ka hawlmang dia, namsau in na gam uh atuansuak sam kei ding hi.
Na melmate uh na delh ding ua, na ma uah namsau a thah in a-om ding uh.
Mi nga in zakhat na delh ding ua, zakhat in singkhat na delh ding uh. Na melmate uh na ma uah namsau a thah in a-om ding uhi.
K'on deihsak dia, chi tampi ka hon suangsak ding hi. Na lak uah ka thukhun ka hihkip ding.
Sawtpi na kepsa, aluite na ne ding ua, athak koihna ding in aluite na lakhe ding uh.
Na lak uah ka biakbuk ka omsak dia; ka hinna in noute ahon kih kei ding.
Na lak uah ka teng dia, na Pathian uh ka hi dia, nou leng ka mite na hi ding uh.
Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, asikha uh na hihlouhna ding ua Aigupta gam a pan noute hon pikhepa ka hi. Na hakkolte uh ka hihtanta a, dingtang in ka hon paisakta hi.
"Himahleh ka thu pom lou a, hiai thupiak tengteng na zuih kei ua, ka thusehte na deih kei ua,
na hinna un ka vaihawmte ahuat a, ka thupiak tengteng zui lou a, ka thukhun na bohsiat uleh ke'n leng na tung uah hiai ka hih ding.
Na tung uah thil lauhuai, na hinna uh netum leh na mit uh hihsia kumzawnna leh khodam ka lengsak ding hi. Na haichite uh bangmah lou dia ching na hi ding ua, na melmate un ane zel ding uh.
Na tung uah ka mai ka gumsak dia, na melmate uh ma ah na vuallel ding uh. Nou hon hote'n na tung uah vai ahawm ding ua, kuamah delh louh in na tai ding uhi.
"Huchi pipi a leng ka thu na pom kei lai uleh na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei ka hon gawt lai ding hi.
Na thilhihtheihna ki-otsakna uh ka hihse dia, na tung ua van sik bang in leh na nuai ua lei sumsan bang in ka bawl ding.
Na tha uh na sengthawn lel ding ua; na gam un thil apiangsak kei dia, gam a singte'n gah asuang sam kei ding uh.
"Kei kalh lam a na om ua, ka thu na pom kei uleh na khelhna uh dungzui in amun sagih in na tung uah gawtna ka tungsak ding.
Na lak uah gamsate ka hon sawl dia, huaite'n na tate uh ahon laksak ding ua, na gantate uh ahihmangthang ding ua, na hong tawm mahmah ding ua, na lampite uh nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
"Hiaite tawn a ka hon bawlhoihna na pom tuan kei ua, kei kalh a na om lailai uleh,
ke'n leng nou ka hon kalh dia, kei mahmah in na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei ka hon gawt ding hi.

Huchi in na tung uah namsau ka lengsak dia, huai in ka thukhun na palsat uh phu ala ding hi. Noumau khosung chiat a na kibawmkhawm chiang un, na lak uah hii ka lengsak dia, melma khut a piak na hi ding uh.
Na muanpen uh tanghou ka beisak chiang in, numei sawm in thuk khat ah na tanghou uh a-emkhawm ding ua, na tanghou uh buk chitchiat in ahon pe ding ua; na ne ding ua, na kham tuan kei ding uh.
"Huchi tengteng a leng ka thu na pom kei ua, kei kalh a na om lailai uleh hehtak in noute ka hon kalh ding hi.
Na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei, kei mahmah in ka hon gawt ding hi.
Na tapate uh sa na ne ding ua, na tanute uh sa na ne nalai ding uhi.
Na mun sangte uh ka chimsak dia, na milimte uh ka puksak dia, na luang uh na milimte uh luang tung ah ka pai ding. Ka hinna in nou ahon kih ding hi.
Na khuate uh ka gamsak dia, na mun siangthoute uh ka hawmsak dia, na gimlimte uh ka dik kei ding hi.
Gam ka hihse ding a; huai a om na melmate un lamdang asa ding uh.
Namdangte lak ah ka hon dalhsak dia, noute hon delhzui ding in namsau ka phawi ding. Huchi in na gam uh ahawm dia, na khuate uh agam ding.
Ahawm sung teng leh na melmate uh gam a na om sung teng uh gam in a Sabbathte atang dia, a Sabbathte ah nuam asa ding uhi.
Ahawm sung teng in akhawl ding; asung a na ten lai ua, na Sabbath nite ua, akhawl louh ziak un.
"Na lak ua mi omsunte, amelmate uh gam ah alungtang sung uah bahna ka omsak ding hi. Nahthel ging in leng adelh dia, namsau a pan taikek bang in ataikek ding ua, kuamah delh louh in apuk ding uh.
Kuamah delh louh in namsau ma a taikek bang in akipalpuk lemlum ding ua; na melmate uh dal ding in hatna himhim na nei kei ding uh.
Namdangte lak ah na mangthang ding ua, na melmate gam in noute ahon negai ding.
Na lak ua omsunte na melmate uh gam ah athulimlouhna ziak un, amuih hiaihiai ding ua; api-le-pute un athulimlouhnate uh ziak a amuihloh bang un amau leng amuihloh sam ding uhi.
Ka tung a akhelh ziak leh athulimlouhna uh leh api-le-pute thulimlouhna leh kei kalh a a-om ziak un,

ke'n leng amau ka kalh a, amelmate uh gam a ka omsakdante akitheihmohbawl kei ding ua; asum louh lungtang ua akiniamkhiak ua, athulimlouhna uh ziak a ka gawtna apom uleh, Jakob kiang a ka thukhun ka theigige ding hi.
Isak leh Abraham kiang a ka thukhunte ka theigige ding hi.

"Agam mah leng ka theigige ding hi. Gam in leng akihepmangsan dia, amau om lou in ahawm sung in a Sabbathte ah nuam asa ding. Ka vaihawmte adeih louh ziak uh leh ahinna un ka dan thusehte amuh nop louh nak ziak in, athulimlouhna uh gawtna apom ding uhi.
Huchi pipi in leng, amelmate uh gam a a-om un amaute ka paimang kei dia, amaute hihmangthang ding leh ka thukhun bohse ding in amaute ka kih kei ding; kei TOUPA a Pathian uh lah ka hi ngal a.
A Pathian uh ka hihtheihna dia namte mitmuh a Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak, apipute uh thukhun amaute ziak in ka theigige zaw ding hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
Hiaite Sinai Tang a Mosi zang a amah leh Israel suante kal a TOUPA'N abawl thupiakte, vaihawmte leh dante ahi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Mi khat in midangte TOUPA a tuam dia septuam alan dia thuchiam abawlleh,' achi a,
"Pasal ahihleh na sehdan ding kum sawmnih leh kum sawmguk kikal a upa, mun siangthou a shekel buk dungzui in dangka shekel sawmnga hu ahih ding ahi.
Numei ahihleh na sehdan ding shekel sawmthum ahih ding ahi.
Kum nga leh kum sawmnih kikal a upa ahihleh, na sehdan ding pasal, shekel sawmnih, numei, shekel sawm ahih ding ahi.
Kha khat leh kum nga kikal a upa ahihleh, na sehdan ding pasal, dangka shekel nga, numei, shekel thum ahih ding ahi.
Kum sawmguk a kipan atunglam ahihleh, na sehdan ding pasal, shekel sawm-le-nga, numei, shekel sawm ahih ding ahi.
"Himahleh na seh zah pe zou lou khop a mizawng ahihleh siampu kiang ah ava pai dia, siampu in anasep ding; thuchiammi zoh hun bangbang ana sep ding ahi.
"Thillat, TOUPA kiang a alat ding uh gan ahihleh kuapeuh in TOUPA a dia huchibang apiak peuh uh siangthou ahih ding ahi.
Ahihlamdang ding ahi kei, ahoih pen asia in, asia pen ahoih in akheng ding ahi sam kei. Gan pen gan mah a akhen teiteileh anih in asiangthou ding uhi.
"Gan siang lou, TOUPA kiang a lat ngei louh chi ahihleh, gan pen siampu ma ah akoih ding ahi.
Siampu in ahoihdan bang in aman hun ana sep ding. Siampu in aseh bangbang ahi zel ding hi.
Himahleh atat nawn taktak dingleh na seh zah mun nga a khen mun khat abehlap ding ahi.
"Mi'n a-inn TOUPA a tuam dia alat dingleh ahoih leh hoih louh dungzui in siampu in asep dia; siampu seh bang ahi ding.
Alanmi in a-inn pen atat nawn dingleh aman ding ana seh zah mun nga a khen mun khat abehlap ding hi. Huchi in amah a ahi nawn ding hi.
"Mi'n agam a lou akhen TOUPA a tuam dia alat ding leh na sehdan ding achi tuh dungzui zel in ahi ding. Barli buh homer khat mun, dangka shekel sawmnga man ahi ding.
Alou pen Jubili kum a pan lat ahihleh na seh bang ahitou pek ding.
Jubili kum nung a lat ahihleh bel siampu in Jubili tun nawnna ding kum dungzui zel in aman asep dia, na sehdan a pan akiam hun bawl ahi ding.
Alanmi in atat nawn taktak ding leh aman na seh zah mun nga a khen mun khat abehlap dia, amah a ahi nawn ding hi.
Lou pen atat nop louh hiam, midang kiang a khot hiam ahihleh tat nawn theih ahi kei ding.
Jubili kum a apawt nawn hun in lou pen TOUPA a dia siangthou, amah a tuam siangthou ahi dia siampu a ahi ding hi.
"Amah lou him hilou, aleisa lou, mi'n TOUPA kiang a alatleh,
Jubili kum tan in na sehdan bang in siampu in aman asehsak dia, na seh bang in TOUPA a dia siangthou hi ding in huai ni in ape ding hi.
Jubili kum in aleinapa, agamneipa mah in atang nawn ding.
"Na sehdan tengteng mun siangthou shekel bang zel ahi dia, gerah sawmnih shekel khat ahi ding.
"Ganta lak a piang masapen, apian masakpen ziak a TOUPA a tuam dia sehsa peuhmah kuamah in alan ding ahi kei. Bawngtal leng belam leng hitaleh, TOUPA a tuam ahi.
Gan siang lou ahihleh na sehdan bang a tat ding ahi dia, amun nga a khen mun khat abehlap ding hi. Tat ahihkeileh, na sehdan bang a khot ding ahi.
"Mi'n aneih lak a bangpeuh, mihing hi in, ganta hiam, aneihsa lou hitaleh, TOUPA kiang a apiaksa zuak ding ahi kei a, tat ding leng ahi kei. Huai thil chih TOUPA a dia siangthoupen ahi.
Kuapeuh si dia vai hawmsak, mihing lak a pan manthatsak ding, tat ding ahi kei, amah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
"Gamsung a sawm-a-khat peuhmah, gamsung a haichi hitaleh, singgah hitaleh, TOUPA a ahi. TOUPA a dia thil siangthou ahi.
Mi'n asawm-a-khat atat nopleh, mun nga a khen mun khat abehlap ding ahi.
Bawng leh belam sawm-a-khat thu ah, ganvulmi chiang a chiamtehsa nangawn leng, asawmna zel TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ding.
Huai gan hoih hia, hoih lou, a-enchian ding ahi kei, akhek ding leng ahi sam kei. Akhekleh, akhek pen leh akhekna pen leng anih un siangthou ahi ding ua; tat ding ahi kei hi," achi hi.
Hiaite Israel suante a dia TOUPA'N Sinai Tang a Mosi kiang a thupiakte ahi uhi.
“Huan a thillat, lemna thillat kithoihna ahih a, ganhon lak a alatleh, TOUPA ma ah gensiatbei alan ding ahi”.
Athillat lutung ah akhut akoih dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah agou ding. Aaron tapa siampute'n maitam kimvel ah sisan atheh ding uhi.
Lemna thillat kithoihna, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat alan dia, asungkua, athau leh agilbom tengteng leh,
akal nihte leh atuamthau aphuk chin a omleh asin tuam lam, akalte toh kigawm in asuah ding ahi.
Aaron tapate'n maitam ah mei a sing om tung a halmang thillat tung ah ahal ding uhi. Hiai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ahi.
“Lemna thillat kithoihna a TOUPA a dia athillat belamhon lak ate ahihleh, anu leng hita hen aw, apa leng hitaleh, gensiatbei ahih ding ahi”.
Athillat a, belamnou alatleh TOUPA ma ah alan ding ahi.
Athillat lutung ah akhut akoih ding a, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi ah agou ding. Aaron tapate'n maitam kimvel ah asisan atheh ding uhi.
Lemna thillat kithoihnate, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat alan ding ahi. Athaute leh ameibul thau mahmah atawn in, akawngguh tan in ala vek ding a; asungkua thaute, agilbom tengtengte,
akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam alap, akalte nangawn toh asuah ding ahi.
siampu in huai maitam ah ahal dia; hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat nek ding ansiah ahi.
“Athillat kel ahihleh ToUPA ma ah alan ding ahi,
Alutung ah akhut akoih ding a, kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah agou ding”. Aaron tapate'n maitam kimvel in sisan atheh ding uhi.
Athillat pen alan dia, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat tak, asungkua thau leh agilbom tengteng leh,
akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam lam, akalte toh nangawn in asuah ding ahi.
Hiai siampu in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Gimlim dia mei a thillat nek ding ansiah ahi a; athau tengteng TOUPA a tuam ahi.
Sathau hiam, sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei, chih na suante uh a ding in abanban in na tenna phot uah tangtawn a dan thuseh ahi ding," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'TOUPA'N thilhih louh ding a thu apiakte, abangpeuh leng mi'n na hihkhial kha in, abangpeuh leng na hih taleh,
thaunilh siampu in thil ahihkhelh amipite tung a mohpaihna atunsakleh athilhihkhelhsa thoihna ding in TOUPA kiang ah ganhon lak a pan bawngtuai gensiatbei, khelh thoihna ding in lan hen,
Bawng pen kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah ahon kai dia, bawng lutung ah akhut akoih dia, TOUPA ma ah huai bawng agou ding ahi”.
Thaunilh siampu in bawng sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, kihoupihna biakbuk ah ahon tawi ding hi.
Siampu in sisan ah akhut adiah dia, akhenkhat TOUPA ma ah, mun siangthou puanzak bul ah sagihvei atheh ding ahi.

Siampu in TOUPA ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk a gimlimtak maitam kiite ah huai sisan bangzah hiam atat ding ahi. Bawng sisan tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kiang a halmang thillat maitam bul ah asungkhe ding ahi.
Khelh thoihna bawng thau tengteng, asungkua thau leh agilbom teng leng ala vek dia;
akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam alam, akal nihte nangawn toh asuah ding ahi.
Lemna thillat kithoihna bawngtal a kipan alak bang in, siampu in halmang thillat maitam ah ahal ding ahi.
Bawngvunte, asa tengtengte, alu toh, akhete toh, asungkuate, a-ekte,
abawng pumpi toh giahphual polam mun siang ah, vut paihna ah apaipih dia, sing tung ah ahal ding, vut paihna ahal ding ahi,' achi hi.
"Israel omkhawm tengteng in ahihkhelh khak ua, mipi mitmuh a sel ahih a, TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu apiakte, abang mahmah ahih ua,
siam louh atan ua, athil gilou hih uh theihkhiak ahihleh, mipi in khelh thoihna ding in bawngtuai alan ding ua, kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah ahon kai ding uhi.
Upa omkhawmte'n TOUPA ma ah bawng lutung ah akhut uh akoih ding ua; TOUPA ma a huai bawng goh ding ahi.
Thaunilh siampu in kihoupihna biakbuk ah bawng sisan bangzah hiam ahon tawi ding hi.
Siampu in huai sisan ah akhutzung adiah dia, puanzak bul ah TOUPA ma ah sagihvei atheh ding hi.
Sisan pen kihoupihna biakbuk a TOUPA ma ah maitam kii ah tam lou atat dia, sisan tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kiang a halmang thillat maitam bul ah asungkhe ding ahi.
Athau tengteng ala vek dia, maitam ah ahal ding.
Huchibang in bawng pen ahih dia; khelh thoihna bawng ahih bang geih in hiai leng ahih ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in kilemna abawl ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding uhi.
Huai bawng giahphual pua ah apaipih dia, bawng masa ahal bang in ahal ding hi. Hiai mipi a dia khelh thoihna ahi.
"Vaihawmtu in thil ahihkhelh a, TOUPA a Pathian in hih louh ding a thu apiakte abang pen hiam ahihkhak a, siam louh atan a,
athil gilou hih atheihleh athillat ding in kelpa gensiatbei ahon kai ding ahi.
Kel lutung ah akhut akoih dia, TOUPA ma ah halmang thillat agoh zelna uah agou ding hi”. Hiai khelh thoihna ahi.
Siampu in khelh thoihna sisan akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, maitam kiite ah halmang thillat atat dia, halmang thillat maitam bul ah asisan asungkhe ding hi.
Athau tengteng, lemna thillat kithoihna thau ahal bang in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in akhelhna tungthu ah siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
"Vantang lak a mi, akuamah mah in TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu apiakte abangmah hihkhial in, siam louh na tangleh,
athil gilou hih atheihleh athillat ding in kelnu gensiatbei, athilhihkhelhsa khelh thoihna ding in ahon kai ding hi”.
"Khelh thoihna lutung ah akhut akoih dia, halmang thillatna mun ah khelh thoihna agou ding hi”.
Siampu in asisan, akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, halmang thillat maitam kiite ah atat dia, asisan tengteng maitam bul ah asungkhe ding hi.
Athau tengteng lemna thillat kithoihna thau alak bang in ala vek ding hi. Siampu in TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
"Khelh thoihna dia athillat ding belamnou ahon tawileh, anu, gensiatbei ahon tawi ding ahi”.
Khelh thoihna lutung ah akhut akoih dia, halmang thillat agohna uah khelhna thoihna ding in agou ding hi.
Siampu in khelh thoihna sisan akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, halmang thillat maitam kiite ah atat dia, sisan tengteng maitam bul ah asungkhe ding hi.

Athau tengteng, belamnou thau, lemna thillat kithoihna alak bang in ala vek ding a, siampu in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat bang in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in athilhihkhelhsa tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
"Huan kuapeuh athil muh hiam, athil zak hiam a dia theihpih ahih a, kichiamsakmi aw azak a leng gen nuam lou a, thil ahihkhelhleh athulimlouhna moh apo ding”.
"Kuapeuh in thilsiang lou himhim, gamsa siang lou luang hiam, gan siang lou luang hiam, avakthoh ganhing siang lou luang hiam thei lou a, akhoihkhakleh, siang lou leh mohtang ahi ding hi”.
"Mihing leng asianlouhna bangpeuh hi hen aw, asianlouhna thei lou a, akhoihleh atheihkhiak hun in siam louh atang ding hi”.
"Kuapeuh in thil hoih lou hiam, thil hoih hiam hih dia, akam a thei lou a, akichiam zialzialleh, akoi abang hitaleh, akichiam zialzialna atheihkhiak hun in siam louh atang ding hi”.
"Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai thilte khat a leng siam louh atan chiang in akhelhna apuang ding ahi.

Khelh thoihna ding in belamhon lak ah anu, belamnou hiam kel hiam, athilhihkhelhsa man ding in TOUPA kiang a lat ding in khelhna thoihna ahon tawi dia; siampu in akhelh tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi”.

"Aneih in belamnou achin zoh keileh TOUPA kiang a lat ding in akhelh man ding in akhelh thoihna ding in vakhu nih hiam, vapalnou hiam ahon tawi ding ahi. Khat, khelh thoihna ding in, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in.
Siampu kiang ah ahon tawi dia, ama'n khelh thoihna ding in alan masa dia, phelkhap lou in angawng ah alu ahektan ding hi.
Khelh thoihna sisan maitam pang ah tam lou atheh dia, asisan om lai teng maitam bul ah atakkangsak ding hi. Hiai khelh thoihna ahi.
Akhat pen dan dungzui in halmang thillat ding in alan dia; siampu in athilhihkhelhsa tungthu ah lemna abawlsak dia”, ngaihdam ahi ding.

"Himahleh vakhu nih hiam, vapalnou nih hiam aneih zoh keileh akhelh man thillat ding leh khelh thoihna ding in tangbuang nel dimdem, ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat ahon tawi ding hi. Sathau a buak ding ahi kei a, atung ah begaw akoih ding ahi kei; khelh thoihna ahih ziak in.
Siampu kiang ah ahon tawi dia, siampu in theihgigena ding in apham khat ala dia, maitam tung ah TOUPA a ding in mei a thillat bang in ahal ding ahi. Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi.
Huai thillak a abangmah leng ahihkhelhsa tungtang thu ah siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding. A-om lai teng tangbuang thillat bangmah in siampu tantuam ahi ding," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelh a, TOUPA thil siangthoute tung a akhelh khakleh, akhelh thoihna, belamhon lak a belampa gensiatbei, Mun siangthou shekel bang in, dangka shekel bangzah hiam gun a ngaih, tatlek kithoihna ding in TOUPA a ding in ahon kai ding ahi.

Thil siangthou tung a ana hihdiklouh khitsa pen adin dia, amun nga a khen mun khat abehlap dia, siampu ape ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in tatlek thoihna belampa in kilemna abawlsak dia”, ngaihdam ahi ding.
"Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelh a, hih louh dia TOUPA'N thu apiakte khatpeuh ahihleh, thei kei mahleh siam louh atang himhim dia, athulimlouhna moh apo ding ahi.
Belamhon lak a belampa gensiatbei, aman kilawm hun, tatlek thoihna ding in siampu kiang ah ahon kai ding ahi. Siampu in theiloupi a hihkhelh khak tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding.
Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi a; TOUPA ma ah talek mah ahi," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Kuapeuh in thil hihkhial in, TOUPA thu kalh in talek taleh, sum kepsak thu ah hiam, lep thu ah hiam, guktak thu ah hiam a-invengte khem in, a-invengte zuaubawl taleh,
ahihkeileh, vanmangte mu in, khem in, zuau in kichiam taleh, hiai thil tengteng akhatpeuh leng hihkhial taleh,
hichi ahi ding a, akhial ngei ahih a, siam louh atanleh avan gukte, khem a athillakte, akiang a kepsak sumte, vanmang atopte,
zuau a kichiamna thil bangpeuh leng adit nawn ding ahi. Akim sipsip in adin nawn vek ding a, amun nga a khen mun khat val in abehlap ding. Siam louh atan ni in aneitu ape ding ahi.
Atatlek thoihna, belamhon lak a, aman kilawm hun, belampa gensiatbei tatlek thoihna ding in TOUPA a ding in siampu kiang ah ahon kai ding ahi.
Siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding a, siam louh tanna ding a thil ahih peuhmah tungthu ah, ngaihdam ahi ding,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, hiai halmang thillat dan ding ahi. Haltum thillat pen maitam tung a, ahalna ah zankhua in azingchiang tan in a-om dia; maitam a mei akuang nilouh ding ahi.
Siampu in apuanmalngat puansilh asilh dia, asa khuhna ding in apuanmalngat khekol ateng dia; maitam a halmang thillat kangvute ala dia, maitam pang ah akoih ding ahi.
Apuansilh siangthou asuah dia, puansilh dang asilh dia, avute giahphual pua mun siangthou ah apaipih ding ahi.
Maitam tung ah mei kuansak nilouh ahi dia, amit ding ahi kei. Siampu in zingsang teng in sing akhul dia, halmang thillat akoih hoih dia, huai ah kilemna thillatte thau ahal ding ahi.
Maitam ah mei akuang gige dia, amit ding ahi kei hi.
"Hiai tangbuang thillatdan ding ahi. Aaron tapate'n maitam bul ah, TOUPA ma ah alan ding uh ahi.
Ama'n apham khat in tangbuang thillat tung a begaw tengteng alakhe dia, TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, theihgigena ding in maitam ah ahal ding hi.
Alak bangte Aaron leh atapate'n ane ding uhi. Huai mun siangthou ah silngou soh louh in ane ding ua; kihoupihna biakbuk kongtual ah ane ding uh ahi.
Silngou toh akan ding uh ahi kei. Mei a ka thillat atantuan ding ua ka piak ahi. Huai khelh thoihna leh tatlek thoihna bang a siangthoupen ahi.

Aaron suan pasal tengteng in anek ding uh ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia halmang thillat tungthu a na suante zel uh tan a tangtawn dan ahi ding. Kuapeuh hiaite khoih peuhmah asiangthou ding uh, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Thaunilh a, a-om ni ua, Aaron leh atapate'n TOUPA kiang a alat ding uh thillat hiai ahi. Tangbuang thillat dia lat zel ding, tangbuang nel dimdem ephah sawm a khen mun khat, zingsang in akim, nitak in akim.
Sathau in kuangdai sung ah na kang dia, sathau a akidiah suak khit chiang in na hon lalut dia; na balnen dia, tangbuang thillat TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in na lan ding ahi.
Atapate lak a, asik a pangmi, thaunilh siampu in alan dia; tangtawn dan thuseh ding in TOUPA a dia halmang vek ding ahi.
Siampu in tangbuang thillat a lat peuhmah halmang vek ding ahi a, nek het louh ding ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hiai khelh thoihna dan ding ahi. Haltum thillat goh zelna ah khelh thoihna leng TOUPA ma a goh ding ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
Khelh thoihna lantu siampu in ane dia; kihoupihna biakbuk kongtual ah, mun siangthou ah ane ding ahi.
Kuapeuh huai sa khoih peuhmah asiangthou ding ahi. Asisan pen bang puan peuh a theh ahihleh, abanna peuhmah mun siangthou ah na sawp ding ahi.
Ahuanna leibel pen sukkhap ding ahi. Sumbel a huan ahihleh bel nawtsiang a khuahsiang ding ahi.
Pasal siampu tengteng in huai ane ding uh ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
Khelh thoihna sisan, Mun Siangthou a kilemna bawlna dia kihoupihna puanin a hong kitawi pen nek ding ahi kei, mei a halmang ding ahi.
"Huchi mah bang in hiai tatlek thoihdan ding ahi. Thil siangthoupen ahi.
Haltum thillat agoh zelna ua tatlek kithoihna leng goh ding ahi a; asisan a maitam theh kimvel ding ahi.
Athau tengteng alat ding ahi. Amei thautakte, asungkua thaute,
akal nihte leh aboh thau, aphuk kiang a thau leh asin tuam lap, akalte nangawn in asuahkhe ding ahi.
Siampu in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ding in maitam tung ah ahal ding ahi. Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi.
Pasal siampu tengteng in ane ding ua; mun siangthou a nek ding ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
"Tatlek thoihna pen khelh thoihna mah bang ahi a, dan khat ahi. Kilepna bawltu siampu in huai atang ding hi.
Siampu, kuapeuh halmang thillat latsaktu siampu ngei in halmang thillat dia alat vun apum tan ding ahi.
Akanna a kan tangbuang thillat peuhmah, sikbel a kan leh kuang a kan tengteng alantu siampu atuam ding ahi.
Tangbuang thillat tengteng sathau a mek leng, agaw leng adang mah bang in Aaron tapa tengteng akihawm dialdial ding uh ahi.
"Hiai pen mi'n TOUPA kiang a alat ding, lemna thillat a kithoihdan ding ahi.

Kipahthu genna dia alatleh kipahthu genna kithoihna ding in sathau a zut, silngou soh louh tanghou leh sathau a zut silngou soh louh tanghou pa didekte leh sathau a mek tangbuang nel mahmah kidiah suak a lat tel ding ahi.
"Kipahthu genna dia lemna thillat kithoihna ah tanghou silngou soh alat tel ding ahi.
Huai athillat teng a TOUPA a dia vei thillat a ding in khat chiat alan dia; lemna thillat sisan a thehtu siampu a tuam ding ahi.
Kipahthu genna dia alemna thillat kithoihna sa pen thillat alat ni mah a nekgaih ding ahi. Azingchiang tan a bangmah asit ding ahi kei.
"Himahleh athillat kithoihna pen thuchiam hiam, amah ut thu a thillat hiam ahihleh kithoihna alat ni mah a nek ding ahi a; nek bang azingchiang a nek ding ahi.
Himahleh kithoihna sa, ani thum ni tan a-om lailaileh hal ding ahi.
Alemna thillat kithoihna sa ani thum ni tan a anek uleh, pomsak ahi kei dia, alantu leng alan a sim ahi kei ding. Thilkihhuai ahi dia, kuapeuh ane in athulimlouhna moh uh apo ding hi.
Thilsiang lou himhim toh kisukha sa nek ding ahi kei, hal ding ahi. Sa siang peuhmah nek ding ahi.
Himahleh lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam, siang lou nemi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.

Kuapeuh in thilsiang lou himhim, misiang lou hiam, gan siang lou hiam, thilkihhuai siang lou himhim akhoih a, lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam anekleh huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi, chi in Aaron leh atapate houpih in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam thau na ne ding uh ahi kei.
Amah sih a si thau leh gamsa balzan thau thil dang a dia zat ding ahi. Na ne himhim ding uh ahi kei.
Kuapeuh, TOUPA a dia mi'n mei thillat alat uh sathau nemi, achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
Na tenna peuh uah sisan himhim, vasa hiam, gamsa hiam sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei.
Kuapeuh hitaleh, sisan ne himhim achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi, chi in Israel suante houpih in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"TOUPA kiang a lemna thillat kithoihna lan peuhmah in, TOUPA a dia athillat, alemna thillat kithoihna a pan ahong lat ding ahi.
TOUPA a dia mei a thillat amah khut mahmah in ahon tawi ding a; athau leh a-awm ahon la ding ahi; a-awm pen TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding a vei ahihtheihna ding in.
Siampu in maitam ah athau ahal dia, a-awm bel Aaron leh atapate a tuam ding ahi.
Aliang taklam pen kilemna thillat kithoihna a pan vei thillat dia siampu na piak ding uh ahi.
Aaron tapate lak a lemna thillat sisan leh thau lantu kuapeuh in atantuan ding in aliang taklam atang ding ahi.

A-awm leh aliang avei lel pen uh Israel suante a lemna thillat kithoihna a pan ka la tuam a, Israel suante tangtawn dan thuseh ding in siampu Aaron leh atapate ka pia ahi, chi in Israel suante kiang ah gen in," achi hi.
Hiai ahi, siampu nasem dia TOUPA kiang a lat ahih nungsiah TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a pan Aaron tantuan leh atapate tantuan ding,
amau thau anilh ni a Israel suante'n dan thuseh a apiak gige ding ua TOUPA'N thu apiak. Hiai tangtawn a asuan hong om zel dingte tan a ahihdan ding uh ahi.
Hiai ahi halmang thillat, tang- buang thillat, khelh thoihna leh tatlek kithoihna dan.
Sinai gamdai a Israel suante'n thillat TOUPA kiang a alat ding ua thu apiak ni a Sinai Tang a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak ahi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron atapate toh pi inla, puansilhte, nilhchi sathau, khelh thoihna bawngtalte, belampa nihte, tanghou silngou soh louh bawm khat toh tawi inla,
Omkhawmte tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kim ah paikhawmsak in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Mosi in ahih a; omkhawmte tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kim ah a-omkhawm uhi.
Mosi in omkhawmte kiang ah, "Hiai ahi, TOUPA'N hih dia ahon thupiak pen," achi hi.
Mosi in Aaron leh atapate ahon pi a, tui in amaute asil hi.
Puanak asilhsak a, kawnggakna in agak a, puanaktual asilhsak a, siampu puanak in atuam a, siampu puanak gakna siamtak a gat in agak a, huai in agakbelh hi.
Awmtuamna athuah a, awmtuamna ah Urim leh Thummim akoih hi.
Dial akhimsak a, dial tung ah dangka-eng sikpek abulh a, huai mailam ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in siampu lukhu siangthou akilhbelh hi.
Mosi in nilhchi sathau ala a, biakbuk leh asung a thil om teng-teng anilh a, asiangthousak chiat hi.
Huai mah in sagihvei maitam atheh a, maitam leh atui-um belsuan tengteng, maiphiatna kuang leh atunna siangthousak ding in anilh hi.
Huai sathau Aaron lu ah abuak a asianthouna ding in anilh hi.
Mosi in Aaron tapate ahon pi a, puanak sungsilh tualte asilhsak a, kawnggakna in agak a, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in dial akhimsak hi.
Khelh thoihna bawngtal ahon kai a, Aaron leh atapate'n khelh thoihna ding bawngtal lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
Agou a; Mosi in asisan ala a, huai maitam a dia kilemna bawlna ding in akhutzung in maitam kii ah akimvel in atat a, maitam asiangsak a, maitam bul ah sisan sung in asiangthousak hi.
Agilbom tengteng, asin, alap, akal nihte leh athau ala a, maitam tung ah Mosi in ahal hi.
Bawngtal pen avun toh, asa toh, a-ek toh giahphual pua ah ahal hi; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
Haltum thillat belampa pen alan a, Aaron leh atapate'n belampa lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
Agou a, Mosi in maitam sisan in akimvel in atheh hi.
Belampa asem a, alu, asemnente leh athau ahal hi.
Asungkua leh akhete asil a; belampa pen maitam ah avek in ahal hi. Huai gimlim dia halmang thillat ahi a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
Belampa dang, hihtuamna belampa pen ahon la nawn a, Aaron leh atapate'n belampa lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
Mosi in agou a, asisan ala a, Aaron bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi anuh hi.
Mosi in Aaron tapate api a, abil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi, akhe taklam khepi anuh a, maitam sisan in akimvel ah atheh hi.
Athaute, amei thau, agilbom tengteng asin tuam pen alapte, akal nih leh athau leh aliang taklam ala hi:
TOUPA ma a tanghou silngou soh louh bawm a pan tanghou silngou soh louh khat leh sathau a mek tanghou pei khat leh tanghou peipa'n khat ala a, thau tung leh aliang taklam tung ah akoih hi.
Avek in Aaron khutpek tung ah leh atapate khutpek tung ah akoih a, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in avei hi.
Mosi in akhut a pan ala a, halmang thillat tung ah maitam ah ahal hi. Huai gimlim dia ahihtuamna ahi. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
Mosi in a-awm ala a, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in avei a; hihtuamna belampa Mosi tantuam ahi, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.

Mosi in nilhchi sathau a pan tam lou leh maitam asisan tam lou ala a, huai in Aaron leh apuansilhte atheh a; atapate leh atapate puansilhte leng atheh hi. Aaron leh apuansilh ahihsiangthou a, atapate leh atapate puansilhte leng ahihsiangthou hi.
Mosi in Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, "Kihoupihna puanin kongpi bul ah sa huan unla, Aaron leh atapate'n anek ding uh ahi, chi a thu ka piak bang in, huai ah hihtuamna bawm a tanghou toh ne uhen.
Sa leh tanghou nekbangte na hal ding uh ahi.
Na kihihtuamna ni uh achin masiah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi pawtsan lou in ni sagih na om ding uh ahi. Ni sagih sung nou hon hihtuam ding ahi ngal a.
Tuni a ahihsa bang in, nou a dia kilemna hon bawlsak ding in TOUPA'N thu apeta hi.
Huaiziak in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah ni sagih, sun leh zan in na om nilouh ding ua, na sihlouhna ding ua TOUPA thupiak na zuih ding uh ahi; huchibang ding a thu piak ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi zang a ahih ding ua thu apiak tengteng Aaron leh atapate'n ahih uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani giat ni in Mosi in Aaron leh atapate leh Israel upate asam hi.
Aaron kiang ah, "Khelh thoihna ding in bawngnoupa leh halmang thillat ding in belampa gensiatbei tuaktuak kai inla, TOUPA ma ah lan in," achi hi.
"Israel suante kiang ah, 'Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa, halmang thillat ding in bawngnou leh belamnou kum khat a upa tuaktuak gensiatbei tuak
leh bawngtal leh belampa, sathau a mek tangbuang thillat toh TOUPA ma a lemna thillat a lat ding in hon kai un.' Tuni in na kiang uah TOUPA ahong kilang ding hi, chi in hilh in,” achi hi.
Mosi in thu apiak bang in kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah ahon kai ua; TOUPA ma ah omkhawmte tengteng in ava naih ua, ava dingh uhi.
Mosi in, “Hiai ahi na hih ding ua Toupa'n thu ahon piak, na lak uah TOUPA thupina ahong kilang ding," achi hi.

Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Maitam hon naih inla, na khelh thoihna leh na halmang thillat lan inla, nang a ding leh mipite a ding in kilemna bawl in. Mipite thillat pen lan inla, amau a ding in kilemna bawl in, TOUPA thupiak bang in,” achi hi.
Aaron in maitam ava naih a, amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngnou agou hi.
Aaron tapate'n akiang ah sisan ahon tawi ua, huai sisan ah akhutzung adiah a, maitam kiite ah atat a, sisan pen maitam bul ah asung hi.
Himahleh, khelh thoihna thau, akalte leh asin tuam pen lapte, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in maitam tung ah ahal hi.
Asa leh avun giahphual pua ah ahal hi.
Haltum thillat pen agou a; Aaron tapate'n asisan apia ua, ama'n maitam kimvel in atheh hi.
Haltum thillat sabakte leh alu apia ua, ama'n maitam ah ana hal hi.
Asungkuate leh akhete asil a, maitam ah halmang thillat tung ah ahal hi.
Mipite thillat pen alan a, mipite khelh thoihna kel akai a, agou a, ama a mah bang in khelh thoihna ding in alan hi.
Haltum thillat alan a, adan bang in alan hi.
Tangbuang thillat alan a, huai a pan pham khat ala a, zingsang a halmang thillat chih louh leng maitam ah ahal lai hi.
Mipite atuam dia lemna thillat kithoihna bawngtal leh belampa leng agou a, Aaron tapate'n asisan apia ua, maitam kimvel ah atheh hi.
Bawngtal thau leh belampa thau, amei thau, agilbomte, akalte, asin tuam pen alapte leng apia uhi.
Athau pen a-awmte tung ah akoih a, ama'n athau pen maitam ah ahal hi.
A-awm leh aliang taklam pen, Mosi thupiak bang in Aaron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in avei hi.
Aaron in mipi lam ah aban azak a, avek un avualzawl hi. Khelh thoihna, halmang thillat leh lemna thillat alat zoh in ahong paisuk hi.
Kihoupihna puanin ah Mosi leh Aaron ava lut ua, ahong pawtkhe nawn ua, mipite avualzawl uhi. TOUPA thupina mi tengteng kiang ah ahong kilang hi.
TOUPA ma a pan mei ahong pawtkhia a, halmang thillat leh thaute maitam ah akangtumta hi. Mipi tengteng in huai amuh un akikou zuazua ua, lei si in abokkhup uhi.
Huai thilte i lak ua tak petpet a gintak a om, mi tampi in athu gelh ana tup uh,
atung a pan a mute leh thu nasemte'n ahon hilh bang un,
Theophilus aw, abul a pan bangkim chiantak in ka sui a, kizom zel in nang a ding in kigelhleh ahoih ding, ka chi hi;
huai tuma a nang ahon hilh uh thudik ahi chih na theihsemna ding in.
Judia gam kumpipa Herod adam lai in, Abijah pawl a mi amin Zakariah a-om a; huai mi in Aaron tanute lak a khat zi in anei a, amin Elizabeth ahi.
Anih un Pathian mitmuh in diktat in a-om ua, gensiatbei in Toupa thupiak leh adan thuseh tengteng zui in a-om zel uhi.
Himahleh Elizabeth achiin ziak in ta anei kei ua, anih un upa pitak ahi tuak uhi.
Huan hichibang ahi a, apawlte hihdan ngeina bang a Pathian ma a siampu nna sem a a-om lai in,
siampu dan bang in Toupa tempul a lut leh gimlim hal atan ahi.
Gimlim hal hun lai in mipite avek un inpua ah ana thum uhi.
Toupa angel khat gimlim halna maitam taklam a dingh in akiang ah akilak hi.
Zakariah in amuhtak in alungzing a, lauh leng alau hi.
Himahleh angel in akiang ah, "Zakariah, lau ke'n, na ngetna zak a a-om ziak in, na zi Elizabeth in tapa hon neihsak dia, amin Johan na sak ding ahi.
Huan nang nuam in na kipak ding a; amah apian in mi tampi akipak ding uhi.
Toupa ngaih in milian ahi dia, uain leh zu himhim adawn kei ding; anu sung a pan in Kha Siangthou in adim ding hi.
Israel suante tampi Toupa a Pathian lam uh angasak nawn ding hi.

Pate lungtang tate lam angasak ding, michihmohte midiktat pilna lam ngasak ding, Toupa a dia mipite mansa a omsak ding a bawlkhol ding in Elijah lungsim leh thilhihtheihna pu in Toupa ma ah apai ding," achi hi.
Huan Zakariah in angel kiang ah, "Huai bangchi in ka thei dia? Kei putekpi hi ing a, ka zi leng pitek ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Angel in adawng a, akiang ah, "Kei Gabriel, Pathian ma a dingh zel ka hi; nang hon houpih ding leh hiai thuhoih hon hilh ding a sawl ka hi.
Ngai in ka thugente ahuntak a hong tung ding, na gintak louh ziak in huai thilte ahong tun masiah na dai dide ding a, pau leng na pau thei kei ding," achi hi.
Huan mipite'n Zakariah ana ngak ua, tempul sung a a-om sawt ziak in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huan ahong pawt in akiang uah thu agen theita kei hi; huchi in tempul ah kha kilak amu ahi chih atheita ua; akiang uah chiamtehnate abawl a, pau thei lou in a-om hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, anasepna ni akimtak in a-inn ah apaita hi.
Huai nite nung in, azi Elizabeth agaita a, kha nga akisel zoh in,
"Mi lak a ka minse khuhna ding in, Toupa'n ahon muh in, hichibang in ka tung ah ahihta," achi hi.
Huan akha gukna ah Pathian in Galili gam a khua khat Nazaret achih uah, angel Gabriel,
nungak siangthou khat kiang ah asawl a, huai nungak tuh David suan a mi khat amin Joseph toh kikham ahi ua; nungak min Mari ahi.
Huan akiang ah angel alut a, "Chibai, nang nakpitak a deihtuam; na kiang ah Toupa a-om," achi hi.
Huai thugen ziak in alunghimoh mahmah a, bangchidan a chibai hon buk adiam aw? chi in akingaihtuah hi.
Angel in akiang ah, "Mari, lau ke'n; Pathian a pan deihsakna na tang hi.
Ngai in, na gai ding a, tapa na nei dia, amin Jesu na sa ding hi.
Amah milian ahong hi ding a, Tungnungpen Tapa achi ding uh. Toupa Pathian in apu David laltutphah ape dia,
Jakob suante tung ah tangtawn in vai ahawm dia, agam in bei ni anei kei ding,” achi hi.
Huan Mari in angel kiang ah, "Hiai bangchi in ahi thei dia? Pasal lah nei lou ing a," achi hi.

Huan angel in adawng a, akiang ah, "Na tung ah Kha Siangthou ahong tung ding a, Tungnungpen thilhihtheihna in ahon liahkhum ding, huaiziak in misiangthou hong piang ding leng, siangthou Pathian Tapa chih in a-om ding, achi hi.
Ngai in, na sanggamnu Elizabeth in leng atek nung in tapa apaita; achiing achih uh, tu kha akha gukna ahita hi.
Pathian thupawt himhim thil hi thei lou a-om kei," achi hi.
Mari in, "Ngai in, Toupa sikhanu ka hi, na thu bang zel in ka tung ah tung hen," achi hi. Huan angel in apaisanta hi.
Huai lai in Mari athou a, singtang ah, Judia gam a khua khat ah ahoh pah hi.
Zakariah inn ah alut a, Elizabeth chibai abuk hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mari in Elizabeth chibai abuktak in, asung a naungek ahong kitawm a; Kha Siangthou in Elizabeth ahong dimta hi; aw ngaihtak in akikou a,
"Nang numei sapsap ding in na hampha hi, na gilgah leng ahampha hi.
Ka Toupa nu ka kiang a na hong bangchidan ahia oi?
Ngai in, na hon chibai buk husa ka bil a aluttak in, akipah ziak in ka sung a naungek akitawm hi.
Agingtanu leng ahampha hi, akiang a Toupa thugen tangtung ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.
Huan Mari in: "Ka nuntakna in Toupa apahtawi e,
ka kha leng ka Hondampa Pathian tung ah akipak mahmah a.
Asikhanu namtomdan amu a, ahehpih a; ngai in, tunung siah khang tengteng in hampha ahon chi ding uh.
Amah mihat in ka tung ah thil thupitak ahon hihsak a, amin leng asiangthou hi.
Amah laute tung ah akhang- akhang in azahngaihna a-om hi.
Aban in athahatdan a-ensak a, mikisatheite alunggelna uh ahihdalhta hi.
Alaltutphah ua tu kumpipate akaikhia a, namtomte apahtawita hi.
Gilkialte thil hoih in ahihvah a, mihaute khutvuak in apaimangsakta hi.
Asikha Israel taksap awng ahuta a, azahngaihna theihgigena ding in.
I pipute Abraham leh asuante kiang a tangtawn thuchiam agen bang ahi."
Akiang uah kha thum vel Mari a-om a, a-inn ah akik nawnta hi.
Huan Elizabeth nau neih ahong hunta a; huchi in tapa ahon neita hi.
Toupa'n atung ah azahngaihna thupi asuah chih avengte leh asanggamte'n ana za ua, akipahpih uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani giat ni in naungek zeksum ding in ahong pai ua; amin ding in apa min mah Zakariah sak atum uhi.
Anu'n, "Hilou e, Johan chih ding ahi," chi in adawng hi.
Anu kiang ah, "Na sanggamte lak ah hiai min pu kuamah a-om kei uh, achi uhi.
Huan apa kiang ah chiamtehna bawl in, amin ding in bang sa lehang na deih a? achi uhi.
Huan laigelhna pek angen a, amin Johan ahi," chi in agelh hi.
Avek un lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Thakhat in akam hong kihong in, alei ahong kiphel a, Pathian phat in ahong paukheta hi.
Akim ua omte tengteng in alauta ua; huchi in huai thute Judia gam singtang gam tengteng ah athangta hi.
Aza peuhmah in, alungtang un avei chiat ua, "Huai naungek bangchi phet ahong hi diam aw?" achi uhi. Huan Toupa khut in amah apanpih hi.
Huan apa Zakariah, Kha Siangthou in adim a, agenkhol a,
"Toupa Israel' Pathian phat in om hen, amite ahong veh a, tatna abawlsak hi.
Asikha David inkuante lak ah hotdamna kii ahon bawlsak tak ziak in;
Tang lai a pan a zawlnei siangthoute kam a agen bang in.
I doute lak leh hon ho tengteng lak a hotdam a i om ding thu,
I pipute kiang a achiam zahngaihna tangtungsak ding leh athukhun siangthou theigige ding in.
I pu Abraham kiang a kichiam a,
I doute lak a ahon humbit a, lau lou a ama nna i sepna ding in.
I damsung teng a amitmuh a siangthou leh diktattak a omna ding in.
Ahi, Bawi, nang zaw Tungnungpen Zawlnei ahon chi ding ua; alampite bawlkhol ding in Toupa ma ah na pai ding hi.
Akhelhnate uh ngaihdamna dia amite kiang a hotdamna theihna pe ding in.
I Pathian lungtang a zahngaihna nou ngiingei ziak in, huchi in tunglam a kipan i tung a ninou suak in ahong veh ding a,
mial lak leh sihna lim a tute tanvak ding leh khamuanna lampi a i khete kalsuansak ding in," achi hi.
Huan naungek ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, akhalam ahong hat hiaihiai a, Israelte kiang a ahong kilak masiah gamdai ah a-om gige hi.
Huai khit in Toupa'n midang sawmsagih asep a, apaina ding kho teng leh mun teng ah, ama ah nihnih in asawl hi.
Akiang uah, "Buh lak ding atam mahmah a, himahleh asemte atawm uh, huchi in abuh la ding a sem dingte sawl ding in buh neipa kiang ah ngen un.
Pai un; ngai un, ngehon lak a belamnou bang in ka hon sawl ahi.
Dangka ip, kawlzal leh khedap tawi kei unla, lampi ah kuamah chibai buk kei un.
Huan inn na lutna peuh uah amasapen in, 'Hiai inn ah khamuanna tung hen!' chi un.
Huai inn a khamuanna ta a-omleh na khamuanna thu uh atung ah a-om ding a; a-om keileh na kiang uah ahong kik nawn ding hi.
Huai inn ah tung in om nilouh unla, ahon piak peuh uh ne in dawn un; nasemmi loh mu tak ahi. Inn teng ah ban hoh kei un.
Huan khua na lutna peuh uah hon kipahpih uleh, hon lui peuh uh na ne ding ua; huai a damlou omte leng na hihdam ding ua;
akiang uah, 'Pathian lalgam na kiang uah hong tungta,' na chi ding uh.
Khua na lutna peuh uah hon kipahpih kei uleh akongzing uah paikhia unla,
na kho leivui uh ka khepek ua bang teng na tung uah tatsiang ung e; himahleh Pathian lalgam ahong naita chih thei un, na chi ding uhi.
K'on hilh ahi, huai ni chiang in huai khuate thuak sang in Sodom khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding hi.
"Korazin, na tung agik e! Bethsaida, na tung agik e! Noumau a thillamdang kihihte Tura leh Sidon a hih hileh, sai-ip puan silh a vut lak a tu in akisik khin thamta ding uh.
Himahleh thukhen ni chiang in nou thuak sang in Tura leh Sidon khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding.
Huan nang Kapernaum, van tan ah tawisang in na om a, misikhua a sawnkhiak a om ding na hi.

"Kuapeuh na thu uh ngaikhia keimah thu ngaikhia ahi a; kuapeuh nou hon deih lou kei hon deih lou ahi; kuapeuh nou hon ngai lou kei hon ngai lou ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon ngai lou tuh hon sawlpa ngai lou ahi," achi hi.
Huan sawmsagihte kipaktak in ahong kik nawn ua, "Toupa, dawite nangawn na min ziak in ka thuthu un a-om uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Khophia bang in van a kipan Setan hong kia ka mu hi.
Ngai un, gulte, aikamte sikdenna thu leh melma thilhihtheihna tengteng tung a thuneihna ka hon pia ahi; bangmah in ahon hih na kei hial ding.
Himahleh dawite na thuthu ua a-om ziak un kipak kei un; van a na min uh gelh ahih ziak in kipak zaw un,” achi hi.

Huai laitak in Jesu, Kha Siangthou in akipak mahmah a, "Pa aw, lei leh van Toupa, nang mipil leh mibengvakte kiang ah hiai thu na iim a, naungekte kiang a na than ziak in ka hon phat hi; ahi, Pa, huchibang hih nang ngaih in ahoih ahi.
Ka Pa'n bangkim ahon kemsak a, Tapa kua ahia, Pa lou ngal kuamah in athei kei, Pa leng kua ahia, Tapa leh akiang ua Tapa in atheihsak nopnate kia lou ngal kuamah in athei kei," achi hi.
Huan nungzuite lam anga a, asim in, "Na thil muhte uh amu mitte ahampha e!
K'on chi ahi, zawlnei tampi leh kumpipa tampite'n leng na thil muhte uh muh akilawp gige ua, himahleh amu kei uh, bil a na zakte uh leng zak akilawp thei mahmah ua, himahleh aza kei uh," achi hi.
Huan ngai un dan thei mi kuahiam adingh a, amah ze-etna ding in, "Sinsakpa, tangtawn hinna neihna ding in bang ka hih dia?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Dan laibu ah bang gelh ahia? Bangchi in na sim a?" achi hi.

Huan ama'n, "Toupa, na Pathian na lungtang tengteng, na kha tengteng, na hatna tengteng, na lungsim tengteng in na it ding ahi; nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi, chih," chi in adawng hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Na dawng dik hi; huchi in hih lechin na hing ding,” achi hi.
Ama'n bel kisiamtansak ut in, Jesu kiang ah, "Ahihleh, ka inveng kua ahia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, "Kuahiam Jerusalem a kipan Jeriko ah ahohsuk a, suamhatte atuak hi. Amau apuansilh asuahsak vek ua, avua ua, si dektak in apaisanta uhi.
Huan huai lampi ah siampu kuahiam ava paisuk a, amuhtak in lampi sik lehlam ah apel maimah hi.
Huan huchibang mah in Levi chimi khat leng huai mun ahong tung a, amuhtak in lampi sik lehlam ah apel maimah hi.
Himahleh, Samaria gam a mi kuahiam zin pai lai a-omna ahong tung a, amuhtak in alainat mahmah hi.
Akiang ah ava hoh a, aliamnate thau leh uain abuak a, atuam a, amah gan tung ah atuangsak a, khualbuk ah apaipih a, akemta hi.
Huan azing in makhai nih asuahkhia a, khualbuk kempa kiang ah apia a, amah na kem inla, hiai ban ana zat teng, ka hong kik nawn chiang in ka hon din ding," achi hi.
Huai mi thumte lak ah, suamhatte tuakpa a ding in, invengte hi pen kua hi in na gingta a? achi hi.
Ama'n, "Huai atung a zahngaihna suahpa," achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang leng huai mah bang in va hih in," achi hi.
Huan azin kawm un khua khat ah alut a; numei khat amin Martha in ana zintun hi.
Huai minu'n sanggam numei khat anei a, amin Mari ahi, huai minu Toupa khebul ah atu a, athu angaikhia hi.
Martha in bel nna sem in abuai mahmah a; huchi in akiang a hong pai in, "Toupa, ka sanggamnu'n kei kia nasem ding a hon khiat khawk sa lou na hi maw? Hon huh ding in sawl in,” achi hi.
Toupa'n, "Martha, Martha, thil tampi na ngaihtuah a, buai nei ve; thil khat kia akul ahi;
Mari in tan hoih atel a, huai laksak ding ahi kei," chi in adawng hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu koi lai mun hiam ah athum a, athum khit in anungzui mi khat in akiang ah, "Toupa, Johan in anungzuite thumdan ahilh bang in hon hilh sam in," achi hi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Na thum chiang un hichibang in na chi ding uh, achi hi: Ka Pa uh, van a om, na min kizahtak hen, na gam hong tung hen.
Niteng in ka nek khop uh an hon pia in.
Ka khelhnate uh hon ngaidam in, kou leng kuapeuh bat hon neite ka ngaidam uhi; Khemna ah hon pilut ke'n. Gilou lak ah hon hu zaw in."
Huan akiang uah, "Na lak ua kuahiam in lawm nei henla, zan lai in akiang a hoh in, 'Lawm, tanghou phel thum hon leitawisak ve.
Ka lawm zin in ahon tawn a, ama a lui ding bangmah ka nei kei,' chi henla;
ama'n insung a pan in, 'Hon hihbuai ke'n; tu'n zaw kong khak ahi, ka tate leng ka kiang ah lupna ah a-ihmuta uh; thou in ka hong pe thei kei chi in dawng taleh, ka hon hilh ahi,'
alawm ahih ziak in thou in ava pe kei na a, anget ngutngut ziak in thou in adeih zahzah ava pe ding hi.
"Huchi in ka hon hilh ahi, 'Ngen un, piak in na om ding uh; zong un, na mu ding uh; kiu un, honsak in na om ding uh.
Kuapeuh angen in angah a, kuapeuh azong in amu a, akiu peuhmah honsak in a-om ding hi.'
Nou lak a papen, ata in tanghou ngen taleh kua ahia suang pe ding? Ahihleh ngasa ngen taleh kua ahia gul pe ding?
Ahihkeileh, aktui ngen taleh aikam ape dia hia?
Huchi in nou migilou in bawn na tate thil hoih piakdan na theih uleh, na Pa uh van a om in angente Kha Siangthou pe na tel in chia!" achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n dawi pau thei lou khat adelhkhia hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, dawi apawttak in pau thei lou ahong pauta; huchi in mipi'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Himahleh akhen in, "Dawimang Beelzibul ziak in ei ve dawite adelhkhiak zel," achi uhi.
Akhen in, amah ze-etna ding in, van a kipan chiamtehna angen uhi.
Ama'n angaihtuah uh athei a, akiang uah, "Koi gam leng amah kidou peuh amangthang a; inkuan khat leng amah kidou amangthang hi.
Setan leng amah akidouleh agam bangchi in adingkhe dia? Beelzibul ziak in dawite adelhkhia, na hon chi uh maw;
ke'n Beelzibul ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh, na tate un kua ziak in ahia adelhkhiak uh? Huaiziak in amau noute hon vai hawmsak dingte ahi ding uh.
Himahleh ke'n Pathian khutzung ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh Pathian lalgam na kiang uah ahong tung khinta hi.
"Mihat in hiamzat kim tawi a a-inn aven sung teng, asum bittak in a-om gige hi.
Himahleh amah sang a hatzaw in ahong sual a, azoh chiang in, amuan agalvan kim asut a, sum alaksak a ahawmzak zel hi.
"Kuapeuh ka lam a pang lou tuh hon dou ahi a, kuapeuh hon lakkhawmpih lou in ahihzak hi.
"Dawi nin paimi sung a kipan apawt in, khawlna zong in tui omlouhna mun peuh ah avakvak hi. Huan khawlna himhim amu kei a, ka pawtna inn ah ka kik nawn mai ding," achi hi.
Ava tun in phiatsiang leh zephoih in amu hi.
Huaitak in ava pai a, amah sang a gilouzaw dawi dang sagih ahon pi a, huai mi sung ah alut ua, ateng uhi. "Huai mihing omdan nanung, amasa sang in ahoih kei zaw tham hi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thute agen lai in, mipi lak ah numei khat akikoukhia a, akiang ah, "Nang hon painu gil leh, nang hon vaktu nawi ahampha e,” achi hi.
Ama'n bel, "Pathian thu za a zuite mihampha ahi zaw uh," achi hi.
Huan mipite akiang a ahong kikhop lai un, Jesu'n, "Hiai khang giloute ahi uh; chiamtehna azong ua; himahleh Jonah chiamtehna chih louh akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding.
Nineveh a mite a dia chiamtehna Jonah ahih bang in, Mihing Tapa leng hiai khangte chiamtehna ahong hi ding hi.

Thukhen ni chiang in, Simlam kumpinu hiai khangte kiang ah adingh dia, siam louh atangsak ding; Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in kawlmong a kipan ahong ngal a; ngai un, Solomon sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.
Thukhen ni chiang in, Nineveh khua a mite hiai khangte kiang ah adingh ding ua, siam louh atangsak ding uh, Jonah thuhilh ziak in akisik ngal ua; ngai un, Jonah sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.
"Kuamah in khawnvak akimu lou ding in asel kei a, loh nuai ah leng akoih ngei sam kei uh, alut mite'n vak amuhtheihna ding un akoihna ah akoih zel uhi.
Na pumpi khawnvak na mit ahi; na mit achiimleh na pumpi leng avek in avaksuak nak hi; achiim keileh bel na pumpi amial vek nak hi.
Huchi in na sung a vak om mial ana hi kha ding e, pilvang in.
Huchi in na pumpi koi lai peuh mial lou a, avek a avakkhiakleh khawnvak vak petpet in atatvak bang in avakkhe vek ding," achi hi.
Huan agen lai in Pharisai khat in amah kiang a an ne ding in achial a; huchi in alut a an ane hi.
Pharisai in an um amuh in, an nek ma a khut asil louh lamdang asa mahmah hi.
Toupa'n akiang ah, "Nou Pharisaite'n nou leh kuang polam na silsiang ngeitak ua; na sunglam uh lah lepgukna leh gilou in adim hi.
Mihaite aw, polam bawlpa'n sunglam leng abawl kei a hia?
Himahleh na neihte uh migenthei kiang a thilthawnpiak ding in zang un; huchi in ngai un, nou a ding in bangkim asiang vek hi.

"Nou Pharisaite aw, na tung uh agik e; pudina, pardi leh anteh-louhing teng sawm-a-khat na pia ua, diktatna leh Pathian itna na limsak kei uhi; himahleh huaite ei ve na hih ding uh, adangte hih lou tuan lou in.
Nou Pharisaite aw, na tung uh agik e! Sinagog ah tutphah hoihpente leh dawr mun a chibai bukte na ngaisang uh.
Laigelhmite leh Pharisai lepchiahte, na tung uh agik hi! Han chiamteh louh, atung a thei lou a mi apaina zel bang na hi uh," achi hi.
Huan dan thei mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, hiai thu na gen kou leng hon tai na hi," chi in adawng hi.
Huan ama'n, "Dan thei mite aw, nou leng na tung uh agik! Puakgik, puak haksa pipi mite na suan ua, nou lah huai puakgikte na khutzung khat un leng na khoih ngei kei uh.
Na tung uh agik! Na pipute uh thahsa zawlneite han inn na lam ngal ua.
Huchi in na pipute uh thilhihte na theihpih un na hoihsakpih uh ahi; amau athat ua, nou ahan innte na lam uhi.
Huaiziak in 'Pathian pilna in leng, akiang uah zawlneite leh sawltakte ka sawl dia, akhen athat ding ua, akhen asawi ding uh,' achi hi.
Zawlnei tengteng sisan, leitung pian tung a kipan a kisuah, hiai khangte tung ah phu alak theih ding in achi hi.
Abel sisan suah a kipan, Zakariah, maitam leh tempul kikal a sisan suah tan in; ahi, ka hon hilh ahi, hiai khangte tung ah phu akila ding.
Nou dan theite aw, na tung uh agik e! Theihna chabi na paimangpih ua; nou lah na lut ngal kei ua, mi alut dingte na dal uhi,” achi hi.
Huai a kipan apawt in, lai-gelhmite leh Pharisaite'n amah atawng ua, thu chiteng gensak teitei tum in leh,
apaukhelh zenzenleh mat tum in atang gige uhi.
Huchih lai a mipi sang tampi kiphu mawimawi zou hial a ahong kikhop un, Jesu'n amasapen in anungzuite kiang ah, "Pharisaite silngou, lepchiahna lak ah pilvang un,
kilang lou ding a selguk bangmah a-om kei a; theih louh ding a iim leng bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
Huaiziak in mial a na gen peuh uh vak a zak in a-om ding; dantan sunggil a bilbul a na thugen uh intung vum ah tangkoupih in a-om ding hi.
"Huan ka lawmte aw, ka hon hilh ahi, pumpi that a, huai nung a bangmah dang hih nawn theiloute zaw, kihta kei un,
Himahleh kua ahia na lauh ding uh ka hon hilhkhol ahi; ahihlup nung a leng Gehenna a paihtheihna thuneipa lau un.
"Dal dangka nih in kawlgit nga azuak sek kei ua hia? Himahleh alak ua khat leng Pathian in amangngilh ngei kei hi.
Na luzang ua samzangte nangawn leng sim vek ahi uh. Lau kei un; kawlgit tampi sang in na manphazaw uhi.
"Huan ka hon hilh ahi, mite ma a hon gum peuhmah Pathian angelte ma ah Mihing Tapa in agum sam ding hi.
Himahleh mite ma a hon kitheihmohbawl peuhmah Pathian angelte ma ah ka kitheihmohbawl sam ding hi.
Mihing Tapa kalh a thu gen peuhmah agenkalhna ngaihdamsak ahi ding a; himahleh Kha Siangthou hilhial gensia zaw agensiatna ngaihdamsak ahi kei ding.
"Sinagog a mite, vaihawmte, heutute ma a ahon pi hun chiang un, bangchi in bang thu in ka dawng dia, bang thu ka gen dia chi in lungkham kei un.
Huai huntak in, bang ahia na gen ding uh, Kha Siangthou in ahon hilh ding hi,” achi hi.
Mipi lak a khat in Jesu kiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ka u kiang ah gou hon hawm sam ding in hilh in," achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang ah, "Mihing, noumau tung ah kua'n ahia kei thukhenpa hiam tan seppa hiam a hon bawl?" achi hi.
Akiang uah, "Pilvang unla, enna lak ah kiveng un; hauhna mihing damsan ahi kei," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah gentehna thu agen a, "Mihau kuahiam ahong pung mahmah hi.
Huchi in akingaihtuah a, bangchibang in ka hih diam aw? Ka buh-le-bal koihkhawmna ding ka nei kei hi.
Hichibang in ka hih ding e, 'ka buh innte ka phel ding a, asang a lianzaw in ka lam dia, huai ah buh leh ka van tengteng ka koihkhawm ding.'
Huan ka kha kiang ah, 'Kha aw, kum tampi sung daih ding tampi na kholta; khawl inla, ne in dawn inla, nuamtak in om in, ka chi ding,' achi hi.
Himahleh, Pathian in akiang ah, 'Nang mihai, tuzan chiah na kha ahon laksak ding uh, huai na lamkhiakte, kua a ahita dia?'
Amau a dia gou khol a, Pathian lam a hauloute huchi ahi uh," achi hi.
Huan anungzuite kiang ah, "Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, bang ka ne diam aw? chi in na hinna thu uh leh bang silh in ka teng diam aw? chi in na pumpi thu uah lunghimoh kei un.
