Nek ding sang in hinna athupizawa, puansilh sang in leng pumpi athupizaw hi.
Va-akte ngaihtuah dih uh, buh atuh kei ua, a-at sam kei uh; buhpang leh buh inn leng anei kei uh; himahleh Pathian in amaute avak hi; noute vasate sang a manphazaw na hi uh.
Huan nou lak ah lunghimoh ziak a kua'n ahia ama dunglam tong khat a hihsang thei tuan?
Hiai lel leng hihtheiloute'n bangziak a thil dang lunghimoh nak na hi ua?

Lilite khandan ngaihtuah dih uh; nna asem kei ua, khau leng akhek kei uh; himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Solomon hilhial leng athupina tengteng a akizep in, hiai lilite lak a khat tuk in zep in a-om kei hi.
Huchi in gamlak loupa tuni a hing a, azing a thukkhuk a khul nawn mai ding bawn Pathian in hichi tel a azepleh, aw nou mi gintawmte, huaite sang in puansilh hon pe zaw na tel in chia!
Huan na nek ding uh, na dawn ding uh, zong kei un; ginglel in leng om sam kei un.
Khovel a namte'n huai thil tengteng azong uh; huai bang na kiphamoh uh chih na Pa un atheigige hi.
Himahleh Pathian kumpigam zong zaw un, huchi in huai thilte leng ahon piak behlap ding hi.
"Pawltawmte aw, lau kei un; nou kiang a gam piak ding na Pa uh kipah lamtak ahi.
Na neih peuh uh zuak unla, migentheite kiang ah pia un; van ah guta naih phaklouhna ah, leikha in aneksiatlouhna ah, dangka ip lui theiloute, gou bei theiloute kibawl un.
Na gou omna peuh ua na lungtang uh leng a-om ding ziak in.
"Na kawng uh gak unla, na khawnvak uh leng desa diam in om un.
Mi'n apu uh kitenna ankuangluina a kipan ahong pai chiang a, kongkhak ahon kiuhtak a, hon thei pah ding a angak nilouh bang in, om un.
Apu uh ahong pai chiang in sikha na ngak nilouh a, amuhte ahampha uh; chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ama'n akawng agak dia, amau an um ding in atusak ding a, a-nna uh asepsak ding hi.
Zan lai in hiam, thoh hun in hiam a hong a, huchibang a ahon muh, huai sikhate ahampha uhi.
"Himahleh, hiai thei un, guta ahong pai ding inn neipa'n theileh aveng dia, a-inn aphenvangsak kei ding hi.
Nou leng mansa in om un, na gintak louh dak un Mihing Tapa ahong pai ding hi,” achi hi.
Huan Peter in, "Toupa, hiai gentehna koumau kia hia na hon hilh, mi tengteng?" achi hi.
Toupa'n, "Sumkempa ginom, piltak, apu in ahun teng a atan ding uh hawmsak ding a a-inkuanpihte tung a heutu a abawl ding kua pen ahi dia le?"
Apu hong pai chiang in sikha huchibang a hih a hon muh dingpa ahampha hi.
Diktak in ka hon hilh ahi, aneih tengteng tung a heutu ding in abawl ding hi.
Himahleh huai sikha in alungtang in, "Ka pu ahong zok kei ding e," chi in asikhanu, asikhapa, na vo taleh ne in dawn in na kham taleh;
huai sikha pu, agin louh ni, atheih louh lai in ahong ding a, tum nih ahon suah ding a, miginomloute tan bang atangsak ding hi.
Sikha apu deihlam theigige napi a na kiging tuan lou a, apu deihlam a gamta loupa'n nakpitak a vuak atuak ding hi.
Himahleh theiloupi a vuakna tham a gamtapa'n awlchik a vuak atuak ding. Tampi piak a ommi kiang ah tampi phut in a-om ding a; tampi kepsakpa kiang ah atamsem aphut ding uhi.
"Khovel a mei khesuk ding a hong pai ka hi; tu in leng kang pahleh chi na tel ing e!
Himahleh baptisma tan ding ka nei, huai ka hihtangtun mateng ka om nuam lou hi na mahmah e;
khovel a lem lengsak ding a hong pai hiam hon sa na hi uh maw? Hi dek lou hial, ka hon hilh ahi, kikhenna lengsak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw.
Tunung chiang in inkuan khat ah mi nga akidou ding uh, thum in nih, nih in thum.
Akidou ding ua, pa in atapa, atapa in apa; anu in atanu, atanu in anu; atekpi in amou, amou in atekpi," achi hi.
Huan mipi kiang ah leng, "Tumlam a mei kai na muh uleh, 'vuah azu ding na chi pah ua; huan ahong zu ngei zel hi.'
Sim huih nung na muh chiang un, 'khua alum ding, na chi ua, ahong lum hi.'
Nou lepchiahte aw, khovel leh van omdan leng na genchian thei ngal ua, bang achia tu hun theichian siam lou na hi ua?
"Bang achia noumau in thudik kikhen lou na hi ua?

Hon hekpa toh thukhenpa kiang na zot lai un, lampi ah kileptheihna khat zong teitei in; huchi lou in zaw thukhenpa mai ah hon kailut ding a, thukhenpa'n miman heutu ahon mansak ding a, miman heutupa'n suangkul ah ahon khum kha ding hi.
K'on hilh ahi, paihsa san khat nangawn na piak kim masiah, huai a kipan na pawt kei hial ding," achi hi.
Huai lai in, kuate hiam a-om ua, huaite'n Pilat in Galili mite asisan uh Pathian biakna sagohte lak a ahelsakte tungtang Jesu ahilh uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huai Galili mite huchibang thil athuak ziak un Galili mi tengteng sang in migilou tuan hi un na gingta ua hia?
Hilou e, ka hon hilh ahi, nou leng na kisik kei uleh huchi mah bang in na mangthang vek ding uhi.
Huan Siloam insang in mi sawm-le-giat adelhlupte leng Jerusalem a om tengteng sang in migilouzaw hi un na gingta ua hia?
Hilou e, ka hon hilh ahi, nou leng na kisik kei uleh huchibang mah in na mangthang vek ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan hiai gentehna agen a, "Kuahiam in agrephuan ah theipi kung khat asuan hi. Huan akung ah gah ahong zong a khat leng amu kei hi.
Huchi in grephuan kemmi kiang ah, 'Ngai in, kum thum sung hiai theipi kung ah agah ka va zong zel a, khat leng ka mu kei; phuk in; bangziak a mun dal a om nilouh ahia?' achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah 'Pu, tukum bek om henla, akimvel in ka tou ding a, ek in ka phungvuh lai dia;
huchi a agahleh ahoih ding, agah kei laileh phuk mai in,' " achi hi.
Huan Sabbath ni in ama'n sinagog khat ah thu ahilh hi.
Ngai in, kum sawm-le-giat hatlouhna nei dawimat numei khat a-om a; huai mi akun kheukheu a, a-ut thu in adingtang thei kei hi.
Jesu'n amah amuhtak in asam a, akiang ah, "Numei, na hatlouhna in ahon khahta," achi hi.
Huan atung ah akhut akoih a; thakhat in atang pah a, Pathian aphatta hi.
Jesu'n Sabbath ni a mi ahihdam ziak in sinagog heutu aheh a, mipi ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Mihing nasepna ding ni guk a-om vo oi; huai sung in kihihdam un, Sabbath ni in hilou in," achi hi.
Toupa'n akiang ah, "Nou lepchiahte aw, Sabbath ni in na bawng uh hiam na sabiltung uh hiam a-an nekna a kipan phel in, tui dawn ding in na pikhe chiat zel uh hilou hia?
Hiai numei, Abraham tanu ahi ngal a, ngai un, Setan in kum sawm-le-giat aman a, Sabbath ni in leng hiai gak phelsak louh dan ahi a hia?" chi in adawng hi.
Huai thute agen lai in amelma tengteng azum ua; mipi bel athil thupi hih tengteng ziak in akipak uhi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Pathian lalgam bang ahia? Bang toh ka teh dia?
Ankam chi tang khat mi'n alak a, huan a atheh bang ahi, huai ahong pou a, sing ahong hi a, ahiangte ah tungleng vasate agiak uh," achi hi.
Huan "Pathian lalgam bang toh ka teh dia? achi nawn a.
Silngou numei in alak a, anbuang tehna thum lak a avek a athoh mateng aphum bang ahi," achi hi.
Huan ama'n thu hilh kawm zel in, Jerusalem kholam naih in kholian leh khoneute a tawn zel hi.
Kuahiam in akiang ah, "Hotdamte tawmchik ahi ding uh maw? achi hi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, kong kochik ah lut tum teitei un; ka hon hilh ahi, mi tampi in lut atum ding ua, alut thei kei ding uh.
Inn neipa athoh a, kong akhak nung in, nou apua a dingh in, 'Toupa, kong hon hon in, chi a kongkhak na hon kiuh chiang un, ama'n koilam mi na hi ua, hon thei lou ka hi' chi in nou ahon dawng ding hi.
Huai hun chiang in, nou, 'Na muh in ka ne ua, ka dawn ve ua oi, ka kongzing uah leng thu na hilh zel vo oi,' chi in na gen pan ding uh.
Ama'n, 'Ka hon hilh ahi, koilam mi na hi ua, ka hon thei ngei kei; nou thil gilou hihte aw, ka kiang a pan paimang vek un,' ahon chi ding hi.
Pathian lalgam sung a Abraham, Isak, Jakob leh zawlnei tengteng om na muh ua, nou polam a delhkhiak a om na hih lam uh na kitheih chiang un, na kap ding ua, ha na gawi ding uhi.
Huan suahlam, tumlam, simlam leh mallam a kipan mite ahong pai ding ua, Pathian lalgam ah ne in adawn ding uhi.
Huan ngai un, ananungpente leng amasapen a om a-om ding ua, amasapente leng ananungpen a om ding a-om uh," achi hi.
Huaitak in Pharisai kuate hiam ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Pawt inla, hiai a kipan paimang in; Herod in thah hon sawm ahi,” achi uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huai sehal kiang ah hiai thu va gen un, 'Ngai in, tuni toh, zingchiang toh dawite ka delhkhe dia, natnate leng ka hihdam lai dia, ani thum ni in ka zou ding.
Akoi abang hitaleh tuni toh, zingchiang toh, ani thum ni toh ka pai zel lai ding; Jerusalem kho polam ah zawlnei amanthat thil hi thei hilou ahi.'
Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem; zawlneite that, na kiang a hon sawlte suang a na denglum; akpi in anoute akha nuai a a-opkhum bang in na tate bangzah vei opkhum ka tum a? Himahleh na ut kei uhi.
En in, na inn avuak a taihsan in a-omta. Ka hon hilh ahi, 'Toupa min a hong pai ahampha, na chih masiah na hon mu kei ding, " achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni in Pharisai vaihawmmi khat inn a an ne ding a ahoh in ana enkhia uhi.
Huan ngai in ama ah damlou chibawk kuahiam a-om hi.
Huchi in Jesu'n dan thei mi leh Pharisaite ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihdam asiang hia, siang lou?" achi hi.
Amau adai dide uhi. Ama'n damlou alawng a, hihdam in apaisakta hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Na lak uah kuahiam in sabiltung hiam bawngtal hiam nei unla, Sabbath ni in tuikul sung ah ke taleh kua ahia kaikhe pah lou ding?" achi hi.
Huai thu adawng thei kei uhi.
Huan amichialte un tutna mun hoihpen atel zel uh amu a, akiang uah gentehna agen hi,
"Kitenna an ne ding a kuapeuh in ahon sap chiang in tutna mun hoihpen ah tu kei un; huchi lou in zaw noute sang a mizahtakhuai zaw ana sam kha dia, huchi in ahon sampa'n,
'Hiai mi tutna ding awn in,' ahon chi dia; huan nang zumpi in tutna mun niampen ah na tu nawn phing ding hi.

Ahon sap chiang in tutna mun niampen ah na va tu zaw ding a; huchi in ahon sampa ahong chiang in, na kiang ah, 'Lawm, tutna mun hoih deuh ah tu in, ahon chi thei ding hi.' Huchi in na an umpihte mitmuh in pahtawi in na om ding hi.
Kingaisang peuhmah aneu ding a; kingaineu pahtawi a om ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.

Huan asampa kiang ah leng, “Sun an hiam nitak an hiam a ankuang na lui chiang in, na lawmte, na unaute, na sanggamte, na inveng mihaute na sam kei ding hi; huchi lou in zaw ahon sam thuk ding ua, ahon thuk chitchiat kha ding uh.
Ankuang na lui chiang in, tagahte, piangsualte, khebaite, mittawte, na sam zaw ding hi.
Huchi in huaite'n thukna ding aneih louh ziak un, na hampha ding; midikte thohnawn chiang a thukkik na hih ding ziak in," achi hi.
Huan a-an umpih kuahiam in huai thu aza a, akiang ah, "Pathian lalgam a an ne ding mi ahampha," achi hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, “Mi kuahiam in nitak in ankuang thupi alui a, mi tampi asam hi.
An nek hun in, amisapte kiang ah, 'Hong paita un, bangkim amanta,' chi ding in asikha khat asawl hi.
Huan avek un thukhat sat in paulam anei chiat uhi. Amasapen in akiang ah, 'Lou ka na lei a, a-en dia ka hoh kiphamoh ahi; hon hehpih inla, hon ngaisiam hen,' achi hi.
Midang in 'Bawngtal tuak nga ka na lei a, asiat aphat chian ding in ka kuan ding a, hon hehpih inla, hon ngaisiam hen,' achi hi.
Huan midang in, 'Zi ka na nei a, huaiziak in ka hoh thei kei,' achi hi.

"Huan sikha in apu kiang ah, huai thute ava hilh hi. Huan inn neipa aheh a, asikha kiang ah, 'Kintak in pawt inla, kongzing leh kongkawm kal ah pai inla, mizawngte leh poihlongte leh mittawte leh khebaite hiai lai ah hon pilut in,' achi hi.
Huan asikha in, 'Pu, na hon thupiak bang in ka hih khin a, himahleh mun awng lailai veh aw,' achi hi.
Apu in, sikha kiang ah, 'Pawt inla, lamlian leh daikil kal ah pai inla, ka inn dimna ding in mi hon sawllut teitei in achi hi.'
K'on hilh ahi, ka misapte khat in leng ka ankuang lui achiam kei hial ding," achi hi.
Huan mipi tampitakte akiang ah ahoh ua; huchi in amah akihei a, akiang uah,
"Kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai in anu leh apa leh azi leh atate leh a-unaute leh asanggamnu leh ama hinna nangawn ahuat keileh ka nungzui ahi thei kei ding.
Kuapeuh ama kros pua a hon zui lou ka nungzui tak ahi thei kei ding.
"Nou lak a kuahiam in insang lam tum unla, kua ahia tu masa a, lam zohna khop sum na neih uleh neih louh thei ding a, abei ding zah sut masa lou ding?
Huchi lou in zaw, suangphum khin phot a, alam zoh theih keileh a-en peuh in,
'Hiai mi'n gel napi in azou thei ngal kei chi in anuihsan ding uh.'
"Huan kumpipa kua'n ahia kumpipa dang dou ding a akuan ding in, tu masa a, mi singnih toh amah dou ding a hong, mi singkhat toh atuah ngam ding leh ding louh, mi dong lou ding?
Huchi ahih kei vanglakleh kumpipa dang gamlapi a a-om lai in, kituahna lam thuchiam ngen ding in palai asawl ding hi.
Huchibang in, nou lak ah kuapeuh aneih tengteng paisan lou ka nungzui ahi thei kei ding hi.
"Chi ahoih a, himahleh chi apen khit in, bang in ahih al nawn dia?
Lei a ding in ahoih kei; ekvum ding in leng ahoih sam kei; mi'n apaikhia uhi. Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei in za hen," achi hi.
Huan siahkhon mite leh mikhialte tengteng in athu za ding in akiang ahon zuan uhi.
Pharisaite leh laigelhmite'n, "Hiai mi'n mikhialte akithuahpih a, akiang uah an ane chi in aphun tuak uhi."
Huchi in ama'n akiang uah hiai gentehna agen hi.
"Nou lak ah kuahiam in belam zakhat nei henla, alak ua khat mangsak taleh gamdai ah sawmkua-le-kuate nusia in, amang pen amuh nawn masiah kua ahia zong lou ding?
Huan amuh nawn in kipaktak in aliangzang ah apua hi.
Inn atuntak in, alawmte leh avengte asamkhawm a, akiang uah, 'Hon kipahpih un, ka belam mang ka mu nawnta,' achi hi.
K'on hilh ahi, huchi mah bang in, midik sawmkua-le-kua kisik tuan ding neiloute sang in mikhial khat kisik, tung a van a mi akipahna athupizaw ding hi.
"Huan numei kuapeuh in makhai sawm nei in khat mangsak taleh khawnvak de in, inn phiat in amuh nawn masiah kua ahia hoihtak a zong lou ding?
Huan amuh nawn in, alawmte leh avengte asamkhawm a, 'Hon kipahpih un, ka makhai mansak ka mu nawnta,' achi hi.
K'on hilh ahi, huchi mah bang in, Pathian angelte ma ah, mikhial khat kisik tung ah kipahna a-om nak hi," achi hi.
"Mi kuahiam in tapa nih anei hi:
Anaupangzaw pen in, apa kiang ah, 'Pa, gou ka tan ding a tuak teng hon pia in,' achi hi. Huchi in akiang uah agoute ahawmta hi.
Huan ni sawt lou nung in atapa naupangzaw pen in atan ding tuak tengteng alakhawm vek a, gam gamlapi ah azinta a, huai ah nuamtat lua in agoute amawk zatmangta hi.
Huan azatbei zoh vektak in, huai gam ah kial thupitak ahong tung a; nek ding ahong tasamta hi.
Huchi in huai gammi khat ava bel a; ama'n vok an pe ding in alou ah asawl hi.
Huan thil hawng vok in anekte ua kihihvah a-ut mahmah a; kuamah in lah bangmah ape ngal kei ua.
Huan amah-le-amah ahong kiphawkkhiaktak in, 'Ka pa kiang a kilohte an nek seng louh atamtam maizen toh, kei lah hiai ah gilkial a si ding himai veng in!'
Ka thou ding a, ka pa kiang ah ka pai ding a, akiang ah, 'Pa, van a tung ah leh nangmah mitmuh in thil ka hihkhial; na tapa a seh tak ka hita kei;
na kiang a kiloh khat bang in hon bawl in, ka chi ding,' achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, apa kiang ah apaita hi. Huan gamlapi a a-om lai in, apa'n ana mu a, alainat mahmah a, atai a, ava pom a, atawp tonton hi.
Huan atapa in akiang ah, 'Pa, van a tung ah leh nangmah mitmuh in thil ka hihkhial; na tapa a seh tak ka hita kei,' achi hi.
Himahleh apa'n asikhate kiang ah, 'Puan hoihpen hon lakhe pah unla, silhsak un; akhut ah zungbuh, akhepek ah khedap bunsak un;
bawngnou thautak hon la unla; gou un, i ne ding ua, nopbawl in i om ding uh.
Hiai ka tapa asi a, ahong hing nawnta hi; amang a, i mu nawnta uhi,' achi a. Huchi in kipaktak in a-om panta ua.
"Huan atapa upazaw pen lou ah a-om hi; inn ahong tun kuan in bangpeuh tumging leh lam husa azata hi.
Huchi in asikha khat asam a, tua bang ahia? chi in adong hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, 'Na nau ahong tung a, damtak a amuh nawn ziak in na pa'n bawngnou thautak agou hi,' achi a.
"Amah aheh a, alut nuamta kei hi. Huchi in apa ahong pawtkhia a, amah ahong sam hi.
Himahleh ama'n apa kiang ah, 'Ngai in, kum hiai zah na nna semta ing a, na thu a lah talek ngei lou ing a; ka lawmte toh kipahna ka bawlna ding in kelnou khat leng na hon pe ngei kei hi.
Himahleh hiai na tapa kizuakte kiang a na sum nemang vekpa ahong tuntak a maw, amah a ding a bawngnou thautak na goh!' chi in adawng hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, 'Ka tapa, ka kiang a om gige hi chin a, ka neih tengteng nang a ahi.'
Kipak leh nuamtak a om ding ahi; hiai na nau asi a; ahong hing nawn a; amang a, i mu nawnta ahi,” achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah hiai thu leng agen a, "Mi sumhau kuahiam in sumkemmi anei a; huai mi'n asum azatbeisak thu ah akiang ah ahek uhi.
Huchi in ama'n amah asam a, akiang ah, 'Na tungtang thu ka zak bangchidan ahia? Na sumkep thu hon pelut in; tuban siah sumkem in na pang thei nawn kei ding,' achi hi.
Sumkempa'n, alungsim in, 'Ka pu in ka sumkep hon tawpsak ding hi a, bangchi in ka hihta dia le? Lei toh ka ngap kei a, khutdoh lah ka zum ngal hi.
Sumkep ahon tawpsak hun chiang in a-innte ua hon omsak theihna ding un ka hihdan ding ka theita,' achi hi.
"Huchi in atoupa sumbate asam chiat a, amasapen kiang ah, 'Ka pu lak ah bangzah na ba a?' achi hi.
Ama'n, 'Thau tehna dan zakhat, achi a, ama'n akiang ah, na lai la inla tu meng inla, sawmnga gelh in,' achi hi.
Midang kiang ah, 'Nang bangzah na ba a?' achi hi. Ama'n buh tehna dan zakhat, achi a, ama'n akiang ah, 'Na lai la inla, sawmgiat gelh in,' achi hi.
"Huan apu in sumkempa diklou alemtheih ziak in aphat hi; vak tate sang in hiai khovel tate atulai thu ua apil zawk ziak un.
"K'on hilh ahi, diktatlouhna sum in nou a ding in lawm bawl un, sum abei hun chiang a tangtawn a omna a ahon omsakna ding un.
'Kuapeuh tawmchik tung a ginom lou tampi tung ah leng aginom kei uhi.'
Sumlem tung a bawn na ginom kei uleh kua'n ahia hauhna dik noute hon kemsak ding?
Midang atung a bawn na ginom kei un, noumau akua in hon peta dia?
"Sikha kuamah in heutu nih nna asemkop thei kei, khat hua in khat adeih ding, ahihkeileh khat gum in khat amusit ding, Pathian leh sum nna na semkop thei kei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan Pharisai sum deihtate'n huai thu tengteng aza ua, anuihsan uhi.
Huchi in ama'n akiang uah, "Mi mitmuh a kisiamtangsak na hi uh, himahleh Pathian in na lungtang uh athei a; mihing lak a apahtawi uh Pathian mitmuh in kihhuaipi ahi."
"Dan leh Zawlneite, Johan hong om tan in a-om a; huai nungsiah Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih agen ua, michih in pawnglut asawm uhi.
Himahleh dan thu sutvom neuchik aman sang in lei leh van amanthat abaihlamzaw hi."
"Kuapeuh azi ma a, adang nei, angkawm ahi; kuapeuh mi zi maksa nei angkawm ahi.”
"Huan mihausa kuahiam a-om a, puan sandup leh puanmalngat asilh a, niteng in nuamsatak in a-om hi.
Amin Lazaras khutdoh, meima a pumdim, akongkhak bul ah alum hi.
Mihausa dohkan a khatehnen kiate nek alunggulh a; uite'n ameimate aliahsak uhi."
"Huan hichi ahong hi a, khutdohpa asi a, angelte'n apaipih ua, Abraham angsung ah akoih uhi. Mihausa leng asi a, vui in a-omta hi.
Huan misikhua ah gimthuak in a-om a, adaktouhleh gamlapi a Abraham leh a-angsung a Lazaras om amuta hi.
Akikou a, 'Pa Abraham, ka tung ah zahngai in, Lazaras hon sawl inla, tui ah akhutzung muk diah henla, ka lei hihvotna ding in; hiai meikuang ah ka gim mahmah hi, " achi hi.

"Himahleh Abraham in, 'Ka tapa, nang na dam lai in, thil hoih na mu a, huchi mah bang in Lazaras in thil hoih lou amuh thei tanla; himahleh tu'n ah amah zaw hiai ah khamuangtak in a-om a, nang zaw gim na hita ve.

Huai lou leng hiai a kipan a nou kiang a paitumte apai theihlouhna ding un leh kuamah huai a kipan kou kiang a ahong kai theihlouhna ding in, kou leh nou kikal ah guam thupitak koihdet in a-om hi,' " achi hi.
Huan ama'n, "Ahihleh, pa, amah ka pa inn ah paisak ding bek in, ka hon ngen hi.
Sanggam pasal nga ka nei a; hiai gimthuakna mun ah ahong pai kha ding uh chih akiang uah va hilhleh," achi hi.
"Abraham in, 'Mosi leh zawlneite anei ve ua oi; huai mite thu ngai le uh ake,' achi hi.
Huan ama'n pa Abraham, 'Hilou e; misi lak a mi hilhial akiang uah hohleh akisik ding uh,' achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, 'Mosi leh zawlneite thu angaih kei un zaw, misi lak a mi thounawn hoh mahleh leng ataksang tuan kei ding uh, " achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Puknate om lou thei ahi kei; himahleh puknate omsakpa tung agik hi!
Hiai mineute lak a khat leng hihpuk sang in, angawng ah buhgawina suang oksak in, tuipi ah kipaileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
Pilvang un, na unau in thil ahihkhelhleh taihilh in; akisikleh ngaidam in.
Ni khat in na tung ah sagihvei thil hihkhial in sagihvei, ka kisik, chi a nang lam a ahong kihei nawnleh na ngaihdam ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan sawltakte'n Toupa kiang ah, "Ka ginna uh khangsak in," achi uhi.
Toupa'n, "Ankam tang khat bang ginna na neih uleh, hiai singtheimi kung kiang ah, na kibotkhia inla, tuipi ah na kisuan in, na chi ding ua, na thu uh amang mai ding hi.
"Himahleh nou lak ah kuapeuh in lei let hiam, belamching hiam sikha nei unla, ahong vaipaitak in, an hong um pah aw, kua ahia nou lak ana chi ding?
'Ka nek ding hon bawlsak inla, puan teng inla, ka nek a ka dawn zoh masiah ka nek bawl in; huai khit chiang in nang ne in dawn in, na lak ua kua ahia na chi zaw lou ding?'
Na thu bang ua ahih ziak in na sikha kiang ah kipahthu na gen ngei ua hia?
Huchibang in 'Nou leng na kiang ua thupiak tengteng bang a na hih nung un, sikha phatuam lou ka hi uh, ka hih ding him uh ahi ka hih uh,' chi un,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem kholam a apai lai in, Samaria leh Galili gam atawn hi.
Huan koi khua hiam a alut ding in, miphak ngenta, sawm in ana dawn uh a, huaite'n gamlatak a dingh in, aw ngaihtak in,
"Jesu, Heutupa, ka tung uah zahngai in," achi uhi.
Ama'n amau amuh in, akiang uah, "Siampute kiang ah va kilak un," achi hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, apai lai un ahong siang chiat uhi.
Huan alak ua khat in dam chih akitheih in, aw ngaihtak a Pathian phat kawm in akik nawnta hi.
Huan akhebul ah abokkhup a, akipahna thu agen hi; huai mi Samari mi ahi.
Huchi in Jesu'n, "Mi sawm hong siangta hilou na hi uh maw? Kuate koi ah?" chi in adong hi.
"Pathian phat ding a kik nawn, hiai theih louh mi kia lou ngal kuamah muh a om lou uhia?" achi hi.
Akiang ah, "Thou inla, paita in; na ginna na dampih hi," achi hi.
Pharisaite'n Pathian lalgam hong tun hun ding adot ziak un, akiang uah, "Pathian lalgam muh theih in ahong tung kei,
'En un, hiai ah hiam, huai ah hiam, achi kei ding uh,' ngai un, Pathian lalgam na lak uah a-om," chi in adawng hi.
Huan nungzuite kiang ah, "Mihing Tapa dam lai ni, ni khat bek na muhnop ni uh ahong om ding a himahleh na mu kei ding uh.
Na kiang uah, 'Hiai ah en un, hiam pam ah en un, ahon chi ding ua; paikhe kei unla, amau leng zui kei un,
van nuai lehlam a khua aphiat a, van nuai lehlam tanpha a avak zel bang in Mihing Tapa ahong pai ni in a-om ding ahi ngal a.'
Himahleh huai ma in thil tamtak athuak ding a, hiai khangte deih louh in a-om ding hi.
Noah dam lai a thil omdan bang in, Mihing Tapa ahong pai nawn hun chiang in a-om sam ding hi.
Noah long a alut a, tui ahong let a, avek ua ahihlup khit ni atun masiah, ane un adawn ua, zi leh pasal in akinei uhi.
Huchibang in Lot dam lai in ahong om a; ane un adawn ua, alei un azuak ua, asuan un alam uhi.
Himahleh Sodom a kipan Lot apawt ni in van a kipan mei leh kaat azu a, avek un ahihlumta hi.
Huchibang in Mihing Tapa ahong kilak ni in a-om ding hi.
"Huai ni in kuamah insung a avan om, ama inn tung a om, va la ding in kum kei heh; lou a om leng pai kei hen.
Lot zi theigige un.
Kuapeuh ahinna humbit sawm in amansuah ding a kuapeuh ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
K'on hilh ahi, huai zan in lupna khat ah mi nih alum ding ua, khat lak in a-om ding a, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
Buh gawizan in numei nih a-om ding ua, khat lak in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
Lou ah pasal nih a-om ding ua; khat lak in a-om dia; khat nutsiat in a-om ding," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Toupa, koi ah eita?" chi in adong uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Saluang omna peuh ah musane leng akikhawm ding uh," achi hi.
Huan lunglel lou a thum gige ding ahi chih atheihna ding un akiang uah gentehna agen hi.
"Koi lai khua hiam ah thukhenmi khat a-om a, huai mi'n Pathian alau kei a, mihing leng khawk asa kei hi.
Huai khua ah meithai khat a-om a; ama'n, ka melma tung ah phu hon laksak in, chi in akiang ah ahoh zihzeh hi.
Huan amah sawt khop a-ut kei a; himahleh anung in alungsim in 'Pathian lau lou in mihing khawk sa kei mah leng;
hiai meithainu'n hon hihbuai ziak in aphu ka laksak mai ding, huchi lou in zaw, hong zihzeh taleh ahon hihbuai den kha ding, achi hi.
"Huan Toupa mah in, thukhen midiktat lou thugen za un.
'Atung uah dohzou tadih mahleh leng amitel, asun-azan a amah samte phu Pathian in alaksak kei dia hia?'
K'on hilh ahi, aphu uh alaksak pah ding. Himahleh Mihing Tapa ahong pai chiang in leitung ah huai bang ginna ahon mu diam?" achi hi.
Huan midiktat hih kigingta a, midang tengteng musit kuate hiam kiang ah hiai gentehna leng agen hi.
"Tempul ah thum ding in mi nih ahohtou ua; khat Pharisai ahi a, khat siahkhonmi ahi.
"Pharisai adingh a, amah kia in hichibang in athum hi: 'Pathian, midang negute, dikloute, angkawmte bang ka hih louh ziak leh hiai siahkhonmi bang leng ka hih louh ziak in na tung ah ka kipak hi.'
Nipikal teng in nihvei an ka ngawl zel; ka neih teng sawm-a-khat ka pe zel," achi hi.
"Siahkhonmi'n bel gamlatak a dingh in, van lam leng adak ngam kei a, 'Pathian, kei mikhial, ka tung ah zahngai in,' chi in a-awm akitum hi.
K'on hilh ahi, amasa sang in huai mi pen siamtang in a-inn ah apaikikta hi. Kingai thupi peuh aniam ding ua, kingainiam pahtawi in a-om ding," achi hi.
Huan akhoih ding in akiang ah anaupang neute uh ahon pi ua; nungzuite'n huai amuhtak un ana tai uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah amaute asam a, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un, Pathian lalgam huchibang mite a ahi ngal a.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh Pathian lalgam naupang neu in akipahpih bang a kipahpih lou asung ah alut kei hial ding," achi hi.
Vaihawmmi kuahiam in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa hoih, tangtawn hinna tanna ding in bang ka hih dia?" chi in adong hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Bangziak a hoih hon chi? Mi khat kia ngal lou kuamah hoih a-om kei, huai tuh Pathian ahi.
Thupiakte: Ang kawm ke'n, Tual that ke'n, Gu ke'n, Hek ke'n, Na nu leh pa zahtak in, chihte, na thei vele," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Huai tengteng ka tuailai chil a kipan ka zui zel," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n huai azaktak in akiang ah, "Tu in thil khat na sam lai; na neih tengteng zuak inla, gentheite kiang ah hawm in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan hong pai inla, hon zui in," achi hi.
Amah bel, huai thute azak in, ahauh mahmah ziak in alungkham mahmah hi.
Huchi in Jesu'n amah a-en a, "Mihaute Pathian lalgam lut haksa hi na e!
Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in phimbil a sangawngsau lutsuak abaihlamzaw,” achi hi.
Huai thu zate'n, "Huchi ahih in kua hotdam in a-om thei dia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Mihing hih vual louh Pathian hihtheih ahi,” achi hi.
Peter in, "Ngai in, kou bangkim nusia in ka hon zui uh," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, 'Kuapeuh Pathian lalgam ziak a, inn hiam, zi hiam, unaute hiam, nu le pa hiam, tate hiam paisan photphot,
tu damsung mahmah in asang a tamzaw mu lou ding kuamah a-om kei, hun hong tung lai ding a tangtawn hinna toh,' " achi hi.
Huan sawm-le-nihte akiang ah apituam a, akiang uah, "Ngai un, Jerusalem a hohtou ding i hi ua; zawlneite thugelh tengteng Mihing Tapa tung ah atung ding hi.
Zentelte kiang ah piak in a-om ding a, nuihza bawlna in azang ding uh, zumhuaitak in abawl ding ua, achilphih ding uhi.
Huan avo ding ua, athat ding uh; ni thum ni in athounawn ding," achi hi.
Huai thute atheisiam kei ua, athugen alak uah sel in a-om, bang gen ahia chih leng athei kei uh.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jeriko atun ding kuan in, mittaw kuahiam lam gei ah khutdoh in ana tu hi.
Huai mi'n mipi paiging aza a, bangchi thu ahia chih adong hi.
Amau, "Nazaret Jesu apai ahi," chih ahilh uhi. 38 Huchi in "Jesu, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou hi.
Amasate'n dai ding in atai ua, himahleh, "David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou nak semsem hi.
Huchi in Jesu adingh a, akiang a hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
Huchi in Jesu adingh a, akiang a hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
Akiang ahong tun in, "Na tung ah bangchi a ka hih ahia na deih?" achi a, ana dong hi. Ama'n, "Toupa, muh theih ka ut," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Mutheita in, na ginna dampih na hi," achi hi.
Huan thakhat in amu thei pah a, Pathian phat kawm zel in amah azuita hi; huan mi tengteng in huai amuh un, Pathian aphat uhi.
Jeriko ah Jesu alut a, paisuak ding in akisa hi.
Ngai in, mi khat amin Zakai a-om a; huai mi tuh siahkhon heutu ahi; amah ahausa ngial hi.
Jesu mi bangchibang hiam chi in muh atum a; amah lah aniam ngal a, mipi ziak in amu thei kei hi.
Huchi in amatai a, a-en ding in theipi kung ah akal a; huai lampi ahon tot ding ahi ngal a.

Huai amuhtak un avek un, "Mikhialte kiang a tung ding in alutta ve," chi in aphun uhi.

Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tuni in hiai inn ah hotdamna ahong tungta; amah leng Abraham tapa ahi ngal a.
Mangthangte zong a hondam ding in Mihing Tapa hong pai ahi him hi," achi hi.
Huan huai thute angaihkhiak lai un, Jerusalem anaih tak ziak leh Pathian lalgam hong lang pah ding hi a angaihtuah ziak un gentehna agen hi.
Huchi in hiai thu agen hi. "Milian kuahiam gamukna thu la a hong kik nawn ding in kho gamlatak ah ahoh hi.
Ahoh ding in asikhate sawm asam a, akiang uah dangka sawm apia a, ka hong tun nawn masiah hiai in sum na sin un, chi in.
Himahleh akhua-le-tuite'n ahua ua, hiai mi ka tung ua vaihawm ding in ka deih kei uh, chi in anung ah thu akhak uhi.
"Huan hichi ahong hi a, lalgam la zou, ahong kik nawn in asikha sum apiakte, apeipundan uh theihna ding in asamsak hi.
Amasapen ahong pai a, 'Toupa, na dangka sawm in apung,' achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, 'Sikha hoih, na hihhoih e; tawmchik tung a na ginom ziak in kho sawm tung ah heutu in om in' achi hi.
Anihna ahong pai a, 'Toupa, na dangka nga in apung e,' achi hi.
Amah kiang ah leng, 'Nang leng kho nga tung ah heutu in om in,' achi hi.
"Huan midang ahong pai a, 'Toupa en in, hiai na dangka, kho-ul nulna puan in ka kem kinken hi.
Mimawktat na hih ziak in ka hon lau hi; na koih louh leng na la a, na tuh louh leng na at ngal a,' achi hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, 'Sikha gilou, na paukam suak ngei in ka hon siam louh ding. Mimawktat ka hih a, ka koih louh leng ka lak a, ka tuh louh leng ka at na thei maw?
Huchi ahihleh bangziak a sumbuk a ka dangka na koih mai louh; huchi a ka hong pai chiang a apung toh ka lak ding hi a?' achi hi.
"Huan akiang a dinghte kiang ah, 'Asum laksak unla, dangka sawm neipa kiang ah pia un,' achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, 'Toupa, ama'n sum sawm anei aka,' achi uhi.
K'on chi ahi, 'Anei peuh piak behlap ahi ding a, anei lou aneihsun leng laksak ahi ding hi.
Himahleh hiai ka galte atung ua vaihawm dia hon deih lou, hon pi unla, ka ma ah that un, " achi hi.
Hiai thu agen khit in Jerusalem kholam naihtou in ma akai hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Bethphage leh Bethani kho kiang, Olive tang kichi atun in, nungzuite lak a mi nih asawl hi.
"Na mazawn khua uah va hoh unla; huai ah na lut tung un sabiltungnou kikhih, kuamah tuan ngei nailouhna, na va mu ding ua, huai hon phel unla, hon kai un.
Huan kuapeuh in 'Bangziak a phel?' chi a ahon dot uleh 'Toupa'n adeih a ahi,' chi un," achi hi.
Huan amisawlte apaita ua, akiang ua agen bang in ava mu uhi.
Sabiltungnou aphel lai un, aneite'n akiang uah, "Sabiltungnou bangziak a phel?" achi uhi.
Amau, "Toupa'n adeih a ahi," achi uhi.
Huchi in Jesu kiang ah ahon kai ua; huan sabiltungnou tung ah apuante uh aphah ua, atung ah Jesu atuangsak uhi.
Huan apaina ding lampi ah apuante uh aphah uhi.
Huan atun kuan in, Olive tang kumsukna dingtak ah, anungzui mihonpi tengteng in athil thupi hih tengteng amuh ziak un akipak ua, aw ngaihtak in Pathian aphat ua,
"Toupa min a kumpipa hong pai ahampha e; van ah lemthu leng henla, tungnungpen ah thupina om hen," chi in.
Huan mipi lak a Pharisai khenkhat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, na nungzuite tai in," achi uhi.
Ama'n bel ka hon hilh ahi, "Hiaite adaih uleh suangte bek akikou ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan atun kuan in, khua amu a, akahkhum a,
"Aw, nang tel in tu sung in khamuanna thei leteh aw; himahleh tu'n zaw na muhlouhna ding in akiselta ngal a.
Na galte'n na kimvel ah leikulh akhoh ding ua, ahon um ding ua, na kimvel ah pawt theih louh in ahon opkhum ding ua, huchibang nite na tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
Na sung a na ta, na naute, nangmah toh lei ah ahon pai ek ding ua; na sung ah suang kichiang himhim ahawi kei ding uh; veh a na om ni na theih louh ziak in," chi in.
Huan tempul ah ava lut a, bangpeuh zuakte adelhkhia a, akiang uah,
"Ka inn thumna inn ahi ding, chih gelh ahi; nou bel suamhatte khuk in na bawl zaw uh," achi hi.
Huan niteng in tempul ah thu ahilh zel hi. Siampu liante, laigelhmite leh vantang lak a heutu deuhte'n amah hihman atum uhi.
Himahleh mipi'n phatuamngaitak a athugen angaihkhiak ziak un, ahihdan ding athei tuan kei uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai a a-om lai un, anau neih ahong hun hi.

Huan ngai in, Jerusalem ah mi khat amin Simeon a-om a; huai mi midiktat leh Pathian limsak ahi a, Israelte khamuanpa ding angak gige a, atung ah Kha Siangthou a-om hi.

na hotdamna ka mit in amuh tak ziak in,
huai michih muh dia na bawl tak;
Zentelte kiang a kilakna vak leh na mi Israelte thupina ding," achi hi.

Ahi, nang lungtang leng namsau in adawt pailet ding a; huchi a mi tampi in alungtang ua angaihtuahte uh alatna ding in,” achi hi.
Huan mi khat, amin, Anna, zawlnei, Phanuel Tanu, Asher nam a mi a-om a; amah tektak ahi a, anungak tawp nungsiah apasal kiang ah kum sagih a-om hi.
Kum sawmgiat-le-li ahih tanpha meithai in a-om a, ama'n tempul paisan lou in asun-azan in an ngawl a thum in Pathian abe zel hi.
Huchih laitak in amah ahong pai a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen a, Jerusalem tatna lamen peuhmahte kiang ah Jesu tanchin agen hi.
Huan Toupa dan bang zel a thil tengteng ahihzoh un, Galili gam a, amau khua Nazaret ah akik nawnta uhi.
Naungek ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, ahong hat hiaihiai a, pilna in adimta a, atung ah Pathian deihsakna a-om hi.
Huan kum teng in, Paikan Ankuanglui hun in, anu leh apa Jerusalem ah ahoh zel uhi.
Amah kum sawm-le-nih ahih in dan ngeina in ahohtou uhi.
Ankuanglui zoh a akik nawn lai un, Jerusalem ah naupang Jesu a-om lai a, anu leh pa'n athei kei uhi.
Huchi in apawlte lak ua om hi na'nteh achi ua, ni khat lam apai khin ua, asanggamte uh leh ameltheihte uh lak ah azong uhi.
Amuh louh ziak un zong kawmkawm in Jerusalem ah akik nawnta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum nung in, tempul ah, sinsak mite lak a tu a, athu uh na ngaikhia a, amaute thudong in, ava mu uhi.
Athu zate'n atheihdan leh adawndan lamdang asa mahmah uh.
Anu leh apa'n amah amuh un, lamdang asa mahmah ua; anu'n, akiang ah, "Tapa aw, bangziak a hichibang a hon hih na hia? Ngai in, na pa leh ke'n lungkhamtak in ka hon zong ua," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon zong na hi ua? Ka Pa inn a ka om ding na thei kei ua hia?" achi hi.
Huan akiang ua athugen atheisiam kei uhi.
Huan amau azuisuk a, Nazaret khua ahong tung ua, athu uh mang in a-om hi. Anu'n huai thil tengteng alungtang ah avom gige hi.
Jesu apil deuhdeuh a, ahong lian hiaihiai a, Pathian leh mihing deihsak in a-om deuhdeuhta hi.
Huan ni khat tempul a mite thu hilh a, tanchinhoih agen lai in, siampu liante, laigelhmite, upate toh akiang ah ahong pai guih uhi.
Akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thilte na hih? Kua'n ahia thu hon pia? hon hilh in," achi uhi.

"Johan baptisma van a kipan hia, mihing a kipan?" chi in adong hi.

Huan mipite kiang ah hiai gentehna agen a, "Mi kuahiam in grephuan abawl a, aloukemte kiang ah khohloh ding in apia a, sawtpi taam ding in gamdang ah ahohta hi.
Huan agah loh hun in atan ding gah apiak ding un loukemte kiang ah sikha khat asawl hi Himahleh loukemte'n a na vua uhi.
Sikha dang asawl nawn a; huai leng na vo nawn in, zumhuaipi in ana bawl ua, khutvuak in apaisak nawnta uhi.
Huan athumna asawl nawn a; huai leng hihliam in apaikhia uhi.
Huai zoh in grephuan neipa'n, 'Bangchi in ka hihta dia? Ka tapa deihtak ka sawlmai ding; amah ana zah khamoh kei ding uh,' achi hi.

Huchi in grephuan a pan apaikhia ua, ahihlumta uhi. Huan grephuan neipa'n amaute bang alohta dia le?
Loukemte ahong hihmang dia, huan grephuan midangte ape ding," achi hi. Huan huai azak un, "Huai tel zaw tung keileh," achi uhi.
Himahleh amaute a-en a, ahihleh hiai thu agelh uh bang ahia? "Inn lam mite suang deih louhpen, huai mahmah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita, chih.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Huchi ahih nung, Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah pia un," achi hi.
Huchi in mipi ma a paukhelh lak ding amu kei ua; adawnna lamdang asa mahmah ua, adai dide uhi.
Huan Saddukai, thohnawnna a-om kei chite lak a mi kuate hiam akiang ah ahong ua; thu adong uhi.
"Sinsakpa, Mosi in, mi'n zi nei in, ta nei lou in sihsan taleh a-unaupa'n azi luah in, a-unaupa a ding in chi asuahsak ding chih, agelh hi.
Ahi a, unau pasal sagih a-om ua; upapen in zi anei a, ta nei lou in asi hi.
Anihna in aluah a; ta nei lou in asi nawn hi.
Athumna in aluah nawn a, huchibang in unau sagihte'n anei chiat ua, ta nei lou in asi uhi.

Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tulai mite zi leh ta in akinei zel ua,

Na khepek ngakna ding a na melmate ka bawl masiah," ana chi hi.

"Hiai na thil muh uh, hihchip louh a suang kichiang himhim hiai a a-om louh ding nite ahong tung ding hi," achi hi.
7 Huan amau akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, huaite chikchiang in ahong om ding ua? Huaite ahong tun ding chiamtehna bang a-om dia?" chi in adong uhi.

Himahleh, na samzang uh khat leng amangthang kei ding.

"Himahleh sepaihte'n Jerusalem khua a-um uh na muh chiang un, amangthang dek chih thei un.

"Himahleh pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw nekvah luat toh, zukham toh damsung khosak ngaihtuah in, na lungtang uh adim lo kha ding a, huai ni in thang-awk bang in thakhat in na tung uah ahong tung guih kha ding hi.

Siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n hihlup theihna ding dan azong ua, vantang lah akihta ngal ua.
Sawm-le-nihte lak a pang, Judas, Iskariot kichi sung ah Setan alut hi.
Huchi in amah ava pai a siampu liante leh heutute kiang ah zuausan a matsak theihna ding dan ava kihoupih hi.
Amau akipak mahmah ua, akiang ah dangka piak achiamta uhi.
Ama'n lem asa a, mipi om louh kal a zuausan a matsakna lemtang azongta hi.
Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ni, Paikan Ankuangluina belamnou gohna ding ni ahong tungta hi.
Huchi in Jesu'n, "Peter leh Johan asawl a, Paikan Ankuang i nek ding hon va bawlsak un," chi in.
Huan amau akiang ah, "Koi ah va bawl le ung na ut a?” achi uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ngai un, khopi a na lut un, pasal, bel a tui tawi in ahon tuak ding a, alutna inn ah zui lut un," achi hi.
Inn neipa kiang ah, "Sinsakpa'n, ka nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka nekna ding uh, mikhual inn pindan koi lai ahia ahon chi, na chi ding uh.
Huchi in ama'n indan tungnung zapi, van omsa, ahon ensak ding; huai ah hih un," achi hi.
Huan ahohta ua, akiang ua agen bangtak in amuta ua; huan Paikan Ankuang ava bawl uhi.
Huan anek hun in, dohkan um in atu a, asawltakte toh a-um uhi.
Huan akiang uah, "Ka thuak ding ka thuak ma in hiai Paikan Ankuang hon nekpih ka ut mahmah hi.
K'on hilh ahi, hiai Pathian lalgam a atak a hihtangtun ahih masiah, ka ne nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Huan nou ala a, kipahthu agen khit in, "Hiai la unla, kihawm un;
k'on hilh ahi, tuban Pathian lalgam ahong tun masiah grepgui gahtui ka dawn nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Huan tanghou ala a, kipahthu agen khit in abalkham a, akiang uah apia a, "Hiai ka pumpi ahi, na sik ua piak ding pen; keimah theihgigena in hih zel un,” achi hi.
Huchibang in nitak an nek zoh in nou ala a, "Hiai nou ka sisan a thukhun thak, na sik ua pawt ding pen."
"Himahleh ngai un, zuausan a hon mansak dingpa khut ka kiang ah dohkan tung ah a-omta hi.
Mihing Tapa seh a a-om bangtak in apai ding hi, himahleh zuausan a mansak dingpa mihing tung agik hi!" achi hi.
Huan amau lak ah, "Huchibang thilhih ding kua ahi dia le?" chi in akidongtuah uhi.
Huan alak uah kua pen ahia thupipen a seh chih thu ah, kiselna ahong pawt hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Zentel kumpipate atung uah thu anei gige ua, atung ua thuneite thil hoih hihsakte in angai uhi.
Himahleh nou zaw huchibang na hi kei ding uh; na lak ua thupipen nauzaw bang in om henla, makaipen leng nasempen bang in om zaw hen.
Kua ahia thupizaw, dohkan a an um hia, an pepa? Dohkan a an um pen ahi zaw kei maw? Himahleh kei zaw na lak uah nasempa bang in ka om hi.
"Ze-etna ka tuah sung noute kei hon ompihte na hi uh.
Huchi in kei, ka Pa'n gam ahon sehsak bang in gam ka hon sehsak ahi.
Ka gam a ka dohkan a na nek ua na dawntheihna ding un; huchi in Israel nam sawm-le-nih vai hawmsak in laltutphah ah na hong tu ding uhi.
"Simon, Simon, ngai in, Setan in buhsep bang a ahon septheihna ding in, noute ahon ngen hi.
Himahleh na ginna amanlouhna ding in ka hon thumsak hi; na kihei nawn chiang in nang na unaute hihkip in," achi hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Toupa, na kiang ah suangkul ah leh sihna ah leng pai sam ngap ka hi,” achi hi.
"Ama'n Peter, ka hon hilh ahi, na hon theihna ah thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl masiah tuni in ak akhuang kei ding,” achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Dangka ip lou, kawlzal lou leh khedap lou a ka hon sawlkhiak in bang na tasam ua?" achi hi. Amau, "Bangmah,” achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Tu'n zaw dangka ip nei in keng henla, kawlzal toh, kuapeuh namsau nei lou in apuan zuak henla, lei hen.
K'on hilh ahi, amah talekte lak ah simtel ahi, chi a kigelh ka tung ah ahong tung ahi; ka tungtang thu tungkim ngei ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Huan amau, "Toupa, en dih, hiai ah namsau nih a-om," achi ua. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ahun,” achi hi.
Huan amah apawt a, angeina dan in Olive tang ah ahohta a; nungzuite'n leng azui uhi.
Amun ava tun un, akiang uah, "Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un thum un,” achi hi.
Huan suang a denphak tan vel ah ava paituam hi.
Huan akhukdin a, athum a, "Pa, hoih na sakleh ka kiang a pan hiai nou lasuan in; himahleh kei thu hilou in, nangmah thu hi zaw hen," achi hi.
Huan van a kipan angel khat amah hihhat ding in akiang ah ahong kilak hi.
Huan agim mahmah a, phatuamngai nawn sem in athum a; sisan bang in akho-ul mal liantak in lei ah atakkheta hi.
Huan athum khit a athoh in, nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai a, alungkham ziak un ana ihmu uh amu hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Bangziak a ihmu na hi ua? Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un thou unla, thum un," achi hi.
Huan huai agen laitak in, ngai dih, mipi ahong pai ua, sawm-le-nihte lak a tel Judas in ama uh akai a; tawp tum in Jesu ahon zuan hi.
Himahleh Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Judas, Mihing Tapa tawp a mansak ding na hi maw?" achi hi.
Huan akim a mite'n thil hong tung ding atheih un, "Toupa, namsau in ka sat ding uam?" achi uhi.
Huan alak ua kuahiam in siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil taklam asatkhiaksak hi.
Huan Jesu'n, "Hih nawn ke'n," achi a, abil akhoih a, ahihdamta hi.
Jesu'n akiang a hong siampu liante tempul heutute leh upate kiang ah, "Namsau leh khetbuk tawi in, suamhat man ding bang hial in na hong kuan uh maw?
Tempul a na kiang ua niteng a ka om lai in hon mat tum in na hon sawk kei ua; himahleh tu mial thuneihna toh na tat hun uh ahi,” achi hi.
Huan aman ua, api ua, siampu lianpen inn ah apilut uhi. Peter in gamlapi ah azui hi.
Huan inn huangsung intual ah mei achih ua, atukhawm ua, alak uah Peter ava tu sam hi.
Huan meivak nuai a atut lai in nungak kuahiam in amu a, a-en nilouh a, "Hiai mi leng akiang a om ahi,” achi hi.
Ama'n bel, "Numei, amah ka thei kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi.
Aden chiang deuh in midang in ahong mu nawn a, "Nang leng alak ua mi na hi ve," achi hi. Peter in bel, "Mihing aw, ka hi kei,” achi hi.
Huan dakkal khat phial nung in, midang in, "Hiai mi leng akiang a om ahi tham hi; Galili gammi ahi," achi tinten hi.
Huan Peter in, "Mihing aw, na thugen ka thei kei," achi hi. Huan thakhat in, apau laitak in ak ahong khuangta hi.
Huan Toupa akihei a, Peter a-en hi. Peter in, "Ak khuan ma in thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding, chi a Toupa'n akiang a athugen ahon phawkkhe thak hi."
Huan apawt a, akap huphup hi.
Jesu lente'n nuihza bawlna in azang ua, asat uhi.
Amit atuamsak ua, "Kua ahia hon sat, gen in?" chi in adong uhi.
Thudang tampi in leng agensia un akou uhi.
Huan khua avaktak in upa hon, siampu liante leh laigelhmite ahong kikhawm ua, avaihawmna uah api uhi.
"Khrist na hihleh hon hilh in," achi uhi. Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hon hilh mah leng na gingta kei ding uh.
Ke'n noute thu hon dong hita leng leng, na hon dawng kei ding ua, na hon khah sam kei ding uh.
Himahleh tuban siah Mihing Tapa, Pathian thilhihtheihna taklam ah atuta ding," achi hi.
Huan avek un, "Nang Pathian Tapa na hi maw le?" achi ua. Ama'n akiang uah, "Hi e, na hon chih bang un," achi hi.
Huan amau, "Bang theihpihna dang i deih lai dia? Eimah mah in amah kamsuak a pan i zata ve ua le,” achi uhi.
Huan mipi tengteng adingh ua, Pilat kiang ah Jesu apita uhi.
"Hiai mi'n ka chite uh apimang a, Kaisar kiang ah siah liau akham a, Khrist, kumpipa, akichih ka za uh," chi in ahek uhi.
Pilat in akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" chi in adong a. Ama'n, "Hi e," chi in adawng hi.
Pilat in siampu liante leh mipite kiang ah, "Hiai mi tung ah bangmah khelhna ka mu kei,” achi hi.
Himahleh amau, "Galili gam a kipan Judia gam khua teng leh hiai mun tan ah thu hilh in, mi tengteng afuihse gige," chi in akhauh semsem uhi.
Pilat in huai azak in, hiai mi Galili gam a mi ahi hiam chih adong hi.
Huchi in Herod ukna sung a mi ahi chih atheihtak in Herod kiang ah asawlta a; huai lai in amah leng Jerusalem ah a-om hi.
Herod in Jesu amuh in akipak mahmah a; atanchin azak ziak in, tuma lam a pan muh ana ut him ahi a, athillamdang hih banghiam bek muh alamen hi.
Huan thu tampi adong a; himahleh bangmah in adawng tuan kei.
Siampu Liante leh laigelhmite'n dingh in nakpitak in ahek uhi.
Herod leh asepaihte'n Jesu simmohbawl in nuihza bawlna'n azang uh, puan thupitak silhsak in Pilat kiang ah asawl nawnta hi.
Huai ni in Herod leh Pilat akihoutheita uh; huai masiah a zaw kimelma et ahi uhi.
Pilat in siampu liante, heutute, mi tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah,
"Mite apimang chi in hiai mi ka kiang ah na hon pi uhi, ngai un, na ma ua ka etchet nung in na hekna thu uah hiai mi tung ah bangmah khelhna ka mu kei;
Herod in leng mu tuan lou in, i kiang uah ahon sawlkik nawn hi. Ngai un, sihna khop hial bangmah ahih kei hi.
Huchi in ka vo ding a, ka pawtsak mai ding," achi hi.
(Ankuanglui ni a alak ua mi khat apawtsak teitei ding ahi ngal a).
Himahleh kituaktak in akikou ua, "Hiai mi hihmangthang inla, Barabbas pen hon pawtsak zaw in," achi uhi.
Huai mi khopi a helna leh tualthah ziak a suangkul tang ahi.
Pilat in bel Jesu khah a-ut a, akiang uah thu agen nawn hi.
Himahleh, "Kros ah kilhden in, kros ah kilhden in,” chi in akikou uhi.
Huan ama'n, athumveina ah akiang uah, "Bang ding in maw? Hiai mi in bang ahia ahihkhelh? Sihna khop hial atung ah bangmah ka mu kei; ka sawi ding a, ka khah mai ding," achi hi.
Amau bel aw ngaihtak suah in kilhden ding in angen teitei uhi. Huan a-aw un avau daita uhi.
Pilat in anget bang ua hih ding in thu ahihpukta hi.
Helna leh tualthah ziak a suangkul tang anget uh akhah a; Jesu bel a-utut aloh ding un apeta hi.
Apikhiak lai un, Kurini khomi Simon kichi, gamsung a kipan hong pai amantawm ua, Jesu nunglam a po ding in atung ah kros angata uhi.
Huan mi nazong leh numei amah kah a mau zelzul, mipi tampitak in amah azui uhi.
Jesu bel amaute lam nga in, "Jerusalem tanute aw, hon kah kei un, noumau leh na tate uh a ding in kap zaw un," achi hi.
"Ngai un, ani ahong tung ding a, 'Huai ni in, numei chingte, naupai ngeilouhna gilte, naungek tep ngei louh nawite ahampha uh,' achi ding uhi.
Huai hun chiang in mite'n, tangte kiang ah, 'Hon delh un,' achi ding uh, mualte kiang ah, 'Hon khuh un,' achi ding uhi.
Sing ahin lai a bawn hichibang a ahih uleh; akeu chiang in bang alohta phet ding ua?" achi hi.
Huan akiang ah midang nih, migiloute leng hihlup ding in api uhi.
Kalvari, achih mun uh atun un, migiloute, ataklam ah khat, aveilam ah khat toh akilhden uhi.
Jesu'n, "Pa, amaute ngaidam in; athilhih uh athei kei ua ahi," achi hi. Huchi in apuansilhte kihawm in, ai asan uhi.
Huan mihonpi'n dingh kawm in a-en uhi. Huchi in vaihawm mite'n, "Midang bawn ahondam aka; Pathian tel Khrist ahih taktakleh amah leng kihondam hen aw," chi in a-enghou uhi.
Sepaihte'n leng amah nuihza bawlna in anei ua, akiang ah ahong ua, zu thuk apia uhi.
"Judate' Kumpipa na hih taktakleh kihondam in," achi uhi.
Huan alutung zawn kros ah, Grik, Latin leh Hebru laimal in, "HIAI JUDATE' KUMPIPA AHI," chi in laigelh atak uhi.
Huan amigilou kilh khat un Jesu atai a, "Khrist na hi kei a hia? Kihondam inla, kou leng hon hondam tanla," achi hi.
Himahleh khatpa'n dawng kawm in, ataihilh a, "Pathian nangawn na kihta kei a hia kibang sap a hon gawt uh?
Ei zaw gawt tuak him i hi; i thilhih man lel mu i hi a; hiai mi'n bangmah ahihkhial ngal kei a,” achi hi.
Ama'n Jesu kiang ah, "Toupa na lalgam a na hong pai chiang in hon theigige in," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, tuni in ka kiang ah Paradis ah na om sam ding,” achi hi.
Huan dak gukna vel ahi a, huai nungsiah dak kuana hun tan in gam pumpi ahong mialvekta a, nisa vak abeita hi.
Tempul puanzak alai ah ahong keksuak hi.
Aw ngaihtak in Jesu akikou a, "Pa, na khut ah ka kha ka hon kemsak hi," achi hi. Huai achih zoh in akha akhahta hi.
Sepaih zaheutupa'n thil omdan amuh in, "Hiai mi, pel lou in midik ahi ngeingei," chi in Pathian aphat hi.
Huai etnop en ding a mipi hong kikhawm tengtengte'n thil omdante amuh un a-awm uh kitum in akik nawnta uhi.
Huan ameltheihte tengteng leh numei Galili gam a kipan a hon zuite, huai thilte en in gamlatak ah adingh uhi.
Huan ngai un, mi khat amin Joseph, vaihawmmi, mihoihtak, diktak, Judate khua khat Arimathai a kipan a-om hi.
Avaihawm uah leh athilhih uah leng aki-awi kei him a, ama'n Pathian lalgam ana lamen gige hi.
Huai mi Pilat kiang ah ahoh a, Jesu luang angen hi.
Huan alakhia a, puanmalngat in atuam a, han, suang khuakkuak, kuamah sial nailouhna ah, asial hi.
Huan huai ni tuh Kisakkholhna ni, Sabbath ni tun dek kuan ahi.
Galili gam a kipan akiang a numei hong zuite'n azui zel ua, han leh aluang sialdan amu uhi.
Huan apai nawn ua, gimnamtui leh thaunamtui abawl ua; huan Sabbath ni in thupiak bang in akhawlta uhi.
Huan nipikal a ani masapen, phalvak in, gimnamtui abawlte uh tawi in, han ah ava hoh uhi.
Han a kipan suangtum khuksuan a om amu uhi.
Huan alut ua, Toupa Jesu luang amu kei uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huaiziak a amangbat lai un, ngai in, mi nih puan milengthei silh akiang uah ahong dingh uhi.
Alau ziak ua, lei si a bokkhup a a-om lai un, akiang uah, "Bangziak a misi lak a mihing zong?
Hiai ah a-om nawnta kei, athounawnta; Galili gam a a-om lai a na kiang ua athugen theigige un,
Mihing Tapa mikhialte khut ah matsak in a-om ding a, akilhden ding ua, ani thum ni in athounawn ding ahi, achih," achi uhi.
Huan athugente ahon thei thak nawn uhi.
Hanmun a kipan apai nawn un, sawm-le-khatte leh midang tengtengte kiang ah huai thil tengteng ahilh uhi.
Sawltakte kiang a huai thuhilhte bel Mari Magdalin, Mari, Joanna, Jakob nu Mari leh akiang ua numei dangte ahi uhi.
Himahleh huaite thugen thu maimai in angai ua, amau ataksang kei uhi.
Himahleh Peter athou a, han ah ataita a; huan akun a, a-en a, puanmalngat omte kia amu a, huchi in thil omdan lamdang satak in inn lam ah apaita hi.
Huan ngai in, huai ni mah in alak ua mi nih khua khat Emmaus achih uah ahoh dek ua, huai khua Jerusalem a pan ching sawmguk ahi.
Huan thil hong tung tengteng agenkhawm zel uhi.
Gen a akisel lai un, Jesu ngei in ahon zuan a, akiang uah apai samta hi.
Himahleh amah a theihlouhna ding un, amit uh hihvaih in a-om hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Pai kawm a na genkhawm uh bang thu ahia?” achi hi. Huan dahmeltak in adingh dinden uhi.
Huan amin Kleopas pen in akiang ah, "Tulai a thil omdan na theih louh, Jerusalem ah nangmah kia in hia na ten?" chi in adong hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bang thil eita?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Nazaret Jesu, Pathian leh mi tengteng mitmuh a athu leh athilhih a zawlnei minthangtak tanchin thu;
siampu liante leh ka heutute un thah ding a thu apiak ua, akilhden thute uh.
Kou amah zaw Israelte tanpa hi ding a lamen lua hi ung a, himahleh, huai thiltun nungsiah tuni ani thum ni ahita hi.
Huai lou leng ka pawlte uh numei kuate hiam zingsang in, han ah ava hoh ua, hon hihmangbang uhi.
Aluang muloupi in, Pathian angelte kilak ka mu uh, huai mite'n athounawnta chih agen uh, ahong chi uhi.
Ka ompihte lak ua kuate hiam han ah ahoh ua, numeite gen bang ngei in amu ua; himahleh amah amu kei uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Mihaite aw, zawlneite thugen tengteng gintak thu a ze-olte aw;
Khrist in huai thilte thuak a thupina a lut ding him ahi kei a hia?" achi hi.
Mosi leh zawlneite tengteng a pan in, Laisiangthou tengteng a ama tanchin toh kisai peuhmah amau ahilhchian zel hi.
Huan ahohna ding khua uh atung dekta ua; amah gamla deuh a hoh tum bang in a-om hi.
Kam in akhou ua, "Ka kiang uah taam in; nitaklam hi ding ahita a, ni leng tum dekta ahi," chi in. Huchi in akiang ua taam ding in alutta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ua an um a atut in tanghou ala a, avualzawl a, abalkham a, akiang uah apia hi.
Huan amit uh ahong vakta a, amel atheichianta uhi. Himahleh amah amangta mai hi.
Amau, “Lampi a hon houpih lai a Laisiangthou thute hon hilhchet lai in i lungtang avakhuai him hilou hia?" akichi uhi.
Huai laitak in, athou ua, Jerusalem ah akik nawn ua, sawm-le-khatte leh alawm omkhawmte amu ua, amau,
"Toupa ana thounawn taktak ahi, Simon kiang ah leng akilakta," ana chi uhi.
Amau lampi a bang thil om hiam chih leh tanghou abalkhap a, amel atheihdante uh ahilh sam uhi.
Huai thu agen lai un, Jesu mahmah alak uah ahong dingh a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
Himahleh kiguih hial in, lauhuai asa mahmah ua, sikha mu hi in akingaihtuah uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bang achia mangbang na hi ua? Bangziak a na lungsim ua ginlahna hong om ahia?
Ka khutte ka khepekte en un, kei mahmah ka hi. Hon khoih unla, thei un; sa leh guh nei a na hon muh bang un, kha in zaw sa leh guh anei ngal kei hi," achi hi.
Huai agen khit in akhutte akhepekte amau alak hi.
Kipah luat ziak a agin ngam louh ua lamdang asak lai un, akiang uah, "Hiai ah banghiam nek ding na nei uhia?" achi hi.
Ngahou, bak khat leh khuaizu khak apia uhi.
Ala a, ama uah aneta hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Na kiang ua ka om lai a ka tanchin gelh peuhmah thute ahong tung ding chi a ka hon hilhhilhte Mosi Dan, zawlneite leh phatna late a thu kigen, hiaite mah ka thu ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Laisiangthou thu theihna ding in alungtang uh avaksakta hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Hichibang a gelh ahi, Khrist in gim athuak ding a, ani thum ni in misi lak a kipan athounawn ding,” achi hi.
"Ama min in kisikna leh khelh ngaihdamna thu Jerusalem khua a pan in nam chih kiang ah hilh ahi ding," chi in.
"Huai thil tengteng atheihpihte na hi uhi.
Huan ngai un, na tung uah ka Pa thuchiam ka hon sawl ding hi. Himahleh, tunglam a kipan thilhihtheihna silhsak a na om masiah uh khopi ah om kinken un," achi hi.
Huan Bethani pha in amau apikhia a; huan aban azak a, avualzawl hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, avualzawl laitak in amau apaisan a, van ah pitouh in a-omta hi.
Huan amah abia ua, kipak kawm in Jerusalem ah akik nawn ua;
tempul ah Pathian phat in a-om nilouh uhi. Amen.

Tiberias Kaisar vaihawm akum sawm-le-nga kum in, Judia gam ukpa Pontias Pilat ahi a, Galili gam kumpipa Herod ahi a, a-unau Philip, Ituria leh Trakoniti gam kumpipa ahi a, Abilin gam kumpipa Lusania ahi.
Annas leh Kaiapha siampu lianpen ahi ua, huai lai in gamdai ah Zakariah tapa Johan kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi.
Amah bel Jordan lui gei kim gam tengteng ah ahoh a, thil hihkhial ngaihdamna ding in kisikna baptisma thu agen zel hi.
Zawlnei Isai laibu a: "Gamdai a kikou aw in, Toupa lampi sial unla, alampite tangsak un.
Guam chih sundim ahi ding a, tang leh mual chih, hihniam ahi ding; lampi kawite tansak ahi ding a, lampi phokte mamsak ahi ding.
Huan mi tengteng in Pathian hotdamna amu ding uh," achi, chih gelh bang in.
Ama'n baptisma tang ding akiang a mipi hong sukte kiang ah, "Nou gul suante aw, thangpaihna hong tung ding taisan ding a kua'n hon vauhilh ahia?
Huchi in kisik minputak in gah un, ei hon suangpa Abraham ahi na lungsim un chi kei un; Pathian in hiai suangte Abraham suante in adingsak thei chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Tu mahmah in singbul teng ah heipi koih ahita; huchi in sing chih gah hoih a gah lou peuhmah phuk in a-om a, mei ah paih in a-om," achi hi.
Huan mipite'n akiang ah, "Bang ka hihta ding ua?" chi in adong uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuapeuh puanak nih nei in anei lou kiang ah hawm hen; kuapeuh an nei in huchibang mah in hih hen," chi in adawng hi.
Huan siahkhon mite leng baptisma tang ding in ahong ua, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, bang ka hih ding ua?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon sehsak val uh khon kei un," achi hi.
Sepaihte'n leng akiang ah, "Kou leng bang ka hih ding ua?" chi in adong uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuamah hiamgam in hih kei unla, dikloupi in kuamah hek kei unla, na loh uah lungkim un," achi hi.
Huan mite'n alamet ua, mi tengteng in Johan tungthu alungtang ua, Khrist ahi kha zenzen diam aw? chi a angaihtuah lai un,

Johan in adawng a, avek ua kiang ah, "Ke'n tui in ka hon baptis a, himahleh kei sang a mithupizaw ahong pai ding, akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei; ama'n Kha Siangthou leh mei in nou ahon baptis ding.
Akhut in aphazah atawi a, aphual zapsianna ding leh buhpang a buhte sunlutna ding in; asite mei mit ngei lou ah ahalmang ding," achi hi.
Huan hanthawnna tampi in mite kiang ah tanchinhoih ahilh zel hi.
Himahleh kumpipa Herod in anaupa zi, Herodias tungthu ah leh athilhihkhelh tung a Johan in ataihilh ziak in,
athilhihkhelh tengteng behlap in amah suangkul ah akhum hi.
Huan mi tengteng abaptis zoh in, hichi ahong hi a, Jesu leng baptis zoh a a-om in, athum a, van ahong kihong a,
Kha Siangthou sa pu in vakhu bang in ahong suk a, atung ah atuta a; van a kipan in aw ahong pawt a, "Nang ka Tapa deihtak na hi; na tung ah ka kipak mahmah," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n thu ahilh pat tung lai in amah kum sawmthum vel ahita, mi ngaih in zaw Joseph tapa ahi a, huai Heli tapa ahi a,
huai Matthat tapa ahi a, huai Levi tapa ahi a, huai Melki tapa ahi a, huai Janna tapa ahi a, huai Joseph tapa ahi a,
huai Matthathias tapa ahi a, huai Amos tapa ahi a, huai Nahum tapa ahi a, huai Esli tapa ahi a, huai Naggai tapa ahi a,
huai Maathi tapa ahi a, huai Matthathias tapa ahi a, huai Semmei tapa ahi a, huai Josek tapa ahi a, huai Joda tapa ahi a,
huai Joanan tapa ahi a, huai Rhesa tapa ahi a, huai Zerubbabel tapa ahi a, huai Salathiel tapa ahi a, huai Neri tapa ahi,
huai Melki tapa ahi, huai Addi tapa ahi, huai Kosam tapa ahi, huai Elmadam tapa ahi, huai Er tapa ahi,
huai Joses tapa ahi a, huai Eliezer tapa ahi a, huai Jorim tapa ahi a, huai Matthat tapa ahi,
huai Levi tapa ahi a; huai Simeon tapa ahi, huai Judah tapa ahi, huai Joseph tapa ahi, huai Jonam tapa ahi, huai Eliakim tapa ahi a,
huai Melia tapa ahi, huai Menna tapa ahi, huai Mattatha tapa ahi a, huai Nathan tapa ahi, huai David tapa ahi,
huai Jesse tapa ahi, huai Obed tapa ahi a, huai Boaz tapa ahi a, huai Salmon tapa ahi a, huai Nahshon tapa ahi,
huai Amminadab tapa ahi a, huai Admin tapa ahi, huai Arni tapa ahi a, huai Hezron tapa ahi, huai Perez tapa ahi a, huai Judah tapa ahi,
huai Jakob tapa ahi a, huai Isak tapa ahi, huai Abraham tapa ahi a, huai Tera tapa ahi a, huai Nahor tapa ahi.
Huai Serug tapa ahi, huai Reu tapa ahi, huai Peleg tapa ahi, huai Eber tapa ahi, huai Selah tapa ahi,
huai Kainan tapa ahi, huai Arpakshad tapa ahi, huai Sem tapa ahi, huai Noah tapa ahi, huai Lamekh tapa ahi,
huai Methuselah tapa ahi, huai Enok tapa ahi, huai Jared tapa ahi, huai Mahalalel tapa ahi, huai Kainan tapa ahi,
huai Enos tapa ahi, huai Seth tapa ahi, huai Adam tapa ahi, huai Pathian tapa ahi.
Jesu, Kha Siangthou in adim a, Jordan lui a kipan akik nawn a, diabol khem kawm in gamdai ah ni sawmli Kha pi in a-om hi.
Huai nite in bangmah ane kei hi.
Atawp in agil ahong kialta a, diabol in akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai suang tanghou suak ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei ding, Pathian kam a thupawt in ahing zaw ding," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
Huan tang sangtak ah apitou a, mitphiat kal lou in khovel gam tengteng a-ensak hi.
Akiang ah, "Hiai tengteng tung a thuneihna leh athupina ka hon pe ding; ka kiang a piak ahita hi, ka ut peuh kiang ah leng ka pe zel hi.
Huchi in hon bia inla, avek in nang a ahi ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian na biak ding a, amah nna kia na sep ding ahi," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jerusalem ah api a, tempul tungzum ah akoih a, akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai a kipan kikesak in;
nangmah humbit ding in na tungthu ah zaw a-angelte thu ape ding a,
amau akhut un ahon dom ding uh, huchi lou in zaw na khe in suang na sui kha ding, chih gelh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian ze-et ke'n," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
Huan diabol in akhemna ding teng a akhem khit in alemtan hun chiang a ding in apaisanta hi.
Kha thilhihtheihna in Galili gam ah Jesu apai nawnta a; atanchin huai kim gam teng ah athangta hi.
Huan sinagogte ah thu ahilh zel a, mi tengteng phat in a-om hi.
Huan akhanletna khua Nazaret ahong tung a; Sabbath ni a ahihdan ngeina bang in sinagog ah alut a, sim ding in adingh hi.
Akiang ah zawlnei Isai laibu apia ua, ama'n laibuzial aphel a, hiai thu kigelhna laitak asim hi:

"Liangvaite kiang a Tanchinhoih gen ding a na hon seh ziak in ka tung ah Toupa Kha a-om; ama'n ahon sawl, salte kiang ah pawtna thu leh, mittawte kiang a mitvak neih nawnna thu gen ding, simmoh thuakte pawtsakna ding.
Toupa lungkim kum thu gen ding in," chih.
Huan laibu azial a, nasepsakpa ape nawn a, atuta hi. Huan sinagog a mi tengteng mit atung ah atuta hi.
Akiang uah, "Hiai Laisiangthou thu tuni in na zak un atangtungta," chi in agen pan hi.
Avek un amah aphat ua, akamsuak hehpihna thute lamdang asa mahmah uh, "Hiai mi Joseph tapa ahi kei a hia?" achi uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou hiai thupil thu, Daktor, nang leh nang kihihdam in, Kapernaum a na thilhih ka na zak peuh uh, hiai ah nangmah kholam ah leng hih in chi in hon chi khong ding zaw na hi ve ua,” achi hi.
Amah mah in, “Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, zawlnei kuamah ama kholam ah pahtawi in a-om ngei kei hi.
Huchi in diktak in ka hon chi ahi, Elijah dam lai a, kum thum leh kha guk van abin a, khovel a kial nakpitak a ahong tun in, Israel gam ah meithai tampi a-om uhi.
Himahleh alak ua kuamah kiang ah Elijah sawl ahi kei, Sidon gam lam a Zarephath a numei, meithai kiang kia a sawl ahi zaw hi.
Huan zawlnei Elishah dam lai in leng Israel gam ah phak tampi a-om ua; himahleh alak uah kuamah hihsiangthou in a-om kei, Siria mi Naaman kia hihsiangthou in a-om zaw hi," achi hi.
Huan sinagog a mi tengteng in huai thute azaktak un, aheh mahmah uhi.
Adingh suausuau ua, khua a kipan in asawnkhia ua, paihkhiak ding in akho omna mual pang ah api uhi.
Himahleh amah alak uah apaisuak a, apaimangta hi.
Huan Galili gam a khua khat, Kapernaum ah ava hohsuk hi. Sabbath ni in mite thu ahilh hi.
Thuneitak a agen ziak in athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huan sinagog ah dawi nin paimi khat ana om hi.
Amah aw ngaihtak in akikou a, “Eh! Nazaret Jesu, kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Hon hihmangthang ding in na hong maw? Nang ka hon thei, Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi," achi hi.
Jesu'n atai a, “Dai inla, asung a kipan pawt in," achi hi. Huan dawi in alai ah ahihpuk a, hihna lou in asung a kipan apawtta hi.
Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Bang thu ahia le? Thuneitak leh thilhihtheitak in dawi ninte thu apia a, apawt uh," chi in akihou uhi.
Huan huai kim gam khua teng ah atanchin athangta hi.
Huan athou a, sinagog a kipan apawt a, Simon inn ah alut hi. Simon zi nu nakpitak in akhosik a, huchi in amah a ding in ana ngetsak uhi.
Akiang ah adingh a, khosik atai a, adaita hi; athou pah a, a-nna uh asepsakta hi.
Huan nitum kuan in natna tuamtuam a na, damlou nei peuhmah in akiang ah ahon pi ua; avek un atung uah akhut akoih chiat a, ana hihdam zel hi.
Huan dawite'n leng, "Pathian Tapa na hi," chi a kikou in, mi tampi sung a kipan in hong pawt uhi. Huan amau atai a, Khrist ahi chih atheih ziak un apau uh aphal kei hi.
Huan khovak tak in apawt a, kuamah omlouhna mun ah ahoh a; mipite'n azong ua, akiang ah ahong ua, amau apaisanlouhna ding in let atum uhi.
Himahleh akiang uah, "Kho dang ah leng Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih ka hilh ding ahi, huai ding a sawl ka hi ngal a,” achi hi.
Huchi in Galili gam a sinagogte ah thu ahilhta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi'n Pathian thu angaihkhiak ua, amah aboh huthut lai un, amah Gennesaret tuipi gei ah adingh hi.
Huan tuipi gei a long nih om amu a, himahleh ngaman mite apawtkhia ua, alente uh asawp uhi.
Huchi in long khat Simon a pen ah atuang a, akiang ah lui gei a kipan neukha tolhlutsak deuh angen hi. Huan atu a, long a kipan mipite thu ahilh hi.
Huan thugen azoh in, Simon kiang ah, "Lithuk lam naih unla, ngaman ding in, na lente uh pai un," achi hi.
Huan Simon in akiang ah, "Heutupa, gimtak in zankhua in ka pang ua, bangmah ka man kei ua, himahleh na thu in lente ka pai nawn ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan apaih ualeh nga tampitak akhuh ua, alente uh akek iak-iak hi.
Huan long dang a om alawmte uh amau huh ding in akhutvan hial uhi. Ahong pai ua, long nih tum phialphial in asungdim tuaktuak uhi.
Simon Peter in huai amuh in, Jesu khebul a bokkhup in, “Toupa, hon paisan in, mikhial ka hi,” achi hi.
Anga mat uh amah leh alawmte'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi;
Simon pawlte mah Zebedai tapa Jakob leh Johan in leng lamdang asa mahmah sam uhi. Simon kiang ah Jesu'n, "Lau ke'n, tuban siah mihing na manta ding," achi hi.
Huan lui gei ah alongte uh atolh galkai ua, bangkim paisan in amah azuita uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, khua khat a a-om lai in ngai dih, mi khat phak a pumdim a-om a, ama'n Jesu amuh in, ama a bokkhup in, "Toupa, na utleh na hon hihsiang thei," chi in angen ngutngut hi.
Ama'n sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangta in,” achi hi. Huan thakhat in aphak ahong bei pah hi.
Akiang ah, "Kuamah hilh ke'n, himahleh siampu kiang ah va ki-ensak inla, na sianthouna ding Mosi seh bang lan in, mite theihchetna ding in," achi hi.
Himahleh atanchin thu athang semsem a; mipi tampitak athu za nuam leh anatnate uh hihdam ut in ahong kikhawm kheukhou uhi.
Himahleh amah gamdai ah apaituam a, athum hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in ni khat thu ahilh hi. Akiang ah Pharisaite leh dansiamte atu uhi, huaite Galili leh Judia gam kho teng a kipan a hong pai ahi uhi. Mite hihdamna ding in akiang ah Toupa thilhihtheihna a-om hi.
Huan ngai dih, lupna toh mizaw khat ahon zawng ua; ama a koih ding in zawnlut atum uhi.
Himahleh mipi ziak in zawnlutdan ding amu thei kei ua, intung a kipan alaitak, Jesu ma ah alupna toh akhaikhesuk uhi.
Huan aginna uh amuh in akiang ah, "Mihing, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n, "Pathian gensia hiai mi kua ahia? Pathian kia lou in kua'n ahia khelhnate ngaidam thei?" chi in angaihtuah uhi.
Huchi in Jesu'n angaihtuah uh athei a, akiang uah, "Na lungtang uah bang na ngaihtuah ua?
Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita, chih leh thou inla, khe in paita in, chih, akoi pen gen anuam zaw?
Himahleh, khovel ah Mihing Tapa in khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," damlou mizaw kiang ah, “Thou inla, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in, ka hon chi,” achi hi.
Huchi in amitmuh un athou pah a, alupna ala a, Pathian phat kawmkawm in a-inn ah apaita hi.
Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, Pathian aphat uhi. "Tuni in thillamdang pitak i mu hi,” achi ua, alau mahmah uhi.
Huaite khit in apawt a, siah piakna mun a tu, siahkhonmi khat amin Levi amu a; akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
Huchi in adingh a bangkim paisan in azuita hi.
Huan Levi in a-inn ah Jesu a ding in ankuang thupitak alui a; siahkhonmi leh midangte toh mi tampi in amau a-umpih chiat uhi.
Pharisaite leh laigelhmite anungzuite tung ah aphun uhi, "Bangziak a siahkhon mite leh mikhialte kiang a ne a dawn na hi ua?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Midam-theite'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamtheiloute'n akiphamoh uhi.
Midiktatte sam ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte kisiksak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
Huan amau akiang ah, "Johan nungzuite'n an angawl zel ua, athum zel uh; Pharisaite nungzuite'n leng huchibang mah in ahih zel uh; himahleh na nungzuite'n ane un adawn gige uh," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupi mite kiang a apasal ding a om lai siah moupi mite an angawlsak thei ua hia?
Himahleh apasal ding amau a kipan pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai ni chiang in zaw angawl ding uh," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah gentehna thu leng agen a, "Kuamah in puan thak them in puan lui athuap ngei kei, thuap mah le uh, athak in akaikek dia, athak them leh alui akituak kei ding uhi.
Huan kuamah in uain thak savun uain thawl lui ah athun ngei kei, thun le uh uain thak savun thawlte apuakzak dia, abo dia, savun thawlte leng asegawp ding uhi.
Uain thak savun uain thawl thak ah athun zaw ding uhi.
Huan kuapeuh uain lui na dawn khin in leng, athak aduh pah kei hi; alui pen hoihzaw achi ngal a,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni khat in buhlei ah apaisuak a, anungzuite'n buhvuite akhiak ua, akhutpek ua nuaisiang in ane uhi.
Pharisai kuate hiam in, "Bangziak a Sabbath ni a hihsiang lou hih na hi ua?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a, "David agilkial lai a alawmte toh athilhih uh huai bangte leng na sim kei ua hia?
Huchi a Pathian inn a lut a, siampute lou ngal in anek siang louh tanghou koihtuam alak a, alawmte kiang a apiak sam thu," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath' Toupa ahi,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni dang khat in sinagog ah alut a, thu ahilh a; huai ah mi khat khut taklam zaw ana om hi.
Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n ahekna ding amuhtheihna ding un, Sabbath ni in hihdam ding in akisa hia kisa lou asim et uhi.
Himahleh ama'n alungsim uh thei a, khutzaw kiang ah, "Thou inla, alai ah dingkhia in," achi hi. Huan athou a, adingkheta hi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihhoih asiang hia, hihsiat? Hotdam asiang hia, hihlup? K'on dong ahi," achi hi.
Huan avek un a-en velvel a, akiang ah, "Na khut zankhia in,” achi hi. Huan azankhia a, akhut adamta hi.
Huchi in aheh lo mahmah ua, Jesu tung a hihdan ding akihouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai a kipan in apawt a, thum ding in tang ah akuan a, Pathian kiang ah zankhua in athum hi.
Khua avaktak in anungzuite asam a; alak uah sawm-le-nih atel a, amin ding un leng Sawltakte asa hi.
Huaite Simon Peter achih leh a-unaupa Andru, Jakob leh Johan, Philip leh Bartholomai,
Matthai leh Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Zealot kichi Simon,
leh Jakob tapa Judas leh amansakpa Judas Iskariot ahi uh.

Huan amau toh apaikhia a, mun zang ah adingh a, anungzui mipite toh, Judia gam tengteng a kipan leh Jerusalem a kipan leh Tura leh Sidon kholam a tuipi gei a kipan mipi tampitak athu ngainuam leh adamlouhnate uh hihdam ut in ahong pai uhi.
Huchi in dawi nin sukbuaite leng damsak in a-omta uhi.
Huan akiang a kipan thilhihtheihna apawtkhia a, michih ahihdam zel ziak in mipi tengteng in amah khoih atum uhi.
Huan adakkhia a, anungzuite mitsuan kawm in agen a: "Nou gentheite aw, na hampha uh; Pathian lalgam nou a ahi ngal a.
Nou tua gilkialte aw, na hampha uh, tai ding na hi ngal ua. Nou tua kapte aw, na hampha uh, nui ding na hi ngal ua."
"Mihing Tapa ziak a mite'n ahon huat ua, hon pampaih ua, hon tai ua, na min uh ahoih kei chi a ahon paihmang chiang un, na hampha ding uh.
Huai ni in kipak unla, nuam in tawm un, ngai un, van ah na kipahman uh a-om kihkeih hi; huchibang mah in apipute un zawlneite tung ah ahih uhi.”
"Himahleh, nou mihaute aw, na tung uh agik e; na khamuanna uh na mu khinta ngal ua;
nou tua vahte aw, na tung uh agik e; na gil uh ahong kial ding. Nou tua nuite aw; na tung uh agik e; lungkham a kap ding na hi ngal ua."
"Mi tengteng in ahon phat chiang un na tung uh agik ding hi; huchi mah bang in apipute un zawlnei takloute tung ah ahih uhi.
"Ka thu ngaikhete aw, ka hon hilh ahi, na melmate uh it unla, hon hote hoihna ding hih un,
Hon hamsiatte vualzawl unla, hon simmohte thumsak un.
Biang langkhat a hon bengpa alehlam leng doh in; na puan hon laksakpa kiang ah na puanak leng it ke'n.
Ahon ngen peuh kiang ah pia in; huan na van hon laksakpa kiang ah ngen nawn ke'n.
Huan mi'n na tung ua ahih ding uh na deih bang zel un mi tung ah leng hih sam un.
"Huan ahon itte kia na it un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng amau itte a-it sam ve ua oi!
Na tung ua hoihte tung kia a na hoih un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng huchibang mah in ahih zel ve ua oi.
Muh nawn lametnate kiang kia a thil na leitawisak un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng angeingei mu nawn ding in mikhialte kiang ah aleitawisak sam uhi.

Himahleh na melmate uh it unla, ahoihna ding un hih unla, lunglel het lou in leitawisak un; huchi in na kipahman uh atam dia, Tungnungpen tate na hi ding uh; ama'n mi kipahna dan theiloute leh migiloute ahehpih hi.
Na Pa azahngaih theih bang in zahngai thei in om un.
"Hawmsak kei un, huchi in hawmsak in na om kei ding uh; kuamah siam lou in sep kei un, huchi in siam louh in na om kei ding uh; ngaidam un, huchi in ngaihdam in na om ding uh;

pia un, huchi in piak in na om ding uh, hoihtak a teh a, hen gak a, sin gak in, let nawinawi in na angsung uah piak in na om ding uh. Noumau tehna ngei mah a tehsak a piak in na om ding uh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, gentehna agen a: "Mittaw in mittaw mah api thei diam? Anih un kokhuk ah akekhawm kei ding ua hia?
Asinsakpa tung ah nungzui a-om kei; himahleh mi kuapeuh kisinsiamtate asinsakpa bang in a-om ding uh.
"Huan bangziak a na mit a singtum om limsak lou a, na unau mit a ninneng neuchik om mu na hia?

Nangmah mit a singtum om mu lou in, na unau kiang a, 'Unau, na mit a ninneng neuchik om hon lakhesak ve,' bangchi a chi thei na hia? Milepchiah na mit a pan singtum lakhe masa in, huchi in na unau mit a ninneng neuchik lakkhiak ding chiantak in na mu thei ding hi.
"Sing hoih gahsia a gah a-om ngei kei; sing sia lah gah hoih a gah a-om ngei sam kei hi.
Sing chih amau gah chiat ah akithei hi. Mi'n khaulingnei kung ah theipi alou ngei kei uh, loubukh lingnok lak ah grep gah alou ngei sam kei uh.
Mihoih in alungtang goubawm hoih a kipan thil hoihte alakhia a; migilou in alungtang goubawm sia a kipan thil hoihloute alakhe zel hi; alungtang a dim val kam in agen zel ngal a.
"Huan nou bang ding a, ka gente hihloupi a, Toupa, Toupa, hon chi na hi ua?
Michih ka kiang a hong a, ka thu za a zui peuhmah kua bang ahi ua, ka hon ensak ding:
Amah zaw inn lammi in lei thukpi a tou a, suangpi tung a suangphum lem mi bang ahi; huan tui ahong khan in, tui khauh in huai inn akhoh a, ahihling thei kei; hoihtak a lam ahih ziak in.
Himahleh thu za a mang lou suangphum louh a leitung maimah a inn lammi ahi; tui khauh in huai inn akhoh a, achim pah a; huai inn siatna thupitak ahi,” achi hi.
Huan mipite zak a athugen teng azohtak in Kapernaum ah alut a,
sepaih zaheutu kuahiam sikha deihtak a china in, asi dekdek hi.
Huchi in Jesu tanchin azaktak in asikha hong hihdam ding a ngen ding in akiang ah Juda upate asawl hi.
Amau Jesu kiang ava tung ua, limtak in angen uhi,
"Amah zaw na hihsak tak ahi; ka nam uh a-it a, ka sinagog uh leng ama hon lamsak ahi,” achi uhi.
Huchi in Jesu amau toh ahong pai hi. A-inn atun dek kuan in sepaih zaheutu'n alawmte asawl a, "Ka insung na lutna tak ahi kei,
huaiziak in na kiang a hong tak in leng ka kisim kei, thu leltak gen lechin, ka naupang adam mai ding.

Kei leng mi thunuai a om ka hi a, ka nuai ah sepaihte a-om ua; huai mipa, hiai mipa, 'Pai in,' ka chihleh apai a, midang kiang ah leng, 'Hong pai in,' ka chihleh ahong pai a; ka sikha kiang ah leng, hiai hih in, ka chih leh ahih zel," achi hi.
Jesu'n huai thu azak in lamdang asa mahmah a, akihei a, mipi amah zuite kiang ah, "K'on hilh ahi, Israelte lak ah leng hichi tel a ginna thupi ka mu kha kei," achi hi.
Huan inn ah amisawlte apai nawn ua, damtak in sikha amuta uhi.
Huan sawt louchik in khua khat Nain kichi ah ahoh a; akiang ah anungzuite leh mipi tampitak ahoh sam uhi.
Khopi kongkhak kiang atun in, ngai in, misi ahon zawngkhia ua, anu tapa neihsun ahi a, amah lah meithai ahi ngal a; akhua mite tampi akiang ah a-om uhi.
Toupa'n meithainu amuh in, alainat mahmah a, "Kap ke'n," achi hi.
Huan ava naih a, lang ava len hi; huchi in lang zawngte akhawl uhi. "Tangval thou in, ka hon chi," achi hi.
Huan misi atukhia a, ahong pauta hi. Huchi in Jesu'n anu kiang ah apeta hi.
Huan mi tengteng in alau ua, Pathian aphat ua, "I lak ah zawlnei thupi ahong suakta, achi ua, Pathian in amite hong vehta," achi uhi.
Huan huai mi tungtang thu Judia gam tengteng leh akiang vel gam teng ah athangkheta hi.
Huan Johan nungzuite'n huai thu tengteng Johan ahilh uhi.
Huchi in Johan in anungzuite nih asam a, Toupa kiang ah asawl a, "Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, midang hungaih lailai ding ka hi uhia?” chi in.
Huan amisawlte akiang ahong tun un, "Baptispa Johan in, 'Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, midang hungaih lai ding ka hi uhia?' chi in na kiang ah kou a hon sawl," achi uhi.
Huaitak in Jesu'n, damloute, hipi veite, dawimatte tampi ahihdam a, mittaw tampite leng amit uh ahihvak hi.

Akiang uah, "Pai nawnta unla, thil na muh uleh na zak uh Johan va hilh un; mittawte mit ahong vakta, khebaite khe in apaita ua, phakte hihsiang in om ua, nangongte bil ahong vakta, misite kaihthoh in a-omta uh, azawngte'n tanchinhoih hilh atangta uh.
Huan kuapeuh ka tung a lung hihlouhna mu lou ahampha hi," chi in adawng hi.
Johan sawltakte apai nung un Jesu'n mipite kiang ah Johan thu agen a, "Bang en ding a gamdai a paikhia na hi ua? Sialluang huih mut ling maw?
Ahihkeileh, bang en ding pen a paikhia na hi ua? Puannem silh mi maw? Ngai un, puan thupi silh leh minuamsate kumpipate inn ah ei ve a-om uh.
Ahihkeileh, bang en ding pen in ahia na paikhiak uh? Zawlnei maw? Ahi tawk vo oi, ka hon chi ahi, amah zaw zawlnei sang a leng thupizaw ahi.
'En dih, ka thangkou na ma ah ka sawl ahi, ama'n na ma ah na lampi abawlkhol ding, chi a, atanchin kigelh, hiai mipa ahi.’
Numei suan lak ah Johan sang a thupizaw a-om kei; himahleh Pathian lalgam a mineupen leng amah sang in athupizaw, ka hon chi ahi," achi hi.
Huan mi tengteng leh siahkhonte'n huai azak un, Johan khut a baptisma tangsa ahih ziak un, Pathian siam atangsak uhi.
Pharisaite leh dan thei mite'n bel akiang a baptisma ana tang kei ua, amau a ding a Pathian in hoih dia asehsak adeih kei uhi.
Huchi in Jesu mah in, "Hiai khang bang toh ka teh diam aw? Bang toh kibang ahi ua?
Naupang dawr mun a tu a, 'Tamngai hon tumsak ung a, lam lou uchin a;' 'Suun ung a, nou lah kap tuan lou uchin a,' chi a kichituahte bang ahi uh.
Baptispa Johan ahong pai a, tanghou ane kei, uain leng adawn kei a nou, 'Dawi zawl ei ve,' na chi uhi.
Mihing Tapa ahong pai a, ane in adawn a, 'En dih uh, an haipa, uain haipa, siahkhon mite leh mikhialte lawm,' na chi zel uhi.
Himahleh pilna tuh atate tengteng in siam atan uhi," achi hi.
Pharisaite lak a mi khat in akiang a an ne ding in adeih hi. Huai Pharisai inn ah alut a, an a-um hi.
Ngai dih, huai khua a numei khat om in Pharisai inn ah an um in atu chih a theihtak in alabaster bawm in thaunamtui ahon tawi hi.
Anung ah akhepek bul ah kap kawm in adingh a, akhitui in akhepek asukawt a, asam in anul a, akhepek atawp a, thaunamtui anuh hi.
Huan asampa Pharisai in huai amuh in, alungsim in, “Hiai mi zawlnei ahihleh akhoihnu numei kua ahia, mi bangchi ahia, theihtuaktak hi a, mikhial ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, na kiang ah thu kam khat gen ding ka nei," chi in adawng hi. Ama'n, "Bang ahia, Sinsakpa?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Dangka leitawisak kuahiam in leibami nih anei a; khat in makhai zanga, khat in sawmnga aba uhi.
Huan aditna ding anei kei ua, angaidam tuaktuak hi. Huai mite akua in amah a-itzaw dia?" achi hi.
Simon in, "Angaihdam tampen in hi in ka gingta," chi in adawng hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Na chi dik," achi hi.
