Huan numei lam anga a, Simon kiang ah, "Hiai numei na mu hia? Na inn ah ka hong lut a, nang ka khepek silna ding tui na hon pe kei a, ama'n akhitui in ka khepek asukawt a, asam in anul hi.
Nang tawp himhim na hon tawp kei; ama'n ka hong lut nungsiah ka khepek tawp atawlnga kei hi.
Nang ka lutang ah thau na hon nilh kei a; ama'n ka khepek thaunamtui anilh hi.
Huaiziak in ka hon chi ahi, akhelhna tampi ngaihdam in a-omta; ama'n nakpi in a-it hi. Himahleh, ngaidam tawm in, neuchik in a-it," achi hi.
Huai zoh in numei kiang ah, "Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
Huchi in an umpihte'n, "Mikhialte nangawn ngaidam kua ahia eita?" akichi uhi.
Numei kiang ah, "Na ginna in ahon hondam hi, khamuangtak in paita in," achi hi.
Anung in Jesu thuhih leh Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih gen kawm in kholian leh khoneute tawn vialvial in apai a; akiang ah sawm-le-nihte a-om uhi.
Numei kuate hiam dawimat leh china dam nawnte Magdalin kichi Mari sung a dawi sagih pawtna achih uh,
Joanna, Herod sumkempa Chuza zi, Sussana leh midang tampite toh ahi uh; huaite'n amau neihsa in amah nna asepsak zel uhi.
Huan mipi tampitak ahong kikhawm ua, kho chih a pan akiang a hong paikhawm mite kiang ah gentehna in thu agen a.
"Buhchithehpa buhchi theh in akuan a; atheh lai in akhen lamsik ah akia a, mi'n asikden ua, tungleng vasate'n anegai uhi.
Huan akhen suang tung ah akia a, apoutak in akawt louh ziak in avuai pah hi.
Huan akhen loulingnei lak ah akia a, lou in apou tonpih a, adepmang hi.
Huan akhen lei hoih ah akia a, ahong pou a, aleh za in agahta," achi hi. Huai thu agen lai in akikou a, "Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za uhen!" achi hi.
Huan anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Hiai gentehna bang chihna ahia?" chi in adong uhi.
Ama'n, "Pathian lalgam thugukte na theih ding ua piak ahi a, midang kiang ah bel gentehna kia a gen ahi; mu napi a amuh theihlouhna ding uleh za napi a atheihsiamlouhna ding un," chi in adawng hi.
Huai gentehna thu omdan hiai ahi: Buhchi Pathian thu ahi.
Lampi sik a kiate thu zasate ahi uh; himahleh diabol ahong pai a, agin louh ua, hotdam ahihtheihlouhna ding un alungtang ua kipan thu alakmangsak zel hi.
Huan suang tung a kiate azaktak ua thu kipaktak a pom pahte ahi ua; himahleh zung himhim anei kei ua, sawt louchik kia agingta ua, khemna hun in atawpsan nak uhi.
Huan loulingnei lak a kiate thuzate ahi ua; himahleh akhosak zelna uah damsung khosak ngaihtuahnate, hauhsaknate, nopsaknate'n adep a, agah piching kei nak uhi.
Lei hoih a kiate bel thu za a lungtang kizen leh hoihtak a kem kinken a, thuakzoutak a gahsuahte ahi uhi.
"Kuamah khawnvak de in bel in akhuh kei uh, lupna nuai ah leng akoih kei uh; alut peuhmah in avak amuhtheihna ding un akoihna ah akoih zaw hi.
Thang lou ding a iim bangmah a-om kei, theih louh ding leh lang lou ding a selguk bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
Huchi in bangchibang in ahia na zak uh pilvang un; kuapeuh anei piak behlap ahi ding a, kuapeuh anei lou nei akichih sun leng laksak ahi ding,” achi hi.
Huan anu leh a-unaute'n Jesu kiang ahong naih ua, himahleh mipi ziak in akiang atung thei kei uhi.
"Na nu leh na unaute nangmah muh tum in inpua ah adingh nilouh uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Pathian thu za a gingtate ka nu leh ka unaute ahi uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in ni khat anungzuite toh long ah atuang a, akiang uah, "Dil gal khat lam ah i kai ding uh,” achi a, huchi in long aphel ua, apaita uhi.
Long a atuan lai un Jesu a-ihmuta a; tuipi ah huihpi ahong nungsuk a, along uh tui in adim dekdek a, lauhuaipi in a-omta hi.
Huan akiang ah ava hoh ua, aphawng ua, "Heutupa, heutupa, mangthang ding ka kei uh maw,” achi uhi. Amah akhanglou a huih leh tuikihot ataita a; atawp ua adaita mai uhi.
Huan akiang uah, "Na ginna uh koi a om ahia?" achi hi. Huan alau ua, lamdang asa mahmah uh. "Hiai mi kua ahia le, huih leh tui nangawn thu apiak a, athu aman uh?" akichi uhi.
Galili gam zawn Gerasinte gam atung uhi.
Huan gam a apaikhiak lai in, khua a mi dawimat kuahiam in ana mu a; huai mi sawtpi puan silh lou in a-om hi, inn ah leng a-om kei a, han ngen ah a-om zaw hi.
Jesu amuhtak in akikou a, ama ah abokkhup a, aw ngaihtak in, "Jesu, Pathian Tungnungpen Tapa, kei leh nang bang i kizolhna om ahia? Hon hihgim lou ding in ka hon ngen ahi," achi hi.

Jesu'n huai mi sung a kipan a dawi nin pawt ding in thu ape khinta hi. Huai mi dawi in tamveipi amat ahi a; khainiang leh kol abunsak ua, aveng zel ua; himahleh agakna uh ahihtat a, dawi in gamkeu ah adelhkhia hi.
Jesu'n, "Na min bang ahia?" chi in adong a, ama'n, "Nuai ka hi," achi, asung a dawi tampi alut ziak in.
Huan kokhuk taw nei lou a paih ding thu pe lou ding in Jesu kiang ah angen uhi.
Huai tang ah vokhon tampi agamta ua; vok sung a luttheihna thu akiang ah angen uhi. Ama'n phalna apia hi.
Dawite huai mi sung a kipan apawt ua, vok sung ah alut uhi; huan tuipi gei, ken ah vokhonte ataisuk ua, tuipi ah atailut ua, tui hak in asita uhi.
Huan vok vulte'n huai thil omdan amu ua, atai ua, khua ah leh gam ah agen uhi.
Huan bang ahita a? chi a en ding in apawt chiat uhi. Jesu kiang ahong tun un, dawi pawtsan nung puansilh a, lungsim ngeina pu in, Jesu khebul a tu ahong mu ua, huchi in alauta uhi.
Huan atheite'n dawimat ahihdamdan thu amaute ana hilh uhi.
Huan akim Gerasinte gam a mi tengteng in, alau mahmah ziak un, amah akiang ua kipan paimang ding in angen ua; huan, long ah atuang a, apaikik nawnta hi.
Dawi pawtsan mi in Jesu kiang a omdet angen hi.

Himahleh Jesu'n, "Na inn ah pai inla, Pathian in nang a dia thil ahon hihsak thupidan va hilh in," chi in asawlkhia hi. Huchi in apai a, khopi sung tengteng ah Jesu'n amah a dia thil ahihsak thupidan atangkoupihta hi.
Huan Jesu ahong kik nawn in mipi in amah akipahpih ua; amah ana ngak nilouh uhi.
Huan ngai dih, sinagog vaihawmpa mi khat amin Jaira ahong pai a, Jesu khebul ah abokkhup a, a-inn a hoh ding in angen ngutngut hi.
Tanu tang khat, kum sawm-le-nih hiam ding anei a, amah laitat ding in alum hi. Huan Jesu apai lai in mipihon in aboh lutlut uhi.
Numei khat kum sawm-le-nih sipawt a china asum neih tengteng daktorte lak a zang khinta, kuamah in ahihdam theih tuan louh uh;
anung ah ahong pai a, apuan mong akhoih a; thakhat in asipawt akam guih hi.
Jesu'n, "Kua ahia hon khoih?" achi hi. "Kei zaw ka hi kei," ana chi chiat uhi. Peter leh alawmte'n, "Heutupa, mipi'n hon boh lutlut in, ahon vel vengvung ve ua," achi uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n, "Kuahiam in hon khoih ahi, ka sung a kipan thilhihtheihna apawt chih ka theih ziak in," achi hi.
Huan numei in akisel theih louh atheih in, ling kawm in ahong pai a, ama ah bokkhup in akhoihsan leh thakhat a adam takdan mi tengteng ma ah agenkheta hi.
Huan akiang ah, "Tanu, na ginna na dampih hi, khamuangtak in paita in," achi hi.
Apau laitak in sinagog vaihawmpa inn a kipan mi khat ahong pai a, "Na tanu asita, heutupa hihgim nuam dah in," achi hi.
Jesu'n huai thu azak in, "Lau ke'n, gingta mai in, huchi in adam nawn ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan inn ava tun in, Peter, Johan, Jakob leh naupang nu leh pate kia chih louh ngal kuamah lut ding aphal kei hi.
Avek un ana kap kheukhou ua, akap vengvung ua, himahleh, ama'n, "Kap kei un, asi kei, ihmu ahi zaw," achi hi.
Huan si khin a atheih ziak un anuihsan maimah uhi.
Jesu'n akhut alen a, "Nungaknou, thou in," achi a, asam hi.
Huan akha ahong kik nawn a, athou pah hi.
Banghiam nek ding piak ding thu apia hi. Anu leh apa'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Himahleh ama'n athilhih kuamah hilh lou ding in achi bikbek hi.
Huan Jesu'n sawm-le-nihte asamkhawm a, dawi nin tengteng tung a thilhihtheihna leh natnate hihdamtheihna thuneihna apia hi.
Huchi in Pathian lalgam thu gen ding leh damloute hihdam ding in asawlkheta hi.
Akiang uah, "Zinna a ding in chiangkhun hiam, kawlzal hiam, tanghou hiam, dangka hiam, bangmah keng kei un; puanak nih leng keng kei un.
Na tunna inn uah tung kinken unla, huai inn a kipan paikhia un.
Huan ahon kipahpih lou peuhmah huai khua a kipan na paikhiak chiang un amau mohpaihna ding in na khepek ua leivui tatkhia un,” achi hi.
Huchi in akuanta ua, khua atawn vialvial uhi. Gam chih ah tanchinhoih ahilh ua, mi ahihdam zel uhi.
Huan kumpipa Herod in athilhih tengteng uh ana za a; khenkhat in, "Johan hing nawnta ahi, achi ua, khenkhat in,
Elijah hong kilak ahi, achi ua, khenkhat in, nidanglai zawlnei kuahiam thounawnta ahi," achih ziak un, alungzingta hi.
Herod in, "Johan alu ka tanta a; himahleh hichi lawmlawm a athu ka zakzak kua ahia?" chi in amah muh atumta hi.
Huan sawltakte ahong kik nawn un, akiang ah athilhihte uh ahilh ua, ama'n amaute pi in khopi Bethsaida kichi ah apaituamta hi.
Himahleh mipi'n athei ua, azui zel uh; ama'n amaute ana kipahpih a, Pathian lalgam thu ahilh a, hihdam kiphamoh peuhmahte ahihdam hi.
Huan nitaklam ahong hi dekta a; sawm-le-nihte ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Khuate leh akim gam ah giahna leh annek-tuidawn zong ding in mipite paisak tanla; gamkeu mun a om hi ngal hang a," achi uhi.
Ama'n bel akiang uah, "Nou nek ding pia un," achi hi. Amau, “Mi hiai zahzah nek ding i va leisak keileh, tanghou phel nga leh nga nih kia lou ngal bangmah i nei kei uh," achi uhi.
Piching ngen leng sangnga phial ahi uhi. Huan anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite apawlpawl in tusak un, sawmnga zel in,” achi hi.
Huchi in ahih ua, atusak vekta uhi.
Huan tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, abalkham a, mipi ma a lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia hi.
Huan ane ua, avah chiatta ua, akhamval nengte uh bawm sawm-le-nih aluakdim uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu amah kia a athum lai in akiang ah anungzuite a-om ua; akiang uah, "Mipite'n kua ka hi ahon chi ua?" chi in adong hi.
Amau, "Baptispa Johan ahon chi ua; himahleh khenkhat in, Elijah hiam nidanglai zawlnei kuahiam thounawn ahon chi uh," chi in adawng uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" achi hi. Peter in, "Pathian Khrist mah," chi in adawng hi.
Huan huai thu kuamah hilh louh ding chi bikbek in, thu apia hi:
"Mihing Tapa in thil tampi athuak dia, upate, siampu liante leh laigelhmite deih louh in a-om ding, thah in a-om dia, ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding," achi hi.
Huan mi tengteng kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuih a-utleh amah kingaihsak lou in, niteng a ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding; kuapeuh keimah ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding.
Mi'n khovel apum in nei henla, amah kimangsak hiam, ahihkeileh kimanlohleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia?
Kuapeuh keimah leh ka thu zahpihmi zaw Mihing Tapa in ama thupina toh, a Pa thupina leh a-angel siangthoute thupina toh ahong pai hun chiang in azahpih ding hi.
Diktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai a dinghte akhen, Pathian lalgam amuh masiah uh sihna chiam lou hial ding a-om uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n athugen nung ni giat hiam in, Peter, Johan leh Jakob api a, thum ding in tang ah ahohtou uhi.
Athum lai in amel omdan ahong lamdang a, apuansilhte mi lengthei in ahong ngouta hi.
Huan ngai in, mi nih amah toh akihou ua, huai mite Mosi leh Elijah ahi uh.
Thupina a kithuam in akilak ua, Jerusalem a sihna ahih bukim ding thu agen uhi.
Peter leh alawmte bel a-ihmut uh asuak a, himahleh ahak teitei ua athupina leh akiang a mi nih dinghte amu uhi.

Huan huai mite'n Jesu apaisan dek lai un, Peter in Jesu kiang ah, "Heutupa, ei a ding in hiai a om ahoih, aidakbuk thum i khoh dia, nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat, achi a, athugen leng theiloupi in."
Huan huai thute agen lai in mei ahong kai a, amau aliahta; mei lak a alut lai un alau uhi.
Meipi a kipan aw ahong suak a, "Hiai ka Tapa, ka tel ahi, amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
Huan aw adaihtak in Jesu kia amuta uhi. Huan adai dide ua, huai lai in athil muh uh kuamah bangmah ahilh kei uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in tang a kipan apaisuk nung un, mipi tampitak in amah ana dawn uhi.
Ngai in, mipi lak ah mi khat akikou a, "Sinsakpa, ka tapa en ding in ka hon ngen ahi, amah ka tapa neihsun ahi.
Ngai in, dawi in aman a, akikoukhe guih zel a; huchi in achilphuan ke hial in agimbawl a, nakpitak a hih sidup in apaisan zel hi.
Na nungzuite kiang ah delhkhe ding in ka ngen na a, ahihthei kei uh," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n, "Ginna nei lou khang leh lampialte aw, bang tan ahia ka hon thuak theih ding? Hiai ah na tapa hon pi in," chi in adawng hi.
Huan ahong pai lai in dawi in ahihpuk ek a, nakpitak in agimbawlta hi; himahleh Jesu'n dawi nin atai a, naupang ahihdam a, apa kiang ah apaisak nawnta hi.
Huan mi tengteng in Pathian thupidan lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Huchi in mi tengteng in athilhih tengteng lamdang asak lai un, Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah,
"Hiai thute na bil uah lut hen. Mihingte khut a Mihing Tapa matsak a om ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Himahleh athugen atheisiam kei uh, atheihtheihlouhna ding ua kisel ahi, huai thugen tanchin amah adong ngam kei uhi.
Huan alak uah kua athupipen dia? chih thu in ana kisel uhi.
Jesu'n alungtang ua angaihtuah uh athei a, naupang neu khat akai a, asik ah a-omsak a, akiang uah,
"Kuapeuh ka min ziak a hiai naupang neu kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi ding uh; keimah hon kipahpih hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi; na vek ua lak a neupen athupipen ahi ding," achi hi.
Johan in, “Heutupa, kuahiam na min a dawite delkhia ka mu ua, ka hon zuihna ua apan louh ziak in ka khamta uhi,” chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kham nawn kei un, kuapeuh nou hon dal lou nou lam a pang ahi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah pitouh hun ding anaitak in, Jerusalem a hoh atum tinten a, ama ah mi ama taisak hi.
Huan apai ua, amah a dia na kimansak ding in Samari mite khua khat ah alut uhi.
Amai Jerusalem kholam naih a alat ziak in amah ana kipahpih kei uhi.
Huchi in anungzui Jakob leh Johan in huai atheih un, "Toupa, amaute kangmang ding in, Elijah hih bang in van a kipan mei hong ke ding a thu ka piak uh hoih na sa hia?" achi uhi.
Amah akihei a, amau tai in, "Bang kha a pan na hi ua chih thei lou na hi uhiam?
Mihing Tapa mite hihmangthang ding hilou in, hondam ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi,” achi hi. Huan kho dang ah apaita uhi.
Huan lampi a apai lai un, kuahiam in akiang ah, "Na paina peuh ah ka hon zui ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sehalte'n kua anei ua, tungleng vasate'n leng bu anei uh, himahleh Mihing Tapa in zaw alu ngakna ding mun anei kei," achi hi.
Jesu'n midang kiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi. Himahleh ama'n, "Toupa, ka pa hon vuisak phot in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Misite'n amisi uh kivui uhen; nang Pathian lalgam thu va gen zaw in," achi hi.
Huan midang in leng, "Toupa, ka hon zui ding, himahleh ka inn a mite kampha in hon khasak phot in," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuapeuh leilehna len a, nunglam nga Pathian kumpigam mi hi tak ahi kei," achi hi.
Israel kiang a TOUPA kilakna Malaki in amuh.
"Ka hon itta," TOUPA'N achi. Nou bel, "Koi lai ah ahia nang kou na hon it tak?" na chi uhi, "Esau, Jakob unaupa ahi kei maw? Hinapi in, Jakob ka it hi."
Himahleh Esau ka hua a, atang sangte ka hihgawp a, gamdai sehalte kiang ah agoutan ka peta hi, TOUPA'N achi.

Edom in, "Suk zawngkhal in i om ua, himahleh i kik nawn ding ua mun kisegawpsate i lam ding uh," chi mahleh, hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Alam nawn ding ua, himahleh ka chimsak ding; mite'n amaute gitlouhna gam leh mipi atung ua tangtawn a TOUPA hehna nam," achi ding uhi.
Huchi in na mitte un amu dia, "Israel gamgi khen ah TOUPA letsak in om hen," na chi ding uhi.

"Tapa in apa azahtak a, sikha in apu; huchi apa ka hihleh, kei zahtakna koi a om ahia? Huchi a pu ka hihleh, kei kihtakna koi a om ahia? Sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang uah achi, siampu ka min musitte aw. Nou koi lai ah ahia na min ka muhsit uh? na chi uhi.
Ka maitam tung ah tanghou sesa na lan ua, nou koi lai ah ahia ka hon hihnit uh? na chi uh. TOUPA dohkan asimmohhuai, na chihna uah.

Kithoihna ding a mittaw na lat un, gilou ahi kei maw? Khebai leh damlou na lat un, gilou ahi kei maw? Tu in na ukpipa kiang ah pe mah dih ua, ama'n apom in na tung ah alungdam diam? Ahihkeileh nou ahon deihsak diam?" sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Huchi in tu in ka hon ngen hi, i tung a azahngaihna na theihna ding un Pathian deihsakna ngen un. Hiai na khut ua kipan thilpiak toh nou hon deihsak diam? sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.

Athawn a ka maitam tung a mei na tohlouhna ding un, na lak ua mi khat kongkhakte khak ding omleh aw; Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Nou ah kipahna ka nei kei a, na khut ua kipan in thillat leng ka sang sam kei ding.
Nisuahna a kipan nitumna lam pha hial in leng namte lak ah ka min athupi hi, mun chih ah ka min a ding in gimlim akilan a, thillat siangthou; namte lak a ka min alet ziak in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Himahleh nou na hihnin ua, TOUPA dohkan anin a, huai a agah toh an nangawn azahpihhuai na chihna uah.

'Ngai un, nak chimtakhuai hina e; na chi lai ua, huan na hahchhiai khum uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, hiamgamtak a lak hiam ahihkeileh khebaite leh damloute huchibang thillat na hon tawi uh; na khut ua kipan in hiaite sang peuhmah ding ka diam?' TOUPA'N achi.
Himahleh aganhon lak a apa nei a, thuchiam a TOUPA lak a thil demkai a kithoih, mikhempa hamsiat in om heh; Kumpipa thupi ka hi a, namte lak ah ka min alauhuai ngal a," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Tu in, nou siampute aw, “Hiai thupiak noute a ding ahi.

Ka min pahtawi ding a, na ngaihkhiak louh ua, na lungtang ua na koih kei uleh, huchi in na tung uah hamsia ka tungsak ding a, na vualzawlnate uh ka hamsiatkhum ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, ahi, lungtang a na koih louh ziak un, ka hamsiat khinta hi.
Ngai un, noute ziak in na chi tuh ka sal ding a, na mai uah ek ka thehthang ding a, na kithoihna ek ngei uh; huchi in huai toh lakmang in na om ding uhi.
Hiai thupiak, Levi toh ka thukhun a-omtheihna ding in, na kiang uah ka hon sawlta chih na thei ding uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
"Hinna leh lungmuanna ka thukhun amah toh a-om hi, akihtak theihna ding in akiang ah amaute ka peta a, kei ahon kihta a, ka min azahtak mahmah hi.
Akamsung ah thutak dan a-om a, diktatlouhna amuk ah akimu kei; lungmuanna leh tanna ah ka thu azui a, gitlouhna a kipan in mi tampi aheimangsak hi.
Siampu mukte'n theihna akem un, akam uah dan azong ding uh ahi him hi; amah lah sepaihte' TOUPA sawltak ahi ngal a.
"Himahleh lampi a kipan pialsak in na om ua; tampi dan ah na kisuipuksak uhi; Levi thukhun na suseta uhi.
Huaiziak in ka lampite na zuih louh dungzui un, dan a mite deihsak tuam na neih zawk ziak un, ke'n leng mipite tengteng ma ah zahpihhuai leh dai in ka hon bawlta hi," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
I vek un pa khat i nei kei ua hia? Pathian khat in hon siam kei a hia? Bangziak a lepchiahtak a michih in i pipute uh thukhun hihnin a-unau siatna ding a hih i hi ua?
Judah in lepchiahtak in ahihta a, Israel ah leh Jerusalem ah kihhuai hih in a-om hi, Judah in Pathian' mun siangthou it ahihninta a, theih louh pathian tanu akitenpihta hi.
TOUPA'N hiai thilhihpa, sinsakpa leh sinsak a ompa, Jakob puanin a kipan leh sepaihte' TOUPA kiang a thillat lanpa asatkhe ding hi.
Huan hiai na hih nawn uh; TOUPA maitam khitui, kah leh thumna in na khuh ua, thillat alimsak nawn louh a, na khut ua kipan deihsakna toh san leng asan nawn louh tanpha in.
Hinapi in lah, "Bangziak in maw?" achi uhi. Na tuailai zi, lepchiahtak a na bawl, na kithuahpihnu, na thukhun zi hinapi in, amah leh nang kikal ah TOUPA theihpihpa ahih khit tak ziak in.

Pathian in nihte sa khat in hon bawl kei maw? Khat in na kha hon bawlsak in, ahingsak kei maw? Bang achia khat? Pathian limsak chi azong ahi. Huaiziak in michih in atuailai zi lepchiahtak a hih lou ding in na kha thu uah pilvang un.

TOUPA Israel' Pathian in achi, koihmangna ka hua a, hiamgamna a puansilh khuh mipa ka mudah hi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Huaiziak in michih in atuailai zi lepchiahtak a hih lou ding in, na kha thu uah pilvang un.

Na thu un TOUPA na hihgimta uh, koi ah ka hon hihgim ua ahia, na chi lai uhi; michih gilou hih TOUPA mitmuh in ahoih a, huaite ah amah akipak hi na chihna uah leh vaihawmna Pathian koi a om hiam na chih nakna uah.

"Ngai in, ka sawltak ka sawl a, ama'n ka ma ah lampi abawlkhol ding a TOUPA, na zon uh, atempul ah thakhat in ahong pai ding; na kipahna uh, thukhun sawltak, ngai un, ahong hi," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Himahleh ahong paina ni kua'n athuakzou thei dia? Ahong lat chiang in kua adingzou dia? Amah hihsiangthou meikuang leh puansawptu sahbon bang ahi ngal a.

Huchi in dangka hihsiangthoumi leh siangsakmi bang in atu ding a Levi tapate ahihsiang ding hi, dangka-eng leh dangka bang in amau akhuahsiang ding a, huchi in diktatna in TOUPA kiang ah thillatte alan ding uhi.
Huai chiang in Judah leh Jerusalem thillatte nidanglai bang leh tang a kumte bang in TOUPA a ding in namtui ahi ding hi.

"Huan vaihawmna ah aisan mite kalh in, angkawmte kalh in, zuau a kichiamte kalh in theihpihpa kin ka hi ding a, loh thu a migoih, meithai, pabei, nuaisiah, athuneihna a kipan mikhual kaiheipa, kei hon kihtaloute kalh in, na kiang uah ka hong ding sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
"Kei TOUPA ka zulhzau kei a; huaiziak in Jakob tapate aw, haltum in na om kei uhi.

Na pipute uh dam lai a kipan ka dan thupiakte na kilehheisan ua, na zui kei uhi. Ka kiang ah hong kik unla, na kiang uah ka hong kik ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Himahleh nou, koi ah i kik ding ua? na chi uhi.
Mi'n Pathian alok diam? Hinapi in noute'n na hon lok uh. Himahleh bangchidan in ka hon lok ua eita? na chi uhi. Sawm-a-khatte ah leh thillatte ah.
Hiai nam pumpi in, kei na hon loh ziak un hamsiatna a hamsiat na hi uhi.

Ka insung a an ahong omtheihna ding in koihkhawmna inn ah sawm-a-khat avek in hon lalut unla, huai in kei hon entel un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Akoihna ding dantan kiching om lou khop in van tohlette hong in, vualzawlna ka hon buakkhe kei na hiam!
Huan negaimi pen nou ziak in ka sal ding a, na leigahte uh ahihse kei ding hi; na grepgui uh leng lou ah ahun tun ma in agah akesak kei ding hi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Huchi in nam tengteng in nang nuamsa ahon chi ding ua; gam deihhuai na hih ding ziak un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
"Kei dem a na thute uh akhauh hi," TOUPA'N achi, "Nou koi ah nang dem in thu ka gen ua eita," na chi uh.
"Pathian nasep athawn ahi, athupiak i zuih ua, suunna puan silh a sepaihte' TOUPA ma a i om uh bang ahia aphattuamna, na chi uh.
Tu in kisatheite nuamsa chi in agitlouhna nasemte tunding in a-om uh; ahi; Pathian khemte hotkhiak in a-om uh," i chi uhi.
TOUPA kihtate akihoupih ua; huchi in TOUPA'N angaikhia a, aza a, TOUPA kihta a, amin ngaihtuahte ama ah, theihgigena laibuzial ah gelh ahi.
"Huan amau kei a ahi ding ua, gou lamdangtak ka bawl ni chiang in," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Mi'n ama nasem atapa ahawi bang in huchi in amau ka hawi ding hi.
Huai hun chiang in na hong kihei ding ua, diktatte leh giloute, Pathian nasem leh ama nna semloute kal na khenchian thei ding uhi.

"Ngai in, ani ahong tun ziak in, meiphualpi bang in akuang a; huchi in kisatheite tengteng, gilou nasemte tengteng, buhpawl ahi ding uh; huan ahong tung huai ni in amaute zung leh hiang nuse lou hial in akangmang ding uh," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Himahleh nou ka min kihtate kiang ah diktatna ni, akhate ahihdamna toh ahong suak ding; huchi in na pawtkhe ding ua, huangsung bawngnoute bang in na diang velhvelh ding uhi.
Huan giloute na sikden ding ua; ka gamtat ni chiang in na khepek nuai uah meivu hi ding ahih ziak un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
"Horeb a Israel tengteng a ding a ka sikha Mosi Dan, amah thupiak, dan thusehte leh vaihawmte ngei, theigige un.
Ngai un, TOUPA ni thupi leh mulkimhuai ahong tun ma in na kiang uah zawlnei Elijah ka hon sawl ding hi.
Pate lungtang tate lam ah, tate lungtang apate uh lam ah angasak ding; huchi lou in zaw hamsia in lei ka gawt kha ding hi.”
Pathian Tapa, Jesu Khrist tanchinhoih kipat tungna,
zawlneite Isai laibu in, "Ngai dih, na ma ah ka sawltak ka sawl a, ama'n na lampi abawlkhol ding;
gamdai a kikoupa aw in, Toupa lamlian sial unla, alampite hihtang un," chi a gelh ahih bang in.
Johan in gamdai ah abaptis a, khelhnate ngaihdamna ding a kisikna baptisma thu gen in, ahong pawt hi.
Judia gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng apawt ua, akiang ah apai ua, akhelhnate uh thupha tawi in Jordan lui ah, amaute abaptis zel hi.
Johan sangawngsau mul puan in akivan a, akawng savun kawnggak in agak a, a-an khaukhup leh khuaizu ahi.
"Ka nung ah kei sang a thupizaw ahong pailel ahi; kun a akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei," achi hi.
"Ke'n tui in noute ka hon baptis a; ama'n ahihleh Kha Siangthou in ahi ahon baptis ding," chi in agen hi.
Huai nite in hichi ahong hi a, Galili gam a Nazaret a kipan Jesu ahong pai a, Jordan lui ah Johan in ana baptis hi.
Tui a pan ahong pawttak in, van kihong a vakhu bang a atung a Kha hong kum amu hi.
Huan van a kipan aw hong pawt in, "Nang ka Tapa deihtak na hi a, na tung ah ka kipak mahmah," achi hi.
Kha in amah gamdai ah asawl pah hi.
Huchi in Setan khem in gamdai ah ni sawmli a-om a, gamsate lak ah a-om a; angelte'n a-nna asepsak uhi.
Johan mat a a-om nung in, Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, Galili gam ah Jesu ahong pai hi.
"Ahun ahong tungta a, Pathian lalgam ahong naita; kisik unla tanchinhoih gingta un," chi in.
Galili tuipi gei anawk lai in tuipi a Simon leh Simon unaupa Andru len pai a om amu a; amaute ngamanmi ahi him uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hon zui un, huchi in mihing man ding in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
Alen uh paisan in amah azui pah uhi.
Sau lou apaileh Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unaupa Johan amu a, huaite len bawlpha in long ah a-om uhi.
Huan ama'n amau asam pah a; apa uh Zebedai leh kilohmi agoihte uh toh long nusia in azuita uhi.
Huan Kapernaum ah ava lut ua; Sabbath ni in sinagog ah alut a, thu ahilh hi.
Laigelhmite bang lou a, thuneitak a amau thu ahilh ziak in athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Asinagog uah dawi nin paimi khat ana om a; ama'n;
"Nazaret Jesu, kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Kou hon hihmang dia hong pai na hi maw? Nang ka hon thei a, Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi," chi in akikoukhia hi.
Jesu'n atai a, "Dai inla, asung a kipan hong pawt in," achi hi.
Dawi nin in amah a-engbawl a ngaihtak a kikou in asung a kipan ahong pawtta hi.
Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, huchi in "Hiai bang ahia le! Sinsakna thak ahi ve! Dawi ninte nangawn thuneitak in thu apia a, athu amang zel uh," chi in akihou uhi.
Huan Galili leh akim gam tengteng ah atanchin athangta hi.
Huan sinagog a kipan apawt un, Jakob leh Johan toh Simon leh Andru inn ah alut uhi.
Huan Simon sungnu khosik in achi ana a, ana lum a; huchi in a-omdan Jesu ahilh pah uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akhut a len in, aphong a; huchi in khosik in anuseta a, a-nna uh asepsak hi.
Huan nitaklam a nitum nung in, akiang ah damlou tengteng leh dawimatte ahon pi uhi.
Akhomi tengteng kongkhak bul ah ahong omkhawm khiukheu uhi.
Huan mi tampi natna chiteng a nate ahihdam a, dawi tampi adelhkhia a; dawite'n amah atheih ziak un apau uh aphal kei hi.
Huan zingsang khovak ma tham a thou in apawt a, gamdai mun ah ahoh a, huai ah athum hi.
Simon leh alawmte'n anung ah azui uhi.
Amah ava muh un akiang ah, "Mi tengteng in ahon zong uh,” achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Maban khuate ah pai ni, huai a leng thu ka gentheihna ding in; huai mah ka hong pawtsan ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in thu hilh a dawite delhkhe kawm in Galili gam tengteng a asinagogte uah alut hi.
Huan akiang ah phak ahong pai a, "Na utleh na hon hihsiangthou thei," chi in ama ah khukdin in angen ngutngut hi.
Ama'n ahehpih mahmah a, sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangthouta in," achi hi.
Huchi in phakna in amah anuse pah a, ahong siangthouta hi.
Jesu'n amah akham bikbek kawm in asawlkhe pah hi.
"Kuamah kiang a bangmah gen lou ding in pilvang in; himahleh siampu kiang ah va kilak inla, na kisiansakna ding in Mosi thilsehte lan in, mite'n ahon theihchetna ding un," achi hi.

Himahleh amah apawt a, huai thu nakpitak a kikoupih in athang-zakta hi; huchi in Jesu alangtang in khua ah alut thei nawnta kei a, gamdai mun ah a-om zawta a; huan mun teng a kipan mite akiang ah ahong pai uhi.
Huan adingh a, huai a kipan Judia gam ah leh Jordan gal ah apaita hi. Akiang ah mipite ahong kikhawm ua; huchi in ahih ngeidan in amaute thu ahilh nawn hi.
Pharisai khenkhat akiang ah ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in, "Mi'n zi amak asiang hia?" chi in ahong dong uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Mosi in bangchi in thu ahon pia a?" chi in adawng a.
Amau, "Mosi in kimakna laigelh a mak aphal," achi uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na lungtang khauh ziak un ahi huai thupiak nou a dia ahon gelhsak.
Himahleh leitung pian tung a kipan, Pathian in amaute numei leh pasal asiam hi.
Huai thu ziak in pasal in anu leh apa apaisan ding a, azi alen tinten ding;
huchi in anih un sa khat ahong hita ding ua; nih ahi nawnta kei ua, sa khat ahong hi zawta ding uh.
Huaiziak in Pathian in agawmsa mihing in khen kei hen," achi hi.
Huan inn ah anungzuite'n huai thu amah adong nawn uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuapeuh azi ma a, midang nei in azi ang akawmsan hi;
ama'n leng apasal khen a, midang aneihleh angkawm ahi," achi hi.
Mite'n akhoih ding in naupang neute ahon pi ua; huan nungzuite'n huai mite ana tai uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n huai amuh in alung hi kei mahmah a, nungzuite kiang ah, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un; Pathian lalgam hichibang mite a ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, "Kuapeuh naupang neute'n akipahpih bang a Pathian lalgam kipahpih lou asung ah alut kei hial ding,” achi hi.
Huan amau pom in, atung uah akhut akoih a, avualzawlta hi.
Huan pai ding a apawt lai in mi khat amah lam ah ahong tai a, ama ah akhukdin a, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa hoih, tangtawn hinna ka neihtheihna ding in bang ka hih dia?" chi in adong hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Bangziak a hoih hon chi na hia? Mi khat kia lou ngal kuamah hoih a-om kei uh, huai Pathian ahi.
Thupiakte na thei vo oi; tual that ke'n, angkawm ke'n, gu ke'n, hek ke'n, khem ke'n, na nu leh na pa zahtak in, chihte," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, huai tengteng ka naupan lai a kipan ka zuita," achi hi.

Jesu'n amah a-en a, a-it a, akiang ah, "Hih ding khat nei lai chia; pai inla, na neih peuhmah zuak inla, tagahte kiang ah pia in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan hong pai inla, hon zui in,” achi hi.
Himahleh, huai thu ah amel ahong mual a, lungkhamtak in apaimangta; mihausa ahih ziak in.
Jesu'n a-en vialvial a, anungzuite kiang ah, "Mihausate ding in Pathian lalgam lut haksat tuak hi na mai e," achi hi.
Nungzuite'n athugen lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Naute aw, hauhna muangte a ding in Pathian lalgam a lut ahaksa ngei e.
Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in sangawngsau phim bilvang a lut paisuak abaihlamzaw," achi hi.
Amau lamdang asa mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Ahihleh, kua hotdam ahi thei dia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n amau a-en a, "Huai zaw mihing a ding in hih vual ahi kei, Pathian a ding in bel hih vual louh a-om kei; Pathian a ding in bangkim hihtheih ahi ngal iris a," achi hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, kou bangkim paisan in ka hon zui ua,” chi in agen pan a.
Jesu'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh keimah ziak leh tanchinhoih ziak a inn, unaupate, unaunute, nu, pa, tate leh gamte paisan,
tu damsung mahmah in, innte, unaupate, sanggamnute, nute, tate, gamte aleh za in, sawinate toh, hun hong tung ding a tangtawn hinna toh mu lou ding mahmah a-om kei hi.
Himahleh mi tampi masapen a omte nanungpen ahong hi ding ua, nanungpente leng masapen ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
Huan Jerusalem a hohtou ding in lampi ah a-om ua; Jesu'n ama uh akai hi. Amau lamdang asa mahmah ua; ahon zuite'n alau uhi. Ama'n sawm-le-nihte apituam nawn a, atung a tung dingte ahilh hi.
"Ngai dih ua, Jerusalem a hohtou ding i hi ua; Mihing Tapa siampu liante leh laigelhmite khut ah matsak in a-om ding; amau si ding in atung ah thu ahihpuk ding ua, Zentelte kiang ah ape ding uh.
Amau nuihza bawlna in anei ding ua, chil asiatkhum ding ua, avo ding ua, athat ding uh; himahleh ni thum nung in athounawn ding," chi in atung a thil tung dingte amaute ahilh hi.
Huan Zebedai tapa Jakob leh Johan in amah ahong naih ua, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa na kiang a ka hon nget peuh uh na hon hihsak ka ut uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou a ding in bang hon hihsak leng na ut ua?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Na thupina ah na taklam ah khat, na veilam ah khat hon tusak in," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na nget uh na thei kei ua ahi. Ka nou dawn ding na dawn thei ding ua hia? Ka baptisma tan ding leng na tang thei ding ua hia?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Hihthei e,” achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka nou dawn ding na dawn ding ua, ka baptisma tan ding leng na tang ding uh;
himahleh ka taklam leh ka veilam a tut ding thu zaw kei piak ding ahi kei a, abawlsakte uh a ding ahi zaw,” achi hi.
Huan sawmte'n huai azak un, Jakob leh Johan tung ah alungkim kei uhi.
Jesu'n amau asam a, akiang uah, "Zentelte tung a vaihawm dia asehte uh atung uah alian mahmah ua, amiliante un atung uah thu anei mahmah uh chih na thei uhi.
Himahleh noute lak ah zaw huchibang ahi kei ding; kuapeuh na lak ua milian hih ut nasemtu in apang zaw ding ahi.
Kuapeuh na lak ua masapen hih utmi tengteng sikha a apan ding ahi.
Mihing Tapa hial leng nna sepsak a om ding in ahong pai kei a, nasem ding leh mi tampi tatna dia ahinna pe ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi," achi hi.
Huan Jeriko khua ahong tung uhi; huchi in Jesu, Jeriko a kipan anungzuite leh mipi tampitak toh apawt lai un khutdoh mittaw, Timai tapa Bartimai lam gei ah ana tu hi.
Huan Nazaret Jesu ahi chih azaktak in, "Jesu, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou hi.
Mi tampi in dai ding in akhou ua; himahleh ama'n, "David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akinak kou semsem hi.
Jesu adingh a, "Amah hon sam dih ua," achi hi. Huan mittaw asam ua akiang ah, "Khamuangtak in om in. Thou in; ahon sam," achi uhi.
Huan apuan paikhia in adingh a, Jesu kiang ah ahohta hi.
Jesu'n amah ahoupih a, "Na tung ah bang hon hihsak leng na ut a?" achi hi. Mittaw in akiang ah, "Heutupa, muh theih ka ut," achi hi.
Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Paita in, na ginna dampih hi teh,” achi a, huchi in amu thei pahta a, lampi ah Jesu azuita hi.
Huchi in Jerusalem khua tung ding a akisak ua, Olive tang a Bethphage leh Bethani kho kiang atun un, anungzuite lak a mi nih asawl a, akiang uah,
"Na mazawn ua khua ah va hoh unla; na lut tung un sabiltungnou kikhih, kuamah tuan ngeilouhna, na mu ding ua; phel unla, hon kai un.
Huan kuapeuh in, huai bangziak a hih ahon chih uleh, Toupa'n adeih a ahi; hiai ah ahon koihsak nawn pah na ding, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
Huan ahohta ua, kongzing ah kongkhak polam a sabiltungnou kikhih ava mu ua; huai aphelta uhi.
Huai a dingh kuate hiam in, akiang uah, "Sabiltungnou bangziak a phel?" achi uhi.
Amau Jesu gen bangtak in akiang uah agen ua; huchi in aphalta uhi.
Huan Jesu kiang ah sabiltungnou ahon kai ua, atung ah apuante uh aphah ua; atung ah atuangta hi.
Mi tampi in lampi ah apuan uh aphah ua; midang in leng gam a sawlnah sat in aphah uhi.
Amalam a paite leh anunglam a hon zuite'n: "Hosanna! Toupa min a hong pai ahampha!
Gam hong tung ding, i Pa David lalgam ahampha! Tungnungpen ah Hosanna!" chi in akikou uhi.
Huan Jerusalem a tempul ah ava lut a; bangkim a-et velvel khit in nitaklam leng ahong hita a, apawt a, sawm-le-nihte toh Bethani ah apaita uhi.
Azing in Bethani a kipan apawt nung in agil ahong kialta hi.
Theipi kung nah nei gamlapi ah amu a, agah ka muh khakleh chi in ava zuan hi; ava tun in anah kia lou ngal bangmah amuta kei a; theipi gah hun ahi kei him hi.
Huchi in Jesu'n sing ahoupih a, "Tuban tangtawn in nang a pan kuamah in gah ne nawnta kei hen," achi hi. Anungzuite'n huai aza uhi.
Huan Jerusalem khua atung ua, tempul ah ava lut a, tempul a zuak mite leh lei mite adelhkhia a, dangka kheng mite dohkante leh vakhu zuak mite tutphah asawnpuksak hi.
Tempul a mite'n van alut paisuakpih uh aphalta kei hi.
Huan amaute sinsak in akiang uah, "Ka inn nam chih a ding in thumna inn achi ding uh, chih gelh ahi kei a hia? Nou suamhatte khuk in na bawl ua," achi hi.
Siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n huai aza ua, amah hihmanthat theihna ding azongta uhi; mipi tengteng in athuhilh lamdang asak ziak un amah alau uhi.
Huan nitaklam ahong hih in khopi a kipan apawtkhia uhi.
Huan zingsang a apai kawm un huai theipi kung azung tanpha vuai khin in amuta uhi.
Huchi in Peter in theikhia in akiang ah, "Heutupa, en dih; theipi kung hamsiat na loh ana vuai khin vekta," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian gingta un.

Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh in hiai tang kiang ah, na kisuan inla, tuipi ah na kipailut in chi a, alungtang a ginglel lou a agen atung ngeingei ding chih gingta peuhmah in agen bangbang amu ding uhi.
Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, bangkim thum a na nget peuhmah uh musa in kiging unla huchi in na mu ding uh.
Thum a na din peuhmah chiang un kua tung ah leng thubuai banghiam na neih uleh ngaidam un; na Pa uh van a om in leng na tatlekna uh ahon ngaihdam theihna ding in.
Himahleh na ngaihdam kei uleh, na Pa uh van a om in na tatleknate uh ahon ngaidam sam kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jerusalem khua atung nawn ua; tempul a avak lai in siampu liante, laigelhmite leh upate akiang ah ahong pai ua,
akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thilte na hih? Hiai thilte hih ding in kua'n ahia nang thu hon piak?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng thu kam khat ka hon dong sam ding, hon dawng le uchin, huchi in kua thu in ahia hiai thil ka hih chih ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
"Johan Baptisma van a kipan hia; mihing a kipan? Hon dawng un," achi hi.
Huan akingaihtuah ua, "Van a kipan chi lehang, Bang achia athu gingta lou na hi ua, ahon chi dia;
himahleh mihing a kipan chi leng mipi akihta ua; mi tengteng in Johan zawlnei taktak in abawl chiat uhi."
Huchi in Jesu adawng ua, "Thei kei ung," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng kua thu in ahia hiai thilte ka hih, ka hon hilh sam kei ding," achi hi.

Huan gentehna thu in akiang uah agen a, "Mi kuahiam in grephuan abawl a, akim huang in a-um a, grep sukna ding khuk atou a, insang alam a, loukhou mite kiang ah khohloh ding in apia a, gamdang ah apaisanta hi.
Agah loh hun in atansik amau kiang a kipan la ding in lou khohloh mite kiang ah sikha khat asawl hi.
Huai mi ana man ua, avua ua, khutvuak in apaisak uhi.
Huan sikha dang akiang uah asawl nawn a; huai mi leng alu ana hihliam ua, zumhuaipi in ana bawl uhi.
Huan sikha dang asawl nawn zel a; huai mi ana that ua, sikha dang tampi leng, khenkhat ana vua ua, khenkhat ana that uhi.
Huan sawl ding khat, atapa deihtak kia anei lai hi; 'Ka tapa zaw ana zahtak ding uh' chi in amah ananungpen in akiang uah asawl hi.
Himahleh huai lou khohloh mite'n, 'hiai mi gouluah dingpa ahi; i that ding uh aw; huchi in agouluah ding ei a ahi mai ding,' akichi uhi.
Huchi in amah aman ua, that in, grephuan a pan alawnkhia uhi.
Huaiziak in grephuan neipa'n bangchi in ahon hih dia? Lou khohloh mite ahon hihmangthang dia; grephuan midangte ape ding hi.
Hiai Laisiangthou na sim kei ua hia? 'Inn lam mite' suang deih louhpen, huai mahmah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita hi.
Huai Toupa hih ahi, i mitmuh un alamdang hi, chih,' " achi hi.
Huan amah mat atum ua; himahleh huai gentehna thu amau dem a agen ahi chih atheih ziak un, mipite alau uhi. Huchi in amah anusia ua, apaimangta uhi.
Huan athugen a mat ahihtheihna ding in Pharisaite leh Herod pawl a mi kuate hiam akiang ah asawl uhi.

Huchi in amau ahong tun un akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, midiktat na hi a, deihsak tuam kuamah na nei kei chih ka thei uh, kuamah khentuam nei lou in, chihtak ngial in Pathian lam thu na hilh zel hi; Kaisar kiang a leiman liau asiang hia siang lou?
Pe ding ka hi uhia, pe lou ding?" achi uhi. Ama'n alepchiahdan uh thei in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon ze-et na hi ua? Makhai hon tawi un, ka en ding," achi hi.
Ahon tawi ua, ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kua lim leh kua min ahia?" achi hi.
Amau, "Kaisar a," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah peta unla," achi hi. Huchi in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huan Saddukai, thohnawnna a-om kei chite, akiang ah ahong ua,
akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, kuapeuh a-unaupa'n ta nei lou in azi sihsan taleh a-unaupa'n azi luah in a-unaupa a ding in chi asuahsak ding chi in ahon gelhsak hi.
Ahi, sal sagih a-om ua; a-upapen in zi anei a, chi suah lou in asi hi.
Huan anihna in aluah a, chi suah lou in asi nawn zel a; athumna in huchi mah bang in.
Huchi in sal sagihte chi suah lou in asita ua, atawpna ah numei leng asita hi.
Thohnawn hun in akua pen zi ahi dia le? Sagihte'n zi in anei chiat ngal ua," chi in adong uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai ziak hilou hia, na theihkhelh nak uh, Laisiangthou leh Pathian thilhihtheihna na theih louh ziak un?
Misi lak a pan athohnawn hun un zi leh pasal a kinei lou in, van angelte bang ahi zawta ding uh ahi.
Huan misite kaihthoh a a-om ding thu lah Mosi laibu a loubukh kuang thu a Pathian in, 'Kei Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ka hi, chi a, amah ahoupihdan na sim kei ua hia?'
Amah misi Pathian ahi kei a, mihing Pathian ahi zaw; na theikhial tel uh," achi hi.
Huan laigelhmite lak a mi khat ahong a, akisel uh ana ngaikhia a, Jesu'n amaute thutak in adawng chih athei a, akiang ah, "Thupiak tengteng ah koi ahia thupipen?" chi in adong hi.
Jesu'n, "Athupipen hiai ahi; Israel aw, ngai dih uh, Toupa i Pathian uh Toupa khat kia ahi;
'Toupa na Pathian na lungtang tengteng in, na kha tengteng in, na lungsim tengteng in leh na hatna tengteng in na it ding ahi,' chih.
Azom hiai ahi, 'Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding,' chih. Hiaite sang a thupiak thupizaw a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
Laigelhmi'n akiang ah, "Hina ngei e, Sinsakpa amah zaw khat kia ahi a, amah lou zaw kuamah dang a-om kei,
amah lungtang tengteng, theihsiamna tengteng, hatna tengteng a it a, eimah i ki-it bang a vengte it halmang thilpiak leh kithoihna tengteng sang in ahoihzaw petmah chih, na gen dik ngei," achi hi.
Piltak in adawng chih Jesu'n atheih in akiang ah, "Pathian lalgam na gamlat kei hi," achi a, huai nungsiah kuamah in thu adong ngamta kei uhi.
Huan tempul a Jesu'n thu ahilh lai in, amau ahoupih a, "Khrist David tapa ahi chih laigelhmite'n bangchidan a gen uh ahia?
David ngei in, Kha Siangthou in, Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, 'Na melmate na khepek ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, achi,' achi hi.
"David ngei in amah Toupa, achi ngal a, koi a kipan in ahia amah atapa ahih?" achi hi. Huan mivantang in kipaktak in athu angaikhia uhi.
Huan athuhilhna ah, "Lai-gelhmite lak ah pilvang un; amau puanaktual silh a vak a-ut ua, dawr munte ah mite chibai abuk ua,
sinagog ah tutphah hoihpen leh ankuangluina a mun hoihpen adeihtuam nak uh;
meithai inn anegai ua, kilimbawl in sawt pipi athum uh; huaite'n siam louh tanna lianzaw atang ding uh," achi hi.
Huan sumkholna zawn ah atu a; sumkholna a mipi sumkhiakdan a-en a; mihau tampitak in tampipi akhia uhi.
Meithai zawngtak ahong pai a, dal dangka muza nih akhia a, huai tuh paihsa khat hu ahi.
Jesu'n anungzuite asam a, akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, sumkholna a khe tengteng lak ah hiai meithai zawngtak in akhe tampen hi.
Hiaite tengteng in aneihlet uh akhia ua; ama'n zaw adeihthoh laitak, aneihsun, ahinna ding tengteng akhe vek ahi," achi hi.
Huan tempul a kipan apaikhiak lai in, anungzuite lak a mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, en dih, suang leh innte athupi mahmah hi," achi hi.
Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Hiai inn thupitakte na mu maw? Hihchip louh a, suang kichiang hiai ah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
Huan Olive tang a tempul zawn a atut lai in, Peter, Jakob, Johan leh Andrute'n akiang ah,
"Huaite chikchiang in ahong om dia? Huai tengteng atun ding chiang in chiamtehna bang a-om dia, hon hilh in," chi in asimdot uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kuamah in hon khemlouhna ding in pilvang un.
Mi tampi, Khrist ka hi, chi in keimah min lou in ahong pai ding ua, mi tampi akhempuk ding uh.
Huan kidou thu leh kidou thuthang na zak hun chiang un mangbang kei un; huaite hong tung ding him ahi uh. Himahleh atawpna zaw ahi nai tadih kei ding.
Nam tuam leh nam tuam akidou ding ua, gam tuam leh gam tuam akidou ding ua; mun tuamtuam ah zin aling dia; kial ake ding hi. Hiaite nauvei kipatna ahi.
"Himahleh pilvang un; vaihawmte ahon mansak ding ua; sinagog ah ahon vo ding ua; keimah ziak in gamukte leh kumpipate ma ah theihpihna pe ding in na dingh ding uhi.
Huan nam tengteng kiang a tanchinhoih hilh masak ding ahi.

Huan hon pi a, ahon matsak hun chiang un, bang ka gen dia chi in ngaihtuah khawl kei un; ahuntak a theihsak a na om peuh uh, huai ngeingei gen zaw un; agen pen zaw noumau hilou in Kha Siangthou ahi zaw ding hi.
Huan hihlup ding in unaupa leh unaupa akimansak ding ua, pa in atapa amansak ding a; tate'n leng anu leh pate uh adou ding ua, athatsak ding uhi.
Keimah min ziak in mi tengteng huat na hi ding uh; himahleh atawp pha a thuak mualsuahmi, huai mi hotdam in a-om ding hi.
"Himahleh zawlnei Daniel in agen bang a hihmangbangpa kihhuai adinlouhna ding a dingh na muh chiang un, asim peuh in a-omdan thei hen, huai hun chiang in Judia gam a omte tang sang ah taimang uhen;
inn tung a om kum kei hen; a-insung a thil lakhe ding in lut sam kei hen.
Huan lou a om apuansilh la ding in kik nawn kei hen.
Huai ni in naupaite leh naunou pomte tung agik ding hi.
Huaite phalbi a ahong tunlouhna ding in thum un.
Huai nite bang a gimthuakna thupi Pathian siam leilung pian tung a kipan tutan in a-om ngei nai kei a, chik mah chiang in a-om ngei nawn kei ding hi.
Huan Toupa'n huai nite hihtom keileh mihing dam in asuakta kei ding; himahleh, telte ziak in nite ahihtom hi.
"Huai hun chiang in, kuapeuh in na kiang ua, 'En dih uh; hiai ah Khrist a-om!' ahihkeileh 'En dih uh; huai ah a-om!' hiam achih chiang un gingta kei un.
Khrist takloute leh zawlnei takloute hong pawt ding ahi ngal ua, huaite'n chiamtehna leh thillamdang ahih ding uh; hi thei ngialleh telte nangawn akhemtheihna ding un.
Nou zaw pilvang un, ngai dih uh, bangkim ka hon hilhkhol khinta ahi.
"Himahleh huai nite zoh in, huai gimthuakna khit in, ni hihmial in a-om ding a, kha avak nawn kei ding hi.
Van a kipan aksite ahong ke ding ua, van a thilhihtheihna omte hihlin in a-om ding uhi.
Huai hun chiang in Mihing Tapa, thilhihtheihna leh thupina lianpi toh meipi lak a hong pai amu ding uhi.
Huai hun chiang in a-angelte asawlkhe dia, atelte lei ning li a pan lei tawp a kipan van tawp pha in apikhawm ding uhi.
"Huchi in theipi kung ah gentehna zil un; ahiang ahong nou a, anah ahong sel in nipi anaita chih na thei uhi.
Huchi mah bang in, nou leng huaite hong tung na muh chiang un, amah ahong naita a, kongkhak bul mahmah ah a-om chih, thei un.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng atunkim masiah hiai khang amang kei ding hi.
Lei leh van amang dia, ka thu ahihleh amang kei ding hi.
"Himahleh huai ni leh dak Pa kia lou ngal kuamah in, van a angelte'n leng Tapa in leng athei kei uhi.
Pilvang unla, kiging gige in thum un; ahun lah na thei ngal kei ua.
Mi a-inn paisan a, asikhate thu neisak a, anasep ding uh pe chiat a, kongkhak veng leng kigin ding thu pe phot a, gamdang a va taam bang ahi.
Huaiziak in kiging gige in om un, inn neipa hong pai ding hun, nitaklam in hia, zan in hia, ak khuan in hia, zing in hia chih lah na thei ngal kei ua.
Huchi lou in zaw, hong pai guih kha taleh ihmu in ahon mu kha ding.
Huan na kiang ua ka genmi tengteng kiang a ka gen ahi: Kiging gige in om un," achi hi.
Huan ni nih nung a Paikan Ankuangluina leh Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina om ding ahi a; siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n, amah khem a, man a, ahihlup theihna ding dan azongzong uhi.
Himahleh, "Ankuanglui sung in hi kei hen, huchi lou in zaw vantang lak ah buaina ahong om kha ding," achi uhi.
Huan Bethani a phak Simon inn a a-om lai a, ankuang a-um lai in numei khat, alabaster bawm a spiknardi thau gimlim man tampi tawi in ahong a, abawm ahihkham a, alu ah asungta hi.
Himahleh khenkhatte alunghita kei ua, "Bangziak a thau gimlim hihmang mawkmawk ahia?
Hiai thau makhai zathum sang a tamzaw a zuak a, migentheite kiang a piak theih ahi ngal a," achi uhi. Huchi in atung ah aphun uhi.
Jesu'n, "Hih hen aw; bangziak a va hihbuai na hi ua? Ka tung ah thil hoihtak a hih ahi.
Migentheite na kiang ua om gige ahi ua, na ut hun peuh un na hehpih thei uhi; kei bel na kiang ua om gige lou ding ka hi.
Ahihtheih khamkham a hih ahi; ka pumpi vui ding a sathau nuhkhol ahi.
Huchi in chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, khovel tengteng a tanchinhoih akigenna koipeuh ah hiai numei thilhih, amah theihgigena ding in akigen zel ding,” achi hi.
Huan Judas Iskariot, sawm-le-nihte lak a khat in, Jesu akiang ua zuausan a amatsak theihna ding in siampu liante kiang ah ava hoh hi.
Amau huai thu azaktak un akipak mahmah ua, akiang ah dangka piak achiamta uhi. Huchi in zuausan a matsakdan ding lemtang azongta uhi.
Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ani masapen a, Paikan Ankuangluina belamnou agoh zelna ni uah, anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Paikan Ankuanglui na nektheihna ding in koi ah va bawl le ung na ut a?" achi uhi.
Huchi in anungzuite lak a mi nih asawl a, akiang uah, "Khopi ah va lut unla, huai ah bel a tui pua pasal in ahon tuak dia; amah zui un.
Huan alutna peuh ah huai inn kempa kiang ah, 'Sinsakpa'n ka nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka nekna ding uh, mikhual inn pindan koi lai ahia? achi,' na chi ding uhi.
Huchi in ama'n inn pindan tungnung zatak, van omsa, mansa dimdiam ahon ensak dia; huai ah ei a ding in bawl un," achi hi.
Huan nungzuite apawt ua, khopi ah ava lut ua, akiang ua agen bangtak in ava mu ua; Paikan Ankuang abawlta uhi.
Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, amah sawm-le-nihte toh ava hohta uhi.
Huan an a-um ua anek lai un Jesu'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat, ka kiang a ne sam in, hon zuausan in hon mansak ding," achi hi.
Huan alungkham panta ua, khatkhat in akiang ah, "Keimah ka hi hia?" achi chiat uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, ka kuang a tanghou hon diahpihpa ahi.
Mihing Tapa atanchin agelh bangtak un apai ding; himahleh Mihing Tapa mansak ding mipa tung agik hi! Huai mihing zaw piang keileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding," achi hi.
Huan an anek lai un Jesu'n tanghou ala a, avualzawl zoh in abalkham a, akiang uah apia a, "La unla ne un, hiai ka pumpi ahi," achi hi.
Huan nou ala a, kipahthu agen zoh in akiang uah apia a; huchi in avek un adawn chiat uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai ka sisan a thukhun thak ahi, mi tampi a dia pawt ding ahi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Pathian lalgam a athak ka dawn ni atun masiah grep guigah tui ka dawn nawnta kei ding,” achi hi.
Huan la asak zoh un, apawt ua, Olive tang ah apaita uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na vek un lungkia in na hon taisan ding uh. 'Belamchingpa ka khen dia, belamte adalh ding uh' chih gelh ahi ngal a.
Himahleh ka thohnawn nung in Galili gam ah na ma uah ka pai ding," achi hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Avek un lungkia in hon taisan mah le uh, ke'n zaw ka hon taisan kei ding," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, tuzan ngeingei in, ak nihvei akhuan ma in, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achi hi.
Ama'n bel khauhtak in, "Na sihna ah si sam ding himah leng ka hon kitheihmohbawl kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchibang in achi chiat uhi.
Huan Gethsemani achih mun uh atung ua; ama'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Ka thum sung teng hiai ah na tu un," achi hi.
Peter, Jakob leh Johan api a, nakpitak a lungkham in amangbang mahmah hi.
Huchi in akiang uah, "Ka kha alungkham mahmah a, sihna khop hial ahi; hiai ah om unla, kiging gige un," achi hi.
Huan neukha in malam ah ava pai zek a, lei ah abokkhup a, ahihtheihleh huai hun in amah pel ding in athum hi.
"Abba, Pa, bangkim na hihthei a; kei a kipan in hiai nou lamang in; himahleh kei thu hilou in nangmah thuthu hi zaw hen," achi hi.
Huan ahong pai a, amau ihmu in ahong mu a, huchi in Peter kiang ah, "Simon, ihmu na hi maw? Dakkal khat lel leng kiging gige in na om thei kei maw?
Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un kiging gige in thum un. Kha in tuh angap a, sa zaw ahat kei,” achi hi.
Huan ava hoh nawn a, athugen ngei gen in athum nawn hi.
Huan ahong pai nawn a amau ihmu in ahong mu nawn hi, a-ihmut uh asuak mahmah ngal a; athugen dawndan ding leng athei kei uhi.
Huan ahong pai thumveina ah akiang uah, "Na ihmu lailai uh maw, na tawlnga lailai uh maw? Ahunta ve; ahun hong tungta; Mihing Tapa mikhialte khut a zuausan a piak ahita hi.
Thou un, i pai ding uh; en un, zuausanpa ahong naita," achi hi.
Huan agen laitak in, Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, ahong tung pah a, siampu liante leh laigelhmite leh upate a kipan mipi, namsau leh khetbuk tawite toh.
Huan zuausanpa'n, "ka tawp peuhmah amah ahi ding; man unla, kizentak in na pimang ding uh," chi in chiamtehna ana hilhkhol dimdiam hi.
Huchi in atuntak in ava naih a, "Rabbi!" chi in atawp tonton hi.
Huan amah alen ua, amanta uhi.
Huan akiang a dinghte lak a mi kuahiam in anamsau adok a, siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil asatkhiaksak hi.
Huan Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Temsaute, khetbukte tawi in suamhat man ding bang in, kei hon man ding in na hong kuan uh maw?
Tempul ah niteng a thu hilh in na kiang uah ka om a; na hon man ngal kei ua, himahleh Laisiangthou thugelh atuntheihna ding ei ve," achi hi.
Huan avek un amah anusia ua, ataimang vekta uhi.
Tangval kuahiam, puanmalngat kia bat in, amah azui a; amah ana man uhi.
Himahleh apuanmalngat ataisan a, vuaktang in ataimangta hi.
Siampu lian kiang ah Jesu api ua; siampu liante, upate leh laigelhmite tengteng toh ahong ton uhi.
Peter in gamlapi a pai in amah azui a, siampu lianpen inn huangsung kong lai pha in; sikhate lak ah meilum awi in atu sam hi.
Jesu ahihlup theihna ding un siampu liante leh vaihawmte tengteng in amah hekna azong ua, amu kei uh.
Mi tampi in zuau in ahek ua, himahleh, ahekna thu uh akituak kei hi.
Huan kuate hiam adingh ua, zuau in ahek uhi.
Hiai mi'n, "Khut a lam tempul ka hihse dia, ni thum sung in tempul dang, khut a lam louh, ka lam ding, achih, ka za uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in leng ahekna thu uh akituak thei sam kei uhi.
Siampu lianpen alai ah adingkhia a, Jesu kiang ah, "Bangmah a dawng lou maw? Hiaite hon hekna bangchidan ahia?" chi in adong hi.
Amah lah adai dide a, bangmah in adawng kei. Siampu lianpen in akiang ah, "Khrist, Hampha Tapa, na hi hia?" chi in adong nawn hi.
Jesu'n, "Hi e, Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna taklam a tu a, van meipi lak a hong pai na mu ding uh," achi hi.
Siampu lianpen in apuansilh abotkek a, "Theihpih dang bang ding in i deih lai dia?
Pathian agensiatdan na zata uh; bangchi na sa ua?" achi hi. Avek un amah si tak in asep chiat uhi.
Huan akhen in amah achilsiat pah ua, amai tuam in khuttum in atum ua, akiang ah, "Zawlnei bang in gen in," achi uhi; sikhate'n apaipih kawm un akhutpek un abeng ekek uhi.
Huan Peter nuailam a inn huangsung kong lai a a-om lai in siampu lianpen sikha nungakte lak a khat ahong pai a,
Peter, meilum awi amu a, a-en a, "Nang leng Nazaret mi Jesu kiang a om na hi ve," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Na thugen ka thei kei, angaihna leng ka thei kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi. Inn lim ah apawtkhia a; huchi in ak akhuangta hi.
Huan nungak in amu a, akiang a dinghte kiang ah, "Hiai mi alak ua mi ahi," achi nawn hi.
Himahleh akitheihmohbawl nawn hi. Sawt lou nung in akiang a dinghte'n, Peter kiang ah, "Alak ua mi hi tawk teh, Galili gam a mi na hi ngal a,” achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Huai na mihing gen uh ka thei kei," chi in hamsia kiloh in akichiamta hi.
Huan ak khuan nihveina akhuang pah hi. Peter in, Jesu'n akiang a, "Ak nihvei akhuan ma in nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achih atheikhe thak nawn a, huai angaihtuah a akapta hi.
Huan zingsang ahong hih in, siampu liante, upate leh laigelhmite leh vaihawmte tengteng toh akihou ua, Jesu ahen ua, api ua, Pilat kiang ah apeta uhi.
Pilat in akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia," chi in adong a, ama'n akiang ah, "Na gen bang in himah ing," chi in adawng hi.
Siampu liante'n thu tampi in ahek uhi.
Huchi in Pilat in adong nawn a, akiang ah, "Bangmah a dawng lou maw? Ngai in, ahon hekna uh tamdan!" achi hi.
Jesu'n bangmah in adawng kei; huchi in Pilat in lamdang asa mahmah hi.
Huan Pilat in ankuanglui ni in mi henta khat anget peuhmah uh apawtsak zel hi.
Mi khat, Barabbas achih uh, ahelte lak ah hensa in a-om a, amah bel helna a pang leh tualthat ahi.
Mipite ahohtou ua, amau a dia ahihsak zel bang a hihsak ding in angen uhi.
Pilat in adawng a akiang uah, "Judate' Kumpipa hon khahsak leng na ut uhia?" achi hi.
Siampu liante'n hazat ziak a paipih uh ahi, chih athei hi.
Himahleh siampu liante'n Barabbas pawtsak zawk ngen ding in mipite ahasuan uhi.
Huan Pilat in akiang uah, "Judate' Kumpipa achih uh bang ka lohta dia le?" chi in adong nawn hi.
Huan amau, “Kros ah kilhden in," chi in akikou nawn uhi.
Pilat in akiang uah, "Bang ding in maw? Bang ahihkhial a ahia?" achi hi. Himahleh amau, "Kilhden in," chi in akikou semsem uhi.
Huchi in Pilat in mipite hihlungkim ut in, Barabbas apawtsakta a; Jesu avuak zoh in kilhden ding in apeta hi.
Huan sepaihte'n inn huangsung kong lai, Praitoriam achih uah, amah apilut ua, apawl ua mi tengteng asamkhawm uhi.
Huchi in puan sandup asilhsak ua, linglukhu phan in akhusak uhi.
"Chibai, Judate' Kumpipa!" chi in chibai abuk uhi.
Alu sialluang in akhen ua, chil aphih ua, khukdin in chibai abuk uhi.
Huan nuihza bawlna a azatzoh un, puan sandup ahawk ua, ama puan asilhsak nawn ua, kilhden ding in apikhia uhi.
Huan mi vialvak khat, Kurini khomi, Alexander leh Rufas pa, Simon, agam lam a kipan hong pai, akros po ding in aman uhi.
Golgotha mun ah Jesu api ua, huai tuh Luguh Mun, chihna ahi.
Huan uain murrah toh hel apia ua, himahleh adawn nuam kei.
Akilhden ua, atan ding chiat uh theihna ding in aisan in apuansilhte akihawm uhi.
Akilhden hun uh dak thumna vel ahi.
Ahekna lai atunglam ah agelh ua, "JUDATE' KUMPIPA,” chi in.
Huan suamhat nih, ataklam ah khat, aveilam ah khat amah toh akilhden uhi.
Laisiangthou in, "Amah talekte toh simkhawm ahita," chih genna hihtangtun in a-omta hi.
Huan mi kivialleh peuh in alu uh sing in, "Ehe! Nang tempul susia a ni thum a lam nawnpa,
Kihondam inla, kros a kipan hong kum in," chi in a-enghou uhi.
Huchi mah bang in siampu liante'n, laigelhmite toh, amau lak a enghou in, "Midang bawn hondam a, amah kihondam theiloupi in," achi uh.
I muh a, i gintak theihna ding in, "Khrist, Israel Kumpipa, tu in kros a kipan hong kumleh akei dia," achi uhi. Huan amah toh akilhden samte'n leng a-enghou uhi.
Huan dak gukna ahong hih in, dak kuana dong in gam pumpi ahong mialta hi.
Dak kuana ding in aw ngaihtak in Jesu, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?" chi in akikoukhia a, huai tuh, "Ka Pathian, Ka Pathian, bang achia hon paisan?" chihna ahi.
Huan akiang a dingh khenkhatte'n huai azak un, "Ngai un, Elijah sam ahi," achi uh.
Mi khat atai a, uain thuk spanji diahdim in, chiangdawn ah atak a, adawnsak hi. "Khawl dih ua, amah lakhe ding in Elijah ahong hiam i en ding uh," achi uhi.
Aw ngaihtak in Jesu akikou a, akha akhahta hi.
Tempul puanzak atunglam a kipan anuailam pha in ahong keksuakta hi.
Amazawn a sepaih zaheutupa dingh in huchibang a akha akhah amuh in, “Hiai mi zaw Pathian Tapa ahi ngeingei," achi hi.
Numeite'n leng gamlatak a dingh in a-en ua; huaite lak ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob naupangzaw leh Joses nu Mari, Salomi leng apang uhi.
Huaite Galili gam a a-om lai a, amah zui a, a-nna sepsak zelte ahi uhi; numei dang tampi Jerusalem a amah toh hohtoute leng a-om uhi.
Huan nitaklam ahih in Kisakkholhna ahih ziak in, huai Sabbath ma ni ahi,
Arimathai a om, Joseph, vaihawmpa zahtakhuai, Pathian lalgam lamenmi, ahong pai a, hangsantak in Pilat kiang ah alut a, Jesu luang angenta hi.
Huchi in Pilat in huchibang a asih pah lamdang asa mahmah a, huchi in sepaih zaheutupa sam in, asihna asawtta hiam chih adong hi.
Sepaih zaheutupa kam a pan sita ahi chih atheih in, Joseph kiang ah aluang apia hi.
Huan ama'n puanmalngat alei a, amah alakhia a, puanmalngat in atuam a, han khuakkuak ah asial a, suang in han kong adelhta hi.
Huan Mari Magdalin leh Joses nu Mari in asialna amu uhi.
Huan Sabbath ni abei in han ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob nu Mari leh Salomite ava hoh ua, amah nuh ding in gimlim alei uhi.
Ni sagih ani masapen in, zingsangpi in, nisuah lai in han ava tung uhi.
"Han kong a suang kua'n hon khukkhiaksak ding adiam aw?" akichih laitak un,
adak uleh suang khukkhiaksa in amuta uh, alian mahmah ngal a.
Han sung ah alut ua, pasal khat puanngou silh, ataklam pang a tu amu ua; lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huchi in ama'n akiang uah, "Lamdang sa kei un; Jesu Nazaret mi, akilhden uh, na zong ua; athounawnta; hiai ah a-omta kei; en un, asialna uh!
Himahleh pai unla, anungzuite leh Peter kiang ah, Galili gam ah na ma uah apai ding hi; na kiang ua achih bang ngei in huai ah na mu ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in linna leh lamdang sak luatna in amau atuam ziak in apawt ua, han a kipan atai vengveng ua; alauh ziak un kuamah kiang ah bangmah agen kei uhi.
Huan ni sagih ni masapen zingsang a athohnawn in, Mari Magdalin, asung a pan dawi sagih adelhkhiakna nu kiang ah akilak masapen hi.
Amah Jesu ompih zelte kiang ah ava hoh a, misi suun a akah lai un ava hilhta hi.
Himahleh amah ahing a, muh leng amu chih aza na ua, agingta tuan kei uhi.
Huai nung in alak ua mi nih gam lam zuan a apai lai un mel dang pu in akiang uah akilak nawn hi.
Amau nungzui dangte kiang ah ava hilh ua, amau thu leng agingta tuan kei uhi.
Huai nung in, an a-um lai un sawm-le-khatte kiang ah akilak a, athohnawn nung a amute thu agintak louh uh leh alungtang khauh thu uah ataihilh hi.
Akiang uah, "Khovel tengteng ah pai unla, thilsiam tengteng kiang ah tanchinhoih hilh un.
Agingta a baptisma tang hotdam in a-om ding a; agingta lou tuh siam louh tang in a-om ding.
Hiai chiamtehnate'n agingtate azui zel ding: Ka min in dawite adelhkhe ding ua, pau thak in apau ding uh;
khut in gulte ala ding ua; sihna gu bangchibang dawn mah le uh bangmah achi kei ding uh; damloute tung ah akhut uh akoih ding ua, adam zel ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Toupa Jesu'n akiang ua thu agen khit in van ah pitouh in a-om a, Pathian taklam ah atu hi.
Huchi in amau apaikhia ua, gam teng ah thu agenta uhi. Toupa'n amau aseppih a, chiamtehnate'n zui in thu ahihkip zel hi. Amen.
Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Kapernaum a ahong lut nawnleh inn ah a-om chih thu ahong thang hi.
Huchi in kongkhak kim a omna ding om lou khop in mi tampi ahong kikhawm ua, akiang uah thu agen hi.
Mizaw khat, mi li zawn, akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
Mipi ziak a akiangnai a ahong pai theih louh ziak un a-omna intung aphenvang ua; huai khit in alupna leh atung a mizaw lum kawm in akhaikhesuk uhi.
Huchi in Jesu'n aginna uh amuh in, mizaw kiang ah, "Ka tapa, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
Laigelhmi khenkhat huai mun ah atu uhi.
"Hiai mi'n bangziak a hichibang thu gen ahia? Pathian agensia hi; mi khat, Pathian kia lou ngal, kua'n ahia khelhnate ngaidam thei?" chi in alungtang un angaihtuah uhi.
Huan Jesu'n, alungtang un huchibang angaihtuah uh chih alungsim in athei pah a, akiang uah, "Huai thu bangziak a na lungtang ua ngaihtuah na hi ua?
Mizaw kiang a, 'Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita,' chih leh 'na lupna la inla, khe in paita in,' chih akoi ahia agen nuamzaw?
Himahleh leitung ah Mihing Tapa in khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," ahi, mizaw kiang ah;
"Thou inla, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in, ka hon chi," achi hi.
Huchi in amah athou a, alupna la pah in, avek ua mitmuh in apaita hi; huchi in avek un lamdang asa mahmah uh, hichibang himhim i mu ngei kei, chi in Pathian aphat uhi.
Huan apawt nawn a tuipi gei ah apaita hi, mipi tengteng akiang ah ava pai ua, ama'n thu ana hilh hi.
Apai kawm in, Alphai tapa, Levi siah piakna mun a tu amu a, akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi. Athou a azuita hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n Levi inn ah an a-um a, siahkhonte leh mikhialte tampi in Jesu leh anungzuite a-umpih uhi, amah zuite tampi ahi uh.

Jesu'n huai aza a, akiang uah, "Michidamte'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamloute'n akiphamohzaw uh; midiktatte sam ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte sam ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi.

Huan Johan nungzuite leh Pharisaite'n an angawl zel uhi. Amau ahong pai ua, Jesu kiang ah, "Bangziak a Johan nungzuite leh Pharisaite nungzuite'n an ngawl ua, nang nungzuite'n angolh sam louh uh?" achi uhi.

Himahleh akiang ua kipan apasal pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai ni chiang in zaw angawl ding uhi.
"Kuamah in puan tui khai nai louh them in puan lui athuap ngei kei uh; thuap le uh, thuap bit asawmna lam uah akaikek ding a, athak in alui akaikek ding a, ahong kek semsem ding hi.

Huan kuamah in savun uain thawl lui ah uain thak athun ngei kei, uain in savun thawl aphukham ding a, uain abo bei ding hi, savun thawl mah leng; uain thak savun uain thawl thak ah athun zaw uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu Sabbath ni in buhlei ah apaisuak hi, anungzuite'n apai kawm un buhvuite akhiak uhi.
Pharisaite'n akiang ah, "En dih, bangziak a Sabbath ni a hihsiang lou hih ahi ua?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "David leh alawmte ataksap ua, agilkial lai ua athilhih uh na sim kei ua hia?
Abiathar siampu lianpen ahih lai a, Pathian inn a alut a, siampute kia lou ngal in anek siang louh tanghou koihtuam anek a, alawmte kiang a apiak sam thu,” achi hi.
Huan amah mah in, akiang uah, "Sabbath zaw mihing a dia bawl ahi, mihing bel Sabbath ni a dia bawl ahi kei hi.
Huchi in Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath tung nangawn a Toupa ahi," achi hi.
Huan sinagog ah alut nawn a; huai ah khutzaw khat ana om hi.
Amah ahektheihna ding un Sabbath ni a ahihdam nop leh nop louh a-enkhia uhi.
Ama'n khutzaw kiang ah, "Dingkhia in," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihhoih hia siang, hihsiat? Hotdam hia siang, hihlup?" chi in adong hi. Himahleh adai dide uhi.
Huan alungtang uh tak ziak a lungkham mahmah leh heh kawm a amaute a-et velvel nung in, huai mi kiang ah, "Na khut zan in," achi a, huchi in azankhia a, akhut adamta hi.
Pharisaite apawtkhia ua, amah hihlup theihna ding lampi ngaihtuah in Herod pawl a mite toh akihoukhawm pah uhi.
Jesu anungzuite toh tuipi lam ah apaimang ua; Galili gam a kipan mipi tampitak in azui uhi.
Athilhih thupidan azak un Judia gam a kipan, Jerusalem a kipan, Idumai gam a kipan, Jordan gal a kipan, Tura leh Sidon kho kim a kipan in mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong pai uhi.
Mipi ziak in amah a dia long neu mansa a om ding in anungzuite ahilh hi, huchi lou in zaw hon um lutlut kha ding uhi.
Mipi tampi ahihdam tak ziak in natna nei peuhmah in amah akhoihtheihna ding un aboh huthut uhi.
Dawi ninte'n leng amah amuh un ama ah bokkhup in, "Nang Pathian Tapa na hi," chi in akikou uhi.
Huan atanchin genthang lou ding in akiang uah achi bikbek hi.
Huan tang ah ahohtou a, ama'n angaihngaih akiang ah asam a; amau akiang ah ahohtou uhi.
Akiang a om ding leh thugen dia asawlkhiak ding in sawm-le-nihte asep hi.
Natnate hihdam ding leh dawite delhkhe ding in thuneihna apia hi.
Huai mite, Simon, Peter, achih pa;
Zebedai tapa, Jakob leh Jakob unau Johan, huai mite Boanerges achihte; huai omdan tuh vanpiging tapate chihna ahi.
Andru, Philip, Bartholomai, Matthai, Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Thaddai, Kanaan mi Simon leh,
amansakpa, Judas Iskariot ahi uhi.
Huai zoh in, inn khat ah alut uhi. Huai ah mipi tampi ahong kikhawm nawn ua, huchi in an nangawn leng ane thei kei uhi.
Huan alawmte'n azak un, "Lungsim buai ahita," chi in amah mat atum uhi.
Huan laigelhmi, Jerusalem a kipan a hong sukte'n, "Beelzibul zawl ahi, dawite kumpipa ziak in ahi, dawite adelhkhiak," achi uhi.
Jesu'n laigelhmite asam a, gentehna in akiang uah, "Setan in Setan mah bangchi in adelhkhe thei dia?
Gam leng amah akidouleh huai gam adingkhe thei kei ding hi.
Inkuan khat leng amah akidou uleh, huaite inkuan adingkhe thei kei ding uhi.
Setan leng amah kidou a, akilanleh adingkhe thei kei ding a, amangthang zaw ding hi.
Kuamah in mihatpa ahen masak phot keileh inn a lut in asum alaksak thei kei uh, huai nung in bel a-inn alok mai ding uhi.
"Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mihing tate, akhelhna tengteng uah leh Pathian agensiatna bangpeuh uah leng agensiatnate uh ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
Kuapeuh Kha Siangthou hilhial gensia zaw chik mah chiang in ngaihdam ahi kei ding a, tangtawn khelhna ah siam louh in a-om zaw ding," achi hi.
Dawi nin pai ahi, achih ziak un huai agen ahi.
Huan anu leh a-unaute ahong ua, inpua ah adingh ua; amah sam ding in mi asawl uhi.
Akim a mipi tu diamduamte'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, inpua ah na nu leh na sanggampate'n ahon ngak uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka nu leh ka sanggampate kuate ahi ua?" chi in adong hi.
Akiang a tute a-en vialvial a, "En un, ka nu leh ka sanggampate;
kuapeuh Pathian deihlam hih photphot ka sanggampa, ka sanggamnu leh ka nu ahi uh," achi hi.
Huan tuipiau ah thu ahilh nawn hi. Mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, huchi in tuipi ah long ah tuang in atu a, mipi tengteng tuipiau a leitung ah a-om uhi.
Huan gentehna zang in thil tampi asinsak a, amah sinsakna dan in akiang uah,
"Ngaikhia unla, en dih ua; buhchithehpa buhchi theh ding in akuan hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, atheh lai in akhen lampi sik ah akia a, vasate'n anegai uhi.
Akhen suangsilei ah akia a; lei asah louh ziak in apou pah hi.
Himahleh ni ahong suah in haivuai in ahong om a, zung aneih louh ziak in avuaimang uhi.
Akhen loulingnei lak ah akia a, loupa ahong khang a, buhkungte adepmang a, agahta kei hi.
Akhen lei hoih a kia in apou a, akhanglian a, agah a; aleh sawmthum aleh sawmguk leh aleh za in apung chiat uhi,” achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
Huan amah kia a-om lai in akim a omte leh sawm-le-nihte'n gentehna thu adongchian thak uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Pathian lalgam thuguk zaw noute kiang a piak ahi a, polam mite a ding in bel bangkim gentehna a gen ahi.
Muh zaw amu na ua, atheisiam kei ding uh, huchi lou in zaw akihei nawn ding ua, ngaihdam ahong hi kha ding uh," achi hi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai gentehna thu na theisiam kei uh maw? Huchi ahih in bangchi in gentehna tengteng na theisiam tuan ding ua?
Buhchithehpa'n thu atheh ahi.
Lamsik a thu theh hiai bang ahi uh; thu azaktak un kintak a Setan hong pai in alungtang ua thu theh alakmangsak hi.
Huchibang mah in suangsilei a theh hiaite ahi uh; thu azak phet ua kipaktak a pom pahte.
Himahleh amau ah zung anei kei ua, sawt louchik kia a-om uh; huai nung in thu ziak a gimthuakna hiam sawina hiam ahong om phet in akipuk pah uhi.
Huan midangte loulingnei lak a theh bang ahi uh; huaite'n thu azata ua,
himahleh khovel lunggulhnate, thil dang duhgawlnate ahong lut chiang in, thu adep a, gah lou in a-om hi.
Huchi in lei hoih a kia hiaite ahi uh; thu za a, pom, aleh sawmthum, aleh sawmguk leh aleh za a gahte ahi uh," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Mi'n khawnvak de in akoihna a koih lou in, loh nuai hiam, lupna nuai hiam ah akoih ngei ua hia?
Thang lou ding a iim bangmah a-om ngei kei a, lang lou ding a sel bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei peuh in za hen," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Na zak uh bang ahia, pilvang un; na tehna ngei mah ua tehsak in na om ding ua, atamzaw bawn piak in na om ding uhi.
Kuapeuh anei piak behlap in a-om ding ua, kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak in om ding," achi hi.
"Pathian lalgam tuh mi'n lei a chi atuh bang ahi," achi hi.
"Zan chiang in a-ihmu a, sun chiang in athou zel a; chi pou in ana khang a, himahleh bangchi a pou a, khang ahia chih athei kei.
Lei in amah in gah ahon suah a; amasapen in akung, huan avui leh avui ah atang hong om hi.
Himahleh agah amin chiang in, kawite in a-at pah uhi; buhlak ahun tak ziak in," achi hi.
Huan "Pathian lalgam bang toh i tehpih dia? Ahihkeileh, bang gentehna in ahia i genteh ding? achi hi.
Ankam chi tang khat lei a atuh un, lei a chi tengteng sang in neupen mahleh,
atuh nung un ahong pou a, loupa tengteng sang in ahong lianzawta a, hiang liantak ahon nei a, huchi in tungleng vasate alim ah agiak uh, huchi mah bang ahi," achi hi.
Huan huchibang gentehna thu tampi in, atheihsiam theih khomkhom uh, akiang uah agen zel hi.
Himahleh gentehna lou in zaw akiang uah thu agen ngei kei; amah nungzuite kiang ah asim in bangkim ahilhchian zel hi.
Huai ni mah nitaklam ahong hih in, akiang uah, "Gal khat lam i kai ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in mipite paisan in, a-om ngeingei bang in, long ah apaipih pah ua, long dangte leng akiang ah a-om uhi.
Huchi in huihpi thupitak ahong nung a, tuikihotte long ah ahong kihotlut zuazua hi, huchi in long ahong dimta hi.
Amah lukham kham a ihmu in, longmei lam ah a-om hi. Huan aphawng ua akiang ah, "Heutupa, ka manthat uh khawk sa lou na hi maw?" achi uhi.
Amah ahong thou a, huih atai a, tuipi kiang ah leng, "Dai inla om kinken in," achi hi. Huan huih atawp a, hong dai dide hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchi a hichi tel a lau na hi ua oi? Ginna nei lou na hi uh maw?" achi hi.
Huchi in lau petmah in alau ua, "Hiai mi kua ahia le, huih leh tuipi nangawn in athu aman uh?" akichi uhi.
Huan dil gal, Gerasin mite gam ahong tung uhi.
Long a kipan apawt nung in dawi nin pai khat, han a kipan a hong pawt in amah ana tuak pah hi.
Hanmunte ah akhosa zel a, kuamah in sik khainiang nangawn a ahen theih louh uh ahi.
Sikkol leh sik khainiang in ahen ua; himahleh sik khainiang abottat a, sikkol leng ahihtan zel a; kuamah in athuzoh zou kei uhi.
Sun leh zan in han leh tang ah akikoukou a, suang in aki-at hi.
Huan gamlatak a kipan Jesu amuhtak in atai a, amah abia hi.
Huan aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Jesu, Pathian Tungnungpen Tapa, kei leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Hon gimsak lou ding in Pathian min in nget chihtak in ka hon ngen hi,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang, dawi nin pai, hiai mi sung a kipan pawt in," ana chi hi.
Huan ama'n, "Na min bang ahia?" chi in adong hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka min nuai ahi, tampi ka hih ziak un," achi hi.
Huai gam a pan amau sawlkhe lou ding in Jesu kiang ah nakpi in angen hi.
Huan huai lai a tang pang ah vokhon tampi ata uhi.
Dawi ninte'n, "Vok sung ah hon sawl in, asung ua ka luttheihna ding un," chi in akiang ah angen uhi.
Ama'n thu apia a, huchi in dawi ninte apawt ua, vok sung ah alut ua; vokhonte sangnih phial ahi ua, ken ah ataisuk ua, tuipi ah atailut ua; tuipi ah tui hak in asita uhi.
Huan vok an pete atai ua, khua leh lou ah agen ua, huai thil hong om bang ahia chih en ding in mite ahong taikhawm uhi.
Jesu kiang ahong tung ua, dawimatpa, alungsim ngei pu leh puansilh a huai a tu amu ua, huchi in alauta uhi.
Ama ua mute'n, dawimat tung a thiltundan leh vok tanchin amaute ana hilh uhi.
Huan amau agam ua kipan a pawt ding in angenta uhi.
Huan long a alut in dawi nin paipa'n amah kiang a omsak ding in angen hi.
Himahleh Jesu'n aphal kei a, akiang ah, "Na inn a na lawmte kiang ah pai inla, Toupa'n nang a dia thil hon hihsak athupidan leh nang ahon lainatdan va hilh in," achi zaw hi.
Huan apai a, Dekapolis ah Jesu'n amah a dia thil ahihsak thupidan atangkoupihta hi. Huan mi tengteng in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Jesu long a gal khat lam a ahong kai nawn in mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong paikhawm ua, amah tuipi gei ah a-om hi.
Huchi in sinagog a vaihawmte lak a mi khat, amin Jaira, ahong a, Jesu amuhtak in akhebul ah abokkhup hi.
"Ka tanu naupang chik asi dekdek a; hong dam a, ahintheihna ding in hong pai a atung a na khut koih ding in ka hon ngen hi," chi in nakpi in athum hi.
Huchi in Jesu akiang ah ava hoh a, mipi tampitak in zui in, amah aboh lutlut uhi.
Huan numei khat kum sawm-le-nih sipawt a damlou a-om hi.
Daktor tampi lak ah nakpitak a thuak in, aneih tengteng azangbei khinta a, phattuam nak sang in ase zosop hi.
Huai mi'n Jesu tanchin ana za a, anung ah mipi lak ah ahong pai a, apuan mong akhoih hi.
"Apuan mong kia khoih leng hihdam in ka om mai ding," alungsim in achi hi.
Huan thakhat in asipawt akam ngal a, anatna hihdam ahi chih asa ah akitheita hi.
Jesu'n, asung a kipan thilhihtheihna apawt chih athei a, mi lak ah akihei vialvial a, "Kua ahia ka puan mong khoih?" achi hi.
Anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Mipi'n ahon boh lutlut uh mu chin a, kua ahia hon khoih? Bangchidan a chi na hia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n huai thilhihnu muh tum in a-en vialvial hi.
Huchi in numei in atung a thil ahihsak thei in, lau leh ling kawm in ahong pai a, ama ah bokkhup in, akiang ah thudik ahilh vek hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Tanu na ginna dampih na hi, khamuangtak in pai inla, na natna a kipan na damta in," achi hi.
Apau laitak in sinagog a vaihawmpa inn a kipan mi ahong pai ua, "Na tanu asita, sinsakpa hihbuai lailai ding na hiam?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n athugen uh ngeingaih lou in, sinagog a vaihawmpa kiang ah, "Lau ke'n, gingta mai in," achi hi.
Peter, Jakob leh Jakob unau Johan chih louh ngal midang kuamah in amah azuih uh aphal kei hi.
Huan sinagog vaihawmpa inn atung a, Jesu'n ana buai vengvung, kap vengvung leh mau vengvungte thawm aza hi.
Ava lut a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a bil am zen a kap na hi ua? Naupang si lou ahi, ihmu ahi zaw," achi hi.
Huan amah anuihsan maimah uhi. Himahleh ama'n avek un apawtsak a, naupang omna ah ava lut hi.
Huan naupang khut alen a, akiang ah, "Talitha kumi," achi a, huai tuh "Nungaknou, thou in, ka hon chi," chihna ahi.
Huan numei naupang athou a, apai pah ngal a; amah kum sawm-le-nih mi ahi. Huan amau lamdang asa mahmah uh.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kuamah in thei kei hen," achi bilbel a, nek ding piak ding thu apia hi.
Huan huai a kipan apawt a, a-omna kholam atungta a; anungzuite'n azui uhi.

Sabbath ni ahong hi a, sinagog ah thu ahilh a; mi tampi athu zate'n, "Hiai mi'n hiai thu koi a kipan amuh ahia? Hiai mi kiang a pilna piak bang pilna ahia? Akhut in hichi tel a thillamdang ahih bangchidan ahia?" ana chi uhi.

"Hiai mi Mari tapa, Jakob, Joses, Judas leh Simon sanggampa, singlem bawlpa ahi kei a hia? Asanggamnute leng hiai a i kiang ua om ahi kei ua hia?" achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Huchi in atung ah alungkim kei uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zawlnei zaw ama kholam ah, ama inkote lak ah, ama inn kia lou ngal ah pahtawi louh in a-om ngei kei," achi hi.
Huan mi damlou tawmchikte tung a khut koih a ahihdam kia lou ngal huai ah thil thupi lua ahih kei hi.
Agintak louh uh lamdang asa mahmah hi. Huan thuhilh kawm in khuate atawn vialvial hi.
Huan sawm-le-nihte asam a, nihnih in asawlkhia a; dawi ninte tung a thuneihna leng apia hi.
Azinna ua ding in chiangkhun kia lou ngal bangmah, tanghou leh kawlzal leng, akawnggak ua dangka tawi louh ding achi bikbek hi.
Khedap bel but ding achi a; puanak nih silhthuah kei un, achi lai hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Koipeuh ah leng na tunna inn uah, huai a kipan na pawt mateng uh tung kinken un.
Huan koi khua peuh in ahon kipahpih louh ua, na thu uh angaihkhiak kei ualeh huai a kipan na pawt chiang un, amau mohpaih ding in, na khepek nuai ua leivui kai na tatkhe ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in apaikhia ua, mite akisik ding uh ahi chih agen uhi.
Dawi tampi leng adelhkhia ua, damlou tampi leng thau anilh ua, ahihdam uhi.
Huan kumpipa Herod in ana za a, amin athan ziak in, "Baptispa Johan, misi lak a pan thounawn a, huaiziak a huai thilhihtheihnate'n amah a sem ahi," achi hi.
Midangte'n bel, "Elijah ahi, achi ua; midangte'n, ma lai zawlneite bang zawlnei khat ahi," achi uhi.
Himahleh Herod in ana zak in, "Alutang ka tanpa ngei, hong thounawnta ahi," achi hi.
Herod in a-unau Philip zi Herodias ziak in mi asawlkhia a, Johan amansak a, suangkul ah hen in ana khum khinta a; Herodias zi in ana neita ngal a.
Johan in lah Herod kiang a, "Na unaupa zi na neihsak siang lou ahi," ana chih khit tak ziak in.
Huaiziak in Herodias in amah amudah a, hihlup a-ut a, himahleh ahihthei kei hi.
Herod in, Johan midiktat leh misiangthou ahi chih atheih ziak in amah akihta a, amah a-enkhia a, athu azak in, thil tampi ahih a, kipaktak in angaikhia hi.
Huan Herod in apian ni in amithupite, sepaih heutu liante, Galili gam a miliante a ding a zan ankuang alui lai in hun lemtang ahong omta hi.
Herodias tanu ahong lut a, alam a, Herod leh a-ankuang umpihte akipaksakta hi. Kumpipa'n numei naupang kiang ah, "Na deihdeih hon ngen in, ka hon pe ding,” achi hi.
"Bangpeuh na hon nget phot, hon pe ding ka hi, ka gam kimkhat nangawn leng," chi in akiang ah akichiam hial hi.
Amah apawt a, anu kiang ah, "Bang ka ngen dia?" ava chi hi. Anu'n, "Baptispa Johan lutang," ana chi hi.
Huan amah kintak in kumpipa kiang ah ava lut pah a, "Kuangpi a Baptispa Johan lutang na hon piak pah ka ut," chi in angen hi.
Huan kumpipa alungkham mahmah a; himahleh akichiamna leh a-ankuang umpihte ziak in asel nuam kei hi.
