Huan kumpipa'n amah vengte lak a sepaih khat alutang va la ding a thu pia in asawl pah hi. Amah suangkul a pai in alutang ava tankheta hi.
Huai lutang kuang in ahon tawi a, numei naupang kiang ah apia a, huan numei naupang in anu kiang ah apeta hi.
Huan anungzuite'n azak un, aluang la in, han ah avuita uhi.
Huan sawltakte Jesu kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, thil bangkim, athilhih peuh uleh athuhilh peuh uh, ahong hilh uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Noumau kia in gamdai mun ah atuam in hong unla, khawl tadih un," achi hi. Mipi atam a, akuan leh apai akiphamat ua, an nangawn leng ane man kei uhi.
Huchi in gamdai mun ah long in apaituamta uhi.
Mite'n apai lai uh amu ua, mi tampi in amau athei ua, kho chih a pan huai ah khe in ataikhawm ua, ana makhelhta uhi.
Huchi in amah hong paikhiak in mipi tampitak amuta a, chingtu ding nei lou belamte bang ahih ziak un alainat mahmah a, thu tampi ahilhta hi.
Huan ni akai mahmahta a, anungzuite akiang ah ahong ua, "Hiai gamdai mun ahi a, ni akaita mahmah hi.
I kim a loute leh khuate a hoh a, anek ding uh banghiam bek aleitheihna ding un amaute paisakta in," achi uhi.
Ama'n bel akiang uah, "Noumau nek ding pia un," chi in adawng hi. Amau akiang ah, "Makhai zanih man tanghou va lei in nek ding pe ding ka ding uam?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua? Hon en dih ua," achi a. Huan aneih zah uh atheihtak un, "Nga leh ngasa nih," achi uhi.
Huan ama'n, avek un loupa hing tung ah apawlpawl a tusak ding in akiang uah thu apia hi.
Huchi in apawlpawl in, zakhat khawng, sawmnga khawng in atu uhi.

Huan ama'n tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, tanghou phelte abalkham a, ama ua lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia a; ngasa nih leng huaite tengteng lak ah ahawmzak hi.
Avek un ane ua, akham chiat uh.
Huan tanghou leh ngasa nente bawm sawm-le-nih adim hi.
Tanghou phel nete pasal piching ngen sangnga ahi uh.
Huan mipi akikhensak nung in gal khat lam a Bethsaida a na pai masa ding in long ah anungzuite atuangsak pah hi.
Amau akikhensak nung in thum ding in tang ah ahohtou hi.
Nitaklam ahong hih in, tuipi laitak ah long a-om a, amah kia in gam ah a-om hi.
Long kalh a mangbang in amaute amu a, huih in ahilou lam ah asep hi. Huchi in zanven lina ding kuan in tuipi tung a khe a pai in amau lam ahon zuan a, amau paisuak san atum hi.
Himahleh amah tuipi tung a khe a pai amuh un sikha sa in, akikoukhia uhi.
Avek un amah amu ua, alau mahmah uhi. Himahleh ama'n amau ahoupih pah a, akiang uah, "Khamuangtak in om un, keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
Huan long ah akiang uah atuangtou sam a, huih adai maimah hi. Huan lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Alungtang uh akhauh ziak in tanghou beu thillamdang thu angaihtuah ban kei uhi.
Huan gal khat lam akai un Gennesaret gam atung ua, luipiau ah long akhih uhi.
Long a kipan apawt nung un mite'n amah ana thei pah uhi.
Huai gam kim tengteng ah atai ua, a-om chih azakna peuh uah alupna un damloute ahon zawng hial uhi.
Huan khoneu leh kholian ah khopi leh khota leh koipeuh ah leng alutna ah damloute, dawr mun ah alumsak ua, apuan mong bek khoihsak ding in angen ngutngut uhi. Huan amah khoih peuhmah adam uhi.
Huan Pharisaite leh laigelhmite lak a mi kuate hiam, Jerusalem a kipan akiang ah ahong kikhawm uhi.
Huaite'n nungzui khenkhatte'n khut ninpi a tanghou anek uh amu ua, nin, chih tuh, sil lou, chihna ahi.
Pharisaite leh Judate tengteng in upate thugousiah apom tinten ziak un akhut uh hoihtak a asil kei uleh ane ngei kei uhi.
Dawr mun a kipan a apai un leng akisil phot kei uleh ane ngei kei uhi. Huan thugousiah dang tampi achin uh a-om, nou, bel, taubelte sil thute ah.
Huchi in Pharisaite leh laigelhmite'n, "Bang achia upate thugousiah bang a na nungzuite om lou a, khut ninpi a tanghou ne ahi ua," chi in adong uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Isai in nou milepchiahte thu a na genkhol dik hilhial ve, 'Hiai mite'n amuk un ahon zahtak ua, alungtang un hon gamlat uh' achi hi.
'Mihing thupiakte asinsak lel ziak un ahon biak uh athawn ahi,' chih gelh bang in.
"Pathian thupiakte nelhsiah in mihing thugousiah na len tinten ua ei ve," achi hi.
Akiang uah, "Na thugousiah uh na zuihtheihna ding ua Pathian thupiakte na deih louh uh zaw, lem na thei hial ve ua.
Mosi in, 'Na nu leh na pa zahtak in,' 'Kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam gensia si mahmah hen,' achi a;
nou hichibang in na chi ua, mi'n, anu hiam, apa hiam kiang a, 'Na hon phatuampihna ding Korban ahita,' achih, (huai tuh Pathian kiang a piak, chihna ahi),
Anu a ding hiam, apa a ding hiam in bangmah hihsak na phal nawn kei nak uh.
Na thugousiah uh na piak sawnsawnna un Pathian thu bangmah lou na suah uhi; huai bang thil tampi na hih uh," achi hi.
Huan mipite asam nawn a, akiang uah, "Na vek un ka thu ngaikhia unla, theisiam un;
mihing polam a kipan asung a lut amah hihnin thei bangmah a-om kei; mihing sung a kipan a hong pawt, huaite mihing hihnin ahi zaw hi.
Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
Mipite inn a alutsan nung in anungzuite'n gentehna thu amah adongchian uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou leng huchi tel a theihsiamna nei lou na hi uh maw? Bangpeuh polam a kipan a mihing sung a lut in amah ahihnin thei kei chih na thei kei ua hia?
Alungtang sung a lut lou a, agilpi sung a alut zawk ziak in leh dailenna a pawtkhe mai ahih ziak in," achi a. (Huai tuh an chiteng asiang, achihna ahi).
"Mihing sung a pan hong pawt, huai ngeingei in mihing ahihnin nak ahi.
Mihingte sunglam lungtang a kipan in, ngaihtuahna giloute ahong pawt nak hi;
kingaihna, guktakna, tualthahna, angkawmna leh enna, gitlouhna, khemhatna, bevenna, hazatna gensiatna, kisaktheihna leh haihuainate ahi.
Hiai thil giloute tengteng sunglam a kipan ahong pawt a, mihing ahihnin nak hi,” achi hi.
Huan athou a, huai a kipan in Tura leh Sidon uk ah apaita hi. Inn ah alut a, kuamah theih adeih kei a; himahleh akisel thei tuan kei.
Huchi in numei khat, atanu naupang chik dawi nin pai in, atanchin ana za a, akhebul ah abokkhup hi.
Huai numei tuh Grik mi ahi a, Sirophoinisia gam a piang ahi. Ama'n atanu sung a kipan a dawi delhkhe ding in angen hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Tate hong vah masa uhen aw; tate tanghou laksak a uite kiang a paih kilawm lou ahi,” achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, "Toupa, hih zaw ahi na a, himahleh dohkan nuai a uite'n leng tate tanghou nen ane zel sam ve uah oi," chi in adawng hi.
Ama'n, akiang ah, "Na thugen ziak in paita in; na tanu sung a kipan dawi apawtta hi,” achi hi.
Huan a-inn ah apaita, atanu, dawi in apawtkhiaksan, lupna a lum ava muta hi.
Huan Tura gam a kipan apawt nawn a, Sidon khua tawn in Dekapolis gam paikan in Galili tuipi atungta hi.
Mi khat nangong, pau leng pau kichian thei lou akiang ah hon tonpih ua, atung a khut koih ding in angen uhi.
Ama'n mipi lak a kipan in amah kia in apituam a, akhutzungte in abilsung akhoih a, chil sia in alei akhoihsak hi.
Van lam en in akhoisa huthut hi. Huan akiang ah, "Ephatha," achi a; huai bel, "Kihongta in," chihna ahi.
Huchi in abilte hong kihong a, aleigakna leng ahong kiphel a, chiantak in apau theita hi.
Akiang uah, kuamah hilh lou ding achi bikbek a; himahleh anak kham peuhleh, anak tangkoupihzaw sem uhi.
"Ama'n bangkim hoihtak in ahih a; nangongte nangawn apausak zel," achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huai nite in, mipi tampitak ahong om nawn ua, nek ding bangmah anei kei ua, ama'n anungzuite asam a, akiang uah,
"Mipite tu in ka kiang ah ni thum a-omta ua, nek ding bangmah aneih louh ziak un ka lainat mahmah hi.
An ngawl in a-inn uah paisak leng lamkal ah abah kha ding uh; khenkhatte houh ahong paina uh agamla mahmah ngal a," achi hi.
Anungzuite'n, "Mi'n hiai gamdai ah koi a tanghou in ahia hiai mite ahihvah theih ding uh?" chi in amah adawng uhi.
Huan ama'n, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua?" chi in amau adong a. Amau, "Phel sagih," achi uhi.
Huan mipite lei a tu ding in thu apia a; tanghou phel sagih ala a, kipahthu agen khit in abalkham a, ama ua lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia a; huchi in mipite ma ah aluita uhi.
Ngasa tawmchik leng anei ua; ama'n avualzawl a, huaite leng ama ua lui ding in thu apia hi.
Huchi in ane ua, akham chiat ua; bawm sagih dim in akhamval nen uh aluak uhi.
Amau sangli vel ahi ua; ama'n amaute apaisakta hi.
Amah bel anungzuite kiang ah long ah atuang pah a, huchi in Dalmanutha gam atung uhi.
Pharisaite ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in, amah a pan van a kipan a chiamtehna zong in amah ahong sel uhi.
Huan amah alungsim in nakpi in anak kuaikuai a, "Bang achia hiai khangte'n chiamtehna zong uh ahia? Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai khangte kiang ah chiamtehna himhim piak ahi kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in amaute paisan in long ah atuang nawn a, gal khat lam ah apaisanta hi.
Huan anungzuite'n tanghou atawi mangngilh ua, tanghou phel khat kia lou ngal long ah tanghou dang himhim lah anei kei uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Pharisaite silngou leh Herod silngou lak ah kiveng unla, pilvang un," achi hi.
Amau, "Tanghou i neih louh ziak ei ve," chi in akingaihtuah uhi.
Jesu'n huai atheih in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a tanghou na neih louh ziak ua kingaihtuah na hi ua? Tu nangawn in na theisiam kei lai uh maw? Theisiam lou lai maw? Na lungtang uh na khauhsak ua hia?
Mit nei napi in na mu kei ua hia? Bil nei napi in na za kei ua hia? Theigige lou uh maw?
Sangnga lak a tanghou phel nga ka balkhap lai in anen bawm bangzah ahia na luahdim uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Sawm-le-nih,” achi uhi.
Huan sangli a dia sagih ka balkhap lai in, anen bawm bangzah ahia na luahdim uh? achi a. Amau akiang ah, "Sagih," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchidan a tu nangawn a theisiam lou lailai na hi ua?" achi hi.
Huai nung in Bethsaida ahong tung uhi. Huan akiang ah mittaw ahon pi ua, amah khoih ding in angen uhi.
Ama'n mittaw khut alen a, khua a kipan apikhia hi; amit ah chil sia in atung a akhut akoih khit in, "Khua na mu thei hia?" chi in adong hi.
Amah hong dakkhia a, "Mite ka mu; singkung pai bang in ka mu,” achi hi.
Amit ah akhut akoih nawn a, ahong hakkhia a, ahong dam maimah a, bangkim chiantak in amutheita hi.
Huan Jesu'n, khua ah leng lut ke'n chi in a-inn ah apaisakta hi.
Huan Jesu leh anungzuite ahong pai zel ua, Kaisaria Philippi khuate ahong tung ua; huan pai kawm in anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite'n kei kua ka hi ahon chi ua?" chi in adong hi.
Amau, "Baptispa Johan ahi, ahon chi ua; midang in Elijah ahi, ahon chi ua; khenkhat in bel, zawlnei kuahiam ahi, ahon chi uh," achi uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kei kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" chi in adong hi. Peter in akiang ah, "Khrist na hi," chi in adawng hi.
Huan ama'n atanchin kuamah hilh louh ding in achi bikbek hi.
Huan Mihing Tapa in thil tampi athuak dingte, upate, siampu liante, laigelhmite deih louh a a-om ding, hihlup a a-om ding leh ni thum nung a athohnawn ding thute amau ahilh hi.
Huai thute chiantak in agen hi. Huan Peter in amah apituam a, atai hi.
Himahleh amah ahong kihei a, anungzuite muh in, Peter atai a, "Setan, ka nung ah pai in, Pathian thilte ngaihtuah lou in, mihing thilte na ngaihtuah zaw,” achi hi.
Huan mipite, anungzuite toh asam a, akiang uah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuih a-utleh amah kingaihsak lou in, ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding a; kuapeuh keimah ziak leh tanchinhoih ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
Mi'n khovel apum in nei henla, ahinna tan taleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia?
Mi'n ahinna tang in bang ape thei dia?

Kuapeuh hiai khang a angkawm leh gilou chingte lak ah keimah leh ka thu zumpih, Mihing Tapa in, angel siangthoute toh a Pa thupina a kivan a ahong hun chiang in, huai mi ahon zumpih thuk sam ding," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai a dingh akhente, Pathian lalgam thilhihtheihna toh hong tung amuh ma ua, sihna chiam lou ding a-om uh," achi hi.
Huan ni guk nung in Jesu'n Peter, Jakob leh Johan apituam a, tang sangtak ah apaitouhpih a; ama uah amel omdan ahong lamdangta hi.
Huchi in apuansilhte lei a puansawpmi in asawp ngou theih louh khop hial a ngou velvol in ahong lamdangta hi.
Akiang uah Elijah leh Mosi ahong kilak ua, Jesu toh akihou uhi.
Peter in Jesu ahoupih a, "Heutupa, ei a ding in hiai a om ahoih; aidakbuk thum i lam ding ua, nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat," achi hi.
Alau mahmah ziak un agen pen leng athei kei hi.
Huan amau liah in meipi ahong kai a; meipi a pan aw ahong suak a, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak ahi, amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
Kintak in akimvel a-en ua, akiang ua Jesu kia lou ngal kuamah amuta kei uhi.
Huan tang a kipan apaisuk lai un, "Misi lak a kipan Mihing Tapa athohnawn khit mateng athil muhte uh kuamah hilh louh ding," achi bikbek hi.
Huchi in huai thu avom kinken uhi, misi lak a pan thohnawn pen bang chihna hi ding ahia chih akidong uhi.
Huan amau akiang ah, "Bangchidan a laigelhmite'n, Elijah ahong pai masa ding ahi," chi ahi ua? chi in adong uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangkim bawlhoih thak ding in Elijah ahong pai masa him ahi; ahihleh thil tampi athuak ding a, muhdah a mawkbawl in a-om ding chi a Mihing Tapa tungthu bangchidan a gelh a na om ahia le? achi hi.
Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Elijah zaw ahong pai khinta hi, atanchin agelh bang ngei un atung ah a-utut un ahih khinta uhi,” achi hi.
Huan nungzuite kiang atunsuk un, akim ua mipi tampite leh laigelhmite ana kisel lai uh amu uhi.
Mipi tengteng in amah amuhtak un lamdang asa mahmah ua, akiang ah atai pah ua, chibai ava buk kheukhou uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Amaute toh bang thu ahia na na kisel uh?" chi in adong hi.
Mipi lak a mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ka tapa, dawi mat pau thei lou dia abawl, na kiang ah ka hon pi a;
amatna peuh ah apuksak ekek a; huchi in achilphuan pawt in, aha agawi a, ahong kongkaw a; na nungzuite'n delhkhe le uh ka chihleh adelhkhe thei kei uh," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ginna nei lou khangte aw, bang tan na kiang ua om ding a bang tan hon thuak thei ding ka hia? Amah ka kiang ah hon pi un," chi in adawng hi.
Huan amah Jesu kiang ah ahon pi ua; dawi in amah amuhtak in nakpi in naupang asawisa pah a; huchi in lei ah apuk a, achilphuan kai zezu in akikhuk volvol hi.
Huan ama'n apa kiang ah, "Hichibang a ahong kipatna bang tan ahita a?" chi in adong hi. Ama'n, "Anaupan lai a kipan ahita,"
"Huchi in amah hihmangthang ding in tamveipi mei ah leh tui ah asawnpuk a; himahleh nang bangchi chi hiam bek a na hihtheihleh hon hehpih inla, hon huh in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na gintakleh e! Agingtami a ding in bangkim hihtheih ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in naupang' pa'n khitui toh, "Toupa, ka gingta hi, ka ginlahna hon huh in," chi in akikoukhia hi.
Jesu'n mipi hong taikhawm amuh in, dawi nin atai a, akiang ah, "Nang dawi pau thei lou leh nangong, thu ka hon pia hi, asung a kipan pawt inla, lut nawn ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in akikoukheta a, nakpitak a asawi khit in apawtta a, naupang misi bang in a-om a; huchi in mi tamzawte'n, "Asi ahi," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akhut alen a, akaithou a; huan ahong thou maimahta hi.
Huan Jesu inn a ava lutleh anungzuite'n, "Bangchi a kou delhkhe thei lou ka hi ua?" chi in asim in adong uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hichibang zaw thumna leh an ngawlna kia lou ngal in bangchi mah in apawt thei kei,” achi hi.
Huan huai a kipan apaikhia ua; Galili gam paikan in, kuamah theih adeih kei,
anungzuite asinsak lai ahih ziak in akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa mihingte khut ah matsak in a-om dia, athat ding ua; ahihlup nung uh ni thum nung in athounawn ding," achi ngal a.
Himahleh athugen atheisiam kei ua, amah lah adong ngam kei uhi.
Huan Kapernaum khua ahong tung ua; insung a a-om lai in, akiang uah, "Lampi a bang thu ahia na kisel uh?" chi in adong hi.
Lampi ah, i lak uah kua i thupipen dia? chi a ana kisel khit ziak un adai dide uhi.
Huan amah atu a, sawm-le-nihte asam a, akiang uah, "Kuapeuh in masapen hih a-utleh mi tengteng sang in ananungpen in a-om ding ahi, mi tengteng nna sem in a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan naupang chik khat akai a, alak uah adingsak a; apom a akiang uah,
"Kuapeuh ka min ziak a hiai bang naupang chik khat kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih zaw, kei hon kipahpih ahi kei ding, hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi zaw uh," achi hi.
Johan in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, kuahiam na min a dawite delhkhia ka mu ua; ahon zuih louh ziak in ka kham uhi," achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Kham nawn kei un; kuamah ka min a thil thupi hih kei hon gense pah thei a-om kei hi.
Kuapeuh ei hon dou lou i lam a pang ahi.
Kuapeuh Khrist mi na hih ziak ua tui nou khat dawn ding hon pia, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, akipahman atan kei hial ding hi.
"Huan kuapeuh hon gingta neuchikte lak a khat leng hihpuk, angawng ah buh gawizanna suang lianpi oksak in tuipi ah khe le uh, amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
Huan na khut in ahon hihpukleh tankhia in; melhem a hinna a lut nang ding in ahoihzaw, khut nih nei a gawtmun mei mit thei lou a pai sang in,
athan uh asih louh a, meikuang mihlouhna ah.
Na khe in ahon hihpukleh tankhia in, khe nih nei a gawtmun a paih a om sang in, khebai a hinna a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
Athan uh asih louh a, meikuang amihlouhna ah.
Huan na mit in ahon hihpukleh khelkhia in; mit langnih nei a gawtmun a paih a om sang in mit langkhat nei a Pathian lalgam a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
Athan uh sih ngeilouhna leh mei mih ngeilouhna ah.
Michih mei a soh a om ding uh ahi ngal a.
Chi ahoih hi; himahleh, chi apen khitleh bang in na hih al nawn ding ua? Noumau ngei ah chi nei unla, khat-le-khat kilem in om un," achi hi.
Abraham tapa, David tapa, Jesu Khrist khangthubu.
Abraham in Isak asuang a, Isak in Jakob asuang a, Jakob in Judas leh a-unaute asuang hi.
Judas in Tamar a pan Perez leh Zerah asuang a, Perez in Erom asuang a, Erom in Aram asuang hi.
Aram in Amminadab asuang a, Amminadab in Nashon asuang a, Nashon in Salmon asuang hi.
Salmon in Rahab a pan Boaz asuang a, Boaz in Ruth a pan Obed asuang a, Obed in Jesse asuang hi.
Jesse in kumpipa David asuang a, kumpipa David in Uria zi a pan Solomon asuang hi.
Solomon in Rehoboam asuang a, Rehoboam in Abijah asuang a, Abijah in Asa asuang hi.
Asa in Jehoshaphat asuang a, Jehoshaphat in Jeram asuang a, Jeram in Uzzia asuang hi.
Uzzia in Jotham asuang a, Jotham in Ahaz asuang a, Ahaz in Hezekiah asuang hi.
Hezekiah in Manasseh asuang a, Manasseh in Amon asuang a, Amon in Josiah asuang hi.
Babulon sal a api lai un Josiah in Jekoniah leh a-unaute asuang hi.
Huan Babulon sal a api nung un Jekoniah in Salathiel asuang a, Salathiel in Zerubbabel asuang hi.
Zerubbabel in Abiud asuang a, Abiud in Eliakim asuang a, Eliakim in Azor asuang a,
Azor in Zadok asuang a, Zadok in Akim asuang a, Akim in Eliud asuang hi.
Eliud in Eleazar asuang a, Eleazar in Mathan asuang a, Mathan in Jakob asuang hi.
Jakob in Joseph, Mari pasal asuang a, huai Mari lak ah Jesu Khrist ahong piangta hi.
Huchi in suan tengteng Abraham a pan David tan suan sawm-le-li ahi a, David a pan Babulon a sal a pi ahih tan un, suan sawm-le-li ahi a, Babulon a sal a pi ahih ua pan Khrist tan suan sawm-le-li ahi.
Jesu Khrist hong piandan hichibang ahi. Anu Mari leh Joseph akikham lai ua a-omkhawm ma un, Kha Siangthou in agaisak chih atheita uhi.
Huchi in apasal Joseph, midiktak ahi a, amah daisak a-ut kei a, aguk in tawpsan atum hi.
Himahleh, huai thute angaihtuah lai in, ngai in, amang in akiang ah Toupa angel ahong kilak a, "Joseph, nang David tapa, na zi Mari neih lau ke'n, anaupai Kha Siangthou a kipan ahi.
Tapa anei dia, amin ding in Jesu na sa ding; ama'n amite akhelhna ua kipan ahotdam ding ziak in," achi hi.
Toupa'n zawlnei kam a:
"Ngai in, nungak siangthou agai dia, tapa anei dia, amin Immanuel asa ding uh," chi a agen ahong tuntheihna ding in huai tengteng ahong om hi. Huai tuh, "I kiang uah Pathian a-om," chihna ahi.
Huchi in Joseph ihmu athoukhia a, Toupa Angel in akiang a thu apiak bang in ahih a, azi aneita hi.
Himahleh, tapa aneih masiah akithuahpih kei; huan amin Jesu asata hi.
Huai zoh in anungzui sawm-le-nihte akiang ah asamkhawm a, akiang uah khaninte tung leh amau hawlkhe ding, damlouhna chiteng leh natna chiteng hihdam ding in athuneihna apia hi.
Huai sawltak sawm-le-nihte min hiaite ahi: Amasapen in Simon Peter leh a-unau Andru; Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unau Johan,
Philip leh Bartholomai; Thomas leh siahkhon Matthai; Alphai tapa Jakob leh Thaddai;
Kanaan mi Simon leh zuausan a mansakpa Judas Iskariot.
Hiai sawm-le-nihte Jesu'n asawlkhia a, akiang uah huchi in thu apia hi. "Zentelte lam ah pai kei unla, Samari mite khua ah leng lut kei un.
Himahleh Israel inkuan belam mangte kiang ah pai zaw un.
Huan na pai un, van-gam anaita, chi in thu gen zel un.
Damloute hihdam unla, misite kaithou unla, phakte hihsiangthou unla; dawite hawlkhia un, athawn in na mu ua, athawn in pia un.
Na kawnggak uah dangka-eng hiam, dangka hiam, dal dangka hiam vom kei un.
Zinna a ding in kawlzal hiam, puanak nih hiam, khedap hiam, chiangkhun hiam tawi sam kei un; nasemmi nek ding mu tak ahi.
"Huan kholian hi in khoneu hitaleh na lutna peuh uah nou hon tungsaktak mi zongkhia unla, na pawt nawn mateng uh huai inn ah tung den un.
A-inn ua na lut peuh chiang un, chibai buk un.
Huai inn a mite chibai buktak ahih ualeh atung uah na khamuanna uh atung dia; atak kei ualeh nou tung ah akhamuanna uh hong kik nawn ding hi.
Kuapeuh nou hon kipahpih lou a, na thu uh leng angaihkhiak keileh, huai inn a kipan leh huai khua a kipan na pawt chiang un, na khepek ua leivui tatkhia un.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in huai khua sang in Sodom leh Gomorrah gam thuak ding adan a-omzaw ding hi.
"Ngai dih ua, ngia lak a belam om bang in ka hon sawlkhia hi; gul bang a pil in, vakhu bang a poi khoih lou in om un.
Himahleh mihing lak ah pilvang un; vaihawmte ahon mansak ding uh; sinagogte a hon vuak ding ziak un.
Keimah ziak in gamukte leh kumpipate ma ah amaute leh Zentelte theihsakna ding in hon pi ding uhi.
Himahleh ahon matsak chiang un, bang chih ding ahia, bang thu ka gen dia? chi in lungkham kei un; ahuntak in na gen ding uh ahon theisak ding hi.
Agenpa noumau na hi kei ding ua, na Pa uh Kha in noumau ah agen zaw ding hi.
"Huan hihlup ding in unaupa leh unaupa akimansak ding ua, pa'n leng ata amansak ding; tate'n leng anu leh apate uh adou ding uh, ahihlumsak ding uh.
Ka min ziak in mi tengteng huat na hi ding ua; himahleh atawp pha a thuak ngap peuhmah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
Huchi in hiai khua ahon gawt chiang un, kho dang ah taisan un; chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Mihing Tapa hong pai ma in Israel gam a khopite na siksuak kei ding uhi.
"Nungzui aheutu tung ah a-om kei; sikha leng apu tung ah a-om kei hi.
Nungzui aheutu bang a a-om leh sikha apu bang a a-om ahun lel hi. Inn neipa bawn Beelzibul achih uleh, a-inkuanpihte nak chih na tel un chia!
"Huaiziak in amaute kihta kei un; lang lou ding a sel bangmah a-om kei, theih louh ding a iim bangmah a-om kei hi.
Mial a nou ka hon hilh vak ah na gen ding ua; bilbul ana zak uh intung a tuang in tangkoupih un.
Huan pumpi that a kha that theiloute kihta kei unla; Gehenna a kha leh pumpi hihmang theipa kihta zaw un.
Kawlgit nih dal dangka khat in azuak zel uh hilou hiam? Himahleh alak ua khat leng na Pa uh theih louh in lei ah ake kei ding hi.
Na samzangte uh nangawn leng sim vek ahi.
Huaiziak in lau kei un; kawlgit tampi sang in na manphazaw uhi.
"Huchi in mite ma a hon gum peuhmah, ka Pa van a om ma ah ka gum sam ding hi.
Himahleh kuapeuh mite ma a hon kitheihmohbawl, ka Pa van a om ma ah ka kitheihmohbawl sam ding.
"Leitung a lemna lengsak ding a hong pai hon sa kei un; lemna lengsak ding hilou in namsau lengsak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw.
Mi apa dousak ding in, tanu anu dousak ding in, mou anu dousak ding a hong pai ka hi.
Mi amelma amah inkuanpihte lak a mi mah ahi ding hi.
"Kuapeuh anu hiam, apa hiam, kei sang a itzaw tuh ka mi hi tak ahi kei; kuapeuh atanu hiam atapa hiam kei sang a itzaw leng, ka mi hi tak ahi kei.
Kuapeuh ama kros pua a hon zui lou ka mi hi tak ahi kei.
Kuapeuh ahinna mu in amansuah ding a, keimah ziak a ahinna mansuah in amu ding.
"Kuapeuh nou hon kipahpih in kei hon kipahpih ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih ahon sawlpa kipahpih ahi.
Zawlnei kuahiam, zawlnei ahih ziak a kipahpih in zawlnei pahtakman angah ding a; kuapeuh midiktat kuahiam midiktat ahih ziak a kipahpih in midiktat pahtakman angah ding hi.
Huan kuapeuh hiai mineuchikte lak a khat kiang a, nungzui ahih ziak a tuisik nou khat kia pia leng, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ama pahtakman amansuah kei hial ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n anungzui sawm-le-nihte thu apiak zoh in huai a pan in akhopite uah sinsak ding leh thugen ding in apaita uhi.
Johan in suangkul sung a Khrist thilhihte ana zak in anungzuite sawl in akiang ah,
"Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, ahihkeileh midang hungaih lai ding ka hi uhiam?" achisak hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pai nawnta unla, thil na muh uh leh na zak uh Johan kiang ah va hilh un;

mittawte amit uh ahong vakta, khebaite khe in ahong pai ua, phakte ahong siangthouta ua, nangongte leng abil uh ahong vakta, misite leng kaihthoh in a-omta ua; mizawngte'n leng tanchinhoih hilh adongta uhi.
Kuapeuh ka tung a lung hihlouhna mu lou ahampha hi," chi in adawng hi.
Huai mite apaitak un, Jesu'n mipite kiang ah Johan thu agenta hi, "Bang en ding a gamdai a paikhia na hi ua? Sialluang huih mut ling maw?
Ahihkeileh bang en ding pen a paikhia na hita ua? Puannem silh maw? Ngai un, puannem silhte zaw kumpipate inn ah ei ve a-om uh.
Ahihkeileh bangziak pentak in ahia na paikhiak uh? Zawlnei en ding in maw? Ahi tawk vo oi, ka hon chi ahi; zawlnei sang a leng thupizaw.
"En dih, na ma ah ka thangkou ka sawl ahi, ama'n na ma ah na lampite abawl ding chih atanchin agelh uh hiai mipa ahi.
"Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, numei suan lak ah baptispa Johan sang a thupizaw apiang kei; himahleh van-gam a mineupen amah sang in athupizaw hi.
Baptispa Johan om a kipan tutan in van-gam in hiamgamna atuak nak, hiamgamte'n thagum in ala uhi.
Zawlneite tengteng leh Dan thu in Johan ahong om tanpha in ana genkhol zel uhi.
Na pom nop uleh, huai zaw Elijah hong pai dingpa mah ahi.
Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei in za hen!
"Himahleh hiai khangte bang toh ka tehpih dia? Naupang dawr mun a tu a, alawmte sam a,
tamngai hon tumsak ung a, lam lou uchin a, kap huphup ung a, suun lou uchin a, chite bang ahi uh.
Johan ahong pai a, ne in adawn kei a, dawi zawl achi uhi.
Mihing Tapa ahong pai a, ne in adawn a, 'En dih ua, an haipa, uain haipa, siahkhonte leh mikhialte lawm,' achi uh. Hinapi in athilhih in pilna siam atan uh," achi hi.
Huan akisik louh ziak un, athil thupi hihtamna khopite atai hi.
"Korazin, na tung agik e; Bethsaida, na tung agik e; noumau a thil thupi kihihte Tura leh Sidon a hih hileh, sai-ip puan silh a vut lak a tu in akisikta ding uhi.
Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in nou thuak ding sang in Tura leh Sidon khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding hi.
Huan nang Kapernaum, van tan a tawisang na hi dia hia? Misikhua tan a paisuk ding na hita ve, nangmah a thil thupitak kihihte Sodom a hih hileh, tutan in a-om lai ding hi.
Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in na thuak ding sang in Sodom gam thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding," achi hi.
Huchih lai in Jesu'n ahoupih a, "Pa aw, leitung leh van Toupa, nang mipil leh mibengvakte kiang ah hiai thu na iim a, naungekte kiang a na theihsak ziak in ka hon phat hi.
Ahi, Pa, tua bang hih, nang ngaih in ahoih ahi.
Ka Pa'n thil bangkim hon kemsakta; Pa lou in kuamah in Tapa athei kei; Tapa leh akiang ua Tapa in akitheihsak utnate kia lou ngal in kuamah in Pa athei kei hi.
"Nou semgim leh puakgik po tengteng aw, ka kiang ah hong pai un, keima'n khawlna ka hon pe ding hi.
Ka hakkol pua unla, kei a kipan zil un; thunuailut leh lungtang kingainiamtak ka hi; huchi in na kha ua ding in khawlna na mu ding uh.
Ka hakkol puak anuam a, ka puakgik leng azang hi," achi hi.
Huchih lai in, Sabbath ni in buhlei kantan in Jesu apai hi. Nungzuite agilkial ua, nek ding in buhvuite akhiak uhi.
Pharisaite'n huai amuh un, akiang ah, "En dih, na nungzuite'n Sabbath ni in hihsiang lou ahih uh," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "David in agilkial lai a alawmte toh athilhih uh na sim kei ua hia?
Huchi a Pathian inn a alut a, amah leh alawmte'n nek siang louh, siampute kia nek siang tanghou koihtuam anek thu uh?
Ahihkeileh Sabbath ni in tempul a siampu omte'n Sabbath ni abohsiat un leng siamtang in a-om uh chih Dan thu na sim kei ua hia?
Huchi ahih ngalleh, tempul sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Himahleh 'kithoihna deih lou in, zahngaihna ka deih' chih a-omdan na thei hi le uchin, mi siamtangte siam louh tangsak lou ding hi ve uchin.
Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath' Toupa ahi," achi hi.
Huan huai a kipan apai a, asinagogte uah ava lut hi.
Ngai dih, mi khat khutzaw ana om a, amah ahektheihna ding un, "Sabbath ni a hihdam asiang hia?" chi in Jesu adong uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Noute lak ah kuapeuh in belam khat nei unla, Sabbath ni in kokhuk ah ke taleh kua ahia len a kaikhe lou ding?
Belam khat sang in mihing khat bangchi lel a manphazaw ahia? Huaiziak in Sabbath ni in hihhoih asiang hi,” achi hi.
Huai zoh in, huai mi kiang ah, "Na khut zan in," achi a, huchi in azan a, alangkhat bang in adamsiangta hi.
Pharisaite bel apawt ua, amah ahihlup theihdan ding uh ngaihtuah in akihou uhi.
Jesu'n huai thu atheih in huai mun a kipan in akihemmang hi. Himahleh mi tampi in amah azui ua, adamloute uh ana hihdam vek hi.
Atanchin genthang het lou ding in akiang uah achi hi.
Huai zawlnei Isai thugenkholh tangtunna ding ahi zaw hi;
"En dih, ka sikha ka tel, ka deihtak, ka lungsim in apahtak mahmah, atung ah ka Kha ka koih dia, huchi in Zentelte kiang ah dik a vaihawmna apuangkhe ding hi;
Asel kei ding a, akikou sam kei ding, kongzing ah kuamah in a-aw aza kei ding uh.
Dik a vaihawmna avualzohsak mateng sialluang kigawpsa ahihtankhe kei ding a, meivak kuang liakliak ahihmit sam kei ding hi.
Amah min ah Zentelte'n lametna angah ding uh," achi hi.
Huchih lai in dawimat mittaw pau thei lou khat akiang ah hon pi ua; ama'n ahihdam a, pau thei lou hong pau in, ahon mutheita hi.
Huchi in mipi tengteng in lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Hiai mipa, David Tapa hilou ahi maw?" achi uhi.
Himahleh Pharisaite'n huai azak phet un, "Hiai mi'n dawite kumpipa, Beelzibul ziak lou in dawite adelhkhe kei ding," achi uhi.
Jesu'n amaute ngaihtuahte athei a, akiang uah, "Koi gam leng amah kidou amangthang nak; koi khua hiam, inkuan khat leng amah kidou, akhosuak kei ding hi.
Setan in Setan mah adelhkhiak in amah-le-amah kidou hi ding ahi a; agam bangchi in adingh dia le?
Huan kei Beelzibul ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh, na tate un kua ziak in ahia adelhkhiak uh? Huaiziak in amaute noute tung a thukhen mite ahi ding uhi.
Himahleh, ke'n Pathian Kha ziak a dawite delhkhia ka na hihleh, Pathian lalgam na kiang uah hong tungta ahi ding hi.
"Huchi ahih kei ngal in, mi'n mihat agak masak phot keileh bangchi in ahia mihat inn alut a, asum alaksak theih ding? Huai nung in a-inn alok mai ding hi.
"Kuapeuh kei lam a pang lou, hon dou ahi; kuapeuh hon lakkhawmpih lou in athehzak ahi.
Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi akhelhna chiteng uah leh Pathian agensiatna chiteng uh ngaihdam ahi ding ua; Kha hilhial agensiatna ngaihdamsak ahi kei ding hi.
Kuapeuh Mihing Tapa kalh, akalhna uh ngaihdamsak ahi ding; kuapeuh Kha Siangthou hilhial kalh zaw huai akalhna uh, tu damsung leh hun hong tung ding ah leng, ngaihdam ahi kei ding," achi hi.
"Sing hoih agah leng ahoih na chih kei ngal uleh, sing sia agah leng asia, chi vanglak un; sing agah a akitheih ziak in.
Nou gul suante aw, nou gilou napi in bangchi in ahia thuhoih na gen theih ding uh? Lungtang a dim val kam in agen zel hi.
Mihoih in agoubawm hoih a kipan thil hoihte alakhia a, migilou in agoubawm hoih lou a kipan thil hoih lou alakhe zel hi.
"Huan ka hon hilh ahi. Mite'n thugina lou agen peuhmah uh huai thu tanchin mah vaihawm ni chiang in agen ding uhi.
Na thu in siam ahon tangsak ding a, na thu mah in siam louh ahon tangsak ding hi," achi hi.
Huai lai in laigelhmite leh Pharisaite lak a mi kuate hiam in amah ahoupih ua akiang ah, "Heutupa, nang a kipan chiamtehna muh ka ut uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Khang gilou leh angkawmte'n chiamtehna azong ua, himahleh zawlnei Jonah chiamtehna lou ngal akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding hi.
Ngapi gilsung a Jonah ni thum leh zan thum a-om bang in, Mihing Tapa ni thum leh zan thum lei gilsung ah a-om sam ding hi.
Nineveh khomite thukhen ni chiang in hiai khangte kiang ah adingh sam ding ua, siam louh atangsak ding uh. Jonah thugen ziak in akisik ua; ngai dih ua, Jonah sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.

Thukhen ni chiang in hiai khangte kiang ah simlam kumpinu athou ding a, siam louh atangsak ding hi, Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in kawlmong a kipan ahong pai ngal a; ngai dih ua, hiai ah Solomon sang a thupizawa-om hi!
"Huan mihing sung a kipan a dawi nin pawt in, khawlna zong in tui omlouhna mun ah avakvak a, amu kei hi.
Huan 'ka pawtna inn mah ah ka kik nawn mai ding,' achi a; ava tunleh ahawm a zephoihsa in ava mu hi.

Huaitak in ava pai a, amah sang a gilouzaw dawi dang sagih ahon pi a, huai mi sung ah alut ua, atengta uhi; huai mihing omdan nanung amasa sang in ahong hoih kei zaw hi. Tua bang mah in, hiai khang giloutakte tung ah ahong om ding," chi in adawng hi.
Mipite kiang a thu agen lai in ngai dih, amah houpih tum in inpua ah anu leh a-unaute adingh uhi.
Mi khat in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, na nu leh na unaute nang hon houpih tum in inpua ah adingh nilouh uh," achi hi.
Ama'n ahilhpa kiang ah, "Ka nu kua ahia? Ka unaute leng kuate ahi ua?" chi in adawng hi.
Huan nungzuite lam a akhut zan in, "En un, ka nu leh ka unaute;
kuapeuh ka Pa van a om deihlam hih phot ka unaupa leh ka unaunu leh ka nu ahi uh," achi hi.
Huai ni'n inn a kipan Jesu pakhia a, tuipi gei ah atu hi.
Huan akiang ah mipi tampitak ahong kikhawm ua, huchi in long ah atuang a, atu a, mipi tengteng piautak ah adingh uhi.
Gentehna in thu tampi akiang uah agen hi, "Ngai dih ua, buhchithehpa buhchi theh in akuan hi.
Buhchi atheh lai in akhen lamsik ah akia a, vasate'n ane zou uhi.
Akhen suangsilei lak ah akia a, lei asah louh ziak in hong pou pah hi.
Himahleh ni asuah in haivuai in a-om a; zung aneih louh ziak in avuai maimah hi.
Huan akhen loulingnei lak ah akia a, loupa hong pousang a; adepmangta hi.
Akhen lei hoih ah akia a, khenkhat aleh za, khenkhat aleh sawmguk, khenkhatte aleh sawmthum in hong gah uhi.
Kuapeuh bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
Huan nungzuite ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Bangziak a gentehna a thu gen na hia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n adawng a akiang uah, "Van lalgam thuguk noute theih phal ahi a, amau theih zaw phal ahi kei hi.
Kuapeuh anei piak behlap ahi ding a, ahau ding; kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak ahi ding hi.
Huchi ahih ziak in akiang uah gentehna in thu ka gen ahi; 'mu napi in amu kei nak ua, za napi in atheisiam kei nak uh.'
Isai thugenkholh atung uah atung hi; 'Bil in zaw na za ding ua, theih bel na theisiam kei ding uh; muh zaw na mu ding ua, theih bel na thei kei ding uh.

Hiai chite lungtang ananggawpta, abilte uh angong a, amitsi ua, huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza kha ding ua, alungtang un atheisiam ding ua, ahong kik nawn kha ding ua, amau ka na hihdam kha ding,' ana chi hi.
"Nou mitte zaw ahampha hi, amuh ziak in; na bil uh leng ahampha hi, azak ziak in.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, zawlnei tampi leh midiktat tampi'n leng na thil muhte uh muh a-ut ua, himahleh amu kei uh; na thilzakte uh zak a-ut ua, himahleh aza kei uhi.
"Huaiziak in buhchithehpa gentehna thu za un.
Kuapeuh in lalgam thu bil a azak a, atheihsiam keileh migilou hong pai in, alungtang a thehsa alaksak nak hi. Huai tuh lamsik a theh ahi.
Suangsilei a theh bel, thu za a kipaktak a pom bang ahi.
Himahleh amah ah zung a-om kei a, sawt louchik kia a-om a, thu ziak a gimthuakna leh sawina ahong omtak in apuk pah hi.
Huan loulingnei lak a thehte tuh thu za a, himahleh khovel awlmohna leh hauhsakna khemna in thu adep a, gah lou in ahong om hi.
Huan lei hoih tung a theh tuh thu bil a za a, theisiam ahi; huai tuh agah ngei a, khenkhat aleh za, khenkhat aleh sawmguk, khenkhat aleh sawmthum in apung," achi hi.
Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh mi alou a chi hoih thehpa toh teh ahi.
Himahleh mi a-ihmut kal in melma ahong pai a, buhlak ah buhlem atheh a, apaimang nawnta hi.
Huan buh hong pou a, ahong vuih in, buhlem leng ahong kilang sam hi.
Huchi in inn neipa sikhate ahong pai ua, akiang ah, Pu, na lou a chi hoih theh lou na hi maw? Buhlemte koi a kipan a hong om ahia? achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, melma in na theh ahi ve," achi hi. Sikhate'n akiang ah ahihleh huaite va lakhawm le ung hoih na sa hia? achi uhi.
Ama'n bel, "sa lou e, buhlem na lakkhawmna lam uah buhtak na botkhawm kha ding uh.
Buh lak dong in poukhawm uheh; buhlak hun chiang in buh atte kiang ah, buhlem lakhawm masa phot unla, hal ding in lomgak un; buhtak pen bel ka buh inn ah seklut un, ka chi ding," achi hi.
Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh mi'n ankam chi tang khat alak a, alou a atheh bang ahi.
Huai chi laklak ah aneupen a; himahleh ahong pousang chiang in loupa lak ah alianpen a, sing hong hi a, huchi in tungleng vasate ahong pai ua, ahiang ah agiak uh," achi hi.
Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh numei in silngou anbuang tehna thum lak a abilh a, avek a athoh mateng aphum bang ahi," achi hi.
Jesu'n mipite kiang ah gentehna in huai tengteng agen a, gentehna lou in akiang uah bangmah agen kei hi.
Zawlnei in, "Gentehna in ka kam ka ka ding a, leilung pian tung a kipat thil kisel ka genkhe ding," chi a agen ahong tuntheihna ding in.
Huai lai in mipite apaisan a, inn ah alut a, nungzuite akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Lou a buhlem gentehna thu hon hilhchian in," achi uhi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Chi hoih thehpa Mihing Tapa ahi a; lou bel khovel ahi.
Chi hoihte gam tate ahi ua; buhlemte migilou tate ahi.
Melma buhlem thehpa diabol ahi a, buhlak hun khovel tawpna ding ahi; a-atte angelte ahi uhi.
Huchi in buhlemte alakhawm ua mei a ahal bang un khovel tawpna ah a-om ding hi.
Mihing Tapa in angelte asawlkhe ding a, gam a kipan hihkhialsakte leh thil hihkhialte tengteng akhawmkhe ding uh.
Amaute haltuina mei ah apai ding ua, huai lai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding hi.
Huai hun chiang in midiktatte a Pa uh gam ah ni bang in atang ding uhi. Zakna ding a bil nei peuh in za hen!
"Van lalgam tuh lou a gou phumguk bang ahi; mi'n huai mu in, asel nawn a, akipah ziak in aneih tengteng azuak a, huai lou aleita hi.
"Huan van-gam tuh sumsinmi tuikepsuang hoihtak zongmi bang ahi nawn hi.
Huan ama'n tuikepsuang manphatak khat amu a, aneih tengteng zuak in aleita hi.
"Van lalgam tuh lenpi, tuipi a paih, chi chih tunkhawmna bang ahi nawn hi.
Adimtak in agei ah akaikhia ua, atu ua, bawm ah ahoih teng alakhawm ua, ahoihloute apaih uh bang ahi.
Khovel tawp hun chiang in huchibang mah in a-om ding, angelte ahong pawt ding ua, midiktatte lak ah migiloute akhenkhe ding uh.
Huchi in haltuina mei ah apai ding ua, huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding," achi hi.
Jesu mah in akiang uah, "Huai tengteng na theisiam uhia?" achi a, amau akiang ah, "Thei e,” achi uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huaiziak in laigelhmi van-gam thuhilh a om peuhmah, inn neipa, agoubawm a kipan a thil thakte leh thil luite pholhkhepa bang ahi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai gentehnate agen khit in huai a kipan apaita hi.
A-omna kholam atung a, asinagogte uah amaute thu ahilh a, huchi in lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Hiai mi'n koi a kipan a hiai bang pilna leh hiai nasep thupi hihtheihnate amuh ahia?
Hiai mi singlem bawlpa tapa hilou hia? Anu Mari kichi hilou hia? A-unaute Jakob, Joseph, Simon, Judas kichite hilou uhia?
Hiai mi in koi a kipan a hiaite tengteng mu ahia? Asanggamnute leng i kiang ua om vek hilou uhia?" achi uhi.
Huchi in atung ah alungkim kei uhi. Himahleh Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zawlnei ama kholam leh ama inn lam lou ngal ah pahtawi louh in a-om ngei kei," achi hi.
Agin louh ziak un huai ah nasep thupi dang tam ahih kei hi.
Huai laitak in kumpipa Herod in Jesu tanchin ana za hi.
Asikhate kiang ah thu agen a, "Hiai Baptispa Johan ahi; misi lak a kipan thounawn ahi; huaiziak in huai thilhihtheihnate'n amah a sem ahi," achi hi.
Herod in a-unau Philip zi, Herodias ziak in Johan aman a, ahen a, suangkul ah ana khum hi.
Johan in akiang ah amah na neih asiang kei, achih ziak in.
Johan hihlup ut mahleh mipi akihta a, zawlnei hi a apom ziak un.
Himahleh Herod pian ni ahong tun in alai ah Herodias tanu alam a, Herod akipaksak hi.
Huai phet in anget peuhmah pe ding in thu akichiam hi.
Ama'n anu' thuhilh bang in, "Hiai kuang ah Baptispa Johan lutang hon pia in," achi hi.
Kumpipa alungkhamta a, himahleh athuchiamte leh a-ankuang umpihte ziak in piak ding thu apia hi.
Huchi in mi asawl a, Johan lutang atansak hi.
Huan kuang in alutang ahon la ua, numei naupang kiang ah apia ua, ama'n anu kiang ah apaipihta hi.
Johan nungzuite'n aluang hong la ua, avui ua, huchi in Jesu ava hilh uhi.
Jesu'n huai thu azak in, hiai a kipan long in gamkeu lam ah apaituamta hi. Himahleh mipi'n azaktak un khua a kipan khe a pai in azuita uhi.
Huchi in amah ahong paikhiakleh mipi tampitak amu a, ahehpih mahmah a, adamloute uh ahihdamsak hi.
Nitaklam ahong hih in, nungzuite akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Hiai mun gamkeu ahi a, ni akaita a, mipite khuate apai a, amau a ding nek ding aleitheihna ding un paisakta in," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Apaimang uh akiphamoh kei, noumau nek ding pia un," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Hiai ah tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih kia i nei uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Huaite ka kiang ah hon la un," achi hi.

Huchi in loupa tung a tu ding in mipite thu apia a, tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nihte ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, abalkham a, nungzuite kiang ah tanghoute apia a, mipite kiang ah nungzuite'n apesawn uhi.
Huan avek un ane ua, avah chiatta ua; akhamval uh bawmpi sawm-le-nih dim angah uhi.
Anete numei leh naupang sim louh in, piching ngen sangnga vel ahi uh.
Huan mipite asawlmang khit in apai ma a gal khat na pai masa ding in nungzuite long ah atuangsak teitei hi.
Mipite apaimang nung un thum ding in tang ah atuam in apaitou a, nitaklam ahong hih in huai ah amah kia in a-omta hi.
Tuipi laitak ah long a-omta a; huih in ahilou lam a asawn ziak in tuikihot in asepta hi.
Zanven lina ah tuipi tung a khe a Jesu pai a, akiang lam uh hon zuan in amu uhi.
Nungzuite'n amah tuipi tung a khe apai amuh un, "Sikha ahi," chi in abuai ua, lau in akikouta uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n amaute ahoupih pah a, "Khamuangtak in om un, keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
Peter in adawng a, "Toupa, nang na hihleh tui tung ah nang kiang a hong pai thu hon pia in," achi hi.
Huan ama'n, "Hong pai ve,” achi a, long a kipan Peter akum a, Jesu kiang zuan in tui tung ah khe in apaita hi.
Himahleh huih nung amuh in alau a, tum ding in akisa a, "Toupa, hon hondam in," chi in akikou hi.
Jesu'n asawk pah a, amah alen a, akiang ah, "Nang gintawm, bangziak a ginglah na hia?" achi hi.
Huan long a atuan uleh huih adaita hi.
Long a omte'n, "Pathian Tapa na hi taktak hi," chi in amah abia uhi.
Huan gal khat lam akai uleh, Gennesaret gam ahong tung uhi.
Huai mun a mite'n amah atheihtak un, huai kim gam tengteng ah mi asawl ua, damlou tengteng akiang ah ahon pi ua;
Apuan mong bek khoih theih angen ngutngut ua; huan akhoih peuhmah adam zel uhi.
Huai khit in Jesu kiang ah Jerusalem a kipan Pharisaite leh laigelhmite ahong pai ua,
"Bangziak a upate thugousiah a na nungzuite talek nak uh ahia? Tanghou anek chiang un akhut uh asil ngei kei uh," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Nou leng bangziak a na thugousiah ziak ua Pathian thupiak a talek na hi ua?
Pathian in, 'Na nu leh na pa zahtak in, kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam gensia si ngeingei heh' achi hi.
Nou bel, 'kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam kiang a, na hon zatna ding Pathian kiang a piak ahih peuhmah chiang in,
anu leh apa azah ding ahi nawn kei,' na chi uhi. Huchi in na thugousiah ziak un Pathian thu bangmah lou na suah uhi.
Nou lepchiahte, Isai in na tungtang thu uh ana genkhol dik mahmah hi;
"Hiai mite'n akam un ahon zah ua, amuk un ahon phat ua, himahleh alungtang un ahon gamlat uh.
Himahleh, athuhilhna ua mihing thupiak ahilh ziak un ahon biak uh athawn mai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
Huan mipi asam a akiang uah, "Ngaikhia unla, theisiam un;
kam a lut in mihing ahihnin kei a; himahleh kam a pawt, huai ngei in mihing ahihnin zaw hi,” achi hi.
Huai lai in anungzuite ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Pharisaite'n huai thu azak ua alungkimlouhdan uh na thei hia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Kung tengteng ka Pa van a om suan louh bohkhiak in a-om ding.
Amaute awlmoh kei un; mittaw makai ahi uh; huchi in mittaw in mittaw mah apileh kokhuk ah akekhawm ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Huai gentehna thu hon hilhchian in," chi in adong hi.
Ama'n, "Tutan a nou leng thei nai lou lai na hi uh maw?
Kam a lut peuhmah gil ah alutsuk a, dailenna ah paihkhiak in a-om chih na thei kei ua hia?
Kam a pawtte bel lungtang a kipan a hong pawt ahi ua; huaite ngeingei in mihing ahihnin nak hi.
Lungtang a kipan ngaihtuahna giloute, tualthahna, angkawmna, kingaihna, guktakna, hekna, gensiatna ahong pawt nak hi.
Huaite ahi mihing hihnin; khut sil lou a an nek in mi ahihnin kei,” achi hi.
Jesu hiai a kipan pawt in Tura leh Sidon uk ah apaita hi.
Huan ngai dih, huai gam a kipan Kanaan numei khat ahong pai a, "Toupa, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in, ka tanu dawi in lungkhamhuaipi in ama'n," chi in akikou hi.
Ama'n bel kam khat in leng adawng kei hi. Anungzuite'n, "I nung ah akikoukou a, paisak mai in," chi in hong gen uhi.
Ama'n bel, "Israel inkote nam lak a belam mangte kiang lou ngal ah sawl ka hi kei," chi in adawng hi.
Himahleh numei ahong pai a, "Toupa hon huh in," chi in abia hi.
Huan ama'n, "Tate tanghou laksak a, uite kiang a paih akilawm kei," chi in adawng hi.
Numei in, "Toupa, hih zaw ahi tham hi; himahleh, uite'n leng apu uh dohkan a kipan a tanghou nen kia ane zel sam ve ua oi," achi hi.
Huaitak in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, na ginna thupi na tel e; na deih bangtak in na tung ah om hen," chi in adawng a, huchi in atanu huai hun ngei in adamta hi.
Huai a kipan Jesu apai a, Galili tuipi kiang ahong tung a; tang ah apaitou a, huai ah atu hi.
Huchi in akiang ah mipi tampi ahong ua, khebaite, mittawte, pau theiloute, piangsualte leh midang tampi ahon pi ua, ama'n amaute ana hihdam chiat hi.
Mipite'n pau theiloute hong pau a, piangsualte hong hoih a, khebaite khe a pai a, mittawte'n hon mutheita uh chih amuh un lamdang asa mahmah ua; huchi in Israel' Pathian aphatta uhi.

Huchi in Jesu'n anungzuite asam a, "Ka kiang ah mipite ni thum a-omta ua, nek ding bangmah aneih louh ziak un, ka lainat mahmah; an ngawl in ka paikiksak ut kei hi, huchi lou in zaw lamkal ah abahsegawp kha ding uh," achi hi.
Nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Mipi hiai zahzah vahna khop tanghou huai zahzah gamdai ah koi a kipan i mu dia?" achi uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua? achi hi. Amau akiang ah, phel sagih leh nga neu tawmchik toh," achi uhi.
Huan ama'n lei a tu ding in mipite thu apia a,
huan tanghou phel sagih leh ngate ala a, kipahthu gen in, abalkham a, nungzuite kiang ah apia a, huchi in nungzuite'n mipite kiang ah apesawn uhi.
Huan avek un ane ua, avah chiatta ua; akhamval nen uh bawmpi sagih adim hi.
Anete tuh numei leh naupang sim louh in, piching ngen sangli ahi uh.
Huan mipite asawlmang nung in long ah Jesu atuang a, Magadan gam atung hi.
Huai zoh in Pharisaite leh Saddukaite ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in van a kipan chiamtehna amaute ensak ding in angen uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nitaklam ahong hih in, khua apha dia ahi ding e, meisan asuak a, na chi nak uh.
Huan zingsang in, tuni'n khua se dia ahi ding e, meisan asuak a, aniamkai, na chi nak uh. 'Van omdan na theisiam ngal ua, himahleh, hun chiamtehnate na theisiam thei kei uhi.'
Khang gilou leh angkawmte'n chiamtehna azong ua, himahleh, Jonah chiamtehna lou ngal akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding," chi in adawng hi. Huan amaute paisan in apawtkheta hi.
Huan nungzuite gal khat lam atun un tanghou apo mangngilh ua,
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pharisaite leh Saddukaite silngou lak ah kiveng unla, pilvang un," achi hi.
Amau, "Tanghou i puak louh ziak uh ei ve," chi in akingaihtuah uhi.
Jesu'n huai athei a, "Nou ginglahte aw, bang achia tanghou na neih louh ziak ua kingaihtuah maimah na hi ua?
Tu nangawn in na lungsim un na thei nai kei lailai uh maw? Mi sangnga nek tanghou phel nga leh akhamval uh bawmpi bangzah na dimsak zah uh na theigige kei ua hia?
Mi sangli nek tanghou phel sagih leh akhamval uh bawmpi bangzah hiam na luahdim uh chih thei lou uh maw?
Tanghou thu na kiang ua gen lou in, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite silngou a pan pilvang un, chih gen ka hi zaw chih bang achia thei lou na hi ua?" achi hi.
Huaitak in tanghou silngou lak a pilvang ding in asawl kei a, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite thuhilhna a pan pilvang ding in amau asawl zaw chih atheita uhi.
Kaisaria uk a Philippi mun ahong tun in Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite'n Mihing Tapa kua ahi achi ua?" chi in adong hi.
Amau, "Khenkhat in Baptispa Johan ahi, achi ua; khenkhat in Elijah; khenkhat in Jeremiah hiam zawlnei kuahiam ahi," achi uh, achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" achi hi.
Simon Peter in, "Khrist Pathian Hing Tapa na hi," chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, Bar Jonah, hampha chia; sa leh sisan in hon theihsak na hi kei a, ka Pa van a om hon theihsak na hi zaw hi.
K'on hilh ahi, nang Peter na hi, hiai suangpi tung ah ka saptuam ka lamtou ding a, misi khokulh kongkhakte'n hiai azou kei ding uh.
Van lalgam chabite ka hon pe ding a, leitung ah bangpeuh na hen van ah leng hen ahi ding a, leitung ah bangpeuh na phel van ah leng phel ahi ding,” achi hi.
Huai zoh in Khrist ahi chih kuamah hilh lou ding in nungzuite achi bikbek hi.

Huai nung in Jerusalem a apai ding dan, upate, siampu liante, laigelhmite a pan thil tampi athuakdan ding leh hihlup a a-omdan ding, ni thum ni a kaihthoh a a-omdan ding Jesu'n anungzuite atheisak panta hi.
Huai phet in Peter in amah apituam a, "Toupa, hi kei hen! Huaite na tung ah tung ngei kei hen!" chi in ataihilh hi.
Jesu akihei a, Peter kiang ah, "Setan, ka nung ah pai in, kei a di'n pukna na hi; Pathian thilte ngaihtuah lou in mihing thilte na ngaihtuah zaw hi," achi hi.
Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuihnopleh amah kimangngilh in, ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding a; kuapeuh keimah ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
Mi'n khovel apumpi in nei henla, ahinna tanleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia? Ahihkeileh mi'n ahinna sik in bang ape thei dia?
"Mihing Tapa a-angelte toh, a Pa thupina a kizem a ahong pai ding ziak in. Huai hun chiang in michih anasep bang un adin chiat ding hi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon chi ahi, hiai adingh akhente, agam a Mihing Tapa hong pai amuh masiah uh, sihna chiam lou hial ding a-om uh," achi hi.
Huan ni guk nung in Jesu'n atuam in tang sangtak ah Peter, Jakob leh a-unau Johan apaitouhpih hi.
Huan ama uah amel omdan ahong lamdangta a; amai ni bang in ahong tang a, apuansilhte vuk bang in ahong ngouta hi.
Huan ngai dih, Mosi leh Elijah, amah kihoupih in akiang uah akilak uhi.
Huan Peter in Jesu ahoupih a, "Toupa, ei a di'n hiai a om ahoih, na utleh hiai ah aidakbuk thum ka bawl ding a; nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat,” achi hi.
Agen laitak in, mei ngoutak in amaute aliahta a; ngai dih, mei a kipan aw in, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi; amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
Huan nungzuite'n huai azak un bokkhup in apuk ua, alau mahmah uhi.
Jesu'n amaute ahong khoih a, "Thou unla, lau kei un,” achi hi.
Huan adakkhia ua, Jesu kia lou ngal kuamah amuta kei uhi.
Huan tang a kipan akum lai un, Jesu'n akiang uah, "Misi lak a kipan Mihing Tapa athohnawn masiah na thil muh uh kuamah hilh kei un," chi in thu apia hi.
Huan anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Laigelhmite'n Elijah hong pai masa ding ahi, bangchidan a chi ahi ua?" chi in adong uhi.
Ama'n, "Elijah ahong pai ding him ahi a, bangkim asiam hoih ding hi.
Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Elijah zaw ahong pai khinta, amah athei kei ua, atung ah a-utut un ahihzawta uhi. Huchi mah bang in Mihing Tapa in leng alak uah athuak sam ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huaitak in, nungzuite'n akiang ua Baptispa Johan thu gen ahi chih atheita uhi.
Huan mipi kiang ahong tun un mi khat akiang ah ahong pai a, ama a khukdin in,
"Toupa ka tapa tung ah zahngai in, amah phungzawl vei ahi a, anak thuak tel mai; tamveipi mei ah apuklut a, tamveipi tui ah leng apuk nak hi.
Na nungzuite kiang ah ka hon pi a, ahihdam thei kei uh," achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Ginna nei lou leh khang genhakte aw, bang tan ahia ka hon thuakzoh ding, amah ka kiang ah hon pi un," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jesu'n dawi atai a, asung a kipan apawt a; huai dak in naupang adamta hi.
Huai zoh in, atuam in Jesu kiang ah nungzuite ahong pai ua, "Bang achia kou delhkhe thei lou ka hi ua?" achi uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Na gintak louh ziak un ahi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ankam tang khat bang ginna na neih uleh, hiai tang kiang ah, 'Hiai a kipan huai a pam ah va kisuan in,' na chi ding ua, akisuan mai ding; nou a ding in hihtheih louh bangmah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
Akoi abang hitaleh, hichibang zaw thumna leh an ngawlna lou ngal in apaikhe kei ding hi.
Galili gam a a-om lai un Jesu'n akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa zaw mihingte khut ah matsak in a-om ding a, athat ding ua;
ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding hi," achi a, huchi in alungkham mahmah uhi.
Kapernaum khua ahong tun un, Peter kiang ah sumkhonte ahong pai ua, "Na pu un siah pe zel lou hia?" achi uhi.

Ama'n, "Pe zel e,” achi hi. Huan insung a ava lut in, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, bangchi in na ngai a? Lei a kumpipate'n siah leh leiman sumte kua a pan ahia alak zel uh? Atate ua pan hia, mituam a pan?" chi in ana gentuh hi.
Peter in, "Mituam a pan," achihtak in, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Huchi ahihleh tate awl uh ahi mai vo oi.

Himahleh nang tuipi ah va hoh inla, ngakuai diah inla, nga hong suak masapen man in, akam kek lechin dangka nih na mu ding; huaite la inla kei leh nang a ding in akiang uah pia in, huchi lou in zaw amaute i hihlungkim kei kha ding," achi hi.
Huai laitak in Jesu kiang ah hungzuite ahong pai ua, “Van lalgam ah kua athupipen dia?" achi uhi.
Huan ama'n naupang neuchik asam a; alak uah adingsak hi.
"Chihtaktak in ka hon chi ahi, na lamdan ua, naupang neuchik bang na hong hih kei uleh, van-gam ah na lut kei hial ding uh.
Huchi in kuapeuh hiai naupang neuchik bang a kingainiam, huai mi van-gam ah athupipen ding," achi hi.
Huan kuapeuh ka min ziak a hichibang naupang neuchik khat kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi.
"Himahleh hiai hon gingta neuchikte lak a khat leng hihpuk, angawng ah buh gawizanna suang lianpi oksak in tuipi thuk lai ah khemang le uh, amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
Puknate ziak in khovel tung agik hi, puknate bel om ding him ahi a; himahleh pukna omsakpa tung agik hi!

"Huan na khut hiam na khe hiam in hon hihpukleh, tankhia inla, paimang in; khut nih leh khe nih nei a tangtawn mei a paih a na om sang in, piangsual hiam khebai hiam a hinna a lut nang ding in ahoihzaw hi.
Huan na mit in hon hihpukleh khelkhia inla, paimang in; mit langnih nei a Gehenna mei a paih a om sang in, mit langkhat nei a hinna a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
"Hiai mineute lak a khat leng simmoh lou ding in pilvang un, a-angelte un van ah ka Pa van a om mel a-en gige uh chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Mihing Tapa mangthangte zong ding a hong pai ahi him hi.
"Bangchi na sa ua? Mi kuapeuh in belam za nei henla, alak ua khat vakmang taleh sawmkua-le-kuate nusia in, tang a pai in, amang pen azong kei dia hia?
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amuh nawn zenzenleh sawmkua-le-kua vakmangloute tung ah sang in, tua belam tung ah akipak zaw ding hi.
Huchi mah bang in hiai mineute lak a khat manthat na Pa uh van a om deihlam ahi kei hi.
"Huan na unau in na tung a thil ahihkhelhleh pai inla, amah leh nang kia theih in akhelhna hilh in; ahon ngaihkhiakleh na unau zou na hi ding.
Ahon ngaihkhiak keileh midang khat hiam nih hiam na kiang ah na pi dia, huchi in thu chiteng theihpihmi nih hiam thum hiam kam a hihkip a a-omtheihna ding in.
Huan amau leng angaihkhiak nop kei laileh, saptuamte kiang ah tun in. Huan saptuamte leng angaihkhiak nop keileh amah tuh nang ding in Zentel leh siahkhonmi bang hi hen.
"Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, leitung ah bangpeuh na hen uh, van ah hen ahi ding. Huan leitung a na phel uh, van ah leng phel ahi ding hi.
"Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh nawn hi. Leitung ah na lak ua mi nih athilnget ua akithutuah uleh, ka Pa van a om hihsak in a-om ding uh.
Mi nih hiam thum hiam ka min a akikhopna peuh uah alak uah ka om zel hi," achi hi.
Huai lai in Peter ahong pai a, "Toupa, ka unau in bangzah vei ahia ka tung ah hihkhialleh ka ngaihdam ding? Sagihvei tan in ahi diam?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sagihvei tan ka hon chi kei a, sagihvei mun sawmsagih tan," ka hon chi zaw ahi.
"Huaiziak in van-gam tuh kuahiam asikhate kiang a asum thu saifel tum toh tehpih ahi.
Huchi a sum thu hon sai pattak in, mi khat talent singkhat ba akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
Huan piak ding aneih louh ziak in, apu in amah toh, azi toh, atate toh, aneih tengteng toh zuak a dit ding thu apia hi.
Huchi in sikha in Toupa, 'ka tung ah zahngai tadih inla, avek in ka hon pe ding, chi in bokkhup in abia hi.'
Huai sikhapa pu'n ahehpih mahmah a, akhah a, abat angaidamta hi.
"Himahleh huai sikha apaikhia a, asikha hihpihte lak a khat amakhai zakhat ba ava mu a; amah aman a, na bat hon pia in, chi in agawlmek hi.
Huchi in asikha hihpihpa'n bokkhup in, ka tung ah zahngai tadih inla, ka hon pe ding, chi in angen ngutngut hi.
Himahleh a-ut kei a; abat apiak zoh masiah suangkul ah akhumta hi.
Huchi in asikha hihpihte'n athilhih amuh un, poi asa mahmah ua, athilhih tengteng atoupa uh ahilhta uhi.
Huaitak in atoupa'n amah asam a, akiang ah, sikha gilou, na hon nget ngutngut ziak a, na bat tengteng hon ngaidam ing a;
k'on hehpih bang in nang leng na sikha hihpih na hehpih sam ding hilou hia? achi hi.
Huchi in atoupa athangpaita a, abat tengteng apiak zoh masiah migawtte kiang ah apeta hi.
Michih in na lungtangtak ua na unaute uh na ngaihdam kei uleh ka Pa van a om in leng huchi mah bang in na tung uah ahih sam ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thute agen zoh in, Galili gam a kipan apawt a, Jordan lui gal Judia gam ah ahoh hi.
Mipi thupitak in azui ua; amaute ahihdam zel hi.
Huan Pharisaite akiang ah ahong ua, amah ze-etna ding in, "Bangziak peuh in mi'n azi mak asiang hia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Atung a kipan amau bawlpa'n numei leh pasal abawlleh,
hiai ziak in pasal in anu leh apa apaisan ding a, azi alen ding.

Huchi in anih un sapum khat ahong hita ding uh, achi chih na sim kei ua hia? Huchi in nih ahita kei ua, sapum khat ahi zawta uhi. Huaiziak in Pathian in agawmsa mihing in khen kei hen," chi in adawng hi.
Amau bel akiang ah, "Ahihleh, bangziak a Mosi in kimakna laipiak a mak ding chi a thu pia ahia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Mosi in na lungtang uh khauh ziak in ei ve na zite uh mak aphal; himahleh atung a kipan huchibang ahi ngei kei hi.
Ke'n zaw ka hon chi ahi, kuapeuh kingaihna ziak hilou a, zi ma a midang nei angkawm ahi; maksa nei peuhmah leng angkawm ahi," achi hi.
Nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Azi lam thu a pasal huchibang ahihleh kiten louh ahoihzaw," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Huai thu ahihleh, apiaknate kia lou ngal, mi napeuh in apom thei kei ding uh.

Michilgeh, anu gilsung ua kipan huchibang a piang himte a-om ua; michilgeh, mihing khut a gehte leng a-om sam ua; michilgeh van-gam ziak a chilgeh a kibawltawmte leng a-om sam uhi. Kuapeuh apom thei in pom hen," achi hi.
Huai lai in atung ua akhut koih a, athumsak ding in, akiang ah naupang neute ahon pi ua; nungzuite'n ana tai uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un; van-gam hichibang mite a ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Huan atung uah akhut akoih a, huai a pan in apaita hi.
Huan mi khat akiang ah ahong a, "Pu, tangtawn hinna ka neihtheihna ding in thil hoih bang ka hih ding?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Thil hoih thu bangziak a hon dong? Hoih khat kia a-om; himahleh, hinna a na lut utleh thupiakte zui in," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Akoi pen maw?" achi hi. Jesu'n, "Tual na that ding ahi kei; Ang na kawm ding ahi kei; Na gu ding ahi kei; Na hek ding ahi kei;
Na nu leh na pa zahtak in, chihte leh nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi chih," achi hi.
Tangval in akiang ah, "Huaite teng ka zui zel; bang ka sam lai a?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hoihkim a om na utleh, pai inla, na neih tengteng zuak inla, mizawngte kiang ah pia in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan, hong pai inla, hon zui in," achi hi.
Tangval bel mihausa ahih ziak in, huai thu azak in lungkhamtak in apaimangta hi.
Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mihausa a dia van-gam lut haksapi ahi.
Huan ka hon hilh ahi, Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in phimbil a sangawngsau lutsuak abaihlamzaw," achi hi.
Huan nungzuite'n huai azak un, lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Kua hotdam in a-om zou dia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n amau a-en a, akiang uah, "Huai mihing hih vual ahi kei, Pathian a di'n bangkim hihtheih ahi," achi hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, kou bangkim paisan in ka hon zuita ua; bang ka mu ding ua?" chi in adong hi.

Jesu'n akiang ah, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, "Khovel thak ah, athupina tutphah a Mihing Tapa atut chiang in, nou kei hon zuite, Israel nam sawm-le-nihte tung a vaihawm in, laltutphah sawm-le-nih ah na tu sam ding uhi.
Huan michih a-innte, a-unaute, asanggamnute, apa, anu, atate, agamte ka min ziak a paisan peuhmah in aleh za amu ding ua, tangtawn hinna atang ding uh.
Himahleh mi tampi, amasapen a omte, ananungpen ah a-om ding ua; ananungpen a omte leng amasapen ah a-om ding uh," achi hi.
Huan kumpipa Herod vaihawm lai a Judia gam a, Bethlehem a Jesu ahong pian lai in, ngai in, suahlam a kipan Jerusalem ah mipilte ahong pai uhi.
"Koi ah ahia Judate' Kumpipa ahong pian? Suahlam ah ama aksi ka mu ua, amah be dia hong pai ka hi uh," achi uhi.
Kumpipa Herod in huai azak phet in alungzing a, Jerusalem tengteng leng alung uh azing sam hi.
Huchi in siampu liante leh mite laigelhmi tengteng asamkhawm a, Khrist pianna ding thu adongta hi.
Huan amau akiang ah, "Judia gam a Bethlehem khua ah zawlnei in hichi in agelh akei hiam:
"Nang, Judia gam a Bethlehem aw, Judia khopite lak ah na neupen kei hial, na sung a kipan ukpa hong suak ding ahi ngal a, ka mi Israelte vengpa ding," chih, achi uhi.
Huai nung in Herod in aguk in mipilte asam a, ngenteltak in aksi kilat lai adongkheta hi.
Huan amau Bethlehem ah apaisak a, "Paita unla, naungek thu ngenteltak in dongkhia un, ke'n leng amah ka hong biak theih samna ding in, na muh chiang un hong hilh un," achi hi.
Huan kumpipa thu azak un apaita ua, ngai in suahlam a aksi amuh uh naungek omna tung zawn atun a akhawl masiah ama uah apai zel hi.
Aksi amuh un, akipak lo mahmah uhi.
Inn sung ah ava lut ua, anu Mari kiang a naungek om amuh un, abokkhup ua, abia uhi. Agoubawm uh ahong ua, akiang ah kipahna dangka-eng, begaw leh murrah alan uhi.
Herod kiang a kik nawn lou ding in amang ua vauhilh a a-om ziak un, amau kholam, lam tuam ah apaita uhi.

Huan apai nung un, ngai in, Joseph kiang ah amang in Toupa angel akilak a, "Thou inla, naungek leh anu pi inla, Aigupta gam ah taipih in, ka hon hilh nawn masiah huai ah om gige in; Herod in naungek hihsiat dia zong ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, azanzan in naungek leh anu api a, Aigupta gam ah apaita hi.
Herod sih mateng huai ah a-om gige hi. Toupa'n zawlnei kam a, "Ka tapa Aigupta gam a pan ka samkhia," chi a agen ahong tuntheihna ding ahi.

Huchih lai in Herod in mipilte' khem a om ahih lam akitheihtak in aheh mahmah a, mi asawl a, ahun laitak thu ngenteltak a mipilte adotkhiak bang in, Bethlehem khua leh akim tengteng a pasal naupang kum nih chiang nuailam avek un athatta hi.
Huchih lai in zawlnei Jeremiah in:
"Ramah ah husa aza uh, suunna, kah thawm, misi ngai a mau vengvungte, Rakil in atate akah a, a-om nawn louh ziak un akhamuan theih kei," chi a ana gen ahong tungta hi.
Himahleh Herod asih nung in, ngai in, Aigupta gam a Joseph kiang ah Toupa Angel amang in akilak hi.
"Thou inla, naungek leh anu pi inla, Israel gam ah pai in; naungek thah tumte asih tak ziak un," achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, naungek leh anu api a, Israel gam ah apaita uhi.
Himahleh Arkelaus in apa Herod sik in Judia gam ah vai ahawm chih azak in, huai lam a pai alau a; amang a vauhilh a a-om ziak in Galili gam ah apai a,
Nazaret kichi khua khat ah atengta hi. "Amah zaw Nazaret mi achi ding uh," chi a zawlneite na gen ahong tuntheihna ding in.
"Van lalgam tuh inn neipa grephuan a sem dingte chial ding a zing a pawtkhia bang ahi.
Ama'n nasemte toh ni khat a makhai loh dia akituahtak un agrephuan ah asawl chiat hi.
Huan dak thumna ding vel in ava pawt a, midang dawr mun a dingh maimaite amu hi.
Akiang uah, 'nou leng grephuan ah va pai sam ve ua, akilawm hun ka hon pe na ding,' achi hi.
Huchi in apaita uhi. Huan dak gukna ding leh dak kuana ding vel in ava pawt nawn a, huchi mah bang in ahih nawn hi.
Huan dak sawm-le-khatna ding in ava pawt a, midang dinghte amu a; akiang uah, 'Bangziak a nitum a hiai lai a dingh maimai na hi ua?' achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, 'kuamah in ahon chial louh ziak un,' achi uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, 'Nou leng grephuan ah va hoh sam un,' achi hi.
"Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, grephuan neipa'n asumkempa kiang ah, 'Nasemte samkhawm inla, ananungpen a kipan amasapen tan in aloh uh pia in,' achi hi.
Huan dak sawm-le-khatna ding khawng a achialte ahong uleh makhai amu chiat uhi.
Amasapente ahong ua, muh tam deuh akigingta ua; himahleh amau leng makhai mah amu chiat uhi.
Aloh uh asantak un, inn neipa tung ah aphun uhi.
Hiai nanungpente'n dakkal khat kia asem ua, kou sun haksa leh kho-ul thuakte toh kibang in na bawl a," chi in.
Ama'n bel alak ua mi khat kiang ah, "Lawm, na tung ah bangmah ka hihkhial sam a; makhai loh ding a kithukim i hi kei maw?
Nang a la inla pai mai in; nang ka hon piak bangmah hiai nanungpen kiang ah ka pe nuam ahi.
Kei a hiven, ka ut-ut a ka hih asiang kei a hia? Ahihkeileh kei ka hoih ziak in nang na haza a hia?" chi in adawng hi.
"Huchi in ananungpente, amasapente ahong hi ding ua, amasapente leng ananungpente ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
Jerusalem a ahohtouh lai in Jesu'n anungzui sawm-le-nihte apituam a, lampi ah akiang uah,
"Ngai dih uh, Jerusalem ah i paitou dia, siampu liante leh laigelhmite khut a Mihing Tapa matsak in a-om ding a; amau si ding in atung ah thu ahihpuk ding uhi.
Nuihza bawlna dia zat ding leh kilhden ding in Zentelte kiang ah ape ding uh; huan, ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding," achi hi.
Huai laitak in, Zebedai tapate nu, atate pi in akiang ah ahong a, amah bia in thil banghiam angen hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Bang ahia na deih?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ka tapa nihte na gam ah na taklam ah khat, na veilam ah khat atuttheihna ding un thu pia in," achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Na nget uh thei lou hi uteh. Ka nou dawn ding na dawn thei ua hia? Ka baptisma tan ding na tang thei ding ua hia?" chi in adawng hi. Amau akiang ah, "Thei e,” achi uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka nou na dawn ngei ding ua; ka baptisma tan ding na tang thei ding uh. Himahleh ka taklam leh ka veilam a tut ding thu zaw kei piak ding ahi kei, ka Pa bawlsakte a ding ahi zaw ding," achi hi.
Huchi in sawmkhatte'n huai azak un unau nihte tung ah ahehta uhi.
Jesu'n amaute asam a, "Zentelte vaihawmte atung uah thu anei mahmah ua, amiliante un atung uah thu anei mahmah lai uh chih leng na thei uh.
Himahleh nou lak ah zaw huchi ahi kei ding; kuapeuh na lak ua milian hih ut na nasem un a-om zaw ding hi.
Kuapeuh na lak ua masapen hih ut na nasem un a-om lai ding ahi.
Mihing Tapa nasepsak a om ding in ahong pai kei a, nasem ding leh mi tampi tatna dia ahinna pe ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi," achi hi.
Jeriko a kipan apawt lai un mipi tampitak in amah azui uhi.
Ngai dih, mittaw nih lam gei a tute'n Jesu ahong pai chih azak un, "Toupa, Nang David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in," chi in akikou uhi.
Mipite'n dai ding in atai ua, himahleh amau, "Toupa, Nang David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in,” chi in akinak kou semsem uhi.
Jesu adingh a, amau asam a, "Na tung uah bang ka hih na ut ua?" achi hi.
Amaute'n akiang ah, "Mitvak ka ut uh," achi uhi.
Jesu'n amau ahehpih mahmah a, amit uh akhoihsak a; huchi in amu thei pah ngal ua, amah azuita uhi.
Huchi in Jerusalem khua atun ding kuan ua, Bethphage khua, Olive tang atun un Jesu'n nungzuite nih asawl a, akiang uah,
"Na mazawn ua khua ah va hoh unla, sabiltung khih, akiang a anou toh na mu ding ua; phel unla, ka kiang ah hon kai un.
Huan kuapeuh in na kiang ua banghiam agen uleh, 'Toupa'n adeih a ahi,' na chi ding uh; ama'n ahon sawl pah mai ding," achi hi.
Hiai tengteng zawlnei kam a gen ahong tuntheihna ding in ahong omta hi.
"En dih, na Kumpipa, thunuailuttak in, sabiltung tung ah, sabiltungnou tung ngei a tuang in na kiang ah ahong pai, chi in Zion tanu hilh in," achih.
Huchi in nungzuite ava pai ua, Jesu'n akiang ua thu apiak bang ngei in ahihta uhi.
Sabiltung leh anou ahon kai ua, atung uah apuante uh aphah ua, huai ah atuangta hi.
Huan mipi lak a tamzaw in lampi ah apuante uh ana phah ua, midang in singsawl sat in, lampi ah aphah uhi.
Mipi amalam a paite leh amah zuite'n, "David Tapa kiang ah Hosanna! Toupa min a hong pai ahampha hi; tungnungpen ah Hosanna!" chi in akikou uhi.
Jerusalem khua ahong lut in akhua in, "Hiai mi kua ahia?" chi in aling souhsouh uhi.
Mipite'n hiai mi zawlnei Jesu, Galili gam a Nazaret a ahi, achi uhi.
Pathian tempul ah Jesu ava lut a, tempul a zuak mite leh lei mite tengteng adelhkhia a, dangka khengte' dohkante leh vakhu zuakte tutphahte leng asawnpaihsak hi.
Akiang uah, "Ka inn thumna inn achi ding uh, chi a gelh ahi. Himahleh nou bel suamhatte khuk in na bawl zaw uh," achi hi.
Huan tempul ah mittawte leh khebaite akiang ah ahong ua; amau ana hihdam hi.
Himahleh siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n athillamdang hihte leh tempul a, David Tapa Hosanna; chi a naupang kikoute amuh un, alungkim kei mahmah uhi.
Akiang ah, hiaite thugen na za hia? achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Za e, 'naungekte leh nawi ne laite kam a pawt in pahtawina na hihkimta,' chih na sim ngei kei ua hia?" achi hi.
Huan amaute apaisan a, khopi a pan pawt in, Bethani ah apai a; huai ah agiakta hi.
Azing a khopi lam a akik nawn lai in agil hong kialta hi.
Lampi sik ah theipi kung amu a, ava naihleh anah kia lou ngal muh ding a-om kei hi. Huan akiang ah, "Tangtawn in na gah nawn ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in theipi avuai pah hi. Nungzuite'n huai amuh un, "Bangchidan ahia theipi avuai pah tel?" chi in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.

Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ginna na neih ua, na ginlah kei uleh, theipi tung a hih bang phet leng na hih kei ding ua, hiai tang kiang ah na kisuan inla tuipi ah na kipailut in, chi le uchin, na chih bang un a-om mai ding hi.
Bangpeuh gingta a thum a na nget uh na mu ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan tempul alut nung a thu ahilh lai in, akiang ah siampu liante leh vantang upate ahong ua, akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thil na hih? Kua'n thu hon pia ahia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng thu kam khat ka hon dong sam ding a, huai na hon hilh uleh, kua thu in hiam hiai thilte ka hih chih ka hon hilh sam ding hi.
Johan baptisma koi a kipan ahia? Van a kipan hia, ahihkeileh mihing a kipan?" chi in adong hi. Amau akingaihtuah ua, "Van a kipan chi lehang, bangziak a amah ginglou na hi ua le?" ahon chi dia;
"Mihing a kipan chi lehang, mipi i kihta ngal ua; mi tengteng in lah Johan zawlnei in apom ngal ua," achi uhi.
Huchi in Jesu adawng ua, "Thei kei ung," achi uhi. Ama'n leng akiang uah, "Ke'n leng kua thu in ahia hiai thilte ka hih ka hon hilh sam kei ding," achi hi.
"Himahleh nou bangchi na sa ua? Mi kuahiam in tapa nih anei a, akhatna pen kiang ah ava hoh a, 'Tapa aw, kuan inla ka grephuan ah va sem ve,' achi hi.
Ama'n, 'Ka ut kei,' chi in adawng hi. Himahleh aden chiang in alungsim kheng in, akuanta hi.
Huan anihna pa kiang ah leng ava hoh a, tua bangmah in ava chi hi. Ama'n 'Pu, ka kuan ding, " chi in adawng a, himahleh akuanta kei hi.

"Huai mi nihte akua zaw in apa uh deihlam ahih a le?" achi hi. Amaute'n, "Amasapen in," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, siahkhonte leh kizuakte'n Pathian lalgam ah nou hon lutsan ding uh.
Diktatna tawn in na kiang uah Johan ahong a, amah na gingta kei uh; siahkhonte leh kizuakte'n amah agingta ua; noute'n huai na muh nung un leng amah na gintakna ding un na kisik nuam tuan kei uh.

"Gentehna thudang ngaikhia un; mi kuahiam inn neitu a-om a, huai mi'n grephuan abawl a, dai in a-umsuak a, grep sukna khuk atou a, inn sang alam a; loukemte kiang ah khohloh ding a pia in gamdang ah apaita hi.
Huan agah loh hun in agah lakhawm ding in loukemte kiang ah asikhate asawl hi.
Loukemte'n tua sikhate ana man ua, khat avua ua, khat pen that in, adang khat suang in adeng uhi.
Huai zoh in sikha dang amasa pawl sang a tamzaw asawl nawn hi. Amau tung ah leng ama ua mite ahih bangmah un ana hih nawn uhi.
Huai nung in, 'Ka tapa azahtak kha ding uh,' chi in atapa akiang uah asawl hi.
Himahleh loukemte'n atapa ana muhtak un, hiai mipa gouluah dingpa ahi; that ni in agouluah ding tansak ni, akichi uhi.
Huchi in amah aman ua, grephuan a kipan paikhia in athat uhi.
Huchi in grephuan neipa ahong pai chiang in huai loukemte tung ah bangchi in ahihta dia le?" achi hi.
Amaute'n akiang ah, “Huai migiloute haksatak in ahihmangthang ding a, grephuan loukem midang aloh hun teng a agahte akiang a pe zel dingte kiang ah khohloh ding in ape ding," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Inn lam mite suang deih louhpen huai ngeingei aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita. Huai Toupa hih ahi, i mitmuh in alamdang ahi, chih Laisiangthoute na sim ngei kei ua hia?”
"Huaiziak in Pathian lalgam na kiang ua kipan laksak ahi dia, namdang kiang ah agahsuah ding piak ahi ding, chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Huai suang tung a puk tuh akitamgawp dia; adelhkhak mi agawizan ding," achi hi.
Huan siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n agentehna thute azak un amau tungthu gen ahi chih atheita uhi.
Huchi in amah mat atum ua; himahleh mipi'n zawlnei a apom ziak un akihta uhi.
Jesu'n amaute houpih in akiang uah gentehna thu agen nawn hi,
"Van lalgam tuh kumpipa kuahiam atapa a dia kitenna ankuanglui toh teh ahi.
Huan kitenna ankuang um dia achialte sam ding in asikhate asawl a, himahleh ahong nuam kei uh.

Ama'n, ka chialte kiang ah, 'ngai dih ua, ka ankuang amanta; ka bawngtalte leh ka gan vak thaute ka gouta a, bang teng amanta hi; kitenna ankuang um ding in hong paita un,' chi un, chi in sikha dang asawl nawn hi.
Himahleh ana limsak kei ua, khat a lou ah akuan a, khat asumsinna ah apaimang hi.
Midangte'n asikhate aman ua, zumhuaitak in abawl ua, ahihlumta uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa athangpaita a; asepaihhon asawl a, tualthatte ahihmang a, akhua uh leng ahalsakta hi.
Asikhate kiang ah, 'kitenna ankuang man ahita, ka chialte ne tak ahi kei uh.
Huaiziak in lamlian ah pai unla, mi na muh peuhpeuh uh kitenna ankuang um ding in chial un,' achi hi.
Huchi in huai sikhate apawt ua, lamlian a va pai in, amuh peuhmah uh migilou leh mihoihte leng apikhawm vek uhi. Huchi in michialte in kitenna dantan ahong dimta hi.
"Himahleh kumpipa michialte enkhe ding a ahong lutleh kitenna puan silhloumi khat huai ah amu hi.
Huchi in akiang ah, 'Lawm, bangchidan a kitenna puan silh lou a hiai a hong lut na hia?' achi hi. Amah adai dide hi.
Kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, 'Akhut leh akhe gak unla, polam mial ah paikhia un; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding,' achi hi.
Chialte tampi ahi ua, telte zaw tawmchik ahi uh," achi hi.
Huai lai in Pharisaite athugen a amattheihna ding dan akikum uhi.
Huan amau anungzuite uleh Herod pawlte akiang ah asawl ua, huai mite'n, "Sinsakpa, midiktak na hi a, diktak in Pathian thu na hilh a, kuamah deihsak tuam leh maivil tuam na nei kei chih ka thei uh.
Huaiziak in bangchi na sa a, hon hilh in, Kaisar kiang a siah piak asiang hia siang lou?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n agitlouhdan uh ana thei a, "Lepchiahte aw, bangziak a hon ze-et na hi ua?
Na siahsum uh hon ensak un," achi hi. Huan akiang ah makhai ahon la uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kua lim leh kua min ahia?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Kaisar a," achi uh. Ama'n akiang uah, "Huchi ahih nung Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah pia un," achi hi.
Hiai thute azaktak un lamdang asa mahmah ua, amah nusia in, apaimangta uhi.
Huai ni mah in, akiang ah Saddukaite, thohnawnna a-om kei chite ahong pai ua;
akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, mi ta nei lou in sileh, a-unaupa'n azi luah in a-unaupa a ding in chi akhahsak ding ahi,” achi hi.
"Ahi a, koute lak ah sal sagih a-om ua; a-upapen in zi anei a, asi a, chi akhah louh ziak in a-unaupa luah ding in azi anutsiat hi.
Huchi mah bang in anihna in aluah a, athumna in aluah lai a, asagihna tan in aluah chiat uhi.
Atawp in avek ua asih nung un numei mah leng hong sita hi.
Huchi in thohnawnna ah amau sagihte lak ah akua pen zi ahi dia? Avek un lah anei kha chiat ngal ua? chi in," adong uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Laisiangthou leh Pathian thilhihtheihna na theih louh ziak un na ngaikhial nak uhi.
Thohnawn hun ah zi leh pasal a kitenna a-om nawn kei a, van a angelte bang ahi zawta ding uh," achi hi.
Himahleh, misi thohnawnna thu Pathian in na kiang ua agen na sim kei ua hia?
"Kei Abraham' Pathian, Isak Pathian, Jakob' Pathian ka hi, Pathian zaw misite Pathian ahi kei a, ahingte Pathian ahi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
Mipite'n huai azak un athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Jesu'n Saddukaite selkhia ahi chih Pharisaite'n azak un akikhawm uhi.
Huchi in alak ua dansiammi khat in, amah ze-et in thu adong hi.
"Sinsakpa, dan ah bang thupiak pen ahia thupipen?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian tuh na lungtang tengteng, na kha tengteng, na lungsim tengteng in na it ding ahi, chih.
Huai thupiak thupipen leh poimohpen ahi.
Huan a zom in, akibatpih hiai ahi, 'Nangmah na ki-it bang in na inveng leng na it ding ahi, chih.'
Huai thupiak nihte ah dan leh zawlneite thu tengteng akikhaikhawm vek," achi hi.
Huan Pharisaite akikhop lai un Jesu'n amaute thu adong hi.
"Khrist bangchi na sa ua? Kua tapa ahia?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "David tapa," achi uh.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchidan in ahia David in Kha a amah Toupa, achih?
"Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, 'Na melmate na khepek nuai a ka koih masiah ka taklam ah tu in,' achih?
David in amah Toupa, achih ngalleh, bangchi in atapa ahi dia?" achi hi.
Kuamah in kam khat in leng adawng thei kei ua, huai ni a kipan kuamah in thudang adong ngam nawnta kei uhi.
Jesu'n mipite leh anungzuite kiang ah thu agen hi.
“Mosi tutphah ah laigelhmite leh Pharisaite atu uhi.
Huaiziak in ahon hilh peuhmah uh hih unla zui zel un; amau thilhih bang zaw hih tuan kei un, gen zaw agen ua, ahih tuan kei uh.
Puakgik haksatak abawl ua, mite asuan ua, amau lah akhutzung un leng akhoih nuam kei uh.
Athilhih tengteng uh mihing muh ding in ahi, ahih zawk uh, athil buh uleh akhipte uh aliansak ua, apuan mongkai uh asausak ua,
ankuangluina ah mun hoihpen leh sinagogte ah tutphah hoihpen leh,
dawr mun a chibai buk leh mi'n, 'Rabbi, Rabbi,' achih bang uh adeihtuamse uhi.
Nou zaw, Rabbi chih in om kei un; sinsakpa khat na nei ua, nou tengteng unaute na hi uhi.
Huan leitung ah kuamah Pa, chi kei un; na Pa uh khat kia van a om ahi.
Heutute chih in om sam kei un, heutu khat na nei ua amah Khrist ahi.
Na lak ua thupipen na sikha ua a-om zawk ding ahi.
Kuapeuh kiliansak adai ding, kuapeuh kingaineu pahtawi in a-om ding hi.
"Himahleh nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; van-gam lampi mite na khaksak ngal ua; nou lah na lut ngal kei uh, mi alut dingte lut ding leng na phal kei zel uh.
Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; meithai innte na negai ngal ua, thumna saupi mi khemna ding in na nei ua, huaiziak in mohna liansem na mu ding uhi.

"Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; phungkai khat lel bawl ding in tuipi leh gam na pai kimvel ngal ua, huchibang a ahong omtak in, amah noumau lehnih in gawtmun ta in na bawl uhi.
