"Nou makai mittaw, kuapeuh tempul lou a kichiam bangmah ahi kei; kuapeuh tempul a dangka-eng lou a kichiam zaw tangtunsak ding ahi chite aw, na tung uh agik hi.
Nou mihai leh mittawte aw; abang pen athupizaw a, dangka-eng hia, ahihkeileh dangka-eng siangthousak tempul?
Kuapeuh maitam lou a kichiam bangmah ahi kei; atung a thilpiak om lou a kichiam in atangtunsak ding ahi, na chi uh.
Nou mittawte aw, abang athupizaw a, thilpiak hia thilpiak siangthousak maitam?
Huchi in 'maitam lou a kichiam peuhmah zaw maitam leh atung a om tengteng lou a kichiam ahi.
Huan tempul lou a kichiam peuhmah zaw tempul leh asung a tengpa lou a kichiam ahi.
Huan van lou a kichiam peuhmah leng Pathian laltutphah leh atung a tupa lou a kichiam ahi.'

"Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; pudina, mohuri, zira sawm-a-khat na pia ua, dan khawkzaw, diktatna, zahngaihna, ginomna na limsak ngal kei uh; himahleh hiaite ei ve na hih ding uh, adangte hih lou tuan lou in.
Nou makai mittawte, thousi khisiang a sangawngsau nawmvalhte aw!
"Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; nou leh kuang polam na hihsiang ua, asung lah lepgukna leh kideklouhna in adim uhi.
Nou Pharisai mittaw, nou leh kuang sunglam hihsiang masa un, apolam leng ahong siantheihna ding in.
"Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; hansuang nuhngou, polam a kilawmtak a kilang, asunglam misi guhte leh nin chiteng a dim bang na hi uh.
Nou leng huai bang in polam ah mihing mitmuh in diktattak in na kilang ua, na sunglam uh bel lepchiahna leh gitlouhna in na dim uhi.
"Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; zawlneite han na lam ua, midiktat hante leng na zem uhi.
I pipute dam lai a na om hi taleng, zawlneite sisan suahna ua pang lou ding hi hang a,' na chi uhi.
Huchi in zawlneite thatte suante na hi uh chih na kitheisak uhi.
Na pipute uh hih bang in sem zom tou ngal un.
Gulte leh gul suante aw, Gehenna vaihawmna bangchi in na pel thei ding ua?

Ngai dih ua, huaiziak mah in na kiang uah, zawlneite, mipilte, laigelhmite ka hon sawl ding; khenkhat na that ding ua, kros ah na kilhden ding uh, khenkhat na sinagogte uah savun khau in na zep ding ua, kho teng ah na sawi zel ding uhi.
Huchi in Abel midiktattak sisan a kipan, tempul leh maitam kikal a Barak tapa Zekariah na thah uh sisan tan in, leitung a midiktat sisan na suah tengteng uh noumau tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng tu khang tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
"Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem, zawlneite that, na kiang ua ahon sawlte uh suang a na denglum a, akpi in anoute akha nuai a a-opkhum bang in na tate bangzah vei opkhum ka tum a, himahleh na ut kei uhi.
En un, na inn uh avuak a taisan in a-omta hi.
K'on hilh ahi, 'Toupa min a hong pai ahampha hi, na chih masiah uh tuban na hon mu nawnta kei ding uh,’ " achi hi.
Tempul a kipan Jesu pawtkhia a, apai lai in, anungzuite tempul ensak ding in akiang ah hong pai uhi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai tengteng na mu uh maw? Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hihchip louh a suang kichiang hiai ah a-om kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
Olive tang a atut lai in nungzuite amau kia in akiang ah ahong ua, "Huaite chikchiang in ahong om dia? Na hong pai nawnna leh khovel tawpna ding chiamtehna bang ahi dia? hon hilh in," achi uhi.
Jesu'n amau adawng a, "Kuamah hon khemzohlouhna ding in pilvang un.
Mi tampi'n, 'Khrist ka hi, chi in keimah min lou in ahong pai ding uh; mi tampi akhemzoh ding ziak un.'
Huan kidou thu leh kidou thuthang na za ding ua; na mangbatlouhna ding un pilvang un; huaite ahong om ding him ahi; himahleh tawpna zaw ahi nai tadih kei ding hi.
Nam tuam leh nam tuam akidou ding ua, gam tuam leh gam tuam akidou ding ua, mun tuamtuam ah kial ake dia, zin aling ding hi.
Huai tengteng nauvei kipatna ahi.
"Huai hun chiang in gimthuak ding in hon mansak ding ua, hon that ding uh. Ka min ziak in nam tengteng huat na hi ding uh.
Huai hun chiang in mi tampi apuk ding ua, akimansaktuah ding ua, akihotuah ding uhi.
Zawlnei taklou tampi ahong pawt ding ua, mi tampi akhempuk ding uh.
Huan hihkhelhna apun ding ziak in mi tamzaw itna ahong dai ding hi.
Himahleh, atawp tan a thuak ngap peuhmah, huai mi ngei hotdam in a-om ding hi.
Huan hiai lalgam tanchinhoih nam tengteng theihsakna ding in khovel tengteng ah hilh in a-om ding; huai khit chiang in tawpna ahong tung ding hi.
"Huchi in hihmangbangpa kihhuai, zawlnei Daniel gen, mun siangthou a dingh na muh chiang un, asim peuhmah in a-omdan thei hen.
Judia gam a omte tang sang ah taimang uhen.
Inn tung a om in a-inn a banghiam la ding in kum kei hen.
Huan lou a om inn a puan la ding in kik nawn kei hen.
Huai ni'n numei gaite leh naunou pomte tung agik ding hi!
Na taimang hun ding uh phalbi lai hiam, Sabbath ni hiam a ahong tunlouhna ding in thum un.
Huai hun chiang in gimthuakna thupi a-om ding ziak in, hichibang a thupi leilung pian tung a kipan tutan in a-om ngei nai kei a, chik mah chiang in ahong om nawn sam kei ding.
Huai nite hihtom hi keileh mihing dam in apawt kei ding uh; himahleh, telte ziak in huai nite hihtom ahi ding hi.
"Huai hun chiang in kuapeuh in na kiang ua, 'En dih, Khrist hiai ah hiam, huai ah hiam,' achih uleh, gingta kei un.
Khrist taklou leh zawlnei takloute ahong pawt ding ziak un, huaite'n hi thei liaileh telte nangawn leng akhempuk theihna ding un chiamtehna leh thillamdang thupitakte ahih ding uhi.
Ngai un, ka hon hilhkhol khinta hi.
"Huchi in na kiang uah, 'ngai un, gamdai ah a-om' hon chih uleh, 'paikhe kei un; dantan sunggil ah a-om, hon chih uleh, taksang sam kei un'.
Khua, suahlam a ahong phiat a, tumlam tan a akilat zel bang in, Mihing Tapa ahong pai nawnna huchibang ahi ding hi.
"Siluang omna mun peuh ah musanete leng a-omkhawm ding uh.
"Himahleh huai gimthuakna nite nung zek in, ni hihmial in a-om ding a, kha avak nawnta kei dia, van a kipan aksite ahong ke ding ua, van thilhihtheihnate hihlin in a-om ding uh.

Huai hun chiang in van ah Mihing Tapa chiamtehna ahong lang ding a, huai hun chiang in leitung a nam tengteng in asuun ding ua, 'Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna leh thupina lian toh van meipi tung a hong pai amu ding uh.'
Huan a-angelte pengkul ging thupi toh asawlkhe ding a, amau atelte lei ning lite a kipan, van tawp a kipan alehlam tawp pha in akaikhawm ding uh.
"Huchi in theipi kung ah gentehna thu zil un; ahiang ahong nou a, anah ahong sel in nipi anai chih na thei uh.
Huchi mah bang in nou leng huai tengteng na muh chiang un, amah ahong naita a, kongkhak bul ah a-om chih thei un.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng atunkim masiah hiai khang amang kei ding.
Lei leh van amang dia, ka thu ahihleh amang kei ding hi.
"Himahleh, huai ni leh hun thu Pa kia lou ngal kuamah in, van a angelte'n leng, Tapa in leng athei kei uh.
Noah dam lai bang in Mihing Tapa hong pai nawnna ah ahi ding.
Huai ni, tuichim tun ma in, long a Noah alut ni tan in, ane un adawn ua, zi leh pasal in akinei ua;
tuichim ahong tung a, avek ua alakmang masiah bangmah athei kei uh; Mihing Tapa hong pai nawnna huchi mah bang ahi ding.
Huai hun chiang in lou ah mi nih a-om ding ua; khat paimangpih in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding.
Numei nih buh gawinelna ah buh gawinel in a-om ding ua, khat paimangpih in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
"Huaiziak in kiging un, bang ni'n ahia na Toupa uh ahong pai ding na theih louh ziak un.
Himahleh, hiai thei un, guta hong pai hun ding inn neitu in theileh, aveng ding a, a-inn aphenvangsak kei ding hi.
Huaiziak in nou leng kiging gige in om un, na gin louh dak ua Mihing Tapa ahong pai ding ziak in.
"Sikha muanhuai, piltak, apu'n ahun teng a atan ding uh hawmsak ding a a-inkuanpihte tung a heutu dia akoih, kua pen ahi dia le?
Apu hong pai chiang in sikha huchibang hih a amuh pen ahampha ding hi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, aneih tengteng tung ah heutu ding in akoih ding hi.
Himahleh sikha gilou in alungtang in, ka pu ahong zok kei ding, chi in
asikha hihpihte na vua henla, nekham-takhamte kiang ah ne in dawn taleh;
huai sikha pu agintak louh ni'n, atheih louh lai in, ahong pai ding a,
tum nih asuah ding a, milepchiahte tan bangbang atangsak ding; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding hi."
"Huai hun chiang in van-gam tuh nungak siangthou sawm, akhawnvak uh tawi a mouneipa dawn ding a pawtte toh teh ahi ding hi.
Huchi in alak ua nga ahai ua, nga apil uhi.
Ahaite'n akhawnvak uh atawi ua, atui atawi kei uhi.
Apilte'n bel akhawnvakte uh tawi in, a-um ah atui leng atawi uhi.
Huan mouneipa hong zekai ziak in avek un alusu ua, ana ihmuta uhi.
"Ngai dih uh! Zan lai in, 'Mouneipa ahong e; adawn ding in hong pawt un,' chi in kikou ging ahong omta hi.
Huaitak in nungak siangthoute athou vek ua, akhawnvakte uh ahahsiang uhi.
Huan ahaite'n apilte kiang ah, 'Na khawnvaktui uh hon pe sam un; ka khawnvak uh mit ding in akisa,' achi uhi.
Himahleh, apilte'n, 'Kou leh nou a ding in akiching kei ding; azuakte kiang ah pai unla, va lei zaw un,' chi in adawng uhi.
Huan lei ding a apaimang kal un mouneipa ahong tungta a; huchi in amansate amah toh kitenna ankuang um ding in alut ua; huan, kongkhak akhakta uh.
"Huai nung in nungak siangthou dangte leng ahong tung ua, 'Toupa, toupa, hon hon in,' achi uhi.
Himahleh ama'n, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ka hon thei ngei kei,’ chi in adawng hi.
"Huaiziak in kiging un, ani leh ahun na theih louh ziak un.
"Van lalgam tuh mi gamdang a pai dia kisa, asikhate sam a, akiang ua asumte kemsak bang ahi.
Sikha khat kiang ah talent nga apia a, sikha dang kiang ah talent nih apia a, sikha dang kiang ah talent khat apia a; ahihtheih hundan ding chiat ua pia in apaita hi.
Talent nga mupa huai in ava sumsin pah a, talent nga dang amukheta hi.
Huchi mah bang in talent nih mupa'n leng talent nih dang amukhia hi.
Talent khat mupa bel ava kuan a, lei atou a, apu dangka aphumgu zawta hi.
"Hun sawtpi nung in huai sikhate pu amau toh asum tungtang hihfel ding in ahong pai hi.
Talent nga mupa ahong pai a, talent nga dang ahon tawi a, 'Pu, nang talent nga na hon kemsak a; en dih, talent nga dang ka mukhia,' achi hi.
Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha hoih leh muanhuai, na hihhoih hi, tawmchik tung ah na muanhuai a, tampi tung ah ka hon omsak ding; na pu kipahna ah lut in,' achi hi.
"Talent nih mupa leng ahong pai a, 'Pu, nang talent nih na hon kemsak a; en dih, talent nih dang ka mukhia,' achi hi.
Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha hoih leh muanhuai, na hihhoih e, tawmchik tung ah na muanhuai a, tampi tung ah ka hon omsak ding; na pu kipahna ah lut in,' achi hi.
"Huan talent khat mupa leng ahong pai a, 'Pu, mi chihhakpi na hi chih ka hon thei a; na tuhlouhna ah leng na at a, na thehlouhna ah leng na khawm hi.
Huaiziak in ka lau a, ka va pai a, lei ah na talent ka selgu a; en in, nang a ngei na mu nawn,' achi hi.
"Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha gilou leh zongzaw, ka tuhlouhna ah ka at a, ka thehlouhna ah leng ka khawm chih na thei maw?
Huchi ahih ngalleh sumsinte kiang a ka dangka na koih ding hi a, huchi a ka hong pai a kei a apung toh ka muh nawn ding ahi.
Huaiziak in atalent khat laksak unla, talent sawm neipa kiang ah pia un.
Kuapeuh anei piak behlap ahi ding a, ahong hau ding; kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak ahi ding.
Huan sikha phatuam lou polam mial ah paikhia un, huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding,' chi in adawng hi.
"Himahleh, Mihing Tapa, a-angelte tengteng toh athupina a kivan a ahong pai hun chiang in, athupina laltutphah ah atu ding hi.
Ama ah nam chih akikhawm ding ua; belamchingpa'n kel lak a pan belamte akhenkhia bang in amaute akhenkhe ding hi.
Belamte ataklam ah akoih ding a, aveilam ah kelte akoih ding hi.
Huai hun chiang in Kumpipa'n ataklam a mite kiang ah, 'Ka Pa deihsakte aw, hong pai un, khovel siamchil a pan nou a dia gam bawlsa luah un.
Ka gil akial in, nek ding na hon pia ua; ka dang atak in, dawn ding na hon pia uh; mikhual ka hih in na hon zintun ua;
vuaktang ka hih in, puan na hon silhsak uh; ka chi anat a, ka kiang a na hong ziak un,' achi ding hi.
"Huai hun chiang in, midiktatte'n, 'Toupa, chik in ahia gilkial a ka hon muh ua nek ding ka hon piak uh? Dangtak a ka hon muh ua, dawn ding ka hon piak uh?
Chik in ahia mikhual a ka hon muh ua, ka hon zintun ua, vuaktang a ka hon muh ua, puan ka hon silhsak uh?
Chik in ahia china in hiam suangkul ah hiam ka hon muh ua, na kiang a ka hong uh?' chi in adong ding uh.
Kumpipa'n amaute kiang ah, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai ka unau neupente lak a mi khat tung a na hih uh ka tung a hih na hi uh,' chi in adawng ding hi.
"Huai khit in, aveilam a mite kiang ah leng, 'Nou hamse thuakte aw, tangtawn mei diabol leh asawltakte dia mun bawl ah hon paimangsan un;
Ka gil akial in, nek ding na hon pe kei ua; ka dang atak in, dawn ding na hon pe kei ua;
mikhual ka hih in, na hon zintun kei uh; vuaktang ka hih in, puan na hon silhsak kei ua; china leh suangkul a ka om a, na hon veh louh ziak un,' achi ding hi.
"Huai hun chiang in amau leng, 'Toupa, chik in ahia gilkial hiam, vuaktang hiam, china hiam, suangkul ah hiam ka hon muh ua, na nna ka hon sepsak louh uh?' chi in adong ding uh.
Ama'n akiang uah, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai mineupente lak a mi khat tung a na hih louh uh ka tung a hih lou na hi uh' chi in adawng ding hi.
Huan huaite tangtawn gawtna ah apai ding ua; midiktatte bel tangtawn hinna ah apai ding uhi,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thu tengteng agen khit in, anungzuite kiang ah,
"Ni nih nung chiang in Paikan Ankuangluina ahong om ding chih na thei ua, Mihing Tapa kilhden ding in amansak ding uh," achi hi.
Huai lai in siampu lianpen Kaiapha achih uh huangsung ah siampu liante leh vantang upate akikhawm uhi.
Jesu khem a mat a, ahihlup theihna ding un akikum uhi.
Himahleh, "Ankuanglui ni in hi keileh, huchi lou in zaw vantang lak ah buaina ahong piang kha ding," achi uhi.
Bethani khua a, miphak Simon inn a Jesu a-om lai in,
numei khat alabaster bawm a thau gimlim mantam tawi in, akiang ah ahong pai a, an a-um lai in alu ah asung hi.
Himahleh nungzuite'n huai amuh un aheh ua, "Bangziak a hichibang a hihmangthang mawkmawk ahia?
Hiai thau mantam tampi a zuak a, mizawngte kiang a piak theih ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
Jesu'n huai atheih in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a numei hihbuai na hi ua? Ka tung ah thil hoihtak ahih ahi.
Mizawngte tangtawn a na kiang ua om ahi kei hiam, kei bel tangtawn a na kiang ua om ka hi kei hi.
Hiai thau gimlim ka sa a asun, vui ding a hon bawl ding in ahih ahi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, khovel tengteng ah koi ah leng hiai tanchinhoih agenna peuh uah hiai numei thilhih leng amah theihgigena ding in agen zel ding uh," achi hi.
Huai nung in sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, Judas Iskariot achih uh, siampu liante kiang ah ahoh a;
"Amah hon mansak leng, bang na hon pe ding ua?" achi hi. Huchi in dangka sawmthum abuksakta uhi.
Huai nung siah zuausan a matsakna ding hunlem azongta hi.
Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ani masapen in Jesu kiang ah nungzuite ahong ua, "Paikan Ankuanglui nekna ding koi lai ah hon bawlsak le ung na ut a?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Khopi ah kuahiam kiang ah hoh unla, akiang ah, 'Sinsakpa'n, ka hun anaita a; na inn ah nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka um ding uh e' achi, va chi un,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ua achih bang in nungzuite'n ahih ua; Paikan Ankuang abawlta uhi.
Huai ni nitaklam in, nungzui sawm-le-nihte toh an a-um uhi.
An anek lai un, ama'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat in kei ahon mansak ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in alungkham mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Toupa, kei ka hi maw?" achi chiat uhi.
Ama'n, "Ankuang hon sawkpihpa ngei in kei hon zuausan in hon mansak ding achi hi.
Mihing Tapa tanchin agelh bang un apai ding hi. Himahleh, Mihing Tapa mansak dingpa tung agik hi; huai mipa zaw piang keileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan amansak dingpa Judas in adong a, "Heutupa, keimah ka hi maw?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi e,” achi hi.
Huan an anek lai un Jesu'n tanghou ala a, avualzawl khit in, abalkham a; nungzuite kiang ah apia a, "La unla, ne un; hiai ka pumpi ahi," achi hi.
Huai zoh in nou leng la a, kipahthu agen khit in, akiang uah apia a, "Na vek un dawn un;
hiai ka sisan a thukhun thak, khelhnate ngaihdamna dia mi tampi a dia pawt ding ahi.
Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, ka Pa gam a noute toh athak ka dawn ni atun masiah tuban grepgui gahtui ka dawn nawnta kei ding," achi hi.
Huan la asak zoh un apawt ua, Olive tang ah apaita uhi.
Jesu'n amau kiang ah, "Tuzan chiang in na vek un ka tungthu a lungkia in na hon taisan vek ding uh; 'Belamchingpa ka zep ding a, belamhonte adalh ding uh' chih gelh bang in.
"Himahleh ka thohnawn nung in Galili gam ah na ma uah ka pai ding," achi hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Avek un na tungthu ah lungkia in om mah le uh kei zaw lungkia in ka om kei hial ding," chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, tuzan in ak khuan ma in, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achi hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Na sihna a leng si sam ding himah leng ka hon kitheihmohbawl kei hial ding," achi a. Huchibang mah in nungzuite'n leng achi chiat uhi.
Huai zoh in amau toh mun khat Gethsemani achih uh atung ua; anungzuite kiang ah, "Pam a ka va thum kal in hiai ah na tu un," achi hi.
Peter leh Zebedai tapate nih api a, alungkham in ahong mangbang mahmahta hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Ka kha alungkham mahmah a, sihna khop hial ahi; hiai ah om unla, hon venpih un," achi hi.
Neukha in malam ah ava pai zek a, bokkhup in, "Ka Pa aw, ahihtheihleh hiai nou in hon pel mahmah hen; himahleh kei thu hilou in, nang thuthu hi zaw hen," chi in athum hi.
Huan nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai a, amaute ihmu in ahong mu a, Peter kiang ah, "Nou dakkal khat lel leng hon hahpih zou lou na hi uh maw?
Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un kiging gige in thum un; kha in zaw angap a, sa bel ahat kei," achi hi.
Nihveina ah ava pai a, athum nawn a, "Ka Pa aw, ka dawn louh a hiai nou in ahon pelh theih keileh nangmah thuthu hi hen," achi hi.
Ahong pai nawn a, amaute ihmu in ahong mu nawn hi; a-ihmut uh asuah mahmah ziak in.
Huan apaisan nawn a, athumveina ah agen ngei gen in athum nawn hi.
Huai khit in nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai nawn a, akiang uah, "Na ihmu lailai uh maw, na tawlnga lailai uh maw? Ngai dih uh, ahun ahong tungta, mikhialte khut ah Mihing Tapa khot khit ahita.
Thou unla, pai ni, en dih uh, hon mansak dingpa ahong naita," achi hi.
Huan agen lai mah in Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, siampu liante leh laigelhmite leh upate kiang a kipan mipi tampitak leh namsau leh khetbukte toh ahong tung hi.
Amansak ding pa'n chiamtehna ding ahilhkhol sipsip a, "Ka tawp penpen amah na man ding uh," chi in.
Huchi in Jesu ava naih a, "Chibai, Heutupa," chi in atawp hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Lawm, na hong nangawn hih in," achi hi. Huaitak in, Jesu alen ua, amanta uh.
Huan ngai dih, Jesu ompihte lak a khat in akhut zankhia in anamsau adokkhia a, siampu lianpen sikha aban a, abil abankhiaksak hi.
Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na namsau akoihna ah koih nawn in; namsau pan peuhmah namsau mah a asih ding ziak in.
Ka Pa ngen leng angel sangguk mun sawm-le-nih hon sawl pah ding ahi; ngen thei lou in na hon ngaihtuah ua hia?
Himahleh, ngen leng bangchi in ahia Laisiangthou in hichibang a hong om ding achihte atangtun theih ding?" achi hi.
Huai laitak in Jesu'n mipite kiang ah, "Namsaute, khetbukte tawi in suamhat man ding bang in keimah man ding a hong pawt na hi uh maw? Tempul ah niteng in thuhilh in ka tu a, na hon man ngal kei uhi.
Himahleh zawlnei Laisiangthou thute atunkimna dia hiai tengteng hong tungta ei ve," achi hi. Huchi in nungzui tengteng in amah anusia ua, ataimangta uhi.
Jesu mante'n siampu lianpen Kaiapha inn a, laigelhmite leh upate omkhawmna ah amah apita uhi.
Himahleh Peter in gamlatak ah siampu lianpen huangsung tan in amah zui in ava lut a, atawpna tan thei ding in sikhate lak ah ava tu hi.
Amah ahihlup theihna ding un siampu liante leh vaihawmte tengteng in Jesu hekna ding azong uhi.
Theihpih taklou tampi toh hong pai mah le uh ngohna ding bangmah amu thei kei uhi. Aden chiang in mi nih ahong pai ua,
hiai mipa'n, "Tempul hihsia a, ni thum sung a lam nawn thei ka hi, achi,” achi uhi.
Huchi in siampu lianpen adingtou a, akiang ah, "Bangmah adawng lou ding maw? Hiaite hon hekna bangchidan ahia?” achi hi.
Jesu bel adai dide hi. Huan siampu lianpen in akiang ah, "Pathian hing min in ka hon ngen ahi, Khrist, Pathian Tapa na hi hia? Hon hilh in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hi e, himahleh, ka hon hilh ahi, tunung chiang in Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna taklam a tu a, van meipi tung a hong pai na mu ding uh," achi hi.
Huan siampu lianpen in apuansilh abotkek a, "Pathian agenseta e! Theihpih dang bang i kiphamoh nawn dia? Ngai dih uh, Pathian agensiatdan tu in na zata uh. Bangchi na sa ua?" achi hi.
Amaute'n, "Si tak ahi," chi in adawng uhi. 67 Huan amai ah chil aphih ua, atum ua; khenkhat in akhutpek ua beng in,
"Nang Khrist, kua ahia hon tum hon hilh in?" achi uhi.
Vaihawmna huangsung polam ah Peter atu a; nungaknou khat akiang ah ahong pai a, "Nang leng Galili gam a mi, Jesu kiang a om na hi ve," achi hi.
Ama'n bel, "Na thugen ka thei kei," chi in avek ua ma ah akitheihmohbawl hi.
Huan inlim a apawttak in nungak dang in amah amu a, huai a omte kiang ah, "Hiai mi Nazaret Jesu kiang a ompa ahi," achi hi.
Peter kichiam in, "Huai mipa ka thei kha kei," chi in kitheihmohbawl nawn hi.
Peter kichiam in, "Huai mipa ka thei kha kei," chi in kitheihmohbawl nawn hi.
Huan sawt lou nung in, akiang a dinghte'n Peter kiang ah, "Nang leng alak ua mi na hi vo oi, na pau ah akithei," achi uhi.
Ama'n bel huai mipa ka thei kha kei, chi in hamsia kiloh in akichiamta hi. Huchi in ak akhuang pah ngal hi.
Huan Peter in, "Jesu'n ak akhuan ma in nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," chi a akiang a athugen aphawkkhia a, apawtkhia a, akap huphup hi.
Huan zingsang ahong hih in siampu liante leh vantang upate tengteng Jesu that ding in atungthu ah akihou uhi.
Amah hen in api ua, gam-ukpa Pilat kiang ah api uhi.
Huan amansakpa Judas in Jesu siam louh tangsak uh ahi chih atheihtak in akisik a, siampu liante leh upate kiang ah dangka sawmthum ahon tawikik hi.
"Midik sisan ka khot thil ka hihkhial,” achi hi. Amau, "Huai kou a ding in bang akhawk dia? Nang na lohloh kiloh in,” achihsan uhi.
Ama'n huai dangka tempul ah apailut a, paimang in a-awklumta hi.
Huan siampu liante'n huai dangka ala ua, "Hiai sumbawm a koih asiang kei, sisan man ahi," achi uhi.
Huchi in akihou ua, mikhualte vuina ding in belvelmi mun aleita uhi.
Huaiziak in tutan in huai mun, "Sisan mun" achi uhi.
Huan zawlnei Jeremiah in ana gen, "Amah man ding a Israel suante lak a kuate hiam in asak uh dangka sawmthum alata uh;
Toupa'n hon hilh bang in belvelmi mun man ding in apia uh," chih ahong tangtungta hi.
Huan gam-ukpa ma ah Jesu adingh hi. Gam-ukpa'n, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" chi in adong hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hi e,” achi hi.
Siampu liante leh upate'n ahek lai un bangmah in adawng kei hi.
Huchi in Pilat in akiang ah, "Ahon hekna zouzai uh na za kei a hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n kam khat lel in leng adawng kei hi; huchi in gam-ukpa'n lamdang asa mahmah hi.
Huan gam-ukpa'n ankuanglui ni in henta khat, adeihdeih uh, mipite a ding in apawtsak zel hi.
Huai lai in henta minthang, Barabbas achih uh a-om hi.
Huchi in ahong kikhop un, Pilat in akiang uah, "Kua zaw hon pawtsak leng na ut ua? Barabbas hia, Jesu Khrist kichi?" achi hi.
Hazat ziak in amah amansak uh chih athei hi.
Vaihawmna tutphah a atut lai in, azi in, "Hiai midik tung ah bangmah hih ke'n, tuni'n amah ziak in ka mang in thil tampi ka thuak hi," chi in athukhak hi.
Huan siampu liante leh upate'n, Barabbas nget a Jesu hihmanthat ding in mipite athuzoh uhi.
Gam-ukpa'n amau ahoupih a, "Amau nihte akua zaw hon pawtsak leng chi na hi ua?" achi nawn hi.
Amaute'n, "Barabbas," achi uhi. Pilat in akiang uah, "Jesu Khrist kichi, bang ka chihta dia le?" achi hi. Avek un, "Amah kilhden in om hen," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Bang ding in maw? Bang ahihkhial a ahia?" achi hi. Himahleh amau, "Kilhden in," chi in akikou vengvung uhi.

Huchi in Pilat in bangmah ahihtheita kei a, hong buai deuhdeuh zaw ding chih akitheih in, tui ala a, mipite ma ah akhut asil a, "Hiai midik sisan ah ka siang e; noumau na lohloh uh kiloh un," achi hi.
Huan mipi tengteng in, "Asisan zaw koumau tung ah leh ka tate uh tung ah om hen," chi in adawng uhi.
Huai khit in Barabbas apawtsak a; Jesu azep a, kilhden ding in apeta hi.
Huai khit in, sepaihte'n gam-ukpa inpi ah Jesu apilut ua, apawl ua mi tengteng akiang ah hong kikhawm uhi.
Apuante suahsak in, puan sandup asilhsak uhi.
Linglukhu aphan ua, khusak in, akhut taklam in sialluang atawisak ua; ama ah akhukdin ua, "Chibai, Judate' Kumpipa," chi in nuihza bawlna in anei uhi.
Huan amah achilsiat ua, sialluang laksak in alu akhen uhi.
Nuihza bawlna dia aneih khit un, puan asuahsak ua, ama puante asilhsak nawn ua, kilhden ding in apikheta uhi.
Huan apaikhiak lai un, Kurini a mi, amin Simon amu ua; huai mi ama kros po ding in aman uhi.
Golgotha mun ahong tun un, huai tuh Luguh mun chihna ahi,
uain thuk, thil kha toh hel, dawn ding in apia ua, himahleh acheptak in adawn nuam kei hi.
Akilhden khit un, ai san in apuansilh akihawm uhi.
Huan huai ah tu in avengta uhi.
Ahekna uh, "HIAI JUDATE' KUMPIPA JESU AHI," chi a gelh, alutung ah asuang uhi.
Amah toh, suamhat nih, ataklam ah khat leh aveilam ah khat akilhden uhi.
Huan mi vialvak peuh in alu uh sinkhum in,
"Nang tempul hihsia a ni thum a lam nawnpa, kihihdam in; Pathian Tapa na hihleh kros a kipan hong kumsuk tanla," chi in a-enghou uhi.
Huchi mah bang in siampu liante'n, laigelhmite toh, enghou in,
"Midangte hondampa, amah-le-amah kihondam theiloupi in, Israelte kumpipa ahih ngalleh tu in kros a kipan hong kumleh a kei dia, huchi in amah i gingta mai ding.
Pathian amuang na aka, amah zaw a-utleh tu in kihondamleh ake; Pathian Tapa ka hi, achi ngal a," achi uhi.
Suamhat akilhden un leng, huchi mah bang in a-enghou hi.
Huan dak gukna a kipan dak kuana tan in khua ahong mialvekta hi.
Dak kuana ding in, aw ngaihtak in, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?" chi in Jesu akikoukhia a, huai tuh, "Ka Pathian, ka Pathian bang achia hon paisan?" chihna ahi.
Akiang a dingh khenkhatte'n huai azak un, “Hiai mi'n Elijah sam ahi," achi uhi.
Alak ua mi khat kintak in atai pah a, spanji ala a, uain thuk diahdim in chiang ah asuang a, adawnsak hi.
Midangte'n, "Ngaihsak kei un, amah lakhe ding in Elijah ahong pai hiam i en ding uh,” achi uhi.
Jesu ngaihtak in akikou nawn a, akha akhahta hi.
Huan ngai dih, tempul puanzak atunglam a kipan anuailam tan in hong keksuakta a; ziin ahong ling a, suangpite khangkham in; hante ahong kihong hi.
Mi Siangthou ihmusate pumpi tampi leng kaihthoh in a-omta uhi.
Huaite athohnawn nung in, han a kipan hong pawt in kho siangthou ah alut ua, mi tampi lak ah akilakta uhi.
Huan sepaih zaheutu leh akiang a Jesu veng a omte'n, zinling leh thil omdante amuh un alau mahmah ua, "Hiai mi zaw Pathian Tapa ahi ngeingei," achi uhi.
Huai ah, numei tampi, a-nna sepsak kawm zel a Galili gam a kipan a hon zuite a-om ua, gamlapi ah a-en uhi.
Huaite lak ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob leh Joseph nu Mari leh Zebedai tapate' nute a-om uhi.
Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, Arimathai khua a mihausa, amin Joseph ahong pai a, amah leng Jesu nungzui ahi sam hi.
Huai mi Pilat kiang ah ava hoh a, Jesu luang angen hi. Pilat in piak ding in thu apia hi.
Huchi in Joseph in aluang ala a, puanmalngat siangtak in atuam hi.
Ama hankhuk thak, suang khuakkuak ah asial a; suang lianpi in hankhuk kongkhak adelh a, apaita hi.
Huan huai ah Mari Magdalin leh Mari dang a-om ua, hankhuk mazawn ah atu uhi.
Huan azing in, huai tuh, kisakkholhna zoh ni zing ahi a, Pilat kiang ah siampu liante leh Pharisaite a-omkhawm kheukhou uhi.
"Pu, huai mikhemhat in adam lai in, ni thum nung in ka thounawn ding, achih ka theigige uhi.

Huchi in ani thum ni tanpha hankhuk venghoih ding in thu pia in; huchi lou in zaw anungzuite'n amah ava gukhe ding ua, vantang kiang ah, misi lak a kipan athounawnta achi kha ding uh; huchi in khemna nanung zaw amasa sang in ahoih kei zaw sem ding," achi uhi.
Pilat in akiang uah, "Vengmi sepaihte na nei ve ua oi; pai unla, na hihtheih bang un venghoihsakta unla," achi hi.
Huchi in vengmi sepaihte toh ava hoh ua, hankhuk avenghoihsak ua, hansuang achiamteh uhi.
Huan Sabbath ni abei in, ani sagih ni masapen ding a phalvak in, han en ding in Mari Magdalin leh Mari dang akuan uhi.
Ngai dih, nakpitak in ziin ahong ling a; van a kipan Toupa angel ahong suk a, suang ahong khukkhia a, atung ah atuta hi.
Amel omdan khophia bang ahi a, apuansilhte tuh vuk bang in angou hi;
Amah akihtak ziak un veng mite aling ua, misi bang in a-om hial uhi.
Angel in numeite ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Nou zaw lau kei un; akilhden uh Jesu zong na hi uh chih ka thei;
hiai ah a-omta kei; agen bang ngei in athounawnta, alupna mun en un, achi hi.
Pai meng unla, nungzuite kiang ah, 'Misi lak a kipan athounawnta hi. Ngai dih uh, Galili gam ah na ma uah apai; huai ah amah na mu ding uh' chi in hilh un. Ngai dih uh, ka hon hilhta ahi," achi hi.
Huan lau leh kipak mahmah kawm in, han a kipan apai mengmeng ua, anungzuite hilh ding in ataita uhi.
Huan ngai dih, Jesu'n amaute atuak a, "Chibai aw,” achi hi. Huchi in amaute'n akhepek alen ua, abia uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, paita un, Galili gam a pai ding in ka unaute va hilh un; huai ah na hon mu ding uh, achi," chi in.
Huan apai lai un vengmi sepaih khenkhat khopi ah ava lut ua, thil omdan tengteng siampu liante kiang ah ava hilh uhi.
Upate toh akikhawm ua, akihou zoh un, sepaihte kiang ah dangka tampi apia ua,
"Zan a ka ihmut kal un, anungzuite hong pai in, amah aguta uh, chi unla,
gam-ukpa'n huai ana zakleh amah leng i khem ding ua lunghimoh lou ding in i bawl na ke,” achi uhi.
Huchi in dangka ala ua, ahilh bang un ahihta ua; huchi in tutan in huai thu Judate lak ah agenthang lai uhi.
Himahleh Galili gam a Jesu'n tang a sehsak ah nungzui sawm-le-khatte ahoh uhi.
Amah amuh un abia ua; khenkhat in aginglah uhi.
Huchi in akiang uah Jesu ahong pai a, amau ahoupih a, "Lei leh van a thuneihna tengteng ka kiang a piak ahita.
Huaiziak in kuan unla, nam chih a pan nungzuite bawl unla, Pa toh, Tapa toh, Kha Siangthou toh min in baptis unla,
thu ka hon piak tengteng zui ding in thuhilh un. Ngai un, kei tangtawn in, khovel tawp pha in leng, na kiang uah ka om gige hi," achi hi.
Huchih lai in Baptispa Johan in,
"Kisik un! Van-gam anaita," chi in Judia gamdai ah thu gen in ahong pai hi.
Amah ahi, zawlnei Isai in: "Gamdai a mi kikou aw in, Toupa lamlian sial unla, alampite tangsak un, achi," chi a ana gen pen.
Johan in sangawngsau mul puan asilh a, savun kawnggak agak a, a-an khaukhup leh khuaizu ahi.
Huchih lai in Jerusalem khua, Judia gam tengteng, Jordan luidung kim tengteng akiang ah ahong paikhawm ua,
akhelhna uh thupha tawi in, Jordan lui ah baptisma atang uhi.
Himahleh Pharisaite leh Saddukaite tampi ama a baptisma tang ding a hong paite amuh in, akiang uah, "Nou gul suante! Thangpaihna hong tung ding taisan ding a kua'n hon thuhilh ahia?
Huchi in kisikna toh kilawm gah hon suangkhia un.
Abraham ka pu uh ahi, chi in kingaihtuah kei un, Pathian in hiai suangte Abraham suante in adingsak thei ka hon chi ahi.
Tu a kipan in singbul teng ah heipi akoihta uh; huchi in sing chih gah hoih a gah lou peuhpeuh aphuk ua, mei ah apailut zel uhi.

Ke'n zaw kisikna ding in tui in ka hon baptis a, himahleh, amah ka nung a hong pai kei sang in athupizaw a, akhedap tawitak leng ka hi kei, ama'n zaw Kha Siangthou leh mei in noute ahon baptis ding hi.
Akhut in phazah atawi a, aphual azapsiang sipsip ding a, buhpang ah abuh asung ding, asi bel mei mit thei lou in ahalmang ding,” achi hi.
Huchih lai in akiang a baptisma tang ding in Galili gam a kipan Jordan lui ah Johan kiang ah Jesu ahong pai hi.
Johan in, "Nang kei na hon baptis kiphamohzaw hinapi, ka kiang ah na hong zosop ahi maw?" chi in akham hi.
Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tu in lemsa teitei in, hichibang a diktatna tengteng hihtangtun ei a ding in akilawm ngal a," chi in adawng a, huchi in lem asata hi.
Huan Jesu baptisma atantak in tui a kipan apawt pah a, ngai in, amah a ding in van ahong kihong a, Pathian Kha, vakhu bang a hong suk in, atung a hong tu amu hi.
Huan ngai in, van a kipan aw in, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi," achi hi.
Huai khit in diabol khem a om ding in gamdai ah Kha pilut in Jesu a-omta hi.
Huan ni sawmli leh zan sawmli an angolh nung in agil hong kialta hi.
Khempa ahong pai a, akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai suangte tanghou suak ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n, "Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei ding, Pathian kam a thupawtte in ahing zaw ding, chih gelh ahi ngal a," chi in adawng hi.
Huai zoh in, diabol in kho siangthou ah apilut a, Pathian tempul tungzum ah akoih a,
akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh kikesak in; 'Na tungthu ah a-angelte thu ape ding a, akhut un ahon dom ding uh, huchi lou in zaw na khe in suang na sui kha ding,' chih gelh ahi ngal a,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian ze-et ke'n chih gelh ahi zaw," achi hi.
Huan diabol in tang sangtak ah api nawn a, khovel gam tengteng leh athupina a-ensak hi.
Huan akiang ah, "Bokkhup in hon bia in, hiai tengteng ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
Huaitak in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Setan, hiai a kipan paimang in, Toupa na Pathian na biak ding, ama nna kia na sep ding ahi chih gelh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Huai zoh in diabol in apaisanta a, ngai in, angelte'n amah nna ahong sepsak uhi.
Huan Johan aman uh chih Jesu'n azak phet in, Galili ah akihemkhia hi.
Nazaret khua apaisan a, Kapernaum ah a-om nilouh a, huai tuh Zebulun leh Naphtali uk, tuipi gei a om ahi a,
zawlnei Isai kam a thugenkholh tangtunna ding ahi:
"Dil lam a, Jordan gal a, Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam, Zentelte Galili gam a,
mial nuai a tute'n vak thupi amu ua, sihna lim nuai a tute tung ah vak ahong suakta,” chi a agen hong tuntheihna ding in.
Huai hun a kipan in Jesu'n, "Kisik un! Van lalgam anaita," chi in thu agenta hi.
Huan Galili Tuipi gei a avak kawm in, unau nih Simon Peter kichi a-unau Andru toh, tuipi ah len pai lai amu a; amaute ngamanmi ahi him uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zui un, mihing man ding in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
Huchi in alente uh nuse pah in amah azuita uhi.
Huan huai a kipan apai zel a unau dang nih, Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unau Johan, apa uh Zebedai kiang a long a alente uh bawlpha in amu a; amaute asam hi.
Huchi in long leh apa uh nuse pah in amah azuita uhi.
Jesu'n asinagogte ua thu hilh in, lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, mite natna chiteng leh hatlouhna chiteng hihdam in Galili gam tengteng ah apai vialvial hi.
Siria gam tengteng ah atanchin athangta a, akiang ah mi damlou tengteng damlouhna leh natna chih thuakte, dawimatte, kaih veite leh zawte ahon pi ua, ana hihdam hi.
Galili gam a kipan, Dekapolis a kipan, Jerusalem leh Judia a kipan leh Jordan gal a kipan in mipi tampitak in amah azui uhi.
Huchi in mipite amuh in tang a paitou in atu a, akiang ah anungzuite hong pai uhi.
Huan thu agen a, amaute thu ahilh hi.
"Lungsim a gentheite ahampha uh, van-gam amaute a ahi ngal a.
Lungkhamte ahampha uh, khamuan a om ding ahi ngal ua.
Thunuailutte ahampha uh, leigou luah ding ahi ngal ua.
Diktatna lunggulh a gilkial leh dangtakte ahampha uh, tai ding ahi ngal ua.
Zahngaitheite ahampha uh, zahngaihna mu ding ahi ngal ua.
Lungsim a siangthoute ahampha uh, Pathian mu ding ahi ngal ua.
Lemna bawlte ahampha uh, Pathian tate chih ding ahi ngal ua.
Diktatna ziak a sawina thuakte ahampha uh, van-gam amau a ahi ngal a.
"Mi'n keimah ziak a ahon tai ua, ahon sawi ua, zuau a gilou chiteng a hon hek hun chiang un, na hampha uhi.
Kipak unla, nakpitak in nuam un, van ah na kipahman uh athupi ngal a; huchi mah bang in na ma ua zawlnei omte leng ana sawi zel uhi.
"Lei chi na hi uh, himahleh chi peng taleh, bang in ahia ahih al nawn ding? Paihkhiak a mihingte chilgawp ding louh ngal, bangmah ding in aphatuam kei hi.
"Khovel vak na hi uh. Mual tung a khopi om selguk theih ahi kei.
Mi'n khawnvak de in loh nuai ah akoih ngei kei ua, akoihna ah akoih zaw uhi. Huchi in insung a om tengteng atanvak hi.
Huchi mah bang in, na vak uh mite mitmuh ding in vak hen, huchi in na thil hoih hihte uh amu ding ua, na Pa uh van a om apahtawi thei ding uhi.
"Dan hiam zawlneite thu hihmang ding a hong pai in hon ngaihtuah kei un; hihmang ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, hihtangtung ding a hong pai ka hi zaw hi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, lei leh van aman ma, avek a atunkim masiah uh dan thu a sutvom neuchik hiam, thaivom neuchik hiam, khat leng amang kei hial ding.

Huchi in kuapeuh hiai thupiak neupente lak a khat bohsia a, huai zui dia mite thuhilh peuhmah, van-gam ah mineupen akichi ding; himahleh kuapeuh zui a thuhilh behlapte, van-gam ah milian akichi ding hi.
Na diktatna un laigelhmite leh Pharisaite diktatna akhup kei in zaw van-gam ah na lut kei hial ding uh chih ka hon hilh ahi.
"Nidanglai a mite kiang ah, 'Tual na that ding ahi kei,' kichi leh, 'Kuapeuh tualthat vaihawmna a ding in lauhuai in a-om ding, kichi na zata uh.

Ke'n zaw, kuapeuh a-unau tung a heh vaihawmna a ding in lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding. Kuapeuh a-unau selphou vaihawmte hawmsak a om lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding; 'Nang mihai' chi kuapeuh Gehenna mei a paih lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding uh, chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Huaiziak in maitam a na thilpiak na lat lai a na unau in na tung ah lung hihlouhna anei chih na theihkhiakleh,
huai maitam ma a na thilpiak nusia in pai inla, na unau kilempih in, huai zoh in na thilpiak lan in.

Na langpa toh vaihawmna inn zuan a lampi a na paikhawm lai un kilempih in, huchi lou in zaw na langpa'n thukhenmi khut ah hon pe dia, thukhenmi'n mimanpa kiang ah hon pe dia; suangkul ah hon khum kha ding hi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, paihsa san khat nangawn na piak kim masiah huai a kipan in na pawtkhe kei hial ding hi.
"Nidanglai mite'n 'Ang na kawm ding ahi kei' achih uh na zata uhi.
Himahleh ke'n zaw kuapeuh etlahna lungsim toh numei en in, alungsim in angkawm ahi chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Na mit taklam in hon hihpukleh, khelkhia inla paihmang in; na pumpi Gehenna a pai sang in na pumpi a hiang khat manthat nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
Na khut taklam in hon hihpukleh, tankhia inla paihmang in; na pumpi a Gehenna a pai sang in, na pumpi a hiang khat manthat nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
"Kuapeuh zi ma in kimakna lai akiang ah pia heh, leng akichi.
Ke'n zaw kuapeuh kingaihna ziak hilou a zi ma in amah angkawmsak ahi, kuapeuh maksa nei nawn angkawm ahi chih ka hon hilh ahi.
"Nidanglai in mite kiang ah, 'Zuau in kichiam ke'nla, Toupa kiang ah na kichiamnate tangtun zaw in,' akichi chih leng na zata uhi.
Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi, chiam himhim kichiam kei un; van lou in kichiam kei un, huai Pathian laltutphah ahi ngal a; lei lou in kichiam sam kei un, huai akhe ngakna ahi.
Jerusalem lou in kichiam sam kei un, huai Kumpipa thupitak khopi ahi.
Na lutang lou in na kichiam ding ahi sam kei, samzang khat lel leng na hihngou in, na hihvom thei ngal kei uhi.
Na thugen uh, 'Ahi, hi henla,' 'Hilou, hilou,' hi vanglak hen, akan-aval zaw gitlouhna asuak ahi.
"Mit sik in mit, ha sik in ha, akichi chih na zata uhi.
Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi. Migilou nang kei un; na taklam biang bengte, alehlam leng doh zaw un.
Kuapeuh in na lak ah thusia bawl ut in, na puanak lak atupleh, na puanza leng lasak ngal in.
Huan mel khat pai dia hon phut kiang ah mel nih pai in.
Ahon ngen kiang ah pia inla, nang lak a leitawi nuam kiheisan ke'n.
"Na vengte it inla, na melmate hua in, akichi chih na zata uhi.
Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi, na melmate uh it unla, hon sawite thumsak un.
Na Pa uh van a om tate na hihtheihna ding un. Ama'n migiloute leh mihoihte tung ah anisa asuaksak a, midiktatte leh diktatloute tung ah leng vuah azusak hi.
Nou hon itte kia na it un, kipahman bang ahia na muh ding uh? Siahkhon mite'n leng huchibang in ahih sam kei ua hia?
Huan na unaute kia uh chibai na buk un bang na hihtam tuan ua ahia? Zentelte'n leng hichibang in ahih sam kei ua hia?
Huchi in na Pa uh van a om ahoihkim sipsip bang in na hoihkim sipsip ding uh ahi."
"Na diktatna nasepte uh mite ma a, mihing mitmuh ding a hih lou ding in pilvang un; huchi lou in zaw na Pa uh van a om kiang ah kipahman na nei kei ding uh.

"Huchi in mi kiang a thilpiak na piak in, milepchiahte'n mite phat alohtheihna ding ua sinagogte leh kongzing a ahih nak bang un na ma uah pengkul mut kei un. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amaute'n apahtakman uh angahta uh.
Nang zaw mi kiang a thilpiak na piak in, na khut taklam in ahih na khut veilam in thei kei hen;
na thilpiak aguk ahihtheihna ding in. Huchi in na Pa aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.

"Huan na thum chiang un milepchiahte bang in na hih ding uh ahi kei; mi'n amuhtheihna ding un, sinagogte leh kongzing kathuam laitak khawng ah dingh kawm a thum a-ut se uhi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amaute'n apahtakman uh angahta uh.
Nang zaw na thum chiang in, na dantan sunggil a lut in, na kongkhak khak inla, na Pa aguk a om kiang ah thum in. Huchi in na Pa aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.
"Huan na thum un, Zentelte bang in gentuan mawkmawk kei un; apau tam ziak ua zak a om ding akisa uhi.
Huaiziak in amaute bang in om kei un, amah na nget ma ua na Pa un bangbang ahia na poimoh uh theigige ahi.”
Huchi in nou zaw hichibang in thum un: "Ka Pa uh van a om, na min kizahtak hen.
Na gam hong tung hen. Na deihlam van a akihih bang in, lei ah leng kihih hen.
Niteng ka nek khop uh an hon pia in.
Ka tung ua khialte ka ngaihdam bang un, nang leng ka khelhna uh hon ngaidam in.
Khemna ah hon pilut ke'nla, gilou lak ah hon hu zaw in, lalgam leh thilbawltheihna leh thupina Tangtawn a nang a ahih ziak in, Amen," chi in.
"Mi atatleknate uh na ngaihdam uleh, na Pa uh van a om in leng hon ngaidam sam ding hi.
Himahleh mite tatleknate na ngaihdam kei ngal un, na Pa un na tatleknate uh angaidam sam kei ding hi.

"An na ngolh un leng, milepchiahte bang in nguimel pu kei un; amau zaw mite mitmuh a an ngawl a akilat theihna ding un, amel uh anguisak nak uhi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, apahtakman uh angahta uhi.
Nou zaw, an na ngolh chiang un na lu uh sathau nilh unla, na mai uh phiat un.
Huchi in na Pa uh aguk a om mitmuh lou ngal ah mihing mitmuh in an ngawl na bang kei ding ua; huchi in na Pa uh aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.
"Lei a, leikha leh tui-ek in aneksiatna ah, gutate'n phenvang a agukna uah gou kikhol kei un.
Van ah, leikha leh tui-ek in aneksiatlouhna ah, gutate'n aphen ua aguklouhna uah, gou kikhol zaw un.
Na gou omna peuh uah na lungtang uh leng a-om ding hi.
"Pumpi khawnvak mit ahi; huchi a na mit achimleh avek in na pumpi atansuak ding hi.
Na mit asiatleh na pumpi avek in amial khin vek ding. Huchi in na sung a vak om pen mial hileh nak mial na tel in chia!
"Kuamah in heutu nih nna asemkop thei kei; khat hua in khat a-it ding; ahihkeileh, khat gum in khat asimmoh ding. Pathian leh sum nna na semkop thei kei ding uh.

"Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi. Bang ahia ka nek ding, bang ahia ka dawn ding, chi in na hinna thu uh leh; bang ahia ka silh ding, bang ahia ka ten ding, chi in na pumpi thu uh lunghimoh kei un. Nek ding sang in hinna athupizaw kei a hia? Silh-leten sang in pumpi leng athupizaw kei a hia?
Tungleng vasate en un; buh atuh kei ua, a-at kei uh, buh inn ah leng aseklut sam kei uh. Himahleh na Pa uh van a om in amaute avak hi. Noute amau sang a nakpitak a manphazaw hilou na hi uh maw?
Huan noute lak ah lunghihmoh ziak a kua'n ahia ama dunglam tong khat a hihsang thei tuan?
"Huan silh-le-ten thu bang ding a lunghimoh na hi ua? Gamlak lili pak khandan hoihtak in ngaihtuah un; nna asem kei ua, khau leng akhek kei uh.
Himahleh, ka hon hilh ahi, Solomon hial leng athupina tengteng a akizep in hiai lili pak khat bang in zep in a-om kei hi.
Huchi in gamlak loupa, tuni a hing a, azing a thuk a khul mai ding bawn Pathian in huchi lawmlawm a azepleh, aw nou gintawmte, silh-le-ten ding hon pe tawk na lou ding hiam?
"Huchi in bang ahia i nek ding, ahihkeileh bang ahia i dawn ding? Ahihkeileh bang silh in ahia i om ding chi in lunghimoh kei un.
Zentelte'n huai tengteng azong uhi. Hiaite tengteng na poimoh uh chih na Pa uh van a om in theigige ahi.
Agam leh ama diktatna zong masa un, huchi in hiaite tengteng ahon piak behlap ding hi.
"Huchi in azing a ding lunghimoh kei un; azing in amah a ding akilunghimoh tawm ding ziak in. Ni khat a ding in ni khat buaina ahun lel hi.”
"Vai hawmsak kei un, vai hawmsak na hihlouhna ding un.
Na vai hawmsak mah bang un hawmsak in na om ding uh, na tehna ngei mah un hon tehsak nawn ding uh.
Huan bangziak a, nangmah mit a singtum om ngaihtuah lou a, na unau mit a ninneng neuchik mu na hia?
Bangchi in na unau kiang ah, na mit a kipan huai ninneng neuchik hon lakhesak ve, na chih theih ding? Ngai in, nangmah mit mahmah ah singtum a-om nilouh ngal a.
Milepchiah, na mit a kipan singtum lakhe masa in; huchi in na unau mit a kipan ninneng neuchik lakkhiak ding kichiantak in na mu thei ding hi.
"Ui kiang ah thil siangthou pe kei un; vok ma ah na tuikepsuang uh pai kei un, achilse kha ding ua, huan kihei in nang ahon balzak kha ding uh.
"Ngen un, piak in na om ding uh; zong un, na mu ding uh; kiu un, hon honsak ding uh.
Kuapeuh angen in angah a; kuapeuh azong in amu a; akiu peuhmah honsak in a-om ding hi.
Ahihleh noute kuapeuh na tapa un tanghou ngen taleh, kua'n suang pe ding na hi ua?
Ahihkeileh ngasa ngen taleh, kua'n gul pe ding na hi ua?
Huchi hileh nou migilou in bawn, na tate uh thil hoih piakdan na theih un, na Pa uh van a om in angente thil hoih pe zaw sem lou ding hia?
"Huaiziak in mi'n na tung ua thil bangpeuh hih ding a na deih bang uh, mi tung ah leng hih sam un; huai Dan leh zawlneite thu ahi him hi.
"Kong kochik ah lut un; manthatna a paina kong aza a, alampi leng alian a, huai a lut tam leng atam mahmah uhi.
Hinna a paina kong akochik a, alampi aneu a, atawnte tawmchik ahi uh.
"Zawlnei takloute lak ah pilvang un, amaute belam vun silh in na kiang uah ahong pai nak ua, asunglam uh nge duhgawl pipi ahi uh.
Amaute agah uah na thei mai ding uh. Khaulingnei gui ah grep gah alou ngei ua hia? Lenling ah theipi a lou ngei ua hia?
Huchi mah bang in sing hoih peuhmah agah ahoih a; sing sia agah ase nak.
Sing hoih agah ase thei kei, sing sia agah ahoih thei sam kei hi.
Sing chih gah hoih lou aphuk ua, mei ah apai uhi.
Huaiziak in amaute agah uah na thei mai ding uhi.
"Toupa, Toupa, hon chi na peuh van-gam ah alut kei ding uh; ka Pa van a om deihlam hihte alut ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in mi tampi'n, Toupa, na min in thute ka gen ua, na min in dawite ka delhkhia ua, na min in thillamdang tampi ka hih zel uh hilou hiam? achi ding uh.
Huai hun chiang in, 'Nou thil gilou hihte aw, ka hon thei ngei kei, ka kiang a kipan paimang un, chi in amaute ka hilh ding hi.'
"Huchi in michih hiai ka thu za a, zui peuhmah, mipil suangpi tung a inn lammi toh ka tehpih ding hi.
Vuahpi hong zu in tui ahong khang a, huih ahong nung a, huai inn hon mut zialzial a; himahleh achim kei; suangpi tung a lepkip ahih ziak in.
Huan michih, hiai ka thu za a zom lou peuhmah, mihai piaunel tung a inn lammi toh ka teh ding hi.
Vuah hong zu in tui ahong khang a, huih ahong nung a, huai inn hon mut zialzial a; achimta a, huai inn anakchip ngel hi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thu agen zoh in, mipi'n athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uh;
laigelhmite bang lou a, thuneihna neitak a amaute thu ahilh ziak in.
Huan tang a kipan a ahong paisuk nung in mipi tampitak in amah azuita uhi.
Ngai in, akiang ah phak khat ahong pai a, "Toupa, na utleh na hon hihsiangthou thei hi,” chi in abia hi.
Jesu'n sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangthouta in," achi hi. Thakhat in phak hong siangthou pah hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuamah hilh lou ding in pilvang in, himahleh siampu kiang ah va kilak inla, Mosi in thilpiak ding achihte lan in; amau hon theihchetna ding un," achi hi.
Kapernaum a lut in, akiang ah sepaih zaheutu ahong pai hi.
"Toupa, inn ah ka sikha alum maimah a, nakpitak a hihnat in a-om," chi in ana ngen hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Ka hong pai dia, ka hihdam ding," achi hi.
Sepaih zaheutu'n, "Toupa, ka insung na lutna tak ahi kei, thu kia gen lechin ka sikha adam mai ding.

Kei leng mi thunuai a om ka hi a, ka nuai ah sepaihte a-om ua, 'nang pai in,' ka chihleh apai zel a; midang kiang ah, 'nang hong pai in,' ka chihleh ahong pai zel; ka sikha kiang ah leng, 'hiai hih in' ka chihleh ahih zel," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jesu'n hiai thu azak in lamdang asa a, amah zuite kiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, Israelte lak ah hichi tel a ginna thupi ka mu kei hi.
K'on hilh ahi, suahlam leh tumlam a pan mi tampi ahong pai ding ua, van-gam ah Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang ah atu ding uh.
Gam tate zaw polam mial ah paihkhiak in a-om ding uh; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n sepaih zaheutu kiang ah, "Paita in, na gin bang in na tung ah tung hen," achi a, huchi in sikha adamta hi.
Peter inn ah Jesu alut a, azi nu khosik a lum amu hi.
Akhut akhoihsak a, akhosik adaita; athou a, a-nna asepsakta hi.
Huan nitaklam ahong hih in akiang ah dawimatte tampi ahon pi ua; thu in dawite adelhkhia a, damlou tengteng ahihdam hi.
Zawlnei Isai in, "Amah ngei in i hatlouhnate ala a, i natnate apua," chi a agen hong tangtun theihna ding in.
Jesu'n akimvel a mipi tampitak amuh in, gal khat lam a pai ding in thu apia hi.
Laigelhmi khat ahong pai a, akiang ah, "Heutupa, na paina peuh ah ka hon zui ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sehalte'n kua anei ua, tungleng vasate'n leng bu anei uh, himahleh Mihing Tapa in zaw lungakna ding mun anei kei," achi hi.
Huan anungzuite lak a midang khat in, "Toupa, ka pa hon vuisak phot in," achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang ah, "Hon zui in; misi in amau misi kivui uhen," achi hi.
Huan long sung ah alut a, anungzuite'n azui uhi.
Ngai in, tuipi ah huihpi hattak ahong nung a, huchi in tuikihot in long atumtou a; himahleh amah a-ihmu hi.
Huan akiang a hong pai in aphawng ua, "Toupa, hon hondam in, mangthang ding ka kei uhiam,” achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou ginglahte aw, bangziak a lau na hi ua?" achi hi. Huchi in athou a, huih leh tuipi atai a; huan ahong dai sipsipta hi.
Huan mite'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi. "Hiai mi bangchidan ahia, huih leh tuipi nangawn in athu aman uh?" achi uhi.
Huan gal khat lam Gadaren mite gam atun in dawimat nih, han a kipan hong pawt in, ahon tuak ua; ahang mahmah ua, huchi in huai lampi ah kuamah apai thei kei uhi.
Ngai in, amau, "Pathian Tapa kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Hunchiam tun ma a koute hon gawt ding a hong pai na hi maw?" chi in akikou uhi.
Huan a-omna ua kipan gamla khop ah vokhon tampi agamta uhi.
Huan dawite'n, "N'on delhkhiak aleh huai a vokhonte sung ah hon lutsak in," chi in akiang ah nakpi in angen uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Pai un," achi a, huchi in ahong pawtkhia ua, vok sung ah alut ua; ngai in, vokhon tengteng tui gei ken lak ah ataisuk ua, tuipi a tailut in, tui ah amangthangta uhi.
Huan ganvulte atai ua, khua ah apai ua, dawimatte tung a thil hong tungte bangkim ahilhta uhi.
Ngai in, akhua in Jesu mu ding in ahong pawt ua; amah amuhtak un agam ua kipan a pawtkhe ding in nakpi in angen uhi.
Huan long ah lut in agalkah a, ama khua ahong tung hi.
Ngai in, mizeng khat damlou, lupna a lum ahon zawng ua; huchi in Jesu'n aginna uh mu in, zeng damloupa kiang ah, "Tapa, khamuangtak in om in, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
Ngai in, laigelhmi kuate hiam akingaihtuah ua, "Hiai mi'n Pathian agensia," achi uh.
Huchi in Jesu'n angaihtuahte uh athei a, "Bangziak a na lungtang ua gilou ngaihtuah na hi ua? achi hi.
'Na khelhnate ngaihdam hi hen' chih leh 'thou inla, khe in pai in, chih koi abaihlamzaw?'
Himahleh Mihing Tapa in leitung ah khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," zeng damloupa kiang ah, "Thou in, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in,” achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, a-inn ah apaita hi.
Himahleh, mipi'n amuh un lamdang asa ua, huchibang hihtheihna mihingte kiang a pepa, Pathian apahtawita uhi.
Huai a kipan Jesu apai zel a, siah piakna mun a tu, mi khat, amin Matthai amu a; akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi a, huchi in athou a, azuita hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-inn a ankuang a-um lai in, ngai in, siahkhonte leh mikhial tampi ahong pai ua, Jesu leh anungzuite a-umpih uhi.
Pharisaite'n huai amuh un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangziak a na heutupa un siahkhonte leh mikhialte kiang a ne ahia?" achi uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n huai azaktak in, "Midamtheite'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamtheiloute'n akiphamohzaw uhi.
Huchi in 'kithoihna deih lou in zahngaihna ka deih hi,' chih, a-omdan va zil un, midiktatte sam dia hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte sam ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi.
Huchih lai in akiang ah Johan nungzuite ahong pai ua, "Bangziak a kou leh Pharisaite'n an ngawl zelzel ua, na nungzuite'n ngawl lou uh ahia?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupite kiang a apasal a-om lai teng moupite'n asuun thei ua hia? Himahleh, akiang ua kipan apasal pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai hun chiang in an angawl ding uhi.
Huan kuamah in puan lui puan tui khai louh them in athuap ngei kei; athuapna in puan akaihkek ding ziak in, ahong nakkek zaw sem ding hi.

Kuamah in uain thak savun uain thawl lui ah athun ngei kei uh; huchi lou in zaw savun thawlte apuakkek dia, uain abo dia, savun thawl leng hong kise ding; huaiziak in savun uain thawl thak ah uain thak athun zaw ua, huchi in hoihtak in a-om tuaktuak hi,” achi hi.
Huan akiang ua agen laitak in, ngai in, vaihawmpa khat ahong pai a, amah bia in, "Tu mah in ka tanu asi a; himahleh hong pai inla, atung ah na khut koih lechin ahong hing nawn ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Jesu athou a, azuita a, nungzuite'n leng azui uhi.
Ngai in, numei khat kum sawm leh kum nih sipawt damlou, anung ah hong pai a, apuan mong akhoihsak hi.
"Apuan mongkai khoih lel leng, hihdam in ka om mai ding," alungsim in achi hi.
Huan Jesu akihei a, amah amu a, "Ka tanu, khamuangtak in om in; na ginna na dampih hi," achi hi. Huchi in numeinu huai dakkal a kipan adamta hi.
Vaihawmpa inn ah Jesu alut a, tamngai tumte leh mipi thawm ngaih vengvungte ava muh in,
"Pawt un; naupang asi kei, ihmu ahi zaw," achi hi. Amau bel amah anuihsan maimah uh.
Himahleh mipite polam a apawtsak zoh in amah alut a, naupang khut ah alen a, hong thou maimah hi.
Hiai tanchin huai gam tengteng ah athangkheta hi.
Huai a kipan Jesu apai zel a, mittaw nih in, "David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in," chi a kikou in azui uhi.
Huan inn a alutleh akiang ah mittawte ahong pai ua; Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai hihthei ding in na hon gingta ua hia?" achi hi. Amaute'n akiang ah, "Gingta e, Toupa," achi uhi.
Ama'n amit uh akhoihsak a, "Na gintak bang un na tung uah tung hen," achi hi.
Huchi in amitte uh hong vakta hi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kuamah theih louh ding in pilvang un," achi bilbel hi.
Himahleh amau apawt ua, huai gam tengteng ah atanchin agenthangta uhi.
Huai a pan apawt laitak un, ngai in, dawimat pau thei lou khat akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
Huai dawi adelhkhiaktak in pau thei lou tuh ahong pauta a; mipite'n lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Israelte lak ah hichibang akimu ngei kei hi,” achi uhi.
Pharisaite'n bel, "Dawi kumpipa ziak in ahi, dawite adelhkhiak nak," achi uh.
Huan Jesu'n asinagogte ua hilh a, lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, damlouhna chiteng leh natna chiteng ahihdam a, kholian leh khoneu tengteng atawn vialvial hi.
Huchi in mipite amuh in, chingtu nei lou belamte bang a gimthuak leh dalh a a-om ziak un alainat mahmah hi.
Anungzuite kiang ah, "Buh lak ding atam mahmah a, himahleh sem mite atawm uhi.
Huaiziak in abuh la dia sem dingte sawl ding in buh neipa kiang ah ngen un," achi hi.
Judah kumpipa Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiah vaihawm lai a Moreseth mi Mikah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung, Samaria khua leh Jerusalem kho tungtang amuh thu.
Nou, mite aw, na vek un za unla; Aw lei leh asung a om tengteng aw, ngaikhia un; Toupa PATHIAN, Toupa atempul siangthou a kipan, nou dem in na tungthu uh theihpihpa hi hen.
Ngai dih ua, TOUPA amun a kipan in ahong pawt a, ahong paisuk ding a, lei mun sangte achil ngal ding hi.
Mei kiangchin a khuainun bang leh munken a tui kikhohkhia bang mai in, tangte anuai ah azul ding a, munzangte akhangkham ding.
Hiai tengteng Jakobte tatlekna ziak leh Israel inkote khelhna ziak ahi. Jakobte tatlekna bang ahia oi? Samaria ahi kei maw? Judah mun sangte bang ahia? Jerusalem ahi kei maw?
Huaiziak in Samaria gam a thil sia omkhawm bang in ka bawl ding a, grephuan mun bang mai in; huai mun a suangte lui phaizang ah ka khukkhe ding a, asuangphumte ka dawksak ding hi.

Amilim bawltawm tengteng sukkhap vek ahi ding a, akizuakna mante mei a halmang ahi ding a, amilim tengteng ka hihgawp ding; kizuakna man ding in ala vek ngal a, kizuakna man mah in apang nawn ding uhi.
Hiai ziak in ka kap ding a, ka mau tuaituai ding a, kisuah leh vuaktang in ka om ding; sehalte bang in ka kikou ding a, vangawngsaute bang in ka thum ding hi.
Aliamna hihdam theih ahi kei; Judah gam atungta ngal a; ka mite kongpi, Jerusalem hial atungta hi.
Gath ah gen kei unla kap het kei un; Beth-le-aphrah ah leivui lak ah kikhuk un.
Aw Saphir mi, vuaktang leh zumtak in paimang in; Zaanan mite Beth-ezel kahna ziak in ahong pawtkhe kei ding ua; huai a bitna mun a-om louh ziak in.
Maroth mi in tanhoih tan angaklah tuntun hi; TOUPA kiang a kipan thil hoih lou Jerusalem kongpi tan a ahong tunsuk ziak in.
Aw Lakish mi, kangtalai sakol hattak henden in; amah pen Zion tanu khelhna kipatna ahi. Israelte tatlekna nang a muh ahi.
Huaiziak in Moreseth-gath kiang ah kikhakna thilpiak na piak ding ahi; Akzib innte Israel gam kumpipate a ding in khemna ahi ding hi.
Aw Maresa mi, nang hon zoutu na kiang ah ka hon pi ding; Israelte thupina Adullam pha in ahong pai ding hi.
Kimetgiau inla, na ta deihtakte ziak in kimetgiau in; musane bang in kihihgiau semsem in; na kiang a kipan sal a pi in a-omta uhi.
Alupna tung ua thulimlouhna gelmi leh thil hoih lou ngaihtuahkhemi tung agik hi; zingsang a khua avak in huai ahih zel uhi.
Miloute eng in alaksak ua; innte a-eng ua, alaksak zel uhi; mi leh a-inkote uh mi leh agoutan un anuaisiah uhi.

Huaiziak in TOUPA'n hichi in achi: “Ngai dih, hiai inko tung ah thil hoih lou ka gel ahi, huai a kipan in na ngawng uh na suan kei ding ua, kisatheitak in apai nawn kei ding uh; hun hoih lou ahih ding ziak in.

Huai ni chiang in noute dem in gentehna abawl ding ua, kahla khasiathuai a sam in; "Suksiat in i om vekta ua, ka mite thil tan akilamdangta; kei kipan gam lakmang ahi a; helhatmi kiang ah i lou uh hawmzak ahita," achi ding uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA mite kikhawmte lak ah aisan a khau a tehsak mi kuamah na nei kei ding uhi.
Thu gen kei un, chi in agen zel ua, hiai mite kiang ah thu agen kei ding uh; gensiatna adai kei ding hi.
Aw Jakob inkote aw, TOUPA kha nehden in a-om a hia? Hiaite athilhih chih ding ahi maw? Diktak a om zel mi tung ah ka thute'n thil hoih ahih kei maw?
Himahleh ka mite tunai chin in melma bang in ahong dingkhia uhi; kidou ding lungsim a nei lou, muangtak a vialvakte lak a kipan in apuansilh puanaktualte uh na suahsak uhi.
Ka mi numeite a-inn nuamtak ua kipan na delhkhia ua; anaupang neute a kipan ka thupina alamang den uhi.
Thou unla, paimang un; hiai khawlna mun ding ahi kei a; siatna thupitak tan ahi, buahna a-om ziak in.
Mi kuahiam in kha a om chi a zuauthu gen in, "Uain leh zu na taina ding uh ahi," chi in hong gen taleh huai mi, mipite zaknop lel thugen zawlnei ahi ding hi.

Aw Jakobte, na vek un ka hon samkhawm ding a; Israel khosuak-sunte ka pikhawm ding a; Bozrah khua belam bang a koihkhawm ding; ganhonte aloupa mun ua om bang in, mipi ahih ziak un achiak zuazua ding uh.
Ama uah lampi phuvangpa apai a; aphu pailet ua, kongkhak pha in apai zel ua, huai ah apaikhia uhi; akumpipa uh ama uah apai a, TOUPA'N ama uh akai hi.
Aw nou Jakob heutute leh Israel inkote vaihawmte aw: Ngaikhia unla, ka hon ngen hi ka chi ahi; vaihawmdan na theih ding uh hilou hia?
Thil hoih na hua ua, thil hoih lou na it ua, avun uh na hawksak ua, aguh ua kipan in sa na leukhia uh.
Ka mite sa ne in; avun uh na lip ua, aguh uh na hihtansak ua; ahi, sa uina bel sung a sa atnen bang in huan ding in na atnen uhi.
Huai hun chiang in TOUPA asam ding ua, himahleh amau adawng kei ding; ahi, huai hun chiang in athilhih ua ahihhoih louhdan bang un, amau a kipan amai asel ding hi.
Ka mite thil hihkhialsak mi, nek ding banghiam piak a a-om chiang ua, "Muanna" chi a kikou a, huai bang peloute peuhmah kidouna thu a vaulau zawlneite tungtang thu TOUPA'N hichi in achi:

"Huaiziak in kilakna na neihlouhna ding un noute kiang zan hong tung hi; aisan na bawl theihlouhna ding un na kiang uah mialna ahong om ding a; zawlneite a ding in ni atum ding a, amau tung ah sun amial ding hi.
Mutheite azum ding ua, aisan siamte azahlak ding uh, avek un amuk uh ahum ding uh; Pathian in adawn louh ziak in."
Himahleh Jakob kiang ah atatlekna uh theisak ding leh Israelte kiang ah akhelhna uh theisak ding in TOUPA kha ziak athilhihtheihnate, vaihawmnate, hatnate in ka dim hi.
Nou Jakob inkote heutute leh Israel inkote vaihawmmi, vaihawmna kih a, dikna chiteng lumlet mite aw, hiai ngaikhia un, ka hon ngen ahi.
Sisan in Zion leh ginatlouhna in Jerusalem alam uh.

Huai ah heutute'n kipahman lamen in vai ahawm ua, siampute'n loh lamen in asinsak ua, azawlneite'n dangka lamen in ai asan uhi; huchi in leng, TOUPA alak uah a-om kei a hia? I tung uah thil hoih lou ahong tung kei ding, chi in TOUPA tung ah akinga uhi.
Huaiziak in Zion, noute ziak in, lou bang a leileh ahi ding a, Jerusalem thilsia omkhawm ahi ding a, tang a inn omna gammang bang ahi ding.

Himahleh ni nanung chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA' inn omna tang, tang lian tungte hihkip in a-om ding a, mualte tung ah tawisang in a-om ding; huai ah tawisang in a-om ding; huai ah chichihte apai zungzung ding uh.

Nam tampite apai ding ua, hong unla, TOUPA tang ah, Jakob' Pathian inn ah i hohtou ding uh; huchi in ama'n alampi tanchinte hon sinsak ding a, alampite ah i pai ding ua, achi ding uh; Zion a kipan dan thu ahong pawt ding a. TOUPA thu bel Jerusalem a kipan in ahong pawt ding hi.

Ama'n chi tampi lak ah vai ahawm ding a, gamlapi a nam hattak leng asal ding; anamsaute uh leilehna mukzum ding in asek ding ua, ateipite uh theikung attanna temkawi ding in asek ding uh; namdang in namdang tung ah namsau alikta kei ding a, kidoudan leng asinsakta kei ding uh.
Michihte agrepgui nuai uah leh atheipi kung nuai uah atu ding ua; kuamah in alausak kei ding uh; Sepaihte' TOUPA kam in agenta ngal a.
Mi chih amau pathian min chiat in a-om ding ua, ei leng TOUPA i Pathian min in tangtawn tangtawn in i om ding hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Huai ni chiang in khebaite ka kaikhawm ding a, delhmang a om leh sukgim a omte ka kaikhawm ding," chi in.
Akhosuaksunte ka khosuaksak ding a, gamlapi a delhmang a omte bel nam hattak in ka bawl ding; tuban siah Zion tang ah tangtawn in TOUPA'N atung uah vai ahawmta ding hi.
Aw nang, ganchinna insang, Zion tanu tenna bitna tang, na kiang ah lalgam masa ahong tung ding; ahi, Jerusalem tanu kiang ngei ah lalgam ahong tung ding hi.
Bang achia hichi nak kah na hia? Na sung ah kumpipa a-om kei a hia, nang hon gensakpa amangthangta a hia, numei nauvei bang a lunggimna in nang ahon mat?

Aw Zion tanu, numei nauvei suak ding bang in natna thuak in vei in; khopi a kipan in na pawtkhe ding a, gam ah na teng ding a, Babulon tanpha a pai ding na hi ngal a, huai ah hotkhiak in na om ding a, huai ah na melmate khut a kipan TOUPA'N nang ahon hunkhe ding hi.
Tu in tampi nang hon dou in akikhawm ua, hihbuai in om henla, i mit in Zion tung a alunggulhpen mu hen, achi uhi.
Himahleh TOUPA ngaihtuahnate athei kei ua, aphatsakna leng atheisiam sam kei uh; phual a buhphal koihkhawm bang in amau akaikhawmta ngal a.

Aw Zion tanu, thou inla chil in; sik bang in na kii ka bawl ding a, dal bang in na khepek ka bawl ding; huan mi tampite na satnen ding a; athil neihte uh TOUPA a dia na koihtuam ding ahi, asum uh lei kumpi TOUPA a ding in akoihtuam ding uhi.
Aw sepaihhonte' tanu, tu in sepaih hon kaikhawm inla; amau ahon umsuakta ua; Israelte vaihawmpa abiang ah sikchiang in asun ding uhi.

Himahleh nang, Bethlehem Ephratha aw, Judah gam a sang tampi lak a tel ding in neu tawk lechin leng, nang a kipan in Israelte vaihawmpa ding kei a ding in ahong pawt ding; ahong pawtna sawtpi, tang lai nite a kipan ahi.
Huaiziak in nauveimi'n asuahsak mateng amau alehngatsan ding; huchi in a-unau khosuaksunte Israel suante kiang ah akik nawn ding uhi.
Amah adingh dia, TOUPA a Pathian min thupina ngei in; amaute a-omta ding ua; amah lah lei tawp pha in athupi ding hi.
Huan hiai mi kilemna ahi ding; Assuria mi agam ua ahong a, i kumpipa uh innte ahon sik chiang in, amah dou ding in belampu sagih leh mithupi giat i kitelkhe ding uhi.
Assuria gam namsau in ahihse ding ua, Nimrod gam a lutna ahihse lai ding uh; huan ama'n, i gam ua Assuria mi hong pai a, i gam chiang uh ahong sik hun chiang in, amah a kipan in ahon hunkhe ding hi.
Jakob mi khosuaksunte chi tampi lak ah TOUPA a kipan a daitui kia bang leh loupa tung a vuahzu bang in a-om ding uh; huai in mihing angak kei a, mihing tapate angak sam kei hi.

Jakob khosuaksunte namte lak ah leh chi tampite lak ah gamnuai sate lak a humpinelkai bang leh belamhon lak a humpinelkai lun lai bang in a-om ding; ama'n apaisuak peuhmahte asikden a, abotnen a, humbit ding leng kuamah a-om kei uh.
Na khut nang hon doute tung ah lik in om henla, na melma tengteng hihman in om hen.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N achi, nang a kipan in na sakolte ka hihmang ding a, na kangtalaite ka hihse ding;
na khopite ka hihmang ding a, na kulhhat tengteng ka hihchim ding;
na khut a kipan bumsiamte ka hihmang ding a; aisan siamte ka hihmang ding; aisan siamte na nei nawnta kei ding hi;
nang a kipan na milim bawltawmte leh na suangphuhte ka hihmang ding a; na khutsuakte na be nawn kei ding hi.
Nang a kipan Asherahte ka botkhe ding a; na khopite ka hihse ding hi.
Huan thu ngaikhe lou namte tung ah hehna leh thangpaihna in phulakna ka pichingsak ding hi.
Tu in TOUPA thugen ngaikhia un: Thou inla, tangte ma ah lang in, mualte'n na aw ngaikhia uhen,
Aw tangte aw, TOUPA hon hekna ngaikhia unla, nou leitung kingaknate aw, ngaikhia un; TOUPA amite toh akilang a, Israelte ahekna agen ding hi.
Aw ka mite aw, na tung uah bang ka hihta a ahia? Bang lam in ahia ka hon hihgim? Hon gen dih ua.
Aigupta gam a kipan in nou ka hon pikhia a, saltanna inn a pan nou ka hon tankhia a; na ma uah Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam ka sawl hi.
Aw ka mite aw, TOUPA thilhih diktat na theihna ding un, Moab kumpipa Balak thusawm leh Boer tapa Balaam in adawndan, Sittim a kipan a Gilgal pha a thil omdante khawng tu in theigige un.
Bang toh ahia TOUPA ma a ka hong pai ding a, Pathian tungnung ma a ka kun ding? Haltum thillatte, bawngnou kum khat a upate toh ama ah ka hong pai dia hia?
TOUPA belamtal sang tampi hiam sathau lui singkhatte hiam ah alungkim dia hia? Ka tatlekna ziak in ka tachil pia in, ka khelhna ziak in pumpi gah ka pe dia hia?
Aw mihing, ahoih nang ahon ensakta hi; TOUPA'N nang ahon phut bang ahia? Diktak a hih leh zahngaihna it leh na Pathian toh kiniamkhiaktak a tonkhawm ahi kei maw?
TOUPA'N khopi asam hi, pilna nei mi'n na min laudan asiam ding; khetbuk leh aseppa limsak un.
Migilou insung ah gitlouhna a kaihkhawm goubawmte leh tehna diklou kihhuaitak a-om lai hia?
Bukna diklou zangte leh khemna dia gikdan tehna diklou zangte siangthou ka chi ding a hia?
Huai a mihausate lah hiamgamna in adim ua, huai a tengte'n zuau agen ua, akamsung ua alei uh khemhat ahi.
Huaiziak in ke'n leng nakpi a hon limsak in ka hon khen a; na khelhna ziak in ka hon hihgam hi.
Na ne ding a, himahleh na tai kei ding; na kiang ah na daina a-om ding a; na khol ding a, himahleh abit kei ding; na kholsate namsau kiang ah paimangpih ding in ka pe ding hi.
Na tuh ding a, himahleh na la kei ding; olive gahte na chil ding a, himahleh athau na nilh kei ding; grep chil mah lechin, a-uain na dawn kei ding.

Omri dan thusehte lah na vom gige ngal a, Ahab inkuan thuhilhna tengteng zui in amau lemtheihna ah na pai uhi; huchi in mun gamgawp in ka hon bawl sinta, na sung a tengte simmoh thuak in soisak in a-om ding uhi.
Ka tung gik hina mai e! Nipithei sekkhawm hun lai a om bang leh grep loh hun lai a grep maih loh ding bang ka hi ngal a; gahbom nek ding a-om kei; ka hinna in theipi min masa alunggulh hi.
Pathian limsakmi lei a kipan amang ua, mihing lak ah midiktak a-om kei uh; sisan suah ding in atang vek ua; michih in amau unau len in agem uhi.
Akhutte uh thil hoih lou tung a thanuamtak a hih ding in anga ua; kumpipa'n thilpiak angiat a, vaihawmpa'n anegu a; milian in alungsim thilhihkhelhna agenkhia a; huai in akithutuak uhi.
Alak ua mihoihpen loulingnei bang ahi a; midikpen leng dailing nei sang in ahoih kei zaw; nang veng mite ni, veh a na om ni ngei ahong tung hi; huai tuh amangbat ni uh ahi ding hi.
Lawm ah muang kei unla, makaimi ah ginna koih kei un; na angsung a omnu a kipan in na kam kongkhakte veng in.
Tapa in pa min ahihsia a, tanu in anu adou a, mou in api adou ngal a; mihing melmate zaw amah inkote mah ahi uh.
Huaiziak in ke'n zaw TOUPA lam ka en ding a; ka hotdamna Pathian ka ngak ding; ka Pathian in ahon ngaikhe ding hi.
Aw ka melma, ka puk hun chiang in hon awi ke'n; ka thounawn ding; mial a ka tut in leng TOUPA kei a ding in vak ahi ding hi.
TOUPA tung a thil ka hihkhelh ziak in, alung hihlouhna mahmah ka po ding, ka tungthu ahon genpih a, kei a dia vaihawmna atangtun masiah; vak ah ahon pikhe ding a, huan diktatna ka mu ding hi.
Huchi in ka melma ka kiang a, TOUPA na Pathian koi ah, chipa'n huai amu ding a, zahlakna'n amah atuam ding hi. Ka mite'n amah a-en ding ua; tu'n zaw kongzing buannawi bang a sikden ahita ding hi.
Na kulhbaangte bawlna ni ding leh na gamgi kekletna ni ahong tung ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in Assuria gam leh Aigupta khopi a kipan, Aigupta leh Lui pha hial a kipan, tuipi leh tuipi kikal a kipan leh tang leh tang kikal a kipan na kiang ah ahong pai ding uhi.
Huchipi in gam, asung a tengte ziak leh athilhih uh gah ziak in hihgam ahi ding hi.
Karmel tangkal a gamnuai a lungzuangtak a om na goutan belamhon, na mite na khetbuk zang in vak inla; nidanglai bang in Bashan leh Gilead ah vak in om chiat uhen.
Aigupta gam a kipan a na paikhiak lai bang in akiang ah thillamdang mahmahte ka ensak ding hi.
Namte'n huai amu ding ua, athilhihtheihna tengteng uh azumpih ding uh; amuk uh ahum ding ua, abil uh angong ding hi.

Gul bang in leivui aliak ding ua; bokkhup a vakte bang in a-omna kua ua kipan in ling kawm in ahong pai ding uh; TOUPA i Pathian kiang ah laudan siam kawm in ahong pai ding ua, nang ziak in alau ding uhi.
Nang bang a thulimlouhna ngaidampa leh agoutan khosuaksun tatlekna nelhsiah Pathian kua a-om a? Ahehna tangtawn in avom gige kei; zahngaihna a akipah mahmah ziak in.
Akiheikik nawn ding a, i tung ah hehpihna anei ding; akhenuai ah i thulimlouhnate asikden ding a; nang amaute khelhna tengteng tuipi taw thukpi ah na pailut ding hi.
Nidanglai a ka pu leh pate kiang a na kichiamsa, Jakob kiang ah thutak leh Abraham kiang ah zahngaihna na tangtun ding hi.
Nineveh kho puakgik. Elkosh mi Nahum kilakna bu,
TOUPA zaw mullit hat Pathian leh phulak ching ahi; TOUPA'N phu ala a, hehna in adim hi; TOUPA'N amah dou mite tung ah phu ala a, amelmate a ding in hehna akholkhawm hi.
TOUPA alungnel a, nakpi a thilhihthei ahi, mimohte siam atangsak mahmah kei ding; TOUPA'N pingpei leh huihpi ah alampi anei a, meipite akhe a leivui ahi.
Tuipi asal a, akangtatsak a, lui tengteng leng akangsak khin a; Bashan gam abah a, Karmel tang leh Lebanon tang paklunte avuai uhi.
Amah ziak in tangte aling ua, mualte azulmang ua; ama ah lei avuak a, ahi leitung leh asung a om tengteng toh in.
Alung hihlouhna mai ah kua ahia dingh thei a, ahehna thupitak ah kua ahia om thei ding? Ahehna mei bang a sunbuak ahi a, suangpite akekzaksak vek hi.
TOUPA zaw ahoih a, mangbat ni a kulhkip ahi; amah a aginna uh koih mite athei hi.
Himahleh tui khang luanglet zang in huai mun manthat vekna atungsak ding a, khomial a amelmate delhlut ding in.
TOUPA kalh in bang na gel ua? Bei sipsipna atungsak ahi, haksa nihveina atung kei ding hi.
Lingnok bang a om in a-uain dawn un diahkawt dimdem bang in om mahleh, buhpawl keu bang mai a hihman vek in a-om ding uhi.
Nang a pawt mi khat TOUPA kalh a thil gilou ngaihtuahmi, gitlouhna thuhilhmi a-om hi.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ahat theihtawp un hat mah le uh, tam leng tampi himah le uh, huchipi in leng vatpuk in a-om ding ua, amangthang ding uhi. Hon na hihgim khin mah leng ka hon hihgim nawnta kei ding hi.
Tu'n zaw na kiang a kipan ahakkol ka kitansak ding a, nang gakna khaute ka kitatsak vek ding.

"TOUPA'N na tungtang thu ah thu apia hi, na min chi bang a tuh ahi nawnta kei ding a; na pathiante inn a kipan milim bawltawm leh milim sunte ka hihmangthang ding a; na han ka bawl ding; na gilou ngal a," chi in.
Tangte a tanchinhoih tun a, lemna thu tangkoupihte khe en dih; Aw Judah, na ankuang lui inla, na thuchiamte tangtun in; mi thugina lou in ahon pal paisuak nawn kei ding a; hihmanthat vek ahita hi.
Kitamgawpsakpa doutu na mai ah ahong pawt hi; kigalthuam inla, na lampi veng in, na kawng khauhsak inla na thilhihtheihna hattak in bawlhoih in.
Hihse mite'n Israel thupina hihsia in agrep guite hihtan mah le uh, TOUPA Jakobte thupina ama a bang in atungding nawn ngal ding ahi.
Amihatte lum sansak ahi a, mihangsante asan-au in akivan ua; akisakna ni in kangtalaite kahpasik tet in ate kelkel ua, teipite mulkimhuaitak in aphe zolzol hi.
Kangtalaite kongzing ah atai gomgom a; lamlian zate ah akiphu noknok ua; meisel bang in alang ua, khophia bang in atai zualzual uhi.
Amiliante atheigige a; apai lai un akisuipai ua; baang lam zuan in akinoh ua, kihumbitna ding abawl uhi.
Lui kongkhakte hon ahi a, kumpipa' inn hihsiat in a-om hi.
Huan Huzzab salmat in apaimangpih ua, asikhanute'n a-awm uh tum in vakhu bang a ham in akah uhi.
Nidanglai a kipan Nineveh khua zaw dil a tui luangkhia bang ahi; himahleh ami tampi ataikhe ding ua, khawl in, khawl in, chi in kikou mah le uh kuamah akihei kei ding uh.
Dangkasik gallak in laksak unla unla, dangka-eng leng gallak in laksak un; gou manpha a dim ahih ziak in thil kisekkhawm leh vanhoihte tawi bei ni anei kei ding hi.
Sukvuak in a-om a, avuak keuhkeuh a, asiang sipsip; lungtang azulmang a, khukte akihot ua, kawng tengteng ana tuntun a, amelte amual khin vek hi.
Humpinelkai khosakna mun, humpinelkai pite leh anoute nek ding abalnenna leh alausak ding om lou a humpinelkai leh humpinelkai tekte pai vialvialna koi mun hita ahia?
Humpinelkai tal in anoute kham khop abotnen a, humpinelkai pite a ding in akeilum a, akokhukte uh sa keih in adimsak a, a-omna kokhuk samatte in adimsak hi.

Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih, ka hon dou ahi, akangtalaite ka halkhu vungvung ding a, na humpinelkai noute namsau in ahihmang ding; lei a na sa keih ka sutawp ding a, na palaite aw zak ahi nawnta kei ding," achi hi.
Sisan suah hat khopi tung agik hi! Zuau leh kilohna in adim khin a; asa keih uh tatlak lou ahi.
Zepna ging, kangtalai khe ging, sakol tawmte, kangtalai tai gopgopte toh.
Sakol tungtuangmi sakol a tuangte, namsau te zolzolte, teipi te zualzual toh; mi thah om lemlumte, luang om ziazuate toh; luang in bei chih mahmah anei kei; siluangte pal in akisuipuk uhi;
Huai kizuak melhoih, bumsiamnu, a-angkawmna ziak a nam zuak a, abumhatna ziak a inkuan zuaknu angkawmna thupi mahmah ziak a hon gawm ahi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, ka hon dou ahi; na mai ah na puan ka lem ding a; na vuaktanna namte kiang ah leh na zahlakna kumpipa gamte kiang ah ka ensak ding.
Nin kihhuai mahmah in ka hon theh ding a, zumhuai mahmah in ka hon bawl dia, muhnop a ding in ka hon koih ding.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, nang hon mu peuhmah nang a kipan ataimang ding ua, Nineveh khua ahong segawpta hi; kua'n amah suun dia, ahehnemtu ding koi a zong ding ka hia?
Nile Luite kikal a om Thebes, akim a tui in a-um, akulh ding a tuipi zang a kulhbaang ding a tuipi nei sang in na hoihzaw a hia?
Ethiopia leh Aigupta ahatna ahi a, huai tuh tawp hun nei lou ahi; Put leh Libiate ahihleh nang hon panpihte ahi uh.
Huchipi in leng lakmang in a-om a, sal in atang a; kongzing teng tawp ah anaupang neute apaihnensak uh; amithahte uh a ding in ai asan ua, amiliante tengteng khainiang a gak ahi uh.
Nang leng na kham sam ding a, sel in na om ding; melma ziak in kulh kip na zong lai ding hi.
Na kulh tengteng theipi kung, gah min masa pulh bang ahi ding ua; alin peuhmah uleh nemi kam ah akelut zel uhi.
Ngai in, na sung a na mipite numei ahi ua; na melmate a ding in na kongpi akihong heuhou a; na kikalhna siktawnte mei in akangtum hi.
Umkimvel a na om sung a ding in tui tawi inla, ka kulhte hihkip in; tungman omna ah hoh in, belhkipna chil in, lei haltakna thuk hihkip in.
Huai ah mei in ahong kangtum ding a, namsau in ahon satlum ding a, singnget bang in ahon hihmangthang ding hi. Singnget bang in kipungsak inla, khaukhup bang in kihihpung in.
Na sumsin mite van aksi sang a tam in na khangsak a; singnget in ahihsia a, alengmang mai uhi.
Kumpi lukhu khu na mite lah khaukhup bang ahi ua, na sepaihte khovot ni a huandai a khaupehon bokkhawm bang ahi uh, himahleh ni ahong suak a, alengmang ua, a-omna mun uh theih ahi kei hi.
Assuria kumpipa aw, na belamching mite alusu uhi; na miliante akhawl ua; na mipite tangte ah adalh ua, pikhawmmi kuamah a-om kei uhi.
Na natna damna ding a-om kei; na liamna athupi mahmah hi; na husa za peuh in khut ahon betkhum ua; na gitlouhna thuak kha lou kua a-om a?
Hakaliah tapa Nehemiah thute: Kisleu kha, akum sawmnihna kum a, Susa Inpi a ka om lai in hichi ahong hi a,
Hananiah, ka unaute lak a khat ahong a, amah leh Judah a kipan mi kuate hiam; amaute kiang ah saltanna a kipan a nutsiat a omte, Juda suaktate tanchin leh Jerusalem thu ka dong hi.
Amau ka kiang ah, "Huai lai bial a saltanna a kipan omlaite gimthuakna thupi thuak leh simmoh in a-om uh: Jerusalem kulhbaangte leng achim a, akongpite leng mei in akang," achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, hiai thute ka zak lai in, ka tu a ka kap a, ni bangzah hiam ka suun a; van Pathian ma ah an ngawl in ka thum hi.
"AW TOUPA, van Pathian, Pathian thupi leh lauhuai, amah it a, athupiakte zuite tung a thukhun theigige leh zahngaihna nei gige.

"Tu in na bil in hon ngeingaih henla, na mitte hong kihong hen, huchi a na sikha thumna, huai hun a, sun leh zan a, na sikhate Israel suante a dia, nangmah tung a ka hihkhelh uh, Israel suante khelhna thupha tawi a, ka thumna na hon ngaihkhiaksakna ding in: Ahi, kei leh ka pa inkote ka khialta uhi.
"Thanghuaitak in na tung ah ka na gamtata ua, na thupiakte ka zuita kei ua, na sikha Mosi kiang a na thupiak, dan thusehte leh vaihawmte.
Theigige in, ka hon ngen ahi, na sikha Mosi kiang a thu na piak, na tatlek uh leh mite lak ah ka hon thehzak ding.

Himahleh ka kiang a na hong kik ua, ka thupiakte na zuih ua na hih uleh, delhkhiak a na omna uh van tawp mun ah himahleh, huai a kipan in amaute ka kaikhawm ding a, ka min omna dia ka mun telsa ah amaute ka pikhawm ding, chi in.
Tu in hiaite, na thilhihtheihna thupi leh na banhat a na tatsa, na sikhate leh na mite ahi uh.

"AW TOUPA, ka hon ngen ahi, na min laudan siam nuamsa, na sikha thumna leh na sikhate thumna na bil in ngeingaih hen: ka hon ngen ahi, tuni in na sikha lohchingsak inla, hiai mi mitmuh in akiang ah zahngaihna pia in," achi hi. Kei bel kumpipa nou dompa ka hi.
Suaikaite hiaite ahi uh Nehemiah Tirshatha, Hakaliah tapa leh Zedekiah;
Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah;
Pashur, Amariah, Malkijah;
Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluk;
Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah;
Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruk;
Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin;
Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: hiaite siampute ahi uh.
Levi mite: huaite, Jeshua, Azaniah tapa, Henadad tapa Binnui Kadmiel;
A-unaute uh, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan;
Mika, Rehob, Hashabiah;
Zakkur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah;
Hodiah, Bani, Beninu.
Mite hausate: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani;
Bunni, Azgad, Bebai;
Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin;
Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur;
Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai;
Hariph, Anathot, Nebai;
Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir;
Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua;
Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah;
Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasub;
Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek;
Rehum, Hasabnah, Maaseiah;
Huan Ahijah, Hanan, Anan;
