Malluk, Harim, Baanah.

Huan mipi lak a adangte, siampute, Levi mite, Kongkhak ngakte, Lasa mite, Nethinim mite leh gamte a mite lak a kipan amau leh amau Pathian dan lam a kituamsehte tengteng, azite uh, atapate uh, atanute uh, michih theihna leh theihtheihna neite.

A-unaute uh, amiliante uh lam ah abelh tinten ua, Mosi Pathian sikha in apiak Pathian Dan a om ding leh TOUPA I TOUPA uh thupiak tengteng zui ding leh hih ding a, avaihawmte leh adan thusehte hih ding in hamsia leh kichiamna abawl uhi.
Huan i tanute gam a mite pe lou ding leh i tapate a dia atanute uh la lou ding in.

Gam a mite'n Sabbath ni a van hiam an nek hiam zuak ding ahon tawi uleh, Sabbath hiam, ni sianthou ni hiam in huaite i lei kei ding uh; huchi in akum sagihna louhaite lak leh leiba chiteng sik i kidek ding uh.
Huai lou leng i Pathian uh inn a nasepna ding a kum teng a shekel seh thumna kibasak ding in, thupiakte i kibawl uhi.

Tanghou koihna ding, anpiak thillat gige a ding, halmang thillat gige a ding, Sabbathte, kha thakte, sehsa ankuangte a ding, thil siangthoute a ding, Israel a dia lemna kithoihna bawlna dia khelhna thillatte a ding leh i Pathian inn ua nasepna tengteng a ding in.

Ai i san ua, siampute, Levi mite leh mite, sing thillat a ding in, dan a kigelh bang a, i Pathian uh TOUPA maitam tung a khul ding, kum teng a, hun sehsa, i pipute inkote dungzui a, i Pathian inn ua laklut ding in.
TOUPA' inn a, kum teng a, i lei theigah masapente, sing chiteng a gah tengteng a kipan gah masapente, tawi ding in.

Dan a kigelh bang in, i tapate lak a piang masapen leh i gantate lak a leng, i bawnghonte lak leh i belamhonte lak a nou masapente, i Pathian inn ua nasem siampute kiang a i Pathian inn ua tawi ding in.

I tangbuang mek masakpen uleh, i vei thillatte uleh, sing chiteng gah, uain leh thau, i Pathian uh inn a dantante ah, siampute kiang ah i tawi ding uh; huan i louma a sawm-a-khatte Levi mite kiang ah; amau, Levi mite'n, singtang khopi tengteng uah sawm-a-khat ala uhi.

Aaron tapa siampu, Levi mite'n sawm-a-khat alak chiang un, Levi mite kiang ah a-om ding: huchi in Levi mite'n sawm-a-khatte' sawm-a-khat i Pathian inn uah, dantante ah, sumbawm inn ah atawitou ding uhi.

Israel suante leh Levi tate'n buh-le-bal, uain, thau, thillat mun siang tui-um belsuan nasem siampute, kongkhak ngakte leh lasa mite omna, mun siangthou a atawi ding uh ahi. Huchi in i Pathian inn i nuse kei ding uhi.
Huchi in mite vaihawmte Jerusalem ah ateng ua: midangte'n leng, khopi siangthou Jerusalem a teng ding sawm lak a khat leh khopi dangte a teng dia seh kuate theihna ding in ai asan uhi.
Mite'n Jerusalem a teng ding a uttak a amau leh amau kipete tengteng avualzawlta uhi.

Huchi in Jerusalem a teng bial sung a hausate hiaite ahi uh; himahleh Judah khopite ah michih amau khopite uah michih atan chiat uah amau ateng ua, huaite, Israel siampute, Levi mite leh Nethinim mite leh Solomon sikhate tate.
Jerusalem ah Judah tate lak a leh Benjamin tate lak a kuate hiam ateng uhi. Judah tate lak ah: Athaiah Uzziah tapa, Zekariah tapa, Amariah tapa, Shephatiah tapa, Mahalalel tapa, Perez tate lak ah;
Maaseiah Baruk tapa, Kolhozeh tapa, Hazaiah tapa, Adaiah tapa, Joiarib tapa, Zekariah tapa, Shiloni tapa.
Jerusalem a teng Perez tapate tengteng pasal hangsan ngen zali sawmguk-le-giat ahi uh.
Hiaite Benjamin tapate ahi uh: Sallu, Meshullam tapa, Joed tapa, Pedaiah tapa, Kolaiah tapa, Maaseiah tapa, Ithiel tapa, Jeshaiah tapa.
Huai nung in Gabbai, Sallai, zakua sawmnih-le-giat.
Huan Zikri tapa Joel aheutu uh ahi: huan Senuah tapa Judah khopi tung a nihna ahi.
Siampute lak ah: Joiarib tapa Jedaiah, Jakin tapa,
Hilkiah tapa Seraiah, Meshullam tapa, Zadok tapa, Meraioth tapa, Ahitub tapa, Pathian inn a vaihawm,
leh a-unaute uh huai inn a nasep sem, zagiat sawmnih-le-nih: huan Jeroham tapa Adaiah, Pelaliah tapa, Amzi tapa, Zekariah tapa, Pashur tapa, Malkijah tapa,
leh a-unaute, pipute inkote hausate, zanih sawmli-le-nih: huan Azarel tapa Amashai, Ahzai tapa, Mesillemoth tapa, Immer tapa,
leh a-unaute uh, mihat hangsante, za-le-sawmnih-le-giat: huan aheutu uh Zabdiel, Haggedolim tapa ahi.
Levi mite lak ah: Hassub tapa Shemaiah, Azrikam tapa, Hashabiah tapa, Bunni tapa;
Shabbethai leh Jozabad, Levi mite hausate lak a, Pathian inn polam nasep a heutu;
Mika tapa Mattaniah, Zabdi tapa, Asaph tapa, thumna a kipahthu genna pankhe pipen ahi. Huan Bakbukiah, a-unaute lak a nihna; huan Shammua tapa Abda, Galal tapa, Jeduthun tapa.
Khopi siangthou sung a Levi mite tengteng zanih sawmgiat-le-li.
Huai ban ah kongkhak ngakte, Akkub, Talmon leh a-unaute uh kongpite ngakte, za sawmsagih-le-nih ahi uhi.
Huan Israel lak a omlaite, siampute lak a Levi mite, Judah khopite tengteng ah a-om ua, michih agouluahna chiat uah.
Himahleh Ophel ah Nethinim mite ateng uh; huan mite tung ah Ziha leh Gispa Nethinim a-om uhi.
Jerusalem a Levi mite heutu leng Bani tapa Uzzi ahi, Hashabiah tapa, Mattaniah tapa, Mika tapa, Asaph tapate, Pathian inn a nasepna a lasa mite;
amau tungtang thu ah kumpipa a kipan a thupiak, niteng a akiphamoh bang in; lasa mite a ding a dan kipsa lah a-om ngal a.
Huan Pethahiah, Meshezabel tapa, Judah tapa Zerah tate lak a mipite tungtang thu tengteng amah kumpipa khut ah a-om hi.
Khuate, aloute uh toh ahihleh, Judah tate lak a akhenkhatte Kiriatharba leh akhotate ah, Dibon leh akhotate ah, Jekabzeel leh akhotate ah ateng ua;
Jeshua leh Moladah leh Bethphelet ah;
Hazar-shual leh Beer-sheba leh akhotate ah;
Ziklag leh Mekonah leh akhotate ah;
Enrimmon leh Zariah leh Jarmuth ah;
Zanoah, Adullam leh akhotate uah, Lakish leh huai aloute, Azekah leh akhotate. Huchi in Beer-sheba a kipan Hinnom Phaizang tan in giahbuk abawl uhi.
Benjamin tate leng Geba a kipan in atengtou zel ua, Mikmash leh Aija ah, Bethel leh akhotate ah;
Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah ah;
Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim;
Hadid, Zeboim. Neballat;
Lod leh Ono, khutsiamte phaizang ah.
Huan Judah a Levi mite sehkhen bangzah hiam Benjamin toh akizom uhi.
Huan hiaite Joshua leh Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel toh tontou siampute leh Levi mite ahi uh.
Siampute: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra, Amariah, Malluk, Hattush;
Shekaniah, Rehum, Meremoth;
Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah;
Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah;
Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah;
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. Hiaite siampute lak leh a- unaute uh lak a Jeshua dam lai a makai lianpente uh ahi.
Levi mite mah leng: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, Mattaniah, kipahthu genna tung a om, amah leh a-unaute.
Bakbukiah leh Unni leng, a-unaute uh toh venbuk sung ah a-om uh.
Huan Joshua in Joiakim asuang, Joiakim in Eliashib asuang, Eliashib in Joiada asuang,
Joiada in Jonathan asuang, Jonathan in Jaddua asuang hi.
Huan Joiakim dam lai in siampute a-om ua, pipute' inkuan a lupente: Seraiah a pan Meraiah; Jeremiah a pan Hananiah;
Ezra a pan Meshullam; Amariah a pan Jehohanan;
Meliku a pan Jonathan; Shebaniah a pan Joseph;
Harim a pan Adna; Meraioth a pan Helkai;
Iddo a pan Zekariah; Ginnethon a pan Meshullam;
Abijah a pan Zikri; Miniamin lak ah, Moadiah a pan Piltai;
Bilgah a pan Shammua; Shemaiah a pan Jehonathan;
Joiarib a pan Mattenai; Jedaiah a pan Uzzi;
Sallai a pan Kallai; Amok a pan Eber;
Hilkiah a pan Hashabiah; Jedaiah a pan Nethaneel.
Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, Jaddua dam lai in Levi mite, pipute inkote vaihawm makai a gelh ahi uh: Persia mi Darias vaihawm lai a, siampute toh in.
Levi tapate, pipute inkuan a lupente, khangthubu ah, Eliashib tapa Johanan dam lai tan a gelh ahi.
Huan Levi mite hausate: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Kadmiel tapa Jeshua, a-unaute uh toh amau hunbi chiat ah Pathian mipa David thupiak dungzui a kipahthu gen ding in kimaituah in adingh uhi.
Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkubte kongnite yankoihna dantan kem kongkhak ngakte ahi uhi.
Hiaite Jozadak tapa, Jeshua tapa, Joiakim hun lai a damte ahi ua, huan huai tuh ukpipa Nehemiah leh laigelhmi, siampu Ezra hun lai ahi.

Huan Jerusalem kulhbaang latna a ding in a-omna tengteng uah Levi mite azongkhia ua, kipahna toh, kipahthu genna leh lasak, dakkhutbet, tumgingte leh kaihgingte toh Jerusalem a amaute hon pi ding a, kipahna bawl ding in.
Huchi in lasa mite tapate akikaikhawm ua, Jerusalem kimvel a phaizang a kipan leh Netophah mite khotate a kipan in;
Beth-gilgal a kipan in leng, Geba leh Azmaveth loute a kipan in; lasa mite'n lah Jerusalem kimvel in khotate ana bawlta ngal ua.
Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite akihihsiangthou ua, mite leh kongpite leh kulhbaangte ahihsiangthou uhi.
Huchih lai in kulhbaang tung ah Judah vaihawmte ka pitou a, kipahthugen leh ahon a pai pawlpi nih ka sep a; huai ah pawl khat kulhbaang tung ah Ekvum Kongpi lam ah apai uhi.
Amaute nung in Hoshaiah leh Judah vaihawmte lak a kimkhat,
Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
leh siampute tapate lak a kuate hiam pengkulte toh, Zekariah Jonathan tapa, Shemaiah tapa, Mattaniah tapa, Mikaiah tapa, Zakkur tapa, Asaph tapa;
a-unaute, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, Judah, Hanani Pathian mipa David tumging theihte toh; ama uah Ezra laigelhmi a-om hi.
Tuikhuk kongpi kiang ah, amazawntak uah, David khopi dohkang ah apaitou ua, kulhbaang toupaina ah, David inn tunglam ah, suahlam pang a Tui Kongpi pha in.
Huan alak ua pawl dang kipahthugente amaute tuak ding in apai ua, kei amau nung ah, kulhbaang tung a, meipi insang tunglam ah, kulhbaang lian tanpha in;
Ephraim kongpi tung ah, kongpi lui kiang, ngasa kongpi kiang a Hananel insang, Meah insang, Belam Kongpi tanpha in Venna Kongpi ah adingh den uhi.
Huchi in Pathian insung a kipahthugen pawl nihte leh kei leh ka kiang a vaihawmte lak a akimkhatte adingh ua:
Siampute, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Mikaiah, Elioenai, Zekariah, Hananiah, pengkulte toh;
huan Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam leh Ezer. Huchi in lasa mite'n ngaihtak in, aheutupa uh Jezrahiah toh la asa uhi.

Huai ni in kithoihna thupite alan ua, nuam asa uhi; Pathian in lah nopsakna thupi in amau nuam asasak hi; numeite leh naupangte toh akipak uhi: huchi in Jerusalem kipahna husa gamlapi tan ah leng zak in a-om hi.

Huai ni in thilpiakte, vei thillatte, haithak masapente, sawm-a-khatte koihkhawmna dantante a heutu, Dan in aseh bang a, siampu leh Levite tantuan kho chih in ana hihzoh bang zel ua lakhawm ding mite asep uhi. Judahte bel nasemmi siampute leh Levite ziak in akipak mahmah uhi.
A Pathian uh indan leh siansakna indan akem ua, huchibang in lasa mite leh kongkhak ngak mite'n David leh atapa Solomon thupiak bang in ahihta uhi.
David leh nidanglai a Asaph dam lai in lasami heutupen leh Pathian kiang a phatna leh kipahthu genna lasate lah a-om ngal a,

Huan Zerubbabel dam lai leh Nehemiah dam lai in Israel tengteng in, niteng a akul bang in lasa mite leh kongkhak ngak mite tantuan ape zel uhi: Levi mite a ding in thilsiangte asepsiang ua; Levi mite'n Aaron tapate a ding in asepsiangthou uhi.
Huai ni in mite zak in Mosi laibu asim ua; Ammon mi leh Moab mi tangtawn in Pathian khawmpi sung a alut ding uh ahi kei chih, huai sung a kigelh amu uhi.
Tanghou leh tui a Israel suante dawn lou a, amaute hamsiat ding a, amaute siatna ding a Balaam alak ziak un: himahleh i Pathian in hamsia vualzawlna asuaksakta hi.
Dan azak lai un, hichi ahong hi a, gamdangmi suante a pan Israel mite akikhenkhe tuamta uhi.
Huan hiai ma in, siampu Eliashib i Pathian inn ua dantante tung a seh a ompa, Tobiah toh kizom in,

ama a ding in dantan thupi abawlkhol a, huai ah amalam in anpiak thillatte, begaw leh tui-um belsuante leh buh-le-bal, uain leh thaute sawm-a-khatte akoih ua, huaite bel Levi mite leh lasa mite leh kongkhak ngak mite kiang a thupiak a piak ahi a; huan vei thillatte siampute a ding in.
Himahleh hiai hunte in, Jerusalem ah ka om kei: Babulon kumpipa Artaksarses kum sawmthum-le-nih kum in kumpipa kiang ah ka hoh a, ni bangzah hiam nung in kumpipa phalna ka ngen hi.
Huchi in Jerusalem ah ka hong a, Pathian inn pisate sung dantan amah a dia abawlsakna ah, Eliashib in Tobiah a dia gilou ahihdan ka theisiam hi.
Huchi in kei hon dahsak mahmah a: huaiziak in dantan a kipan in Tobiah inn van tengteng ka lawnkhia hi.
Huan thu ka pia a, dantante ahihsiang ua: huai ah anpiak thillatte leh begaw toh, Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan ka hon la nawn hi.
Levi mite tante amau kiang ah piak nai louh in a-om chih ka thei a; huchi in Levi mite leh lasa mite, nasep semte michih aloulam ah ataizak uhi.
Kei tuh vaihawmte toh ka kiselta ua, bang ding a Pathian inn mangngilh a om ahia? ka chi hi. Amau ka kaikhawm a, amun uah ka koih hi.
Judah tengteng in buh-le-bal leh uain leh thau sawm-a-khat sumbawm ah ahon tawi uhi.

Sumbawm a ding in sumkem mite ka bawl a, Shelemiah siampute, Zadok laigelhmite leh Levi mite lak ah Pedaiah. Huan amaute zom in Zakkur tapa Hanan, Mattaniah tapa: muanhuai a sim ahi ngal ua, anasep uh a-unaute uh kiang a hawm ding ahi.
Aw ka Pathian, hiai thu ah hon theigige inla, ka Pathian inn a ding a ka nasep hoih ka hihte leh huai a zuih dingte nulmang ke'n.

Huai lai in Judah ah Sabbath ni a kuate hiam uain suknate chil a, buhphalte hon tawi a, huaite toh asabiltungte van guang ka mu a; uain, grep gahte, theipite van puakgik chi chih, Sabbath ni a Jerusalem a hon tawilutte leng; huan an nekte azuak ni uh huai ni in amaute dem in thu ka gen hi.
Huai ah Tura mite leng a-om ua, ngasa ahon tawi ua, van chi tuamtuam toh, Judah tate kiang leh Jerusalem ah Sabbath ni in azuak uhi.
Huchi in ke'n Judahte miliante ka kiselpih a, akiang uah, "Bang thil gilou ahia hiai na hih ua, Sabbath na hihnit uh?

Na pipute un huchibang in ahih ngei ua hia, i Pathian in eite tung leh hiai khopi tung ah hiai hoih lou tengteng hon tun ahi kei maw? Hinapi in nou Sabbath hihnin in Israel tung ah thangpaihna tamsem na tun ua," ka chi hi.

Huan Jerusalem kongpite Sabbath ni ma a khua amial pat in, hichi ahong hi a, kongkhakte khak ding in thu ka pia a, Sabbath ni abei matan kihong lou ding in thu ka pia a, ka sikhate lak a akhen kongpi tung ah ka pangsak a, huchi a Sabbath ni a puakgik ahong kilaklutlouhna ding in.
Huchi in khatvei hiam nihvei hiam sumsin mite leh van chiteng zuak mite Jerusalem polam ah agiak uhi.

Amaute dem in thu ka gen a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a kulhbaang kim a giak na hi ua? Na hih nawn uleh, na tung uah khut ka kha ding," ka chi lai hi. Huai hun a kipan in Sabbath ni in ahong pai nawnta kei uhi.

Kihihsiangthou ding leh hong kuan a kongpite ngak ding, Sabbath ni siangsak ding in, Levi mite thu ka pia hi. Aw ka Pathian, hiai ah leng kei hon theigige in, na zahngaihna letdan dungzui in kei hon hawi in.
Huai lai in Judate Ashdod, Ammon leh Moab numeite kitenpihte leng ka mu hi:
Huchi in atate'n Ashdod pau kimkhat leh namdangte pau azang ua, Judate pau in apau thei kei uhi.

Amaute ka kiselpih a, ka hamsiatkhum a, alak ua kuate hiam ka khen a, amul uh ka bohkhiaksak a, Pathian min lou in ka kichiamsak a, "Na tanute uh atapate uh a ding in na pe kei ding ua, na tapate uh a ding hiam, noumau a ding hiam in leng atanute uh na la ding uh ahi kei chi in.

Israel kumpipa Solomon hiaite in akhial kei maw? Hinapi in lah nam tampite lak ah amah bang kumpipa a-om kei a, a Pathian it in a-om a, Israel tengteng tung ah Pathian in kumpipa in abawl hi. Himahleh amah nangawn numei lamdangte'n akhialsak uhi.
Ahihleh hiai gilou mahmah hih ding in, numei lamdangte kitenpih a i Pathian tung a talek ding in, na thu hon zui ding ka hi uh maw?"
Joiada tapate lak a khat, siampu lianpen Eliashib tapa, Horon mi Sanballat tanu' pasal ahi a; huaiziak in kei a kipan ka delhkhia hi.
Aw ka Pathian, siamputna, siamputna thukhun leh Levi mite ahihnit ziak un, amaute theigige in.
Huchi in mikhualte tengteng a kipan in amaute ka hihsiang a, siampute a ding leh Levi mite a ding in, michih anasep uah, nasepdante ka sehsak a;
hun sehsa a sing thillat a ding leh gah masa a ding in. Aw ka Pathian, hoihna ding in kei hon theigige in.
Kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm akum sawmnih, Nisan kha in, ama a uain a-om lai in hichi ahong hi a, uain ka la a, kumpipa kiang ah ka pia hi. Ama ah nidang in dahmel ka pu ngei nai kei hi.
Kumpipa'n ka kiang ah, "Na chi lah ana kei a, bangchi a dahmel pu mawk na hia? Hiai zaw bangmah dang ahi kei, lungtang dahna ahi," achi hi. Huchi in ka lauta mahmah a.
Kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa tangtawn in dam hen: ka pipute hante omna, khopi kisegawp a om a, huai a kongpite mei in kangtum hiven bangchi in ka mel adah lou dia?" ka chi hi.
Kumpipa'n ka kiang ah, "Ahihleh bang ahia na nget?" achi hi. Huchi in van Pathian kiang ah ka thumta hi.
Kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa kipah lam ahih a, na mitmuh a na sikha in deihsakna atanleh, Judah gam ah, ka pipute han omna khopi ka bawltheihna ding in kei hon sawl in," ka chi hi.

Kumpipa'n ka kiang ah, (kumpinu leng akiang a tu ahi a), "Na khualzinna bang tan a sawt ahi dia? Chikchiang in na hong kik nawn dia?" ahon chita hi. Huchi in kei hon sawl ding kumpipa kipah lam ahi a; amah hun ka pia hi.
Huai lou in kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa kipah lam ahih a, Judah gam tan ka tun mateng a kei ahon paisak zel theihna ding un, luipi khen a ukpipate kiang a piak ding laikhakte hon pe lechin.

Inn toh kizom kulh kongpite a ding leh khopi kulhbaangte a ding leh ka lutna ding inn a dia bawl ding inkamte bawlna dia sing ahon piakna ding in, kumpipa gammang kempa Asaph kiang ah laikhak hon khaksak lechin, ka chi hi. Huchi in kumpipa'n ka tung a ka Pathian khut hoih a-om bang in hon phalsak hi.
"Huchi in luipi khen a ukpipate kiang ka hong tung a, akiang uah kumpipa laikhakte ka pia hi. Huchi in kumpipa'n hon zui ding in sepaih pawl heutute leh sakol tungtuang mite asawl hi.
Horon mi, Sanballat leh sikha Tobiah, Ammon mi in azaktak un, Israel suante hoihna zongmi kuahiam khat ahong pai ziak in nakpitak in alungkim kei mahmah uhi.
Huchi in Jerusalem ah ka hong a, huai ah ni thum ka omta hi.

"Zan in ka thou a, kei leh ka kiang a om mi tawmchikte; Jerusalem a dia hih ding ka lungtang sung a ka Pathian in bang ahia a koihmi kuamah ka hilh kei a: atung a ka tuanna ganta chih louh ngal ka kiang ah ganta a-om kei hi.
"Zan in Gulpi Tuileh lam, Ekvum Kongpi lam ah, Phaizang Kongpi a pai in ka pawtkhia a, achimsa, Jerusalem kulhbaangte leh mei a kangsa kongpite ka velta hi.
"Tuikhuk Kongpi leh Kumpipa Dil ah ka hoh a: himahleh ka nuai a om ganta paina ding mun a-om kei hi.
"Luita zui in zan in ka paitou a, kulhbaang ka vel a; ka kik nawn a, Phaizang Kongpi ah ka lut a, huchi in ka kik nawnta hi.
"Huchi in ka paina lam hiam, ka hih hiam vaihawm mite'n athei kei uh; Judate kiang ah leng, siampute hiam, miliante hiam, vaihawmte hiam leh nasep sem midangte kiang ah leng ka gen nai kei hi.

Huan akiang uah, 'I dinmun uh hoihlouhdan na mu ua, Jerusalem asiat khitdan, huai a kongpite mei a akat khitdan: simmoh a i om nawnlouhna ding in, kisa un Jerusalem baang i lam nawn ding uh,' ka chi hi.

"Huchi in ka tung a hoih ka Pathian' khut tanchin ka kiang a agen kumpipa thute leng amau ka hilh a; huchi in amau, 'Thou ni in lam ni,' achi uhi. Huchi in nasep hoih sem ding in akhutte uh ahatsakta uhi.
Himahleh Horon mi Sanballat leh Ammon mi sikha Tobiah leh Arabia mi Geshem in azak un, ahon nuihsan ua, ahon simmohbawl ua, 'Bang thil ahia na hih uh? Kumpipa tung a hel sawm na hi uhia?' achi uhi.

"Amau ka dawng a, akiang uah, 'Van Pathian in koute ahon lohchingsak ding, huaiziak in kou asikhate ka thou ding ua ka lam ding uh: himahleh nou Jerusalem ah thuneihna, theihgigena leh tan na nei kei uhi,' " ka chi hi.
Huchi in siampu lianpen Eliashib a-unau siampute toh athou ua, Belam Kongpi abawl ua; ahihsiangthou ua, akongkhakte atung ua; Hameah insang tan in ahihsiangthou ua, Hananel insang tan in.
Amah zom in Jeriko mite'n alam uhi. Amau zom in Imri tapa Zakkur in alam hi.
Hassenaah tapate'n Ngasa Kongpi ahih ua; a-inkamte akhung ua, akongkhakte atung ua, akalhnate leh akalhna tawnte.
Amau zom in Uriah tapa, Hakkoz tapa, Meremoth in abawlhoih hi. Amaute zom in Berekiah tapa Meshullam, Meshezabel tapa in abawlhoih hi. Amaute zom in Baana tapa Zadok in abawlhoih hi.
Amaute zom in Tekoa mite'n abawlhoih ua; himahleh amiliante un a TOUPA uh nasepna ah anak pan nuam kei uhi.
Kongpi lui pen Paseah tapa Jehoiada leh Besodeiah tapa Meshullam in abawlhoih ua, a-inkamte akhung ua, akongkhakte atung ua, akalhnate leh akalhna tawnte toh.
Amaute zom in Gibeon mi Melatiah leh Meronoth mi, Jadon, Gibeon mite, Mizpah mite, luipi khen a ukpipa laltutphah toh kizomte'n abawlhoih uhi.
Amah zom in Harhaiah, dangka-eng sek mite tapa Uzziel in abawlhoih hi. Amah zom in gimlim bawl mite tapa Hananiah in abawlhoih a, kulhbaang za tanpha in Jerusalem abubitsak uhi.
Amaute zom in Jerusalem seh kimkhat a vaihawmpa, Hur tapa Rephaiah in abawlhoih hi.
Amaute zom in Harumaph tapa Jedaiah in, ama inn sun hial in abawlhoih hi. Huan amah zom in Hashabneiah tapa Hattush in abawlhoih hi.
Malkijah, Harim tapa leh Pahath-moab tapa Hasub in amun dang leh meipi insang abawlhoih uhi.
Amah zom in Jerusalem seh kimkhat a vaihawmpa, Hallohesh tapa Shallum in, amah leh atanute toh abawlhoih uhi.
Guam Kongpi pen Hanun leh Zanoah a tengte'n abawlhoih ua, alam ua, akongkhakte atung ua, akalhnate leh akalhna tawnte leh Ekvum Kongpi lam a kulhbaang tong sangkhat toh.
Huchi in Beth-hakkerem seh a vaihawmpa, Rekab tapa Malkijah in Ekvum Kongpi abawlhoih a, akongkhakte, akalhnate leh atung a akalhna tawnte alam hi.

Mizpah seh a vaihawmpa, Kol-hozeh tapa Shallum in tuikhuk kongpi abawlhoih a; alam a, avuk a, kongkhakte, kalhnate leh kalhna tawnte leh kumpipa huan kiang a Shiloah Dil baang, David Khopi a kipan a sukpai leichial tan in abawl hi.
Amah nung in Azbuk tapa Nehemiah, Beth-zur gam kimkhat a vaihawmpa'n, David han toh kimatuah mun leh dil bawltawm chiang leh mihatte inn tan in abawlhoih hi.
Amah nung in, Levite, Bani tapa Rehumte'n abawlhoih uhi. Huan amah zom in Keilah seh kimkhat a vaihawmpa Hashabiah in ama seh ding in abawlhoih hi.
Amah nung in a-unaute uh, Keilah seh kimkhat a vaihawmpa, Henadad tapa Bavai in abawlhoih hi.
Amah zom in Mizpah vaihawmpa, Jeshua tapa Ezer in seh dang, kulhbaang kawina tak a galvan koihkhawmna tan a paitouhna sun in abawlhoih hi.
Amah nung in Zabbai tapa Baruk in seh dang, kulhbaang kawina a kipan siampu lianpen Eliashib inn kongkhak chiang abawlhoih hi.
Amah nung in Hakkoz tapa Uriah tapa Meremoth in seh dang, Eliashib in kongkhak a kipan Eliashib inn tawpna chiang abawlhoih hi.
Amah nung in, phaizang mite, siampute'n abawlhoih uhi.
Amaute nung in Benjamin leh Hasub in a-inn pha un abawlhoih ua. Amau nung in Ananiah tapa Maaseiah tapa Azariah in amah inn sik ah abawlhoih hi.
Amah nung in Henadad tapa Binui in seh dang, Azariah inn a kipan kulhbaang kawina tan leh aning chiang abawlhoih hi.
Uzai tapa Palal in kulhbaang kawina sun chiang abawlhoih a, kumpipa' inn tungnungzaw a kipan a hong dingkhetou insang, venna pisa kiang a om toh, amah nung in Parosh tapa Pedaiah,
leh tempul nasem Ophel a tengteng suahlam pang Tui Kongpi leh insang lawkkhia zawn tan abawlhoih uhi.
Amah khit in Tekoa mite'n seh dang, Ophel kulhbaang chiang pha, insang thupi dingkhetou sun in abawlhoih uhi.
Siampute'n Sakol Kongpi tunglam, michih in ama inn tung sun chiat in abawlhoih uhi.
Amaute nung in Immer tapa Zadok in ama inn tung suntou chiang abawlhoih hi. Amah nung in suahlam kongpi ngakpa Shekaniah tapa Shemaiah in abawlhoih hi.
Amah nung in Shelemiah tapa Hananiah leh Zalaph tapa gukna Hanun in seh dang abawlhoih uhi. Amah nung in Berekiah tapa Meshullam in adantan tung zawn abawlhoih hi.
Amah nung in dangka-eng sek mite tapa Malkijah in Nethinimte inn leh sumsin mite inn chiang, Hammipkad Kongpi zawn chiang leh aning a kahtouhna chiang abawlhoih hi.
Huan aning a kahtouhna leh Belam Kongpi kikal dangka-eng sek mite leh sumsin mite'n abawlhoih uhi.
Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang i lam uh chih Sanballat in azak in, ahehta a, nakpitak in athangpai a, Judate akouta hi.

Huchi in a-unaute leh Samari sepaih pawl ma ah thu agen a, "Hiai Juda zawngkhalte'n bang ahia ahih uh? Kihihhat ding uhia? Kithoih ding uh hia? Ni khat a zoh sawm uhia? Akangsa ahi chih mu napi in, ninneng sunvum a kipan a suangte bawl thak ding uhia?" achi hi.
Huai lai in Ammon mi Tobiah akiang ah a-om a, "Ama'n, a-inn lam uh, sihal nangawn va kaltouleh, asuang baang uh alaichim ding," achi hi.
Za in aw ka Pathian; simmoh in lah ka om ngal ua: ahon kouna uh amau lutung ah kiksak inla, saltanna gam a loh ding in amau pia in:
Aginatlouhna uh khuh ke'nla, na ma a kipan akhelhna uh nulmang in omsak ke'n: inn lamte ma ah nang ahon hehsakta uhi.
Huchi in baang ka bawl ua; baang tengteng, asandan kim chiang in akizom ta hi: mite'n lah nna sem ding in lungsim anei ngal ua.

Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mite, Ammon mite leh Ashdod mite'n Jerusalem kulhbaangte bawlphatna in ma asawntou zel a, akichipsiatna akibawlpha, chih azak un, athangpai mahmah uhi.
Huchi in avek ua hong kuan a Jerusalem dou ding leh huai a buaina omsak ding in akikumkhawmta uhi.
Himahleh i Pathian kiang ah i thum ua, amau ziak in sun leh zan in amaute vil ding i koih uhi.
Judah in, "Puakgik pote hatna abahta a, ninneng tampi a-om; huchi in kulhbaang bawl thei lou i hi uh," achi hi.
I melmate un, "Alak uh i hong tun ua, amaute i thah ua, nasep i khawlsak matan athei kei ding ua, muh leng amu kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, amau kiang a teng Judate ahong pai lai un, "Sawmvei i kiang uah mun tengteng a kipan hon dou ding uh ahi," ahon chi uhi.
Huaiziak in kulhbaang nunglam mun a mun niam penpen, mun awngthawlte ah, ka koih a, mite a-inkuankuan uh dungzui in anamsaute uh toh, ateipite uh toh, athalpeute uh toh ka koih hi.

Huchi in ka en a, ka thou a, miliante leh vaihawmte leh mipi dangte kiang ah, "Amau lau kei un: TOUPA thupi leh lauhuai theigige unla, na unaute uh, na tapate uh leh na tanute uh a ding in gal dou un, na zite uh leh na innte uh a ding in," ka chi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, i melmate thil sawm i na theita ua, Pathian in athusawm uh bangmah lou asuaksak a, kulhbaang bawl ding in i vek un michih anasepna mun ah i kileh nawnta uh chih aza lai uhi.

Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, huai hun a kipan in, ka sikhate lak a kimkhat nasepna ah apang ua, alak ua kimkhat in lum, teipi leh thalpeu leh sik puanakte alen ua; vaihawmte Judah inkote nung ah a-om vek uhi.
Kulhbaang bawlte leh van-gik pote'n apuak lai un, michih in akhutte uh khat nasepna a nna sem in, akhut khat lam a galvan tawi in.
Inn lam mite'n, michih in anamsau apang ah khaisa a nei in, huchi in alamtou zel uhi. Pengkul mutpa ka kiang ah a-om hi.
Huchi in miliante kiang leh vaihawmte kiang ah leh mite lak a adangdangte kiang ah, "Nasep athupi in, atam a, kulhbaang tung ah i kikhenzak ua, kigamlattak in:
Koi lai mun peuh a pengkul ging na zakna uah, i kiang uah huai lam ah kuan un; i Pathian un gal hon dousak ding ahi," ka chi hi.
Nna i sem ua: alak ua akimkhat in zingsang kipat a kipan aksite ahong kilat matan teipi atawi uhi.
Huchi mah bang in huai lai in mite kiang ah, michih asikha toh Jerusalem sung ah giak hen, zan chiang a eite a dia galvil ahih a, sun chiang a nna aseptheihna ding un, ka chi hi.
Huchi in kei hiam, ka unaute hiam, ka sikhate hiam, kei hong zui galvil mite, i lak ua kuamah in i puante uh sawp ding nasan in i suah man kei uhi.
Huai lai in a-unaute uh Judate dem a nakpitak a kikouna, mite leh azite ua kipan ahong omta hi.
Kou, ka tapate leh ka tanute uh, tampi ka hi ua: "Ka nek ua ka hintheihna ding un, buh-le-bal hon pia un," chi pawl ahong om uhi.
"Ka loute uh, ka grephuante uh, ka innte uh ka zuak ua; kial ziak in, buh-le-bal hon pia un," chi kuate hiam leng a-om uhi.
"Ka loute uh leh ka grephuante ua dit ding in kumpipa siah ding in sum ka leitawi uh, chimi khenkhat leng a-om uhi.

Hinapi in ka sa uh ka unaute uh sa bang ahi a, ka tate uh lah amau tate bang: Ngai un, ka tapate uh leh ka tanute uh sikhate hi ding in tanna ah ka pi ua, ka tanute uh lak a akhente tanna a pi in a-om khin man hial ua, panpih theihna ka nei kei ua; midangte'n lah ka loute uh leh ka grephuante uh anei ngal ua," chi in.
Huchi a akikouna uleh hiai thute ka zak in ka heh mahmah hi.
Huchih lai in ka kingaihtuah a, miliante leh vaihawmte ka sal a, akiang uah, "Michih in a-unau lak ah apung na phut uh," ka chi hi. Huchi in amaute demna kikhawmpi thupi ka nei hi.

Akiang uah, "Khovel mite kiang a zuak a omsa, i unau Judate i theih bang un i tanta ua; nou na unaute uh zuak in, i lak ua khot a om ding uh ahi maw?" ka chi hi. Amau adai dide ua, thu khat leng anei kei uhi.
"Na thilhih uh ahoih kei; i melmate khovel mite'n hon simmohna ziak un, i Pathian laudan siam a na om ding uh hilou hia? ka chih behlap hi.
Huchi mah bang in, 'ka unaute leh ka sikhate leh ke'n amau kiang ah sum leh buh-le-bal ka leitawisak uhi. K'on ngen ahi, apung omsak kei ni.'

'Pe nawn un, ka hon ngen ahi, akiang uah, tuni mahmah in, aloute uh, agrephuante uh, a-olive huante uleh a-innte uh, asum uh aseh zakhatna leng, buh-le-bal, uain,' leh sathau, amau a kipan na phutkhia uhi," ka chi hi.

Huchi in amau, "Ka pe nawn ding ua, amau a kipan bangmah ka phut kei ding uh; huchibang in ka hih ding ua, na chih mah bang in," achi uhi. Ke'n siampute ka sam a, akichiamna uh ka la a, huchi a hiai thuchiam bang a ahihna ding un.

Ke'n leng ka pheipi ka vuangsak a, "Hiai thuchiam bawl lou peuhmah, a-inn a kipan, anasepna a kipan Pathian in hichibang in vuangsak hen; hichibangtak a vuankhiak ahi ding a, ahawm ding," ka chi hi. Huan khawmpite tengteng in, "Amen, TOUPA phat in om hen," achi uhi. Huchi in mite'n hiai thuchiam dungzui in ahih uhi.

Huai lou in Judah gam a a-ukpipa ding ua seh a ka om lai a kipan, kumpipa Artaksarses akum sawmnihna leh akum sawmthum-le-nihna chiang, huai bel, kum sawm-le-nih ahi a, kei leh ka unaute'n ukpipa tanghou ka ne kei uhi.

Himahleh kei ma a ukpipa masate mite tung a mohsak theih ahi ua, amau a kipan in tanghou leh uain ala uh, dangka shekel sawmli sim louh in; ahi, asikhate uh nangawn in mite tung ah vai ahawm uhi. Himahleh ke'n Pathian ka kihtak ziak in huchibang in ka hih kei hi.
Ahi, huai lou leng hiai kulhbaang nasepna ah ka pang nilouh a, gam himhim leng i lei kei uh: ka sikhate tengteng huai lam ah nasepna ah kaihkhawm in a-om uhi.
Huai ban ah ka dohkan ah Judate leh vaihawmte lak a mi za-le-sawmnga, i kim i vel ua om khovel mite lak a pan i kiang ua hong paite chih louh, a-om uhi.

Ni khat a ding a bawlkholhsa bawngtal khat leh belam hoih ngenta guk ahi ua; vasate leng kei dia bawlkholhsa in a-om ua, huan ni sawm sung a khatvei uain chi chih a kipan koih hoih: hinapi in hiai mite tung a tanna agik ziak in, ukpipa tanghou hiaite tengteng ziak in ka phut kei hi.
Aw ka Pathian, hoihna ding in, hiai mite a dia ka hih tengteng kei lam hon theigige in.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang ka lam khin a, huai ah khangkham a-om nawnta kei chih, Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem Arabia mi leh i melma dangdangte kiang a akitut lai in; huai hun tan in kongpi kongkhakte tung nai kei mah leng;
Sanballat leh Geshem in ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl ua, "Hong pai in, Ono Phaizang a khuate lak a khat ah i va kimu ding," chi in. Himahleh ka tung ah gilou hih angaihtuah uhi.
Huchi in akiang uah sawltakte ka sawl a, "Nna thupitak sem ka hi, ka hong paisuk thei kei; bangziak a ka nna nusia a, na kiang úa ka hong suk ziak a, nasep khawl ding ahia oi?" ka chi hi.
Huan hichibang ngen in livei ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl ua; angeingei in amaute ka dawng zel hi.
Huchi in Sanballat in ka kiang ah hichibang in angaveina ding in asikha akhut a laikhak honsa toh ahon sawl a;
huai ah, "Namte lak ah akigen a, Gasmu in achi a, nang leh Judate'n hel na tum uh; huai a ding in kulhbaang na lam hi: huchi in nang akumpipa uh hi ding in, hiai thute dungzui in,

Jerusalem a nang tanchin gen ding in zawlneite leng na sep a, Judah ah kumpipa a-om chi in. Huchi in tu in hiai thute dungzui in kumpipa kiang a tut ding ahi; huaiziak in hong kuan inla, kihouna i nei ding," chi in.
Akiang ah mi ka sawl a, "Na gen bang a huchibang thilhih a-om kei a, himahleh na lungtang a kipan na phuahtawm ahi," chi in.
Amau lah, hih louh ahihna ding in, "Nasepna a kipan akhutte uh hatsak louh in a-om ding," chi a hon lauhsak a-ut ngal ua. Himahleh tu in, Aw Pathian, nang ka khutte hatsak in.

Khum a om, Mehetabel tapa Delaiah tapa Shemaiah inn ah ka hoh a, ama'n, "Tempul sung ah, Pathian inn ah i kikhawm dia, huchi in tempul kongkhakte i khak ding, nang that dia hong ding uh lah ahi ngal ua; ahi, zan in nang that ding a hong ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Ke'n bel, "Kei bang mi, taise ding hon sa maw? Huan kua ahia, huchi a kei bang a om a, ahinna humbitna ding a tempul sung a hoh nuam ding? Ka lut kei ding," ka chi hi.
Ka ngaihtuah a, huchi in ngai in, Pathian in amah asawl kei a; himahleh ka siatna ding in hiai genkholhna agenkheta hi: Tobiah leh Sanballat in amah aguai uhi.
Hiai a ding a goih ahi, ka launa ding leh huchibang a hih a, khial a, thutut gilou ding a thubuai aneihtheihna ding ua, kei ahon simmoh theihna ding un.
Aw ka Pathian, Tobiah leh Sanballat anasepte uh bang zel leh zawlneinu Noadiah leh zawlnei dangte, lausak hon tumte, theigige in.
Huchi in Elul kha ani sawmnih-le-nga ni, ani sawmnga-le-nih sung in, kulhbaang zoh in a-omta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, i melmate tengteng in huai azak un, i kim i vel ua om namte teng in alauta ua, amitmuh ngei uah nakpitak in alunglelta uhi; hiai nasep i Pathian hih ahi chih athei ngal ua.
Huai lou in huai lai in Judah miliante'n laikhak tampi Tobiah kiang ah akhak ua, amau kiang ah Tobiah laikhakte ahong tung hi.
Amah Arah tapa Shekaniah tanu pasal ahih ziak in, Judah ah mi tampi amah lam a kichiam lah a-om ngal ua; atapa Jehohanan in Berekiah tapa Meshullam tanu zi in anei hi.
Huai lou leng ka ma ah athil hoih hihte agen ua, amah kiang ah ka thute atun zel uhi. Huchi in Tobiah in kei hon hihlau ding in laikhakte akhak hi.
Hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang lam khit ahih a, kongkhakte ka tun khit a, kongkhak ngak mite leh lasa mite leh Levi mite seh ahih khit nung un,
ka unau Hanani leh Hananiah kulh ukpa kiang ah Jerusalem kepna ka pia a: amah miginom ahi a, tampi sang a Pathian laudan siam ahih ziak in.

Akiang ah, "Ni asat mateng Jerusalem kongpite hon hi kei hen; galvilmi adin lai un, kongkhakte khak uhenla, amaute kalhkhum un; Jerusalem a tengte vengmi sep inla, michih ama dinmun ah, michih ama inn zawn chiat ah," chi in.
Khopi aza in alian a: himahleh huai ah mite atawm ua, innte lah lam ahi kei uhi.

Huchi in ka Pathian in ka lungtang miliante, vaihawm mite, mipite, khangsutna a sim ahihtheihna ding ua kaikhawm ding in akoih hi. Huan amasapen a hong lang amaute khangsutna laibu ka muta a, huai ah gelh a om ka mu hi.
Hiaite bial naupangte ahi ua, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in apimangte, huai pimang a omte lak a saltanna kipan a paitoute, Jerusalem leh Judah akik nawn, michih amah khopi a kik;
Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah toh hong paite.
Israel mite lak a pasal zah: Parosh suante, sangnih zakhat sawmsagih-le-nih.
Shephatiah suante, zathum sawmsagih-le-nih.
Arah suante, zaguk sawmnga-le-nih.
Pahath-moab suante, Jeshua leh Joab tate, sangnih zagiat sawmkhat-le-giat.
Elam suan sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
Zattu suan zagiat sawmli-le-nga.
Zakkai suan zasagih-le-sawmguk.
Binnui suan zaguk sawmli-le-giat.
Bebai suan zaguk sawmnih-le-giat.
Azgad suan sangnih zathum sawmnih-le-nih.
Adonikam suan zaguk sawmguk-le-sagih.
Bigvai suan sangnih sawmguk-le-sagih.
Adin suan zaguk sawmnga-le-nga.
Ater, Hezekiah suan sawmkua-le-giat.
Hashum suan zathum sawmnih-le-giat.
Bezai suan zathum sawmnih-le-li.
Hariph suan zakhat sawmkhat-le-nih.
Gibeon suan sawmkua-le-nga.
Bethlehem leh Netophah suan zakhat sawmgiat-le-giat.
Anathoth mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
Beth-azmaveth, mite sawmli-le-nih.
Kiriath-jearim, Kephirah, Beeroth suante, zasagih sawmli-le-thum.
Ramah leh Geba mite, zaguk sawmnih-le-khat.
Mikmas suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-nih.
Bethel leh Ai mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-thum.
Nebo dang mite, sawmnga-le-nih.
Elam dang suan sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
Harim suan zathum-le-sawmnih.
Jeriko suan zathum sawmli-le-nga.
Lod, Hadid leh Ono suante, zasagih sawmnih-le-khat.
Senaah suan sangthum zakua-le-sawmthum.
Siampute: Jedaiah suante, Jeshua inkuan a kipan, zakua sawmsagih-le-thum.
Imer suante, sangkhat sawmnga-le-nih.
Pashur suante, sangkhat zanih sawmli-le-sagih.
Harim suante, sangkhat sawm-le-sagih.
Levi mite: Jeshua, Kadmiel suante, Hodevah suante, sawmsagih-le-li.
Lasa mite: Asaph suante, zakhat sawmli-le-giat.
Kongkhak ngakte: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai suante, zakhat sawmthum-le-giat.
Tempul nasem, Nethinim mite: Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth;
Keros, Sia, Padon;
Lebana, Hagabah, Shalmai;
Hanan, Giddel, Gahar;
Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda;
Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah;
Besai, Meunim, Nephishesim;
Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur;
Bazlith, Mehida, Harsha;
Barkos, Sisera, Tamah;
Neziah leh Hatipha suante.
Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida;
Jaala, Darkon, Giddel;
Shephatiah, Hattil, Zebaim mi Pokereth leh Ammon suante.
Nethinim mite tengteng leh Solomon sikhate' suante, zathum sawmkua-le-nih.
uan hiaite Telmelah, Tel-harsha, Kerub, Addon leh Immer a kipan paitoute ahi uh, himahleh apipute uh inkote, Israel a kipan ahi hiam chih bel a-ensak thei kei uhi:
Delaiah, Tobiah leh Nekoda suante, zaguk sawmli-le-nih.
Siampute a kipan: Habaiah, Koz leh Barzillai suan Gilead mi Barzillai tanute lak a zi neipa min atamsak uhi.
Hiaite'n khangthu suina a sim a omte lak ah amin gelhna uh azong ua, himahleh muh in a-om kei; huaiziak in nin a sim ahi ua siamputna a kipan koihkhiak ahi uhi.
Ukpipa in akiang uah, siampu khat Urim leh Thummim toh ahong suah mateng thil siangthoupente lak a nek louh ding chih agen hi.
Omkhawm tengteng avek un singli sangnih zathum-le-sawmguk,
Apasal sikhate uh leh anungak sikhate uh, sangsagih zathum sawmthum-le-sagihte sim louh in: pasal lasa leh numei lasa zanih sawmli-le-nga anei uhi.
Asakolte uh zasagih sawmthum-le-guk; asakolneute uh, zanih sawmli-le-nga;
Asangawngsaute, zali sawmthum-le-nga; asabiltungte uh sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnih.
Pipute inkote lak a lupente lak a kipan khenkhatte nasem ding in akipia uhi. Ukpipa'n sumbawm ah dangka- eng darik sangkhat, maiphiat kuang sawmnga, siampute puan zanga-le- sawmthum apia hi.
Huan pipute inkote lak a lupente lak a khenkhatte'n dangka-eng darik singnih leh, dangka paun sangnih-le-zanih apia uhi.
Mipite lak a adangdangte piak dangka-eng darik singnih leh dangka paun sangnih leh, siampute puan sawmguk-le- sagih ahi.

Huchi in siampute, Levi mite, kongkhak ngakte leh lasa mite, mite lak a akhente leh Nethinim mite leh Israel tengteng a khopite uah atengta uhi. Akha sagihna ahong tun in, Israel suante akhopite uah a-om uhi.
Huchi in mite tengteng Tui Kongpi mai a om mun lian ah mi khat bang in akikhawmkhawmta ua; TOUPA'N Israel kiang a apiak, Mosi Dan laibu hon tawi ding in laigelhmi Ezra kiang ah thu ahilh uhi.
Siampu Ezra in omkhawmte, pasal leh numei, theihsiamna toh za thei ding tengteng ma ah akha sagihna ani khat ni in dan thu ahon lata hi.
Pasal leh numeite leh theisiam thei dingte ma ah, zingkhang a kipan sun lai tanpha in Tui Kongpi mai a om mun lian ma ah asimta hi; huchi in mite tengteng in Dan Laibu abildoh chiat uhi.

Huai ding mah a abawl uh, sing dohkang tung ah laigelhmi Ezra adingh a; asik ah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah leh Maaseiah, ataklam pang ah adingh ua; aveilam pang ah, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddana, Zekariah leh Meshullam.
Huchi in Ezra in mite mitmuh in laibu ahong a; mite tunglam ah a-om ngal a; huan ahongta a, mite tengteng adingh uhi:
Ezra in TOUPA, Pathian thupi avualzawl hi. Huchi in mipi tengteng in adawng ua, "Amen, Amen," chi a akhutte uh lik kawm in alute uh akunsak ua amai ua lei si in TOUPA abia uhi.

Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah leh Levi mite'n mipite dan theisiam ding in abawl ua: huchi in mite amau mun ah adingh uhi.
Huchi in teltak in laibu ah, Pathian dan sung ah asim ua; a-omdan ataklang ua, huchi a lai simkhiak atheihsiamna ding un.

Huan Nehemiah, amah Tirshatha ahi a, huan siampu leh laigelhmi Ezra, leh Levite mite sinsakte'n, mite tengteng kiang ah, "Tuni TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia ni siangthou ahi; dah kei unla kap kei un," achi ua. Dan thute azak un lah mite tengteng akap ngal ua.

Akiang uah, "Pai unla, thaute ne unla, akhumkhum dawn un, amah a dia bangmah bawlkhol a om lou kiang ah tantuante khak un: tuni lah i TOUPA uh a dia ni siangthou ahi ngal a. Dah kei unla; TOUPA a kipahna na hatna uh ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Levite'n mite tengteng adaisak ua, "Tuni siangthou ahih ziak in, dai sipsip unla; dah kei un," chi in.
Huan mite tengteng ne ding leh dawn ding leh vualnopna thupi bawl ding in apaita ua, akiang ua phuankhiak a om thute atheisiamta uhi.
Ani nih ni in mite tengteng pipute inko lupente, siampute leh Levi mite, laigelhmi Ezra kiang ah, Dan thute ngaikhe ding in akikhawmkhawm uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Israel suante akha sagihna ankuangluina a aidakbuk a atendan ding ua thu apiakdan dan a kigelh amu uhi:

"Tang ah kuankhia unla, olive hiang, gam olive leh muising hiang, tum hiang, sing vunsah hiang, akigelh bang a, aidakbuk bawlna ding in va la un, akhopi tengteng uh leh Jerusalem a apuankhiak theihna ding un," achi hi.
Huchi in mite akuankhia ua, ava la ua, michih in a-inn tung ah, ahuangsungte uah, Pathian huangsungte ah, Tui Kongpi a mun lian ah leh Ephraim Kongpi a mun lian ah aidakbukte akibawlta uhi.

Huan saltanna a kipan hong pai nawn omkhawmte tengteng in aidakbukte abawl ua, aidakbuk ah ateng uhi. Nun tapa Joshua dam lai a kipan huai ni tanpha in Israel suante'n lah huchibang in ahih nai kei uhi. Huchi in nakpi a kipahna mahmah a-omta hi.
Huai lou in niteng in ani masapen a kipan ani tawp ni tan in Pathian Dan laibu sung ah asim hi. Huan ankuangluina ni sagih anei ua; ani giat ni in paidan dungzui in kikhopna thupi a-omta hi.
Hiai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni in Israel suante an ngawl kawm leh sai-ip puansilh kawm leh atung ua lei kibuak kawm in akikhawm ua.
Huchi in Israel chite mikhual tengteng a kipan in akikoihtuam ua, adingh ua akhelhnate uleh, apipute uh thulimlouhnate thupha atawi uhi.
Amun uah adingh ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh Dan laibu sung ah ni khat a aseh lina teng asim ua; aseh lina teng thupha atawi ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh abeta uhi.
Huchih lai in Levi mite, Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani leh Kenanite dohkan tung ah adingh ua, TOUPA a Pathian kiang uah aw ngaihtak in akikou uhi.

Huai lai in Levi mite, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah leh Pethahiahte'n, "Dingh unla tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in TOUPA na Pathian uh vualzawl un: huchi in vualzawlna leh phatna tengteng tunglam a tawisang a om, na min thupi vualzawl in om hen.”

"Nang, nang kia mahmah TOUPA na hi; van, vante' van a, sepaihte tengteng, lei leh asung a thil om tengteng, tuipite leh asung ua om tengteng na bawl a, avek un na hawi a; van sepaihte'n nang ahon bia uhi.
Abram tel a, Kaldaite Ur a kipan a amah pikhia a, akiang a Abraham min pepa, TOUPA Pathian na hi;

Na ma a lungtang ginom na mu a, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Jebus mite leh Girgas mite gam pe ding a amah toh thukhun bawlpa, achite kiang a pe ding in, na thute bawl piching a; nang lah na diktat ngal a.
Aigupta a ka pipute uh gimthuakna na mu a, Tuipi San a akah uh na za a;

Pharaoh tung leh, asikhate tengteng tung leh, agam a mite tengteng tung ah chiamtehna leh thillamdangte na ensak a; amaute siatna ding in kisatheitak in agamtang uh chih lah na thei ngal hi; tuni a bang in, min na kimuh hi.
Ama uah tuipi na khen a, huchi in gam hul tung ah tuipi lak ah apaisuak ua; amau delhte nang tui thuk sung ah, tui hattak sung a suang bang in na pailut hi.
Huai lou in sun in meipi kitung in amaute na pi a; zan in meikuang dingh in, apaina ding lampi ua vakna amaute kiang a pe ding in.
Sinai Tang ah leng na hohsuk a, van a kipan in amau na houpih a, vaihawmna dikte leh dan dikte, dan thuseh leh thupiak hoihte na pia hi.
Amau kiang ah na Sabbath siangthou na theisak a, na sikha Mosi khut in, thupiakte leh dan thusehte leh dan amaute na thupiak in na pia hi.
Agilkial un van a kipan tanghou na pia a, adangtak un suangpi a kipan amaute a ding in tui na pawtkhesak a, amaute pe ding a na khut na lik a, gam luah ding a kuan ding in amaute thu na pia hi.
Himahleh amaute leh apipute un kisatheitak in ahih ua, apaupeng ua, na thupiakte angaikhe kei uhi,

Thu amang nuam kei ua, alak ua na hih na thillamdangte leng alimsak sam kei uh; himahleh aki-uangsak ua, ahelna uah atanna ua kik nawn ding in heutu khat asep uhi; himahleh nang ngaidam dia mansa, lainatna a dim leh hehpihsiam, heh mengmeng lou, zahngaihna hau, amaute lehngatsan lou Pathian na hi.
Ahi, bawngnou sun abawl lai un, Aigupta a kipan a nang hon pikhepa hiai na Pathian ahi, achi ua, nakpitak a thangpaihnate abawl lai un.

Huchi napi in na zahngaihna tampite ziak in amaute gamdai ah na lehngatsan kei hi: sun in atung ua kipan meipi dingh apaimang kei a, vakna amau pe ding, zan a meikuang dingh leng, apaina lampi uah amaute pi ding in.
Amaute chil ding in na kha hoih na pia a, akam uah na Manna na phal lou kei a, amaute adangtak un tui na pia hi.
Ahi, gamdai ah kum sawmli amaute na vak a, bangmah atasam kei ua; apuansilhte uh atul kei a, akhepekte uh abawk kei hi.
Huai ban ah lalgamte leh mite amau na pia a, atantuante uh dungzui a na piakkhiakte: Sihon gam, Heshbon kumpipa gam leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam alata uhi.
Van aksite bang in atate uh na pungsak a, nei ding in alut ding uh chi a, api-le-pute kiang a na gen bang in, gamsung ah na pilut hi.
Huchi in tate alut ua gam aneita ua, ama uah gam a tengte na satpuka, Kanaante, akumpite leh, gam a mite, amau khut ah na pia a, huchi a a-utdan ua atung ua ahihtheihna ding un.

Khopi hatte, gam hoihte ala ua, thil hoih tengteng a dim innte anei ua, tuibel sekte, grephuante, olive huante, atam a tam theikungte: huchi in ane ua, avah ua, ahong thau ua, na hoihna thupi ziak in akipak mahmah uhi.
Hinapi'n lah thu amang kei ua, na tung ah ahel ua, na dan anunglam uah apai ua, na kiang lam amaute ngasak nawn ding a, amaute dem a thugen na zawlneite athat ua, thangpaihna thupi mahmah abawl uhi.

Huaiziak in amelmate uh khut ah amau na pia a, amau ahihgenthei uh: abuai ni ua na kiang a ahong kah lai un, van a kipan in na za a; na zahngaihna tampi dungzui in amelmate uh khut a kipan a amaute hondam ding in akiang uah hondam mite na pia hi.

Himahleh atawldam nung un na ma ah gilou ahih nawn zel ua; huaiziak in amelmate uh khut ah amau na nusia a, huchi in amau atung uah thu anei ua: hinapi in ahong kihei ua, na kiang a akah un, van a kipan na za a; na zahngaihnate dungzui in amaute tamveipi na hunkhia hi.

Na dan a na pilut theih nawnna ding in, amau na dem a: himahleh kisatheitak in ahih ua, na thupiakte alimsak kei ua, na vaihawmte tung ah akhial zosop uhi, huai mi'n ahihleh, huai ah ahing ding, liang asawisak ua, aki-uangsak ua, aza nuam kei uhi.
Himahleh kum tampi amau na thuakzou a, na zawlneite in na kha zang in amaute na dem a, himahleh angaikhe nuam kei ua; huaiziak in gam mite khut ah amaute na peta hi.
Huchi napi in na zahngaihna tampite ziak in amaute na hihbei keuhkeuh kei a, na lehngatsan kei; nang lah hehpih thei leh chingthei Pathian na hi ngal a.

Huaiziak in tu in, ka Pathian uh, thupi Pathian hat leh kihtakhuai, thukhun leh zahngaihna vompa, na ma ah, ka tung uh, ka kumpipate uh tung, ka vaihawmte uh tung, ka siampute uh tung, ka zawlneite uh tung, ka pipute uh tung, na mite, Assuria kumpipate dam lai a kipan a tuni tan, na mite tung a, nauveina bangmah tham lou bang in kilang kei hen.
Akoi abang hitaleh ka tung ua hong tung tengteng ah nang na diktat a; nang lah diktak in na hih ngal a, kou bel giloutak in ka hih uhi.
Kumpipate leh ka vaihawmte uh hiam, siampute uh hiam, ka pipute uh hiam in na dan azui kei ua, na thupiakte leh na thu theihpihnate, amaute dem a na theihpihnate lah angaikhe nuam sam kei uhi.
Agam uah nang nna asem kei ua, na hoih mahmahna ziak a amau na piak, ama ua na piak gam lian leh hoih, anasep gilou ua kipan akilehhei sam kei uhi.
Ngai in, tuni in sikhate ka hi ua, agah nekna ding leh huai ahoihte neihna dia ka pipute uh kiang a na piak gam ahihleh, ngai in, asung ah sikhate ka hi uhi.
Ka khelhna ziak ua ka tung ua na koih kumpipate a ding in anak pun mahmah a, athuthu un, ka pumpite uleh, ka gantate uh tung athilhihtheihna anei ua, kou ka nak gim mahmah uhi."
Huan hiaite tengteng huchibang hita mahleh thukhun muanhuai ka bawl ua, ka gelh ua; ka vaihawmte uh, ka Levi mite uleh ka siampute un, huai ah suai akai uhi.
Aigupta gam a kipan ahong pawt uh akum nihna, akha nihna, ani khat ni in Sinai gamdai ah kihoupihna biakbuk ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suan omkhawm tengteng, a-inkuankuan un amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal tengteng sim vek in," achi hi.
"Kum sawmnih a pan atunglam Israel lak a galdou thei chiang peuhmah nang leh Aaron in apawlpawl in na sim vek ding uh ahi.
Na kiang ah nam chih lak a khat, inkuan a vaihawm makai a-om ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Hiaite na kiang a om dingte min ahi: Reuben nam a kipan Shedeur tapa Elizur,
Simeon nam a kipan Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel.
Judah nam a kipan Amminadab tapa Nahson.
Issakar nam a kipan Zuar tapa Nethaneel.
Zebulun nam a kipan Helon tapa Eliab.
Joseph tapate a kipan: Ephraim nam a kipan Ammihud tapa Elishama; Manasseh nam a kipan Pedazur tapa Gamaliel.
Benjamin nam a kipan Gideoni tapa Abidan.
Dan nam a kipan Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer.
Asher nam a kipan Okran tapa Pagiel.
Gad nam a kipan Deuel tapa Eliasaph.
Naphtali nam a kipan Enan tapa Ahira.
Hiaite omkhawm mipite' tel, api-le-pute uh nam a vaihawm makai Israel inkuan a lupente ahi uh, chi in.
Mosi leh Aaron in huai mi amin ua lohte api uhi.
Mipi omkhawm tengteng akha nihna, ani khat ni in asamkhawm vek ua; a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam teng apipute uh min ataklang uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Sinai gamdai ah asimta uhi.
Israel tapa upapen Reuben tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Reuben nam, asimte uh singli sangguk-le-zanga ahi.
Simeon tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Simeon nam, asimte uh singnga sangkua-le-zathum ahi uh.
Gad tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Gad nam a asimte uh singli sangnga zaguk-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
Judah tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Judah nam a asimte uh singsagih sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
Issakar tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Issakar nam a asimte uh singnga sangli-le-zali ahi uh.
Zebulun tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Zebulun nam a asimte uh singnga sangsagih-le-zali ahi uh.
Joseph tate lak a Ephraim tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Ephraim nam a asimte uh singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
Manasseh tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Manasseh nam a asimte uh singthum sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
Benjamin tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Benjamin nam a asimte uh, singthum sangnga-le-zali ahi uh.
Dan tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Dan nam a asimte uh, singguk sangnih- le-zasagih ahi uh.
Asher tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Asher nam a asimte uh, singli sangkhat-le-zanga ahi uh.
Naphtali tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
Naphtali nam a asimte uh, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi uh.
Hiaite Mosi leh Aaron in Israel vaihawm makai sawm-le-nih, inkuan a lupente toh asimte uh ahi.
Huchi in Israel suan a-inkuankuan ua kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng, Israel gam ate sim ahi uhi.
Asim teng uh nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
Levite pipute asimtel kei uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levi chi na simtel ding ahi kei, Israel mite lak ah na simtel ding ahi sam kei.
"Levite theihpihna biakbuk kem mite leh van tengteng kem mite dia seh zawk ding ahi. Biakbuk a van tengteng azawng ding ua, akem ding ua, biakbuk akimvel in a-omkhum ding uhi.
Biakbuk malam a apai chiang in Levite'n aphel ding ua; biakbuk kaih ding chiang in Levite mah in akai nawn ding uh. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah hihlup ding ahi.
"Israel suante'n amau mun chiat ah, apawlpawl in atamdan uh dungzui zel in apuaninte uh akai ding uh.
Himahleh Levite'n Israel suan omkhawmte tung a hehna a-omlouhna ding in theihpihna biakbuk kimvel ah akai ding uhi. Levite'n theihpihna biakbuk akep ding uh," achi hi.
Huchibang in Israel suante'n TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a thu apiak tengteng bang in ahihta uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Dangka pengkul nih bawl inla; sekthoh in bawl in. Mipi omkhawmte sapkhawmna ding leh pawtsakna dia na zat ding ahi.
Huai akimut chiang in mipi omkhawmte tengteng na kiang ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak bul a ahong kikhop vek ding uh ahi.
Khat lel amut uleh Israel mipite heutu intekpente kia na kiang a ahong paikhawm ding uh ahi.
Gallau mut a na mut uleh suahlam pang a omte apawt ding uhi.
Gallau mut a na mut nawn uleh simlam pang a omte apawt ding uhi. Apawtna ding un gallau mut bang a amut ding uh ahi.
Himahleh mipite hong paikhawmna ding in na mut peuhmah ding ua, gallau mut a bel mut lou in.
Aaron tapa siampute'n pengkul amut ding uh ahi. Huai nou a ding in na suante uh tan a tangtawn dan ahi ding hi.

Na gam ua melma, nou hon nuaisiahte dou dia na kuan chiang un gallau mut in pengkulte na mut ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian ma uah theihgigena ahi ding ua, na melmate ua pan humbit na hi ding uh.

Nuam na sak nite un, ahunbi a na ankuangluinate uah, na kha thakte uah, na halmang thillat uahte leh na kilemna thillat kithoihnate uah pengkul na mut ding uh ahi. Huchi in na Pathian ma uah nou a ding in theihgigena ahi ding. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," chi in.
Akum nihna, akha nihna, huai kha ani sawmnih ni in, hichi ahong hi a, meipi in theihsakna biakbuk tung atungkah santa hi.
Huchi in Israel suante apaidan dungzui in Sinai gamdai a pan apawt ua; Paran gamdai ah meipi akhawlta hi.
Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang in apawt uhi.
Amasapen in Judah pawlte, apawl uh tamdan dungzui zel in apawt ua; aheutu uh Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
Issakarte heutu Zuar tapa Nethaneel;
Zebulunte heutu Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
Biakbuk aphel ua, Gershon tapa leh Merari tapa biakbuk zawng mite apawt uhi.
Reubente apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi.
Simeonte heutu Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel ahi.
Gadte heutu Deuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
Kohathte'n mun siangthou azawng ua, apawt ua; adangte'n atun ma un biakbuk ana lam uh.
Ephraimte apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Emihud tapa Elishama ahi.
Manassehte heutu Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
Benjaminte heutu Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
Ananungpen in Dante apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
Asherte heutu Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
Naphtalite heutu Enan tapa Ahira ahi.
Hiai bang ahi Israel suante pawl atamdan dungzui ua apaidan uh, hiai bang in apai zom zel uhi.

Mosi sunghpa Midian mi Reuel tapa Hobab kiang ah, Mosi in, "K'on pe ding, TOUPA'N achihna mun ah ka pai ding ua, ka kiang uah hong sam inla, hoihtak in na tung ah ka hih ding uh. TOUPA'N Israel suante tungtang thu lah hoih in agenta ngal a," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka hong dah mai ding, ka gam uah ka tanaute kiang ah ka pai zaw mai ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Hon paisan mahmah ke'n, gamdai ah lah giahphual satna ding na thei zaw ngal a, kou a ding in mit na hong hi ding hi.
Hichi ahi dia, ka kiang ua na hong samleh, ahi, hichi ahi ding. TOUPA'N thil hoih hon hihsak bang in ka hon hihsak sam zel ding uhi," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA tang a pan ni thum lam ah apai ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm amau a dia kingakna mun zong in ama uah ni thum lam ah ana pai masa hi.
Abuk ua pan apawt un TOUPA meipi sun in atung uah a-om hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai bawm apawt ding peuhmah chiang in Mosi in, "TOUPA aw, hong kisa inla, na melmate hawlzak in, nang hon hote na ma ah taikek uhen," achi zel hi.
Akingakna peuh ah, TOUPA aw, Israel mipi sang tampite kiang ah hong kik nawn in, achi zel hi.
Huan mipite'n TOUPA zak a phun in thil hoih lou pipi agen ua; TOUPA'N huai azak in ahehta hi. Huchi in TOUPA mei alak uah ahong kuang a, giahphual ponungpen a omte akangta hi.
Huchi in mipite'n Mosi asam ua; TOUPA kiang ah Mosi athum a, huai mei amitta hi.
TOUPA mei alak ua ahong kat ziak in, huai mun min Taberah asa hi.
Alak ua mikihel pawl khat in sa lunggulhna ahon neita ua; Israel suante leng akap nawn ua, "Kua'n ahia nek ding sa hon pe ding?
Ut leh dah a Aigupta gam a ngasa i nek zelte i theigige ua, tangmaite, mazelte, phulun sialnek chite, vaiphulunte, phulun ngou leng.
Himahleh tu in i guhngek uh akeu khinta, bangmah lamet ding a-om kei, manna lel lou ngal," achi uhi.
Manna bel koriandar tang bang, alatdan in bedeli suang bang ahi.
Mite'n atomkhawm ua, gawinelna in agawinel ua, sum in asu ua, belte ah ahuan ua, tanghou in abawl uhi. Nek in sathau a kan tanghou abang hi.
Giahphual a zan a dai akiak in manna leng ahong kia hi.
Mipite a-inkuankuan un apuanin kongkhak chiat uah akap uh, chih Mosi in ana za hi. TOUPA aheh mahmah a; Mosi leng alungkim kei hi.
Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Bangziak in ahia na sikha na hon sukgim a, bang ahia na mit ka tunlouhna, hiai mite tengteng puakgik ka tung a na ngak?
Hiai mipite tengteng ka suan ahi ua hia? Api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a piak na chiam gam a pilut ding in. Naupommi in nawitui ne lai a pom bang in na angsung ah pom in, na hon chih dia ka pikhiak?
Hiai mipi tengteng piak ding sa koi a pan ka nei dia? 'Ka nek ding un sa hon pia in,' chi in akap ngal ua.
Hiai mipi tengteng keimah kia in ka po zou kei. Kei a ding in agik lua hi.
Hichibang a hon hih ding na hihleh, hon sisak vanglak in, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, ka gentheihna hon musak nawn mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Israelte Upa, mipite Upa leh aheutute uh hi a na theih mi sawmsagih ka kiang ah hon pikhawm inla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah nangmah toh dingkhawm ding in hon pi in.
Huchi in ka hong pawt dia, huai ah ka hong houpih ding. Na tung a om kha om pen atung uah ka koih ding. Nang kia'n po lou in mipite puakgik ahon puakpih ding uhi.

Nang mipite kiang ah, zingchiang a ding in kihihsiangthou vek unla; huchi in sa na ne ding uh. Sa nek ding kuan ahia hon pe ding? Aigupta gam a nuam i saksak uh toh, chi in TOUPA zak in na kap ua; huaiziak in, TOUPA'N noute sa ahon pe dia, huchi in na ne ding uhi.
Ni khat kia, ni nih kia, ni sawm kia, ni sawmnih kia leng na ne kei ding ua;

himahleh kha khat pumlum, na nakvang ua ahong pawtkhiak a nou a dia kihhuai ahong hih masiah na ne ding uh. Na lak ua om TOUPA na deih louh ua, Aigupta gam a pan bangziak a paikhia i hi ua? chi a, ama a na kah ziak un," achi hi.
Mosi in, "Ka ompih mipite khe a pai thei kia leng nuaiguk ahi ua; kha khat pumlum nek ding in sa ka pe ding, na chi hi.
Belamhon leh ganhon leng gohsak lehang leng, akham ding ua hia? Tuipi a ngasa tengteng leng matsak vek lehang leng, akhamzou ding ua hia?" achi hi.
TOUPA'N, Mosi kiang ah, "TOUPA khut tomsak ahi a hia? Na tung ah ka thu bang a, atun leh tun louh na thei mai ding,” achi hi.
Mosi apawt a, TOUPA thu mipite ahilh hi. Mipite Upa sawmsagihte asamkhawm a, puanin kim ah adingsak hi.
Meipi ah TOUPA ahong suk a, ahong houpih a, ama tung a om Kha pen Upa sawmsagihte tung ah akoih hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, atung ua kha akoihtak in thu agen ua; agen zom sawt kei uhi.

Himahleh giahphual ah mi nih a-om lai ua, khat min Eldad ahi, akhat pen min Medad ahi. Atung uah kha a-om a, upate lak a min khum ahi ua, himahleh kihoupihna biakbuk ah bel ahoh kei uhi. Giahphual ah thu agen uhi.
Huchi in tangval khat ava tai a, Mosi ava hilh a, "Eldad leh Medad in giahphual ah thu agen uh," achi hi.
Nun tapa Joshua, atuailai a pan Mosi nasempa'n adawng a, "Ka toupa Mosi, kham ve,” achi hi.
Mosi in akiang ah, "Kei gum a na thikthu sia hia? Pathian mi tengteng zawlnei hi vek le uh, TOUPA'N atung uah tua Kha koihchiatleh chi zomah lai ka hi!" achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi leh Israel Upa tengteng giahphual ah alut nawn uhi.
TOUPA a pan huih ahong nung a, tuipi a pan vengkeng ahon mutleng a, giahphual lehlam sang ni khat lam, alehlam ni khat lamtuak dimsuak in giahphual kim ah tong nih ding a sang in akesak hi.
Mipite'n huai ni nitum leh zankhua leh azing nitum tan in vengkeng ava tomkhawm ua; atom tawmpen in leng homer sawm atom hi. Giahphual kim ah amau a chiat aphou uhi.
Huai sa anek lai un, anek khit ma un, mipite tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, TOUPA'N hipi nasatak in mipite agawtta hi.
Hiai mun min Kibroth-hattaavah asa a; huai a saduhte avui ziak un.
Kibroth-hattaavah a pan mipite Hazeroth ah apai ua; Hazeroth ah agiahphual uh asat uhi.
Huan Miriam leh Aaron in Mosi in Kus numei zi a, aneih ziak in agensia ua; Kus numei bel anei ngei hi.
Amau, "Mosi kiang kia ah hia TOUPA'N thu agen tuam? Ei kiang ah leng agen sam kei a hia?" achi uh. TOUPA'N huai ana za hi.
Mosi bel leitung a mihing tengteng sang in amigi mahmah hi.
Thakhat in TOUPA'N Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam kiang ah, "Na thum un hong paisuk unla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah hong pai un," achi hi. Huchi in athum un ava hoh uhi.
TOUPA meipi dingh ah ahong paisuk a, puanin kongkhak ah ahong dingh a, Aaron leh Miriam asam a; anih un ahong paisuk uhi.
Ama'n, "Ka thu ngaikhia un. Na lak ua zawlnei na om uleh amah kiang ah kei TOUPA kilakna in ka kihil dia, manglam in ka houpih ding.
Ka sikha Mosi bel huchibang ahi kei. Ka inko tengteng ah amuanhuai hi.
Amah toh paukam in thuguk om lou in teltak in ka kihou ding ua; TOUPA mel leng amu ding. Huaiziak in ka sikha Mosi bangchidan a gense ngam na hi ua?" achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA atung uah aheh mahmah a, apai nawnta hi.
Puanin tung ah meipi akikhinta hi. Ngai in, Miriam vuk bang a ngou in ahong phakta a; Aaron in Miriam a-en a, ngai in, phak ana hita maimah hi,
Huchi in Aaron in Mosi kiang ah, "Ka toupa aw, ka tung uah khelhna nga mahmah ke'n. Haihuaitak in ka na hihta ua, ka na khialta uhi.
Anu sul a pan sisa phial mahmah a ahong pawt bang in amah omsak ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in, "Pathian aw, damsak nawn dih ve," chi in TOUPA angen hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Apa'n amai chilsiat hilhial taleh ni sagih azakta kei ding maw? Giahphual pua ah ni sagih kibu henla; huai khit chiang in pilut nawn hi hen," achi hi.
Huchi in giahphual pua ah ni sagih sung Miriam khumtuam in a-om hi. Miriam apilut nawn ma un mipite akisuan kei uhi.
Huai khit in mipite Hazeroth a pan apawt ua, Paran gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante ka piak, Kanaan gam va enkhe ding in mi sawl in. Anam inko chih ua mi, a-intekpa pen lak a mi khat chiat na sawl ding,” achi hi.
Mosi in Paran gamdai a pan TOUPA thupiak bang in akuansakta a; avek un Israel suante lak a intekpa pen chiat ahi uhi.
Hiaite amin uh ahi: Reuben nam lak a mi Zakkur tapa Shammua.
Simeon nam lak a mi Hori tapa Shaphat.
Judah nam lak a mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb.
Issakar nam lak a mi Joseph tapa Igal.
Ephraim nam lak a mi Nun tapa Hoshea.
Benjamin nam lak a mi Raphu tapa Palti.
Zebulun nam lak a mi Sodi tapa Gaddiel.
Joseph nam, Manasseh nam achih uh, lak a mi Susi tapa Gaddi.
Dan nam lak a mi Gemalli tapa Ammiel.
Asher nam lak a mi Mikael tapa Sethur.
Naphtali nam lak a mi Vophsi tapa Nahbi.
Gad nam lak a mi Maki tapa Geuel.
Hiaite gam enkhe dia Mosi in asawlte min ahi. Mosi in Nun tapa Hoshea, Joshua achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in Kanaan gam enkhe ding in amaute asawl a, akiang uah, "Simlam lampi ah pai phot unla, tangte ah kahtou un.
Huai gam bangchibang ahia, huai a teng mipite ahat uh hia, hat lou, atawm uh leh atam uh;
atenna gam uh ahoih hia hoih lou, a-omna khuate uh bangchibang ahia, puanin maimah hia, kulh nei;
huai gam lei thau ahi hia, lei gawng, gammang om hia om lou chih va enkhia un. Hangsantak in om unla, huai gam theigahte hon pua un," achi hi. Tu grep gah masa gah hun laitak ahi.
Huchi in akuantouta ua, huai gam Zin gamdai a pan Hamath lutna Rehob tan in a-enkhe vek uhi.
Simlam ah ahohtou phot ua, Hebron ava tung ua, huai ah Anak suan Ahiman, Sheshai leh Talmai a-om uhi. Hebron bel Aigupta gam a Zoan kilam ma kum sagih a kilam khinta ahi.
Eshkol Phaizang ava tung ua, huai ah grep gahbom khat ahiang toh asattan ua, chiang in mi nih in azawng uhi. Theibuhfai leh theipite leng apua uhi.
Israel suante'n huai a grep bom asatkhiak ziak un, huai mun Eshkol Phaizang asa uhi.
Ni sawmli zoh in gam etkhiakna a pan ahong kik nawn uhi.

Huchi in Paran gamdai a Kadesh ah Mosi leh Aaron leh Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng kiang ahong tung ua, akiang uah leh mipi omkhawmte tengteng kiang ah thu ahon tun ua, huai gam theite a-ensak uhi.
Akiang ah, "N'on sawlna gam ah ka va hoh ua, bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna ana hi ngei ngut a; hiai agam thei ahi.
Himahleh agam a mi tengte mihat pipi ahi ua, khuate leng kulh nei, thupi taktak ahi. Anak suante leng ka va mu uh.
Simlam gam ah Amalekte ateng ua; tanggam ah Hitte, Jebuste, Amorte ateng uh. Tuipi gei leh Jordan luidung ah Kanaante ateng uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
Huchi in Mosi ma ah Kaleb in mipite adaisak khipkhep a, "Kisa tou zok ni in, va latou zok ni, i zou ngeingei ding uh," achi hi.
Himahleh ahohpihte'n, "I va zou vek thei kei ding e, ei sang in lah ahatzaw ngal ua," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel suante kiang ah, "Ka va gam etkhiak uh gam, enkhe dia ka va vakna uh, asung a mi tengte nek khit hatmi ahi ua; ami om ka muhte uh mi awmkhauh pipi ahi uh.
Huai ah Anak suante, miliante, awmkhauh pipi ka va mu ua; koute lah khaupe bang lel in ka va kimu ua, amau leng khaupe ek bang lel in ahon mu uh," chi in ahoih lou lam in agen uhi.
Huan omkhawm tengteng aw suah in akap ua; huai zan in mite akap uhi.
Israel suan tengteng Mosi tung leh Aaron tung ah aphun ua; omkhawm tengteng in akiang uah, "Aigupta gam ah Pathian in hon that geih hileh aw! Ahihkeileh gamdai ah hon na that geih hileh aw!
Bang achia namsau a si maimah dia Pathian in hiai gam a hon pi ahi diam aw? I zi leh i tate lah mat maimah ding ahi ngal ua. Aigupta gam a kik nawn ei a dia hoihzaw lou ding hia? achi uhi.
Huchi in akihoukhawm ua, heutu bawl ni e, Aigupta gam ah kik nawn ni," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng ma ah Mosi leh Aaron abokkhup uhi.
Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb, gam va enkhete lak a telte'n apuan uh abotkek uh.
Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kiang ah, "Enkhe dia ka va vakna gam uh gam hoihtak ahi.
I tung ua TOUPA akipahleh huai gam ah ahon pilut ngei ding. Huai nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ahon pe ding hi.
TOUPA tung ah hel kei phot le uchin. Huai gam a mite leng lau sam kei un. I an ding uh ahi ua, akihumbitna uh bangmah ahi kei. TOUPA i kiang uah a-om hi, amau lau kei un," chi in agen uhi.
Himahleh omkhawm tengteng in suang a den asawm ua; huchi in kihoupihna biakbuk, Israel suan tengteng ma ah TOUPA thupina ahong kilangta hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n bang tan hon thusim lou ding ahi ua; alak ua chiamtehna ka hih zel nangawn a leng bang tan ahia hon taksan louh lai ding uh?
Hipi in ka gawt dia, ka in-gamsak dia, nangmah ah amau sang a thupi leh thilhihtheizaw nam ka bawlkhe zaw mai ding,” achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Aigupta mite'n aza kha ding uh. Hiai mite lah alak ua pan na thilhihtheihna a na pikhiakte ahi ngal ua.

Hiai gam a teng mite ahilh ding uh. Hiai mite lak ah nang TOUPA na om chih azata uh. Kimaituah hial a muh in na om a, atung uah na meipi a-om a; sun in meipi dingh, zan in meikuang in ama uh lah na pi zel hi.
Hiai mite na thahgamleh na minthanna za namte'n,
TOUPA'N hiai mite kichiam a, achiam gam a api theih louh ziak in gamdai ah athatta, achi ding uh.
Tu in ka hon ngen ahi, ka TOUPA thilhihtheihna hih thupi in om hen, thu a na gen tak dungzui in;
TOUPA lungneltak, migitna hau, thulimlouhnate, tatleknate ngaidam zel; moh a asehte khah ngei loupa, pate thulimlouhna tate, tate tasawnte, suan thumna leh suan lina tan a gawt zel ahi, na chi hi.
Na migitna athupi bang ngei leh Aigupta gam a pan tutan a na ngaihdam bang in mipite thulimlouhna ngaidam in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N, "Na thu bang in ka ngaidam hi.
Himahleh kei ka hin bang in TOUPA thupina in leitung pumpi adimsak ding.
Aigupta gam leh gamdai a ka thupina leh ka thillamdang hihte mu a, huchi pipi a leng sawmveitak hon ze-et lailai a, ka thu zui lou lai mi tengteng in;
apipute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam huai gam amu kei hial ding uh. Alak ua kei hon ngaineute mawngmawng in leng amu sam kei ding uh.
Ka sikha Kaleb in bel lungsim dang aput a, ahon zuih taktak ziak in, amah zaw ava hohna gam ah ka pilut dia, asuante'n huai aluah ding uh.
Phaizang a Amalekte leh Kanaante teng ahih ziak un, zingchiang in kihei unla, Tuipi San lampi lam gamdai ah lut un," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
"Hiai mithulim lou omkhawmte, ka tung a phunphunte bang tan ahia ka dohzoh ding? Israel suante phunna, ka tung a aphunnate uh ka za hi.
Akiang uah, ka hin bang in ka gen ahi, ka bilbuk ngei a na gen bang un na tung uah ka hih ding hi.
Na luang uh gamdai ah apuk dia; na lak ua simsa mi tengteng, kum sawmnih a pan atunglam ka tung a phun teng,
ban zak hial a, ka hon omsak ding, ka chih gam ah Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua kia lou ngal na lut kei ding uh,
Himahleh mat ding lel ahi ding uh, na chih uh na tate uh ka pilut dia, na ngaihneu uh gam athei ding uhi.
"Nou bel na luang uh hiai gamdai ah apuk ding hi.
Na tate uh gamdai ah kum sawmli sung avakvai ding ua, gamdai a na luangte uh amawk man masiah na kizuakna uh amau athuakloh ding uhi.
Gam na va etkhiak ni zah uh, ni sawmli, ni khat tang in kum khat zel, kum sawmli sung na tatlekna uh na thuakloh ding ua, huchi in ka thuchiam ka hihlamdan dan na thei ding uhi.
Kei TOUPA'N migilou omkhawm, kei hon kalh a omkhawmte tung ah hiai ka hih ngei ding ka na chi khinta hi. Hiai gamdai ah amangthang ding ua. Huai ah asi ding uh," achi hi.
Gam enkhe dia Mosi misawl hong kik nawnte'n, gam omdan ahoih lou lam agen un amah tung ah omkhawmte aphunsak hi.
Huai gam omdan ahoih lou lam agente ngei TOUPA ma ah hipi in asita uhi.
Gam enkhe dia hohte lak a Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb bel asi kei uhi.
Mosi in huai thute Israel suan tengteng ahilh a; huchi in mipite'n nakpitak in asuun uhi.
Huchi in zingsangpi in athou ua, tang vum ah ahohtou ua, "Ngai in, hiai ah ka hong pai uh. TOUPA'N ahon chiamna mun ah ka hoh ding uh, ka na khialta uhi," achi uhi.
Mosi in, "Tu a bangziak a TOUPA thupiak palsat na hi ua? Hiai alohching kei ding.
Na kiang ua TOUPA a-om louh ziak in hohtou kei un; melmate thah a na omlouhna ding un," achi hi.
"Na ma uah Amalekte leh Kanaante a-om uhi. Namsau a thah na hi phet ding uh. TOUPA na lehngatsan tak ziak un na kiang uah TOUPA a-om kei ding," achi hi.
Himahleh mualvum a hoh atum ua; himahleh TOUPA thukhun bawm leh Mosi giahphual a pan apawtkhe kei uhi.
Huchi in huai mual a om Amalekte leh Kanaante hong kuansuk in, ahong dou ua, Hormah tanpha in asatpuk phengphung uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, tenna ding a gam ka hon piakna na tun chiang un,

TOUPA kiang a mei a thillat ahihkeileh halmang thillat, ahihkeileh thuchiam tangtun dia kithoihna, ahihkeileh noumau ut thu a thillat, ahihkeileh ankuanglui hunbi, ahihkeileh ganhon lak, ahihkeileh belamhon lak, ahihkeileh TOUPA a dia gimlim bawl ding a na lat chiang un,
TOUPA kiang a thillat lanmi peuhmah in tangbuang thillat, tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat, sathau hin mun li a khen mun khat a mek alat ding ahi.
Dawn thillat dia uain hin mun li a khen mun khat halmang thillat, ahihkeileh kithoihna belamnou khat a dia na bawl ding uh ahi.
Belamtal a tangbuang thillat, tangbuang nelte, ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih, sathau hin mun thum a khen mun khat mek na bawl ding uh ahi.
Dawn thillat dia TOUPA a ding a gimlim ding uain hin mun thum a khen mun khat na lat ding uh ahi.
Haltum thillat ding, ahihkeileh thuchiam tangtun dia kithoihna, ahihkeileh TOUPA kiang a lemna thillat a bawngtal na lat chiang un;
Bawngtal lat toh kiton in tangbuang thillat tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum sathau hin kimkhat a mek na lat ding uh ahi.
Dawn thillat dia uain hin kimkhat, TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat na lat ding uh ahi.
"Huchibang in bawngtal, ahihkeileh belampa, ahihkeileh belamnou, ahihkeileh kelnou ahi ding ahi.
Atamdan uh dungzui zel in na bawl ding ua, atamdan uh dungzui zel in na lan ding uhi.
Huai gam a piang tengteng in hichibang zel in TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat alat chiang un ahih ding uhi.
Namdangmi na kiang ua tengsa him ahihkeileh kuapeuh na kiang ua teng zelzel ding hiamte'n leng TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat lan nuam peuhmah in na hih bang ua ahih sam ding uh ahi.
Na suante uh leh mipite leh namdang na kiang ua omte a dia leng dan khat kia a-om ding ahi. TOUPA ma ah namdangte noumau bang ahi ding uh.
Nou a ding leh na kiang ua namdang omte a ding in dan khat leh hihdan kibang khat kia a-om ding," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, hichi ahi ding a, ka hon pina ding gam na va tun ua,
huai gam tanghou na nek chiang un, TOUPA kiang ah vei thillat na lan ding uh ahi.
Na tanghou mek masakpen lak ua beu khatvei thillat dia na lat ding uh ahi. Buhphual a vei thillat dia na vei bang un na vei ding uhi.
Na suante uh tan in na tanghou mek masakpen uh TOUPA kiang a vei thillat dia na lat zel ding uh ahi.
"Hiai thupiak tengteng, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a agen, tup mawng hilou a zuih khak louh na neih uleh,
TOUPA'N thu apiak tung a pan na suante uh tan a dia Mosi zang a thu apiak tengteng chihna ahi.

Hichi ahi dia, omkhawmte'n thei lou a, ahih khak uh ahihleh, omkhawm tengteng in halmang thillat TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in bawngtuai khat alan ding ua, adan ngeina bang in tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat toh, khelhna kithoihna ding in keltal khat leng alan tel ding uh ahi.

Siampu in Israel suan omkhawm tengteng a ding in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding uh. Thei lou a hihkhak ahih ziak leh athillat uh TOUPA a dia mei a thillat leh ahihkhelh uh sik a khelhna kithoihna alat tak ziak un.
Israel suante omkhawm tengteng ngaihdam ahi ding ua, alak ua namdang omte leng; mipi tengteng in ahih khak uh ahih ziak in.
"Mi'n thei lou a thil ahihkhelhleh khelhna kithoihna ding in kelnu khat kum khat a upa alat ding ahi.
Thei lou a TOUPA ma a hihkhialmi a ding in siampu in kilemna abawl ding hi; huchi in ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
Thei lou a hihkhialmi a ding in, Israel suante, huai gam a piangte a ding leh namdangmi na lak ua omte a ding in leng dan khat na neih ding uh ahi.
"Himahleh tup mawng a hihkhial ahihleh, huai gam a piang hiam, namdang hiam leng hitaleh TOUPA gensia ahi a; huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
TOUPA thu musit a, athupiak abohsiat ziak in, huai mi satkhiak ding ahi, athulimlouhna moh ama'n apo ding, chi in," achi hi.
Israel suante gamdai a a-om lai un mi khat Sabbath ni a sing tom amu uhi.
Asing tom mu mite'n amah Mosi leh Aaron leh mipi omkhawmte kiang ah ahon pi uhi.
Bangchi a hih ding ahia chih genkhiak nai louh ahih ziak in tanna inn ah akhum uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mi hihlup ngeingei ding ahi, giahphual pua ah mipi omkhawm tengteng in suang in adeng ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in mipi omkhawm tengteng in giahphual pua ah api ua, suang in adenglumta uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah, asuante uh tanpha a, apuan mong ua agei bawl ding leh among teng gei a adum khak ding in gen in.
Huai among na et ua, TOUPA thupiak tengteng na theihgige ua na zuihna ding un leh; kizuak a na om zel bang ua na lungtang uh deih leh na mit uh la lam peuh deih a na omlouhna ding un.
Ka thupiak tengteng na theihgige ua na zuih ua, na Pathian uh a dia na sianthou theihna ding uh ahi.
Na Pathian uh hi ding a Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa TOUPA, na Pathian uh ka hi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi,” achi hi.
Levi tapa Kohath, huai tapa Izhar, huai tapa Korah pen Eliab tapate, Dathan leh Abiram leh Peleth tapa On leh Reuben tapate'n mite api ua;
Israel suante, mi tallang deuhdeuh mipi omkhawmte lak a heutu vaihawmmi dia telte lak a mi zanih-le-sawmnga toh Mosi ma ah ava kisa uhi.

Mosi leh Aaron kalh in akikhawm ua, akiang uah, "Na uang lua uh, na uang lua uh, omkhawm mipite lah asiangthou chiat ngal ua, TOUPA alak uah a-om chih mu zenpi a, bangziak a TOUPA mipi omkhawmte tung a kikoih na hi ua?" achi uh.
Mosi in huai azak in amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.

Korah leh apawlte tengteng kiang ah, "Zingchiang in TOUPA'N amah ate kuate ahi ua, kuate ahia siangthou, chih ataklang ding a, akiang ah ahon pai naisak ding. Ama'n amitel ngei tan in akiangnai ah apaisak ding hi.
Hichi in hih un, Korah leh apawlte tengteng aw, zingchiang in mei laknate tawi unla;
huai ah mei koih unla, TOUPA ma ah gimlim buak un. TOUPA'N atel peuhmah asiangthou ding. Levi tapate, na uang lua uh," chi in agen hi.
Mosi in Korah kiang ah, "Nou Levi tapate aw, ngaikhia unla,

TOUPA biakbuk nasep sem ding leh khawmpi nna sem dia khawmpite ma a dingh a, amah kiang a hon om naisak ding a, Israel Pathian in Israel omkhawmte a pan noute ahon omsak, nou a dia thil neuchik phet a kilang hia?
Amah kiang ah ahon om naisakta a, na kiang a na unau Levi tapa tengteng, siamputna leng na zong ua hia?
Huaiziak in nang leh na pawl tengteng TOUPA kalh in na kikhawm uh ahi. Aaron in bang ahih a ahia, atung a na phun uh?" achi hi.
Mosi in Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram asamsak a, "Amau ka hong paitou kei ding uh.
Gamdai a hon that dia nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a pan na hon pikhiak thil neuchik ahi hia? Ka tung uah na kilalsak nawn ngal a.
Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ah na hon pilut kei a, lou ding leh grephuan gou ding lah na hon pe kei a; hiai mite mitte na mialsak ding maw? Ka hong paitou kei hial ding uh," achi uh.
Huchi in Mosi aheh mahmah a, "TOUPA kiang ah, athillat uh sang ke'n. Asabiltung uh khat lel leng ka la kei, kuamah ka hih na kei," achi hi.
Mosi in Korah kiang ah, "Zingchiang in nang, na mi kikhawmte leh Aaron TOUPA ma ah ana om un.

Amei lakna uh tawi chiat uhenla, gimlim buak uhen. TOUPA ma ah amei lakna uh hon tawi uhenla, mei lakna zanih-le-sawmnga hon tawi uhen. Nang leh Aaron in leng na mei lakna uh tawi tuaktuak un," achi hi.
Huchi in michih in amei lakna uh atawi chiat ua, mei akoih ua, gimlim abuak ua, Mosi leh Aaron toh kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ava dingh uhi.
Korah in mipi tengteng ama ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah a-omkhawmsak a; mipi tengteng kiang ah TOUPA thupina ahong langta hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
"Hiai mipi omkhawmte a pan kihuikhia un, amau ka hihmang guihtheihna ding in," achi hi.
Amau abokkhup ua, "Pathian aw, sa tengteng kha Pathian, mi khat khelh ziak in mipi omkhawm tengteng tung ah na heh dia hia?" achi uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Mipite kiang ah, Korah, Dathan leh Abiram puanin a pan kihemkhia un, chi in gen in," achi hi.
Mosi athoutou a, Dathan leh Abiram kiang ah ava hoh a; Israelte upate'n azui uhi.
Omkhawmte kiang ah, "Hiai migiloute puanin a pan pawtkhia un. Abangmah uh khoih kei un, huchi lou in zaw akhelhna tengteng uah na pangkha ding uh," chi in agen hi.
