Huchi in Korah, Dathan leh Abiram puanin a pan apawtkhe duamduam ua; Dathan leh Abiram ahong pawtkhia ua, apuanin kongkhak uah azite, atapate leh atanu neu chikchikte uh toh adingh uhi.
Mosi in, "Keimah lungsim a pawtkhia ahi kei a, hiai thilhih ding in TOUPA'N ahon sawl ahi, chih hiai ah na thei ding uh.
Hiai mi tengteng dan bang lel a asih ua, mi tengteng gawt bang lel a gawt ahih uleh Pathian in kei hon sawl lou ahi ding.
Himahleh TOUPA'N thil thak abawl a, lei in akam akat a, amau leh amau a tengteng avalh a, ahing a Sheol alut uleh bel hiai mite'n TOUPA ana hehsak uh, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thu tengteng agen khit in anuai ua lei ahong khangkham phok hi.
Lei in akam aka a, a-inkuan un Korah mi tengteng, aneih tengteng uh toh avalh khin vekta hi.
Huchi in amau leh amau a tengteng Sheol ah ahing in atum vek ua, lei in akam achihkhum a, omkhawmte lak a pan amangthangta uhi.
Huchi in akim ua Israel tengteng akikou husa uah ataizak ua, lei in ei leng ahon valh kha ding, achi uhi.
TOUPA a pan meikuang ahong pawtkhia a, gimlim lanmi zanih-le-sawmnga ahong kanglumta hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron tapa siampu Eleazar kiang ah thu gen inla, ama'n meikuang a pan mei laknate lakhe ding in hilh in, siangthou lah ahita ngal ua.
Ahinna tung mah a hiai mikhialte mei laknate maitam khuhna kuang ding in sek hi uhen, TOUPA ma a lat ahi ngal a. Huaiziak in asiangthou hi, huai Israel suante a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding," achi hi.
Siampu Eleazar in mi kangte dal mei laknate ala a; maitam khuhna ding in asekta hi.

Israel suante a dia theihgigena hi ding in huchi a Aaron tate hilou namdang himhim, TOUPA ma a gimlim hal dia ahong pai nailouhna ding un. Mosi zang a akiang a TOUPA'Nagen bang a, Korah leh apawlte bang ahong hihlouhna ding in.
Himahleh azingsang in, TOUPA mite na that uh, chi in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Mosi leh Aaron tung ah aphun uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi leh Aaron tung mipi apunkhawm lai un, kihoupihna biakbuk lam a-en ua; ngai in, meipi in ahon khuh a, TOUPA thupina ahong kilang hi.
Mosi leh Aaron kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ahoh uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hiai mipi omkhawmte lak a pan kihemkhia un, amau ka hihmang guihtheihna ding in," achi hi. Amau amai ua lei si in abokkhup uhi.

Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Na mei lakna tawi inla, maitam a pan mei koih inla; gimlim buak inla, mipi omkhawmte kiang ah paipih meng inla, amaute a ding in kilemna bawl in. TOUPA hehna ahong suak hi; hipi aleng panta," achi hi.
Aaron in Mosi gen bang in atawi a, omkhawmte lak ah atailut a, ngai in, mipi lak ah huai hipi ahong leng pan a; gimlim abuak a, mipi a ding in kilemna abawl hi.
Misi leh mihing kikal ah adingh a, hipi akhawlta hi.
Huchi in Korah tungtang thu a site sim louh, hipi a si tengteng singkhat sangli-le-zasagih ahi uh.
Aaron kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a Mosi kiang ah akik nawn a, huchi in hipi akhawlta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, a-inkuan chih a tuam ding in chiang khat chiat, a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a a-intekpen tengteng zah, chiang sawm-le-nih la inla; achiang uah amin uh gelh in.
Levi chiang ah Aaron min gelh inla; a-inkuan chih uh a ding in chiang khat zel ahi ding ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin thu theihsakna ma ah na koih dia, huai ah i kimu ding.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka tel ding mi chiang asel ding; huchi in Israel suante na tung a aphunna uh ka daisak ding,” achi hi.
Mosi in Israel suante ahoupih a, a-intekpen tengteng in amau inkuan chih a tuam a ding, intekpen chih in chiang khat zel, chiang sawm-le-nih apia uhi. Huaite lak ah Aaron chiang leng atel sam hi.
Mosi in theihpihna biakbuk ah TOUPA ma ah huai chiangte akoih hi.
Azing in hichi ahong hi a, theihpihna puanin ah Mosi ava hoh a; ngai in, Levi inkuante a dia Aaron chiang ana sel a, pakmum asuah a, apakpalh a, vaisuaklu min asuang hi.
Mosi in TOUPA ma a pan chiang tengteng Israel tengteng kiang ah alakhia a; ana en ua, amau chiang chiat ala uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Helhat tate ahi uh chih theihsak zelna ding in Aaron chiang theihpihna bul ah koih nawn in. Huchi in ka tung a ahelna uh na daisak thei ding, asihlouhna ding un," achi hi.
Huchibang in Mosi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahih hi.
Israel suante'n Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka si ua, ka mangthang uh, ka vek un ka mangthang uh.
TOUPA biakbuk kiangnai a hong pai peuhmah asi ding uh. Kou leng si in ka mangthang ding uh maw?" achi uhi.

Huan TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Nang leh na tapate leh na inkuan un mun siangthou tung a khelhna toh kisai mohpuakna na la ding uh ahi. Nang leh na tapate kia in siampu hihna toh kisai thilhihkhelhte a mohpuakna na puak ding uh ahi.

Na unaute, Levi suante leh na pa inkote hon tawnpih in, huchi a amau mun siangthou tung a khelhna toh kisai a mohpuakna alaktheihna ding un. Nang leh na tapate'n bel siampu hihna toh kisai thilhihkhelhte ah mohpuakna na lak ding uh ahi.
Nna nasep ahon huh ding ua, puanin nasep tengteng atang ding ua, himahleh mun siangthou tui-um belsuan leh maitam pen hon naih kei uhen, asihlouhna ding un, amau hiam, nang hiam in leng.
Puanin nasepna tengteng ah kihoupihna biakbuk nna pen atang ding uh. Namdangte'n nou ahon naih ding uh ahi kei hi.
Nang mun siangthou nasep leh maitam nasep pen na tang ding, Israel suante tung a hehna a-om nawnlouhna ding in.
Ngai in, ke'n na unau Levite, Israel suante lak a pan ka telkhia a, kihoupihna biakbuk ah asem ding uh. TOUPA'N nang a hon thilthawnpiak ahi uh.

Nang leh na tapate'n maitam leh puanzak sunglam thu ah na siampu nasep uh na sem ding uh. Nang na sem dia; siampu nasep na sep ding in ka hon pia hi. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah thah ahi ding uh," achi hi.

TOUPA'N Aaron ahoupih a, "Ngai in, Israelte thil siangthou teng lak a kei a dia vei thillat teng leng ka hon pia hi. Thaunilh na hih ziak leh na tapate tangtawn dan ding ahih ziak in huaite ka hon pia hi.

Mei a dia keptuam, thillat siangthoupente nang a ahi ding uh. Athillat teng uh, tangbuang thillat hiam khelhna thillat hiam mohna thillat hiam tantuan thillat tengteng nang leh na tapate tantuan ahi uh.
Mun siangthoupen ah na ne ding ua; pasal teng in ane ding ua, nou a ding in hiai thil siangthou ahi.

"Hiaite kei a tuam ahi; athilpiak uh tangbuang thillat, Israel suante vei thillat tengteng tan in. Nang, na tapate leh tanute a dia tangtawn a na tantuam ding ua ka hon piak ahi. Na inn a misiang tengteng in ane thei ding uh.
Sathau hoihpen, grep hoihpen, buh hoihpen leh gah masapen TOUPA a dia apiak teng uh ka hon pia hi.
Alou ua gah min masapen TOUPA a dia ahon tawi uh nang a ahi dia; na inn a misiang teng in ane thei ding uh.
Israelte thillat tengteng nang a ahi ding.
"TOUPA a dia apiak uh sul hong masapen peuhmah mihing leng gan leng nang a ahi ding. Himahleh tapa masapen zaw na tan ngeingei dia, gan siang lou nou suakkhe masapen leng na tat ding ahi.
"Kha khat ahih in tat dingte tatna man na sehdan bang in, mun siangthou a shekel hihdan bang a shekel nga a na tat ding ahi, shekel tuh gerah sawmnih ahi.

Himahleh bawng suakkhe masapen hiam, belam suakkhe masapen hiam, kel suakkhe masapen hiam, na tat ding ahi kei; asiangthou uhi. Asisan uh maitam ah na theh dia, TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in athaute mei a thillat in na hal ding ahi.
Asa uh nang a ahi dia, vei thillat leh aliang taklam pang nang a ahih bang in.
"Thil siangthou vei thillat, Israel suante'n TOUPA a dia alatte uh tangtawn a na tantuam ding un ka hon pia hi. TOUPA ma a nang, na tapate leh na tanute a dia tangtawn thukhun ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Agam uah goutan na nei kei dia, alak uah leng tantuan na nei sam kei ding. Israel suante lak a na tantuan leh na goutan, Keimah ka hi.
"Ngai in, anasep, puanin a asep man ding un, Israel gam a sawm-a-khat tengteng Levi suante kiang ah ka pia ahi.
Tu a pan Israel suante'n kihoupihna biakbuk ahon naih het louh ding uh ahi; khelhna pua in asi kha ding uh.

Himahleh Levite'n bel kihoupihna biakbuk nasep asem ding ua; Israelte khelhna toh kisai mohpuakna ala ding uh. Hiai asuante tan a ding in dan thusehsa hi dia; Israel suante lak ah goutan anei kei ding uh.
Israel suante'n sawm-a-khat TOUPA a dia vei thillat alat uh Levite goutan ding in ka pia hi. Huaiziak in akiang uah, Israel suante lak ah goutan anei kei ding uh, ka na chita him ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levite houpih inla, akiang uah, na goutan ding ua Israel suante sawm- a-khat ka hon piak na lak chiang un, huai sawm-a-khat a pan sawm-a-khat TOUPA kiang ah vei thillat ding in na lan ding uh ahi.
Na vei thillat uh buhphual a buh leh uain tung masapen dia sim ahi ding.
Huchibang in Israel suante lak a sawm-a-khat na lak tengteng uah leng TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan zui zel ding uhi; huai TOUPA vei thillat pen siampu Aaron na piak ding uh ahi.
Na thillat tengteng lak ua ahoihpen, asiangthoupen TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan ding uhi.
Huaiziak in akiang uah, ahoihpen na vei chiang un Levite buhphual a tung leh grep sukna a pan tung bang a sim ahi ding.
Koi lai peuh ah leng na ne thei ding uh, nou leh na inkuanpihte un leng; kihoupihna biakbuk a na sep man uh ahi ngal a.
Ahoihpen na vei uleh akhelh moh na po kei ding uh. Israel suante thil siangthou na hihthanghuai kei ding ua, na si kei ding uhi, chi in," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
"Hiai TOUPA thupiak dan ahi. Israel suante bawngla san, dembei, gensiatbei, hakkol bulhsak ngei het louh na kiang a hon kai ding in hilh un.
Siampu Eleazar na pe ding a, ama'n giahphual pua ah apikhe dia, ama ah mi khat in agou ding hi.
Siampu Eleazar in akhut in asisan ala dia, kihoupihna biakbuk ma ah asisan sagihvei atheh ding.
Mi khat in huai bawngla amitmuh in ahal dia; avun, asa, asisan leh a-ek ahalmang ding hi.
Siampu in sidar sing, hissop leh khau san ala dia, abawngla hal uah apailut ding ahi.
Siampu in apuansilhte sawp in, akisil dia, huai khit in giahphual ah ahoh dia, nitaklam tan in siampu siang lou ahi ding.
Ahal mi in apuansilhte sawp in, akisil dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Mi asiang khat in bawngla vu alakhawm dia, giahphual pua a mun siang a ngaih ah akoih dia, Israel suan mipi omkhawmte kisiansakna tui dia zat ding ahi. Hiai khelh siansakna ahi.
Bawngla vu lakhawm mi in apuansilhte asawp dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding. Hiai Israel suante leh namdang akiang ua omte a ding in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
"Kuapeuh siluang khoih peuhmah ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding.
Amah ani thum ni in akisiangsak dia, ani sagih ni in asiang ding. Himahleh, ani thum ni a akisiansak keileh ani sagih ni in leng asiang kei ding hi.

Kuapeuh siluang khoihmi, akisiansak keileh TOUPA biakbuk ahihnin ahi. Huai mi Israel mite a pan satkhiak ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui atung a atheh louh ziak in asiang kei dia, atung ah asianlouhna a-om lai hi.
"Puanin a mi asihleh hiai adan ding ahi. Puanin a lut peuhmah leh puanin sung a om peuhmahte ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding uh.
Tui-um belsuan kihong, sit louh peuhmah siang lou ahi uh.
Gamlak a namsau a thah hiam, misi luang hiam, mihing guh hiam, han hiam mi'n akhoihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding.
"Asiangloute a tuam ding in khelh thoihna vu ala ding ua, bel ah tuikhuk tui toh asung ding uhi.
Misiang in, hissop ala dia, tui ah adiah dia, puanin tung, tui-um belsuan tengteng, huai a om mi tengteng, guh hiam, thah siluang hiam, misi luang hiam, han hiam khoih mite tung ah atheh ding.
Misiang in ani thum ni leh ani sagih ni in misiang lou atheh dia, ani sagih ni in ahihsiang dia; apuansilhte asawp dia, akisil dia, nitaklam in ahong siangta ding hi.
"Misiang lou kisiangsak lou in TOUPA mun siangthou ahihnit ziak in huai mi omkhawmte a pan satkhiak ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui a theh louh ahi a, siang lou ahi.
Hiai amau a ding in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui a theh peuhmah in apuansilhte asawp dia; akisiansakna tui khoih peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
Misiang lou in akhoih peuhmah siang lou ahi zel dia; huai khoihmi kuapeuh nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupiha,
“Israel suante’n a inkuan chiamtehna uh bang chiat in apawl uh hihdan bang in apuanin uh akai ding uhi. Kihoupihna puanin a pan bangtan hiam kihal in akai ding uhi.
"Nisuahna lam suahlam pang ah apawl uh tamdan dungzui zel a puanin kai dingte Judah pawlte ahi ding ua; Judah tate lak a vaihawmbmakai ding Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
Sim a om pawlte tamdan, singsagih sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
Amah zom a puanin kai dingte Issakar chi ahi ding a; Issakar tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Zuar tapa Nethaneel ahi.
Sim a om pawlte tamdan singnga sangli-le-zali ahi uh.
Zebulun chite, Zebulun tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangsagih-le-zali ahi uh.
Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in sim a om Judah inkuante nuaikhat singgiat sangguk-le-zali ahi uh. Amaute'n ma akai zel ding uhi.
"Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in asimlam pang ah Reubente pawl a-om ding ua; Reuben tate lak a vaihawm makai Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli sangguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
Azom a dingte Simeon chi ahi ding ua; Simeon tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangkua-le-zathum ahi uh.
Huai khit in Gad chite ahi ding ua, Gad tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Reuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli sangnga zaguk-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
Reubente tamdan nuaikhat singnga sangkhat zali-le-sawmnga ahi uh; apawl uh dungzui in. Azom in amaute apawtkhe ding uhi.
"Kihoupihna puanin ah akipankhe ding ua, Levite alai ah a-om ding ua, a-omna thu zil bang zel in apawlpawl in apai chiat ding uhi.
"Apawl tamdan thu in atumlam pang ah Ephraimte a-om ding ua, Ephraim tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Ammihud tapa Elishama ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
Azom in Manasseh chi ahi ding a; Manasseh tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singthum sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
Azom nawn in Benjamin chite, Benjamin tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singthum sangnga-le-zali ahi uh.
Ephraimte tamdan nuaikhat sanggiat-le-zakhat ahi. Azom nawn in apaikhe ding uhi.
"Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in Dante amallam pang ah a-om ding ua; Dan tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singguk leh sangnih leh zasagih ahi uh.
Azom a puanin kai dingte Asher chi ahi ding a; Asher tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli leh sangkhat leh zanga ahi uh.
Azom nawn in Naphtali chite; Naphtali tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Enan tapa Ahira ahi,
Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi uh.
Dante tamdan nuaikhat singnga sangsagih-le-zaguk ahi ua; amau apawlpawl a pawtkhia in ananungpen ahi ding uhi."
Hiai Israel suante inkuan teng a mi asimte uh, tamdan ahi a, nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga apha uhi.
Levite Israel suante lak a simtel ahi kei uh; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
Huchibang in Israel suante'n ahih ua; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang zel in apawlpawl in puanin akai uhi. Huchi mah bang in achichi in a-inkuankuan zel un akipankhe zel uhi.
Huan Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng huai kha khatna in Zin gamdai alut ua; mipite'n Kadesh ah giahphual asat ua; huai ah Miriam asi a, huai ah avui uhi.
Omkhawmte a ding in tui a-om kei a; Mosi leh Aaron kalh in akikhawm uh.
Mite'n, "TOUPA ma a i unaute asih lai un Pathian in hon that geih maileh aw!
Kou leh ka gante uh toh bangziak a TOUPA mipite si ding a gamdai a pilut na hia?

Bangziak in ahia hiai gam hoihloupi a hon pilut dia Aigupta gam a pan na hon pawtkhiaksak mahmah? Buh-le-balte, theipite, grepkungte, theibuhfaite omlouhna mun ahi, tui dawn ding mahmah leng a-om sam kei hi,” achi uhi.
Huchi in Mosi leh Aaron mipi a pan kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ahoh ua, abokkhup ua; TOUPA thupina akiang uah ahong kilang hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Chiang la inla, mipite omkhawmsak inla, nang leh na sanggampa Aaron toh, huai suangpi in amitmuh ua tui pawtsak ding in thu pia in. Suangpi a pan tui na lakkhiaksak dia, mipi omkhawmte leh agante uh na dawnsak ding ahi," achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA ma a pan chiang, athupiak bang in ala hi.
Mosi leh Aaron in mipite suangpi bul ah a-omkhawmsak ua, Mosi in akiang uah, "Nou mihelte aw, ngai un, hiai suangpi a pan tui ka hon lakkhiaksak ding ua hia?" achi uhi.
Mosi in aban azak a, achiang in suangpi nihvei asat a; huchi in tui tamtak ahong pawt a, mipi omkhawmte leh agante un adawn uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "N'on gintak louh ua, Israel suante mitmuh a na hon pahtawi louh ziak un hiai omkhawmte ka piak gam ah na pilut kei ding uh," achi hi.
Hiai Meribah tui ahi. Israel suante'n TOUPA akinakpih ua, amaute lak a amah pahtawi a a-om ziak in.
Mosi in Kadesh a pan Edom kumpipa kiang ah mi asawl a, "Na unaupa Israel in hichi in achi, ka tung ua thuakna hong tung tengteng na thei hi.
Ka pipute uh Aigupta gam ah ahohsuk ua, sawtpi Aigupta gam a ka om uh, Aigupta mite'n kou leh ka pipute hoih loutak in ahon bawl uh.
Huchi in TOUPA ka sam ua, ka aw uh ana za a, angel ahon sawl a, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia a, ngai in, na gam naihpen khua Kadesh ah ka om uhi.

Hehpih in na gam ka tawn paisuak ding uh aw. Lou hiam, grephuan hiam ka tawn kei ding ua, tuileh tuite leng ka dawn kei ding uh. Kumpipa lamlian ah ka pai ding ua, na gam ka khen masiah uh taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah ka pial kei ding uh," achi hi.
Edom in akiang ah, "N'on palsuak ding ahi kei. N'on palleh hon dou ding in namsau toh ka hong kuan ding," achi hi.
Israel suante'n akiang ah, "Lamlian ah ka paitou ding ua; kou leh ka ganta un na tui ka dawn uleh aman ka hon pe ding uh. Thil dang bangmah hih lou in apai in ka paisuak mai ding uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Paisuak lou ding," achi hi. Huchi in Edom mipi tampi leh mihat taktakte toh amau dou ding in ahong kuanta uhi.
Hiai bang in Edom in Israel mite agam a apaisuak uh aphal kei a, Israel mite'n akiksan nawnta uhi.
Huchi in Kadesh a pan apawt ua; Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Hor tang ahong tung uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron, Edom gam naih Hor tang ah ahoupih a,
"Achipihte kiang ah Aaron pi ahita ding. Meribah tui a ka thu kalh a, ahel ziak in Israel suante ka piak gam ah alut kei ding.
Aaron leh atapa Eleazar Hor tang ah hon pitou in.
Aaron puansilhte suahsak inla, atapa Eleazar silhsak in. Aaron achipihte kiang a pi ahi ding, huai ah asi ding," achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in ahih a; mipi omkhawm tengteng mitmuh in Hor tang ah apaitou uhi.
Huchi in Mosi in Aaron puansilh asuahsak a, Eleazar asilhsak hi. Aaron tang vum ah asita a, tang a pan Mosi leh Eleazar ahong paikhesuk uhi.
Mipi omkhawm tengteng in Aaron si ahi chih atheih un, Israel inkote'n ni sawmthum sung Aaron asuun uhi.
Huan Kanaan mi, kumpipa Arad simlam a om in, Atharim lampi ah Israel mite ahong pai uh chi a kigen ana za a; huchi in Israel mite ana dou a, galmat khenkhat anei hi.
Israel mite'n TOUPA kiang ah thu achiam ua, "Ka khut ua hiai mite na hon piakleh akhuate uh ka hihmang ding uh," achi uh.
TOUPA'N Israel mite thu apom a, akiang uah Kanaan mite apia a, amau leh akhuate ahihmang uhi. Huai mun min Hormah asa uhi.
Hor tang a pan Tuipi San lam ah Edom gam kualkhum in apai ua; alampi ziak in mipi alunglel mahmah uhi.
Mipite'n Pathian leh Mosi kalh in, "Gamdai a si dia bang ding a Aigupta a pan hon pikhia na hia? Tanghou lah om lou, tui lah om lou. Hiai tanghou kihhuai lah ka hinna un akih hi,” achi uh.
Huchi in TOUPA'N mipi lak ah gul gukhahte asawl a, mite atu ua, Israel mite tampi asi uhi.

Huaiziak in mite Mosi kiang ah ahong pai ua, "TOUPA leh nang kalh a ka na pau uh ka khialta uh, i lak ua gulte lamang ding in TOUPA kiang ah thum dih ve," achi uhi. Huchi in mite a ding in Mosi athum hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Gul gukhah lim bawl inla, khuam lek ah khai in. Huan hichi ahi ding a, gultukmi peuhmah in huai a-et uleh adam ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in dal gul abawl a, khuam lek ah akhai a; huan hichi ahong hi a, gultukmi peuhmah in huai dal gul a-et uleh adam uhi.
Israel suante apai zel ua, Oboth ah giahphual asat uhi.
Oboth a pan apai nawn ua, nisuahna lam Moab gamdai bul Ije-abarim ah giahphual asat uhi.
Huai a pan apai nawn ua, Zered Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
Huai a pan apai nawn ua, Amorte gamgi a pan hong dawktuam gamdai a Arnon lehlam ah giahphual asat uhi. Arnon bel Moab gamgi, Moab leh Amorte kikal a om ahi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA kidounate laibu ah, Tuipi San leh Arnon luitate a;
Ar tenna a luangkhia luite leh Moab gamgi a omte ah athilhihte, achih.
Huai a pan Beer ah apai nawn ua; huai bel TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a mipite samkhawm inla, tui ka pe ding, achihna tuileh ahi.
Huchi in Israelte'n hiai la asa uh. "Aw tuikhuk, hong kikhohkhia inla, athu la in sa un.
Dan petu in akawkmuh bang a miliante uleh mipite heutute'n akhetbuk uh toh alaih uh tuikhuk," chi in. Huchi in gamdai a pan Mattanah tan;
Mattanah a pan Nahaliel ah; Nahaliel a pan Bamoth ah;
Bamoth a pan Moab lou a phaizang leh gamdai sunsuk Jeshimon lam nga Pisgah vum ah apai uhi.
Israel mite'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon kiang ah mi asawl ua,
"Na gam ah hon paisuaksak ve; lou ah hiam, grephuan ah hiam ka pial kei ding ua; tuileh tuite ka dawn kei ding uh. Na gam ka khen masiah uh Kumpipa Lamlian ah ka pai zel ding uh," chi in.

Himahleh Sihon in Israel mite agam a apaisuak uh aphal kei hi. Sihon in amite tengteng akaikhawm vek a, Israel mite dou ding in gamdai ah akisazawta hi. Jahaz ava tung ua; huai ah Israel mite adou uh.
Israel mite'n namsau in amah athat ua, agam Arnon a pan Jabok tan in, Ammon suante tan in alazou uhi. Ammon suante gamgi kulh nei ahih ziak in agam chiang lel alazou uhi.
Israel mite'n huai khua tengteng ala ua; Israel mite'n Amorte khua tengteng aluah uhi. Heshbon leh akhopel tengteng ah leng ateng uhi.
Heshbon khua bel Amorte kumpipa Sihon khua ahi. Amah huai ma a Moab kumpipa asual a akhut a pan gam tengteng, Arnon tan alaksakpa ahi.
Huaiziak in paunak gente'n, "Heshbon ah hong pai in, kilam thak hen, Sihon khopi kilam thak hen, achi uhi.
Heshbon a pan mei ahong pawt a, Sihon khopi a pan meikuang. Moab a Ar akang khin a, Arnon a mun sang a toupate toh.
Aw, Moab, na tung agik hi. Na mangthangta, Aw Kemosh mi! Ama'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon kiang ah tapate galtaite bang in leh atanute saltangte bang in apia hi.
Himahleh amau ka kap ua, Dibon tan in Heshbon amangthangta. Huchi in Nophah tan in ka hihmang uh, huai in Medeba tan apha hi."
Huchibang in, Amorte gam ah Israel mite ateng uhi,
Mosi in Jazer enkhe ding in mi asawl a, akhuate ala ua, huai a teng Amorte ahawlkhia uhi.
Akik nawn ua, Bashan lampi ah apaitou uh. Bashan kumpipa Og, amau dou ding in, amah leh amite tengteng, Edrei ah akisakhia uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Amah lau ke'n. Amah, amite tengteng leh agam na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon tung a na hih bang in na hih ding ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in amah leh tapate hawi himhim nei lou in amite tengteng toh athat ua; agam aluahsakta uhi.
Huan Israel suante apai zel ua, Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
Zippor tapa Balak in Israel mite'n Amorte abawldan tengteng uh ana thei hi.
Moabte'n mite alau mahmah ua, atam ngal ua. Israel suante ziak in Moabte alungkham uhi.
Moabte'n Midian upate kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n bawng in loupa anekgaih bang in i kim ua mi tengteng anegai ding uh," achi uhi. Huai lai in Zippor tapa Balak Moab kumpipa ahi.

Huaiziak in Beor tapa Balaam, Pethor a om kiang ah mi asawl hi. Huai bel amite suante gam a lui kiang a om ahi. Amah ava sam ua, "Ngai in, Aigupta gam a pan hong paikhia mipi a-om ua; ngai in, leitung maikaih atuamdim ua, ka kiangchin ah a-om uhi.

Hehpih in hong pai inla, hiai mite hong hamsiat dih ve. Kei a ding in ahat lua ua, ka zoh theih ua ka gam a pan ka delhkhiak theih zenzen khak uleh. Na vualzawl peuhmah vualzawl in a-om a, na hamsiat peuhmah lah hamsiat in a-om, chih ka thei," ava chisak hi.
Huchi in Moab upate leh Midian upate aisanna ding tawi in apawtkhia ua; Balaam kiang ava tung ua, Balak thukhah ahilh uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Tuzan hiai ah giak unla, TOUPA'N hon hilh bangbang thu na kiang ua ka hon tun ding," achi hi. Huchi in Moab miliante Balaam kiang ah agiakta uhi.
Balaam kiang ah Pathian ahong a, na kiang a mite kuate ahi ua? achi hi.
Balaam in Pathian kiang ah, "Zippor tapa Moab kumpipa Balak in ka kiang ah,
'Ngai in, Aigupta gam a pan a hong pai mipite'n leitung maikaih aluahdim uh. Hong pai inla, hong hamsiat in, ka zoh theih a, ka delhkhiak theih khakleh,' " chi in mi ahon sawl hi, achi hi.
Pathian in Balaam kiang ah, "Akiang ua na hoh ding ahi kei. Huai mite na hamsiat ding ahi kei; mihampha ahi uh," achi hi.
Zingsang in Balaam athou a, Balak miliante kiang ah, "Na gam uah pai nawnta un. TOUPA'N na kiang ua hoh dia ka pawt aphal kei,” achi hi.
Huchi in Moab miliante athou ua, Balak kiang ah apai ua, "Balaam in ahon zui ut kei," achi uhi.
Balak in milian tamsem, asang ua zahtakhuaizaw asawl nawn hi.
Balaam kiang ava tung ua, akiang ah, "Zippor tapa Balak in hichi in achi, 'Ka kiang a na hong hoh ding bangmah in dal kei hen.
Mithupitak in ka hon bawl dia, ka kiang a na gen peuhmah ka hih zel ding. Huaiziak in hong pai teitei inla, hiai mite hong hamsiatsak mahmah mai in,' " achi uhi.
Balaam in Balak mite adawng a, akiang uah, "Balak in a-inn dim dangka leh dangka-eng hon pe ding himahleh, abangmah TOUPA ka Pathian thu pel in ka hihthei kei.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah bangchi in ahia agen nawn ding, tuzan hiai lai ah giak peuhmah phot un," achi hi.
Zan in Balaam kiang ah Pathian ahong a, akiang ah, "Hiai mite nang hong sam a hong ahih uleh, thou inla, akiang uah hoh in. Himahleh na kiang a ka gen kia na hih ding ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in zingsang in Balaam athou a, asabiltung tung ah tutphah aphah a, Moab miliante azuita hi.
Huchi in ahoh ziak in Pathian aheh mahmah a, amah na lamdal ding in lampi ah TOUPA angel ana dingh hi. Asabiltung tung a tuang ahi a, asikhate nih leng akiang ah a-om uhi.
Sabiltung in TOUPA angel, namsau tawi a lampi a dingh amu hi. Huchi in lampi a pan sabiltung apialkhia a, gamlak ah apai a, Balaam in lampi a kiksak tum in sabiltung asat hi.
Grephuan umna kikal kuak ah TOUPA angel adingh hi.
Sabiltung in TOUPA angel amu a, grephuan umna ava ngai a, dai umna toh Balaam khe anehden hi. Balaam in asabiltung asat nawn hi.
Apam deuh ah TOUPA angel apai a, mun kochik laitak, taklam hiam, veilam hiam a leng pialna omlouhna laitak ah adingh hi.
Sabiltung in TOUPA angel amu a, Balaam akualpihta hi. Balaam aheh mahmah a, achiangkhun in sabiltung asat hi.
TOUPA'N sabiltung apausak a, Balaam kiang ah, "Bang ka hon chih a ahia? Thumveitak na hon huchi sat?" achi hi.
Balaam in sabiltung kiang ah, "N'on simmoh ziak in ahi. Namsau tawi hi leng, ka hon that khin hialta ding," achi hi.
Sabiltung in Balaam kiang ah, "Tutan a na tuanna gige na sabiltung ka hi kei a hia? Hichibang in ka hon hih ngei a hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hih ngei lou e,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Balaam mit avaksak a, TOUPA angel namsau tawi alampi a dingh amuta a; akun a, amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Bang achia hichibang a na sabiltung thumvei sat na hia? Ngai in, na gamtatdan ka mitmuh a asiat ziak in hon na lamdal dia hong pawtkhia ka hi.
Sabiltung in ahon mu a, ka ma a thumvei pial ahi. Pial keileh amah that lou a, nang hon that khin ding ka hi,” achi hi.
Balaam in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Ka na khialta hi. Hon na lamdal ding in lampi ah na dingh chih ka thei kei hi," achi hi.
TOUPA angel in Balaam kiang ah, "Hiai mite kiang ah hoh inla; himahleh na kiang a ka thugen ding kia na gen ding ahi," achi hi. Huchi in Balaam in Balak miliante azuita hi.
Balak in Balaam ahong chih azak in Arnon lam a gamgi chiang ah Moab khopi pha in ava dawn a, huai tuh gamgi tawpna ahi.
Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Phatuamngaitak a nang hong sam dia mi ka hon sawl ahi kei maw? Bangziak a ka kiang a hong nuam lou na hia? Mithupitak in ka hon bawl thei ka hia?" achi hi.
Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka hong hi. Bangmah gentheihna mawngmawng ka nei a hia? Pathian in ka kam a thu akoih kia ka gen ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Balak kiang ah Balaam ahohta a, Kiriath-huzot ava tung uhi.
Balak in bawng leh belam alan a, khenkhat Balaam leh akiang a om miliante kiang ah akhak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Balak in Balaam api a, Baal mun sangte ah ahohtouhpih a, huai a pan mite omna chiang amupha hi.
Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Hiai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belampa sagih hon suktuahsak in," achi hi.
Balak in Balaam gen bang in ahih a; Balak leh Balaam in maitam chin ah bawngtal khat leh belam khat alan uhi.

Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Na halmang thillat bul ah ana dingh gige inla, kei ka va paituam ding. Kei hon houpih ding in TOUPA ahong pai kha thei hi. Ama'n hon hilh peuhmah ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
Huchi in mual giau velvul ah ahohtou hi. Pathian in Balaam ana kituahpih hi. Balaam in akiang ah, "Maitam sagih ka bawl khin a; maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat ka lan chiat," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Balaam kam ah thu akoih a, "Balak kiang ah kik nawn inla, va gensawn in," achi hi.
Huchi in akiang ah akik nawnta a; ngai in, ahalmang thillat bul ah amah leh Moab milian tengteng leng ana dingh lai uhi.
Ama'n thu agenta a, "Aram a pan Balak in ahon pi a, suahlam tang a Moab kumpipa'n, 'Hong inla, Jakobte hon hamsiatsak in, hong inla, Israelte hong dalsak in!' achi a.
Bangchi in Pathian hamsiat louh ka hamsiat dia? Bangchi in Pathian dal louh ka dal dia?
Amau lah suangpi tung a pan ka mu ngal a, mualte a pan amau ka mu a, ngai in, mite atuam in ateng ding ua, namte lak a simtel louh ding ahi uh.
Jakobte leivui kua'n asim thei dia, Israelte mun li a khen, mun khat kua'n ahia sim thei ding? Midiktat sih in si sam ning, ka tawpna amah a bang hi hen!" achi hi.
Balaam kiang ah Balak in, "N'on bawldan bangchidan ahia? Ka melmate hamsiat ding in ka hon pi a, na vualzawl zaw mawk ngal a!" achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "TOUPA'N ka kam a akoih ka gen ding mah hilou ding maw?" achi hi.
Balak in akiang ah, "Mun dang ah hoh nawn dih ni e, huai a pan na thei vek ding. A-omna chiang uh na mu ding, avek un zaw na mu vek khol kei ding. Huai a pan hon hamsiatsak in," achi hi.
Huchi in Zophimte tenna Pisgah vum ah apitou a, maitam sagih adoh a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat alan hi.
Balak kiang ah, "Pam a TOUPA ka va houpih sung in na halmang thillat bul ah ana dingh lai in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Balaam ana kituahpih a, akam ah thu akoih a, "Balak kiang ah kik nawnta inla, akiang ah va gensawn in," achi hi.
Akiang ah ava hoh a, ngai in, ahalmang thillat bul ah ana dingh nilouh hi. Moab miliante leng akiang ah a-om uh. Balak in akiang ah, "TOUPA'N bang ana gen a?" achi hi.
Ama'n thu agenta hi: "Thou inla, Balak, ngaikhia in. Zippor tapa, ka thu ngai in.
Pathian zaw Zuauhat mihing ahi kei. Kisik hat mihing tapa leng ahi sam kei. Agensa ahih kei dia hia? Ana gensa ahih piching kei dia hia?
Ngai in, vualzawl ding in thupiak ka mu a, ama'n avualzawl khin a, ke'n ka hihlamdang thei kei.
Jakobte ah thulimlouhna amu kei a, Israelte ah phengphitna amu sam kei. TOUPA a Pathian uh akiang uah a-om a, alak uah kumpipa kikou husa a-om hi.
Aigupta a pan Pathian in apikhia a, gam bawngtal tha bang anei uhi.
Jakobte tung ah bumhaina a-om kei a; Israelte tung ah leng khimhaina a-om sam kei hi. Jakobte leh Israelte kiang ah Pathian thilhih hihlat ahi!
Ngai in, humpinelkai lian bang in mipite athou ua, humpinelkai dawng bang in adingtou ua; asamat uh anek ma un akual kei ding uh, amat uh sisan adawn ma un," achi hi.
Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Hamsiat ke'nla, vualzawl leng vualzawl het ke'n," achi hi.
Himahleh Balaam in adawng a, Balak kiang ah, "TOUPA'N agen tengteng ka hih ngeingei ding ahi chi in ka hon hilh khin ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Hong dih, mun dang ah ka hon pi nawn dia, huai a pan na hon hamsiatsak Pathian in phal kha zenzen hiam," achi hi.
Huchi in Jeshimon lam nga Peor vum ah Balak in Balaam apitouta hi.
Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Hiai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belampa sagih hon suktuahsak in," achi hi.
Balak in Balaam gen bang in ahih a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat alan hi.
Israelte vualzawl ding TOUPA deihlam ahi chih Balaam in atheih in nidang a ahih bang in bumna zat tum lou in gamdai lam anga zawta hi.
Balaam avandak a, Israel mite anam dungzui zel a om amu a; atung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung hi.
Huchi in hiai thu agen a, "Beor tapa Balaam in agen a, amit a kichiantak a mupa'n agen hi.
Pathian thute za a, Bangkim hihtheipa kilakna mu, akhup a puk a, amitte hong vakpa'n agen hi.
Jakob aw, na puaninte hoih hi na e, Israel aw, na biakbukte uh!
Phaizang bang in akiphah a, luidung a huante bang in, TOUPA suan tosaw bang in, luidung a sidar singte bang ahi uh.
Abaltinte a pan tui asungkhe dia, tui tampite ah ahaichi a-om dia, akumpipa Agag sang in asangzaw dia, alalgam tawisang in a-om ding hi.
"Aigupta a pan Pathian in apikhia a, gam bawngtal hatna bang anei a, Amelma uh namdangte anegai dia, aguhte uh atansak dia, athaltangte in akap pailet ding hi.
Akun a, humpinelkai bang in akual a, humpinelkai bang mai in; kua'n atokthou dia? Hon vualzawl peuhmah vualzawl in om uhenla, hon hamsiat peuhmah hamsiat in om hen," achi hi.
Balaam tung ah Balak aheh mahmah a; akhutte nuaituah in Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Ka melmate hamsiat ding in ka hon sam a, tu in, thumveitak amau na vualzawlta.
Huaiziak in na mun ah taimang in. Thupitak a hon tawisang ding ka hon chih na hi a; himahleh, ngai in, TOUPA'N nang ka hon tawisang ding adal," achi hi.
Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Na misawlte kiang ah ka gen kei maw?

'Balak in a-inn dangka leh dangka- eng a dim hon pe ding himahleh, ahoih lam hiam, aselam hiam TOUPA thu khen lam ah keimah lungsim a suak in bangmah ka hihthei kei. TOUPA'N agen peuhmah ka gen ding,' chi in.
"Ngai in, ka mite kiang ah ka paita ding. Huaiziak in hong hoh in, tunung a na mite tung a hiai mite'n ahih ding uh ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
Hiai thu agen a, Beor tapa Balaam mitvaktak amu in agen hi.
"Pathian thute za a, Tungnungpen theihna thei, Bangkim hihthei kilakna mu, akhup a puk a mit hong vakta in;

Amah ka mu, himahleh tu in hilou in; Amah ka en a, naichik ah hilou in. Jakob a pan aksi khat ahong suakkhe dia, Israel a pan lalchiang ahong dingkhe dia, Moab gam nawlte adou dia, Seth tapate ahihse ding hi.
Amelma Edom leh Seirte lak zoh in a-om ding ua; Israel in hattak in ahih ding hi.
Jakob a pan ukmi khat ahong paikhe dia, khopi a omsunte ahihmang ding," achi hi.
Amalek lam anga a, thu agen a, "Amalek bel namte bulpen ahi na a, adawn lam tangtawn a amanthatna ahi," achi hi.
Kente lam anga a, thu agen a, "Na tenna mun akip a, suangpi ah na bu na sep hi.
"Asshurte'n sal a hon pimang masiah, Kente hihmanthat in na om ding uh," achi hi.
Thu agen nawn a, "Pathian in hiai ahih, kua ahing zou dia?
Himahleh Kittim gam a pan longte ahong tung ding ua, Asshur ahihgim dia, Eber ahihgim ding ua, Amah leng amangthang ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Balaam adingkhia a, akhua ah apaita. Huchi in Balak leng apai samta hi.
Huan Shittim a Israelte ataam sung un, pasalte'n Moab numeite akithuahpih uhi.
Apathiante uh ma a kithoihnate ah achial ua; huchi in ane ua, apathiante ma ah akun uhi.
Israelte'n Peor Baal abe samta uhi. Huchi in Israelte tung ah TOUPA hehna akuangta hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mipite heutu tengteng pi inla, TOUPA hehna lauhuaitak mai Israelte tung a pan akikhinmang theihna ding in sun khovak ah amaute that in," achi hi.
Mosi in Israelte vaihawmte kiang ah, "Peor Baal biakna a tel peuhmahte that vek un," achi hi.
Ngai in, puanin kongkhak a mite kap a a-om laitak un, Mosi leh Israel omkhawmte mitmuh in Israel mi khat in Midian numei khat a-unaute kiang ah ahon pi hi.
Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in amuhtak in omkhawmte a pan athou a, teipi khat alata hi.
Israel mi apuanin sung ah adelhlut a, Israel mi toh anih un asun pailet a, numei pen agil ah asun pailet hi. Huchi in Israel suante tung a hipi adaita hi.
Himahleh huai hipi a site singnih-le-sangli ahi uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in alak ua kei a dia phatuam angaih ziak in Israel suante a pan ka hehna aheimang a, huchi in ka thikthusiat ziak in Israel suante ka hihmangthang kei hi.
Huaiziak in ngai in, ka lemna thukhun amah ka pe ding hi.
Amah leh anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn siamputna thukhun ahi dia; a Pathian a dia phatuam ngai a Israel suante a dia kilemna abawlsak ziak in, chi in gen in," achi hi.
Midian numei toh athah uh Israel mi min Jimri ahi a, amah Simeonte lak a inkuan a vaihawm makai Salu tapa ahi.
Athah uh Midian numei min Kozbi ahi. Amah Zur tanu ahi a, Midiante inkuan lak a heutu ahi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Midiante hihlungzing unla, that un.
Amau Peor tungtang thu leh a-unaunu uh Midiante heutu tanu Kozbi toh kisai a noute ahon khem lai un, melma bang a hon sai uh ahi. Peor ziak a hipi ahong tun in Kozbi thah a om ahi,” achi hi.
Huan hipi adaih nung in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Mosi leh siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar ahoupih a,
"Israel suan omkhawm tengteng, kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, a-inkuan dungzui un Israel gam a galdou thei chiang teng sim vek un," achi hi.
Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang ah amaute ahoupih a,
"Mipite kum sawmnih a pan atunglamte sim un," TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante kiang a thu apiak bang in, achi uhi.
Israel ta upapen Reuben: Reuben tapate: Hanok suan Hanok inkote, Pallu suan Pallu inkote.
Hezron suan Hezron inkote, Karmi suan Karmi inkote.
Hiaite Reubente inkuante ahi uh. Sim a om tengteng singli sangthum zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi uh.
Pallu suan Eliab.
Eliab suante: Neumuel, Dathan leh Ahiram ahi uh. Hiai Dathan leh Abiram ahi ua, TOUPA ahehsak lai ua Mosi leh Aaron kalh a Korah pawl a tel omkhawmte.
Huai pawl asih lai un lei in akam aka a, Korahte toh avalhkhawm a; mei in mi zanih-le-sawmnga akattum lai in, huchi in chiamtehna ana hita uhi.
Himahleh Korah tapate asi kei uh.
Simeon tapate inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a asuante uh: Nemuel suan Nemuel inkote, Jamin suan Jamin inkote, Jakin suan Jakin inkote,
Zerah suan Zerah inkote, Shaul suan Shaul inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite Simeon suante ahi ua, singnih sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Gad tapate: Zephon suan Zephon inkote, Haggi suan Haggi inkote leh Shuni suan Shuni inkote,
Ozni suan Ozni inkote, Eri suan Eri inkote;
Arod suan Arod inkote leh Areli suan Areli inkote.
Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Gad tapate suante ahi ua, singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
Judah tapate: Er leh Onan ahi a, huan Kanaan gam ah Er leh Onan asi uhi.
Judah suante inkuan paidan hichibang ahi: Shelah suan Shelah inkote,
leh Perez suan Perez inkote: Zer suan Zer inkote, Hezron suan Hezron inkote; Hamul suan Hamul inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite asimdan bang zel un Judah tapate suante ahi ua, singsagih sangguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Issakar suante: Tola suan Tola inkote, Puah suan Puah inkote,
Jashub suan Jashub inkote, Shimron suan Shimron inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Issakar tapate suante ahi ua, singguk sangli-le-zathum ahi.
A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Zebulun suante: Sered suan Sered inkote, Elon suan Elon inkote, Jahleel suan Jahleel inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Zebulunte suante ahi ua, singguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
A-inkuan uh kizomdan dungzui zel a Joseph suante: Manasseh leh Ephraim.
Manasseh suante: Makir suan Makir inkote; Makir in Gilead asuang a, Gilead suan Gilead inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite Gilead suante ahi ua: Iezer suan Iezer inkote, Helek suan Helek inkote,
Asriel suan Asriel inkote, Shekem suan Shekem inkote,
Shemida suan Shemida inkote; Hepher suan Hepher inkote ahi uh.
Hepher tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lou in tanute anei a: Zelophehad tanute min Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi uh.
Hiaite Manasseh suante ahi uh. Asim teng uh singnga sangnih-le-zasagih ahi.
Hiai a-inkuan uh kizomdan dungzui zel a Ephraim suante ahi ua: Shuthelah suan Suthelah inkote, Beker suan Beker inkote, Tahan suan Tahan inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite Shuthelah suante ahi ua: Eran suan Eran inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite asimdan bang zel un Ephraim suante inkuan ahi ua, singthum sangnih-le-zanga ahi. Hiai a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Joseph suante ahi uh.
A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Benjamin suante: Bela suan Bela inkote, Ashbel suan Ashbel inkote, Ahiram suan Ahiram inkote,
Shupham suan Shupham inkote, Hupham suan Hupham inkote ahi uh.
Bela suante Ard leh Naaman ahi uh: Ard suan Ard inkote, Naaman suan Naaman inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel in Benjamin suante ahi uh. Asim teng uh singli sangnga-le-zaguk ahi.
Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi ua: Shuham suan Shuham inkote ahi uh. Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi uh.
Saham suante tengteng asimdan bang zel un singguk sangli-le-zali ahi.
A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Asher suante ahi ua: Jimna suan a pan Jimna inkote, Ishvi suan a pan Ishvi inkote; Beriah suan a pan Beriah inkote.
Beriah suan Beriah inkote: Heber suan a pan Heber inkote; Malkiel suan a pan Malkiel inkote ahi uh.
Asher tanu min Serah ahi.
Hiaite Asher tapate suan asim teng uh ahi ua, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi.
A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante: Jahzeel suan a pan Jahzeel inkote; Guni suan a pan Guni inkote;
Jezer suan a pan Jezer inkote; Silem suan a pan Silem inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante ahi ua; asim teng uh singli sangnga-le-zali ahi.
Hiaite Israel suante asim teng uh ahi ua, nuaiguk sangkhat zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hiaite amin zah zel ua gam hawmsak ding ahi.
Atam deuhte gam na pe tam dia, atawm deuhte gam na pe tawm deuh ding ahi. Asimdan bang in gam piak chiat ding ahi.
Himahleh aisan a gam hawm ding ahi: Apute nam min kizomdan bang zel in gam atang ding uhi.
Aisan bang zel in atam leh atawmte kiang ah gam hawm ahi ding hi,” achi hi.
Hiai Levite, a-inkuan kizomdan bang zel ua simte ahi uh: Gershon suan a pan Gershon inkote; Kohath suan a pan Kohath inkote; Merari suan a pan Merari inkote ahi uh.
Hiaite Levi suante ahi uh: Libni inkote, Hebron inkote, Mahli inkote, Mushi inkote, Korah inkote ahi uhi.
Kohath in Amram asuang a, Amram zi min Jokebed, Levi tanu, Aigupta gam a Levi a pan a piang ahi a, ama'n Amram lak ah Aaron leh Mosi leh asanggamnu Miriam asuang hi.
Aaron in Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar asuang hi.
Nadab leh Abihu in TOUPA zat louh chi meikuang azat lai un asi uhi.
Sim tengteng pasal kha khat chiang tunglam teng singnih-le-sangthum ahi. Israel mite lak ah gam hawm tang ding ahih louh ziak un Israel mite lak ah sim ahi kei uh.
Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang a Israel suante Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in asim uh hiaite ahi uh.
Himahleh hiaite lak ah Sinai gamdai a Israel mite Mosi leh siampu Aaron in asimte, khat lel leng a-omta kei hi.
TOUPA'N gamdai ah asi ngeingei ding uh, ana chi khinta ngal a. Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua lou ngal kuamah dam a-om kei uhi.
oseph tapa Manasseh suan a Manasseh tapa Makir, huai mi tapa Gilead, huai mi tapa Hepher tapa Jelophehad tanute ahong pai ua, atanute min, Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi uh.
Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh miliante leh omkhawmte tengteng ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ava dingh uhi.
"Gamdai ah ka pu uh asi a, TOUPA kalh a kikhawm, Korah pawl ah atel kei. Himahleh amah khelh ziak in asi a, tapa anei kei hi.
Tapa aneih louh ziak lel in bangziak a ka pa uh min, asuante a pan mang ding ahia? Ka pa unaute lak ah tantuan hon pia un," achi uhi.
Mosi in athu uh TOUPA ma ah atun hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Jelophehad tanute'n ahihdik uhi. Apa uh unaute lak ah tantuan na bawlsak ding ahi. Apa uh tantuan na piak ding ahi.
Israel suante kiang ah mi tapa nei lou a asihleh agou atanute na piak ding uh ahi.
Tanu aneih keileh agou a-unaute na piak ding uh ahi.
"Sanggam pasalte aneih keileh agou apa sanggam pasalte na piak ding uh ahi.
Apa'n sanggam pasalte aneih keileh agou atanau na pe ding ua, ama'n aluah ding hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a Israel suante a ding in vaihawmna dan thuseh kip ahi ding, chi in gen in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Abarim tang ah hohtou inla, Israel suante ka piak ding gam va en in.
Na muh khit chiang in na sanggampa Aaron achipihte kiang a pi ahih mah bang in nang leng pi na hita ding hi!
Zin gamdai a omkhawmte aphun lai ua amitmuh ua tui a kei hon pahtawi dia ka hon thupiak kalh a na hel ziak in," achi hi. Huaite Zin gamdai a Kadesh a Meribah tuite ahi.
Mosi in TOUPA ahoupih a,
"Omkhawm mipite tung a om ding mi khat, sa tengteng khate Pathian, TOUPA'N sep hen.
TOUPA mi omkhawmte chingtu nei lou belam bang a a-omlouhna ding un, ama uh kai ding, amaute pikhia a, pilut ding in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Huai Kha omnapa Nun tapa Joshua pi inla, atung ah na khut nga in.
Siampu Eleazar leh omkhawm mipite ma ah dingsak inla, amitmuh un amah nna guan in.
Israel suante mipi omkhawm tengteng in athu aman theihna ding un atung ah na zahtakhuaina nga in.
Huchi in amah siampu Eleazar ma ah adingh dia, ama'n TOUPA ma ah Urim thu alaksak dia; athu in apawt ding ua, athu in alut ding uh; amah leh Israel suan tengteng, omkhawmte toh," achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in ahih a, Joshua api a, Eleazar leh omkhawmte ma ah adingsak hi.
Huchi in atung ah akhut anga a, Mosi zang a TOUPA'N agen bang in nna aguanta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante thu pia inla, akiang uah, kei a dia gimlim mei a thillat, ka kiang a thillat pen ahun geih in na lan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Akiang uah, hiai mei a thillat TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi. Belamnoupa, kum khat a upa, gensiatbei, niteng in nih, halmang thillat alat gige ding ahi.
Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan ding ua, nitaklam in khat na lan ding uh.
Tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat sathau suk, hin mun li a khen mun khat a hel toh.
TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, gimlim dia Sinai Tang a sehsa halmang thillat lat gige ding ahi.
Belamnou khat latna a dawn thillat, hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi. TOUPA a dia uain, dawn thillat mun siangthou ah na sungkhe ding ahi.
Belamnou khat nitaklam in na lan dia: zingsang lam a tangbuang thillat bang in leh dawn thillat bang in TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mei a thillat na lan ding ahi.
Sabbath ni in belamnoupa kum khat a upa, gensiatbei nih leh tangbuang thillat a ding in tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih sathau a helkhawm leh dawn thillat toh na lat ding ahi.
Hiai Sabbath niteng a halmang thillat lat gige leh dawn thillat sim louh a halmang thillat lat ding ahi.
Na kha thak teng un TOUPA a dia halmang thil na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.

Bawngtal chih ah tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum; belam khat a tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen mun nih.
Belamnou chih ah tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen mun khat. Hiai halmang thillat gimlim TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
Adawn thillat uh bawngtal khat ah uain hin kimkhat ahi dia, belampa khat ah hin mun thum a khen mun khat, belamnou khat ah hin mun li a khen mun khat. Hiai kumtawn a kha teng a halmang thillat ahi.
TOUPA kiang a khelh thoihna dia kelpa khat na lat ding uh ahi; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai dawn thillat sim louh in.
Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni TOUPA Paikan ahi.
Huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni ankuanglui ni ahi dia; ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh nek ding ahi.
Ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou a-om dia; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
Mei a thillat bel TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi.
Tangbuang nelte, sathau helkhawm, atangbuang thillat uh toh, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
Belamnou sagih bel belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi.
Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat.
Hiaite zingsang a halmang thillat dawn thillat sim louh a lat gige ding ahi.
Hichibang in TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat nek ding niteng in, ni sagih sung na lan ding uh ahi; halmang thillat lat gige leh dawn thillat sim louh in.
Ani sagih ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
Na Nipikal Ankuangluina, na buh thak tung ankuangluina TOUPA a dia thil thak tangbuang thillat na lat ni un leng khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA a dia gimlim halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi; ganhopn a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih.
Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum.
Belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih, belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding kelpa khat toh.
Haltum thillat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, huaite dawn thillat toh na lat ding uh ahi, na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi.
"Huan akha sagihna, ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei; nou a ding in pengkul mut ni ahi ding ahi.
TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat na lan ding uh ahi: Ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih,
belamnou sagih, khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding in khelh thoihna kelpa khat toh.
Kha thak halmang thillat leh huai tangbuang thillatte, halmang thillat lat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, dawn thillat, ahihdan ngeina uh TOUPA a dia gimlim ding a mei a thillatte sim louh in.
"Hiai akha sagihna, ani sawm ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding uh. Na hinna uh zangsak in nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat na lan ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahih ding ahi.
Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
Belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat toh; kilemna dia khelh thoihna, halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat uh sim louh in.
"Akha sagihna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei, TOUPA a ding in ni sagih sung ankuang na lui ding uh ahi.

TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mei a thillat, halmang thillat na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai sawm-le-thum, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawm-le-li, huaite gensiatbei chiat ahih ding uh ahi:
Atangbuang thillat uh sathau toh helkhawm bawngtal sawm-le-thum, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa nih, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
Belamnou sawm-le-li, belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
"Ani nih ni in bawngtaltuai sawm-le-nih, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li na lat ding uh ahi.
Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat a dan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat gige, huai atangbuang thillat, dawn thillat sim louh in.
"Ani thum ni in bawngtal sawm-le-khat, belampa nih, belamnou kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding.
Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai atangbuang thillat leh huai adawn thillat sim louh in.
"Ani li ni in bawngtal sawm, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
"Ani nga ni in bawngtal kua, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.

Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat uh, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding.
Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn ding thillat sim louh in.
"Ani guk ni in bawngtal giat, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding;
khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
"Ani sagih ni in bawngtal sagih, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
"Ani giat ni in khawmpi siangthoutak na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi. Bawngtal khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
"Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un,
khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn ding thillat sim louh in.

"Na thuchiamte uh, ut thu a thillatte, na halmang thillatte uh, na tangbuang thillatte uh, na dawn thillatte uh, na kilemna thillatte uh sim louh in hiaite ankuangluina hunbi nei a na neihte uh ni in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uhi, chi in,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng Mosi in Israel suante ahilh hi.
TOUPA'N Sinai Tang a Mosi ahouph la a Aaron leh Mosi suan hiaite ahi uh.
Aaron tapate min, a-upapen Nadab, huan Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi.
Hiaite siampu dia thaunilh, siampu nasem ding a sehtuam, Aaron tapate min ahi.
Nadab leh Abihu ahihleh Sinai gamdai a mei zat louh ding achih, TOUPA ma a alat lai un TOUPA ma ah asita ua, ta anei kei uhi. Eleazar leh Ithamar in apa uh Aaron dam lai in siampu nna asem uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levi chite, siampu Aaron kiang ah pi inla, nna aseptheihna ding un akiang ah omsak in.
Amau biakbuk a nasem in kihoupihna biakbuk chin ah amah leh omkhawm mipi tengteng a ding in nna asem ding uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin van tengteng akem ding ua, Israel suante a ding in biakbuk ah asem ding uh.
Levite Aaron leh atapate kiang ah na pe ding a; Israel suante lak a kipan amah kiang a piak ahi uhi.
Aaron leh atapate na sep ding a, asiampu hihna nna asem nilouh ding uh. Midang hong kigolh a-omleh hihlup ding ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Ngai in, Levite Israel suante lak a pan Israel suante tachil sul hong masapen sik-le-tang a keimah ngei in ka lak ahi uh. Huaiziak in Levite kei a ahi ding uhi.

Piang masa ta tengteng kei a ahi. Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng ka thah ni in Israelte lak a piang masa tengteng, amihing leh ganta tan in kei a tuam ding a ka kham ahi. Kei a ahi ding uh. Kei, TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
Sinai gamdai ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levi tate a-inkuankuan un, akhang-akhang un sim inla; pasal peuhmah kha khat a pan atunglam teng na sim ding ahi," achi hi.
Mosi in ahih ding a thupiak bang in TOUPA thu bang in asim chiatta hi.
Levi tapate min: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari ahi.
Amaute suangpa Gershon tapate min Libni leh Shimei ahi.
Amaute suangpa Kohath tapate min Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi.
Amaute suangpa Merari tapate min Mahli leh Mushi ahi. Hiaite a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Levi suante ahi uh.
Gershon, Libnite leh Simeite suangpa ahi a, hiaite Gershonte suante ahi uhi,
Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimte uh sangsagih-le-zanga ahi uhi.
Gershonte suante'n apuanin uh biakbuk tumlam pang ah akai ding uhi.
Gershonte inkuan a vaihawm makai Lael tapa Eliasaph ahi.
Gershon tapate'n kihoupihna biakbuk a asep ding uh ahihleh biakbuk leh puanin, atung, kihoupihna biakbuk leh akongkhak puanzak kep ahi ding a;
a-intual puanzakte, biakbuk chin a, a-intual kongkhak puanzak leh maitam kim a zat ding khau tengteng toh leng ahi lai ding hi.
Kohath bel Amramte, Izharte, Hebronte leh Uzzielte suangpa ahi a; hiai teng Kohath suante ahi uhi.
Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimdan bang zel un sanggiat-le-zaguk ahi ua, mun siangthou akem ding uhi.
Kohath tapate suante'n biakbuk simlam pang ah apuanin akai ding uhi.
Kohathte suante inkuan a vaihawm makai ding Uzziel tapa Eliazaphan ahi.
Akep dingte: bawm, dohkan, sathau, khawnvak koihna, maitam, mun siangthou a nasepna tui-um belsuan tengteng, puanzak leh huai a nasepna thil tengteng ahi.
Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar, Levi makaite vaihawm makai ahi ding a, mun siangthou kem mite amakaih ding hi.
Merari, Mahlite leh Mushite suangpa ahi. Hiai Merari suante ahi uh.
Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimdan bang zel un sangguk-le-zanih ahi uh.
Merari suante inkuan a vaihawm makai Abihail tapa Zuriel ahi a; biakbuk mallam pang ah apuanin akai ding uhi.
Merari tapate kep ding a sehte biakbuk khuam lepkhawm, baangkal, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuak, avanzat tengteng leh nasepna vanzat tengteng ahi uh.
Akongpi umna khuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, akilhbelhna leh akhaute toh leng ahi lai ding hi.

Biakbuk suahlam pang kihoupihna biakbuk chin a, nisuahna lam a puanin kai ding ahihleh Mosi leh Aaron leh atapa ahi ding ua, mun siangthou ah Israel suante a tuam ding in akul peuhpeuh asem ding uh. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah thah ding ahi.
TOUPA thupiak a Levite a-inkuankuan ua pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam Mosi leh Aaron in asim teng uh singnih-le-sangnih ahi uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Israel suante lak a piang masa, pasal kha khat a pan atunglam teng sim inla, azah uh thei in.
Israel suante lak a piang masa teng sik in kei a ding in Levite na hon laksak dia, Israel suante gan tengteng apiang masapen sik in Levite gante, na hon laksak ding ahi, kei TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Israel suante lak a piang masa teng asim hi.
Amin uh kizom bang zel in kha khat a pan atunglam piang masa pasal teng asim a, singnih sangnih zanih sawmsagih-le-thum ahi uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante lak a piang masa teng sik in Levite la inla, agan uh sik in Levite gan; Levite kei a ahi ding ua; kei TOUPA ka hi.
Levite sang a tamzawte lak ah tat ding in Israel suante piang masa zanih sawmsagih-le-thum la in.
Shekel nga chiat na la ding ahi; mun siangthou a shekel bang in na la ding, shekel bel gerah sawmnih ahi:
Atatna sum val Aaron leh atapate na piak ding ahi," achi hi.
Levite tatte ban ah atatna sum uh Mosi in ala hi.
Israel suante piang masate lak a pan sum ala a; sum siangthou shekel bang in sangkhat zathum sawmguk-le-nga ala hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak, TOUPA thu bang in Mosi in tatna sum Aaron leh atapate apia hi.
Huan Mosi in Israel suan Intekpente ahoupih a, "TOUPA'N thu apiak pentak hiai ahi.
Mi'n TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a ahihkeileh athuchiam a kihenleh athuchiam abohse ding ahi kei. Akam a pawt bangbang ahih ding ahi.
"Numei in leng anungak lai a, apa inn a a-om lai a, TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a, athuchiam a akihen a;
athuchiam leh athuchiam a akihenna apa'n azak a, apa'n adaihsan maimahleh athuchiam tengteng apaisuak ding ahi. Athuchiam a akihenna a-om gige ding ahi.
Himahleh apa'n azak ni a aphal keileh athuchiam a akihenna thuchiamte akoi mahmah apaisuak kei ding. Apa'n aphal louh ziak in TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding hi.
"Thuchiam min thu khual lou a, ahenna a-om lai a pasal aneih a;
apasal in azak a, azak ni a, adaih dideleh athuchiam a-om gige dia, thuchiam a ahenna leng a-om gige ding.
Himahleh apasal in azak ni a aphal keileh atung a thuchiam leh khual lou a akihenna amang dia, TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding.
"Himahleh meithai hiam, mak a omnu hiam thuchiam zaw, ahenna tengteng in adelh gige ding.
"Inn a thu achiam a, kichiam a akihenleh,
apasal in azak a leng adaih dide a, aphal louh keileh athuchiam a-om gige dia, kichiam a akihenna leng a-om gige ding hi.

Himahleh apasal in azak ni a bangmah lou a bawl a, ahihmangleh athuchiam hiam, kichiam a akihenna a kam a thupawt peuhmah a-om nawn kei ding. Apasal in ahihmang khinta ahi. TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding.
Thuchiam tengteng leh hinna hihgim dia hen akichiamna tengteng apasal in akipsak thei in ahihmang thei hi.
Himahleh apasal in azak ni a pan adeihdan leh athuchiam tengteng leh atung ahenna om tengteng kipsak ahi a; azak ni a pan adaihsan ziak in akipsak ahi.
Himahleh azak khit nung a bangmah lou a bawl a, ahihmanleh athulimlouhna moh apuak ding ahi," achi hi.
Hiaite pasal leh azi kal leh apa inn a a-om gige lai a, akikal ua dan ding a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiakte ahi uh.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Midiante tung ah Israel suante phu la in. Huai khit chiang in na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding," achi hi.
Mosi in mipite ahoupih a, "Midiante tung a TOUPA phulakna tangtun dia Midiante dou ding in na lak ua mi kigalthuam uhen.
Israel nam tengteng lak a nam chih a mi sangkhat zel kidouna a na kuan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Israelte sang tamtak lak a pan, nam chih a pan sangkhat chiat, kidouna a kuan ding in sepaih singkhat-le-sangnih apekhia uhi.
Huchi in Mosi in chi chih lak a mi sangkhat chiat leh siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas mun siangthou a tui-um belsuante, thupiakna dia pengkulte tawi in kidouna ah akuansak hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Midiante adou ua; pasal teng athat uhi.
Amithahte lak ah Midiante kumpipate leng atel uh. Huai Midiante kumpipa ngate Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba ahi a, Beor tapa Balaam leng namsau in athat uhi.
Israel suante'n Midiante numei teng leh atate uh sal in api ua; aganta tengteng uh, abelamhon tengteng uh leh avan tengteng uh gallak in ala uhi.
A-omna khuate leh agiahna tengteng uh ahal vek uhi.
Gallak tengteng, mihing leh gan tan in apaipih vek uhi.
Salte, matte leh gallakte, Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh Israel suan omkhawmte kiang, Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab Phaizang a agiahphual uh ahon tun uhi.
Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawmte intek penpente'n giahphual pua ah ana dawn uhi.
Sepaih heutu, sangkhatte tung a heutute leh zakhatte tung a heutute, kidouna a pan hong tungte tung ah Mosi aheh hi.
Mosi in akiang uah, "Numei tengteng na hinghawi vek uh maw?
Ngai un, Balaam lemtheih a Peor tungtang thu ah Israelte TOUPA tung a taleksak mite hiaite ahi uh. TOUPA mi omkhawmte lak ah hipi ahong leng hi.
Huaiziak in naupangte lak a pasal tengteng that unla, pasal kithuahpihsa numei teng leng that un.
Numei naupang pasal kithuahpih nai louh tengteng nou a ding in hinghawi un.
Giahphual pua ah ni sagih sung giak unla; kuapeuh mi that leh thah a om misi khoih peuhmah ani thum ni leh ani sagih ni in kisiangsak un; noumau leh na salte uh leng.
Van himhim leh savun a thilbawl tengteng, kel mul a thilbawl tengteng, sing a thilbawl tengteng thu ah na kisiangsak ding uh," achi hi.
Siampu Eleazar in kidouna a hoh kidou mite kiang ah, "Hiai TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak, dan thuseh ahi.
Bangpeuh dangka-eng, dangkasik, dal, sik, langva leh ngen,

mei a hal a se thei lou teng mei ah na tholh paisuak ding ua, huchi in ahong siangthou ding uh. Bangpeuh, silsianna tui a hihsiangthou ding ahi. Mei a hal thuak thei lou peuhmah tui a na tholh paisuak ding uh ahi.
Ani sagih ni in na puan uh na sawp ding ua, na hong siang ding uh. Huai khit in giahphual ah na hong lut ding uh ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Nang, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawmte inkuan lupente'n gallak a, alak uh mihing leh gante sim vek un.
Gallak mun nih ah khen un; kidouna a kuan kidou mite a ding leh omkhawmte a ding in.
Kidouna a kuan galdoumi a pan TOUPA a dia siah piak ding in mihing zanga zel ah khat, mihing a pan, bawng a pan, sabiltung a pan leh belamhon a pan sepkhia un.
Huaite a tan kimkhat ua pan la unla, TOUPA a dia vei thillat ding in siampu Eleazar pia un.
Israel suante tan sawmnga a pan khat, mihing a pan, bawng a pan, sabiltung a pan, belamhon a pan leh ganhon a pan sepkhia inla, huaite TOUPA biakbuk kemmi Levite pia in," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in ahih uhi.
Sepaihte'n amat uh gallak sim louh alak uh belam nuaiguk singsagih-le-sangnga,
Bawng singsagih-le-sangnga,
sabiltung singguk-le-sangkhat,
pasal kithuahpih nai louh numei singthum-le-sangnih ahi uh.
Akimkhat, kidouna a kuante tantuan, belam nuaithum singthum sangsagih-le-zanga ahi,
TOUPA siah belam zaguk sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
Bawng singthum-le-sangguk ahi a; huai a TOURA siah sawmguk-le-khat ahi.
Sabiltung singthum-le-zanga ahi; huai a TOUPA siah sawmguk-le-khat ahi.
Mihing singkhat-le-sangguk ahi ua; huai a TOUPA siah mi sawmthum-le-nih ahi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in siah, TOUPA vei thillat Mosi in siampu Eleazar apia hi.
Mosi in galdou mite a pan ahawm Israel mite tantuan kimkhat galdou a kuante lak ah ahawm hi.
Omkhawmte' tantuan kimkhat belam nuaithum singthum sangsagih-le-zanga,
Bawng singthum-le-sangguk,
Sabiltung singthum-le-zanga,
Mihing singkhat-le-sangguk ahi.
Israel tantuan kimkhat a pan Mosi in mihing leh gan sawmnga zel ah khat ala a, TOUPA thupiak bang in TOUPA biakbuk kemmi Levite apia hi.
Sepaihte tung a heutu, sang-khatte tung a heutute, zakhatte tung a heutute'n Mosi ava naih uhi.
Mosi kiang ah, "Na sikhate'n ka khut ua om kidou mite ka sim ua, kuamah kim lou ka om kei uhi.

Ka hinna ua dia TOUPA ma a kilemna bawlna dia TOUPA a dia thillat mi'n aneih lam uh, dangka-eng a bawl zephoih van, khengawng a bulhte, khutngawng a bulhte, minsawnna zungbuhte, bilbahte, khite ka hon tawi uh," achi uhi.
Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in dangka-eng a bawl van tengteng ana sang uhi.
Sangte tung a heutute leh zate tung a heutute'n dangka-eng TOUPA kiang a vei thillat dia alat tengteng uh shekel singkhat sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnga ahi.
Galdou mite'n agallak uh amau a chiat ding in ala ngal ua.
Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in sangkhatte tung a heutu leh zakhatte tung a heutute dangka-eng ala ua, Israel suante theihgigena ding in kihoupihna biakbuk ah TOUPA ma ah ahon tawi uhi.
Reuben leh Gad tate'n ganta ahau mahmah ua; Jazer gam leh Gilead gam amuh un, amun ganta a dia hoihtak hi in athei uhi.
Huchi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawm mipite ava houpih ua,
"Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Shebam, Nebo leh Beon,
Israel omkhawmte ma a TOUPA'N azoh gam, gante a ding in ahoih a, na sikhate'n ganhonte ka nei uhi.
Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan uleh, na sikhate kiang ah ka luah ding un hiai gam hon pia inla, Jordan lui hon pi galkai dah mai ve," achi uhi.
Mosi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate kiang ah, "Na unaute uh kidouna ah akuan ding ua, nou bel hiai ah na om maimah ding uh maw?
Bangziak a TOUPA'N apiak gam a lut lou dia Israel suante lungtang lunglelsak na hi ua?
Kadesh-barnea a pan gam va enkhe dia ka sawl in na pate un hichi mah bang in ahih uhi.
Eshkol Phaizang atuntouh un gam ava mu ua, TOUPA'N gam apiak a alut noplouhna ding un Israel suante lungtang alunglelsak uhi.
Huai ni in TOUPA aheh mahmah a, akichiam a,
Aigupta gam a pan hong pawt, kum sawmnih chiang tunglam mi himhim in Abraham, Isak leh Jakob, kiang a kichiam a, ka piak gam kuamah in amu kei ding uh; ahon zuih taktak louh ziak un.
'Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua kia lou ngal, amau bel TOUPA azuih taktak ziak un,' achi hi.
Israelte tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hihmi suan tengteng amanthat vek masiah uh gamdai ah kum sawmli avakvaisak hi.
Ngai un, Israelte tung a TOUPA hehna lauhuaitak behlap in nou gilou in na pute uh sik in na dinghta uhi,
TOUPA zui lou a, na om himhim uleh ama'n amaute gamdai ah a-omsak nawn ding hi. Hiai mi tengteng na hihmang mai kei ding uh maw?" achi hi.
Ava naih ua, akiang ah, "Hiai ah ka gante uh a ding in belam huangte leh ka tate uh a ding in khua ka sat ding uh.
Kou bel amun ding uh ka tut masiah uh Israel suante ma a pai ding in ka kigalthuam ding uhi. Hiai gam a mite ziak in ka tate uh kulh nei khuate ah ateng ding uh.
Israel suante michih in amun luah ding aluah chiat ma un ka inn uah ka paikik kei ding uh.
Ka luah ding uh bel hiai lam gal Jordan suahlam ahih ziak in Jordan gal khat lam leh akhen lam zaw ka luahpih kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Mosi in akiang uah, "Huchibang na chih ua, galdou dia TOUPA ma a kuan dia na kigalvat ua,
TOUPA ma a gam zoh ahih masiah na lak ua kigalthuam tengteng TOUPA ma a Jordan na galkah vek ua, ama a melmate adelhkhiak mateng leh
TOUPA ma a gam lak a om a, huai khit chiang a na kik nawn ding uleh TOUPA leh Israelte ma ah na mohpuakna ua pan na siangta ding ua, TOUPA ma ah hiai gam na luah ding uhi.
Himahleh huchibang a na hih kei uleh, ngai un, TOUPA tung ah na khial uh ahi dia, na khelhna un hon mukhe ngeingei ding chih thei un.
Na tate uh a ding in khuate sat unla, na belamte uh a ding in leng huangte bawl unla, na gen bangbang un hih un,” achi hi.
Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n Mosi kiang ah, "Na sikhate'n ka toupa uh thupiak bang in ka hih ding uh.
Ka zi, ka tate uh, ka belamhonte uh leh ka ganhon tengteng uh Gilead gam khuate ah ana om ding uh.
Himahleh na sikha, kidou dia kigalthuam tengteng in ka toupa uh gen bang in TOUPA ma ah ka va galkah ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
Huchi in Mosi in, atungtang thu uah siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel nam inkuan lupente thu apia hi.
Mosi in akiang uah, "Gad tate, Reuben tate leh galdou dia kigalthuam tengteng in TOUPA ma a Jordan lui ahong galkahpih ua, huai gam na zoh uleh Gilead gam pen aluah ding ua na piak ding uh ahi.
Himahleh kigalthuam a ahong galkahpih kei uleh Kanaan gam ah na lak uah atel mai ding uh," achi hi.
Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n, "Asikha kiang a TOUPA'N agen bang in ka hih ding uh.
Kigalvan a TOUPA ma a galkah in Kanaan gam ah ka lut ding ua, ka gam luah ding uh Jordan lui khen lam ah ahi lai ding," chỉ in adawng uhi.
Mosi in Gad tate, Reuben tate leh Joseph tapa Manasseh suan nam kimkhatte Amor kumpipa Sihon gam, Bashan Kumpipa Og gam, huai gamte a khua tengteng toh, akim gam a khuate nangawn toh apia hi.
Gad tate'n Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer;
Atroth leh Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah;
Beth-nimrah leh Beth- haran alam ua, khopi kulh neite, belam huangte toh.
Reuben tate'n Heshbon, Elealeh, Kirjathaim,
Nebo leh Baal-meon, aminte khek khit ahi, huan Sibmah alam ua; akhosatte uh min dang aphuak zel uhi.
Manasseh tapa Makir tapate Gilead gam ah ahoh ua, ala ua, huai a teng Amorte ahawlkhia uhi.
Mosi in Gilead gam Manasseh tapa Makir apia a; huai ah ateng hi.
Manasseh tapa Jair in akhotate ava la a, Havothjair asa hi.
Nobah in Kenath ava la a, akhotate toh, ama min tam in Nobah asa hi.
Mosi leh Aaron makaih a Aigupta gam a pan apawlpawl a pawt a, apai zeldan uh hiải bang ahi.
TOUPA thupiak in apaikhia ua, apai zelnate uh Mosi in agelh a; apaikhiak ua apainate uh hiaite ahi.
Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Rameses a pan apawt ua; Paikan Ankuanglui ni zing in Aigupta mi teng muh in hangsantak in Israel suante apawtkhia uhi.
Aigupta mite'n ata masapen teng uh TOUPA'N athahsakte avui ua, apathiante uh leng TOUPA'N athukhen khumta hi.
Huchi in Israel suante Rameses a pan apawt ua, Sukot ah giahphual asat uhi.
Sukot a pan apawt ua, gamdai phak tung Etham ah giahphual asat uhi.
Etham a pan apawt ua, Baal-zephon bul a Pi-hahiroth lam ah akinung khin ua, Migdol chin ah giahphual asat uhi.
Pi-hahiroth chin a pan apawt ua, tuipi apaltan ua, gamdai ah alut uhi. Etham gamdai ah ni thum lam apai ua, Marah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Marah a pan apawt ua, Elim atung uh. Elim ah tui nak nei sawm-le-nih leh tum sing sawmsagih a-om a; huai ah giahphual asat uhi.
Elim a pan apawt ua, Tupi San ah giahphual asat uhi.
Tuipi San a pan apawt ua, Sin gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
Sin gamdai a pan apawt ua, Dophkah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Dophkah a pan apawt ua, Alush ah giahphual asat uhi.
Alush a pan apawt ua, Rephidim ah giahphual asat ua, huai ah mipite dawn ding tui a-om kei hi.
Rephidim a pan apawt ua, Sinai gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
Sinai gamdai a pan apawt ua, Kibroth- hattaavah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Kibroth-hattaavah a pan apawt ua, Hazeroth ah giahphual asat uhi.
Hazeroth a pan apawt ua, Rithmah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Rithmah a pan apawt ua, Rimmon-parez ah giahphual asat uhi.
Rimmon-parez a pan apawt ua, Libnah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Libnah a pan apawt ua, Rissah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Rissah a pan apawt ua, Kehelathah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Kehelathah a pan apawt ua, Shepher tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
Shepher tang a pan apawt ua, Haradah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Haradah a pan apawt ua, Makheloth ah giahphual asat uhi.
Makheloth a pan apawt ua, Tahath ah giahphual asat uhi.
Tahath a pan apawt ua, Terah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Terah a pan apawt ua, Mithkah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Mithkah a pan apawt ua, Hashmonah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Hashmonah a pan apawt ua, Moseroth ah giahphual asat uhi.
Moseroth a pan in apawt ua, Bene-jaakan ah giahphual asat uhi.
Bene-jaakan a pan apawt ua, Hor-hagidgad ah giahphual asat uhi.
Hor-hagidgad a pan apawt ua, Jotbathah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Jotbathah a pan apawt ua, Abronah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Abronah a pan apawt ua, Ezion-geber ah giahphual asat uhi.
Ezion-geber a pan apawt ua, Zin gamdai ah giahphual asat uh huai tuh Kadesh leng achi uhi.
Kadesh a pan apawt ua, Edom gam chin a Hor tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
TOUPA thupiak in Hor tang ah Siampu Aaron ahohtou a, Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt uh akum sawmlina, akha ngana, ani khat ni in huai ah asita hi.
Aaron Hor tang a asih in kum zakhat sawmnih-le-thum ahi.
Kanaan mi, Kanaan gam simlam a om Arad kumpipa'n Israel suante ahong pai uh ana za hi.
Hor tang a pan apawt ua, Zalmonah ah giahphual asat uhi.
Zalmonah a pan apawt ua, Punon ah giahphual asat uhi.
Punon a pan apawt ua, Oboth ah giahphual asat uhi.
Oboth a pan apawt ua, Moab gam naih Ije-abarim ah giahphual asat uhi.
Ije-abarim a pan apawt ua, Dibon-gad ah giahphual asat uhi.
Dibon-gad a pan apawt ua, Almon-diblathaim ah giahphual asat uhi.
Almon-diblathaim a pan apawt ua, Nebo chin a Abarim tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
Abarim tang a pan apawt ua, Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
Jordan gei Beth-jeshimoth a pan Abel-shittim pha in Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab Phaizang ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah Jordan lui na kan ua, Kanaan gam na lut chiang un,
huai gam a om tengteng na delhkhe vek ding ua, asuang milim tengteng uh na hihse vek ding ua, amilim sunte uh na hihse vek ding ua, amun sangte uh na hihchim vek ding uh ahi.
Gam na luah ding ua, huai ah na teng ding uh. Na luah ding ua gam ka hon piaksa na hi uh.

Achi dungzui bang zel in aisan in gam na luah ding ua, a-inbul deuhte gam za deuh na pe ding ua, a-inbul lou deuhte gam neu deuh na pe ding uh. Aisan apukna peuh michih a tuam ahi dia; na pi-le-pute uh chi paidan bang zel in na luah ding uhi.
Himahleh huai gam a omte na delhkhiak kei uleh na omsakte uh na mit ua ding in sutna zum leh na sa ua ding in ling bang ahi ding ua, na omna gam uah buaina ahon tun ding uhi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, atung ua hih ka tup bang na tung uah ka hih ding, chi in," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante thu pia inla, akiang uah, Kanaan gam na tun chiang un, Kanaan gam, agamgi dan dungzui zel a na luah ding gam uh,
simlam na luah ding chiang uh Zin gamdai a pan Edom gam zulzul ahi dia, simlam gamgi Chi Tuipi tawp a pan suahlam pang ahi ding.
Na gamgi uh Akrabbim tungkahna simlam pang ah akawi dia, ahong pawtna Kadesh-barnea simlam ah ahi dia, Hazaraddar ah apai dia, Azmon ah apai zel ding.
Gamgi Azmon a pan Aigupta lui tan in akawi dia, atawpna Tuipi ah ahi ding.
"Tumlam pang ah Tuipi Lian agamgi ding in na tang ding ua, hiai tumlam a na gamgi uh ahi ding.
"Hiai mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding. Tuipi Lian a pan Hor tang huap in na bawl ding uh.
Hor tang a pan Hamath lutna tan in na bawl dia, gamgi tunna bel Zedad ah ahi ding hi.
Gamgi Jiphron ah apai zel dia, atunna Hazar-enan ah ahi ding. Hiai mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding hi.
"Suahlam a na gamgi uh Hazar-enan a pan Shepham tan in na bawl ding uhi.
Gamgi Shepham a pan Riblah tan in Ain suahlam pang ah asukpai dia; huchi in gamgi apai suksuk dia, Kinereth tuipi suahlam pang asun ding hi.
Gamgi Jordan ah apaisuk dia, atunna Chi Tuipi ah ahi dia hiai akimvel a gamgi paidan bang in na gam uh ahi ding, chi in," achi hi.
Mosi in Israel suante thu apia a, "Hiai TOUPA'N nam kua-le-akimte piak dia thu apiak aisan a na luah ding gam uh ahi.
Reuben tate nam in a-inkuan uh dungzui zel leh Gad tate nam in a-inkuan uh dungzui zel leh Manasseh nam kimkhat in leng agam luah ding uh atangta ngal ua.
Nam nih leh nam kimkhatte'n agam luah ding uh nisuahna lam Jeriko zawn Jordan gal suahlam ah atangta uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Luah dia gam hon khennenpihte min hiaite ahi. Siampu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua.
Gam luah dia khennen ding in nam chih a pan a-intekpen khat chiat na tel ding ahi," achi hi.
Huai mite min bel hiaite ahi. Judah nam a mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb.
Simeon tate nam a mi Ammihud tapa Semuel.
Benjamin nam a mi Kislon tapa Elidad.
Dan tate nam lak a intekpen Jogli tapa Bukki.
Joseph tate lak a mi, Manasseh tate nam intekpen Ephod tapa Hanniel.
Ephraim tate nam lak a intekpen Sitan tapa Kemuel.
Zebulun tate nam lak a intekpen Parnak tapa Elizaphan.
Issakar tate nam lak a intekpen Azan tapa Paltiel.
Asher tate nam lak a intekpen Selo mi tapa Ahihud.
Naphtali tate nam lak a intekpen Ammihud tapa Padahel.
Hiaite Kanaan gam a Israel suante gam luah ding hawm dia TOUPA'N thu apiakte ahi uhi.
Huan Jeriko zawn Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante thu pia inla, agam uah Levite tenna ding khuate bawlsak uhen. Agante uh tatna ding in kho dainawl kim Levite na piak ding uh ahi.
Khuate atenna ding uh ahi dia, akimte bel bawng leh agante leh aganvulh tengteng a ding ahi.
Levite na piak ding dainawl khokulh a pan tong sangkhat a sau ahih ding ahi.
Kulh polam a pan na teh dia, suahlam pang ah tong sangnih, mallam pang ah tong sangnih, khopi bel alaitak ah a-om ding ahi. Hiai amau dainawl tuam ahi ding.
Levite na piak ding khuate lak ah tualthatte taina ding kihumbitna khopi guk ahi dia; huaite lou khua sawmli-le-nih na piak lai ding uh ahi.
Levite na piak ding khua tengteng khua sawmli-le-giat ahi ding. Dainawl toh na piak ding uh ahi.
Israel suante luah khua na piakdan ding, mi tamte na pe tam dia, atawmte na pe tawm ding ahi. Michih in aluah uh gam tamdan dungzui a khua Levite na piak ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah,
Jordan lui na galkah ua Kanaan gam na lut chiang un kihumbitna khua na sep ding uh ahi, tup mawng hilou a tual thatkhami taina ding in.
Huai khuate, phulami a pan na kihumbitna khua uh, omkhawmte ma a vai hawmsak dia adin ma a tualthatmi asihlouhna ding ahi.
Nou a dia kihumbitna ding na sehte uh khopi guk ahi ding.
Jordan gal ah khopi thum na sep dingua, Kanaan gam ah khopi thum na sep ding ua, kihumbitna khopite ahi ding uh.
Israel suante leh namdang leh akiang ua tengte a ding in hiai khopi gukte kihumbitna ahi dia, huai ah kuapeuh mi that kha atailut ding ahi.
"Himahleh mi kuahiam in sik a mi asat a, asihleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
Si khop a suang a mi aden a, asihleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
Ahihkeileh mi khat in mi khat sing zang in sat henla, si taleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
