Sisan phulami'n tualthatmi athat dia, amuh peuh chiang in athat ding ahi.
"Mi khatpeuh in huatna toh tupkholhna nei in midang khat sawn henla, ahihkeileh tup mawng in banghiam in deng henla, huai mi si taleh;
ahihkeileh kimelmakna nei in akhuttum in tum henla, huai mi si taleh ahihlumpa hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Amah tualthat ahi a, sisan phulami in athah ding ahi.
"Himahleh kimelmakna nei hilou a, kuahiam khat in midang asawn khak ahihkeileh tup mawng hilou a amah aden khak a,
ahihkeileh amah mu lou a, amah that thei suang atung a akhiak a, amah asihleh amelma leng hilou a, hihnat tum leng hilou ahih ziak in.
Omkhawmte'n hiai vaihawmna dan bang in ahihlum mi leh sisan phulami vai ahawmsak ding uh ahi:

Omkhawmte'n tualthatmi sisan phulami a pan ahumbit ding ua, omkhawmte'n ataina, akihumbitna khua ah atengsak ding ua, sathau siangthou nilh a om siampu lianpen asih mateng huai lai khua ah ateng ding hi.
Himahleh chik lai peuh in tualthatmi ataina, a kihumbitna kho gamgi polam apai a;
sisan phulami in akihumbitna kho polam a amuh a, sisan phulami in athahleh asisan ah moh apo kei ding.
Siampu lian asih mateng akihumbitna khua ah ateng gige ding a, himahleh siampu asih in bel tualthatmi atenna gam ah apaikik ding ahi.
Hiai thilte na suante uh tan a na tenna peuh ua na vaihawmna dan thuseh ding uh ahi.
"Kuapeuh in mi athahleh tualthatmi pen theihpihte kam a pan thupawt a hihlup ding ahi. Himahleh theihpih khat kia mi hihlupna ding in ahun kei.
Tualthatmi na tan ding uh ahi kei. Sihna khop a moh ahi a, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi zaw.
Siampu sih ma in, kihumbitna khua a tailut kuapeuh agam a sawlkik nawn dia tatna sum na lak ding uh ahi kei.
Huchi in na tenna gam uh na hihthanghuai kei ding ua, sisan in gam ahihthanghuaileh sisan suahna gam hihthanghuai silna ding in asuahmi sisan kia lou lah zattheih ahi ngal kei a.
Na tenna gam uh, ka omna na hihthanghuai ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA lah Israel suante lak ah ka om ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
Huan Joseph inkuanpihte lak a mi, Manasseh tapa Makir tapa Gilead tate inkuan lupente lak a mite'n ahon naih ua, Mosi leh heutu, Israel suante intekpente ma ah thu agen uhi.
"TOUPA'N ka toupa Israel suante aisan a, aluah ding uh gam pe ding in thu apia hi. TOUPA'N ka toupa, ka unaupa uh Jelophehad gam a tanute pe ding in nang thu ahon pia hi.

Amau Israel suante lak a mi, namdang kuapeuh tate ava kitenpih uleh, ka pi-le-pute uh gam aluah uh laksak a, akitenpih uh namte gam toh gawm ding ahi dia; huchibang in ka gam tantuan ua kipan lakkhiak ahi ding hi.
Israel suante Jubili ahong tun chiang in agam uh ava kitenpih uh namte gam toh gawm ding ahi dia; huchi in ka pi-le-pute uh gam a pan amau gam lak hek ahong hi ding hi," achi uh.
Mosi in, TOUPA thu bang in Israel suante thu apia a, "Joseph tate nam in agen dik uhi.
Jelophehad tanute tungtang thu a TOUPA'N thu apiak pen hiai ahi. 'Hoih asaksak uh kitenpih uhenla, himahleh apate uh nampih lak a mi ngei akitenpih ding uh ahi.
Huchi in Israel suante gam pen namdang kiang a suan ahi kei ding. Israel suante'n api-le-pute uh nam gam aneih gige ding uh ahi.
Israel suante lak a gouluah ding tanu peuhmah Israel suante'n api-le-pute uh gam aluah chiat zel theihna ding un apa nampih lak a mi zi ahih ngeingei ding ahi.
Huchi in gam bel namdang kiang a suan ahi kei ding hi. Israel suante'n amau gam chiat atang gige ding uh ahi ngal a, " achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Jelophehad tanute'n ahih uhi.
Jelophehad tanu Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Noahte'n apa uh unau tapate akitenpih uhi.
Joseph tapa Manasseh tapate akitenpih ua, agam uh apa uh nam ah a-om gige hi.
Hiaite TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab Phaizang a Israel suante apiak, thupiakte leh vaihawmdante ahi uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levi tapate lak a Kohath tapate, akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un, sim vek in.
kum sawmthum a pan atunglam, kum sawmnga tan in nasepna, kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding teng.
Kihoupihna puanin mun siangthoupen a Kohath tapate nasep ding hiaite ahi.
"Giahphual a suan ding teng un Aaron, atapate toh alut ding ua, dantan puanzak ahawkkhe ding ua, huai in thukhun bawm akhuh ding uh.
Huai pen ngalvang vun in akhuh ding ua, puandum buang in leng akhuh ding ua, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
"Etsakna tanghou dohkan tung ah puandum buang aphah ding ua, huai ah kuangte, keute, belhbute leh noute butkhiakna ding akoih ding uhi. Tatlak lou in tanghou koih huai ah a-om ding ahi.
Huai pen puansan in akhuh ding ua; akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding uh, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
"Vaksak khawnvak koihna leh huai a dia azat ding ua khawnvakte, ataitehte, avu koihnate, thau bing tengteng puandum buang in akhuh ding uhi.
Huai leh avanzat tengteng akhuhna ngalvang vun a khuh in azawnna ah akoih ding uhi.
"Dangka-eng maitam puandum buang in akhuh ding ua, akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh nawn ding uh, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
Mun siangthou a vanzat leh tui- um belsuan tengteng ala vek ding ua, puandum buang in atun ding ua, akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding uh, azawnna ah akoih ding uhi.
Maitam a meivu alamang ding ua, atung ah puan sandup aphah ding uhi.

Atung ah anasep vialvialna uh tui-um belsuan tengteng, mei laknate, sa thukna sikkhutte vutluahnate, tuikuangte leh maitam tui-um belsuan tengteng akoih ding uhi. Akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding ua, azawnna abulh ding uh.

Aaron leh atapate'n mun siangthou leh mun siangthou van tengteng om mun suan dia akhuh khit chiang un; huai khit chiang in azawng ding in Kohath tapate ahong pai ding uhi. Himahleh thil siangthou himhim akhoih ding uh ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw asi kha ding uh. Hiaite kihoupihna biakbuk a Kohath tapate nasep ding ahi.
"Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar sep ding, det ding thau, gimnamtui, niteng a tangbuang thillat, nilhchi thau, biakbuk, huai a thil om tengteng, mun siangthou leh avante ngaihtuah ahi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
"Kohath suan inkuan zaw Levite lak a pan satkhe kei un.
Himahleh thil siangthoute khoih lou a, si lou a a-omtheihna ding uh hichibang ahi. Aaron leh atapate lut uhenla, asep ding uh leh atantuam ding chiat uh sehsak uhen.
Himahleh akikhuh lai teng thil siangthoute en ding in lut kei uhen, alut uleh asi ding uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Gershon tapate leng a-inkuankuan un, akhang-akhang un sim vek in.
Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan in nasepna kihoupihna biakbuk a sem thei ding teng zah sim vek in.
Gershon suante tantuam nasep lam leh puak lam hiai ahi.
Biakbuk puanzakte, kihoupihna biakbuk, akhuhnate, atung khuhna ngalvang vun, kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak puanzak;
intual puanzakte, intual kongkhak puanzakte, abiakbuk leh maitam bul a, akhaute leh avanzat tengteng uh toh apo ding ua, sep dia kiphamoh Reuhmah asem ding uhi.
Gershon suante nasep, asep lam leh puak lam ah atantuan tengteng uh Aaron leh atapate'n asep ding ua; ahih ding uh banghiam nengneng tan a sehsak in huaite asem ding uhi.
Huaite kihoupihna biakbuk a Gershon suante nasep ahi. Ahih ding uh siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar seh ding ahi.
"Merari tapate, akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un na sim ding ahi.
Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan in kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding zah na sim vek ding ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin a anasep uh, atantuam ding uh hiaite ahi. Biakbuk khuam lepkhawmte, abaangkalte, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte;
a-intual umna khuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, akilhbelhnate, akhaute, avanzat tengteng leh avanzat dang tengteng puakte, amin uh lou chiat in atantuam ding uh na sehsak ding ahi.
Huaite siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar heu a kihoupihna biakbuk a Merari tapate suante'n ahih ding uh banghiam nengneng tan a anasepdan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi leh Aaron leh omkhawmte lak a lupente'n Kohathte tapate akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un asimta uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin a nasepna a ding in michih nasem dia kisate, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
Huaite akhang-akhang a asim uh sangnih zasagih-le-sawmnga ahi uhi.
Hiaite ahi uh, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem Kohathte suan Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte.
Hiaite a-inkuankuan a, akhang-akhang ua kisim, Gershon tapate ahi uh.
Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan kihoupihna biakbuk nasepna a dia michih nasem dia kisate.
Akhang akhang a, a-inkuankuan ua asimte uh sangnih zaguk-le-sawmthum ahi uh.
Huaite ahi uh, Gershon tapate suante, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem teng, TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte uh.
Huaite a-inkuankuan ua, akhang- akhang ua, Merari tapate asimte uh ahi,
kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding a nasem zah ding, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
Huai akhang-akhang a, a-inkuankuan ua asimte uh sangthum leh zanih ahi uh.
Hiaite Merari tapate suante asim uh, Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte ahi uhi.
Mosi leh Aaron leh Israelte lupente'n akhang-akhang a, a-inkuankuan a, asimte uh avek un huai teng ahi uh.
Nasem ding leh kihoupihna biakbuk a puakchi pomi ding zah, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
Asimte uh sanggiat zanga-le-sawmgiat ahi uh.
Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a michih asep ding leh atantuam ding dungzui zel a sim ahi. Hichibang in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a sim ahi uhi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante agiahna mun ua kipan phak tengteng leh sipawt tengteng leh misi ziak a buah peuhmahte pawtkhesak vek ding in thu pia in.
Numei leh pasal pawtkhesak in giahphual pua ah na koih ding ahi. Alaitak a ka omna giahna mun abuahsaklouhna ding un," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih uhi, dainawl ah akoihkhia ua; TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a agen bang in Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, pasal hiam, numei hiam in TOUPA tung ah thil bangpeuh na hihkhial in moh taleh;
ahihkhelhna ah thupha atawi ding ahi. Ahihkhelh man pen kimtak in adin dia, amun nga a khen mun khat ahihkhelhnapa apiak behlap ding ahi.
Himahleh huai mi in khelh man piakna ding tanau nai aneih keileh, khelh man pen TOUPA a tuam ahi dia, akhelh man leh akhialpa a dia kilemna bawlsakna belampa pen siampu kiang a piak ding ahi.
Israel suante thil siangthou vei thillat tengteng, siampu kiang a lat peuhmah siampu a tuam ding ahi.
Michih thil siangthou siampu a tuam ahi dia, mite'n siampu apiak peuhmah ama a tuam ahi ding, chi in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, akiang uah, Mi, azi in alampialsan a, mi'n amah kithuahpih henla, apasal in thei kei henla,
huchibang a a-om nilouh a, kihihthanghuai pipi a kigenkhe nai lou hi in, athei kuamah om lou, mat louh hitaleh;
apasal thikthu hong sia a, azi muangmoh a, siangthou lou mah ana hihleh, ahihkeileh apasal thikthu hong sia a, azi muangmoh a, azi siangthou ana hihleh:

huai mi in azi a dia thillat barli buh tangbuang ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat tawi in siampu kiang ah azi api ding hi. Athillat ding sathau abuak ding ahi kei a, begaw leng anuh ding ahi sam kei. Thikthusiatna tangbuang thillat, theihgigena thillat, thulimlouhna theihgigena ahi.
"Siampu in azi api dia, TOUPA ma ah adingsak dia:
Siampu in leibel in tui siangthou ala dia, biakbuk pialkhang a leivui ala dia, tui ah akhe ding hi.
Siampu in huai numei TOUPA ma ah adingsak dia, asam akhahkhiaksak dia, theihgigena tangbuang thillat atawisak dia; siampu in hamsia tungsak tui kha akhut in atawi ding,
Siampu in huai numei akichiamsak dia, numei kiang ah, 'Na pasal hilou midang kuamah in hon kithuahpih louh a, nitna lam a na lampial keileh hamsia tungsak hiai tui kha a pan na hul ding.
Himahleh lampialsan a na kihihnit a, na pasal lou mi kuahiam in ahon kithuahpihleh na hul kei ding,' achi ding.
Siampu in numei avau dia, akichiamsak ding. Numei kiang ah siampu in, 'TOUPA'N na pheipi azawtsak a, na gil apuaksakleh, TOUPA'N na chipihte lak ah hamsethuak in nang hon bawl hen.
Hamsia tungsak hiai tui na gil ah alut dia, na gil apuaksak dia, na pheipi azawsak ding. Numei in, Amen, Amen,' achi ding.
"Siampu in huai hamsia thute laibu ah agelh dia, tui kha ah adiah ding hi.
Hamsia tungsak tui kha numei adawnsak ding ahi. Huchi in hamsia tungsak tui kha agilsung ah alut dia, ahong kha ding hi.
Siampu in thikthusiatna thillat tangbuang numei khut a pan ala dia; TOUPA ma ah tangbuang thillat avei dia, maitam ah apaipih ding hi.
Siampu in tangbuang thillat theihgigena pham khat ala dia, maitam ah ahal dia, huai khit in tui numei adawnsak ding ahi.

Tui adawnsakleh hichi ahi dia; ahong nit a, apasal tung a thil hihkhial ana hihleh hamsia tungsak huai tui agilsung ah alut dia, ahong kha dia, agil ahong puak dia, apheipi ahong zaw dia; huchi in numei achipihte lak a hamsia thuaknu ahong hi ding hi.
Himahleh numei anit louh a, asianthouleh ahul dia, nau apai thei ding.
"Hiai zi lampial a, apasal hilou midang toh kihihnin hiam,
ahihkeileh apasal thikthu hong siat a azi ahazat chiang a vaihawmdan ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA ma ah api dia, siampu in hiai dan tengteng bang in atung ah ahih ding.
Huchi in pasal pen thulimlouhna ah ahul dia, numei in akhelhna moh apo ding hi, chi in," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, akiang uah, pasal hiam, numei hiam in leng banghiam thuchiam tuam, TOUPA a dia akipiakna Nazarit thuchiam achiam lai in uain leh zu angawl ding ahi.
Uain thuk, zu thuk leh grep tui adawn ding ahi kei a, grep mindup hiam, minvuai hiam leng ane ding ahi sam kei hi.
Akihihtuam sung teng grepgui a pan atang leng, ahawng leng ane ding ahi kei.
"Kihihtuamna thu achiam sung teng alu leng amet louh hial ding ahi. TOUPA a dia akihihtuam sung ni akim mateng hihtuam ahi dia, asam ahawi ding ahi.
TOUPA a dia akihihtuam sung teng misi luang anaih ding ahi kei.
Apa, anu, a-unaupa, a-unaunu hiam sih thu ah leng akihihnin ding ahi kei hi; Pathian a dia akihihtuamna in amah agak ziak in.
Akihihtuam sung teng TOUPA a tuam ahi.
"Akiang ah mi hong siguih in, akihihtuamna lutang hon hihnin kha taleh, akisiansak ni, ani sagih ni in alu amet ding ahi.
Ani giat ni in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a siampu kiang ah vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam ahon tawi ding ahi.
Siampu in khat khelh thoihna ding in alan dia, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in, misi ziak a ahihkhelhna ah kilemna abawlsak ding. Huai ni mah in alu ahihsiangthou ding ahi.
Akihihtuamna nite TOUPA kiang a pia in khelh thoihna ding in belamnoupa kum khat a upa ahon tawi ding hi. Himahleh akihihtuamna hihnit ahih tak ziak in amangta ding uhi.
"Hiai Nazarit mi dan ahi: Akihihtuamna ni abukim chiang in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a pi ahi ding.

TOUPA a dia thillat ding in belampa kum khat a upa gensiatbei halmang thillat ding in khat, khelh thoihna ding in belamnounu kum khat a upa gensiatbei khat, lemna thillat ding in belampa gensiatbei khat,

silngou soh louh tanghou loh khat, tangbuang nel mahmah thau a mek tanghou leh tangbuang nel mahmah thau a mek tanghou beu, thau a zut tanghou pek silngou soh louh leh nek thillat ding uleh dawn ding thillatte toh alan ding ahi.
"Siampu in huaite TOUPA ma ah alan dia, akhelh kithoihna leh ahalmang thillat alan ding ahi.
Belampa pen palbawm a tanghou silngou soh louh toh lemna kithoih thillat TOUPA kiang ah alan dia; siampu in tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat mah leng alan tel ding ahi.
Nazarit mi in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah akihihtuamna lu amet dia, akihihtuamna sam ala dia, lemna kithoihna thillat nuai a mei ah ahalmang ding hi.
Siampu in belampa liang huanmin leh bawm a silngou soh louh tanghou khat leh silngou soh louh tanghou pek khat ala dia, Nazarit mi in akihihtuamna lu amet khit in atawisak ding hi.
Siampu in vei thillat ding in TOUPA ma ah avei ding ahi. Hiai siampu a tuam ahi ding, awm vei leh liang vei toh. Huai khit in Nazarit mi in uain adawn theita ding hi.
"Hiai ahi Nazarit mi thuchiam dan leh TOUPA ma a thillatdan. Ama ut thu a lat sim louh in akihihtuamna thuchiam dungzui zel in ahih ding ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, hichi- bang in Israel suante na vualzawl ding ahi. Akiang uah,
"TOUPA'N nou hon vualzawl in hon veng hen.
TOUPA'N na tung uah amel vaksak henla, hon hehpih hen.
TOUPA'N nou lam hong nga henla, lungmuanna noute hon pia hen, chi in gen un, chi in agen hi.
"Huchibang a hih in Israel suante tung ah ka min tuansak ahi dia, amau ka vualzawl ding," achi hi.
Mosi in biakbuk alam khit a, thau anilh khit a, ahihsiangthou khit a, van tengteng leh maitam leh tui-um belsuan tengteng thaunilh a, ahihsiangthou ni in hichi ahi a,
Israel intekpen, a-inkuan ua intekpente'n thillat alan ua, huaite anam ua intekpente, asimte uh tung a omte ahi uh.
Athillatte uh kangtalai tung nei guk leh bawngtal sawm-le-nih, intekpen nih in kangtalai khat zel, khat in bawngtal khat zel TOUPA ma ah ahon paipih ua, biakbuk ah ahong lan uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Biakbuk nasepna ding in aphatuam kha ding, na la chiat un; Levite, anasep uh dungzui zel in na pe chiat ding hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in kangtalaite leh bawngtalte ala a, Levite khut ah apia hi.
Kangtalai nih leh bawngtal li Gershon tapate anasep uh dungzui zel in apia hi.
Kangtalai li leh bawngtal giat, siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar, Merari tapate anasep uh dungzui in apia hi.
Kohath tapate bel mun siangthou a nasep amau a tuam hi a, anasep uh azawnthoh ahih ziak in ape kei hi.
Intekpente'n thaunilh ni in maitam latna dia athillatte uh maitam bul ah alan uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Intekpen chih in maitam latna dia athillat, athillat uh amau tan hi zel ding in alan ding uhi," achi hi.
Ni khat ni a thillat lan ding mi Judah chi Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.

Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik, dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding in thau helsa tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
Shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding in bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;
lemna kithoihna thillat ding in bawngtal nih, belamtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi a, hiaite Amminadab tapa Nashon thillatte ahi uh.
Ni nih ni in Issakar intekpente'n Zuar tapa Nethaneel in alan hi.

Athillat ding in dangkasik kuang khat agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding in bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;
lemna kithoihna thillat ding in bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga alan hi. Hiaite Zuar tapa Nethaneel thillatte ahi uh.
Ani thum ni in Zebulun tate intekpen Helon tapa Eliab in alan hi.

Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik, dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;
lemna kithoih thillat ding in bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi. Hiaite Helon tapa Eliab thillatte ahi uh.
Ani li ni in Reuben tate intekpen Shedeur tapa Elizur in alan hi.
Athillat dangkasik kuang khat agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat dia thau hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoihna thillat ding in bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi. Hiaite Shedeur tapa Elizur thillatte ahi uh.
Ani nga ni in Simeon tate intekpen Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel in alan hi.

Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum; mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik, dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbuang thillat ding in thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat a lat ding in bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga. Hiaite Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel thillatte ahi uh.
Ani guk ni in Gad tate intekpen Deuel tapa Eliasaph in alan hi.

Athillat dang-kasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa ngate Deuel tapa Eliasaph thillatte ahi uh.
Ani sagih ni in Ephraim tate intekpen Ammihud tapa Elishama in alan hi.

Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat; halmang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa ngate Ammihud tapa Elishama thillatte ahi uh.
Ani giat ni in Manasseh tate intekpen Pedazur tapa Gamaliel in alan hi.

Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel, tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa ngate Pedazur tapa Gamaliel thillatte ahi.
Ani kua ni in Benjamin tate intekpen Gideoni tapa Abidan in alan hi.

Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi. Hiaite Gideoni tapa Abidan thillatte ahi uh.
Ani sawm ni in Dan tate intekpen Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer in alan hi.

Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
Shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi. Hiaite Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer thillatte ahi uh.
Ani sawm-le-khat ni in Asher tate intekpen Okran tapa Pagiel in alan hi.
Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel sawm-thum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat upa ngate Okran tapa Pagiel thillatte ahi uh.
Ani sawm-le-nih ni in Naphtali tate intekpen Enan tapa Ahira in alan hi.

Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa ngate Enan tapa Ahira thillatte ahi uh.
Maitam thau nilh ni a Israel intekpente thillatte dangkasik kuang sawm-le-nih, dangkasik belhbu sawm-le-nih leh dangka-eng keu sawm-le-nih ahi.
Dangkasik kuang shekel za-le-sawmthum toh kikim a gik chiat ahi a, belhbu sawmsagih chiat ahi. Dangkasik tui-um belsuan tengteng mun siangthou a shekel sangnih-le-zali toh kikim a gik ahi.
Gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu sawm-le-nih mun siangthou a shekel sawm toh kikim a gik chiat ahi. Dangka-eng keu tengteng shekel za-le-sawmnih toh kikim a gik ahi.
Haltum thillat ding bawngtal tengteng sawm-le-nih ahi a, belamtal sawm-le-nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawm-le-nih; atangbuang thillatte uh toh, Khelh thoihna ding keltal sawm-le-nih.
Lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal sawmnih-le-li ahi a, belamtal bel sawmguk, keltal sawmguk, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawmguk ahi. Hiai thau nilh khit a maitam latna dia thilpiakte ahi uh.
Huchi in biakbuk a amah be dia Mosi alut in thukhun bawm tung a zahngaihna tutphah tunglam a cherub nihte kikal a pan amah ahoupihna aw aza hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron houpih inla, akiang ah, khawnvak na det chiang in khawnvak sagihte'n sathau khawnvak koihna malam atatvak ding uh ahi," chi in.
Aaron in huchibang in ahih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in khawnvak koihna malam ah khawnvakte ade hi.
Hiai khawnvak koihna ahihleh dangka-eng a sekthoh chi ahi a; amung bul a kipan apak tan a sekthoh ahi. Alim TOUPA'N Mosi a-etsak bang geih a khawnvak koihna bawl ahi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levite, Israel suante lak a pan hihtuam inla, hihsiangthou in.
Amaute hihsiangthou ding in hichibang in na hih ding ahi. Atung uah sawpsianna tui sung inla, apumpi tengteng uh metsak inla, apuante uh sawpsak inla, kihihsiangthousak in.
Bawngtaltuai khat tangbuang thillat thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah toh lasak inla, khelh thoihna ding in bawngtaltuai khat dang leng na kaisak ding ahi.
Levite kihoupihna biakbuk bul ah pi inla, Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kigawmkhawmsak vek in.
Levite TOUPA kiang ah na lan dia; Israel suante'n Levite tung ah akhut uh anga ding uhi.
Huchi in Aaron in Levite, TOUPA nna aseptheihna ding un Israel suante min in vei thillat TOUPA kiang ah alan ding.
Levite'n bawngtalte lutung ah akhut uh anga ding ua; Levite a dia kilemna bawlna ding in, khat, khelh thoihna ding in, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah alan ding ahi.
"Levite Aaron leh atapate ma ah na omsak dia, TOUPA a ding in vei thillat ding in na lan ding ahi.
Huchibang in Israel suante lak a pan Levite na hihtuam dia, huchi in Levite kei a ahi ding uh.
Huai khit in Levite kihoupihna biakbuk nasem ding in alut ding ua, nang amaute na hihsiangthou ding, vei thillat ding in na lan ding ahi.
Israel suante lak a pan kei a tuam dia seh ahi ngal ua. Sul hong tengteng, Israel suante ta masapen teng tang in kei a ding in ka neita hi.
Israel suante lak a ta masapente, mihing toh ganta toh kei a ahi him uhi. Aigupta gam a ta masapente ka sihsak lai in kei a tuam dia ka sehsa ahi.
Huchi in Israel suante lak a ta masapente tang in Levite ka nei khinta ahi.

Huchi in Israel suante tang a kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem ding leh Israel suante'n mun siangthou ahon naih ua leng Israel suante lak a hii alenlouhna dia lemna bawl ding in Israel suante lak a pan Levite Aaron leh atapate ka pia ahi," achi hi.
Huchibang in Mosi, Aaron leh Israel suan omkhawm tengteng in Levite tung ah ahihta uhi. Levite tungtang thu a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng bang in atung uah Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
Huchi in Levite siansak ahi ua, apuante uh asawp ua; Aaron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in alan hi. Amau hihsianthouna ding in Aaron in kilemna abawlsak hi.
Huai zoh in Levite Aaron leh atapate nuai a, anasep uh sem ding in kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah alut uhi. Levite tungtang thu a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in atung uah ahihta hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levite tantuam hiaite ahi. Kum sawmnih-le-nga chiang tunglam in kihoupihna biakbuk a nasep asem ding uh.
Kum sawmnga a upate'n anasep uh akhawlsan ding ua, nna asem nawn kei ding uh.
Himahleh khawmpite biakbuk kep thu ah a-unaute uh ahuh zel ding ua, nasep zaw asem nawn kei ding uh. Hichibang in Levite nasep na gelsak ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh akum nihna, akha khatna in Sinai gamdai ah Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante'n Paikan Ankuangluina ahunbi zel in nei uhen.
Ahunbi in, hiai kha, ani sawm-le-li nitaklam in na nei ding uhi. Huai a hih dia seh tengteng leh dan bang in na nei ding uhi," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in Israel suante Paikan Ankuangluina nei ding in ahilh hi.
Huchi in Sinai gamdai ah akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni nitaklam in Paikan Ankuangluina anei uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang zel in Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
Kuate hiam misi luang ziak a siang lou ana om ua, huai ni in Paikan Ankuangluina ah atel thei kei ua, huchi in huai ni in Mosi leh Aaron ma ah ahoh uhi.
Huaite'n akiang ah, "Misi luang ziak in siang lou ka hi ua; huaiziak in hia, Israel suante lak a ahunbi a TOUPA kiang a thillat ka lat sam uh kham ka hih uh?" achi uhi.
Mosi in akiang uah, "Na pau kei phot dih uh. Na tungtang thu uah TOUPA'N bangchi in ahia thu ahon piak ka hon za masa phot ding," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah, na lak ua kuapeuh, na suante uh lak a kuapeuh, misi luang ziak a siang lou hiam, ana zinmang hiam a-om zenzen uleh TOUPA a ding in Paikan Ankuangluina neih himhim ding ahi.
Akha nihna, ani sawm-le-li ni nitaklam in anei ding ua; tanghou silngou soh louh lou kha toh anek ding uh ahi.
Azing a ding in bangmah akoih ding uh ahi kei. Aguh leng ahihtan ding uh ahi kei. Paikan Ankuangluina a hih dia seh bang zel a ahih ding uh ahi.

Himahleh, siang ngal a, zinmangna nei lou, Paikan Ankuangluina a tel lou mawkmawk ahihleh achipihte lak a pan huai mi satkhiak ding ahi. Ahunbi a TOUPA kiang a thillat alat louh ziak in huai mi in akhelh moh akipuak ding hi.

"Namdangmi na kiang ua om in TOUPA a dia ankuangluina a tel sam a-utleh Paikan Ankuangluina a hih dia seh leh adan bang in ahih ding ahi. Hiai gam a mi mawng leh namdang mite a dia dan kikhat na neih ding uh ahi, chi in gen in,” achi hi.
Huchi in biakbuk lam khit ni in biakbuk, theihpihna puanin pen meipi in atuam liiliai hi. Nitaklam in biakbuk tung ah meikuang bangbang azingsang tan in a-om hi.
Huchibang in a-om nilouh a; meipi in atuam nilouh a, zan chiang in mei bang in akilang hi.
Meipi in puanin akikhinsan teng in Israel suante'n pai ding vai ahawm zel ua; meipi khawlna mun peuh ah Israel suante'n giahphual asat zel uhi.
TOUPA thupiak in Israel suante apai zel ua, TOUPA thupiak mah in giahphual asat uhi. Biakbuk tung a meipi a-om sung teng giahphual ah a-om nilouh uh.
Biakbuk tung a meipi sawtpi a-omleh Israel suante'n TOUPA thu azui ua, apai kei uhi.
Biakbuk tung a ni tam lou sung meipi a-om chiang in giahphual asat ua, TOUPA thupiak bang in, huchi in apai zel uhi.
Akalkal in meipi nitaklam a pan azingsang pha in a-om a; zingsang a meipi in atungkahsanleh apai zel uhi. Ni khat lel hiam, zan khat lel hiam om a meipi in atungkahsanleh apai zel uhi.
Biakbuk tung a meipi ni nih hiam, kha khat hiam, kum khat hiam a-om a, huai a a-om nilouh leh Israel suante giahphual ah a-om nilouh ua, apai kei uh. Atungkahsanleh bel apai zel uhi.
TOUPA thupiak in giahphual asat zel ua, TOUPA thupiak in apai zel uh. Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak in TOUPA thu azui uhi.
Obadiah mengmuhna Toupa PATHIAN in Edom tungtang ah hichi in achi: TOUPA a kipan thu ka thei a, namte lak ah palai sawl ahi, "Thou unla, kidouna ah amah dou ding in i kuan ding uh," chi in.
"Ngai dih, namte lak ah ka hon hihneuta hi; nakpi a muhsit in na omta.
Aw nang, suangpi kitam kal a teng, mun sang luah, kua'n ahia lei a hon kesak ding lungsim a chipa? Na lungtang kisaktheihna in nang ahon khemta hi.
Muvanlai bang in sangpi ah lengtou mah lechin, na bu leng aksi lak ah seh in om mahleh, huai a kipan ka hon kaikhesuk ding," TOUPA'N achi.

"Na kiang ah gutate, suamhatte zan in hong pai le uh, hihman nak hih na ni chia, adeihzah un agu kei ding ua hia? Na kiang ah grep lakhawm mite hong pai le uh, grep lak ding khenkhatte anuse kei ding ua hia?
Esau thilte zonkhiak ahita a; agoubawm selgukte maikhiak ahita!
Nang lawmte khem in na om a, gamgi pha in hon delhkhe ding ua; na kituahpihte'n nang ahon zouta ua; na tanghou nete'n na nuai ah thang akam ua; amah ah theihsiamna a-om kei hi.
Huai ni chiang in Edom a kipan mipilte ka hihmang in, Esau tang a kipan theihsiamna ka hihmang kei dia hia?" TOUPA'N achi hi.
Aw Teman, Esau tang ah michih thahgam a a-om vekna ding ua, na mihatte nakpitak in alunglel ding uh.
"Na unaupa Jakob tung a na hiamgamna ziak in zumna in nang ahon khuh ding, tangtawn in hihmanthat in na om ding hi.
Langkhat a na din ni a, mikhualte'n asum alakmang ni ua, namdang mite akulh kongkhak a ahong lut ua, Jerusalem tung a ai asan lai un, nang leng amau lak a tel bang in na om hi.
Himahleh na unaupa asiat lai in awibawl ke'nla, Judah tate amanthat ni un kipak ke'n; ahaksat ni in kisatheitak in pau ke'n.
Ka mite avangsiat ni un akulh kongpi uah lut ke'nla; avangsiat ni un athuakna uh en ke'n, avangsiat ni un asum-le-paite uh tung ah na khutte uh nga sam kei un.
Ami khenkhat taikhete that ding in lamka thuam a dingh in, haksat ni in ami omsunte mansak ke'n.
Nam tengteng tung ah TOUPA ni lah anai ngal a; na hihsiat mah bang in na tung ah hih ahi ding; na hihdan nangmah luzang ah hong kik ding hi.
Ka tang siangthou a na dawn bang un, nam tengteng in adawn gige ding uh, ahi, adawn ding ua, avalh ding ua, piang lou bang in a-om ding uh.
Zion tang ah bel suaktate a-om ding ua, asiangthou ding uh; Jakob inkote'n agoutante uh atang ding uhi.

Jakob inkote mei ahi ding ua, Joseph inkote meikuang ahi ding, Esau inkote buhpawl ahi ding ua, amau lak ah akuang ding ua, akangmang ding uh; Esau inkote khosuak a-om kei ding uh; TOUPA'N lah achita ngal hi.
Simlam mite'n Esau mual atang ding a; phaizang mite'n Philistia atang ding uh; amaute'n Ephraim leh Samaria lou atang ding uh; Benjamin in Gilead gam atang ding hi.
Kanaan mite lak a hiai Israel suan saltang mipite'n Zarephath gam tan atang ding ua; Sepharad gam a Jerusalem khomite saltang in simlam khopite atang ding uhi.
Zion tang a pan Esau dou ding in akuantou ding ua, atung ah vai ahawm ding uhi; huan gam TOUPA a ah i ding hi.”
Paul leh Timothi, Khrist Jesu sikhate'n, Philippi a om misiangthou tengteng leh heutute leh upate kiang ah:
Hehpihna leh khamuanna i Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan na tung uah om hen.
Noute ka hon theihgigena ah ka Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi,
na vek ua ding a kipaktak a thum a ka hon ngetsakna teng ah;
ani masapen a pan tuni tanpha a tanchinhoih a na kithuahkhawmna ziak ua kipak in.
Hiai thil mahmah gingta ing; amah nou a nasep hoih panpa'n Jesu ni tanpha in azoukim vek ding hi.
Na vek ua tungtang thu a, ke'n hichibang lungsim ka neih adik ahi, ka lungtang a ka hon neih ziak in; ka kolbutna leh tanchinhoih gupna leh hihkipna thu a hehpihna ka tanpihte na hi vek uhi.
Khrist Jesu hehpihna nou ngiingei ah nou ka hon ngai mahmah chih Pathian in ahon theihpih hi.
Noute theihna leh theihkakna toh kithuah itna a na khan semsemna ding un ka thum hi.
Huchi a thil hoihpen na deih ua, Khrist ni a siangthou leh dembei a na omtheihna ding uh leh,
Pathian thupina leh pahtawina ding a, Jesu Khrist ziak a hong om dikna gahte na dimtheihna ding un.
Unaute aw, tu in ka tung a thil hong tungte, tanchinhoih akhanna dia hong tung ahi uh chih na theih uh ka deih;
huchi in inpi vengpawl tengteng leh adang tengteng kiang ah Khrist ziak a kolbun ka hi chih achiangta hi.
Ka kolbuhna a kipan a Toupa muanna nei in unaute lak a tampite lau lou a Pathian thu gen ding in nakpitak in ahong hangsan deuhdeuhta uhi.
Khenkhatte'n hazatna ziak leh thangpaihna ziak in Khrist atangkoupih ua; khenkhatte'n hoih asak ziak un agen uh.
Pawl khatte'n itna ziak in, tanchinhoih dikdan gen dia om ka hihdan thei in agen uhi.
Himahleh pawl dang in kikhenna ding in Khrist atangkoupih ua, ataktak hilou in ka kolbuhna a ka thuakna behlap tum in.
Bang apoi a? Kong bangkim a Khrist akigenkhiak photleh akhem hi in atak hitaleh, huai ah ka kipak hi. Ahi, ka kipak zel lai ding hi.
Na thumnate uh leh Jesu Khrist Kha panpihna ziak in hiai ka suahtakna hong suak ding chih ka thei hi.

Ka gintak taktakna leh ka lametna bang in bangmah ah hihzum in ka om kei hial dia, himahleh ahi gige sa mah bang in tu in leng ka hinna hiam ka sihna hiam in ka pumpi ah hangsanna kim toh Khrist hihlet in a-om ngeingei ding hi.
Kei a ding in zaw hin Khrist ahi a, huan sih leng punna ahi.
Himahleh sa a hin ka tan ding hitaleh kei a ding in sepgim gah tampi suahna ding ahi. Hinapi in ka tel ding pen ka thei kei.
Nih kalteh in hamhaihtak in ka om hi. Paimang a Khrist kiang a om utna ka nei a; huai lah nakpitak in ahoihzaw ngal a.
Himahleh noute ziak in sa a om phot akiphamohzaw hi.
Huchi in hiai ginna ka neih ziak in, ka om phot ding chih ka thei; ginna a na khanletna ding uh leh na kipahna ding un, na vek ua lak ah ka om phot ding hi;
huchi a na kiang ua ka hong pai nawn ding ziak a Khrist Jesu na suanna ding uh tam semsem kei a na neihna ding un.

Na omdan uh Khrist tanchinhoih toh kituaksak photphot un; hong hoh a, nou hong muh hiam, ahihkeileh ka om louh a leng kha khat a na dinkipdan uh leh lungsim khat nei a tanchinhoih thugin a na pandan uh, na tanchin uh ka zaktheihna ding in.
Huan bangmah ah na melmate uh hihlau in om kei un. Huai amau a ding in manna ding kichetna teltak ahi a, himahleh nou a ding in hotdamna ding kichetna ahi, huai Pathian a kipan ahi.
Hiai tuh noute a ding in phal ahita; Khrist gingtate kia hilou in, ama ziak in na thuak sam ding uh.
Keimah a na muh uleh na zak uh huai kidouna mah na dou ding uh ahi.
Huaiziak in Khrist a thu kihilh ding a-om a, itna a kinep theihna ding a-om a, kha toh kithuahna, kilainatna leh kihehpihna a-omleh,
huai lungsim mah pu in, hichibang itna mah nei unla, tup kibang leh lungsim khat nei in ka kipahna hon hihkimsak un.
Kikhenna ding leh kithupisakna ziak in bangmah hih kei un; lungsim niamlak in michih in ama sang in midang hoih sa zaw hen.
Na lak ua kuapeuh in amah a ding kia en lou in, midang a leng en sam hen.
Khrist Jesu a om hiai lungsim nei le uchin:
Amah Pathian bang a om hinapi in, Pathian toh kikim a om thil khiaklah ding in asep kei hi,
himahleh amah ahong ki- awngsak a, sikha bang in ahong om a, mihing bang geih in ahong piang hi.
Huchi in mihing mel ahon pu a, ahong kingainiam a, si ding in thu ahon mang a, ahi, kros a sihna nangawn.
Huaiziak in Pathian in amah nakpitak in ahihlianta a, min laklak a min tungnungpen apeta hi;
Jesu min a mi tengteng akhukdin a, van tung, leitung leh lei nuai a thil om tengteng leh,
lei tengteng in Jesu Khrist Pa Pathian thupina ding a Toupa ahi chih apuankhiak theihna ding un.
Huchi ahih ziak in, ka itte aw, ka om lai kia hilou a, ka om louh lai a leng thu na man theih tak mah bang un, lau leh ling kawm in na hotdamna chiat uh semkhia un;
ama lungtaina ding a noumau a hon utsak leh hon semsakpa Pathian ahi.
Dawngdawng lou leh phunphun lou in thil bangkim hih un;
Khangthak gilou leh khial, alak ua khovel vak bang a na tennate lak uah Pathian ta gensiatbei leh siangthou,
hinna thu taklang na hihtheihna ding un; huai a kipan ke'n, Khrist ni ahong tun chiang a, athawn in ka semgim kei a, athawn in ka taigim kei ka chih ngamna ding in.
Ahi, na ginna thillat tung ua Pathian a dia buakkhiak a om ding na hi leng ka kipak a, na vek un ka hon kipahpih hi.
Huaiziak mah in, nou leng kipak unla; kei leng hon kipahpih un.
Akoi abang hitaleh na omdan uh ka theih a lungmuang a ka omtheihna ding in na kiang ua Timothi hon sawl pah Toupa Jesu ah ka lamen hi.
Hichibang lungsim pu a, na hoihna ding uh awlmoh midang kuamah ka nei kei hi.
Jesu Khrist thilte zong lou in, avek un amau tuam chiat azong uhi.
Himahleh ama'n tuh ta in apa nna asep bang in tanchinhoih genzakna ah kei ahon seppih chih theihchetna amah ah na nei uhi.
Huaiziak in bangchi in ka om dia chih ka hon theihchet peuhpeuh chiang in amah hon sawlkhiak pah ka kilamen hi.
Himahleh keimah mah leng ka hong pah ding chih Toupa ah ka kilamen hi.
Himahleh ka sanggam leh seppih leh sepaihpih leh na taksapna ua gamtang leh sawltak Epaphroditas na kiang ua hon sawl kiphamoh ka sa hi;
na vek un ahon ngai mahmah a, adam louh thu na zak un, alungkham mahmah hi.
Si dektak in achina ngei a; himahleh Pathian in atung ah zahngaihna anei a; amah tung kia leng hilou in kei tung ah leng ahi sam a, huchi a lungkhamna ka neih sawnsawnlouhna ding in.
Huaiziak in amah ka hon sawl teitei hi, amah na muh chiang un ana kipahpih un, huchi a kei leng ka dah luatlouhna ding in.
Huaiziak in kipaktak in Toupa ah amah na kipahpih unla, hichibang mite ana ngaisang un;
Khrist nasepna ah amah tuh ahong si dek a, kei a ding a na hihkimlouhte uh hon hihsak atupna lam ah ahinna akhuai dektak hi.
Atawp pen in unaute aw, Toupa ah kipak un. Angei mah gelh kei a ding in achimtakhuai kei a, nou a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
Uite lak ah kiveng un, nna gilou semte a pan kiveng un, sa atgawp mite a pan kiveng un.
Eite lah Kha a Pathian bia, Khrist Jesu suang, zeksum diktakte i hi ngal ua, huan pumpi ah suan ding i nei kei uhi.
Sa ah suang ding chi lehang kei mahmah in suan ding ka nei sem ding hi. Mi himhim in asa a suan ding nei a akitheihleh ke'n ka nei sem hi.
Ani giat ni a zeksum, Israel chi, Benjamin nam, Hebru mi kholdiak, dan lam a Pharisai;
phatuamngaihna lam chi lehang saptuamte sawi; dan a diktatna lam chi lehang gensiatbei ka hi.
Ahihi hitaleh, kei a dia punna ka ngah thilte peuhmah Khrist ziak in manna in ka simta hi.
Ahitak in, ka Toupa theihna manpha ziak in thil tengteng ka tanta hi. Khrist ka tantheihna ding in thil tengteng ninneng bang phet in ka sim hi.
Amah a ka omtheihna ding in leh dan a kinga keimah diktatna hilou a, Khrist ginna ziak a om pen, ginna a kinga Pathian a pan suak diktatna nei zaw in.
Huchi a amah leh athohnawnna thilhihtheihna ka theih a, athuaknate tanpih a, asihna a amah batna ka neihtheihna ding in.
Bangchi hiam a misi lak a kipan thohnawnna ka ngah theih khakleh chi in.

Nou mahmah, nou Philippite ngei in leng tanchinhoih om tung a kipat, Masidonia gam a kipan a ka pai nung, nou chih louh saptuam dang kuamah in piak leh muh lam ah ahon pe kei uh chih na thei uhi.

Huai chiang in ka Pathian in Khrist Jesu thupina ahauhna bang in na taksap tengteng uh ahon pe ngeingei ding hi. hi.
Tu in Pathian leh i Pa uh kiang ah tangtawn, tangtawn in thupina om hen, Amen.
Khrist Jesu a misiangthou tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Ka kiang a unau omte'n leng chibai ahon buk uhi.
Misiangthou tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi, Kaisar inkuanpihte ahi deuh tuam uhi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna in hon ompih hen, Amen.
Paul, Khrist Jesu hentapa leh i unaupa Timothi in, ka deihtak leh ka sepgimpih uh Philemon kiang leh,
ka sanggamnu uh Apphia kiang ah, ka sepaihpih uh Arkippas kiang leh na inn a saptuam kikhawmte kiang ah leng:
Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Ka thumnate ah na min lou gige in, ka Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi.
Toupa Jesu lam leh misiangthou tengteng lam a itna leh ginna na neih za in.
Na ginna kikoppihna, noumau a om thil hoih chiteng theihkimna lam ah Khrist lam a ahong phattuam theihna ding in.
Unaupa aw, nangmah ziak a misiangthoute lungtang ahong halh tak ziak in na itna ah ka kipak in ka kha amuang mahmah hi.
Huaiziak in akilawm hun hih ding in nang thu hon piak Khrist ah kingap mah leng,
itna ziak in, Paul putek hial hita leh, tu a Khrist Jesu hentapa hita in, anget in ka hon ngen zaw hi.
Ka ta Onesimas, kolbun kawm a ka neihkhiak, amah a ding in na kiang ah ka ngetsak hi.
Tuma lam in nang a ding in aphatuam kei a, tu'n zaw kei leh nang a ding in aphatuamta hi.
Amah, ka lungtang mahmah na kiang ah ka hon sawlkik nawn hi.
Amah tanchinhoih a ka kolbutna a nangmah sik a nna ahon sepsak theihna ding in ka kiang a omsak nilouh ka ut mahmah hi.
Himahleh na hehpihna hehpihsak teitei bang hilou in, na thu bang ahihtheih zawkna ding in, na thu lou in bangmah hih ka ut kei hi.
Sawt lou kal nang ahon khen tangtawn a amah na neih tawntungna ding ziak ahi kha mai ding hi,
himahleh sikha bang hi nawn lou a, sikha sang a hoih unau deihtak bang zaw in; kei a ding in deihtak ahi diak a, nang a ding ngial in sa leh Toupa ah nak hihna in chia!
Huchi in lawm a na hon simleh keimah bang in amah na kipahpih in.
Huan na tung a banghiam ahihkhelh a, na thil banghiam abatleh keimah bat in bawl in.
Kei Paul in, keimah khut ngei a ka gelh ahi. Keimah in ka ditsak ding hi; ka kiang a nangma'n leng bat na neih sam dan hon hilh bel ka hi kei hi.
Ahi, unaupa aw, nangmah ziak in Toupa ah kipahna hon neisak inla, Khrist ah leng ka lungtang hihhalh in.
Ka gen sang a thupizaw tham in na hih ding chih ka theih ziak in, na hon thuman ding chih muang in na kiang ah ka gelh ahi.
Akoi abang hitaleh, huai kia hih lou in, tunna ding hon na suktuahsak in; na thumnate uh ziak in na kiang ua piak ka hi ding chih ka kigingta hi.
Epaphras, Khrist Jesu a ka hentakpihpa'n chibai ahon buk hi;
huchi mah bang in ka seppih Marka, Aristarkhas, Demas leh Lukate'n leng chibai ahon buk uhi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kha uah om hen, Amen.
Israel kumpipa, David tapa Solomon paunakte.
Pilna leh hilhna theihna ding; theihsiamna thute theihkakna ding;
thilhih pilhuai a hilhna mu ding, diktatna, vaihawm leh hawmsiamna ah;
mimawlte kiang a kivensiamna pe ding, tangval kiang a theihna leh ngentelna.
Mipil in azak theih a, sinsiamna a apuntheihna ding in; theisiammi in thuphate aphaktheihna ding;
Paunak leh lim a thugen theisiam ding; mipilte thute, gentehna thugen theihhakte theisiam ding in.
TOUPA kihtak theihna kipatna ahi; himahleh mihai in pilna leh hilhna amusit.
Ka tapa, na pa hilhna za in, na nu dan mangngilh ke'n;
na lu a ding in deihhuai lutang zem leh na ngawng vial ding khainiangte hi ding ahi ngal a.
Ka tapa, mikhialte'n ahon zol ualeh, pha sakpih ke'n.
Hon zui in, sisan i buk ding ua, aziak bei in mihoihte aguk in i tang ding uh, achih uleh;
Sheol bang in amaute ahing in i nawmvalh ding ua, huan, kokhuk sung a paisukte bang in,
apum in van manpha tengteng i mu ding ua, gallakte in i innte uh i dimsak ding uh;
na tan kou lak ah na seplut ding a; sumbawm khat i neikhawm ding ua;
ka tapa, lampi ah amau toh ton ke'n; alampi ua kipan na khe kaikik in;
gilou hih ding in akhe uh atai ngal a, huan sisan suah ding in akinoh uhi.
Vasa himhim mitmuh in, len akiphah thawn ngal a,
huan hiaite'n amau sisan ngei atang ua, amau hinna ngei aguk in abuk uhi.
Huchibang tuh michih punna a duhgawlte lampi ahi a; huai in aneitute hinna alakmangsak sek hi.
Kongzing ah ngaihtak in pilna akikou a; mun liante ah a-aw asuah a;
mipi omkhawmte munpipen ah akikou a; kongpite lutna ah, khopi ah, athute agen.
Bang tan ahia, nou mimawlte'n, mawlna na it ding uh? Nuihsan mite'n nuihsan a amaute akipah ding ua, mihaite'n theihna ahuat ding uh?
Ka salhna ah kihei unla; ngai in na tung uah ka kha ka sungbo ding, na kiang uah ka thute ka theisak ding hi.
Ka sap a, na nial ziak un; ka bante ka zak a, kuamah in alimsak kei uh.
Himahleh ka thupha tengteng bangmah lou in na koih ua, ka salhnate bangmah na deih kei uhi.
Ke'n leng na tuahsiat ni un ka hon nuihsan dia; na launa uh ahong tun chiang in ka hon chiamnuih ding;
huihpi bang a na launa uh ahong tun chiang in; pingpei bang a na tuahsiatna uh ahong tun chiang in; lungkhamna leh dahna na tung ua ahong tun chiang in.
Huai hun chiang in kei ahon sam ding ua, himahleh ka dawng kei ding; thanuamtak in ahon zong ding ua, himahleh ahon mu kei ding uh.
Theihna ahuat ua, TOUPA kihtakna azon louh ziak un,
ka thupha lak ah bangmah adeih kei ua; ka salhna tengteng amusit uhi.
Huaiziak in alampi uh gah ane ding ua, amau thusawmte ngei in avah ding uhi.
Mimawlte nungtolhna in amaute athat dia, mihaite hauhsakna in amaute hihmang ding ahih ziak in.
Himahleh kuapeuh kei hon ngaikhia bittak in ateng ding ua, gilou launa pang lou in amuang ding uhi.
Solomon paunakte. Tapa pil in pa kipak abawl a; himahleh tapa hai anu gikna ahi.
Gitlouhna sumte'n bangmah aloh tak kei; himahleh diktatna in sihna a kipan atankhia hi.
TOUPA'N midiktat kialsih aphal kei ding; himahleh migilou a kipan atankhia hi.
Khut ze-ol mi ahong genthei a; himahleh mithanuam khut in hauhsakna abawl hi.
Nipi lai a lakhawmpa tapa pil ahi; himahleh pawltak hun a ihmu zumhuai omsak tapa ahi.
Midiktat lutung ah vualzawlnate a-om a; himahleh gilou kam hiamgamna in atuam hi.
Midik theihgigena anuam a; himahleh migilou min amuat mang ding.
Lungtang pil in thupiakte asang ding a; himahleh mihai haiham apuk ding.
Tangtak a pai hoihtak in apai a; himahleh alampite kilawmlousak theih in a-om ding hi.
Amit a chiamtehna bawl in lungkhamna a-omsak a; himahleh mihai haiham apuk ding.
Midiktat kam hinna tuikhuk ahi; himahleh hiamgamna in gilou kam atuam hi.
Huatna in kidouna atokthou a, himahleh itna in tatlekna tengteng akhuh hi.
Theihkak theihna neimi muk ah pilna muh in a-om; himahleh chiang theihsiamna neiloumi nungzang a ding ahi.
Mipilte'n theihna akholkhawm ua; himahleh mihai kam in siatna anaih.
Mihausa hauhsakna akhopi muanhuai ahi; migenthei siatna agentheih uh ahi.
Midiktat sepgimna in hinna azuan a; gilou punna in khelhna lam.
Bawlhoihna limsak hinna lampi ah a-om a; himahleh salhna don lou apaikhial hi.
Huatna sel zuauthei mukte a kipan ahi a; huan migensiatna gen mihai ahi.
Thu tampite ah tatlekna a-om lou kei a; himahleh amukte thuzoh in piltak in ahih hi.
Midiktat lei dangka hoihpen bang ahi; migilou lungtang athamatna neuchik ahi.
Midiktat mukte'n mi tampi avak a; himahleh mihaite theihsiamna taksap ziak in asi uh.
TOUPA vualzawlna in hauhsakna abawl a, huan huai ah lungkhamna abehlap kei hi.
Mihai a ding in gitlouhna hih kisukhalhna bang ahi; huchibang in theisiammi a ding in pilna ahi.
Migilou launa, amah tung ah ahong tung ding; midiktat deihna phal in a-om ding hi.
Pingpei alenmang bang in, migilou a-om nawn kei; himahleh midiktat tangtawn suangphum ahi.
Zu thuk in ha asuksiat bang in meikhu in mit asusia a, huchibang mah in amah sawlte a ding in mi zongzaw a-om hi.
TOUPA kihtak in nite asausak a, himahleh migilou kumte hihtom ahi ding.
Midiktat lametna kipahna ahi ding, himahleh migilou lametna amangthang ding.
TOUPA lampi a mitangte a ding in kulh muanhuai ahi; himahleh migilou nasem mite a ding in siatna ahi.
Midiktat suankhiak ahi ngei kei ding; himahleh gamsung ah migilou ateng kei ding hi.
Midiktat kam in pilna ahon tun a; himahleh lei gina lou satkhiak in a-om ding.
Midiktat mukte'n lak tuak bang ahia athei a, himahleh migilou kam in ginatlouhna agen hi.
TOUPA a ding in bukna diklou kihhuai ahi, himahleh gikdan dik akipahpih lam ahi.
Kisaktheihna ahong pai chiang in, zumna ahong pai; himahleh mikiniamkhiakte kiang ah pilna a-om hi.

Thangpaih ni in hauhsak aphatuam kei, himahleh diktatna in sihna a kipan ahunkhia hi.

Migilou asih chiang in alametna amangthang ding; huan thulimlouhna lametna amangthang hi.

Akam a Pathian limsak lou mi'n a-inveng ahihsia a; himahleh theihna ziak in midiktat suahtaksak in a-om hi.

Kuapeuh a-inveng musit pilna bei ahi; himahleh theisiammi adai dide hi.

Mipilvang in hoih lou amu a, abu hi; himahleh mimawl in a- awlmoh kei a, athuakloh hi.
Mikhual a ding moh khu dia om puansilh la in; huan numei lamdang a dia moh khu dia om chiamkhamna ding in len in.
Kuapeuh aw ngaihtaka, zingsang beltak a thou a, a-inveng vualzawl, ama a ding in hamsia a sim ahi ding hi.
Vuahchiin ni a vuah zu leh numei kinak hat akibang.
Kuapeuh amah khou huih khou bang ahi a, khut taklam a sathau ham bang ahi.
Sik in sik ahiamsak bang in mihing in alawm mel ahiamsak hi.
Kuapeuh theipi kung kem in huai a agah ane ding; huan kuapeuh apu ngak zahtak in a-om ding hi.
Tui a maitang in maitang amuh bang in, huai mah bang in mihing lungsim ah mihinna akimu hi.
Sheol leh Abaddon alungkim ngei kei ua, huan mihing mitte alungkim ngei kei uh.
Huansianna bel dangka a ding ahi, huan meipi dangka-eng a ding, huchibang mah in mihing phatna a ze-et in a-om hi.
Mihai sum sung ah buh taisate lak ah suk in su mah lechin, huchipi in leng amah a kipan in ahaina apaimang kei lai ding hi.
Na belamhonte omdan thei ding in thanuam in, na ganhonte hoihtak in en in;
Hauhsaknate tangtawn a ding ahi kei a; lallukhu in suan tengteng adaih zou hia?
Buhpawl puak in a-om a, huan loupa nou akilang, mualte a loupate akilakhawm hi.
Belamnoute'n na puansilh ding ahon pe ding, huan kelte'n na lou man ding.
Huan na an ding in, na inkote an ding in kel nawitui kiching a-om ding hi; huan na nungakte vakna ding in.
Migilou kuamah delh louh in atai; himahleh midiktat humpinelkai bang in ahangsan hi.
Gam tatlekna ziak in thuneimi tampi a-om a; himahleh theisiam leh theihna nei mite ziak in huai gam bel suk vaiveng theih ahi.
Taksap hau migenthei nuaisiahte zaw lou susia vuahpi zu bang ahi.
Amau dan mangngilhte'n migilou aphat ua; himahleh huchibang dan zuite amau tung ah athangpai uhi.
Mihoih lou in vaihawmna atheisiam kei; himahleh amau TOUPA zongte'n thil tengteng atheisiam uh.
Alampite a hoih lou mihau sang in athutakna a om migenthei ahoihzaw hi.
Kuapeuh dan zui tapa pil ahi; himahleh kuapeuh anhai mite toh kithuah in apa azumsak hi.
Kuapeuh aneih, anou leh apung tamsak in, migenthei hehpihmi amah a ding in alakhawm hi.
Kuapeuh dan za lou ding a abil kaihei, athumna nangawn kihhuai ahi.
Kuapeuh lampi gilou a midik lamhaihsak, ama kokhuk mahmah ah akelut ding hi; himahleh mihoihkim in gou hoih aluah ding hi.
Mihausa ama ngaih in apil a; himahleh migenthei theihsiamna nei in amah azongkhia hi.
Midiktat avualzoh chiang in, thupina lian a-om; himahleh migilou athoh chiang in, mite abu uhi.
Kuapeuh atatlekna khuh alohching kei ding; himahleh kuapeuh huaite thupha tawi a, mangngilh in zahngaihna amu ding uh.
Lau thei gige mi ahampha hi; himahleh alungtang saksak gige siatna ah ake ding hi.
Humpinelkai humham leh vompi hawk bang in; huai mah bang in migentheite tung a vaihawmmi gilou ahi.
Vaihawmmi theihsiamna tasam nuaisiah hat mithupi ahi; himahleh kuapeuh huaihamna hua in anite asausak ding hi.
Mi kuapeuh sisan a dimmi himhim, kokhuk sung ah atailut ding; kuamah in panpih kei hen.
Kuapeuh tangtak a om suahtaksak in a-om ding; himahleh kuapeuh alampite a hoih lou apuk zaw ding hi.
Kuapeuh agam lei let in tanghou tampi anei ding; himahleh kuapeuh mi bangmah lou nungzui in gentheihna kiching anei ding hi.
Miginom in vualzawlna ahau ding; himahleh kuapeuh hau ding a kintat gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
Mite deihsak tuam neih ahoih kei; tanghou them ziak in mi atalek ding leng ahi sam kei hi.
Kuapeuh deihgawl sumchit hauhsakna delh in akinoh a, huan atung ah taksapna ahong tung sin chih athei kei hi.
Kuapeuh mi deihsakna a sal in alei a maitangphat hatmi sang in deihsakna tamsem anung in amu ding hi.
Kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam lok a, "Tatlekna ahi kei," chimi zaw; amah mah hihsemi kithuahpih ahi hi.
Kuapeuh lungsim duhgawl in kinakna atokthou hi; himahleh kuapeuh TOUPA a muanna koih thausak in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh ama lungtang muang mihai ahi; himahleh kuapeuh piltak a om, suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh genthei kiang a pia atasam kei ding a; himahleh kuapeuh amit sel in hamsia tampi anei ding hi.
Migiloute alal chiang un, mite akibu ua; himahleh amanthat chiang un, midiktat apung hi.
Kuapeuh salh a om nak a, genhak teitei hihdamna om lou in thakhat in akise ding hi.
Midiktatte apun chiang un, mite akipak uh; himahleh migilou in vaihawmna apuak chiang in, mite amau uh.
Kuapeuh pilna it in apa akipaksak a; himahleh kuapeuh kizuakte kithuahpih in asum amawk zatbei hi.
Kumpipa'n vaihawmna in gam ahihkip a; himahleh kuapeuh thilpiak phut teitei in ahihsia hi.
Mi invengte maitangphat in kalsuante a ding in len azaksak hi.
Mihoih lou tatlekna ah thang a-om; himahleh midiktat in la asa a, akipak hi.
Midiktat in migenthei thu atheihpih a; migilou in huai thei ding in theihsiamna anei kei hi.
Misimmoh hatte'n khopi ahal ua; himahleh mipilte'n thangpaihna aheimang uh.
Mipil in mihai akiselpihleh, aheh hiam anui hiam, khawlna a-om kei ding hi.
Sisan duh a dangtak in amah mihoihkim amudah; huan mitang ahihleh, ahinna azong uhi.
Mihai in ahehna tengteng agen a; himahleh mipil in agenkhe kei a, akhemdai hi.
Vaihawmmi'n zuauthu angaih-khiakleh, asikha tengteng gilou ahi uh.
Migenthei leh nuaisiah hat akituakkhawm ua; TOUPA'N anih tuak uh mitte asukvaksak hi.
Kumpipa ginomtak gentheite ngaihtuah, tangtawn in alaltutphah akip ding hi.
Chiang leh salhna in pilna apia; himahleh naupang ama thuthu a omsak in anu a ding in zumna ahi.
Giloute apun chiang un, tatlekna apung hi; himahleh midiktat in apukna uh a-en ding hi.
Na tapa bawlhoih in, awlna ahon pe ding hi; ahi, na kha a ding in nopna ahon pe ding hi.
Mengmuhna omlouhna ah, mite azautat uh; himahleh kuapeuh dan zui, ama'n nuam asa hi.
Sikha thute a bawlhoih in a-om kei ding; thei mahleh alimsak kei ding.
Athute a kinoh mi na mu hia? Amah sang in mihai a kipan in lametna a-om zaw hi.
Kuapeuh anaupan a kipan a asikha nuamtattak a kem in atawptawp in ama tapa hong hi in anei ding hi.
Miheh in kinakna atokthou a, huan mithangpai in tatlekna ahau hi.
Mihing kisaktheihna in amah alainiam ding; himahleh kuapeuh lungsim kiniamkhiak in pahtawina amu ding.
Kuapeuh guta toh kithuah in amah kha amudah hi; nakpitak a ngetna aza a, huan bangmah agen kei hi.
Mihing kihtakna in thang ahon tawi a; himahleh kuapeuh TOUPA a muanna koih abit ding hi.
Mi tampi'n vaihawmmi deihsakna azong ua; himahleh mihing vaihawmna TOUPA a kipan hong pai ahi.
Midiklou midiktat a ding in kihhuai ahi; huan kuapeuh lampi a tang migilou a ding in kihhuai ahi.
Ka tapa, ka dan mangngilh ke'n; himahleh ka thupiakte na lungtang in kem hen.
Nite sawtna leh damsung kumte leh muanna, nang a hong kibehlap ding ahi ngal a.
Zahngaihna leh thutak in nang hon nuse kei hen; na ngawng kimvel in vial inla; na lungtang dohkan tung ah amaute gelh in.
Huchi in Pathian leh mihing mitmuh in deihsakna leh theihsiamna hoih na mu ding hi.
Na lungtang tengteng toh TOUPA ah muang inla, nangmah theihsiamna ah kinga ke'n.
Na lampi tengteng ah amah thei inla, huchi in ama'n na lampite apitang ding hi.
Nangmah mit ah pil ke'nla; TOUPA kihta inla, gilou taisan in.
Na lai a ding in damna ahi ding a, na guhte a ding in guhngek.
Na van in TOUPA zahtak in, na punna tengteng a gah masate toh in.
Huchi in hauhna in na pangte adimlet dia, na belte uain thak in adimlet ding hi.
Ka tapa, TOUPA sawina musit ke'nla; abawlhoihna leng chimtak sam ke'n.
Pa'n akipahna tapa asalh bang in; TOUPA'N a-itte asal ngal a.
Pilna mumi leh theihsiamna mumi'n nuam asa hi.
Huai a vante lah dangka vante sang in ahoihzaw ngal a, huan huai a punna dangka- eng hoih sang in.
Rubi suang sang in amanphazaw; huan amah toh na thil deihte na tehpih thei kei ding.
Akhut taklam ah nite sawtna a-om a; akhut veilam ah hauhsaknate leh zahtakhuaina.
Alampite nopna lampite ahi a, alampite tengteng muanna ahi.
Amah len tintente a ding in hinna sing ahi; amah nei den michih in nuam asa uhi.
TOUPA'N pilna in lei amukhia a; theihsiamna in vante ahihkipta hi.
Atheihna in thuknate akitam a, huan vante'n adaitui ataksak uhi.
Ka tapa, na mitte a kipan amaute paimangsak ke'n; pilna hoih leh ngentelna kem gige in.
Huchi in na kha a ding in hinna ahi ding ua, na ngawng a ding in kilawmna.
Huchi in bittak in na lampi ah na pai ding a, na khe akisui kei ding hi.
Na lup chiang in, na lau kei dia; ahi, na lum ding a, na ihmut alim ding.
Lauguihna kihta ke'n, ahong pai chiang in, giloute hihgawpna leng lau sam ke'n.
TOUPA na kimuanna ahi sin ngal a, na khe thang a awk lou ding in aveng ding hi.
Amu dingte a kipan thil hoih it ke'n, hih ding a na khut thilhihtheihna a-om lai in.
Na invengte kiang ah, na kiang a na neih lai in, pai inla, hong nawn in, huchi in zingsang chiang in ka hon pe ding, chi ke'n.
Na invengte siatna ding gilou ngaihtuah ke'n, na kiang ah bittak in ateng chih thei in.
Aziak bei in mi toh kina ke'n, gilou bangmah na tung a ahihkeileh.
Hiamgammi eng ke'n, alampite bangmah tel ke'n.
Kilawm lou lah TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi ngal a; himahleh athuguk mitangte kiang ah a-om hi.
TOUPA hamsia migiloute inn ah a-om; himahleh midiktatte tenna avualzawl hi.
Ama'n nuihsan hatte anuihsan a, himahleh kingainiamte kiang ah hehpihna apia hi.
Mipil in thupina gou aluah ding; himahleh zumna mihaite kaisanna ahi ding hi.
Jakeh tapa Agur thute. Huai mi in Ithiel kiang ah, Ithiel leh Ukal kiang ah.
Chihtaktak in kuamah sang in ka haizaw a, mihing theihsiamna ka nei kei.
Pilna ka sin nai kei a, Mi Siangthou theihna leng aka nei kei, achi hi.

Van ah kua akahtouta in ahong kumsuk a? Akhuttum sung ah kua'n huih alakhawmta a? Apuansilh in kua'n tuite atun a? Lei tawpnate kua'n ahihkipta a? Amin bang ahia? Huan atapa min bang ahia, na theihleh?
Pathian thu chiteng ettel ahi; amah a muangte a ding in lum ahi.
Athute ah behlap ke'n, hon sal dia, zuauthei amuh in na om kha ding hi.
Thil nih ka hon ngen; ka sih ma in huaite hon kitheihmohbawl ke'n.
Bangmah lou leh zuau kei a kipan gamlapi ah suan in. Gentheihna hiam hauhsaknate hiam hon pe ke'n; kei a dia kiphamoh an in hon vak in.
Huchi lou in zaw ka kham in, nang ka hon kitheihmohbawl in, TOUPA kua ahia? Ka chi kha ding hi. Ahihkeileh, ka genthei in, ka gu in, ka Pathian min thanghuaitak in ka bawl kha ding hi.
Apu kiang ah sikha gense ke'n, huchi lou in zaw nang ahon hamsiat dia, mohtansak in na om ding hi.
Apa uh hamsiat suan khat a-om a, anu uh vualzawl lou.
Amau mitte a siangthou suan khat a-om a, ahi a lah anitna ua kipan silsiang louh ahi uhi.
Suan khat a-om a, aw amitte uh sanghah hi na e; huan amitkhu vunte sansak in a-om hi.
Ahate uh namsau bang leh ahate uh temta bang suan khat a-om uh, lei a kipan a migenthei leh tasamte mite lak a kipan anekbeina ding in.
Vot in tanu nih anei a, hon pia in, hon pia in, chi in akikou ua. Thil thum lungkimsak theih ngei louh a-om uh, ahi, li, "Hun e,” chi lou.
Han leh sul hut; lei tui a hihlungkim a om lou; huan mei, "Hun e," chi lou.
Apa nuihsan mit leh anu thuman musit, phaizang va- akte'n atawm ding ua, muvanlai noute'n ane ding uhi.
Thil thum kei a ding a lamdang lua a-om ua, ahi, ka theih louh li.
Huihkhua a muvanlai lampi; suangpi tung a gulpi lampi; tuipi lak a long lampi leh pasal nungak toh alampi.
Huai mah bang in angkawm hat numei lampi ahi; ane a, zapi in akam aka a, gitlouhna ka hih kei, achi hi.
Thil thum ziak in lei aling a, huan thil li apuak zoh louh ziak in;
sikha kumpipa hong hih lai leh mihai ankham lai;
numei huathuaitak in pasal aneih a, sikha nungak in api aluah in.
Leitung ah aneu thil li a-om ua himahleh apil mahmah uh.
Miksite hat lou ganhing hon ahi ua, himahleh nipi lai in anek ding uh asutuah ua;
kawl sazawte hat lou pawltak ahi ua, himahleh suangpi heng ah a-inn abawl uhi.
Khaukhupte'n kumpipa anei kei ua, himahleh ahonhon in avek un kilem in apai uh;
inhikte na khut a na tawi theih ahi ua; himahleh kumpipate inpite ah ateng uh.
Apai chiang ua thupi thil thum a-om ua, ahi, apai chiang ua thupi, li.
Humpinelkai, gamsa laklak a hat penpen, bangmah ma ah akiheimang kei hi;
kidouna sakol; keltal leng; huan kumpipa, amite ma a pai.
Na kiletsak a haitak a na gamtatleh, ahihkeileh ngaihtuahna gilou na neihleh, na kam tung ah na khut koih in,
nawitui pei in nawituidat a- omsak a, nak hek in sisan asuahkhesak; huchi mah bang in thangpaihna paisuak in kilaina a-omsak hi.
Kumpipa Lemuel thute; anu'n amah athuhilh thu:
Bang ahia, ka tapa? Bang ahia, Aw ka sul tapa? Huan bang ahia, ka thuchiam tapa?
Na hatna numeite kiang ah pe ke'nla, kumpipate hihsete kiang ah leng na lampite pe sam ke'n.
Kumpipate a ding ahi kei, Aw Lemuel, uain dawn kumpipate a ding ahi kei; Zu khauh koi a om ahia, chih leng lalte a ding ahi sam kei.
Huchi lou in zaw adawn un, dan amangngilh un, gimthuak kuapeuh vaihawmna akaikawi kha ding uh.
Mangthang dia mansa kiang ah zu khauh pia un, kha a haksa sa kiang ah uain.
Dawnsak unla, agentheihna mangngilhsak un, ahaksatna theigige nawn kei hen.
Pau thei lou a ding in na kam ka in, sukgawp a ommi huchibangte tengteng thu ah.
Na kam ka inla, diktak in vai hawm in, gentheite leh tasamte kiang ah vai hawmsak in.
Zi nunhoih kua'n amu dia? Rubi suang tung pek sang in amanphazaw hi.
Apasal lungtang in amah amuang a, punna taksapna anei kei ding hi.
Adamsung niteng in amah ahihhoih a, ahihse kei.
Samul leh ziza azong a, akhut in kilawptak in nna asem hi.
Sumsinmi longte bang ahi a; gamla a kipan in an ahon tawi a.
Zan lai in leng athou a, a-inkote ding an leh asikhanute kiang ah asep ding apia hi.
Lou angaihtuah a, alei a; akhut a gahte in grephuan abawl hi.
Hatna in akawng agak a, akhutte ahatsak hi.
Asumsinna vante aphatuam chih amu a; zan in akhawnvak amit kei hi.
Akhutte muikhut ah anga a, akhutte mui ah anga hi.
Gentheite lam ah akhut azak a; ahi, tasamte lam asawk hi.
A-inkote ziak in vuk akihta kei a; a-inkote tengteng puan san-au in akithuam uhi.
Puanphah zehoih mantam akibawl a; apuansilh puanmalngat leh sandup ahi.
Kongpite a gam upate lak a apasal atut chiang in, mite' theihtuam in a-om hi.
Puan hoih puansilh abawl a, azuak a; sumsinmi kiang ah kawnggakte apekhia hi.
Hatna leh zahtakna apuansilh ahi; huan hun hong tung ding anuihsan hi.
Pilna in akam aka a; siamna dan alei ah a-om hi.
A-inkote lampi hoihtak in a-en a, huan thadahna tanghou ane kei hi.
Atate athou ua, amah nuamsa achi uhi; apasal in leng, amah aphat hi.
Tanu tampite'n hoihtak in ahih ua, himahleh nang zaw amaute tengteng na khup vek hi, chi in.
Ngaihbanna khemna in adim a, huan kilawmna bangmah lou ahi; himahleh numei TOUPA laudan siam, phat in a-om ding hi.
Akhut a gahte amah pia un; huan kongpite ah athilhihte'n amah phat hen.
Tate aw, pa hilhna za un, theihsiamna thei ding in limsak un.
Thugin hoihtak ka hon pe ngal a; ka dan taisan kei un.
Ka pa a ding in tapa ka hi a, ka nu mitmuh a nunnem leh ithuaipen ka hi.
Huan ahon sinsak a, ka kiang ah, na lungtang in ka thute lenden hen; ka thupiakte zui inla, huchi in hing in.
Pilna nei in, theihsiamna nei in; mangngilh ke'n, ka kam a thute a kipan lunglel ke'n.
Huai mangngilh ke'nla, nang ahon hawi ding a; amah it inla, ama'n ahon kem ding hi.
Pilna thil thupipen ahi; huaiziak in pilna la in; ahi, na muhsa tengteng toh theihsiamna la in.
Amah pahtawi inla, ama'n nang hon kaisangsak ding; pahtawina ahon tun dia, amah na kawi lai in.
Na lu a ding in kilawmna kizepna ahon pe dia; kilawmna lallukhu nang ahon pe ding hi.
Aw ka tapa, ka gente za inla, sang in; huchi in na damsung kumte atam ding hi.
Pilna lampi ah ka hon kisinsakta a; lampi tangte ah ka hon pita hi.
Na pai chiang in, na kalsuante haksa in a-om kei ding a; na taileh, na kisui puk kei ding.
Hilhna kiptak in len in; paisak ke'n; amah vom in; amah lah na hinna ahi ngal a.
Migiloute lampi ah lut ke'n; gilou mite lampi ah pai ke'n.
Pel inla, akiang ah pai ke'n; kiheisan inla, pai vengveng in.
Poi akhoih kei ngal uleh, a- ihmu ngal kei ua; kuahiam apuksak kei uleh, a-ihmutna uh lakmang in a-om hi.
Gitlouhna tanghou lah ane ngal ua, hiamgamna uain adawn uhi.
Himahleh midiktatte lampi khovak tung bang ahi, sun laitak a nisa bang a tangpha semsem.
Migiloute lampi khomial bang ahi; akisuihna uh athei kei uhi.
Ka tapa, ka thute limsak in; ka gente ah na bildoh in.
Na mitte a kipan amaute lamang ke'n; na lungtang lak ah vom in.
Amau mute a ding in hinna ahi ngal ua, asa uh a ding in damna.
Thanopna tengteng toh na lungtang kem in; huai a kipan lah hinna tui nakte aluang ngal a.
Nang a kipan kam hoih lou koihmang inla, nang a kipan in muk kilawmloute gamlapi ah koih in.
Na mitte'n tangtak in en uhenla, na etna na ma ah tang hen.
Na khe lampi pheisak inla, huan na lampi tengteng hihkip in omsak in.
Na khut taklam hiam veilam hiam ah pial ke'n; gilou lampi ah pai ke'n.
Ka tapa, ka pilna limsak in; ka theihsiamna na bildoh in.
Ngentelna na vom theih a, na mukte'n theihna akeptheihna ding un.
Numei gina lou mukte'n lah khuaizu atakkhesak ngal a, akam sathau sang in analzaw hi.
Himahleh atawpna nanung gamsai bang in akha a, namsau hiamtuah bang in ahiam hi.
Akhete sihna lam ah apaisuk a; akalsuante'n Sheol zuan in alen tinten hi.
Huchi in hinna lampi phei amu kei hi; alampite akip kei a, ama'n athei kei hi.
Huaiziak in tu in, ka tapate, hon ngaikhia unla, ka kam a thute a kipan paimang kei un.
Amah a kipan in na lampi gamlapi ah suanmang in, a-inn kongkhak nai ah hong pai ke'n.
Huchi lou in zaw midangte kiang ah na zahtakhuaina na pe kha ding a, na kumte gilou kiang ah.
Huchi lou in zaw na hatna in mikhualte avah kha ding ua, gamdangmi inn ah na sepgimnate a-om kha ding;
Huan na sa leh na pumpi hihgawp a a-om lai in na tawpna nanung ah na sun kha ding.
Huchi in hilhna za nuam lou hi na tel ing e, ka lungtang in salhna na musit na tel e, na chi kha ding.
Hon sinsak mite aw ka mang kei a, kei hon hilhte lam leng ka bil in ka na doh kei.
Omkhawmte leh kikhawmpite lak ah gilou tengteng ah siatna ka na hita mahmah hi.
Nangmah tuibem a kipan tuite dawn in, nangmah tuileh a kipan tui luang laite.
Na tui nak neite suk thanghuaigawp a om ding hia, kongzingte ah na luite?
Nangmah a ding kia hi uhen, nang kiang a mikhualte ding hilou in.
Na tuikhuk vualzawl in om hen; huan na tuailai zi ah kipak in.
Deihhuai sazukpi leh heksiam sakhipi bang. A-itna leh ngaihnatna in chik lai peuh in leng nang hon lungkimsak gige hen; huan a-itna a vak in om gige in.
Bangziak in ahia, ka tapa, numei lamdang vak a om a, mikhual ang va kawi ding na hia?

Amah ahi, kumpipate kiang a hotdamna pia a, namsau mi hihse thei lak a asikha David hunkhepa pen.
Hon honkhia inla, mikhualte khut a kipan hon humbit in, akam un thu bangmah lou peuh agen nak ua, akhut taklam uh khut taklam diklou ahi.
Ka tate uh ahong valnou ua singnou dipdip bang a a-om ua; ka tanute uh leng inpi omdan gel bang a aning a suangkhuak bang a a-om hun un;
Ka buh innte uh adim a, thil chi chih a-om phetphut a; ka belamte un leng nou asang asang a tam, asing asing a tam ka mun ua aneih chiang un;
Ka bawngte uh ahong suan phat a; nou neihsiat himhim a-om louh a; insung lok leh pawtkhia a-om louh a, ka kongzingte ua kikou husa a-om louh chiang in.
Huchibang a om mite kipaktak in a-om nak uhi; ahi, TOUPA Pathian anei mite kipaktak in a-om nak uhi.
Kumpipa aw, ka Pathian, ka hon pahtawi ding a; na min tangtawn tangtawn in ka phat ding hi.
Niteng in ka hon phat ding a; na min tangtawn tangtawn in ka phat ding hi.
TOUPA athupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi; athupidan suikhiak vual ahi kei hi.
Suan khat in suan dang kiang ah na thilhihte aphat sawnsawn ding a, na thilhih thupitakte atheisak ding hi.
Nangmah pahtawina kilawmdan thupitak leh na thillamdang hihte ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
Mite'n na thilhih mulkimhuaite hatdan agen ding ua; ke'n leng na thupidan ka theisak sam ding hi.

TOUPA mihehpih thei, chitna a dim, lungnel, zahngaihna thupitak nei ahi.
TOUPA bangkim tung ah leng ahoih hi; athilsiamte tung ah zahngaihnate a-om hi.
TOUPA aw, na thilsiam teng in na kiang ah kipahthu ahon hilh ding ua; misiangthoute'n nang ahon phat ding uhi.
Na gam thupidan thu gen in, na thilhihtheihna thu houlimna in azang ding ua;
Mihing tate kiang a athilhih thupitakte leh agam kilawmna thupidan theisak ding in.
Na gam tangtawn gam ding ahi a, na thuneihna suan om sung teng in a-om gige ding hi. TOUPA athute ah amuanhuai a, anasepte ah deihsak asiam hi.
TOUPA'N apukte alen gige a, kun kheukheu a omte akaitang hi.
Amau tengteng mit nang tung ah atu a; ahuntak ah an nek ding uh na pia hi;

Aw hong pai TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in la i sa ding uh; i hotdamna suangpi pahtawi in nuamsatak in i kikou ding uhi.
Kipahthu gen in ama ah pai ni e, phatna la sa a amah pahtawi in nuamsatak in aw i suah ding uhi.
TOUPA Pathian athupi mahmah ziak in, pathian tengteng tung ah Kumpipa thupitak ahi.
Amah khut ah lei mun thuktakte a-om a, mual dawn sangtakte amah a mah ahi.
Tuipi amah a ahi a, ama bawl ahi a; gam leng akhutsuak ahi.
Aw hong pai unla, bia in kun ni e, TOUPA eite Hon siampa ma ah i khukdin ding uh.
Amah i Pathian ahi a, eite agantatna mun a mite leh, akhut a belamte i hi ngal ua. Tuni in a-aw na zak uleh,
Meribah a ahih bang un na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un, Gamdai a Massah ni bang in.
Huai lai in na pipute un ahon khem ua, hon ze-et ua, ka thilhih amu uhi.
Kum sawmli sung huai suante tung ah ka lunghi kei hi. Alungtang ua ngaihkhelh hatmi ahi ua, ka lampite leng athei kei uhi, ka chi hi.
Huaiziak in ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh, chi in heh in ka kichiam hi.
Aw, TOUPA phat in la thak sa unla; leitung luah tengteng aw, TOUPA phat in la sa un.
TOUPA phat a la sa in, amin phat unla; niteng in ahotdamna thu theisak un.
Namte lak ah athupina gen unla, michih kua peuhmah kiang ah athillamdang hihte gen un.
TOUPA a thupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi ngal a; Pathian tengteng sang a kihtak ding ahi.
Mipite pathiante milim ahi ua; TOUPA'N bel vante abawl ahi.
Pahtawina leh thupina ama ah a-om ua, hatna leh kilawmna amun siangthou ah a-om uhi.
Michih a chichihte aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA kiang ah thupina leh hatna pia un.
TOUPA kiang ah amin thupina pia unla, thillat ding tawi in ahuangsung intual ah hong pai un.
Aw, siangthou kilawmna silh in TOUPA bia unla; leitung luahte teng aw, ama ah ling un.
Namte lak ah, kumpipa in TOUPA atu, chi un! Leitung mah leng alin theihlouhna ding in, hihkip in a-om hi; ama'n khentuam nei lou in michih vai ahawm ding hi.
Vante kipaktak in om henla, lei leng nuamtak in om hen; tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng lum honhon uhen;
Lou leh asung a om tengteng kipaktak in om henla; huai hun in gam a sing teng in nuam in la asa ding uh;
TOUPA ma ah, amah ahong pai dek hi; lei vaihawm ding in ahong dek ngal a. Khovel diktak in vai ahawmsak ding a, michih thutak in vai ahawmsak ding hi.
TOUPA'N vai ahawm a; leitung in nuam sa hen; tuikulh gam tampite kipaktak in om hen.
Meite leh mial sah bikbek akim ah a-om a; diktatna vaihawmna dik a laltutphah kingakna ahi.
Amalam ah mei apai a, akim a amah galte akangmang hi.
Akhophiate'n khovel asalvak a; leitung in amu a, aling hi.
Tangte khuainun bang in TOUPA ma ah azul khin a, leitung tengteng TOUPA ma ah.
Vante'n adiktatna atangkoupih zel ua, mi khempeuh in athupidan amuta uhi.
Milim bawltawm nasemte zahlak in om uhen, milim suangte mah; nou pathian tengteng aw, amah bia un.
Zion in aza a, kipaktak in a-om a, Judah tanute leng nuamsatak in a-om uh; TOUPA aw, na vaihawmte ziak in.
TOUPA, nang leitung tengteng tung pek ah pahtawi in na om hi.
TOUPA itte aw, gilou lehngatsan un; ama'n misiangthoute hinna avomhoih a; amau migilou-salou khut a kipan ahumbit nak hi.
Midiktat a ding in khua avak a, lungtang diktak pu a ding in kipahna a-om hi.
Midiktatte aw, TOUPA ah kipaktak in om unla; amin siangthou phat un.
Aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa un; thillamdangtakte ahihta ngal a! Akhut taklam leh aban siangthou in amah a ding in hotdamna ahihsakta hi.
TOUPA'N ahotdamna atheisak a, adiktatna namte mitmuh in chiantak in alangsakta hi.
Israel inkuanpihte tung a azahngaihna leh aginomdan atheigige a; kawlmong a mi tengteng in, Pathian hotdamna amuta uhi.
Leitung luah tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in kikou unla; kikoukhia unla nuamsa in la sa un, ahi, phatna la sa un.
Kaihging toh TOUPA phat in la sa un, kaihging leh phatna la husa toh.
Pengkulte leh pengkul binei ging toh kumpipa, TOUPA ma ah, nuamsatak in kikou un.
Tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng lum honhon hen; khovel leh asung a tengteng toh,
luipite'n akhut uh beng uhenla; mualte'n nuam in la sakhawm uhen,
TOUPA ma ah; lei vaihawm ding in, ahong pai dek ngal a khovel diktattak in vai ahawmsak ding a, khentuam nei lou in michih vai ahawmsak ding hi.
Kumpipa in TOUPA'N vai ahawm a; michih ling uhen! Amah cherubte tung ah atu a; leitung ling hen.
TOUPA Zion khosung ah thupitak ahi a; michihte tung ah tungnung tham ahi.
Amau na min thupi lauhuaitak phat uhen; amah asiangthou hi.
Kumpipa hatna in vaihawmna a-it a; nang khentuam neihlouhna na hihkip hi, nang Jakobte lak ah vai na hawm a, diktak in na hih hi.
TOUPA i Pathian uh pahtawi unla, akhe ngakna bul ah bia un; amah asiangthou hi.
Asiampute lak ah Mosi leh Aaron, aminloute lak ah Samuel; amau TOUPA asam ua, ama'n adawngta ahi,
meipi dingh ah akiang uah thu agen a, athut athu theihpihte leh thupiakte azui zel uhi.
Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, nang amaute na dawng a; nang amau ngaidampa Pathian na hi, athilhih tung uahte phu la zel mah lechin.
TOUPA i Pathian pahtawi unla, amual siangthou ah bia un; TOUPA i Pathian asiangthou hi.
Jesu Khrist kilakna, Pathian in asikhate kiang a lahkhiak ding a amah apiak, thil hong om pah mahmah dingte. Huan ama'n asikha Johan kiang ah a-angel sawl in chiamtehna in atheisak hi.
Johan in Pathian thu leh Jesu Khrist tungtang a athil muhte tengteng atheisakta hi.
Hiai genkholhna thute sim a, athute za a, huai a thil kigelhte zuite ahampha uhi; ahun anai tak ziak in.
Johan in Asia gam a om saptuam sagihte kiang ah, amah omlel, omsa leh hong pai ngei dingpa a kipan leh alaltutphah ma a om, Kha sagihte a kipan in hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen;
huan Jesu Khrist, theihpihpa ginom, misite lak a piang masapen leh leitung a kumpipate vaihawmpa a kipan. Eite hon it a i khelhna a kipan a asisan a hon sawppa amah kiang ngei ah;
leh lalgam hi ding a hon bawl, Pathian leh a Pa kiang a siampute hi ding a hon bawl, amah kiang ah thupina leh vaihawmna, tangtawn tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
Ngai in, meipi toh ahong pai hi; mit teng in amah amu ding ua, amah sunte'n leng; leitung a nam tengteng in amah asuun ding uh, huai bang hi hen, Amen.
"Kei Alpha leh Omega, abul leh atawp," Toupa Pathian, omsa, omlel leh hong pai ding Bangkim hihthei in achi hi.
Kei, Johan, na unau uleh Jesu a om haksa thuakna leh lalgam leh kuhkalna a na tanpihpa uh, Pathian thu ziak leh Jesu theihpihna ziak in tuikulh gam Patmos kichi ah ka om hi.
Toupa ni in Kha in ka om a, ka nunglam ah aw ngaihtak in pengkul ging bang mai ka za hi.

Aw in, "Kei Alpha leh Omega, abul leh atawp ka hi, na thil muhte laibu ah gelh inla, Asia gam a saptuam sagih, Ephesa, Smarna, Pergamos, Thiatira, Sardis, Philadelphia leh Laodisia kiang ah khak in," achih ka za hi.
Huan kei hon houpih huai aw muh tum in ka kihei hi. Huchi a ka kiheileh dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagih ka mu hi.
Huai khawnvak koihna lai ah kuahiam Mihing Tapa toh kibang, akhepek tuampha puansilh, a-awm kimvel dangka-eng gakna a kigak ka mu hi.
Alu leh asamte samul ngou leh vuk bang in angou a; amitte meikuang bang ahi.
Akhepekte sumsan nawttet meipi a halsiangsa abang a, huan a-aw tui tampi ging bang ahi.
Huan akhut taklam in aksi sagih atawi a; akam a kipan in namsau hiamtuah asuakkhia a; huan amel nisa asat san lai bang ahi.
Huchi a amah ka muhtak in, misi bang in akhebul ah ka puk hi. Huan ama'n ka tung a akhut taklam koih in, "Lau ke'n, amasapen leh ananungpen ka hi.
Huai ahingpa ka hi; ka sita a, ngai in tangtawn in ka hing hi, sihna leh misi kho chabi ka nei hi.
Huaiziak in na thil muhsate, thil omlelte leh tunung a thil hong om dingte gelh in.
Ka khut taklam a aksi sagih na muhte leh dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagihte thuguk hiai ahi: Aksi sagihte saptuam sagihte angelte ahi ua; khawnvak koihna sagihte saptuam sagihte ahi uh," achi hi.
Huan meipi puansilh a kizem van a kipan angel hat dang hong paikhesuk ka mu hi; alutung ah sakhituihup a-om a, amai nisa mah abang a, akhete mei khuamte bang mai ahi.
