Akhut a laibuzial neuchik honsa atawi a; akhe taklam a tuipi tung sik in akhe veilam leitung ah anga hi.
Humpinelkai humham bang in aw ngaihtak in akikou a; akikou khit in vanpiging sagihte'n a-aw uh asuah uhi.
Huan vanpiging sagihte'n a-aw uh asuahtak un gelh ding in ka kisa hi; van a kipan aw in, "Vanpiging sagihte' thugen iim bikbek inla gelhkhe ke'n,” achih ka za hi.
Huan tuipi tung leh leitung a angel dingh ka muh in van lam ah akhut taklam aliktou a;
huchi in huai tangtawn a hing van leh leitung leh asung a om tengteng leh tuipi leh asung a om tengteng siampa min lou in azekai nawnlouhna ding chi in akichiam hi.
Himahleh angel sagihna in amut ding pengkulpi agin chiang in, huai hun chiang in, "Pathian thuguk, asikha zawlneite kiang a agenkhiak tak hihkim in a-omta ding," chi in.
Van a kipan a ka aw zak in kei hon houpih a, "Kuan inla, tuipi tung leh leitung a angel dingh khut a laibuzial neuchik honsa va la in,” achih ka za nawn hi.

Kei, angel kiang ah ka va hoh a, laibuzial neu hon pe ding in akiang ah ka va gen hi. Ama'n ka kiang ah, "La inla, ne zou vek in; huai in na gil hihkha in chin himahleh na kam ah khuaizu bang in akhum ding," achi hi.
Huan angel khut a kipan in laibuzial neuchik ka la a, ka ne zou vek a; ka kam ah khuaizu bang in akhum a; huan ka nekzohtak in ka gil hihkhat in ahong om hi.
Huan ka kiang ah, "Mi tampite leh namte leh paute leh kumpipate kiang ah Pathian thusuak na genkholh nawn ngeingei ding ahi," ahon chi hi.
Huan sialluang chiang bang tehna chiang khat piak in ka om a; angel in, "Thou inla, Pathian tempul leh maitam leh huai a bete teh in;
tempul huangsung polam ahihleh nusia inla, teh ke'n; Zentelte kiang a piaksa ahih tak ziak in; huan kho siangthou akhenuai un kha sawmli-le-nih sung asikden ding uhi.
Huan ka theihpihtu nihte kiang ah thilhihtheihna ka pe dia, amau sai-ip puan silh in ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmguk thu agenkhol ding uh achi hi."
Hiaite olive sing nihte leh khawnvak koihna nihte, leitung a Toupa ma a dinghte ahi uhi.
Mi kuapeuh in amau suknat atup ualeh, akam ua kipan a mei hong suakkhia in amelmate akangtum vek dia; kuapeuh in amau hihnat atup ualeh huchibang a thah in a-om ding uhi.

Hiai mite'n athugenkholh sung ua vuah azuklouhna ding in, van khaktheihna anei ua; huan a-ut hunhun ua sisan suaksak ding in tuite tung ah thu anei ua, leitung leng gawtna chiteng a gawt ding in thu anei uhi.
Huan atheihpihna nasep uh azoh chiang un, kokhuk taw nei lou a kipan a hong pawtkhia huai gamsa in amau akidoupih ding a, amau azou dia, athat ding hi.
Asiluang uh khopi thupi kongzing ah akisial a, huai khalam thu ah Sodom leh Aigupta kichi, kros a Toupa kilhlup a a-omna mah ahi.
Mite leh chite leh paute leh namte lak a kipan mite aluang uh ni thum-le-akim a-en ua, aluang uh han a vui aphal kei uhi.
Huchi in leitung a tengte amaute tung a kisial in akipak ua, kipahna abawl ua; thilpiakte akikhaktuah ua; hiai zawlnei nihte'n amau leitung a tengte athuakgimsak khit tak ziak un.
Huan ni thum-le-akim nung in, Pathian a kipan in hinna hatna amau ah ahong lut a, akhe un adingh uhi; amau mu tengteng tung ah nakpi a launa ahong omta hi.
Van a kipan in aw thupitak aza ua, "Hiai ah hong paitou un," chi in. Huan amau meipi lak ah van ah apaitou uhi; amelmate un amau amu chiat uhi.
Huai dak in zinling thupitak ahong om a, khopi mun sawm a khen mun khat achim hi. Huai zinling ah mi sangsagih thah in a-om ua; adangte'n alau ua, van a Pathian kiang ah thupina apia uhi.
Tunggikna nihna abeita a; ngai in, tunggikna thumna ahong tung pah ding hi.
Huan angel sagihna in apengkul amut a; van ah aw thupitak in, "Khovel lalgam tuh i Toupa leh a Khrist a ahong hita hi; ama'n tangtawn in vai ahawm ding," achi uhi.
Upa sawmnih-le-li, laltutphah tung a Pathian ma a tute'n amai ua lei si in Pathian abia uhi.
"Na tung ah ka kipak uhi, Toupa Pathian Bangkim hihthei, omlel leh omsa leh hong om ding; na thilhihtheihna thupi na lak tak ziak in leh vai na hawm tak ziak in,

Namte aheh ua, tu in nang thangpaihna ni ahong tung hi, misite vai na hawmsak hun leh na sikha zawlneite leh misiangthoute kiang leh na min kihtate milian leh mineute kiang a kipahman na piakna hun leh leitung hihsete hihsiat a a-om sam hun uh ahong tungta hi," achi uhi.
Huan van a om Pathian tempul hon in a-om a; atempul sung ah thukhun bawm ahong kimu hi; huchi in khophiate, awte, van-gingte, zinlingte leh gial thupitak in azui ngal hi.
Van ah chiamtehna thupi leh lamdangtak; numei khat ni a kizem, akhenuai a khapi sikden leh alutung a lallukhu aksi sawm-le-nih khu hong kimu hi.
Ama'n nau apai a, nauvei leh suakkhe ding natna in akapkhia hi.
Huan van ah chiamtehna dang khat ahong kilang a; ngai in, dragon san lianpi, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei, alutung a lallukhu sagih khu hong kilang hi.
Amei in van a aksite mun thum a khen mun khat akaikhia a, leitung ah apaikhia a; dragon in huai numei nau nei ding a kisa, aneih chiang a anau nek zoh tum in ama ah adingh hi.
Ta pasal naupang, sikchiang a nam tengteng tung a vaihawm ding anei a; atapa pen Pathian leh alaltutphah ah laktouh in a-om a,
numei pen gamdai ah, Pathian in amah a dia amun bawlsak ah, huai ah ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmguk khoi a om ding in atai hi.
Huan van ah kidouna a-om a; Mikael leh a-angelte dragon toh kidou ding in akuankhia ua; dragon leh a-angelte'n leng adouthuk uhi.
Huan azou kei ua, van ah amun himhim uh muh in a-omta kei hi.
Dragon lian, gulpi tek, diabol leh Setan chih a ompa, khovel pumpi khempa leh amah nasem angelte toh van a kipan paihkhiaksuk in a-om uhi.

Huan van ah aw ngaihtak mai ka za hi, "Tu'n ah i Pathian hotdamna ahong tungta, thilhihtheihna leh Khrist thuneihna; i unaute hekpa, i Pathian ma a sun leh zan a amau hekpa, paihkhiaksuk a a-om ziak in.
Belamnou sisan ziak leh atheihpih uh thu ziak in amah tung ah avualzouta ua; sih tanpha in leng ahinna uh a-it kei uhi.

Huaiziak in kipak un, aw van leh nou asung a tengte, leitung leh tuipi a ding in atung uh agik; diabol in hun tomchik phet anei chih akitheih ziak in, aheh mahmah a na kiang uah ahong paisuk hi," chi in.
Leitung a dragon paihkhiak ahita chih akitheihtak in, huai numei nau pasal neinu agawt hi.
Himahleh huai numei kiang ah muvanlai thupitak kha nih piak in a-om a, gulpi mai a kipan gamdai mun a alenlut theihna ding in, huai ah hun khat sung leh hunte leh hun kimkhat sung vak in a-om hi.
Gulpi in akam a kipan in tuipi bang tui luang a numei ataihmangsak theihna ding in numei nung ah asekhia hi.
Lei in numei apanpih a, lei in akam aka a, dragon in akam a kipan a atui siatkhiak ana valhzohsak vekta hi.
Numei tung ah dragon aheh mahmah a, asuan omsun, Pathian thupiak zuite leh Jesu thu theihpihte kidoupih ding in akuankhia hi.
Huan tuipiau ah dragon adingh hi.
Tuipi piau a ka dinleh tuipi a kipan gamsa khat, kii sawm leh lu sagih nei, akiite tung a lallukhu sawm om chiat, alutungte a Pathian gensiatna om, hong paikhetou ka mu hi.
Ka gamsa muh gialbem abang a, akhe vompi khe abang a, akam humpinelkai kam abang hi; dragon in athuneihna thupi leh alaltutphah leh athilhihtheihnate amah apia hi.
Alute lak a khat sihpih khop hial dia liam hileh kilawm in ka mu hi; sihpih khop hial dia liam pen hihdam in a-om a; huchi in leitung pumpi in huai gamsa lamdang sa in azuita uhi.
Dragon, gamsa kiang a athuneihna petu abia ua; huchi in hiai gamsa abiak kawm in, "Hiai gamsa bang kua a-om a, amah kidoupih thei kua om ahia?" achi uhi.
Huan gamsa kiang ah thil thupite leh Pathian gensiatnate genna ding kam piak in a-om a, huan akiang ah thuneihna piak in a-om hi; kha sawmli-le-nih thilhihtheihna piak ahi.
Pathian gensiatna ding, amin gense ding leh a-omna, van a tengte ngei gensia in akamkata hi.
Huan dragon in gamsa kiang ah misiangthoute kidoupih ding leh amaute zou ding in phalna apia a; chi chih, pau chih leh nam chih tung a thuneihna leng apia hi.
Huan khovel om tung a pan thahsa Belamnou' hinna laibu a amin tuangloute tengteng leh leitung a teng tengteng in amah abe ding uhi.
"Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!"
Kuapeuh sal a pi dingte sal a pi in a-om ding; kuapeuh namsau a thah dingte namsau a thah in a-om ding. Hiai ah misiangthoute kuhkalna leh ginna nei ding a chial ahi uh.
Huan gamsa dang khat leitung a kipat a hong pawtkhetou ka mu a; belamnou bang in kii nih anei a, dragon bang in thu agen hi.
Gamsa masapen thuneihna tengteng amitmuh in azang hi. Leitung leh asung a teng tengteng gamsa masapen, si khop hial a liam hihdam a om, be ding in asawl hi.
Huan mite mitmuh in van a kipan in leitung a mei kesuk thei khop in thillamdang pipi ahih hi.
Huan gamsa sik leh amitmuh a thillamdang hihtheihna piak a a-omna in ama'n leitung a tengte akhem a; huai gamsa namsau a satliam leh dam nawn lim bawl ding in lei a tengte thu apia hi.
Gamsa masa lim a nakna pe ding leh tua gamsa apau theihna ding in dragon in amah kiang ah thilhihtheihna apia a, huchi a gamsa lim be nuam lou tengteng leng athahsak theihna ding in.
Mi tengteng, aneu leh alian, azawng ahau, sikha leh sikha lou, akhut taklam uh hiam, atal uh hiam ah chiamtehna piak in a-om chiat uhi;
huchi a kuamah in huai chiamtehna hiam, gamsa min hiam, ahihkeileh amin nambat neiloute'n lei thei lou hiam, zuak thei lou a a-omna ding in.
Hiai ah pilna a-om hi. Kuapeuh theihsiamna nei in, gamsa nambat sutkhia hen; huai lah mihing nambat ahi ngal a; huan ama nambat tuh zaguk sawmguk-le-guk ahi.
Huai nung in ka etleh ngai in, Zion tang tung a Belamnou dingh ka mu a, akiang ah mipi nuaikhat singli-le-sangli, atal ua a Pa min kigelh chiatte toh adingkhawm uhi.
Tui tampi leh vanpiging bang a ging van a kipan in aw ka za a; ka aw zak gosem tumte'n agosem uh atumging uh abang a;
laltutphah leh thil hing lite ma leh upate ma ah la thak hileh kilawm khat asa ua; leitung a kipat a huai leikhiaksate, nuaikhat singli-le-sanglite lou ngal kuamah in huai la atheithei kei uhi.

Hiaite numei lak a kihihninloute ahi ua; nungak siangthou bang ahi uhi. Hiaite apaina lamlam ua Belamnou zuite ahi uhi. Pathian a ding leh Belamnou a ding a gah masapen hi ding a mite lak a kipan a leisate ahi uhi.
Huan akam uah zuau a-om kei a; amaute lah Pathian laltutphah ma ah gensiatbei ahi ngal ua.
Huan angel dang van laizawl a leng ka mu a, ama'n tangtawn tanchinhoih, leitung a tengte kiang leh nam chih leh chi chih leh pau chih leh michihte kiang a genkhiak ding anei hi.
Aw ngaihtak in, "Pathian kihta unla, amah thupina pia un; avaihawmna hun ahong tungta ngal a; van leh lei leh tuipi leh tuikhukte siampa amah bia un," achi hi.
Huan angel nihna in ahon zui a, "Pukta, pukta Babulon kho thupi, nam tengteng a mingaihhatna, hehna uain dawnsaknu,” achi hi.
Angel thumna in amau ahon zui a, aw ngaihtak in, "Kuapeuh gamsa leh alim bia, atal hiam akhut hiam a chiamtehna neite'n
Pathian thangpaihna uain adawn ding ua, huai uain thangpaihna nou, bangmah toh hel louh hial a bawl ahi; angel siangthoute leh Belamnou muh in amah mei leh kaat in hihnat in om in teh.
Huan ahihnatna meikhu uh tangtawn tangtawn in azamtou dia; huai gamsa leh alim bete leh kuapeuh amin chiamtehna nei taphot in sun leh zan in tawlngakna anei kei ding uh," achi hi.
Hiai ah misiangthou, Pathian thupiakte leh Jesu ginna zuite kuhkalna nei ding a chialna a-om hi.

Huan van a kipan aw in hichibang in, "Gelh in, tua kipan in misite, Toupa a site ahampha uh," Kha in, "Ahi, asepgimna uh akhawlsanta ding ua, athilhihte un hon zui ding ahih ziak in," achih uh ka za hi.
Huan ka etleh ngai in, meipi ngou ka mu a; huai mei tung ah mi khat Mihing Tapa toh kibang, alu a dangka-eng lallukhu khu, akhut a kawite hiamtak tawi ka mu hi.
Angel dang tempul a kipan ahong paikhia a, meipi tung a tupa kiang ah ngaihtak in, "Na kawite lik inla, at in; at hun atungta; leitung buh amingawpta," chi in akikou hi.
Huai mei tung a tupa'n leitung ah akawite alik a; leitung at in a-omta hi.
Huan van a om tempul a kipan in angel dang ahong paikhia a, ama'n leng kawite hiamtak atawi hi.

Huan meikuang tung a thilhihtheihna nei, angel dang maitam ma a kipan in ahong paikhia a; ama'n aw ngaihtak in, huai kawite tawipa sam in, "Na kawite hiamtak lik inla, leitung a grep gahbomte lakhawm in; grepte amin mahmahta hi,” achi hi.
Huai angel in leitung ah akawite alik a, leitung a grep gahte alakhawm a, Pathian thangpaihna, uain sukna thupi, uain sukna ah apailut hi.
Kho polam ah uain sukna chil in a-om a, uain sukna a kipan sakol kamkaihna tanpha louching sangkhat-le-zaguk pha in sisan aluangkhia hi.
Huan chiamtehna thupi leh lamdang, angel sagih, hii nanung sagih, ananungpente, Pathian hehna toh kidim tawi, van ah ka mu hi.
Huan limlang tuipi hileh kilawm, mei toh kihel leh gamsa leh alim leh amin nambat tung a vualzoute, akhut ua Pathian gosem tawi a, limlang tuipi kiang a dingh ka mu a,
amau Pathian sikha, Mosi la leh Belamnou la asa uhi. "Na thilhihte thupi in alamdang hi. Aw Toupa Pathian, Bangkim hihthei! Na lampite adik in atang uhi, Misiangthoute Kumpipa, chi in.

Toupa aw, kua'n ahia na min hih thupi a lau lou ding? Nang kia lah siangthou na hi ngal a. Namte tengteng hong pai in na ma ah ahong be ding uh, na thilhih diktatte lah hihlat in omta ngal ua," achi uhi.
Hiai thilte ka muh nung in, van a theihsakna biakbuk dantan sungnung hon in a-om a;
huan hiai dantan sungnung a kipan in angel sagih, gawtna sagih nei, puanmalngat siangthou leh vak a kizem a, dangka-eng kawnggak a a-awm ua kigakte ahong paikhia uhi.
Thil hing lite lak a khat in angel sagihte kiang ah tangtawn tangtawn a hing Pathian hehna a dim dangka-eng belhbu sagihte apia hi.
Huchi in Pathian thupina athilhihtheihna a kipan meikhu in tempul hihdim in a-om hi; angel sagihte gawtna sagihte atunkim masiah asung ah kuamah alut theita kei uhi.
Huan tempul dantan sungnung a kipan hong suak aw thupi in, angel sagihte kiang ah, "Kuan unla, leitung ah Pathian thangpaihna belhbu sagihte va sungkhia un," achih ka za hi.
Amasapen akuan a, leitung ah abelhbu asungkhia a, huai gamsa chiamtehna nei, alim bemite tung ah meima sia leh nai in ahong suak hi.
Anihna in tuipi tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; misite si bang in sisan ahong suak a; tuipi sung a thil omte tanpha in hinna nei peuhmah asita uhi.
Athumna pen in luite leh tui nakte tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; sisan ahong suak uhi.
Tuite angel in, "Nang omsa leh omlel, nang Siangthoupa aw, hichibang a vai na hawm tak ziak in na diktat hi.
Amau misiangthoute leh zawlneite sisan asuah ua, nang adawn ding ua sisan na piak, aphu tawk him uh ahi,” achih ka za hi.
Huan maitam in, “Ahi, Toupa Pathian aw, Bangkim hihthei, na vaihawmte adik in adiktathuai hi!" achih ka za hi.
Alina pen in nisa tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; amah kiang ah mite meikuang a hainat theihna piak in a-om hi.
Asat a sa a mite hainat in a-om ua; hichibang natnate tung a thilhihtheihna nei, Pathian min agensia ua; Pathian kiang a thupina pe ding in akisik tuan kei uhi.
Angana in gamsa tutphah tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; huan alalgam hihmial in a-om a; amau na sa in alei uh akei ua,
anatna uh leh ameimate uh ziak in amau tuh van a Pathian agensia ua; athilhihte uah akisik tuan kei uhi.
Agukna in Euphrates Luipi thupi tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; huai tui akang vek hi, huchi a suahlam a kipan kumpipate lampi ding bawlsa a a-omtheihna ding in.
Dragon kam a kipan leh gamsa kam a kipan leh zawlnei taklou kam a kipan in kha nin thum, ukeng bang mai hong paikhia ka mu hi.
Amaute ahih uleh dawite kha, thillamdang hihte; khovel pumpi leh lei kumpipate kiang a hong a, Pathian Bangkim hihtheipa Ni thupi a kidouna a dia amaute pikhawmte ahi uhi.
"Ngai in, guta bang in ka hong pai hi! Kiveng leh puan tengsa a ommi ahampha hi, huchi lou in zaw vuaktang in a-om dia; azumhuaina amu kha ding uhi."
Huchi in amaute mun khat, Hebru pau a "Armageddon" kichi ah apikhawm uhi.
Asagihna in huihkhua tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; huan laltutphah a kipan in dantan sungnung ah aw ngaihtak ahong suakkhia a, "Zoh ahita!" achi hi.
Huchi in khophiate, awte, van-gingte, leh zinling thupi ahong om a, huchibang a thupi leh hat leitung a mihing om nungsiah om ngei nai lou zinling thupi ahi.
Khopi thupi mun thum in akikhen a, namte' khopite achim ua; Babulon khopi thupi Pathian mitmuh in theihgige in a-om a, adawn ding in ahehna kihtakhuai uain nou piak in a-om hi.
Tuikulh gam chiteng ataimang ua, tang sangte muh phak in a-omta kei hi.
Huan van a kipan in gial lian pipi, talent khat a gik mite tung ah ahong kesuk hi; mite'n huai gial a gawtna ziak in Pathian agensia ua; huai gawtna athupi mahmah hi.
Huai thil nung in belhbu sagih tawi angel sagihte lak a khat hong pai in kei ahong houpih a, "Hong pai in, tui tampite tung a tu kizuaknu thupi tung a vaihawmna ka hon ensak ding.
Leitung kumpipate amah toh akingai ua, huan amingaihna uain in leitung a tengte khamsak in a-om uh," achi hi.
Ama'n Kha in gamdai ah hon pomang a; huan gamsa san-au, Pathian gensiatna min a pumdim, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei tung a numei khat tu ka mu hi.
Huai numei in puan sandup leh puan sandang asilh a, dangka-eng leh suangmantam leh tuikepsuang in akizem hi; akhut in dangka-eng nou, thilkihhuaite leh angkawm nitna a dim atawi hi.
Huan ataltang ah, "Babilon thupi, kizuakte leh leitung a kihhuaite nu," chih min khat akigelh hi.
Huan huai numei, misiangthoute sisan leh Jesu martarte sisan dawnkham in ka mu hi. Huai minu ka muhtak in lamdang ka sa mahmah hi.
Huan angel in ka kiang ah, "Bangziak a lamdang sa na hia? Huai numei leh amah pua gamsa, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei, thuguk ka hon hilh ding, achi hi.

Huai na gamsa muh a-om khin a, huan a-om kei a; kokhuk taw nei lou a kipan a hong paikhe ding ahi, manthatna a pai ding ahi. Huan leitung a tengte, khovel siam tung a kipan a hinna laibu a min gelhlouhte'n tua gamsa om khin a, om lou leh hong om ding ahihdan amuh chiang un lamdang asa ding uhi.
"Hiai ah pilna lungsim neih akul hi. Lu sagihte numei tutna tang sang sagihte ahi uhi.
Huan kumpipa sagihte a-om ua; nga apuk khin ua, khat a-om lel a, khat ahong tung nai kei hi. Ahong tun chiang in, hun tomchik sung a-om ding hi.
Huai gamsa na om khinsa, tua om lou pen kumpi giatna ahi. Amah sagihte lak a tel ahi; huan manthatna ah apai ding hi.
"Huan kii sawm na muhte, lalgam nei nai lou, kumpipa sawmte ahi ua; himahleh dakkal khat lel, huai gamsa toh amau kumpipate bang in thuneihna anei ding uhi.
Hiaite'n lungsim khat nei in, gamsa kiang ah athilhihtheihna leh athuneihna uh apia uhi.
Hiaite'n Belamnou akidoupih ding ua, Belamnou in amau azou dia, amah toupate' Toupa leh kumpipate' Kumpipa ahih ziak in; amah toh omkhawmte bel sapte, telte leh muanhuaite ahi uhi.”
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Kizuaknu tutna tui na muhte mite leh mipite leh namte leh paute ahi uhi.
Kii sawm na muhte leh na gamsa muhte'n kizuaknu amudah ding ua, suanbei leh vuaktang asuaksak ding uhi, asa ane ding ua, amah mei in ahaltum vek ding uhi.
Pathian thu hihkim a a-om mateng, amah deihlam ahihna ding uleh, lungsim khat aneihna ding uleh, alalgam uh gamsa kiang a apiakna ding un, Pathian in amau ah ngaihtuahna akoih hi.
"Huan na numei muh khopi thupi, leitung kumpipate tung a vaihawmnu ahi,” achi lai hi.
Hiai thil nung in van a kipan angel dang, thuneihna liantak nei, van a kipan hong paikhesuk ka mu a; athupina in leitung avaksak hi.
Aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Chimta, chimta Babulon khopi thupi, dawite omna leh kha nin tengteng kulh leh vasa nin leh huathuai teng kulh ahong hita hi.
Nam tengteng in amingaihna hehna uain a nam tengteng dawnkhamsak a-om ua, leitung Kumpipate'n amah akingaihpih ua, leitung sumsinte noptal luatna a ahong hauh tak ziak un," achi hi.
Huan van a kipan in aw dang in hichibang in agen hi: "Ka mite akhelhna ua na pan khaklouhna ding uh leh ahii na kailouhna ding un, amah a kipan in hong paikhia un, achih ka za hi.
Akhelhna van atungta a, Pathian in akhelhnate atheigige hi.
Ama'n hon piak bangmah akiang ah pia unla, amah gamtatna aleh nih in thukkik un; ahelna nou ah amah a ding in aleh nih in helsak un,
Akithupisakna zahzah leh anoptalna zah in amah bawlgim un, hihlungkham un; ama'n alungsim a, 'Kumpinu in ka tu a, meithai ka hi kei, bangchi mah in ka lungkham ngei kei ding,' achih ziak in.
Huaiziak in ni khat sung in hipi a gawtna, sihna, lungkhamna leh kialna ahong tung ding hi; huan amah mei in halmang vek in om in teh; atung a vaihawm Toupa Pathian ahat ziak in."
Huan leitung a kumpipate amah kingaihpih leh nuamtat a omte'n, amah haltumna meikhu amuh chiang un, amah kah in amau ding uhi.
Athuakna a hihnat a om ding lau in gamlapi a dingh in, "Maizen! Maizen! Khopi thupi Babilon! Dakkal khat sung a na tung a vaihawmna ahong tung ngal a," achi ding uhi.
Huan leitung a sumsinte'n, asumsinna van uh kuamah in alei louh ziak un, kap in asuun ding uhi.

Huan asumsinna vante uh dangka-eng leh dangka a sumsinna van, suangmantam, tuikepsuang, puanmalngat hoih, puansan, maimom puan, puan eng, singnamtui, saiha a bawl van, sing mantampen chi a van bawl tengteng, sumsan leh sik leh marbul suang a belsuan bawl tengteng;
leh singguithak, namtui, namtui haichi, thaunamtui, chim, uain, thau, buhnel, buh, belam, huan sakol kangtalai leh sal, huai tuh mite hinna ahi.
"Huan na lungsim a na deih gahte'n nang hon taimangsan ua, thil limchi leh hoih teng in nang ahon manthatsan ua, muh nawn ahi ngei kei ding," achi uhi.
Hiai thilte a sumsinte, amah ziak a hau a bawlte'n, amah hihnat a a-omna lau in gamlapi a dingh in, kap in asuun ding uhi.
“Maizen! Maizen! Khopi thupi, puanmalngat hoih, asan leh a-eng a kizem a, dangka-eng, suangmantam leh tuikepsuang a kivannu!

Dakkal khat in hichi tel a hauhna thupi bangmah lou a bawl a a-om ziak in,” achi ding uhi. Huan longpute leh akoilam lam a long a hong tungte leh long mite leh tuipi a nek zong tengteng gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
Amau khopi kang leh halna meikhu amuh chiang un, "Hiai bang kho thupi a-om ngei hiam," chi in akikou uhi.

Huan alutung ua leivui kibuak in akikou ua, kap leh suun in, "Maizen! Maizen! Kho thupi huai a tuipi a mi longnei tengteng ama hauhsakna ziak a hauhsak in a-om uhi! Dakkal khat sung a amah bangmah lou ahong hih tak mai, achi ding uhi.
"Aw nang van, amah tung ah kipak unla, Aw nou misiangthoute leh nou sawltakte leh nou zawlneite; na tung ua avaihawmna Pathian in ama tung a vai ahawm tak ziak in kipak un!" achi uhi.

Huan angel hat khat in buhgawina suang lianpi hileh kilawm suang khat adom a, tuipi ah apailut a, "Hichibang in khopi thupi, Babulon nakpi a hihchip in om in chin, muhkhiak nawn louh hial in a-om ding.

Gosem tumte leh lasiamte leh tamngai tumte leh pengkul tumte, na sung ah akiza nawn kei hial ding hi. Khutsiam siamna nei himhim, na sung ah muhkhiak in om nawn kei hial un chin; na sung ah khawl ging akiza nawn sam kei ding hi.
Na sung ah meivak avak nawn kei ding a; mouneipa aw leh mou aw na sung ah akiza nawn kei ding; na sumsinte lah leitung kumpipate ahi ngal ua; na bumsiamna in nam tengteng khem in a-omta uhi!
"Amah sung ah zawlneite sisan leh misiangthoute sisan leh leitung a thah a omte tengteng sisan akimukhia hi," achi hi.
Hiai thilte nung in van ah mipi aw hileh kilawm in, "Hallelujah! Hotdamna leh thupina leh thilhihtheihna i Pathian a ahi;
avaihawmna adik in akizen hi; kizuaknu thupi leitung a, amingaihna a hihsenu tung a vai ahawm tak ziak in, ama'n asikhate sisan ama tung ah athukta," achih ka za hi.
"Hallelujah! Huai khopi halna meikhu tangtawn tangtawn in azamtou hi," chi in akikou nawn uhi.
Upa sawmnih-le-lite leh thil hing lite abokkhup ua, Pathian laltutphah a tupa, "Amen, Hallelujah!" chi in abia uhi.
Huan laltutphah a kipan in aw ahong pawtkhia a, "Nou asikhate aw, na vek un, aneu leh alian, nou amah laute, Pathian phatna pia un," chi in.
Mipi tampi aw hileh kilawm tui tampi ging bang leh vanpiging bang aw in, “Hallelujah! Toupa i Pathian Bangkim hihthei in vai ahawm ziak in,
nuam ni, nakpitak in kipak ni, amah kiang ah thupina pia in; Belamnou zineih hun ahong tungta hi. Azi leng akisak khit tak ziak in;
amah puanmalngat hoih leh siangthou a kizepna ding in piak in a-omta, achih ka za hi, tua puanmalngat hoih misiangthoute nasep diktatte ahi."
Huan angel in ka kiang ah, "Gelh in, Belamnou zineihna nitak ankuang um ding a chial a omte ahampha uhi," achi hi.

Huan amah be ding in akhebul ah ka puk hi. Huan ka kiang ah, "Hon be kei hial in; Jesu thu theihpihna kem nangmah unau leh sikha hihpih ka hi; Pathian be zaw in, Jesu thu theihpihna genkholhna kha ahih ziak in," achi hi.
Huan van kihong ka mu a; ngai in, sakol kang leh atung a tuang Ginom leh Dik kichi leng ka mu hi; ama'n dikna a vaihawm in kidouna abawl hi.
Amit meikuang bang ahi a, alutung ah lallukhu tampi a-om a, min khat amah lou ngal kuamah theih louh kigelh anei hi.
Amah puan sisan a diah in akizem a; amin, "Pathian Thu,” chih ahi.
Amah van a om sepaihhon puanmalngat hoih, ngou leh siangthou silh a sakol kang tung a tuang in ahon zui uhi.
Akam a kipan in namte asatna ding, namsau hiam khat ahong suakkhia a; amau tung ah sikchiang in vai ahawm dia; Pathian Bangkim hihthei hehna lauhuaina uain sukna achil hi.
Apuan tung leh aphei tung ah min, "KUMPIPATE' KUMPIPA, LEH TOUPATE' TOUPA," chih akigelh hi.
Huan angel khat ni a dingh ka mu a; amah aw ngaihtak a kikou in, van laizawl a vasa leng tengteng kiang ah, "Hong unla, Pathian nitak an thupi ah hong kikhawm vek un;
Kumpipate sa, sepaih heutute sa, mihatte sa, sakolte sa, atung a tute sa, mi tengteng sa, sikha leh sikhaloute sa leh milian leh mineu sa na nektheihna ding un," achi hi.
Huai gamsa leh leitung a kumpipate leh asepaihte uh, huai sakol tung a tuangpa leh asepaihte kidoupih ding in ahong kikhawm uhi.
Gamsa mat in a-om a, zawlnei tak lou, ama a chiamtehna hih a gamsa chiamtehna neite leh amah limbete akhempa toh amankhawm a; anih tuak un ahing in meidil, kaat a kang sung ah paihlut in a-om uhi.
Huan adangte huai sakol tung a tupa kam a kipan a hong suak namsau a thah in a-om uhi; vasa tengteng amau sa in gilvah in a-om uhi.
"Ephesa saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Akhut taklam a aksi sagih tawi dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagih lai a vialvakpa'n hiai thilte agen hi.
"Na thilhihte, na sepgimdan leh na kuhkaldan, migiloute na ngaihmohdan leh hiloupi a amau sawltak kichite na ze-et a, amaute zuauthei ahi uh chih na muhkhiakdan ka thei hi.
Huan thuakzohna na nei a, ka min ziak in na thuak teitei a, huchi in leng na bah kei hi.
Himahleh na hon itna masapen na tawpsan thu ah ka hon dem hi.

Huaiziak in na pukna laitak theigige inla, kisik in, na thilhih masapente hih nawn in; huchi lou in zaw na kiang ah ka hong pai dia, na kisik keileh a-omna a kipan in na khawnvak koihna ka suan ding hi.
Himahleh hiai thu ah na hoih, Nikol pawlte thilhihte na hua a, ke'n leng huaite ka hua hi.
"Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa kiang ah Pathian Paradis a om, anek ding in hinna sing ka pe ding achi," chi in.
"Huan Smarna a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Amasapen leh ananungpen, huai si a hing nawnta in hiai thilte agen hi.
"Na thilhihte, na gimthuakdan leh na zawndan, himahleh na hau hi, Judate hilou napi, ahi a kigen Setan sinagogte Pathian gensiatna ka thei hi.

Na thuak pah ding thilte kihta ke'n; ngai in, ze-et a na omtheihna ding un diabol in na lak ua akhente suangkul ah ahon khum pah ding; ni sawm sung gimthuakna na nei ding uhi. Sihpha in ginom in om in, huchi in hinna lallukhu ka hon pe ding hi.
"Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa sih nihna hihnat in a-om kei ding achi," chi in.
"Huan Pergamom a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Namsau hiamtak hiamtuah nei in hiai thilte agen hi.
"Na tenna leh Setan laltutphah omna leng ka thei; ka min kiptak in na lenden a, Setan tenna mun a ka palai ginom, Antipas thah a a-om lai in leng na ginna na tawpsan tuan kei hi.

Himahleh demna zek ka hon nei, huai lai a mi khenkhat Balaam sinsakna zuite na ompih ziak in, Israel suante ma a kipukna koih ding leh milimte kiang a kithoihna thilte ne ding leh kingaihna khelhna hih ding in ama'n tuh Balak athuhilh hi.
Huchibang mah in Nikol pawlte sinsakna zui, mi khenkhat mah na ompih hi.
Huaiziak in kisik in; huchi lou in zaw na kiang ah ka hong pai pah dia, amau ka kam a namsau in ka dou ding hi.

"Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa kiang ah manna selguk ka pe ding, huan suangpek ka pe dia, huai suang tung ah min thak, aneipa lou ngal kuamah in atheih louh a kigelh achi," chi in.
"Huan Thiatira a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Pathian Tapa, meikuang bang mit nei a, sumsan nawttet bang khe neipa'n, hiai thilte agen hi.
Na thilhihte leh na itna leh na ginna leh na nasepna leh na thuakzohna ka thei hi, amasapen sang in na thilhih nanungte atamzaw hi.

Himahleh hiai thu ah demna ka hon nei hi, huai numei Jezebel, zawlnei kichinu khawk na sak louh ziak in; ama'n ka sikhate kingaihna khelhna hih ding leh milimte kiang a kithoihna thilte ne ding a khem in ahilh hi.
Huchi in amah akisikna ding in hun ka pia hi; huan amingaihna khelhna ah akisik tuan kei hi.
Ngai in, amah damlou lupna ah ka pai ding a, athilhihte akisik tuan keileh amah angkawm teng leng gimthuakna thupi ah ka pai ding hi.
Huan hipi in atate ka that dia; saptuamte tengteng in lungsim kiheinate leh lungtang theipa kei ka hi chih athei ding uh; na thilhihte bangbang un na lak ua mi tengteng ka pe ding hi.
"Himahleh, nou, Thiatira a om midangte hiai thuhilh nei lou a, 'Setan thil thukte' thei lou tengteng kiang ah tunggikna dang na tung uah ka hon behlap kei ding, ka chi hi.
Himahleh ka hong mateng na neih pen uh lenkip un.
Huan avualzoupa leh atawp pha a ka nnate kempa kiang ah, namte tung a thuneihna ka pe ding hi;
ama'n sikchiang in amau tung ah vai ahawm ding a, leibel bang in amaute akhentam ding hi, hiai thuneihna ka Pa a pan ka muh ahi.
Huan amah zingsol aksi ka pe ding hi.
Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in.
Huan angel khat van a kipan a hong paikhesuk, akhut a kokhuk taw nei lou honna chabi leh khainiang lianpi tawi ka mu hi.
Ama'n dragon, gulpi tek, diabol leh Setan aman a, kum sangkhat sung a ding in amah ahen hi.
Kum sangkhat achin ma a namte akhem nawnlouhna ding in amah kokhuk taw nei lou ah paihlut in a-om a, akhakkhum a, amah akilhkhum hi; tunung in sawt lou kal amah khah nawn a om ding ahi.

Huan laltutphahte leh atung a tute ka mu a, amaute kiang ah vaihawmna piak in a-om hi; Jesu thu theihsakna ziak leh Pathian thu ziak a angawng uh sattan a omte kha ka mu a, huaite gamsa leh alim beloute, atal ua leh akhut ua achiamtehna neiloute ahi ua; amaute ahong hing ua, Khrist toh kum sangkhat vai ahawm uhi.
Hiai pen thohnawnna masapen ahi. Misi dangte bel kum sangkhat abei mateng ahingkik kei uhi.

Thohnawnna masapen a pangte ahampha un asiangthou uhi; amaute tung a sih nihna in hihtheih aneih louh ziak in; himahleh amau Pathian leh Khrist siampute ahong hi ding ua, kum sangkhat sung amah toh vai ahawm ding uhi.
Huan kum sangkhat abei chiang in, atanna suangkul a kipan Setan khahkhiak in a-om dia,
leitung kil li a om namte, Gog leh Magog khem a amau kidouna mun a pikhawm ding in amah ahong paikhe pah dia; atamdan uh tuipi piaunel bang ahi uhi.
Huan amau leitung vailam khaksuak in apaitou ua, misiangthoute giahphual leh khopi it, akimvel in a-um uhi. Huan van a kipan in mei ahong kesuk a, amaute akangtum vek hi.
Huan amaute khempa diabol gamsa leh zawlnei taklou omna, mei leh kaat dil ah paihlut in a-om uhi; tangtawn tangtawn in sun leh zan in hihnat in a-omta ding uhi.
Huan laltutphah ngou thupi leh atung a tu ka mu a; amai a kipan lei leh van ataimang a, amaute a ding in mun himhim a-om kei hi.

Misite, aneu leh alian, huai laltutphah ma a dinghte ka mu a; laibute akihong a; laibu dang, hinna laibu leng akihong a; misite huai laibute a thil kigelhte a kipan in athilhih bang ua vai hawmsak in a-om uhi.
Tuipi in asung a om misite ahon pawtsak a; sihna leh misikhua in asung ua misi omte ahon pawtsak ua; mi chiteng athilhih bangbang ua vai hawmsak in a-om uhi.
Sihna leh misikhua meidil ah paihlut in a-om uhi. Hiai meidil pen sih nihna ahi.
Kuapeuh hinna laibu a kigelh amuh louh uh, meidil ah paihlut in a-om uhi.
Huan van masapen leh lei masapen abei tak ziak un van thak leh lei thak ka mu a; tuipi leng a-om nawnta kei hi.
Khopi siangthou, Jerusalem thak, mou apasal a ding a kizem bang a bawlzohsa a om, Pathian a kipan van ahong paikhesuk ka mu hi.

Huan laltutphah a kipan aw thupitak ka zak in, "Ngai in, mihingte lak ah Pathian biakbuk a-om a, amau lak ah ateng dia amau amite ahi ding ua, Pathian mahmah in amaute a-ompih dia, a Pathian uh ahi ding hi.
Huan amit ua kipan in khitui tengteng anulhul dia; sihna a-om nawn kei dia; lusuun leh kah leh natna himhim leng a-om nawn kei ding hi,” achi hi.
Huan laltutphah tung a tupa'n, "Ngai in, thil tengteng ka siam thakta," achi hi. "Gelh in, hiai thute amuanhuai in adik uhi,” achi hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Sep zoh ahita. Kei Alpha leh Omega, abul leh atawp ka hi. Dangtakte kiang ah aman bei in hinna tuikhuk a tui amau ka pe ding hi.
Kuapeuh avualzoupa'n hiai thilte aluah ding; a Pathian ka hi dia, amah ka tapa ahi ding hi.
Himahleh dawilokte leh gingtaloute leh kihhuaite leh tualthatte leh mingaihhatte leh bumhatte leh milim bete leh zuautheite tengteng tan tuh dil, mei leh kaat a kang, sih nihna ahi," achi hi.
Huan angel sagih belhbu sagih leh gawtna sagih nanungpen tawite lak a khat ahong pai a; kei ahon houpih a, "Hiai ah hong pai in, mou, Belamnou zi ka hon ensak ding," achi hi.
Ama'n Kha in tang lian leh sangpi ah ahon pomang a, huchi in khopi siangthou Jerusalem, Pathian a kipan a van a hong paikhesuk ahon ensak a,
Pathian thupina anei a; avakna suangmantam pen, jasper suang, kristal bang in asiang hi.
Kulhbaang thupi leh sangpi anei a; kong sawm-le-nih anei a, huai kongte ah angel sawm-le-nih a-om ua; huai kongtungte ah Israel suan nam sawm-le-nihte min akigelh hi:
asuahlam ah kongpi thum a-om a; amallam ah kongpi thum, asimlam ah kongpi thum; atumlam ah kongpi thum a-om hi.
Huan khopi kulhbaang in nuaiphah sawm-le-nih anei a, huaite tung ah Belamnou sawltak sawm-le-nihte minte atuang hi.
Huan kei hon houpihpa'n khopi leh kongpite leh kulhbaangte tehna ding in tehna dangka-eng sialluang atawi hi.
Huai khua in ning li anei a, adunglam availam chiachia in alian a; asialluang in khopi ateh a, lou chiing singkhat-le-sangnih ahi a, dunglam leh vailam leh asanlam akikim uhi.
Huan angel in huai kulhbaang mihing tehna dan in ateh a, tong za-le-sawmli-le-li a sah ahi.
Huan akhopi kulhbaang jasper suang a kibawl ahi a; huan akhopi dangka-eng siang, limlang siang bang ahi.
Huai khopi kulhbaang suang-phum suangmantam chiteng a zep ahi. Asuangphum khatna jasper suang ahi a; anihna sapphir suang, athumna kalsedoni suang; alina emerald suang;

angana sardonik suang; agukna sardi suang; asagihna kristolait suang; agiatna beril suang; akuana topaz suang; asawmna krisopras suang; asawm-le-khatna zasinth suang; asawm-le-nihna amethis suang ahi uhi.
Huan kongpi sawm-le-nihte tuikepsuang sawm-le-nihte ahi ua; akongpite tuikepsuang khat chiat a bawl ahi a; khopi kholak dangka-eng siang ahi a, limlang muh paisuak theih bang ahi.
Toupa Pathian Bangkim hihthei leh Belamnou atempul ahih ziak in, huai khopi ah tempul ka mu kei hi.
Huan atung a tanvak ding in huai khopi in ni hiam, kha hiam leng apoimoh kei a, Pathian thupina in atanvak a, Belamnou ameivak uh ahi.
Huai vak ah hotdam namte akhosa ding ua; leitung kumpipate athupina uh toh ahong lut ding uhi.
Bangchi mah in huai kongpite sun a khak in a-om kei ding hi, huai lai a zan a-om louh ding ziak in.
Huai mun ah namte thupina leh zahtakhuaina laklut ahi ding hi.
Bangchi mah in huai ah thilnin hiam, ahihkeileh kihhuai leh zuaubawl himhim leng alut kei ding a; himahleh Belamnou hinna laibu a min gelhte kia alut ding uhi.
Huan hinna tui siang luanna lui ahon ensak a, huai lui bel kristal bang a siang, Pathian leh Belamnou laltutphah a pan hong luangkhia ahi.
Huai a kongzing lai, alui lang tuaktuak ah hinna singgah chi sawm-le-nih nei, kha teng a gah a-om a; huai singnahte namte hihdamna ding ahi.
Huan hamsia himhim a-om nawnta kei dia; huai ah Pathian leh Belamnou laltutphah a-omta ding hi; asikhate'n a-nna asem ding uhi.
Amaute'n amel amu ding ua; atal uah ama min a-om ding hi.
Huan zan himhim a-om nawn kei dia; khawnvak vak leh nisa vak hiam leng apoimoh nawn kei ding uh; Toupa Pathian in amau vakna apiak ding ziak in; amau tangtawn tangtawn in vai ahawmta ding uhi.
Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, hiai thute amuanhuai un adik uhi; Toupa zawlnei siangthoute Pathian in thil hong om pah mahmah dingte asikhate kiang ah musak ding in a-angel asawl hi.
"Ngai in, Ka hong pai pah ding. Hiai laibu a genkholhna thute zui peuhmah ahampha hi," achi hi.
Huan kei Johan, hiai thilte zapa leh mupa ka hi. Huchi a ka zak leh ka muhtak in, hiai thilte hon musakpa angel khebul ah be ding in ka puk hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hon be kei hial in, hiai laibu thute kem, na unau zawlneite leh nang sikha hihpih ka hi; Pathian be zaw in," achi hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai laibu a genkholhnate bilhkhum ke'n, ahun anai tak ziak in.
Kuapeuh midiklou in diklouhna hih nalai henla, kuapeuh minin, nin nalai hen; kuapeuh midiktat, diktat nalai henla; kuapeuh Mi Siangthou, siangthou nalai hen," achi hi.
"Ngai in, ka hong pai pah ding hi; michih athilhih bang zel ua piak ding in ka kiang ah ka kipahman a-om hi.
Kei Alpha leh Omega, amasapen leh ananungpen, abul leh atawp ka hi."
Hinna sing ahon zottheihna ding uleh, khopi kongpi a aluttheihna ding ua apuan uh sawpsiangte ahampha uhi.
Apolam ah uite, bumhatte, mingaihhatte, tualthatte, milim bete leh kuapeuh zuauthu deih a, zuauthu bawlte a-om uhi.
"Kei, Jesu in saptuamte a ding a hiai thilte na kiang ua hon theisak ding in ka angel ka hon sawl hi. David zung leh asuan zingsol aksi vak ka hi," achi hi.
Kha leh Mou in, "Hong pai in," achi uhi. Aza peuh in, "Hong pai in," chi hen. Kuapeuh a-ut in hinna tui aman bei in dawn hen.
Hiai laibu a genkholhna thute za peuh kiang ah ka theisak hi: Mi kuapeuh in hiai thute abehlapleh Pathian in ama tung ah hiai laibu a kigelh gawtnate abehlap ding hi;
huan kuapeuh in hiai genkholhna laibu a thute lakmang aneihleh Pathian in atan ding hiai laibu a kigelh, hinna sing leh khopi siangthou a kipan alamang ding hi.
Hiai thilte theisakpa'n, "Ahi, ka hong pai pah ding hi,” achi hi. Amen! Hong pai in, Toupa Jesu.
Toupa Jesu hehpihna noute tengteng tung ah om hen, Amen.
"Huan Sardis a saptuamte angel kiang an hichibang in gelh in: Pathian Kha sagih leh aksi sagih neipa'n hiai thilte agen hi. "Na thilhihte ka thei, si napi in hingmin na pu hi.
Kiveng in, thil omsunte, si dia kisate, tungding nawn in; ka Pathian ma ah na thilhih zohsa set theih ka mu kei hi.
Huaiziak in na muhdan leh na zakdan theigige in; kem inla, kisik in. Huchi a na kiven keileh guta bang in ka hong pai dia, bangchik hun in ahia nang ka hong phawn ding chih na thei kei hi.
Himahleh Sardis ah min tawmchik apuante uh hihnit louh na nei hi; amaute puanngou silh a kei toh tonkhawm ding a kilawm him ahi uhi.
Avualzoupa huchibang in puanngou in akizem dia, bangchi mah in hinna laibu a kipat amin ka hihmang kei ding, ka Pa ma leh a-angelte ma ah amin ka gum ding hi.
"Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi, chi in.

"Philadelphia a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Huai siangthoupa, dikpa leh David chabi neipa, amah hon kuamah in akhak theih louh leh amah khak kuamah in ahon theih louhpa'n hiai thilte agen hi.
"Na thilhihte ka thei, ngai in, na ma ah kuamah khak theih louh kong honsa ka koih hi; thilhihtheihna neuchik na nei a, ka thu na kem a, ka min na pai kei hi.
Ngai in, zuau lel gen a Judate hilou napi, ahi a kigen Setan sinagogte ka hon pia hi; ngai in, amau ka hon paisak dia, na khebul ah ka kunsak ding; nang ka hon itdan atheihna ding un.
Ka dohzohna thu na kep ziak in, ze-et a na om chiang in ke'n leng ka hon kem ding, huai hun khovel pumpi tung a hong tung ding ahi; leitung a om tengteng leng ze-et ding in.
Ka hong pai pah ding. Kuamah in na lallukhu alaklouhna ding in, na neih pen kem kinken in.

Avualzoupa ka tempul ah khuam in ka pangsak dia, huai a kipan in apaikhe nawn kei ding, amah tung ah ka Pathian min leh ka Pathian khopi Jerusalem thak, ka Pathian a kipan van a hong paikhesuk min leh keimah min thak ka gelh ding hi.
"Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in.
"Huan Laodisia a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Theihpihpa ginom leh dik, Pathian thilsiam bul Amen in hiai thilte agen hi.
"Na thilhihte ka thei, lum lah lum lou, vot lah vot lou in na om a; na lumleh lum inla na votleh vot vanglak in!
Lum lah lum lou, vot lah vot lou a na om pelhpulh ziak in, ka kam a kipan in ka hon sekhe ding hi.
Migenthei nuamsa lou, zawng, mitdel leh vuaktang na hih lam kithei lou a, 'ka hausa, hauhsaknate ka neita, bangmah ka kitasam kei,' na chih ziak in.

Kei a kipan in dangka-eng mei a hihsiangthousa lei ding in ka hon thuhilh ahi, na hong hauhsak theihna ding in; puanngoute na hon silh a, na vuaktang zumhuaina adawklouhna ding in; huan na muhtheihna ding in na mit a nuh ding mitlou lei in.
Ka itte ka thuhilh in ka sawi a; huaiziak in phatuamngai inla, kisik in.
Ngai in kongkhak a dingh in ka kiu hi; mi kuapeuh in ka aw azak a kong ahonleh akiang ah ka lut dia amah toh nitak an ka ne dia, ama'n leng kei toh ane ding hi.
Avualzoupa ka laltutphah tung ah ka kiang ah ka tusak ding, kei leng ka vualzou a, laltutphah tung a ka Pa toh ka tut bang in.
"Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in achi hi.

Hiai thilte nung a ka etleh, ngai in, van ah kongkhak akihong a; ka aw zak masakpen pengkul aw ging bang in kei ahon houpih hi, "Hiai ah hong paitou in, huan tunung chiang a thil hong om dingte ka hon musak ding," achi hi.
Thakhat in Kha in ka om pah ngal a; ngai in, van ah laltutphah ahong kitungta a, laltutphah tung ah mi khat atu hi.
Huai mi jasper leh karnelia suang bang in akimu a; huai laltutphah kimvel ah sakhituihup, emerald suang bang mai a kimu in azam hi.
Huan huai laltutphah kimvel ah laltutphah dang sawmnih-le-li a-om a; huai laltutphahte tung ah upa sawmnih-le-li, puanngou a kizem a tu ka mu a, amaute'n dangka-eng lallukhu akhu chiat uhi.
Huai laltutphah a kipan in khophiate, awte leh vanpigingte ahong suakkhia hi. Huan mei khawnvak sagih, laltutphah ma ah akuang a, huaite Pathian Kha sagihte ahi uhi.
Huai laltutphah ma ah kristal bang a siang limlang tuipi a-om hi. Huai laltutphah kimvel ah thil hing nunglam leh malam mit a dim a-om uhi.
Thil hing khatna humpinelkai bang ahi a, thil hing nihna bawngnou bang ahi a, thil hing thumna in mihing mai bang anei hi, thil hing lina muvanlai leng lai bang ahi.

Huai thil hing lite'n kha guk anei chiat ua, akimvel leh asunglam mit ngen a dim ahi a; amaute'n sun leh zan khawl lou in: "Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou, Toupa Pathian, Bangkim hihthei, omsa leh omlel leh hong om ding," achi uhi.
Huan huai amah laltutphah tung a tupa leh huai amah tangtawn tangtawn a hingpa kiang a thil hingte'n, thupina leh zahhuaina leh kipahna thu apiak chiang un,
amah laltutphah tung a tupa ma ah upa sawmnih-le-lite abokkhup uhi, huai laltutphah ma a alallukhute uh koih in, amah tangtawn tangtawn a hingpa abia uhi.
"Nang ka Toupa leh ka Pathian uh, thupina, zahhuaina, thilhihtheihna mu tak na hi; thil tengteng nang na siam a, nang thu ziak a om leh siam ahi uhi," achi uhi.
Huai laltutphah tung a tupa khut taklam ah laibuzial, asunglam leh apolam kigelh chiamtehna sagih a kichiamteh ka mu hi.
Angel hat khat in aw ngaihtak in, "Kua ahia laibuzial hong a, huai a chiamtehnate phel tham?" chi a puangkhia ka mu hi.
Huan van tung hi in, leitung hiam, ahihkeileh lei nuai ah leng huai laibuzial hong thei hiam, ahihkeileh atung en thei kuamah a-om kei hi.
Huchi in huai laibuzial hong a sim tak hiam, ahihkeileh atung en tak kuamah a-om louh ziak in ka kapkap hi.
Huan upate lak a khat in ka kiang ah, "Kap ke'nla ngai in, humpinelkai, Judah nam a, David Zung in, laibuzial hong thei ding leh huai a chiamtehna sagihte phel thei ding in avualzouta," achi hi.

Huan huai laltutphah leh huai thil hing lite leh huai upate lai ah thahsa hileh kilawm, Belamnou, kii sagih leh mit sagih nei dingh ka mu a, huai mit sagihte Pathian kha sagih leitung tengteng a sawlkhiakte ahi uhi.
Amah ahong pai a, laltutphah tung a tupa khut taklam a kipan laibuzial ala hi.

Huai laibuzial alaktak in, thil hing lite leh upa sawmnih-le-lite, gosem khat chiat leh dangka-eng belhbute gimnamtui a dim chiat tawi in, Belamnou ma ah abokkhup ua, huaite gimnamtui misiangthoute thumna ahi.

Huan la thak khat asa uhi: "Laibuzial la a, huai a chiamtehnate phel tham na hi; thah in na omta a, chi chih leh pau chih leh michih leh nam chih a mite Pathian a ding a na sisan a na lei tak ziak in.
Ka Pathian kiang uah amau lalgam leh siampute hi ding in na bawl a; amaute'n leitung ah vai ahawm ding uh," chi in.
Huan ka etleh, laltutphah leh thil hingte leh upate kimvel ah, angel tampi aw ka za hi. Atamdan uh singkhat mun singkhat leh asang mun sang tampi ahi uh;
Amau aw ngaihtak in: "Thah a om, Belamnou in hatnate, leh hauhsaknate, leh thilhihtheihnate, leh zahtakhuainate, leh thupinate, leh vualzawlnate mu tham na hi,' chi in akikou uhi.

Huan thilsiam khempeuh van a omte, leitung a omte, lei nuai a omte, tuipi tung a omte leh amau a thil omte tengteng in, "Laltutphah tung a tupa leh Belamnou kiang ah; Vualzawlnate, zahtakhuainate, thupinate leh vaihawmnate, tangtawn tangtawn in om hen," achih uh ka za hi.
Huan thil hing lite'n, "Amen!" achi ua, huan upate abokkhup ua, abia uhi.
Belamnou in chiamtehna sagihte lak a khat aphel lai ka mu a, thil hing lite lak a khat aw in, vanpiging bang mai in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi.
Huan ka etleh ngai in, sakol kang leh atung a tupa thalpeu tawi ka mu a; amah kiang ah lallukhu piak in a-om a; amah vualzou a vualzou zou zel ding in ahong paikhia hi.
Huan chiamtehna nihna aphel lai in, thil hing nihna in, "Hong pai in,” achih ka za hi.
Sakol dang asan khat ahong paikhia a; huai tung a tupa kiang ah leitung a kipan lemna lakhe ding a thupiak ahi a, huchi a amau akithahtuahna ding un; amah kiang a namsau thupi piak ahita hi.
Huan chiamtehna thumna aphel lai in thil hing thumna in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi. Ka etleh ngai in, sakol vom ka mu hi; atung a tupa'n akhut in bukna atawi hi.
Huan thil hing lite lai ah aw hileh kilawm in, "Huit buh tehna dan khat dinari khat, huan barli buh tehna dan thum in dinari khat, huan thau leh uain zaw hihse ke'n," achih ka za hi.
Chiamtehna lina aphel lai in, thil hing lina aw in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi.

Ka etleh ngai in, sakol daang ka mu hi; atung a tupa min Sihna ahi a, Misikhua toh akizui uhi. Namsau, kial leh sihna leh leitung a gam sahangte thah ding in amau kiang ah leitung seh li suah seh khat tung a thuneihna piak ahita hi.
Chiamtehna ngana aphel lai in, Pathian thu ziak leh azuih uh theihsakna ziak a amau thah a omte maitam nuai ah ka mu hi.
Amaute aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Toupa Tungnungpen aw, siangthou leh dik bang tan ka sisan man uh amau leitung a tengte tung a thuk lou leh vaihawm lou ding na hia?" achi uhi.
Amaute kiang ah puanngou thupi piak in a-om chiat ua; amau asikha hihpihte uleh a-unaute uh amau bang a thah a om dingte akim mateng uh na khawl tadih un chi a hilh in a-om uhi.
Chiamtehna gukna aphel lai ka mu a, zinling thupitak a-om hi. Nisa tuh samul sai-ip puan bang in ahong vom a, kha leng apum in sisan bang in asan hi.
Van aksite theipi kung huihpi in amutling a, ahutte apulh bang in leitung ah apulh uhi.
Van laibuzial bang a kizial zou in suanmang in a-omta; tang sangte leh tuikulh gam teng amun ua pat suanmang in a-omta uhi.
Huchi in leitung kumpipate, miliante, heutute leh ahat leh ahaute, salte leh sal lou teng leng tang sangte leh suangpi heng leh kokhukte ah akisel uhi.
Tang sangte kiang leh suangpite kiang ah, "Hon delhlum unla, amah laltutphah tung a tupa leh Belamnou thangpaihna mai a kipan hon sel un;
athangpaihna ni thupi hong tung hi; kua adingh zou dia?” achi uhi.
Hiai thilte zoh in angel li, lei kil li a dinghte'n leitung a huih lite leitung a nung lou ding leh tuipi tung hiam, ahihkeileh sing tung hiam a nung lou ding in akhawlsak uhi.
Huan amau chiamtehna a pan angel dang kuantou ka mu hi, Pathian hing chiamtehna anei ua; ama'n huai angel lite leitung leh tuipi hihse ding a piak a omte kiang ah aw ngaihtak a kikou in.
"Pathian sikhate atal ua i chiamteh zoh ma in leitung leh tuipi leh singte hihse kei un," achi hi.
Huai chiamteh a omte lak a tampi, nuaikhat singli-le-sangli, Israel suan chiteng a kipan chiamteh zah ka za hi.
Judah chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih chiamteh in a-om ua. Reuben chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Gad chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
Asher chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Naphtali chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Manasseh chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
Simeon chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Levi chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Issakar chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
Zebulun chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih, Joseph chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih, Benjamin chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih.

Hiai thil teng zoh in ka etleh ngai in, mipi tampi kuamah sim seng louh, nam chih leh chi chih leh mi tengteng leh pau tengteng a kipan laltutphah leh Belamnou ma a dingh a, puanngou thupi a kizem a tumnah tawi ka mu a,
huan amau aw ngaihtak in, "Laltutphah a tu i Pathian leh Belamnou kiang ah hotdamna," chi in akikou uhi.
Angel tengteng laltutphah leh upate leh thil hing lite kimvel in adingh ua; laltutphah ma a bokkhup in, Pathian abia uhi:
"Amen! Vualzawlnate, leh thupinate, leh pilnate, leh zahtakhuainate, leh thilhihtheihnate, leh hatnate, tangtawn tangtawn in i Pathian kiang ah om hen,” achi uhi.
Huan upate lak a khat in ka kiang ah, "Hiai puanngou thupi a kizemte kuate ahi ua, koi a kipan a hong pai ahi ua?” chi in ahon houpih a,
ke'n akiang ah, "Ka Toupa, nang na thei hi," ka chi hi. Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai mite gimthuakna thupi a kipan hong paite ahi ua, apuan thupi uh sawp in, Belamnou sisan in ahihngou uhi."
"Huaiziak in Pathian laltutphah ma ah a-om ua, sun leh zan in atempul uah amah asepsak uhi; amah laltutphah tung a tupa'n amau tung ah apuanin azak ding hi.
Agil uh kial nawn ke'n chin, adang uh tak nawn himhim ke'n teh, amau ni in kang ke'n chin, satna in leng ahihgim kei ding hi.
Belamnou huai laltutphah lak a om abelamchingpa uh ahih ding ziak in, amau hinna tuikhuk ah api ding a; Pathian in amit ua kipan khitui anulhul ding," achi hi.
Chiamtehna sagihna aphel lai in dakkal kimkhat sung van adai sipsip hi.
Huchi in Pathian ma a angel sagih dinghte ka mu a, amaute kiang ah pengkul sagih piak in a-om hi.

Huan angel dang khat ahong pai a, gimnamtui halna dangka-eng bel tawi in, maitam kiang ah adingh hi, akiang ah gimnamtui tampi laltutphah ma a om dangka-eng maitam teng a misiangthou tengteng thumna toh hel ding in, piak in a-om hi.
Huai gimnamtui khu leh misiangthoute thumna angel khut a kipan Pathian ma ah azamtou hi.
Angel in gimnamtui halna dangka-eng bel ala a; huai maitam amei in ahihdim a, leitung ah apaikhia a; huan awgingte, van-gingte leh khophiate leh zinlingte ahong om hi.
Huan angel sagih pengkul sagih tawite mut ding in ahong kisa uhi.

Angel masapen in amut a, sisan toh kihel gial leh mei ahong om hi, huaite leitung a paihkhiak in a-om ua; leitung mun thum a khen mun khat akangbei hi, huan sing mun thum a khen mun khat akangbei a; loupa hing tengteng akangbei hi.
Huan angel nihna in amut a, tang lianpi mei a kang bang a kang hileh kilawm tuipi ah paihkhiak in ahong om a; tuipi mun thum a khen mun khat sisan asuak hi.
Huai tuipi a thil hingte hinna neite mun thum a khen mun khat asi ua; long mun thum a khen mun khat hihsiat in a-om hi.
Huan angel thumna in amut a, van a kipan in aksi lianpi, meisel bang a kuang ahong kesuk a, lui mun thum a khen mun khat leh tui tuikhukte tung adeng hi.
Huai aksi min Gamsai ahi; tui mun thum a khen mun khat gamsai asuak hi; tuite hihkhaat a a-om ziak un mi tampi asi uhi.

Huan angel lina in amut a, huan ni mun thum a khen mun khat leh kha mun thum a khen mun khat leh aksi mun thum a khen mun khat hihsiat ahong hi a; huchi in avaknate uh mun thum a khen mun khat hihmial in a-om a; sun hun seh thum suah seh khat leh zan hun seh thum suah seh khat beisak in a-om hi.

Huan ka etleh, angel khat van laizawl a leng in aw ngaihtak in, "Tunggik, tunggik, angel thum pengkul mut lai dingte leh huai ging hong om lai dingte ziak in leitung a omte tung agik," achih ka za hi.
Angel ngana in amut a, van a kipan leitung a aksi kia ka mu a; amah kiang ah kokhuk taw nei lou honna chabi piak in a-om hi.
Ama'n kokhuk taw nei lou ahong a; huai kokhuk a kipan in meikhu, meipi khu bang mai ahong pawttou a, huai kokhuk a meikhu ziak in ni leh huihkhua hihmial in a-omta hi.
Huan meikhu a kipan in leitung ah khaupete ahong suak ua; aikamte'n thilhihtheihna aneih bang un amau thilhihtheihna piak in a-om uhi.
Amau leitung a loupate, thil hing himhimte leh sing peuhmahte, hihse lou a, mi kuapeuh atal ua Pathian chiamtehna neiloute kia hihse dia hilh in a-om uhi.
Amau that lou ding a, kha nga sung amau hihgenthei zaw ding a hilh in a-om ua; huai a hihgentheihna tuh aikam in mi kuahiam ateh a ahihgentheih bang ahi.
Huai ni chiang in mi'n sihna azong ding ua, bangchi mah in amu kei ding uh; sih a-ut ding ua, himahleh sihna in amau ataimangsan ding hi.
Huan khaupete kilatdan sakol kidouna a pang dia bawl bang ahi ua; alutung uah dangka-eng lallukhu hileh kilawm a-om a, amai uh mihingte mai bang ahi.
Numei sam bang sam anei ua, aha uh humpinelkai ha bang ahi.
A-awm uah sik awmphawte bang anei ua; akhazap ging uh kidouna lam a sakol tampi tai dupdup, kidouna kangtalai tampi ging bang ahi.
Huan aikam bang in meigu nei anei ua, mihingte kha nga sung hihnatna ding in amei uah thilhihtheihna anei uhi.
Amaute'n kokhuk taw nei lou neitu angel atung ua kumpipa in anei uhi; ama min Hebru pau in Abaddon ahi a, Grik pau in Appolion ahi.
Tunggikna masapen abeita a, ngai in, tunggikna nih tunung chiang in ahong tung lai ding hi.
Huan angel gukna in amut a, Pathian ma a om dangka-eng maitam kii a kipan in aw ka za a;
huai aw in angel gukna pengkul nei kiang ah, "Euphrates luipi lianpi a angel li hen a omte phel in," achi hi.
Huan mi mun thum a khen mun khat athahtheihna ding ua dak khat, ni khat, kha khat leh kum khat sung kisa a na om, angel lite phel in a-om uhi.
Huan sakol tungtuang sepaih atamdan uh sing ngen mun singnih ahi chi a atamdan uh kigen ka za hi.

Huchibang in kilakna in sakolte leh atung ua tuangte, mei bang a san, engdup leh kaat bang a eng, awmphaw neite ka mu hi; sakolte lu humpinelkai lu bang ahi ua; akam ua kipan in mei leh meikhu leh kaat asuakkhia hi.
Huan akamsung ua kipan a hong pawtkhia huai hipi thum, mei, meikhu leh kaat in mihing mun thum a khen mun khat thah in a-om uhi.
Huai sakolte thilhihtheihna akam uh leh amei ua om ahi a; amei uh gulpi mei toh akibang ua, lu leng anei ua, huaite in mi ahih na uhi.

Huan midang huai gawtna a siloute akhut ua sepkhiakte ah akisik tuan kei ua; dawite, dangka-engte, milimte, dangka milimte, suang milimte leh sing milimte; mu theiloute, za thei lou leh tang theiloute be nawn lou ding in akisik tuan kei uhi.
Huan atualthahna uh, ami bumna uh leh akingaihna khelhna uh leh aguktakna uh akisik tuan kei uhi.
Paul, Jesu Khrist sikha, sawltak hi ding a sap, Pathian tanchinhoih lam a khenkhiak,
Pathian in tuma lam a Laisiangthou a azawlneite a achiamsa,
atapa, salam a David suan a piang tungtang thu,
amah Pathian Tapa hihna bel misi lak a kipan thilhihtheihna toh athohnawnna ziak a sianthouna Kha in Jesu Khrist, Toupa chi a apuankhiak ahi.
Amin ziak a ginna nam chih lak a mi gingtasak ding in, amah ziak in hehpihna leh sawltak hihna i tangta hi;
huai lak ah nou leng Jesu Khrist sapte na hi uh;
Rome khua Pathian deihtak, misiangthou a om ding a sapte tengteng kiang ah, Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Amasa in khovel tengteng ah na ginna uh athan ziak in na vek ua tung ah ka kipahthu Jesu Khrist ziak in ka Pathian kiang ah ka gen hi.
Ka thumnate ah tawp lou in na min uh ka lou nilouh ahi, chih kei hon theihpihpa Pathian ahi a, amah ahi a Tapa tanchinhoih gen a ka kha a, a-nna ka sep gige pa pen;
tu bek a na kiang ua ka hong theihna ding in Pathian thuthu a zin hun lemtang ka muh teitei theihna ding ka ngen hi.
Na kipna ding ua khalam thilpiak banghiam nou ka hon piaktheihna ding in nou hon muh ka ut thei mahmah ngal a;
huai na ginna uh leh ka ginna a i kikhamuantuah theihna ding un ka chihna ahi.

Unaute aw, Zentel dangte kiang a ka sepgim gah ka muhtak bangmah in, noumau lak ah leng gahte ka muhtheihna ding in na kiang uah tamveipi hong ka tumta chih na theih louh uh ka deih kei hi; himahleh tu tanpha dal in ka om nilouh hi.
Grik mite leh melmak mite kiang ah bat ka nei a; mipil leh mipilloute kiang ah leng.
Huchi in nou Rome a omte kiang ah leng tanchinhoih gen ka ut mahmah hi.
Tanchinhoih tuh ka zahpih kei a; kuapeuh agingta phot a ding in hotdamna ding a Pathian thilhihtheihna ahi ngal a; atung in Juda mi a ding in ahi a, huan Grik mi a ding in leng ahong hi nawn hi.
Huai ah tuh gin semsemna ding in ginna in Pathian diktatna latsak in a-om hi, "Midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding," chi a gelh ahih bang in.
Dik loutak a thutak dalte leh Pathian limsaklouhna leh diktatlouhna tengteng tung ah van a kipan in Pathian thangpaihna ahong kilangta hi.
Pathian in atheihsak tak ziak in Pathian tanchin theihtheih ding tuh alungsim uah chiangtak a theihsak in a-omta ngal a.
Khovel siam tung a kipan a pianken muh theih louh, atangtawn thilhihtheihna leh a Pathianna, thilsiamte ah chiantak a muh theih ahi; huaiziak in paulam ding anei kei uhi.
Pathian thei ngal in Pathian bang in apahtawi kei ua; kipahthu leng agen sam kei uh; himahleh thil thulim lou angaihtuah zaw ua, alungtang hai uh ahong mialta hi.
Pil kisa khem in mihai ahong suak ua,
asithei lou Pathian thupina sithei mihingte leh vasate, gamsate leh bokvak ganhingte lim asuaksak uhi.
Huaiziak in asa uh zumhuaipi a kibawltuah ding in alungtang uh duhgawlna bang a thilnin hihphal in Pathian in alehngatsan hi.
Pathian thutak tuh zuau tangsak in, abawlpa biak sang in abawl bia in a-nna asem uhi. Abawlpa tuh tangtawn a phat tuak ahi, Amen.
Huaiziak in Pathian in zumhuaipi a huk phal in lehlam angatsanta hi; anumeite nangawn un leng a-omdan pianpih uh dan lou bang a om ding in akibawl lamdang ua;
pasalte'n leng numei zatdan ngeina tawpsan in, huk in aki-enlahtuah ua, pasal leh pasal zummoh thilhih in a-om uh; agitlouh man muh ding uh asa tung ua mu in.
Huan Pathian theih a-ut louh ziak un, thil kilawmloute hih ding a adeih louh lam lungsim neih phal in Pathian in alehngatsanta hi.
Huchi in diktatlouhna, gitlouhna, huaihamna, huatna in adim ua; hazatna, tualthahna, kiselna, khemna, nundan hoih lou in adim ua;
gensiatnate, migennate, Pathian huat lamte, kisaktheihnate, kisathei mite, thil gilou bawlkhete,
nu leh pa thu mangloute, theihna beite, thuchiam susete, itna pianpih neiloute, hehpihna neiloute ahi uhi.
Huchibang hihte tuh si tak him ahi uh chih Pathian dan tuh theigige in, amau kia a hih leng hilou in, midang hih zelte tung ah leng akipak uhi.
Unaute aw, ka lungtang deihlam leh amau a dia Pathian kiang a ka thumna pen zaw, hotdam ahong hihtheihna ding uh ahi.
Pathian lam ah phatuam angai uh chih ka theihpih ahi, himahleh theihna ahihvak in zaw ahi kei uh.
Pathian diktatna thei lou in, amau diktatna lamkhiak atum ua, Pathian diktatna ah akipelut sam kei uhi.
Khrist bel agingta peuhmahte a ding in diktatna amuhtheihna ding un dan tawpna ahi.
Mosi in, "Dan a diktatna zui zaw, huai mi diktatna ziak in ahing ding," chi in agelh hi.
Ginna a diktatna in bel huchi in agen: "Na lungsim in, kua ahia van a kah ding? (huai lah 'tunglam a kipan Khrist va pisuk ding,' chihna ahi ngal a).
Ahihkeileh, kua ahia khukthuk a hohsuk ding? Huai lah 'misi lak a kipan Khrist pitou nawn ding,' chihna ahi, chi ke'n," chi in.
Ahihleh, bang ahia agen? "Thu in ahon naih hi, na kam leh na lungtang ah a-om," chi in agen ahi; (huai ahi ginna thu ka tangkoupih pen uh).
Na kam a Jesu, Toupa ahi chih na gup a, misi lak a kipan Pathian in akaithou chih na lungtang a na gintakleh hotdam in na om ding, chih.
Mi'n lungtang in agingta ua, diktatna amu uh; kam in agum ua, hotdamna leng amu nak uh ahi.
Laisiangthou in, "Kuapeuh amah gingta azahlak kei ding,” achi hi.
Juda leh Grik mite bangmah ah alamdang tuan kei ua, Toupa khat avek ua tung ah Toupa ahi a, amin lou peuhmahte tung ah hoihna ahau ngal a.
"Kuapeuh Toupa min lou tuh hotdam in a-om ding," chih ahi.
Ahihleh, agintak louhpi uh bangchi in alou ding ua? Athu azak louhpi uh bangchi in agingta ding ua? Thuhilhmi om lou in bangchi in aza ding ua?
Sawl ahih kei uleh bangchi in thu ahilh ding ua? "Thil hoih tanchin kipahhuai tunte khe kilawm hi na tel e!" chih gelh bang in.
Himahleh tanchinhoih azui vek kei uh. Isai in, "Toupa, ka thugen uh kua'n ahia gingta?" achih bang in.
Huchi in ginna tuh zakna ziak in ahong om a, zakna tuh Khrist thu kigen ziak in ahong om hi.
Ahihleh abil un aza kei ua hia? Za na ke, "Ahusa uh gam chih ah athang a, athu uh kawlmong pha in athangsuakta," chih ahi.
Ahihleh, Israel mite'n aza kei ua hia? "Mipi dia gen thamlouhte ka hon hazasak dia; nam pilloute zang in ka hon hehsak ding," chi in Mosi in agen masapen hi.
Huan Isai in hangsantak in, "Hon zongloute muh in ka omta; hon kanloute ka kimusakta," achi hi.
Himahleh Israel mite thu ah, "Michihmoh leh selhatte a ding in sun nilouh in ka ban ka zak hi,” achi hi.
Ahihleh Pathian in amite apaikhia a hia? Paikhe lou hial! Kei leng Israel mi, Abraham suan Benjamin nam ka hi ngal a.
Pathian in ami a theihkholhte apaikhe kei hi. Laisiangthou in Elijah thu agen na thei kei ua hia? Ama'n Israel mite tungthu Pathian kiang ah atun a,
"Toupa na zawlneite athat ua, na maitamte ahihchim ua; keimah kia nutsiat in ka om, kei leng hihlup ahon tum uhi," achih.
Himahleh Pathian in bangchi in adawng a? "Baal ma a khukdin ngeiloumi sangsagih keimah a ding in ka hawi hi,” chi in adawng hi.
Huchibang in tulai in leng akhosuaksun, hehpihna a tel a-om uhi.
Hehpihna ziak ahihleh, nasep ziak ahita kei, huchi hi keileh, hehpihna tuh hehpihna ahita kei ding.
Bangchi ahita dia le? Israel mite'n azon uh amu kei uh. Telte'n bel amu ua, adangte tengteng ananggawpta uhi.
"Pathian in tuni tan in akiang uah lusukna kha apia a, muh theihlouhna mitte, zak theihlouhna bilte toh," chih gelh bang in.
David in, "Adohkan uh amau a ding in thang leh pial, pukna leh phulakna hong hi hen;
Amuh theihlouhna ding un amitte uh hong mial hen, nang anungzang uh kunsak gige in," achi hi.
Ahihleh akisuih uh akipukdetna ding uhia? Hilou hial! Apuk ziak un Zentelte kiang ah hotdamna ahong tung zawta hi; Israel mite hazatsakna ding in.
Huchi in apukna uh bawn khovel hih hauhsakna ahih a, akiamna uh leng Zentelte hauhsakna ahihleh, abuchin nawnna uh bangchi phet a hamphatna lianzaw in azui diam aw!
Huchi in nou Zentelte kiang ah ka gen ahi. Kei Zentelte kiang a sawltak ka hih ziak in, ka nasepna pen ka pahtawi ahi.
Huchi a ka chipihte ka hazatsak theih teiteina ding leh alak ua khenkhatte ka hotdam theihna ding in.
Amau paihkhiakna bawn khovel toh kituah nawnna ahihleh, amau deih nawnna ding sihna a kipan hin nawnna lou ngal bang ahi dia?
Huan gah masa thillat, tangbuang mekthem asianthouleh huchi mah bang in abeupi asiangthou hi; azungpi asianthouleh ahiangte leng huchi mah bang ahi uhi.
Hiang khenkhatte hihtan a a-om in, nang, olive tak lou, amaute lak a phuhlut a na om a, olive sing a hauhna zung kikoppih sam na hihman in,
hiang dangte lak ah kisathei ke'n. Kisathei mah lechin nang azung vakpa na hi kei a, huai azung pen nang hon vakpa ahi zaw hi.
Huan nang, "Phuhlut a ka omtheihna ding in hiangte hihtan in a-om khinta vo oi," na chi dia.
Ahi agintaklouhna ziak un hihtan in a-om ua, nang na ginna ziak in na dingh ahi, uang ke'nla, lau zaw in.
Pathian in hiangtakte pen bawn ahawi kei ngalleh nang leng ahon hawi tuan kei ding hi.
Huchi in Pathian hoihna leh athukhauhna ngaihtuah in; apukte a ding a athukhauhna; nang a ding in bel ahoihna, hoihna a na om gigeleh; huchi ahihkeileh nang leng satkhiak in na om sam ding.
Huan amau leng gingta lou a a-om nilouh kei uleh, phuhlut in a-om nawn ding uh; Pathian in amaute aphutlut nawn thei hi.
Nang piandan a olive tak lou a kipan a satsup bawn, piandan lou bang a olive sing hoih a phuhlut a na omleh, tua ahiangtakte, amau olive sing ngei ah phuhlut hi na tel un chia!
Unaute aw, hiai thuguk na theih louh uh ka ut kei a, huchi lou in zaw na kipilsak ding uh; Zentelte buchinna ahong tun masiah Israel mi khenkhatte tung ah siatna ahong tung tadih hi.
Huchi in Israel mi tengteng hotdam in a-om ding uh: "Zion a kipan in Hondampa ahong suak ding a, Jakob kiang a kipan Pathian limsaklouhna ahihmang ding,"
"Akiang ua ka thukhun ding hiai ahi, akhelhnate uh ka lakmang chiang in," chih gelh bang in.
Tanchinhoih lam ngaihtuah in, nou ziak in melma ahi ua; tel thu lam ngaihtuah in bel apipute uh ziak in deihtakte ahi uhi.
Pathian in athilthawnpiak ah leh asapna ah alungsim akhel ngei kei hi.
Nidanglai in Pathian thu na gingta kei ua, himahleh tu in amau agin louh ziak un zahngaihna na mu ngal ua.
Huchi mah bang in tu in, Pathian in nou ahon hehpihna ziak a, zahngaihna amuhtheihna ding un amau leng ging lou ahita ve ua.
Pathian in azahngaih vek theihna ding in ginlouhna ah mi tengteng akhumvekta hi.
Pathian pilna leh theihna hauhdan thuk hi na tel e! Avaihawm-nate theihtheih vual leh alampite sui zoh vual hi kei na tel e!
"Toupa lungsim kua'n ahia thei? ahihkeileh kua ahia ama thuhilhmi?
Ahihkeileh adit nawn ding a leng akiang ah kua'n ahia thil pe masa?"
Amah a kipan leh amah ziak leh amah a ding a thil tengteng ahong om ahi ngal a; amah kiang ah tangtawn in thupina om hen. Amen.
Huchi in unaute aw, Pathian zahngaihna ziak in, kithoihna hing, siangthou leh Pathian lung tuak ding in na pumpi uh lan ding in ka hon ngen ahi; huai na biakna dan ding him uh ahi.
Hiai khovel dan bang in om kei unla; Pathian deihlam a hoih leh lungtuahhuaitak leh hoih bukim na theihtel theihna ding un, na lungsim uh athak a om in hong kikheng lamdang zawta un.

Na lak uah kuamah na kiletsak ding hun val ua kiliansak lou in, Pathian in michih kiang a ginna hun apiak bang zel a diktak a ngaihtuah zaw ding in Pathian in ahon piak hehpihna ziak in ka hon chi chiat ahi.
Pumpi khat ah hiang tampi i nei ua, hiang tengteng nasep bel akibang kei hi,
huchi mah bang in, eite tampi himah lehang Khrist ah pumpi khat i hi ua; atuamtuam in i kihiangtuah chiat uhi.
Hehpihna ahon piakdan bang zel in thilthawnpiak tuamtuam i nei chiat uhi; thugen ding ahihleh i ginna toh kihun in i gen ding uhi;
Nasepna ahihleh tua anasepna mah ah sem hen; sinsakmi'n asinsakna ah sinsak hen;
Hanthawn mi in ahanthawnna mah sem hen; thilpemi'n phaltak in pia hen; makaimi'n phatuamngaihna toh ma kai hen; zahngaihna nasemmi in kipaktak in sem hen.
Itna ahihleh lepchiahna tel lou in hi hen. Gilou hua unla, ahoih lam len tinten un.
Unaute itna lam ah ittak in kilainattuah chiat un; pahtawi lam ah, kideihsaktuah chiat un.
Thanop lam ah, thadah kei un; Kha a vakna toh phatuamngai in Toupa nna sem un.
Lametna ah kipak unla; gimthuakna ah kuhkal un; thumna ah thum teitei un;
Misiangthoute taksapna ah taksap awng hu unla; mikhualte kipahpih in om nilouh un.
Hon sawite vualzawl un, vualzawl unla, hamsiat kei un.
Kipakte kipahpih unla, kapte kahpih un.
Ngaihtuah kibang in om chiat un, kingaihtuah sang lo kei unla, mi neuneu kithuahpih zaw un. Kipilsak kei un.
Kua gitlouh leng gilou in thuk kei un. Mi tengteng muh in thil kilawm ngaihtuah un.
Ahihtheih liaileh noumau lam bek, mi tengteng toh kituak in om un.
Deihtakte aw, phu kila kei un, Pathian hehna awn zaw un, "Phulak himhim keimah lak ding ahi, ke'n ka thuk na ding, Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
Huaiziak in "Na melma agil akialleh nek ding pia inla; adang atakleh dawn ding pia in; huchibang a na hihleh alutung ah mei-am sekkhawm na hi ding hi."
Gitlouh zoh in om ke'nla, hoihna in gilou zou zaw in.
Michih atung ua vaihawm thuneite thuthu in om hen. Pathian thu lou in kuamah thunei a-om ngal kei ua; vaihawm thunei mite zaw Pathian seh ahi uh.
Huaiziak in kuapeuh vaihawmmi sel Pathian sehkalh ahi a, aselte'n amau tung ah vaihawmna akimuh ding uhi.
Vaihawmte thil hoih hihte ding in kihtakhuai ahi kei ua; thil hoih lou hihte a ding in bel kihtakhuai ahi uhi. Ahihleh vaihawmmi kihta lou a om na ut uhia? Thil hoih hih le uchin phat na loh ding uh.
Amah tuh na hoihna ding ua Pathian nasemmi ahi ngal a. Himahleh kihta un, namsau lah amawk tawi ngal kei a; amah Pathian nasemmi, thil hihkhialmi tung a heh a phulami ahi.
Huaiziak in Pathian hehna kihtakna ziak kia hilou in, na sia-le-pha theihna ziak lel ua leng na kituklut ding uh ahi.
Hiai ziak in siah leng na liau zel ve ua le; huchibang thil ngei hih teitei ding in Pathian nasem mite ahi uhi.
Mi tengteng kiang ah piak ding peuhmah pia un; leiman piakna ding kiang ah leiman pia unla, siah liauna dingpa kiang ah siah liau unla; kihtak dingpa leng kihta unla; zahtak dingpa leng zahtak un.
Ki-ittuahna lou ngal kuamah bangmah ba kei un; amau mihinpih itpa'n dan azuikimta hi.
Hiaite, "Ang kawm ke'n, Tualthat ke'n, Gu ke'n, Eng ke'n," chih leh thupiak dang om lai himhimte, "Nangmah na ki-it bang in na invengte na it ding ahi,” chih in akhaikhawm vek hi.
Itna in a-invengte ahihse ngei kei a; huaiziak in itna zaw dan zuihkimna ahi.
Huai lou in, tu bang hun ahia chih na thei ua, ihmu khanloh a hun mahmahta chih na thei uhi. Tu'n zaw i gintak tung lai sang in i hotdamna anai zawta ngal a.
Zan abei dekdekta a, khua avak dekta hi; huaiziak in mial a thilhihte paikhia in vak thuam in i kithuam ding uh.
Sun a om bang in kilawmtak in i om ding uh, zu dawn buai leh zu kham a om lou in, huk leh kingaihhat a om lou in, kilai leh kihaza a om lou in.
Toupa Jesu Khrist in kithuam zaw unla, na sa duhgawlna uh pichin ding in bangmah kibawl kei un.
Huan ginna hat lou mi, angaihdante gense lou in ngai un.
Mi khat in thil bangkim ne thei ding in akigingta a, mihat lou in bel anteh-louhing kia ane hi.
Ane mite'n nelou a kidekte simmoh kei henla; nelou a kidekte'n leng anete soisel tuan kei hen; Pathian in amah akipahpih khinta ngal a.
Midang sikha tung a soiselpa nang kua na hia? Apu a ding in ahi adin hiam ahihkeileh apuk. Himahleh amah zaw dinsak in a-om ding, Toupa'n adingsak thei hi.
Mi khat in ni khat nidang sang in athupi ngaih tuam a, midang in ni tengteng kibang chiat in angai. Michih amah lungsim ah kitheichian hen aw.

Ni tangpa'n Toupa pahtawina ding in atang hi. Huan bangkim nepa'n, Pathian kiang a kipahthu agen ziak in, Toupa pahtawina ding in ane a; aneloupa'n leng Toupa pahtawina ding in ane kei a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen hi.
Kuamah eimah a dia hing i hi kei ua, kuamah eimah a dia si leng i hi sam kei.
I hinleh Toupa a ding in i hing a; i sih in leng Toupa a dia si i hi ngal a; huaiziak in i hin in leng, i sih in leng Toupa a i hi uhi.
Khrist sihna leh ahin nawnna pen, mihing leh misi Toupa ahihtheihna ding ahi.
Himahleh nang bang achia na unau soisel na hia oi? Ahihkeileh nang bang achia na unau simmoh na hia oi? Pathian' thukhenna tutphah ma a dingh vek ding lah i hi ngal ua.
"Toupa'n, kei ka hin bang in, mi tengteng ka ma ah akun ding ua, lei tengteng leng Pathian kiang ah akipulak ding uh chi in ka chiam ahi," achi, chih gelh ahi.
Huchi in i vek un Pathian kiang ah eimah tanchin i gen chiat ding uhi.
Huaiziak in kisoisel nawn kei ni, kuapeuh in a-unau lampi ah kisuihna hiam dalna hiam koih louh tum zaw hen.
Amah mawngmawng a siang lou bangmah himhim a-om kei chih Toupa Jesu ah ka thei mahmah hi; thil khatpeuh siang lou a seh pen bel aseppa a ding in siang lou ahi mai hi.
Na banghiam nek ziak a na unau lungsim anatleh itna dan in na gamta kei' a ahi. Asih sik a Khrist in asihsakpa na thil nek in hihmang kei hen.
Huchi in nou a dia hoihna, gilou lam a gen in om kei hen.
Pathian lalgam nek-le-dawn thu hilou in Kha Siangthou a diktatna, kituahna leh kipahna ahi zaw hi.
Kuapeuh huai thu ah Khrist nasem Pathian kipahpih leh mihing phat in a-om hi.
Huchi in kituahna ding leh kihihhat tuahna ding thilte i delh ding uh.
Na thil nek ziak in Pathian nasep hihse ke'n. Thil tengteng asiangthou ngei a, himahleh banghiam anek in mi ahihpukleh anepa a ding in gilou ahi.
Na unau pukna ding ahihleh, sa neklouhte, uain dawnlouhte, thil bangpeuh hih louh ahoih ahi.
Ginna na neih Pathian ma ah nangmah kia theih in nei mai in. Ama hoihsak lam a siam louh kitan lou tuh mihampha ahi.
Himahleh ginglelpa'n anekleh, ginna a anek louh ziak in, siam louh atang hi; bangpeuh ginna lou a hih zaw khelhna ahi.
Huchi in ei ahatte'n, eimah kipahna zong lou in, ahatlouhnate hatlouhna i thuakpih ding uh ahi.
Eimah invengte chiat tunding leh ahoihna ding ua kipahsak i tum chiat ding uh.
Khrist in leng amah kipahna azong ngal kei a, "Nang hon taite taina ka tung ah atuta," chih gelh bang in ahi zaw.
Laisiangthou a kuhkalna leh khamuanna mu a lametna i neihtheihna ding un, nidanglai a gelh peuhmahte eite hon hilhna ding a gelh ahi uhi.
Tu in kuhkalna leh khamuanna Pathian in, Khrist Jesu ah noute lungsim leh ngaihtuahna mun khat pu in hon omsak hen;
Huchi a, lungsim mun khat leh kituaktak a Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pathian na pahtawi theihna ding uh ahi.
Huaiziak in Khrist in Pathian thupina ding a noute ahon kipahpih mah bang in, khat-le-khat kipahpihtuah chiat un.
Tu in, pipute kiang a thuchiamte hihkipna ding in Khrist tuh Pathian thutakdan theihsakna ding in zeksumte nasempa ahong hita chih na kiang uah ka gen hi.
Azahngaihna ziak a Zentelte'n Pathian apahtawi theihna ding un, "Huaiziak in Zentelte lak ah ka hon phat ding a, na min pahtawina ding in la ka sa ding," chih gelh bang in.
"Huan nou Zentel tengtengte aw, amite toh kipak un," achi nawn hi.
"Nou Zentel tengtengte aw, Toupa phat un, mi tengteng in amah phat uhen," achi nawn hi.
Isai in: "Jesse zungzam ahong khang ding a, Zentelte tung a vaihawm dingpa ahong dingkhe ding hi; amah ah Zentelte'n alametna uh akoih ding uhi," achi lai hi.
Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna ziak a lametna na hauhtheihna ding un, lametna Pathian, na gintak ziak un, kipahna leh kituahna chiteng in hon hihdim hen.
Huan ka unaute aw, nou tungthu zaw noumau mah hoihna in na dim ua, na kihanthawntuah thei uh chih keimah ngei in leng diktak in ka thei hi.
Himahleh Pathian in ahon piak hehpihna ziak in nou hon theihpih ding in koi kalkal hiam ah hangsantak in ka gelh hi.
Zentelte kiang a Khrist Jesu nasempa a ka omtheihna ding in, Zentelte Kha Siangthou a hihsiangthou ahih ua, pomtak ahihtheihna ding un Pathian tanchinhoih lam ah siampu nna ka sem ahi.
Huchi in Pathian nna ka sep lam thu ah Khrist Jesu ah kisaktheihna ding ka nei ahi.
Khrist in Zentelte thumangsak ding a ka thugen leh nasepnate zang a asepkhiakte lou ngal bangmah ka gen ngam ngal kei a,

chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte, thilhihtheihna ah, Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna in Jerusalem khua leh akim gam a kipan in, Illirikum gam pha in, Khrist tanchinhoih gam chih ah ka hilh kimta; keimah hon zang a athilhih tuh huchi tel ahi.
Ahi, midang suangphum tung a lem ka hihlouhna ding in, tanchinhoih Khrist min loh khitna mun a gen lou in.
"Atanchin gen ngeilouhnate'n amu ding ua, za ngei nailoute'n aza ding uh," chih gelh bang in, gen ka tum zaw ahi.
Huaiziak in ahi, na kiang ua hong ka kikhelsak naknak.
Tu in bel hiai gam kim ah sepna mun himhim ka neita kei a, kum tampi na kiang ua hong ut in leng ka omta hi.
Spain gam a ka hoh chiang in ka pai kawm a nou hon muh ka kilamen ngal a, noumau toh kithuahkhawm phot in, maban ka paina ding ah noute'n na hon va khaksuk uh leng ka lamen ahi.
Tu in bel, misiangthoute nasem ding in Jerusalem ah ka hoh tadih ding hi.
Masidonia leh Akhaia gam a mite'n kipaktak in Jerusalem a misiangthoute lak a gentheite a ding in thilpiakte ape chiat uhi.
Hiai thilpiak in amau nakpi in akipaksak hi; amaute ding in leng bat ahi him hi; Zentelte'n Judate khalam vualzawlna akikoppih ualeh salam thil a amaute taksap awng ahuksak sam uh akilawm him ahi.
Huaiziak in huai ka hih a, gah leng amaute diktak a ka muhsak nung in, noute hon tawn in, Spain gam ah ka pai zel ding hi.
Huan na kiang ua ka hong chiang in, Khrist tanchinhoih vualzawlna kim pu in ka hong ding chih ka thei hi.
Unaute aw, Pathian kiang a na hon thumsak na uah, hon thumpih teitei ding in Toupa Jesu Khrist leh Kha Siangthou itna in nget petmah in ka hon ngen ahi.
Juda gam a gingloute lak a ka bit theihna ding leh Jerusalem a dia huhna ka tawi misiangthoute kipahna lamtak ahihtheihna ding in.
Pathian hoihsak bang a nuamtak a na kiang ua ka hong a, i halhkhawm vek theihna ding un.
Lemna Pathian na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
I sanggamnu, Phoebi, Kenkriai a saptuamte nasem,

Toupa min a misiangthoute bang a na na kipahpihna ding uleh, na huh uh akiphatmohna peuh a na na huh ding un hon kimeltheihsak ka ut ahi. Amah mah in leng mi tampi ana huh a, kei ngei leng ahon huh zel hi.
Khrist Jesu a hon huhte Priscilla leh Akuila chibai hon buksak un,
ka hinna humbitna ding a amau ngawngtan ngapte; amau tung kia ah kipahthu ka gen kei a, Zentel saptuam tengteng tung ah leng ka gen sam hi.
A-inn ua saptuam kikhawmte leng chibai hon buksak un. Ka deihtak, Epanitas, Asia gam a Khrist gingta masapen, chibai hon buksak un aw.
Noute a dia semgim Mari, chibai hon buksak un aw.
Ka chipih leh ka hentakpih, Andronikas leh Junia, chibai hon buksak un; amau sawltakte lak a minthangtak ahi ua, kei sang a Khrist a om masazaw ahi uh.
Amplias, Toupa a ka deihtak, chibai hon buksak un aw.
Khrist a i naseppih uh Urbanes leh ka deihtak Stakis chibai hon buksak un.
Khrist a mitak, Apelles, chibai hon buksak un. Aristobulas, a-inkuanpihte lak a mite chibai hon buksak un.
Ka chipih, Herodion, chibai hon buksak un. Inkuanpihte lak a mi Narkissas, Toupa a om, chibai hon buksak un.
Triphena leh Triphosa Toupa a semgimte, chibai hon buksak un aw. Deihtak Persis, Toupa a ana semgim mahmah, chibai hon na buksak un.
Toupa amitel Rufus leh anu, kei nu leng hi sam, chibai hon na buksak un.
Asinkritas, Phligon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes leh akiang ua unau omte, chibai hon na buksak un aw.
Philologas leh Julia, Nerias leh sanggamnu, Olimpas leh akiang ua misiangthou om tengteng, chibai hon na buksak un.
Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un. Khrist saptuam pawl tengteng in chibai ahon buk chiat uhi.
Huan unaute aw, thuhilhna thu noumau hilh louh lam a kikhenna leh pukna omsakte a pan kiveng ding leh kiheisan ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
Huchibang mite'n i Toupa Khrist nna asem kei ua, amau gilpi nna asem zaw uhi; akamzolna uleh akamsiamna un mipilloute lungtang akhem nak uhi.
Na thumandan uh mi tengteng lak ah athangkheta ngal a. Huaiziak in noumau tungthu ah ka kipak hi; himahleh, hoih lam a na pil ua, gilou lam a na pil louh uh ka deih ahi.
Huan lemna Pathian in na khepek nuai uah Setan ahon sikdensak pah ding hi. I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen.
Ka naseppih Timothi leh ka chipih Lusias leh Jason, Sosipaterte'n chibai ahon buk uhi.
Kei Tertias, hiai laigelhtu in, Toupa min in chibai ka hon buk hi.
Ka tunnapa Gaias leh saptuam tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi. Huai sumkempa Erastas leh unaupa Kuartas in chibai ahon buk uhi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
Tu in amah, ka tanchinhoih gen bang leh thuguk kilakna bangbang a Jesu Khrist ka tangkoupih bang a noute hon hihhattheipa, huai thuguk tang lai sawtpi mahmah sung selguk in na om mahleh,
tu'n bel ginna thumanna piangsak ding in zawlnei laibute zang a nam tengteng kiang a theihsak leh tangtawn Pathian thupiak bang in taklat in ahong omta hi.
Pilna Pathian kiang kia ah, Jesu Khrist ziak in thupina tangtawn dong in om hen! Amen.

Huaiziak in mihing aw, miselhat kuapeuh himah lechin paulam himhim na nei kei hi. Midang na selna mah ah nangmah leh nangmah siam louh na kitan hi. Nang selhat in leng huchibang thilte na hih sam ngal hi.
Huchibang thilhih nakte tung ah Pathian' vaihawmna diktak in atung, chih i thei uhi.
