Mihing aw, huchibang thilhih nakte gensia, nang leng huchibang na hih sam ngal nak a, Pathian' vaihawmna pelh na kigingta a hia?
Ahihkeileh Pathian hoihna kisikna a nang hon pi ding a om ahi chih thei lou in, ahoihna, athuaktheihna leh adohtheihna hauhnate na ngaineu a hia?
Himahleh na lungtang khauh leh kisik utlouhnate ziak in, na tung ah thangpaihna na kholkhawmte Pathian' vaihawmna diktat hong kilatna, thangpaihna ni chiang a ding a kholkhawm ahi zaw hi.
Pathian in michih athilhih bang zel un ahawmsak ding;
Thil hoih hih teitei a, thupina leh pahtawina leh manthat theihlouhna zong mite kiang ah tangtawn hinna ape ding hi.
Himahleh genhakte, thutak zui lou a, gitlouhna zui zawte tung ah, hehna leh thangpaihna, haksatna leh lungkhamna thupitak a-om dia;
mihing thil hihkhial tengteng kha tung ah a-om ding, Juda mi kha tung ah a-om masa ding a, huan, Grik mi kha tung ah a-om nawn ding hi.
Himahleh, thil hoih hih peuhmahte kiang ah thupina, pahtawina, khamuanna piak ahi ding, Juda mi kiang ah piak ahi masa ding a, huan, Grik mi kiang ah ahi nawn ding hi.
Pathian in mi deihsak tuam anei ngal kei hi.
Kuapeuh dan nei lou a thil hihkhial, dan lou in amangthang ding hi; kuapeuh dan nei a thil hihkhial, dan bang in vaihawm in a-om ding.
Dan zami phette Pathian mitmuh in midik ahi kei ua; dan zuite midik ahi zaw ding uhi.
Dan nei lou Zentelte'n amau pianpih a dan thilte ahih un, amau dan nei kei mah le uh, amau leh amau dan in akinei tawm uhi.
Alungtang uah dan thilhih gelh ahi chih langsak ding in asia-le-pha theihna un atheihpih hi; alungsimte un leng theihpih ahih ziak in angaihtuahna un siam louh atangsak hiam siam atangsak zel hi.
Ka tanchinhoih gen bang in, Pathian vaihawm ni chiang in mihing thugukte, Jesu Khrist ah angaihtuah ding hi.
Himahleh nang Juda na kichi a, dan a kinga in Pathian na suang hi.
Adeihlam na thei a, thil hoihzawte hoih na sa a, dan a hilh in na om a,
nangmah mittawte pipa, mial lak a omte vakna hi in na kigingta hi.
Dan ah pilna leh thutak omdan na theih ziak in, mipilloute hilhpilpa, naungekte hilhpa in na kigingta hi.
Huchibang na hih ngalleh nang midangte hilhpa, nangmah na kihilh kei a hia? Nang guta lou dia mite hilhpa, nang na gu nak maw?
Nang angkawm lou dia hilhpa, nang ang na kawm maw? Nang milim hopa, nang milim tempul a thilte na gu nak maw?
Nang dan suangpa, nang dan a na tatlek ziak in Pathian na hihminse zel ahi maw?
"Pathian min noumau ziak in Zentelte lak ah gensiat in a-omta hi," chi a kigelh bang in.
Dan zuipa na hihleh zeksum aphatuam ngíal hi; dan a talekpa na hihleh bel, na zeksum sum louh bang phet ahong hita hi.
Huaiziak in zek sumloumi in dan thusehte azuihleh azeksum louh, sum bang a sim ahi kei dia hia?
Huan amau sa a zeksum louh in dan azuih kim uleh, nang dan thu gelh leh zeksum nei ngal a dan a talekpa ahon mohpaih kei ding ua hia?
Alang lel a Juda mi hih zaw Juda mi tak ahi kei a; alang a sa lel a zeksum zaw zeksum tak ahi tuan sam kei hi.
Himahleh alang lel hilou a, Juda mi zaw, Juda mi tak ahi; huan zeksum tak, lungsim a sum ahi, laigelh thu phet ah hilou in, kha ah ahi; huai mi'n mihing phat aloh kei a, Pathian phat aloh zaw ahi.
Ahihleh Juda mi'n hamphat tuamna bang ahia aneih tuan? Zeksum leng bang ahia aphattuamna?
Bang lam peuh ah aphatuam hi; Pathian thute akiang ua kepsak a a-om ziak ahi pen.
Mi khenkhatte'n ginna nei kei mah le uh, bang ahi tuan a eita? Agintaklouhna un Pathian muanhuaina bangmah lou in abawl tuan a hia?
Bawl tuan lou hial! Pathian midiktak hita hen, michih zuauthei hi uhen: "Nang na thugen in siam na tang thei a, vaihawm a na om in leng na zohtheihna ding in," chih gelh bang in.
Himahleh i diktatlouhna in Pathian diktatna a hihlat semleh bang i gen dia? Pathian in mi agawt in, midiktat lou ahi hia? Mihing dan bang in ka gen ahi.
Hilou hial! Huchibang hitaleh, Pathian in khovel vai bangchi in ahawm dia?
Himahleh ka zuauthu gen ziak a Pathian thu dikdan amah hih thupi khop hial a alat sem ngalleh bang achia kei leng mikhial bang a siam louh tansak a om lai ka hia?

Bang achia, ahon hek ua, mi khenkhat in gen louhpi hon gensak bang un, "Thil hoih ahong tuntheihna ding in thil gilou i hih ding uh," chi a i gen zawk louh? Huchibang ching mite'n siam louh atan uh adik him ahi.
Ahihleh amau sang in i hoihzaw khol ua hia? Hoihzaw lou hial. Judate leh Grikte khelhna sikha a om vek in tuma in leng i ngohta vele;
"Kuamah midiktat himhim a-om kei uh, khat leng a-om kei uh;
kuamah theisiam himhim a-om kei uh, kuamah Pathian zong himhim a-om kei uh.
Ahilou lam ah apial khinta ua, bangmah phatuam lou in a-om khinta ua, kuamah thil hoih hih himhim a-om kei uh, khat lel leng a-om kei uh,"
Agawl uh han kihong ahi a; alei un khemna thu agen uhi. Akamsung uah gulgu a-om hi.
Akam uh hamse lohna leh thukha in adim hi.
Akhete uh sisan suah ding in akinsuan uhi;
Alampite uah manthatna leh gimthuakna a-om a;
khamuanna lampi athei kei ua,
amit uah Pathian launa a-om kei, chih gelh bang in.
Dan in bangpeuh agen a, dan thuthu a omte kiang a agen ahi chih i thei uhi; kam chiteng adaihsak theihna ding in leh khovel a mi tengteng Pathian vaihawm a a-omtheihna ding un.
Huchi in "Dan thilhihte ziak in mi kuamah amitmuh in siamtang in a-om kei ding uhi," dan tawn in khelhna theihna ahong om hi.
Himahleh tu'n bel dan leh zawlneite na theihsak Pathian dikna dan tel lou in hihlat in a-omta hi.
Huai tuh Jesu Khrist gintak ziak a, agingtate tengteng a dia Pathian diktatna ahi. Lamdanna himhim a-om kei.
Mi tengteng in thil ahihkhelh ziak ua Pathian thupina atan zoh louh nung un,
Khrist Jesu a om tatna ziak in, hehpihna a athawn a siamtansak in a-om uhi.
Amah tuh asisan ziak a thuphatawina hi in, ginna a muh ding in Pathian in aluikheta hi. Hiai tuh Pathian dikna latsakna ding ahi, ama'n adohtheihna ziak a nidanglai khelhnate apaikan tak ziak in.
Huan amah ngei adik a, chih leh Jesu a ginna neimi siam atangsak chih chetna ding in.
Na ki-otsakna uh koi a om ahia le? Posiah in a-omta. Bang dan in ahia le? Thilhihna dan in hia? Hilou hial, ginna dan in ahi zaw hi.
Huchi in dan thilhihte ziak hilou in, ginna in mihingte siamtansak in a-om chi in i sep uhi.
Pathian, Judate Pathian kia ahi hia? Zentelte Pathian leng ahi sam kei a hia? Hi e, Zentelte Pathian leng ahi.
Pathian khat kia ahih ziak in; ama'n zeksumte aginna ziak un, zeksumlouhte aginna ziak un siam atangsak ding hi.
Huchi ahihleh hiai ginna ziak in dan bangmah lou a bawl i hi uhia? Bawl lou hial! Dan tuh i hihkip zaw uhi.
Ahihleh Abraham, sadan a i pu un, bang ahia amuh i gen ding?
Abraham in thilhih ziak a siam atan ngalleh suan ding anei ahi, Pathian ma ah zaw hi het lou in.
Laisiangthou in bang agen a? "Abraham in Pathian agingta a, huan huai ginna tuh adikna a seh ahi," chi in agen ahi.
Huan nasemmi loh tuh hehpihna a seh ahi kei a, bat a seh ahi zaw hi.
Himahleh nna sem lou a, Pathian limsak lou siamtangsakpa gingtazaw mi ginna, ama diktatna a seh ahi.
Mi athilhih ngaihtuah lou a, Pathian in diktat a aseh, avualzawlsak thu David in leng,
"Atatleknate ngaihdam a om a, akhelhnate uh khuh a omte, ahampha uhi,
Toupa'n khelhna nei a asehlouhte ahampha uhi," chi a agen bang in.
Ahihleh huai vualzawlna zeksumte kia tung ah hia a-om, zeksumloute tung ah leng? Abraham ginna adiktatna a seh ahi, i chi ngal ua.
Huai bangchi seh ahia? Azeksum nung in hia, azeksum ma in? Azeksum nung in ahi kei a, azeksum ma in ahi zaw hi.
Huchi in azeksum ma in ginna ziak in diktatna amu chih chiamtehna ding in zeksum thu amu hi. Huchi a amah tuh zeksum lou himahleh agingtate diktatna sehsak a omte tengteng pa ahihtheihna ding in.
Huchi mah bang a zeksumte phet hilou, i pa uh Abraham in zek asum ma a aneih ginna bang ginna khekhap zuite pa ahihtheihna ding ahi.
Abraham leh asuante kiang a khovel gouluah ding ahi ding uh chih thuchiam zaw dan a kinga ahi kei a, ginna ziak a diktatna a kinga ahi zaw hi.
Dan nei mite gouluahte hi ding hi le uh bel, ginna bangmah in aphatuam kei a, thuchiam leng thuchiam ahita kei hi.
Dan in thangpaihna atun nak ngal a; himahleh dan omlouhna ah tatlekna leng a-om kei hi.

Huaiziak in thuchiam hehpihna a piak ahihtheihna ding in ginna a kinga ahi, asuante tengteng in thuchiam pel lou a aluahtheihna ding un. Dan nei mite kia in aluah kei ding ua, Abraham neih bang ginna neite'n leng aluah sam ding uhi; amah i vek ua pa ahi.
"Nam tampite pa in ka hon bawlta," chi a gelh ahih bang in, misite hihhingpa leh thil omloute om bang a genpa, agin Pathian mitmuh ah eite pa a bawl in a-om zaw hi.
Lamet tuak a a-om louh in leng ama'n zaw lamentak in agingta a, "Nam tampite pa ahong hihtheihna ding in; huchibang in na suante ahong hi ding uh," chi a hilh a a-om bang in.
Huan ginna kip lou tuan lou in, apumpi sisa bang a om tuh angaihtuah a, amah kum za vel mi ahi ngal a, Sarah chiing leng angaihtuah sam hi.
Pathian thuchiam ginglel lou in ginna tasam in a-om kei a, Pathian apahtawi hi.
Athuchiam alohchingsak thei chih agingta a, aginna ahong kip zawta hi.
Huaiziak in aginna tuh adiktatna a seh ahita hi.
Huchi in "amah ah sehsak in a-om," chih amah ziak kia a gelh ahi kei a,
eite ziak in leng ahi. Jesu i Toupa misi lak a kipan a kaithoupa gingta, eite a ding in sehsak ahi ding,
amah i tatlekna ziak a piakkhiak a om a, siam i tanna ding a kaihthoh a ompa ahi.
Huaiziak in ginna ziak a siamtansak a om in i Toupa Jesu Khrist pansan in Pathian toh kilem in i om uhi.
Amah tawn mah in ginna in hiai hehpihna ah luttheihna i nei ua; huai a ding in Pathian thupina i tan ding lametna ah kipak in i om uhi.
Huai kia leng hilou in, i gimthuakna ah leng kipak in i om uh, gimthuakna in thuakhatna atun hi.
Thuakhatna in hindan hoih atun a, hindan hoih in lametna atun chih thei in.
Huan lametna in ahon zahlaksak kei a, huai Kha Siangthou i kiang ua hon piak tawn a Pathian itna i lungtang ua sun a a-om tak ziak in.
I hat louh lai in ahuntak in Pathian limsakloute sih sik in Khrist ahong sita hi.
Midik sik a sih, mi a-ut ngel kei hial ding ua, mihoih sik in bel mi kuahiam bek in sih angap khamoh kei ding hi.
Himahleh Pathian in mikhialte i hih lai a Khrist i sik a asihna ah ahon itna alangsakta hi.
Huchi in asisan a siamtansak a i om khit nung in, amah ziak in Pathian hehna a kipan hotdam in i om ngei ding uhi.
Melma i hih lai a bawn a Tapa sihna ziak a Pathian toh na kilemkik khin i hih ngal uleh, kilem a i om khit nung un ahinna ziak in hotdam in i om sem ding uhi.
Huai kia leng ahi kei, kilepkikna tua hon musakpa i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak in Pathian ah leng i kipak ahi.
Huan mi khat ziak in khovel ah khelhna alut a, khelhna ziak in sihna alut a, huchi in mi tengteng akhelh tak ziak un sihna in mi tengteng azelsuakta hi.
Dan om ma in khovel ah khelhna a-om khin ngal a; dan a-om louh lai in khelhna tuh khelhna a sim ahi kei hi.
Himahleh Adam om a kipan Mosi om pha in Adam tatlekna bang a thil hihkhialloute tung ah leng sihna in vai ahawm zel hi. Adam tuh hong pai dingpa tehpihna ahi.

Himahleh thilthawnpiak zaw tatlekna toh akibang kei. Mi khat tatlekna ziak a mi tampi asih ualeh Pathian hehpihna leh mi khat, Jesu Khrist hehpihna thawnpiak akichingzaw sem a mi tampi tung ah vuh in a-om hi.

Huan thilthawnpiak zaw mi khat tatlekna gah toh leng akibang sam kei hi. Mi khat tatlekna tung a vaihawmna in siam louh tansakna atun a, mi tampi tatlekna tung a thilthawnpiak in bel siamtansakna atun hi.

Mi khat tatlekna ziak a sihna in huai mi khat mah pansan a vai ahawm leh hehpihna kiningching mahmah leh diktatna thawnpiak tangte'n mi khat, Jesu Khrist pansan in hinna ah vai ahawm zaw sem ding uhi.
Huan mi khat tatlekna in mi tengteng a ding a siam louh tansakna atut mah bang in, mi khat diktatna thilhih in mi tengteng a ding in suahtakna leh hinna ahon tun hi.
Mi khat thumanlouhna ziak a mi tampi mikhial a bawl ahih bang un, mi khat thumanna ziak in mi tampi midiktat a bawl ahi ding uhi.
Khelhna latsak semna ding in Dan ahong om behlap a; himahleh khelhna akhanna peuh ah hehpihna akhangsem,
huchi a khelhna in sihna a vai ahawm mah bang a, hehpihna in leng i Toupa Jesu Khrist pansan a diktatna ziak a tangtawn hinna dong a vai ahawmtheihna ding in.
Bang i genta dia le? Hehpihna akhansem theihna ding in khelhna ah i om nilouh ding ua hia?
Om nilouh lou hial ding! Eite khelhna lam a sisa, khelhna ah bangchi in i hing thei lailai dia?
Eite Khrist Jesu a baptis lut a om tengteng asihna ah baptis lut in i om chih na thei kei ua hia?
Huaiziak in asihna a baptis lut a om in amah toh vuikhawm in i om uhi, huchi a Pa thupina in misi lak a kipan a Khrist akaihthoh tak bang a eite leng hinna thak a i khosak theihna ding in.
Asihna kibatpih a amah toh i kizop khit ngalleh athohnawnna kibatpih in leng i kizom ngei ding uhi.
I mihing lui akiang ah kilhden in a-om samta chih i thei; huchi a khelhna pumpi hihmanthat a a-omtheihna ding leh tua kipan a khelhna sikha a i omlouhna ding in.
Kuapeuh sisa khelhna lak ah asuaktata hi.
Huan Khrist toh i sih samleh akiang ah i hing sam ding chih i gingta uhi.
Misi lak a kipan Khrist kaihthoh in a-omta, asi nawn kei ding chih i thei ngal ua; sihna in amah tung ah thu aneita kei hi.
Asihna khelhna lam thu ah tangtawn a ding in khatvei kia asi a, ahinna bel Pathian lam thu ah ahing ahi.
Huchi mah bang in, nou leng khelhna lam thu ah sisa in kisep unla, Pathian lam thu ah bel Khrist Jesu ah hing in kisep un.
Huaiziak in na pumpi uh duhgawlna thumang ding in na pumpi sithei uah khelhna vai hawmsak kei un.

Na pumpi hiangte uh leng diktatlouhna vanzat ding in khelhna kiang ah pe phal sam kei un; himahleh misi lak a kipan hing nawn bang in Pathian kiang ah kipia unla, na pumpi hiangte uh leng diktatna vanzat ding in Pathian kiang ah pe phal zaw un.
Noute dan thunuai a om hilou a, hehpihna nuai a om na hih ziak un khelhna in na tung uah thu anei nawn kei ding hi.
Bangchi in ahita dia le? Dan thunuai a om i hi kei ua, hehpihna nuai a om i hih zawk ziak in i khial ding uh ahi diam? Hilou hial ding!
Kua kiang peuh ah leng athu mang ding a asikha dia na kipiak un sihna khop a khelhna sikha hiam, diktatna khop a thumang sikha hiam, athu na man uh sikha na hi uh chih na thei kei ua hia?
Himahleh Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen; noute khelhna sikha na hita mah le uchin, thuginpi a na kipiakna uh na lungtang taktak un na zuita uhi.
Khelhna lak a kipan suahtaksak in na omta ua, diktatna sikhate na hong hita uhi.

Na sa uh hat louh ziak in mihing dan in thu ka gen hi; na sahiangte uh nitna leh tatlekna ding a tatlekna kiang a sikha ding a na piak phal bang un, tu in na sahiangte uh sianthouna ding in diktatna kiang ah sikha ding in pe zaw un.
Khelhna sikhate na hih lai un diktatna lak ah na siang uhi.
Huai na thil zahpihsate uah, huai lai in gah bang ahia na muh zel uh? Huai thilte tawpna zaw sihna ahi.
Tu'n ah bel khelhna lak a hihsiang a om in, Pathian sikhate na hong hih un, sianthouna mu khop in na gah uh na nei uh akei hiam, huai tawpna tangtawn a hinna toh.
Khelhna man sihna ahi ngal a, Pathian thilthawnpiak bel i Toupa Khrist Jesu ziak in tangtawn a hinna ahi.
Ahihleh unaute aw, dan in mi adamsung teng atungah vai ahawm nak chih na thei kei ua hia? Dan thei mite kiang ah ka gen ahi.
Pasal nei lai numei apasal damsung teng apasal ah dan a hen in a-om ngal a; himahleh asih in bel pasal lam ah dan a kipan khahkhiak in a-om hi.
Huchi a apasal damsung a midang akitenpihleh angkawm chih ahi ding a; apasal asih in bel huai dan a kipan khahkhiak in a-om a, huchi in midang nei taleh leng angkawm ahi kei hi.

Huchi ahih mah bang in ka unaute aw, Pathian lam a i gahtheihna ding in midang, misi lak a kipan kaihthoh ngeingei na kitenpih theihna ding un, Khrist pumpi pansan in dan lam ah sihsak in na omta uhi.
Sa a i om lai un dan ziak a khelhna utna hong suakte'n, i sahiangte ah sihna khop a gah ding in asem nak hi.
Tu in bel hon henpa lak ah si khin in, dan a kipan khah in i omta, laigelh lui bang hilou a, Kha a hinna thak a nna i septheihna ding in.
Bang i genta dia le? Dan khelhna ahi a hia le? Hilou hial! Himahleh, dan tawn a theih hi keileh khelhna thei lou ding hi ing a; dan in, "Eng ke'n," chi keileh, en chih thei lou ding ka hi.
Himahleh khelhna in, thupiak ziak in, lemtan lai mu in ka sung ah enna chiteng a-omsak hi. Dan pang lou in khelhna kichi asisa ahi ngal a.
Tuma lam in kei dan lou in ka na hing a; himahleh thupiak ahong omtak in khelhna ahong halh a, kei ka sita hi.
Huan hinna thuchiam nei thupiak kei a ding in sihna ahong hi chih ka na theita hi.
Khelhna in thupiak ziak in, lemtanna la in ahon khem a, huai tungtawn mah in ahon hihlumta hi.
Huchi ahih ziak in dan asiangthou a, thupiak leng asiangthou in, adik a, ahoih ahi.

Ahihleh thil hoih kichi kei a ding in sihna ahong hi a hia? Hilou hial! Khelhna tuh kei a ding in sihna ahong hi zawta hi. Huchi in khelhna, khelhna ahi chih alattheihna ding in thil hoih zang in ahon that a; thupiak ziak a khelhna, khelhna pen thupitak ahong hihtheihna ding in.
Dan ahihleh khalam thil ahi chih i thei ngal ua, kei bel sami, khelhna a khotsa ka hi.
Keimah thilhih mah leng ka theisiam thei kei; ka thilhih zel pen lah ka hih ut lam ahi ngal kei a, ka thil huat lamtak ka hih zaw nak ngal a.
Ka hih ut louh lam ka hih zel in tuh, dan hoih ahi chih pompih ka suak hi.
Tu in, huai thilhih pen keimah ahi nawnta kei a, keimah a om khelhna in ahih ahi zaw hi.
Keimah ah, huai bel, ka taksa ah, thil hoih hih ding lunggulhna zaw keimah ah a-om, himahleh huai thil hoih bangchi sepsuah ding ahia chih ka thei zou kei.
Thil hoih hih ka ut pen hih lou in, khelhna hih ka ut louh pen, ka hih zaw kha nak ngal a.
Tu in ka hih ut louh lam pen ka hihleh, ahihpa kei ka hi nawnta kei a, ka sung a teng huai khelhna pen ahi zaw hi.
Huchi in thil hoih hih ka ut laitak in kei ah gitlouhna ahong om nak chih hiai dan ka mukhia hi.
Ka lungsim taktak in Pathian dan tung ah ka kipahpih ngal nak a;
himahleh ka sahiangte ah dan tuam a-om chih ka thei, huai in ka lungsim dan adou a, ka sahiangte a khelhna dan om kiang ah sal in ahon pi hi.
Genthei hi na lawmlawm ing e! Hiai sihna pumpi a pan kua'n ahia hon suahtaksak ding?
Jesu Khrist i Toupa ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi. Huchi in keimah tak in zaw ka lungsim in Pathian dan ka sem a, ka taksa in bel gitlouhna dan asem hi.
Huaiziak in tu'n ah zaw Khrist Jesu a omte a ding in siam louh tansakna himhim a-omta kei hi.
Khrist Jesu a Hinna Khadan in khelhna leh sihna dan a kipan hon suaktasakta ngal a.
Sa ziak a dan ahat louh a, ahihtheih vual louh, Pathian in, amah Tapa ngei, khelhna sa gilou bang pu in, khelhna thoihna ding a hon sawl in, sa a khelhna om tuh siam louh atangsakta,
sadan zui lou a Khadan zui zawte eimah a dan in angiat diktatna tangtun a a-omtheihna ding in.
Sadan a omte'n salam thilte alunggulh nak ua; Khadan a omte'n bel Khalam thilte alunggulh nak uhi.
Sa thilte deih zaw sihna ahi ngal a, Kha thil deih bel hinna leh khamuanna ahi.
Sa deihdan zaw Pathian douna ahih ziak in, huai Pathian dan in a-om ngal kei a, om leng a-om thei kei him ahi.
Huchi in sa a omte'n Pathian akipaksak thei kei uhi.
Himahleh Pathian Kha noumau a a-om taktakleh sa a om na hi kei ua, Kha a om na hi zaw uhi. Himahleh, kuapeuh Khrist Kha nei lou zaw amah a ahi kei.
Khrist Kha noumau a a-om ngalleh khelhna ziak in pumpi asi ahi; kha bel dikna ziak in ahing ahi.
Himahleh misi lak a kipan Jesu kaithounawn pa Kha noumau a a-omleh, misi lak a kipan Khrist Jesu kaithounawn pa'n, noumau a om ama Kha pansan in na pumpi sitheite uh ahihhing sam ding hi.
Huaiziak in unaute aw, bat i nei; sadan a om ding in sa lak ah bel ahi kei.
Sadan a na om uleh, na si mahmah ding uh; himahleh pumpi thilhihte Kha a na hihlup zel uleh bel na hing ding uhi.
Pathian Kha pi a om peuhmahte zaw, Pathian tate ahi ngal ua.
Lau a om nawn ding in bawi hihna kha tang na hi ngal kei ua; himahleh ta hihna kha na tang ua, "Abba, Pa!" chi in i kikou hi,
Kha mahmah in, eimah kha toh, Pathian tate i hi chih hon theisak hi.
Huan tate i hihleh gouluahpihte i hi uhi; Pathian gouluahte, Khrist luahpihte i hi ua; akiang a pahtawi a i om sam theihna ding a amah i thuakpih taktak nakleh.
Tu lel a thuaknate den chiang a i tung a thupina hihlat a om ding toh tehpih tham in ka sep kei hi.
Thilsiam tengteng in, lamen mahmah in, Pathian tate hong latna angaklah mahmah uhi.
Thilsiam tengtengte thil thulim lou thuthu a omsak in a-omta uh; a-ut ua om ahi kei ua, lametna a a-omsakpa ziak ahi zaw hi.
Thilsiam tengteng leng siatna sikha a kipan suahtaksak in a-om ding ua, Pathian tate noplenna thupi ah alut ding uhi.
Thilsiam tengteng tutan in thum leh nauvei nat thuak in a-om uh chih i thei ngal ua.
Thilsiamte kia hilou in, eite ngei, Kha gah masa tengte leng, ta hihna kilatna, i pumpi tatna ngak in i lungsim sung uah i mau uhi.
Hiai lametna a hotdam lah i hi ngal ua. Himahleh muh theihgige lametna zaw lametna ahi kei. Kua'n amuh theihgige alamen a?
I muh louh pen i lametleh bel i ngak teitei hi.
Huai bang in, Kha in i hatlouhna ah hon huh zel a; bangchi a thum ding ahia chih i thei ngal kei ua; himahleh Kha in mauna gen vual louh in hon thumsak zel hi.
Pathian deihlam bang zel a misiangthoute athumsak zel ziak in, lungtang enpa'n Kha deihlam athei hi.
Pathian a-it mite, Ama'n aseh bang a asapte a ding in, ahoihna ding un thil bangkim asemkhawm chih i thei hi.
Atheihkholhte ama Tapa batpih a om ding in asepkhol a, a-unau tampite lak a ta masapen ahong hihtheihna ding in.
Huan asehkholhte asam a; huan asapte siam atangsak lai a; siam atansakte apahtawi lai hi.
Huai thu ah bang i genta dia le? Pathian ei lam a apanleh kua'n ahia hon zou thei ding?
Ama Tapa ngei leng hawi lou a, i vek ua ding a pepa'n thil tengteng athawn in ahon pe tawk kei dia hia?
Pathian mitelte kua'n ahia hek ding? Siamtangsakpa lah Pathian ahi ngal a.
Kua'n ahia siam louh tangsak ding? Asi pen Khrist Jesu ahi; ahi, athounawn zawta a, Pathian taklam a om hon gensakpa ahi.
Khrist itna a kipan kua'n ahia hon khen ding? Gimthuakna in hia, lungngaihna in hia, sawina in hia, taam in hia, vuaktanna in hia, lauhuaina in hia, namsau in hia?
"Nangmah ziak in nitum in thah in ka om ua; goh ding belam bang a sim ka hi uh," chih gelh bang in.
Khen lou hial ding, huaite tengteng ah, hon itpa ziak in, vual tungtuangte sang a tungtuangzaw i hi uhi.
Sihna hiam, hinna hiam, angelte hiam, thupinate hiam, thil omlelte leh thil hong om dingte hiam thilhihtheihna leh,
sanna, thukna leh thilsiam dangte himhim in leng, i Toupa Khrist Jesu a om Pathian itna a kipan hon khen thei kei ding chih diktak in ka theichian hi.
Khrist ah thutak tak ka gen ahi, ka zuau kei, Kha Siangthou ah ka sia-le-pha theihna in leng hon theihpih hi.
Ka lungtang ah haksatna thupitak leh lungngaihna dai thei lou ka pai hi.
Ka unaute salam a ka chipihte sik in, kei pen Khrist a kipan hihtuam khop hial in hamsethuak in om leng ka chi hi.
Amau Israel mi ahi ngal ua; ta hihna, thupina leh thukhun tengteng, dan piakna leh Pathian nasepna a thuchiam tengteng amau a ahi.
Pipute leng amau a ahi ua, salam thu ah Khrist leng amau a kipan a hong pawt ahi a; amah thil tengteng tung a om, tangtawn a phat tuak Pathian ahi. Amen.
Himahleh Pathian thu bangmah lou bang a omta ahi kei hi. Israel suante Israel mi ahi vek kei uh;
Abraham suante ahih ziak un avek un atate leng ahi kei uhi, "Isak ah na suante akiminloh ding," chih ahi zaw hi.
Huai sa tate Pathian tate chihna ahi kei ua, thuchiam tate Abraham suan a seh ahi uh chihna ahi zaw uhi.
Thuchiam pen hiai ahi, "Tu hun bang in ka hong dia, Sarah in tapa anei ding,"
Huai phet ahi kei Rebekah in leng i pu Isak lak a nau apai lai in,
naupangte apian ma uh, sia-le-pha atheih ma un, thilhih ziak hilou in, asampa deihna ziak zaw in, tel lam thu ah Pathian thiltup akiptheihna ding in akiang ah;
"A-upazaw in anaupangzaw nna asem ding," Pathian in achi hi.
"Jakob ka it a, Esau zaw ka hua," chih gelh bang in.
Bang i genta ding ua le? Pathian ah diktatlouhna a-om a hia?
Om lou hial! Ama'n, "Ka hehpih peuhmah ka hehpih dia, zah ka ngaihna tung peuhmah ah zah ka ngai ding," chi in Mosi kiang ah agenta hi.
Huaiziak in adeihpa ziak ahi kei a, ataipa ziak leng ahi sam kei a, ahehpihpa Pathian ziak ahi zaw hi.
Laisiangthou in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hiai ziak tak in ahi ka hon tunding, nang a ka thilhihtheihna ka taklat theihna ding leh leitung tengteng a ka min athantheihna ding in," achi hi.
Huchi in Pathian in zahngaihna asuah ut peuhmah tung ah azahngai a, a-ut peuhmah alungkhauhsak hi.
Nou ka kiang ah, bangziak a ama'n moh a hon dem lai ahia? Kua in adeihlam kalh ahia? hon chi ding na hih tuak uhi.
Ahi a, mihing aw, nang Pathian nial vialpa kua na hia le? Thilsiam in asiampa kiang ah, "Bang achia hichibang a hon siam,” achi dia hia?
Tungman tang khat a pan bel khat kilawmtak, manphatak a zat ding leh manpha lou deuh a zat ding bawl ding in belvelpa'n tungman tung ah thu anei kei a hia?
Pathian in ahehna leh athilhihtheihna latsak a-ut a, ahehna thuak ding a hihsiat a om ding a abawlkholhte tung a ahehpihna hauhdan alatsak a athuakzoh teiteileh bang apoi a?
Huchi a athupina hauhsaknate, azahngaihna thupina tang ding a abawlkholhte tung a asunbuakleh alatsak theihna ding in,
huaite tuh eite i hi ua, Judate lak a kipan kia hilou in, Zentelte lak a kipan a leng sapte ahi.
Hosea laibu ah: "Ka mite hi ngei lou, ka mite, ka chi dia; it ngei louhnu leng itnu, ka chita ding hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, akiang ua, ka mite na hi kei uh achihna mun ngei ah Pathian hing tate chih in a- omta ding uh, chih gelh bang in."
Isai in leng Israel mite thu kikoupih in, "Israel mite zaw tuipi piaunel zah in tam mah le uh, akhosuaksunte kia hotdam in a-om ding uh.
Toupa'n kintak a hihzou vek in leitung ah agawt ding thu atangtun dek ngal a," achi hi.
Isai in, "Sepaihte' Toupa'n chisuah ding hon na hawisak lou hileh Sodom khua bang in i na omta ding ua, Gomorrah khua bang a bawl in i na omta ding uh," chi a agenkholh bang in.
Bang i genta dia le? Zentel, diktatna delhloute'n, ginna ziak adiktatna tuh ana phata uhi.
Israel, diktatna dan delhte'n, diktatna pen aphazouta kei uh.
Bangziak in ahia? Ginna in adelh kei ua, thilhih a muh theih bang a adelh ziak uh ahi. Pukna suang ah apukta uhi.
Laisiangthou in: "Ngai in, Zion ah kisuihna suang leh pukna suangpi ka koih a, kuapeuh amah gingta tuh azahlak kei ding," chih gelh bang in.
Vaihawm mite'n vai ahawm lai un hichi ahong ahi. Huai gam ah kial akia hi. Judah gam a Bethlehem mi khat Moab gam a teng tadih ding in amah leh azi leh atapate nih toh ahoh uhi.
Huai mi min Elimelek ahi, azi min Naomi ahi, atapate nih min Mahlon leh Kilon ahi. Amau Judah gam a Bethlehem, Ephrath mi ahi uh. Moab gam ah ahoh ua, huai ah a-om nilouh uhi.
Elimelek, Naomi pasal asi a, amah leh atapate nih kia ahita uh.
Amau Moab gam numei zi in anei ua, akhat pen min Orpah ahi a, akhat pen min Ruth ahi. Huai ah kum sawm a-omta uhi.
Mahlon leh Kilon asi tuaktuak ua; huchi in huai numei atapate nih leh apasal in asihsanta uhi.
Huchi in amoute toh Moab gam a pan kik nawn ding in akisa uh; TOUPA'N nek ding pia a mite avehdan Moab gam a pan ana zak ziak in.
Huchi in a-omna a pan amoute nih toh apawt ua; Judah gam a kik nawn ding in apaita uhi.
Naomi in amou nihte kiang ah, "Na nute uh inn tuak ah pai nawnta un. Misi tung leh ka tung a siamtak a na hih bang un TOUPA'N na tung uah hih hen.
TOUPA'N na nih un na pasalte uh inn a khawlna na muhtheihna ding un hon hehpih hen," achi hi. Huchi in atawp a, aw suah hial in akapta uhi.
Amau akiang ah, "Pai kei ni ung, na chite kiang a na paina ah ka tel sam ding uh," achi uhi.
Naomi in, "Ka tanute aw, pai nawn zaw un. Bangziak a ka kiang a hong pai lai mahmah ding na hi ua? Na pasal ding uh tapate ka pai thei nawn dia hia?
Ka tanute aw, kisa unla, pai un; pasal nei ding in lah ka upa lota ngal a. Lametna ka nei chi mah leng, tuzan mahmah in leng pasal nei in tapate leng nei mah leng,
apichin tan ua om ding na hi ding uam? Pasal lou in na om nilouh ding ua hia? Hi tel lou e, ka tanute aw; nou ziak in ka lungkhamna a-uang semsem hi. TOUPA khut ka tung a tu ahita ve," achi hi.
A-aw uh suah in akap nawn leuleu uhi. Huchi in Orpah in api atawp a; Ruth in bel alen tinten hi.
Ama'n, "Ngai in, na moupihnu achite kiang leh apathian kiang ah apaikik nawnta. Nang leng na moupihnu delh inla, pai nawnta in," achi hi.
Ruth in, "Nang khen ding leh nang zui lou a kik nawn ding in hon kun ke'n. Na paina peuh ah ka pai dia; na giahna peuh ah ka giak dia; na chite ka chite ahi ding ua, na Pathian ka Pathian ahi ding.
Na sihna peuh ah ka si dia, huai ah na hon vui sam ding ahi. Nang leh kei sihna lou ngal thil dang in ahon khenleh TOUPA'N ahihhih in hon hih henla, hiai sang a thupizaw in leng," achi hi.
Huchi in akiang a pai atum tinten chih atheih in adaihsanta hi.
Huchi in Bethlehem tan apaikhawmta uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, Bethlehem atun un, akhozang un aling ua, numeite'n, "Hiai Naomi ahi maw?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Naomi hon chi kei un. Mara hon chi zaw un, Bangkim hihtheipa'n lah khatak in ahon hihta ngal a," achi hi.

"Buchingtak in ka pawt a, ToUPA'N avuak in hon pi nawn hi. TOUPA'N ka tung ah alungkimlouhna ahihlang a, Bangkim hihtheipa'n ahon hihgentheihdan theigige napi a bangziak a Naomi hon chi lailai na hi ua?" achi hi.
Huchi in Naomi ahong kik a, amounu Moab mi Ruth toh Moab gam a pan ahong kik uhi. Barli buhlak pat tung lai in Bethlehem atung uhi.
Huan Naomi in apasal tanau, Elimelek beh, mineizoutak tanau anei a; amin Boaz ahi.
Moab mi Ruth in Naomi kiang ah, "Lou ah ka va hoh dia, buhsang ka va zong ding aw, hon deihsakmi kuate hiam va tuak moh lou ka hi,” achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hoh in, ka tanu," achi hi.
Huchi in ahohta a, buh la mite lakmaih ava zong a; huchi in Elimelek beh Boaz lou ah ava hoh kha geih hi.
Huchi in ngai in, Bethlehem a pan Boaz ava hoh a, buh la mite kiang ah, “Na kiang uah TOUPA om hen," achi hi. Amau, “TOUPA'N nang hon vualzawl hen,” chi in adawng uhi.
Huchi in Boaz in asikha, buh la mite tung a heutu kiang ah, “Hiai kua nungaknou ahia oi?” achi hi.
Abuh la mite tung a heutu asikha in, "Moab nungaknou, Moab gam a pan Naomi toh hong pai ahi.

Ama'n, 'hon hehpih inla, na buhsang ka zong dia, buh la mite'n abuhphal uh alakkhawm khit chiang un ka zong zel ding aw' achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai a, inn a tomchik a-om chih louh zingsang a pan a-om nilouh hi," chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in Boaz in Ruth kiang ah, "Ka tanu, ngai dih, buhsang zong in lou dang ah hoh ke'nla, hiai a pan paisuan ke'n. Ka sikha nungakte kiang ah om gige in.
Abuhlak uh en gige inla, anung uh sui zel in. Tangvalte nang bangmah hon chih lou ding in thu ka pevekta hi. Na dangtak peuh chiang in tuibel a tangvalte tui tawisa dawn zel in," achi hi.
Huchi in akun a, lei si in abokkhup a, akiang ah, "Namdang hinapi ing a, nang hichibang a na hon theihnop a, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan bangchidan ahia?" achi hi.

Boaz in adawng a, akiang ah, "Na pasal sih nungsiah na pi tung a na thilhihdan tengteng mi'n ahon hilh vek uh. Na nu leh na pa leh na pianna gam paisan atum a lam a na mi theih ngeilouhte kiang a na hong paidante leng.
TOUPA'N na thilhih hon din henla, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, kihumbitna dia akha nuai na muan in kipahman tampi hon pia hen," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka toupa, na mitmuh in deihsakna ka tang a, na hon lungmuan a, na sikha nungakte lak a mi hi kei mah leng, na sikhanu hoihtak in na hon houpihta ngal a,” achi hi.

An nek hun in Boaz in akiang ah, "Hong pai inla, tanghoute hong ne sam inla, tanghou themte uain thuk ah hong diah in,” achi hi. Huchi in buh la mite kiang ah atu a; buhkan apia a; ane a, anek nung in leng akhamval lai hi.
Buhsang zong dia adin nawn in, Boaz in atangvalte kiang ah, "Buhphalte lak ah leng tawmsak zel unla, tai kei un.
Alomte leng dohkhiaksak unla, nutsiat zel unla, tom henla, tai kei un," chỉ in thu apia hi.
Huchi in lou a buhsang nitaklam tan in azong hi. Azonsa akhen a, barli buh ephah khat hiamtak apha hi.
Avan kisuan in khopi ah apaita hi. Api in abuhsang zon ana mu a; ama'n anek kham val asitte asuahkhia a, apia hi.

Api in akiang ah, "Tuni a koilam a buhsang zong na hia? Koi ah ahia na va sep? Ahon na theinuampa vualzawl in om hen," achi hi. Ama'n kua kiang ah ahia ava sep chih api ahilh hi. "Tuni a nna ka va sepna pa min Boaz ahi,” achi hi.
Naomi in amounu kiang ah, "TOUPA, mihing leh misi tung a ahehpihna tawp tuan ngei lou in amah vualzawl hen,” achi hi. Naomi in akiang ah, "Huai mi, i kinaihpih, i tanau bul ei ve,” achi hi.
Moab mi Ruth in, "Kei kiang a leng hon chi ei ve,” achi hi.
Naomi in amounu Ruth kiang ah, "Ka tanu, lou dang a ahon muh hetlouhna ding in asikha nungakte lak ngen ah pai lechin ahoih ding," achi hi.
Huchi in barli buh leh buhpi lak khit mateng Boaz sikha nungakte lak kia ah buhsang zong in ahoh a, api kiang ah ateng hi.
Huan api Naomi, apasal nu'n akiang ah, "Ka tanu, nang a ding in khawlna ka hon zonsak kei dia hia, huchi in nang a ding in ahoih ding hi.
I tanaupa Boaz, asikha nungakte toh nna na sepna pa om hilou hia? Ngai in, tuzan in phual ah barli buh azapsiang ding hi.
Huchi in kisil inla, thau kinilh inla, na kizepna puan silh inla, phual ah va hohsuk in. Himahleh an ne a, adawn khit masiah akiang ah kitheisak ke'n.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, alup chiang in alupna chiamteh inla, lut inla, akhe lem inla, va lum in. Ama'n na hih ding ahon hilh ding," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Na gen teng ka hih ding," achi hi.
Huchi in phual ah ahohsuk a, api hilh bang in ava hihta hi.
Boaz in an ne a, adawn khit in alungtang akipak a, buhvum bul a lum ding in apaita a, huan, minu leng awlawl in ahong pai a, akhe alem a, alumta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, akhe kiang ah numei khat ana lumta mai a, zan lai in huai mipa kiguih in akihei hi.
Ama'n, "Kua na hia?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikhanu Ruth ka hi. Huchi in na sikhanu na puan hon zawn in, ka tanau bul lah na hi ngal a," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka tanu, TOUPA'N nang hon vualzawl hen. Tangval zawng hiam, hausa hiam na zuih louh in atung lai sang in anunglam ah hoihna na hihlang zaw hi.
Huchi in ka tanu, lau ke'n. Na gen bang in na tung ah ka hih ding. I khua a mi tengteng in numei kizentak na hi chih athei vek ngal ua.
Kitanau nai i hi ngut hi. Himahleh kei sang a naizaw a-om hi.

Tuzan zaw om peuhmah inla, zingchiang zingsang in na tung a ama'n atanau hih ding ahihnopleh ahoih hi. Himahleh tanau hih ding na tung a ahihnop keileh, tanau hih ding pen TOUPA ahin bang in ke'n ka hih ding. Zingsang tan lum nilouh in,” achi hi.
Huchi in zingsang tan in akhebul ah alum hi. Kuamah akimuh chet theih ma in athoukhia hi. Ama'n, "Phual ah numei a hong chih himhim kuamah in thei kei hen," achi hi.
Akiang ah, "Na puansilh la inla, doh in," achi hi. Huchi in adoh a, barli buh tehna guk atehsak a, asuan a; huchi in khua ah apaita hi.
Api kiang atun in, "Ka tanu, bang na hong chi a?" ana chi hi. Ama'n, huai mipa in atung a thil ana hih tengteng ahilhta hi.
"Hiai barli buh tehna guk ahon pia a, 'na pi kiang ah avuak in pai ke'n,' ahon chi," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka tanu, bangchibang in ahia thil ahong om ding na theih ma in tu maimai in. Tuni a hiai thil ahih khit mateng huai mipa dai mai lou ding ahi," achi hi.

Huchi in Boaz kulh kongpi ah ahohtou a, huai ah atu hi. Ngai in, atanau bul uh atungtang thu Boaz in agen ahong pai hi. Huai mi kiang ah, "Eh! Nang na hi maw! Hong pai inla, hong tu dih ve," achi hi. Amah hong pai in atuta hi.
Huai khua a upate lak a mi sawm api a, akiang uah, "Hiai ah tu dih ua," achi a, huchi in amau atuta uhi.
Atanau bul uh kiang ah, "Moab gam a pan hong kik Naomi in i unaupa Elimelek gam azuak hi.

Huchi in khomite mitmuh leh ka mite upate mitmuh in lei in. Na tat nopleh tan in. Himahleh na tatnop keileh ka theihtheihna ding in hon hilh in. Nang lou lah kuamah atan dia kilawm a-om ngal kei ua. Nang zom in kei ka hi chih nang hon theihsak kiphamoh in ka thei,” achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka tan ding," achi hi.
Boaz in, "Naomi khut a pan huai gam na lei ni'n, misi zi, Moab numei Ruth a pan misi min bei lou a, agouluah ding mi a-om zel theihna ding in na lei tel ding ahi," achi hi.
Atanau bulpa in, "Kei a ding in zaw ka tan thei kei. Huchi lou in zaw keimah gouluah ka mansuah kha ding. Ka tattheihna nang tang mai in. Ke'n zaw tan thei lou ka himai hi,” achi hi.
Nidanglai a Israelte lak a thil bangkim ahihkipna ding ua akitatdan uleh akikhendan uh hichi ahi. Khedap aphel ua, avengte uh apia ua, huai Israelte lak a ahihdan uh ahi.
Huchi in atanau bulpa un Boaz kiang ah, "Nang a ding in lei zaw in," achi hi. Huchi in akhedap aphelta hi.
Boaz in upate leh mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Tuni in noute Elimelek thil neih tengteng leh Kilon leh Mahlon thil neih tengteng Naomi khut a pan ka lei chih theihpihtute na hi uh.
Huai kia hilou in misi min amanlouhna ding in Moab numei Ruth, Mahlon zi ka zi ding in ka lei a, huai, tuni in noute atheihpihtute na hi uh," achi hi.

Kulh kongpi a mipi tengteng leh upate'n, "Theihpihtute ka hi uh. Na inn a numei hong lut Rakil leh Leah, Israel inkuan dingsak nihte bang in TOUPA'N bawl hen. Nang Ephrathah ah suanhuaitak in hong om inla, Bethlehem ah minthangtak in hong om in.
TOUPA'N hiai nungaknou a pan suan ahon bawlsak ding ziak in na inkuan uh Tamar in Judah asuansak Perez inkuan bang hong hi hen," achi uhi.
Huchi in Boaz in Ruth api a, azi ahong hita hi. Huchi in akithuahpih a, TOUPA'N nau apaisak a, tapa anei hi.
Numeite'n Naomi kiang ah, "Tuni mahmah a tanau nai bei a hon omsak lou, TOUPA phat in om hen. Israelte lak ah amin hong thang hen.
Amah na hinna tungdingpa leh na tek lam a hon vakpa ahong hi dia; na mounu nang hon itnu, tapa sagihte sang a nang a dia hoih in amah lah asuangta ngal a," achi uhi.
Naomi in nau ala a, apom a, adonta hi.
A-inveng numeite'n amin aphuak ua, "Naomi a ding in tapa ahong piangta," chi in amin Obed asa uhi. Amah, David pa Jesse pa ahi.
Hiaite Perez suante ahi uh. Perez in Hezron asuang;
Hezron in Ram asuang; Ram in Amminadab asuang;
Amminadab in Nashon asuang a, Nashon in Salmon asuang;
Salmon in Boaz asuang a, Boaz in Obed asuang;
Obed in Jesse asuang a, Jesse in David asuang hi.
Late la, Solomon' a.
Atawpna kam in hon tawp hen aw! Na itna lah uain sang in ahoihzaw ngal a.
Na kinuhte'n gimlim hoihtak anei a, na min kinuh butkhiak bang ahi a, huaiziak in nungak siangthoute'n nang ahon it uhi.
Hon kai in, nang ka hon delh ding; kumpipa'n adantante sung ah ahon pita a, nang ah ka kipak un nuam ka sa ding uh, uain sang in na itna ka genkhe mun zaw ding ua; adikte'n nang ahon it uhi.
Ka vom a, himahleh ka mel ahoih hi, Aw nou Jerusalem tanute, Kedar puaninte bang, Solomon puankhaite bang.
Ka vom ziak in hon en ke'n, ni in ahon hai ziak in. Ka nu tapate ka tung ah athangpai ua, grephuante kem in ahon bawl ua; himahleh keimah grephuan leng ka kem kei.
Hon hilh ve, aw nang ka kha in a-it, na ganhon vakna mun, sun lai a na khawlsakna mun; bang ding a na kithuahpihte lak a ganhon kiang a maituam bang a kei om ding ka hia?
Na theih keileh, Aw nang numeite lak a kilawmpen, ganhonte khapte zui in kuankhia inla, belamchingte puanin kiang ah na kelnoute vak in.
Aw ka it, Pharaoh kangtalaite lak a sakol toh ka hon teh hi.
Na kicheinate toh na biang akilawm a, na ngawng suangmantam khite toh.
Dangka-eng samphekte dangka siatte toh ka hon bawlsak ding uh.
Kumpipa adohkan a atut lai in, ka spiknardi gimlim in anamtuina asawlkhia.
Ka ngaihnou kei a ding in murrah gimlim bang ahi a, ka nawite kikal a om.
Ka ngaihnou kei a ding in Engedi grephuante a henna pak bawk bang ahi.
Ngai in, na kilawm, ka it; ngai in, na kilawm; na mitte vahui bang ahi uh.
Ngai in, na kilawm ka ngaihnou, ahi, anuam; i tutna nem leng ahing.
Sidar singte i inkamte ahi a, i insunte meilah singte ahi.
Sharon pak ka hi, phaizang lili pak.
Ling lak a lili pak bang in, huchibang in tanute lak ah ka it a-om hi.
Gamlak singte lak a epul kung bang in, huchibang in tapate lak ah ka ngaihnou a-om hi. Nakpi a kipahna toh aliim nuai ah ka tu a, agah ka chep in akhum hi.
Ankuangluina inn ah ahon pi a, ka tung a kizak puanlap a-itna ahi.
Grep phoukeu in hon khou unla, epul thei in hon nem un; zawlngai in ka chi ana ngal a.
Akhut veilam ka lu nuai ah a-om a, akhut taklam in ahon kawi hi.
Zuktal leh gam a zukpite ka hon ngen hi, Aw Jerusalem tanute, ka it hihbuai kei unla, phawng kei un, alungkim matan.
Ka ngaihnou aw! Ngai un, ahong hi, tangte tung ah atawm a, mual tungte ah adiang hi.
Ka ngaihnou zaw zuktal hiam ahihkeileh sakhi tuailai bang ahi; Ngai in, ka kulhbaang nunglam uah adingh a, tohlette ah a-en a, anannate ah amah akimusak.
Ka ngaihnou in thu agen a, ka kiang ah, "Pasal thou in, ka it, ka kilawmnou, hong pai meng in," achi hi.
Ngai in, phalbi lah abeita ngal a, vuah atheuta a, apaimangta hi;
Leitung ah pakte hong kilang a; vasate lasak hun ahong tung a, i gam uah vakhu aw akizata hi.
Theipi kung in gahhingte aminsak a, grep guite apaklun uhi, agimlimte uh asuaksak uhi. Thou ve, ka it, ka kilawmnou hong pai meng in.
Mun sang a suangpi heng a om, vakhu bang na hi, na mel hon musak inla, na aw hon zasak in, na aw akhum a, na mel ahoih hi.
Sehalte, grephuan hihsia, sehal neute hon matsak ve; ka grephuan uh apaklun ngal a.
Ka ngaihnou kei a ahi, kei amah a ka hi; lili pak lak ah aganta aching a,
Ni ahong nem a, limliapte aman matan, ka ngaihnou, kihei inla, Bether mual tung a zuktal hiam sakhi tuailai bang in om in.
Zan a ka lupna tung a ka ihmut in, ka mang in ka it ka mu hi; amah ka zongzong a, himahleh ka mu kei.
Ka thou ding a, khopi kim ah ka pai dia, kongzing leh lampi ah, amah ka kha in a-it ka zong ding, ka chi a ka zong hi, himahleh amah muh zoh in a-omta kei.
Khopi a vialpai veng mite'n ahon mu ua; akiang uah, "Amah ka kha in a-it na mu uhia?" ka chi a.
Amaute ka paisan sawt louchik ahi, huan amah ka kha in a-it ka mu hi; ka paisak kei, ka nu insung, hon painu dantan sung a amah ka pilut masiah.
Zuktal leh gam a zukpite in ka hon ngen hi, Aw Jerusalem tanute aw, ka it hihbuai kei unla, phawng kei un, alungkim matan.
Gamdai a kipan a meikhu kitung bang a hong pai murrah leh begaw kinuh a, sumsinmi nuhngou vui kinuh hiai kua ahia?
Ngai in, Solomon lupna ahi; akim ah mihat sawmguk, Israel mihatte a kipan a-om uh.
Namsau atawi chiat ua, kidouna a kivate ahi uhi. Michih in apheipi tung ah namsau atawi chiat ua, zan a launa ziak in.
Kumpipa Solomon in Lebanon sing in kangtalai akibawl hi.
Huai a khuamte dangka in abawl a, anuai dangka-eng, atutphah asandup, alaizang, Jerusalem tanute a kipan a- itna toh aphah ahi.
Aw nou Zion tanute, pawtkhia unla, kumpipa Solomon en un, azineih ni leh alungtang kipahna ni a, anu'n amah lallukhu akhuksak toh.
Ngai in, na kilawm hi, ka it; ngai in, na kilawm hi; na maituamna liah ah na mitte vahui bang ahi ua; na sam kelhon bang ahi, Gilead tang pang a kualte.
Na hate mulmet thak belamnu hon bang ahi ua, sil khit phet a hong paitoute; huai ah amaute chiat in phik anei ua, alak ua kuamah aching a-om kei uh.
Na mukte khau san-au abang ua, na kam akilawm a; na mit laivomte theibuhfai them bang ahi, na maituamna liah ah.
Na ngawng David galvan koihna insang kilam bang ahi, lumbem neute sangkhat kikhaina mun, mihat lum in akivan uh.
Na nawite zuktal nou nih phikte abang ua, lili pak lak a tate.
Ni anem a limliap aman mateng murrah tang ah leh, begaw mual ah ka hoh ding.
Na kilawm hi, ka it; nang ah thilnin bangmah a-om kei hi.
Lebanon a kipan hon zui in, ka mou, Lebanon a pan kei toh, Amana vum a kipan dak in, Shenir leh Hermon vum a kipan, humpinelkaite kua a kipan, gialbemte mual a kipan.
Ka lungtang na tuahmangta, ka sanggamnu, ka mou; na mitte lak a khat in ka lungtang na tuahmangta hi, na ngawng a khainiang khat in.
Na itna kilawm na tel e, ka sanggamnu, ka mou! Na itna uain sang in nakpi in ahoihzaw! Na kinuh gim, gimlim chiteng sang in ahoihzaw.
Na mukte, Aw ka mou, khuaikhak bang in atakkhia a; na lei nuai ah khuaizu leh nawitui a-om; na puansilh gim Lebanon gim ahi.
Huan umsuak ka sanggamnu, ka mou; tui nak kihu, tui kivuh.
Na huansung theibuhfai, gah manphate toh ahi; spiknardi sing suan toh henna pak ahi.
Spiknardi leh pak gimlim, kepbuk leh singnamtui begaw sing tengteng; murrah leh aloe, gimlim pipen teng toh.
Huan atuikhuk na hi a, tuihing lui, Lebanon a kipan a lui luangte.
Khanglou in, Aw mallam huih; huan hong in, nang simlam; ka huan tung ah hong nung in, Na gimnamtuite aluankhiak theihna ding in. Ka ngaihnou ahuansung ah hong pai henla, atheigah manphate ne hen aw.

Ka huansung ah ka hong pai hi, ka sanggamnu, ka mou; ka murrah ka gimnamtui toh ka lakhawmta; ka khuaikhak ka khuaizu toh ka neta a; ka uain ka nawitui toh ka dawnta. Aw, lawmte. Ne un; dawn un, ahi, tampi dawn un, Aw ka ngaihnou.

Ka ihmu a, himahleh ka lungtang ahak; Tua aw, ka ngaihnou kiuhna aw ahi. Pasal' Hon hon in, ka sanggamnu, ka it, ka vahui, ka nin baang lou; ka lutang daitui in adim a, ka samtum lah zan a tui tak in.
Ka puanak tung ka suahta a; bangchi in ka silh nawn dia? Ka khepekte ka silta a; bangchi in ka hihnin dia?
Ka ngaihnou in kongkhak awng ah akhut ahon golhlut a, amah ziak in ka lungtang hihlin in a-om hi.
Ka ngaihnou hon ding in ka thouta a; ka khutte murrah in atak a, ka khutzungte murrah tui in, kalhna hekna tung ah.
Ka ngaihnou ka honta a; himahleh ka ngaihnou ana kik nawn a, a-omta kei hi. Thu agen lai in ka kha in ahon zuausan a; amah ka zong a, himahleh hon dawng kei hi.
Khopi a vialvak veng mite'n ahon mu ua, ahon khen ua, ahon liamsak uh; kulhbaang ngakte'n ka puanak ahon lakmangsak uh.
K'on ngen ahi, Aw Jerusalem tanute, Ka ngaihnou na muh uleh, zawlngai in ka chi ana chih, amah na hilh un aw.
Na ngaihnou, ngaihnou dang sang a atuansemna bang ahia? Aw nang numeite lak a kilawmpen? Na ngaihnou, ngaihnou dang sang a atuansemna bang ahia, huchibang na hon nget?
Ka ngaihnou zaw asan hiuhiau a, singkhat lak a makai lianpen ahi.
Alutang dangka-eng hoihpen abang a, asamtumte alian a, va-ak bang in avom hi.
Amitte luita tui kiang a vahui bang ahi a; nawitui a sil, kituaktak a bulh ahi.
Abiangte gimnamtui omna bang ahi a, loupa gimlim bang; amukte lili pak bang ahi a, murrah tui takkhesak in.
Akhutte dangka-eng zungbuh beril suangmantam siatna bang ahi; apumpi saiha a bawl sapphir suangmantam a luan bang ahi.
Akhete suangpak khuam, dangka-eng hoihte kuak a kitung bang ahi; Akilatdan Lebanon bang, sidar bang a thupi ahi.
Akam akhum penpen a; ahi, angaihhuai tuntun hi. Hiai ka ngaihnou ahi a, hiai ka lawm ahi. Aw Jerusalem tanute.
Na ngaihnou koilam a pai ahia, Aw nang numeite lak a kilawm penpen? Amah na ngaihnou koilam a kiheita ahia, amah ka hon zonpih theihna ding un?
Ka ngaihnou ahuan ah ahohsuk a, gimnamtui mun ah, huansung a vak in, lili pak lakhawm ding in.
Ka ngaihnou a ka hi a, ka ngaihnou kei a ahi; lili pak lak ah aganta aching hi.
Na kilawm hi, Aw ka it, Tirzah bang a kilawm, Jerusalem bang a deihhuai, na lauhuaina sepaih pawl puanlapte bang in ahi.
Kei a kipan na mitte lakik in, amau lah ahon zouta ua. Na sam Gilead pang a kual kelhon bang ahi.
Na hate belamnuhon bang ahi ua, sil khit phet a hong paitoute; huai ah amaute chiat in phik anei ua, alak uah kuamah aching a-om kei uh.
Na mit laivomte theibuhfai them na maituamna liah a om bang ahi.
Kumpinu sawmguk a-om ua, mei sawmgiat, huan nungak siangthou sim seng louh.
Ka vahui, ka nin baang lou, khat kia ahi; anu lak a amah kia ahi; amah suang lak a ahoihpen ahi. Tanute'n amah amu ua, nuamsa achi uhi, ahi, kumpinute leh ameite'n amah aphat uhi.
Zingsang bang a dakkhia amah kua ahia? khapi bang a kilawm, ni bang a siang, sepaihhon puanlap bang a lauhuai?
Makhatang huan ah ka paisuak a, phaizang a sing suan hingte en ding in, grep apakmum hiam chih leh theibuhfai apakpalhta hiam chih en ding in.
Ahihkeileh ka theihkhiak ma in ka kha in ka lunglutna ka mipite kangtalai lak ah ahon koihta hi.
Hong kik in, hong kik in, aw Shulam mi; hong kik in, hong kik in, ka hon ettheihna ding un. Numei' Bangziak a Mahanaim mite lam en bang a Shulam mi en ding na hi ua?
Khedap tung nei lou ah na khepekte kilawm hi na mahmah e, Aw kumpi tanu; na phei guhtuah suangmantam bang ahi ua, nasem mipil khut nasep bang.
Na lai noubem bang ahi, huai ah uain hel akitasam ngei kei a; na gilpi huit buh hum lili pak siat dim abang hi.
Na nawi zuktal nou nih phik abang uhi.
Na ngawng saiha insang abang; na mitte Barthrabbim kongpi a, Heshbon a om dilte abang uh; na nak Lebanon a insang abang a Damaskas lam muhsukna om.
Na tung a na lutang Karmel abang a, na lu a sam sandup abang; huai sampha lak ah kumpipa sal a mat in a-om hi.
Aw it, kipahna ding in nak kilawm in nak nop hi na mahmah chia!
Na sandan tum sing bang ahi a, na nawite grep gahbomte bang.
tum sing ah ka kaltou ding a, huai a hiangte ka len ding, ka chi a; na nawi grepgui gahbom bang hi henla, huan na nawi gim epul bang;
Na kam uain hoihpen pen abang hi. Numei' Ka ngaihnou a dia nemtak a paisuk, ihmute muk a tolh paisuak.
Ka ngaihnou a ka hi a, adeihlam kei lam ah a-om.
Hong in, ka ngaihnou, gam ah i paikhe ding a; khoneute ah i giak ding.
Grephuan lam ah zingkhang in i thou ding a; Grepgui apakmumta hia, apakpalh akihongta hia i va en ding, huan theibuhfai apakkheta hia; huai ah ka itna ka hon pe ding hi.
Zawlzongpak in gimnamtui asuaksak a, ka kongkhak uah thei manpha chikim, athak leh alui a-om, nang a ding in ka na kholkhawm, aw ngaihnou.
Aw ka nu nawi ne, ka unaupa bang hi lechin maw! Polam a ka hon muhleh, ka hon tawp ding; Ahi, kuamah in ahon musit kei ding uh.
Nang ka hon pi ding a, ka nu inn sung ah ka hon lalut ding a, ama'n kei ahon hilh ding; uain namtui ka hon dawnsak ding a, ka theibuhfai tuining.
Akhut veilam ka lu nuai ah a-om ding a, akhut taklam in ahon kawi ding hi.
K'on ngen hi, Aw Jerusalem tanute, ka it, hihbuai kei unla, phawng kei un, alungkim matan.
Gamdai a kipan a hong tou hiai angaihnou tung a kingai kua ahia? Numei' Epul sing nuai ah ka hon phawng a; huai ah na nun nang ahon vei a, huai ah nang hon piangsak amah nauvei in a-om hi.
Na lungtang a suai bang in, na ban a suai bang in kei hon koih in; itna lah sihna bang in ahat ngal a; han bang in agilou a; huai a kuangte meikuang TOUPA meikuang bang ahi uhi.
Tui tampi in itna aphelh thei kei a, tui khangte'n atum thei kei hi; itna ziak in min a-inn a vante pe ding hitaleh, nakpitak a muhsit in a-om ding hi.
Sanggamnu neu ka nei ua, nawi anei kei. Atungtang kigen ni in ka sanggamnu uh a ding in bang ka hih ding ua?
Kulhbaang hileh bel, amah tung ah dangka insang neu khat ka lam ding ua; kongkhak hitaleh, amah sidar singpek in ka sungkhum ding uh.
Kulhbaang ka hi a, ka nawite huai a insang bang ahi uh; huchih lai in mi muanna musa bang in amit ah ka om hi.
Baal-hamon ah Solomon in grephuan anei hi; kem mite kiang ah grephuan akhelsak a; huai a agah a ding in michih in dangka sangkhat ngen ahon tawi ding uh ahi.
Grephuan, kei a ahi a, ka ma ah a-om; aw Solomon, nang, sang na nei ding a, huai a theigah kemte'n zanih.
Nang huante sung a teng, na kithuahpihte'n na aw angai ua, huai hon zasak in.
Kin meng in, ka ngaihnou, gimlim mual tung a zuktal hiam sakhi tuailai hiam bang in om in.
Paul, Pathian sikha leh Jesu Khrist sawitak, Pathian mitelte, aginna uh lamtou ding leh Pathian limsakna toh kithuah thutak theisak ding a sem in;
huai tangtawn hinna lametna a kinga, Pathian zuaugen thei lou in khovel om ma a achiam,
himahleh amah huntak ah thugenna zang in athu ahihlangta, huai thugenna Pathian i Hondampa thupiak bang zel a kepsak ka hi.
Ginna kibang a ka tapa diktak Titas kiang ah, Pathian leh Khrist Jesu i Hondampa kiang a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna leh khamuanna om hen.
Hiai ziak in ahi huai Kret tuikulh a nang ka hon nutsiat, thilhih zoh nailouhte na hihzoh theihna ding leh thu ka hon piak bang a, khua teng a upate na sehtheihna ding in.
Upa ding zaw gensiatbei, zi khat nei, tate Pathian gingta, nopsak bawl luatna lamsang a gensiat loh lou, dan bang lou a om lou, nei ahih peuhmah uleh,
saptuam heutu Pathian nasep enkaimi ahih ziak in gensiatbei ahih ding ahi; migenhak, lunggam, uain khamhat, mivuak hat, punna nin a huaihammi hi ding hilou ahi.
Mi kipahpihdan siam, hoih lam deih, lungsim diktak, midiktat, misiangthou, kidektheimi ahih ding ahi.
Asinsa thuhilhna dik midang sinsak thei leh selhat mite siam louh tangsak thei ding a sinsak a om thugin muanhuai lenkip mi ahi ding hi.
Dan bang lou a om, thu mawk gengen leh mikhem chingmi tampi, abik in zeksumte lak a mi a-om uhi.
Huai mite kam humsak ding ahi, punna nin deih ziak a thuhilh louh ding hilh in, mite a-inkuankuan un apisia uhi.
Amaute lak a mi azawlnei khat un houh: "Kret tuikulh a mite zaw zuautheite, gamsa giloute, thadah anhaite ahi uh," achi hi.
Hiai theihpihna adik ahi. Huaiziak in ginna a adiktheihna ding un leh,
Judate tangthu phuahtawmte a kisubuai lou ding leh thutak nungngatsan nakte thupiak alimsaklouhna ding un naktak in taihilh in.
Siangthoute a ding in bangkim asiangthou hi; himahleh minin leh gingloute a ding in bangmah siangthou a-om kei, alungsim uh asia-le-pha theihna uh leng anin hi.
Pathian thei akichi ua, himahleh athilhih un anawlkhin nak uhi. Kihhuaite, thumangloute, thil hoih sep ding peuhmah a deihlouhte ahi uhi.
Nang zaw thuhilhna hoih toh kituak thu gen in.
Putekte kidek thei, zahtakhuai, lungsim hoihtak, ginna leh itna leh kuhkalna a diktak hi ding in hanthawn in.
Pitekte leng huchibang in, sianthouna toh kimeh, khohei a zahdan siam ding leh heh hat lou, uain hai lou, thil hoihte zilsakte hi zaw ding in hanthawn in.
Nungak deuhte tuh apasalte uh leh atate uh it ding leh lungsim hoihtak pu a om ding a ahilhtheihna ding un,
Pathian thu gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in theisiamtak a kithunun thei, beven lou, amau insung kem hiathiat, chingkam leh apasalte thuthu a om ding a athuhilh theihna ding in.
Huai bang in, tangvalte lungsim hoihtak pu ding in hasuan in.
Thil bangkim a thil hoih hih lam a etton ding in kibawl inla; na thugin sinsakna ah diktatna, chihtakna leh,
gensiat vual louh paukamte langsak lechin alehlam a nang hon demte'n nang tungtang thu a thusia gen ding nei lou a azumtheihna ding un.
Sikhate, apute uh sel lou a athuthu a om ding leh bangkim a akipahna ding ua om ding in thuhilh in.
Pathian i hondampa thuhilhna thu bangkim a akilawmsak theihna ding un, khut them nei lou ding, muanhuai a nna hoih tengteng hihlang zaw ding in sinsak in.
Mi tengteng kiang ah hotdamna hon tun in i Pathian hehpihna ahong tungta hi.
Pathian limsaklouhna leh khovel duhgawlna tawpsan in, tulai khovel ah kidek leh diktattak leh Pathian limsak in i om ding uh chih theisak in.
Lametna kipahhuai, i Pathian thupi leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist thupina kilakna ngak in.
Ama'n tatlekna tengteng lak a kipan in ahon tattheihna ding in leh chitel tuam, thil hoih hih a phatuamngai, amah a ding a ahihsiangthou theihna ding in i sik in akipeta hi.
Thuneitak in huai thute hilh inla, hanthawn inla, taihilh in. Kuamah in nang hon musit kei uhen.
Vaihawmte leh thuneite nuai a kitahlut a thumang ding leh thil hoih chiteng sem ding a mansa a om ding in sinsak inla,
kuamah gensiatlouhdan ding, vuallemtak a omdan ding, mi tengteng lak a thunuailutna chiteng hihlang a, nunnem ding in amaute theikhe thaksak nawn in.
Ei leng nidanglai in mihai, thumang lou, khem a om, utna leh kipahna chiteng sem, gilou leh hazat hat a om, kihhuai leh kihotuahte i hi uhi.
Himahleh Pathian, i hondampa migitdan leh mihing tung a a-itdan ahong kilat lai in,
diktatna a i thilhihte ziak hilou, azahngaihna ziak a pianthakna a sawp in leh Kha Siangthou a thaksakna in eite ahon hondamta hi.
Huai Kha Siangthou, Jesu Khrist i Hondampa ziak in nakpitak in i tung ah asungbota hi.
Huchi a ahehpihna a siamtansak a om in, lametna a tangtawn hinna gouluahte i hihtheihna ding in.
Hiai thugen adik ahi. Hiai thilte na phut tinten ka hon deih hi, huchi a Pathian gingtasate'n thil hoih hih ding a apilvan theihna ding un; hiaite mihingte a ding in ahoih in aphatuam uhi.
Himahleh dotna haihuai, khangthu suina, kiselna, dan thu a kilaina nungngatsan in; huaite thil phatuam lou leh bangmah lou ahi.
Ginna tuam neimi zaw khatvei nihvei hilh nung in deih ke'n.
Huchibang mi lampial leh gilou ahi chih thei in, amah mah siam louh akitangsak ahi.
Artemas hiam, Taikikas hiam, na kiang a ka hon sawl chiang in, Nikopolis ah ka kiang ah hong pai teitei in; hiai mun a phalbi zat ka tum hi.
Dansiam, Zenas leh Apollos azinna ua bangkim ataksaplouhna ding un, phatuamngaitak in na panpih un.
I mite'n leng ataksap khawktakte uh asuktuah theihna ding un leh gah lou a a-omlouhna ding un thil hoih hih a kuhkal ding in zil uhen.
Ka kiang a om tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi. Ginna a kei hon itte chibai hon buksak in. Na vek ua kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
Darias akum nihna, akha giatna in, iddo tapa, Berekiah tapa, Zekariah, zawlnei kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
"Na pipute uh tung ah TOUPA nakpitak in alungkim kei hi," chi in.
Huaiziak in nang akiang uah, huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Ka kiang ah hong kik un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, huan na kiang uah ka hong kik ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.

Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, "Tu in na omdan gilou ua kipan leh na thilhih giloute ua kipan hong kik un," chi a zawlnei masate'n agenna uh, na pipute uh bang in om kei un; himahleh amau hon za kei ua, hon ngaikhe sam kei uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Na pipute uh tua koi a omta ahi ua? Huan azawlneite uh tangtawn in ahing uhia?

Himahleh ka thute leh ka dan thusehte, ka sikha zawlneite thupiak a ka piakte, huaite'n na pipute uh delhphata uh ahi kei maw? Huan akihei ua, "Sepaihte' TOUPA'N i tung ua hih dia angaihtuah bang in, i omdan bang zel in leh i thilhihte bang zel a i tung ua hih ahita ve," achi uhi.
Darias akum nihna, Sebat kha, akha sawm-le-khat, ani sawmnih-le-li ni in, Iddo tapa, Berekiah tapa Zekariah, zawlnei kiang ah, TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
"Zan in mengmuhna in mi khat sakol san tung a tuang, munliap a om muisingte lak a dingh ka mu a, anunglam ah sakolte a-om ua, asan, asanpuang leh angou ahi uhi.
Huchi in 'Aw ka toupa, hiaite bang ahi ua?' ka chi a, huan kei hon houpih angel in ka kiang ah, ‘Hiaite bang ahi ua ka hon ensak ding,' achi hi.
Huai muising lak a dingpa'n adawng a, 'Hiaite leitung a kivialleh a vak dia TOUPA'N asawlte ahi uh,' achi hi.
"Huchi in huai muising lak a dingh TOUPA angel adawng ua, 'Leitung ah kivialleh in ka vakta ua, ngai in, leitung tengteng atu kinken a, akhawl dide hi,' " achi uhi.
Huan TOUPA angel in adawng a, "Aw sepaihte' TOUPA, hiai kum sawmsagih na hehkhum, Jerusalem tung leh Judah khopite tung ah bang tan zahngaihna nei lou ding na hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N thuhoihte, thu lungmuanhuaite a kei hon houpih angel adawng hi.
Huchi in kei hon houpih angel in ka kiang ah, hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Thikthu setak in Jerusalem leh Zion ka deihthoh ahi, chi in nang kikou in, chi in.
Huan bangmah awlmoh lou namte tung ah ka lungkim kei ding a; neukha lel a ka lung hih louh lai in, siatna athupisak semsem uhi.
Huaiziak in hichibang in TOUPA'N achi: Zahngaihnate toh Jerusalem ah ka kik nawnta a, asung ah inn lam ahi ding," chi in.
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Hauhsakna ziak in ka khopite akiphalh ding a; TOUPA'N Zion alungmuan in, Jerusalem atel lai ding hi, chi in kikou behlap lai in," chi in.
Huan ka dak a, ngai in kii li ka mu hi.
Kei hon houpih angel kiang ah, "Hiaite bang hi ding ahia?" ka chi a. Ama'n, "Hiaite Judah, Israel leh Jerusalem hawlzak mite ahi uh," chi in ahon dawng hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'n siksekmi li ahon ensak hi.

Huchi in ke'n, "Bang hih dia hiaite hong uh ahi ua?" ka chi hi. Ama'n thu agen a, "Kuamah in alu adaksaklouhna dia, Judah dalhzaksak hiai kiite ahi uh; himahleh hiaite, dalhzaksak ding a Judah gam tung a akii uh sangsak namte dou ding leh akiite uh paikhe ding a hong paite ahi uh," achi hi.
Vuah nanung hun in TOUPA vuah ngen un, meipite bawlpa TOUPA mahmah, huchi in vuahphinte, gam a loupate kiang ah, amaute ape ding.

Milimte'n bangmah lou thu agen un, aisante'n zuau amu uh; mang zuauthei agen ua, athawn lel in alungmuan uh; huaiziak in belamte bang in amau lampi ah apai ua, belamchingmi a-om louh ziak in hihgim in a-om uhi.
"Belamching mite tung ah ka hehna apuakzak a, aheutute uh ka gawt ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Judah inkote, abelamte avehta a, kidouna a sakol hoih bang in amaute abawl ding hi.
Amah a kipan in aning a suang, amah a kipan puanin khetphim amah a kipan kidouna thalpeu, amah a kipan vaihawm tengteng ahong paikhe ding hi.
Kidouna a kongzing a buannawi a amelmate uh childen in, mihatte bang in a-om ding ua; akiang ua TOUPA a-om ziak in adou ding uh; sakol tung a tuangte hih lungzin in a-om ding uhi."

"Judah inkote ka hatsak ding a, Joseph inkote ka hondam ding, amaute ka hon pi nawn ding a, amau tung ah zahngaihna ka nei; huchi in ka paihkhiak het louh bang ahong hi ding uh; TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi a, amaute ka dawng ding hi.
Ephraim mite mihatpa in a-om ding ua, uain ziak in alungtang uh akipak ding a; ahi, atate un huai amu ding ua, akipak ding uh; TOUPA ah alungtang uh akipak ding hi.
Amau ka khutvan ding a, amau ka kaikhawm ding; amau ka tanta hi; apun khitsa bang un apung ding uh.
Namte lak ah hawldalh mah leng; gam gamlate ah kei ahon theigige ding uh; huchi in atate uh toh ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn ding uhi.
Aigupta gam a pan ka pi nawn ding a, Assuria a kipan ka pikik nawn ding hi; Gilead leh Lebanon gam ah amau ka pilut ding; amaute a dia mun akidaih louh dong in

gimthuakna tuipi apalkai ding ua, tuipi a tui kihawtte khet in a-om ding uh, huchi in Nile luipi thukna tengteng akang vek ding; Assuria kisaktheihna koihniam in a-om dia, Aigupta kumpi chiang apaimang vengveng ding hi.
Huan TOUPA ah amau ka hihhat ding a; amin in avaktou un avaksuk ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Aw Le Lebanon, mei in na sidar singte akattum theihna ding in na kongkhakte hong in.
Aw meilah sing, mau vongvong in, Sidar sing apukta ngal a, ahoih tatate hihsiat a a-om ziak un; Aw nou Bashan tosaw singte chiau vongvong un, gammangpi vatpaih ahita hi.
Ngai un belamching mite amau vongvong ding ua, na thupina uh loh a a-om ziak in, ngai un humpinelkai ahumham a, Jordan gammang athengta hi!
Hichibang in TOUPA ka Pathian in achi hi, "Goh ding belamhon chingpa hong hi in.
Amau leite'n athat ua, gawt in a-om kei ua; amau zuakte'n TOUPA phat in om hen! Ka hauta uh! Amau chingte'n alainat kei uhi,” achi uhi.

"Gam a tengte ka hehpih nawn kei ding, TOUPA'N achi. Himahleh ngai in mite michih a-invengte khut ah leh akumpipa khut ah ka pe ding; amau gam agawt ding ua, akhut ua kipan amaute ka hunkhe kei ding," chi in.

"Huchi in belamte a sumdawngte a dia thah ding a om belamte chingpa ka hong hita hi. Huchi in chiang nih ka kilak a; khat pen 'Deihsakna' ka chi a, adang pen 'Kizopna' ka chi; huchi in belamte ka vak hi.
Huan kha khat in belamchingmi thum ka satkhia hi. Himahleh ka kha in amau achimtak a, amau kha in leng kei ahon chimtak uhi.
Huaitak in ke'n, 'K'on vak kei ding, asi dingte, si henla, satkhiak a om dingte, satkhiak in om heh; nutsiatte khat-le-khat sa kinetuah uhen,' ka chita hi.
Huan 'Deihsakna' kichi ka chiangkhun ka la a, ka sattan a, mite tengteng toh ka thukhun ka bawl ka suksiat theihna ding in.
Huchi in huai ni in akitanta, huchi in pawlte lak ah agenthei kei hon limsakte'n TOUPA thu ahi chih athei uhi.
Ke'n akiang uah, 'Hoih a na ngaihtuah ualeh ka loh tak hon pia, un ahihkeileh, tang un,' ka chi hi. Huchi in ka loh tak ding in 'dangka shekel sawmthum' abuk uhi.
"Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, 'Ka man ding a aseh uh, man hoih belvelmi kiang ah khia in,' achi hi. Dangka shekel sawmthum ka la a TOUPA' inn a, belvelmi kiang ah ka khia hi.
Huchi in Judah leh Israel kikal a ki-unauna ka suksiat theihna ding in, ka chiangkhun dang 'Kizopna' kichi pen ka tumtan hi.
"Huan TOUPA'n ka kiang ah, 'Belamching mihai vanzatte kilak nawn in,' achi hi.

Ngai in, gamsung ah belamchingmi ka bawlkhe ding hi. Ama'n satkhiak a om dingte aveh kei dia, delhzak a om dingte leng azong sam kei dia, satkeh a omte leng ahihdam sam kei ding, ahoih leng avak sam kei dia, himahleh athaute sa ane ding a, achinte nangawn uh atolsak ding hi.
Belamhonte nusia belamchingmi phattuamna bei tung agik hi; aban tung leh amit taklam tung namsau in adou ding a; aban akeugawp kiuhkeuh ding a, amit taklam amial bikbek ding!" achi hi.
Judah tungtang a TOUPA thu kilakna: Van phalhkhia a, lei kingakna koih a, mihing sung a mihing kha koihpa, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
"Ngai in, kho kimvel a mite a ding in hoina nou in Jerusalem ka bawl ding a, Judah tung ah leng, Jerusalem lakna ah ahi ding hi.

Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mi tengteng a ding in Jerusalem suang chimtakhuai in ka bawl ding a, ama ziak a tunggik kisate nakpi in liamsak in a-om ding ua, amah dou ding in leitung a nam tengteng akikhawmkhawm ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in lamdangsakna toh sakol chih ka khen ding a, hehna toh atungtuangmi; huan Judah inkote tung ah ka mit ahak ding a mittawtna in mite sakol chih ka gawt ding hi.
Judah hausate'n alungtang un, Jerusalem a tengte'n sepaihte' TOUPA a Pathian uah hatna anei uh," achi ding uhi.

Huai ni chiang in Judah hausate sing lak a mei-am bang in ka bawl dia, buhphal lak a meisel bang in akimvel, khut taklam pang leh veilam pang a mite tengteng anegai ding uh. Jerusalem ahihleh ama mun, Jerusalem mahmah ah ahong teng nawn ding hi.
TOUPA'N amasa in Judah puaninte leng ahondam ding; David inkote thupina leh Jerusalem a tengte thupina Judah tung akiliksaklouhna ding in.
Huai ni chiang in TOUPA'N Jerusalem a tengte ahum ding a, alak ua hatloupen leng huai ni chiang in David bang ahi ding a; David inkote Pathian bang in a-om ding, ama ua pai TOUPA angel bang in.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem dou ding a hong kuan nam tengteng hihse ding in ka kuankhe ding hi.

Huan David inkote tung leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah hehpihna leh thumna kha ka sungbo ding a; asutpa uh lam a-en ding uh; amah asuun ding ua, mi'n atapa neihsun asuun bang in, mi'n ata masa khasetak a akah bang in, amah akah ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in Jerusalem ah suunna thupi a-om ding, Megiddon Phaizang a Hadad-rimmon suunna bang in.
Huan gam pumpi in asuun dia; inkuan chih in atuam in, David nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in; Nathan nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in;
Levi nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in; Shimei inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in;
inkuan om lai teng a inkuan chih atuam in, azite un atuam in.
Huai ni chiang in khelhna leh nitna siangsak ding in, David inkote leh Jerusalem a tengte a ding in tuikhuk kihong ahong om ding hi.

Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, gam a kipan in milimte minte ka satkhe ding a, theihgige in a-omta kei ding uh; huan zawlneite leh kha nin gam a kipan in ka paikhesak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, zawlnei kuapeuh ahong kilat laileh amah suangtu anu leh apa'n akiang ah, "Na hing kei ding; TOUPA min in zuau na gen a," achi ding ua; amah suangtu anu leh apa'n thu agenkholh ziak in amah asun pailet ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, zawlneite thu agenkholhna uah, amengmuh uah azahlak chiat ding ua; khem ding in samul phan puanak leng asilh sam kei ding uhi.
"Zawlnei ka hi kei, leiletmi ka hi; ka tuailai a kipan a sikha a bawl ka hih khit tak ziak in,” achi zaw ding uhi.
Mi'n akiang ah, na bante kikal a liamnate bang ahia? achi ding ua, huchi in ama'n, "Huaite ka lawmte insung a ka liamnate ahi uh," chi in adawng ding uhi.
"Aw namsau, ka belamchingmi dou ding leh mi ka lawm dou ding in halh in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Belamchingmi khen in, huan belamte adalh ding uh; huchi in aneute tung ah ka khut ka lik ding hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, gam tengteng ah, huai a seh nih satkhiak in a-om dia asi ding uhi; himahleh huai a athumna nutsiat in a-om ding, TOUPA'N achi.

Huan aseh thumna mei a paisuak in ka hon tawi dia, dangka hihsiangthou bang in ka hihsiangthou ding a, dangka ettel bang in ka entel ding hi; ka min alou ding ua, amau ka dawng ding; ka mite ahi, ka chi dia, amau, TOUPA ka Pathian ahi," hon chi ding uhi.
Ngai in, TOUPA ni, na gallak na lak a hawm a a-om ding hun ahong tung hi.

Jerusalem dou a galdou ding in nam tengteng ka kaikhawm ding a; khopi lak in a-om dia, innte lok in leh numeite sualluih in a-om ding uh; khopi kimkhat sal a kaih in a-om ding a, khopi a kipan mikhosuaksunte kuamah satkhiak in a-om kei ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in TOUPA apaikhe dia, kidou lai a adou bang in huai namte adou ding hi.

Huai ni chiang in akhe a Jerusalem suahlam a om, Olive Tang sik in adingh dia, huchi in Olive Tang bel suahlam a pan tumlam ah phel nih kisuah in akiphelkhap ding hi, huchi in phaizang thupi mahmah ahong omta ding a; tang kimkhat mallam ah leh akimkhat simlam ah akikhin ding hi. Huchi in phaizang lam ah ka mualte na taikek ding uhi.

Mualte phaizang Azal tung ding ahi ngal a; ahi, Judah kumpipa Uzziah dam lai a zinling ma a kipan na taikek uh bang in; huchi in TOUPA ka Pathian ahong pai ding a, akiang ah misiangthoute ahon tonpih ding hi.
Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, khovot a-om kei dia, vuk a-om sam kei ding.
Himahleh TOUPA a dia theih a om ni khat ahi ding; sun hilou, zan hilou; himahleh hichi ahi ding a, nitaklam in khovak a-om ding hi.
Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in tui hingte aluangkhe dia; alak ua kimkhat suahlam tuipi ah, alak ua kimkhat tumlam tuipi ah; nipi leh phalbi in a-omden ding hi.
Huchi in leitung tengteng ah TOUPA kumpipa ahi ding; huai ni chiang in TOUPA khat amin khat ahi ding hi.

Jerusalem sim Geba a kipan Rimmon tan, gam tengteng phaizang asuak ding a; Jerusalem bel Benjamin kongpi a kipan kongpi khatna chiang, aning a kongpi chiang, Hananel insang a kipan kumpipa uain sukna pha a kipan khentuam in a-om ding hi.
Huai ah mite ateng ding ua, hamsia a-om nawn kei dia; himahleh Jerusalem ah muangtak in ateng ding uhi.
Huan Jerusalem kidoupih mite tengteng TOUPA'N agawtna ding hipi bel hiai ahi ding; akhe ua adin lai un, asa uh amuat ding a, amit hawm sung uah amit uh amuat ding, akamsung uah alei uh amuat ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA a kipan nakpitak a buaina alak uah ahong om ding a; michih in a-invengte khut ah alen tinten ding a, a-invengte khut dou ding in akhut akisa ding hi.
Judah in leng Jerusalem ah adou dia; kho kim khovel a nam tengteng hauhsakna dangka-eng, dangka, puansilh atam a tam in alakhawm ding hi.
Huchibang in hiai gawtna hipi gamsa tengteng leh sakol, sakolneu, sangawngsau leh sabiltungte puaninte ah hiai gawtna a-om ding hi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem dou ding a hong kuan nam tengteng lak a nutsiat a om michih akum sik in Kumpipa, sepaihte' TOUPA, be ding leh Biakbukte Ankuangluina nei ding in Jerusalem ah akuantou ding uhi.
Hichi ahi ding a, leitung a inkuan tengteng, Jerusalem a Kumpipa, sepaihte' TOUPA, be ding a hohtou lou peuhmah, atung uah vuah azu kei ding hi.
Aigupta inkuan ahohtouh louh ua, ahong pai kei uleh, amaute tung ah leng vuah azu kei ding; Biakbuk Ankuangluina nei ding a hohtou lou namte gawtna ding hipi a-om zaw ding hi.
Hiai Aigupta gawtna bel Biakbuk Ankuangluina nei ding a hoh lou nam tengteng gawtna ahi ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in sakol longte ah, TOUPA A DING A SIANGTHOU, chih akigelh ding a; TOUPA' inn a belte maitam ma a noubemte bang ahi ding uhi.

Ahi, Jerusalem leh Judah a bel tengteng sepaihte' TOUPA a ding in siangthou ahi ding uh; akithoihte ahong pai ding ua huai belte la in kithoihna sa ahuan ding uhi, huai ni chiang in sepaihte' TOUPA' inn ah Kanaan mi a-om nawn kei ding hi.
Huan ka dak a, ngai in mi khat akhut a tehna khau tawi ka mu hi!
Huai lai in ke'n, “Koilam a hoh ding?" ka chi hi. Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Jerusalem, availam bang tan hi a, adunglam bang tan hiam chih thei ding a teh ding in," ahon chi hi.
Huan ngai in, kei hon houpih angel apaikhia a, amah kituahpih ding in angel dang khat apaikhe nawn hi.
Akiang ah, "Tai inla, huai a tangvalpa kiang ah, Jerusalem zaw asung a mipi tampitak leh ganhonte ziak in, kulhbaang om lou khuate bang in luah in a-om ding a,
huan akimvel a meikuang kulhbaang a umtu ka hi ding a, huchi in asung a athupina ka hih ding ziak in, TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
Khai, khai, mallam gam a kipan taikek un, TOUPA'N achi; van huih lite bang in nou lah ka hon dalhzaksakta ngal a, TOUPA'N achi.
Khai! Zion ah tai in, nang Babulon tanu toh tengkhawm un.
Huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, thupina khit in nang hon lok namte kiang ah ama'n kei ahon sawl hi; kuapeuh nang hon khoih in amit nauta khoih ahi.
"Ngai in, atung ua ka khut sing ding ka hi a, huchi in ana uh sepsakte a ding in gallak ahi ding uh; huan sepaihte TOUPA'N kei ahon sawl chih na thei ding uh.
"Aw Zion tanu, la sa inla, kipak in; ngai in, kei na lak ua teng ding in ka hong pai hi," TOUPA'N achi.
Huai ni chiang in TOUPA lam ah nam tampi akizomkhawm ding ua, ka mite ahi ding uh; na lak ah ka teng ding a, huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang ah kei ahon sawl chih na thei ding hi.
Huan gam siangthou a atantuam bang in TOUPA'N Judah aluah ding a, Jerusalem ahon tel ding hi.
Dai un, mi tengteng, TOUPA ma ah a-omna siangthou a kipan in amah akhanglou in athoukheta hi.
Huchi in siampu lianpen Joshua TOUPA angel ma a dingh leh Setan akhut taklam a ahek ding a dingh ahon musak hi.
TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Aw Setan, TOUPA'N hon tai hen; ahi, Jerusalem telpa TOUPA'N nang hon tai hen; hiai mi kangmei a kipan sahkhiak ahi kei a hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Joshua puansilh nin a kizem in angel ma ah adingh hi.

Angel in ama a dinghte kiang ah thu agenta hi. "Amah a kipan puansilh nin lamang un,” chi in. Huan akiang ah, "Ngai in, na thulimlouhna nang a kipan ka lakheta a, puansilh hoih in ka hon zem ding," chi in.
Huan ke'n, "Aluzang ah lukhu siang koih uhen," ka chi a. Huchi in aluzang ah lukhu siang akoih ua, puansilh in atuam ua; huchi in TOUPA angel kiangnai ah adingh hi.
Huan TOUPA angel in Joshua kiang ah hiai thu agen a,

"Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ka lampite a na om a, ka thupiak na zuihleh ka inko vai na hawm ding a, ka vaihawmna innte ah thu na nei dia, hiai a dinghte lak a luttheihna ka hon pe ding," chi in.
Aw siampu lianpen Joshua, tu in za un; nang leh na ma a tu na lawite; amau chiamtehna hoih mite ahi ua; ngai in ka sikha Hiang hon pi ding ka hih ziak in.
Ngai in, Joshua ma a ka suang koih, suang khat mit sagih nei tung ah laigelh ka gelh ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Ni khat thu in gam pumpi thulimlouhna ka lamang ding hi, chi in.
"Huai ni chiang in, na grepgui nuai leh theipi sing nuai ah michih in a-invengte na chial ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Huan kei hon houpih angel ahong pai nawn a, mi ihmu lai phawn bang in ahong phawng hi.
Huan ka kiang ah, "Bang na mu a?" achi a. Ke'n, "Ngai in, dangka-eng khawnvak koihna, adawn a noubem leh apeng a khawnvak sagih omte, huai a khawnvak sagihte toh ka mu, chi in ka dawng hi.
Huan Olive sing nih akiang a om, khat noubem taklam pang ah khat veilam pang ah," ka chi hi.
Huan ka dawng a, kei hon houpih angel kiang ah thu ka gen a, "Hiaite bang ahi ua, ka toupa?" ka chi hi.
Kei hon houpih angel in ahon dawng a, ka kiang ah, "Hiaite bang ahi ua na thei kei maw?" achi a. Ke'n, " 'Ii,' Thei lou, ka toupa," ka chi hi.
Huaitak in ama'n hon dawng a, ka kiang ah thu agen a, "Hiai Zerubbabel kiang a TOUPA thu ahi: Thahatna in hilou, thilhihtheihna in leng hi sam lou, ka Kha in ahi zaw, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Kua na hia, Aw tang thupi? Zerubbabel ma ah mun zang na hong hi ding; ama'n atung ah, 'Hehpihna, hehpihna!' chi a kikou in suang poimohpen ahon lakhe ding hi," achi hi.
Huai lou in TOUPA thu ka kiang ahong tung lai a, hichi in achi:
"Zerubbabel khut in hiai inn suangphum akoih khinta; akhutte mah in azou ding, huan Sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang ah kei ahon sawlta chih na thei ding," chi in.
Thil neu kipat ni kua'n asimmoh thei a? Zerubbabel khut ah ulum amu ding ua, akipak ding uh. Hiai TOUPA mit sagihte ahi; leitung pumpi kantan a vialtaite.
Huan ke'n ka dawng a akiang ah, "Khawnvak koihna taklam pang tung a hiai olive sing nihte leh huai aveilam pang a bang ahi ua?" ka chi hi.
Anihveina ding in ka dong nawn a, akiang ah, "Dangka-eng kahiang nihte sik a om, dangka-eng sathau amau a kipan suah zel olive hiang nihte bang ahi ua?" ka chi hi.
Ama'n hon dawng a, hiaite bang hi ding ahi ua chih thei lou maw? achi a. Huan ke'n, " 'Ii,' Thei lou, ka toupa," ka chi hi.
Huaitak in ama'n, "Hiaite leitung pumpi TOUPA kiang a dingh, thaunilh nihte ahi uh," achi hi.
Huan ka dak nawn a, ngai in, laibuzial leng ka mu hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Bang na mu a?" hon chi hi. Ke'n, “Laibuzial leng ka mu; huai dunglam tong sawmnih ahi a, availam tong sawm," ka chi hi.

Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai gam pumpi tung a paikhia hamsia ahi, huai dungzui in kuapeuh guta tu a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding ua; huai dungzui in kuapeuh dikloupi a kichiamte tu a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding uh.
Ka paikhesak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi a, gutami inn ah alut ding, ka min a zuau a hamsia zangmi inn ah; huan a-inn ah a-om gige dia, asing asuang toh anegai ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kei hon houpih angel apaikhia a, ka kiang ah, "Tu in dak inla, bang ahia paikhia chih en in," achi hi.
Ke'n, "Bang ahia?" ka chi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai a paikhia 'Ephah' ahi, achi a, huai lou in, hiai, 'Gamsung tengteng a mite khelhna ahi," " achi hi.
Ngai in, "Ngensik dopkang in a-om a; huai Ephah sung a tu hiai numei ahi," achi lai hi.
Huan ama'n, “Hiai gitlouhna ahi," achi a; huai Ephah sung a-ensuak a; huai agong ah ngen gik angasuk hi.
Huchi in ka dak a, ngai in, numei nih hong paikhia ua, akhate uah huih a-om hi. Tuivapi bang in kha anei ua; huchi in lei leh van kikal ah huai Ephah adomtou uhi.
Kei hon houpih angel kiang ah, "Hiaite'n koilam a Ephah po ding uh ahia?" ka chi hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Shinar gam a inn ding lam ding in. Huan abawl zoh chiang un ama muntak ah koih in a-om ding," achi hi.
Huchi in ka dak nawn a, ngai in, tang nih kikal a kipan in kangtalai li a hong paikhia ua, huai tangte dal tang ahi uhi.
Kangtalai khat in sakol san anei ua kangtalai nihna in sakol vom;
kangtalai thumna in sakol ngou; kangtalai lina in sakol puang hat anei uhi.
Huan kei hon houpih angel ka dong a akiang ah, "Hiaite bang ahi ua, ka toupa?" ka chi hi.
Angel in ahon dawng a, ka kiang ah, "Hiaite van huih lite, leitung pumpi Toupa ma a va dingh khin a paikhete ahi uh.
Sakol vomte omna kangtalai mallam gam ah apaikhia ua; amau zui in angoute tumlam ah apawtkhia ua; apuangte simlam zuan in apawtkhia uhi."
Huan sakolte apaikhia ua, lei kantan a avialvak theihna ding uh angaklah uhi. Ama'n, "Hiai a kipan pai unla, lei kantan in vialvak un,” achi a, huchi in lei kantan in avialvak uhi.
Huchi in ahon sam a, ka kiang ah thu agen a, "Ngai in, mallam gam zuan a paite'n mallam gam ah ka kha akhawlsakta uh," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
Babulon a kipan saltang hong pai Heldai, Tobijah leh Jedaiah a pan thilpiak la in; ani mah in pai inla, Zephaniah tapa Josiah inn ah lut in.
Ahi, amau a kipan dangka leh dangka-eng la inla, kumpi lukhute bawl in, Jehozadak tapa Joshua, siampu lianpen luzang ah khusak in.
Huan akiang ah thu gen inla, huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ngai in, mi amin Kahiang: amun a kipan ahong kakhe ding a, ama'n TOUPA tempul alam ding hi.

Ama'n TOUPA tempul alam ding a, thupina silhsak in a-om ding a, alaltutphah tung ah atu dia, vai ahawm ding; alaltutphah tung ah siampu ahi ding; huchi in amau gel kikal ah lemna thuhilhna a-om ding hi.
Kumpi lukhute Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah leh Zephaniah tapa Hen kiang ah, TOUPA tempul atheihgigena ding in a-om ding uhi.

Huan gamlapi a omte ahong pai ding ua TOUPA tempul ahong lampih ding ua, huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang a kei hon sawl ahi chih na thei ding hi. Huchi in hiai ahong tung ding, TOUPA na Pathian aw pilvangtak a na man uleh, achi, chi in.
Kumpipa Darias akum lina in hichi ahong hi a, Kisleu kha, akha kuana, ani li ni in, Zekariah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Huan amau Bethel a omte'n Serezer leh Regem-melek leh amite uh TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding in asawl ua,
sepaihte' TOUPA' inn a siampute kiang leh zawlneite kiang a thu va gen ding in, "Kum tampi sung ka na hihsa bang in akha ngana ah kei-le-kei kihihtuam in, kap a suun in an ka ngawl diam?" chi in.
Huai lai in sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
"Gam a mite tengteng kiang leh siampute kiang ah thugen in. Hiai kum sawmsagih sung, akha ngana leh akha sagihna a an na ngolh chiang un, kei a ding in, keimah ding in na ngawlta uhia?
