Na nek chiang un, na dawn chiang un, noumau a mah ding in na ne un, na dawn uh ahi kei maw?
"Jerusalem akiluah lai leh ahauhsak lai a, akimvel a khopite leh Sim leh gam niam gam akiluah lai a zawlnei masate zang a TOUPA tangkoupih hiai thute ahi kei ua hia? chi in," chi in.
Huan TOUPA thu Zekariah kiang ah hiai bang in ahong tung hi.
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N thu agen hi: "Vaihawmna dik hih un, michih in a-unau tung ah zahngaihna leh lainatna ensak hen.
Meithai nuaisiah kei un, pabeite, mikhual, gentheite leng, na lak ua kuamah in alungtang in a-unau siatna ding gilou ngaihtuah kei hen, chi in,” achi hi.
Himahleh ngaihkhiak a-ut kei ua, genhaktak in akiheimang ua, azaklouhna ding un abil uh ahum uhi.

Ahi, suang tak bang in alungtang uh abawl ua, huchi keileh dan aza kha ding ua, zawlnei masate khut a ama Kha a sepaihte' TOUPA'N athukhakte aza kha ding uh; huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA a kipan nakpi a hehna ahong tung hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, "Ka kikou lai a angaihkhiak louh ziak un akikou chiang un leng ka ngaikhe sam kei ding," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.

"Himahleh atheih louh uh namte lam ah pingpei in amaute ka delhsak ding. Huchi in gam amau nung in akisegawp ding a, kuamah in akantan un alehkik kei ding uh; gam nuam asukgawp ziak un, achi," chi in.
Huchi in sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a;
"Hichibang in sepaihte! TOUPA'N achi: Thikthusetak in Zion ka deihthoh a, nakpitak a hehna toh amah a ding in phatuam ka ngai hi," chi in.
Hichibang in TOUPA'N achi: Zion ah kiksak in ka om a, Jerusalem lai ah ka teng ding; Jerusalem bel Thutak khopi, sepaihte' TOUPA tang, tang siangthou akichi ding hi.
Hichi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Jerusalem kongzingte ah putekte leh pitekte ahong khosa ding ua, a-upat ziak un akhut uah chiangkhun akhun chiat ding uh.
Khopi kongzingte a kimawl in numei leh pasal naupangte adim ding hi.
Hichibang in sepaihte' ToUPA'N achi: Huai ni chiang a hiai mite lak a khosuaksunte mit a lamdang ahihleh, kei mit ah leng alamdang sam kei dia hia? sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ngai in, suahlam gam a kipan leh tumlam gam a kipan, ka mite ka hondam ding hi.
Amau ka hon pikhawm ding a, Jerusalem lai ah ateng ding ua; ka mite ahi ding uh, thutak leh diktatna ah, a Pathian uh ka hi ding hi.
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "TOUPA' inn suangphum phum ni a kipan a hiai nite a zawlneite kam a kipan a hiai thu zate'n, tempul akilam theihna ding in noute khut hatsak un.

Huai nite malam a mihing a dia kilohna a-om louh a, aganta dia leng kilohna a-om sam louh ziak in; melma ziak in apawtkhia hiam hong lut hiam a ding in leng muanna himhim a-omsak kei a, mi tengteng michih a-invengte dou in ka koih hi.
Himahleh tu in zaw hiai mite lak a khosuaksunte tung ah tuma lam nite bang in ka om kei ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.

Huan haichi pawi a om ding ahi ngal a; grepgui in agah asuang ding a, leitung in apung a-omsak ding a, vante'n adaitui uh ape ding uh; huchi in hiai mite lak a omlaite hiai thil tengteng ka luahsak ding hi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, namte lak a hamsia na hih tak bang un, Aw Judah inkote leh Israel inkote, huchibang mah in nou ka hon hondam ding a; vualzawlna na hi ding uh; lau kei un, himahleh na khutte uh hatsak un."
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Na pipute un ahon hihheh lai ua, na tung ua gilou hih ding ka tup bang in, huchi in ka nem tuan kei, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi:
Huchi in Jerusalem tung leh Judah inkote tung ah hoih hih ding tulai nite in ka tum nawnta hi; lau kei un.
Na hih ding uh thil hiaite ahi: Michih in a-invengte toh thutak kihilh un; na kongpite uah thutak leh lemna vaihawmna hih un;
na lak ua kuamah in a-invengte siatna ding na lungtang uah gilou ngaihtuah kei un; thuchiam diklou deih kei un; hiaite tengteng ka thil huat lam ahi uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Huan sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi,

Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Kha lina an ngawlna, ngana an ngawlna, sagihna an ngawlna leh sawmna an ngawlna, Judah inkote a ding in nopna leh kipahna, ankuangluina vualnopna ahi ding hi; huaiziak in thutak leh lemna deih in," chi in.
Huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Hichibang in ahong om lai ding, mite leh khopi tampite a pan ahong pai ding ua;
huan, khopi khat a teng mite khopi dang a tengte kiang ah apai ding ua, TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding leh sepaihte' TOUPA zong ding in kintak in kuan ni; kei leng ka kuan ding, achi ding uhi.
Ahi, mi tampite leh nam hatte Jerusalem a TOUPA sepaihte zong ding leh TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding in ahong kuan ding uhi.

Huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, namte pau tengteng a kipan mi sawm in Juda mipa puanten alen ding ua, na kiang ah ka pai ding uh, na kiang ah Pathian a-om chih ka za ngal ua, achi ding uh," chi in.
Hadrak gam dou in TOUPA thu a kilak a, "Damaskas akhawlna mun ahi ding. Aram khopite TOUPA a ahi, Israel nam tengteng ahih bang un,
huan pil mah le uh agamgitpih Hamath, Tura leh Sidon tung atung ding hi.
Tura kulh muanhuaitak in akilamkhia in, dangka leivui bang in vum venvon in, kongzingte buannawi bang in dangka-eng hoih in dim mahleh.
Ngai in, TOUPA'N amah neih-le-lam alamang ding a, tuipi a ahauhsakna ahihse ding; huchi in meikuang a nekgaih ahong hi ding hi.
"Ashkelon in huai amu dia, alau ding; Gaza in leng amu dia, nakpi a suknat in a-om ding; Ekron, alametna zahlakna ahi dia; Gaza a kipan kumpipa amangthang ding a, Ashkelon luah in a-om kei ding hi.
Huchi in Ashdod ah chi siangloute ateng ding ua, Philistiate kisaktheihna ka satkhe ding hi.
Huan akam a kipan asisan ka lamang ding a, ahate kikal a kipan in akihhuainate; huchi in amah leng i Pathian a ding in khosuaksun ahi ding hi; Jebus mi bang in Judah leh Ekron ah hausa ahi ding hi.

Huan sepaih pawlte ziak in akimvel in ka inn ka um ding, huchi a kuamah apaisuak uhiam akik nawnlouhna ding un; huchi in nuaisiahmi in apaltan nawnta kei ding; tu in ka mit mahmah in ka muta hi," achi hi.

Aw Zion tanu, nakpi mahmah in kipak in; Aw Jerusalem tanu, kikou in; ngai in, na kumpipa kiniamkhiak in, sabiltung tung, sabiltungnou tuan ngei nailouhna tung a tuang in na kiang ah ahong hi; amah adiktat a, hotdamna anei.

Ephraim a kipan kangtalai leh Jerusalem a kipan sakol ka satkhe ding a, kidouna thalpeu satkhiak in a-om ding a; namte kiang ah lemna thu agen ding; huchi in agam tuipi a kipan tuipi tan, luipi a kipan lei tawpnate tan ahi ding hi.
Nang tungthu ah leng, na thukhun sisan ziak in tui omlouhna kokhuk a kipan in na suangkul tangte ka sawlkheta hi.
Lametna suangkul a tangte, kulh muanhuai lam ah kihei un; tuni mahmah in na tung ah azahnih in ka hon dinkik ding chih ka puang hi.

Judah thalpeu bang in ka laikulta a, Ephraim thal a bawl in thalpeu ah ka bulhta hi. Aw Zion, na tapate dou ding in na tapate ka tokthou ding, Aw Grik, huchi in mihat namsau bang in, nang ka hon bawl ding hi.
Huchi in atung ah TOUPA akimu ding a, khophia bang in athal apaikhe ding; Toupa PATHIAN in pengkul amut dia, simlam pingpei toh apaikhe ding hi.

Sepaihte' TOUPA'N amaute ahunkhe ding a; suang sailim tangte asikden ding ua; anegai ding ua, uain bang in asisan uh adawn ding uh; noubemte bang in adim ding ua, maitam ningte bang in akawt ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in TOUPA a Pathian un abelamhonte bang in amau ahondam ding a; lallukhu a suangmantamte bang in agam ah atang ding uhi.
Ahi, ahoihna alian mahmah a, akilawmna athupi mahmah a; buh-le-bal in tangvalte atai ding a, uain thak in nungakte atai ding uhi.
Judah kumpipa, Ammon tapa Josiah dam lai a, Kushi tapa, Gedaliah tapa, Amariah tapa, Hezekiah tapa, Zephaniah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
"Leitung a thil om tengteng ka hihbei sipsip ding," TOUPA'N achi.
"Mihing leh sa ka hihbei ding; van a tungleng vasate, tuipi a ngasate, giloute toh kipalpuknate ka hihbei ding; leitung a pan mihing ka satkhe ding," TOUPA'N achi.
"Judah tung leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a; hiai mun a kipan in Baal omlaite leh milim biak ching siampute min ka satkhe ding;
Intung a van aksihon bia; TOUPA kiang a kun a kichiam khin napi a, Milkom mai a kichiamte;
TOUPA zuihna a kipan kilehheite leh TOUPA zong lou a, amah kanloute ka satkhe ding hi.”
Toupa PATHIAN ma ah dai sipsip in, TOUPA ni lah anaita ngal a; TOUPA'N lah kithoihna abawlkhol khin a, amisapte ahihsiangthou khinta hi.
TOUPA kithoih ni in hichi ahi ding, heutute leh kumpipa tapate leh gamdang puan a kizem huchibang tengteng ka gawt ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in, phual kan a tawmte, hiamgamna leh khemna a apu uh inn hihdimte, ka gawt ding hi.
"Huai ni chiang in," TOUPA'N achi, Ngasa Kongpi a pan kah thawmging a-om dia, Kongpi Nihna a pan mauna leh mualte a kipan nakpitak a siatna husa a-om ding.
Mau un, nou Maktes a tengte, na sumsin mite tengteng a-omta kei ua; dangka teh mite satkhiak ahita uhi.

Huai hun chiang in hichi ahi ding hi, khawnvak tawi in Jerusalem zong ding ka hi; mi uain dawn a tengden, alungtang ua, TOUPA'N thil hoih hi in thil gilou leng ahih sam kei ding chi mite ka gawt ding hi.
Huchi in ahauhna uh gallak ahong hi dia, a-innte uh asegawp ding; innte alam ding ua, himahleh aluah kei ding uh; grephuante abawl ding ua, himahleh huai a uain adawn kei ding uhi.
TOUPA ni thupi anai a, anai a, akinoh mahmah, TOUPA ni in kah aw athupi ding a; mi thilhihtheitakte huai ah akap loloih ding uhi.
Huai ni thangpaihna ni ahi, lungzinna leh dahna ni, mialna leh lungkiakna ni, meipi leh khomial bikbek ahi;
pengkul leh gallauna ni, khopi daikaih siatna, aning a insangte siat ni.
Huan mite tung ah dahna ka tun ding a, mittawte bang in avak ding uh, TOUPA tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak un; huchi in asisan uh leivui bang leh asa uh eklei bang in butkhiak in a-om ding hi.

TOUPA thangpaihna ni chiang in adangka uhiam adangka-eng uhiam in amaute atan thei kei ding; himahleh amullitna mei in gam pumpi akangbei ding a; hihbei a om ding ahih ziak in, beina mulkimhuai, gamsung a tengte tengteng tung ah a-om ding hi.
Kikaikhawm un, ahi, kikaikhawm un, zumna nei lou namte aw;
thupiak akuankhiak ma a, buhsi bang a hon mutmang ma in, na tung ua TOUPA hehna kihtakhuai ahong tun ma in, na tung ua TOUPA hehna ni ahong tun ma in kikaikhawm un.
Avaihawmna zui, nou lei a minunnem tengtengte aw, TOUPA zong un; diktatna zong un, migitna zong un; TOUPA hehna ni ah sel in na om kha thei uhi.
Gaza lah nutsiat in a-om dia, Ashkelon hihgawp in; suntang lai in Ashdod ahawlkhe ding ua, Ekron akizungkalh ding hi.
Tuipi piau a teng Kereth namte aw na tung uh agik hi! TOUPA thu in noute ahon dem hi, Kanaan aw, Philistiate gam a teng om lou ding in ka hon hihgawp ding.
Huchi in tuipi, piaute louhing nou mun ahi ding a, belamchingte innte leh belamhonte ahuangte ahi ding hi.

Huai piau bel Judah inkuan khosuaksunte a ding ahi ding; huai ah abelamhonte uh avak ding uh; nitaklam in Ashkelon innte ah akual ding uh; TOUPA a Pathian un amaute aveh in, sal a atang uh pikhe nawn ding ahih ziak in.
Moab hon kouna leh Ammon tate gensiatna ka zata hi. Akigitpihte uh tung a kiliansak a, ka mite gam dou asawm uhi.

Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian ka hin bang in, "Chihtaktak in Moab, Sodom bang ahi ding a, Ammon tate Gomorrah bang, lou bineite leh chikhukte mun sia asuakden ding a, ka mi omlaite'n alok ding ua, ka nam omlaite'n amaute aluah ding uhi.”
Sepaihte' TOUPA mite tung a akiletsak ua, akou ziak un, akisak-theihna ziak un sawi in a-om ding uhi.
Amaute tung ah TOUPA alauhuai ding a; lei pathiante tengteng kial in ahihbei chiang in michih in amau mun chiat leh namte' tuikulh gam tengteng nangawn in amah abe ding uhi.
Nou Ethiopiate leng, ka namsau a thah a om ding na hi uhi.
Huan ama'n mallam dou in akhut alikkhe ding a, Assuria ahihse ding; Nineveh akisegawp ding a, huchi in gamdai bang in akeu ding uh.

Alai ah belamte akual ding ua, namte ganta tengteng; vangawngsau leh sakuh achial tungnung ah agiak ding ua; tohlet ah a-aw in la asa ding uh; sangkilte ah siatgawpna a-om ding; sidar sing a nasepte ahihsiat ziak in.

Hiai khopi nuamsa pilvang loutak a teng a, "Alungtang a keimah ka hi, kei lou kuamah dang a-om kei," chi ahi; bangchidan a hong segawp a, gantate a dia kualna ding hi ahia; kuapeuh akiang a pai in anuihsan in, akhut alehkhum ding uhi.
Khopi helhat leh buah, nuaisiah ching tung agik hi!
Kuamah thu angaikhe kei a, bawlhoihna leng asang thei kei. amuanna leng TOUPA ah a-om kei a; a Pathian anaih sam kei hi.
Asung a aheutu liante uh humpinelkai humham ahi ua, avaihawmte uh lah nitaklam ngehon, azingchiang a nek ding nuse ut lou bang ahi uh.
Azawlneite uh lah mizuauthei leh lepchiah ahi ua; asiampute un mun siangthou ahihbuah ua, dan tung ah ahiamgam uhi.
Asung ua TOUPA bel adiktat a; thil thulim lou ahih kei ding; zingsang teng in avaihawm khovak ah alak a, avuaksuak ngei kei a; himahleh midiktatloute'n zaw zumna athei kei uhi.
Namte ka satkheta a, a-insangte uh akisegawp hi; akongzingte uh ka susia a, kuamah apai kei uhi; akhopite uh hihsiat in a-om a, huchi a mi kuamah om lou in, ateng leng a-om kei uhi.

Chihtaktak in kei na hon kihta ding ua, bawlhoihna na kipahpih ding, ka chi a; huchi in atenna satkhiak in a-om kei dia, amah tungtang a sehsa tengteng bang in; himahleh beltak in athou ua, ahih tengteng uh asesak uhi.

"Huaiziak in mat ding zuan a ka thoh ni atun masiah hon na ngak un," TOUPA'N achi. Namte kaihkhawm ka tup ahi ngal a, lalgamte ka suktuah a atung ua ka hehna ka sunbuak theihna ding in, ka thangpaihna lauhuai tengteng; ka mullitna mei a leitung pumpi nekgaih a om ding lah ahi ngal a.
Huai hun chiang a mite'n TOUPA min aloh ua, thukhat sat a amah nna aseptheihna ding un, akiang uah muk siangthou ka pe ding hi.
Ethiopia luite khen lam a kipan gimlim hal mite, dalhsa ka mite tanu mahmah in ka thillat ahon tawi ding hi.

Huai ni chiang in ka tung a na tatlekna, na thilhihte tengteng ziak in na zahlak kei ding; huai hun chiang a na lak a na mikisathei leh ki-uangsakte lakhe ding ka hih ziak in, huchi in ka tang siangthou ah na ki-uangsak nawnta kei ding uhi.
Himahleh na lak ah mi gimthuak leh genthei ka nuse ding a, TOUPA ah amuang ding uhi.
Israel khosuaksunte'n gilou ahih kei ding ua, zuau agen sam kei ding uh; akam uah leng lei khemhat akimu kei ding hi; ne a, lum a, amaute kuamah in ahihlau louh ding ziak un.
La sa in, Aw Zion tanu; kikou in, aw Israel! Jerusalem tanu aw, na lungtang tengteng toh kipak inla, nuamsa in!
TOUPA'N na vaihawmnate alamangta a, na melma adelhkhia a, na lak ah Israel kumpipa, TOUPA a-om hi; gilou na lau nawn kei ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in, Jerusalem kiang ah, "Lau ke'n," chih ahi ding; Aw Zion, na khutte ze-olsak ke'n.
Na lak ah TOUPA na Pathian a-om hi, hondam ding mihat; na itna ah akhawl ding, la sa in na tung ah anuam ding hi.
Khawmpi kulmut ziak a dahnate, noute a dia puakgik leh gensiatna hiite ka lamang ding hi.

Ngai in, huai hun chiang in, nang hihgimte tengteng ka bawl ding a, panpih kiphamohnu ka hondam ding a, hawlmang a omnu ka lakhawm ding; huchi in leitung pumpi a azahlakna uh ana omkhitnate ah, phatna leh minthanna amaute ka pe ding hi.

Huai hun chiang in ka hon la nawn ding a, huai hun chiang in nou ka hon kaikhawm ding hi; na mitmuh ua na saltanna ua kipan ka hon pi nawn hun chiang in, lei a mi tengteng lak ah min leh phatna in nou ka hon bawl ding, TOUPA'N achita hi.

Pathian honphat ung,
Na it, Na tapa ziak;
Jesu in hontan in,
Tu in van ah om.
Halleluijah Na thupina,
Halleijah Amen;
Halleluijah Na thupina,
Hon halhsak nawn in.
Pathian honphat ung,
Na Kha Siangthou vak in,
Zan mial tanvak suak in,
Hondampa hon musak.
Phat leh thupina,
Belamnou thah ading’n;
I khelhna teng uh pua’n,
Mohna teng sawpsiang.
Phat leh thupina,
Itna’ dim Pathian kiang;
Honzong in A hon leita
I lampi hon ching.
Hon halhsak nawn in,
Itna’n lungsim dimsak’n;
Kha teng kitohhalh thak hen,
Van apan mei in.

Vakna nunnem, mial na’n hon um
Nang honpi in,
Zan a mial lua; inn apan gamla ing,
Nang honpi in
Ka khe kem in, gamlapi muh ngen keng;
Kei a dingin kal khat, ka suan leng hun.
Tuabang hingeilou, thum leng thum ngeilou;
Honpiin chi’n,
Ka deih teelin na pai; mah leng tu’n zaw,
Nang honpiin,
Nopsakna ka na ngai, lauhna theilou;
Kisathei hi’ng, kum paisa mangngilh in.
Na hatna’n Non kem gige, tuin leng
Nonpi ding hi,
Loutam, linglak, kawl leh kense lak ah,
Zan beima tan; khua hong vak chian,
Angelte nuih mel mu’n,
Ka mansak zual, ka na deih tawntung hi.

Lam tawntungin nivak nuai ah pai ing,
Mual leh kuam thuk tawn’ ka zinna ah;
“Kon nusia ngeikei ding” Jesu’n a chi,
Pathian thuchiam, tua zuau ngeilou hi.
Thangvan sunni tang,
Thangvan sunni tang,
Pathian thupina’n ka kha tum in;
Halleluijah! kipahna’n ka dim,
A phat la ka sa, Jesu keia.
Ka kim ka vel mialna in hon tuam zong,
Ka Hondampa, Pitu, liah ngeilou;
Vak ahi, Amah ah mialna omlou,
Amah toh ton in ka pai jel hi.
Sunni tang nuai ah kipak gige in,
Tunglam innpi juan in ka pai jel;
Amah phat la sa’n, kipakin ka pai,
Itna sunni tang nuai ah pai ing.

Lalgam chihoih na tuh jeljel na hiam unau,
Jingsang nivak kilawm ah?
Lalgam chihoih na tuh jeljel na hiam unau,
Sunkimlai nisa khauh nuai ah.
Buhlak hun a hongtung pahta ding,
Buhlak nasep pat ahipah ding;
Na buhphal atam diam,
Buhpang ah na sung diam?
Pawltak chia inn a kaihkhawm dingin.
Lalgam chihoih na tuh jeljel na hiam unau,
Zan khosiang leh dai nuai ah?
Lalgam chihoih na tuh jeljel na hiam unau,
Buh hoih leh siangthou lakna ding?
Lalgam chihoih na tuh jeljel na hiam unau,
Lei hoihna mun koipeuh ah?
Lalgam chihoih na tuh jeljel na hiam unau,
Nitawp chiangin na at ngei ding?

Toupa lung a itte’n,
Itna la honsa un;
Lung kilual in la hon sa un, (2)
Mangtutphah kimvel in. (2)
Zion manoh hi hang,
Tungchiang khopi Pathian Zion;
Tungchiang Zion khopi nuampen,
Toupa Pathian khopi ahi.
Toupa mel a mate’n,
Hiai la sa nuam lou zong;
Tung Pathian tatsate in zaw, (2)
Sa louin om theilou. (2)
Zion tang hoih simthu’n,
Zata selung taisak;
Thangvan khopi suangmantam khua, (2)
Tualnuam i tun mateng. (2)
Hongun, nopla lem ni,
Lungngaih mittui hul hen;
Immanuel khopi fang ni, (2)
Zion, Toupa khopi. (2)

Kris ka Tanpa toh vuiin ka omta,
Hindan lui haihuai leh khelhna sihsan;
Setan’ sam in khovel in honkun zong,
Ka sungah dawnna aw suakta lou.
Khovel sihsan, honsapna aw teng toh,
Athak a hing, thumang leh suakta;
Kei hon hiip, ngei nopnate sihsanta,
Hizong kei hilou, Kris kei a teng.
Ka deihluat thilte lamdangsa nawnlou,
Huaite’n hon kai in hon hiip nawnta lou;
Kris toh sa a ka thuak khawmtak ziakin,
Thilluite mangta, ka deih nawn kei.
Khelhna sihsan in kha in ka hingta,
Amah toh hankhuk mialpan thounawnta;
Thil tengteng thakta, kei ka kipak hi,
A itna lian leh hotdamna ah.
Khelhnain ka tungah thu nei nawnlou,
“Hinna thaka khosa” ka suakta ta;
Kris ka Tanpa’n A hinna thupi tak,
Kei toh A hon kikoppihta hi.

Toupa hon chingpa hi,
Samlou in hon pe ding;
Amah keia, kei Amah’ a,
Bangdang ka ngai nawn dia? (2)
Van gam louhing mun ah,
Aman honpi jel hi;
Hinna tuisik dam luanna ah,
Hotdamna bukim om. (2)
Na pialmang khata leng,
Ka kha akem hoih jel;
Amah’ lampi dik ah honpii,
A min siangthouna di’n. (2)

Kris khovel di’n i phuang,
Khovel Kris kiang i puak
Kipumpiakin,
Genthei leh lusunte,
Bah leh puak gik pawte,
Khial damlou leh lungkham,
Kris damsakte.
Kris khovel di’n i phuang,
Khovel Kris kiang i puak,
Thum kawm in ah,
Lamhaih leh mangthangte,
Itna tawlnga lou in,
Pikik nawn le’ng mangthangte
Mial apan.
Kris khovel di’n i phuang,
Khovel Kris kiang i puak,
Kipumpiak in,
Pangkhawm a na sem in,
Hangsanna toh sem in,
A kros pawkhawm jel in,
Kris Toupa di’n.

Janggam niam ah leng ka Hondampa toh ton ning,
Pak hoihte pakna, tuilim lui luanna mun ah;
A honpina peuh ah ka jui ka jui jel ding hi,
Manglukhu ka ngah mateng A sul jui ning.
Jui ning, jui ning, Jesu ka jui ding hi,
Koipeuh ah munteng ah, ka jui jel ding hi;
Jui ning, jui ning, Jesu ka jui ding hi,
Munteng ah, Honpina ah ka jui jel ding.
Janggam niam ah leng ka Hondampa toh ton ning,
Huihpi anunna, tui lauhuai luanna mun ah;
A khut in honpi dia, kei ka lau ngeingei kei ding,
Ka Toupa a nai leh lauhuai kihta lou.
Janggam niam ah hiam, tangsang ken diidiai tungah,
Ka Hondampa naih in ka kha om gige ding;
Amah’ zuihsa lampi ah bittakin honpi ding,
Pathian tang tung, kikhopna mun tanpha in.

Aw, Nangmah bang leng! ka Tanpa nuamsa,
Hiai ka deih leh thumna hi gige;
Lei gou tengteng, kipakin ka taan ding,
Jesu, nang batna kim silh dingin.
Aw, Nangmah bang leng! (2)
Tanpa nuamsa, Nang banga siangthou;
Na hoihna buchinna toh hong inla,
Ka lungsim ah Na mel thaamsak in.
Aw, Nangmah bang leng! hehpihna a dim,
Itsiam, ngaihdam hat, nunnem, migi;
Panpihngai panpih, bahte kipaksak,
Khial a vakmang zong a man dingin.
Aw, Nangmah bang leng! lungsim kiniamkhiak,
Siangthou, poikhoihlou, kuhkal, hangsan;
Demna, kounate jainemtaka thuak,
Midangte hotdamna dia thuak nuam.
Aw, Nangmah bang leng! Toupa ka hongpai,
Pathian thaunilhna tua tang dingin;
Ka hinna leh ka neih tengteng kon keng,
Toupa, tuapat Nanga vek hidi’n.

Van dum khenlam ah Pathian om,
Mihing muhlouh in kisel hi;
Zia kilawm in vante zem hi,
A hatna thupi’n khovel siam.
Pathian khat om, Amah hing hi,
Amah vangin hing in i dam;
Leivui panin mihing siam a,
Amah i Pathian thupi hi,
Pathian thupi.
Pathian tanglaia jawlneite’n,
A aw ana ngaihkhiak jel uh;
Amah Pathian i theih dingin,
A hatkhum thu in hon houpih.
Hinna Pathian khut a om ziak,
Mihing hinkhua bitna om hi;
Mihingte’n zongmahleh mulou,
Pathian kia in a thei siam hi.
I Pathian a Tapa hinna,
Singtung ah hon pekhe nuam in;
Mite khialpan suakta sak a,
Amah toh om tawntung thei di’n.

Jesu a lawm hoih i neih dan,
I khelhna, dahna paw ding;
Hamphat huai mahmah i hilh theih,
Bangteng Pathian kiang’ thumna’n.
Aw lungmuanna tam i na taan,
Aw nat thuak louh ding i thuak;
Amah’ kiang i tutlouh vang hi,
Bangteng Pathian kiang’ thumna’n.
Ze-et leh khemna i tuak hiam,
Koipeuh ah buaina om hiam?
I lunglel ngeikei ding uhi,
Toupa kiang’thumna’n gen in.
Tuabang lawm gin-om i mu diam?
I lungkham hon thuakpih ding;
I hatlouhna teng Jesu’n thei,
Toupa kiang’ thumna’n gen in.
Hatlou leh gikpua’n i om hiam?
Awlmoh tampi’n hon dal hiam?
Hondampa hoih i bukna hi,
Toupa kiang’ thumna’n gen in.
Lawmte’n simmoh’n hon tawpsan hiam?
Toupa kiang’ thumna’n gen in;
A angah pom in honliah ding,
Tua ah muanna na mu ding.

Ni tamlou sung pahtawina a dim ding,
Tangthu lui gengen ta ni hang;
Khua hong mui a Hondampa’n honsap chian,
Ka pai ding Amah kiang thupi’n.
Ka kros puak manglukhu in ka kheng ding,
Kongpi khak ngeilouhna mun ah;
A khebul ah puakgik teng ngakhia ning,
Jesu toh tangtawn om khawm ding.
Kum tamlou sung sepgim khituite leh,
Khualzinna hong beita ding hi;
Tuachian Amah toh ka om khawmta ding,
Tangtawn a nuamsata dingin.
A tangte keen in a kuamte thuk zong,
Ka lampi pakbang jem lou zong;
Zan thawmhau huai in khawlna’ng mu kei zong,
Jingsang kipahna’n hon ngak hi.
Mu dia ka thohchian kipah na’n dim ning
Amah ka muhnop penpen hi,
Lungkham nawnlou ding, si ngei nawnlou ding,
Huai ni ka lung in ngaklah hi.

Ka kros puakgik tawlhuai mahleh,
Ka damsung buaina’n adim zong;
Vangsiatna tuak jel mah leng leng,
Ka Toupa nusia kei ning.
Hondampa nusia ngeikei ning,
Aman kei hon nusia ngei lou;
A khut hat nuaiah lauhuai teng panin bit ing,
Ka Toupa nusia kei ning.
Khemhatpa’n ka kha mat sawm in,
Tanglaia a khem dan bangin;
Khem tumin tang gige mahleh,
Ka Toupa nusia kei ning.
Tu’n buai mahmah leng zong nungchiang’
Bang ka suakta ding hiam thei keng;
Jesu’n thei, honpi pa hi ding,
Ka Toupa nusia kei ning.

Kanaan gam nuam juan in ka pai,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah,
Ka zan mial sun suak ding tua ah,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah.
Kikhen lungkham,
(Lawm ngaihte kikhenna omlou)
Khitui luanglou;
(Khitui luang nawn lou ding)
Itna in dim,
(Itna, kipahna muanna omna mun)
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah.
(Kha sih ngeilouhna ah)
Kei di’n huai ah pak hoihte pak;
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah.
Tangtawn hun tua ah ka mang ding,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah.
Ki-it tuahna vak tang tua ah,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah;
Tua ah innpi vakna in dim,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah.
Ka hinna ihmu lou ding tua’h,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah,
Ka louta ding tangtawn nopna,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah.
Ka pai jel tua gam hoih juanin,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah;
Tua ah kikhen om nawn lou ding,
Kha sih ngeilouhna ah.

Jesu’n mikhialte sang ding,
Hiai chitna thu genzak un;
Van lampi pan pialmangte,
Zekai leh pukte kiangah.
Sa un, sa un, sa jel un,
Kris in mikhialte sang hi;
Hiai thu hoihtak’n hilhchian in,
Kris in mikhialte sang hi.
Hongin, khawlna honpe ding,
Muangin, A thu kichian hi;
Mikhialpen zong Aman deih,
Kris in mikhialte sang hi.
Tu’n zaw kimohpaihta keng,
A dan ah ka siangta hi;
Ka mohna teng hon sawpsiang,
Adeih bangin ka siangta.
Kris in mikhialte sang hi,
Kei nangawn ka moh teng toh;
Ka nitna tengteng silsiang,
Amah toh van a lutta’ng.

Jesu, kipahman pedia A hong chian,
Sunlai hiam zanlai hiamin;
Ginom a Amah ngakin honmu diam,
I khawnvak bawlsa’ vakin?
Aw manta ung, i chi thei diam unau?
Laukha inn vak juan dingin;
Toupa hongpai chian nang leh kei,
Amah ngakin,
Amah ngakin hon mu diam?
Jingkhangpi khovak ma’n hongpaita leh,
Sik-khatin honsam inchin;
Toupa kiang i talent i piak kik chian,
“Na hihhoih hi,” hon chi diam?
Muanga hon nutsiatbang’n i ginom hiam?
I theihtawp i suah na hiam?
I lungsimin hon siamlouh kei a leh,
Khawlna thupi i nei ding.
Toupa’n kiging a A muhte hampha,
A thupina tang ding uh;
Phalvak hiam, jingkhang hiamin hongpai leh,
Kigingsa’n A hon mu diam?

Hon ompih’n Toupa Nang lou in om thei keng,
Nang lou in kal khat kia leng suan ngam keng;
Panpih louh in damsung puakgik pozou keng,
Kingakna ding Na hatna ka ngai hi.
Hon ompih’n Toupa lauhuaite’n hon um leh,
Ze-etna huihpi, vuahpi ka thuak chian;
Tuipi kihawt lauhuaite’n hon naih in zong,
Hon suse kei ding hi lunglau kei ning.
Hon ompih’n Toupa hiai toh tehpih dingin,
Vualjawlna leh thilpiak dang om lou ding;
Nang non ompih gige hi chi ka theihna,
Koimun ah ka om zong Nang nong nai hi.
Hon ompih’n Toupa thawmhau a ka om chian,
Natna, satna thuak a ka kah chiangin;
Theihngeilouh khovel juan a ka pai hun ding,
Hongtung tanpha’n Toupa hon ompih in.

Tatsa hi’ng, phuanzak nuam ka sa hi,
Belamnou sisan a tatsa;
A zahngaihna tawp neilou a tat,
A ta ka hi tangtawn dong in.
Tatsa, tatsa,
Belamnou sisan a tatsa;
Tatsa, tatsa,
A ta ka hi, tangtawn dong in.
Tatsa hi’ng, Jesu ah kipak ing,
Ka kipahna gen zoukei veng;
A angsung vak nuam om chih ka thei,
Tua ah hon ompih tawntung hi.
Ka Tanpa Vanglian ka ngaihtuah a,
Ni tawntungin Amah geel ing;
Dai maimai theilouin la ka sa,
Hon itna ka la thupi hi.
A kilawmna ka mu ding, ka thei,
A dante ka it, Kumpipa;
Ka kalsuan teng itna in hon ching,
Zan chiang ka la sak ding hon hilh.
Manglukhu in hon ngak chih ka thei,
Huai innpi vak kei dia bawlsa;
Kha a sukbuchin in om pah ning,
Tua ah ka Toupa toh teng ning.

Aw Zion, na nasep buchingsak mengin,
Khovel teng a ‘Pathian vak hi’ chih ding;
Nam tengteng bawlpa’n kha khat a manthat ding,
Zan mial lak a mang dingin deihlou hi.
Phuangzak in Thupha,
Muanna Thupha;
Jesu tatna leh
Hon khahkhiakna Thupha.
Enin, sang tampite mawk om lailai uh,
Khelhna suangkulh mial sungah koltang uh;
A vualzohna ding ua Hondampa sihna,
Amau hilhtu ding kuamah omlou hi.
Tangthupha paw dingin na tate guan in,
A kinsemna ding un na neih pia in;
A vualzohna ding un na kha’n thumsak in,
Na sen tengteng Jesu’n hon din vek ding.
Hongpai nawn ding, aw Zion na tuah main,
A hotdamna thu mi chih theisak in;
Tatsa kuamah na dawnlou in om kei hen,
Ngaihsaklouh ziak mutaklou om kei hen.

Jesu di’n hing ve aw unau,
A nungjui tawntung dingin;
Toupa thilkia dingte pia in,
Kuamah dang kiang’ pelou in.
Jesu di’n hing in, Jesu di’n,
Na piak ding teng Amah pia’n;
Khovel Tanpa in kros tungah,
Na hinna di’n A hin’ pia.
Jesu di’n hing ve ka kha aw,
Lamtawn in a sul juiin;
Heutupa honsawlna ngaikhia’n,
A dikna thute mang in.
Jesu di’n hing’ damsung jinglam’n,
Sun hun zong Amah di’n hing’n;
Nitaklam’  ani hong tum chian,
Nopna tawplou na luah ding.
Jesu di’n hing ve khial vakvai,
Setan nuai ah sem nawnken;
Kipahman chiam na mu ding hi,
Na damlai ni a bei chian.

Jesu nasep lungkimna hipenpen hi,
Amah ah kipahna sangpen om hi;
Amah muanga A thu a kingak van hi,
Niteng Jesu nasep punna.
Jesu nasep punna, niteng punna hi,
Lamtawn’ kalsuan tengin punna;
Akal chian Thupina lampi haksa mahleh,
Lamtawnin nuamsain na pai ding.
Bangteng tung zong Jesu nasep punna hi,
I sep peuhmah ah dik le’ng punna hi;
Amah ah om le’ng zahngaihna tampi om,
Niteng Jesu nasep punna.
I lampi mial in a khuh ton om mahleh,
Inn lam juan, lungkhamna tuak jel mahle’ng;
I Tanpa’n i sepgimnate hon louh ding,
Niteng Jesu nasep punna.

A sangzaw lam ka delh tawntung,
Niteng in munsang ka tung tou;
Malam nawt kawmin ka thum hi,
Toupa, ka khe munsang tun in.
Toupa hon dom’n, hon dingsak in,
Ginna in vantung gamjang ah;
Ka muh sanga mun sangzaw ah,
Toupa, ka khe munsang tun in.
Ginlahna leh lauhna mun ah,
Ka lungsim in teendet ut keng;
Tuabang mun ah midang teeng zong,
Ka tup, mun sangzaw di’n ka thum.
Khovel tung a teen ka ut hi,
Setan thalte’n hon kap mahleh;
Ginna in pahna aw zata,
Mun sangzaw a misiangte la.
A sangpen mun a kal ka ut,
Thupina vak vamuh ka ut;
Van ka tun mateng ka thum ding,
Toupa, mun sangah honpi in.

Kumpi puanlap khaisang dinga piak in om,
Kumpi sepaihte kiang ah;
Hiai chiamtehna hoih tuni’n i domsang hi,
Tatsate’n la sa kawm in.
Ma nawt un, ma nawt un,
Kris di’n i bangkim pekhia ni;
Manglukhu khusak'n la sa un,
Kumpi kros puanlap nuai ah.
Lei leh tuipi tung mihing tenna peuh ah,
Thupuak minthang theisak un;
Puanlap sisan baang in a tangthu gen hi,
Toupa’n A mi honsap chian.
Tua ni jingsang thupi hongnai deuhdeuh hi,
Niteng in kinoh semsem;
Tuani’n kumpi ma ah melmate bei ding,
Kros in khovel zouta ding.
I gal Lamkai lian, van pan hong kumsuk chian,
Thohnawnna ni hon phuang ding;
Tuachian kumpi ma ah melma zong si ding,
Misiangthoute’n khua fang ding.

“Kon mangngilh kei ding,” chi-a thuchiam hoih om,
Bangmahin ka kha subuai nawnlou ding hi;
Hiai leitung kuamthuk zan mialin jing mahleh,
Tua khen lam ah tangtawn ni tang gige om.
“Hon mangngilh in, hon nusia kei ning,
Ka khut in kon len dia;
Ka ang ah kon pom ding,
Hon mangngilh in, hon nusia kei ning;
Kei na Tanpa ka hi, kon veng ding,” achi.
“Kon mangngilh kei ding,” chih a thuchiam muangin,
Itna leh pahna lasa’n ka pai jel ding;
Lei in honhua in, lawmte’n hon nusia zong,
Van ka inn nuam ah theihgige ka hi ding.
Suangmantam kongkhak bul a ka din chiangin,
Ka thuakna teng leh ka lungkhamna bei ding;
“Semtu ginom, inn ah hong lutin,” chi a,
Hon kipahpihna thuphuan zak nop huai ding.

Leitung ka inn hilou, ka khualzinna phet hi,
Ka gou manpha a om, van dum kiikiai khen ah;
Angelte’n van kongkhak pan, khut honvan uhi,
Hiai leitung ah zaw, nuam ka sathei nawnlou hi.
Toupa, Na thei, Nang bang lawm ka neilou,
Van ka inn hikei leh, Toupa bang ka loh dia;
Angelte’n van kongkhak pan khut honvan uhi,
Hiai leitung ah zaw, nuam ka sathei nawnlou hi.
Kei hon na lamen uh, hiai ka theichian mahmah,
Hondampa’n hon ngaidam, tu’n van juan ka pai hi;
Ka thei, inn hontun ding hi, hatlou tawk leng zong,
Hiai leitung ah zaw, nuam ka sathei nawnlou hi.
Vangam thupi tak ah, hon it Hondampa om,
A khut ka let mateng, khawl maimai ka tumlou;
A kihong van kongkhak ah Aman honngak hi,
Hiai leitung ah zaw, nuam ka sathei nawnlou hi.
Vangam thupi tak ah, tangawn in i teng ding,
Misiangte’n kimkot ah, vualzohna la sa uh;
Phatna la ngaih a sak un, van pan lei honthawn,
Hiai leitung ah zaw, nuam ka sathei nawnlou hi.

Kum tampi kisaktheihna’n ka mang,
Ka Toupa kilhlup ngaihsaklou in;
Kei dia hongsi ahih theilou in,
Kalvari ah.
Tua zahngaihna, hehpihna manbei,
Tua ah ngaihdamna tampi ka mu;
Tua ah ka kha in suahtakna mu,
Kalvari ah.
Pathian thu pan’ khelhna ka phawkta,
A dante lau a ling, nusia ning;
Ka kha moh maisakna ding ngen in,
Kalvari ah.
Tu’n ka bangkim Jesu ka peta,
Tu’n nuam in Amah Kumpi’n ka nei;
Ka kha’n kipah la sa theita ding,
Kalvari ah.
Aw itna’n hotdamna hon naihsak,
A hehpihna mihing kianga puak;
Kal gamlapi Pathian in naisak,
Kalvari ah.

Jesu banga nunnem lawm dang omlou,
Khattang zong! Khattang zong!
I kha natna damsak thei dang omlou,
Khattang zong! Khattang zong!
Jesu in i buainate teng thei,
Sunni tumdong in honpi ding;
Jesu banga nunnem lawm dang omlou,
Khattang zong! Khattang zong!
Amah bang lawm siangthou lunglian omlou,
Khattang zong! Khattang zong!
Kiniamkhiak leh ching lawm dang leng omlou,
Khattang zong! Khattang zong!
I kiangnai a A omlouh lai omlou,
Khatvei zong! Khatvei zong!
A itna’ kipahlouh zanmial omlou,
Khatvei zong! Khatvei zong!
A misiangthou A nusia ngeita hiam?
Nusia lou! Khatvei zong!
Mikhial A laklut noplouh leng omlou,
Khattang zong! Khattang zong!
Hondampa piak bang thilpiak om ngei hiam?
Om ngeilou! Khatvei zong!
Misiangthou van inn a A nial omlou,
Khattang zong! Khattang zong!

Hiai damsung tomchik beihun ding sawtnawn lou ding,
Jesu hong kumsuk hun ding a sawtnawn kei ding;
Kris a sisate hankhuk jalna pan thou ding,
Toupa Kumpipa tunglam van a tuak dingin.
A sawtnawn kei ding hi, a sawtnawn kei ding hi,
Jesu hong kilat hun ding tua ni hong naita;
Na kimanzou na diam tatsate tuak dingin,
Tua ni adi’n kisa’n, a sawtnawn kei ding hi.
Hiai a i len tawp ding hun a sawtnawn kei ding,
Misiangthoute inn tun ding, a sawtnawn kei ding;
Kipahmel toh suangmantam khopi i fang ding,
Vanmi tullouhna ah Hondampa phat lasa’n.
I puakgik i ngak hun ding a sawtnawn kei ding,
Manglukhu i ngah hun ding a sawtnawn kei ding;
Mangtutphah kim ah Angelte toh lasa in,
Van a i kimuh chian tua kitheih bang’  thei ni.
Hiai lei aman hun ding a sawtnawn kei ding hi,
Mihing thilbawl muat hun ding a sawtnawn kei ding;
Hizong Jesu’n tenna ding inn nuam bawl zou hi,
A hehpihna teh vuallouh muang peuhmahte di’n.

Tui kihawt dailou tung pan sapna ging hi,
Tanvak in, tanvak in;
Kha hotkhiak ding, kha hotdam ding tampi om,
Tanvak in, tanvak in.
Tanvak in, vualjawlna Gospel vak,
Hongvak hen, gam chihteng ah;
Tanvak in, vualjawlna Gospel vak,
Hongvak hen, tangtawn dongin.
Masidonia sapna tuni in i za,
Tanvak in, tanvak in;
Kros bulah thilpiak manpha i lan uhi,
Tanvak in, tanvak in.
Hehpihna munchih a tunna di’n thumni,
Tanvak in, tanvak in;
Kris bang kha munchih a muh ahihna di’n,
Tanvak in, tanvak in.
Itna nasep ah tawl kisa kei ni hang,
Tanvak in, tanvak in;
Suangmantam van’ manglukhu di’n khawm ni hang,
Tanvak in, tanvak in.

Pathian itna, zahngaihna vak,
I vialvakna, lampi teng;
Pahna thousak, dahna vaksak,
Pathian pilna, itna hi.
Bangkim kikheng in buai gige,
Mihing vuai in kumte pai;
A zahngaihna kiam ngei nawnlou,
Pathian pilna, itna hi.
Mangbatpen ni mial nuai ah leng,
A hoihna tullou in chiang;
Lungdonna ah A vak hongtang,
Pathian pilna, itna hi.
Tunglam nopna leh lametna,
Leitung buaina toh zom khawm;
Koipeuh ah A thupina tang,
Pathian pilna, itna hi.

Bible hon pia in, kipahna aksi vak,
Vakmang, huihpi nuaite kipak sak di’n;
Tua muanna vak, huihpi’n selmang zoulou ding,
Mangthangte zong’ Jesu hongpai ziak in.
Bible honpia in thupha siangthou vak hi,
Na vak in lam kochik ah honpi ding;
Thukhun leh thuchiam, dan leh itna kigawm,
Zanmial beia tangtawn ni a suah ma’n.
Bible honpia in, lungkia a ka om chian,
Ka kha khial leh lungkham a alau chian;
Jesu thugen thu manpha bu honpia in,
Ka Hondampa nai chih ginna vak di’n.
Bible hon pia in, ka kalsuan teng vaksak,
Hiai nuai leigam lauhuai dan hon hilhin;
Tua bitna khawnvak in mialna tanvak ding,
Tua vak kia’n muanna lampi hon hilh thei.
Bible hon pia in, tangtawn hinna vak hi,
Hankhuk kihong mial lak tanvak sak un;
Van kongkhak vak apan vak honmu sak in,
Jordan tuikihawt hoih honmu sak in.

Non juan diam, non juan diam?
Na lungtang puakgik toh;
Khelhna’ gawt leh nuaisiah,
Na Toupa leh Hondampa khebul ah nga in,
Jesu’n khawlna pe ding.
Aw khawlna nuam, deih khawlna nuam,
Jesu’n khawlna pe ding;
Aw, muanna lel toh hon juan lou ding na hiam?
Jesu’n khawlna pe ding.
Non juan diam, non juan diam?
Nangdi’n zahngaihna om;
Na lungkham damna ding,
A min gingta inla, na hih bangin juan in,
Jesu’n khawlna pe ding.
Non juan diam, non juan diam?
Bangmah na piak ngailou;
Nang hon itpen Jesu’n,
Kros A sihna in na kha di’n hinna leita,
Jesu’n khawlna pe ding.
Non juan diam, non juan diam?
Tu’n na kiang gengen hi;
Hon itna ang juan in,
Na khelhna leh lungkhamna bangteng hitazong.
Jesu’n khawlna pe ding.

Lei ah inn zongin gim leh tawl in ka sem a,
Mihingte laka tenna ding in;
Van ah innpi bawlsa khat in kei hon nangak,
“Hong lut in,” chi’n aw nemin hon zol.
Innpi bawlsa awngin tu’n kei hon nangak hi,
Damsung lampi haksa abei chian;
Lawmte leh it leh ngaihte’n honna tuak ding ua,
Khatvei tei, huai innpi kong bul ah.
Hondampa leh Toupa’n semgimte kiang’ khawlna,
Honchiam ka kipahna pen ahi;
Tunga innpi loungal bangdang ka deih omlou,
Hotdamte toh ka tenkhawmna ding.
Hiai leitung a ka sepgimte abei chiangin,
Ka khut sep gimna pan tawlnga in;
Hiai lei inn luiin van a innpi ka kheng dia,
Angel tungnungpen toh om khawm ding.

Kris i Tanpa kros tungah hong si,
Khialte di’n hongsi a batteng pia;
Amah pomte di’n lau ngai nawnlou,
Hon kaan ding hi, nang hon paikaan ding.
Sisan ka mu chian (3)
Ka paikaan ding, ka hon paikaan ding.
Khial tungnungpen Jesu’n hondam thei,
A chiam bangin Aman ahih ding;
Aw, mikhial, ngaiin, A thu ging in,
Huan Pathian in nang hon paikaan ding.
Thukhenna om ding miteng kim ding,
Amah na niala pom nuamloute;
Aw, khial, kinin Jesu lutsak in,
Huan, hon kaan ding nang hon paikaan ding.
Aw lainatna, Aw itna tawplou!
Jesu’n hatna nei, Jesu dik hi;
Amah muang teng huihpi lak’h bit ding,
Aw, hon kaan ding, nang hon paikaan ding.

Khelhna a mangthangsa,
Jesu’n hon sam nawn hi;
Huan vantung vakna in ka kha dimsakta hi;
Itna’n ka lung sawpsiang,
Tunglam ah ka min gelh;
Jesu kiang ka gen peuh leh
Aman hondam sak.
(Jesu toh)
Kipolhna nuam i nei ding uh,
(Khaile)
I buaina teng Amah hilh in;
(Aman)
I sapna za in,
(Huan Aman)
Hon dawng jel jel ding;
(Thumna nei)
Dia lungjuanna na neih chiangin,
(Na lung)
Sim a vanlam na ngat aleh,
(Jesu)
Toh kipolhna nuam in,
Hon bawlhoih ding hi.
Akal chian ka lampi,
Mial kipahna omlou;
Ginlelhna meipi’n sun khovak selmang thei.
Khelhna meipi jing in,
Van aksi taang selmang;
Jesu kiang ka gen peuh leh,
Ka lampi siangsak.
Ginlelh na leh launa’n,
Ka khitui hong luang zong;
Sun leh zan a honching Jesu ka lawm ahi;
Thumna’n Amah ka juan,
Ka buaina teng A thei,
Jesu kiang ka gen peuh leh,
Aman hon bawl dik.

Khovel thilte’n tu’n kei hon hiipmang lou ding,
A nunnopna leh pilna bangmahlou;
Kingakna kip leh muanhuai ka zong zaw ding,
Hinkhua’n Jesu khatna’n koih ning.
Ka gen peuhmah leh ka sep peuhmah ah,
Khovel sepgim leh tawlna ah;
Sun leh zan a Amah hatna muangin,
Hinkhua’n Jesu khatna’n koih ning.
Ka hotdamna di’n Toupa Jesu si hi,
Kei tangin Kalvari ah A si luang;
Tatna’n ka khelhna teng tawpsan di’n hon phut,
Hinkhua’n Jesu khatna’n koih ning.
Tatsate ding tua ah inn om chih ka thei,
Sihna leh buaina a then hun chiangin;
Hoihna kim pia a Jesu itte dingin,
Hinkhua’n Jesu khatna’n koih ning.
Leitung gimthuaknate niteng’ om jel ding,
Nopna’n honsam’ gitlouhna’n hon tuam zong;
A hehpihna’n kei hon humbit tawntung ding,
Hinkhua’n Jesu khatna’n koih ning.

Kawlmong pha a buh om tengteng,
Minta, lak khawm hunta e!
Sana buhphal phai leh zou ah,
Thei bang in minzouta e.
Toupa aw Nang konsaplai un,
Kong thumna aw uh ngai in;
Tuin at ding hon sawlta in,
Lak hun akikhel ma in.
Jingsang pi in zong sawl inla,
Sun nisat laitak in zong;
Nitum dektak chiang’ zong sawl in,
Mun chih pan khawm di’n sawl in.
Kinmeng in, buh kuaigawp ding hi,
Sana buhphal khawm dingin;
A inn sunga non puakkhawm leh,
Hongpai nawn chia nuamsa ding.

Pathian itna, itna tungnung,
Van pahna, hong kumsuk in;
Kou ah Na tenna hongbawl in,
Na hehpihna muanhuai khu’n;
Jesu, Nang lainatna a dim,
Itna siangthou, tawp neilou,
Na hotdamna toh hong veh in,
Lunglawngte siang ah lut in.
Na itna kha’n hong hat khum in,
Lung buaite lungsim sung ah,
Bangteng Nang ah hon luahta nung,
Khawlna non chiam zongta nung;
Khelh utna lamangta inla,
Ka moh puakgik lakhia in,
Na patna na tawpta hen la,
Tangtawn ni hon tunta in.
Hondam ding vanglian nang hongin,
Nang hinna hon neisak in,
Hong kikpah inla, na temple-
Kou, hon nuse ngei nawn ken;
Nangah vualjawl tawntung’n om nung,
Na na sem in tunglam ah;
Thum a, Nangmah phat tawplou ding,
Na itna a thupi in.
Huan, Na thilsiam thak na zou dia,
Siangthou, nin banglou hi nung,
Hotdamna kim kon mu ding ua,
Nang ah bukim a bit in;
Thupina pan thupina in,
Van a mun ka luah ma un,
Na ma a manglukhu ngak ma’n
Lamdang, itna, phatna’n dim.

Ni sanga vakzaw gam hoih a om,
Ginna in tua gamlapi mu thei;
Pa in lampi ah hon na ngak hi,
Eidia huaia tenna bawl dingin.
Denchiang in, nuamsa in,
Tua gam hoih ah i kimu khawm ding;
Denchiang in, nuamsa in,
Tua gam hoih ah i kimu khawm ding.
Tua gam hoih ah eite’n la sa ding,
Tatsate la ging kilawm hi ding;
I kha lungkham nawn talou ding hi,
Khawlna nuam a hamhaih nawnlou ding.
I Pa migi van a om kiang ah,
I phatna thilpiak tu’n pe ve ni;
A hon itna thilpiak thupi leh,
Vualjawlna’n i nite siangsak ding.

Pathian Laibu manpha nah e,
Hatkhum a honpiak hi;
A sinsakna khawnvak bang’ vak,
Ka kha van a pi ding.
Pathian Laisiangthou,
Ka gou manpha hi!
Ka khe ding khawnvak, ka lampi di’n vak,
Bittak’ inn hontun ding.
Ka lungsim gim a kipaksak,
Hiai mial khitui luanna’h;
Ka hinna vak ape jel ding,
Ka launate beisak.
Damsung zanmial chimtakhuai ah,
Ka lam honpi jel ding;
Tangtawn ni vakphazaw leh siang,
Ka muh hun tanpha in.

Aw khawlna gam ka ngaklah hi,
Chikchian hong tung ding hiam?
Chikchian ka galvan ngakhia in,
Muangin, inn’h ka teng diam?
Jesu, hongpai mateng semni,
Jesu hong pai mateng, i na semni;
Huan inn ah kikhawm ding.
Khawlna ding Jesu kiang ka juan,
Vakmang nawn ken hon chi;
A ang ah Panpihpa ka mu,
Inn nuam hon tut mateng.
Ka Hondampa kiang lam ka juan,
Vakmang nawnlou dingin;
Amah ziakin sihna zou in,
Ka van inn nuam tung ning.
Lei ah kipahna ka mu kei,
Muanna inn nuam omlou;
Hiai leitung lungkhamna gamdai,
Ka inn nuam a hilou.

Ka lungkhamna teng Jesu kiang gen ning,
Hiai puakgikte kei kia’n ka zoulou;
Ka mangbatna ah hon panpih dinga,
Amah tate it in kem gige.
Jesu kiang gen ning, (2)
Ka puakgikte kei kia’n ka zoulou;
Jesu kiang gen ning, (2)
Jesu kia in kei hon panpih thei.
Ka buaina teng Jesu kiangah gen ning,
Amah lawm lainat siam, hehpihthei;
Amah hilh leng Aman hon honkhe dia,
Ka buainate A beisak pah ding.
Khem leh sual a om Hondampa ka ngai,
Aman ka puakgik hon dawnzaang thei;
Jesu kiang gen ning, Jesu kiang gen ning,
Ka lungkhamna teng hon thuakpih ding.
Aw, khovel in khelhna ah kei hon hiip,
Khial di’n ka lungsim khem in om nak;
Jesu kiang gen leng A hon panpih ding,
Khovel tung ah vualzohna tang di’n.

Kuan in, sem in, kizangbei in,
Pa deihlam sep ah kipak in;
Tua hi, Heutupa paina lam,
A nasempa’n juilou ding maw? (2)
Kuan in, semin, a thawn hilou,
Leia manna, van a punna;
Mite’n it in hon phatlou zong,
Poikei, Heutupa’n hon pakta. (2)
Sem in, duai ken, thum in ngak in,
Khialte pikik di’n pilvang in;
Khovel lamlian ah kuankhia in,
Vakmangte hon sawl lut meng in. (2)
Sem in, na sep ah kipak in,
Semgim di’n khawl, vakvai di’n inn;
Mouneipa aw na za pah ding,
Zankhang aw ging “Ngaiin, ka hong.” (2)

Toupa tu’n Na ma’h hong ung
Na khebul ah hong kun ung;
Ka ngetna uh hon nial ken,
A thawn in kon zong ding uam?
A thawn in kon zong ding uam?
Toupa ka kha un Nang ngak,
Lainat in hong kumsuk in;
Na hehpih’ hauhna’n dim sak’n,
Ka muk un Nang hon phat ding,
Ka muk un Nang hon phat ding.
Na deihdan bangin honpi’n,
Hia’h om in kon zong uhi;
Toupa bangchi’n masawn ding?
Na vualjawlna mulou in,
Na vualjawlna mulou in
Miteng in zong in mu hen,
Pathian tungnung hehpihsiam;
Damlou damsak’n, saltang hong’n,
Nang ah kipakin nuam ung,
Nang ah kipakin nuam ung.

En in! A hongsuk meipi toh,
Giloute adia thahpa;
Misiangthou sang tampi’n honjui,
A vualzoh la sa kawm in,
Halleluijah (3)
Jesu Kris lal tawntung ding.
Mit tengin Amah a mu dia,
Lalpen lauhuai a kijem;
Amah simmohte leh zuakte,
Singa kilhlum a dawt te’n;
Lungkham lua in (3)
Messiah taktak mu un teh.
Ahi, Amen, Honpak uhen,
Tawisang na mangtutphah ah;
Hondampa, Hatna, Thupina,
Lalgam phuang in Nanga di’n;
Halleluijah (3)
Aw, Toupa hong meng meng in.
Pengkulpi a honggin chiangin,
Lei leh van a taimang dia;
Mite deihlouh A misiangte,
Huih khua ah hon tuak in chin.
Thukhenna ah (3)
Hong in, Thukhenna ah chi’n.

Jesu kiang kal khat kia lel,
Bangdia tua suanlou ding?
Hong in, na khelhna phuang in,
Na Tanpa ma’h kun in.
Kal khat kia lel, kal khat kia lel!
Suan in, hon ngak hi;
Hong in, na khelhna phuang in,
Vualjawlna na tang ding hi;
A hehpihna manbei hi,
Nang hon piak, nial het ken.
Jesu kiang kal khat kia lel!
Ging in, na hing ding hi;
Tu’n aman It in hon ngak,
Ngaidam dia mansa in.
Jesu kiang kal khat kia lel!
Khelhna pan hehpihna;
Na lungtang koilam puk hiam?
Mitphiat kal teng hun bei.
Jesu kiang kal khat kia lel!
Aw, bangdia hon suan lou?
Tanpa na kiang kong kipia,
Bangdia chi mai lou oi?

Lungsim a kipak kawm in,
Hehpihsiam Toupa phat ni.
A zahngaihna om gige,
Chitak leh muanhuai gige.
A thupiak thilhihtheihna’n,
Siamthak khovel vaksak hi.
Aman nizung san singseng,
Ni tawntungin paisak hi.
Thilhing tengteng Aman vak,
A taksap chiteng uh pia.
Ahihleh, lung kipakin,
Hehpihsiam Toupa phat ni.

Kitheih chianna nuam Jesu keia,
Aw Pathian thupina ka chiam panta;
Hotdamna gou luah, Pathian leisa,
A kha a piansak, A si a sil.
Hiai ahi ka thu, hiai hi ka la,
Sun nichin a ka Hondampa phat,
Hiai ahi ka thu, hiai hi ka la,
Sun nichin a ka Hondampa phat.
Kipumpiakna kim, kipahna kim,
Tangtawn a nopna kim melin muta’ng;
Angelte’n hon puak tung lam apan,
A chitna’n hon thawn, itna’n hong huau.
Kipumpiakna kim, bangkim khawlta,
Ka Hondampa ah nuamsa’n hampha ing;
Tunglam en in galdon in ngak ing,
A hoihna’n dim ing, A itna zong.

Leitung om ma in Thu a om a,
Pa Pathian toh tangtawn in a kizom;
Bangkim a vek in Amah siam hi,
A siamlouh omlou hiai leitung ah.
Hiai thu ah hiaipen kipahpih hang,
Hiai Thu tuh mihing bang in hong piang;
A thupina mupen in hon gelh,
Hehpihna leh Thutak in a dim.
Bangdang hi kei e, hiai Thu i chih,
Toupa Jesu Kris, Amah ngei ahi;
Mi lungsim Thu a hong suak bangin,
Pathian lungsim a suak Kris ahi.
Pathian Jawlneite’n thu a gen uh,
Van Angelte’n zong a hon gen uhi;
Pak veni aw, A hon sawl nanung,
Pathian, Mihing, Amah Tapa ngei.

Jordan luigei huihpi lak ah.
Dingin mitmei suan ing;
Kanaan gam nuam leh gam hoih pen,
Ka neih teng om khawmna.
Huai gam nuam leh gam hoih ah i khawl ding,
Huai luigal gam hing eng singseng na’h,
Mosi leh Belamnou la sa in, denchiang in,
Jesu toh i om tawntung ding.
Huai phaijang gam zapi tung ah.
Tangtawn ni khat a tang;
Hua’h Pathian, Sunni in vaihawm,
Mialna teng a delh mang.
Chikchian huai mun nuam ka tung dia,
Kumtuang vualjawl hi in;
Chikchian ka Pa mel ka mu dia,
A angsunga khawl in.
Ka kha kipak’ nopna a dim,
Hia’h om sawt nawnlou ding;
Jordan tui kihawt’n hon um zong,
Laulou in galkai ning.
Huah nuamsa a ki kaihkhawmna,
Gam nuam hing ngiingei leh,
Kipahna tuipi luang khawng bang,
Ka mit in muta ding.

Jesu di’n bangkim, Jesu di’n,
Ka hihna teng hon tankhia;
Ka ngaihtuah ka gen leh sep teng,
Ka ni leh ka hun teng zong.
:$: Jesu di’n bangkim, Jesu di’n,
Ka ni leh ka hunteng zong.
D.S.
Ka khutte’n a chih teng sem hen,
Ka khete’n a lam tawn hen;
Ka mitte’n Jesu kia mu hen,
Ka muk in Amah phat hen.
:$: Jesu di’n bangkim, Jesu di’n,
Ka muk in Amah phat hen.
D.S.
Ka mit in Jesu kia en hi,
Thildangte teng mu nawn keng;
Ka kha’n mitkhain Amah mu,
Kilhbelh a om kia en in.
:$: Jesu di’n bangkim, Jesu di’n,
Kilhbelh a om kia en in.
D.S.
Aw lamdang hi, aw piandang hi,
Kumpite kumpi Jesu’n;
A it chi-in hon minloh a,
A kha nuai khawl di’n honsawl.
:$: Jesu di’n bangkim, Jesu di’n,
A kha nuaiah tu’n khawl ing.
D.S.

Tua luiah i kikhawm ding uam?
Angel siangte paina ah;
Tua ah siktui siang luang gige,
Pathian mangtutphah pan luang.
Tua luiah i kikhawm ding hi,
Tua lui kilawm, lui kilawm leh hoih ah;
Misiangthoute toh lui a kikhawm,
Pathian tutphah kianga luang.
Tua luigei mun nuampen pen ah,
Tuimal siangin theh silsil;
Amah be tawntung in om ni,
Ni thupi kipahna’n dim.
Tua lui tang mun i tun ma in.
I puakgikte ngakhia in,
I kha in hehpihna tang in,
Lalpuan leh manglukhu sang.
Tua luisiang mun i tungpah ding,
I khualzinna beipah ding;
I lung kipahna’n dimpah ding,
Muanna la ging kilawm ah.
Tua lui naubang nuihna mun ah,
Hondampa mel muhna hi;
Sihna khenlouh misiangthoute’n,
Hehpihna tatna la sa.

Immanuel nakliam apan,
Sisan leh tui hongluang;
:$: Tua sisan lui migilou di’n,
Gitlouh silsianna hi.(3)
D.S.
Gilou si ding a kilh un zong,
Hotdamna lui a mu;
:$: Amah bangin gilou leng zong,
Jesu’n hon ngaidam nuam.(3)
D.S.
Belamnou si, Na sisan pha’h,
Thilhihtheihna beilou;
:$: Pathian Saptuam tatsate teng,
Khial nawnlou di’n hon tan.(3)
D.S.
Huai lui Na liamnate a luang,
Ginna a ka muh nung;
:$: Itna, tatna ka la ahi,
Ka sih tanpha’n hi ding.(3)
D.S.
Ka lei mawltak, kamsiamlou pi’n,
Hankhuk dai a zot ma’n;
:$: La hoihzaw leh thupizaw in,
Na tatna la’n sa ning.(3)
D.S.

Zan kimlai hi Olive tang ah,
Zan khosawt aksi taang hil-hial;
Zan kimlai in tua hun sung ah,
Hondampa’n thuakin mimbang thum.
Zan kimlai’n bangteng paisan in,
Hondampa’n launa khattang’n thuak;
Nungjui A it luat nangawn in,
A Pu dah leh kap ngaihsaklou.
Zan kimlai’n singdang moh vangin,
Mi lunggim, luankhi si-in luang;
Albang dah lungkham a khukdin.
A Pathian in taisan lou hi.
Zan kimlai van huihkhi siang pan’n,
Zaila ngaih Angelte’n sa uh;
Simlei mi’n zalou tua zaila,
Hondampa gimthuakna hehnem.

Lam-et dang bangmah ka nei lou,
Jesu sisan hoihna loungal’
A hoihpen zong ka muang ngamlou,
Jesu min kia ah kinga ing.
Kris Suangpi kip tungah ka ding,
Mundang piaunel tumtheihna hi. (2)
Khomial in a mai a liah chian,
A itna danglou ah khawl ing;
Huihpi hat leh lauhuai nuai ah,
Ka sikkip in a honlen hi.
A chiam, A thukhun, A sisan,
Tuilian lak ah kei hon panpih;
Ka kha lungkia a om laiin,
Ka kinepna leh tenna hi.
Pengkul ging toh ahong nawn chian,
Aw huan Amah ah ka om dia;
Amah hoihna kia a thuamin,
Mangtutphah ma’h dembei ding ning.

Na sianna dingin Jesu kiang na juan hiam?
Belamnou si in na kisawp hiam?
A hehpihna tuin na muangkip na hiam?
Belamnou si in na kisawp hiam?
Na kisawp siang na hiam?
Kha sawpsiangna Belamnou si ah;
Na silhpuan siang vuk bangin a ngou na hiam?
Belamnou si in na kisawp hiam?
Nitengin Hondampa toh na tonkhawm hiam?
Belamnou si in na kisawp hiam?
Kilhden a ompa kiang na khawl den na hiam?
Belamnou si in na kisawp hiam?
Mouneipa hongpai chian na puan angou diam?
Belamnou si a sawpsiang leh ngou,
Na laukha tua inn vaak tungdi’n a man hiam?
Belamnou si in na kisawp hiam?
Khelhna a mual na puansilh koihkhia inla,
Belamnou si ah na kisawp in;
Kha siangloute dingin tua ah tuinak luang,
Aw, Belamnou si ah kisawp in.

Damsung khosak huihpi hatin hon nuai chian,
Lunglel a bangteng mangsak na kisak chian;
Hon vualjawlna tampi, khat khatin sim in,
Toupa’n nangdia Ahih lamdang na sa ding.
Hon vualjawlna khat khat in sim in,
Pathian honpiak vualjawlna sim in;
Hon vualjawlna khat khat in sim in,
Pathian honpiak vualjawlna tampi sim in.
Damsung lungkham puakgik pua’n na om ngei hiam?
Paw dia hon sap kros puakgik, gik na sa hiam?
Hon vualjawlna sim in, ginlahna bei ding,
Niteng in la sasa in na omta ding.
Midang gam neih leh hauhsakna na et chian,
Kris in hauhna gensenglouh hon chiam thei in;
Hon vualjawlna sim in, sum a leitheih louh,
Van a na kipahman leh tunga na inn.
Huchi’n gal lian leh gal neu douna lakah;
Pathian bangkim tungah om lungkia’n om ken;
Hon vualjawlna sim in Angelte’n hon kem,
Na zinna beima’n panpih in hon khamuan.

Toupa pengkul honggin chiangin hun beina a hong hi dia,
Tangtawn jingkhua hoih a hong vak kheta dia;
Lui gal gam nuam a leimi hotdamte kimukhawm un chin,
Tunglam a minsap khawm chiangin ka om ding.
Tunglam a min sapkhawm chiangin,(3)
Tunglam a min sap khawm chiangin ka om ding.
Tua sunni thak suah chiangin Kris a misite thou un chin,
Amah thohnawnna thupina tang un chin;
Van khena a inn ua, Amah mitelte a khop chiangin,
Tunglam a min sapkhawm chiangin ka om ding.
Jingni suah pan a tum dongin, i Toupa di’n i sem ding.
A hon itna lamdan dan gengen veni;
Huan sunni hongtum a zaitha tawl khawl a hong hun chiangin,
Tunglam a min sapkhawm chiangin ka om ding.

Toupa Jesu, Na thupha in,
Miza lungsim taisak;
Aw, Toupa, Na thu hoihdan dang,
Miza nunnopna hi.
Toupa Jesu, hinna kei di’n,
Pathian kiang kithoihna;
Pa, Pathian leh genthei kei di’n,
Ki pahna gim namtui.
Ken zong Toupa, ka sum leh pai,
Ka lungsim leh zaitha;
Lung kisik lou A kiang pe leng,
Amah di’n gim namtui.
Toupa thupha, nopna simthu,
Mohneite kiang gen ni;
Tangtawn hinna simthu pha hi,
Nam chih ta’n hon juan hen.

Lungdong ken bangteng na tuak zong,
Pathian in hon kem ding;
A itna kha nuai ah om in,
Pathian in hon kem ding.
Pathian in hon kem ding,
Nitengin leh lam tawntung in;
Aman hon kem ding hi,
Pathian in hon kem ding.
Sepgimni chian lungdong a om,
Pathian in hon kem ding;
Na lampi a lauhuai chiangin,
Pathian in hon kem ding.
Na poimoh teng A honpe ding,
Pathian in hon kem ding;
Na nget peuhmah hon it kei ding,
Pathian in hon kem ding.
Etkhiakna bangteng na tuak zong,
Pathian in hon kem ding;
Thatawl gim aw, A ang juan in,
Pathian in hon kem ding.

I sem ding, i sem ding, Pathian tate i hi,
I Toupa totsa lampi ah jui jel jel ni;
Zaitha tawl halhsak di’n Amah kamdam ngakin,
Khut in sep ding a muh peuh theihtawpin sem ni.
I sem ding, I sem ding,
I sem ding, I sem ding;
Lam-enin, ngak ni hang,
Heutupa hong matan sem ni.
I sem ding, i sem ding, gilkialte vah sak ni,
Hinna tuinak ah zaitha tawlte pi veni;
Kros leh a puanlap ah i thupina om ding,
Thupha “Hotdamna manbei” Thu i phuan laiin.
I sem ding, i sem ding, mi teng di’n sep ding om,
Mial leh khelhna lalgam thuneihna beita ding;
Jehovah Pathian min kia kitawisangta ding,
“Hotdamna manbei,” chi’n zaila ngaihin lem uh.
I sem ding, i sem ding, Toupa hatna muang in,
I sepgim man silhpuan leh manglukhu sang ding;
Mi ginomte inn, i tenna ahih hun chian,
Hotdamna manbei, tatsate’n kikou pih ni.

Jesu min heina peuh’ pua in,
Lungkham liangvai tate aw;
Kipahna muanna honpe ding,
Heina peuh ah paw jel un.
Min manpha, aw min ngaih,
Lei lam-et leh van pahna;
Min manpha, aw min ngaih,
Lei lam-et leh van pahna.
Jesu min chiklaipeuh’ pua in,
Khemna thang a na phaw di’n;
Khemnate’n hon um kimvel chian,
Min siangthou sam in thum in.
Aw Jesu min manpha lawmlawm!
I kha kipak in halhsak;
A itna anga hon pom chian,
I leite’n A phatlasa.
Jesu min a kiniamkhiak in,
A khebul ah hong kun un;
Van kumpite Kumpi, khusak’n,
I zinna i zoh chiangin.

Kris toh kivui khawm in ka thou khawm,
Ka hih ding bangdang om lai hiam?
Buaina leh haksatna tawpsan in,
Hinna thak lampi tawn in ka pai.
Khelhna sihsan, Kris toh kivui khawm,
Sisa, Kris Jesu ah ka hing nawn;
A niteng vaihawm a khosa in,
Lamtawn in hon don in honkem hi.
Ka thupina Lu Kris toh thou khawm,
Tu’n sianthouna lampi ka tawn;
Ngaihtuahna hoih toh huai ah pai ing,
Asisa khelhna pan suakta ing.
Kris toh hing in ka pumpi ka pia,
Pathian na sem dia chiamteh hi’ng;
Dan nuai hilou, hehpihna nuai ah,,
Khelhna nuaisiah in Kris hong tengta.
Asi nawnlou Kris toh ka hingkhawm,
Ka ma a pai Kris jui kawm in;
Ka saltanna pan suakta siang ing,
Keimah mah si a kibawl in.

Aw kipah ni, Nang ka Pathian,

Kipah ni, kipah ni,

Zoh hi, nasep zoh ahita,

Ka lungsim buai gige tu’n khawl,
Hiai kipahna ah kinga’n khawl;
Hia’h loupisemna ka muta,

Ki-ngakna nuam, thuchiam sukip,

Kipahna la’n a inn dim hen,
A inn siangthou a ka pai chian.

Leitunga ka na ka zoh chian,
Na itna a gal ka zoh chian;
Sihna daidam zong lau kei ning,

Itna mangtutphah ma’h sa ni,

Van lampi muangin juita in,
