Tangthu siangthou vakna tengteng,
Tawisanna a tungah om.
Damsung lungkhamna’n hon phak chian,
Lamet bei, launa a buai;
Kros in hon nusia ngeilou ding,
Enin! muanna, pahna’n vak.
Kipahna ni a hongtaan chian,
Itna, vak ka lampi ah;
Kros akipan hongtang khia in,
Sun nivak phasak sem hi.
Man-na, neihna, natna, nopna,
Tua kros in siangsak vek hi;
Tua ah muanna tehtheih vuallouh,
Kipahna toh om tawntung.

Toupa dinga nasemtu hih ka ut,
It a A thu siangthou pom hih ka ut;
Thum a phatna la sa’n, Nitenga A nasem in,
I Toupa Grephuan sung ah.
Ka sem ding, ka thum ding,
Toupa Grephuan, i Toupa, Grephuan sungah,
Ka sem ding, thumna toh,
Nitenga A nasem in,
I Toupa Grephuan sung ah.
Niteng a A nasemtu hih ka ut,
Khialte lamdika pitu hih ka ut;
Van inn nuam a lemna leh itna omna mun ah,
I Toupa Lalgam sungah.
Na semtu hat leh hangsan hih ka ut,
Jesu thu hondamthei pom hih ka ut,
Michih diktaka juante’n khawlna inn ngah ding hi,
I Toupa Lalgam sungah.
Semtu hih ka ut Toupa hon panpih’n,
Khial leh mangthangte na thu a pi din;
Nunnop tawp ngeilouhna tunglam kipahna hon hilh,
I Toupa Lalgam sungah.

Khovel kipak hen, Toupa hong,
Lei in pak hen, a Lal;
Amah’ di’n miteng kisa hen,
Van leh thilsiamte’n pak (2)
Van leh thilsiamte’n pahla sa.
Leitung nuam hen, Hondampa’n hawm,
Mite’n pahla sa hen;
Leite, luite, janggam, tangte’n,
Pahna la sa non uh (2)
Pahna la sa tuantuan uhi.
Khelhna, lungkhamna beita hen,
Ling in dou nawn kei hen;
A vualjawlna pedi’n hongpai,
Hamsia teng beita hen (2)
Hamsia tengteng beivekta hen.
Khovel dikna, itna’n vaihawm,
A thupinate teng;
A sianthouna namte theisak,
A itna lamdang hi (2)
A itna lamdang mahmah hi.

Jesu dinga  nitenga kha mangthang man hih ka ut,
Kei di’n manpha lua hi;
Khial mangthangsa lampi diklou nose di’n ka hilh nuam,
Saltang suakta sak di’n.
Jesu dinga kha mantu (2)
Aw, niteng’ hi nuam ing;
Jesu dinga kha mantu (2)
Kei di’n manpha lua hi.
Kha mangthang mantu leh Kris kianga pitu hih ka ut,
Hehpihna theisak di’n;
Jesu a tengden a, A deihdante hih ka ut hi,
Kei hon it luat ziakin.
Jesu’n kei honsap mateng kha mantu hih ka ut hi,
Ka puakgik nga dingin;
“Buhphal tampi na khawma, manglukhu vak hoih tangin,”
Hon chih ka za nuam hi.

Tui kihawt mial ah Hinna khau khak in,
Unau khat om, khattei hotdam dingin;
Khattei unau hi, aw, kua hiam kuan ngam?
Hinna khau vakhak ding, lauhuai thuakpih ding?
Hinna khau khak in, (2)
Tui in a taih mi khat om;
Hinna khau khak in, (2)
Kuahiam tui a tum ding hi.
Khut kin leh hatin Hinna khau khak in,
Bang dinga khawlkhawl, bangdia sawt zekai?
Enin, tum hi, aw tuni’n kinmeng in;
Hinna kuang toh kuankhia in, delh kin mengin.
Lauhuai a omte Hinna khau khak in,
Na phaklouhna munah tumding uhi;
Khemna huihpi leh lungkham tui hualte’n,
Tui dum kiai kuai luanna’n sepkhe pah ding hi.
Hotkhiakna hun hong kikhel pah ding hi,
Tangtawn’ mangthang dia tum pah ding uhi;
Kin-in, unau, zekai na’ng hun omlou,
Hinna khau khak inla, tuni’n honkhia in.

A zapeuhmahin hiai thu tangkoupih hen,
Leitung tengah hiai tangthu pha phuangzak un;
Mi omna peuh ah kipahna thu phuang un,
A ut peuhmah hongpai hen.
A ut peuhmah in, (2)
Singtang leh phai jang ah,
Hiai thu gensawn un;
Itna Pa in vakmangte inn ah honsam,
A ut peuhmah hongpai hen.
Hongpai peuhte dingin zekai ngailou hi,
Tu’n kong kihong, na lut theih laiin lutin;
Jesu kia Hinna Lampi dikpen ahi,
A ut peuhmah hongpai hen.
A ut peuhmahte adi’n thuchiam kip hi,
A ut peuhmahte tangtawn a muanhuai ding;
A ut peuhmahte di’n tangtawn hinna hi,
A ut peuhmah hongpai hen.

Phat un Toupa vante’n pahtawi,
Angel tungnungte’n phat un;
Ni leh kha A maah nuam un;
Aksi tangte’n Amah phat.
Halleluijah Amen,
Amen, Amen.
Phat un Toupa A thu gen ziak’n,
Khovel in A aw jui hen;
Dan thu a kise ngeilou ding,
Amau pitu dia A bawl.
Phat un Toupa A thupi ziak’n,
A thuchiam zuau ngeilou  ding;
A misiangthoute vualzou sak.
Khelhna leh sihna’n zoulou.
Phat un i hotdamna Pathian,
Van mipi’n A hatna phuang;
Lei leh van leh thilsiam tengin,
A min phat in liansak un.

Toupa Nanga hi’ng Na aw zata ing,
Na hon itna hon hilh hi;
Hizong muanna angsunga om ka ut,
Nang naihsem a om ka ut.
Honpi nai in, naisem, Toupa aw,
Na sihna sing kros naih in,
Honpi nai in, naisem, naisem Toupa aw,
Na si manpha luanna ah.
Tu’n hon siangsak’ Toupa Na nasem di’n,
Na hehpihna thahat in;
Ka kha’n lam-etna kip in hon en hen,
Nangah ka deihteng kim hi.
Aw dakkal khatlel kipahna siangthou,
Na tutphah maa ka zat;
Pathian Na kiang’ khukdin a ka thum chian,
Lawmta bangin kon houpih.
Itna thuk pipi ka theih zohlouh om,
Tuipi zim ka kan mateng;
Kipahna sangpi ka bat phaklouh om,
Nang toh muang a ka khawl ma’n.

Tu’n sun hun a beita,
Zan a hong naita;
Nitaklam nilim in,
Vanlai kan in liap, Amen.
Jesu, gim leh tawlte,
Tawlngakna nuam pia’n;
Na vualjawlna nem in,
Hon ihmusak in, Amen.
Naupang neute kiangah,
Nang muhna vak pia’n;
Longpu buaite veng in,
Tuipi dum tung ah, Amen.
Gimthuakte hehnem in,
Nat thuakte ching in;
Thil gilou hihtumte,
Khelhna pan khou in, Amen.
Jingkhua hongvak chiangin,
Nangmah mitmuh a;
Siang, a thak, khelh bei in,
Jing hon thousak in, Amen.

Angel tongsuah bang’ nem ngii-ngei,
Zaklouh thuhilhna honpia;
Lametna toh jaidam in zol.
Hehnepna thu in hong huau;
Zanmial abei matan ngak in,
Huihpi daih mateng ngak in;
Jingchia nisa vak lam-en in,
Vuahmal phin a then chiangin.
Lam-et thu huau,
Aw, na aw ngai na’ng e;
Ka lungsim, lungkhamna kipaksak hi.
Nitak vak philphial a tun chian,
Gamlapi gam mial mahleh;
Zankhua hong mial bikbek zong leh,
Aksi tang in vaksak lou;
Huan zan khomial in hontuam chian,
Bangdi’n i lungke ding hiam?
Zankhang mial a hong bei chiangin,
Jing ni suak ding na ngak in.
Lam-etna long khuam bang a kip,
I kha di’n mialpuan hawkkhia,
Heutupa honglutna lam ah,
A tunna ding han la mang;
Hongin, aw hongin, kipak in,
Ka lung tawl leh lungkham ah;
Hongin, Nang, thupina lem-et,
Hon paimangsan ngeingei ken.

Aw ginna a ton nawnlou ding,
Melma in sual mahleh;
Leitung lungkham chiteng a zong,
Linglou ginna ka deih.
Taihilhna chianga sawi a leng,
Soisel leh phunphun lou;
Dahna, natna tuah chianga leng,
Pathian a kinga ding.
Ginna siang leh a tangpha sem,
Huihpi’n a nuai chia zong;
Lauhuaina mun a zong laulou,
Mial a ginlah neilou.
Toupa, hiai bang ginna hon pia’n,
Huan bangteng hongtung zong;
Tua tangtawn inn nopna siangthou,
Lei ah leng chiam khol nung.

La in sa ning tangthu lamdang,
Kris keia dia hong sih thu;
A van inn thupi hon nusia’n,
Kalvari kros ah hong si.
La in sa ning tangthu lamdang,
Kris keia dia hongsih thu;
Tuipi siang geia kikhawm in,
Misiangthoute toh sa ning.
Kei mangthangsa Jesu’n hon zong,
Belam vakmangsa hon mu;
A itna ban a hon kai in,
A lampi a hon pikik.
Ka liamnate Jesu’n damsak,
Puk leh hamhaih in ka om;
Mitvakna bei’n launa’n hon bawm,
Hizong Aman hon honkhia.
Mialna nite’n kei hon tuam lai,
Lungkhamna lampi ka jui;
Hizong Hondampa’n hon ompih,
A khut in bittak’n honpi.
Tuipi luang in ka khe taizong,
Aman hon kem gige ding;
Bittakin hon gal kaipih dia,
Huai ah itteng muta ning.

Pathian in mimang honsam,
Ngaklou in juan meng in,
Ngaiin aw ngaikhia in,
Tu’n nang hon sam hi;
A ang a pan na vakmang zong,
Tuni’n hon juan in,
Ngaiin, itna aw’n hon sam lai.
Tu’n nang hon sam hi.
Aw, mimang gim hon juan in;
Tu’n nang hon sam hi,
Aw, mimang gim hon juan in.
Zahngai, it leh nunnem in
Pa in hon sam lailai.
Ngaiin, aw ngaikhia in,
Tu’n nang hon sam hi;
Aw hong kik in kha in,
Hehpih a hon gensak lai’n,
Ngaiin, itna aw’n hon sam lai.
Hongin na Pa inn ah,
Neksenglouh ding an om hi,
Ngaiin aw ngaikhia in,
Tu’n nang hon sam hi;
Ngaidih dohkan tung ah,
Nek ding luisa in hon ngak,
Ngaiin, itna aw’n hon sam lai.

Jesu’n hon sam, damsung tuipi,
Lauhuai leh kihawt khen ah;
Niteng in A aw nem kiza,
“Kristian, hon juiin,” chiin.
Jesu’n hon sam, leitung sabiak,
Bangmahlou hauhsakna pan;
Ei hon khouthei milemte pan,
“Kristian, hon it sem in,” chi’n.
I nopna leh i dahna ah,
Sepgimna leh awlna ah!
Mangbat, nopsak in leng hon sam,
“Hiaite sang’n hon it zaw’n,” chi’n.
Jesu’n hon sam, na zahngaihna’n,
Hondampa, hon zasak in;
Na thumang di’n lungsim pai nung,
Na na sem’ hon itpen di’n.

Ni tumna khen ah, aw jingsang nuam ah,
I Hondampa toh van i tun chian!
Lei sepgim bei dia ni thupi suak ding,
Ni tumna khen ah, damsung bei chian.
Ni tumna khen ah, meipi kai nawn lou,
Huihpi-vuahpi bei, launa beita;
Aw kipahna ni, aw tawp neilou ni,
Ni tumna khen ah, tangtawn nopna!
Ni tumna khen ah, A khut’n honpi ding,
I Pa Pathian kiang Amah bia in;
A thupina ma’h, hontuahna kamdam,
Tua luipiau nuam ah, ka tantuan hi.
Ni tumna khen ah, kituahkhawmna nuam,
A na paisa it leh ngaihte toh;
Tua gam inn hoih ah, kikhen om nawn lou,
Ni tumna khen ah, tangtawn dong in.

Damlai ni leh nop lai ni a tom ngei e,
Hizong ka Toupa hon itna leh thuakna;
Phawklou in lungkham mangbatnate leh natnate’n,
Ni chin in hontuam kimvel.
Lunggim na leh natna te’n,
A itna a hon mu sak tua itna vak tuh keia ahita;
Kris itna vak in ka lampi hon tangsak a,
Lungdam a len dan ka siam ta. (2)
Nunnuam a laitual ngabang ka len chiangin,
Ka Toupa hon itna leh thuaknate teng;
Ngilhkha jel ing, gimna leh haksatna ka tuah chiang,
A hon itna phawk jel ing.
Kris vang a hing ka hi chih ka thei kheta,
A sisan manpha vang A nunnop laiin;
Kei honnem jel Kris a hing hi’ng lungngaih ding omlou,
A gamchiam lut ding hi ta’ng.

Jesu, Hondampa honpi’n,
Damsung tuipi kihawt lak’h;
Ka ma’h theihlouh tui kihawt,
Suangpi, leh tuidai lauhuai.
Theih theihna Nang honpia in,
Jesu, Hondampa honpi’n.
Nu in nau kap a khem bang’n,
Nang na daisak thei tuilian;
Tui kihawt in na thumang,
Nang “Daita un,” Na chih chian;
Tuipi tung Kumpi, Lamdang,
Jesu, Hondampa honpi’n.
Tuipi gal kong nai chiangin,
Muang a khawlna kongtun ma’n;
Tui kihawt lauhuai hong mau,
Na angsung lam hon juan leng.
“Lauken, ka honpi kai ding,”
Ka kiang’ non chih ka za diam?

Kumtawn suangpi khi kei di’n,
Na lim ah hon busak in;
Na pang liam a si leh tui,
Hong luangkhia damna tui hi.
Khelhna leh ka sual thilhih,
Hon silsiang in damta ning.
Khut a ka nasepte in,
Na dan deihbang jui kim lou;
Ka khitui luang tawntung leh,
Nasep hoihte phatuamlou;
Khelhna tengteng maisak lou,
Nang kia in non hondam thei.
Khut ah bangmah hon tawi keng,
Na kros bel in kon len mai;
Vuaktang, puan deih in kon juan,
Panpihbei, hehpihna deih;
Mikhial in tuinak kon juan,
Non sil keileh si ding hi’ng.
Hing-dam a ka nak sung in,
Sihna a ka mitsin chian;
Theihlouh gam a ka thoh chian,
Pathian, mangtutphah a mu’n;
Kumtawn suangpi khi keidi’n,
Na lim ah hon busak in.

Hondampa, sihtan pha’n,
Itna non pia;
Ken zong ka im kei ding,
Nang di’n Toupa.
Ka kha itna’n kun in,
Ka thuchiam tang tung in;
Tu’n ka thilpiak kon tawi,
Hiai beek Nang di’n.
Na zahngaihna tutphah,
Ma ah konngen,
Ginna hatlou’n kon en,
Jesu Nang kiang.
Kros ka puak hon panpih’n,
Na itna lamdang’n phuang;
La hiam, thumna hiam in,
Hiai beek Nang di’n.
Lungsim ginom hon pia’n,
Nangmah bang di’n;
Ka paikhiak niteng in,
Hon mu nawn di’n;
Itna nasep pan in;
Migitna na sem in;
Vakvai zongin pi leng,
Hiai beek Nang di’n.
Ka neih ka hihna teng,
Na thil thawnpiak;
Damsung nopna, dahna’n,
Toupa, Nang di’n.
Na mel ka muh chiangin,
Ka kha tatsa hi’n chin,
Tangtawn, tangtawn dongin,
Hiai beek Nang di’n.

Kros lampi tawn in van inn ka juan ngei ding,
Hiailou lampi dang om lou;
Kongpi vak ka mu kha ngeikei ding hi,
Kros tawn lampi ka haih a leh.
Kros lampi’n inn ah honpi, (2)
Ka pai kawm a ka theih nuam ka sa hi;
Kros lampi’n inn ah honpi.
Sisan a theh lam tawn in ka pai ngei ding,
Hondampa totsa lampi;
Munsang thupi a ka kal touh aleh,
Tua inn ah Pathian toh teeng ning.
Huan khovel lampi toh ka kikhen ta hi,
Huaite jui ngei nawnlou ding;
Ka Toupa’n “Hong in” honchi inn ka zong,
Kong honsa a hon ngakna ah.

Nizung tang bangin ka vak ding,
Niteng vak siang leh hoih in;
Mial lak a vak hoih tangsak ding,
Mei vomte delhmang dingin.
Jesu di’n ka vak jel ding,
Niteng, mitphiatkal in;
Jesu di’n ka vak jel ding,
Mialna teng delhmang ding.
Lungkhamna meipi mial pen ah,
Agei jem in ka pang ding;
Jesu di’n ka vak gige ding,
Ka paina koimunpeuh ah.
Nizung tang banga vak dingin,
Toupa aw hon panpih in;
Nangmah batna Na kilawmna,
Kei ah hong kilangta hen.

Toupa toh i ton chian, A thu vak a paiin,
I lampi thupina’n hon tangsak;
A deihlam i bawl leh, i kiangah teng gige,
Amah muang a, thujuite kiang ah.
Muang in, jui in, Jesu a pahna ding,
Lampi dang omlou hial hi,
Muan leh thuman louhngal.
Puakgik paw nawnta lou lungkhamna thuak nawnlou,
I sepgimnate tampi’n hon din;
Lungkhamna, manna zong, nguina leh hehnate,
Muang in A thu jui le’ng vualjawlna.
Limliap omtalou ding, van meipi kailou ding,
A mel lungdamhuai in delhmang ding;
Ginlelh, launa omlou, lungngaih mittui omlou,
Amah muang a A thu i zuih leh.
A itna’n kipahna i theichian ngeikei ding,
I bangkim maitam a i piak ma’n;
Deihsakna A piakte, kipahna A piakte,
Muang a A thujuite ading hi.
Kithuahna nuamtak in A khebul ah tu ni,
A genpeuh i sem dia, Amah toh-ton in lam i pai ding;
Hon sawlna i pai dia,
Lau lou in muang ni, A thu jui ni.

Aw, Pathian hotdamna hehpihna za in thuk,
Kros a kipan kei dia luangkhia!
Tua ah Hondampa’n ka khelhna leiba lian din,
Kalvari a A thuakna in!
Aw, tuabang itna lamdang thukdan!
Tawplou in luang, kiching, manbei;
Ka khelhna leiba teng din zou vek,
Kalvari a A thuak na in!
Lungsim niamkhiak in tuni’n A ma ah ka kun,
A thuaknatdan ka ngaihtuah in;
A liamnate’n khelhna kol pan hon suaktasak,
Kalvari a A thuakjal in.
Aw, lainatna lamdang lua, itna kiam theilou!
Hehpihna tehvuallouh ka mu,
A sisan in ka siangta suakta, ka kipak,
Kalvari a A thuakjal in!

Pathian in A honzong hi;
Huaiziakin Amah ei Hontanpa phatni,
Vualjawl vuahtui hong luang hen.
Hon juan un, hon juan un,
Tuin A min in kikhawm ni;
Suah, Tum, Sim leh Mal, honjuan un,
Van ankuang um di’n honchial.
Belam bangin A kiang a pan in i mang,
Mohna lingnok in hondal;
Pathian in sulkik dingin A honsamta,
Sulkik in lambang pakni.
I pu leh pa apan i deihpen ahi,
Honzongin A hongtungta;
I Pa i zon mel in i na theilou hi,
Mite aw sulkik veni.
Tangthu lamdang vanglian vannuai ah hongthang,
Hon-gumpa Jesu simthu;
Tung thangvan apan hong kumsuk in A si,
A hon it mahmah ziakin.

Mimang zong inla kamsiam in jawl in.
Tang sangtung a mimang lamhaihte;
“Ka kiang hong un,” chi’n A thu’n gen tuantuan,
Heutupa thute’n tuni’n hon gen.
Gamla’ kuan in, tangsang tunglam ah,
Lamhaihte hon pikik nawn in, kik nawn in;
Kei Hontanpa huangsung nuamtak ah,
Jesu Belamnou khialte dia thah, khialte dia thah.
Mimang zongin, amau kawkmuh’n Jesu,
Kha hatloute leh lungsim bahte;
Hotdamna lampi ah honpilut in,
Tangtawn hinna lampi musak in.
Tua hehpihna thu gen in ka kuan ding,
Niteng a Kris sul jui gige in;
Bahte halhsakin, kipukte phong in,
Mangthangte kawkmuh’n, Lampi, Jesu.

Kon it sem ding Kris aw, kon it sem ding,
Ka thumna hon za in, ka khukdin hi;
Hiai ka ngetpen ahi, kon it sem ding Kris aw,
Kon it sem ding, kon it sem ding.
Lei pahna ka na zong, muanna, khawlna,
Tu’n Nang kia ka hon zong, Hon pia’n hoihpen;
Hiai teng ka thumna hi. kon it sem ding Kris aw,
Kon it sem ding, kon it sem ding.
Dah na ut leh om hen, lungkham, natna,
Na sawlte’n kei hon nem, la in hon nem;
Hiai ka sakkhawm chiangun, kon it sem ding Kris aw,
Kon it sem ding, kon it sem ding.
Ka hat tawp pen dongin, Nang phat lai ding,
Hiai khenna aw hihen, ka lungsung ah;
Hiai ka thumna hi lai, kon it sem ding Kris aw,
Kon it sem ding, kon it sem ding.

Jesu, Hondampa, Bethlehem ah hong,
Zum leh dah thuak di’n gankuang ah hongpiang;
Aw a lamdang, A min phat in om hen,
Kei hong zong hi, hong zong.
Kei hong zong hi, (4)
Aw a lamdang, A min phat in om hen,
Kei hong zong hi, hong zong.
Jesu, Hondampa’n Kalvari sing ah,
Leibat lian pia, ka kha suakta sak hi;
Aw a lamdang, tuabang omthei lawmlawm,
Kei di’n hongsi, kei di’n.
Kei di’n hong si, (4)
Aw a lamdang, tuabang omthei lawmlawm,
Kei di’n hong si, kei di’n.
Jesu, Hondampa zahngaihna, itna’n.
Tunglam van inn nuam apan hongpai in;
Mikhial kei di’n aw nem in hon gensak,
Hon gensak hi, kei di’n.
Hon gensak hi, (4)
Mikhial kei di’n aw nem in hon gensak,
Hon gensak hi, kei di’n.
Jesu, Hondampa tang a angei bang,
A huang apan gamla’ ka vakmang chian;
Zaidam leh itna’n ka kha di’n gensak,
Kei honsam hi, hon sam.
Kei honsam hi, (4)
Zaidam leh itna’n ka kha di’n gensak,
Kei honsam hi, hon sam.

Ka kipak, Pa van a omin hon hilh,
A honpiak Laibu sung ah A itna;
Bible sung ah thillamdangte ka mu,
Hiai manpha pen hi Jesu’n kei hon it.
Jesu’n hon it, ka kipak lua hi,
Jesu’n hon it, Jesu’n hon it;
Jesu’n hon it, ka kipak lua hi,
Kei nangawn A hon it.
Amah mangngilh in na vakmang leng zong,
Ka vakmangna peuh ah hon it lailai;
A itna angsung juan in taikik ning,
Jesu’n kei hon it chih ka theih khiak chian.
Aw la khatbek saktheih ka neih aleh,
A kilawmna a Kumpi ka muh chian;
Tangtawn tangtawn in hiai ka la hi ding,
“Jesu’n kei A hon it, lamdang hi,” chih.
Hiai kitheihchianna ah khawlna ka mu,
Jesu muang, ka hampha hi chih ka thei;
Jesu’n kei hon it chih ka hilh phet in,
Lungdong setan in ka kha taisan tu’n.

Jesu kiang ah ka kipumpiak,
Bangteng Amah ka pevek;
Amah it in ka muang den ding,
Niteng’ A kiang ah ka om.
Kong kipumpiak hi, (2)
Hondampa hoih, bangteng Na kiang’
Kong kipumpiak hi.
Jesu kiangah ka kipumpiak,
A khe phung ah ka kun hi;
Leitung nopsakna nusia ing,
Jesu tuin, honla in.
Jesu kiang ah ka kipumpiak,
Hondampa ka pum’n hon nei’n;
Damsung kipahna hon hilh in,
Nang keia chih thei chiang ning.
Jesu kiang ah ka kipumpiak,
Toupa, Na kiang’h kong kipia;
Na itna, hatna’n hon dimsak,
Na vualjawlna hon buak in.

Muanna’n luiluang bang ka lampi hon zuih chian,
Lungkham tuipi hong kihawt chian;
Ka tan khempeuh ah, “A hoih hi, ka kha di’n,”
“A hoih hi,” chi dingin non hilhta.
A hoih hi, ka kha di’n,
A hoih hi, ka kha di’n, A hoih hi.
Aw ka khelhna, hiai ngaihtuah nuam ka sa hi,
Ka khelhna a khen kia hilou;
Avek in kros ah kilhden hi, neita keng,
Ka kha aw, phat in Toupa phat in.
Setan in sual in, ze-etna om mahleh,
Hiai thuchiam hoih in hon lenkip,
Kris in panpih ka ngaihdan limsak gige,
Ka kha di’n A sisan a suahta.
Gingtu kimuhkhawm ni tung zok hen Toupa,
Van meipi jing daibang theng hen,
Pengkul ging nawn ding, Toupa hong kumsuk ding,
“Huchi’n leng,” a hoih hi, ka kha di’n.

Nipikal ni masapen in,
I Hondampa han apan thou;
Hong si vuia omin thounawn,
Vaihawm, vualzou leh hondam di’n.
Midangte’n Toupa nusia zong,
Na thutak zong di’n kou om ung;
Na hon ompihna’n hon khamuan,
Nipikal ni masapen in.
Nipikal masapen in,
Ei dia sisan luang Amah ngei;
Theihgigena tanghou balkham,
Nou dawn di’n nungjuite kikhawm.
Nipikal ni masapen in,
I biak kumpite Kumpipa;
Toupa vualjawlna i muh bang,
Amah’ di’n koihkhawl chiat ni hang.
Hiai ni’n nungjui it, Johan in,
Kris mu in A aw ngaih za hi;
En leng kha in Amah bia hang,
Thumna leh la’n i lung nuamsak.

Pak banga kilawm leh hoih ahi;
Inn nuampen ni sanga vakzaw hi,
Lengnuam veng Jesu kiang thangvan ah.
Len ka nuam, len ka nuam,
Jesu kiang thangvan ah leng nuam ing;
Len ka nuam, len ka nuam,
Jesu kiang thangvan ah leng nuam ing.
Pathian thu lungsim a ngaihtuah in,
Hinna muanna thu ahi ka thei;
Gilkial leh dangtak na ahon nem,
Liangvaite Pathian ah munmuang ding.
Van-gam nopdan kuata’n gen thei ding,
Kahna leh lungkhamna bang himhim;
Phamsa ngai a naubang kahnate,
Sihna leh mauna bang om nawnlou.
Huai gam nunnuam i luah ding gam  hi,
Pathian in mite a honsam hi;
A sapna hoihtak in ngaidih ua,
Toupa kiang kumtuang a omna hi.

Kris ei hon Tanpa, phattak mahmah hi,
Thupi, zahtakhuai leh thahat hi;
I kha tengteng a pahtawi dia hoih hi,
Phattak Na hi, phattak Na hi.
Hauhsakna, vualjawlna leh zahhuaina,
Pilna, thupina, thilhihtheihna;
Lei leh vanmi kipahna Nanga vek,
Phattak Na hi, phattak Na hi.
Kipumpiakin phatna aw ngaihsak un,
Lei misiangthou teng A ma’h kun hen;
Van a Angelte’n hiai chiin bia hen,
Phattak Na hi, phattak Na hi.
Toupa Na ma’h lasa’n hong pai ni ung!
Na kha pilna leh thahatna toh;
Zahna leh phatna hon pe ni ung maw!
Phattak Na hi, phattak Na hi.

Tawlna gam ah Suangpi khat om hi,
Alim in piaunel sa votsak hi;
Khualzinte na na samsam hi,
Gamdai limliap ah hong khawl un chi’n.
Ba si ding na hiam, Aw bangdia si ding?
Bukna ding Suangpi a nai laiin,
Aw bangdia si ding?
Gamkeu jang ah tuikulh khat om hi,
A tui in deihsakin hon zolzol;
“Aw kha khial dangtak peuhmahte,
Hongun, manbeiin dawn un, damna’n,”
Ba si ding na hiam, Aw bangdia si ding?
Tuikulh a tui hing a nai laiin,
Aw bangdia si ding?
Kong zapi a hon huang khat om hi,
Belamte mualpang ah vakmang uh;
Belampu mualtung ah kah in,
A belam mang tuin muta hi.
Ba si ding na hiam, Aw bangdia si ding?
Belampu belam huang nai laiin,
Aw bangdia si ding?
Hondampa sihna kros khat om hi,
A sisan tuinak bangin luang hi;
Mite khelhna kithoihna hi,
A lut peuhmahte dia manbei hi.
Ba si ding na hiam, Aw bangdia si ding?
Sisan a luang kros a nai laiin,
Aw bangdia si ding?

Hondampa gen ka za,
Na hatna neulua hi;
Hatlou aw, ngak in thum in,
Kei ah na deih teng mu in.
Jesu’n pezou vek,
Amah ka ba vek;
Khelhna a nin baangsa hi’ng,
Aman vuk bang sawpsiang.
Toupa tu’n ka muta,
Na hatna, Nanga kia;
Phakna ma hihsiang thei,
Lungtang khauh hihnem thei.
Bangmah hoihna nei keng,
Na zahngaihna ngen di’n;
Ka puansilh sawpsiang ding,
Kalvari Belamnou si’n.
A mangtutphah ma ah,
Gensiatbei’ ka din chian;
Ka sepgah teng Jesu,
Khebul ah ngata ning.

Hondampa lamdang Jesu, ka Toupa hi,
Kei di’n Hondampa lamdang hi;
Suangpi khi ah Aman ka kha hon selsak.
Tua ah nopna lui luang ka mu.
Suangpi khi ah Aman ka kha hon selsak,
Tua in ka buaina teng beisak;
A itna thuk ah ka hinna hon selsak,
Tua ah A khut in honhum hi.(2)
Hondampa lamdang Jesu, ka Toupa hi.
Aman ka puakgik lamang ta;
Aman honlenkip, ka paimang kei ding hi,
Aman niteng’ hatna honpia.
Mitphiatkal teng’n vualjawlna tampi’n honvuk,
A hoihna kim in hon dimsak;
Lawp in  la ka sa hi, aw Pathian thupi,
Tuabang Tanpa keia hitel!
A vak’ thupi a kijem a ka thoh chian,
Van a Amah tuak di’n thou ning;
A hotdamna bukim, A itna lamdang,
Vanmi nuai tampi toh sa ning.

Jingsol aksi bang tang in;
Na tatna sisan pha vang in,
Tangtawn nunnop, hinna pia’n.
Aw Toupa, solnou bang tang in,
Tuipi gal gam gamla ah;
Nang non itna simthu hoihpen.
A mawk a piak na chiam hi.
Khomialna mun hiai leitung ah,
Mi si dingte nang gum in;
Kum bei, ni bei, hun beibeita,
Awlmoh in a man ma un.
Na thuchiam thupi leh siangthou,
Gospel simthu lel unla;
Huan, na kiang uah ka om jel ding,
Chi a Na thuchiam hilh in.

Jesu’n honsam hi, hon samsam hi,
Jesu’n tuni’n honsam hi;
Bangdia zekai ding ka hiam, ka hiam?
Ka thou dia, ka juanpah ding.
Amau nuamsa uh, nuamsa, nuamsa,
Hondampa thumangte in;
Bangdia zekai ding ka hiam, ka hiam?
Ka thou dia, ka juanpah ding.
Jesu’n hon gensak, gensak sak hi,
Bangdi’n khelhna’h ka mang dia?
A thupina, a thupina ah,
Kipakin A hontuak ding.
Angelte’n honveng, honveng veng uh,
Ka zuih ding kinem kawm in;
Amah pom ning, it ningin bia ning,
Jesu, tuni’n ka hong hi.
Jesu’n hon ngak hi, hon ngakngak hi,
Tuin kong honsa in om;
Zan hongtungpah ding hi, tungpah ding,
Kong kikhak tawntungta ding.

Kristian sepaih masuan, galkap di’n pai un,
Jesu kros pua unla, malam ah pai un;
Kris, Kumpi, Heutupa, galdou di’n makai,
Masuan un galmun ah, en un A puanzak.
Kristian sepaih masuan, galdou di’n paiin,
Jesu kros pua unla, malam ah pai un.
Mangtutphah, manglukhu, Lalgamte mangthei,
Jesu Saptuamte bel, om tawntung ding hi;
Gawtmun kongkhak in lel, Saptuam te’n zou hi,
Kris thuchiam nei hang e, tua zuauthei ngeilou.
I vualzohna ma ah, Setan pawlte tai,
Kuan un kristian sepaih, vualzou ngei dingin;
Gawtmun suangphum lingta, phatna aw ging ah,
Unaute, kikou un, phatla ngaihsak un.
Mipite, masuan un, Pawl nuamsa jui un,
Nou aw, kou aw gawm ni, vualzohna la sa’n;
Thupi, phat, zahtakna, Kris kumpi kiang ah,
Hiai kumsawt kumsawt in, mi, Angelte’n sa.
Sepaih hatte bangin, Pathian saptuam pai,
Mi siangthoute sul jui hihang unaute;
Kikhen omlou hihang, sapum khat hihang,
Lamet, thugin a khat, hehpihna a khat.

Pathian in hon it man in,
A ta khat neihsun pia;
Mi khempeuh Amah gingtute di’n,
Tangtawn hinna lampi,
Manbei in jui sak hi,
En in A lalgam hongtungta hi.
Lawm aw nang nong jui diam?
Ka muh hinna lampi,
Pathian pan a Thupiak muanhuai hi.
Jesu ah lampi dik leh,
Thutak leh hinna om;
Pa kiang tunna Amah lampi hi,
Thutak khuam kingakna;
Amah gingtute hi,
Jui in na hinna a bei ma in.
Aw B-I-B-L-E hi,
Bible hi Pathian thu;
Bible sung ah dan khempeuh kim hi,
Pathian gingtute di’n;
Dan dang bawl ngailou hi,
Zong in akimdan na mu ding hi.
Pathian khat leh ginna khat,
Baptisma khat ahi;
Pathian lalgam sung a lutna di’n,
Hiai teng na hih peuhleh;
Lalgam na lut ding hi,
Hiai lou lampi dang kibawl lou hi.

Jesu khebul ah tu kawm in,
Niteng’n ngak in vil gige’n;
A hehpihna leh hatna muang’,
Lamtawn in hon kembit hi.
Jesu khebul ah tu kawm in,
Tua’h khukdin in ka thum nuam;
A hoihna leh A thupina’n,
Ka lammial a delhmang ma’n.
Jesu khebul ah ngaikhia in,
A thupiak za a thei ding;
Amah’ pilna muang gige in,
Ka zuih chian bittak’ honpi.
Jesu khebul ah zong lai in,
Mun dang ka zong nawn kei ding;
Tua ah A hehpihna kiching,
Ka nget theihna mun pen hi.
Damsung sepgimna a bei chian,
Leitung taina ka zoh chian;
Nitak khua mial a hun bei chian,
Tua mun ah hon muta ding.

Theihgigena manpha kei ah,
Muhlouh Angelte’n honsawl;
Ka kha ah mang ngeilou in teng,
Hun hoih paisa honghil jel.
Theihgigena manpha, taang den,
Ka kha tuibangin tum hi;
Zan khang lai khodai nuai ah leng,
Mun siangthou manpha honghil.
Manpha, Pathian, Hondampa it,
Kumkhua in amau it ning;
Grephuan sung ah na ka sem ding,
Ka Toupa it hongpai pha’n.
Zankhanglai khodai nuai ah leng,
Hun paisa awte ka za;
Misiangthoute’n unaute toh,
La sa in thu kihilh uh.
Damsung lampi a ka zin lai,
Kum hoih, kum sia theilou in;
Ka gelgel leh kinepna om,
Theihgigenate’n hontuam.

Pathian a pan ka vakmangta,
Tuin inn kon juan;
Khelhna lampi sawt ka tawn lua,
Toupa inn kon juan.
Inn kon juan, inn kon juan,
Mawkvak nawnlou di’n;
Hehpihna’n Nang a hi ning,
Toupa inn kon juan.
Kum hoih tampi mawk bei sakta’ng,
Tuin inn kon juan;
Tu’n khitui luangin kisikta’ng,
Toupa inn kon juan.
Toupa sual a vakthang tawl ing,
Tuin inn kon juan;
Na itna muang’n Na thu ging ning,
Toupa inn kon juan.
Ka kha damlou, ka lung ana,
Tuin inn kon juan;
Ka tha leh lam-et thaksak in,
Toupa inn kon juan.

Kha mang aw, bangdia zekai a,
Pathian huang ‘pan vakmang ding?
A hon sapna za lou na hiam?
Na Pathian tuak di’n kisa’n.
Kha mang aw thuhilhna limsak’n,
Na hinna beipah ding hi;
Kiginglou a thukhenna ma’,
Pathian na tuah ding poi lua!
Hun leh kumte khawllou in pai,
Bang dia kingaihtuah zok lou?
Damsung haihuai a zang ding maw?
Na Pathian tuak di’n kisa’n.
Na lawm leh vual hon deihsakte’n,
Hon hilhhilh uh za lou maw?
Jingchiang hong tunma in, Pathian
Tuak di’n sap na hikha thei.
Kha in hon paimangsan pha a,
A hon sapna na nial leh;
Kiginglou a Pathian tuak in,
Lungkham dahna na mu ding.

Ngai un, Toupa Jesu’n hon sam hi,
Buhla ding hangsan, dik;
Lou a sana buh at di’n hon ngak,
Hizong nasem ding tawm.
Kuan un, kuhkal, it leh migi in,
Toupa Jesu min in;
Hotdamna manbei thupha phuang un,
Leitung namchih lai ah.
Kuan unla mangthangte honkhia un,
Mohnei mial a omte;
Pai unla, hondam di’n va panpih’n,
Setan kolbulh phel un.
Kuan un liangvaite pak in nuam hen,
Itna kuang um uh hen;
Amah, tangtawn Hinna Tanghou in,
Amau a nem ding hi.
Kuan un ni tumdek hi mualdawn ah,
Ahong tum zok ding hi;
Ani leh dak ahong tungpah ding,
Na sep theih nawnlouh hun.

Ka Hondampa toh kituak ding,
Khutvuak in ka pai ding hiam?
Ni khat beek A na sem louin,
Bang ka chitel ding a hiam?
Ka Hondampa toh kituak ding,
Khutvuak in ka pai ding maw?
Kha mang khat kia beek pilou a,
Ka tuah ding ka Hondampa!
Sih zaw dah in lungkham keng e,
Hondampa’n honpi ziakin;
Hizong khut vuak a tuah dingin,
Hondahsak in, lungkhamsak.
Kum mangkhinsa zousiahte aw,
Sap nawn theih hile uchin;
Honsam in, Hondampa kiang ah,
Kipak in ka honpe ding.
Mi tengtengte aw, thou unla,
Tung sunni a vak lai in;
Sihna’n a honlap man ma in,
Na kha uh dingin sem un.

Ahi, kei A hon ngaihsak hi,
Itna nem in honching;
Ahi, ka puakgik leh launa,
Hon dawn in hon thuakpih.
Ahi, kei honveng honching hi;
Sun leh zan tawlnga lou in;
Ahi, manthatna lampi’ pan,
Kei mahmah hon kaikhia.
Ahi, kei dingin hon gensak,
Hehpihna tutphah ah,
Kei di’n khawl lou in gen gige;
Itna’n, itna tawp lou’.
Ahi, itna leh vak in thuam,
Lei pahna banglou hon pia;
Kei hon khuh di’n A hatna,
Itna’n ka tungah kha zak.
Ahi, keiah Amah hong teng,
Kei Amah ah ka teng;
Huan kinepna’n ka kha dimsak,
Tunung ding buai mahleh.
A hongpai kik ngak in ka om,
Van lam tawntung a la sa’n;
Tua jingsang kipahna late,
Tua nitak la ngaihte.

Tuani hongtun chiangin jingsang zong hithei hi,
Khomial leh liap a kipan nivak hong suah chian;
Jesu thupina teng a thuam in hong pai dia,
Leia A mite khawm dingin.
Toupa Jesu, bang tan kipah la sa’n ka om ding ua?
Kris hong pai ma’n;
Halleluijah! Halleluijah! Amen.
Halleluijah, Amen.
Sunkimlai zong hithei, khovak kuan zong hithei,
Zankhang kimlai mial lak bang hita zenzen leh;
A thupi na vak sunni bang in hong tang dia,
Jesu’n A mite la ding hi.
Van pan hong kum A sepaihte’n Hosana chi’n,
Angel leh misiangthou thupite’n hon jui in;
Hehpihna leh thupina di’n Amah’ ang ah,
Jesu’n A mite la ding hi.
Lunglawp leh kipak in i paidenta ding hi,
Natna, lungkhamna, lauhna, kahna om nawnlou;
I Toupa thupi a meipi lak a tuak ding,
Jesu’n A mite la ding hi.

Tua mun thupi khenlam ah gamchiam gamnuam khat a om hi,
Hotdamta te’n A thupina chiampah ding;
Tua mun ah mihingte kha lut dinga hing gigeta ding,
Tua mun ah mitengteng kipakta ding hi.
Mi tengteng kipakta ding hi,
Tua mun ah kipakta ding;
Amah’ phatna la sa ni,
Tua mun ah mitengteng kipakta ding hi.
Tua mun ah mangtutphah kim ah tatsate’n lasa ding uh,
Huai gam ah lung khamna kuama’n theingei lou!
Nam tengteng a kristiante’n vualzohla sakhawmta ding uh,
Tua mun ah mitengteng kipakta ding hi.
Huai gam ah kuamah thumna leh mauna i zata kei ding,
I puak ding puakgik himhim omta lou ding;
Mitengin “Belamnou kiang’h thupina om hen,’ chih sa in,
Tua mun ah mitengteng kipakta ding hi.
Tua ah i Hondampa hehpih a Honchingpa i tuak dia,
Huaigam vak leh hoih a honpi pa mu in;
A ma ah A min phatnala sain om gigeta ni,
Tua mun ah mitengteng kipakta ding hi.

Jesu, Sharon Rose lungsung ah hong pak in,
Na thutak hoihna leh siangthou hong hilh in;
Koi mun teng ah ka pai zong ka hinna in,
Pathian itna theihna gimnamtui suah hen.
Jesu Sharon Rosepak,
Ka lungsung ah itna leh hoihna’n pak hen.
Jesu Sharon Rosepak leitung a muh theih,
Pak hoih chi teng sang a hoihzaw leh namtui;
Nitengin na hehpihna leh sianthouna,
Hon pia inla ka hinna buchingsak in.
Jesu, Sharon Rosepak, natna dia damna,
Na hehpihna hihdamtheihna in luang hen;
Kha lam a tawlte leh puakgik pote di’n.
Tasamte hatna leh muanna penawn in.
Jesu, Sharon Rosepak, pak tawntungta hen,
Na thupina lei mun teng ah kilang hen;
Namte’n na lalna buching a ngah mateng,
A letna uh ngakhia’n na ma’h kun uhen.

Ka om dan ka gamtat dan a honglamdangta,
Jesu’n ka lungsim Aluah nung!
Ka zonzon vakna ka lungsim ah ka neita,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Ka lungsim ah kipahna tuipi bangin luang,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Ka vakvaih leh lammanna apan ka khawlta,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Ka khelhna tampite sawpsiang vek ahita,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Lametna kipaktak leh muanhuai ka neita,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Ginlahna mei mial in ka lampi tu’n liah lou.
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Tuin sihna kuam ah vak a om kei dingin,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Tua khen a khopi kongpi ka mu theita hi,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!
Tua khopi a teng di’n ka pai ding chih ka thei,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luahnung!
Kipak in nuam mahmah ing, ka pai kawmkawm in,
Jesu’n ka lungsim A luah nung!

Toupa Jesu hong kumsukna ngakte aw,
A hongpai ding chih gen kimvel un;
A thu mangin pai un, kuan un gamchih ah,
Tangtawn hinna Amah’ thu gen un.
Hong kumsukna ding ni chiam hongnaita e,
Nite a kiam, hun a tomta;
Tatsa te’n hongpai kipahpih’n lasa hen,
Mi chih kisakhol hen.
Toupa Jesu hong kumsukna ngakte aw,
Ihmute phawng unla, thumsak un;
Van a Mouneipa A hongtungzok ding hi,
En unla kiging un, hongpai ding.
Zion Toupa thupi, pahtawi chiat lehang,
Jawlneite’n lenga na genkholh uh;
Lasa in Toupa phat un, Angelte aw,
Amah ma ah kipahthu gen un.

Ka mu gamnuam kei ding a om,
Lungsim maimit a ka et chian’,
Tua gam vak in eng singseng e,
Tua gam in vak silhpuan in nei.
Aw itna gam, nuampen leh vak,
Na thupina’n lei mial tanvak;
Na luipiau nuam, kou zong mu ding,
Sunni suah a, mialna bei chian.
Tua gam kilawm luipiau nuam ah,
Mialna omlou, nitna omlou;
Tua’ kimute kikhen nawn lou,
Kumsawt kikhen dawnbang kituak.
A vaante lei vaante banglou,
Zehoih leh vak chichih a dim;
Tua mun ah sunni tang ngailou.
Zan khomial delhmang ding omlou.
Tua mun ah huihkhi sia lang lou,
Tenna gam nuam leh muanna ah;
Vakvaite’n tua ah inn mu thei,
Pathian Paradis sung nuam ah.

Amah’ khekhap na jui na hiam,
Thilhoih na hih gige hiam?
Na chihtakna tengteng suah in,
Jesu nung na jui na hiam?
Huai lampi tawn na jui na hiam?
Tua hong tangpha sem ding hi,
Tua gam nibang tanna mun a,
Innpi nuam na tun ma in.
Amah’ khekhap na jui na hiam,
Thilhoih na hih gige hiam?
Na chihtakna tengteng suah in,
Jesu nung na jui na hiam?
Amah’ khekhap na jui na hiam,
Mimangte na zong ngei hiam?
Gamkeu gam leh mualsang tungah,
Bangzahta sen a ngai zong;
Lamlian ah leh pumpelhte ah,
Na khap a kimu ngei hiam?
A khe tawl leh khepek gim in,
Khap a nawtsiatna lei ah.
Amah’ khekhap na jui na hiam?
Nitenga jui dia hon sawl,
Hondampa a kiang’ na jui hiam?
Amah mupha gige in;
Nisa nuai leh niliap ah leng,
Mial nuaiah leh vak ah leng,
Tua gam nibang tanna mun a,
Na zinna ma na sawn hiam?

Jesu hoihna keimah tung ah kimu hen,
A sianthouna teng leh A thuakna lamdang;
Pathian kha in ka mihinna teng bawlhoih hen,
Jesu hoihna keimah tung ah kimu hen.
Na puakgik giklua a, apuakhak chiang in,
Na vengte’n na puakgik hon dawn noplouh chian;
Chihna ding theilou a mangbang a na om chian,
Jesu hoihna nangmah ah kimusak in.
Kuahiam khat in honhehpih hetlouh chiang in,
Hon kouna un hon suklunggim hun chian zong;
Khem, chilphih leh kousiat a ompa ngaihtuah in,
Jesu hoihna nangmah ah kimusak in.
Jingsang phalvak apat nitum tanpha in,
Nasep leh thugen teng a etton ding in;
Na thilpiak hoih a khebul ah hon tawikhawm in,
Jesu hoihna nangmah ah kimusak in.

Aw koia om uh hiam buh at dingte,
Khelhna lou apan buhvui hoih khawm ding?
Thutak kawite a zang a nasem ding,
Buhlak zoh ma a kuamah khawllou ding.
Buh at ding koiah, kuahiam kuan ding?
Buhlak thupitak inn a hon nawnlut ding,
Kua hiam hon huh ding, lakhawm dingin;
Khelhna lou apan buhvui hoih khawm ding.
Lamchih ah kuankhia in va zong vek in,
Loupa taam mahleh buh om kha thei hi;
Lamlian kim zong in, khat leng taisan ken,
Vantung a inn adi’n hon khawm vek in.
Gamla naiah buhte min phengphung hi,
Buhlak hun lua, leitung in hon ngak hi;
A la dingte tawm, nasep ding tamlua,
Buhlak zekai leh tampi mangthang ding.
Mite aw hong un, na kawite u toh,
Sana buhvuite hon kaikhawm vek un;
Toupa A hongpai phain nasem un,
Pawltak chia inn a pahna jou khawm ding.

Toupa, Nang naihsem nuam ing,
Nang hon naihsem ing;
Na kha lim nuaiah bit in,
Om gige nuam ing.
Ginlah leh khelhna lian hi,
Sung leh pua a honsual hi;
Zou di’n hon panpih’n Toupa,
Nang hon naihsem ing.
Toupa, ka Suangpi kon naih,
Ka kha bukna aw;
Huihpi hat zong ka lau kei,
Tui kihawt zongleh.
Huih hatpen zong laulou in,
Hon hihnat theihlouh ziakin;
Na itna ban a kinga’n,
Nang hon naihsem ing.
Panpihpa leh Kingakna,
Nang naihsem sem in;
Kingainiam’n hiai chithei ning,
“Pa kei thu hilou.”
Gimthuak hun a kisin in,
Dahna meipi hong kai chian;
Itna’n Na khut kuansak ding,
Nang hon naihsem ing.
Toupa, nang naihsem hong ing,
Pathian hinna vak;
Nopna muanna keia hi,
Nuamsa Tapa ziak.
Na itna’n hon tengsak in,
Na kiang nai’h hon omsak in;
“Kumtawn Suangpi” ah buin,
Nang hon naihsem ing.

Khovel pahnate hiip a omom
Nawn lou di’n ka thupukta;
Tunglam thil asangzaw leh hoihzawte,
Ka lunggulh zawta hi.
Amah kiang juan meng ning,
Kipak in juan meng ning;
Jesu, Vanglian, Sangpen,
Na kiang hon juan ning.
Khelhna buaina nawsia’n,
Hondampa kiang juan di’n ka thupukta;
Amah kia dik, Vaihawmsiampa ahi,
Aman hinna thu nei.
Nisim dik leh muanhuai a,
Hondampa jui di’n ka thupukta;
A thugen ngaihsak’ A deihlam sem in,
Hinna lampi ahi.
Khelhna lampi taisan in
A Lalgam lut di’n ka thupukta;
Lawmte’n hon dal in, melma’n hon sual zong,
Ka lut teitei ding hi.
Ka thupukta, kua hiam kei hon jui ding?
Lawmte, hong mengmeng un,
Laisiangthou sinsak in leh kha pii in,
Van lampi i jui ding.

Van ah lungkham omlou khitui luanglou,

Khitui luanglou, kahna omlou,

Khitui luanglou, kahna omlou,

I Hondampa toh om gigeta ding,
Dahna’n hon hihbuai nawnlou ding.
Huai jing ni suah chian, lungngaihna tawp ding,
Hiai damsung thil muhtheihte zong;
Kichiansem in tatsate manpha ding,
Van ah thil bangkim thakta ding.

Tua nop la dal di’n kikhenna om nawnlou,
Pathian in khitui nul ding.

Tatsa ka hihnung in.

Ni sang in leng vakphazaw teh,

Na let leh phatla a sakte,

Ka tangtawn hinna di’n Nong si,

Hiai nuailei paisan khit chiang a,

Pathian in a phuansa hon chialna ginglel ken,

Si ngeinawnlou ding na hih kitheichianta in,

Ka khelhna teng Aman lamang hi,
Amin siang phat ning (2)
Ka khelhna teng Aman lamang hi,
Halleluijah, Amin in!
Ka khelhna teng toh Toupa juan ning,

Aman ka thum za in hon honkhia,
Hiai ka la hi ding hi.
Ka hat tawpna in Amah phat ning,
Sihna tung a vualzou hi;
Tangtawn in Amah phat tawntung ning,
Hiai ka la hi ding hi.
Azong khempeuh ading in mun om,
A ut peuhmah in juan un;
Kipahna kim Toupa kianga om,
Nuamna zaila sa in.

Ka Toupa mu kei mahleng leng,

A deihlam na ka sep lai in,
Toupa pak in A aw ka za.
A aw ka za Hondampa aw,
Ka lungsim ah nopna honpia,
Hon ompih gige tawplou in.
Toupa pak in A aw ka za.
A mel mu ngeikei mahle hang,
Huihpi, vuahpi laiah theihang;
Tuipi kihawt lai zong khawlsak,
Bangkim tung ah Lal hi muang in.
Thudik, thupha ka kiang hon gen,
Muhphaklouh gam nunnuam honhilh;
Muanna itna thupha hon hilh,
Honhilh inn nuam vantung sang a.

Mihing bang a tel hiam, Thianmang?
Na Ta thangvan nusia Non sawl;
Na itna thuk, Na itna sang, Thianmang,
Mihing pilna lung in gel maw’ng.
Gel maw’ng e, gel maw’ng e, gel maw’ng,
Mihing leh Na itna simthu;
Mihing pilna lung in gel maw’ng, Thianmang,
Laukha’n lailung ah hon gel hen!
Mihing bang a tel hiam, Toupa?
Van mangtutphah nusia Nong tat;
Na lainatna lian in za e, Toupa,
Simlei singta lung in gel moh!
Mihing bang a tel hiam, Thianmang?
Kum sang zatam Na lunggimna;
A gawl han, a lei khemna hilou hiam?
Naubang Na dopna kansang sa’ng!
Mihing bang a tel hiam, Thianmang?
Van gouluah dia ngaihkhua Na tuah;
Itna sang hi, gupna sang hi, Thianmang,
Mihing simthu, zaila’n lel moh!

Jesu lailung sung ah thuk semsem a pai in ka zong,
Zong ning banghang a tua bang zah a kei hon it hiam?
Banghang a kei buannawi pan hondom kang dia kun hiam?
Ka kha hunkhia kei hon damsak,
Vak mangthang khin himah leng.
Jesu deihdan lam ah thuk semsem a pai in ka zong,
Hehpihna’n zuih ding ngen in A lampite zong ning;
Kipumpiak in kun ning A vualjawlna khebul ah,
Mek a honbawl dingin ngen ning,
A deih bang ka tun mateng.
Jesu singlamteh ah thuk semsem a pai in ka zong,
Huan sung pha a jui jel in tuak ing melma lauhuai;
Dawn ing lungkhamna nou lungtang tamkham a kap in,
Tanpa it aw, kei hon huh in,
Ka bah hehpihna’n nem in.
Jesu kipahna ah thuk semsem a pai in ka zong,
Kha nopna sang tang in hiai nuai simlei tung pek ah;
Lungkham sik a kipahna natna pan tawldamna,
Jesu’n pe ding Jesu’n pe ding,
Honlen in honkem den ding.

Khakiakna chiaugal ah vangkho nunnuam aom,
Mizata’n lambang a etchimlouh;
Tung sunni lenkil kelou khimkhua jing ngeilou,
Thianmang vangkhua lunlai Thangvan ah.
Sunni tum nawn louhna,
Muikhua khimbang jing lou;
Mohnei loute’n limbelh Toupa lambang pak uh,
Thianmang vangkhua lunlai Thangvan ah.
Tua mun a kumpi vanglian pen leh Hontanpa,
Amah ging teng a siang tutkhawl dia;
Tung si-alte bang a tang kumkhuata ding uh,
Thianmang vangkhua lunlaiThangvan ah.
Zatam laukha singlamteh phung a tuangtun in,
Tung Pathian siang sial zinbang hawl le’ng;
I khuklu pak silbang a jemna ding ahi,
Thianmang vangkhua lunlai thangvan ah.
Thianmang vontawi phamsate thelbang i thohchian,
Jerusalem vangkho thak nuam ah;
Nunnuam in Toupa lambang pak kumkhuata ni,
Thianmang vangkhua lunlai Thangvan ah.

Aw Kris ka kha’n Nangmah muta,
Nang kia ah a muta;
Muanna leh kipahna ka zon,
Nopsakna tua thei phet.
Tu’n Kris lou lungkimna dang bei,
Kei di’n min dang omlou;
Itna, hinna, pahna tawplou,
Toupa Jesu, Nang ah.
Khawlna leh kipahna ka ngai,
Nang ngailou’ amau ngai;
Ka Hondampa ka pelh laiin,
A itna in honman.
Toupa, a bel gawpsa ka zong,
Maizen, tui lah omlou;
Dawn dinga ka kunsuka leh,
Khem in ka om maimah.
Vualnop paisa ngaiin ka kap,
Nang dia lah kap ngeilou;
Na hoihna na hehpihna in,
A hon muhsak mateng.

Kanaan juan i pai, puanlap khaia lasa’n,

Hizong galdoulai kikhen i om louhna’ng,

I lak ua kua hiam vaihawmna nuai a om,

Lungtang kisathei niamkhiak in honla in,
Toupa’n hon ngak lai’n Amah lam juan meng in.
Dahna, natna leh bawlsiatna khawksa ken,
Thum a i khawisatna la hong suak pah ding;
I zuih muanhuai ei honpi Pa kros puain,
Vualzou, i kikou ding “Toupa lam’ pang hang.”

Chih a i om theihna’n.

A hon itna lamdang pa in;

Tate chih a i omna’n.

Zaitha nopna honpia’n,
Na min siangthou thang hen;
Na hatna in hon panpih in,
Ka kiang uah hong ompi’n.
Zaitha nopna honpia’n,
Kou masawn zoukei ung;
Na thau namtui in hon nilh in,
Ka kiang uah hong ompi’n.
Zaitha nopna honpia’n,
Ka lungsim sung mial uah;
Khua vaksak in hong vak inla,
Na min hong thang jel hen.

Khovel gal lai’h Toupa di’n dingkip in,
Huihhat hong mau in tui kihawt sang zong;
Suangpi kia hi hinna leh hatna pia,
Khelhna sepaih hongnai chian.
Tua Suangpi ah ding ni,
Aw, kiptakin ding ni;
Kris Suangpi kip tung kia ah;
Douna dou teitei le’ng bittak’ i ding diing,
Mangtutphah um misiangte toh.
Tupna siang toh adik gum’ dingkip in,
Lungtang dik, hangsan ginna’n hat gige’n;
Hiai khovel diklouhna tampi tung ah,
Suangpi kia hi zohna pia.
Thudik gum, ding kip in, nang di’n hoihpen,
Ngaksawt ngai zong atawp a vualzou ding;
Suangpi kia hi muanna leh khawlna pia,
Damsung huihpi a then chian.

Zatam laukha jinmang kaihsa,
Salbang suah di’n Thianmang vontawi;
Nuaisimlei ah hong tualkum in,
Ngaihtam sial in kha a hongpham.
A min ngaihloh bang theikei veng,
Salbang honsuah Toupa Jesu;
A hon itna piandang lel maw’ng,
Khakiakna pan gitbang hon hong.
Kulsin pan thelbang thou piandang,
Vanmang vontawi Tang ngalliam in;
Dougal nuaisiah lim in dang e,
Simlei, Thangvan a vualtungtuang!
Hong tualkum ding Toupa Jesu,
A duang lawmnou mel i mu dia;
Zata’ laukha jing vaihawm in,
Thangvan gam nuam tuang hontun ding.

I long inn lam juan in paisak un,
Tuitung’ lametna puan zak un;
Hon na ngak lawmte teng ngaihtuah un,
Long khawl chiang a ei zong tua’ khawl ding.
Khitui beichia nivak a kikhawm ding,
Sepgim zoh chia khawlna a kikhawm ding;
Tatsa mi tampite pah la sak i za ding,
Hamphat lawhte innpi a kikhawm ding.
I long inn lam juan in paisak un,
Laulou in i pai jel ding uh;
Longkhawlna muanna mun i naih chiang’n,
Longkhawlna meivakte i thei ding.
Tenna ding Gam a tang hoih leh vak,
Tua gam in pak hoih puan in nei;
Hon it Amah, ei hon Tanpa kiang,
Phatna la kipak in i sa ding.
Tua Gam pan’ huihkhi leng damtuam hi,
Tua luigal jing khovak hoih tuam;
Tua ah dahna, natna, sihna bei,
Tua ah it leh ngaih mu nawnta ding.

Sunchin Jesu ka lungsim in ka hon it semsem a,
Amah zaw jingsol aksi sang a tang kilawmzaw hi;
Amah tuh kei dingin nunnuam, ka muannapen ahi,
Sunchin tuma sangin  a hongkilawm semsem jel hi.
A heidan gen thei kei hang,
Tua chiaugal khopi nuam;
A gam nunnuam dohtam ah,
A kilawm semsem ding hi.
Gamlapi apan ka muh in A vanglian in hontan,
Lili pallun leh jingsol aksi sang’ tang kilawmzaw;
Ka deihnate a hihdim in a hihnuam semsem hi,
Sunchin tuma sangin a hongkilawm semsem jel hi.
Ka lungsim a hongbah chiangin Aman hon panpih a,
Ka dah mahmah laiin Aman A anglai ah hon sial;
Kris ka mohna tengteng popa Amah ka it ahi,
Sunchin tuma sangin a hongkilawm semsem jel hi.

Ka khelh sawpsiang ding, ka nit sawpsiang ding,
Kalvari kros ah, Jesu kilh in om;
Angelte’n ensuk, lamdangsa uh hi,
Mikhial keia ding, A kipumpiakna.
Aw, itna lamdang, Aw tatna manpha!
Ka khelh beisak ding, a man piak thupi;
Hiai thuhoih gen un, hotdamna manbei,
Mikhial keia ding, A kipumpiakna!
Ka khelhna tengteng, Jesu’n a pua hi,
Ka tatna man kim, athawn in pia hi;
Ka khelhna teng pua, Kalvari sing ah,
Mikhial keia ding, itna lamdang hi.
Linglukhu khusak’ Amah paipih uh,
Tua ni mulkimhuai, luguhmun tun uh;
Khua a hongmial zong, miteng in mu uh,
Mikhial keia ding, A kipumpiakna.
A luang sial uh hi, Josepha han ah,
Tua kilh lup Toupa hondam dia hat hi;
A hinna pia hi, kei ka hin theihna’n,
Mikhial keia ding, itna lamdang hi.

Toupa tung i kipak ding hiam?
A hauhsakna sut in,
A thu ah ginna’n hon theisak,
Hauhna kiamtheilou hi.
Ngaihdamna, muanna, hatna,
Sianthouna leh Paradis om;
Hiai teng Kris vang in keia hi,
Amah phatna’n kipahna la sa ni.
Pathian hehpihna’n khelhna teng,
Ngaihdamna mabei pia;
Tua ngaihdamna’h muanna ka nei,
Jesu sisan vangin.
Khelhna phel na’ng in hehpihna,
Lungsung ah Khasiangthou;
A kiching in A hon guan hi,
Khelhna pan sianthouna.
Midang Pathian a dia zohna,
Kha Siangthou’n hon guan hi;
I Toupa Kris in a hon piak.
I lungsim ah teng hi.
Vualjawlna teng ginna’n i mu,
Naupang bang muanna ah;
Pathian in hon piak nop lam hi,
Kris a Ahon chiamsa.

Mimbang thum a, khukdin a kun;
A dawngkot hong Zion nga’n galkhua dak,
A Pathian khang sumbang bia.
Jerusalem lam nga’n dawngkot na hong hiam?
Melmak tengkhawi sim sal in i tang zong leh;
Salbang honsuah ding i Toupa hong kuan ding,
Sekdou haibang a na ngak ni.
Kammei laiah hon pai zong, lunglau ken,
Sa limlian kiang honpiak ziak un;
Tung Pathian in gitbang hon hong dingin,
Angelte honsawl ding hi.
Pathian vontawite aw, lunglau kei un,
Salbang a honsuahna simthu;
Nunnop zaila’n i sa ding Zion ah,
Toupa hongpai kik chiangin.

Vualjawlna vuah hongzu ding hi,
Hiai itna thuchiam ahi;
Halh hun leng hong om nawn ding hi,
Hondampa a kipan in.
Vualjawlna vuahtui,
Vualjawlna vuahtui i ngai;
I kim a itna tuimaltak,
Azukin honzu sak in.
Vualjawlna vuah hong zu ding hi,
Hihhalhna manpha ahi;
Janggam leh mualtunga kipan,
Vuah tampi thawmging i za.
Vualjawlna vuah hong zu ding hi,
Toupa kou tung’h zusak in;
Tu’n ah halhna honpia inla,
Na thu tu’n tangtung sak in.
Vualjawlna vuah hong zu ding hi,
Tuni’n zupah mai leh aw;
Pathian kianga tua kiphuang a,
Jesu min i loh lai in.
Vualjawlna vuah hong zu ding hi,
Ginna a thu i man leh;
Halh hun leng hong om nawn ding hi,
Amah’ deihdan hisak le’ng.

Toupa Jesu hatna muang lechin,
A hon panpih ding, hon panpih ding;
A hon itna pellou hi ging in,
La hon sakpih ding hi.
A hatna leh A itna muang in,
A hatna leh A itna kilang;
A hatna leh van inn sang en in,
Hondampa hoih na mu ding.
Toupa Jesu hatna muang lechin,
Lampi a vak ding A vak sak ding;
Kipak in honpi na ah jui in,
A aw nem mang jel in.
Toupa Jesu hatna muang inla,
Na buaina pia in, Amah pia in;
Na puak gik in haksa mahleh leng,
Toupa kiang’ thum jel in.
Toupa Jesu hatna muang inla,
Na bangkim pia in, bangkim pia in;
Hehpih leh itna in A dim hi,
Hon ensim lou ding hi.
Toupa Jesu hatna muang inla,
Na taksap lungjin honhu ding hi;
Hondampa dia Amah pom teng di’n,
Lawm dik leh muanhuai hi.

Ngaiin, Jesu kikou aw ging,
Tunia kua sem dia kuan ding;
Buhmin lua a la ding ngak hi,
Kuain buhphal paw ding hiam?
Toupa’n ngaihtakin honsam hi,
Kipahman tampi honchiam;
Kipaka hichia dawng ding kua?
“Hia’h om ing, kei honsawl in.”(2)
Tuilian galna kai thei lou zong,
Awilou gam na pha kei zong;
Amau naisem ah na mu thei,
Kongbul ah leng na hilh thei.
Sangtampi nei kei mahle chin,
Meithai piak bangin pia in;
Toupa dia na hihzoh sunsun,
A muh a thupi lua hi.(2)
Angel bang na pau thei kei zong,
Paul bang na gen thei kei zong;
Jesu itna na hilh theia,
Miteng dia si na gen thei.
Vaihawmna lauhuaitakin leng,
Mikhial na lausak lah zong;
Hondampa hehpihna ang ah,
Naupangte na pi thei hi.(2)
Zion tangsang tunga ding a,
Van gam lampi kawkmuh a;
Miteng dia hinna pia bangin,
Om theikei mahle chin leng.
Na thumsakna leh thilpiakin,
Vantung deihlam na bawl thei;
Jawlnei ban domkang Aron bang,
Nasep theihkhomkhom sem in.(2)
Upa lak’ na phatuam kei zong,
Kris i Belamchingpa’n chi;
Ka belamnoute vak inla,
A bat ding un an koih in.
Khut ling kawmkawma a kianga,
Naupang neuneu na pi te;
Gam hoihzaw mun na tun chiangin,
Na suangmantam honghi ding.(2)
Ka hih theih bangmah a om kei,
Kuamah zak in chi het ken;
Mihing laukha mangthang lellel,
Toupa’n na sem di’n honsam.
Kipaktakin A na sem in,
A nasep kipahna ding;
A honsapna kintak’ dawng in,
“Hia’h  om  ing, honsawl in,” chi’n. 2)

Jesu lailung a ka it aw,
Na hehpihna mahmah kon ngen;
Aw, Na deih bangin honpia in,
Nang it semna a ka zat di’n.
Minthang khopi Suangmantam khua,
Mite’n lunggulh in ngai mahleh,
Ka kha’n a muh nop dang omlou,
Na omna peuh kei di’n van hi.
Lei a itna vak hoihpen leng,
Nanga loungal chimtakhuai hi;
Ngai in tunglam kon entou hi,
Na mel chikleh ka mu diam chi’ng?
Van ah kipahna tam mahleh,
Pak hoih muhnophuai tam mahleh;
Sana kongkhak, Angel aw’n zong,
Nang it kana pahna pelou.
Nangmah ngallou van vak omlou,
Ka kha taisak a vaksak ding;
Nang ah lei lungkhamhuai vak suak,
Van a kipahna vak hoih in.

Kris sisan pha tuibang hongluang,
Ka mohna sianna hi;
Lunglauna leh ginlouhna pan,
Ka laukha tutkhawlta.
Aw piandang sisan pha hongluang,
Hon gum Toupa nak pan!
Thangvan dong a ka zaila ding,
Aw sisan, sisan pha!
“A khelhna leh lungmawlna uh,
Lailung’n ngilhta ning e;
Ka Ta neihsun amau di’n si,
Tung Pathian in A chi.
Ka ginna leh ka meltheihna,
Mohna’n bawl mang lou ding;
A sisan pha hongluang kei di’n.
Ka khelhna sawp siang hi.
Ka simlei mi hinna pumpi’n,
Omlaivei thuak zongleh;
Tua sisan pha a tutkhawl in,
Lailung muang kumkhua ning.

Aw, Nang omna peuh ka kha in nuamsa hi,
Gim ka thuak laiin Nang kon sam;
Sunchin ka kinepna zan khosawt ka la,
Ka lam et, ka damna, ka bangkim.
Hon Chingpa it aw, koilai ah na om hiam,
Na belamte itna a pin?
Bangdingin sihna luikuam ah ka kap dia,
Hiai khovel gamdai a vakvai in.
Bangdi’n Na kiang apan ka taimang ding hiam,
Gamdai a gilkial a kap in?
Na melma in ka lungkham muin nuam ding,
Ka khitui muin nuihmai ding hi.
Hondampa it, Na mel hon musak gige’n,
Na khamuanna honpia inla;
Na itna ngaihdamna kitheihna nuam in,
Ka kha lungkham, thawmhau muangsak in.
Angel sang sawmte Na mel mu in nuam uh,
Sang sawm tampi’n Na paukam ngak;
Na paukam tangtawn in manglou in ging hi,
Tangtawn in Toupa Nangmah hon phat.

Pathian chitna lamdang penpen la in sani,
A hon khotuah leh ven gigena;
I kipumpiakna gimlim bangin zamtou hen,
Thum a A ma a i kikhop in.
Amah phat in bia ni,
A silbawlte vangin,
A hoihna leh khotuahna gen ni;
I kipumpiakna gimlim bangin zamtou hen,
Thum a A ma a i kikhop in.
A hehpihna thilpiak lamdang la in sani,
Nun a nem in i kiang hon musak;
Jesu, A Tapa toh i kikholhna nuam ah,
Tuain A mangtutphah hon naihsak.
A vualjawlna in hon jui jel dingin thum ni,
I lampi a hon vaksakna di’n;
I kha Amah a hong buchin theihna dingin,
A van lalgam i luahtheihna di’n.

Amau va at dingin kuan in;
Toupa’n hon panpih ding,
Nang hatna’h kinga ken,
Toupa hatna ah kingazaw in.
Na chi tuh a pou dia,
Toupa’n hon panpih ding;
Na tangtawn mun na tun theihna di’n,
Na hat laiin sem in,
Toupa hatna muang in.
Na seplouh ziakin tampi mangthang gawpta uh,
Toupa itte mangmang mawk hi;
Amau panpih di’n na kuan ding hiam?
Panpih ngai mahmah uh,
A manthat vek ma un.
Kuan in, kuan in, vasem in,
A ni uh tum man ding;
Laukha sim vuallouh mangthang dingte,
Na it kei hial a hiam?
Khat beek hon pikhia in.
Dakkhia in, envel dih, tatna thei nailoute,
Toupa’n A tatlam thei kei uh;
Lungmuang in tulai uh,
Pikhe dingin kuamah dang omlou,
Hondampa theilou uh.
A mau vapi dingin,
Toupa’n nang hon deih hi;
Chikchiang Jesu ma a kun ding ua,
Hondampa chih thei in;
A lalna min phat in.

Na chitna Tangthupha’n,
Ka lungtang khauh nuaisiah;
Leitung hon it man in,
A Ta khat neihsun pia.
“Kuapeuhmah in A thu ging leh,
Tangtawn hinna pha mu ding hi”
Tangtawn hinna pha mu ding hi.
Gul lim khaikang et a,
Hinna damna om leh;
Jesu kros tung a khai,
Et hinna a hizaw.
“Kha khial a si ding” chih,
Ka tuah ding mulkimhuai;
Na chitna thulou in,
Mangthang tawntung ding hi’ng.
Leitung mohpaih dingin,
Jesu hongpai lou hi;
A min a Hotdamna,
Mite’n a muhna di’n.
Ka ginlahna Toupa,
Ginna muana hon pia’n;
Na Tangthupha gen bang’n,
Nang muang a khawl dingin.

Tung thangvan-gamnuam ah tatsate’n la sa,
A Kumpi uh ma ah manglukhu koih in;
Leitung lungkham, dahna, launa, mohna  bei,
Mi siangthoute’n kipahna la thak sa uh.
Be... lamnou phat in,
Kalvari a ei dia hong si;
Be...lamnou phat in,
Tangtawn dong a hing gige Pa.
A hehpihna la lamdangpen a hong kim,
Amah muang a gingte di’n gimnamtui hi;
Toupa eia dinga si a thounawnta,
Pathian kiangah tangtawn in vai i hawm  ding.
Belamnou sisan a kisawpsiang loungal,
Tua la thak hoih kuama’n sa theilou ding hi;
Mohna khelhna apan Toupa’n hon sawp hen,
Tuin nop la thupitak in lem nihang.

Min khat ka zak nop a om hi,
Min ngaih la in sa ning;
Ka zak in a ging kilawm hi,
Vannuai a min ngaihpen.
Aw, Jesu ka it tel!
Aw, Jesu ka it tel!
Aw, Jesu ka it tel!
A hon it masak ziak’n.
Hondampa itna hon hilh hi,
Kei hon hunkhe dia si;
A sisan manpha thu honhilh,
Mikhial ken ka suanpen.
Ka Pa thil neihte hon hilh hi,
Niteng kei dia A koih;
Lampi mial tawn in ka pai zong,
Lamtawn’n nivak honpia.
Lungkham thukpen hon Theihpihpa,
Itna lungsim honhilh;
Ka dahna teng honthuakpih a,
Midang hon nem omlou.

Ka bat teng hon sutsak;
A lu siangthou a hong kunta,
Hinna ka neih theih na’n.
Belamnou tongdamnem in,
Kalvari ah hong thuak;
Belamnou thahsa A hong thounawnta,
Ka Hondampa ahi.
Ka moh vang in Hon-gum Toupa,
Kros tung ah hong si hi;
Hehpihna leh mi it theihna,
Hon pia, tangtawn hinna.
Tung a Ni in mel lakngamlou,
Meipi puan in a silh;
Hondampa’n ka khelhna pua a,
Tua a A sih lai in.
Ken leng tu’n ka lu kunsak ning,
Ka Toupa’ kros bul ah;
A thuaknat dan ka ngaihtuah in,
A mel kia ka en hi.
Ka lungkhamna khitui luang zong,
Kei sang’n Toupa’n thuak zaw;
Ka pumpi in ka kipe ding,
Ka hihtheih dan ahi.

Hondampa paina khap sul a zuih tum in,
I Hondampa leh Kumpipa jui in;
Damsung Amah omdan bangdia kisek in,
Nuam leh kipak in pahna la i sa.
Hondampa paina khap,
Sul zuih nuam hina mai e!
Avak a pai in, a vak a pai in,
Hondampa paina khap;
Sul zuih nuam hina mai e!
Lam vak tawn a pai.
Lampi a pial dia khem a i om chaingin,
Hon huaipa Amah kiang naih a bel in;
Ei hon humbit ding Aban thahat muang in,
Nuam leh kipak in nitengin phatni.
Thuakhat leh nunnem a A sulnung jui in,
Gin-omna khap, hehpihna leh itna;
A hehpihna manbei hon chiamna ngak in,
Nuam leh kipak in, vanlam juan i pai.
Hondampa paina khap sul a zuih tum in,
Honpipa tunglam sangsem ah juiin;
A hoihna a kijem Kumpi i muh chian,
Nuam leh kipak in, a kiang tutkhawlni.

Aw lunggimte, inn khat om hi,
Sepgim leh buaina gam khen ah;
Omdan kikhen nawnlouhna inn,
Huaia khawl utlou kua om diam?
Aw chingkam in ngakin, phunlou in,
Aw chingkam in ngakin, phunlou in,
Aw chingkam in,
Aw ngakin, phunlou in.
Hizong leia puakgik puak chian,
Leia i tan van in hon piak;
Tunglam vualjawlna entou in,
Chingkam in ngakin phunlou in.
Sem in, haksa mahleh thuak in,
Mauna zaklouh, thumna mangngilh;
Nang di’n khawlna ni hong suak ding,
Chingkam in ngakin phunlou in.

Na damsung vualjawlna nak hi hiam,
Pathian itna na sung ah luang hiam?
Hondampa thu mangthangte na hilh hiam,
A na sem dingin na kiman hiam?
Vualjawlna nak kei ah bawl in tuni’n,
Vualjawlna nak kei ah bawl in, kon ngen;
Ka damsung hausak’n ka na sep vualjawl’n,
Vualjawlna nak kei ah bawl in, tuni’n.
Na damsung vualjawlna nak hi hiam,
Mangthangte dingin na lunggim hiam?
Pialmangte pikik di’n na thuhilh hiam?
Kros a si i Hondampa thu.
Na damsung vualjawlna nak hi hiam,
Niteng in amah thu na gen hiam?
Khelhna a si ding mihingte kiang ah,
Hotdamna thu na genta hiam?
I hinkhua khelhna pan i sian keh,
Vualjawlna tuinak i hithei kei;
Mi mangthangte pikik i tupte dingin,
Daltu leh nangtu i hi ding.

Hiai tangbang damlai buaihuai ah,
Thumthum, dah in puakgik mahleh;
Malam ah khawlna munnuam om,
Chiau tuipi etlawmnou gal ah.
Tua chiau tuipi etlawm gal ah,
Hondampa’n kipak in hon ngak;
Amah kiang a teng gige di’n,
Leitung buaina thuak nawnlou in.
Khemna huihpi hong nung mahleh,
Lauhuaite’n hon hihbuai mahleh;
Nunglam ah nusia ning buaina,
Chiau tuipi kilawm galkai in.
Ka zinna ka khit zoh chiangin,
Khawlna munnuam chiam tungta ning;
Kris kiang a teng tawntung dingin,
Chiau tuipi kilawm galkai chian.

Na it teng kros ah kilhden ahi hiam,
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?
Jesu di’n thil teng manna’n na sim hiam,
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?
A sisan a bual in,
Kisawp siangthouta, kingainiamta in,
Pathian mit na tung hiam?
Nangmah leh khelhna tung’ thu na nei hiam,
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?
Sung leh pua a sual chiteng tung ah zong,
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?
Khelhna a mohpaih nawnlouh na hi hiam,
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?
Jesu’n na sapum ah vai a hawm hiam,
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?
Na hihtheihna teng Jesu’n a kem hiam,
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?
Mitphiatkal teng na kha ah a teng hiam,
Pathian lung na tuak hiam?

Ka Jesu, Nang kon it, Nang keia hichia,
Nang dingin khelh hoihlou tenteng tawpsan ta’ng;
Ka Tanpa itsiam, ka Hondampa Na hi,
It lai kon neih leh, ka Jesu aw tu hi.
Nang kon it hi, Nang non it masak ziakin,
Kalvari sing ah ngaidam in Non leita;
Nang kon it hi, linglukhu Na khuk ziakin,
It lai kon neih leh, ka Jesu aw tu hi.
Damsung in kon it ding, sihpha’n kon it ding,
Nakna Non piak laiteng Nang kon phat ding hi;
Ka sihni tanpha in hiai ka chichi ding,
It lai kon neih leh, ka Jesu aw tu hi.
Thupina leh kipah tawplouhna inn ah,
Vanmun vakna ah ka hon pak tawntung ding;
Manglukhu teselsel khu in la sa ning,
It lai kon neih leh, ka Jesu aw tu hi.

Hong un Pathian phat khawm ni hang, Itna hi,
Lei leh van in Amah phat hen, Itna hi;
Khelhna a pan kha teng thou hen,
Lungsim a ging kilawm bawl in,
Jesu di’n phatna la sa ni,
Itna Pathian.
Itna hi, itna hi,
Hong un Pathian phat khawm ni hang,
Itna Pathian.
Leitawp gamlapen pha’n hilh un, Itna hi,
Kris ah i tatkhiakna i mu, Itna hi;

Kidouna ah vualzou in hong,
Khuk teng Amah’ kiang’ kun ding!
Khusak un, Angelte’n, khusak’,
Kumpite Lal, Hondampa;
Khusak un, Angelte’n, khusak’,
Kumpite Lal, Hondampa.
Khialte’n nuihza bawlna’n khusak,
Hondampa gen nuihsan uh;
Mi siangthou leh Angel kikhawm,
Amah’ min pua in phat uh.
Ngai un, tua phatna aw ging ngaih,
Ngaiun, vualzohna la ngaih;
Jesu’n mun sangpen A luahta,
Aw, huai muh nuam hi nah e!

Khovel tangin, Jesu hon pia’n.
A nopnate bangmahlou;
Jesu itna om tawntung hi,
Tangtawn dongin angeingei.
Aw zahngaihna thuk in sang e,
Aw itna lian in za e!
Aw tatna buching na lawmlawm,
Tunglam hin tawplou chiamna.
Khovel tangin, Jesu hon pia’n.
Ka kha dia nopna penpen;
Ka Hondampa’n hon ching jel a,
Tui kihawt lai zong la sa’ng.
Khovel tangin, Jesu hon pia’n,
A nuihmai gige en ning;
Huan ka zinna lam tawntung ah,
Vak in hon kipaksak ding.
Khovel tangin, Jesu hon pia’n.
A kros ah ka muanna om;
Chiang sem leh vak sema, Toupa
Kimaituah a ka muh ma’n.

Na chialna aw ka za,
Toupa na kiang’h hon sam;
Na sisan manpha a siang di’n,
Kalvari a luang in.
Toupa hongpai ing,
Na kiang kon juan hi;
Sisan in hon sawpsiang in,
Kalvari a luang in.
Khial, hatlou in kon juan,
Ka hatna ding non chiam;
Ka mohna teng Nang non siangsak,
Siang leh nin banglou di’n.
Hiai leitung leh van ah,
Kinepna leh muanna;
Ginna leh itna kim tang di’n,
Jesu’n kei a honsam.
Aman theihchianna pia,
Lungsim niam, dikte kiang’h,
A thuchiam teng tangtung sakta,
Za a hihte kiangah.

Kua hiam kongkhak a dinga,
Kuhkal taka hon naih;
Innsunga lut hon ngen a,
A aw ka zak kua hiam?
Aw nem ngiingei in hon chi,
Kei di’n kong hon honve;
Kon sapna na limsak leh,
Nang toh tengkhawm ding hi’ng.
Amah kia innpua ah ding,
Innsung a kei kia om;
Ka kizekaisak kal in,
Hon pel manlou ding hiam?
Zan khotawn mial leh dai ah,
Hon kiu nawn Amah hi;
Jesu non chimtak kei maw,
Tua bang hun sawt non ngak?
Ka lungsim kongkhak hong di’n,
Kintakin ka hongta;
Hon taihilh in honsawi zong,
Ka kiangah teng ding hi.

Ka khelh bangin sawpsiang thei?
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan,
Bangin hon damkik sak thei?
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan.
Aw, sisan manpha luang,
Vuk bangin hon siangsak;
Tui dang sianna omlou.
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan.
Ngaihdamna ka muh theihna,
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan;
Sianna ka nget theihna sun,
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan.
Bangmahin moh tan theilou,
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan;
Ka thilhih hoih vang hilou,
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan.
Ka lamet muanna hiai hi,
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan:
Ka diktatna hiai teng hi,
Bangdang hilou Jesu sisan.

Hon pi’n Aw vanglian, Jehovah,
Hiai gamdai a ka zin sung;
Kei hatlou, Nangzaw na hat hi,
Na khut thahat in hon pi’n.
Van Tanghou aw,
Ka vah mateng honvak in.
Van Tanghou aw,
Ka vah mateng honvak in.
Tuinak siangthou tu’n hong inla,
Damna tui a luankhiakna;
Meikuang pha leh meipi khuam in,
Ka zin sungteng honpi in.
Hontanpa hat,
Ka hatna leh lum hong hi’n.
Hontanpa hat,
Ka hatna leh lum hong hi’n.
Jordan luigei kong tun chiangin,
Ka lauthawngna kiamsak in;
Tui kihawt kan in hon pi in,
Kanaan gam lam hontun in.
Phatna late,
Nang konpe tawngtung ding hi.
Phatna late,
Nang konpe tawngtung ding hi.

Lungsim pak a nuamte,
Toupa it a ngai teng;
A minthang Toupa hi,
Hong un, la sa’n pak ni;
Hilh un, hilh un, milian, mineu,
Hilh un, hilh un, milian, mineu,
A hehpihna ei di’n lian hi.
A Lallukhu nusia’n,
A Lalpuan thupi toh;
Hehpihna kha zak in,
Hongkum, hongsi, ei di’n;
Kuan gen thei ding, A thuak gimna,
Kuan gen thei ding, A thuak gimna,
Gawtmun sihna pan hontankhia.
Misite omna mun,
Hankhuk mial pan thounawn;
Hatna thupi tang in,
A melma teng nuaisiah,
Vualzou vantung sang ah paitou,
Vualzou vantung sang ah paitou,
Hondampa Pathian in vaihawm.
Thangvan sang pan hong ding,
Kiknawn dingin hong ding;
I khate pi dingin,
Hintawp lou gamnuam ah;
Muta ni hang, A mel kilawm,
Muta ni hang, A mel kilawm,
A angsung nuam ah hon pom ding.

Ni thupi hongtung ding, ni thupi tung ding,
Ni thupi hong tung ding, dengchiangin;
Misiangthou leh mikhialte ziat leh veia kikhen ding,
Tua ni adingin na kiman hiam?
Na kiman hiam, na kiman hiam?
Thukhen ni adi’n na kiman hiam?
Na kiman hiam, na kiman hiam?
Thukhen ni adi’n.
Ni vakpha hongtung ding, ni vakpha tung ding,
Ni vakpha hong tung ding, dengchiangin;
Hizong Toupa itte kia tungah tua vak tung ding hi,
Tua ni adingin na kiman hiam?
Dahna ni hongtung ding, dahni hongtung ding,
Dahna ni hongtung ding, denchiang in;
Mikhialte’n ‘Paimang un, kon theikei’ chih a za ding ua,
Tua ni adingin na ki man hiam?

Jordan chiau gei a i kikhop hun chian,
Hotdamte vanglian in mel mu ni;
Chiaului gei a piaunel sim zohlouh bang,
Et chimlouh piandang mel i mu ding!
Chiaului gei a piaunel sim zohlouh bang,
Chiaului gei a piaunel sim zohlouh bang!
Etnophuai hi ding,
Hotdamte i muh hun chian;
Chiaului gei a piaunel sim zohlouh bangin.
Leitung mimbang pianchil pan hotdamte’n,
Lungkham leh mangbatna zouta uh;
Tungchiang ah dawn bang kituak nawn ni hang,
Et chimlouh piandang mel i mu ding!
Tua chiaului gei a i din hun chiangin,
Guabang hinna tullim’h tutkhawl ni;
Kanaan gam etlawm lam gal in don ni,
Et chimlouh piandang mel i mu ding!
Hon Hondampa pen leh a vangletna,
Chiantak a mel i muh hun chiangin;
Toupa’n vannuai zousiah simthu lel ding,
Mizata’n piandang hi, i chi ding!

Mohnei, hongpai in, zahngaihna om,
Jesu khebul ah,
Hong in kisik in na bangkim nga’n;
Jesu khebul ah.
Nga in, nga in, aw nga in,
Na puakgik tengteng nga in;
Nga in, nga in, aw nga in,
Jesu khebul ah.
Ging in, hongpai in, khawl na zong in,
Jesu khebul ah!
Na lunggimna van gikte nga in,
Jesu khebul ah.
Hongin, na ginna’n hondamsak ding,
Jesu khebul ah!
Hongin, na kha tawl leh gim nga in,
Jesu khebul ah.
Hongin, nang di’n mun om kipak in,
Jesu khebul ah!
Na mohna gik bangteng zong nga in,
Jesu khebul ah.

Na khelhna toh lui hon juan in,
Na dah lung kham puak gik toh;
A tuiah thukpi’n phummang in,
Tua’h tawldamna na mu ding.
Kinmeng inla, bangdia khawl ding?
Zekai zek ziakin na kha mangsak ken;
Jesu’n hondam di’n hon ngak hi,
Zahngaihna’n tuni’n hon sam.
Na hihbang in lui hon juan in,
Jesu’n nang hon nangak hi;
Na khelhna sandup bang mahleh,
Vuk banga ngou in siang ding.
Hondampa thugen hiaite hi,
Kisik a Amah gingte;
Amah muangnuam mi khempeuhte,
A khut ah hinna mu ding.
Hongin lui ah kidamsak in,
Muanna thugen aw ngai in;
Mikhial khat hongkik nawn tung ah,
Angelte tu’n kipak hen.

Kristian thou un, ihmu lou,
Midang kah sung i khawl diam?
Toupa’n thu hon piak laiin,
I mawk tut maimai ding hiam?
Kuan un sem un, tu’n sem un,
Kuan un, zong un mangthangte;
Khelhna khukpi mial apan,
Kuang um di’n honpi lut in.
Hondampa min i it hiam,
A thuchiam i ging ngam diam?
I bangkim i pe vek hiam?
Honsapna manglou ding maw?
I muan ding bangin i muang hiam,
Hon hilh bangin i om hiam?
Amah’ a kia i hi hiam?
Nasep in ginna lak le’ng.
Kros i puak ding a om hi,
Manglukhu i lamet leh;
Thanuamtakin ma sawn ni,
Hun a tom ni a tawmta.

Hongin, Kumpi Vanglian, Na min phatla sa di’n;
Hon panpih in! Ka pa uh thupipen,
Bangkim tunga vualzou; Hongin, vai hong hawmin,
Tanglai Nite.
Hongin Thu, ‘mihing suak’, Na temsau hat kuah in;
Ka thum uh za’n; Na mite vualjawl in,
Na thu lohching sak in; sianthouna Kha kou tung’h
Hong kumsuk in.
Aw Toupa Pathian kiang, phatna sangpen om hen,
Om tawntung hen; Na lalna thuneihna,
Thupina ah mu n’ung; tangtawn, tangtawn dongin,
It in bia n’ung.

Aw Toupa, Na vualjawlna pha,
Ka bangkim tung uah kilang;
Na thu louin kou hinna pha,
Ka neih teng uh zong mang ding.
Lambang pak ung (2)
Na hehpihna ka muh un (2).
Na hon hehpihna banjal pan,
Hinna leh taksap chiteng;
Silpak leh guabang hing tengin,
A mu uh vualjawlnate.
Phatna zaila’n (2)
Hon awi uhi kumkhua in (2)
Aw Toupa, sil bangkim Siampa,
Na banjal siamsil tengin;
Albangdah a lumbang honsung,
Lambang hon paklah zong leng.
Hon heisan ken (2)
Na deihdan hon sinsak in (2)
Hunte, nite a bei jel a,
Simlei pallun sawlbang heu;
Ka khelhna teng uh aw Toupa,
Na siamna in a sawpsiang.
Hun muh nuam ung (2)
Na zaitha hatna muangin (2)

Kristian pawlte, gamla, nai pan,
I kikhawm hia’h Toupa vangin;
Kilam etna leh muanna toh,
Toupa Laisiangthou ngaikhia ni.
Lungsim leh kha kituak,
I kikhawm hiai laiah;
Lungtup tuibang luangkhawm,
Kipahna a dim in;
Toupa min gam chih leh,
Mun chih a genzak ding,
Tung thangvan Mangpa Thianmang in,
Hon huai chiat hen.
I kikhawm hia’h, i Toupa Kris,
Pahtawina la pha sa chiat ni;
Tangtuan hinna tawplou simthu,
U leh Nau in sutkhawm chiat ni.
I Toupa na lei a i sep,
Lungnuam in, machiang suan ni e;
I tha, i zung Amah pia ni,
Tung thangvan tuang i tun phain.

Muatthei a phum a om,
Muattheilou a thou ding;
Simmohhuai a phum a omte,
Thupi a pahtawi a thou ding. (2)
Hatlou a phum a om,
Vanglian a thoukik ding;
Sa pumpi toh phum a omte,
Laukha pumpi toh thoukik ding. (2)
Lei pumpi a tuam a,
Van pumpi a tuam hi;
Lei pumpi thupina a tuam,
Kha pumpi thupina a tuam. (2)
Toupa kikou aw toh,
Angel vanglian’ aw toh;
Pengkul in hon samkhawm dinga,
Toupa kiang ah tutkhawlta ding. (2)
Sihna om nawnlou ding,
Kahna om nawnlou ding;
Sihna gu in hon zoulou ding,
Dougal nanung nuaisiahta ding. (2)

Kris Saptuam in Kris thu jui hi,
A pauna ah kou leng pau ung;
A daihna ah kou leng dai ung,
Kris thupiak bangin ka hih un.
Heutupa di’n niteng’ sem ni,
Khialte a lampi a pi in;
A thu ginga a thupiak jui in,
Kris Saptuam, a ding tawntung ding hi.
Ging a kisik a na it leh,
Miteng ma a A min gum in;
Amah toh tui a kiphum in,
Jesu’n van ah na min behlap.
I Hondampa mou Kris Saptuam,
Hiai di’n thuak, A si luangin si;
Kuapeuh Jesu Kris gingta a,
Amah pomte di’n kihong hi.
Kris kiang ah thupina om hen,
Pial lou in Saptuam na sem in;
Aw, mihing thuhilhna jui ken,
Pathian in thilgel kim hon pia.

Hondampa hon itna ka thei,
Hehpihna lamdang ahimah ding;
Tungthangvan pan a hong kumsuk,
Hon it leh hon khasiat ahi hiam, hi hiam?
Hon it leh hon khasiat ahi hiam?
Hi, hi, hi, kei di’n, kei di’n,
Hi, hi, hi, kei di’n;
Toupa A hongsuk A hehpih tawplou in,
Kros tung ah A si hon hotdamna’n.
A thuak a A si tuibang luang,
A gimna leh sing a sih ka thei;
Koiah hiam huai simthu kigen,
Kei dia gim leh hon thuaksak hi hiam, hi hiam?
Kei dia gim leh hon thuaksak hi hiam?
Tung thangvan simthu ka theita,
Jesu mite’n a mu ding uhi;
Hizong tung thangvan ah munnuam,
Kei adia bawlkhitsiang ahi hiam, hi hiam?
Kei adia bawlkhitsiang ahi hiam ?
Toupa ka dotna hon dawng in,
Nang kiang lou kua kiang ka pai ding hiam?
Kha Siangthou in kei a honhilh,
Hondampa leh van a om kei di’n, kei di’n,
Hondampa leh van a om kei di’n.

Gentheih i thuak sawt nawnlou ding;
Thupina inn lam i juan ding,
Tua Jerusalem Thak ah.
Ei di’n Itna hehpih thawnpiak,
Itna hehpihna kim;
Itna hehpihna kim,
Tua Jerusalem Thak ah,
Aw Toupa honpi jel in,
Jordan luigal lam ah;
Toupa, honpi jel in.
Tua Jerusalem Thak ah.
Kua pai ding kipahman mu in,
Van-gam thupina tang dingin?
Tua ah pahna tullou ding hi,
Tua Jerusalem Thak ah.
Hotdamna thupi la sa in,
Ka lungsung nopna pahna’n dim;
Ka kha in a khazak in leng,
Jerusalem Thak juan in.
Mi siangthoute’n puanngou silh in,
Manglukhu toh phat la sa uh;
Amau lak a tel  sam ka ut,
Tua Jerusalem Thak ah.

Tulvuah leh lummei kaina khen ah,
Chiau i gal ah;
Tung Pathian sunni bangin atang,
Muikhua khim bang jing lou.
Dahna leh omlaivei gibang kikhenna omlou,
Chiau i gal ah dawn bang kituak ni;
Muanna Thianmang siang ah.
Galdot kaitui luang bangin Thianmang,
Tongdamnem in;
Khakiak mohna vangkhua nun a nuam,
A om chi in hon hilh.
Khakiakna chiaului kuam gal lawmvual,
Ngaihte’n khengta;
Thianmang siang ah dawnbang tuaknawn ni,
Gibang kikhen omlou.
Guabang hinna leh muanna Toupa,
Hong tualkum chiang’n;
Albang dah lelliang theite luankhi,
Buan bang a nulsiang ding.

Jesu’n hon vaksak, vak siangthoutak in,
Zan miala khawnvak hoihtaka vak bangin;
Hiai leitung mial lak ah, i vak ding,
Nang na mun ah vak in, kei ka mun ah.
Jesu’n hon vaksak, Amah’ adingin,
Hoihtak’ muin thei, i vak hoih leh hoihlou;
Van apan hon ensuk, i vak mu,
Nang na omna mun ah, kei ka mun ah.
Jesu’n hon vaksak, Amah’ dia sem in,
Khelhna lampi a vakmangte honpi in;
Hon panpih gige ding, i vak leh,
Nang na omna mun ah kei ka mun ah.

Pathian in hon itna a lamdang mahmah,
Migenthei hinglou ding a honhuai mahmah;
Damna, hinna leh lungmuanna honpia hi,
I dougal tunga vualzou di’n hon panpih.
Ka mohnate tui in hon silsiang theilou,
Huangvulh ganta sisan in hontan theilou;
Jesu sisan hoih i kithoihna ahi,
I gitlouhte nalou in a hihdam thei.
Vannuai mi Tanpa kiang’h kumsawt pahtawina,
Lei leh van a mi tengteng in pia uhen;
Hon hihdam tak ziakin kipah la sani,
Mi tengteng Tanpa ahi, pahtawi veni.
Leitung ah thu hoih tuin a hong tungta,
Leimial taanvakpa Jesu Amah i mu;
Leitung a namchih tengteng kikhawm in ah,
Nopna zaila sa’n Vanmang pahtawi veni.

Hinna kidangta kei dingin,
Hondampa ka muh nung;
Zahngaihna tam kros ah ka mu,
Migi, ithuai Hondampa.
Ka ginlah leh lau beita,
Jesu’n ka zan sun suahta;
Vangam gamla nawn hetlou,
Hondampa ka muh nung.
Itna lamdang a hon zon vang’,
Hondampa ka muta;
Hotdamna honpuak tunglam pan,
Hondampa manpha, keia.
Meipi kai in hon tuam nak zong,
Hondampa ka muh nung;
Hon ompih hi kimu lou zong,
A nai tawntung Hondampa.
Aman ka khut kiptak in len,
Hondampa ka muh nung;
Mangtutphah juan in kei hon pi,
Aw, tua’h Hondampa mu ning.

A sihma zan lungkhamhuai ah,
Khialte dia thah Jesu’n;
Sihkuan a thugen tawpna ah,
Hiai ankuang na khung hi.
Um di’n hong kikhawm ung Toupa,
Nang hon theigige di’n;
“Kei di’n hong si, kei di’n hong si,’
Chidi’n tatte panpih’n.
Toupa Na thuakna ngilh kei ung,
Kon theihgigena uah;
Tanghou nein, a nou dawn ung,
Thil thupizaw gel ung.

Mikhat pan’ Toupa’n namte bawl,
Khat ziak pukna hongtung;
Khelhna A itna’n delhjui jel,
Gospel michih ding hi.
Gospel deihhuai mi tengteng ding,
Gospel miteng ding hi;
Khelhna A itna’n delhjui jel,
Gospel miteng ding hi.
Gingloute’n a awlmoh kei uh,
Sapna za khang chiken;
Banghang ei kia hampha tuam ding?
Gospel michih ding hi.
A thawn a muh a thawn in pia’n,
Gamchih pan hon sam uh;
Za lou in hing theilou ding uh,
Gospel michih ding hi.

Tua kros lamdang ka ngaihtuah chian,
Thupina kumpipa hong si;
Ka punna pen manna’n ka sim,
Ka hoihpenna zong kihhuai sa’ng.
Phal ken Toupa ka suang kha ding,
Kris, ka Toupa sihna loungal;
Bangmahlou thil kei hon hipte,
A sisan ah ka lan vek hi.
A lu, A khut, A khe en in,
Dahna leh mi itna luang khawm;
Dah leh it a kituak ngei hiam,
Linglukhu hi chi hoih ngei hiam?
Leitung pumpi keia hileh,
Pathian piak dingin ka sit lai;
Itna lamdang in siangthou lua,
Ka kha, hinna bangkim hon ngen.

Jesu’n Kalvari ah tatna dingin Ahinna pia,
Kalvari mual ah, mulkimhuai tang ah;
Manglukhu vak i ngahna di’n sisan in lampi hong,
A min siang’ phat un.
Toupa phat un, hotdamna hon tun hi,
Kuan in kikou un leitung hilhvek un,
Tuni’n gen un, tuni’n gen un,
Pathian thu gen un,
Manglukhu ngah dingin,
Hilh un, mangthangte,
Hotdamna manbei,
Thu thehzak un, leitung leh tui tungah.
Gamla’h gen un, gamla’h gen un,
Toupa phat un hotdamna hon tun hi.
Lawm neilou in Amah kiain thuak khin in pezou vek;
Ahi pezou vek, Jesu’n pezou vek;
Thupha a honchiam bangin vualzohna nuam i ngah ding,
A min siang’ phat un.
Gam thupi gamlapi ah inn nuam kei dia bawla om,
Gam thupi vak ah, gam thupi nuam ah;
A itna muang in tuin vanlam juan in ka pai hi,
A min siang’ phat un.

Amah’ sisan hongpia;
Keimah bang a migilou di’n,
Kilhbelh in a om hi.
Hondampa aw, hon panpih in,
Ging kiptak hih ka ut;
Na omna a Na om sung in,
Toupa hon mangngilh ken.
Sing kros tung ah bangkim a thuak,
Hon ngaihdamna dingin;
Hon itna a thupilua hi,
Lung in ngaihtuah zoulou.
Ka Hondampa a sih lai in,
Ni zong kilang ngamlou;
A gentheihna khuhmang dingin,
Meipi a hong jing hi.
Kei leng tua Amah’ kros ma ah,
Ka lu ka kun ding hi;
Kipah ziakin ka biang ah leng,
Khitui a luang gige.
Nasapi in lungkham mahleng,
Bangmah phatuam lou ding;
Ka hinna teng ka hon pia hi,
Ka hihtheih dang omlou.

Khatvei khelhna kolbun in ka tang a,
Suahtak tum mahleng suakta zoulou;
Hizong suahtakna thupi ka neita,
Jesu’n ka kolbutte tansakta.
Suahtakna thupi, suahtakna lamdang,
Khelhna kolbun a thumthum nawn lou;
Hon suaktasak pa thupi Jesu hi,
Amah tangtawn in keia hi ding.
Enna, huatna, kisiat leh kinakna,
Kiletsakna leh ki-otsakna;
Khovel thildeih ka hin nuamlousak teng,
Sa ut leh deih pan a suahtakna.
Kisaktheihna leh khelh nopsakna pan,
Sum leh pai, hauhna deihtakna pan;
Heh leh lungsim sia pan a suahtakna,
Suahtakna thupi, nopna thupi.

Na tuailai hun in na mihinna bawl;
Na hun zatdan en inla,
Na lungsim leh deih enchian in.
Na tuailai hun in Pathian thei inla,
Hon Siampa thei in tuailai in.
Tuailai lungsim gilou mi hoihlou suak,
Tuailai lungsim hoihte mi hoih hong suak;
Mi hoih a honbawl dingin,
Pathian ta Jesu si ei di’n.
Mi Pathian theite zaw lungmuang in si,
Hiai hi Pathian theihna Jesu Kris neih;
Amah’ thupiak zuih chiangin,
Pathian tate chih in i om.
