Albang manna leh dahna gam tanvak in.
Kumpi David leh hambang huai Mosi,
Lei aksi lian mualliamta uh;
Tuin Mang Jesu leh Laukha Siangthou,
I Siampu Lianpen leh i Aksi hi.
Ngoutuisuahgiat leh simlei mual din ma'n,
Theih phaklouh Pathian Nang Na hi;
Sunni leh solkha leh si-al teng in,
Na vakna ningbang jou in a tang uh.
Thuneihna thupi, pahtawina sang pen,
Vualjawlna tang dia lawm na hi;
Leilung pian lai a gawhsa Belamnou,
A sisan in khovel hondam hen aw.

Aw hehpihtu Pathian in,
Eite lailung sung ah;
Laukha hon piak lungdamna,
Khovel pilna'n a zoulou hi.
Mipil mihinna in zaw,
A ngaihtuah khia zoulou ding hi;
Ka Hondampa Na thuguk zaw.
Aw thuk in sang natel e!
Khovel pilna teng sang';
Pathian hon itna simthu,
Thangvan leh simlei dim zouta.
Aw kei mikhial mangthangsa,
A hehpihna vang in;
Laukha hon piak hinna hi,
Aw ka hinna Toupa phat in.

Aw Hondampa sual leh buaina khimjing lai ah,
Laukha'n hambang hon huai in;
Sisan luang a Na tatsate sual a liam in,
Nunnopna tuipi luanglai a khawl.
Nopna tuipi luang henla,
Simlei albang dahna;
Mang Vontawi ka sual Tanpa,
Ka machiang ah sawlbang hong hei in.
Bangdang teng sang' Na thupi e, ka Hondampa,
Na khutsuak kipahpih ung;
Thilsiam teng sang' Na hoih tungtuang ka Hondampa,
Anbang Non itna lung in gel mawng.
Toupa simlei Na thil thawnpiak masa ahi,
Lei pahna ka simsenglou;
Van mun thupi Na vualjawlna bukim ahi,
Kalvari mual ah kei non pia hi.
Thilsiam teng in Na hehpihna theisiam le uh,
Simlei leh thangvan dong in,
Phatna zaila dim in a ging a dai lou ding;
Thilsiam teng in Nang hon pahtawi hen.

Aw phat un Pathian Belamnou,
Kalvari a si in;
Nang leh kei A hon tatna di'n,
A sisan hong luangkhia.
Sisan in, Sisan in,
Hon tanta, Belamnou sisan in;
Hon tanta, hon tanta,
Belamnou, Halleluijah! Phat un.
Aw, Toupa hon itna thupi,
A hauhsak chil vuallouh!
Sang tam kiang' A peta, kei zong,
Vualjawlna honpia hi.
Halleluijah, thupina teng,
Aman tang tawntung hen;
Khovel khelhna leh kei Kris in,
Sisan pha'n hon tanta.

Aw Toupa ka gam uh hon en in,
Khelhna leh gitlouhnate'n munteng a luah zou;
Ki itna a kiamta hehpihna a bei,
Ka gam uh siatna'n kidim,Toupa aw hon damsak in.
Ka gam uh Toupa hon damsak in,
Van apan hon en inla;
Aw na mite sualna hon mu inla,
Sualna vang a liamsa gam;
Toupa aw hon damsak in.
Duhamna ki neksiatna gam hi,
Angmasialna toh kidim huaihamna ngen hi;
Siatna tui kihawt in lehlam lehlam ah,
Ka gam uh ahon pi e, Toupa aw hon hondam in.
Kristian gam kichi sam napi in,
Muanna leh nunnopnate galmuanna omlou;
Kithahna a pungjel, mulkimna beita,
Ka gam uah na mel kilawm loubang in tul zouta e.
Toupa aw, ka gam siatnate uh,
Itna leh zahngaihna toh aw hon en lai in;
Na mite kisik a, a hong thum uleh,
Sualna henkol apan in Toupa aw hon honkhia in.

Pengkul hong gin chiangin, misite thou unchin,
Sitheilou mi thupi’n, thangvan a hon tuam dinga;
Sihna pua Angel in, hon suse nawnlou ding,
Misite thouta ding uh, jingsang kipahhuai ah.
Jingsang kipahhuai ah, (2)
I kikhawm ding thupi in;
Jingsang kipahhuai ah. (3)
I kikhawm ding thupi in;
Jingsang kipahhuai ah.
Kumpipa honglat chian, van a thupina toh,
Ata itte teng thangvan jawl ah hon samkhawm ding;
Toupa adingin nasem in i omta ding,
I kha in siamtangta ding, jingsang kipahhuai ah.
Aw, huai jingsang nuam ah, i it i ngaihte toh,
Tatsate zaila sa in i kimu tuah chiat dia;
Belamnou phat la sa’n, tangtawn kumkhua’n om ni,
Lungkhamna khitui luangte, i mangngilhta ding uh.

(kumtawn suangpi,kei man),
Nang kon muang hi Toupa it,
(Toupa it nang kon muang hi),
Ka zinna zohma hon kem in,
(Zinzoh ma hon kem in)
Na mel lungdam huai muh dong.
Honsel in aw kumtawn suangpi,
Na mel lungdamhuai mu din,
(Thupi a na mel mudin);
Huihpi hat in hon tuam chiang in,
(Hat in hontuam nuamsa),
Kumtawn suangpi honsel in.
Meipi hong jin in hon kem in,
(Hon kem in meipi jing)
Nisa hong tan nawm mateng,
(Mial lak pan hong tang khia in)
Nna ka zohmateng hon kem in,
(Hon kem in nna zou a)
Khovel ka nutsiat ma teng.
Ka zinna ka zoh vek chiang in,
(Zoh vek chiang in honpa)
Nna sepding om nawn louh chiang,
(Sepding beichiang, Aw nuamsa)
Ka Khat tawlpi in Hondampa,
(Ka laukha tawl tua mun)
Vandum khen gamnun nuam ah.

Aw, simlei i tuallenna gam,
Lungtuak gibang khenna;
Aw chikchiang' tuangnung ka siah diam,
Hambang ka vaihna gam? (2)
Aw chikchiang' tuangnung ka siah diam,
Hambang ka vaihna gam?
Lenmual khumsa tung si-al zong,
Thangvan jawl ah munmuang;
Sanggah liangvai kei simlei ah,
Hambang vai sawt lua ing. (2)
Sanggah liangvai kei simlei ah,
Hambang vai sawt lua ing.
Zatam vualgen itte lenna,
Lelliangte tutkhawlna;
Kei zong tua ah ka tutkhawl ding,
Hambang vai nawn lou in. (2)
Kei zong tua ah ka tutkhawl ding,
Hambang vai nawn lou in.
Simlei daidam ah giakmawh bang,
Gahliang in vai zong leng;
Si-al tang Inn nuam ka tun chiang';
Hambang vai nawnlou ding. (2)
Si-al tang Inn nuam ka tun chiang';
Hambang vai nawnlou ding.

Buaina hong theng in, ka gam ka juan ding,
Simlei ah zaw ka kha a muang theilou;
Toupa bawl Salem Thak vadon dih ning.
Aw, phamsa thelbang thohna sihna zoupa,
Kho siangthou ah tuang hon tun in,
Luipiau kilawm zaw ah;
Buai leh sihna zou in zaila sa ning.
Kap veng aw Toupa, Na mel mulou in,
Suihlung leng in sunni ka tum zoulou,
Zion kulhpi, koilai ah om na hiam?
Pialgal ni vak hoih ka lampi mial ah,
Hong tang in aw, Toupa ka pai siam lou;
Buai leh han mial in palbang hon nang hi.
Ka damlai ni zaw kulsin ah pel ning,
Hihhang' non ngakna gam ka manawh ding;
Tuipi luang ging daihna ah ka khawl ding.

Na kiang lam honjuan ua;
Hinna leh damna na pia,
Tangtawn hinna leh Damna.
Aw Jesu tuihing lui na hi
Kalvari a tui hing;
Hiai tui hong zang kik nawn in,
Natnavei tute tengteng' Damna.
Tang a khovel a na leen lai in
Na kiang apan damna;
Mite'n ana sangjel ua,
Tuin zong neih ka ut hi.
Muang leh lau-lou in hon juan meng in,
Jesu kiang a damna pen;
Ei dia koih ahi ngal a,
Juanmeng in aw i Damna.
Phak leh mitdel,Piangsual,Khebaite'n
TouJesu kiang ah damna;
Ei di'n koih ahi ngal a,
Aw Jesu hon pia in aw.

En in, Toupa in na ma ah,
Lampi nih ka Ka khung chi;
Koi zaw na jui ding hiam?
Na ut zawkzawk tel in.
Kumsawt hinna lampi leh,
Kumsawt manna lampi hi;
Koi zaw na jui ding hiam?
Na ut zawkzawk tel in.
Lampi nih kathuam lai' na ding,
Kumtawn damna lampi leh,
Kumtawn sihna lampi;
Na ut zawkzawk tel in.
Apelmawh a zuih ding lampi,
Nopna khopi tunna lam leh,
Dahna khua tunna lam;
Na ut zawkzawk tel in.
A lamtou pen van gam lampi,
A lamphei pen dahna lampi,
Koi zaw i jui nuam diam?
I ut zawkzawk tel ni.

Enven ka ten na'ng gam nuam leimite'n a tel zawhlouh,
Mizawng mipoite leh tagahte nopsakna gam;
Kei hong simmawh kha ken maw;
Inn leh lou ka neihlouh hang,
Lei inn sanga pha zaw van ah innuam ka nei hi.
Ngaklah veng tua khuapi ka tun hun ding,
Tou Jesu a khutpawn ka let ni chiang;
Lungdamna khituite a luang ding a,
Kei hong Honpa aw chi'n lungdam in la ka sa ding.
Enven Tunou anglai ah, melsia mipoi tampite,
Van mi bang mel etlawm Toupa'n bawlpha khin zouta;
Lei a i kousiatnate kham lukhu in khuta uh,
A lutung te ziahziah suang manpha tawh kizem hi.
Sihna hanmual hong liamsan apaisa it leh ngaihte'n,
Hih lei gentheihna gam nusia in hongpai un chi;
Kei ngai in kap kei unla, kei omna ah hong pai un,
I tun ding hong ngaklah van khuapi pan khut hong van.

Kumpipa' thahatna'n dou lehang;
Kha namsau hiam tawiin pang lehang,
Giloute Jesu kiang i tun ding.
I zou ding, ka ging hi,
Kumpipa thahatna'n dou lehang;
I zou ding, ka ging hi,
Kumpipa thahatna'n dou lehang.
Ni dangin eite i vualzou ngei,
Gal mun ah galte i delhjak ngei;
Atawp pha'n Kumpipa dia dou ding,
Kha namsau tawiin i pang ding hi.
Galte hatin, hangsan mahle uh,
Kidouna haksa'n lauhuai mahleh,
Kumpipa hondam dingin hat hi,
Kidou lai' i kiang nai gige hi.
Kumpipa minin gal i dou ding,
I puanlap huihmuta kipei tawh;
Pathian leh adik gum i dou ding,
Setan thuneihna gam i sut ding.
Pathian leh sepaih pawl dia muanhuai,
Kumpipa min in gal i dou ding;
Mei leh sisan in gal i zou ding,
A khebul ah khovel i tun ding.

Ginna kha a leng in,
Kalvari mual lam vajuan ve ning;
Ka Toupa kha A phamna mun,
Ka tenna ding tung Salem Thak mu ning.
Ka lei lungkham naubang kah bangta ning,
Pahna pak hoih lutna ka ngaihtuah chiang'.
Kalvari tang tung a,
Sisan luangkhia Hondampa' nak a,
Namchih tuibang a sianna ah,
Aw ka laukha, limnga bang vabual in.
Jerusalem vangkhua
Thak ngoubang a latna dang omlou;
Gal in don ni Kalvari ah,
Ngoubang a lang hon gum Toupa nak ah.
Ka laukha valeng in,
Hongum Toupa kha phamna mun ah;
Nangmah vang a A thuakna hi,
A hon itna sisan ah vabual in.

Ginna'n gelsiam lehang,
Hiai khovel a pan in;
Pak ka nuam Hondampa,
Na hehpihna deihhuai.
Kipak louthei hi keng, (2)
Hondampa, Na nak liam,
Tatna sisan pawtna;
En in Non tatdan tel;
Na lua lawmlawm sa'ng e.
Na manna kumsawt gam,
Pel in nuai simlei ah;
Ka dahna uh Na pua,
Hamse thuak singdawn ah.
Tang a pi leh pute,
Mansaksa van pialgal;
Itna sisan vang in,
Kei in ka na muta.
Angel siangte lenna,
Sunni tumseng lou gam;
Aw, Na sisan vang in,
Chikleh tuang ka tung diam?
Simlei ah liang zongleh,
Hehpihna'n honhuai in;
Ka laukha vangam ah,
Nunnuam in lengta ding.
Na min thupi phat in,
Nuam in zaila sa ning;
Tullou pak Hondampa,
Aw, Na hoih tuan lua hi.

Haibang hon ngak ung Mangpen,
Lei gimhuai khimjing nuai ah;
Na sat van Salem khopi aw, mubang ngai nang e,
Simlei lungkhamna leh khimjing nuai ah ka leng zong;
Anbang it a kei hon zong,
Ka ngaih bang theilou hi.
Van thupi Eden Thak nunnuam,
Lungkham om nawnlouhna tua mun;
Aw, chikchiang in ka tung ding hiam?
Na tangtawn manna gam,
Nunnuam eng singseng.
Hong nai in, ka Hondampa,
Gal a lian, nuai simlei ah;
Sisan a Na tatsate lungkham naubang kap uh,
Lei a na len lai a Na mangbatna Kalvari,
Dougalte a hong nai uh,
Na gam hon doutute.
Aw, koiah hiam Hondampa,
Zion tang gal muanna mun?
Mawhsianna itna tui a kou dia na luanna mun;
Sual danna dai kulhpi Na tangtawn van khua-le-tui,
Hotdamte Na lim nuai ah;
Nunnuam a lenna mun.
Aw, simlei a hong mang ding,
Sawtlou kal in hong mang ding;
Hondampa A kikou dia, lei i nusiata ding;
Toupa anbang itten, A vangletna tang ding uh,
Anbang itna tuibang lian,
Nuam un, Halleluijah.

Toupa tuni’n hon naihsem in,
Nidang sang’n naisem in;
Niteng paina ah hongnai in,
Hon taimangsak nawn ken.
Hongnai in, Toupa, naisem,
Hon ompih gige in;
Damsung lampi,
Kei kia’n juilou’n;
Nang toh tonin pai ning.
Toupa hongnaisem in, Nang a,
Pahna honsinsak in;
Na deihbang nate sem jel ning,
Nang dia phatuam dingin.
Ka kiang hongnaisem in Toupa,
Nang bangsem a khang di’n;
Nangmah batna ka put chiangin,
Na itna kim lak ning.

Haibang ka ngak vangkhua minthang,
Tungchiang Jerusalem khopi;
Nuai simlei lungkhamna, sen naubang kahna mun,
Tuangnung sia'n leng nuam veng.
Toupa aw, hambang hon huai in,
Lungkham buaina lummei kaiin hon bawm;
Ka van innpi minthang gam vangla leh nuam ah,
Chikchiang' tuang ka tung diam!
Ka tangtawn innpi ding ngai veng,
Suangmantam leh sana vangkhua;
Lungkham, buai, kah omlou, gilkial, dangtak omlou,
Gibang khenna omlou.
Aw ngai veng Immanuel' gam,
Van misiangte tuallenna mun;
Muikhua jinna omlou Belamnou nibang tang,
Zion khopi tual ah.
Chikchiang' nong tualkum diam, Toupa?
Simlei dahna'n mangbang hon bawm;
Thangvan khopi tual ah ngabang ka len hun ding,
Sunchin gal in don veng.

Haibang ngakla'ng Zion khua nuam,
Mang lenna van gam thupi;
Suihlung len in gal in don veng,
Simlei buaina tuangnung sia'n.
Aw, gam siangthou, hinna gam vak,
Manna gam etlawm mu nuam veng;
Tuang ka tun ma'n aw Mang nunnem,
Na ban' hambang hon huai jel in.
Tungchiang a leng in kha jak uh,
Natna leh albang dahna,
Phamna chiaukuam a ding hihang,
Hinna gam gal in don ni.
Damlai simlei don dih ve ua,
Lungkham lummei jingden hi;
Simlei pel a nunthak ngai in,
Mang nunnem mai ah kap veng.
Pham ngai heh hong nem in Toupa,
Phamna vontawite pahna'n;
Pham ngaite din lenkawl hong eng,
Zion gam gal in don ni.

Hatlou mi ka hi zong, hat theihna thuguk te,
Toupa in kei a dingin a nei,
Khovel in a tellouh, khovel in a deihlouh,
Toupa in Amah dingin a tel.
Aw a lamdang e ..Aw a thupi e,
Na itna aw na hehpihna,
Mimawlte nangawn zong aw na tel lawmlawm.
Lamdang in aw a thupi e.
Lelliangte na it a, genthei te na huai a,
Leitung mi'n a phawk zohlouh te zong,
Toupa aw na thei a, Itna in na pi zel,
Gentheihna panin nunnopna ah.
Lamet bei a lungngai, mipoite na thei a,
Piangsualte bukimloute na ngawn,
Khovel hoihna mulou, mitdel te na thei a,
Nang a din na telta lamdang e.
A chinglou a om lou, a siamlou a omlou,
Mi khempeuh i Toupa mai ah zaw,
Leitung mi a ding a simmoh huai a neute,
Silpak bang a lun Toupa a din.
Aw a lamdang e ..Aw a hon telna,
Kipak in nuamna lasa ni,
Khovel in a phawklouh mi ihi zongin,
A hontel na a lamdang e.

Hattak leh hangtak in ei Kristiante'n,
Pichin lam i manoh jel ding uh;
Itna i neihsa uh khangsak semsem in,
Masuan jelni hang Kris nungjuite'n.
Hattak leh hangtak in Kris sepaihte'n,
Sualgal thupi laulou in pal jelni;
Kidouna haksa in lauhuai mahleh zong;
Toupa toh pang in i zou ding uh.
Hattak leh hangtak in Kris tuailaite'n,
I tuailai hun hoih neihlai sung un;
Gammial a tangthupha thehzak thei ding in;
Dialdial leh diamdiam in masuan ni.
Hattak leh hangtak in Kris Saptuamte'n,
Hiai khovel a i leen sung un ah,
I bangkim uh Toupa di'n i pia ding ua,
Thangvan ah danbang kituak nawn ni.
CODA:Sian aw hon kem hon huai jel in.

Mi teng leh namchihta ding;
Vual hon jawlpa phat chiat un,
Mang thupi tungnung ahi.
Mikhial, genthei leh liangvai,
Hehpihna gamnuam juan un;
Sisan siangthou in hon tan zouta,
A ut peuhmah hong lut un.
Van kong kihon lai ahi,
Lut chiat ni, gamnuam sung ah;
Na khelhna teng tawh hong pai,
Hehpihna'n A ngaidam ding.
Gamchiam tang dinga sehsa,
Unau gammang nawn ken la;
Sapna aw nem ngaikhia in,
Van Kanan Toupa ahi.
Lungdam aw nem ka zata,
Vak thupi ka muh laitak'n;
Toupa'n lungnopna hon pia,
Tatna sisan ka tangta.

Hiai khovel ah zaw gingtu a tam ngei e,
Hizong gingtu nundan siam a tawm ngei e;
Hizong puakgik pua nun tawldamloute din,
Nundan siam hon sinsaktu Jesu ahi.
Nundan ka hong siamta (2)
Hon sinsaktu Mang Jesu Amah ngei ahi;
Lungkim jel ka chingta (2)
Lungkimna hon sinsaktu Jesu ahi.
Sum leh pai hauhsakna duhamnate in,
Hunta chih nei ngeilou lungkim zawh haksa;
Sanggah gentheite zong Jesu panglou in,
Thuaksiam dan omlou hi lungkim zawh haksa.
Gentheih dan ka siamta, hauhsak dan ka siamta,
Niangletai, gilkial a omdan ka siamta;
Anbang hon it Toupa ka bangkim a hi,
Hon hihhatpa vang in bangkim ka hihthei.
Kris itna pan bangmah in honkhen lou ding,
Lauhna lungkhamna leh haksatnate'n zong;
Nopna leh muanna ah hon pitu ahi,
Hon hihhatpa' vang in bangkim ka hihthei.

Hiai khovel damlai gamdai
Lummei bang jing nuai ah;
Sual chiteng leh lungkhamnaten hon umkimvel,
Himahleh leng ka Hondampa,
Na simthu hoih ka hon theih in,
Ka lungkhamna teng kipahna a suaksak jel.
Tanchinhoih ka kipahna,
Tanchinhoih kei dia damna,
Ka Mang' thukhun thupipen ahi,
Aw, kei dia damna.
Sual huihpi leh gamhuaite'n,
Hon um kimvel mahleh;
Ka Hondampa'n A hehpihna kulhpi sung ah,
Ka laukha liam A pi ding a,
Hon Tanpa' thuchiam khuambang kip,
Bangmah in dal zoulou hi, aw A hehpihna.
A hehpihna min thupi-
Pen kia kei di'n manpha;
Kei migilou, liangvai, genthei, hingtak nawnlou,
Tangtawn pialgal kong hon honsak;
A sisan lui siangthou tak in,
Lungsim in hon musak in, aw ka Mang Jesu.

Hiai lei zaw tangtawn gam a chinglou,
Lungkham naubang kahna ahi, Toupa;
Nopnaten lenmual khumzouta,
Nunnop pak heuta.
Aw, gal in don veng tung thangvan,
Angel lenna minthang khopi ah;
Hotdamten khawlna galmuang ah,
Simlei albang mang hen chi uh.
Aw, ka ngai pak chih lutna gamnuam,
Tul lou ding Mang nunnem in a siam ah,
Hon pi in, hon kai tawntung in,
Kah lai hon nem in.
Belamnou' gam Zion ka tun chiang',
Lungdeih gibang khenna ngai nawnlou ding;
Itna khopi namchih zata,
Nunnop kimna hi.
Thianmang anglai limbelh kulhpi ah,
Nunnuam phungching in tualleng diamdiam uh;
Nuai simlei pan ka galdot in,
Ka sinlai hon lun.

Hiai leitung a ka len lai in,
Sunchin buaina in hon bawm;
Khakiakna Jordan gal ka kai ma'n,
Toupa, lungkhamna honglian jel hi.
Mel hon musak in, Na bawl Salem,
Lungtuak angel tuallenna, gibang khenlouhna;
Simlei lungkhamna tuangnung sia'n,
Aw, bangchikchiang' tuang ka tung ding hiam?
Tang a lungkham huibang maute,
Tua mun tuang a tun chiang un;
Tuangtung masa leh angel siang tawh,
Aw, Salem Mangpa phat la sa uh.
Aw, kumsawt zaila oihpih din,
Malbang hon kou vualngaihten;
A tongluang lawmnou uh ka zak in,
Aw, tua mun thupi ngai in ka kap.
Mubang ngai veng Immanuel,
Na sat Salem Thak nunnuam;
Ka lenna gamdai ahi, Toupa,
Tuangtun louh lau veng, hon huai jel in.

Nazareth Jesu Toupa ma’h,
Lamdang sain ka ding a;
Huchitela A hon itna,
Mikhial siamlou tangsa nung.
Aw hon itna, a lamdang lua,
Chih ka la hi gige ding;
Aw hon itna a lamdang lua,
Ka Hondampa hon itna.
Kei di’n huan ah hon thumsak a,
“Kei thu hilou, Nang thu” chi’n’
Amah’ dia lungkham dah hilou,
Kei di’n kho-ul sibang luang.
Angelte’n Amah lungmuan in,
Khovel vak pan hong kum uh;
A lungkhamna lungmuan dingin,
Ka kha dia a thuak zan in.
Ka khelh dahna teng lamang in,
Amah’ a banga bawl-in;
Kalvari tanpha’n puakgik pua’n,
Khattang thuakin hong si hi.
Tatsate toh thupitakin,
A mel ka muh hun chiangin;
Hon itna la a ka sak ding,
Ka tangtawn nopna hi ding.

Hinna hongpia ka Toupa hong it ing,
Mangthang lungngai ka vaih laiin,
Lunglaigil ah khamuanna Nong pia,
Muanna tuibang na hong luanna.
Hinna hongpia ka Toupa aw,
Nanglou muanna ding ka nei ngei diam?
Lungngai huibang ka mauna simlei ah,
Nang toh omleng ka lung nuam hi.
Suan ding omlou ka hoihna zong omlou,
Nang toh om di'n ka ching zoulou,
Hizong Toupa na itna aw nem toh,
Kong it chiin Na hong samlai.
Keimah lampi ka zuih khempeuhte leh,
Ka lunggel leh ka ngaihtuahna,
Toupa nang di'n a chingzou ding omlou,
Hizong kong it ka ta nong chi.

Hun kidangta, vaihawmna ni thupi,
Sunchin ka naih semsem;
Khemna leh lungkham buainate,
Ka dougal tuibang a hong lian.
Aw, khattang hon nusia ken,
Ka kiang ah om jel in;
Zion tang etlawm ka tun ma'n,
Ka Hondampa, hon pi jel in.
Ka ma ah khemna tuipi a hong lian,
Man ding lau veng Toupa;
Tua chiaului a tumsate zaw,
Tangtawn gam tuangtungnawn-louding.
Noa damlaia thil omdan bang in,
Leh Sodom khua bang in;
Mahni nopsakna kia zong in;
Aw, Toupa hon heisanta uh.
Na laibu siangthou a kigelh bang in,
Nuai simlei a buaita,
Kiitna a hong dai zouta,
Buaina leh lungkhamna'n a dim.
Simlei gimhuaina leh lungkhamnain,
Pa' mel hon musak in;
Zion tate i noplenna'ng,
Ni thupi a hong naita hi.

Hun leh kum albang mang jel,
Nun i nop lai niteng tawh;
Jangni pal leh nuai simlei pallun,
Kei' di'n lungkham kahna mun leh gam ahi.
Aw, i tangtawn khopi gal muanna mun,
Ngaina veng e, tatsate tuallenna mun,
Lungkhamna leh lungdonnate,
Om nawnlou dia kahna a beita ding.
Nuai simlei lungkhamna leh,
Luankhi in palbang hon nang;
Gamkeu-gamdai huibang ka mauna,
Lambang kheng in itte tawh leng nuam ing e.
Nun i noplai pakbang vul,
Nuai simlei pallun teng zong;
Simlei nopna loubang tul jeljel,
Loubang tullou kumsawt gamnuam ngai nang e.
Heh hong nem ve aw, Toupa,
Khapham lusun, liangvaita;
Hon huai ve aw, Na lenna gam ah,
Buaina gam nuai simlei ka ngai nawn lou ding.

Hun tuibang kiam jel e, simlei nunnopna bei,
Nuai simlei ah nunnopna kim theilou;
Toupa hong tualkum in ni thupi hon tun in,
Liangvai taten leitung haksa nusia nuam uh.
Aw, Eden Thak inn nunnuam ah hon tun in,
Dah leh kap a gibang kikhente lengkhawm le'ng,
Nunnop teng kim dia lambang hon pak jel n'ung,
Hiai leitung mubang ngai kei n'ung,
Na gam ah zaw.
Nang ding a thuakte tua gam nuam in kinem uh,
Leitung ah nunnop amau din pallou;
Zion mizata leh ki-itna Toupa' mel,
Minthang sunni tuang hongtung ding donchim lou uh.
Leitung dahna kahna, buaina meipi nuai ah,
Gingtuten nunnuam in zai awi jel uh;
Amau din khua vak hen, Salem thak nunnuam ah,
Na pikhawm ding hun ni thupi ngaiin don uh.
Simlei zaw nuai omlai vei gibang khenna hi,
Lungjuan sunsawt naubang a oihna hi;
Lawmvual lungtuak zaila'n palbang ki-am zong le'ng,
Kawlni sialbang hong suak dia gibang hon khen ding.

Hunte tuibang in a luang a,
I khovel damlai nite zong;
Ngak neilou in sun nichin in mual ah liam jel,
Khovel pahna albang mangjel;
Zong a nichin a nunnuamte,
Muang om nawn ken vualngaihte aw;
Tawpna ni a naita.
Hiai khovel ah nopna zong in,
Sang tampi hanmual ah liam jel,
Hizong nopna mu leh neite nuamden omlou;
Muanna bitna a chihlai un,
A tawpna un a honlap ding;
Muang om nawn ken, vualngaihte aw,
Tawpna ni a naita.
Aw, hongpai un vualngaihte aw,
Hotdamna thu hong ngaikhia un,
I Toupa hehpihna aw in a honsam hi;
Na hun kikhel saksak nawn ken,
Na tan ding zaw ka ngaingam lou,
Muang om nawn ken vualngaihte aw,
Hun in ngak a neilou.
Sihna in zawhlah a neilou,
Natna in zong lauh a neilou,
Gawtmun in zong kuamah gawt zohlouh a neilou;
Hotdamna thu na ngaih ken zaw,
Na tan ding zaw ka ngaingam lou;
Muang om nawn ken vualngaihte aw,
Sihna'n a hon ngak hi.

I omna uh lei inn chim mahleh,
Khut a bawllouh tangtawn inn ka nei;
Tua munnuam ngai in tu'n tuang ka tung thei nailou,
Lei inn ka pumpi in hondal hi.
Gam ka nei, gam thupi,
Hondampa'n kei ding a A bawlsa;
Hiai lei ah ten kumkhuana ding mun ka neilou,
Gam hoihzaw tung thangvan gam lou zaw.
I omna lei Inn huibang mauna,
Aw, bangchikchiang ka paisan ding hiam?
Itna Toupa phat leh Amah pahtawi ding in,
Lei inn ka pumpi in hon dal hi.
Lungmuanna leh khawlna ka zong a,
Mu zoukei veng hiai nuai simlei ah,
Ginna'n Gam siangthou don ing, ka tung thei nailou,
Lei inn ka pumpi in hon dal hi.
Abraham mah bang in tuin zaw,
Ginna in gamchiam juan in ka pai;
Misiangthoute tawh gam thupi luah sam ding in,
Lei inn ka pumpi in hon dal hi.

I Toupa hon itna lian hi na lawmlawm,
Hoihna khat zong nei lou i hih lai in;
Itna sisan hong luang in a hon tanta,
A ta'n hon bawl lamdang e a hon itna.
Tua sisan hi, ka lungnop a kimna,
Tua sisan ahi ka kisak theihna pen;
Kalvari Kros a sisan hong luangkhia,
Kei adi'n aw ka damna tua sisan hi.
Eimah utdan a om in i leeng jel a,
Amah i heisan lai a hon itpa;
Lam pialsan a i om zong hon it lailai,
Toupa it bang itna dang a om lou e.
Mihingte it vang in aw a hon thuak a,
I mohna liammate a damsak ta;
Aw miteng dia hinna lui a hong luanna,
A dawnte din damna lui a hong hi ta.

Itna sisan luangin ka tatsa mite,
Khomial gimna sung ah kahna aw ka za;
Lainat in ka khi luang kua sawl ding ka hiam?
A mangthang khate kua'n piikhia ding hiam?
Toupa'n nang hong sam lainatna aw tawh,
Ka nasem dingte a tawmlua e;
Mangthang khate kiang itna thu gen ding,
Nang hong sawl ing e, na hizou diam chi.
Na neih na lam khempeuh kong piaksa hi a,
Khat zong siit lou in la-kik thei Pa ka hi;
Hizong la-kik kei ning na phal bang pia in,
Van ah nong chiah chiang na hawmthoh kha diam?
Na tuailai in sem in tuumbang na vuai ding,
Na neihlai pia in beina hun hong tung ding;
Gal leh sa haksa in buaina'n hong lap ding,
Sep theihlai sem in khua hong mial ding hi.

Jerusalem Zion khopi gal in don un,
Aw, mi a tam Belamnou Mang len na'ng
Mun a om lou;
Aw, lungkhamna leh pahna Kalvari
Tang a kilang hi.
Aw nam tengteng leh,
Chi chih pau chihte;
Van Mang naubang a kahna Kalvari ah,
Khentuam neilou uh. (2)
D.S.
Jerusalem khopi thak nuam galin don un,
Aw, mi atam Belamnou Mang lenna
Mun etlawm ah;
Aw, Kalvari a Pathian' hehpihna,
Lung a gel kul hi.
Halleluijah, gensiam leng aw, Halleluijah,
Aw, hehpihna dai ngeilou kipahna
Hinna pak hoih;
Gensiam om di'am, sutsiam om him di'am maw-
Aw, A hon itna.

Jerusalem Zion vangkhua tualnuam ah,
Salsuahna dongkot kihong;
Chichih, pauchih, namchih chial hi,
A ut peuhmah lut hen.
Tanga Jawlnei genbang laukha siangthou tuangtung,
Mizata'n pian in dang sa;
Nungjuite'n tongdang in simthu lel uh,
Laukha salbang suahna simthupha.
Gingtute mohpuak tangthupha phuanzak hi,
Nuai zinmang henkol bulhsut;
Zata laukha albang mang ding,
Anbang it, salbang suah.
Tangthupha phuangzak di'n nang bang na sem dia?
Pai in,kuankhia in gen in;
Sum leh pai pia in, laigelh in,
Thum in, ngen in, tau in.

I Toupa Lalgam sung ah,
Michih di’n hehpihna om;
I Toupa Lalgam sung ah,
Vualjawlna om khelhna bei.
Aw, Lalgam thupi,
Hondampa mou hi!
Pathian thilgeel hih -
Tangtung di’n om tawntung.
Lalgam sung kia ah hotdam,
Hoih leh nuamsate om uh;
Hia’h Hondampa’n Ama’ thei,
Nopna, muanna, khawlna om.
I Toupa Lalgam sung ah,
Kris teng, a kumpipa hi;
A thute i it ding hi,
Bangkim a kitahlut in.

Jesu itna'n sihna pan hong gumkhia,
Mikhial kei a ding in a sisan luangkhia,
Mangthang, mikhial, gilou, kihhuai pen in,
Vanglian a ka tuahding tel!
Aw kei bang leltak in vanglian a ka tuah ding,
Lamdang, aw lamdang lua;
Aw kei bang leltak in vanglian a ka tuah ding,
Lamdang, aw lamdang lua!
Aw A itnan Jesun hong gumkhia zou,
Phulouh vangletna toh kei hongpom lai a,
Mangthang, mikhial, gilou, kihhuaipen in,
Vanglian a ka tuah ding tel!
Tua vangletna piandang sisan vang hi,
Piandang vangletna hi ka tandia lawmlou,
Mangthang, mikhial, gilou, kihhuaipen in,
Vanglian a ka tuah ding tel!
Vantung ka tun ding a ka la ding hiai,
Piandang sisan vang in vangletna kei a;
Mangthang, mikhial, gilou, kihhuaipen in,
Vanglian a ka tuah ding tel!

Jesu min a tungnung pen hi,
Simlei leh thangvan ah;
Angel leh mihing in a biak,
Nuai jinmang in a lauh.
Deihlouhna dang nei nawn kei veng,
Midang ka ngai nawnlou;
Kris sihna kei di'n a hun hi,
Kei ding a hong si hi.
Jesu' min giloute ding hi,
Gilou adia piak hi;
Gitlouh mohpuak a lamangta,
Gawtmun van a tangsak.
Jesu'n koltangte kolbut sut,
Setan' lu khen sidup;
Hatna neiloute hatna pia,
Misite hinna pia.
Aw, khovel in mu in thei leh,
A hehpihna hauhna;
A itna khut kei hon pom pen,
Mi khempeuh in sang ding.
A dikna thupi ka ensak,
A hotdamna ka phuang;
Leia ka damsung nasep hiai,
Belamnou en un chih.
Ka hat tawpna'n A min lou leh,
Nuamsa ka hi mah ding;
Ka laitah dong' A min gen leng,
'En ve un, Belamnou.'

Jesu neih hinna nuam,
Kipahna thuguk hi;
Ka kha ah muanna honpia,
Jesu neih kia kipahna.
Jesu neih pilna bulpi,
Jesu neih hauhna bukim;
Jesu neih zaw, Vannuai toh kikhenna.
Jesu ka nei hi gen,
Kimvel ning vannuai ah;
Ginna in ka muchianta,
Kros tunga a sihna mel.
Jesu neih hinna nuam,
Mihaute'n nei zoulou;
Mipilte'n theisiamlou uh,
Kua ziak a dangtak hi hiam?
Van Kanan ka inn ding,
Leitung ka khualzinna;
Aigupta a haksa lua,
Ka Mang Jesu honpi in.

Nang bangdia na hinna it maw lawm,
A kha a hinna nang honpia zou;
Ei leng kipia lel maini aw lawm.
Lawm nang bangdia na hinna it,
Tatna theilou, mi sangtampi om,
Toupa'n nang hon zang nuam hilou maw?
Ding khe kin meng mai in hun bei ding.
Amah ei tang a ding in kipia;
Zuthuuk pia in a khut ah kilh uh,
A naak ah a dawt laitak un zong,
Pa aw amau ngaidam in chi lai.
Saggam aw i kiim ah buh minlua,
Lakhawm ding in nang leh kei hong deih,
Hatna bangmah a omlouh hang in,
Toupa'n kon panpihna ding chi hi.

Ka bualna simlei khimjing a man chiang',
Tung thangvan mite heina munnuam;
Khuambang ka luah ding gam vangkho nuam ah,
Jesu sisan vang in teng kumkhua ning.
Tatsate tua ah paksil lunlai nou bang,
Silhpuan nem ngiingei duang a bat;
Simlei ngailou a tuangnungsia'n,
Toupa lambang pak uh aw, Halleluijah, chi in.
Toupa' gam nunnuam sunni bang tang ah,
Lawmvual ngaih khensa chiambang nui uh;
Simlei lungkham buaina tuangnung siah in,
Nun khonuam in laitual ngabang leng uh.
Simlei khimjing buaina loubang tulsa,
Lambang kheng a tuangnung siahna ding,
Laambang ka et chiang' ka ngai, aw tua gam,
Ka ngaih puanbang a thak thangvan khopi.
Ka Jua Thianmang' saupha tunkal ngak la'ng,
Kawlni suahsim lungngaih mei' hon bawm;
Omlaivei ngaihtamsial kah omlouhna,
Mubang ngaiing, Thianmang' saupha nunnuam.
Aw, hambang hon huai, Laukha hong leng in,
Naubang kap heh hong nem aw, Laukha;
Ngaihtam sialna nuai simlei sau daidam,
Tuangnung sia'n leng nuam ing, vangkhua thak ah.

Ka damsung huihpi a then chiang in,
Ka Mang Hondampa' mel ka muta ding a;
Tua ah ka nunnopna tul lou ding,
A mel ah van heisa a pal tawntung ding.
Aw hinna sing, na limliap ah,
Van angel lungtuak ngabang leng;
Aw, tua ah i tutkhawl ding hi,
Israel tang siangthou nuam ah.
Tua khopi ngai a ka mauna in,
Lungkham, buaina, sihna tuang hontun thei leh;
Tatna sisan vang a lungdeihte,
Nuai simlei ah zaw gibang ka khenta ding.
I paijel ding aw Zion vontawi,
I zalenna gam thupi a hong naita;
Tu a lungkham, kah leh buainate,
Nun i nopna'n silbang in hong pal ngei ding.
Tua khopi hoih tuang ka tun chiang in,
Ka lenna gamdai mubang ngainawn kei ning;
Van Belamnou leh A mangtutphah,
Piandang etchimlouh leh kipahna pen hi.

Ka hinna hon bawlhoih sakjel ka Toupa,
Non itna thupi in aw a lamdang lua;
Hoihna leh chitna ka neihlouh zongin,
Aw na hoihna ka tungah honglang.
Jehovah Pathian na min ka pahtawi hi,
N'on itna leh n'on khotuahna aw atul ngeilou;
Kei bangleltak adi'n thupilua sa ing,
A manpha Kris vangin Halleluijah!
Na hoihna chitnate in kei n'ong tuam a,
A vuak ka hih zongin na itna'n nong dimjel;
Hon heisan ngeingei ken aw ka Toupa,
Nang tellou in bangmah ka hilou.
Hon theisiamsak jelin na lemgel dante,
Ka mihing pilna in aw a sui zoulou;
Nang theihlouh a ka tuah khatzong omlou,
Vanglian Pathian aw muanhuai na hi.

Ka hinna zaw heisa bang in,
Sawtlou kal in a bei ding;
Zanchiang jalmang khua a vak a,
A mang nawn bang lel ahi.
Aw ka laukha, van ah leng in,
Lei bang na khiaklah na hiam?
Na tangtawn khopi hoih juan in,
Misiangthoute' khopi hi.
Leitung hinna bang bel ahiam?
Natna leh lungkhamna kia;
Nunnopna leh kipahnate,
Loupa pak bang lel ahi.
I lawm ngaihtak paikhinsate,
Kipak in tungkhinta uh;
Mangtutphah kimvel' la sa uh,
I tangtawn Toupa pak in.
A thupina vak etlawmnou,
Sunni sang in tangpha zaw;
A thupina mai a ding in,
I Mang Jesu i mu ding.
Ka aw hoih neihsun tengteng in,
Ka phat ding ka tun chiang in;
Vakhu bang a lensiam hileng,
Lengnuam veng vantung sang ah.
Aw ka kha aw, tuin leng in,
Leitung zaw paisan mai in;
Na tangtawn khopi hoih juan in,
Khopi hoih Toupa' gam nuam.

Pathian’ ankuang kilui,
Tanghou leh grep gah tui in;
Misiangthoute’n um chiat uhi,
Toupa nitak ankuang ah.
Toupa theisiam kawm in,
A sihna phawkna siangthou;
Ginna’n nehang hongpai ngak in,
Toupa nitak ankuang ah.
Pathian’ ankuang kilui,
Tanghou leh grep gah tui in;
Misiangthoute’n um chiat uhi,
Toupa nitak ankuang ah.
Toupa theisiam kawm in,
A sihna phawkna siangthou;
Ginna’n nehang hongpai ngak in,
Toupa nitak ankuang ah.

Hun haksa leh lungkhamhuai lua ana hi Jesu kianga,
Kisatheitaka ‘Kei kia hun, Nang ngailou hi’ ka chih lai.
“Kei kia hun, Nang ngailou hi” (2)
Jesu kianga “Kei kia hun hi,
Nang ngailou hi” ka chih lai.
Hizong Aman hon mukhia hi, hamse sing’ siluang ka mu;
Ka lungsim nguiin hiai chita; “kei kia hunlou, Nang kon ngai”
“Kei kia hunlou, Nang kon ngai” (2)
Ka lungsim nguiin hiai chita;
“Kei kia hunlou, Nang kon ngai”
Niteng’ A zahngaihna nemin, damsak, panpih, kim manbei;
‘Kei tawmsem, Nang tamsem ngai’ chi’n, kingainiam in hon huau sak.
‘Kei tawmsem, nang tamsem ngai’ (2)
‘Kei tawmsem, Nang tamsem ngai’ chi’n,
Kingainiam in hon huau sak.
Van sangpente sanga sang zaw tui thukpen sang a thukzaw
Toupa, Na itna’n hon zouta, “kei bangmahlou, nang kia ngai’
“Kei bangmahlou, Nang kia ngai’ (2)
Toupa, Na itna’n hon zouta,
Kei bangmahlou, Nang kia ngai.

Ka lailung sung mawhna' dimsa,
Na temple hong suaksak in;
A sung ah ka it Toupa aw,
Kumsawt ngabang hong leng in.
Na heina mun, (2)
Tangtawn nun a nopna hi.
Na heina mun,
Tangtawn nun a nopna hi.
Aw khatvei bek kimu thei leng,
Khatvei bek Na mel mu leng;
Simlei nunnop pallun sang in,
A lehza in etlawm chia.
Hong kipia ning, (2)
Nang tawh ngabang lengkhawm di'n.
Hong kipia ning,
Nang tawh ngabang lengkhawm di'n.
Aw hawkkhia in, ka mawhnate,
Ka laukha humbit inla;
Ka chimta hi, mial a om zaw,
Hong vak in, van Vak Vanglian.
Na hong vak chiang', (2)
Lailung sung nopna'n a dim.
Na hong vak chiang',
Lailung sung nopna'n a dim.

Ka lenna gamdai tuangnung sia'n,
Van Jerusalem nunnuam ah;
Bangchik leh tuang k'ong tung sam diam?
Na tangtawn pialgal gam ah.
Aw, ka ngai gibang khenlouhna gamnuam ah,
Hinna tui a luang;
Hotdamtaten a dawn ua,
Tangtawn hinna tang uh.
Belamnou lenna mun thupi,
Ngaiin sunchin galin don veng;
Aw Laukha Siangthou, hong leng in,
Na gam ah tuang hontun in.
Kongkhak ging kilawm a hong ua,
A ging lawmnou in lung honlen;
Misiangthoute tuallenna ah,
Aw, kei zong len ka nuam hi.
Aw, tua mun ah ka Mang deihhuai,
A mel sunni vanglai bang in;
A vaknate tang kimvel e,
Tangtawn a damna ding in.

Ka ma ah chiaugal vangkhua etlawm om,
Tunkal ngakla'ng khopi etlawm;
It leh ngaih lungtuak teng kimna,
Melmuh nuam in donchim la'ng e.
Aw, khaubang chiah lai tutkhawl lou in,
Toupa hatna muang in,
Khopi etlawm juan ni.
Tua vankhua etlawm lam manawh jel in,
Bah lou in machiang suan jel ni;
Simlei ah lungmuanna omlou,
Toupa siang tuang i tun mateng.
Khaubang sutsiam hileng phatchim kei ning,
Jin dougal lai ah leng zong leng;
Van mun thupi tun hun chiang in,
Phatna zaila dai nawnlou ding.
Aw van Laukha Siangthou hong leng inla,
Lailung khimjing tanvak ding in;
Na gamnuam ah tuang hon tun in,
Nunnop pallai heu louhna ah.

Ka Pa na hi, Ka Pathian ngei na hi,
Gam vangla khelhna sal a ka tan lai,
Na hehpihna simthupha tuang hong tung,
Hong sulhei in kong tan zouta, chiin.
Na hehpihna thupiak zuih zaw,
Kisik om ngeilou uhi Toupa;
Leia mi leh van mi dong in.
Aw Toupa Na hon vualjawlna phate,
Nang sang in zatam in ngaina zaw uh;
Taksap vang a khitui a dai lai' zong,
Na gam leh dikna'n kei hon gamlat ke'n.
Nang ngei Jesu ka hon neih leh,
Bangdang ka ngai ding hiam aw Toupa;
Bangkim a ka bangkim na hi.
Nopna zong in sang tampi vialtai uh,
Mulou in han mial ah mangthangta uh;
Thupina lim a delh uh mei lim bang,
Mu leh tang te'n zong nei denlou uhi.
Nang ngei Jesu neih tak nahi.
Tangtawn dong a thupi leh hoih semsem;
Lei leh van a vualjawlna pha.

Ka thou ding a ka Pa sianglam vajuan ve ning,
Ka machiang lummei bang a jing;
Anbang hon it singdang omlou nuai simlei ah,
Ka Pa loungal ka dougal hi.
Gilou in heisan mahleng,
A hoihna tul ngeilou;
Lunghei in A siang zong leng,
A vang ka jou nawn ding.
Ka Pa' inn ah hauhsakna kim, nunnopna kim,
Albang dahte heh A nem jel;
Kei vuaktang leh laisung gilkial ka si ding maw,
Bangdia lelliang bang vai ka hiam?
Aw, A nen a ka hei laiin nunnuam na'ng e,
Simlei nunnop ka zon tengteng;
Ka Pa' insung ngaina veng e, gel chingtang e,
Thupha tawi ding hilou ka hiam?
Kei migilou, lungkhamsak leh zahlaksakpa,
Kei ding a mun A hon phal leh;
Simlei pallun ka dougalte ngai nawn kei ning,
A lut lai hun a tom lua hi.

Kalvari a itna lamdang pen,
Vanmang vontawi Kros ah duang kikhai;
Ka khelhna tengteng pua in hong si,
A sisan vangin ngaihdan ka hi ta.
Lei mi a piang van mi'n na hon bawl a,
Kalvari ah itna a lamdang lua;
Na hotdamna lel zong hun ahih lai,
Lei vualjawlna zong na hon guan lai maw?
Gengen leng zong genzou ngei kei ning,
Sasa leng zong sa chim kei ning e;
Lei zoulou ding hiai itna simthu,
Sut zoulou ding mihing pilna in zong.
Kei lei hinna a bei mateng in,
Hon zang jelin na Lalgam a di'n;
Mite dia vualjawlna hithei di'n,
Khattang hon nusia lou aw ka Toupa.

Kalvari a Na hon itna,
Tui bang a hong luang in,
Kei mikhial, gamdai gamkeu, guamse mun ah,
Nem ngii ngei in a hongluang a,
A tung ah ginna long lepdan siam theikei veng.
Leppihpa Laukha ka ngai,
Leppihpa Laukha ka ngai e,
Noa long Leppihpa Laukha ka ngai.
Toupa, Zion paina lampi,
Laukha huai louh in zaw;
Sinlai heksiam vang a kua tuangtung thei ding?
Toupa khaubang hong chiah thei ke'ng,
Na pilna leh ka siamna kiton louh vang in.
Toupa, Na banjal hat ngak in,
Khelhna tuipi tung ah;
Donding neilou naungek bang in ka om a,
Na hon itna a hong tung a,
Ka ginna bangjel in nuam in ka omjel hi.
Ka Hondampa ka Mang Jesu,
Tuibang a honglet chiang;
Ka haksatna leh buaina a tummang dia,
Anbang A itna'n hon hum dia,
A nen a tutkhawl di'n A hon pilutta ding.

Kha Siang, Nang pitu muanhuai!
Kristian kiang-a nai gige,
Khut-a len in honpi in,
Gamdai a khualzin lai in;
Tawlte kipak gige uh,
Aw nem-a huau a zak un,
'Vakvai, hong in, hong jui in,
Inn tun pha in konpii ding'.
Chikpeuh a om lawm dik pen,
Honpanpih dia nai gige;
Mial lakah hon nusia ken,
Lau leh ging lah a vai in;
Huihpi a lau, lam-et bei,
Aw nem penin hon huau in,
'Vakvai, hong in, hong jui in,
Inn tun phain konpii ding'.
Sepgim nite bei chiangin,
Tawldamna nuam ngaklai in,
Van leh thumna lel kisam,
Tua lai kou min om muangin,
Tuithuk pal, Jesu' sisan
Kia suanga om hong huau in,
'Vakvai hong in, hong jui in,
Inn tun phain konpii ding'.

Sunchin in tua gam etlawm omdan ka ngaihtuah,
Tung sunni tum chiangin ka tung ding;
Hehpihna ziaka Hondampa kiang ka din chiang,
Ka manglukhu aksi’n ajem diam?
Ka manglukhu aksi’n, aksi in ajem diam?
Ka damlai sunni a tum chiangin;
Khawlna inn nuam a tatsate toh ka thoh chian,
Ka manglukhu aksi’n ajem diam?
Toupa hatna ah thum kawmin ka sem dinga,
Kha mangthangte man di’n ka vil ding;
Ni thupi tun chia aksi tangpha keia ding,
Phatna la tuipi bang a mau chian.
Aw A mel ka muh chian, bangchi nop tading hiam,
A khebul a suangmantam ngain?
Sana khopi ah ka nopna kimta ding hi,
Ka manglukhu aksi’n ajem ding.

Lailung juan ni'n don kimvel veng,
Hiai leitung gam kikhenna mun;
Lungkham meipi in mualchin bawm,
Ka laukha lungkham in a vai.
Aw, honpi in damlai,
Lungkham meipi bang jing nuai ah;
Hon ompih in aw ka Toupa,
Naubang kahlai bang ning.
Aw, ka lunggulh aksi khen gam,
Angel siang lungtuakte lenna;
Kei selung juang naubang kahna,
Lungkham meipi bang jing nuai ah.
Aw, ka laukha, na lungkhamna,
Leitung dahna tuangnung sia in;
Khuva bang in valeng inla,
Nunnopna gam van khopi ah.
Tua ah lungkham kah leh buaina,
Om nawnlou ding, thangvan gam ah;
Aw, Hondampa, hon pi jel in,
Phamna chiaugal gam nunnuam ah.

Lamtawnin Jesu ka jui jel ding,
A hon itpa ahih manin;
Ka hondampa dia ka pomtak jiakin,
Lamtawnin Jesu ka jui jel ding.
Lamtawnin Jesu ka jui jel ding,
Van-gam hon tunpih ding chih ka thei hi;
Thupina tawh A hongpai nawn chiangin,
Tangtawnin A kiangah ka khawl ding.
Lamtawnin Jesu ka jui jel ding,
Haksatna huihpi hongnung zong;
A hatna thagui ka lenden ding a,
Ka khelhna paisan in ka jui ding.
Lamtawnin Jesu ka jui jel ding,
Kha Siangthou in honpi ding hi;
Hon hihsiangthou hi, Amah bang dingin,
Van-gam ah hihthupi ka hi ding.
Lamtawnin Jesu ka jui jel ding,
Mite'n hon simmoh mah lezong;
Ka Hondampa dia ka pomtak ziakin,
Tangtawnin A kiangah ka khawl ding.

Laukha Siangthou, khuva bang nem,
Hong leng nawn in, hon ngai ung;
Hon halhsak nawn in mipi a bahte,
Mualliam louin hong kik nawn in.
Aw hon ngai ung e, Laukha nunnem,
Nangmah louin mipite lammang uh;
Pi nawn inla aw Jingdam Solnou,
Zion, nopna lam siangthou ah.
Ngaidih, Toupa Na tatsate'n,
A tangtawn tuanglam haih uh;
Lei Belamchingten lah pi theilou uh,
Bangchin hita ding hiam, Toupa?
Laukha Siangthou, Nang Na om chiang',
Lei lungkhamna a nem jel;
Sual huihpi leh khemna gal lian zong leh,
Na min phat in zaila sa ning.
Jesu nunnem hong gen nawn in,
Lungkham tak a Na thuakna;
Theisak inla, aw, Na linglukhu tawh,
Na lungjinna lamdang lua tawh.

Laukha Siangthou, meikuang leh meipi a Pipa,
Mang Immanuel hong nai nawn in;
Gamdai suk leh tou a ka vaih lai in,
Hong vak nawn in, pialgal,
Jingdam Solnou, vak hoihtak in.
Aw van Aksi, aw van Aksi etlawm,
Ka Hondampa leh Ka Mang deihhuaipen Na hi,
Lungkham tuipi kihawt in gal hong lian zong leh,
Bitna Toupa, kon belding kum khua in.
Suangmanpha dawngkot hoih leh thupi hon hun chiang',
Sana vangkhua tuallai' ka leng dia;
Khelh vang a ka lungkhamnate teng zong,
Gam minthang leh tangtawn mun ah,
Sil bang in a pal ding.
Belamnou manna gam nitum ngeilouhna ah,
Khensate'n simlei ngai nawnlou in;
Zaila'n Belamnou lambang a pak ua,
Hinna tulsing lim nuam ah,
Silhpuan ngou bat in leng uh.

Gentheih dahna kia ahi;
Dougal in hon umkimvel,
Niteng' buaina in hon bawm.
Toupa, Nang ka hon muang hi,
Tung Pathian Mitel Na hi;
Niteng' la ka sa ding a,
Nang kia hon pahtawi ding in.
Bawlhoih thei, Nang hon kem in,
Ka damna'n hon silsiang in;
Huan Na kros ka pahtawi ding,
Thangvan gamnuam tun phain.
Ka damsung in hithei leng,
Nangmah na kia ka sem ding;
Nangdi'n ka kimangzou ding,
Niteng' Nang ka hon pawl ding.
Jesu migi hon jel in,
Hong vak in ka kungtung ah,
Huan Na kros ka pahtawi ding,
Thangvan gamnuam tun phain.

Lun leh mang lamtam vaivut suak thei,
Simlei pallun lai sawlbang heu thei;
Tangbang i damlai ni lenkil hong kia zong leh,
Kumsawt guabang hing Jesu nei hang.
Lili pallun Mang Jesu keia,
Heisa bang pal thangvan gamnuam ah;
Ngaihtamsial albang dahin Aman hon nem,
Lili pallun Mang Jesu keia.
A gam nunnuam sunni bang tang ah,
Jingdam Solnou hon gum Mang Jesu;
Gimthei thuak mahleng hiai leitung lungkhamna ah,
A gamnuam ah tuang A hon tun ding.
Tuin kap in huibang mau zongleng,
Khakiakna dawnbang ka tuah chiang in;
Lunglau kei ning kulsin pan Toupa'n hon phong dia,
Dah leh kahna mittui nulsiang ding.
Lawmvual i ngaihte'n nuai simlei ah,
Tuangnung hon siah chian lungkham ngai ing;
Albang dah kei ning khattang sawlbang ka hei zong,
Lili pallun Jesu'n heh honnem.

Lung honlen galdon chim la'ng e,
Simlei dahna khen gam;
Damlai lungkhamna lummei jing,
Ka pel ding kahna gam.
Lei lungkham luankhi a hul dia,
Naubang ka kahni bei dia;
Aw Toupa melmuh kal ngakla'ng,
Albang mang hen lei chimhuai.
Kalvari ah hongum Toupa'n,
Thangvan dawngkot A hong;
Sihsial bang vajuan in laukha,
Na tangtawn gam a lang.
Ka kahna zanmial a bei ding,
Jordan luigal gam ah;
Aw ka ngaih ka lungdamna pen,
Ngabang a lenna uah.
Aw chikchiang ka tuangtung diam chi'ng,
Tungchiang vangkhua nuam ah;
Sihna luimial ka kan khit chian,
Kahna gam ngai kei ning.

Lungkham dah ni a om,
Lungkham buaini a om;
Hon khutvan uh kipahpih ning,
Pathian' Angelte omna'h.
Pathian' Angelte omna'h,
Gam vangla nunnuam ah;
Nuamsa tak a ka luah hun ding,
Pathian' Angelte omna'h.
Toupa ka hatna hi,
Hon pi tawntung Aksi;
Bit a tua gam hon tun ding in,
Pathian' Angelte omna'h.
Gam vangla nunnuam ah,
Ka luah ding in nuam om;
Tua ah Manglukhu kei din om,
Pathian' Angelte omna'h.
Ka long in innlam juan,
Hon buaisak kan pah ning;
Bit in tua inn ah ka tung ding,
Pathian' Angelte omna'h.

Lau a lingte di’n kros ah mun om,
Nang di’n kros ah mun om;
Tua ah khialte hihdamin om ding,
Nang di’n kros ah mun om.
Mun, mun, kros ah mun om,
Nang di’n kros ah mun om.
Mun, mun, kros ah mun om,
Nang di’n kros ah mun om.
Lungkhamte dingin kros ah mun om,
Nang di’n kros ah mun om;
Mari bangin tanhoihzaw teel in,
Nang di’n kros ah mun om.
Dah leh tawlte di’n kros ah mun om,
Nang di’n kros ah mun om;
Bangdia dah lailai, aw, hongpai ve,
Nang di’n kros ah mun om.

Lungkham mangbang in ka om a,
Ka zuih ding tuanglam mial in sau e;
Tuanglam sau in tawlhuai mahleh,
Limbelh Toupa'n honpii jel.
Ka kinepna, Tungnungpen tongsuak,
Mangbat ni in honsam lechin,
Kon humbit ding a,
Nang non pahtawi ding hi.
Belh ding neilou khattang ka hei,
Nemtu ding omlou zata lai ah;
Chinlou, taklou ka hizong in,
Toupa'n lumbang honsung hi.
Nang Non ompih bang ka lau dia,
Nang ka bitna leh kulhpi muanhuai;
Lailung muanna bukim Na hi;
Honphat ning,hon phat jel ning.

Lungkhamna te’n a hon tuam chiang’n,
Kipahnate a hong bei chiang’n;
Ka zuih siam hilou tuanglam ka zuih lai in,
Ka Toupa in a hon sinsak hi zaw.
Hon pinate ka gel chiang in,
Keimah lemgel in theihsiam a haksa ngei;
Hizong kei a di’n A vualjawlna leh,
Amah muan ding hon sinsak ahi zaw.
Kaan zohlouh a ka ngaihsutte,
Pal zohlouh a ka ngaihsutte;
A muanhuainate ka muhna ding hi zaw,
Amah a di’n a haksa omlou e.
Vuui takmai a ka om in zaw,
Aw a pialpak a lang theilou;
Tua in aw ka lam-etna a bahsak a,
Hizong Aman a pialpak hon musak.
Koimun peuh ah ka om zong in,
Hon pina khut a muanhuai hi;
Keimah hatna zaw muan ding a omlou e,
Amah hatna a muanhuai pen hi zaw.

Lunglai ah aw ka gel chiang in,
Aw ana i gam simthu;
Toupa mel loubang a tul zouta,
Aw lung in i gel ngam diam.
Toupa aw hong leng in,
Ka gam uah nang vaihawm in;
Toupa aw hon ngai ung,
Nanglou in zaw muanna aw a om theilou.
Simlei muanna ka zong jel ua,
Muanna ding a omlou e;
Taikhua val dong a ka sial lai un,
Sial zatam tuibang kang jel.
Aw na mite na hon vel chia'n,
Lung na awina hiam Toupa;
Itna leh lainatna bei zouta,
Toupa aw hon ngaidam in.
U leh naute kingaihsun ni,
Lung i gel a hunta hi;
Ngaihdamna ei a ahihlai in,
Toupa kiang i juan ding uh.

Na tuailai hun in na mihinna bawl;
Na zatdan en inla,
Na lungsim leh deih enchian in.
Na tuailai hun in Pathian thei inla,
Hon Siampa thei in tuailai in.
Tuailai lungsim gilou mi hoihlou suak,
Tuailai lungsim hoihte mihoih hong suak;
Mi hoih a honbawl ding in,
Pathian ta Jesu si ei di'n.
Mi Pathian theite zaw lungmuang in si,
Hiai hi Pathian theihna Jesu Kris neih;
Amah' thupiak zuih chiangin,
Pathian tate chih in i om.

Mikhial ka hi Toupa hon ngaidam in,
Thupha ka hon tawi hi, Na khe bul ah.
Ka kiang a Na om louh leh,
Leitung kei din sihna;
Van zong ka kahna gam ding,
Aw, hon ompih in.
Muanna dang omlou hi nuai simlei ah,
Nang kia ka hon bel ding dougal ma ah.
Gamdai a kumsawt hambang ka vaih nua'n,
Tuin Na aw za in ka hon juan hi.
Tuin Toupa, tuibang hon siangsak in,
Na gam huin melma ka dou sam ding.

Min dang tengteng sang in,
A ngaih pen Mang Jesu hi;
Mawhna apan hong tan,
En in, van mangtutphah ah,
Vai A hawm lel hi.
Ginna'n gal in don leng,
Anbang itna leh nunnop pallun jou in,
Aw lungdeih teng tual a leng diam?
Ka laukha hambang vai,
Na Toupa mu lou na hiam?
En in Zion tate,
Tangtawn gam thupi juan in,
Khaubang chiah uhi.
Mawhna in gam thupi,
Leh ka Toupa mel a liah;
Pialgal tuanglam haih veng,
Lungkham dahna tuibang lian,
Laukha, hon huai in.

Ken bel ka Kros mah pua in ka jui jel ding;
Nisim tha hong guan ding in,
Tou Jesu ka nei zouta,
Suploh kei ning Jesu nung ka zuih man in.
Hon piaksa te bek a lungdam ka hikei hi,
Hongpiak laidingte hang zong A min phat ing;
Tuaman in nisim in ah vualzohna la ka sa ding,
Suploh kei ning Jesu nung ka zuih man in.
Ka kha nuntakna ding in ka muh nailouh vantung,
Gam upna toh tung ding chi a kigenkhol bang;
Pasian hong kamchiam bang in,
Hih leitung nna khempeuh zong,
Hong pia zou hi chi'n upna toh ka muta.

Limbelh Toupa muang un;
Albang dah in mau kei un,
Toupa Kris a ihmute,
Hon pi ding ngoumei lai'h.
Ki lungmuan tuah chiat un, (6)
Ki lungmuan tuah chiat unla,
Hiai thu in.
Na lung uh mangbang kei hen,
Toupa Jesu muang un;
Tu'n khimkhua hong jing zongleh,
Jing taikhua a hong vak chiang'
Hinna A hong pia ding.
Toupa hong tualkum ding hun,
A ni nai donsak un;
Misiangthoute' na sepsak,
Tungchiang thangvan a chiahpa;
Hong tualkum nawn pah ding.

Na mangtutphah leh Na manglukhu non nusia,
Leitung a kei dia Nong pai laiin;
Hizong Beth-lehem inn sung ah mun awnglou,
Nang misiangthou Nong pian nading'.
Hongluah in aw, Jesu, ka lung,
Nang di'n ka lungsung ah mun om;
Hongluah in aw, Jesu, ka lungsung!
Nang di'n ka lungsung ah mun om.
Angelte lasak in vanmun thupi thawn e,
Na Mang thupiakte a phuan lai un;
Hizong Toupa aw, mun niampen ah Nong piang,
Kingaihneuna niam penpen in.
Sihalte'n bukna nei, vasate'n zong bu nei,
Nuai simleia singlim liap lakah;
Hizong Nang Pathian' Tapa jalna gankuang,
Galili ah gam daidam ah.
Hinna thu tawh hongpai chia, Toupa Pathian aw,
Na mite dia salsuahna bawlin;
Hizong simmawh in om chia, linglukhu tawh,
Kalvari ah Nang honpii uh.
Hongluah in aw, Jesu, ka lung,
Nangma' kros kia ahi ka suan;
Hongluah in aw, Jesu, ka lungsung!
Nangma' kros kia ahi ka suan.
Thangvan zaila sak chiang' mualchih gamchih thawn ding,
Vualzoua Nang na hongpai nawn chiang';
Non sapna aw za ning e, aw ka Toupa,
Nang di'n ka kiang' mun om honchi'n.
Ka lung nuam ding, Toupa Jesu,
Hongpai a kei nong sap chiang in;
Ka lung nuam ding, Toupa Jesu aw,
Hongpai a kei nong sap chiangin.

Na thupina gen in gen vual hilou,
Aw a vanglian Toupa nang na min lian hi;
Van Angel sangsawmte'n,
Phat la ngaihtak in na kim ah leng uh.
Vangletna leh minthanna,
Thupina leh pahtawina;
Zahtakna teng vaihawmna teng Nang a,
Na siangthou Na siangthou hi Toupa;
Tangtawn in thupina Nang ahi.
Nang phatna la tangtawn in sa nuam ing,
Nang phatna ka kha ah dim leh ka nuam hi;
Na mai a hong kun in,
Pahtawina leh Thupina ka hon pia.
A hoih khempeuh keia nong hisak a,
Na kilawmna khempeuh kei ah nong koih hi;
Na hoihna a lian lua,
Halleluijah Halleluijah Amen.

Na vangletna vual in gen e,
Zion tung Pathian vangkhua;
A simthu chiam pel ngeiou Pa'n,
A omna di'n A hon bawl;
Khuambang kip suangpi a kinga,
Bang in a hihling ding hiam?
Hotdamna kulh a ki um in,
Lei dougal i lau ding hiam?
Hotdamna kulh a ki um in,
Lei dougal i lau ding hiam?
En in, tung Pathian hon itna,
Hinna ding in tuisik luang;
Na tate'n huailai hon juan uh,
Gilkial leh dangtak omlou;
Huailai ah hinna tuisik luang,
Kua hiam dangtak a thum ding?
Toupa'n A deih chibang a tel,
Kikhasiatna tawp lou ding.
Toupa'n A deih chibang a tel,
Kikhasiatna tawp lou ding.
A vankho doh tam kimvel in,
Vangletna bitna ding in;
Meikuang leh meipi hong kilang,
Toupa mel a theih nang un;
Tua meipi leh meikuang ziak in,
Mun nuampen mel in mu uh;
Nun nopna'n mana a muang ua,
Toupa'n amau a piak hi.
Nun nopna'n mana a muang ua,
Toupa'n amau a piak hi.
Toupa Zion vangkho nunnuam,
Luah din chibang non tel a;
Khovel in hon pampaih mahleh,
Na min kia ka suang ding hi;
Khovel nunnop mangthang jel hi,
A thupi leh etlawmna;
Zion tate chibang tel te'n,
Kumsawt nun nopna mel mu.
Zion tate chibang tel te'n,
Kumsawt nun nopna mel mu.

Ngai un,zatam lelliangte aw,
Thianmang vontawi Jesu simthu;
Lengvan tualnuam tuangnungsiah a,
Kalvari tulsing lel a hong pham.
Kulsin pan zuangthou lim in dang,
Thianmang vontawi ngalliam Jesu;
A sakmin ngaih, min ngaih tungnungpen,
Vanglian Toupa leh Kris.
Phammohna doh-ai tawi Jesu,
Simlei, thangvan ah vualtungtuang;
Laukha zatam albang mang ding,
Gitva bang hong in,salbang suah e.
Nuai zinmang laihen zatamte,
Lengvan kai ding lung a gulhte'n,
Limbelh Lal Jesu Kris juan a,
Siktui leh laukha a pianthak ding.

Ni tum ngeilou Zion khopi,
Ngai in ka mau ka kap sun nichin in;
Tatsate leng uh silhpuan piandang tawh,
Kei di'n zong mun om hiam tua gam nuam ah.
Ngaina veng e, ngaina veng e,
A mun thupi nibang lunlai sang in;
Anbang hon it Mang Kris mel etlawmnou,
Mu nuam veng albang dah ka banna ding.
A gam etlawmdan genseng louh,
Sisan in a hongta zalenna gam;
Ka laukha tua gamnuam galdon jel in,
Simlei pallun loubang hong tul ding hi.
Lungdeih Hondampa lenna mun,
Tuangtun louh ding lunglau veng Mang Jesu;
Sisan in hon sil in Laukha in honhuai in,
Mang nunnem' gam pen mah ngaina veng e.
Sisan a loubang N'on khualna,
Khuambang luah a Na pallun jou ding in;
Na vanglian lim sawlbang bel nuam veng e,
Simlei pallun sun naubang awiawi veng.

Ni tumna vakna khenlam ah,
Van meipi kai khen ah,
Van aksi a vaklouhna ah,
Tunglam ah inn ka nei.
Khut a lamlouh, huai a innpi,
Kei din mun bawlsa om;
Pathian leh angelte' omna,
Huai inn kei inn ding hi.
Natna, lungkhamna khenlam ah,
Hin haksatna khen ah;
Hun leh lamdanna beina mun,
Ka inn in hon ngak hi.
Sihna tui kihawt khenlam ah,
Hiai zan khawmial khen ah;
Ka kha'n kipak kawm in a en,
Tua a vakna innpi.
Gitlou, dah, hehna leh buaina,
Mang un, ka chita a;
Tangtawn in tunglam van mun ah,
Kris ka Toupa kiang ah.

Nunlui liamsa ka gel jel a,
Ka phawk kik jel tualniam ka hinkhua;
Ka phu lel in hon pi lechin,
Ka tang zou diam ka tu dinmun.
Kipahna genseng louh ka nei Toupa,
Na vualjawlna ka tan vang in aw;
A omlai ding ka kipahna,
Ka tanlai ding vualjawlna omte ah.
Van daitui in Na honluan a,
Ka na ah lei vualjawlna non pia;
Ka neih haichi tangkhat lel zong,
A leh za in na pungsakta.
Na honpi dan a lamdang ngei,
Ka hihna bangmah a hilou zong;
Mi a simtaak hi lou mah leng,
Na honpi lut mihing lai ah.
Leivui pan in na honpi khia,
Na pal jou in a sangzaw sem ah;
Sim zohlouh vualjawlna mu dia,
Na hopi zaw a lamdang lua.

Nuntom pakpalh bang lel ka simlei,
Tangbang damlai hun leh nite;
Vulpah ding hizong leh,
Pal zatam te'n Toupa pampaih in,
Simlei pallunte jou zong leh,
Ken bel Toupa di'n zang ning e.
Toupa aw hong sang in ka pallutnate,
Hatlou zong leh,
Nang a ding in hong pia ing e.
Toupa aw hong sang in ka pallutnate,
Hatlou zong leh,
Nang a ding in hong pia ing e.
Anbang itna simthu hemlam a naubang,
A sangte vaang in maw, Na mel englou zong leh;
Silpak etlawm namtui a leng hiauhiau,
Bang in maw kei zong Toupa,
Na gim ka duang ah theng lou ding.

Pathian in a thilsiamte a et et chiangin,
A lungkim mahmah hi, hoih asa mahmah hi;
Hizong pasal amah kia a om a etin,
Hoihsalou in numei panpihtu ding pia hi.
Hiai ahi kitenna, hiai ahi kitenna,
Pathian in a gawmsa mihing in khen kei hen,
Khenlou dia tong chiamsa,
Sian in lumbang honsung jel hen.
Vondeih zatam tawi a siangsung phungching dingin,
Houlungtuak tangbang dam nunnuam ngabang leng din;
Tung Thianmang vanglian in lumbang honsung jel hen,
Itna tongchiam simthu hualkhau khihkip den hen.
Tanglai Kana khua a na tel bangin Toupa,
Taksap teng hongguan din hongngai ung hongleng in;
Lungkham dah leh taksap hun hongtung jel mahleh,
Hiai kitenna siangthou pahtawiin omjel hen.

Pi leh pu suihlung a mawl ziak',
Phamna leh lungkham dahnate,
Namchih tung ah a leng ua;
Ka tung ah khuaibang a tu,
Lungkham huibang in ka mau.
Kumsawt gam ka ngai e,
Ka ngai e ka Pa' gamnuam,
Laukha in hon huai in;
Anbang itte khawlna mun,
Tuang hon tun in.
Khovel nun ka ngaihtuah chiang in,
Suihlung a mawl selung a jing;
Phamsa'n lenmual a khum ua,
Bangteng selunggel a hun,
Lungkham dahna tuibang lian.
Vual ngaih mualliamsate don veng,
Phamsa ngaiin malbang kou veng;
Nungchiang heilou in leng uh,
Mangtutphah din kimvel in,
Halleluijah, chi'n leng uh.
Van khopi thak tuang ka tun chiang',
Gibang khenna omnawn lou ding;
Lungtuak vuitangbang kimna,
Angel siang Serafim tawh,
Mang nunnem zaila'n awi ni.

Pialgal ka ngai, ka Mang lenna,
Lungkham omlouhna gam etlawm;
Chikchiang ka tung ding hiam?
Albang ka dahna luankhi,
Chikchiang' a hul ding hiam?
Chi a ka ngaihtuah in,
Ka ngaih Toupa'n kei honpi in.
Guabang hinna singlim liap ah,
Hon khawlsak sam ve, aw Toupa;
Khemna tangnisa ka dou zoulou,
Guabang hinna singlim liap ah,
Hon khawlsak sam ve, aw Toupa.
Leitung haksatna thuakzoute,
A tung uah puanin na jak maw?
Kei zong hong jakkhum in;
Khawlna ding limliap omlou,
Leitung gamdai gam ah khawlna limliap omlou,
Khemna tangnisa dou la'ng e.
Nuai simlei gamkeu gamdai ah,
Khawlna om hiam chi'n ka zong a;
Khawlna gam ahi lou,
Tangtawn gam ding hilou hi;
Simlei gimhuai ahi chih ka theihkhiak chiang in,
Guabang hinna singlim ngai veng.
Guabang hinna singlim liap ah,
Misiangthoute a khawlta uh;
Kei pen bang ka hi hiam,
Tawlnga theilou a ka om?
Ka sapum in hon dal, hihlamdang ni tung leh,
Kei zong khawlsamta ding hi'ng a.

Hiai lei i khawlmun leh i inn hilou,
Khovel hongom ding juana zin hihang;
I damsung ni tawmchik hongtawp pah ding,
Leia i mun taisan in i leng tou ding.
Aw, inn i tun hun ding sawtnawn lou ding,
Sihna om nawn lou, buaina tungta lou;
Puakgik pua a haambang vaihna omlou,
Van inn nuam ah Kris toh om tawntungta ding.
Tunglam a inn ngai in mitmei suan hang,
It leh ngaih sihna in hon khen chiangin;
Khopi kilawm lungsim mitkha’n mu hang,
Kikhenna beita ding tunglam van inn ah.
Toupa’n A bawlkholh van a inn manpha,
A Laibu sunga min tuangte a ding;
Toupa hong painawnna ding lunggulh hang,
I kituahkhawm hun ding tunglam van inn ah.

Sakmin ngaih a hawmsiam pen Vanglian tung Pathian,
Simleitung leh thangvan ah min ngaihpen na hi;
Koute dia a hoih tawntung limbelh tung Pathian,
Min ngaihpen a Vanglian Nang Na hi.
Min ngaihpen a Vanglian pen Toupa hong phat ung,
Koute dia ka Pathian uh, Thupipen Na hi;
Khang suangpi a bei ngeilou Toupa Nang Na hi,
Sutseng louh na min ngaih hina e.
Damloute, misite zong damsak thei Na hi,
Guhkeute a dia hinna pia thei pa Na hi;
Thil bangkim na bawl thei a, bangkim Nang Na hi,
Thupi pen a Vanglian hong phat ung.
Na hoihna a honglang jel Na mite a di’n,
Nisim a ka taksap uh hong pia jel Pathian;
Khattang hon nusia ngeilou hon ompih Na hi,
Nang it bang a hon it omlou e.

Sian lemgeel hinkhua ka tuahte,
Sian phallouh theihpihlou omlou;
A honpi dan ka theisiam lou zong,
A honpi tu ken ka theichian hi,
Jehovah Toupa'n kei hon pi hi.
Nang lemgeel a thil hong tungte,
Na phal hang a ka tuahjelte;
Banghang hihiam chin lel uh,
Ka kungtung a tung khempeuhte,
Sian in a phal hang a tung hi e.
Nang lemgeel a thilhong tungte,
A hang tua theih lung ka lawplou;
Sihna apan nong humbit den pen,
Bang hang hihiam bang ding a nong deih,
Nong deih na theih lung ka lawp zaw hi.
Ka khualzinna ka zoh chiang in,
Hinkhua ka tuah haksatna te;
A ziak a hang ka theichianlou zong,
Bukim a theihchetna gam tung in,
Nopna bukim toh Sian min phat ning.

Simlei ah zaw khemna leh,
Gitlouhna bei lou ding,
Sunchin in khemin ka om gige;
Ka mitmuh leh bil a ka zakte in,
Khelhna ah hon tun.
Hizong ka Toupa' hehpihna thupi in,
Gilou kisik ngaidam;
Kisik, kiheiin kon juan, Toupa (2)
Ka gitlouh ngaidam in.
Anbang A hon it vang in,
Hing leh dam in i om;
Hizong A itna thei kei nak hang,
Kalvari a tatna ngailou bang in,
Leipal i pak uh.
Simlei hoihnate khempeuh,
Tangtawn a ching zoulou;
Hizong a etlawmna zong nak hang,
Nuai simlei ah nuam in ka leng zong a,
Mangthang ka na hi.
Mangthangte zong a hondam,
Ding in Mang Jesu in,
Hehpih in hon zong liangvai tate;
Sual sihna mial nuai a na kimangte,
Thounawnta ve ni.

Simlei ah zaw khualtaam lel ka hi a,
Ki sapna ngen hi bukimna omlou;
Lungsiknate leh lungngaihna te in,
Ka lampi a ding in lingbang a hon sun.
Inn ka tun chiang’n van inn nuam ka tun chiang’n,
Leitung lungkhamnate a beita ding;
Gimtak leh bahtak a ka puak van-gikte,
Ka pa inn ka tun chiang in a beita ding.
Simlei ah gou manphate neilou in,
Vuallel tak in simlei ah leng zong leng;
Thangvan ka tun chiang’n ka gou manpha leh,
Vualzohna in tua ah kei hon na ngak hi.
Khatvei leh lungkiatnate’n a hon tuam,
Ka hinna zong bah in a ngui sak jel;
Tuni’n ka nuam zong, zingchiang ka dahna,
Lungnop kisinna kia’n sunni ka tum jel.

Simlei ah zaw khualzin ka hi,
Ka khualzinna a bei mateng;
Simlei hinna ka khit chiang in,
Van khopi a lengta ding.
Van khopi a ka len chiang in,
Ka khualzinna a bei chiang in;
Lungdon kahna Aigupta zaw,
Ngai nawn lou ding van gam ah.
Simlei ah zaw khualzin ka hi,
Siatna tuipi kihot lai ah;
Khemna huihpi bang in a nung,
Toupa nang hon panpih in.
Simlei ah zaw khualzin ka hi,
Ka khualzinna sawt nawnlou ding;
Ka khualzinna ka khit chiang in,
Van khopi a lengta ding.

Sian anglai ah mun muangta ding a;
Gim gentheihna teng ngilhta ding a,
Khen nawnlou ding it leh ngaih teng toh.
Hinna singliim nuai ah khawl denta ni,
Hih leitung hong bei chiang'n,
Mubang ngaikei ning tulsa simlei,
Sian anglai ah tuang i tun chiang in.
Naubang kahna gam tuang nung siah leng,
Tung thangvan gam saumang nunnuam ah;
Angel siangte toh houlung tuak in,
Leng diamdiam ta ni thangvan gam ah.
Thangvan gamnuam tuang i tun chiang in,
Gibang khenna om nawnlou ding a,
Lungjuan nat leh sat ngilhta ding a;
Phatna tullou ding tangtawn dong in.

Simlei tuangnung siah le'ng,
Nungchiang hei nawn lou in;
Nuam a pai masaten,
Pialgal gamnuam ah hon ngak uh,
Tangtawn nopna mun ah.
Kahna leh lungkhamna,
Simlei ka tenna gam;
Lungtuak lenna Zion tanga,
I len hun ding ngakla'ng.
Toupa aw, hon en dih,
Ka bualna uh simlei,
Gamdai lungkhamna hi;
Sihna in lawmvual hon khen nak,
Na gam tun ma in zaw.
Lunmang Immanuel,
Khopi Zion ah zaw,
Gibang khen om nawnlou;
Tua ah lungkham liangvai tate,
Dawnbang tuah kal ngakla'ng.

A palh kiksa daitui te bangzah in etlawm;
Zion mualtung a Hermon daitui chiim bang,
Etlawm Kalvari kros kei a hi.
Kei nuamlua ing Toupa aw
K'ong muantheih nuamlua ing
Ka thei gige ka gumpa nang na hi
Bangzah ta'n ka nuam diam
Na mai k'ong muh hun chiang
Gen ning gengen ning sa sa ning
Hih thu mahmah Zion mualtung ah
Hermon daitui chiim bang
Etlawm Kalvari kros kei a hi.
Tualai ah hong luang ka moh ngaihdamna si,
Gensiam leng aw sutsiam leng maw hih thu mahmah;
Mite'n simmoh in chilphih gawp mahle uh,
Kei di'n etlawm kros pua hi lailai.

Ka tuanglam khimbang jing in;
Ka ginna malneu mahleh,
Toupa kia ka honlen ding hi.
Sunni chin a muan Toupa,
Sun leh zan a muan Toupa;
Chikmah in ngilh theikei ning,
Toupa Jesu nung jui jel ning.
Tung Pathian' Khasiangthou in,
Ka lungsung a sunvak hi;
Koimun ah leng laulou in,
Toupa Jesu nung jui jel ning.
Nopna mun a la sa in,
Dahna mun a thuak jel in,
Sihna manna kal ah leng,
Toupa Jesu nung jui jel ning.
Ka damlai ni bei masang,
Simlei albang man masang;
Thangvan tuang ka tun mateng,
Toupa Jesu nung jui jel ning.

Tangthu Pha thu lamdang,(3)
Lung in gel dih ua;
Hiai tangbang damlai hun,
Lung a gel leh hih hun ahi;
Sual ngaihdamna thu ahi,
Sihnung thawhnawnna thu lungdamhuai pen hi.
Aw hun kipelhsak ken.
Tua pan kum za nung chiang',(3)
Koilai na om diam?
Hiai tangbang damlai hun,
Lung a gel leh hih hun ahi;
Simlei tuangnung na siah dia,
Van leh gawtmun ah bang na suakta ding hiam?
Deihzawk tel hun ahi.
Mi gen van saumang ah,(3)
Mun na tangta hiam?
Hiai tangbang damlai hun,
Lung a gel leh hih hun ahi;
Tua a mun na tan kei leh,
Gawtmun leh sihna mun nang a hi lailai,
Aw, na kingaihtuah in.

Khelhna nuaisiah khate hong un,
Toupa zahngaihna om;
Aman khawlna honpe ding hi,
Amah’ thu gingta un.
Amah muang un (2)
Tu’n Amah muang un;
Hon gum ding hi (2)
Tu’n hon hondam ding.
Jesu’n A sisan manpha pia,
Vualjawlna manpha pen;
A sisan ah tuin bualin,
Vuk bangin sawpsiang hi.
Jesu Thudik, Lampi A hi,
Khawlna a hon pitu;
A thu mangin zekai louin,
Vangphatna kim tang di’n.
Hong un, juan un thupina toh,
Pawl siangthoute jui un;
Van tung gam nuama teng dingin,
Tangtawn a nuamsa ding.

Thangvan sang a Toupa Jesu,
Lungkham, genthei nopna Toupa;
Simlei gimhuai teng thuak zou in,
Ei din Toupa A hong vakvai.
Lamdang na e! lamdang na e!
Na hon itna a na lua hi;
Kou dia Na thuakna Kalvari,
Gen thei kei veng , Toupa Jesu.
Simlei ah lungnopna omlou,
Kap leh mau in albang mang veng;
Hizong itna mel lungdamhuai,
Kou ding' Kris na hong paita hi.
Lungkham buaina chiau tuipi lian,
Pal ngam kei veng ka Hondampa;
Anbang itna Kha Siangthou in,
Simlei gimhuaina beisak in.
Khebaite khe in paita uh,
Phakte siansak in omta uh;
Piangsualte'n pianthakna mu uh,
Misite kaihthawh in om uh.
Gentawp thei kei veng, aw Toupa,
Hon ngai tawp thei kei veng Toupa;
Ka lungsung mial hong vaksak in,
Itna lui luang hon musak in.
Anbang non itna pal jou ning,
Ka laukha bah hih halh jel in;
Simlei buaina' ka len sung in,
Laukha'n hambang honhuai jel in.

Thianmang anglai tuibang siang ah,
Sihna vontawi tutkhawl ding;
Tuamun ah lamdang sa ding uh,
Gawtmun mei a pawtna uh.
Pathian phatna (2)
Thangvan ah tawpnawn lou ding. (3)
Mawhna pan hon tatkhiak ziak in,
Hondampa Toupa Jesu,
Tangtawn mun nuam tuangtun chiang in,
Lasa in phat tawntung ding.
Semgua tumte (2)
Thangvan ah dai nawnlou ding. (3)
Mihing lungsim a lut ngeilou,
Mit muh louh, bil a zak louh;
Toupa'n amah itte adia,
A bawl khuambang luah ding uh.
Nunkhawnopna (2)
Tangtawn in uang semsem ding. (3)
Pathian mai a puan ngou silh in,
Sun, zan zom in om ding uh;
Gilkial dangtak thuak nawnlou in,
Nunnop kim jouta ding uh.
Ngaihtam sialna, (2)
Tangtawn in thuak ngeilou ding. (3)
Jerusalem Thak nunnuam ah,
Khakiak, nat, lusun, lungdon;
Albang dah zaitha tawl lou in,
Enchim lou ding Etlawmnou.
Toupa' itna, (2)
Bang lou in lambang pak ding. (3)

Toupa a omte dingin bangkim a hauhna hi,
Itna ah zong itna lian semsem,
Zawnna ah zong hauhna thupi pen,
Toupa a neite a di'n.
Nang na omna nuam,
Nang na om na a nuam hi,
Toupa aw ka siang uah hong om in,
Nang toh ton in pai leng,
Bangkim a muanna,
Toupa na om na nuam hi.
Lemna leh muanna gam zaw Toupa a neite hi,
Huatna leh kidanna om ngeilou,
Ei a din i gam a din damna,
Toupa a hong om chiangin.
Sum leh pai hauhna, pilna, siamna leh sanna te,
Manna ding a omlou na omlouh le,
Hinna khempeuh sang na manpha zaw,
Toupa na om leh nuam hi.

Toupa aw kong ngen hi na khut in honlen in,
Na itna hoihna muthei gige di'n;
Simlei lungngaihna leh dahna  natna lakah,
Nanga muanna  kha'n hong dimsak jelin.
Nang lou in muanna omlou,
Nang lou in damna omlou;
Nang lou in ngaihdamna omlou,
Muanna suangpi nahi, tangtawn hinna nahi,
Khamuanna nanga om mite hampha.
Simlei miza laiah, muanna pethei omlou,
Sum leh pai Pilna Siamna haute zong;
Lunglen Lungmuang theilou simlei thawmhau den ah,
Khamuanna nanga om mite hampha.
Chitna khatzong neilou, hoihna khatzong neilou,
Na itna lian in sang hi Toupa aw;
Man ngenlou a hinna hongpia Pathian hoih aw,
Nuamlua ing natungah lungdam lua ing.

Toupa aw na hon itnate ka suiseng lou,
Na thupi dan ka genseng lou;
Lamdang lua hi nong itna thupi lua sang e,
Sutseng in ka genseng ngeikei ding.
Mikhial mangthang sa si ding
Tangtawn hinna hong pia
Mangthang sa tangtawn hinna hong pia
Na van hauhsaknate nong koppih lai
Na angsung ah tawldam ing
Mikhial mangthang sa si ding
Tangtawn hinna hong pia
Mangthang sa tangtawn hinna hong pia
Na van hauhsaknate nong koppih lai
Na angsung ah tawldam ing
Na siang ah lungkhamna leh dahnate omlou,
Lungmuang tawldam a om denta ding;
Tawlchiang a khawlna leh ka muanna Toupa aw,
Na min thupi pen hen aw Toupa.
Na hon khotuahnate te leh na hon itna in,
Na siang tunkal lung lawpsak hi;
Huaisiam leh pitu nunnem hon chingtu Toupa,
Hong it ing hong ngailua ing Pa aw.

Toupa hiai leitung khomial ah,
Jingsol aksi bang taangin,
Na tatna sisan pha vangin,
Tangtawn nunnop hinna pia'n.
Aw Toupa solnou bangtaangin,
Tuipi galgam gamla ah,
Nang non itna simthu hoihpen,
A thawn a piakna chiam hi.
Khomialna mun hiai leitung ah,
Misi dingte nang gum in,
Kumbei, nibei, hunbei beita,
Awlmoh in aman ma un.
Na thu chiam thupi leh siangthou,
Gospel simthu lel unla,
Huan nakiang uah ka om jel ding,
Chi-a na thuchiam hilh in.

Lungkham hun in hong huh a,
Amah kiang a,abel mite,
Aman limtak hong kem hi.
Hong phat ning maw Toupa hong phat ning,
Na vangletna lamdang si (Halleluiah);
Thuk in zai veh;Lamdang nong itna,
Ka belh suangpi Tou Jesu.
Lungsim tamkham, Lamet beite,
Meigong tagah gentheite;
Leivui pan in hong laamtou a,
Jesu hong itna bek hi.
Kha siangthou mit hong vaksakta,
Itna khut toh hong len a;
Kei nong sap leh kong dawng ding a,
Ka thusim kong hilh ding hi.

Pathian hat, thilbangkim thei Pa,
A lampi, theihvuallouh;
Aman thil hoihteng gel khia hi,
A hehpihna’n zou jel.
Amah koimunpeuh ah om hi,
Ka totna lam peuh ah;
Pathian chitna-kepna kheng in,
Ka na paimang ngeikei hi.
A thu ah Amah ka mu thei,
Ginglelin lau kei ning;
Toupa’n ka kalsuante pi jel,
Pi ding A khut nai hi.
Ze-etna’n ka kha khou lou ding,
Pathian’n hon nuselou;
Khemna a ka suahtakna ding,
Lampi hon bawlsak ding.
Hun hongtung dingin kei honsam,
Pathian in buai beisak;
Enin ka ma ah Amah pai,
Ka lam hon bawlsak ding.

Toupa ka hong kipia nang a ding in,
Na khut sung ah ka om hon zang in aw;
Ka siamna omlou zong ka pilna omlou zong,
Ka nunna tualniam zong hong sang in aw.
Hong sang inka nunna Toupa aw,
Na min thupina di’n hon zang in;
Ka hihna bangbang in nang in hon pom ila,
Na deihna mun peuh ah hon zang in aw.
Ki manna ding omlou ka hizong in,
Hoih ding na chihna peuh ah hong koih in;
Bellei a seekpa in a deihbang a bawl bang,
Kei zong hong bawl in aw na deih bang in.
Mihing in a et bang hon enlou aw,
Mihing in a telbang hon tellou aw;
Nang in a hatloute nangawn na tel zaw a,
A hatlou keimah zong hong sang in aw.

Toupa na omna deihhuai hinah e,
Nang omna ah khimkhua jing ngeilou;
Na siang ah ngabang leng nuam ing e,
Nuai jinmang in palbang hon nang.
Toupa, na siang ah hong leng nuam ing e,
Muikhawjin in thilhingte'n hon phat;
Kei zong Toupa, na omna ngai in.
Zion Pathian mai' khukdin ing.
Toupa, muikhawjin in hon ompih in,
Ka hinna hon bawlhoihsak jel in;
Gitlouhna puan inn a ka om sung,
Aw Jesu, sawnban honkai in.
Toupa, kong thumna na bil hon dawh in,
Sunni tum in kon samsam ngal a;
Sepaihte Toupa, koi' om na hiam?
Galdouna ah hon panpih in.
Toupa, galzou a na kiang kong chiah chiang',
Na dikna nivak hoihtak mai ah;
Belamnou thahsa thounawn, angel,
Siangte tawh phat kal ngaklah ing.

Toupa Pathian aw na hoihna ka mu,
Vualjawlna lampite ah na honpi;
Lam-etna khen gam ah na honpi lai,
Manpha in thupi lua.
Non vualjawlna simseng ahi lou,
Na honpi dan suut seng a hilou;
Kei leh ka innkuan bang hiam ka hih uh,
Hiai tantan a Na honpi.
Ahun ahun in Na hoihna hong tung,
Koi a kipan a hong pai ahi hiam;
Zion apan in aw Na panpih na,
Hongtung ahi zaw hi.
Na simthuphate Na hon musak a,
Manpha hina e, thupi hina e;
Mimawl a ding in pilna ahi a,
Hon tawisangtu ahi.
Na hon khotuah daan thupi hina e,
Loubang na khualna kan in a sang ngei;
Gamkeu leh haksatna ah hilou in,
Vualjawlna ah No'n pi.

Tu in Toupa hon muta'ng,
Min dang zong nawn kei ning;
Nangma' angsung ah ka teng ding,
Na itna tuisuahgiat ah.
Ka Mang hi chia hon mu ning e,
Hon mu ning e, ka Mang na hi;
Aw, Na hon itdan ka theih in,
Na thuak hi, Kalvari ah.
Aw, Na thuakna Kalvari,
Don ning e, simlei ah,
Itna vang in mel in mu ning,
Aw, ni sang' Na vakzaw hi.
Mipi leh lei lunmangte'n,
Simmoh in kimvel uh;
Nang zaw gentheite Toupa kia,
Kei din Na hun hi, Toupa.
Na pianna leimun niampen,
Na phamna luguh mun;
Na gentheihna paibang kop ning,
Aw nunnuam ning Nang vang in.

Tuin a thak kiitna vak nuam ah,
I Toupa mun thupi;
Nunnopna silpak lun e tua mun ah,
Sawlbang heu nawnlou ding.
Nunnuam in denchiang kikhawm ve ni,
Tung thangvan angel lungtuakte tawh;
Lungkhamna gam a i mauna teng,
I Toupa mai' pahna la hi ding.
Ka damlai sunni lenkil kiak mateng,
Kei din meipi a jing;
Denchiang a tua gam tuang ka tun chiang in,

Toupa, Nang toh lut thei ning.

Na moh puakgik pan na suakta nuam hiam?
Hihtheihna sisan, sisan ah om;
Khelhna tunga zohna neih na ut hiam?
Hatna lamdang sisan ah om.
Thilhihtheihna lamdang a om hi,
Belamnou sisan ah;
Thilhihtheihna lamdang a om hi,
Belamnou sisan manpha ah.
Hehna kisathei na taisan nuam hiam?
Hihtheihna sisan, sisan ah om;
Sianna di’n Kalvari tuinak juan in,
Hatna lamdang sisan ah om.
Vuk sanga ngouzaw a ngou na ut hiam?
Hihtheihna sisan, sisan ah om;
Tua hinna tui luangin mohna sawpsiang,
Hatna lamdang sisan ah om.
Na kumpipa Jesu na na sem diam?
Hihtheihna sisan, sisan ah om;
Niteng A phatna la sa’n na om diam?
Hatna lamdang sisan ah om.

Hinna tanghou balkham in Toupa it,
Tuipi geia tanghou,Na balkhap bang,
Na laipek siang lam ah, kon zong Toupa,
Ka kha Nang ngaiin mau Hinna thu aw.
Thutak kei di’n vualjawl in Toupa it,
Galili a tanghou, Na vualjawl bang,
Huan saltanna bei ding; henkol ke ding,
Huan muanna muta ning ka bangkim teng.
Hinna tanghou na hi, kei di’n Toupa,
Na Thutak siangthou in, kei hon hondam,
Nek ding hon pia’n tunglam, Nang toh teng di’n,
Thutak it di’n honhilh’n Itna Na hi.

Hondampa belampu bang’n honpi’n,
Honpi’n Na kep ngai ung;
Loupa hoih mun ah hon vak in,
Kou di’n belam huang bawl in.
:$: Nuamsa Jesu, Nuamsa Jesu,
Non leita, Nanga hi ung.
D.S.
Nang a hi ung hon lawmbawl in,
Ka lampi chingtu hong hi’n;
Na gante khelhna pan hum in,
Ka vakmang chian hon zong in.
:$: Nuamsa Jesu, Nuamsa Jesu,
Ka thum chiangin hon dawng in.
D.S.
Kon na pom ding chi’n non chiam a,
Khial genthei himahle ung;
Hon dawnzang ding zahngaihna nei,
Hehpihna leh hatna zong.
:$: Nuamsa Jesu, Nuamsa Jesu,
Nangmah lam hon juanpah nung.
D.S.
Na deihsakna hon zongpah nung,
Na deihna bang semta nung;
Toupa leh Hondampa omsun,
Na itna in ka lung dim.
:$: Nuamsa Jesu, Nuamsa Jesu,
Non it hi, Non it lailai.
D.S.

Banghang Pathian in hehpihna,
Hon theisak hiam thei keng;
Banghang kei it taaklou Kris in,
Amah’ dia hong tan hiam?
Ahihhang ka Ginpa ka thei hi,
Ken ka thei zou hi; Aman a kem thei;
Amah’ kiang ka piak, ka kepsak,
Tua ni dong in kem ding hi.
Bangchidan a, Kha in mikhial,
Hon zou hiam ka thei kei;
A thuin Jesu hon theisak,
Amah ging di’n hon bawl.
Kei dia hoih leh hoihlou thei keng,
A hon hawisak teng teng;
Lam haksa leh nihoihte ah,
A mel ka muh ma in.
Chikchia’n ka Toupa hongpai ding,
Zan hiam, sun hiam thei keng;
Amah toh guam kan a paiin,
Huihkhua ah ka tuak ding.
Hiai ginna in hon hondam ding,
Chih A hon hilh thei ing;
A thu ginga i zuih a leh,
Lungsung ah muanna pia.

Ka thumna uh lohchingsakpa,
Lungmuanna kon ngen uh;
Lungkham in liangvai mahle ung,
Aw Toupa, hon nial ken.
Nangmah banga om nuam ung e,
Nang kou hon Itpa aw;
Ka pil zohlouh chiang un leng Nang,
Aw Toupa, hon nial ken.
Na deih bangin om nuam ung e,
Mikhial ka hih man un;
Nangmah kiang a hong pai dingin,
Aw Toupa, hon nial ken.
Ka vengte leh ka sungte’n leng,
Hon deih kei mahle uh;
Lawmte’n hon paisan mahle uh,
Aw Toupa, hon nial ken.
Hiai leitung a  nong kumsuk in,
Singdawn ah Na si a;
Thangvan ah kou di’n non thumsak,
Aw Toupa, hon nial ken.
Saptuamte kianga om dingin,
Vanglian leh zahtakhuai;
Meipi toh Nong kumsuk chiangin,
Aw Toupa, hon nial ken.

Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou,
Toupa Pathian Hat;
Jingkhang in ka la uh,
Na kiang’h hong tung ding a;
Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou,
Hehpihsiam, Vanglianpen,
Pathian a Mithum, Thum nuamsate aw!
Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou,
Misiangthoute’n honbia,
A manglukhu jem uh-
Tuipi siang kim a koih in;
Cherubim leh Seraph,
Na ma ah khukdin uh,
Omkhin, omlel leh omgige ding Pa.
Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou,
Mial in Nang honliah zong;
Mikhialte mit in Na-
Thupina hon mukei zong,
Nangkia siangthou Na hi,
Nanglou kuadang omlou,
Hatna, Itna leh Sianthouna bukim.
Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou,
Toupa Pathian Hat;
Lei leh van tuipi tung’h-
Na siamte’n Na min phat hen;
Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou,
Hehpihsiam, Vanglianpen,
Pathian a Mithum, Thum nuamsate aw!

Niteng in na hoih ka sem ding,
Panpih ngaite panpih jel in;’
Leia damsung tomchik kia hi,
Ka theihtawpin na hoih sem ning.
Damsung beikuan, ni tum hiaihiai,
Ni tamlou nungchiah ka pai ding;
Ka nasepsate tuak dingin,
Ni tumlouhna tua mun nuam ah.
Niteng a Pathian ta hidi’n,
Lam tawntung in ka vak taang ding;
Amah phatla sa tawntung ning,
Kha mangthangte ka panpih ding.
Leia damsung manpha i chih,
Itna leh hoih leh siangthou hi;
Pathian adi’n ka dingkip ding,
Niteng panpihna khut zak ning.
Panpihngaite ka panpih ding,
Khawllou in ka pai jel dinga;
Damlou, tagah leh hatloute,
Itna thu in ka nem ding hi.
Damsung tawlna lampi zuih lai
Jingzinte puakgik ka dawn ding;
Zan mialte sun vak suaksak in,
Lawmtawn in pak ka paksak ding.

Toupa keia hi zumpih keng,
Amah’ dinga pan leng;
A thu zahtaka kem hoih in,
A kros vangletna toh.
Kros phung ah, Kros phung ah
Vak ka mu masapen,
Ka lungsim gitlouh van-gik puak tukmang;
Tua ah ginna in, mit vakna ka mu,
Tu’n zaw sunkhua in ka kipak hi.
Toupa Pathian a min ka thei,
A min kia ka muang hi,
Ka lamet leh laukha muanna,
Hon selphou lou ding hi.
A mangtutphah bang a kip in,
A thuchiam a kemzou;
A khut a ka kepsak teng zong,
Thukhenna hun tanpha’n.
Ka min thulimlou a gum ding,
A pa mai ma ngei ah;
Huan van Jerusalem thak ah,
Omna ding honpe ding.

Tua lui gal ah i kituak diam?
Tui kihawt daihna mun ah;
Tua bangteng vak tawntungna ah,
Kha lungkham omlouhna ah.
I kituak khawm na diam,
Tua lui gal ah i kituak diam?
Tua lui gal ah i kituak diam?
Tui kihawt daihna mun ah.
Luipang nuam ah i kituak diam?
I zinna a bei chiangin,
Kituak in i khawlkhawm na diam?
Thangvan luipang vak nuam ah.
Tua khopi ah i kituak diam?
Innsang vak sitsetna ah,
A baangte suang zetuam a bawl,
Pathian khutsiamna a lam.
I Hondampa Kris i tuak diam?
A mite la dia hong chian,
Hon deihsakna hoih i thei diam;
A mangtutphah i ngah diam?

I kimuh nawn mateng Pathian in,
A khotuah siamna’n hon veng hen;
A belam bittak’n hon huai hen,
I kimuh nawn ma’n Hon ompih hen.
I kimuh nawn mateng,
Jesu kiang i kimuh ma’n;
I kimuh nawn mateng,
I kimuh nawn ma’n Hon ompih hen.
I kimuh nawn mateng Pathian in,
A khanuai bittak’ hon sel hen;
Niteng Manna honpe lai hen,
I kimuh nawn ma’n Hon ompih hen.
I kimuh nawn mateng Pathian in,
Damsung lauhuai in hon bawm chian;
A angsung bit ah hon pom hen,
I kimuh nawn ma’n Hon ompih hen.
I kimuh nawn mateng Pathian in,
Itna kha na tunga zakin;
Sihna lauhuai hon zoh sak hen,
I kimuh nawn ma’n Hon ompih hen.

Tuni’n ka kha ah sunni tang,
Vakna thupi ahi;
Leitung nisanga vakpha zaw,
Jesu ka vakna hi.
Aw sunni tang, sunni tang nuam,
Muanna leh kipahna hunte liam;
Jesu’n a nuihmel honlah chian,
Ka kha ah sunni tang hi.
Tuni’n ka kha ah zaila ging,
Ka kumpipa phatna;
Jesu’n ngaikhia in zaza hi,
Ka sakkhiak theih louh zong.
Tuni’n ka kha ah nahnoulai,
Toupa hongnai ziakin;
Muanna khuva ka lung ah ham,
Zahngaihna pak hong lang.
Tuni’n ka kha kipakin om,
Lamet phatna, itna;
Tua vualjawlna kei honpiak toh,
Vanah pahna koihlai.

Hondampa aw in “Hong in” chi,
A sihna sing kros kimu hi;
Tu’n leng kros phung ah mun omlai,
Tuzan in Jesu kiang non juan diam?
Tuzan in Jesu kiang non juan diam?
Tuzan in Jesu kiang non juan diam?
Mouneipa leh Kha in hon chial,
Tuzan in Jesu kiang non juan diam?
I pa aw in hon chial chial hi,
Zahngaihna sangtawp lamdang in;
A itna luang honsapna ah,
Tuzan in Jesu kiang non juan diam?
It leh ngaihte’n hon na ngetsak,
Na lungin adik uh na thei;
Ut ve, hunte pai hulhul veh!
Tuzan in Jesu kiang non juan diam?
I lawm it paisate aw in,
Vak gam a pan hong gingkhia in;
Aw nem in gen tuantuan uhi,
Tuzan in Jesu kiang non juan diam?
Aw, kuahiam thudik jui nuam ding?
Miteng hiai aw in chial vek hi;
Kuan dawng ding, unau na dawng diam?
Tuzan in Jesu kiang non juan diam?

Kristian itna lungsim,
A i kigakkhawm nuam;
Lungkituakte kipawlkhawmna,
Vanlam omdan ahi.
I Pa tutphah ma ah,
I thumnate pia hang;
I lauh, i tup, i lamet khat,
Nopsak, awlmoh kibang.
Dahna kithuakpih in,
Puakgik i kidawn chiat;
A kallak chiangin lainatna,
Khitui i kiluan chiat.
Gibang i kikhen chian,
Lungsim sung hon dahsak;
Hizong lungsim kizom gige’n
Kimuh nawn lamen hang.
Hiai kinepna thupi’n,
Lampi ah hon halhsak;
Lamen chiata i hin sungin,
Ni thupi ngaklah hang.
Lungkham, sepgim, natna,
Khelhna pan i suakta;
Itna bukim, kipawlkhawmna,
Tangtawn in omta hen.

Thukhah zuih ding ka nei,
Pahtawi ding Pathian khat;
A si ngeilou kha hotdam ding,
Van tungsak ngei dingin.
Toupa na sem jel ding,
Hon sapna tangtun ding;
Ka Heutupa deihlam sem di’n,
Ka hatna teng pia ning.
Kiging leh thum dingin,
Nangmah muang hon panpi’n;
Ka muanna kon zuausan aleh,
Tangtawn a si ding hi’ng.

Damsung huihpi ah na long a kip diam,
Meipi kai in buaina kha honzak chian?
Tui kihawt hat a, long khau kikan chian,
Na sikkip a tolh diam, akip ding hiam?
I kha bitna ding sikkip i nei,
Tui kihawt lauhuai a kip, muanhuai;
Lingvuallou Suangpi a khihkip hi,
Hondampa itna a thukpi a phum.
Bittak a kaih hi, huihpi nangzou ding,
Hondampa khut a hoihtak khihkip hi;
Longkhau di’n Amah’ lungsim kei hon guan,
Pathian hatna’n huihpi hat douzou ni.
Sihna tuikhang lian a leng muanhuai hi,
A tuivot in hat tawpna khingsak zong;
Tuikhang lian ah leng tan ngeingeilou ding,
Lametna Amah a nga in om le’ng.
Huai zan kikhopna mun mit a mu in,
Long khawlna ding sana khopi i juan;
Van luipiau ah i kinga pahta ding,
Huihpi lauhuai tuangnung i siahsan ding.
Lauhuaina hawkguam kal ah zong muanhuai,
Tui kihawt in suangphum guk om hon hilh;
Tui kihawt mau in huih hat hong nung zong,
Tui kihawt in i long hon tumlou ding.
